text:
[Ang 1 | Raag: Jap | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirbhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibhan gur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. The Name Is Truth. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying, Beyond Birth, Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace ~

Gurbani: ॥ ਜਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: | jap |
English: Chant And Meditate:

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਸਚੁ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਸਚੁ ॥
Transliteration: aad sach jugaad sach |
English: True In The Primal Beginning. True Throughout The Ages.

Gurbani: ਹੈ ਭੀ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹੋਸੀ ਭੀ ਸਚੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: hai bhee sach naanak hosee bhee sach |1|
English: True Here And Now. O Nanak, Forever And Ever True. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੋਚੈ ਸੋਚਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜੇ ਸੋਚੀ ਲਖ ਵਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: sochai soch na hovee je sochee lakh vaar |
English: By thinking, He cannot be reduced to thought, even by thinking hundreds of thousands of times.

Gurbani: ਚੁਪੈ ਚੁਪ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜੇ ਲਾਇ ਰਹਾ ਲਿਵ ਤਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: chupai chup na hovee je laae rahaa liv taar |
English: By remaining silent, inner silence is not obtained, even by remaining lovingly absorbed deep within.

Gurbani: ਭੁਖਿਆ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਉਤਰੀ ਜੇ ਬੰਨਾ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਭਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: bhukhiaa bhukh na utaree je banaa pureea bhaar |
English: The hunger of the hungry is not appeased, even by piling up loads of worldly goods.

Gurbani: ਸਹਸ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਲਖ ਹੋਹਿ ਤ ਇਕ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: sehas siaanapaa lakh hohi ta ik na chalai naal |
English: Hundreds of thousands of clever tricks, but not even one of them will go along with you in the end.

Gurbani: ਕਿਵ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ਹੋਈਐ ਕਿਵ ਕੂੜੈ ਤੁਟੈ ਪਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: kiv sachiaaraa hoeeai kiv koorrai tuttai paal |
English: So how can you become truthful? And how can the veil of illusion be torn away?

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਜਾਈ ਚਲਣਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: hukam rajaaee chalanaa naanak likhiaa naal |1|
English: O Nanak, it is written that you shall obey the Hukam of His Command, and walk in the Way of His Will. ||1||

[Ang 1 | Raag: Jap | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਆਕਾਰ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਕਹਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: hukamee hovan aakaar hukam na kahiaa jaaee |
English: By His Command, bodies are created; His Command cannot be described.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਜੀਅ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: hukamee hovan jeea hukam milai vaddiaaee |
English: By His Command, souls come into being; by His Command, glory and greatness are obtained.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਉਤਮੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: hukamee utam neech hukam likh dukh sukh paaeeeh |
English: By His Command, some are high and some are low; by His Written Command, pain and pleasure are obtained.

Gurbani: ਇਕਨਾ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਬਖਸੀਸ ਇਕਿ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸਦਾ ਭਵਾਈਅਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: eikanaa hukamee bakhasees ik hukamee sadaa bhavaaeeeh |
English: Some, by His Command, are blessed and forgiven; others, by His Command, wander aimlessly forever.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਹੁਕਮ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: hukamai andar sabh ko baahar hukam na koe |
English: Everyone is subject to His Command; no one is beyond His Command.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਜੇ ਬੁਝੈ ਤ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak hukamai je bujhai ta haumai kahai na koe |2|
English: O Nanak, one who understands His Command, does not speak in ego. ||2||

[Ang 1 | Raag: Jap | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਤਾਣੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਿਸੈ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: gaavai ko taan hovai kisai taan |
English: Some sing of His Power-who has that Power?

Gurbani: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: gaavai ko daat jaanai neesaan |
English: Some sing of His Gifts, and know His Sign and Insignia.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਗੁਣ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਚਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: gaavai ko gun vaddiaaeea chaar |
English: Some sing of His Glorious Virtues, Greatness and Beauty.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਵਿਦਿਆ ਵਿਖਮੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: gaavai ko vidiaa vikham veechaar |
English: Some sing of knowledge obtained of Him, through difficult philosophical studies.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਸਾਜਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਨੁ ਖੇਹ ॥
Transliteration: gaavai ko saaj kare tan kheh |
English: Some sing that He fashions the body, and then again reduces it to dust.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਜੀਅ ਲੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੇਹ ॥
Transliteration: gaavai ko jeea lai fir deh |
English: Some sing that He takes life away, and then again restores it.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਜਾਪੈ ਦਿਸੈ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: gaavai ko jaapai disai door |
English: Some sing that He seems so very far away.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਵੇਖੈ ਹਾਦਰਾ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: gaavai ko vekhai haadaraa hadoor |
English: Some sing that He watches over us, face to face, ever-present.

Gurbani: ਕਥਨਾ ਕਥੀ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਤੋਟਿ ॥
Transliteration: kathanaa kathee na aavai tott |
English: There is no shortage of those who preach and teach.

Gurbani: ਕਥਿ ਕਥਿ ਕਥੀ ਕੋਟੀ ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ॥
Transliteration: kath kath kathee kottee kott kott |
English: Millions upon millions offer millions of sermons and stories.

Gurbani: ਦੇਦਾ ਦੇ ਲੈਦੇ ਥਕਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: dedaa de laide thak paeh |
English: The Great Giver keeps on giving, while those who receive grow weary of receiving.

Gurbani: ਜੁਗਾ ਜੁਗੰਤਰਿ ਖਾਹੀ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jugaa jugantar khaahee khaeh |
English: Throughout the ages, consumers consume.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚਲਾਏ ਰਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: hukamee hukam chalaae raahu |
English: The Commander, by His Command, leads us to walk on the Path.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak vigasai veparavaahu |3|
English: O Nanak, He blossoms forth, Carefree and Untroubled. ||3||

[Ang 2 | Raag: Jap | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਇ ਭਾਖਿਆ ਭਾਉ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: saachaa saahib saach naae bhaakhiaa bhaau apaar |
English: True is the Master, True is His Name-speak it with infinite love.

Gurbani: ਆਖਹਿ ਮੰਗਹਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: aakheh mangeh dehi dehi daat kare daataar |
English: People beg and pray, "Give to us, give to us", and the Great Giver gives His Gifts.

Gurbani: ਫੇਰਿ ਕਿ ਅਗੈ ਰਖੀਐ ਜਿਤੁ ਦਿਸੈ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: fer ki agai rakheeai jit disai darabaar |
English: So what offering can we place before Him, by which we might see the Darbaar of His Court?

Gurbani: ਮੁਹੌ ਕਿ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਬੋਲੀਐ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: muhau ki bolan boleeai jit sun dhare piaar |
English: What words can we speak to evoke His Love?

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵੇਲਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: amrit velaa sach naau vaddiaaee veechaar |
English: In the Amrit Vaylaa, the ambrosial hours before dawn, chant the True Name, and contemplate His Glorious Greatness.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮੀ ਆਵੈ ਕਪੜਾ ਨਦਰੀ ਮੋਖੁ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: karamee aavai kaparraa nadaree mokh duaar |
English: By the karma of past actions, the robe of this physical body is obtained. By His Grace, the Gate of Liberation is found.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਵੈ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak evai jaaneeai sabh aape sachiaar |4|
English: O Nanak, know this well: the True One Himself is All. ||4||

[Ang 2 | Raag: Jap | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਥਾਪਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਕੀਤਾ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: thaapiaa na jaae keetaa na hoe |
English: He cannot be established, He cannot be created.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aape aap niranjan soe |
English: He Himself is Immaculate and Pure.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: jin seviaa tin paaeaa maan |
English: Those who serve Him are honored.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਾਵੀਐ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak gaaveeai gunee nidhaan |
English: O Nanak, sing of the Lord, the Treasure of Excellence.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵੀਐ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਮਨਿ ਰਖੀਐ ਭਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gaaveeai suneeai man rakheeai bhaau |
English: Sing, and listen, and let your mind be filled with love.

Gurbani: ਦੁਖੁ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਘਰਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: dukh parahar sukh ghar lai jaae |
English: Your pain shall be sent far away, and peace shall come to your home.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਦੰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੇਦੰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh naadan guramukh vedan guramukh rahiaa samaaee |
English: The Guru's Word is the Sound-current of the Naad; the Guru's Word is the Wisdom of the Vedas; the Guru's Word is all-pervading.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਈਸਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਰਖੁ ਬਰਮਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬਤੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur eesar gur gorakh baramaa gur paarabatee maaee |
English: The Guru is Shiva, the Guru is Vishnu and Brahma; the Guru is Paarvati and Lakhshmi.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਹਉ ਜਾਣਾ ਆਖਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: je hau jaanaa aakhaa naahee kahanaa kathan na jaaee |
English: Even knowing God, I cannot describe Him; He cannot be described in words.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਾ ਇਕ ਦੇਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: guraa ik dehi bujhaaee |
English: The Guru has given me this one understanding:

Gurbani: ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਇਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਮੈ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: sabhanaa jeea kaa ik daataa so mai visar na jaaee |5|
English: there is only the One, the Giver of all souls. May I never forget Him! ||5||

[Ang 2 | Raag: Jap | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵਾ ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵਾ ਵਿਣੁ ਭਾਣੇ ਕਿ ਨਾਇ ਕਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: teerath naavaa je tis bhaavaa vin bhaane ki naae karee |
English: If I am pleasing to Him, then that is my pilgrimage and cleansing bath. Without pleasing Him, what good are ritual cleansings?

Gurbani: ਜੇਤੀ ਸਿਰਠਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਵੇਖਾ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਲਈ ॥
Transliteration: jetee siratth upaaee vekhaa vin karamaa ki milai lee |
English: I gaze upon all the created beings: without the karma of good actions, what are they given to receive?

Gurbani: ਮਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਤਨ ਜਵਾਹਰ ਮਾਣਿਕ ਜੇ ਇਕ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: mat vich ratan javaahar maanik je ik gur kee sikh sunee |
English: Within the mind are gems, jewels and rubies, if you listen to the Guru's Teachings, even once.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਾ ਇਕ ਦੇਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: guraa ik dehi bujhaaee |
English: The Guru has given me this one understanding:

Gurbani: ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਇਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਮੈ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: sabhanaa jeea kaa ik daataa so mai visar na jaaee |6|
English: there is only the One, the Giver of all souls. May I never forget Him! ||6||

[Ang 2 | Raag: Jap | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜੇ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਆਰਜਾ ਹੋਰ ਦਸੂਣੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: je jug chaare aarajaa hor dasoonee hoe |
English: Even if you could live throughout the four ages, or even ten times more,

Gurbani: ਨਵਾ ਖੰਡਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਨਾਲਿ ਚਲੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: navaa khanddaa vich jaaneeai naal chalai sabh koe |
English: and even if you were known throughout the nine continents and followed by all,

Gurbani: ਚੰਗਾ ਨਾਉ ਰਖਾਇ ਕੈ ਜਸੁ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਜਗਿ ਲੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: changaa naau rakhaae kai jas keerat jag lee |
English: with a good name and reputation, with praise and fame throughout the world-

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਤ ਵਾਤ ਨ ਪੁਛੈ ਕੇ ॥
Transliteration: je tis nadar na aavee ta vaat na puchhai ke |
English: still, if the Lord does not bless you with His Glance of Grace, then who cares? What is the use?

Gurbani: ਕੀਟਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕੀਟੁ ਕਰਿ ਦੋਸੀ ਦੋਸੁ ਧਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: keettaa andar keett kar dosee dos dhare |
English: Among worms, you would be considered a lowly worm, and even contemptible sinners would hold you in contempt.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਗੁਣਿ ਗੁਣੁ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਣਵੰਤਿਆ ਗੁਣੁ ਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak niragun gun kare gunavantiaa gun de |
English: O Nanak, God blesses the unworthy with virtue, and bestows virtue on the virtuous.

Gurbani: ਤੇਹਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਜਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਣੁ ਕੋਇ ਕਰੇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: tehaa koe na sujhee ji tis gun koe kare |7|
English: No one can even imagine anyone who can bestow virtue upon Him. ||7||

[Ang 2 | Raag: Jap | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਸਿਧ ਪੀਰ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਾਥ ॥
Transliteration: suniai sidh peer sur naath |
English: Listening-the Siddhas, the spiritual teachers, the heroic warriors, the yogic masters.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਧਰਤਿ ਧਵਲ ਆਕਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: suniai dharat dhaval aakaas |
English: Listening-the earth, its support and the Akaashic ethers.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਦੀਪ ਲੋਅ ਪਾਤਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: suniai deep loa paataal |
English: Listening-the oceans, the lands of the world and the nether regions of the underworld.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਪੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: suniai pohi na sakai kaal |
English: Listening-Death cannot even touch you.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਵਿਗਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak bhagataa sadaa vigaas |
English: O Nanak, the devotees are forever in bliss.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਦੂਖ ਪਾਪ ਕਾ ਨਾਸੁ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: suniai dookh paap kaa naas |8|
English: Listening-pain and sin are erased. ||8||

[Ang 2 | Raag: Jap | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਈਸਰੁ ਬਰਮਾ ਇੰਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: suniai eesar baramaa ind |
English: Listening-Shiva, Brahma and Indra.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਲਾਹਣ ਮੰਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: suniai mukh saalaahan mand |
English: Listening-even foul-mouthed people praise Him.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਤਨਿ ਭੇਦ ॥
Transliteration: suniai jog jugat tan bhed |
English: Listening-the technology of Yoga and the secrets of the body.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਸਾਸਤ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਵੇਦ ॥
Transliteration: suniai saasat simrit ved |
English: Listening-the Shaastras, the Simritees and the Vedas.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਵਿਗਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak bhagataa sadaa vigaas |
English: O Nanak, the devotees are forever in bliss.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਦੂਖ ਪਾਪ ਕਾ ਨਾਸੁ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: suniai dookh paap kaa naas |9|
English: Listening-pain and sin are erased. ||9||

[Ang 3 | Raag: Jap | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: suniai sat santokh giaan |
English: Listening-truth, contentment and spiritual wisdom.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਕਾ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: suniai atthasatth kaa isanaan |
English: Listening-take your cleansing bath at the sixty-eight places of pilgrimage.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥

English: Listening-reading and reciting, honor is obtained.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: suniai laagai sehaj dhiaan |

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਵਿਗਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak bhagataa sadaa vigaas |

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਦੂਖ ਪਾਪ ਕਾ ਨਾਸੁ ॥੧੦॥

English: Listening-dive deep into the ocean of virtue.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਸੇਖ ਪੀਰ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ॥

English: Listening-the Shaykhs, religious scholars, spiritual teachers and emperors.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਹਾਥ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਸਗਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: suniai haath hovai asagaahu |
English: Listening-the Unreachable comes within your grasp.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਵਿਗਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak bhagataa sadaa vigaas |
English: O Nanak, the devotees are forever in bliss.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਦੂਖ ਪਾਪ ਕਾ ਨਾਸੁ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: suniai dookh paap kaa naas |11|
English: Listening-pain and sin are erased. ||11||

[Ang 3 | Raag: Jap | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮੰਨੇ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: mane kee gat kahee na jaae |
English: The state of the faithful cannot be described.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਪਿਛੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥

English: One who tries to describe this shall regret the attempt.

English: No paper, no pen, no scribe

Gurbani: ਮੰਨੇ ਕਾ ਬਹਿ ਕਰਨਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: mane kaa beh karan veechaar |
English: can record the state of the faithful.

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa naam niranjan hoe |
English: Such is the Name of the Immaculate Lord.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਕੋਇ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: je ko man jaanai man koe |12|
English: Only one who has faith comes to know such a state of mind. ||12||

[Ang 3 | Raag: Jap | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮੰਨੈ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਬੁਧਿ ॥
Transliteration: manai surat hovai man budh |
English: The faithful have intuitive awareness and intelligence.

Transliteration: manai jam kai saath na jaae |

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa naam niranjan hoe |
English: Such is the Name of the Immaculate Lord.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਕੋਇ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: je ko man jaanai man koe |13|
English: Only one who has faith comes to know such a state of mind. ||13||

[Ang 3 | Raag: Jap | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮੰਨੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਠਾਕ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: manai maarag tthaak na paae |
English: The path of the faithful shall never be blocked.

Gurbani: ਮੰਨੈ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: manai pat siau paragatt jaae |
English: The faithful shall depart with honor and fame.

Gurbani: ਮੰਨੈ ਮਗੁ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਪੰਥੁ ॥
Transliteration: manai mag na chalai panth |

Gurbani: ਮੰਨੈ ਧਰਮ ਸੇਤੀ ਸਨਬੰਧੁ ॥

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa naam niranjan hoe |
English: Such is the Name of the Immaculate Lord.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਕੋਇ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: je ko man jaanai man koe |14|
English: Only one who has faith comes to know such a state of mind. ||14||

[Ang 3 | Raag: Jap | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮੰਨੈ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮੋਖੁ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: manai paaveh mokh duaar |
English: The faithful find the Door of Liberation.

Gurbani: ਮੰਨੈ ਪਰਵਾਰੈ ਸਾਧਾਰੁ ॥

Gurbani: ਮੰਨੈ ਤਰੈ ਤਾਰੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ॥

Transliteration: manai naanak bhaveh na bhikh |
English: The faithful, O Nanak, do not wander around begging.

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa naam niranjan hoe |
English: Such is the Name of the Immaculate Lord.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਕੋਇ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: je ko man jaanai man koe |15|
English: Only one who has faith comes to know such a state of mind. ||15||

Transliteration: panch paravaan panch paradhaan |
English: The chosen ones, the self-elect, are accepted and approved.

Gurbani: ਪੰਚੇ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: panche paaveh darageh maan |
English: The chosen ones are honored in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਪੰਚੇ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਦਰਿ ਰਾਜਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: panche soheh dar raajaan |
English: The chosen ones look beautiful in the courts of kings.

Gurbani: ਪੰਚਾ ਕਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: panchaa kaa gur ek dhiaan |
English: The chosen ones meditate single-mindedly on the Guru.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਕਰੈ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: je ko kahai karai veechaar |
English: No matter how much anyone tries to explain and describe them,

Gurbani: ਕਰਤੇ ਕੈ ਕਰਣੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: karate kai karanai naahee sumaar |
English: the actions of the Creator cannot be counted.

Gurbani: ਧੌਲੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਾ ਪੂਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: dhaual dharam deaa kaa poot |
English: The mythical bull is Dharma, the son of compassion;

Gurbani: ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਥਾਪਿ ਰਖਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਸੂਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: santokh thaap rakhiaa jin soot |
English: this is what patiently holds the earth in its place.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਬੁਝੈ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: je ko bujhai hovai sachiaar |
English: One who understands this becomes truthful.

Gurbani: ਧਵਲੈ ਉਪਰਿ ਕੇਤਾ ਭਾਰੁ ॥

Gurbani: ਧਰਤੀ ਹੋਰੁ ਪਰੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਹੋਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: dharatee hor parai hor hor |
English: So many worlds beyond this world-so very many!

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਭਾਰੁ ਤਲੈ ਕਵਣੁ ਜੋਰੁ ॥

Gurbani: ਸਭਨਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਵੁੜੀ ਕਲਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sabhanaa likhiaa vurree kalaam |
English: were all inscribed by the Ever-flowing Pen of God.

Gurbani: ਏਹੁ ਲੇਖਾ ਲਿਖਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: ehu lekhaa likh jaanai koe |
English: Who knows how to write this account?

Gurbani: ਲੇਖਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕੇਤਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: lekhaa likhiaa ketaa hoe |
English: Just imagine what a huge scroll it would take!

Gurbani: ਕੇਤਾ ਤਾਣੁ ਸੁਆਲਿਹੁ ਰੂਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: ketaa taan suaalihu roop |
English: What power! What fascinating beauty!

Gurbani: ਕੇਤੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੌਣੁ ਕੂਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: ketee daat jaanai kauan koot |
English: And what gifts! Who can know their extent?

Gurbani: ਕੀਤਾ ਪਸਾਉ ਏਕੋ ਕਵਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: keetaa pasaau eko kavaau |
English: You created the vast expanse of the Universe with One Word!

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਹੋਏ ਲਖ ਦਰੀਆਉ ॥
Transliteration: tis te hoe lakh dareeaau |
English: Hundreds of thousands of rivers began to flow.

Gurbani: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਵਣ ਕਹਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: kudarat kavan kahaa veechaar |
English: How can Your Creative Potency be described?

Gurbani: ਵਾਰਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਵਾ ਏਕ ਵਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: vaariaa na jaavaa ek vaar |
English: I cannot even once be a sacrifice to You.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਈ ਭਲੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai saaee bhalee kaar |
English: Whatever pleases You is the only good done,

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥੧੬॥

Transliteration: asankh poojaa asankh tap taau |

Gurbani: ਅਸੰਖ ਗਰੰਥ ਮੁਖਿ ਵੇਦ ਪਾਠ ॥
Transliteration: asankh garanth mukh ved paatth |
English: Countless scriptures, and ritual recitations of the Vedas.

Gurbani: ਅਸੰਖ ਜੋਗ ਮਨਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਉਦਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: asankh jog man raheh udaas |

Gurbani: ਅਸੰਖ ਭਗਤ ਗੁਣ ਗਿਆਨ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: asankh bhagat gun giaan veechaar |
English: Countless devotees contemplate the Wisdom and Virtues of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਸੰਖ ਸਤੀ ਅਸੰਖ ਦਾਤਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: asankh satee asankh daataar |
English: Countless the holy, countless the givers.

Gurbani: ਅਸੰਖ ਸੂਰ ਮੁਹ ਭਖ ਸਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: asankh soor muh bhakh saar |
English: Countless heroic spiritual warriors, who bear the brunt of the attack in battle (who with their mouths eat steel).

Gurbani: ਅਸੰਖ ਮੋਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ਤਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: asankh mon liv laae taar |
English: Countless silent sages, vibrating the String of His Love.

Gurbani: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਵਣ ਕਹਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: kudarat kavan kahaa veechaar |
English: How can Your Creative Potency be described?

Gurbani: ਵਾਰਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਵਾ ਏਕ ਵਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: vaariaa na jaavaa ek vaar |
English: I cannot even once be a sacrifice to You.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਈ ਭਲੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai saaee bhalee kaar |
English: Whatever pleases You is the only good done,

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥੧੭॥

Gurbani: ਅਸੰਖ ਮੂਰਖ ਅੰਧ ਘੋਰ ॥
Transliteration: asankh moorakh andh ghor |
English: Countless fools, blinded by ignorance.

Gurbani: ਅਸੰਖ ਚੋਰ ਹਰਾਮਖੋਰ ॥
Transliteration: asankh chor haraamakhor |

Transliteration: asankh amar kar jaeh jor |
English: Countless impose their will by force.

Gurbani: ਅਸੰਖ ਗਲਵਢ ਹਤਿਆ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: asankh galavadt hatiaa kamaeh |
English: Countless cut-throats and ruthless killers.

Gurbani: ਅਸੰਖ ਪਾਪੀ ਪਾਪੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥

English: Countless sinners who keep on sinning.

Gurbani: ਅਸੰਖ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਕੂੜੇ ਫਿਰਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: asankh koorriaar koorre firaeh |
English: Countless liars, wandering lost in their lies.

Gurbani: ਅਸੰਖ ਮਲੇਛ ਮਲੁ ਭਖਿ ਖਾਹਿ ॥

English: Countless wretches, eating filth as their ration.

Gurbani: ਅਸੰਖ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਭਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: asankh nindak sir kareh bhaar |
English: Countless slanderers, carrying the weight of their stupid mistakes on their heads.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥

Gurbani: ਵਾਰਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਵਾ ਏਕ ਵਾਰ ॥

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਈ ਭਲੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai saaee bhalee kaar |
English: Whatever pleases You is the only good done,

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: too sadaa salaamat nirankaar |18|
English: You, Eternal and Formless One. ||18||

[Ang 4 | Raag: Jap | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਅਸੰਖ ਨਾਵ ਅਸੰਖ ਥਾਵ ॥
Transliteration: asankh naav asankh thaav |
English: Countless names, countless places.

Gurbani: ਅਗੰਮ ਅਗੰਮ ਅਸੰਖ ਲੋਅ ॥

English: Inaccessible, unapproachable, countless celestial realms.

Gurbani: ਅਸੰਖ ਕਹਹਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: asankh kaheh sir bhaar hoe |
English: Even to call them countless is to carry the weight on your head.

Gurbani: ਅਖਰੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਖਰੀ ਸਾਲਾਹ ॥
Transliteration: akharee naam akharee saalaah |
English: From the Word, comes the Naam; from the Word, comes Your Praise.

Gurbani: ਅਖਰੀ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਗੀਤ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹ ॥
Transliteration: akharee giaan geet gun gaah |
English: From the Word, comes spiritual wisdom, singing the Songs of Your Glory.

Gurbani: ਅਖਰੀ ਲਿਖਣੁ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਬਾਣਿ ॥
Transliteration: akharee likhan bolan baan |
English: From the Word, come the written and spoken words and hymns.

Gurbani: ਅਖਰਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਵਖਾਣਿ ॥
Transliteration: akharaa sir sanjog vakhaan |
English: From the Word, comes destiny, written on one's forehead.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹਿ ਲਿਖੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jin ehi likhe tis sir naeh |
English: But the One who wrote these Words of Destiny-no words are written on His Forehead.

Gurbani: ਜਿਵ ਫੁਰਮਾਏ ਤਿਵ ਤਿਵ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jiv furamaae tiv tiv paeh |
English: As He ordains, so do we receive.

Gurbani: ਜੇਤਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਤੇਤਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jetaa keetaa tetaa naau |
English: The created universe is the manifestation of Your Name.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਥਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: vin naavai naahee ko thaau |
English: Without Your Name, there is no place at all.

Gurbani: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਵਣ ਕਹਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: kudarat kavan kahaa veechaar |
English: How can I describe Your Creative Power?

Gurbani: ਵਾਰਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਵਾ ਏਕ ਵਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: vaariaa na jaavaa ek vaar |
English: I cannot even once be a sacrifice to You.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਈ ਭਲੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai saaee bhalee kaar |
English: Whatever pleases You is the only good done,

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: too sadaa salaamat nirankaar |19|
English: You, Eternal and Formless One. ||19||

[Ang 4 | Raag: Jap | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਭਰੀਐ ਹਥੁ ਪੈਰੁ ਤਨੁ ਦੇਹ ॥
Transliteration: bhareeai hath pair tan deh |
English: When the hands and the feet and the body are dirty,

Gurbani: ਪਾਣੀ ਧੋਤੈ ਉਤਰਸੁ ਖੇਹ ॥
Transliteration: paanee dhotai utaras kheh |
English: water can wash away the dirt.

Gurbani: ਮੂਤ ਪਲੀਤੀ ਕਪੜੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: moot paleetee kaparr hoe |
English: When the clothes are soiled and stained by urine,

Gurbani: ਦੇ ਸਾਬੂਣੁ ਲਈਐ ਓਹੁ ਧੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: de saaboon leeai ohu dhoe |
English: soap can wash them clean.

Gurbani: ਭਰੀਐ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਪਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: bhareeai mat paapaa kai sang |
English: But when the intellect is stained and polluted by sin,

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਧੋਪੈ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: ohu dhopai naavai kai rang |
English: it can only be cleansed by the Love of the Name.

Gurbani: ਪੁੰਨੀ ਪਾਪੀ ਆਖਣੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: punee paapee aakhan naeh |
English: Virtue and vice do not come by mere words;

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਣਾ ਲਿਖਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: kar kar karanaa likh lai jaahu |
English: actions repeated, over and over again, are engraved on the soul.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਬੀਜਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਖਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape beej aape hee khaahu |
English: You shall harvest what you plant.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਆਵਹੁ ਜਾਹੁ ॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: naanak hukamee aavahu jaahu |20|
English: O Nanak, by the Hukam of God's Command, we come and go in reincarnation. ||20||

[Ang 4 | Raag: Jap | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਤੀਰਥੁ ਤਪੁ ਦਇਆ ਦਤੁ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: teerath tap deaa dat daan |
English: Pilgrimages, austere discipline, compassion and charity

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਪਾਵੈ ਤਿਲ ਕਾ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: je ko paavai til kaa maan |
English: these, by themselves, bring only an iota of merit.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿਆ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: suniaa maniaa man keetaa bhaau |
English: Listening and believing with love and humility in your mind,

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਗਤਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਮਲਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: antaragat teerath mal naau |
English: cleanse yourself with the Name, at the sacred shrine deep within.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabh gun tere mai naahee koe |
English: All virtues are Yours, Lord, I have none at all.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਣ ਕੀਤੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: vin gun keete bhagat na hoe |
English: Without virtue, there is no devotional worship.

Gurbani: ਸੁਅਸਤਿ ਆਥਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਬਰਮਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: suasat aath baanee baramaau |
English: I bow to the Lord of the World, to His Word, to Brahma the Creator.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਣੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sat suhaan sadaa man chaau |
English: He is Beautiful, True and Eternally Joyful.

Gurbani: ਕਵਣੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਵਖਤੁ ਕਵਣੁ ਕਵਣ ਥਿਤਿ ਕਵਣੁ ਵਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: kavan su velaa vakhat kavan kavan thit kavan vaar |
English: What was that time, and what was that moment? What was that day, and what was that date?

Gurbani: ਕਵਣਿ ਸਿ ਰੁਤੀ ਮਾਹੁ ਕਵਣੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਹੋਆ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: kavan si rutee maahu kavan jit hoaa aakaar |
English: What was that season, and what was that month, when the Universe was created?

Gurbani: ਵੇਲ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ਪੰਡਤੀ ਜਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲੇਖੁ ਪੁਰਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: vel na paaeea panddatee ji hovai lekh puraan |
English: The Pandits, the religious scholars, cannot find that time, even if it is written in the Puraanas.

Gurbani: ਵਖਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਕਾਦੀਆ ਜਿ ਲਿਖਨਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਕੁਰਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: vakhat na paaeo kaadeea ji likhan lekh kuraan |
English: That time is not known to the Qazis, who study the Koran.

Gurbani: ਥਿਤਿ ਵਾਰੁ ਨਾ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਾਣੈ ਰੁਤਿ ਮਾਹੁ ਨਾ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: thit vaar naa jogee jaanai rut maahu naa koee |
English: The day and the date are not known to the Yogis, nor is the month or the season.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਿਰਠੀ ਕਉ ਸਾਜੇ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jaa karataa siratthee kau saaje aape jaanai soee |
English: The Creator who created this creation-only He Himself knows.

Gurbani: ਕਿਵ ਕਰਿ ਆਖਾ ਕਿਵ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਕਿਉ ਵਰਨੀ ਕਿਵ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: kiv kar aakhaa kiv saalaahee kiau varanee kiv jaanaa |
English: How can we speak of Him? How can we praise Him? How can we describe Him? How can we know Him?

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਖਣਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਆਖੈ ਇਕ ਦੂ ਇਕੁ ਸਿਆਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: naanak aakhan sabh ko aakhai ik doo ik siaanaa |
English: O Nanak, everyone speaks of Him, each one wiser than the rest.

Gurbani: ਵਡਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਵਡੀ ਨਾਈ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: vaddaa saahib vaddee naaee keetaa jaa kaa hovai |
English: Great is the Master, Great is His Name. Whatever happens is according to His Will.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਆਪੌ ਜਾਣੈ ਅਗੈ ਗਇਆ ਨ ਸੋਹੈ ॥੨੧॥
Transliteration: naanak je ko aapau jaanai agai geaa na sohai |21|
English: O Nanak, one who claims to know everything shall not be decorated in the world hereafter. ||21||

[Ang 5 | Raag: Jap | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਾਤਾਲਾ ਪਾਤਾਲ ਲਖ ਆਗਾਸਾ ਆਗਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: paataalaa paataal lakh aagaasaa aagaas |
English: There are nether worlds beneath nether worlds, and hundreds of thousands of heavenly worlds above.

Gurbani: ਓੜਕ ਓੜਕ ਭਾਲਿ ਥਕੇ ਵੇਦ ਕਹਨਿ ਇਕ ਵਾਤ ॥
Transliteration: orrak orrak bhaal thake ved kehan ik vaat |
English: The Vedas say that you can search and search for them all, until you grow weary.

Gurbani: ਸਹਸ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਕਹਨਿ ਕਤੇਬਾ ਅਸੁਲੂ ਇਕੁ ਧਾਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: sehas atthaarah kehan katebaa asuloo ik dhaat |
English: The scriptures say that there are 18,000 worlds, but in reality, there is only One Universe.

Gurbani: ਲੇਖਾ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਲਿਖੀਐ ਲੇਖੈ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: lekhaa hoe ta likheeai lekhai hoe vinaas |
English: If you try to write an account of this, you will surely finish yourself before you finish writing it.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਡਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪੁ ॥੨੨॥
Transliteration: naanak vaddaa aakheeai aape jaanai aap |22|
English: O Nanak, call Him Great! He Himself knows Himself. ||22||

[Ang 5 | Raag: Jap | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਏਤੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: saalaahee saalaeh etee surat na paaeea |
English: The praisers praise the Lord, but they do not obtain intuitive understanding

Gurbani: ਨਦੀਆ ਅਤੈ ਵਾਹ ਪਵਹਿ ਸਮੁੰਦਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: nadeea atai vaah paveh samund na jaaneeeh |
English: the streams and rivers flowing into the ocean do not know its vastness.

Gurbani: ਸਮੁੰਦ ਸਾਹ ਸੁਲਤਾਨ ਗਿਰਹਾ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਾਲੁ ਧਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: samund saah sulataan girahaa setee maal dhan |
English: Even kings and emperors, with mountains of property and oceans of wealth

Gurbani: ਕੀੜੀ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਨੀ ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰਹਿ ॥੨੩॥
Transliteration: keerree tul na hovanee je tis manahu na veesareh |23|
English: -these are not even equal to an ant, who does not forget God. ||23||

[Ang 5 | Raag: Jap | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਕਹਣਿ ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: ant na sifatee kehan na ant |
English: Endless are His Praises, endless are those who speak them.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਕਰਣੈ ਦੇਣਿ ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: ant na karanai den na ant |
English: Endless are His Actions, endless are His Gifts.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਵੇਖਣਿ ਸੁਣਣਿ ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: ant na vekhan sunan na ant |
English: Endless is His Vision, endless is His Hearing.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ਕਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਮੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: ant na jaapai kiaa man mant |
English: His limits cannot be perceived. What is the Mystery of His Mind?

Gurbani: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ਕੀਤਾ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: ant na jaapai keetaa aakaar |
English: The limits of the created universe cannot be perceived.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: ant na jaapai paaraavaar |
English: Its limits here and beyond cannot be perceived.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਬਿਲਲਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: ant kaaran kete bilalaeh |
English: Many struggle to know His limits,

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਅੰਤ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: taa ke ant na paae jaeh |
English: but His limits cannot be found.

Gurbani: ਏਹੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: ehu ant na jaanai koe |
English: No one can know these limits.

Gurbani: ਬਹੁਤਾ ਕਹੀਐ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bahutaa kaheeai bahutaa hoe |
English: The more you say about them, the more there still remains to be said.

Gurbani: ਵਡਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਊਚਾ ਥਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: vaddaa saahib aoochaa thaau |
English: Great is the Master, High is His Heavenly Home.

Gurbani: ਊਚੇ ਉਪਰਿ ਊਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aooche upar aoochaa naau |
English: Highest of the High, above all is His Name.

Gurbani: ਏਵਡੁ ਊਚਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: evadd aoochaa hovai koe |
English: Only one as Great and as High as God

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਊਚੇ ਕਉ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: tis aooche kau jaanai soe |
English: can know His Lofty and Exalted State.

Gurbani: ਜੇਵਡੁ ਆਪਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: jevadd aap jaanai aap aap |
English: Only He Himself is that Great. He Himself knows Himself.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਕਰਮੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥੨੪॥
Transliteration: naanak nadaree karamee daat |24|
English: O Nanak, by His Glance of Grace, He bestows His Blessings. ||24||

[Ang 5 | Raag: Jap | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਹੁਤਾ ਕਰਮੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਨਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bahutaa karam likhiaa naa jaae |
English: His Blessings are so abundant that there can be no written account of them.

Gurbani: ਵਡਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: vaddaa daataa til na tamaae |
English: The Great Giver does not hold back anything.

Gurbani: ਕੇਤੇ ਮੰਗਹਿ ਜੋਧ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: kete mangeh jodh apaar |
English: There are so many great, heroic warriors begging at the Door of the Infinite Lord.

Gurbani: ਕੇਤਿਆ ਗਣਤ ਨਹੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: ketiaa ganat nahee veechaar |
English: So many contemplate and dwell upon Him, that they cannot be counted.

Gurbani: ਕੇਤੇ ਖਪਿ ਤੁਟਹਿ ਵੇਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: kete khap tutteh vekaar |
English: So many waste away to death engaged in corruption.

Gurbani: ਕੇਤੇ ਲੈ ਲੈ ਮੁਕਰੁ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: kete lai lai mukar paeh |
English: So many take and take again, and then deny receiving.

Gurbani: ਕੇਤੇ ਮੂਰਖ ਖਾਹੀ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: kete moorakh khaahee khaeh |
English: So many foolish consumers keep on consuming.

Gurbani: ਕੇਤਿਆ ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਸਦ ਮਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: ketiaa dookh bhookh sad maar |
English: So many endure distress, deprivation and constant abuse.

Gurbani: ਏਹਿ ਭਿ ਦਾਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਤਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: ehi bhi daat teree daataar |
English: Even these are Your Gifts, O Great Giver!

Gurbani: ਬੰਦਿ ਖਲਾਸੀ ਭਾਣੈ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: band khalaasee bhaanai hoe |
English: Liberation from bondage comes only by Your Will.

Gurbani: ਹੋਰੁ ਆਖਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: hor aakh na sakai koe |
English: No one else has any say in this.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਖਾਇਕੁ ਆਖਣਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: je ko khaaeik aakhan paae |
English: If some fool should presume to say that he does,

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੇਤੀਆ ਮੁਹਿ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: ohu jaanai jeteea muhi khaae |
English: he shall learn, and feel the effects of his folly.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: aape jaanai aape dee |
English: He Himself knows, He Himself gives.

Gurbani: ਆਖਹਿ ਸਿ ਭਿ ਕੇਈ ਕੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: aakheh si bhi keee kee |
English: Few, very few are those who acknowledge this.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਖਸੇ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਾਲਾਹ ॥
Transliteration: jis no bakhase sifat saalaah |
English: One who is blessed to sing the Praises of the Lord,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ॥੨੫॥
Transliteration: naanak paatisaahee paatisaahu |25|
English: O Nanak, is the king of kings. ||25||

[Ang 5 | Raag: Jap | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਅਮੁਲ ਗੁਣ ਅਮੁਲ ਵਾਪਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: amul gun amul vaapaar |
English: Priceless are His Virtues, Priceless are His Dealings.

Gurbani: ਅਮੁਲ ਵਾਪਾਰੀਏ ਅਮੁਲ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: amul vaapaaree amul bhanddaar |
English: Priceless are His Dealers, Priceless are His Treasures.

Gurbani: ਅਮੁਲ ਆਵਹਿ ਅਮੁਲ ਲੈ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: amul aaveh amul lai jaeh |
English: Priceless are those who come to Him, Priceless are those who buy from Him.

Gurbani: ਅਮੁਲ ਭਾਇ ਅਮੁਲਾ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: amul bhaae amulaa samaeh |
English: Priceless is Love for Him, Priceless is absorption into Him.

Gurbani: ਅਮੁਲੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਅਮੁਲੁ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: amul dharam amul deebaan |
English: Priceless is the Divine Law of Dharma, Priceless is the Divine Court of Justice.

Gurbani: ਅਮੁਲੁ ਤੁਲੁ ਅਮੁਲੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: amul tul amul paravaan |
English: Priceless are the scales, priceless are the weights.

Gurbani: ਅਮੁਲੁ ਬਖਸੀਸ ਅਮੁਲੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: amul bakhasees amul neesaan |
English: Priceless are His Blessings, Priceless is His Banner and Insignia.

Gurbani: ਅਮੁਲੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਅਮੁਲੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: amul karam amul furamaan |
English: Priceless is His Mercy, Priceless is His Royal Command.

Gurbani: ਅਮੁਲੋ ਅਮੁਲੁ ਆਖਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: amulo amul aakhiaa na jaae |
English: Priceless, O Priceless beyond expression!

Gurbani: ਆਖਿ ਆਖਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aakh aakh rahe liv laae |
English: Speak of Him continually, and remain absorbed in His Love.

Gurbani: ਆਖਹਿ ਵੇਦ ਪਾਠ ਪੁਰਾਣ ॥
Transliteration: aakheh ved paatth puraan |
English: The Vedas and the Puraanas speak.

Gurbani: ਆਖਹਿ ਪੜੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਖਿਆਣ ॥
Transliteration: aakheh parre kareh vakhiaan |
English: The scholars speak and lecture.

Gurbani: ਆਖਹਿ ਬਰਮੇ ਆਖਹਿ ਇੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: aakheh barame aakheh ind |
English: Brahma speaks, Indra speaks.

Gurbani: ਆਖਹਿ ਗੋਪੀ ਤੈ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: aakheh gopee tai govind |
English: The Gopis and Krishna speak.

Gurbani: ਆਖਹਿ ਈਸਰ ਆਖਹਿ ਸਿਧ ॥
Transliteration: aakheh eesar aakheh sidh |
English: Shiva speaks, the Siddhas speak.

Gurbani: ਆਖਹਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਕੀਤੇ ਬੁਧ ॥
Transliteration: aakheh kete keete budh |
English: The many created Buddhas speak.

Gurbani: ਆਖਹਿ ਦਾਨਵ ਆਖਹਿ ਦੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: aakheh daanav aakheh dev |
English: The demons speak, the demi-gods speak.

Gurbani: ਆਖਹਿ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: aakheh sur nar mun jan sev |
English: The spiritual warriors, the heavenly beings, the silent sages, the humble and serviceful speak.

Gurbani: ਕੇਤੇ ਆਖਹਿ ਆਖਣਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: kete aakheh aakhan paeh |
English: Many speak and try to describe Him.

Gurbani: ਕੇਤੇ ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਉਠਿ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: kete keh keh utth utth jaeh |
English: Many have spoken of Him over and over again, and have then arisen and departed.

Gurbani: ਏਤੇ ਕੀਤੇ ਹੋਰਿ ਕਰੇਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: ete keete hor karehi |
English: If He were to create as many again as there already are,

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਆਖਿ ਨ ਸਕਹਿ ਕੇਈ ਕੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: taa aakh na sakeh keee kee |
English: even then, they could not describe Him.

Gurbani: ਜੇਵਡੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੇਵਡੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jevadd bhaavai tevadd hoe |
English: He is as Great as He wishes to be.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak jaanai saachaa soe |
English: O Nanak, the True Lord knows.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਆਖੈ ਬੋਲੁਵਿਗਾੜੁ ॥
Transliteration: je ko aakhai boluvigaarr |
English: If anyone presumes to describe God,

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਲਿਖੀਐ ਸਿਰਿ ਗਾਵਾਰਾ ਗਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੨੬॥
Transliteration: taa likheeai sir gaavaaraa gaavaar |26|
English: he shall be known as the greatest fool of fools! ||26||

[Ang 6 | Raag: Jap | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਬਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: so dar kehaa so ghar kehaa jit beh sarab samaale |
English: Where is that Gate, and where is that Dwelling, in which You sit and take care of all?

Gurbani: ਵਾਜੇ ਨਾਦ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਸੰਖਾ ਕੇਤੇ ਵਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: vaaje naad anek asankhaa kete vaavanahaare |
English: The Sound-current of the Naad vibrates there, and countless musicians play on all sorts of instruments there.

Gurbani: ਕੇਤੇ ਰਾਗ ਪਰੀ ਸਿਉ ਕਹੀਅਨਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਗਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kete raag paree siau kaheean kete gaavanahaare |
English: So many Ragas, so many musicians singing there.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਤੁਹਨੋ ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਰਾਜਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gaaveh tuhano paun paanee baisantar gaavai raajaa dharam duaare |
English: The praanic wind, water and fire sing; the Righteous Judge of Dharma sings at Your Door.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਲਿਖਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਧਰਮੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gaaveh chit gupat likh jaaneh likh likh dharam veechaare |
English: Chitr and Gupt, the angels of the conscious and the subconscious who record actions, and the Righteous Judge of Dharma who judges this record sing.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਈਸਰੁ ਬਰਮਾ ਦੇਵੀ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gaaveh eesar baramaa devee sohan sadaa savaare |
English: Shiva, Brahma and the Goddess of Beauty, ever adorned, sing.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਇੰਦ ਇਦਾਸਣਿ ਬੈਠੇ ਦੇਵਤਿਆ ਦਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: gaaveh ind idaasan baitthe devatiaa dar naale |
English: Indra, seated upon His Throne, sings with the deities at Your Door.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਸਾਧ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gaaveh sidh samaadhee andar gaavan saadh vichaare |
English: The Siddhas in Samaadhi sing; the Saadhus sing in contemplation.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਵੀਰ ਕਰਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gaavan jatee satee santokhee gaaveh veer karaare |
English: The celibates, the fanatics, the peacefully accepting and the fearless warriors sing.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਨਿ ਰਖੀਸਰ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਵੇਦਾ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: gaavan panddit parran rakheesar jug jug vedaa naale |
English: The Pandits, the religious scholars who recite the Vedas, with the supreme sages of all the ages, sing.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਮੋਹਣੀਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਨਿ ਸੁਰਗਾ ਮਛ ਪਇਆਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: gaaveh mohaneea man mohan suragaa machh peaale |
English: The Mohinis, the enchanting heavenly beauties who entice hearts in this world, in paradise, and in the underworld of the subconscious sing.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਰਤਨ ਉਪਾਏ ਤੇਰੇ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: gaavan ratan upaae tere atthasatth teerath naale |
English: The celestial jewels created by You, and the sixty-eight holy places of pilgrimage sing.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਜੋਧ ਮਹਾਬਲ ਸੂਰਾ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਖਾਣੀ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gaaveh jodh mahaabal sooraa gaaveh khaanee chaare |
English: The brave and mighty warriors sing; the spiritual heroes and the four sources of creation sing.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ ਵਰਭੰਡਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਖੇ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gaaveh khandd manddal varabhanddaa kar kar rakhe dhaare |
English: The planets, solar systems and galaxies, created and arranged by Your Hand, sing.

Gurbani: ਸੇਈ ਤੁਧੁਨੋ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਨਿ ਰਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਰਸਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: seee tudhuno gaaveh jo tudh bhaavan rate tere bhagat rasaale |
English: They alone sing, who are pleasing to Your Will. Your devotees are imbued with the Nectar of Your Essence.

Gurbani: ਹੋਰਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਸੇ ਮੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਨਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਿਆ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: hor kete gaavan se mai chit na aavan naanak kiaa veechaare |
English: So many others sing, they do not come to mind. O Nanak, how can I consider them all?

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: soee soee sadaa sach saahib saachaa saachee naaee |
English: That True Lord is True, Forever True, and True is His Name.

Gurbani: ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਜਾਸੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: hai bhee hosee jaae na jaasee rachanaa jin rachaaee |
English: He is, and shall always be. He shall not depart, even when this Universe which He has created departs.

Gurbani: ਰੰਗੀ ਰੰਗੀ ਭਾਤੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਿਨਸੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: rangee rangee bhaatee kar kar jinasee maaeaa jin upaaee |
English: He created the world, with its various colors, species of beings, and the variety of Maya.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਕੀਤਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਿਵ ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: kar kar vekhai keetaa aapanaa jiv tis dee vaddiaaee |
English: Having created the creation, He watches over it Himself, by His Greatness.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਸੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jo tis bhaavai soee karasee hukam na karanaa jaaee |
English: He does whatever He pleases. No order can be issued to Him.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਹਣੁ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੨੭॥
Transliteration: so paatisaahu saahaa paatisaahib naanak rehan rajaaee |27|
English: He is the King, the King of kings, the Supreme Lord and Master of kings. Nanak remains subject to His Will. ||27||

[Ang 6 | Raag: Jap | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮੁੰਦਾ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸਰਮੁ ਪਤੁ ਝੋਲੀ ਧਿਆਨ ਕੀ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਿਭੂਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: mundaa santokh saram pat jholee dhiaan kee kareh bibhoot |
English: Make contentment your ear-rings, humility your begging bowl, and meditation the ashes you apply to your body.

Gurbani: ਖਿੰਥਾ ਕਾਲੁ ਕੁਆਰੀ ਕਾਇਆ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਡੰਡਾ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: khinthaa kaal kuaaree kaaeaa jugat ddanddaa parateet |
English: Let the remembrance of death be the patched coat you wear, let the purity of virginity be your way in the world, and let faith in the Lord be your walking stick.

Gurbani: ਆਈ ਪੰਥੀ ਸਗਲ ਜਮਾਤੀ ਮਨਿ ਜੀਤੈ ਜਗੁ ਜੀਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: aaee panthee sagal jamaatee man jeetai jag jeet |
English: See the brotherhood of all mankind as the highest order of Yogis; conquer your own mind, and conquer the world.

Gurbani: ਆਦੇਸੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਆਦੇਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: aades tisai aades |
English: I bow to Him, I humbly bow.

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਅਨੀਲੁ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਅਨਾਹਤਿ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਸੁ ॥੨੮॥
Transliteration: aad aneel anaad anaahat jug jug eko ves |28|
English: The Primal One, the Pure Light, without beginning, without end. Throughout all the ages, He is One and the Same. ||28||

[Ang 6 | Raag: Jap | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਭੁਗਤਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਦਇਆ ਭੰਡਾਰਣਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਵਾਜਹਿ ਨਾਦ ॥
Transliteration: bhugat giaan deaa bhanddaaran ghatt ghatt vaajeh naad |
English: Let spiritual wisdom be your food, and compassion your attendant. The Sound-current of the Naad vibrates in each and every heart.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਨਾਥੁ ਨਾਥੀ ਸਭ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਅਵਰਾ ਸਾਦ ॥
Transliteration: aap naath naathee sabh jaa kee ridh sidh avaraa saad |
English: He Himself is the Supreme Master of all; wealth and miraculous spiritual powers, and all other external tastes and pleasures, are all like beads on a string.

Gurbani: ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਦੁਇ ਕਾਰ ਚਲਾਵਹਿ ਲੇਖੇ ਆਵਹਿ ਭਾਗ ॥
Transliteration: sanjog vijog due kaar chalaaveh lekhe aaveh bhaag |
English: Union with Him, and separation from Him, come by His Will. We come to receive what is written in our destiny.

Gurbani: ਆਦੇਸੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਆਦੇਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: aades tisai aades |
English: I bow to Him, I humbly bow.

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਅਨੀਲੁ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਅਨਾਹਤਿ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਸੁ ॥੨੯॥
Transliteration: aad aneel anaad anaahat jug jug eko ves |29|
English: The Primal One, the Pure Light, without beginning, without end. Throughout all the ages, He is One and the Same. ||29||

[Ang 7 | Raag: Jap | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਏਕਾ ਮਾਈ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਵਿਆਈ ਤਿਨਿ ਚੇਲੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: ekaa maaee jugat viaaee tin chele paravaan |
English: The One Divine Mother conceived and gave birth to the three deities.

Gurbani: ਇਕੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ਇਕੁ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ ਇਕੁ ਲਾਏ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: eik sansaaree ik bhanddaaree ik laae deebaan |
English: One, the Creator of the World; One, the Sustainer; and One, the Destroyer.

Gurbani: ਜਿਵ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਵੈ ਜਿਵ ਹੋਵੈ ਫੁਰਮਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: jiv tis bhaavai tivai chalaavai jiv hovai furamaan |
English: He makes things happen according to the Pleasure of His Will. Such is His Celestial Order.

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਵੇਖੈ ਓਨਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਏਹੁ ਵਿਡਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: ohu vekhai onaa nadar na aavai bahutaa ehu viddaan |
English: He watches over all, but none see Him. How wonderful this is!

Gurbani: ਆਦੇਸੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਆਦੇਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: aades tisai aades |
English: I bow to Him, I humbly bow.

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਅਨੀਲੁ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਅਨਾਹਤਿ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਸੁ ॥੩੦॥
Transliteration: aad aneel anaad anaahat jug jug eko ves |30|
English: The Primal One, the Pure Light, without beginning, without end. Throughout all the ages, He is One and the Same. ||30||

[Ang 7 | Raag: Jap | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਣੁ ਲੋਇ ਲੋਇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: aasan loe loe bhanddaar |
English: On world after world are His Seats of Authority and His Storehouses.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁ ਏਕਾ ਵਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: jo kichh paaeaa su ekaa vaar |
English: Whatever was put into them, was put there once and for all.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: kar kar vekhai sirajanahaar |
English: Having created the creation, the Creator Lord watches over it.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਸਾਚੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: naanak sache kee saachee kaar |
English: O Nanak, True is the Creation of the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਦੇਸੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਆਦੇਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: aades tisai aades |
English: I bow to Him, I humbly bow.

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਅਨੀਲੁ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਅਨਾਹਤਿ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਸੁ ॥੩੧॥
Transliteration: aad aneel anaad anaahat jug jug eko ves |31|
English: The Primal One, the Pure Light, without beginning, without end. Throughout all the ages, He is One and the Same. ||31||

[Ang 7 | Raag: Jap | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਇਕ ਦੂ ਜੀਭੌ ਲਖ ਹੋਹਿ ਲਖ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਲਖ ਵੀਸ ॥
Transliteration: eik doo jeebhau lakh hohi lakh hoveh lakh vees |
English: If I had 100,000 tongues, and these were then multiplied twenty times more, with each tongue,

Gurbani: ਲਖੁ ਲਖੁ ਗੇੜਾ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਗਦੀਸ ॥
Transliteration: lakh lakh gerraa aakheeeh ek naam jagadees |
English: I would repeat, hundreds of thousands of times, the Name of the One, the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਏਤੁ ਰਾਹਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਵੜੀਆ ਚੜੀਐ ਹੋਇ ਇਕੀਸ ॥
Transliteration: et raeh pat pavarreea charreeai hoe ikees |
English: Along this path to our Husband Lord, we climb the steps of the ladder, and come to merge with Him.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਗਲਾ ਆਕਾਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਟਾ ਆਈ ਰੀਸ ॥
Transliteration: sun galaa aakaas kee keettaa aaee rees |
English: Hearing of the etheric realms, even worms long to come back home.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਕੂੜੀ ਕੂੜੈ ਠੀਸ ॥੩੨॥
Transliteration: naanak nadaree paaeeai koorree koorrai tthees |32|
English: O Nanak, by His Grace He is obtained. False are the boastings of the false. ||32||

[Ang 7 | Raag: Jap | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਖਣਿ ਜੋਰੁ ਚੁਪੈ ਨਹ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: aakhan jor chupai neh jor |
English: No power to speak, no power to keep silent.

Gurbani: ਜੋਰੁ ਨ ਮੰਗਣਿ ਦੇਣਿ ਨ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jor na mangan den na jor |
English: No power to beg, no power to give.

Gurbani: ਜੋਰੁ ਨ ਜੀਵਣਿ ਮਰਣਿ ਨਹ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jor na jeevan maran neh jor |
English: No power to live, no power to die.

Gurbani: ਜੋਰੁ ਨ ਰਾਜਿ ਮਾਲਿ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jor na raaj maal man sor |
English: No power to rule, with wealth and occult mental powers.

Gurbani: ਜੋਰੁ ਨ ਸੁਰਤੀ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jor na suratee giaan veechaar |
English: No power to gain intuitive understanding, spiritual wisdom and meditation.

Gurbani: ਜੋਰੁ ਨ ਜੁਗਤੀ ਛੁਟੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jor na jugatee chhuttai sansaar |
English: No power to find the way to escape from the world.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਹਥਿ ਜੋਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jis hath jor kar vekhai soe |
English: He alone has the Power in His Hands. He watches over all.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਤਮੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੩੩॥
Transliteration: naanak utam neech na koe |33|
English: O Nanak, no one is high or low. ||33||

[Ang 7 | Raag: Jap | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਤੀ ਰੁਤੀ ਥਿਤੀ ਵਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: raatee rutee thitee vaar |
English: Nights, days, weeks and seasons;

Gurbani: ਪਵਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਅਗਨੀ ਪਾਤਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: pavan paanee aganee paataal |
English: wind, water, fire and the nether regions

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਥਾਪਿ ਰਖੀ ਧਰਮ ਸਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: tis vich dharatee thaap rakhee dharam saal |
English: in the midst of these, He established the earth as a home for Dharma.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੀਅ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਕੇ ਰੰਗ ॥
Transliteration: tis vich jeea jugat ke rang |
English: Upon it, He placed the various species of beings.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਨੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: tin ke naam anek anant |
English: Their names are uncounted and endless.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮੀ ਕਰਮੀ ਹੋਇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: karamee karamee hoe veechaar |
English: By their deeds and their actions, they shall be judged.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਆਪਿ ਸਚਾ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa aap sachaa darabaar |
English: God Himself is True, and True is His Court.

Gurbani: ਤਿਥੈ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਪੰਚ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: tithai sohan panch paravaan |
English: There, in perfect grace and ease, sit the self-elect, the self-realized Saints.

Gurbani: ਨਦਰੀ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਵੈ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: nadaree karam pavai neesaan |
English: They receive the Mark of Grace from the Merciful Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਚ ਪਕਾਈ ਓਥੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kach pakaaee othai paae |
English: The ripe and the unripe, the good and the bad, shall there be judged.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਇਆ ਜਾਪੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੩੪॥
Transliteration: naanak geaa jaapai jaae |34|
English: O Nanak, when you go home, you will see this. ||34||

[Ang 7 | Raag: Jap | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਰਮ ਖੰਡ ਕਾ ਏਹੋ ਧਰਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: dharam khandd kaa eho dharam |
English: This is righteous living in the realm of Dharma.

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨ ਖੰਡ ਕਾ ਆਖਹੁ ਕਰਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: giaan khandd kaa aakhahu karam |
English: And now we speak of the realm of spiritual wisdom.

Gurbani: ਕੇਤੇ ਪਵਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਵੈਸੰਤਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਕਾਨ ਮਹੇਸ ॥
Transliteration: kete pavan paanee vaisantar kete kaan mahes |
English: So many winds, waters and fires; so many Krishnas and Shivas.

Gurbani: ਕੇਤੇ ਬਰਮੇ ਘਾੜਤਿ ਘੜੀਅਹਿ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਕੇ ਵੇਸ ॥
Transliteration: kete barame ghaarrat gharreeeh roop rang ke ves |
English: So many Brahmas, fashioning forms of great beauty, adorned and dressed in many colors.

Gurbani: ਕੇਤੀਆ ਕਰਮ ਭੂਮੀ ਮੇਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਧੂ ਉਪਦੇਸ ॥
Transliteration: keteea karam bhoomee mer kete kete dhoo upades |
English: So many worlds and lands for working out karma. So very many lessons to be learned!

Gurbani: ਕੇਤੇ ਇੰਦ ਚੰਦ ਸੂਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਮੰਡਲ ਦੇਸ ॥
Transliteration: kete ind chand soor kete kete manddal des |
English: So many Indras, so many moons and suns, so many worlds and lands.

Gurbani: ਕੇਤੇ ਸਿਧ ਬੁਧ ਨਾਥ ਕੇਤੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਦੇਵੀ ਵੇਸ ॥
Transliteration: kete sidh budh naath kete kete devee ves |
English: So many Siddhas and Buddhas, so many Yogic masters. So many goddesses of various kinds.

Gurbani: ਕੇਤੇ ਦੇਵ ਦਾਨਵ ਮੁਨਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਰਤਨ ਸਮੁੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: kete dev daanav mun kete kete ratan samund |
English: So many demi-gods and demons, so many silent sages. So many oceans of jewels.

Gurbani: ਕੇਤੀਆ ਖਾਣੀ ਕੇਤੀਆ ਬਾਣੀ ਕੇਤੇ ਪਾਤ ਨਰਿੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: keteea khaanee keteea baanee kete paat narind |
English: So many ways of life, so many languages. So many dynasties of rulers.

Gurbani: ਕੇਤੀਆ ਸੁਰਤੀ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੇਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ॥੩੫॥
Transliteration: keteea suratee sevak kete naanak ant na ant |35|
English: So many intuitive people, so many selfless servants. O Nanak, His limit has no limit! ||35||

[Ang 7 | Raag: Jap | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨ ਖੰਡ ਮਹਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਰਚੰਡੁ ॥
Transliteration: giaan khandd meh giaan parachandd |
English: In the realm of wisdom, spiritual wisdom reigns supreme.

Gurbani: ਤਿਥੈ ਨਾਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਕੋਡ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: tithai naad binod kodd anand |
English: The Sound-current of the Naad vibrates there, amidst the sounds and the sights of bliss.

Gurbani: ਸਰਮ ਖੰਡ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਰੂਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: saram khandd kee baanee roop |
English: In the realm of humility, the Word is Beauty.

Gurbani: ਤਿਥੈ ਘਾੜਤਿ ਘੜੀਐ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਨੂਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: tithai ghaarrat gharreeai bahut anoop |
English: Forms of incomparable beauty are fashioned there.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੀਆ ਗਲਾ ਕਥੀਆ ਨਾ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: taa keea galaa katheea naa jaeh |
English: These things cannot be described.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਪਿਛੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: je ko kahai pichhai pachhutaae |
English: One who tries to speak of these shall regret the attempt.

Gurbani: ਤਿਥੈ ਘੜੀਐ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਬੁਧਿ ॥
Transliteration: tithai gharreeai surat mat man budh |
English: The intuitive consciousness, intellect and understanding of the mind are shaped there.

Gurbani: ਤਿਥੈ ਘੜੀਐ ਸੁਰਾ ਸਿਧਾ ਕੀ ਸੁਧਿ ॥੩੬॥
Transliteration: tithai gharreeai suraa sidhaa kee sudh |36|
English: The consciousness of the spiritual warriors and the Siddhas, the beings of spiritual perfection, are shaped there. ||36||

[Ang 8 | Raag: Jap | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਕਰਮ ਖੰਡ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: karam khandd kee baanee jor |
English: In the realm of karma, the Word is Power.

Gurbani: ਤਿਥੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਹੋਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: tithai hor na koee hor |
English: No one else dwells there,

Gurbani: ਤਿਥੈ ਜੋਧ ਮਹਾਬਲ ਸੂਰ ॥
Transliteration: tithai jodh mahaabal soor |
English: except the warriors of great power, the spiritual heroes.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰ ॥
Transliteration: tin meh raam rahiaa bharapoor |
English: They are totally fulfilled, imbued with the Lord's Essence.

Gurbani: ਤਿਥੈ ਸੀਤੋ ਸੀਤਾ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: tithai seeto seetaa mahimaa maeh |
English: Myriads of Sitas are there, cool and calm in their majestic glory.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਰੂਪ ਨ ਕਥਨੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: taa ke roop na kathane jaeh |
English: Their beauty cannot be described.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਓਹਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਨ ਠਾਗੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: naa ohi mareh na tthaage jaeh |
English: Neither death nor deception comes to those,

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jin kai raam vasai man maeh |
English: within whose minds the Lord abides.

Gurbani: ਤਿਥੈ ਭਗਤ ਵਸਹਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਅ ॥
Transliteration: tithai bhagat vaseh ke loa |
English: The devotees of many worlds dwell there.

Gurbani: ਕਰਹਿ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਸਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: kareh anand sachaa man soe |
English: They celebrate; their minds are imbued with the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਚ ਖੰਡਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sach khandd vasai nirankaar |
English: In the realm of Truth, the Formless Lord abides.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: kar kar vekhai nadar nihaal |
English: Having created the creation, He watches over it. By His Glance of Grace, He bestows happiness.

Gurbani: ਤਿਥੈ ਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ ਵਰਭੰਡ ॥
Transliteration: tithai khandd manddal varabhandd |
English: There are planets, solar systems and galaxies.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਥੈ ਤ ਅੰਤ ਨ ਅੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: je ko kathai ta ant na ant |
English: If one speaks of them, there is no limit, no end.

Gurbani: ਤਿਥੈ ਲੋਅ ਲੋਅ ਆਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: tithai loa loa aakaar |
English: There are worlds upon worlds of His Creation.

Gurbani: ਜਿਵ ਜਿਵ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਤਿਵੈ ਤਿਵ ਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: jiv jiv hukam tivai tiv kaar |
English: As He commands, so they exist.

Gurbani: ਵੇਖੈ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਕਰਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: vekhai vigasai kar veechaar |
English: He watches over all, and contemplating the creation, He rejoices.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਥਨਾ ਕਰੜਾ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੩੭॥
Transliteration: naanak kathanaa kararraa saar |37|
English: O Nanak, to describe this is as hard as steel! ||37||

[Ang 8 | Raag: Jap | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜਤੁ ਪਾਹਾਰਾ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਸੁਨਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jat paahaaraa dheeraj suniaar |
English: Let self-control be the furnace, and patience the goldsmith.

Gurbani: ਅਹਰਣਿ ਮਤਿ ਵੇਦੁ ਹਥੀਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: aharan mat ved hatheeaar |
English: Let understanding be the anvil, and spiritual wisdom the tools.

Gurbani: ਭਉ ਖਲਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਤਪ ਤਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhau khalaa agan tap taau |
English: With the Fear of God as the bellows, fan the flames of tapa, the body's inner heat.

Gurbani: ਭਾਂਡਾ ਭਾਉ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਢਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: bhaanddaa bhaau amrit tith dtaal |
English: In the crucible of love, melt the Nectar of the Name,

Gurbani: ਘੜੀਐ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚੀ ਟਕਸਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: gharreeai sabad sachee ttakasaal |
English: and mint the True Coin of the Shabad, the Word of God.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: jin kau nadar karam tin kaar |
English: Such is the karma of those upon whom He has cast His Glance of Grace.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੩੮॥
Transliteration: naanak nadaree nadar nihaal |38|
English: O Nanak, the Merciful Lord, by His Grace, uplifts and exalts them. ||38||

[Ang 8 | Raag: Jap | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਪਵਣੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਤਾ ਧਰਤਿ ਮਹਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: pavan guroo paanee pitaa maataa dharat mehat |
English: Air is the Guru, Water is the Father, and Earth is the Great Mother of all.

Gurbani: ਦਿਵਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਦੁਇ ਦਾਈ ਦਾਇਆ ਖੇਲੈ ਸਗਲ ਜਗਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: divas raat due daaee daaeaa khelai sagal jagat |
English: Day and night are the two nurses, in whose lap all the world is at play.

Gurbani: ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਬੁਰਿਆਈਆ ਵਾਚੈ ਧਰਮੁ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: changiaaeea buriaaeea vaachai dharam hadoor |
English: Good deeds and bad deeds-the record is read out in the Presence of the Lord of Dharma.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮੀ ਆਪੋ ਆਪਣੀ ਕੇ ਨੇੜੈ ਕੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: karamee aapo aapanee ke nerrai ke door |
English: According to their own actions, some are drawn closer, and some are driven farther away.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗਏ ਮਸਕਤਿ ਘਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: jinee naam dhiaaeaa ge masakat ghaal |
English: Those who have meditated on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and departed after having worked by the sweat of their brows

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਕੇਤੀ ਛੁਟੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak te mukh ujale ketee chhuttee naal |1|
English: -O Nanak, their faces are radiant in the Court of the Lord, and many are saved along with them! ||1||

[Ang 8 | Raag: So Dar | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: so dar raag aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: So Dar ~ That Door. Raag Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੇਹਾ ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਬਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: so dar teraa kehaa so ghar kehaa jit beh sarab samaale |
English: Where is That Door of Yours, and where is That Home, in which You sit and take care of all?

Gurbani: ਵਾਜੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਦ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਸੰਖਾ ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਵਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: vaaje tere naad anek asankhaa kete tere vaavanahaare |
English: The Sound-current of the Naad vibrates there for You, and countless musicians play all sorts of instruments there for You.

Gurbani: ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਰਾਗ ਪਰੀ ਸਿਉ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਗਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kete tere raag paree siau kaheeeh kete tere gaavanahaare |
English: There are so many Ragas and musical harmonies to You; so many minstrels sing hymns of You.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਪਵਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਰਾਜਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gaavan tudhano pavan paanee baisantar gaavai raajaa dharam duaare |
English: Wind, water and fire sing of You. The Righteous Judge of Dharma sings at Your Door.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਚਿਤੁ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਲਿਖਿ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਧਰਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gaavan tudhano chit gupat likh jaanan likh likh dharam beechaare |
English: Chitr and Gupt, the angels of the conscious and the subconscious who keep the record of actions, and the Righteous Judge of Dharma who reads this record, sing of You.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਈਸਰੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਦੇਵੀ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gaavan tudhano eesar brahamaa devee sohan tere sadaa savaare |
English: Shiva, Brahma and the Goddess of Beauty, ever adorned by You, sing of You.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਸਣਿ ਬੈਠੇ ਦੇਵਤਿਆ ਦਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: gaavan tudhano indr indraasan baitthe devatiaa dar naale |
English: Indra, seated on His Throne, sings of You, with the deities at Your Door.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਸਾਧ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gaavan tudhano sidh samaadhee andar gaavan tudhano saadh beechaare |
English: The Siddhas in Samaadhi sing of You; the Saadhus sing of You in contemplation.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਵੀਰ ਕਰਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gaavan tudhano jatee satee santokhee gaavan tudhano veer karaare |
English: The celibates, the fanatics, and the peacefully accepting sing of You; the fearless warriors sing of You.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਨਿ ਰਖੀਸੁਰ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਵੇਦਾ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: gaavan tudhano panddit parran rakheesur jug jug vedaa naale |
English: The Pandits, the religious scholars who recite the Vedas, with the supreme sages of all the ages, sing of You.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਮੋਹਣੀਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਨਿ ਸੁਰਗੁ ਮਛੁ ਪਇਆਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: gaavan tudhano mohaneea man mohan surag machh peaale |
English: The Mohinis, the enchanting heavenly beauties who entice hearts in paradise, in this world, and in the underworld of the subconscious, sing of You.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਰਤਨ ਉਪਾਏ ਤੇਰੇ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: gaavan tudhano ratan upaae tere atthasatth teerath naale |
English: The celestial jewels created by You, and the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, sing of You.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਜੋਧ ਮਹਾਬਲ ਸੂਰਾ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਖਾਣੀ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gaavan tudhano jodh mahaabal sooraa gaavan tudhano khaanee chaare |
English: The brave and mighty warriors sing of You. The spiritual heroes and the four sources of creation sing of You.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਖੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gaavan tudhano khandd manddal brahamanddaa kar kar rakhe tere dhaare |
English: The worlds, solar systems and galaxies, created and arranged by Your Hand, sing of You.

Gurbani: ਸੇਈ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਨਿ ਰਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਰਸਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: seee tudhano gaavan jo tudh bhaavan rate tere bhagat rasaale |
English: They alone sing of You, who are pleasing to Your Will. Your devotees are imbued with Your Sublime Essence.

Gurbani: ਹੋਰਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਸੇ ਮੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਨਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਿਆ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: hor kete tudhano gaavan se mai chit na aavan naanak kiaa beechaare |
English: So many others sing of You, they do not come to mind. O Nanak, how can I think of them all?

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: soee soee sadaa sach saahib saachaa saachee naaee |
English: That True Lord is True, forever True, and True is His Name.

Gurbani: ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਜਾਸੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: hai bhee hosee jaae na jaasee rachanaa jin rachaaee |
English: He is, and shall always be. He shall not depart, even when this Universe which He has created departs.

Gurbani: ਰੰਗੀ ਰੰਗੀ ਭਾਤੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਿਨਸੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: rangee rangee bhaatee kar kar jinasee maaeaa jin upaaee |
English: He created the world, with its various colors, species of beings, and the variety of Maya.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਕੀਤਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: kar kar dekhai keetaa aapanaa jiau tis dee vaddiaaee |
English: Having created the creation, He watches over it Himself, by His Greatness.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਸੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jo tis bhaavai soee karasee fir hukam na karanaa jaaee |
English: He does whatever He pleases. No one can issue any order to Him.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਤਿਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਹਣੁ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: so paatisaahu saahaa patisaahib naanak rehan rajaaee |1|
English: He is the King, the King of kings, the Supreme Lord and Master of kings. Nanak remains subject to His Will. ||1||

[Ang 9 | Raag: So Dar | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਵਡਾ ਆਖੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sun vaddaa aakhai sabh koe |
English: Hearing of His Greatness, everyone calls Him Great.

Gurbani: ਕੇਵਡੁ ਵਡਾ ਡੀਠਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: kevadd vaddaa ddeetthaa hoe |
English: But just how Great His Greatness is-this is known only to those who have seen Him.

Gurbani: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇ ਨ ਕਹਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: keemat paae na kahiaa jaae |
English: His Value cannot be estimated; He cannot be described.

Gurbani: ਕਹਣੈ ਵਾਲੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kahanai vaale tere rahe samaae |1|
English: Those who describe You, Lord, remain immersed and absorbed in You. ||1||

Gurbani: ਵਡੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: vadde mere saahibaa gahir ganbheeraa gunee gaheeraa |
English: O my Great Lord and Master of Unfathomable Depth, You are the Ocean of Excellence.

Gurbani: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੇਤਾ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਚੀਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: koe na jaanai teraa ketaa kevadd cheeraa |1| rahaau |
English: No one knows the extent or the vastness of Your Expanse. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਰਤੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sabh suratee mil surat kamaaee |
English: All the intuitives met and practiced intuitive meditation.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sabh keemat mil keemat paaee |
English: All the appraisers met and made the appraisal.

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਗੁਰਹਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: giaanee dhiaanee gur gurahaaee |
English: The spiritual teachers, the teachers of meditation, and the teachers of teachers

Gurbani: ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਤੇਰੀ ਤਿਲੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kehan na jaaee teree til vaddiaaee |2|
English: -they cannot describe even an iota of Your Greatness. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਸਤ ਸਭਿ ਤਪ ਸਭਿ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabh sat sabh tap sabh changiaaeea |
English: All Truth, all austere discipline, all goodness,

Gurbani: ਸਿਧਾ ਪੁਰਖਾ ਕੀਆ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: sidhaa purakhaa keea vaddiaaeea |
English: all the great miraculous spiritual powers of the Siddhas

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਿਧੀ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: tudh vin sidhee kinai na paaeea |
English: without You, no one has attained such powers.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਈਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: karam milai naahee tthaak rahaaeea |3|
English: They are received only by Your Grace. No one can block them or stop their flow. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਖਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਕਿਆ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aakhan vaalaa kiaa vechaaraa |
English: What can the poor helpless creatures do?

Gurbani: ਸਿਫਤੀ ਭਰੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sifatee bhare tere bhanddaaraa |
English: Your Praises are overflowing with Your Treasures.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਿਆ ਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jis too dehi tisai kiaa chaaraa |
English: Those, unto whom You give-how can they think of any other?

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak sach savaaranahaaraa |4|2|
English: O Nanak, the True One embellishes and exalts. ||4||2||

[Ang 9 | Raag: So Dar | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਖਾ ਜੀਵਾ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aakhaa jeevaa visarai mar jaau |
English: Chanting it, I live; forgetting it, I die.

Gurbani: ਆਖਣਿ ਅਉਖਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aakhan aaukhaa saachaa naau |
English: It is so difficult to chant the True Name.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਲਾਗੈ ਭੂਖ ॥
Transliteration: saache naam kee laagai bhookh |
English: If someone feels hunger for the True Name,

Gurbani: ਉਤੁ ਭੂਖੈ ਖਾਇ ਚਲੀਅਹਿ ਦੂਖ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aut bhookhai khaae chaleeeh dookh |1|
English: that hunger shall consume his pain. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: so kiau visarai meree maae |
English: How can I forget Him, O my mother?

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saachaa saahib saachai naae |1| rahaau |
English: True is the Master, True is His Name. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਤਿਲੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: saache naam kee til vaddiaaee |
English: Trying to describe even an iota of the Greatness of the True Name,

Gurbani: ਆਖਿ ਥਕੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aakh thake keemat nahee paaee |
English: people have grown weary, but they have not been able to evaluate it.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਸਭਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੈ ਆਖਣ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: je sabh mil kai aakhan paeh |
English: Even if everyone were to gather together and speak of Him,

Gurbani: ਵਡਾ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਘਾਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: vaddaa na hovai ghaatt na jaae |2|
English: He would not become any greater or any lesser. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: naa ohu marai na hovai sog |
English: That Lord does not die; there is no reason to mourn.

Gurbani: ਦੇਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ਭੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: dedaa rahai na chookai bhog |
English: He continues to give, and His Provisions never run short.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣੁ ਏਹੋ ਹੋਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: gun eho hor naahee koe |
English: This Virtue is His alone; there is no other like Him.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਆ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naa ko hoaa naa ko hoe |3|
English: There never has been, and there never will be. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੇਵਡੁ ਆਪਿ ਤੇਵਡ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: jevadd aap tevadd teree daat |
English: As Great as You Yourself are, O Lord, so Great are Your Gifts.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਕੀਤੀ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: jin din kar kai keetee raat |
English: The One who created the day also created the night.

Gurbani: ਖਸਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਹਿ ਤੇ ਕਮਜਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: khasam visaareh te kamajaat |
English: Those who forget their Lord and Master are vile and despicable.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਾਝੁ ਸਨਾਤਿ ॥੪॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak naavai baajh sanaat |4|3|
English: O Nanak, without the Name, they are wretched outcasts. ||4||3||

[Ang 10 | Raag: So Dar | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: raag goojaree mahalaa 4 |
English: Raag Goojaree, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਤਪੁਰਖਾ ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰਉ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: har ke jan satigur satapurakhaa binau krau gur paas |
English: O humble servant of the Lord, O True Guru, O True Primal Being: I offer my humble prayer to You, O Guru.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਕੀਰੇ ਕਿਰਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ham keere kiram satigur saranaaee kar deaa naam paragaas |1|
English: I am a mere insect, a worm. O True Guru, I seek Your Sanctuary. Please be merciful, and bless me with the Light of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: mere meet guradev mo kau raam naam paragaas |
English: O my Best Friend, O Divine Guru, please enlighten me with the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸਖਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹਮਰੀ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: guramat naam meraa praan sakhaaee har keerat hamaree raharaas |1| rahaau |
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Naam is my breath of life. The Kirtan of the Lord's Praise is my life's occupation. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਵਡ ਭਾਗ ਵਡੇਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਧਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
Transliteration: har jan ke vadd bhaag vaddere jin har har saradhaa har piaas |
English: The servants of the Lord have the greatest good fortune; they have faith in the Lord, and a longing for the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸਹਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har har naam milai tripataaseh mil sangat gun paragaas |2|
English: Obtaining the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, they are satisfied; joining the Sangat, the Blessed Congregation, their virtues shine forth. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਜਮ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: jin har har har ras naam na paaeaa te bhaagaheen jam paas |
English: Those who have not obtained the Sublime Essence of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, are most unfortunate; they are led away by the Messenger of Death.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਏ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵੇ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jo satigur saran sangat nahee aae dhrig jeeve dhrig jeevaas |3|
English: Those who have not sought the Sanctuary of the True Guru and the Sangat, the Holy Congregation-cursed are their lives, and cursed are their hopes of life. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਤਿਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲਿਖਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: jin har jan satigur sangat paaee tin dhur masatak likhiaa likhaas |
English: Those humble servants of the Lord who have attained the Company of the True Guru, have such pre-ordained destiny inscribed on their foreheads.

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੪॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan satasangat jit har ras paaeaa mil jan naanak naam paragaas |4|4|
English: Blessed, blessed is the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, where the Lord's Essence is obtained. Meeting with His humble servant, O Nanak, the Light of the Naam shines forth. ||4||4||

[Ang 10 | Raag: So Dar | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raag goojaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Raag Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੇ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਚਿਤਵਹਿ ਉਦਮੁ ਜਾ ਆਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਪਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: kaahe re man chitaveh udam jaa aahar har jeeo pariaa |
English: Why, O mind, do you plot and plan, when the Dear Lord Himself provides for your care?

Gurbani: ਸੈਲ ਪਥਰ ਮਹਿ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਏ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਆਗੈ ਕਰਿ ਧਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sail pathar meh jant upaae taa kaa rijak aagai kar dhariaa |1|
English: From rocks and stones He created living beings; He places their nourishment before them. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਾਧਉ ਜੀ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁ ਤਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: mere maadhau jee satasangat mile su tariaa |
English: O my Dear Lord of souls, one who joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, is saved.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੂਕੇ ਕਾਸਟ ਹਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaad param pad paaeaa sooke kaasatt hariaa |1| rahaau |
English: By Guru's Grace, the supreme status is obtained, and the dry wood blossoms forth again in lush greenery. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਨਨਿ ਪਿਤਾ ਲੋਕ ਸੁਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸ ਕੀ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: janan pitaa lok sut banitaa koe na kis kee dhariaa |
English: Mothers, fathers, friends, children and spouses-no one is the support of anyone else.

Gurbani: ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕਾਹੇ ਮਨ ਭਉ ਕਰਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sir sir rijak sanbaahe tthaakur kaahe man bhau kariaa |2|
English: For each and every person, our Lord and Master provides sustenance. Why are you so afraid, O mind? ||2||

Gurbani: ਊਡੇ ਊਡਿ ਆਵੈ ਸੈ ਕੋਸਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਾਛੈ ਬਚਰੇ ਛਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: aoodde aoodd aavai sai kosaa tis paachhai bachare chhariaa |
English: The flamingoes fly hundreds of miles, leaving their young ones behind.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕਵਣੁ ਖਲਾਵੈ ਕਵਣੁ ਚੁਗਾਵੈ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਕਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tin kavan khalaavai kavan chugaavai man meh simaran kariaa |3|
English: Who feeds them, and who teaches them to feed themselves? Have you ever thought of this in your mind? ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਦਸ ਅਸਟ ਸਿਧਾਨ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਰ ਤਲ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabh nidhaan das asatt sidhaan tthaakur kar tal dhariaa |
English: All the nine treasures, and the eighteen supernatural powers are held by our Lord and Master in the Palm of His Hand.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਰਿਆ ॥੪॥੫॥
Transliteration: jan naanak bal bal sad bal jaaeeai teraa ant na paaraavariaa |4|5|
English: Servant Nanak is devoted, dedicated, forever a sacrifice to You, Lord. Your Expanse has no limit, no boundary. ||4||5||

[Ang 10 | Raag: So Purakh | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: raag aasaa mahalaa 4 so purakh |
English: Raag Aasaa, Fourth Mehl, So Purakh ~ That Primal Being:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: so purakh niranjan har purakh niranjan har agamaa agam apaaraa |
English: That Primal Being is Immaculate and Pure. The Lord, the Primal Being, is Immaculate and Pure. The Lord is Inaccessible, Unreachable and Unrivalled.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabh dhiaaveh sabh dhiaaveh tudh jee har sache sirajanahaaraa |
English: All meditate, all meditate on You, Dear Lord, O True Creator Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਜੀ ਤੂੰ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabh jeea tumaare jee toon jeea kaa daataaraa |
English: All living beings are Yours-You are the Giver of all souls.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਜੀ ਸਭਿ ਦੂਖ ਵਿਸਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har dhiaavahu santahu jee sabh dookh visaaranahaaraa |
English: Meditate on the Lord, O Saints; He is the Dispeller of all sorrow.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜੀ ਕਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
