Transliteration: har aape tthaakur har aape sevak jee kiaa naanak jant vichaaraa |1|
English: The Lord Himself is the Master, the Lord Himself is the Servant. O Nanak, the poor beings are wretched and miserable! ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: toon ghatt ghatt antar sarab nirantar jee har eko purakh samaanaa |
English: You are constant in each and every heart, and in all things. O Dear Lord, you are the One.

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਦਾਤੇ ਇਕਿ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ਜੀ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: eik daate ik bhekhaaree jee sabh tere choj viddaanaa |
English: Some are givers, and some are beggars. This is all Your Wondrous Play.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਦਾਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਜੀ ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: toon aape daataa aape bhugataa jee hau tudh bin avar na jaanaa |
English: You Yourself are the Giver, and You Yourself are the Enjoyer. I know no other than You.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਜੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: toon paarabraham beant beant jee tere kiaa gun aakh vakhaanaa |
English: You are the Supreme Lord God, Limitless and Infinite. What Virtues of Yours can I speak of and describe?

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਜੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੁਰਬਾਣਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jo seveh jo seveh tudh jee jan naanak tin kurabaanaa |2|
English: Unto those who serve You, unto those who serve You, Dear Lord, servant Nanak is a sacrifice. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਸੁਖਵਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: har dhiaaveh har dhiaaveh tudh jee se jan jug meh sukhavaasee |
English: Those who meditate on You, Lord, those who meditate on You-those humble beings dwell in peace in this world.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਸੇ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਭਏ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜੀ ਤਿਨ ਤੂਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: se mukat se mukat bhe jin har dhiaaeaa jee tin toottee jam kee faasee |
English: They are liberated, they are liberated-those who meditate on the Lord. For them, the noose of death is cut away.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜੀ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਸਭੁ ਗਵਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: jin nirbhau jin har nirbhau dhiaaeaa jee tin kaa bhau sabh gavaasee |
English: Those who meditate on the Fearless One, on the Fearless Lord-all their fears are dispelled.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੂਪਿ ਸਮਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: jin seviaa jin seviaa meraa har jee te har har roop samaasee |
English: Those who serve, those who serve my Dear Lord, are absorbed into the Being of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੇ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜੀ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਸੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: se dhan se dhan jin har dhiaaeaa jee jan naanak tin bal jaasee |3|
English: Blessed are they, blessed are they, who meditate on their Dear Lord. Servant Nanak is a sacrifice to them. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਜੀ ਭਰੇ ਬਿਅੰਤ ਬੇਅੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: teree bhagat teree bhagat bhanddaar jee bhare biant beantaa |
English: Devotion to You, devotion to You, is a treasure overflowing, infinite and beyond measure.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਨੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: tere bhagat tere bhagat salaahan tudh jee har anik anek anantaa |
English: Your devotees, Your devotees praise You, Dear Lord, in many and various and countless ways.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੀ ਅਨਿਕ ਤੇਰੀ ਅਨਿਕ ਕਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਜੀ ਤਪੁ ਤਾਪਹਿ ਜਪਹਿ ਬੇਅੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: teree anik teree anik kareh har poojaa jee tap taapeh japeh beantaa |
English: For You, many, for You, so very many perform worship services, O Dear Infinite Lord; they practice disciplined meditation and chant endlessly.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਤੇਰੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਪੜਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਜੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: tere anek tere anek parreh bahu simrit saasat jee kar kiriaa khatt karam karantaa |
English: For You, many, for You, so very many read the various Simritees and Shaastras. They perform rituals and religious rites.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਭਲੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀ ਜੋ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: se bhagat se bhagat bhale jan naanak jee jo bhaaveh mere har bhagavantaa |4|
English: Those devotees, those devotees are sublime, O servant Nanak, who are pleasing to my Dear Lord God. ||4||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਜੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: toon aad purakh aparanpar karataa jee tudh jevadd avar na koee |
English: You are the Primal Being, the Most Wonderful Creator. There is no other as Great as You.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੂੰ ਏਕੋ ਜੀ ਤੂੰ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: toon jug jug eko sadaa sadaa toon eko jee toon nihachal karataa soee |
English: Age after age, You are the One. Forever and ever, You are the One. You never change, O Creator Lord.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਵਰਤੈ ਜੀ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: tudh aape bhaavai soee varatai jee toon aape kareh su hoee |
English: Everything happens according to Your Will. You Yourself accomplish all that occurs.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਉਪਾਈ ਜੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਿਰਜਿ ਸਭ ਗੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: tudh aape srisatt sabh upaaee jee tudh aape siraj sabh goee |
English: You Yourself created the entire universe, and having fashioned it, You Yourself shall destroy it all.

Gurbani: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੇ ਜੀ ਜੋ ਸਭਸੈ ਕਾ ਜਾਣੋਈ ॥੫॥੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak gun gaavai karate ke jee jo sabhasai kaa jaanoee |5|1|
English: Servant Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Dear Creator, the Knower of all. ||5||1||

[Ang 11 | Raag: So Purakh | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 |
English: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ਮੈਡਾ ਸਾਂਈ ॥
Transliteration: toon karataa sachiaar maiddaa saanee |
English: You are the True Creator, my Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਥੀਸੀ ਜੋ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਹਉ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo tau bhaavai soee theesee jo toon dehi soee hau paaee |1| rahaau |
English: Whatever pleases You comes to pass. As You give, so do we receive. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabh teree toon sabhanee dhiaaeaa |
English: All belong to You, all meditate on you.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jis no kripaa kareh tin naam ratan paaeaa |
English: Those who are blessed with Your Mercy obtain the Jewel of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਧਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh laadhaa manamukh gavaaeaa |
English: The Gurmukhs obtain it, and the self-willed manmukhs lose it.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tudh aap vichhorriaa aap milaaeaa |1|
English: You Yourself separate them from Yourself, and You Yourself reunite with them again. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਸਭ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: toon dareeaau sabh tujh hee maeh |
English: You are the River of Life; all are within You.

Gurbani: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: tujh bin doojaa koee naeh |
English: There is no one except You.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਖੇਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jant sabh teraa khel |
English: All living beings are Your playthings.

Gurbani: ਵਿਜੋਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਮੇਲੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: vijog mil vichhurriaa sanjogee mel |2|
English: The separated ones meet, and by great good fortune, those suffering in separation are reunited once again. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਜਾਣਾਇਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: jis no too jaanaaeihi soee jan jaanai |
English: They alone understand, whom You inspire to understand;

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: har gun sad hee aakh vakhaanai |
English: they continually chant and repeat the Lord's Praises.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jin har seviaa tin sukh paaeaa |
English: Those who serve You find peace.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sahaje hee har naam samaaeaa |3|
English: They are intuitively absorbed into the Lord's Name. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: too aape karataa teraa keea sabh hoe |
English: You Yourself are the Creator. Everything that happens is by Your Doing.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: tudh bin doojaa avar na koe |
English: There is no one except You.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: too kar kar vekheh jaaneh soe |
English: You created the creation; You behold it and understand it.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: jan naanak guramukh paragatt hoe |4|2|
English: O servant Nanak, the Lord is revealed through the Gurmukh, the Living Expression of the Guru's Word. ||4||2||

[Ang 12 | Raag: So Purakh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤਿਤੁ ਸਰਵਰੜੈ ਭਈਲੇ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਕੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: tit saravararrai bheele nivaasaa paanee paavak tineh keea |
English: In that pool, people have made their homes, but the water there is as hot as fire!

Gurbani: ਪੰਕਜੁ ਮੋਹ ਪਗੁ ਨਹੀ ਚਾਲੈ ਹਮ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਡੂਬੀਅਲੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: pankaj moh pag nahee chaalai ham dekhaa teh ddoobeeale |1|
English: In the swamp of emotional attachment, their feet cannot move. I have seen them drowning there. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਏਕੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਸਿ ਮੂੜ ਮਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: man ek na chetas moorr manaa |
English: In your mind, you do not remember the One Lord-you fool!

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਲਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har bisarat tere gun galiaa |1| rahaau |
English: You have forgotten the Lord; your virtues shall wither away. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਹਉ ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਨਹੀ ਪੜਿਆ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: naa hau jatee satee nahee parriaa moorakh mugadhaa janam bheaa |
English: I am not celibate, nor truthful, nor scholarly. I was born foolish and ignorant into this world.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾ ਜਿਨ ਤੂ ਨਾਹੀ ਵੀਸਰਿਆ ॥੨॥੩॥
Transliteration: pranavat naanak tin kee saranaa jin too naahee veesariaa |2|3|
English: Prays Nanak, I seek the Sanctuary of those who have not forgotten You, O Lord! ||2||3||

[Ang 12 | Raag: So Purakh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਭਈ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਦੇਹੁਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: bhee paraapat maanukh dehureea |
English: This human body has been given to you.

Gurbani: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਮਿਲਣ ਕੀ ਇਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: gobind milan kee ih teree bareea |
English: This is your chance to meet the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰਿ ਕਾਜ ਤੇਰੈ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਕਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: avar kaaj terai kitai na kaam |
English: Nothing else will work.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਭਜੁ ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mil saadhasangat bhaj keval naam |1|
English: Join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; vibrate and meditate on the Jewel of the Naam. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਰੰਜਾਮਿ ਲਾਗੁ ਭਵਜਲ ਤਰਨ ਕੈ ॥
Transliteration: saranjaam laag bhavajal taran kai |
English: Make every effort to cross over this terrifying world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮੁ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਜਾਤ ਰੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: janam brithaa jaat rang maaeaa kai |1| rahaau |
English: You are squandering this life uselessly in the love of Maya. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਨ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jap tap sanjam dharam na kamaaeaa |
English: I have not practiced meditation, self-discipline, self-restraint or righteous living.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਾ ਸਾਧ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sevaa saadh na jaaniaa har raaeaa |
English: I have not served the Holy; I have not acknowledged the Lord, my King.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਮ ਨੀਚ ਕਰੰਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak ham neech karamaa |
English: Says Nanak, my actions are contemptible!

Gurbani: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਕੀ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਰਮਾ ॥੨॥੪॥
Transliteration: saran pare kee raakhahu saramaa |2|4|
English: O Lord, I seek Your Sanctuary; please, preserve my honor! ||2||4||

[Ang 12 | Raag: Sohila | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਦੀਪਕੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: sohilaa raag gaurree deepakee mahalaa 1 |
English: Sohilaa ~ The Song Of Praise. Raag Gauree Deepakee, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਜੈ ਘਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਆਖੀਐ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: jai ghar keerat aakheeai karate kaa hoe beechaaro |
English: In that house where the Praises of the Creator are chanted and contemplated

Gurbani: ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਸਿਵਰਿਹੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tit ghar gaavahu sohilaa sivarihu sirajanahaaro |1|
English: -in that house, sing Songs of Praise; meditate and remember the Creator Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕਾ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: tum gaavahu mere nirbhau kaa sohilaa |
English: Sing the Songs of Praise of my Fearless Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੋਹਿਲੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hau vaaree jit sohilai sadaa sukh hoe |1| rahaau |
English: I am a sacrifice to that Song of Praise which brings eternal peace. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਸਮਾਲੀਅਨਿ ਦੇਖੈਗਾ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: nit nit jeearre samaaleean dekhaigaa devanahaar |
English: Day after day, He cares for His beings; the Great Giver watches over all.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਨੈ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਦਾਤੇ ਕਵਣੁ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tere daanai keemat naa pavai tis daate kavan sumaar |2|
English: Your Gifts cannot be appraised; how can anyone compare to the Giver? ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੰਬਤਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਤੇਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: sanbat saahaa likhiaa mil kar paavahu tel |
English: The day of my wedding is pre-ordained. Come, gather together and pour the oil over the threshold.

Gurbani: ਦੇਹੁ ਸਜਣ ਅਸੀਸੜੀਆ ਜਿਉ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਲੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: dehu sajan aseesarreea jiau hovai saahib siau mel |3|
English: My friends, give me your blessings, that I may merge with my Lord and Master. ||3||

Gurbani: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਏਹੋ ਪਾਹੁਚਾ ਸਦੜੇ ਨਿਤ ਪਵੰਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: ghar ghar eho paahuchaa sadarre nit pavan |
English: Unto each and every home, into each and every heart, this summons is sent out; the call comes each and every day.

Gurbani: ਸਦਣਹਾਰਾ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਦਿਹ ਆਵੰਨਿ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: sadanahaaraa simareeai naanak se dih aavan |4|1|
English: Remember in meditation the One who summons us; O Nanak, that day is drawing near! ||4||1||

[Ang 12 | Raag: Sohila | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raag aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Raag Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਛਿਅ ਘਰ ਛਿਅ ਗੁਰ ਛਿਅ ਉਪਦੇਸ ॥
Transliteration: chhia ghar chhia gur chhia upades |
English: There are six schools of philosophy, six teachers, and six sets of teachings.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਸ ਅਨੇਕ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur gur eko ves anek |1|
English: But the Teacher of teachers is the One, who appears in so many forms. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਾਬਾ ਜੈ ਘਰਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: baabaa jai ghar karate keerat hoe |
English: O Baba: that system in which the Praises of the Creator are sung

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਤੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: so ghar raakh vaddaaee toe |1| rahaau |
English: -follow that system; in it rests true greatness. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਵਿਸੁਏ ਚਸਿਆ ਘੜੀਆ ਪਹਰਾ ਥਿਤੀ ਵਾਰੀ ਮਾਹੁ ਹੋਆ ॥
Transliteration: visue chasiaa gharreea paharaa thitee vaaree maahu hoaa |
English: The seconds, minutes and hours, days, weeks and months,

Gurbani: ਸੂਰਜੁ ਏਕੋ ਰੁਤਿ ਅਨੇਕ ॥ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਵੇਸ ॥੨॥੨॥
Transliteration: sooraj eko rut anek | naanak karate ke kete ves |2|2|
English: And the various seasons originate from the one sun; O Nanak, in just the same way, the many forms originate from the Creator. ||2||2||

[Ang 13 | Raag: Sohila | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raag dhanaasaree mahalaa 1 |
English: Raag Dhanaasaree, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗਗਨ ਮੈ ਥਾਲੁ ਰਵਿ ਚੰਦੁ ਦੀਪਕ ਬਨੇ ਤਾਰਿਕਾ ਮੰਡਲ ਜਨਕ ਮੋਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: gagan mai thaal rav chand deepak bane taarikaa manddal janak motee |
English: Upon that cosmic plate of the sky, the sun and the moon are the lamps. The stars and their orbs are the studded pearls.

Gurbani: ਧੂਪੁ ਮਲਆਨਲੋ ਪਵਣੁ ਚਵਰੋ ਕਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਬਨਰਾਇ ਫੂਲੰਤ ਜੋਤੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dhoop malaanalo pavan chavaro kare sagal banaraae foolant jotee |1|
English: The fragrance of sandalwood in the air is the temple incense, and the wind is the fan. All the plants of the world are the altar flowers in offering to You, O Luminous Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕੈਸੀ ਆਰਤੀ ਹੋਇ ॥ ਭਵ ਖੰਡਨਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਰਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: kaisee aaratee hoe | bhav khanddanaa teree aaratee |
English: What a beautiful Aartee, lamp-lit worship service this is! O Destroyer of Fear, this is Your Ceremony of Light.

Gurbani: ਅਨਹਤਾ ਸਬਦ ਵਾਜੰਤ ਭੇਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: anahataa sabad vaajant bheree |1| rahaau |
English: The Unstruck Sound-current of the Shabad is the vibration of the temple drums. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਹਸ ਤਵ ਨੈਨ ਨਨ ਨੈਨ ਹਹਿ ਤੋਹਿ ਕਉ ਸਹਸ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਨਨਾ ਏਕ ਤੋੁਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: sehas tav nain nan nain heh tohi kau sehas moorat nanaa ek tuohee |
English: You have thousands of eyes, and yet You have no eyes. You have thousands of forms, and yet You do not have even one.

Gurbani: ਸਹਸ ਪਦ ਬਿਮਲ ਨਨ ਏਕ ਪਦ ਗੰਧ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਹਸ ਤਵ ਗੰਧ ਇਵ ਚਲਤ ਮੋਹੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sehas pad bimal nan ek pad gandh bin sehas tav gandh iv chalat mohee |2|
English: You have thousands of Lotus Feet, and yet You do not have even one foot. You have no nose, but you have thousands of noses. This Play of Yours entrances me. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਹੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabh meh jot jot hai soe |
English: Amongst all is the Light-You are that Light.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਦੈ ਚਾਨਣਿ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: tis dai chaanan sabh meh chaanan hoe |
English: By this Illumination, that Light is radiant within all.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸਾਖੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur saakhee jot paragatt hoe |
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Light shines forth.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਆਰਤੀ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jo tis bhaavai su aaratee hoe |3|
English: That which is pleasing to Him is the lamp-lit worship service. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਲੋਭਿਤ ਮਨੋ ਅਨਦਿਨੋੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਆਹੀ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: har charan kaval makarand lobhit mano anadinuo mohi aahee piaasaa |
English: My mind is enticed by the honey-sweet Lotus Feet of the Lord. Day and night, I thirst for them.

Gurbani: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਜਲੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਰਿੰਗ ਕਉ ਹੋਇ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਇ ਵਾਸਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
Transliteration: kripaa jal dehi naanak saaring kau hoe jaa te terai naae vaasaa |4|3|
English: Bestow the Water of Your Mercy upon Nanak, the thirsty song-bird, so that he may come to dwell in Your Name. ||4||3||

[Ang 13 | Raag: Sohila | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: raag gaurree poorabee mahalaa 4 |
English: Raag Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਾਮਿ ਕਰੋਧਿ ਨਗਰੁ ਬਹੁ ਭਰਿਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਖੰਡਲ ਖੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: kaam karodh nagar bahu bhariaa mil saadhoo khanddal khanddaa he |
English: The body-village is filled to overflowing with anger and sexual desire; these were broken into bits when I met with the Holy Saint.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਤ ਲਿਖੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਮੰਡਲ ਮੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: poorab likhat likhe gur paaeaa man har liv manddal manddaa he |1|
English: By pre-ordained destiny, I have met with the Guru. I have entered into the realm of the Lord's Love. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਅੰਜੁਲੀ ਪੁਨੁ ਵਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: kar saadhoo anjulee pun vaddaa he |
English: Greet the Holy Saint with your palms pressed together; this is an act of great merit.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਡੰਡਉਤ ਪੁਨੁ ਵਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kar ddanddaut pun vaddaa he |1| rahaau |
English: Bow down before Him; this is a virtuous action indeed. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਕੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: saakat har ras saad na jaaniaa tin antar haumai kanddaa he |
English: The wicked shaaktas, the faithless cynics, do not know the Taste of the Lord's Sublime Essence. The thorn of egotism is embedded deep within them.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਚਲਹਿ ਚੁਭੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਸਹਹਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਡੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jiau jiau chaleh chubhai dukh paaveh jamakaal saheh sir ddanddaa he |2|
English: The more they walk away, the deeper it pierces them, and the more they suffer in pain, until finally, the Messenger of Death smashes his club against their heads. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭਵ ਖੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: har jan har har naam samaane dukh janam maran bhav khanddaa he |
English: The humble servants of the Lord are absorbed in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. The pain of birth and the fear of death are eradicated.

Gurbani: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਬਹੁ ਸੋਭ ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: abinaasee purakh paaeaa paramesar bahu sobh khandd brahamanddaa he |3|
English: They have found the Imperishable Supreme Being, the Transcendent Lord God, and they receive great honor throughout all the worlds and realms. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਗਰੀਬ ਮਸਕੀਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਵਡ ਵਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: ham gareeb masakeen prabh tere har raakh raakh vadd vaddaa he |
English: I am poor and meek, God, but I belong to You! Save me-please save me, O Greatest of the Great!

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਮੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥੪॥
Transliteration: jan naanak naam adhaar ttek hai har naame hee sukh manddaa he |4|4|
English: Servant Nanak takes the Sustenance and Support of the Naam. In the Name of the Lord, he enjoys celestial peace. ||4||4||

[Ang 13 | Raag: Sohila | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raag gaurree poorabee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raag Gauree Poorbee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ ਸੰਤ ਟਹਲ ਕੀ ਬੇਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: krau benantee sunahu mere meetaa sant ttehal kee belaa |
English: Listen, my friends, I beg of you: now is the time to serve the Saints!

Gurbani: ਈਹਾ ਖਾਟਿ ਚਲਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਆਗੈ ਬਸਨੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: eehaa khaatt chalahu har laahaa aagai basan suhelaa |1|
English: In this world, earn the profit of the Lord's Name, and hereafter, you shall dwell in peace. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਉਧ ਘਟੈ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aaudh ghattai dinas rainaare |
English: This life is diminishing, day and night.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: man gur mil kaaj savaare |1| rahaau |
English: Meeting with the Guru, your affairs shall be resolved. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਬਿਕਾਰੁ ਸੰਸੇ ਮਹਿ ਤਰਿਓ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: eihu sansaar bikaar sanse meh tario braham giaanee |
English: This world is engrossed in corruption and cynicism. Only those who know God are saved.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਜਗਾਇ ਪੀਆਵੈ ਇਹੁ ਰਸੁ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jiseh jagaae peeaavai ihu ras akath kathaa tin jaanee |2|
English: Only those who are awakened by the Lord to drink in this Sublime Essence, come to know the Unspoken Speech of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਆਏ ਸੋਈ ਬਿਹਾਝਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਨਹਿ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kau aae soee bihaajhahu har gur te maneh baseraa |
English: Purchase only that for which you have come into the world, and through the Guru, the Lord shall dwell within your mind.

Gurbani: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜੇ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਇਗੋ ਫੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: nij ghar mehal paavahu sukh sahaje bahur na hoeigo feraa |3|
English: Within the home of your own inner being, you shall obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence with intuitive ease. You shall not be consigned again to the wheel of reincarnation. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ਸਰਧਾ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: antarajaamee purakh bidhaate saradhaa man kee poore |
English: O Inner-knower, Searcher of Hearts, O Primal Being, Architect of Destiny: please fulfill this yearning of my mind.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਇਹੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰੇ ॥੪॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak daas ihai sukh maagai mo kau kar santan kee dhoore |4|5|
English: Nanak, Your slave, begs for this happiness: let me be the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||4||5||

[Ang 14 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ਪਹਿਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raag sireeraag mahalaa pahilaa 1 ghar 1 |
English: Raag Siree Raag, First Mehl, First House:

Gurbani: ਮੋਤੀ ਤ ਮੰਦਰ ਊਸਰਹਿ ਰਤਨੀ ਤ ਹੋਹਿ ਜੜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: motee ta mandar aoosareh ratanee ta hohi jarraau |
English: If I had a palace made of pearls, inlaid with jewels,

Gurbani: ਕਸਤੂਰਿ ਕੁੰਗੂ ਅਗਰਿ ਚੰਦਨਿ ਲੀਪਿ ਆਵੈ ਚਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kasatoor kungoo agar chandan leep aavai chaau |
English: scented with musk, saffron and sandalwood, a sheer delight to behold

Gurbani: ਮਤੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੂਲਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mat dekh bhoolaa veesarai teraa chit na aavai naau |1|
English: -seeing this, I might go astray and forget You, and Your Name would not enter into my mind. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਉ ਜਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har bin jeeo jal bal jaau |
English: Without the Lord, my soul is scorched and burnt.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਛਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mai aapanaa gur poochh dekhiaa avar naahee thaau |1| rahaau |
English: I consulted my Guru, and now I see that there is no other place at all. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਧਰਤੀ ਤ ਹੀਰੇ ਲਾਲ ਜੜਤੀ ਪਲਘਿ ਲਾਲ ਜੜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dharatee ta heere laal jarratee palagh laal jarraau |
English: If the floor of this palace was a mosaic of diamonds and rubies, and if my bed was encased with rubies,

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਣੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਣੀ ਸੋਹੈ ਕਰੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਪਸਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mohanee mukh manee sohai kare rang pasaau |
English: and if heavenly beauties, their faces adorned with emeralds, tried to entice me with sensual gestures of love

Gurbani: ਮਤੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੂਲਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mat dekh bhoolaa veesarai teraa chit na aavai naau |2|
English: -seeing these, I might go astray and forget You, and Your Name would not enter into my mind. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਿਧੁ ਹੋਵਾ ਸਿਧਿ ਲਾਈ ਰਿਧਿ ਆਖਾ ਆਉ ॥
Transliteration: sidh hovaa sidh laaee ridh aakhaa aau |
English: If I were to become a Siddha, and work miracles, summon wealth

Gurbani: ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ਬੈਸਾ ਲੋਕੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਭਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gupat paragatt hoe baisaa lok raakhai bhaau |
English: and become invisible and visible at will, so that people would hold me in awe

Gurbani: ਮਤੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੂਲਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨਾਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: mat dekh bhoolaa veesarai teraa chit na aavai naau |3|
English: -seeing these, I might go astray and forget You, and Your Name would not enter into my mind. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੁਲਤਾਨੁ ਹੋਵਾ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਸਕਰ ਤਖਤਿ ਰਾਖਾ ਪਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sulataan hovaa mel lasakar takhat raakhaa paau |
English: If I were to become an emperor and raise a huge army, and sit on a throne,

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹਾਸਲੁ ਕਰੀ ਬੈਠਾ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਭ ਵਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hukam haasal karee baitthaa naanakaa sabh vaau |
English: issuing commands and collecting taxes-O Nanak, all of this could pass away like a puff of wind.

Gurbani: ਮਤੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੂਲਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: mat dekh bhoolaa veesarai teraa chit na aavai naau |4|1|
English: Seeing these, I might go astray and forget You, and Your Name would not enter into my mind. ||4||1||

[Ang 14 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਆਰਜਾ ਪਵਣੁ ਪੀਅਣੁ ਅਪਿਆਉ ॥
Transliteration: kott kottee meree aarajaa pavan peean apiaau |
English: If I could live for millions and millions of years, and if the air was my food and drink,

Gurbani: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਗੁਫੈ ਨ ਦੇਖਾ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਸਉਣ ਨ ਥਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: chand sooraj due gufai na dekhaa supanai saun na thaau |
English: and if I lived in a cave and never saw either the sun or the moon, and if I never slept, even in dreams

Gurbani: ਭੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਹਉ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਆਖਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bhee teree keemat naa pavai hau kevadd aakhaa naau |1|
English: -even so, I could not estimate Your Value. How can I describe the Greatness of Your Name? ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਾ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਜ ਥਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: saachaa nirankaar nij thaae |
English: The True Lord, the Formless One, is Himself in His Own Place.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਖਣੁ ਆਖਣਾ ਜੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਕਰੇ ਤਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sun sun aakhan aakhanaa je bhaavai kare tamaae |1| rahaau |
English: I have heard, over and over again, and so I tell the tale; as it pleases You, Lord, please instill within me the yearning for You. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕੁਸਾ ਕਟੀਆ ਵਾਰ ਵਾਰ ਪੀਸਣਿ ਪੀਸਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kusaa katteea vaar vaar peesan peesaa paae |
English: If I was slashed and cut into pieces, over and over again, and put into the mill and ground into flour,

Gurbani: ਅਗੀ ਸੇਤੀ ਜਾਲੀਆ ਭਸਮ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: agee setee jaaleea bhasam setee ral jaau |
English: burnt by fire and mixed with ashes

Gurbani: ਭੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਹਉ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਆਖਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bhee teree keemat naa pavai hau kevadd aakhaa naau |2|
English: -even then, I could not estimate Your Value. How can I describe the Greatness of Your Name? ||2||

Gurbani: ਪੰਖੀ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਜੇ ਭਵਾ ਸੈ ਅਸਮਾਨੀ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: pankhee hoe kai je bhavaa sai asamaanee jaau |
English: If I was a bird, soaring and flying through hundreds of heavens,

Gurbani: ਨਦਰੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਆਵਊ ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਪੀਆ ਨ ਖਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: nadaree kisai na aavaoo naa kichh peea na khaau |
English: and if I was invisible, neither eating nor drinking anything

Gurbani: ਭੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਹਉ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਆਖਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bhee teree keemat naa pavai hau kevadd aakhaa naau |3|
English: -even so, I could not estimate Your Value. How can I describe the Greatness of Your Name? ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਗਦ ਲਖ ਮਣਾ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਕੀਚੈ ਭਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: naanak kaagad lakh manaa parr parr keechai bhaau |
English: O Nanak, if I had hundreds of thousands of stacks of paper, and if I were to read and recite and embrace love for the Lord,

Gurbani: ਮਸੂ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਲੇਖਣਿ ਪਉਣੁ ਚਲਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: masoo tott na aavee lekhan paun chalaau |
English: and if ink were never to fail me, and if my pen were able to move like the wind

Gurbani: ਭੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਹਉ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਆਖਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: bhee teree keemat naa pavai hau kevadd aakhaa naau |4|2|
English: -even so, I could not estimate Your Value. How can I describe the Greatness of Your Name? ||4||2||

[Ang 15 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਲੇਖੈ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਲੇਖੈ ਖਾਣਾ ਖਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: lekhai bolan bolanaa lekhai khaanaa khaau |
English: As it is pre-ordained, people speak their words. As it is pre-ordained, they consume their food.

Gurbani: ਲੇਖੈ ਵਾਟ ਚਲਾਈਆ ਲੇਖੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਵੇਖਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: lekhai vaatt chalaaeea lekhai sun vekhaau |
English: As it is pre-ordained, they walk along the way. As it is pre-ordained, they see and hear.

Gurbani: ਲੇਖੈ ਸਾਹ ਲਵਾਈਅਹਿ ਪੜੇ ਕਿ ਪੁਛਣ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: lekhai saah lavaaeeeh parre ki puchhan jaau |1|
English: As it is pre-ordained, they draw their breath. Why should I go and ask the scholars about this? ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਾਬਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਰਚਨਾ ਧੋਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: baabaa maaeaa rachanaa dhohu |
English: O Baba, the splendor of Maya is deceptive.

Gurbani: ਅੰਧੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਏਹ ਨ ਓਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: andhai naam visaariaa naa tis eeh na ohu |1| rahaau |
English: The blind man has forgotten the Name; he is in limbo, neither here nor there. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਣ ਮਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ ਏਥੈ ਖਾਜੈ ਕਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: jeevan maranaa jaae kai ethai khaajai kaal |
English: Life and death come to all who are born. Everything here gets devoured by Death.

Gurbani: ਜਿਥੈ ਬਹਿ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਤਿਥੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਚਲਿਓ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: jithai beh samajhaaeeai tithai koe na chalio naal |
English: He sits and examines the accounts, there where no one goes along with anyone.

Gurbani: ਰੋਵਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਜੇਤੜੇ ਸਭਿ ਬੰਨਹਿ ਪੰਡ ਪਰਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: rovan vaale jetarre sabh baneh pandd paraal |2|
English: Those who weep and wail might just as well all tie bundles of straw. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਆਖੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਨ ਆਖੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabh ko aakhai bahut bahut ghatt na aakhai koe |
English: Everyone says that God is the Greatest of the Great. No one calls Him any less.

Gurbani: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ਕਹਣਿ ਨ ਵਡਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: keemat kinai na paaeea kehan na vaddaa hoe |
English: No one can estimate His Worth. By speaking of Him, His Greatness is not increased.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਬੁ ਏਕੁ ਤੂ ਹੋਰਿ ਜੀਆ ਕੇਤੇ ਲੋਅ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: saachaa saahab ek too hor jeea kete loa |3|
English: You are the One True Lord and Master of all the other beings, of so many worlds. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨੀਚਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨੀਚ ਜਾਤਿ ਨੀਚੀ ਹੂ ਅਤਿ ਨੀਚੁ ॥
Transliteration: neechaa andar neech jaat neechee hoo at neech |
English: Nanak seeks the company of the lowest of the low class, the very lowest of the low.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਥਿ ਵਡਿਆ ਸਿਉ ਕਿਆ ਰੀਸ ॥
Transliteration: naanak tin kai sang saath vaddiaa siau kiaa rees |
English: Why should he try to compete with the great?

Gurbani: ਜਿਥੈ ਨੀਚ ਸਮਾਲੀਅਨਿ ਤਿਥੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਖਸੀਸ ॥੪॥੩॥
Transliteration: jithai neech samaaleean tithai nadar teree bakhasees |4|3|
English: In that place where the lowly are cared for-there, the Blessings of Your Glance of Grace rain down. ||4||3||

[Ang 15 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਲਬੁ ਕੁਤਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਚੂਹੜਾ ਠਗਿ ਖਾਧਾ ਮੁਰਦਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: lab kutaa koorr chooharraa tthag khaadhaa muradaar |
English: Greed is a dog; falsehood is a filthy street-sweeper. Cheating is eating a rotting carcass.

Gurbani: ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਪਰ ਮਲੁ ਮੁਖ ਸੁਧੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਚੰਡਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: par nindaa par mal mukh sudhee agan krodh chanddaal |
English: Slandering others is putting the filth of others into your own mouth. The fire of anger is the outcaste who burns dead bodies at the crematorium.

Gurbani: ਰਸ ਕਸ ਆਪੁ ਸਲਾਹਣਾ ਏ ਕਰਮ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ras kas aap salaahanaa e karam mere karataar |1|
English: I am caught in these tastes and flavors, and in self-conceited praise. These are my actions, O my Creator! ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਾਬਾ ਬੋਲੀਐ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: baabaa boleeai pat hoe |
English: O Baba, speak only that which will bring you honor.

Gurbani: ਊਤਮ ਸੇ ਦਰਿ ਊਤਮ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਨੀਚ ਕਰਮ ਬਹਿ ਰੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aootam se dar aootam kaheeeh neech karam beh roe |1| rahaau |
English: They alone are good, who are judged good at the Lord's Door. Those with bad karma can only sit and weep. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਰਸੁ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰਸੁ ਰੁਪਾ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਰਮਲ ਕੀ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: ras sueinaa ras rupaa kaaman ras paramal kee vaas |
English: The pleasures of gold and silver, the pleasures of women, the pleasure of the fragrance of sandalwood,

Gurbani: ਰਸੁ ਘੋੜੇ ਰਸੁ ਸੇਜਾ ਮੰਦਰ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਰਸੁ ਮਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: ras ghorre ras sejaa mandar ras meetthaa ras maas |
English: the pleasure of horses, the pleasure of a soft bed in a palace, the pleasure of sweet treats and the pleasure of hearty meals

Gurbani: ਏਤੇ ਰਸ ਸਰੀਰ ਕੇ ਕੈ ਘਟਿ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ete ras sareer ke kai ghatt naam nivaas |2|
English: -these pleasures of the human body are so numerous; how can the Naam, the Name of the Lord, find its dwelling in the heart? ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਬੋਲਿਐ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸੋ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: jit boliai pat paaeeai so boliaa paravaan |
English: Those words are acceptable, which, when spoken, bring honor.

Gurbani: ਫਿਕਾ ਬੋਲਿ ਵਿਗੁਚਣਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਮਨ ਅਜਾਣ ॥
Transliteration: fikaa bol viguchanaa sun moorakh man ajaan |
English: Harsh words bring only grief. Listen, O foolish and ignorant mind!

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਭਲੇ ਹੋਰਿ ਕਿ ਕਹਣ ਵਖਾਣ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jo tis bhaaveh se bhale hor ki kehan vakhaan |3|
English: Those who are pleasing to Him are good. What else is there to be said? ||3||

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਮਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਪਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਜਿਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: tin mat tin pat tin dhan palai jin hiradai rahiaa samaae |
English: Wisdom, honor and wealth are in the laps of those whose hearts remain permeated with the Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਅਵਰ ਸੁਆਲਿਉ ਕਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: tin kaa kiaa saalaahanaa avar suaaliau kaae |
English: What praise can be offered to them? What other adornments can be bestowed upon them?

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਬਾਹਰੇ ਰਾਚਹਿ ਦਾਨਿ ਨ ਨਾਇ ॥੪॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak nadaree baahare raacheh daan na naae |4|4|
English: O Nanak, those who lack the Lord's Glance of Grace cherish neither charity nor the Lord's Name. ||4||4||

[Ang 15 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਮਲੁ ਗਲੋਲਾ ਕੂੜ ਕਾ ਦਿਤਾ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: amal galolaa koorr kaa ditaa devanahaar |
English: The Great Giver has given the intoxicating drug of falsehood.

Gurbani: ਮਤੀ ਮਰਣੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਖੁਸੀ ਕੀਤੀ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: matee maran visaariaa khusee keetee din chaar |
English: The people are intoxicated; they have forgotten death, and they have fun for a few days.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਸੋਫੀਆ ਰਾਖਣ ਕਉ ਦਰਵਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sach miliaa tin sofeea raakhan kau daravaar |1|
English: Those who do not use intoxicants are true; they dwell in the Court of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੇ ਕਉ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak saache kau sach jaan |
English: O Nanak, know the True Lord as True.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਚਲੈ ਮਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jit seviai sukh paaeeai teree daragah chalai maan |1| rahaau |
English: Serving Him, peace is obtained; you shall go to His Court with honor. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸਰਾ ਗੁੜ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sach saraa gurr baaharaa jis vich sachaa naau |
English: The Wine of Truth is not fermented from molasses. The True Name is contained within it.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਹਿ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਜੇਤੜੇ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: suneh vakhaaneh jetarre hau tin balihaarai jaau |
English: I am a sacrifice to those who hear and chant the True Name.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਖੀਵਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਮਹਲੀ ਪਾਏ ਥਾਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: taa man kheevaa jaaneeai jaa mahalee paae thaau |2|
English: Only one who obtains a room in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is deemed to be truly intoxicated. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਾਉ ਨੀਰੁ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਸਤੁ ਪਰਮਲੁ ਤਨਿ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: naau neer changiaaeea sat paramal tan vaas |
English: Bathe in the waters of Goodness and apply the scented oil of Truth to your body,

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਮੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਉਜਲਾ ਲਖ ਦਾਤੀ ਇਕ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: taa mukh hovai ujalaa lakh daatee ik daat |
English: and your face shall become radiant. This is the gift of 100,000 gifts.

Gurbani: ਦੂਖ ਤਿਸੈ ਪਹਿ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਸੂਖ ਜਿਸੈ ਹੀ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: dookh tisai peh aakheeeh sookh jisai hee paas |3|
English: Tell your troubles to the One who is the Source of all comfort. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਪਰਾਣ ॥
Transliteration: so kiau manahu visaareeai jaa ke jeea paraan |
English: How can you forget the One who created your soul, and the praanaa, the breath of life?

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਭੁ ਅਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਹੈ ਜੇਤਾ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਖਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: tis vin sabh apavitru hai jetaa painan khaan |
English: Without Him, all that we wear and eat is impure.

Gurbani: ਹੋਰਿ ਗਲਾਂ ਸਭਿ ਕੂੜੀਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੫॥
Transliteration: hor galaan sabh koorreea tudh bhaavai paravaan |4|5|
English: Everything else is false. Whatever pleases Your Will is acceptable. ||4||5||

[Ang 16 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mehal 1 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਾਲਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਘਸਿ ਮਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਤਿ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jaal mohu ghas mas kar mat kaagad kar saar |
English: Burn emotional attachment, and grind it into ink. Transform your intelligence into the purest of paper.

Gurbani: ਭਾਉ ਕਲਮ ਕਰਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲੇਖਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਪੁਛਿ ਲਿਖੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: bhaau kalam kar chit lekhaaree gur puchh likh beechaar |
English: Make the love of the Lord your pen, and let your consciousness be the scribe. Then, seek the Guru's Instructions, and record these deliberations.

Gurbani: ਲਿਖੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਲਾਹ ਲਿਖੁ ਲਿਖੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: likh naam saalaah likh likh ant na paaraavaar |1|
English: Write the Praises of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; write over and over again that He has no end or limitation. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਾਬਾ ਏਹੁ ਲੇਖਾ ਲਿਖਿ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: baabaa ehu lekhaa likh jaan |
English: O Baba, write such an account,

Gurbani: ਜਿਥੈ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਤਿਥੈ ਹੋਇ ਸਚਾ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jithai lekhaa mangeeai tithai hoe sachaa neesaan |1| rahaau |
English: that when it is asked for, it will bring the Mark of Truth. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਥੈ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਸਦ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਸਦ ਚਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jithai mileh vaddiaaeea sad khuseea sad chaau |
English: There, where greatness, eternal peace and everlasting joy are bestowed,

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਮੁਖਿ ਟਿਕੇ ਨਿਕਲਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tin mukh ttike nikaleh jin man sachaa naau |
English: the faces of those whose minds are attuned to the True Name are anointed with the Mark of Grace.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਹੀ ਗਲੀ ਵਾਉ ਦੁਆਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: karam milai taa paaeeai naahee galee vaau duaau |2|
English: If one receives God's Grace, then such honors are received, and not by mere words. ||2||

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਉਠਿ ਰਖੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਵ ਸਲਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: eik aaveh ik jaeh utth rakheeeh naav salaar |
English: Some come, and some arise and depart. They give themselves lofty names.

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਮੰਗਤੇ ਇਕਨਾ ਵਡੇ ਦਰਵਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: eik upaae mangate ikanaa vadde daravaar |
English: Some are born beggars, and some hold vast courts.

Gurbani: ਅਗੈ ਗਇਆ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਵੇਕਾਰ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: agai geaa jaaneeai vin naavai vekaar |3|
English: Going to the world hereafter, everyone shall realize that without the Name, it is all useless. ||3||

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਡਰੁ ਅਗਲਾ ਖਪਿ ਖਪਿ ਛਿਜੈ ਦੇਹ ॥
Transliteration: bhai terai ddar agalaa khap khap chhijai deh |
English: I am terrified by the Fear of You, God. Bothered and bewildered, my body is wasting away.

Gurbani: ਨਾਵ ਜਿਨਾ ਸੁਲਤਾਨ ਖਾਨ ਹੋਦੇ ਡਿਠੇ ਖੇਹ ॥
Transliteration: naav jinaa sulataan khaan hode dditthe kheh |
English: Those who are known as sultans and emperors shall be reduced to dust in the end.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਠੀ ਚਲਿਆ ਸਭਿ ਕੂੜੇ ਤੁਟੇ ਨੇਹ ॥੪॥੬॥
Transliteration: naanak utthee chaliaa sabh koorre tutte neh |4|6|
English: O Nanak, arising and departing, all false attachments are cut away. ||4||6||

[Ang 16 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਮਿਠੇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਸਾਲੋਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: sabh ras mitthe maniai suniai saalone |
English: Believing, all tastes are sweet. Hearing, the salty flavors are tasted;

Gurbani: ਖਟ ਤੁਰਸੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਮਾਰਣ ਨਾਦ ਕੀਏ ॥
Transliteration: khatt turasee mukh bolanaa maaran naad kee |
English: chanting with one's mouth, the spicy flavors are savored. All these spices have been made from the Sound-current of the Naad.

Gurbani: ਛਤੀਹ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਾਉ ਏਕੁ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: chhateeh amrit bhaau ek jaa kau nadar karee |1|
English: The thirty-six flavors of ambrosial nectar are in the Love of the One Lord; they are tasted only by one who is blessed by His Glance of Grace. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਾਬਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਖੁਸੀ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: baabaa hor khaanaa khusee khuaar |
English: O Baba, the pleasures of other foods are false.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਖਾਧੈ ਤਨੁ ਪੀੜੀਐ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jit khaadhai tan peerreeai man meh chaleh vikaar |1| rahaau |
English: Eating them, the body is ruined, and wickedness and corruption enter into the mind. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਰਤਾ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਸੁਪੇਦੀ ਸਤੁ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: rataa painan man rataa supedee sat daan |
English: My mind is imbued with the Lord's Love; it is dyed a deep crimson. Truth and charity are my white clothes.

Gurbani: ਨੀਲੀ ਸਿਆਹੀ ਕਦਾ ਕਰਣੀ ਪਹਿਰਣੁ ਪੈਰ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: neelee siaahee kadaa karanee pahiran pair dhiaan |
English: Erasing the blackness of sin is my wearing of blue clothes, and meditation on the Lord's Lotus Feet is my robe of honor.

Gurbani: ਕਮਰਬੰਦੁ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਕਾ ਧਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kamaraband santokh kaa dhan joban teraa naam |2|
English: Contentment is my cummerbund, Your Name is my wealth and youth. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬਾਬਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਖੁਸੀ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: baabaa hor painan khusee khuaar |
English: O Baba, the pleasures of other clothes are false.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਪੈਧੈ ਤਨੁ ਪੀੜੀਐ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jit paidhai tan peerreeai man meh chaleh vikaar |1| rahaau |
English: Wearing them, the body is ruined, and wickedness and corruption enter into the mind. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਘੋੜੇ ਪਾਖਰ ਸੁਇਨੇ ਸਾਖਤਿ ਬੂਝਣੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਾਟ ॥
Transliteration: ghorre paakhar sueine saakhat boojhan teree vaatt |
English: The understanding of Your Way, Lord, is horses, saddles and bags of gold for me.

Gurbani: ਤਰਕਸ ਤੀਰ ਕਮਾਣ ਸਾਂਗ ਤੇਗਬੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਧਾਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: tarakas teer kamaan saang tegaband gun dhaat |
English: The pursuit of virtue is my bow and arrow, my quiver, sword and scabbard.

Gurbani: ਵਾਜਾ ਨੇਜਾ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਾਤਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: vaajaa nejaa pat siau paragatt karam teraa meree jaat |3|
English: To be distinguished with honor is my drum and banner. Your Mercy is my social status. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬਾਬਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਚੜਣਾ ਖੁਸੀ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: baabaa hor charranaa khusee khuaar |
English: O Baba, the pleasures of other rides are false.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਚੜਿਐ ਤਨੁ ਪੀੜੀਐ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jit charriai tan peerreeai man meh chaleh vikaar |1| rahaau |
English: By such rides, the body is ruined, and wickedness and corruption enter into the mind. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਖੁਸੀ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: ghar mandar khusee naam kee nadar teree paravaar |
English: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the pleasure of houses and mansions. Your Glance of Grace is my family, Lord.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸੋਈ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਸੀ ਹੋਰੁ ਆਖਣੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: hukam soee tudh bhaavasee hor aakhan bahut apaar |
English: The Hukam of Your Command is the pleasure of Your Will, Lord. To say anything else is far beyond anyone's reach.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਪੂਛਿ ਨ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak sachaa paatisaahu poochh na kare beechaar |4|
English: O Nanak, the True King does not seek advice from anyone else in His decisions. ||4||

Gurbani: ਬਾਬਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਸਉਣਾ ਖੁਸੀ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: baabaa hor saunaa khusee khuaar |
English: O Baba, the pleasure of other sleep is false.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਸੁਤੈ ਤਨੁ ਪੀੜੀਐ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥੪॥੭॥
Transliteration: jit sutai tan peerreeai man meh chaleh vikaar |1| rahaau |4|7|
English: By such sleep, the body is ruined, and wickedness and corruption enter into the mind. ||1||Pause||4||7||

[Ang 17 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕੁੰਗੂ ਕੀ ਕਾਂਇਆ ਰਤਨਾ ਕੀ ਲਲਿਤਾ ਅਗਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਤਨਿ ਸਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: kungoo kee kaaneaa ratanaa kee lalitaa agar vaas tan saas |
English: With the body of saffron, and the tongue a jewel, and the breath of the body pure fragrant incense;

Gurbani: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਕਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਟਿਕਾ ਤਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਮਤਿ ਵਿਗਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: atthasatth teerath kaa mukh ttikaa tith ghatt mat vigaas |
English: with the face anointed at the sixty-eight holy places of pilgrimage, and the heart illuminated with wisdom

Gurbani: ਓਤੁ ਮਤੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ot matee saalaahanaa sach naam gunataas |1|
English: -with that wisdom, chant the Praises of the True Name, the Treasure of Excellence. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਾਬਾ ਹੋਰ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਰ ਹੋਰ ॥
Transliteration: baabaa hor mat hor hor |
English: O Baba, other wisdom is useless and irrelevant.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਵੇਰ ਕਮਾਈਐ ਕੂੜੈ ਕੂੜਾ ਜੋਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: je sau ver kamaaeeai koorrai koorraa jor |1| rahaau |
English: If falsehood is practiced a hundred times, it is still false in its effects. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪੂਜ ਲਗੈ ਪੀਰੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: pooj lagai peer aakheeai sabh milai sansaar |
English: You may be worshipped and adored as a Pir (a spiritual teacher); you may be welcomed by all the world;

Gurbani: ਨਾਉ ਸਦਾਏ ਆਪਣਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਿਧੁ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: naau sadaae aapanaa hovai sidh sumaar |
English: you may adopt a lofty name, and be known to have supernatural spiritual powers

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਪਤਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਸਭਾ ਪੂਜ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jaa pat lekhai naa pavai sabhaa pooj khuaar |2|
English: -even so, if you are not accepted in the Court of the Lord, then all this adoration is false. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਥਾਪਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jin kau satigur thaapiaa tin mett na sakai koe |
English: No one can overthrow those who have been established by the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਓਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੋ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: onaa andar naam nidhaan hai naamo paragatt hoe |
English: The Treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is within them, and through the Naam, they are radiant and famous.

Gurbani: ਨਾਉ ਪੂਜੀਐ ਨਾਉ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਅਖੰਡੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naau poojeeai naau maneeai akhandd sadaa sach soe |3|
English: They worship the Naam, and they believe in the Naam. The True One is forever Intact and Unbroken. ||3||

Gurbani: ਖੇਹੂ ਖੇਹ ਰਲਾਈਐ ਤਾ ਜੀਉ ਕੇਹਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: khehoo kheh ralaaeeai taa jeeo kehaa hoe |
English: When the body mingles with dust, what happens to the soul?

Gurbani: ਜਲੀਆ ਸਭਿ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਉਠੀ ਚਲਿਆ ਰੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jaleea sabh siaanapaa utthee chaliaa roe |
English: All clever tricks are burnt away, and you shall depart crying.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਐ ਦਰਿ ਗਇਆ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੮॥
Transliteration: naanak naam visaariai dar geaa kiaa hoe |4|8|
English: O Nanak, those who forget the Naam-what will happen when they go to the Court of the Lord? ||4||8||

[Ang 17 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਵੀਥਰੈ ਅਉਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਝੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: gunavantee gun veetharai aaugunavantee jhoor |
English: The virtuous wife exudes virtue; the unvirtuous suffer in misery.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਵਰੁ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਨਹ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਪਿਰ ਕੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: je lorreh var kaamanee neh mileeai pir koor |
English: If you long for your Husband Lord, O soul-bride, you must know that He is not met by falsehood.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਬੇੜੀ ਨਾ ਤੁਲਹੜਾ ਨਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਿਰੁ ਦੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naa berree naa tulaharraa naa paaeeai pir door |1|
English: No boat or raft can take you to Him. Your Husband Lord is far away. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਅਡੋਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: mere tthaakur poorai takhat addol |
English: My Lord and Master is Perfect; His Throne is Eternal and Immovable.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਾਚੁ ਅਤੋਲੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh pooraa je kare paaeeai saach atol |1| rahaau |
English: One who attains perfection as Gurmukh, obtains the Immeasurable True Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਰਿਮੰਦਰੁ ਸੋਹਣਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਣਕ ਲਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: prabh harimandar sohanaa tis meh maanak laal |
English: The Palace of the Lord God is so beautiful.

Gurbani: ਮੋਤੀ ਹੀਰਾ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਕੰਚਨ ਕੋਟ ਰੀਸਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: motee heeraa niramalaa kanchan kott reesaal |
English: Within it, there are gems, rubies, pearls and flawless diamonds. A fortress of gold surrounds this Source of Nectar.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਪਉੜੀ ਗੜਿ ਕਿਉ ਚੜਉ ਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਨ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bin paurree garr kiau chrrau gur har dhiaan nihaal |2|
English: How can I climb up to the Fortress without a ladder? By meditating on the Lord, through the Guru, I am blessed and exalted. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਉੜੀ ਬੇੜੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਲਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur paurree berree guroo gur tulahaa har naau |
English: The Guru is the Ladder, the Guru is the Boat, and the Guru is the Raft to take me to the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਦਰੀਆਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur sar saagar bohitho gur teerath dareeaau |
English: The Guru is the Boat to carry me across the world-ocean; the Guru is the Sacred Shrine of Pilgrimage, the Guru is the Holy River.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਊਜਲੀ ਸਤ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਵਣ ਜਾਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: je tis bhaavai aoojalee sat sar naavan jaau |3|
English: If it pleases Him, I bathe in the Pool of Truth, and become radiant and pure. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੋ ਪੂਰੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਪੂਰੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: pooro pooro aakheeai poorai takhat nivaas |
English: He is called the Most Perfect of the Perfect. He sits upon His Perfect Throne.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਥਾਨਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੈ ਪੂਰੈ ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: poorai thaan suhaavanai poorai aas niraas |
English: He looks so Beautiful in His Perfect Place. He fulfills the hopes of the hopeless.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਾ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਕਿਉ ਘਾਟੈ ਗੁਣ ਤਾਸ ॥੪॥੯॥
Transliteration: naanak pooraa je milai kiau ghaattai gun taas |4|9|
English: O Nanak, if one obtains the Perfect Lord, how can his virtues decrease? ||4||9||

[Ang 17 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਵਹੁ ਭੈਣੇ ਗਲਿ ਮਿਲਹ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਹੇਲੜੀਆਹ ॥
Transliteration: aavahu bhaine gal milah ank sahelarreeaah |
English: Come, my dear sisters and spiritual companions; hug me close in your embrace.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਕੈ ਕਰਹ ਕਹਾਣੀਆ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥ ਕੰਤ ਕੀਆਹ ॥
Transliteration: mil kai karah kahaaneea samrath kant keeaah |
English: Let's join together, and tell stories of our All-powerful Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਭਿ ਗੁਣ ਅਉਗਣ ਸਭਿ ਅਸਾਹ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saache saahib sabh gun aaugan sabh asaah |1|
English: All Virtues are in our True Lord and Master; we are utterly without virtue. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਜੋਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: karataa sabh ko terai jor |
English: O Creator Lord, all are in Your Power.

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਜਾ ਤੂ ਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ek sabad beechaareeai jaa too taa kiaa hor |1| rahaau |
English: I dwell upon the One Word of the Shabad. You are mine-what else do I need? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਾਇ ਪੁਛਹੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਤੁਸੀ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਕਿਨੀ ਗੁਣਂੀ ॥
Transliteration: jaae puchhahu sohaaganee tusee raaviaa kinee gunanee |
English: Go, and ask the happy soul-brides, "By what virtuous qualities do you enjoy your Husband Lord?"

Gurbani: ਸਹਜਿ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੀਆ ਮਿਠਾ ਬੋਲਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj santokh seegaareea mitthaa bolanee |
English: "We are adorned with intuitive ease, contentment and sweet words.

Gurbani: ਪਿਰੁ ਰੀਸਾਲੂ ਤਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: pir reesaaloo taa milai jaa gur kaa sabad sunee |2|
English: We meet with our Beloved, the Source of Joy, when we listen to the Word of the Guru's Shabad." ||2||

Gurbani: ਕੇਤੀਆ ਤੇਰੀਆ ਕੁਦਰਤੀ ਕੇਵਡ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: keteea tereea kudaratee kevadd teree daat |
English: You have so many Creative Powers, Lord; Your Bountiful Blessings are so Great.

Gurbani: ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: kete tere jeea jant sifat kareh din raat |
English: So many of Your beings and creatures praise You day and night.

Gurbani: ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਕੇਤੇ ਜਾਤਿ ਅਜਾਤਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kete tere roop rang kete jaat ajaat |3|
English: You have so many forms and colors, so many classes, high and low. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਚ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sach milai sach aoopajai sach meh saach samaae |
English: Meeting the True One, Truth wells up. The truthful are absorbed into the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਊਗਵੈ ਗੁਰਬਚਨੀ ਭਉ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: surat hovai pat aoogavai gurabachanee bhau khaae |
English: Intuitive understanding is obtained and one is welcomed with honor, through the Guru's Word, filled with the Fear of God.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: naanak sachaa paatisaahu aape le milaae |4|10|
English: O Nanak, the True King absorbs us into Himself. ||4||10||

[Ang 18 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਭਲੀ ਸਰੀ ਜਿ ਉਬਰੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੁਈ ਘਰਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: bhalee saree ji ubaree haumai muee gharaahu |
English: It all worked out-I was saved, and the egotism within my heart was subdued.

Gurbani: ਦੂਤ ਲਗੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: doot lage fir chaakaree satigur kaa vesaahu |
English: The evil energies have been made to serve me, since I placed my faith in the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਕਲਪ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਬਾਦਿ ਹੈ ਸਚਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kalap tiaagee baad hai sachaa veparavaahu |1|
English: I have renounced my useless schemes, by the Grace of the True, Carefree Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਭਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man re sach milai bhau jaae |
English: O mind, meeting with the True One, fear departs.

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕਿਉ ਥੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhai bin nirbhau kiau theeai guramukh sabad samaae |1| rahaau |
English: Without the Fear of God, how can anyone become fearless? Become Gurmukh, and immerse yourself in the Shabad. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕੇਤਾ ਆਖਣੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਆਖਣਿ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: ketaa aakhan aakheeai aakhan tott na hoe |
English: How can we describe Him with words? There is no end to the descriptions of Him.

Gurbani: ਮੰਗਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਕੇਤੜੇ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: mangan vaale ketarre daataa eko soe |
English: There are so many beggars, but He is the only Giver.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਪਰਾਣ ਹੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jis ke jeea paraan hai man vasiai sukh hoe |2|
English: He is the Giver of the soul, and the praanaa, the breath of life; when He dwells within the mind, there is peace. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਗੁ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਬਾਜੀ ਬਨੀ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਖੇਲੁ ਖੇਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jag supanaa baajee banee khin meh khel khelaae |
English: The world is a drama, staged in a dream. In a moment, the play is played out.

Gurbani: ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਏਕਸੇ ਵਿਜੋਗੀ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sanjogee mil ekase vijogee utth jaae |
English: Some attain union with the Lord, while others depart in separation.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jo tis bhaanaa so theeai avar na karanaa jaae |3|
English: Whatever pleases Him comes to pass; nothing else can be done. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਵੇਸਾਹੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh vasat vesaaheeai sach vakhar sach raas |
English: The Gurmukhs purchase the Genuine Article. The True Merchandise is purchased with the True Capital.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: jinee sach vananjiaa gur poore saabaas |
English: Those who purchase this True Merchandise through the Perfect Guru are blessed.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਸਤੁ ਪਛਾਣਸੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਉਦਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: naanak vasat pachhaanasee sach saudaa jis paas |4|11|
English: O Nanak, one who stocks this True Merchandise shall recognize and realize the Genuine Article. ||4||11||

[Ang 18 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mehal 1 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਧਾਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਫੁਨਿ ਧਾਤੁ ਕਉ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: dhaat milai fun dhaat kau sifatee sifat samaae |
English: As metal merges with metal, those who chant the Praises of the Lord are absorbed into the Praiseworthy Lord.

Gurbani: ਲਾਲੁ ਗੁਲਾਲੁ ਗਹਬਰਾ ਸਚਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: laal gulaal gahabaraa sachaa rang charraau |
English: Like the poppies, they are dyed in the deep crimson color of Truthfulness.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਏਕੈ ਭਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sach milai santokheea har jap ekai bhaae |1|
English: Those contented souls who meditate on the Lord with single-minded love, meet the True Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: bhaaee re sant janaa kee ren |
English: O Siblings of Destiny, become the dust of the feet of the humble Saints.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਧੇਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sant sabhaa gur paaeeai mukat padaarath dhen |1| rahaau |
English: In the Society of the Saints, the Guru is found. He is the Treasure of Liberation, the Source of all good fortune. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਊਚਉ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਾ ਊਪਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: aoochau thaan suhaavanaa aoopar mehal muraar |
English: Upon that Highest Plane of Sublime Beauty, stands the Mansion of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਦੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: sach karanee de paaeeai dar ghar mehal piaar |
English: By true actions, this human body is obtained, and the door within ourselves which leads to the Mansion of the Beloved, is found.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: guramukh man samajhaaeeai aatam raam beechaar |2|
English: The Gurmukhs train their minds to contemplate the Lord, the Supreme Soul. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਈਅਹਿ ਆਸ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: tribidh karam kamaaeeeh aas andesaa hoe |
English: By actions committed under the influence of the three qualities, hope and anxiety are produced.

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਛੁਟਸੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: kiau gur bin trikuttee chhuttasee sehaj miliai sukh hoe |
English: Without the Guru, how can anyone be released from these three qualities? Through intuitive wisdom, we meet with Him and find peace.

Gurbani: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: nij ghar mehal pachhaaneeai nadar kare mal dhoe |3|
English: Within the home of the self, the Mansion of His Presence is realized when He bestows His Glance of Grace and washes away our pollution. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਉ ਘਰ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: bin gur mail na utarai bin har kiau ghar vaas |
English: Without the Guru, this pollution is not removed. Without the Lord, how can there be any homecoming?

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਅਵਰ ਤਿਆਗੈ ਆਸ ॥
Transliteration: eko sabad veechaareeai avar tiaagai aas |
English: Contemplate the One Word of the Shabad, and abandon other hopes.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਈਐ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਸੁ ॥੪॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: naanak dekh dikhaaeeai hau sad balihaarai jaas |4|12|
English: O Nanak, I am forever a sacrifice to the one who beholds, and inspires others to behold Him. ||4||12||

[Ang 18 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਮੁਠੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: dhrig jeevan dohaaganee mutthee doojai bhaae |
English: The life of the discarded bride is cursed. She is deceived by the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਕਲਰ ਕੇਰੀ ਕੰਧ ਜਿਉ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਕਿਰਿ ਢਹਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kalar keree kandh jiau ahinis kir dteh paae |
English: Like a wall of sand, day and night, she crumbles, and eventually, she breaks down altogether.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bin sabadai sukh naa theeai pir bin dookh na jaae |1|
English: Without the Word of the Shabad, peace does not come. Without her Husband Lord, her suffering does not end. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੁੰਧੇ ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਆ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: mundhe pir bin kiaa seegaar |
English: O soul-bride, without your Husband Lord, what good are your decorations?

Gurbani: ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਢੋਈ ਨ ਲਹੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਝੂਠੁ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dar ghar dtoee na lahai daragah jhootth khuaar |1| rahaau |
English: In this world, you shall not find any shelter; in the world hereafter, being false, you shall suffer. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਨ ਭੁਲਈ ਸਚਾ ਵਡ ਕਿਰਸਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: aap sujaan na bhulee sachaa vadd kirasaan |
English: The True Lord Himself knows all; He makes no mistakes. He is the Great Farmer of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਾਧਿ ਕੈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇ ਦਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: pahilaa dharatee saadh kai sach naam de daan |
English: First, He prepares the ground, and then He plants the Seed of the True Name.

Gurbani: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਏਕੁ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਵੈ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: nau nidh upajai naam ek karam pavai neesaan |2|
English: The nine treasures are produced from Name of the One Lord. By His Grace, we obtain His Banner and Insignia. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਜਾਣਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਕਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਚਜੁ ਅਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur kau jaan na jaanee kiaa tis chaj achaar |
English: Some are very knowledgeable, but if they do not know the Guru, then what is the use of their lives?

Gurbani: ਅੰਧੁਲੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: andhulai naam visaariaa manamukh andh gubaar |
English: The blind have forgotten the Naam, the Name of the Lord. The self-willed manmukhs are in utter darkness.

Gurbani: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aavan jaan na chukee mar janamai hoe khuaar |3|
English: Their comings and goings in reincarnation do not end; through death and rebirth, they are wasting away. ||3||

Gurbani: ਚੰਦਨੁ ਮੋਲਿ ਅਣਾਇਆ ਕੁੰਗੂ ਮਾਂਗ ਸੰਧੂਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: chandan mol anaaeaa kungoo maang sandhoor |
English: The bride may buy sandalwood oil and perfumes, and apply them in great quantities to her hair;

Gurbani: ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਬਹੁ ਘਣਾ ਪਾਨਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਕਪੂਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: choaa chandan bahu ghanaa paanaa naal kapoor |
English: she may sweeten her breath with betel leaf and camphor,

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਧਨ ਕੰਤਿ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ਤ ਸਭਿ ਅਡੰਬਰ ਕੂੜੁ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: je dhan kant na bhaavee ta sabh addanbar koorr |4|
English: but if this bride is not pleasing to her Husband Lord, then all these trappings are false. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣ ਬਾਦਿ ਹਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: sabh ras bhogan baad heh sabh seegaar vikaar |
English: Her enjoyment of all pleasures is futile, and all her decorations are corrupt.

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਭੇਦੀਐ ਕਿਉ ਸੋਹੈ ਗੁਰਦੁਆਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jab lag sabad na bhedeeai kiau sohai guraduaar |
English: Until she has been pierced through with the Shabad, how can she look beautiful at Guru's Gate?

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨ ਸਹ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੫॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: naanak dhan suhaaganee jin seh naal piaar |5|13|
English: O Nanak, blessed is that fortunate bride, who is in love with her Husband Lord. ||5||13||

[Ang 19 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਞੀ ਦੇਹ ਡਰਾਵਣੀ ਜਾ ਜੀਉ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sunyee deh ddaraavanee jaa jeeo vichahu jaae |
English: The empty body is dreadful, when the soul goes out from within.

Gurbani: ਭਾਹਿ ਬਲੰਦੀ ਵਿਝਵੀ ਧੂਉ ਨ ਨਿਕਸਿਓ ਕਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhaeh balandee vijhavee dhooau na nikasio kaae |
English: The burning fire of life is extinguished, and the smoke of the breath no longer emerges.

Gurbani: ਪੰਚੇ ਰੁੰਨੇ ਦੁਖਿ ਭਰੇ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: panche rune dukh bhare binase doojai bhaae |1|
English: The five relatives (the senses) weep and wail painfully, and waste away through the love of duality. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੂੜੇ ਰਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: moorre raam japahu gun saar |
English: You fool: chant the Name of the Lord, and preserve your virtue.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਸਭ ਮੁਠੀ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: haumai mamataa mohanee sabh mutthee ahankaar |1| rahaau |
English: Egotism and possessiveness are very enticing; egotistical pride has plundered everyone. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਦੂਜੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: jinee naam visaariaa doojee kaarai lag |
English: Those who have forgotten the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are attached to affairs of duality.

Gurbani: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਲਾਗੇ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: dubidhaa laage pach mue antar trisanaa ag |
English: Attached to duality, they putrefy and die; they are filled with the fire of desire within.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਹੋਰਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਧੰਧੈ ਠਗਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur raakhe se ubare hor mutthee dhandhai tthag |2|
English: Those who are protected by the Guru are saved; all others are cheated and plundered by deceitful worldly affairs. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮੁਈ ਪਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਗਇਆ ਮੁਆ ਵੈਰੁ ਵਿਰੋਧੁ ॥
Transliteration: muee pareet piaar geaa muaa vair virodh |
English: Love dies, and affection vanishes. Hatred and alienation die.

Gurbani: ਧੰਧਾ ਥਕਾ ਹਉ ਮੁਈ ਮਮਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ॥
Transliteration: dhandhaa thakaa hau muee mamataa maaeaa krodh |
English: Entanglements end, and egotism dies, along with attachment to Maya, possessiveness and anger.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰੋਧੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: karam milai sach paaeeai guramukh sadaa nirodh |3|
English: Those who receive His Mercy obtain the True One. The Gurmukhs dwell forever in balanced restraint. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sachee kaarai sach milai guramat palai paae |
English: By true actions, the True Lord is met, and the Guru's Teachings are found.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਨਰੁ ਜੰਮੈ ਨਾ ਮਰੈ ਨਾ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: so nar jamai naa marai naa aavai naa jaae |
English: Then, they are not subject to birth and death; they do not come and go in reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਿ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਸੋ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: naanak dar paradhaan so darageh paidhaa jaae |4|14|
English: O Nanak, they are respected at the Lord's Gate; they are robed in honor in the Court of the Lord. ||4||14||

[Ang 19 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mehal 1 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਜਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਮਾਟੀ ਭਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਨੂਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: tan jal bal maattee bheaa man maaeaa mohi manoor |
English: The body is burnt to ashes; by its love of Maya, the mind is rusted through.

Gurbani: ਅਉਗਣ ਫਿਰਿ ਲਾਗੂ ਭਏ ਕੂਰਿ ਵਜਾਵੈ ਤੂਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: aaugan fir laagoo bhe koor vajaavai toor |
English: Demerits become one's enemies, and falsehood blows the bugle of attack.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਭਰਮਾਈਐ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਡੋਬੇ ਪੂਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bin sabadai bharamaaeeai dubidhaa ddobe poor |1|
English: Without the Word of the Shabad, people wander lost in reincarnation. Through the love of duality, multitudes have been drowned. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਰਹੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man re sabad tarahu chit laae |
English: O mind, swim across, by focusing your consciousness on the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝਿਆ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jin guramukh naam na boojhiaa mar janamai aavai jaae |1| rahaau |
English: Those who do not become Gurmukh do not understand the Naam; they die, and continue coming and going in reincarnation. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਸੂਚਾ ਸੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tan soochaa so aakheeai jis meh saachaa naau |
English: That body is said to be pure, in which the True Name abides.

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhai sach raatee dehuree jihavaa sach suaau |
English: One whose body is imbued with the Fear of the True One, and whose tongue savors Truthfulness,

Gurbani: ਸਚੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀਐ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਤਾਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sachee nadar nihaaleeai bahurr na paavai taau |2|
English: is brought to ecstasy by the True Lord's Glance of Grace. That person does not have to go through the fire of the womb again. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੇ ਤੇ ਪਵਨਾ ਭਇਆ ਪਵਨੈ ਤੇ ਜਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: saache te pavanaa bheaa pavanai te jal hoe |
English: From the True Lord came the air, and from the air came water.

Gurbani: ਜਲ ਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jal te tribhavan saajiaa ghatt ghatt jot samoe |
English: From water, He created the three worlds; in each and every heart He has infused His Light.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: niramal mailaa naa theeai sabad rate pat hoe |3|
English: The Immaculate Lord does not become polluted. Attuned to the Shabad, honor is obtained. ||3||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਸੰਤੋਖਿਆ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: eihu man saach santokhiaa nadar kare tis maeh |
English: One whose mind is contented with Truthfulness, is blessed with the Lord's Glance of Grace.

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਭੂਤ ਸਚਿ ਭੈ ਰਤੇ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਚੀ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: panch bhoot sach bhai rate jot sachee man maeh |
English: The body of the five elements is dyed in the Fear of the True One; the mind is filled with the True Light.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਉਗਣ ਵੀਸਰੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਪਤਿ ਤਾਹਿ ॥੪॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: naanak aaugan veesare gur raakhe pat taeh |4|15|
English: O Nanak, your demerits shall be forgotten; the Guru shall preserve your honor. ||4||15||

[Ang 20 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬੇੜੀ ਸਚ ਕੀ ਤਰੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: naanak berree sach kee tareeai gur veechaar |
English: O Nanak, the Boat of Truth will ferry you across; contemplate the Guru.

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਜਾਵਹੀ ਪੂਰਿ ਭਰੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: eik aaveh ik jaavahee poor bhare ahankaar |
English: Some come, and some go; they are totally filled with egotism.

Gurbani: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਮਤੀ ਬੂਡੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੁ ਤਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: manahatth matee booddeeai guramukh sach su taar |1|
English: Through stubborn-mindedness, the intellect is drowned; one who becomes Gurmukh and truthful is saved. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਤਰੀਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur bin kiau tareeai sukh hoe |
English: Without the Guru, how can anyone swim across to find peace?

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖੁ ਤੂ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jiau bhaavai tiau raakh too mai avar na doojaa koe |1| rahaau |
English: As it pleases You, Lord, You save me. There is no other for me at all. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਗੈ ਦੇਖਉ ਡਉ ਜਲੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਹਰਿਓ ਅੰਗੂਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: aagai dekhau ddau jalai paachhai hario angoor |
English: In front of me, I see the jungle burning; behind me, I see green plants sprouting.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੈ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਚੁ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jis te upajai tis te binasai ghatt ghatt sach bharapoor |
English: We shall merge into the One from whom we came. The True One is pervading each and every heart.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੀ ਸਾਚੈ ਮਹਲਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aape mel milaavahee saachai mehal hadoor |2|
English: He Himself unites us in Union with Himself; the True Mansion of His Presence is close at hand. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਾਹਿ ਸਾਹਿ ਤੁਝੁ ਸੰਮਲਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਸਾਰੇਉ ॥
Transliteration: saeh saeh tujh samalaa kade na visaareo |
English: With each and every breath, I dwell upon You; I shall never forget You.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਸਾਹਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੇਉ ॥
Transliteration: jiau jiau saahab man vasai guramukh amrit peo |
English: The more the Lord and Master dwells within the mind, the more the Gurmukh drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਧਣੀ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਸਮੇਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: man tan teraa too dhanee garab nivaar sameo |3|
English: Mind and body are Yours; You are my Master. Please rid me of my pride, and let me merge with You. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਕਰਿ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jin ehu jagat upaaeaa tribhavan kar aakaar |
English: The One who formed this universe created the creation of the three worlds.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh chaanan jaaneeai manamukh mugadh gubaar |
English: The Gurmukh knows the Divine Light, while the foolish self-willed manmukh gropes around in the darkness.

Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰੀ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt jot nirantaree boojhai guramat saar |4|
English: One who sees that Light within each and every heart understands the Essence of the Guru's Teachings. ||4||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਕੀਚੈ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh jinee jaaniaa tin keechai saabaas |
English: Those who understand are Gurmukh; recognize and applaud them.

Gurbani: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਲਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: sache setee ral mile sache gun paragaas |
English: They meet and merge with the True One. They become the Radiant Manifestation of the Excellence of the True One.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੫॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: naanak naam santokheea jeeo pindd prabh paas |5|16|
English: O Nanak, they are contented with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. They offer their bodies and souls to God. ||5||16||

[Ang 20 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਮਿਲੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਹੈ ਏਹ ॥
Transliteration: sun man mitr piaariaa mil velaa hai eh |
English: Listen, O my mind, my friend, my darling: now is the time to meet the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਸਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਦੇਹ ॥
Transliteration: jab lag joban saas hai tab lag ihu tan deh |
English: As long as there is youth and breath, give this body to Him.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਢਹਿ ਢੇਰੀ ਤਨੁ ਖੇਹ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bin gun kaam na aavee dteh dteree tan kheh |1|
English: Without virtue, it is useless; the body shall crumble into a pile of dust. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: mere man lai laahaa ghar jaeh |
English: O my mind, earn the profit, before you return home.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਨਿਵਰੀ ਭਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh naam salaaheeai haumai nivaree bhaeh |1| rahaau |
English: The Gurmukh praises the Naam, and the fire of egotism is extinguished. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੰਢਣੁ ਗੰਢੀਐ ਲਿਖਿ ਪੜਿ ਬੁਝਹਿ ਭਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sun sun gandtan gandteeai likh parr bujheh bhaar |
English: Again and again, we hear and tell stories; we read and write and understand loads of knowledge,

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਅਗਲੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: trisanaa ahinis agalee haumai rog vikaar |
English: but still, desires increase day and night, and the disease of egotism fills us with corruption.

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਅਤੋਲਵਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ohu veparavaahu atolavaa guramat keemat saar |2|
English: That Carefree Lord cannot be appraised; His Real Value is known only through the Wisdom of the Guru's Teachings. ||2||

Gurbani: ਲਖ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਜੇ ਕਰੀ ਲਖ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: lakh siaanap je karee lakh siau preet milaap |
English: Even if someone has hundreds of thousands of clever mental tricks, and the love and company of hundreds of thousands of people

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਨ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੀਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੂਖ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: bin sangat saadh na dhraapeea bin naavai dookh santaap |
English: still, without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he will not feel satisfied. Without the Name, all suffer in sorrow.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਅਰੇ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚੀਨੈ ਆਪੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har jap jeeare chhutteeai guramukh cheenai aap |3|
English: Chanting the Name of the Lord, O my soul, you shall be emancipated; as Gurmukh, you shall come to understand your own self. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਵੇਚਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਸਿਰੁ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: tan man gur peh vechiaa man deea sir naal |
English: I have sold my body and mind to the Guru, and I have given my mind and head as well.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਢੰਢੋਲਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਜਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: tribhavan khoj dtandtoliaa guramukh khoj nihaal |
English: I was seeking and searching for Him throughout the three worlds; then, as Gurmukh, I sought and found Him.

Gurbani: ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੪॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: satagur mel milaaeaa naanak so prabh naal |4|17|
English: The True Guru has united me in Union, O Nanak, with that God. ||4||17||

[Ang 20 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਰਣੈ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਨਹੀ ਜੀਵਣ ਕੀ ਨਹੀ ਆਸ ॥
Transliteration: maranai kee chintaa nahee jeevan kee nahee aas |
English: I have no anxiety about dying, and no hope of living.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਹੀ ਲੇਖੈ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: too sarab jeea pratipaalahee lekhai saas giraas |
English: You are the Cherisher of all beings; You keep the account of our breaths and morsels of food.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤੂ ਵਸਹਿ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਨਿਰਜਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
