Transliteration: antar guramukh too vaseh jiau bhaavai tiau nirajaas |1|
English: You abide within the Gurmukh. As it pleases You, You decide our allotment. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੀਅਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਜਪਤ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: jeeare raam japat man maan |
English: O my soul, chant the Name of the Lord; the mind will be pleased and appeased.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਜਲਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: antar laagee jal bujhee paaeaa guramukh giaan |1| rahaau |
English: The raging fire within is extinguished; the Gurmukh obtains spiritual wisdom. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਸੰਕ ਉਤਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: antar kee gat jaaneeai gur mileeai sank utaar |
English: Know the state of your inner being; meet with the Guru and get rid of your skepticism.

Gurbani: ਮੁਇਆ ਜਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਤਿਤੁ ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਮਰੁ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: mueaa jit ghar jaaeeai tith jeevadiaa mar maar |
English: To reach your True Home after you die, you must conquer death while you are still alive.

Gurbani: ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: anahad sabad suhaavane paaeeai gur veechaar |2|
English: The beautiful, Unstruck Sound of the Shabad is obtained, contemplating the Guru. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਣੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਤਹ ਹਉਮੈ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: anahad baanee paaeeai teh haumai hoe binaas |
English: The Unstruck Melody of Gurbani is obtained, and egotism is eliminated.

Gurbani: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੈ ਤਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: satagur seve aapanaa hau sad kurabaanai taas |
English: I am forever a sacrifice to those who serve their True Guru.

Gurbani: ਖੜਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਨਾਈਐ ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kharr daragah painaaeeai mukh har naam nivaas |3|
English: They are dressed in robes of honor in the Court of the Lord; the Name of the Lord is on their lips. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਕਾ ਮੇਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: jeh dekhaa teh rav rahe siv sakatee kaa mel |
English: Wherever I look, I see the Lord pervading there, in the union of Shiva and Shakti, of consciousness and matter.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਬੰਧੀ ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਜੋ ਆਇਆ ਜਗਿ ਸੋ ਖੇਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: trihu gun bandhee dehuree jo aaeaa jag so khel |
English: The three qualities hold the body in bondage; whoever comes into the world is subject to their play.

Gurbani: ਵਿਜੋਗੀ ਦੁਖਿ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਲਹਹਿ ਨ ਮੇਲੁ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: vijogee dukh vichhurre manamukh laheh na mel |4|
English: Those who separate themselves from the Lord wander lost in misery. The self-willed manmukhs do not attain union with Him. ||4||

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਘਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਚ ਭੈ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: man bairaagee ghar vasai sach bhai raataa hoe |
English: If the mind becomes balanced and detached, and comes to dwell in its own true home, imbued with the Fear of God,

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨ ਮਹਾਰਸੁ ਭੋਗਵੈ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: giaan mahaaras bhogavai baahurr bhookh na hoe |
English: then it enjoys the essence of supreme spiritual wisdom; it shall never feel hunger again.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲੁ ਭੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: naanak ihu man maar mil bhee fir dukh na hoe |5|18|
English: O Nanak, conquer and subdue this mind; meet with the Lord, and you shall never again suffer in pain. ||5||18||

[Ang 21 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਏਹੁ ਮਨੋ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਲੋਭੀਆ ਲੋਭੇ ਲਗਾ ਲੋੁਭਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: ehu mano moorakh lobheea lobhe lagaa luobhaan |
English: This foolish mind is greedy; through greed, it becomes even more attached to greed.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਸਾਕਤਾ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਆਵਨੁ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: sabad na bheejai saakataa duramat aavan jaan |
English: The evil-minded shaaktas, the faithless cynics, are not attuned to the Shabad; they come and go in reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saadhoo satagur je milai taa paaeeai gunee nidhaan |1|
English: One who meets with the Holy True Guru finds the Treasure of Excellence. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਛੋਡਿ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: man re haumai chhodd gumaan |
English: O mind, renounce your egotistical pride.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਤੂ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har gur saravar sev too paaveh daragah maan |1| rahaau |
English: Serve the Lord, the Guru, the Sacred Pool, and you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam jap dinas raat guramukh har dhan jaan |
English: Chant the Name of the Lord day and night; become Gurmukh, and know the Wealth of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣੇ ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: sabh sukh har ras bhogane sant sabhaa mil giaan |
English: All comforts and peace, and the Essence of the Lord, are enjoyed by acquiring spiritual wisdom in the Society of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਨਿਤਿ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: nit ahinis har prabh seviaa satagur deea naam |2|
English: Day and night, continually serve the Lord God; the True Guru has given the Naam. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕੂਕਰ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਪਚੈ ਪਚਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: kookar koorr kamaaeeai gur nindaa pachai pachaan |
English: Those who practice falsehood are dogs; those who slander the Guru shall burn in their own fire.

Gurbani: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਰੈ ਖੁਲਹਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: bharame bhoolaa dukh ghano jam maar karai khulahaan |
English: They wander lost and confused, deceived by doubt, suffering in terrible pain. The Messenger of Death shall beat them to a pulp.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਸੁਭਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: manamukh sukh na paaeeai guramukh sukh subhaan |3|
English: The self-willed manmukhs find no peace, while the Gurmukhs are wondrously joyful. ||3||

Gurbani: ਐਥੈ ਧੰਧੁ ਪਿਟਾਈਐ ਸਚੁ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: aithai dhandh pittaaeeai sach likhat paravaan |
English: In this world, people are engrossed in false pursuits, but in the world hereafter, only the account of your true actions is accepted.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਦਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਰਣੀ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: har sajan gur sevadaa gur karanee paradhaan |
English: The Guru serves the Lord, His Intimate Friend. The Guru's actions are supremely exalted.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਸਚੈ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: naanak naam na veesarai karam sachai neesaan |4|19|
English: O Nanak, never forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the True Lord shall bless you with His Mark of Grace. ||4||19||

[Ang 21 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਵਡਾ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: eik til piaaraa veesarai rog vaddaa man maeh |
English: Forgetting the Beloved, even for a moment, the mind is afflicted with terrible diseases.

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਨ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: kiau daragah pat paaeeai jaa har na vasai man maeh |
English: How can honor be attained in His Court, if the Lord does not dwell in the mind?

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur miliai sukh paaeeai agan marai gun maeh |1|
English: Meeting with the Guru, peace is found. The fire is extinguished in His Glorious Praises. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: man re ahinis har gun saar |
English: O mind, enshrine the Praises of the Lord, day and night.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jin khin pal naam na veesarai te jan virale sansaar |1| rahaau |
English: One who does not forget the Naam, for a moment or even an instant-how rare is such a person in this world! ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈਐ ਸੁਰਤੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: jotee jot milaaeeai suratee surat sanjog |
English: When one's light merges into the Light, and one's intuitive consciousness is joined with the Intuitive Consciousness,

Gurbani: ਹਿੰਸਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਤੁ ਗਏ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਹਸਾ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: hinsaa haumai gat ge naahee sahasaa sog |
English: then one's cruel and violent instincts and egotism depart, and skepticism and sorrow are taken away.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: guramukh jis har man vasai tis mele gur sanjog |2|
English: The Lord abides within the mind of the Gurmukh, who merges in the Lord's Union, through the Guru. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਜੇ ਕਰੀ ਭੋਗੇ ਭੋਗਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa kaaman je karee bhoge bhoganahaar |
English: If I surrender my body like a bride, the Enjoyer will enjoy me.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਨ ਕੀਜਈ ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਚਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: tis siau nehu na keejee jo deesai chalanahaar |
English: Do not make love with one who is just a passing show.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਵਹਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਜ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: guramukh raveh sohaaganee so prabh sej bhataar |3|
English: The Gurmukh is ravished like the pure and happy bride on the Bed of God, her Husband. ||3||

Gurbani: ਚਾਰੇ ਅਗਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਮਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: chaare agan nivaar mar guramukh har jal paae |
English: The Gurmukh puts out the four fires, with the Water of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਭਰਿਆ ਅਘਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: antar kamal pragaasiaa amrit bhariaa aghaae |
English: The lotus blossoms deep within the heart, and filled with Ambrosial Nectar, one is satisfied.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੀਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: naanak satagur meet kar sach paaveh daragah jaae |4|20|
English: O Nanak, make the True Guru your friend; going to His Court, you shall obtain the True Lord. ||4||20||

[Ang 22 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਹੁ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: har har japahu piaariaa guramat le har bol |
English: Meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, O my beloved; follow the Guru's Teachings, and speak of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਸਚ ਕਸਵਟੀ ਲਾਈਐ ਤੁਲੀਐ ਪੂਰੈ ਤੋਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: man sach kasavattee laaeeai tuleeai poorai tol |
English: Apply the Touchstone of Truth to your mind, and see if it comes up to its full weight.

Gurbani: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਰਿਦ ਮਾਣਕ ਮੋਲਿ ਅਮੋਲਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: keemat kinai na paaeeai rid maanak mol amol |1|
English: No one has found the worth of the ruby of the heart; its value cannot be estimated. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹੀਰਾ ਗੁਰ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: bhaaee re har heeraa gur maeh |
English: O Siblings of Destiny, the Diamond of the Lord is within the Guru.

Gurbani: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: satasangat satagur paaeeai ahinis sabad salaeh |1| rahaau |
English: The True Guru is found in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. Day and night, praise the Word of His Shabad. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਲੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: sach vakhar dhan raas lai paaeeai gur paragaas |
English: The True Merchandise, Wealth and Capital are obtained through the Radiant Light of the Guru.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਰੈ ਜਲਿ ਪਾਇਐ ਤਿਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: jiau agan marai jal paaeiai tiau trisanaa daasan daas |
English: Just as fire is extinguished by pouring on water, desire becomes the slave of the Lord's slaves.

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਇਉ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰੈ ਤਰਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jam jandaar na lagee iau bhaujal tarai taraas |2|
English: The Messenger of Death will not touch you; in this way, you shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean, carrying others across with you. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਚ ਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh koorr na bhaavee sach rate sach bhaae |
English: The Gurmukhs do not like falsehood. They are imbued with Truth; they love only Truth.

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ਕੂੜੈ ਕੂੜੀ ਪਾਂਇ ॥
Transliteration: saakat sach na bhaavee koorrai koorree paane |
English: The shaaktas, the faithless cynics, do not like the Truth; false are the foundations of the false.

Gurbani: ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਿਐ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sach rate gur meliai sache sach samaae |3|
English: Imbued with Truth, you shall meet the Guru. The true ones are absorbed into the True Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਹੀਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: man meh maanak laal naam ratan padaarath heer |
English: Within the mind are emeralds and rubies, the Jewel of the Naam, treasures and diamonds.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sach vakhar dhan naam hai ghatt ghatt gahir ganbheer |
English: The Naam is the True Merchandise and Wealth; in each and every heart, His Presence is deep and profound.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹੀਰੁ ॥੪॥੨੧॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh paaeeai deaa kare har heer |4|21|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh finds the Diamond of the Lord, by His Kindness and Compassion. ||4||21||

[Ang 22 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਭਰਮੇ ਭਾਹਿ ਨ ਵਿਝਵੈ ਜੇ ਭਵੈ ਦਿਸੰਤਰ ਦੇਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: bharame bhaeh na vijhavai je bhavai disantar des |
English: The fire of doubt is not extinguished, even by wandering through foreign lands and countries.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਵੇਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: antar mail na utarai dhrig jeevan dhrig ves |
English: If inner filth is not removed, one's life is cursed, and one's clothes are cursed.

Gurbani: ਹੋਰੁ ਕਿਤੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਉਪਦੇਸ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: hor kitai bhagat na hovee bin satigur ke upades |1|
English: There is no other way to perform devotional worship, except through the Teachings of the True Guru. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: man re guramukh agan nivaar |
English: O mind, become Gurmukh, and extinguish the fire within.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa kahiaa man vasai haumai trisanaa maar |1| rahaau |
English: Let the Words of the Guru abide within your mind; let egotism and desires die. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਨਿਰਮੋਲੁ ਹੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man maanak niramol hai raam naam pat paae |
English: The jewel of the mind is priceless; through the Name of the Lord, honor is obtained.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: mil satasangat har paaeeai guramukh har liv laae |
English: Join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and find the Lord. The Gurmukh embraces love for the Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਲਲੈ ਸਲਲ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aap geaa sukh paaeaa mil salalai salal samaae |2|
English: Give up your selfishness, and you shall find peace; like water mingling with water, you shall merge in absorption. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਸੁ ਅਉਗੁਣਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jin har har naam na chetio su aaugun aavai jaae |
English: Those who have not contemplated the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, are unworthy; they come and go in reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਸੁ ਭਉਜਲਿ ਪਚੈ ਪਚਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jis satagur purakh na bhettio su bhaujal pachai pachaae |
English: One who has not met with the True Guru, the Primal Being, is bothered and bewildered in the terrifying world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਜੀਉ ਨਿਰਮੋਲੁ ਹੈ ਇਉ ਕਉਡੀ ਬਦਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: eihu maanak jeeo niramol hai iau kauddee badalai jaae |3|
English: This jewel of the soul is priceless, and yet it is being squandered like this, in exchange for a mere shell. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿੰਨਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਰਸਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਪੁਰਖ ਸੁਜਾਣ ॥
Transliteration: jinaa satagur ras milai se poore purakh sujaan |
English: Those who joyfully meet with the True Guru are perfectly fulfilled and wise.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਲੰਘੀਐ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur mil bhaujal langheeai daragah pat paravaan |
English: Meeting with the Guru, they cross over the terrifying world-ocean. In the Court of the Lord, they are honored and approved.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੨੨॥
Transliteration: naanak te mukh ujale dhun upajai sabad neesaan |4|22|
English: O Nanak, their faces are radiant; the Music of the Shabad, the Word of God, wells up within them. ||4||22||

[Ang 22 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਹੋ ਵਖਰੁ ਲੇਹੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: vanaj karahu vanajaariho vakhar lehu samaal |
English: Make your deals, dealers, and take care of your merchandise.

Gurbani: ਤੈਸੀ ਵਸਤੁ ਵਿਸਾਹੀਐ ਜੈਸੀ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: taisee vasat visaaheeai jaisee nibahai naal |
English: Buy that object which will go along with you.

Gurbani: ਅਗੈ ਸਾਹੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਲੈਸੀ ਵਸਤੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: agai saahu sujaan hai laisee vasat samaal |1|
English: In the next world, the All-knowing Merchant will take this object and care for it. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਰਾਮੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhaaee re raam kahahu chit laae |
English: O Siblings of Destiny, chant the Lord's Name, and focus your consciousness on Him.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਲੈ ਚਲਹੁ ਸਹੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਪਤੀਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har jas vakhar lai chalahu sahu dekhai pateeae |1| rahaau |
English: Take the Merchandise of the Lord's Praises with you. Your Husband Lord shall see this and approve. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਾ ਰਾਸਿ ਨ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਉ ਤਿਨਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jinaa raas na sach hai kiau tinaa sukh hoe |
English: Those who do not have the Assets of Truth-how can they find peace?

Gurbani: ਖੋਟੈ ਵਣਜਿ ਵਣੰਜਿਐ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਖੋਟਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: khottai vanaj vananjiai man tan khottaa hoe |
English: By dealing their deals of falsehood, their minds and bodies become false.

Gurbani: ਫਾਹੀ ਫਾਥੇ ਮਿਰਗ ਜਿਉ ਦੂਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਨਿਤ ਰੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: faahee faathe mirag jiau dookh ghano nit roe |2|
English: Like the deer caught in the trap, they suffer in terrible agony; they continually cry out in pain. ||2||

Gurbani: ਖੋਟੇ ਪੋਤੈ ਨਾ ਪਵਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: khotte potai naa paveh tin har gur daras na hoe |
English: The counterfeit coins are not put into the Treasury; they do not obtain the Blessed Vision of the Lord-Guru.

Gurbani: ਖੋਟੇ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਪਤਿ ਹੈ ਖੋਟਿ ਨ ਸੀਝਸਿ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: khotte jaat na pat hai khott na seejhas koe |
English: The false ones have no social status or honor. No one succeeds through falsehood.

Gurbani: ਖੋਟੇ ਖੋਟੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਆਇ ਗਇਆ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: khotte khott kamaavanaa aae geaa pat khoe |3|
English: Practicing falsehood again and again, people come and go in reincarnation, and forfeit their honor. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਲਾਹ ॥
Transliteration: naanak man samajhaaeeai gur kai sabad saalaah |
English: O Nanak, instruct your mind through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and praise the Lord.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਿਆ ਭਾਰੁ ਨ ਭਰਮੁ ਤਿਨਾਹ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam rang ratiaa bhaar na bharam tinaah |
English: Those who are imbued with the love of the Name of the Lord are not loaded down by doubt.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਅਗਲਾ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹਰਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਹ ॥੪॥੨੩॥
Transliteration: har jap laahaa agalaa nirbhau har man maah |4|23|
English: Those who chant the Name of the Lord earn great profits; the Fearless Lord abides within their minds. ||4||23||

[Ang 23 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ghar 2 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Second House:

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਅਰੁ ਫੁਲੜਾ ਨਾਠੀਅੜੇ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: dhan joban ar fularraa naattheearre din chaar |
English: Wealth, the beauty of youth and flowers are guests for only a few days.

Gurbani: ਪਬਣਿ ਕੇਰੇ ਪਤ ਜਿਉ ਢਲਿ ਢੁਲਿ ਜੁੰਮਣਹਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: paban kere pat jiau dtal dtul junmanahaar |1|
English: Like the leaves of the water-lily, they wither and fade and finally die. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਿ ਲੈ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜਾ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਨਉ ਹੁਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: rang maan lai piaariaa jaa joban nau hulaa |
English: Be happy, dear beloved, as long as your youth is fresh and delightful.

Gurbani: ਦਿਨ ਥੋੜੜੇ ਥਕੇ ਭਇਆ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ ਚੋਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: din thorrarre thake bheaa puraanaa cholaa |1| rahaau |
English: But your days are few-you have grown weary, and now your body has grown old. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਜਣ ਮੇਰੇ ਰੰਗੁਲੇ ਜਾਇ ਸੁਤੇ ਜੀਰਾਣਿ ॥
Transliteration: sajan mere rangule jaae sute jeeraan |
English: My playful friends have gone to sleep in the graveyard.

Gurbani: ਹੰ ਭੀ ਵੰਞਾ ਡੁਮਣੀ ਰੋਵਾ ਝੀਣੀ ਬਾਣਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: han bhee vanyaa ddumanee rovaa jheenee baan |2|
English: In my double-mindedness, I shall have to go as well. I cry in a feeble voice. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕੀ ਨ ਸੁਣੇਹੀ ਗੋਰੀਏ ਆਪਣ ਕੰਨੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: kee na sunehee goree aapan kanee soe |
English: Haven't you heard the call from beyond, O beautiful soul-bride?

Gurbani: ਲਗੀ ਆਵਹਿ ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਨਿਤ ਨ ਪੇਈਆ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: lagee aaveh saahurai nit na peeea hoe |3|
English: You must go to your in-laws; you cannot stay with your parents forever. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਤੀ ਪੇਈਐ ਜਾਣੁ ਵਿਰਤੀ ਸੰਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: naanak sutee peeeai jaan viratee san |
English: O Nanak, know that she who sleeps in her parents' home is plundered in broad daylight.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣਾ ਗਵਾਈ ਗੰਠੜੀ ਅਵਗਣ ਚਲੀ ਬੰਨਿ ॥੪॥੨੪॥
Transliteration: gunaa gavaaee ganttharree avagan chalee ban |4|24|
English: She has lost her bouquet of merits; gathering one of demerits, she departs. ||4||24||

[Ang 23 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ਦੂਜਾ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ghar doojaa 2 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Second House:

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਰਸੀਆ ਆਪਿ ਰਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਰਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape raseea aap ras aape raavanahaar |
English: He Himself is the Enjoyer, and He Himself is the Enjoyment. He Himself is the Ravisher of all.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਚੋਲੜਾ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਜ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aape hovai cholarraa aape sej bhataar |1|
English: He Himself is the Bride in her dress, He Himself is the Bridegroom on the bed. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: rang rataa meraa saahib rav rahiaa bharapoor |1| rahaau |
English: My Lord and Master is imbued with love; He is totally permeating and pervading all. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮਾਛੀ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਣੀ ਜਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape maachhee machhulee aape paanee jaal |
English: He Himself is the fisherman and the fish; He Himself is the water and the net.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਲ ਮਣਕੜਾ ਆਪੇ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਲਾਲੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aape jaal manakarraa aape andar laal |2|
English: He Himself is the sinker, and He Himself is the bait. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਰੰਗੁਲਾ ਸਖੀਏ ਮੇਰਾ ਲਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape bahu bidh rangulaa sakhee meraa laal |
English: He Himself loves in so many ways. O sister soul-brides, He is my Beloved.

Gurbani: ਨਿਤ ਰਵੈ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਦੇਖੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਹਾਲੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: nit ravai sohaaganee dekh hamaaraa haal |3|
English: He continually ravishes and enjoys the happy soul-brides; just look at the plight I am in without Him! ||3||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਤੂ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਤੂ ਹੰਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: pranavai naanak benatee too saravar too hans |
English: Prays Nanak, please hear my prayer: You are the pool, and You are the soul-swan.

Gurbani: ਕਉਲੁ ਤੂ ਹੈ ਕਵੀਆ ਤੂ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸੁ ॥੪॥੨੫॥
Transliteration: kaul too hai kaveea too hai aape vekh vigas |4|25|
English: You are the lotus flower of the day and You are the water-lily of the night. You Yourself behold them, and blossom forth in bliss. ||4||25||

[Ang 23 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ghar 3 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Third House:

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਰਤੀ ਬੀਜੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕਰੋ ਸਲਿਲ ਆਪਾਉ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਪਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: eihu tan dharatee beej karamaa karo salil aapaau saaringapaanee |
English: Make this body the field, and plant the seed of good actions. Water it with the Name of the Lord, who holds all the world in His Hands.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਕਿਰਸਾਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਜੰਮਾਇ ਲੈ ਇਉ ਪਾਵਸਿ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: man kirasaan har ridai jamaae lai iau paavas pad nirabaanee |1|
English: Let your mind be the farmer; the Lord shall sprout in your heart, and you shall attain the state of Nirvaanaa. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੇ ਗਰਬਸਿ ਮੂੜੇ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kaahe garabas moorre maaeaa |
English: You fool! Why are you so proud of Maya?

Gurbani: ਪਿਤ ਸੁਤੋ ਸਗਲ ਕਾਲਤ੍ਰ ਮਾਤਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਹੋਹਿ ਨ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਇਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: pit suto sagal kaalatr maataa tere hohi na ant sakhaaeaa | rahaau |
English: Father, children, spouse, mother and all relatives-they shall not be your helpers in the end. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਦੁਸਟ ਕਿਰਖਾ ਕਰੇ ਇਨ ਤਜਿ ਆਤਮੈ ਹੋਇ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: bikhai bikaar dusatt kirakhaa kare in taj aatamai hoe dhiaaee |
English: So weed out evil, wickedness and corruption; leave these behind, and let your soul meditate on God.

Gurbani: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਹੋਹਿ ਜਬ ਰਾਖੇ ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਮਧੁ ਆਸ੍ਰਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jap tap sanjam hohi jab raakhe kamal bigasai madh aasramaaee |2|
English: When chanting, austere meditation and self-discipline become your protectors, then the lotus blossoms forth, and the honey trickles out. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬੀਸ ਸਪਤਾਹਰੋ ਬਾਸਰੋ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ ਤੀਨਿ ਖੋੜਾ ਨਿਤ ਕਾਲੁ ਸਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: bees sapataaharo baasaro sangrahai teen khorraa nit kaal saarai |
English: Bring the twenty-seven elements of the body under your control, and throughout the three stages of life, remember death.

Gurbani: ਦਸ ਅਠਾਰ ਮੈ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੋ ਚੀਨੈ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਇਵ ਏਕੁ ਤਾਰੈ ॥੩॥੨੬॥
Transliteration: das atthaar mai aparanparo cheenai kahai naanak iv ek taarai |3|26|
English: See the Infinite Lord in the ten directions, and in all the variety of nature. Says Nanak, in this way, the One Lord shall carry you across. ||3||26||

[Ang 24 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ghar 3 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Third House:

Gurbani: ਅਮਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਬੀਜੁ ਸਬਦੋ ਕਰਿ ਸਚ ਕੀ ਆਬ ਨਿਤ ਦੇਹਿ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: amal kar dharatee beej sabado kar sach kee aab nit dehi paanee |
English: Make good deeds the soil, and let the Word of the Shabad be the seed; irrigate it continually with the water of Truth.

Gurbani: ਹੋਇ ਕਿਰਸਾਣੁ ਈਮਾਨੁ ਜੰਮਾਇ ਲੈ ਭਿਸਤੁ ਦੋਜਕੁ ਮੂੜੇ ਏਵ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: hoe kirasaan eemaan jamaae lai bhisat dojak moorre ev jaanee |1|
English: Become such a farmer, and faith will sprout. This brings knowledge of heaven and hell, you fool! ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਤੁ ਜਾਣ ਸਹਿ ਗਲੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: mat jaan seh galee paaeaa |
English: Do not think that your Husband Lord can be obtained by mere words.

Gurbani: ਮਾਲ ਕੈ ਮਾਣੈ ਰੂਪ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਇਤੁ ਬਿਧੀ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: maal kai maanai roop kee sobhaa it bidhee janam gavaaeaa |1| rahaau |
English: You are wasting this life in the pride of wealth and the splendor of beauty. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਐਬ ਤਨਿ ਚਿਕੜੋ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੀਡਕੋ ਕਮਲ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨਹੀ ਮੂਲਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aib tan chikarro ihu man meeddako kamal kee saar nahee mool paaee |
English: The defect of the body which leads to sin is the mud puddle, and this mind is the frog, which does not appreciate the lotus flower at all.

Gurbani: ਭਉਰੁ ਉਸਤਾਦੁ ਨਿਤ ਭਾਖਿਆ ਬੋਲੇ ਕਿਉ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਾ ਨਹ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bhaur usataad nit bhaakhiaa bole kiau boojhai jaa neh bujhaaee |2|
English: The bumble bee is the teacher who continually teaches the lesson. But how can one understand, unless one is made to understand? ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਖਣੁ ਸੁਨਣਾ ਪਉਣ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aakhan sunanaa paun kee baanee ihu man rataa maaeaa |
English: This speaking and listening is like the song of the wind, for those whose minds are colored by the love of Maya.

Gurbani: ਖਸਮ ਕੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਦਿਲਹਿ ਪਸਿੰਦੇ ਜਿਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: khasam kee nadar dileh pasinde jinee kar ek dhiaaeaa |3|
English: The Grace of the Master is bestowed upon those who meditate on Him alone. They are pleasing to His Heart. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤੀਹ ਕਰਿ ਰਖੇ ਪੰਜ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਥੀ ਨਾਉ ਸੈਤਾਨੁ ਮਤੁ ਕਟਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: teeh kar rakhe panj kar saathee naau saitaan mat katt jaaee |
English: You may observe the thirty fasts, and say the five prayers each day, but 'Satan' can undo them.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ ਰਾਹਿ ਪੈ ਚਲਣਾ ਮਾਲੁ ਧਨੁ ਕਿਤ ਕੂ ਸੰਜਿਆਹੀ ॥੪॥੨੭॥
Transliteration: naanak aakhai raeh pai chalanaa maal dhan kit koo sanjiaahee |4|27|
English: Says Nanak, you will have to walk on the Path of Death, so why do you bother to collect wealth and property? ||4||27||

[Ang 24 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ghar 4 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Fourth House:

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਮਉਲਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗੁ ਮਉਲਿਆ ਹਰਿਆ ਕੀਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: soee maulaa jin jag mauliaa hariaa keea sansaaro |
English: He is the Master who has made the world bloom; He makes the Universe blossom forth, fresh and green.

Gurbani: ਆਬ ਖਾਕੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਰਹਾਈ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aab khaak jin bandh rahaaee dhan sirajanahaaro |1|
English: He holds the water and the land in bondage. Hail to the Creator Lord! ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਰਣਾ ਮੁਲਾ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: maranaa mulaa maranaa |
English: Death, O Mullah-death will come,

Gurbani: ਭੀ ਕਰਤਾਰਹੁ ਡਰਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhee karataarahu ddaranaa |1| rahaau |
English: so live in the Fear of God the Creator. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਤੂ ਮੁਲਾ ਤਾ ਤੂ ਕਾਜੀ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਖੁਦਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: taa too mulaa taa too kaajee jaaneh naam khudaaee |
English: You are a Mullah, and you are a Qazi, only when you know the Naam, the Name of God.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰਾ ਪੜਿਆ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਕੋ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਭਰੀਐ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: je bahuteraa parriaa hoveh ko rahai na bhareeai paaee |2|
English: You may be very educated, but no one can remain when the measure of life is full. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਕਾਜੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੁ ਤਜਿਆ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੀਆ ਆਧਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: soee kaajee jin aap tajiaa ik naam keea aadhaaro |
English: He alone is a Qazi, who renounces selfishness and conceit, and makes the One Name his Support.

Gurbani: ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਜਾਸੀ ਸਚਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: hai bhee hosee jaae na jaasee sachaa sirajanahaaro |3|
English: The True Creator Lord is, and shall always be. He was not born; He shall not die. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪੰਜ ਵਖਤ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਗੁਜਾਰਹਿ ਪੜਹਿ ਕਤੇਬ ਕੁਰਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: panj vakhat nivaaj gujaareh parreh kateb kuraanaa |
English: You may chant your prayers five times each day; you may read the Bible and the Koran.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ ਗੋਰ ਸਦੇਈ ਰਹਿਓ ਪੀਣਾ ਖਾਣਾ ॥੪॥੨੮॥
Transliteration: naanak aakhai gor sadeee rahio peenaa khaanaa |4|28|
English: Says Nanak, the grave is calling you, and now your food and drink are finished. ||4||28||

[Ang 24 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ghar 4 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Fourth House:

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਸੁਆਨੁ ਦੁਇ ਸੁਆਨੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: ek suaan due suaanee naal |
English: The dogs of greed are with me.

Gurbani: ਭਲਕੇ ਭਉਕਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਬਇਆਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: bhalake bhaukeh sadaa beaal |
English: In the early morning, they continually bark at the wind.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜੁ ਛੁਰਾ ਮੁਠਾ ਮੁਰਦਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: koorr chhuraa mutthaa muradaar |
English: Falsehood is my dagger; through deception, I eat the carcasses of the dead.

Gurbani: ਧਾਣਕ ਰੂਪਿ ਰਹਾ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dhaanak roop rahaa karataar |1|
English: I live as a wild hunter, O Creator! ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਪਤਿ ਕੀ ਪੰਦਿ ਨ ਕਰਣੀ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: mai pat kee pand na karanee kee kaar |
English: I have not followed good advice, nor have I done good deeds.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਬਿਗੜੈ ਰੂਪਿ ਰਹਾ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: hau bigarrai roop rahaa bikaraal |
English: I am deformed and horribly disfigured.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਾਰੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: teraa ek naam taare sansaar |
English: Your Name alone, Lord, saves the world.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਏਹਾ ਆਸ ਏਹੋ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mai ehaa aas eho aadhaar |1| rahaau |
English: This is my hope; this is my support. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੁਖਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਆਖਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: mukh nindaa aakhaa din raat |
English: With my mouth I speak slander, day and night.

Gurbani: ਪਰ ਘਰੁ ਜੋਹੀ ਨੀਚ ਸਨਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: par ghar johee neech sanaat |
English: I spy on the houses of others-I am such a wretched low-life!

Gurbani: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਤਨਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਚੰਡਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh tan vaseh chanddaal |
English: Unfulfilled sexual desire and unresolved anger dwell in my body, like the outcasts who cremate the dead.

Gurbani: ਧਾਣਕ ਰੂਪਿ ਰਹਾ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: dhaanak roop rahaa karataar |2|
English: I live as a wild hunter, O Creator! ||2||

Gurbani: ਫਾਹੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਲੂਕੀ ਵੇਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: faahee surat malookee ves |
English: I make plans to trap others, although I appear gentle.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਠਗਵਾੜਾ ਠਗੀ ਦੇਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: hau tthagavaarraa tthagee des |
English: I am a robber-I rob the world.

Gurbani: ਖਰਾ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਭਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: kharaa siaanaa bahutaa bhaar |
English: I am very clever-I carry loads of sin.

Gurbani: ਧਾਣਕ ਰੂਪਿ ਰਹਾ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: dhaanak roop rahaa karataar |3|
English: I live as a wild hunter, O Creator! ||3||

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਕੀਤਾ ਨ ਜਾਤਾ ਹਰਾਮਖੋਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: mai keetaa na jaataa haraamakhor |
English: I have not appreciated what You have done for me, Lord; I take from others and exploit them.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਦੇਸਾ ਦੁਸਟੁ ਚੋਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: hau kiaa muhu desaa dusatt chor |
English: What face shall I show You, Lord? I am a sneak and a thief.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak neech kahai beechaar |
English: Nanak describes the state of the lowly.

Gurbani: ਧਾਣਕ ਰੂਪਿ ਰਹਾ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੪॥੨੯॥
Transliteration: dhaanak roop rahaa karataar |4|29|
English: I live as a wild hunter, O Creator! ||4||29||

[Ang 24 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ghar 4 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Fourth House:

Gurbani: ਏਕਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਜੇਤੇ ਹੈ ਜੀਅ ॥
Transliteration: ekaa surat jete hai jeea |
English: There is one awareness among all created beings.

Gurbani: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਵਿਹੂਣਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕੀਅ ॥
Transliteration: surat vihoonaa koe na keea |
English: None have been created without this awareness.

Gurbani: ਜੇਹੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਤੇਹਾ ਤਿਨ ਰਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: jehee surat tehaa tin raahu |
English: As is their awareness, so is their way.

Gurbani: ਲੇਖਾ ਇਕੋ ਆਵਹੁ ਜਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: lekhaa iko aavahu jaahu |1|
English: According to the account of our actions, we come and go in reincarnation. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੇ ਜੀਅ ਕਰਹਿ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kaahe jeea kareh chaturaaee |
English: Why, O soul, do you try such clever tricks?

Gurbani: ਲੇਵੈ ਦੇਵੈ ਢਿਲ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: levai devai dtil na paaee |1| rahaau |
English: Taking away and giving back, God does not delay. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਤੋਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: tere jeea jeea kaa tohi |
English: All beings belong to You; all beings are Yours. O Lord and Master,

Gurbani: ਕਿਤ ਕਉ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਆਵਹਿ ਰੋਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: kit kau saahib aaveh rohi |
English: how can You become angry with them?

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਤੂ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਆਵਹਿ ਰੋਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: je too saahib aaveh rohi |
English: Even if You, O Lord and Master, become angry with them,

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਓਨਾ ਕਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਓਹਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: too onaa kaa tere ohi |2|
English: still, You are theirs, and they are Yours. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਸੀ ਬੋਲਵਿਗਾੜ ਵਿਗਾੜਹ ਬੋਲ ॥
Transliteration: asee bolavigaarr vigaarrah bol |
English: We are foul-mouthed; we spoil everything with our foul words.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਨਦਰੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤੋਲਹਿ ਤੋਲ ॥
Transliteration: too nadaree andar toleh tol |
English: You weigh us in the balance of Your Glance of Grace.

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਕਰਣੀ ਤਹ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: jeh karanee teh pooree mat |
English: When one's actions are right, the understanding is perfect.

Gurbani: ਕਰਣੀ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਘਟੇ ਘਟਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: karanee baajhahu ghatte ghatt |3|
English: Without good deeds, it becomes more and more deficient. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: pranavat naanak giaanee kaisaa hoe |
English: Prays Nanak, what is the nature of the spiritual people?

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aap pachhaanai boojhai soe |
English: They are self-realized; they understand God.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaad kare beechaar |
English: By Guru's Grace, they contemplate Him;

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੩੦॥
Transliteration: so giaanee daragah paravaan |4|30|
English: such spiritual people are honored in His Court. ||4||30||

[Ang 25 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ghar 4 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Fourth House:

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਦਾਨਾ ਬੀਨਾ ਮੈ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਕੈਸੇ ਅੰਤੁ ਲਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: too dareeaau daanaa beenaa mai machhulee kaise ant lahaa |
English: You are the River, All-knowing and All-seeing. I am just a fish-how can I find Your limit?

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਤੂ ਹੈ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਨਿਕਸੀ ਫੂਟਿ ਮਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jeh jeh dekhaa teh teh too hai tujh te nikasee foott maraa |1|
English: Wherever I look, You are there. Outside of You, I would burst and die. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਮੇਉ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਜਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: n jaanaa meo na jaanaa jaalee |
English: I do not know of the fisherman, and I do not know of the net.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਾ ਤੁਝੈ ਸਮਾਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaa dukh laagai taa tujhai samaalee |1| rahaau |
English: But when the pain comes, then I call upon You. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਮੈ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: too bharapoor jaaniaa mai door |
English: You are present everywhere. I had thought that You were far away.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਛੁ ਕਰੀ ਸੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jo kachh karee su terai hadoor |
English: Whatever I do, I do in Your Presence.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਹਉ ਮੁਕਰਿ ਪਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: too dekheh hau mukar paau |
English: You see all my actions, and yet I deny them.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੈ ਕੰਮਿ ਨ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: terai kam na terai naae |2|
English: I have not worked for You, or Your Name. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੇਤਾ ਦੇਹਿ ਤੇਤਾ ਹਉ ਖਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jetaa dehi tetaa hau khaau |
English: Whatever You give me, that is what I eat.

Gurbani: ਬਿਆ ਦਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: biaa dar naahee kai dar jaau |
English: There is no other door-unto which door should I go?

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਏਕ ਕਹੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: naanak ek kahai aradaas |
English: Nanak offers this one prayer:

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jeeo pindd sabh terai paas |3|
English: this body and soul are totally Yours. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਨੇੜੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪੇ ਮੰਝਿ ਮਿਆਨੋੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape nerrai door aape hee aape manjh miaanuo |
English: He Himself is near, and He Himself is far away; He Himself is in-between.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਸੁਣੇ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਹਾਨੋੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape vekhai sune aape hee kudarat kare jahaanuo |
English: He Himself beholds, and He Himself listens. By His Creative Power, He created the world.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸੋਈ ਪਰਵਾਨੋੁ ॥੪॥੩੧॥
Transliteration: jo tis bhaavai naanakaa hukam soee paravaanuo |4|31|
English: Whatever pleases Him, O Nanak-that Command is acceptable. ||4||31||

[Ang 25 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ghar 4 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Fourth House:

Gurbani: ਕੀਤਾ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: keetaa kahaa kare man maan |
English: Why should the created beings feel pride in their minds?

Gurbani: ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੇ ਕੈ ਹਥਿ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: devanahaare kai hath daan |
English: The Gift is in the Hands of the Great Giver.

Gurbani: ਭਾਵੈ ਦੇਇ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhaavai dee na deee soe |
English: As it pleases Him, He may give, or not give.

Gurbani: ਕੀਤੇ ਕੈ ਕਹਿਐ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: keete kai kahiai kiaa hoe |1|
English: What can be done by the order of the created beings? ||1||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਚੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਚੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape sach bhaavai tis sach |
English: He Himself is True; Truth is pleasing to His Will.

Gurbani: ਅੰਧਾ ਕਚਾ ਕਚੁ ਨਿਕਚੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: andhaa kachaa kach nikach |1| rahaau |
English: The spiritually blind are unripe and imperfect, inferior and worthless. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਰੁਖ ਬਿਰਖ ਆਰਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaa ke rukh birakh aaraau |
English: The One who owns the trees of the forest and the plants of the garden

Gurbani: ਜੇਹੀ ਧਾਤੁ ਤੇਹਾ ਤਿਨ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jehee dhaat tehaa tin naau |
English: according to their nature, He gives them all their names.

Gurbani: ਫੁਲੁ ਭਾਉ ਫਲੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: ful bhaau fal likhiaa paae |
English: The Flower and the Fruit of the Lord's Love are obtained by pre-ordained destiny.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਬੀਜਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਖਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aap beej aape hee khaae |2|
English: As we plant, so we harvest and eat. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਚੀ ਕੰਧ ਕਚਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਾਜੁ ॥
Transliteration: kachee kandh kachaa vich raaj |
English: The wall of the body is temporary, as is the soul-mason within it.

Gurbani: ਮਤਿ ਅਲੂਣੀ ਫਿਕਾ ਸਾਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: mat aloonee fikaa saad |
English: The flavor of the intellect is bland and insipid without the Salt.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਣੇ ਆਵੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: naanak aane aavai raas |
English: O Nanak, as He wills, He makes things right.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥੩॥੩੨॥
Transliteration: vin naavai naahee saabaas |3|32|
English: Without the Name, no one is approved. ||3||32||

[Ang 25 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ghar 5 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Fifth House:

Gurbani: ਅਛਲ ਛਲਾਈ ਨਹ ਛਲੈ ਨਹ ਘਾਉ ਕਟਾਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਕੈ ॥
Transliteration: achhal chhalaaee neh chhalai neh ghaau kattaaraa kar sakai |
English: The Undeceiveable is not deceived by deception. He cannot be wounded by any dagger.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਇਸੁ ਲੋਭੀ ਕਾ ਜੀਉ ਟਲ ਪਲੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jiau saahib raakhai tiau rahai is lobhee kaa jeeo ttal palai |1|
English: As our Lord and Master keeps us, so do we exist. The soul of this greedy person is tossed this way and that. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਤੇਲ ਦੀਵਾ ਕਿਉ ਜਲੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bin tel deevaa kiau jalai |1| rahaau |
English: Without the oil, how can the lamp be lit? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪੋਥੀ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: pothee puraan kamaaeeai |
English: Let the reading of your prayer book be the oil,

Gurbani: ਭਉ ਵਟੀ ਇਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: bhau vattee it tan paaeeai |
English: And let the Fear of God be the wick for the lamp of this body.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਬੂਝਣੁ ਆਣਿ ਜਲਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sach boojhan aan jalaaeeai |2|
English: Light this lamp with the understanding of Truth. ||2||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਤੇਲੁ ਦੀਵਾ ਇਉ ਜਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: eihu tel deevaa iau jalai |
English: Use this oil to light this lamp.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤਉ ਮਿਲੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kar chaanan saahib tau milai |1| rahaau |
English: Light it, and meet your Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਇਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਬਾਣੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: eit tan laagai baaneea |
English: This body is softened with the Word of the Guru's Bani;

Gurbani: ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਣੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: sukh hovai sev kamaaneea |
English: you shall find peace, doing seva (selfless service).

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੀਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sabh duneea aavan jaaneea |3|
English: All the world continues coming and going in reincarnation. ||3||

Gurbani: ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: vich duneea sev kamaaeeai |
English: In the midst of this world, do seva,

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਬੈਸਣੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: taa daragah baisan paaeeai |
English: and you shall be given a place of honor in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਹ ਲੁਡਾਈਐ ॥੪॥੩੩॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak baah luddaaeeai |4|33|
English: Says Nanak, swing your arms in joy! ||4||33||

[Ang 26 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ghar 1 |
English: Siree Raag, Third Mehl, First House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕ ਚਿਤਿ ਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: hau satigur sevee aapanaa ik man ik chit bhaae |
English: I serve my True Guru with single-minded devotion, and lovingly focus my consciousness on Him.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਨ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur man kaamanaa teerath hai jis no dee bujhaae |
English: The True Guru is the mind's desire and the sacred shrine of pilgrimage, for those unto whom He has given this understanding.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਵਣਾ ਜੋ ਇਛੈ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man chindiaa var paavanaa jo ichhai so fal paae |
English: The blessings of the wishes of the mind are obtained, and the fruits of one's desires.

Gurbani: ਨਾਉ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਨਾਉ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naau dhiaaeeai naau mangeeai naame sehaj samaae |1|
English: Meditate on the Name, worship the Name, and through the Name, you shall be absorbed in intuitive peace and poise. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੁ ਤਿਖ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man mere har ras chaakh tikh jaae |
English: O my mind, drink in the Sublime Essence of the Lord, and your thirst shall be quenched.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jinee guramukh chaakhiaa sahaje rahe samaae |1| rahaau |
English: Those Gurmukhs who have tasted it remain intuitively absorbed in the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: jinee satigur seviaa tinee paaeaa naam nidhaan |
English: Those who serve the True Guru obtain the Treasure of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਚੂਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: antar har ras rav rahiaa chookaa man abhimaan |
English: Deep within, they are drenched with the Essence of the Lord, and the egotistical pride of the mind is subdued.

Gurbani: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਮਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਲਾਗਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: hiradai kamal pragaasiaa laagaa sehaj dhiaan |
English: The heart-lotus blossoms forth, and they intuitively center themselves in meditation.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: man niramal har rav rahiaa paaeaa darageh maan |2|
English: Their minds become pure, and they remain immersed in the Lord; they are honored in His Court. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਤੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sevan aapanaa te virale sansaar |
English: Those who serve the True Guru in this world are very rare.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: haumai mamataa maar kai har raakhiaa ur dhaar |
English: Those who keep the Lord enshrined in their hearts subdue egotism and possessiveness.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜਿਨਾ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਗਾ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: hau tin kai balihaaranai jinaa naame lagaa piaar |
English: I am a sacrifice to those who are in love with the Naam.

Gurbani: ਸੇਈ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗੀ ਜਿਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: seee sukhee chahu jugee jinaa naam akhutt apaar |3|
English: Those who attain the Inexhaustible Name of the Infinite Lord remain happy throughout the four ages. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਚੂਕੈ ਮੋਹ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
Transliteration: gur miliai naam paaeeai chookai moh piaas |
English: Meeting with the Guru, the Naam is obtained, and the thirst of emotional attachment departs.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: har setee man rav rahiaa ghar hee maeh udaas |
English: When the mind is permeated with the Lord, one remains detached within the home of the heart.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: jinaa har kaa saad aaeaa hau tin balihaarai jaas |
English: I am a sacrifice to those who enjoy the Sublime Taste of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੪॥
Transliteration: naanak nadaree paaeeai sach naam gunataas |4|1|34|
English: O Nanak, by His Glance of Grace, the True Name, the Treasure of Excellence, is obtained. ||4||1||34||

[Ang 26 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 |
English: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬਹੁ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਿ ਭਰਮਾਈਐ ਮਨਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bahu bhekh kar bharamaaeeai man hiradai kapatt kamaae |
English: People wear all sorts of costumes and wander all around, but in their hearts and minds, they practice deception.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਈ ਮਰਿ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har kaa mehal na paavee mar visattaa maeh samaae |1|
English: They do not attain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and after death, they sink into manure. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: man re grih hee maeh udaas |
English: O mind, remain detached in the midst of your household.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sach sanjam karanee so kare guramukh hoe paragaas |1| rahaau |
English: Practicing truth, self-discipline and good deeds, the Gurmukh is enlightened. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਤਿਆ ਗਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਘਰੈ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad man jeetiaa gat mukat gharai meh paae |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the mind is conquered, and one attains the State of Liberation in one's own home.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam dhiaaeeai satasangat mel milaae |2|
English: So meditate on the Name of the Lord; join and merge with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਲਖ ਇਸਤਰੀਆ ਭੋਗ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: je lakh isatareea bhog kareh nav khandd raaj kamaeh |
English: You may enjoy the pleasures of hundreds of thousands of women, and rule the nine continents of the world.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bin satagur sukh na paavee fir fir jonee paeh |3|
English: But without the True Guru, you will not find peace; you will be reincarnated over and over again. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਾਰੁ ਕੰਠਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਪਹਿਰਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: har haar kantth jinee pahiriaa gur charanee chit laae |
English: Those who wear the Necklace of the Lord around their necks, and focus their consciousness on the Guru's Feet

Gurbani: ਤਿਨਾ ਪਿਛੈ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਓਨਾ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: tinaa pichhai ridh sidh firai onaa til na tamaae |4|
English: -wealth and supernatural spiritual powers follow them, but they do not care for such things at all. ||4||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jo prabh bhaavai so theeai avar na karanaa jaae |
English: Whatever pleases God's Will comes to pass. Nothing else can be done.

Gurbani: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੫॥੨॥੩੫॥
Transliteration: jan naanak jeevai naam lai har devahu sehaj subhaae |5|2|35|
English: Servant Nanak lives by chanting the Naam. O Lord, please give it to me, in Your Natural Way. ||5||2||35||

[Ang 27 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ghar 1 |
English: Siree Raag, Third Mehl, First House:

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੀ ਸਿਰਕਾਰ ਹੈ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jis hee kee sirakaar hai tis hee kaa sabh koe |
English: Everyone belongs to the One who rules the Universe.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਘਟਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh kaar kamaavanee sach ghatt paragatt hoe |
English: The Gurmukh practices good deeds, and the truth is revealed in the heart.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਸਚੁ ਵਸੈ ਸਚੇ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: antar jis kai sach vasai sache sachee soe |
English: True is the reputation of the true, within whom truth abides.

Gurbani: ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sach mile se na vichhurreh tin nij ghar vaasaa hoe |1|
English: Those who meet the True Lord are not separated again; they come to dwell in the home of the self deep within. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: mere raam mai har bin avar na koe |
English: O my Lord! Without the Lord, I have no other at all.

Gurbani: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: satagur sach prabh niramalaa sabad milaavaa hoe |1| rahaau |
English: The True Guru leads us to meet the Immaculate True God through the Word of His Shabad. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨਉ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabad milai so mil rahai jis nau aape le milaae |
English: One whom the Lord merges into Himself is merged in the Shabad, and remains so merged.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਕੋ ਨਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: doojai bhaae ko naa milai fir fir aavai jaae |
English: No one merges with Him through the love of duality; over and over again, they come and go in reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਏਕੋ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabh meh ik varatadaa eko rahiaa samaae |
English: The One Lord permeates all. The One Lord is pervading everywhere.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨਉ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jis nau aap deaal hoe so guramukh naam samaae |2|
English: That Gurmukh, unto whom the Lord shows His Kindness, is absorbed in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਜੋਤਕੀ ਵਾਦ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: parr parr panddit jotakee vaad kareh beechaar |
English: After all their reading, the Pandits, the religious scholars, and the astrologers argue and debate.

Gurbani: ਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਭਵੀ ਨ ਬੁਝਈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: mat budh bhavee na bujhee antar lobh vikaar |
English: Their intellect and understanding are perverted; they just don't understand. They are filled with greed and corruption.

Gurbani: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਭਰਮਦੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh bharamade bhram bhram hoe khuaar |
English: Through 8.4 million incarnations they wander lost and confused; through all their wandering and roaming, they are ruined.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: poorab likhiaa kamaavanaa koe na mettanahaar |3|
English: They act according to their pre-ordained destiny, which no one can erase. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਗਾਖੜੀ ਸਿਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: satagur kee sevaa gaakharree sir deejai aap gavaae |
English: It is very difficult to serve the True Guru. Surrender your head; give up your selfishness.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੇਵਾ ਪਵੈ ਸਭ ਥਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabad mileh taa har milai sevaa pavai sabh thaae |
English: Realizing the Shabad, one meets with the Lord, and all one's service is accepted.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਸਿ ਪਰਸਿਐ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: paaras parasiai paaras hoe jotee jot samaae |
English: By personally experiencing the Personality of the Guru, one's own personality is uplifted, and one's light merges into the Light.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jin kau poorab likhiaa tin satagur miliaa aae |4|
English: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny come to meet the True Guru. ||4||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਭੁਖਾ ਭੁਖਾ ਮਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਮਤ ਤੂ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੂਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: man bhukhaa bhukhaa mat kareh mat too kareh pookaar |
English: O mind, don't cry out that you are hungry, always hungry; stop complaining.

Gurbani: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਰੀ ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇਇ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh jin siree sabhasai dee adhaar |
English: The One who created the 8.4 million species of beings gives sustenance to all.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਰਦਾ ਸਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: nirbhau sadaa deaal hai sabhanaa karadaa saar |
English: The Fearless Lord is forever Merciful; He takes care of all.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਪਾਈਐ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੫॥੩॥੩੬॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh bujheeai paaeeai mokh duaar |5|3|36|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh understands, and finds the Door of Liberation. ||5||3||36||

[Ang 27 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 |
English: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਕੈ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: jinee sun kai maniaa tinaa nij ghar vaas |
English: Those who hear and believe, find the home of the self deep within.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramatee saalaeh sach har paaeaa gunataas |
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, they praise the True Lord; they find the Lord, the Treasure of Excellence.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: sabad rate se niramale hau sad balihaarai jaas |
English: Attuned to the Word of the Shabad, they are immaculate and pure. I am forever a sacrifice to them.

Gurbani: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਹੈ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: hiradai jin kai har vasai tith ghatt hai paragaas |1|
English: Those people, within whose hearts the Lord abides, are radiant and enlightened. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: man mere har har niramal dhiaae |
English: O my mind, meditate on the Immaculate Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dhur masatak jin kau likhiaa se guramukh rahe liv laae |1| rahaau |
English: Those whose have such pre-ordained destiny written on their foreheads-those Gurmukhs remain absorbed in the Lord's Love. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: har santahu dekhahu nadar kar nikatt vasai bharapoor |
English: O Saints, see clearly that the Lord is near at hand; He is pervading everywhere.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਸੇ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: guramat jinee pachhaaniaa se dekheh sadaa hadoor |
English: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings realize Him, and see Him Ever-present.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਣ ਤਿਨ ਸਦ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਅਉਗੁਣਵੰਤਿਆ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jin gun tin sad man vasai aaugunavantiaa door |
English: He dwells forever in the minds of the virtuous. He is far removed from those worthless people who lack virtue.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਗੁਣ ਤੈ ਬਾਹਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮਰਦੇ ਝੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: manamukh gun tai baahare bin naavai marade jhoor |2|
English: The self-willed manmukhs are totally without virtue. Without the Name, they die in frustration. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jin sabad guroo sun maniaa tin man dhiaaeaa har soe |
English: Those who hear and believe in the Word of the Guru's Shabad, meditate on the Lord in their minds.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: anadin bhagatee ratiaa man tan niramal hoe |
English: Night and day, they are steeped in devotion; their minds and bodies become pure.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਕਾ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਰੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: koorraa rang kasunbh kaa binas jaae dukh roe |
English: The color of the world is false and weak; when it washes away, people cry out in pain.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਓਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jis andar naam pragaas hai ohu sadaa sadaa thir hoe |3|
English: Those who have the Radiant Light of the Naam within, become steady and stable, forever and ever. ||3||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: eihu janam padaarath paae kai har naam na chetai liv laae |
English: The blessing of this human life has been obtained, but still, people do not lovingly focus their thoughts on the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਪਗਿ ਖਿਸਿਐ ਰਹਣਾ ਨਹੀ ਆਗੈ ਠਉਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: pag khisiai rahanaa nahee aagai tthaur na paae |
English: Their feet slip, and they cannot stay here any longer. And in the next world, they find no place of rest at all.

Gurbani: ਓਹ ਵੇਲਾ ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: oeh velaa hath na aavee ant geaa pachhutaae |
English: This opportunity shall not come again. In the end, they depart, regretting and repenting.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਉਬਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jis nadar kare so ubarai har setee liv laae |4|
English: Those whom the Lord blesses with His Glance of Grace are saved; they are lovingly attuned to the Lord. ||4||

Gurbani: ਦੇਖਾ ਦੇਖੀ ਸਭ ਕਰੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: dekhaa dekhee sabh kare manamukh boojh na paae |
English: They all show off and pretend, but the self-willed manmukhs do not understand.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਿਰਦਾ ਸੁਧੁ ਹੈ ਸੇਵ ਪਈ ਤਿਨ ਥਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jin guramukh hiradaa sudh hai sev pee tin thaae |
English: Those Gurmukhs who are pure of heart-their service is accepted.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਤ ਪੜਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: har gun gaaveh har nit parreh har gun gaae samaae |
English: They sing the Glorious Praise of the Lord; they read about the Lord each day. Singing the Praise of the Lord, they merge in absorption.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਜਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੫॥੪॥੩੭॥
Transliteration: naanak tin kee baanee sadaa sach hai ji naam rahe liv laae |5|4|37|
English: O Nanak, the words of those who are lovingly attuned to the Naam are true forever. ||5||4||37||

[Ang 28 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 |
English: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jinee ik man naam dhiaaeaa guramatee veechaar |
English: Those who meditate single-mindedly on the Naam, and contemplate the Teachings of the Guru

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਸਦ ਉਜਲੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: tin ke mukh sad ujale tith sachai darabaar |
English: -their faces are forever radiant in the Court of the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: oe amrit peeveh sadaa sadaa sachai naam piaar |1|
English: They drink in the Ambrosial Nectar forever and ever, and they love the True Name. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhaaee re guramukh sadaa pat hoe |
English: O Siblings of Destiny, the Gurmukhs are honored forever.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਮਲੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਢੈ ਧੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har har sadaa dhiaaeeai mal haumai kadtai dhoe |1| rahaau |
English: They meditate forever on the Lord, Har, Har, and they wash off the filth of egotism. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh naam na jaananee vin naavai pat jaae |
English: The self-willed manmukhs do not know the Naam. Without the Name, they lose their honor.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੈ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਲਾਗੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabadai saad na aaeo laage doojai bhaae |
English: They do not savor the Taste of the Shabad; they are attached to the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਵਿਸਟਾ ਕੇ ਕੀੜੇ ਪਵਹਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਸੇ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: visattaa ke keerre paveh vich visattaa se visattaa maeh samaae |2|
English: They are worms in the filth of manure. They fall into manure, and into manure they are absorbed. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਚਲਹਿ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: tin kaa janam safal hai jo chaleh satagur bhaae |
English: Fruitful are the lives of those who walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਕੁਲੁ ਉਧਾਰਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਣੇਦੀ ਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kul udhaareh aapanaa dhan janedee maae |
English: Their families are saved; blessed are the mothers who gave birth to them.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਜਿਸ ਨਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har har naam dhiaaeeai jis nau kirapaa kare rajaae |3|
English: By His Will He grants His Grace; those who are so blessed, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jinee guramukh naam dhiaaeaa vichahu aap gavaae |
English: The Gurmukhs meditate on the Naam; they eradicate selfishness and conceit from within.

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: oe andarahu baaharahu niramale sache sach samaae |
English: They are pure, inwardly and outwardly; they merge into the Truest of the True.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਏ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੪॥੫॥੩੮॥
Transliteration: naanak aae se paravaan heh jin guramatee har dhiaae |4|5|38|
English: O Nanak, blessed is the coming of those who follow the Guru's Teachings and meditate on the Lord. ||4||5||38||

[Ang 28 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 |
English: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਛਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: har bhagataa har dhan raas hai gur poochh kareh vaapaar |
English: The devotees of the Lord have the Wealth and Capital of the Lord; with Guru's Advice, they carry on their trade.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਵਖਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: har naam salaahan sadaa sadaa vakhar har naam adhaar |
English: They praise the Name of the Lord forever and ever. The Name of the Lord is their Merchandise and Support.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਅਤੁਟੁ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur poorai har naam drirraaeaa har bhagataa atutt bhanddaar |1|
English: The Perfect Guru has implanted the Name of the Lord into the Lord's devotees; it is an Inexhaustible Treasure. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhaaee re is man kau samajhaae |
English: O Siblings of Destiny, instruct your minds in this way.

Gurbani: ਏ ਮਨ ਆਲਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: e man aalas kiaa kareh guramukh naam dhiaae |1| rahaau |
English: O mind, why are you so lazy? Become Gurmukh, and meditate on the Naam. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਹੈ ਜੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: har bhagat har kaa piaar hai je guramukh kare beechaar |
English: Devotion to the Lord is love for the Lord. The Gurmukh reflects deeply and contemplates.

Gurbani: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਬੋਲੁ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: paakhandd bhagat na hovee dubidhaa bol khuaar |
English: Hypocrisy is not devotion-speaking words of duality leads only to misery.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਰਲਾਇਆ ਨਾ ਰਲੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: so jan ralaaeaa naa ralai jis antar bibek beechaar |2|
English: Those humble beings who are filled with keen understanding and meditative contemplation-even though they intermingle with others, they remain distinct. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਖੀਐ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: so sevak har aakheeai jo har raakhai ur dhaar |
English: Those who keep the Lord enshrined within their hearts are said to be the servants of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਉਪੇ ਆਗੈ ਧਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: man tan saupe aagai dhare haumai vichahu maar |
English: Placing mind and body in offering before the Lord, they conquer and eradicate egotism from within.

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਜਿ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: dhan guramukh so paravaan hai ji kade na aavai haar |3|
English: Blessed and acclaimed is that Gurmukh, who shall never be defeated. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: karam milai taa paaeeai vin karamai paaeaa na jaae |
English: Those who receive His Grace find Him. Without His Grace, He cannot be found.

Gurbani: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਤਰਸਦੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh tarasade jis mele so milai har aae |
English: The 8.4 million species of beings all yearn for the Lord. Those whom He unites, come to be united with the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੬॥੩੯॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh har paaeaa sadaa har naam samaae |4|6|39|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh finds the Lord, and remains forever absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||4||6||39||

[Ang 29 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 |
English: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sukh saagar har naam hai guramukh paaeaa jaae |
English: The Name of the Lord is the Ocean of Peace; the Gurmukhs obtain it.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: anadin naam dhiaaeeai sahaje naam samaae |
English: Meditating on the Naam, night and day, they are easily and intuitively absorbed in the Naam.

Gurbani: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਰਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਚ ਸਿਉ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: andar rachai har sach siau rasanaa har gun gaae |1|
English: Their inner beings are immersed in the True Lord; they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਜਗੁ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhaaee re jag dukheea doojai bhaae |
English: O Siblings of Destiny, the world is in misery, engrossed in the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਲਹਹਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur saranaaee sukh laheh anadin naam dhiaae |1| rahaau |
English: In the Sanctuary of the Guru, peace is found, meditating on the Naam night and day. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੇ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗਈ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: saache mail na laagee man niramal har dhiaae |
English: The truthful ones are not stained by filth. Meditating on the Lord, their minds remain pure.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh sabad pachhaaneeai har amrit naam samaae |
English: The Gurmukhs realize the Word of the Shabad; they are immersed in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡੁ ਬਲਾਇਆ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur giaan prachandd balaaeaa agiaan andheraa jaae |2|
English: The Guru has lit the brilliant light of spiritual wisdom, and the darkness of ignorance has been dispelled. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੈਲੇ ਮਲੁ ਭਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh maile mal bhare haumai trisanaa vikaar |
English: The self-willed manmukhs are polluted. They are filled with the pollution of egotism, wickedness and desire.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: bin sabadai mail na utarai mar jameh hoe khuaar |
English: Without the Shabad, this pollution is not washed off; through the cycle of death and rebirth, they waste away in misery.

Gurbani: ਧਾਤੁਰ ਬਾਜੀ ਪਲਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: dhaatur baajee palach rahe naa uravaar na paar |3|
English: Engrossed in this transitory drama, they are not at home in either this world or the next. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh jap tap sanjamee har kai naam piaar |
English: For the Gurmukh, the love of the Name of the Lord is chanting, deep meditation and self-discipline.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh sadaa dhiaaeeai ek naam karataar |
English: The Gurmukh meditates forever on the Name of the One Creator Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੭॥੪੦॥
Transliteration: naanak naam dhiaaeeai sabhanaa jeea kaa aadhaar |4|7|40|
English: O Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the Support of all beings. ||4||7||40||

[Ang 29 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: sreeraag mahalaa 3 |
English: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh mohi viaapiaa bairaag udaasee na hoe |
English: The self-willed manmukhs are engrossed in emotional attachment; they are not balanced or detached.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੈ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabad na cheenai sadaa dukh har darageh pat khoe |
English: They do not comprehend the Word of the Shabad. They suffer in pain forever, and lose their honor in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਈਐ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: haumai guramukh khoeeai naam rate sukh hoe |1|
English: The Gurmukhs shed their ego; attuned to the Naam, they find peace. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੀ ਨਿਤ ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: mere man ahinis poor rahee nit aasaa |
English: O my mind, day and night, you are always full of wishful hopes.

Gurbani: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਪਰਜਲੈ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: satagur sev mohu parajalai ghar hee maeh udaasaa |1| rahaau |
English: Serve the True Guru, and your emotional attachment shall be totally burnt away; remain detached within the home of your heart. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh karam kamaavai bigasai har bairaag anand |
English: The Gurmukhs do good deeds and blossom forth; balanced and detached in the Lord, they are in ecstasy.

Gurbani: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਨਿਚੰਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: ahinis bhagat kare din raatee haumai maar nichand |
English: Night and day, they perform devotional worship, day and night; subduing their ego, they are carefree.

Gurbani: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: vaddai bhaag satasangat paaee har paaeaa sehaj anand |2|
English: By great good fortune, I found the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation; I have found the Lord, with intuitive ease and ecstasy. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਾਧੂ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਸੋਈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: so saadhoo bairaagee soee hiradai naam vasaae |
English: That person is a Holy Saadhu, and a renouncer of the world, whose heart is filled with the Naam.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਨ ਤਾਮਸੁ ਮੂਲੇ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: antar laag na taamas moole vichahu aap gavaae |
English: His inner being is not touched by anger or dark energies at all; he has lost his selfishness and conceit.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਤਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਖਾਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ ਅਘਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naam nidhaan sataguroo dikhaaliaa har ras peea aghaae |3|
English: The True Guru has revealed to him the Treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; he drinks in the Sublime Essence of the Lord, and is satisfied. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤੀ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਬੈਰਾਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: jin kinai paaeaa saadhasangatee poorai bhaag bairaag |
English: Whoever has found it, has done so in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. Through perfect good fortune, such balanced detachment is attained.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਲਾਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh fireh na jaaneh satagur haumai andar laag |
English: The self-willed manmukhs wander around lost, but they do not know the True Guru. They are inwardly attached to egotism.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰੰਗਾਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਭੈ ਕੇਹੀ ਲਾਗਿ ॥੪॥੮॥੪੧॥
Transliteration: naanak sabad rate har naam rangaae bin bhai kehee laag |4|8|41|
English: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Shabad are dyed in the Color of the Lord's Name. Without the Fear of God, how can they retain this Color? ||4||8||41||

[Ang 29 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 |
English: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਸਉਦਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਭ ਵਥੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: ghar hee saudaa paaeeai antar sabh vath hoe |
English: Within the home of your own inner being, the merchandise is obtained. All commodities are within.

Gurbani: ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: khin khin naam samaaleeai guramukh paavai koe |
English: Each and every moment, dwell on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the Gurmukhs obtain it.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ਹੈ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naam nidhaan akhutt hai vaddabhaag paraapat hoe |1|
English: The Treasure of the Naam is inexhaustible. By great good fortune, it is obtained. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਤਜਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: mere man taj nindaa haumai ahankaar |
English: O my mind, give up slander, egotism and arrogance.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har jeeo sadaa dhiaae too guramukh ekankaar |1| rahaau |
English: Become Gurmukh, and meditate forever on the Dear Lord, the One and Only Creator. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: guramukhaa ke mukh ujale gurasabadee beechaar |
English: The faces of the Gurmukhs are radiant and bright; they reflect on the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦੇ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: halat palat sukh paaeide jap jap ridai muraar |
English: They obtain peace in this world and the next, chanting and meditating within their hearts on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ghar hee vich mehal paaeaa gurasabadee veechaar |2|
English: Within the home of their own inner being, they obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, reflecting on the Guru's Shabad. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਮੁਹ ਫੇਰਹਿ ਮਥੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: satagur te jo muh fereh mathe tin kaale |
English: Those who turn their faces away from the True Guru shall have their faces blackened.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਦੁਖ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਨਿਤ ਜੋਹੇ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: anadin dukh kamaavade nit johe jam jaale |
English: Night and day, they suffer in pain; they see the noose of Death always hovering above them.

Gurbani: ਸੁਪਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਦੇਖਨੀ ਬਹੁ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਪਰਜਾਲੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: supanai sukh na dekhanee bahu chintaa parajaale |3|
English: Even in their dreams, they find no peace; they are consumed by the fires of intense anxiety. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabhanaa kaa daataa ek hai aape bakhas karee |
English: The One Lord is the Giver of all; He Himself bestows all blessings.

Gurbani: ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਵਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: kahanaa kichhoo na jaavee jis bhaavai tis dee |
English: No one else has any say in this; He gives just as He pleases.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੯॥੪੨॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh paaeeai aape jaanai soe |4|9|42|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs obtain Him; He Himself knows Himself. ||4||9||42||

[Ang 30 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 |
English: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa saahib seveeai sach vaddiaaee dee |
English: Serve your True Lord and Master, and you shall be blessed with true greatness.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee man vasai haumai door karee |
English: By Guru's Grace, He abides in the mind, and egotism is driven out.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਤਾ ਰਹੈ ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: eihu man dhaavat taa rahai jaa aape nadar karee |1|
English: This wandering mind comes to rest, when the Lord casts His Glance of Grace. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhaaee re guramukh har naam dhiaae |
English: O Siblings of Destiny, become Gurmukh, and meditate on the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਦ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਹਲੀ ਪਾਵੈ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: naam nidhaan sad man vasai mahalee paavai thaau |1| rahaau |
English: The Treasure of the Naam abides forever within the mind, and one's place of rest is found in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸ ਨਉ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਠਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh man tan andh hai tis nau tthaur na tthaau |
English: The minds and bodies of the self-willed manmukhs are filled with darkness; they find no shelter, no place of rest.

Gurbani: ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਭਉਦਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਜਿਉ ਸੁੰਞੈਂ ਘਰਿ ਕਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bahu jonee bhaudaa firai jiau sunyain ghar kaau |
English: Through countless incarnations they wander lost, like crows in a deserted house.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: guramatee ghatt chaananaa sabad milai har naau |2|
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, the heart is illuminated. Through the Shabad, the Name of the Lord is received. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਅੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਗੁਬਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: trai gun bikhiaa andh hai maaeaa moh gubaar |
English: In the corruption of the three qualities, there is blindness; in attachment to Maya, there is darkness.

Gurbani: ਲੋਭੀ ਅਨ ਕਉ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਪੜਿ ਵੇਦਾ ਕਰੈ ਪੂਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: lobhee an kau sevade parr vedaa karai pookaar |
English: The greedy people serve others, instead of the Lord, although they loudly announce their reading of scriptures.
