Gurbani: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bikhiaa andar pach mue naa uravaar na paar |3|
English: They are burnt to death by their own corruption; they are not at home, on either this shore or the one beyond. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਜਗਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohi visaariaa jagat pitaa pratipaal |
English: In attachment to Maya, they have forgotten the Father, the Cherisher of the World.

Gurbani: ਬਾਝਹੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਅਚੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਬਧੀ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: baajhahu guroo achet hai sabh badhee jamakaal |
English: Without the Guru, all are unconscious; they are held in bondage by the Messenger of Death.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੪੩॥
Transliteration: naanak guramat ubare sachaa naam samaal |4|10|43|
English: O Nanak, through the Guru's Teachings, you shall be saved, contemplating the True Name. ||4||10||43||

[Ang 30 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 |
English: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਉਥਾ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: trai gun maaeaa mohu hai guramukh chauthaa pad paae |
English: The three qualities hold people in attachment to Maya. The Gurmukh attains the fourth state of higher consciousness.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa melaaeian har naam vasiaa man aae |
English: Granting His Grace, God unites us with Himself. The Name of the Lord comes to abide within the mind.

Gurbani: ਪੋਤੈ ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਨ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: potai jin kai pun hai tin satasangat melaae |1|
English: Those who have the treasure of goodness join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhaaee re guramat saach rahaau |
English: O Siblings of Destiny, follow the Guru's Teachings and dwell in truth.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੋ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saacho saach kamaavanaa saachai sabad milaau |1| rahaau |
English: Practice truth, and only truth, and merge in the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jinee naam pachhaaniaa tin vittahu bal jaau |
English: I am a sacrifice to those who recognize the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਗਾ ਚਲਾ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aap chhodd charanee lagaa chalaa tin kai bhaae |
English: Renouncing selfishness, I fall at their feet, and walk in harmony with His Will.

Gurbani: ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: laahaa har har naam milai sahaje naam samaae |2|
English: Earning the Profit of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I am intuitively absorbed in the Naam. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin gur mehal na paaeeai naam na paraapat hoe |
English: Without the Guru, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is not found, and the Naam is not obtained.

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਲੋੜਿ ਲਹੁ ਜਿਦੂ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa satagur lorr lahu jidoo paaeeai sach soe |
English: Seek and find such a True Guru, who shall lead you to the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਸੁਰ ਸੰਘਾਰੈ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸੈ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: asur sanghaarai sukh vasai jo tis bhaavai su hoe |3|
English: Destroy your evil passions, and you shall dwell in peace. Whatever pleases the Lord comes to pass. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੇਹਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਤੇਹੋ ਜੇਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jehaa satagur kar jaaniaa teho jehaa sukh hoe |
English: As one knows the True Guru, so is the peace obtained.

Gurbani: ਏਹੁ ਸਹਸਾ ਮੂਲੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਭਾਉ ਲਾਏ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: ehu sahasaa moole naahee bhaau laae jan koe |
English: There is no doubt at all about this, but those who love Him are very rare.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕ ਜੋਤਿ ਦੁਇ ਮੂਰਤੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੪੪॥
Transliteration: naanak ek jot due mooratee sabad milaavaa hoe |4|11|44|
English: O Nanak, the One Light has two forms; through the Shabad, union is attained. ||4||11||44||

[Ang 31 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 |
English: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਲੋਭਾਣੇ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: amrit chhodd bikhiaa lobhaane sevaa kareh viddaanee |
English: Discarding the Ambrosial Nectar, they greedily grab the poison; they serve others, instead of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਪਣਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਹਿ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਦੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: aapanaa dharam gavaaveh boojheh naahee anadin dukh vihaanee |
English: They lose their faith, they have no understanding; night and day, they suffer in pain.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧ ਨ ਚੇਤਹੀ ਡੂਬਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: manamukh andh na chetahee ddoob mue bin paanee |1|
English: The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not even think of the Lord; they are drowned to death without water. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਭਜਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: man re sadaa bhajahu har saranaaee |
English: O mind, vibrate and meditate forever on the Lord; seek the Protection of His Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa sabad antar vasai taa har visar na jaaee |1| rahaau |
English: If the Word of the Guru's Shabad abides deep within, then you shall not forget the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਪੁਤਲਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਸਟੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: eihu sareer maaeaa kaa putalaa vich haumai dusattee paaee |
English: This body is the puppet of Maya. The evil of egotism is within it.

Gurbani: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣਾ ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aavan jaanaa jaman maranaa manamukh pat gavaaee |
English: Coming and going through birth and death, the self-willed manmukhs lose their honor.

Gurbani: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: satagur sev sadaa sukh paaeaa jotee jot milaaee |2|
English: Serving the True Guru, eternal peace is obtained, and one's light merges into the Light. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਅਤਿ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਜੋ ਇਛੇ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: satagur kee sevaa at sukhaalee jo ichhe so fal paae |
English: Serving the True Guru brings a deep and profound peace, and one's desires are fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਤਪੁ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਸਰੀਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jat sat tap pavit sareeraa har har man vasaae |
English: Abstinence, truthfulness and self-discipline are obtained, and the body is purified; the Lord, Har, Har, comes to dwell within the mind.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sadaa anand rahai din raatee mil preetam sukh paae |3|
English: Such a person remains blissful forever, day and night. Meeting the Beloved, peace is found. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo satagur kee saranaagatee hau tin kai bal jaau |
English: I am a sacrifice to those who seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dar sachai sachee vaddiaaee sahaje sach samaau |
English: In the Court of the True One, they are blessed with true greatness; they are intuitively absorbed into the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੪੫॥
Transliteration: naanak nadaree paaeeai guramukh mel milaau |4|12|45|
English: O Nanak, by His Glance of Grace He is found; the Gurmukh is united in His Union. ||4||12||45||

[Ang 31 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 |
English: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਜਿਉ ਦੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਤਨਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh karam kamaavane jiau dohaagan tan seegaar |
English: The self-willed manmukh performs religious rituals, like the unwanted bride decorating her body.

Gurbani: ਸੇਜੈ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sejai kant na aavee nit nit hoe khuaar |
English: Her Husband Lord does not come to her bed; day after day, she grows more and more miserable.

Gurbani: ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਈ ਨਾ ਦੀਸੈ ਘਰੁ ਬਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: pir kaa mehal na paavee naa deesai ghar baar |1|
English: She does not attain the Mansion of His Presence; she does not find the door to His House. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhaaee re ik man naam dhiaae |
English: O Siblings of Destiny, meditate on the Naam with one-pointed mind.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਜਪਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: santaa sangat mil rahai jap raam naam sukh paae |1| rahaau |
English: Remain united with the Society of the Saints; chant the Name of the Lord, and find peace. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh sadaa sohaaganee pir raakhiaa ur dhaar |
English: The Gurmukh is the happy and pure soul-bride forever. She keeps her Husband Lord enshrined within her heart.

Gurbani: ਮਿਠਾ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਸੇਜੈ ਰਵੈ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: mitthaa boleh niv chaleh sejai ravai bhataar |
English: Her speech is sweet, and her way of life is humble. She enjoys the Bed of her Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਹੇਤੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sobhaavantee sohaaganee jin gur kaa het apaar |2|
English: The happy and pure soul-bride is noble; she has infinite love for the Guru. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਾ ਭਾਗੈ ਕਾ ਉਦਉ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: poorai bhaag satagur milai jaa bhaagai kaa udau hoe |
English: By perfect good fortune, one meets the True Guru, when one's destiny is awakened.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: antarahu dukh bhram katteeai sukh paraapat hoe |
English: Suffering and doubt are cut out from within, and peace is obtained.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur kai bhaanai jo chalai dukh na paavai koe |3|
English: One who walks in harmony with the Guru's Will shall not suffer in pain. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਭਾਣੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur ke bhaane vich amrit hai sahaje paavai koe |
English: The Amrit, the Ambrosial Nectar, is in the Guru's Will. With intuitive ease, it is obtained.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਾ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਪੀਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਖੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jinaa paraapat tin peea haumai vichahu khoe |
English: Those who are destined to have it, drink it in; their egotism is eradicated from within.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੪੬॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh naam dhiaaeeai sach milaavaa hoe |4|13|46|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh meditates on the Naam, and is united with the True Lord. ||4||13||46||

[Ang 31 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 |
English: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਗੈ ਧਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: jaa pir jaanai aapanaa tan man agai dharee |
English: If you know that He is your Husband Lord, offer your body and mind to Him.

Gurbani: ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਦੀਆ ਸੇਈ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: sohaaganee karam kamaavadeea seee karam karee |
English: Behave like the happy and pure soul-bride.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੜਾ ਸਾਚੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਦੇਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sahaje saach milaavarraa saach vaddaaee dee |1|
English: With intuitive ease, you shall merge with the True Lord, and He shall bless you with true greatness. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhaaee re gur bin bhagat na hoe |
English: O Siblings of Destiny, without the Guru, there is no devotional worship.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bin gur bhagat na paaeeai je lochai sabh koe |1| rahaau |
English: Without the Guru, devotion is not obtained, even though everyone may long for it. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਫੇਰੁ ਪਇਆ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh fer peaa kaaman doojai bhaae |
English: The soul-bride in love with duality goes around the wheel of reincarnation, through 8.4 million incarnations.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਦੁਖੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin gur need na aavee dukhee rain vihaae |
English: Without the Guru, she finds no sleep, and she passes her life-night in pain.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bin sabadai pir na paaeeai birathaa janam gavaae |2|
English: Without the Shabad, she does not find her Husband Lord, and her life wastes away in vain. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤੀ ਜਗੁ ਫਿਰੀ ਨਾ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਪੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: hau hau karatee jag firee naa dhan sanpai naal |
English: Practicing egotism, selfishness and conceit, she wanders around the world, but her wealth and property will not go with her.

Gurbani: ਅੰਧੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਈ ਸਭ ਬਾਧੀ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: andhee naam na chetee sabh baadhee jamakaal |
English: The spiritually blind do not even think of the Naam; they are all bound and gagged by the Messenger of Death.

Gurbani: ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: satagur miliai dhan paaeaa har naamaa ridai samaal |3|
English: Meeting the True Guru, the wealth is obtained, contemplating the Name of the Lord in the heart. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: naam rate se niramale gur kai sehaj subhaae |
English: Those who are attuned to the Naam are immaculate and pure; through the Guru, they obtain intuitive peace and poise.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man tan raataa rang siau rasanaa rasan rasaae |
English: Their minds and bodies are dyed in the Color of the Lord's Love, and their tongues savor His Sublime Essence.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਧੁਰਿ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੪੭॥
Transliteration: naanak rang na utarai jo har dhur chhoddiaa laae |4|14|47|
English: O Nanak, that Primal Color which the Lord has applied, shall never fade away. ||4||14||47||

[Ang 32 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 |
English: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕੀਜੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh kripaa kare bhagat keejai bin gur bhagat na hoee |
English: By His Grace one becomes Gurmukh, worshipping the Lord with devotion. Without the Guru there is no devotional worship.

Gurbani: ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਬੂਝੈ ਤਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aapai aap milaae boojhai taa niramal hovai soee |
English: Those whom He unites with Himself, understand and become pure.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har jeeo saachaa saachee baanee sabad milaavaa hoee |1|
English: The Dear Lord is True, and True is the Word of His Bani. Through the Shabad, we merge with Him. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਭਗਤਿਹੀਣੁ ਕਾਹੇ ਜਗਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bhaaee re bhagatiheen kaahe jag aaeaa |
English: O Siblings of Destiny: those who lack devotion-why have they even bothered to come into the world?

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਕੀਨੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: poore gur kee sev na keenee birathaa janam gavaaeaa |1| rahaau |
English: They do not serve the Perfect Guru; they waste away their lives in vain. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aape jagajeevan sukhadaataa aape bakhas milaae |
English: The Lord Himself, the Life of the World, is the Giver of Peace. He Himself forgives, and unites with Himself.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਏ ਕਿਆ ਵੇਚਾਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jant e kiaa vechaare kiaa ko aakh sunaae |
English: So what about all these poor beings and creatures? What can anyone say?

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਾਈ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਾਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: guramukh aape dee vaddaaee aape sev karaae |2|
English: He Himself blesses the Gurmukh with glory. He Himself enjoins us to His Service. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦੇਖਿ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੋਭਾਣਾ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: dekh kuttanb mohi lobhaanaa chaladiaa naal na jaaee |
English: Gazing upon their families, people are lured and trapped by emotional attachment, but none will go along with them in the end.

Gurbani: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: satagur sev gun nidhaan paaeaa tis dee keem na paaee |
English: Serving the True Guru, one finds the Lord, the Treasure of Excellence. His Value cannot be estimated.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਖਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har prabh sakhaa meet prabh meraa ante hoe sakhaaee |3|
English: The Lord God is my Friend and Companion. God shall be my Helper and Support in the end. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਪਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aapanai man chit kahai kahaae bin gur aap na jaaee |
English: Within your conscious mind, you may say anything, but without the Guru, selfishness is not removed.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਦਾਤਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har jeeo daataa bhagat vachhal hai kar kirapaa man vasaaee |
English: The Dear Lord is the Giver, the Lover of His devotees. By His Grace, He comes to dwell in the mind.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਭਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੪੮॥
Transliteration: naanak sobhaa surat dee prabh aape guramukh de vaddiaaee |4|15|48|
English: O Nanak, by His Grace, He bestows enlightened awareness; God Himself blesses the Gurmukh with glorious greatness. ||4||15||48||

[Ang 32 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 |
English: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਜਨਨੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਾਇਆ ਧੰਨੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: dhan jananee jin jaaeaa dhan pitaa paradhaan |
English: Blessed is the mother who gave birth; blessed and respected is the father of one who serves the True Guru and finds peace.

Gurbani: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਗਇਆ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: satagur sev sukh paaeaa vichahu geaa gumaan |
English: His arrogant pride is banished from within.

Gurbani: ਦਰਿ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਖੜੇ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dar sevan sant jan kharre paaein gunee nidhaan |1|
English: Standing at the Lord's Door, the humble Saints serve Him; they find the Treasure of Excellence. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਖਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: mere man gur mukh dhiaae har soe |
English: O my mind, become Gurmukh, and meditate on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa sabad man vasai man tan niramal hoe |1| rahaau |
English: The Word of the Guru's Shabad abides within the mind, and the body and mind become pure. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਆਪੇ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa ghar aaeaa aape miliaa aae |
English: By His Grace, He has come into my home; He Himself has come to meet me.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਰੰਗੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gurasabadee saalaaheeai range sehaj subhaae |
English: Singing His Praises through the Shabads of the Guru, we are dyed in His Color with intuitive ease.

Gurbani: ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sachai sach samaaeaa mil rahai na vichhurr jaae |2|
English: Becoming truthful, we merge with the True One; remaining blended with Him, we shall never be separated again. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jo kichh karanaa su kar rahiaa avar na karanaa jaae |
English: Whatever is to be done, the Lord is doing. No one else can do anything.

Gurbani: ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੇ ਮੇਲਿਅਨੁ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਪੰਨੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: chiree vichhune melian satagur panai paae |
English: Those separated from Him for so long are reunited with Him once again by the True Guru, who takes them into His Own Account.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਇਸੀ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aape kaar karaaeisee avar na karanaa jaae |3|
English: He Himself assigns all to their tasks; nothing else can be done. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: man tan rataa rang siau haumai taj vikaar |
English: One whose mind and body are imbued with the Lord's Love gives up egotism and corruption.

Gurbani: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: ahinis hiradai rav rahai nirbhau naam nirankaar |
English: Day and night, the Name of the One Lord, the Fearless and Formless One, dwells within the heart.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੪੯॥
Transliteration: naanak aap milaaeian poorai sabad apaar |4|16|49|
English: O Nanak, He blends us with Himself, through the Perfect, Infinite Word of His Shabad. ||4||16||49||

[Ang 32 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 |
English: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: govid gunee nidhaan hai ant na paaeaa jaae |
English: The Lord of the Universe is the Treasure of Excellence; His limits cannot be found.

Gurbani: ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਨੀ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kathanee badanee na paaeeai haumai vichahu jaae |
English: He is not obtained by mouthing mere words, but by rooting out ego from within.

Gurbani: ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਦ ਭੈ ਰਚੈ ਆਪਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: satagur miliai sad bhai rachai aap vasai man aae |1|
English: Meeting the True Guru, one is permeated forever with the Fear of God, who Himself comes to dwell within the mind. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhaaee re guramukh boojhai koe |
English: O Siblings of Destiny, one who becomes Gurmukh and understands this is very rare.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਖੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bin boojhe karam kamaavane janam padaarath khoe |1| rahaau |
English: To act without understanding is to lose the treasure of this human life. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਤਿਨੀ ਸਾਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਚਾਖੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jinee chaakhiaa tinee saad paaeaa bin chaakhe bharam bhulaae |
English: Those who have tasted it, enjoy its flavor; without tasting it, they wander in doubt, lost and deceived.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: amrit saachaa naam hai kahanaa kachhoo na jaae |
English: The True Name is the Ambrosial Nectar; no one can describe it.

Gurbani: ਪੀਵਤ ਹੂ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਭਇਆ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: peevat hoo paravaan bheaa poorai sabad samaae |2|
English: Drinking it in, one becomes honorable, absorbed in the Perfect Word of the Shabad. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਤ ਪਾਈਐ ਹੋਰੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aape dee ta paaeeai hor karanaa kichhoo na jaae |
English: He Himself gives, and then we receive. Nothing else can be done.

Gurbani: ਦੇਵਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਕੈ ਹਥਿ ਦਾਤਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: devan vaale kai hath daat hai guroo duaarai paae |
English: The Gift is in the Hands of the Great Giver. At the Guru's Door, in the Gurdwara, it is received.

Gurbani: ਜੇਹਾ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਤੇਹਾ ਹੋਆ ਜੇਹੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jehaa keeton tehaa hoaa jehe karam kamaae |3|
English: Whatever He does, comes to pass. All act according to His Will. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jat sat sanjam naam hai vin naavai niramal na hoe |
English: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is abstinence, truthfulness, and self-restraint. Without the Name, no one becomes pure.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: poorai bhaag naam man vasai sabad milaavaa hoe |
English: Through perfect good fortune, the Naam comes to abide within the mind. Through the Shabad, we merge into Him.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਰੰਗਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੧੭॥੫੦॥
Transliteration: naanak sahaje hee rang varatadaa har gun paavai soe |4|17|50|
English: O Nanak, one who lives in intuitive peace and poise, imbued with the Lord's Love, obtains the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||17||50||

[Ang 33 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 |
English: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਾਂਇਆ ਸਾਧੈ ਉਰਧ ਤਪੁ ਕਰੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kaaneaa saadhai uradh tap karai vichahu haumai na jaae |
English: You may torment your body with extremes of self-discipline, practice intensive meditation and hang upside-down, but your ego will not be eliminated from within.

Gurbani: ਅਧਿਆਤਮ ਕਰਮ ਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: adhiaatam karam je kare naam na kab hee paae |
English: You may perform religious rituals, and still never obtain the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad jeevat marai har naam vasai man aae |1|
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, remain dead while yet alive, and the Name of the Lord shall come to dwell within the mind. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਜੁ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: sun man mere bhaj satagur saranaa |
English: Listen, O my mind: hurry to the Protection of the Guru's Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਬਿਖੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰ ਤਰਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee chhutteeai bikh bhavajal sabad gur taranaa |1| rahaau |
English: By Guru's Grace you shall be saved. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, you shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean of poison. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਸਭਾ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: trai gun sabhaa dhaat hai doojaa bhaau vikaar |
English: Everything under the influence of the three qualities shall perish; the love of duality is corrupting.

Gurbani: ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਪੜੈ ਬੰਧਨ ਮੋਹ ਬਾਧਾ ਨਹ ਬੂਝੈ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: panddit parrai bandhan moh baadhaa neh boojhai bikhiaa piaar |
English: The Pandits, the religious scholars, read the scriptures, but they are trapped in the bondage of emotional attachment. In love with evil, they do not understand.

Gurbani: ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਛੂਟੈ ਚਉਥੈ ਪਦਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: satagur miliai trikuttee chhoottai chauthai pad mukat duaar |2|
English: Meeting the Guru, the bondage of the three qualities is cut away, and in the fourth state, the Door of Liberation is attained. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਚੂਕੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur te maarag paaeeai chookai mohu gubaar |
English: Through the Guru, the Path is found, and the darkness of emotional attachment is dispelled.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਉਧਰੈ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sabad marai taa udharai paae mokh duaar |
English: If one dies through the Shabad, then salvation is obtained, and one finds the Door of Liberation.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee mil rahai sach naam karataar |3|
English: By Guru's Grace, one remains blended with the True Name of the Creator. ||3||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਅਤਿ ਸਬਲ ਹੈ ਛਡੇ ਨ ਕਿਤੈ ਉਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: eihu manooaa at sabal hai chhadde na kitai upaae |
English: This mind is very powerful; we cannot escape it just by trying.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਇਦਾ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: doojai bhaae dukh laaeidaa bahutee dee sajaae |
English: In the love of duality, people suffer in pain, condemned to terrible punishment.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੮॥੫੧॥
Transliteration: naanak naam lage se ubare haumai sabad gavaae |4|18|51|
English: O Nanak, those who are attached to the Naam are saved; through the Shabad, their ego is banished. ||4||18||51||

[Ang 33 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 |
English: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਦੇਇ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kirapaa kare gur paaeeai har naamo dee drirraae |
English: By His Grace, the Guru is found, and the Name of the Lord is implanted within.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin gur kinai na paaeo birathaa janam gavaae |
English: Without the Guru, no one has obtained it; they waste away their lives in vain.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: manamukh karam kamaavane daragah milai sajaae |1|
English: The self-willed manmukhs create karma, and in the Court of the Lord, they receive their punishment. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਚੁਕਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man re doojaa bhaau chukaae |
English: O mind, give up the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: antar terai har vasai gur sevaa sukh paae | rahaau |
English: The Lord dwells within you; serving the Guru, you shall find peace. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਸਚਿ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sach baanee sach sabad hai jaa sach dhare piaar |
English: When you love the Truth, your words are true; they reflect the True Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam man vasai haumai krodh nivaar |
English: The Name of the Lord dwells within the mind; egotism and anger are wiped away.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਤਾ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: man niramal naam dhiaaeeai taa paae mokh duaar |2|
English: Meditating on the Naam with a pure mind, the Door of Liberation is found. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਗੁ ਬਿਨਸਦਾ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: haumai vich jag binasadaa mar jamai aavai jaae |
English: Engrossed in egotism, the world perishes. It dies and is re-born; it continues coming and going in reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਜਾਸਨਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh sabad na jaananee jaasan pat gavaae |
English: The self-willed manmukhs do not recognize the Shabad; they forfeit their honor, and depart in disgrace.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur sevaa naau paaeeai sache rahai samaae |3|
English: Serving the Guru, the Name is obtained, and one remains absorbed in the True Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabad maniai gur paaeeai vichahu aap gavaae |
English: With faith in the Shabad, the Guru is found, and selfishness is eradicated from within.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: anadin bhagat kare sadaa saache kee liv laae |
English: Night and day, worship the True Lord with devotion and love forever.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੯॥੫੨॥
Transliteration: naam padaarath man vasiaa naanak sehaj samaae |4|19|52|
English: The Treasure of the Naam abides in the mind; O Nanak, in the poise of perfect balance, merge into the Lord. ||4||19||52||

[Ang 34 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 |
English: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਪੁਰਖੀ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਸੇ ਦੁਖੀਏ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jinee purakhee satagur na sevio se dukhee jug chaar |
English: Those who do not serve the True Guru shall be miserable throughout the four ages.

Gurbani: ਘਰਿ ਹੋਦਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਿ ਮੁਠੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: ghar hodaa purakh na pachhaaniaa abhimaan mutthe ahankaar |
English: The Primal Being is within their own home, but they do not recognize Him. They are plundered by their egotistical pride and arrogance.

Gurbani: ਸਤਗੁਰੂ ਕਿਆ ਫਿਟਕਿਆ ਮੰਗਿ ਥਕੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: sataguroo kiaa fittakiaa mang thake sansaar |
English: Cursed by the True Guru, they wander around the world begging, until they are exhausted.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sachaa sabad na sevio sabh kaaj savaaranahaar |1|
English: They do not serve the True Word of the Shabad, which is the solution to all of their problems. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਵੇਖੁ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: man mere sadaa har vekh hadoor |
English: O my mind, see the Lord ever close at hand.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਰਹਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: janam maran dukh paraharai sabad rahiaa bharapoor |1| rahaau |
English: He shall remove the pains of death and rebirth; the Word of the Shabad shall fill you to overflowing. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਸੇ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sach salaahan se sache sachaa naam adhaar |
English: Those who praise the True One are true; the True Name is their Support.

Gurbani: ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sachee kaar kamaavanee sache naal piaar |
English: They act truthfully, in love with the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa saahu varatadaa koe na mettanahaar |
English: The True King has written His Order, which no one can erase.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੀ ਕੂੜਿ ਮੁਠੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: manamukh mehal na paaeinee koorr mutthe koorriaar |2|
English: The self-willed manmukhs do not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. The false are plundered by falsehood. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਗੁ ਮੁਆ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: haumai karataa jag muaa gur bin ghor andhaar |
English: Engrossed in egotism, the world perishes. Without the Guru, there is utter darkness.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohi visaariaa sukhadaataa daataar |
English: In emotional attachment to Maya, they have forgotten the Great Giver, the Giver of Peace.

Gurbani: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਉਬਰਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਰਖਹਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: satagur seveh taa ubareh sach rakheh ur dhaar |
English: Those who serve the True Guru are saved; they keep the True One enshrined in their hearts.

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kirapaa te har paaeeai sach sabad veechaar |3|
English: By His Grace, we find the Lord, and reflect on the True Word of the Shabad. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: satagur sev man niramalaa haumai taj vikaar |
English: Serving the True Guru, the mind becomes immaculate and pure; egotism and corruption are discarded.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: aap chhodd jeevat marai gur kai sabad veechaar |
English: So abandon your selfishness, and remain dead while yet alive. Contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਧੰਧਾ ਧਾਵਤ ਰਹਿ ਗਏ ਲਾਗਾ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: dhandhaa dhaavat reh ge laagaa saach piaar |
English: The pursuit of worldly affairs comes to an end, when you embrace love for the True One.

Gurbani: ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: sach rate mukh ujale tith saachai darabaar |4|
English: Those who are attuned to Truth-their faces are radiant in the Court of the True Lord. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਮੰਨਿਓ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: satagur purakh na manio sabad na lago piaar |
English: Those who do not have faith in the Primal Being, the True Guru, and who do not enshrine love for the Shabad

Gurbani: ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਜੇਤਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: eisanaan daan jetaa kareh doojai bhaae khuaar |
English: they take their cleansing baths, and give to charity again and again, but they are ultimately consumed by their love of duality.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਣੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਨਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: har jeeo aapanee kripaa kare taa laagai naam piaar |
English: When the Dear Lord Himself grants His Grace, they are inspired to love the Naam.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਤੂ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥੫॥੨੦॥੫੩॥
Transliteration: naanak naam samaal too gur kai het apaar |5|20|53|
English: O Nanak, immerse yourself in the Naam, through the Infinite Love of the Guru. ||5||20||53||

[Ang 34 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 |
English: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਿਸੁ ਹਉ ਸੇਵੀ ਕਿਆ ਜਪੁ ਕਰੀ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਪੂਛਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kis hau sevee kiaa jap karee satagur poochhau jaae |
English: Whom shall I serve? What shall I chant? I will go and ask the Guru.

Gurbani: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਲਈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: satagur kaa bhaanaa man lee vichahu aap gavaae |
English: I will accept the Will of the True Guru, and eradicate selfishness from within.

Gurbani: ਏਹਾ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: ehaa sevaa chaakaree naam vasai man aae |
English: By this work and service, the Naam shall come to dwell within my mind.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naamai hee te sukh paaeeai sachai sabad suhaae |1|
English: Through the Naam, peace is obtained; I am adorned and embellished by the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗੁ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: man mere anadin jaag har chet |
English: O my mind, remain awake and aware night and day, and think of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਪਣੀ ਖੇਤੀ ਰਖਿ ਲੈ ਕੂੰਜ ਪੜੈਗੀ ਖੇਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aapanee khetee rakh lai koonj parraigee khet |1| rahaau |
English: Protect your crops, or else the birds shall descend on your farm. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕੀਆ ਇਛਾ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: man keea ichhaa pooreea sabad rahiaa bharapoor |
English: The desires of the mind are fulfilled, when one is filled to overflowing with the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਦਾ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: bhai bhaae bhagat kareh din raatee har jeeo vekhai sadaa hadoor |
English: One who fears, loves, and is devoted to the Dear Lord day and night, sees Him always close at hand.

Gurbani: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਸਰੀਰਹੁ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: sachai sabad sadaa man raataa bhram geaa sareerahu door |
English: Doubt runs far away from the bodies of those, whose minds remain forever attuned to the True Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਚਾ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: niramal saahib paaeaa saachaa gunee gaheer |2|
English: The Immaculate Lord and Master is found. He is True; He is the Ocean of Excellence. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜਾਗੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਸੂਤੇ ਗਏ ਮੁਹਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jo jaage se ubare soote ge muhaae |
English: Those who remain awake and aware are saved, while those who sleep are plundered.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਿਓ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਗਇਆ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa sabad na pachhaanio supanaa geaa vihaae |
English: They do not recognize the True Word of the Shabad, and like a dream, their lives fade away.

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਞੇ ਘਰ ਕਾ ਪਾਹੁਣਾ ਜਿਉ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sunye ghar kaa paahunaa jiau aaeaa tiau jaae |
English: Like guests in a deserted house, they leave just exactly as they have come.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਜਨਮੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਗਇਆ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਦੇਸੀ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: manamukh janam birathaa geaa kiaa muhu desee jaae |3|
English: The life of the self-willed manmukh passes uselessly. What face will he show when he passes beyond? ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh aape aap hai haumai vich kehan na jaae |
English: God Himself is everything; those who are in their ego cannot even speak of this.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad pachhaaneeai dukh haumai vichahu gavaae |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is realized, and the pain of egotism is eradicated from within.

Gurbani: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: satagur sevan aapanaa hau tin kai laagau paae |
English: I fall at the feet of those who serve their True Guru.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰ ਹਹਿ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥੪॥੨੧॥੫੪॥
Transliteration: naanak dar sachai sachiaar heh hau tin balihaarai jaau |4|21|54|
English: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those who are found to be true in the True Court. ||4||21||54||

[Ang 35 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 |
English: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਵੇਲਾ ਵਖਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਤਾ ਕਿਤੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: je velaa vakhat veechaareeai taa kit velaa bhagat hoe |
English: Consider the time and the moment-when should we worship the Lord?

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਤਿਆ ਸਚੇ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: anadin naame ratiaa sache sachee soe |
English: Night and day, one who is attuned to the Name of the True Lord is true.

Gurbani: ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਿਨੇਹੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: eik til piaaraa visarai bhagat kinehee hoe |
English: If someone forgets the Beloved Lord, even for an instant, what sort of devotion is that?

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਾਚ ਸਿਉ ਸਾਸੁ ਨ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: man tan seetal saach siau saas na birathaa koe |1|
English: One whose mind and body are cooled and soothed by the True Lord-no breath of his is wasted. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: mere man har kaa naam dhiaae |
English: O my mind, meditate on the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਤਾ ਥੀਐ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saachee bhagat taa theeai jaa har vasai man aae |1| rahaau |
English: True devotional worship is performed when the Lord comes to dwell in the mind. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਖੇਤੀ ਰਾਹੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੀਜੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sahaje khetee raaheeai sach naam beej paae |
English: With intuitive ease, cultivate your farm, and plant the Seed of the True Name.

Gurbani: ਖੇਤੀ ਜੰਮੀ ਅਗਲੀ ਮਨੂਆ ਰਜਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: khetee jamee agalee manooaa rajaa sehaj subhaae |
English: The seedlings have sprouted luxuriantly, and with intuitive ease, the mind is satisfied.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਪੀਤੈ ਤਿਖ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa sabad amrit hai jit peetai tikh jaae |
English: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is Ambrosial Nectar; drinking it in, thirst is quenched.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਚਿ ਰਤਾ ਸਚੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: eihu man saachaa sach rataa sache rahiaa samaae |2|
English: This true mind is attuned to Truth, and it remains permeated with the True One. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਖਣੁ ਵੇਖਣੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਸਬਦੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aakhan vekhan bolanaa sabade rahiaa samaae |
English: In speaking, in seeing and in words, remain immersed in the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਬਾਣੀ ਵਜੀ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗੀ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: baanee vajee chahu jugee sacho sach sunaae |
English: The Word of the Guru's Bani vibrates throughout the four ages. As Truth, it teaches Truth.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਹਿ ਗਇਆ ਸਚੈ ਲਇਆ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: haumai meraa reh geaa sachai leaa milaae |
English: Egotism and possessiveness are eliminated, and the True One absorbs them into Himself.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਮਹਲੁ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tin kau mehal hadoor hai jo sach rahe liv laae |3|
English: Those who remain lovingly absorbed in the True One see the Mansion of His Presence close at hand. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਦਰੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: nadaree naam dhiaaeeai vin karamaa paaeaa na jaae |
English: By His Grace, we meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Without His Mercy, it cannot be obtained.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਲਹੈ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: poorai bhaag satasangat lahai satagur bhettai jis aae |
English: Through perfect good destiny, one finds the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and one comes to meet the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਤਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: anadin naame ratiaa dukh bikhiaa vichahu jaae |
English: Night and day, remain attuned to the Naam, and the pain of corruption shall be dispelled from within.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੜਾ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੨੨॥੫੫॥
Transliteration: naanak sabad milaavarraa naame naam samaae |4|22|55|
English: O Nanak, merging with the Shabad through the Name, one is immersed in the Name. ||4||22||55||

[Ang 35 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 |
English: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਪਣਾ ਭਉ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: aapanaa bhau tin paaeon jin gur kaa sabad beechaar |
English: Those who contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad are filled with the Fear of God.

Gurbani: ਸਤਸੰਗਤੀ ਸਦਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: satasangatee sadaa mil rahe sache ke gun saar |
English: They remain forever merged with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation; they dwell upon the Glories of the True One.

Gurbani: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਈਅਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: dubidhaa mail chukaaeean har raakhiaa ur dhaar |
English: They cast off the filth of their mental duality, and they keep the Lord enshrined in their hearts.

Gurbani: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sachee baanee sach man sache naal piaar |1|
English: True is their speech, and true are their minds. They are in love with the True One. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: man mere haumai mail bhar naal |
English: O my mind, you are filled with the filth of egotism.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਣਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har niramal sadaa sohanaa sabad savaaranahaar |1| rahaau |
English: The Immaculate Lord is eternally Beautiful. We are adorned with the Word of the Shabad. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sachai sabad man mohiaa prabh aape le milaae |
English: God joins to Himself those whose minds are fascinated with the True Word of His Shabad.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਤਿਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: anadin naame ratiaa jotee jot samaae |
English: Night and day, they are attuned to the Naam, and their light is absorbed into the Light.

Gurbani: ਜੋਤੀ ਹੂ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਪਦਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jotee hoo prabh jaapadaa bin satagur boojh na paae |
English: Through His Light, God is revealed. Without the True Guru, understanding is not obtained.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jin kau poorab likhiaa satagur bhettiaa tin aae |2|
English: The True Guru comes to meet those who have such pre-ordained destiny. ||2||

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਡੁਮਣੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: vin naavai sabh ddumanee doojai bhaae khuaae |
English: Without the Name, all are miserable. In the love of duality, they are ruined.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਜੀਵਦੀ ਦੁਖੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: tis bin gharree na jeevadee dukhee rain vihaae |
English: Without Him, I cannot survive even for an instant, and my life-night passes in anguish.

Gurbani: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣਾ ਅੰਧੁਲਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bharam bhulaanaa andhulaa fir fir aavai jaae |
English: Wandering in doubt, the spiritually blind come and go in reincarnation, over and over again.

Gurbani: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: nadar kare prabh aapanee aape le milaae |3|
English: When God Himself bestows His Glance of Grace, He blends us into Himself. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੁਣਦਾ ਵੇਖਦਾ ਕਿਉ ਮੁਕਰਿ ਪਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh sunadaa vekhadaa kiau mukar peaa jaae |
English: He hears and sees everything. How can anyone deny Him?

Gurbani: ਪਾਪੋ ਪਾਪੁ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਪਾਪੇ ਪਚਹਿ ਪਚਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: paapo paap kamaavade paape pacheh pachaae |
English: Those who sin again and again, shall rot and die in sin.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: so prabh nadar na aavee manamukh boojh na paae |
English: God's Glance of Grace does not come to them; those self-willed manmukhs do not obtain understanding.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਵੇਖਾਲੇ ਸੋਈ ਵੇਖੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੫੬॥
Transliteration: jis vekhaale soee vekhai naanak guramukh paae |4|23|56|
English: They alone see the Lord, unto whom He reveals Himself. O Nanak, the Gurmukhs find Him. ||4||23||56||

[Ang 36 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: sreeraag mahalaa 3 |
English: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਤੁਟਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਪੀੜ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin gur rog na tuttee haumai peerr na jaae |
English: Without the Guru, the disease is not cured, and the pain of egotism is not removed.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee man vasai naame rahai samaae |
English: By Guru's Grace, He dwells in the mind, and one remains immersed in His Name.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gurasabadee har paaeeai bin sabadai bharam bhulaae |1|
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord is found; without the Shabad, people wander, deceived by doubt. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: man re nij ghar vaasaa hoe |
English: O mind, dwell in the balanced state of your own inner being.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਤੂ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam saalaeh too fir aavan jaan na hoe |1| rahaau |
English: Praise the Lord's Name, and you shall no longer come and go in reincarnation. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: har iko daataa varatadaa doojaa avar na koe |
English: The One Lord alone is the Giver, pervading everywhere. There is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabad saalaahee man vasai sahaje hee sukh hoe |
English: Praise the Word of the Shabad, and He shall come to dwell in your mind; you shall be blessed with intuitive peace and poise.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਨਦਰੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵੇਖਦਾ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sabh nadaree andar vekhadaa jai bhaavai tai dee |2|
English: Everything is within the Lord's Glance of Grace. As He wishes, He gives. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਸਭਾ ਗਣਤ ਹੈ ਗਣਤੈ ਨਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: haumai sabhaa ganat hai ganatai nau sukh naeh |
English: In egotism, all must account for their actions. In this accounting, there is no peace.

Gurbani: ਬਿਖੁ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਬਿਖੁ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: bikh kee kaar kamaavanee bikh hee maeh samaeh |
English: Acting in evil and corruption, people are immersed in corruption.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਠਉਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੀ ਜਮਪੁਰਿ ਦੂਖ ਸਹਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bin naavai tthaur na paaeinee jamapur dookh sahaeh |3|
English: Without the Name, they find no place of rest. In the City of Death, they suffer in agony. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਤਿਸੈ ਦਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jeeo pindd sabh tis daa tisai daa aadhaar |
English: Body and soul all belong to Him; He is the Support of all.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਤਾ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee bujheeai taa paae mokh duaar |
English: By Guru's Grace, understanding comes, and then the Door of Liberation is found.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੨੪॥੫੭॥
Transliteration: naanak naam salaeh toon ant na paaraavaar |4|24|57|
English: O Nanak, sing the Praises of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; He has no end or limitation. ||4||24||57||

[Ang 36 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 |
English: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤਿਨਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: tinaa anand sadaa sukh hai jinaa sach naam aadhaar |
English: Those who have the Support of the True Name are in ecstasy and peace forever.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: gurasabadee sach paaeaa dookh nivaaranahaar |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they obtain the True One, the Destroyer of pain.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa saache gun gaaveh saachai naae piaar |
English: Forever and ever, they sing the Glorious Praises of the True One; they love the True Name.

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਆਪਣੀ ਦਿਤੋਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kirapaa kar kai aapanee diton bhagat bhanddaar |1|
English: When the Lord Himself grants His Grace, He bestows the treasure of devotion. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man re sadaa anand gun gaae |
English: O mind, sing His Glorious Praises, and be in ecstasy forever.

Gurbani: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sachee baanee har paaeeai har siau rahai samaae |1| rahaau |
English: Through the True Word of His Bani, the Lord is obtained, and one remains immersed in the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਥੀਆ ਰਤਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sachee bhagatee man laal theea rataa sehaj subhaae |
English: In true devotion, the mind is dyed in the deep crimson color of the Lord's Love, with intuitive peace and poise.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gurasabadee man mohiaa kahanaa kachhoo na jaae |
English: The mind is fascinated by the Word of the Guru's Shabad, which cannot be described.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਰਤੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਰਸਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jihavaa ratee sabad sachai amrit peevai ras gun gaae |
English: The tongue imbued with the True Word of the Shabad drinks in the Amrit with delight, singing His Glorious Praises.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਹੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: guramukh ehu rang paaeeai jis no kirapaa kare rajaae |2|
English: The Gurmukh obtains this love, when the Lord, in His Will, grants His Grace. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੰਸਾ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਸੁਤਿਆ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sansaa ihu sansaar hai sutiaa rain vihaae |
English: This world is an illusion; people pass their life-nights sleeping.

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਕਢਿ ਲਇਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਲਇਓਨੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: eik aapanai bhaanai kadt leian aape leon milaae |
English: By the Pleasure of His Will, He lifts some out, and unites them with Himself.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aape hee aap man vasiaa maaeaa mohu chukaae |
English: He Himself abides in the mind, and drives out attachment to Maya.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਦਿਤੀਅਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aap vaddaaee diteean guramukh dee bujhaae |3|
English: He Himself bestows glorious greatness; He inspires the Gurmukh to understand. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਭੁਲਿਆ ਲਏ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabhanaa kaa daataa ek hai bhuliaa le samajhaae |
English: The One Lord is the Giver of all. He corrects those who make mistakes.

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਇਅਨੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਛਡਿਅਨੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: eik aape aap khuaaeian doojai chhaddian laae |
English: He Himself has deceived some, and attached them to duality.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramatee har paaeeai jotee jot milaae |
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Lord is found, and one's light merges into the Light.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਤਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੨੫॥੫੮॥
Transliteration: anadin naame ratiaa naanak naam samaae |4|25|58|
English: Attuned to the Name of the Lord night and day, O Nanak, you shall be absorbed into the Name. ||4||25||58||

[Ang 36 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 |
English: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: gunavantee sach paaeaa trisanaa taj vikaar |
English: The virtuous obtain Truth; they give up their desires for evil and corruption.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗਿਆ ਰਸਨਾ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: gurasabadee man rangiaa rasanaa prem piaar |
English: Their minds are imbued with the Word of the Guru's Shabad; the Love of their Beloved is on their tongues.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: bin satigur kinai na paaeo kar vekhahu man veechaar |
English: Without the True Guru, no one has found Him; reflect upon this in your mind and see.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਕਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: manamukh mail na utarai jichar gur sabad na kare piaar |1|
English: The filth of the self-willed manmukhs is not washed off; they have no love for the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: man mere satigur kai bhaanai chal |
English: O my mind, walk in harmony with the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਸੁਖ ਲਹਹਿ ਮਹਲੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: nij ghar vaseh amrit peeveh taa sukh laheh mehal |1| rahaau |
English: Dwell within the home of your own inner being, and drink in the Ambrosial Nectar; you shall attain the Peace of the Mansion of His Presence. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਉਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਗੁਣੁ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਬਹਣਿ ਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: aaugunavantee gun ko nahee behan na milai hadoor |
English: The unvirtuous have no merit; they are not allowed to sit in His Presence.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਅਵਗਣਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh sabad na jaanee avagan so prabh door |
English: The self-willed manmukhs do not know the Shabad; those without virtue are far removed from God.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jinee sach pachhaaniaa sach rate bharapoor |
English: Those who recognize the True One are permeated and attuned to Truth.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gurasabadee man bedhiaa prabh miliaa aap hadoor |2|
English: Their minds are pierced through by the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and God Himself ushers them into His Presence. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਰੰਗਣਿ ਰੰਗਿਓਨੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਲਇਓਨੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aape rangan rangion sabade leon milaae |
English: He Himself dyes us in the Color of His Love; through the Word of His Shabad, He unites us with Himself.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa rang na utarai jo sach rate liv laae |
English: This True Color shall not fade away, for those who are attuned to His Love.

Gurbani: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਭਵਿ ਥਕੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: chaare kunddaa bhav thake manamukh boojh na paae |
English: The self-willed manmukhs grow weary of wandering around in all four directions, but they do not understand.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jis satigur mele so milai sachai sabad samaae |3|
English: One who is united with the True Guru, meets and merges in the True Word of the Shabad. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਘਣੇਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਥਕੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: mitr ghanere kar thakee meraa dukh kaattai koe |
English: I have grown weary of making so many friends, hoping that someone might be able to end my suffering.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਟਿਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: mil preetam dukh kattiaa sabad milaavaa hoe |
English: Meeting with my Beloved, my suffering has ended; I have attained Union with the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਖਟਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਸਚੇ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sach khattanaa sach raas hai sache sachee soe |
English: Earning Truth, and accumulating the Wealth of Truth, the truthful person gains a reputation of Truth.

Gurbani: ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੨੬॥੫੯॥
Transliteration: sach mile se na vichhurreh naanak guramukh hoe |4|26|59|
English: Meeting with the True One, O Nanak, the Gurmukh shall not be separated from Him again. ||4||26||59||

[Ang 37 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 |
English: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aape kaaran karataa kare srisatt dekhai aap upaae |
English: The Creator Himself created the Creation; He produced the Universe, and He Himself watches over it.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਏਕੋ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabh eko ik varatadaa alakh na lakhiaa jaae |
English: The One and Only Lord is pervading and permeating all. The Unseen cannot be seen.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aape prabhoo deaal hai aape dee bujhaae |
English: God Himself is Merciful; He Himself bestows understanding.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਦ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: guramatee sad man vasiaa sach rahe liv laae |1|
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, the True One dwells forever in the mind of those who remain lovingly attached to Him. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਲੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man mere gur kee man lai rajaae |
English: O my mind, surrender to the Guru's Will.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਭੁ ਥੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: man tan seetal sabh theeai naam vasai man aae |1| rahaau |
English: Mind and body are totally cooled and soothed, and the Naam comes to dwell in the mind. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਧਾਰਿਆ ਸੋਈ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: jin kar kaaran dhaariaa soee saar karee |
English: Having created the creation, He supports it and takes care of it.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad pachhaaneeai jaa aape nadar karee |
English: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is realized, when He Himself bestows His Glance of Grace.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਬਦੇ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: se jan sabade sohane tith sachai darabaar |
English: Those who are beautifully adorned with the Shabad in the Court of the True Lord

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਆਪਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: guramukh sachai sabad rate aap mele karataar |2|
English: -those Gurmukhs are attuned to the True Word of the Shabad; the Creator unites them with Himself. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਣਾ ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramatee sach salaahanaa jis daa ant na paaraavaar |
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, praise the True One, who has no end or limitation.

Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਵਸੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt aape hukam vasai hukame kare beechaar |
English: He dwells in each and every heart, by the Hukam of His Command; by His Hukam, we contemplate Him.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਖੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: gurasabadee saalaaheeai haumai vichahu khoe |
English: So praise Him through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and drive out egotism from within.

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਅਵਗਣਵੰਤੀ ਰੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: saa dhan naavai baaharee avaganavantee roe |3|
English: That soul-bride who lacks the Lord's Name acts without virtue, and so she grieves. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਸਚਿ ਲਗਾ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sach salaahee sach lagaa sachai naae tripat hoe |
English: Praising the True One, attached to the True One, I am satisfied with the True Name.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਾ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਕਢਾ ਧੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: gun veechaaree gun sangrahaa avagun kadtaa dhoe |
English: Contemplating His Virtues, I accumulate virtue and merit; I wash myself clean of demerits.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਵੇਛੋੜਾ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aape mel milaaeidaa fir vechhorraa na hoe |
English: He Himself unites us in His Union; there is no more separation.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਿਦੂ ਪਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੨੭॥੬੦॥
Transliteration: naanak gur saalaahee aapanaa jidoo paaee prabh soe |4|27|60|
English: O Nanak, I sing the Praises of my Guru; through Him, I find that God. ||4||27||60||

[Ang 37 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 |
English: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਕਾਮ ਗਹੇਲੀਏ ਕਿਆ ਚਲਹਿ ਬਾਹ ਲੁਡਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sun sun kaam gahelee kiaa chaleh baah luddaae |
English: Listen, listen, O soul-bride: you are overtaken by sexual desire-why do you walk like that, swinging your arms in joy?

Gurbani: ਆਪਣਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਹੀ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਦੇਸਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aapanaa pir na pachhaanahee kiaa muhu deseh jaae |
English: You do not recognize your own Husband Lord! When you go to Him, what face will you show Him?

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਖਂੀ ਕੰਤੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jinee sakhanee kant pachhaaniaa hau tin kai laagau paae |
English: I touch the feet of my sister soul-brides who have known their Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਜੈਸੀ ਥੀ ਰਹਾ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tin hee jaisee thee rahaa satasangat mel milaae |1|
English: If only I could be like them! Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I am united in His Union. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੁੰਧੇ ਕੂੜਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: mundhe koorr mutthee koorriaar |
English: O woman, the false ones are being cheated by falsehood.

Gurbani: ਪਿਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਹਣਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: pir prabh saachaa sohanaa paaeeai gur beechaar |1| rahaau |
English: God is your Husband; He is Handsome and True. He is obtained by reflecting upon the Guru. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਈ ਤਿਨ ਕਿਉ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh kant na pachhaanee tin kiau rain vihaae |
English: The self-willed manmukhs do not recognize their Husband Lord; how will they spend their life-night?

Gurbani: ਗਰਬਿ ਅਟੀਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਲਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: garab atteea trisanaa jaleh dukh paaveh doojai bhaae |
English: Filled with arrogance, they burn with desire; they suffer in the pain of the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਤਿਨ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabad rateea sohaaganee tin vichahu haumai jaae |
English: The happy soul-brides are attuned to the Shabad; their egotism is eliminated from within.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਿਨਾ ਸੁਖੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sadaa pir raaveh aapanaa tinaa sukhe sukh vihaae |2|
English: They enjoy their Husband Lord forever, and their life-night passes in the most blissful peace. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਹੂਣੀ ਪਿਰ ਮੁਤੀਆ ਪਿਰਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: giaan vihoonee pir muteea piram na paaeaa jaae |
English: She is utterly lacking in spiritual wisdom; she is abandoned by her Husband Lord. She cannot obtain His Love.

Gurbani: ਅਗਿਆਨ ਮਤੀ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਹੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਦੇਖੇ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: agiaan matee andher hai bin pir dekhe bhukh na jaae |
English: In the darkness of intellectual ignorance, she cannot see her Husband, and her hunger does not depart.

Gurbani: ਆਵਹੁ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਸਹੇਲੀਹੋ ਮੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aavahu milahu saheleeho mai pir dehu milaae |
English: Come and meet with me, my sister soul-brides, and unite me with my Husband.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: poorai bhaag satigur milai pir paaeaa sach samaae |3|
English: She who meets the True Guru, by perfect good fortune, finds her Husband; she is absorbed in the True One. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਸਹੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: se saheea sohaaganee jin kau nadar karee |
English: Those upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace become His happy soul-brides.

Gurbani: ਖਸਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਆਗੈ ਦੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: khasam pachhaaneh aapanaa tan man aagai dee |
English: One who recognizes her Lord and Master places her body and mind in offering before Him.

Gurbani: ਘਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਪਣਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: ghar var paaeaa aapanaa haumai door karee |
English: Within her own home, she finds her Husband Lord; her egotism is dispelled.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੪॥੨੮॥੬੧॥
Transliteration: naanak sobhaavanteea sohaaganee anadin bhagat karee |4|28|61|
English: O Nanak, the happy soul-brides are embellished and exalted; night and day they are absorbed in devotional worship. ||4||28||61||

[Ang 38 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 |
English: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਹਉ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਪੂਛਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: eik pir raaveh aapanaa hau kai dar poochhau jaae |
English: Some enjoy their Husband Lord; unto whose door should I go to ask for Him?

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਮੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sevee bhaau kar mai pir dehu milaae |
English: I serve my True Guru with love, that He may lead me to Union with my Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਉਪਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਕਿਸੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਕਿਸੁ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: sabh upaae aape vekhai kis nerrai kis door |
English: He created all, and He Himself watches over us. Some are close to Him, and some are far away.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਸੰਗੇ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਸਦਾ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jin pir sange jaaniaa pir raave sadaa hadoor |1|
English: She who knows her Husband Lord to be always with her, enjoys His Constant Presence. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੁੰਧੇ ਤੂ ਚਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: mundhe too chal gur kai bhaae |
English: O woman, you must walk in harmony with the Guru's Will.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਵਹਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: anadin raaveh pir aapanaa sahaje sach samaae |1| rahaau |
English: Night and day, you shall enjoy your Husband, and you shall intuitively merge into the True One. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: sabad rateea sohaaganee sachai sabad seegaar |
English: Attuned to the Shabad, the happy soul-brides are adorned with the True Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: har var paaein ghar aapanai gur kai het piaar |
English: Within their own home, they obtain the Lord as their Husband, with love for the Guru.

Gurbani: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਵੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: sej suhaavee har rang ravai bhagat bhare bhanddaar |
English: Upon her beautiful and cozy bed, she enjoys the Love of her Lord. She is overflowing with the treasure of devotion.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਜਿ ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇਇ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: so prabh preetam man vasai ji sabhasai dee adhaar |2|
English: That Beloved God abides in her mind; He gives His Support to all. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪਿਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: pir saalaahan aapanaa tin kai hau sad balihaarai jaau |
English: I am forever a sacrifice to those who praise their Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪੀ ਸਿਰੁ ਦੇਈ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man tan arapee sir deee tin kai laagaa paae |
English: I dedicate my mind and body to them, and give my head as well; I fall at their feet.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਇਕੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਚੁਕਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jinee ik pachhaaniaa doojaa bhaau chukaae |
English: Those who recognize the One renounce the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥੨੯॥੬੨॥
Transliteration: guramukh naam pachhaaneeai naanak sach samaae |3|29|62|
English: The Gurmukh recognizes the Naam, O Nanak, and is absorbed into the True One. ||3||29||62||

[Ang 38 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 |
English: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਤੂ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਚੀਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: har jee sachaa sach too sabh kichh terai cheerai |
English: O Dear Lord, You are the Truest of the True. All things are in Your Power.

Gurbani: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਤਰਸਦੇ ਫਿਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਪੀਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh tarasade fire bin gur bhette peerai |
English: The 8.4 million species of beings wander around searching for You, but without the Guru, they do not find You.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਬਖਸੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਸੂਖ ਸਦਾ ਸਰੀਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: har jeeo bakhase bakhas le sookh sadaa sareerai |
English: When the Dear Lord grants His Forgiveness, this human body finds lasting peace.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੀ ਸਚੁ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee sev karee sach gahir ganbheerai |1|
English: By Guru's Grace, I serve the True One, who is Immeasurably Deep and Profound. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: man mere naam rate sukh hoe |
English: O my mind, attuned to the Naam, you shall find peace.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: guramatee naam salaaheeai doojaa avar na koe |1| rahaau |
English: Follow the Guru's Teachings, and praise the Naam; there is no other at all. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਨੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੈ ਬਹਿ ਸਚਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: dharam raae no hukam hai beh sachaa dharam beechaar |
English: The Righteous Judge of Dharma, by the Hukam of God's Command, sits and administers True Justice.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਸਟੁ ਆਤਮਾ ਓਹੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: doojai bhaae dusatt aatamaa ohu teree sarakaar |
English: Those evil souls, ensnared by the love of duality, are subject to Your Command.

Gurbani: ਅਧਿਆਤਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਤਾਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਜਪਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: adhiaatamee har gun taas man japeh ek muraar |
English: The souls on their spiritual journey chant and meditate within their minds on the One Lord, the Treasure of Excellence.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕਰੈ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tin kee sevaa dharam raae karai dhan savaaranahaar |2|
English: The Righteous Judge of Dharma serves them; blessed is the Lord who adorns them. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕੇ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮਨਹਿ ਤਜੈ ਮਨਿ ਚੂਕੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: man ke bikaar maneh tajai man chookai mohu abhimaan |
English: One who eliminates mental wickedness from within the mind, and casts out emotional attachment and egotistical pride,

Gurbani: ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: aatam raam pachhaaniaa sahaje naam samaan |
English: comes to recognize the All-pervading Soul, and is intuitively absorbed into the Naam.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਦਿਵਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: bin satigur mukat na paaeeai manamukh firai divaan |
English: Without the True Guru, the self-willed manmukhs do not find liberation; they wander around like lunatics.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੈ ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਨੀ ਕਰੇ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sabad na cheenai kathanee badanee kare bikhiaa maeh samaan |3|
English: They do not contemplate the Shabad; engrossed in corruption, they utter only empty words. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh aape aap hai doojaa avar na koe |
English: He Himself is everything; there is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਬੋਲਾਏ ਤਿਉ ਬੋਲੀਐ ਜਾ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਲਾਏ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jiau bolaae tiau boleeai jaa aap bulaae soe |
English: I speak just as He makes me speak, when He Himself makes me speak.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh baanee braham hai sabad milaavaa hoe |
English: The Word of the Gurmukh is God Himself. Through the Shabad, we merge in Him.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਤੂ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੩੦॥੬੩॥
Transliteration: naanak naam samaal too jit seviai sukh hoe |4|30|63|
English: O Nanak, remember the Naam; serving Him, peace is obtained. ||4||30||63||

[Ang 39 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 |
English: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਗਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jag haumai mail dukh paaeaa mal laagee doojai bhaae |
English: The world is polluted with the filth of egotism, suffering in pain. This filth sticks to them because of their love of duality.

Gurbani: ਮਲੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਧੋਤੀ ਕਿਵੈ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਜੇ ਸਉ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: mal haumai dhotee kivai na utarai je sau teerath naae |
English: This filth of egotism cannot be washed away, even by taking cleansing baths at hundreds of sacred shrines.

Gurbani: ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਦੂਣੀ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: bahu bidh karam kamaavade doonee mal laagee aae |
English: Performing all sorts of rituals, people are smeared with twice as much filth.

Gurbani: ਪੜਿਐ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਗਿਆਨੀਆ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: parriai mail na utarai poochhahu giaaneea jaae |1|
English: This filth is not removed by studying. Go ahead, and ask the wise ones. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: man mere gur saran aavai taa niramal hoe |
English: O my mind, coming to the Sanctuary of the Guru, you shall become immaculate and pure.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਥਕੇ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਸਕੀ ਧੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh har har kar thake mail na sakee dhoe |1| rahaau |
English: The self-willed manmukhs have grown weary of chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, but their filth cannot be removed. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਮੈਲੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man mailai bhagat na hovee naam na paaeaa jaae |
English: With a polluted mind, devotional service cannot be performed, and the Naam, the Name of the Lord, cannot be obtained.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੈਲੇ ਮੈਲੇ ਮੁਏ ਜਾਸਨਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh maile maile mue jaasan pat gavaae |
English: The filthy, self-willed manmukhs die in filth, and they depart in disgrace.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਲੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee man vasai mal haumai jaae samaae |
English: By Guru's Grace, the Lord comes to abide in the mind, and the filth of egotism is dispelled.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਅੰਧੇਰੈ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਬਾਲੀਐ ਤਿਉ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਤਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jiau andherai deepak baaleeai tiau gur giaan agiaan tajaae |2|
English: Like a lamp lit in the darkness, the spiritual wisdom of the Guru dispels ignorance. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਕੀਆ ਹਮ ਕਰਹਗੇ ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਗਾਵਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: ham keea ham karahage ham moorakh gaavaar |
English: "I have done this, and I will do that" - I am an idiotic fool for saying this!

Gurbani: ਕਰਣੈ ਵਾਲਾ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: karanai vaalaa visariaa doojai bhaae piaar |
English: I have forgotten the Doer of all; I am caught in the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਸਭਿ ਭਵਿ ਥਕੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa jevadd dukh nahee sabh bhav thake sansaar |
English: There is no pain as great as the pain of Maya; it drives people to wander all around the world, until they become exhausted.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: guramatee sukh paaeeai sach naam ur dhaar |3|
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, peace is found, with the True Name enshrined in the heart. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jis no mele so milai hau tis balihaarai jaau |
English: I am a sacrifice to those who meet and merge with the Lord.

Gurbani: ਏ ਮਨ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਿਜ ਥਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: e man bhagatee ratiaa sach baanee nij thaau |
English: This mind is attuned to devotional worship; through the True Word of Gurbani, it finds its own home.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਰਤੇ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਰਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਚੇ ਗਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: man rate jihavaa ratee har gun sache gaau |
English: With the mind so imbued, and the tongue imbued as well, sing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਸਚੇ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੪॥੩੧॥੬੪॥
Transliteration: naanak naam na veesarai sache maeh samaau |4|31|64|
English: O Nanak, never forget the Naam; immerse yourself in the True One. ||4||31||64||

[Ang 39 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 4 ghar 1 |
English: Siree Raag, Fourth Mehl, First House:

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਅਤਿ ਅਗਲਾ ਕਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: mai man tan birahu at agalaa kiau preetam milai ghar aae |
English: Within my mind and body is the intense pain of separation; how can my Beloved come to meet me in my home?

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਦੇਖਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦੇਖਿਐ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jaa dekhaa prabh aapanaa prabh dekhiai dukh jaae |
English: When I see my God, seeing God Himself, my pain is taken away.

Gurbani: ਜਾਇ ਪੁਛਾ ਤਿਨ ਸਜਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jaae puchhaa tin sajanaa prabh kit bidh milai milaae |1|
English: I go and ask my friends, "How can I meet and merge with God?" ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਾ ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: mere satiguraa mai tujh bin avar na koe |
English: O my True Guru, without You I have no other at all.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ham moorakh mugadh saranaagatee kar kirapaa mele har soe |1| rahaau |
English: I am foolish and ignorant; I seek Your Sanctuary. Please be Merciful and unite me with the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur daataa har naam kaa prabh aap milaavai soe |
English: The True Guru is the Giver of the Name of the Lord. God Himself causes us to meet Him.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur har prabh bujhiaa gur jevadd avar na koe |
English: The True Guru understands the Lord God. There is no other as Great as the Guru.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਢਹਿ ਪਵਾ ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਮੇਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: hau gur saranaaee dteh pavaa kar deaa mele prabh soe |2|
English: I have come and collapsed in the Guru's Sanctuary. In His Kindness, He has united me with God. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਉਪਾਵ ਥਕੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: manahatth kinai na paaeaa kar upaav thake sabh koe |
English: No one has found Him by stubborn-mindedness. All have grown weary of the effort.

Gurbani: ਸਹਸ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਮਨਿ ਕੋਰੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sehas siaanap kar rahe man korai rang na hoe |
English: Thousands of clever mental tricks have been tried, but still, the raw and undisciplined mind does not absorb the Color of the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜਿ ਕਪਟਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਜੋ ਬੀਜੈ ਖਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: koorr kapatt kinai na paaeo jo beejai khaavai soe |3|
English: By falsehood and deception, none have found Him. Whatever you plant, you shall eat. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਭਨਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਸ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: sabhanaa teree aas prabh sabh jeea tere toon raas |
