English: O God, You are the Hope of all. All beings are Yours; You are the Wealth of all.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਧਹੁ ਖਾਲੀ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਦਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: prabh tudhahu khaalee ko nahee dar guramukhaa no saabaas |
English: O God, none return from You empty-handed; at Your Door, the Gurmukhs are praised and acclaimed.

Gurbani: ਬਿਖੁ ਭਉਜਲ ਡੁਬਦੇ ਕਢਿ ਲੈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੧॥੬੫॥
Transliteration: bikh bhaujal ddubade kadt lai jan naanak kee aradaas |4|1|65|
English: In the terrifying world-ocean of poison, people are drowning-please lift them up and save them! This is servant Nanak's humble prayer. ||4||1||65||

[Ang 40 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 4 |
English: Siree Raag, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੀਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: naam milai man tripateeai bin naamai dhrig jeevaas |
English: Receiving the Naam, the mind is satisfied; without the Naam, life is cursed.

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਮੈ ਦਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: koee guramukh sajan je milai mai dase prabh gunataas |
English: If I meet the Gurmukh, my Spiritual Friend, he will show me God, the Treasure of Excellence.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਚਉ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਮੈ ਨਾਮ ਕਰੇ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: hau tis vittahu chau khaneeai mai naam kare paragaas |1|
English: I am every bit a sacrifice to one who reveals to me the Naam. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਾ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: mere preetamaa hau jeevaa naam dhiaae |
English: O my Beloved, I live by meditating on Your Name.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bin naavai jeevan naa theeai mere satigur naam drirraae |1| rahaau |
English: Without Your Name, my life does not even exist. My True Guru has implanted the Naam within me. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: naam amolak ratan hai poore satigur paas |
English: The Naam is a Priceless Jewel; it is with the Perfect True Guru.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੈ ਲਗਿਆ ਕਢਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sevai lagiaa kadt ratan devai paragaas |
English: When one is enjoined to serve the True Guru, He brings out this Jewel and bestows this enlightenment.

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ ਜੋ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: dhan vaddabhaagee vaddabhaageea jo aae mile gur paas |2|
English: Blessed, and most fortunate of the very fortunate, are those who come to meet the Guru. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਸੇ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਵਸਿ ਕਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: jinaa satigur purakh na bhettio se bhaagaheen vas kaal |
English: Those who have not met the Primal Being, the True Guru, are most unfortunate, and are subject to death.

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਭਵਾਈਅਹਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਕਰਿ ਵਿਕਰਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: oe fir fir jon bhavaaeeeh vich visattaa kar vikaraal |
English: They wander in reincarnation over and over again, as the most disgusting maggots in manure.

Gurbani: ਓਨਾ ਪਾਸਿ ਦੁਆਸਿ ਨ ਭਿਟੀਐ ਜਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਚੰਡਾਲ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: onaa paas duaas na bhitteeai jin antar krodh chanddaal |3|
English: Do not meet with, or even approach those people, whose hearts are filled with horrible anger. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਵਹਿ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur purakh amrit sar vaddabhaagee naaveh aae |
English: The True Guru, the Primal Being, is the Pool of Ambrosial Nectar. The very fortunate ones come to bathe in it.

Gurbani: ਉਨ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aun janam janam kee mail utarai niramal naam drirraae |
English: The filth of many incarnations is washed away, and the Immaculate Naam is implanted within.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਉਤਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੨॥੬੬॥
Transliteration: jan naanak utam pad paaeaa satigur kee liv laae |4|2|66|
English: Servant Nanak has obtained the most exalted state, lovingly attuned to the True Guru. ||4||2||66||

[Ang 40 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 4 |
English: Siree Raag, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਗੁਣ ਵਿਥਰਾ ਗੁਣ ਬੋਲੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gun gaavaa gun vitharaa gun bolee meree maae |
English: I sing His Glories, I describe His Glories, I speak of His Glories, O my mother.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਜਣ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh sajan gunakaareea mil sajan har gun gaae |
English: The Gurmukhs, my spiritual friends, bestow virtue. Meeting with my spiritual friends, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹੀਰੈ ਹੀਰੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: heerai heer mil bedhiaa rang chaloolai naae |1|
English: The Diamond of the Guru has pierced the diamond of my mind, which is now dyed in the deep crimson color of the Name. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: mere govindaa gun gaavaa tripat man hoe |
English: O my Lord of the Universe, singing Your Glorious Praises, my mind is satisfied.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਿਆਸ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: antar piaas har naam kee gur tus milaavai soe |1| rahaau |
English: Within me is the thirst for the Lord's Name; may the Guru, in His Pleasure, grant it to me. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗਹੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਹੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਕਰੇ ਪਸਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: man rangahu vaddabhaageeho gur tutthaa kare pasaau |
English: Let your minds be imbued with His Love, O blessed and fortunate ones. By His Pleasure, the Guru bestows His Gifts.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur naam drirraae rang siau hau satigur kai bal jaau |
English: The Guru has lovingly implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me; I am a sacrifice to the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਲਭਈ ਲਖ ਕੋਟੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bin satigur har naam na labhee lakh kottee karam kamaau |2|
English: Without the True Guru, the Name of the Lord is not found, even though people may perform hundreds of thousands, even millions of rituals. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਠਿਆ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨਿਤ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: bin bhaagaa satigur naa milai ghar baitthiaa nikatt nit paas |
English: Without destiny, the True Guru is not found, even though He sits within the home of our own inner being, always near and close at hand.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਹੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਪੜਦਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਪਈਆਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: antar agiaan dukh bharam hai vich parradaa door peeaas |
English: There is ignorance within, and the pain of doubt, like a separating screen.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਲੋਹੁ ਬੂਡਾ ਬੇੜੀ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bin satigur bhette kanchan naa theeai manamukh lohu booddaa berree paas |3|
English: Without meeting with the True Guru, no one is transformed into gold. The self-willed manmukh sinks like iron, while the boat is very close. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਵ ਹੈ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਚੜਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur bohith har naav hai kit bidh charriaa jaae |
English: The Boat of the True Guru is the Name of the Lord. How can we climb on board?

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਬੈਠਾ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur kai bhaanai jo chalai vich bohith baitthaa aae |
English: One who walks in harmony with the True Guru's Will comes to sit in this Boat.

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੩॥੬੭॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan vaddabhaagee naanakaa jinaa satigur le milaae |4|3|67|
English: Blessed, blessed are those very fortunate ones, O Nanak, who are united with the Lord through the True Guru. ||4||3||67||

[Ang 41 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 4 |
English: Siree Raag, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਪੰਥੁ ਦਸਾਈ ਨਿਤ ਖੜੀ ਕੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਸੇ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hau panth dasaaee nit kharree koee prabh dase tin jaau |
English: I stand by the wayside and ask the Way. If only someone would show me the Way to God-I would go with him.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਪੀਛੈ ਲਾਗਿ ਫਿਰਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jinee meraa piaaraa raaviaa tin peechhai laag firaau |
English: I follow in the footsteps of those who enjoy the Love of my Beloved.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਮਿੰਨਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੋਦੜੀ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲਣੈ ਕਾ ਚਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kar minat kar jodarree mai prabh milanai kaa chaau |1|
English: I beg of them, I implore them; I have such a yearning to meet God! ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਜਨਾ ਕੋਈ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: mere bhaaee janaa koee mo kau har prabh mel milaae |
English: O my Siblings of Destiny, please unite me in Union with my Lord God.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hau satigur vittahu vaariaa jin har prabh deea dikhaae |1| rahaau |
English: I am a sacrifice to the True Guru, who has shown me the Lord God. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹੋਇ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਢਹਿ ਪਵਾ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: hoe nimaanee dteh pavaa poore satigur paas |
English: In deep humility, I fall at the Feet of the Perfect True Guru.

Gurbani: ਨਿਮਾਣਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: nimaaniaa gur maan hai gur satigur kare saabaas |
English: The Guru is the Honor of the dishonored. The Guru, the True Guru, brings approval and applause.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਨ ਰਜਊ ਮੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: hau gur saalaeh na rjaoo mai mele har prabh paas |2|
English: I am never tired of praising the Guru, who unites me with the Lord God. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨੋ ਸਭ ਕੋ ਲੋਚਦਾ ਜੇਤਾ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur no sabh ko lochadaa jetaa jagat sabh koe |
English: Everyone, all over the world, longs for the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਬਹਿ ਰੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin bhaagaa darasan naa theeai bhaagaheen beh roe |
English: Without the good fortune of destiny, the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is not obtained. The unfortunate ones just sit and cry.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣਾ ਸੋ ਥੀਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jo har prabh bhaanaa so theea dhur likhiaa na mettai koe |3|
English: All things happen according to the Will of the Lord God. No one can erase the pre-ordained Writ of Destiny. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aape satigur aap har aape mel milaae |
English: He Himself is the True Guru; He Himself is the Lord. He Himself unites in His Union.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਮੇਲਸੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੀਛੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aap deaa kar melasee gur satigur peechhai paae |
English: In His Kindness, He unites us with Himself, as we follow the Guru, the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਜਗਿ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਲੁ ਜਲਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੪॥੬੮॥
Transliteration: sabh jagajeevan jag aap hai naanak jal jaleh samaae |4|4|68|
English: Over all the world, He is the Life of the World, O Nanak, like water mingled with water. ||4||4||68||

[Ang 41 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 4 |
English: Siree Raag, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸੁ ਅਤਿ ਭਲਾ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: ras amrit naam ras at bhalaa kit bidh milai ras khaae |
English: The Essence of the Ambrosial Naam is the most sublime essence; how can I get to taste this essence?

Gurbani: ਜਾਇ ਪੁਛਹੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਤੁਸਾ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: jaae puchhahu sohaaganee tusaa kiau kar miliaa prabh aae |
English: I go and ask the happy soul-brides, "How did you come to meet God?"

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹ ਨ ਬੋਲਨੀ ਹਉ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਧੋਵਾ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: oe veparavaah na bolanee hau mal mal dhovaa tin paae |1|
English: They are care-free and do not speak; I massage and wash their feet. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਜਣ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: bhaaee re mil sajan har gun saar |
English: O Siblings of Destiny, meet with your spiritual friend, and dwell upon the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਜਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਢੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sajan satigur purakh hai dukh kadtai haumai maar |1| rahaau |
English: The True Guru, the Primal Being, is your Friend, who shall drive out pain and subdue your ego. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਤਿਨ ਦਇਆ ਪਈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukheea sohaaganee tin deaa pee man aae |
English: The Gurmukhs are the happy soul-brides; their minds are filled with kindness.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਚਨੁ ਰਤੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਮੰਨੇ ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur vachan ratan hai jo mane su har ras khaae |
English: The Word of the True Guru is the Jewel. One who believes in it tastes the Sublime Essence of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਵਡ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਧਾ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: se vaddabhaagee vadd jaaneeeh jin har ras khaadhaa gur bhaae |2|
English: Those who partake of the Lord's Sublime Essence, through the Guru's Love, are known as great and very fortunate. ||2||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਵਣਿ ਤਿਣਿ ਸਭਤੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਨਹੀ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: eihu har ras van tin sabhat hai bhaagaheen nahee khaae |
English: This Sublime Essence of the Lord is in the forests, in the fields and everywhere, but the unfortunate ones do not taste it.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਲੈ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਰਹੇ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin satigur palai naa pavai manamukh rahe bilalaae |
English: Without the True Guru, it is not obtained. The self-willed manmukhs continue to cry in misery.

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਨਾ ਨਿਵਹਿ ਓਨਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਬਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: oe satigur aagai naa niveh onaa antar krodh balaae |3|
English: They do not bow before the True Guru; the demon of anger is within them. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: har har har ras aap hai aape har ras hoe |
English: The Lord Himself, Har, Har, Har, is the Sublime Essence. The Lord Himself is the Essence.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਵਸੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਚੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aap deaa kar devasee guramukh amrit choe |
English: In His Kindness, He blesses the Gurmukh with it; the Ambrosial Nectar of this Amrit trickles down.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੫॥੬੯॥
Transliteration: sabh tan man hariaa hoeaa naanak har vasiaa man soe |4|5|69|
English: Then, the body and mind totally blossom forth and flourish; O Nanak, the Lord comes to dwell within the mind. ||4||5||69||

[Ang 41 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 4 |
English: Siree Raag, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਚੜੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਥਵੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਸਬਾਈ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: dinas charrai fir aathavai rain sabaaee jaae |
English: The day dawns, and then it ends, and the night passes away.

Gurbani: ਆਵ ਘਟੈ ਨਰੁ ਨਾ ਬੁਝੈ ਨਿਤਿ ਮੂਸਾ ਲਾਜੁ ਟੁਕਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aav ghattai nar naa bujhai nit moosaa laaj ttukaae |
English: Man's life is diminishing, but he does not understand. Each day, the mouse of death is gnawing away at the rope of life.

Gurbani: ਗੁੜੁ ਮਿਠਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਲਗਿ ਮਾਖੀ ਪਚੈ ਪਚਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gurr mitthaa maaeaa pasariaa manamukh lag maakhee pachai pachaae |1|
English: Maya spreads out like sweet molasses; the self-willed manmukh is stuck like a fly, rotting away. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਮੈ ਮੀਤੁ ਸਖਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhaaee re mai meet sakhaa prabh soe |
English: O Siblings of Destiny, God is my Friend and Companion.

Gurbani: ਪੁਤੁ ਕਲਤੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਤਿ ਬੇਲੀ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: put kalat mohu bikh hai ant belee koe na hoe |1| rahaau |
English: Emotional attachment to children and spouse is poison; in the end, no one will go along with you as your helper. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਉਬਰੇ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਰਹੇ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramat har liv ubare alipat rahe saranaae |
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, some embrace love for the Lord, and are saved. They remain detached and unaffected, and they find the Sanctuary of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਓਨੀ ਚਲਣੁ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਖਰਚੁ ਲੀਆ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: onee chalan sadaa nihaaliaa har kharach leea pat paae |
English: They keep death constantly before their eyes; they gather the Provisions of the Lord's Name, and receive honor.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਮੰਨੀਅਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਲਏ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: guramukh daragah maneeeh har aap le gal laae |2|
English: The Gurmukhs are honored in the Court of the Lord. The Lord Himself takes them in His Loving Embrace. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਪੰਥੁ ਪਰਗਟਾ ਦਰਿ ਠਾਕ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukhaa no panth paragattaa dar tthaak na koee paae |
English: For the Gurmukhs, the Way is obvious. At the Lord's Door, they face no obstructions.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: har naam salaahan naam man naam rehan liv laae |
English: They praise the Lord's Name, they keep the Naam in their minds, and they remain attached to the Love of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨੀ ਦਰਿ ਵਜਦੇ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: anahad dhunee dar vajade dar sachai sobhaa paae |3|
English: The Unstruck Celestial Music vibrates for them at the Lord's Door, and they are honored at the True Door. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਸਭ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: jinee guramukh naam salaahiaa tinaa sabh ko kahai saabaas |
English: Those Gurmukhs who praise the Naam are applauded by everyone.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੈ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: tin kee sangat dehi prabh mai jaachik kee aradaas |
English: Grant me their company, God-I am a beggar; this is my prayer.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਾਗ ਵਡੇ ਤਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਜਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੩੩॥੩੧॥੬॥੭੦॥
Transliteration: naanak bhaag vadde tinaa guramukhaa jin antar naam paragaas |4|33|31|6|70|
English: O Nanak, great is the good fortune of those Gurmukhs, who are filled with the Light of the Naam within. ||4||33||31||6||70||

[Ang 42 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ghar 1 |
English: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl, First House:

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਤੂ ਰਤਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਸੀਗਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa too rataa dekh kai putr kalatr seegaar |
English: Why are you so thrilled by the sight of your son and your beautifully decorated wife?

Gurbani: ਰਸ ਭੋਗਹਿ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਮਾਣਹਿ ਰੰਗ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: ras bhogeh khuseea kareh maaneh rang apaar |
English: You enjoy tasty delicacies, you have lots of fun, and you indulge in endless pleasures.

Gurbani: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਸੀ ਵਰਤਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਫਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: bahut kareh furamaaeisee varateh hoe afaar |
English: You give all sorts of commands, and you act so superior.

Gurbani: ਕਰਤਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: karataa chit na aavee manamukh andh gavaar |1|
English: The Creator does not come into the mind of the blind, idiotic, self-willed manmukh. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: mere man sukhadaataa har soe |
English: O my mind, the Lord is the Giver of peace.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee paaeeai karam paraapat hoe |1| rahaau |
English: By Guru's Grace, He is found. By His Mercy, He is obtained. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਪੜਿ ਭੋਗਿ ਲਪਟਾਇਆ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਖਾਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: kaparr bhog lapattaaeaa sueinaa rupaa khaak |
English: People are entangled in the enjoyment of fine clothes, but gold and silver are only dust.

Gurbani: ਹੈਵਰ ਗੈਵਰ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੇ ਕੀਏ ਰਥ ਅਥਾਕ ॥
Transliteration: haivar gaivar bahu range kee rath athaak |
English: They acquire beautiful horses and elephants, and ornate carriages of many kinds.

Gurbani: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੀ ਬਿਸਰਿਆ ਸਭ ਸਾਕ ॥
Transliteration: kis hee chit na paavahee bisariaa sabh saak |
English: They think of nothing else, and they forget all their relatives.

Gurbani: ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਾਪਾਕ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sirajanahaar bhulaaeaa vin naavai naapaak |2|
English: They ignore their Creator; without the Name, they are impure. ||2||

Gurbani: ਲੈਦਾ ਬਦ ਦੁਆਇ ਤੂੰ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਇਕਤ ॥
Transliteration: laidaa bad duaae toon maaeaa kareh ikat |
English: Gathering the wealth of Maya, you earn an evil reputation.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂੰ ਪਤੀਆਇਦਾ ਸੋ ਸਣੁ ਤੁਝੈ ਅਨਿਤ ॥
Transliteration: jis no toon pateeaeidaa so san tujhai anit |
English: Those whom you work to please shall pass away along with you.

Gurbani: ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀਆ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: ahankaar kareh ahankaareea viaapiaa man kee mat |
English: The egotistical are engrossed in egotism, ensnared by the intellect of the mind.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਪਤਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tin prabh aap bhulaaeaa naa tis jaat na pat |3|
English: One who is deceived by God Himself, has no position and no honor. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਇਕੋ ਸਜਣੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur purakh milaaeaa iko sajan soe |
English: The True Guru, the Primal Being, has led me to meet the One, my only Friend.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਰਾਖਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਆ ਮਾਣਸ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: har jan kaa raakhaa ek hai kiaa maanas haumai roe |
English: The One is the Saving Grace of His humble servant. Why should the proud cry out in ego?

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਦਰਿ ਫੇਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jo har jan bhaavai so kare dar fer na paavai koe |
English: As the servant of the Lord wills, so does the Lord act. At the Lord's Door, none of his requests are denied.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਤਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਭ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੭੧॥
Transliteration: naanak rataa rang har sabh jag meh chaanan hoe |4|1|71|
English: Nanak is attuned to the Love of the Lord, whose Light pervades the entire Universe. ||4||1||71||

[Ang 42 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 |
English: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਬਿਲਾਸੁ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਘਣਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਭੂਲਿ ਖੁਸੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: man bilaas bahu rang ghanaa drisatt bhool khuseea |
English: With the mind caught up in playful pleasures, involved in all sorts of amusements and sights that stagger the eyes, people are led astray.

Gurbani: ਛਤ੍ਰਧਾਰ ਬਾਦਿਸਾਹੀਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਹਸੇ ਪਰੀਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: chhatradhaar baadisaaheea vich sahase pareea |1|
English: The emperors sitting on their thrones are consumed by anxiety. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bhaaee re sukh saadhasang paaeaa |
English: O Siblings of Destiny, peace is found in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਬਿਧਾਤੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਹਸਾ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: likhiaa lekh tin purakh bidhaatai dukh sahasaa mitt geaa |1| rahaau |
English: If the Supreme Lord, the Architect of Destiny, writes such an order, then anguish and anxiety are erased. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੇਤੇ ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਾ ਤੇਤੇ ਭਵਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jete thaan thanantaraa tete bhav aaeaa |
English: There are so many places-I have wandered through them all.

Gurbani: ਧਨ ਪਾਤੀ ਵਡ ਭੂਮੀਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਪਰਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: dhan paatee vadd bhoomeea meree meree kar pariaa |2|
English: The masters of wealth and the great land-lords have fallen, crying out, "This is mine! This is mine!" ||2||

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚਲਾਏ ਨਿਸੰਗ ਹੋਇ ਵਰਤੈ ਅਫਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: hukam chalaae nisang hoe varatai afariaa |
English: They issue their commands fearlessly, and act in pride.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਲਇਓਨੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਖਾਕੁ ਰਲਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sabh ko vasagat kar leon bin naavai khaak raliaa |3|
English: They subdue all under their command, but without the Name, they are reduced to dust. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਸੇਵਕਾ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਦਰਿ ਖਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: kott tetees sevakaa sidh saadhik dar khariaa |
English: Even those who are served by the 33 million angelic beings, at whose door the Siddhas and the Saadhus stand,

Gurbani: ਗਿਰੰਬਾਰੀ ਵਡ ਸਾਹਬੀ ਸਭੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਪਨੁ ਥੀਆ ॥੪॥੨॥੭੨॥
Transliteration: giranbaaree vadd saahabee sabh naanak supan theea |4|2|72|
English: who live in wondrous affluence and rule over mountains, oceans and vast dominions-O Nanak, in the end, all this vanishes like a dream! ||4||2||72||

[Ang 43 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 |
English: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਭਲਕੇ ਉਠਿ ਪਪੋਲੀਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਬੁਝੇ ਮੁਗਧ ਅਜਾਣਿ ॥
Transliteration: bhalake utth papoleeai vin bujhe mugadh ajaan |
English: Arising each day, you cherish your body, but you are idiotic, ignorant and without understanding.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਛੁਟੈਗੀ ਬੇਬਾਣਿ ॥
Transliteration: so prabh chit na aaeo chhuttaigee bebaan |
English: You are not conscious of God, and your body shall be cast into the wilderness.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: satigur setee chit laae sadaa sadaa rang maan |1|
English: Focus your consciousness on the True Guru; you shall enjoy bliss forever and ever. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਤੂੰ ਆਇਆ ਲਾਹਾ ਲੈਣਿ ॥
Transliteration: praanee toon aaeaa laahaa lain |
English: O mortal, you came here to earn a profit.

Gurbani: ਲਗਾ ਕਿਤੁ ਕੁਫਕੜੇ ਸਭ ਮੁਕਦੀ ਚਲੀ ਰੈਣਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: lagaa kit kufakarre sabh mukadee chalee rain |1| rahaau |
English: What useless activities are you attached to? Your life-night is coming to its end. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕੁਦਮ ਕਰੇ ਪਸੁ ਪੰਖੀਆ ਦਿਸੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: kudam kare pas pankheea disai naahee kaal |
English: The animals and the birds frolic and play-they do not see death.

Gurbani: ਓਤੈ ਸਾਥਿ ਮਨੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਫਾਥਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: otai saath manukh hai faathaa maaeaa jaal |
English: Mankind is also with them, trapped in the net of Maya.

Gurbani: ਮੁਕਤੇ ਸੇਈ ਭਾਲੀਅਹਿ ਜਿ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mukate seee bhaaleeeh ji sachaa naam samaal |2|
English: Those who always remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are considered to be liberated. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਘਰੁ ਛਡਿ ਗਵਾਵਣਾ ਸੋ ਲਗਾ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jo ghar chhadd gavaavanaa so lagaa man maeh |
English: That dwelling which you will have to abandon and vacate-you are attached to it in your mind.

Gurbani: ਜਿਥੈ ਜਾਇ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਰਤਣਾ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jithai jaae tudh varatanaa tis kee chintaa naeh |
English: And that place where you must go to dwell-you have no regard for it at all.

Gurbani: ਫਾਥੇ ਸੇਈ ਨਿਕਲੇ ਜਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: faathe seee nikale ji gur kee pairee paeh |3|
English: Those who fall at the Feet of the Guru are released from this bondage. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਰਖਿ ਨ ਸਕਈ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: koee rakh na sakee doojaa ko na dikhaae |
English: No one else can save you-don't look for anyone else.

Gurbani: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਭਾਲਿ ਕੈ ਆਇ ਪਇਆ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: chaare kunddaa bhaal kai aae peaa saranaae |
English: I have searched in all four directions; I have come to find His Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੈ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਿ ਡੁਬਦਾ ਲਇਆ ਕਢਾਇ ॥੪॥੩॥੭੩॥
Transliteration: naanak sachai paatisaeh ddubadaa leaa kadtaae |4|3|73|
English: O Nanak, the True King has pulled me out and saved me from drowning! ||4||3||73||

[Ang 43 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 |
English: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਘੜੀ ਮੁਹਤ ਕਾ ਪਾਹੁਣਾ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: gharree muhat kaa paahunaa kaaj savaaranahaar |
English: For a brief moment, man is a guest of the Lord; he tries to resolve his affairs.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਮਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਸਮਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਗਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa kaam viaapiaa samajhai naahee gaavaar |
English: Engrossed in Maya and sexual desire, the fool does not understand.

Gurbani: ਉਠਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਇਆ ਪਰਿਆ ਵਸਿ ਜੰਦਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: autth chaliaa pachhutaaeaa pariaa vas jandaar |1|
English: He arises and departs with regret, and falls into the clutches of the Messenger of Death. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅੰਧੇ ਤੂੰ ਬੈਠਾ ਕੰਧੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: andhe toon baitthaa kandhee paeh |
English: You are sitting on the collapsing riverbank-are you blind?

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਹੋਵੀ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: je hovee poorab likhiaa taa gur kaa bachan kamaeh |1| rahaau |
English: If you are so pre-destined, then act according to the Guru's Teachings. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਹ ਡਡੁਰੀ ਪਕੀ ਵਢਣਹਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: haree naahee neh ddadduree pakee vadtanahaar |
English: The Reaper does not look upon any as unripe, half-ripe or fully ripe.

Gurbani: ਲੈ ਲੈ ਦਾਤ ਪਹੁਤਿਆ ਲਾਵੇ ਕਰਿ ਤਈਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: lai lai daat pahutiaa laave kar teeaar |
English: Picking up and wielding their sickles, the harvesters arrive.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਹੋਆ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਿਰਸਾਣ ਦਾ ਤਾ ਲੁਣਿ ਮਿਣਿਆ ਖੇਤਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jaa hoaa hukam kirasaan daa taa lun miniaa khetaar |2|
English: When the landlord gives the order, they cut and measure the crop. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਪਹਰੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਗਇਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਿ ਸੋਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: pahilaa pehar dhandhai geaa doojai bhar soeaa |
English: The first watch of the night passes away in worthless affairs, and the second passes in deep sleep.

Gurbani: ਤੀਜੈ ਝਾਖ ਝਖਾਇਆ ਚਉਥੈ ਭੋਰੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: teejai jhaakh jhakhaaeaa chauthai bhor bheaa |
English: In the third, they babble nonsense, and when the fourth watch comes, the day of death has arrived.

Gurbani: ਕਦ ਹੀ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਜਿਨਿ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਦੀਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kad hee chit na aaeo jin jeeo pindd deea |3|
English: The thought of the One who bestows body and soul never enters the mind. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ਕੀਆ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasangat kau vaariaa jeeo keea kurabaan |
English: I am devoted to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; I sacrifice my soul to them.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਮਨਿ ਪਈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: jis te sojhee man pee miliaa purakh sujaan |
English: Through them, understanding has entered my mind, and I have met the All-knowing Lord God.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਡਿਠਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੪॥੭੪॥
Transliteration: naanak dditthaa sadaa naal har antarajaamee jaan |4|4|74|
English: Nanak sees the Lord always with him-the Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||4||4||74||

[Ang 43 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 |
English: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਭੇ ਗਲਾ ਵਿਸਰਨੁ ਇਕੋ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sabhe galaa visaran iko visar na jaau |
English: Let me forget everything, but let me not forget the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਧੰਧਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਲਾਇ ਕੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
Transliteration: dhandhaa sabh jalaae kai gur naam deea sach suaau |
English: All my evil pursuits have been burnt away; the Guru has blessed me with the Naam, the true object of life.

Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਸਭੇ ਲਾਹਿ ਕੈ ਇਕਾ ਆਸ ਕਮਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa sabhe laeh kai ikaa aas kamaau |
English: Give up all other hopes, and rely on the One Hope.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਅਗੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jinee satigur seviaa tin agai miliaa thaau |1|
English: Those who serve the True Guru receive a place in the world hereafter. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਰਤੇ ਨੋ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: man mere karate no saalaeh |
English: O my mind, praise the Creator.

Gurbani: ਸਭੇ ਛਡਿ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sabhe chhadd siaanapaa gur kee pairee paeh |1| rahaau |
English: Give up all your clever tricks, and fall at the Feet of the Guru. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਨਹ ਵਿਆਪਈ ਜੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: dukh bhukh neh viaapee je sukhadaataa man hoe |
English: Pain and hunger shall not oppress you, if the Giver of Peace comes into your mind.

Gurbani: ਕਿਤ ਹੀ ਕੰਮਿ ਨ ਛਿਜੀਐ ਜਾ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: kit hee kam na chhijeeai jaa hiradai sachaa soe |
English: No undertaking shall fail, when the True Lord is always in your heart.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਰਖਹਿ ਹਥ ਦੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jis toon rakheh hath de tis maar na sakai koe |
English: No one can kill that one unto whom You, Lord, give Your Hand and protect.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਸਭਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਕਢੈ ਧੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sukhadaataa gur seveeai sabh avagan kadtai dhoe |2|
English: Serve the Guru, the Giver of Peace; He shall remove and wash off all your faults. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਾ ਮੰਗੈ ਸੇਵਕੋ ਲਾਈਆਂ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਸੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: sevaa mangai sevako laaeean apunee sev |
English: Your servant begs to serve those who are enjoined to Your service.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਮਸਕਤੇ ਤੂਠੈ ਪਾਵਾ ਦੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: saadhoo sang masakate tootthai paavaa dev |
English: The opportunity to work hard serving the Saadh Sangat is obtained, when the Divine Lord is pleased.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਸਾਹਿਬੈ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਣ ਕਰੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh vasagat saahibai aape karan karev |
English: Everything is in the Hands of our Lord and Master; He Himself is the Doer of deeds.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਮਨਸਾ ਸਭ ਪੂਰੇਵ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: satigur kai balihaaranai manasaa sabh poorev |3|
English: I am a sacrifice to the True Guru, who fulfills all hopes and desires. ||3||

Gurbani: ਇਕੋ ਦਿਸੈ ਸਜਣੋ ਇਕੋ ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: eiko disai sajano iko bhaaee meet |
English: The One appears to be my Companion; the One is my Brother and Friend.

Gurbani: ਇਕਸੈ ਦੀ ਸਾਮਗਰੀ ਇਕਸੈ ਦੀ ਹੈ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: eikasai dee saamagaree ikasai dee hai reet |
English: The elements and the components are all made by the One; they are held in their order by the One.

Gurbani: ਇਕਸ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਤਾ ਹੋਆ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਚੀਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: eikas siau man maaniaa taa hoaa nihachal cheet |
English: When the mind accepts, and is satisfied with the One, then the consciousness becomes steady and stable.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਪੈਨਣਾ ਟੇਕ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਕੀਤੁ ॥੪॥੫॥੭੫॥
Transliteration: sach khaanaa sach painanaa ttek naanak sach keet |4|5|75|
English: Then, one's food is the True Name, one's garments are the True Name, and one's Support, O Nanak, is the True Name. ||4||5||75||

[Ang 44 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 |
English: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਭੇ ਥੋਕ ਪਰਾਪਤੇ ਜੇ ਆਵੈ ਇਕੁ ਹਥਿ ॥
Transliteration: sabhe thok paraapate je aavai ik hath |
English: All things are received if the One is obtained.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਹੈ ਜੇ ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਥਿ ॥
Transliteration: janam padaarath safal hai je sachaa sabad kath |
English: The precious gift of this human life becomes fruitful when one chants the True Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਰਾਪਤੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਮਥਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur te mehal paraapate jis likhiaa hovai math |1|
English: One who has such destiny written on his forehead enters the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, through the Guru. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਏਕਸ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: mere man ekas siau chit laae |
English: O my mind, focus your consciousness on the One.

Gurbani: ਏਕਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਭ ਧੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ekas bin sabh dhandh hai sabh mithiaa mohu maae |1| rahaau |
English: Without the One, all entanglements are worthless; emotional attachment to Maya is totally false. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਲਖ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀਆ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: lakh khuseea paatisaaheea je satigur nadar karee |
English: Hundreds of thousands of princely pleasures are enjoyed, if the True Guru bestows His Glance of Grace.

Gurbani: ਨਿਮਖ ਏਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: nimakh ek har naam dee meraa man tan seetal hoe |
English: If He bestows the Name of the Lord, for even a moment, my mind and body are cooled and soothed.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਗਹੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jis kau poorab likhiaa tin satigur charan gahe |2|
English: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny hold tight to the Feet of the True Guru. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤੁ ਸਫਲਾ ਘੜੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: safal moorat safalaa gharree jit sache naal piaar |
English: Fruitful is that moment, and fruitful is that time, when one is in love with the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਦੂਖੁ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: dookh santaap na lagee jis har kaa naam adhaar |
English: Suffering and sorrow do not touch those who have the Support of the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਬਾਹ ਪਕੜਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਢਿਆ ਸੋਈ ਉਤਰਿਆ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: baah pakarr gur kaadtiaa soee utariaa paar |3|
English: Grasping him by the arm, the Guru lifts them up and out, and carries them across to the other side. ||3||

Gurbani: ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਥੈ ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ॥
Transliteration: thaan suhaavaa pavit hai jithai sant sabhaa |
English: Embellished and immaculate is that place where the Saints gather together.

Gurbani: ਢੋਈ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਨੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਲਭਾ ॥
Transliteration: dtoee tis hee no milai jin pooraa guroo labhaa |
English: He alone finds shelter, who has met the Perfect Guru.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਧਾ ਘਰੁ ਤਹਾਂ ਜਿਥੈ ਮਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਜਰਾ ॥੪॥੬॥੭੬॥
Transliteration: naanak badhaa ghar tahaan jithai mirat na janam jaraa |4|6|76|
English: Nanak builds his house upon that site where there is no death, no birth, and no old age. ||4||6||76||

[Ang 44 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: sreeraag mahalaa 5 |
English: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾਂ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: soee dhiaaeeai jeearre sir saahaan paatisaahu |
English: Meditate on Him, O my soul; He is the Supreme Lord over kings and emperors.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਆਸ ਮਨ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਭਸੁ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: tis hee kee kar aas man jis kaa sabhas vesaahu |
English: Place the hopes of your mind in the One, in whom all have faith.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਛਡਿ ਕੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਪਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sabh siaanapaa chhadd kai gur kee charanee paahu |1|
English: Give up all your clever tricks, and grasp the Feet of the Guru. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਸੇਤੀ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: man mere sukh sehaj setee jap naau |
English: O my mind, chant the Name with intuitive peace and poise.

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂੰ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਇੰਦ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar prabh dhiaae toon gun goeind nit gaau |1| rahaau |
English: Twenty-four hours a day, meditate on God. Constantly sing the Glories of the Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸਰਨੀ ਪਰੁ ਮਨਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: tis kee saranee par manaa jis jevadd avar na koe |
English: Seek His Shelter, O my mind; there is no other as Great as He.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਘਣਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਨ ਮੂਲੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jis simarat sukh hoe ghanaa dukh darad na moole hoe |
English: Remembering Him in meditation, a profound peace is obtained. Pain and suffering will not touch you at all.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa kar chaakaree prabh saahib sachaa soe |2|
English: Forever and ever, work for God; He is our True Lord and Master. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਕਟੀਐ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasangat hoe niramalaa katteeai jam kee faas |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall become absolutely pure, and the noose of death shall be cut away.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਕਰਿ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: sukhadaataa bhai bhanjano tis aagai kar aradaas |
English: So offer your prayers to Him, the Giver of Peace, the Destroyer of fear.

Gurbani: ਮਿਹਰ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ਤਾਂ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਆਵੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: mihar kare jis miharavaan taan kaaraj aavai raas |3|
English: Showing His Mercy, the Merciful Master shall resolve your affairs. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬਹੁਤੋ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਊਚੋ ਊਚਾ ਥਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bahuto bahut vakhaaneeai aoocho aoochaa thaau |
English: The Lord is said to be the Greatest of the Great; His Kingdom is the Highest of the High.

Gurbani: ਵਰਨਾ ਚਿਹਨਾ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: varanaa chihanaa baaharaa keemat keh na sakaau |
English: He has no color or mark; His Value cannot be estimated.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਅਪੁਣਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥੭॥੭੭॥
Transliteration: naanak kau prabh meaa kar sach devahu apunaa naau |4|7|77|
English: Please show Mercy to Nanak, God, and bless him with Your True Name. ||4||7||77||

[Ang 44 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: sreeraag mahalaa 5 |
English: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: naam dhiaae so sukhee tis mukh aoojal hoe |
English: One who meditates on the Naam is at peace; his face is radiant and bright.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਸਭਨੀ ਲੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: poore gur te paaeeai paragatt sabhanee loe |
English: Obtaining it from the Perfect Guru, he is honored all over the world.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਏਕੋ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saadhasangat kai ghar vasai eko sachaa soe |1|
English: In the Company of the Holy, the One True Lord comes to abide within the home of the self. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: mere man har har naam dhiaae |
English: O my mind, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਹਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਆਗੈ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: naam sahaaee sadaa sang aagai le chhaddaae |1| rahaau |
English: The Naam is your Companion; it shall always be with you. It shall save you in the world hereafter. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕੀਆ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਕਵਨੈ ਆਵਹਿ ਕਾਮਿ ॥
Transliteration: duneea keea vaddiaaeea kavanai aaveh kaam |
English: What good is worldly greatness?

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਸਭੁ ਫਿਕਾ ਜਾਤੋ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਨਿਦਾਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa kaa rang sabh fikaa jaato binas nidaan |
English: All the pleasures of Maya are tasteless and insipid. In the end, they shall all fade away.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਸੋ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jaa kai hiradai har vasai so pooraa paradhaan |2|
English: Perfectly fulfilled and supremely acclaimed is the one, in whose heart the Lord abides. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਹੋਹੁ ਰੇਣੁਕਾ ਅਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: saadhoo kee hohu renukaa apanaa aap tiaag |
English: Become the dust of the Saints; renounce your selfishness and conceit.

Gurbani: ਉਪਾਵ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਸਗਲ ਛਡਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: aupaav siaanap sagal chhadd gur kee charanee laag |
English: Give up all your schemes and your clever mental tricks, and fall at the Feet of the Guru.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਭਾਗੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tiseh paraapat ratan hoe jis masatak hovai bhaag |3|
English: He alone receives the Jewel, upon whose forehead such wondrous destiny is written. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੈ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਭਾਈਹੋ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: tisai paraapat bhaaeeho jis devai prabh aap |
English: O Siblings of Destiny, it is received only when God Himself bestows it.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਾਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: satigur kee sevaa so kare jis binasai haumai taap |
English: People serve the True Guru only when the fever of egotism has been eradicated.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥੪॥੮॥੭੮॥
Transliteration: naanak kau gur bhettiaa binase sagal santaap |4|8|78|
English: Nanak has met the Guru; all his sufferings have come to an end. ||4||8||78||

[Ang 45 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 |
English: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਇਕੁ ਪਛਾਣੂ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਇਕੋ ਰਖਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: eik pachhaanoo jeea kaa iko rakhanahaar |
English: The One is the Knower of all beings; He alone is our Savior.

Gurbani: ਇਕਸ ਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਆਸਰਾ ਇਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: eikas kaa man aasaraa iko praan adhaar |
English: The One is the Support of the mind; the One is the Support of the breath of life.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tis saranaaee sadaa sukh paarabraham karataar |1|
English: In His Sanctuary there is eternal peace. He is the Supreme Lord God, the Creator. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਉਪਾਵ ਤਿਆਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: man mere sagal upaav tiaag |
English: O my mind, give up all these efforts.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਆਰਾਧਿ ਨਿਤ ਇਕਸੁ ਕੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur pooraa aaraadh nit ikas kee liv laag |1| rahaau |
English: Dwell upon the Perfect Guru each day, and attach yourself to the One Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਇਕੋ ਭਾਈ ਮਿਤੁ ਇਕੁ ਇਕੋ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: eiko bhaaee mit ik iko maat pitaa |
English: The One is my Brother, the One is my Friend. The One is my Mother and Father.

Gurbani: ਇਕਸ ਕੀ ਮਨਿ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਦਿਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: eikas kee man ttek hai jin jeeo pindd ditaa |
English: The One is the Support of the mind; He has given us body and soul.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਤਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: so prabh manahu na visarai jin sabh kichh vas keetaa |2|
English: May I never forget God from my mind; He holds all in the Power of His Hands. ||2||

Gurbani: ਘਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: ghar iko baahar iko thaan thanantar aap |
English: The One is within the home of the self, and the One is outside as well. He Himself is in all places and interspaces.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਏ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jant sabh jin kee aatth pehar tis jaap |
English: Meditate twenty-four hours a day on the One who created all beings and creatures.

Gurbani: ਇਕਸੁ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: eikas setee ratiaa na hovee sog santaap |3|
English: Attuned to the Love of the One, there is no sorrow or suffering. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham prabh ek hai doojaa naahee koe |
English: There is only the One Supreme Lord God; there is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jeeo pindd sabh tis kaa jo tis bhaavai su hoe |
English: Soul and body all belong to Him; whatever pleases His Will comes to pass.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਭਇਆ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੯॥੭੯॥
Transliteration: gur poorai pooraa bheaa jap naanak sachaa soe |4|9|79|
English: Through the Perfect Guru, one becomes perfect; O Nanak, meditate on the True One. ||4||9||79||

[Ang 45 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 |
English: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਪਰਧਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: jinaa satigur siau chit laaeaa se poore paradhaan |
English: Those who focus their consciousness on the True Guru are perfectly fulfilled and famous.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਤਿਨ ਉਪਜੈ ਮਨਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: jin kau aap deaal hoe tin upajai man giaan |
English: Spiritual wisdom wells up in the minds of those unto whom the Lord Himself shows Mercy.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jin kau masatak likhiaa tin paaeaa har naam |1|
English: Those who have such destiny written upon their foreheads obtain the Name of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: man mere eko naam dhiaae |
English: O my mind, meditate on the Name of the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਸੁਖ ਊਪਜਹਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sarab sukhaa sukh aoopajeh daragah paidhaa jaae |1| rahaau |
English: The happiness of all happiness shall well up, and in the Court of the Lord, you shall be dressed in robes of honor. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਗਇਆ ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: janam maran kaa bhau geaa bhaau bhagat gopaal |
English: The fear of death and rebirth is removed by performing loving devotional service to the Lord of the World.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: saadhoo sangat niramalaa aap kare pratipaal |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one becomes immaculate and pure; the Lord Himself takes care of such a one.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: janam maran kee mal katteeai gur darasan dekh nihaal |2|
English: The filth of birth and death is washed away, and one is uplifted, beholding the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan. ||2||

Gurbani: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: thaan thanantar rav rahiaa paarabraham prabh soe |
English: The Supreme Lord God is pervading all places and interspaces.

Gurbani: ਸਭਨਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabhanaa daataa ek hai doojaa naahee koe |
English: The One is the Giver of all-there is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਕੀਤਾ ਲੋੜੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tis saranaaee chhutteeai keetaa lorre su hoe |3|
English: In His Sanctuary, one is saved. Whatever He wishes, comes to pass. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਪਰਧਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: jin man vasiaa paarabraham se poore paradhaan |
English: Perfectly fulfilled and famous are those, in whose minds the Supreme Lord God abides.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੀ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਭਈ ਜਹਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: tin kee sobhaa niramalee paragatt bhee jahaan |
English: Their reputation is spotless and pure; they are famous all over the world.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੮੦॥
Transliteration: jinee meraa prabh dhiaaeaa naanak tin kurabaan |4|10|80|
English: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those who meditate on my God. ||4||10||80||

[Ang 46 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 |
English: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: mil satigur sabh dukh geaa har sukh vasiaa man aae |
English: Meeting the True Guru, all my sufferings have ended, and the Peace of the Lord has come to dwell within my mind.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੀਆ ਏਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: antar jot pragaaseea ekas siau liv laae |
English: The Divine Light illuminates my inner being, and I am lovingly absorbed in the One.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲਾ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: mil saadhoo mukh aoojalaa poorab likhiaa paae |
English: Meeting with the Holy Saint, my face is radiant; I have realized my pre-ordained destiny.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਵਣੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gun govind nit gaavane niramal saachai naae |1|
English: I constantly sing the Glories of the Lord of the Universe. Through the True Name, I have become spotlessly pure. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: mere man gurasabadee sukh hoe |
English: O my mind, you shall find peace through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur poore kee chaakaree birathaa jaae na koe |1| rahaau |
English: Working for the Perfect Guru, no one goes away empty-handed. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕੀਆ ਇਛਾਂ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: man keea ichhaan pooreea paaeaa naam nidhaan |
English: The desires of the mind are fulfilled, when the Treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is obtained.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੁ ਪਛਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: antarajaamee sadaa sang karanaihaar pachhaan |
English: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is always with you; recognize Him as the Creator.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲਾ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee mukh aoojalaa jap naam daan isanaan |
English: By Guru's Grace, your face shall be radiant. Chanting the Naam, you shall receive the benefits of giving charity and taking cleansing baths.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਬਿਨਸਿਆ ਤਜਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh lobh binasiaa tajiaa sabh abhimaan |2|
English: Sexual desire, anger and greed are eliminated, and all egotistical pride is abandoned. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪਾਇਆ ਲਾਹਾ ਲਾਭੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਏ ਕਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: paaeaa laahaa laabh naam pooran hoe kaam |
English: The Profit of the Naam is obtained, and all affairs are brought to fruition.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮੇਲਿਆ ਦੀਆ ਅਪਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh meliaa deea apanaa naam |
English: In His Mercy, God unites us with Himself, and He blesses us with the Naam.

Gurbani: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਰਹਿ ਗਇਆ ਆਪਿ ਹੋਆ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: aavan jaanaa reh geaa aap hoaa miharavaan |
English: My comings and goings in reincarnation have come to an end; He Himself has bestowed His Mercy.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sach mehal ghar paaeaa gur kaa sabad pachhaan |3|
English: I have obtained my home in the True Mansion of His Presence, realizing the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||3||

Gurbani: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਰਾਖਦਾ ਆਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat janaa kau raakhadaa aapanee kirapaa dhaar |
English: His humble devotees are protected and saved; He Himself showers His Blessings upon us.

Gurbani: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲੇ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: halat palat mukh aoojale saache ke gun saar |
English: In this world and in the world hereafter, radiant are the faces of those who cherish and enshrine the Glories of the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਦੇ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar gun saarade rate rang apaar |
English: Twenty-four hours a day, they lovingly dwell upon His Glories; they are imbued with His Infinite Love.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੮੧॥
Transliteration: paarabraham sukh saagaro naanak sad balihaar |4|11|81|
English: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to the Supreme Lord God, the Ocean of Peace. ||4||11||81||

[Ang 46 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 |
English: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: pooraa satigur je milai paaeeai sabad nidhaan |
English: If we meet the Perfect True Guru, we obtain the Treasure of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਣੀ ਜਪੀਐ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh aapanee japeeai amrit naam |
English: Please grant Your Grace, God, that we may meditate on Your Ambrosial Naam.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟੀਐ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: janam maran dukh kaatteeai laagai sehaj dhiaan |1|
English: The pains of birth and death are taken away; we are intuitively centered on His Meditation. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: mere man prabh saranaaee paae |
English: O my mind, seek the Sanctuary of God.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har bin doojaa ko nahee eko naam dhiaae |1| rahaau |
English: Without the Lord, there is no other at all. Meditate on the One and only Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਅਥਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: keemat kehan na jaaeeai saagar gunee athaahu |
English: His Value cannot be estimated; He is the Vast Ocean of Excellence.

Gurbani: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮਿਲੁ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਿਸਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: vaddabhaagee mil sangatee sachaa sabad visaahu |
English: O most fortunate ones, join the Sangat, the Blessed Congregation; purchase the True Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kar sevaa sukh saagarai sir saahaa paatisaahu |2|
English: Serve the Lord, the Ocean of Peace, the Supreme Lord over kings and emperors. ||2||

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਕਾ ਆਸਰਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਠਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal kaa aasaraa doojaa naahee tthaau |
English: I take the Support of the Lord's Lotus Feet; there is no other place of rest for me.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਧਰ ਤੇਰੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਤੇਰੈ ਤਾਣਿ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mai dhar teree paarabraham terai taan rahaau |
English: I lean upon You as my Support, O Supreme Lord God. I exist only by Your Power.

Gurbani: ਨਿਮਾਣਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਾਣੁ ਤੂੰ ਤੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: nimaaniaa prabh maan toon terai sang samaau |3|
English: O God, You are the Honor of the dishonored. I seek to merge with You. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: har japeeai aaraadheeai aatth pehar govind |
English: Chant the Lord's Name and contemplate the Lord of the World, twenty-four hours a day.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਰਖੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਾਖੀ ਜਿੰਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: jeea praan tan dhan rakhe kar kirapaa raakhee jind |
English: He preserves our soul, our breath of life, body and wealth. By His Grace, He protects our soul.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੋਖ ਉਤਾਰਿਅਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਖਸਿੰਦੁ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੮੨॥
Transliteration: naanak sagale dokh utaarian prabh paarabraham bakhasind |4|12|82|
English: O Nanak, all pain has been washed away, by the Supreme Lord God, the Forgiver. ||4||12||82||

[Ang 46 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 |
English: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਚ ਸਿਉ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: preet lagee tis sach siau marai na aavai jaae |
English: I have fallen in love with the True Lord. He does not die, He does not come and go.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਵੇਛੋੜਿਆ ਵਿਛੁੜੈ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: naa vechhorriaa vichhurrai sabh meh rahiaa samaae |
English: In separation, He is not separated from us; He is pervading and permeating amongst all.

Gurbani: ਦੀਨ ਦਰਦ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨਾ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੈ ਸਤ ਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: deen darad dukh bhanjanaa sevak kai sat bhaae |
English: He is the Destroyer of the pain and suffering of the meek. He bears True Love for His servants.

Gurbani: ਅਚਰਜ ਰੂਪੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੋ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਾਇਆ ਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: acharaj roop niranjano gur melaaeaa maae |1|
English: Wondrous is the Form of the Immaculate One. Through the Guru, I have met Him, O my mother! ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਮੀਤੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhaaee re meet karahu prabh soe |
English: O Siblings of Destiny, make God your Friend.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਰੀਤਿ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਸੁਖੀ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa moh pareet dhrig sukhee na deesai koe |1| rahaau |
English: Cursed is emotional attachment and love of Maya; no one is seen to be at peace. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦਾਨਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੀਲਵੰਤੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: daanaa daataa seelavant niramal roop apaar |
English: God is Wise, Giving, Tender-hearted, Pure, Beautiful and Infinite.

Gurbani: ਸਖਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਅਤਿ ਵਡਾ ਊਚਾ ਵਡਾ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sakhaa sahaaee at vaddaa aoochaa vaddaa apaar |
English: He is our Companion and Helper, Supremely Great, Lofty and Utterly Infinite.

Gurbani: ਬਾਲਕੁ ਬਿਰਧਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਦਰਵਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: baalak biradh na jaaneeai nihachal tis daravaar |
English: He is not known as young or old; His Court is Steady and Stable.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਿਧਾਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jo mangeeai soee paaeeai nidhaaraa aadhaar |2|
English: Whatever we seek from Him, we receive. He is the Support of the unsupported. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਪੇਖਤ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਹਿਰਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਾਂਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: jis pekhat kilavikh hireh man tan hovai saant |
English: Seeing Him, our evil inclinations vanish; mind and body become peaceful and tranquil.

Gurbani: ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਲਾਹਿ ਭਰਾਂਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: eik man ek dhiaaeeai man kee laeh bharaant |
English: With one-pointed mind, meditate on the One Lord, and the doubts of your mind will be dispelled.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਨਵਤਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: gun nidhaan navatan sadaa pooran jaa kee daat |
English: He is the Treasure of Excellence, the Ever-fresh Being. His Gift is Perfect and Complete.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਦਿਨੁ ਵਿਸਰਹੁ ਨਹੀ ਰਾਤਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa aaraadheeai din visarahu nahee raat |3|
English: Forever and ever, worship and adore Him. Day and night, do not forget Him. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਸਖਾ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: jin kau poorab likhiaa tin kaa sakhaa govind |
English: One whose destiny is so pre-ordained, obtains the Lord of the Universe as his Companion.

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਅਰਪੀ ਸਭੋ ਸਗਲ ਵਾਰੀਐ ਇਹ ਜਿੰਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: tan man dhan arapee sabho sagal vaareeai ih jind |
English: I dedicate my body, mind, wealth and all to Him. I totally sacrifice my soul to Him.

Gurbani: ਦੇਖੈ ਸੁਣੈ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਸਦ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਰਵਿੰਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: dekhai sunai hadoor sad ghatt ghatt braham ravind |
English: Seeing and hearing, He is always close at hand. In each and every heart, God is pervading.

Gurbani: ਅਕਿਰਤਘਣਾ ਨੋ ਪਾਲਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਖਸਿੰਦੁ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੮੩॥
Transliteration: akirataghanaa no paaladaa prabh naanak sad bakhasind |4|13|83|
English: Even the ungrateful ones are cherished by God. O Nanak, He is forever the Forgiver. ||4||13||83||

[Ang 47 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 |
English: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦੀਆ ਰਖਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: man tan dhan jin prabh deea rakhiaa sehaj savaar |
English: This mind, body and wealth were given by God, who naturally adorns us.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਪਿਆ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: sarab kalaa kar thaapiaa antar jot apaar |
English: He has blessed us with all our energy, and infused His Infinite Light deep within us.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਖੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa prabh simareeai antar rakh ur dhaar |1|
English: Forever and ever, meditate in remembrance on God; keep Him enshrined in your heart. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: mere man har bin avar na koe |
English: O my mind, without the Lord, there is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: prabh saranaaee sadaa rahu dookh na viaapai koe |1| rahaau |
English: Remain in God's Sanctuary forever, and no suffering shall afflict you. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਮਾਣਕਾ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਖਾਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: ratan padaarath maanakaa sueinaa rupaa khaak |
English: Jewels, treasures, pearls, gold and silver-all these are just dust.

Gurbani: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪਾ ਕੂੜੇ ਸਭੇ ਸਾਕ ॥
Transliteration: maat pitaa sut bandhapaa koorre sabhe saak |
English: Mother, father, children and relatives-all relations are false.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਪਸੁ ਨਾਪਾਕ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jin keetaa tiseh na jaanee manamukh pas naapaak |2|
English: The self-willed manmukh is an insulting beast; he does not acknowledge the One who created him. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: antar baahar rav rahiaa tis no jaanai door |
English: The Lord is pervading within and beyond, and yet people think that He is far away.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਲਾਗੀ ਰਚਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਕੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: trisanaa laagee rach rahiaa antar haumai koor |
English: They are engrossed in clinging desires; within their hearts there is ego and falsehood.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤੀ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣਿਆ ਆਵਹਿ ਵੰਞਹਿ ਪੂਰ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bhagatee naam vihooniaa aaveh vanyeh poor |3|
English: Without devotion to the Naam, crowds of people come and go. ||3||

Gurbani: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰਣਹਾਰ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: raakh lehu prabh karanahaar jeea jant kar deaa |
English: Please preserve Your beings and creatures, God; O Creator Lord, please be merciful!

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਰਖਨਹਾਰੁ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਕਟ ਜਮ ਭਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bin prabh koe na rakhanahaar mahaa bikatt jam bheaa |
English: Without God, there is no saving grace. The Messenger of Death is cruel and unfeeling.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰਉ ਕਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੮੪॥
Transliteration: naanak naam na veesrau kar apunee har meaa |4|14|84|
English: O Nanak, may I never forget the Naam! Please bless me with Your Mercy, Lord! ||4||14||84||

[Ang 47 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 |
English: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਤਨੁ ਅਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਾਜ ਰੂਪ ਮੈ ਦੇਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: meraa tan ar dhan meraa raaj roop mai des |
English: "My body and my wealth; my ruling power, my beautiful form and country-mine!"

Gurbani: ਸੁਤ ਦਾਰਾ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਅਨੇਕ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਰੰਗ ਅਰੁ ਵੇਸ ॥
Transliteration: sut daaraa banitaa anek bahut rang ar ves |
English: You may have children, a wife and many mistresses; you may enjoy all sorts of pleasures and fine clothes.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਨ ਵਸਈ ਕਾਰਜਿ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਲੇਖਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har naam ridai na vasee kaaraj kitai na lekh |1|
English: And yet, if the Name of the Lord does not abide within the heart, none of it has any use or value. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: mere man har har naam dhiaae |
English: O my mind, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kar sangat nit saadh kee gur charanee chit laae |1| rahaau |
English: Always keep the Company of the Holy, and focus your consciousness on the Feet of the Guru. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਭਾਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: naam nidhaan dhiaaeeai masatak hovai bhaag |
English: Those who have such blessed destiny written on their foreheads meditate on the Treasure of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਕਾਰਜ ਸਭਿ ਸਵਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: kaaraj sabh savaareeeh gur kee charanee laag |
English: All their affairs are brought to fruition, holding onto the Guru's Feet.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਨਾ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਜਾਗੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: haumai rog bhram katteeai naa aavai naa jaag |2|
English: The diseases of ego and doubt are cast out; they shall not come and go in reincarnation. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਤੂ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kar sangat too saadh kee atthasatth teerath naau |
English: Let the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, be your cleansing baths at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਏਹੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
Transliteration: jeeo praan man tan hare saachaa ehu suaau |
English: Your soul, breath of life, mind and body shall blossom forth in lush profusion; this is the true purpose of life.

Gurbani: ਐਥੈ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਵਡਾਈਆ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਥਾਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aithai mileh vaddaaeea darageh paaveh thaau |3|
English: In this world you shall be blessed with greatness, and in the Court of the Lord you shall find your place of rest. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
Transliteration: kare karaae aap prabh sabh kichh tis hee haath |
English: God Himself acts, and causes others to act; everything is in His Hands.

Gurbani: ਮਾਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਜੀਵਾਲਦਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
Transliteration: maar aape jeevaaladaa antar baahar saath |
English: He Himself bestows life and death; He is with us, within and beyond.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਸਰਬ ਘਟਾ ਕੇ ਨਾਥ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੮੫॥
Transliteration: naanak prabh saranaagatee sarab ghattaa ke naath |4|15|85|
English: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God, the Master of all hearts. ||4||15||85||

[Ang 48 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 |
English: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਣੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਆ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: saran pe prabh aapane gur hoaa kirapaal |
English: The Guru is Merciful; we seek the Sanctuary of God.

Gurbani: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਐ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਰਬ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: satagur kai upadesiai binase sarab janjaal |
English: Through the Teachings of the True Guru, all worldly entanglements are eliminated.

Gurbani: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਲਗਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: andar lagaa raam naam amrit nadar nihaal |1|
English: The Name of the Lord is firmly implanted within my mind; through His Ambrosial Glance of Grace, I am exalted and enraptured. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: man mere satigur sevaa saar |
English: O my mind, serve the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਕਰੇ ਦਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kare deaa prabh aapanee ik nimakh na manahu visaar | rahaau |
English: God Himself grants His Grace; do not forget Him, even for an instant. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਵੀਅਹਿ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਕਟਣਹਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: gun govind nit gaaveeeh avagun kattanahaar |
English: Continually sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, the Destroyer of demerits.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਕਰਿ ਡਿਠੇ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: bin har naam na sukh hoe kar dditthe bisathaar |
English: Without the Name of the Lord, there is no peace. Having tried all sorts of ostentatious displays, I have come to see this.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਉਤਰੇ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sahaje sifatee ratiaa bhavajal utare paar |2|
English: Intuitively imbued with His Praises, one is saved, crossing over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੀਰਥ ਵਰਤ ਲਖ ਸੰਜਮਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: teerath varat lakh sanjamaa paaeeai saadhoo dhoor |
English: The merits of pilgrimages, fasts and hundreds of thousands of techniques of austere self-discipline are found in the dust of the feet of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਲੂਕਿ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਕਿਸ ਤੇ ਜਾ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਦਾ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: look kamaavai kis te jaa vekhai sadaa hadoor |
English: From whom are you trying to hide your actions? God sees all;

Gurbani: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: thaan thanantar rav rahiaa prabh meraa bharapoor |3|
English: He is Ever-present. My God is totally pervading all places and interspaces. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀ ਅਮਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਾ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: sach paatisaahee amar sach sache sachaa thaan |
English: True is His Empire, and True is His Command. True is His Seat of True Authority.

Gurbani: ਸਚੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਧਾਰੀਅਨੁ ਸਚਿ ਸਿਰਜਿਓਨੁ ਜਹਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: sachee kudarat dhaareean sach sirajion jahaan |
English: True is the Creative Power which He has created. True is the world which He has fashioned.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੮੬॥
Transliteration: naanak japeeai sach naam hau sadaa sadaa kurabaan |4|16|86|
English: O Nanak, chant the True Name; I am forever and ever a sacrifice to Him. ||4||16||86||

[Ang 48 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 |
English: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪਣਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਧਨੁ ਖਾਟਿ ॥
Transliteration: audam kar har jaapanaa vaddabhaagee dhan khaatt |
English: Make the effort, and chant the Lord's Name. O very fortunate ones, earn this wealth.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਣਾ ਮਲੁ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਕਾਟਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: santasang har simaranaa mal janam janam kee kaatt |1|
English: In the Society of the Saints, meditate in remembrance on the Lord, and wash off the filth of countless incarnations. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਜਾਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: man mere raam naam jap jaap |
English: O my mind, chant and meditate on the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਫਲ ਭੁੰਚਿ ਤੂ ਸਭੁ ਚੂਕੈ ਸੋਗੁ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: man ichhe fal bhunch too sabh chookai sog santaap | rahaau |
English: Enjoy the fruits of your mind's desires; all suffering and sorrow shall depart. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਤਨੁ ਧਾਰਿਆ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਡਿਠਾ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: jis kaaran tan dhaariaa so prabh dditthaa naal |
English: For His sake, you assumed this body; see God always with you.

Gurbani: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jal thal maheeal pooriaa prabh aapanee nadar nihaal |2|
English: God is pervading the water, the land and the sky; He sees all with His Glance of Grace. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇਆ ਲਾਗੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: man tan niramal hoeaa laagee saach pareet |
English: The mind and body become spotlessly pure, enshrining love for the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਭਜੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਕੀਤਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: charan bhaje paarabraham ke sabh jap tap tin hee keet |3|
English: One who dwells upon the Feet of the Supreme Lord God has truly performed all meditations and austerities. ||3||

Gurbani: ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਮਾਣਿਕਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ratan javehar maanikaa amrit har kaa naau |
English: The Ambrosial Name of the Lord is a Gem, a Jewel, a Pearl.

Gurbani: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਰਸ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੪॥੧੭॥੮੭॥
Transliteration: sookh sehaj aanand ras jan naanak har gun gaau |4|17|87|
English: The essence of intuitive peace and bliss is obtained, O servant Nanak, by singing the Glories of God. ||4||17||87||

[Ang 48 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 |
English: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਸਾਸਤੁ ਸਉਣੁ ਸੋਇ ਜਿਤੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: soee saasat saun soe jit japeeai har naau |
English: That is the essence of the scriptures, and that is a good omen, by which one comes to chant the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਗੁਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਥਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal gur dhan deea miliaa nithaave thaau |
English: The Guru has given me the Wealth of the Lotus Feet of the Lord, and I, without shelter, have now obtained Shelter.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੀ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੋ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saachee poonjee sach sanjamo aatth pehar gun gaau |
English: The True Capital, and the True Way of Life, comes by chanting His Glories, twenty-four hours a day.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh bhettiaa maran na aavan jaau |1|
English: Granting His Grace, God meets us, and we no longer die, or come or go in reincarnation. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਸਦਾ ਇਕ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: mere man har bhaj sadaa ik rang |
English: O my mind, vibrate and meditate forever on the Lord, with single-minded love.

Gurbani: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt antar rav rahiaa sadaa sahaaee sang |1| rahaau |
English: He is contained deep within each and every heart. He is always with you, as your Helper and Support. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੁਖਾ ਕੀ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਿਆ ਗਣੀ ਜਾ ਸਿਮਰੀ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: sukhaa kee mit kiaa ganee jaa simaree govind |
English: How can I measure the happiness of meditating on the Lord of the Universe?

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸਿਆ ਉਹ ਰਸੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਿੰਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: jin chaakhiaa se tripataasiaa uh ras jaanai jind |
English: Those who taste it are satisfied and fulfilled; their souls know this Sublime Essence.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਬਖਸਿੰਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: santaa sangat man vasai prabh preetam bakhasind |
English: In the Society of the Saints, God, the Beloved, the Forgiver, comes to dwell within the mind.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੋਈ ਰਾਜ ਨਰਿੰਦੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jin seviaa prabh aapanaa soee raaj narind |2|
English: One who has served his God is the emperor of kings||2||

Gurbani: ਅਉਸਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗੁਣ ਰਮਣ ਜਿਤੁ ਕੋਟਿ ਮਜਨ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: aausar har jas gun raman jit kott majan isanaan |
English: This is the time to speak and sing the Praise and the Glory of God, which brings the merit of millions of cleansing and purifying baths.

Gurbani: ਰਸਨਾ ਉਚਰੈ ਗੁਣਵਤੀ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪੁਜੈ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: rasanaa ucharai gunavatee koe na pujai daan |
English: The tongue which chants these Praises is worthy; there is no charity equal to this.

Gurbani: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: drisatt dhaar man tan vasai deaal purakh miharavaan |
English: Blessing us with His Glance of Grace, the Kind and Compassionate, All-powerful Lord comes to dwell within the mind and body.

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਧਨੁ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਹਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jeeo pindd dhan tis daa hau sadaa sadaa kurabaan |3|
English: My soul, body and wealth are His. Forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to Him. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜੈ ਜੋ ਮੇਲਿਆ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: miliaa kade na vichhurrai jo meliaa karataar |
English: One whom the Creator Lord has met and joined to Himself shall never again be separated.

Gurbani: ਦਾਸਾ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਟਿਆ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: daasaa ke bandhan kattiaa saachai sirajanahaar |
English: The True Creator Lord breaks the bonds of His slave.

Gurbani: ਭੂਲਾ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: bhoolaa maarag paaeon gun avagun na beechaar |
English: The doubter has been put back on the path; his merits and demerits have not been considered.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਜਿ ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੧੮॥੮੮॥
Transliteration: naanak tis saranaagatee ji sagal ghattaa aadhaar |4|18|88|
English: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the One who is the Support of every heart. ||4||18||88||

[Ang 49 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 |
English: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਸਨਾ ਸਚਾ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: rasanaa sachaa simareeai man tan niramal hoe |
English: With your tongue, repeat the True Name, and your mind and body shall become pure.

Gurbani: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸਾਕ ਅਗਲੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: maat pitaa saak agale tis bin avar na koe |
English: Your mother and father and all your relations-without Him, there are none at all.

Gurbani: ਮਿਹਰ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਚਸਾ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mihar kare je aapanee chasaa na visarai soe |1|
English: If God Himself bestows His Mercy, then He is not forgotten, even for an instant. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੇਵਿ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਸਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: man mere saachaa sev jichar saas |
English: O my mind, serve the True One, as long as you have the breath of life.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਭ ਕੂੜੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bin sache sabh koorr hai ante hoe binaas |1| rahaau |
English: Without the True One, everything is false; in the end, all shall perish. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: saahib meraa niramalaa tis bin rehan na jaae |
English: My Lord and Master is Immaculate and Pure; without Him, I cannot even survive.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਭੁਖ ਅਤਿ ਅਗਲੀ ਕੋਈ ਆਣਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: merai man tan bhukh at agalee koee aan milaavai maae |
English: Within my mind and body, there is such a great hunger; if only someone would come and unite me with Him, O my mother!

Gurbani: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਭਾਲੀਆ ਸਹ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: chaare kunddaa bhaaleea seh bin avar na jaae |2|
English: I have searched the four corners of the world-without our Husband Lord, there is no other place of rest. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੋ ਮੇਲੇ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: tis aagai aradaas kar jo mele karataar |
English: Offer your prayers to Him, who shall unite you with the Creator.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: satigur daataa naam kaa pooraa jis bhanddaar |
English: The True Guru is the Giver of the Naam; His Treasure is perfect and overflowing.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa saalaaheeai ant na paaraavaar |3|
English: Forever and ever, praise the One, who has no end or limitation. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪਰਵਦਗਾਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਸ ਦੇ ਚਲਤ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
Transliteration: paravadagaar saalaaheeai jis de chalat anek |
English: Praise God, the Nurturer and Cherisher; His Wondrous Ways are unlimited.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਏਹਾ ਮਤਿ ਵਿਸੇਖ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa aaraadheeai ehaa mat visekh |
English: Forever and ever, worship and adore Him; this is the most wonderful wisdom.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮਿਠਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਗੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੇਖ ॥੪॥੧੯॥੮੯॥
Transliteration: man tan mitthaa tis lagai jis masatak naanak lekh |4|19|89|
English: O Nanak, God's Flavor is sweet to the minds and bodies of those who have such blessed destiny written on their foreheads. ||4||19||89||

[Ang 49 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 |
English: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਹੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਾਈਹੋ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: sant janahu mil bhaaeeho sachaa naam samaal |
English: Meet with the humble Saints, O Siblings of Destiny, and contemplate the True Name.

Gurbani: ਤੋਸਾ ਬੰਧਹੁ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: tosaa bandhahu jeea kaa aithai othai naal |
English: For the journey of the soul, gather those supplies which will go with you here and hereafter.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਪਣੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: gur poore te paaeeai apanee nadar nihaal |
English: These are obtained from the Perfect Guru, when God bestows His Glance of Grace.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: karam paraapat tis hovai jis no hoe deaal |1|
English: Those unto whom He is Merciful, receive His Grace. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: mere man gur jevadd avar na koe |
English: O my mind, there is no other as great as the Guru.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜਾ ਥਾਉ ਨ ਕੋ ਸੁਝੈ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਲੇ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: doojaa thaau na ko sujhai gur mele sach soe |1| rahaau |
English: I cannot imagine any other place. The Guru leads me to meet the True Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਡਿਠਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sagal padaarath tis mile jin gur dditthaa jaae |
