English: Those who go to see the Guru obtain all treasures.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਜਿਨ ਮਨੁ ਲਗਾ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur charanee jin man lagaa se vaddabhaagee maae |
English: Those whose minds are attached to the Guru's Feet are very fortunate, O my mother.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur daataa samarath gur gur sabh meh rahiaa samaae |
English: The Guru is the Giver, the Guru is All-powerful. The Guru is All-pervading, contained amongst all.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਡੁਬਦਾ ਲਏ ਤਰਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur paramesar paarabraham gur ddubadaa le taraae |2|
English: The Guru is the Transcendent Lord, the Supreme Lord God. The Guru lifts up and saves those who are drowning. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥
Transliteration: kit mukh gur saalaaheeai karan kaaran samarath |
English: How shall I praise the Guru, the All-powerful Cause of causes?

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਮਥੇ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਰਹੇ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਆ ਹਥੁ ॥
Transliteration: se mathe nihachal rahe jin gur dhaariaa hath |
English: Those, upon whose foreheads the Guru has placed His Hand, remain steady and stable.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੀਆਲਿਆ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕਾ ਪਥੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur amrit naam peeaaliaa janam maran kaa path |
English: The Guru has led me to drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; He has released me from the cycle of birth and death.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਦੁਖ ਲਥੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur paramesar seviaa bhai bhanjan dukh lath |3|
English: I serve the Guru, the Transcendent Lord, the Dispeller of fear; my suffering has been taken away. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਗਹਿਰ ਗਭੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਅਘਖੰਡੁ ॥
Transliteration: satigur gahir gabheer hai sukh saagar aghakhandd |
English: The True Guru is the Deep and Profound Ocean of Peace, the Destroyer of sin.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਮਦੂਤ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਡੰਡੁ ॥
Transliteration: jin gur seviaa aapanaa jamadoot na laagai ddandd |
English: For those who serve their Guru, there is no punishment at the hands of the Messenger of Death.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਖੋਜਿ ਡਿਠਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur naal tul na lagee khoj dditthaa brahamandd |
English: There is none to compare with the Guru; I have searched and looked throughout the entire universe.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਮੰਡੁ ॥੪॥੨੦॥੯੦॥
Transliteration: naam nidhaan satigur deea sukh naanak man meh mandd |4|20|90|
English: The True Guru has bestowed the Treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. O Nanak, the mind is filled with peace. ||4||20||90||

[Ang 50 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 |
English: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਿਠਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਖਾਇਆ ਕਉੜਾ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਸਾਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: mitthaa kar kai khaaeaa kaurraa upajiaa saad |
English: People eat what they believe to be sweet, but it turns out to be bitter in taste.

Gurbani: ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤ ਸੁਰਿਦ ਕੀਏ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਚਿਆ ਬਾਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: bhaaee meet surid kee bikhiaa rachiaa baad |
English: They attach their affections to brothers and friends, uselessly engrossed in corruption.

Gurbani: ਜਾਂਦੇ ਬਿਲਮ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jaande bilam na hovee vin naavai bisamaad |1|
English: They vanish without a moment's delay; without God's Name, they are stunned and amazed. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: mere man satagur kee sevaa laag |
English: O my mind, attach yourself to the service of the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਵਿਣਸਣਾ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਤਿਆਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo deesai so vinasanaa man kee mat tiaag |1| rahaau |
English: Whatever is seen, shall pass away. Abandon the intellectualizations of your mind. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਕੂਕਰੁ ਹਰਕਾਇਆ ਧਾਵੈ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jiau kookar harakaaeaa dhaavai deh dis jaae |
English: Like the mad dog running around in all directions,

Gurbani: ਲੋਭੀ ਜੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਭਖੁ ਅਭਖੁ ਸਭ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: lobhee jant na jaanee bhakh abhakh sabh khaae |
English: the greedy person, unaware, consumes everything, edible and non-edible alike.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮਦਿ ਬਿਆਪਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh mad biaapiaa fir fir jonee paae |2|
English: Engrossed in the intoxication of sexual desire and anger, people wander through reincarnation over and over again. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਜਾਲੁ ਪਸਾਰਿਆ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਚੋਗ ਬਣਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa jaal pasaariaa bheetar chog banaae |
English: Maya has spread out her net, and in it, she has placed the bait.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਪੰਖੀ ਫਾਸਿਆ ਨਿਕਸੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: trisanaa pankhee faasiaa nikas na paae maae |
English: The bird of desire is caught, and cannot find any escape, O my mother.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jin keetaa tiseh na jaanee fir fir aavai jaae |3|
English: One who does not know the Lord who created him, comes and goes in reincarnation over and over again. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰੀ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: anik prakaaree mohiaa bahu bidh ihu sansaar |
English: By various devices, and in so many ways, this world is enticed.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਰਖੈ ਸੋ ਰਹੈ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਿਥੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jis no rakhai so rahai samrith purakh apaar |
English: They alone are saved, whom the All-powerful, Infinite Lord protects.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਉਧਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੨੧॥੯੧॥
Transliteration: har jan har liv udhare naanak sad balihaar |4|21|91|
English: The servants of the Lord are saved by the Love of the Lord. O Nanak, I am forever a sacrifice to them. ||4||21||91||

[Ang 50 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ghar 2 |
English: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl, Second House:

Gurbani: ਗੋਇਲਿ ਆਇਆ ਗੋਇਲੀ ਕਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਡੰਫੁ ਪਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: goeil aaeaa goeilee kiaa tis ddanf pasaar |
English: The herdsman comes to the pasture lands-what good are his ostentatious displays here?

Gurbani: ਮੁਹਲਤਿ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਚਲਣਾ ਤੂੰ ਸੰਮਲੁ ਘਰ ਬਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: muhalat punee chalanaa toon samal ghar baar |1|
English: When your allotted time is up, you must go. Take care of your real hearth and home. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ਮਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: har gun gaau manaa satigur sev piaar |
English: O mind, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and serve the True Guru with love.

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਥੋੜੜੀ ਬਾਤ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa thorrarree baat gumaan |1| rahaau |
English: Why do you take pride in trivial matters? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੇ ਰੈਣਿ ਪਰਾਹੁਣੇ ਉਠਿ ਚਲਸਹਿ ਪਰਭਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: jaise rain paraahune utth chalaseh parabhaat |
English: Like an overnight guest, you shall arise and depart in the morning.

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਤੂੰ ਰਤਾ ਗਿਰਸਤ ਸਿਉ ਸਭ ਫੁਲਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਗਾਤਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kiaa toon rataa girasat siau sabh fulaa kee baagaat |2|
English: Why are you so attached to your household? It is all like flowers in the garden. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲੋੜਿ ॥
Transliteration: meree meree kiaa kareh jin deea so prabh lorr |
English: Why do you say, "Mine, mine"? Look to God, who has given it to you.

Gurbani: ਸਰਪਰ ਉਠੀ ਚਲਣਾ ਛਡਿ ਜਾਸੀ ਲਖ ਕਰੋੜਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sarapar utthee chalanaa chhadd jaasee lakh karorr |3|
English: It is certain that you must arise and depart, and leave behind your hundreds of thousands and millions. ||3||

Gurbani: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਭ੍ਰਮਤਿਆ ਦੁਲਭ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਾਇਓਇ ॥
Transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh bhramatiaa dulabh janam paaeoe |
English: Through 8.4 million incarnations you have wandered, to obtain this rare and precious human life.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਤੂੰ ਸੋ ਦਿਨੁ ਨੇੜਾ ਆਇਓਇ ॥੪॥੨੨॥੯੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naam samaal toon so din nerraa aaeoe |4|22|92|
English: O Nanak, remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the day of departure is drawing near! ||4||22||92||

[Ang 50 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 |
English: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤਿਚਰੁ ਵਸਹਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੜੀ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਸਾਥੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: tichar vaseh suhelarree jichar saathee naal |
English: As long as the soul-companion is with the body, it dwells in happiness.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਸਾਥੀ ਉਠੀ ਚਲਿਆ ਤਾ ਧਨ ਖਾਕੂ ਰਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jaa saathee utthee chaliaa taa dhan khaakoo raal |1|
English: But when the companion arises and departs, then the body-bride mingles with dust. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਭਇਆ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਣੈ ਕਾ ਚਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: man bairaag bheaa darasan dekhanai kaa chaau |
English: My mind has become detached from the world; it longs to see the Vision of God's Darshan.

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਥਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dhan su teraa thaan |1| rahaau |
English: Blessed is Your Place. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਚਰੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਕੰਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਜੀਉ ਸਭਿ ਕਹਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: jichar vasiaa kant ghar jeeo jeeo sabh kahaat |
English: As long as the soul-husband dwells in the body-house, everyone greets you with respect.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਉਠੀ ਚਲਸੀ ਕੰਤੜਾ ਤਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪੁਛੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਤ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jaa utthee chalasee kantarraa taa koe na puchhai teree baat |2|
English: But when the soul-husband arises and departs, then no one cares for you at all. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਸਹੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: peeearrai sahu sev toon saahurarrai sukh vas |
English: In this world of your parents' home, serve your Husband Lord; in the world beyond, in your in-laws' home, you shall dwell in peace.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਚਜੁ ਅਚਾਰੁ ਸਿਖੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਦੁਖੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur mil chaj achaar sikh tudh kade na lagai dukh |3|
English: Meeting with the Guru, be a sincere student of proper conduct, and suffering shall never touch you. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਭਨਾ ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਵੰਞਣਾ ਸਭਿ ਮੁਕਲਾਵਣਹਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: sabhanaa saahurai vanyanaa sabh mukalaavanahaar |
English: Everyone shall go to their Husband Lord. Everyone shall be given their ceremonial send-off after their marriage.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨ ਸਹ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੯੩॥
Transliteration: naanak dhan sohaaganee jin seh naal piaar |4|23|93|
English: O Nanak, blessed are the happy soul-brides, who are in love with their Husband Lord. ||4||23||93||

[Ang 51 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੬ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ghar 6 |
English: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl, Sixth House:

Gurbani: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਏਕੁ ਓਹੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: karan kaaran ek ohee jin keea aakaar |
English: The One Lord is the Doer, the Cause of causes, who has created the creation.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਰਬ ਕੋ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tiseh dhiaavahu man mere sarab ko aadhaar |1|
English: Meditate on the One, O my mind, who is the Support of all. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur ke charan man meh dhiaae |
English: Meditate within your mind on the Guru's Feet.

Gurbani: ਛੋਡਿ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: chhodd sagal siaanapaa saach sabad liv laae |1| rahaau |
English: Give up all your clever mental tricks, and lovingly attune yourself to the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦੁਖੁ ਕਲੇਸੁ ਨ ਭਉ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: dukh kales na bhau biaapai gur mantru hiradai hoe |
English: Suffering, agony and fear do not cling to one whose heart is filled with the GurMantra.

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਤਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਤਰਿਓ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kott jatanaa kar rahe gur bin tario na koe |2|
English: Trying millions of things, people have grown weary, but without the Guru, none have been saved. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਧਾਰੈ ਪਾਪ ਸਗਲੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: dekh darasan man saadhaarai paap sagale jaeh |
English: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan, the mind is comforted and all sins depart.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: hau tin kai balihaaranai ji gur kee pairee paeh |3|
English: I am a sacrifice to those who fall at the Feet of the Guru. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasangat man vasai saach har kaa naau |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the True Name of the Lord comes to dwell in the mind.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਭਾਉ ॥੪॥੨੪॥੯੪॥
Transliteration: se vaddabhaagee naanakaa jinaa man ihu bhaau |4|24|94|
English: Very fortunate are those, O Nanak, whose minds are filled with this love. ||4||24||94||

[Ang 51 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 |
English: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੰਚਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪੂਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਸਗਲ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: sanch har dhan pooj satigur chhodd sagal vikaar |
English: Gather in the Wealth of the Lord, worship the True Guru, and give up all your corrupt ways.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jin toon saaj savaariaa har simar hoe udhaar |1|
English: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord who created and adorned you, and you shall be saved. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਏਕੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jap man naam ek apaar |
English: O mind, chant the Name of the One, the Unique and Infinite Lord.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਜਿਨਹਿ ਦੀਆ ਰਿਦੇ ਕਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: praan man tan jineh deea ride kaa aadhaar |1| rahaau |
English: He gave you the praanaa, the breath of life, and your mind and body. He is the Support of the heart. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਮਾਤੇ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh ahankaar maate viaapiaa sansaar |
English: The world is drunk, engrossed in sexual desire, anger and egotism.

Gurbani: ਪਉ ਸੰਤ ਸਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੁ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਿਟੈ ਦੂਖੁ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: pau sant saranee laag charanee mittai dookh andhaar |2|
English: Seek the Sanctuary of the Saints, and fall at their feet; your suffering and darkness shall be removed. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਏਹ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: sat santokh deaa kamaavai eeh karanee saar |
English: Practice truth, contentment and kindness; this is the most excellent way of life.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਸਭ ਹੋਇ ਰੇਣਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aap chhodd sabh hoe renaa jis dee prabh nirankaar |3|
English: One who is so blessed by the Formless Lord God renounces selfishness, and becomes the dust of all. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਸਗਲ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਪਾਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jo deesai so sagal toonhai pasariaa paasaar |
English: All that is seen is You, Lord, the expansion of the expanse.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਕਾਟਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੨੫॥੯੫॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak gur bharam kaattiaa sagal braham beechaar |4|25|95|
English: Says Nanak, the Guru has removed my doubts; I recognize God in all. ||4||25||95||

[Ang 51 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 |
English: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਮੰਧੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਗਲਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: dukrit sukrit mandhe sansaar sagalaanaa |
English: The whole world is engrossed in bad deeds and good deeds.

Gurbani: ਦੁਹਹੂੰ ਤੇ ਰਹਤ ਭਗਤੁ ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਜਾਣਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: duhahoon te rehat bhagat hai koee viralaa jaanaa |1|
English: God's devotee is above both, but those who understand this are very rare. ||1||

Gurbani: ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਰਬੇ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: tthaakur sarabe samaanaa |
English: Our Lord and Master is all-pervading everywhere.

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਕਹਉ ਸੁਣਉ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੂੰ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa khau sunau suaamee toon vadd purakh sujaanaa |1| rahaau |
English: What should I say, and what should I hear? O my Lord and Master, You are Great, All-powerful and All-knowing. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਾਨ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ਮੰਧੇ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: maan abhimaan mandhe so sevak naahee |
English: One who is influenced by praise and blame is not God's servant.

Gurbani: ਤਤ ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਕੋਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਮੰਧਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tat samadarasee santahu koee kott mandhaahee |2|
English: One who sees the essence of reality with impartial vision, O Saints, is very rare-one among millions. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਹਨ ਕਹਾਵਨ ਇਹੁ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਰਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: kehan kahaavan ihu keerat karalaa |
English: People talk on and on about Him; they consider this to be praise of God.

Gurbani: ਕਥਨ ਕਹਨ ਤੇ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੋਈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kathan kehan te mukataa guramukh koee viralaa |3|
English: But rare indeed is the Gurmukh, who is above this mere talk. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗਤਿ ਅਵਿਗਤਿ ਕਛੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gat avigat kachh nadar na aaeaa |
English: He is not concerned with deliverance or bondage.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੨੬॥੯੬॥
Transliteration: santan kee ren naanak daan paaeaa |4|26|96|
English: Nanak has obtained the gift of the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||4||26||96||

[Ang 51 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੭ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ghar 7 |
English: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl, Seventh House:

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੈ ਭਰੋਸੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮੈ ਲਾਡ ਲਡਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: terai bharosai piaare mai laadd laddaaeaa |
English: Relying on Your Mercy, Dear Lord, I have cherished and loved you.

Gurbani: ਭੂਲਹਿ ਚੂਕਹਿ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤੂੰ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bhooleh chookeh baarik toon har pitaa maaeaa |1|
English: Like a foolish child, I have made mistakes. O Lord, You are my Father and Mother. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਕਹਨੁ ਕਹਾਵਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: suhelaa kehan kahaavan |
English: It is easy to speak and talk,

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਭਾਵਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: teraa bikham bhaavan |1| rahaau |
English: but it is difficult to accept Your Will. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਮਾਣੁ ਤਾਣੁ ਕਰਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਹਉ ਜਾਨਉ ਆਪਾ ॥
Transliteration: hau maan taan krau teraa hau jaanau aapaa |
English: I stand tall; You are my Strength. I know that You are mine.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਹੀ ਮਧਿ ਸਭਹਿ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਬੇਮੁਹਤਾਜ ਬਾਪਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sabh hee madh sabheh te baahar bemuhataaj baapaa |2|
English: Inside of all, and outside of all, You are our Self-sufficient Father. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪਿਤਾ ਹਉ ਜਾਨਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਵਨ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: pitaa hau jaanau naahee teree kavan jugataa |
English: O Father, I do not know-how can I know Your Way?

Gurbani: ਬੰਧਨ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਰਾਖੈ ਮਮਤਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bandhan mukat santahu meree raakhai mamataa |3|
English: He frees us from bondage, O Saints, and saves us from possessiveness. ||3||

Gurbani: ਭਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਰਹਿਓ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: bhe kirapaal tthaakur rahio aavan jaanaa |
English: Becoming Merciful, my Lord and Master has ended my comings and goings in reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਾ ॥੪॥੨੭॥੯੭॥
Transliteration: gur mil naanak paarabraham pachhaanaa |4|27|97|
English: Meeting with the Guru, Nanak has recognized the Supreme Lord God. ||4||27||97||

[Ang 52 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ghar 1 |
English: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl, First House:

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਾਈਆ ਕਟਿਅੜਾ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: sant janaa mil bhaaeea kattiarraa jamakaal |
English: Meeting with the humble beings, O Siblings of Destiny, the Messenger of Death is conquered.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਹੋਆ ਖਸਮੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa saahib man vutthaa hoaa khasam deaal |
English: The True Lord and Master has come to dwell within my mind; my Lord and Master has become Merciful.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਬਿਨਸਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਜੰਜਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: pooraa satigur bhettiaa binasiaa sabh janjaal |1|
English: Meeting with the Perfect True Guru, all my worldly entanglements have ended. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਾ ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: mere satiguraa hau tudh vittahu kurabaan |
English: O my True Guru, I am a sacrifice to You.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਤੁਸਿ ਦਿਤਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tere darasan kau balihaaranai tus ditaa amrit naam |1| rahaau |
English: I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. By the Pleasure of Your Will, You have blessed me with the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਤੂੰ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਸੇਈ ਪੁਰਖ ਸੁਜਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: jin toon seviaa bhaau kar seee purakh sujaan |
English: Those who have served You with love are truly wise.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨਾ ਪਿਛੈ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਜਿਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: tinaa pichhai chhutteeai jin andar naam nidhaan |
English: Those who have the Treasure of the Naam within emancipate others as well as themselves.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਦਿਤਾ ਆਤਮ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur jevadd daataa ko nahee jin ditaa aatam daan |2|
English: There is no other Giver as great as the Guru, who has given the gift of the soul. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਏ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aae se paravaan heh jin gur miliaa subhaae |
English: Blessed and acclaimed is the coming of those who have met the Guru with loving faith.

Gurbani: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਦਰਗਹ ਬੈਸਣੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sache setee ratiaa daragah baisan jaae |
English: Attuned to the True One, you shall obtain a place of honor in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਰਤੇ ਹਥਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: karate hath vaddiaaeea poorab likhiaa paae |3|
English: Greatness is in the Hands of the Creator; it is obtained by pre-ordained destiny. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਟੇਕ ॥
Transliteration: sach karataa sach karanahaar sach saahib sach ttek |
English: True is the Creator, True is the Doer. True is our Lord and Master, and True is His Support.

Gurbani: ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਸਚੋ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥
Transliteration: sacho sach vakhaaneeai sacho budh bibek |
English: So speak the Truest of the True. Through the True One, an intuitive and discerning mind is obtained.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵੈ ਏਕ ॥੪॥੨੮॥੯੮॥
Transliteration: sarab nirantar rav rahiaa jap naanak jeevai ek |4|28|98|
English: Nanak lives by chanting and meditating on the One, who is pervading within and contained amongst all. ||4||28||98||

[Ang 52 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 |
English: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰੁ ਪੂਜੀਐ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਲਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur paramesur poojeeai man tan laae piaar |
English: Worship the Guru, the Transcendent Lord, with your mind and body attuned to love.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇਇ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: satigur daataa jeea kaa sabhasai dee adhaar |
English: The True Guru is the Giver of the soul; He gives Support to all.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਸਚਾ ਏਹੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: satigur bachan kamaavane sachaa ehu veechaar |
English: Act according to the Instructions of the True Guru; this is the true philosophy.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਰਤਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bin saadhoo sangat ratiaa maaeaa mohu sabh chhaar |1|
English: Without being attuned to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, all attachment to Maya is just dust. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: mere saajan har har naam samaal |
English: O my friend, reflect upon the Name of the Lord, Har, Har

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਘਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saadhoo sangat man vasai pooran hovai ghaal |1| rahaau |
English: . In the Saadh Sangat, He dwells within the mind, and one's works are brought to perfect fruition. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur samarath apaar gur vaddabhaagee darasan hoe |
English: The Guru is All-powerful, the Guru is Infinite. By great good fortune, the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is obtained.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur agochar niramalaa gur jevadd avar na koe |
English: The Guru is Imperceptible, Immaculate and Pure. There is no other as great as the Guru.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur karataa gur karanahaar guramukh sachee soe |
English: The Guru is the Creator, the Guru is the Doer. The Gurmukh obtains true glory.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਲੋੜੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur te baahar kichh nahee gur keetaa lorre su hoe |2|
English: Nothing is beyond the Guru; whatever He wishes comes to pass. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਜਾਤੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur teerath gur paarajaat gur manasaa pooranahaar |
English: The Guru is the Sacred Shrine of Pilgrimage, the Guru is the Wish-fulfilling Elysian Tree.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਇ ਉਧਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur daataa har naam dee udharai sabh sansaar |
English: The Guru is the Fulfiller of the desires of the mind. The Guru is the Giver of the Name of the Lord, by which all the world is saved.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਊਚਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur samarath gur nirankaar gur aoochaa agam apaar |
English: The Guru is All-powerful, the Guru is Formless; the Guru is Lofty, Inaccessible and Infinite.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਅਗਮ ਹੈ ਕਿਆ ਕਥੇ ਕਥਨਹਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur kee mahimaa agam hai kiaa kathe kathanahaar |3|
English: The Praise of the Guru is so sublime-what can any speaker say? ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੜੇ ਫਲ ਮਨਿ ਬਾਛੀਅਹਿ ਤਿਤੜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: jitarre fal man baachheeeh titarre satigur paas |
English: All the rewards which the mind desires are with the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਬ ਲਿਖੇ ਪਾਵਣੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: poorab likhe paavane saach naam de raas |
English: One whose destiny is so pre-ordained, obtains the Wealth of the True Name.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਇਆਂ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: satigur saranee aaeaan baahurr nahee binaas |
English: Entering the Sanctuary of the True Guru, you shall never die again.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਸਰਉ ਏਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਾਸੁ ॥੪॥੨੯॥੯੯॥
Transliteration: har naanak kade na visrau ehu jeeo pindd teraa saas |4|29|99|
English: Nanak: may I never forget You, Lord. This soul, body and breath are Yours. ||4||29||99||

[Ang 52 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 |
English: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਹੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਭਾਈਹੋ ਛੂਟਨੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sant janahu sun bhaaeeho chhoottan saachai naae |
English: O Saints, O Siblings of Destiny, listen: release comes only through the True Name.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਸਰੇਵਣੇ ਤੀਰਥ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur ke charan sarevane teerath har kaa naau |
English: Worship the Feet of the Guru. Let the Name of the Lord be your sacred shrine of pilgrimage.

Gurbani: ਆਗੈ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਮੰਨੀਅਹਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aagai darageh maneeeh milai nithaave thaau |1|
English: Hereafter, you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord; there, even the homeless find a home. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਸਾਚੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: bhaaee re saachee satigur sev |
English: O Siblings of Destiny, service to the True Guru alone is True.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੁਠੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur tutthai paaeeai pooran alakh abhev |1| rahaau |
English: When the True Guru is pleased, we obtain the Perfect, Unseen, Unknowable Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਦਿਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur vittahu vaariaa jin ditaa sach naau |
English: I am a sacrifice to the True Guru, who has bestowed the True Name.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਣਾ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: anadin sach salaahanaa sache ke gun gaau |
English: Night and day, I praise the True One; I sing the Glorious Praises of the True One.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਪੈਨਣਾ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sach khaanaa sach painanaa sache sachaa naau |2|
English: True is the food, and true are the clothes, of those who chant the True Name of the True One. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਸਫਲੁ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: saas giraas na visarai safal moorat gur aap |
English: With each breath and morsel of food, do not forget the Guru, the Embodiment of Fulfillment.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦਿਸਈ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: gur jevadd avar na disee aatth pehar tis jaap |
English: None is seen to be as great as the Guru. Meditate on Him twenty-four hours a day.

Gurbani: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: nadar kare taa paaeeai sach naam gunataas |3|
English: As He casts His Glance of Grace, we obtain the True Name, the Treasure of Excellence. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur paramesar ek hai sabh meh rahiaa samaae |
English: The Guru and the Transcendent Lord are one and the same, pervading and permeating amongst all.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੇਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: jin kau poorab likhiaa seee naam dhiaae |
English: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny, meditate on the Naam.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੩੦॥੧੦੦॥
Transliteration: naanak gur saranaagatee marai na aavai jaae |4|30|100|
English: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Guru, who does not die, or come and go in reincarnation. ||4||30||100||

[Ang 53 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ghar 1 asattapadeea |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl, First House, Ashtpadheeyaa:

Gurbani: ਆਖਿ ਆਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਵਾਵਣਾ ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਜਾਪੈ ਵਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aakh aakh man vaavanaa jiau jiau jaapai vaae |
English: I speak and chant His Praises, vibrating the instrument of my mind. The more I know Him, the more I vibrate it.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਵਾਇ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ਸੋ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਥਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jis no vaae sunaaeeai so kevadd kit thaae |
English: The One, unto whom we vibrate and sing-how great is He, and where is His Place?

Gurbani: ਆਖਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਜੇਤੜੇ ਸਭਿ ਆਖਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aakhan vaale jetarre sabh aakh rahe liv laae |1|
English: Those who speak of Him and praise Him-they all continue speaking of Him with love. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਾਬਾ ਅਲਹੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: baabaa alahu agam apaar |
English: O Baba, the Lord Allah is Inaccessible and Infinite.

Gurbani: ਪਾਕੀ ਨਾਈ ਪਾਕ ਥਾਇ ਸਚਾ ਪਰਵਦਿਗਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: paakee naaee paak thaae sachaa paravadigaar |1| rahaau |
English: Sacred is His Name, and Sacred is His Place. He is the True Cherisher. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੀ ਕੇਤੜਾ ਲਿਖਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: teraa hukam na jaapee ketarraa likh na jaanai koe |
English: The extent of Your Command cannot be seen; no one knows how to write it.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਸਾਇਰ ਮੇਲੀਅਹਿ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਪੁਜਾਵਹਿ ਰੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: je sau saaeir meleeeh til na pujaaveh roe |
English: Even if a hundred poets met together, they could not describe even a tiny bit of it.

Gurbani: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਖਹਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: keemat kinai na paaeea sabh sun sun aakheh soe |2|
English: No one has found Your Value; they all merely write what they have heard again and again. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪੀਰ ਪੈਕਾਮਰ ਸਾਲਕ ਸਾਦਕ ਸੁਹਦੇ ਅਉਰੁ ਸਹੀਦ ॥
Transliteration: peer paikaamar saalak saadak suhade aaur saheed |
English: The Pirs, the Prophets, the spiritual teachers, the faithful, the innocents and the martyrs,

Gurbani: ਸੇਖ ਮਸਾਇਕ ਕਾਜੀ ਮੁਲਾ ਦਰਿ ਦਰਵੇਸ ਰਸੀਦ ॥
Transliteration: sekh masaaeik kaajee mulaa dar daraves raseed |
English: the Shaikhs, the mystics, the Qazis, the Mullahs and the Dervishes at His Door

Gurbani: ਬਰਕਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਅਗਲੀ ਪੜਦੇ ਰਹਨਿ ਦਰੂਦ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: barakat tin kau agalee parrade rehan darood |3|
English: -they are blessed all the more as they continue reading their prayers in praise to Him. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪੁਛਿ ਨ ਸਾਜੇ ਪੁਛਿ ਨ ਢਾਹੇ ਪੁਛਿ ਨ ਦੇਵੈ ਲੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: puchh na saaje puchh na dtaahe puchh na devai lee |
English: He seeks no advice when He builds; He seeks no advice when He destroys. He seeks no advice while giving or taking.

Gurbani: ਆਪਣੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਣੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: aapanee kudarat aape jaanai aape karan karee |
English: He alone knows His Creative Power; He Himself does all deeds.

Gurbani: ਸਭਨਾ ਵੇਖੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: sabhanaa vekhai nadar kar jai bhaavai tai dee |4|
English: He beholds all in His Vision. He gives to those with whom He is pleased. ||4||

Gurbani: ਥਾਵਾ ਨਾਵ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਵਾ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: thaavaa naav na jaaneeeh naavaa kevadd naau |
English: His Place and His Name are not known, no one knows how great is His Name.

Gurbani: ਜਿਥੈ ਵਸੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਸੋ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਹੈ ਥਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jithai vasai meraa paatisaahu so kevadd hai thaau |
English: How great is that place where my Sovereign Lord dwells?

Gurbani: ਅੰਬੜਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਕਈ ਹਉ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਪੁਛਣਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: anbarr koe na sakee hau kis no puchhan jaau |5|
English: No one can reach it; whom shall I go and ask? ||5||

Gurbani: ਵਰਨਾ ਵਰਨ ਨ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਜੇ ਕਿਸੈ ਵਡਾ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: varanaa varan na bhaavanee je kisai vaddaa karee |
English: One class of people does not like the other, when one has been made great.

Gurbani: ਵਡੇ ਹਥਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: vadde hath vaddiaaeea jai bhaavai tai dee |
English: Greatness is only in His Great Hands; He gives to those with whom He is pleased.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਆਪਣੈ ਚਸਾ ਨ ਢਿਲ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: hukam savaare aapanai chasaa na dtil karee |6|
English: By the Hukam of His Command, He Himself regenerates, without a moment's delay. ||6||

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਆਖੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਲੈਣੈ ਕੈ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: sabh ko aakhai bahut bahut lainai kai veechaar |
English: Everyone cries out, "More! More!", with the idea of receiving.

Gurbani: ਕੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਦੇ ਕੈ ਰਹਿਆ ਸੁਮਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: kevadd daataa aakheeai de kai rahiaa sumaar |
English: How great should we call the Giver? His Gifts are beyond estimation.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਤੇਰੇ ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗਹ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥੭॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak tott na aavee tere jugah jugah bhanddaar |7|1|
English: O Nanak, there is no deficiency; Your Storehouses are filled to overflowing, age after age. ||7||1||

[Ang 53 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਭੇ ਕੰਤ ਮਹੇਲੀਆ ਸਗਲੀਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sabhe kant maheleea sagaleea kareh seegaar |
English: All are brides of the Husband Lord; all decorate themselves for Him.

Gurbani: ਗਣਤ ਗਣਾਵਣਿ ਆਈਆ ਸੂਹਾ ਵੇਸੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: ganat ganaavan aaeea soohaa ves vikaar |
English: But when the time comes to settle their accounts, their red robes are corrupt.

Gurbani: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਖੋਟਾ ਪਾਜੁ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: paakhandd prem na paaeeai khottaa paaj khuaar |1|
English: His Love is not obtained through hypocrisy. Her false coverings bring only ruin. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਇਉ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੈ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: har jeeo iau pir raavai naar |
English: In this way, the Dear Husband Lord ravishes and enjoys His bride.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਨਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਅਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੈਹਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tudh bhaavan sohaaganee apanee kirapaa laihi savaar |1| rahaau |
English: The happy soul-bride is pleasing to You, Lord; by Your Grace, You adorn her. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸੀਗਾਰੀਆ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: gurasabadee seegaareea tan man pir kai paas |
English: She is decorated with the Word of the Guru's Shabad; her mind and body belong to her Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਖੜੀ ਤਕੈ ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: due kar jorr kharree takai sach kahai aradaas |
English: With her palms pressed together, she stands, waiting on Him, and offers her True prayers to Him.

Gurbani: ਲਾਲਿ ਰਤੀ ਸਚ ਭੈ ਵਸੀ ਭਾਇ ਰਤੀ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: laal ratee sach bhai vasee bhaae ratee rang raas |2|
English: Dyed in the deep crimson of the Love of her Darling Lord, she dwells in the Fear of the True One. Imbued with His Love, she is dyed in the color of His Love. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਕੀ ਚੇਰੀ ਕਾਂਢੀਐ ਲਾਲੀ ਮਾਨੈ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: pria kee cheree kaandteeai laalee maanai naau |
English: She is said to be the hand-maiden of her Beloved Lord; His sweetheart surrenders to His Name.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਤੁਟਈ ਸਾਚੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saachee preet na tuttee saache mel milaau |
English: True Love is never broken; she is united in Union with the True One.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਵੇਧਿਆ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sabad ratee man vedhiaa hau sad balihaarai jaau |3|
English: Attuned to the Word of the Shabad, her mind is pierced through. I am forever a sacrifice to Him. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਰੰਡ ਨ ਬੈਸਈ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: saa dhan randd na baisee je satigur maeh samaae |
English: That bride, who is absorbed into the True Guru, shall never become a widow.

Gurbani: ਪਿਰੁ ਰੀਸਾਲੂ ਨਉਤਨੋ ਸਾਚਉ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: pir reesaaloo nautano saachau marai na jaae |
English: Her Husband Lord is Beautiful; His Body is forever fresh and new. The True One does not die, and shall not go.

Gurbani: ਨਿਤ ਰਵੈ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਸਾਚੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: nit ravai sohaaganee saachee nadar rajaae |4|
English: He continually enjoys His happy soul-bride; He casts His Gracious Glance of Truth upon her, and she abides in His Will. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੁ ਧੜੀ ਧਨ ਮਾਡੀਐ ਕਾਪੜੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: saach dharree dhan maaddeeai kaaparr prem seegaar |
English: The bride braids her hair with Truth; her clothes are decorated with His Love.

Gurbani: ਚੰਦਨੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਦਸਵਾ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: chandan cheet vasaaeaa mandar dasavaa duaar |
English: Like the essence of sandalwood, He permeates her consciousness, and the Temple of the Tenth Gate is opened.

Gurbani: ਦੀਪਕੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਿਗਾਸਿਆ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰ ਹਾਰੁ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: deepak sabad vigaasiaa raam naam ur haar |5|
English: The lamp of the Shabad is lit, and the Name of the Lord is her necklace. ||5||

Gurbani: ਨਾਰੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸੋਹਣੀ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਮਣੀ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: naaree andar sohanee masatak manee piaar |
English: She is the most beautiful among women; upon her forehead she wears the Jewel of the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਸੋਭਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਸਾਚੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: sobhaa surat suhaavanee saachai prem apaar |
English: Her glory and her wisdom are magnificent; her love for the Infinite Lord is True.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: bin pir purakh na jaanee saache gur kai het piaar |6|
English: Other than her Beloved Lord, she knows no man. She enshrines love for the True Guru. ||6||

Gurbani: ਨਿਸਿ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੀ ਸੁਤੀਏ ਕਿਉ ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: nis andhiaaree sutee kiau pir bin rain vihaae |
English: Asleep in the darkness of the night, how shall she pass her life-night without her Husband?

Gurbani: ਅੰਕੁ ਜਲਉ ਤਨੁ ਜਾਲੀਅਉ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਜਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: ank jlau tan jaaleeo man dhan jal bal jaae |
English: Her limbs shall burn, her body shall burn, and her mind and wealth shall burn as well.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਧਨ ਕੰਤਿ ਨ ਰਾਵੀਆ ਤਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: jaa dhan kant na raaveea taa birathaa joban jaae |7|
English: When the Husband does not enjoy His bride, then her youth passes away in vain. ||7||

Gurbani: ਸੇਜੈ ਕੰਤ ਮਹੇਲੜੀ ਸੂਤੀ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sejai kant mahelarree sootee boojh na paae |
English: The Husband is on the Bed, but the bride is asleep, and so she does not come to know Him.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਸੁਤੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਜਾਗਣਾ ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਪੂਛਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: hau sutee pir jaaganaa kis kau poochhau jaae |
English: While I am asleep, my Husband Lord is awake. Where can I go for advice?

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਭੈ ਵਸੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਸਖਾਇ ॥੮॥੨॥
Transliteration: satigur melee bhai vasee naanak prem sakhaae |8|2|
English: The True Guru has led me to meet Him, and now I dwell in the Fear of God. O Nanak, His Love is always with me. ||8||2||

[Ang 54 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣ ਆਪੇ ਕਥੈ ਆਪੇ ਸੁਣਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape gun aape kathai aape sun veechaar |
English: O Lord, You are Your Own Glorious Praise. You Yourself speak it; You Yourself hear it and contemplate it.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਰਖਿ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਮੋਲੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape ratan parakh toon aape mol apaar |
English: You Yourself are the Jewel, and You are the Appraiser. You Yourself are of Infinite Value.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਉ ਮਾਨੁ ਮਹਤੁ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saachau maan mehat toon aape devanahaar |1|
English: O True Lord, You are Honor and Glory; You Yourself are the Giver. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: har jeeo toon karataa karataar |
English: O Dear Lord, You are the Creator and the Cause.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖੁ ਤੂੰ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਆਚਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jiau bhaavai tiau raakh toon har naam milai aachaar |1| rahaau |
English: If it is Your Will, please save and protect me; please bless me with the lifestyle of the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਹੀਰਾ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਆਪੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਜੀਠ ॥
Transliteration: aape heeraa niramalaa aape rang majeetth |
English: You Yourself are the flawless diamond; You Yourself are the deep crimson color.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮੋਤੀ ਊਜਲੋ ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤ ਬਸੀਠੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape motee aoojalo aape bhagat baseetth |
English: You Yourself are the perfect pearl; You Yourself are the devotee and the priest.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹਣਾ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਡੀਠੁ ਅਡੀਠੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad salaahanaa ghatt ghatt ddeetth addeetth |2|
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, You are praised. In each and every heart, the Unseen is seen. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਰੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape saagar bohithaa aape paar apaar |
English: You Yourself are the ocean and the boat. You Yourself are this shore, and the one beyond.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੀ ਵਾਟ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਤੂੰ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਘਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: saachee vaatt sujaan toon sabad laghaavanahaar |
English: O All-knowing Lord, You are the True Way. The Shabad is the Navigator to ferry us across.

Gurbani: ਨਿਡਰਿਆ ਡਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: niddariaa ddar jaaneeai baajh guroo gubaar |3|
English: One who does not fear God shall live in fear; without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਹੋਰੁ ਕੇਤੀ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: asathir karataa dekheeai hor ketee aavai jaae |
English: The Creator alone is seen to be Eternal; all others come and go.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਏਕੁ ਤੂੰ ਹੋਰ ਬੰਧੀ ਧੰਧੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aape niramal ek toon hor bandhee dhandhai paae |
English: Only You, Lord, are Immaculate and Pure. All others are bound up in worldly pursuits.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: gur raakhe se ubare saache siau liv laae |4|
English: Those who are protected by the Guru are saved. They are lovingly attuned to the True Lord. ||4||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਵਾਕਿ ॥
Transliteration: har jeeo sabad pachhaaneeai saach rate gur vaak |
English: Through the Shabad, they recognize the Dear Lord; through the Guru's Word, they are attuned to Truth.

Gurbani: ਤਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਸਚ ਘਰਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਓਤਾਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: tit tan mail na lagee sach ghar jis otaak |
English: Filth does not stick to the body of one who has secured a dwelling in his True Home.

Gurbani: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਆ ਸਾਕੁ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: nadar kare sach paaeeai bin naavai kiaa saak |5|
English: When the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, we obtain the True Name. Without the Name, who are our relatives? ||5||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਸੇ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jinee sach pachhaaniaa se sukhee jug chaar |
English: Those who have realized the Truth are at peace throughout the four ages.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਕੈ ਸਚੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: haumai trisanaa maar kai sach rakhiaa ur dhaar |
English: Subduing their egotism and desires, they keep the True Name enshrined in their hearts.

Gurbani: ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: jag meh laahaa ek naam paaeeai gur veechaar |6|
English: In this world, the only real profit is the Name of the One Lord; it is earned by contemplating the Guru. ||6||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਉ ਵਖਰੁ ਲਾਦੀਐ ਲਾਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: saachau vakhar laadeeai laabh sadaa sach raas |
English: Loading the Merchandise of the True Name, you shall gather in your profits forever with the Capital of Truth.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਬੈਸਈ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਚੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: saachee daragah baisee bhagat sachee aradaas |
English: In the Court of the True One, you shall sit in truthful devotion and prayer.

Gurbani: ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਲੇਖਾ ਨਿਬੜੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: pat siau lekhaa nibarrai raam naam paragaas |7|
English: Your account shall be settled with honor, in the Radiant Light of the Name of the Lord. ||7||

Gurbani: ਊਚਾ ਊਚਉ ਆਖੀਐ ਕਹਉ ਨ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aoochaa aoochau aakheeai khau na dekhiaa jaae |
English: The Lord is said to be the Highest of the High; no one can perceive Him.

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਏਕੁ ਤੂੰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jeh dekhaa teh ek toon satigur deea dikhaae |
English: Wherever I look, I see only You. The True Guru has inspired me to see You.

Gurbani: ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੮॥੩॥
Transliteration: jot nirantar jaaneeai naanak sehaj subhaae |8|3|
English: The Divine Light within is revealed, O Nanak, through this intuitive understanding. ||8||3||

[Ang 55 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਛੁਲੀ ਜਾਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਸਰੁ ਖਾਰਾ ਅਸਗਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: machhulee jaal na jaaniaa sar khaaraa asagaahu |
English: The fish did not notice the net in the deep and salty sea.

Gurbani: ਅਤਿ ਸਿਆਣੀ ਸੋਹਣੀ ਕਿਉ ਕੀਤੋ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: at siaanee sohanee kiau keeto vesaahu |
English: It was so clever and beautiful, but why was it so confident?

Gurbani: ਕੀਤੇ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਪਾਕੜੀ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਟਲੈ ਸਿਰਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: keete kaaran paakarree kaal na ttalai siraahu |1|
English: By its actions it was caught, and now death cannot be turned away from its head. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਇਉ ਸਿਰਿ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: bhaaee re iau sir jaanahu kaal |
English: O Siblings of Destiny, just like this, see death hovering over your own heads!

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਮਛੀ ਤਿਉ ਮਾਣਸਾ ਪਵੈ ਅਚਿੰਤਾ ਜਾਲੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jiau machhee tiau maanasaa pavai achintaa jaal |1| rahaau |
English: People are just like this fish; unaware, the noose of death descends upon them. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਬਾਧੋ ਕਾਲ ਕੋ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਾਲੁ ਅਫਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sabh jag baadho kaal ko bin gur kaal afaar |
English: The whole world is bound by death; without the Guru, death cannot be avoided.

Gurbani: ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਛੋਡਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: sach rate se ubare dubidhaa chhodd vikaar |
English: Those who are attuned to Truth are saved; they renounce duality and corruption.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: hau tin kai balihaaranai dar sachai sachiaar |2|
English: I am a sacrifice to those who are found to be Truthful in the True Court. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੀਚਾਨੇ ਜਿਉ ਪੰਖੀਆ ਜਾਲੀ ਬਧਿਕ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
Transliteration: seechaane jiau pankheea jaalee badhik haath |
English: Think of the hawk preying on the birds, and the net in the hands of the hunter.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਹੋਰਿ ਫਾਥੇ ਚੋਗੈ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
Transliteration: gur raakhe se ubare hor faathe chogai saath |
English: Those who are protected by the Guru are saved; the others are caught by the bait.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਚੁਣਿ ਸੁਟੀਅਹਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸੰਗੀ ਸਾਥਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bin naavai chun sutteeeh koe na sangee saath |3|
English: Without the Name, they are picked up and thrown away; they have no friends or companions. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਚੋ ਸਚਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਾ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: sacho sachaa aakheeai sache sachaa thaan |
English: God is said to be the Truest of the True; His Place is the Truest of the True.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚਾ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: jinee sachaa maniaa tin man sach dhiaan |
English: Those who obey the True One-their minds abide in true meditation.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਸੂਚੇ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: man mukh sooche jaaneeeh guramukh jinaa giaan |4|
English: Those who become Gurmukh, and obtain spiritual wisdom-their minds and mouths are known to be pure. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਗੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur agai aradaas kar saajan dee milaae |
English: Offer your most sincere prayers to the True Guru, so that He may unite you with your Best Friend.

Gurbani: ਸਾਜਨਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਮਦੂਤ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: saajan miliai sukh paaeaa jamadoot mue bikh khaae |
English: Meeting your Best Friend, you shall find peace; the Messenger of Death shall take poison and die.

Gurbani: ਨਾਵੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹਉ ਵਸਾਂ ਨਾਉ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: naavai andar hau vasaan naau vasai man aae |5|
English: I dwell deep within the Name; the Name has come to dwell within my mind. ||5||

Gurbani: ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: baajh guroo gubaar hai bin sabadai boojh na paae |
English: Without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness; without the Shabad, understanding is not obtained.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramatee paragaas hoe sach rahai liv laae |
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, you shall be enlightened; remain absorbed in the Love of the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਿਥੈ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਸੰਚਰੈ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: tithai kaal na sancharai jotee jot samaae |6|
English: Death does not go there; your light shall merge with the Light. ||6||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰਹੈ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਤੂੰ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: toonhai saajan toon sujaan toon aape melanahaar |
English: You are my Best Friend; You are All-knowing. You are the One who unites us with Yourself.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: gurasabadee saalaaheeai ant na paaraavaar |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, we praise You; You have no end or limitation.

Gurbani: ਤਿਥੈ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਅਪੜੈ ਜਿਥੈ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: tithai kaal na aparrai jithai gur kaa sabad apaar |7|
English: Death does not reach that place, where the Infinite Word of the Guru's Shabad resounds. ||7||

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸਭੇ ਊਪਜਹਿ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: hukamee sabhe aoopajeh hukamee kaar kamaeh |
English: By the Hukam of His Command, all are created. By His Command, actions are performed.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਕਾਲੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: hukamee kaalai vas hai hukamee saach samaeh |
English: By His Command, all are subject to death; by His Command, they merge in Truth.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਇਨਾ ਜੰਤਾ ਵਸਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੮॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak jo tis bhaavai so theeai inaa jantaa vas kichh naeh |8|4|
English: O Nanak, whatever pleases His Will comes to pass. Nothing is in the hands of these beings. ||8||4||

[Ang 55 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਜੂਠੈ ਤਨਿ ਜੂਠਿ ਹੈ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਜੂਠੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: man jootthai tan jootth hai jihavaa jootthee hoe |
English: If the mind is polluted, then the body is polluted, and the tongue is polluted as well.

Gurbani: ਮੁਖਿ ਝੂਠੈ ਝੂਠੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਸੂਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: mukh jhootthai jhootth bolanaa kiau kar soochaa hoe |
English: With false mouths, people speak falsehood. How can they be made pure?

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਅਭ ਸਬਦ ਨ ਮਾਂਜੀਐ ਸਾਚੇ ਤੇ ਸਚੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bin abh sabad na maanjeeai saache te sach hoe |1|
English: Without the Holy Water of the Shabad, they are not cleansed. From the True One alone comes Truth. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੁੰਧੇ ਗੁਣਹੀਣੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਕੇਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: mundhe gunaheenee sukh kehi |
English: O soul-bride, without virtue, what happiness can there be?

Gurbani: ਪਿਰੁ ਰਲੀਆ ਰਸਿ ਮਾਣਸੀ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਨੇਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: pir raleea ras maanasee saach sabad sukh nehi |1| rahaau |
English: The Husband Lord enjoys her with pleasure and delight; she is at peace in the love of the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪਿਰੁ ਪਰਦੇਸੀ ਜੇ ਥੀਐ ਧਨ ਵਾਂਢੀ ਝੂਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: pir paradesee je theeai dhan vaandtee jhooree |
English: When the Husband goes away, the bride suffers in the pain of separation,

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਜਲਿ ਥੋੜੈ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਵ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: jiau jal thorrai machhulee karan palaav karee |
English: like the fish in shallow water, crying for mercy.

Gurbani: ਪਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: pir bhaavai sukh paaeeai jaa aape nadar karee |2|
English: As it pleases the Will of the Husband Lord, peace is obtained, when He Himself casts His Glance of Grace. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪਿਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: pir saalaahee aapanaa sakhee sahelee naal |
English: Praise your Husband Lord, together with your bridesmaids and friends.

Gurbani: ਤਨਿ ਸੋਹੈ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਰਤੀ ਰੰਗਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: tan sohai man mohiaa ratee rang nihaal |
English: The body is beautified, and the mind is fascinated. Imbued with His Love, we are enraptured.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ਸੋਹਣੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sabad savaaree sohanee pir raave gun naal |3|
English: Adorned with the Shabad, the beautiful bride enjoys her Husband with virtue. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਖੋਟੀ ਅਵਗਣਿਆਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: kaaman kaam na aavee khottee avaganiaar |
English: The soul-bride is of no use at all, if she is evil and without virtue.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪੇਈਐ ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਝੂਠਿ ਜਲੀ ਵੇਕਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: naa sukh peeeai saahurai jhootth jalee vekaar |
English: She does not find peace in this world or the next; she burns in falsehood and corruption.

Gurbani: ਆਵਣੁ ਵੰਞਣੁ ਡਾਖੜੋ ਛੋਡੀ ਕੰਤਿ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: aavan vanyan ddaakharro chhoddee kant visaar |4|
English: Coming and going are very difficult for that bride who is abandoned and forgotten by her Husband Lord. ||4||

Gurbani: ਪਿਰ ਕੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਮੁਤੀ ਸੋ ਕਿਤੁ ਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: pir kee naar suhaavanee mutee so kit saad |
English: The beautiful soul-bride of the Husband Lord-by what sensual pleasures has she been doomed?

Gurbani: ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਬੋਲੇ ਫਾਦਿਲੁ ਬਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: pir kai kaam na aavee bole faadil baad |
English: She is of no use to her Husband if she babbles in useless arguments.

Gurbani: ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਢੋਈ ਨਾ ਲਹੈ ਛੂਟੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਸਾਦਿ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: dar ghar dtoee naa lahai chhoottee doojai saad |5|
English: At the Door of His Home, she finds no shelter; she is discarded for seeking other pleasures. ||5||

Gurbani: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਵਾਚਹਿ ਪੋਥੀਆ ਨਾ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: panddit vaacheh potheea naa boojheh veechaar |
English: The Pandits, the religious scholars, read their books, but they do not understand the real meaning.

Gurbani: ਅਨ ਕਉ ਮਤੀ ਦੇ ਚਲਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: an kau matee de chaleh maaeaa kaa vaapaar |
English: They give instructions to others, and then walk away, but they deal in Maya themselves.

Gurbani: ਕਥਨੀ ਝੂਠੀ ਜਗੁ ਭਵੈ ਰਹਣੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: kathanee jhootthee jag bhavai rahanee sabad su saar |6|
English: Speaking falsehood, they wander around the world, while those who remain true to the Shabad are excellent and exalted. ||6||

Gurbani: ਕੇਤੇ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਜੋਤਕੀ ਬੇਦਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: kete panddit jotakee bedaa kareh beechaar |
English: There are so many Pandits and astrologers who ponder over the Vedas.

Gurbani: ਵਾਦਿ ਵਿਰੋਧਿ ਸਲਾਹਣੇ ਵਾਦੇ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: vaad virodh salaahane vaade aavan jaan |
English: They glorify their disputes and arguments, and in these controversies they continue coming and going.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਰਮ ਨ ਛੁਟਸੀ ਕਹਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੁ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: bin gur karam na chhuttasee keh sun aakh vakhaan |7|
English: Without the Guru, they are not released from their karma, although they speak and listen and preach and explain. ||7||

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਮੈ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabh gunavantee aakheeeh mai gun naahee koe |
English: They all call themselves virtuous, but I have no virtue at all.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਨਾਰਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਮੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: har var naar suhaavanee mai bhaavai prabh soe |
English: With the Lord as her Husband, the soul-bride is happy; I, too, love that God.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੜਾ ਨਾ ਵੇਛੋੜਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੮॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak sabad milaavarraa naa vechhorraa hoe |8|5|
English: O Nanak, through the Shabad, union is obtained; there is no more separation. ||8||5||

[Ang 56 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਾਧੀਐ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਕੀਚੈ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: jap tap sanjam saadheeai teerath keechai vaas |
English: You may chant and meditate, practice austerities and self-restraint, and dwell at sacred shrines of pilgrimage;

Gurbani: ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਕਿਆ ਤਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: pun daan changiaaeea bin saache kiaa taas |
English: you may give donations to charity, and perform good deeds, but without the True One, what is the use of it all?

Gurbani: ਜੇਹਾ ਰਾਧੇ ਤੇਹਾ ਲੁਣੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਜਨਮੁ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jehaa raadhe tehaa lunai bin gun janam vinaas |1|
English: As you plant, so shall you harvest. Without virtue, this human life passes away in vain. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੁੰਧੇ ਗੁਣ ਦਾਸੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: mundhe gun daasee sukh hoe |
English: O young bride, be a slave to virtue, and you shall find peace.

Gurbani: ਅਵਗਣ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: avagan tiaag samaaeeai guramat pooraa soe |1| rahaau |
English: Renouncing wrongful actions, following the Guru's Teachings, you shall be absorbed into the Perfect One. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਰਾਸੀ ਵਾਪਾਰੀਆ ਤਕੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: vin raasee vaapaareea take kunddaa chaar |
English: Without capital, the trader looks around in all four directions.

Gurbani: ਮੂਲੁ ਨ ਬੁਝੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਵਸਤੁ ਰਹੀ ਘਰ ਬਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: mool na bujhai aapanaa vasat rahee ghar baar |
English: He does not understand his own origins; the merchandise remains within the door of his own house.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਵਖਰ ਦੁਖੁ ਅਗਲਾ ਕੂੜਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: vin vakhar dukh agalaa koorr mutthee koorriaar |2|
English: Without this commodity, there is great pain. The false are ruined by falsehood. ||2||

Gurbani: ਲਾਹਾ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਉਤਨਾ ਪਰਖੇ ਰਤਨੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: laahaa ahinis nautanaa parakhe ratan veechaar |
English: One who contemplates and appraises this Jewel day and night reaps new profits.

Gurbani: ਵਸਤੁ ਲਹੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਚਲੈ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: vasat lahai ghar aapanai chalai kaaraj saar |
English: He finds the merchandise within his own home, and departs after arranging his affairs.

Gurbani: ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਸਿਉ ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: vanajaariaa siau vanaj kar guramukh braham beechaar |3|
English: So trade with the true traders, and as Gurmukh, contemplate God. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਾਂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: santaan sangat paaeeai je mele melanahaar |
English: In the Society of the Saints, He is found, if the Uniter unites us.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: miliaa hoe na vichhurrai jis antar jot apaar |
English: One whose heart is filled with His Infinite Light meets with Him, and shall never again be separated from Him.

Gurbani: ਸਚੈ ਆਸਣਿ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਸਚੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਰ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: sachai aasan sach rahai sachai prem piaar |4|
English: True is his position; he abides in Truth, with love and affection for the True One. ||4||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਸੁਥਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jinee aap pachhaaniaa ghar meh mehal suthaae |
English: One who understands himself finds the Mansion of the Lord's Presence within his own home.

Gurbani: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਸਚੋ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sache setee ratiaa sacho palai paae |
English: Imbued with the True Lord, Truth is gathered in.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਸਾਚੋ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: tribhavan so prabh jaaneeai saacho saachai naae |5|
English: God is known throughout the three worlds. True is the Name of the True One. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਖਰੀ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: saa dhan kharee suhaavanee jin pir jaataa sang |
English: The wife who knows that her Husband Lord is always with her is very beautiful.

Gurbani: ਮਹਲੀ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਈਐ ਸੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: mahalee mehal bulaaeeai so pir raave rang |
English: The soul-bride is called to the Mansion of the His Presence, and her Husband Lord ravishes her with love.

Gurbani: ਸਚਿ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਾ ਭਲੀ ਪਿਰਿ ਮੋਹੀ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗਿ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: sach suhaagan saa bhalee pir mohee gun sang |6|
English: The happy soul-bride is true and good; she is fascinated by the Glories of her Husband Lord. ||6||

Gurbani: ਭੂਲੀ ਭੂਲੀ ਥਲਿ ਚੜਾ ਥਲਿ ਚੜਿ ਡੂਗਰਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhoolee bhoolee thal charraa thal charr ddoogar jaau |
English: Wandering around and making mistakes, I climb the plateau; having climbed the plateau, I go up the mountain.

Gurbani: ਬਨ ਮਹਿ ਭੂਲੀ ਜੇ ਫਿਰਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ban meh bhoolee je firaa bin gur boojh na paau |
English: But now I have lost my way, and I am wandering around in the forest; without the Guru, I do not understand.

Gurbani: ਨਾਵਹੁ ਭੂਲੀ ਜੇ ਫਿਰਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਉ ਜਾਉ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: naavahu bhoolee je firaa fir fir aavau jaau |7|
English: If I wander around forgetting God's Name, I shall continue coming and going in reincarnation, over and over again. ||7||

Gurbani: ਪੁਛਹੁ ਜਾਇ ਪਧਾਊਆ ਚਲੇ ਚਾਕਰ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: puchhahu jaae padhaaooaa chale chaakar hoe |
English: Go and ask the travellers, how to walk on the Path as His slave.

Gurbani: ਰਾਜਨੁ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਠਾਕ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: raajan jaaneh aapanaa dar ghar tthaak na hoe |
English: They know the Lord to be their King, and at the Door to His Home, their way is not blocked.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੮॥੬॥
Transliteration: naanak eko rav rahiaa doojaa avar na koe |8|6|
English: O Nanak, the One is pervading everywhere; there is no other at all. ||8||6||

[Ang 57 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਦੇਹ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur te niramal jaaneeai niramal deh sareer |
English: Through the Guru, the Pure One is known, and the human body becomes pure as well.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਾਚੋ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਅਭ ਪੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: niramal saacho man vasai so jaanai abh peer |
English: The Pure, True Lord abides within the mind; He knows the pain of our hearts.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੈ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਅਗਲੋ ਨਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਜਮ ਤੀਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sahajai te sukh agalo naa laagai jam teer |1|
English: With intuitive ease, a great peace is found, and the arrow of death shall not strike you. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਮੈਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਲਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhaaee re mail naahee niramal jal naae |
English: O Siblings of Destiny, filth is washed away by bathing in the Pure Water of the Name.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਏਕੁ ਤੂ ਹੋਰੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੀ ਸਭ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: niramal saachaa ek too hor mail bharee sabh jaae |1| rahaau |
English: You alone are Perfectly Pure, O True Lord; all other places are filled with filth. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਸੋਹਣਾ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa mandar sohanaa keea karanaihaar |
English: The Temple of the Lord is beautiful; it was made by the Creator Lord.

Gurbani: ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਦੀਪ ਅਨੂਪ ਜੋਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: rav sas deep anoop jot tribhavan jot apaar |
English: The sun and the moon are lamps of incomparably beautiful light. Throughout the three worlds, the Infinite Light is pervading.

Gurbani: ਹਾਟ ਪਟਣ ਗੜ ਕੋਠੜੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਉਦਾ ਵਾਪਾਰ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: haatt pattan garr kottharree sach saudaa vaapaar |2|
English: In the shops of the city of the body, in the fortresses and in the huts, the True Merchandise is traded. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨਾ ਦੇਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: giaan anjan bhai bhanjanaa dekh niranjan bhaae |
English: The ointment of spiritual wisdom is the destroyer of fear; through love, the Pure One is seen.

Gurbani: ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਸਭ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਠਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gupat pragatt sabh jaaneeai je man raakhai tthaae |
English: The mysteries of the seen and the unseen are all known, if the mind is kept centered and balanced.

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aisaa satigur je milai taa sahaje le milaae |3|
English: If one finds such a True Guru, the Lord is met with intuitive ease. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਸਿ ਕਸਵਟੀ ਲਾਈਐ ਪਰਖੇ ਹਿਤੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kas kasavattee laaeeai parakhe hit chit laae |
English: He draws us to His Touchstone, to test our love and consciousness.

Gurbani: ਖੋਟੇ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੀ ਖਰੇ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: khotte tthaur na paaeinee khare khajaanai paae |
English: The counterfeit have no place there, but the genuine are placed in His Treasury.

Gurbani: ਆਸ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਇਉ ਮਲੁ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: aas andesaa door kar iau mal jaae samaae |4|
English: Let your hopes and anxieties depart; thus pollution is washed away. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਕਉ ਮਾਗੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਮਾਗੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sukh kau maagai sabh ko dukh na maagai koe |
English: Everyone begs for happiness; no one asks for suffering.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖੈ ਕਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਅਗਲਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sukhai kau dukh agalaa manamukh boojh na hoe |
English: But in the wake of happiness, there comes great suffering. The self-willed manmukhs do not understand this.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਭੇਦਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: sukh dukh sam kar jaaneeeh sabad bhed sukh hoe |5|
English: Those who see pain and pleasure as one and the same find peace; they are pierced through by the Shabad. ||5||

Gurbani: ਬੇਦੁ ਪੁਕਾਰੇ ਵਾਚੀਐ ਬਾਣੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਆਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: bed pukaare vaacheeai baanee braham biaas |
English: The Vedas proclaim, and the words of Vyaasa tell us,

Gurbani: ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਾਧਿਕਾ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: mun jan sevak saadhikaa naam rate gunataas |
English: that the silent sages, the servants of the Lord, and those who practice a life of spiritual discipline are attuned to the Naam, the Treasure of Excellence.

Gurbani: ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਜਿਣਿ ਗਏ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਸੁ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: sach rate se jin ge hau sad balihaarai jaas |6|
English: Those who are attuned to the True Name win the game of life; I am forever a sacrifice to them. ||6||

Gurbani: ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗਿ ਮੈਲੇ ਮਲੁ ਭਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: chahu jug maile mal bhare jin mukh naam na hoe |
English: Those who do not have the Naam in their mouths are filled with pollution; they are filthy throughout the four ages.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤੀ ਭਾਇ ਵਿਹੂਣਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਕਾਲਾ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhagatee bhaae vihooniaa muhu kaalaa pat khoe |
English: Without loving devotion to God, their faces are blackened, and their honor is lost.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਅਵਗਣ ਮੁਠੀ ਰੋਇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: jinee naam visaariaa avagan mutthee roe |7|
English: Those who have forgotten the Naam are plundered by evil; they weep and wail in dismay. ||7||

Gurbani: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਪਾਇਆ ਡਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: khojat khojat paaeaa ddar kar milai milaae |
English: I searched and searched, and found God. In the Fear of God, I have been united in His Union.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਘਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aap pachhaanai ghar vasai haumai trisanaa jaae |
English: Through self-realization, people dwell within the home of their inner being; egotism and desire depart.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਊਜਲੇ ਜੋ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥੮॥੭॥
Transliteration: naanak niramal aoojale jo raate har naae |8|7|
English: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Name of the Lord are immaculate and radiant. ||8||7||

[Ang 57 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਭੂਲੇ ਬਾਵਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: sun man bhoole baavare gur kee charanee laag |
English: Listen, O deluded and demented mind: hold tight to the Guru's Feet.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਜਮੁ ਡਰਪੈ ਦੁਖ ਭਾਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: har jap naam dhiaae too jam ddarapai dukh bhaag |
English: Chant and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; death will be afraid of you, and suffering shall depart.

Gurbani: ਦੂਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਕਿਉ ਥਿਰੁ ਰਹੈ ਸੁਹਾਗੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dookh ghano dohaaganee kiau thir rahai suhaag |1|
English: The deserted wife suffers terrible pain. How can her Husband Lord remain with her forever? ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੈ ਥਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhaaee re avar naahee mai thaau |
English: O Siblings of Destiny, I have no other place to go.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mai dhan naam nidhaan hai gur deea bal jaau |1| rahaau |
English: The Guru has given me the Treasure of the Wealth of the Naam; I am a sacrifice to Him. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: guramat pat saabaas tis tis kai sang milaau |
English: The Guru's Teachings bring honor. Blessed is He-may I meet and be with Him!

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਜੀਵਊ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tis bin gharree na jeevaoo bin naavai mar jaau |
English: Without Him, I cannot live, even for a moment. Without His Name, I die.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਟੇਕ ਟਿਕੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mai andhule naam na veesarai ttek ttikee ghar jaau |2|
English: I am blind-may I never forget the Naam! Under His Protection, I shall reach my true home. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੂ ਜਿਨਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਧੁਲਾ ਚੇਲੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਠਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: guroo jinaa kaa andhulaa chele naahee tthaau |
English: Those chaylaas, those devotees, whose spiritual teacher is blind, shall not find their place of rest.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਉ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਆ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
Transliteration: bin satigur naau na paaeeai bin naavai kiaa suaau |
English: Without the True Guru, the Name is not obtained. Without the Name, what is the use of it all?

Gurbani: ਆਇ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਣਾ ਜਿਉ ਸੁੰਞੈ ਘਰਿ ਕਾਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aae geaa pachhutaavanaa jiau sunyai ghar kaau |3|
English: People come and go, regretting and repenting, like crows in a deserted house. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਜਿਉ ਕਲਰ ਕੀ ਭੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: bin naavai dukh dehuree jiau kalar kee bheet |
English: Without the Name, the body suffers in pain; it crumbles like a wall of sand.

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਨ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: tab lag mehal na paaeeai jab lag saach na cheet |
English: As long as Truth does not enter into the consciousness, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is not found.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਪੈ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ਪਦੁ ਨੀਤਿ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: sabad rapai ghar paaeeai nirabaanee pad neet |4|
English: Attuned to the Shabad, we enter our home, and obtain the Eternal State of Nirvaanaa. ||4||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਛਉ ਆਪਣੇ ਗੁਰ ਪੁਛਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hau gur poochhau aapane gur puchh kaar kamaau |
English: I ask my Guru for His Advice, and I follow the Guru's Advice.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sabad salaahee man vasai haumai dukh jal jaau |
English: With the Shabads of Praise abiding in the mind, the pain of egotism is burnt away.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਮਿਲਾਵੜਾ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: sahaje hoe milaavarraa saache saach milaau |5|
English: We are intuitively united with Him, and we meet the Truest of the True. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਤਜਿ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sabad rate se niramale taj kaam krodh ahankaar |
English: Those who are attuned to the Shabad are spotless and pure; they renounce sexual desire, anger, selfishness and conceit.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: naam salaahan sad sadaa har raakheh ur dhaar |
English: They sing the Praises of the Naam, forever and ever; they keep the Lord enshrined within their hearts.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਸਭ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: so kiau manahu visaareeai sabh jeea kaa aadhaar |6|
English: How could we ever forget Him from our minds? He is the Support of all beings. ||6||

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਸੋ ਮਰਿ ਰਹੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਦੂਜੀ ਵਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: sabad marai so mar rahai fir marai na doojee vaar |
English: One who dies in the Shabad is beyond death, and shall never die again.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sabadai hee te paaeeai har naame lagai piaar |
English: Through the Shabad, we find Him, and embrace love for the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਜਗੁ ਭੂਲਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: bin sabadai jag bhoolaa firai mar janamai vaaro vaar |7|
English: Without the Shabad, the world is deceived; it dies and is reborn, over and over again. ||7||

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਸਾਲਾਹੈ ਆਪ ਕਉ ਵਡਹੁ ਵਡੇਰੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabh saalaahai aap kau vaddahu vadderee hoe |
English: All praise themselves, and call themselves the greatest of the great.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੀਐ ਕਹੇ ਸੁਣੇ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur bin aap na cheeneeai kahe sune kiaa hoe |
English: Without the Guru, one's self cannot be known. By merely speaking and listening, what is accomplished?

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੮॥੮॥
Transliteration: naanak sabad pachhaaneeai haumai karai na koe |8|8|
English: O Nanak, one who realizes the Shabad does not act in egotism. ||8||8||

[Ang 58 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਧਨ ਸੀਗਾਰੀਐ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਬਾਦਿ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: bin pir dhan seegaareeai joban baad khuaar |
English: Without her Husband, the soul-bride's youth and ornaments are useless and wretched.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਮਾਣੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੇਜੜੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਬਾਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: naa maane sukh sejarree bin pir baad seegaar |
English: She does not enjoy the pleasure of His Bed; without her Husband, her ornaments are absurd.

Gurbani: ਦੂਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਨਾ ਘਰਿ ਸੇਜ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dookh ghano dohaaganee naa ghar sej bhataar |1|
English: The discarded bride suffers terrible pain; her Husband does not come to the bed of her home. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਜਪਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: man re raam japahu sukh hoe |
English: O mind, meditate on the Lord, and find peace.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bin gur prem na paaeeai sabad milai rang hoe |1| rahaau |
English: Without the Guru, love is not found. United with the Shabad, happiness is found. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur sevaa sukh paaeeai har var sehaj seegaar |
English: Serving the Guru, she finds peace, and her Husband Lord adorns her with intuitive wisdom.

Gurbani: ਸਚਿ ਮਾਣੇ ਪਿਰ ਸੇਜੜੀ ਗੂੜਾ ਹੇਤੁ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sach maane pir sejarree goorraa het piaar |
English: Truly, she enjoys the Bed of her Husband, through her deep love and affection.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣਿ ਸਿਞਾਣੀਐ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਗੁਣ ਚਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: guramukh jaan siyaaneeai gur melee gun chaar |2|
English: As Gurmukh, she comes to know Him. Meeting with the Guru, she maintains a virtuous lifestyle. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਵਰ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਪਿਰਿ ਮੋਹੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sach milahu var kaamanee pir mohee rang laae |
English: Through Truth, meet your Husband Lord, O soul-bride. Enchanted by your Husband, enshrine love for Him.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਵਿਗਸਿਆ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man tan saach vigasiaa keemat kehan na jaae |
English: Your mind and body shall blossom forth in Truth. The value of this cannot be described.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har var ghar sohaaganee niramal saachai naae |3|
English: The soul-bride finds her Husband Lord in the home of her own being; she is purified by the True Name. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੈ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: man meh manooaa je marai taa pir raavai naar |
English: If the mind within the mind dies, then the Husband ravishes and enjoys His bride.

Gurbani: ਇਕਤੁ ਤਾਗੈ ਰਲਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਗਲਿ ਮੋਤੀਅਨ ਕਾ ਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: eikat taagai ral milai gal moteean kaa haar |
English: They are woven into one texture, like pearls on a necklace around the neck.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: sant sabhaa sukh aoopajai guramukh naam adhaar |4|
English: In the Society of the Saints, peace wells up; the Gurmukhs take the Support of the Naam. ||4||

Gurbani: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਖਿਨਿ ਖਪੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਆਵੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: khin meh upajai khin khapai khin aavai khin jaae |
English: In an instant, one is born, and in an instant, one dies. In an instant one comes, and in an instant one goes.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੈ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਸੰਤਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabad pachhaanai rav rahai naa tis kaal santaae |
English: One who recognizes the Shabad merges into it, and is not afflicted by death.

Gurbani: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਨ ਤੋਲੀਐ ਕਥਨਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: saahib atul na toleeai kathan na paaeaa jaae |5|
English: Our Lord and Master is Unweighable; He cannot be weighed. He cannot be found merely by talking. ||5||

Gurbani: ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਆਏ ਵਜਹੁ ਲਿਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: vaapaaree vanajaariaa aae vajahu likhaae |
English: The merchants and the traders have come; their profits are pre-ordained.

Gurbani: ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਚ ਕੀ ਲਾਹਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kaar kamaaveh sach kee laahaa milai rajaae |
English: Those who practice Truth reap the profits, abiding in the Will of God.

Gurbani: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਾਚੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: poonjee saachee gur milai naa tis til na tamaae |6|
English: With the Merchandise of Truth, they meet the Guru, who does not have a trace of greed. ||6||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤੋਲਿ ਤੋੁਲਾਇਸੀ ਸਚੁ ਤਰਾਜੀ ਤੋਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh tol tuolaaeisee sach taraajee tol |
English: As Gurmukh, they are weighed and measured, in the balance and the scales of Truth.

Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਠਾਕੀ ਸਚੁ ਬੋਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa manasaa mohanee gur tthaakee sach bol |
English: The enticements of hope and desire are quieted by the Guru, whose Word is True.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਤੁਲਾਏ ਤੋਲਸੀ ਪੂਰੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਤੋਲੁ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: aap tulaae tolasee poore pooraa tol |7|
English: He Himself weighs with the scale; perfect is the weighing of the Perfect One. ||7||

Gurbani: ਕਥਨੈ ਕਹਣਿ ਨ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਨਾ ਪੜਿ ਪੁਸਤਕ ਭਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: kathanai kehan na chhutteeai naa parr pusatak bhaar |
English: No one is saved by mere talk and speech, nor by reading loads of books.

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਸੋਚ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਿਆਰ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa soch na paaeeai bin har bhagat piaar |
English: The body does not obtain purity without loving devotion to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੮॥੯॥
Transliteration: naanak naam na veesarai mele gur karataar |8|9|
English: O Nanak, never forget the Naam; the Guru shall unite us with the Creator. ||8||9||

[Ang 59 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਰਤਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: satigur pooraa je milai paaeeai ratan beechaar |
English: Meeting the Perfect True Guru, we find the jewel of meditative reflection.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਰਬ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: man deejai gur aapane paaeeai sarab piaar |
English: Surrendering our minds to our Guru, we find universal love.

Gurbani: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਵਗਣ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mukat padaarath paaeeai avagan mettanahaar |1|
English: We find the wealth of liberation, and our demerits are erased. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhaaee re gur bin giaan na hoe |
English: O Siblings of Destiny, without the Guru, there is no spiritual wisdom.

Gurbani: ਪੂਛਹੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਨਾਰਦੈ ਬੇਦ ਬਿਆਸੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
