Transliteration: poochhahu brahame naaradai bed biaasai koe |1| rahaau |
English: Go and ask Brahma, Naarad and Vyaas, the writer of the Vedas. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧੁਨਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: giaan dhiaan dhun jaaneeai akath kahaavai soe |
English: Know that from the vibration of the Word, we obtain spiritual wisdom and meditation. Through it, we speak the Unspoken.

Gurbani: ਸਫਲਿਓ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਹਰੀਆਵਲਾ ਛਾਵ ਘਣੇਰੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: safalio birakh hareeaavalaa chhaav ghaneree hoe |
English: He is the fruit-bearing Tree, luxuriantly green with abundant shade.

Gurbani: ਲਾਲ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਮਾਣਕੀ ਗੁਰ ਭੰਡਾਰੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: laal javehar maanakee gur bhanddaarai soe |2|
English: The rubies, jewels and emeralds are in the Guru's Treasury. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਭੰਡਾਰੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur bhanddaarai paaeeai niramal naam piaar |
English: From the Guru's Treasury, we receive the Love of the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੋ ਵਖਰੁ ਸੰਚੀਐ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: saacho vakhar sancheeai poorai karam apaar |
English: We gather in the True Merchandise, through the Perfect Grace of the Infinite.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਦੁਖ ਮੇਟਣੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਸੁਰ ਸੰਘਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sukhadaataa dukh mettano satigur asur sanghaar |3|
English: The True Guru is the Giver of peace, the Dispeller of pain, the Destroyer of demons. ||3||

Gurbani: ਭਵਜਲੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਡਰਾਵਣੋ ਨਾ ਕੰਧੀ ਨਾ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: bhavajal bikham ddaraavano naa kandhee naa paar |
English: The terrifying world-ocean is difficult and dreadful; there is no shore on this side or the one beyond.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਬੇੜੀ ਨਾ ਤੁਲਹੜਾ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਵੰਝੁ ਮਲਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: naa berree naa tulaharraa naa tis vanjh malaar |
English: There is no boat, no raft, no oars and no boatman.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੈ ਕਾ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: satigur bhai kaa bohithaa nadaree paar utaar |4|
English: The True Guru is the only boat on this terrifying ocean. His Glance of Grace carries us across. ||4||

Gurbani: ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: eik til piaaraa visarai dukh laagai sukh jaae |
English: If I forget my Beloved, even for an instant, suffering overtakes me and peace departs.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਜਲਉ ਜਲਾਵਣੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਪੈ ਰਸਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jihavaa jlau jalaavanee naam na japai rasaae |
English: Let that tongue be burnt in flames, which does not chant the Naam with love.

Gurbani: ਘਟੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਅਗਲੋ ਜਮੁ ਪਕੜੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: ghatt binasai dukh agalo jam pakarrai pachhutaae |5|
English: When the pitcher of the body bursts, there is terrible pain; those who are caught by the Minister of Death regret and repent. ||5||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਗਏ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਕਲਤੁ ਨ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
Transliteration: meree meree kar ge tan dhan kalat na saath |
English: Crying out, "Mine! Mine!", they have departed, but their bodies, their wealth, and their wives did not go with them.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਧਨੁ ਬਾਦਿ ਹੈ ਭੂਲੋ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਆਥਿ ॥
Transliteration: bin naavai dhan baad hai bhoolo maarag aath |
English: Without the Name, wealth is useless; deceived by wealth, they have lost their way.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਉ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਕਥੋ ਕਾਥਿ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: saachau saahib seveeai guramukh akatho kaath |6|
English: So serve the True Lord; become Gurmukh, and speak the Unspoken. ||6||

Gurbani: ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਭਵਾਈਐ ਪਇਐ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aavai jaae bhavaaeeai peiai kirat kamaae |
English: Coming and going, people wander through reincarnation; they act according to their past actions.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਿਉ ਮੇਟੀਐ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: poorab likhiaa kiau metteeai likhiaa lekh rajaae |
English: How can one's pre-ordained destiny be erased? It is written in accordance with the Lord's Will.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: bin har naam na chhutteeai guramat milai milaae |7|
English: Without the Name of the Lord, no one can be saved. Through the Guru's Teachings, we are united in His Union. ||7||

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਜੀਉ ਪਰਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: tis bin meraa ko nahee jis kaa jeeo paraan |
English: Without Him, I have no one to call my own. My soul and my breath of life belong to Him.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਜਲਿ ਬਲਉ ਲੋਭੁ ਜਲਉ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: haumai mamataa jal blau lobh jlau abhimaan |
English: May my egotism and possessiveness be burnt to ashes, and my greed and egotistical pride consigned to the fire.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੮॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: naanak sabad veechaareeai paaeeai gunee nidhaan |8|10|
English: O Nanak, contemplating the Shabad, the Treasure of Excellence is obtained. ||8||10||

[Ang 59 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਐਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੈਸੀ ਜਲ ਕਮਲੇਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: re man aisee har siau preet kar jaisee jal kamalehi |
English: O mind, love the Lord, as the lotus loves the water.

Gurbani: ਲਹਰੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਛਾੜੀਐ ਭੀ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਅਸਨੇਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: laharee naal pachhaarreeai bhee vigasai asanehi |
English: Tossed about by the waves, it still blossoms with love.

Gurbani: ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਜੀਅ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਮਰਣੁ ਤਿਨੇਹਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jal meh jeea upaae kai bin jal maran tinehi |1|
English: In the water, the creatures are created; outside of the water they die. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਕਿਉ ਛੂਟਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਆਰ ॥
Transliteration: man re kiau chhootteh bin piaar |
English: O mind, how can you be saved without love?

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਖਸੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh antar rav rahiaa bakhase bhagat bhanddaar |1| rahaau |
English: God permeates the inner beings of the Gurmukhs. They are blessed with the treasure of devotion. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਐਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੈਸੀ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਨੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: re man aisee har siau preet kar jaisee machhulee neer |
English: O mind, love the Lord, as the fish loves the water.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਅਧਿਕਉ ਤਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: jiau adhikau tiau sukh ghano man tan saant sareer |
English: The more the water, the more the happiness, and the greater the peace of mind and body.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਜੀਵਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਅਭ ਪੀਰ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bin jal gharree na jeevee prabh jaanai abh peer |2|
English: Without water, she cannot live, even for an instant. God knows the suffering of her mind. ||2||

Gurbani: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਐਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੈਸੀ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਮੇਹ ॥
Transliteration: re man aisee har siau preet kar jaisee chaatrik meh |
English: O mind, love the Lord, as the song-bird loves the rain.

Gurbani: ਸਰ ਭਰਿ ਥਲ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੇ ਇਕ ਬੂੰਦ ਨ ਪਵਈ ਕੇਹ ॥
Transliteration: sar bhar thal hareeaavale ik boond na pavee keh |
English: The pools are overflowing with water, and the land is luxuriantly green, but what are they to her, if that single drop of rain does not fall into her mouth?

Gurbani: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਪਇਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਦੇਹ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: karam milai so paaeeai kirat peaa sir deh |3|
English: By His Grace, she receives it; otherwise, because of her past actions, she gives her head. ||3||

Gurbani: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਐਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੈਸੀ ਜਲ ਦੁਧ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: re man aisee har siau preet kar jaisee jal dudh hoe |
English: O mind, love the Lord, as the water loves the milk.

Gurbani: ਆਵਟਣੁ ਆਪੇ ਖਵੈ ਦੁਧ ਕਉ ਖਪਣਿ ਨ ਦੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: aavattan aape khavai dudh kau khapan na dee |
English: The water, added to the milk, itself bears the heat, and prevents the milk from burning.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ਸਚਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: aape mel vichhuniaa sach vaddiaaee dee |4|
English: God unites the separated ones with Himself again, and blesses them with true greatness. ||4||

Gurbani: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਐਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੈਸੀ ਚਕਵੀ ਸੂਰ ॥
Transliteration: re man aisee har siau preet kar jaisee chakavee soor |
English: O mind, love the Lord, as the chakvee duck loves the sun.

Gurbani: ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਸੋਵਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: khin pal need na sovee jaanai door hajoor |
English: She does not sleep, for an instant or a moment; the sun is so far away, but she thinks that it is near.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: manamukh sojhee naa pavai guramukh sadaa hajoor |5|
English: Understanding does not come to the self-willed manmukh. But to the Gurmukh, the Lord is always close. ||5||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਗਣਤ ਗਣਾਵਣੀ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh ganat ganaavanee karataa kare su hoe |
English: The self-willed manmukhs make their calculations and plans, but only the actions of the Creator come to pass.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: taa kee keemat naa pavai je lochai sabh koe |
English: His Value cannot be estimated, even though everyone may wish to do so.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: guramat hoe ta paaeeai sach milai sukh hoe |6|
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, it is revealed. Meeting with the True One, peace is found. ||6||

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਨ ਤੁਟਈ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa nehu na tuttee je satigur bhettai soe |
English: True love shall not be broken, if the True Guru is met.

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: giaan padaarath paaeeai tribhavan sojhee hoe |
English: Obtaining the wealth of spiritual wisdom, the understanding of the three worlds is acquired.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਕਾ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: niramal naam na veesarai je gun kaa gaahak hoe |7|
English: So become a customer of merit, and do not forget the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||7||

Gurbani: ਖੇਲਿ ਗਏ ਸੇ ਪੰਖਣੂੰ ਜੋ ਚੁਗਦੇ ਸਰ ਤਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: khel ge se pankhanoon jo chugade sar tal |
English: Those birds which peck at the shore of the pool have played and have departed.

Gurbani: ਘੜੀ ਕਿ ਮੁਹਤਿ ਕਿ ਚਲਣਾ ਖੇਲਣੁ ਅਜੁ ਕਿ ਕਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: gharree ki muhat ki chalanaa khelan aj ki kal |
English: In a moment, in an instant, we too must depart. Our play is only for today or tomorrow.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਾਇ ਸਚਾ ਪਿੜੁ ਮਲਿ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: jis toon meleh so milai jaae sachaa pirr mal |8|
English: But those whom You unite, Lord, are united with You; they obtain a seat in the Arena of Truth. ||8||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin gur preet na aoopajai haumai mail na jaae |
English: Without the Guru, love does not well up, and the filth of egotism does not depart.

Gurbani: ਸੋਹੰ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਭੇਦਿ ਪਤੀਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: sohan aap pachhaaneeai sabad bhed pateeae |
English: One who recognizes within himself that, "He is me", and who is pierced through by the Shabad, is satisfied.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਅਵਰ ਕਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: guramukh aap pachhaaneeai avar ki kare karaae |9|
English: When one becomes Gurmukh and realizes his own self, what more is there left to do or have done? ||9||

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਮੇਲੀਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਤੀਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: miliaa kaa kiaa meleeai sabad mile pateeae |
English: Why speak of union to those who are already united with the Lord? Receiving the Shabad, they are satisfied.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਵੀਛੁੜਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh sojhee naa pavai veechhurr chottaa khaae |
English: The self-willed manmukhs do not understand; separated from Him, they endure beatings.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜੀ ਜਾਇ ॥੧੦॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: naanak dar ghar ek hai avar na doojee jaae |10|11|
English: O Nanak, there is only the one door to His Home; there is no other place at all. ||10||11||

[Ang 60 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਭੁਲੈ ਭੁਲਾਈਐ ਭੂਲੀ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਕਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh bhulai bhulaaeeai bhoolee tthaur na kaae |
English: The self-willed manmukhs wander around, deluded and deceived. They find no place of rest.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋ ਨ ਦਿਖਾਵਈ ਅੰਧੀ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur bin ko na dikhaavee andhee aavai jaae |
English: Without the Guru, no one is shown the Way. Like the blind, they continue coming and going.

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਖੋਇਆ ਠਗਿਆ ਮੁਠਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: giaan padaarath khoeaa tthagiaa mutthaa jaae |1|
English: Having lost the treasure of spiritual wisdom, they depart, defrauded and plundered. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਾਬਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: baabaa maaeaa bharam bhulaae |
English: O Baba, Maya deceives with its illusion.

Gurbani: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੀ ਡੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਨਾ ਪਿਰ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bharam bhulee ddohaaganee naa pir ank samaae |1| rahaau |
English: Deceived by doubt, the discarded bride is not received into the Lap of her Beloved. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਭੂਲੀ ਫਿਰੈ ਦਿਸੰਤਰੀ ਭੂਲੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਤਜਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhoolee firai disantaree bhoolee grihu taj jaae |
English: The deceived bride wanders around in foreign lands; she leaves, and abandons her own home.

Gurbani: ਭੂਲੀ ਡੂੰਗਰਿ ਥਲਿ ਚੜੈ ਭਰਮੈ ਮਨੁ ਡੋਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhoolee ddoongar thal charrai bharamai man ddolaae |
English: Deceived, she climbs the plateaus and mountains; her mind wavers in doubt.

Gurbani: ਧੁਰਹੁ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੀ ਕਿਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਗਰਬਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: dhurahu vichhunee kiau milai garab mutthee bilalaae |2|
English: Separated from the Primal Being, how can she meet with Him again? Plundered by pride, she cries out and bewails. ||2||

Gurbani: ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਨਾਮ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: vichhurriaa gur melasee har ras naam piaar |
English: The Guru unites the separated ones with the Lord again, through the love of the Delicious Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਘਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: saach sehaj sobhaa ghanee har gun naam adhaar |
English: Through truth and intuitive poise, great honor is obtained, with the Support of the Naam and the Glory of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਖੁ ਤੂੰ ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਵਨੁ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jiau bhaavai tiau rakh toon mai tujh bin kavan bhataar |3|
English: As it pleases You, Lord, please save and protect me. Without You, O my Husband Lord, who else is there for me? ||3||

Gurbani: ਅਖਰ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਭੁਲੀਐ ਭੇਖੀ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: akhar parr parr bhuleeai bhekhee bahut abhimaan |
English: Reading their books over and over again, people continue making mistakes; they are so proud of their religious robes.

Gurbani: ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: teerath naataa kiaa kare man meh mail gumaan |
English: But what is the use of bathing at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, when the filth of stubborn pride is within the mind?

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਨਿ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਸੁਲਤਾਨੁ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: gur bin kin samajhaaeeai man raajaa sulataan |4|
English: Other than the Guru, who can explain that within the mind is the Lord, the King, the Emperor? ||4||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: prem padaarath paaeeai guramukh tat veechaar |
English: The Treasure of the Lord's Love is obtained by the Gurmukh, who contemplates the essence of reality.

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: saa dhan aap gavaaeaa gur kai sabad seegaar |
English: The bride eradicates her selfishness, and adorns herself with the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਸੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: ghar hee so pir paaeaa gur kai het apaar |5|
English: Within her own home, she finds her Husband, through infinite love for the Guru. ||5||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur kee sevaa chaakaree man niramal sukh hoe |
English: Applying oneself to the service of the Guru, the mind is purified, and peace is obtained.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਖੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa sabad man vasiaa haumai vichahu khoe |
English: The Word of the Guru's Shabad abides within the mind, and egotism is eliminated from within.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਲਾਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: naam padaarath paaeaa laabh sadaa man hoe |6|
English: The Treasure of the Naam is acquired, and the mind reaps the lasting profit. ||6||

Gurbani: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਆਪਿ ਨ ਲਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: karam milai taa paaeeai aap na leaa jaae |
English: If He grants His Grace, then we obtain it. We cannot find it by our own efforts.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਗਿ ਰਹੁ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur kee charanee lag rahu vichahu aap gavaae |
English: Remain attached to the Feet of the Guru, and eradicate selfishness from within.

Gurbani: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਸਚੋ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: sache setee ratiaa sacho palai paae |7|
English: Attuned to Truth, you shall obtain the True One. ||7||

Gurbani: ਭੁਲਣ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਅਭੁਲੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: bhulan andar sabh ko abhul guroo karataar |
English: Everyone makes mistakes; only the Guru and the Creator are infallible.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ ਲਾਗਾ ਤਿਸੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramat man samajhaaeaa laagaa tisai piaar |
English: One who instructs his mind with the Guru's Teachings comes to embrace love for the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੮॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: naanak saach na veesarai mele sabad apaar |8|12|
English: O Nanak, do not forget the Truth; you shall receive the Infinite Word of the Shabad. ||8||12||

[Ang 61 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪ ਘਰ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: trisanaa maaeaa mohanee sut bandhap ghar naar |
English: The enticing desire for Maya leads people to become emotionally attached to their children, relatives, households and spouses.

Gurbani: ਧਨਿ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਜਗੁ ਠਗਿਆ ਲਬਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: dhan joban jag tthagiaa lab lobh ahankaar |
English: The world is deceived and plundered by riches, youth, greed and egotism.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹ ਠਗਉਲੀ ਹਉ ਮੁਈ ਸਾ ਵਰਤੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: moh tthgaulee hau muee saa varatai sansaar |1|
English: The drug of emotional attachment has destroyed me, as it has destroyed the whole world. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਾ ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: mere preetamaa mai tujh bin avar na koe |
English: O my Beloved, I have no one except You.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ਤੂੰ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mai tujh bin avar na bhaavee toon bhaaveh sukh hoe |1| rahaau |
English: Without You, nothing else pleases me. Loving You, I am at peace. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: naam saalaahee rang siau gur kai sabad santokh |
English: I sing the Praises of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, with love; I am content with the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਚਲਸੀ ਕੂੜਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਨ ਵੇਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: jo deesai so chalasee koorraa mohu na vekh |
English: Whatever is seen shall pass away. So do not be attached to this false show.

Gurbani: ਵਾਟ ਵਟਾਊ ਆਇਆ ਨਿਤ ਚਲਦਾ ਸਾਥੁ ਦੇਖੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: vaatt vattaaoo aaeaa nit chaladaa saath dekh |2|
English: Like a traveller in his travels, you have come. Behold the caravan leaving each day. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਖਣਿ ਆਖਹਿ ਕੇਤੜੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aakhan aakheh ketarre gur bin boojh na hoe |
English: Many preach sermons, but without the Guru, understanding is not obtained.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚਿ ਰਪੈ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: naam vaddaaee je milai sach rapai pat hoe |
English: If someone receives the Glory of the Naam, he is attuned to truth and blessed with honor.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਭਲੇ ਖੋਟਾ ਖਰਾ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jo tudh bhaaveh se bhale khottaa kharaa na koe |3|
English: Those who are pleasing to You are good; no one is counterfeit or genuine. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਖੋਟੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: gur saranaaee chhutteeai manamukh khottee raas |
English: In the Guru's Sanctuary we are saved. The assets of the self-willed manmukhs are false.

Gurbani: ਅਸਟ ਧਾਤੁ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਕੀ ਘੜੀਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਿਗਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: asatt dhaat paatisaah kee gharreeai sabad vigaas |
English: The eight metals of the King are made into coins by the Word of His Shabad.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਪਰਖੇ ਪਾਰਖੂ ਪਵੈ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: aape parakhe paarakhoo pavai khajaanai raas |4|
English: The Assayer Himself assays them, and He places the genuine ones in His Treasury. ||4||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਸਭ ਡਿਠੀ ਠੋਕਿ ਵਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: teree keemat naa pavai sabh dditthee tthok vajaae |
English: Your Value cannot be appraised; I have seen and tested everything.

Gurbani: ਕਹਣੈ ਹਾਥ ਨ ਲਭਈ ਸਚਿ ਟਿਕੈ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kahanai haath na labhee sach ttikai pat paae |
English: By speaking, His Depth cannot be found. Abiding in truth, honor is obtained.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: guramat toon saalaahanaa hor keemat kehan na jaae |5|
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, I praise You; otherwise, I cannot describe Your Value. ||5||

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਾਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: jit tan naam na bhaavee tith tan haumai vaad |
English: That body which does not appreciate the Naam-that body is infested with egotism and conflict.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਸਾਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur bin giaan na paaeeai bikhiaa doojaa saad |
English: Without the Guru, spiritual wisdom is not obtained; other tastes are poison.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਮਾਇਆ ਫੀਕਾ ਸਾਦੁ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: bin gun kaam na aavee maaeaa feekaa saad |6|
English: Without virtue, nothing is of any use. The taste of Maya is bland and insipid. ||6||

Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜੰਮਿਆ ਆਸਾ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa andar jamiaa aasaa ras kas khaae |
English: Through desire, people are cast into the womb and reborn. Through desire, they taste the sweet and sour flavors.

Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਬੰਧਿ ਚਲਾਈਐ ਮੁਹੇ ਮੁਹਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa bandh chalaaeeai muhe muhi chottaa khaae |
English: Bound by desire, they are led on, beaten and struck on their faces and mouths.

Gurbani: ਅਵਗਣਿ ਬਧਾ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਛੂਟੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: avagan badhaa maareeai chhoottai guramat naae |7|
English: Bound and gagged and assaulted by evil, they are released only through the Name, through the Guru's Teachings. ||7||

Gurbani: ਸਰਬੇ ਥਾਈ ਏਕੁ ਤੂੰ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: sarabe thaaee ek toon jiau bhaavai tiau raakh |
English: In all places, You are the One and Only. As it pleases You, Lord, please save and protect me!

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਲੋ ਪਤਿ ਸਾਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramat saachaa man vasai naam bhalo pat saakh |
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, the True One abides within the mind. The Companionship of the Naam brings the most excellent honor.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚੁ ਭਾਖੁ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: haumai rog gavaaeeai sabad sachai sach bhaakh |8|
English: Eradicate the disease of egotism, and chant the True Shabad, the Word of the True Lord. ||8||

Gurbani: ਆਕਾਸੀ ਪਾਤਾਲਿ ਤੂੰ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aakaasee paataal toon tribhavan rahiaa samaae |
English: You are pervading throughout the Akaashic Ethers, the nether regions and the three worlds.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤੀ ਭਾਉ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aape bhagatee bhaau toon aape mileh milaae |
English: You Yourself are bhakti, loving devotional worship. You Yourself unite us in Union with Yourself.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੯॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: naanak naam na veesarai jiau bhaavai tivai rajaae |9|13|
English: O Nanak, may I never forget the Naam! As is Your Pleasure, so is Your Will. ||9||13||

[Ang 62 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਿ ਕਰੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam man bedhiaa avar ki karee veechaar |
English: My mind is pierced through by the Name of the Lord. What else should I contemplate?

Gurbani: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਤਉ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sabad surat sukh aoopajai prabh raatau sukh saar |
English: Focusing your awareness on the Shabad, happiness wells up. Attuned to God, the most excellent peace is found.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖੁ ਤੂੰ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jiau bhaavai tiau raakh toon mai har naam adhaar |1|
English: As it pleases You, please save me, Lord. The Name of the Lord is my Support. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਾਚੀ ਖਸਮ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man re saachee khasam rajaae |
English: O mind, the Will of our Lord and Master is true.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਜਿ ਸੀਗਾਰਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jin tan man saaj seegaariaa tis setee liv laae |1| rahaau |
English: Focus your love upon the One who created and adorned your body and mind. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਬੈਸੰਤਰਿ ਹੋਮੀਐ ਇਕ ਰਤੀ ਤੋਲਿ ਕਟਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: tan baisantar homeeai ik ratee tol kattaae |
English: If I cut my body into pieces, and burn them in the fire,

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਧਾ ਜੇ ਕਰੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: tan man samadhaa je karee anadin agan jalaae |
English: and if I make my body and mind into firewood, and night and day burn them in the fire,

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਪੁਜਈ ਜੇ ਲਖ ਕੋਟੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har naamai tul na pujee je lakh kottee karam kamaae |2|
English: and if I perform hundreds of thousands and millions of religious rituals-still, all these are not equal to the Name of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਰਧ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਕਟਾਈਐ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਵਤੁ ਧਰਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aradh sareer kattaaeeai sir karavat dharaae |
English: If my body were cut in half, if a saw was put to my head,

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਹੈਮੰਚਲਿ ਗਾਲੀਐ ਭੀ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: tan haimanchal gaaleeai bhee man te rog na jaae |
English: and if my body were frozen in the Himalayas-even then, my mind would not be free of disease.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਪੁਜਈ ਸਭ ਡਿਠੀ ਠੋਕਿ ਵਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har naamai tul na pujee sabh dditthee tthok vajaae |3|
English: None of these are equal to the Name of the Lord. I have seen and tried and tested them all. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕੰਚਨ ਕੇ ਕੋਟ ਦਤੁ ਕਰੀ ਬਹੁ ਹੈਵਰ ਗੈਵਰ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: kanchan ke kott dat karee bahu haivar gaivar daan |
English: If I made a donation of castles of gold, and gave lots of fine horses and wondrous elephants in charity,

Gurbani: ਭੂਮਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਗਊਆ ਘਣੀ ਭੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗਰਬੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: bhoom daan gaooaa ghanee bhee antar garab gumaan |
English: and if I made donations of land and cows-even then, pride and ego would still be within me.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਸਚੁ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: raam naam man bedhiaa gur deea sach daan |4|
English: The Name of the Lord has pierced my mind; the Guru has given me this true gift. ||4||

Gurbani: ਮਨਹਠ ਬੁਧੀ ਕੇਤੀਆ ਕੇਤੇ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: manahatth budhee keteea kete bed beechaar |
English: There are so many stubborn-minded intelligent people, and so many who contemplate the Vedas.

Gurbani: ਕੇਤੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਜੀਅ ਕੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
Transliteration: kete bandhan jeea ke guramukh mokh duaar |
English: There are so many entanglements for the soul. Only as Gurmukh do we find the Gate of Liberation.

Gurbani: ਸਚਹੁ ਓਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਉਪਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਆਚਾਰੁ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: sachahu orai sabh ko upar sach aachaar |5|
English: Truth is higher than everything; but higher still is truthful living. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਊਚਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਨੀਚੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabh ko aoochaa aakheeai neech na deesai koe |
English: Call everyone exalted; no one seems lowly.

Gurbani: ਇਕਨੈ ਭਾਂਡੇ ਸਾਜਿਐ ਇਕੁ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: eikanai bhaandde saajiai ik chaanan tihu loe |
English: The One Lord has fashioned the vessels, and His One Light pervades the three worlds.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਧੁਰਿ ਬਖਸ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: karam milai sach paaeeai dhur bakhas na mettai koe |6|
English: Receiving His Grace, we obtain Truth. No one can erase His Primal Blessing. ||6||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨੈ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਵਸੈ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: saadh milai saadhoo janai santokh vasai gur bhaae |
English: When one Holy person meets another Holy person, they abide in contentment, through the Love of the Guru.

Gurbani: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: akath kathaa veechaareeai je satigur maeh samaae |
English: They contemplate the Unspoken Speech, merging in absorption in the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਪੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖਿਆ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: pee amrit santokhiaa darageh paidhaa jaae |7|
English: Drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar, they are contented; they go to the Court of the Lord in robes of honor. ||7||

Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਵਾਜੈ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt vaajai kinguree anadin sabad subhaae |
English: In each and every heart the Music of the Lord's Flute vibrates, night and day, with sublime love for the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕਉ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: virale kau sojhee pee guramukh man samajhaae |
English: Only those few who become Gurmukh understand this by instructing their minds.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਛੂਟੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੮॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: naanak naam na veesarai chhoottai sabad kamaae |8|14|
English: O Nanak, do not forget the Naam. Practicing the Shabad you shall be saved. ||8||14||

[Ang 62 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਚਿਤੇ ਦਿਸਹਿ ਧਉਲਹਰ ਬਗੇ ਬੰਕ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
Transliteration: chite diseh dhaulahar bage bank duaar |
English: There are painted mansions to behold, white-washed, with beautiful doors;

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਮਨ ਖੁਸੀ ਉਸਾਰਿਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: kar man khusee usaariaa doojai het piaar |
English: they were constructed to give pleasure to the mind, but this is only for the sake of the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਖਾਲੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਢਹਿ ਢੇਰੀ ਤਨੁ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: andar khaalee prem bin dteh dteree tan chhaar |1|
English: The inner being is empty without love. The body shall crumble into a heap of ashes. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhaaee re tan dhan saath na hoe |
English: O Siblings of Destiny, this body and wealth shall not go along with you.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam dhan niramalo gur daat kare prabh soe |1| rahaau |
English: The Lord's Name is the pure wealth; through the Guru, God bestows this gift. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੋ ਜੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam dhan niramalo je devai devanahaar |
English: The Lord's Name is the pure wealth; it is given only by the Giver.

Gurbani: ਆਗੈ ਪੂਛ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਬੇਲੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: aagai poochh na hovee jis belee gur karataar |
English: One who has the Guru, the Creator, as his Friend, shall not be questioned hereafter.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਛਡਾਏ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aap chhaddaae chhutteeai aape bakhasanahaar |2|
English: He Himself delivers those who are delivered. He Himself is the Forgiver. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਣੇ ਧੀਆ ਪੂਤ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh jaanai aapane dheea poot sanjog |
English: The self-willed manmukh looks upon his daughters, sons and relatives as his own.

Gurbani: ਨਾਰੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਾਸੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਲੇ ਹਰਖੁ ਸੁ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: naaree dekh vigaaseeeh naale harakh su sog |
English: Gazing upon his wife, he is pleased. But along with happiness, they bring grief.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਰੰਗਾਵਲੇ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਭੋਗੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: guramukh sabad rangaavale ahinis har ras bhog |3|
English: The Gurmukhs are attuned to the Word of the Shabad. Day and night, they enjoy the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਚਿਤੁ ਚਲੈ ਵਿਤੁ ਜਾਵਣੋ ਸਾਕਤ ਡੋਲਿ ਡੋਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: chit chalai vit jaavano saakat ddol ddolaae |
English: The consciousness of the wicked, faithless cynics wanders around in search of transitory wealth, unstable and distracted.

Gurbani: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਢੂੰਢਿ ਵਿਗੁਚੀਐ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਸੁਥਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: baahar dtoondt vigucheeai ghar meh vasat suthaae |
English: Searching outside of themselves, they are ruined; the object of their search is in that sacred place within the home of the heart.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਸੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: manamukh haumai kar musee guramukh palai paae |4|
English: The self-willed manmukhs, in their ego, miss it; the Gurmukhs receive it in their laps. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤ ਨਿਰਗੁਣਿਆਰਿਆ ਆਪਣਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: saakat niraguniaariaa aapanaa mool pachhaan |
English: You worthless, faithless cynic-recognize your own origin!

Gurbani: ਰਕਤੁ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੋ ਅਗਨੀ ਪਾਸਿ ਪਿਰਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: rakat bind kaa ihu tano aganee paas piraan |
English: This body is made of blood and semen. It shall be consigned to the fire in the end.

Gurbani: ਪਵਣੈ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਸਚੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: pavanai kai vas dehuree masatak sach neesaan |5|
English: The body is under the power of the breath, according to the True Sign inscribed upon your forehead. ||5||

Gurbani: ਬਹੁਤਾ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਮੁਆ ਨ ਲੋੜੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bahutaa jeevan mangeeai muaa na lorrai koe |
English: Everyone begs for a long life-no one wishes to die.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sukh jeevan tis aakheeai jis guramukh vasiaa soe |
English: A life of peace and comfort comes to that Gurmukh, within whom God dwells.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੇ ਕਿਆ ਗਣੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: naam vihoone kiaa ganee jis har gur daras na hoe |6|
English: Without the Naam, what good those who do not have the Blessed Vision, the Darshan of the Lord and Guru? ||6||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਨਿਸਿ ਭੁਲੀਐ ਜਬ ਲਗਿ ਨਿਦ੍ਰਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jiau supanai nis bhuleeai jab lag nidraa hoe |
English: In their dreams at night, people wander around as long as they sleep;

Gurbani: ਇਉ ਸਰਪਨਿ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: eiau sarapan kai vas jeearraa antar haumai doe |
English: just so, they are under the power of the snake Maya, as long as their hearts are filled with ego and duality.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਲੋਇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: guramat hoe veechaareeai supanaa ihu jag loe |7|
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, they come to understand and see that this world is just a dream. ||7||

Gurbani: ਅਗਨਿ ਮਰੈ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਦੂਧੈ ਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: agan marai jal paaeeai jiau baarik doodhai maae |
English: As thirst is quenched with water, and the baby is satisfied with mother's milk,

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਕਮਲ ਸੁ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਮੀਨੁ ਮਰਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin jal kamal su naa theeai bin jal meen maraae |
English: and as the lotus does not exist without water, and as the fish dies without water

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਜੀਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੮॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh har ras milai jeevaa har gun gaae |8|15|
English: -O Nanak, so does the Gurmukh live, receiving the Sublime Essence of the Lord, and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||8||15||

[Ang 63 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਡੂੰਗਰੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਡਰਾਵਣੋ ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਡਰੀਆਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: ddoongar dekh ddaraavano peeearrai ddareeaas |
English: Beholding the terrifying mountain in this world of my father's home, I am terrified.

Gurbani: ਊਚਉ ਪਰਬਤੁ ਗਾਖੜੋ ਨਾ ਪਉੜੀ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: aoochau parabat gaakharro naa paurree tith taas |
English: It is so difficult to climb this high mountain; there is no ladder which reaches up there.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਤਰੀਆਸੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: guramukh antar jaaniaa gur melee tareeaas |1|
English: But as Gurmukh, I know that it is within my self; the Guru has brought me to Union, and so I cross over. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਡਰਾਂਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhaaee re bhavajal bikham ddaraanau |
English: O Siblings of Destiny, the terrifying world-ocean is so difficult to cross-I am terrified!

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਰਸਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਤਾਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: pooraa satigur ras milai gur taare har naau |1| rahaau |
English: The Perfect True Guru, in His Pleasure, has met with me; the Guru has saved me, through the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਚਲਾ ਚਲਾ ਜੇ ਕਰੀ ਜਾਣਾ ਚਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: chalaa chalaa je karee jaanaa chalanahaar |
English: I may say, "I am going, I am going", but I know that, in the end, I must really go.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਆਇਆ ਸੋ ਚਲਸੀ ਅਮਰੁ ਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jo aaeaa so chalasee amar su gur karataar |
English: Whoever comes must also go. Only the Guru and the Creator are Eternal.

Gurbani: ਭੀ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਸਚੈ ਥਾਨਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bhee sachaa saalaahanaa sachai thaan piaar |2|
English: So praise the True One continually, and love His Place of Truth. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦਰ ਘਰ ਮਹਲਾ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਪਕੇ ਕੋਟ ਹਜਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: dar ghar mahalaa sohane pake kott hajaar |
English: Beautiful gates, houses and palaces, solidly built forts,

Gurbani: ਹਸਤੀ ਘੋੜੇ ਪਾਖਰੇ ਲਸਕਰ ਲਖ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: hasatee ghorre paakhare lasakar lakh apaar |
English: elephants, saddled horses, hundreds of thousands of uncounted armies

Gurbani: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲਿਆ ਖਪਿ ਖਪਿ ਮੁਏ ਅਸਾਰ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kis hee naal na chaliaa khap khap mue asaar |3|
English: -none of these will go along with anyone in the end, and yet, the fools bother themselves to exhaustion with these, and then die. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਸੰਚੀਐ ਮਾਲੁ ਜਾਲੁ ਜੰਜਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: sueinaa rupaa sancheeai maal jaal janjaal |
English: You may gather gold and sliver, but wealth is just a net of entanglement.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਦੋਹੀ ਫੇਰੀਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: sabh jag meh dohee fereeai bin naavai sir kaal |
English: You may beat the drum and proclaim authority over the whole world, but without the Name, death hovers over your head.

Gurbani: ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪੜੈ ਜੀਉ ਖੇਲਸੀ ਬਦਫੈਲੀ ਕਿਆ ਹਾਲੁ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: pindd parrai jeeo khelasee badafailee kiaa haal |4|
English: When the body falls, the play of life is over; what shall be the condition of the evil-doers then? ||4||

Gurbani: ਪੁਤਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸੀਐ ਨਾਰੀ ਸੇਜ ਭਤਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: putaa dekh vigaseeai naaree sej bhataar |
English: The husband is delighted seeing his sons, and his wife upon his bed.

Gurbani: ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਲਾਈਐ ਕਾਪੜੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: choaa chandan laaeeai kaaparr roop seegaar |
English: He applies sandalwood and scented oils, and dresses himself in his beautiful clothes.

Gurbani: ਖੇਹੂ ਖੇਹ ਰਲਾਈਐ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਲੈ ਘਰ ਬਾਰੁ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: khehoo kheh ralaaeeai chhodd chalai ghar baar |5|
English: But dust shall mix with dust, and he shall depart, leaving hearth and home behind. ||5||

Gurbani: ਮਹਰ ਮਲੂਕ ਕਹਾਈਐ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਉ ਕਿ ਖਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: mehar malook kahaaeeai raajaa raau ki khaan |
English: He may be called a chief, an emperor, a king, a governor or a lord;

Gurbani: ਚਉਧਰੀ ਰਾਉ ਸਦਾਈਐ ਜਲਿ ਬਲੀਐ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: chaudharee raau sadaaeeai jal baleeai abhimaan |
English: he may present himself as a leader or a chief, but this just burns him in the fire of egotistical pride.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਉ ਡਵਿ ਦਧਾ ਕਾਨੁ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: manamukh naam visaariaa jiau ddav dadhaa kaan |6|
English: The self-willed manmukh has forgotten the Naam. He is like straw, burning in the forest fire. ||6||

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਇਸੀ ਜੋ ਆਇਆ ਜਗ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: haumai kar kar jaaeisee jo aaeaa jag maeh |
English: Whoever comes into the world and indulges in ego, must depart.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਕਾਜਲ ਕੋਠੜੀ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਹ ਸੁਆਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: sabh jag kaajal kottharree tan man deh suaaeh |
English: The whole world is a store-house of lamp-black; the body and mind are blackened with it.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਭਾਹਿ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: gur raakhe se niramale sabad nivaaree bhaeh |7|
English: Those who are saved by the Guru are immaculate and pure; through the Word of the Shabad, they extinguish the fire of desire. ||7||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਰੀਐ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak tareeai sach naam sir saahaa paatisaahu |
English: O Nanak, they swim across with the True Name of the Lord, the King above the heads of kings.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: mai har naam na veesarai har naam ratan vesaahu |
English: May I never forget the Name of the Lord! I have purchased the Jewel of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਉਜਲਿ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਰੇ ਅਥਾਹੁ ॥੮॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: manamukh bhaujal pach mue guramukh tare athaahu |8|16|
English: The self-willed manmukhs putrefy and die in the terrifying world-ocean, while the Gurmukhs cross over the bottomless ocean. ||8||16||

[Ang 64 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ghar 2 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Second House:

Gurbani: ਮੁਕਾਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਸਣਾ ਨਿਤ ਚਲਣੈ ਕੀ ਧੋਖ ॥
Transliteration: mukaam kar ghar baisanaa nit chalanai kee dhokh |
English: They have made this their resting place and they sit at home, but the urge to depart is always there.

Gurbani: ਮੁਕਾਮੁ ਤਾ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਲੋਕ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mukaam taa par jaaneeai jaa rahai nihachal lok |1|
English: This would be known as a lasting place of rest, only if they were to remain stable and unchanging. ||1||

Gurbani: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕੈਸਿ ਮੁਕਾਮੇ ॥
Transliteration: duneea kais mukaame |
English: What sort of a resting place is this world?

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਸਿਦਕੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਖਰਚੁ ਬਾਧਹੁ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੁ ਨਾਮੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kar sidak karanee kharach baadhahu laag rahu naame |1| rahaau |
English: Doing deeds of faith, pack up the supplies for your journey, and remain committed to the Name. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੋਗੀ ਤ ਆਸਣੁ ਕਰਿ ਬਹੈ ਮੁਲਾ ਬਹੈ ਮੁਕਾਮਿ ॥
Transliteration: jogee ta aasan kar bahai mulaa bahai mukaam |
English: The Yogis sit in their Yogic postures, and the Mullahs sit at their resting stations.

Gurbani: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਪੋਥੀਆ ਸਿਧ ਬਹਹਿ ਦੇਵ ਸਥਾਨਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: panddit vakhaaneh potheea sidh baheh dev sathaan |2|
English: The Hindu Pandits recite from their books, and the Siddhas sit in the temples of their gods. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੁਰ ਸਿਧ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸੇਖ ਪੀਰ ਸਲਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: sur sidh gan gandharab mun jan sekh peer salaar |
English: The angels, Siddhas, worshippers of Shiva, heavenly musicians, silent sages, Saints, priests, preachers, spiritual teachers and commanders

Gurbani: ਦਰਿ ਕੂਚ ਕੂਚਾ ਕਰਿ ਗਏ ਅਵਰੇ ਭਿ ਚਲਣਹਾਰ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: dar kooch koochaa kar ge avare bhi chalanahaar |3|
English: -each and every one has left, and all others shall depart as well. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੁਲਤਾਨ ਖਾਨ ਮਲੂਕ ਉਮਰੇ ਗਏ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕੂਚੁ ॥
Transliteration: sulataan khaan malook umare ge kar kar kooch |
English: The sultans and kings, the rich and the mighty, have marched away in succession.

Gurbani: ਘੜੀ ਮੁਹਤਿ ਕਿ ਚਲਣਾ ਦਿਲ ਸਮਝੁ ਤੂੰ ਭਿ ਪਹੂਚੁ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: gharree muhat ki chalanaa dil samajh toon bhi pahooch |4|
English: In a moment or two, we shall also depart. O my heart, understand that you must go as well! ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਾਹ ਮਾਹਿ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਤ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabadaah maeh vakhaaneeai viralaa ta boojhai koe |
English: This is described in the Shabads; only a few understand this!

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak vakhaanai benatee jal thal maheeal soe |5|
English: Nanak offers this prayer to the One who pervades the water, the land and the air. ||5||

Gurbani: ਅਲਾਹੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਕਾਦਰੁ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਕਰੀਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: alaahu alakh agam kaadar karanahaar kareem |
English: He is Allah, the Unknowable, the Inaccessible, All-powerful and Merciful Creator.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਦੁਨੀ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਵਣੀ ਮੁਕਾਮੁ ਏਕੁ ਰਹੀਮੁ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: sabh dunee aavan jaavanee mukaam ek raheem |6|
English: All the world comes and goes-only the Merciful Lord is permanent. ||6||

Gurbani: ਮੁਕਾਮੁ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਸਿ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਲੇਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: mukaam tis no aakheeai jis sis na hovee lekh |
English: Call permanent only the One, who does not have destiny inscribed upon His Forehead.

Gurbani: ਅਸਮਾਨੁ ਧਰਤੀ ਚਲਸੀ ਮੁਕਾਮੁ ਓਹੀ ਏਕੁ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: asamaan dharatee chalasee mukaam ohee ek |7|
English: The sky and the earth shall pass away; He alone is permanent. ||7||

Gurbani: ਦਿਨ ਰਵਿ ਚਲੈ ਨਿਸਿ ਸਸਿ ਚਲੈ ਤਾਰਿਕਾ ਲਖ ਪਲੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: din rav chalai nis sas chalai taarikaa lakh paloe |
English: The day and the sun shall pass away; the night and the moon shall pass away; the hundreds of thousands of stars shall disappear.

Gurbani: ਮੁਕਾਮੁ ਓਹੀ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਚੁ ਬੁਗੋਇ ॥੮॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: mukaam ohee ek hai naanakaa sach bugoe |8|17|
English: He alone is permanent; Nanak speaks the Truth. ||8||17||

Gurbani: ਮਹਲੇ ਪਹਿਲੇ ਸਤਾਰਹ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: mahale pahile sataarah asattapadeea |
English: Seventeen Ashtpadheeyaa Of The First Mehl.

[Ang 64 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ghar 1 asattapadeea |
English: Siree Raag, Third Mehl, First House, Ashtpadheeyaa:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕੀਜੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh kripaa kare bhagat keejai bin gur bhagat na hoe |
English: By God's Grace, the Gurmukh practices devotion; without the Guru, there is no devotional worship.

Gurbani: ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਬੂਝੈ ਤਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aapai aap milaae boojhai taa niramal hovai koe |
English: One who merges his own self into Him understands, and so becomes pure.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har jeeo sachaa sachee baanee sabad milaavaa hoe |1|
English: The Dear Lord is True, and True is the Word of His Bani. Through the Word of the Shabad, Union with Him is obtained. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਭਗਤਿਹੀਣੁ ਕਾਹੇ ਜਗਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bhaaee re bhagatiheen kaahe jag aaeaa |
English: O Siblings of Destiny, without devotion, why have people even come into the world?

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਕੀਨੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: poore gur kee sev na keenee birathaa janam gavaaeaa |1| rahaau |
English: They have not served the Perfect Guru; they have wasted their lives in vain. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aape har jagajeevan daataa aape bakhas milaae |
English: The Lord Himself, the Life of the World, is the Giver. He Himself forgives, and unites us with Himself.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਏ ਕਿਆ ਵੇਚਾਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jant e kiaa vechaare kiaa ko aakh sunaae |
English: What are these poor beings and creatures? What can they speak and say?

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਾਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: guramukh aape de vaddiaaee aape sev karaae |2|
English: God Himself grants glory to the Gurmukhs; He joins them to His Service. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦੇਖਿ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੋਭਾਣਾ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: dekh kuttanb mohi lobhaanaa chaladiaa naal na jaaee |
English: Beholding your family, you are lured away by emotional attachment, but when you leave, they will not go with you.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sev gun nidhaan paaeaa tis kee keem na paaee |
English: Serving the True Guru, I have found the Treasure of Excellence. Its value cannot be estimated.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: prabh sakhaa har jeeo meraa ante hoe sakhaaee |3|
English: The Dear Lord God is my Best Friend. In the end, He shall be my Companion and Support. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: peeearrai jagajeevan daataa manamukh pat gavaaee |
English: In this world of my father's home, the Great Giver is the Life of the World. The self-willed manmukhs have lost their honor.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੋ ਮਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਅੰਧੇ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: bin satigur ko mag na jaanai andhe tthaur na kaaee |
English: Without the True Guru, no one knows the Way. The blind find no place of rest.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਵਸਿਆ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: har sukhadaataa man nahee vasiaa ant geaa pachhutaaee |4|
English: If the Lord, the Giver of Peace, does not dwell within the mind, then they shall depart with regret in the end. ||4||

Gurbani: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: peeearrai jagajeevan daataa guramat man vasaaeaa |
English: In this world of my father's house, through the Guru's Teachings, I have cultivated within my mind the Great Giver, the Life of the World.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: anadin bhagat kareh din raatee haumai mohu chukaaeaa |
English: Night and day, performing devotional worship, day and night, ego and emotional attachment are removed.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਤਾ ਤੈਸੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: jis siau raataa taiso hovai sache sach samaaeaa |5|
English: And then, attuned to Him, we become like Him, truly absorbed in the True One. ||5||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਭਾਉ ਲਾਏ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: aape nadar kare bhaau laae gurasabadee beechaar |
English: Bestowing His Glance of Grace, He gives us His Love, and we contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸਹਜੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: satigur seviai sehaj aoopajai haumai trisanaa maar |
English: Serving the True Guru, intuitive peace wells up, and ego and desire die.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਸਦ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਚੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: har gunadaataa sad man vasai sach rakhiaa ur dhaar |6|
English: The Lord, the Giver of Virtue, dwells forever within the minds of those who keep Truth enshrined within their hearts. ||6||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਮਨਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: prabh meraa sadaa niramalaa man niramal paaeaa jaae |
English: My God is forever Immaculate and Pure; with a pure mind, He can be found.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: naam nidhaan har man vasai haumai dukh sabh jaae |
English: If the Treasure of the Name of the Lord abides within the mind, egotism and pain are totally eliminated.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: satigur sabad sunaaeaa hau sad balihaarai jaau |7|
English: The True Guru has instructed me in the Word of the Shabad. I am forever a sacrifice to Him. ||7||

Gurbani: ਆਪਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aapanai man chit kahai kahaae bin gur aap na jaaee |
English: Within your own conscious mind, you may say anything, but without the Guru, selfishness and conceit are not eradicated.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har jeeo bhagat vachhal sukhadaataa kar kirapaa man vasaaee |
English: The Dear Lord is the Lover of His devotees, the Giver of Peace. By His Grace, He abides within the mind.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਭਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੮॥੧॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: naanak sobhaa surat dee prabh aape guramukh de vaddiaaee |8|1|18|
English: O Nanak, God blesses us with the sublime awakening of consciousness; He Himself grants glorious greatness to the Gurmukh. ||8||1||18||

[Ang 65 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 |
English: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਜਮਡੰਡੁ ਲਗੈ ਤਿਨ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: haumai karam kamaavade jamaddandd lagai tin aae |
English: Those who go around acting in egotism are struck down by the Messenger of Death with his club.

Gurbani: ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ji satigur sevan se ubare har setee liv laae |1|
English: Those who serve the True Guru are uplifted and saved, in love with the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: man re guramukh naam dhiaae |
English: O mind, become Gurmukh, and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਧੁਰਿ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dhur poorab karatai likhiaa tinaa guramat naam samaae |1| rahaau |
English: Those who are so pre-destined by the Creator are absorbed into the Naam, through the Guru's Teachings. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੋ ਭਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: vin satigur parateet na aavee naam na laago bhaau |
English: Without the True Guru, faith does not come, and love for the Naam is not embraced.

Gurbani: ਸੁਪਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਈ ਦੁਖ ਮਹਿ ਸਵੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: supanai sukh na paavee dukh meh savai samaae |2|
English: Even in dreams, they find no peace; they sleep immersed in pain. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਚੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਲੋਚੀਐ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: je har har keechai bahut locheeai kirat na mettiaa jaae |
English: Even if you chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, with great longing, your past actions are still not erased.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਭਗਤੀ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਪਏ ਦਰਿ ਥਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har kaa bhaanaa bhagatee maniaa se bhagat pe dar thaae |3|
English: The Lord's devotees surrender to His Will; those devotees are accepted at His Door. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਦਿੜਾਵੈ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur sabad dirraavai rang siau bin kirapaa leaa na jaae |
English: The Guru has lovingly implanted the Word of His Shabad within me. Without His Grace, it cannot be attained.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨੀਰੀਐ ਭੀ ਬਿਖੁ ਫਲੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਧਾਇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: je sau amrit neereeai bhee bikh fal laagai dhaae |4|
English: Even if the poisonous plant is watered with ambrosial nectar a hundred times, it will still bear poisonous fruit. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਚੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: se jan sache niramale jin satigur naal piaar |
English: Those humble beings who are in love with the True Guru are pure and true.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: satigur kaa bhaanaa kamaavade bikh haumai taj vikaar |5|
English: They act in harmony with the Will of the True Guru; they shed the poison of ego and corruption. ||5||

Gurbani: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਿਤੈ ਉਪਾਇ ਨ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸੋਧਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: manahatth kitai upaae na chhootteeai simrit saasatr sodhahu jaae |
English: Acting in stubborn-mindedness, no one is saved; go and study the Simritees and the Shaastras.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਉਬਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: mil sangat saadhoo ubare gur kaa sabad kamaae |6|
English: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and practicing the Shabads of the Guru, you shall be saved. ||6||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam nidhaan hai jis ant na paaraavaar |
English: The Name of the Lord is the Treasure, which has no end or limitation.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਈ ਸੋਹਦੇ ਜਿਨ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: guramukh seee sohade jin kirapaa kare karataar |7|
English: The Gurmukhs are beauteous; the Creator has blessed them with His Mercy. ||7||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਉਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak daataa ek hai doojaa aaur na koe |
English: O Nanak, the One Lord alone is the Giver; there is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੮॥੨॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee paaeeai karam paraapat hoe |8|2|19|
English: By Guru's Grace, He is obtained. By His Mercy, He is found. ||8||2||19||

[Ang 66 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 |
English: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪੰਖੀ ਬਿਰਖਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੜਾ ਸਚੁ ਚੁਗੈ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: pankhee birakh suhaavarraa sach chugai gur bhaae |
English: The soul-bird in the beautiful tree of the body pecks at Truth, with love for the Guru.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਰਹੈ ਉਡੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: har ras peevai sehaj rahai uddai na aavai jaae |
English: She drinks in the Sublime Essence of the Lord, and abides in intuitive ease; she does not fly around coming and going.

Gurbani: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: nij ghar vaasaa paaeaa har har naam samaae |1|
English: She obtains her home within her own heart; she is absorbed into the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man re gur kee kaar kamaae |
English: O mind, work to serve the Guru.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੇ ਚਲਹਿ ਤਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਚਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai bhaanai je chaleh taa anadin raacheh har naae |1| rahaau |
English: If you walk in harmony with the Guru's Will, you shall remain immersed in the Lord's Name, night and day. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪੰਖੀ ਬਿਰਖ ਸੁਹਾਵੜੇ ਊਡਹਿ ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: pankhee birakh suhaavarre aooddeh chahu dis jaeh |
English: The birds in the beautiful trees fly around in all four directions.

Gurbani: ਜੇਤਾ ਊਡਹਿ ਦੁਖ ਘਣੇ ਨਿਤ ਦਾਝਹਿ ਤੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jetaa aooddeh dukh ghane nit daajheh tai bilalaeh |
English: The more they fly around, the more they suffer; they burn and cry out in pain.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਪਈ ਨਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bin gur mehal na jaapee naa amrit fal paeh |2|
English: Without the Guru, they do not find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and they do not obtain the Ambrosial Fruit. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹਰੀਆਵਲਾ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh braham hareeaavalaa saachai sehaj subhaae |
English: The Gurmukh is like God's tree, always green, blessed with the Sublime Love of the True One, with intuitive peace and poise.

Gurbani: ਸਾਖਾ ਤੀਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀਆ ਏਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: saakhaa teen nivaareea ek sabad liv laae |
English: He cuts off the three branches of the three qualities, and embraces love for the One Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਖਵਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: amrit fal har ek hai aape dee khavaae |3|
English: The Lord alone is the Ambrosial Fruit; He Himself gives it to us to eat. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਊਭੇ ਸੁਕਿ ਗਏ ਨਾ ਫਲੁ ਤਿੰਨਾ ਛਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh aoobhe suk ge naa fal tinaa chhaau |
English: The self-willed manmukhs stand there and dry up; they do not bear any fruit, and they do not provide any shade.

Gurbani: ਤਿੰਨਾ ਪਾਸਿ ਨ ਬੈਸੀਐ ਓਨਾ ਘਰੁ ਨ ਗਿਰਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tinaa paas na baiseeai onaa ghar na giraau |
English: Don't even bother to sit near them-they have no home or village.

Gurbani: ਕਟੀਅਹਿ ਤੈ ਨਿਤ ਜਾਲੀਅਹਿ ਓਨਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: katteeeh tai nit jaaleeeh onaa sabad na naau |4|
English: They are cut down and burnt each day; they have neither the Shabad, nor the Lord's Name. ||4||

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਪਇਐ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਫਿਰਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hukame karam kamaavane peiai kirat firaau |
English: According to the Lord's Command, people perform their actions; they wander around, driven by the karma of their past actions.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਣਾ ਜਹ ਭੇਜਹਿ ਤਹ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hukame darasan dekhanaa jeh bhejeh teh jaau |
English: By the Lord's Command, they behold the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. Wherever He sends them, there they go.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: hukame har har man vasai hukame sach samaau |5|
English: By His Command, the Lord, Har, Har, abides within our minds; by His Command we merge in Truth. ||5||

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਬਪੁੜੇ ਭੂਲੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: hukam na jaaneh bapurre bhoole fireh gavaar |
English: The wretched fools do not know the Lord's Will; they wander around making mistakes.

Gurbani: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਹੋਹਿ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: manahatth karam kamaavade nit nit hohi khuaar |
English: They go about their business stubborn-mindedly; they are disgraced forever and ever.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਨਾ ਸਚਿ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: antar saant na aavee naa sach lagai piaar |6|
English: Inner peace does not come to them; they do not embrace love for the True Lord. ||6||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖੀਆ ਮੁਹ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: guramukheea muh sohane gur kai het piaar |
English: Beautiful are the faces of the Gurmukhs, who bear love and affection for the Guru.

Gurbani: ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤੀ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰ ॥
Transliteration: sachee bhagatee sach rate dar sachai sachiaar |
English: Through true devotional worship, they are attuned to Truth; at the True Door, they are found to be true.

Gurbani: ਆਏ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਕੁਲ ਕਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: aae se paravaan hai sabh kul kaa kareh udhaar |7|
English: Blessed is their coming into being; they redeem all their ancestors. ||7||

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਨਦਰੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਨਦਰੀ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabh nadaree karam kamaavade nadaree baahar na koe |
English: All do their deeds under the Lord's Glance of Grace; no one is beyond His Vision.

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਸਚਾ ਤੈਸਾ ਹੀ ਕੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jaisee nadar kar dekhai sachaa taisaa hee ko hoe |
English: According to the Glance of Grace with which the True Lord beholds us, so do we become.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਾਈਆ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੮॥੩॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: naanak naam vaddaaeea karam paraapat hoe |8|3|20|
English: O Nanak, the Glorious Greatness of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is received only by His Mercy. ||8||3||20||

[Ang 66 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 |
English: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh naam dhiaaeeai manamukh boojh na paae |
English: The Gurmukhs meditate on the Naam; the self-willed manmukhs do not understand.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh sadaa mukh aoojale har vasiaa man aae |
English: The faces of the Gurmukhs are always radiant; the Lord has come to dwell within their minds.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sahaje hee sukh paaeeai sahaje rahai samaae |1|
English: Through intuitive understanding they are at peace, and through intuitive understanding they remain absorbed in the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhaaee re daasan daasaa hoe |
English: O Siblings of Destiny, be the slaves of the Lord's slaves.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur kee sevaa gur bhagat hai viralaa paae koe |1| rahaau |
English: Service to the Guru is worship of the Guru. How rare are those who obtain it! ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗੁ ਸੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਜੇ ਚਲਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa suhaag suhaaganee je chaleh satigur bhaae |
English: The happy soul-bride is always with her Husband Lord, if she walks in harmony with the Will of the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa pir nihachal paaeeai naa ohu marai na jaae |
English: She attains her Eternal, Ever-stable Husband, who never dies or goes away.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਨਾ ਵੀਛੁੜੈ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sabad milee naa veechhurrai pir kai ank samaae |2|
English: United with the Word of the Shabad, she shall not be separated again. She is immersed in the Lap of her Beloved. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਅਤਿ ਊਜਲਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: har niramal at aoojalaa bin gur paaeaa na jaae |
English: The Lord is Immaculate and Radiantly Bright; without the Guru, He cannot be found.

Gurbani: ਪਾਠੁ ਪੜੈ ਨਾ ਬੂਝਈ ਭੇਖੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: paatth parrai naa boojhee bhekhee bharam bhulaae |
English: He cannot be understood by reading scriptures; the deceitful pretenders are deluded by doubt.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: guramatee har sadaa paaeaa rasanaa har ras samaae |3|
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Lord is always found, and the tongue is permeated with the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohu chukaaeaa guramatee sehaj subhaae |
English: Emotional attachment to Maya is shed with intuitive ease, through the Guru's Teachings.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਜਗੁ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਫਿਰੈ ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਗਈ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin sabadai jag dukheea firai manamukhaa no gee khaae |
English: Without the Shabad, the world wanders lost in pain. The self-willed manmukh is consumed.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਬਦੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: sabade naam dhiaaeeai sabade sach samaae |4|
English: Through the Shabad, meditate on the Naam; through the Shabad, you shall merge in Truth. ||4||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਭੂਲੇ ਸਿਧ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa bhoole sidh fireh samaadh na lagai subhaae |
English: The Siddhas wander around, deluded by Maya; they are not absorbed in the Samaadhi of the Lord's Sublime Love.

Gurbani: ਤੀਨੇ ਲੋਅ ਵਿਆਪਤ ਹੈ ਅਧਿਕ ਰਹੀ ਲਪਟਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: teene loa viaapat hai adhik rahee lapattaae |
English: The three worlds are permeated by Maya; they are totally covered by it.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: bin gur mukat na paaeeai naa dubidhaa maaeaa jaae |5|
English: Without the Guru, liberation is not attained, and the double-mindedness of Maya does not go away. ||5||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਕਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa kis no aakheeai kiaa maaeaa karam kamaae |
English: What is called Maya? What does Maya do?

Gurbani: ਦੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਏਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਬਧੁ ਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: dukh sukh ehu jeeo badh hai haumai karam kamaae |
English: These beings are bound by pleasure and pain; they do their deeds in egotism.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਚੂਕਈ ਨਾ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: bin sabadai bharam na chookee naa vichahu haumai jaae |6|
English: Without the Shabad, doubt is not dispelled, and egotism is not eliminated from within. ||6||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin preetee bhagat na hovee bin sabadai thaae na paae |
English: Without love, there is no devotional worship. Without the Shabad, no one finds acceptance.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabade haumai maareeai maaeaa kaa bhram jaae |
English: Through the Shabad, egotism is conquered and subdued, and the illusion of Maya is dispelled.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: naam padaarath paaeeai guramukh sehaj subhaae |7|
English: The Gurmukh obtains the Treasure of the Naam with intuitive ease. ||7||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਗੁਣ ਨ ਜਾਪਨੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin gur gun na jaapanee bin gun bhagat na hoe |
English: Without the Guru, one's virtues do not shine forth; without virtue, there is no devotional worship.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat vachhal har man vasiaa sehaj miliaa prabh soe |
English: The Lord is the Lover of His devotees; He abides within their minds. They meet that God with intuitive ease.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੮॥੪॥੨੧॥
Transliteration: naanak sabade har saalaaheeai karam paraapat hoe |8|4|21|
English: O Nanak, through the Shabad, praise the Lord. By His Grace, He is obtained. ||8||4||21||

[Ang 67 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 |
English: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨਾ ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohu merai prabh keenaa aape bharam bhulaae |
English: Emotional attachment to Maya is created by my God; He Himself misleads us through illusion and doubt.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh karam kareh nahee boojheh birathaa janam gavaae |
English: The self-willed manmukhs perform their actions, but they do not understand; they waste away their lives in vain.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਕਰਮਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gurabaanee is jag meh chaanan karam vasai man aae |1|
English: Gurbani is the Light to illuminate this world; by His Grace, it comes to abide within the mind. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: man re naam japahu sukh hoe |
English: O mind, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and find peace.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur pooraa saalaaheeai sehaj milai prabh soe |1| rahaau |
English: Praising the Perfect Guru, you shall easily meet with that God. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਭਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bharam geaa bhau bhaagiaa har charanee chit laae |
English: Doubt departs, and fear runs away, when you focus your consciousness on the Lord's Feet.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh sabad kamaaeeai har vasai man aae |
English: The Gurmukh practices the Shabad, and the Lord comes to dwell within the mind.

Gurbani: ਘਰਿ ਮਹਲਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਖਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ghar mehal sach samaaeeai jamakaal na sakai khaae |2|
English: In the mansion of the home within the self, we merge in Truth, and the Messenger of Death cannot devour us. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਾ ਛੀਬਾ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਜੋੁਲਾਹਾ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: naamaa chheebaa kabeer juolaahaa poore gur te gat paaee |
English: Naam Dayv the printer, and Kabeer the weaver, obtained salvation through the Perfect Guru.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੇ ਬੇਤੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: braham ke bete sabad pachhaaneh haumai jaat gavaaee |
English: Those who know God and recognize His Shabad lose their ego and class consciousness.

Gurbani: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਭਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sur nar tin kee baanee gaaveh koe na mettai bhaaee |3|
English: Their Banis are sung by the angelic beings, and no one can erase them, O Siblings of Destiny! ||3||

Gurbani: ਦੈਤ ਪੁਤੁ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੰਜਮ ਨ ਪੜੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: dait put karam dharam kichh sanjam na parrai doojaa bhaau na jaanai |
English: The demon's son Prahlaad had not read about religious rituals or ceremonies, austerity or self-discipline; he did not know the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਐ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur bhettiai niramal hoaa anadin naam vakhaanai |
English: Upon meeting with the True Guru, he became pure; night and day, he chanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਪੜੈ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਉ ਬੂਝੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: eko parrai eko naau boojhai doojaa avar na jaanai |4|
English: He read only of the One and he understood only the One Name; he knew no other at all. ||4||

Gurbani: ਖਟੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਜੋਗੀ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: khatt darasan jogee saniaasee bin gur bharam bhulaae |
English: The followers of the six different life-styles and world-views, the Yogis and the Sanyaasees have gone astray in doubt without the Guru.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: satigur seveh taa gat mit paaveh har jeeo man vasaae |
English: If they serve the True Guru, they find the state of salvation; they enshrine the Dear Lord within their minds.

Gurbani: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਰਹਾਏ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: sachee baanee siau chit laagai aavan jaan rahaae |5|
English: They focus their consciousness on the True Bani, and their comings and goings in reincarnation are over. ||5||

Gurbani: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਵਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: panddit parr parr vaad vakhaaneh bin gur bharam bhulaae |
English: The Pandits, the religious scholars, read and argue and stir up controversies, but without the Guru, they are deluded by doubt.

Gurbani: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਫੇਰੁ ਪਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh fer peaa bin sabadai mukat na paae |
English: They wander around the cycle of 8.4 million reincarnations; without the Shabad, they do not attain liberation.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਨਾਉ ਚੇਤੈ ਤਾ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: jaa naau chetai taa gat paae jaa satigur mel milaae |6|
English: But when they remember the Name, then they attain the state of salvation, when the True Guru unites them in Union. ||6||

Gurbani: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: satasangat meh naam har upajai jaa satigur milai subhaae |
English: In the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, the Name of the Lord wells up, when the True Guru unites us in His Sublime Love.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪੀ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈ ਚਲਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: man tan arapee aap gavaaee chalaa satigur bhaae |
English: I offer my mind and body, and I renounce my selfishness and conceit; I walk in Harmony with the Will of the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: sad balihaaree gur apune vittahu ji har setee chit laae |7|
English: I am forever a sacrifice to my Guru, who has attached my consciousness to the Lord. ||7||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜੋ ਬਿੰਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: so braahaman braham jo binde har setee rang raataa |
English: He alone is a Brahmin, who knows the Lord Brahma, and is attuned to the Love of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਭਨਾ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: prabh nikatt vasai sabhanaa ghatt antar guramukh viralai jaataa |
English: God is close at hand; He dwells deep within the hearts of all. How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, know Him.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥੮॥੫॥੨੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naam milai vaddiaaee gur kai sabad pachhaataa |8|5|22|
English: O Nanak, through the Naam, greatness is obtained; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is realized. ||8||5||22||

[Ang 68 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 |
English: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੈ ਨੋ ਸਭ ਲੋਚਦੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sahajai no sabh lochadee bin gur paaeaa na jaae |
English: Everyone longs to be centered and balanced, but without the Guru, no one can.

Gurbani: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਜੋਤਕੀ ਥਕੇ ਭੇਖੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: parr parr panddit jotakee thake bhekhee bharam bhulaae |
English: The Pandits and the astrologers read and read until they grow weary, while the fanatics are deluded by doubt.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਸਹਜੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur bhette sehaj paaeaa aapanee kirapaa kare rajaae |1|
English: Meeting with the Guru, intuitive balance is obtained, when God, in His Will, grants His Grace. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhaaee re gur bin sehaj na hoe |
English: O Siblings of Destiny, without the Guru, intuitive balance is not obtained.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸਹਜੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sabadai hee te sehaj aoopajai har paaeaa sach soe |1| rahaau |
English: Through the Word of the Shabad, intuitive peace and poise wells up, and that True Lord is obtained. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਗਾਵਿਆ ਥਾਇ ਪਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਹਜੈ ਕਥਨੀ ਬਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: sahaje gaaviaa thaae pavai bin sahajai kathanee baad |
English: That which is sung intuitively is acceptable; without this intuition, all chanting is useless.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ਬੈਰਾਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: sahaje hee bhagat aoopajai sehaj piaar bairaag |
English: In the state of intuitive balance, devotion wells up. In intuitive balance, love is balanced and detached.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਹਜੈ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਬਾਦਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sahajai hee te sukh saat hoe bin sahajai jeevan baad |2|
English: In the state of intuitive balance, peace and tranquility are produced. Without intuitive balance, life is useless. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਹਜਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj saalaahee sadaa sadaa sehaj samaadh lagaae |
English: In the state of intuitive balance, praise the Lord forever and ever. With intuitive ease, embrace Samaadhi.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਗੁਣ ਊਚਰੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sahaje hee gun aoocharai bhagat kare liv laae |
English: In the state of intuitive balance, chant His Glories, lovingly absorbed in devotional worship.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੇ ਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sabade hee har man vasai rasanaa har ras khaae |3|
English: Through the Shabad, the Lord dwells within the mind, and the tongue tastes the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਕਾਲੁ ਵਿਡਾਰਿਆ ਸਚ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sahaje kaal viddaariaa sach saranaaee paae |
English: In the poise of intuitive balance, death is destroyed, entering the Sanctuary of the True One.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sahaje har naam man vasiaa sachee kaar kamaae |
English: Intuitively balanced, the Name of the Lord dwells within the mind, practicing the lifestyle of Truth.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿਨੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: se vaddabhaagee jinee paaeaa sahaje rahe samaae |4|
English: Those who have found Him are very fortunate; they remain intuitively absorbed in Him. ||4||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa vich sehaj na aoopajai maaeaa doojai bhaae |
English: Within Maya, the poise of intuitive balance is not produced. Maya leads to the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਲੈ ਜਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh karam kamaavane haumai jalai jalaae |
English: The self-willed manmukhs perform religious rituals, but they are burnt down by their selfishness and conceit.

Gurbani: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਚੂਕਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: jaman maran na chookee fir fir aavai jaae |5|
English: Their births and deaths do not cease; over and over again, they come and go in reincarnation. ||5||

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਗੁਣਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: trihu gunaa vich sehaj na paaeeai trai gun bharam bhulaae |
English: In the three qualities, intuitive balance is not obtained; the three qualities lead to delusion and doubt.

Gurbani: ਪੜੀਐ ਗੁਣੀਐ ਕਿਆ ਕਥੀਐ ਜਾ ਮੁੰਢਹੁ ਘੁਥਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: parreeai guneeai kiaa katheeai jaa mundtahu ghuthaa jaae |
English: What is the point of reading, studying and debating, if one loses his roots?

Gurbani: ਚਉਥੇ ਪਦ ਮਹਿ ਸਹਜੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: chauthe pad meh sehaj hai guramukh palai paae |6|
English: In the fourth state, there is intuitive balance; the Gurmukhs gather it in. ||6||

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: niragun naam nidhaan hai sahaje sojhee hoe |
English: The Naam, the Name of the Formless Lord, is the treasure. Through intuitive balance, understanding is obtained.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਆ ਸਚੇ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: gunavantee saalaahiaa sache sachee soe |
English: The virtuous praise the True One; their reputation is true.

Gurbani: ਭੁਲਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਸੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: bhuliaa sehaj milaaeisee sabad milaavaa hoe |7|
English: The wayward are united with God through intuitive balance; through the Shabad, union is obtained. ||7||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਹਜੈ ਸਭੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: bin sahajai sabh andh hai maaeaa mohu gubaar |
English: Without intuitive balance, all are blind. Emotional attachment to Maya is utter darkness.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਈ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: sahaje hee sojhee pee sachai sabad apaar |
English: In intuitive balance, understanding of the True, Infinite Shabad is obtained.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: aape bakhas milaaeian poore gur karataar |8|
English: Granting forgiveness, the Perfect Guru unites us with the Creator. ||8||

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਅਦਿਸਟੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sahaje adisatt pachhaaneeai nirbhau jot nirankaar |
English: In intuitive balance, the Unseen is recognized-the Fearless, Luminous, Formless Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਇਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sabhanaa jeea kaa ik daataa jotee jot milaavanahaar |
English: There is only the One Giver of all beings. He blends our light with His Light.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: poorai sabad salaaheeai jis daa ant na paaraavaar |9|
English: So praise God through the Perfect Word of His Shabad; He has no end or limitation. ||9||

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨੀਆ ਕਾ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
