Transliteration: giaaneea kaa dhan naam hai sehaj kareh vaapaar |
English: Those who are wise take the Naam as their wealth; with intuitive ease, they trade with Him.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਨਿ ਅਖੁਟ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: anadin laahaa har naam lain akhutt bhare bhanddaar |
English: Night and day, they receive the Profit of the Lord's Name, which is an inexhaustible and over-flowing treasure.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਦੀਏ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰਿ ॥੧੦॥੬॥੨੩॥
Transliteration: naanak tott na aavee dee devanahaar |10|6|23|
English: O Nanak, when the Great Giver gives, nothing at all is lacking. ||10||6||23||

[Ang 69 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 |
English: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਫੇਰੁ ਨ ਪਵੈ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur miliai fer na pavai janam maran dukh jaae |
English: Meeting with the True Guru, you shall not have to go through the cycle of reincarnation again; the pains of birth and death will be taken away.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਭ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: poorai sabad sabh sojhee hoee har naamai rahai samaae |1|
English: Through the Perfect Word of the Shabad, all understanding is obtained; remain absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man mere satigur siau chit laae |
English: O my mind, focus your consciousness on the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦ ਨਵਤਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: niramal naam sad navatano aap vasai man aae |1| rahaau |
English: The Immaculate Naam itself, ever-fresh, comes to abide within the mind. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਰਹਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: har jeeo raakhahu apunee saranaaee jiau raakheh tiau rahanaa |
English: O Dear Lord, please protect and preserve me in Your Sanctuary. As You keep me, so do I remain.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰਣਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad jeevat marai guramukh bhavajal taranaa |2|
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Gurmukh remains dead while yet alive, and swims across the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

Gurbani: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: vaddai bhaag naau paaeeai guramat sabad suhaaee |
English: By great good fortune, the Name is obtained. Following the Guru's Teachings, through the Shabad, you shall be exalted.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aape man vasiaa prabh karataa sahaje rahiaa samaaee |3|
English: God, the Creator Himself, dwells within the mind; remain absorbed in the state of intuitive balance. ||3||

Gurbani: ਇਕਨਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਬੰਧਨਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਭਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: eikanaa manamukh sabad na bhaavai bandhan bandh bhavaaeaa |
English: Some are self-willed manmukhs; they do not love the Word of the Shabad. Bound in chains, they wander lost in reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh fir fir aavai birathaa janam gavaaeaa |4|
English: Through 8.4 million lifetimes, they wander over and over again; they waste away their lives in vain. ||4||

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: bhagataa man aanand hai sachai sabad rang raate |
English: In the minds of the devotees there is bliss; they are attuned to the Love of the True Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਦ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਤੇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: anadin gun gaaveh sad niramal sahaje naam samaate |5|
English: Night and day, they constantly sing the Glories of the Immaculate Lord; with intuitive ease, they are absorbed into the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||5||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਸਭ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh amrit baanee boleh sabh aatam raam pachhaanee |
English: The Gurmukhs speak the Ambrosial Bani; they recognize the Lord, the Supreme Soul in all.

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਏਕੁ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: eko sevan ek araadheh guramukh akath kahaanee |6|
English: They serve the One; they worship and adore the One. The Gurmukhs speak the Unspoken Speech. ||6||

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa saahib seveeai guramukh vasai man aae |
English: The Gurmukhs serve their True Lord and Master, who comes to dwell in the mind.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਚ ਸਿਉ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: sadaa rang raate sach siau apunee kirapaa kare milaae |7|
English: They are forever attuned to the Love of the True One, who bestows His Mercy and unites them with Himself. ||7||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਇਕਨਾ ਸੁਤਿਆ ਦੇਇ ਜਗਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aape kare karaae aape ikanaa sutiaa dee jagaae |
English: He Himself does, and He Himself causes others to do; He wakes some from their sleep.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੮॥੭॥੨੪॥
Transliteration: aape mel milaaeidaa naanak sabad samaae |8|7|24|
English: He Himself unites us in Union; Nanak is absorbed in the Shabad. ||8||7||24||

[Ang 69 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 |
English: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਭਏ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: satigur seviai man niramalaa bhe pavit sareer |
English: Serving the True Guru, the mind becomes immaculate, and the body becomes pure.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: man aanand sadaa sukh paaeaa bhettiaa gahir ganbheer |
English: The mind obtains bliss and eternal peace, meeting with the Deep and Profound Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਚੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਬੈਸਣਾ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sachee sangat baisanaa sach naam man dheer |1|
English: Sitting in the Sangat, the True Congregation, the mind is comforted and consoled by the True Name. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਨਿਸੰਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: man re satigur sev nisang |
English: O mind, serve the True Guru without hesitation.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਮੈਲੁ ਪਤੰਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur seviai har man vasai lagai na mail patang |1| rahaau |
English: Serving the True Guru, the Lord abides within the mind, and no trace of filth shall attach itself to you. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sachai sabad pat aoopajai sache sachaa naau |
English: From the True Word of the Shabad comes honor. True is the Name of the True One.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jinee haumai maar pachhaaniaa hau tin balihaarai jaau |
English: I am a sacrifice to those who conquer their ego and recognize the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਤਿਨ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਥਾਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: manamukh sach na jaananee tin tthaur na katahoo thaau |2|
English: The self-willed manmukhs do not know the True One; they find no shelter, and no place of rest anywhere. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਪੈਨਣਾ ਸਚੇ ਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: sach khaanaa sach painanaa sache hee vich vaas |
English: Those who take the Truth as their food and the Truth as their clothing, have their home in the True One.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sachaa saalaahanaa sachai sabad nivaas |
English: They constantly praise the True One, and in the True Word of the Shabad they have their dwelling.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sabh aatam raam pachhaaniaa guramatee nij ghar vaas |3|
English: They recognize the Lord, the Supreme Soul in all, and through the Guru's Teachings they dwell in the home of their own inner self. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਵੇਖਣੁ ਸਚੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sach vekhan sach bolanaa tan man sachaa hoe |
English: They see the Truth, and they speak the Truth; their bodies and minds are True.

Gurbani: ਸਚੀ ਸਾਖੀ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sachee saakhee upades sach sache sachee soe |
English: True are their teachings, and True are their instructions; True are the reputations of the true ones.

Gurbani: ਜਿੰਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਸੇ ਦੁਖੀਏ ਚਲੇ ਰੋਇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jinee sach visaariaa se dukhee chale roe |4|
English: Those who have forgotten the True One are miserable-they depart weeping and wailing. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਸੇ ਕਿਤੁ ਆਏ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: satigur jinee na sevio se kit aae sansaar |
English: Those who have not served the True Guru-why did they even bother to come into the world?

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਕੂਕ ਨ ਸੁਣੈ ਪੂਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: jam dar badhe maareeeh kook na sunai pookaar |
English: They are bound and gagged and beaten at Death's door, but no one hears their shrieks and cries.

Gurbani: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: birathaa janam gavaaeaa mar jameh vaaro vaar |5|
English: They waste their lives uselessly; they die and are reincarnated over and over again. ||5||

Gurbani: ਏਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਜਲਤਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ ਭਜਿ ਪਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: ehu jag jalataa dekh kai bhaj pe satigur saranaa |
English: Seeing this world on fire, I rushed to the Sanctuary of the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ ਸਦਾ ਸਚਿ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਰਹਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sach dirraaeaa sadaa sach sanjam rahanaa |
English: The True Guru has implanted the Truth within me; I dwell steadfastly in Truth and self-restraint.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਚਾ ਹੈ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਸਬਦੇ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰਣਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: satigur sachaa hai bohithaa sabade bhavajal taranaa |6|
English: The True Guru is the Boat of Truth; in the Word of the Shabad, we cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||6||

Gurbani: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਫਿਰਦੇ ਰਹੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh firade rahe bin satigur mukat na hoee |
English: People continue wandering through the cycle of 8.4 million incarnations; without the True Guru, liberation is not obtained.

Gurbani: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮੋਨੀ ਥਕੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: parr parr panddit monee thake doojai bhaae pat khoee |
English: Reading and studying, the Pandits and the silent sages have grown weary, but attached to the love of duality, they have lost their honor.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਚੇ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: satigur sabad sunaaeaa bin sache avar na koee |7|
English: The True Guru teaches the Word of the Shabad; without the True One, there is no other at all. ||7||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਸਚੈ ਲਾਏ ਸੇ ਸਚਿ ਲਗੇ ਨਿਤ ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਰੰਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: jo sachai laae se sach lage nit sachee kaar karan |
English: Those who are linked by the True One are linked to Truth. They always act in Truth.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੈ ਮਹਲਿ ਰਹੰਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: tinaa nij ghar vaasaa paaeaa sachai mehal rahan |
English: They attain their dwelling in the home of their own inner being, and they abide in the Mansion of Truth.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਚੰਨਿ ॥੮॥੧੭॥੮॥੨੫॥
Transliteration: naanak bhagat sukhee sadaa sachai naam rachan |8|17|8|25|
English: O Nanak, the devotees are happy and peaceful forever. They are absorbed in the True Name. ||8||17||8||25||

[Ang 70 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 |
English: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਮੁਸਕਲੁ ਅਤਿ ਬਣੈ ਢੋਈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਦੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kau musakal at banai dtoee koe na dee |
English: When you are confronted with terrible hardships, and no one offers you any support,

Gurbani: ਲਾਗੂ ਹੋਏ ਦੁਸਮਨਾ ਸਾਕ ਭਿ ਭਜਿ ਖਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: laagoo hoe dusamanaa saak bhi bhaj khale |
English: when your friends turn into enemies, and even your relatives have deserted you,

Gurbani: ਸਭੋ ਭਜੈ ਆਸਰਾ ਚੁਕੈ ਸਭੁ ਅਸਰਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sabho bhajai aasaraa chukai sabh asaraau |
English: and when all support has given way, and all hope has been lost

Gurbani: ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਓਸੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਤਤੀ ਵਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: chit aavai os paarabraham lagai na tatee vaau |1|
English: -if you then come to remember the Supreme Lord God, even the hot wind shall not touch you. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਨਿਤਾਣਿਆ ਕਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: saahib nitaaniaa kaa taan |
English: Our Lord and Master is the Power of the powerless.

Gurbani: ਆਇ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਥਿਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aae na jaaee thir sadaa gurasabadee sach jaan |1| rahaau |
English: He does not come or go; He is Eternal and Permanent. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is known as True. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਦੁਬਲਾ ਨੰਗ ਭੁਖ ਕੀ ਪੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: je ko hovai dubalaa nang bhukh kee peer |
English: If you are weakened by the pains of hunger and poverty,

Gurbani: ਦਮੜਾ ਪਲੈ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਧੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: damarraa palai naa pavai naa ko devai dheer |
English: with no money in your pockets, and no one will give you any comfort,

Gurbani: ਸੁਆਰਥੁ ਸੁਆਉ ਨ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਾਜੁ ॥
Transliteration: suaarath suaau na ko kare naa kichh hovai kaaj |
English: and no one will satisfy your hopes and desires, and none of your works is accomplished

Gurbani: ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਓਸੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਤਾ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਰਾਜੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: chit aavai os paarabraham taa nihachal hovai raaj |2|
English: -if you then come to remember the Supreme Lord God, you shall obtain the eternal kingdom. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kau chintaa bahut bahut dehee viaapai rog |
English: When you are plagued by great and excessive anxiety, and diseases of the body;

Gurbani: ਗ੍ਰਿਸਤਿ ਕੁਟੰਬਿ ਪਲੇਟਿਆ ਕਦੇ ਹਰਖੁ ਕਦੇ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: grisat kuttanb palettiaa kade harakh kade sog |
English: when you are wrapped up in the attachments of household and family, sometimes feeling joy, and then other times sorrow;

Gurbani: ਗਉਣੁ ਕਰੇ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਟ ਕਾ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਬੈਸਣੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: gaun kare chahu kuntt kaa gharree na baisan soe |
English: when you are wandering around in all four directions, and you cannot sit or sleep even for a moment

Gurbani: ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਓਸੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: chit aavai os paarabraham tan man seetal hoe |3|
English: -if you come to remember the Supreme Lord God, then your body and mind shall be cooled and soothed. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਾਮਿ ਕਰੋਧਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਆ ਕਿਰਪਨ ਲੋਭਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: kaam karodh mohi vas keea kirapan lobh piaar |
English: When you are under the power of sexual desire, anger and worldly attachment, or a greedy miser in love with your wealth;

Gurbani: ਚਾਰੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਉਨਿ ਅਘ ਕੀਏ ਹੋਆ ਅਸੁਰ ਸੰਘਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: chaare kilavikh un agh kee hoaa asur sanghaar |
English: if you have committed the four great sins and other mistakes; even if you are a murderous fiend

Gurbani: ਪੋਥੀ ਗੀਤ ਕਵਿਤ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਕਰਨਿ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: pothee geet kavit kichh kade na karan dhariaa |
English: who has never taken the time to listen to sacred books, hymns and poetry

Gurbani: ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਓਸੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਤਾ ਨਿਮਖ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਤਰਿਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: chit aavai os paarabraham taa nimakh simarat tariaa |4|
English: -if you then come to remember the Supreme Lord God, and contemplate Him, even for a moment, you shall be saved. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਤ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਬੇਦ ਚਾਰਿ ਮੁਖਾਗਰ ਬਿਚਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: saasat sinmrit bed chaar mukhaagar bichare |
English: People may recite by heart the Shaastras, the Simritees and the four Vedas;

Gurbani: ਤਪੇ ਤਪੀਸਰ ਜੋਗੀਆ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਗਵਨੁ ਕਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: tape tapeesar jogeea teerath gavan kare |
English: they may be ascetics, great, self-disciplined Yogis; they may visit sacred shrines of pilgrimage

Gurbani: ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਤੇ ਦੁਗੁਣੇ ਪੂਜਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਨਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: khatt karamaa te dugune poojaa karataa naae |
English: and perform the six ceremonial rituals, over and over again, performing worship services and ritual bathings.

Gurbani: ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਲਗੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਤਾ ਸਰਪਰ ਨਰਕੇ ਜਾਇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: rang na lagee paarabraham taa sarapar narake jaae |5|
English: Even so, if they have not embraced love for the Supreme Lord God, then they shall surely go to hell. ||5||

Gurbani: ਰਾਜ ਮਿਲਕ ਸਿਕਦਾਰੀਆ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: raaj milak sikadaareea ras bhogan bisathaar |
English: You may possess empires, vast estates, authority over others, and the enjoyment of myriads of pleasures;

Gurbani: ਬਾਗ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਚਲੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਅਫਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: baag suhaave sohane chalai hukam afaar |
English: you may have delightful and beautiful gardens, and issue unquestioned commands;

Gurbani: ਰੰਗ ਤਮਾਸੇ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧੀ ਚਾਇ ਲਗਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: rang tamaase bahu bidhee chaae lag rahiaa |
English: you may have enjoyments and entertainments of all sorts and kinds, and continue to enjoy exciting pleasures

Gurbani: ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਤਾ ਸਰਪ ਕੀ ਜੂਨਿ ਗਇਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: chit na aaeo paarabraham taa sarap kee joon geaa |6|
English: -and yet, if you do not come to remember the Supreme Lord God, you shall be reincarnated as a snake. ||6||

Gurbani: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਧਨਾਢਿ ਅਚਾਰਵੰਤੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: bahut dhanaadt achaaravant sobhaa niramal reet |
English: You may possess vast riches, maintain virtuous conduct, have a spotless reputation and observe religious customs;

Gurbani: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਭਾਈਆ ਸਾਜਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: maat pitaa sut bhaaeea saajan sang pareet |
English: you may have the loving affections of mother, father, children, siblings and friends;

Gurbani: ਲਸਕਰ ਤਰਕਸਬੰਦ ਬੰਦ ਜੀਉ ਜੀਉ ਸਗਲੀ ਕੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: lasakar tarakasaband band jeeo jeeo sagalee keet |
English: you may have armies well-equipped with weapons, and all may salute you with respect;

Gurbani: ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਤਾ ਖੜਿ ਰਸਾਤਲਿ ਦੀਤ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: chit na aaeo paarabraham taa kharr rasaatal deet |7|
English: But still, if you do not come to remember the Supreme Lord God, then you shall be taken and consigned to the most hideous hell! ||7||

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਛਿਦ੍ਰੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਾੜਾ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa rog na chhidru kichh naa kichh kaarraa sog |
English: You may have a body free of disease and deformity, and have no worries or grief at all;

Gurbani: ਮਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਆਵੀ ਚਿਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭੋਗੈ ਭੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: mirat na aavee chit tis ahinis bhogai bhog |
English: you may be unmindful of death, and night and day revel in pleasures;

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਜੀਇ ਨ ਸੰਕ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh keeton aapanaa jee na sank dhariaa |
English: you may take everything as your own, and have no fear in your mind at all;

Gurbani: ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਮਕੰਕਰ ਵਸਿ ਪਰਿਆ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: chit na aaeo paarabraham jamakankar vas pariaa |8|
English: but still, if you do not come to remember the Supreme Lord God, you shall fall under the power of the Messenger of Death. ||8||

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: kirapaa kare jis paarabraham hovai saadhoo sang |
English: The Supreme Lord showers His Mercy, and we find the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਓਹੁ ਵਧਾਈਐ ਤਿਉ ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: jiau jiau ohu vadhaaeeai tiau tiau har siau rang |
English: The more time we spend there, the more we come to love the Lord.

Gurbani: ਦੁਹਾ ਸਿਰਿਆ ਕਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਆਪਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਥਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: duhaa siriaa kaa khasam aap avar na doojaa thaau |
English: The Lord is the Master of both worlds; there is no other place of rest.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੁਠੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੯॥੧॥੨੬॥
Transliteration: satigur tutthai paaeaa naanak sachaa naau |9|1|26|
English: When the True Guru is pleased and satisfied, O Nanak, the True Name is obtained. ||9||1||26||

[Ang 71 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ghar 5 |
English: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl, Fifth House:

Gurbani: ਜਾਨਉ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਵੈ ਕਵਨ ਬਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaanau nahee bhaavai kavan baataa |
English: I do not know what pleases my Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਖੋਜਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: man khoj maarag |1| rahaau |
English: O mind, seek out the way! ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਧਿਆਨੀ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਲਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: dhiaanee dhiaan laaveh |
English: The meditatives practice meditation,

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: giaanee giaan kamaaveh |
English: and the wise practice spiritual wisdom,

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: prabh kin hee jaataa |1|
English: but how rare are those who know God! ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਗਉਤੀ ਰਹਤ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: bhgautee rehat jugataa |
English: The worshipper of Bhagaauti practices self-discipline,

Gurbani: ਜੋਗੀ ਕਹਤ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: jogee kehat mukataa |
English: the Yogi speaks of liberation,

Gurbani: ਤਪਸੀ ਤਪਹਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tapasee tapeh raataa |2|
English: and the ascetic is absorbed in asceticism. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮੋਨੀ ਮੋਨਿਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: monee monidhaaree |
English: The men of silence observe silence,

Gurbani: ਸਨਿਆਸੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: saniaasee brahamachaaree |
English: the Sanyaasees observe celibacy,

Gurbani: ਉਦਾਸੀ ਉਦਾਸਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: audaasee udaas raataa |3|
English: and the Udaasees abide in detachment. ||3||

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਨਵੈ ਪਰਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat navai parakaaraa |
English: There are nine forms of devotional worship.

Gurbani: ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਵੇਦੁ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: panddit ved pukaaraa |
English: The Pandits recite the Vedas.

Gurbani: ਗਿਰਸਤੀ ਗਿਰਸਤਿ ਧਰਮਾਤਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: girasatee girasat dharamaataa |4|
English: The householders assert their faith in family life. ||4||

Gurbani: ਇਕ ਸਬਦੀ ਬਹੁ ਰੂਪਿ ਅਵਧੂਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: eik sabadee bahu roop avadhootaa |
English: Those who utter only One Word, those who take many forms, the naked renunciates,

Gurbani: ਕਾਪੜੀ ਕਉਤੇ ਜਾਗੂਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaaparree kaute jaagootaa |
English: the wearers of patched coats, the magicians, those who remain always awake,

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਤਾ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: eik teerath naataa |5|
English: and those who bathe at holy places of pilgrimage-||5||

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਹਾਰ ਵਰਤੀ ਆਪਰਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: nirahaar varatee aaparasaa |
English: Those who go without food, those who never touch others,

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਲੂਕਿ ਨ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਦਰਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: eik look na deveh darasaa |
English: the hermits who never show themselves,

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਗਿਆਤਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: eik man hee giaataa |6|
English: and those who are wise in their own minds-||6||

Gurbani: ਘਾਟਿ ਨ ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਕਹਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: ghaatt na kin hee kahaaeaa |
English: Of these, no one admits to any deficiency;

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਕਹਤੇ ਹੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kahate hai paaeaa |
English: all say that they have found the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੋ ਭਗਤਾ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: jis mele so bhagataa |7|
English: But he alone is a devotee, whom the Lord has united with Himself. ||7||

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਉਕਤਿ ਉਪਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: sagal ukat upaavaa |
English: Abandoning all devices and contrivances,

Gurbani: ਤਿਆਗੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: tiaagee saran paavaa |
English: I have sought His Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣਿ ਪਰਾਤਾ ॥੮॥੨॥੨੭॥
Transliteration: naanak gur charan paraataa |8|2|27|
English: Nanak has fallen at the Feet of the Guru. ||8||2||27||

[Ang 71 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ghar 3 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Third House:

Gurbani: ਜੋਗੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜੋਗੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: jogee andar jogeea |
English: Among Yogis, You are the Yogi;

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਭੋਗੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਭੋਗੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: toon bhogee andar bhogeea |
English: among pleasure seekers, You are the Pleasure Seeker.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁਰਗਿ ਮਛਿ ਪਇਆਲਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: teraa ant na paaeaa surag machh peaal jeeo |1|
English: Your limits are not known to any of the beings in the heavens, in this world, or in the nether regions of the underworld. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਹਉ ਵਾਰਣੈ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਵ ਨੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hau vaaree hau vaaranai kurabaan tere naav no |1| rahaau |
English: I am devoted, dedicated, a sacrifice to Your Name. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tudh sansaar upaaeaa |
English: You created the world,

Gurbani: ਸਿਰੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧੇ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sire sir dhandhe laaeaa |
English: and assigned tasks to one and all.

Gurbani: ਵੇਖਹਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਪਾਸਾ ਢਾਲਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: vekheh keetaa aapanaa kar kudarat paasaa dtaal jeeo |2|
English: You watch over Your Creation, and through Your All-powerful Creative Potency, You cast the dice. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪਰਗਟਿ ਪਾਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਪਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: paragatt paahaarai jaapadaa |
English: You are manifest in the Expanse of Your Workshop.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨੋ ਪਰਤਾਪਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabh naavai no parataapadaa |
English: Everyone longs for Your Name,

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਭ ਮੋਹੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਾਲਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: satigur baajh na paaeo sabh mohee maaeaa jaal jeeo |3|
English: but without the Guru, no one finds You. All are enticed and trapped by Maya. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: satigur kau bal jaaeeai |
English: I am a sacrifice to the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: jit miliai param gat paaeeai |
English: Meeting Him, the supreme status is obtained.

Gurbani: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਲੋਚਦੇ ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਬੁਝਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: sur nar mun jan lochade so satigur deea bujhaae jeeo |4|
English: The angelic beings and the silent sages long for Him; the True Guru has given me this understanding. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈਸੀ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: satasangat kaisee jaaneeai |
English: How is the Society of the Saints to be known?

Gurbani: ਜਿਥੈ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: jithai eko naam vakhaaneeai |
English: There, the Name of the One Lord is chanted.

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਬੁਝਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: eko naam hukam hai naanak satigur deea bujhaae jeeo |5|
English: The One Name is the Lord's Command; O Nanak, the True Guru has given me this understanding. ||5||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: eihu jagat bharam bhulaaeaa |
English: This world has been deluded by doubt.

Gurbani: ਆਪਹੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਖੁਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aapahu tudh khuaaeaa |
English: You Yourself, Lord, have led it astray.

Gurbani: ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਲਗਾ ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਭਾਗ ਜਿਨਾ ਕੇ ਨਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: parataap lagaa dohaaganee bhaag jinaa ke naeh jeeo |6|
English: The discarded soul-brides suffer in terrible agony; they have no luck at all. ||6||

Gurbani: ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਕਿਆ ਨੀਸਾਣੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: dohaaganee kiaa neesaaneea |
English: What are the signs of the discarded brides?

Gurbani: ਖਸਮਹੁ ਘੁਥੀਆ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਨਿਮਾਣੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: khasamahu ghutheea fireh nimaaneea |
English: They miss their Husband Lord, and they wander around in dishonor.

Gurbani: ਮੈਲੇ ਵੇਸ ਤਿਨਾ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਦੁਖੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: maile ves tinaa kaamanee dukhee rain vihaae jeeo |7|
English: The clothes of those brides are filthy-they pass their life-night in agony. ||7||

Gurbani: ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sohaaganee kiaa karam kamaaeaa |
English: What actions have the happy soul-brides performed?

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: poorab likhiaa fal paaeaa |
English: They have obtained the fruit of their pre-ordained destiny.

Gurbani: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਕੈ ਆਪਣੀ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: nadar kare kai aapanee aape le milaae jeeo |8|
English: Casting His Glance of Grace, the Lord unites them with Himself. ||8||

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਜਿਨਾ ਨੋ ਮਨਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: hukam jinaa no manaaeaa |
English: Those, whom God causes to abide by His Will,

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tin antar sabad vasaaeaa |
English: have the Shabad of His Word abiding deep within.

Gurbani: ਸਹੀਆ ਸੇ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨ ਸਹ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: saheea se sohaaganee jin seh naal piaar jeeo |9|
English: They are the true soul-brides, who embrace love for their Husband Lord. ||9||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਾ ਭਾਣੇ ਕਾ ਰਸੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jinaa bhaane kaa ras aaeaa |
English: Those who take pleasure in God's Will

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tin vichahu bharam chukaaeaa |
English: remove doubt from within.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਐਸਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜੋ ਸਭਸੈ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: naanak satigur aisaa jaaneeai jo sabhasai le milaae jeeo |10|
English: O Nanak, know Him as the True Guru, who unites all with the Lord. ||10||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: satigur miliai fal paaeaa |
English: Meeting with the True Guru, they receive the fruits of their destiny,

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਅਹਕਰਣੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jin vichahu ahakaran chukaaeaa |
English: and egotism is driven out from within.

Gurbani: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਟਿਆ ਭਾਗੁ ਬੈਠਾ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਆਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: duramat kaa dukh kattiaa bhaag baitthaa masatak aae jeeo |11|
English: The pain of evil-mindedness is eliminated; good fortune comes and shines radiantly from their foreheads. ||11||

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: amrit teree baaneea |
English: The Bani of Your Word is Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਿਆ ਭਗਤਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਣੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: teriaa bhagataa ridai samaaneea |
English: It permeates the hearts of Your devotees.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਸੇਵਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਖਿਐ ਆਪਣੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: sukh sevaa andar rakhiai aapanee nadar kareh nisataar jeeo |12|
English: Serving You, peace is obtained; granting Your Mercy, You bestow salvation. ||12||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: satigur miliaa jaaneeai |
English: Meeting with the True Guru, one comes to know;

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: jit miliai naam vakhaaneeai |
English: by this meeting, one comes to chant the Name.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਭ ਥਕੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: satigur baajh na paaeo sabh thakee karam kamaae jeeo |13|
English: Without the True Guru, God is not found; all have grown weary of performing religious rituals. ||13||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਘੁਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau satigur vittahu ghumaaeaa |
English: I am a sacrifice to the True Guru;

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jin bhram bhulaa maarag paaeaa |
English: I was wandering in doubt, and He has set me on the right path.

Gurbani: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਰਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: nadar kare je aapanee aape le ralaae jeeo |14|
English: If the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, He unites us with Himself. ||14||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: toon sabhanaa maeh samaaeaa |
English: You, Lord, are pervading in all,

Gurbani: ਤਿਨਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਆਪੁ ਲੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tin karatai aap lukaaeaa |
English: and yet, the Creator keeps Himself concealed.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇਆ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਜੋਤਿ ਧਰੀ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh paragatt hoeaa jaa kau jot dharee karataar jeeo |15|
English: O Nanak, the Creator is revealed to the Gurmukh, within whom He has infused His Light. ||15||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਖਸਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਜਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: aape khasam nivaajiaa |
English: The Master Himself bestows honor.

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਦੇ ਸਾਜਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jeeo pindd de saajiaa |
English: He creates and bestows body and soul.

Gurbani: ਆਪਣੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੀਆ ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: aapane sevak kee paij rakheea due kar masatak dhaar jeeo |16|
English: He Himself preserves the honor of His servants; He places both His Hands upon their foreheads. ||16||

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਸੰਜਮ ਰਹੇ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabh sanjam rahe siaanapaa |
English: All strict rituals are just clever contrivances.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: meraa prabh sabh kichh jaanadaa |
English: My God knows everything.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ਵਰਤਾਇਓ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਕੁ ਕਰੈ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: pragatt prataap varataaeo sabh lok karai jaikaar jeeo |17|
English: He has made His Glory manifest, and all people celebrate Him. ||17||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਅਵਗਨ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: mere gun avagan na beechaariaa |
English: He has not considered my merits and demerits;

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਣਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: prabh apanaa birad samaariaa |
English: this is God's Own Nature.

Gurbani: ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਕੈ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਤਤੀ ਵਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: kantth laae kai rakhion lagai na tatee vaau jeeo |18|
English: Hugging me close in His Embrace, He protects me, and now, even the hot wind does not touch me. ||18||

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: mai man tan prabhoo dhiaaeaa |
English: Within my mind and body, I meditate on God.

Gurbani: ਜੀਇ ਇਛਿਅੜਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jee ichhiarraa fal paaeaa |
English: I have obtained the fruits of my soul's desire.

Gurbani: ਸਾਹ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਸਿਰਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਤੂੰ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵੈ ਨਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: saah paatisaah sir khasam toon jap naanak jeevai naau jeeo |19|
English: You are the Supreme Lord and Master, above the heads of kings. Nanak lives by chanting Your Name. ||19||

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tudh aape aap upaaeaa |
English: You Yourself created the Universe;

Gurbani: ਦੂਜਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਦਿਖਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: doojaa khel kar dikhalaaeaa |
English: You created the play of duality, and staged it.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਬੁਝਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: sabh sacho sach varatadaa jis bhaavai tisai bujhaae jeeo |20|
English: The Truest of the True is pervading everywhere; He instructs those with whom He is pleased. ||20||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee paaeaa |
English: By Guru's Grace, I have found God.

Gurbani: ਤਿਥੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tithai maaeaa mohu chukaaeaa |
English: By His Grace, I have shed emotional attachment to Maya.

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਆਪਣੀ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਸਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨੧॥
Transliteration: kirapaa kar kai aapanee aape le samaae jeeo |21|
English: Showering His Mercy, He has blended me into Himself. ||21||

Gurbani: ਗੋਪੀ ਨੈ ਗੋਆਲੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: gopee nai goaaleea |
English: You are the Gopis, the milk-maids of Krishna; You are the sacred river Jamunaa; You are Krishna, the herdsman.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਗੋਇ ਉਠਾਲੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: tudh aape goe utthaaleea |
English: You Yourself support the world.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਭਾਂਡੇ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਭੰਨਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੨੨॥
Transliteration: hukamee bhaandde saajiaa toon aape bhan savaar jeeo |22|
English: By Your Command, human beings are fashioned. You Yourself embellish them, and then again destroy them. ||22||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jin satigur siau chit laaeaa |
English: Those who have focused their consciousness on the True Guru

Gurbani: ਤਿਨੀ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tinee doojaa bhaau chukaaeaa |
English: have rid themselves of the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀਆ ਓਇ ਚਲੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੨੩॥
Transliteration: niramal jot tin praaneea oe chale janam savaar jeeo |23|
English: The light of those mortal beings is immaculate. They depart after redeeming their lives. ||23||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੀਆ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: tereea sadaa sadaa changiaaeea |
English: I praise the Greatness of Your Goodness,

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਹੈ ਵਡਿਆਈਆਂ ॥
Transliteration: mai raat dihai vaddiaaeean |
English: Forever and ever, night and day.

Gurbani: ਅਣਮੰਗਿਆ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵਣਾ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੨੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: anamangiaa daan devanaa kahu naanak sach samaal jeeo |24|1|
English: You bestow Your Gifts, even if we do not ask for them. Says Nanak, contemplate the True Lord. ||24||1||

[Ang 73 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 |
English: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪੈ ਪਾਇ ਮਨਾਈ ਸੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: pai paae manaaee soe jeeo |
English: I fall at His Feet to please and appease Him.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur purakh milaaeaa tis jevadd avar na koe jeeo |1| rahaau |
English: The True Guru has united me with the Lord, the Primal Being. There is no other as great as He. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੋਸਾਈ ਮਿਹੰਡਾ ਇਠੜਾ ॥
Transliteration: gosaaee mihanddaa ittharraa |
English: The Lord of the Universe is my Sweet Beloved.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ ਅਬੇ ਥਾਵਹੁ ਮਿਠੜਾ ॥
Transliteration: am abe thaavahu mittharraa |
English: He is sweeter than my mother or father.

Gurbani: ਭੈਣ ਭਾਈ ਸਭਿ ਸਜਣਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਹਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bhain bhaaee sabh sajanaa tudh jehaa naahee koe jeeo |1|
English: Among all sisters and brothers and friends, there is no one like You. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸਾਵਣੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: terai hukame saavan aaeaa |
English: By Your Command, the month of Saawan has come.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਸਤ ਕਾ ਹਲੁ ਜੋਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: mai sat kaa hal joaaeaa |
English: I have hooked up the plow of Truth,

Gurbani: ਨਾਉ ਬੀਜਣ ਲਗਾ ਆਸ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਹਲ ਬਖਸ ਜਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naau beejan lagaa aas kar har bohal bakhas jamaae jeeo |2|
English: and I plant the seed of the Name in hopes that the Lord, in His Generosity, will bestow a bountiful harvest. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਇਕੁ ਪਛਾਣਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: hau gur mil ik pachhaanadaa |
English: Meeting with the Guru, I recognize only the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਦੁਯਾ ਕਾਗਲੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: duyaa kaagal chit na jaanadaa |
English: In my consciousness, I do not know of any other account.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਇਕਤੈ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਇਓਨੁ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਂਵੈ ਨਿਬਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har ikatai kaarai laaeon jiau bhaavai tinvai nibaeh jeeo |3|
English: The Lord has assigned one task to me; as it pleases Him, I perform it. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤੁਸੀ ਭੋਗਿਹੁ ਭੁੰਚਹੁ ਭਾਈਹੋ ॥
Transliteration: tusee bhogihu bhunchahu bhaaeeho |
English: Enjoy yourselves and eat, O Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਬਾਣਿ ਕਵਾਇ ਪੈਨਾਈਓ ॥
Transliteration: gur deebaan kavaae painaaeeo |
English: In the Guru's Court, He has blessed me with the Robe of Honor.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਹੋਆ ਮਾਹਰੁ ਪਿੰਡ ਦਾ ਬੰਨਿ ਆਦੇ ਪੰਜਿ ਸਰੀਕ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: hau hoaa maahar pindd daa ban aade panj sareek jeeo |4|
English: I have become the Master of my body-village; I have taken the five rivals as prisoners. ||4||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਆਇਆ ਸਾਮੑੈ ਤਿਹੰਡੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau aaeaa saamai tihanddeea |
English: I have come to Your Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਪੰਜਿ ਕਿਰਸਾਣ ਮੁਜੇਰੇ ਮਿਹਡਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: panj kirasaan mujere mihaddiaa |
English: The five farm-hands have become my tenants;

Gurbani: ਕੰਨੁ ਕੋਈ ਕਢਿ ਨ ਹੰਘਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਵੁਠਾ ਘੁਘਿ ਗਿਰਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: kan koee kadt na hanghee naanak vutthaa ghugh giraau jeeo |5|
English: none dare to raise their heads against me. O Nanak, my village is populous and prosperous. ||5||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਘੁੰਮਾ ਜਾਵਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: hau vaaree ghunmaa jaavadaa |
English: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to You.

Gurbani: ਇਕ ਸਾਹਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: eik saahaa tudh dhiaaeidaa |
English: I meditate on You continually.

Gurbani: ਉਜੜੁ ਥੇਹੁ ਵਸਾਇਓ ਹਉ ਤੁਧ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: aujarr thehu vasaaeo hau tudh vittahu kurabaan jeeo |6|
English: The village was in ruins, but You have re-populated it. I am a sacrifice to You. ||6||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਇਠੈ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: har itthai nit dhiaaeidaa |
English: O Beloved Lord, I meditate on You continually;

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦੀ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: man chindee so fal paaeidaa |
English: I obtain the fruits of my mind's desires.

Gurbani: ਸਭੇ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਿਅਨੁ ਲਾਹੀਅਨੁ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਭੁਖ ਜੀਉ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: sabhe kaaj savaarian laaheean man kee bhukh jeeo |7|
English: All my affairs are arranged, and the hunger of my mind is appeased. ||7||

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਛਡਿਆ ਸਭੋ ਧੰਧੜਾ ॥
Transliteration: mai chhaddiaa sabho dhandharraa |
English: I have forsaken all my entanglements;

Gurbani: ਗੋਸਾਈ ਸੇਵੀ ਸਚੜਾ ॥
Transliteration: gosaaee sevee sacharraa |
English: I serve the True Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੈ ਪਲੈ ਬਧਾ ਛਿਕਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: nau nidh naam nidhaan har mai palai badhaa chhik jeeo |8|
English: I have firmly attached the Name, the Home of the Nine Treasures to my robe. ||8||

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਸੁਖੀ ਹੂੰ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: mai sukhee hoon sukh paaeaa |
English: I have obtained the comfort of comforts.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur antar sabad vasaaeaa |
English: The Guru has implanted the Word of the Shabad deep within me.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਵਿਖਾਲਿਆ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਰਿ ਕੈ ਹਥੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: satigur purakh vikhaaliaa masatak dhar kai hath jeeo |9|
English: The True Guru has shown me my Husband Lord; He has placed His Hand upon my forehead. ||9||

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਬਧੀ ਸਚੁ ਧਰਮ ਸਾਲ ਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: mai badhee sach dharam saal hai |
English: I have established the Temple of Truth.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਲਹਦਾ ਭਾਲਿ ਕੈ ॥
Transliteration: gurasikhaa lahadaa bhaal kai |
English: I sought out the Guru's Sikhs, and brought them into it.

Gurbani: ਪੈਰ ਧੋਵਾ ਪਖਾ ਫੇਰਦਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਗਾ ਪਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: pair dhovaa pakhaa feradaa tis niv niv lagaa paae jeeo |10|
English: I wash their feet, and wave the fan over them. Bowing low, I fall at their feet. ||10||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਗਲਾ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sun galaa gur peh aaeaa |
English: I heard of the Guru, and so I went to Him.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: naam daan isanaan dirraaeaa |
English: He instilled within me the Naam, the goodness of charity and true cleansing.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹੋਆ ਸੈਸਾਰੜਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੀ ਬੇੜੀ ਚਾੜਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: sabh mukat hoaa saisaararraa naanak sachee berree chaarr jeeo |11|
English: All the world is liberated, O Nanak, by embarking upon the Boat of Truth. ||11||

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸੇਵੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: sabh srisatt seve din raat jeeo |
English: The whole Universe serves You, day and night.

Gurbani: ਦੇ ਕੰਨੁ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: de kan sunahu aradaas jeeo |
English: Please hear my prayer, O Dear Lord.

Gurbani: ਠੋਕਿ ਵਜਾਇ ਸਭ ਡਿਠੀਆ ਤੁਸਿ ਆਪੇ ਲਇਅਨੁ ਛਡਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: tthok vajaae sabh ddittheea tus aape leian chhaddaae jeeo |12|
English: I have thoroughly tested and seen all-You alone, by Your Pleasure, can save us. ||12||

Gurbani: ਹੁਣਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੋਆ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਣ ਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: hun hukam hoaa miharavaan daa |
English: Now, the Merciful Lord has issued His Command.

Gurbani: ਪੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸੈ ਰਞਾਣਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: pai koe na kisai rayaanadaa |
English: Let no one chase after and attack anyone else.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਵੁਠੀਆ ਇਹੁ ਹੋਆ ਹਲੇਮੀ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: sabh sukhaalee vuttheea ihu hoaa halemee raaj jeeo |13|
English: Let all abide in peace, under this Benevolent Rule. ||13||

Gurbani: ਝਿੰਮਿ ਝਿੰਮਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵਰਸਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: jhinm jhinm amrit varasadaa |
English: Softly and gently, drop by drop, the Ambrosial Nectar trickles down.

Gurbani: ਬੋਲਾਇਆ ਬੋਲੀ ਖਸਮ ਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: bolaaeaa bolee khasam daa |
English: I speak as my Lord and Master causes me to speak.

Gurbani: ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣੁ ਕੀਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਉਪਰੇ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਇਹਿ ਥਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: bahu maan keea tudh upare toon aape paaeihi thaae jeeo |14|
English: I place all my faith in You; please accept me. ||14||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਿਆ ਭਗਤਾ ਭੁਖ ਸਦ ਤੇਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: teriaa bhagataa bhukh sad tereea |
English: Your devotees are forever hungry for You.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਲੋਚਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਮੇਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: har lochaa pooran mereea |
English: O Lord, please fulfill my desires.

Gurbani: ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਿਆ ਮੈ ਗਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: dehu daras sukhadaatiaa mai gal vich laihu milaae jeeo |15|
English: Grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, O Giver of Peace. Please, take me into Your Embrace. ||15||

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: tudh jevadd avar na bhaaliaa |
English: I have not found any other as Great as You.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਦੀਪ ਲੋਅ ਪਇਆਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: toon deep loa peaaliaa |
English: You pervade the continents, the worlds and the nether regions;

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਥਾਨਿ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: toon thaan thanantar rav rahiaa naanak bhagataa sach adhaar jeeo |16|
English: You are permeating all places and interspaces. Nanak: You are the True Support of Your devotees. ||16||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਗੋਸਾਈ ਦਾ ਪਹਿਲਵਾਨੜਾ ॥
Transliteration: hau gosaaee daa pahilavaanarraa |
English: I am a wrestler; I belong to the Lord of the World.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਉਚ ਦੁਮਾਲੜਾ ॥
Transliteration: mai gur mil uch dumaalarraa |
English: I met with the Guru, and I have tied a tall, plumed turban.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਹੋਈ ਛਿੰਝ ਇਕਠੀਆ ਦਯੁ ਬੈਠਾ ਵੇਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: sabh hoee chhinjh ikattheea day baitthaa vekhai aap jeeo |17|
English: All have gathered to watch the wrestling match, and the Merciful Lord Himself is seated to behold it. ||17||

Gurbani: ਵਾਤ ਵਜਨਿ ਟੰਮਕ ਭੇਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: vaat vajan ttamak bhereea |
English: The bugles play and the drums beat.

Gurbani: ਮਲ ਲਥੇ ਲੈਦੇ ਫੇਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: mal lathe laide fereea |
English: The wrestlers enter the arena and circle around.

Gurbani: ਨਿਹਤੇ ਪੰਜਿ ਜੁਆਨ ਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਥਾਪੀ ਦਿਤੀ ਕੰਡਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: nihate panj juaan mai gur thaapee ditee kandd jeeo |18|
English: I have thrown the five challengers to the ground, and the Guru has patted me on the back. ||18||

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਇਕਠੇ ਹੋਇ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabh ikatthe hoe aaeaa |
English: All have gathered together,

Gurbani: ਘਰਿ ਜਾਸਨਿ ਵਾਟ ਵਟਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: ghar jaasan vaatt vattaaeaa |
English: but we shall return home by different routes.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਲੈ ਗਏ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਚਲੇ ਮੂਲੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: guramukh laahaa lai ge manamukh chale mool gavaae jeeo |19|
English: The Gurmukhs reap their profits and leave, while the self-willed manmukhs lose their investment and depart. ||19||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਵਰਨਾ ਚਿਹਨਾ ਬਾਹਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: toon varanaa chihanaa baaharaa |
English: You are without color or mark.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦਿਸਹਿ ਹਾਜਰੁ ਜਾਹਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har diseh haajar jaaharaa |
English: The Lord is seen to be manifest and present.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਤੁਝੈ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਰਤੇ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: sun sun tujhai dhiaaeide tere bhagat rate gunataas jeeo |20|
English: Hearing of Your Glories again and again, Your devotees meditate on You; they are attuned to You, O Lord, Treasure of Excellence. ||20||

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਦਯੈ ਸੇਵੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: mai jug jug dayai sevarree |
English: Through age after age, I am the servant of the Merciful Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਕਟੀ ਮਿਹਡੀ ਜੇਵੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur kattee mihaddee jevarree |
English: The Guru has cut away my bonds.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਛਿੰਝ ਨ ਨਚਊ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਲਧਾ ਭਾਲਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੨੧॥੨॥੨੯॥
Transliteration: hau baahurr chhinjh na nchaoo naanak aausar ladhaa bhaal jeeo |21|2|29|
English: I shall not have to dance in the wrestling arena of life again. Nanak has searched, and found this opportunity. ||21||2||29||

[Ang 74 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਪਹਰੇ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 pahare ghar 1 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Pehray, First House:

Gurbani: ਪਹਿਲੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਪਇਆ ਗਰਭਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: pahilai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa hukam peaa garabhaas |
English: In the first watch of the night, O my merchant friend, you were cast into the womb, by the Lord's Command.

Gurbani: ਉਰਧ ਤਪੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਖਸਮ ਸੇਤੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: auradh tap antar kare vanajaariaa mitraa khasam setee aradaas |
English: Upside-down, within the womb, you performed penance, O my merchant friend, and you prayed to your Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਖਸਮ ਸੇਤੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਉਰਧ ਧਿਆਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: khasam setee aradaas vakhaanai uradh dhiaan liv laagaa |
English: You uttered prayers to your Lord and Master, while upside-down, and you meditated on Him with deep love and affection.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਮਰਜਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ ਕਲਿ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਜਾਸੀ ਨਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: naa marajaad aaeaa kal bheetar baahurr jaasee naagaa |
English: You came into this Dark Age of Kali Yuga naked, and you shall depart again naked.

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੀ ਕਲਮ ਵੁੜੀ ਹੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਤੈਸੀ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: jaisee kalam vurree hai masatak taisee jeearre paas |
English: As God's Pen has written on your forehead, so it shall be with your soul.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਪਹਿਲੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਪਇਆ ਗਰਭਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak praanee pahilai paharai hukam peaa garabhaas |1|
English: Says Nanak, in the first watch of the night, by the Hukam of the Lord's Command, you enter into the womb. ||1||

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਗਇਆ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: doojai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa visar geaa dhiaan |
English: In the second watch of the night, O my merchant friend, you have forgotten to meditate.

Gurbani: ਹਥੋ ਹਥਿ ਨਚਾਈਐ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਜਿਉ ਜਸੁਦਾ ਘਰਿ ਕਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: hatho hath nachaaeeai vanajaariaa mitraa jiau jasudaa ghar kaan |
English: From hand to hand, you are passed around, O my merchant friend, like Krishna in the house of Yashoda.

Gurbani: ਹਥੋ ਹਥਿ ਨਚਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਮਾਤ ਕਹੈ ਸੁਤੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: hatho hath nachaaeeai praanee maat kahai sut meraa |
English: From hand to hand, you are passed around, and your mother says, "This is my son."

Gurbani: ਚੇਤਿ ਅਚੇਤ ਮੂੜ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਅੰਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: chet achet moorr man mere ant nahee kachh teraa |
English: O, my thoughtless and foolish mind, think: In the end, nothing shall be yours.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਿ ਰਚਿਆ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਮਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਧਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: jin rach rachiaa tiseh na jaanai man bheetar dhar giaan |
English: You do not know the One who created the creation. Gather spiritual wisdom within your mind.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਗਇਆ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak praanee doojai paharai visar geaa dhiaan |2|
English: Says Nanak, in the second watch of the night, you have forgotten to meditate. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੀਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਧਨ ਜੋਬਨ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: teejai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa dhan joban siau chit |
English: In the third watch of the night, O my merchant friend, your consciousness is focused on wealth and youth.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਹੀ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਬਧਾ ਛੁਟਹਿ ਜਿਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam na chetahee vanajaariaa mitraa badhaa chhutteh jit |
English: You have not remembered the Name of the Lord, O my merchant friend, although it would release you from bondage.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਬਿਕਲੁ ਭਇਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam na chetai praanee bikal bheaa sang maaeaa |
English: You do not remember the Name of the Lord, and you become confused by Maya.

Gurbani: ਧਨ ਸਿਉ ਰਤਾ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਮਤਾ ਅਹਿਲਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: dhan siau rataa joban mataa ahilaa janam gavaaeaa |
English: Revelling in your riches and intoxicated with youth, you waste your life uselessly.

Gurbani: ਧਰਮ ਸੇਤੀ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ਨ ਕੀਤੋ ਕਰਮੁ ਨ ਕੀਤੋ ਮਿਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: dharam setee vaapaar na keeto karam na keeto mit |
English: You have not traded in righteousness and Dharma; you have not made good deeds your friends.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੀਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਧਨ ਜੋਬਨ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak teejai paharai praanee dhan joban siau chit |3|
English: Says Nanak, in the third watch of the night, your mind is attached to wealth and youth. ||3||

Gurbani: ਚਉਥੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਲਾਵੀ ਆਇਆ ਖੇਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: chauthai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa laavee aaeaa khet |
English: In the fourth watch of the night, O my merchant friend, the Grim Reaper comes to the field.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਜਮਿ ਪਕੜਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਭੇਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: jaa jam pakarr chalaaeaa vanajaariaa mitraa kisai na miliaa bhet |
English: When the Messenger of Death seizes and dispatches you, O my merchant friend, no one knows the mystery of where you have gone.

Gurbani: ਭੇਤੁ ਚੇਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਜਾ ਜਮਿ ਪਕੜਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bhet chet har kisai na milio jaa jam pakarr chalaaeaa |
English: So think of the Lord! No one knows this secret, of when the Messenger of Death will seize you and take you away.

Gurbani: ਝੂਠਾ ਰੁਦਨੁ ਹੋਆ ਦੋੁਆਲੈ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਭਇਆ ਪਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jhootthaa rudan hoaa duoaalai khin meh bheaa paraaeaa |
English: All your weeping and wailing then is false. In an instant, you become a stranger.

Gurbani: ਸਾਈ ਵਸਤੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਇਆ ਹੇਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: saaee vasat paraapat hoee jis siau laaeaa het |
English: You obtain exactly what you have longed for.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਚਉਥੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਲਾਵੀ ਲੁਣਿਆ ਖੇਤੁ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak praanee chauthai paharai laavee luniaa khet |4|1|
English: Says Nanak, in the fourth watch of the night, O mortal, the Grim Reaper has harvested your field. ||4||1||

[Ang 75 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 |
English: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪਹਿਲੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਬਾਲਕ ਬੁਧਿ ਅਚੇਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: pahilai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa baalak budh achet |
English: In the first watch of the night, O my merchant friend, your innocent mind has a child-like understanding.

Gurbani: ਖੀਰੁ ਪੀਐ ਖੇਲਾਈਐ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਹੇਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: kheer peeai khelaaeeai vanajaariaa mitraa maat pitaa sut het |
English: You drink milk, and you are fondled so gently, O my merchant friend.

Gurbani: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਨੇਹੁ ਘਨੇਰਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਬਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: maat pitaa sut nehu ghaneraa maaeaa mohu sabaaee |
English: The mother and father love their child so much, but in Maya, all are caught in emotional attachment.

Gurbani: ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਆਇਆ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sanjogee aaeaa kirat kamaaeaa karanee kaar karaaee |
English: By the good fortune of good deeds done in the past, you have come, and now you perform actions to determine your future.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਬੂਡੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਹੇਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam bin mukat na hoee booddee doojai het |
English: Without the Lord's Name, liberation is not obtained, and you are drowned in the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਪਹਿਲੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਛੂਟਹਿਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak praanee pahilai paharai chhoottahigaa har chet |1|
English: Says Nanak, in the first watch of the night, O mortal, you shall be saved by remembering the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਭਰਿ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਮੈ ਮਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: doojai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa bhar joban mai mat |
English: In the second watch of the night, O my merchant friend, you are intoxicated with the wine of youth and beauty.

Gurbani: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਕਾਮਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚਿਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: ahinis kaam viaapiaa vanajaariaa mitraa andhule naam na chit |
English: Day and night, you are engrossed in sexual desire, O my merchant friend, and your consciousness is blind to the Naam.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਹੋਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਮੀਠੇ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam ghatt antar naahee hor jaanai ras kas meetthe |
English: The Lord's Name is not within your heart, but all sorts of other tastes seem sweet to you.

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰਹੁਗੇ ਝੂਠੇ ॥
Transliteration: giaan dhiaan gun sanjam naahee janam marahuge jhootthe |
English: You have no wisdom at all, no meditation, no virtue or self-discipline; in falsehood, you are caught in the cycle of birth and death.

Gurbani: ਤੀਰਥ ਵਰਤ ਸੁਚਿ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਰਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: teerath varat such sanjam naahee karam dharam nahee poojaa |
English: Pilgrimages, fasts, purification and self-discipline are of no use, nor are rituals, religious ceremonies or empty worship.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak bhaae bhagat nisataaraa dubidhaa viaapai doojaa |2|
English: O Nanak, emancipation comes only by loving devotional worship; through duality, people are engrossed in duality. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੀਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਸਰਿ ਹੰਸ ਉਲਥੜੇ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: teejai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa sar hans ulatharre aae |
English: In the third watch of the night, O my merchant friend, the swans, the white hairs, come and land upon the pool of the head.

Gurbani: ਜੋਬਨੁ ਘਟੈ ਜਰੂਆ ਜਿਣੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਆਵ ਘਟੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: joban ghattai jarooaa jinai vanajaariaa mitraa aav ghattai din jaae |
English: Youth wears itself out, and old age triumphs, O my merchant friend; as time passes, your days diminish.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਸੀ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਜਾ ਜਮਿ ਪਕੜਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: ant kaal pachhutaasee andhule jaa jam pakarr chalaaeaa |
English: At the last moment, you repent-you are so blind!-when the Messenger of Death seizes you and carries you away.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਭਇਆ ਪਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh apunaa kar kar raakhiaa khin meh bheaa paraaeaa |
English: You kept all your things for yourself, but in an instant, they are all lost.

Gurbani: ਬੁਧਿ ਵਿਸਰਜੀ ਗਈ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਕਰਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: budh visarajee gee siaanap kar avagan pachhutaae |
English: Your intellect left you, your wisdom departed, and now you repent for the evil deeds you committed.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਤੀਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚੇਤਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak praanee teejai paharai prabh chetahu liv laae |3|
English: Says Nanak, O mortal, in the third watch of the night, let your consciousness be lovingly focused on God. ||3||

Gurbani: ਚਉਥੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਬਿਰਧਿ ਭਇਆ ਤਨੁ ਖੀਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: chauthai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa biradh bheaa tan kheen |
English: In the fourth watch of the night, O my merchant friend, your body grows old and weak.

Gurbani: ਅਖੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਨ ਦੀਸਈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਕੰਨੀ ਸੁਣੈ ਨ ਵੈਣ ॥
Transliteration: akhee andh na deesee vanajaariaa mitraa kanee sunai na vain |
English: Your eyes go blind, and cannot see, O my merchant friend, and your ears do not hear any words.

Gurbani: ਅਖੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਜੀਭ ਰਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਰਹੇ ਪਰਾਕਉ ਤਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: akhee andh jeebh ras naahee rahe paraakau taanaa |
English: Your eyes go blind, and your tongue is unable to taste; you live only with the help of others.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: gun antar naahee kiau sukh paavai manamukh aavan jaanaa |
English: With no virtue within, how can you find peace? The self-willed manmukh comes and goes in reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਖੜੁ ਪਕੀ ਕੁੜਿ ਭਜੈ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਆਇ ਚਲੈ ਕਿਆ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: kharr pakee kurr bhajai binasai aae chalai kiaa maan |
English: When the crop of life has matured, it bends, breaks and perishes; why take pride in that which comes and goes?

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਚਉਥੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak praanee chauthai paharai guramukh sabad pachhaan |4|
English: Says Nanak, O mortal, in the fourth watch of the night, the Gurmukh recognizes the Word of the Shabad. ||4||

Gurbani: ਓੜਕੁ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਸਾਹਿਆ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਜਰੁ ਜਰਵਾਣਾ ਕੰਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: orrak aaeaa tin saahiaa vanajaariaa mitraa jar jaravaanaa kan |
English: Your breath comes to its end, O my merchant friend, and your shoulders are weighed down by the tyrant of old age.

Gurbani: ਇਕ ਰਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਨ ਸਮਾਣਿਆ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਅਵਗਣ ਖੜਸਨਿ ਬੰਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: eik ratee gun na samaaniaa vanajaariaa mitraa avagan kharrasan ban |
English: Not one iota of virtue came into you, O my merchant friend; bound and gagged by evil, you are driven along.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਜਾਵੈ ਚੋਟ ਨ ਖਾਵੈ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: gun sanjam jaavai chott na khaavai naa tis jaman maranaa |
English: One who departs with virtue and self-discipline is not struck down, and is not consigned to the cycle of birth and death.

Gurbani: ਕਾਲੁ ਜਾਲੁ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੈ ਤਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaal jaal jam johi na saakai bhaae bhagat bhai taranaa |
English: The Messenger of Death and his trap cannot touch him; through loving devotional worship, he crosses over the ocean of fear.

Gurbani: ਪਤਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਜਾਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਮਿਟਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: pat setee jaavai sehaj samaavai sagale dookh mittaavai |
English: He departs with honor, and merges in intuitive peace and poise; all his pains depart.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਛੂਟੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਤੇ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੫॥੨॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak praanee guramukh chhoottai saache te pat paavai |5|2|
English: Says Nanak, when the mortal becomes Gurmukh, he is saved and honored by the True Lord. ||5||2||

[Ang 76 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 4 |
English: Siree Raag, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪਹਿਲੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਉਦਰ ਮੰਝਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: pahilai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa har paaeaa udar manjhaar |
English: In the first watch of the night, O my merchant friend, the Lord places you in the womb.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਉਚਰੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: har dhiaavai har ucharai vanajaariaa mitraa har har naam samaar |
English: You meditate on the Lord, and chant the Lord's Name, O my merchant friend. You contemplate the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਅਗਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam jape aaraadhe vich aganee har jap jeeviaa |
English: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and meditating on it within the fire of the womb, your life is sustained by dwelling on the Naam.

Gurbani: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਭਇਆ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਸਰਸੇ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਤ ਥੀਵਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: baahar janam bheaa mukh laagaa sarase pitaa maat theeviaa |
English: You are born and you come out, and your mother and father are delighted to see your face.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਵਸਤੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਚੇਤਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਕਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jis kee vasat tis chetahu praanee kar hiradai guramukh beechaar |
English: Remember the One, O mortal, to whom the child belongs. As Gurmukh, reflect upon Him within your heart.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਪਹਿਲੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak praanee pahilai paharai har japeeai kirapaa dhaar |1|
English: Says Nanak, O mortal, in the first watch of the night, dwell upon the Lord, who shall shower you with His Grace. ||1||

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: doojai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa man laagaa doojai bhaae |
English: In the second watch of the night, O my merchant friend, the mind is attached to the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਲੀਐ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਲੇ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: meraa meraa kar paaleeai vanajaariaa mitraa le maat pitaa gal laae |
English: Mother and father hug you close in their embrace, claiming, "He is mine, he is mine"; so is the child brought up, O my merchant friend.

Gurbani: ਲਾਵੈ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਗਲ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਖਟਿ ਖਵਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: laavai maat pitaa sadaa gal setee man jaanai khatt khavaae |
English: Your mother and father constantly hug you close in their embrace; in their minds, they believe that you will provide for them and support them.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਮੂੜਾ ਦਿਤੇ ਨੋ ਲਪਟਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jo devai tisai na jaanai moorraa dite no lapattaae |
English: The fool does not know the One who gives; instead, he clings to the gift.

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਕਰੈ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: koee guramukh hovai su karai veechaar har dhiaavai man liv laae |
English: Rare is the Gurmukh who reflects upon, meditates upon, and within his mind, is lovingly attached to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੂਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਖਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak doojai paharai praanee tis kaal na kabahoon khaae |2|
English: Says Nanak, in the second watch of the night, O mortal, death never devours you. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੀਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਗਾ ਆਲਿ ਜੰਜਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: teejai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa man lagaa aal janjaal |
English: In the third watch of the night, O my merchant friend, your mind is entangled in worldly and household affairs.

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਵੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਨ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: dhan chitavai dhan sanchavai vanajaariaa mitraa har naamaa har na samaal |
English: You think of wealth, and gather wealth, O my merchant friend, but you do not contemplate the Lord or the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਸਮਾਲੈ ਜਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har naamaa har har kade na samaalai ji hovai ant sakhaaee |
English: You never dwell upon the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, who will be your only Helper and Support in the end.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਪੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਝੂਠੀ ਅੰਤਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: eihu dhan sanpai maaeaa jhootthee ant chhodd chaliaa pachhutaaee |
English: This wealth, property and Maya are false. In the end, you must leave these, and depart in sorrow.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: jis no kirapaa kare gur mele so har har naam samaal |
English: Those whom the Lord, in His Mercy, unites with the Guru, reflect upon the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੀਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਸੇ ਜਾਇ ਮਿਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak teejai paharai praanee se jaae mile har naal |3|
English: Says Nanak, in the third watch of the night, O mortal, they go, and are united with the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਚਉਥੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਚਲਣ ਵੇਲਾ ਆਦੀ ॥
Transliteration: chauthai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa har chalan velaa aadee |
English: In the fourth watch of the night, O my merchant friend, the Lord announces the time of departure.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਸਭ ਚਲੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਦੀ ॥
Transliteration: kar sevahu pooraa satiguroo vanajaariaa mitraa sabh chalee rain vihaadee |
English: Serve the Perfect True Guru, O my merchant friend; your entire life-night is passing away.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਢਿਲ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਕਰਿਹੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਹੋਵਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: har sevahu khin khin dtil mool na karihu jit asathir jug jug hovahu |
English: Serve the Lord each and every instant-do not delay! You shall become eternal throughout the ages.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਸਦ ਮਾਣਹੁ ਰਲੀਆ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖ ਖੋਵਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: har setee sad maanahu raleea janam maran dukh khovahu |
English: Enjoy ecstasy forever with the Lord, and do away with the pains of birth and death.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੁਖਾਂਦੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur satigur suaamee bhed na jaanahu jit mil har bhagat sukhaandee |
English: Know that there is no difference between the Guru, the True Guru, and your Lord and Master. Meeting with Him, take pleasure in the Lord's devotional service.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਚਉਥੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਸਫਲਿਓੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਦੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak praanee chauthai paharai safalio rain bhagataa dee |4|1|3|
English: Says Nanak, O mortal, in the fourth watch of the night, the life-night of the devotee is fruitful. ||4||1||3||

[Ang 77 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 |
English: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪਹਿਲੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਧਰਿ ਪਾਇਤਾ ਉਦਰੈ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: pahilai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa dhar paaeitaa udarai maeh |
English: In the first watch of the night, O my merchant friend, the Lord placed your soul in the womb.

Gurbani: ਦਸੀ ਮਾਸੀ ਮਾਨਸੁ ਕੀਆ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਹਲਤਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: dasee maasee maanas keea vanajaariaa mitraa kar muhalat karam kamaeh |
English: In the tenth month, you were made into a human being, O my merchant friend, and you were given your allotted time to perform good deeds.

Gurbani: ਮੁਹਲਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਣੇ ਜੈਸਾ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: muhalat kar deenee karam kamaane jaisaa likhat dhur paaeaa |
English: You were given this time to perform good deeds, according to your pre-ordained destiny.

Gurbani: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਤਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸੰਜੋਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: maat pitaa bhaaee sut banitaa tin bheetar prabhoo sanjoeaa |
English: God placed you with your mother, father, brothers, sons and wife.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮ ਸੁਕਰਮ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਇਸੁ ਜੰਤੈ ਵਸਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: karam sukaram karaae aape is jantai vas kichh naeh |
English: God Himself is the Cause of causes, good and bad-no one has control over these things.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਪਹਿਲੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਧਰਿ ਪਾਇਤਾ ਉਦਰੈ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak praanee pahilai paharai dhar paaeitaa udarai maeh |1|
English: Says Nanak, O mortal, in the first watch of the night, the soul is placed in the womb. ||1||

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਭਰਿ ਜੁਆਨੀ ਲਹਰੀ ਦੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: doojai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa bhar juaanee laharee dee |
English: In the second watch of the night, O my merchant friend, the fullness of youth rises in you like waves.

Gurbani: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਤਾ ਅਹੰਮੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: buraa bhalaa na pachhaanee vanajaariaa mitraa man mataa ahamee |
English: You do not distinguish between good and evil, O my merchant friend-your mind is intoxicated with ego.

Gurbani: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਨ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਆਗੈ ਪੰਥੁ ਕਰਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: buraa bhalaa na pachhaanai praanee aagai panth karaaraa |
English: Mortal beings do not distinguish between good and evil, and the road ahead is treacherous.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਠਾਢੇ ਜਮ ਜੰਦਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: pooraa satigur kabahoon na seviaa sir tthaadte jam jandaaraa |
English: They never serve the Perfect True Guru, and the cruel tyrant Death stands over their heads.

Gurbani: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਜਬ ਪਕਰਸਿ ਬਵਰੇ ਤਬ ਕਿਆ ਜਬਾਬੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: dharam raae jab pakaras bavare tab kiaa jabaab karee |
English: When the Righteous Judge seizes you and interrogates you, O madman, what answer will you give him then?

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੂਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਭਰਿ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਲਹਰੀ ਦੇਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak doojai paharai praanee bhar joban laharee dee |2|
English: Says Nanak, in the second watch of the night, O mortal, the fullness of youth tosses you about like waves in the storm. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੀਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਸੰਚੈ ਅੰਧੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: teejai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa bikh sanchai andh agiaan |
English: In the third watch of the night, O my merchant friend, the blind and ignorant person gathers poison.

Gurbani: ਪੁਤ੍ਰਿ ਕਲਤ੍ਰਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਲਪਟਿਆ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲਹਰਿ ਲੋਭਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: putr kalatr mohi lapattiaa vanajaariaa mitraa antar lehar lobhaan |
English: He is entangled in emotional attachment to his wife and sons, O my merchant friend, and deep within him, the waves of greed are rising up.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲਹਰਿ ਲੋਭਾਨੁ ਪਰਾਨੀ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: antar lehar lobhaan paraanee so prabh chit na aavai |
English: The waves of greed are rising up within him, and he does not remember God.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਕੀਆ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasangat siau sang na keea bahu jonee dukh paavai |
English: He does not join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and he suffers in terrible pain through countless incarnations.

Gurbani: ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: sirajanahaar visaariaa suaamee ik nimakh na lago dhiaan |
English: He has forgotten the Creator, his Lord and Master, and he does not meditate on Him, even for an instant.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਤੀਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਸੰਚੇ ਅੰਧੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak praanee teejai paharai bikh sanche andh agiaan |3|
English: Says Nanak, in the third watch of the night, the blind and ignorant person gathers poison. ||3||

Gurbani: ਚਉਥੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਆਇਆ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: chauthai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa din nerrai aaeaa soe |
English: In the fourth watch of the night, O my merchant friend, that day is drawing near.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਤੂੰ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਬੇਲੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh naam samaal toon vanajaariaa mitraa teraa daragah belee hoe |
English: As Gurmukh, remember the Naam, O my merchant friend. It shall be your Friend in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਪਰਾਣੀ ਅੰਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh naam samaal paraanee ante hoe sakhaaee |
English: As Gurmukh, remember the Naam, O mortal; in the end, it shall be your only companion.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਤੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਝੂਠੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: eihu mohu maaeaa terai sang na chaalai jhootthee preet lagaaee |
English: This emotional attachment to Maya shall not go with you; it is false to fall in love with it.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਗੁਦਰੀ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੀ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sagalee rain gudaree andhiaaree sev satigur chaanan hoe |
English: The entire night of your life has passed away in darkness; but by serving the True Guru, the Divine Light shall dawn within.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਚਉਥੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਆਇਆ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak praanee chauthai paharai din nerrai aaeaa soe |4|
English: Says Nanak, O mortal, in the fourth watch of the night, that day is drawing near! ||4||

Gurbani: ਲਿਖਿਆ ਆਇਆ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕਾ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਉਠਿ ਚਲੇ ਕਮਾਣਾ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
Transliteration: likhiaa aaeaa govind kaa vanajaariaa mitraa utth chale kamaanaa saath |
English: Receiving the summons from the Lord of the Universe, O my merchant friend, you must arise and depart with the actions you have committed.

Gurbani: ਇਕ ਰਤੀ ਬਿਲਮ ਨ ਦੇਵਨੀ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਓਨੀ ਤਕੜੇ ਪਾਏ ਹਾਥ ॥
Transliteration: eik ratee bilam na devanee vanajaariaa mitraa onee takarre paae haath |
English: You are not allowed a moment's delay, O my merchant friend; the Messenger of Death seizes you with firm hands.

Gurbani: ਲਿਖਿਆ ਆਇਆ ਪਕੜਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਹੇਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: likhiaa aaeaa pakarr chalaaeaa manamukh sadaa duhele |
English: Receiving the summons, people are seized and dispatched. The self-willed manmukhs are miserable forever.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਸੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: jinee pooraa satigur seviaa se daragah sadaa suhele |
English: But those who serve the Perfect True Guru are forever happy in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਜੁਗ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋ ਬੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਖਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: karam dharatee sareer jug antar jo bovai so khaat |
English: The body is the field of karma in this age; whatever you plant, you shall harvest.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਦਰਵਾਰੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸਦਾ ਭਵਾਤਿ ॥੫॥੧॥੪॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak bhagat soheh daravaare manamukh sadaa bhavaat |5|1|4|
English: Says Nanak, the devotees look beautiful in the Court of the Lord; the self-willed manmukhs wander forever in reincarnation. ||5||1||4||

[Ang 78 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਛੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 4 ghar 2 chhant |
English: Siree Raag, Fourth Mehl, Second House, Chhant:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਮੁੰਧ ਇਆਣੀ ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਿਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: mundh eaanee peeearrai kiau kar har darasan pikhai |
English: How can the ignorant soul-bride obtain the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, while she is in this world of her father's home?

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਪਨੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਕੰਮ ਸਿਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: har har apanee kirapaa kare guramukh saahurarrai kam sikhai |
English: When the Lord Himself grants His Grace, the Gurmukh learns the duties of her Husband's Celestial Home.

Gurbani: ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਕੰਮ ਸਿਖੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: saahurarrai kam sikhai guramukh har har sadaa dhiaae |
English: The Gurmukh learns the duties of her Husband's Celestial Home; she meditates forever on the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਸਹੀਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਬਾਹ ਲੁਡਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: saheea vich firai suhelee har daragah baah luddaae |
English: She walks happily among her companions, and in the Lord's Court, she swings her arms joyfully.

Gurbani: ਲੇਖਾ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੀ ਬਾਕੀ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਿਰਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: lekhaa dharam raae kee baakee jap har har naam kirakhai |
English: Her account is cleared by the Righteous Judge of Dharma, when she chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਮੁੰਧ ਇਆਣੀ ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦਿਖੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mundh eaanee peeearrai guramukh har darasan dikhai |1|
English: The ignorant soul-bride becomes Gurmukh, and gains the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, while she is still in her father's house. ||1||

Gurbani: ਵੀਆਹੁ ਹੋਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਬੁਲਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: veeaahu hoaa mere baabulaa guramukhe har paaeaa |
English: My marriage has been performed, O my father. As Gurmukh, I have found the Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਕਟਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡੁ ਬਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: agiaan andheraa kattiaa gur giaan prachandd balaaeaa |
English: The darkness of ignorance has been dispelled. The Guru has revealed the blazing light of spiritual wisdom.

Gurbani: ਬਲਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਬਿਨਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਲਾਧਾ ॥
Transliteration: baliaa gur giaan andheraa binasiaa har ratan padaarath laadhaa |
English: This spiritual wisdom given by the Guru shines forth, and the darkness has been dispelled. I have found the Priceless Jewel of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਥਾ ਆਪੁ ਆਪੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਖਾਧਾ ॥
Transliteration: haumai rog geaa dukh laathaa aap aapai guramat khaadhaa |
English: The sickness of my ego has been dispelled, and my pain is over and done. Through the Guru's Teachings, my identity has consumed my identical identity.

Gurbani: ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਨਾ ਕਦੇ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: akaal moorat var paaeaa abinaasee naa kade marai na jaaeaa |
English: I have obtained my Husband Lord, the Akaal Moorat, the Undying Form. He is Imperishable; He shall never die, and He shall never ever leave.

Gurbani: ਵੀਆਹੁ ਹੋਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਬੋਲਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: veeaahu hoaa mere baabolaa guramukhe har paaeaa |2|
English: My marriage has been performed, O my father. As Gurmukh, I have found the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਬੁਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੰਞ ਸੁਹੰਦੀ ॥
Transliteration: har sat sate mere baabulaa har jan mil jany suhandee |
English: The Lord is the Truest of the True, O my father. Meeting with the humble servants of the Lord, the marriage procession looks beautiful.

Gurbani: ਪੇਵਕੜੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਖਰੀ ਸੋਹੰਦੀ ॥
Transliteration: pevakarrai har jap suhelee vich saahurarrai kharee sohandee |
English: She who chants the Lord's Name is happy in this world of her father's home, and in the next world of her Husband Lord, she shall be very beautiful.

Gurbani: ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਖਰੀ ਸੋਹੰਦੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੇਵਕੜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: saahurarrai vich kharee sohandee jin pevakarrai naam samaaliaa |
English: In her Husband Lord's Celestial Home, she shall be most beautiful, if she has remembered the Naam in this world.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਸਫਲਿਓ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਜਿਣਿ ਪਾਸਾ ਢਾਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabh safalio janam tinaa daa guramukh jinaa man jin paasaa dtaaliaa |
English: Fruitful are the lives of those who, as Gurmukh, have conquered their minds-they have won the game of life.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸੋਹਿਆ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਨੰਦੀ ॥
Transliteration: har sant janaa mil kaaraj sohiaa var paaeaa purakh anandee |
English: Joining with the humble Saints of the Lord, my actions bring prosperity, and I have obtained the Lord of Bliss as my Husband.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਬੋਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੰਞ ਸੋੁਹੰਦੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har sat sat mere baabolaa har jan mil jany suohandee |3|
English: The Lord is the Truest of the True, O my father. Joining with the humble servants of the Lord, the marriage party has been embellished. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਬੁਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਮੈ ਦਾਜੋ ॥
Transliteration: har prabh mere baabulaa har devahu daan mai daajo |
English: O my father, give me the Name of the Lord God as my wedding gift and dowry.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਪੜੋ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਵਰੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਾਜੋ ॥
Transliteration: har kaparro har sobhaa devahu jit savarai meraa kaajo |
English: Give me the Lord as my wedding gown, and the Lord as my glory, to accomplish my works.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਕਾਜੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦਿਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: har har bhagatee kaaj suhelaa gur satigur daan divaaeaa |
