English: Through devotional worship to the Lord, this ceremony is made blissful and beautiful; the Guru, the True Guru, has given this gift.

Gurbani: ਖੰਡਿ ਵਰਭੰਡਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਹੋਈ ਇਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਨ ਰਲੈ ਰਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: khandd varabhandd har sobhaa hoee ihu daan na ralai ralaaeaa |
English: Across the continents, and throughout the Universe, the Lord's Glory is pervading. This gift is not diminished by being diffused among all.

Gurbani: ਹੋਰਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦਾਜੁ ਜਿ ਰਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਲਹਿ ਸੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਕਚੁ ਪਾਜੋ ॥
Transliteration: hor manamukh daaj ji rakh dikhaaleh su koorr ahankaar kach paajo |
English: Any other dowry, which the self-willed manmukhs offer for show, is only false egotism and a worthless display.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਬੁਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਮੈ ਦਾਜੋ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: har prabh mere baabulaa har devahu daan mai daajo |4|
English: O my father, please give me the Name of the Lord God as my wedding gift and dowry. ||4||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਬੋਲਾ ਪਿਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਧਨ ਵੇਲ ਵਧੰਦੀ ॥
Transliteration: har raam raam mere baabolaa pir mil dhan vel vadhandee |
English: The Lord, Raam, Raam, is All-pervading, O my father. Meeting her Husband Lord, the soul-bride blossoms forth like the flourishing vine.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗੋ ਜੁਗ ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗੋ ਸਦ ਪੀੜੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਚਲੰਦੀ ॥
Transliteration: har jugah jugo jug jugah jugo sad peerree guroo chalandee |
English: In age after age, through all the ages, forever and ever, those who belong to the Guru's Family shall prosper and increase.

Gurbani: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਪੀੜੀ ਚਲੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jug jug peerree chalai satigur kee jinee guramukh naam dhiaaeaa |
English: Age after age, the Family of the True Guru shall increase. As Gurmukh, they meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਜਾਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਦੇਵੈ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: har purakh na kab hee binasai jaavai nit devai charrai savaaeaa |
English: The Almighty Lord never dies or goes away. Whatever He gives, keeps on increasing.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੋਹੰਦੀ ॥
Transliteration: naanak sant sant har eko jap har har naam sohandee |
English: O Nanak, the One Lord is the Saint of Saints. Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the soul-bride is bountiful and beautiful.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਬੁਲਾ ਪਿਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਧਨ ਵੇਲ ਵਧੰਦੀ ॥੫॥੧॥
Transliteration: har raam raam mere baabulaa pir mil dhan vel vadhandee |5|1|
English: The Lord, Raam, Raam, is All-pervading, O my father. Meeting her Husband Lord, the soul-bride blossoms forth like the flourishing vine. ||5||1||

[Ang 79 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 chhant |
English: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl, Chhant:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: man piaariaa jeeo mitraa gobind naam samaale |
English: O dear beloved mind, my friend, reflect upon the Name of the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜੀ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: man piaariaa jee mitraa har nibahai terai naale |
English: O dear beloved mind, my friend, the Lord shall always be with you.

Gurbani: ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sang sahaaee har naam dhiaaee birathaa koe na jaae |
English: The Name of the Lord shall be with you as your Helper and Support. Meditate on Him-no one who does so shall ever return empty-handed.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦੇ ਸੇਈ ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: man chinde seee fal paaveh charan kamal chit laae |
English: You shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires, by focusing your consciousness on the Lord's Lotus Feet.

Gurbani: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: jal thal poor rahiaa banavaaree ghatt ghatt nadar nihaale |
English: He is totally pervading the water and the land; He is the Lord of the World-forest. Behold Him in exaltation in each and every heart.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਿਖ ਦੇਇ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਜਾਲੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak sikh dee man preetam saadhasang bhram jaale |1|
English: Nanak gives this advice: O beloved mind, in the Company of the Holy, burn away your doubts. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜੀ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਪਸਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: man piaariaa jee mitraa har bin jhootth pasaare |
English: O dear beloved mind, my friend, without the Lord, all outward show is false.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: man piaariaa jeeo mitraa bikh saagar sansaare |
English: O dear beloved mind, my friend, the world is an ocean of poison.

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਕਰਿ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal kar bohith karate sahasaa dookh na biaapai |
English: Let the Lord's Lotus Feet be your Boat, so that pain and skepticism shall not touch you.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur pooraa bhettai vaddabhaagee aatth pehar prabh jaapai |
English: Meeting with the Perfect Guru, by great good fortune, meditate on God twenty-four hours a day.

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aad jugaadee sevak suaamee bhagataa naam adhaare |
English: From the very beginning, and throughout the ages, He is the Lord and Master of His servants. His Name is the Support of His devotees.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਿਖ ਦੇਇ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਝੂਠ ਪਸਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak sikh dee man preetam bin har jhootth pasaare |2|
English: Nanak gives this advice: O beloved mind, without the Lord, all outward show is false. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਲਦੇ ਖੇਪ ਸਵਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: man piaariaa jeeo mitraa har lade khep savalee |
English: O dear beloved mind, my friend, load the profitable cargo of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਦਰੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਮਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: man piaariaa jeeo mitraa har dar nihachal malee |
English: O dear beloved mind, my friend, enter through the eternal Door of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵੇ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਆਸਣੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: har dar seve alakh abheve nihachal aasan paaeaa |
English: One who serves at the Door of the Imperceptible and Unfathomable Lord, obtains this eternal position.

Gurbani: ਤਹ ਜਨਮ ਨ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਸੰਸਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: teh janam na maran na aavan jaanaa sansaa dookh mittaaeaa |
English: There is no birth or death there, no coming or going; anguish and anxiety are ended.

Gurbani: ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਪਤ ਕਾ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਫਾਰਿਆ ਜਮਦੂਤਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਚਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: chitr gupat kaa kaagad faariaa jamadootaa kachhoo na chalee |
English: The accounts of Chitr and Gupt, the recording scribes of the conscious and the subconscious are torn up, and the Messenger of Death cannot do anything.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਿਖ ਦੇਇ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਹਰਿ ਲਦੇ ਖੇਪ ਸਵਲੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak sikh dee man preetam har lade khep savalee |3|
English: Nanak gives this advice: O beloved mind, load the profitable cargo of the Lord's Name. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੋ ॥
Transliteration: man piaariaa jeeo mitraa kar santaa sang nivaaso |
English: O dear beloved mind, my friend, abide in the Society of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਪਰਗਾਸੋ ॥
Transliteration: man piaariaa jeeo mitraa har naam japat paragaaso |
English: O dear beloved mind, my friend, chanting the Lord's Name, the Divine Light shines within.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਖਹ ਗਾਮੀ ਇਛ ਸਗਲੀ ਪੁੰਨੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: simar suaamee sukhah gaamee ichh sagalee puneea |
English: Remember your Lord and Master, who is easily obtained, and all desires shall be fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਪੁਰਬੇ ਕਮਾਏ ਸ੍ਰੀਰੰਗ ਪਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: purabe kamaae sreerang paae har mile chiree vichhuniaa |
English: By my past actions, I have found the Lord, the Greatest Lover. Separated from Him for so long, I am united with Him again.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸਰਬਤਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਬਿਸੁਆਸੋ ॥
Transliteration: antar baahar sarabat raviaa man upajiaa bisuaaso |
English: Inside and out, He is pervading everywhere. Faith in Him has welled up within my mind.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਿਖ ਦੇਇ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੋ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak sikh dee man preetam kar santaa sang nivaaso |4|
English: Nanak gives this advice: O beloved mind, let the Society of the Saints be your dwelling. ||4||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: man piaariaa jeeo mitraa har prem bhagat man leenaa |
English: O dear beloved mind, my friend, let your mind remain absorbed in loving devotion to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਲ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੀਵੇ ਮੀਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: man piaariaa jeeo mitraa har jal mil jeeve meenaa |
English: O dear beloved mind, my friend, the fish of the mind lives only when it is immersed in the Water of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪੀ ਆਘਾਨੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਨੇ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਮਨ ਵੁਠੇ ॥
Transliteration: har pee aaghaane amrit baane srab sukhaa man vutthe |
English: Drinking in the Lord's Ambrosial Bani, the mind is satisfied, and all pleasures come to abide within.

Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਪਾਏ ਮੰਗਲ ਗਾਏ ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੁਠੇ ॥
Transliteration: sreedhar paae mangal gaae ichh punee satigur tutthe |
English: Attaining the Lord of Excellence, I sing the Songs of Joy. The True Guru, becoming merciful, has fulfilled my desires.

Gurbani: ਲੜਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਲਾਏ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਉ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: larr leene laae nau nidh paae naau sarabas tthaakur deenaa |
English: He has attached me to the hem of His robe, and I have obtained the nine treasures. My Lord and Master has bestowed His Name, which is everything to me.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਤ ਸਮਝਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ ॥੫॥੧॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak sikh sant samajhaaee har prem bhagat man leenaa |5|1|2|
English: Nanak instructs the Saints to teach, that the mind is imbued with loving devotion to the Lord. ||5||1||2||

[Ang 80 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗ ਕੇ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag ke chhant mahalaa 5 |
English: Chhants Of Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਡਖਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: ddakhanaa |
English: Dakhanaa:

Gurbani: ਹਠ ਮਝਾਹੂ ਮਾ ਪਿਰੀ ਪਸੇ ਕਿਉ ਦੀਦਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: hatth majhaahoo maa piree pase kiau deedaar |
English: My Beloved Husband Lord is deep within my heart. How can I see Him?

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਲਭਣੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sant saranaaee labhane naanak praan adhaar |1|
English: In the Sanctuary of the Saints, O Nanak, the Support of the breath of life is found. ||1||

[Ang 80 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: chhant |
English: Chhant:

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰੀਤਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਮਨਿ ਆਵਏ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal siau preet reet santan man aave jeeo |
English: To love the Lotus Feet of the Lord-this way of life has come into the minds of His Saints.

Gurbani: ਦੁਤੀਆ ਭਾਉ ਬਿਪਰੀਤਿ ਅਨੀਤਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਨਹ ਭਾਵਏ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: duteea bhaau bipareet aneet daasaa neh bhaave jeeo |
English: The love of duality, this evil practice, this bad habit, is not liked by the Lord's slaves.

Gurbani: ਦਾਸਾ ਨਹ ਭਾਵਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਦਰਸਾਵਏ ਇਕ ਖਿਨੁ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਕਿਉ ਕਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: daasaa neh bhaave bin darasaave ik khin dheeraj kiau karai |
English: It is not pleasing to the Lord's slaves; without the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, how can they find peace, even for a moment?

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਨਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹੀਨਾ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਜਿਉ ਮਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: naam bihoonaa tan man heenaa jal bin machhulee jiau marai |
English: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the body and mind are empty; like fish out of water, they die.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਗਾਵਏ ॥
Transliteration: mil mere piaare praan adhaare gun saadhasang mil gaave |
English: Please meet with me, O my Beloved-You are the Support of my breath of life. Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I sing Your Glorious Praises.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਧਾਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਵਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak ke suaamee dhaar anugrahu man tan ank samaave |1|
English: O Lord and Master of Nanak, please grant Your Grace, and permeate my body, mind and being. ||1||

[Ang 80 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਡਖਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: ddakhanaa |
English: Dakhanaa:

Gurbani: ਸੋਹੰਦੜੋ ਹਭ ਠਾਇ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਦਿਸੈ ਡੂਜੜੋ ॥
Transliteration: sohandarro habh tthaae koe na disai ddoojarro |
English: He is Beautiful in all places; I do not see any other at all.

Gurbani: ਖੁਲੑੜੇ ਕਪਾਟ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟਤੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: khularre kapaatt naanak satigur bhettate |1|
English: Meeting with the True Guru, O Nanak, the doors are opened wide. ||1||

[Ang 80 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: chhant |
English: Chhant:

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੇ ਬਚਨ ਅਨੂਪ ਅਪਾਰ ਸੰਤਨ ਆਧਾਰ ਬਾਣੀ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: tere bachan anoop apaar santan aadhaar baanee beechaareeai jeeo |
English: Your Word is Incomparable and Infinite. I contemplate the Word of Your Bani, the Support of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸ ਪੂਰਨ ਬਿਸੁਆਸ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਬਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: simarat saas giraas pooran bisuaas kiau manahu bisaareeai jeeo |
English: I remember Him in meditation with every breath and morsel of food, with perfect faith. How could I forget Him from my mind?

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਬੇਸਾਰੀਐ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਹੀ ਟਾਰੀਐ ਗੁਣਵੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kiau manahu besaareeai nimakh nahee ttaareeai gunavant praan hamaare |
English: How could I forget Him from my mind, even for an instant? He is the Most Worthy; He is my very life!

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਫਲ ਦੇਤ ਹੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਸਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: man baanchhat fal det hai suaamee jeea kee birathaa saare |
English: My Lord and Master is the Giver of the fruits of the mind's desires. He knows all the useless vanities and pains of the soul.

Gurbani: ਅਨਾਥ ਕੇ ਨਾਥੇ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਕੈ ਸਾਥੇ ਜਪਿ ਜੂਐ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹਾਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: anaath ke naathe srab kai saathe jap jooai janam na haareeai |
English: Meditating on the Patron of lost souls, the Companion of all, your life shall not be lost in the gamble.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਹਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਾਰੀਐ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak kee benantee prabh peh kripaa kar bhavajal taareeai |2|
English: Nanak offers this prayer to God: Please shower me with Your Mercy, and carry me across the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

[Ang 80 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਡਖਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: ddakhanaa |
English: Dakhanaa:

Gurbani: ਧੂੜੀ ਮਜਨੁ ਸਾਧ ਖੇ ਸਾਈ ਥੀਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: dhoorree majan saadh khe saaee thee kripaal |
English: People bathe in the dust of the feet of the Saints, when the Lord becomes merciful.

Gurbani: ਲਧੇ ਹਭੇ ਥੋਕੜੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ladhe habhe thokarre naanak har dhan maal |1|
English: I have obtained all things, O Nanak; the Lord is my Wealth and Property. ||1||

[Ang 80 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: chhant |
English: Chhant:

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਧਾਮ ਭਗਤਹ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਆਸਾ ਲਗਿ ਜੀਵਤੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: sundar suaamee dhaam bhagatah bisraam aasaa lag jeevate jeeo |
English: My Lord and Master's Home is beautiful. It is the resting place of His devotees, who live in hopes of attaining it.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਤਨੇ ਗਲਤਾਨ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਤੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: man tane galataan simarat prabh naam har amrit peevate jeeo |
English: Their minds and bodies are absorbed in meditation on the Name of God; they drink in the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਪੀਵਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਥੀਵਤੇ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਨੁ ਫੀਕਾ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: amrit har peevate sadaa thir theevate bikhai ban feekaa jaaniaa |
English: They drink in the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar, and become eternally stable. They know that the water of corruption is insipid and tasteless.

Gurbani: ਭਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: bhe kirapaal gopaal prabh mere saadhasangat nidh maaniaa |
English: When my God, the Lord of the Universe became merciful, I came to look upon the Saadh Sangat as the treasure.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬਸੋ ਸੂਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਘਨ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੀਵਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: sarabaso sookh aanand ghan piaare har ratan man antar seevate |
English: All pleasures and supreme ecstasy, O my Beloved, come to those who sew the Jewel of the Lord into their minds.

Gurbani: ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਆਧਾਰਾ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵਤੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: eik til nahee visarai praan aadhaaraa jap jap naanak jeevate |3|
English: They do not forget, even for an instant, the Support of the breath of life. They live by constantly meditating on Him, O Nanak. ||3||

[Ang 81 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਡਖਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: ddakhanaa |
English: Dakhanaa:

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤਉ ਕੀਨੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਤਿਨਾ ਕੂੰ ਮਿਲਿਓਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jo tau keene aapane tinaa koon miliohi |
English: O Lord, You meet and merge with those whom you have made Your Own.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪਿ ਮੋਹਿਓਹੁ ਜਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਣਿਓਹਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aape hee aap mohiohu jas naanak aap suniohi |1|
English: You Yourself are entranced, O Nanak, hearing Your Own Praises. ||1||

[Ang 81 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: chhant |
English: Chhant:

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਪਾਇ ਰੀਝਾਇ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: prem tthgauree paae reejhaae gobind man mohiaa jeeo |
English: Administering the intoxicating drug of love, I have won over the Lord of the Universe; I have fascinated His Mind.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਕੰਠੇ ਲਗਿ ਸੋਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: santan kai parasaad agaadh kantthe lag sohiaa jeeo |
English: By the Grace of the Saints, I am held in the loving embrace of the Unfathomable Lord, and I am entranced.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਗਿ ਸੋਹਿਆ ਦੋਖ ਸਭਿ ਜੋਹਿਆ ਭਗਤਿ ਲਖੵਣ ਕਰਿ ਵਸਿ ਭਏ ॥
Transliteration: har kantth lag sohiaa dokh sabh johiaa bhagat lakhayan kar vas bhe |
English: Held in the Lord's loving embrace, I look beautiful, and all my pains have been dispelled. By the loving worship of His devotees, the Lord has come under their power.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਵੁਠੇ ਗੋਵਿਦ ਤੁਠੇ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣਾ ਸਭਿ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ॥
Transliteration: man sarab sukh vutthe govid tutthe janam maranaa sabh mitt ge |
English: All pleasures have come to dwell in the mind; the Lord of the Universe is pleased and appeased. Birth and death have been totally eliminated.

Gurbani: ਸਖੀ ਮੰਗਲੋ ਗਾਇਆ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਇਆ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਹੋਹਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sakhee mangalo gaaeaa ichh pujaaeaa bahurr na maaeaa hohiaa |
English: O my companions, sing the Songs of Joy. My desires have been fulfilled, and I shall never again be trapped or shaken by Maya.

Gurbani: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਪੋਹਿਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: kar geh leene naanak prabh piaare sansaar saagar nahee pohiaa |4|
English: Taking hold of my hand, O Nanak, my Beloved God will not let me be swallowed up by the world-ocean. ||4||

[Ang 81 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਡਖਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: ddakhanaa |
English: Dakhanaa:

Gurbani: ਸਾਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਣਦੋ ॥
Transliteration: saaee naam amol keem na koee jaanado |
English: The Master's Name is Priceless; no one knows its value.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਾ ਭਾਗ ਮਥਾਹਿ ਸੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਦੋ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jinaa bhaag mathaeh se naanak har rang maanado |1|
English: Those who have good destiny recorded upon their foreheads, O Nanak, enjoy the Love of the Lord. ||1||

[Ang 81 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: chhant |
English: Chhant:

Gurbani: ਕਹਤੇ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਣਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਧੰਨੁ ਲਿਖਤਂੀ ਕੁਲੁ ਤਾਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: kahate pavitr sunate sabh dhan likhatanee kul taariaa jeeo |
English: Those who chant are sanctified. All those who listen are blessed, and those who write save their ancestors.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਤਿਨੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: jin kau saadhoo sang naam har rang tinee braham beechaariaa jeeo |
English: Those who join the Saadh Sangat are imbued with the Lord's Love; they reflect and meditate on God.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: braham beechaariaa janam savaariaa pooran kirapaa prabh karee |
English: Contemplating God, their lives are reformed and redeemed; God has showered His Perfect Mercy upon them.

Gurbani: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੋ ਦੀਨੇ ਜੋਨਿ ਨਾ ਧਾਵੈ ਨਹ ਮਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kar geh leene har jaso deene jon naa dhaavai neh maree |
English: Taking them by the hand, the Lord has blessed them with His Praises. They no longer have to wander in reincarnation, and they never have to die.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਇਆਲ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਭੇਟਤ ਹਰੇ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: satigur deaal kirapaal bhettat hare kaam krodh lobh maariaa |
English: Through the Kind and Compassionate True Guru, I have met the Lord; I have conquered sexual desire, anger and greed.

Gurbani: ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਅਕਥੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਦਕੈ ਜਾਇ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ॥੫॥੧॥੩॥
Transliteration: kathan na jaae akath suaamee sadakai jaae naanak vaariaa |5|1|3|
English: Our Indescribable Lord and Master cannot be described. Nanak is devoted, forever a sacrifice to Him. ||5||1||3||

[Ang 81 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 4 vanajaaraa |
English: Siree Raag, Fourth Mehl, Vanajaaraa ~ The Merchant:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar sat naam gur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. By Guru's Grace:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਤਮੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਰਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har har utam naam hai jin siriaa sabh koe jeeo |
English: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is Excellent and Sublime. He created everyone.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਅ ਸਭੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਦਾ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਮਈਆ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: har jeea sabhe pratipaaladaa ghatt ghatt rameea soe |
English: The Lord cherishes all beings. He permeates each and every heart.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: so har sadaa dhiaaeeai tis bin avar na koe |
English: Meditate forever on that Lord. Without Him, there is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਦੇ ਸੇ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਲੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਰੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jo mohi maaeaa chit laaeide se chhodd chale dukh roe |
English: Those who focus their consciousness on emotional attachment to Maya must leave; they depart crying out in despair.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak naam dhiaaeaa har ant sakhaaee hoe |1|
English: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, his only Companion in the end. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: mai har bin avar na koe |
English: I have none other than You, O Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har gur saranaaee paaeeai vanajaariaa mitraa vaddabhaag paraapat hoe |1| rahaau |
English: In the Guru's Sanctuary, the Lord is found, O my merchant friend; by great good fortune, He is obtained. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਵਿਣੁ ਭਾਈਆ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sant janaa vin bhaaeea har kinai na paaeaa naau |
English: Without the humble Saints, O Siblings of Destiny, no one has obtained the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਜਿਉ ਵੇਸੁਆ ਪੁਤੁ ਨਿਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: vich haumai karam kamaavade jiau vesuaa put ninaau |
English: Those who do their deeds in ego are like the prostitute's son, who has no name.

Gurbani: ਪਿਤਾ ਜਾਤਿ ਤਾ ਹੋਈਐ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਕਰੇ ਪਸਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: pitaa jaat taa hoeeai gur tutthaa kare pasaau |
English: The father's status is obtained only if the Guru is pleased and bestows His Favor.

Gurbani: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਲਗਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: vaddabhaagee gur paaeaa har ahinis lagaa bhaau |
English: By great good fortune, the Guru is found; embrace love for the Lord, day and night.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jan naanak braham pachhaaniaa har keerat karam kamaau |2|
English: Servant Nanak has realized God; he sings the Lord's Praises through the actions he does. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਗਾ ਚਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: man har har lagaa chaau |
English: In my mind there is such a deep yearning for the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur poorai naam drirraaeaa har miliaa har prabh naau |1| rahaau |
English: The Perfect Guru has implanted the Naam within me; I have found the Lord through the Lord God's Name. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਸਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: jab lag joban saas hai tab lag naam dhiaae |
English: As long as there is youth and health, meditate on the Naam.

Gurbani: ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਲਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤੇ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: chaladiaa naal har chalasee har ante le chhaddaae |
English: Along the way, the Lord shall go along with you, and in the end, He shall save you.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: hau balihaaree tin kau jin har man vutthaa aae |
English: I am a sacrifice to those, within whose minds the Lord has come to dwell.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਸੇ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਏ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jinee har har naam na chetio se ant ge pachhutaae |
English: Those who have not remembered the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, shall leave with regret in the end.

Gurbani: ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: dhur masatak har prabh likhiaa jan naanak naam dhiaae |3|
English: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny written upon their foreheads, O servant Nanak, meditate on the Naam. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man har har preet lagaae |
English: O my mind, embrace love for the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਪਾਰਿ ਲਘਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: vaddabhaagee gur paaeaa gurasabadee paar laghaae |1| rahaau |
English: By great good fortune, the Guru is found; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, we are carried across to the other side. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਲੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: har aape aap upaaeidaa har aape devai lee |
English: The Lord Himself creates, He Himself gives and takes away.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: har aape bharam bhulaaeidaa har aape hee mat dee |
English: The Lord Himself leads us astray in doubt; the Lord Himself imparts understanding.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਮਨਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਸੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕੇਈ ਕੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukhaa man paragaas hai se virale keee kee |
English: The minds of the Gurmukhs are illuminated and enlightened; they are so very rare.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: hau balihaaree tin kau jin har paaeaa guramate |
English: I am a sacrifice to those who find the Lord, through the Guru's Teachings.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਵੁਠੜਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jan naanak kamal paragaasiaa man har har vuttharraa he |4|
English: Servant Nanak's heart-lotus has blossomed forth, and the Lord, Har, Har, has come to dwell in the mind. ||4||

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨੁ ਕਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: man har har japan kare |
English: O mind, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਭਜਿ ਪਉ ਜਿੰਦੂ ਸਭ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਦੁਖ ਪਰਹਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har gur saranaaee bhaj pau jindoo sabh kilavikh dukh parahare |1| rahaau |
English: Hurry to the Sanctuary of the Lord, the Guru, O my soul; all your sins shall be taken away. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਮਈਆ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਿਤੁ ਭਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt rameea man vasai kiau paaeeai kit bhat |
English: The All-pervading Lord dwells within each and every person's heart-how can He be obtained?

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਆਇ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: gur pooraa satigur bhetteeai har aae vasai man chit |
English: By meeting the Perfect Guru, the True Guru, the Lord comes to dwell within the conscious mind.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਧਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਤੇ ਗਤਿ ਮਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: mai dhar naam adhaar hai har naamai te gat mat |
English: The Naam is my Support and Sustenance. From the Lord's Name, I obtain salvation and understanding.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਹੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਜਤਿ ਪਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: mai har har naam visaahu hai har naame hee jat pat |
English: My faith is in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. The Lord's Name is my status and honor.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਿ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: jan naanak naam dhiaaeaa rang ratarraa har rang rat |5|
English: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; He is dyed in the deep crimson color of the Lord's Love. ||5||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: har dhiaavahu har prabh sat |
English: Meditate on the Lord, the True Lord God.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਸਭ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤੇ ਉਤਪਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur bachanee har prabh jaaniaa sabh har prabh te utapat |1| rahaau |
English: Through the Guru's Word, you shall come to know the Lord God. From the Lord God, everything was created. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੇ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: jin kau poorab likhiaa se aae mile gur paas |
English: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny, come to the Guru and meet Him.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਕ ਭਾਇ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: sevak bhaae vanajaariaa mitraa gur har har naam pragaas |
English: They love to serve, O my merchant friend, and through the Guru, they are illuminated by the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਵਣਜੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੀਆ ਜਿਨ ਵਖਰੁ ਲਦਿਅੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan vanaj vaapaareea jin vakhar ladiarraa har raas |
English: Blessed, blessed is the trade of those traders who have loaded the merchandise of the Wealth of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਦਰਿ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਸੇ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: guramukhaa dar mukh ujale se aae mile har paas |
English: The faces of the Gurmukhs are radiant in the Court of the Lord; they come to the Lord and merge with Him.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਾ ਆਪਿ ਤੁਠਾ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਿ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: jan naanak gur tin paaeaa jinaa aap tutthaa gunataas |6|
English: O servant Nanak, they alone find the Guru, with whom the Lord, the Treasure of Excellence, is pleased. ||6||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: har dhiaavahu saas giraas |
English: Meditate on the Lord, with every breath and morsel of food.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਤਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਨਾ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: man preet lagee tinaa guramukhaa har naam jinaa raharaas |1| rahaau |1|
English: The Gurmukhs embrace the Love of the Lord in their minds; they are continually occupied with the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||1||

[Ang 83 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਸਲੋਕਾ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag kee vaar mahalaa 4 salokaa naal |
English: Vaar Of Siree Raag, Fourth Mehl, With Saloks:

Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਾਗਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਸ੍ਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਹੈ ਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: raagaa vich sreeraag hai je sach dhare piaar |
English: Among the ragas, Siree Raag is the best, if it inspires you to enshrine love for the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਮਤਿ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa har sach man vasai nihachal mat apaar |
English: The True Lord comes to abide forever in the mind, and your understanding becomes steady and unequalled.

Gurbani: ਰਤਨੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: ratan amolak paaeaa gur kaa sabad beechaar |
English: The priceless jewel is obtained, by contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਸਚੀ ਮਨੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਚਾ ਸਰੀਰ ਅਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jihavaa sachee man sachaa sachaa sareer akaar |
English: The tongue becomes true, the mind becomes true, and the body becomes true as well.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak sachai satigur seviai sadaa sach vaapaar |1|
English: O Nanak, forever true are the dealings of those who serve the True Guru. ||1||

[Ang 83 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹੋਰੁ ਬਿਰਹਾ ਸਭ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: hor birahaa sabh dhaat hai jab lag saahib preet na hoe |
English: All other loves are transitory, as long as people do not love their Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਵੇਖਣੁ ਸੁਨਣੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: eihu man maaeaa mohiaa vekhan sunan na hoe |
English: This mind is enticed by Maya-it cannot see or hear.

Gurbani: ਸਹ ਦੇਖੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਅੰਧਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: seh dekhe bin preet na aoopajai andhaa kiaa karee |
English: Without seeing her Husband Lord, love does not well up; what can the blind person do?

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਅਖੀ ਲੀਤੀਆ ਸੋਈ ਸਚਾ ਦੇਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak jin akhee leeteea soee sachaa dee |2|
English: O Nanak, the True One who takes away the eyes of spiritual wisdom-He alone can restore them. ||2||

[Ang 83 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਇਕੁ ਇਕੋ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਹਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: har iko karataa ik iko deebaan har |
English: The Lord alone is the One Creator; there is only the One Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਇਕਸੈ ਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਮਰੁ ਇਕੋ ਹਰਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਧਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: har ikasai daa hai amar iko har chit dhar |
English: The One Lord's Command is the One and Only-enshrine the One Lord in your consciousness.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹਿ ਡਰੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: har tis bin koee naeh ddar bhram bhau door kar |
English: Without that Lord, there is no other at all. Remove your fear, doubt and dread.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਨੋ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਜਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਰਖੈ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਘਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: har tisai no saalaeh ji tudh rakhai baahar ghar |
English: Praise that Lord who protects you, inside your home, and outside as well.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਭਉ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਤਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har jis no hoe deaal so har jap bhau bikham tar |1|
English: When that Lord becomes merciful, and one comes to chant the Lord's Name, one swims across the ocean of fear. ||1||

[Ang 83 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦਾਤੀ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸੰਦੀਆ ਕਿਆ ਚਲੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: daatee saahib sandeea kiaa chalai tis naal |
English: The gifts belong to our Lord and Master; how can we compete with Him?

Gurbani: ਇਕ ਜਾਗੰਦੇ ਨਾ ਲਹੰਨਿ ਇਕਨਾ ਸੁਤਿਆ ਦੇਇ ਉਠਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: eik jaagande naa lahan ikanaa sutiaa dee utthaal |1|
English: Some remain awake and aware, and do not receive these gifts, while others are awakened from their sleep to be blessed. ||1||

[Ang 83 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਿਦਕੁ ਸਬੂਰੀ ਸਾਦਿਕਾ ਸਬਰੁ ਤੋਸਾ ਮਲਾਇਕਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: sidak sabooree saadikaa sabar tosaa malaaeikaan |
English: Faith, contentment and tolerance are the food and provisions of the angels.

Gurbani: ਦੀਦਾਰੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਪਾਇਸਾ ਥਾਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਖਾਇਕਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: deedaar poore paaeisaa thaau naahee khaaeikaa |2|
English: They obtain the Perfect Vision of the Lord, while those who gossip find no place of rest. ||2||

[Ang 83 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਆਪੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਆਪਿ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sabh aape tudh upaae kai aap kaarai laaee |
English: You Yourself created all; You Yourself delegate the tasks.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸਦਾ ਆਪਣੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: toon aape vekh vigasadaa aapanee vaddiaaee |
English: You Yourself are pleased, beholding Your Own Glorious Greatness.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਤੁਧਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har tudhahu baahar kichh naahee toon sachaa saaee |
English: O Lord, there is nothing at all beyond You. You are the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਸਭਨੀ ਹੀ ਥਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: toon aape aap varatadaa sabhanee hee thaaee |
English: You Yourself are contained in all places.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਹੁ ਜੋ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har tisai dhiaavahu sant janahu jo le chhaddaaee |2|
English: Meditate on that Lord, O Saints; He shall rescue and save you. ||2||

[Ang 83 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਫਕੜ ਜਾਤੀ ਫਕੜੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: fakarr jaatee fakarr naau |
English: Pride in social status is empty; pride in personal glory is useless.

Gurbani: ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਇਕਾ ਛਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sabhanaa jeea ikaa chhaau |
English: The One Lord gives shade to all beings.

Gurbani: ਆਪਹੁ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਭਲਾ ਕਹਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aapahu je ko bhalaa kahaae |
English: You may call yourself good;

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਪੈ ਜਾ ਪਤਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak taa par jaapai jaa pat lekhai paae |1|
English: O Nanak, this will only be known when your honor is approved in God's Account. ||1||

[Ang 83 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 2 |
English: Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਮਰਿ ਚਲੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: jis piaare siau nehu tis aagai mar chaleeai |
English: Die before the one whom you love;

Gurbani: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਜੀਵਣਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: dhrig jeevan sansaar taa kai paachhai jeevanaa |2|
English: to live after he dies is to live a worthless life in this world. ||2||

[Ang 83 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਾਜੀਐ ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਦੀਵੇ ॥
Transliteration: tudh aape dharatee saajeeai chand sooraj due deeve |
English: You Yourself created the earth, and the two lamps of the sun and the moon.

Gurbani: ਦਸ ਚਾਰਿ ਹਟ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ਕਰੀਵੇ ॥
Transliteration: das chaar hatt tudh saajiaa vaapaar kareeve |
English: You created the fourteen world-shops, in which Your Business is transacted.

Gurbani: ਇਕਨਾ ਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਭੁ ਦੇਇ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਥੀਵੇ ॥
Transliteration: eikanaa no har laabh dee jo guramukh theeve |
English: The Lord bestows His Profits on those who become Gurmukh.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪਈ ਜਿਨ ਸਚੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੇ ॥
Transliteration: tin jamakaal na viaapee jin sach amrit peeve |
English: The Messenger of Death does not touch those who drink in the True Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਆਪਿ ਛੁਟੇ ਪਰਵਾਰ ਸਿਉ ਤਿਨ ਪਿਛੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਛੁਟੀਵੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: oe aap chhutte paravaar siau tin pichhai sabh jagat chhutteeve |3|
English: They themselves are saved, along with their family, and all those who follow them are saved as well. ||3||

[Ang 83 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: kudarat kar kai vasiaa soe |
English: He created the Creative Power of the Universe, within which He dwells.

Gurbani: ਵਖਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ਸੁ ਬੰਦਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: vakhat veechaare su bandaa hoe |
English: One who reflects upon his allotted span of life, becomes the slave of God.

Gurbani: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਹੈ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kudarat hai keemat nahee paae |
English: The value of the Creative Power of the Universe cannot be known.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇ ਤ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jaa keemat paae ta kahee na jaae |
English: Even if its value were known, it could not be described.

Gurbani: ਸਰੈ ਸਰੀਅਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sarai sareeat kareh beechaar |
English: Some think about religious rituals and regulations,

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਕੈਸੇ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: bin boojhe kaise paaveh paar |
English: but without understanding, how can they cross over to the other side?

Gurbani: ਸਿਦਕੁ ਕਰਿ ਸਿਜਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਖਸੂਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: sidak kar sijadaa man kar makhasood |
English: Let sincere faith be your bowing in prayer, and let the conquest of your mind be your objective in life.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਧਿਰਿ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਿਹ ਧਿਰਿ ਮਉਜੂਦੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jih dhir dekhaa tih dhir maujood |1|
English: Wherever I look, there I see God's Presence. ||1||

[Ang 84 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸਭਾ ਏਵ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾ ਨੇੜੈ ਨਾ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: gur sabhaa ev na paaeeai naa nerrai naa door |
English: The Society of the Guru is not obtained like this, by trying to be near or far away.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਾਂ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak satigur taan milai jaa man rahai hadoor |2|
English: O Nanak, you shall meet the True Guru, if your mind remains in His Presence. ||2||

[Ang 84 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸਪਤ ਦੀਪ ਸਪਤ ਸਾਗਰਾ ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਚਾਰਿ ਵੇਦ ਦਸ ਅਸਟ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: sapat deep sapat saagaraa nav khandd chaar ved das asatt puraanaa |
English: The seven islands, seven seas, nine continents, four Vedas and eighteen Puraanas

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਤੂੰ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: har sabhanaa vich toon varatadaa har sabhanaa bhaanaa |
English: O Lord, You pervade and permeate all. Lord, everyone loves You.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਤੁਝੈ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਰਗ ਪਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabh tujhai dhiaaveh jeea jant har saarag paanaa |
English: All beings and creatures meditate on You, Lord. You hold the earth in Your Hands.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਹਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo guramukh har aaraadhade tin hau kurabaanaa |
English: I am a sacrifice to those Gurmukhs who worship and adore the Lord.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: toon aape aap varatadaa kar choj viddaanaa |4|
English: You Yourself are All-pervading; You stage this wondrous drama! ||4||

[Ang 84 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਲਉ ਮਸਾਜਨੀ ਕਿਆ ਸਦਾਈਐ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹੀ ਲਿਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: klau masaajanee kiaa sadaaeeai hiradai hee likh lehu |
English: Why ask for a pen, and why ask for ink? Write within your heart.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਹੈ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨ ਤੂਟਸਿ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa saahib kai rang rahai kabahoon na toottas nehu |
English: Remain immersed forever in the Love of your Lord and Master, and your love for Him shall never break.

Gurbani: ਕਲਉ ਮਸਾਜਨੀ ਜਾਇਸੀ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਭੀ ਨਾਲੇ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: klau masaajanee jaaeisee likhiaa bhee naale jaae |
English: Pen and ink shall pass away, along with what has been written.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਇਸੀ ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਛੋਡੀ ਸਚੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak seh preet na jaaeisee jo dhur chhoddee sachai paae |1|
English: O Nanak, the Love of your Husband Lord shall never perish. The True Lord has bestowed it, as it was pre-ordained. ||1||

[Ang 84 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵਦਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕੋ ਵਿਉਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: nadaree aavadaa naal na chalee vekhahu ko viaupaae |
English: That which is seen, shall not go along with you. What does it take to make you see this?

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਸਚਿ ਰਹਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sach drirraaeaa sach rahahu liv laae |
English: The True Guru has implanted the True Name within; remain lovingly absorbed in the True One.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਕਰਮੀ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak sabadee sach hai karamee palai paae |2|
English: O Nanak, the Word of His Shabad is True. By His Grace, it is obtained. ||2||

[Ang 84 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਤੂੰ ਤੂੰ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਭੇਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: har andar baahar ik toon toon jaaneh bhet |
English: O Lord, You are inside and outside as well. You are the Knower of secrets.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕੀਚੈ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: jo keechai so har jaanadaa mere man har chet |
English: Whatever anyone does, the Lord knows. O my mind, think of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਡਰੈ ਜਿ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਵਦਾ ਧਰਮੀ ਵਿਗਸੇਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: so ddarai ji paap kamaavadaa dharamee vigaset |
English: The one who commits sins lives in fear, while the one who lives righteously rejoices.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਆਉ ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਡਰੀਐ ਕੇਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: toon sachaa aap niaau sach taa ddareeai ket |
English: O Lord, You Yourself are True, and True is Your Justice. Why should anyone be afraid?

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਸੇ ਸਚਿ ਰਲੇਤੁ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: jinaa naanak sach pachhaaniaa se sach ralet |5|
English: O Nanak, those who recognize the True Lord are blended with the True One. ||5||

[Ang 84 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਲਮ ਜਲਉ ਸਣੁ ਮਸਵਾਣੀਐ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਭੀ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kalam jlau san masavaaneeai kaagad bhee jal jaau |
English: Burn the pen, and burn the ink; burn the paper as well.

Gurbani: ਲਿਖਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਜਲਿ ਬਲਉ ਜਿਨਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: likhan vaalaa jal blau jin likhiaa doojaa bhaau |
English: Burn the writer who writes in the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak poorab likhiaa kamaavanaa avar na karanaa jaae |1|
English: O Nanak, people do what is pre-ordained; they cannot do anything else. ||1||

[Ang 84 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹੋਰੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਪੜਣਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: hor koorr parranaa koorr bolanaa maaeaa naal piaar |
English: False is other reading, and false is other speaking, in the love of Maya.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak vin naavai ko thir nahee parr parr hoe khuaar |2|
English: O Nanak, without the Name, nothing is permanent; those who read and read are ruined. ||2||

[Ang 84 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੀ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ॥
Transliteration: har kee vaddiaaee vaddee hai har keeratan har kaa |
English: Great is the Greatness of the Lord, and the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੀ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਨਿਆਉ ਹੈ ਧਰਮ ਕਾ ॥
Transliteration: har kee vaddiaaee vaddee hai jaa niaau hai dharam kaa |
English: Great is the Greatness of the Lord; His Justice is totally Righteous.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੀ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਫਲੁ ਹੈ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ॥
Transliteration: har kee vaddiaaee vaddee hai jaa fal hai jeea kaa |
English: Great is the Greatness of the Lord; people receive the fruits of the soul.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੀ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਨ ਸੁਣਈ ਕਹਿਆ ਚੁਗਲ ਕਾ ॥
Transliteration: har kee vaddiaaee vaddee hai jaa na sunee kahiaa chugal kaa |
English: Great is the Greatness of the Lord; He does not hear the words of the back-biters.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੀ ਹੈ ਅਪੁਛਿਆ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵਕਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: har kee vaddiaaee vaddee hai apuchhiaa daan devakaa |6|
English: Great is the Greatness of the Lord; He gives His Gifts without being asked. ||6||

[Ang 84 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤੀ ਸਭ ਮੁਈ ਸੰਪਉ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: hau hau karatee sabh muee sanpau kisai na naal |
English: Those who act in ego shall all die. Their worldly possessions shall not go along with them.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਭ ਜੋਹੀ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: doojai bhaae dukh paaeaa sabh johee jamakaal |
English: Because of their love of duality, they suffer in pain. The Messenger of Death is watching all.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh ubare saachaa naam samaal |1|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are saved, by contemplating the True Name. ||1||

[Ang 85 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗਲਂੀ ਅਸੀ ਚੰਗੀਆ ਆਚਾਰੀ ਬੁਰੀਆਹ ॥
Transliteration: galanee asee changeea aachaaree bureeaah |
English: We are good at talking, but our actions are bad.

Gurbani: ਮਨਹੁ ਕੁਸੁਧਾ ਕਾਲੀਆ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਚਿਟਵੀਆਹ ॥
Transliteration: manahu kusudhaa kaaleea baahar chittaveeaah |
English: Mentally, we are impure and black, but outwardly, we appear white.

Gurbani: ਰੀਸਾ ਕਰਿਹ ਤਿਨਾੜੀਆ ਜੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਦਰੁ ਖੜੀਆਹ ॥
Transliteration: reesaa karih tinaarreea jo seveh dar kharreeaah |
English: We imitate those who stand and serve at the Lord's Door.

Gurbani: ਨਾਲਿ ਖਸਮੈ ਰਤੀਆ ਮਾਣਹਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਰਲੀਆਹ ॥
Transliteration: naal khasamai rateea maaneh sukh raleeaah |
English: They are attuned to the Love of their Husband Lord, and they experience the pleasure of His Love.

Gurbani: ਹੋਦੈ ਤਾਣਿ ਨਿਤਾਣੀਆ ਰਹਹਿ ਨਿਮਾਨਣੀਆਹ ॥
Transliteration: hodai taan nitaaneea raheh nimaananeeaah |
English: They remain powerless, even while they have power; they remain humble and meek.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਕਾਰਥਾ ਜੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਹ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak janam sakaarathaa je tin kai sang milaah |2|
English: O Nanak, our lives become profitable if we associate with them. ||2||

[Ang 85 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਜਲੁ ਮੀਨਾ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪਿ ਜਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: toon aape jal meenaa hai aape aape hee aap jaal |
English: You Yourself are the water, You Yourself are the fish, and You Yourself are the net.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਲੁ ਵਤਾਇਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੇਬਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: toon aape jaal vataaeidaa aape vich sebaal |
English: You Yourself cast the net, and You Yourself are the bait.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਕਮਲੁ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਹੈ ਸੈ ਹਥਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਗੁਲਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: toon aape kamal alipat hai sai hathaa vich gulaal |
English: You Yourself are the lotus, unaffected and still brightly-colored in hundreds of feet of water.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਘੜੀ ਕਰਿ ਖਿਆਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: toon aape mukat karaaeidaa ik nimakh gharree kar khiaal |
English: You Yourself liberate those who think of You for even an instant.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਤੁਧਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਵੇਖਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: har tudhahu baahar kichh nahee gurasabadee vekh nihaal |7|
English: O Lord, nothing is beyond You. I am delighted to behold You, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||7||

[Ang 85 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਰੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: hukam na jaanai bahutaa rovai |
English: One who does not know the Hukam of the Lord's Command cries out in terrible pain.

Gurbani: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਧੋਖਾ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਸੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: andar dhokhaa need na sovai |
English: She is filled with deception, and she cannot sleep in peace.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਧਨ ਖਸਮੈ ਚਲੈ ਰਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: je dhan khasamai chalai rajaaee |
English: But if the soul-bride follows the Will of her Lord and Master,

Gurbani: ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: dar ghar sobhaa mehal bulaaee |
English: She shall be honored in her own home, and called to the Mansion of His Presence.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਮੀ ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: naanak karamee ih mat paaee |
English: O Nanak, by His Mercy, this understanding is obtained.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee sach samaaee |1|
English: By Guru's Grace, she is absorbed into the True One. ||1||

[Ang 85 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣਿਆ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਨ ਭੁਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh naam vihooniaa rang kasunbhaa dekh na bhul |
English: O self-willed manmukh, devoid of the Naam, do not be misled upon beholding the color of the safflower.

Gurbani: ਇਸ ਕਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਦਿਨ ਥੋੜਿਆ ਛੋਛਾ ਇਸ ਦਾ ਮੁਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: eis kaa rang din thorriaa chhochhaa is daa mul |
English: Its color lasts for only a few days-it is worthless!

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗੇ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਮੂਰਖ ਅੰਧ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: doojai lage pach mue moorakh andh gavaar |
English: Attached to duality, the foolish, blind and stupid people waste away and die.

Gurbani: ਬਿਸਟਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕੀਟ ਸੇ ਪਇ ਪਚਹਿ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: bisattaa andar keett se pe pacheh vaaro vaar |
English: Like worms, they live in manure, and in it, they die over and over again.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਰੰਗੁਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak naam rate se rangule gur kai sehaj subhaae |
English: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam are dyed in the color of truth; they take on the intuitive peace and poise of the Guru.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bhagatee rang na utarai sahaje rahai samaae |2|
English: The color of devotional worship does not fade away; they remain intuitively absorbed in the Lord. ||2||

[Ang 85 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਸਭ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sisatt upaaee sabh tudh aape rijak sanbaahiaa |
English: You created the entire universe, and You Yourself bring sustenance to it.

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਵਲੁ ਛਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਖਾਵਦੇ ਮੁਹਹੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਸਤੁ ਤਿਨੀ ਢਾਹਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: eik val chhal kar kai khaavade muhahu koorr kusat tinee dtaahiaa |
English: Some eat and survive by practicing fraud and deceit; from their mouths they drop falsehood and lies.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਓਤੈ ਕੰਮਿ ਓਇ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tudh aape bhaavai so kareh tudh otai kam oe laaeaa |
English: As it pleases You, You assign them their tasks.

Gurbani: ਇਕਨਾ ਸਚੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਓਨੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਅਤੁਟ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਦੇਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: eikanaa sach bujhaaeon tinaa atutt bhanddaar devaaeaa |
English: Some understand Truthfulness; they are given the inexhaustible treasure.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿ ਖਾਹਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਸਫਲੁ ਹੈ ਅਚੇਤਾ ਹਥ ਤਡਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: har chet khaeh tinaa safal hai achetaa hath taddaaeaa |8|
English: Those who eat by remembering the Lord are prosperous, while those who do not remember Him stretch out their hands in need. ||8||

[Ang 85 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਬੇਦ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਸੁਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: parr parr panddit bed vakhaaneh maaeaa moh suaae |
English: The Pandits, the religious scholars, constantly read and recite the Vedas, for the sake of the love of Maya.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਮਨ ਮੂਰਖ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: doojai bhaae har naam visaariaa man moorakh milai sajaae |
English: In the love of duality, the foolish people have forgotten the Lord's Name; they shall receive their punishment.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਦਿਤਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਜੋ ਦੇਂਦਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jin jeeo pindd ditaa tis kabahoon na chetai jo dendaa rijak sanbaeh |
English: They never think of the One who gave them body and soul, who provides sustenance to all.

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਕਾ ਫਾਹਾ ਗਲਹੁ ਨ ਕਟੀਐ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jam kaa faahaa galahu na katteeai fir fir aavai jaae |
English: The noose of death shall not be cut away from their necks; they shall come and go in reincarnation over and over again.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh kichhoo na soojhai andhule poorab likhiaa kamaae |
English: The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not understand anything. They do what they are pre-ordained to do.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: poorai bhaag satigur milai sukhadaataa naam vasai man aae |
English: Through perfect destiny, they meet the True Guru, the Giver of peace, and the Naam comes to abide in the mind.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਣਹਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪੈਨਣਾ ਸੁਖੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sukh maaneh sukh painanaa sukhe sukh vihaae |
English: They enjoy peace, they wear peace, and they pass their lives in the peace of peace.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਨਾਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਜਿਤੁ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak so naau manahu na visaareeai jit dar sachai sobhaa paae |1|
English: O Nanak, they do not forget the Naam from the mind; they are honored in the Court of the Lord. ||1||

[Ang 85 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sev sukh paaeaa sach naam gunataas |
English: Serving the True Guru, peace is obtained. The True Name is the Treasure of Excellence.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramatee aap pachhaaniaa raam naam paragaas |
English: Follow the Guru's Teachings, and recognize your own self; the Divine Light of the Lord's Name shall shine within.

Gurbani: ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੇ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: sacho sach kamaavanaa vaddiaaee vadde paas |
English: The true ones practice Truth; greatness rests in the Great Lord.

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: jeeo pindd sabh tis kaa sifat kare aradaas |
English: Body, soul and all things belong to the Lord-praise Him, and offer your prayers to Him.

Gurbani: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਸੁਖੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: sachai sabad saalaahanaa sukhe sukh nivaas |
English: Sing the Praises of the True Lord through the Word of His Shabad, and you shall abide in the peace of peace.

Gurbani: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਮਨੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: jap tap sanjam manai maeh bin naavai dhrig jeevaas |
English: You may practice chanting, penance and austere self-discipline within your mind, but without the Name, life is useless.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramatee naau paaeeai manamukh mohi vinaas |
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Name is obtained, while the self-willed manmukh wastes away in emotional attachment.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖੁ ਤੂੰ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਾਸੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jiau bhaavai tiau raakh toon naanak teraa daas |2|
English: Please protect me, by the Pleasure of Your Will. Nanak is Your slave. ||2||

[Ang 86 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਭਸੁ ਦਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨਾ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: sabh ko teraa toon sabhas daa toon sabhanaa raas |
English: All are Yours, and You belong to all. You are the wealth of all.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਤੁਧੈ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਮੰਗਦੇ ਨਿਤ ਕਰਿ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: sabh tudhai paasahu mangade nit kar aradaas |
English: Everyone begs from You, and all offer prayers to You each day.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਇਕਨਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਹੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: jis toon dehi tis sabh kichh milai ikanaa door hai paas |
English: Those, unto whom You give, receive everything. You are far away from some, and You are close to others.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਥਾਉ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਮਨਿ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕੋ ਨਿਰਜਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: tudh baajhahu thaau ko naahee jis paasahu mangeeai man vekhahu ko nirajaas |
English: Without You, there is not even a place to stand begging. See this yourself and verify it in your mind.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਤੁਧੈ ਨੋ ਸਾਲਾਹਦੇ ਦਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: sabh tudhai no saalaahade dar guramukhaa no paragaas |9|
English: All praise You, O Lord; at Your Door, the Gurmukhs are enlightened. ||9||

[Ang 86 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਉਚਾ ਕੂਕਦਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: panddit parr parr uchaa kookadaa maaeaa mohi piaar |
English: The Pandits, the religious scholars, read and read, and shout out loud, but they are attached to the love of Maya.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨ ਚੀਨਈ ਮਨਿ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਗਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: antar braham na cheenee man moorakh gaavaar |
English: They do not recognize God within themselves-they are so foolish and ignorant!

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਜਗਤੁ ਪਰਬੋਧਦਾ ਨਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: doojai bhaae jagat parabodhadaa naa boojhai beechaar |
English: In the love of duality, they try to teach the world, but they do not understand meditative contemplation.

Gurbani: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: birathaa janam gavaaeaa mar jamai vaaro vaar |1|
English: They lose their lives uselessly; they die, only to be re-born, over and over again. ||1||

[Ang 86 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨੀ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਇਆ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jinee satigur seviaa tinee naau paaeaa boojhahu kar beechaar |
English: Those who serve the True Guru obtain the Name. Reflect on this and understand.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਚੂਕੈ ਕੂਕ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa saant sukh man vasai chookai kook pukaar |
English: Eternal peace and joy abide in their minds; they abandon their cries and complaints.

Gurbani: ਆਪੈ ਨੋ ਆਪੁ ਖਾਇ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: aapai no aap khaae man niramal hovai gurasabadee veechaar |
English: Their identity consumes their identical identity, and their minds become pure by contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak sabad rate se mukat hai har jeeo het piaar |2|
English: O Nanak, attuned to the Shabad, they are liberated. They love their Beloved Lord. ||2||

[Ang 86 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਫਲ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਥਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: har kee sevaa safal hai guramukh paavai thaae |
English: Service to the Lord is fruitful; through it, the Gurmukh is honored and approved.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: jis har bhaavai tis gur milai so har naam dhiaae |
English: That person, with whom the Lord is pleased, meets with the Guru, and meditates on the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਲਘਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gurasabadee har paaeeai har paar laghaae |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord is found. The Lord carries us across.

Gurbani: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਪੁਛਹੁ ਵੇਦਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: manahatth kinai na paaeo puchhahu vedaa jaae |
English: Through stubborn-mindedness, none have found Him; go and consult the Vedas on this.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਏ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਇ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: naanak har kee sevaa so kare jis le har laae |10|
English: O Nanak, he alone serves the Lord, whom the Lord attaches to Himself. ||10||

[Ang 86 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸੂਰਾ ਵਰੀਆਮੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਦੁਸਟੁ ਅਹੰਕਰਣੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: naanak so sooraa vareeaam jin vichahu dusatt ahankaran maariaa |
English: O Nanak, he is a brave warrior, who conquers and subdues his vicious inner ego.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh naam saalaeh janam savaariaa |
English: Praising the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the Gurmukhs redeem their lives.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਹੋਆ ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੁਲੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: aap hoaa sadaa mukat sabh kul nisataariaa |
English: They themselves are liberated forever, and they save all their ancestors.

Gurbani: ਸੋਹਨਿ ਸਚਿ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sohan sach duaar naam piaariaa |
English: Those who love the Naam look beauteous at the Gate of Truth.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਰਹਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਵਿਗਾੜਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh mareh ahankaar maran vigaarriaa |
English: The self-willed manmukhs die in egotism-even their death is painfully ugly.

Gurbani: ਸਭੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਿਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabho varatai hukam kiaa kareh vichaariaa |
English: Everything happens according to the Lord's Will; what can the poor people do?

Gurbani: ਆਪਹੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: aapahu doojai lag khasam visaariaa |
English: Attached to self-conceit and duality, they have forgotten their Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak bin naavai sabh dukh sukh visaariaa |1|
English: O Nanak, without the Name, everything is painful, and happiness is forgotten. ||1||

[Ang 86 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur poorai har naam dirraaeaa tin vichahu bharam chukaaeaa |
English: The Perfect Guru has implanted the Name of the Lord within me. It has dispelled my doubts from within.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗਾਈ ਕਰਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਮਗੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam har keerat gaaee kar chaanan mag dikhaaeaa |
English: I sing the Lord's Name and the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises; the Divine Light shines, and now I see the Way.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: haumai maar ek liv laagee antar naam vasaaeaa |
English: Conquering my ego, I am lovingly focused on the One Lord; the Naam has come to dwell within me.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: guramatee jam johi na saakai saachai naam samaaeaa |
English: Following the Guru's Teachings, I cannot be touched by the Messenger of Death. I am absorbed in the True Name.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਕਰਤਾ ਜੋ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਨਾਇ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabh aape aap varatai karataa jo bhaavai so naae laaeaa |
English: The Creator Himself is All-pervading everywhere; He links those with whom He is pleased to His Name.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਏ ਤਾ ਜੀਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jan naanak naam le taa jeevai bin naavai khin mar jaaeaa |2|
English: Servant Nanak chants the Naam, and so he lives. Without the Name, he would die in an instant. ||2||

[Ang 87 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਬਾਣ ਸਿਉ ਸੋ ਸਭਨੀ ਦੀਬਾਣੀ ਮਿਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jo miliaa har deebaan siau so sabhanee deebaanee miliaa |
English: One who is accepted at the Court of the Lord shall be accepted in courts everywhere.

Gurbani: ਜਿਥੈ ਓਹੁ ਜਾਇ ਤਿਥੈ ਓਹੁ ਸੁਰਖਰੂ ਉਸ ਕੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਡਿਠੈ ਸਭ ਪਾਪੀ ਤਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jithai ohu jaae tithai ohu surakharoo us kai muhi dditthai sabh paapee tariaa |
English: Wherever he goes, he is recognized as honorable. Seeing his face, all sinners are saved.

Gurbani: ਓਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੋ ਪਰਵਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: os antar naam nidhaan hai naamo paravariaa |
English: Within him is the Treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Through the Naam, he is exalted.

Gurbani: ਨਾਉ ਪੂਜੀਐ ਨਾਉ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਨਾਇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਸਭ ਹਿਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: naau poojeeai naau maneeai naae kilavikh sabh hiriaa |
English: He worships the Name, and believes in the Name; the Name erases all his sinful mistakes.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕ ਚਿਤਿ ਸੇ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਜਗਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: jinee naam dhiaaeaa ik man ik chit se asathir jag rahiaa |11|
English: Those who meditate on the Name, with one-pointed mind and focused consciousness, remain forever stable in the world. ||11||

[Ang 87 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਤਮਾ ਦੇਉ ਪੂਜੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aatamaa deo poojeeai gur kai sehaj subhaae |
English: Worship the Divine, Supreme Soul, with the intuitive peace and poise of the Guru.

Gurbani: ਆਤਮੇ ਨੋ ਆਤਮੇ ਦੀ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਤਾ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਪਰਚਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aatame no aatame dee prateet hoe taa ghar hee parachaa paae |
English: If the individual soul has faith in the Supreme Soul, then it shall obtain realization within its own home.

Gurbani: ਆਤਮਾ ਅਡੋਲੁ ਨ ਡੋਲਈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aatamaa addol na ddolee gur kai bhaae subhaae |
English: The soul becomes steady, and does not waver, by the natural inclination of the Guru's Loving Will.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur vin sehaj na aavee lobh mail na vichahu jaae |
English: Without the Guru, intuitive wisdom does not come, and the filth of greed does not depart from within.

Gurbani: ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਭ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: khin pal har naam man vasai sabh atthasatth teerath naae |
English: If the Lord's Name abides within the mind, for a moment, even for an instant, it is like bathing at all the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

Gurbani: ਸਚੇ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sache mail na lagee mal laagai doojai bhaae |
English: Filth does not stick to those who are true, but filth attaches itself to those who love duality.

Gurbani: ਧੋਤੀ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਜੇ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: dhotee mool na utarai je atthasatth teerath naae |
English: This filth cannot be washed off, even by bathing at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh karam kare ahankaaree sabh dukho dukh kamaae |
English: The self-willed manmukh does deeds in egotism; he earns only pain and more pain.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈਲਾ ਊਜਲੁ ਤਾ ਥੀਐ ਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak mailaa aoojal taa theeai jaa satigur maeh samaae |1|
English: O Nanak, the filthy ones become clean only when they meet and surrender to the True Guru. ||1||

[Ang 87 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਲੋਕੁ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਕਦਹੁ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh lok samajhaaeeai kadahu samajhaaeaa jaae |
English: The self-willed manmukhs may be taught, but how can they really be taught?

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਰਲਾਇਆ ਨਾ ਰਲੈ ਪਇਐ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਫਿਰਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh ralaaeaa naa ralai peiai kirat firaae |
English: The manmukhs do not fit in at all. Because of their past actions, they are condemned to the cycle of reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਲਿਵ ਧਾਤੁ ਦੁਇ ਰਾਹ ਹੈ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: liv dhaat due raah hai hukamee kaar kamaae |
English: Loving attention to the Lord and attachment to Maya are the two separate ways; all act according to the Hukam of the Lord's Command.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਕਸਵਟੀ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh aapanaa man maariaa sabad kasavattee laae |
English: The Gurmukh has conquered his own mind, by applying the Touchstone of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਹੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਝਗੜਾ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਸਥ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮੰਝਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man hee naal jhagarraa man hee naal sath man hee manjh samaae |
English: He fights with his mind, he settles with his mind, and he is at peace with his mind.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਜੋ ਇਛੇ ਸੋ ਲਹੈ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man jo ichhe so lahai sachai sabad subhaae |
English: All obtain the desires of their minds, through the Love of the True Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦ ਭੁੰਚੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: amrit naam sad bhuncheeai guramukh kaar kamaae |
English: They drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam forever; this is how the Gurmukhs act.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਮਨੈ ਜਿ ਹੋਰੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਲੁਝਣਾ ਜਾਸੀ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: vin manai ji horee naal lujhanaa jaasee janam gavaae |
English: Those who struggle with something other than their own mind, shall depart having wasted their lives.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖੀ ਮਨਹਠਿ ਹਾਰਿਆ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਸਤੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: manamukhee manahatth haariaa koorr kusat kamaae |
English: The self-willed manmukhs, through stubborn-mindedness and the practice of falsehood, lose the game of life.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਨੁ ਜਿਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee man jinai har setee liv laae |
English: Those who conquer their own mind, by Guru's Grace, lovingly focus their attention on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh sach kamaavai manamukh aavai jaae |2|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs practice Truth, while the self-willed manmukhs continue coming and going in reincarnation. ||2||

[Ang 87 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਇਕ ਸਾਖੀ ॥
Transliteration: har ke sant sunahu jan bhaaee har satigur kee ik saakhee |
English: O Saints of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny, listen, and hear the Lord's Teachings, through the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਲੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਾਖੀ ॥
Transliteration: jis dhur bhaag hovai mukh masatak tin jan lai hiradai raakhee |
English: Those who have good destiny pre-ordained and inscribed on their foreheads, grasp it and keep it enshrined in the heart.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਥਾ ਸਰੇਸਟ ਊਤਮ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਚਾਖੀ ॥
Transliteration: har amrit kathaa saresatt aootam gur bachanee sahaje chaakhee |
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, they intuitively taste the sublime, exquisite and ambrosial sermon of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਹ ਭਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ਜਿਉ ਸੂਰਜ ਰੈਣਿ ਕਿਰਾਖੀ ॥
Transliteration: teh bheaa pragaas mittiaa andhiaaraa jiau sooraj rain kiraakhee |
English: The Divine Light shines in their hearts, and like the sun which removes the darkness of night, it dispels the darkness of ignorance.

Gurbani: ਅਦਿਸਟੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸੋ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਖੀ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: adisatt agochar alakh niranjan so dekhiaa guramukh aakhee |12|
English: As Gurmukh, they behold with their eyes the Unseen, Imperceptible, Unknowable, Immaculate Lord. ||12||

[Ang 87 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੋ ਸਿਰੁ ਲੇਖੈ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur seve aapanaa so sir lekhai laae |
English: Those who serve their True Guru are certified and accepted.

Gurbani: ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਕੈ ਰਹਨਿ ਸਚਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: vichahu aap gavaae kai rehan sach liv laae |
English: They eradicate selfishness and conceit from within; they remain lovingly absorbed in the True One.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਤਿਨਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur jinee na sevio tinaa birathaa janam gavaae |
English: Those who do not serve the True Guru waste away their lives in vain.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak jo tis bhaavai so kare kahanaa kichhoo na jaae |1|
English: O Nanak, the Lord does just as He pleases. No one has any say in this. ||1||

[Ang 88 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਵੇਕਾਰੀ ਵੇੜਿਆ ਵੇਕਾਰਾ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man vekaaree verriaa vekaaraa karam kamaae |
English: With the mind encircled by wickedness and evil, people do evil deeds.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਪੂਜਦੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: doojai bhaae agiaanee poojade daragah milai sajaae |
English: The ignorant worship the love of duality; in the Lord's Court they shall be punished.

Gurbani: ਆਤਮ ਦੇਉ ਪੂਜੀਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aatam deo poojeeai bin satigur boojh na paae |
English: So worship the Lord, the Light of the soul; without the True Guru, understanding is not obtained.

Gurbani: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕਾ ਕਰਮੀ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jap tap sanjam bhaanaa satiguroo kaa karamee palai paae |
English: Meditation, penance and austere self-discipline are found by surrendering to the True Guru's Will. By His Grace this is received.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak sevaa surat kamaavanee jo har bhaavai so thaae paae |2|
English: O Nanak, serve with this intuitive awareness; only that which is pleasing to the Lord is approved. ||2||

[Ang 88 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam japahu man mere jit sadaa sukh hovai din raatee |
English: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind; it will bring you eternal peace, day and night.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਲਹਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam japahu man mere jit simarat sabh kilavikh paap lahaatee |
English: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind; meditating on it, all sins and misdeeds shall be erased.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਜਿਤੁ ਦਾਲਦੁ ਦੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਸਭ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam japahu man mere jit daalad dukh bhukh sabh leh jaatee |
English: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind; through it, all poverty, pain and hunger shall be removed.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam japahu man mere mukh guramukh preet lagaatee |
English: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind; as Gurmukh, declare your love.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਤੀ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: jit mukh bhaag likhiaa dhur saachai har tith mukh naam japaatee |13|
English: One who has such pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon his forehead by the True Lord, chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||13||

[Ang 88 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਕੀਤੋ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: satigur jinee na sevio sabad na keeto veechaar |
English: Those who do not serve the True Guru, and who do not contemplate the Word of the Shabad

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਮਿਰਤਕੁ ਹੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: antar giaan na aaeo miratak hai sansaar |
English: -spiritual wisdom does not enter into their hearts; they are like dead bodies in the world.

Gurbani: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਫੇਰੁ ਪਇਆ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh fer peaa mar jamai hoe khuaar |
English: They go through the cycle of 8.4 million reincarnations, and they are ruined through death and rebirth.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur kee sevaa so kare jis no aap karaae soe |
English: He alone serves the True Guru, whom the Lord Himself inspires to do so.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur vich naam nidhaan hai karam paraapat hoe |
English: The Treasure of the Naam is within the True Guru; by His Grace, it is obtained.

Gurbani: ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਸਿਉ ਤਿਨ ਸਚੀ ਸਦਾ ਲਿਵ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sach rate gurasabad siau tin sachee sadaa liv hoe |
English: Those who are truly attuned to the Word of the Guru's Shabad-their love is forever True.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਮੇਲੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak jis no mele na vichhurrai sehaj samaavai soe |1|
English: O Nanak, those who are united with Him shall not be separated again. They merge imperceptibly into God. ||1||

[Ang 88 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਭਗਉਤੀ ਜੋੁ ਭਗਵੰਤੈ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: so bhgautee juo bhagavantai jaanai |
English: One who knows the Benevolent Lord God is the true devotee of Bhagaautee.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee aap pachhaanai |
English: By Guru's Grace, he is self-realized.

Gurbani: ਧਾਵਤੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਇਕਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: dhaavat raakhai ikat ghar aanai |
English: He restrains his wandering mind, and brings it back to its own home within the self.

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: jeevat marai har naam vakhaanai |
English: He remains dead while yet alive, and he chants the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਭਗਉਤੀ ਉਤਮੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa bhgautee utam hoe |
English: Such a Bhagaautee is most exalted.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak sach samaavai soe |2|
English: O Nanak, he merges into the True One. ||2||

[Ang 88 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
