Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਭਗਉਤੀ ਕਹਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: antar kapatt bhgautee kahaae |
English: He is full of deceit, and yet he calls himself a devotee of Bhagaautee.

Gurbani: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: paakhandd paarabraham kade na paae |
English: Through hypocrisy, he shall never attain the Supreme Lord God.

Gurbani: ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰੇ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: par nindaa kare antar mal laae |
English: He slanders others, and pollutes himself with his own filth.

Gurbani: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਵੈ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: baahar mal dhovai man kee jootth na jaae |
English: Outwardly, he washes off the filth, but the impurity of his mind does not go away.

Gurbani: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਬਾਦੁ ਰਚਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: satasangat siau baad rachaae |
English: He argues with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਰਚਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: anadin dukheea doojai bhaae rachaae |
English: Night and day, he suffers, engrossed in the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: har naam na chetai bahu karam kamaae |
English: He does not remember the Name of the Lord, but still, he performs all sorts of empty rituals.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਬ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਮੇਟਣਾ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: poorab likhiaa su mettanaa na jaae |
English: That which is pre-ordained cannot be erased.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਮੋਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak bin satigur seve mokh na paae |3|
English: O Nanak, without serving the True Guru, liberation is not obtained. ||3||

[Ang 88 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਸੇ ਕੜਿ ਨ ਸਵਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: satigur jinee dhiaaeaa se karr na savaahee |
English: Those who meditate on the True Guru shall not be burnt to ashes.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਸੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: satigur jinee dhiaaeaa se tripat aghaahee |
English: Those who meditate on the True Guru are satisfied and fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਜਮ ਡਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: satigur jinee dhiaaeaa tin jam ddar naahee |
English: Those who meditate on the True Guru are not afraid of the Messenger of Death.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਹੋਆ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jin kau hoaa kripaal har se satigur pairee paahee |
English: Those upon whom the Lord showers His Mercy, fall at the Feet of the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧੇ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: tin aithai othai mukh ujale har daragah paidhe jaahee |14|
English: Here and hereafter, their faces are radiant; they go to the Lord's Court in robes of honor. ||14||

[Ang 89 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 2 |
English: Salok, Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਸਿਰੁ ਸਾਂਈ ਨਾ ਨਿਵੈ ਸੋ ਸਿਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਡਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jo sir saanee naa nivai so sir deejai ddaar |
English: Chop off that head which does not bow to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਪਿੰਜਰ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਰਹਾ ਨਹੀ ਸੋ ਪਿੰਜਰੁ ਲੈ ਜਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak jis pinjar meh birahaa nahee so pinjar lai jaar |1|
English: O Nanak, that human body, in which there is no pain of separation from the Lord-take that body and burn it. ||1||

[Ang 89 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੁੰਢਹੁ ਭੁਲੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਮੁਈਆਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: mundtahu bhulee naanakaa fir fir janam mueeaas |
English: Forgetting the Primal Lord, O Nanak, people are born and die, over and over again.

Gurbani: ਕਸਤੂਰੀ ਕੈ ਭੋਲੜੈ ਗੰਦੇ ਡੁੰਮਿ ਪਈਆਸੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kasatooree kai bholarrai gande ddunm peeaas |2|
English: Mistaking it for musk, they have fallen into the stinking pit of filth. ||2||

[Ang 89 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੋ ਸਭਨਾ ਉਪਰਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: so aisaa har naam dhiaaeeai man mere jo sabhanaa upar hukam chalaae |
English: Meditate on that Name of the Lord, O my mind, whose Command rules over all.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੋ ਅੰਤੀ ਅਉਸਰਿ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: so aisaa har naam japeeai man mere jo antee aausar le chhaddaae |
English: Chant that Name of the Lord, O my mind, which will save you at the very last moment.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੁ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਸਭ ਭੁਖ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: so aisaa har naam japeeai man mere ju man kee trisanaa sabh bhukh gavaae |
English: Chant that Name of the Lord, O my mind, which shall drive out all hunger and desire from your mind.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਤਿਨ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਦੁਸਟ ਸਭਿ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: so guramukh naam japiaa vaddabhaagee tin nindak dusatt sabh pairee paae |
English: Very fortunate and blessed is that Gurmukh who chants the Naam; it shall bring all slanderers and wicked enemies to fall at his feet.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਤੇ ਵਡਾ ਸਭਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਅਗੈ ਆਣਿ ਨਿਵਾਏ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: naanak naam araadh sabhanaa te vaddaa sabh naavai agai aan nivaae |15|
English: O Nanak, worship and adore the Naam, the Greatest Name of all, before which all come and bow. ||15||

[Ang 89 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਵੇਸ ਕਰੇ ਕੁਰੂਪਿ ਕੁਲਖਣੀ ਮਨਿ ਖੋਟੈ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: ves kare kuroop kulakhanee man khottai koorriaar |
English: She may wear good clothes, but the bride is ugly and rude; her mind is false and impure.

Gurbani: ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਨਾ ਚਲੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਗਾਵਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: pir kai bhaanai naa chalai hukam kare gaavaar |
English: She does not walk in harmony with the Will of her Husband Lord. Instead, she foolishly gives Him orders.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖ ਨਿਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai bhaanai jo chalai sabh dukh nivaaranahaar |
English: But she who walks in harmony with the Guru's Will, shall be spared all pain and suffering.

Gurbani: ਲਿਖਿਆ ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਕੀਐ ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: likhiaa mett na sakeeai jo dhur likhiaa karataar |
English: That destiny which was pre-ordained by the Creator cannot be erased.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਉਪੇ ਕੰਤ ਕਉ ਸਬਦੇ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: man tan saupe kant kau sabade dhare piaar |
English: She must dedicate her mind and body to her Husband Lord, and enshrine love for the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: bin naavai kinai na paaeaa dekhahu ridai beechaar |
English: Without His Name, no one has found Him; see this and reflect upon it in your heart.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾ ਸੁਆਲਿਓ ਸੁਲਖਣੀ ਜਿ ਰਾਵੀ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak saa suaalio sulakhanee ji raavee sirajanahaar |1|
English: O Nanak, she is beautiful and graceful; the Creator Lord ravishes and enjoys her. ||1||

[Ang 89 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਨ ਦਿਸੈ ਉਰਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohu gubaar hai tis daa na disai uravaar na paar |
English: Attachment to Maya is an ocean of darkness; neither this shore nor the one beyond can be seen.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦੇ ਡੁਬੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh agiaanee mahaa dukh paaeide ddube har naam visaar |
English: The ignorant, self-willed manmukhs suffer in terrible pain; they forget the Lord's Name and drown.

Gurbani: ਭਲਕੇ ਉਠਿ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: bhalake utth bahu karam kamaaveh doojai bhaae piaar |
English: They arise in the morning and perform all sorts of rituals, but they are caught in the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਉਤਰੇ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: satigur seveh aapanaa bhaujal utare paar |
English: Those who serve the True Guru cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh sach samaaveh sach naam ur dhaar |2|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs keep the True Name enshrined in their hearts; they are absorbed into the True One. ||2||

[Ang 89 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: har jal thal maheeal bharapoor doojaa naeh koe |
English: The Lord pervades and permeates the water, the land and the sky; there is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਬਹਿ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਆਉ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਸਭ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਢੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: har aap beh kare niaau koorriaar sabh maar kadtoe |
English: The Lord Himself sits upon His Throne and administers justice. He beats and drives out the false-hearted.

Gurbani: ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਧਰਮ ਨਿਆਉ ਕੀਓਇ ॥
Transliteration: sachiaaraa dee vaddiaaee har dharam niaau keeoe |
English: The Lord bestows glorious greatness upon those who are truthful. He administers righteous justice.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਕਰਹੁ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਗਰੀਬ ਅਨਾਥ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਓਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabh har kee karahu usatat jin gareeb anaath raakh leeoe |
English: So praise the Lord, everybody; He protects the poor and the lost souls.

Gurbani: ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਓ ਧਰਮੀਆ ਕਾ ਪਾਪੀ ਕਉ ਡੰਡੁ ਦੀਓਇ ॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: jaikaar keeo dharameea kaa paapee kau ddandd deeoe |16|
English: He honors the righteous and punishes the sinners. ||16||

[Ang 89 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੈਲੀ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਕੁਲਖਣੀ ਕੁਨਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh mailee kaamanee kulakhanee kunaar |
English: The self-willed manmukh, the foolish bride, is a filthy, rude and evil wife.

Gurbani: ਪਿਰੁ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਪਰ ਪੁਰਖੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: pir chhoddiaa ghar aapanaa par purakhai naal piaar |
English: Forsaking her Husband Lord and leaving her own home, she gives her love to another.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਜਲਦੀ ਕਰੇ ਪੂਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: trisanaa kade na chukee jaladee kare pookaar |
English: Her desires are never satisfied, and she burns and cries out in pain.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੁਰੂਪਿ ਕੁਸੋਹਣੀ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਛੋਡੀ ਭਤਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak bin naavai kuroop kusohanee parahar chhoddee bhataar |1|
English: O Nanak, without the Name, she is ugly and ungraceful. She is abandoned and left behind by her Husband Lord. ||1||

[Ang 90 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੀ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: sabad ratee sohaaganee satigur kai bhaae piaar |
English: The happy soul-bride is attuned to the Word of the Shabad; she is in love with the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਰਾਵੇ ਪਿਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਚੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa raave pir aapanaa sachai prem piaar |
English: She continually enjoys and ravishes her Beloved, with true love and affection.

Gurbani: ਅਤਿ ਸੁਆਲਿਉ ਸੁੰਦਰੀ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: at suaaliau sundaree sobhaavantee naar |
English: She is such a loveable, beautiful and noble woman.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਮੇਲੀ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naam sohaaganee melee melanahaar |2|
English: O Nanak, through the Naam, the happy soul-bride unites with the Lord of Union. ||2||

[Ang 90 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਭ ਕਰਹਿ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਫਾਥੇ ਕਾਢਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: har teree sabh kareh usatat jin faathe kaadtiaa |
English: Lord, everyone sings Your Praises. You have freed us from bondage.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਭ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਾਪੈ ਤੇ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: har tudhano kareh sabh namasakaar jin paapai te raakhiaa |
English: Lord, everyone bows in reverence to You. You have saved us from our sinful ways.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਮਾਣਿਆ ਤੂੰ ਮਾਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਡਾਢੀ ਹੂੰ ਤੂੰ ਡਾਢਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: har nimaaniaa toon maan har ddaadtee hoon toon ddaadtiaa |
English: Lord, You are the Honor of the dishonored. Lord, You are the Strongest of the strong.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀਆ ਮਾਰਿ ਨਿਵਾਏ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂੜ ਸਾਧਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: har ahankaareea maar nivaae manamukh moorr saadhiaa |
English: The Lord beats down the egocentrics and corrects the foolish, self-willed manmukhs.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗਰੀਬ ਅਨਾਥਿਆ ॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: har bhagataa dee vaddiaaee gareeb anaathiaa |17|
English: The Lord bestows glorious greatness on His devotees, the poor, and the lost souls. ||17||

[Ang 90 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur kai bhaanai jo chalai tis vaddiaaee vaddee hoe |
English: One who walks in harmony with the Will of the True Guru, obtains the greatest glory.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਤਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam utam man vasai mett na sakai koe |
English: The Exalted Name of the Lord abides in his mind, and no one can take it away.

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: kirapaa kare jis aapanee tis karam paraapat hoe |
English: That person, upon whom the Lord bestows His Grace, receives His Mercy.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak kaaran karate vas hai guramukh boojhai koe |1|
English: O Nanak, creativity is under the control of the Creator; how rare are those who, as Gurmukh, realize this! ||1||

[Ang 90 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਤਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: naanak har naam jinee aaraadhiaa anadin har liv taar |
English: O Nanak, those who worship and adore the Lord's Name night and day, vibrate the String of the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਬੰਦੀ ਖਸਮ ਕੀ ਤਿਨ ਅਗੈ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa bandee khasam kee tin agai kamaavai kaar |
English: Maya, the maid-servant of our Lord and Master, serves them.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: poorai pooraa kar chhoddiaa hukam savaaranahaar |
English: The Perfect One has made them perfect; by the Hukam of His Command, they are embellished.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee jin bujhiaa tin paaeaa mokh duaar |
English: By Guru's Grace, they understand Him, and they find the gate of salvation.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਤਿਨ ਮਾਰੇ ਜਮ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh hukam na jaananee tin maare jam jandaar |
English: The self-willed manmukhs do not know the Lord's Command; they are beaten down by the Messenger of Death.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਤਿਨੀ ਤਰਿਆ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh jinee araadhiaa tinee tariaa bhaujal sansaar |
English: But the Gurmukhs, who worship and adore the Lord, cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਅਉਗਣ ਗੁਣੀ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sabh aaugan gunee mittaaeaa gur aape bakhasanahaar |2|
English: All their demerits are erased, and replaced with merits. The Guru Himself is their Forgiver. ||2||

[Ang 90 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: har kee bhagataa parateet har sabh kichh jaanadaa |
English: The Lord's devotees have faith in Him. The Lord knows everything.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਰਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: har jevadd naahee koee jaan har dharam beechaaradaa |
English: No one is as great a Knower as the Lord; the Lord administers righteous justice.

Gurbani: ਕਾੜਾ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਕਿਉ ਕੀਜੈ ਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਧਰਮਿ ਮਾਰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaarraa andesaa kiau keejai jaa naahee adharam maaradaa |
English: Why should we feel any burning anxiety, since the Lord does not punish without just cause?

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਆਉ ਪਾਪੀ ਨਰੁ ਹਾਰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa saahib sach niaau paapee nar haaradaa |
English: True is the Master, and True is His Justice; only the sinners are defeated.

Gurbani: ਸਾਲਾਹਿਹੁ ਭਗਤਹੁ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਜਨ ਤਾਰਦਾ ॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: saalaahihu bhagatahu kar jorr har bhagat jan taaradaa |18|
English: O devotees, praise the Lord with your palms pressed together; the Lord saves His humble devotees. ||18||

[Ang 90 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਪਣੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਖਾ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: aapane preetam mil rahaa antar rakhaa ur dhaar |
English: Oh, if only I could meet my Beloved, and keep Him enshrined deep within my heart!

Gurbani: ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: saalaahee so prabh sadaa sadaa gur kai het piaar |
English: I praise that God forever and ever, through love and affection for the Guru.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਸਾਈ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak jis nadar kare tis mel le saaee suhaagan naar |1|
English: O Nanak, that one upon whom He bestows His Glance of Grace is united with Him; such a person is the true soul-bride of the Lord. ||1||

[Ang 90 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur sevaa te har paaeeai jaa kau nadar karee |
English: Serving the Guru, the Lord is obtained, when He bestows His Glance of Grace.

Gurbani: ਮਾਣਸ ਤੇ ਦੇਵਤੇ ਭਏ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: maanas te devate bhe dhiaaeaa naam hare |
English: They are transformed from humans into angels, meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: haumai maar milaaeian gur kai sabad tare |
English: They conquer their egotism and merge with the Lord; they are saved through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਅਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਣੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak sehaj samaaeian har aapanee kripaa kare |2|
English: O Nanak, they merge imperceptibly into the Lord, who has bestowed His Favor upon them. ||2||

[Ang 90 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਣੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵੇਖਾਲੀਅਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: har aapanee bhagat karaae vaddiaaee vekhaaleean |
English: The Lord Himself inspires us to worship Him; He reveals His Glorious Greatness.

Gurbani: ਆਪਣੀ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵ ਘਾਲੀਅਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: aapanee aap kare parateet aape sev ghaaleean |
English: He Himself inspires us to place our faith in Him. Thus He performs His Own Service.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਘਰੀ ਬਹਾਲਿਅਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: har bhagataa no dee anand thir gharee bahaalian |
English: The Lord bestows bliss upon His devotees, and gives them a seat in the eternal home.

Gurbani: ਪਾਪੀਆ ਨੋ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਥਿਰੁ ਰਹਣਿ ਚੁਣਿ ਨਰਕ ਘੋਰਿ ਚਾਲਿਅਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: paapeea no na deee thir rehan chun narak ghor chaalian |
English: He does not give the sinners any stability or place of rest; He consigns them to the depths of hell.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਅੰਗੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿਅਨੁ ॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: har bhagataa no dee piaar kar ang nisataarian |19|
English: The Lord blesses His devotees with His Love; He sides with them and saves them. ||19||

[Ang 91 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕੁਬੁਧਿ ਡੂਮਣੀ ਕੁਦਇਆ ਕਸਾਇਣਿ ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਘਟ ਚੂਹੜੀ ਮੁਠੀ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਚੰਡਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: kubudh ddoomanee kudeaa kasaaein par nindaa ghatt chooharree mutthee krodh chanddaal |
English: False-mindedness is the drummer-woman; cruelty is the butcheress; slander of others in one's heart is the cleaning-woman, and deceitful anger is the outcast-woman.

Gurbani: ਕਾਰੀ ਕਢੀ ਕਿਆ ਥੀਐ ਜਾਂ ਚਾਰੇ ਬੈਠੀਆ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: kaaree kadtee kiaa theeai jaan chaare baittheea naal |
English: What good are the ceremonial lines drawn around your kitchen, when these four are seated there with you?

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਰਾਂ ਨਾਵਣੁ ਨਾਉ ਜਪੇਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: sach sanjam karanee kaaraan naavan naau japehee |
English: Make Truth your self-discipline, and make good deeds the lines you draw; make chanting the Name your cleansing bath.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਗੈ ਊਤਮ ਸੇਈ ਜਿ ਪਾਪਾਂ ਪੰਦਿ ਨ ਦੇਹੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak agai aootam seee ji paapaan pand na dehee |1|
English: O Nanak, those who do not walk in the ways of sin, shall be exalted in the world hereafter. ||1||

[Ang 91 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਹੰਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਬਗੁਲਾ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa hans kiaa bagulaa jaa kau nadar karee |
English: Which is the swan, and which is the crane? It is only by His Glance of Grace.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਕਾਗਹੁ ਹੰਸੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jo tis bhaavai naanakaa kaagahu hans karee |2|
English: Whoever is pleasing to Him, O Nanak, is transformed from a crow into a swan. ||2||

[Ang 91 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਕੀਤਾ ਲੋੜੀਐ ਕੰਮੁ ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਹਿ ਆਖੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: keetaa lorreeai kam su har peh aakheeai |
English: Whatever work you wish to accomplish-tell it to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਾਰਜੁ ਦੇਇ ਸਵਾਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਖੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: kaaraj dee savaar satigur sach saakheeai |
English: He will resolve your affairs; the True Guru gives His Guarantee of Truth.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਚਾਖੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: santaa sang nidhaan amrit chaakheeai |
English: In the Society of the Saints, you shall taste the treasure of the Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਰਾਖੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: bhai bhanjan miharavaan daas kee raakheeai |
English: The Lord is the Merciful Destroyer of fear; He preserves and protects His slaves.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਅਲਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਾਖੀਐ ॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: naanak har gun gaae alakh prabh laakheeai |20|
English: O Nanak, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and see the Unseen Lord God. ||20||

[Ang 91 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇਇ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jeeo pindd sabh tis kaa sabhasai dee adhaar |
English: Body and soul, all belong to Him. He gives His Support to all.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh seveeai sadaa sadaa daataar |
English: O Nanak, become Gurmukh and serve Him, who is forever and ever the Giver.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਜਿਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: hau balihaaree tin kau jin dhiaaeaa har nirankaar |
English: I am a sacrifice to those who meditate on the Formless Lord.

Gurbani: ਓਨਾ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਸਦ ਉਜਲੇ ਓਨਾ ਨੋ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਕਰੇ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: onaa ke mukh sad ujale onaa no sabh jagat kare namasakaar |1|
English: Their faces are forever radiant, and the whole world bows in reverence to them. ||1||

[Ang 91 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਉਲਟੀ ਭਈ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਖਰਚਿਉ ਖਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur miliai ulattee bhee nav nidh kharachiau khaau |
English: Meeting the True Guru, I am totally transformed; I have obtained the nine treasures to use and consume.

Gurbani: ਅਠਾਰਹ ਸਿਧੀ ਪਿਛੈ ਲਗੀਆ ਫਿਰਨਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਿਜ ਥਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: atthaarah sidhee pichhai lageea firan nij ghar vasai nij thaae |
English: The Siddhis-the eighteen supernatural spiritual powers-follow in my footsteps; I dwell in my own home, within my own self.

Gurbani: ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨੀ ਸਦ ਵਜਦੇ ਉਨਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: anahad dhunee sad vajade unaman har liv laae |
English: The Unstruck Melody constantly vibrates within; my mind is exalted and uplifted-I am lovingly absorbed in the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਜਿਨ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak har bhagat tinaa kai man vasai jin masatak likhiaa dhur paae |2|
English: O Nanak, devotion to the Lord abides within the minds of those who have such pre-ordained destiny written on their foreheads. ||2||

[Ang 91 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਢਾਢੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau dtaadtee har prabh khasam kaa har kai dar aaeaa |
English: I am a minstrel of the Lord God, my Lord and Master; I have come to the Lord's Door.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਪੂਕਾਰ ਢਾਢੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: har andar sunee pookaar dtaadtee mukh laaeaa |
English: The Lord has heard my sad cries from within; He has called me, His minstrel, into His Presence.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪੁਛਿਆ ਢਾਢੀ ਸਦਿ ਕੈ ਕਿਤੁ ਅਰਥਿ ਤੂੰ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: har puchhiaa dtaadtee sad kai kit arath toon aaeaa |
English: The Lord called His minstrel in, and asked, "Why have you come here?"

Gurbani: ਨਿਤ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: nit devahu daan deaal prabh har naam dhiaaeaa |
English: "O Merciful God, please grant me the gift of continual meditation on the Lord's Name."

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦਾਤੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪੈਨਾਇਆ ॥੨੧॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ
Transliteration: har daatai har naam japaaeaa naanak painaaeaa |21|1| sudh
English: And so the Lord, the Great Giver, inspired Nanak to chant the Lord's Name, and blessed him with robes of honor. ||21||1||Sudh||

[Ang 91 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕਾ ॥ ਏਕੁ ਸੁਆਨੁ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਗਾਵਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag kabeer jeeo kaa | ek suaan kai ghar gaavanaa |
English: Siree Raag, Kabeer Jee: To Be Sung To The Tune Of "Ayk Su-Aan" :

Gurbani: ਜਨਨੀ ਜਾਨਤ ਸੁਤੁ ਬਡਾ ਹੋਤੁ ਹੈ ਇਤਨਾ ਕੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਜਿ ਦਿਨ ਦਿਨ ਅਵਧ ਘਟਤੁ ਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: jananee jaanat sut baddaa hot hai itanaa ku na jaanai ji din din avadh ghattat hai |
English: The mother thinks that her son is growing up; she does not understand that, day by day, his life is diminishing.

Gurbani: ਮੋਰ ਮੋਰ ਕਰਿ ਅਧਿਕ ਲਾਡੁ ਧਰਿ ਪੇਖਤ ਹੀ ਜਮਰਾਉ ਹਸੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mor mor kar adhik laadd dhar pekhat hee jamaraau hasai |1|
English: Calling him, "Mine, mine", she fondles him lovingly, while the Messenger of Death looks on and laughs. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਤੈਂ ਜਗੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa tain jag bharam laaeaa |
English: You have misled the world so deeply in doubt.

Gurbani: ਕੈਸੇ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਬ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kaise boojhai jab mohiaa hai maaeaa |1| rahaau |
English: How can people understand You, when they are entranced by Maya? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਛੋਡਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਸ ਇਤੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਿਹਚਉ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: kehat kabeer chhodd bikhiaa ras it sangat nihchau maranaa |
English: Says Kabeer, give up the pleasures of corruption, or else you will surely die of them.

Gurbani: ਰਮਈਆ ਜਪਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਅਨਤ ਜੀਵਣ ਬਾਣੀ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਣਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: rameea japahu praanee anat jeevan baanee in bidh bhav saagar taranaa |2|
English: Meditate on the Lord, O mortal being, through the Word of His Bani; you shall be blessed with eternal life. In this way, shall you cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਾਂ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਭਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaan tis bhaavai taa laagai bhaau |
English: As it pleases Him, people embrace love for the Lord,

Gurbani: ਭਰਮੁ ਭੁਲਾਵਾ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bharam bhulaavaa vichahu jaae |
English: and doubt and delusion are dispelled from within.

Gurbani: ਉਪਜੈ ਸਹਜੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਮਤਿ ਜਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: aupajai sehaj giaan mat jaagai |
English: Intuitive peace and poise well up within, and the intellect is awakened to spiritual wisdom.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad antar liv laagai |3|
English: By Guru's Grace, the inner being is touched by the Lord's Love. ||3||

Gurbani: ਇਤੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: eit sangat naahee maranaa |
English: In this association, there is no death.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿ ਤਾ ਖਸਮੈ ਮਿਲਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: hukam pachhaan taa khasamai milanaa |1| rahaau doojaa |
English: Recognizing the Hukam of His Command, you shall meet with your Lord and Master. ||1||Second Pause||

[Ang 92 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Bhagat Trilochan Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨ ਕਾ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag trilochan kaa |
English: Siree Raag, Trilochan:

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਆਗਲੜਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਜਰਾ ਮਰਣੁ ਭਉ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohu man aagalarraa praanee jaraa maran bhau visar geaa |
English: The mind is totally attached to Maya; the mortal has forgotten his fear of old age and death.

Gurbani: ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਬਿਗਸਹਿ ਕਮਲਾ ਜਿਉ ਪਰ ਘਰਿ ਜੋਹਹਿ ਕਪਟ ਨਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kuttanb dekh bigaseh kamalaa jiau par ghar joheh kapatt naraa |1|
English: Gazing upon his family, he blossoms forth like the lotus flower; the deceitful person watches and covets the homes of others. ||1||

Gurbani: ਦੂੜਾ ਆਇਓਹਿ ਜਮਹਿ ਤਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: doorraa aaeohi jameh tanaa |
English: When the powerful Messenger of Death comes,

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਆਗਲੜੈ ਮੈ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: tin aagalarrai mai rehan na jaae |
English: No one can stand against his awesome power.

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਕੋਈ ਸਾਜਣੁ ਆਇ ਕਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: koee koee saajan aae kahai |
English: Rare, very rare, is that friend who comes and says,

Gurbani: ਮਿਲੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਬੀਠੁਲਾ ਲੈ ਬਾਹੜੀ ਵਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: mil mere beetthulaa lai baaharree valaae |
English: "O my Beloved, take me into Your Embrace!

Gurbani: ਮਿਲੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਮਈਆ ਮੈ ਲੇਹਿ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mil mere rameea mai lehi chhaddaae |1| rahaau |
English: O my Lord, please save me!" ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਭੋਗ ਰਾਜ ਬਿਸਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਪੈ ਅਮਰੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: anik anik bhog raaj bisare praanee sansaar saagar pai amar bheaa |
English: Indulging in all sorts of princely pleasures, O mortal, you have forgotten God; you have fallen into the world-ocean, and you think that you have become immortal.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੂਠਾ ਚੇਤਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਓ ਆਲਸੀਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mootthaa chetas naahee janam gavaaeo aalaseea |2|
English: Cheated and plundered by Maya, you do not think of God, and you waste your life in laziness. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬਿਖਮ ਘੋਰ ਪੰਥਿ ਚਾਲਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਤਹ ਨ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸੰ ॥
Transliteration: bikham ghor panth chaalanaa praanee rav sas teh na pravesan |
English: The path you must walk is treacherous and terrifying, O mortal; neither the sun nor the moon shine there.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਤਬ ਬਿਸਰਿ ਗਇਆ ਜਾਂ ਤਜੀਅਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੰ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohu tab bisar geaa jaan tajeeale sansaaran |3|
English: Your emotional attachment to Maya will be forgotten, when you have to leave this world. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਜੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਭਇਆ ਹੈ ਪੇਖੀਅਲੇ ਧਰਮਰਾਓ ॥
Transliteration: aaj merai man pragatt bheaa hai pekheeale dharamaraao |
English: Today, it became clear to my mind that the Righteous Judge of Dharma is watching us.

Gurbani: ਤਹ ਕਰ ਦਲ ਕਰਨਿ ਮਹਾਬਲੀ ਤਿਨ ਆਗਲੜੈ ਮੈ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: teh kar dal karan mahaabalee tin aagalarrai mai rehan na jaae |4|
English: His messengers, with their awesome power, crush people between their hands; I cannot stand against them. ||4||

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਮੂੰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਰਤੁ ਹੈ ਤਾ ਵਣਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਣਿ ਰਤੜਾ ਨਾਰਾਇਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: je ko moon upades karat hai taa van trin ratarraa naaraaeinaa |
English: If someone is going to teach me something, let it be that the Lord is pervading the forests and fields.

Gurbani: ਐ ਜੀ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਬਦਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨੁ ਰਾਮਈਆ ॥੫॥੨॥
Transliteration: ai jee toon aape sabh kichh jaanadaa badat trilochan raameea |5|2|
English: O Dear Lord, You Yourself know everything; so prays Trilochan, Lord. ||5||2||

[Ang 92 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕਾ ॥
Transliteration: sreeraag bhagat kabeer jeeo kaa |
English: Siree Raag, Devotee Kabeer Jee:

Gurbani: ਅਚਰਜ ਏਕੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਪੰਡੀਆ ਅਬ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: acharaj ek sunahu re panddeea ab kichh kehan na jaaee |
English: Listen, O religious scholar: the One Lord alone is Wondrous; no one can describe Him.

Gurbani: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਗਣ ਗੰਧ੍ਰਬ ਜਿਨਿ ਮੋਹੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਮੇਖੁਲੀ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sur nar gan gandhrab jin mohe tribhavan mekhulee laaee |1|
English: He fascinates the angels, the celestial singers and the heavenly musicians; he has strung the three worlds upon His Thread. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਅਨਹਦ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਬਾਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: raajaa raam anahad kinguree baajai |
English: The Unstruck Melody of the Sovereign Lord's Harp vibrates;

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦਿਸਟਿ ਨਾਦ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kee disatt naad liv laagai |1| rahaau |
English: by His Glance of Grace, we are lovingly attuned to the Sound-current of the Naad. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਭਾਠੀ ਗਗਨੁ ਸਿੰਙਿਆ ਅਰੁ ਚੁੰਙਿਆ ਕਨਕ ਕਲਸ ਇਕੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bhaatthee gagan singiaa ar chungiaa kanak kalas ik paaeaa |
English: The Tenth Gate of my crown chakra is the distilling fire, and the channels of the Ida and Pingala are the funnels, to pour in and empty out the golden vat.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਧਾਰ ਚੁਐ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰਸ ਮਹਿ ਰਸਨ ਚੁਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tis meh dhaar chuai at niramal ras meh rasan chuaaeaa |2|
English: Into that vat, there trickles a gentle stream of the most sublime and pure essence of all distilled essences. ||2||

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਜੁ ਬਾਤ ਅਨੂਪ ਬਨੀ ਹੈ ਪਵਨ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਸਾਜਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: ek ju baat anoop banee hai pavan piaalaa saajiaa |
English: Something wonderful has happened-the breath has become the cup.

Gurbani: ਤੀਨਿ ਭਵਨ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੋ ਜੋਗੀ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਵਨੁ ਹੈ ਰਾਜਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: teen bhavan meh eko jogee kahahu kavan hai raajaa |3|
English: In all the three worlds, such a Yogi is unique. What king can compare to him? ||3||

Gurbani: ਐਸੇ ਗਿਆਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਆ ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮ ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: aise giaan pragattiaa purakhotam kahu kabeer rang raataa |
English: This spiritual wisdom of God, the Supreme Soul, has illuminated my being. Says Kabeer, I am attuned to His Love.

Gurbani: ਅਉਰ ਦੁਨੀ ਸਭ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਨੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਨ ਮਾਤਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
Transliteration: aaur dunee sabh bharam bhulaanee man raam rasaaein maataa |4|3|
English: All the rest of the world is deluded by doubt, while my mind is intoxicated with the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||4||3||

[Ang 93 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Bhagat Beni Ji]
Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰੀਰਾਗ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਬੇਣੀ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ॥ ਪਹਰਿਆ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਗਾਵਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: sreeraag baanee bhagat benee jeeo kee | pahariaa kai ghar gaavanaa |
English: Sree Raag, The Word Of Devotee Baynee Jee: To Be Sung To The Tune Of "Pehray":

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਰੇ ਨਰ ਗਰਭ ਕੁੰਡਲ ਜਬ ਆਛਤ ਉਰਧ ਧਿਆਨ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: re nar garabh kunddal jab aachhat uradh dhiaan liv laagaa |
English: O man, when you were coiled in the cradle of the womb, upside-down, you were absorbed in meditation.

Gurbani: ਮਿਰਤਕ ਪਿੰਡਿ ਪਦ ਮਦ ਨਾ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਏਕੁ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਸੁ ਨਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: miratak pindd pad mad naa ahinis ek agiaan su naagaa |
English: You took no pride in your perishable body; night and day were all the same to you-you lived unknowing, in the silence of the void.

Gurbani: ਤੇ ਦਿਨ ਸੰਮਲੁ ਕਸਟ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖ ਅਬ ਚਿਤੁ ਅਧਿਕ ਪਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: te din samal kasatt mahaa dukh ab chit adhik pasaariaa |
English: Remember the terrible pain and suffering of those days, now that you have spread out the net of your consciousness far and wide.

Gurbani: ਗਰਭ ਛੋਡਿ ਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਮੰਡਲ ਆਇਆ ਤਉ ਨਰਹਰਿ ਮਨਹੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: garabh chhodd mrit manddal aaeaa tau narahar manahu bisaariaa |1|
English: Leaving the womb, you entered this mortal world; you have forgotten the Lord from your mind. ||1||

Gurbani: ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਹਿਗਾ ਮੂੜਿਆ ਤੂੰ ਕਵਨ ਕੁਮਤਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: fir pachhutaavahigaa moorriaa toon kavan kumat bhram laagaa |
English: Later, you will regret and repent-you fool! Why are you engrossed in evil-mindedness and skepticism?

Gurbani: ਚੇਤਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਜਾਹਿਗਾ ਜਨੁ ਬਿਚਰੈ ਅਨਰਾਧਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: chet raam naahee jam pur jaahigaa jan bicharai anaraadhaa |1| rahaau |
English: Think of the Lord, or else you shall be led to the City of Death. Why are you wandering around, out of control? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਾਲ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਚਿੰਦ ਰਸ ਲਾਗਾ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: baal binod chind ras laagaa khin khin mohi biaapai |
English: You play like a child, craving sweets; moment by moment, you become more entangled in emotional attachment.

Gurbani: ਰਸੁ ਮਿਸੁ ਮੇਧੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਚਾਖੀ ਤਉ ਪੰਚ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: ras mis medh amrit bikh chaakhee tau panch pragatt santaapai |
English: Tasting good and bad, you eat nectar and then poison, and then the five passions appear and torture you.

Gurbani: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਮਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jap tap sanjam chhodd sukrit mat raam naam na araadhiaa |
English: Abandoning meditation, penance and self-restraint, and the wisdom of good actions, you do not worship and adore the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਉਛਲਿਆ ਕਾਮੁ ਕਾਲ ਮਤਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਤਉ ਆਨਿ ਸਕਤਿ ਗਲਿ ਬਾਂਧਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: auchhaliaa kaam kaal mat laagee tau aan sakat gal baandhiaa |2|
English: You are overflowing with sexual desire, and your intellect is stained with darkness; you are held in the grip of Shakti's power. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤਰੁਣ ਤੇਜੁ ਪਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਅ ਮੁਖੁ ਜੋਹਹਿ ਸਰੁ ਅਪਸਰੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: tarun tej par tria mukh joheh sar apasar na pachhaaniaa |
English: In the heat of youthful passion, you look with desire upon the faces of other men's wives; you do not distinguish between good and evil.

Gurbani: ਉਨਮਤ ਕਾਮਿ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਭੂਲੈ ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: aunamat kaam mahaa bikh bhoolai paap pun na pachhaaniaa |
English: Drunk with sexual desire and other great sins, you go astray, and do not distinguish between vice and virtue.

Gurbani: ਸੁਤ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਗਰਬਿਆ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਤੇ ਖੋਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sut sanpat dekh ihu man garabiaa raam ridai te khoeaa |
English: Gazing upon your children and your property, your mind is proud and arrogant; you cast out the Lord from your heart.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰ ਮਰਤ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਤੋਲੇ ਤਉ ਭਗ ਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਵਿਗੋਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: avar marat maaeaa man tole tau bhag mukh janam vigoeaa |3|
English: When others die, you measure your own wealth in your mind; you waste your life in the pleasures of the mouth and sexual organs. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪੁੰਡਰ ਕੇਸ ਕੁਸਮ ਤੇ ਧਉਲੇ ਸਪਤ ਪਾਤਾਲ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: punddar kes kusam te dhaule sapat paataal kee baanee |
English: Your hair is whiter than the jasmine flower, and your voice has grown feeble, as if it comes from the seventh underworld.

Gurbani: ਲੋਚਨ ਸ੍ਰਮਹਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਲ ਨਾਠੀ ਤਾ ਕਾਮੁ ਪਵਸਿ ਮਾਧਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: lochan srameh budh bal naatthee taa kaam pavas maadhaanee |
English: Your eyes water, and your intellect and strength have left you; but still, your sexual desire churns and drives you on.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਬਿਖੈ ਭਈ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਵਸਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਕਮਲੁ ਕੁਮਲਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: taa te bikhai bhee mat paavas kaaeaa kamal kumalaanaa |
English: And so, your intellect has dried up through corruption, and the lotus flower of your body has wilted and withered.

Gurbani: ਅਵਗਤਿ ਬਾਣਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਮੰਡਲਿ ਤਉ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਣਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: avagat baan chhodd mrit manddal tau paachhai pachhutaanaa |4|
English: You have forsaken the Bani, the Word of the Immortal Lord, in this mortal world; in the end, you shall regret and repent. ||4||

Gurbani: ਨਿਕੁਟੀ ਦੇਹ ਦੇਖਿ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਮਾਨ ਕਰਤ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
Transliteration: nikuttee deh dekh dhun upajai maan karat nahee boojhai |
English: Gazing upon the tiny bodies of your children, love has welled up within your heart; you are proud of them, but you do not understand.

Gurbani: ਲਾਲਚੁ ਕਰੈ ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦ ਕਾਰਨ ਲੋਚਨ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
Transliteration: laalach karai jeevan pad kaaran lochan kachhoo na soojhai |
English: You long for the dignity of a long life, but your eyes can no longer see anything.

Gurbani: ਥਾਕਾ ਤੇਜੁ ਉਡਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਪੰਖੀ ਘਰਿ ਆਂਗਨਿ ਨ ਸੁਖਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: thaakaa tej uddiaa man pankhee ghar aangan na sukhaaee |
English: Your light has gone out, and the bird of your mind has flown away; you are no longer welcome in your own home and courtyard.

Gurbani: ਬੇਣੀ ਕਹੈ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਭਗਤਹੁ ਮਰਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਿਨਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: benee kahai sunahu re bhagatahu maran mukat kin paaee |5|
English: Says Baynee, listen, O devotee: who has ever attained liberation after such a death? ||5||

[Ang 93 | Raag: Siree Raag | Author: Bhagat Ravidas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: sireeraag |
English: Sree Raag:

Gurbani: ਤੋਹੀ ਮੋਹੀ ਮੋਹੀ ਤੋਹੀ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਕੈਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: tohee mohee mohee tohee antar kaisaa |
English: You are me, and I am You-what is the difference between us?

Gurbani: ਕਨਕ ਕਟਿਕ ਜਲ ਤਰੰਗ ਜੈਸਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kanak kattik jal tarang jaisaa |1|
English: We are like gold and the bracelet, or water and the waves. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਪੈ ਹਮ ਨ ਪਾਪ ਕਰੰਤਾ ਅਹੇ ਅਨੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: jau pai ham na paap karantaa ahe anantaa |
English: If I did not commit any sins, O Infinite Lord,

Gurbani: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਹੁੰਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: patit paavan naam kaise huntaa |1| rahaau |
English: how would You have acquired the name, 'Redeemer of sinners'? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮੑ ਜੁ ਨਾਇਕ ਆਛਹੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: tuma ju naaeik aachhahu antarajaamee |
English: You are my Master, the Inner-knower, Searcher of hearts.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਨੀਜੈ ਜਨ ਤੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: prabh te jan jaaneejai jan te suaamee |2|
English: The servant is known by his God, and the Lord and Master is known by His servant. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਰੀਰੁ ਆਰਾਧੈ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਦੇਹੂ ॥
Transliteration: sareer aaraadhai mo kau beechaar dehoo |
English: Grant me the wisdom to worship and adore You with my body.

Gurbani: ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਸਮ ਦਲ ਸਮਝਾਵੈ ਕੋਊ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ravidaas sam dal samajhaavai koaoo |3|
English: O Ravi Daas, one who understands that the Lord is equally in all, is very rare. ||3||

[Ang 94 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਝ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: raag maajh chaupade ghar 1 mahalaa 4 |
English: Raag Maajh, Chau-Padhay, First House, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirbhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibhan gur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. The Name Is Truth. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying, Beyond Birth, Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam mai har man bhaaeaa |
English: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is pleasing to my mind.

Gurbani: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: vaddabhaagee har naam dhiaaeaa |
English: By great good fortune, I meditate on the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਚਲੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur poorai har naam sidh paaee ko viralaa guramat chalai jeeo |1|
English: The Perfect Guru has attained spiritual perfection in the Name of the Lord. How rare are those who follow the Guru's Teachings. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਖਰਚੁ ਲਇਆ ਬੰਨਿ ਪਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: mai har har kharach leaa ban palai |
English: I have loaded my pack with the provisions of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਸਖਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਚਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: meraa praan sakhaaee sadaa naal chalai |
English: The Companion of my breath of life shall always be with me.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur poorai har naam dirraaeaa har nihachal har dhan palai jeeo |2|
English: The Perfect Guru has implanted the Lord's Name within me. I have the Imperishable Treasure of the Lord in my lap. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: har har sajan meraa preetam raaeaa |
English: The Lord, Har, Har, is my Best Friend; He is my Beloved Lord King.

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਆਣਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਜੀਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: koee aan milaavai mere praan jeevaaeaa |
English: If only someone would come and introduce me to Him, the Rejuvenator of my breath of life.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਾ ਮੈ ਨੀਰੁ ਵਹੇ ਵਹਿ ਚਲੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: hau reh na sakaa bin dekhe preetamaa mai neer vahe veh chalai jeeo |3|
English: I cannot survive without seeing my Beloved. My eyes are welling up with tears. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਬਾਲ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur mitru meraa baal sakhaaee |
English: My Friend, the True Guru, has been my Best Friend since I was very young.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: hau reh na sakaa bin dekhe meree maaee |
English: I cannot survive without seeing Him, O my mother!

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: har jeeo kripaa karahu gur melahu jan naanak har dhan palai jeeo |4|1|
English: O Dear Lord, please show Mercy to me, that I may meet the Guru. Servant Nanak gathers the Wealth of the Lord's Name in his lap. ||4||1||

[Ang 94 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 4 |
English: Maajh, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: madhusoodan mere man tan praanaa |
English: The Lord is my mind, body and breath of life.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: hau har bin doojaa avar na jaanaa |
English: I do not know any other than the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਸਜਣੁ ਸੰਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਦਸੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: koee sajan sant milai vaddabhaagee mai har prabh piaaraa dasai jeeo |1|
English: If only I could have the good fortune to meet some friendly Saint; he might show me the Way to my Beloved Lord God. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਖੋਜੀ ਭਾਲਿ ਭਾਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: hau man tan khojee bhaal bhaalaaee |
English: I have searched my mind and body, through and through.

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kiau piaaraa preetam milai meree maaee |
English: How can I meet my Darling Beloved, O my mother?

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਖੋਜੁ ਦਸਾਈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਵਸੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mil satasangat khoj dasaaee vich sangat har prabh vasai jeeo |2|
English: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I ask about the Path to God. In that Congregation, the Lord God abides. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: meraa piaaraa preetam satigur rakhavaalaa |
English: My Darling Beloved True Guru is my Protector.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਦੀਨ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: ham baarik deen karahu pratipaalaa |
English: I am a helpless child-please cherish me.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰ ਜਲ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: meraa maat pitaa gur satigur pooraa gur jal mil kamal vigasai jeeo |3|
English: The Guru, the Perfect True Guru, is my Mother and Father. Obtaining the Water of the Guru, the lotus of my heart blossoms forth. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਦੇਖੇ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: mai bin gur dekhe need na aavai |
English: Without seeing my Guru, sleep does not come.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਤਨਿ ਵੇਦਨ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਲਗਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: mere man tan vedan gur birahu lagaavai |
English: My mind and body are afflicted with the pain of separation from the Guru.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹਸੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: har har deaa karahu gur melahu jan naanak gur mil rahasai jeeo |4|2|
English: O Lord, Har, Har, show mercy to me, that I may meet my Guru. Meeting the Guru, servant Nanak blossoms forth. ||4||2||

[Ang 95 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 4 |
English: Maajh, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਪੜੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗੁਣੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: har gun parreeai har gun guneeai |
English: Read of the Lord's Glories and reflect upon the Lord's Glories.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕਥਾ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਣੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam kathaa nit suneeai |
English: Listen continually to the Sermon of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਜਗੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mil satasangat har gun gaae jag bhaujal dutar tareeai jeeo |1|
English: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, you shall cross over the treacherous and terrifying world-ocean. ||1||

Gurbani: ਆਉ ਸਖੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੁ ਕਰੇਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: aau sakhee har mel karehaa |
English: Come, friends, let us meet our Lord.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕਾ ਮੈ ਦੇਇ ਸਨੇਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: mere preetam kaa mai dee sanehaa |
English: Bring me a message from my Beloved.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਖਾ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਭਾਈ ਮੈ ਦਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਰਹਰੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: meraa mitru sakhaa so preetam bhaaee mai dase har narahareeai jeeo |2|
English: He alone is a friend, companion, beloved and brother of mine, who shows me the way to the Lord, the Lord of all. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੀ ਬੇਦਨ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: meree bedan har gur pooraa jaanai |
English: My illness is known only to the Lord and the Perfect Guru.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਵਖਾਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: hau reh na sakaa bin naam vakhaane |
English: I cannot continue living without chanting the Naam.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਉਧਰੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: mai aaukhadh mantru deejai gur poore mai har har naam udhareeai jeeo |3|
English: So give me the medicine, the Mantra of the Perfect Guru. Through the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I am saved. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਦੀਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ham chaatrik deen satigur saranaaee |
English: I am just a poor song-bird, in the Sanctuary of the True Guru,

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੂੰਦ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam boond mukh paaee |
English: who has placed the Drop of Water, the Lord's Name, Har, Har, in my mouth.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਲਨਿਧਿ ਹਮ ਜਲ ਕੇ ਮੀਨੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਰੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩॥
Transliteration: har jalanidh ham jal ke meene jan naanak jal bin mareeai jeeo |4|3|
English: The Lord is the Treasure of Water; I am just a fish in that water. Without this Water, servant Nanak would die. ||4||3||

[Ang 95 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 4 |
English: Maajh, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har jan sant milahu mere bhaaee |
English: O servants of the Lord, O Saints, O my Siblings of Destiny, let us join together!

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਸਹੁ ਮੈ ਭੁਖ ਲਗਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: meraa har prabh dasahu mai bhukh lagaaee |
English: Show me the way to my Lord God-I am so hungry for Him!

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੀ ਸਰਧਾ ਪੂਰਿ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਦਾਤੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: meree saradhaa poor jagajeevan daate mil har darasan man bheejai jeeo |1|
English: Please reward my faith, O Life of the World, O Great Giver. Obtaining the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, my mind is fulfilled. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਬੋਲੀ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: mil satasang bolee har baanee |
English: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I chant the Bani of the Lord's Word.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: har har kathaa merai man bhaanee |
English: The Sermon of the Lord, Har, Har, is pleasing to my mind.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har har amrit har man bhaavai mil satigur amrit peejai jeeo |2|
English: The Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, is so sweet to my mind. Meeting the True Guru, I drink in this Ambrosial Nectar. ||2||

Gurbani: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: vaddabhaagee har sangat paaveh |
English: By great good fortune, the Lord's Congregation is found,

Gurbani: ਭਾਗਹੀਨ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: bhaagaheen bhram chottaa khaaveh |
English: while the unfortunate ones wander around in doubt, enduring painful beatings.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਸਤਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਲਭੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੀਜੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bin bhaagaa satasang na labhai bin sangat mail bhareejai jeeo |3|
English: Without good fortune, the Sat Sangat is not found; without this Sangat, people are stained with filth and pollution. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਆਇ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: mai aae milahu jagajeevan piaare |
English: Come and meet me, O Life of the World, my Beloved.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam deaa man dhaare |
English: Please bless me with Your Mercy, and enshrine Your Name, Har, Har, within my mind.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੪॥
Transliteration: guramat naam meetthaa man bhaaeaa jan naanak naam man bheejai jeeo |4|4|
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Sweet Name has become pleasing to my mind. Servant Nanak's mind is drenched and delighted with the Naam. ||4||4||

[Ang 95 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 4 |
English: Maajh, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: har gur giaan har ras har paaeaa |
English: Through the Guru, I have obtained the Lord's spiritual wisdom. I have obtained the Sublime Essence of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: man har rang raataa har ras peeaeaa |
English: My mind is imbued with the Love of the Lord; I drink in the Sublime Essence of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲੀ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਟੁਲਿ ਟੁਲਿ ਪਉਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har har naam mukh har har bolee man har ras ttul ttul paudaa jeeo |1|
English: With my mouth, I chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; my mind is filled to overflowing with the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਮੈ ਗਲਿ ਮੇਲਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: aavahu sant mai gal melaaeeai |
English: Come, O Saints, and lead me to my Lord's Embrace.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕੀ ਮੈ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: mere preetam kee mai kathaa sunaaeeai |
English: Recite to me the Sermon of my Beloved.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਵਾ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਚਉਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har ke sant milahu man devaa jo gurabaanee mukh chaudaa jeeo |2|
English: I dedicate my mind to those Saints of the Lord, who chant the Word of the Guru's Bani with their mouths. ||2||

Gurbani: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: vaddabhaagee har sant milaaeaa |
English: By great good fortune, the Lord has led me to meet His Saint.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur poorai har ras mukh paaeaa |
English: The Perfect Guru has placed the Sublime Essence of the Lord into my mouth.

Gurbani: ਭਾਗਹੀਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਗਰਭ ਜੂਨੀ ਨਿਤਿ ਪਉਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bhaagaheen satigur nahee paaeaa manamukh garabh joonee nit paudaa jeeo |3|
English: The unfortunate ones do not find the True Guru; the self-willed manmukhs continually endure reincarnation through the womb. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲਿ ਦਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: aap deaal deaa prabh dhaaree |
English: God, the Merciful, has Himself bestowed His Mercy.

Gurbani: ਮਲੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸਭ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: mal haumai bikhiaa sabh nivaaree |
English: He has totally removed the poisonous pollution of egotism.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਟ ਪਟਣ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਾਂਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਲੈਂਦੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਉਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak hatt pattan vich kaaneaa har lainde guramukh saudaa jeeo |4|5|
English: O Nanak, in the shops of the city of the human body, the Gurmukhs buy the merchandise of the Lord's Name. ||4||5||

[Ang 95 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 4 |
English: Maajh, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: hau gun govind har naam dhiaaee |
English: I meditate on the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, and the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: mil sangat man naam vasaaee |
English: Joining the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, the Name comes to dwell in the mind.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਕੀਚੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har prabh agam agochar suaamee mil satigur har ras keechai jeeo |1|
English: The Lord God is our Lord and Master, Inaccessible and Unfathomable. Meeting the True Guru, I enjoy the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan har jan jin har prabh jaataa |
English: Blessed, blessed are the humble servants of the Lord, who know the Lord God.

Gurbani: ਜਾਇ ਪੁਛਾ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਬਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaae puchhaa jan har kee baataa |
English: I go and ask those humble servants about the Mysteries of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਪਾਵ ਮਲੋਵਾ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਧੋਵਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਚੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: paav malovaa mal mal dhovaa mil har jan har ras peechai jeeo |2|
English: I wash and massage their feet; joining with the humble servants of the Lord, I drink in the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਾਤੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: satigur daatai naam dirraaeaa |
English: The True Guru, the Giver, has implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me.

Gurbani: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: vaddabhaagee gur darasan paaeaa |
English: By great good fortune, I have obtained the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਸਚੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬੋਲੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਲੀਚੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: amrit ras sach amrit bolee gur poorai amrit leechai jeeo |3|
English: The True Essence is Ambrosial Nectar; through the Ambrosial Words of the Perfect Guru, this Amrit is obtained. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: har satasangat sat purakh milaaeeai |
English: O Lord, lead me to the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and the true beings.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: mil satasangat har naam dhiaaeeai |
English: Joining the Sat Sangat, I meditate on the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਰੀਚੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੬॥
Transliteration: naanak har kathaa sunee mukh bolee guramat har naam pareechai jeeo |4|6|
English: O Nanak, I listen and chant the Lord's Sermon; through the Guru's Teachings, I am fulfilled by the Name of the Lord. ||4||6||

[Ang 96 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 4 |
English: Maajh, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਵਹੁ ਭੈਣੇ ਤੁਸੀ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: aavahu bhaine tusee milahu piaareea |
English: Come, dear sisters-let us join together.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਦਸੇ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: jo meraa preetam dase tis kai hau vaareea |
English: I am a sacrifice to the one who tells me of my Beloved.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਲਧਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਘੁਮਾਈਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mil satasangat ladhaa har sajan hau satigur vittahu ghumaaeea jeeo |1|
English: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I have found the Lord, my Best Friend. I am a sacrifice to the True Guru. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: jeh jeh dekhaa teh teh suaamee |
English: Wherever I look, there I see my Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: too ghatt ghatt raviaa antarajaamee |
English: You are permeating each and every heart, O Lord, Inner-knower, Searcher of Hearts.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲਿ ਦਿਖਾਲਿਆ ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਸਦ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur poorai har naal dikhaaliaa hau satigur vittahu sad vaariaa jeeo |2|
English: The Perfect Guru has shown me that the Lord is always with me. I am forever a sacrifice to the True Guru. ||2||

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਪਵਣੁ ਮਾਟੀ ਸਭ ਏਕਾ ਸਭ ਏਕਾ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਾਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: eko pavan maattee sabh ekaa sabh ekaa jot sabaaeea |
English: There is only one breath; all are made of the same clay; the light within all is the same.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਇਕਾ ਜੋਤਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਭਿਨਿ ਭਿਨਿ ਨ ਰਲਈ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੀ ਰਲਾਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabh ikaa jot varatai bhin bhin na ralee kisai dee ralaaeea |
English: The One Light pervades all the many and various beings. This Light intermingles with them, but it is not diluted or obscured.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਇਕੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਵਤਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee ik nadaree aaeaa hau satigur vittahu vataaeaa jeeo |3|
English: By Guru's Grace, I have come to see the One. I am a sacrifice to the True Guru. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: jan naanak bolai amrit baanee |
English: Servant Nanak speaks the Ambrosial Bani of the Word.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾਂ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: gurasikhaan kai man piaaree bhaanee |
English: It is dear and pleasing to the minds of the GurSikhs.

Gurbani: ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੭॥
Transliteration: aupades kare gur satigur pooraa gur satigur praupakaareea jeeo |4|7|
English: The Guru, the Perfect True Guru, shares the Teachings. The Guru, the True Guru, is Generous to all. ||4||7||

Gurbani: ਸਤ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਮਹਲੇ ਚਉਥੇ ਕੇ ॥
Transliteration: sat chaupade mahale chauthe ke |
English: Seven Chau-Padhay Of The Fourth Mehl. ||

[Ang 96 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 chaupade ghar 1 |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl, Chau-Padhay, First House:

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਲੋਚੈ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨ ਤਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: meraa man lochai gur darasan taaee |
English: My mind longs for the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan.

Gurbani: ਬਿਲਪ ਕਰੇ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: bilap kare chaatrik kee niaaee |
English: It cries out like the thirsty song-bird.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: trikhaa na utarai saant na aavai bin darasan sant piaare jeeo |1|
English: My thirst is not quenched, and I can find no peace, without the Blessed Vision of the Beloved Saint. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਘੋਲੀ ਜੀਉ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੁਮਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hau gholee jeeo ghol ghumaaee gur darasan sant piaare jeeo |1| rahaau |
English: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to the Blessed Vision of the Beloved Saint Guru. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਮੁਖੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਜੀਉ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: teraa mukh suhaavaa jeeo sehaj dhun baanee |
English: Your Face is so Beautiful, and the Sound of Your Words imparts intuitive wisdom.

Gurbani: ਚਿਰੁ ਹੋਆ ਦੇਖੇ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਪਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: chir hoaa dekhe saaringapaanee |
English: It is so long since this rainbird has had even a glimpse of water.

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਦੇਸੁ ਜਹਾ ਤੂੰ ਵਸਿਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਜਣ ਮੀਤ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: dhan su des jahaa toon vasiaa mere sajan meet muraare jeeo |2|
English: Blessed is that land where You dwell, O my Friend and Intimate Divine Guru. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਘੋਲੀ ਹਉ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੁਮਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਸਜਣ ਮੀਤ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hau gholee hau ghol ghumaaee gur sajan meet muraare jeeo |1| rahaau |
English: I am a sacrifice, I am forever a sacrifice, to my Friend and Intimate Divine Guru. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਇਕ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਮਿਲਤੇ ਤਾ ਕਲਿਜੁਗੁ ਹੋਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: eik gharree na milate taa kalijug hotaa |
English: When I could not be with You for just one moment, the Dark Age of Kali Yuga dawned for me.

Gurbani: ਹੁਣਿ ਕਦਿ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: hun kad mileeai pria tudh bhagavantaa |
English: When will I meet You, O my Beloved Lord?

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਰੈਣਿ ਨ ਵਿਹਾਵੈ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: mohi rain na vihaavai need na aavai bin dekhe gur darabaare jeeo |3|
English: I cannot endure the night, and sleep does not come, without the Sight of the Beloved Guru's Court. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਘੋਲੀ ਜੀਉ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੁਮਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hau gholee jeeo ghol ghumaaee tis sache gur darabaare jeeo |1| rahaau |
English: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to that True Court of the Beloved Guru. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਭਾਗੁ ਹੋਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਸੰਤੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bhaag hoaa gur sant milaaeaa |
English: By good fortune, I have met the Saint Guru.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: prabh abinaasee ghar meh paaeaa |
English: I have found the Immortal Lord within the home of my own self.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵ ਕਰੀ ਪਲੁ ਚਸਾ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: sev karee pal chasaa na vichhurraa jan naanak daas tumaare jeeo |4|
English: I will now serve You forever, and I shall never be separated from You, even for an instant. Servant Nanak is Your slave, O Beloved Master. ||4||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਘੋਲੀ ਜੀਉ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੁਮਾਈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥੧॥੮॥
Transliteration: hau gholee jeeo ghol ghumaaee jan naanak daas tumaare jeeo | rahaau |1|8|
English: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice; servant Nanak is Your slave, Lord. ||Pause||1||8||

[Ang 97 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raag maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Raag Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਰੁਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਮਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: saa rut suhaavee jit tudh samaalee |
English: Sweet is that season when I remember You.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਕੰਮੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਜੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਘਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: so kam suhelaa jo teree ghaalee |
English: Sublime is that work which is done for You.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਰਿਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਤੂੰ ਵੁਠਾ ਸਭਨਾ ਕੇ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: so ridaa suhelaa jit ridai toon vutthaa sabhanaa ke daataaraa jeeo |1|
English: Blessed is that heart in which You dwell, O Giver of all. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਸਾਝਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਬਾਪੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: toon saajhaa saahib baap hamaaraa |
English: You are the Universal Father of all, O my Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਅਖੁਟ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: nau nidh terai akhutt bhanddaaraa |
English: Your nine treasures are an inexhaustible storehouse.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਗਤੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jis toon dehi su tripat aghaavai soee bhagat tumaaraa jeeo |2|
English: Those unto whom You give are satisfied and fulfilled; they become Your devotees, Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਆਸੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਬੈਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabh ko aasai teree baitthaa |
English: All place their hopes in You.

Gurbani: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਵੁਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt antar toonhai vutthaa |
English: You dwell deep within each and every heart.

Gurbani: ਸਭੇ ਸਾਝੀਵਾਲ ਸਦਾਇਨਿ ਤੂੰ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਦਿਸਹਿ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sabhe saajheevaal sadaaein toon kisai na diseh baaharaa jeeo |3|
English: All share in Your Grace; none are beyond You. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਇਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: toon aape guramukh mukat karaaeihi |
English: You Yourself liberate the Gurmukhs;

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਭਵਾਇਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: toon aape manamukh janam bhavaaeihi |
English: You Yourself consign the self-willed manmukhs to wander in reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਦਸਾਹਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨॥੯॥
Transliteration: naanak daas terai balihaarai sabh teraa khel dasaaharaa jeeo |4|2|9|
English: Slave Nanak is a sacrifice to You; Your Entire Play is self-evident, Lord. ||4||2||9||

[Ang 97 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਨਹਦੁ ਵਾਜੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: anahad vaajai sehaj suhelaa |
English: The Unstruck Melody resounds and resonates in peaceful ease.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਅਨੰਦ ਕਰੇ ਸਦ ਕੇਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabad anand kare sad kelaa |
English: I rejoice in the eternal bliss of the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜ ਗੁਫਾ ਮਹਿ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ਆਸਣੁ ਊਚ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sehaj gufaa meh taarree laaee aasan aooch savaariaa jeeo |1|
English: In the cave of intuitive wisdom I sit, absorbed in the silent trance of the Primal Void. I have obtained my seat in the heavens. ||1||

Gurbani: ਫਿਰਿ ਘਿਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: fir ghir apune grih meh aaeaa |
English: After wandering through many other homes and houses, I have returned to my own home,

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਲੋੜੀਦਾ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jo lorreedaa soee paaeaa |
English: and I have found what I was longing for.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਇ ਰਹਿਆ ਹੈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਅਨਭਉ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਦਿਖਾਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tripat aghaae rahiaa hai santahu gur anbhau purakh dikhaariaa jeeo |2|
English: I am satisfied and fulfilled; O Saints, the Guru has shown me the Fearless Lord God. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਰਾਜਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਲੋਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape raajan aape logaa |
English: He Himself is the King, and He Himself is the people.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ਆਪੇ ਭੋਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: aap nirabaanee aape bhogaa |
English: He Himself is in Nirvaanaa, and He Himself indulges in pleasures.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਤਖਤਿ ਬਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਆਈ ਸਭ ਚੂਕੀ ਕੂਕ ਪੁਕਾਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aape takhat bahai sach niaaee sabh chookee kook pukaariaa jeeo |3|
English: He Himself sits on the throne of true justice, answering the cries and prayers of all. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੇਹਾ ਡਿਠਾ ਮੈ ਤੇਹੋ ਕਹਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jehaa dditthaa mai teho kahiaa |
English: As I have seen Him, so have I described Him.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਰਸੁ ਆਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਭੇਦੁ ਲਹਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: tis ras aaeaa jin bhed lahiaa |
English: This Sublime Essence comes only to one who knows the Mystery of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਕੁ ਪਸਾਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: jotee jot milee sukh paaeaa jan naanak ik pasaariaa jeeo |4|3|10|
English: His light merges into the Light, and he finds peace. O servant Nanak, this is all the Extension of the One. ||4||3||10||

[Ang 97 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਪਿਰਿ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jit ghar pir sohaag banaaeaa |
English: That house, in which the soul-bride has married her Husband Lord

Gurbani: ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਸਖੀਏ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tit ghar sakhee mangal gaaeaa |
English: in that house, O my companions, sing the songs of rejoicing.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਤਿਤੈ ਘਰਿ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਜੋ ਧਨ ਕੰਤਿ ਸਿਗਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: anad binod titai ghar soheh jo dhan kant sigaaree jeeo |1|
English: Joy and celebrations decorate that house, in which the Husband Lord has adorned His soul-bride. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਸਾ ਵਡਭਾਗਣਿ ॥
Transliteration: saa gunavantee saa vaddabhaagan |
English: She is virtuous, and she is very fortunate;

Gurbani: ਪੁਤ੍ਰਵੰਤੀ ਸੀਲਵੰਤਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ॥
Transliteration: putravantee seelavant sohaagan |
English: she is blessed with sons and tender-hearted. The happy soul-bride is loved by her Husband.

Gurbani: ਰੂਪਵੰਤਿ ਸਾ ਸੁਘੜਿ ਬਿਚਖਣਿ ਜੋ ਧਨ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: roopavant saa sugharr bichakhan jo dhan kant piaaree jeeo |2|
English: She is beautiful, wise, and clever. That soul-bride is the beloved of her Husband Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਚਾਰਵੰਤਿ ਸਾਈ ਪਰਧਾਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: achaaravant saaee paradhaane |
English: She is well-mannered, noble and distinguished.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਬਣੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਗਿਆਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: sabh singaar bane tis giaane |
English: She is decorated and adorned with wisdom.

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਕੁਲਵੰਤੀ ਸਾ ਸਭਰਾਈ ਜੋ ਪਿਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: saa kulavantee saa sabharaaee jo pir kai rang savaaree jeeo |3|
English: She is from a most respected family; she is the queen, adorned with the Love of her Husband Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਹਿਮਾ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: mahimaa tis kee kehan na jaae |
English: Her glory cannot be described;

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਪਿਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਈ ਅੰਗਿ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jo pir mel lee ang laae |
English: she melts in the Embrace of her Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਥਿਰੁ ਸੁਹਾਗੁ ਵਰੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਸਾਧਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: thir suhaag var agam agochar jan naanak prem saadhaaree jeeo |4|4|11|
English: Her marriage is eternal; her Husband is Inaccessible and Incomprehensible. O Servant Nanak, His Love is her only Support. ||4||4||11||

[Ang 98 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਦਰਸਨ ਚਾਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: khojat khojat darasan chaahe |
English: I have searched and searched, seeking the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

Gurbani: ਭਾਤਿ ਭਾਤਿ ਬਨ ਬਨ ਅਵਗਾਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: bhaat bhaat ban ban avagaahe |
English: I travelled through all sorts of woods and forests.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਗੁਣੁ ਸਰਗੁਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਕੋਈ ਹੈ ਜੀਉ ਆਣਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: niragun saragun har har meraa koee hai jeeo aan milaavai jeeo |1|
English: My Lord, Har, Har, is both absolute and related, unmanifest and manifest; is there anyone who can come and unite me with Him? ||1||

Gurbani: ਖਟੁ ਸਾਸਤ ਬਿਚਰਤ ਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: khatt saasat bicharat mukh giaanaa |
English: People recite from memory the wisdom of the six schools of philosophy;

Gurbani: ਪੂਜਾ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਤੀਰਥ ਇਸਨਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: poojaa tilak teerath isanaanaa |
English: they perform worship services, wear ceremonial religious marks on their foreheads, and take ritual cleansing baths at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

Gurbani: ਨਿਵਲੀ ਕਰਮ ਆਸਨ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਇਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: nivalee karam aasan chauraaseeh in meh saant na aavai jeeo |2|
English: They perform the inner cleansing practice with water and adopt the eighty-four Yogic postures; but still, they find no peace in any of these. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਰਖ ਕੀਏ ਜਪ ਤਾਪਾ ॥
Transliteration: anik barakh kee jap taapaa |
English: They chant and meditate, practicing austere self-discipline for years and years;

Gurbani: ਗਵਨੁ ਕੀਆ ਧਰਤੀ ਭਰਮਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: gavan keea dharatee bharamaataa |
English: they wander on journeys all over the earth;

Gurbani: ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜੋਗੀ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: eik khin hiradai saant na aavai jogee bahurr bahurr utth dhaavai jeeo |3|
English: and yet, their hearts are not at peace, even for an instant. The Yogi rises up and goes out, over and over again. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਾਧੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa mohi saadh milaaeaa |
English: By His Mercy, I have met the Holy Saint.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: man tan seetal dheeraj paaeaa |
English: My mind and body have been cooled and soothed; I have been blessed with patience and composure.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਬਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: prabh abinaasee basiaa ghatt bheetar har mangal naanak gaavai jeeo |4|5|12|
English: The Immortal Lord God has come to dwell within my heart. Nanak sings the songs of joy to the Lord. ||4||5||12||

[Ang 98 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham aparanpar devaa |
English: The Supreme Lord God is Infinite and Divine;

Gurbani: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: agam agochar alakh abhevaa |
English: He is Inaccessible, Incomprehensible, Invisible and Inscrutable.

Gurbani: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਤੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: deen deaal gopaal gobindaa har dhiaavahu guramukh gaatee jeeo |1|
English: Merciful to the meek, Sustainer of the World, Lord of the Universe-meditating on the Lord, the Gurmukhs find salvation. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh madhusoodan nisataare |
English: The Gurmukhs are emancipated by the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੰਗੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh sangee krisan muraare |
English: The Lord Krishna becomes the Gurmukh's Companion.

Gurbani: ਦਇਆਲ ਦਮੋਦਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹੋਰਤੁ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਭਾਤੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: deaal damodar guramukh paaeeai horat kitai na bhaatee jeeo |2|
English: The Gurmukh finds the Merciful Lord. He is not found any other way. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਹਾਰੀ ਕੇਸਵ ਨਿਰਵੈਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: nirahaaree kesav niravairaa |
English: He does not need to eat; His Hair is Wondrous and Beautiful; He is free of hate.

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਾ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਜਹਿ ਪੈਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kott janaa jaa ke poojeh pairaa |
English: Millions of people worship His Feet.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਈ ਭਗਤੁ ਇਕਾਤੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: guramukh hiradai jaa kai har har soee bhagat ikaatee jeeo |3|
English: He alone is a devotee, who becomes Gurmukh, whose heart is filled with the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅਮੋਘ ਦਰਸਨ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: amogh darasan beant apaaraa |
English: Forever fruitful is the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; He is Infinite and Incomparable.

Gurbani: ਵਡ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸਦਾ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: vadd samarath sadaa daataaraa |
English: He is Awesome and All-powerful; He is forever the Great Giver.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਰੀਐ ਗਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਰਲੀ ਜਾਤੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: guramukh naam japeeai tith tareeai gat naanak viralee jaatee jeeo |4|6|13|
English: As Gurmukh, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and you shall be carried across. O Nanak, rare are those who know this state! ||4||6||13||

[Ang 98 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਹਿਆ ਕਰਣਾ ਦਿਤਾ ਲੈਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: kahiaa karanaa ditaa lainaa |
English: As You command, I obey; as You give, I receive.

Gurbani: ਗਰੀਬਾ ਅਨਾਥਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਮਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: gareebaa anaathaa teraa maanaa |
English: You are the Pride of the meek and the poor.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh toonhai toonhai mere piaare teree kudarat kau bal jaaee jeeo |1|
English: You are everything; You are my Beloved. I am a sacrifice to Your Creative Power. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਾਣੈ ਉਝੜ ਭਾਣੈ ਰਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: bhaanai ujharr bhaanai raahaa |
English: By Your Will, we wander in the wilderness; by Your Will, we find the path.

Gurbani: ਭਾਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਵਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: bhaanai har gun guramukh gaavaahaa |
English: By Your Will, we become Gurmukh and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਭਾਣੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭਵੈ ਬਹੁ ਜੂਨੀ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਰਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bhaanai bharam bhavai bahu joonee sabh kichh tisai rajaaee jeeo |2|
English: By Your Will, we wander in doubt through countless lifetimes. Everything happens by Your Will. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਸਿਆਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: naa ko moorakh naa ko siaanaa |
English: No one is foolish, and no one is clever.

Gurbani: ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: varatai sabh kichh teraa bhaanaa |
English: Your Will determines everything;

Gurbani: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਅਥਾਹਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: agam agochar beant athaahaa teree keemat kehan na jaaee jeeo |3|
English: You are Inaccessible, Incomprehensible, Infinite and Unfathomable. Your Value cannot be expressed. ||3||

Gurbani: ਖਾਕੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਦੇਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: khaak santan kee dehu piaare |
English: Please bless me with the dust of the Saints, O my Beloved.

Gurbani: ਆਇ ਪਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਦੁਆਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: aae peaa har terai duaarai |
English: I have come and fallen at Your Door, O Lord.

Gurbani: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਤ ਮਨੁ ਆਘਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲਣੁ ਸੁਭਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: darasan pekhat man aaghaavai naanak milan subhaaee jeeo |4|7|14|
English: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, my mind is fulfilled. O Nanak, with natural ease, I merge into Him. ||4||7||14||

[Ang 98 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦੁਖੁ ਤਦੇ ਜਾ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: dukh tade jaa visar jaavai |
English: They forget the Lord, and they suffer in pain.

Gurbani: ਭੁਖ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: bhukh viaapai bahu bidh dhaavai |
English: Afflicted with hunger, they run around in all directions.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: simarat naam sadaa suhelaa jis devai deen deaalaa jeeo |1|
English: Meditating in remembrance on the Naam, they are happy forever. The Lord, Merciful to the meek, bestows it upon them. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਵਡ ਸਮਰਥਾ ॥
Transliteration: satigur meraa vadd samarathaa |
English: My True Guru is absolutely All-powerful.

Gurbani: ਜੀਇ ਸਮਾਲੀ ਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਥਾ ॥
