Transliteration: jee samaalee taa sabh dukh lathaa |
English: When I dwell upon Him in my soul, all my sorrows depart.

Gurbani: ਚਿੰਤਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਈ ਹਉ ਪੀੜਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: chintaa rog gee hau peerraa aap kare pratipaalaa jeeo |2|
English: The sickness of anxiety and the disease of ego are cured; He Himself cherishes me. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬਾਰਿਕ ਵਾਂਗੀ ਹਉ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੰਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: baarik vaangee hau sabh kichh mangaa |
English: Like a child, I ask for everything.

Gurbani: ਦੇਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰੰਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: dede tott naahee prabh rangaa |
English: God is Bountiful and Beautiful; He never comes up empty.

Gurbani: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮਨਾਈ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: pairee pai pai bahut manaaee deen deaal gopaalaa jeeo |3|
English: Again and again, I fall at His Feet. He is Merciful to the meek, the Sustainer of the World. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: hau balihaaree satigur poore |
English: I am a sacrifice to the Perfect True Guru,

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jin bandhan kaatte sagale mere |
English: who has shattered all my bonds.

Gurbani: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕੀਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਸਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੮॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: hiradai naam de niramal kee naanak rang rasaalaa jeeo |4|8|15|
English: With the Naam, the Name of the Lord, in my heart, I have been purified. O Nanak, His Love has imbued me with nectar. ||4||8||15||

[Ang 99 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਲਾਲ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਰੰਗੀਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: laal gopaal deaal rangeele |
English: O my Love, Sustainer of the World, Merciful, Loving Lord,

Gurbani: ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: gahir ganbheer beant govinde |
English: Profoundly Deep, Infinite Lord of the Universe,

Gurbani: ਊਚ ਅਥਾਹ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aooch athaah beant suaamee simar simar hau jeevaan jeeo |1|
English: Highest of the High, Unfathomable, Infinite Lord and Master: continually remembering You in deep meditation, I live. ||1||

Gurbani: ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਅਮੋਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: dukh bhanjan nidhaan amole |
English: O Destroyer of pain, Priceless Treasure,

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰ ਅਥਾਹ ਅਤੋਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: nirbhau niravair athaah atole |
English: Fearless, free of hate, Unfathomable, Immeasurable,

Gurbani: ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੰਭੌ ਮਨ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਠੰਢਾ ਥੀਵਾਂ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: akaal moorat ajoonee sanbhau man simarat tthandtaa theevaan jeeo |2|
English: of Undying Form, Unborn, Self-illumined: remembering You in meditation, my mind is filled with a deep and profound peace. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sangee har rang gopaalaa |
English: The Joyous Lord, the Sustainer of the World, is my constant Companion.

Gurbani: ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: aooch neech kare pratipaalaa |
English: He cherishes the high and the low.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਇਣੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਾਂ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naam rasaaein man tripataaein guramukh amrit peevaan jeeo |3|
English: The Nectar of the Name satisfies my mind. As Gurmukh, I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: dukh sukh piaare tudh dhiaaee |
English: In suffering and in comfort, I meditate on You, O Beloved.

Gurbani: ਏਹ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: eeh sumat guroo te paaee |
English: I have obtained this sublime understanding from the Guru.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਧਰ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰੀਵਾਂ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੯॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: naanak kee dhar toonhai tthaakur har rang paar pareevaan jeeo |4|9|16|
English: You are Nanak's Support, O my Lord and Master; through Your Love, I swim across to the other side. ||4||9||16||

[Ang 99 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: dhan su velaa jit mai satigur miliaa |
English: Blessed is that time when I meet the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਸਫਲੁ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਪੇਖਤ ਤਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: safal darasan netr pekhat tariaa |
English: Gazing upon the Fruitful Vision of His Darshan, I have been saved.

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਮੂਰਤ ਚਸੇ ਪਲ ਘੜੀਆ ਧੰਨਿ ਸੁ ਓਇ ਸੰਜੋਗਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dhan moorat chase pal gharreea dhan su oe sanjogaa jeeo |1|
English: Blessed are the hours, the minutes and the seconds-blessed is that Union with Him. ||1||

Gurbani: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਤ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ ॥
Transliteration: audam karat man niramal hoaa |
English: Making the effort, my mind has become pure.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਲਤ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਸਗਲਾ ਖੋਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: har maarag chalat bhram sagalaa khoeaa |
English: Walking on the Lord's Path, my doubts have all been cast out.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਸਗਲੇ ਰੋਗਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naam nidhaan satiguroo sunaaeaa mitt ge sagale rogaa jeeo |2|
English: The True Guru has inspired me to hear the Treasure of the Naam; all my illness has been dispelled. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: antar baahar teree baanee |
English: The Word of Your Bani is inside and outside as well.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਿ ਕਥੀ ਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: tudh aap kathee tai aap vakhaanee |
English: You Yourself chant it, and You Yourself speak it.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੋ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਹੋਇਗਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur kahiaa sabh eko eko avar na koee hoeigaa jeeo |3|
English: The Guru has said that He is One-All is the One. There shall never be any other. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: amrit ras har gur te peea |
English: I drink in the Lord's Ambrosial Essence from the Guru;

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਥੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: har painan naam bhojan theea |
English: the Lord's Name has become my clothing and food.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਿ ਰੰਗ ਨਾਮਿ ਚੋਜ ਤਮਾਸੇ ਨਾਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀਨੇ ਭੋਗਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: naam rang naam choj tamaase naau naanak keene bhogaa jeeo |4|10|17|
English: The Name is my delight, the Name is my play and entertainment. O Nanak, I have made the Name my enjoyment. ||4||10||17||

[Ang 99 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਸੰਤਨ ਪਹਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਇਕ ਮਾਂਗਉ ॥
Transliteration: sagal santan peh vasat ik maangau |
English: I beg of all the Saints: please, give me the merchandise.

Gurbani: ਕਰਉ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਮਾਨੁ ਤਿਆਗਉ ॥
Transliteration: krau binantee maan tiaagau |
English: I offer my prayers-I have forsaken my pride.

Gurbani: ਵਾਰਿ ਵਾਰਿ ਜਾਈ ਲਖ ਵਰੀਆ ਦੇਹੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: vaar vaar jaaee lakh vareea dehu santan kee dhooraa jeeo |1|
English: I am a sacrifice, hundreds of thousands of times a sacrifice, and I pray: please, give me the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਦਾਤੇ ਤੁਮ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: tum daate tum purakh bidhaate |
English: You are the Giver, You are the Architect of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਸਮਰਥ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: tum samarath sadaa sukhadaate |
English: You are All-powerful, the Giver of Eternal Peace.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਕੋ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਵਰਸਾਵੈ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sabh ko tum hee te varasaavai aausar karahu hamaaraa pooraa jeeo |2|
English: You bless everyone. Please bring my life to fulfillment. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦਰਸਨਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਭਵਨ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: darasan terai bhavan puneetaa |
English: The body-temple is sanctified by the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan,

Gurbani: ਆਤਮ ਗੜੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਹੀ ਜੀਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: aatam garr bikham tinaa hee jeetaa |
English: and thus, the impregnable fort of the soul is conquered.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਦਾਤੇ ਤੁਮ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਸੂਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tum daate tum purakh bidhaate tudh jevadd avar na sooraa jeeo |3|
English: You are the Giver, You are the Architect of Destiny. There is no other warrior as great as You. ||3||

Gurbani: ਰੇਨੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: ren santan kee merai mukh laagee |
English: I applied the dust of the feet of the Saints to my face.

Gurbani: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਕੁਬੁਧਿ ਅਭਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: duramat binasee kubudh abhaagee |
English: My evil-mindedness disappeared, along with my misfortune and false-mindedness.

Gurbani: ਸਚ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਸਿ ਰਹੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਕੂਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: sach ghar bais rahe gun gaae naanak binase kooraa jeeo |4|11|18|
English: I sit in the true home of my self; I sing His Glorious Praises. O Nanak, my falsehood has vanished! ||4||11||18||

[Ang 100 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਵਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਏਵਡ ਦਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: visar naahee evadd daate |
English: I shall never forget You-You are such a Great Giver!

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਗਤਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa bhagatan sang raate |
English: Please grant Your Grace, and imbue me with the love of devotional worship.

Gurbani: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਜਿਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਏਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਰਣਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dinas rain jiau tudh dhiaaee ehu daan mohi karanaa jeeo |1|
English: If it pleases You, let me meditate on You day and night; please, grant me this gift! ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਾਟੀ ਅੰਧੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: maattee andhee surat samaaee |
English: Into this blind clay, You have infused awareness.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੀਆ ਭਲੀਆ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh deea bhaleea jaaee |
English: Everything, everywhere which You have given is good.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਚੋਜ ਤਮਾਸੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਹੋਣਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: anad binod choj tamaase tudh bhaavai so honaa jeeo |2|
English: Bliss, joyful celebrations, wondrous plays and entertainment-whatever pleases You, comes to pass. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਦਿਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਲੈਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: jis daa ditaa sabh kichh lainaa |
English: Everything we receive is a gift from Him

Gurbani: ਛਤੀਹ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਖਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: chhateeh amrit bhojan khaanaa |
English: -the thirty-six delicious foods to eat,

Gurbani: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਪਵਣਾ ਸਹਜ ਕੇਲ ਰੰਗ ਕਰਣਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sej sukhaalee seetal pavanaa sehaj kel rang karanaa jeeo |3|
English: cozy beds, cooling breezes, peaceful joy and the experience of pleasure. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਬੁਧਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: saa budh deejai jit visareh naahee |
English: Give me that state of mind, by which I may not forget You.

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਮਤਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: saa mat deejai jit tudh dhiaaee |
English: Give me that understanding, by which I may meditate on You.

Gurbani: ਸਾਸ ਸਾਸ ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਓਟ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: saas saas tere gun gaavaa ott naanak gur charanaa jeeo |4|12|19|
English: I sing Your Glorious Praises with each and every breath. Nanak takes the Support of the Guru's Feet. ||4||12||19||

[Ang 100 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਾਲਾਹਣੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਰਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sifat saalaahan teraa hukam rajaaee |
English: To praise You is to follow Your Command and Your Will.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: so giaan dhiaan jo tudh bhaaee |
English: That which pleases You is spiritual wisdom and meditation.

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਜਪੁ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਪੂਰ ਗਿਆਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: soee jap jo prabh jeeo bhaavai bhaanai poor giaanaa jeeo |1|
English: That which pleases God is chanting and meditation; to be in harmony with His Will is perfect spiritual wisdom. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੋਈ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: amrit naam teraa soee gaavai |
English: He alone sings Your Ambrosial Naam,

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jo saahib terai man bhaavai |
English: Who is pleasing to Your Mind, O my Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ ਸੰਤ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਸੰਤ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: toon santan kaa sant tumaare sant saahib man maanaa jeeo |2|
English: You belong to the Saints, and the Saints belong to You. The minds of the Saints are attuned to You, O my Lord and Master. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਕਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: toon santan kee kareh pratipaalaa |
English: You cherish and nurture the Saints.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਖੇਲਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: sant kheleh tum sang gopaalaa |
English: The Saints play with You, O Sustainer of the World.

Gurbani: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸੰਤ ਤੁਧੁ ਖਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤੂ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: apune sant tudh khare piaare too santan ke praanaa jeeo |3|
English: Your Saints are very dear to You. You are the breath of life of the Saints. ||3||

Gurbani: ਉਨ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: aun santan kai meraa man kurabaane |
English: My mind is a sacrifice to those Saints who know You,

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਤੂੰ ਜਾਤਾ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: jin toon jaataa jo tudh man bhaane |
English: and are pleasing to Your Mind.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਨਾਨਕ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: tin kai sang sadaa sukh paaeaa har ras naanak tripat aghaanaa jeeo |4|13|20|
English: In their company I have found a lasting peace. Nanak is satisfied and fulfilled with the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||4||13||20||

[Ang 100 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਜਲਨਿਧਿ ਹਮ ਮੀਨ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: toon jalanidh ham meen tumaare |
English: You are the Ocean of Water, and I am Your fish.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੂੰਦ ਹਮ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਤਿਖਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: teraa naam boond ham chaatrik tikhahaare |
English: Your Name is the drop of water, and I am a thirsty rainbird.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਆਸ ਪਿਆਸਾ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tumaree aas piaasaa tumaree tum hee sang man leenaa jeeo |1|
English: You are my hope, and You are my thirst. My mind is absorbed in You. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਪੀ ਖੀਰੁ ਅਘਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jiau baarik pee kheer aghaavai |
English: Just as the baby is satisfied by drinking milk,

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਨਿਰਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jiau niradhan dhan dekh sukh paavai |
English: and the poor person is pleased by seeing wealth,

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾਵੰਤ ਜਲੁ ਪੀਵਤ ਠੰਢਾ ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: trikhaavant jal peevat tthandtaa tiau har sang ihu man bheenaa jeeo |2|
English: and the thirsty person is refreshed by drinking cool water, so is this mind drenched with delight in the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੈ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: jiau andhiaarai deepak paragaasaa |
English: Just as the darkness is lit up by the lamp,

Gurbani: ਭਰਤਾ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: bharataa chitavat pooran aasaa |
English: and the hopes of the wife are fulfilled by thinking about her husband,

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਜਿਉ ਹੋਤ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗੀਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: mil preetam jiau hot anandaa tiau har rang man rangeenaa jeeo |3|
English: and people are filled with bliss upon meeting their beloved, so is my mind imbued with the Lord's Love. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਨ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: santan mo kau har maarag paaeaa |
English: The Saints have set me upon the Lord's Path.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਗਿਝਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kripaal har sang gijhaaeaa |
English: By the Grace of the Holy Saint, I have been attuned to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਮਰਾ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਸੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਚੁ ਦੀਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੨੧॥
Transliteration: har hamaraa ham har ke daase naanak sabad guroo sach deenaa jeeo |4|14|21|
English: The Lord is mine, and I am the slave of the Lord. O Nanak, the Guru has blessed me with the True Word of the Shabad. ||4||14||21||

[Ang 100 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: amrit naam sadaa niramaleea |
English: The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, is eternally pure.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਡਾਰਨ ਹਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: sukhadaaee dookh biddaaran hareea |
English: The Lord is the Giver of Peace and the Dispeller of sorrow.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰਿ ਸਾਦ ਚਖਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੇਖੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਮੀਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: avar saad chakh sagale dekhe man har ras sabh te meetthaa jeeo |1|
English: I have seen and tasted all other flavors, but to my mind, the Subtle Essence of the Lord is the sweetest of all. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਪੀਵੈ ਸੋ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jo jo peevai so tripataavai |
English: Whoever drinks this in, is satisfied.

Gurbani: ਅਮਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੋ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: amar hovai jo naam ras paavai |
English: Whoever obtains the Sublime Essence of the Naam becomes immortal.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਨਿ ਵੂਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naam nidhaan tiseh paraapat jis sabad guroo man vootthaa jeeo |2|
English: The Treasure of the Naam is obtained by one whose mind is filled with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jin har ras paaeaa so tripat aghaanaa |
English: One who obtains the Sublime Essence of the Lord is satisfied and fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋ ਨਾਹਿ ਡੁਲਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jin har saad paaeaa so naeh ddulaanaa |
English: One who obtains this Flavor of the Lord does not waver.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੀਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tiseh paraapat har har naamaa jis masatak bhaageetthaa jeeo |3|
English: One who has this destiny written on his forehead obtains the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਇਕਸੁ ਹਥਿ ਆਇਆ ਵਰਸਾਣੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har ikas hath aaeaa varasaane bahutere |
English: The Lord has come into the hands of the One, the Guru, who has blessed so many with good fortune.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਲਗਿ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਭਏ ਘਣੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: tis lag mukat bhe ghanere |
English: Attached to Him, a great many have been liberated.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਰਲੀ ਡੀਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੨੨॥
Transliteration: naam nidhaanaa guramukh paaeeai kahu naanak viralee ddeetthaa jeeo |4|15|22|
English: The Gurmukh obtains the Treasure of the Naam; says Nanak, those who see the Lord are very rare. ||4||15||22||

[Ang 101 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: nidh sidh ridh har har har merai |
English: My Lord, Har, Har, Har, is the nine treasures, the supernatural spiritual powers of the Siddhas, wealth and prosperity.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: janam padaarath gahir ganbheerai |
English: He is the Deep and Profound Treasure of Life.

Gurbani: ਲਾਖ ਕੋਟ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਰੰਗ ਰਾਵੈ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਲਾਗਾ ਪਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: laakh kott khuseea rang raavai jo gur laagaa paaee jeeo |1|
English: Hundreds of thousands, even millions of pleasures and delights are enjoyed by one who falls at the Guru's Feet. ||1||

Gurbani: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਤ ਭਏ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: darasan pekhat bhe puneetaa |
English: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, all are sanctified,

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: sagal udhaare bhaaee meetaa |
English: and all family and friends are saved.

Gurbani: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: agam agochar suaamee apunaa gur kirapaa te sach dhiaaee jeeo |2|
English: By Guru's Grace, I meditate on the Inaccessible and Unfathomable True Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਖੋਜਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kau khojeh sarab upaae |
English: The One, the Guru, who is sought by all-only a few,

Gurbani: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: vaddabhaagee darasan ko viralaa paae |
English: By great good fortune, receive His Darshan.

Gurbani: ਊਚ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਥਾਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੇਖਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aooch apaar agochar thaanaa ohu mehal guroo dekhaaee jeeo |3|
English: His Place is lofty, infinite and unfathomable; the Guru has shown me that palace. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: gahir ganbheer amrit naam teraa |
English: Your Ambrosial Name is deep and profound.

Gurbani: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਇਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: mukat bheaa jis ridai vaseraa |
English: That person is liberated, in whose heart You dwell.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਕਾਟੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੨੩॥
Transliteration: gur bandhan tin ke sagale kaatte jan naanak sehaj samaaee jeeo |4|16|23|
English: The Guru cuts away all his bonds; O Servant Nanak, he is absorbed in the poise of intuitive peace. ||4||16||23||

[Ang 101 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kirapaa te har har dhiaavau |
English: By God's Grace, I meditate on the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਇਆ ਤੇ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: prabhoo deaa te mangal gaavau |
English: By God's Kindness, I sing the songs of joy.

Gurbani: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਜਾਗਤ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਗਲ ਅਵਰਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aootthat baitthat sovat jaagat har dhiaaeeai sagal avaradaa jeeo |1|
English: While standing and sitting, while sleeping and while awake, meditate on the Lord, all your life. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਸਾਧੂ ਦੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: naam aaukhadh mo kau saadhoo deea |
English: The Holy Saint has given me the Medicine of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਥੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: kilabikh kaatte niramal theea |
English: My sins have been cut out, and I have become pure.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਨਿਕਸੀ ਸਭ ਪੀਰਾ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਦਰਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: anad bheaa nikasee sabh peeraa sagal binaase daradaa jeeo |2|
English: I am filled with bliss, and all my pains have been taken away. All my suffering has been dispelled. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਅੰਗੁ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jis kaa ang kare meraa piaaraa |
English: One who has my Beloved on his side,

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: so mukataa saagar sansaaraa |
English: Is liberated from the world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਡਰਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sat kare jin guroo pachhaataa so kaahe kau ddaradaa jeeo |3|
English: One who recognizes the Guru practices Truth; why should he be afraid? ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jab te saadhoo sangat paae |
English: Since I found the Company of the Holy and met the Guru,

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟਤ ਹਉ ਗਈ ਬਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur bhettat hau gee balaae |
English: The demon of pride has departed.

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਢਾਕਿ ਲੀਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਪੜਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੭॥੨੪॥
Transliteration: saas saas har gaavai naanak satigur dtaak leea meraa parradaa jeeo |4|17|24|
English: With each and every breath, Nanak sings the Lord's Praises. The True Guru has covered my sins. ||4||17||24||

[Ang 101 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: ot pot sevak sang raataa |
English: Through and through, the Lord is intermingled with His servant.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: prabh pratipaale sevak sukhadaataa |
English: God, the Giver of Peace, cherishes His servant.

Gurbani: ਪਾਣੀ ਪਖਾ ਪੀਸਉ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੈ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹੀ ਕਾ ਆਹਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: paanee pakhaa peesau sevak kai tthaakur hee kaa aahar jeeo |1|
English: I carry the water, wave the fan, and grind the grain for the servant of my Lord and Master. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਾਟਿ ਸਿਲਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kaatt silak prabh sevaa laaeaa |
English: God has cut the noose from around my neck; He has placed me in His Service.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: hukam saahib kaa sevak man bhaaeaa |
English: The Lord and Master's Command is pleasing to the mind of His servant.

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਜੋ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਮਾਹਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: soee kamaavai jo saahib bhaavai sevak antar baahar maahar jeeo |2|
English: He does that which pleases his Lord and Master. Inwardly and outwardly, the servant knows his Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਨਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਨਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: toon daanaa tthaakur sabh bidh jaaneh |
English: You are the All-knowing Lord and Master; You know all ways and means.

Gurbani: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: tthaakur ke sevak har rang maaneh |
English: The servant of the Lord and Master enjoys the Love and Affection of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਾ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਾਹਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jo kichh tthaakur kaa so sevak kaa sevak tthaakur hee sang jaahar jeeo |3|
English: That which belongs to the Lord and Master, belongs to His servant. The servant becomes distinguished in association with his Lord and Master. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅਪੁਨੈ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਜੋ ਪਹਿਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: apunai tthaakur jo pahiraaeaa |
English: He, whom the Lord and Master dresses in the robes of honor,

Gurbani: ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਲੇਖਾ ਪੁਛਿ ਬੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bahur na lekhaa puchh bulaaeaa |
English: Is not called to answer for his account any longer.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਸੋ ਗਹਿਰ ਗਭੀਰਾ ਗਉਹਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੮॥੨੫॥
Transliteration: tis sevak kai naanak kurabaanee so gahir gabheeraa gauhar jeeo |4|18|25|
English: Nanak is a sacrifice to that servant. He is the pearl of the deep and unfathomable Ocean of God. ||4||18||25||

[Ang 102 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh ghar meh baahar naahee |
English: Everything is within the home of the self; there is nothing beyond.

Gurbani: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਟੋਲੈ ਸੋ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: baahar ttolai so bharam bhulaahee |
English: One who searches outside is deluded by doubt.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਿਨੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee jinee antar paaeaa so antar baahar suhelaa jeeo |1|
English: By Guru's Grace, one who has found the Lord within is happy, inwardly and outwardly. ||1||

Gurbani: ਝਿਮਿ ਝਿਮਿ ਵਰਸੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jhim jhim varasai amrit dhaaraa |
English: Slowly, gently, drop by drop, the stream of nectar trickles down within.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਸੁਨਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: man peevai sun sabad beechaaraa |
English: The mind drinks it in, hearing and reflecting on the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: anad binod kare din raatee sadaa sadaa har kelaa jeeo |2|
English: It enjoys bliss and ecstasy day and night, and plays with the Lord forever and ever. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਮਿਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: janam janam kaa vichhurriaa miliaa |
English: I have now been united with the Lord after having been separated and cut off from Him for so many lifetimes;

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਸੂਕਾ ਹਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kripaa te sookaa hariaa |
English: by the Grace of the Holy Saint, the dried-up branches have blossomed forth again in their greenery.

Gurbani: ਸੁਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਏ ਮੇਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sumat paae naam dhiaae guramukh hoe melaa jeeo |3|
English: I have obtained this sublime understanding, and I meditate on the Naam; as Gurmukh, I have met the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਲ ਤਰੰਗੁ ਜਿਉ ਜਲਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jal tarang jiau jaleh samaaeaa |
English: As the waves of water merge again with the water,

Gurbani: ਤਿਉ ਜੋਤੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tiau jotee sang jot milaaeaa |
English: so does my light merge again into the Light.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕਟੇ ਕਿਵਾੜਾ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਹੋਈਐ ਜਉਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੯॥੨੬॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak bhram katte kivaarraa bahurr na hoeeai jaulaa jeeo |4|19|26|
English: Says Nanak, the veil of illusion has been cut away, and I shall not go out wandering any more. ||4||19||26||

[Ang 102 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂੰ ਸੁਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: tis kurabaanee jin toon suniaa |
English: I am a sacrifice to those who have heard of You.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਭਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: tis balihaaree jin rasanaa bhaniaa |
English: I am a sacrifice to those whose tongues speak of You.

Gurbani: ਵਾਰਿ ਵਾਰਿ ਜਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਜੋ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: vaar vaar jaaee tis vittahu jo man tan tudh aaraadhe jeeo |1|
English: Again and again, I am a sacrifice to those who meditate on You with mind and body. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਚਰਣ ਪਖਾਲੀ ਜੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਾਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: tis charan pakhaalee jo terai maarag chaalai |
English: I wash the feet of those who walk upon Your Path.

Gurbani: ਨੈਨ ਨਿਹਾਲੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਦਇਆਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: nain nihaalee tis purakh deaalai |
English: With my eyes, I long to behold those kind people.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਦੇਵਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਾਜਨ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਾਧੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: man devaa tis apune saajan jin gur mil so prabh laadhe jeeo |2|
English: I offer my mind to those friends, who have met the Guru and found God. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਤੁਮ ਜਾਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: se vaddabhaagee jin tum jaane |
English: Very fortunate are those who know You.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਕੈ ਮਧੇ ਅਲਿਪਤ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kai madhe alipat nirabaane |
English: In the midst of all, they remain detached and balanced in Nirvaanaa.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਨਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਦੂਤ ਉਨਿ ਸਾਧੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: saadh kai sang un bhaujal tariaa sagal doot un saadhe jeeo |3|
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, they cross over the terrifying world-ocean, and conquer all their evil passions. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: tin kee saran pariaa man meraa |
English: My mind has entered their Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਮਾਣੁ ਤਾਣੁ ਤਜਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: maan taan taj mohu andheraa |
English: I have renounced my pride in my own strength, and the darkness of emotional attachment.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੦॥੨੭॥
Transliteration: naam daan deejai naanak kau tis prabh agam agaadhe jeeo |4|20|27|
English: Please bless Nanak with the Gift of the Naam, the Name of the Inaccessible and Unfathomable God. ||4||20||27||

[Ang 102 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਪੇਡੁ ਸਾਖ ਤੇਰੀ ਫੂਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: toon pedd saakh teree foolee |
English: You are the tree; Your branches have blossomed forth.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਸੂਖਮੁ ਹੋਆ ਅਸਥੂਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: toon sookham hoaa asathoolee |
English: From the very small and subtle, You have become huge and manifest.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਜਲਨਿਧਿ ਤੂੰ ਫੇਨੁ ਬੁਦਬੁਦਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਲੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: toon jalanidh toon fen budabudaa tudh bin avar na bhaaleeai jeeo |1|
English: You are the Ocean of Water, and You are the foam and the bubbles on its surface. I cannot see any other except You, Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਸੂਤੁ ਮਣੀਏ ਭੀ ਤੂੰਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: toon soot manee bhee toonhai |
English: You are the thread, and You are also the beads.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਗੰਠੀ ਮੇਰੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਤੂੰਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: toon gantthee mer sir toonhai |
English: You are the knot, and You are the primary bead of the maalaa.

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਦਿਖਾਲੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aad madh ant prabh soee avar na koe dikhaaleeai jeeo |2|
English: In the beginning, in the middle and in the end, there is God. I cannot see any other except You, Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਨਿਰਗੁਣੁ ਸਰਗੁਣੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: toon niragun saragun sukhadaataa |
English: You transcend all qualities, and You possess the supreme qualities. You are the Giver of peace.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ਰਸੀਆ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: toon nirabaan raseea rang raataa |
English: You are detached in Nirvaanaa, and You are the Enjoyer, imbued with love.

Gurbani: ਅਪਣੇ ਕਰਤਬ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਆਪੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: apane karatab aape jaaneh aape tudh samaaleeai jeeo |3|
English: You Yourself know Your Own Ways; You dwell upon Yourself. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਫੁਨਿ ਆਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: toon tthaakur sevak fun aape |
English: You are the Master, and then again, You are the servant.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: toon gupat paragatt prabh aape |
English: O God, You Yourself are the Manifest and the Unmanifest.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਇਕ ਭੋਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੧॥੨੮॥
Transliteration: naanak daas sadaa gun gaavai ik bhoree nadar nihaaleeai jeeo |4|21|28|
English: Slave Nanak sings Your Glorious Praises forever. Please, just for a moment, bless him with Your Glance of Grace. ||4||21||28||

[Ang 103 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਫਲ ਸੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: safal su baanee jit naam vakhaanee |
English: Blessed are those words, by which the Naam is chanted.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaad kinai viralai jaanee |
English: Rare are those who know this, by Guru's Grace.

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਵਤ ਸੁਨਣਾ ਆਏ ਤੇ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dhan su velaa jit har gaavat sunanaa aae te paravaanaa jeeo |1|
English: Blessed is that time when one sings and hears the Lord's Name. Blessed and approved is the coming of such a one. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਾ ॥
Transliteration: se netr paravaan jinee darasan pekhaa |
English: Those eyes which behold the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan are approved and accepted.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਕਰ ਭਲੇ ਜਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਲੇਖਾ ॥
Transliteration: se kar bhale jinee har jas lekhaa |
English: Those hands which write the Praises of the Lord are good.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਚਰਣ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਲੇ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਤਿਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਛਾਣਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: se charan suhaave jo har maarag chale hau bal tin sang pachhaanaa jeeo |2|
English: Those feet which walk in the Lord's Way are beautiful. I am a sacrifice to that Congregation in which the Lord is recognized. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sun saajan mere meet piaare |
English: Listen, O my beloved friends and companions:

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang khin maeh udhaare |
English: in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall be saved in an instant.

Gurbani: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਾਟਿ ਹੋਆ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kilavikh kaatt hoaa man niramal mitt ge aavan jaanaa jeeo |3|
English: Your sins will be cut out; your mind will be immaculate and pure. Your comings and goings shall cease. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਇਕੁ ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: due kar jorr ik binau kareejai |
English: With my palms pressed together, I offer this prayer:

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਡੁਬਦਾ ਪਥਰੁ ਲੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa ddubadaa pathar leejai |
English: please bless me with Your Mercy, and save this sinking stone.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੨॥੨੯॥
Transliteration: naanak kau prabh bhe kripaalaa prabh naanak man bhaanaa jeeo |4|22|29|
English: God has become merciful to Nanak; God is pleasing to Nanak's mind. ||4||22||29||

[Ang 103 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: amrit baanee har har teree |
English: The Word of Your Bani, Lord, is Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: sun sun hovai param gat meree |
English: Hearing it again and again, I am elevated to the supreme heights.

Gurbani: ਜਲਨਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਨੂਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jalan bujhee seetal hoe manooaa satigur kaa darasan paae jeeo |1|
English: The burning within me has been extinguished, and my mind has been cooled and soothed, by the Blessed Vision of the True Guru. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੂਖੁ ਭਇਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਪਰਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: sookh bheaa dukh door paraanaa |
English: Happiness is obtained, and sorrow runs far away,

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਰਸਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: sant rasan har naam vakhaanaa |
English: when the Saints chant the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਜਲ ਥਲ ਨੀਰਿ ਭਰੇ ਸਰ ਸੁਭਰ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jal thal neer bhare sar subhar birathaa koe na jaae jeeo |2|
English: The sea, the dry land, and the lakes are filled with the Water of the Lord's Name; no place is left empty. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰੀ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: deaa dhaaree tin sirajanahaare |
English: The Creator has showered His Kindness;

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਗਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jant sagale pratipaare |
English: He cherishes and nurtures all beings and creatures.

Gurbani: ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਸਗਲੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: miharavaan kirapaal deaalaa sagale tripat aghaae jeeo |3|
English: He is Merciful, Kind and Compassionate. All are satisfied and fulfilled through Him. ||3||

Gurbani: ਵਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: van trin tribhavan keeton hariaa |
English: The woods, the meadows and the three worlds are rendered green.

Gurbani: ਕਰਣਹਾਰਿ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਕਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: karanahaar khin bheetar kariaa |
English: The Doer of all did this in an instant.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੈ ਅਰਾਧੇ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਪੁਜਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੩੦॥
Transliteration: guramukh naanak tisai araadhe man kee aas pujaae jeeo |4|23|30|
English: As Gurmukh, Nanak meditates on the One who fulfills the desires of the mind. ||4||23||30||

[Ang 103 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: toon meraa pitaa toonhai meraa maataa |
English: You are my Father, and You are my Mother.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਬੰਧਪੁ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: toon meraa bandhap toon meraa bhraataa |
English: You are my Relative, and You are my Brother.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਾਖਾ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ਤਾ ਭਉ ਕੇਹਾ ਕਾੜਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: toon meraa raakhaa sabhanee thaaee taa bhau kehaa kaarraa jeeo |1|
English: You are my Protector everywhere; why should I feel any fear or anxiety? ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਛਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: tumaree kripaa te tudh pachhaanaa |
English: By Your Grace, I recognize You.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਓਟ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: toon meree ott toonhai meraa maanaa |
English: You are my Shelter, and You are my Honor.

Gurbani: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਅਖਾੜਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tujh bin doojaa avar na koee sabh teraa khel akhaarraa jeeo |2|
English: Without You, there is no other; the entire Universe is the Arena of Your Play. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jant sabh tudh upaae |
English: You have created all beings and creatures.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jit jit bhaanaa tith tit laae |
English: As it pleases You, You assign tasks to one and all.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਅਸਾੜਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh keetaa teraa hovai naahee kichh asaarraa jeeo |3|
English: All things are Your Doing; we can do nothing ourselves. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: naam dhiaae mahaa sukh paaeaa |
English: Meditating on the Naam, I have found great peace.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: har gun gaae meraa man seetalaaeaa |
English: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, my mind is cooled and soothed.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਵਜੀ ਵਾਧਾਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਤਾ ਬਿਖਾੜਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੪॥੩੧॥
Transliteration: gur poorai vajee vaadhaaee naanak jitaa bikhaarraa jeeo |4|24|31|
English: Through the Perfect Guru, congratulations are pouring in-Nanak is victorious on the arduous battlefield of life! ||4||24||31||

[Ang 103 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਨਹਿ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeea praan prabh maneh adhaaraa |
English: God is the Breath of Life of my soul, the Support of my mind.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat jeeveh gun gaae apaaraa |
English: His devotees live by singing the Glorious Praises of the Infinite Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਧਿਆਇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gun nidhaan amrit har naamaa har dhiaae dhiaae sukh paaeaa jeeo |1|
English: The Ambrosial Name of the Lord is the Treasure of Excellence. Meditating, meditating on the Lord's Name, I have found peace. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨਸਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਜੋ ਘਰ ਤੇ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: manasaa dhaar jo ghar te aavai |
English: One whose heart's desires lead him from his own home,

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਮਿਟਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang janam maran mittaavai |
English: To the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, shall be rid of the cycle of birth and death.

Gurbani: ਆਸ ਮਨੋਰਥੁ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਭੇਟਤ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aas manorath pooran hovai bhettat gur darasaaeaa jeeo |2|
English: His hopes and desires are fulfilled, when he gains the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਕਿਛੁ ਮਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: agam agochar kichh mit nahee jaanee |
English: The limits of the Inaccessible and Unfathomable Lord cannot be known.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: saadhik sidh dhiaaveh giaanee |
English: The seekers, the Siddhas, those beings of miraculous spiritual powers, and the spiritual teachers, all meditate on Him.

Gurbani: ਖੁਦੀ ਮਿਟੀ ਚੂਕਾ ਭੋਲਾਵਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: khudee mittee chookaa bholaavaa gur man hee meh pragattaaeaa jeeo |3|
English: Thus, their egos are erased, and their doubts are dispelled. The Guru has enlightened their minds. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: anad mangal kaliaan nidhaanaa |
English: I chant the Name of the Lord, the Treasure of bliss,

Gurbani: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: sookh sehaj har naam vakhaanaa |
English: Joy, salvation, intuitive peace and poise.

Gurbani: ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਪਨਾ ਨਾਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੫॥੩੨॥
Transliteration: hoe kripaal suaamee apanaa naau naanak ghar meh aaeaa jeeo |4|25|32|
English: When my Lord and Master blessed me with His Mercy, O Nanak, then His Name entered the home of my mind. ||4||25||32||

[Ang 104 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਸੋਇ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: sun sun jeevaa soe tumaaree |
English: Hearing of You, I live.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: toon preetam tthaakur at bhaaree |
English: You are my Beloved, my Lord and Master, Utterly Great.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮਰੇ ਕਰਤਬ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਓਟ ਗੋੁਪਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tumare karatab tum hee jaanahu tumaree ott guopaalaa jeeo |1|
English: You alone know Your Ways; I grasp Your Support, Lord of the World. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: gun gaavat man hariaa hovai |
English: Singing Your Glorious Praises, my mind is rejuvenated.

Gurbani: ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਤ ਮਲੁ ਸਗਲੀ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: kathaa sunat mal sagalee khovai |
English: Hearing Your Sermon, all filth is removed.

Gurbani: ਭੇਟਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਸਦਾ ਜਪਉ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bhettat sang saadh santan kai sadaa jpau deaalaa jeeo |2|
English: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I meditate forever on the Merciful Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਮਾਰਉ ॥
Transliteration: prabh apunaa saas saas samaarau |
English: I dwell on my God with each and every breath.

Gurbani: ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮਨਿ ਧਾਰਉ ॥
Transliteration: eih mat gur prasaad man dhaarau |
English: This understanding has been implanted within my mind, by Guru's Grace.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ ਸਰਬ ਮਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tumaree kripaa te hoe pragaasaa sarab meaa pratipaalaa jeeo |3|
English: By Your Grace, the Divine Light has dawned. The Merciful Lord cherishes everyone. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: sat sat sat prabh soee |
English: True, True, True is that God.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਦ ਆਪੇ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa sad aape hoee |
English: Forever, forever and ever, He Himself is.

Gurbani: ਚਲਿਤ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੬॥੩੩॥
Transliteration: chalit tumaare pragatt piaare dekh naanak bhe nihaalaa jeeo |4|26|33|
English: Your Playful Ways are revealed, O my Beloved. Beholding them, Nanak is enraptured. ||4||26||33||

[Ang 104 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਵਰਸਣ ਲਾਗੇ ਮੇਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: hukamee varasan laage mehaa |
English: By His Command, the rain begins to fall.

Gurbani: ਸਾਜਨ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: saajan sant mil naam japehaa |
English: The Saints and friends have met to chant the Naam.

Gurbani: ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਠਾਢਿ ਪਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: seetal saant sehaj sukh paaeaa tthaadt paaee prabh aape jeeo |1|
English: Serene tranquility and peaceful ease have come; God Himself has brought a deep and profound peace. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਬਹੁਤੋ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh bahuto bahut upaaeaa |
English: God has produced everything in great abundance.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸਗਲ ਰਜਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh sagal rajaaeaa |
English: Granting His Grace, God has satisfied all.

Gurbani: ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: daat karahu mere daataaraa jeea jant sabh dhraape jeeo |2|
English: Bless us with Your Gifts, O my Great Giver. All beings and creatures are satisfied. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa saahib sachee naaee |
English: True is the Master, and True is His Name.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaad tis sadaa dhiaaee |
English: By Guru's Grace, I meditate forever on Him.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭੈ ਕਾਟੇ ਮੋਹਾ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: janam maran bhai kaatte mohaa binase sog santaape jeeo |3|
English: The fear of birth and death has been dispelled; emotional attachment, sorrow and suffering have been erased. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: saas saas naanak saalaahe |
English: With each and every breath, Nanak praises the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਾਟੇ ਸਭਿ ਫਾਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: simarat naam kaatte sabh faahe |
English: Meditating in remembrance on the Name, all bonds are cut away.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸ ਕਰੀ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਜਾਪੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੭॥੩੪॥
Transliteration: pooran aas karee khin bheetar har har har gun jaape jeeo |4|27|34|
English: One's hopes are fulfilled in an instant, chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har. ||4||27||34||

[Ang 104 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਉ ਸਾਜਨ ਸੰਤ ਮੀਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aau saajan sant meet piaare |
English: Come, dear friends, Saints and companions:

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਗਾਵਹ ਗੁਣ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: mil gaavah gun agam apaare |
English: let us join together and sing the Glorious Praises of the Inaccessible and Infinite Lord.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਤ ਸੁਣਤ ਸਭੇ ਹੀ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਸੋ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਮ ਕੀਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gaavat sunat sabhe hee mukate so dhiaaeeai jin ham kee jeeo |1|
English: Those who sing and hear these praises are liberated, so let us meditate on the One who created us. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਜਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: janam janam ke kilabikh jaaveh |
English: The sins of countless incarnations depart,

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦੇ ਸੇਈ ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: man chinde seee fal paaveh |
English: and we receive the fruits of the mind's desires.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਭਸੁ ਕਉ ਦੀਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: simar saahib so sach suaamee rijak sabhas kau dee jeeo |2|
English: So meditate on that Lord, our True Lord and Master, who gives sustenance to all. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: naam japat sarab sukh paaeeai |
English: Chanting the Naam, all pleasures are obtained.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਭਉ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: sabh bhau binasai har har dhiaaeeai |
English: All fears are erased, meditating on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਸੋ ਪਾਰਗਿਰਾਮੀ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲੇ ਥੀਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jin seviaa so paaragiraamee kaaraj sagale thee jeeo |3|
English: One who serves the Lord swims across to the other side, and all his affairs are resolved. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਇ ਪਇਆ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aae peaa teree saranaaee |
English: I have come to Your Sanctuary;

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਲੈਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jiau bhaavai tiau laihi milaaee |
English: if it pleases You, unite me with You.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੮॥੩੫॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh bhagatee laavahu sach naanak amrit pee jeeo |4|28|35|
English: Shower Your Mercy upon me, God; let me be committed to devotional worship. Nanak drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar of Truth. ||4||28||35||

[Ang 105 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: bhe kripaal govind gusaaee |
English: The Lord of the Universe, the Support of the earth, has become Merciful;

Gurbani: ਮੇਘੁ ਵਰਸੈ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: megh varasai sabhanee thaaee |
English: the rain is falling everywhere.

Gurbani: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਦਾ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ਠਾਢਿ ਪਾਈ ਕਰਤਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: deen deaal sadaa kirapaalaa tthaadt paaee karataare jeeo |1|
English: He is Merciful to the meek, always Kind and Gentle; the Creator has brought cooling relief. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: apune jeea jant pratipaare |
English: He cherishes all His beings and creatures,

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਮਾਤਾ ਸੰਮਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jiau baarik maataa samaare |
English: as the mother cares for her children.

Gurbani: ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਦੇਤ ਸਗਲ ਆਹਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: dukh bhanjan sukh saagar suaamee det sagal aahaare jeeo |2|
English: The Destroyer of pain, the Ocean of Peace, the Lord and Master gives sustenance to all. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jal thal poor rahiaa miharavaanaa |
English: The Merciful Lord is totally pervading and permeating the water and the land.

Gurbani: ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: sad balihaar jaaeeai kurabaanaa |
English: I am forever devoted, a sacrifice to Him.

Gurbani: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈ ਜਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: rain dinas tis sadaa dhiaaee ji khin meh sagal udhaare jeeo |3|
English: Night and day, I always meditate on Him; in an instant, He saves all. ||3||

Gurbani: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਸਗਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: raakh lee sagale prabh aape |
English: God Himself protects all;

Gurbani: ਉਤਰਿ ਗਏ ਸਭ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: autar ge sabh sog santaape |
English: He drives out all sorrow and suffering.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੯॥੩੬॥
Transliteration: naam japat man tan hareeaaval prabh naanak nadar nihaare jeeo |4|29|36|
English: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind and body are rejuvenated. O Nanak, God has bestowed His Glance of Grace. ||4||29||36||

[Ang 105 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਥੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jithai naam japeeai prabh piaare |
English: Where the Naam, the Name of God the Beloved is chanted

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਅਸਥਲ ਸੋਇਨ ਚਉਬਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: se asathal soein chaubaare |
English: those barren places become mansions of gold.

Gurbani: ਜਿਥੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਪੀਐ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਇਦਾ ਸੇਈ ਨਗਰ ਉਜਾੜੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jithai naam na japeeai mere goeidaa seee nagar ujaarree jeeo |1|
English: Where the Naam, the Name of my Lord of the Universe is not chanted-those towns are like the barren wilderness. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰੁਖੀ ਰੋਟੀ ਖਾਇ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: har rukhee rottee khaae samaale |
English: One who meditates as he eats dry bread,

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: har antar baahar nadar nihaale |
English: sees the Blessed Lord inwardly and outwardly.

Gurbani: ਖਾਇ ਖਾਇ ਕਰੇ ਬਦਫੈਲੀ ਜਾਣੁ ਵਿਸੂ ਕੀ ਵਾੜੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: khaae khaae kare badafailee jaan visoo kee vaarree jeeo |2|
English: Know this well, that one who eats and eats while practicing evil, is like a field of poisonous plants. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਾ ਸੇਤੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: santaa setee rang na laae |
English: One who does not feel love for the Saints,

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਵਿਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: saakat sang vikaram kamaae |
English: misbehaves in the company of the wicked shaaktas, the faithless cynics;

Gurbani: ਦੁਲਭ ਦੇਹ ਖੋਈ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਜੜ ਅਪੁਣੀ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾੜੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: dulabh deh khoee agiaanee jarr apunee aap upaarree jeeo |3|
English: he wastes this human body, so difficult to obtain. In his ignorance, he tears up his own roots. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: teree saran mere deen deaalaa |
English: I seek Your Sanctuary, O my Lord, Merciful to the meek,

Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: sukh saagar mere gur gopaalaa |
English: Ocean of Peace, my Guru, Sustainer of the world.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਰਮ ਅਸਾੜੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੦॥੩੭॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa naanak gun gaavai raakhahu saram asaarree jeeo |4|30|37|
English: Shower Your Mercy upon Nanak, that he may sing Your Glorious Praises; please, preserve my honor. ||4||30||37||

[Ang 105 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: charan tthaakur ke ridai samaane |
English: I cherish in my heart the Feet of my Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਸਭ ਦੂਰਿ ਪਇਆਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: kal kales sabh door peaane |
English: All my troubles and sufferings have run away.

Gurbani: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੀ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saant sookh sehaj dhun upajee saadhoo sang nivaasaa jeeo |1|
English: The music of intuitive peace, poise and tranquility wells up within; I dwell in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||

Gurbani: ਲਾਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਤੂਟੈ ਮੂਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: laagee preet na toottai moole |
English: The bonds of love with the Lord are never broken.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har antar baahar rahiaa bharapoore |
English: The Lord is totally permeating and pervading inside and out.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਕਾਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: simar simar simar gun gaavaa kaattee jam kee faasaa jeeo |2|
English: Meditating, meditating, meditating in remembrance on Him, singing His Glorious Praises, the noose of death is cut away. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵਰਖੈ ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: amrit varakhai anahad baanee |
English: The Ambrosial Nectar, the Unstruck Melody of Gurbani rains down continually;

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: man tan antar saant samaanee |
English: deep within my mind and body, peace and tranquility have come.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਇ ਰਹੇ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਦਿਲਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tripat aghaae rahe jan tere satigur keea dilaasaa jeeo |3|
English: Your humble servants remain satisfied and fulfilled, and the True Guru blesses them with encouragement and comfort. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jis kaa saa tis te fal paaeaa |
English: We are His, and from Him, we receive our rewards.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh sang milaaeaa |
English: Showering His Mercy upon us, God has united us with Him.

Gurbani: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣ ਰਹੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੧॥੩੮॥
Transliteration: aavan jaan rahe vaddabhaagee naanak pooran aasaa jeeo |4|31|38|
English: Our comings and goings have ended, and through great good fortune, O Nanak, our hopes are fulfilled. ||4||31||38||

[Ang 105 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੀਹੁ ਪਇਆ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: meehu peaa paramesar paaeaa |
English: The rain has fallen; I have found the Transcendent Lord God.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖੀ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jant sabh sukhee vasaaeaa |
English: All beings and creatures dwell in peace.

Gurbani: ਗਇਆ ਕਲੇਸੁ ਭਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: geaa kales bheaa sukh saachaa har har naam samaalee jeeo |1|
English: Suffering has been dispelled, and true happiness has dawned, as we meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਸੇ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jis ke se tin hee pratipaare |
English: The One, to whom we belong, cherishes and nurtures us.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਰਖਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham prabh bhe rakhavaare |
English: The Supreme Lord God has become our Protector.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਘਾਲੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sunee benantee tthaakur merai pooran hoee ghaalee jeeo |2|
English: My Lord and Master has heard my prayer; my efforts have been rewarded. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਕਉ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sarab jeea kau devanahaaraa |
English: He is the Giver of all souls.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee nadar nihaaraa |
English: By Guru's Grace, He blesses us with His Glance of Grace.

Gurbani: ਜਲ ਥਲ ਮਹੀਅਲ ਸਭਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਣੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਲੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jal thal maheeal sabh tripataane saadhoo charan pakhaalee jeeo |3|
English: The beings in the water, on the land and in the sky are all satisfied; I wash the Feet of the Holy. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: man kee ichh pujaavanahaaraa |
English: He is the Fulfiller of the desires of the mind.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa jaaee balihaaraa |
English: Forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to Him.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਨੁ ਕੀਆ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨਿ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਸਾਲੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੨॥੩੯॥
Transliteration: naanak daan keea dukh bhanjan rate rang rasaalee jeeo |4|32|39|
English: O Nanak, the Destroyer of pain has given this Gift; I am imbued with the Love of the Delightful Lord. ||4||32||39||

[Ang 106 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਧਨੁ ਭੀ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: man tan teraa dhan bhee teraa |
English: Mind and body are Yours; all wealth is Yours.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: toon tthaakur suaamee prabh meraa |
English: You are my God, my Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਜੋਰੁ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jeeo pindd sabh raas tumaaree teraa jor gopaalaa jeeo |1|
English: Body and soul and all riches are Yours. Yours is the Power, O Lord of the World. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa toonhai sukhadaaee |
English: Forever and ever, You are the Giver of Peace.

Gurbani: ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: niv niv laagaa teree paaee |
English: I bow down and fall at Your Feet.

Gurbani: ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਾ ਜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਾ ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kaar kamaavaa je tudh bhaavaa jaa toon dehi deaalaa jeeo |2|
English: I act as it pleases You, as You cause me to act, Kind and Compassionate Dear Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਲਹਣਾ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਗਹਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: prabh tum te lahanaa toon meraa gahanaa |
English: O God, from You I receive; You are my decoration.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਹਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo toon dehi soee sukh sahanaa |
English: Whatever You give me, brings me happiness.

Gurbani: ਜਿਥੈ ਰਖਹਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠੁ ਤਿਥਾਈ ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨਾ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jithai rakheh baikuntth tithaaee toon sabhanaa ke pratipaalaa jeeo |3|
English: Wherever You keep me, is heaven. You are the Cherisher of all. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: simar simar naanak sukh paaeaa |
English: Meditating, meditating in remembrance, Nanak has found peace.

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar tere gun gaaeaa |
English: Twenty-four hours a day, I sing Your Glorious Praises.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਏ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਦੁਖਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੩॥੪੦॥
Transliteration: sagal manorath pooran hoe kade na hoe dukhaalaa jeeo |4|33|40|
English: All my hopes and desires are fulfilled; I shall never again suffer sorrow. ||4||33||40||

[Ang 106 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮੇਘੁ ਪਠਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham prabh megh patthaaeaa |
English: The Supreme Lord God has unleashed the rain clouds.

Gurbani: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਵਰਸਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jal thal maheeal deh dis varasaaeaa |
English: Over the sea and over the land-over all the earth's surface, in all directions, He has brought the rain.

Gurbani: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਭਈ ਬੁਝੀ ਸਭ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saant bhee bujhee sabh trisanaa anad bheaa sabh tthaaee jeeo |1|
English: Peace has come, and the thirst of all has been quenched; there is joy and ecstasy everywhere. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sukhadaataa dukh bhanjanahaaraa |
English: He is the Giver of Peace, the Destroyer of pain.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਕਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape bakhas kare jeea saaraa |
English: He gives and forgives all beings.

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੇ ਕੀਤੇ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੇ ਪਇ ਪੈਰੀ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਮਨਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: apane keete no aap pratipaale pe pairee tiseh manaaee jeeo |2|
English: He Himself nurtures and cherishes His Creation. I fall at His Feet and surrender to Him. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kee saran peaa gat paaeeai |
English: Seeking His Sanctuary, salvation is obtained.

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: saas saas har naam dhiaaeeai |
English: With each and every breath, I meditate on the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਭ ਤਿਸੈ ਕੀਆ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tis bin hor na doojaa tthaakur sabh tisai keea jaaee jeeo |3|
English: Without Him, there is no other Lord and Master. All places belong to Him. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਮਾਣੁ ਤਾਣੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: teraa maan taan prabh teraa |
English: Yours is the Honor, God, and Yours is the Power.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: toon sachaa saahib gunee gaheraa |
English: You are the True Lord and Master, the Ocean of Excellence.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੪॥੪੧॥
Transliteration: naanak daas kahai benantee aatth pehar tudh dhiaaee jeeo |4|34|41|
English: Servant Nanak utters this prayer: may I meditate on You twenty-four hours a day. ||4||34||41||

[Ang 106 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਭੇ ਸੁਖ ਭਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਠੇ ॥
Transliteration: sabhe sukh bhe prabh tutthe |
English: All happiness comes, when God is pleased.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur poore ke charan man vutthe |
English: The Feet of the Perfect Guru dwell in my mind.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗੀ ਲਿਵ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੋ ਰਸੁ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sehaj samaadh lagee liv antar so ras soee jaanai jeeo |1|
English: I am intuitively absorbed in the state of Samaadhi deep within. God alone knows this sweet pleasure. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: agam agochar saahib meraa |
English: My Lord and Master is Inaccessible and Unfathomable.

Gurbani: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਨੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt antar varatai neraa |
English: Deep within each and every heart, He dwells near and close at hand.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sadaa alipat jeea kaa daataa ko viralaa aap pachhaanai jeeo |2|
English: He is always detached; He is the Giver of souls. How rare is that person who understands his own self. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਣੈ ਕੀ ਏਹ ਨੀਸਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: prabh milanai kee eeh neesaanee |
English: This is the sign of union with God:

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਇਕੋ ਸਚਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: man iko sachaa hukam pachhaanee |
English: in the mind, the Command of the True Lord is recognized.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜਿ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੇ ਅਨਦੁ ਖਸਮ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sehaj santokh sadaa tripataase anad khasam kai bhaanai jeeo |3|
English: Intuitive peace and poise, contentment, enduring satisfaction and bliss come through the Pleasure of the Master's Will. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਥੀ ਦਿਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: hathee ditee prabh devanahaarai |
English: God, the Great Giver, has given me His Hand.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਰੋਗ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: janam maran rog sabh nivaare |
English: He has erased all the sickness of birth and death.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਕੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੫॥੪੨॥
Transliteration: naanak daas kee prabh apune har keeratan rang maane jeeo |4|35|42|
English: O Nanak, those whom God has made His slaves, rejoice in the pleasure of singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||4||35||42||

[Ang 107 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕੀਨੀ ਦਇਆ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: keenee deaa gopaal gusaaee |
English: The Life of the World, the Sustainer of the Earth, has showered His Mercy;

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਵਸੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur ke charan vase man maahee |
English: the Guru's Feet have come to dwell within my mind.

Gurbani: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਦੁਖ ਕਾ ਡੇਰਾ ਢਾਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: angeekaar keea tin karatai dukh kaa dderaa dtaahiaa jeeo |1|
English: The Creator has made me His Own. He has destroyed the city of sorrow. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: man tan vasiaa sachaa soee |
English: The True One abides within my mind and body;

Gurbani: ਬਿਖੜਾ ਥਾਨੁ ਨ ਦਿਸੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: bikharraa thaan na disai koee |
English: no place seems difficult to me now.

Gurbani: ਦੂਤ ਦੁਸਮਣ ਸਭਿ ਸਜਣ ਹੋਏ ਏਕੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: doot dusaman sabh sajan hoe eko suaamee aahiaa jeeo |2|
English: All the evil-doers and enemies have now become my friends. I long only for my Lord and Master. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: jo kichh kare su aape aapai |
English: Whatever He does, He does all by Himself.

Gurbani: ਬੁਧਿ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: budh siaanap kichhoo na jaapai |
English: No one can know His Ways.

Gurbani: ਆਪਣਿਆ ਸੰਤਾ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਭਰਮ ਭੁਲਾਵਾ ਲਾਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aapaniaa santaa no aap sahaaee prabh bharam bhulaavaa laahiaa jeeo |3|
English: He Himself is the Helper and Support of His Saints. God has cast out my doubts and delusions. ||3||

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਆਧਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal jan kaa aadhaaro |
English: His Lotus Feet are the Support of His humble servants.

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar raam naam vaapaaro |
English: Twenty-four hours a day, they deal in the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੬॥੪੩॥
Transliteration: sehaj anand gaaveh gun govind prabh naanak sarab samaahiaa jeeo |4|36|43|
English: In peace and pleasure, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe. O Nanak, God is permeating everywhere. ||4||36||43||

[Ang 107 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: so sach mandar jit sach dhiaaeeai |
English: True is that temple, within which one meditates on the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਰਿਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: so ridaa suhelaa jit har gun gaaeeai |
English: Blessed is that heart, within which the Lord's Glorious Praises are sung.

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਧਰਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਵਸਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੋ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saa dharat suhaavee jit vaseh har jan sache naam vittahu kurabaano jeeo |1|
English: Beautiful is that land, where the Lord's humble servants dwell. I am a sacrifice to the True Name. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sach vaddaaee keem na paaee |
English: The extent of the True Lord's Greatness cannot be known.

Gurbani: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਨ ਕਹਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kudarat karam na kahanaa jaaee |
English: His Creative Power and His Bounties cannot be described.

Gurbani: ਧਿਆਇ ਧਿਆਇ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਣੋ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: dhiaae dhiaae jeeveh jan tere sach sabad man maano jeeo |2|
English: Your humble servants live by meditating, meditating on You. Their minds treasure the True Word of the Shabad. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਣੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: sach saalaahan vaddabhaagee paaeeai |
English: The Praises of the True One are obtained by great good fortune.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee har gun gaaeeai |
English: By Guru's Grace, the Glorious Praises of the Lord are sung.

Gurbani: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਤੇਰੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੋ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: rang rate terai tudh bhaaveh sach naam neesaano jeeo |3|
English: Those who are imbued with Your Love are pleasing to You. The True Name is their Banner and Insignia. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਚੇ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: sache ant na jaanai koee |
English: No one knows the limits of the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਥਾਨਿ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: thaan thanantar sachaa soee |
English: In all places and interspaces, the True One is pervading.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਾਣੋ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੭॥੪੪॥
Transliteration: naanak sach dhiaaeeai sad hee antarajaamee jaano jeeo |4|37|44|
English: O Nanak, meditate forever on the True One, the Searcher of hearts, the Knower of all. ||4||37||44||

[Ang 107 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰੈਣਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੜੀ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: rain suhaavarree dinas suhelaa |
English: Beautiful is the night, and beautiful is the day,

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: jap amrit naam santasang melaa |
English: when one joins the Society of the Saints and chants the Ambrosial Naam.

Gurbani: ਘੜੀ ਮੂਰਤ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪਲ ਵੰਞਹਿ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਤਿਥਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gharree moorat simarat pal vanyeh jeevan safal tithaaee jeeo |1|
English: If you remember the Lord in meditation for a moment, even for an instant, then your life will become fruitful and prosperous. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੋਖ ਸਭਿ ਲਾਥੇ ॥
Transliteration: simarat naam dokh sabh laathe |
English: Remembering the Naam, the Name of the Lord, all sinful mistakes are erased.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਥੇ ॥
Transliteration: antar baahar har prabh saathe |
English: Inwardly and outwardly, the Lord God is always with us.

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਭਉ ਭਰਮੁ ਖੋਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੇਖਾ ਸਭਨੀ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bhai bhau bharam khoeaa gur poorai dekhaa sabhanee jaaee jeeo |2|
English: Fear, dread and doubt have been dispelled by the Perfect Guru; now, I see God everywhere. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਵਡ ਊਚ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: prabh samarath vadd aooch apaaraa |
English: God is All-powerful, Vast, Lofty and Infinite.

Gurbani: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: nau nidh naam bhare bhanddaaraa |
English: The Naam is overflowing with the nine treasures.

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਮਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ਦੂਜਾ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aad ant madh prabh soee doojaa lavai na laaee jeeo |3|
English: In the beginning, in the middle, and in the end, there is God. Nothing else even comes close to Him. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa mere deen deaalaa |
English: Take pity on me, O my Lord, Merciful to the meek.

Gurbani: ਜਾਚਿਕੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਸਾਧ ਰਵਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaachik jaachai saadh ravaalaa |
English: I am a beggar, begging for the dust of the feet of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਦੇਹਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਨੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੮॥੪੫॥
Transliteration: dehi daan naanak jan maagai sadaa sadaa har dhiaaee jeeo |4|38|45|
English: Servant Nanak begs for this gift: let me meditate on the Lord, forever and ever. ||4||38||45||

[Ang 107 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਐਥੈ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਆਗੈ ਆਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: aithai toonhai aagai aape |
English: You are here, and You are hereafter.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਥਾਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jantr sabh tere thaape |
English: All beings and creatures were created by You.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਕਰਤੇ ਮੈ ਧਰ ਓਟ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tudh bin avar na koee karate mai dhar ott tumaaree jeeo |1|
English: Without You, there is no other, O Creator. You are my Support and my Protection. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਸਨਾ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: rasanaa jap jap jeevai suaamee |
English: The tongue lives by chanting and meditating on the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham prabh antarajaamee |
English: The Supreme Lord God is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਜੂਐ ਹਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jin seviaa tin hee sukh paaeaa so janam na jooai haaree jeeo |2|
English: Those who serve the Lord find peace; they do not lose their lives in the gamble. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਵਖਧੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: naam avakhadh jin jan terai paaeaa |
English: Your humble servant, who obtains the Medicine of the Naam,

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: janam janam kaa rog gavaaeaa |
English: is rid of the illnesses of countless lifetimes and incarnations.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਫਲ ਏਹਾ ਹੈ ਕਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har keeratan gaavahu din raatee safal ehaa hai kaaree jeeo |3|
English: So sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, day and night. This is the most fruitful occupation. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਅਪਨਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: drisatt dhaar apanaa daas savaariaa |
English: Bestowing His Glance of Grace, He has adorned His slave.

Gurbani: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt antar paarabraham namasakaariaa |
English: Deep within each and every heart, the Supreme Lord is humbly worshipped.

Gurbani: ਇਕਸੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਾਬਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਸਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੯॥੪੬॥
Transliteration: eikas vin hor doojaa naahee baabaa naanak ih mat saaree jeeo |4|39|46|
English: Without the One, there is no other at all. O Baba Nanak, this is the most excellent wisdom. ||4||39||46||

[Ang 108 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: man tan rataa raam piaare |
English: My mind and body are imbued with love for the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬਸੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਅਪਨਾ ਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sarabas deejai apanaa vaare |
English: I sacrifice everything for Him.

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ਬਿਸਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਸਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar govind gun gaaeeai bisar na koee saasaa jeeo |1|
English: Twenty-four hours a day, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe. Do not forget Him, for even one breath. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਸਾਜਨ ਮੀਤੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: soee saajan meet piaaraa |
English: He is a companion, a friend, and a beloved of mine,

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam saadhasang beechaaraa |
English: who reflects upon the Lord's Name, in the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਰੀਜੈ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saadhoo sang tareejai saagar katteeai jam kee faasaa jeeo |2|
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, cross over the world-ocean, and the noose of death shall be cut away. ||2||

Gurbani: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: chaar padaarath har kee sevaa |
English: The four cardinal blessings are obtained by serving the Lord.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਜਾਤੁ ਜਪਿ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: paarajaat jap alakh abhevaa |
English: The Elysian Tree, the source of all blessings, is meditation on the Unseen and Unknowable Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਟੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਆਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh kilabikh gur kaatte pooran hoee aasaa jeeo |3|
English: The Guru has cut out the sinful mistakes of sexual desire and anger, and my hopes have been fulfilled. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਭਾਗ ਭਏ ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: pooran bhaag bhe jis praanee |
English: That mortal who is blessed by perfect destiny meets the Lord,

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਾਰੰਗਪਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang mile saarangapaanee |
English: The Sustainer of the Universe, in the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਗਿਰਸਤ ਉਦਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੪੦॥੪੭॥
Transliteration: naanak naam vasiaa jis antar paravaan girasat udaasaa jeeo |4|40|47|
English: O Nanak, if the Naam, the Name of the Lord, dwells within the mind, one is approved and accepted, whether he is a house-holder or a renunciate. ||4||40||47||

[Ang 108 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: simarat naam ridai sukh paaeaa |
English: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, my heart is filled with peace.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਗਤਂੀ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa bhagatanee pragattaaeaa |
English: By His Grace, His devotees become famous and acclaimed.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਆਲਸ ਰੋਗਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: santasang mil har har japiaa binase aalas rogaa jeeo |1|
English: Joining the Society of the Saints, I chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; the disease of laziness has disappeared. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai grihi nav nidh har bhaaee |
English: O Siblings of Destiny, the nine treasures are found in the Home of the Lord;

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਪੁਰਬ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: tis miliaa jis purab kamaaee |
English: He comes to meet those who deserve it by their past actions.

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਗਲਾ ਜੋਗਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: giaan dhiaan pooran paramesur prabh sabhanaa galaa jogaa jeeo |2|
English: The Perfect Transcendent Lord is spiritual wisdom and meditation. God is All-powerful to do all things. ||2||

Gurbani: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: khin meh thaap uthaapanahaaraa |
English: In an instant, He establishes and disestablishes.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਇਕੰਤੀ ਆਪਿ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aap ikantee aap pasaaraa |
English: He Himself is the One, and He Himself is the Many.

Gurbani: ਲੇਪੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਦਾਤੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਡਿਠੇ ਲਹਨਿ ਵਿਜੋਗਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: lep nahee jagajeevan daate darasan dditthe lehan vijogaa jeeo |3|
English: Filth does not stick to the Giver, the Life of the World. Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, the pain of separation departs. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅੰਚਲਿ ਲਾਇ ਸਭ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਤਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: anchal laae sabh sisatt taraaee |
English: Holding on to the hem of His Robe, the entire Universe is saved.

Gurbani: ਆਪਣਾ ਨਾਉ ਆਪਿ ਜਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aapanaa naau aap japaaee |
English: He Himself causes His Name to be chanted.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਧੁਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੪੧॥੪੮॥
Transliteration: gur bohith paaeaa kirapaa te naanak dhur sanjogaa jeeo |4|41|48|
