English: The Boat of the Guru is found by His Grace; O Nanak, such blessed destiny is pre-ordained. ||4||41||48||

[Ang 108 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: soee karanaa ji aap karaae |
English: People do whatever the Lord inspires them to do.

Gurbani: ਜਿਥੈ ਰਖੈ ਸਾ ਭਲੀ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jithai rakhai saa bhalee jaae |
English: Wherever He keeps us is a good place.

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਸੋ ਪਤਿਵੰਤਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਲਗੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: soee siaanaa so pativantaa hukam lagai jis meetthaa jeeo |1|
English: That person is clever and honorable, unto whom the Hukam of the Lord's Command seems sweet. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਪਰੋਈ ਇਕਤੁ ਧਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: sabh paroee ikat dhaagai |
English: Everything is strung upon the One String of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਲਾਇ ਲਏ ਸੋ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: jis laae le so charanee laagai |
English: Those whom the Lord attaches, are attached to His Feet.

Gurbani: ਊਂਧ ਕਵਲੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਡੀਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aoondh kaval jis hoe pragaasaa tin sarab niranjan ddeetthaa jeeo |2|
English: Those, whose inverted lotus of the crown chakra is illuminated, see the Immaculate Lord everywhere. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਜਾਣਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: teree mahimaa toonhai jaaneh |
English: Only You Yourself know Your Glory.

Gurbani: ਅਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਤੂੰ ਆਪਿ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: apanaa aap toon aap pachhaaneh |
English: You Yourself recognize Your Own Self.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸੰਤਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਪੀਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: hau balihaaree santan tere jin kaam krodh lobh peetthaa jeeo |3|
English: I am a sacrifice to Your Saints, who have crushed their sexual desire, anger and greed. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਸੰਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ॥
Transliteration: toon niravair sant tere niramal |
English: You have no hatred or vengeance; Your Saints are immaculate and pure.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਦੇਖੇ ਸਭ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਕਲਮਲ ॥
Transliteration: jin dekhe sabh utareh kalamal |
English: Seeing them, all sins depart.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਧਿਆਇ ਜੀਵੈ ਬਿਨਸਿਆ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਧੀਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੪੨॥੪੯॥
Transliteration: naanak naam dhiaae dhiaae jeevai binasiaa bhram bhau dheetthaa jeeo |4|42|49|
English: Nanak lives by meditating, meditating on the Naam. His stubborn doubt and fear have departed. ||4||42||49||

[Ang 109 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਂਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maanjh mahalaa 5 |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਝੂਠਾ ਮੰਗਣੁ ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ਮਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: jhootthaa mangan je koee maagai |
English: One who asks for a false gift,

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਮਰਤੇ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: tis kau marate gharree na laagai |
English: shall not take even an instant to die.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜੋ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਕਹਣਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: paarabraham jo sad hee sevai so gur mil nihachal kahanaa |1|
English: But one who continually serves the Supreme Lord God and meets the Guru, is said to be immortal. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: prem bhagat jis kai man laagee |
English: One whose mind is dedicated to loving devotional worship

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਿਤਿ ਜਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: gun gaavai anadin nit jaagee |
English: sings His Glorious Praises night and day, and remains forever awake and aware.

Gurbani: ਬਾਹ ਪਕੜਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਲੈ ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਹਣਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: baah pakarr tis suaamee melai jis kai masatak lahanaa |2|
English: Taking him by the hand, the Lord and Master merges into Himself that person, upon whose forehead such destiny is written. ||2||

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਭਗਤਾਂ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠੇ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal bhagataan man vutthe |
English: His Lotus Feet dwell in the minds of His devotees.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਸਗਲੇ ਮੁਠੇ ॥
Transliteration: vin paramesar sagale mutthe |
English: Without the Transcendent Lord, all are plundered.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾਂ ਕੀ ਧੂੜਿ ਨਿਤ ਬਾਂਛਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚੇ ਕਾ ਗਹਣਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sant janaan kee dhoorr nit baanchheh naam sache kaa gahanaa |3|
English: I long for the dust of the feet of His humble servants. The Name of the True Lord is my decoration. ||3||

Gurbani: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: aootthat baitthat har har gaaeeai |
English: Standing up and sitting down, I sing the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਵਰੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: jis simarat var nihachal paaeeai |
English: Meditating in remembrance on Him, I obtain my Eternal Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਸਹਣਾ ॥੪॥੪੩॥੫੦॥
Transliteration: naanak kau prabh hoe deaalaa teraa keetaa sahanaa |4|43|50|
English: God has become merciful to Nanak. I cheerfully accept Your Will. ||4||43||50||

[Ang 109 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਝ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raag maajh asattapadeea mahalaa 1 ghar 1 |
English: Raag Maajh, Ashtpadheeyaa: First Mehl, First House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਰੰਗਾਏ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਬਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sabad rangaae hukam sabaae |
English: By His Command, all are attuned to the Word of the Shabad,

Gurbani: ਸਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sachee daragah mehal bulaae |
English: and all are called to the Mansion of His Presence, the True Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਚੇ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਸਚੇ ਮਨੁ ਪਤੀਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sache deen deaal mere saahibaa sache man pateeaavaniaa |1|
English: O my True Lord and Master, Merciful to the meek, my mind is pleased and appeased by the Truth. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau vaaree jeeo vaaree sabad suhaavaniaa |
English: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who are adorned with the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: amrit naam sadaa sukhadaataa guramatee man vasaavaniaa |1| rahaau |
English: The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, is forever the Giver of Peace. Through the Guru's Teachings, it dwells in the mind. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਉ ਕਿਸੁ ਕੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: naa ko meraa hau kis keraa |
English: No one is mine, and I am no one else's.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: saachaa tthaakur tribhavan meraa |
English: The True Lord and Master of the three worlds is mine.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਘਣੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਪਛੋਤਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: haumai kar kar jaae ghaneree kar avagan pachhotaavaniaa |2|
English: Acting in egotism, so very many have died. After making mistakes, they later repent and regret. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: hukam pachhaanai su har gun vakhaanai |
English: Those who recognize the Hukam of the Lord's Command chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad naam neesaanai |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they are glorified with the Naam.

Gurbani: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਦਰਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਸਚੈ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sabhanaa kaa dar lekhaa sachai chhoottas naam suhaavaniaa |3|
English: Everyone's account is kept in the True Court, and through the Beauty of the Naam, they are saved. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਭੂਲਾ ਠਉਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh bhoolaa tthaur na paae |
English: The self-willed manmukhs are deluded; they find no place of rest.

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਧਾ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jam dar badhaa chottaa khaae |
English: Bound and gagged at Death's Door, they are brutally beaten.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਸਾਥੀ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: bin naavai ko sang na saathee mukate naam dhiaavaniaa |4|
English: Without the Name, there are no companions or friends. Liberation comes only by meditating on the Naam. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤ ਕੂੜੇ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: saakat koorre sach na bhaavai |
English: The false shaaktas, the faithless cynics, do not like the Truth.

Gurbani: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਬਾਧਾ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: dubidhaa baadhaa aavai jaavai |
English: Bound by duality, they come and go in reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: likhiaa lekh na mettai koee guramukh mukat karaavaniaa |5|
English: No one can erase pre-recorded destiny; the Gurmukhs are liberated. ||5||

Gurbani: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਜਾਤੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: peeearrai pir jaato naahee |
English: In this world of her parents' house, the young bride did not know her Husband.

Gurbani: ਝੂਠਿ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੀ ਰੋਵੈ ਧਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jhootth vichhunee rovai dhaahee |
English: Through falsehood, she has been separated from Him, and she cries out in misery.

Gurbani: ਅਵਗਣਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਅਵਗਣ ਗੁਣਿ ਬਖਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: avagan mutthee mehal na paae avagan gun bakhasaavaniaa |6|
English: Defrauded by demerits, she does not find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. But through virtuous actions, her demerits are forgiven. ||6||

Gurbani: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: peeearrai jin jaataa piaaraa |
English: She, who knows her Beloved in her parents' house,

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh boojhai tat beechaaraa |
English: as Gurmukh, comes to understand the essence of reality; she contemplates her Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣਾ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਏ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: aavan jaanaa tthaak rahaae sachai naam samaavaniaa |7|
English: Her comings and goings cease, and she is absorbed in the True Name. ||7||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh boojhai akath kahaavai |
English: The Gurmukhs understand and describe the Indescribable.

Gurbani: ਸਚੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਾਚੋ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: sache tthaakur saacho bhaavai |
English: True is our Lord and Master; He loves the Truth.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak sach kahai benantee sach milai gun gaavaniaa |8|1|
English: Nanak offers this true prayer: singing His Glorious Praises, I merge with the True One. ||8||1||

[Ang 109 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 ghar 1 |
English: Maajh, Third Mehl, First House:

Gurbani: ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: karam hovai satiguroo milaae |
English: By His Mercy, we meet the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sevaa surat sabad chit laae |
English: Center your awareness on seva-selfless service-and focus your consciousness on the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: haumai maar sadaa sukh paaeaa maaeaa mohu chukaavaniaa |1|
English: Subduing your ego, you shall find a lasting peace, and your emotional attachment to Maya will be dispelled. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau vaaree jeeo vaaree satigur kai balihaaraniaa |
English: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, I am totally devoted to the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਹੋਆ ਜੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: guramatee paragaas hoaa jee anadin har gun gaavaniaa |1| rahaau |
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Divine Light has dawned; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, night and day. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਖੋਜੇ ਤਾ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: tan man khoje taa naau paae |
English: Search your body and mind, and find the Name.

Gurbani: ਧਾਵਤੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: dhaavat raakhai tthaak rahaae |
English: Restrain your wandering mind, and keep it in check.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur kee baanee anadin gaavai sahaje bhagat karaavaniaa |2|
English: Night and day, sing the Songs of the Guru's Bani; worship the Lord with intuitive devotion. ||2||

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਅਸੰਖਾ ॥
Transliteration: eis kaaeaa andar vasat asankhaa |
English: Within this body are countless objects.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਵੇਖਾ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh saach milai taa vekhaa |
English: The Gurmukh attains Truth, and comes to see them.

Gurbani: ਨਉ ਦਰਵਾਜੇ ਦਸਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: nau daravaaje dasavai mukataa anahad sabad vajaavaniaa |3|
English: Beyond the nine gates, the Tenth Gate is found, and liberation is obtained. The Unstruck Melody of the Shabad vibrates. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa saahib sachee naaee |
English: True is the Master, and True is His Name.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee man vasaaee |
English: By Guru's Grace, He comes to dwell within the mind.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: anadin sadaa rahai rang raataa dar sachai sojhee paavaniaa |4|
English: Night and day, remain attuned to the Lord's Love forever, and you shall obtain understanding in the True Court. ||4||

Gurbani: ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: paap pun kee saar na jaanee |
English: Those who do not understand the nature of sin and virtue

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਗੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: doojai laagee bharam bhulaanee |
English: are attached to duality; they wander around deluded.

Gurbani: ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧਾ ਮਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: agiaanee andhaa mag na jaanai fir fir aavan jaavaniaa |5|
English: The ignorant and blind people do not know the way; they come and go in reincarnation over and over again. ||5||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur sevaa te sadaa sukh paaeaa |
English: Serving the Guru, I have found eternal peace;

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: haumai meraa tthaak rahaaeaa |
English: my ego has been silenced and subdued.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸਾਖੀ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਖੁਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: gur saakhee mittiaa andhiaaraa bajar kapaatt khulaavaniaa |6|
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, the darkness has been dispelled, and the heavy doors have been opened. ||6||

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: haumai maar man vasaaeaa |
English: Subduing my ego, I have enshrined the Lord within my mind.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਸਦਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur charanee sadaa chit laaeaa |
English: I focus my consciousness on the Guru's Feet forever.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: gur kirapaa te man tan niramal niramal naam dhiaavaniaa |7|
English: By Guru's Grace, my mind and body are immaculate and pure; I meditate on the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||7||

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਸਭੁ ਤੁਧੈ ਤਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jeevan maranaa sabh tudhai taaee |
English: From birth to death, everything is for You.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: jis bakhase tis de vaddiaaee |
English: You bestow greatness upon those whom You have forgiven.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਦਾ ਤੂੰ ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naam dhiaae sadaa toon jaman maran savaaraniaa |8|1|2|
English: O Nanak, meditating forever on the Naam, you shall be blessed in both birth and death. ||8||1||2||

[Ang 110 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 |
English: Maajh, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: meraa prabh niramal agam apaaraa |
English: My God is Immaculate, Inaccessible and Infinite.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਤਕੜੀ ਤੋਲੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: bin takarree tolai sansaaraa |
English: Without a scale, He weighs the universe.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: guramukh hovai soee boojhai gun keh gunee samaavaniaa |1|
English: One who becomes Gurmukh, understands. Chanting His Glorious Praises, he is absorbed into the Lord of Virtue. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau vaaree jeeo vaaree har kaa naam man vasaavaniaa |
English: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those whose minds are filled with the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਸੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗੇ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo sach laage se anadin jaage dar sachai sobhaa paavaniaa |1| rahaau |
English: Those who are committed to Truth remain awake and aware night and day. They are honored in the True Court. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਸੁਣੈ ਤੈ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: aap sunai tai aape vekhai |
English: He Himself hears, and He Himself sees.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਲੇਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: jis no nadar kare soee jan lekhai |
English: Those, upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace, become acceptable.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਲਾਇ ਲਏ ਸੋ ਲਾਗੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aape laae le so laagai guramukh sach kamaavaniaa |2|
English: They are attached, whom the Lord Himself attaches; as Gurmukh, they live the Truth. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਸੁ ਕਿਥੈ ਹਥੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jis aap bhulaae su kithai hath paae |
English: Those whom the Lord Himself misleads-whose hand can they take?

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਮੇਟਣਾ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: poorab likhiaa su mettanaa na jaae |
English: That which is pre-ordained, cannot be erased.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jin satigur miliaa se vaddabhaagee poorai karam milaavaniaa |3|
English: Those who meet the True Guru are very fortunate and blessed; through perfect karma, He is met. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਧਨ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੁਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: peeearrai dhan anadin sutee |
English: The young bride is fast asleep in her parents' home, night and day.

Gurbani: ਕੰਤਿ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ਅਵਗਣਿ ਮੁਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: kant visaaree avagan mutee |
English: She has forgotten her Husband Lord; because of her faults and demerits, she is abandoned.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਦੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: anadin sadaa firai bilalaadee bin pir need na paavaniaa |4|
English: She wanders around continually, crying out, night and day. Without her Husband Lord, she cannot get any sleep. ||4||

Gurbani: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: peeearrai sukhadaataa jaataa |
English: In this world of her parents' home, she may come to know the Giver of peace,

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: haumai maar gur sabad pachhaataa |
English: if she subdues her ego, and recognizes the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਸਚੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: sej suhaavee sadaa pir raave sach seegaar banaavaniaa |5|
English: Her bed is beautiful; she ravishes and enjoys her Husband Lord forever. She is adorned with the Decorations of Truth. ||5||

Gurbani: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜੀਅ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh jeea upaae |
English: He created the 8.4 million species of beings.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jis no nadar kare tis guroo milaae |
English: Those, upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace, come to meet the Guru.

Gurbani: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟਿ ਸਦਾ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: kilabikh kaatt sadaa jan niramal dar sachai naam suhaavaniaa |6|
English: Shedding their sins, His servants are forever pure; at the True Court, they are beautified by the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||6||

Gurbani: ਲੇਖਾ ਮਾਗੈ ਤਾ ਕਿਨਿ ਦੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: lekhaa maagai taa kin deeai |
English: When they are called to settle their accounts, who will answer then?

Gurbani: ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਫੁਨਿ ਦੂਐ ਤੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: sukh naahee fun dooai teeai |
English: There shall be no peace then, from counting out by twos and threes.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: aape bakhas le prabh saachaa aape bakhas milaavaniaa |7|
English: The True Lord God Himself forgives, and having forgiven, He unites them with Himself. ||7||

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aap kare tai aap karaae |
English: He Himself does, and He Himself causes all to be done.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: poore gur kai sabad milaae |
English: Through the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect Guru, He is met.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak naam milai vaddiaaee aape mel milaavaniaa |8|2|3|
English: O Nanak, through the Naam, greatness is obtained. He Himself unites in His Union. ||8||2||3||

[Ang 111 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 |
English: Maajh, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਇਕੋ ਆਪਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਪਰਛੰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: eiko aap firai parachhanaa |
English: The One Lord Himself moves about imperceptibly.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੇਖਾ ਤਾ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭਿੰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh vekhaa taa ihu man bhinaa |
English: As Gurmukh, I see Him, and then this mind is pleased and uplifted.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਤਜਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਏਕੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: trisanaa taj sehaj sukh paaeaa eko man vasaavaniaa |1|
English: Renouncing desire, I have found intuitive peace and poise; I have enshrined the One within my mind. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਇਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau vaaree jeeo vaaree ikas siau chit laavaniaa |
English: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who focus their consciousness on the One.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਇਕਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਸਚੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: guramatee man ikat ghar aaeaa sachai rang rangaavaniaa |1| rahaau |
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, my mind has come to its only home; it is imbued with the True Color of the Lord's Love. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਭੂਲਾ ਤੈਂ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: eihu jag bhoolaa tain aap bhulaaeaa |
English: This world is deluded; You Yourself have deluded it.

Gurbani: ਇਕੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਲੋਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: eik visaar doojai lobhaaeaa |
English: Forgetting the One, it has become engrossed in duality.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੂਲਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: anadin sadaa firai bhram bhoolaa bin naavai dukh paavaniaa |2|
English: Night and day, it wanders around endlessly, deluded by doubt; without the Name, it suffers in pain. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: jo rang raate karam bidhaate |
English: Those who are attuned to the Love of the Lord, the Architect of Destiny

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਜਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur sevaa te jug chaare jaate |
English: by serving the Guru, they are known throughout the four ages.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jis no aap dee vaddiaaee har kai naam samaavaniaa |3|
English: Those, upon whom the Lord bestows greatness, are absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohi har chetai naahee |
English: Being in love with Maya, they do not think of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਮਪੁਰਿ ਬਧਾ ਦੁਖ ਸਹਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jamapur badhaa dukh sahaahee |
English: Bound and gagged in the City of Death, they suffer in terrible pain.

Gurbani: ਅੰਨਾ ਬੋਲਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਪਾਪਿ ਪਚਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: anaa bolaa kichh nadar na aavai manamukh paap pachaavaniaa |4|
English: Blind and deaf, they see nothing at all; the self-willed manmukhs rot away in sin. ||4||

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: eik rang raate jo tudh aap liv laae |
English: Those, whom You attach to Your Love, are attuned to Your Love.

Gurbani: ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: bhaae bhagat terai man bhaae |
English: Through loving devotional worship, they become pleasing to Your Mind.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸਭ ਇਛਾ ਆਪਿ ਪੁਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: satigur sevan sadaa sukhadaataa sabh ichhaa aap pujaavaniaa |5|
English: They serve the True Guru, the Giver of eternal peace, and all their desires are fulfilled. ||5||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har jeeo teree sadaa saranaaee |
English: O Dear Lord, I seek Your Sanctuary forever.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿਹਿ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: aape bakhasihi de vaddiaaee |
English: You Yourself forgive us, and bless us with Glorious Greatness.

Gurbani: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: jamakaal tis nerr na aavai jo har har naam dhiaavaniaa |6|
English: The Messenger of Death does not draw near those who meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||6||

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੇ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: anadin raate jo har bhaae |
English: Night and day, they are attuned to His Love; they are pleasing to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: merai prabh mele mel milaae |
English: My God merges with them, and unites them in Union.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਸਚੁ ਬੁਝਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa sache teree saranaaee toon aape sach bujhaavaniaa |7|
English: Forever and ever, O True Lord, I seek the Protection of Your Sanctuary; You Yourself inspire us to understand the Truth. ||7||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਸੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: jin sach jaataa se sach samaane |
English: Those who know the Truth are absorbed in Truth.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਾਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: har gun gaaveh sach vakhaane |
English: They sing the Lord's Glorious Praises, and speak the Truth.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੩॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak naam rate bairaagee nij ghar taarree laavaniaa |8|3|4|
English: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam remain unattached and balanced; in the home of the inner self, they are absorbed in the primal trance of deep meditation. ||8||3||4||

[Ang 111 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 |
English: Maajh, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਸੁ ਮੁਆ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: sabad marai su muaa jaapai |
English: One who dies in the Word of the Shabad is truly dead.

Gurbani: ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਚਾਪੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: kaal na chaapai dukh na santaapai |
English: Death does not crush him, and pain does not afflict him.

Gurbani: ਜੋਤੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jotee vich mil jot samaanee sun man sach samaavaniaa |1|
English: His light merges and is absorbed into the Light, when he hears and merges in the Truth. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau vaaree jeeo vaaree har kai naae sobhaa paavaniaa |
English: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to the Lord's Name, which brings us to glory.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਚਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sev sach chit laaeaa guramatee sehaj samaavaniaa |1| rahaau |
English: One who serves the True Guru, and focuses his consciousness on Truth, following the Guru's Teachings, is absorbed in intuitive peace and poise. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਚੀ ਕਚਾ ਚੀਰੁ ਹੰਢਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa kachee kachaa cheer handtaae |
English: This human body is transitory, and transitory are the garments it wears.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਗੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: doojai laagee mehal na paae |
English: Attached to duality, no one attains the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਲਦੀ ਫਿਰੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਬਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: anadin jaladee firai din raatee bin pir bahu dukh paavaniaa |2|
English: Night and day, day and night, they burn. Without her Husband Lord, the soul-bride suffers in terrible pain. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦੇਹੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਆਗੈ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: dehee jaat na aagai jaae |
English: Her body and her status shall not go with her to the world hereafter.

Gurbani: ਜਿਥੈ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਤਿਥੈ ਛੁਟੈ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jithai lekhaa mangeeai tithai chhuttai sach kamaae |
English: Where she is called to answer for her account, there, she shall be emancipated only by true actions.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸੇ ਧਨਵੰਤੇ ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: satigur sevan se dhanavante aithai othai naam samaavaniaa |3|
English: Those who serve the True Guru shall prosper; here and hereafter, they are absorbed in the Naam. ||3||

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: bhai bhaae seegaar banaae |
English: She who adorns herself with the Love and the Fear of God,

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee mehal ghar paae |
English: by Guru's Grace, obtains the Mansion of the Lord's Presence as her home.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਜੀਠੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਬਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: anadin sadaa ravai din raatee majeetthai rang banaavaniaa |4|
English: Night and day, day and night, she constantly ravishes and enjoys her Beloved. She is dyed in the permanent color of His Love. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਭਨਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਵਸੈ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: sabhanaa pir vasai sadaa naale |
English: The Husband Lord abides with everyone, always;

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee ko nadar nihaale |
English: but how rare are those few who, by Guru's Grace, obtain His Glance of Grace.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਤਿ ਊਚੋ ਊਚਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: meraa prabh at aoocho aoochaa kar kirapaa aap milaavaniaa |5|
English: My God is the Highest of the High; granting His Grace, He merges us into Himself. ||5||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਸੁਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohi ihu jag sutaa |
English: This world is asleep in emotional attachment to Maya.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਵਿਗੁਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: naam visaar ant vigutaa |
English: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, it ultimately comes to ruin.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਸੁਤਾ ਸੋ ਜਾਗਾਏ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: jis te sutaa so jaagaae guramat sojhee paavaniaa |6|
English: The One who put it to sleep shall also awaken it. Through the Guru's Teachings, understanding dawns. ||6||

Gurbani: ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀਐ ਸੋ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: apiau peeai so bharam gavaae |
English: One who drinks in this Nectar, shall have his delusions dispelled.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaad mukat gat paae |
English: By Guru's Grace, the state of liberation is attained.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤੀ ਰਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਆਪੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: bhagatee rataa sadaa bairaagee aap maar milaavaniaa |7|
English: One who is imbued with devotion to the Lord, remains always balanced and detached. Subduing selfishness and conceit, he is united with the Lord. ||7||

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aap upaae dhandhai laae |
English: He Himself creates, and He Himself assigns us to our tasks.

Gurbani: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਆਪਿ ਅਪੜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: lakh chauraasee rijak aap aparraae |
English: He Himself gives sustenance to the 8.4 million species of beings.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੪॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak naam dhiaae sach raate jo tis bhaavai su kaar karaavaniaa |8|4|5|
English: O Nanak, those who meditate on the Naam are atuned to Truth. They do that which is pleasing to His Will. ||8||4||5||

[Ang 112 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 |
English: Maajh, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹੀਰਾ ਲਾਲੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: andar heeraa laal banaaeaa |
English: Diamonds and rubies are produced deep within the self.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਰਖਿ ਪਰਖਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad parakh parakhaaeaa |
English: They are assayed and valued through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਸਚੁ ਪਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਸਵਟੀ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jin sach palai sach vakhaaneh sach kasavattee laavaniaa |1|
English: Those who have gathered Truth, speak Truth; they apply the Touch-stone of Truth. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau vaaree jeeo vaaree gur kee baanee man vasaavaniaa |
English: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Word of the Guru's Bani within their minds.

Gurbani: ਅੰਜਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: anjan maeh niranjan paaeaa jotee jot milaavaniaa |1| rahaau |
English: In the midst of the darkness of the world, they obtain the Immaculate One, and their light merges into the Light. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: eis kaaeaa andar bahut pasaaraa |
English: Within this body are countless vast vistas;

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਅਤਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: naam niranjan at agam apaaraa |
English: the Immaculate Naam is totally Inaccessible and Infinite.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: guramukh hovai soee paae aape bakhas milaavaniaa |2|
English: He alone becomes Gurmukh and obtains it, whom the Lord forgives, and unites with Himself. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: meraa tthaakur sach drirraae |
English: My Lord and Master implants the Truth.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਚਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee sach chit laae |
English: By Guru's Grace, one's consciousness is attached to the Truth.

Gurbani: ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sacho sach varatai sabhanee thaaee sache sach samaavaniaa |3|
English: The Truest of the True is pervading everywhere; the true ones merge in Truth. ||3||

Gurbani: ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: veparavaahu sach meraa piaaraa |
English: The True Carefree Lord is my Beloved.

Gurbani: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਅਵਗਣ ਕਾਟਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kilavikh avagan kaattanahaaraa |
English: He cuts out our sinful mistakes and evil actions;

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: prem preet sadaa dhiaaeeai bhai bhaae bhagat drirraavaniaa |4|
English: with love and affection, meditate forever on Him. He implants the Fear of God and loving devotional worship within us. ||4||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਚੀ ਜੇ ਸਚੇ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: teree bhagat sachee je sache bhaavai |
English: Devotional worship is True, if it pleases the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: aape dee na pachhotaavai |
English: He Himself bestows it; He does not regret it later.

Gurbani: ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਏਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਬਦੇ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: sabhanaa jeea kaa eko daataa sabade maar jeevaavaniaa |5|
English: He alone is the Giver of all beings. The Lord kills with the Word of His Shabad, and then revives. ||5||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਮੈ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: har tudh baajhahu mai koee naahee |
English: Other than You, Lord, nothing is mine.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਤੁਧੈ ਸੇਵੀ ਤੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: har tudhai sevee tai tudh saalaahee |
English: I serve You, Lord, and I praise You.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਚੇ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਤੂੰ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: aape mel laihu prabh saache poorai karam toon paavaniaa |6|
English: You unite me with Yourself, O True God. Through perfect good karma You are obtained. ||6||

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਤੁਧੈ ਜੇਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: mai hor na koee tudhai jehaa |
English: For me, there is no other like You.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੀ ਨਦਰੀ ਸੀਝਸਿ ਦੇਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: teree nadaree seejhas dehaa |
English: By Your Glance of Grace, my body is blessed and sanctified.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: anadin saar samaal har raakheh guramukh sehaj samaavaniaa |7|
English: Night and day, the Lord takes care of us and protects us. The Gurmukhs are absorbed in intuitive peace and poise. ||7||

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਮੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: tudh jevadd mai hor na koee |
English: For me, there is no other as Great as You.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਿਰਜੀ ਆਪੇ ਗੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: tudh aape sirajee aape goee |
English: You Yourself create, and You Yourself destroy.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਘੜਿ ਭੰਨਿ ਸਵਾਰਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੫॥੬॥
Transliteration: toon aape hee gharr bhan savaareh naanak naam suhaavaniaa |8|5|6|
English: You Yourself create, destroy and adorn. O Nanak, we are adorned and embellished with the Naam. ||8||5||6||

[Ang 113 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 |
English: Maajh, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਘਟ ਆਪੇ ਭੋਗਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabh ghatt aape bhoganahaaraa |
English: He is the Enjoyer of all hearts.

Gurbani: ਅਲਖੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: alakh varatai agam apaaraa |
English: The Invisible, Inaccessible and Infinite is pervading everywhere.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad meraa har prabh dhiaaeeai sahaje sach samaavaniaa |1|
English: Meditating on my Lord God, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I am intuitively absorbed in the Truth. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau vaaree jeeo vaaree gurasabad man vasaavaniaa |
English: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who implant the Word of the Guru's Shabad in their minds.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਤਾ ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਲੂਝੈ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sabad soojhai taa man siau loojhai manasaa maar samaavaniaa |1| rahaau |
English: When someone understands the Shabad, then he wrestles with his own mind; subduing his desires, he merges with the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਮੁਹਹਿ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: panch doot muheh sansaaraa |
English: The five enemies are plundering the world.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧੇ ਸੁਧਿ ਨ ਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh andhe sudh na saaraa |
English: The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not understand or appreciate this.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਘਰੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਚਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: guramukh hovai su apanaa ghar raakhai panch doot sabad pachaavaniaa |2|
English: Those who become Gurmukh-their houses are protected. The five enemies are destroyed by the Shabad. ||2||

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: eik guramukh sadaa sachai rang raate |
English: The Gurmukhs are forever imbued with love for the True One.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਮਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: sahaje prabh seveh anadin maate |
English: They serve God with intuitive ease. Night and day, they are intoxicated with His Love.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: mil preetam sache gun gaaveh har dar sobhaa paavaniaa |3|
English: Meeting with their Beloved, they sing the Glorious Praises of the True one; they are honored in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਏਕਮ ਏਕੈ ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: ekam ekai aap upaaeaa |
English: First, the One created Himself;

Gurbani: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: dubidhaa doojaa tribidh maaeaa |
English: second, the sense of duality; third, the three-phased Maya.

Gurbani: ਚਉਥੀ ਪਉੜੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਊਚੀ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: chauthee paurree guramukh aoochee sacho sach kamaavaniaa |4|
English: The fourth state, the highest, is obtained by the Gurmukh, who practices Truth, and only Truth. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਹੈ ਸਚਾ ਜੇ ਸਚੇ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: sabh hai sachaa je sache bhaavai |
English: Everything which is pleasing to the True Lord is true.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jin sach jaataa so sehaj samaavai |
English: Those who know the Truth merge in intuitive peace and poise.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਚੇ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: guramukh karanee sache seveh saache jaae samaavaniaa |5|
English: The life-style of the Gurmukh is to serve the True Lord. He goes and blends with the True Lord. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸਚੇ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਕੋ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਆ ॥
Transliteration: sache baajhahu ko avar na dooaa |
English: Without the True One, there is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਗਿ ਜਗੁ ਖਪਿ ਖਪਿ ਮੂਆ ॥
Transliteration: doojai laag jag khap khap mooaa |
English: Attached to duality, the world is distracted and distressed to death.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਏਕੋ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: guramukh hovai su eko jaanai eko sev sukh paavaniaa |6|
English: One who becomes Gurmukh knows only the One. Serving the One, peace is obtained. ||6||

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jant sabh saran tumaaree |
English: All beings and creatures are in the Protection of Your Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਧਰਿ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਕਚੀ ਪਕੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: aape dhar dekheh kachee pakee saaree |
English: You place the chessmen on the board; You see the imperfect and the perfect as well.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: anadin aape kaar karaae aape mel milaavaniaa |7|
English: Night and day, You cause people to act; You unite them in Union with Yourself. ||7||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: toon aape meleh vekheh hadoor |
English: You Yourself unite, and You see Yourself close at hand.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: sabh meh aap rahiaa bharapoor |
English: You Yourself are totally pervading amongst all.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੬॥੭॥
Transliteration: naanak aape aap varatai guramukh sojhee paavaniaa |8|6|7|
English: O Nanak, God Himself is pervading and permeating everywhere; only the Gurmukhs understand this. ||8||6||7||

[Ang 113 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 |
English: Maajh, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮੀਠੀ ॥
Transliteration: amrit baanee gur kee meetthee |
English: The Nectar of the Guru's Bani is very sweet.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਚਖਿ ਡੀਠੀ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh viralai kinai chakh ddeetthee |
English: Rare are the Gurmukhs who see and taste it.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: antar paragaas mahaa ras peevai dar sachai sabad vajaavaniaa |1|
English: The Divine Light dawns within, and the supreme essence is found. In the True Court, the Word of the Shabad vibrates. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau vaaree jeeo vaaree gur charanee chit laavaniaa |
English: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who focus their consciousness on the Guru's Feet.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਮਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur hai amrit sar saachaa man naavai mail chukaavaniaa |1| rahaau |
English: The True Guru is the True Pool of Nectar; bathing in it, the mind is washed clean of all filth. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਸਚੇ ਕਿਨੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: teraa sache kinai ant na paaeaa |
English: Your limits, O True Lord, are not known to anyone.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaad kinai viralai chit laaeaa |
English: Rare are those who, by Guru's Grace, focus their consciousness on You.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਨ ਰਜਾ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਭੁਖ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tudh saalaeh na rajaa kabahoon sache naavai kee bhukh laavaniaa |2|
English: Praising You, I am never satisfied; such is the hunger I feel for the True Name. ||2||

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਵੇਖਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਬੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: eko vekhaa avar na beea |
English: I see only the One, and no other.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee amrit peea |
English: By Guru's Grace, I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਿਖਾ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੂਖਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad tikhaa nivaaree sahaje sookh samaavaniaa |3|
English: My thirst is quenched by the Word of the Guru's Shabad; I am absorbed in intuitive peace and poise. ||3||

Gurbani: ਰਤਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਲਰਿ ਤਿਆਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: ratan padaarath palar tiaagai |
English: The Priceless Jewel is discarded like straw;

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅੰਧਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh andhaa doojai bhaae laagai |
English: the blind self-willed manmukhs are attached to the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jo beejai soee fal paae supanai sukh na paavaniaa |4|
English: As they plant, so do they harvest. They shall not obtain peace, even in their dreams. ||4||

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: apanee kirapaa kare soee jan paae |
English: Those who are blessed with His Mercy find the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa sabad man vasaae |
English: The Word of the Guru's Shabad abides in the mind.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਭੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਭੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: anadin sadaa rahai bhai andar bhai maar bharam chukaavaniaa |5|
English: Night and day, they remain in the Fear of God; conquering their fears, their doubts are dispelled. ||5||

Gurbani: ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bharam chukaaeaa sadaa sukh paaeaa |
English: Dispelling their doubts, they find a lasting peace.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaad param pad paaeaa |
English: By Guru's Grace, the supreme status is attained.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਹਜੇ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: antar niramal niramal baanee har gun sahaje gaavaniaa |6|
English: Deep within, they are pure, and their words are pure as well; intuitively, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||6||

Gurbani: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਬੇਦ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: simrit saasat bed vakhaanai |
English: They recite the Simritees, the Shaastras and the Vedas,

Gurbani: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: bharame bhoolaa tat na jaanai |
English: but deluded by doubt, they do not understand the essence of reality.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਦੁਖੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: bin satigur seve sukh na paae dukho dukh kamaavaniaa |7|
English: Without serving the True Guru, they find no peace; they earn only pain and misery. ||7||

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aap kare kis aakhai koee |
English: The Lord Himself acts; unto whom should we complain?

Gurbani: ਆਖਣਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਜੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aakhan jaaeeai je bhoolaa hoee |
English: How can anyone complain that the Lord has made a mistake?

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੭॥੮॥
Transliteration: naanak aape kare karaae naame naam samaavaniaa |8|7|8|
English: O Nanak, the Lord Himself does, and causes things to be done; chanting the Naam, we are absorbed in the Naam. ||8||7||8||

[Ang 114 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 |
English: Maajh, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਰੰਗੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aape range sehaj subhaae |
English: He Himself imbues us with His Love, with effortless ease.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad har rang charraae |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, we are dyed in the color of the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਰਸਨਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੀ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: man tan rataa rasanaa rang chaloolee bhai bhaae rang charraavaniaa |1|
English: This mind and body are so imbued, and this tongue is dyed in the deep crimson color of the poppy. Through the Love and the Fear of God, we are dyed in this color. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau vaaree jeeo vaaree nirbhau man vasaavaniaa |
English: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Fearless Lord within their minds.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur kirapaa te har nirbhau dhiaaeaa bikh bhaujal sabad taraavaniaa |1| rahaau |
English: By Guru's Grace, I meditate on the Fearless Lord; the Shabad has carried me across the poisonous world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਕਰਹਿ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh mugadh kareh chaturaaee |
English: The idiotic self-willed manmukhs try to be clever,

Gurbani: ਨਾਤਾ ਧੋਤਾ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: naataa dhotaa thaae na paaee |
English: but in spite of their bathing and washing, they shall not be acceptable.

Gurbani: ਜੇਹਾ ਆਇਆ ਤੇਹਾ ਜਾਸੀ ਕਰਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਪਛੋਤਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jehaa aaeaa tehaa jaasee kar avagan pachhotaavaniaa |2|
English: As they came, so shall they go, regretting the mistakes they made. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧੇ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh andhe kichhoo na soojhai |
English: The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not understand anything;

Gurbani: ਮਰਣੁ ਲਿਖਾਇ ਆਏ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
Transliteration: maran likhaae aae nahee boojhai |
English: death was pre-ordained for them when they came into the world, but they do not understand.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: manamukh karam kare nahee paae bin naavai janam gavaavaniaa |3|
English: The self-willed manmukhs may practice religious rituals, but they do not obtain the Name; without the Name, they lose this life in vain. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sach karanee sabad hai saar |
English: The practice of Truth is the essence of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: poorai gur paaeeai mokh duaar |
English: Through the Perfect Guru, the gate of salvation is found.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: anadin baanee sabad sunaae sach raate rang rangaavaniaa |4|
English: So, night and day, listen to the Word of the Guru's Bani, and the Shabad. Let yourself be colored by this love. ||4||

Gurbani: ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: rasanaa har ras raatee rang laae |
English: The tongue, imbued with the Lord's Essence, delights in His Love.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: man tan mohiaa sehaj subhaae |
English: My mind and body are enticed by the Lord's Sublime Love.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: sahaje preetam piaaraa paaeaa sahaje sehaj milaavaniaa |5|
English: I have easily obtained my Darling Beloved; I am intuitively absorbed in celestial peace. ||5||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਸੋਈ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jis andar rang soee gun gaavai |
English: Those who have the Lord's Love within, sing His Glorious Praises;

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad sahaje sukh samaavai |
English: through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they are intuitively absorbed in celestial peace.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਦਾ ਤਿਨ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: hau balihaaree sadaa tin vittahu gur sevaa chit laavaniaa |6|
English: I am forever a sacrifice to those who dedicate their consciousness to the Guru's Service. ||6||

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਸਚੋ ਸਚਿ ਪਤੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa sacho sach pateejai |
English: The True Lord is pleased with Truth, and only Truth.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਅੰਦਰੁ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee andar bheejai |
English: By Guru's Grace, one's inner being is deeply imbued with His Love.

Gurbani: ਬੈਸਿ ਸੁਥਾਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਮਨਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: bais suthaan har gun gaaveh aape kar sat manaavaniaa |7|
English: Sitting in that blessed place, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, who Himself inspires us to accept His Truth. ||7||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jis no nadar kare so paae |
English: That one, upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, obtains it.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee haumai jaae |
English: By Guru's Grace, egotism departs.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੮॥੯॥
Transliteration: naanak naam vasai man antar dar sachai sobhaa paavaniaa |8|8|9|
English: O Nanak, that one, within whose mind the Name dwells, is honored in the True Court. ||8||8||9||

[Ang 114 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 |
English: Maajh Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur seviai vaddee vaddiaaee |
English: Serving the True Guru is the greatest greatness.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: har jee achint vasai man aaee |
English: The Dear Lord automatically comes to dwell in the mind.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਫਲਿਓ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੀਤਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਿਖਾ ਲਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har jeeo safalio birakh hai amrit jin peetaa tis tikhaa lahaavaniaa |1|
English: The Dear Lord is the fruit-bearing tree; drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar, thirst is quenched. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau vaaree jeeo vaaree sach sangat mel milaavaniaa |
English: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to the one who leads me to join the True Congregation.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har satasangat aape melai gurasabadee har gun gaavaniaa |1| rahaau |
English: The Lord Himself unites me with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sevee sabad suhaaeaa |
English: I serve the True Guru; the Word of His Shabad is beautiful.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jin har kaa naam man vasaaeaa |
English: Through it, the Name of the Lord comes to dwell within the mind.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har niramal haumai mail gavaae dar sachai sobhaa paavaniaa |2|
English: The Pure Lord removes the filth of egotism, and we are honored in the True Court. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin gur naam na paaeaa jaae |
English: Without the Guru, the Naam cannot be obtained.

Gurbani: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਰਹੇ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sidh saadhik rahe bilalaae |
English: The Siddhas and the seekers lack it; they weep and wail.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bin gur seve sukh na hovee poorai bhaag gur paavaniaa |3|
English: Without serving the True Guru, peace is not obtained; through perfect destiny, the Guru is found. ||3||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਆਰਸੀ ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੇਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: eihu man aarasee koee guramukh vekhai |
English: This mind is a mirror; how rare are those who, as Gurmukh, see themselves in it.

Gurbani: ਮੋਰਚਾ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਜਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਸੋਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: morachaa na laagai jaa haumai sokhai |
English: Rust does not stick to those who burn their ego.

Gurbani: ਅਨਹਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਏ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: anahat baanee niramal sabad vajaae gurasabadee sach samaavaniaa |4|
English: The Unstruck Melody of the Bani resounds through the Pure Word of the Shabad; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, we are absorbed into the True One. ||4||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਿਹੁ ਨ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin satigur kihu na dekhiaa jaae |
English: Without the True Guru, the Lord cannot be seen.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਆਪੁ ਦਿਤਾ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur kirapaa kar aap ditaa dikhaae |
English: Granting His Grace, He Himself has allowed me to see Him.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: aape aap aap mil rahiaa sahaje sehaj samaavaniaa |5|
English: All by Himself, He Himself is permeating and pervading; He is intuitively absorbed in celestial peace. ||5||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਇਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh hovai su ikas siau liv laae |
English: One who becomes Gurmukh embraces love for the One.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: doojaa bharam gur sabad jalaae |
English: Doubt and duality are burned away by the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa andar vanaj kare vaapaaraa naam nidhaan sach paavaniaa |6|
English: Within his body, he deals and trades, and obtains the Treasure of the True Name. ||6||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh karanee har keerat saar |
English: The life-style of the Gurmukh is sublime; he sings the Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh paae mokh duaar |
English: The Gurmukh finds the gate of salvation.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: anadin rang rataa gun gaavai andar mehal bulaavaniaa |7|
English: Night and day, he is imbued with the Lord's Love. He sings the Lord's Glorious Praises, and he is called to the Mansion of His Presence. ||7||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: satigur daataa milai milaaeaa |
English: The True Guru, the Giver, is met when the Lord leads us to meet Him.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਮਨਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: poorai bhaag man sabad vasaaeaa |
English: Through perfect destiny, the Shabad is enshrined in the mind.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੯॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: naanak naam milai vaddiaaee har sache ke gun gaavaniaa |8|9|10|
English: O Nanak, the greatness of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is obtained by chanting the Glorious Praises of the True Lord. ||8||9||10||

[Ang 115 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 |
English: Maajh, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਵੰਞਾਏ ਤਾ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aap vanyaae taa sabh kichh paae |
English: Those who lose their own selves obtain everything.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਚੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gurasabadee sachee liv laae |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they enshrine Love for the True one.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਘਰਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sach vananjeh sach sanghareh sach vaapaar karaavaniaa |1|
English: They trade in Truth, they gather in Truth, and they deal only in Truth. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau vaaree jeeo vaaree har gun anadin gaavaniaa |
English: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, night and day.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hau teraa toon tthaakur meraa sabad vaddiaaee devaniaa |1| rahaau |
English: I am Yours, You are my Lord and Master. You bestow greatness through the Word of Your Shabad. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਵੇਲਾ ਵਖਤ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: velaa vakhat sabh suhaaeaa |
English: That time, that moment is totally beautiful,

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਸਚਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jit sachaa mere man bhaaeaa |
English: when the True One becomes pleasing to my mind.

Gurbani: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸਚੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sache seviai sach vaddiaaee gur kirapaa te sach paavaniaa |2|
English: Serving the True One, true greatness is obtained. By Guru's Grace, the True One is obtained. ||2||

Gurbani: ਭਾਉ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: bhaau bhojan satigur tutthai paae |
English: The food of spiritual love is obtained when the True Guru is pleased.

Gurbani: ਅਨ ਰਸੁ ਚੂਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: an ras chookai har ras man vasaae |
English: Other essences are forgotten, when the Lord's Essence comes to dwell in the mind.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sach santokh sehaj sukh baanee poore gur te paavaniaa |3|
English: Truth, contentment and intuitive peace and poise are obtained from the Bani, the Word of the Perfect Guru. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਅੰਧ ਗਵਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: satigur na seveh moorakh andh gavaaraa |
English: The blind and ignorant fools do not serve the True Guru;

Gurbani: ਫਿਰਿ ਓਇ ਕਿਥਹੁ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: fir oe kithahu paaein mokh duaaraa |
English: how will they find the gate of salvation?

Gurbani: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: mar mar jameh fir fir aaveh jam dar chottaa khaavaniaa |4|
English: They die and die, over and over again, only to be reborn, over and over again. They are struck down at Death's Door. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੈ ਸਾਦੁ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਤਾ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: sabadai saad jaaneh taa aap pachhaaneh |
English: Those who know the essence of the Shabad, understand their own selves.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: niramal baanee sabad vakhaaneh |
English: Immaculate is the speech of those who chant the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: sache sev sadaa sukh paaein nau nidh naam man vasaavaniaa |5|
English: Serving the True One, they find a lasting peace; they enshrine the nine treasures of the Naam within their minds. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: so thaan suhaaeaa jo har man bhaaeaa |
English: Beautiful is that place, which is pleasing to the Lord's Mind.

Gurbani: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: satasangat beh har gun gaaeaa |
English: There, sitting in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, the Glorious Praises of the Lord are sung.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹਹਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਦੁ ਵਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: anadin har saalaaheh saachaa niramal naad vajaavaniaa |6|
English: Night and day, the True One is praised; the Immaculate Sound-current of the Naad resounds there. ||6||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਖੋਟੀ ਰਾਸਿ ਖੋਟਾ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh khottee raas khottaa paasaaraa |
English: The wealth of the self-willed manmukhs is false, and false is their ostentatious display.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਨਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਭਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: koorr kamaavan dukh laagai bhaaraa |
English: They practice falsehood, and suffer terrible pain.

Gurbani: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲੇ ਫਿਰਨਿ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: bharame bhoole firan din raatee mar janameh janam gavaavaniaa |7|
English: Deluded by doubt, they wander day and night; through birth and death, they lose their lives. ||7||

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੈ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa saahib mai at piaaraa |
English: My True Lord and Master is very dear to me.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: poore gur kai sabad adhaaraa |
English: The Shabad of the Perfect Guru is my Support.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੦॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: naanak naam milai vaddiaaee dukh sukh sam kar jaananiaa |8|10|11|
English: O Nanak, one who obtains the Greatness of the Naam, looks upon pain and pleasure as one and the same. ||8||10||11||

[Ang 116 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 |
English: Maajh, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੀਆ ਖਾਣੀ ਤੇਰੀਆ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: tereea khaanee tereea baanee |
English: The four sources of creation are Yours; the spoken word is Yours.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: bin naavai sabh bharam bhulaanee |
English: Without the Name, all are deluded by doubt.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur sevaa te har naam paaeaa bin satigur koe na paavaniaa |1|
English: Serving the Guru, the Lord's Name is obtained. Without the True Guru, no one can receive it. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau vaaree jeeo vaaree har setee chit laavaniaa |
English: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who focus their consciousness on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਹਜੇ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har sachaa gur bhagatee paaeeai sahaje man vasaavaniaa |1| rahaau |
English: Through devotion to the Guru, the True One is found; He comes to abide in the mind, with intuitive ease. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਾ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: satigur seve taa sabh kichh paae |
English: Serving the True Guru, all things are obtained.

Gurbani: ਜੇਹੀ ਮਨਸਾ ਕਰਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਤੇਹਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jehee manasaa kar laagai tehaa fal paae |
English: As are the desires one harbors, so are the rewards one receives.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭਨਾ ਵਥੂ ਕਾ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: satigur daataa sabhanaa vathoo kaa poorai bhaag milaavaniaa |2|
English: The True Guru is the Giver of all things; through perfect destiny, He is met. ||2||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਇਕੁ ਨ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: eihu man mailaa ik na dhiaae |
English: This mind is filthy and polluted; it does not meditate on the One.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ ਬਹੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: antar mail laagee bahu doojai bhaae |
English: Deep within, it is soiled and stained by the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਤਟਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਦਿਸੰਤਰਿ ਭਵੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ਹੋਰੁ ਵਧੇਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tatt teerath disantar bhavai ahankaaree hor vadherai haumai mal laavaniaa |3|
English: The egotists may go on pilgrimages to holy rivers, sacred shrines and foreign lands, but they only gather more of the dirt of egotism. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਾ ਮਲੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: satigur seve taa mal jaae |
English: Serving the True Guru, filth and pollution are removed.

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jeevat marai har siau chit laae |
English: Those who focus their consciousness on the Lord remain dead while yet alive.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਚੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਚਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: har niramal sach mail na laagai sach laagai mail gavaavaniaa |4|
English: The True Lord is Pure; no filth sticks to Him. Those who are attached to the True One have their filth washed away. ||4||

Gurbani: ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਅੰਧ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: baajh guroo hai andh gubaaraa |
English: Without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness.

Gurbani: ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧਾ ਅੰਧੁ ਅੰਧਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: agiaanee andhaa andh andhaaraa |
English: The ignorant ones are blind-there is only utter darkness for them.

Gurbani: ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕੇ ਕੀੜੇ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਪਚਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: bisattaa ke keerre bisattaa kamaaveh fir bisattaa maeh pachaavaniaa |5|
English: The maggots in manure do filthy deeds, and in filth they rot and putrefy. ||5||

Gurbani: ਮੁਕਤੇ ਸੇਵੇ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: mukate seve mukataa hovai |
English: Serving the Lord of Liberation, liberation is achieved.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਸਬਦੇ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: haumai mamataa sabade khovai |
English: The Word of the Shabad eradicates egotism and possessiveness.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਚਾ ਸੇਵੀ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: anadin har jeeo sachaa sevee poorai bhaag gur paavaniaa |6|
English: So serve the Dear True Lord, night and day. By perfect good destiny, the Guru is found. ||6||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aape bakhase mel milaae |
English: He Himself forgives and unites in His Union.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: poore gur te naam nidh paae |
English: From the Perfect Guru, the Treasure of the Naam is obtained.

Gurbani: ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: sachai naam sadaa man sachaa sach seve dukh gavaavaniaa |7|
English: By the True Name, the mind is made true forever. Serving the True Lord, sorrow is driven out. ||7||

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa hajoor door na jaanahu |
English: He is always close at hand-do not think that He is far away.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਛਾਣਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: gurasabadee har antar pachhaanahu |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, recognize the Lord deep within your own being.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੧॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naam milai vaddiaaee poore gur te paavaniaa |8|11|12|
English: O Nanak, through the Naam, glorious greatness is received. Through the Perfect Guru, the Naam is obtained. ||8||11||12||

[Ang 116 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 |
English: Maajh, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਐਥੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਸਾਚੇ ॥
Transliteration: aithai saache su aagai saache |
English: Those who are True here, are True hereafter as well.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਾਚੇ ॥
Transliteration: man sachaa sachai sabad raache |
English: That mind is true, which is attuned to the True Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sachaa seveh sach kamaaveh sacho sach kamaavaniaa |1|
English: They serve the True One, and practice Truth; they earn Truth, and only Truth. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau vaaree jeeo vaaree sachaa naam man vasaavaniaa |
English: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those whose minds are filled with the True Name.

Gurbani: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sache seveh sach samaaveh sache ke gun gaavaniaa |1| rahaau |
English: They serve the True One, and are absorbed into the True One, singing the Glorious Praises of the True One. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਹਿ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: panddit parreh saad na paaveh |
English: The Pandits, the religious scholars read, but they do not taste the essence.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਭਰਮਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: doojai bhaae maaeaa man bharamaaveh |
English: In love with duality and Maya, their minds wander, unfocused.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਭ ਸੁਧਿ ਗਵਾਈ ਕਰਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਪਛੋਤਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohi sabh sudh gavaaee kar avagan pachhotaavaniaa |2|
English: The love of Maya has displaced all their understanding; making mistakes, they live in regret. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਤਤੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: satigur milai taa tat paae |
English: But if they should meet the True Guru, then they obtain the essence of reality;

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam man vasaae |
English: the Name of the Lord comes to dwell in their minds.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੈ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਮੁਕਤੀ ਕਾ ਦਰੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sabad marai man maarai apunaa mukatee kaa dar paavaniaa |3|
English: Those who die in the Shabad and subdue their own minds, obtain the door of liberation. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਾਟੈ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kilavikh kaattai krodh nivaare |
English: They erase their sins, and eliminate their anger;

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਖੈ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa sabad rakhai ur dhaare |
English: they keep the Guru's Shabad clasped tightly to their hearts.

Gurbani: ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: sach rate sadaa bairaagee haumai maar milaavaniaa |4|
English: Those who are attuned to Truth, remain balanced and detached forever. Subduing their egotism, they are united with the Lord. ||4||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: antar ratan milai milaaeaa |
English: Deep within the nucleus of the self is the jewel; we receive it only if the Lord inspires us to receive it.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਮਨਸਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tribidh manasaa tribidh maaeaa |
English: The mind is bound by the three dispositions-the three modes of Maya.

Gurbani: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮੋਨੀ ਥਕੇ ਚਉਥੇ ਪਦ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: parr parr panddit monee thake chauthe pad kee saar na paavaniaa |5|
English: Reading and reciting, the Pandits, the religious scholars, and the silent sages have grown weary, but they have not found the supreme essence of the fourth state. ||5||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਰੰਗੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aape range rang charraae |
English: The Lord Himself dyes us in the color of His Love.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਰਾਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਰੰਗਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: se jan raate gur sabad rangaae |
English: Only those who are steeped in the Word of the Guru's Shabad are so imbued with His Love.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਿਆ ਅਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: har rang charriaa at apaaraa har ras ras gun gaavaniaa |6|
English: Imbued with the most beautiful color of the Lord's Love, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, with great pleasure and joy. ||6||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh ridh sidh sach sanjam soee |
English: To the Gurmukh, the True Lord is wealth, miraculous spiritual powers and strict self-discipline.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh giaan naam mukat hoee |
English: Through the spiritual wisdom of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the Gurmukh is liberated.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: guramukh kaar sach kamaaveh sache sach samaavaniaa |7|
English: The Gurmukh practices Truth, and is absorbed in the Truest of the True. ||7||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਥਾਪੇ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh thaape thaap uthaape |
English: The Gurmukh realizes that the Lord alone creates, and having created, He destroys.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh jaat pat sabh aape |
English: To the Gurmukh, the Lord Himself is social class, status and all honor.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੨॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh naam dhiaae naame naam samaavaniaa |8|12|13|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs meditate on the Naam; through the Naam, they merge in the Naam. ||8||12||13||

[Ang 117 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 |
English: Maajh, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਉਤਪਤਿ ਪਰਲਉ ਸਬਦੇ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: autapat parlau sabade hovai |
English: Creation and destruction happen through the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੇ ਹੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਓਪਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: sabade hee fir opat hovai |
English: Through the Shabad, creation happens again.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਚਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: guramukh varatai sabh aape sachaa guramukh upaae samaavaniaa |1|
English: The Gurmukh knows that the True Lord is all-pervading. The Gurmukh understands creation and merger. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau vaaree jeeo vaaree gur pooraa man vasaavaniaa |
English: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Perfect Guru within their minds.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਾਤਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur te saat bhagat kare din raatee gun keh gunee samaavaniaa |1| rahaau |
English: From the Guru comes peace and tranquility; worship Him with devotion, day and night. Chanting His Glorious Praises, merge into the Glorious Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh dharatee guramukh paanee |
English: The Gurmukh sees the Lord on the earth, and the Gurmukh sees Him in the water.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਵਣੁ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਖੇਲੈ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh pavan baisantar khelai viddaanee |
English: The Gurmukh sees Him in wind and fire; such is the wonder of His Play.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਨਿਗੁਰਾ ਜੋ ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਨਿਗੁਰੇ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: so niguraa jo mar mar jamai nigure aavan jaavaniaa |2|
English: One who has no Guru, dies over and over again, only to be re-born. One who has no Guru continues coming and going in reincarnation. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤਿਨਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਇਕੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tin karatai ik khel rachaaeaa |
English: The One Creator has set this play in motion.

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਸਰੀਰੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa sareerai vich sabh kichh paaeaa |
English: In the frame of the human body, He has placed all things.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਭੇਦਿ ਕੋਈ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਮਹਲੇ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sabad bhed koee mehal paae mahale mehal bulaavaniaa |3|
English: Those few who are pierced through by the Word of the Shabad, obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. He calls them into His Wondrous Palace. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਚੇ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa saahu sache vanajaare |
English: True is the Banker, and true are His traders.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sach vananjeh gur het apaare |
English: They purchase Truth, with infinite love for the Guru.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਵਿਹਾਝਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: sach vihaajheh sach kamaaveh sacho sach kamaavaniaa |4|
English: They deal in Truth, and they practice Truth. They earn Truth, and only Truth. ||4||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਰਾਸੀ ਕੋ ਵਥੁ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: bin raasee ko vath kiau paae |
English: Without investment capital, how can anyone acquire merchandise?

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭੂਲੇ ਲੋਕ ਸਬਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh bhoole lok sabaae |
English: The self-willed manmukhs have all gone astray.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਰਾਸੀ ਸਭ ਖਾਲੀ ਚਲੇ ਖਾਲੀ ਜਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: bin raasee sabh khaalee chale khaalee jaae dukh paavaniaa |5|
English: Without true wealth, everyone goes empty-handed; going empty-handed, they suffer in pain. ||5||

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: eik sach vananjeh gur sabad piaare |
English: Some deal in Truth, through love of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਤਰਹਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aap tareh sagale kul taare |
English: They save themselves, and save all their ancestors as well.

Gurbani: ਆਏ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੋਏ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: aae se paravaan hoe mil preetam sukh paavaniaa |6|
English: Very auspicious is the coming of those who meet their Beloved and find peace. ||6||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਮੂੜਾ ਬਾਹਰੁ ਭਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: antar vasat moorraa baahar bhaale |
English: Deep within the self is the secret, but the fool looks for it outside.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਬੇਤਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh andhe fireh betaale |
English: The blind self-willed manmukhs wander around like demons;

Gurbani: ਜਿਥੈ ਵਥੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਿਥਹੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: jithai vath hovai tithahu koe na paavai manamukh bharam bhulaavaniaa |7|
English: but where the secret is, there, they do not find it. The manmukhs are deluded by doubt. ||7||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aape devai sabad bulaae |
English: He Himself calls us, and bestows the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਮਹਲੀ ਮਹਲਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: mahalee mehal sehaj sukh paae |
English: The soul-bride finds intuitive peace and poise in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਆਪੇ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੩॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: naanak naam milai vaddiaaee aape sun sun dhiaavaniaa |8|13|14|
English: O Nanak, she obtains the glorious greatness of the Naam; she hears it again and again, and she meditates on it. ||8||13||14||

[Ang 117 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 |
English: Maajh, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਚੀ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur saachee sikh sunaaee |
English: The True Guru has imparted the True Teachings.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਹੁ ਅੰਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har chetahu ant hoe sakhaaee |
English: Think of the Lord, who shall be your Help and Support in the end.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har agam agochar anaath ajonee satigur kai bhaae paavaniaa |1|
English: The Lord is Inaccessible and Incomprehensible. He has no master, and He is not born. He is obtained through love of the True Guru. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਆਪੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau vaaree jeeo vaaree aap nivaaraniaa |
English: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who eliminate selfishness and conceit.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aap gavaae taa har paae har siau sehaj samaavaniaa |1| rahaau |
English: They eradicate selfishness and conceit, and then find the Lord; they are intuitively immersed in the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: poorab likhiaa su karam kamaaeaa |
English: According to their pre-ordained destiny, they act out their karma.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sev sadaa sukh paaeaa |
English: Serving the True Guru, a lasting peace is found.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਬਦੈ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bin bhaagaa gur paaeeai naahee sabadai mel milaavaniaa |2|
English: Without good fortune, the Guru is not found. Through the Word of the Shabad, they are united in the Lord's Union. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh alipat rahai sansaare |
English: The Gurmukhs remain unaffected in the midst of the world.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਤਕੀਐ ਨਾਮਿ ਅਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai takeeai naam adhaare |
English: The Guru is their cushion, and the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is their Support.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪੇ ਖਪਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: guramukh jor kare kiaa tis no aape khap dukh paavaniaa |3|
English: Who can oppress the Gurmukh? One who tries shall perish, writhing in pain. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧੇ ਸੁਧਿ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh andhe sudh na kaaee |
English: The blind self-willed manmukhs have no understanding at all.

Gurbani: ਆਤਮ ਘਾਤੀ ਹੈ ਜਗਤ ਕਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aatam ghaatee hai jagat kasaaee |
