English: They are the assassins of the self, and the butchers of the world.

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਰੁ ਉਠਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਜੂਰੀ ਭਾਰੁ ਪਹੁਚਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: nindaa kar kar bahu bhaar utthaavai bin majooree bhaar pahuchaavaniaa |4|
English: By continually slandering others, they carry a terrible load, and they carry the loads of others for nothing. ||4||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਵਾੜੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: eihu jag vaarree meraa prabh maalee |
English: This world is a garden, and my Lord God is the Gardener.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ਖਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa samaale ko naahee khaalee |
English: He always takes care of it-nothing is exempt from His Care.

Gurbani: ਜੇਹੀ ਵਾਸਨਾ ਪਾਏ ਤੇਹੀ ਵਰਤੈ ਵਾਸੂ ਵਾਸੁ ਜਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: jehee vaasanaa paae tehee varatai vaasoo vaas janaavaniaa |5|
English: As is the fragrance which He bestows, so is the fragrant flower known. ||5||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਰੋਗੀ ਹੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh rogee hai sansaaraa |
English: The self-willed manmukhs are sick and diseased in the world.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sukhadaataa visariaa agam apaaraa |
English: They have forgotten the Giver of peace, the Unfathomable, the Infinite.

Gurbani: ਦੁਖੀਏ ਨਿਤਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਬਿਲਲਾਦੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: dukhee nit fireh bilalaade bin gur saant na paavaniaa |6|
English: These miserable people wander endlessly, crying out in pain; without the Guru, they find no peace. ||6||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤੇ ਸੋਈ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: jin keete soee bidh jaanai |
English: The One who created them, knows their condition.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: aap kare taa hukam pachhaanai |
English: And if He inspires them, then they realize the Hukam of His Command.

Gurbani: ਜੇਹਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਾਏ ਤੇਹਾ ਵਰਤੈ ਆਪੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: jehaa andar paae tehaa varatai aape baahar paavaniaa |7|
English: Whatever He places within them, that is what prevails, and so they outwardly appear. ||7||

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਸਚੇ ਮੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: tis baajhahu sache mai hor na koee |
English: I know of no other except the True One.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਲਾਇ ਲਏ ਸੋ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jis laae le so niramal hoee |
English: Those, whom the Lord attaches to Himself, become pure.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੪॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: naanak naam vasai ghatt antar jis devai so paavaniaa |8|14|15|
English: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within the heart of those, unto whom He has given it. ||8||14||15||

[Ang 118 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 |
English: Maajh, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: amrit naam man vasaae |
English: Enshrining the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, in the mind,

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: haumai meraa sabh dukh gavaae |
English: all the pains of egotism, selfishness and conceit are eliminated.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: amrit baanee sadaa salaahe amrit amrit paavaniaa |1|
English: By continually praising the Ambrosial Bani of the Word, I obtain the Amrit, the Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau vaaree jeeo vaaree amrit baanee man vasaavaniaa |
English: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Ambrosial Bani of the Word within their minds.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: amrit baanee man vasaae amrit naam dhiaavaniaa |1| rahaau |
English: Enshrining the Ambrosial Bani in their minds, they meditate on the Ambrosial Naam. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਸਦਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਵੈਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: amrit bolai sadaa mukh vainee |
English: Those who continually chant the Ambrosial Words of Nectar,

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵੇਖੈ ਪਰਖੈ ਸਦਾ ਨੈਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: amrit vekhai parakhai sadaa nainee |
English: See and behold this Amrit everywhere with their eyes.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਥਾ ਕਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਅਵਰਾ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਨਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: amrit kathaa kahai sadaa din raatee avaraa aakh sunaavaniaa |2|
English: They continually chant the Ambrosial Sermon day and night; chanting it, they cause others to hear it. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: amrit rang rataa liv laae |
English: Imbued with the Ambrosial Love of the Lord, they lovingly focus their attention on Him.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: amrit gur parasaadee paae |
English: By Guru's Grace, they receive this Amrit.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਬੋਲੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: amrit rasanaa bolai din raatee man tan amrit peeaavaniaa |3|
English: They chant the Ambrosial Name with their tongues day and night; their minds and bodies are satisfied by this Amrit. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਜੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: so kichh karai ju chit na hoee |
English: That which God does is beyond anyone's consciousness;

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: tis daa hukam mett na sakai koee |
English: no one can erase the Hukam of His Command.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਵਰਤੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: hukame varatai amrit baanee hukame amrit peeaavaniaa |4|
English: By His Command, the Ambrosial Bani of the Word prevails, and by His Command, we drink in the Amrit. ||4||

Gurbani: ਅਜਬ ਕੰਮ ਕਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: ajab kam karate har kere |
English: The actions of the Creator Lord are marvellous and wonderful.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭੂਲਾ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਫੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: eihu man bhoolaa jaandaa fere |
English: This mind is deluded, and goes around the wheel of reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: amrit baanee siau chit laae amrit sabad vajaavaniaa |5|
English: Those who focus their consciousness on the Ambrosial Bani of the Word, hear the vibrations of the Ambrosial Word of the Shabad. ||5||

Gurbani: ਖੋਟੇ ਖਰੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: khotte khare tudh aap upaae |
English: You Yourself created the counterfeit and the genuine.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਪਰਖੇ ਲੋਕ ਸਬਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: tudh aape parakhe lok sabaae |
English: You Yourself appraise all people.

Gurbani: ਖਰੇ ਪਰਖਿ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਪਾਇਹਿ ਖੋਟੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: khare parakh khajaanai paaeihi khotte bharam bhulaavaniaa |6|
English: You appraise the true, and place them in Your Treasury; You consign the false to wander in delusion. ||6||

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖਾ ਕਿਉ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: kiau kar vekhaa kiau saalaahee |
English: How can I behold You? How can I praise You?

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee sabad salaahee |
English: By Guru's Grace, I praise You through the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੇ ਭਾਣੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵਸੈ ਤੂੰ ਭਾਣੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: tere bhaane vich amrit vasai toon bhaanai amrit peeaavaniaa |7|
English: In Your Sweet Will, the Amrit is found; by Your Will, You inspire us to drink in this Amrit. ||7||

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਬਦੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: amrit sabad amrit har baanee |
English: The Shabad is Amrit; the Lord's Bani is Amrit.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: satigur seviai ridai samaanee |
English: Serving the True Guru, it permeates the heart.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਪੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਭ ਭੁਖ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੫॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: naanak amrit naam sadaa sukhadaataa pee amrit sabh bhukh leh jaavaniaa |8|15|16|
English: O Nanak, the Ambrosial Naam is forever the Giver of peace; drinking in this Amrit, all hunger is satisfied. ||8||15||16||

[Ang 119 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 |
English: Maajh, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵਰਸੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: amrit varasai sehaj subhaae |
English: The Ambrosial Nectar rains down, softly and gently.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh viralaa koee jan paae |
English: How rare are those Gurmukhs who find it.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀ ਸਦਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੁਝਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: amrit pee sadaa tripataase kar kirapaa trisanaa bujhaavaniaa |1|
English: Those who drink it in are satisfied forever. Showering His Mercy upon them, the Lord quenches their thirst. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਵਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau vaaree jeeo vaaree guramukh amrit peeaavaniaa |
English: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those Gurmukhs who drink in this Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: rasanaa ras chaakh sadaa rahai rang raatee sahaje har gun gaavaniaa |1| rahaau |
English: The tongue tastes the essence, and remains forever imbued with the Lord's Love, intuitively singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਹਜੁ ਕੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee sehaj ko paae |
English: By Guru's Grace, intuitive understanding is obtained;

Gurbani: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਰੇ ਇਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: dubidhaa maare ikas siau liv laae |
English: subduing the sense of duality, they are in love with the One.

Gurbani: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਦਰੀ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: nadar kare taa har gun gaavai nadaree sach samaavaniaa |2|
English: When He bestows His Glance of Grace, then they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; by His Grace, they merge in Truth. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਭਨਾ ਉਪਰਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: sabhanaa upar nadar prabh teree |
English: Above all is Your Glance of Grace, O God.

Gurbani: ਕਿਸੈ ਥੋੜੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਹੈ ਘਣੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kisai thorree kisai hai ghaneree |
English: Upon some it is bestowed less, and upon others it is bestowed more.

Gurbani: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tujh te baahar kichh na hovai guramukh sojhee paavaniaa |3|
English: Without You, nothing happens at all; the Gurmukhs understand this. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਤੁ ਹੈ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh tat hai beechaaraa |
English: The Gurmukhs contemplate the essence of reality;

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: amrit bhare tere bhanddaaraa |
English: Your Treasures are overflowing with Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਕੋਈ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: bin satigur seve koee na paavai gur kirapaa te paavaniaa |4|
English: Without serving the True Guru, no one obtains it. It is obtained only by Guru's Grace. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sevai so jan sohai |
English: Those who serve the True Guru are beautiful.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮਿ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: amrit naam antar man mohai |
English: The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, entices their inner minds.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਰਤਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: amrit man tan baanee rataa amrit sehaj sunaavaniaa |5|
English: Their minds and bodies are attuned to the Ambrosial Bani of the Word; this Ambrosial Nectar is intuitively heard. ||5||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਭੂਲਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh bhoolaa doojai bhaae khuaae |
English: The deluded, self-willed manmukhs are ruined through the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਲੇਵੈ ਮਰੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: naam na levai marai bikh khaae |
English: They do not chant the Naam, and they die, eating poison.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਮਹਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: anadin sadaa visattaa meh vaasaa bin sevaa janam gavaavaniaa |6|
English: Night and day, they continually sit in manure. Without selfless service, their lives are wasted away. ||6||

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਪੀਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: amrit peevai jis no aap peeae |
English: They alone drink in this Amrit, whom the Lord Himself inspires to do so.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee sehaj liv laae |
English: By Guru's Grace, they intuitively enshrine love for the Lord.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: pooran poor rahiaa sabh aape guramat nadaree aavaniaa |7|
English: The Perfect Lord is Himself perfectly pervading everywhere; through the Guru's Teachings, He is perceived. ||7||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aape aap niranjan soee |
English: He Himself is the Immaculate Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਰਜੀ ਤਿਨਿ ਆਪੇ ਗੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jin sirajee tin aape goee |
English: He who has created, shall Himself destroy.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਸਦਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੬॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: naanak naam samaal sadaa toon sahaje sach samaavaniaa |8|16|17|
English: O Nanak, remember the Naam forever, and you shall merge into the True One with intuitive ease. ||8||16||17||

[Ang 119 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 |
English: Maajh, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਸਚਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: se sach laage jo tudh bhaae |
English: Those who please You are linked to the Truth.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sach seveh sehaj subhaae |
English: They serve the True One forever, with intuitive ease.

Gurbani: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਚੈ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sachai sabad sachaa saalaahee sachai mel milaavaniaa |1|
English: Through the True Word of the Shabad, they praise the True One, and they merge in the merging of Truth. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau vaaree jeeo vaaree sach saalaahaniaa |
English: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who praise the True One.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਸੇ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sach dhiaaein se sach raate sache sach samaavaniaa |1| rahaau |
English: Those who meditate on the True One are attuned to Truth; they are absorbed into the Truest of the True. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jeh dekhaa sach sabhanee thaaee |
English: The True One is everywhere, wherever I look.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee man vasaaee |
English: By Guru's Grace, I enshrine Him in my mind.

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਸਚਾ ਰਸਨਾ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਨਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tan sachaa rasanaa sach raatee sach sun aakh vakhaananiaa |2|
English: True are the bodies of those whose tongues are attuned to Truth. They hear the Truth, and speak it with their mouths. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: manasaa maar sach samaanee |
English: Subduing their desires, they merge with the True One;

Gurbani: ਇਨਿ ਮਨਿ ਡੀਠੀ ਸਭ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: ein man ddeetthee sabh aavan jaanee |
English: they see in their minds that everyone comes and goes in reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: satigur seve sadaa man nihachal nij ghar vaasaa paavaniaa |3|
English: Serving the True Guru, they become stable forever, and they obtain their dwelling in the home of the self. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad ridai dikhaaeaa |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord is seen within one's own heart.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohu sabad jalaaeaa |
English: Through the Shabad, I have burned my emotional attachment to Maya.

Gurbani: ਸਚੋ ਸਚਾ ਵੇਖਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: sacho sachaa vekh saalaahee gurasabadee sach paavaniaa |4|
English: I gaze upon the Truest of the True, and I praise Him. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I obtain the True One. ||4||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਸਚੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: jo sach raate tin sachee liv laagee |
English: Those who are attuned to Truth are blessed with the Love of the True One.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਹਿ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: har naam samaaleh se vaddabhaagee |
English: Those who praise the Lord's Name are very fortunate.

Gurbani: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: sachai sabad aap milaae satasangat sach gun gaavaniaa |5|
English: Through the Word of His Shabad, the True One blends with Himself, those who join the True Congregation and sing the Glorious Praises of the True One. ||5||

Gurbani: ਲੇਖਾ ਪੜੀਐ ਜੇ ਲੇਖੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: lekhaa parreeai je lekhe vich hovai |
English: We could read the account of the Lord, if He were in any account.

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਧਿ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: ohu agam agochar sabad sudh hovai |
English: He is Inaccessible and Incomprehensible; through the Shabad, understanding is obtained.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਹੋਰੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: anadin sach sabad saalaahee hor koe na keemat paavaniaa |6|
English: Night and day, praise the True Word of the Shabad. There is no other way to know His Worth. ||6||

Gurbani: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: parr parr thaake saant na aaee |
English: People read and recite until they grow weary, but they do not find peace.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਾਲੇ ਸੁਧਿ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: trisanaa jaale sudh na kaaee |
English: Consumed by desire, they have no understanding at all.

Gurbani: ਬਿਖੁ ਬਿਹਾਝਹਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਮੋਹ ਪਿਆਸੇ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: bikh bihaajheh bikh moh piaase koorr bol bikh khaavaniaa |7|
English: They purchase poison, and they are thirsty with their fascination for poison. Telling lies, they eat poison. ||7||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee eko jaanaa |
English: By Guru's Grace, I know the One.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: doojaa maar man sach samaanaa |
English: Subduing my sense of duality, my mind is absorbed into the True One.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੭॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: naanak eko naam varatai man antar gur parasaadee paavaniaa |8|17|18|
English: O Nanak, the One Name is pervading deep within my mind; by Guru's Grace, I receive it. ||8||17||18||

[Ang 120 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 |
English: Maajh, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਵਰਨ ਰੂਪ ਵਰਤਹਿ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: varan roop varateh sabh tere |
English: In all colors and forms, You are pervading.

Gurbani: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਫੇਰ ਪਵਹਿ ਘਣੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: mar mar jameh fer paveh ghanere |
English: People die over and over again; they are re-born, and make their rounds on the wheel of reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਏਕੋ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: toon eko nihachal agam apaaraa guramatee boojh bujhaavaniaa |1|
English: You alone are Eternal and Unchanging, Inaccessible and Infinite. Through the Guru's Teachings, understanding is imparted. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau vaaree jeeo vaaree raam naam man vasaavaniaa |
English: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Lord's Name in their minds.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਵਰਨੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tis roop na rekhiaa varan na koee guramatee aap bujhaavaniaa |1| rahaau |
English: The Lord has no form, features or color. Through the Guru's Teachings, He inspires us to understand Him. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਏਕਾ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: sabh ekaa jot jaanai je koee |
English: The One Light is all-pervading; only a few know this.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur seviai paragatt hoee |
English: Serving the True Guru, this is revealed.

Gurbani: ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gupat paragatt varatai sabh thaaee jotee jot milaavaniaa |2|
English: In the hidden and in the obvious, He is pervading all places. Our light merges into the Light. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਲੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: tisanaa agan jalai sansaaraa |
English: The world is burning in the fire of desire,

Gurbani: ਲੋਭੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: lobh abhimaan bahut ahankaaraa |
English: in greed, arrogance and excessive ego.

Gurbani: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਏ ਅਪਣੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: mar mar janamai pat gavaae apanee birathaa janam gavaavaniaa |3|
English: People die over and over again; they are re-born, and lose their honor. They waste away their lives in vain. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa sabad ko viralaa boojhai |
English: Those who understand the Word of the Guru's Shabad are very rare.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
Transliteration: aap maare taa tribhavan soojhai |
English: Those who subdue their egotism, come to know the three worlds.

Gurbani: ਫਿਰਿ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਮਰਣਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: fir ohu marai na maranaa hovai sahaje sach samaavaniaa |4|
English: Then, they die, never to die again. They are intuitively absorbed in the True One. ||4||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa meh fir chit na laae |
English: They do not focus their consciousness on Maya again.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad sad rahai samaae |
English: They remain absorbed forever in the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਸਭ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: sach salaahe sabh ghatt antar sacho sach suhaavaniaa |5|
English: They praise the True One, who is contained deep within all hearts. They are blessed and exalted by the Truest of the True. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sach saalaahee sadaa hajoore |
English: Praise the True One, who is Ever-present.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad rahiaa bharapoore |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is pervading everywhere.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵੈ ਸਚੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee sach nadaree aavai sache hee sukh paavaniaa |6|
English: By Guru's Grace, we come to behold the True One; from the True One, peace is obtained. ||6||

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਮਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sach man andar rahiaa samaae |
English: The True One permeates and pervades the mind within.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sach nihachal aavai na jaae |
English: The True One is Eternal and Unchanging; He does not come and go in reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਸਚੇ ਲਾਗੈ ਸੋ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: sache laagai so man niramal guramatee sach samaavaniaa |7|
English: Those who are attached to the True One are immaculate and pure. Through the Guru's Teachings, they merge in the True One. ||7||

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: sach saalaahee avar na koee |
English: Praise the True One, and no other.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jit seviai sadaa sukh hoee |
English: Serving Him, eternal peace is obtained.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੮॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: naanak naam rate veechaaree sacho sach kamaavaniaa |8|18|19|
English: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam, reflect deeply on the Truth; they practice only Truth. ||8||18||19||

[Ang 121 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 |
English: Maajh, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੈ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: niramal sabad niramal hai baanee |
English: The Word of the Shabad is Immaculate and Pure; the Bani of the Word is Pure.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਭ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: niramal jot sabh maeh samaanee |
English: The Light which is pervading among all is Immaculate.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: niramal baanee har saalaahee jap har niramal mail gavaavaniaa |1|
English: So praise the Immaculate Word of the Lord's Bani; chanting the Immaculate Name of the Lord, all filth is washed away. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau vaaree jeeo vaaree sukhadaataa man vasaavaniaa |
English: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Giver of peace within their minds.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਸਬਦੋ ਸੁਣਿ ਤਿਸਾ ਮਿਟਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har niramal gur sabad salaahee sabado sun tisaa mittaavaniaa |1| rahaau |
English: Praise the Immaculate Lord, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. Listen to the Shabad, and quench your thirst. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: niramal naam vasiaa man aae |
English: When the Immaculate Naam comes to dwell in the mind,

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: man tan niramal maaeaa mohu gavaae |
English: the mind and body become Immaculate, and emotional attachment to Maya departs.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਦੁ ਵਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: niramal gun gaavai nit saache ke niramal naad vajaavaniaa |2|
English: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Immaculate True Lord forever, and the Immaculate Sound-current of the Naad shall vibrate within. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: niramal amrit gur te paaeaa |
English: The Immaculate Ambrosial Nectar is obtained from the Guru.

Gurbani: ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਮੁਆ ਤਿਥੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: vichahu aap muaa tithai mohu na maaeaa |
English: When selfishness and conceit are eradicated from within, then there is no attachment to Maya.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: niramal giaan dhiaan at niramal niramal baanee man vasaavaniaa |3|
English: Immaculate is the spiritual wisdom, and utterly immaculate is the meditation, of those whose minds are filled with the Immaculate Bani of the Word. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jo niramal seve su niramal hovai |
English: One who serves the Immaculate Lord becomes immaculate.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੇ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: haumai mail gurasabade dhovai |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the filth of egotism is washed away.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਵਾਜੈ ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: niramal vaajai anahad dhun baanee dar sachai sobhaa paavaniaa |4|
English: The Immaculate Bani and the Unstruck Melody of the Sound-current vibrate, and in the True Court, honor is obtained. ||4||

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: niramal te sabh niramal hovai |
English: Through the Immaculate Lord, all become immaculate.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਰੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: niramal manooaa har sabad parovai |
English: Immaculate is the mind which weaves the Word of the Lord's Shabad into itself.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗੇ ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: niramal naam lage baddabhaagee niramal naam suhaavaniaa |5|
English: Blessed and very fortunate are those who are committed to the Immaculate Name; through the Immaculate Name, they are blessed and beautified. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਜੋ ਸਬਦੇ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: so niramal jo sabade sohai |
English: Immaculate is the one who is adorned with the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਮੋਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: niramal naam man tan mohai |
English: The Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord, entices the mind and body.

Gurbani: ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਲੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲੁ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: sach naam mal kade na laagai mukh aoojal sach karaavaniaa |6|
English: No filth ever attaches itself to the True Name; one's face is made radiant by the True One. ||6||

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man mailaa hai doojai bhaae |
English: The mind is polluted by the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਮੈਲਾ ਚਉਕਾ ਮੈਲੈ ਥਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: mailaa chaukaa mailai thaae |
English: Filthy is that kitchen, and filthy is that dwelling;

Gurbani: ਮੈਲਾ ਖਾਇ ਫਿਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਵਧਾਏ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੈਲੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: mailaa khaae fir mail vadhaae manamukh mail dukh paavaniaa |7|
English: eating filth, the self-willed manmukhs become even more filthy. Because of their filth, they suffer in pain. ||7||

Gurbani: ਮੈਲੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਭਿ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਬਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: maile niramal sabh hukam sabaae |
English: The filthy, and the immaculate as well, are all subject to the Hukam of God's Command.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: se niramal jo har saache bhaae |
English: They alone are immaculate, who are pleasing to the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੯॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: naanak naam vasai man antar guramukh mail chukaavaniaa |8|19|20|
English: O Nanak, the Naam abides deep within the minds of the Gurmukhs, who are cleansed of all their filth. ||8||19||20||

[Ang 121 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 |
English: Maajh, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਊਜਲੁ ਊਜਲ ਹੰਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: govind aoojal aoojal hansaa |
English: The Lord of the Universe is radiant, and radiant are His soul-swans.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਨਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: man baanee niramal meree manasaa |
English: Their minds and their speech are immaculate; they are my hope and ideal.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਊਜਲ ਸਦਾ ਮੁਖ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਅਤਿ ਊਜਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: man aoojal sadaa mukh soheh at aoojal naam dhiaavaniaa |1|
English: Their minds are radiant, and their faces are always beautiful; they meditate on the most radiant Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau vaaree jeeo vaaree gobind gun gaavaniaa |
English: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਕਹੈ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਗੁਣ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gobid gobid kahai din raatee gobid gun sabad sunaavaniaa |1| rahaau |
English: So chant Gobind, Gobind, the Lord of the Universe, day and night; sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord Gobind, through the Word of His Shabad. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gobid gaaveh sehaj subhaae |
English: Sing of the Lord Gobind with intuitive ease,

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭੈ ਊਜਲ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai bhai aoojal haumai mal jaae |
English: in the Fear of the Guru; you shall become radiant, and the filth of egotism shall depart.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sadaa anand raheh bhagat kareh din raatee sun gobid gun gaavaniaa |2|
English: Remain in bliss forever, and perform devotional worship, day and night. Hear and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord Gobind. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨੂਆ ਨਾਚੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: manooaa naachai bhagat drirraae |
English: Channel your dancing mind in devotional worship,

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad manai man milaae |
English: and through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, merge your mind with the Supreme Mind.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਤਾਲੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ਸਬਦੇ ਨਿਰਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sachaa taal poore maaeaa mohu chukaae sabade nirat karaavaniaa |3|
English: Let your true and perfect tune be the subjugation of your love of Maya, and let yourself dance to the Shabad. ||3||

Gurbani: ਊਚਾ ਕੂਕੇ ਤਨਹਿ ਪਛਾੜੇ ॥
Transliteration: aoochaa kooke taneh pachhaarre |
English: People shout out loud and move their bodies,

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਜੋਹਿਆ ਜਮਕਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohi johiaa jamakaale |
English: but if they are emotionally attached to Maya, then the Messenger of Death shall hunt them down.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਇਸੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਨਚਾਏ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohu is maneh nachaae antar kapatt dukh paavaniaa |4|
English: The love of Maya makes this mind dance, and the deceit within makes people suffer in pain. ||4||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh bhagat jaa aap karaae |
English: When the Lord inspires one to become Gurmukh, and perform devotional worship,

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: tan man raataa sehaj subhaae |
English: then his body and mind are attuned to His Love with intuitive ease.

Gurbani: ਬਾਣੀ ਵਜੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਜਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: baanee vajai sabad vajaae guramukh bhagat thaae paavaniaa |5|
English: The Word of His Bani vibrates, and the Word of His Shabad resounds, for the Gurmukh whose devotional worship is accepted. ||5||

Gurbani: ਬਹੁ ਤਾਲ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਾਜੇ ਵਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: bahu taal poore vaaje vajaae |
English: One may beat upon and play all sorts of instruments,

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਸੁਣੇ ਨ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: naa ko sune na man vasaae |
English: but no one will listen, and no one will enshrine it in the mind.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਪਿੜ ਬੰਧਿ ਨਾਚੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: maaeaa kaaran pirr bandh naachai doojai bhaae dukh paavaniaa |6|
English: For the sake of Maya, they set the stage and dance, but they are in love with duality, and they obtain only sorrow. ||6||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੈ ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: jis antar preet lagai so mukataa |
English: Those whose inner beings are attached to the Lord's Love are liberated.

Gurbani: ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਵਸਿ ਸਚ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: eindree vas sach sanjam jugataa |
English: They control their sexual desires, and their lifestyle is the self-discipline of Truth.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਏ ਏਹਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad sadaa har dhiaae ehaa bhagat har bhaavaniaa |7|
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they meditate forever on the Lord. This devotional worship is pleasing to the Lord. ||7||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh bhagat jug chaare hoee |
English: To live as Gurmukh is devotional worship, throughout the four ages.

Gurbani: ਹੋਰਤੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: horat bhagat na paae koee |
English: This devotional worship is not obtained by any other means.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੦॥੨੧॥
Transliteration: naanak naam gur bhagatee paaeeai gur charanee chit laavaniaa |8|20|21|
English: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is obtained only through devotion to the Guru. So focus your consciousness on the Guru's Feet. ||8||20||21||

[Ang 122 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 |
English: Maajh, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਸੇਵੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa sevee sach saalaahee |
English: Serve the True One, and praise the True One.

Gurbani: ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: sachai naae dukh kab hee naahee |
English: With the True Name, pain shall never afflict you.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sukhadaataa sevan sukh paaein guramat man vasaavaniaa |1|
English: Those who serve the Giver of peace find peace. They enshrine the Guru's Teachings within their minds. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau vaaree jeeo vaaree sukh sehaj samaadh lagaavaniaa |
English: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who intuitively enter into the peace of Samaadhi.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo har seveh se sadaa soheh sobhaa surat suhaavaniaa |1| rahaau |
English: Those who serve the Lord are always beautiful. The glory of their intuitive awareness is beautiful. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਗਤੁ ਕਹਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sabh ko teraa bhagat kahaae |
English: All call themselves Your devotees,

Gurbani: ਸੇਈ ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: seee bhagat terai man bhaae |
English: but they alone are Your devotees, who are pleasing to Your mind.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਤੁਧੈ ਸਾਲਾਹਨਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sach baanee tudhai saalaahan rang raate bhagat karaavaniaa |2|
English: Through the True Word of Your Bani, they praise You; attuned to Your Love, they worship You with devotion. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਸਚੇ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabh ko sache har jeeo teraa |
English: All are Yours, O Dear True Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਚੂਕੈ ਫੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh milai taa chookai feraa |
English: Meeting the Gurmukh, this cycle of reincarnation comes to an end.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਨਾਇ ਰਚਾਵਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਨਾਉ ਜਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jaa tudh bhaavai taa naae rachaaveh toon aape naau japaavaniaa |3|
English: When it pleases Your Will, then we merge in the Name. You Yourself inspire us to chant the Name. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: guramatee har man vasaaeaa |
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, I enshrine the Lord within my mind.

Gurbani: ਹਰਖੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਸਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: harakh sog sabh mohu gavaaeaa |
English: Pleasure and pain, and all emotional attachments are gone.

Gurbani: ਇਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: eikas siau liv laagee sad hee har naam man vasaavaniaa |4|
English: I am lovingly centered on the One Lord forever. I enshrine the Lord's Name within my mind. ||4||

Gurbani: ਭਗਤ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰੈ ਚਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat rang raate sadaa terai chaae |
English: Your devotees are attuned to Your Love; they are always joyful.

Gurbani: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: nau nidh naam vasiaa man aae |
English: The nine treasures of the Naam come to dwell within their minds.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਬਦੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: poorai bhaag satigur paaeaa sabade mel milaavaniaa |5|
English: By perfect destiny, they find the True Guru, and through the Word of the Shabad, they are united in the Lord's Union. ||5||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: toon deaal sadaa sukhadaataa |
English: You are Merciful, and always the Giver of peace.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: toon aape melihi guramukh jaataa |
English: You Yourself unite us; You are known only to the Gurmukhs.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: toon aape deveh naam vaddaaee naam rate sukh paavaniaa |6|
English: You Yourself bestow the glorious greatness of the Naam; attuned to the Naam, we find peace. ||6||

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਚੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa saache tudh saalaahee |
English: Forever and ever, O True Lord, I praise You.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh jaataa doojaa ko naahee |
English: As Gurmukh, I know no other at all.

Gurbani: ਏਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਏ ਮਨਿ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਮਨਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: ekas siau man rahiaa samaae man maniai maneh milaavaniaa |7|
English: My mind remains immersed in the One Lord; my mind surrenders to Him, and in my mind I meet Him. ||7||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh hovai so saalaahe |
English: One who becomes Gurmukh, praises the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: saache tthaakur veparavaahe |
English: Our True Lord and Master is Carefree.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੧॥੨੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naam vasai man antar gurasabadee har melaavaniaa |8|21|22|
English: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within the mind; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, we merge with the Lord. ||8||21||22||

[Ang 122 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 |
English: Maajh, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: tere bhagat soheh saachai darabaare |
English: Your devotees look beautiful in the True Court.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad naam savaare |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they are adorned with the Naam.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sadaa anand raheh din raatee gun keh gunee samaavaniaa |1|
English: They are forever in bliss, day and night; chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord, they merge with the Lord of Glory. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau vaaree jeeo vaaree naam sun man vasaavaniaa |
English: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who hear and enshrine the Naam within their minds.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਚਾ ਊਚੋ ਊਚਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har jeeo sachaa aoocho aoochaa haumai maar milaavaniaa |1| rahaau |
English: The Dear Lord, the True One, the Highest of the High, subdues their ego and blends them with Himself. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har jeeo saachaa saachee naaee |
English: True is the Dear Lord, and True is His Name.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee kisai milaaee |
English: By Guru's Grace, some merge with Him.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਸੇ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur sabad mileh se vichhurreh naahee sahaje sach samaavaniaa |2|
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, those who merge with the Lord shall not be separated from Him again. They merge with intuitive ease into the True Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: tujh te baahar kachhoo na hoe |
English: There is nothing beyond You;

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: toon kar kar vekheh jaaneh soe |
English: You are the One who does, sees, and knows.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aape kare karaae karataa guramat aap milaavaniaa |3|
English: The Creator Himself acts, and inspires others to act. Through the Guru's Teachings, He blends us into Himself. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: kaaman gunavantee har paae |
English: The virtuous soul-bride finds the Lord;

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: bhai bhaae seegaar banaae |
English: she decorates herself with the Love and the Fear of God.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਚ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: satigur sev sadaa sohaagan sach upades samaavaniaa |4|
English: She who serves the True Guru is forever a happy soul-bride. She is absorbed in the true teachings. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਨਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਠਉਰੁ ਨ ਠਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sabad visaaran tinaa tthaur na tthaau |
English: Those who forget the Word of the Shabad have no home and no place of rest.

Gurbani: ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਜਿਉ ਸੁੰਞੈ ਘਰਿ ਕਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhram bhoole jiau sunyai ghar kaau |
English: They are deluded by doubt, like a crow in a deserted house.

Gurbani: ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਤਿਨੀ ਦੋਵੈ ਗਵਾਏ ਦੁਖੇ ਦੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: halat palat tinee dovai gavaae dukhe dukh vihaavaniaa |5|
English: They forfeit both this world and the next, and they pass their lives suffering in pain and misery. ||5||

Gurbani: ਲਿਖਦਿਆ ਲਿਖਦਿਆ ਕਾਗਦ ਮਸੁ ਖੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: likhadiaa likhadiaa kaagad mas khoee |
English: Writing on and on endlessly, they run out of paper and ink.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: doojai bhaae sukh paae na koee |
English: Through the love with duality, no one has found peace.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜੁ ਲਿਖਹਿ ਤੈ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਕੂੜਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: koorr likheh tai koorr kamaaveh jal jaaveh koorr chit laavaniaa |6|
English: They write falsehood, and they practice falsehood; they are burnt to ashes by focusing their consciousness on falsehood. ||6||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਲਿਖਹਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh sacho sach likheh veechaar |
English: The Gurmukhs write and reflect on Truth, and only Truth.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਚੇ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: se jan sache paaveh mokh duaar |
English: The true ones find the gate of salvation.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਕਲਮ ਮਸਵਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਲਿਖਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: sach kaagad kalam masavaanee sach likh sach samaavaniaa |7|
English: True is their paper, pen and ink; writing Truth, they are absorbed in the True One. ||7||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬੈਠਾ ਵੇਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: meraa prabh antar baitthaa vekhai |
English: My God sits deep within the self; He watches over us.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਲੇਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee milai soee jan lekhai |
English: Those who meet the Lord, by Guru's Grace, are acceptable.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੨॥੨੩॥
Transliteration: naanak naam milai vaddiaaee poore gur te paavaniaa |8|22|23|
English: O Nanak, glorious greatness is received through the Naam, which is obtained through the Perfect Guru. ||8||22||23||

[Ang 123 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 |
English: Maajh, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: aatam raam paragaas gur te hovai |
English: The Divine Light of the Supreme Soul shines forth from the Guru.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: haumai mail laagee gurasabadee khovai |
English: The filth stuck to the ego is removed through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਾਤਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: man niramal anadin bhagatee raataa bhagat kare har paavaniaa |1|
English: One who is imbued with devotional worship to the Lord night and day becomes pure. Worshipping the Lord, He is obtained. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਆਪਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਨਿ ਅਵਰਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau vaaree jeeo vaaree aap bhagat karan avaraa bhagat karaavaniaa |
English: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who themselves worship the Lord, and inspire others to worship Him as well.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨਾ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਜੋ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tinaa bhagat janaa kau sad namasakaar keejai jo anadin har gun gaavaniaa |1| rahaau |
English: I humbly bow to those devotees who chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, night and day. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aape karataa kaaran karaae |
English: The Creator Lord Himself is the Doer of deeds.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jit bhaavai tith kaarai laae |
English: As He pleases, He applies us to our tasks.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: poorai bhaag gur sevaa hovai gur sevaa te sukh paavaniaa |2|
English: Through perfect destiny, we serve the Guru; serving the Guru, peace is found. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਤਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: mar mar jeevai taa kichh paae |
English: Those who die, and remain dead while yet alive, obtain it.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee har man vasaae |
English: By Guru's Grace, they enshrine the Lord within their minds.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sadaa mukat har man vasaae sahaje sehaj samaavaniaa |3|
English: Enshrining the Lord within their minds, they are liberated forever. With intuitive ease, they merge into the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: bahu karam kamaavai mukat na paae |
English: They perform all sorts of rituals, but they do not obtain liberation through them.

Gurbani: ਦੇਸੰਤਰੁ ਭਵੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: desantar bhavai doojai bhaae khuaae |
English: They wander around the countryside, and in love with duality, they are ruined.

Gurbani: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਕਪਟੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: birathaa janam gavaaeaa kapattee bin sabadai dukh paavaniaa |4|
English: The deceitful lose their lives in vain; without the Word of the Shabad, they obtain only misery. ||4||

Gurbani: ਧਾਵਤੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: dhaavat raakhai tthaak rahaae |
English: Those who restrain their wandering mind, keeping it steady and stable,

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee param pad paae |
English: obtain the supreme status, by Guru's Grace.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: satigur aape mel milaae mil preetam sukh paavaniaa |5|
English: The True Guru Himself unites us in Union with the Lord. Meeting the Beloved, peace is obtained. ||5||

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਕੂੜਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਕੂੜੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: eik koorr laage koorre fal paae |
English: Some are stuck in falsehood, and false are the rewards they receive.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: doojai bhaae birathaa janam gavaae |
English: In love with duality, they waste away their lives in vain.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਡੁਬੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਡੋਬੇ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: aap ddube sagale kul ddobe koorr bol bikh khaavaniaa |6|
English: They drown themselves, and drown their entire family; speaking lies, they eat poison. ||6||

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਕੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: eis tan meh man ko guramukh dekhai |
English: How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, look within their bodies, into their minds.

Gurbani: ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਸੋਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: bhaae bhagat jaa haumai sokhai |
English: Through loving devotion, their ego evaporates.

Gurbani: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਮੋਨਿਧਾਰੀ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ਤਿਨ ਭੀ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਦਿਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: sidh saadhik monidhaaree rahe liv laae tin bhee tan meh man na dikhaavaniaa |7|
English: The Siddhas, the seekers and the silent sages continually, lovingly focus their consciousness, but they have not seen the mind within the body. ||7||

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aap karaae karataa soee |
English: The Creator Himself inspires us to work;

Gurbani: ਹੋਰੁ ਕਿ ਕਰੇ ਕੀਤੈ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: hor ki kare keetai kiaa hoee |
English: what can anyone else do? What can be done by our doing?

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਲੇਵੈ ਨਾਮੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੩॥੨੪॥
Transliteration: naanak jis naam devai so levai naamo man vasaavaniaa |8|23|24|
English: O Nanak, the Lord bestows His Name; we receive it, and enshrine it within the mind. ||8||23||24||

[Ang 124 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 |
English: Maajh, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਗੁਫਾ ਮਹਿ ਅਖੁਟ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: eis gufaa meh akhutt bhanddaaraa |
English: Within this cave, there is an inexhaustible treasure.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: tis vich vasai har alakh apaaraa |
English: Within this cave, the Invisible and Infinite Lord abides.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਆਪੁ ਵੰਞਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aape gupat paragatt hai aape gurasabadee aap vanyaavaniaa |1|
English: He Himself is hidden, and He Himself is revealed; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, selfishness and conceit are eliminated. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau vaaree jeeo vaaree amrit naam man vasaavaniaa |
English: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, within their minds.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: amrit naam mahaa ras meetthaa guramatee amrit peeaavaniaa |1| rahaau |
English: The taste of the Ambrosial Naam is very sweet! Through the Guru's Teachings, drink in this Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਖੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: haumai maar bajar kapaatt khulaaeaa |
English: Subduing egotism, the rigid doors are opened.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: naam amolak gur parasaadee paaeaa |
English: The Priceless Naam is obtained by Guru's Grace.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bin sabadai naam na paae koee gur kirapaa man vasaavaniaa |2|
English: Without the Shabad, the Naam is not obtained. By Guru's Grace, it is implanted within the mind. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਨੇਤ੍ਰੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur giaan anjan sach netree paaeaa |
English: The Guru has applied the true ointment of spiritual wisdom to my eyes.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: antar chaanan agiaan andher gavaaeaa |
English: Deep within, the Divine Light has dawned, and the darkness of ignorance has been dispelled.

Gurbani: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jotee jot milee man maaniaa har dar sobhaa paavaniaa |3|
English: My light has merged into the Light; my mind has surrendered, and I am blessed with Glory in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਰੀਰਹੁ ਭਾਲਣਿ ਕੋ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sareerahu bhaalan ko baahar jaae |
English: Those who look outside the body, searching for the Lord,

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਲਹੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਵੇਗਾਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: naam na lahai bahut vegaar dukh paae |
English: Shall not receive the Naam; they shall instead be forced to suffer the terrible pains of slavery.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧੇ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਘਿਰਿ ਆਇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਥੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: manamukh andhe soojhai naahee fir ghir aae guramukh vath paavaniaa |4|
English: The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not understand; but when they return once again to their own home, then, as Gurmukh, they find the genuine article. ||4||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਚਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee sachaa har paae |
English: By Guru's Grace, the True Lord is found.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: man tan vekhai haumai mail jaae |
English: Within your mind and body, see the Lord, and the filth of egotism shall depart.

Gurbani: ਬੈਸਿ ਸੁਥਾਨਿ ਸਦ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: bais suthaan sad har gun gaavai sachai sabad samaavaniaa |5|
English: Sitting in that place, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord forever, and be absorbed in the True Word of the Shabad. ||5||

Gurbani: ਨਉ ਦਰ ਠਾਕੇ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: nau dar tthaake dhaavat rahaae |
English: Those who close off the nine gates, and restrain the wandering mind,

Gurbani: ਦਸਵੈ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: dasavai nij ghar vaasaa paae |
English: come to dwell in the Home of the Tenth Gate.

Gurbani: ਓਥੈ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਵਜਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: othai anahad sabad vajeh din raatee guramatee sabad sunaavaniaa |6|
English: There, the Unstruck Melody of the Shabad vibrates day and night. Through the Guru's Teachings, the Shabad is heard. ||6||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਆਨੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: bin sabadai antar aaneraa |
English: Without the Shabad, there is only darkness within.

Gurbani: ਨ ਵਸਤੁ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ਫੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: n vasat lahai na chookai feraa |
English: The genuine article is not found, and the cycle of reincarnation does not end.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਥਿ ਕੁੰਜੀ ਹੋਰਤੁ ਦਰੁ ਖੁਲੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: satigur hath kunjee horat dar khulai naahee gur poorai bhaag milaavaniaa |7|
English: The key is in the hands of the True Guru; no one else can open this door. By perfect destiny, He is met. ||7||

Gurbani: ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: gupat paragatt toon sabhanee thaaee |
English: You are the hidden and the revealed in all places.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee mil sojhee paaee |
English: Receiving Guru's Grace, this understanding is obtained.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਤੂੰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੪॥੨੫॥
Transliteration: naanak naam salaeh sadaa toon guramukh man vasaavaniaa |8|24|25|
English: O Nanak, praise the Naam forever; as Gurmukh, enshrine it within the mind. ||8||24||25||

[Ang 124 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 |
English: Maajh, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਆਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh milai milaae aape |
English: The Gurmukhs meet the Lord, and inspire others to meet Him as well.

Gurbani: ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਜੋਹੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਸੰਤਾਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: kaal na johai dukh na santaape |
English: Death does not see them, and pain does not afflict them.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਸਭ ਤੋੜੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: haumai maar bandhan sabh torrai guramukh sabad suhaavaniaa |1|
English: Subduing egotism, they break all their bonds; as Gurmukh, they are adorned with the Word of the Shabad. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau vaaree jeeo vaaree har har naam suhaavaniaa |
English: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who look beautiful in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh gaavai guramukh naachai har setee chit laavaniaa |1| rahaau |
English: The Gurmukhs sing, the Gurmukhs dance, and focus their consciousness on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਮਰੈ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh jeevai marai paravaan |
English: The Gurmukhs are celebrated in life and death.

Gurbani: ਆਰਜਾ ਨ ਛੀਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: aarajaa na chheejai sabad pachhaan |
English: Their lives are not wasted; they realize the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਖਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: guramukh marai na kaal na khaae guramukh sach samaavaniaa |2|
English: The Gurmukhs do not die; they are not consumed by death. The Gurmukhs are absorbed in the True Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh har dar sobhaa paae |
English: The Gurmukhs are honored in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh vichahu aap gavaae |
English: The Gurmukhs eradicate selfishness and conceit from within.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਕੁਲ ਸਗਲੇ ਤਾਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aap tarai kul sagale taare guramukh janam savaaraniaa |3|
English: They save themselves, and save all their families and ancestors as well. The Gurmukhs redeem their lives. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਸਰੀਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh dukh kade na lagai sareer |
English: The Gurmukhs never suffer bodily pain.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਚੂਕੈ ਪੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh haumai chookai peer |
English: The Gurmukhs have the pain of egotism taken away.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: guramukh man niramal fir mail na laagai guramukh sehaj samaavaniaa |4|
English: The minds of the Gurmukhs are immaculate and pure; no filth ever sticks to them again. The Gurmukhs merge in celestial peace. ||4||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh naam milai vaddiaaee |
English: The Gurmukhs obtain the Greatness of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh gun gaavai sobhaa paaee |
English: The Gurmukhs sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and obtain honor.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: sadaa anand rahai din raatee guramukh sabad karaavaniaa |5|
English: They remain in bliss forever, day and night. The Gurmukhs practice the Word of the Shabad. ||5||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh anadin sabade raataa |
English: The Gurmukhs are attuned to the Shabad, night and day.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਹੈ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh jug chaare hai jaataa |
English: The Gurmukhs are known throughout the four ages.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: guramukh gun gaavai sadaa niramal sabade bhagat karaavaniaa |6|
English: The Gurmukhs always sing the Glorious Praises of the Immaculate Lord. Through the Shabad, they practice devotional worship. ||6||

Gurbani: ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਅੰਧ ਅੰਧਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: baajh guroo hai andh andhaaraa |
English: Without the Guru, there is only pitch-black darkness.

Gurbani: ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ਗਰਠੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jamakaal garatthe kareh pukaaraa |
English: Seized by the Messenger of Death, people cry out and scream.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰੋਗੀ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕੇ ਕੀੜੇ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: anadin rogee bisattaa ke keerre bisattaa meh dukh paavaniaa |7|
English: Night and day, they are diseased, like maggots in manure, and in manure they endure agony. ||7||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh aape kare karaae |
English: The Gurmukhs know that the Lord alone acts, and causes others to act.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵੁਠਾ ਆਪਿ ਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh hiradai vutthaa aap aae |
English: In the hearts of the Gurmukhs, the Lord Himself comes to dwell.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੫॥੨੬॥
Transliteration: naanak naam milai vaddiaaee poore gur te paavaniaa |8|25|26|
English: O Nanak, through the Naam, greatness is obtained. It is received from the Perfect Guru. ||8||25||26||

[Ang 125 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 |
English: Maajh, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਏਕਾ ਜੋਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਹੈ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: ekaa jot jot hai sareeraa |
English: The One Light is the light of all bodies.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabad dikhaae satigur pooraa |
English: The Perfect True Guru reveals it through the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਫਰਕੁ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aape farak keeton ghatt antar aape banat banaavaniaa |1|
English: He Himself instills the sense of separation within our hearts; He Himself created the Creation. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau vaaree jeeo vaaree har sache ke gun gaavaniaa |
English: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who sing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੋ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: baajh guroo ko sehaj na paae guramukh sehaj samaavaniaa |1| rahaau |
English: Without the Guru, no one obtains intuitive wisdom; the Gurmukh is absorbed in intuitive peace. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਗੁ ਮੋਹਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: toon aape soheh aape jag moheh |
English: You Yourself are Beautiful, and You Yourself entice the world.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰੀ ਜਗਤੁ ਪਰੋਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: toon aape nadaree jagat paroveh |
English: You Yourself, by Your Kind Mercy, weave the thread of the world.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: toon aape dukh sukh deveh karate guramukh har dekhaavaniaa |2|
English: You Yourself bestow pain and pleasure, O Creator. The Lord reveals Himself to the Gurmukh. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aape karataa kare karaae |
English: The Creator Himself acts, and causes others to act.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aape sabad gur man vasaae |
English: Through Him, the Word of the Guru's Shabad is enshrined within the mind.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੇ ਉਪਜੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sabade upajai amrit baanee guramukh aakh sunaavaniaa |3|
English: The Ambrosial Word of the Guru's Bani emanates from the Word of the Shabad. The Gurmukh speaks it and hears it. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਭੁਗਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape karataa aape bhugataa |
English: He Himself is the Creator, and He Himself is the Enjoyer.

Gurbani: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋੜੇ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: bandhan torre sadaa hai mukataa |
English: One who breaks out of bondage is liberated forever.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੈ ਸਚਾ ਆਪੇ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: sadaa mukat aape hai sachaa aape alakh lakhaavaniaa |4|
English: The True Lord is liberated forever. The Unseen Lord causes Himself to be seen. ||4||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਆਪੇ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aape maaeaa aape chhaaeaa |
English: He Himself is Maya, and He Himself is the Illusion.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aape mohu sabh jagat upaaeaa |
English: He Himself has generated emotional attachment throughout the entire universe.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: aape gunadaataa gun gaavai aape aakh sunaavaniaa |5|
English: He Himself is the Giver of Virtue; He Himself sings the Lord's Glorious Praises. He chants them and causes them to be heard. ||5||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: aape kare karaae aape |
English: He Himself acts, and causes others to act.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੇ ਆਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: aape thaap uthaape aape |
English: He Himself establishes and disestablishes.

Gurbani: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: tujh te baahar kachhoo na hovai toon aape kaarai laavaniaa |6|
English: Without You, nothing can be done. You Yourself have engaged all in their tasks. ||6||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਜੀਵਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aape maare aap jeevaae |
English: He Himself kills, and He Himself revives.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aape mele mel milaae |
English: He Himself unites us, and unites us in Union with Himself.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: sevaa te sadaa sukh paaeaa guramukh sehaj samaavaniaa |7|
English: Through selfless service, eternal peace is obtained. The Gurmukh is absorbed in intuitive peace. ||7||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਊਚਾ ਊਚੋ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aape aoochaa aoocho hoee |
English: He Himself is the Highest of the High.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਵਿਖਾਲੇ ਸੁ ਵੇਖੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jis aap vikhaale su vekhai koee |
English: How rare are those who behold Him. He causes Himself to be seen.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਖਾਲਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੬॥੨੭॥
Transliteration: naanak naam vasai ghatt antar aape vekh vikhaalaniaa |8|26|27|
English: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within the hearts of those who see the Lord themselves, and inspire others to see Him as well. ||8||26||27||

[Ang 126 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 |
English: Maajh, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: meraa prabh bharapoor rahiaa sabh thaaee |
English: My God is pervading and permeating all places.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee ghar hee meh paaee |
English: By Guru's Grace, I have found Him within the home of my own heart.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਰੇਵੀ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sadaa sarevee ik man dhiaaee guramukh sach samaavaniaa |1|
English: I serve Him constantly, and I meditate on Him single-mindedly. As Gurmukh, I am absorbed in the True One. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau vaaree jeeo vaaree jagajeevan man vasaavaniaa |
English: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Lord, the Life of the World, within their minds.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har jagajeevan nirbhau daataa guramat sehaj samaavaniaa |1| rahaau |
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, I merge with intuitive ease into the Lord, the Life of the World, the Fearless One, the Great Giver. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਧਉਲੁ ਪਾਤਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: ghar meh dharatee dhaul paataalaa |
English: Within the home of the self is the earth, its support and the nether regions of the underworld.

Gurbani: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਬਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: ghar hee meh preetam sadaa hai baalaa |
English: Within the home of the self is the Eternally Young Beloved.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sadaa anand rahai sukhadaataa guramat sehaj samaavaniaa |2|
English: The Giver of peace is eternally blissful. Through the Guru's Teachings, we are absorbed in intuitive peace. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa andar haumai meraa |
English: When the body is filled with ego and selfishness,

Gurbani: ਜੰਮਣ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ਫੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaman maran na chookai feraa |
English: the cycle of birth and death does not end.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੇ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: guramukh hovai su haumai maare sacho sach dhiaavaniaa |3|
English: One who becomes Gurmukh subdues egotism, and meditates on the Truest of the True. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਦੁਇ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa andar paap pun due bhaaee |
English: Within this body are the two brothers, sin and virtue.

Gurbani: ਦੁਹੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੈ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: duhee mil kai srisatt upaaee |
English: When the two joined together, the Universe was produced.

Gurbani: ਦੋਵੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਇਕਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: dovai maar jaae ikat ghar aavai guramat sehaj samaavaniaa |4|
English: Subduing both, and entering into the Home of the One, through the Guru's Teachings, we are absorbed in intuitive peace. ||4||

Gurbani: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਅਨੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: ghar hee maeh doojai bhaae aneraa |
English: Within the home of the self is the darkness of the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਚਾਨਣੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਛੋਡੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: chaanan hovai chhoddai haumai meraa |
English: When the Divine Light dawns, ego and selfishness are dispelled.

Gurbani: ਪਰਗਟੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: paragatt sabad hai sukhadaataa anadin naam dhiaavaniaa |5|
English: The Giver of peace is revealed through the Shabad, meditating upon the Naam, night and day. ||5||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: antar jot paragatt paasaaraa |
English: Deep within the self is the Light of God; It radiates throughout the expanse of His creation.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸਾਖੀ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur saakhee mittiaa andhiaaraa |
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, the darkness of spiritual ignorance is dispelled.

Gurbani: ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਾਸਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: kamal bigaas sadaa sukh paaeaa jotee jot milaavaniaa |6|
English: The heart-lotus blossoms forth, and eternal peace is obtained, as one's light merges into the Light. ||6||

Gurbani: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮਹਲ ਰਤਨੀ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: andar mehal ratanee bhare bhanddaaraa |
English: Within the mansion is the treasure house, overflowing with jewels.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh paae naam apaaraa |
English: The Gurmukh obtains the Infinite Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਣਜੇ ਸਦਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: guramukh vanaje sadaa vaapaaree laahaa naam sad paavaniaa |7|
English: The Gurmukh, the trader, always purchases the merchandise of the Naam, and always reaps profits. ||7||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਵਥੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: aape vath raakhai aape dee |
English: The Lord Himself keeps this merchandise in stock, and He Himself distributes it.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਣਜਹਿ ਕੇਈ ਕੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh vanajeh keee kee |
English: Rare is that Gurmukh who trades in this.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੭॥੨੮॥
Transliteration: naanak jis nadar kare so paae kar kirapaa man vasaavaniaa |8|27|28|
English: O Nanak, those upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, obtain it. Through His Mercy, it is enshrined in the mind. ||8||27||28||

[Ang 126 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 |
English: Maajh, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: har aape mele sev karaae |
English: The Lord Himself leads us to merge with Him and serve Him.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਭਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad bhaau doojaa jaae |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the love of duality is eradicated.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har niramal sadaa gunadaataa har gun meh aap samaavaniaa |1|
English: The Immaculate Lord is the Bestower of eternal virtue. The Lord Himself leads us to merge in His Virtuous Goodness. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau vaaree jeeo vaaree sach sachaa hiradai vasaavaniaa |
English: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Truest of the True within their hearts.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa naam sadaa hai niramal gurasabadee man vasaavaniaa |1| rahaau |
English: The True Name is eternally pure and immaculate. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it is enshrined within the mind. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਕਰਮਿ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape gur daataa karam bidhaataa |
English: The Guru Himself is the Giver, the Architect of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: sevak seveh guramukh har jaataa |
English: The Gurmukh, the humble servant who serves the Lord, comes to know Him.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਦਾ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: amrit naam sadaa jan soheh guramat har ras paavaniaa |2|
English: Those humble beings look beautiful forever in the Ambrosial Naam. Through the Guru's Teachings, they receive the sublime essence of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਗੁਫਾ ਮਹਿ ਇਕੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: eis gufaa meh ik thaan suhaaeaa |
English: Within the cave of this body, there is one beautiful place.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: poorai gur haumai bharam chukaaeaa |
English: Through the Perfect Guru, ego and doubt are dispelled.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: anadin naam salaahan rang raate gur kirapaa te paavaniaa |3|
English: Night and day, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord; imbued with the Lord's Love, by Guru's Grace, you shall find Him. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਇਹੁ ਗੁਫਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad ihu gufaa veechaare |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, search this cave.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: naam niranjan antar vasai muraare |
English: The Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within the self.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਏ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: har gun gaavai sabad suhaae mil preetam sukh paavaniaa |4|
English: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and decorate yourself with the Shabad. Meeting with your Beloved, you shall find peace. ||4||

Gurbani: ਜਮੁ ਜਾਗਾਤੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਕਰੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jam jaagaatee doojai bhaae kar laae |
English: The Messenger of Death imposes his tax on those who are attached to duality.

Gurbani: ਨਾਵਹੁ ਭੂਲੇ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: naavahu bhoole dee sajaae |
English: He inflicts punishment on those who forget the Name.

Gurbani: ਘੜੀ ਮੁਹਤ ਕਾ ਲੇਖਾ ਲੇਵੈ ਰਤੀਅਹੁ ਮਾਸਾ ਤੋਲ ਕਢਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: gharree muhat kaa lekhaa levai rateeahu maasaa tol kadtaavaniaa |5|
English: They are called to account for each instant and each moment. Every grain, every particle, is weighed and counted. ||5||

Gurbani: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਚੇਤੇ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: peeearrai pir chete naahee |
English: One who does not remember her Husband Lord in this world is being cheated by duality;

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਮੁਠੀ ਰੋਵੈ ਧਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: doojai mutthee rovai dhaahee |
English: She shall weep bitterly in the end.

Gurbani: ਖਰੀ ਕੁਆਲਿਓ ਕੁਰੂਪਿ ਕੁਲਖਣੀ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: kharee kuaalio kuroop kulakhanee supanai pir nahee paavaniaa |6|
English: She is from an evil family; she is ugly and vile. Even in her dreams, she does not meet her Husband Lord. ||6||

Gurbani: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: peeearrai pir man vasaaeaa |
English: She who enshrines her Husband Lord in her mind in this world

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: poorai gur hadoor dikhaaeaa |
English: His Presence is revealed to her by the Perfect Guru.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਸਬਦੇ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੈ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: kaaman pir raakhiaa kantth laae sabade pir raavai sej suhaavaniaa |7|
English: That soul-bride keeps her Husband Lord clasped tightly to her heart, and through the Word of the Shabad, she enjoys her Husband Lord upon His Beautiful Bed. ||7||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਸਦਿ ਬੁਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aape devai sad bulaae |
English: The Lord Himself sends out the call, and He summons us to His Presence.

Gurbani: ਆਪਣਾ ਨਾਉ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aapanaa naau man vasaae |
English: He enshrines His Name within our minds.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੮॥੨੯॥
Transliteration: naanak naam milai vaddiaaee anadin sadaa gun gaavaniaa |8|28|29|
English: O Nanak, one who receives the greatness of the Naam night and day, constantly sings His Glorious Praises. ||8||28||29||

[Ang 127 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 |
English: Maajh, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਊਤਮ ਜਨਮੁ ਸੁਥਾਨਿ ਹੈ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aootam janam suthaan hai vaasaa |
English: Sublime is their birth, and the place where they dwell.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਘਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: satigur seveh ghar maeh udaasaa |
English: Those who serve the True Guru remain detached in the home of their own being.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har rang raheh sadaa rang raate har ras man tripataavaniaa |1|
English: They abide in the Lord's Love, and constantly imbued with His Love, their minds are satisfied and fulfilled with the Lord's Essence. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਪੜਿ ਬੁਝਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau vaaree jeeo vaaree parr bujh man vasaavaniaa |
English: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who read of the Lord, who understand and enshrine Him within their minds.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੜਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਹਿ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh parreh har naam salaaheh dar sachai sobhaa paavaniaa |1| rahaau |
English: The Gurmukhs read and praise the Lord's Name; they are honored in the True Court. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: alakh abheo har rahiaa samaae |
English: The Unseen and Inscrutable Lord is permeating and pervading everywhere.

Gurbani: ਉਪਾਇ ਨ ਕਿਤੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aupaae na kitee paaeaa jaae |
English: He cannot be obtained by any effort.

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਨਦਰੀ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kirapaa kare taa satigur bhettai nadaree mel milaavaniaa |2|
English: If the Lord grants His Grace, then we come to meet the True Guru. By His Kindness, we are united in His Union. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪੜੈ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
Transliteration: doojai bhaae parrai nahee boojhai |
English: One who reads, while attached to duality, does not understand.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਲੂਝੈ ॥
Transliteration: tribidh maaeaa kaaran loojhai |
English: He yearns for the three-phased Maya.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੂਟਹਿ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tribidh bandhan tootteh gurasabadee gurasabadee mukat karaavaniaa |3|
English: The bonds of the three-phased Maya are broken by the Word of the Guru's Shabad. Through the Guru's Shabad, liberation is achieved. ||3||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਚੰਚਲੁ ਵਸਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: eihu man chanchal vas na aavai |
English: This unstable mind cannot be held steady.

Gurbani: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: dubidhaa laagai deh dis dhaavai |
English: Attached to duality, it wanders in the ten directions.

Gurbani: ਬਿਖੁ ਕਾ ਕੀੜਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਪਚਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: bikh kaa keerraa bikh meh raataa bikh hee maeh pachaavaniaa |4|
English: It is a poisonous worm, drenched with poison, and in poison it rots away. ||4||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰੇ ਤੈ ਆਪੁ ਜਣਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: hau hau kare tai aap janaae |
English: Practicing egotism and selfishness, they try to impress others by showing off.

Gurbani: ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: bahu karam karai kichh thaae na paae |
English: They perform all sorts of rituals, but they gain no acceptance.

Gurbani: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਬਖਸੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: tujh te baahar kichhoo na hovai bakhase sabad suhaavaniaa |5|
English: Without You, Lord, nothing happens at all. You forgive those who are adorned with the Word of Your Shabad. ||5||

Gurbani: ਉਪਜੈ ਪਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: aupajai pachai har boojhai naahee |
English: They are born, and they die, but they do not understand the Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਫਿਰਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: anadin doojai bhaae firaahee |
English: Night and day, they wander, in love with duality.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਹੈ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: manamukh janam geaa hai birathaa ant geaa pachhutaavaniaa |6|
