English: The lives of the self-willed manmukhs are useless; in the end, they die, regretting and repenting. ||6||

Gurbani: ਪਿਰੁ ਪਰਦੇਸਿ ਸਿਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: pir parades sigaar banaae |
English: The Husband is away, and the wife is getting dressed up.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧੁ ਐਸੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh andh aise karam kamaae |
English: This is what the blind, self-willed manmukhs are doing.

Gurbani: ਹਲਤਿ ਨ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਲਤਿ ਨ ਢੋਈ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: halat na sobhaa palat na dtoee birathaa janam gavaavaniaa |7|
English: They are not honored in this world, and they shall find no shelter in the world hereafter. They are wasting their lives in vain. ||7||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam kinai viralai jaataa |
English: How rare are those who know the Name of the Lord!

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: poore gur kai sabad pachhaataa |
English: Through the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect Guru, the Lord is realized.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: anadin bhagat kare din raatee sahaje hee sukh paavaniaa |8|
English: Night and day, they perform the Lord's devotional service; day and night, they find intuitive peace. ||8||

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: sabh meh varatai eko soee |
English: That One Lord is pervading in all.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh viralaa boojhai koee |
English: Only a few, as Gurmukh, understand this.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੯॥੨੯॥੩੦॥
Transliteration: naanak naam rate jan soheh kar kirapaa aap milaavaniaa |9|29|30|
English: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam are beautiful. Granting His Grace, God unites them with Himself. ||9||29||30||

[Ang 128 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 |
English: Maajh, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਪੜਹਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਕਹਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh parreh panddit kahaaveh |
English: The self-willed manmukhs read and recite; they are called Pandits-spiritual scholars.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: doojai bhaae mahaa dukh paaveh |
English: But they are in love with duality, and they suffer in terrible pain.

Gurbani: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਾਤੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bikhiaa maate kichh soojhai naahee fir fir joonee aavaniaa |1|
English: Intoxicated with vice, they understand nothing at all. They are reincarnated, over and over again. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau vaaree jeeo vaaree haumai maar milaavaniaa |
English: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who subdue their ego, and unite with the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਪੀਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur sevaa te har man vasiaa har ras sehaj peeaavaniaa |1| rahaau |
English: They serve the Guru, and the Lord dwells within their minds; they intuitively drink in the sublime essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਵੇਦੁ ਪੜਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਨਹੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: ved parreh har ras nahee aaeaa |
English: The Pandits read the Vedas, but they do not obtain the Lord's essence.

Gurbani: ਵਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਮੋਹੇ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: vaad vakhaaneh mohe maaeaa |
English: Intoxicated with Maya, they argue and debate.

Gurbani: ਅਗਿਆਨਮਤੀ ਸਦਾ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: agiaanamatee sadaa andhiaaraa guramukh boojh har gaavaniaa |2|
English: The foolish intellectuals are forever in spiritual darkness. The Gurmukhs understand, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਕਥੋ ਕਥੀਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: akatho katheeai sabad suhaavai |
English: The Indescribable is described only through the beauteous Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮਨਿ ਸਚੋ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: guramatee man sacho bhaavai |
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Truth becomes pleasing to the mind.

Gurbani: ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਰਵਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਚਿ ਰੰਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sacho sach raveh din raatee ihu man sach rangaavaniaa |3|
English: Those who speak of the truest of the true, day and night-their minds are imbued with the Truth. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਸਚੋ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jo sach rate tin sacho bhaavai |
English: Those who are attuned to Truth, love the Truth.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: aape dee na pachhotaavai |
English: The Lord Himself bestows this gift; He shall not take it back.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਚੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad sadaa sach jaataa mil sache sukh paavaniaa |4|
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the True Lord is known forever; meeting the True One, peace is found. ||4||

Gurbani: ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਸਤੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: koorr kusat tinaa mail na laagai |
English: The filth of fraud and falsehood does not stick to those who,

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee anadin jaagai |
English: By Guru's Grace, remain awake and aware, night and day.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: niramal naam vasai ghatt bheetar jotee jot milaavaniaa |5|
English: The Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within their hearts; their light merges into the Light. ||5||

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਪੜਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: trai gun parreh har tat na jaaneh |
English: They read about the three qualities, but they do not know the essential reality of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮੂਲਹੁ ਭੁਲੇ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: moolahu bhule gurasabad na pachhaaneh |
English: They forget the Primal Lord, the Source of all, and they do not recognize the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹ ਬਿਆਪੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: moh biaape kichh soojhai naahee gurasabadee har paavaniaa |6|
English: They are engrossed in emotional attachment; they do not understand anything at all. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord is found. ||6||

Gurbani: ਵੇਦੁ ਪੁਕਾਰੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: ved pukaarai tribidh maaeaa |
English: The Vedas proclaim that Maya is of three qualities.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਨ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh na boojheh doojai bhaaeaa |
English: The self-willed manmukhs, in love with duality, do not understand.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਪੜਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: trai gun parreh har ek na jaaneh bin boojhe dukh paavaniaa |7|
English: They read of the three qualities, but they do not know the One Lord. Without understanding, they obtain only pain and suffering. ||7||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jaa tis bhaavai taa aap milaae |
English: When it pleases the Lord, He unites us with Himself.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gurasabadee sahasaa dookh chukaae |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, skepticism and suffering are dispelled.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਨਾਮੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੩੦॥੩੧॥
Transliteration: naanak naavai kee sachee vaddiaaee naamo man sukh paavaniaa |8|30|31|
English: O Nanak, True is the Greatness of the Name. Believing in the Name, peace is obtained. ||8||30||31||

[Ang 128 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 |
English: Maajh, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਗੁਣੁ ਸਰਗੁਣੁ ਆਪੇ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: niragun saragun aape soee |
English: The Lord Himself is Unmanifest and Unrelated; He is Manifest and Related as well.

Gurbani: ਤਤੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸੋ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: tat pachhaanai so panddit hoee |
English: Those who recognize this essential reality are the true Pandits, the spiritual scholars.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aap tarai sagale kul taarai har naam man vasaavaniaa |1|
English: They save themselves, and save all their families and ancestors as well, when they enshrine the Lord's Name in the mind. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਖਿ ਸਾਦੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau vaaree jeeo vaaree har ras chakh saad paavaniaa |
English: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who taste the essence of the Lord, and savor its taste.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har ras chaakheh se jan niramal niramal naam dhiaavaniaa |1| rahaau |
English: Those who taste this essence of the Lord are the pure, immaculate beings. They meditate on the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਨਿਹਕਰਮੀ ਜੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: so nihakaramee jo sabad beechaare |
English: Those who reflect upon the Shabad are beyond karma.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: antar tat giaan haumai maare |
English: They subdue their ego, and find the essence of wisdom, deep within their being.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਏ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮੇਟਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naam padaarath nau nidh paae trai gun mett samaavaniaa |2|
English: They obtain the nine treasures of the wealth of the Naam. Rising above the three qualities, they merge into the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰੈ ਨਿਹਕਰਮੀ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: haumai karai nihakaramee na hovai |
English: Those who act in ego do not go beyond karma.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee haumai khovai |
English: It is only by Guru's Grace that one is rid of ego.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਿਬੇਕੁ ਸਦਾ ਆਪੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: antar bibek sadaa aap veechaare gurasabadee gun gaavaniaa |3|
English: Those who have discriminating minds, continually examine their own selves. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they sing the Lord's Glorious Praises. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: har sar saagar niramal soee |
English: The Lord is the most pure and sublime Ocean.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਚੁਗਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: sant chugeh nit guramukh hoee |
English: The Saintly Gurmukhs continually peck at the Naam, like swans pecking at pearls in the ocean.

Gurbani: ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: eisanaan kareh sadaa din raatee haumai mail chukaavaniaa |4|
English: They bathe in it continually, day and night, and the filth of ego is washed away. ||4||

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੰਸਾ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: niramal hansaa prem piaar |
English: The pure swans, with love and affection,

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: har sar vasai haumai maar |
English: Dwell in the Ocean of the Lord, and subdue their ego.

Gurbani: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: ahinis preet sabad saachai har sar vaasaa paavaniaa |5|
English: Day and night, they are in love with the True Word of the Shabad. They obtain their home in the Ocean of the Lord. ||5||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਸਦਾ ਬਗੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh sadaa bag mailaa haumai mal laaee |
English: The self-willed manmukhs shall always be filthy cranes, smeared with the filth of ego.

Gurbani: ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰੈ ਪਰੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: eisanaan karai par mail na jaaee |
English: They may bathe, but their filth is not removed.

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: jeevat marai gurasabad beechaarai haumai mail chukaavaniaa |6|
English: One who dies while yet alive, and contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad, is rid of this filth of ego. ||6||

Gurbani: ਰਤਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਘਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: ratan padaarath ghar te paaeaa |
English: The Priceless Jewel is found, in the home of one's own being,

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: poorai satigur sabad sunaaeaa |
English: when one listens to the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect True Guru.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਨਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: gur parasaad mittiaa andhiaaraa ghatt chaanan aap pachhaananiaa |7|
English: By Guru's Grace, the darkness of spiritual ignorance is dispelled; I have come to recognize the Divine Light within my own heart. ||7||

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਤੈ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: aap upaae tai aape vekhai |
English: The Lord Himself creates, and He Himself beholds.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਲੇਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sevai so jan lekhai |
English: Serving the True Guru, one becomes acceptable.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੩੧॥੩੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naam vasai ghatt antar gur kirapaa te paavaniaa |8|31|32|
English: O Nanak, the Naam dwells deep within the heart; by Guru's Grace, it is obtained. ||8||31||32||

[Ang 129 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 |
English: Maajh, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohu jagat sabaaeaa |
English: The whole world is engrossed in emotional attachment to Maya.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਦੀਸਹਿ ਮੋਹੇ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: trai gun deeseh mohe maaeaa |
English: Those who are controlled by the three qualities are attached to Maya.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਚਉਥੈ ਪਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee ko viralaa boojhai chauthai pad liv laavaniaa |1|
English: By Guru's Grace, a few come to understand; they center their consciousness in the fourth state. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau vaaree jeeo vaaree maaeaa mohu sabad jalaavaniaa |
English: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who burn away their emotional attachment to Maya, through the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਜਲਾਏ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਮਹਲੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohu jalaae so har siau chit laae har dar mahalee sobhaa paavaniaa |1| rahaau |
English: Those who burn away this attachment to Maya, and focus their consciousness on the Lord are honored in the True Court, and the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: devee devaa mool hai maaeaa |
English: The source, the root, of the gods and goddesses is Maya.

Gurbani: ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਜਿੰਨਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sinmrit saasat jin upaaeaa |
English: For them, the Simritees and the Shaastras were composed.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ਆਇ ਜਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh pasariaa sansaare aae jaae dukh paavaniaa |2|
English: Sexual desire and anger are diffused throughout the universe. Coming and going, people suffer in pain. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ ਇਕੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tis vich giaan ratan ik paaeaa |
English: The jewel of spiritual wisdom was placed within the universe.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee man vasaaeaa |
English: By Guru's Grace, it is enshrined within the mind.

Gurbani: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jat sat sanjam sach kamaavai gur poorai naam dhiaavaniaa |3|
English: Celibacy, chastity, self-discipline and the practice of truthfulness are obtained from the Perfect Guru, by meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਧਨ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: peeearrai dhan bharam bhulaanee |
English: In this world of her parents' home, the soul-bride has been deluded by doubt.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਗੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੋਤਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: doojai laagee fir pachhotaanee |
English: Attached to duality, she later comes to regret it.

Gurbani: ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਦੋਵੈ ਗਵਾਏ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: halat palat dovai gavaae supanai sukh na paavaniaa |4|
English: She forfeits both this world and the next, and even in her dreams, she does not find peace. ||4||

Gurbani: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਧਨ ਕੰਤੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: peeearrai dhan kant samaale |
English: The soul-bride who remembers her Husband Lord in this world,

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਵੇਖੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee vekhai naale |
English: by Guru's Grace, sees Him close at hand.

Gurbani: ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਿੰਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: pir kai sehaj rahai rang raatee sabad singaar banaavaniaa |5|
English: She remains intuitively attuned to the Love of her Beloved; she makes the Word of His Shabad her decoration. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: safal janam jinaa satigur paaeaa |
English: Blessed and fruitful is the coming of those who find the True Guru;

Gurbani: ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: doojaa bhaau gur sabad jalaaeaa |
English: through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they burn their love of duality.

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: eko rav rahiaa ghatt antar mil satasangat har gun gaavaniaa |6|
English: The One Lord is permeating and pervading deep within the heart. Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||6||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਕਾਹੇ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: satigur na seve so kaahe aaeaa |
English: Those who do not serve the True Guru-why did they even come into this world?

Gurbani: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: dhrig jeevan birathaa janam gavaaeaa |
English: Cursed are their lives; they have uselessly wasted this human life.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: manamukh naam chit na aavai bin naavai bahu dukh paavaniaa |7|
English: The self-willed manmukhs do not remember the Naam. Without the Naam, they suffer in terrible pain. ||7||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਸਾਜੀ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: jin sisatt saajee soee jaanai |
English: The One who created the Universe, He alone knows it.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: aape melai sabad pachhaanai |
English: He unites with Himself those who realize the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਜਿਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧॥੩੨॥੩੩॥
Transliteration: naanak naam miliaa tin jan kau jin dhur masatak lekh likhaavaniaa |8|1|32|33|
English: O Nanak, they alone receive the Naam, upon whose foreheads such pre-ordained destiny is recorded. ||8||1||32||33||

[Ang 129 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 4 |
English: Maajh, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਆਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: aad purakh aparanpar aape |
English: The Primal Being is Himself remote and beyond.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਥਾਪੇ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: aape thaape thaap uthaape |
English: He Himself establishes, and having established, He disestablishes.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sabh meh varatai eko soee guramukh sobhaa paavaniaa |1|
English: The One Lord is pervading in all; those who become Gurmukh are honored. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau vaaree jeeo vaaree nirankaaree naam dhiaavaniaa |
English: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Formless Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tis roop na rekhiaa ghatt ghatt dekhiaa guramukh alakh lakhaavaniaa |1| rahaau |
English: He has no form or shape; He is seen within each and every heart. The Gurmukh comes to know the unknowable. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: too deaal kirapaal prabh soee |
English: You are God, Kind and Merciful.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: tudh bin doojaa avar na koee |
English: Without You, there is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਸਾਦੁ ਕਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur parasaad kare naam devai naame naam samaavaniaa |2|
English: When the Guru showers His Grace upon us, He blesses us with the Naam; through the Naam, we merge in the Naam. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਸਚਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: toon aape sachaa sirajanahaaraa |
English: You Yourself are the True Creator Lord.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤੀ ਭਰੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: bhagatee bhare tere bhanddaaraa |
English: Your treasures are overflowing with devotional worship.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: guramukh naam milai man bheejai sehaj samaadh lagaavaniaa |3|
English: The Gurmukhs obtain the Naam. Their minds are enraptured, and they easily and intuitively enter into Samaadhi. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: anadin gun gaavaa prabh tere |
English: Night and day, I sing Your Glorious Praises, God.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: tudh saalaahee preetam mere |
English: I praise You, O my Beloved.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਚਾ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਤੂੰ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: tudh bin avar na koee jaachaa gur parasaadee toon paavaniaa |4|
English: Without You, there is no other for me to seek out. It is only by Guru's Grace that You are found. ||4||

Gurbani: ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਮਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: agam agochar mit nahee paaee |
English: The limits of the Inaccessible and Incomprehensible Lord cannot be found.

Gurbani: ਅਪਣੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਲੈਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: apanee kripaa kareh toon laihi milaaee |
English: Bestowing Your Mercy, You merge us into Yourself.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: poore gur kai sabad dhiaaeeai sabad sev sukh paavaniaa |5|
English: Through the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect Guru, we meditate on the Lord. Serving the Shabad, peace is found. ||5||

Gurbani: ਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: rasanaa gunavantee gun gaavai |
English: Praiseworthy is the tongue which sings the Lord's Glorious Praises.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਸਚੇ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: naam salaahe sache bhaavai |
English: Praising the Naam, one becomes pleasing to the True One.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਚੇ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: guramukh sadaa rahai rang raatee mil sache sobhaa paavaniaa |6|
English: The Gurmukh remains forever imbued with the Lord's Love. Meeting the True Lord, glory is obtained. ||6||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh karam kare ahankaaree |
English: The self-willed manmukhs do their deeds in ego.

Gurbani: ਜੂਐ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਭ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jooai janam sabh baajee haaree |
English: They lose their whole lives in the gamble.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਮਹਾ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: antar lobh mahaa gubaaraa fir fir aavan jaavaniaa |7|
English: Within is the terrible darkness of greed, and so they come and go in reincarnation, over and over again. ||7||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: aape karataa de vaddiaaee |
English: The Creator Himself bestows Glory

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਆਪਿ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jin kau aap likhat dhur paaee |
English: On those whom He Himself has so pre-destined.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧॥੩੪॥
Transliteration: naanak naam milai bhau bhanjan gurasabadee sukh paavaniaa |8|1|34|
English: O Nanak, they receive the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the Destroyer of fear; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they find peace. ||8||1||34||

[Ang 130 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ghar 1 |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl, First House:

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਲਖਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: antar alakh na jaaee lakhiaa |
English: The Unseen Lord is within, but He cannot be seen.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਲੈ ਗੁਝਾ ਰਖਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: naam ratan lai gujhaa rakhiaa |
English: He has taken the Jewel of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and He keeps it well concealed.

Gurbani: ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: agam agochar sabh te aoochaa gur kai sabad lakhaavaniaa |1|
English: The Inaccessible and Incomprehensible Lord is the highest of all. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is known. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau vaaree jeeo vaaree kal meh naam sunaavaniaa |
English: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who chant the Naam, in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਚੈ ਧਾਰੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sant piaare sachai dhaare vaddabhaagee darasan paavaniaa |1| rahaau |
English: The Beloved Saints were established by the True Lord. By great good fortune, the Blessed Vision of their Darshan is obtained. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਜਿਸੈ ਕਉ ਫਿਰਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: saadhik sidh jisai kau firade |
English: The One who is sought by the Siddhas and the seekers,

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਹਿਰਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: brahame indr dhiaaein hirade |
English: upon whom Brahma and Indra meditate within their hearts,

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਤੇਤੀਸਾ ਖੋਜਹਿ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kott teteesaa khojeh taa kau gur mil hiradai gaavaniaa |2|
English: whom the three hundred thirty million demi-gods search for-meeting the Guru, one comes to sing His Praises within the heart. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤੁਧੁ ਜਾਪੇ ਪਵਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar tudh jaape pavanaa |
English: Twenty-four hours a day, the wind breathes Your Name.

Gurbani: ਧਰਤੀ ਸੇਵਕ ਪਾਇਕ ਚਰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: dharatee sevak paaeik charanaa |
English: The earth is Your servant, a slave at Your Feet.

Gurbani: ਖਾਣੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਸਭਨਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: khaanee baanee sarab nivaasee sabhanaa kai man bhaavaniaa |3|
English: In the four sources of creation, and in all speech, You dwell. You are dear to the minds of all. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: saachaa saahib guramukh jaapai |
English: The True Lord and Master is known to the Gurmukhs.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਿਞਾਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: poore gur kai sabad siyaapai |
English: He is realized through the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect Guru.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਪੀਆ ਸੇਈ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੇ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਅਘਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jin peea seee tripataase sache sach aghaavaniaa |4|
English: Those who drink it in are satisfied. Through the Truest of the True, they are fulfilled. ||4||

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਘਰਿ ਸਹਜਾ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: tis ghar sahajaa soee suhelaa |
English: In the home of their own beings, they are peacefully and comfortably at ease.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਕਰੇ ਸਦ ਕੇਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: anad binod kare sad kelaa |
English: They are blissful, enjoying pleasures, and eternally joyful.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਧਨਵੰਤਾ ਸੋ ਵਡ ਸਾਹਾ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: so dhanavantaa so vadd saahaa jo gur charanee man laavaniaa |5|
English: They are wealthy, and the greatest kings; they center their minds on the Guru's Feet. ||5||

Gurbani: ਪਹਿਲੋ ਦੇ ਤੈਂ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਮਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: pahilo de tain rijak samaahaa |
English: First, You created nourishment;

Gurbani: ਪਿਛੋ ਦੇ ਤੈਂ ਜੰਤੁ ਉਪਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: pichho de tain jant upaahaa |
English: then, You created the living beings.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: tudh jevadd daataa avar na suaamee lavai na koee laavaniaa |6|
English: There is no other Giver as Great as You, O my Lord and Master. None approach or equal You. ||6||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਤੁਠਾ ਸੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: jis toon tutthaa so tudh dhiaae |
English: Those who are pleasing to You meditate on You.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: saadh janaa kaa mantru kamaae |
English: They practice the Mantra of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਠਾਕ ਨ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: aap tarai sagale kul taare tis daragah tthaak na paavaniaa |7|
English: They themselves swim across, and they save all their ancestors and families as well. In the Court of the Lord, they meet with no obstruction. ||7||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਵਡਾ ਤੂੰ ਊਚੋ ਊਚਾ ॥
Transliteration: toon vaddaa toon aoocho aoochaa |
English: You are so Great! You are the Highest of the High!

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਅਤਿ ਮੂਚੋ ਮੂਚਾ ॥
Transliteration: toon beant at moocho moochaa |
English: You are Infinite, You are Everything!

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਤੇਰੈ ਵੰਞਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧॥੩੫॥
Transliteration: hau kurabaanee terai vanyaa naanak daas dasaavaniaa |8|1|35|
English: I am a sacrifice to You. Nanak is the slave of Your slaves. ||8||1||35||

[Ang 131 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaun su mukataa kaun su jugataa |
English: Who is liberated, and who is united?

Gurbani: ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਬਕਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaun su giaanee kaun su bakataa |
English: Who is a spiritual teacher, and who is a preacher?

Gurbani: ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਕਉਣੁ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kaun su girahee kaun udaasee kaun su keemat paae jeeo |1|
English: Who is a house-holder, and who is a renunciate? Who can estimate the Lord's Value? ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਾਧਾ ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਛੂਟਾ ॥
Transliteration: kin bidh baadhaa kin bidh chhoottaa |
English: How is one bound, and how is one freed of his bonds?

Gurbani: ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਵਣੁ ਤੂਟਾ ॥
Transliteration: kin bidh aavan jaavan toottaa |
English: How can one escape from the cycle of coming and going in reincarnation?

Gurbani: ਕਉਣ ਕਰਮ ਕਉਣ ਨਿਹਕਰਮਾ ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kaun karam kaun nihakaramaa kaun su kahai kahaae jeeo |2|
English: Who is subject to karma, and who is beyond karma? Who chants the Name, and inspires others to chant it? ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਦੁਖੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: kaun su sukheea kaun su dukheea |
English: Who is happy, and who is sad?

Gurbani: ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਸਨਮੁਖੁ ਕਉਣੁ ਵੇਮੁਖੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: kaun su sanamukh kaun vemukheea |
English: Who, as sunmukh, turns toward the Guru, and who, as vaymukh, turns away from the Guru?

Gurbani: ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਛੁਰੈ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਉਣੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kin bidh mileeai kin bidh bichhurai ih bidh kaun pragattaae jeeo |3|
English: How can one meet the Lord? How is one separated from Him? Who can reveal the way to me? ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਅਖਰੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਰਹਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaun su akhar jit dhaavat rahataa |
English: What is that Word, by which the wandering mind can be restrained?

Gurbani: ਕਉਣੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਸਹਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaun upades jit dukh sukh sam sahataa |
English: What are those teachings, by which we may endure pain and pleasure alike?

Gurbani: ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਚਾਲ ਜਿਤੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: kaun su chaal jit paarabraham dhiaae kin bidh keeratan gaae jeeo |4|
English: What is that lifestyle, by which we may come to meditate on the Supreme Lord? How may we sing the Kirtan of His Praises? ||4||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh mukataa guramukh jugataa |
English: The Gurmukh is liberated, and the Gurmukh is linked.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਕਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh giaanee guramukh bakataa |
English: The Gurmukh is the spiritual teacher, and the Gurmukh is the preacher.

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: dhan girahee udaasee guramukh guramukh keemat paae jeeo |5|
English: Blessed is the Gurmukh, the householder and the renunciate. The Gurmukh knows the Lord's Value. ||5||

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਬਾਧਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਛੂਟਾ ॥
Transliteration: haumai baadhaa guramukh chhoottaa |
English: Egotism is bondage; as Gurmukh, one is emancipated.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਵਣੁ ਤੂਟਾ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh aavan jaavan toottaa |
English: The Gurmukh escapes the cycle of coming and going in reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਮ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਹਕਰਮਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਸੁਭਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: guramukh karam guramukh nihakaramaa guramukh kare su subhaae jeeo |6|
English: The Gurmukh performs actions of good karma, and the Gurmukh is beyond karma. Whatever the Gurmukh does, is done in good faith. ||6||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦੁਖੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh sukheea manamukh dukheea |
English: The Gurmukh is happy, while the self-willed manmukh is sad.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਨਮੁਖੁ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਵੇਮੁਖੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh sanamukh manamukh vemukheea |
English: The Gurmukh turns toward the Guru, and the self-willed manmukh turns away from the Guru.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਛੁਰੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: guramukh mileeai manamukh vichhurai guramukh bidh pragattaae jeeo |7|
English: The Gurmukh is united with the Lord, while the manmukh is separated from Him. The Gurmukh reveals the way. ||7||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਖਰੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਰਹਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh akhar jit dhaavat rahataa |
English: The Guru's Instruction is the Word, by which the wandering mind is restrained.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਸਹਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh upades dukh sukh sam sahataa |
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, we can endure pain and pleasure alike.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਾਲ ਜਿਤੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: guramukh chaal jit paarabraham dhiaae guramukh keeratan gaae jeeo |8|
English: To live as Gurmukh is the lifestyle by which we come to meditate on the Supreme Lord. The Gurmukh sings the Kirtan of His Praises. ||8||

Gurbani: ਸਗਲੀ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ਆਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: sagalee banat banaaee aape |
English: The Lord Himself created the entire creation.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਥਾਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: aape kare karaae thaape |
English: He Himself acts, and causes others to act. He Himself establishes.

Gurbani: ਇਕਸੁ ਤੇ ਹੋਇਓ ਅਨੰਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੯॥੨॥੩੬॥
Transliteration: eikas te hoeo anantaa naanak ekas maeh samaae jeeo |9|2|36|
English: From oneness, He has brought forth the countless multitudes. O Nanak, they shall merge into the One once again. ||9||2||36||

[Ang 131 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਾੜਾ ॥
Transliteration: prabh abinaasee taa kiaa kaarraa |
English: God is Eternal and Imperishable, so why should anyone be anxious?

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ਤਾ ਜਨੁ ਖਰਾ ਸੁਖਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: har bhagavantaa taa jan kharaa sukhaalaa |
English: The Lord is Wealthy and Prosperous, so His humble servant should feel totally secure.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮਾਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jeea praan maan sukhadaataa toon kareh soee sukh paavaniaa |1|
English: O Giver of peace of the soul, of life, of honor-as You ordain, I obtain peace. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਭਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau vaaree jeeo vaaree guramukh man tan bhaavaniaa |
English: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to that Gurmukh whose mind and body are pleased with You.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਰਬਤੁ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਓਲਾ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: toon meraa parabat toon meraa olaa tum sang lavai na laavaniaa |1| rahaau |
English: You are my mountain, You are my shelter and shield. No one can rival You. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: teraa keetaa jis laagai meetthaa |
English: That person, unto whom Your actions seem sweet,

Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਡੀਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt paarabraham tin jan ddeetthaa |
English: comes to see the Supreme Lord God in each and every heart.

Gurbani: ਥਾਨਿ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਇਕੋ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: thaan thanantar toonhai toonhai iko ik varataavaniaa |2|
English: In all places and interspaces, You exist. You are the One and Only Lord, pervading everywhere. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sagal manorath toon devanahaaraa |
English: You are the Fulfiller of all the mind's desires.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤੀ ਭਾਇ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: bhagatee bhaae bhare bhanddaaraa |
English: Your treasures are overflowing with love and devotion.

Gurbani: ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਸੇਈ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: deaa dhaar raakhe tudh seee poorai karam samaavaniaa |3|
English: Showering Your Mercy, You protect those who, through perfect destiny, merge into You. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਕੰਢੈ ਚਾੜੇ ॥
Transliteration: andh koop te kandtai chaarre |
English: You pulled me out of the deep, dark well onto the dry ground.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦਾਸ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa daas nadar nihaale |
English: Showering Your Mercy, You blessed Your servant with Your Glance of Grace.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਕਹਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: gun gaaveh pooran abinaasee keh sun tott na aavaniaa |4|
English: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Perfect, Immortal Lord. By speaking and hearing these Praises, they are not used up. ||4||

Gurbani: ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: aithai othai toonhai rakhavaalaa |
English: Here and hereafter, You are our Protector.

Gurbani: ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਮਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: maat garabh meh tum hee paalaa |
English: In the womb of the mother, You cherish and nurture the baby.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਪੋਹੈ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: maaeaa agan na pohai tin kau rang rate gun gaavaniaa |5|
English: The fire of Maya does not affect those who are imbued with the Lord's Love; they sing His Glorious Praises. ||5||

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਆਖਿ ਸਮਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa gun tere aakh samaalee |
English: What Praises of Yours can I chant and contemplate?

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: man tan antar tudh nadar nihaalee |
English: Deep within my mind and body, I behold Your Presence.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: toon meraa meet saajan meraa suaamee tudh bin avar na jaananiaa |6|
English: You are my Friend and Companion, my Lord and Master. Without You, I do not know any other at all. ||6||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਇਆ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jis kau toon prabh bheaa sahaaee |
English: O God, that one, unto whom You have given shelter,

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਤਤੀ ਵਾਉ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਕਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: tis tatee vaau na lagai kaaee |
English: is not touched by the hot winds.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: too saahib saran sukhadaataa satasangat jap pragattaavaniaa |7|
English: O my Lord and Master, You are my Sanctuary, the Giver of peace. Chanting, meditating on You in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, You are revealed. ||7||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਊਚ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਅਮੋਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: toon aooch athaahu apaar amolaa |
English: You are Exalted, Unfathomable, Infinite and Invaluable.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਗੋਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: toon saachaa saahib daas teraa golaa |
English: You are my True Lord and Master. I am Your servant and slave.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਮੀਰਾ ਸਾਚੀ ਠਕੁਰਾਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੩॥੩੭॥
Transliteration: toon meeraa saachee tthakuraaee naanak bal bal jaavaniaa |8|3|37|
English: You are the King, Your Sovereign Rule is True. Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to You. ||8||3||37||

[Ang 132 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ghar 2 |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl, Second House:

Gurbani: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਦਯੁ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: nit nit day samaaleeai |
English: Continually, continuously, remember the Merciful Lord.

Gurbani: ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mool na manahu visaareeai | rahaau |
English: Never forget Him from your mind. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: santaa sangat paaeeai |
English: Join the Society of the Saints,

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਪੰਥਿ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: jit jam kai panth na jaaeeai |
English: and you shall not have to go down the path of Death.

Gurbani: ਤੋਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੁਲਹਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਗਾਲਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tosaa har kaa naam lai tere kuleh na laagai gaal jeeo |1|
English: Take the Provisions of the Lord's Name with you, and no stain shall attach itself to your family. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਸਿਮਰੰਦੇ ਸਾਂਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: jo simarande saaneeai |
English: Those who meditate on the Master

Gurbani: ਨਰਕਿ ਨ ਸੇਈ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: narak na seee paaeeai |
English: shall not be thrown down into hell.

Gurbani: ਤਤੀ ਵਾਉ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਆਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tatee vaau na lagee jin man vutthaa aae jeeo |2|
English: Even the hot winds shall not touch them. The Lord has come to dwell within their minds. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੇਈ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸੋਹਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: seee sundar sohane |
English: They alone are beautiful and attractive,

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਿਨ ਬੈਹਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang jin baihane |
English: who abide in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਸੰਜਿਆ ਸੇਈ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har dhan jinee sanjiaa seee ganbheer apaar jeeo |3|
English: Those who have gathered in the wealth of the Lord's Name-they alone are deep and thoughtful and vast. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਅਮਿਉ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਪੀਵੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: har amiau rasaaein peeveeai |
English: Drink in the Ambrosial Essence of the Name,

Gurbani: ਮੁਹਿ ਡਿਠੈ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਜੀਵੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: muhi dditthai jan kai jeeveeai |
English: and live by beholding the face of the Lord's servant.

Gurbani: ਕਾਰਜ ਸਭਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ਲੈ ਨਿਤ ਪੂਜਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਪਾਵ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: kaaraj sabh savaar lai nit poojahu gur ke paav jeeo |4|
English: Let all your affairs be resolved, by continually worshipping the Feet of the Guru. ||4||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਆਪਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo har keetaa aapanaa |
English: He alone meditates on the Lord of the World,

Gurbani: ਤਿਨਹਿ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਜਾਪਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: tineh gusaaee jaapanaa |
English: Whom the Lord has made His Own.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸੂਰਾ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਸੋ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਜਿਸ ਦੈ ਭਾਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: so sooraa paradhaan so masatak jis dai bhaag jeeo |5|
English: He alone is a warrior, and he alone is the chosen one, upon whose forehead good destiny is recorded. ||5||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮੰਧੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਵਗਾਹੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: man mandhe prabh avagaaheea |
English: Within my mind, I meditate on God.

Gurbani: ਏਹਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: ehi ras bhogan paatisaaheea |
English: For me, this is like the enjoyment of princely pleasures.

Gurbani: ਮੰਦਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਤਰੇ ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਗਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: mandaa mool na upajio tare sachee kaarai laag jeeo |6|
English: Evil does not well up within me, since I am saved, and dedicated to truthful actions. ||6||

Gurbani: ਕਰਤਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: karataa man vasaaeaa |
English: I have enshrined the Creator within my mind;

Gurbani: ਜਨਮੈ ਕਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: janamai kaa fal paaeaa |
English: I have obtained the fruits of life's rewards.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੰਦਾ ਕੰਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਹੋਆ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: man bhaavandaa kant har teraa thir hoaa sohaag jeeo |7|
English: If your Husband Lord is pleasing to your mind, then your married life shall be eternal. ||7||

Gurbani: ਅਟਲ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: attal padaarath paaeaa |
English: I have obtained everlasting wealth;

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bhai bhanjan kee saranaaeaa |
English: I have found the Sanctuary of the Dispeller of fear.

Gurbani: ਲਾਇ ਅੰਚਲਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾਰਿਅਨੁ ਜਿਤਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਪਾਰ ਜੀਉ ॥੮॥੪॥੩੮॥
Transliteration: laae anchal naanak taarian jitaa janam apaar jeeo |8|4|38|
English: Grasping hold of the hem of the Lord's robe, Nanak is saved. He has won the incomparable life. ||8||4||38||

[Ang 132 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ghar 3 |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl, Third House:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਪੇ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har jap jape man dheere |1| rahaau |
English: Chanting and meditating on the Lord, the mind is held steady. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਭੈ ਦੂਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: simar simar guradeo mitt ge bhai doore |1|
English: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Divine Guru, one's fears are erased and dispelled. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਰਨਿ ਆਵੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਤਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਝੂਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saran aavai paarabraham kee taa fir kaahe jhoore |2|
English: Entering the Sanctuary of the Supreme Lord God, how could anyone feel grief any longer? ||2||

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਸੇਵ ਸੰਤ ਸਾਧ ਕੇ ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: charan sev sant saadh ke sagal manorath poore |3|
English: Serving at the Feet of the Holy Saints, all desires are fulfilled. ||3||

Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਏਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰੇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt ek varatadaa jal thal maheeal poore |4|
English: In each and every heart, the One Lord is pervading. He is totally permeating the water, the land, and the sky. ||4||

Gurbani: ਪਾਪ ਬਿਨਾਸਨੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰੇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: paap binaasan seviaa pavitr santan kee dhoore |5|
English: I serve the Destroyer of sin, and I am sanctified by the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਛਡਾਈ ਖਸਮਿ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਭਈ ਠਰੂਰੇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: sabh chhaddaaee khasam aap har jap bhee ttharoore |6|
English: My Lord and Master Himself has saved me completely; I am comforted by meditating on the Lord. ||6||

Gurbani: ਕਰਤੈ ਕੀਆ ਤਪਾਵਸੋ ਦੁਸਟ ਮੁਏ ਹੋਇ ਮੂਰੇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: karatai keea tapaavaso dusatt mue hoe moore |7|
English: The Creator has passed judgement, and the evil-doers have been silenced and killed. ||7||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਤਾ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰੇ ॥੮॥੫॥੩੯॥੧॥੩੨॥੧॥੫॥੩੯॥
Transliteration: naanak rataa sach naae har vekhai sadaa hajoore |8|5|39|1|32|1|5|39|
English: Nanak is attuned to the True Name; he beholds the Presence of the Ever-present Lord. ||8||5||39||1||32||1||5||39||

[Ang 133 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਾਰਹ ਮਾਹਾ ਮਾਂਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: baarah maahaa maanjh mahalaa 5 ghar 4 |
English: Baarah Maahaa ~ The Twelve Months: Maajh, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਰਮ ਕੇ ਵੀਛੁੜੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: kirat karam ke veechhurre kar kirapaa melahu raam |
English: By the actions we have committed, we are separated from You. Please show Your Mercy, and unite us with Yourself, Lord.

Gurbani: ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਭ੍ਰਮੇ ਥਕਿ ਆਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: chaar kuntt deh dis bhrame thak aae prabh kee saam |
English: We have grown weary of wandering to the four corners of the earth and in the ten directions. We have come to Your Sanctuary, God.

Gurbani: ਧੇਨੁ ਦੁਧੈ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: dhen dudhai te baaharee kitai na aavai kaam |
English: Without milk, a cow serves no purpose.

Gurbani: ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਖ ਕੁਮਲਾਵਤੀ ਉਪਜਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਦਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: jal bin saakh kumalaavatee upajeh naahee daam |
English: Without water, the crop withers, and it will not bring a good price.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਹ ਨ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਸਾਜਨੈ ਕਤ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਸਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: har naah na mileeai saajanai kat paaeeai bisaraam |
English: If we do not meet the Lord, our Friend, how can we find our place of rest?

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਈ ਭਠਿ ਨਗਰ ਸੇ ਗ੍ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: jit ghar har kant na pragattee bhatth nagar se graam |
English: Those homes, those hearts, in which the Husband Lord is not manifest-those towns and villages are like burning furnaces.

Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰਬ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਤੰਬੋਲ ਰਸ ਸਣੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਸਭ ਖਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: srab seegaar tanbol ras san dehee sabh khaam |
English: All decorations, the chewing of betel to sweeten the breath, and the body itself, are all useless and vain.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੰਤ ਵਿਹੂਣੀਆ ਮੀਤ ਸਜਣ ਸਭਿ ਜਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: prabh suaamee kant vihooneea meet sajan sabh jaam |
English: Without God, our Husband, our Lord and Master, all friends and companions are like the Messenger of Death.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak kee benanteea kar kirapaa deejai naam |
English: This is Nanak's prayer: "Please show Your Mercy, and bestow Your Name.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਧਾਮ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har melahu suaamee sang prabh jis kaa nihachal dhaam |1|
English: O my Lord and Master, please unite me with Yourself, O God, in the Eternal Mansion of Your Presence". ||1||

[Ang 133 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਚੇਤਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਅਰਾਧੀਐ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਘਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: chet govind araadheeai hovai anand ghanaa |
English: In the month of Chayt, by meditating on the Lord of the Universe, a deep and profound joy arises.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: sant janaa mil paaeeai rasanaa naam bhanaa |
English: Meeting with the humble Saints, the Lord is found, as we chant His Name with our tongues.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਏ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਗਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: jin paaeaa prabh aapanaa aae tiseh ganaa |
English: Those who have found God-blessed is their coming into this world.

Gurbani: ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਵਣਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਜਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: eik khin tis bin jeevanaa birathaa janam janaa |
English: Those who live without Him, for even an instant-their lives are rendered useless.

Gurbani: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਿਆ ਰਵਿਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: jal thal maheeal pooriaa raviaa vich vanaa |
English: The Lord is totally pervading the water, the land, and all space. He is contained in the forests as well.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਕਿਤੜਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: so prabh chit na aavee kitarraa dukh ganaa |
English: Those who do not remember God-how much pain must they suffer!

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤਿੰਨਾ ਭਾਗੁ ਮਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: jinee raaviaa so prabhoo tinaa bhaag manaa |
English: Those who dwell upon their God have great good fortune.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੰਉ ਮਨੁ ਲੋਚਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਆਸ ਮਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: har darasan knau man lochadaa naanak piaas manaa |
English: My mind yearns for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. O Nanak, my mind is so thirsty!

Gurbani: ਚੇਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਪਾਇ ਲਗਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: chet milaae so prabhoo tis kai paae lagaa |2|
English: I touch the feet of one who unites me with God in the month of Chayt. ||2||

[Ang 133 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਵੈਸਾਖਿ ਧੀਰਨਿ ਕਿਉ ਵਾਢੀਆ ਜਿਨਾ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਿਛੋਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: vaisaakh dheeran kiau vaadteea jinaa prem bichhohu |
English: In the month of Vaisaakh, how can the bride be patient? She is separated from her Beloved.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਕੈ ਲਗੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਧੋਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: har saajan purakh visaar kai lagee maaeaa dhohu |
English: She has forgotten the Lord, her Life-companion, her Master; she has become attached to Maya, the deceitful one.

Gurbani: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਧਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਅਵਿਨਾਸੀ ਓਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: putr kalatr na sang dhanaa har avinaasee ohu |
English: Neither son, nor spouse, nor wealth shall go along with you-only the Eternal Lord.

Gurbani: ਪਲਚਿ ਪਲਚਿ ਸਗਲੀ ਮੁਈ ਝੂਠੈ ਧੰਧੈ ਮੋਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: palach palach sagalee muee jhootthai dhandhai mohu |
English: Entangled and enmeshed in the love of false occupations, the whole world is perishing.

Gurbani: ਇਕਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਗੈ ਲਈਅਹਿ ਖੋਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: eikas har ke naam bin agai leeeh khohi |
English: Without the Naam, the Name of the One Lord, they lose their lives in the hereafter.

Gurbani: ਦਯੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਵਿਗੁਚਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: day visaar viguchanaa prabh bin avar na koe |
English: Forgetting the Merciful Lord, they are ruined. Without God, there is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਚਰਣੀ ਜੋ ਲਗੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: preetam charanee jo lage tin kee niramal soe |
English: Pure is the reputation of those who are attached to the Feet of the Beloved Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak kee prabh benatee prabh milahu paraapat hoe |
English: Nanak makes this prayer to God: "Please, come and unite me with Yourself."

Gurbani: ਵੈਸਾਖੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਤਾਂ ਲਗੈ ਜਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: vaisaakh suhaavaa taan lagai jaa sant bhettai har soe |3|
English: The month of Vaisaakh is beautiful and pleasant, when the Saint causes me to meet the Lord. ||3||

[Ang 134 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੇਠਿ ਜੁੜੰਦਾ ਲੋੜੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਵੰਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: har jetth jurrandaa lorreeai jis agai sabh nivan |
English: In the month of Jayt'h, the bride longs to meet with the Lord. All bow in humility before Him.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣ ਦਾਵਣਿ ਲਗਿਆ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਬੰਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: har sajan daavan lagiaa kisai na deee ban |
English: One who has grasped the hem of the robe of the Lord, the True Friend-no one can keep him in bondage.

Gurbani: ਮਾਣਕ ਮੋਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਉਨ ਲਗੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੰਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: maanak motee naam prabh un lagai naahee san |
English: God's Name is the Jewel, the Pearl. It cannot be stolen or taken away.

Gurbani: ਰੰਗ ਸਭੇ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੈ ਜੇਤੇ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੰਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: rang sabhe naaraaeinai jete man bhaavan |
English: In the Lord are all pleasures which please the mind.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਲੋੜੇ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਜੀਅ ਕਰੰਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: jo har lorre so kare soee jeea karan |
English: As the Lord wishes, so He acts, and so His creatures act.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਤੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਸੇਈ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਧੰਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: jo prabh keete aapane seee kaheeeh dhan |
English: They alone are called blessed, whom God has made His Own.

Gurbani: ਆਪਣ ਲੀਆ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਕਿਉ ਰੋਵੰਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: aapan leea je milai vichhurr kiau rovan |
English: If people could meet the Lord by their own efforts, why would they be crying out in the pain of separation?

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਰਾਪਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੰਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: saadhoo sang paraapate naanak rang maanan |
English: Meeting Him in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, celestial bliss is enjoyed.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੇਠੁ ਰੰਗੀਲਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਧਣੀ ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਭਾਗੁ ਮਥੰਨਿ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: har jetth rangeelaa tis dhanee jis kai bhaag mathan |4|
English: In the month of Jayt'h, the playful Husband Lord meets her, upon whose forehead such good destiny is recorded. ||4||

[Ang 134 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾੜੁ ਤਪੰਦਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਹੁ ਨ ਜਿੰਨਾ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: aasaarr tapandaa tis lagai har naahu na jinaa paas |
English: The month of Aasaarh seems burning hot, to those who are not close to their Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਕੈ ਮਾਣਸ ਸੰਦੀ ਆਸ ॥
Transliteration: jagajeevan purakh tiaag kai maanas sandee aas |
English: They have forsaken God the Primal Being, the Life of the World, and they have come to rely upon mere mortals.

Gurbani: ਦੁਯੈ ਭਾਇ ਵਿਗੁਚੀਐ ਗਲਿ ਪਈਸੁ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: duyai bhaae vigucheeai gal pees jam kee faas |
English: In the love of duality, the soul-bride is ruined; around her neck she wears the noose of Death.

Gurbani: ਜੇਹਾ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋ ਲੁਣੈ ਮਥੈ ਜੋ ਲਿਖਿਆਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: jehaa beejai so lunai mathai jo likhiaas |
English: As you plant, so shall you harvest; your destiny is recorded on your forehead.

Gurbani: ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੀ ਉਠਿ ਚਲੀ ਗਈ ਨਿਰਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: rain vihaanee pachhutaanee utth chalee gee niraas |
English: The life-night passes away, and in the end, one comes to regret and repent, and then depart with no hope at all.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕੌ ਸਾਧੂ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਸੋ ਦਰਗਹ ਹੋਇ ਖਲਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: jin kau saadhoo bhetteeai so daragah hoe khalaas |
English: Those who meet with the Holy Saints are liberated in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਣੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਹੋਇ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh aapanee tere darasan hoe piaas |
English: Show Your Mercy to me, O God; I am thirsty for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: prabh tudh bin doojaa ko nahee naanak kee aradaas |
English: Without You, God, there is no other at all. This is Nanak's humble prayer.

Gurbani: ਆਸਾੜੁ ਸੁਹੰਦਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਗੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: aasaarr suhandaa tis lagai jis man har charan nivaas |5|
English: The month of Aasaarh is pleasant, when the Feet of the Lord abide in the mind. ||5||

[Ang 134 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਵਣਿ ਸਰਸੀ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: saavan sarasee kaamanee charan kamal siau piaar |
English: In the month of Saawan, the soul-bride is happy, if she falls in love with the Lotus Feet of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਸਚ ਰੰਗਿ ਇਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: man tan rataa sach rang iko naam adhaar |
English: Her mind and body are imbued with the Love of the True One; His Name is her only Support.

Gurbani: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰੰਗ ਕੂੜਾਵਿਆ ਦਿਸਨਿ ਸਭੇ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: bikhiaa rang koorraaviaa disan sabhe chhaar |
English: The pleasures of corruption are false. All that is seen shall turn to ashes.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬੂੰਦ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਪੀਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: har amrit boond suhaavanee mil saadhoo peevanahaar |
English: The drops of the Lord's Nectar are so beautiful! Meeting the Holy Saint, we drink these in.

Gurbani: ਵਣੁ ਤਿਣੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਉਲਿਆ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: van tin prabh sang mauliaa samrath purakh apaar |
English: The forests and the meadows are rejuvenated and refreshed with the Love of God, the All-powerful, Infinite Primal Being.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਣੈ ਨੋ ਮਨੁ ਲੋਚਦਾ ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: har milanai no man lochadaa karam milaavanahaar |
English: My mind yearns to meet the Lord. If only He would show His Mercy, and unite me with Himself!

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਖੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹੰਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: jinee sakhee prabh paaeaa hnau tin kai sad balihaar |
English: Those brides who have obtained God-I am forever a sacrifice to them.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਮਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak har jee meaa kar sabad savaaranahaar |
English: O Nanak, when the Dear Lord shows kindness, He adorns His bride with the Word of His Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਾਵਣੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰਿ ਹਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: saavan tinaa suhaaganee jin raam naam ur haar |6|
English: Saawan is delightful for those happy soul-brides whose hearts are adorned with the Necklace of the Lord's Name. ||6||

[Ang 134 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਭਾਦੁਇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੀਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗਾ ਹੇਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: bhaadue bharam bhulaaneea doojai lagaa het |
English: In the month of Bhaadon, she is deluded by doubt, because of her attachment to duality.

Gurbani: ਲਖ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਜਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੇਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: lakh seegaar banaaeaa kaaraj naahee ket |
English: She may wear thousands of ornaments, but they are of no use at all.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਦਿਨਿ ਦੇਹ ਬਿਨਸਸੀ ਤਿਤੁ ਵੇਲੈ ਕਹਸਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: jit din deh binasasee tith velai kahasan pret |
English: On that day when the body perishes-at that time, she becomes a ghost.

Gurbani: ਪਕੜਿ ਚਲਾਇਨਿ ਦੂਤ ਜਮ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਦੇਨੀ ਭੇਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: pakarr chalaaein doot jam kisai na denee bhet |
English: The Messenger of Death seizes and holds her, and does not tell anyone his secret.

Gurbani: ਛਡਿ ਖੜੋਤੇ ਖਿਨੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਸਿਉ ਲਗਾ ਹੇਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: chhadd kharrote khinai maeh jin siau lagaa het |
English: And her loved ones-in an instant, they move on, leaving her all alone.

Gurbani: ਹਥ ਮਰੋੜੈ ਤਨੁ ਕਪੇ ਸਿਆਹਹੁ ਹੋਆ ਸੇਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: hath marorrai tan kape siaahahu hoaa set |
English: She wrings her hands, her body writhes in pain, and she turns from black to white.

Gurbani: ਜੇਹਾ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋ ਲੁਣੈ ਕਰਮਾ ਸੰਦੜਾ ਖੇਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: jehaa beejai so lunai karamaa sandarraa khet |
English: As she has planted, so does she harvest; such is the field of karma.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਚਰਣ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak prabh saranaagatee charan bohith prabh det |
English: Nanak seeks God's Sanctuary; God has given him the Boat of His Feet.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਭਾਦੁਇ ਨਰਕਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਰਖਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੇਤੁ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: se bhaadue narak na paaeeeh gur rakhan vaalaa het |7|
English: Those who love the Guru, the Protector and Savior, in Bhaadon, shall not be thrown down into hell. ||7||

[Ang 134 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਅਸੁਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਉਮਾਹੜਾ ਕਿਉ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: asun prem umaaharraa kiau mileeai har jaae |
English: In the month of Assu, my love for the Lord overwhelms me. How can I go and meet the Lord?

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪਿਆਸ ਦਰਸਨ ਘਣੀ ਕੋਈ ਆਣਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man tan piaas darasan ghanee koee aan milaavai maae |
English: My mind and body are so thirsty for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. Won't someone please come and lead me to him, O my mother.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੇ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sant sahaaee prem ke hau tin kai laagaa paae |
English: The Saints are the helpers of the Lord's lovers; I fall and touch their feet.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: vin prabh kiau sukh paaeeai doojee naahee jaae |
English: Without God, how can I find peace? There is nowhere else to go.

Gurbani: ਜਿੰਨੑੀ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਸੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਰਹੇ ਆਘਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jinaee chaakhiaa prem ras se tripat rahe aaghaae |
English: Those who have tasted the sublime essence of His Love, remain satisfied and fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਬਿਨਤੀ ਕਰਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aap tiaag binatee kareh lehu prabhoo larr laae |
English: They renounce their selfishness and conceit, and they pray, "God, please attach me to the hem of Your robe."

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈਆ ਸਿ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jo har kant milaaeea si vichhurr kateh na jaae |
English: Those whom the Husband Lord has united with Himself, shall not be separated from Him again.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਵਿਣੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: prabh vin doojaa ko nahee naanak har saranaae |
English: Without God, there is no other at all. Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਸੂ ਸੁਖੀ ਵਸੰਦੀਆ ਜਿਨਾ ਮਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: asoo sukhee vasandeea jinaa meaa har raae |8|
English: In Assu, the Lord, the Sovereign King, has granted His Mercy, and they dwell in peace. ||8||

[Ang 135 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਕਤਿਕਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: katik karam kamaavane dos na kaahoo jog |
English: In the month of Katak, do good deeds. Do not try to blame anyone else.

Gurbani: ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਤੇ ਭੁਲਿਆਂ ਵਿਆਪਨਿ ਸਭੇ ਰੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: paramesar te bhuliaan viaapan sabhe rog |
English: Forgetting the Transcendent Lord, all sorts of illnesses are contracted.

Gurbani: ਵੇਮੁਖ ਹੋਏ ਰਾਮ ਤੇ ਲਗਨਿ ਜਨਮ ਵਿਜੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: vemukh hoe raam te lagan janam vijog |
English: Those who turn their backs on the Lord shall be separated from Him and consigned to reincarnation, over and over again.

Gurbani: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਉੜੇ ਹੋਇ ਗਏ ਜਿਤੜੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਭੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: khin meh kaurre hoe ge jitarre maaeaa bhog |
English: In an instant, all of Maya's sensual pleasures turn bitter.

Gurbani: ਵਿਚੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਕਰਿ ਸਕੈ ਕਿਸ ਥੈ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਰੋਜ ॥
Transliteration: vich na koee kar sakai kis thai roveh roj |
English: No one can then serve as your intermediary. Unto whom can we turn and cry?

Gurbani: ਕੀਤਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: keetaa kichhoo na hovee likhiaa dhur sanjog |
English: By one's own actions, nothing can be done; destiny was pre-determined from the very beginning.

Gurbani: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾਂ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਬਿਓਗ ॥
Transliteration: vaddabhaagee meraa prabh milai taan utareh sabh biog |
English: By great good fortune, I meet my God, and then all pain of separation departs.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਬੰਦੀ ਮੋਚ ॥
Transliteration: naanak kau prabh raakh lehi mere saahib bandee moch |
English: Please protect Nanak, God; O my Lord and Master, please release me from bondage.

Gurbani: ਕਤਿਕ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਬਿਨਸਹਿ ਸਭੇ ਸੋਚ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: katik hovai saadhasang binaseh sabhe soch |9|
English: In Katak, in the Company of the Holy, all anxiety vanishes. ||9||

[Ang 135 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮੰਘਿਰਿ ਮਾਹਿ ਸੋਹੰਦੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਬੈਠੜੀਆਹ ॥
Transliteration: manghir maeh sohandeea har pir sang baittharreeaah |
English: In the month of Maghar, those who sit with their Beloved Husband Lord are beautiful.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਕਿਆ ਗਣੀ ਜਿ ਸਾਹਿਬਿ ਮੇਲੜੀਆਹ ॥
Transliteration: tin kee sobhaa kiaa ganee ji saahib melarreeaah |
English: How can their glory be measured? Their Lord and Master blends them with Himself.

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਉਲਿਆ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧ ਸਹੇਲੜੀਆਹ ॥
Transliteration: tan man mauliaa raam siau sang saadh sahelarreeaah |
English: Their bodies and minds blossom forth in the Lord; they have the companionship of the Holy Saints.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਸੇ ਰਹਨਿ ਇਕੇਲੜੀਆਹ ॥
Transliteration: saadh janaa te baaharee se rehan ikelarreeaah |
English: Those who lack the Company of the Holy, remain all alone.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਉਤਰੈ ਸੇ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਪੜੀਆਹ ॥
Transliteration: tin dukh na kabahoo utarai se jam kai vas parreeaah |
English: Their pain never departs, and they fall into the grip of the Messenger of Death.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੇ ਦਿਸਨਿ ਨਿਤ ਖੜੀਆਹ ॥
Transliteration: jinee raaviaa prabh aapanaa se disan nit kharreeaah |
English: Those who have ravished and enjoyed their God, are seen to be continually exalted and uplifted.

Gurbani: ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਲਾਲ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਠਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਜੜੀਆਹ ॥
Transliteration: ratan javehar laal har kantth tinaa jarreeaah |
English: They wear the Necklace of the jewels, emeralds and rubies of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਂਛੈ ਧੂੜਿ ਤਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣੀ ਦਰਿ ਪੜੀਆਹ ॥
Transliteration: naanak baanchhai dhoorr tin prabh saranee dar parreeaah |
English: Nanak seeks the dust of the feet of those who take to the Sanctuary of the Lord's Door.

Gurbani: ਮੰਘਿਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਰਾਧਣਾ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਜਨਮੜੀਆਹ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: manghir prabh aaraadhanaa bahurr na janamarreeaah |10|
English: Those who worship and adore God in Maghar, do not suffer the cycle of reincarnation ever again. ||10||

[Ang 135 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪੋਖਿ ਤੁਖਾਰੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪਈ ਕੰਠਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: pokh tukhaar na viaapee kantth miliaa har naahu |
English: In the month of Poh, the cold does not touch those, whom the Husband Lord hugs close in His Embrace.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਚਰਨਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਲਗੜਾ ਸਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: man bedhiaa charanaarabind darasan lagarraa saahu |
English: Their minds are transfixed by His Lotus Feet. They are attached to the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

Gurbani: ਓਟ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਰਾਇ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਲਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: ott govind gopaal raae sevaa suaamee laahu |
English: Seek the Protection of the Lord of the Universe; His service is truly profitable.

Gurbani: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਪੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਈ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: bikhiaa pohi na sakee mil saadhoo gun gaahu |
English: Corruption shall not touch you, when you join the Holy Saints and sing the Lord's Praises.

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੀ ਤਹ ਮਿਲੀ ਸਚੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਮਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: jeh te upajee teh milee sachee preet samaahu |
English: From where it originated, there the soul is blended again. It is absorbed in the Love of the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜੀਆਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: kar geh leenee paarabraham bahurr na vichhurreeaahu |
English: When the Supreme Lord God grasps someone's hand, he shall never again suffer separation from Him.

Gurbani: ਬਾਰਿ ਜਾਉ ਲਖ ਬੇਰੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: baar jaau lakh bereea har sajan agam agaahu |
English: I am a sacrifice, 100,000 times, to the Lord, my Friend, the Unapproachable and Unfathomable.

Gurbani: ਸਰਮ ਪਈ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਿ ਪਈਆਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: saram pee naaraaeinai naanak dar peeaahu |
English: Please preserve my honor, Lord; Nanak begs at Your Door.

Gurbani: ਪੋਖੁ ਸੋੁਹੰਦਾ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: pokh suohandaa sarab sukh jis bakhase veparavaahu |11|
English: Poh is beautiful, and all comforts come to that one, whom the Carefree Lord has forgiven. ||11||

[Ang 135 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਘਿ ਮਜਨੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧੂਆ ਧੂੜੀ ਕਰਿ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: maagh majan sang saadhooaa dhoorree kar isanaan |
English: In the month of Maagh, let your cleansing bath be the dust of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਨੋ ਕਰਿ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam dhiaae sun sabhanaa no kar daan |
English: Meditate and listen to the Name of the Lord, and give it to everyone.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਕਰਮ ਮਲੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਜਾਇ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: janam karam mal utarai man te jaae gumaan |
English: In this way, the filth of lifetimes of karma shall be removed, and egotistical pride shall vanish from your mind.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮਿ ਕਰੋਧਿ ਨ ਮੋਹੀਐ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਲੋਭੁ ਸੁਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: kaam karodh na moheeai binasai lobh suaan |
English: Sexual desire and anger shall not seduce you, and the dog of greed shall depart.

Gurbani: ਸਚੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਹਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: sachai maarag chaladiaa usatat kare jahaan |
English: Those who walk on the Path of Truth shall be praised throughout the world.

Gurbani: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਸਗਲ ਪੁੰਨ ਜੀਅ ਦਇਆ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: atthasatth teerath sagal pun jeea deaa paravaan |
English: Be kind to all beings-this is more meritorious than bathing at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage and the giving of charity.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਸੋਈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: jis no devai deaa kar soee purakh sujaan |
English: That person, upon whom the Lord bestows His Mercy, is a wise person.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: jinaa miliaa prabh aapanaa naanak tin kurabaan |
English: Nanak is a sacrifice to those who have merged with God.

Gurbani: ਮਾਘਿ ਸੁਚੇ ਸੇ ਕਾਂਢੀਅਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: maagh suche se kaandteeeh jin pooraa gur miharavaan |12|
English: In Maagh, they alone are known as true, unto whom the Perfect Guru is Merciful. ||12||

[Ang 136 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਫਲਗੁਣਿ ਅਨੰਦ ਉਪਾਰਜਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: falagun anand upaarajanaa har sajan pragatte aae |
English: In the month of Phalgun, bliss comes to those, unto whom the Lord, the Friend, has been revealed.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ਰਾਮ ਕੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੀਆ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sant sahaaee raam ke kar kirapaa deea milaae |
English: The Saints, the Lord's helpers, in their mercy, have united me with Him.

Gurbani: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਹੁਣਿ ਦੁਖਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sej suhaavee sarab sukh hun dukhaa naahee jaae |
English: My bed is beautiful, and I have all comforts. I feel no sadness at all.

Gurbani: ਇਛ ਪੁਨੀ ਵਡਭਾਗਣੀ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: eichh punee vaddabhaaganee var paaeaa har raae |
English: My desires have been fulfilled-by great good fortune, I have obtained the Sovereign Lord as my Husband.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਹੀਆ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਵਹੀ ਗੀਤ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਅਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: mil saheea mangal gaavahee geet govind alaae |
English: Join with me, my sisters, and sing the songs of rejoicing and the Hymns of the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੇਹਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦਿਸਈ ਕੋਈ ਦੂਜਾ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: har jehaa avar na disee koee doojaa lavai na laae |
English: There is no other like the Lord-there is no equal to Him.

Gurbani: ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਓਨੁ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਦਿਤੀਅਨੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: halat palat savaarion nihachal diteean jaae |
English: He embellishes this world and the world hereafter, and He gives us our permanent home there.

Gurbani: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਤੇ ਰਖਿਅਨੁ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਜਨਮੈ ਧਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sansaar saagar te rakhian bahurr na janamai dhaae |
English: He rescues us from the world-ocean; never again do we have to run the cycle of reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਏਕ ਅਨੇਕ ਗੁਣ ਤਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਚਰਣੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jihavaa ek anek gun tare naanak charanee paae |
English: I have only one tongue, but Your Glorious Virtues are beyond counting. Nanak is saved, falling at Your Feet.

Gurbani: ਫਲਗੁਣਿ ਨਿਤ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਇ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: falagun nit salaaheeai jis no til na tamaae |13|
English: In Phalgun, praise Him continually; He has not even an iota of greed. ||13||

[Ang 136 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਕਾਜ ਸਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jin jin naam dhiaaeaa tin ke kaaj sare |
English: Those who meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord-their affairs are all resolved.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਚਿ ਖਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har gur pooraa aaraadhiaa daragah sach khare |
English: Those who meditate on the Perfect Guru, the Lord-Incarnate-they are judged true in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਚਰਣ ਹਰਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਤਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sarab sukhaa nidh charan har bhaujal bikham tare |
English: The Lord's Feet are the Treasure of all peace and comfort for them; they cross over the terrifying and treacherous world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਈਆ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਨਾਹਿ ਜਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: prem bhagat tin paaeea bikhiaa naeh jare |
English: They obtain love and devotion, and they do not burn in corruption.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜ ਗਏ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਨਸੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਚਿ ਭਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: koorr ge dubidhaa nasee pooran sach bhare |
English: Falsehood has vanished, duality has been erased, and they are totally overflowing with Truth.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਮਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਧਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham prabh sevade man andar ek dhare |
English: They serve the Supreme Lord God, and enshrine the One Lord within their minds.

Gurbani: ਮਾਹ ਦਿਵਸ ਮੂਰਤ ਭਲੇ ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: maah divas moorat bhale jis kau nadar kare |
English: The months, the days, and the moments are auspicious, for those upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਰਸ ਦਾਨੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਰੇ ॥੧੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak mangai daras daan kirapaa karahu hare |14|1|
English: Nanak begs for the blessing of Your Vision, O Lord. Please, shower Your Mercy upon me! ||14||1||

[Ang 136 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦਿਨ ਰੈਣਿ ॥
Transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 din rain |
English: Maajh, Fifth Mehl: Day And Night:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸੇਵੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰੀ ਦਿਨ ਸਭਿ ਰੈਣ ॥
Transliteration: sevee satigur aapanaa har simaree din sabh rain |
English: I serve my True Guru, and meditate on Him all day and night.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਵਾਂ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੀ ਮਿਠੜੇ ਵੈਣ ॥
Transliteration: aap tiaag saranee pavaan mukh bolee mittharre vain |
English: Renouncing selfishness and conceit, I seek His Sanctuary, and speak sweet words to Him.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਸੈਣ ॥
Transliteration: janam janam kaa vichhurriaa har melahu sajan sain |
English: Through countless lifetimes and incarnations, I was separated from Him. O Lord, you are my Friend and Companion-please unite me with Yourself.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੀਅ ਹਰਿ ਤੇ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਸੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਨ ਵਸਨਿ ਭੈਣ ॥
Transliteration: jo jeea har te vichhurre se sukh na vasan bhain |
English: Those who are separated from the Lord do not dwell in peace, O sister.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਚੈਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਖੋਜਿ ਡਿਠੇ ਸਭਿ ਗੈਣ ॥
Transliteration: har pir bin chain na paaeeai khoj dditthe sabh gain |
English: Without their Husband Lord, they find no comfort. I have searched and seen all realms.

Gurbani: ਆਪ ਕਮਾਣੈ ਵਿਛੁੜੀ ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਦੇਣ ॥
Transliteration: aap kamaanai vichhurree dos na kaahoo den |
English: My own evil actions have kept me separate from Him; why should I accuse anyone else?

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਰਣ ਕਰੇਣ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh raakh lehu hor naahee karan karen |
English: Bestow Your Mercy, God, and save me! No one else can bestow Your Mercy.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਖਾਕੂ ਰੂਲਣਾ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਥੈ ਵੈਣ ॥
Transliteration: har tudh vin khaakoo roolanaa kaheeai kithai vain |
English: Without You, Lord, we roll around in the dust. Unto whom should we utter our cries of distress?

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਰਜਨੁ ਦੇਖਾ ਨੈਣ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak kee benanteea har surajan dekhaa nain |1|
English: This is Nanak's prayer: "May my eyes behold the Lord, the Angelic Being." ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਸੋ ਸੁਣੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਿਥ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jeea kee birathaa so sune har samrith purakh apaar |
English: The Lord hears the anguish of the soul; He is the All-powerful and Infinite Primal Being.

Gurbani: ਮਰਣਿ ਜੀਵਣਿ ਆਰਾਧਣਾ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: maran jeevan aaraadhanaa sabhanaa kaa aadhaar |
English: In death and in life, worship and adore the Lord, the Support of all.

Gurbani: ਸਸੁਰੈ ਪੇਈਐ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੰਤ ਕੀ ਵਡਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sasurai peeeai tis kant kee vaddaa jis paravaar |
English: In this world and in the next, the soul-bride belongs to her Husband Lord, who has such a vast family.

Gurbani: ਊਚਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧ ਕਿਛੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: aoochaa agam agaadh bodh kichh ant na paaraavaar |
English: He is Lofty and Inaccessible. His Wisdom is Unfathomable.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਾ ਸਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵਸੀ ਸੰਤਾ ਕੀ ਹੋਇ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sevaa saa tis bhaavasee santaa kee hoe chhaar |
English: He has no end or limitation. That service is pleasing to Him, which makes one humble, like the dust of the feet of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਦੈਆਲ ਦੇਵ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: deenaa naath daiaal dev patit udhaaranahaar |
English: He is the Patron of the poor, the Merciful, Luminous Lord, the Redeemer of sinners.

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਰਖਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: aad jugaadee rakhadaa sach naam karataar |
English: From the very beginning, and throughout the ages, the True Name of the Creator has been our Saving Grace.

Gurbani: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੋਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: keemat koe na jaanee ko naahee tolanahaar |
English: No one can know His Value; no one can weigh it.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਿ ਰਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਹੀ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: man tan antar vas rahe naanak nahee sumaar |
English: He dwells deep within the mind and body. O Nanak, He cannot be measured.

Gurbani: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਜਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੰਉ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: din rain ji prabh knau sevade tin kai sad balihaar |2|
English: I am forever a sacrifice to those who serve God, day and night. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਅਰਾਧਨਿ ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਬਖਸਿੰਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: sant araadhan sad sadaa sabhanaa kaa bakhasind |
English: The Saints worship and adore Him forever and ever; He is the Forgiver of all.

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦਿਤੀਨੁ ਜਿੰਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: jeeo pindd jin saajiaa kar kirapaa diteen jind |
English: He fashioned the soul and the body, and by His Kindness, He bestowed the soul.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਜਪੀਐ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: gurasabadee aaraadheeai japeeai niramal mant |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, worship and adore Him, and chant His Pure Mantra.

Gurbani: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: keemat kehan na jaaeeai paramesur beant |
English: His Value cannot be evaluated. The Transcendent Lord is endless.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਰਾਇਣੋ ਸੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਭਗਵੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: jis man vasai naraaeino so kaheeai bhagavant |
English: That one, within whose mind the Lord abides, is said to be most fortunate.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਲੋਚਾ ਪੂਰੀਐ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: jeea kee lochaa pooreeai milai suaamee kant |
English: The soul's desires are fulfilled, upon meeting the Master, our Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਜਪਿ ਹਰੀ ਦੋਖ ਸਭੇ ਹੀ ਹੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak jeevai jap haree dokh sabhe hee hant |
English: Nanak lives by chanting the Lord's Name; all sorrows have been erased.

Gurbani: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਸੋ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੰਤੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: din rain jis na visarai so hariaa hovai jant |3|
English: One who does not forget Him, day and night, is continually rejuvenated. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੂਰਣੋ ਮੰਞੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਥਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sarab kalaa prabh poorano many nimaanee thaau |
English: God is overflowing with all powers. I have no honor-He is my resting place.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਮਨ ਅੰਦਰੇ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har ott gahee man andare jap jap jeevaan naau |
English: I have grasped the Support of the Lord within my mind; I live by chanting and meditating on His Name.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਣੀ ਜਨ ਧੂੜੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh aapanee jan dhoorree sang samaau |
English: Grant Your Grace, God, and bless me, that I may merge into the dust of the feet of the humble.
