Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਰਹਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਿਤਾ ਪੈਨਾ ਖਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jiau toon raakheh tiau rahaa teraa ditaa painaa khaau |
English: As You keep me, so do I live. I wear and eat whatever You give me.

Gurbani: ਉਦਮੁ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: audam soee karaae prabh mil saadhoo gun gaau |
English: May I make the effort, O God, to sing Your Glorious Praises in the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੀ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਕਿਥੈ ਕੂਕਣ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: doojee jaae na sujhee kithai kookan jaau |
English: I can conceive of no other place; where could I go to lodge a complaint?

Gurbani: ਅਗਿਆਨ ਬਿਨਾਸਨ ਤਮ ਹਰਣ ਊਚੇ ਅਗਮ ਅਮਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: agiaan binaasan tam haran aooche agam amaau |
English: You are the Dispeller of ignorance, the Destroyer of darkness, O Lofty, Unfathomable and Unapproachable Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਹੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
Transliteration: man vichhurriaa har meleeai naanak ehu suaau |
English: Please unite this separated one with Yourself; this is Nanak's yearning.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਿਆਣਾ ਤਿਤੁ ਦਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਰਸੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਪਾਉ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: sarab kaliaanaa tith din har parasee gur ke paau |4|1|
English: That day shall bring every joy, O Lord, when I take to the Feet of the Guru. ||4||1||

[Ang 137 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਾਰ ਮਾਝ ਕੀ ਤਥਾ ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਮਲਕ ਮੁਰੀਦ ਤਥਾ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਹੜਾ ਸੋਹੀਆ ਕੀ ਧੁਨੀ ਗਾਵਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: vaar maajh kee tathaa salok mahalaa 1 malak mureed tathaa chandraharraa soheea kee dhunee gaavanee |
English: Vaar In Maajh, And Saloks Of The First Mehl: To Be Sung To The Tune Of "Malik Mureed And Chandrahraa Sohee-Aa"

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar sat naam karataa purakh gur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru's Grace:

Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਹਿਵੈ ਘਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਤਿਹ ਲੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur daataa gur hivai ghar gur deepak tih loe |
English: The Guru is the Giver; the Guru is the House of ice. The Guru is the Light of the three worlds.

Gurbani: ਅਮਰ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਨਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: amar padaarath naanakaa man maaniai sukh hoe |1|
English: O Nanak, He is everlasting wealth. Place your mind's faith in Him, and you shall find peace. ||1||

[Ang 137 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪਹਿਲੈ ਪਿਆਰਿ ਲਗਾ ਥਣ ਦੁਧਿ ॥
Transliteration: pahilai piaar lagaa than dudh |
English: First, the baby loves mother's milk;

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਮਾਇ ਬਾਪ ਕੀ ਸੁਧਿ ॥
Transliteration: doojai maae baap kee sudh |
English: second, he learns of his mother and father;

Gurbani: ਤੀਜੈ ਭਯਾ ਭਾਭੀ ਬੇਬ ॥
Transliteration: teejai bhayaa bhaabhee beb |
English: third, his brothers, sisters-in-law and sisters;

Gurbani: ਚਉਥੈ ਪਿਆਰਿ ਉਪੰਨੀ ਖੇਡ ॥
Transliteration: chauthai piaar upanee khedd |
English: fourth, the love of play awakens.

Gurbani: ਪੰਜਵੈ ਖਾਣ ਪੀਅਣ ਕੀ ਧਾਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: panjavai khaan peean kee dhaat |
English: Fifth, he runs after food and drink;

Gurbani: ਛਿਵੈ ਕਾਮੁ ਨ ਪੁਛੈ ਜਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: chhivai kaam na puchhai jaat |
English: sixth, in his sexual desire, he does not respect social customs.

Gurbani: ਸਤਵੈ ਸੰਜਿ ਕੀਆ ਘਰ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: satavai sanj keea ghar vaas |
English: Seventh, he gathers wealth and dwells in his house;

Gurbani: ਅਠਵੈ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਹੋਆ ਤਨ ਨਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: atthavai krodh hoaa tan naas |
English: eighth, he becomes angry, and his body is consumed.

Gurbani: ਨਾਵੈ ਧਉਲੇ ਉਭੇ ਸਾਹ ॥
Transliteration: naavai dhaule ubhe saah |
English: Ninth, he turns grey, and his breathing becomes labored;

Gurbani: ਦਸਵੈ ਦਧਾ ਹੋਆ ਸੁਆਹ ॥
Transliteration: dasavai dadhaa hoaa suaah |
English: tenth, he is cremated, and turns to ashes.

Gurbani: ਗਏ ਸਿਗੀਤ ਪੁਕਾਰੀ ਧਾਹ ॥
Transliteration: ge sigeet pukaaree dhaah |
English: His companions send him off, crying out and lamenting.

Gurbani: ਉਡਿਆ ਹੰਸੁ ਦਸਾਏ ਰਾਹ ॥
Transliteration: auddiaa hans dasaae raah |
English: The swan of the soul takes flight, and asks which way to go.

Gurbani: ਆਇਆ ਗਇਆ ਮੁਇਆ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aaeaa geaa mueaa naau |
English: He came and he went, and now, even his name has died.

Gurbani: ਪਿਛੈ ਪਤਲਿ ਸਦਿਹੁ ਕਾਵ ॥
Transliteration: pichhai patal sadihu kaav |
English: After he left, food was offered on leaves, and the birds were called to come and eat.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧੁ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak manamukh andh piaar |
English: O Nanak, the self-willed manmukhs love the darkness.

Gurbani: ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਡੁਬਾ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: baajh guroo ddubaa sansaar |2|
English: Without the Guru, the world is drowning. ||2||

[Ang 138 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦਸ ਬਾਲਤਣਿ ਬੀਸ ਰਵਣਿ ਤੀਸਾ ਕਾ ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: das baalatan bees ravan teesaa kaa sundar kahaavai |
English: At the age of ten, he is a child; at twenty, a youth, and at thirty, he is called handsome.

Gurbani: ਚਾਲੀਸੀ ਪੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਪਚਾਸੀ ਪਗੁ ਖਿਸੈ ਸਠੀ ਕੇ ਬੋਢੇਪਾ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: chaaleesee pur hoe pachaasee pag khisai satthee ke bodtepaa aavai |
English: At forty, he is full of life; at fifty, his foot slips, and at sixty, old age is upon him.

Gurbani: ਸਤਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਤਿਹੀਣੁ ਅਸੀਹਾਂ ਕਾ ਵਿਉਹਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: satar kaa matiheen aseehaan kaa viauhaar na paavai |
English: At seventy, he loses his intellect, and at eighty, he cannot perform his duties.

Gurbani: ਨਵੈ ਕਾ ਸਿਹਜਾਸਣੀ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਅਪ ਬਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: navai kaa sihajaasanee mool na jaanai ap bal |
English: At ninety, he lies in his bed, and he cannot understand his weakness.

Gurbani: ਢੰਢੋਲਿਮੁ ਢੂਢਿਮੁ ਡਿਠੁ ਮੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਗੁ ਧੂਏ ਕਾ ਧਵਲਹਰੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: dtandtolim dtoodtim dditth mai naanak jag dhooe kaa dhavalahar |3|
English: After seeking and searching for such a long time, O Nanak, I have seen that the world is just a mansion of smoke. ||3||

[Ang 138 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਆਪਿ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: toon karataa purakh agam hai aap srisatt upaatee |
English: You, O Creator Lord, are Unfathomable. You Yourself created the Universe,

Gurbani: ਰੰਗ ਪਰੰਗ ਉਪਾਰਜਨਾ ਬਹੁ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਭਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: rang parang upaarajanaa bahu bahu bidh bhaatee |
English: its colors, qualities and varieties, in so many ways and forms.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਈਐ ਸਭੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਤੁਮਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: toon jaaneh jin upaaeeai sabh khel tumaatee |
English: You created it, and You alone understand it. It is all Your Play.

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਉਠਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: eik aaveh ik jaeh utth bin naavai mar jaatee |
English: Some come, and some arise and depart; but without the Name, all are bound to die.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲਿਆ ਰੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh rang chalooliaa rang har rang raatee |
English: The Gurmukhs are imbued with the deep crimson color of the poppy; they are dyed in the color of the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: so sevahu sat niranjano har purakh bidhaatee |
English: So serve the True and Pure Lord, the Supremely Powerful Architect of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਵਡਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: toon aape aap sujaan hai vadd purakh vaddaatee |
English: You Yourself are All-knowing. O Lord, You are the Greatest of the Great!

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਚਿਆ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਜਾਤੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jo man chit tudh dhiaaeide mere sachiaa bal bal hau tin jaatee |1|
English: O my True Lord, I am a sacrifice, a humble sacrifice, to those who meditate on You within their conscious mind. ||1||

[Ang 138 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਪਾਇ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਰਖਿਆ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jeeo paae tan saajiaa rakhiaa banat banaae |
English: He placed the soul in the body which He had fashioned. He protects the Creation which He has created.

Gurbani: ਅਖੀ ਦੇਖੈ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਬੋਲੈ ਕੰਨੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: akhee dekhai jihavaa bolai kanee surat samaae |
English: With their eyes, they see, and with their tongues, they speak; with their ears, they bring the mind to awareness.

Gurbani: ਪੈਰੀ ਚਲੈ ਹਥੀ ਕਰਣਾ ਦਿਤਾ ਪੈਨੈ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: pairee chalai hathee karanaa ditaa painai khaae |
English: With their feet, they walk, and with their hands, they work; they wear and eat whatever is given.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਿ ਰਚਿਆ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਅੰਧਾ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jin rach rachiaa tiseh na jaanai andhaa andh kamaae |
English: They do not know the One who created the Creation. The blind fools do their dark deeds.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਭਜੈ ਤਾ ਠੀਕਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਘਾੜਤ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jaa bhajai taa ttheekar hovai ghaarrat gharree na jaae |
English: When the pitcher of the body breaks and shatters into pieces, it cannot be re-created again.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਵਿਣੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak gur bin naeh pat pat vin paar na paae |1|
English: O Nanak, without the Guru, there is no honor; without honor, no one is carried across. ||1||

[Ang 138 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 2 |
English: Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦੇਂਦੇ ਥਾਵਹੁ ਦਿਤਾ ਚੰਗਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਐਸਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: dende thaavahu ditaa changaa manamukh aisaa jaaneeai |
English: They prefer the gift, instead of the Giver; such is the way of the self-willed manmukhs.

Gurbani: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: surat mat chaturaaee taa kee kiaa kar aakh vakhaaneeai |
English: What can anyone say about their intelligence, their understanding or their cleverness?

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਹਿ ਕੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਡੀ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: antar beh kai karam kamaavai so chahu kunddee jaaneeai |
English: The deeds which one commits, while sitting in one's own home, are known far and wide, in the four directions.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਧਰਮ ਨਾਉ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਾਪਿ ਕਮਾਣੈ ਪਾਪੀ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: jo dharam kamaavai tis dharam naau hovai paap kamaanai paapee jaaneeai |
English: One who lives righteously is known as righteous; one who commits sins is known as a sinner.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: toon aape khel kareh sabh karate kiaa doojaa aakh vakhaaneeai |
English: You Yourself enact the entire play, O Creator. Why should we speak of any other?

Gurbani: ਜਿਚਰੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਤਿਚਰੁ ਜੋਤੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਤੂੰ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਵਿਣੁ ਜੋਤੀ ਕੋਈ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਿਹੁ ਦਿਖਾ ਸਿਆਣੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: jichar teree jot tichar jotee vich toon boleh vin jotee koee kichh karihu dikhaa siaaneeai |
English: As long as Your Light is within the body, You speak through that Light. Without Your Light, who can do anything? Show me any such cleverness!

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੀਐ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh nadaree aaeaa har iko sugharr sujaaneeai |2|
English: O Nanak, the Lord alone is Perfect and All-knowing; He is revealed to the Gurmukh. ||2||

[Ang 138 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tudh aape jagat upaae kai tudh aape dhandhai laaeaa |
English: You Yourself created the world, and You Yourself put it to work.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹ ਠਗਉਲੀ ਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਖੁਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: moh tthgaulee paae kai tudh aapahu jagat khuaaeaa |
English: Administering the drug of emotional attachment, You Yourself have led the world astray.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਹੈ ਨਹ ਤਿਪਤੈ ਭੁਖਾ ਤਿਹਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tisanaa andar agan hai neh tipatai bhukhaa tihaaeaa |
English: The fire of desire is deep within; unsatisfied, people remain hungry and thirsty.

Gurbani: ਸਹਸਾ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਆਇਆ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sahasaa ihu sansaar hai mar jamai aaeaa jaaeaa |
English: This world is an illusion; it dies and it is re-born-it comes and it goes in reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੋਹੁ ਨ ਤੁਟਈ ਸਭਿ ਥਕੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bin satigur mohu na tuttee sabh thake karam kamaaeaa |
English: Without the True Guru, emotional attachment is not broken. All have grown weary of performing empty rituals.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸੁਖਿ ਰਜਾ ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: guramatee naam dhiaaeeai sukh rajaa jaa tudh bhaaeaa |
English: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Filled with a joyful peace, they surrender to Your Will.

Gurbani: ਕੁਲੁ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਣੇਦੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kul udhaare aapanaa dhan janedee maaeaa |
English: They save their families and ancestors; blessed are the mothers who gave birth to them.

Gurbani: ਸੋਭਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sobhaa surat suhaavanee jin har setee chit laaeaa |2|
English: Beautiful and sublime is the glory and the understanding of those who focus their consciousness on the Lord. ||2||

[Ang 139 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 2 |
English: Salok, Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਖੀ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਵੇਖਣਾ ਵਿਣੁ ਕੰਨਾ ਸੁਨਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: akhee baajhahu vekhanaa vin kanaa sunanaa |
English: To see without eyes; to hear without ears;

Gurbani: ਪੈਰਾ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਚਲਣਾ ਵਿਣੁ ਹਥਾ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: pairaa baajhahu chalanaa vin hathaa karanaa |
English: to walk without feet; to work without hands;

Gurbani: ਜੀਭੈ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਇਉ ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeebhai baajhahu bolanaa iau jeevat maranaa |
English: to speak without a tongue-like this, one remains dead while yet alive.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿ ਕੈ ਤਉ ਖਸਮੈ ਮਿਲਣਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak hukam pachhaan kai tau khasamai milanaa |1|
English: O Nanak, recognize the Hukam of the Lord's Command, and merge with your Lord and Master. ||1||

[Ang 139 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 2 |
English: Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦਿਸੈ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਸਾਉ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: disai suneeai jaaneeai saau na paaeaa jaae |
English: He is seen, heard and known, but His subtle essence is not obtained.

Gurbani: ਰੁਹਲਾ ਟੁੰਡਾ ਅੰਧੁਲਾ ਕਿਉ ਗਲਿ ਲਗੈ ਧਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: ruhalaa ttunddaa andhulaa kiau gal lagai dhaae |
English: How can the lame, armless and blind person run to embrace the Lord?

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਕਰ ਭਾਵ ਕੇ ਲੋਇਣ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhai ke charan kar bhaav ke loein surat karee |
English: Let the Fear of God be your feet, and let His Love be your hands; let His Understanding be your eyes.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਿਆਣੀਏ ਇਵ ਕੰਤ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak kahai siaanee iv kant milaavaa hoe |2|
English: Says Nanak, in this way, O wise soul-bride, you shall be united with your Husband Lord. ||2||

[Ang 139 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੂੰ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa toon ek hai tudh doojaa khel rachaaeaa |
English: Forever and ever, You are the only One; You set the play of duality in motion.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਲੋਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੰਤਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: haumai garab upaae kai lobh antar jantaa paaeaa |
English: You created egotism and arrogant pride, and You placed greed within our beings.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਖੁ ਤੂ ਸਭ ਕਰੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jiau bhaavai tiau rakh too sabh kare teraa karaaeaa |
English: Keep me as it pleases Your Will; everyone acts as You cause them to act.

Gurbani: ਇਕਨਾ ਬਖਸਹਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਤੁਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: eikanaa bakhaseh mel laihi guramatee tudhai laaeaa |
English: Some are forgiven, and merge with You; through the Guru's Teachings, we are joined to You.

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਖੜੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: eik kharre kareh teree chaakaree vin naavai hor na bhaaeaa |
English: Some stand and serve You; without the Name, nothing else pleases them.

Gurbani: ਹੋਰੁ ਕਾਰ ਵੇਕਾਰ ਹੈ ਇਕਿ ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: hor kaar vekaar hai ik sachee kaarai laaeaa |
English: Any other task would be worthless to them-You have enjoined them to Your True Service.

Gurbani: ਪੁਤੁ ਕਲਤੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਹੈ ਇਕਿ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਰਹੇ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: put kalat kuttanb hai ik alipat rahe jo tudh bhaaeaa |
English: In the midst of children, spouse and relations, some still remain detached; they are pleasing to Your Will.

Gurbani: ਓਹਿ ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ohi andarahu baaharahu niramale sachai naae samaaeaa |3|
English: Inwardly and outwardly, they are pure, and they are absorbed in the True Name. ||3||

[Ang 139 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੁਇਨੇ ਕੈ ਪਰਬਤਿ ਗੁਫਾ ਕਰੀ ਕੈ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਇਆਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: sueine kai parabat gufaa karee kai paanee peaal |
English: I may make a cave, in a mountain of gold, or in the water of the nether regions;

Gurbani: ਕੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਕੈ ਆਕਾਸੀ ਉਰਧਿ ਰਹਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: kai vich dharatee kai aakaasee uradh rahaa sir bhaar |
English: I may remain standing on my head, upside-down, on the earth or up in the sky;

Gurbani: ਪੁਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਕਪੜੁ ਪਹਿਰਾ ਧੋਵਾ ਸਦਾ ਕਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: pur kar kaaeaa kaparr pahiraa dhovaa sadaa kaar |
English: I may totally cover my body with clothes, and wash them continually;

Gurbani: ਬਗਾ ਰਤਾ ਪੀਅਲਾ ਕਾਲਾ ਬੇਦਾ ਕਰੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: bagaa rataa peealaa kaalaa bedaa karee pukaar |
English: I may shout out loud, the white, red, yellow and black Vedas;

Gurbani: ਹੋਇ ਕੁਚੀਲੁ ਰਹਾ ਮਲੁ ਧਾਰੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: hoe kucheel rahaa mal dhaaree duramat mat vikaar |
English: I may even live in dirt and filth. And yet, all this is just a product of evil-mindedness, and intellectual corruption.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਹਉ ਨਾ ਮੈ ਨਾ ਹਉ ਹੋਵਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naa hau naa mai naa hau hovaa naanak sabad veechaar |1|
English: I was not, I am not, and I will never be anything at all! O Nanak, I dwell only on the Word of the Shabad. ||1||

[Ang 139 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਵਸਤ੍ਰ ਪਖਾਲਿ ਪਖਾਲੇ ਕਾਇਆ ਆਪੇ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: vasatr pakhaal pakhaale kaaeaa aape sanjam hovai |
English: They wash their clothes, and scrub their bodies, and try to practice self-discipline.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਲਗੀ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੈ ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: antar mail lagee nahee jaanai baaharahu mal mal dhovai |
English: But they are not aware of the filth staining their inner being, while they try and try to wash off the outer dirt.

Gurbani: ਅੰਧਾ ਭੂਲਿ ਪਇਆ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: andhaa bhool peaa jam jaale |
English: The blind go astray, caught by the noose of Death.

Gurbani: ਵਸਤੁ ਪਰਾਈ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਘਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: vasat paraaee apunee kar jaanai haumai vich dukh ghaale |
English: They see other people's property as their own, and in egotism, they suffer in pain.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਤੁਟੈ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh haumai tuttai taa har har naam dhiaavai |
English: O Nanak, the egotism of the Gurmukhs is broken, and then, they meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇ ਨਾਮੋ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਨਾਮੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naam jape naamo aaraadhe naame sukh samaavai |2|
English: They chant the Naam, meditate on the Naam, and through the Naam, they are absorbed in peace. ||2||

[Ang 139 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਵੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: pavarree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਹੰਸਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa hans sanjog mel milaaeaa |
English: Destiny has brought together and united the body and the soul-swan.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਕੀਆ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tin hee keea vijog jin upaaeaa |
English: He who created them, also separates them.

Gurbani: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਭੋਗੇ ਭੋਗੁ ਦੁਖ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: moorakh bhoge bhog dukh sabaaeaa |
English: The fools enjoy their pleasures; they must also endure all their pains.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖਹੁ ਉਠੇ ਰੋਗ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sukhahu utthe rog paap kamaaeaa |
English: From pleasures, arise diseases and the commission of sins.

Gurbani: ਹਰਖਹੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਖਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: harakhahu sog vijog upaae khapaaeaa |
English: From sinful pleasures come sorrow, separation, birth and death.

Gurbani: ਮੂਰਖ ਗਣਤ ਗਣਾਇ ਝਗੜਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: moorakh ganat ganaae jhagarraa paaeaa |
English: The fools try to account for their misdeeds, and argue uselessly.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਥਿ ਨਿਬੇੜੁ ਝਗੜੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: satigur hath niberr jhagarr chukaaeaa |
English: The judgement is in the Hands of the True Guru, who puts an end to the argument.

Gurbani: ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਗੁ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: karataa kare su hog na chalai chalaaeaa |4|
English: Whatever the Creator does, comes to pass. It cannot be changed by anyone's efforts. ||4||

[Ang 139 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਮੁਰਦਾਰੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: koorr bol muradaar khaae |
English: Telling lies, they eat dead bodies.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰੀ ਨੋ ਸਮਝਾਵਣਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: avaree no samajhaavan jaae |
English: And yet, they go out to teach others.

Gurbani: ਮੁਠਾ ਆਪਿ ਮੁਹਾਏ ਸਾਥੈ ॥
Transliteration: mutthaa aap muhaae saathai |
English: They are deceived, and they deceive their companions.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਐਸਾ ਆਗੂ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak aisaa aagoo jaapai |1|
English: O Nanak, such are the leaders of men. ||1||

[Ang 140 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 4 |
English: Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਦੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸੋ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਅਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jis dai andar sach hai so sachaa naam mukh sach alaae |
English: Those, within whom the Truth dwells, obtain the True Name; they speak only the Truth.

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਆਪਿ ਚਲਦਾ ਹੋਰਨਾ ਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: ohu har maarag aap chaladaa horanaa no har maarag paae |
English: They walk on the Lord's Path, and inspire others to walk on the Lord's Path as well.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਅਗੈ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਹੋਇ ਤਾ ਮਲੁ ਲਹੈ ਛਪੜਿ ਨਾਤੈ ਸਗਵੀ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: je agai teerath hoe taa mal lahai chhaparr naatai sagavee mal laae |
English: Bathing in a pool of holy water, they are washed clean of filth. But, by bathing in a stagnant pond, they are contaminated with even more filth.

Gurbani: ਤੀਰਥੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਜੋ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: teerath pooraa satiguroo jo anadin har har naam dhiaae |
English: The True Guru is the Perfect Pool of Holy Water. Night and day, He meditates on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਛੁਟਾ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਿਉ ਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਛਡਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: ohu aap chhuttaa kuttanb siau de har har naam sabh srisatt chhaddaae |
English: He is saved, along with his family; bestowing the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, He saves the whole world.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜੋ ਆਪਿ ਜਪੈ ਅਵਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jan naanak tis balihaaranai jo aap japai avaraa naam japaae |2|
English: Servant Nanak is a sacrifice to one who himself chants the Naam, and inspires others to chant it as well. ||2||

[Ang 140 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਕੰਦ ਮੂਲੁ ਚੁਣਿ ਖਾਹਿ ਵਣ ਖੰਡਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: eik kand mool chun khaeh van khandd vaasaa |
English: Some pick and eat fruits and roots, and live in the wilderness.

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਭਗਵਾ ਵੇਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਸੰਨਿਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: eik bhagavaa ves kar fireh jogee saniaasaa |
English: Some wander around wearing saffron robes, as Yogis and Sanyaasees.

Gurbani: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਛਾਦਨ ਭੋਜਨ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: andar trisanaa bahut chhaadan bhojan kee aasaa |
English: But there is still so much desire within them-they still yearn for clothes and food.

Gurbani: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਨ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਨ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: birathaa janam gavaae na girahee na udaasaa |
English: They waste their lives uselessly; they are neither householders nor renunciates.

Gurbani: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਸਿਰਹੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਮਨਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: jamakaal sirahu na utarai tribidh manasaa |
English: The Messenger of Death hangs over their heads, and they cannot escape the three-phased desire.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨੇੜੈ ਜਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: guramatee kaal na aavai nerrai jaa hovai daasan daasaa |
English: Death does not even approach those who follow the Guru's Teachings, and become the slaves of the Lord's slaves.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa sabad sach man ghar hee maeh udaasaa |
English: The True Word of the Shabad abides in their true minds; within the home of their own inner beings, they remain detached.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੇ ਆਸਾ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak satigur sevan aapanaa se aasaa te niraasaa |5|
English: O Nanak, those who serve their True Guru, rise from desire to desirelessness. ||5||

[Ang 140 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਰਤੁ ਲਗੈ ਕਪੜੈ ਜਾਮਾ ਹੋਇ ਪਲੀਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: je rat lagai kaparrai jaamaa hoe paleet |
English: If one's clothes are stained with blood, the garment becomes polluted.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਰਤੁ ਪੀਵਹਿ ਮਾਣਸਾ ਤਿਨ ਕਿਉ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਚੀਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: jo rat peeveh maanasaa tin kiau niramal cheet |
English: Those who suck the blood of human beings-how can their consciousness be pure?

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਉ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਕਾ ਦਿਲਿ ਹਛੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak naau khudaae kaa dil hachhai mukh lehu |
English: O Nanak, chant the Name of God, with heart-felt devotion.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰਿ ਦਿਵਾਜੇ ਦੁਨੀ ਕੇ ਝੂਠੇ ਅਮਲ ਕਰੇਹੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: avar divaaje dunee ke jhootthe amal karehu |1|
English: Everything else is just a pompous worldly show, and the practice of false deeds. ||1||

[Ang 140 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਹਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਆਖਾ ਕਿਹੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaa hau naahee taa kiaa aakhaa kihu naahee kiaa hovaa |
English: Since I am no one, what can I say? Since I am nothing, what can I be?

Gurbani: ਕੀਤਾ ਕਰਣਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਕਥਨਾ ਭਰਿਆ ਭਰਿ ਭਰਿ ਧੋਵਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: keetaa karanaa kahiaa kathanaa bhariaa bhar bhar dhovaan |
English: As He created me, so I act. As He causes me to speak, so I speak. I am full and overflowing with sins-if only I could wash them away!

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਨ ਬੁਝਾ ਲੋਕ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਐਸਾ ਆਗੂ ਹੋਵਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: aap na bujhaa lok bujhaaee aisaa aagoo hovaan |
English: I do not understand myself, and yet I try to teach others. Such is the guide I am!

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਧਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਦਸੇ ਰਾਹੈ ਸਭਸੁ ਮੁਹਾਏ ਸਾਥੈ ॥
Transliteration: naanak andhaa hoe kai dase raahai sabhas muhaae saathai |
English: O Nanak, the one who is blind shows others the way, and misleads all his companions.

Gurbani: ਅਗੈ ਗਇਆ ਮੁਹੇ ਮੁਹਿ ਪਾਹਿ ਸੁ ਐਸਾ ਆਗੂ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: agai geaa muhe muhi paeh su aisaa aagoo jaapai |2|
English: But, going to the world hereafter, he shall be beaten and kicked in the face; then, it will be obvious, what sort of guide he was! ||2||

[Ang 140 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਮਾਹਾ ਰੁਤੀ ਸਭ ਤੂੰ ਘੜੀ ਮੂਰਤ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: maahaa rutee sabh toon gharree moorat veechaaraa |
English: Through all the months and the seasons, the minutes and the hours, I dwell upon You, O Lord.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਗਣਤੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਚੇ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: toon ganatai kinai na paaeo sache alakh apaaraa |
English: No one has attained You by clever calculations, O True, Unseen and Infinite Lord.

Gurbani: ਪੜਿਆ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: parriaa moorakh aakheeai jis lab lobh ahankaaraa |
English: That scholar who is full of greed, arrogant pride and egotism, is known to be a fool.

Gurbani: ਨਾਉ ਪੜੀਐ ਨਾਉ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: naau parreeai naau bujheeai guramatee veechaaraa |
English: So read the Name, and realize the Name, and contemplate the Guru's Teachings.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਖਟਿਆ ਭਗਤੀ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: guramatee naam dhan khattiaa bhagatee bhare bhanddaaraa |
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, I have earned the wealth of the Naam; I possess the storehouses, overflowing with devotion to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: niramal naam maniaa dar sachai sachiaaraa |
English: Believing in the Immaculate Naam, one is hailed as true, in the True Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਜੀਉ ਪਰਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jis daa jeeo paraan hai antar jot apaaraa |
English: The Divine Light of the Infinite Lord, who owns the soul and the breath of life, is deep within the inner being.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਇਕੁ ਤੂੰ ਹੋਰੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: sachaa saahu ik toon hor jagat vanajaaraa |6|
English: You alone are the True Banker, O Lord; the rest of the world is just Your petty trader. ||6||

[Ang 140 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਿਹਰ ਮਸੀਤਿ ਸਿਦਕੁ ਮੁਸਲਾ ਹਕੁ ਹਲਾਲੁ ਕੁਰਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: mihar maseet sidak musalaa hak halaal kuraan |
English: Let mercy be your mosque, faith your prayer-mat, and honest living your Koran.

Gurbani: ਸਰਮ ਸੁੰਨਤਿ ਸੀਲੁ ਰੋਜਾ ਹੋਹੁ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: saram sunat seel rojaa hohu musalamaan |
English: Make modesty your circumcision, and good conduct your fast. In this way, you shall be a true Muslim.

Gurbani: ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਬਾ ਸਚੁ ਪੀਰੁ ਕਲਮਾ ਕਰਮ ਨਿਵਾਜ ॥
Transliteration: karanee kaabaa sach peer kalamaa karam nivaaj |
English: Let good conduct be your Kaabaa, Truth your spiritual guide, and the karma of good deeds your prayer and chant.

Gurbani: ਤਸਬੀ ਸਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵਸੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਖੈ ਲਾਜ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tasabee saa tis bhaavasee naanak rakhai laaj |1|
English: Let your rosary be that which is pleasing to His Will. O Nanak, God shall preserve your honor. ||1||

[Ang 141 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl

Gurbani: ਹਕੁ ਪਰਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਉਸੁ ਸੂਅਰ ਉਸੁ ਗਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: hak paraaeaa naanakaa us sooar us gaae |
English: : To take what rightfully belongs to another, is like a Muslim eating pork, or a Hindu eating beef.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੀਰੁ ਹਾਮਾ ਤਾ ਭਰੇ ਜਾ ਮੁਰਦਾਰੁ ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur peer haamaa taa bhare jaa muradaar na khaae |
English: Our Guru, our Spiritual Guide, stands by us, if we do not eat those carcasses.

Gurbani: ਗਲੀ ਭਿਸਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ਛੁਟੈ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: galee bhisat na jaaeeai chhuttai sach kamaae |
English: By mere talk, people do not earn passage to Heaven. Salvation comes only from the practice of Truth.

Gurbani: ਮਾਰਣ ਪਾਹਿ ਹਰਾਮ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਹਲਾਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: maaran paeh haraam meh hoe halaal na jaae |
English: By adding spices to forbidden foods, they are not made acceptable.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਲੀ ਕੂੜੀਈ ਕੂੜੋ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak galee koorreeee koorro palai paae |2|
English: O Nanak, from false talk, only falsehood is obtained. ||2||

[Ang 141 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪੰਜਿ ਨਿਵਾਜਾ ਵਖਤ ਪੰਜਿ ਪੰਜਾ ਪੰਜੇ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: panj nivaajaa vakhat panj panjaa panje naau |
English: There are five prayers and five times of day for prayer; the five have five names.

Gurbani: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਸਚੁ ਹਲਾਲ ਦੁਇ ਤੀਜਾ ਖੈਰ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: pahilaa sach halaal due teejaa khair khudaae |
English: Let the first be truthfulness, the second honest living, and the third charity in the Name of God.

Gurbani: ਚਉਥੀ ਨੀਅਤਿ ਰਾਸਿ ਮਨੁ ਪੰਜਵੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਨਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: chauthee neeat raas man panjavee sifat sanaae |
English: Let the fourth be good will to all, and the fifth the praise of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਰਣੀ ਕਲਮਾ ਆਖਿ ਕੈ ਤਾ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੁ ਸਦਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: karanee kalamaa aakh kai taa musalamaan sadaae |
English: Repeat the prayer of good deeds, and then, you may call yourself a Muslim.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੇਤੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਕੂੜੈ ਕੂੜੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak jete koorriaar koorrai koorree paae |3|
English: O Nanak, the false obtain falsehood, and only falsehood. ||3||

[Ang 141 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਵਣਜਦੇ ਇਕਿ ਕਚੈ ਦੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: eik ratan padaarath vanajade ik kachai de vaapaaraa |
English: Some trade in priceless jewels, while others deal in mere glass.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਪਾਈਅਨਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਤਨ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: satigur tutthai paaeean andar ratan bhanddaaraa |
English: When the True Guru is pleased, we find the treasure of the jewel, deep within the self.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਲਧਿਆ ਅੰਧੇ ਭਉਕਿ ਮੁਏ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: vin gur kinai na ladhiaa andhe bhauk mue koorriaaraa |
English: Without the Guru, no one has found this treasure. The blind and the false have died in their endless wanderings.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦੂਜੈ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਨਾ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh doojai pach mue naa boojheh veechaaraa |
English: The self-willed manmukhs putrefy and die in duality. They do not understand contemplative meditation.

Gurbani: ਇਕਸੁ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਕਿਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: eikas baajhahu doojaa ko nahee kis agai kareh pukaaraa |
English: Without the One Lord, there is no other at all. Unto whom should they complain?

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਨਿਰਧਨ ਸਦਾ ਭਉਕਦੇ ਇਕਨਾ ਭਰੇ ਤੁਜਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: eik niradhan sadaa bhaukade ikanaa bhare tujaaraa |
English: Some are destitute, and wander around endlessly, while others have storehouses of wealth.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਹੋਰੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਛਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: vin naavai hor dhan naahee hor bikhiaa sabh chhaaraa |
English: Without God's Name, there is no other wealth. Everything else is just poison and ashes.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: naanak aap karaae kare aap hukam savaaranahaaraa |7|
English: O Nanak, the Lord Himself acts, and causes others to act; by the Hukam of His Command, we are embellished and exalted. ||7||

[Ang 141 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੁ ਕਹਾਵਣੁ ਮੁਸਕਲੁ ਜਾ ਹੋਇ ਤਾ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: musalamaan kahaavan musakal jaa hoe taa musalamaan kahaavai |
English: It is difficult to be called a Muslim; if one is truly a Muslim, then he may be called one.

Gurbani: ਅਵਲਿ ਅਉਲਿ ਦੀਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਠਾ ਮਸਕਲ ਮਾਨਾ ਮਾਲੁ ਮੁਸਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: aval aaul deen kar mitthaa masakal maanaa maal musaavai |
English: First, let him savor the religion of the Prophet as sweet; then, let his pride of his possessions be scraped away.

Gurbani: ਹੋਇ ਮੁਸਲਿਮੁ ਦੀਨ ਮੁਹਾਣੈ ਮਰਣ ਜੀਵਣ ਕਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: hoe musalim deen muhaanai maran jeevan kaa bharam chukaavai |
English: Becoming a true Muslim, a disciple of the faith of Mohammed, let him put aside the delusion of death and life.

Gurbani: ਰਬ ਕੀ ਰਜਾਇ ਮੰਨੇ ਸਿਰ ਉਪਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਮੰਨੇ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: rab kee rajaae mane sir upar karataa mane aap gavaavai |
English: As he submits to God's Will, and surrenders to the Creator, he is rid of selfishness and conceit.

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਮਿਹਰੰਮਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tau naanak sarab jeea miharamat hoe ta musalamaan kahaavai |1|
English: And when, O Nanak, he is merciful to all beings, only then shall he be called a Muslim. ||1||

[Ang 141 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 4 |
English: Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪਰਹਰਿ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਤਜਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਚੁਕਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: parahar kaam krodh jhootth nindaa taj maaeaa ahankaar chukaavai |
English: Renounce sexual desire, anger, falsehood and slander; forsake Maya and eliminate egotistical pride.

Gurbani: ਤਜਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕਾਮਿਨੀ ਮੋਹੁ ਤਜੈ ਤਾ ਅੰਜਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: taj kaam kaaminee mohu tajai taa anjan maeh niranjan paavai |
English: Renounce sexual desire and promiscuity, and give up emotional attachment. Only then shall you obtain the Immaculate Lord amidst the darkness of the world.

Gurbani: ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸੁਤ ਦਾਰਾ ਤਜਿ ਪਿਆਸ ਆਸ ਰਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: taj maan abhimaan preet sut daaraa taj piaas aas raam liv laavai |
English: Renounce selfishness, conceit and arrogant pride, and your love for your children and spouse. Abandon your thirsty hopes and desires, and embrace love for the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak saachaa man vasai saach sabad har naam samaavai |2|
English: O Nanak, the True One shall come to dwell in your mind. Through the True Word of the Shabad, you shall be absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||2||

[Ang 141 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਰਾਜੇ ਰਯਤਿ ਸਿਕਦਾਰ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਰਹਸੀਓ ॥
Transliteration: raaje rayat sikadaar koe na rahaseeo |
English: Neither the kings, nor their subjects, nor the leaders shall remain.

Gurbani: ਹਟ ਪਟਣ ਬਾਜਾਰ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਢਹਸੀਓ ॥
Transliteration: hatt pattan baajaar hukamee dtahaseeo |
English: The shops, the cities and the streets shall eventually disintegrate, by the Hukam of the Lord's Command.

Gurbani: ਪਕੇ ਬੰਕ ਦੁਆਰ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: pake bank duaar moorakh jaanai aapane |
English: Those solid and beautiful mansions-the fools think that they belong to them.

Gurbani: ਦਰਬਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਰੀਤੇ ਇਕਿ ਖਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: darab bhare bhanddaar reete ik khane |
English: The treasure-houses, filled with wealth, shall be emptied out in an instant.

Gurbani: ਤਾਜੀ ਰਥ ਤੁਖਾਰ ਹਾਥੀ ਪਾਖਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: taajee rath tukhaar haathee paakhare |
English: The horses, chariots, camels and elephants, with all their decorations;

Gurbani: ਬਾਗ ਮਿਲਖ ਘਰ ਬਾਰ ਕਿਥੈ ਸਿ ਆਪਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: baag milakh ghar baar kithai si aapane |
English: the gardens, lands, houses, tents, soft beds and satin pavilions -

Gurbani: ਤੰਬੂ ਪਲੰਘ ਨਿਵਾਰ ਸਰਾਇਚੇ ਲਾਲਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: tanboo palangh nivaar saraaeiche laalatee |
English: Oh, where are those things, which they believe to be their own?

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਸਿਨਾਖਤੁ ਕੁਦਰਤੀ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: naanak sach daataar sinaakhat kudaratee |8|
English: O Nanak, the True One is the Giver of all; He is revealed through His All-powerful Creative Nature. ||8||

[Ang 141 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਦੀਆ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਧੇਣਵਾ ਸੁੰਮ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਦੁਧੁ ਘੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: nadeea hoveh dhenavaa sunm hoveh dudh gheeo |
English: If the rivers became cows, giving milk, and the spring water became milk and ghee;

Gurbani: ਸਗਲੀ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਕਰ ਹੋਵੈ ਖੁਸੀ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: sagalee dharatee sakar hovai khusee kare nit jeeo |
English: If all the earth became sugar, to continually excite the mind;

Gurbani: ਪਰਬਤੁ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਹੀਰੇ ਲਾਲ ਜੜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: parabat sueinaa rupaa hovai heere laal jarraau |
English: if the mountains became gold and silver, studded with gems and jewels

Gurbani: ਭੀ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਆਖਣ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਚਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bhee toonhai saalaahanaa aakhan lahai na chaau |1|
English: -even then, I would worship and adore You, and my longing to chant Your Praises would not decrease. ||1||

[Ang 142 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਭਾਰ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਮੇਵਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਗਰੁੜਾ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhaar atthaarah mevaa hovai garurraa hoe suaau |
English: If all the eighteen loads of vegetation became fruits,

Gurbani: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਫਿਰਦੇ ਰਖੀਅਹਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਥਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: chand sooraj due firade rakheeeh nihachal hovai thaau |
English: and the growing grass became sweet rice; if I were able to stop the sun and the moon in their orbits and hold them perfectly steady

Gurbani: ਭੀ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਆਖਣ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਚਾਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bhee toonhai saalaahanaa aakhan lahai na chaau |2|
English: -even then, I would worship and adore You, and my longing to chant Your Praises would not decrease. ||2||

[Ang 142 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਦੇਹੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਈਐ ਪਾਪ ਗਰਹ ਦੁਇ ਰਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: je dehai dukh laaeeai paap garah due raahu |
English: If my body were afflicted with pain, under the evil influence of unlucky stars;

Gurbani: ਰਤੁ ਪੀਣੇ ਰਾਜੇ ਸਿਰੈ ਉਪਰਿ ਰਖੀਅਹਿ ਏਵੈ ਜਾਪੈ ਭਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: rat peene raaje sirai upar rakheeeh evai jaapai bhaau |
English: and if the blood-sucking kings were to hold power over me

Gurbani: ਭੀ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਆਖਣ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਚਾਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bhee toonhai saalaahanaa aakhan lahai na chaau |3|
English: -even if this were my condition, I would still worship and adore You, and my longing to chant Your Praises would not decrease. ||3||

[Ang 142 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਗੀ ਪਾਲਾ ਕਪੜੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਖਾਣਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਵਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: agee paalaa kaparr hovai khaanaa hovai vaau |
English: If fire and ice were my clothes, and the wind was my food;

Gurbani: ਸੁਰਗੈ ਦੀਆ ਮੋਹਣੀਆ ਇਸਤਰੀਆ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭੋ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: suragai deea mohaneea isatareea hovan naanak sabho jaau |
English: and even if the enticing heavenly beauties were my wives, O Nanak-all this shall pass away!

Gurbani: ਭੀ ਤੂਹੈ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਆਖਣ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਚਾਉ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: bhee toohai saalaahanaa aakhan lahai na chaau |4|
English: Even then, I would worship and adore You, and my longing to chant Your Praises would not decrease. ||4||

[Ang 142 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਵੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: pavarree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਬਦਫੈਲੀ ਗੈਬਾਨਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ॥
Transliteration: badafailee gaibaanaa khasam na jaanee |
English: The foolish demon, who does evil deeds, does not know his Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਦੇਵਾਨਾ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਈ ॥
Transliteration: so kaheeai devaanaa aap na pachhaanee |
English: Call him a mad-man, if he does not understand himself.

Gurbani: ਕਲਹਿ ਬੁਰੀ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਵਾਦੇ ਖਪੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: kaleh buree sansaar vaade khapeeai |
English: The strife of this world is evil; these struggles are consuming it.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਵੇਕਾਰਿ ਭਰਮੇ ਪਚੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: vin naavai vekaar bharame pacheeai |
English: Without the Lord's Name, life is worthless. Through doubt, the people are being destroyed.

Gurbani: ਰਾਹ ਦੋਵੈ ਇਕੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਈ ਸਿਝਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: raah dovai ik jaanai soee sijhasee |
English: One who recognizes that all spiritual paths lead to the One shall be emancipated.

Gurbani: ਕੁਫਰ ਗੋਅ ਕੁਫਰਾਣੈ ਪਇਆ ਦਝਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: kufar goa kufaraanai peaa dajhasee |
English: One who speaks lies shall fall into hell and burn.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਸੁਬਹਾਨੁ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: sabh duneea subahaan sach samaaeeai |
English: In all the world, the most blessed and sanctified are those who remain absorbed in Truth.

Gurbani: ਸਿਝੈ ਦਰਿ ਦੀਵਾਨਿ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: sijhai dar deevaan aap gavaaeeai |9|
English: One who eliminates selfishness and conceit is redeemed in the Court of the Lord. ||9||

[Ang 142 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 salok |
English: First Mehl, Salok:

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: so jeeviaa jis man vasiaa soe |
English: They alone are truly alive, whose minds are filled with the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜੀਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak avar na jeevai koe |
English: O Nanak, no one else is truly alive;

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਜੀਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਲਥੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: je jeevai pat lathee jaae |
English: those who merely live shall depart in dishonor;

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਹਰਾਮੁ ਜੇਤਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabh haraam jetaa kichh khaae |
English: everything they eat is impure.

Gurbani: ਰਾਜਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਲਿ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: raaj rang maal rang |
English: Intoxicated with power and thrilled with wealth,

Gurbani: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ ਨਚੈ ਨੰਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: rang rataa nachai nang |
English: They delight in their pleasures, and dance about shamelessly.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਠਗਿਆ ਮੁਠਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak tthagiaa mutthaa jaae |
English: O Nanak, they are deluded and defrauded.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: vin naavai pat geaa gavaae |1|
English: Without the Lord's Name, they lose their honor and depart. ||1||

[Ang 142 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਖਾਧੈ ਕਿਆ ਪੈਧੈ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa khaadhai kiaa paidhai hoe |
English: What good is food, and what good are clothes,

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jaa man naahee sachaa soe |
English: if the True Lord does not abide within the mind?

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਮੇਵਾ ਕਿਆ ਘਿਉ ਗੁੜੁ ਮਿਠਾ ਕਿਆ ਮੈਦਾ ਕਿਆ ਮਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa mevaa kiaa ghiau gurr mitthaa kiaa maidaa kiaa maas |
English: What good are fruits, what good is ghee, sweet jaggery, what good is flour, and what good is meat?

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਕਪੜੁ ਕਿਆ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਕੀਜਹਿ ਭੋਗ ਬਿਲਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa kaparr kiaa sej sukhaalee keejeh bhog bilaas |
English: What good are clothes, and what good is a soft bed, to enjoy pleasures and sensual delights?

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਲਸਕਰ ਕਿਆ ਨੇਬ ਖਵਾਸੀ ਆਵੈ ਮਹਲੀ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa lasakar kiaa neb khavaasee aavai mahalee vaas |
English: What good is an army, and what good are soldiers, servants and mansions to live in?

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਭੇ ਟੋਲ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak sache naam vin sabhe ttol vinaas |2|
English: O Nanak, without the True Name, all this paraphernalia shall disappear. ||2||

[Ang 142 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਵੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: pavarree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਜਾਤੀ ਦੈ ਕਿਆ ਹਥਿ ਸਚੁ ਪਰਖੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: jaatee dai kiaa hath sach parakheeai |
English: What good is social class and status? Truthfulness is measured within.

Gurbani: ਮਹੁਰਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਥਿ ਮਰੀਐ ਚਖੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: mahuraa hovai hath mareeai chakheeai |
English: Pride in one's status is like poison-holding it in your hand and eating it, you shall die.

Gurbani: ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਸਿਰਕਾਰ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: sache kee sirakaar jug jug jaaneeai |
English: The True Lord's Sovereign Rule is known throughout the ages.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨੇ ਸਿਰਦਾਰੁ ਦਰਿ ਦੀਬਾਣੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: hukam mane siradaar dar deebaaneeai |
English: One who respects the Hukam of the Lord's Command is honored and respected in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਫੁਰਮਾਨੀ ਹੈ ਕਾਰ ਖਸਮਿ ਪਠਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: furamaanee hai kaar khasam patthaaeaa |
English: By the Order of our Lord and Master, we have been brought into this world.

Gurbani: ਤਬਲਬਾਜ ਬੀਚਾਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tabalabaaj beechaar sabad sunaaeaa |
English: The Drummer, the Guru, has announced the Lord's meditation, through the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਹੋਏ ਅਸਵਾਰ ਇਕਨਾ ਸਾਖਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: eik hoe asavaar ikanaa saakhatee |
English: Some have mounted their horses in response, and others are saddling up.

Gurbani: ਇਕਨੀ ਬਧੇ ਭਾਰ ਇਕਨਾ ਤਾਖਤੀ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: eikanee badhe bhaar ikanaa taakhatee |10|
English: Some have tied up their bridles, and others have already ridden off. ||10||

[Ang 142 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਪਕਾ ਤਾ ਕਟਿਆ ਰਹੀ ਸੁ ਪਲਰਿ ਵਾੜਿ ॥
Transliteration: jaa pakaa taa kattiaa rahee su palar vaarr |
English: When the crop is ripe, then it is cut down; only the stalks are left standing.

Gurbani: ਸਣੁ ਕੀਸਾਰਾ ਚਿਥਿਆ ਕਣੁ ਲਇਆ ਤਨੁ ਝਾੜਿ ॥
Transliteration: san keesaaraa chithiaa kan leaa tan jhaarr |
English: The corn on the cob is put into the thresher, and the kernels are separated from the cobs.

Gurbani: ਦੁਇ ਪੁੜ ਚਕੀ ਜੋੜਿ ਕੈ ਪੀਸਣ ਆਇ ਬਹਿਠੁ ॥
Transliteration: due purr chakee jorr kai peesan aae bahitth |
English: Placing the kernels between the two mill-stones, people sit and grind the corn.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਦਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਸੁ ਉਬਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਜਬੁ ਡਿਠੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jo dar rahe su ubare naanak ajab dditth |1|
English: Those kernels which stick to the central axle are spared-Nanak has seen this wonderful vision! ||1||

[Ang 142 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਵੇਖੁ ਜਿ ਮਿਠਾ ਕਟਿਆ ਕਟਿ ਕੁਟਿ ਬਧਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: vekh ji mitthaa kattiaa katt kutt badhaa paae |
English: Look, and see how the sugar-cane is cut down. After cutting away its branches, its feet are bound together into bundles,

Gurbani: ਖੁੰਢਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਖਿ ਕੈ ਦੇਨਿ ਸੁ ਮਲ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: khundtaa andar rakh kai den su mal sajaae |
English: and then, it is placed between the wooden rollers and crushed.

Gurbani: ਰਸੁ ਕਸੁ ਟਟਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਤਪੈ ਤੈ ਵਿਲਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: ras kas ttattar paaeeai tapai tai vilalaae |
English: What punishment is inflicted upon it! Its juice is extracted and placed in the cauldron; as it is heated, it groans and cries out.

Gurbani: ਭੀ ਸੋ ਫੋਗੁ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ ਦਿਚੈ ਅਗਿ ਜਾਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhee so fog samaaleeai dichai ag jaalaae |
English: And then, the crushed cane is collected and burnt in the fire below.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਠੈ ਪਤਰੀਐ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਲੋਕਾ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak mitthai patareeai vekhahu lokaa aae |2|
English: Nanak: come, people, and see how the sweet sugar-cane is treated! ||2||

[Ang 143 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਵੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: pavarree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਇਕਨਾ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਸ ਘਣੇਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: eikanaa maran na chit aas ghaneriaa |
English: Some do not think of death; they entertain great hopes.

Gurbani: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਕੇਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: mar mar jameh nit kisai na keriaa |
English: They die, and are re-born, and die, over and over again. They are of no use at all!

Gurbani: ਆਪਨੜੈ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਹਨਿ ਚੰਗੇਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: aapanarrai man chit kehan changeriaa |
English: In their conscious minds, they call themselves good.

Gurbani: ਜਮਰਾਜੈ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਹੇਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jamaraajai nit nit manamukh heriaa |
English: The King of the Angels of Death hunts down those self-willed manmukhs, over and over again.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਲੂਣ ਹਾਰਾਮ ਕਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh loon haaraam kiaa na jaaniaa |
English: The manmukhs are false to their own selves; they feel no gratitude for what they have been given.

Gurbani: ਬਧੇ ਕਰਨਿ ਸਲਾਮ ਖਸਮ ਨ ਭਾਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: badhe karan salaam khasam na bhaaniaa |
English: Those who merely perform rituals of worship are not pleasing to their Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਭਾਵਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: sach milai mukh naam saahib bhaavasee |
English: Those who attain the True Lord and chant His Name are pleasing to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਰਸਨਿ ਤਖਤਿ ਸਲਾਮੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਵਸੀ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: karasan takhat salaam likhiaa paavasee |11|
English: They worship the Lord and bow at His Throne. They fulfill their pre-ordained destiny. ||11||

[Ang 143 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 salok |
English: First Mehl, Salok:

Gurbani: ਮਛੀ ਤਾਰੂ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਪੰਖੀ ਕਿਆ ਆਕਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: machhee taaroo kiaa kare pankhee kiaa aakaas |
English: What can deep water do to a fish? What can the vast sky do to a bird?

Gurbani: ਪਥਰ ਪਾਲਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਸਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਘਰ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: pathar paalaa kiaa kare khusare kiaa ghar vaas |
English: What can cold do to a stone? What is married life to a eunuch?

Gurbani: ਕੁਤੇ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਲਾਈਐ ਭੀ ਸੋ ਕੁਤੀ ਧਾਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: kute chandan laaeeai bhee so kutee dhaat |
English: You may apply sandalwood oil to a dog, but he will still be a dog.

Gurbani: ਬੋਲਾ ਜੇ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਪੜੀਅਹਿ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪਾਠ ॥
Transliteration: bolaa je samajhaaeeai parreeeh sinmrit paatth |
English: You may try to teach a deaf person by reading the Simritees to him, but how will he learn?

Gurbani: ਅੰਧਾ ਚਾਨਣਿ ਰਖੀਐ ਦੀਵੇ ਬਲਹਿ ਪਚਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: andhaa chaanan rakheeai deeve baleh pachaas |
English: You may place a light before a blind man and burn fifty lamps, but how will he see?

Gurbani: ਚਉਣੇ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਚੁਣਿ ਚੁਣਿ ਖਾਵੈ ਘਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: chaune sueinaa paaeeai chun chun khaavai ghaas |
English: You may place gold before a herd of cattle, but they will pick out the grass to eat.

Gurbani: ਲੋਹਾ ਮਾਰਣਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਢਹੈ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਕਪਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: lohaa maaran paaeeai dtahai na hoe kapaas |
English: You may add flux to iron and melt it, but it will not become soft like cotton.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੂਰਖ ਏਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਬੋਲੇ ਸਦਾ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak moorakh ehi gun bole sadaa vinaas |1|
English: O Nanak, this is the nature of a fool-everything he speaks is useless and wasted. ||1||

[Ang 143 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕੈਹਾ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਤੁਟੈ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: kaihaa kanchan tuttai saar |
English: When pieces of bronze or gold or iron break,

Gurbani: ਅਗਨੀ ਗੰਢੁ ਪਾਏ ਲੋਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: aganee gandt paae lohaar |
English: the metal-smith welds them together again in the fire, and the bond is established.

Gurbani: ਗੋਰੀ ਸੇਤੀ ਤੁਟੈ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: goree setee tuttai bhataar |
English: If a husband leaves his wife,

Gurbani: ਪੁਤਂੀ ਗੰਢੁ ਪਵੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: putanee gandt pavai sansaar |
English: their children may bring them back together in the world, and the bond is established.

Gurbani: ਰਾਜਾ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਿਤੈ ਗੰਢੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: raajaa mangai ditai gandt paae |
English: When the king makes a demand, and it is met, the bond is established.

Gurbani: ਭੁਖਿਆ ਗੰਢੁ ਪਵੈ ਜਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhukhiaa gandt pavai jaa khaae |
English: When the hungry man eats, he is satisfied, and the bond is established.

Gurbani: ਕਾਲਾ ਗੰਢੁ ਨਦੀਆ ਮੀਹ ਝੋਲ ॥
Transliteration: kaalaa gandt nadeea meeh jhol |
English: In the famine, the rain fills the streams to overflowing, and the bond is established.

Gurbani: ਗੰਢੁ ਪਰੀਤੀ ਮਿਠੇ ਬੋਲ ॥
Transliteration: gandt pareetee mitthe bol |
English: There is a bond between love and words of sweetness.

Gurbani: ਬੇਦਾ ਗੰਢੁ ਬੋਲੇ ਸਚੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bedaa gandt bole sach koe |
English: When one speaks the Truth, a bond is established with the Holy Scriptures.

Gurbani: ਮੁਇਆ ਗੰਢੁ ਨੇਕੀ ਸਤੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: mueaa gandt nekee sat hoe |
English: Through goodness and truth, the dead establish a bond with the living.

Gurbani: ਏਤੁ ਗੰਢਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: et gandt varatai sansaar |
English: Such are the bonds which prevail in the world.

Gurbani: ਮੂਰਖ ਗੰਢੁ ਪਵੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਮਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: moorakh gandt pavai muhi maar |
English: The fool establishes his bonds only when he is slapped in the face.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ ਏਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak aakhai ehu beechaar |
English: Nanak says this after deep reflection:

Gurbani: ਸਿਫਤੀ ਗੰਢੁ ਪਵੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sifatee gandt pavai darabaar |2|
English: through the Lord's Praise, we establish a bond with His Court. ||2||

[Ang 143 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸਾਜਿ ਕੈ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape kudarat saaj kai aape kare beechaar |
English: He Himself created and adorned the Universe, and He Himself contemplates it.

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਖੋਟੇ ਇਕਿ ਖਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਪਰਖਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: eik khotte ik khare aape parakhanahaar |
English: Some are counterfeit, and some are genuine. He Himself is the Appraiser.

Gurbani: ਖਰੇ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ਖੋਟੇ ਸਟੀਅਹਿ ਬਾਹਰ ਵਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: khare khajaanai paaeeeh khotte satteeeh baahar vaar |
English: The genuine are placed in His Treasury, while the counterfeit are thrown away.

Gurbani: ਖੋਟੇ ਸਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੁਟੀਅਹਿ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: khotte sachee daragah sutteeeh kis aagai kareh pukaar |
English: The counterfeit are thrown out of the True Court-unto whom should they complain?

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਿਛੈ ਭਜਿ ਪਵਹਿ ਏਹਾ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: satigur pichhai bhaj paveh ehaa karanee saar |
English: They should worship and follow the True Guru-this is the lifestyle of excellence.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਖੋਟਿਅਹੁ ਖਰੇ ਕਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: satigur khottiahu khare kare sabad savaaranahaar |
English: The True Guru converts the counterfeit into genuine; through the Word of the Shabad, He embellishes and exalts us.

Gurbani: ਸਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਮੰਨੀਅਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: sachee daragah maneean gur kai prem piaar |
English: Those who have enshrined love and affection for the Guru, are honored in the True Court.

Gurbani: ਗਣਤ ਤਿਨਾ ਦੀ ਕੋ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਜੋ ਆਪਿ ਬਖਸੇ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: ganat tinaa dee ko kiaa kare jo aap bakhase karataar |12|
English: Who can estimate the value of those who have been forgiven by the Creator Lord Himself? ||12||

[Ang 143 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਜੇਰ ਜਿਮੀ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਪੀਰਾ ਮਸਾਇਕਾ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: ham jer jimee duneea peeraa masaaeikaa raaeaa |
English: All the spiritual teachers, their disciples and the rulers of the world shall be buried under the ground.

Gurbani: ਮੇ ਰਵਦਿ ਬਾਦਿਸਾਹਾ ਅਫਜੂ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: me ravad baadisaahaa afajoo khudaae |
English: The emperors shall also pass away; God alone is Eternal.

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਤੂਹੀ ਏਕ ਤੁਹੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ek toohee ek tuhee |1|
English: You alone, Lord, You alone. ||1||

[Ang 143 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨ ਦੇਵ ਦਾਨਵਾ ਨਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: n dev daanavaa naraa |
English: Neither the angels, nor the demons, nor human beings,

Gurbani: ਨ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕਾ ਧਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: n sidh saadhikaa dharaa |
English: Nor the Siddhas, nor the seekers shall remain on the earth.

Gurbani: ਅਸਤਿ ਏਕ ਦਿਗਰਿ ਕੁਈ ॥
Transliteration: asat ek digar kuee |
English: Who else is there?

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਤੁਈ ਏਕ ਤੁਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ek tuee ek tuee |2|
English: You alone, Lord, You alone. ||2||

[Ang 144 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨ ਦਾਦੇ ਦਿਹੰਦ ਆਦਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: n daade dihand aadamee |
English: Neither the just, nor the generous, nor any humans at all,

Gurbani: ਨ ਸਪਤ ਜੇਰ ਜਿਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: n sapat jer jimee |
English: Nor the seven realms beneath the earth, shall remain.

Gurbani: ਅਸਤਿ ਏਕ ਦਿਗਰਿ ਕੁਈ ॥
Transliteration: asat ek digar kuee |
English: The One Lord alone exists. Who else is there?

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਤੁਈ ਏਕ ਤੁਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ek tuee ek tuee |3|
English: You alone, Lord, You alone. ||3||

[Ang 144 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨ ਸੂਰ ਸਸਿ ਮੰਡਲੋ ॥
Transliteration: n soor sas manddalo |
English: Neither the sun, nor the moon, nor the planets,

Gurbani: ਨ ਸਪਤ ਦੀਪ ਨਹ ਜਲੋ ॥
Transliteration: n sapat deep neh jalo |
English: Nor the seven continents, nor the oceans,

Gurbani: ਅੰਨ ਪਉਣ ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਕੁਈ ॥
Transliteration: an paun thir na kuee |
English: Nor food, nor the wind-nothing is permanent.

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਤੁਈ ਏਕੁ ਤੁਈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: ek tuee ek tuee |4|
English: You alone, Lord, You alone. ||4||

[Ang 144 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਦਸਤ ਆ ਕਸੇ ॥
Transliteration: n rijak dasat aa kase |
English: Our sustenance is not in the hands of any person.

Gurbani: ਹਮਾ ਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਆਸ ਵਸੇ ॥
Transliteration: hamaa raa ek aas vase |
English: The hopes of all rest in the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਸਤਿ ਏਕੁ ਦਿਗਰ ਕੁਈ ॥
Transliteration: asat ek digar kuee |
English: The One Lord alone exists-who else is there?

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਤੁਈ ਏਕੁ ਤੁਈ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: ek tuee ek tuee |5|
English: You alone, Lord, You alone. ||5||

[Ang 144 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪਰੰਦਏ ਨ ਗਿਰਾਹ ਜਰ ॥
Transliteration: parande na giraah jar |
English: The birds have no money in their pockets.

Gurbani: ਦਰਖਤ ਆਬ ਆਸ ਕਰ ॥
Transliteration: darakhat aab aas kar |
English: They place their hopes on trees and water.

Gurbani: ਦਿਹੰਦ ਸੁਈ ॥
Transliteration: dihand suee |
English: He alone is the Giver.

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਤੁਈ ਏਕ ਤੁਈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: ek tuee ek tuee |6|
English: You alone, Lord, You alone. ||6||

[Ang 144 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਲਾਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak lilaar likhiaa soe |
English: O Nanak, that destiny which is pre-ordained and written on one's forehead

Gurbani: ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: mett na saakai koe |
English: no one can erase it.

Gurbani: ਕਲਾ ਧਰੈ ਹਿਰੈ ਸੁਈ ॥
Transliteration: kalaa dharai hirai suee |
English: The Lord infuses strength, and He takes it away again.

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਤੁਈ ਏਕੁ ਤੁਈ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: ek tuee ek tuee |7|
English: You alone, O Lord, You alone. ||7||

[Ang 144 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa teraa hukam guramukh jaaniaa |
English: True is the Hukam of Your Command. To the Gurmukh, it is known.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: guramatee aap gavaae sach pachhaaniaa |
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, selfishness and conceit are eradicated, and the Truth is realized.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sach teraa darabaar sabad neesaaniaa |
English: True is Your Court. It is proclaimed and revealed through the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa sabad veechaar sach samaaniaa |
English: Meditating deeply on the True Word of the Shabad, I have merged into the Truth.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸਦਾ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh sadaa koorriaar bharam bhulaaniaa |
English: The self-willed manmukhs are always false; they are deluded by doubt.

Gurbani: ਵਿਸਟਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: visattaa andar vaas saad na jaaniaa |
English: They dwell in manure, and they do not know the taste of the Name.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: vin naavai dukh paae aavan jaaniaa |
English: Without the Name, they suffer the agonies of coming and going.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਖੁ ਆਪਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਖੋਟਾ ਖਰਾ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: naanak paarakh aap jin khottaa kharaa pachhaaniaa |13|
English: O Nanak, the Lord Himself is the Appraiser, who distinguishes the counterfeit from the genuine. ||13||

[Ang 144 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੀਹਾ ਬਾਜਾ ਚਰਗਾ ਕੁਹੀਆ ਏਨਾ ਖਵਾਲੇ ਘਾਹ ॥
Transliteration: seehaa baajaa charagaa kuheea enaa khavaale ghaah |
English: Tigers, hawks, falcons and eagles-the Lord could make them eat grass.

Gurbani: ਘਾਹੁ ਖਾਨਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਮਾਸੁ ਖਵਾਲੇ ਏਹਿ ਚਲਾਏ ਰਾਹ ॥
Transliteration: ghaahu khaan tinaa maas khavaale ehi chalaae raah |
English: And those animals which eat grass-He could make them eat meat. He could make them follow this way of life.

Gurbani: ਨਦੀਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਟਿਬੇ ਦੇਖਾਲੇ ਥਲੀ ਕਰੇ ਅਸਗਾਹ ॥
Transliteration: nadeea vich ttibe dekhaale thalee kare asagaah |
English: He could raise dry land from the rivers, and turn the deserts into bottomless oceans.

Gurbani: ਕੀੜਾ ਥਾਪਿ ਦੇਇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀ ਲਸਕਰ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਆਹ ॥
Transliteration: keerraa thaap dee paatisaahee lasakar kare suaah |
English: He could appoint a worm as king, and reduce an army to ashes.

Gurbani: ਜੇਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਲੈ ਸਾਹਾ ਜੀਵਾਲੇ ਤਾ ਕਿ ਅਸਾਹ ॥
Transliteration: jete jeea jeeveh lai saahaa jeevaale taa ki asaah |
English: All beings and creatures live by breathing, but He could keep us alive, even without the breath.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਸਚੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਤਿਉ ਦੇਇ ਗਿਰਾਹ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak jiau jiau sache bhaavai tiau tiau dee giraah |1|
English: O Nanak, as it pleases the True Lord, He gives us sustenance. ||1||

[Ang 144 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਮਾਸਹਾਰੀ ਇਕਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: eik maasahaaree ik trin khaeh |
English: Some eat meat, while others eat grass.

Gurbani: ਇਕਨਾ ਛਤੀਹ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: eikanaa chhateeh amrit paeh |
English: Some have all the thirty-six varieties of delicacies,

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਮਿਟੀਆ ਮਹਿ ਮਿਟੀਆ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: eik mitteea meh mitteea khaeh |
English: while others live in the dirt and eat mud.

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਪਉਣ ਸੁਮਾਰੀ ਪਉਣ ਸੁਮਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: eik paun sumaaree paun sumaar |
English: Some control the breath, and regulate their breathing.

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ਨਾਮ ਆਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: eik nirankaaree naam aadhaar |
English: Some live by the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Formless Lord.

Gurbani: ਜੀਵੈ ਦਾਤਾ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jeevai daataa marai na koe |
English: The Great Giver lives; no one dies.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੁਠੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak mutthe jaeh naahee man soe |2|
English: O Nanak, those who do not enshrine the Lord within their minds are deluded. ||2||

[Ang 144 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਮਿ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: poore gur kee kaar karam kamaaeeai |
English: By the karma of good actions, some come to serve the Perfect Guru.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: guramatee aap gavaae naam dhiaaeeai |
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, some eliminate selfishness and conceit, and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਗਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: doojee kaarai lag janam gavaaeeai |
English: Undertaking any other task, they waste their lives in vain.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਵਿਸੁ ਪੈਝੈ ਖਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: vin naavai sabh vis paijhai khaaeeai |
English: Without the Name, all that they wear and eat is poison.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa sabad saalaeh sach samaaeeai |
English: Praising the True Word of the Shabad, they merge with the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੁਖਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: vin satigur seve naahee sukh nivaas fir fir aaeeai |
English: Without serving the True Guru, they do not obtain the home of peace; they are consigned to reincarnation, over and over again.

Gurbani: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਖੋਟੀ ਰਾਸਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: duneea khottee raas koorr kamaaeeai |
English: Investing counterfeit capital, they earn only falsehood in the world.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਖਰਾ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: naanak sach kharaa saalaeh pat siau jaaeeai |14|
English: O Nanak, singing the Praises of the Pure, True Lord, they depart with honor. ||14||

[Ang 144 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਵਾਵਹਿ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਜਲਿ ਨਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: tudh bhaavai taa vaaveh gaaveh tudh bhaavai jal naaveh |
English: When it pleases You, we play music and sing; when it pleases You, we bathe in water.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਿਭੂਤਾ ਸਿੰਙੀ ਨਾਦੁ ਵਜਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jaa tudh bhaaveh taa kareh bibhootaa singee naad vajaaveh |
English: When it pleases You, we smear our bodies with ashes, and blow the horn and the conch shell.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਪੜਹਿ ਕਤੇਬਾ ਮੁਲਾ ਸੇਖ ਕਹਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jaa tudh bhaavai taa parreh katebaa mulaa sekh kahaaveh |
English: When it pleases You, we read the Islamic Scriptures, and are acclaimed as Mullahs and Shaykhs.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jaa tudh bhaavai taa hoveh raaje ras kas bahut kamaaveh |
English: When it pleases You, we become kings, and enjoy all sorts of tastes and pleasures.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੇਗ ਵਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਿਰ ਮੁੰਡੀ ਕਟਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jaa tudh bhaavai teg vagaaveh sir munddee katt jaaveh |
English: When it pleases You, we wield the sword, and cut off the heads of our enemies.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਜਾਹਿ ਦਿਸੰਤਰਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਗਲਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jaa tudh bhaavai jaeh disantar sun galaa ghar aaveh |
English: When it pleases You, we go out to foreign lands; hearing news of home, we come back again.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਇ ਰਚਾਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣੇ ਤੂੰ ਭਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jaa tudh bhaavai naae rachaaveh tudh bhaane toon bhaaveh |
English: When it pleases You, we are attuned to the Name, and when it pleases You, we become pleasing to You.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਏਕ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਹੋਰਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak ek kahai benantee hor sagale koorr kamaaveh |1|
English: Nanak utters this one prayer; everything else is just the practice of falsehood. ||1||

[Ang 145 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਵਡਾ ਸਭਿ ਵਡਿਆਂਈਆ ਚੰਗੈ ਚੰਗਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jaa toon vaddaa sabh vaddiaaneea changai changaa hoee |
English: You are so Great-all Greatness flows from You. You are So Good-Goodness radiates from You.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਸਚਾ ਕੂੜਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jaa toon sachaa taa sabh ko sachaa koorraa koe na koee |
English: You are True-all that flows from You is True. Nothing at all is false.

Gurbani: ਆਖਣੁ ਵੇਖਣੁ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਚਲਣੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਧਾਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: aakhan vekhan bolan chalan jeevan maranaa dhaat |
English: Talking, seeing, speaking, walking, living and dying-all these are transitory.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਾਜਿ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਖੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਆਪਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: hukam saaj hukamai vich rakhai naanak sachaa aap |2|
English: By the Hukam of His Command, He creates, and in His Command, He keeps us. O Nanak, He Himself is True. ||2||

[Ang 145 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਨਿਸੰਗੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sev nisang bharam chukaaeeai |
English: Serve the True Guru fearlessly, and your doubt shall be dispelled.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਖੈ ਕਾਰ ਸੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: satigur aakhai kaar su kaar kamaaeeai |
English: Do that work which the True Guru asks you to do.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: satigur hoe deaal ta naam dhiaaeeai |
English: When the True Guru becomes merciful, we meditate on the Naam.

Gurbani: ਲਾਹਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: laahaa bhagat su saar guramukh paaeeai |
English: The profit of devotional worship is excellent. It is obtained by the Gurmukh.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh koorr gubaar koorr kamaaeeai |
English: The self-willed manmukhs are trapped in the darkness of falsehood; they practice nothing but falsehood.

Gurbani: ਸਚੇ ਦੈ ਦਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਸਚੁ ਚਵਾਂਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: sache dai dar jaae sach chavaaneeai |
English: Go to the Gate of Truth, and speak the Truth.

Gurbani: ਸਚੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮਹਲਿ ਸਚਿ ਬੁਲਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: sachai andar mehal sach bulaaeeai |
English: The True Lord calls the true ones to the Mansion of His Presence.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: naanak sach sadaa sachiaar sach samaaeeai |15|
English: O Nanak, the true ones are forever true; they are absorbed in the True Lord. ||15||

[Ang 145 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਲਿ ਕਾਤੀ ਰਾਜੇ ਕਾਸਾਈ ਧਰਮੁ ਪੰਖ ਕਰਿ ਉਡਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: kal kaatee raaje kaasaaee dharam pankh kar uddariaa |
English: The Dark Age of Kali Yuga is the knife, and the kings are butchers; righteousness has sprouted wings and flown away.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜੁ ਅਮਾਵਸ ਸਚੁ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਮਾ ਦੀਸੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਹ ਚੜਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: koorr amaavas sach chandramaa deesai naahee keh charriaa |
English: In this dark night of falsehood, the moon of Truth is not visible anywhere.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਭਾਲਿ ਵਿਕੁੰਨੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: hau bhaal vikunee hoee |
English: I have searched in vain, and I am so confused;

Gurbani: ਆਧੇਰੈ ਰਾਹੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aadherai raahu na koee |
English: In this darkness, I cannot find the path.

Gurbani: ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਰੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: vich haumai kar dukh roee |
English: In egotism, they cry out in pain.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak kin bidh gat hoee |1|
English: Says Nanak, how will they be saved? ||1||

[Ang 145 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਲਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: kal keerat paragatt chaanan sansaar |
English: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise has appeared as a Light in the world.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੋਈ ਉਤਰੈ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh koee utarai paar |
English: How rare are those few Gurmukhs who swim across to the other side!

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jis no nadar kare tis devai |
English: The Lord bestows His Glance of Grace;

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਸੋ ਲੇਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh ratan so levai |2|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh receives the jewel. ||2||

[Ang 145 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਾ ਤੈ ਸੈਸਾਰੀਆ ਜੋੜੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bhagataa tai saisaareea jorr kade na aaeaa |
English: Between the Lord's devotees and the people of the world, there can never be any true alliance.

Gurbani: ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਅਭੁਲੁ ਹੈ ਨ ਭੁਲੈ ਕਿਸੈ ਦਾ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: karataa aap abhul hai na bhulai kisai daa bhulaaeaa |
English: The Creator Himself is infallible. He cannot be fooled; no one can fool Him.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿਅਨੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat aape melian jinee sacho sach kamaaeaa |
English: He blends His devotees with Himself; they practice Truth, and only Truth.

Gurbani: ਸੈਸਾਰੀ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਇਅਨੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬੋਲਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: saisaaree aap khuaaeian jinee koorr bol bol bikh khaaeaa |
English: The Lord Himself leads the people of the world astray; they tell lies, and by telling lies, they eat poison.

Gurbani: ਚਲਣ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰੋਧੁ ਵਿਸੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: chalan saar na jaananee kaam karodh vis vadhaaeaa |
English: They do not recognize the ultimate reality, that we all must go; they continue to cultivate the poisons of sexual desire and anger.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤ ਕਰਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਜਿਨੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat karan har chaakaree jinee anadin naam dhiaaeaa |
English: The devotees serve the Lord; night and day, they meditate on the Naam.

Gurbani: ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਜਿਨੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: daasan daas hoe kai jinee vichahu aap gavaaeaa |
English: Becoming the slaves of the Lord's slaves, they eradicate selfishness and conceit from within.

Gurbani: ਓਨਾ ਖਸਮੈ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: onaa khasamai kai dar mukh ujale sachai sabad suhaaeaa |16|
English: In the Court of their Lord and Master, their faces are radiant; they are embellished and exalted with the True Word of the Shabad. ||16||

[Ang 145 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਬਾਹੀ ਸਾਲਾਹ ਜਿਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: sabaahee saalaah jinee dhiaaeaa ik man |
English: Those who praise the Lord in the early hours of the morning and meditate on Him single-mindedly,

Gurbani: ਸੇਈ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਾਹ ਵਖਤੈ ਉਪਰਿ ਲੜਿ ਮੁਏ ॥
Transliteration: seee poore saah vakhatai upar larr mue |
English: are the perfect kings; at the right time, they die fighting.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਬਹੁਤੇ ਰਾਹ ਮਨ ਕੀਆ ਮਤੀ ਖਿੰਡੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: doojai bahute raah man keea matee khinddeea |
English: In the second watch, the focus of the mind is scattered in all sorts of ways.

Gurbani: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪਏ ਅਸਗਾਹ ਗੋਤੇ ਖਾਹਿ ਨ ਨਿਕਲਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: bahut pe asagaah gote khaeh na nikaleh |
English: So many fall into the bottomless pit; they are dragged under, and they cannot get out again.

Gurbani: ਤੀਜੈ ਮੁਹੀ ਗਿਰਾਹ ਭੁਖ ਤਿਖਾ ਦੁਇ ਭਉਕੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: teejai muhee giraah bhukh tikhaa due bhaukeea |
English: In the third watch, both hunger and thirst bark for attention, and food is put into the mouth.

Gurbani: ਖਾਧਾ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਆਹ ਭੀ ਖਾਣੇ ਸਿਉ ਦੋਸਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: khaadhaa hoe suaah bhee khaane siau dosatee |
English: That which is eaten becomes dust, but they are still attached to eating.

Gurbani: ਚਉਥੈ ਆਈ ਊਂਘ ਅਖੀ ਮੀਟਿ ਪਵਾਰਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: chauthai aaee aoongh akhee meett pavaar geaa |
English: In the fourth watch, they become drowsy. They close their eyes and begin to dream.

Gurbani: ਭੀ ਉਠਿ ਰਚਿਓਨੁ ਵਾਦੁ ਸੈ ਵਰਿੑਆ ਕੀ ਪਿੜ ਬਧੀ ॥
Transliteration: bhee utth rachion vaad sai varaa kee pirr badhee |
English: Rising up again, they engage in conflicts; they set the stage as if they will live for 100 years.

Gurbani: ਸਭੇ ਵੇਲਾ ਵਖਤ ਸਭਿ ਜੇ ਅਠੀ ਭਉ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabhe velaa vakhat sabh je atthee bhau hoe |
English: If at all times, at each and every moment, they live in the fear of God

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਵਣੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak saahib man vasai sachaa naavan hoe |1|
English: -O Nanak, the Lord dwells within their minds, and their cleansing bath is true. ||1||

[Ang 146 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 2 |
English: Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੇਈ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਾਹ ਜਿਨੀ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: seee poore saah jinee pooraa paaeaa |
English: They are the perfect kings, who have found the Perfect Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਠੀ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹ ਰਹਨਿ ਇਕਤੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: atthee veparavaah rehan ikatai rang |
English: Twenty-four hours a day, they remain unconcerned, imbued with the Love of the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਦਰਸਨਿ ਰੂਪਿ ਅਥਾਹ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: darasan roop athaah virale paaeeeh |
English: Only a few obtain the Darshan, the Blessed Vision of the Unimaginably Beauteous Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਬੋਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: karam poorai pooraa guroo pooraa jaa kaa bol |
English: Through the perfect karma of good deeds, one meets the Perfect Guru, whose speech is perfect.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਾ ਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਘਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੋਲੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak pooraa je kare ghattai naahee tol |2|
English: O Nanak, when the Guru makes one perfect, one's weight does not decrease. ||2||

[Ang 146 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਰਿ ਮੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: jaa toon taa kiaa hor mai sach sunaaeeai |
English: When You are with me, what more could I want? I speak only the Truth.

Gurbani: ਮੁਠੀ ਧੰਧੈ ਚੋਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: mutthee dhandhai chor mehal na paaeeai |
English: Plundered by the thieves of worldly affairs, she does not obtain the Mansion of His Presence.

Gurbani: ਏਨੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਠੋਰਿ ਸੇਵ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: enai chit katthor sev gavaaeeai |
English: Being so stone-hearted, she has lost her chance to serve the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ਸੁ ਭੰਨਿ ਘੜਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: jit ghatt sach na paae su bhan gharraaeeai |
English: That heart, in which the True Lord is not found, should be torn down and re-built.

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਵਟਿ ਤੋਲਿ ਤੁਲਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: kiau kar poorai vatt tol tulaaeeai |
English: How can she be weighed accurately, upon the scale of perfection?

Gurbani: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਆਖੈ ਘਟਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
