Transliteration: koe na aakhai ghatt haumai jaaeeai |
English: No one will say that her weight has been shorted, if she rids herself of egotism.

Gurbani: ਲਈਅਨਿ ਖਰੇ ਪਰਖਿ ਦਰਿ ਬੀਨਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: leean khare parakh dar beenaaeeai |
English: The genuine are assayed, and accepted in the Court of the All-knowing Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਉਦਾ ਇਕਤੁ ਹਟਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: saudaa ikat hatt poorai gur paaeeai |17|
English: The genuine merchandise is found only in one shop-it is obtained from the Perfect Guru. ||17||

[Ang 146 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 2 |
English: Salok, Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਠੀ ਪਹਰੀ ਅਠ ਖੰਡ ਨਾਵਾ ਖੰਡੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: atthee paharee atth khandd naavaa khandd sareer |
English: Twenty-four hours a day, destroy the eight things, and in the ninth place, conquer the body.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਏਕੁ ਭਾਲਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: tis vich nau nidh naam ek bhaaleh gunee gaheer |
English: Within the body are the nine treasures of the Name of the Lord-seek the depths of these virtues.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮਵੰਤੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੀਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: karamavantee saalaahiaa naanak kar gur peer |
English: Those blessed with the karma of good actions praise the Lord. O Nanak, they make the Guru their spiritual teacher.

Gurbani: ਚਉਥੈ ਪਹਰਿ ਸਬਾਹ ਕੈ ਸੁਰਤਿਆ ਉਪਜੈ ਚਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: chauthai pehar sabaah kai suratiaa upajai chaau |
English: In the fourth watch of the early morning hours, a longing arises in their higher consciousness.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨਾ ਦਰੀਆਵਾ ਸਿਉ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tinaa dareeaavaa siau dosatee man mukh sachaa naau |
English: They are attuned to the river of life; the True Name is in their minds and on their lips.

Gurbani: ਓਥੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵੰਡੀਐ ਕਰਮੀ ਹੋਇ ਪਸਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: othai amrit vanddeeai karamee hoe pasaau |
English: The Ambrosial Nectar is distributed, and those with good karma receive this gift.

Gurbani: ਕੰਚਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਕਸੀਐ ਵੰਨੀ ਚੜੈ ਚੜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kanchan kaaeaa kaseeai vanee charrai charraau |
English: Their bodies become golden, and take on the color of spirituality.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਸਰਾਫ ਕੀ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ਤਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: je hovai nadar saraaf kee bahurr na paaee taau |
English: If the Jeweller casts His Glance of Grace, they are not placed in the fire again.

Gurbani: ਸਤੀ ਪਹਰੀ ਸਤੁ ਭਲਾ ਬਹੀਐ ਪੜਿਆ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: satee paharee sat bhalaa baheeai parriaa paas |
English: Throughout the other seven watches of the day, it is good to speak the Truth, and sit with the spiritually wise.

Gurbani: ਓਥੈ ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਕੂੜੈ ਘਟੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: othai paap pun beechaareeai koorrai ghattai raas |
English: There, vice and virtue are distinguished, and the capital of falsehood is decreased.

Gurbani: ਓਥੈ ਖੋਟੇ ਸਟੀਅਹਿ ਖਰੇ ਕੀਚਹਿ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: othai khotte satteeeh khare keecheh saabaas |
English: There, the counterfeit are cast aside, and the genuine are cheered.

Gurbani: ਬੋਲਣੁ ਫਾਦਲੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਖਸਮੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bolan faadal naanakaa dukh sukh khasamai paas |1|
English: Speech is vain and useless. O Nanak, pain and pleasure are in the power of our Lord and Master. ||1||

[Ang 146 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 2 |
English: Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪਉਣੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਤਾ ਧਰਤਿ ਮਹਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: paun guroo paanee pitaa maataa dharat mehat |
English: Air is the Guru, Water is the Father, and Earth is the Great Mother of all.

Gurbani: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਦੁਇ ਦਾਈ ਦਾਇਆ ਖੇਲੈ ਸਗਲ ਜਗਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: dinas raat due daaee daaeaa khelai sagal jagat |
English: Day and night are the two nurses, in whose lap all the world is at play.

Gurbani: ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਬੁਰਿਆਈਆ ਵਾਚੇ ਧਰਮੁ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: changiaaeea buriaaeea vaache dharam hadoor |
English: Good deeds and bad deeds-the record is read out in the Presence of the Lord of Dharma.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮੀ ਆਪੋ ਆਪਣੀ ਕੇ ਨੇੜੈ ਕੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: karamee aapo aapanee ke nerrai ke door |
English: According to their own actions, some are drawn closer, and some are driven farther away.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗਏ ਮਸਕਤਿ ਘਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: jinee naam dhiaaeaa ge masakat ghaal |
English: Those who have meditated on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and departed after having worked by the sweat of their brow

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਹੋਰ ਕੇਤੀ ਛੁਟੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak te mukh ujale hor ketee chhuttee naal |2|
English: -O Nanak, their faces are radiant in the Court of the Lord, and many others are saved along with them! ||2||

[Ang 146 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭਾਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਸਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa bhojan bhaau satigur dasiaa |
English: The True Food is the Love of the Lord; the True Guru has spoken.

Gurbani: ਸਚੇ ਹੀ ਪਤੀਆਇ ਸਚਿ ਵਿਗਸਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sache hee pateeae sach vigasiaa |
English: With this True Food, I am satisfied, and with the Truth, I am delighted.

Gurbani: ਸਚੈ ਕੋਟਿ ਗਿਰਾਂਇ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sachai kott giraane nij ghar vasiaa |
English: True are the cities and the villages, where one abides in the True Home of the self.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਨਾਉ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਰਹਸਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: satigur tutthai naau prem rahasiaa |
English: When the True Guru is pleased, one receives the Lord's Name, and blossoms forth in His Love.

Gurbani: ਸਚੈ ਦੈ ਦੀਬਾਣਿ ਕੂੜਿ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: sachai dai deebaan koorr na jaaeeai |
English: No one enters the Court of the True Lord through falsehood.

Gurbani: ਝੂਠੋ ਝੂਠੁ ਵਖਾਣਿ ਸੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਖੁਆਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: jhoottho jhootth vakhaan su mehal khuaaeeai |
English: By uttering falsehood and only falsehood, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is lost.

Gurbani: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨੀਸਾਣਿ ਠਾਕ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: sachai sabad neesaan tthaak na paaeeai |
English: No one blocks the way of those who are blessed with the Banner of the True Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਬੁਝਿ ਵਖਾਣਿ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਈਐ ॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: sach sun bujh vakhaan mehal bulaaeeai |18|
English: Hearing, understanding and speaking Truth, one is called to the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||18||

[Ang 147 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪਹਿਰਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਹਿਵੈ ਘਰੁ ਬਾਧਾ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਕਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: pahiraa agan hivai ghar baadhaa bhojan saar karaaee |
English: If I dressed myself in fire, and built my house of snow, and made iron my food;

Gurbani: ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਪਾਣੀ ਕਰਿ ਪੀਵਾ ਧਰਤੀ ਹਾਕ ਚਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sagale dookh paanee kar peevaa dharatee haak chalaaee |
English: and if I were to drink in all pain like water, and drive the entire earth before me;

Gurbani: ਧਰਿ ਤਾਰਾਜੀ ਅੰਬਰੁ ਤੋਲੀ ਪਿਛੈ ਟੰਕੁ ਚੜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: dhar taaraajee anbar tolee pichhai ttank charraaee |
English: and if I were to place the earth upon a scale and balance it with a single copper coin;

Gurbani: ਏਵਡੁ ਵਧਾ ਮਾਵਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਭਸੈ ਨਥਿ ਚਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: evadd vadhaa maavaa naahee sabhasai nath chalaaee |
English: and if I were to become so great that I could not be contained, and if I were to control and lead all;

Gurbani: ਏਤਾ ਤਾਣੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਰੀ ਭਿ ਆਖਿ ਕਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: etaa taan hovai man andar karee bhi aakh karaaee |
English: and if I were to possess so much power within my mind that I could cause others to do my bidding-so what?

Gurbani: ਜੇਵਡੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਤੇਵਡ ਦਾਤੀ ਦੇ ਦੇ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jevadd saahib tevadd daatee de de kare rajaaee |
English: As Great as our Lord and Master is, so great are His gifts. He bestows them according to His Will.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਉਪਰਿ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak nadar kare jis upar sach naam vaddiaaee |1|
English: O Nanak, those upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, obtain the glorious greatness of the True Name. ||1||

[Ang 147 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 2 |
English: Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਖਣੁ ਆਖਿ ਨ ਰਜਿਆ ਸੁਨਣਿ ਨ ਰਜੇ ਕੰਨ ॥
Transliteration: aakhan aakh na rajiaa sunan na raje kan |
English: The mouth is not satisfied by speaking, and the ears are not satisfied by hearing.

Gurbani: ਅਖੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਨ ਰਜੀਆ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹਕ ਇਕ ਵੰਨ ॥
Transliteration: akhee dekh na rajeea gun gaahak ik van |
English: The eyes are not satisfied by seeing-each organ seeks out one sensory quality.

Gurbani: ਭੁਖਿਆ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਗਲੀ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhukhiaa bhukh na utarai galee bhukh na jaae |
English: The hunger of the hungry is not appeased; by mere words, hunger is not relieved.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਭੁਖਾ ਤਾ ਰਜੈ ਜਾ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak bhukhaa taa rajai jaa gun keh gunee samaae |2|
English: O Nanak, hunger is relieved only when one utters the Glorious Praises of the Praiseworthy Lord. ||2||

[Ang 147 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: vin sache sabh koorr koorr kamaaeeai |
English: Without the True One, all are false, and all practice falsehood.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਚੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੁ ਬੰਨਿ ਚਲਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: vin sache koorriaar ban chalaaeeai |
English: Without the True One, the false ones are bound and gagged and driven off.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਚੇ ਤਨੁ ਛਾਰੁ ਛਾਰੁ ਰਲਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: vin sache tan chhaar chhaar ralaaeeai |
English: Without the True One, the body is just ashes, and it mingles again with ashes.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਭ ਭੁਖ ਜਿ ਪੈਝੈ ਖਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: vin sache sabh bhukh ji paijhai khaaeeai |
English: Without the True Ome, all food and clothes are unsatisfying.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਚੇ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ਕੂੜਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: vin sache darabaar koorr na paaeeai |
English: Without the True One, the false ones do not attain the Lord's Court.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜੈ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਲਗਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਖੁਆਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: koorrai laalach lag mehal khuaaeeai |
English: Attached to false attachments, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is lost.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਠਗਿਓ ਠਗਿ ਆਈਐ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: sabh jag tthagio tthag aaeeai jaaeeai |
English: The whole world is deceived by deception, coming and going in reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਈਐ ॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: tan meh trisanaa ag sabad bujhaaeeai |19|
English: Within the body is the fire of desire; through the Word of the Shabad, it is quenched. ||19||

[Ang 147 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਰੁਖੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਫੁਲੁ ਫਲ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak gur santokh rukh dharam ful fal giaan |
English: O Nanak, the Guru is the tree of contentment, with flowers of faith, and fruits of spiritual wisdom.

Gurbani: ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿਆ ਹਰਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਪਕੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਧਿਆਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: ras rasiaa hariaa sadaa pakai karam dhiaan |
English: Watered with the Lord's Love, it remains forever green; through the karma of good deeds and meditation, it ripens.

Gurbani: ਪਤਿ ਕੇ ਸਾਦ ਖਾਦਾ ਲਹੈ ਦਾਨਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: pat ke saad khaadaa lahai daanaa kai sir daan |1|
English: Honor is obtained by eating this tasty dish; of all gifts, this is the greatest gift. ||1||

[Ang 147 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੁਇਨੇ ਕਾ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਪਤ ਪਰਵਾਲਾ ਫੁਲ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਲਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: sueine kaa birakh pat paravaalaa ful javehar laal |
English: The Guru is the tree of gold, with leaves of coral, and blossoms of jewels and rubies.

Gurbani: ਤਿਤੁ ਫਲ ਰਤਨ ਲਗਹਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਭਾਖਿਤ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: tit fal ratan lageh mukh bhaakhit hiradai ridai nihaal |
English: The Words from His Mouth are fruits of jewels. Within His Heart, He beholds the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਲੇਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak karam hovai mukh masatak likhiaa hovai lekh |
English: O Nanak, He is obtained by those, upon whose faces and foreheads such pre-recorded destiny is written.

Gurbani: ਅਠਿਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਪੂਜੈ ਸਦਾ ਵਿਸੇਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: atthisatth teerath gur kee charanee poojai sadaa visekh |
English: The sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage are contained in the constant worship of the feet of the Exalted Guru.

Gurbani: ਹੰਸੁ ਹੇਤੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਕੋਪੁ ਚਾਰੇ ਨਦੀਆ ਅਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: hans het lobh kop chaare nadeea ag |
English: Cruelty, material attachment, greed and anger are the four rivers of fire.

Gurbani: ਪਵਹਿ ਦਝਹਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਤਰੀਐ ਕਰਮੀ ਲਗਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: paveh dajheh naanakaa tareeai karamee lag |2|
English: Falling into them, one is burned, O Nanak! One is saved only by holding tight to good deeds. ||2||

[Ang 147 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਮਰੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: jeevadiaa mar maar na pachhotaaeeai |
English: While you are alive, conquer death, and you shall have no regrets in the end.

Gurbani: ਝੂਠਾ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਕਿਨਿ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: jhootthaa ihu sansaar kin samajhaaeeai |
English: This world is false, but only a few understand this.

Gurbani: ਸਚਿ ਨ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਧਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: sach na dhare piaar dhandhai dhaaeeai |
English: People do not enshrine love for the Truth; they chase after worldly affairs instead.

Gurbani: ਕਾਲੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਖੈ ਕਾਲੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਦੁਨੀਆਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: kaal buraa khai kaal sir duneeaeeai |
English: The terrible time of death and annihilation hovers over the heads of the world.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਦਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: hukamee sir jandaar maare daaeeai |
English: By the Hukam of the Lord's Command, the Messenger of Death smashes his club over their heads.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: aape dee piaar man vasaaeeai |
English: The Lord Himself gives His Love, and enshrines it within their minds.

Gurbani: ਮੁਹਤੁ ਨ ਚਸਾ ਵਿਲੰਮੁ ਭਰੀਐ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: muhat na chasaa vilam bhareeai paaeeai |
English: Not a moment or an instant's delay is permitted, when one's measure of life is full.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੁਝਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee bujh sach samaaeeai |20|
English: By Guru's Grace, one comes to know the True One, and is absorbed into Him. ||20||

[Ang 147 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤੁਮੀ ਤੁਮਾ ਵਿਸੁ ਅਕੁ ਧਤੂਰਾ ਨਿਮੁ ਫਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: tumee tumaa vis ak dhatooraa nim fal |
English: Bitter melon, swallow-wort, thorn-apple and nim fruit

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: man mukh vaseh tis jis toon chit na aavahee |
English: these bitter poisons lodge in the minds and mouths of those who do not remember You

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਸੁ ਹੰਢਨਿ ਕਰਮਾ ਬਾਹਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak kaheeai kis handtan karamaa baahare |1|
English: O Nanak, how shall I tell them this? Without the karma of good deeds, they are only destroying themselves. ||1||

[Ang 147 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਤਿ ਪੰਖੇਰੂ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਸਾਥਿ ਕਬ ਉਤਮ ਕਬ ਨੀਚ ॥
Transliteration: mat pankheroo kirat saath kab utam kab neech |
English: The intellect is a bird; on account of its actions, it is sometimes high, and sometimes low.

Gurbani: ਕਬ ਚੰਦਨਿ ਕਬ ਅਕਿ ਡਾਲਿ ਕਬ ਉਚੀ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: kab chandan kab ak ddaal kab uchee pareet |
English: Sometimes it is perched on the sandalwood tree, and sometimes it is on the branch of the poisonous swallow-wort. Sometimes, it soars through the heavens.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਚਲਾਈਐ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਲਗੀ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak hukam chalaaeeai saahib lagee reet |2|
English: O Nanak, our Lord and Master leads us on, according to the Hukam of His Command; such is His Way. ||2||

[Ang 148 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਕੇਤੇ ਕਹਹਿ ਵਖਾਣ ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਜਾਵਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: kete kaheh vakhaan keh keh jaavanaa |
English: Some speak and expound, and while speaking and lecturing, they pass away.

Gurbani: ਵੇਦ ਕਹਹਿ ਵਖਿਆਣ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: ved kaheh vakhiaan ant na paavanaa |
English: The Vedas speak and expound on the Lord, but they do not know His limits.

Gurbani: ਪੜਿਐ ਨਾਹੀ ਭੇਦੁ ਬੁਝਿਐ ਪਾਵਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: parriai naahee bhed bujhiai paavanaa |
English: Not by studying, but through understanding, is the Lord's Mystery revealed.

Gurbani: ਖਟੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੈ ਭੇਖਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: khatt darasan kai bhekh kisai sach samaavanaa |
English: There are six pathways in the Shaastras, but how rare are those who merge in the True Lord through them.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa purakh alakh sabad suhaavanaa |
English: The True Lord is Unknowable; through the Word of His Shabad, we are embellished.

Gurbani: ਮੰਨੇ ਨਾਉ ਬਿਸੰਖ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: mane naau bisankh daragah paavanaa |
English: One who believes in the Name of the Infinite Lord, attains the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਖਾਲਕ ਕਉ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਢਾਢੀ ਗਾਵਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: khaalak kau aades dtaadtee gaavanaa |
English: I humbly bow to the Creator Lord; I am a minstrel singing His Praises.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਾ ॥੨੧॥
Transliteration: naanak jug jug ek man vasaavanaa |21|
English: Nanak enshrines the Lord within his mind. He is the One, throughout the ages. ||21||

[Ang 148 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 2 |
English: Salok, Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਹੋਇ ਅਠੂਹਿਆ ਨਾਗੀ ਲਗੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: mantree hoe atthoohiaa naagee lagai jaae |
English: Those who charm scorpions and handle snakes

Gurbani: ਆਪਣ ਹਥੀ ਆਪਣੈ ਦੇ ਕੂਚਾ ਆਪੇ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aapan hathee aapanai de koochaa aape laae |
English: Only brand themselves with their own hands.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਇਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਅਤੀ ਹੂ ਧਕਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: hukam peaa dhur khasam kaa atee hoo dhakaa khaae |
English: By the pre-ordained Order of our Lord and Master, they are beaten badly, and struck down.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਸਿਉ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅੜੈ ਡੁਬੈ ਹਕਿ ਨਿਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh siau manamukh arrai ddubai hak niaae |
English: If the self-willed manmukhs fight with the Gurmukh, they are condemned by the Lord, the True Judge.

Gurbani: ਦੁਹਾ ਸਿਰਿਆ ਆਪੇ ਖਸਮੁ ਵੇਖੈ ਕਰਿ ਵਿਉਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: duhaa siriaa aape khasam vekhai kar viaupaae |
English: He Himself is the Lord and Master of both worlds. He beholds all and makes the exact determination.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਵੈ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak evai jaaneeai sabh kichh tiseh rajaae |1|
English: O Nanak, know this well: everything is in accordance with His Will. ||1||

[Ang 148 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 2 |
English: Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰਖੇ ਆਪ ਕਉ ਤਾ ਪਾਰਖੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak parakhe aap kau taa paarakh jaan |
English: O Nanak, if someone judges himself, only then is he known as a real judge.

Gurbani: ਰੋਗੁ ਦਾਰੂ ਦੋਵੈ ਬੁਝੈ ਤਾ ਵੈਦੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: rog daaroo dovai bujhai taa vaid sujaan |
English: If someone understands both the disease and the medicine, only then is he a wise physician.

Gurbani: ਵਾਟ ਨ ਕਰਈ ਮਾਮਲਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਮਿਹਮਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: vaatt na karee maamalaa jaanai mihamaan |
English: Do not involve yourself in idle business on the way; remember that you are only a guest here.

Gurbani: ਮੂਲੁ ਜਾਣਿ ਗਲਾ ਕਰੇ ਹਾਣਿ ਲਾਏ ਹਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: mool jaan galaa kare haan laae haan |
English: Speak with those who know the Primal Lord, and renounce your evil ways.

Gurbani: ਲਬਿ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਸੋ ਵਿਸਟੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: lab na chalee sach rahai so visatt paravaan |
English: That virtuous person who does not walk in the way of greed, and who abides in Truth, is accepted and famous.

Gurbani: ਸਰੁ ਸੰਧੇ ਆਗਾਸ ਕਉ ਕਿਉ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਬਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: sar sandhe aagaas kau kiau pahuchai baan |
English: If an arrow is shot at the sky, how can it reach there?

Gurbani: ਅਗੈ ਓਹੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਵਾਹੇਦੜੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: agai ohu agam hai vaahedarr jaan |2|
English: The sky above is unreachable-know this well, O archer! ||2||

[Ang 148 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਨਾਰੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: naaree purakh piaar prem seegaareea |
English: The soul-bride loves her Husband Lord; she is embellished with His Love.

Gurbani: ਕਰਨਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਨ ਰਹਨੀ ਵਾਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: karan bhagat din raat na rahanee vaareea |
English: She worships Him day and night; she cannot be restrained from doing so.

Gurbani: ਮਹਲਾ ਮੰਝਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa manjh nivaas sabad savaareea |
English: In the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, she has made her home; she is adorned with the Word of His Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਕਹਨਿ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਸੇ ਵੇਚਾਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: sach kehan aradaas se vechaareea |
English: She is humble, and she offers her true and sincere prayer.

Gurbani: ਸੋਹਨਿ ਖਸਮੈ ਪਾਸਿ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਿਧਾਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: sohan khasamai paas hukam sidhaareea |
English: She is beautiful in the Company of her Lord and Master; she walks in the Way of His Will.

Gurbani: ਸਖੀ ਕਹਨਿ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਮਨਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: sakhee kehan aradaas manahu piaareea |
English: With her dear friends, she offers her heart-felt prayers to her Beloved.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਵਾਸੁ ਫਿਟੁ ਸੁ ਜੀਵਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: bin naavai dhrig vaas fitt su jeeviaa |
English: Cursed is that home, and shameful is that life, which is without the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੀਆਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਿਆ ॥੨੨॥
Transliteration: sabad savaareeaas amrit peeviaa |22|
English: But she who is adorned with the Word of His Shabad, drinks in the Amrit of His Nectar. ||22||

[Ang 148 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮੀਹਿ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿਆ ਅਗੀ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਭੁਖ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo meehi na tripatiaa agee lahai na bhukh |
English: The desert is not satisfied by rain, and the fire is not quenched by desire.

Gurbani: ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਜਿ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿਆ ਸਾਇਰ ਭਰੇ ਕਿਸੁਕ ॥
Transliteration: raajaa raaj na tripatiaa saaeir bhare kisuk |
English: The king is not satisfied with his kingdom, and the oceans are full, but still they thirst for more.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਕੇਤੀ ਪੁਛਾ ਪੁਛ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak sache naam kee ketee puchhaa puchh |1|
English: O Nanak, how many times must I seek and ask for the True Name? ||1||

[Ang 148 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 2 |
English: Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਿਹਫਲੰ ਤਸਿ ਜਨਮਸਿ ਜਾਵਤੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨ ਬਿੰਦਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: nihafalan tas janamas jaavat braham na bindate |
English: Life is useless, as long as one does not know the Lord God.

Gurbani: ਸਾਗਰੰ ਸੰਸਾਰਸਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਤਰਹਿ ਕੇ ॥
Transliteration: saagaran sansaaras gur parasaadee tareh ke |
English: Only a few cross over the world-ocean, by Guru's Grace.

Gurbani: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਹੈ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: karan kaaran samarath hai kahu naanak beechaar |
English: The Lord is the All-powerful Cause of causes, says Nanak after deep deliberation.

Gurbani: ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਲ ਰਖੀ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kaaran karate vas hai jin kal rakhee dhaar |2|
English: The creation is subject to the Creator, who sustains it by His Almighty Power. ||2||

[Ang 148 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਖਸਮੈ ਕੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ਢਾਢੀ ਵਸਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: khasamai kai darabaar dtaadtee vasiaa |
English: In the Court of the Lord and Master, His minstrels dwell.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਕਲਾਣਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਵਿਗਸਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa khasam kalaan kamal vigasiaa |
English: Singing the Praises of their True Lord and Master, the lotuses of their hearts have blossomed forth.

Gurbani: ਖਸਮਹੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇ ਮਨਹੁ ਰਹਸਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: khasamahu pooraa paae manahu rahasiaa |
English: Obtaining their Perfect Lord and Master, their minds are transfixed with ecstasy.

Gurbani: ਦੁਸਮਨ ਕਢੇ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਜਣ ਸਰਸਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: dusaman kadte maar sajan sarasiaa |
English: Their enemies have been driven out and subdued, and their friends are very pleased.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸਚਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦਸਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa satigur sevan sachaa maarag dasiaa |
English: Those who serve the Truthful True Guru are shown the True Path.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਵਿਧਉਸਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa sabad beechaar kaal vidhausiaa |
English: Reflecting on the True Word of the Shabad, death is overcome.

Gurbani: ਢਾਢੀ ਕਥੇ ਅਕਥੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: dtaadtee kathe akath sabad savaariaa |
English: Speaking the Unspoken Speech of the Lord, one is adorned with the Word of His Shabad.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਣ ਗਹਿ ਰਾਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥੨੩॥
Transliteration: naanak gun geh raas har jeeo mile piaariaa |23|
English: Nanak holds tight to the Treasure of Virtue, and meets with the Dear, Beloved Lord. ||23||

[Ang 149 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਖਤਿਅਹੁ ਜੰਮੇ ਖਤੇ ਕਰਨਿ ਤ ਖਤਿਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: khatiahu jame khate karan ta khatiaa vich paeh |
English: Born because of the karma of their past mistakes, they make more mistakes, and fall into mistakes.

Gurbani: ਧੋਤੇ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਜੇ ਸਉ ਧੋਵਣ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: dhote mool na utareh je sau dhovan paeh |
English: By washing, their pollution is not removed, even though they may wash hundreds of times.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸੇ ਬਖਸੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਹਿ ਤ ਪਾਹੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak bakhase bakhaseeeh naeh ta paahee paeh |1|
English: O Nanak, if God forgives, they are forgiven; otherwise, they are kicked and beaten. ||1||

[Ang 149 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਝਖਣਾ ਦੁਖ ਛਡਿ ਮੰਗੀਅਹਿ ਸੁਖ ॥
Transliteration: naanak bolan jhakhanaa dukh chhadd mangeeeh sukh |
English: O Nanak, it is absurd to ask to be spared from pain by begging for comfort.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੁਇ ਦਰਿ ਕਪੜੇ ਪਹਿਰਹਿ ਜਾਇ ਮਨੁਖ ॥
Transliteration: sukh dukh due dar kaparre pahireh jaae manukh |
English: Pleasure and pain are the two garments given, to be worn in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਥੈ ਬੋਲਣਿ ਹਾਰੀਐ ਤਿਥੈ ਚੰਗੀ ਚੁਪ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jithai bolan haareeai tithai changee chup |2|
English: Where you are bound to lose by speaking, there, you ought to remain silent. ||2||

[Ang 149 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਅੰਦਰੁ ਭਾਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: chaare kunddaa dekh andar bhaaliaa |
English: After looking around in the four directions, I looked within my own self.

Gurbani: ਸਚੈ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਅਲਖਿ ਸਿਰਜਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sachai purakh alakh siraj nihaaliaa |
English: There, I saw the True, Invisible Lord Creator.

Gurbani: ਉਝੜਿ ਭੁਲੇ ਰਾਹ ਗੁਰਿ ਵੇਖਾਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: aujharr bhule raah gur vekhaaliaa |
English: I was wandering in the wilderness, but now the Guru has shown me the Way.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਚੇ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sache vaahu sach samaaliaa |
English: Hail to the True, True Guru, through whom we merge in the Truth.

Gurbani: ਪਾਇਆ ਰਤਨੁ ਘਰਾਹੁ ਦੀਵਾ ਬਾਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: paaeaa ratan gharaahu deevaa baaliaa |
English: I have found the jewel within the home of my own self; the lamp within has been lit.

Gurbani: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਸਚ ਵਾਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sachai sabad salaeh sukhee sach vaaliaa |
English: Those who praise the True Word of the Shabad, abide in the peace of Truth.

Gurbani: ਨਿਡਰਿਆ ਡਰੁ ਲਗਿ ਗਰਬਿ ਸਿ ਗਾਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: niddariaa ddar lag garab si gaaliaa |
English: But those who do not have the Fear of God, are overtaken by fear. They are destroyed by their own pride.

Gurbani: ਨਾਵਹੁ ਭੁਲਾ ਜਗੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਬੇਤਾਲਿਆ ॥੨੪॥
Transliteration: naavahu bhulaa jag firai betaaliaa |24|
English: Having forgotten the Name, the world is roaming around like a wild demon. ||24||

[Ang 149 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਭੈ ਮਰੈ ਭੀ ਭਉ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhai vich jamai bhai marai bhee bhau man meh hoe |
English: In fear we are born, and in fear we die. Fear is always present in the mind.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ਸਹਿਲਾ ਆਇਆ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak bhai vich je marai sahilaa aaeaa soe |1|
English: O Nanak, if one dies in the fear of God, his coming into the world is blessed and approved. ||1||

[Ang 149 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਖੁਸੀ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhai vin jeevai bahut bahut khuseea khusee kamaae |
English: Without the fear of God, you may live very, very long, and savor the most enjoyable pleasures.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਭੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਕਾਲੈ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak bhai vin je marai muhi kaalai utth jaae |2|
English: O Nanak, if you die without the fear of God, you will arise and depart with a blackened face. ||2||

[Ang 149 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤ ਸਰਧਾ ਪੂਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: satigur hoe deaal ta saradhaa pooreeai |
English: When the True Guru is merciful, then your desires will be fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਝੂਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: satigur hoe deaal na kabahoon jhooreeai |
English: When the True Guru is merciful, you will never grieve.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: satigur hoe deaal taa dukh na jaaneeai |
English: When the True Guru is merciful, you will know no pain.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: satigur hoe deaal taa har rang maaneeai |
English: When the True Guru is merciful, you will enjoy the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਾ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਡਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: satigur hoe deaal taa jam kaa ddar kehaa |
English: When the True Guru is merciful, then why should you fear death?

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਾ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: satigur hoe deaal taa sad hee sukh dehaa |
English: When the True Guru is merciful, the body is always at peace.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਾ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: satigur hoe deaal taa nav nidh paaeeai |
English: When the True Guru is merciful, the nine treasures are obtained.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥੨੫॥
Transliteration: satigur hoe deaal ta sach samaaeeai |25|
English: When the True Guru is merciful, you shall be absorbed in the True Lord. ||25||

[Ang 149 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਿਰੁ ਖੋਹਾਇ ਪੀਅਹਿ ਮਲਵਾਣੀ ਜੂਠਾ ਮੰਗਿ ਮੰਗਿ ਖਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: sir khohaae peeeh malavaanee jootthaa mang mang khaahee |
English: They pluck the hair out of their heads, and drink in filthy water; they beg endlessly and eat the garbage which others have thrown away.

Gurbani: ਫੋਲਿ ਫਦੀਹਤਿ ਮੁਹਿ ਲੈਨਿ ਭੜਾਸਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਗਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: fol fadeehat muhi lain bharraasaa paanee dekh sagaahee |
English: They spread manure, they suck in rotting smells, and they are afraid of clean water.

Gurbani: ਭੇਡਾ ਵਾਗੀ ਸਿਰੁ ਖੋਹਾਇਨਿ ਭਰੀਅਨਿ ਹਥ ਸੁਆਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: bheddaa vaagee sir khohaaein bhareean hath suaahee |
English: Their hands are smeared with ashes, and the hair on their heads is plucked out-they are like sheep!

Gurbani: ਮਾਊ ਪੀਊ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਗਵਾਇਨਿ ਟਬਰ ਰੋਵਨਿ ਧਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: maaoo peeaoo kirat gavaaein ttabar rovan dhaahee |
English: They have renounced the lifestyle of their mothers and fathers, and their families and relatives cry out in distress.

Gurbani: ਓਨਾ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਨ ਪਤਲਿ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਨ ਦੀਵਾ ਮੁਏ ਕਿਥਾਊ ਪਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: onaa pindd na patal kiriaa na deevaa mue kithaaoo paahee |
English: No one offers the rice dishes at their last rites, and no one lights the lamps for them. After their death, where will they be sent?

Gurbani: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਦੇਨਿ ਨ ਢੋਈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣ ਅੰਨੁ ਨ ਖਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: atthasatth teerath den na dtoee brahaman an na khaahee |
English: The sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage give them no place of protection, and no Brahmin will eat their food.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਕੁਚੀਲ ਰਹਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਥੈ ਟਿਕੇ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa kucheel raheh din raatee mathai ttike naahee |
English: They remain polluted forever, day and night; they do not apply the ceremonial tilak mark to their foreheads.

Gurbani: ਝੁੰਡੀ ਪਾਇ ਬਹਨਿ ਨਿਤਿ ਮਰਣੈ ਦੜਿ ਦੀਬਾਣਿ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jhunddee paae behan nit maranai darr deebaan na jaahee |
English: They sit together in silence, as if in mourning; they do not go to the Lord's Court.

Gurbani: ਲਕੀ ਕਾਸੇ ਹਥੀ ਫੁੰਮਣ ਅਗੋ ਪਿਛੀ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: lakee kaase hathee funman ago pichhee jaahee |
English: With their begging bowls hanging from their waists, and their fly-brushes in their hands, they walk along in single file.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਓਇ ਜੋਗੀ ਨਾ ਓਇ ਜੰਗਮ ਨਾ ਓਇ ਕਾਜੀ ਮੁੰਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: naa oe jogee naa oe jangam naa oe kaajee munlaa |
English: They are not Yogis, and they are not Jangams, followers of Shiva. They are not Qazis or Mullahs.

Gurbani: ਦਯਿ ਵਿਗੋਏ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਵਿਗੁਤੇ ਫਿਟਾ ਵਤੈ ਗਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: day vigoe fireh vigute fittaa vatai galaa |
English: Ruined by the Merciful Lord, they wander around in disgrace, and their entire troop is contaminated.

Gurbani: ਜੀਆ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲੇ ਸੋਈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਰਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: jeea maar jeevaale soee avar na koee rakhai |
English: The Lord alone kills and restores to life; no one else can protect anyone from Him.

Gurbani: ਦਾਨਹੁ ਤੈ ਇਸਨਾਨਹੁ ਵੰਜੇ ਭਸੁ ਪਈ ਸਿਰਿ ਖੁਥੈ ॥
Transliteration: daanahu tai isanaanahu vanje bhas pee sir khuthai |
English: They go without giving alms or any cleansing baths; their shaven heads become covered with dust.

Gurbani: ਪਾਣੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਰਤਨ ਉਪੰਨੇ ਮੇਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਮਾਧਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: paanee vichahu ratan upane mer keea maadhaanee |
English: The jewel emerged from the water, when the mountain of gold was used to churn it.

Gurbani: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਦੇਵੀ ਥਾਪੇ ਪੁਰਬੀ ਲਗੈ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: atthasatth teerath devee thaape purabee lagai baanee |
English: The gods established the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, where the festivals are celebrated and hymns are chanted.

Gurbani: ਨਾਇ ਨਿਵਾਜਾ ਨਾਤੈ ਪੂਜਾ ਨਾਵਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਜਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: naae nivaajaa naatai poojaa naavan sadaa sujaanee |
English: After bathing, the Muslims recite their prayers, and after bathing, the Hindus perform their worship services. The wise always take cleansing baths.

Gurbani: ਮੁਇਆ ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਾਂ ਸਿਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: mueaa jeevadiaa gat hovai jaan sir paaeeai paanee |
English: At the time of death, and at the time of birth, they are purified, when water is poured on their heads.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਰਖੁਥੇ ਸੈਤਾਨੀ ਏਨਾ ਗਲ ਨ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: naanak sirakhuthe saitaanee enaa gal na bhaanee |
English: O Nanak, the shaven-headed ones are devils. They are not pleased to hear these words.

Gurbani: ਵੁਠੈ ਹੋਇਐ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਜੀਆ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: vutthai hoeiai hoe bilaaval jeea jugat samaanee |
English: When it rains, there is happiness. Water is the key to all life.

Gurbani: ਵੁਠੈ ਅੰਨੁ ਕਮਾਦੁ ਕਪਾਹਾ ਸਭਸੈ ਪੜਦਾ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: vutthai an kamaad kapaahaa sabhasai parradaa hovai |
English: When it rains, the corn grows, and the sugar cane, and the cotton, which provides clothing for all.

Gurbani: ਵੁਠੈ ਘਾਹੁ ਚਰਹਿ ਨਿਤਿ ਸੁਰਹੀ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਦਹੀ ਵਿਲੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: vutthai ghaahu chareh nit surahee saa dhan dahee vilovai |
English: When it rains, the cows always have grass to graze upon, and housewives can churn the milk into butter.

Gurbani: ਤਿਤੁ ਘਿਇ ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਸਦ ਪੂਜਾ ਪਇਐ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: tit ghie hom jag sad poojaa peiai kaaraj sohai |
English: With that ghee, sacred feasts and worship services are performed; all these efforts are blessed.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੂ ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਨਦੀ ਸਭਿ ਸਿਖੀ ਨਾਤੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: guroo samund nadee sabh sikhee naatai jit vaddiaaee |
English: The Guru is the ocean, and all His Teachings are the river. Bathing within it, glorious greatness is obtained.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੇ ਸਿਰਖੁਥੇ ਨਾਵਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਾ ਸਤ ਚਟੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak je sirakhuthe naavan naahee taa sat chatte sir chhaaee |1|
English: O Nanak, if the shaven-headed ones do not bathe, then seven handfuls of ashes are upon their heads. ||1||

[Ang 150 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 2 |
English: Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਗੀ ਪਾਲਾ ਕਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੂਰਜ ਕੇਹੀ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: agee paalaa ki kare sooraj kehee raat |
English: What can the cold do to the fire? How can the night affect the sun?

Gurbani: ਚੰਦ ਅਨੇਰਾ ਕਿ ਕਰੇ ਪਉਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: chand aneraa ki kare paun paanee kiaa jaat |
English: What can the darkness do to the moon? What can social status do to air and water?

Gurbani: ਧਰਤੀ ਚੀਜੀ ਕਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: dharatee cheejee ki kare jis vich sabh kichh hoe |
English: What are personal possessions to the earth, from which all things are produced?

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਪਤਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਪਤਿ ਰਖੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak taa pat jaaneeai jaa pat rakhai soe |2|
English: O Nanak, he alone is known as honorable, whose honor the Lord preserves. ||2||

[Ang 150 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਸਚੇ ਸੁਬਹਾਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਕਲਾਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: tudh sache subahaan sadaa kalaaniaa |
English: It is of You, O my True and Wondrous Lord, that I sing forever.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਹੋਰਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: toon sachaa deebaan hor aavan jaaniaa |
English: Yours is the True Court. All others are subject to coming and going.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਜਿ ਮੰਗਹਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਸਿ ਤੁਧੈ ਜੇਹਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sach ji mangeh daan si tudhai jehiaa |
English: Those who ask for the gift of the True Name are like You.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਫੁਰਮਾਨੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਸੋਹਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sach teraa furamaan sabade sohiaa |
English: Your Command is True; we are adorned with the Word of Your Shabad.

Gurbani: ਮੰਨਿਐ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਤੁਧੈ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: maniai giaan dhiaan tudhai te paaeaa |
English: Through faith and trust, we receive spiritual wisdom and meditation from You.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮਿ ਪਵੈ ਨੀਸਾਨੁ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: karam pavai neesaan na chalai chalaaeaa |
English: By Your Grace, the banner of honor is obtained. It cannot be taken away or lost.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਨਿਤ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਚੜਹਿ ਸਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: toon sachaa daataar nit deveh charreh savaaeaa |
English: You are the True Giver; You give continually. Your Gifts continue to increase.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੨੬॥
Transliteration: naanak mangai daan jo tudh bhaaeaa |26|
English: Nanak begs for that gift which is pleasing to You. ||26||

[Ang 150 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 2 |
English: Salok, Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦੀਖਿਆ ਆਖਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਸਚਿ ਸਮੇਉ ॥
Transliteration: deekhiaa aakh bujhaaeaa sifatee sach sameo |
English: Those who have accepted the Guru's Teachings, and who have found the path, remain absorbed in the Praises of the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਕਿਆ ਉਪਦੇਸੀਐ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tin kau kiaa upadeseeai jin gur naanak deo |1|
English: What teachings can be imparted to those who have the Divine Guru Nanak as their Guru? ||1||

[Ang 150 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
Transliteration: aap bujhaae soee boojhai |
English: We understand the Lord only when He Himself inspires us to understand Him.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਝਾਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
Transliteration: jis aap sujhaae tis sabh kichh soojhai |
English: He alone knows everything, unto whom the Lord Himself gives knowledge.

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਕਥਨਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਲੂਝੈ ॥
Transliteration: keh keh kathanaa maaeaa loojhai |
English: One may talk and preach and give sermons but still yearn after Maya.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸਗਲ ਕਰੇ ਆਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: hukamee sagal kare aakaar |
English: The Lord, by the Hukam of His Command, has created the entire creation.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਰਬ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: aape jaanai sarab veechaar |
English: He Himself knows the inner nature of all.

Gurbani: ਅਖਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਖਿਓ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: akhar naanak akhio aap |
English: O Nanak, He Himself uttered the Word.

Gurbani: ਲਹੈ ਭਰਾਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਦਾਤਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: lahai bharaat hovai jis daat |2|
English: Doubt departs from one who receives this gift. ||2||

[Ang 150 | Raag: Raag Maajh | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਢਾਢੀ ਵੇਕਾਰੁ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau dtaadtee vekaar kaarai laaeaa |
English: I was a minstrel, out of work, when the Lord took me into His service.

Gurbani: ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਹੈ ਕੈ ਵਾਰ ਧੁਰਹੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: raat dihai kai vaar dhurahu furamaaeaa |
English: To sing His Praises day and night, He gave me His Order, right from the start.

Gurbani: ਢਾਢੀ ਸਚੈ ਮਹਲਿ ਖਸਮਿ ਬੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: dtaadtee sachai mehal khasam bulaaeaa |
English: My Lord and Master has summoned me, His minstrel, to the True Mansion of His Presence.

Gurbani: ਸਚੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਾਲਾਹ ਕਪੜਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sachee sifat saalaah kaparraa paaeaa |
English: He has dressed me in the robes of His True Praise and Glory.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa amrit naam bhojan aaeaa |
English: The Ambrosial Nectar of the True Name has become my food.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਖਾਧਾ ਰਜਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: guramatee khaadhaa raj tin sukh paaeaa |
English: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings, who eat this food and are satisfied, find peace.

Gurbani: ਢਾਢੀ ਕਰੇ ਪਸਾਉ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: dtaadtee kare pasaau sabad vajaaeaa |
English: His minstrel spreads His Glory, singing and vibrating the Word of His Shabad.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨੭॥ ਸੁਧੁ
Transliteration: naanak sach saalaeh pooraa paaeaa |27| sudh
English: O Nanak, praising the True Lord, I have obtained His Perfection. ||27||Sudh||

[Ang 151 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: raag gaurree guaareree mahalaa 1 chaupade dupade |
English: Raag Gauree Gwaarayree, First Mehl, Chau-Padhay & Dho-Padhay:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirbhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibhan gur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

Gurbani: ਭਉ ਮੁਚੁ ਭਾਰਾ ਵਡਾ ਤੋਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: bhau much bhaaraa vaddaa tol |
English: The Fear of God is overpowering, and so very heavy,

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮਤਿ ਹਉਲੀ ਬੋਲੇ ਬੋਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: man mat haulee bole bol |
English: while the intellect is lightweight, as is the speech one speaks.

Gurbani: ਸਿਰਿ ਧਰਿ ਚਲੀਐ ਸਹੀਐ ਭਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sir dhar chaleeai saheeai bhaar |
English: So place the Fear of God upon your head, and bear that weight;

Gurbani: ਨਦਰੀ ਕਰਮੀ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: nadaree karamee gur beechaar |1|
English: by the Grace of the Merciful Lord, contemplate the Guru. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਲੰਘਸਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: bhai bin koe na langhas paar |
English: Without the Fear of God, no one crosses over the world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਭਉ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਭਾਇ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhai bhau raakhiaa bhaae savaar |1| rahaau |
English: This Fear of God adorns the Love of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਤਨਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਭਖੈ ਭੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: bhai tan agan bhakhai bhai naal |
English: The fire of fear within the body is burnt away by the Fear of God.

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਭਉ ਘੜੀਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: bhai bhau gharreeai sabad savaar |
English: Through this Fear of God, we are adorned with the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਘਾੜਤ ਕਚੁ ਨਿਕਚ ॥
Transliteration: bhai bin ghaarrat kach nikach |
English: Without the Fear of God, all that is fashioned is false.

Gurbani: ਅੰਧਾ ਸਚਾ ਅੰਧੀ ਸਟ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: andhaa sachaa andhee satt |2|
English: Useless is the mold, and useless are the hammer-strokes on the mold. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬੁਧੀ ਬਾਜੀ ਉਪਜੈ ਚਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: budhee baajee upajai chaau |
English: The desire for the worldly drama arises in the intellect,

Gurbani: ਸਹਸ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਪਵੈ ਨ ਤਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sehas siaanap pavai na taau |
English: but even with thousands of clever mental tricks, the heat of the Fear of God does not come into play.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਵਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: naanak manamukh bolan vaau |
English: O Nanak, the speech of the self-willed manmukh is just wind.

Gurbani: ਅੰਧਾ ਅਖਰੁ ਵਾਉ ਦੁਆਉ ॥੩॥੧॥
Transliteration: andhaa akhar vaau duaau |3|1|
English: His words are worthless and empty, like the wind. ||3||1||

[Ang 151 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 1 |
English: Gauree, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਡਰਿ ਘਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਡਰੁ ਡਰਿ ਡਰੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: ddar ghar ghar ddar ddar ddar jaae |
English: Place the Fear of God within the home of your heart; with this Fear of God in your heart, all other fears shall be frightened away.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਡਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਡਰਿ ਡਰੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: so ddar kehaa jit ddar ddar paae |
English: What sort of fear is that, which frightens other fears?

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: tudh bin doojee naahee jaae |
English: Without You, I have other place of rest at all.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jo kichh varatai sabh teree rajaae |1|
English: Whatever happens is all according to Your Will. ||1||

Gurbani: ਡਰੀਐ ਜੇ ਡਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਹੋਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: ddareeai je ddar hovai hor |
English: Be afraid, if you have any fear, other than the Fear of God.

Gurbani: ਡਰਿ ਡਰਿ ਡਰਣਾ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਸੋਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ddar ddar ddaranaa man kaa sor |1| rahaau |
English: Afraid of fear, and living in fear, the mind is held in tumult. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਜੀਉ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਡੂਬੈ ਤਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: naa jeeo marai na ddoobai tarai |
English: The soul does not die; it does not drown, and it does not swim across.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: jin kichh keea so kichh karai |
English: The One who created everything does everything.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਆਵੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: hukame aavai hukame jaae |
English: By the Hukam of His Command we come, and by the Hukam of His Command we go.

Gurbani: ਆਗੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aagai paachhai hukam samaae |2|
English: Before and after, His Command is pervading. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹੰਸੁ ਹੇਤੁ ਆਸਾ ਅਸਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: hans het aasaa asamaan |
English: Cruelty, attachment, desire and egotism

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਭੂਖ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਨੈ ਸਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: tis vich bhookh bahut nai saan |
English: there is great hunger in these, like the raging torrent of a wild stream.

Gurbani: ਭਉ ਖਾਣਾ ਪੀਣਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: bhau khaanaa peenaa aadhaar |
English: Let the Fear of God be your food, drink and support.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਖਾਧੇ ਮਰਿ ਹੋਹਿ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: vin khaadhe mar hohi gavaar |3|
English: Without doing this, the fools simply die. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਕੋਇ ਕੋਈ ਕੋਇ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jis kaa koe koee koe koe |
English: If anyone really has anyone else - how rare is that person!

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabh ko teraa toon sabhanaa kaa soe |
English: All are Yours - You are the Lord of all.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: jaa ke jeea jant dhan maal |
English: All beings and creatures, wealth and property belong to Him.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਖਣੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak aakhan bikham beechaar |4|2|
English: O Nanak, it is so difficult to describe and contemplate Him. ||4||2||

[Ang 151 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 1 |
English: Gauree, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਾਤਾ ਮਤਿ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: maataa mat pitaa santokh |
English: Let wisdom be your mother, and contentment your father.

Gurbani: ਸਤੁ ਭਾਈ ਕਰਿ ਏਹੁ ਵਿਸੇਖੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sat bhaaee kar ehu visekh |1|
English: Let Truth be your brother - these are your best relatives. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਹਣਾ ਹੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kahanaa hai kichh kehan na jaae |
English: He has been described, but He cannot be described at all.

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tau kudarat keemat nahee paae |1| rahaau |
English: Your All-pervading creative nature cannot be estimated. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਰਮ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਦੁਇ ਸਸੁਰ ਭਏ ॥
Transliteration: saram surat due sasur bhe |
English: Modesty, humility and intuitive understanding are my mother-in-law and father-in-law;

Gurbani: ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਨ ਲਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: karanee kaaman kar man le |2|
English: I have made good deeds my spouse. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਾਹਾ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਵੀਆਹੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: saahaa sanjog veeaahu vijog |
English: Union with the Holy is my wedding date, and separation from the world is my marriage.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਤਤਿ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੩॥੩॥
Transliteration: sach santat kahu naanak jog |3|3|
English: Says Nanak, Truth is the child born of this Union. ||3||3||

[Ang 152 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 1 |
English: Gauree, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪਉਣੈ ਪਾਣੀ ਅਗਨੀ ਕਾ ਮੇਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: paunai paanee aganee kaa mel |
English: The union of air, water and fire

Gurbani: ਚੰਚਲ ਚਪਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਕਾ ਖੇਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: chanchal chapal budh kaa khel |
English: the body is the play-thing of the fickle and unsteady intellect.

Gurbani: ਨਉ ਦਰਵਾਜੇ ਦਸਵਾ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: nau daravaaje dasavaa duaar |
English: It has nine doors, and then there is the Tenth Gate.

Gurbani: ਬੁਝੁ ਰੇ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਏਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bujh re giaanee ehu beechaar |1|
English: Reflect upon this and understand it, O wise one. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਥਤਾ ਬਕਤਾ ਸੁਨਤਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: kathataa bakataa sunataa soee |
English: The Lord is the One who speaks, teaches and listens.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ਸੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aap beechaare su giaanee hoee |1| rahaau |
English: One who contemplates his own self is truly wise. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦੇਹੀ ਮਾਟੀ ਬੋਲੈ ਪਉਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: dehee maattee bolai paun |
English: The body is dust; the wind speaks through it.

Gurbani: ਬੁਝੁ ਰੇ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਮੂਆ ਹੈ ਕਉਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: bujh re giaanee mooaa hai kaun |
English: Understand, O wise one, who has died.

Gurbani: ਮੂਈ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਬਾਦੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: mooee surat baad ahankaar |
English: Awareness, conflict and ego have died,

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਨ ਮੂਆ ਜੋ ਦੇਖਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ohu na mooaa jo dekhanahaar |2|
English: but the One who sees does not die. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੈ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਤਟਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jai kaaran tatt teerath jaahee |
English: For the sake of it, you journey to sacred shrines and holy rivers;

Gurbani: ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਘਟ ਹੀ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: ratan padaarath ghatt hee maahee |
English: but this priceless jewel is within your own heart.

Gurbani: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਬਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: parr parr panddit baad vakhaanai |
English: The Pandits, the religious scholars, read and read endlessly; they stir up arguments and controversies,

Gurbani: ਭੀਤਰਿ ਹੋਦੀ ਵਸਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bheetar hodee vasat na jaanai |3|
English: but they do not know the secret deep within. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਨ ਮੂਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਮੁਈ ਬਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: hau na mooaa meree muee balaae |
English: I have not died - that evil nature within me has died.

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਨ ਮੂਆ ਜੋ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: ohu na mooaa jo rahiaa samaae |
English: The One who is pervading everywhere does not die.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak gur braham dikhaaeaa |
English: Says Nanak, the Guru has revealed God to me,

Gurbani: ਮਰਤਾ ਜਾਤਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੪॥
Transliteration: marataa jaataa nadar na aaeaa |4|4|
English: and now I see that there is no such thing as birth or death. ||4||4||

[Ang 152 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਦਖਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 1 dakhanee |
English: Gauree, First Mehl, Dakhanee:

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਮਾਨੈ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sun sun boojhai maanai naau |
English: I am forever a sacrifice to the one who listens and hears,

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: taa kai sad balihaarai jaau |
English: Who understands and believes in the Name.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਠਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aap bhulaae tthaur na tthaau |
English: When the Lord Himself leads us astray, there is no other place of rest for us to find.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਸਮਝਾਵਹਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: toon samajhaaveh mel milaau |1|
English: You impart understanding, and You unite us in Your Union. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਚਲੈ ਮੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: naam milai chalai mai naal |
English: I obtain the Naam, which shall go along with me in the end.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਾਧੀ ਸਭ ਕਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bin naavai baadhee sabh kaal |1| rahaau |
English: Without the Name, all are held in the grip of Death. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਖੇਤੀ ਵਣਜੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਓਟ ॥
Transliteration: khetee vanaj naavai kee ott |
English: My farming and my trading are by the Support of the Name.

Gurbani: ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਬੀਜ ਕੀ ਪੋਟ ॥
Transliteration: paap pun beej kee pott |
English: The seeds of sin and virtue are bound together.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਜੀਅ ਮਹਿ ਚੋਟ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh jeea meh chott |
English: Sexual desire and anger are the wounds of the soul.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਚਲੇ ਮਨਿ ਖੋਟ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naam visaar chale man khott |2|
English: The evil-minded ones forget the Naam, and then depart. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਚੀ ਸੀਖ ॥
Transliteration: saache gur kee saachee seekh |
English: True are the Teachings of the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਰੀਖ ॥
Transliteration: tan man seetal saach pareekh |
English: The body and mind are cooled and soothed, by the touchstone of Truth.

Gurbani: ਜਲ ਪੁਰਾਇਨਿ ਰਸ ਕਮਲ ਪਰੀਖ ॥
Transliteration: jal puraaein ras kamal pareekh |
English: This is the true mark of wisdom: that one remains detached, like the water-lily, or the lotus upon the water.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਮੀਠੇ ਰਸ ਈਖ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sabad rate meetthe ras eekh |3|
English: Attuned to the Word of the Shabad, one becomes sweet, like the juice of the sugar cane. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਗੜਿ ਦਸ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
Transliteration: hukam sanjogee garr das duaar |
English: By the Hukam of the Lord's Command, the castle of the body has ten gates.

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਵਸਹਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: panch vaseh mil jot apaar |
English: The five passions dwell there, together with the Divine Light of the Infinite.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਤੁਲੈ ਆਪੇ ਵਣਜਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: aap tulai aape vanajaar |
English: The Lord Himself is the merchandise, and He Himself is the trader.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰ ॥੪॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak naam savaaranahaar |4|5|
English: O Nanak, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, we are adorned and rejuvenated. ||4||5||

[Ang 152 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 1 |
English: Gauree, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਾਤੋ ਜਾਇ ਕਹਾ ਤੇ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jaato jaae kahaa te aavai |
English: How can we know where we came from?

Gurbani: ਕਹ ਉਪਜੈ ਕਹ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: keh upajai keh jaae samaavai |
English: Where did we originate, and where will we go and merge?

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਕਿਉ ਮੁਕਤੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: kiau baadhio kiau mukatee paavai |
English: How are we bound, and how do we obtain liberation?

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kiau abinaasee sehaj samaavai |1|
English: How do we merge with intuitive ease into the Eternal, Imperishable Lord? ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: naam ridai amrit mukh naam |
English: With the Naam in the heart and the Ambrosial Naam on our lips,

Gurbani: ਨਰਹਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਰਹਰ ਨਿਹਕਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: narahar naam narahar nihakaam |1| rahaau |
English: through the Name of the Lord, we rise above desire, like the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਆਵੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sahaje aavai sahaje jaae |
English: With intuitive ease we come, and with intuitive ease we depart.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man te upajai man maeh samaae |
English: From the mind we originate, and into the mind we are absorbed.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਕਤੋ ਬੰਧੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh mukato bandh na paae |
English: As Gurmukh, we are liberated, and are not bound.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਛੁਟੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sabad beechaar chhuttai har naae |2|
English: Contemplating the Word of the Shabad, we are emancipated through the Name of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤਰਵਰ ਪੰਖੀ ਬਹੁ ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: taravar pankhee bahu nis baas |
English: At night, lots of birds settle on the tree.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਮਨਿ ਮੋਹ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: sukh dukheea man moh vinaas |
English: Some are happy, and some are sad. Caught in the desires of the mind, they perish.

Gurbani: ਸਾਝ ਬਿਹਾਗ ਤਕਹਿ ਆਗਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: saajh bihaag takeh aagaas |
English: And when the life-night comes to its end, then they look to the sky.

Gurbani: ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਧਾਵਹਿ ਕਰਮਿ ਲਿਖਿਆਸੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: deh dis dhaaveh karam likhiaas |3|
English: They fly away in all ten directions, according to their pre-ordained destiny. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਗੋਇਲਿ ਥਾਟੁ ॥
Transliteration: naam sanjogee goeil thaatt |
English: Those who are committed to the Naam, see the world as merely a temporary pasture.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਫੂਟੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਟੁ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh foottai bikh maatt |
English: Sexual desire and anger are broken, like a jar of poison.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਵਖਰ ਸੂਨੋ ਘਰੁ ਹਾਟੁ ॥
Transliteration: bin vakhar soono ghar haatt |
English: Without the merchandise of the Name, the house of the body and the store of the mind are empty.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਖੋਲੇ ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: gur mil khole bajar kapaatt |4|
English: Meeting the Guru, the hard and heavy doors are opened. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਪੂਰਬ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: saadh milai poorab sanjog |
English: One meets the Holy Saint only through perfect destiny.

Gurbani: ਸਚਿ ਰਹਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਲੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: sach rahase poore har log |
English: The Lord's perfect people rejoice in the Truth.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਦੇ ਲੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man tan de lai sehaj subhaae |
English: Surrendering their minds and bodies, they find the Lord with intuitive ease.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥੫॥੬॥
Transliteration: naanak tin kai laagau paae |5|6|
English: Nanak falls at their feet. ||5||6||

[Ang 153 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 1 |
English: Gauree, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਿ ਚੀਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh maaeaa meh cheet |
English: The conscious mind is engrossed in sexual desire, anger and Maya.

Gurbani: ਝੂਠ ਵਿਕਾਰਿ ਜਾਗੈ ਹਿਤ ਚੀਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: jhootth vikaar jaagai hit cheet |
English: The conscious mind is awake only to falsehood, corruption and attachment.

Gurbani: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਪਾਪ ਲੋਭ ਕੀ ਕੀਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: poonjee paap lobh kee keet |
English: It gathers in the assets of sin and greed.

Gurbani: ਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੀ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਚੀਤੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tar taaree man naam sucheet |1|
English: So swim across the river of life, O my mind, with the Sacred Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਮੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ॥
Transliteration: vaahu vaahu saache mai teree ttek |
English: Waaho! Waaho! - Great! Great is my True Lord! I seek Your All-powerful Support.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਪਾਪੀ ਤੂੰ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਏਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hau paapee toon niramal ek |1| rahaau |
English: I am a sinner - You alone are pure. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਗਨਿ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੋਲੈ ਭੜਵਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: agan paanee bolai bharravaau |
English: Fire and water join together, and the breath roars in its fury!

Gurbani: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਏਕੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
Transliteration: jihavaa indree ek suaau |
English: The tongue and the sex organs each seek to taste.

Gurbani: ਦਿਸਟਿ ਵਿਕਾਰੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਭਉ ਭਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: disatt vikaaree naahee bhau bhaau |
English: The eyes which look upon corruption do not know the Love and the Fear of God.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਾ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aap maare taa paae naau |2|
English: Conquering self-conceit, one obtains the Name. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabad marai fir maran na hoe |
English: One who dies in the Word of the Shabad, shall never again have to die.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਮੂਏ ਕਿਉ ਪੂਰਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin mooe kiau pooraa hoe |
English: Without such a death, how can one attain perfection?

Gurbani: ਪਰਪੰਚਿ ਵਿਆਪਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਦੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: parapanch viaap rahiaa man doe |
English: The mind is engrossed in deception, treachery and duality.

Gurbani: ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: thir naaraaein kare su hoe |3|
English: Whatever the Immortal Lord does, comes to pass. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬੋਹਿਥਿ ਚੜਉ ਜਾ ਆਵੈ ਵਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: bohith chrrau jaa aavai vaar |
English: So get aboard that boat when your turn comes.

Gurbani: ਠਾਕੇ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: tthaake bohith daragah maar |
English: Those who fail to embark upon that boat shall be beaten in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sach saalaahee dhan guraduaar |
English: Blessed is that Gurdwara, the Guru's Gate, where the Praises of the True Lord are sung.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੭॥
Transliteration: naanak dar ghar ekankaar |4|7|
English: O Nanak, the One Creator Lord is pervading hearth and home. ||4||7||

[Ang 153 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 1 |
English: Gauree, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਉਲਟਿਓ ਕਮਲੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: aulattio kamal braham beechaar |
English: The inverted heart-lotus has been turned upright, through reflective meditation on God.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰ ਗਗਨਿ ਦਸ ਦੁਆਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: amrit dhaar gagan das duaar |
English: From the Sky of the Tenth Gate, the Ambrosial Nectar trickles down.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tribhavan bedhiaa aap muraar |1|
English: The Lord Himself is pervading the three worlds. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: re man mere bharam na keejai |
English: O my mind, do not give in to doubt.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਮਾਨਿਐ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: man maaniai amrit ras peejai |1| rahaau |
English: When the mind surrenders to the Name, it drinks in the essence of Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਨਮੁ ਜੀਤਿ ਮਰਣਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: janam jeet maran man maaniaa |
English: So win the game of life; let your mind surrender and accept death.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਮੂਆ ਮਨੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: aap mooaa man man te jaaniaa |
English: When the self dies, the individual mind comes to know the Supreme Mind.

Gurbani: ਨਜਰਿ ਭਈ ਘਰੁ ਘਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: najar bhee ghar ghar te jaaniaa |2|
English: As the inner vision is awakened, one comes to know one's own home, deep within the self. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਮਜਨੁ ਨਾਮਿ ॥
Transliteration: jat sat teerath majan naam |
English: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is austerity, chastity and cleansing baths at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

Gurbani: ਅਧਿਕ ਬਿਥਾਰੁ ਕਰਉ ਕਿਸੁ ਕਾਮਿ ॥
Transliteration: adhik bithaar krau kis kaam |
English: What good are ostentatious displays?

Gurbani: ਨਰ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: nar naaraaein antarajaam |3|
English: The All-pervading Lord is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਨ ਮਨਉ ਤਉ ਪਰ ਘਰ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aan mnau tau par ghar jaau |
English: If I had faith in someone else, then I would go to that one's house.

Gurbani: ਕਿਸੁ ਜਾਚਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਥਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kis jaachau naahee ko thaau |
English: But where should I go, to beg? There is no other place for me.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੪॥੮॥
Transliteration: naanak guramat sehaj samaau |4|8|
English: O Nanak, through the Guru's Teachings, I am intuitively absorbed in the Lord. ||4||8||

[Ang 153 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 1 |
English: Gauree, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਦਿਖਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: satigur milai su maran dikhaae |
English: Meeting the True Guru, we are shown the way to die.

Gurbani: ਮਰਣ ਰਹਣ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਭਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: maran rehan ras antar bhaae |
English: Remaining alive in this death brings joy deep within.

Gurbani: ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਗਗਨ ਪੁਰੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: garab nivaar gagan pur paae |1|
English: Overcoming egotistical pride, the Tenth Gate is found. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਰਣੁ ਲਿਖਾਇ ਆਏ ਨਹੀ ਰਹਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: maran likhaae aae nahee rahanaa |
English: Death is pre-ordained - no one who comes can remain here.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਾਪਿ ਰਹਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har jap jaap rehan har saranaa |1| rahaau |
English: So chant and meditate on the Lord, and remain in the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur milai ta dubidhaa bhaagai |
English: Meeting the True Guru, duality is dispelled.

Gurbani: ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਾਸਿ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: kamal bigaas man har prabh laagai |
English: The heart-lotus blossoms forth, and the mind is attached to the Lord God.

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਆਗੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jeevat marai mahaa ras aagai |2|
English: One who remains dead while yet alive obtains the greatest happiness hereafter. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਚ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਸੂਚਾ ॥
Transliteration: satigur miliai sach sanjam soochaa |
English: Meeting the True Guru, one becomes truthful, chaste and pure.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਉੜੀ ਊਚੋ ਊਚਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur kee paurree aoocho aoochaa |
English: Climbing up the steps of the Guru's Path, one becomes the highest of the high.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਮੂਚਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: karam milai jam kaa bhau moochaa |3|
English: When the Lord grants His Mercy, the fear of death is conquered. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਮਿਲਿ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur miliai mil ank samaaeaa |
English: Uniting in Guru's Union, we are absorbed in His Loving Embrace.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਘਰੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa ghar mehal dikhaaeaa |
English: Granting His Grace, He reveals the Mansion of His Presence, within the home of the self.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੯॥
Transliteration: naanak haumai maar milaaeaa |4|9|
English: O Nanak, conquering egotism, we are absorbed into the Lord. ||4||9||

[Ang 154 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 1 |
English: Gauree, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਤੁ ਪਇਆ ਨਹ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: kirat peaa neh mettai koe |
English: Past actions cannot be erased.

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਜਾਣਾ ਕਿਆ ਆਗੈ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa jaanaa kiaa aagai hoe |
English: What do we know of what will happen hereafter?

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਸੋਈ ਹੂਆ ॥
Transliteration: jo tis bhaanaa soee hooaa |
English: Whatever pleases Him shall come to pass.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣੈ ਵਾਲਾ ਦੂਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: avar na karanai vaalaa dooaa |1|
English: There is no other Doer except Him. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਜਾਣਾ ਕਰਮ ਕੇਵਡ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: naa jaanaa karam kevadd teree daat |
English: I do not know about karma, or how great Your gifts are.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਜਾਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: karam dharam tere naam kee jaat |1| rahaau |
English: The karma of actions, the Dharma of righteousness, social class and status, are contained within Your Name. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਏਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: too evadd daataa devanahaar |
English: You are So Great, O Giver, O Great Giver!

Gurbani: ਤੋਟਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: tott naahee tudh bhagat bhanddaar |
English: The treasure of Your devotional worship is never exhausted.

Gurbani: ਕੀਆ ਗਰਬੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: keea garab na aavai raas |
English: One who takes pride in himself shall never be right.

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jeeo pindd sabh terai paas |2|
English: The soul and body are all at Your disposal. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲਹਿ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: too maar jeevaaleh bakhas milaae |
English: You kill and rejuvenate. You forgive and merge us into Yourself.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੀ ਤਿਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jiau bhaavee tiau naam japaae |
English: As it pleases You, You inspire us to chant Your Name.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਨਾ ਬੀਨਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਮੇਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: toon daanaa beenaa saachaa sir merai |
English: You are All-knowing, All-seeing and True, O my Supreme Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੇਇ ਭਰੋਸੈ ਤੇਰੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: guramat dee bharosai terai |3|
English: Please, bless me with the Guru's Teachings; my faith is in You alone. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: tan meh mail naahee man raataa |
English: One whose mind is attuned to the Lord, has no pollution in his body.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur bachanee sach sabad pachhaataa |
English: Through the Guru's Word, the True Shabad is realized.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਤਾਣੁ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: teraa taan naam kee vaddiaaee |
English: All Power is Yours, through the greatness of Your Name.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਹਣਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: naanak rahanaa bhagat saranaaee |4|10|
English: Nanak abides in the Sanctuary of Your devotees. ||4||10||

[Ang 154 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 1 |
English: Gauree, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਹਾਇਆ ਅਪਿਓ ਪੀਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jin akath kahaaeaa apio peeaeaa |
English: Those who speak the Unspoken, drink in the Nectar.

Gurbani: ਅਨ ਭੈ ਵਿਸਰੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: an bhai visare naam samaaeaa |1|
English: Other fears are forgotten, and they are absorbed into the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਡਰੀਐ ਡਰੁ ਡਰਹਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa ddareeai ddar ddareh samaanaa |
English: Why should we fear, when fear is dispelled by the Fear of God?

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: poore gur kai sabad pachhaanaa |1| rahaau |
English: Through the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect Guru, I recognize God. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਰ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: jis nar raam ridai har raas |
English: Those whose hearts are filled with the Lord's essence are blessed and acclaimed,

Gurbani: ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sehaj subhaae mile saabaas |2|
English: And intuitively absorbed into the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਾਹਿ ਸਵਾਰੈ ਸਾਝ ਬਿਆਲ ॥
Transliteration: jaeh savaarai saajh biaal |
English: Those whom the Lord puts to sleep, evening and morning

Gurbani: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬਾਧੇ ਕਾਲ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: eit ut manamukh baadhe kaal |3|
English: - those self-willed manmukhs are bound and gagged by Death, here and hereafter. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: ahinis raam ridai se poore |
English: Those whose hearts are filled with the Lord, day and night, are perfect.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਮਿਲੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਦੂਰੇ ॥੪॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: naanak raam mile bhram doore |4|11|
English: O Nanak, they merge into the Lord, and their doubts are cast away. ||4||11||

[Ang 154 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 1 |
English: Gauree, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਹਿਤਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: janam marai trai gun hitakaar |
English: One who loves the three qualities is subject to birth and death.

Gurbani: ਚਾਰੇ ਬੇਦ ਕਥਹਿ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: chaare bed katheh aakaar |
English: The four Vedas speak only of the visible forms.

Gurbani: ਤੀਨਿ ਅਵਸਥਾ ਕਹਹਿ ਵਖਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: teen avasathaa kaheh vakhiaan |
English: They describe and explain the three states of mind,

Gurbani: ਤੁਰੀਆਵਸਥਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tureeaavasathaa satigur te har jaan |1|
English: but the fourth state, union with the Lord, is known only through the True Guru. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: raam bhagat gur sevaa taranaa |
English: Through devotional worship of the Lord, and service to the Guru, one swims across.

Gurbani: ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਹੈ ਮਰਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: baahurr janam na hoe hai maranaa |1| rahaau |
English: Then, one is not born again, and is not subject to death. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਕਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: chaar padaarath kahai sabh koee |
English: Everyone speaks of the four great blessings;

Gurbani: ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: sinmrit saasat panddit mukh soee |
English: the Simritees, the Shaastras and the Pandits speak of them as well.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਅਰਥੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bin gur arath beechaar na paaeaa |
English: But without the Guru, they do not understand their true significance.

Gurbani: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mukat padaarath bhagat har paaeaa |2|
English: The treasure of liberation is obtained through devotional worship of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai hiradai vasiaa har soee |
English: Those, within whose hearts the Lord dwells,

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh bhagat paraapat hoee |
English: become Gurmukh; they receive the blessings of devotional worship.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: har kee bhagat mukat aanand |
English: Through devotional worship of the Lord, liberation and bliss are obtained.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: guramat paae paramaanand |3|
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, supreme ecstasy is obtained. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jin paaeaa gur dekh dikhaaeaa |
English: One who meets the Guru, beholds Him, and inspires others to behold Him as well.

Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਸੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa maeh niraas bujhaaeaa |
English: In the midst of hope, the Guru teaches us to live above hope and desire.

Gurbani: ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥੁ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: deenaa naath sarab sukhadaataa |
English: He is the Master of the meek, the Giver of peace to all.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੪॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: naanak har charanee man raataa |4|12|
English: Nanak's mind is imbued with the Lotus Feet of the Lord. ||4||12||

[Ang 154 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਚੇਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree chetee mahalaa 1 |
English: Gauree Chaytee, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਾਇਆ ਰਹੈ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਬਾਜੀ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: amrit kaaeaa rahai sukhaalee baajee ihu sansaaro |
English: With your nectar-like body, you live in comfort, but this world is just a passing drama.

Gurbani: ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੁਚੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਉਠਾਵਹਿ ਭਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: lab lobh much koorr kamaaveh bahut utthaaveh bhaaro |
English: You practice greed, avarice and great falsehood, and you carry such a heavy burden.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਕਾਇਆ ਮੈ ਰੁਲਦੀ ਦੇਖੀ ਜਿਉ ਧਰ ਉਪਰਿ ਛਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: toon kaaeaa mai ruladee dekhee jiau dhar upar chhaaro |1|
English: O body, I have seen you blowing away like dust on the earth. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਿਖ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: sun sun sikh hamaaree |
English: Listen - listen to my advice!

Gurbani: ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਰਹਸੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sukrit keetaa rahasee mere jeearre bahurr na aavai vaaree |1| rahaau |
English: Only the good deeds which you have done shall remain with you, O my soul. This opportunity shall not come again! ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਖਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਾਇਆ ਤੂੰ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਿਖ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: hau tudh aakhaa meree kaaeaa toon sun sikh hamaaree |
English: I say to you, O my body: listen to my advice!

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਚਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰਾਈ ਝੂਠੀ ਲਾਇਤਬਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: nindaa chindaa kareh paraaee jhootthee laaeitabaaree |
English: You slander, and then praise others; you indulge in lies and gossip.

Gurbani: ਵੇਲਿ ਪਰਾਈ ਜੋਹਹਿ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਚੋਰੀ ਬੁਰਿਆਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: vel paraaee joheh jeearre kareh choree buriaaree |
English: You gaze upon the wives of others, O my soul; you steal and commit evil deeds.

Gurbani: ਹੰਸੁ ਚਲਿਆ ਤੂੰ ਪਿਛੈ ਰਹੀਏਹਿ ਛੁਟੜਿ ਹੋਈਅਹਿ ਨਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: hans chaliaa toon pichhai raheehi chhuttarr hoeeeh naaree |2|
English: But when the swan departs, you shall remain behind, like an abandoned woman. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਕਾਇਆ ਰਹੀਅਹਿ ਸੁਪਨੰਤਰਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: toon kaaeaa raheeeh supanantar tudh kiaa karam kamaaeaa |
English: O body, you are living in a dream! What good deeds have you done?

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਚੋਰੀ ਮੈ ਜਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਲੀਆ ਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਲਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kar choree mai jaa kichh leea taa man bhalaa bhaaeaa |
English: When I stole something by deception, then my mind was pleased.

Gurbani: ਹਲਤਿ ਨ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਲਤਿ ਨ ਢੋਈ ਅਹਿਲਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: halat na sobhaa palat na dtoee ahilaa janam gavaaeaa |3|
English: I have no honor in this world, and I shall find no shelter in the world hereafter. My life has been lost, wasted in vain! ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਖਰੀ ਦੁਹੇਲੀ ਹੋਈ ਬਾਬਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰੀ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਪੁਛੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hau kharee duhelee hoee baabaa naanak meree baat na puchhai koee |1| rahaau |
English: I am totally miserable! O Baba Nanak, no one cares for me at all! ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤਾਜੀ ਤੁਰਕੀ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਕਪੜ ਕੇਰੇ ਭਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: taajee turakee sueinaa rupaa kaparr kere bhaaraa |
English: Turkish horses, gold, silver and loads of gorgeous clothes

Gurbani: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਝੜਿ ਝੜਿ ਪਏ ਗਵਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kis hee naal na chale naanak jharr jharr pe gavaaraa |
English: - none of these shall go with you, O Nanak. They are lost and left behind, you fool!

Gurbani: ਕੂਜਾ ਮੇਵਾ ਮੈ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਇਕੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: koojaa mevaa mai sabh kichh chaakhiaa ik amrit naam tumaaraa |4|
English: I have tasted all the sugar candy and sweets, but Your Name alone is Ambrosial Nectar. ||4||

Gurbani: ਦੇ ਦੇ ਨੀਵ ਦਿਵਾਲ ਉਸਾਰੀ ਭਸਮੰਦਰ ਕੀ ਢੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: de de neev divaal usaaree bhasamandar kee dteree |
English: Digging deep foundations, the walls are constructed, but in the end, the buildings return to heaps of dust.

Gurbani: ਸੰਚੇ ਸੰਚਿ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਭ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: sanche sanch na deee kis hee andh jaanai sabh meree |
English: People gather and hoard their possessions, and give nothing to anyone else - the poor fools think that everything is theirs.

Gurbani: ਸੋਇਨ ਲੰਕਾ ਸੋਇਨ ਮਾੜੀ ਸੰਪੈ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਕੇਰੀ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: soein lankaa soein maarree sanpai kisai na keree |5|
English: Riches do not remain with anyone - not even the golden palaces of Sri Lanka. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੰਨ ਅਜਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: sun moorakh man ajaanaa |
English: Listen, you foolish and ignorant mind

Gurbani: ਹੋਗੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hog tisai kaa bhaanaa |1| rahaau |
English: - only His Will prevails. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਹੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਭਾਰਾ ਹਮ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: saahu hamaaraa tthaakur bhaaraa ham tis ke vanajaare |
English: My Banker is the Great Lord and Master. I am only His petty merchant.

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭ ਰਾਸਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਕੀ ਮਾਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਜੀਵਾਲੇ ॥੬॥੧॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: jeeo pindd sabh raas tisai kee maar aape jeevaale |6|1|13|
