English: This soul and body all are His. He Himself kills, and brings back to life. ||6||1||13||

[Ang 155 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਚੇਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree chetee mahalaa 1 |
English: Gauree Chaytee, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਵਰਿ ਪੰਚ ਹਮ ਏਕ ਜਨਾ ਕਿਉ ਰਾਖਉ ਘਰ ਬਾਰੁ ਮਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: avar panch ham ek janaa kiau raakhau ghar baar manaa |
English: There are five of them, but I am all alone. How can I protect my hearth and home, O my mind?

Gurbani: ਮਾਰਹਿ ਲੂਟਹਿ ਨੀਤ ਨੀਤ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਕਰੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਜਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: maareh lootteh neet neet kis aagai karee pukaar janaa |1|
English: They are beating and plundering me over and over again; unto whom can I complain? ||1||

Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਉਚਰੁ ਮਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: sree raam naamaa uchar manaa |
English: Chant the Name of the Supreme Lord, O my mind.

Gurbani: ਆਗੈ ਜਮ ਦਲੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਘਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aagai jam dal bikham ghanaa |1| rahaau |
English: Otherwise, in the world hereafter, you will have to face the awesome and cruel army of Death. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਉਸਾਰਿ ਮੜੋਲੀ ਰਾਖੈ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਬੈਠੀ ਸਾ ਧਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: ausaar marrolee raakhai duaaraa bheetar baitthee saa dhanaa |
English: God has erected the temple of the body; He has placed the nine doors, and the soul-bride sits within.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕੇਲ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਅਵਰਿ ਲੁਟੇਨਿ ਸੁ ਪੰਚ ਜਨਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: amrit kel kare nit kaaman avar lutten su panch janaa |2|
English: She enjoys the sweet play again and again, while the five demons are plundering her. ||2||

Gurbani: ਢਾਹਿ ਮੜੋਲੀ ਲੂਟਿਆ ਦੇਹੁਰਾ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਪਕੜੀ ਏਕ ਜਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: dtaeh marrolee loottiaa dehuraa saa dhan pakarree ek janaa |
English: In this way, the temple is being demolished; the body is being plundered, and the soul-bride, left all alone, is captured.

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਡੰਡਾ ਗਲਿ ਸੰਗਲੁ ਪੜਿਆ ਭਾਗਿ ਗਏ ਸੇ ਪੰਚ ਜਨਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jam ddanddaa gal sangal parriaa bhaag ge se panch janaa |3|
English: Death strikes her down with his rod, the shackles are placed around her neck, and now the five have left. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਲੋੜੈ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਲੁੜੇਨਿ ਸੁ ਖਾਧਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaaman lorrai sueinaa rupaa mitr lurren su khaadhaataa |
English: The wife yearns for gold and silver, and her friends, the senses, yearn for good food.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਪ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਜਾਸੀ ਜਮਪੁਰਿ ਬਾਧਾਤਾ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: naanak paap kare tin kaaran jaasee jamapur baadhaataa |4|2|14|
English: O Nanak, she commits sins for their sake; she shall go, bound and gagged, to the City of Death. ||4||2||14||

[Ang 155 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਚੇਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree chetee mahalaa 1 |
English: Gauree Chaytee, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਤੇ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਕਾਂਇਆ ਕੀਜੈ ਖਿੰਥਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: mundraa te ghatt bheetar mundraa kaaneaa keejai khinthaataa |
English: Let your ear-rings be those ear-rings which pierce deep within your heart. Let your body be your patched coat.

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਚੇਲੇ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਜਹਿ ਰਾਵਲ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਡੰਡਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: panch chele vas keejeh raaval ihu man keejai ddanddaataa |1|
English: Let the five passions be disciples under your control, O begging Yogi, and make this mind your walking stick. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਇਵ ਪਾਵਸਿਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: jog jugat iv paavasitaa |
English: Thus you shall find the Way of Yoga.

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਨਾਸਤਿ ਕੰਦ ਮੂਲਿ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਵਸਿਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ek sabad doojaa hor naasat kand mool man laavasitaa |1| rahaau |
English: There is only the One Word of the Shabad; everything else shall pass away. Let this be the fruits and roots of your mind's diet. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੂੰਡਿ ਮੁੰਡਾਇਐ ਜੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਮ ਗੁਰੁ ਕੀਨੀ ਗੰਗਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: moondd munddaaeiai je gur paaeeai ham gur keenee gangaataa |
English: Some try to find the Guru by shaving their heads at the Ganges, but I have made the Guru my Ganges.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਏਕੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਸਿ ਅੰਧਾਤਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tribhavan taaranahaar suaamee ek na chetas andhaataa |2|
English: The Saving Grace of the three worlds is the One Lord and Master, but those in darkness do not remember Him. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਪਟੰਬੁ ਗਲੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਵਸਿ ਸੰਸਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਵਸਿਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: kar pattanb galee man laavas sansaa mool na jaavasitaa |
English: Practicing hypocrisy and attaching your mind to worldly objects, your doubt shall never depart.

Gurbani: ਏਕਸੁ ਚਰਣੀ ਜੇ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹਿ ਲਬਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਕੀ ਧਾਵਸਿਤਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ekas charanee je chit laaveh lab lobh kee dhaavasitaa |3|
English: If you focus your consciousness on the Feet of the One Lord, what reason would you have to chase after greed? ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਪਸਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਰਚਸਿ ਮਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: japas niranjan rachas manaa |
English: Meditate on the Immaculate Lord, and saturate your mind with Him.

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੇ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਕਪਟੁ ਘਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kaahe boleh jogee kapatt ghanaa |1| rahaau |
English: Why, O Yogi, do you make so many false and deceptive claims? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਮਲੀ ਹੰਸੁ ਇਆਣਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਹਾਣੀਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa kamalee hans eaanaa meree meree karat bihaaneetaa |
English: The body is wild, and the mind is foolish. Practicing egotism, selfishness and conceit, your life is passing away.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨਾਗੀ ਦਾਝੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੀਤਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: pranavat naanak naagee daajhai fir paachhai pachhutaaneetaa |4|3|15|
English: Prays Nanak, when the naked body is cremated, then you will come to regret and repent. ||4||3||15||

[Ang 156 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਚੇਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree chetee mahalaa 1 |
English: Gauree Chaytee, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਉਖਧ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਮੂਲੁ ਮਨ ਏਕੈ ਜੇ ਕਰਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aaukhadh mantr mool man ekai je kar drirr chit keejai re |
English: O mind, there is only the One medicine, mantra and healing herb - center your consciousness firmly on the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਕਰਮ ਕੇ ਕਾਟਨਹਾਰਾ ਲੀਜੈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: janam janam ke paap karam ke kaattanahaaraa leejai re |1|
English: Take to the Lord, the Destroyer of the sins and karma of past incarnations. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਏਕੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: man eko saahib bhaaee re |
English: The One Lord and Master is pleasing to my mind.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੇ ਤੀਨਿ ਗੁਣਾ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖਣਾ ਜਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tere teen gunaa sansaar samaaveh alakh na lakhanaa jaaee re |1| rahaau |
English: In Your three qualities, the world is engrossed; the Unknowable cannot be known. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਕਰ ਖੰਡੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਤਨਿ ਮੀਠੀ ਹਮ ਤਉ ਪੰਡ ਉਚਾਈ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sakar khandd maaeaa tan meetthee ham tau pandd uchaaee re |
English: Maya is so sweet to the body, like sugar or molasses. We all carry loads of it.

Gurbani: ਰਾਤਿ ਅਨੇਰੀ ਸੂਝਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਲਜੁ ਟੂਕਸਿ ਮੂਸਾ ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: raat aneree soojhas naahee laj ttookas moosaa bhaaee re |2|
English: In the dark of the night, nothing can be seen. The mouse of death is gnawing away at the rope of life, O Siblings of Destiny! ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੇਤਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh kareh tetaa dukh laagai guramukh milai vaddaaee re |
English: As the self-willed manmukhs act, they suffer in pain. The Gurmukh obtains honor and greatness.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਸੋਈ ਹੋਆ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਜਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jo tin keea soee hoaa kirat na mettiaa jaaee re |3|
English: Whatever He does, that alone happens; past actions cannot be erased. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੁਭਰ ਭਰੇ ਨ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਊਣੇ ਜੋ ਰਾਤੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਈ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: subhar bhare na hoveh aoone jo raate rang laaee re |
English: Those who are imbued with, and committed to the Lord's Love, are filled to overflowing; they never lack anything.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਪੰਕ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੇ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਉ ਮੂੜਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: tin kee pank hovai je naanak tau moorraa kichh paaee re |4|4|16|
English: If Nanak could be the dust of their feet, then he, the ignorant one, might also obtain some. ||4||4||16||

[Ang 156 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਚੇਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree chetee mahalaa 1 |
English: Gauree Chaytee, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਤ ਕੀ ਮਾਈ ਬਾਪੁ ਕਤ ਕੇਰਾ ਕਿਦੂ ਥਾਵਹੁ ਹਮ ਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: kat kee maaee baap kat keraa kidoo thaavahu ham aae |
English: Who is our mother, and who is our father? Where did we come from?

Gurbani: ਅਗਨਿ ਬਿੰਬ ਜਲ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਨਿਪਜੇ ਕਾਹੇ ਕੰਮਿ ਉਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: agan binb jal bheetar nipaje kaahe kam upaae |1|
English: We are formed from the fire of the womb within, and the bubble of water of the sperm. For what purpose are we created? ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਕਉਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: mere saahibaa kaun jaanai gun tere |
English: O my Master, who can know Your Glorious Virtues?

Gurbani: ਕਹੇ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ਅਉਗਣ ਮੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kahe na jaanee aaugan mere |1| rahaau |
English: My own demerits cannot be counted. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕੇਤੇ ਰੁਖ ਬਿਰਖ ਹਮ ਚੀਨੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਪਸੂ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: kete rukh birakh ham cheene kete pasoo upaae |
English: I took the form of so many plants and trees, and so many animals.

Gurbani: ਕੇਤੇ ਨਾਗ ਕੁਲੀ ਮਹਿ ਆਏ ਕੇਤੇ ਪੰਖ ਉਡਾਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kete naag kulee meh aae kete pankh uddaae |2|
English: Many times I entered the families of snakes and flying birds. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਟ ਪਟਣ ਬਿਜ ਮੰਦਰ ਭੰਨੈ ਕਰਿ ਚੋਰੀ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: hatt pattan bij mandar bhanai kar choree ghar aavai |
English: I broke into the shops of the city and well-guarded palaces; stealing from them, I snuck home again.

Gurbani: ਅਗਹੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਪਿਛਹੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਕਹਾ ਛਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: agahu dekhai pichhahu dekhai tujh te kahaa chhapaavai |3|
English: I looked in front of me, and I looked behind me, but where could I hide from You? ||3||

Gurbani: ਤਟ ਤੀਰਥ ਹਮ ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਦੇਖੇ ਹਟ ਪਟਣ ਬਾਜਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: tatt teerath ham nav khandd dekhe hatt pattan baajaaraa |
English: I saw the banks of sacred rivers, the nine continents, the shops and bazaars of the cities.

Gurbani: ਲੈ ਕੈ ਤਕੜੀ ਤੋਲਣਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਘਟ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: lai kai takarree tolan laagaa ghatt hee meh vanajaaraa |4|
English: Taking the scale, the merchant begins to weigh his actions within his own heart. ||4||

Gurbani: ਜੇਤਾ ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਨੀਰਿ ਭਰਿਆ ਤੇਤੇ ਅਉਗਣ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jetaa samund saagar neer bhariaa tete aaugan hamaare |
English: As the seas and the oceans are overflowing with water, so vast are my own sins.

Gurbani: ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮਿਹਰ ਉਪਾਵਹੁ ਡੁਬਦੇ ਪਥਰ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: deaa karahu kichh mihar upaavahu ddubade pathar taare |5|
English: Please, shower me with Your Mercy, and take pity upon me. I am a sinking stone - please carry me across! ||5||

Gurbani: ਜੀਅੜਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬਰਾਬਰਿ ਤਪੈ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਵਗੈ ਕਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: jeearraa agan baraabar tapai bheetar vagai kaatee |
English: My soul is burning like fire, and the knife is cutting deep.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ॥੬॥੫॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: pranavat naanak hukam pachhaanai sukh hovai din raatee |6|5|17|
English: Prays Nanak, recognizing the Lord's Command, I am at peace, day and night. ||6||5||17||

[Ang 156 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree bairaagan mahalaa 1 |
English: Gauree Bairaagan, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰੈਣਿ ਗਵਾਈ ਸੋਇ ਕੈ ਦਿਵਸੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: rain gavaaee soe kai divas gavaaeaa khaae |
English: The nights are wasted sleeping, and the days are wasted eating.

Gurbani: ਹੀਰੇ ਜੈਸਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਹੈ ਕਉਡੀ ਬਦਲੇ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: heere jaisaa janam hai kauddee badale jaae |1|
English: Human life is such a precious jewel, but it is being lost in exchange for a mere shell. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਰਾਮ ਕਾ ॥
Transliteration: naam na jaaniaa raam kaa |
English: You do not know the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮੂੜੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਹਿ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: moorre fir paachhai pachhutaeh re |1| rahaau |
English: You fool - you shall regret and repent in the end! ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਨਤਾ ਧਨੁ ਧਰਣੀ ਧਰੇ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਚਾਹਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: anataa dhan dharanee dhare anat na chaahiaa jaae |
English: You bury your temporary wealth in the ground, but how can you love that which is temporary?

Gurbani: ਅਨਤ ਕਉ ਚਾਹਨ ਜੋ ਗਏ ਸੇ ਆਏ ਅਨਤ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: anat kau chaahan jo ge se aae anat gavaae |2|
English: Those who have departed, after craving for temporary wealth, have returned home without this temporary wealth. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਪਣ ਲੀਆ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਭਾਗਠੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aapan leea je milai taa sabh ko bhaagatth hoe |
English: If people could gather it in by their own efforts, then everyone would be so lucky.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮਾ ਉਪਰਿ ਨਿਬੜੈ ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: karamaa upar nibarrai je lochai sabh koe |3|
English: According to the karma of past actions, one's destiny unfolds, even though everyone wants to be so lucky. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਸੋਈ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak karanaa jin keea soee saar karee |
English: O Nanak, the One who created the creation - He alone takes care of it.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੀ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਕਿਸੈ ਵਡਾਈ ਦੇਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: hukam na jaapee khasam kaa kisai vaddaaee dee |4|1|18|
English: The Hukam of our Lord and Master's Command cannot be known; He Himself blesses us with greatness. ||4||1||18||

[Ang 157 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree bairaagan mahalaa 1 |
English: Gauree Bairaagan, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਣੀ ਹੋਵਾ ਬਨਿ ਬਸਾ ਕੰਦ ਮੂਲ ਚੁਣਿ ਖਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: haranee hovaa ban basaa kand mool chun khaau |
English: What if I were to become a deer, and live in the forest, picking and eating fruits and roots

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਹੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਾਰਿ ਵਾਰਿ ਹਉ ਜਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee meraa sahu milai vaar vaar hau jaau jeeo |1|
English: - by Guru's Grace, I am a sacrifice to my Master. Again and again, I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਬਨਜਾਰਨਿ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: mai banajaaran raam kee |
English: I am the shop-keeper of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ਜੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: teraa naam vakhar vaapaar jee |1| rahaau |
English: Your Name is my merchandise and trade. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕੋਕਿਲ ਹੋਵਾ ਅੰਬਿ ਬਸਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਬਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: kokil hovaa anb basaa sehaj sabad beechaar |
English: If I were to become a cuckoo, living in a mango tree, I would still contemplate the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਹੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਰੂਪਿ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sehaj subhaae meraa sahu milai darasan roop apaar |2|
English: I would still meet my Lord and Master, with intuitive ease; the Darshan, the Blessed Vision of His Form, is incomparably beautiful. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਛੁਲੀ ਹੋਵਾ ਜਲਿ ਬਸਾ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: machhulee hovaa jal basaa jeea jant sabh saar |
English: If I were to become a fish, living in the water, I would still remember the Lord, who watches over all beings and creatures.

Gurbani: ਉਰਵਾਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਹੁ ਵਸੈ ਹਉ ਮਿਲਉਗੀ ਬਾਹ ਪਸਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: auravaar paar meraa sahu vasai hau milaugee baah pasaar |3|
English: My Husband Lord dwells on this shore, and on the shore beyond; I would still meet Him, and hug Him close in my embrace. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਗਨਿ ਹੋਵਾ ਧਰ ਵਸਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸੈ ਭਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: naagan hovaa dhar vasaa sabad vasai bhau jaae |
English: If I were to become a snake, living in the ground, the Shabad would still dwell in my mind, and my fears would be dispelled.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: naanak sadaa sohaaganee jin jotee jot samaae |4|2|19|
English: O Nanak, they are forever the happy soul-brides, whose light merges into His Light. ||4||2||19||

[Ang 157 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਦੀਪਕੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree poorabee deepakee mahalaa 1 |
English: Gauree Poorbee Deepkee, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਜੈ ਘਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਆਖੀਐ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: jai ghar keerat aakheeai karate kaa hoe beechaaro |
English: In that house where the Praises of the Creator are chanted

Gurbani: ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਸਿਵਰਹੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tit ghar gaavahu sohilaa sivarahu sirajanahaaro |1|
English: - in that house, sing the Songs of Praise, and meditate in remembrance on the Creator Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕਾ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: tum gaavahu mere nirbhau kaa sohilaa |
English: Sing the Songs of Praise of my Fearless Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜਾਉ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੋਹਿਲੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hau vaaree jaau jit sohilai sadaa sukh hoe |1| rahaau |
English: I am a sacrifice to that Song of Praise which brings eternal peace. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਸਮਾਲੀਅਨਿ ਦੇਖੈਗਾ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: nit nit jeearre samaaleean dekhaigaa devanahaar |
English: Day after day, He cares for His beings; the Great Giver watches over all.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਨੈ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਦਾਤੇ ਕਵਣੁ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tere daanai keemat naa pavai tis daate kavan sumaar |2|
English: Your gifts cannot be appraised; how can anyone compare to the Giver? ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੰਬਤਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਤੇਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: sanbat saahaa likhiaa mil kar paavahu tel |
English: The day of my wedding is pre-ordained. Come - let's gather together and pour the oil over the threshold.

Gurbani: ਦੇਹੁ ਸਜਣ ਆਸੀਸੜੀਆ ਜਿਉ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਲੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: dehu sajan aaseesarreea jiau hovai saahib siau mel |3|
English: My friends, give me your blessings, that I may merge with my Lord and Master. ||3||

Gurbani: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਏਹੋ ਪਾਹੁਚਾ ਸਦੜੇ ਨਿਤ ਪਵੰਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: ghar ghar eho paahuchaa sadarre nit pavan |
English: Unto each and every home, into each and every heart, this summons is sent out; the call comes each and every day.

Gurbani: ਸਦਣਹਾਰਾ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਦਿਹ ਆਵੰਨਿ ॥੪॥੧॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: sadanahaaraa simareeai naanak se dih aavan |4|1|20|
English: Remember in meditation the One who summons us; O Nanak, that day is drawing near! ||4||1||20||

[Ang 157 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ॥ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: raag gaurree guaareree | mahalaa 3 chaupade |
English: Raag Gauree Gwaarayree: Third Mehl, Chau-Padhay:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur miliai har melaa hoee |
English: Meeting the Guru, we meet the Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aape mel milaavai soee |
English: He Himself unites us in His Union.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: meraa prabh sabh bidh aape jaanai |
English: My God knows all His Own Ways.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: hukame mele sabad pachhaanai |1|
English: By the Hukam of His Command, He unites those who recognize the Word of the Shabad. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਇ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur kai bhe bhram bhau jaae |
English: By the Fear of the True Guru, doubt and fear are dispelled.

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਰਾਚੈ ਸਚ ਰੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhai raachai sach rang samaae |1| rahaau |
English: Imbued with His Fear, we are absorbed in the Love of the True One. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur miliai har man vasai subhaae |
English: Meeting the Guru, the Lord naturally dwells within the mind.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭਾਰਾ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: meraa prabh bhaaraa keemat nahee paae |
English: My God is Great and Almighty; His value cannot be estimated.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sabad saalaahai ant na paaraavaar |
English: Through the Shabad, I praise Him; He has no end or limitations.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: meraa prabh bakhase bakhasanahaar |2|
English: My God is the Forgiver. I pray that He may forgive me. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਭ ਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur miliai sabh mat budh hoe |
English: Meeting the Guru, all wisdom and understanding are obtained.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: man niramal vasai sach soe |
English: The mind becomes pure, when the True Lord dwells within.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਿ ਵਸਿਐ ਸਾਚੀ ਸਭ ਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: saach vasiai saachee sabh kaar |
English: When one dwells in Truth, all actions become true.

Gurbani: ਊਤਮ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਬਦ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aootam karanee sabad beechaar |3|
English: The ultimate action is to contemplate the Word of the Shabad. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਾਚੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur te saachee sevaa hoe |
English: Through the Guru, true service is performed.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh naam pachhaanai koe |
English: How rare is that Gurmukh who recognizes the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜੀਵੈ ਦਾਤਾ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jeevai daataa devanahaar |
English: The Giver, the Great Giver, lives forever.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੨੧॥
Transliteration: naanak har naame lagai piaar |4|1|21|
English: Nanak enshrines love for the Name of the Lord. ||4||1||21||

[Ang 158 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 3 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur te giaan paae jan koe |
English: Those who obtain spiritual wisdom from the Guru are very rare.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੀਝੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur te boojhai seejhai soe |
English: Those who obtain this understanding from the Guru become acceptable.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਹਜੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur te sehaj saach beechaar |
English: Through the Guru, we intuitively contemplate the True One.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur te paae mukat duaar |1|
English: Through the Guru, the Gate of Liberation is found. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: poorai bhaag milai gur aae |
English: Through perfect good destiny, we come to meet the Guru.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saachai sehaj saach samaae |1| rahaau |
English: The true ones are intuitively absorbed in the True Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur miliai trisanaa agan bujhaae |
English: Meeting the Guru, the fire of desire is quenched.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur te saant vasai man aae |
English: Through the Guru, peace and tranquility come to dwell within the mind.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਵਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਸੁਚਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur te pavit paavan such hoe |
English: Through the Guru, we become pure, holy and true.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur te sabad milaavaa hoe |2|
English: Through the Guru, we are absorbed in the Word of the Shabad. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਭ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: baajh guroo sabh bharam bhulaaee |
English: Without the Guru, everyone wanders in doubt.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: bin naavai bahutaa dukh paaee |
English: Without the Name, they suffer in terrible pain.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh hovai su naam dhiaaee |
English: Those who meditate on the Naam become Gurmukh.

Gurbani: ਦਰਸਨਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚੀ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: darasan sachai sachee pat hoee |3|
English: True honor is obtained through the Darshan, the Blessed Vision of the True Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਦਾਤਾ ਇਕੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: kis no kaheeai daataa ik soee |
English: Why speak of any other? He alone is the Giver.

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: kirapaa kare sabad milaavaa hoee |
English: When He grants His Grace, union with the Shabad is obtained.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: mil preetam saache gun gaavaa |
English: Meeting with my Beloved, I sing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਾ ॥੪॥੨॥੨੨॥
Transliteration: naanak saache saach samaavaa |4|2|22|
English: O Nanak, becoming true, I am absorbed in the True One. ||4||2||22||

[Ang 158 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 3 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੁ ਥਾਉ ਸਚੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: su thaau sach man niramal hoe |
English: True is that place, where the mind becomes pure.

Gurbani: ਸਚਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਕਰੇ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sach nivaas kare sach soe |
English: True is the one who abides in Truth.

Gurbani: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: sachee baanee jug chaare jaapai |
English: The True Bani of the Word is known throughout the four ages.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh saachaa aape aapai |1|
English: The True One Himself is everything. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: karam hovai satasang milaae |
English: Through the karma of good actions, one joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਬੈਸਿ ਸੁ ਥਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har gun gaavai bais su thaae |1| rahaau |
English: Sing the Glories of the Lord, sitting in that place. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਲਉ ਇਹ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jlau ih jihavaa doojai bhaae |
English: Burn this tongue, which loves duality,

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਨ ਚਾਖੈ ਫੀਕਾ ਆਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: har ras na chaakhai feekaa aalaae |
English: which does not taste the sublime essence of the Lord, and which utters insipid words.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਫੀਕਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin boojhe tan man feekaa hoe |
English: Without understanding, the body and mind become tasteless and insipid.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਚਲਿਆ ਰੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bin naavai dukheea chaliaa roe |2|
English: Without the Name, the miserable ones depart crying out in pain. ||2||

Gurbani: ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: rasanaa har ras chaakhiaa sehaj subhaae |
English: One whose tongue naturally and intuitively tastes the Lord's sublime essence,

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur kirapaa te sach samaae |
English: By Guru's Grace, is absorbed in the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੇ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: saache raatee gurasabad veechaar |
English: Imbued with Truth, one contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad,

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਧਾਰ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: amrit peevai niramal dhaar |3|
English: and drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar, from the immaculate stream within. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਜੋ ਭਾਡਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: naam samaavai jo bhaaddaa hoe |
English: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is collected in the vessel of the mind.

Gurbani: ਊਂਧੈ ਭਾਂਡੈ ਟਿਕੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aoondhai bhaanddai ttikai na koe |
English: Nothing is collected if the vessel is upside-down.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: gurasabadee man naam nivaas |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Naam abides within the mind.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਭਾਂਡਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਬਦ ਪਿਆਸ ॥੪॥੩॥੨੩॥
Transliteration: naanak sach bhaanddaa jis sabad piaas |4|3|23|
English: O Nanak, True is that vessel of the mind, which thirsts for the Shabad. ||4||3||23||

[Ang 158 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 3 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਗਾਵਤ ਰਹੇ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: eik gaavat rahe man saad na paae |
English: Some sing on and on, but their minds do not find happiness.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: haumai vich gaaveh birathaa jaae |
English: In egotism, they sing, but it is wasted uselessly.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਣਿ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਨਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: gaavan gaaveh jin naam piaar |
English: Those who love the Naam, sing the song.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saachee baanee sabad beechaar |1|
English: They contemplate the True Bani of the Word, and the Shabad. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਤ ਰਹੈ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: gaavat rahai je satigur bhaavai |
English: They sing on and on, if it pleases the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: man tan raataa naam suhaavai |1| rahaau |
English: Their minds and bodies are embellished and adorned, attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: eik gaaveh ik bhagat karehi |
English: Some sing, and some perform devotional worship.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਸਨੇਹ ॥
Transliteration: naam na paaveh bin asaneh |
English: Without heart-felt love, the Naam is not obtained.

Gurbani: ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: sachee bhagat gurasabad piaar |
English: True devotional worship consists of love for the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਅਪਨਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: apanaa pir raakhiaa sadaa ur dhaar |2|
English: The devotee keeps his Beloved clasped tightly to his heart. ||2||

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਆਪੁ ਜਣਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat kareh moorakh aap janaaveh |
English: The fools perform devotional worship by showing off;

Gurbani: ਨਚਿ ਨਚਿ ਟਪਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: nach nach ttapeh bahut dukh paaveh |
English: they dance and dance and jump all around, but they only suffer in terrible pain.

Gurbani: ਨਚਿਐ ਟਪਿਐ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: nachiai ttapiai bhagat na hoe |
English: By dancing and jumping, devotional worship is not performed.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sabad marai bhagat paae jan soe |3|
English: But one who dies in the Word of the Shabad, obtains devotional worship. ||3||

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat vachhal bhagat karaae soe |
English: The Lord is the Lover of His devotees; He inspires them to perform devotional worship.

Gurbani: ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਖੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sachee bhagat vichahu aap khoe |
English: True devotional worship consists of eliminating selfishness and conceit from within.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: meraa prabh saachaa sabh bidh jaanai |
English: My True God knows all ways and means.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੪॥੪॥੨੪॥
Transliteration: naanak bakhase naam pachhaanai |4|4|24|
English: O Nanak, He forgives those who recognize the Naam. ||4||4||24||

[Ang 159 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 3 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਧਾਤੁ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man maare dhaat mar jaae |
English: When someone kills and subdues his own mind, his wandering nature is also subdued.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਮੂਏ ਕੈਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin mooe kaise har paae |
English: Without such a death, how can one find the Lord?

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਮਰੈ ਦਾਰੂ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: man marai daaroo jaanai koe |
English: Only a few know the medicine to kill the mind.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: man sabad marai boojhai jan soe |1|
English: One whose mind dies in the Word of the Shabad, understands Him. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਖਸੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: jis no bakhase de vaddiaaee |
English: He grants greatness to those whom He forgives.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaad har vasai man aaee |1| rahaau |
English: By Guru's Grace, the Lord comes to dwell within the mind. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh karanee kaar kamaavai |
English: The Gurmukh practices doing good deeds;

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: taa is man kee sojhee paavai |
English: thus he comes to understand this mind.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਮੈ ਮਤੁ ਮੈਗਲ ਮਿਕਦਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: man mai mat maigal mikadaaraa |
English: The mind is like an elephant, drunk with wine.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਅੰਕਸੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur ankas maar jeevaalanahaaraa |2|
English: The Guru is the rod which controls it, and shows it the way. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਅਸਾਧੁ ਸਾਧੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: man asaadh saadhai jan koe |
English: The mind is uncontrollable; how rare are those who subdue it.

Gurbani: ਅਚਰੁ ਚਰੈ ਤਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: achar charai taa niramal hoe |
English: Those who move the immovable become pure.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਇਆ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh ihu man leaa savaar |
English: The Gurmukhs embellish and beautify this mind.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਤਜੇ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: haumai vichahu taje vikaar |3|
English: They eradicate egotism and corruption from within. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਅਨੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jo dhur raakhian mel milaae |
English: Those who, by pre-ordained destiny, are united in the Lord's Union,

Gurbani: ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kade na vichhurreh sabad samaae |
English: are never separated from Him again; they are absorbed in the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਆਪਣੀ ਕਲਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: aapanee kalaa aape hee jaanai |
English: He Himself knows His Own Almighty Power.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੪॥੫॥੨੫॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh naam pachhaanai |4|5|25|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh realizes the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||5||25||

[Ang 159 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 3 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਬਉਰਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: haumai vich sabh jag bauraanaa |
English: The entire world has gone insane in egotism.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: doojai bhaae bharam bhulaanaa |
English: In the love of duality, it wanders deluded by doubt.

Gurbani: ਬਹੁ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: bahu chintaa chitavai aap na pachhaanaa |
English: The mind is distracted by great anxiety; no one recognizes one's own self.

Gurbani: ਧੰਧਾ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਵਿਹਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dhandhaa karatiaa anadin vihaanaa |1|
English: Occupied with their own affairs, their nights and days are passing away. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਮਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: hiradai raam ramahu mere bhaaee |
English: Meditate on the Lord in your hearts, O my Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh rasanaa har rasan rasaaee |1| rahaau |
English: The Gurmukh's tongue savors the sublime essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh hiradai jin raam pachhaataa |
English: The Gurmukhs recognize the Lord in their own hearts;

Gurbani: ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: jagajeevan sev jug chaare jaataa |
English: they serve the Lord, the Life of the World. They are famous throughout the four ages.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: haumai maar gur sabad pachhaataa |
English: They subdue egotism, and realize the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kripaa kare prabh karam bidhaataa |2|
English: God, the Architect of Destiny, showers His Mercy upon them. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਚੇ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: se jan sache jo gur sabad milaae |
English: True are those who merge into the Word of the Guru's Shabad;

Gurbani: ਧਾਵਤ ਵਰਜੇ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: dhaavat varaje tthaak rahaae |
English: they restrain their wandering mind and keep it steady.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: naam nav nidh gur te paae |
English: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the nine treasures. It is obtained from the Guru.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har kirapaa te har vasai man aae |3|
English: By the Lord's Grace, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind. ||3||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: raam raam karatiaa sukh saant sareer |
English: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, the body becomes peaceful and tranquil.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਜਮ ਪੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: antar vasai na laagai jam peer |
English: He dwells deep within - the pain of death does not touch Him.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਆਪਿ ਵਜੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: aape saahib aap vajeer |
English: He Himself is our Lord and Master; He is His Own Advisor.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰ ॥੪॥੬॥੨੬॥
Transliteration: naanak sev sadaa har gunee gaheer |4|6|26|
English: O Nanak, serve the Lord forever; He is the treasure of glorious virtue. ||4||6||26||

[Ang 159 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 3 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਪਰਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: so kiau visarai jis ke jeea paraanaa |
English: Why forget Him, unto whom the soul and the breath of life belong?

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਸਭ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: so kiau visarai sabh maeh samaanaa |
English: Why forget Him, who is all-pervading?

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jit seviai daragah pat paravaanaa |1|
English: Serving Him, one is honored and accepted in the Court of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har ke naam vittahu bal jaau |
English: I am a sacrifice to the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਤਦਿ ਹੀ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: toon visareh tad hee mar jaau |1| rahaau |
English: If I were to forget You, at that very instant, I would die. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਤੂੰ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਜਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: tin toon visareh ji tudh aap bhulaae |
English: Those whom You Yourself have led astray, forget You.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਤੂੰ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਜਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: tin toon visareh ji doojai bhaae |
English: Thse who are in love with duality forget You.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: manamukh agiaanee jonee paae |2|
English: The ignorant, self-willed manmukhs are consigned to reincarnation. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਤੁਠਾ ਸੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jin ik man tutthaa se satigur sevaa laae |
English: Those who are pleasing to the One Lord are assigned

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਤੁਠਾ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jin ik man tutthaa tin har man vasaae |
English: to His service and enshrine Him within their minds.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: guramatee har naam samaae |3|
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, they are absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਾ ਪੋਤੈ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਸੇ ਗਿਆਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jinaa potai pun se giaan beechaaree |
English: Those who have virtue as their treasure, contemplate spiritual wisdom.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਾ ਪੋਤੈ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਤਿਨ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jinaa potai pun tin haumai maaree |
English: Those who have virtue as their treasure, subdue egotism.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੭॥੨੭॥
Transliteration: naanak jo naam rate tin kau balihaaree |4|7|27|
English: Nanak is a sacrifice to those who are attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||7||27||

[Ang 160 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 3 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਿਉ ਕਥਿਆ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: toon akath kiau kathiaa jaeh |
English: You are Indescribable; how can I describe You?

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਮਾਰਣੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: gurasabad maaran man maeh samaeh |
English: Those who subdue their minds, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, are absorbed in You.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਅਨੇਕ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tere gun anek keemat neh paeh |1|
English: Your Glorious Virtues are countless; their value cannot be estimated. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: jis kee baanee tis maeh samaanee |
English: The Word of His Bani belongs to Him; in Him, it is diffused.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੀ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: teree akath kathaa gur sabad vakhaanee |1| rahaau |
English: Your Speech cannot be spoken; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it is chanted. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਹ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jeh satigur teh satasangat banaaee |
English: Where the True Guru is - there is the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jeh satigur sahaje har gun gaaee |
English: Where the True Guru is - there, the Glorious Praises of the Lord are intuitively sung.

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਹਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jeh satigur tahaa haumai sabad jalaaee |2|
English: Where the True Guru is - there egotism is burnt away, through the Word of the Shabad. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਮਹਲੀ ਥਾਉ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh sevaa mahalee thaau paae |
English: The Gurmukhs serve Him; they obtain a place in the Mansion of His Presence.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh antar har naam vasaae |
English: The Gurmukhs enshrine the Naam within the mind.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: guramukh bhagat har naam samaae |3|
English: The Gurmukhs worship the Lord, and are absorbed in the Naam. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape daat kare daataar |
English: The Giver Himself gives His Gifts,

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: poore satigur siau lagai piaar |
English: as we enshrine love for the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੮॥੨੮॥
Transliteration: naanak naam rate tin kau jaikaar |4|8|28|
English: Nanak celebrates those who are attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||8||28||

[Ang 160 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 3 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਏਕਸੁ ਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਰੂਪ ਹਹਿ ਰੰਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: ekas te sabh roop heh rangaa |
English: All forms and colors come from the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਸਭਿ ਸਹਲੰਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: paun paanee baisantar sabh sehalangaa |
English: Air, water and fire are all kept together.

Gurbani: ਭਿੰਨ ਭਿੰਨ ਵੇਖੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰੰਗਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bhin bhin vekhai har prabh rangaa |1|
English: The Lord God beholds the many and various colors. ||1||

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਏਕੋ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: ek acharaj eko hai soee |
English: The One Lord is wondrous and amazing! He is the One, the One and Only.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh veechaare viralaa koee |1| rahaau |
English: How rare is that Gurmukh who meditates on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਹਜਿ ਭਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj bhavai prabh sabhanee thaaee |
English: God is naturally pervading all places.

Gurbani: ਕਹਾ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kahaa gupat pragatt prabh banat banaaee |
English: Sometimes He is hidden, and sometimes He is revealed; thus God has made the world of His making.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸੁਤਿਆ ਦੇਇ ਜਗਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aape sutiaa dee jagaaee |2|
English: He Himself wakes us from sleep. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: tis kee keemat kinai na hoee |
English: No one can estimate His value,

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਕਥਨੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: keh keh kathan kahai sabh koee |
English: although everyone has tried, over and over again, to describe Him.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur sabad samaavai boojhai har soee |3|
English: Those who merge in the Word of the Guru's Shabad, come to understand the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sun sun vekhai sabad milaae |
English: They listen to the Shabad continually; beholding Him, they merge into Him.

Gurbani: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: vaddee vaddiaaee gur sevaa te paae |
English: They obtain glorious greatness by serving the Guru.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੪॥੯॥੨੯॥
Transliteration: naanak naam rate har naam samaae |4|9|29|
English: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Name are absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||4||9||29||

[Ang 160 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 3 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸੂਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh sootaa maaeaa mohi piaar |
English: The self-willed manmukhs are asleep, in love and attachment to Maya.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਗੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਿਆਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh jaage gun giaan beechaar |
English: The Gurmukhs are awake, contemplating spiritual wisdom and the Glory of God.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਜਾਗੇ ਜਿਨ ਨਾਮ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: se jan jaage jin naam piaar |1|
English: Those humble beings who love the Naam, are awake and aware. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਜਾਗੈ ਸਵੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sahaje jaagai savai na koe |
English: One who is awake to this intuitive wisdom does not fall asleep.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: poore gur te boojhai jan koe |1| rahaau |
English: How rare are those humble beings who understand this through the Perfect Guru. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਸੰਤੁ ਅਨਾੜੀ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
Transliteration: asant anaarree kade na boojhai |
English: The unsaintly blockhead shall never understand.

Gurbani: ਕਥਨੀ ਕਰੇ ਤੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਲੂਝੈ ॥
Transliteration: kathanee kare tai maaeaa naal loojhai |
English: He babbles on and on, but he is infatuated with Maya.

Gurbani: ਅੰਧੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਸੀਝੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: andh agiaanee kade na seejhai |2|
English: Blind and ignorant, he shall never be reformed. ||2||

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: eis jug meh raam naam nisataaraa |
English: In this age, salvation comes only from the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: viralaa ko paae gur sabad veechaaraa |
English: How rare are those who contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aap tarai sagale kul udhaaraa |3|
English: They save themselves, and save all their family and ancestors as well. ||3||

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: eis kalijug meh karam dharam na koee |
English: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, no one is interested in good karma, or Dharmic faith.

Gurbani: ਕਲੀ ਕਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਚੰਡਾਲ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: kalee kaa janam chanddaal kai ghar hoee |
English: This Dark Age was born in the house of evil.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੋ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੩੦॥
Transliteration: naanak naam binaa ko mukat na hoee |4|10|30|
English: O Nanak, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, no one is liberated. ||4||10||30||

[Ang 161 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 3 guaareree |
English: Gauree, Third Mehl, Gwaarayree:

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਅਮਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa amar sachaa paatisaahu |
English: True is the Lord King, True is His Royal Command.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: man saachai raate har veparavaahu |
English: Those whose minds are attuned to the True,

Gurbani: ਸਚੈ ਮਹਲਿ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sachai mehal sach naam samaahu |1|
English: Carefree Lord enter the True Mansion of His Presence, and merge in the True Name. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: sun man mere sabad veechaar |
English: Listen, O my mind: contemplate the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਜਪਹੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਉਤਰਹੁ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raam japahu bhavajal utarahu paar |1| rahaau |
English: Chant the Lord's Name, and cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਭਰਮੇ ਆਵੈ ਭਰਮੇ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bharame aavai bharame jaae |
English: In doubt he comes, and in doubt he goes.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਜਨਮਿਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: eihu jag janamiaa doojai bhaae |
English: This world is born out of the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: manamukh na chetai aavai jaae |2|
English: The self-willed manmukh does not remember the Lord; he continues coming and going in reincarnation. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾ ਕਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aap bhulaa ki prabh aap bhulaaeaa |
English: Does he himself go astray, or does God lead him astray?

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: eihu jeeo viddaanee chaakaree laaeaa |
English: This soul is enjoined to the service of someone else.

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਖਟੇ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: mahaa dukh khatte birathaa janam gavaaeaa |3|
English: It earns only terrible pain, and this life is lost in vain. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: kirapaa kar satiguroo milaae |
English: Granting His Grace, He leads us to meet the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੇਤੇ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: eko naam chete vichahu bharam chukaae |
English: Remembering the One Name, doubt is cast out from within.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇ ਨਾਉ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੩੧॥
Transliteration: naanak naam jape naau nau nidh paae |4|11|31|
English: O Nanak, chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the nine treasures of the Name are obtained. ||4||11||31||

[Ang 161 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 3 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਪੂਛਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jinaa guramukh dhiaaeaa tin poochhau jaae |
English: Go and ask the Gurmukhs, who meditate on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਪਤੀਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur sevaa te man pateeae |
English: Serving the Guru, the mind is satisfied.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਧਨਵੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: se dhanavant har naam kamaae |
English: Those who earn the Lord's Name are wealthy.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: poore gur te sojhee paae |1|
English: Through the Perfect Guru, understanding is obtained. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam japahu mere bhaaee |
English: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਘਾਲ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh sevaa har ghaal thaae paaee |1| rahaau |
English: The Gurmukhs serve the Lord, and so they are accepted. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aap pachhaanai man niramal hoe |
English: Those who recognize the self - their minds become pure.

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jeevan mukat har paavai soe |
English: They become Jivan-mukta, liberated while yet alive, and they find the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: har gun gaavai mat aootam hoe |
English: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the intellect becomes pure and sublime,

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sahaje sehaj samaavai soe |2|
English: and they are easily and intuitively absorbed in the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: doojai bhaae na seviaa jaae |
English: In the love of duality, no one can serve the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: haumai maaeaa mahaa bikh khaae |
English: In egotism and Maya, they are eating toxic poison.

Gurbani: ਪੁਤਿ ਕੁਟੰਬਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: put kuttanb grihi mohiaa maae |
English: They are emotionally attached to their children, family and home.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧਾ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: manamukh andhaa aavai jaae |3|
English: The blind, self-willed manmukhs come and go in reincarnation. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam devai jan soe |
English: Those, unto whom the Lord bestows His Name,

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: anadin bhagat gurasabadee hoe |
English: Worship Him night and day, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramat viralaa boojhai koe |
English: How rare are those who understand the Guru's Teachings!

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੩੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naam samaavai soe |4|12|32|
English: O Nanak, they are absorbed in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||12||32||

[Ang 161 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 3 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur sevaa jug chaare hoee |
English: The Guru's service has been performed throughout the four ages.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਾ ਜਨੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: pooraa jan kaar kamaavai koee |
English: Very few are those perfect ones who do this good deed.

Gurbani: ਅਖੁਟੁ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: akhutt naam dhan har tott na hoee |
English: The wealth of the Lord's Name is inexhaustible; it shall never be exhausted.

Gurbani: ਐਥੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aithai sadaa sukh dar sobhaa hoee |1|
English: In this world, it brings a constant peace, and at the Lord's Gate, it brings honor. ||1||

Gurbani: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: e man mere bharam na keejai |
English: O my mind, have no doubt about this.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh sevaa amrit ras peejai |1| rahaau |
English: Those Gurmukhs who serve, drink in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਮਹਾਪੁਰਖ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur seveh se mahaapurakh sansaare |
English: Those who serve the True Guru are the greatest people of the world.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਉਧਰੇ ਕੁਲ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aap udhare kul sagal nisataare |
English: They save themselves, and they redeem all their generations as well.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖਹਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam rakheh ur dhaare |
English: They keep the Name of the Lord clasped tightly to their hearts.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਭਉਜਲ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਪਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naam rate bhaujal utareh paare |2|
English: Attuned to the Naam, they cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: satigur seveh sadaa man daasaa |
English: Serving the True Guru, the mind becomes humble forever.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: haumai maar kamal paragaasaa |
English: Egotism is subdued, and the heart-lotus blossoms forth.

Gurbani: ਅਨਹਦੁ ਵਾਜੈ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: anahad vaajai nij ghar vaasaa |
English: The Unstruck Melody vibrates, as they dwell within the home of the self.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਘਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naam rate ghar maeh udaasaa |3|
English: Attuned to the Naam, they remain detached within their own home. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: satigur seveh tin kee sachee baanee |
English: Serving the True Guru, their words are true.

Gurbani: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: jug jug bhagatee aakh vakhaanee |
English: Throughout the ages, the devotees chant and repeat these words.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਪਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਰੰਗਪਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: anadin japeh har saarangapaanee |
English: Night and day, they meditate on the Lord, the Sustainer of the Earth.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੩੩॥
Transliteration: naanak naam rate nihakeval nirabaanee |4|13|33|
English: O Nanak, attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, they are detached, in the perfect balance of Nirvaanaa. ||4||13||33||

[Ang 162 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 3 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: satigur milai vaddabhaag sanjog |
English: Through great good fortune and high destiny, one meets the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: hiradai naam nit har ras bhog |1|
English: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is constantly within the heart, and one enjoys the sublime essence of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh praanee naam har dhiaae |
English: O mortal, become Gurmukh, and meditate on the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮੁ ਜੀਤਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: janam jeet laahaa naam paae |1| rahaau |
English: Be victorious in the game of life, and earn the profit of the Naam. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: giaan dhiaan gurasabad hai meetthaa |
English: Spiritual wisdom and meditation come to those unto whom the Word of the Guru's Shabad is sweet.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਚਖਿ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur kirapaa te kinai viralai chakh ddeetthaa |2|
English: By Guru's Grace, a few have tasted, and seen it. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਰਮ ਕਾਂਡ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਚਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: karam kaandd bahu kareh achaar |
English: They may perform all sorts of religious rituals and good actions,

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bin naavai dhrig dhrig ahankaar |3|
English: but without the Name, the egotistical ones are cursed and doomed. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬੰਧਨਿ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਮਾਇਆ ਫਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: bandhan baadhio maaeaa faas |
English: They are bound and gagged, and hung by Maya's noose;

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਛੂਟੈ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਗਾਸ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੩੪॥
Transliteration: jan naanak chhoottai gur paragaas |4|14|34|
English: O servant Nanak, they shall be released only by Guru's Grace. ||4||14||34||

[Ang 162 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 gaurree bairaagan |
English: Third Mehl, Gauree Bairaagan:

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੀ ਧਰਤੀ ਊਪਰਿਮੇਘੁਲਾ ਬਰਸਤੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਆ ਧਰਤੀ ਮਧੇ ਪਾਣੀ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jaisee dharatee aooparimeghulaa barasat hai kiaa dharatee madhe paanee naahee |
English: The clouds pour their rain down upon the earth, but isn't there water within the earth as well?

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਮਧੇ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਗਾ ਵਰਸਤ ਫਿਰਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jaise dharatee madhe paanee paragaasiaa bin pagaa varasat firaahee |1|
English: Water is contained within the earth; without feet, the clouds run around and let down their rain. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਾਬਾ ਤੂੰ ਐਸੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: baabaa toon aise bharam chukaahee |
English: O Baba, get rid of your doubts like this.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਤੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਕੋਈ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਤੈਸੇ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo kichh karat hai soee koee hai re taise jaae samaahee |1| rahaau |
English: As you act, so shall you become, and so you shall go and mingle. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਇਸਤਰੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਕਿਆ ਓਇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: eisataree purakh hoe kai kiaa oe karam kamaahee |
English: As woman or man, what can anyone do?

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਾ ਰੂਪ ਸਦਾ ਹਹਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanaa roop sadaa heh tere tujh hee maeh samaahee |2|
English: The many and various forms are always Yours, O Lord; they shall merge again into You. ||2||

Gurbani: ਇਤਨੇ ਜਨਮ ਭੂਲਿ ਪਰੇ ਸੇ ਜਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਾ ਭੂਲੇ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: eitane janam bhool pare se jaa paaeaa taa bhoole naahee |
English: In countless incarnations, I went astray. Now that I have found You, I shall no longer wander.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸੋਈ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jaa kaa kaaraj soee par jaanai je gur kai sabad samaahee |3|
English: It is His work; those who are absorbed in the Word of the Guru's Shabad come to know it well. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਹਹਿ ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਕਹਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: teraa sabad toonhai heh aape bharam kahaahee |
English: The Shabad is Yours; You are Yourself. Where is there any doubt?

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਤੁ ਤਤ ਸਿਉ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪੁਨਰਪਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਹੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੫॥੩੫॥
Transliteration: naanak tat tat siau miliaa punarap janam na aahee |4|1|15|35|
English: O Nanak, one whose essence is merged with the Lord's essence does not have to enter the cycle of reincarnation again. ||4||1||15||35||

[Ang 162 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree bairaagan mahalaa 3 |
English: Gauree Bairaagan, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਕਾਲੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਬਾਧਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabh jag kaalai vas hai baadhaa doojai bhaae |
English: The whole world is under the power of Death, bound by the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: haumai karam kamaavade manamukh milai sajaae |1|
English: The self-willed manmukhs do their deeds in ego; they receive their just rewards. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: mere man gur charanee chit laae |
English: O my mind, focus your consciousness on the Guru's Feet.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਲੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh naam nidhaan lai daragah le chhaddaae |1| rahaau |
English: As Gurmukh, you shall be awarded the treasure of the Naam. In the Court of the Lord, you shall be saved. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਭਰਮਦੇ ਮਨਹਠਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh bharamade manahatth aavai jaae |
English: Through 8.4 million incarnations, people wander lost; in stubborn-mindedness, they come and go.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਚੀਨਿਓ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur kaa sabad na cheenio fir fir jonee paae |2|
English: They do not realize the Word of the Guru's Shabad; they are reincarnated over and over again. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh aap pachhaaniaa har naam vasiaa man aae |
English: The Gurmukh understands his own self. The Lord's Name comes to dwell within the mind.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: anadin bhagatee ratiaa har naame sukh samaae |3|
English: Imbued with devotion to the Lord's Name, night and day, he merges in peace. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜੇ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: man sabad marai parateet hoe haumai taje vikaar |
English: When one's mind dies in the Shabad, one radiates faith and confidence, shedding egotism and corruption.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਮੀ ਪਾਈਅਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੬॥੩੬॥
Transliteration: jan naanak karamee paaeean har naamaa bhagat bhanddaar |4|2|16|36|
English: O servant Nanak, through the karma of good actions, the treasure of devotional worship and the Name of the Lord are attained. ||4||2||16||36||

[Ang 162 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree bairaagan mahalaa 3 |
English: Gauree Bairaagan, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: peeearrai din chaar hai har har likh paaeaa |
English: The Lord, Har, Har, has ordained that the soul is to stay in her parents' home for only a few short days.

Gurbani: ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sobhaavantee naar hai guramukh gun gaaeaa |
English: Glorious is that soul-bride, who as Gurmukh, sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਪੇਵਕੜੈ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਮਲੈ ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਵਾਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: pevakarrai gun samalai saahurai vaas paaeaa |
English: She who cultivates virtue in her parents' home, shall obtain a home at her in-laws.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: guramukh sehaj samaaneea har har man bhaaeaa |1|
English: The Gurmukhs are intuitively absorbed into the Lord. The Lord is pleasing to their minds. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਸੁਰੈ ਪੇਈਐ ਪਿਰੁ ਵਸੈ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: sasurai peeeai pir vasai kahu kit bidh paaeeai |
English: Our Husband Lord dwells in this world, and in the world beyond. Tell me, how can He be found?

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aap niranjan alakh hai aape melaaeeai |1| rahaau |
English: The Immaculate Lord Himself is unseen. He unites us with Himself. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: aape hee prabh dehi mat har naam dhiaaeeai |
English: God Himself bestows wisdom; meditate on the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: vaddabhaagee satigur milai mukh amrit paaeeai |
English: By great good fortune, one meets the True Guru, who places the Ambrosial Nectar in the mouth.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: haumai dubidhaa binas jaae sahaje sukh samaaeeai |
English: When egotism and duality are eradicated, one intuitively merges in peace.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਨਾਇ ਲਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sabh aape aap varatadaa aape naae laaeeai |2|
English: He Himself is All-pervading; He Himself links us to His Name. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਗਰਬਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਇਆਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh garab na paaeo agiaan eaane |
English: The self-willed manmukhs, in their arrogant pride, do not find God; they are so ignorant and foolish!

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sevaa naa kareh fir fir pachhutaane |
English: They do not serve the True Guru, and in the end, they regret and repent, over and over again.

Gurbani: ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨੀ ਵਾਸੁ ਪਾਇਦੇ ਗਰਭੇ ਗਲਿ ਜਾਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: garabh jonee vaas paaeide garabhe gal jaane |
English: They are cast into the womb to be reincarnated, and within the womb, they rot.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਕਰਤੇ ਏਵੈ ਭਾਵਦਾ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮਾਣੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: mere karate evai bhaavadaa manamukh bharamaane |3|
English: As it pleases my Creator Lord, the self-willed manmukhs wander around lost. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਇਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: merai har prabh lekh likhaaeaa dhur masatak pooraa |
English: My Lord God inscribed the full pre-ordained destiny upon the forehead.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੂਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam dhiaaeaa bhettiaa gur sooraa |
English: When one meets the Great and Courageous Guru, one meditates on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਬੰਧਪੁ ਬੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: meraa pitaa maataa har naam hai har bandhap beeraa |
English: The Lord's Name is my mother and father; the Lord is my relative and brother.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕੀਰਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੭॥੩੭॥
Transliteration: har har bakhas milaae prabh jan naanak keeraa |4|3|17|37|
English: O Lord, Har, Har, please forgive me and unite me with Yourself. Servant Nanak is a lowly worm. ||4||3||17||37||

[Ang 163 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree bairaagan mahalaa 3 |
English: Gauree Bairaagan, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: satigur te giaan paaeaa har tat beechaaraa |
English: From the True Guru, I obtained spiritual wisdom; I contemplate the Lord's essence.

Gurbani: ਮਤਿ ਮਲੀਣ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਭਈ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: mat maleen paragatt bhee jap naam muraaraa |
English: My polluted intellect was enlightened by chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਿਵਿ ਸਕਤਿ ਮਿਟਾਈਆ ਚੂਕਾ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: siv sakat mittaaeea chookaa andhiaaraa |
English: The distinction between Shiva and Shakti - mind and matter - has been destroyed, and the darkness has been dispelled.

Gurbani: ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dhur masatak jin kau likhiaa tin har naam piaaraa |1|
English: The Lord's Name is loved by those, upon whose foreheads such pre-ordained destiny was written. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਹੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: har kit bidh paaeeai sant janahu jis dekh hau jeevaa |
English: How can the Lord be obtained, O Saints? Seeing Him, my life is sustained.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਚਸਾ ਨ ਜੀਵਤੀ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਿਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har bin chasaa na jeevatee gur melihu har ras peevaa |1| rahaau |
English: Without the Lord, I cannot live, even for an instant. Unite me with the Guru, so that I may drink in the sublime essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਤਿ ਕੀਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: hau har gun gaavaa nit har sunee har har gat keenee |
English: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and I listen to them daily; the Lord, Har, Har, has emancipated me.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਲੀਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: har ras gur te paaeaa meraa man tan leenee |
English: I have obtained the Lord's essence from the Guru; my mind and body are drenched with it.

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan gur sat purakh hai jin bhagat har deenee |
English: Blessed, blessed is the Guru, the True Being, who has blessed me with devotional worship of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਹਮ ਕੀਨੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jis gur te har paaeaa so gur ham keenee |2|
English: From the Guru, I have obtained the Lord; I have made Him my Guru. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ਹੈ ਹਮ ਅਵਗਣਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gunadaataa har raae hai ham avaganiaare |
English: The Sovereign Lord is the Giver of virtue. I am worthless and without virtue.

Gurbani: ਪਾਪੀ ਪਾਥਰ ਡੂਬਦੇ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: paapee paathar ddoobade guramat har taare |
English: The sinners sink like stones; through the Guru's Teachings, the Lord carries us across.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਹਮ ਅਵਗਣਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: toon gunadaataa niramalaa ham avaganiaare |
English: You are the Giver of virtue, O Immaculate Lord; I am worthless and without virtue.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har saranaagat raakh lehu moorr mugadh nisataare |3|
English: I have entered Your Sanctuary, Lord; please save me, as You have saved the idiots and fools. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj anand sadaa guramatee har har man dhiaaeaa |
English: Eternal celestial bliss comes through the Guru's Teachings, by meditating continually on the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਸਜਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਘਰਿ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sajan har prabh paaeaa ghar sohilaa gaaeaa |
English: I have obtained the Lord God as my Best Friend, within the home of my own self. I sing the Songs of Joy.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: har deaa dhaar prabh benatee har har chetaaeaa |
English: Please shower me with Your Mercy, O Lord God, that I may meditate on Your Name, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਧੂੜਿ ਤਿਨ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੮॥੩੮॥
Transliteration: jan naanak mangai dhoorr tin jin satigur paaeaa |4|4|18|38|
English: Servant Nanak begs for the dust of the feet of those who have found the True Guru. ||4||4||18||38||

[Ang 163 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਚਉਥਾ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 4 chauthaa chaupade |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fourth Mehl, Chau-Padhay:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਸਾਸਤ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪੜਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: panddit saasat simrit parriaa |
English: The Pandit - the religious scholar - recites the Shaastras and the Simritees;

Gurbani: ਜੋਗੀ ਗੋਰਖੁ ਗੋਰਖੁ ਕਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jogee gorakh gorakh kariaa |
English: the Yogi cries out, "Gorakh, Gorakh".

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਪੜਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mai moorakh har har jap parriaa |1|
English: But I am just a fool - I just chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਜਾਨਾ ਕਿਆ ਗਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: naa jaanaa kiaa gat raam hamaaree |
English: I do not know what my condition shall be, Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤਰੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤੂ ਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har bhaj man mere tar bhaujal too taaree |1| rahaau |
English: O my mind, vibrate and meditate on the Name of the Lord. You shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਬਿਭੂਤ ਲਾਇ ਦੇਹ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: saniaasee bibhoot laae deh savaaree |
English: The Sannyaasee smears his body with ashes;

Gurbani: ਪਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਅ ਤਿਆਗੁ ਕਰੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: par tria tiaag karee brahamachaaree |
English: renouncing other men's women, he practices celibacy.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਹਰਿ ਆਸ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mai moorakh har aas tumaaree |2|
English: I am just a fool, Lord; I place my hopes in You! ||2||

Gurbani: ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇ ਸੂਰਤਣੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: khatree karam kare sooratan paavai |
English: The Kh'shaatriya acts bravely, and is recognized as a warrior.

Gurbani: ਸੂਦੁ ਵੈਸੁ ਪਰ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: sood vais par kirat kamaavai |
English: The Shoodra and the Vaisha work and slave for others;

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਛਡਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: mai moorakh har naam chhaddaavai |3|
English: I am just a fool - I am saved by the Lord's Name. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਤੂੰ ਆਪਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sabh teree srisatt toon aap rahiaa samaaee |
English: The entire Universe is Yours; You Yourself permeate and pervade it.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh naanak de vaddiaaee |
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are blessed with glorious greatness.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਟੇਕ ਟਿਕਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੯॥
Transliteration: mai andhule har ttek ttikaaee |4|1|39|
English: I am blind - I have taken the Lord as my Support. ||4||1||39||

[Ang 164 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 4 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਕਥਾ ਕਥਾ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: niragun kathaa kathaa hai har kee |
English: The Speech of the Lord is the most sublime speech, free of any attributes.

Gurbani: ਭਜੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: bhaj mil saadhoo sangat jan kee |
English: Vibrate on it, meditate on it, and join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਤਰੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tar bhaujal akath kathaa sun har kee |1|
English: Cross over the terrifying world-ocean, listening to the Unspoken Speech of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gobind satasangat melaae |
English: O Lord of the Universe, unite me with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har ras rasanaa raam gun gaae |1| rahaau |
English: My tongue savors the sublime essence of the Lord, singing the Lord's Glorious Praises. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo jan dhiaaveh har har naamaa |
English: Those humble beings who meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਮ ਰਾਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: tin daasan daas karahu ham raamaa |
English: please make me the slave of their slaves, Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਊਤਮ ਕਾਮਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jan kee sevaa aootam kaamaa |2|
English: Serving Your slaves is the ultimate good deed. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jo har kee har kathaa sunaavai |
English: One who chants the Speech of the Lord

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਹਮਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: so jan hamarai man chit bhaavai |
English: that humble servant is pleasing to my conscious mind.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਪਗ ਰੇਣੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jan pag ren vaddabhaagee paavai |3|
English: Those who are blessed with great good fortune obtain the dust of the feet of the humble. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: sant janaa siau preet ban aaee |
English: Those who are blessed with such pre-ordained destiny

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jin kau likhat likhiaa dhur paaee |
English: Are in love with the humble Saints.

Gurbani: ਤੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੪॥੨॥੪੦॥
Transliteration: te jan naanak naam samaaee |4|2|40|
English: Those humble beings, O Nanak, are absorbed in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||2||40||

[Ang 164 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 4 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਾਤਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਪੁਤੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: maataa preet kare put khaae |
English: The mother loves to see her son eat.

Gurbani: ਮੀਨੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਭਈ ਜਲਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: meene preet bhee jal naae |
English: The fish loves to bathe in the water.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: satigur preet gurasikh mukh paae |1|
English: The True Guru loves to place food in the mouth of His GurSikh. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਹਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: te har jan har melahu ham piaare |
English: If only I could meet those humble servants of the Lord, O my Beloved.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਦੁਖ ਜਾਹਿ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jin miliaa dukh jaeh hamaare |1| rahaau |
English: Meeting with them, my sorrows depart. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਮਿਲਿ ਬਛਰੇ ਗਊ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jiau mil bachhare gaoo preet lagaavai |
English: As the cow shows her love to her strayed calf when she finds it,

Gurbani: ਕਾਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਜਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: kaaman preet jaa pir ghar aavai |
English: and as the bride shows her love for her husband when he returns home,

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har jan preet jaa har jas gaavai |2|
English: so does the Lord's humble servant love to sing the Praises of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਾਰਿੰਗ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਸੈ ਜਲ ਧਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: saaring preet basai jal dhaaraa |
English: The rainbird loves the rainwater, falling in torrents;

Gurbani: ਨਰਪਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: narapat preet maaeaa dekh pasaaraa |
English: the king loves to see his wealth on display.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਜਪੈ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har jan preet japai nirankaaraa |3|
English: The humble servant of the Lord loves to meditate on the Formless Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਰ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਧਨੁ ਖਾਟੇ ॥
Transliteration: nar praanee preet maaeaa dhan khaatte |
English: The mortal man loves to accumulate wealth and property.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗਲਾਟੇ ॥
Transliteration: gurasikh preet gur milai galaatte |
English: The GurSikh loves to meet and embrace the Guru.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਪਗ ਚਾਟੇ ॥੪॥੩॥੪੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak preet saadh pag chaatte |4|3|41|
English: Servant Nanak loves to kiss the feet of the Holy. ||4||3||41||

[Ang 164 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 4 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਭੀਖਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਭੀਖ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bheekhak preet bheekh prabh paae |
English: The beggar loves to receive charity from the wealthy landlord.

Gurbani: ਭੂਖੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਅੰਨੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhookhe preet hovai an khaae |
English: The hungry person loves to eat food.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਆਘਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gurasikh preet gur mil aaghaae |1|
English: The GurSikh loves to find satisfaction by meeting the Guru. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਸ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: har darasan dehu har aas tumaaree |
English: O Lord, grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; I place my hopes in You, Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੋਚ ਪੂਰਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa loch poor hamaaree |1| rahaau |
English: Shower me with Your Mercy, and fulfill my longing. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਚਕਵੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: chakavee preet sooraj mukh laagai |
English: The song-bird loves the sun shining in her face.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਭ ਦੁਖ ਤਿਆਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: milai piaare sabh dukh tiaagai |
English: Meeting her Beloved, all her pains are left behind.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gurasikh preet guroo mukh laagai |2|
English: The GurSikh loves to gaze upon the Face of the Guru. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬਛਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਖੀਰੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bachhare preet kheer mukh khaae |
English: The calf loves to suck its mother's milk;

Gurbani: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਦੇਖੈ ਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: hiradai bigasai dekhai maae |
English: its heart blossoms forth upon seeing its mother.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gurasikh preet guroo mukh laae |3|
English: The GurSikh loves to gaze upon the Face of the Guru. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹੋਰੁ ਸਭ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਕਾਚਾ ॥
Transliteration: hor sabh preet maaeaa mohu kaachaa |
