English: All other loves and emotional attachment to Maya are false.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਕੂਰਾ ਕਚੁ ਪਾਚਾ ॥
Transliteration: binas jaae kooraa kach paachaa |
English: They shall pass away, like false and transitory decorations.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ॥੪॥੪॥੪੨॥
Transliteration: jan naanak preet tripat gur saachaa |4|4|42|
English: Servant Nanak is fulfilled, through the Love of the True Guru. ||4||4||42||

[Ang 165 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 4 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਫਲ ਹੈ ਬਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sevaa safal hai banee |
English: Service to the True Guru is fruitful and rewarding;

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਧਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: jit mil har naam dhiaaeaa har dhanee |
English: meeting Him, I meditate on the Name of the Lord, the Lord Master.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਪੀਛੈ ਛੂਟੀ ਘਣੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jin har japiaa tin peechhai chhoottee ghanee |1|
English: So many are emancipated along with those who meditate on the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: gurasikh har bolahu mere bhaaee |
English: O GurSikhs, chant the Name of the Lord, O my Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਤ ਸਭ ਪਾਪ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har bolat sabh paap leh jaaee |1| rahaau |
English: Chanting the Lord's Name, all sins are washed away. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਬ ਮਨੁ ਵਸਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jab gur miliaa tab man vas aaeaa |
English: When one meets the Guru, then the mind becomes centered.

Gurbani: ਧਾਵਤ ਪੰਚ ਰਹੇ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: dhaavat panch rahe har dhiaaeaa |
English: The five passions, running wild, are brought to rest by meditating on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਗਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: anadin nagaree har gun gaaeaa |2|
English: Night and day, within the body-village, the Glorious Praises of the Lord are sung. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਗ ਧੂਰਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur pag dhoor jinaa mukh laaee |
English: Those who apply the dust of the Feet of the True Guru to their faces,

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕੂੜ ਤਿਆਗੇ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: tin koorr tiaage har liv laaee |
English: renounce falsehood and enshrine love for the Lord.

Gurbani: ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਭਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: te har daragah mukh aoojal bhaaee |3|
English: Their faces are radiant in the Court of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur sevaa aap har bhaavai |
English: Service to the Guru is pleasing to the Lord Himself.

Gurbani: ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨੁ ਬਲਭਦ੍ਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਗ ਲਗਿ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: krisan balabhadru gur pag lag dhiaavai |
English: Even Krishna and Balbhadar meditated on the Lord, falling at the Guru's Feet.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਤਰਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੫॥੪੩॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh har aap taraavai |4|5|43|
English: O Nanak, the Lord Himself saves the Gurmukhs. ||4||5||43||

[Ang 165 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 4 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਜੋਗੀ ਡੰਡਾਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: har aape jogee ddanddaadhaaree |
English: The Lord Himself is the Yogi, who wields the staff of authority.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: har aape rav rahiaa banavaaree |
English: The Lord Himself practices tapa - intense self-disciplined meditation;

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਤਪੁ ਤਾਪੈ ਲਾਇ ਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har aape tap taapai laae taaree |1|
English: He is deeply absorbed in His primal trance. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa meraa raam rahiaa bharapoor |
English: Such is my Lord, who is all-pervading everywhere.

Gurbani: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: nikatt vasai naahee har door |1| rahaau |
English: He dwells near at hand - the Lord is not far away. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਧੁਨਿ ਆਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: har aape sabad surat dhun aape |
English: The Lord Himself is the Word of the Shabad. He Himself is the awareness, attuned to its music.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਆਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: har aape vekhai vigasai aape |
English: The Lord Himself beholds, and He Himself blossoms forth.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਜਪਾਇ ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har aap japaae aape har jaape |2|
English: The Lord Himself chants, and the Lord Himself inspires others to chant. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸਾਰਿੰਗ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਧਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har aape saaring amritadhaaraa |
English: He Himself is the rainbird, and the Ambrosial Nectar raining down.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਆਪਿ ਪੀਆਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har amrit aap peeaavanahaaraa |
English: The Lord is the Ambrosial Nectar; He Himself leads us to drink it in.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har aap kare aape nisataaraa |3|
English: The Lord Himself is the Doer; He Himself is our Saving Grace. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਬੇੜੀ ਤੁਲਹਾ ਤਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har aape berree tulahaa taaraa |
English: The Lord Himself is the Boat, the Raft and the Boatman.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har aape guramatee nisataaraa |
English: The Lord Himself, through the Guru's Teachings, saves us.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਵੈ ਪਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੬॥੪੪॥
Transliteration: har aape naanak paavai paaraa |4|6|44|
English: O Nanak, the Lord Himself carries us across to the other side. ||4||6||44||

[Ang 165 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree bairaagan mahalaa 4 |
English: Gauree Bairaagan, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਾਹੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਧਣੀ ਜੈਸੀ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਸਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਤੈਸੀ ਹਮ ਲੇਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: saahu hamaaraa toon dhanee jaisee toon raas dehi taisee ham lehi |
English: O Master, You are my Banker. I receive only that capital which You give me.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਣੰਜਹ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਜੇ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਦੇਹਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har naam vananjah rang siau je aap deaal hoe dehi |1|
English: I would purchase the Lord's Name with love, if You Yourself, in Your Mercy, would sell it to me. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਕੇ ॥
Transliteration: ham vanajaare raam ke |
English: I am the merchant, the peddler of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਾਵੈ ਦੇ ਰਾਸਿ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har vanaj karaavai de raas re |1| rahaau |
English: I trade in the merchandise and capital of the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਟਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਾਹ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: laahaa har bhagat dhan khattiaa har sache saah man bhaaeaa |
English: I have earned the profit, the wealth of devotional worship of the Lord. I have become pleasing to the Mind of the Lord, the True Banker.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਵਖਰੁ ਲਦਿਆ ਜਮੁ ਜਾਗਾਤੀ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har jap har vakhar ladiaa jam jaagaatee nerr na aaeaa |2|
English: I chant and meditate on the Lord, loading the merchandise of the Lord's Name. The Messenger of Death, the tax collector, does not even approach me. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹੋਰੁ ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਾਪਾਰੀਏ ਅਨੰਤ ਤਰੰਗੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: hor vanaj kareh vaapaaree anant tarangee dukh maaeaa |
English: Those traders who trade in other merchandise, are caught up in the endless waves of the pain of Maya.

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਜੇਹੈ ਵਣਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਇਆ ਫਲੁ ਤੇਹਾ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: oe jehai vanaj har laaeaa fal tehaa tin paaeaa |3|
English: According to the business in which the Lord has placed them, so are the rewards they obtain. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਵਣਜੁ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੇਈ ॥
Transliteration: har har vanaj so jan kare jis kripaal hoe prabh deee |
English: People trade in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, when the God shows His Mercy and bestows it.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਲੇਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੭॥੪੫॥
Transliteration: jan naanak saahu har seviaa fir lekhaa mool na leee |4|1|7|45|
English: Servant Nanak serves the Lord, the Banker; he shall never again be called to render his account. ||4||1||7||45||

[Ang 165 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree bairaagan mahalaa 4 |
English: Gauree Bairaagan, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਜਨਨੀ ਗਰਭੁ ਪਾਲਤੀ ਸੁਤ ਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: jiau jananee garabh paalatee sut kee kar aasaa |
English: The mother nourishes the fetus in the womb, hoping for a son,

Gurbani: ਵਡਾ ਹੋਇ ਧਨੁ ਖਾਟਿ ਦੇਇ ਕਰਿ ਭੋਗ ਬਿਲਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: vaddaa hoe dhan khaatt dee kar bhog bilaasaa |
English: who will grow and earn and give her money to enjoy herself.

Gurbani: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਦਾ ਦੇ ਆਪਿ ਹਥਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tiau har jan preet har raakhadaa de aap hathaasaa |1|
English: In just the same way, the humble servant of the Lord loves the Lord, who extends His Helping Hand to us. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਸਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: mere raam mai moorakh har raakh mere guseea |
English: O my Lord, I am so foolish; save me, O my Lord God!

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਵਡਈਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jan kee upamaa tujheh vaddeea |1| rahaau |
English: Your servant's praise is Your Own Glorious Greatness. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੰਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: mandar ghar aanand har har jas man bhaavai |
English: Those whose minds are pleased by the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, are joyful in the palaces of their own homes.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਰਸ ਮੀਠੇ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਗਹਿ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: sabh ras meetthe mukh lageh jaa har gun gaavai |
English: Their mouths savor all the sweet delicacies when they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ਸਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਇਕੀਹ ਕੁਲੀ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਛਡਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har jan paravaar sadhaar hai ikeeh kulee sabh jagat chhaddaavai |2|
English: The Lord's humble servants are the saviors of their families; they save their families for twenty-one generations - they save the entire world! ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: jo kichh keea so har keea har kee vaddiaaee |
English: Whatever has been done, has been done by the Lord; it is the Glorious Greatness of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂੰ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har jeea tere toon varatadaa har pooj karaaee |
English: O Lord, in Your creatures, You are pervading; You inspire them to worship You.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਲਹਾਇਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਵਰਤਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har bhagat bhanddaar lahaaeidaa aape varataaee |3|
English: The Lord leads us to the treasure of devotional worship; He Himself bestows it. ||3||

Gurbani: ਲਾਲਾ ਹਾਟਿ ਵਿਹਾਝਿਆ ਕਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: laalaa haatt vihaajhiaa kiaa tis chaturaaee |
English: I am a slave, purchased in Your market; what clever tricks do I have?

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਰਾਜਿ ਬਹਾਲੇ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਲਾਮੁ ਘਾਸੀ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਢਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: je raaj bahaale taa har gulaam ghaasee kau har naam kadtaaee |
English: If the Lord were to set me upon a throne, I would still be His slave. If I were a grass-cutter, I would still chant the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੪॥੨॥੮॥੪੬॥
Transliteration: jan naanak har kaa daas hai har kee vaddiaaee |4|2|8|46|
English: Servant Nanak is the slave of the Lord; contemplate the Glorious Greatness of the Lord||4||2||8||46||

[Ang 166 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 4 |
English: Gauree Bairaagan, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਸਾਣੀ ਕਿਰਸਾਣੁ ਕਰੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਜੀਉ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kirasaanee kirasaan kare lochai jeeo laae |
English: The farmers love to work their farms;

Gurbani: ਹਲੁ ਜੋਤੈ ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਪੁਤੁ ਧੀ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: hal jotai udam kare meraa put dhee khaae |
English: they plow and work the fields, so that their sons and daughters may eat.

Gurbani: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tiau har jan har har jap kare har ant chhaddaae |1|
English: In just the same way, the Lord's humble servants chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and in the end, the Lord shall save them. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਕੀਜੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: mai moorakh kee gat keejai mere raam |
English: I am foolish - save me, O my Lord!

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਇ ਹਮ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur satigur sevaa har laae ham kaam |1| rahaau |
English: O Lord, enjoin me to work and serve the Guru, the True Guru. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਲੈ ਤੁਰੇ ਸਉਦਾਗਰੀ ਸਉਦਾਗਰੁ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: lai ture saudaagaree saudaagar dhaavai |
English: The traders buy horses, planning to trade them.

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਖਟੈ ਆਸਾ ਕਰੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਧਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: dhan khattai aasaa karai maaeaa mohu vadhaavai |
English: They hope to earn wealth; their attachment to Maya increases.

Gurbani: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tiau har jan har har bolataa har bol sukh paavai |2|
English: In just the same way, the Lord's humble servants chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; chanting the Lord's Name, they find peace. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬਿਖੁ ਸੰਚੈ ਹਟਵਾਣੀਆ ਬਹਿ ਹਾਟਿ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bikh sanchai hattavaaneea beh haatt kamaae |
English: The shop-keepers collect poison, sitting in their shops, carrying on their business.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹ ਝੂਠੁ ਪਸਾਰਾ ਝੂਠ ਕਾ ਝੂਠੇ ਲਪਟਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: moh jhootth pasaaraa jhootth kaa jhootthe lapattaae |
English: Their love is false, their displays are false, and they are engrossed in falsehood.

Gurbani: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਖਰਚੁ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tiau har jan har dhan sanchiaa har kharach lai jaae |3|
English: In just the same way, the Lord's humble servants gather the wealth of the Lord's Name; they take the Lord's Name as their supplies. ||3||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੂਜੈ ਫਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: eihu maaeaa moh kuttanb hai bhaae doojai faas |
English: This emotional attachment to Maya and family, and the love of duality, is a noose around the neck.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਤਰੈ ਜੋ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: guramatee so jan tarai jo daasan daas |
English: Following the Guru's Teachings, the humble servants are carried across; they become the slaves of the Lord's slaves.

Gurbani: ਜਨਿ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਾਸ ॥੪॥੩॥੯॥੪੭॥
Transliteration: jan naanak naam dhiaaeaa guramukh paragaas |4|3|9|47|
English: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam; the Gurmukh is enlightened. ||4||3||9||47||

[Ang 166 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree bairaagan mahalaa 4 |
English: Gauree Bairaagan, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਿਤ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਲਾਲਚੁ ਕਰੇ ਭਰਮੈ ਭਰਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: nit dinas raat laalach kare bharamai bharamaaeaa |
English: Continuously, day and night, they are gripped by greed and deluded by doubt.

Gurbani: ਵੇਗਾਰਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਵੇਗਾਰੀਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰੁ ਉਠਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: vegaar firai vegaareea sir bhaar utthaaeaa |
English: The slaves labor in slavery, carrying the loads upon their heads.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਜਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਘਰ ਕੈ ਕੰਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jo gur kee jan sevaa kare so ghar kai kam har laaeaa |1|
English: That humble being who serves the Guru is put to work by the Lord in His Home. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਤੋੜਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਘਰ ਕੈ ਕੰਮਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: mere raam torr bandhan maaeaa ghar kai kam laae |
English: O my Lord, please break these bonds of Maya, and put me to work in Your Home.

Gurbani: ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: nit har gun gaavah har naam samaae |1| rahaau |
English: I continuously sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; I am absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਕਰੇ ਨਰਪਤਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਅਰਥਿ ਸਭ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: nar praanee chaakaree kare narapat raaje arath sabh maaeaa |
English: Mortal men work for kings, all for the sake of wealth and Maya.

Gurbani: ਕੈ ਬੰਧੈ ਕੈ ਡਾਨਿ ਲੇਇ ਕੈ ਨਰਪਤਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kai bandhai kai ddaan lee kai narapat mar jaaeaa |
English: But the king either imprisons them, or fines them, or else dies himself.

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਫਲ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan sevaa safal satiguroo kee jit har har naam jap har sukh paaeaa |2|
English: Blessed, rewarding and fruitful is the service of the True Guru; through it, I chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and I have found peace. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਿਤ ਸਉਦਾ ਸੂਦੁ ਕੀਚੈ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: nit saudaa sood keechai bahu bhaat kar maaeaa kai taaee |
English: Everyday, people carry on their business, with all sorts of devices to earn interest, for the sake of Maya.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਲਾਹਾ ਦੇਇ ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਨੇ ਤੋਟੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jaa laahaa dee taa sukh mane tottai mar jaaee |
English: If they earn a profit, they are pleased, but their hearts are broken by losses.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਝੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jo gun saajhee gur siau kare nit nit sukh paaee |3|
English: One who is worthy, becomes a partner with the Guru, and finds a lasting peace forever. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਤਨੀ ਭੂਖ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਸਾਦ ਹੈ ਤਿਤਨੀ ਭੂਖ ਫਿਰਿ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: jitanee bhookh an ras saad hai titanee bhookh fir laagai |
English: The more one feels hunger for other tastes and pleasures, the more this hunger persists.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਵੇਚੇ ਸਿਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: jis har aap kripaa kare so veche sir gur aagai |
English: Those unto whom the Lord Himself shows mercy, sell their head to the Guru.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੦॥੪੮॥
Transliteration: jan naanak har ras tripatiaa fir bhookh na laagai |4|4|10|48|
English: Servant Nanak is satisfied by the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. He shall never feel hungry again. ||4||4||10||48||

[Ang 167 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree bairaagan mahalaa 4 |
English: Gauree Bairaagan, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਮਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਸ ਨਿਤ ਕਿਉ ਦੇਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: hamarai man chit har aas nit kiau dekhaa har daras tumaaraa |
English: Within my conscious mind is the constant longing for the Lord. How can I behold the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, Lord?

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਈ ਸੋ ਜਾਣਤਾ ਹਮਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jin preet laaee so jaanataa hamarai man chit har bahut piaaraa |
English: One who loves the Lord knows this; the Lord is very dear to my conscious mind.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਮੇਲਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: hau kurabaanee gur aapane jin vichhurriaa meliaa meraa sirajanahaaraa |1|
English: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, who has re-united me with my Creator Lord; I was separated from Him for such a long time! ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: mere raam ham paapee saran pare har duaar |
English: O my Lord, I am a sinner; I have come to Your Sanctuary, and fallen at Your Door, Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਤੁ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਹਮ ਮੇਲੈ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mat niragun ham melai kabahoon apunee kirapaa dhaar |1| rahaau |
English: My intellect is worthless; I am filthy and polluted. Please shower me with Your Mercy sometime. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਮਰੇ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਹੈ ਬਹੁ ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ਹਰਿ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: hamare avagun bahut bahut hai bahu baar baar har ganat na aavai |
English: My demerits are so many and numerous. I have sinned so many times, over and over again. O Lord, they cannot be counted.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਗੁਣਵੰਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: toon gunavantaa har har deaal har aape bakhas laihi har bhaavai |
English: You, Lord, are the Merciful Treasure of Virtue. When it pleases You, Lord, You forgive me.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਰਾਖੇ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਦੀਓ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਛਡਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ham aparaadhee raakhe gur sangatee upades deeo har naam chhaddaavai |2|
English: I am a sinner, saved only by the Company of the Guru. He has bestowed the Teachings of the Lord's Name, which saves me. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਾ ਜਬ ਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਲਹ ਤਬ ਬਿਸਮੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: tumare gun kiaa kahaa mere satiguraa jab gur bolah tab bisam hoe jaae |
English: What Glorious Virtues of Yours can I describe, O my True Guru? When the Guru speaks, I am transfixed with wonder.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਜੈਸੇ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਅਵਰੁ ਕੋਈ ਰਾਖੈ ਜੈਸੇ ਹਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਛਡਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: ham jaise aparaadhee avar koee raakhai jaise ham satigur raakh lee chhaddaae |
English: Can anyone else save a sinner like me? The True Guru has protected and saved me.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਾਤਾ ਤੂੰ ਗੁਰੁ ਬੰਧਪੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਖਾ ਸਖਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: toon gur pitaa toonhai gur maataa toon gur bandhap meraa sakhaa sakhaae |3|
English: O Guru, You are my father. O Guru, You are my mother. O Guru, You are my relative, companion and friend. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਹਮਰੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਹੋਤੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਾ ਸਾ ਬਿਧਿ ਤੁਮ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਆਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: jo hamaree bidh hotee mere satiguraa saa bidh tum har jaanahu aape |
English: My condition, O my True Guru - that condition, O Lord, is known only to You.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਰੁਲਤੇ ਫਿਰਤੇ ਕੋਈ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਪੂਛਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਕੀਰੇ ਹਮ ਥਾਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: ham rulate firate koee baat na poochhataa gur satigur sang keere ham thaape |
English: I was rolling around in the dirt, and no one cared for me at all. In the Company of the Guru, the True Guru, I, the worm, have been raised up and exalted.

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਕੇਰਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਚੂਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪੇ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੧॥੪੯॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan guroo naanak jan keraa jit miliai chooke sabh sog santaape |4|5|11|49|
English: Blessed, blessed is the Guru of servant Nanak; meeting Him, all my sorrows and troubles have come to an end. ||4||5||11||49||

[Ang 167 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree bairaagan mahalaa 4 |
English: Gauree Bairaagan, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕੰਚਨ ਨਾਰੀ ਮਹਿ ਜੀਉ ਲੁਭਤੁ ਹੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kanchan naaree meh jeeo lubhat hai mohu meetthaa maaeaa |
English: The soul of the man is lured by gold and women; emotional attachment to Maya is so sweet to him.

Gurbani: ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਘੋੜੇ ਖੁਸੀ ਮਨੁ ਅਨ ਰਸਿ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: ghar mandar ghorre khusee man an ras laaeaa |
English: The mind has become attached to the pleasures of houses, palaces, horses and other enjoyments.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਕਿਉ ਛੂਟਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har prabh chit na aavee kiau chhoottaa mere har raaeaa |1|
English: The Lord God does not even enter his thoughts; how can he be saved, O my Lord King? ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਇਹ ਨੀਚ ਕਰਮ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: mere raam ih neech karam har mere |
English: O my Lord, these are my lowly actions, O my Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣਵੰਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਬਖਸਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਸਭਿ ਮੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gunavantaa har har deaal kar kirapaa bakhas avagan sabh mere |1| rahaau |
English: O Lord, Har, Har, Treasure of Virtue, Merciful Lord: please bless me with Your Grace and forgive me for all my mistakes. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਿਛੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਢੰਗੁ ਨ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kichh roop nahee kichh jaat naahee kichh dtang na meraa |
English: I have no beauty, no social status, no manners.

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਲੈ ਬੋਲਹ ਗੁਣ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿਆ ਨ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa muhu lai bolah gun bihoon naam japiaa na teraa |
English: With what face am I to speak? I have no virtue at all; I have not chanted Your Name.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਗੁਰ ਉਬਰੇ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ham paapee sang gur ubare pun satigur keraa |2|
English: I am a sinner, saved only by the Company of the Guru. This is the generous blessing of the True Guru. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਨਕੁ ਦੀਆ ਵਰਤਣ ਕਉ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: sabh jeeo pindd mukh nak deea varatan kau paanee |
English: He gave all beings souls, bodies, mouths, noses and water to drink.

Gurbani: ਅੰਨੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਕਪੜੁ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਦੀਆ ਰਸ ਅਨਿ ਭੋਗਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: an khaanaa kaparr painan deea ras an bhogaanee |
English: He gave them corn to eat, clothes to wear, and other pleasures to enjoy.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਏ ਸੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਪਸੂ ਹਉ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jin dee su chit na aavee pasoo hau kar jaanee |3|
English: But they do not remember the One who gave them all this. The animals think that they made themselves! ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਤੂੰ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: sabh keetaa teraa varatadaa toon antarajaamee |
English: You made them all; You are all-pervading. You are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹ ਸਭੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਤੁਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: ham jant vichaare kiaa karah sabh khel tum suaamee |
English: What can these wretched creatures do? This whole drama is Yours, O Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਾਟਿ ਵਿਹਾਝਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਲਮ ਗੁਲਾਮੀ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੨॥੫੦॥
Transliteration: jan naanak haatt vihaajhiaa har gulam gulaamee |4|6|12|50|
English: Servant Nanak was purchased in the slave-market. He is the slave of the Lord's slaves. ||4||6||12||50||

[Ang 168 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree bairaagan mahalaa 4 |
English: Gauree Bairaagan, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਜਨਨੀ ਸੁਤੁ ਜਣਿ ਪਾਲਤੀ ਰਾਖੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਮਝਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jiau jananee sut jan paalatee raakhai nadar majhaar |
English: Just as the mother, having given birth to a son, feeds him and keeps him in her vision

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੇ ਗਿਰਾਸੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਪੋਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: antar baahar mukh de giraas khin khin pochaar |
English: - indoors and outdoors, she puts food in his mouth; each and every moment, she caresses him.

Gurbani: ਤਿਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਰਾਖਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tiau satigur gurasikh raakhataa har preet piaar |1|
English: In just the same way, the True Guru protects His GurSikhs, who love their Beloved Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਹੈ ਇਆਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: mere raam ham baarik har prabh ke hai eaane |
English: O my Lord, we are just the ignorant children of our Lord God.

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਧਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਦੇ ਕੀਏ ਸਿਆਣੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan guroo gur satigur paadhaa jin har upades de kee siaane |1| rahaau |
English: Hail, hail, to the Guru, the Guru, the True Guru, the Divine Teacher who has made me wise through the Lord's Teachings. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੀ ਗਗਨਿ ਫਿਰੰਤੀ ਊਡਤੀ ਕਪਰੇ ਬਾਗੇ ਵਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: jaisee gagan firantee aooddatee kapare baage vaalee |
English: The white flamingo circles through the sky,

Gurbani: ਓਹ ਰਾਖੈ ਚੀਤੁ ਪੀਛੈ ਬਿਚਿ ਬਚਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: oeh raakhai cheet peechhai bich bachare nit hiradai saar samaalee |
English: but she keeps her young ones in her mind; she has left them behind, but she constantly remembers them in her heart.

Gurbani: ਤਿਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਰਖੈ ਜੀਅ ਨਾਲੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tiau satigur sikh preet har har kee gur sikh rakhai jeea naalee |2|
English: In just the same way, the True Guru loves His Sikhs. The Lord cherishes His GurSikhs, and keeps them clasped to His Heart. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੇ ਕਾਤੀ ਤੀਸ ਬਤੀਸ ਹੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਰਸਨਾ ਮਾਸ ਰਤੁ ਕੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jaise kaatee tees batees hai vich raakhai rasanaa maas rat keree |
English: Just as the tongue, made of flesh and blood, is protected within the scissors of the thirty-two teeth

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਮਾਸ ਕਾਤੀ ਕੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਹਾਥਿ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: koee jaanahu maas kaatee kai kichh haath hai sabh vasagat hai har keree |
English: who thinks that the power lies in the flesh or the scissors? Everything is in the Power of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਿਉ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਨਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਪੈਜ ਜਨ ਕੇਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tiau sant janaa kee nar nindaa kareh har raakhai paij jan keree |3|
English: In just the same way, when someone slanders the Saint, the Lord preserves the honor of His servant. ||3||

Gurbani: ਭਾਈ ਮਤ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਕਿਸੀ ਕੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਹਾਥਿ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bhaaee mat koee jaanahu kisee kai kichh haath hai sabh kare karaaeaa |
English: O Siblings of Destiny, let none think that they have any power. All act as the Lord causes them to act.

Gurbani: ਜਰਾ ਮਰਾ ਤਾਪੁ ਸਿਰਤਿ ਸਾਪੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਲਾਗਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jaraa maraa taap sirat saap sabh har kai vas hai koee laag na sakai bin har kaa laaeaa |
English: Old age, death, fever, poisons and snakes - everything is in the Hands of the Lord. Nothing can touch anyone without the Lord's Order.

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਨਿਤਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਅੰਤੀ ਅਉਸਰਿ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੩॥੫੧॥
Transliteration: aisaa har naam man chit nit dhiaavahu jan naanak jo antee aausar le chhaddaaeaa |4|7|13|51|
English: Within your conscious mind, O servant Nanak, meditate forever on the Name of the Lord, who shall deliver you in the end. ||4||7||13||51||

[Ang 168 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree bairaagan mahalaa 4 |
English: Gauree Bairaagan, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: jis miliai man hoe anand so satigur kaheeai |
English: Meeting Him, the mind is filled with bliss. He is called the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: man kee dubidhaa binas jaae har param pad laheeai |1|
English: Double-mindedness departs, and the supreme status of the Lord is obtained. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: meraa satigur piaaraa kit bidh milai |
English: How can I meet my Beloved True Guru?

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਕਰੀ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਿਉ ਮਿਲੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hau khin khin karee namasakaar meraa gur pooraa kiau milai |1| rahaau |
English: Each and every moment, I humbly bow to Him. How will I meet my Perfect Guru? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa har meliaa meraa satigur pooraa |
English: Granting His Grace, the Lord has led me to meet my Perfect True Guru.

Gurbani: ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਜਨ ਕੇਰੀਆ ਲੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਧੂਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: eichh punee jan kereea le satigur dhooraa |2|
English: The desire of His humble servant has been fulfilled. I have received the dust of the Feet of the True Guru. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੁਣੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: har bhagat drirraavai har bhagat sunai tis satigur mileeai |
English: Those who meet the True Guru implant devotional worship to the Lord, and listen to this devotional worship of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਤੋਟਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਭੁ ਨਿਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੀਐ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tottaa mool na aavee har laabh nit drirreeai |3|
English: They never suffer any loss; they continually earn the profit of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਿਗਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jis kau ridai vigaas hai bhaau doojaa naahee |
English: One whose heart blossoms forth, is not in love with duality.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਉਧਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾਹੀ ॥੪॥੮॥੧੪॥੫੨॥
Transliteration: naanak tis gur mil udharai har gun gaavaahee |4|8|14|52|
English: O Nanak, meeting the Guru, one is saved, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||8||14||52||

[Ang 168 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 4 gaurree poorabee |
English: Fourth Mehl, Gauree Poorbee:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆਲਿ ਦਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: har deaal deaa prabh keenee merai man tan mukh har bolee |
English: The Merciful Lord God showered me with His Mercy; with mind and body and mouth, I chant the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਭਇਆ ਅਤਿ ਗੂੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਭੀਨੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਚੋਲੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: guramukh rang bheaa at goorraa har rang bheenee meree cholee |1|
English: As Gurmukh, I have been dyed in the deep and lasting color of the Lord's Love. The robe of my body is drenched with His Love. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਹਉ ਗੋਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: apune har prabh kee hau golee |
English: I am the maid-servant of my Lord God.

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੋ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਗੋਲ ਅਮੋਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jab ham har setee man maaniaa kar deeno jagat sabh gol amolee |1| rahaau |
English: When my mind surrendered to the Lord, He made all the world my slave. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਰਹੁ ਬਿਬੇਕੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ ਖੋਜਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦੇਖਿ ਢੰਢੋਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: karahu bibek sant jan bhaaee khoj hiradai dekh dtandtolee |
English: Consider this well, O Saints, O Siblings of Destiny - search your own hearts, seek and find Him there.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਸਭ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੋਲੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har har roop sabh jot sabaaee har nikatt vasai har kolee |2|
English: The Beauty and the Light of the Lord, Har, Har, is present in all. In all places, the Lord dwells near by, close at hand. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਭ ਜਗ ਕੈ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਤੋਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: har har nikatt vasai sabh jag kai aparanpar purakh atolee |
English: The Lord, Har, Har, dwells close by, all over the world. He is Infinite, All-powerful and Immeasurable.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਕੀਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਿਰੁ ਵੇਚਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਮੋਲੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har har pragatt keeo gur poorai sir vechio gur peh molee |3|
English: The Perfect Guru has revealed the Lord, Har, Har, to me. I have sold my head to the Guru. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਤੁਮ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਤੁਮ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ ਵਡੋਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: har jee antar baahar tum saranaagat tum vadd purakh vaddolee |
English: O Dear Lord, inside and outside, I am in the protection of Your Sanctuary; You are the Greatest of the Great, All-powerful Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗੁਰ ਵੇਚੋਲੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੫॥੫੩॥
Transliteration: jan naanak anadin har gun gaavai mil satigur gur vecholee |4|1|15|53|
English: Servant Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, night and day, meeting the Guru, the True Guru, the Divine Intermediary. ||4||1||15||53||

[Ang 169 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree poorabee mahalaa 4 |
English: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: jagajeevan aparanpar suaamee jagadeesur purakh bidhaate |
English: Life of the World, Infinite Lord and Master, Master of the Universe, All-powerful Architect of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਤੁਮ ਪ੍ਰੇਰਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਤੁ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਹਮ ਜਾਤੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jit maarag tum prerahu suaamee tith maarag ham jaate |1|
English: Whichever way You turn me, O my Lord and Master, that is the way I shall go. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: raam meraa man har setee raate |
English: O Lord, my mind is attuned to the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: satasangat mil raam ras paaeaa har raamai naam samaate |1| rahaau |
English: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I have obtained the sublime essence of the Lord. I am absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਗਿ ਅਵਖਧੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam har har jag avakhadh har har naam har saate |
English: The Lord, Har, Har, and the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is the panacea, the medicine for the world. The Lord, and the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, bring peace and tranquility.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਦੋਖ ਸਭਿ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਤੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tin ke paap dokh sabh binase jo guramat raam ras khaate |2|
English: Those who partake of the Lord's sublime essence, through the Guru's Teachings - their sins and sufferings are all eliminated. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਲਿਖੇ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: jin kau likhat likhe dhur masatak te gur santokh sar naate |
English: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny inscribed on their foreheads, bathe in the pool of contentment of the Guru.

Gurbani: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਈ ਸਭ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਜੋ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: duramat mail gee sabh tin kee jo raam naam rang raate |3|
English: The filth of evil-mindedness is totally washed away, from those who are imbued with the Love of the Lord's Name. ||3||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਤੁਮ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੁਮ ਜੇਵਡ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: raam tum aape aap aap prabh tthaakur tum jevadd avar na daate |
English: O Lord, You Yourself are Your Own Master, O God. There is no other Giver as Great as You.

Gurbani: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਏ ਤਾਂ ਜੀਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੬॥੫੪॥
Transliteration: jan naanak naam le taan jeevai har japeeai har kirapaa te |4|2|16|54|
English: Servant Nanak lives by the Naam, the Name of the Lord; by the Lord's Mercy, he chants the Lord's Name. ||4||2||16||54||

[Ang 169 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree poorabee mahalaa 4 |
English: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਦਾਤੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਾਚੇ ॥
Transliteration: karahu kripaa jagajeevan daate meraa man har setee raache |
English: Show Mercy to me, O Life of the World, O Great Giver, so that my mind may merge with the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬਚਨੁ ਦੀਓ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਚੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: satigur bachan deeo at niramal jap har har har man maache |1|
English: The True Guru has bestowed His most pure and sacred Teachings. Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, my mind is transfixed and enraptured. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਬੇਧਿ ਲੀਓ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਚੇ ॥
Transliteration: raam meraa man tan bedh leeo har saache |
English: O Lord, my mind and body have been pierced through by the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਕਾਲ ਕੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਗ੍ਰਸਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਮ ਬਾਚੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jih kaal kai mukh jagat sabh grasiaa gur satigur kai bachan har ham baache |1| rahaau |
English: The whole world is caught and held in the mouth of Death. Through the Teachings of the Guru, the True Guru, O Lord, I am saved. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਤੇ ਸਾਕਤ ਮੂੜ ਨਰ ਕਾਚੇ ॥
Transliteration: jin kau preet naahee har setee te saakat moorr nar kaache |
English: Those who are not in love with the Lord are foolish and false - they are faithless cynics.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਜਨਮੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਪਾਚੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tin kau janam maran at bhaaree vich visattaa mar mar paache |2|
English: They suffer the most extreme agonies of birth and death; they die over and over again, and they rot away in manure. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੀਜੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਮ ਜਾਚੇ ॥
Transliteration: tum deaal saran pratipaalak mo kau deejai daan har ham jaache |
English: You are the Merciful Cherisher of those who seek Your Sanctuary. I beg of You: please grant me Your gift, Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸ ਹਮ ਕੀਜੈ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਨਾਚੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har ke daas daas ham keejai man nirat kare kar naache |3|
English: Make me the slave of the Lord's slaves, so that my mind might dance in Your Love. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਹ ਵਡੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ਹਹਿ ਤਾ ਚੇ ॥
Transliteration: aape saah vadde prabh suaamee ham vanajaare heh taa che |
English: He Himself is the Great Banker; God is our Lord and Master. I am His petty merchant.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਜੀਉ ਰਾਸਿ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਸਾਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਚੇ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੭॥੫੫॥
Transliteration: meraa man tan jeeo raas sabh teree jan naanak ke saah prabh saache |4|3|17|55|
English: My mind, body and soul are all Your capital assets. You, O God, are the True Banker of servant Nanak. ||4||3||17||55||

[Ang 169 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree poorabee mahalaa 4 |
English: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਰਬ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਇਕ ਬਿਨਉ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਦੇ ਕਾਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: tum deaal sarab dukh bhanjan ik binau sunahu de kaane |
English: You are Merciful, the Destroyer of all pain. Please give me Your Ear and listen to my prayer.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਤੁਮ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਨੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jis te tum har jaane suaamee so satigur mel meraa praane |1|
English: Please unite me with the True Guru, my breath of life; through Him, O my Lord and Master, You are known. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਹਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: raam ham satigur paarabraham kar maane |
English: O Lord, I acknowledge the True Guru as the Supreme Lord God.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ ਅਸੁਧ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਮ ਜਾਨੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ham moorr mugadh asudh mat hote gur satigur kai bachan har ham jaane |1| rahaau |
English: I am foolish and ignorant, and my intellect is impure. Through the Teachings of the Guru, the True Guru, O Lord, I come to know You. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਤਨੇ ਰਸ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਹਮ ਦੇਖੇ ਸਭ ਤਿਤਨੇ ਫੀਕ ਫੀਕਾਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: jitane ras an ras ham dekhe sabh titane feek feekaane |
English: All the pleasures and enjoyments which I have seen - I have found them all to be bland and insipid.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੀਠ ਰਸ ਗਾਨੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam amrit ras chaakhiaa mil satigur meetth ras gaane |2|
English: I have tasted the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, by meeting the True Guru. It is sweet, like the juice of the sugarcane. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਤੇ ਸਾਕਤ ਮੂੜ ਦਿਵਾਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: jin kau gur satigur nahee bhettiaa te saakat moorr divaane |
English: Those who have not met the Guru, the True Guru, are foolish and insane - they are faithless cynics.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਕਰਮਹੀਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਪਾਏ ਦੇਖਿ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਪਚਾਨੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tin ke karamaheen dhur paae dekh deepak mohi pachaane |3|
English: Those who were pre-ordained to have no good karma at all - gazing into the lamp of emotional attachment, they are burnt, like moths in a flame. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵ ਲਗਾਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: jin kau tum deaa kar melahu te har har sev lagaane |
English: Those whom You, in Your Mercy, have met, Lord, are committed to Your Service.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਨੇ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੮॥੫੬॥
Transliteration: jan naanak har har har jap pragatte mat guramat naam samaane |4|4|18|56|
English: Servant Nanak chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har. He is famous, and through the Guru's Teachings, He merges in the Name. ||4||4||18||56||

[Ang 170 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree poorabee mahalaa 4 |
English: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਹੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਥੈ ਹਰਿ ਪਹੁ ਨਸੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: mere man so prabh sadaa naal hai suaamee kahu kithai har pahu naseeai |
English: O my mind, God is always with you; He is your Lord and Master. Tell me, where could you run to get away from the Lord?

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਛਡਾਏ ਛੁਟੀਐ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har aape bakhas le prabh saachaa har aap chhaddaae chhutteeai |1|
English: The True Lord God Himself grants forgiveness; we are emancipated only when the Lord Himself emancipates us. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਜਪੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: mere man jap har har har man japeeai |
English: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har - chant it in your mind.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਭਜਿ ਪਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੀਛੈ ਛੁਟੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur kee saranaaee bhaj pau mere manaa gur satigur peechhai chhutteeai |1| rahaau |
English: Quickly now, run to the Sanctuary of the True Guru, O my mind; following the Guru, the True Guru, you shall be saved. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: mere man sevahu so prabh srab sukhadaataa jit seviai nij ghar vaseeai |
English: O my mind, serve God, the Giver of all peace; serving Him, you shall come to dwell in your own home deep within.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਇ ਲਹਹੁ ਘਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਘਸਿ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਘਸੀਐ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: guramukh jaae lahahu ghar apanaa ghas chandan har jas ghaseeai |2|
English: As Gurmukh, go and enter your own home; anoint yourself with the sandalwood oil of the Lord's Praises. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਊਤਮੁ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਹਸੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: mere man har har har har har jas aootam lai laahaa har man haseeai |
English: O my mind, the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har, Har, are exalted and sublime. Earn the profit of the Lord's Name, and let your mind be happy.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਖੀਐ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har har aap deaa kar devai taa amrit har ras chakheeai |3|
English: If the Lord, Har, Har, in His Mercy, bestows it, then we partake of the ambrosial essence of the Lord's Name. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਜੋ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਗੇ ਤੇ ਸਾਕਤ ਨਰ ਜਮਿ ਘੁਟੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: mere man naam binaa jo doojai laage te saakat nar jam ghutteeai |
English: O my mind, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and attached to duality, those faithless cynics are strangled by the Messenger of Death.

Gurbani: ਤੇ ਸਾਕਤ ਚੋਰ ਜਿਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਮਨ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਭਿਟੀਐ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: te saakat chor jinaa naam visaariaa man tin kai nikatt na bhitteeai |4|
English: Such faithless cynics, who have forgotten the Naam, are thieves. O my mind, do not even go near them. ||4||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਅਲਖ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਨਰਹਰਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਲੇਖਾ ਛੁਟੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: mere man sevahu alakh niranjan narahar jit seviai lekhaa chhutteeai |
English: O my mind, serve the Unknowable and Immaculate Lord, the Man-lion; serving Him, your account will be cleared.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀਏ ਖਿਨੁ ਮਾਸਾ ਤੋਲੁ ਨ ਘਟੀਐ ॥੫॥੫॥੧੯॥੫੭॥
Transliteration: jan naanak har prabh poore kee khin maasaa tol na ghatteeai |5|5|19|57|
English: The Lord God has made servant Nanak perfect; he is not diminished by even the tiniest particle. ||5||5||19||57||

[Ang 170 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree poorabee mahalaa 4 |
English: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਮਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਰੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: hamare praan vasagat prabh tumarai meraa jeeo pindd sabh teree |
English: My breath of life is in Your Power, God; my soul and body are totally Yours.

Gurbani: ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਲੋਚ ਘਣੇਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: deaa karahu har daras dikhaavahu merai man tan loch ghaneree |1|
English: Be merciful to me, and show me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. There is such a great longing within my mind and body! ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਲੋਚ ਮਿਲਣ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: raam merai man tan loch milan har keree |
English: O my Lord, there is such a great longing within my mind and body to meet the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਿੰਚਤ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur kripaal kripaa kinchat gur keenee har miliaa aae prabh meree |1| rahaau |
English: When the Guru, the Merciful Guru, showed just a little mercy to me, my Lord God came and met me. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਹਮਰੈ ਮਨ ਚਿਤਿ ਹੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਾ ਬਿਧਿ ਤੁਮ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jo hamarai man chit hai suaamee saa bidh tum har jaanahu meree |
English: Whatever is in my conscious mind, O Lord and Master - that condition of mine is known only to You, Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ਨਿਤ ਜੀਵਾ ਆਸ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: anadin naam japee sukh paaee nit jeevaa aas har teree |2|
English: Night and day, I chant Your Name, and I find peace. I live by placing my hopes in You, Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਾਤੈ ਪੰਥੁ ਬਤਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur satigur daatai panth bataaeaa har miliaa aae prabh meree |
English: The Guru, the True Guru, the Giver, has shown me the Way; my Lord God came and met me.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸਭ ਆਸ ਪੁਜੀ ਜਨ ਕੇਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: anadin anad bheaa vaddabhaagee sabh aas pujee jan keree |3|
English: Night and day, I am filled with bliss; by great good fortune, all of the hopes of His humble servant have been fulfilled. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਗੰਨਾਥ ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰ ਕਰਤੇ ਸਭ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jaganaath jagadeesur karate sabh vasagat hai har keree |
English: O Lord of the World, Master of the Universe, everything is under Your control.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਆਏ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਪੈਜ ਜਨ ਕੇਰੀ ॥੪॥੬॥੨੦॥੫੮॥
Transliteration: jan naanak saranaagat aae har raakhahu paij jan keree |4|6|20|58|
English: Servant Nanak has come to Your Sanctuary, Lord; please, preserve the honor of Your humble servant. ||4||6||20||58||

[Ang 170 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree poorabee mahalaa 4 |
English: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਖਿਨੁ ਨ ਟਿਕੈ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ਦਹ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਚਲਿ ਚਲਿ ਹਾਢੇ ॥
Transliteration: eihu manooaa khin na ttikai bahu rangee deh deh dis chal chal haadte |
English: This mind does not hold still, even for an instant. Distracted by all sorts of distractions, it wanders around aimlessly in the ten directions.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦੀਆ ਮਨੁ ਠਾਢੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur pooraa paaeaa vaddabhaagee har mantru deea man tthaadte |1|
English: I have found the Perfect Guru, through great good fortune; He has given me the Mantra of the Lord's Name, and my mind has become quiet and tranquil. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਹਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਲਾਲੇ ਕਾਂਢੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raam ham satigur laale kaandte |1| rahaau |
English: O Lord, I am the slave of the True Guru. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਮਰੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਦਾਗੁ ਦਗਾਨਾ ਹਮ ਕਰਜ ਗੁਰੂ ਬਹੁ ਸਾਢੇ ॥
Transliteration: hamarai masatak daag dagaanaa ham karaj guroo bahu saadte |
English: My forehead has been branded with His brand; I owe such a great debt to the Guru.

Gurbani: ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਆ ਭਉ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਢੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: praupakaar pun bahu keea bhau dutar taar paraadte |2|
English: He has been so generous and kind to me; He has carried me across the treacherous and terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਿਨ ਕੂਰੇ ਗਾਢਨ ਗਾਢੇ ॥
Transliteration: jin kau preet ridai har naahee tin koore gaadtan gaadte |
English: Those who do not have love for the Lord within their hearts, harbor only false intentions and goals.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਪਾਣੀ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ਤਿਉ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਗਰਭਿ ਗਲਾਢੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jiau paanee kaagad binas jaat hai tiau manamukh garabh galaadte |3|
English: As paper breaks down and dissolves in water, the self-willed manmukh wastes away in arrogant pride. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਨਹ ਆਗੈ ਜਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਉ ਠਾਢੇ ॥
Transliteration: ham jaaniaa kachhoo na jaanah aagai jiau har raakhai tiau tthaadte |
English: I know nothing, and I do not know the future; as the Lord keeps me, so do I stand.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਭੂਲ ਚੂਕ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੁਤਰੇ ਕਾਢੇ ॥੪॥੭॥੨੧॥੫੯॥
Transliteration: ham bhool chook gur kirapaa dhaarahu jan naanak kutare kaadte |4|7|21|59|
English: For my failings and mistakes, O Guru, grant me Your Grace; servant Nanak is Your obedient dog. ||4||7||21||59||

[Ang 171 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree poorabee mahalaa 4 |
English: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਾਮਿ ਕਰੋਧਿ ਨਗਰੁ ਬਹੁ ਭਰਿਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਖੰਡਲ ਖੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: kaam karodh nagar bahu bhariaa mil saadhoo khanddal khanddaa he |
English: The body-village is filled to overflowing with sexual desire and anger, which were broken into bits when I met with the Holy Saint.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਤ ਲਿਖੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਮੰਡਲ ਮੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: poorab likhat likhe gur paaeaa man har liv manddal manddaa he |1|
English: By pre-ordained destiny, I have met with the Guru. I have entered into the realm of the Lord's Love. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਅੰਜੁਲੀ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਵਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: kar saadhoo anjulee pun vaddaa he |
English: Greet the Holy Saint with your palms pressed together; this is an act of great merit.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਡੰਡਉਤ ਪੁਨੁ ਵਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kar ddanddaut pun vaddaa he |1| rahaau |
English: Bow down before Him; this is a virtuous action indeed. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਕੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: saakat har ras saad na jaaniaa tin antar haumai kanddaa he |
English: The wicked shaaktas, the faithless cynics, do not know the taste of the Lord's sublime essence. The thorn of egotism is embedded deep within them.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਚਲਹਿ ਚੁਭੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਸਹਹਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਡੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jiau jiau chaleh chubhai dukh paaveh jamakaal saheh sir ddanddaa he |2|
English: The more they walk away, the deeper it sticks into them, and the more they suffer in pain, until finally, the Messenger of Death smashes his club against their heads. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭਵ ਖੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: har jan har har naam samaane dukh janam maran bhav khanddaa he |
English: The humble servants of the Lord are absorbed in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. The pain of birth and the fear of death are eradicated.

Gurbani: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਬਹੁ ਸੋਭ ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: abinaasee purakh paaeaa paramesar bahu sobh khandd brahamanddaa he |3|
English: They have obtained the Imperishable Supreme Being, the Transcendent Lord God, and they obtain great honor throughout all the worlds and realms. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਗਰੀਬ ਮਸਕੀਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਵਡ ਵਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: ham gareeb masakeen prabh tere har raakh raakh vadd vaddaa he |
English: I am poor and meek, God, but I am Yours! Save me, please save me, O Greatest of the Great!

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਮੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥੮॥੨੨॥੬੦॥
Transliteration: jan naanak naam adhaar ttek hai har naame hee sukh manddaa he |4|8|22|60|
English: Servant Nanak takes the Sustenance and Support of the Naam. In the Name of the Lord, he enjoys celestial peace. ||4||8||22||60||

[Ang 171 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree poorabee mahalaa 4 |
English: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਗੜ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਹੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਧੀਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: eis garr meh har raam raae hai kichh saad na paavai dheetthaa |
English: Within this body-fortress is the Lord, the Sovereign Lord King, but the stubborn ones do not find the taste.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਕੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਚਖਿ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har deen deaal anugrahu keea har gurasabadee chakh ddeetthaa |1|
English: When the Lord, Merciful to the meek, showed His Mercy, I found and tasted it, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਲਿਵ ਮੀਠਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raam har keeratan gur liv meetthaa |1| rahaau |
English: Lovingly focused upon the Guru, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise has become sweet to me. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਲਾਗਿ ਬਸੀਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: har agam agochar paarabraham hai mil satigur laag baseetthaa |
English: The Lord, the Supreme Lord God, is Inaccessible and Unfathomable. Those who are committed to the True Guru, the Divine Intermediary, meet the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਸੁਖਾਨੇ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਤਿਨ ਆਗੈ ਆਣਿ ਪਰੀਠਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jin gur bachan sukhaane heearai tin aagai aan pareetthaa |2|
English: Those whose hearts are pleased with the Guru's Teachings - the Lord's Presence is revealed to them. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਹੀਅਰਾ ਅਤਿ ਕਠੋਰੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਰੀਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh heearaa at katthor hai tin antar kaar kareetthaa |
English: The hearts of the self-willed manmukhs are hard and cruel; their inner beings are dark.

Gurbani: ਬਿਸੀਅਰ ਕਉ ਬਹੁ ਦੂਧੁ ਪੀਆਈਐ ਬਿਖੁ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਫੋਲਿ ਫੁਲੀਠਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: biseear kau bahu doodh peeaeeai bikh nikasai fol fuleetthaa |3|
English: Even if the poisonous snake is fed large amounts of milk, it will still yield only poison. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਨਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਘਸਿ ਗਰੁੜੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਲੀਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: har prabh aan milaavahu gur saadhoo ghas garurr sabad mukh leetthaa |
English: O Lord God, please unite me with the Holy Guru, so that I might joyfully grind and eat the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਲਾਲੇ ਗੋਲੇ ਲਗਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰੂਆ ਮੀਠਾ ॥੪॥੯॥੨੩॥੬੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak gur ke laale gole lag sangat karooaa meetthaa |4|9|23|61|
English: Servant Nanak is the slave of the Guru; in the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, the bitter becomes sweet. ||4||9||23||61||

[Ang 171 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree poorabee mahalaa 4 |
English: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਰਥਿ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹਮ ਬੇਚਿਆ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਆਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: har har arath sareer ham bechiaa poore gur kai aage |
English: For the sake of the Lord, Har, Har, I have sold my body to the Perfect Guru.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਾਤੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗ ਸਭਾਗੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: satigur daatai naam dirraaeaa mukh masatak bhaag sabhaage |1|
English: The True Guru, the Giver, has implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me. A very blessed and fortunate destiny is recorded upon my forehead. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raam guramat har liv laage |1| rahaau |
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, I am lovingly centered on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਮਈਆ ਰਮਤ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt rameea ramat raam raae gur sabad guroo liv laage |
English: The All-pervading Sovereign Lord King is contained in each and every heart. Through the Guru, and the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I am lovingly centered on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਦੇਵਉ ਕਾਟਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਉ ਮੇਰਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਭਾਗੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: hau man tan devau kaatt guroo kau meraa bhram bhau gur bachanee bhaage |2|
English: Cutting my mind and body into pieces, I offer them to my Guru. The Guru's Teachings have dispelled my doubt and fear. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅੰਧਿਆਰੈ ਦੀਪਕ ਆਨਿ ਜਲਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: andhiaarai deepak aan jalaae gur giaan guroo liv laage |
English: In the darkness, the Guru has lit the lamp of the Guru's wisdom; I am lovingly focused on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਬਿਨਾਸਿਓ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਲਹੀ ਮਨ ਜਾਗੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: agiaan andheraa binas binaasio ghar vasat lahee man jaage |3|
English: The darkness of ignorance has been dispelled, and my mind has been awakened; within the home of my inner being, I have found the genuine article. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤ ਬਧਿਕ ਮਾਇਆਧਾਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਜਮ ਜੋਹਨਿ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: saakat badhik maaeaadhaaree tin jam johan laage |
English: The vicious hunters, the faithless cynics, are hunted down by the Messenger of Death.

Gurbani: ਉਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਸੀਸੁ ਨ ਬੇਚਿਆ ਓਇ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਅਭਾਗੇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: aun satigur aagai sees na bechiaa oe aaveh jaeh abhaage |4|
English: They have not sold their heads to the True Guru; those wretched, unfortunate ones continue coming and going in reincarnation. ||4||

Gurbani: ਹਮਰਾ ਬਿਨਉ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਮ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: hamaraa binau sunahu prabh tthaakur ham saran prabhoo har maage |
English: Hear my prayer, O God, my Lord and Master: I beg for the Sanctuary of the Lord God.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਲਜ ਪਾਤਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਸਿਰੁ ਬੇਚਿਓ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਗੇ ॥੫॥੧੦॥੨੪॥੬੨॥
Transliteration: jan naanak kee laj paat guroo hai sir bechio satigur aage |5|10|24|62|
English: Servant Nanak's honor and respect is the Guru; he has sold his head to the True Guru. ||5||10||24||62||

[Ang 172 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree poorabee mahalaa 4 |
English: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: ham ahankaaree ahankaar agiaan mat gur miliai aap gavaaeaa |
English: I am egotistical and conceited, and my intellect is ignorant. Meeting the Guru, my selfishness and conceit have been abolished.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: haumai rog geaa sukh paaeaa dhan dhan guroo har raaeaa |1|
English: The illness of egotism is gone, and I have found peace. Blessed, blessed is the Guru, the Sovereign Lord King. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raam gur kai bachan har paaeaa |1| rahaau |
English: I have found the Lord, through the Teachings of the Guru. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪੰਥੁ ਬਤਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: merai heearai preet raam raae kee gur maarag panth bataaeaa |
English: My heart is filled with love for the Sovereign Lord King; the Guru has shown me the path and the way to find Him.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: meraa jeeo pindd sabh satigur aagai jin vichhurriaa har gal laaeaa |2|
English: My soul and body all belong to the Guru; I was separated, and He has led me into the Lord's Embrace. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਦੇਖਨ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: merai antar preet lagee dekhan kau gur hirade naal dikhaaeaa |
English: Deep within myself, I would love to see the Lord; the Guru has inspired me to see Him within my heart.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਮੋਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਆਪੁ ਵੇਚਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sehaj anand bheaa man morai gur aagai aap vechaaeaa |3|
English: Within my mind, intuitive peace and bliss have arisen; I have sold myself to the Guru. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਅਪਰਾਧ ਪਾਪ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਨੇ ਕਰਿ ਦੁਸਟੀ ਚੋਰ ਚੁਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: ham aparaadh paap bahu keene kar dusattee chor churaaeaa |
English: I am a sinner - I have committed so many sins; I am a villainous, thieving thief.

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਆਏ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਲਾਜ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੨੫॥੬੩॥
Transliteration: ab naanak saranaagat aae har raakhahu laaj har bhaaeaa |4|11|25|63|
English: Now, Nanak has come to the Lord's Sanctuary; preserve my honor, Lord, as it pleases Your Will. ||4||11||25||63||

[Ang 172 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree poorabee mahalaa 4 |
English: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਬਾਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਨਾਹਦੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: guramat baajai sabad anaahad guramat manooaa gaavai |
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, the unstruck music resounds; through the Guru's Teachings, the mind sings.

Gurbani: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: vaddabhaagee gur darasan paaeaa dhan dhan guroo liv laavai |1|
English: By great good fortune, I received the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan. Blessed, blessed is the Guru, who has led me to love the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh har liv laavai |1| rahaau |
English: The Gurmukh is lovingly centered on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਮਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: hamaraa tthaakur satigur pooraa man gur kee kaar kamaavai |
English: My Lord and Master is the Perfect True Guru. My mind works to serve the Guru.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਧੋਵਹ ਪਾਵ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੇ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ham mal mal dhovah paav guroo ke jo har har kathaa sunaavai |2|
English: I massage and wash the Feet of the Guru, who recites the Sermon of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: hiradai guramat raam rasaaein jihavaa har gun gaavai |
English: The Teachings of the Guru are in my heart; the Lord is the Source of nectar. My tongue sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਆਘਾਨੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਭੂਖ ਲਗਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: man rasak rasak har ras aaghaane fir bahur na bhookh lagaavai |3|
English: My mind is immersed in, and drenched with the Lord's essence. Fulfilled with the Lord's Love, I shall never feel hunger again. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਕਰੈ ਉਪਾਵ ਅਨੇਕ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: koee karai upaav anek bahutere bin kirapaa naam na paavai |
English: People try all sorts of things, but without the Lord's Mercy, His Name is not obtained.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੨੬॥੬੪॥
Transliteration: jan naanak kau har kirapaa dhaaree mat guramat naam drirraavai |4|12|26|64|
English: The Lord has showered His Mercy upon servant Nanak; through the wisdom of the Guru's Teachings, he has enshrined the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||12||26||64||

[Ang 172 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: raag gaurree maajh mahalaa 4 |
English: Raag Gauree Maajh, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿੰਦੂ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰੰਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh jindoo jap naam karamaa |
English: O my soul, as Gurmukh, do this deed: chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਤਿ ਮਾਤਾ ਮਤਿ ਜੀਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: mat maataa mat jeeo naam mukh raamaa |
English: Make that teaching your mother, that it may teach you to keep the Lord's Name in your mouth.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਜਨਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: santokh pitaa kar gur purakh ajanamaa |
English: Let contentment be your father; the Guru is the Primal Being, beyond birth or incarnation.

Gurbani: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮਿਲੁ ਰਾਮਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: vaddabhaagee mil raamaa |1|
English: By great good fortune, you shall meet with the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur jogee purakh miliaa rang maanee jeeo |
English: I have met the Guru, the Yogi, the Primal Being; I am delighted with His Love.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੜਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur har rang ratarraa sadaa nirabaanee jeeo |
English: The Guru is imbued with the Love of the Lord; He dwells forever in Nirvaanaa.

Gurbani: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮਿਲੁ ਸੁਘੜ ਸੁਜਾਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: vaddabhaagee mil sugharr sujaanee jeeo |
English: By great good fortune, I met the most accomplished and all-knowing Lord.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਭਿੰਨਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: meraa man tan har rang bhinaa |2|
English: My mind and body are drenched in the Love of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: aavahu santahu mil naam japaahaa |
English: Come, O Saints - let's meet together and chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਵਿਚਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: vich sangat naam sadaa lai laahaa jeeo |
English: In the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, let's earn the lasting profit of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੰਤਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਹਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: kar sevaa santaa amrit mukh paahaa jeeo |
English: Let's serve the Saints, and drink in the Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲੁ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਅੜੇ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਮਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: mil poorab likhiarre dhur karamaa |3|
English: By one's karma and pre-ordained destiny, they are met. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਾਵਣਿ ਵਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਜਗੁ ਛਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: saavan varas amrit jag chhaaeaa jeeo |
English: In the month of Saawan, the clouds of Ambrosial Nectar hang over the world.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਮੋਰੁ ਕੁਹੁਕਿਅੜਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: man mor kuhukiarraa sabad mukh paaeaa |
English: The peacock of the mind chirps, and receives the Word of the Shabad, in its mouth;

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵੁਠੜਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har amrit vuttharraa miliaa har raaeaa jeeo |
English: the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord rains down, and the Sovereign Lord King is met.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਰਤੰਨਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੨੭॥੬੫॥
Transliteration: jan naanak prem ratanaa |4|1|27|65|
English: Servant Nanak is imbued with the Love of the Lord. ||4||1||27||65||

[Ang 173 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree maajh mahalaa 4 |
English: Gauree Maajh, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਉ ਸਖੀ ਗੁਣ ਕਾਮਣ ਕਰੀਹਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: aau sakhee gun kaaman kareehaa jeeo |
English: Come, O sisters - let's make virtue our charms.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਿਹ ਰਲੀਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: mil sant janaa rang maanih raleea jeeo |
English: Let's join the Saints, and enjoy the pleasure of the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਬਲੀਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur deepak giaan sadaa man baleea jeeo |
English: The lamp of the Guru's spiritual wisdom burns steadily in my mind.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਢੁਲਿ ਢੁਲਿ ਮਿਲੀਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har tutthai dtul dtul mileea jeeo |1|
English: The Lord, being pleased and moved by pity, has led me to meet Him. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਲਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਢੋਲੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: merai man tan prem lagaa har dtole jeeo |
English: My mind and body are filled with love for my Darling Lord.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਵੇਚੋਲੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: mai mele mitru satigur vechole jeeo |
English: The True Guru, the Divine Intermediary, has united me with my Friend.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਦੇਵਾਂ ਸੰਤਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: man devaan santaa meraa prabh mele jeeo |
English: I offer my mind to the Guru, who has led me to meet my God.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਵਿਟੜਿਅਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਘੋਲੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har vittarriahu sadaa ghole jeeo |2|
English: I am forever a sacrifice to the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਵਸੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਵਸੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: vas mere piaariaa vas mere govidaa har kar kirapaa man vas jeeo |
English: Dwell, O my Beloved, dwell, O my Lord of the Universe; O Lord, show mercy to me and come to dwell within my mind.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦਿਅੜਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: man chindiarraa fal paaeaa mere govindaa gur pooraa vekh vigas jeeo |
English: I have obtained the fruits of my mind's desires, O my Lord of the Universe; I am transfixed with ecstasy, gazing upon the Perfect Guru.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਅਨਦੁ ਰਹਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har naam miliaa sohaaganee mere govindaa man anadin anad rehas jeeo |
English: The happy soul-brides receive the Lord's Name, O my Lord of the Universe; night and day, their minds are blissful and happy.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਅੜਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਨਿਤ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ਮਨਿ ਹਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har paaeiarraa vaddabhaageeee mere govindaa nit lai laahaa man has jeeo |3|
English: By great good fortune, the Lord is found, O my Lord of the Universe; earning profit continually, the mind laughs with joy. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har aap upaae har aape vekhai har aape kaarai laaeaa jeeo |
English: The Lord Himself creates, and the Lord Himself beholds; the Lord Himself assigns all to their tasks.

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਖਾਵਹਿ ਬਖਸ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਇਕਨਾ ਫਕਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: eik khaaveh bakhas tott na aavai ikanaa fakaa paaeaa jeeo |
English: Some partake of the bounty of the Lord's favor, which never runs out, while others receive only a handful.

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਤਖਤਿ ਬਹਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਇਕਨਾ ਭਿਖ ਮੰਗਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: eik raaje takhat baheh nit sukhee ikanaa bhikh mangaaeaa jeeo |
English: Some sit upon thrones as kings, and enjoy constant pleasures, while others must beg for charity.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਇਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨॥੨੮॥੬੬॥
Transliteration: sabh iko sabad varatadaa mere govidaa jan naanak naam dhiaaeaa jeeo |4|2|28|66|
English: The Word of the Shabad is pervading in everyone, O my Lord of the Universe; servant Nanak meditates on the Naam. ||4||2||28||66||

[Ang 173 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree maajh mahalaa 4 |
English: Gauree Maajh, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: man maahee man maahee mere govindaa har rang rataa man maahee jeeo |
English: From within my mind, from within my mind, O my Lord of the Universe, I am imbued with the Love of the Lord, from within my mind.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har rang naal na lakheeai mere govidaa gur pooraa alakh lakhaahee jeeo |
English: The Lord's Love is with me, but it cannot be seen, O my Lord of the Universe; the Perfect Guru has led me to see the unseen.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਸਭ ਦਾਲਦ ਦੁਖ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam paragaasiaa mere govindaa sabh daalad dukh leh jaahee jeeo |
English: He has revealed the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my Lord of the Universe; all poverty and pain have departed.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪਦੁ ਊਤਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har pad aootam paaeaa mere govindaa vaddabhaagee naam samaahee jeeo |1|
English: I have obtained the supreme status of the Lord, O my Lord of the Universe; by great good fortune, I am absorbed in the Naam. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨੈਣੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਨੈਣੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ ਕਿਨੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਡਿਠੜਾ ਨੈਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: nainee mere piaariaa nainee mere govidaa kinai har prabh ddittharraa nainee jeeo |
English: With his eyes, O my Beloved, with his eyes, O my Lord of the Universe - has anyone ever seen the Lord God with his eyes?

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬੈਰਾਗਿਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਧਨ ਕੁਮਲੈਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: meraa man tan bahut bairaagiaa mere govindaa har baajhahu dhan kumalainee jeeo |
English: My mind and body are sad and depressed, O my Lord of the Universe; without her Husband Lord, the soul-bride is withering away.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਸੈਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: sant janaa mil paaeaa mere govidaa meraa har prabh sajan sainee jeeo |
English: Meeting the Saints, O my Lord of the Universe, I have found my Lord God, my Companion, my Best Friend.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਇ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਮੈ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ਰੈਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har aae miliaa jagajeevan mere govindaa mai sukh vihaanee rainee jeeo |2|
English: The Lord, the Life of the World, has come to meet me, O my Lord of the Universe. The night of my life now passes in peace. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਭੁਖ ਲਗਾਈਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: mai melahu sant meraa har prabh sajan mai man tan bhukh lagaaeea jeeo |
English: O Saints, unite me with my Lord God, my Best Friend; my mind and body are hungry for Him.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਈਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: hau reh na skau bin dekhe mere preetam mai antar birahu har laaeea jeeo |
English: I cannot survive without seeing my Beloved; deep within, I feel the pain of separation from the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਜਣੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਵਾਈਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har raaeaa meraa sajan piaaraa gur mele meraa man jeevaaeea jeeo |
English: The Sovereign Lord King is my Beloved, my Best Friend. Through the Guru, I have met Him, and my mind has been rejuvenated.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਆਸਾ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਵਾਧਾਈਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: merai man tan aasaa pooreea mere govindaa har miliaa man vaadhaaeea jeeo |3|
English: The hopes of my mind and body have been fulfilled, O my Lord of the Universe; meeting the Lord, my mind vibrates with joy. ||3||

Gurbani: ਵਾਰੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਵਾਰੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਟੜਿਅਹੁ ਸਦ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: vaaree mere govindaa vaaree mere piaariaa hau tudh vittarriahu sad vaaree jeeo |
English: A sacrifice, O my Lord of the Universe, a sacrifice, O my Beloved; I am forever a sacrifice to You.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਪਿਰੰਮ ਕਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਰਾਖੁ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: merai man tan prem piram kaa mere govidaa har poonjee raakh hamaaree jeeo |
English: My mind and body are filled with love for my Husband Lord; O my Lord of the Universe, please preserve my assets.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਵਿਸਟੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਕਰਿ ਰੈਬਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur visatt mel mere govindaa har mele kar raibaaree jeeo |
English: Unite me with the True Guru, Your Advisor, O my Lord of the Universe; through His guidance, He shall lead me to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩॥੨੯॥੬੭॥
Transliteration: har naam deaa kar paaeaa mere govindaa jan naanak saran tumaaree jeeo |4|3|29|67|
English: I have obtained the Lord's Name, by Your Mercy, O my Lord of the Universe; servant Nanak has entered Your Sanctuary. ||4||3||29||67||

[Ang 174 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree maajh mahalaa 4 |
English: Gauree Maajh, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਚੋਜੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਚੋਜੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਚੋਜੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: chojee mere govindaa chojee mere piaariaa har prabh meraa chojee jeeo |
English: Playful is my Lord of the Universe; playful is my Beloved. My Lord God is wondrous and playful.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਨੑੁ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਗੋਪੀ ਖੋਜੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har aape kaanau upaaeidaa mere govidaa har aape gopee khojee jeeo |
English: The Lord Himself created Krishna, O my Lord of the Universe; the Lord Himself is the milkmaids who seek Him.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸਭ ਘਟ ਭੋਗਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਰਸੀਆ ਭੋਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har aape sabh ghatt bhogadaa mere govindaa aape raseea bhogee jeeo |
English: The Lord Himself enjoys every heart, O my Lord of the Universe; He Himself is the Ravisher and the Enjoyer.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਨ ਭੁਲਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har sujaan na bhulee mere govindaa aape satigur jogee jeeo |1|
English: The Lord is All-knowing - He cannot be fooled, O my Lord of the Universe. He is the True Guru, the Yogi. ||1||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਖੇਲੈ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: aape jagat upaaeidaa mere govidaa har aap khelai bahu rangee jeeo |
English: He Himself created the world, O my Lord of the Universe; the Lord Himself plays in so many ways!

Gurbani: ਇਕਨਾ ਭੋਗ ਭੋਗਾਇਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਇਕਿ ਨਗਨ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਨੰਗ ਨੰਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: eikanaa bhog bhogaaeidaa mere govindaa ik nagan fireh nang nangee jeeo |
English: Some enjoy enjoyments, O my Lord of the Universe, while others wander around naked, the poorest of the poor.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਸਭ ਮੰਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: aape jagat upaaeidaa mere govidaa har daan devai sabh mangee jeeo |
English: He Himself created the world, O my Lord of the Universe; the Lord gives His gifts to all who beg for them.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਮੰਗਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਚੰਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bhagataa naam aadhaar hai mere govindaa har kathaa mangeh har changee jeeo |2|
English: His devotees have the Support of the Naam, O my Lord of the Universe; they beg for the sublime sermon of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਲੋਚ ਮਨਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har aape bhagat karaaeidaa mere govindaa har bhagataa loch man pooree jeeo |
English: The Lord Himself inspires His devotees to worship Him, O my Lord of the Universe; the Lord fulfills the desires of the minds of His devotees.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: aape jal thal varatadaa mere govidaa rav rahiaa nahee dooree jeeo |
English: He Himself is permeating and pervading the waters and the lands, O my Lord of the Universe; He is All-pervading - He is not far away.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har antar baahar aap hai mere govidaa har aap rahiaa bharapooree jeeo |
English: The Lord Himself is within the self, and outside as well, O my Lord of the Universe; the Lord Himself is fully pervading everywhere.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਸਾਰਿਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਹਦੂਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har aatam raam pasaariaa mere govindaa har vekhai aap hadooree jeeo |3|
English: The Lord, the Supreme Soul, is diffused everywhere, O my Lord of the Universe. The Lord Himself beholds all; His Immanent Presence is pervading everywhere. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਾਜਾ ਪਉਣੁ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਜਾਏ ਤਿਉ ਵਾਜੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har antar vaajaa paun hai mere govindaa har aap vajaae tiau vaajai jeeo |
English: O Lord, the music of the praanic wind is deep within, O my Lord of the Universe; as the Lord Himself plays this music, so does it vibrate and resound.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਗਾਜੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har antar naam nidhaan hai mere govindaa gurasabadee har prabh gaajai jeeo |
English: O Lord, the treasure of the Naam is deep within, O my Lord of the Universe; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord God is revealed.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਵਾਇਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਰਾਖੁ ਲਾਜੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: aape saran pavaaeidaa mere govindaa har bhagat janaa raakh laajai jeeo |
