English: He Himself leads us to enter His Sanctuary, O my Lord of the Universe; the Lord preserves the honor of His devotees.

Gurbani: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮਿਲੁ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਧਿ ਕਾਜੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੪॥੩੦॥੬੮॥
Transliteration: vaddabhaagee mil sangatee mere govindaa jan naanak naam sidh kaajai jeeo |4|4|30|68|
English: By great good fortune, one joins the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, O my Lord of the Universe; O servant Nanak, through the Naam, one's affairs are resolved. ||4||4||30||68||

[Ang 175 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree maajh mahalaa 4 |
English: Gauree Maajh, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਲਗਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: mai har naamai har birahu lagaaee jeeo |
English: The Lord has implanted a longing for the Lord's Name within me.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: meraa har prabh mit milai sukh paaee jeeo |
English: I have met the Lord God, my Best Friend, and I have found peace.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har prabh dekh jeevaa meree maaee jeeo |
English: Beholding my Lord God, I live, O my mother.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: meraa naam sakhaa har bhaaee jeeo |1|
English: The Lord's Name is my Friend and Brother. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜੀਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: gun gaavahu sant jeeo mere har prabh kere jeeo |
English: O Dear Saints, sing the Glorious Praises of my Lord God.

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀਉ ਭਾਗ ਵਡੇਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: jap guramukh naam jeeo bhaag vaddere jeeo |
English: As Gurmukh, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O very fortunate ones.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam jeeo praan har mere jeeo |
English: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is my soul and my breath of life.

Gurbani: ਫਿਰਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਭਵਜਲ ਫੇਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: fir bahurr na bhavajal fere jeeo |2|
English: I shall never again have to cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਵੇਖਾ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: kiau har prabh vekhaa merai man tan chaau jeeo |
English: How shall I behold my Lord God? My mind and body yearn for Him.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜੀਉ ਮਨਿ ਲਗਾ ਭਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har melahu sant jeeo man lagaa bhaau jeeo |
English: Unite me with the Lord, Dear Saints; my mind is in love with Him.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਰਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: gurasabadee paaeeai har preetam raau jeeo |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I have found the Sovereign Lord, my Beloved.

Gurbani: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: vaddabhaagee jap naau jeeo |3|
English: O very fortunate ones, chant the Name of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਵਡੜੀ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: merai man tan vaddarree govind prabh aasaa jeeo |
English: Within my mind and body, there is such a great longing for God, the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜੀਉ ਗੋਵਿਦ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har melahu sant jeeo govid prabh paasaa jeeo |
English: Unite me with the Lord, Dear Saints. God, the Lord of the Universe, is so close to me.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur mat naam sadaa paragaasaa jeeo |
English: Through the Teachings of the True Guru, the Naam is always revealed;

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਿਅੜੀ ਮਨਿ ਆਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੫॥੩੧॥੬੯॥
Transliteration: jan naanak pooriarree man aasaa jeeo |4|5|31|69|
English: the desires of servant Nanak's mind have been fulfilled. ||4||5||31||69||

[Ang 175 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree maajh mahalaa 4 |
English: Gauree Maajh, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਬਿਰਹੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਜੀਵਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: meraa birahee naam milai taa jeevaa jeeo |
English: If I receive my Love, the Naam, then I live.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਲੀਵਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: man andar amrit guramat har leevaa jeeo |
English: In the temple of the mind, is the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord; through the Guru's Teachings, we drink it in.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਪੀਵਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: man har rang ratarraa har ras sadaa peevaa jeeo |
English: My mind is drenched with the Love of the Lord. I continually drink in the sublime essence of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਅੜਾ ਮਨਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har paaeiarraa man jeevaa jeeo |1|
English: I have found the Lord within my mind, and so I live. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਲਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: merai man tan prem lagaa har baan jeeo |
English: The arrow of the Lord's Love has pierced by mind and body.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: meraa preetam mitru har purakh sujaan jeeo |
English: The Lord, the Primal Being, is All-knowing; He is my Beloved and my Best Friend.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur mele sant har sugharr sujaan jeeo |
English: The Saintly Guru has united me with the All-knowing and All-seeing Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: hau naam vittahu kurabaan jeeo |2|
English: I am a sacrifice to the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਤੁ ਦਸਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: hau har har sajan har meet dasaaee jeeo |
English: I seek my Lord, Har, Har, my Intimate, my Best Friend.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦਸਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਖੋਜੁ ਪਵਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har dasahu santahu jee har khoj pavaaee jeeo |
English: Show me the way to the Lord, Dear Saints; I am searching all over for Him.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠੜਾ ਦਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur tuttharraa dase har paaee jeeo |
English: The Kind and Compassionate True Guru has shown me the Way, and I have found the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har naame naam samaaee jeeo |3|
English: Through the Name of the Lord, I am absorbed in the Naam. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਵੇਦਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਲਗਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: mai vedan prem har birahu lagaaee jeeo |
English: I am consumed with the pain of separation from the Love of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸਰਧਾ ਪੂਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur saradhaa poor amrit mukh paaee jeeo |
English: The Guru has fulfilled my desire, and I have received the Ambrosial Nectar in my mouth.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har hohu deaal har naam dhiaaee jeeo |
English: The Lord has become merciful, and now I meditate on the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੬॥੨੦॥੧੮॥੩੨॥੭੦॥
Transliteration: jan naanak har ras paaee jeeo |4|6|20|18|32|70|
English: Servant Nanak has obtained the sublime essence of the Lord. ||4||6||20||18||32||70||

[Ang 175 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 raag gaurree guaareree chaupade |
English: Fifth Mehl, Raag Gauree Gwaarayree, Chau-Padhay:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਕਿਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਹੋਤ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kin bidh kusal hot mere bhaaee |
English: How can happiness be found, O my Siblings of Destiny?

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kiau paaeeai har raam sahaaee |1| rahaau |
English: How can the Lord, our Help and Support, be found? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕੁਸਲੁ ਨ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਸਭ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kusal na grihi meree sabh maaeaa |
English: There is no happiness in owning one's own home, in all of Maya,

Gurbani: ਊਚੇ ਮੰਦਰ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aooche mandar sundar chhaaeaa |
English: or in lofty mansions casting beautiful shadows.

Gurbani: ਝੂਠੇ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jhootthe laalach janam gavaaeaa |1|
English: In fraud and greed, this human life is being wasted. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਸਤੀ ਘੋੜੇ ਦੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: hasatee ghorre dekh vigaasaa |
English: He is pleased at the sight of his elephants and horses

Gurbani: ਲਸਕਰ ਜੋੜੇ ਨੇਬ ਖਵਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: lasakar jorre neb khavaasaa |
English: and his armies assembled, his servants and his soldiers.

Gurbani: ਗਲਿ ਜੇਵੜੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਕੇ ਫਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gal jevarree haumai ke faasaa |2|
English: But the noose of egotism is tightening around his neck. ||2||

Gurbani: ਰਾਜੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: raaj kamaavai deh dis saaree |
English: His rule may extend in all ten directions;

Gurbani: ਮਾਣੈ ਰੰਗ ਭੋਗ ਬਹੁ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: maanai rang bhog bahu naaree |
English: he may revel in pleasures, and enjoy many women

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਨਰਪਤਿ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jiau narapat supanai bhekhaaree |3|
English: - but he is just a beggar, who in his dream, is a king. ||3||

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਬਤਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: ek kusal mo kau satiguroo bataaeaa |
English: The True Guru has shown me that there is only one pleasure.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਆ ਭਗਤਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: har jo kichh kare su har kiaa bhagataa bhaaeaa |
English: Whatever the Lord does, is pleasing to the Lord's devotee.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jan naanak haumai maar samaaeaa |4|
English: Servant Nanak has abolished his ego, and he is absorbed in the Lord. ||4||

Gurbani: ਇਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੁਸਲ ਹੋਤ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ein bidh kusal hot mere bhaaee |
English: This is the way to find happiness, O my Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਇਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: eiau paaeeai har raam sahaaee |1| rahaau doojaa |
English: This is the way to find the Lord, our Help and Support. ||1||Second Pause||

[Ang 176 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਭ੍ਰਮੀਐ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਿਸ ਕਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: kiau bhrameeai bhram kis kaa hoee |
English: Why do you doubt? What do you doubt?

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jaa jal thal maheeal raviaa soee |
English: God is pervading the water, the land and the sky.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਬਰੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: guramukh ubare manamukh pat khoee |1|
English: The Gurmukhs are saved, while the self-willed manmukhs lose their honor. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਦਇਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jis raakhai aap raam deaaraa |
English: One who is protected by the Merciful Lord

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਪਹੁਚਨਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tis nahee doojaa ko pahuchanahaaraa |1| rahaau |
English: - no one else can rival him. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਏਕੁ ਅਨੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabh meh varatai ek anantaa |
English: The Infinite One is pervading among all.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਤੂੰ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੋਉ ਹੋਇ ਅਚਿੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: taa toon sukh soau hoe achintaa |
English: So sleep in peace, and don't worry.

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੋ ਵਰਤੰਤਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ohu sabh kichh jaanai jo varatantaa |2|
English: He knows everything which happens. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਏ ਜਿਨ ਦੂਜੀ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh mue jin doojee piaasaa |
English: The self-willed manmukhs are dying in the thirst of duality.

Gurbani: ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਭਵਹਿ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਲਿਖਿਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: bahu jonee bhaveh dhur kirat likhiaasaa |
English: They wander lost through countless incarnations; this is their pre-ordained destiny.

Gurbani: ਜੈਸਾ ਬੀਜਹਿ ਤੈਸਾ ਖਾਸਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jaisaa beejeh taisaa khaasaa |3|
English: As they plant, so shall they harvest. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਇਆ ਵਿਗਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: dekh daras man bheaa vigaasaa |
English: Beholding the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, my mind has blossomed forth.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabh nadaree aaeaa braham paragaasaa |
English: And now everywhere I look, God is revealed to me.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ॥੪॥੨॥੭੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak kee har pooran aasaa |4|2|71|
English: Servant Nanak's hopes have been fulfilled by the Lord. ||4||2||71||

[Ang 176 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਜਨਮ ਭਏ ਕੀਟ ਪਤੰਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: kee janam bhe keett patangaa |
English: In so many incarnations, you were a worm and an insect;

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਜਨਮ ਗਜ ਮੀਨ ਕੁਰੰਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: kee janam gaj meen kurangaa |
English: in so many incarnations, you were an elephant, a fish and a deer.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਜਨਮ ਪੰਖੀ ਸਰਪ ਹੋਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: kee janam pankhee sarap hoeo |
English: In so many incarnations, you were a bird and a snake.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਜਨਮ ਹੈਵਰ ਬ੍ਰਿਖ ਜੋਇਓ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kee janam haivar brikh joeo |1|
English: In so many incarnations, you were yoked as an ox and a horse. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਿਲੁ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਮਿਲਨ ਕੀ ਬਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: mil jagadees milan kee bareea |
English: Meet the Lord of the Universe - now is the time to meet Him.

Gurbani: ਚਿਰੰਕਾਲ ਇਹ ਦੇਹ ਸੰਜਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: chirankaal ih deh sanjareea |1| rahaau |
English: After so very long, this human body was fashioned for you. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਜਨਮ ਸੈਲ ਗਿਰਿ ਕਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: kee janam sail gir kariaa |
English: In so many incarnations, you were rocks and mountains;

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਜਨਮ ਗਰਭ ਹਿਰਿ ਖਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: kee janam garabh hir khariaa |
English: in so many incarnations, you were aborted in the womb;

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਜਨਮ ਸਾਖ ਕਰਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kee janam saakh kar upaaeaa |
English: in so many incarnations, you developed branches and leaves;

Gurbani: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh jon bhramaaeaa |2|
English: you wandered through 8.4 million incarnations. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਭਇਓ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang bheo janam paraapat |
English: Through the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you obtained this human life.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਭਜੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: kar sevaa bhaj har har guramat |
English: Do seva - selfless service; follow the Guru's Teachings, and vibrate the Lord's Name, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਤਿਆਗਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: tiaag maan jhootth abhimaan |
English: Abandon pride, falsehood and arrogance.

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰਹਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jeevat mareh daragah paravaan |3|
English: Remain dead while yet alive, and you shall be welcomed in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਆ ਸੁ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਹੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: jo kichh hoaa su tujh te hog |
English: Whatever has been, and whatever shall be, comes from You, Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕਰਣੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: avar na doojaa karanai jog |
English: No one else can do anything at all.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਜਾ ਲੈਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: taa mileeai jaa laihi milaae |
English: We are united with You, when You unite us with Yourself.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੪॥੩॥੭੨॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak har har gun gaae |4|3|72|
English: Says Nanak, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||3||72||

[Ang 176 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਰਮ ਭੂਮਿ ਮਹਿ ਬੋਅਹੁ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: karam bhoom meh boahu naam |
English: In the field of karma, plant the seed of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਇ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਕਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: pooran hoe tumaaraa kaam |
English: Your works shall be brought to fruition.

Gurbani: ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਿਟੈ ਜਮ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: fal paaveh mittai jam traas |
English: You shall obtain these fruits, and the fear of death shall be dispelled.

Gurbani: ਨਿਤ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਜਾਸ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: nit gaaveh har har gun jaas |1|
English: Sing continually the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam antar ur dhaar |
English: Keep the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, enshrined in your heart,

Gurbani: ਸੀਘਰ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਲੇਹੁ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: seeghar kaaraj lehu savaar |1| rahaau |
English: and your affairs shall be quickly resolved. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਹੋਹੁ ਸਾਵਧਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: apane prabh siau hohu saavadhaan |
English: Be always attentive to your God;

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਤੂੰ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: taa toon daragah paaveh maan |
English: thus you shall be honored in His Court.

Gurbani: ਉਕਤਿ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਸਗਲੀ ਤਿਆਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: aukat siaanap sagalee tiaag |
English: Give up all your clever tricks and devices,

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sant janaa kee charanee laag |2|
English: and hold tight to the Feet of the Saints. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਅ ਹਹਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
Transliteration: sarab jeea heh jaa kai haath |
English: The One, who holds all creatures in His Hands,

Gurbani: ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜੈ ਸਭ ਕੈ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
Transliteration: kade na vichhurrai sabh kai saath |
English: is never separated from them; He is with them all.

Gurbani: ਉਪਾਵ ਛੋਡਿ ਗਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਓਟ ॥
Transliteration: aupaav chhodd gahu tis kee ott |
English: Abandon your clever devices, and grasp hold of His Support.

Gurbani: ਨਿਮਖ ਮਾਹਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਛੋਟਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: nimakh maeh hovai teree chhott |3|
English: In an instant, you shall be saved. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa nikatt kar tis no jaan |
English: Know that He is always near at hand.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kee aagiaa sat kar maan |
English: Accept the Order of God as True.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਮਿਟਾਵਹੁ ਆਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai bachan mittaavahu aap |
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, eradicate selfishness and conceit.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪਿ ਜਾਪੁ ॥੪॥੪॥੭੩॥
Transliteration: har har naam naanak jap jaap |4|4|73|
English: O Nanak, chant and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||4||73||

[Ang 177 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa bachan sadaa abinaasee |
English: The Guru's Word is eternal and everlasting.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਕਟੀ ਜਮ ਫਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai bachan kattee jam faasee |
English: The Guru's Word cuts away the noose of Death.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa bachan jeea kai sang |
English: The Guru's Word is always with the soul.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਰਚੈ ਰਾਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur kai bachan rachai raam kai rang |1|
English: Through the Guru's Word, one is immersed in the Love of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਸੁ ਮਨ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ ॥
Transliteration: jo gur deea su man kai kaam |
English: Whatever the Guru gives, is useful to the mind.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sant kaa keea sat kar maan |1| rahaau |
English: Whatever the Saint does - accept that as True. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਅਟਲ ਅਛੇਦ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa bachan attal achhed |
English: The Guru's Word is infallible and unchanging.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਕਟੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੇਦ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai bachan katte bhram bhed |
English: Through the Guru's Word, doubt and prejudice are dispelled.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਕਤਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa bachan katahu na jaae |
English: The Guru's Word never goes away;

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur kai bachan har ke gun gaae |2|
English: through the Guru's Word, we sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਸਾਥ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa bachan jeea kai saath |
English: The Guru's Word accompanies the soul.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਅਨਾਥ ਕੋ ਨਾਥ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa bachan anaath ko naath |
English: The Guru's Word is the Master of the masterless.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਨਰਕਿ ਨ ਪਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai bachan narak na pavai |
English: The Guru's Word saves one from falling into hell.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਵੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur kai bachan rasanaa amrit ravai |3|
English: Through the Guru's Word, the tongue savors the Ambrosial Nectar. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa bachan paragatt sansaar |
English: The Guru's Word is revealed in the world.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai bachan na aavai haar |
English: Through the Guru's Word, no one suffers defeat.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਹੋਏ ਆਪਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: jis jan hoe aap kripaal |
English: O Nanak, the True Guru is always kind and compassionate,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੪॥੫॥੭੪॥
Transliteration: naanak satigur sadaa deaal |4|5|74|
English: Unto those whom the Lord Himself has blessed with His Mercy. ||4||5||74||

[Ang 177 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਮਾਟੀ ਤੇ ਰਤਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: jin keetaa maattee te ratan |
English: He makes jewels out of the dust,

Gurbani: ਗਰਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਤਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: garabh meh raakhiaa jin kar jatan |
English: and He managed to preserve you in the womb.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: jin deenee sobhaa vaddiaaee |
English: He has given you fame and greatness;

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tis prabh kau aatth pehar dhiaaee |1|
English: meditate on that God, twenty-four hours a day. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਮਈਆ ਰੇਨੁ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: rameea ren saadh jan paavau |
English: O Lord, I seek the dust of the feet of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur mil apunaa khasam dhiaavau |1| rahaau |
English: Meeting the Guru, I meditate on my Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਮੂੜ ਤੇ ਬਕਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: jin keetaa moorr te bakataa |
English: He transformed me, the fool, into a fine speaker,

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਬੇਸੁਰਤ ਤੇ ਸੁਰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: jin keetaa besurat te surataa |
English: and He made the unconscious become conscious;

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਵੈ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jis parasaad navai nidh paaee |
English: by His Grace, I have obtained the nine treasures.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: so prabh man te bisarat naahee |2|
English: May I never forget that God from my mind. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਕਉ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: jin deea nithaave kau thaan |
English: He has given a home to the homeless;

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਨਿਮਾਨੇ ਕਉ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: jin deea nimaane kau maan |
English: He has given honor to the dishonored.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਸਭ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: jin keenee sabh pooran aasaa |
English: He has fulfilled all desires;

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਉ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: simrau din rain saas giraasaa |3|
English: remember Him in meditation, day and night, with every breath and every morsel of food. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਿਲਕ ਕਾਟੀ ॥
Transliteration: jis prasaad maaeaa silak kaattee |
English: By His Grace, the bonds of Maya are cut away.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਟੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad amrit bikh khaattee |
English: By Guru's Grace, the bitter poison has become Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਸ ਤੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak is te kichh naahee |
English: Says Nanak, I cannot do anything;

Gurbani: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੇ ਕਉ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥੪॥੬॥੭੫॥
Transliteration: raakhanahaare kau saalaahee |4|6|75|
English: I praise the Lord, the Protector. ||4||6||75||

[Ang 177 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਭਉ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: tis kee saran naahee bhau sog |
English: In His Sanctuary, there is no fear or sorrow.

Gurbani: ਉਸ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: aus te baahar kachhoo na hog |
English: Without Him, nothing at all can be done.

Gurbani: ਤਜੀ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਬਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: tajee siaanap bal budh bikaar |
English: I have renounced clever tricks, power and intellectual corruption.

Gurbani: ਦਾਸ ਅਪਨੇ ਕੀ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: daas apane kee raakhanahaar |1|
English: God is the Protector of His servant. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: jap man mere raam raam rang |
English: Meditate, O my mind, on the Lord, Raam, Raam, with love.

Gurbani: ਘਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਦ ਸੰਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ghar baahar terai sad sang |1| rahaau |
English: Within your home, and beyond it, He is always with you. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਮਨੈ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: tis kee ttek manai meh raakh |
English: Keep His Support in your mind.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa sabad amrit ras chaakh |
English: Taste the ambrosial essence, the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰਿ ਜਤਨ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਉਨ ਕਾਜ ॥
Transliteration: avar jatan kahahu kaun kaaj |
English: Of what use are other efforts?

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਾਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਲਾਜ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa raakhai aap laaj |2|
English: Showing His Mercy, the Lord Himself protects our honor. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa maanukh kahahu kiaa jor |
English: What is the human? What power does he have?

Gurbani: ਝੂਠਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਸੋਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jhootthaa maaeaa kaa sabh sor |
English: All the tumult of Maya is false.

Gurbani: ਕਰਣ ਕਰਾਵਨਹਾਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: karan karaavanahaar suaamee |
English: Our Lord and Master is the One who acts, and causes others to act.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਕੇ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sagal ghattaa ke antarajaamee |3|
English: He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of all hearts. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਏਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: sarab sukhaa sukh saachaa ehu |
English: Of all comforts, this is the true comfort.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਮਨੈ ਮਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur upades manai meh lehu |
English: Keep the Guru's Teachings in your mind.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kau raam naam liv laagee |
English: Those who bear love for the Name of the Lord

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਧੰਨੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥੪॥੭॥੭੬॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak so dhan vaddabhaagee |4|7|76|
English: - says Nanak, they are blessed, and very fortunate. ||4||7||76||

[Ang 178 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਉਤਾਰੀ ਮੈਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: sun har kathaa utaaree mail |
English: Listening to the Lord's sermon, my pollution has been washed away.

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਭਏ ਸੁਖ ਸੈਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: mahaa puneet bhe sukh sail |
English: I have become totally pure, and I now walk in peace.

Gurbani: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: vaddai bhaag paaeaa saadhasang |
English: By great good fortune, I found the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy;

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੋ ਰੰਗੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: paarabraham siau laago rang |1|
English: I have fallen in love with the Supreme Lord God. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਜਨੁ ਤਾਰਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam japat jan taario |
English: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, His servant has been carried across.

Gurbani: ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: agan saagar gur paar utaario |1| rahaau |
English: The Guru has lifted me up and carried me across the ocean of fire. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਮਨ ਸੀਤਲ ਭਏ ॥
Transliteration: kar keeratan man seetal bhe |
English: Singing the Kirtan of His Praises, my mind has become peaceful;

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਗਏ ॥
Transliteration: janam janam ke kilavikh ge |
English: the sins of countless incarnations have been washed away.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪੇਖੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: sarab nidhaan pekhe man maeh |
English: I have seen all the treasures within my own mind;

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਢੂਢਨ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ab dtoodtan kaahe kau jaeh |2|
English: why should I now go out searching for them? ||2||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਜਬ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
Transliteration: prabh apune jab bhe deaal |
English: When God Himself becomes merciful,

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਸੇਵਕ ਘਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: pooran hoee sevak ghaal |
English: the work of His servant becomes perfect.

Gurbani: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਕੀਏ ਅਪਨੇ ਦਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: bandhan kaatt kee apane daas |
English: He has cut away my bonds, and made me His slave.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: simar simar simar gunataas |3|
English: Remember, remember, remember Him in meditation; He is the treasure of excellence. ||3||

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਮਨਿ ਏਕੋ ਸਭ ਠਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: eko man eko sabh tthaae |
English: He alone is in the mind; He alone is everywhere.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਭ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: pooran poor rahio sabh jaae |
English: The Perfect Lord is totally permeating and pervading everywhere.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur poorai sabh bharam chukaaeaa |
English: The Perfect Guru has dispelled all doubts.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੮॥੭੭॥
Transliteration: har simarat naanak sukh paaeaa |4|8|77|
English: Remembering the Lord in meditation, Nanak has found peace. ||4||8||77||

[Ang 178 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਗਲੇ ਮੁਏ ਸਿ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: agale mue si paachhai pare |
English: Those who have died have been forgotten.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਉਬਰੇ ਸੇ ਬੰਧਿ ਲਕੁ ਖਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jo ubare se bandh lak khare |
English: Those who survive have fastened their belts.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਧੰਧੇ ਮਹਿ ਓਇ ਲਪਟਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jih dhandhe meh oe lapattaae |
English: They are busily occupied in their affairs;

Gurbani: ਉਨ ਤੇ ਦੁਗੁਣ ਦਿੜੀ ਉਨ ਮਾਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aun te dugun dirree un maae |1|
English: they cling twice as hard to Maya. ||1||

Gurbani: ਓਹ ਬੇਲਾ ਕਛੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: oeh belaa kachh cheet na aavai |
English: No one thinks of the time of death;

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਤਾਹੂ ਲਪਟਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: binas jaae taahoo lapattaavai |1| rahaau |
English: people grasp to hold that which shall pass away. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਬੰਧੀ ਮੂਰਖ ਦੇਹ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa bandhee moorakh deh |
English: The fools - their bodies are bound down by desires.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲਪਟਿਓ ਅਸਨੇਹ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh lapattio asaneh |
English: They are mired in sexual desire, anger and attachment;

Gurbani: ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਠਾਢੋ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sir aoopar tthaadto dharam raae |
English: the Righteous Judge of Dharma stands over their heads.

Gurbani: ਮੀਠੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਖਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: meetthee kar kar bikhiaa khaae |2|
English: Believing it to be sweet, the fools eat poison. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਬੰਧਉ ਹਉ ਸਾਧਉ ਬੈਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: hau bandhau hau saadhau bair |
English: They say, "I shall tie up my enemy, and I shall cut him down.

Gurbani: ਹਮਰੀ ਭੂਮਿ ਕਉਣੁ ਘਾਲੈ ਪੈਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: hamaree bhoom kaun ghaalai pair |
English: Who dares to set foot upon my land?

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਹਉ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਸਿਆਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: hau panddit hau chatur siaanaa |
English: I am learned, I am clever and wise."

Gurbani: ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੁ ਨ ਬੁਝੈ ਬਿਗਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: karanaihaar na bujhai bigaanaa |3|
English: The ignorant ones do not recognize their Creator. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅਪੁਨੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: apunee gat mit aape jaanai |
English: The Lord Himself knows His Own state and condition.

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਕਿਆ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa ko kahai kiaa aakh vakhaanai |
English: What can anyone say? How can anyone describe Him?

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jit jit laaveh tith tit laganaa |
English: Whatever He attaches us to - to that we are attached.

Gurbani: ਅਪਨਾ ਭਲਾ ਸਭ ਕਾਹੂ ਮੰਗਨਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: apanaa bhalaa sabh kaahoo manganaa |4|
English: Everyone begs for their own good. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh teraa toon karanaihaar |
English: Everything is Yours; You are the Creator Lord.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: ant naahee kichh paaraavaar |
English: You have no end or limitation.

Gurbani: ਦਾਸ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਉ ਦੀਜੈ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: daas apane kau deejai daan |
English: Please give this gift to Your servant,

Gurbani: ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੫॥੯॥੭੮॥
Transliteration: kabahoo na visarai naanak naam |5|9|78|
English: that Nanak might never forget the Naam. ||5||9||78||

[Ang 178 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਨਹੀ ਹੋਤ ਛੁਟਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: anik jatan nahee hot chhuttaaraa |
English: By all sorts of efforts, people do not find salvation.

Gurbani: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਆਗਲ ਭਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: bahut siaanap aagal bhaaraa |
English: Through clever tricks, the weight is only piled on more and more.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੇਤ ॥
Transliteration: har kee sevaa niramal het |
English: Serving the Lord with a pure heart,

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੋਭਾ ਸੇਤ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: prabh kee daragah sobhaa set |1|
English: you shall be received with honor at God's Court. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਗਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਓਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: man mere gahu har naam kaa olaa |
English: O my mind, hold tight to the Support of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਤੁਝੈ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਾਤਾ ਝੋਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tujhai na laagai taataa jholaa |1| rahaau |
English: The hot winds shall never even touch you. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jiau bohith bhai saagar maeh |
English: Like a boat in the ocean of fear;

Gurbani: ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਦੀਪਕ ਦੀਪਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: andhakaar deepak deepaeh |
English: like a lamp which illumines the darkness;

Gurbani: ਅਗਨਿ ਸੀਤ ਕਾ ਲਾਹਸਿ ਦੂਖ ॥
Transliteration: agan seet kaa laahas dookh |
English: like fire which takes away the pain of cold

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਵਤ ਸੂਖ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naam japat man hovat sookh |2|
English: - just so, chanting the Name, the mind becomes peaceful. ||2||

Gurbani: ਉਤਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਤੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
Transliteration: autar jaae tere man kee piaas |
English: The thirst of your mind shall be quenched,

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਗਲੀ ਆਸ ॥
Transliteration: pooran hovai sagalee aas |
English: and all hopes shall be fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਡੋਲੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਚੀਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: ddolai naahee tumaraa cheet |
English: Your consciousness shall not waver.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੀਤ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: amrit naam jap guramukh meet |3|
English: Meditate on the Ambrosial Naam as Gurmukh, O my friend. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: naam aaukhadh soee jan paavai |
English: He alone receives the panacea, the medicine of the Naam,

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਦਿਵਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa jis aap divaavai |
English: unto whom the Lord, in His Grace, bestows it.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam jaa kai hiradai vasai |
English: One whose heart is filled with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har

Gurbani: ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਤਿਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਸੈ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੭੯॥
Transliteration: dookh darad tih naanak nasai |4|10|79|
English: - O Nanak, his pains and sorrows are eliminated. ||4||10||79||

[Ang 179 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦਰਬੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਅਘਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: bahut darab kar man na aghaanaa |
English: Even with vast sums of wealth, the mind is not satisfied.

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਰੂਪ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਹ ਪਤੀਆਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: anik roop dekh neh pateeaanaa |
English: Gazing upon countless beauties, the man is not satisfied.

Gurbani: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਉਰਝਿਓ ਜਾਨਿ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: putr kalatr urajhio jaan meree |
English: He is so involved with his wife and sons - he believes that they belong to him.

Gurbani: ਓਹ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਓਇ ਭਸਮੈ ਢੇਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: oeh binasai oe bhasamai dteree |1|
English: That wealth shall pass away, and those relatives shall be reduced to ashes. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨ ਦੇਖਉ ਬਿਲਲਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: bin har bhajan dekhau bilalaate |
English: Without meditating and vibrating on the Lord, they are crying out in pain.

Gurbani: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਤਨੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dhrig tan dhrig dhan maaeaa sang raate |1| rahaau |
English: Their bodies are cursed, and their wealth is cursed - they are imbued with Maya. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਬਿਗਾਰੀ ਕੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਦੀਜਹਿ ਦਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: jiau bigaaree kai sir deejeh daam |
English: The servant carries the bags of money on his head,

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਖਸਮੈ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਉਨ ਦੂਖ ਸਹਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: oe khasamai kai grihi un dookh sahaam |
English: but it goes to his master's house, and he receives only pain.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਹੋਇ ਬੈਸਤ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: jiau supanai hoe baisat raajaa |
English: The man sits as a king in his dreams,

Gurbani: ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਪਸਾਰੈ ਤਾ ਨਿਰਾਰਥ ਕਾਜਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: netr pasaarai taa niraarath kaajaa |2|
English: but when he opens his eyes, he sees that it was all in vain. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖਾ ਖੇਤ ਊਪਰਿ ਪਰਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jiau raakhaa khet aoopar paraae |
English: The watchman oversees the field of another,

Gurbani: ਖੇਤੁ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਰਾਖਾ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: khet khasam kaa raakhaa utth jaae |
English: but the field belongs to his master, while he must get up and depart.

Gurbani: ਉਸੁ ਖੇਤ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਰਾਖਾ ਕੜੈ ॥
Transliteration: aus khet kaaran raakhaa karrai |
English: He works so hard, and suffers for that field,

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਪਾਲੈ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਪੜੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tis kai paalai kachhoo na parrai |3|
English: but still, nothing comes into his hands. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਰਾਜੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਸੁਪਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jis kaa raaj tisai kaa supanaa |
English: The dream is His, and the kingdom is His;

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੀਨੀ ਤਿਨਿ ਲਾਈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jin maaeaa deenee tin laaee trisanaa |
English: He who has given the wealth of Maya, has infused the desire for it.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਬਿਨਾਹੇ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: aap binaahe aap kare raas |
English: He Himself annihilates, and He Himself restores.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਗੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੮੦॥
Transliteration: naanak prabh aagai aradaas |4|11|80|
English: Nanak offers this prayer to God. ||4||11||80||

[Ang 179 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਇਆ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਪੇਖੀ ॥
Transliteration: bahu rang maaeaa bahu bidh pekhee |
English: I have gazed upon the many forms of Maya, in so many ways.

Gurbani: ਕਲਮ ਕਾਗਦ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਲੇਖੀ ॥
Transliteration: kalam kaagad siaanap lekhee |
English: With pen and paper, I have written clever things.

Gurbani: ਮਹਰ ਮਲੂਕ ਹੋਇ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਖਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: mehar malook hoe dekhiaa khaan |
English: I have seen what it is to be a chief, a king, and an emperor,

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: taa te naahee man tripataan |1|
English: but they do not satisfy the mind. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਸੰਤ ਬਤਾਵਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: so sukh mo kau sant bataavahu |
English: Show me that peace, O Saints,

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: trisanaa boojhai man tripataavahu |1| rahaau |
English: which will quench my thirst and satisfy my mind. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਸੁ ਪਵਨ ਹਸਤਿ ਅਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: as pavan hasat asavaaree |
English: You may have horses as fast as the wind, elephants to ride on,

Gurbani: ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਸੇਜ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: choaa chandan sej sundar naaree |
English: sandalwood oil, and beautiful women in bed,

Gurbani: ਨਟ ਨਾਟਿਕ ਆਖਾਰੇ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: natt naattik aakhaare gaaeaa |
English: actors in dramas, singing in theaters

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: taa meh man santokh na paaeaa |2|
English: - but even with them, the mind does not find contentment. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤਖਤੁ ਸਭਾ ਮੰਡਨ ਦੋਲੀਚੇ ॥
Transliteration: takhat sabhaa manddan doleeche |
English: You may have a throne at the royal court, with beautiful decorations and soft carpets,

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਮੇਵੇ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਬਾਗੀਚੇ ॥
Transliteration: sagal meve sundar baageeche |
English: all sorts of luscious fruits and beautiful gardens,

Gurbani: ਆਖੇੜ ਬਿਰਤਿ ਰਾਜਨ ਕੀ ਲੀਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: aakherr birat raajan kee leelaa |
English: the excitement of the chase and princely pleasures

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਨ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਹੀਲਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: man na suhelaa parapanch heelaa |3|
English: - but still, the mind is not made happy by such illusory diversions. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸੰਤਨ ਸਚੁ ਕਹਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa santan sach kahiaa |
English: In their kindness, the Saints have told me of the True One,

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਇਹੁ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਲਹਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sarab sookh ihu aanand lahiaa |
English: and so I have obtained all comforts and joy.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang har keeratan gaaeeai |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak vaddabhaagee paaeeai |4|
English: Says Nanak, through great good fortune, I have found this. ||4||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai har dhan soee suhelaa |
English: One who obtains the wealth of the Lord becomes happy.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧੨॥੮੧॥
Transliteration: prabh kirapaa te saadhasang melaa |1| rahaau doojaa |12|81|
English: By God's Grace, I have joined the Saadh Sangat. ||1||Second Pause||12||81||

[Ang 179 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਜਾਣੈ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: praanee jaanai ihu tan meraa |
English: The mortal claims this body as his own.

Gurbani: ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਉਆਹੂ ਲਪਟੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: bahur bahur uaahoo lapatteraa |
English: Again and again, he clings to it.

Gurbani: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਗਿਰਸਤ ਕਾ ਫਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: putr kalatr girasat kaa faasaa |
English: He is entangled with his children, his wife and household affairs.

Gurbani: ਹੋਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਰਾਮ ਕੇ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: hon na paaeeai raam ke daasaa |1|
English: He cannot be the slave of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kavan su bidh jit raam gun gaae |
English: What is that way, by which the Lord's Praises might be sung?

Gurbani: ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਮਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਤਰੈ ਇਹ ਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kavan su mat jit tarai ih maae |1| rahaau |
English: What is that intellect, by which this person might swim across, O mother? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਭਲਾਈ ਸੋ ਬੁਰਾ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: jo bhalaaee so buraa jaanai |
English: That which is for his own good, he thinks is evil.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੋ ਬਿਖੈ ਸਮਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: saach kahai so bikhai samaanai |
English: If someone tells him the truth, he looks upon that as poison.

Gurbani: ਜਾਣੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਜੀਤ ਅਰੁ ਹਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: jaanai naahee jeet ar haar |
English: He cannot tell victory from defeat.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਵਲੇਵਾ ਸਾਕਤ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: eihu valevaa saakat sansaar |2|
English: This is the way of life in the world of the faithless cynic. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਹਲਾਹਲ ਸੋ ਪੀਵੈ ਬਉਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo halaahal so peevai bauraa |
English: The demented fool drinks in the deadly poison,

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਉਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: amrit naam jaanai kar kauraa |
English: while he believes the Ambrosial Naam to be bitter.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗ ਕੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਨੇਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang kai naahee ner |
English: He does not even approach the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy;

Gurbani: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਭ੍ਰਮਤਾ ਫੇਰਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh bhramataa fer |3|
English: he wanders lost through 8.4 million incarnations. ||3||

Gurbani: ਏਕੈ ਜਾਲਿ ਫਹਾਏ ਪੰਖੀ ॥
Transliteration: ekai jaal fahaae pankhee |
English: The birds are caught in the net of Maya;

Gurbani: ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਭੋਗ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: ras ras bhog kareh bahu rangee |
English: immersed in the pleasures of love, they frolic in so many ways.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak jis bhe kripaal |
English: Says Nanak, the Perfect Guru has cut away the noose from those,

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਕਾਟੇ ਜਾਲ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੮੨॥
Transliteration: gur poorai taa ke kaatte jaal |4|13|82|
English: Unto whom the Lord has shown His Mercy. ||4||13||82||

[Ang 180 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: tau kirapaa te maarag paaeeai |
English: By Your Grace, we find the Way.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kirapaa te naam dhiaaeeai |
English: By God's Grace, we meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਛੁਟੈ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kirapaa te bandhan chhuttai |
English: By God's Grace, we are released from our bondage.

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਤੁਟੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tau kirapaa te haumai tuttai |1|
English: By Your Grace, egotism is eradicated. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਤਉ ਲਾਗਹ ਸੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: tum laavahu tau laagah sev |
English: As You assign me, so I take to Your service.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਤੇ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਦੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ham te kachhoo na hovai dev |1| rahaau |
English: By myself, I cannot do anything at all, O Divine Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਗਾਵਾ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: tudh bhaavai taa gaavaa baanee |
English: If it pleases You, then I sing the Word of Your Bani.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: tudh bhaavai taa sach vakhaanee |
English: If it pleases You, then I speak the Truth.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tudh bhaavai taa satigur meaa |
English: If it pleases You, then the True Guru showers His Mercy upon me.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sarab sukhaa prabh teree deaa |2|
English: All peace comes by Your Kindness, God. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai so niramal karamaa |
English: Whatever pleases You is a pure action of karma.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਧਰਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai so sach dharamaa |
English: Whatever pleases You is the true faith of Dharma.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਗੁਣ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: sarab nidhaan gun tum hee paas |
English: The treasure of all excellence is with You.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੇਵਕ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: toon saahib sevak aradaas |3|
English: Your servant prays to You, O Lord and Master. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: man tan niramal hoe har rang |
English: The mind and body become immaculate through the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਪਾਵਉ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: sarab sukhaa paavau satasang |
English: All peace is found in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਰਹੈ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: naam terai rahai man raataa |
English: My mind remains attuned to Your Name;

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਕਲਿਆਣੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੮੩॥
Transliteration: eihu kaliaan naanak kar jaataa |4|14|83|
English: Nanak affirms this as his greatest pleasure. ||4||14||83||

[Ang 180 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਨ ਰਸਾ ਜੇਤੇ ਤੈ ਚਾਖੇ ॥
Transliteration: aan rasaa jete tai chaakhe |
English: You may taste the other flavors,

Gurbani: ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਲਾਥੇ ॥
Transliteration: nimakh na trisanaa teree laathe |
English: but your thirst shall not depart, even for an instant.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਕਾ ਤੂੰ ਚਾਖਹਿ ਸਾਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: har ras kaa toon chaakheh saad |
English: But when you taste the sweet flavor the the Lord's sublime essence

Gurbani: ਚਾਖਤ ਹੋਇ ਰਹਹਿ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: chaakhat hoe raheh bisamaad |1|
English: - upon tasting it, you shall be wonder-struck and amazed. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਪੀਉ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: amrit rasanaa peeo piaaree |
English: O dear beloved tongue, drink in the Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਇਹ ਰਸ ਰਾਤੀ ਹੋਇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: eih ras raatee hoe tripataaree |1| rahaau |
English: Imbued with this sublime essence, you shall be satisfied. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹੇ ਜਿਹਵੇ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: he jihave toon raam gun gaau |
English: O tongue, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਉ ॥
Transliteration: nimakh nimakh har har har dhiaau |
English: Each and every moment, meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਆਨ ਨ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: aan na suneeai katahoon jaaeeai |
English: Do not listen to any other, and do not go anywhere else.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saadhasangat vaddabhaagee paaeeai |2|
English: By great good fortune, you shall find the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਜਿਹਵੇ ਆਰਾਧਿ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar jihave aaraadh |
English: Twenty-four hours a day, O tongue, dwell upon God,

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਆਗਾਧਿ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham tthaakur aagaadh |
English: The Unfathomable, Supreme Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: eehaa aoohaa sadaa suhelee |
English: Here and hereafter, you shall be happy forever.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ ਰਸਨ ਅਮੋਲੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har gun gaavat rasan amolee |3|
English: Chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord, O tongue, you shall become priceless. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬਨਸਪਤਿ ਮਉਲੀ ਫਲ ਫੁਲ ਪੇਡੇ ॥
Transliteration: banasapat maulee fal ful pedde |
English: All the vegetation will blossom forth for you, flowering in fruition;

Gurbani: ਇਹ ਰਸ ਰਾਤੀ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਛੋਡੇ ॥
Transliteration: eih ras raatee bahur na chhodde |
English: imbued with this sublime essence, you shall never leave it again.

Gurbani: ਆਨ ਨ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aan na ras kas lavai na laaee |
English: No other sweet and tasty flavors can compare to it.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੮੪॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak gur bhe hai sahaaee |4|15|84|
English: Says Nanak, the Guru has become my Support. ||4||15||84||

[Ang 180 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਜੀ ਬਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: man mandar tan saajee baar |
English: The mind is the temple, and the body is the fence built around it.

Gurbani: ਇਸ ਹੀ ਮਧੇ ਬਸਤੁ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: eis hee madhe basat apaar |
English: The infinite substance is within it.

Gurbani: ਇਸ ਹੀ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸੁਨੀਅਤ ਸਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: eis hee bheetar suneeat saahu |
English: Within it, the great merchant is said to dwell.

Gurbani: ਕਵਨੁ ਬਾਪਾਰੀ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਊਹਾ ਵਿਸਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kavan baapaaree jaa kaa aoohaa visaahu |1|
English: Who is the trader who deals there? ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨ ਕੋ ਕੋ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: naam ratan ko ko biauhaaree |
English: How rare is that trader who deals in the jewel of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਆਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: amrit bhojan kare aahaaree |1| rahaau |
English: He takes the Ambrosial Nectar as his food. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: man tan arapee sev kareejai |
English: He dedicates his mind and body to serving the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: kavan su jugat jit kar bheejai |
English: How can we please the Lord?

Gurbani: ਪਾਇ ਲਗਉ ਤਜਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਤੇਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: paae lgau taj meraa terai |
English: I fall at His Feet, and I renounce all sense of 'mine and yours'.

Gurbani: ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਜਨੁ ਜੋ ਸਉਦਾ ਜੋਰੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kavan su jan jo saudaa jorai |2|
English: Who can settle this bargain? ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਹਲੁ ਸਾਹ ਕਾ ਕਿਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: mehal saah kaa kin bidh paavai |
English: How can I attain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence?

Gurbani: ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਬੁਲਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: kavan su bidh jit bheetar bulaavai |
English: How can I get Him to call me inside?

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਵਡ ਸਾਹੁ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਕੋਟਿ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: toon vadd saahu jaa ke kott vanajaare |
English: You are the Great Merchant; You have millions of traders.

Gurbani: ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਲੇ ਸੰਚਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kavan su daataa le sanchaare |3|
English: Who is the benefactor? Who can take me to Him? ||3||

Gurbani: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਨਿਜ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: khojat khojat nij ghar paaeaa |
English: Seeking and searching, I have found my own home, deep within my own being.

Gurbani: ਅਮੋਲ ਰਤਨੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਦਿਖਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: amol ratan saach dikhalaaeaa |
English: The True Lord has shown me the priceless jewel.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਬ ਮੇਲੇ ਸਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa jab mele saeh |
English: When the Great Merchant shows His Mercy, He blends us into Himself.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਵੇਸਾਹਿ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੮੫॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak gur kai vesaeh |4|16|85|
English: Says Nanak, place your faith in the Guru. ||4||16||85||

[Ang 181 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 guaareree |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl, Gwaarayree:

Gurbani: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਹੈ ਇਕ ਰੰਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: rain dinas rahai ik rangaa |
English: Night and day, they remain in the Love of the One.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kau jaanai sad hee sangaa |
English: They know that God is always with them.

Gurbani: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੀਓ ਉਨਿ ਵਰਤਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: tthaakur naam keeo un varatan |
English: They make the Name of their Lord and Master their way of life;

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਵਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਦਰਸਨਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tripat aghaavan har kai darasan |1|
English: they are satisfied and fulfilled with the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਹਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har sang raate man tan hare |
English: Imbued with the Love of the Lord, their minds and bodies are rejuvenated,

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਸਰਨੀ ਪਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur poore kee saranee pare |1| rahaau |
English: entering the Sanctuary of the Perfect Guru. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਆਤਮ ਆਧਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal aatam aadhaar |
English: The Lord's Lotus Feet are the Support of the soul.

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਨਿਹਾਰਹਿ ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: ek nihaareh aagiaakaar |
English: They see only the One, and obey His Order.

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਬਨਜੁ ਏਕੋ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: eko banaj eko biauhaaree |
English: There is only one trade, and one occupation.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: avar na jaaneh bin nirankaaree |2|
English: They know no other than the Formless Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਦੁਹਹੂੰ ਤੇ ਮੁਕਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: harakh sog duhahoon te mukate |
English: They are free of both pleasure and pain.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਜੋਗ ਅਰੁ ਜੁਗਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa alipat jog ar jugate |
English: They remain unattached, joined to the Lord's Way.

Gurbani: ਦੀਸਹਿ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਰਹਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: deeseh sabh meh sabh te rahate |
English: They are seen among all, and yet they are distinct from all.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਾ ਓਇ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰਤੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: paarabraham kaa oe dhiaan dharate |3|
English: They focus their meditation on the Supreme Lord God. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕਵਨ ਵਖਾਨਉ ॥
Transliteration: santan kee mahimaa kavan vakhaanau |
English: How can I describe the Glories of the Saints?

Gurbani: ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਮਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਉ ॥
Transliteration: agaadh bodh kichh mit nahee jaanau |
English: Their knowledge is unfathomable; their limits cannot be known.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham mohi kirapaa keejai |
English: O Supreme Lord God, please shower Your Mercy upon me.

Gurbani: ਧੂਰਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੪॥੧੭॥੮੬॥
Transliteration: dhoor santan kee naanak deejai |4|17|86|
English: Bless Nanak with the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||4||17||86||

[Ang 181 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਖਾ ਤੂੰਹੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: toon meraa sakhaa toonhee meraa meet |
English: You are my Companion; You are my Best Friend.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੀਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: toon meraa preetam tum sang heet |
English: You are my Beloved; I am in love with You.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਪਤਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਗਹਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: toon meree pat toohai meraa gahanaa |
English: You are my honor; You are my decoration.

Gurbani: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਿਮਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਰਹਣਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tujh bin nimakh na jaaee rahanaa |1|
English: Without You, I cannot survive, even for an instant. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲਨ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: toon mere laalan toon mere praan |
English: You are my Intimate Beloved, You are my breath of life.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਖਾਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: toon mere saahib toon mere khaan |1| rahaau |
English: You are my Lord and Master; You are my Leader. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਤੁਮ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਤਿਵ ਹੀ ਰਹਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jiau tum raakhahu tiv hee rahanaa |
English: As You keep me, so do I survive.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੁਮ ਕਹਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo tum kahahu soee mohi karanaa |
English: Whatever You say, that is what I do.

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਪੇਖਉ ਤਹਾ ਤੁਮ ਬਸਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeh pekhau tahaa tum basanaa |
English: Wherever I look, there I see You dwelling.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਰਸਨਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: nirbhau naam jpau teraa rasanaa |2|
English: O my Fearless Lord, with my tongue, I chant Your Name. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਤੂੰ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: toon meree nav nidh toon bhanddaar |
English: You are my nine treasures, You are my storehouse.

Gurbani: ਰੰਗ ਰਸਾ ਤੂੰ ਮਨਹਿ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: rang rasaa toon maneh adhaar |
English: I am imbued with Your Love; You are the Support of my mind.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਚੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: toon meree sobhaa tum sang racheea |
English: You are my Glory; I am blended with You.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਓਟ ਤੂੰ ਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਤਕੀਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: toon meree ott toon hai meraa takeea |3|
English: You are my Shelter; You are my Anchoring Support. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੁਹੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: man tan antar tuhee dhiaaeaa |
English: Deep within my mind and body, I meditate on You.

Gurbani: ਮਰਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: maram tumaaraa gur te paaeaa |
English: I have obtained Your secret from the Guru.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਿਆ ਇਕੁ ਏਕੈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur te drirriaa ik ekai |
English: Through the True Guru, the One and only Lord was implanted within me;

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਟੇਕੈ ॥੪॥੧੮॥੮੭॥
Transliteration: naanak daas har har har ttekai |4|18|87|
English: servant Nanak has taken to the Support of the Lord, Har, Har, Har. ||4||18||87||

[Ang 181 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬਿਆਪਤ ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: biaapat harakh sog bisathaar |
English: It torments us with the expression of pleasure and pain.

Gurbani: ਬਿਆਪਤ ਸੁਰਗ ਨਰਕ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: biaapat surag narak avataar |
English: It torments us through incarnations in heaven and hell.

Gurbani: ਬਿਆਪਤ ਧਨ ਨਿਰਧਨ ਪੇਖਿ ਸੋਭਾ ॥
Transliteration: biaapat dhan niradhan pekh sobhaa |
English: It is seen to afflict the rich, the poor and the glorious.

Gurbani: ਮੂਲੁ ਬਿਆਧੀ ਬਿਆਪਸਿ ਲੋਭਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mool biaadhee biaapas lobhaa |1|
English: The source of this illness which torments us is greed. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਬਹੁ ਪਰਕਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa biaapat bahu parakaaree |
English: Maya torments us in so many ways.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਓਟ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sant jeeveh prabh ott tumaaree |1| rahaau |
English: But the Saints live under Your Protection, God. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਿਆਪਤ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਕਾ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: biaapat ahanbudh kaa maataa |
English: It torments us through intoxication with intellectual pride.

Gurbani: ਬਿਆਪਤ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: biaapat putr kalatr sang raataa |
English: It torments us through the love of children and spouse.

Gurbani: ਬਿਆਪਤ ਹਸਤਿ ਘੋੜੇ ਅਰੁ ਬਸਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: biaapat hasat ghorre ar basataa |
English: It torments us through elephants, horses and beautiful clothes.

Gurbani: ਬਿਆਪਤ ਰੂਪ ਜੋਬਨ ਮਦ ਮਸਤਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: biaapat roop joban mad masataa |2|
English: It torments us through the intoxication of wine and the beauty of youth. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬਿਆਪਤ ਭੂਮਿ ਰੰਕ ਅਰੁ ਰੰਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: biaapat bhoom rank ar rangaa |
English: It torments landlords, paupers and lovers of pleasure.

Gurbani: ਬਿਆਪਤ ਗੀਤ ਨਾਦ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੰਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: biaapat geet naad sun sangaa |
English: It torments us through the sweet sounds of music and parties.

Gurbani: ਬਿਆਪਤ ਸੇਜ ਮਹਲ ਸੀਗਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: biaapat sej mehal seegaar |
English: It torments us through beautiful beds, palaces and decorations.

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਅੰਧਿਆਰ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: panch doot biaapat andhiaar |3|
English: It torments us through the darkness of the five evil passions. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬਿਆਪਤ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਹਉ ਫਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: biaapat karam karai hau faasaa |
English: It torments those who act, entangled in ego.

Gurbani: ਬਿਆਪਤਿ ਗਿਰਸਤ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: biaapat girasat biaapat udaasaa |
English: It torments us through household affairs, and it torments us in renunciation.

Gurbani: ਆਚਾਰ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਇਹ ਜਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: aachaar biauhaar biaapat ih jaat |
English: It torments us through character, lifestyle and social status.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਰਾਤ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh biaapat bin har rang raat |4|
English: It torments us through everything, except for those who are imbued with the Love of the Lord. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: santan ke bandhan kaatte har raae |
English: The Sovereign Lord King has cut away the bonds of His Saints.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕਹਾ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: taa kau kahaa biaapai maae |
English: How can Maya torment them?

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਧੂਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak jin dhoor sant paaee |
English: Says Nanak, Maya does not draw near those

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਮਾਈ ॥੫॥੧੯॥੮੮॥
Transliteration: taa kai nikatt na aavai maaee |5|19|88|
English: Who have obtained the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||5||19||88||

[Ang 182 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨੈਨਹੁ ਨੀਦ ਪਰ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: nainahu need par drisatt vikaar |
English: The eyes are asleep in corruption, gazing upon the beauty of another.

Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰਵਣ ਸੋਏ ਸੁਣਿ ਨਿੰਦ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: sravan soe sun nind veechaar |
English: The ears are asleep, listening to slanderous stories.

Gurbani: ਰਸਨਾ ਸੋਈ ਲੋਭਿ ਮੀਠੈ ਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: rasanaa soee lobh meetthai saad |
English: The tongue is asleep, in its desire for sweet flavors.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਸੋਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਬਿਸਮਾਦਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: man soeaa maaeaa bisamaad |1|
English: The mind is asleep, fascinated by Maya. ||1||

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਗਤੁ ਰਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: eis grih meh koee jaagat rahai |
English: Those who remain awake in this house are very rare;

Gurbani: ਸਾਬਤੁ ਵਸਤੁ ਓਹੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਲਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saabat vasat ohu apanee lahai |1| rahaau |
English: by doing so, they receive the whole thing. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਅਪਨੈ ਰਸ ਮਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: sagal sahelee apanai ras maatee |
English: All of my companions are intoxicated with their sensory pleasures;

Gurbani: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: grih apune kee khabar na jaatee |
English: they do not know how to guard their own home.

Gurbani: ਮੁਸਨਹਾਰ ਪੰਚ ਬਟਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: musanahaar panch battavaare |
English: The five thieves have plundered them;

Gurbani: ਸੂਨੇ ਨਗਰਿ ਪਰੇ ਠਗਹਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: soone nagar pare tthagahaare |2|
English: the thugs descend upon the unguarded village. ||2||

Gurbani: ਉਨ ਤੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਬਾਪੁ ਨ ਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aun te raakhai baap na maaee |
English: Our mothers and fathers cannot save us from them;

Gurbani: ਉਨ ਤੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਮੀਤੁ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aun te raakhai meet na bhaaee |
English: friends and brothers cannot protect us from them

Gurbani: ਦਰਬਿ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਨਾ ਓਇ ਰਹਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: darab siaanap naa oe rahate |
English: they cannot be restrained by wealth or cleverness.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਓਇ ਦੁਸਟ ਵਸਿ ਹੋਤੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: saadhasang oe dusatt vas hote |3|
English: Only through the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, can those villains be brought under control. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਪਾਣਿ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa mohi saaringapaan |
English: Have Mercy upon me, O Lord, Sustainer of the world.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਨ ਧੂਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: santan dhoor sarab nidhaan |
English: The dust of the feet of the Saints is all the treasure I need.

Gurbani: ਸਾਬਤੁ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: saabat poonjee satigur sang |
English: In the Company of the True Guru, one's investment remains intact.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਾਗੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak jaagai paarabraham kai rang |4|
English: Nanak is awake to the Love of the Supreme Lord. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਜਾਗੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: so jaagai jis prabh kirapaal |
English: He alone is awake, unto whom God shows His Mercy.

Gurbani: ਇਹ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਾਬਤੁ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੨੦॥੮੯॥
Transliteration: eih poonjee saabat dhan maal |1| rahaau doojaa |20|89|
English: This investment, wealth and property shall remain intact. ||1||Second Pause||20||89||

[Ang 182 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਖਾਨ ਸੁਲਤਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai vas khaan sulataan |
English: Kings and emperors are under His Power.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਸਗਲ ਜਹਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai vas hai sagal jahaan |
English: The whole world is under His Power.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kaa keea sabh kichh hoe |
English: Everything is done by His doing;

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tis te baahar naahee koe |1|
English: other than Him, there is nothing at all. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: kahu benantee apune satigur paeh |
English: Offer your prayers to your True Guru;

Gurbani: ਕਾਜ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਦੇਇ ਨਿਬਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kaaj tumaare dee nibaeh |1| rahaau |
English: He will resolve your affairs. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sabh te aooch jaa kaa darabaar |
English: The Darbaar of His Court is the most exalted of all.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਭਗਤ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sagal bhagat jaa kaa naam adhaar |
English: His Name is the Support of all His devotees.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਬਿਆਪਿਤ ਪੂਰਨ ਧਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: sarab biaapit pooran dhanee |
English: The Perfect Master is pervading everywhere.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਬਨੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jaa kee sobhaa ghatt ghatt banee |2|
English: His Glory is manifest in each and every heart. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਦੁਖ ਡੇਰਾ ਢਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: jis simarat dukh dderaa dtahai |
English: Remembering Him in meditation, the home of sorrow is abolished.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਜਮੁ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਕਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: jis simarat jam kichhoo na kahai |
English: Remembering Him in meditation, the Messenger of Death shall not touch you.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਹੋਤ ਸੂਕੇ ਹਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jis simarat hot sooke hare |
English: Remembering Him in meditation, the dry branches become green again.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਡੂਬਤ ਪਾਹਨ ਤਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jis simarat ddoobat paahan tare |3|
English: Remembering Him in meditation, sinking stones are made to float. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sant sabhaa kau sadaa jaikaar |
English: I salute and applaud the Society of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam jan praan adhaar |
English: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is the Support of the breath of life of His servant.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰੀ ਸੁਣੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak meree sunee aradaas |
English: Says Nanak, the Lord has heard my prayer;

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੨੧॥੯੦॥
Transliteration: sant prasaad mo kau naam nivaas |4|21|90|
English: by the Grace of the Saints, I dwell in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||21||90||

[Ang 183 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: satigur darasan agan nivaaree |
English: By the Blessed Vision of the True Guru's Darshan, the fire of desire is quenched.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟਤ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: satigur bhettat haumai maaree |
English: Meeting the True Guru, egotism is subdued.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਡੋਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sang naahee man ddolai |
English: In the Company of the True Guru, the mind does not waver.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: amrit baanee guramukh bolai |1|
English: The Gurmukh speaks the Ambrosial Word of Gurbani. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਜਾ ਸਚ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: sabh jag saachaa jaa sach meh raate |
English: He sees the True One pervading the whole world; he is imbued with the True One.

Gurbani: ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: seetal saat gur te prabh jaate |1| rahaau |
English: I have become cool and tranquil, knowing God, through the Guru. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਜਪੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sant prasaad japai har naau |
English: By the Grace of the Saints, one chants the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sant prasaad har keeratan gaau |
English: By the Grace of the Saints, one sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸਗਲ ਦੁਖ ਮਿਟੇ ॥
Transliteration: sant prasaad sagal dukh mitte |
English: By the Grace of the Saints, all pains are erased.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੇ ਛੁਟੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sant prasaad bandhan te chhutte |2|
English: By the Grace of the Saints, one is released from bondage. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਮਿਟੇ ਮੋਹ ਭਰਮ ॥
Transliteration: sant kripaa te mitte moh bharam |
English: By the kind Mercy of the Saints, emotional attachment and doubt are removed.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਰੇਣ ਮਜਨ ਸਭਿ ਧਰਮ ॥
Transliteration: saadh ren majan sabh dharam |
English: Taking a bath in the dust of the feet of the Holy - this is true Dharmic faith.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kripaal deaal govind |
English: By the kindness of the Holy, the Lord of the Universe becomes merciful.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਾ ਮਹਿ ਇਹ ਹਮਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: saadhaa meh ih hamaree jind |3|
English: The life of my soul is with the Holy. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: kirapaa nidh kirapaal dhiaavau |
English: Meditating on the Merciful Lord, the Treasure of Mercy,

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਤਾ ਬੈਠਣੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang taa baitthan paavau |
English: I have obtained a seat in the Saadh Sangat.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਦਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: mohi niragun kau prabh keenee deaa |
English: I am worthless, but God has been kind to me.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਇਆ ॥੪॥੨੨॥੯੧॥
Transliteration: saadhasang naanak naam leaa |4|22|91|
English: In the Saadh Sangat, Nanak has taken to the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||22||91||

[Ang 183 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਭਗਵੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang japio bhagavant |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I meditate on the Lord God.

Gurbani: ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: keval naam deeo gur mant |
English: The Guru has given me the Mantra of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ਭਏ ਨਿਰਵੈਰ ॥
Transliteration: taj abhimaan bhe niravair |
English: Shedding my ego, I have become free of hate.

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪੂਜਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੈਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar poojahu gur pair |1|
English: Twenty-four hours a day, I worship the Guru's Feet. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਮਤਿ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਦੁਸਟ ਬਿਗਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: ab mat binasee dusatt bigaanee |
English: Now, my evil sense of alienation is eliminated,

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jab te suniaa har jas kaanee |1| rahaau |
English: since I have heard the Praises of the Lord with my ears. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਹਜ ਸੂਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj sookh aanand nidhaan |
English: The Savior Lord is the treasure of intuitive peace, poise and bliss.

Gurbani: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਇ ਨਿਦਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: raakhanahaar rakh lee nidaan |
English: He shall save me in the end.

Gurbani: ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਭੈ ਭਰਮ ॥
Transliteration: dookh darad binase bhai bharam |
English: My pains, sufferings, fears and doubts have been erased.

Gurbani: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣ ਰਖੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਮ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aavan jaan rakhe kar karam |2|
English: He has mercifully saved me from coming and going in reincarnation. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪੇਖੈ ਬੋਲੈ ਸੁਣੈ ਸਭੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: pekhai bolai sunai sabh aap |
English: He Himself beholds, speaks and hears all.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਨ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sang taa kau man jaap |
English: O my mind, meditate on the One who is always with you.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਭਇਓ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: sant prasaad bheo paragaas |
English: By the Grace of the Saints, the Light has dawned.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਏਕੈ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: poor rahe ekai gunataas |3|
English: The One Lord, the Treasure of Excellence, is perfectly pervading everywhere. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹਤ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਣਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: kehat pavitr sunat puneet |
English: Pure are those who speak, and sanctified are those who hear and sing,

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਨੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: gun govind gaaveh nit neet |
English: Forever and ever, the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak jaa kau hohu kripaal |
English: Says Nanak, when the Lord bestows His Mercy,

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਪੂਰਨ ਘਾਲ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੯੨॥
Transliteration: tis jan kee sabh pooran ghaal |4|23|92|
English: all one's efforts are fulfilled. ||4||23||92||

[Ang 183 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋੜਿ ਬੋਲਾਵੈ ਰਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: bandhan torr bolaavai raam |
English: He breaks our bonds, and inspires us to chant the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: man meh laagai saach dhiaan |
English: With the mind centered in meditation on the True Lord,

Gurbani: ਮਿਟਹਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਸੁਖੀ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: mitteh kales sukhee hoe raheeai |
English: Anguish is eradicated, and one comes to dwell in peace.

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਕਹੀਐ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aisaa daataa satigur kaheeai |1|
English: Such is the True Guru, the Great Giver. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਜਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: so sukhadaataa ji naam japaavai |
English: He alone is the Giver of peace, who inspires us to chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa tis sang milaavai |1| rahaau |
English: By His Grace, He leads us to merge with Him. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jis hoe deaal tis aap milaavai |
English: He unites with Himself those unto whom He has shown His Mercy.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: sarab nidhaan guroo te paavai |
English: All treasures are received from the Guru.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਮਿਟੈ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: aap tiaag mittai aavan jaanaa |
English: Renouncing selfishness and conceit, coming and going come to an end.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saadh kai sang paarabraham pachhaanaa |2|
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Supreme Lord God is recognized. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
Transliteration: jan aoopar prabh bhe deaal |
English: God has become merciful to His humble servant.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਏਕ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: jan kee ttek ek gopaal |
English: The One Lord of the Universe is the Support of His humble servants.

Gurbani: ਏਕਾ ਲਿਵ ਏਕੋ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ekaa liv eko man bhaau |
English: They love the One Lord; their minds are filled with love for the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sarab nidhaan jan kai har naau |3|
English: The Name of the Lord is all treasures for them. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham siau laagee preet |
English: They are in love with the Supreme Lord God;

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਚੀ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: niramal karanee saachee reet |
English: their actions are pure, and their lifestyle is true.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur poorai mettiaa andhiaaraa |
English: The Perfect Guru has dispelled the darkness.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੨੪॥੯੩॥
Transliteration: naanak kaa prabh apar apaaraa |4|24|93|
English: Nanak's God is Incomparable and Infinite. ||4||24||93||

[Ang 184 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਰੈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jis man vasai tarai jan soe |
English: Those whose minds are filled with the Lord, swim across.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai karam paraapat hoe |
English: Those who have the blessing of good karma, meet with the Lord.

Gurbani: ਦੂਖੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਕਛੁ ਭਉ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: dookh rog kachh bhau na biaapai |
English: Pain, disease and fear do not affect them at all.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: amrit naam ridai har jaapai |1|
English: They meditate on the Ambrosial Name of the Lord within their hearts. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham paramesur dhiaaeeai |
English: Meditate on the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur poore te ih mat paaeeai |1| rahaau |
English: From the Perfect Guru, this understanding is obtained. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਰਣ ਕਰਾਵਨਹਾਰ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
Transliteration: karan karaavanahaar deaal |
English: The Merciful Lord is the Doer, the Cause of causes.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਗਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jant sagale pratipaal |
English: He cherishes and nurtures all beings and creatures.

Gurbani: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਸਦਾ ਬੇਅੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: agam agochar sadaa beantaa |
English: He is Inaccessible, Incomprehensible, Eternal and Infinite.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਮਨਾ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: simar manaa poore gur mantaa |2|
English: Meditate on Him, O my mind, through the Teachings of the Perfect Guru. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kee sevaa sarab nidhaan |
English: Serving Him, all treasures are obtained.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪੂਜਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kee poojaa paaeeai maan |
English: Worshipping God, honor is obtained.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਨ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
