Transliteration: jaa kee ttehal na birathee jaae |
English: Working for Him is never in vain;

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa har ke gun gaae |3|
English: forever and ever, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh antarajaamee |
English: Show Mercy to me, O God, O Searcher of hearts.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਹਰਿ ਅਲਖ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: sukh nidhaan har alakh suaamee |
English: The Unseen Lord and Master is the Treasure of Peace.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jant teree saranaaee |
English: All beings and creatures seek Your Sanctuary;

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੪॥੨੫॥੯੪॥
Transliteration: naanak naam milai vaddiaaee |4|25|94|
English: Nanak is blessed to receive the greatness of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||25||94||

[Ang 184 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹੈ ਹਾਥ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jugat jaa kai hai haath |
English: Our way of life is in His Hands;

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਅਨਾਥ ਕੋ ਨਾਥੁ ॥
Transliteration: so simarahu anaath ko naath |
English: remember Him, the Master of the masterless.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਏ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: prabh chit aae sabh dukh jaae |
English: When God comes to mind, all pains depart.

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਸਭ ਬਿਨਸਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bhai sabh binaseh har kai naae |1|
English: All fears are dispelled through the Name of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਉ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਾ ਮਾਨਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: bin har bhau kaahe kaa maaneh |
English: Why do you fear any other than the Lord?

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਕਾਹੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾਨਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har bisarat kaahe sukh jaaneh |1| rahaau |
English: Forgetting the Lord, why do you pretend to be at peace? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਧਾਰੇ ਬਹੁ ਧਰਣਿ ਅਗਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: jin dhaare bahu dharan agaas |
English: He established the many worlds and skies.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਜੀਅ ਪਰਗਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kee jot jeea paragaas |
English: The soul is illumined with His Light;

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬਖਸ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kee bakhas na mettai koe |
English: no one can revoke His Blessing.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: simar simar prabh nirbhau hoe |2|
English: Meditate, meditate in remembrance on God, and become fearless. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar simarahu prabh naam |
English: Twenty-four hours a day, meditate in remembrance on God's Name.

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਤੀਰਥ ਮਜਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: anik teerath majan isanaan |
English: In it are the many sacred shrines of pilgrimage and cleansing baths.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham kee saranee paeh |
English: Seek the Sanctuary of the Supreme Lord God.

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਕਲੰਕ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਿਟਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kott kalank khin meh mitt jaeh |3|
English: Millions of mistakes shall be erased in an instant. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬੇਮੁਹਤਾਜੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: bemuhataaj pooraa paatisaahu |
English: The Perfect King is self-sufficient.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਾਚਾ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: prabh sevak saachaa vesaahu |
English: God's servant has true faith in Him.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਰਾਖੇ ਦੇ ਹਾਥ ॥
Transliteration: gur poorai raakhe de haath |
English: Giving him His Hand, the Perfect Guru protects him.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਮਰਾਥ ॥੪॥੨੬॥੯੫॥
Transliteration: naanak paarabraham samaraath |4|26|95|
English: O Nanak, the Supreme Lord God is All-powerful. ||4||26||95||

[Ang 184 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaad naam man laagaa |
English: By Guru's Grace, my mind is attached to the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਸੋਇਆ ਜਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: janam janam kaa soeaa jaagaa |
English: Asleep for so many incarnations, it is now awakened.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: amrit gun ucharai prabh baanee |
English: I chant the Ambrosial Bani, the Glorious Praises of God.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਪਰਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: poore gur kee sumat paraanee |1|
English: The Pure Teachings of the Perfect Guru have been revealed to me. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਕੁਸਲ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: prabh simarat kusal sabh paae |
English: Meditating in remembrance on God, I have found total peace.

Gurbani: ਘਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਸਬਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ghar baahar sukh sehaj sabaae |1| rahaau |
English: Within my home, and outside as well, there is peace and poise all around. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਜਿਨਹਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: soee pachhaataa jineh upaaeaa |
English: I have recognized the One who created me.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh aap milaaeaa |
English: Showing His Mercy, God has blended me with Himself.

Gurbani: ਬਾਹ ਪਕਰਿ ਲੀਨੋ ਕਰਿ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: baah pakar leeno kar apanaa |
English: Taking me by the arm, He has made me His Own.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਨਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har har kathaa sadaa jap japanaa |2|
English: I continually chant and meditate on the Sermon of the Lord, Har, Har. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਤੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਪੁਨਹਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: mantru tantru aaukhadh punahachaar |
English: Mantras, tantras, all-curing medicines and acts of atonement,

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam jeea praan adhaar |
English: are all in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the Support of the soul and the breath of life.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਾ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: saachaa dhan paaeo har rang |
English: I have obtained the true wealth of the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰੇ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: dutar tare saadh kai sang |3|
English: I have crossed over the treacherous world-ocean in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੁਖਿ ਬੈਸਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਸਜਨ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sukh baisahu sant sajan paravaar |
English: Sit in peace, O Saints, with the family of friends.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਟਿਓ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਹਿ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: har dhan khattio jaa kaa naeh sumaar |
English: Earn the wealth of the Lord, which is beyond estimation.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: jiseh paraapat tis gur dee |
English: He alone obtains it, unto whom the Guru has bestowed it.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਹੇਇ ॥੪॥੨੭॥੯੬॥
Transliteration: naanak birathaa koe na hee |4|27|96|
English: O Nanak, no one shall go away empty-handed. ||4||27||96||

[Ang 185 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਸਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਹੋਹਿ ਤਤਕਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: hasat puneet hohi tatakaal |
English: The hands are sanctified instantly,

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: binas jaeh maaeaa janjaal |
English: and the entanglements of Maya are dispelled.

Gurbani: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਮਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਨੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: rasanaa ramahu raam gun neet |
English: Repeat constantly with your tongue the Glorious Praises of the Lord,

Gurbani: ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sukh paavahu mere bhaaee meet |1|
English: and you shall find peace, O my friends, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||

Gurbani: ਲਿਖੁ ਲੇਖਣਿ ਕਾਗਦਿ ਮਸਵਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: likh lekhan kaagad masavaanee |
English: With pen and ink, write upon your paper

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam har amrit baanee |1| rahaau |
English: the Name of the Lord, the Ambrosial Word of the Lord's Bani. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਇਹ ਕਾਰਜਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: eih kaaraj tere jaeh bikaar |
English: By this act, your sins shall be washed away.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਮ ਮਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: simarat raam naahee jam maar |
English: Remembering the Lord in meditation, you shall not be punished by the Messenger of Death.

Gurbani: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੇ ਦੂਤ ਨ ਜੋਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: dharam raae ke doot na johai |
English: The couriers of the Righteous Judge of Dharma shall not touch you.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਗਨ ਨ ਕਛੂਐ ਮੋਹੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: maaeaa magan na kachhooai mohai |2|
English: The intoxication of Maya shall not entice you at all. ||2||

Gurbani: ਉਧਰਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: audhareh aap tarai sansaar |
English: You shall be redeemed, and through you, the whole world shall be saved,

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਜਪਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam jap ekankaar |
English: if you chant the Name of the One and Only Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਕਮਾਉ ਅਵਰਾ ਉਪਦੇਸ ॥
Transliteration: aap kamaau avaraa upades |
English: Practice this yourself, and teach others;

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਪਰਵੇਸ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: raam naam hiradai paraves |3|
English: instill the Lord's Name in your heart. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਾਥੈ ਏਹੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai maathai ehu nidhaan |
English: That person, who has this treasure upon his forehead

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਜਪੈ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: soee purakh japai bhagavaan |
English: that person meditates on God.

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar har har gun gaau |
English: Twenty-four hours a day, chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੪॥੨੮॥੯੭॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak hau tis bal jaau |4|28|97|
English: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to Him. ||4||28||97||

[Ang 185 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: raag gaurree guaareree mahalaa 5 chaupade dupade |
English: Raag Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl, Chau-Padhay, Dho-Padhay:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਪਰਾਇਓ ਸੋਈ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo paraaeo soee apanaa |
English: That which belongs to another - he claims as his own.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤਜਿ ਛੋਡਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਰਚਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jo taj chhoddan tis siau man rachanaa |1|
English: That which he must abandon - to that, his mind is attracted. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਹਹੁ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਕੇਹ ॥
Transliteration: kahahu gusaaee mileeai keh |
English: Tell me, how can he meet the Lord of the World?

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਬਿਬਰਜਤ ਤਿਸ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo bibarajat tis siau neh |1| rahaau |
English: That which is forbidden - with that, he is in love. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਝੂਠੁ ਬਾਤ ਸਾ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: jhootth baat saa sach kar jaatee |
English: That which is false - he deems as true.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿ ਹੋਵਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਰਾਤੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sat hovan man lagai na raatee |2|
English: That which is true - his mind is not attached to that at all. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬਾਵੈ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਟੇਢਾ ਚਲਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: baavai maarag ttedtaa chalanaa |
English: He takes the crooked path of the unrighteous way;

Gurbani: ਸੀਧਾ ਛੋਡਿ ਅਪੂਠਾ ਬੁਨਨਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: seedhaa chhodd apootthaa bunanaa |3|
English: leaving the straight and narrow path, he weaves his way backwards. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦੁਹਾ ਸਿਰਿਆ ਕਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: duhaa siriaa kaa khasam prabh soee |
English: God is the Lord and Master of both worlds.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੨੯॥੯੮॥
Transliteration: jis mele naanak so mukataa hoee |4|29|98|
English: He, whom the Lord unites with Himself, O Nanak, is liberated. ||4||29||98||

[Ang 185 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਆਏ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: kalijug meh mil aae sanjog |
English: In the Dark Age of Kali Yuga, they come together through destiny.

Gurbani: ਜਿਚਰੁ ਆਗਿਆ ਤਿਚਰੁ ਭੋਗਹਿ ਭੋਗ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jichar aagiaa tichar bhogeh bhog |1|
English: As long as the Lord commands, they enjoy their pleasures. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਲੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਰਾਮ ਸਨੇਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jalai na paaeeai raam sanehee |
English: By burning oneself, the Beloved Lord is not obtained.

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਤਿ ਸੰਜੋਗਿ ਸਤੀ ਉਠਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kirat sanjog satee utth hoee |1| rahaau |
English: Only by the actions of destiny does she rise up and burn herself, as a 'satee'. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦੇਖਾ ਦੇਖੀ ਮਨਹਠਿ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: dekhaa dekhee manahatth jal jaaeeai |
English: Imitating what she sees, with her stubborn mind-set, she goes into the fire.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨਿ ਭਵਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: pria sang na paavai bahu jon bhavaaeeai |2|
English: She does not obtain the Company of her Beloved Lord, and she wanders through countless incarnations. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੀਲ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਆਗਿਆ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: seel sanjam pria aagiaa maanai |
English: With pure conduct and self-restraint, she surrenders to her Husband Lord's Will;

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਰੀ ਕਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਜਮਾਨੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tis naaree kau dukh na jamaanai |3|
English: that woman shall not suffer pain at the hands of the Messenger of Death. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak jin priau paramesar kar jaaniaa |
English: Says Nanak, she who looks upon the Transcendent Lord as her Husband,

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਸਤੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਰਵਾਨਿਆ ॥੪॥੩੦॥੯੯॥
Transliteration: dhan satee daragah paravaaniaa |4|30|99|
English: is the blessed 'satee'; she is received with honor in the Court of the Lord. ||4||30||99||

[Ang 185 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਧਨਵੰਤ ਭਾਗਠ ਸਚ ਨਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: ham dhanavant bhaagatth sach naae |
English: I am prosperous and fortunate, for I have received the True Name.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har gun gaavah sehaj subhaae |1| rahaau |
English: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, with natural, intuitive ease. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪੀਊ ਦਾਦੇ ਕਾ ਖੋਲਿ ਡਿਠਾ ਖਜਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: peeaoo daade kaa khol dditthaa khajaanaa |
English: When I opened it up and gazed upon the treasures of my father and grandfather,

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਇਆ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: taa merai man bheaa nidhaanaa |1|
English: then my mind became very happy. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਤਨ ਲਾਲ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਮੋਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: ratan laal jaa kaa kachhoo na mol |
English: The storehouse is inexhaustible and immeasurable,

Gurbani: ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਅਖੂਟ ਅਤੋਲ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bhare bhanddaar akhoott atol |2|
English: Overflowing with priceless jewels and rubies. ||2||

Gurbani: ਖਾਵਹਿ ਖਰਚਹਿ ਰਲਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: khaaveh kharacheh ral mil bhaaee |
English: The Siblings of Destiny meet together, and eat and spend,

Gurbani: ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਵਧਦੋ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tott na aavai vadhado jaaee |3|
English: but these resources do not diminish; they continue to increase. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak jis masatak lekh likhaae |
English: Says Nanak, one who has such destiny written on his forehead,

Gurbani: ਸੁ ਏਤੁ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਲਇਆ ਰਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੩੧॥੧੦੦॥
Transliteration: su et khajaanai leaa ralaae |4|31|100|
English: becomes a partner in these treasures. ||4||31||100||

[Ang 186 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਡਰਿ ਡਰਿ ਮਰਤੇ ਜਬ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: ddar ddar marate jab jaaneeai door |
English: I was scared, scared to death, when I thought that He was far away.

Gurbani: ਡਰੁ ਚੂਕਾ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ddar chookaa dekhiaa bharapoor |1|
English: But my fear was removed, when I saw that He is pervading everywhere. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur apane kau balihaarai |
English: I am a sacrifice to my True Guru.

Gurbani: ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਸਰਪਰ ਤਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: chhodd na jaaee sarapar taarai |1| rahaau |
English: He shall not abandon me; He shall surely carry me across. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦੂਖੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਜਬ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: dookh rog sog bisarai jab naam |
English: Pain, disease and sorrow come when one forgets the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sadaa anand jaa har gun gaam |2|
English: Eternal bliss comes when one sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਕੋਈ ਨ ਕਹੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: buraa bhalaa koee na kaheejai |
English: Do not say that anyone is good or bad.

Gurbani: ਛੋਡਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਗਹੀਜੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: chhodd maan har charan gaheejai |3|
English: Renounce your arrogant pride, and grasp the Feet of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਚਿਤਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak gur mantru chitaar |
English: Says Nanak, remember the GurMantra;

Gurbani: ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੩੨॥੧੦੧॥
Transliteration: sukh paaveh saachai darabaar |4|32|101|
English: you shall find peace at the True Court. ||4||32||101||

[Ang 186 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਹੈ ਸਮੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kaa meet saajan hai sameea |
English: Those who have the Lord as their Friend and Companion

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਕਹੁ ਕਾ ਕੀ ਕਮੀਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tis jan kau kahu kaa kee kameea |1|
English: - tell me, what else do they need? ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kee preet gobind siau laagee |
English: Those who are in love with the Lord of the Universe

Gurbani: ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਭਾਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dookh darad bhram taa kaa bhaagee |1| rahaau |
English: - pain, suffering and doubt run away from them. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਹੈ ਆਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kau ras har ras hai aaeo |
English: Those who have enjoyed the flavor of the Lord's sublime essence

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਨਾਹੀ ਲਪਟਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: so an ras naahee lapattaaeo |2|
English: are not attracted to any other pleasures. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਦਰਗਹ ਚਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kaa kahiaa daragah chalai |
English: Those whose speech is accepted in the Court of the Lord

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਲੈ ਆਵੈ ਤਲੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: so kis kau nadar lai aavai talai |3|
English: - what do they care about anything else? ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kaa sabh kichh taa kaa hoe |
English: Those who belong to the One, unto whom all things belong

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੩੩॥੧੦੨॥
Transliteration: naanak taa kau sadaa sukh hoe |4|33|102|
English: - O Nanak, they find a lasting peace. ||4||33||102||

[Ang 186 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai dukh sukh sam kar jaapai |
English: Those who look alike upon pleasure and pain

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕਾੜਾ ਕਹਾ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: taa kau kaarraa kahaa biaapai |1|
English: - how can anxiety touch them? ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj anand har saadhoo maeh |
English: The Lord's Holy Saints abide in celestial bliss.

Gurbani: ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aagiaakaaree har har raae |1| rahaau |
English: They remain obedient to the Lord, the Sovereign Lord King. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai achint vasai man aae |
English: Those who have the Carefree Lord abiding in their minds

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: taa kau chintaa katahoon naeh |2|
English: - no cares will ever bother them. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਭਰਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai binasio man te bharamaa |
English: Those who have banished doubt from their minds

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਕਛੂ ਨਾਹੀ ਡਰੁ ਜਮਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: taa kai kachhoo naahee ddar jamaa |3|
English: are not afraid of death at all. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦੀਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai hiradai deeo gur naamaa |
English: Those whose hearts are filled with the Lord's Name by the Guru

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੩੪॥੧੦੩॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak taa kai sagal nidhaanaa |4|34|103|
English: - says Nanak, all treasures come to them. ||4||34||103||

[Ang 186 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਗਮ ਰੂਪ ਕਾ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: agam roop kaa man meh thaanaa |
English: The Lord of Unfathomable Form has His Place in the mind.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad kinai viralai jaanaa |1|
English: By Guru's Grace, a rare few come to understand this. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਹਜ ਕਥਾ ਕੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕੁੰਟਾ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj kathaa ke amrit kunttaa |
English: The Ambrosial Pools of the celestial sermon

Gurbani: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਲੈ ਭੁੰਚਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jiseh paraapat tis lai bhunchaa |1| rahaau |
English: - those who find them, drink them in. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਨਹਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਥਾਨੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: anahat baanee thaan niraalaa |
English: The unstruck melody of the Guru's Bani vibrates in that most special place.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਧੁਨਿ ਮੋਹੇ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: taa kee dhun mohe gopaalaa |2|
English: The Lord of the World is fascinated with this melody. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤਹ ਸਹਜ ਅਖਾਰੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਨੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: teh sehaj akhaare anek anantaa |
English: The numerous, countless places of celestial peace

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੇ ਸੰਗੀ ਸੰਤਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: paarabraham ke sangee santaa |3|
English: - there, the Saints dwell, in the Company of the Supreme Lord God. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਖ ਅਨੰਤ ਸੋਗ ਨਹੀ ਬੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: harakh anant sog nahee beea |
English: There is infinite joy, and no sorrow or duality.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਦੀਆ ॥੪॥੩੫॥੧੦੪॥
Transliteration: so ghar gur naanak kau deea |4|35|104|
English: The Guru has blessed Nanak with this home. ||4||35||104||

[Ang 186 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਵਨ ਰੂਪੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਰਾਧਉ ॥
Transliteration: kavan roop teraa aaraadhau |
English: What form of Yours should I worship and adore?

Gurbani: ਕਵਨ ਜੋਗ ਕਾਇਆ ਲੇ ਸਾਧਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kavan jog kaaeaa le saadhau |1|
English: What Yoga should I practice to control my body? ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਵਨ ਗੁਨੁ ਜੋ ਤੁਝੁ ਲੈ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: kavan gun jo tujh lai gaavau |
English: What is that virtue, by which I may sing of You?

Gurbani: ਕਵਨ ਬੋਲ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਰੀਝਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kavan bol paarabraham reejhaavau |1| rahaau |
English: What is that speech, by which I may please the Supreme Lord God? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਪੂਜਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਰਉ ॥
Transliteration: kavan su poojaa teree krau |
English: What worship service shall I perform for You?

Gurbani: ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਭਵਜਲ ਤਰਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kavan su bidh jit bhavajal trau |2|
English: How can I cross over the terrifying world-ocean? ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਵਨ ਤਪੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਤਪੀਆ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: kavan tap jit tapeea hoe |
English: What is that penance, by which I may become a penitent?

Gurbani: ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਖੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kavan su naam haumai mal khoe |3|
English: What is that Name, by which the filth of egotism may be washed away? ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਪੂਜਾ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਗਲ ਘਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: gun poojaa giaan dhiaan naanak sagal ghaal |
English: Virtue, worship, spiritual wisdom, meditation and all service, O Nanak,

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jis kar kirapaa satigur milai deaal |4|
English: are obtained from the True Guru, when, in His Mercy and Kindness, He meets us. ||4||

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਗੁਨੁ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: tis hee gun tin hee prabh jaataa |
English: They alone receive this merit, and they alone know God,

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਮਾਨਿ ਲੇਇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੩੬॥੧੦੫॥
Transliteration: jis kee maan lee sukhadaataa |1| rahaau doojaa |36|105|
English: who are approved by the Giver of peace. ||1||Second Pause||36||105||

[Ang 187 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਪਨ ਤਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਗਰਬਾ ॥
Transliteration: aapan tan nahee jaa ko garabaa |
English: The body which you are so proud of, does not belong to you.

Gurbani: ਰਾਜ ਮਿਲਖ ਨਹੀ ਆਪਨ ਦਰਬਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: raaj milakh nahee aapan darabaa |1|
English: Power, property and wealth are not yours. ||1||

Gurbani: ਆਪਨ ਨਹੀ ਕਾ ਕਉ ਲਪਟਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: aapan nahee kaa kau lapattaaeo |
English: They are not yours, so why do you cling to them?

Gurbani: ਆਪਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aapan naam satigur te paaeo |1| rahaau |
English: Only the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is yours; it is received from the True Guru. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੁਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਆਪਨ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sut banitaa aapan nahee bhaaee |
English: Children, spouse and siblings are not yours.

Gurbani: ਇਸਟ ਮੀਤ ਆਪ ਬਾਪੁ ਨ ਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: eisatt meet aap baap na maaee |2|
English: Dear friends, mother and father are not yours. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੂਪਾ ਫੁਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਦਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sueinaa roopaa fun nahee daam |
English: Gold, silver and money are not yours.

Gurbani: ਹੈਵਰ ਗੈਵਰ ਆਪਨ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਮ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: haivar gaivar aapan nahee kaam |3|
English: Fine horses and magnificent elephants are of no use to you. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਿ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak jo gur bakhas milaaeaa |
English: Says Nanak, those whom the Guru forgives, meet with the Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੩੭॥੧੦੬॥
Transliteration: tis kaa sabh kichh jis kaa har raaeaa |4|37|106|
English: Everything belongs to those who have the Lord as their King. ||4||37||106||

[Ang 187 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਊਪਰਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਾਥੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur ke charan aoopar mere maathe |
English: I place the Guru's Feet on my forehead,

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਦੁਖ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਲਾਥੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: taa te dukh mere sagale laathe |1|
English: and all my pains are gone. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: satigur apune kau kurabaanee |
English: I am a sacrifice to my True Guru.

Gurbani: ਆਤਮ ਚੀਨਿ ਪਰਮ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aatam cheen param rang maanee |1| rahaau |
English: I have come to understand my soul, and I enjoy supreme bliss. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਰੇਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: charan ren gur kee mukh laagee |
English: I have applied the dust of the Guru's Feet to my face,

Gurbani: ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ahanbudh tin sagal tiaagee |2|
English: which has removed all my arrogant intellect. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਲਗੋ ਮਨਿ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa sabad lago man meetthaa |
English: The Word of the Guru's Shabad has become sweet to my mind,

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: paarabraham taa te mohi ddeetthaa |3|
English: and I behold the Supreme Lord God. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur sukhadaataa gur karataar |
English: The Guru is the Giver of peace; the Guru is the Creator.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੩੮॥੧੦੭॥
Transliteration: jeea praan naanak gur aadhaar |4|38|107|
English: O Nanak, the Guru is the Support of the breath of life and the soul. ||4||38||107||

[Ang 187 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੂੰ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਆਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: re man mere toon taa kau aaeh |
English: O my mind, seek the One,

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਊਣਾ ਕਛਹੂ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jaa kai aoonaa kachhahoo naeh |1|
English: who lacks nothing. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਨ ਮੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: har saa preetam kar man meet |
English: Make the Beloved Lord your friend.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਦ ਚੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: praan adhaar raakhahu sad cheet |1| rahaau |
English: Keep Him constantly in your mind; He is the Support of the breath of life. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੂੰ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਸੇਵਿ ॥
Transliteration: re man mere toon taa kau sev |
English: O my mind, serve Him;

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਦੇਵ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aad purakh aparanpar dev |2|
English: He is the Primal Being, the Infinite Divine Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਊਪਰਿ ਮਨ ਕਰਿ ਤੂੰ ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: tis aoopar man kar toon aasaa |
English: Place your hopes in the One

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aad jugaad jaa kaa bharavaasaa |3|
English: who is the Support of all beings, from the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kee preet sadaa sukh hoe |
English: His Love brings eternal peace;

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੩੯॥੧੦੮॥
Transliteration: naanak gaavai gur mil soe |4|39|108|
English: meeting the Guru, Nanak sings His Glorious Praises. ||4||39||108||

[Ang 187 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੀਤੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੋਈ ਹਮ ਮਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: meet karai soee ham maanaa |
English: Whatever my Friend does, I accept.

Gurbani: ਮੀਤ ਕੇ ਕਰਤਬ ਕੁਸਲ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: meet ke karatab kusal samaanaa |1|
English: My Friend's actions are pleasing to me. ||1||

Gurbani: ਏਕਾ ਟੇਕ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਚੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: ekaa ttek merai man cheet |
English: Within my conscious mind, the One Lord is my only Support.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੁ ਹਮਰਾ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jis kichh karanaa su hamaraa meet |1| rahaau |
English: One who does this is my Friend. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੀਤੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: meet hamaaraa veparavaahaa |
English: My Friend is Carefree.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਅਸਨਾਹਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur kirapaa te mohi asanaahaa |2|
English: By Guru's Grace, I give my love to Him. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮੀਤੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: meet hamaaraa antarajaamee |
English: My Friend is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

Gurbani: ਸਮਰਥ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: samarath purakh paarabraham suaamee |3|
English: He is the All-powerful Being, the Supreme Lord and Master. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਦਾਸੇ ਤੁਮ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: ham daase tum tthaakur mere |
English: I am Your servant; You are my Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਮਾਨੁ ਮਹਤੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤੇਰੇ ॥੪॥੪੦॥੧੦੯॥
Transliteration: maan mehat naanak prabh tere |4|40|109|
English: Nanak: my honor and glory are Yours, God. ||4||40||109||

[Ang 188 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਭਏ ਸਮਰਥ ਅੰਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kau tum bhe samarath angaa |
English: Those who have You on their side, O All-powerful Lord

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਾਲੰਗਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: taa kau kachh naahee kaalangaa |1|
English: - no black stain can stick to them. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਾਧਉ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹੈ ਆਸ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: maadhau jaa kau hai aas tumaaree |
English: O Lord of wealth, those who place their hopes in You

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: taa kau kachh naahee sansaaree |1| rahaau |
English: - nothing of the world can touch them at all. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai hiradai tthaakur hoe |
English: Those whose hearts are filled with their Lord and Master

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਸਹਸਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: taa kau sahasaa naahee koe |2|
English: - no anxiety can affect them. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਦੀਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kau tum deenee prabh dheer |
English: Those, unto whom You give Your consolation, God

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਪੀਰ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: taa kai nikatt na aavai peer |3|
English: - pain does not even approach them. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈ ਸੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak mai so gur paaeaa |
English: Says Nanak, I have found that Guru,

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਦੇਖਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੪੧॥੧੧੦॥
Transliteration: paarabraham pooran dekhaaeaa |4|41|110|
English: who has shown me the Perfect, Supreme Lord God. ||4||41||110||

[Ang 188 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦੁਲਭ ਦੇਹ ਪਾਈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: dulabh deh paaee vaddabhaagee |
English: This human body is so difficult to obtain; it is only obtained by great good fortune.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਪਹਿ ਤੇ ਆਤਮ ਘਾਤੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naam na japeh te aatam ghaatee |1|
English: Those who do not meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are murderers of the soul. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ਜਿਨਾ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: mar na jaahee jinaa bisarat raam |
English: Those who forget the Lord might just as well die.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਜੀਵਨ ਕਉਨ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: naam bihoon jeevan kaun kaam |1| rahaau |
English: Without the Naam, of what use are their lives? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਖਾਤ ਪੀਤ ਖੇਲਤ ਹਸਤ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: khaat peet khelat hasat bisathaar |
English: Eating, drinking, playing, laughing and showing off

Gurbani: ਕਵਨ ਅਰਥ ਮਿਰਤਕ ਸੀਗਾਰ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kavan arath miratak seegaar |2|
English: - what use are the ostentatious displays of the dead? ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਨ ਸੁਨਹਿ ਜਸੁ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo na suneh jas paramaanandaa |
English: Those who do not listen to the Praises of the Lord of supreme bliss,

Gurbani: ਪਸੁ ਪੰਖੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਗਦ ਜੋਨਿ ਤੇ ਮੰਦਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: pas pankhee trigad jon te mandaa |3|
English: are worse off than beasts, birds or creeping creatures. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak gur mantru drirraaeaa |
English: Says Nanak, the GurMantra has been implanted within me;

Gurbani: ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੪੨॥੧੧੧॥
Transliteration: keval naam rid maeh samaaeaa |4|42|111|
English: the Name alone is contained within my heart. ||4||42||111||

[Ang 188 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਾ ਕੀ ਮਾਈ ਕਾ ਕੋ ਬਾਪ ॥
Transliteration: kaa kee maaee kaa ko baap |
English: Whose mother is this? Whose father is this?

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਧਾਰੀਕ ਝੂਠੇ ਸਭਿ ਸਾਕ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naam dhaareek jhootthe sabh saak |1|
English: They are relatives in name only- they are all false. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਮੂਰਖ ਭਖਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kaahe kau moorakh bhakhalaaeaa |
English: Why are you screaming and shouting, you fool?

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਜੋਗਿ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਤੂੰ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mil sanjog hukam toon aaeaa |1| rahaau |
English: By good destiny and the Lord's Order, you have come into the world. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਏਕਾ ਮਾਟੀ ਏਕਾ ਜੋਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: ekaa maattee ekaa jot |
English: There is the one dust, the one light,

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਪਵਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਕਉਨੁ ਰੋਤਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: eko pavan kahaa kaun rot |2|
English: the one praanic wind. Why are you crying? For whom do you cry? ||2||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਲਲਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: meraa meraa kar bilalaahee |
English: People weep and cry out, "Mine, mine!"

Gurbani: ਮਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਅਰਾ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: maranahaar ihu jeearaa naahee |3|
English: This soul is not perishable. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਲੇ ਕਪਾਟ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak gur khole kapaatt |
English: Says Nanak, the Guru has opened my shutters;

Gurbani: ਮੁਕਤੁ ਭਏ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਥਾਟ ॥੪॥੪੩॥੧੧੨॥
Transliteration: mukat bhe binase bhram thaatt |4|43|112|
English: I am liberated, and my doubts have been dispelled. ||4||43||112||

[Ang 188 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਵਡੇ ਵਡੇ ਜੋ ਦੀਸਹਿ ਲੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: vadde vadde jo deeseh log |
English: Those who seem to be great and powerful,

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਰੋਗ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tin kau biaapai chintaa rog |1|
English: are afflicted by the disease of anxiety. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਉਨ ਵਡਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: kaun vaddaa maaeaa vaddiaaee |
English: Who is great by the greatness of Maya?

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਵਡਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: so vaddaa jin raam liv laaee |1| rahaau |
English: They alone are great, who are lovingly attached to the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਭੂਮੀਆ ਭੂਮਿ ਊਪਰਿ ਨਿਤ ਲੁਝੈ ॥
Transliteration: bhoomeea bhoom aoopar nit lujhai |
English: The landlord fights over his land each day.

Gurbani: ਛੋਡਿ ਚਲੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਨਹੀ ਬੁਝੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: chhodd chalai trisanaa nahee bujhai |2|
English: He shall have to leave it in the end, and yet his desire is still not satisfied. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak ihu tat beechaaraa |
English: Says Nanak, this is the essence of Truth:

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਛੁਟਕਾਰਾ ॥੩॥੪੪॥੧੧੩॥
Transliteration: bin har bhajan naahee chhuttakaaraa |3|44|113|
English: without the Lord's meditation, there is no salvation. ||3||44||113||

[Ang 188 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: pooraa maarag pooraa isanaan |
English: Perfect is the path; perfect is the cleansing bath.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh pooraa hiradai naam |1|
English: Everything is perfect, if the Naam is in the heart. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੀ ਰਹੀ ਜਾ ਪੂਰੈ ਰਾਖੀ ॥
Transliteration: pooree rahee jaa poorai raakhee |
English: One's honor remains perfect, when the Perfect Lord preserves it.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਜਨ ਤਾਕੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham kee saran jan taakee |1| rahaau |
English: His servant takes to the Sanctuary of the Supreme Lord God. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: pooraa sukh pooraa santokh |
English: Perfect is the peace; perfect is the contentment.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਾ ਤਪੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: pooraa tap pooran raaj jog |2|
English: Perfect is the penance; perfect is the Raja Yoga, the Yoga of meditation and success. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: har kai maarag patit puneet |
English: On the Lord's Path, sinners are purified.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਲੋਕੀਕ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: pooree sobhaa pooraa lokeek |3|
English: Perfect is their glory; perfect is their humanity. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਸਦ ਵਸੈ ਹਦੂਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: karanahaar sad vasai hadooraa |
English: They dwell forever in the Presence of the Creator Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥੪॥੪੫॥੧੧੪॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak meraa satigur pooraa |4|45|114|
English: Says Nanak, my True Guru is Perfect. ||4||45||114||

[Ang 188 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਮਿਟੇ ਅਘ ਕੋਟ ॥
Transliteration: sant kee dhoor mitte agh kott |
English: Millions of sins are wiped away by the dust of the feet of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਤੇ ਛੋਟ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sant prasaad janam maran te chhott |1|
English: By the Grace of the Saints, one is released from birth and death. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: sant kaa daras pooran isanaan |
English: The Blessed Vision of the Saints is the perfect cleansing bath.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਜਪੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sant kripaa te japeeai naam |1| rahaau |
English: By the Grace of the Saints, one comes to chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sant kai sang mittiaa ahankaar |
English: In the Society of the Saints, egotism is shed,

Gurbani: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਆਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: drisatt aavai sabh ekankaar |2|
English: and the One Lord is seen everywhere. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਆਏ ਵਸਿ ਪੰਚਾ ॥
Transliteration: sant suprasan aae vas panchaa |
English: By the pleasure of the Saints, the five passions are overpowered,

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਲੈ ਸੰਚਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: amrit naam ridai lai sanchaa |3|
English: and the heart is irrigated with the Ambrosial Naam. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰਮ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak jaa kaa pooraa karam |
English: Says Nanak, one whose karma is perfect,

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ॥੪॥੪੬॥੧੧੫॥
Transliteration: tis bhette saadhoo ke charan |4|46|115|
English: touches the feet of the Holy. ||4||46||115||

[Ang 189 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਜਪਤ ਕਮਲੁ ਪਰਗਾਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: har gun japat kamal paragaasai |
English: Meditating on the Glories of the Lord, the heart-lotus blossoms radiantly.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਸਭ ਨਾਸੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har simarat traas sabh naasai |1|
English: Remembering the Lord in meditation, all fears are dispelled. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਮਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: saa mat pooree jit har gun gaavai |
English: Perfect is that intellect, by which the Glorious Praises of the Lord are sung.

Gurbani: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: vaddai bhaag saadhoo sang paavai |1| rahaau |
English: By great good fortune, one finds the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang paaeeai nidh naamaa |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the treasure of the Name is obtained.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਮਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saadhasang pooran sabh kaamaa |2|
English: In the Saadh Sangat, all one's works are brought to fruition. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: har kee bhagat janam paravaan |
English: Through devotion to the Lord, one's life is approved.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur kirapaa te naam vakhaan |3|
English: By Guru's Grace, one chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak so jan paravaan |
English: Says Nanak, that humble being is accepted,

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸੈ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ॥੪॥੪੭॥੧੧੬॥
Transliteration: jaa kai ridai vasai bhagavaan |4|47|116|
English: within whose heart the Lord God abides. ||4||47||116||

[Ang 189 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਏਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: ekas siau jaa kaa man raataa |
English: Those whose minds are imbued with the One Lord,

Gurbani: ਵਿਸਰੀ ਤਿਸੈ ਪਰਾਈ ਤਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: visaree tisai paraaee taataa |1|
English: forget to feel jealous of others. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: bin gobind na deesai koee |
English: They see none other than the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: karan karaavan karataa soee |1| rahaau |
English: The Creator is the Doer, the Cause of causes. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਨਹਿ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: maneh kamaavai mukh har har bolai |
English: Those who work willingly, and chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਡੋਲੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: so jan it ut kateh na ddolai |2|
English: - they do not waver, here or hereafter. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੋ ਸਚ ਸਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai har dhan so sach saahu |
English: Those who possess the wealth of the Lord are the true bankers.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੋ ਵਿਸਾਹੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur poorai kar deeno visaahu |3|
English: The Perfect Guru has established their line of credit. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jeevan purakh miliaa har raaeaa |
English: The Giver of life, the Sovereign Lord King meets them.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੪੮॥੧੧੭॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak param pad paaeaa |4|48|117|
English: Says Nanak, they attain the supreme status. ||4||48||117||

[Ang 189 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਭਗਤ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: naam bhagat kai praan adhaar |
English: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the Support of the breath of life of His devotees.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੋ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਮੋ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naamo dhan naamo biauhaar |1|
English: The Naam is their wealth, the Naam is their occupation. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਵਡਾਈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: naam vaddaaee jan sobhaa paae |
English: By the greatness of the Naam, His humble servants are blessed with glory.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਦਿਵਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa jis aap divaae |1| rahaau |
English: The Lord Himself bestows it, in His Mercy. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਭਗਤ ਕੈ ਸੁਖ ਅਸਥਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: naam bhagat kai sukh asathaan |
English: The Naam is the home of peace of His devotees.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਰਤੁ ਸੋ ਭਗਤੁ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naam rat so bhagat paravaan |2|
English: Attuned to the Naam, His devotees are approved. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam jan kau dhaarai |
English: The Name of the Lord is the support of His humble servants.

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਰੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: saas saas jan naam samaarai |3|
English: With each and every breath, they remember the Naam. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭਾਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak jis pooraa bhaag |
English: Says Nanak, those who have perfect destiny

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗੁ ॥੪॥੪੯॥੧੧੮॥
Transliteration: naam sang taa kaa man laag |4|49|118|
English: - their minds are attached to the Naam. ||4||49||118||

[Ang 189 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sant prasaad har naam dhiaaeaa |
English: By the Grace of the Saints, I meditated on the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਤੇ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tab te dhaavat man tripataaeaa |1|
English: Since then, my restless mind has been satisfied. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sukh bisraam paaeaa gun gaae |
English: I have obtained the home of peace, singing His Glorious Praises.

Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਹਤੀ ਬਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sram mittiaa meree hatee balaae |1| rahaau |
English: My troubles have ended, and the demon has been destroyed. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal araadh bhagavantaa |
English: Worship and adore the Lotus Feet of the Lord God.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਤੇ ਮਿਟੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har simaran te mittee meree chintaa |2|
English: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, my anxiety has come to an end. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਤਜਿ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਏਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਆਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: sabh taj anaath ek saran aaeo |
English: I have renounced all - I am an orphan. I have come to the Sanctuary of the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਊਚ ਅਸਥਾਨੁ ਤਬ ਸਹਜੇ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aooch asathaan tab sahaje paaeo |3|
English: Since then, I have found the highest celestial home. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਨਸਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: dookh darad bharam bhau nasiaa |
English: My pains, troubles, doubts and fears are gone.

Gurbani: ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਬਸਿਆ ॥੪॥੫੦॥੧੧੯॥
Transliteration: karanahaar naanak man basiaa |4|50|119|
English: The Creator Lord abides in Nanak's mind. ||4||50||119||

[Ang 189 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਰ ਕਰਿ ਟਹਲ ਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: kar kar ttehal rasanaa gun gaavau |
English: With my hands I do His work; with my tongue I sing His Glorious Praises.

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਧਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: charan tthaakur kai maarag dhaavau |1|
English: With my feet, I walk on the Path of my Lord and Master. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਲੋ ਸਮੋ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਕੀ ਬਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: bhalo samo simaran kee bareea |
English: It is a good time, when I remember Him in meditation.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਭੈ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: simarat naam bhai paar utareea |1| rahaau |
English: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, I cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: netr santan kaa darasan pekh |
English: With your eyes, behold the Blessed Vision of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਵਿਨਾਸੀ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਲੇਖੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: prabh avinaasee man meh lekh |2|
English: Record the Immortal Lord God within your mind. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸਾਧ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sun keeratan saadh peh jaae |
English: Listen to the Kirtan of His Praises, at the Feet of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਮਿਟਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: janam maran kee traas mittaae |3|
English: Your fears of birth and death shall depart. ||3||

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal tthaakur ur dhaar |
English: Enshrine the Lotus Feet of your Lord and Master within your heart.

Gurbani: ਦੁਲਭ ਦੇਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੫੧॥੧੨੦॥
Transliteration: dulabh deh naanak nisataar |4|51|120|
English: Thus this human life, so difficult to obtain, shall be redeemed. ||4||51||120||

[Ang 190 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਅਪਨੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kau apanee kirapaa dhaarai |
English: Those, upon whom the Lord Himself showers His Mercy,

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਚਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: so jan rasanaa naam uchaarai |1|
English: chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, with their tongues. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: har bisarat sahasaa dukh biaapai |
English: Forgetting the Lord, superstition and sorrow shall overtake you.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: simarat naam bharam bhau bhaagai |1| rahaau |
English: Meditating on the Naam, doubt and fear shall depart. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸੁਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: har keeratan sunai har keeratan gaavai |
English: Listening to the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, and singing the Lord's Kirtan,

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਦੂਖੁ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tis jan dookh nikatt nahee aavai |2|
English: misfortune shall not even come near you. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਕਰਤ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: har kee ttehal karat jan sohai |
English: Working for the Lord, His humble servants look beautiful.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਾਇਆ ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਪੋਹੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: taa kau maaeaa agan na pohai |3|
English: The fire of Maya does not touch them. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
Transliteration: man tan mukh har naam deaal |
English: Within their minds, bodies and mouths, is the Name of the Merciful Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਜੀਅਲੇ ਅਵਰਿ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥੪॥੫੨॥੧੨੧॥
Transliteration: naanak tajeeale avar janjaal |4|52|121|
English: Nanak has renounced other entanglements. ||4||52||121||

[Ang 190 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਛਾਡਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਬਹੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: chhaadd siaanap bahu chaturaaee |
English: Renounce your cleverness, and your cunning tricks.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਟਿਕਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur poore kee ttek ttikaaee |1|
English: Seek the Support of the Perfect Guru. ||1||

Gurbani: ਦੁਖ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: dukh binase sukh har gun gaae |
English: Your pain shall depart, and in peace, you shall sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur pooraa bhettiaa liv laae |1| rahaau |
English: Meeting the Perfect Guru, let yourself be absorbed in the Lord's Love. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam deeo gur mantru |
English: The Guru has given me the Mantra of the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਿਟੇ ਵਿਸੂਰੇ ਉਤਰੀ ਚਿੰਤ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mitte visoore utaree chint |2|
English: My worries are forgotten, and my anxiety is gone. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਨਦ ਭਏ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: anad bhe gur milat kripaal |
English: Meeting with the Merciful Guru, I am in ecstasy.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਾਟੇ ਜਮ ਜਾਲ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa kaatte jam jaal |3|
English: Showering His Mercy, He has cut away the noose of the Messenger of Death. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak gur pooraa paaeaa |
English: Says Nanak, I have found the Perfect Guru;

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੫੩॥੧੨੨॥
Transliteration: taa te bahur na biaapai maaeaa |4|53|122|
English: Maya shall no longer harass me. ||4||53||122||

[Ang 190 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: raakh leea gur poorai aap |
English: The Perfect Guru Himself has saved me.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਉ ਲਾਗੋ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: manamukh kau laago santaap |1|
English: The self-willed manmukhs are afflicted with misfortune. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਪਿ ਮੀਤ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: guroo guroo jap meet hamaare |
English: Chant and meditate on the Guru, the Guru, O my friend.

Gurbani: ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mukh aoojal hoveh darabaare |1| rahaau |
English: Your face shall be radiant in the Court of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur ke charan hiradai vasaae |
English: Enshrine the Feet of the Guru within your heart;

Gurbani: ਦੁਖ ਦੁਸਮਨ ਤੇਰੀ ਹਤੈ ਬਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: dukh dusaman teree hatai balaae |2|
English: your pains, enemies and bad luck shall be destroyed. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa sabad terai sang sahaaee |
English: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is your Companion and Helper.

Gurbani: ਦਇਆਲ ਭਏ ਸਗਲੇ ਜੀਅ ਭਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: deaal bhe sagale jeea bhaaee |3|
English: O Siblings of Destiny, all beings shall be kind to you. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਜਬ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur poorai jab kirapaa karee |
English: When the Perfect Guru granted His Grace,

Gurbani: ਭਨਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਪਰੀ ॥੪॥੫੪॥੧੨੩॥
Transliteration: bhanat naanak meree pooree paree |4|54|123|
English: says Nanak, I was totally, completely fulfilled. ||4||54||123||

[Ang 190 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਰਸਾ ਖਾਏ ਜੈਸੇ ਢੋਰ ॥
Transliteration: anik rasaa khaae jaise dtor |
English: Like beasts, they consume all sorts of tasty treats.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹ ਕੀ ਜੇਵਰੀ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਚੋਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: moh kee jevaree baadhio chor |1|
English: With the rope of emotional attachment, they are bound and gagged like thieves. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਿਰਤਕ ਦੇਹ ਸਾਧਸੰਗ ਬਿਹੂਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: miratak deh saadhasang bihoonaa |
English: Their bodies are corpses, without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਜੋਨੀ ਦੁਖ ਖੀਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aavat jaat jonee dukh kheenaa |1| rahaau |
English: They come and go in reincarnation, and are destroyed by pain. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਪਹਿਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: anik basatr sundar pahiraaeaa |
English: They wear all sorts of beautiful robes,

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਡਰਨਾ ਖੇਤ ਮਾਹਿ ਡਰਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jiau ddaranaa khet maeh ddaraaeaa |2|
English: but they are still just scarecrows in the field, frightening away the birds. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਸਰੀਰ ਆਵਤ ਸਭ ਕਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sagal sareer aavat sabh kaam |
English: All bodies are of some use,

Gurbani: ਨਿਹਫਲ ਮਾਨੁਖੁ ਜਪੈ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਮ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: nihafal maanukh japai nahee naam |3|
English: but those who do not meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are totally useless. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak jaa kau bhe deaalaa |
English: Says Nanak, those unto whom the Lord becomes Merciful,

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਜਹਿ ਗੋੁਪਾਲਾ ॥੪॥੫੫॥੧੨੪॥
Transliteration: saadhasang mil bhajeh guopaalaa |4|55|124|
English: join the Saadh Sangat, and meditate on the Lord of the Universe. ||4||55||124||

[Ang 190 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kal kales gur sabad nivaare |
English: The Word of the Guru's Shabad quiets worries and troubles.

Gurbani: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣ ਰਹੇ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aavan jaan rahe sukh saare |1|
English: Coming and going ceases, and all comforts are obtained. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bhai binase nirbhau har dhiaaeaa |
English: Fear is dispelled, meditating on the Fearless Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang har ke gun gaaeaa |1| rahaau |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਵਲ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: charan kaval rid antar dhaare |
English: I have enshrined the Lotus Feet of the Lord within my heart.

Gurbani: ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: agan saagar gur paar utaare |2|
English: The Guru has carried me across the ocean of fire. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬੂਡਤ ਜਾਤ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਢੇ ॥
Transliteration: booddat jaat poorai gur kaadte |
English: I was sinking down, and the Perfect Guru pulled me out.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਟੂਟੇ ਗਾਢੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: janam janam ke ttootte gaadte |3|
English: I was cut off from the Lord for countless incarnations, and now the Guru united me with Him again. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak tis gur balihaaree |
English: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Guru;

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਗਤਿ ਭਈ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੫੬॥੧੨੫॥
Transliteration: jis bhettat gat bhee hamaaree |4|56|125|
English: meeting Him, I have been saved. ||4||56||125||

[Ang 191 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਨੀ ਪਰਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang taa kee saranee parahu |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, seek His Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਆਗੈ ਧਰਹੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: man tan apanaa aagai dharahu |1|
English: Place your mind and body in offering before Him. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੀਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: amrit naam peevahu mere bhaaee |
English: Drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Name, O my Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਭ ਤਪਤਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: simar simar sabh tapat bujhaaee |1| rahaau |
English: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Lord, the fire of desire is totally quenched. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: taj abhimaan janam maran nivaarahu |
English: Renounce your arrogant pride, and end the cycle of birth and death.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਹੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har ke daas ke charan namasakaarahu |2|
English: Bow in humility to the feet of the Lord's slave. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: saas saas prabh maneh samaale |
English: Remember God in your mind, with each and every breath.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਜੋ ਚਾਲੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: so dhan sanchahu jo chaalai naale |3|
English: Gather only that wealth, which shall go with you. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: tiseh paraapat jis masatak bhaag |
English: He alone obtains it, upon whose forehead such destiny is written.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੁ ॥੪॥੫੭॥੧੨੬॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak taa kee charanee laag |4|57|126|
English: Says Nanak, fall at the Feet of that Lord. ||4||57||126||

[Ang 191 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੂਕੇ ਹਰੇ ਕੀਏ ਖਿਨ ਮਾਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: sooke hare kee khin maahe |
English: The dried branches are made green again in an instant.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸੰਚਿ ਜੀਵਾਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: amrit drisatt sanch jeevaae |1|
English: His Ambrosial Glance irrigates and revives them. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਾਟੇ ਕਸਟ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: kaatte kasatt poore guradev |
English: The Perfect Divine Guru has removed my sorrow.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਦੀਨੀ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sevak kau deenee apunee sev |1| rahaau |
English: He blesses His servant with His service. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਿਟਿ ਗਈ ਚਿੰਤ ਪੁਨੀ ਮਨ ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: mitt gee chint punee man aasaa |
English: Anxiety is removed, and the desires of the mind are fulfilled,

Gurbani: ਕਰੀ ਦਇਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: karee deaa satigur gunataasaa |2|
English: when the True Guru, the Treasure of Excellence, shows His Kindness. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦੁਖ ਨਾਠੇ ਸੁਖ ਆਇ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: dukh naatthe sukh aae samaae |
English: Pain is driven far away, and peace comes in its place;

Gurbani: ਢੀਲ ਨ ਪਰੀ ਜਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: dteel na paree jaa gur furamaae |3|
English: there is no delay, when the Guru gives the Order. ||3||

Gurbani: ਇਛ ਪੁਨੀ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: eichh punee poore gur mile |
English: Desires are fulfilled, when one meets the True Guru;

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਸੁਫਲ ਫਲੇ ॥੪॥੫੮॥੧੨੭॥
Transliteration: naanak te jan sufal fale |4|58|127|
English: O Nanak, His humble servant is fruitful and prosperous. ||4||58||127||

[Ang 191 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤਾਪ ਗਏ ਪਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: taap ge paaee prabh saant |
English: The fever has departed; God has showered us with peace and tranquility.

Gurbani: ਸੀਤਲ ਭਏ ਕੀਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: seetal bhe keenee prabh daat |1|
English: A cooling peace prevails; God has granted this gift. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kirapaa te bhe suhele |
English: By God's Grace, we have become comfortable.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਬਿਛੁਰੇ ਮੇਲੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: janam janam ke bichhure mele |1| rahaau |
English: Separated from Him for countless incarnations, we are now reunited with Him. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: simarat simarat prabh kaa naau |
English: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on God's Name,

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਰੋਗ ਕਾ ਬਿਨਸਿਆ ਥਾਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sagal rog kaa binasiaa thaau |2|
English: the dwelling of all disease is destroyed. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਬੋਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj subhaae bolai har baanee |
English: In intuitive peace and poise, chant the Word of the Lord's Bani.

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar prabh simarahu praanee |3|
English: Twenty-four hours a day, O mortal, meditate on God. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: dookh darad jam nerr na aavai |
English: Pain, suffering and the Messenger of Death do not even approach that one,

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੫੯॥੧੨੮॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak jo har gun gaavai |4|59|128|
English: says Nanak, who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||59||128||

[Ang 191 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਭਲੇ ਦਿਨਸ ਭਲੇ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: bhale dinas bhale sanjog |
English: Auspicious is the day, and auspicious is the chance,

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਿਰਜੋਗ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jit bhette paarabraham nirajog |1|
English: which brought me to the Supreme Lord God, the Unjoined, Unlimited One. ||1||

Gurbani: ਓਹ ਬੇਲਾ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: oeh belaa kau hau bal jaau |
English: I am a sacrifice to that time,

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਜਪੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jit meraa man japai har naau |1| rahaau |
English: when my mind chants the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤੁ ਸਫਲ ਓਹ ਘਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: safal moorat safal oeh gharee |
English: Blessed is that moment, and blessed is that time,

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਉਚਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jit rasanaa ucharai har haree |2|
English: when my tongue chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Haree. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਫਲੁ ਓਹੁ ਮਾਥਾ ਸੰਤ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: safal ohu maathaa sant namasakaaras |
English: Blessed is that forehead, which bows in humility to the Saints.

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਚਲਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: charan puneet chaleh har maarag |3|
English: Sacred are those feet, which walk on the Lord's Path. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਲਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਮ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak bhalaa meraa karam |
English: Says Nanak, auspicious is my karma,

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ॥੪॥੬੦॥੧੨੯॥
Transliteration: jit bhette saadhoo ke charan |4|60|129|
English: which has led me to touch the Feet of the Holy. ||4||60||129||

[Ang 192 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa sabad raakh man maeh |
English: Keep the Word of the Guru's Shabad in your mind.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਸਭ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naam simar chintaa sabh jaeh |1|
English: Meditating in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, all anxiety is removed. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin bhagavant naahee an koe |
English: Without the Lord God, there is no one else at all.

Gurbani: ਮਾਰੈ ਰਾਖੈ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: maarai raakhai eko soe |1| rahaau |
English: He alone preserves and destroys. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਰਿਦੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: gur ke charan ridai ur dhaar |
English: Enshrine the Guru's Feet in your heart.

Gurbani: ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਜਪਿ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: agan saagar jap utareh paar |2|
English: Meditate on Him and cross over the ocean of fire. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਇ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur moorat siau laae dhiaan |
English: Focus your meditation on the Guru's Sublime Form.

Gurbani: ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: eehaa aoohaa paaveh maan |3|
English: Here and hereafter, you shall be honored. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sagal tiaag gur saranee aaeaa |
English: Renouncing everything, I have come to the Guru's Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਮਿਟੇ ਅੰਦੇਸੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੬੧॥੧੩੦॥
Transliteration: mitte andese naanak sukh paaeaa |4|61|130|
English: My anxieties are over - O Nanak, I have found peace. ||4||61||130||

[Ang 192 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਦੂਖੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jis simarat dookh sabh jaae |
English: Remembering Him in meditation, all pains are gone.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naam ratan vasai man aae |1|
English: The jewel of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to dwell in the mind. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: jap man mere govind kee baanee |
English: O my mind, chant the Bani, the Hymns of the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਸਨ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saadhoo jan raam rasan vakhaanee |1| rahaau |
English: The Holy People chant the Lord's Name with their tongues. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਇਕਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: eikas bin naahee doojaa koe |
English: Without the One Lord, there is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jaa kee drisatt sadaa sukh hoe |2|
English: By His Glance of Grace, eternal peace is obtained. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੀਤੁ ਸਖਾ ਕਰਿ ਏਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: saajan meet sakhaa kar ek |
English: Make the One Lord your friend, intimate and companion.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਖਰ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਲੇਖੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har har akhar man meh lekh |3|
English: Write in your mind the Word of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

Gurbani: ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: rav rahiaa sarabat suaamee |
English: The Lord Master is totally pervading everywhere.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥੪॥੬੨॥੧੩੧॥
Transliteration: gun gaavai naanak antarajaamee |4|62|131|
English: Nanak sings the Praises of the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||4||62||131||

[Ang 192 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਮਹਿ ਰਚਿਓ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: bhai meh rachio sabh sansaaraa |
English: The whole world is engrossed in fear.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਭਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tis bhau naahee jis naam adhaaraa |1|
English: Those who have the Naam, the Name of the Lord, as their Support, feel no fear. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਉ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: bhau na viaapai teree saranaa |
English: Fear does not affect those who take to Your Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai soee karanaa |1| rahaau |
English: You do whatever You please. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੋਗ ਹਰਖ ਮਹਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: sog harakh meh aavan jaanaa |
English: In pleasure and in pain, the world is coming and going in reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tin sukh paaeaa jo prabh bhaanaa |2|
English: Those who are pleasing to God, find peace. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਮਹਾ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: agan saagar mahaa viaapai maaeaa |
English: Maya pervades the awesome ocean of fire.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਸੀਤਲ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: se seetal jin satigur paaeaa |3|
English: Those who have found the True Guru are calm and cool. ||3||

Gurbani: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: raakh lee prabh raakhanahaaraa |
English: Please preserve me, O God, O Great Preserver!

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਆ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੬੩॥੧੩੨॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak kiaa jant vichaaraa |4|63|132|
English: Says Nanak, what a helpless creature I am! ||4||63||132||

[Ang 192 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਜਪੀਐ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tumaree kripaa te japeeai naau |
English: By Your Grace, I chant Your Name.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tumaree kripaa te daragah thaau |1|
English: By Your Grace, I obtain a seat in Your Court. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: tujh bin paarabraham nahee koe |
English: Without You, O Supreme Lord God, there is no one.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tumaree kripaa te sadaa sukh hoe |1| rahaau |
English: By Your Grace, everlasting peace is obtained. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੇ ਤਉ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: tum man vase tau dookh na laagai |
English: If You abide in the mind, we do not suffer in sorrow.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tumaree kripaa te bhram bhau bhaagai |2|
English: By Your Grace, doubt and fear run away. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham aparanpar suaamee |
English: O Supreme Lord God, Infinite Lord and Master,

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਕੇ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sagal ghattaa ke antarajaamee |3|
English: You are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of all hearts. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਰਉ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਅਪਨੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: krau aradaas apane satigur paas |
English: I offer this prayer to the True Guru:

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੬੪॥੧੩੩॥
Transliteration: naanak naam milai sach raas |4|64|133|
English: O Nanak, may I be blessed with the treasure of the True Name. ||4||64||133||

[Ang 192 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਣ ਬਿਨਾ ਜੈਸੇ ਥੋਥਰ ਤੁਖਾ ॥
Transliteration: kan binaa jaise thothar tukhaa |
English: As the husk is empty without the grain,

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਸੂਨੇ ਸੇ ਮੁਖਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naam bihoon soone se mukhaa |1|
English: so is the mouth empty without the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam japahu nit praanee |
English: O mortal, chant continually the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਦੇਹ ਬਿਗਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: naam bihoon dhrig deh bigaanee |1| rahaau |
English: Without the Naam, cursed is the body, which shall be taken back by Death. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਭਾਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: naam binaa naahee mukh bhaag |
English: Without the Naam, no one's face shows good fortune.

Gurbani: ਭਰਤ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਕਹਾ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bharat bihoon kahaa sohaag |2|
English: Without the Husband, where is the marriage? ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਲਗੈ ਅਨ ਸੁਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: naam bisaar lagai an suaae |
English: Forgetting the Naam, and attached to other tastes,

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਨ ਪੂਜੈ ਕਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: taa kee aas na poojai kaae |3|
English: no desires are fulfilled. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh apanee daat |
English: O God, grant Your Grace, and give me this gift.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤਿ ॥੪॥੬੫॥੧੩੪॥
Transliteration: naanak naam japai din raat |4|65|134|
English: Please, let Nanak chant Your Name, day and night. ||4||65||134||

[Ang 193 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: toon samarath toonhai meraa suaamee |
English: You are All-powerful, You are my Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਤੂੰ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh tum te toon antarajaamee |1|
English: Everything comes from You; You are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਜਨ ਓਟ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham pooran jan ott |
English: The Perfect Supreme Lord God is the Support of His humble servant.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਉਧਰਹਿ ਜਨ ਕੋਟਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: teree saran udhareh jan kott |1| rahaau |
English: Millions are saved in Your Sanctuary. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੇਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jete jeea tete sabh tere |
English: As many creatures as there are - they are all Yours.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਸੂਖ ਘਨੇਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tumaree kripaa te sookh ghanere |2|
English: By Your Grace, all sorts of comforts are obtained. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo kichh varatai sabh teraa bhaanaa |
English: Whatever happens, is all according to Your Will.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: hukam boojhai so sach samaanaa |3|
English: One who understands the Hukam of the Lord's Command, is absorbed in the True Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੀਜੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa deejai prabh daan |
English: Please grant Your Grace, God, and bestow this gift

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੪॥੬੬॥੧੩੫॥
Transliteration: naanak simarai naam nidhaan |4|66|135|
English: upon Nanak, that he may meditate on the treasure of the Naam. ||4||66||135||

[Ang 193 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: taa kaa daras paaeeai vaddabhaagee |
English: By great good fortune, the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is obtained,

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jaa kee raam naam liv laagee |1|
English: by those who are lovingly absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai har vasiaa man maahee |
English: Those whose minds are filled with the Lord,

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਭੀ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: taa kau dukh supanai bhee naahee |1| rahaau |
English: do not suffer pain, even in dreams. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਰਾਖੇ ਜਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: sarab nidhaan raakhe jan maeh |
English: All treasures have been placed within the minds of His humble servants.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਦੁਖ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: taa kai sang kilavikh dukh jaeh |2|
English: In their company, sinful mistakes and sorrows are taken away. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕਥੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jan kee mahimaa kathee na jaae |
English: The Glories of the Lord's humble servants cannot be described.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਨੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: paarabraham jan rahiaa samaae |3|
English: The servants of the Supreme Lord God remain absorbed in Him. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨਉ ਸੁਨੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh binau suneejai |
English: Grant Your Grace, God, and hear my prayer:

Gurbani: ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੪॥੬੭॥੧੩੬॥
Transliteration: daas kee dhoor naanak kau deejai |4|67|136|
English: please bless Nanak with the dust of the feet of Your slave. ||4||67||136||

[Ang 193 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਤੇਰੀ ਜਾਇ ਬਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: har simarat teree jaae balaae |
English: Remembering the Lord in meditation, your misfortune shall be taken away,

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sarab kaliaan vasai man aae |1|
English: and all joy shall come to abide in your mind. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਜੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: bhaj man mere eko naam |
English: Meditate, O my mind, on the One Name.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੈ ਆਵੈ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jeea tere kai aavai kaam |1| rahaau |
English: It alone shall be of use to your soul. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ਅਨੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: rain dinas gun gaau anantaa |
English: Night and day, sing the Glorious Praises of the Infinite Lord,

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮੰਤਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur poore kaa niramal mantaa |2|
English: through the Pure Mantra of the Perfect Guru. ||2||

Gurbani: ਛੋਡਿ ਉਪਾਵ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: chhodd upaav ek ttek raakh |
English: Give up other efforts, and place your faith in the Support of the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: mahaa padaarath amrit ras chaakh |3|
English: Taste the Ambrosial Essence of this, the greatest treasure. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬਿਖਮ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤੇਈ ਜਨ ਤਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: bikham saagar teee jan tare |
English: They alone cross over the treacherous world-ocean,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੪॥੬੮॥੧੩੭॥
Transliteration: naanak jaa kau nadar kare |4|68|137|
English: O Nanak, upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace. ||4||68||137||

[Ang 193 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: hiradai charan kamal prabh dhaare |
English: I have enshrined the Lotus Feet of God within my heart.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: poore satigur mil nisataare |1|
English: Meeting the Perfect True Guru, I am emancipated. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: govind gun gaavahu mere bhaaee |
English: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, O my Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mil saadhoo har naam dhiaaee |1| rahaau |
English: Joining the Holy Saints, meditate on the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦੁਲਭ ਦੇਹ ਹੋਈ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: dulabh deh hoee paravaan |
