English: This human body, so difficult to obtain, is redeemed

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮ ਨੀਸਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: satigur te paaeaa naam neesaan |2|
English: when one receives the banner of the Naam from the True Guru. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: har simarat pooran pad paaeaa |
English: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, the state of perfection is attained.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਭੈ ਭਰਮ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: saadhasang bhai bharam mittaaeaa |3|
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, fear and doubt depart. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਤ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jat kat dekhau tat rahiaa samaae |
English: Wherever I look, there I see the Lord pervading.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥੪॥੬੯॥੧੩੮॥
Transliteration: naanak daas har kee saranaae |4|69|138|
English: Slave Nanak has entered the Lord's Sanctuary. ||4||69||138||

[Ang 193 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਜੀ ਕੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur jee ke darasan kau bal jaau |
English: I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan.

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jap jap jeevaa satigur naau |1|
English: Chanting and meditating on the Name of the True Guru, I live. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham pooran guradev |
English: O Supreme Lord God, O Perfect Divine Guru,

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲਾਗਉ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa laagau teree sev |1| rahaau |
English: show mercy to me, and commit me to Your service. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal hiradai ur dhaaree |
English: I enshrine His Lotus Feet within my heart.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਧਨ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: man tan dhan gur praan adhaaree |2|
English: I offer my mind, body and wealth to the Guru, the Support of the breath of life. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: safal janam hovai paravaan |
English: My life is prosperous, fruitful and approved;

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur paarabraham nikatt kar jaan |3|
English: I know that the Guru, the Supreme Lord God, is near me. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਧੂਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: sant dhoor paaeeai vaddabhaagee |
English: By great good fortune, I have obtained the dust of the feet of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟਤ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੪॥੭੦॥੧੩੯॥
Transliteration: naanak gur bhettat har siau liv laagee |4|70|139|
English: O Nanak, meeting the Guru, I have fallen in love with the Lord. ||4||70||139||

[Ang 194 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਰੈ ਦੁਹਕਰਮ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਹੋਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: karai duhakaram dikhaavai hor |
English: They do their evil deeds, and pretend otherwise;

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਬਾਧਾ ਚੋਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: raam kee daragah baadhaa chor |1|
English: but in the Court of the Lord, they shall be bound and gagged like thieves. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮੁ ਰਮੈ ਸੋਈ ਰਾਮਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: raam ramai soee raamaanaa |
English: Those who remember the Lord belong to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਏਕੁ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jal thal maheeal ek samaanaa |1| rahaau |
English: The One Lord is contained in the water, the land and the sky. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: antar bikh mukh amrit sunaavai |
English: Their inner beings are filled with poison, and yet with their mouths, they preach words of Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਾਧਾ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jam pur baadhaa chottaa khaavai |2|
English: Bound and gagged in the City of Death, they are punished and beaten. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਪੜਦੇ ਮਹਿ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: anik parrade meh kamaavai vikaar |
English: Hiding behind many screens, they commit acts of corruption,

Gurbani: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਹੋਹਿ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: khin meh pragatt hohi sansaar |3|
English: but in an instant, they are revealed to all the world. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: antar saach naam ras raataa |
English: Those whose inner beings are true, who are attuned to the ambrosial essence of the Naam, the Name of the Lord

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥੪॥੭੧॥੧੪੦॥
Transliteration: naanak tis kirapaal bidhaataa |4|71|140|
English: - O Nanak, the Lord, the Architect of Destiny, is merciful to them. ||4||71||140||

[Ang 194 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਦੇ ਉਤਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: raam rang kade utar na jaae |
English: The Lord's Love shall never leave or depart.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur pooraa jis dee bujhaae |1|
English: They alone understand, unto whom the Perfect Guru gives it. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ॥
Transliteration: har rang raataa so man saachaa |
English: One whose mind is attuned to the Lord's Love is true.

Gurbani: ਲਾਲ ਰੰਗ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: laal rang pooran purakh bidhaataa |1| rahaau |
English: The Love of the Beloved, the Architect of Destiny, is perfect. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਬੈਸਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: santah sang bais gun gaae |
English: Sitting in the Society of the Saints, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: taa kaa rang na utarai jaae |2|
English: The color of His Love shall never fade away. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bin har simaran sukh nahee paaeaa |
English: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, peace is not found.

Gurbani: ਆਨ ਰੰਗ ਫੀਕੇ ਸਭ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aan rang feeke sabh maaeaa |3|
English: All the other loves and tastes of Maya are bland and insipid. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਰੰਗੇ ਸੇ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: gur range se bhe nihaal |
English: Those who are imbued with love by the Guru become happy.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੪॥੭੨॥੧੪੧॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak gur bhe hai deaal |4|72|141|
English: Says Nanak, the Guru has become merciful to them. ||4||72||141||

[Ang 194 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਨਾਸੇ ॥
Transliteration: simarat suaamee kilavikh naase |
English: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord Master, sinful mistakes are erased,

Gurbani: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਨਿਵਾਸੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sookh sehaj aanand nivaase |1|
English: and one comes to abide in peace, celestial joy and bliss. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਰਾਮ ਭਰੋਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: raam janaa kau raam bharosaa |
English: The Lord's humble servants place their faith in the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਸਭੁ ਮਿਟਿਓ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: naam japat sabh mittio andesaa |1| rahaau |
English: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, all anxieties are dispelled. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਕਛੁ ਭਉ ਨ ਭਰਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang kachh bhau na bharaatee |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, there is no fear or doubt.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗਾਈਅਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gun gopaal gaaeeeh din raatee |2|
English: The Glorious Praises of the Lord are sung there, day and night. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬੰਧਨ ਛੋਟ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh bandhan chhott |
English: Granting His Grace, God has released me from bondage.

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਕੀ ਦੀਨੀ ਓਟ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: charan kamal kee deenee ott |3|
English: He has given me the Support of His Lotus Feet. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਭਈ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak man bhee parateet |
English: Says Nanak, faith comes into the mind of His servant,

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਸੁ ਪੀਵਹਿ ਜਨ ਨੀਤਿ ॥੪॥੭੩॥੧੪੨॥
Transliteration: niramal jas peeveh jan neet |4|73|142|
English: Who continually drinks in the Immaculate Praises of the Lord. ||4||73||142||

[Ang 194 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: har charanee jaa kaa man laagaa |
English: Those who keep their minds attached to the Lord's Feet

Gurbani: ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dookh darad bhram taa kaa bhaagaa |1|
English: - pain, suffering and doubt run away from them. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਧਨ ਕੋ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har dhan ko vaapaaree pooraa |
English: Those who deal in the Lord's wealth are perfect.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਨਿਵਾਜੇ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸੂਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jiseh nivaaje so jan sooraa |1| rahaau |
English: Those who are honored by the Lord are the true spiritual heroes. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kau bhe kripaal gusaaee |
English: Those humble beings, unto whom the Lord of the Universe shows mercy,

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਲਾਗੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: se jan laage gur kee paaee |2|
English: fall at the Guru's Feet. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਆਨੰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: sookh sehaj saant aanandaa |
English: They are blessed with peace, celestial bliss, tranquility and ecstasy;

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵੇ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jap jap jeeve paramaanandaa |3|
English: chanting and meditating, they live in supreme bliss. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਰਾਸਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਖਾਟੀ ॥
Transliteration: naam raas saadh sang khaattee |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, I have earned the wealth of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਦਾ ਕਾਟੀ ॥੪॥੭੪॥੧੪੩॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak prabh apadaa kaattee |4|74|143|
English: Says Nanak, God has relieved my pain. ||4||74||143||

[Ang 194 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਭਿ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਕਲੇਸ ॥
Transliteration: har simarat sabh mitteh kales |
English: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, all suffering is eradicated.

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਪਰਵੇਸ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: charan kamal man meh paraves |1|
English: The Lord's Lotus Feet are enshrined within my mind. ||1||

Gurbani: ਉਚਰਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਖ ਬਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: aucharahu raam naam lakh baaree |
English: Chant the Lord's Name, hundreds of thousands of times, O my dear,

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: amrit ras peevahu prabh piaaree |1| rahaau |
English: and drink deeply of the Ambrosial Essence of God. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਰਸ ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: sookh sehaj ras mahaa anandaa |
English: Peace, celestial bliss, pleasures and the greatest ecstasy are obtained;

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵੇ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jap jap jeeve paramaanandaa |2|
English: chanting and meditating, you shall live in supreme bliss. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮਦ ਖੋਏ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh lobh mad khoe |
English: Sexual desire, anger, greed and ego are eradicated;

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਸਭ ਧੋਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: saadh kai sang kilabikh sabh dhoe |3|
English: in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, all sinful mistakes are washed away. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh deen deaalaa |
English: Grant Your Grace, O God, O Merciful to the meek.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਜੈ ਸਾਧ ਰਵਾਲਾ ॥੪॥੭੫॥੧੪੪॥
Transliteration: naanak deejai saadh ravaalaa |4|75|144|
English: Please bless Nanak with the dust of the feet of the Holy. ||4||75||144||

[Ang 195 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਦੀਆ ਪੈਨੈ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jis kaa deea painai khaae |
English: They wear and eat the gifts from the Lord;

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਆਲਸੁ ਕਿਉ ਬਨੈ ਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tis siau aalas kiau banai maae |1|
English: how can laziness help them, O mother? ||1||

Gurbani: ਖਸਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਆਨ ਕੰਮਿ ਲਾਗਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: khasam bisaar aan kam laageh |
English: Forgetting her Husband Lord, and attaching herself to other affairs,

Gurbani: ਕਉਡੀ ਬਦਲੇ ਰਤਨੁ ਤਿਆਗਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kauddee badale ratan tiaageh |1| rahaau |
English: the soul-bride throws away the precious jewel in exchange for a mere shell. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਲਾਗਤ ਅਨ ਲੋਭਾ ॥
Transliteration: prabhoo tiaag laagat an lobhaa |
English: Forsaking God, she is attached to other desires.

Gurbani: ਦਾਸਿ ਸਲਾਮੁ ਕਰਤ ਕਤ ਸੋਭਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: daas salaam karat kat sobhaa |2|
English: But who has gained honor by saluting the slave? ||2||

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਵਹਿ ਖਾਨ ਪਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: amrit ras khaaveh khaan paan |
English: They consume food and drink, delicious and sublime as ambrosial nectar.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਏ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਸੁਆਨ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jin dee tiseh na jaaneh suaan |3|
English: But the dog does not know the One who has bestowed these. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਮ ਲੂਣ ਹਰਾਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak ham loon haraamee |
English: Says Nanak, I have been unfaithful to my own nature.

Gurbani: ਬਖਸਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥੪॥੭੬॥੧੪੫॥
Transliteration: bakhas lehu prabh antarajaamee |4|76|145|
English: Please forgive me, O God, O Searcher of hearts. ||4||76||145||

[Ang 195 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: prabh ke charan man maeh dhiaan |
English: I meditate on the Feet of God within my mind.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਤੀਰਥ ਮਜਨ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sagal teerath majan isanaan |1|
English: This is my cleansing bath at all the sacred shrines of pilgrimage. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har din har simaran mere bhaaee |
English: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord every day, O my Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kott janam kee mal leh jaaee |1| rahaau |
English: Thus, the filth of millions of incarnations shall be taken away. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਰਿਦ ਮਾਹਿ ਬਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har kee kathaa rid maeh basaaee |
English: Enshrine the Lord's Sermon within your heart,

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਸਗਲੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: man baanchhat sagale fal paaee |2|
English: and you shall obtain all the desires of your mind. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਨ ਮਰਣੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: jeevan maran janam paravaan |
English: Redeemed is the life, death and birth of those,

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸੈ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jaa kai ridai vasai bhagavaan |3|
English: within whose hearts the Lord God abides. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak seee jan poore |
English: Says Nanak, those humble beings are perfect,

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਾ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰੇ ॥੪॥੭੭॥੧੪੬॥
Transliteration: jinaa paraapat saadhoo dhoore |4|77|146|
English: who are blessed with the dust of the feet of the Holy. ||4||77||146||

[Ang 195 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਖਾਦਾ ਪੈਨਦਾ ਮੂਕਰਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: khaadaa painadaa mookar paae |
English: They eat and wear what they are given, but still, they deny the Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਜੋਹਹਿ ਦੂਤ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tis no joheh doot dharam raae |1|
English: The messengers of the Righteous Judge of Dharma shall hunt them down. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਬੇਮੁਖੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: tis siau bemukh jin jeeo pindd deenaa |
English: They are unfaithful to the One, who has given them body and soul.

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਭਰਮਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਜੂਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kott janam bharameh bahu joonaa |1| rahaau |
English: Through millions of incarnations, for so many lifetimes, they wander lost. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤ ਕੀ ਐਸੀ ਹੈ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: saakat kee aisee hai reet |
English: Such is the lifestyle of the faithless cynics;

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਪਰੀਤਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jo kichh karai sagal bipareet |2|
English: everything they do is evil. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਜਿਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jeeo praan jin man tan dhaariaa |
English: Within their minds, they have forgotten that Lord and Master,

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: soee tthaakur manahu bisaariaa |3|
English: Who created the soul, breath of life, mind and body. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬਧੇ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਲਿਖੇ ਬਹੁ ਕਾਗਰ ॥
Transliteration: badhe bikaar likhe bahu kaagar |
English: Their wickedness and corruption have increased - they are recorded in volumes of books.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਧਰੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak udhar kripaa sukh saagar |4|
English: O Nanak, they are saved only by the Mercy of God, the Ocean of peace. ||4||

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham teree saranaae |
English: O Supreme Lord God, I have come to Your Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਤਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੭੮॥੧੪੭॥
Transliteration: bandhan kaatt tarai har naae |1| rahaau doojaa |78|147|
English: Break my bonds, and carry me across, with the Lord's Name. ||1||Second Pause||78||147||

[Ang 195 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੇ ਲੋਭ ਕਉ ਕੀਨੋ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: apane lobh kau keeno meet |
English: For their own advantage, they make God their friend.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦੁ ਦੀਤੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sagal manorath mukat pad deet |1|
English: He fulfills all their desires, and blesses them with the state of liberation. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa meet karahu sabh koe |
English: Everyone should make Him such a friend.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaa te birathaa koe na hoe |1| rahaau |
English: No one goes away empty-handed from Him. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਪੁਨੈ ਸੁਆਇ ਰਿਦੈ ਲੈ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: apunai suaae ridai lai dhaariaa |
English: For their own purposes, they enshrine the Lord in the heart;

Gurbani: ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਰੋਗ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਦਾਰਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: dookh darad rog sagal bidaariaa |2|
English: all pain, suffering and disease are taken away. ||2||

Gurbani: ਰਸਨਾ ਗੀਧੀ ਬੋਲਤ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: rasanaa geedhee bolat raam |
English: Their tongues learn the habit of chanting the Lord's Name,

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਏ ਸਗਲੇ ਕਾਮ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: pooran hoe sagale kaam |3|
English: and all their works are brought to perfection. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: anik baar naanak balihaaraa |
English: So many times, Nanak is a sacrifice to Him;

Gurbani: ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੭੯॥੧੪੮॥
Transliteration: safal darasan gobind hamaaraa |4|79|148|
English: fruitful is the Blessed Vision, the Darshan, of my Lord of the Universe. ||4||79||148||

[Ang 195 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਬਿਘਨ ਹਿਰੇ ਖਿਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: kott bighan hire khin maeh |
English: Millions of obstacles are removed in an instant,

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਨਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har har kathaa saadhasang sunaeh |1|
English: for those who listen to the Sermon of the Lord, Har, Har, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪੀਵਤ ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਗੁਣ ਜਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: peevat raam ras amrit gun jaas |
English: They drink in the sublime essence of the Lord's Name, the Ambrosial Elixir.

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਮਿਟੀ ਖੁਧਿ ਤਾਸੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jap har charan mittee khudh taas |1| rahaau |
English: Meditating on the Lord's Feet, hunger is taken away. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: sarab kaliaan sukh sehaj nidhaan |
English: The treasure of all happiness, celestial peace and poise,

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਹਿ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jaa kai ridai vaseh bhagavaan |2|
English: are obtained by those, whose hearts are filled with the Lord God. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਉਖਧ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਤੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: aaukhadh mantr tant sabh chhaar |
English: All medicines and remedies, mantras and tantras are nothing more than ashes.

Gurbani: ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੁ ਰਿਦੇ ਮਹਿ ਧਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: karanaihaar ride meh dhaar |3|
English: Enshrine the Creator Lord within your heart. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤਜਿ ਸਭਿ ਭਰਮ ਭਜਿਓ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: taj sabh bharam bhajio paarabraham |
English: Renounce all your doubts, and vibrate upon the Supreme Lord God.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਟਲ ਇਹੁ ਧਰਮੁ ॥੪॥੮੦॥੧੪੯॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak attal ihu dharam |4|80|149|
English: Says Nanak, this path of Dharma is eternal and unchanging. ||4||80||149||

[Ang 196 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭੇਟੇ ਗੁਰ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa bhette gur soee |
English: The Lord bestowed His Mercy, and led me to meet the Guru.

Gurbani: ਤਿਤੁ ਬਲਿ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tit bal rog na biaapai koee |1|
English: By His power, no disease afflicts me. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਰਮਣ ਤਰਣ ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰ ॥
Transliteration: raam raman taran bhai saagar |
English: Remembering the Lord, I cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਸਰਣਿ ਸੂਰ ਫਾਰੇ ਜਮ ਕਾਗਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saran soor faare jam kaagar |1| rahaau |
English: In the Sanctuary of the spiritual warrior, the account books of the Messenger of Death are torn up. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦੀਓ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: satigur mantru deeo har naam |
English: The True Guru has given me the Mantra of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਇਹ ਆਸਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਏ ਕਾਮ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: eih aasar pooran bhe kaam |2|
English: By this Support, my affairs have been resolved. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਪੂਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: jap tap sanjam pooree vaddiaaee |
English: Meditation, self-discipline, self-control and perfect greatness were obtained when the Merciful Lord,

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਹਰਿ ਭਏ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur kirapaal har bhe sahaaee |3|
English: The Guru, became my Help and Support. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹ ਖੋਏ ਗੁਰਿ ਭਰਮ ॥
Transliteration: maan moh khoe gur bharam |
English: The Guru has dispelled pride, emotional attachment and superstition.

Gurbani: ਪੇਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਸਰੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ॥੪॥੮੧॥੧੫੦॥
Transliteration: pekh naanak pasare paarabraham |4|81|150|
English: Nanak sees the Supreme Lord God pervading everywhere. ||4||81||150||

[Ang 196 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬਿਖੈ ਰਾਜ ਤੇ ਅੰਧੁਲਾ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: bikhai raaj te andhulaa bhaaree |
English: The blind beggar is better off than the vicious king.

Gurbani: ਦੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਿਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dukh laagai raam naam chitaaree |1|
English: Overcome by pain, the blind man invokes the Lord's Name. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਤੁਹੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: tere daas kau tuhee vaddiaaee |
English: You are the glorious greatness of Your slave.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਗਨੁ ਨਰਕਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa magan narak lai jaaee |1| rahaau |
English: The intoxication of Maya leads the others to hell. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਰੋਗ ਗਿਰਸਤ ਚਿਤਾਰੇ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: rog girasat chitaare naau |
English: Gripped by disease, they invoke the Name.

Gurbani: ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਤੇ ਕਾ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਠਾਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bikh maate kaa tthaur na tthaau |2|
English: But those who are intoxicated with vice shall find no home, no place of rest. ||2||

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal siau laagee preet |
English: One who is in love with the Lord's Lotus Feet,

Gurbani: ਆਨ ਸੁਖਾ ਨਹੀ ਆਵਹਿ ਚੀਤਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aan sukhaa nahee aaveh cheet |3|
English: does not think of any other comforts. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਿਮਰਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa simrau prabh suaamee |
English: Forever and ever, meditate on God, your Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥੪॥੮੨॥੧੫੧॥
Transliteration: mil naanak har antarajaamee |4|82|151|
English: O Nanak, meet with the Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||4||82||151||

[Ang 196 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਸੰਗੀ ਬਟਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar sangee battavaare |
English: Twenty-four hours a day, the highway robbers are my companions.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਲਏ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh le nivaare |1|
English: Granting His Grace, God has driven them away. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਰਮਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa har ras ramahu sabh koe |
English: Everyone should dwell on the Sweet Name of such a Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sarab kalaa pooran prabh soe |1| rahaau |
English: God is overflowing with all power. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਤਪਤਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: mahaa tapat saagar sansaar |
English: The world-ocean is burning hot!

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਣਹਾਰ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: prabh khin meh paar utaaranahaar |2|
English: In an instant, God saves us, and carries us across. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋਰੇ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: anik bandhan tore nahee jaeh |
English: There are so many bonds, they cannot be broken.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਫਲ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: simarat naam mukat fal paeh |3|
English: Remembering the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the fruit of liberation is obtained. ||3||

Gurbani: ਉਕਤਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਇਸ ਤੇ ਕਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: aukat siaanap is te kachh naeh |
English: By clever devices, nothing is accomplished.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹਿ ॥੪॥੮੩॥੧੫੨॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa naanak gun gaeh |4|83|152|
English: Grant Your Grace to Nanak, that he may sing the Glories of God. ||4||83||152||

[Ang 196 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਥਾਤੀ ਪਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: thaatee paaee har ko naam |
English: Those who obtain the wealth of the Lord's Name

Gurbani: ਬਿਚਰੁ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bichar sansaar pooran sabh kaam |1|
English: move freely in the world; all their affairs are resolved. ||1||

Gurbani: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: vaddabhaagee har keeratan gaaeeai |
English: By great good fortune, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises are sung.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਤ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham toon dehi ta paaeeai |1| rahaau |
English: O Supreme Lord God, as You give, so do I receive. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: har ke charan hiradai ur dhaar |
English: Enshrine the Lord's Feet within your heart.

Gurbani: ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਚੜਿ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bhav saagar charr utareh paar |2|
English: Get aboard this boat, and cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: saadhoo sang karahu sabh koe |
English: Everyone who joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy,

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sadaa kaliaan fir dookh na hoe |3|
English: obtains eternal peace; pain does not afflict them any longer. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਜੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: prem bhagat bhaj gunee nidhaan |
English: With loving devotional worship, meditate on the treasure of excellence.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੪॥੮੪॥੧੫੩॥
Transliteration: naanak daragah paaeeai maan |4|84|153|
English: O Nanak, you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord. ||4||84||153||

[Ang 196 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: jal thal maheeal pooran har meet |
English: The Lord, our Friend, is totally pervading the water, the land and the skies.

Gurbani: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਗਾਏ ਗੁਣ ਨੀਤ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bhram binase gaae gun neet |1|
English: Doubts are dispelled by continually singing the Lord's Glorious Praises. ||1||

Gurbani: ਊਠਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਹਰੂਆ ॥
Transliteration: aootthat sovat har sang paharooaa |
English: While rising up, and while lying down in sleep, the Lord is always with you, watching over you.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ ਜਮ ਨਹੀ ਡਰੂਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai simaran jam nahee ddarooaa |1| rahaau |
English: Remembering Him in meditation, the fear of Death departs. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal prabh ridai nivaas |
English: With God's Lotus Feet abiding in the heart,

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਦੂਖ ਕਾ ਹੋਇਆ ਨਾਸੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sagal dookh kaa hoeaa naas |2|
English: all suffering comes to an end. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਾਣੁ ਤਾਣੁ ਧਨੁ ਏਕ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa maan taan dhan ek |
English: The One Lord is my hope, honor, power and wealth.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਹ ਕੀ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਟੇਕ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: saache saah kee man meh ttek |3|
English: Within my mind is the Support of the True Banker. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਗਰੀਬ ਜਨ ਸਾਧ ਅਨਾਥ ॥
Transliteration: mahaa gareeb jan saadh anaath |
English: I am the poorest and most helpless servant of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਦੇ ਹਾਥ ॥੪॥੮੫॥੧੫੪॥
Transliteration: naanak prabh raakhe de haath |4|85|154|
English: O Nanak, giving me His Hand, God has protected me. ||4||85||154||

[Ang 197 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਜਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਸੂਚੇ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam majan kar sooche |
English: Taking my cleansing bath in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I have been purified.

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਗ੍ਰਹਣ ਪੁੰਨ ਫਲ ਮੂਚੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kott grahan pun fal mooche |1| rahaau |
English: Its reward surpasses the giving of charity at millions of solar eclipses. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਰਿਦੇ ਮਹਿ ਬਸੇ ॥
Transliteration: har ke charan ride meh base |
English: With the Lord's Feet abiding in the heart,

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਨਸੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: janam janam ke kilavikh nase |1|
English: the sinful mistakes of countless incarnations are removed. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang keeratan fal paaeaa |
English: I have obtained the reward of the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jam kaa maarag drisatt na aaeaa |2|
English: I no longer have to gaze upon the way of death. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: man bach kram govind adhaar |
English: In thought, word and deed, seek the Support of the Lord of the Universe;

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਛੁਟਿਓ ਬਿਖੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: taa te chhuttio bikh sansaar |3|
English: thus you shall be saved from the poisonous world-ocean. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨੋ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh keeno apanaa |
English: Granting His Grace, God has made me His Own.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਪੁ ਜਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨਾ ॥੪॥੮੬॥੧੫੫॥
Transliteration: naanak jaap jape har japanaa |4|86|155|
English: Nanak chants and meditates on the Chant of the Lord's Name. ||4||86||155||

[Ang 197 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪਉ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: pau saranaaee jin har jaate |
English: Seek the Sanctuary of those who have come to know the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਚਰਣ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: man tan seetal charan har raate |1|
English: Your mind and body shall become cool and peaceful, imbued with the Feet of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਨਿ ਨ ਬਸਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: bhai bhanjan prabh man na basaahee |
English: If God, the Destroyer of fear, does not dwell within your mind,

Gurbani: ਡਰਪਤ ਡਰਪਤ ਜਨਮ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ddarapat ddarapat janam bahut jaahee |1| rahaau |
English: you shall spend countless incarnations in fear and dread. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai ridai basio har naam |
English: Those who have the Lord's Name dwelling within their hearts

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sagal manorath taa ke pooran kaam |2|
English: have all their desires and tasks fulfilled. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਨਮੁ ਜਰਾ ਮਿਰਤੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: janam jaraa mirat jis vaas |
English: Birth, old age and death are in His Power,

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: so samarath simar saas giraas |3|
English: so remember that All-powerful Lord with each breath and morsel of food. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮੀਤੁ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਸਖਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕ ॥
Transliteration: meet saajan sakhaa prabh ek |
English: The One God is my Intimate, Best Friend and Companion.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਟੇਕ ॥੪॥੮੭॥੧੫੬॥
Transliteration: naam suaamee kaa naanak ttek |4|87|156|
English: The Naam, the Name of my Lord and Master, is Nanak's only Support. ||4||87||156||

[Ang 197 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: baahar raakhio ridai samaal |
English: When they are out and about, they keep Him enshrined in their hearts;

Gurbani: ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਲੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ghar aae govind lai naal |1|
English: returning home, the Lord of the Universe is still with them. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam santan kai sang |
English: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is the Companion of His Saints.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਰਾਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: man tan raataa raam kai rang |1| rahaau |
English: Their minds and bodies are imbued with the Love of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee saagar tariaa |
English: By Guru's Grace, one crosses over the world-ocean;

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਸਭਿ ਹਿਰਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: janam janam ke kilavikh sabh hiriaa |2|
English: the sinful mistakes of countless incarnations are all washed away. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੋਭਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਭਗਵੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: sobhaa surat naam bhagavant |
English: Honor and intuitive awareness are acquired through the Name of the Lord God.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮੰਤੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: poore gur kaa niramal mant |3|
English: The Teachings of the Perfect Guru are immaculate and pure. ||3||

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal hirade meh jaap |
English: Within your heart, meditate on the His Lotus Feet.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪੇਖਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥੪॥੮੮॥੧੫੭॥
Transliteration: naanak pekh jeevai parataap |4|88|157|
English: Nanak lives by beholding the Lord's Expansive Power. ||4||88||157||

[Ang 197 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਇਹੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: dhan ihu thaan govind gun gaae |
English: Blessed is this place, where the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe are sung.

Gurbani: ਕੁਸਲ ਖੇਮ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਬਸਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kusal khem prabh aap basaae |1| rahaau |
English: God Himself bestows peace and pleasure. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਿਪਤਿ ਤਹਾ ਜਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: bipat tahaa jahaa har simaran naahee |
English: Misfortune occurs where the Lord is not remembered in meditation.

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਅਨੰਦ ਜਹ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kott anand jeh har gun gaahee |1|
English: There are millions of joys where the Glorious Praises of the Lord are sung. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਿਐ ਦੁਖ ਰੋਗ ਘਨੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har bisariai dukh rog ghanere |
English: Forgetting the Lord, all sorts of pains and diseases come.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੇਵਾ ਜਮੁ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਨੇਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: prabh sevaa jam lagai na nere |2|
English: Serving God, the Messenger of Death will not even approach you. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: so vaddabhaagee nihachal thaan |
English: Very blessed, stable and sublime is that place,

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਜਪੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jeh japeeai prabh keval naam |3|
English: where the Name of God alone is chanted. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਜਾਈਐ ਤਹ ਨਾਲਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: jeh jaaeeai teh naal meraa suaamee |
English: Wherever I go, my Lord and Master is with me.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥੪॥੮੯॥੧੫੮॥
Transliteration: naanak kau miliaa antarajaamee |4|89|158|
English: Nanak has met the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||4||89||158||

[Ang 197 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jo praanee govind dhiaavai |
English: That mortal who meditates on the Lord of the Universe,

Gurbani: ਪੜਿਆ ਅਣਪੜਿਆ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: parriaa anaparriaa param gat paavai |1|
English: whether educated or uneducated, obtains the state of supreme dignity. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: saadhoo sang simar gopaal |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, meditate on the Lord of the World.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਝੂਠਾ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bin naavai jhootthaa dhan maal |1| rahaau |
English: Without the Name, wealth and property are false. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਰੂਪਵੰਤੁ ਸੋ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਸਿਆਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: roopavant so chatur siaanaa |
English: They alone are handsome, clever and wise,

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jin jan maaniaa prabh kaa bhaanaa |2|
English: who surrender to the Will of God. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: jag meh aaeaa so paravaan |
English: Blessed is their coming into this world,

Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਅਪਣਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt apanaa suaamee jaan |3|
English: if they recognize their Lord and Master in each and every heart. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਾਗ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak jaa ke pooran bhaag |
English: Says Nanak, their good fortune is perfect,

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗ ॥੪॥੯੦॥੧੫੯॥
Transliteration: har charanee taa kaa man laag |4|90|159|
English: if they enshrine the Lord's Feet within their minds. ||4||90||159||

[Ang 198 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਸਿਉ ਸਾਕਤ ਨਹੀ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: har ke daas siau saakat nahee sang |
English: The Lord's servant does not associate with the faithless cynic.

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਬਿਖਈ ਓਸੁ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਰੰਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ohu bikhee os raam ko rang |1| rahaau |
English: One is in the clutches of vice, while the other is in love with the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਅਸਵਾਰ ਜੈਸੇ ਤੁਰੀ ਸੀਗਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: man asavaar jaise turee seegaaree |
English: It would be like an imaginary rider on a decorated horse,

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਕਾਪੁਰਖੁ ਪੁਚਾਰੈ ਨਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jiau kaapurakh puchaarai naaree |1|
English: or a eunuch caressing a woman. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬੈਲ ਕਉ ਨੇਤ੍ਰਾ ਪਾਇ ਦੁਹਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: bail kau netraa paae duhaavai |
English: It would be like tying up an ox and trying to milk it,

Gurbani: ਗਊ ਚਰਿ ਸਿੰਘ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gaoo char singh paachhai paavai |2|
English: or riding a cow to chase a tiger. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗਾਡਰ ਲੇ ਕਾਮਧੇਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਪੂਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaaddar le kaamadhen kar poojee |
English: It would be like taking a sheep and worshipping it as the Elysian cow,

Gurbani: ਸਉਦੇ ਕਉ ਧਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਪੂੰਜੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: saude kau dhaavai bin poonjee |3|
English: the giver of all blessings; it would be like going out shopping without any money. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਚੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: naanak raam naam jap cheet |
English: O Nanak, consciously meditate on the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਾ ਮੀਤ ॥੪॥੯੧॥੧੬੦॥
Transliteration: simar suaamee har saa meet |4|91|160|
English: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord Master, your Best Friend. ||4||91||160||

[Ang 198 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਮਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਹੀਅਤ ਧੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: saa mat niramal kaheeat dheer |
English: Pure and steady is that intellect,

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਪੀਵਤ ਬੀਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: raam rasaaein peevat beer |1|
English: which drinks in the Lord's sublime essence. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਰਿ ਓਟ ॥
Transliteration: har ke charan hiradai kar ott |
English: Keep the Support of the Lord's Feet in your heart,

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਤੇ ਹੋਵਤ ਛੋਟ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: janam maran te hovat chhott |1| rahaau |
English: and you shall be saved from the cycle of birth and death. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਨ ਪਾਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: so tan niramal jit upajai na paap |
English: Pure is that body, in which sin does not arise.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: raam rang niramal parataap |2|
English: In the Love of the Lord is pure glory. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਟਿ ਜਾਤ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang mitt jaat bikaar |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, corruption is eradicated.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਏਹੋ ਉਪਕਾਰ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sabh te aooch eho upakaar |3|
English: This is the greatest blessing of all. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: prem bhagat raate gopaal |
English: Imbued with loving devotional worship of the Sustainer of the Universe,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਚੈ ਸਾਧ ਰਵਾਲ ॥੪॥੯੨॥੧੬੧॥
Transliteration: naanak jaachai saadh ravaal |4|92|161|
English: Nanak asks for the dust of the feet of the Holy. ||4||92||161||

[Ang 198 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਐਸੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: aisee preet govind siau laagee |
English: Such is my love for the Lord of the Universe;

Gurbani: ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਪੂਰਨ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mel le pooran vaddabhaagee |1| rahaau |
English: through perfect good destiny, I have been united with Him. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਭਰਤਾ ਪੇਖਿ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਜਿਉ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: bharataa pekh bigasai jiau naaree |
English: As the wife is delighted upon beholding her husband,

Gurbani: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਿਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tiau har jan jeevai naam chitaaree |1|
English: so does the Lord's humble servant live by chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪੂਤ ਪੇਖਿ ਜਿਉ ਜੀਵਤ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: poot pekh jiau jeevat maataa |
English: As the mother is rejuvenated upon seeing her son,

Gurbani: ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ot pot jan har siau raataa |2|
English: so is the Lord's humble servant imbued with Him, through and through. ||2||

Gurbani: ਲੋਭੀ ਅਨਦੁ ਕਰੈ ਪੇਖਿ ਧਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: lobhee anad karai pekh dhanaa |
English: As the greedy man rejoices upon beholding his wealth,

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੋ ਮਨਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jan charan kamal siau laago manaa |3|
English: so is the mind of the Lord's humble servant attached to His Lotus Feet. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬਿਸਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਦਾਤਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: bisar nahee ik til daataar |
English: May I never forget You, for even an instant, O Great Giver!

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰ ॥੪॥੯੩॥੧੬੨॥
Transliteration: naanak ke prabh praan adhaar |4|93|162|
English: Nanak's God is the Support of his breath of life. ||4||93||162||

[Ang 198 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣਿ ਜੋ ਜਨ ਗੀਧੇ ॥
Transliteration: raam rasaaein jo jan geedhe |
English: Those humble beings who are accustomed to the Lord's sublime essence,

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤੀ ਬੀਧੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal prem bhagatee beedhe |1| rahaau |
English: are pierced through with loving devotional worship of the Lord's Lotus Feet. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਨ ਰਸਾ ਦੀਸਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: aan rasaa deeseh sabh chhaar |
English: All other pleasures look like ashes;

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naam binaa nihafal sansaar |1|
English: without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the world is fruitless. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਕਾਢੇ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: andh koop te kaadte aap |
English: He Himself rescues us from the deep dark well.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਅਚਰਜ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gun govind acharaj parataap |2|
English: Wondrous and Glorious are the Praises of the Lord of the Universe. ||2||

Gurbani: ਵਣਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਣਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: van trin tribhavan pooran gopaal |
English: In the woods and meadows, and throughout the three worlds, the Sustainer of the Universe is pervading.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਸਾਰੁ ਜੀਅ ਸੰਗਿ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: braham pasaar jeea sang deaal |3|
English: The Expansive Lord God is Merciful to all beings. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾ ਕਥਨੀ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak saa kathanee saar |
English: Says Nanak, that speech alone is excellent,

Gurbani: ਮਾਨਿ ਲੇਤੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੯੪॥੧੬੩॥
Transliteration: maan let jis sirajanahaar |4|94|163|
English: which is approved by the Creator Lord. ||4||94||163||

[Ang 198 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਿਤਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਨਾਵਣੁ ਰਾਮ ਸਰਿ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: nitaprat naavan raam sar keejai |
English: Every day, take your bath in the Sacred Pool of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਝੋਲਿ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jhol mahaa ras har amrit peejai |1| rahaau |
English: Mix and drink in the most delicious, sublime Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਉਦਕੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕਾ ਨਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: niramal udak govind kaa naam |
English: The water of the Name of the Lord of the Universe is immaculate and pure.

Gurbani: ਮਜਨੁ ਕਰਤ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: majan karat pooran sabh kaam |1|
English: Take your cleansing bath in it, and all your affairs shall be resolved. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਤਹ ਗੋਸਟਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: santasang teh gosatt hoe |
English: In the Society of the Saints, spiritual conversations take place.

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਖੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kott janam ke kilavikh khoe |2|
English: The sinful mistakes of millions of incarnations are erased. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸਾਧ ਕਰਹਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: simareh saadh kareh aanand |
English: The Holy Saints meditate in remembrance, in ecstasy.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: man tan raviaa paramaanand |3|
English: Their minds and bodies are immersed in supreme ecstasy. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: jiseh paraapat har charan nidhaan |
English: Slave Nanak is a sacrifice to those

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ॥੪॥੯੫॥੧੬੪॥
Transliteration: naanak daas tiseh kurabaan |4|95|164|
English: Who have obtained the treasure of the Lord's Feet. ||4||95||164||

[Ang 199 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: so kichh kar jit mail na laagai |
English: Do only that, by which no filth or pollution shall stick to you.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har keeratan meh ehu man jaagai |1| rahaau |
English: Let your mind remain awake and aware, singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: eko simar na doojaa bhaau |
English: Meditate in remembrance on the One Lord; do not be in love with duality.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਜਪਿ ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: santasang jap keval naau |1|
English: In the Society of the Saints, chant only the Name. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਨੇਮ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: karam dharam nem brat poojaa |
English: The karma of good actions, the Dharma of righteous living, religious rituals, fasts and worship

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਾਨੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: paarabraham bin jaan na doojaa |2|
English: - practice these, but do not know any other than the Supreme Lord God. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਘਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: taa kee pooran hoee ghaal |
English: Their works are brought to fruition,

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jaa kee preet apune prabh naal |3|
English: if they place their love in God. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਬੈਸਨੋ ਹੈ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: so baisano hai apar apaar |
English: Infinitely invaluable is that Vaishnaav, that worshipper of Vishnu,

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਤਜੇ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥੪॥੯੬॥੧੬੫॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak jin taje bikaar |4|96|165|
English: says Nanak, who has renounced corruption. ||4||96||165||

[Ang 199 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਤ ਛਾਡਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਦੇਵਾਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: jeevat chhaadd jaeh devaane |
English: They desert you even when you are alive, O madman;

Gurbani: ਮੁਇਆ ਉਨ ਤੇ ਕੋ ਵਰਸਾਂਨੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mueaa un te ko varasaane |1|
English: what good can they do when someone is dead? ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: simar govind man tan dhur likhiaa |
English: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord of the Universe in your mind and body - this is your pre-ordained destiny.

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੂ ਕਾਜ ਨ ਆਵਤ ਬਿਖਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kaahoo kaaj na aavat bikhiaa |1| rahaau |
English: The poison of Maya is of no use at all. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਿਖੈ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਖਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: bikhai tthgauree jin jin khaaee |
English: Those who have eaten this poison of deception

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: taa kee trisanaa kabahoon na jaaee |2|
English: - their thirst shall never depart. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦਾਰਨ ਦੁਖ ਦੁਤਰ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: daaran dukh dutar sansaar |
English: The treacherous world-ocean is filled with terrible pain.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: raam naam bin kaise utaras paar |3|
English: Without the Lord's Name, how can anyone cross over? ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਦੁਇ ਕੁਲ ਸਾਧਿ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang mil due kul saadh |
English: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall be saved here and hereafter.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਰਾਧਿ ॥੪॥੯੭॥੧੬੬॥
Transliteration: raam naam naanak aaraadh |4|97|166|
English: O Nanak, worship and adore the Name of the Lord. ||4||97||166||

[Ang 199 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗਰੀਬਾ ਉਪਰਿ ਜਿ ਖਿੰਜੈ ਦਾੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: gareebaa upar ji khinjai daarree |
English: The bearded emperor who struck down the poor,

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਸਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਸਾੜੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: paarabraham saa agan meh saarree |1|
English: has been burnt in the fire by the Supreme Lord God. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਾ ਨਿਆਉ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: pooraa niaau kare karataar |
English: The Creator administers true justice.

Gurbani: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: apune daas kau raakhanahaar |1| rahaau |
English: He is the Saving Grace of His slaves. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: aad jugaad pragatt parataap |
English: In the beginning, and throughout the ages, His glory is manifest.

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਮੁਆ ਉਪਜਿ ਵਡ ਤਾਪੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: nindak muaa upaj vadd taap |2|
English: The slanderer died after contracting the deadly fever. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤਿਨਿ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਜਿ ਰਖੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: tin maariaa ji rakhai na koe |
English: He is killed, and no one can save him.

Gurbani: ਆਗੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਮੰਦੀ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aagai paachhai mandee soe |3|
English: Here and hereafter, his reputation is evil. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਰਾਖੈ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: apune daas raakhai kantth laae |
English: The Lord hugs His slaves close in His Embrace.

Gurbani: ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੪॥੯੮॥੧੬੭॥
Transliteration: saran naanak har naam dhiaae |4|98|167|
English: Nanak seeks the Lord's Sanctuary, and meditates on the Naam. ||4||98||167||

[Ang 199 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਹਜਰੁ ਝੂਠਾ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: mahajar jhootthaa keeton aap |
English: The memorandum was proven to be false by the Lord Himself.

Gurbani: ਪਾਪੀ ਕਉ ਲਾਗਾ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: paapee kau laagaa santaap |1|
English: The sinner is now suffering in despair. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jiseh sahaaee gobid meraa |
English: Those who have my Lord of the Universe as their support

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਕਉ ਜਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ਨੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tis kau jam nahee aavai neraa |1| rahaau |
English: - death does not even approach them. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਬੋਲੈ ਕੂੜੁ ॥
Transliteration: saachee daragah bolai koorr |
English: In the True Court, they lie;

Gurbani: ਸਿਰੁ ਹਾਥ ਪਛੋੜੈ ਅੰਧਾ ਮੂੜੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sir haath pachhorrai andhaa moorr |2|
English: the blind fools strike their own heads with their own hands. ||2||

Gurbani: ਰੋਗ ਬਿਆਪੇ ਕਰਦੇ ਪਾਪ ॥
Transliteration: rog biaape karade paap |
English: Sickness afflicts those who commit sins;

Gurbani: ਅਦਲੀ ਹੋਇ ਬੈਠਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: adalee hoe baitthaa prabh aap |3|
English: God Himself sits as the Judge. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅਪਨ ਕਮਾਇਐ ਆਪੇ ਬਾਧੇ ॥
Transliteration: apan kamaaeiai aape baadhe |
English: By their own actions, they are bound and gagged.

Gurbani: ਦਰਬੁ ਗਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਸਾਥੈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: darab geaa sabh jeea kai saathai |4|
English: All their wealth is gone, along with their lives. ||4||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੇ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: naanak saran pare darabaar |
English: Nanak has taken to the Sanctuary of the Lord's Court;

Gurbani: ਰਾਖੀ ਪੈਜ ਮੇਰੈ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥੫॥੯੯॥੧੬੮॥
Transliteration: raakhee paij merai karataar |5|99|168|
English: my Creator has preserved my honor. ||5||99||168||

[Ang 199 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਮਨ ਮੀਠ ਖਟਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: jan kee dhoor man meetth khattaanee |
English: The dust of the feet of the humble beings is so sweet to my mind.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਕਰਮਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: poorab karam likhiaa dhur praanee |1| rahaau |
English: Perfect karma is the mortal's pre-ordained destiny. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਮਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਥਿਧਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ahanbudh man poor thidhaaee |
English: The mind is overflowing with the greasy dirt of egotistical pride.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਧੂਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਸੁਧ ਮੰਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saadh dhoor kar sudh manjaaee |1|
English: With the dust of the feet of the Holy, it is scrubbed clean. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਲਾ ਜੇ ਧੋਵੈ ਦੇਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: anik jalaa je dhovai dehee |
English: The body may be washed with loads of water,

Gurbani: ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਸੁਧੁ ਨ ਤੇਹੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mail na utarai sudh na tehee |2|
English: and yet its filth is not removed, and it does not become clean. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਸਦਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: satigur bhettio sadaa kripaal |
English: I have met the True Guru, who is merciful forever.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਕਾਟਿਆ ਭਉ ਕਾਲ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har simar simar kaattiaa bhau kaal |3|
English: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Lord, I am rid of the fear of death. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mukat bhugat jugat har naau |
English: Liberation, pleasures and worldly success are all in the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੪॥੧੦੦॥੧੬੯॥
Transliteration: prem bhagat naanak gun gaau |4|100|169|
English: With loving devotional worship, O Nanak, sing His Glorious Praises. ||4||100||169||

[Ang 200 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦਵੀ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: jeevan padavee har ke daas |
English: The Lord's slaves attain the highest status of life.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਤਮ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jin miliaa aatam paragaas |1|
English: Meeting them, the soul is enlightened. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਸੁਨਿ ਮਨ ਕਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa simaran sun man kaanee |
English: Those who listen with their mind and ears to the Lord's meditative remembrance,

Gurbani: ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sukh paaveh har duaar paraanee |1| rahaau |
English: are blessed with peace at the Lord's Gate, O mortal. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਗੋਪਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar dhiaaeeai gopaal |
English: Twenty-four hours a day, meditate on the Sustainer of the World.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥੨॥੧੦੧॥੧੭੦॥
Transliteration: naanak darasan dekh nihaal |2|101|170|
English: O Nanak, gazing on the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, I am enraptured. ||2||101||170||

[Ang 200 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਭਈ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਬਿਦਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: saant bhee gur gobid paaee |
English: Peace and tranquility have come; the Guru, the Lord of the Universe, has brought it.

Gurbani: ਤਾਪ ਪਾਪ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: taap paap binase mere bhaaee |1| rahaau |
English: The burning sins have departed, O my Siblings of Destiny. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਤ ਰਸਨ ਬਖਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam nit rasan bakhaan |
English: With your tongue, continually chant the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਸੇ ਰੋਗ ਭਏ ਕਲਿਆਨ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: binase rog bhe kaliaan |1|
English: Disease shall depart, and you shall be saved. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਣ ਅਗਮ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham gun agam beechaar |
English: Contemplate the Glorious Virtues of the Unfathomable Supreme Lord God.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਮਿ ਹੈ ਨਿਸਤਾਰ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saadhoo sangam hai nisataar |2|
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall be emancipated. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਨੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: niramal gun gaavahu nit neet |
English: Sing the Glories of God each and every day;

Gurbani: ਗਈ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਨ ਮੀਤ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gee biaadh ubare jan meet |3|
English: your afflictions shall be dispelled, and you shall be saved, my humble friend. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: man bach kram prabh apanaa dhiaaee |
English: In thought, word and deed, I meditate on my God.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੦੨॥੧੭੧॥
Transliteration: naanak daas teree saranaaee |4|102|171|
English: Slave Nanak has come to Your Sanctuary. ||4||102||171||

[Ang 200 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਕੀਆ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: netr pragaas keea guradev |
English: The Divine Guru has opened his eyes.

Gurbani: ਭਰਮ ਗਏ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਈ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bharam ge pooran bhee sev |1| rahaau |
English: Doubt has been dispelled; my service has been successful. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੀਤਲਾ ਤੇ ਰਖਿਆ ਬਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: seetalaa te rakhiaa bihaaree |
English: The Giver of joy has saved him from smallpox.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: paarabraham prabh kirapaa dhaaree |1|
English: The Supreme Lord God has granted His Grace. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਸੋ ਜੀਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: naanak naam japai so jeevai |
English: O Nanak, he alone lives, who chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੈ ॥੨॥੧੦੩॥੧੭੨॥
Transliteration: saadhasang har amrit peevai |2|103|172|
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, drink deeply of the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar. ||2||103||172||

[Ang 200 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਓਹੁ ਮਸਤਕੁ ਧਨੁ ਤੇਰੇ ਨੇਤ ॥
Transliteration: dhan ohu masatak dhan tere net |
English: Blessed is that forehead, and blessed are those eyes;

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਓਇ ਭਗਤ ਜਿਨ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੇਤ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dhan oe bhagat jin tum sang het |1|
English: blessed are those devotees who are in love with You. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਲਹੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: naam binaa kaise sukh laheeai |
English: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, how anyone find peace?

Gurbani: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਜਸੁ ਕਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: rasanaa raam naam jas kaheeai |1| rahaau |
English: With your tongue, chant the Praises of the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: tin aoopar jaaeeai kurabaan |
English: Nanak is a sacrifice to those

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ॥੨॥੧੦੪॥੧੭੩॥
Transliteration: naanak jin japiaa nirabaan |2|104|173|
English: who meditate on the Lord of Nirvaanaa. ||2||104||173||

[Ang 200 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤੂੰਹੈ ਮਸਲਤਿ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: toonhai masalat toonhai naal |
English: You are my Advisor; You are always with me.

Gurbani: ਤੂਹੈ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: toohai raakheh saar samaal |1|
English: You preserve, protect and care for me. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਨੀ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa raam deen dunee sahaaee |
English: Such is the Lord, our Help and Support in this world and the next.

Gurbani: ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: daas kee paij rakhai mere bhaaee |1| rahaau |
English: He protects the honor of His slave, O my Sibling of Destiny. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਗੈ ਆਪਿ ਇਹੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਵਸਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ॥
Transliteration: aagai aap ihu thaan vas jaa kai |
English: He alone exists hereafter; this place is in His Power.

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਉ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar man har kau jaapai |2|
English: Twenty-four hours a day, O my mind, chant and meditate on the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਸਚੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: pat paravaan sach neesaan |
English: His honor is acknowledged, and he bears the True Insignia;

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jaa kau aap kareh furamaan |3|
English: the Lord Himself issues His Royal Command. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਦਾਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: aape daataa aap pratipaal |
English: He Himself is the Giver; He Himself is the Cherisher.

Gurbani: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੪॥੧੦੫॥੧੭੪॥
Transliteration: nit nit naanak raam naam samaal |4|105|174|
English: Continually, continuously, O Nanak, dwell upon the Name of the Lord. ||4||105||174||

[Ang 200 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭਇਆ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: satigur pooraa bheaa kripaal |
English: When the Perfect True Guru becomes merciful,

Gurbani: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਪਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: hiradai vasiaa sadaa gupaal |1|
English: the Lord of the World abides in the heart forever. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵਤ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: raam ravat sad hee sukh paaeaa |
English: Meditating on the Lord, I have found eternal peace.

Gurbani: ਮਇਆ ਕਰੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: meaa karee pooran har raaeaa |1| rahaau |
English: The Sovereign Lord, the Perfect King, has shown His Mercy to me. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਭਾਗ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak jaa ke poore bhaag |
English: Says Nanak, one whose destiny is perfect,

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ॥੨॥੧੦੬॥
Transliteration: har har naam asathir sohaag |2|106|
English: meditates on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the Everlasting Husband. ||2||106||

[Ang 201 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਧੋਤੀ ਖੋਲਿ ਵਿਛਾਏ ਹੇਠਿ ॥
Transliteration: dhotee khol vichhaae hetth |
English: He opens his loin-cloth, and spreads it out beneath him.

Gurbani: ਗਰਧਪ ਵਾਂਗੂ ਲਾਹੇ ਪੇਟਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: garadhap vaangoo laahe pett |1|
English: Like a donkey, he gulps down all that comes his way. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਕਰਤੂਤੀ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: bin karatootee mukat na paaeeai |
English: Without good deeds, liberation is not obtained.

Gurbani: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mukat padaarath naam dhiaaeeai |1| rahaau |
English: The wealth of liberation is only obtained by meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪੂਜਾ ਤਿਲਕ ਕਰਤ ਇਸਨਾਨਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: poojaa tilak karat isanaanaan |
English: He performs worship ceremonies, applies the ceremonial tilak mark to his forehead, and takes his ritual cleansing baths;

Gurbani: ਛੁਰੀ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੇਵੈ ਹਥਿ ਦਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: chhuree kaadt levai hath daanaa |2|
English: he pulls out his knife, and demands donations. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬੇਦੁ ਪੜੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਮੀਠੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: bed parrai mukh meetthee baanee |
English: With his mouth, he recites the Vedas in sweet musical measures,

Gurbani: ਜੀਆਂ ਕੁਹਤ ਨ ਸੰਗੈ ਪਰਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jeean kuhat na sangai paraanee |3|
English: and yet he does not hesitate to take the lives of others. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak jis kirapaa dhaarai |
English: Says Nanak, when God showers His Mercy,

Gurbani: ਹਿਰਦਾ ਸੁਧੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ॥੪॥੧੦੭॥
Transliteration: hiradaa sudh braham beechaarai |4|107|
English: even his heart becomes pure, and he contemplates God. ||4||107||

[Ang 201 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਥਿਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਸਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: thir ghar baisahu har jan piaare |
English: Remain steady in the home of your own self, O beloved servant of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur tumare kaaj savaare |1| rahaau |
English: The True Guru shall resolve all your affairs. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦੁਸਟ ਦੂਤ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: dusatt doot paramesar maare |
English: The Transcendent Lord has struck down the wicked and the evil.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੀ ਕਰਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jan kee paij rakhee karataare |1|
English: The Creator has preserved the honor of His servant. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਾਦਿਸਾਹ ਸਾਹ ਸਭ ਵਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: baadisaah saah sabh vas kar deene |
English: The kings and emperors are all under his power;

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮ ਮਹਾ ਰਸ ਪੀਨੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: amrit naam mahaa ras peene |2|
English: he drinks deeply of the most sublime essence of the Ambrosial Naam. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹੋਇ ਭਜਹੁ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: nirbhau hoe bhajahu bhagavaan |
English: Meditate fearlessly on the Lord God.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੀਨੋ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: saadhasangat mil keeno daan |3|
English: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, this gift is given. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: saran pare prabh antarajaamee |
English: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of God, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts;

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਓਟ ਪਕਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੪॥੧੦੮॥
Transliteration: naanak ott pakaree prabh suaamee |4|108|
English: he grasps the Support of God, his Lord and Master. ||4||108||

[Ang 201 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਭਾਹਿ ਨ ਜਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: har sang raate bhaeh na jalai |
English: One who is attuned to the Lord, shall not be burned in the fire.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਨਹੀ ਛਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: har sang raate maaeaa nahee chhalai |
English: One who is attuned to the Lord, shall not be enticed by Maya.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਨਹੀ ਡੂਬੈ ਜਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: har sang raate nahee ddoobai jalaa |
English: One who is attuned to the Lord, shall not be drowned in water.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸੁਫਲ ਫਲਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har sang raate sufal falaa |1|
English: One who is attuned to the Lord, is prosperous and fruitful. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਭੈ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੈ ਨਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabh bhai mitteh tumaarai naae |
English: All fear is eradicated by Your Name.

Gurbani: ਭੇਟਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhettat sang har har gun gaae | rahaau |
English: Joining the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਮਿਟੈ ਸਭ ਚਿੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: har sang raate mittai sabh chintaa |
English: One who is attuned to the Lord, is free of all anxieties.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਸੋ ਰਚੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਾਧ ਕਾ ਮੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: har siau so rachai jis saadh kaa mantaa |
English: One who is attuned to the Lord, is blessed with the Mantra of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਨਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: har sang raate jam kee nahee traas |
English: One who is attuned to the Lord, is not haunted by the fear of death.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har sang raate pooran aas |2|
English: One who is attuned to the Lord, sees all his hopes fulfilled. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: har sang raate dookh na laagai |
English: One who is attuned to the Lord, does not suffer in pain.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: har sang raataa anadin jaagai |
English: One who is attuned to the Lord, remains awake and aware, night and day.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਹਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: har sang raataa sehaj ghar vasai |
English: One who is attuned to the Lord, dwells in the home of intuitive peace.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਨਸੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har sang raate bhram bhau nasai |3|
English: One who is attuned to the Lord, sees his doubts and fears run away. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: har sang raate mat aootam hoe |
English: One who is attuned to the Lord, has the most sublime and exalted intellect.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: har sang raate niramal soe |
English: One who is attuned to the Lord, has a pure and spotless reputation.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak tin kau bal jaaee |
English: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those,

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੪॥੧੦੯॥
Transliteration: jin kau prabh meraa bisarat naahee |4|109|
English: Who do not forget my God. ||4||109||

[Ang 201 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਤ ਸੀਤਲ ਮਨ ਭਏ ॥
Transliteration: audam karat seetal man bhe |
English: Through sincere efforts, the mind is made peaceful and calm.

Gurbani: ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਲਤ ਸਗਲ ਦੁਖ ਗਏ ॥
Transliteration: maarag chalat sagal dukh ge |
English: Walking on the Lord's Way, all pains are taken away.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਮਨਿ ਭਏ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: naam japat man bhe anand |
English: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind becomes blissful.

Gurbani: ਰਸਿ ਗਾਏ ਗੁਨ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ras gaae gun paramaanand |1|
English: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, supreme bliss is obtained. ||1||

Gurbani: ਖੇਮ ਭਇਆ ਕੁਸਲ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: khem bheaa kusal ghar aae |
English: There is joy all around, and peace has come to my home.

Gurbani: ਭੇਟਤ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਗਈ ਬਲਾਏ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhettat saadhasang gee balaae | rahaau |
English: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, misfortune disappears. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਪੇਖਤ ਹੀ ਦਰਸ ॥
Transliteration: netr puneet pekhat hee daras |
English: My eyes are purified, beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

Gurbani: ਧਨਿ ਮਸਤਕ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਹੀ ਪਰਸ ॥
Transliteration: dhan masatak charan kamal hee paras |
English: Blessed is the forehead which touches His Lotus Feet.

Gurbani: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਸਫਲ ਇਹ ਕਾਂਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gobind kee ttehal safal ih kaaneaa |
English: Working for the Lord of the Universe, the body becomes fruitful.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sant prasaad param pad paaeaa |2|
English: By the Grace of the Saints, I have obtained the supreme status. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਕੀਨੀ ਆਪਿ ਸਹਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jan kee keenee aap sahaae |
English: The Lord is the Help and Support of His humble servant.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਲਗਿ ਦਾਸਹ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sukh paaeaa lag daasah paae |
English: I have found peace, falling at the feet of His slaves.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਤਾ ਆਪਹਿ ਭਏ ॥
Transliteration: aap geaa taa aapeh bhe |
English: When selfishness is gone, then one becomes the Lord Himself;

Gurbani: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਕੀ ਸਰਨੀ ਪਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kripaa nidhaan kee saranee pe |3|
English: seek the Sanctuary of the treasure of mercy. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਚਾਹਤ ਸੋਈ ਜਬ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jo chaahat soee jab paaeaa |
English: When someone finds the One he has desired,

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਢੂੰਢਨ ਕਹਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tab dtoondtan kahaa ko jaaeaa |
English: then where should he go to look for Him?

Gurbani: ਅਸਥਿਰ ਭਏ ਬਸੇ ਸੁਖ ਆਸਨ ॥
Transliteration: asathir bhe base sukh aasan |
English: I have become steady and stable, and I dwell in the seat of peace.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖ ਬਾਸਨ ॥੪॥੧੧੦॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad naanak sukh baasan |4|110|
English: By Guru's Grace, Nanak has entered the home of peace. ||4||110||

[Ang 202 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਜਨ ਕੀਨੋ ਇਸਨਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: kott majan keeno isanaan |
English: The merits of taking millions of ceremonial cleansing baths,

Gurbani: ਲਾਖ ਅਰਬ ਖਰਬ ਦੀਨੋ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: laakh arab kharab deeno daan |
English: the giving of hundreds of thousands, billions and trillions in charity

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jaa man vasio har ko naam |1|
English: - these are obtained by those whose minds are filled with the Name of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਪਵਿਤ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: sagal pavit gun gaae gupaal |
English: Those who sing the Glories of the Lord of the World are totally pure.

Gurbani: ਪਾਪ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਨਿ ਦਇਆਲ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: paap mitteh saadhoo saran deaal | rahaau |
English: Their sins are erased, in the Sanctuary of the Kind and Holy Saints. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਉਰਧ ਤਪ ਸਾਧਨ ਸਾਧੇ ॥
Transliteration: bahut uradh tap saadhan saadhe |
English: The merits of performing all sorts of austere acts of penance and self-discipline,

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਲਾਭ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਲਾਧੇ ॥
Transliteration: anik laabh manorath laadhe |
English: earning huge profits and seeing one's desires fulfilled

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਸਨ ਆਰਾਧੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har har naam rasan aaraadhe |2|
English: - these are obtained by chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, with the tongue. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਬੇਦ ਬਖਾਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: sinmrit saasat bed bakhaane |
English: The merits of reciting the Simritees, the Shaastras and the Vedas,

Gurbani: ਜੋਗ ਗਿਆਨ ਸਿਧ ਸੁਖ ਜਾਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: jog giaan sidh sukh jaane |
English: knowledge of the science of Yoga, spiritual wisdom and the pleasure of miraculous spiritual powers

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਮਨ ਮਾਨੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naam japat prabh siau man maane |3|
English: - these come by surrendering the mind and meditating on the Name of God. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: agaadh bodh har agam apaare |
English: The wisdom of the Inaccessible and Infinite Lord is incomprehensible.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: naam japat naam ride beechaare |
English: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and contemplating the Naam within our hearts,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੧੧੧॥
Transliteration: naanak kau prabh kirapaa dhaare |4|111|
English: O Nanak, God has showered His Mercy upon us. ||4||111||

[Ang 202 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: simar simar simar sukh paaeaa |
English: Meditating, meditating, meditating in remembrance, I have found peace.

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਗੁਰ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: charan kamal gur ridai basaaeaa |1|
English: I have enshrined the Lotus Feet of the Guru within my heart. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur gobind paarabraham pooraa |
English: The Guru, the Lord of the Universe, the Supreme Lord God, is perfect.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tiseh araadh meraa man dheeraa | rahaau |
English: Worshipping Him, my mind has found a lasting peace. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਪਉ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: anadin jpau guroo gur naam |
English: Night and day, I meditate on the Guru, and the Name of the Guru.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਸਿਧਿ ਭਏ ਸਗਲ ਕਾਂਮ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: taa te sidh bhe sagal kaam |2|
English: Thus all my works are brought to perfection. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦਰਸਨ ਦੇਖਿ ਸੀਤਲ ਮਨ ਭਏ ॥
Transliteration: darasan dekh seetal man bhe |
English: Beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, my mind has become cool and tranquil,

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਗਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: janam janam ke kilabikh ge |3|
English: and the sinful mistakes of countless incarnations have been washed away. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਾ ਭੈ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak kahaa bhai bhaaee |
English: Says Nanak, where is fear now, O Siblings of Destiny?

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਆਪਿ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੧੨॥
Transliteration: apane sevak kee aap paij rakhaaee |4|112|
English: The Guru Himself has preserved the honor of His servant. ||4||112||

[Ang 202 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਆਪਿ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: apane sevak kau aap sahaaee |
English: The Lord Himself is the Help and Support of His servants.

Gurbani: ਨਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰੈ ਬਾਪ ਜੈਸੇ ਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: nit pratipaarai baap jaise maaee |1|
English: He always cherishes them, like their father and mother. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਉਬਰੈ ਸਭ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kee saran ubarai sabh koe |
English: In God's Sanctuary, everyone is saved.

Gurbani: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: karan karaavan pooran sach soe | rahaau |
English: That Perfect True Lord is the Doer, the Cause of causes. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਮਨਿ ਬਸਿਆ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: ab man basiaa karanaihaaraa |
English: My mind now dwells in the Creator Lord.

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਆਤਮ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bhai binase aatam sukh saaraa |2|
English: My fears have been dispelled, and my soul has found the most sublime peace. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪਨੇ ਜਨ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa apane jan raakhe |
English: The Lord has granted His Grace, and saved His humble servant.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਲਾਥੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: janam janam ke kilabikh laathe |3|
English: The sinful mistakes of so many incarnations have been washed away. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: kehan na jaae prabh kee vaddiaaee |
English: The Greatness of God cannot be described.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਦਾ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੧੩॥
Transliteration: naanak daas sadaa saranaaee |4|113|
English: Servant Nanak is forever in His Sanctuary. ||4||113||

[Ang 202 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਚੇਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: raag gaurree chetee mahalaa 5 dupade |
English: Raag Gauree Chaytee, Fifth Mehl, Dho-Padhay:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
