English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਬਲੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: raam ko bal pooran bhaaee |
English: The power of the Lord is universal and perfect, O Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਕਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: taa te brithaa na biaapai kaaee |1| rahaau |
English: So no pain can ever afflict me. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਦਾਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jo jo chitavai daas har maaee |
English: Whatever the Lord's slave wishes, O mother,

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: so so karataa aap karaaee |1|
English: the Creator Himself causes that to be done. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: nindak kee prabh pat gavaaee |
English: God causes the slanderers to lose their honor.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਗਾਈ ॥੨॥੧੧੪॥
Transliteration: naanak har gun nirbhau gaaee |2|114|
English: Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Fearless Lord. ||2||114||

[Ang 203 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਭੁਜ ਬਲ ਬੀਰ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਗਰਤ ਪਰਤ ਗਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਅੰਗੁਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhuj bal beer braham sukh saagar garat parat geh lehu angureea |1| rahaau |
English: O Brave and Powerful God, Ocean of Peace, I fell into the pit - please, take my hand. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰਵਨਿ ਨ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨੈਨ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਨਹੀ ਆਰਤ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਰਟਤ ਪਿੰਗੁਰੀਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sravan na surat nain sundar nahee aarat duaar rattat pingureea |1|
English: My ears do not hear, and my eyes are not beautiful. I am in such pain; I am a poor cripple, crying at Your Door. ||1||

Gurbani: ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਅਨਾਥ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਸਾਜਨ ਮੀਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਹਤਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: deenaa naath anaath karunaa mai saajan meet pitaa mahatareea |
English: O Master of the poor and helpless, O Embodiment of Compassion, You are my Friend and Intimate, my Father and Mother.

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਵਲ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਤ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਰੀਆ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੧੫॥
Transliteration: charan kaval hiradai geh naanak bhai saagar sant paar utareea |2|2|115|
English: Nanak holds tight to the Lord's Lotus Feet in his heart; thus the Saints cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||2||115||

[Ang 203 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raag gaurree bairaagan mahalaa 5 |
English: Raag Gauree Bairaagan, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਦਯ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਮੀਤੁਲਾ ਤੂੰ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਬਾਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: day gusaaee meetulaa toon sang hamaarai baas jeeo |1| rahaau |
English: O Dear Lord God, my Best Friend, please, abide with me. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਘਰੀ ਨ ਜੀਵਨਾ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਰਹਣਾ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: tujh bin gharee na jeevanaa dhrig rahanaa sansaar |
English: Without You, I cannot live, even for an instant, and my life in this world is cursed.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਿਆ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿ ਜੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jeea praan sukhadaatiaa nimakh nimakh balihaar jee |1|
English: O Breath of Life of the soul, O Giver of peace, each and every instant I am a sacrifice to You. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਸਤ ਅਲੰਬਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗਰਤਹੁ ਉਧਰੁ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: hasat alanban dehu prabh garatahu udhar gopaal |
English: Please, God, give me the Support of Your Hand; lift me up and pull me out of this pit, O Lord of the World.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਮਤਿ ਥੋਰੀਆ ਤੂੰ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mohi niragun mat thoreea toon sad hee deen deaal |2|
English: I am worthless, with such a shallow intellect; You are always Merciful to the meek. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਸੁਖ ਤੇਰੇ ਸੰਮਲਾ ਕਵਨ ਬਿਧੀ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa sukh tere samalaa kavan bidhee beechaar |
English: What comforts of Yours can I dwell upon? How can I contemplate You?

Gurbani: ਸਰਣਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਦਾਸ ਹਿਤ ਊਚੇ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: saran samaaee daas hit aooche agam apaar |3|
English: You lovingly absorb Your slaves into Your Sanctuary, O Lofty, Inaccessible and Infinite Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਅਸਟ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਾਮ ਮਹਾ ਰਸ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: sagal padaarath asatt sidh naam mahaa ras maeh |
English: All wealth, and the eight miraculous spiritual powers are in the supremely sublime essence of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਕੇਸਵਾ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹਿ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: suprasan bhe kesavaa se jan har gun gaeh |4|
English: Those humble beings, with whom the beautifully-haired Lord is thoroughly pleased, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||

Gurbani: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪੋ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: maat pitaa sut bandhapo toon mere praan adhaar |
English: You are my mother, father, son and relative; You are the Support of the breath of life.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਭਜੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੫॥੧॥੧੧੬॥
Transliteration: saadhasang naanak bhajai bikh tariaa sansaar |5|1|116|
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak meditates on the Lord, and swims across the poisonous world-ocean. ||5||1||116||

[Ang 203 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਰਹੋਏ ਕੇ ਛੰਤ ਕੇ ਘਰਿ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree bairaagan rahoe ke chhant ke ghar mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree Bairaagan, Chhants Of Rehoay, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੋ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: hai koee raam piaaro gaavai |
English: Is there anyone who will sing of the Beloved Lord?

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਸੂਖ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sarab kaliaan sookh sach paavai | rahaau |
English: Surely, this will bring all pleasures and comforts. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਨੁ ਬਨੁ ਖੋਜਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: ban ban khojat firat bairaagee |
English: The renunciate goes out into the woods, searching for Him.

Gurbani: ਬਿਰਲੇ ਕਾਹੂ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: birale kaahoo ek liv laagee |
English: But those who embrace love for the One Lord are very rare.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jin har paaeaa se vaddabhaagee |1|
English: Those who find the Lord are very fortunate and blessed. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿਕ ਸਨਕਾਦਿਕ ਚਾਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: brahamaadik sanakaadik chaahai |
English: The Gods like Brahma and Sanak yearn for Him;

Gurbani: ਜੋਗੀ ਜਤੀ ਸਿਧ ਹਰਿ ਆਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: jogee jatee sidh har aahai |
English: the Yogis, celibates and Siddhas yearn for the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jiseh paraapat so har gun gaahai |2|
English: One who is so blessed, sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਜਿਨ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: taa kee saran jin bisarat naahee |
English: I seek the Sanctuary of those who have not forgotten Him.

Gurbani: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: vaddabhaagee har sant milaahee |
English: By great good fortune, one meets the Lord's Saint.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਤਿਹ ਮੂਲੇ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: janam maran tih moole naahee |3|
English: They are not subject to the cycle of birth and death. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮਿਲੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa mil preetam piaare |
English: Show Your Mercy, and lead me to meet You, O my Darling Beloved.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਉ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਊਚ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: binau sunahu prabh aooch apaare |
English: Hear my prayer, O Lofty and Infinite God;

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਾਂਗਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੧੭॥
Transliteration: naanak maangat naam adhaare |4|1|117|
English: Nanak begs for the Support of Your Name. ||4||1||117||

[Ang 204 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raag gaurree poorabee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raag Gauree Poorbee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਕਵਨ ਗੁਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਮਿਲਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kavan gun praanapat milau meree maaee |1| rahaau |
English: By what virtues can I meet the Lord of life, O my mother? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਰੂਪ ਹੀਨ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਲ ਹੀਨੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਪਰਦੇਸਨਿ ਦੂਰ ਤੇ ਆਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: roop heen budh bal heenee mohi paradesan door te aaee |1|
English: I have no beauty, understanding or strength; I am a stranger, from far away. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਾਹਿਨ ਦਰਬੁ ਨ ਜੋਬਨ ਮਾਤੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਅਨਾਥ ਕੀ ਕਰਹੁ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naahin darab na joban maatee mohi anaath kee karahu samaaee |2|
English: I am not wealthy or youthful. I am an orphan - please, unite me with Yourself. ||2||

Gurbani: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਭਈ ਬੈਰਾਗਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਫਿਰਤ ਤਿਸਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: khojat khojat bhee bairaagan prabh darasan kau hau firat tisaaee |3|
English: Searching and searching, I have become a renunciate, free of desire. I wander around, searching for the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਲਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੧੮॥
Transliteration: deen deaal kripaal prabh naanak saadhasang meree jalan bujhaaee |4|1|118|
English: God is Compassionate, and Merciful to the meek; O Nanak, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the fire of desire has been quenched. ||4||1||118||

[Ang 204 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਬੇ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: prabh milabe kau preet man laagee |
English: The loving desire to meet my Beloved has arisen within my mind.

Gurbani: ਪਾਇ ਲਗਉ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕੋਊ ਸੰਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: paae lgau mohi krau benatee koaoo sant milai baddabhaagee |1| rahaau |
English: I touch His Feet, and offer my prayer to Him. If only I had the great good fortune to meet the Saint. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪਉ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਖਉ ਆਗੈ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: man arpau dhan raakhau aagai man kee mat mohi sagal tiaagee |
English: I surrender my mind to Him; I place my wealth before Him. I totally renounce my selfish ways.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਫਿਰਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਿਛੈ ਵਿਰਾਗੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jo prabh kee har kathaa sunaavai anadin firau tis pichhai viraagee |1|
English: One who teaches me the Sermon of the Lord God - night and day, I shall follow Him. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਬ ਕਰਮ ਅੰਕੁਰ ਜਬ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਰਸਿਕ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: poorab karam ankur jab pragatte bhettio purakh rasik bairaagee |
English: When the seed of the karma of past actions sprouted, I met the Lord; He is both the Enjoyer and the Renunciate.

Gurbani: ਮਿਟਿਓ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਮਿਲਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਗੀ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੧੯॥
Transliteration: mittio andher milat har naanak janam janam kee soee jaagee |2|2|119|
English: My darkness was dispelled when I met the Lord. O Nanak, after being asleep for countless incarnations, I have awakened. ||2||2||119||

[Ang 204 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਿਕਸੁ ਰੇ ਪੰਖੀ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਂਖ ॥
Transliteration: nikas re pankhee simar har paankh |
English: Come out, O soul-bird, and let the meditative remembrance of the Lord be your wings.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਣਿ ਗਹੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਰਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਹੀਅਰੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਖੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mil saadhoo saran gahu pooran raam ratan heeare sang raakh |1| rahaau |
English: Meet the Holy Saint, take to His Sanctuary, and keep the perfect jewel of the Lord enshrined in your heart. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੀ ਕੂਈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਰਸ ਪੰਕਜ ਅਤਿ ਤੀਖੵਣ ਮੋਹ ਕੀ ਫਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: bhram kee kooee trisanaa ras pankaj at teekhayan moh kee faas |
English: Superstition is the well, thirst for pleasure is the mud, and emotional attachment is the noose, so tight around your neck.

Gurbani: ਕਾਟਨਹਾਰ ਜਗਤ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਕਰਹੁ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kaattanahaar jagat gur gobid charan kamal taa ke karahu nivaas |1|
English: The only one who can cut this is the Guru of the World, the Lord of the Universe. So let yourself dwell at His Lotus Feet. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa gobind prabh preetam deenaa naath sunahu aradaas |
English: Bestow Your Mercy, O Lord of the Universe, O God, My Beloved, Master of the meek - please, listen to my prayer.

Gurbani: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੨॥੩॥੧੨੦॥
Transliteration: kar geh lehu naanak ke suaamee jeeo pindd sabh tumaree raas |2|3|120|
English: Take my hand, O Lord and Master of Nanak; my body and soul all belong to You. ||2||3||120||

[Ang 204 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪੇਖਨ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har pekhan kau simarat man meraa |
English: My mind yearns to behold the Lord in meditation.

Gurbani: ਆਸ ਪਿਆਸੀ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨੀ ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਸੰਤੁ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਨੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aas piaasee chitvau din rainee hai koee sant milaavai neraa |1| rahaau |
English: I think of Him, I hope and thirst for Him, day and night; is there any Saint who may bring Him near me? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਉ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੀ ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਰਉ ਨਿਹੋਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sevaa krau daas daasan kee anik bhaant tis krau nihoraa |
English: I serve the slaves of His slaves; in so many ways, I beg of Him.

Gurbani: ਤੁਲਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਤੋਲੇ ਸੁਖ ਸਗਲੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸ ਸਭੋ ਹੀ ਥੋਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tulaa dhaar tole sukh sagale bin har daras sabho hee thoraa |1|
English: Setting them upon the scale, I have weighed all comforts and pleasures; without the Lord's Blessed Vision, they are all totally inadequate. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਗਾਏ ਗੁਨ ਸਾਗਰ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੋ ਜਾਤ ਬਹੋਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sant prasaad gaae gun saagar janam janam ko jaat bahoraa |
English: By the Grace of the Saints, I sing the Praises of the Ocean of virtue; after countless incarnations, I have been released.

Gurbani: ਆਨਦ ਸੂਖ ਭੇਟਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨਮੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਤਾਰਥੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਸਵੇਰਾ ॥੨॥੪॥੧੨੧॥
Transliteration: aanad sookh bhettat har naanak janam kritaarath safal saveraa |2|4|121|
English: Meeting the Lord, Nanak has found peace and bliss; his life is redeemed, and prosperity dawns for him. ||2||4||121||

[Ang 204 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ₁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raag gaurree poorabee₁ mahalaa 5 |
English: Raag Gauree Poorbee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਕਿਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kin bidh milai gusaaee mere raam raae |
English: How may I meet my Master, the King, the Lord of the Universe?

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਐਸਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦੇਇ ਬਤਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: koee aisaa sant sehaj sukhadaataa mohi maarag dee bataaee |1| rahaau |
English: Is there any Saint, who can bestow such celestial peace, and show me the Way to Him? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਲਖਿਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਪੜਦਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: antar alakh na jaaee lakhiaa vich parradaa haumai paaee |
English: The Unseen Lord is deep within the self; He cannot be seen; the curtain of egotism intervenes.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਭੋ ਜਗੁ ਸੋਇਆ ਇਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਉ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohi sabho jag soeaa ihu bharam kahahu kiau jaaee |1|
English: In emotional attachment to Maya, all the world is asleep. Tell me, how can this doubt be dispelled? ||1||

Gurbani: ਏਕਾ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਇਕਤੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਬਸਤੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਕਰਤੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ekaa sangat ikat grihi basate mil baat na karate bhaaee |
English: The one lives together with the other in the same house, but they do not talk to one another, O Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਬਸਤੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਪੰਚ ਦੁਹੇਲੇ ਓਹ ਬਸਤੁ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਠਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ek basat bin panch duhele oeh basat agochar tthaaee |2|
English: Without the one substance, the five are miserable; that substance is in the unapproachable place. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਤਾਲਾ ਕੁੰਜੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਉਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jis kaa grihu tin deea taalaa kunjee gur saupaaee |
English: And the one whose home it is, has locked it up, and given the key to the Guru.

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਉਪਾਵ ਕਰੇ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: anik upaav kare nahee paavai bin satigur saranaaee |3|
English: You may make all sorts of efforts, but it cannot be obtained, without the Sanctuary of the True Guru. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤਿਨ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jin ke bandhan kaatte satigur tin saadhasangat liv laaee |
English: Those whose bonds have been broken by the True Guru, enshrine love for the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: panch janaa mil mangal gaaeaa har naanak bhed na bhaaee |4|
English: The self-elect, the self-realized beings, meet together and sing the joyous songs of the Lord. Nanak, there is no difference between them, O Siblings of Destiny. ||4||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: mere raam raae in bidh milai gusaaee |
English: This is how my Sovereign Lord King, the Lord of the Universe, is met;

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੁ ਭਇਆ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਠਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥੧੨੨॥
Transliteration: sehaj bheaa bhram khin meh naatthaa mil jotee jot samaaee |1| rahaau doojaa |1|122|
English: celestial bliss is attained in an instant, and doubt is dispelled. Meeting Him, my light merges in the Light. ||1||Second Pause||1||122||

[Ang 205 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਐਸੋ ਪਰਚਉ ਪਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: aiso parchau paaeo |
English: I am intimate with Him;

Gurbani: ਕਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਦਇਆਲ ਬੀਠੁਲੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੁਝਹਿ ਬਤਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: karee kripaa deaal beetthulai satigur mujheh bataaeo |1| rahaau |
English: granting His Grace, my Kind Beloved has told me of the True Guru. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਤ ਤਤ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਇਹੁ ਬਿਸੁਆਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਆਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: jat kat dekhau tat tat tum hee mohi ihu bisuaas hoe aaeo |
English: Wherever I look, there You are; I am totally convinced of this.

Gurbani: ਕੈ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਉ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਜਉ ਸੁਨਤੋ ਹੈ ਰਘੁਰਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kai peh krau aradaas benatee jau sunato hai raghuraaeo |1|
English: Unto whom should I pray? The Lord Himself hears all. ||1||

Gurbani: ਲਹਿਓ ਸਹਸਾ ਬੰਧਨ ਗੁਰਿ ਤੋਰੇ ਤਾਂ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: lahio sahasaa bandhan gur tore taan sadaa sehaj sukh paaeo |
English: My anxiety is over. The Guru has cut away my bonds, and I have found eternal peace.

Gurbani: ਹੋਣਾ ਸਾ ਸੋਈ ਫੁਨਿ ਹੋਸੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਹਾ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: honaa saa soee fun hosee sukh dukh kahaa dikhaaeo |2|
English: Whatever shall be, shall be in the end; so where can pain and pleasure be seen? ||2||

Gurbani: ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਕਾ ਏਕੋ ਠਾਣਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਰਦਾ ਖੋਲਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: khandd brahamandd kaa eko tthaanaa gur paradaa khol dikhaaeo |
English: The continents and the solar systems rest in the support of the One Lord. The Guru has removed the veil of illusion, and shown this to me.

Gurbani: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਇਕ ਠਾਈ ਤਉ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕੈਠੈ ਜਾਇਓ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: nau nidh naam nidhaan ik tthaaee tau baahar kaitthai jaaeo |3|
English: The nine treasures of the wealth of the Name of the Lord are in that one place. Where else should we go? ||3||

Gurbani: ਏਕੈ ਕਨਿਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਤਿ ਸਾਜੀ ਬਹੁ ਪਰਕਾਰ ਰਚਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: ekai kanik anik bhaat saajee bahu parakaar rachaaeo |
English: The same gold is fashioned into various articles; just so, the Lord has made the many patterns of the creation.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਰਮੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਈ ਹੈ ਇਵ ਤਤੈ ਤਤੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਓ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੨੩॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak bharam gur khoee hai iv tatai tat milaaeo |4|2|123|
English: Says Nanak, the Guru has dispelled my doubt; in this way, my essence merges into God's essence. ||4||2||123||

[Ang 205 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ₂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree₂ mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਉਧ ਘਟੈ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਨਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aaudh ghattai dinas rainaare |
English: This life is diminishing, day and night.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: man gur mil kaaj savaare |1| rahaau |
English: Meeting with the Guru, your affairs shall be resolved. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ ਸੰਤ ਟਹਲ ਕੀ ਬੇਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: krau benantee sunahu mere meetaa sant ttehal kee belaa |
English: Listen, my friends, I beg of you: now is the time to serve the Saints!

Gurbani: ਈਹਾ ਖਾਟਿ ਚਲਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਆਗੈ ਬਸਨੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: eehaa khaatt chalahu har laahaa aagai basan suhelaa |1|
English: In this world, earn the profit of the Lord's Name, and hereafter, you shall dwell in peace. ||1||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਬਿਕਾਰੁ ਸਹਸੇ ਮਹਿ ਤਰਿਓ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: eihu sansaar bikaar sahase meh tario braham giaanee |
English: This world is engrossed in corruption and cynicism. Only those who know God are saved.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਜਗਾਇ ਪੀਆਏ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jiseh jagaae peeae har ras akath kathaa tin jaanee |2|
English: Those who are awakened by the Lord to drink in this sublime essence, come to know the Unspoken Speech of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਆਏ ਸੋਈ ਵਿਹਾਝਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਨਹਿ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kau aae soee vihaajhahu har gur te maneh baseraa |
English: Purchase only that for which you have come into the world, and through the Guru, the Lord shall dwell within your mind.

Gurbani: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜੇ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਇਗੋ ਫੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: nij ghar mehal paavahu sukh sahaje bahur na hoeigo feraa |3|
English: Within the home of your own inner being, you shall obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence with intuitive ease. You shall not be consigned again to the wheel of reincarnation. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ਸਰਧਾ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: antarajaamee purakh bidhaate saradhaa man kee poore |
English: O Inner-knower, Searcher of hearts, Primal Being, Architect of Destiny: please fulfill this yearning of my mind.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਇਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰੇ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੨੪॥
Transliteration: naanak daas ihee sukh maagai mo kau kar santan kee dhoore |4|3|124|
English: Nanak, Your slave, begs for this happiness: let me be the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||4||3||124||

[Ang 205 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਾਖੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: raakh pitaa prabh mere |
English: Save me, O My Father God.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨੁ ਸਭ ਗੁਨ ਤੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mohi niragun sabh gun tere |1| rahaau |
English: I am worthless and without virtue; all virtues are Yours. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਬਿਖਾਦੀ ਏਕੁ ਗਰੀਬਾ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: panch bikhaadee ek gareebaa raakhahu raakhanahaare |
English: The five vicious thieves are assaulting my poor being; save me, O Savior Lord!

Gurbani: ਖੇਦੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਰੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸੰਤਾਵਹਿ ਆਇਓ ਸਰਨਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: khed kareh ar bahut santaaveh aaeo saran tuhaare |1|
English: They are tormenting and torturing me. I have come, seeking Your Sanctuary. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਰਿਓ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤੀ ਛੋਡਹਿ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: kar kar haario anik bahu bhaatee chhoddeh katahoon naahee |
English: Trying all sorts of things, I have grown weary, but still, they will not leave me alone.

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਬਾਤ ਸੁਨਿ ਤਾਕੀ ਓਟਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਟਿ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ek baat sun taakee ottaa saadhasang mitt jaahee |2|
English: But I have heard that they can be rooted out, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; and so I seek their Shelter. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਤੇ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa sant mile mohi tin te dheeraj paaeaa |
English: In their Mercy, the Saints have met me, and from them, I have obtained satisfaction.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤੀ ਮੰਤੁ ਦੀਓ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: santee mant deeo mohi nirbhau gur kaa sabad kamaaeaa |3|
English: The Saints have given me the Mantra of the Fearless Lord, and now I practice the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੀਤਿ ਲਏ ਓਇ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਾਦੀ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: jeet le oe mahaa bikhaadee sehaj suhelee baanee |
English: I have now conquered those terrible evil-doers, and my speech is now sweet and sublime.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਭਇਆ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੨੫॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak man bheaa paragaasaa paaeaa pad nirabaanee |4|4|125|
English: Says Nanak, the Divine Light has dawned within my mind; I have obtained the state of Nirvaanaa. ||4||4||125||

[Ang 206 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: ohu abinaasee raaeaa |
English: He is the Eternal King.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੈ ਬਸਤੇ ਇਹੁ ਡਰਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਤੇ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: nirbhau sang tumaarai basate ihu ddaran kahaa te aaeaa |1| rahaau |
English: The Fearless Lord abides with you. So where does this fear come from? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਮਹਲਿ ਤੂੰ ਹੋਹਿ ਅਫਾਰੋ ਏਕ ਮਹਲਿ ਨਿਮਾਨੋ ॥
Transliteration: ek mehal toon hohi afaaro ek mehal nimaano |
English: In one person, You are arrogant and proud, and in another, You are meek and humble.

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਮਹਲਿ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਏਕ ਮਹਲਿ ਗਰੀਬਾਨੋ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ek mehal toon aape aape ek mehal gareebaano |1|
English: In one person, You are all by Yourself, and in another, You are poor. ||1||

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਮਹਲਿ ਤੂੰ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਬਕਤਾ ਏਕ ਮਹਲਿ ਖਲੁ ਹੋਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: ek mehal toon panddit bakataa ek mehal khal hotaa |
English: In one person, you are a Pandit, a religious scholar and a preacher, and in another, You are just a fool.

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਮਹਲਿ ਤੂੰ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਗ੍ਰਾਹਜੁ ਏਕ ਮਹਲਿ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਲੇਤਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ek mehal toon sabh kichh graahaj ek mehal kachhoo na letaa |2|
English: In one person, You grab hold of everything, and in another, You accept nothing. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਾਠ ਕੀ ਪੁਤਰੀ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੈ ਬਪੁਰੀ ਖਿਲਾਵਨਹਾਰੋ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: kaatth kee putaree kahaa karai bapuree khilaavanahaaro jaanai |
English: What can the poor wooden puppet do? The Master Puppeteer knows everything.

Gurbani: ਜੈਸਾ ਭੇਖੁ ਕਰਾਵੈ ਬਾਜੀਗਰੁ ਓਹੁ ਤੈਸੋ ਹੀ ਸਾਜੁ ਆਨੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jaisaa bhekh karaavai baajeegar ohu taiso hee saaj aanai |3|
English: As the Puppeteer dresses the puppet, so is the role the puppet plays. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਕੋਠਰੀ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਭਾਤਿ ਕਰੀਆ ਆਪਿ ਹੋਆ ਰਖਵਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: anik kottharee bahut bhaat kareea aap hoaa rakhavaaraa |
English: The Lord has created the various chambers of assorted descriptions, and He Himself protects them.

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੇ ਮਹਲਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਤੈਸੈ ਰਹਨਾ ਕਿਆ ਇਹੁ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jaise mehal raakhai taisai rahanaa kiaa ihu karai bichaaraa |4|
English: As is that vessel in which the Lord places the soul, so does it dwell. What can this poor being do? ||4||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਆ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਨੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਸਾਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: jin kichh keea soee jaanai jin ih sabh bidh saajee |
English: The One who created the thing, understands it; He has fashioned all of this.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਾਜੀ ॥੫॥੫॥੧੨੬॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak aparanpar suaamee keemat apune kaajee |5|5|126|
English: Says Nanak, the Lord and Master is Infinite; He alone understands the value of His Creation. ||5||5||126||

[Ang 206 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ₃ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree₃ mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਛੋਡਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਰੇ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕੇ ਰਸੂਆ ॥
Transliteration: chhodd chhodd re bikhiaa ke rasooaa |
English: Give them up - give up the pleasures of corruption;

Gurbani: ਉਰਝਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਰੇ ਬਾਵਰ ਗਾਵਰ ਜਿਉ ਕਿਰਖੈ ਹਰਿਆਇਓ ਪਸੂਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aurajh rahio re baavar gaavar jiau kirakhai hariaaeo pasooaa |1| rahaau |
English: you are entangled in them, you crazy fool, like an animal grazing in the green fields. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਾਜੈ ਸੋ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਤਸੂਆ ॥
Transliteration: jo jaaneh toon apune kaajai so sang na chaalai terai tasooaa |
English: That which you believe to be of use to you, shall not go even an inch with you.

Gurbani: ਨਾਗੋ ਆਇਓ ਨਾਗ ਸਿਧਾਸੀ ਫੇਰਿ ਫਿਰਿਓ ਅਰੁ ਕਾਲਿ ਗਰਸੂਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naago aaeo naag sidhaasee fer firio ar kaal garasooaa |1|
English: Naked you came, and naked you shall depart. You shall go round and round the cycle of birth and death, and you shall be food for Death. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਰੇ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਕੀ ਲੀਲਾ ਰਾਚਿ ਮਾਚਿ ਤਿਨਹੂੰ ਲਉ ਹਸੂਆ ॥
Transliteration: pekh pekh re kasunbh kee leelaa raach maach tinahoon lau hasooaa |
English: Watching, watching the transitory dramas of the world, you are embroiled and enmeshed in them, and you laugh with delight.

Gurbani: ਛੀਜਤ ਡੋਰਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਅਰੁ ਰੈਨੀ ਜੀਅ ਕੋ ਕਾਜੁ ਨ ਕੀਨੋ ਕਛੂਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: chheejat ddor dinas ar rainee jeea ko kaaj na keeno kachhooaa |2|
English: The string of life is wearing thin, day and night, and you have done nothing for your soul. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਰਤ ਕਰਤ ਇਵ ਹੀ ਬਿਰਧਾਨੋ ਹਾਰਿਓ ਉਕਤੇ ਤਨੁ ਖੀਨਸੂਆ ॥
Transliteration: karat karat iv hee biradhaano haario ukate tan kheenasooaa |
English: Doing your deeds, you have grown old; your voice fails you, and your body has become weak.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਉਨਿ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਬਾਲਾ ਉਸ ਤੇ ਘਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਰੁਚ ਚਸੂਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jiau mohio un mohanee baalaa us te ghattai naahee ruch chasooaa |3|
English: You were enticed by Maya in your youth, and your attachment for it has not diminished, one little bit. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਗੁ ਐਸਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ਤਉ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਤਜਿ ਗਰਬਸੂਆ ॥
Transliteration: jag aisaa mohi gureh dikhaaeo tau saran pario taj garabasooaa |
English: The Guru has shown me that this is the way of the world; I have abandoned the dwelling of pride, and entered Your Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੋ ਸੰਤਿ ਬਤਾਇਓ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੂਆ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੨੭॥
Transliteration: maarag prabh ko sant bataaeo drirree naanak daas bhagat har jasooaa |4|6|127|
English: The Saint has shown me the Path of God; slave Nanak has implanted devotional worship and the Praise of the Lord. ||4||6||127||

[Ang 206 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ₄ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree₄ mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਵਨੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: tujh bin kavan hamaaraa |
English: Except for You, who is mine?

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mere preetam praan adhaaraa |1| rahaau |
English: O my Beloved, You are the Support of the breath of life. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਸਜਨ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: antar kee bidh tum hee jaanee tum hee sajan suhele |
English: You alone know the condition of my inner being. You are my Beautiful Friend.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਗਹ ਅਤੋਲੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sarab sukhaa mai tujh te paae mere tthaakur agah atole |1|
English: I receive all comforts from You, O my Unfathomable and Immeasurable Lord and Master. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਰੰਗਾ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: baran na saakau tumare rangaa gun nidhaan sukhadaate |
English: I cannot describe Your Manifestations, O Treasure of Excellence, O Giver of peace.

Gurbani: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਤੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: agam agochar prabh abinaasee poore gur te jaate |2|
English: God is Inaccessible, Incomprehensible and Imperishable; He is known through the Perfect Guru. ||2||

Gurbani: ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਕਾਟਿ ਕੀਏ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲ ਜਬ ਤੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: bhram bhau kaatt kee nihakeval jab te haumai maaree |
English: My doubt and fear have been taken away, and I have been made pure, since my ego was conquered.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕੋ ਚੂਕੋ ਸਹਸਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਦਰਸਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: janam maran ko chooko sahasaa saadhasangat darasaaree |3|
English: My fear of birth and death has been abolished, beholding Your Blessed Vision in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||3||

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਪਖਾਰਿ ਕਰਉ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਾਰਿ ਜਾਉ ਲਖ ਬਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: charan pakhaar krau gur sevaa baar jaau lakh bareea |
English: I wash the Guru's Feet and serve Him; I am a sacrifice to Him, 100,000 times.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਇਹੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਰੀਆ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੨੮॥
Transliteration: jih prasaad ihu bhaujal tariaa jan naanak pria sang mireea |4|7|128|
English: By His Grace, servant Nanak has crossed over this terrifying world-ocean; I am united with my Beloved. ||4||7||128||

[Ang 207 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਵਨੁ ਰੀਝਾਵੈ ਤੋਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: tujh bin kavan reejhaavai tohee |
English: Who can please You, except You Yourself?

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੋ ਰੂਪੁ ਸਗਲ ਦੇਖਿ ਮੋਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tero roop sagal dekh mohee |1| rahaau |
English: Gazing upon Your Beauteous Form, all are entranced. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੁਰਗ ਪਇਆਲ ਮਿਰਤ ਭੂਅ ਮੰਡਲ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਨੋ ਏਕੈ ਓਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: surag peaal mirat bhooa manddal sarab samaano ekai ohee |
English: In the heavenly paradise, in the nether regions of the underworld, on the planet earth and throughout the galaxies, the One Lord is pervading everywhere.

Gurbani: ਸਿਵ ਸਿਵ ਕਰਤ ਸਗਲ ਕਰ ਜੋਰਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਮਇਆ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੇਰੀ ਦੋਹੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: siv siv karat sagal kar joreh sarab meaa tthaakur teree dohee |1|
English: Everyone calls upon You with their palms pressed together, saying, "Shiva, Shiva". O Merciful Lord and Master, everyone cries out for Your Help. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੀਤਲੋਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: patit paavan tthaakur naam tumaraa sukhadaaee niramal seetalohee |
English: Your Name, O Lord and Master, is the Purifier of sinners, the Giver of peace, immaculate, cooling and soothing.

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸੰਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਿਉ ਗਾਲ ਗਲੋਹੀ ॥੨॥੮॥੧੨੯॥
Transliteration: giaan dhiaan naanak vaddiaaee sant tere siau gaal galohee |2|8|129|
English: O Nanak, spiritual wisdom, meditation and glorious greatness come from dialogue and discourse with Your Saints. ||2||8||129||

[Ang 207 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: milahu piaare jeea |
English: Meet with me, O my Dear Beloved.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਆ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਥੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: prabh keea tumaaraa theea |1| rahaau |
English: O God, whatever You do - that alone happens. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਨਮ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਆ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: anik janam bahu jonee bhramiaa bahur bahur dukh paaeaa |
English: Wandering around through countless incarnations, I endured pain and suffering in so many lives, over and over again.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਦੇਹ ਪਾਈ ਹੈ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tumaree kripaa te maanukh deh paaee hai dehu daras har raaeaa |1|
English: By Your Grace, I obtained this human body; grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, O Sovereign Lord King. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਹੋਆ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਕੀਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: soee hoaa jo tis bhaanaa avar na kin hee keetaa |
English: That which pleases His Will has come to pass; no one else can do anything.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮਰੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਜਾਗਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੂਤਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tumarai bhaanai bharam mohi mohiaa jaagat naahee sootaa |2|
English: By Your Will, enticed by the illusion of emotional attachment, the people are asleep; they do not wake up. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਉ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: binau sunahu tum praanapat piaare kirapaa nidh deaalaa |
English: Please hear my prayer, O Lord of Life, O Beloved, Ocean of mercy and compassion.

Gurbani: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਅਨਾਥਹ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: raakh lehu pitaa prabh mere anaathah kar pratipaalaa |3|
English: Save me, O my Father God. I am an orphan - please, cherish me! ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਪਾਛੈ ॥
Transliteration: jis no tumeh dikhaaeo darasan saadhasangat kai paachhai |
English: You reveal the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, for the sake of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧੂਰਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਇਹੁ ਬਾਛੈ ॥੪॥੯॥੧੩੦॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa dhoor dehu santan kee sukh naanak ihu baachhai |4|9|130|
English: Grant Your Grace, and bless us with the dust of the feet of the Saints; Nanak yearns for this peace. ||4||9||130||

[Ang 207 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: hau taa kai balihaaree |
English: I am a sacrifice to those

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai keval naam adhaaree |1| rahaau |
English: who take the Support of the Naam. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਹਿਮਾ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੇਤਕ ਗਨੀਐ ਜਨ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: mahimaa taa kee ketak ganeeai jan paarabraham rang raate |
English: How can I recount the praises of those humble beings who are attuned to the Love of the Supreme Lord God?

Gurbani: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਤਿਨਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਨ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਦਾਤੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sookh sehaj aanand tinaa sang un samasar avar na daate |1|
English: Peace, intuitive poise and bliss are with them. There are no other givers equal to them. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਗਤ ਉਧਾਰਣ ਸੇਈ ਆਏ ਜੋ ਜਨ ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: jagat udhaaran seee aae jo jan daras piaasaa |
English: They have come to save the world - those humble beings who thirst for His Blessed Vision.

Gurbani: ਉਨ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੈ ਸੋ ਤਰਿਆ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aun kee saran parai so tariaa santasang pooran aasaa |2|
English: Those who seek their Sanctuary are carried across; in the Society of the Saints, their hopes are fulfilled. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਚਰਣਿ ਪਰਉ ਤਾ ਜੀਵਾ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: taa kai charan prau taa jeevaa jan kai sang nihaalaa |
English: If I fall at their Feet, then I live; associating with those humble beings, I remain happy.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਨ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਹੋਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bhagatan kee ren hoe man meraa hohu prabhoo kirapaalaa |3|
English: O God, please be merciful to me, that my mind might become the dust of the feet of Your devotees. ||3||

Gurbani: ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਅਵਧ ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਘਾਟਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: raaj joban avadh jo deesai sabh kichh jug meh ghaattiaa |
English: Power and authority, youth and age - whatever is seen in this world, all of it shall fade away.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਦ ਨਵਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਾਟਿਆ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੧੩੧॥
Transliteration: naam nidhaan sad navatan niramal ihu naanak har dhan khaattiaa |4|10|131|
English: The treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is forever new and immaculate. Nanak has earned this wealth of the Lord. ||4||10||131||

[Ang 208 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਆਇਓ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: jog jugat sun aaeo gur te |
English: I came to the Guru, to learn the Way of Yoga.

Gurbani: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mo kau satigur sabad bujhaaeo |1| rahaau |
English: The True Guru has revealed it to me through the Word of the Shabad. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਉ ਖੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੀ ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: nau khandd prithamee is tan meh raviaa nimakh nimakh namasakaaraa |
English: He is contained in the nine continents of the world, and within this body; each and every moment, I humbly bow to Him.

Gurbani: ਦੀਖਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਕਾਨੀ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਿਓ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: deekhiaa gur kee mundraa kaanee drirrio ek nirankaaraa |1|
English: I have made the Guru's Teachings my ear-rings, and I have enshrined the One Formless Lord within my being. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਚੇਲੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਏ ਇਕਤ੍ਰਾ ਏਕਸੁ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਏ ॥
Transliteration: panch chele mil bhe ikatraa ekas kai vas kee |
English: I have brought the five disciples together, and they are now under the control of the one mind.

Gurbani: ਦਸ ਬੈਰਾਗਨਿ ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ਤਬ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਗੀ ਥੀਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: das bairaagan aagiaakaaree tab niramal jogee thee |2|
English: When the ten hermits become obedient to the Lord, then I became an immaculate Yogi. ||2||

Gurbani: ਭਰਮੁ ਜਰਾਇ ਚਰਾਈ ਬਿਭੂਤਾ ਪੰਥੁ ਏਕੁ ਕਰਿ ਪੇਖਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: bharam jaraae charaaee bibhootaa panth ek kar pekhiaa |
English: I have burnt my doubt, and smeared my body with the ashes. My path is to see the One and Only Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜ ਸੂਖ ਸੋ ਕੀਨੀ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਜੋ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sehaj sookh so keenee bhugataa jo tthaakur masatak lekhiaa |3|
English: I have made that intuitive peace my food; the Lord Master has written this pre-ordained destiny upon my forehead. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਭਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਹਾ ਆਸਨੁ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਸਿੰਗੀ ਅਨਹਤ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: jeh bhau naahee tahaa aasan baadhio singee anahat baanee |
English: In that place where there is no fear, I have assumed my Yogic posture. The unstruck melody of His Bani is my horn.

Gurbani: ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਡੰਡਾ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਨੀ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: tat beechaar ddanddaa kar raakhio jugat naam man bhaanee |4|
English: I have made contemplation upon the essential reality my Yogic staff. The Love of the Name in my mind is my Yogic lifestyle. ||4||

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਜੋਗੀ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਭੇਟੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੈ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa jogee vaddabhaagee bhettai maaeaa ke bandhan kaattai |
English: By great good fortune, such a Yogi is met, who cuts away the bonds of Maya.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਾ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਕੀ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਗ ਚਾਟੈ ॥੫॥੧੧॥੧੩੨॥
Transliteration: sevaa pooj krau tis moorat kee naanak tis pag chaattai |5|11|132|
English: Nanak serves and adores this wondrous person, and kisses his feet. ||5||11||132||

[Ang 208 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਨੂਪ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਸਗਲ ਧਿਆਇਲੇ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: anoop padaarath naam sunahu sagal dhiaaeile meetaa |
English: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is an incomparably beautiful treasure. Listen, everyone, and meditate on it, O friends.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਚੀਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har aaukhadh jaa kau gur deea taa ke niramal cheetaa |1| rahaau |
English: Those, unto whom the Guru has given the Lord's medicine - their minds become pure and immaculate. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅੰਧਕਾਰੁ ਮਿਟਿਓ ਤਿਹ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: andhakaar mittio tih tan te gur sabad deepak paragaasaa |
English: Darkness is dispelled from within that body, in which the Divine Light of the Guru's Shabad shines.

Gurbani: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੀ ਜਾਲੀ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕਾਟੀ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bhram kee jaalee taa kee kaattee jaa kau saadhasangat bisvaasaa |1|
English: The noose of doubt is cut away from those who place their faith in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤਾਰੀਲੇ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਾਰੂ ਬਿਖੜਾ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: taareele bhavajal taaroo bikharraa bohith saadhoo sangaa |
English: The treacherous and terrifying world-ocean is crossed over, in the boat of the Saadh Sangat.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: pooran hoee man kee aasaa gur bhettio har rangaa |2|
English: My mind's desires are fulfilled, meeting the Guru, in love with the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਭਗਤੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: naam khajaanaa bhagatee paaeaa man tan tripat aghaae |
English: The devotees have found the treasure of the Naam; their minds and bodies are satisfied and satiated.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਦੇਵੈ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਏ ॥੩॥੧੨॥੧੩੩॥
Transliteration: naanak har jeeo taa kau devai jaa kau hukam manaae |3|12|133|
English: O Nanak, the Dear Lord gives it only to those who surrender to the Lord's Command. ||3||12||133||

[Ang 208 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ₅ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree₅ mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦਇਆ ਮਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਮੋਰੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਅਨਾਥ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੋਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: deaa meaa kar praanapat more mohi anaath saran prabh toree |
English: Please be kind and compassionate, O Lord of my life; I am helpless, and I seek Your Sanctuary, God.

Gurbani: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਿ ਹਾਥ ਦੇ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਕਛੂ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਉਕਤਿ ਨ ਮੋਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: andh koop meh haath de raakhahu kachhoo siaanap ukat na moree |1| rahaau |
English: Please, give me Your Hand, and lift me up, out of the deep dark pit. I have no clever tricks at all. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਤੁਮ ਸਮਰਥ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਨ ਹੋਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: karan karaavan sabh kichh tum hee tum samarath naahee an horee |
English: You are the Doer, the Cause of causes - You are everything. You are All-powerful; there is no other than You.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ਸੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਜਿਨ ਭਾਗ ਮਥੋਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tumaree gat mit tum hee jaanee se sevak jin bhaag mathoree |1|
English: You alone know Your condition and extent. They alone become Your servants, upon whose foreheads such good destiny is recorded. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਤੇ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਭਗਤਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਜੋਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: apune sevak sang tum prabh raate ot pot bhagatan sang joree |
English: You are imbued with Your servant, God; Your devotees are woven into Your Fabric, through and through.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਚਾਹੈ ਜੈਸੇ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਓਹ ਚੰਦ ਚਕੋਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: priau priau naam teraa darasan chaahai jaise drisatt oeh chand chakoree |2|
English: O Darling Beloved, they yearn for Your Name and the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, like the chakvee bird which longs to see the moon. ||2||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਸੰਤ ਮਹਿ ਭੇਦੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਏਕੁ ਜਨੁ ਕਈ ਮਹਿ ਲਾਖ ਕਰੋਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: raam sant meh bhed kichh naahee ek jan kee meh laakh karoree |
English: Between the Lord and His Saint, there is no difference at all. Among hundreds of thousands and millions, there is scarcely one humble being.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੋਆ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਰਸਨ ਰਮੋਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jaa kai heeai pragatt prabh hoaa anadin keeratan rasan ramoree |3|
English: Those whose hearts are illuminated by God, sing the Kirtan of His Praises night and day with their tongues. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਸਮਰਥ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਤਿ ਊਚੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧੋਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: tum samarath apaar at aooche sukhadaate prabh praan adhoree |
English: You are All-powerful and Infinite, the most lofty and exalted, the Giver of peace; O God, You are the Support of the breath of life.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਜੈ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਉਨ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੰਗੋਰੀ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੧੩੪॥
Transliteration: naanak kau prabh keejai kirapaa un santan kai sang sangoree |4|13|134|
English: Please show mercy to Nanak, O God, that he may remain in the Society of the Saints. ||4||13||134||

[Ang 209 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਾਤੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: tum har setee raate santahu |
English: O Saint, You are attuned to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਿਬਾਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ਓੜਿ ਪਹੁਚਾਵਹੁ ਦਾਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: nibaeh lehu mo kau purakh bidhaate orr pahuchaavahu daate |1| rahaau |
English: Please stand my me, Architect of Destiny; please take me to my destination, Great Giver. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮਰਾ ਮਰਮੁ ਤੁਮਾ ਹੀ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਤੁਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: tumaraa maram tumaa hee jaaniaa tum pooran purakh bidhaate |
English: You alone know Your mystery; You are the Perfect Architect of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਅਨਾਥ ਦੀਨ ਕਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਗਾਤੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: raakhahu saran anaath deen kau karahu hamaaree gaate |1|
English: I am a helpless orphan - please keep me under Your Protection and save me. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤਰਣ ਸਾਗਰ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਚਰਣ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਤੁਮ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਭਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: taran saagar bohith charan tumaare tum jaanahu apunee bhaate |
English: Your Feet are the boat to carry us across the world-ocean; You alone know Your ways.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸੰਗੇ ਤੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਤੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa jis raakhahu sange te te paar paraate |2|
English: Those whom You keep protected, by Your Kindness, cross over to the other side. ||2||

Gurbani: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮ ਸਮਰਥਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਮਰੈ ਹਾਥੇ ॥
Transliteration: eet aoot prabh tum samarathaa sabh kichh tumarai haathe |
English: Here and hereafter, God, You are All-powerful; everything is in Your Hands.

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਚਲੈ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਸਾਥੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aisaa nidhaan dehu mo kau har jan chalai hamaarai saathe |3|
English: Please give me that treasure, which will go along with me, O servant of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਗੁਨੀਆਰੇ ਕਉ ਗੁਨੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਜਾਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: niraguneeaare kau gun keejai har naam meraa man jaape |
English: I am without virtue - please bless me with virtue, so that my mind might chant the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟੇ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਸੀਤਲ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੇ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੧੩੫॥
Transliteration: sant prasaad naanak har bhette man tan seetal dhraape |4|14|135|
English: By the Grace of the Saints, Nanak has met the Lord; his mind and body are soothed and satisfied. ||4||14||135||

[Ang 209 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਓ ਦੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj samaaeo dev |
English: I am intuitively absorbed in the Divine Lord.

Gurbani: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ ਦੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mo kau satigur bhe deaal dev |1| rahaau |
English: The Divine True Guru has become Merciful to me. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਾਟਿ ਜੇਵਰੀ ਕੀਓ ਦਾਸਰੋ ਸੰਤਨ ਟਹਲਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: kaatt jevaree keeo daasaro santan ttahalaaeo |
English: Cutting away the halter, He has made me His slave, and now I work for the Saints.

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਨਾਮ ਕੋ ਥੀਓ ਪੂਜਾਰੀ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ek naam ko theeo poojaaree mo kau acharaj gureh dikhaaeo |1|
English: I have become a worshipper of the One Name; the Guru has shown me this amazing wonder. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਸਰਬ ਉਜੀਆਰਾ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: bheo pragaas sarab ujeeaaraa gur giaan maneh pragattaaeo |
English: The Divine Light has dawned, and everything is illuminated; the Guru has revealed this spiritual wisdom to my mind.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੀਓ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿਆ ਅਨਭੈ ਠਹਰਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: amrit naam peeo man tripatiaa anabhai tthaharaaeo |2|
English: Drinking deeply of the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, my mind is satisfied, and my fears have been vanquished. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਾਨਿ ਆਗਿਆ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ਦੂਖਹ ਠਾਉ ਗਵਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: maan aagiaa sarab sukh paae dookhah tthaau gavaaeo |
English: Accepting the Command of the Lord's Will, I have found total peace; the home of suffering has been destroyed.

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਭੁ ਆਨਦ ਰੂਪੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jau suprasan bhe prabh tthaakur sabh aanad roop dikhaaeo |3|
English: When God, our Lord and Master was totally pleased, He revealed everything in the form of ecstasy. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਵਤ ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਵਤ ਸਭੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਕੀਓ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: naa kichh aavat naa kichh jaavat sabh khel keeo har raaeo |
English: Nothing comes, and nothing goes; this play is all set in motion by the Lord, the Sovereign King.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਮ ਹੈ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਗਤ ਟੇਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇਓ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੧੩੬॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak agam agam hai tthaakur bhagat ttek har naaeo |4|15|136|
English: Says Nanak, our Lord and Master is inaccessible and unfathomable. The Lord's devotees take His Name as their Support. ||4||15||136||

[Ang 209 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ₆ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree₆ mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਮਨ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਗਹੀਜੈ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham pooran paramesur man taa kee ott gaheejai re |
English: He is the Supreme Lord God, the Perfect Transcendent Lord; O my mind, hold tight to the Support of the One

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਧਾਰੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਹਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਜੈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jin dhaare brahamandd khandd har taa ko naam japeejai re |1| rahaau |
English: who established the solar systems and galaxies. Chant the Name of that Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਤਿਆਗਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੂਝਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: man kee mat tiaagahu har jan hukam boojh sukh paaeeai re |
English: Renounce the intellectual cleverness of your mind, O humble servants of the Lord; understanding the Hukam of His Command, peace is found.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨਹੁ ਸੁਖਿ ਦੁਖਿ ਓਹੀ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jo prabh karai soee bhal maanahu sukh dukh ohee dhiaaeeai re |1|
English: Whatever God does, accept that with pleasure; in comfort and in suffering, meditate on Him. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਬਾਰ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kott patit udhaare khin meh karate baar na laagai re |
English: The Creator emancipates millions of sinners in an instant, without a moment's delay.

Gurbani: ਦੀਨ ਦਰਦ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨਿਵਾਜੈ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: deen darad dukh bhanjan suaamee jis bhaavai tiseh nivaajai re |2|
English: The Lord, the Destroyer of the pain and sorrow of the poor, blesses those with whom He is pleased. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਕੋ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕ ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sabh ko maat pitaa pratipaalak jeea praan sukh saagar re |
English: He is Mother and Father, the Cherisher of all; He is the Breath of life of all beings, the Ocean of peace.

Gurbani: ਦੇਂਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਰਤਨਾਗਰੁ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: dende tott naahee tis karate poor rahio ratanaagar re |3|
English: While giving so generously, the Creator does not diminish at all. The Source of jewels, He is All-pervading. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਾਚਿਕੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੋਈ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jaachik jaachai naam teraa suaamee ghatt ghatt antar soee re |
English: The beggar begs for Your Name, O Lord and Master; God is contained deep within the nucleus of each and every heart.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਰੇ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੧੩੭॥
Transliteration: naanak daas taa kee saranaaee jaa te brithaa na koee re |4|16|137|
English: Slave Nanak has entered His Sanctuary; no one returns from Him empty-handed. ||4||16||137||

[Ang 210 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ₁ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raag gaurree₁ poorabee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raag Gauree Poorbee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਮਨਹੁ ਬਿਸਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har har kabahoo na manahu bisaare |
English: Never forget the Lord, Har, Har, from your mind.

Gurbani: ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: eehaa aoohaa sarab sukhadaataa sagal ghattaa pratipaare |1| rahaau |
English: Here and hereafter, He is the Giver of all peace. He is the Cherisher of all hearts. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਕਸਟ ਕਾਟੈ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਿਤਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: mahaa kasatt kaattai khin bheetar rasanaa naam chitaare |
English: He removes the most terrible pains in an instant, if the tongue repeats His Name.

Gurbani: ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੂਖ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣੀ ਜਲਤੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: seetal saant sookh har saranee jalatee agan nivaare |1|
English: In the Lord's Sanctuary there is soothing coolness, peace and tranquility. He has extinguished the burning fire. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗਰਭ ਕੁੰਡ ਨਰਕ ਤੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: garabh kundd narak te raakhai bhavajal paar utaare |
English: He saves us from the hellish pit of the womb, and carries us across the terrifying world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਆਰਾਧਤ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: charan kamal aaraadhat man meh jam kee traas bidaare |2|
English: Adoring His Lotus Feet in the mind, the fear of death is banished. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਊਚਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: pooran paarabraham paramesur aoochaa agam apaare |
English: He is the Perfect, Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, lofty, unfathomable and infinite.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ ਧਿਆਵਤ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਜੂਏ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gun gaavat dhiaavat sukh saagar jooe janam na haare |3|
English: Singing His Glorious Praises, and meditating on the Ocean of peace, one's life is not lost in the gamble. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨੋ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਕੇ ਦਾਤਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh lobh mohi man leeno niragun ke daataare |
English: My mind is engrossed in sexual desire, anger, greed and attachment, O Giver to the unworthy.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੩੮॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa apuno naam deejai naanak sad balihaare |4|1|138|
English: Please grant Your Grace, and bless me with Your Name; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to You. ||4||1||138||

[Ang 210 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਚੇਤੀ₁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raag gaurree chetee₁ mahalaa 5 |
English: Raag Gauree Chaytee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਿਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: sukh naahee re har bhagat binaa |
English: There is no peace without devotional worship of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜੀਤਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਇਹੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਪਿ ਇਕ ਖਿਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jeet janam ihu ratan amolak saadhasangat jap ik khinaa |1| rahaau |
English: Be victorious, and win the priceless jewel of this human life, by meditating on Him in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, even for an instant. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੁਤ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ ॥
Transliteration: sut sanpat banitaa binod |
English: Many have renounced and left their children,

Gurbani: ਛੋਡਿ ਗਏ ਬਹੁ ਲੋਗ ਭੋਗ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: chhodd ge bahu log bhog |1|
English: Wealth, spouses, joyful games and pleasures. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹੈਵਰ ਗੈਵਰ ਰਾਜ ਰੰਗ ॥
Transliteration: haivar gaivar raaj rang |
English: Horses, elephants and the pleasures of power

Gurbani: ਤਿਆਗਿ ਚਲਿਓ ਹੈ ਮੂੜ ਨੰਗ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tiaag chalio hai moorr nang |2|
English: - leaving these behind, the fool must depart naked. ||2||

Gurbani: ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨ ਦੇਹ ਫੂਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: choaa chandan deh fooliaa |
English: The body, scented with musk and sandalwood

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਤਨੁ ਧਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਰੂਲਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: so tan dhar sang rooliaa |3|
English: - that body shall come to roll in the dust. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਜਾਨੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: mohi mohiaa jaanai door hai |
English: Infatuated with emotional attachment, they think that God is far away.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਹੈ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੩੯॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak sadaa hadoor hai |4|1|139|
English: Says Nanak, he is Ever-present! ||4||1||139||

[Ang 210 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਧਰ ਤਰਬੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨੋ ॥
Transliteration: man dhar tarabe har naam no |
English: O mind, cross over with the Support of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਸਾਗਰ ਲਹਰਿ ਸੰਸਾ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਪਾਰ ਗਰਾਮਨੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saagar lehar sansaa sansaar gur bohith paar garaamano |1| rahaau |
English: The Guru is the boat to carry you across the world-ocean, through the waves of cynicism and doubt. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਲਿ ਕਾਲਖ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: kal kaalakh andhiaareea |
English: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, there is only pitch darkness.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਦੀਪਕ ਉਜਿਆਰੀਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur giaan deepak ujiaareea |1|
English: The lamp of the Guru's spiritual wisdom illuminates and enlightens. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਿਖੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਪਸਰੀ ਅਤਿ ਘਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: bikh bikhiaa pasaree at ghanee |
English: The poison of corruption is spread out far and wide.

Gurbani: ਉਬਰੇ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aubare jap jap har gunee |2|
English: Only the virtuous are saved, chanting and meditating on the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਤਵਾਰੋ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੋਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: matavaaro maaeaa soeaa |
English: Intoxicated with Maya, the people are asleep.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟਤ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਖੋਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur bhettat bhram bhau khoeaa |3|
English: Meeting the Guru, doubt and fear are dispelled. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak ek dhiaaeaa |
English: Says Nanak, meditate on the One Lord;

Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੪੦॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt nadaree aaeaa |4|2|140|
English: behold Him in each and every heart. ||4||2||140||

[Ang 210 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦੀਬਾਨੁ ਹਮਾਰੋ ਤੁਹੀ ਏਕ ॥
Transliteration: deebaan hamaaro tuhee ek |
English: You alone are my Chief Advisor.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਾ ਥਾਰੀ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਟੇਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sevaa thaaree gureh ttek |1| rahaau |
English: I serve You with the Support of the Guru. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: anik jugat nahee paaeaa |
English: By various devices, I could not find You.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਚਾਕਰ ਲੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur chaakar lai laaeaa |1|
English: Taking hold of me, the Guru has made me Your slave. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਾਰੇ ਪੰਚ ਬਿਖਾਦੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: maare panch bikhaadeea |
English: I have conquered the five tyrants.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਦਲੁ ਸਾਧਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur kirapaa te dal saadhiaa |2|
English: By Guru's Grace, I have vanquished the army of evil. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬਖਸੀਸ ਵਜਹੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: bakhasees vajahu mil ek naam |
English: I have received the One Name as His bounty and blessing.

Gurbani: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sookh sehaj aanand bisraam |3|
English: Now, I dwell in peace, poise and bliss. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਚਾਕਰ ਸੇ ਭਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: prabh ke chaakar se bhale |
English: The slaves of God are good.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲੇ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੪੧॥
Transliteration: naanak tin mukh aoojale |4|3|141|
English: O Nanak, their faces are radiant. ||4||3||141||

[Ang 211 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੀਅਰੇ ਓਲੑਾ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeeare olaa naam kaa |
English: Hey, soul: your only Support is the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰੁ ਜਿ ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨੋ ਤਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਭਉ ਹੈ ਜਾਮ ਕਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: avar ji karan karaavano tin meh bhau hai jaam kaa |1| rahaau |
English: Whatever else you do or make happen, the fear of death still hangs over you. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਵਰ ਜਤਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: avar jatan nahee paaeeai |
English: He is not obtained by any other efforts.

Gurbani: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: vaddai bhaag har dhiaaeeai |1|
English: By great good fortune, meditate on the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਲਾਖ ਹਿਕਮਤੀ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: laakh hikamatee jaaneeai |
English: You may know hundreds of thousands of clever tricks,

Gurbani: ਆਗੈ ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aagai til nahee maaneeai |2|
English: but not even one will be of any use at all hereafter. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: ahanbudh karam kamaavane |
English: Good deeds done in the pride of ego are swept away,

Gurbani: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਬਾਲੂ ਨੀਰਿ ਬਹਾਵਨੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: grih baaloo neer bahaavane |3|
English: Like the house of sand by water. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kripaal kirapaa karai |
English: When God the Merciful shows His Mercy,

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲੈ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੪੨॥
Transliteration: naam naanak saadhoo sang milai |4|4|142|
English: Nanak receives the Naam in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||4||4||142||

[Ang 211 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬਾਰਨੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਨੈ ਲਖ ਬਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: baaranai balihaaranai lakh bareea |
English: I am a sacrifice, dedicated hundreds of thousands of times, to my Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੋ ਹੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: naamo ho naam saahib ko praan adhareea |1| rahaau |
English: His Name, and His Name alone, is the Support of the breath of life. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਤੁਹੀ ਏਕ ॥
Transliteration: karan karaavan tuhee ek |
English: You alone are the Doer, the Cause of causes.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਕੀ ਤੁਹੀ ਟੇਕ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jeea jant kee tuhee ttek |1|
English: You are the Support of all beings and creatures. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਜ ਜੋਬਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੂੰ ਧਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: raaj joban prabh toon dhanee |
English: O God, You are my power, authority and youth.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਤੂੰ ਸਰਗੁਨੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: toon niragun toon saragunee |2|
English: You are absolute, without attributes, and also related, with the most sublime attributes. ||2||

Gurbani: ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਤੁਮ ਰਖੇ ॥
Transliteration: eehaa aoohaa tum rakhe |
English: Here and hereafter, You are my Savior and Protector.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਕੋ ਲਖੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur kirapaa te ko lakhe |3|
English: By Guru's Grace, some understand You. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: antarajaamee prabh sujaan |
English: God is All-knowing, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਕੀਆ ਤੁਹੀ ਤਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੪੩॥
Transliteration: naanak takeea tuhee taan |4|5|143|
English: You are Nanak's strength and support. ||4||5||143||

[Ang 211 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: har har har aaraadheeai |
English: Worship and adore the Lord, Har, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਭਰਮੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਭਉ ਸਾਧੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: santasang har man vasai bharam mohu bhau saadheeai |1| rahaau |
English: In the Society of the Saints, He dwells in the mind; doubt, emotional attachment and fear are vanquished. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਭਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: bed puraan simrit bhane |
English: The Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees are heard to proclaim

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਊਚ ਬਿਰਾਜਿਤ ਜਨ ਸੁਨੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sabh aooch biraajit jan sune |1|
English: that the Lord's servant dwells as the highest of all. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਅਸਥਾਨ ਭੈ ਭੀਤ ਚੀਨ ॥
Transliteration: sagal asathaan bhai bheet cheen |
English: All places are filled with fear - know this well.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਸੇਵਕ ਭੈ ਰਹਤ ਕੀਨ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: raam sevak bhai rehat keen |2|
English: Only the Lord's servants are free of fear. ||2||

Gurbani: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜੋਨਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh jon fireh |
English: People wander through 8.4 million incarnations.

Gurbani: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਲੋਕ ਨਹੀ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰਹਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gobind lok nahee janam mareh |3|
English: God's people are not subject to birth and death. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਹਉਮੈ ਰਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: bal budh siaanap haumai rahee |
English: He has given up power, wisdom, cleverness and egotism.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧ ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗਹੀ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੪੪॥
Transliteration: har saadh saran naanak gahee |4|6|144|
English: Nanak has taken to the Sanctuary of the Lord's Holy Saints. ||4||6||144||

[Ang 211 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: man raam naam gun gaaeeai |
English: O my mind, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਨੀਤ ਨੀਤ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: neet neet har seveeai saas saas har dhiaaeeai |1| rahaau |
English: Serve the Lord continually and continuously; with each and every breath, meditate on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: santasang har man vasai |
English: In the Society of the Saints, the Lord dwells in the mind,

Gurbani: ਦੁਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਅਨੇਰਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਨਸੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dukh darad aneraa bhram nasai |1|
English: and pain, suffering, darkness and doubt depart. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: sant prasaad har jaapeeai |
English: That humble being, who meditates on the Lord,

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਦੂਖਿ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੀਐ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: so jan dookh na viaapeeai |2|
English: By the Grace of the Saints, is not afflicted with pain. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kau gur har mantru de |
English: Those unto whom the Guru gives the Mantra of the Lord's Name,

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਉਬਰਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਅਗਨਿ ਤੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: so ubariaa maaeaa agan te |3|
English: are saved from the fire of Maya. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਇਆ ਕਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: naanak kau prabh meaa kar |
English: Be kind to Nanak, O God;

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਵਾਸੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੪੫॥
Transliteration: merai man tan vaasai naam har |4|7|145|
English: let the Lord's Name dwell within my mind and body. ||4||7||145||

[Ang 211 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਸਨਾ ਜਪੀਐ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: rasanaa japeeai ek naam |
English: With your tongue, chant the Name of the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਈਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਘਨਾ ਆਗੈ ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: eehaa sukh aanand ghanaa aagai jeea kai sang kaam |1| rahaau |
English: In this world, it shall bring you peace, comfort and great joy; hereafter, it shall go with your soul, and shall be of use to you. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਟੀਐ ਤੇਰਾ ਅਹੰ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: katteeai teraa ahan rog |
English: The disease of your ego shall be eradicated.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਜ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: toon gur prasaad kar raaj jog |1|
English: By Guru's Grace, practice Raja Yoga, the Yoga of meditation and success. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਚਾਖਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: har ras jin jan chaakhiaa |
English: Those who taste the sublime essence of the Lord

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਲਾਥੀਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: taa kee trisanaa laatheea |2|
English: have their thirst quenched. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: har bisraam nidh paaeaa |
English: Those who have found the Lord, the Treasure of peace,

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਕਤ ਹੀ ਧਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: so bahur na kat hee dhaaeaa |3|
English: shall not go anywhere else again. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam jaa kau gur deea |
English: Those, unto whom the Guru has given the Lord's Name, Har, Har

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਗਇਆ ॥੪॥੮॥੧੪੬॥
Transliteration: naanak taa kaa bhau geaa |4|8|146|
English: - O Nanak, their fears are removed. ||4||8||146||

[Ang 212 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ₂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree₂ mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਤਾਹੂ ਕਉ ਪੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kau bisarai raam naam taahoo kau peer |
English: One who forgets the Lord's Name, suffers in pain.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasangat mil har raveh se gunee gaheer |1| rahaau |
English: Those who join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and dwell upon the Lord, find the Ocean of virtue. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਬੁਧਿ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kau guramukh ridai budh |
English: Those Gurmukhs whose hearts are filled with wisdom,

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਕਰ ਤਲ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: taa kai kar tal nav nidh sidh |1|
English: hold the nine treasures, and the miraculous spiritual powers of the Siddhas in the palms of their hands. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: jo jaaneh har prabh dhanee |
English: Those who know the Lord God as their Master,

Gurbani: ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਕਮੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kichh naahee taa kai kamee |2|
English: do not lack anything. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੁ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: karanaihaar pachhaaniaa |
English: Those who realize the Creator Lord,

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sarab sookh rang maaniaa |3|
English: enjoy all peace and pleasure. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਵਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: har dhan jaa kai grihi vasai |
English: Those whose inner homes are filled with the Lord's wealth

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਸੈ ॥੪॥੯॥੧੪੭॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak tin sang dukh nasai |4|9|147|
English: - says Nanak, in their company, pain departs. ||4||9||147||

[Ang 212 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗਰਬੁ ਬਡੋ ਮੂਲੁ ਇਤਨੋ ॥
Transliteration: garab baddo mool itano |
English: Your pride is so great, but what about your origins?

Gurbani: ਰਹਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਗਹੁ ਕਿਤਨੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: rehan nahee gahu kitano |1| rahaau |
English: You cannot remain, no matter how much you try to hold on. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬੇਬਰਜਤ ਬੇਦ ਸੰਤਨਾ ਉਆਹੂ ਸਿਉ ਰੇ ਹਿਤਨੋ ॥
Transliteration: bebarajat bed santanaa uaahoo siau re hitano |
English: That which is forbidden by the Vedas and the Saints - with that, you are in love.

Gurbani: ਹਾਰ ਜੂਆਰ ਜੂਆ ਬਿਧੇ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਵਸਿ ਲੈ ਜਿਤਨੋ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: haar jooaar jooaa bidhe indree vas lai jitano |1|
English: Like the gambler losing the game of chance, you are held in the power of sensory desires. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਨ ਭਰਨ ਸੰਪੂਰਨਾ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਿਤਨੋ ॥
Transliteration: haran bharan sanpooranaa charan kamal rang ritano |
English: The One who is All-powerful to empty out and fill up - you have no love for His Lotus Feet.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਧਰੇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਮੈ ਦਿਤਨੋ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੧੪੮॥
Transliteration: naanak udhare saadhasang kirapaa nidh mai ditano |2|10|148|
English: O Nanak, I have been saved, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. I have been blessed by the Treasure of Mercy. ||2||10||148||

[Ang 212 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ₃ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree₃ mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਦਾਸਰੋ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੋ ॥
Transliteration: mohi daasaro tthaakur ko |
English: I am the slave of my Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਧਾਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਖਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dhaan prabh kaa khaanaa |1| rahaau |
English: I eat whatever God gives me. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਐਸੋ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਖਸਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aiso hai re khasam hamaaraa |
English: Such is my Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: khin meh saaj savaaranahaaraa |1|
English: In an instant, He creates and embellishes. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰੀ ਜੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaam karee je tthaakur bhaavaa |
English: I do that work which pleases my Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਗੀਤ ਚਰਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: geet charit prabh ke gun gaavaa |2|
English: I sing the songs of God's glory, and His wondrous play. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਵਜੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: saran pario tthaakur vajeeraa |
English: I seek the Sanctuary of the Lord's Prime Minister;

Gurbani: ਤਿਨਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tinaa dekh meraa man dheeraa |3|
English: beholding Him, my mind is comforted and consoled. ||3||

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਏਕੋ ਆਧਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: ek ttek eko aadhaaraa |
English: The One Lord is my support, the One is my steady anchor.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਲਾਗਾ ਕਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੧੪੯॥
Transliteration: jan naanak har kee laagaa kaaraa |4|11|149|
English: Servant Nanak is engaged in the Lord's work. ||4||11||149||

[Ang 212 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਐਸਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਤੋਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: hai koee aisaa haumai torai |
English: Is there anyone, who can shatter his ego,

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਮੀਠੀ ਤੇ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: eis meetthee te ihu man horai |1| rahaau |
English: and turn his mind away from this sweet Maya? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਮਾਨੁਖੁ ਭਇਆ ਜੋ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੋ ਲੋਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: agiaanee maanukh bheaa jo naahee so lorai |
English: Humanity is in spiritual ignorance; people see things that do not exist.

Gurbani: ਰੈਣਿ ਅੰਧਾਰੀ ਕਾਰੀਆ ਕਵਨ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਭੋਰੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: rain andhaaree kaareea kavan jugat jit bhorai |1|
English: The night is dark and gloomy; how will the morning dawn? ||1||

Gurbani: ਭ੍ਰਮਤੋ ਭ੍ਰਮਤੋ ਹਾਰਿਆ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਿਧੀ ਕਰਿ ਟੋਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: bhramato bhramato haariaa anik bidhee kar ttorai |
English: Wandering, wandering all around, I have grown weary; trying all sorts of things, I have been searching.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਮੋਰੈ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੧੫੦॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak kirapaa bhee saadhasangat nidh morai |2|12|150|
English: Says Nanak, He has shown mercy to me; I have found the treasure of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||12||150||

[Ang 212 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਚਿੰਤਾਮਣਿ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: chintaaman karunaa me |1| rahaau |
English: He is the Wish-fulfilling Jewel, the Embodiment of Mercy. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ॥ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ ਸੁਖ ਭਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: deen deaalaa paarabraham | jaa kai simaran sukh bhe |1|
English: The Supreme Lord God is Merciful to the meek; Meditating in remembrance on Him, peace is obtained. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਕਾਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧ ॥ ਸੁਨਤ ਜਸੋ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਘ ਖਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: akaal purakh agaadh bodh | sunat jaso kott agh khe |2|
English: The Wisdom of the Undying Primal Being is beyond comprehension. Hearing His Praises, millions of sins are erased. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਇਆ ਧਾਰਿ ॥ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਲਏ ॥੩॥੧੩॥੧੫੧॥
Transliteration: kirapaa nidh prabh meaa dhaar | naanak har har naam le |3|13|151|
English: O God, Treasure of Mercy, please bless Nanak with Your kindness, that he may repeat the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||13||151||

[Ang 212 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ₄ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree poorabee₄ mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree Poorbee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: mere man saran prabhoo sukh paae |
English: O my mind, in the Sanctuary of God, peace is found.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਦਿਨਿ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਤ ਅਜਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaa din bisarai praan sukhadaataa so din jaat ajaae |1| rahaau |
English: That day, when the Giver of life and peace is forgotten - that day passes uselessly. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਰੈਣ ਕੇ ਪਾਹੁਨ ਤੁਮ ਆਏ ਬਹੁ ਜੁਗ ਆਸ ਬਧਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: ek rain ke paahun tum aae bahu jug aas badhaae |
English: You have come as a guest for one short night, and yet you hope to live for many ages.

Gurbani: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮੰਦਰ ਸੰਪੈ ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਜਿਉ ਤਰਵਰ ਕੀ ਛਾਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: grih mandar sanpai jo deesai jiau taravar kee chhaae |1|
English: Households, mansions and wealth - whatever is seen, is like the shade of a tree. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੰਪੈ ਸਭ ਮੇਰੀ ਬਾਗ ਮਿਲਖ ਸਭ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: tan meraa sanpai sabh meree baag milakh sabh jaae |
English: My body, wealth, and all my gardens and property shall all pass away.

Gurbani: ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰਾ ਬਿਸਰਿਓ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਤ ਪਰਾਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: devanahaaraa bisario tthaakur khin meh hot paraae |2|
English: You have forgotten your Lord and Master, the Great Giver. In an instant, these shall belong to somebody else. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪਹਿਰੈ ਬਾਗਾ ਕਰਿ ਇਸਨਾਨਾ ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: pahirai baagaa kar isanaanaa choaa chandan laae |
English: You wear white clothes and take cleansing baths, and anoint yourself with sandalwood oil.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਨਹੀ ਚੀਨਿਆ ਜਿਉ ਹਸਤੀ ਨਾਵਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: nirbhau nirankaar nahee cheeniaa jiau hasatee naavaae |3|
English: But you do not remember the Fearless, Formless Lord - you are like an elephant bathing in the mud. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਤ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੈ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jau hoe kripaal ta satigur melai sabh sukh har ke naae |
English: When God becomes merciful, He leads you to meet the True Guru; all peace is in the Name of the Lord.
