Gurbani: ਮੁਕਤੁ ਭਇਆ ਬੰਧਨ ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਲੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੧੫੨॥
Transliteration: mukat bheaa bandhan gur khole jan naanak har gun gaae |4|14|152|
English: The Guru has liberated me from bondage; servant Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||14||152||

[Ang 213 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree poorabee mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਦ ਕਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: mere man gur gur gur sad kareeai |
English: O my mind, dwell always upon the Guru, Guru, Guru.

Gurbani: ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਰੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ratan janam safal gur keea darasan kau balihareeai |1| rahaau |
English: The Guru has made the jewel of this human life prosperous and fruitful. I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੇਤੇ ਸਾਸ ਗ੍ਰਾਸ ਮਨੁ ਲੇਤਾ ਤੇਤੇ ਹੀ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: jete saas graas man letaa tete hee gun gaaeeai |
English: As many breaths and morsels as you take, O my mind - so many times, sing His Glorious Praises.

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਹੋਇ ਦੈਆਲੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਤਾ ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jau hoe daiaal satigur apunaa taa ih mat budh paaeeai |1|
English: When the True Guru becomes merciful, then this wisdom and understanding is obtained. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਏ ਜਮ ਬੰਧ ਤੇ ਛੂਟਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: mere man naam le jam bandh te chhootteh sarab sukhaa sukh paaeeai |
English: O my mind, taking the Naam, you shall be released from the bondage of death, and the peace of all peace will be found.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਮਨ ਬੰਛਤ ਫਲ ਆਈਐ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sev suaamee satigur daataa man banchhat fal aaeeai |2|
English: Serving your Lord and Master, the True Guru, the Great Giver, you shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਇਸਟੁ ਮੀਤ ਸੁਤ ਕਰਤਾ ਮਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੈ ਚਾਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: naam isatt meet sut karataa man sang tuhaarai chaalai |
English: The Name of the Creator is your beloved friend and child; it alone shall go along with you, O my mind.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਾਲੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kar sevaa satigur apune kee gur te paaeeai paalai |3|
English: So serve your True Guru, and you shall receive the Name from the Guru. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਰਬ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur kirapaal kripaa prabh dhaaree binase sarab andesaa |
English: When God, the Merciful Guru, showered His Mercy upon me, all my anxieties were dispelled.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨਿ ਮਿਟਿਓ ਸਗਲ ਕਲੇਸਾ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੧੫੩॥
Transliteration: naanak sukh paaeaa har keeratan mittio sagal kalesaa |4|15|153|
English: Nanak has found the peace of the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. All his sorrows have been dispelled. ||4||15||153||

[Ang 213 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raag gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Raag Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬਿਰਲੇ ਹੀ ਕੀ ਬੁਝੀ ਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: trisanaa birale hee kee bujhee he |1| rahaau |
English: The thirst of only a few is quenched. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਜੋਰੇ ਲਾਖ ਕ੍ਰੋਰੇ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਰੇ ॥ ਪਰੈ ਪਰੈ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਲੁਝੀ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kott jore laakh krore man na hore | parai parai hee kau lujhee he |1|
English: People may accumulate hundreds of thousands, millions, tens of millions, and yet the mind is not restrained. They only yearn for more and more. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਨਾਰੀ ਅਨਿਕ ਪਰਕਾਰੀ ਪਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਬਿਕਾਰੀ ॥ ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਨਹੀ ਸੁਝੀ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sundar naaree anik parakaaree par grih bikaaree | buraa bhalaa nahee sujhee he |2|
English: They may have all sorts of beautiful women, but still, they commit adultery in the homes of others. They do not distinguish between good and bad. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਬੰਧਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਭਰਮਤੁ ਭਰਮਾਇਆ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਹੀ ਗਾਇਆ ॥ ਮਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਲੁਝੀ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: anik bandhan maaeaa bharamat bharamaaeaa gun nidh nahee gaaeaa | man bikhai hee meh lujhee he |3|
English: They wander around lost, trapped in the myriad bonds of Maya; they do not sing the Praises of the Treasure of Virtue. Their minds are engrossed in poison and corruption. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਰੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੈ ਜੀਵਤ ਸੋਈ ਮਰੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਤਰੈ ॥ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਦਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਝੀ ਹੇ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੫੪॥
Transliteration: jaa kau re kirapaa karai jeevat soee marai saadhasang maaeaa tarai | naanak so jan dar har sijhee he |4|1|154|
English: Those, unto whom the Lord shows His Mercy, remain dead while yet alive. In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, they cross over the ocean of Maya. O Nanak, those humble beings are honored in the Court of the Lord. ||4||1||154||

[Ang 213 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਭਹੂ ਕੋ ਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਹੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sabhahoo ko ras har ho |1| rahaau |
English: The Lord is the essence of all. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੂ ਜੋਗ ਕਾਹੂ ਭੋਗ ਕਾਹੂ ਗਿਆਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਧਿਆਨ ॥ ਕਾਹੂ ਹੋ ਡੰਡ ਧਰਿ ਹੋ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kaahoo jog kaahoo bhog kaahoo giaan kaahoo dhiaan | kaahoo ho ddandd dhar ho |1|
English: Some practice Yoga, some indulge in pleasures; some live in spiritual wisdom, some live in meditation. Some are bearers of the staff. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੂ ਜਾਪ ਕਾਹੂ ਤਾਪ ਕਾਹੂ ਪੂਜਾ ਹੋਮ ਨੇਮ ॥ ਕਾਹੂ ਹੋ ਗਉਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਹੋ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kaahoo jaap kaahoo taap kaahoo poojaa hom nem | kaahoo ho gaun kar ho |2|
English: Some chant in meditation, some practice deep, austere meditation; some worship Him in adoration, some practice daily rituals. Some live the life of a wanderer. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੂ ਤੀਰ ਕਾਹੂ ਨੀਰ ਕਾਹੂ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਹੋ ॥੩॥੨॥੧੫੫॥
Transliteration: kaahoo teer kaahoo neer kaahoo bed beechaar | naanakaa bhagat pria ho |3|2|155|
English: Some live by the shore, some live on the water; some study the Vedas. Nanak loves to worship the Lord. ||3||2||155||

[Ang 213 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਨ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਮੋਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gun keerat nidh moree |1| rahaau |
English: To sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises is my treasure. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰਹੀ ਰਸ ਤੂੰਹੀ ਜਸ ਤੂੰਹੀ ਰੂਪ ਤੂਹੀ ਰੰਗ ॥ ਆਸ ਓਟ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੋਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: toonhee ras toonhee jas toonhee roop toohee rang | aas ott prabh toree |1|
English: You are my delight, You are my praise. You are my beauty, You are my love. O God, You are my hope and support. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੂਹੀ ਮਾਨ ਤੂੰਹੀ ਧਾਨ ਤੂਹੀ ਪਤਿ ਤੂਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥ ਗੁਰਿ ਤੂਟੀ ਲੈ ਜੋਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: toohee maan toonhee dhaan toohee pat toohee praan | gur toottee lai joree |2|
English: You are my pride, You are my wealth. You are my honor, You are my breath of life. The Guru has repaired that which was broken. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੂਹੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਤੂਹੀ ਬਨਿ ਤੂਹੀ ਗਾਉ ਤੂਹੀ ਸੁਨਿ ॥ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨੇਰ ਨੇਰੀ ॥੩॥੩॥੧੫੬॥
Transliteration: toohee grihi toohee ban toohee gaau toohee sun | hai naanak ner neree |3|3|156|
English: You are in the household, and You are in the forest. You are in the village, and You are in the wilderness. Nanak: You are near, so very near! ||3||3||156||

[Ang 214 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਾਤੋ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਮਾਤੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: maato har rang maato |1| rahaau |
English: I am intoxicated, intoxicated with the Love of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਓੁਹੀ ਪੀਓ ਓੁਹੀ ਖੀਓ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਦੀਓ ਦਾਨੁ ਕੀਓ ॥ ਉਆਹੂ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤੋ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ouhee peeo ouhee kheeo gureh deeo daan keeo | uaahoo siau man raato |1|
English: I drink it in - I am drunk with it. The Guru has given it to me in charity. My mind is drenched with it. ||1||

Gurbani: ਓੁਹੀ ਭਾਠੀ ਓੁਹੀ ਪੋਚਾ ਉਹੀ ਪਿਆਰੋ ਉਹੀ ਰੂਚਾ ॥ ਮਨਿ ਓਹੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾਤੋ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ouhee bhaatthee ouhee pochaa uhee piaaro uhee roochaa | man oho sukh jaato |2|
English: It is my furnace, it is the cooling plaster. It is my love, it is my longing. My mind knows it as peace. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਹਜ ਕੇਲ ਅਨਦ ਖੇਲ ਰਹੇ ਫੇਰ ਭਏ ਮੇਲ ॥ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਰਾਤੋ ॥੩॥੪॥੧੫੭॥
Transliteration: sehaj kel anad khel rahe fer bhe mel | naanak gur sabad paraato |3|4|157|
English: I enjoy intuitive peace, and I play in bliss; the cycle of reincarnation is ended for me, and I am merged with the Lord. Nanak is pierced through with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||3||4||157||

[Ang 214 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੌੜੀ ਮਾਲਵਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raag gauarree maalavaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Raag Gauree Maalwaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਹੁ ਮੀਤਾ ਲੇਹੁ ਆਗੈ ਬਿਖਮ ਪੰਥੁ ਭੈਆਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har naam lehu meetaa lehu aagai bikham panth bhaiaan |1| rahaau |
English: Chant the Lord's Name; O my friend, chant it. Hereafter, the path is terrifying and treacherous. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਤ ਸੇਵਤ ਸਦਾ ਸੇਵਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸਤੁ ਹੈ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: sevat sevat sadaa sev terai sang basat hai kaal |
English: Serve, serve, forever serve the Lord. Death hangs over your head.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਹੋ ਕਾਟੀਐ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kar sevaa toon saadh kee ho kaatteeai jam jaal |1|
English: Do seva, selfless service, for the Holy Saints, and the noose of Death shall be cut away. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਤੀਰਥ ਕੀਏ ਬਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਧੇ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: hom jag teerath kee bich haumai badhe bikaar |
English: You may make burnt offerings, sacrificial feasts and pilgrimages to sacred shrines in egotism, but your corruption only increases.

Gurbani: ਨਰਕੁ ਸੁਰਗੁ ਦੁਇ ਭੁੰਚਨਾ ਹੋਇ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: narak surag due bhunchanaa hoe bahur bahur avataar |2|
English: You are subject to both heaven and hell, and you are reincarnated over and over again. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਿਵ ਪੁਰੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਪੁਰੀ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਕੋ ਥਾਉ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: siv puree braham indr puree nihachal ko thaau naeh |
English: The realm of Shiva, the realms of Brahma and Indra as well - no place anywhere is permanent.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਹੋ ਸਾਕਤ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bin har sevaa sukh nahee ho saakat aaveh jaeh |3|
English: Without serving the Lord, there is no peace at all. The faithless cynic comes and goes in reincarnation. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੋ ਗੁਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਮੈ ਤੈਸੋ ਕਹਿਆ ਪੁਕਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jaiso gur upadesiaa mai taiso kahiaa pukaar |
English: As the Guru has taught me, so have I spoken.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੁਨਿ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੫੮॥
Transliteration: naanak kahai sun re manaa kar keeratan hoe udhaar |4|1|158|
English: Says Nanak, listen, people: sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, and you shall be saved. ||4||1||158||

[Ang 214 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਲਾ₁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raag gaurree maalaa₁ mahalaa 5 |
English: Raag Gauree Maalaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਪਾਇਓ ਬਾਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: paaeo baal budh sukh re |
English: Adopting the innocent mind of a child, I have found peace.

Gurbani: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਹਾਨਿ ਮਿਰਤੁ ਦੂਖ ਸੁਖ ਚਿਤਿ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: harakh sog haan mirat dookh sukh chit samasar gur mile |1| rahaau |
English: Joy and sorrow, profit and loss, birth and death, pain and pleasure - they are all the same to my consciousness, since I met the Guru. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਲਉ ਹਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੋਚਉ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਤਉ ਲਉ ਦੁਖਨੁ ਭਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jau lau hau kichh sochau chitvau tau lau dukhan bhare |
English: As long as I plotted and planned things, I was full of frustration.

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਤਉ ਆਨਦ ਸਹਜੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jau kripaal gur pooraa bhettiaa tau aanad sahaje |1|
English: When I met the Kind, Perfect Guru, then I obtained bliss so easily. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੇਤੀ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਕਰਮ ਹਉ ਕੀਏ ਤੇਤੇ ਬੰਧ ਪਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jetee siaanap karam hau kee tete bandh pare |
English: The more clever tricks I tried, the more bonds I was saddled with.

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਸਾਧੂ ਕਰੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਰਿਓ ਤਬ ਹਮ ਮੁਕਤ ਭਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jau saadhoo kar masatak dhario tab ham mukat bhe |2|
English: When the Holy Saint placed His Hand upon my forehead, then I was liberated. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਲਉ ਮੇਰੋ ਮੇਰੋ ਕਰਤੋ ਤਉ ਲਉ ਬਿਖੁ ਘੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jau lau mero mero karato tau lau bikh ghere |
English: As long as I claimed, "Mine, mine!", I was surrounded by wickedness and corruption.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਬੁਧਿ ਅਰਪੀ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਉ ਤਬ ਹਮ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੋਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: man tan budh arapee tthaakur kau tab ham sehaj soe |3|
English: But when I dedicated my mind, body and intellect to my Lord and Master, then I began to sleep in peace. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਲਉ ਪੋਟ ਉਠਾਈ ਚਲਿਅਉ ਤਉ ਲਉ ਡਾਨ ਭਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jau lau pott utthaaee chaliaau tau lau ddaan bhare |
English: As long as I walked along, carrying the load, I continued to pay the fine.

Gurbani: ਪੋਟ ਡਾਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਭਏ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੫੯॥
Transliteration: pott ddaar gur pooraa miliaa tau naanak nirabhe |4|1|159|
English: But I threw away that bundle, when I met the Perfect Guru; O Nanak, then I became fearless. ||4||1||159||

[Ang 214 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਲਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree maalaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree Maalaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਭਾਵਨੁ ਤਿਆਗਿਓ ਰੀ ਤਿਆਗਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: bhaavan tiaagio ree tiaagio |
English: I have renounced my desires; I have renounced them.

Gurbani: ਤਿਆਗਿਓ ਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਤਿਆਗਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: tiaagio mai gur mil tiaagio |
English: I have renounced them; meeting the Guru, I have renounced them.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਰਸ ਮਾਨਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੈ ਆਗਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sarab sukh aanand mangal ras maan gobindai aagio |1| rahaau |
English: All peace, joy, happiness and pleasures have come since I surrendered to the Will of the Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਾਨੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਦੋਊ ਸਮਾਨੇ ਮਸਤਕੁ ਡਾਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਗਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: maan abhimaan doaoo samaane masatak ddaar gur paagio |
English: Honor and dishonor are the same to me; I have placed my forehead upon the Guru's Feet.

Gurbani: ਸੰਪਤ ਹਰਖੁ ਨ ਆਪਤ ਦੂਖਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੈ ਲਾਗਿਓ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sanpat harakh na aapat dookhaa rang tthaakurai laagio |1|
English: Wealth does not excite me, and misfortune does not disturb me; I have embraced love for my Lord and Master. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਾਸ ਬਾਸਰੀ ਏਕੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਗਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: baas baasaree ekai suaamee udiaan drisattaagio |
English: The One Lord and Master dwells in the home; He is seen in the wilderness as well.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਸੰਤ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਡਾਰਿਓ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਰਬਾਗਿਓ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: nirbhau bhe sant bhram ddaario pooran sarabaagio |2|
English: I have become fearless; the Saint has removed my doubts. The All-knowing Lord is pervading everywhere. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਤੈ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਮਨਿ ਬੁਰੋ ਨ ਲਾਗਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: jo kichh karatai kaaran keeno man buro na laagio |
English: Whatever the Creator does, my mind is not troubled.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਸੋਇਓ ਮਨੁ ਜਾਗਿਓ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: saadhasangat parasaad santan kai soeo man jaagio |3|
English: By the Grace of the Saints and the Company of the Holy, my sleeping mind has been awakened. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਓੜਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ ਪਰਿਓ ਆਇਓ ਸਰਣਾਗਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: jan naanak orr tuhaaree pario aaeo saranaagio |
English: Servant Nanak seeks Your Support; he has come to Your Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗ ਸਹਜ ਰਸ ਮਾਣੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗਿਓ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੬੦॥
Transliteration: naam rang sehaj ras maane fir dookh na laagio |4|2|160|
English: In the Love of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he enjoys intuitive peace; pain no longer touches him. ||4||2||160||

[Ang 215 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਲਾ₂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree maalaa₂ mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree Maalaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪਾਇਆ ਲਾਲੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: paaeaa laal ratan man paaeaa |
English: I have found the jewel of my Beloved within my mind.

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਥੀਆ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tan seetal man seetal theea satagur sabad samaaeaa |1| rahaau |
English: My body is cooled, my mind is cooled and soothed, and I am absorbed into the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਲਾਥੀ ਭੂਖ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਸਭ ਲਾਥੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਸਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: laathee bhookh trisan sabh laathee chintaa sagal bisaaree |
English: My hunger has departed, my thirst has totally departed, and all my anxiety is forgotten.

Gurbani: ਕਰੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਧਰਿਓ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਤੋ ਜਗੁ ਸਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kar masatak gur poorai dhario man jeeto jag saaree |1|
English: The Perfect Guru has placed His Hand upon my forehead; conquering my mind, I have conquered the whole world. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਇ ਰਹੇ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਡੋਲਨ ਤੇ ਅਬ ਚੂਕੇ ॥
Transliteration: tripat aghaae rahe rid antar ddolan te ab chooke |
English: Satisfied and satiated, I remain steady within my heart, and now, I do not waver at all.

Gurbani: ਅਖੁਟੁ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਤੋਟਿ ਨਹੀ ਰੇ ਮੂਕੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: akhutt khajaanaa satigur deea tott nahee re mooke |2|
English: The True Guru has given me the inexhaustible treasure; it never decreases, and never runs out. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਚਰਜੁ ਏਕੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਿ ਐਸੀ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: acharaj ek sunahu re bhaaee gur aisee boojh bujhaaee |
English: Listen to this wonder, O Siblings of Destiny: the Guru has given me this understanding.

Gurbani: ਲਾਹਿ ਪਰਦਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਜਉ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਤਉ ਬਿਸਰੀ ਤਾਤਿ ਪਰਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: laeh paradaa tthaakur jau bhettio tau bisaree taat paraaee |3|
English: I threw off the veil of illusion, when I met my Lord and Master; then, I forgot my jealousy of others. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਏਹੁ ਅਚੰਭਉ ਸੋ ਜਾਨੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਚਾਖਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: kahio na jaaee ehu achanbhau so jaanai jin chaakhiaa |
English: This is a wonder which cannot be described. They alone know it, who have tasted it.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚ ਭਏ ਬਿਗਾਸਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਲੈ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੬੧॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak sach bhe bigaasaa gur nidhaan ridai lai raakhiaa |4|3|161|
English: Says Nanak, the Truth has been revealed to me. The Guru has given me the treasure; I have taken it and enshrined it within my heart. ||4||3||161||

[Ang 215 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਲਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree maalaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree Maalaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਉਬਰਤ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: aubarat raajaa raam kee saranee |
English: Those who take to the Sanctuary of the Lord, the King, are saved.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਲੋਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਮੰਡਲ ਗਿਰਿ ਗਿਰਿ ਪਰਤੇ ਧਰਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sarab lok maaeaa ke manddal gir gir parate dharanee |1| rahaau |
English: All other people, in the mansion of Maya, fall flat on their faces on the ground. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਤ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ਮਹਾ ਪੁਰਖਨ ਇਉ ਕਹਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: saasat sinmrit bed beechaare mahaa purakhan iau kahiaa |
English: The great men have studied the Shaastras, the Simritees and the Vedas, and they have said this:

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਸੂਖੁ ਨ ਕਿਨਹੂੰ ਲਹਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bin har bhajan naahee nisataaraa sookh na kinahoon lahiaa |1|
English: "Without the Lord's meditation, there is no emancipation, and no one has ever found peace." ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੀਨਿ ਭਵਨ ਕੀ ਲਖਮੀ ਜੋਰੀ ਬੂਝਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਲਹਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: teen bhavan kee lakhamee joree boojhat naahee lahare |
English: People may accumulate the wealth of the three worlds, but the waves of greed are still not subdued.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਹਾ ਥਿਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਫਿਰਤੋ ਪਹਰੇ ਪਹਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bin har bhagat kahaa thit paavai firato pahare pahare |2|
English: Without devotional worship of the Lord, where can anyone find stability? People wander around endlessly. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਿਲਾਸ ਕਰਤ ਮਨ ਮੋਹਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਤ ਨ ਕਾਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: anik bilaas karat man mohan pooran hot na kaamaa |
English: People engage in all sorts of mind-enticing pastimes, but their passions are not fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਜਲਤੋ ਜਲਤੋ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਬੂਝਤ ਸਗਲ ਬ੍ਰਿਥੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jalato jalato kabahoo na boojhat sagal brithe bin naamaa |3|
English: They burn and burn, and are never satisfied; without the Lord's Name, it is all useless. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ ਇਹੈ ਸਾਰ ਸੁਖੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam japahu mere meetaa ihai saar sukh pooraa |
English: Chant the Name of the Lord, my friend; this is the essence of perfect peace.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਾ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੬੨॥
Transliteration: saadhasangat janam maran nivaarai naanak jan kee dhooraa |4|4|162|
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, birth and death are ended. Nanak is the dust of the feet of the humble. ||4||4||162||

[Ang 215 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਲਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree maalaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree Maalaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੋ ਸਮਝਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: mo kau ih bidh ko samajhaavai |
English: Who can help me understand my condition?

Gurbani: ਕਰਤਾ ਹੋਇ ਜਨਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: karataa hoe janaavai |1| rahaau |
English: Only the Creator knows it. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਨਜਾਨਤ ਕਿਛੁ ਇਨਹਿ ਕਮਾਨੋ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਸਾਧਾ ॥
Transliteration: anajaanat kichh ineh kamaano jap tap kachhoo na saadhaa |
English: This person does things in ignorance; he does not chant in meditation, and does not perform any deep, self-disciplined meditation.

Gurbani: ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਲੈ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦਉਰਾਇਓ ਕਵਨ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਬਾਧਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: deh dis lai ihu man dauraaeo kavan karam kar baadhaa |1|
English: This mind wanders around in the ten directions - how can it be restrained? ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਧਨ ਭੂਮਿ ਕਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਹਉ ਇਸ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: man tan dhan bhoom kaa tthaakur hau is kaa ihu meraa |
English: "I am the lord, the master of my mind, body, wealth and lands. These are mine."

Gurbani: ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਕਛੁ ਸੂਝਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਇਹ ਪੈਖਰ ਪਏ ਪੈਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bharam moh kachh soojhas naahee ih paikhar pe pairaa |2|
English: In doubt and emotional attachment, this person understands nothing; with this leash, these feet are tied up. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਇਹੁ ਕਹਾ ਕਮਾਵਨ ਪਰਿਆ ਜਬ ਇਹੁ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: tab ihu kahaa kamaavan pariaa jab ihu kachhoo na hotaa |
English: What did this person do, when he did not exist?

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਏਕ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪਹਿ ਕਰਤਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jab ek niranjan nirankaar prabh sabh kichh aapeh karataa |3|
English: When the Immaculate and Formless Lord God was all alone, He did everything by Himself. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੇ ਕਰਤਬ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਨੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: apane karatab aape jaanai jin ihu rachan rachaaeaa |
English: He alone knows His actions; He created this creation.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੬੩॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak karanahaar hai aape satigur bharam chukaaeaa |4|5|163|
English: Says Nanak, the Lord Himself is the Doer. The True Guru has dispelled my doubts. ||4||5||163||

[Ang 216 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਲਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree maalaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree Maalaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਆ ਬਿਰਥੇ ॥
Transliteration: har bin avar kriaa birathe |
English: Without the Lord, other actions are useless.

Gurbani: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਣੇ ਇਹਿ ਓਰੈ ਮੂਸੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jap tap sanjam karam kamaane ihi orai moose |1| rahaau |
English: Meditative chants, intense deep meditation, austere self-discipline and rituals - these are plundered in this world. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਸੰਜਮ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਤਾ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਆਢੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: barat nem sanjam meh rahataa tin kaa aadt na paaeaa |
English: Fasting, daily rituals, and austere self-discipline - those who keep the practice of these, are rewarded with less than a shell.

Gurbani: ਆਗੈ ਚਲਣੁ ਅਉਰੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਊਂਹਾ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aagai chalan aaur hai bhaaee aoonhaa kaam na aaeaa |1|
English: Hereafter, the way is different, O Siblings of Destiny. There, these things are of no use at all. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਇ ਅਰੁ ਧਰਨੀ ਭ੍ਰਮਤਾ ਆਗੈ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: teerath naae ar dharanee bhramataa aagai tthaur na paavai |
English: Those who bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, and wander over the earth, find no place of rest hereafter.

Gurbani: ਊਹਾ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਓਹੁ ਲੋਗਨ ਹੀ ਪਤੀਆਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aoohaa kaam na aavai ih bidh ohu logan hee pateeaavai |2|
English: There, these are of no use at all. By these things, they only please other people. ||2||

Gurbani: ਚਤੁਰ ਬੇਦ ਮੁਖ ਬਚਨੀ ਉਚਰੈ ਆਗੈ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: chatur bed mukh bachanee ucharai aagai mehal na paaeeai |
English: Reciting the four Vedas from memory, they do not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence hereafter.

Gurbani: ਬੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਏਕੁ ਸੁਧਾਖਰੁ ਓਹੁ ਸਗਲੀ ਝਾਖ ਝਖਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: boojhai naahee ek sudhaakhar ohu sagalee jhaakh jhakhaaeeai |3|
English: Those who do not understand the One Pure Word, utter total nonsense. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹਤੋ ਇਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ਜਿ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਪਾਰ ਗਰਾਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: naanak kahato ihu beechaaraa ji kamaavai su paar garaamee |
English: Nanak voices this opinion: those who practice it, swim across.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਅਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਤਿਆਗਹੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੀ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੬੪॥
Transliteration: gur sevahu ar naam dhiaavahu tiaagahu manahu gumaanee |4|6|164|
English: Serve the Guru, and meditate on the Naam; renounce the egotistical pride from your mind. ||4||6||164||

[Ang 216 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree maalaa 5 |
English: Gauree Maalaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਾਧਉ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: maadhau har har har mukh kaheeai |
English: O Lord, I chant Your Name, Har, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਤੇ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ham te kachhoo na hovai suaamee jiau raakhahu tiau raheeai |1| rahaau |
English: I cannot do anything by myself, O Lord and Master. As You keep me, so I remain. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਕਿ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਾ ਕਿਆ ਇਸੁ ਹਾਥਿ ਬਿਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa kichh karai ki karanaihaaraa kiaa is haath bichaare |
English: What can the mere mortal do? What is in the hands of this poor creature?

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਤੁਮ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਲਾਗਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਖਸਮ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jit tum laavahu tith hee laagaa pooran khasam hamaare |1|
English: As You attach us, so we are attached, O my Perfect Lord and Master. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਸਰਬ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ ਏਕ ਰੂਪ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: karahu kripaa sarab ke daate ek roop liv laavahu |
English: Take pity on me, O Great Giver of all, that I may enshrine love for Your Form alone.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਹਿ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵਹੁ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੬੫॥
Transliteration: naanak kee benantee har peh apunaa naam japaavahu |2|7|165|
English: Nanak offers this prayer to the Lord, that he may chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||7||165||

[Ang 216 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ₁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raag gaurree maajha₁ mahalaa 5 |
English: Raag Gauree Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਦਮੋਦਰ ਰਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: deen deaal damodar raaeaa jeeo |
English: O Merciful to the meek, O Dear Lord King,

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵ ਲਗਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: kott janaa kar sev lagaaeaa jeeo |
English: You have engaged millions of people in Your Service.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤ ਵਛਲੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਰਖਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat vachhal teraa birad rakhaaeaa jeeo |
English: You are the Lover of Your devotees; this is Your Nature.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭਨੀ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: pooran sabhanee jaaee jeeo |1|
English: You are totally pervading all places. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਪੇਖਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਕਵਣ ਸੁਕਰਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: kiau pekhaa preetam kavan sukaranee jeeo |
English: How can I behold my Beloved? What is that way of life?

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਾ ਦਾਸੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਰਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: santaa daasee sevaa charanee jeeo |
English: Become the slave of the Saints, and serve at their feet.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਵਤਾਈ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: eihu jeeo vataaee bal bal jaaee jeeo |
English: I dedicate this soul; I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to them.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tis niv niv laagau paaee jeeo |2|
English: Bowing low, I fall at the Feet of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪੋਥੀ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਬੇਦ ਖੋਜੰਤਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: pothee panddit bed khojantaa jeeo |
English: The Pandits, the religious scholars, study the books of the Vedas.

Gurbani: ਹੋਇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵੰਤਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: hoe bairaagee teerath naavantaa jeeo |
English: Some become renunciates, and bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

Gurbani: ਗੀਤ ਨਾਦ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਵੰਤਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: geet naad keeratan gaavantaa jeeo |
English: Some sing tunes and melodies and songs.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har nirbhau naam dhiaaee jeeo |3|
English: But I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Fearless Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhe kripaal suaamee mere jeeo |
English: My Lord and Master has become merciful to me.

Gurbani: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵਿਤ ਲਗਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਪੈਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: patit pavit lag gur ke paire jeeo |
English: I was a sinner, and I have been sanctified, taking to the Guru's Feet.

Gurbani: ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਕਾਟਿ ਕੀਏ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhram bhau kaatt kee niravaire jeeo |
English: Dispelling my doubts and fears, the Guru has rid me of hatred.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਪੂਰਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: gur man kee aas pooraaee jeeo |4|
English: The Guru has fulfilled the desires of my mind. ||4||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋ ਧਨਵੰਤਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: jin naau paaeaa so dhanavantaa jeeo |
English: One who has obtained the Name is wealthy.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਸੁ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: jin prabh dhiaaeaa su sobhaavantaa jeeo |
English: One who meditates on God is glorified.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਭ ਸੁਕਰਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: jis saadhoo sangat tis sabh sukaranee jeeo |
English: Sublime are all the actions of those who join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥੧॥੧੬੬॥
Transliteration: jan naanak sehaj samaaee jeeo |5|1|166|
English: Servant Nanak is intuitively absorbed into the Lord. ||5||1||166||

[Ang 217 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਮਾਝ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 maajh |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl, Maajh:

Gurbani: ਆਉ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: aau hamaarai raam piaare jeeo |
English: Come to me, O my Beloved Lord.

Gurbani: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਚਿਤਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: rain dinas saas saas chitaare jeeo |
English: Night and day, with each and every breath, I think of You.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਦੇਉ ਸੰਦੇਸਾ ਪੈ ਚਰਣਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: sant deo sandesaa pai charanaare jeeo |
English: O Saints, give Him this message; I fall at Your Feet.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਤਰੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tudh bin kit bidh tareeai jeeo |1|
English: Without You, how can I be saved? ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੈ ਮੈ ਕਰੇ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: sang tumaarai mai kare anandaa jeeo |
English: In Your Company, I am in ecstasy.

Gurbani: ਵਣਿ ਤਿਣਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: van tin tribhavan sukh paramaanandaa jeeo |
English: In the forest, the fields and the three worlds, there is peace and supreme bliss.

Gurbani: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਗਸੰਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: sej suhaavee ihu man bigasandaa jeeo |
English: My bed is beautiful, and my mind blossoms forth in ecstasy.

Gurbani: ਪੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਇਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਲਹੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: pekh darasan ihu sukh laheeai jeeo |2|
English: Beholding the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, I have found this peace. ||2||

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਪਖਾਰਿ ਕਰੀ ਨਿਤ ਸੇਵਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: charan pakhaar karee nit sevaa jeeo |
English: I wash Your Feet, and constantly serve You.

Gurbani: ਪੂਜਾ ਅਰਚਾ ਬੰਦਨ ਦੇਵਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: poojaa arachaa bandan devaa jeeo |
English: O Divine Lord, I worship and adore You; I bow down before You.

Gurbani: ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਲੇਵਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: daasan daas naam jap levaa jeeo |
English: I am the slave of Your slaves; I chant Your Name.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਉ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਕਹੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: binau tthaakur peh kaheeai jeeo |3|
English: I offer this prayer to my Lord and Master. ||3||

Gurbani: ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: eichh punee meree man tan hariaa jeeo |
English: My desires are fulfilled, and my mind and body are rejuvenated.

Gurbani: ਦਰਸਨ ਪੇਖਤ ਸਭ ਦੁਖ ਪਰਹਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: darasan pekhat sabh dukh parahariaa jeeo |
English: Beholding the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, all my pains have been taken away.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇ ਜਪਿ ਤਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam jape jap tariaa jeeo |
English: Chanting and meditating on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I have been saved.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਅਜਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਹੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੬੭॥
Transliteration: eihu ajar naanak sukh saheeai jeeo |4|2|167|
English: Nanak endures this unendurable celestial bliss. ||4||2||167||

[Ang 217 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਮਨ ਮਿਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: sun sun saajan man mit piaare jeeo |
English: Listen, listen, O my friend and companion, O Beloved of my mind:

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਭਿ ਵਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: man tan teraa ihu jeeo bhi vaare jeeo |
English: my mind and body are Yours. This life is a sacrifice to You as well.

Gurbani: ਵਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: visar naahee prabh praan adhaare jeeo |
English: May I never forget God, the Support of the breath of life.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sadaa teree saranaaee jeeo |1|
English: I have come to Your Eternal Sanctuary. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਭਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: jis miliai man jeevai bhaaee jeeo |
English: Meeting Him, my mind is revived, O Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee so har har paaee jeeo |
English: By Guru's Grace, I have found the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਆ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh prabh kaa prabh keea jaaee jeeo |
English: All things belong to God; all places belong to God.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: prabh kau sad bal jaaee jeeo |2|
English: I am forever a sacrifice to God. ||2||

Gurbani: ਏਹੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਜਪੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: ehu nidhaan japai vaddabhaagee jeeo |
English: Very fortunate are those who meditate on this treasure.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: naam niranjan ek liv laagee jeeo |
English: They enshrine love for the Naam, the Name of the One Immaculate Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur pooraa paaeaa sabh dukh mittaaeaa jeeo |
English: Finding the Perfect Guru, all suffering is dispelled.

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar gun gaaeaa jeeo |3|
English: Twenty-four hours a day, I sing the Glories of God. ||3||

Gurbani: ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: ratan padaarath har naam tumaaraa jeeo |
English: Your Name is the treasure of jewels, Lord.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: toon sachaa saahu bhagat vanajaaraa jeeo |
English: You are the True Banker; Your devotee is the trader.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਸਚੁ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har dhan raas sach vaapaaraa jeeo |
English: True is the trade of those who have the wealth of the Lord's assets.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੬੮॥
Transliteration: jan naanak sad balihaaraa jeeo |4|3|168|
English: Servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice. ||4||3||168||

[Ang 217 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raag gaurree maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Raag Gauree Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: toon meraa bahu maan karate toon meraa bahu maan |
English: I am so proud of You, O Creator; I am so proud of You.

Gurbani: ਜੋਰਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੈ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jor tumaarai sukh vasaa sach sabad neesaan |1| rahaau |
English: Through Your Almighty Power, I dwell in peace. The True Word of the Shabad is my banner and insignia. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਭੇ ਗਲਾ ਜਾਤੀਆ ਸੁਣਿ ਕੈ ਚੁਪ ਕੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabhe galaa jaateea sun kai chup keea |
English: He hears and knows everything, but he keeps silent.

Gurbani: ਕਦ ਹੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨ ਲਧੀਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੜਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kad hee surat na ladheea maaeaa moharriaa |1|
English: Bewitched by Maya, he never regains awareness. ||1||

Gurbani: ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਰਤ ਸਾਰਤਾ ਸੇ ਅਖੀ ਡਿਠੜਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: dee bujhaarat saarataa se akhee ddittharriaa |
English: The riddles and hints are given, and he sees them with his eyes.

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਜਿ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਲੋਭੀਆ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਸੁਣੀ ਕਹਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: koee ji moorakh lobheea mool na sunee kahiaa |2|
English: But he is foolish and greedy, and he never listens to what he is told. ||2||

Gurbani: ਇਕਸੁ ਦੁਹੁ ਚਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਗਣੀ ਸਭ ਇਕਤੁ ਸਾਦਿ ਮੁਠੀ ॥
Transliteration: eikas duhu chahu kiaa ganee sabh ikat saad mutthee |
English: Why bother to count one, two, three, four? The whole world is defrauded by the same enticements.

Gurbani: ਇਕੁ ਅਧੁ ਨਾਇ ਰਸੀਅੜਾ ਕਾ ਵਿਰਲੀ ਜਾਇ ਵੁਠੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: eik adh naae raseearraa kaa viralee jaae vutthee |3|
English: Hardly anyone loves the Lord's Name; how rare is that place which is in bloom. ||3||

Gurbani: ਭਗਤ ਸਚੇ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਹਦੇ ਅਨਦ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat sache dar sohade anad kareh din raat |
English: The devotees look beautiful in the True Court; night and day, they are happy.

Gurbani: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਤ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੬੯॥
Transliteration: rang rate paramesarai jan naanak tin bal jaat |4|1|169|
English: They are imbued with the Love of the Transcendent Lord; servant Nanak is a sacrifice to them. ||4||1||169||

[Ang 218 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਮਾਂਝ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 maanjh |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl, Maajh:

Gurbani: ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: dukh bhanjan teraa naam jee dukh bhanjan teraa naam |
English: The Destroyer of sorrow is Your Name, Lord; the Destroyer of sorrow is Your Name.

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar aaraadheeai pooran satigur giaan |1| rahaau |
English: Twenty-four hours a day, dwell upon the wisdom of the Perfect True Guru. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਥਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jit ghatt vasai paarabraham soee suhaavaa thaau |
English: That heart, in which the Supreme Lord God abides, is the most beautiful place.

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਕੰਕਰੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jam kankar nerr na aavee rasanaa har gun gaau |1|
English: The Messenger of Death does not even approach those who chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord with the tongue. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਆ ਨਾ ਜਾਪੈ ਆਰਾਧਿ ॥
Transliteration: sevaa surat na jaaneea naa jaapai aaraadh |
English: I have not understood the wisdom of serving Him, nor have I worshipped Him in meditation.

Gurbani: ਓਟ ਤੇਰੀ ਜਗਜੀਵਨਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ott teree jagajeevanaa mere tthaakur agam agaadh |2|
English: You are my Support, O Life of the World; O my Lord and Master, Inaccessible and Incomprehensible. ||2||

Gurbani: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਗੁਸਾਈਆ ਨਠੇ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥
Transliteration: bhe kripaal gusaaeea natthe sog santaap |
English: When the Lord of the Universe became merciful, sorrow and suffering departed.

Gurbani: ਤਤੀ ਵਾਉ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਰਖੇ ਆਪਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tatee vaau na lagee satigur rakhe aap |3|
English: The hot winds do not even touch those who are protected by the True Guru. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਦਯੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur naaraaein day gur gur sachaa sirajanahaar |
English: The Guru is the All-pervading Lord, the Guru is the Merciful Master; the Guru is the True Creator Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੭੦॥
Transliteration: gur tutthai sabh kichh paaeaa jan naanak sad balihaar |4|2|170|
English: When the Guru was totally satisfied, I obtained everything. Servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||4||2||170||

[Ang 218 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: har raam raam raam raamaa |
English: The Lord, the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam:

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਏ ਕਾਮਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jap pooran hoe kaamaa |1| rahaau |
English: meditating on Him, all affairs are resolved. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਜਪੇਦਿਆ ਹੋਆ ਮੁਖੁ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: raam gobind japediaa hoaa mukh pavitru |
English: Chanting the Name of the Lord of the Universe, one's mouth is sanctified.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਸੋਈ ਭਾਈ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har jas suneeai jis te soee bhaaee mitru |1|
English: One who recites to me the Praises of the Lord is my friend and brother. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਸਭਿ ਫਲਾ ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: sabh padaarath sabh falaa sarab gunaa jis maeh |
English: All treasures, all rewards and all virtues are in the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਦੁਖ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kiau gobind manahu visaareeai jis simarat dukh jaeh |2|
English: Why forget Him from your mind? Remembering Him in meditation, pain departs. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਲੜਿ ਲਗਿਐ ਜੀਵੀਐ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਪਈਐ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jis larr lagiai jeeveeai bhavajal peeai paar |
English: Grasping the hem of His robe, we live, and cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਾਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: mil saadhoo sang udhaar hoe mukh aoojal darabaar |3|
English: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one is saved, and one's face becomes radiant in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਨ ਰੂਪ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਜਸੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: jeevan roop gopaal jas sant janaa kee raas |
English: The Praise of the Sustainer of the Universe is the essence of life, and the wealth of His Saints.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਬਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੭੧॥
Transliteration: naanak ubare naam jap dar sachai saabaas |4|3|171|
English: Nanak is saved, chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord; in the True Court, he is cheered and applauded. ||4||3||171||

[Ang 218 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੀਠੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ਜਿੰਦੂ ਤੂੰ ਮੀਠੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: meetthe har gun gaau jindoo toon meetthe har gun gaau |
English: Sing the Sweet Praises of the Lord, O my soul, sing the Sweet Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sache setee ratiaa miliaa nithaave thaau |1| rahaau |
English: Attuned to the True One, even the homeless find a home. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹੋਰਿ ਸਾਦ ਸਭਿ ਫਿਕਿਆ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਫਿਕਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: hor saad sabh fikiaa tan man fikaa hoe |
English: All other tastes are bland and insipid; through them, the body and mind are rendered insipid as well.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਫਿਟੁ ਸੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: vin paramesar jo kare fitt su jeevan soe |1|
English: Without the Transcendent Lord, what can anyone do? Cursed is his life, and cursed his reputation. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅੰਚਲੁ ਗਹਿ ਕੈ ਸਾਧ ਕਾ ਤਰਣਾ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: anchal geh kai saadh kaa taranaa ihu sansaar |
English: Grasping the hem of the robe of the Holy Saint, we cross over the world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਉਧਰੈ ਸਭ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: paarabraham aaraadheeai udharai sabh paravaar |2|
English: Worship and adore the Supreme Lord God, and all your family will be saved as well. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਾਜਨੁ ਬੰਧੁ ਸੁਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: saajan bandh sumitru so har naam hiradai dee |
English: He is a companion, a relative, and a good friend of mine, who implants the Lord's Name within my heart.

Gurbani: ਅਉਗਣ ਸਭਿ ਮਿਟਾਇ ਕੈ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aaugan sabh mittaae kai praupakaar karee |3|
English: He washes off all my demerits, and is so generous to me. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਾਲੁ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਥੇਹੁ ਘਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: maal khajaanaa thehu ghar har ke charan nidhaan |
English: Wealth, treasures, and household are all just ruins; the Lord's Feet are the only treasure.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਾਚਕੁ ਦਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੭੨॥
Transliteration: naanak jaachak dar terai prabh tudhano mangai daan |4|4|172|
English: Nanak is a beggar standing at Your Door, God; he begs for Your charity. ||4||4||172||

[Ang 219 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: raag gaurree mahalaa 9 |
English: Raag Gauree, Ninth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੋ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਮਾਨੁ ਤਿਆਗਉ ॥
Transliteration: saadho man kaa maan tiaagau |
English: Holy Saadhus: forsake the pride of your mind.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਦੁਰਜਨ ਕੀ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭਾਗਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh sangat durajan kee taa te ahinis bhaagau |1| rahaau |
English: Sexual desire, anger and the company of evil people - run away from them, day and night. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੋਨੋ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਅਉਰੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਅਪਮਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: sukh dukh dono sam kar jaanai aaur maan apamaanaa |
English: One who knows that pain and pleasure are both the same, and honor and dishonor as well,

Gurbani: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਤੇ ਰਹੈ ਅਤੀਤਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਗਿ ਤਤੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: harakh sog te rahai ateetaa tin jag tat pachhaanaa |1|
English: who remains detached from joy and sorrow, realizes the true essence in the world. ||1||

Gurbani: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਦੋਊ ਤਿਆਗੈ ਖੋਜੈ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: ausatat nindaa doaoo tiaagai khojai pad nirabaanaa |
English: Renounce both praise and blame; seek instead the state of Nirvaanaa.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਕਠਨੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਨਹੂੰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੨॥੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak ihu khel katthan hai kinahoon guramukh jaanaa |2|1|
English: O servant Nanak, this is such a difficult game; only a few Gurmukhs understand it! ||2||1||

[Ang 219 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 9 |
English: Gauree, Ninth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੋ ਰਚਨਾ ਰਾਮ ਬਨਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: saadho rachanaa raam banaaee |
English: Holy Saadhus: the Lord fashioned the creation.

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਇਕ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਲਖਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: eik binasai ik asathir maanai acharaj lakhio na jaaee |1| rahaau |
English: One person passes away, and another thinks that he will live forever - this is a wonder beyond understanding! ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮੋਹ ਬਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਬਿਸਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh moh bas praanee har moorat bisaraaee |
English: The mortal beings are held in the power of sexual desire, anger and emotional attachment; they have forgotten the Lord, the Immortal Form.

Gurbani: ਝੂਠਾ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਓ ਜਿਉ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਰੈਨਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jhootthaa tan saachaa kar maanio jiau supanaa rainaaee |1|
English: The body is false, but they believe it to be true; it is like a dream in the night. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਦਰ ਕੀ ਛਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jo deesai so sagal binaasai jiau baadar kee chhaaee |
English: Whatever is seen, shall all pass away, like the shadow of a cloud.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਗੁ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਰਹਿਓ ਰਾਮ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥੨॥੨॥
Transliteration: jan naanak jag jaanio mithiaa rahio raam saranaaee |2|2|
English: O servant Nanak, one who knows the world to be unreal, dwells in the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||2||2||

[Ang 219 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 9 |
English: Gauree, Ninth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: praanee kau har jas man nahee aavai |
English: The Praise of the Lord does not come to dwell in the minds of the mortal beings.

Gurbani: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਮਗਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੈ ਕਹੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ahinis magan rahai maaeaa mai kahu kaise gun gaavai |1| rahaau |
English: Day and night, they remain engrossed in Maya. Tell me, how can they sing God's Glories? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪੂਤ ਮੀਤ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਮਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਆਪੁ ਬੰਧਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: poot meet maaeaa mamataa siau ih bidh aap bandhaavai |
English: In this way, they bind themselves to children, friends, Maya and possessiveness.

Gurbani: ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਿਉ ਝੂਠੋ ਇਹੁ ਜਗ ਦੇਖਿ ਤਾਸਿ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mrig trisanaa jiau jhoottho ihu jag dekh taas utth dhaavai |1|
English: Like the deer's delusion, this world is false; and yet, beholding it, they chase after it. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭੁਗਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਾ ਕਾਰਨੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੂੜ ਤਾਹਿ ਬਿਸਰਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: bhugat mukat kaa kaaran suaamee moorr taeh bisaraavai |
English: Our Lord and Master is the source of pleasures and liberation; and yet, the fool forgets Him.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੋਟਨ ਮੈ ਕੋਊ ਭਜਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੩॥
Transliteration: jan naanak kottan mai koaoo bhajan raam ko paavai |2|3|
English: O servant Nanak, among millions, there is scarcely anyone who attains the Lord's meditation. ||2||3||

[Ang 219 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 9 |
English: Gauree, Ninth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੋ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਗਹਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: saadho ihu man gahio na jaaee |
English: Holy Saadhus: this mind cannot be restrained.

Gurbani: ਚੰਚਲ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸਤੁ ਹੈ ਯਾ ਤੇ ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: chanchal trisanaa sang basat hai yaa te thir na rahaaee |1| rahaau |
English: Fickle desires dwell with it, and so it cannot remain steady. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਠਨ ਕਰੋਧ ਘਟ ਹੀ ਕੇ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਜਿਹ ਸੁਧਿ ਸਭ ਬਿਸਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: katthan karodh ghatt hee ke bheetar jih sudh sabh bisaraaee |
English: The heart is filled with anger and violence, which cause all sense to be forgotten.

Gurbani: ਰਤਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਭ ਕੋ ਹਿਰਿ ਲੀਨਾ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਬਸਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ratan giaan sabh ko hir leenaa taa siau kachh na basaaee |1|
English: The jewel of spiritual wisdom has been taken away from everyone; nothing can withstand it. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੋਗੀ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਤ ਸਭਿ ਹਾਰੇ ਗੁਨੀ ਰਹੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jogee jatan karat sabh haare gunee rahe gun gaaee |
English: The Yogis have tried everything and failed; the virtuous have grown weary of singing God's Glories.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਤਉ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥੨॥੪॥
Transliteration: jan naanak har bhe deaalaa tau sabh bidh ban aaee |2|4|
English: O servant Nanak, when the Lord becomes merciful, then every effort is successful. ||2||4||

[Ang 219 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 9 |
English: Gauree, Ninth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੋ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: saadho gobind ke gun gaavau |
English: Holy Saadhus: sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕਾਹਿ ਗਵਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: maanas janam amolak paaeo birathaa kaeh gavaavau |1| rahaau |
English: You have obtained the priceless jewel of this human life; why are you uselessly wasting it? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਦੀਨ ਬੰਧ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਆਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: patit puneet deen bandh har saran taeh tum aavau |
English: He is the Purifier of sinners, the Friend of the poor. Come, and enter the Lord's Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਗਜ ਕੋ ਤ੍ਰਾਸੁ ਮਿਟਿਓ ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਤੁਮ ਕਾਹੇ ਬਿਸਰਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gaj ko traas mittio jih simarat tum kaahe bisaraavau |1|
English: Remembering Him, the elephant's fear was removed; so why do you forget Him? ||1||

Gurbani: ਤਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਫੁਨਿ ਭਜਨ ਰਾਮ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: taj abhimaan moh maaeaa fun bhajan raam chit laavau |
English: Renounce your egotistical pride and your emotional attachment to Maya; focus your consciousness on the Lord's meditation.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਤ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪੰਥ ਇਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਤੁਮ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੨॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak kehat mukat panth ihu guramukh hoe tum paavau |2|5|
English: Says Nanak, this is the path to liberation. Become Gurmukh, and attain it. ||2||5||

[Ang 219 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 9 |
English: Gauree, Ninth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕੋਊ ਮਾਈ ਭੂਲਿਓ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: koaoo maaee bhoolio man samajhaavai |
English: O mother, if only someone would instruct my wayward mind.

Gurbani: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਾਧ ਮਗ ਸੁਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bed puraan saadh mag sun kar nimakh na har gun gaavai |1| rahaau |
English: This mind listens to the Vedas, the Puraanas, and the ways of the Holy Saints, but it does not sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, for even an instant. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦੁਰਲਭ ਦੇਹ ਪਾਇ ਮਾਨਸ ਕੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਿਰਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: duralabh deh paae maanas kee birathaa janam siraavai |
English: Having obtained this human body, so very difficult to obtain, it is now being uselessly wasted.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਮਹਾ ਸੰਕਟ ਬਨ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਰੁਚ ਉਪਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: maaeaa moh mahaa sankatt ban taa siau ruch upajaavai |1|
English: Emotional attachment to Maya is such a treacherous wilderness, and yet, people are in love with it. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਨ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: antar baahar sadaa sang prabh taa siau nehu na laavai |
English: Inwardly and outwardly, God is always with them, and yet, they do not enshrine Love for Him.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਮਾਨਹੁ ਜਿਹ ਘਟਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੬॥
Transliteration: naanak mukat taeh tum maanahu jih ghatt raam samaavai |2|6|
English: O Nanak, know that those whose hearts are filled with the Lord are liberated. ||2||6||

[Ang 220 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 9 |
English: Gauree, Ninth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੋ ਰਾਮ ਸਰਨਿ ਬਿਸਰਾਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: saadho raam saran bisaraamaa |
English: Holy Saadhus: rest and peace are in the Sanctuary of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਪੜੇ ਕੋ ਇਹ ਗੁਨ ਸਿਮਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bed puraan parre ko ih gun simare har ko naamaa |1| rahaau |
English: This is the blessing of studying the Vedas and the Puraanas, that you may meditate on the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਮਤਾ ਫੁਨਿ ਅਉ ਬਿਖਿਅਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: lobh moh maaeaa mamataa fun aau bikhian kee sevaa |
English: Greed, emotional attachment to Maya, possessiveness, the service of evil, pleasure and pain,

Gurbani: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਪਰਸੈ ਜਿਹ ਨਾਹਨਿ ਸੋ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਹੈ ਦੇਵਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: harakh sog parasai jih naahan so moorat hai devaa |1|
English: - those who are not touched by these, are the very embodiment of the Divine Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁਰਗ ਨਰਕ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਿਖੁ ਏ ਸਭ ਤਿਉ ਕੰਚਨ ਅਰੁ ਪੈਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: surag narak amrit bikh e sabh tiau kanchan ar paisaa |
English: Heaven and hell, ambrosial nectar and poison, gold and copper - these are all alike to them.

Gurbani: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਏ ਸਮ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਫੁਨਿ ਤੈਸਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ausatat nindaa e sam jaa kai lobh mohu fun taisaa |2|
English: Praise and slander are all the same to them, as are greed and attachment. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਏ ਬਾਧੇ ਜਿਹ ਨਾਹਨਿ ਤਿਹ ਤੁਮ ਜਾਨਉ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: dukh sukh e baadhe jih naahan tih tum jaanau giaanee |
English: They are not bound by pleasure and pain - know that they are truly wise.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਮਾਨਉ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੋ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ॥੩॥੭॥
Transliteration: naanak mukat taeh tum maanau ih bidh ko jo praanee |3|7|
English: O Nanak, recognize those mortal beings as liberated, who live this way of life. ||3||7||

[Ang 220 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 9 |
English: Gauree, Ninth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਕਹਾ ਭਇਓ ਤੈ ਬਉਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: man re kahaa bheo tai bauraa |
English: O mind, why have you gone crazy?

Gurbani: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਅਉਧ ਘਟੈ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੈ ਭਇਓ ਲੋਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਉਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ahinis aaudh ghattai nahee jaanai bheo lobh sang hauraa |1| rahaau |
English: Don't you know that your life is decreasing, day and night? Your life is made worthless with greed. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤਨੁ ਤੈ ਅਪਨੋ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਓ ਅਰੁ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jo tan tai apano kar maanio ar sundar grih naaree |
English: That body, which you believe to be your own, and your beautiful home and spouse

Gurbani: ਇਨ ਮੈਂ ਕਛੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਰੇ ਨਾਹਨਿ ਦੇਖੋ ਸੋਚ ਬਿਚਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ein main kachh tero re naahan dekho soch bichaaree |1|
English: - none of these is yours to keep. See this, reflect upon it and understand. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਪਨੋ ਤੈ ਹਾਰਿਓ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: ratan janam apano tai haario gobind gat nahee jaanee |
English: You have wasted the precious jewel of this human life; you do not know the Way of the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਲੀਨ ਭਇਓ ਚਰਨਨ ਸਿਂਉ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਅਉਧ ਸਿਰਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: nimakh na leen bheo charanan sinau birathaa aaudh siraanee |2|
English: You have not been absorbed in the Lord's Feet, even for an instant. Your life has passed away in vain! ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਈ ਨਰੁ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak soee nar sukheea raam naam gun gaavai |
English: Says Nanak, that man is happy, who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਅਉਰ ਸਗਲ ਜਗੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਪਦੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥੮॥
Transliteration: aaur sagal jag maaeaa mohiaa nirabhai pad nahee paavai |3|8|
English: All the rest of the world is enticed by Maya; they do not obtain the state of fearless dignity. ||3||8||

[Ang 220 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 9 |
English: Gauree, Ninth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਰ ਅਚੇਤ ਪਾਪ ਤੇ ਡਰੁ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: nar achet paap te ddar re |
English: You people are unconscious; you should be afraid of sin.

Gurbani: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਗਲ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਪਰੁ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: deen deaal sagal bhai bhanjan saran taeh tum par re |1| rahaau |
English: Seek the Sanctuary of the Lord, Merciful to the meek, Destroyer of all fear. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਜਾਸ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੀਐ ਮੋ ਧਰੁ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: bed puraan jaas gun gaavat taa ko naam heeai mo dhar re |
English: The Vedas and the Puraanas sing His Praises; enshrine His Name within your heart.

Gurbani: ਪਾਵਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਗਤਿ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਕਸਮਲ ਸਭ ਹਰੁ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: paavan naam jagat mai har ko simar simar kasamal sabh har re |1|
English: Pure and sublime is the Name of the Lord in the world. Remembering it in meditation, all sinful mistakes shall be washed away. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਾਨਸ ਦੇਹ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨਹ ਪਾਵੈ ਕਛੂ ਉਪਾਉ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਾ ਕਰੁ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: maanas deh bahur neh paavai kachhoo upaau mukat kaa kar re |
English: You shall not obtain this human body again; make the effort - try to achieve liberation!

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਤ ਗਾਇ ਕਰੁਨਾ ਮੈ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰ ਕੈ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਰੁ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੯॥੨੫੧॥
Transliteration: naanak kehat gaae karunaa mai bhav saagar kai paar utar re |2|9|251|
English: Says Nanak, sing of the Lord of compassion, and cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||9||251||

[Ang 220 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: raag gaurree asattapadeea mahalaa 1 gaurree guaareree |
English: Raag Gauree, Ashtpadheeyaa, First Mehl: Gauree Gwaarayree:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar sat naam karataa purakh gur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru's Grace:

Gurbani: ਨਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: nidh sidh niramal naam beechaar |
English: The nine treasures and the miraculous spiritual powers come by contemplating the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: pooran poor rahiaa bikh maar |
English: The Perfect Lord is All-pervading everywhere; He destroys the poison of Maya.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਛੂਟੀ ਬਿਮਲ ਮਝਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: trikuttee chhoottee bimal majhaar |
English: I am rid of the three-phased Maya, dwelling in the Pure Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਜੀਇ ਆਈ ਕਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur kee mat jee aaee kaar |1|
English: The Guru's Teachings are useful to my soul. ||1||

Gurbani: ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਮਤ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: ein bidh raam ramat man maaniaa |
English: Chanting the Lord's Name in this way, my mind is satisfied.

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: giaan anjan gur sabad pachhaaniaa |1| rahaau |
English: I have obtained the ointment of spiritual wisdom, recognizing the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਇਕੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: eik sukh maaniaa sehaj milaaeaa |
English: Blended with the One Lord, I enjoy intuitive peace.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: niramal baanee bharam chukaaeaa |
English: Through the Immaculate Bani of the Word, my doubts have been dispelled.

Gurbani: ਲਾਲ ਭਏ ਸੂਹਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: laal bhe soohaa rang maaeaa |
English: Instead of the pale color of Maya, I am imbued with the deep crimson color of the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਨਦਰਿ ਭਈ ਬਿਖੁ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: nadar bhee bikh tthaak rahaaeaa |2|
English: By the Lord's Glance of Grace, the poison has been eliminated. ||2||

Gurbani: ਉਲਟ ਭਈ ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਗਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: aulatt bhee jeevat mar jaagiaa |
English: When I turned away, and became dead while yet alive, I was awakened.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਵੇ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabad rave man har siau laagiaa |
English: Chanting the Word of the Shabad, my mind is attached to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਰਸੁ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਤਿਆਗਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: ras sangreh bikh parahar tiaagiaa |
English: I have gathered in the Lord's sublime essence, and cast out the poison.

Gurbani: ਭਾਇ ਬਸੇ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bhaae base jam kaa bhau bhaagiaa |3|
English: Abiding in His Love, the fear of death has run away. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਾਦ ਰਹੇ ਬਾਦੰ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: saad rahe baadan ahankaaraa |
English: My taste for pleasure ended, along with conflict and egotism.

Gurbani: ਚਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: chit har siau raataa hukam apaaraa |
English: My consciousness is attuned to the Lord, by the Order of the Infinite.

Gurbani: ਜਾਤਿ ਰਹੇ ਪਤਿ ਕੇ ਆਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaat rahe pat ke aachaaraa |
English: My pursuit for worldy pride and honour is over.

Gurbani: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਭਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਆਤਮ ਧਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: drisatt bhee sukh aatam dhaaraa |4|
English: When He blessed me with His Glance of Grace, peace was established in my soul. ||4||

Gurbani: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਦੇਖਉ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: tujh bin koe na dekhau meet |
English: Without You, I see no friend at all.

Gurbani: ਕਿਸੁ ਸੇਵਉ ਕਿਸੁ ਦੇਵਉ ਚੀਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: kis sevau kis devau cheet |
English: Whom should I serve? Unto whom should I dedicate my consciousness?

Gurbani: ਕਿਸੁ ਪੂਛਉ ਕਿਸੁ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kis poochhau kis laagau paae |
English: Whom should I ask? At whose feet should I fall?

Gurbani: ਕਿਸੁ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਰਹਾ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: kis upades rahaa liv laae |5|
English: By whose teachings will I remain absorbed in His Love? ||5||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੀ ਗੁਰ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur sevee gur laagau paae |
English: I serve the Guru, and I fall at the Guru's Feet.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਰਾਚਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat karee raachau har naae |
English: I worship Him, and I am absorbed in the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਸਿਖਿਆ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਭੋਜਨ ਭਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sikhiaa deekhiaa bhojan bhaau |
English: The Lord's Love is my instruction, sermon and food.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: hukam sanjogee nij ghar jaau |6|
English: Enjoined to the Lord's Command, I have entered the home of my inner self. ||6||

Gurbani: ਗਰਬ ਗਤੰ ਸੁਖ ਆਤਮ ਧਿਆਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: garab gatan sukh aatam dhiaanaa |
English: With the extinction of pride, my soul has found peace and meditation.

Gurbani: ਜੋਤਿ ਭਈ ਜੋਤੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jot bhee jotee maeh samaanaa |
English: The Divine Light has dawned, and I am absorbed in the Light.

Gurbani: ਲਿਖਤੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਨਹੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: likhat mittai nahee sabad neesaanaa |
English: Pre-ordained destiny cannot be erased; the Shabad is my banner and insignia.

Gurbani: ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰਣਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: karataa karanaa karataa jaanaa |7|
English: I know the Creator, the Creator of His Creation. ||7||

Gurbani: ਨਹ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਨਹ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਸਿਆਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: neh panddit neh chatur siaanaa |
English: I am not a learned Pandit, I am not clever or wise.

Gurbani: ਨਹ ਭੂਲੋ ਨਹ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: neh bhoolo neh bharam bhulaanaa |
English: I do not wander; I am not deluded by doubt.

Gurbani: ਕਥਉ ਨ ਕਥਨੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: kthau na kathanee hukam pachhaanaa |
English: I do not speak empty speech; I have recognized the Hukam of His Command.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥੮॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak guramat sehaj samaanaa |8|1|
English: Nanak is absorbed in intuitive peace through the Guru's Teachings. ||8||1||

[Ang 221 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 1 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਕੁੰਚਰੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਉਦਿਆਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: man kunchar kaaeaa udiaanai |
English: The mind is an elephant in the forest of the body.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਅੰਕਸੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur ankas sach sabad neesaanai |
English: The Guru is the controlling stick; when the Insignia of the True Shabad is applied,

Gurbani: ਰਾਜ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਸੋਭ ਸੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: raaj duaarai sobh su maanai |1|
English: One obtains honor in the Court of God the King. ||1||

Gurbani: ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਨਹ ਚੀਨਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: chaturaaee neh cheeniaa jaae |
English: He cannot be known through clever tricks.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਕਿਉ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bin maare kiau keemat paae |1| rahaau |
English: Without subduing the mind, how can His value be estimated? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤਸਕਰੁ ਲੇਈ ॥
Transliteration: ghar meh amrit tasakar leee |
English: In the house of the self is the Ambrosial Nectar, which is being stolen by the thieves.

Gurbani: ਨੰਨਾਕਾਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਕਰੇਈ ॥
Transliteration: nanaakaar na koe kareee |
English: No one can say no to them.

Gurbani: ਰਾਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: raakhai aap vaddiaaee deee |2|
English: He Himself protects us, and blesses us with greatness. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨੀਲ ਅਨੀਲ ਅਗਨਿ ਇਕ ਠਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: neel aneel agan ik tthaaee |
English: There are billions, countless billions of fires of desire at the seat of the mind.

Gurbani: ਜਲਿ ਨਿਵਰੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jal nivaree gur boojh bujhaaee |
English: They are extinguished only with the water of understanding, imparted by the Guru.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਦੇ ਲੀਆ ਰਹਸਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: man de leea rehas gun gaaee |3|
English: Offering my mind, I have attained it, and I joyfully sing His Glorious Praises. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੈਸਾ ਘਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੋ ਤੈਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaisaa ghar baahar so taisaa |
English: Just as He is within the home of the self, so is He beyond.

Gurbani: ਬੈਸਿ ਗੁਫਾ ਮਹਿ ਆਖਉ ਕੈਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: bais gufaa meh aakhau kaisaa |
English: But how can I describe Him, sitting in a cave?

Gurbani: ਸਾਗਰਿ ਡੂਗਰਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਐਸਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: saagar ddoogar nirbhau aisaa |4|
English: The Fearless Lord is in the oceans, just as He is in the mountains. ||4||

Gurbani: ਮੂਏ ਕਉ ਕਹੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਕਉਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: mooe kau kahu maare kaun |
English: Tell me, who can kill someone who is already dead?

Gurbani: ਨਿਡਰੇ ਕਉ ਕੈਸਾ ਡਰੁ ਕਵਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: niddare kau kaisaa ddar kavan |
English: What does he fear? Who can frighten the fearless one?

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਨੈ ਤੀਨੇ ਭਉਨ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: sabad pachhaanai teene bhaun |5|
English: He recognizes the Word of the Shabad, throughout the three worlds. ||5||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਕਹਨੁ ਵਖਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jin kahiaa tin kehan vakhaaniaa |
English: One who speaks, merely describes speech.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਬੂਝਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jin boojhiaa tin sehaj pachhaaniaa |
English: But one who understands, intuitively realizes.

Gurbani: ਦੇਖਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: dekh beechaar meraa man maaniaa |6|
English: Seeing and reflecting upon it, my mind surrenders. ||6||

Gurbani: ਕੀਰਤਿ ਸੂਰਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਇਕ ਨਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: keerat soorat mukat ik naaee |
English: Praise, beauty and liberation are in the One Name.

Gurbani: ਤਹੀ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: tahee niranjan rahiaa samaaee |
English: In it, the Immaculate Lord is permeating and pervading.

Gurbani: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਬਿਆਪਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਨਿਜ ਠਾਈ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: nij ghar biaap rahiaa nij tthaaee |7|
English: He dwells in the home of the self, and in His own sublime place. ||7||

Gurbani: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਮੁਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: ausatat kareh kete mun preet |
English: The many silent sages lovingly praise Him.

Gurbani: ਤਨਿ ਮਨਿ ਸੂਚੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਸੁ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: tan man soochai saach su cheet |
English: Their bodies and minds are purified, as they enshrine the True Lord in their consciousness.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਨੀਤਾ ਨੀਤਿ ॥੮॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak har bhaj neetaa neet |8|2|
English: O Nanak, meditate on the Lord, each and every day. ||8||2||

[Ang 222 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 1 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: naa man marai na kaaraj hoe |
English: The mind does not die, so the job is not accomplished.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਵਸਿ ਦੂਤਾ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: man vas dootaa duramat doe |
English: The mind is under the power of the demons of evil intellect and duality.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਇਕੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: man maanai gur te ik hoe |1|
English: But when the mind surrenders, through the Guru, it becomes one. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਰਾਮੁ ਗੁਣਹ ਵਸਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: niragun raam gunah vas hoe |
English: The Lord is without attributes; the attributes of virtue are under His control.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aap nivaar beechaare soe |1| rahaau |
English: One who eliminates selfishness contemplates Him. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਭੂਲੋ ਬਹੁ ਚਿਤੈ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: man bhoolo bahu chitai vikaar |
English: The deluded mind thinks of all sorts of corruption.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਭੂਲੋ ਸਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਭਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: man bhoolo sir aavai bhaar |
English: When the mind is deluded, the load of wickedness falls on the head.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: man maanai har ekankaar |2|
English: But when the mind surrenders to the Lord, it realizes the One and Only Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਭੂਲੋ ਮਾਇਆ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man bhoolo maaeaa ghar jaae |
English: The deluded mind enters the house of Maya.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮਿ ਬਿਰੂਧਉ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਠਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kaam biroodhau rahai na tthaae |
English: Engrossed in sexual desire, it does not remain steady.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har bhaj praanee rasan rasaae |3|
English: O mortal, lovingly vibrate the Lord's Name with your tongue. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੈਵਰ ਹੈਵਰ ਕੰਚਨ ਸੁਤ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaivar haivar kanchan sut naaree |
English: Elephants, horses, gold, children and spouses

Gurbani: ਬਹੁ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਪਿੜ ਚਾਲੈ ਹਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: bahu chintaa pirr chaalai haaree |
English: in the anxious affairs of all these, people lose the game and depart.

Gurbani: ਜੂਐ ਖੇਲਣੁ ਕਾਚੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jooai khelan kaachee saaree |4|
English: In the game of chess, their pieces do not reach their destination. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸੰਪਉ ਸੰਚੀ ਭਏ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: sanpau sanchee bhe vikaar |
English: They gather wealth, but only evil comes from it.

Gurbani: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਕ ਉਭੇ ਦਰਵਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: harakh sok ubhe daravaar |
English: Pleasure and pain stand in the doorway.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਜਪਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: sukh sahaje jap ridai muraar |5|
English: Intuitive peace comes by meditating on the Lord, within the heart. ||5||

Gurbani: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: nadar kare taa mel milaae |
English: When the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, then He unites us in His Union.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਅਉਗਣ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gun sangreh aaugan sabad jalaae |
English: Through the Word of the Shabad, merits are gathered in, and demerits are burned away.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: guramukh naam padaarath paae |6|
English: The Gurmukh obtains the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||6||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: bin naavai sabh dookh nivaas |
English: Without the Name, all live in pain.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂੜ ਮਾਇਆ ਚਿਤ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh moorr maaeaa chit vaas |
English: The consciousness of the foolish, self-willed manmukh is the dwelling place of Maya.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਮਿ ਲਿਖਿਆਸੁ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: guramukh giaan dhur karam likhiaas |7|
English: The Gurmukh obtains spiritual wisdom, according to pre-ordained destiny. ||7||

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਚੰਚਲੁ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਫੁਨਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: man chanchal dhaavat fun dhaavai |
English: The fickle mind continuously runs after fleeting things.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੇ ਸੂਚੇ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: saache sooche mail na bhaavai |
English: The Pure True Lord is not pleased by filth.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੮॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh har gun gaavai |8|3|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||8||3||

[Ang 222 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree mahalaa 1 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਨਹ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: haumai karatiaa neh sukh hoe |
English: Acting in egotism, peace is not obtained.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮਤਿ ਝੂਠੀ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: manamat jhootthee sachaa soe |
English: The intellect of the mind is false; only the Lord is True.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਬਿਗੂਤੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਦੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sagal bigoote bhaavai doe |
English: All who love duality are ruined.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: so kamaavai dhur likhiaa hoe |1|
English: People act as they are pre-ordained. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਜਗੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਜੂਆਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa jag dekhiaa jooaaree |
English: I have seen the world to be such a gambler;

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਗੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sabh sukh maagai naam bisaaree |1| rahaau |
English: all beg for peace, but they forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਦਿਸਟੁ ਦਿਸੈ ਤਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: adisatt disai taa kahiaa jaae |
English: If the Unseen Lord could be seen, then He could be described.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ਕਹਣਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin dekhe kahanaa birathaa jaae |
English: Without seeing Him, all descriptions are useless.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh deesai sehaj subhaae |
English: The Gurmukh sees Him with intuitive ease.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sevaa surat ek liv laae |2|
English: So serve the One Lord, with loving awareness. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਂਗਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਆਗਲ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sukh maangat dukh aagal hoe |
English: People beg for peace, but they receive severe pain.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਵਿਕਾਰੀ ਹਾਰੁ ਪਰੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sagal vikaaree haar paroe |
English: They are all weaving a wreath of corruption.

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਬਿਨਾ ਝੂਠੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: ek binaa jhootthe mukat na hoe |
English: You are false - without the One, there is no liberation.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਦੇਖੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kar kar karataa dekhai soe |3|
English: The Creator created the creation, and He watches over it. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: trisanaa agan sabad bujhaae |
English: The fire of desire is quenched by the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: doojaa bharam sehaj subhaae |
English: Duality and doubt are automatically eliminated.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: guramatee naam ridai vasaae |
English: Following the Guru's Teachings, the Naam abides in the heart.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: saachee baanee har gun gaae |4|
English: Through the True Word of His Bani, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||

Gurbani: ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਚੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tan meh saacho guramukh bhaau |
English: The True Lord abides within the body of that Gurmukh who enshrines love for Him.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਿਜ ਠਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: naam binaa naahee nij tthaau |
English: Without the Naam, none obtain their own place.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਰਾਇਣ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਰਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: prem paraaein preetam raau |
English: The Beloved Lord King is dedicated to love.

Gurbani: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਨਾਉ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: nadar kare taa boojhai naau |5|
English: If He bestows His Glance of Grace, then we realize His Name. ||5||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਰਬ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohu sarab janjaalaa |
English: Emotional attachment to Maya is total entanglement.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕੁਚੀਲ ਕੁਛਿਤ ਬਿਕਰਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh kucheel kuchhit bikaraalaa |
English: The self-willed manmukh is filthy, cursed and dreadful.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਚੂਕੈ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: satigur seve chookai janjaalaa |
English: Serving the True Guru, these entanglements are ended.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਲਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: amrit naam sadaa sukh naalaa |6|
English: In the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, you shall abide in lasting peace. ||6||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh boojhai ek liv laae |
English: The Gurmukhs understand the One Lord, and enshrine love for Him.

Gurbani: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: nij ghar vaasai saach samaae |
English: They dwell in the home of their own inner beings, and merge in the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jaman maranaa tthaak rahaae |
English: The cycle of birth and death is ended.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: poore gur te ih mat paae |7|
English: This understanding is obtained from the Perfect Guru. ||7||

Gurbani: ਕਥਨੀ ਕਥਉ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਓਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: kathanee kthau na aavai or |
English: Speaking the speech, there is no end to it.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਛਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਨਾਹੀ ਦਰੁ ਹੋਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur puchh dekhiaa naahee dar hor |
English: I have consulted the Guru, and I have seen that there is no other door than His.

Gurbani: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਭਾਣੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: dukh sukh bhaanai tisai rajaae |
English: Pain and pleasure reside in the Pleasure of His Will and His Command.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੮॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak neech kahai liv laae |8|4|
English: Nanak, the lowly, says embrace love for the Lord. ||8||4||

[Ang 223 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 1 |
English: Gauree, First Mehl:
