Gurbani: ਦੂਜੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਗਤ ਚਿਤ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: doojee maaeaa jagat chit vaas |
English: The duality of Maya dwells in the consciousness of the people of the world.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh ahankaar binaas |1|
English: They are destroyed by sexual desire, anger and egotism. ||1||

Gurbani: ਦੂਜਾ ਕਉਣੁ ਕਹਾ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: doojaa kaun kahaa nahee koee |
English: Whom should I call the second, when there is only the One?

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sabh meh ek niranjan soee |1| rahaau |
English: The One Immaculate Lord is pervading among all. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਆਖੈ ਦੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: doojee duramat aakhai doe |
English: The dual-minded evil intellect speaks of a second.

Gurbani: ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਮਰਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aavai jaae mar doojaa hoe |2|
English: One who harbors duality comes and goes and dies. ||2||

Gurbani: ਧਰਣਿ ਗਗਨ ਨਹ ਦੇਖਉ ਦੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: dharan gagan neh dekhau doe |
English: In the earth and in the sky, I do not see any second.

Gurbani: ਨਾਰੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਸਬਾਈ ਲੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naaree purakh sabaaee loe |3|
English: Among all the women and the men, His Light is shining. ||3||

Gurbani: ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਦੇਖਉ ਦੀਪਕ ਉਜਿਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: rav sas dekhau deepak ujiaalaa |
English: In the lamps of the sun and the moon, I see His Light.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਬਾਲਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: sarab nirantar preetam baalaa |4|
English: Dwelling among all is my ever-youthful Beloved. ||4||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa meraa chit laaeaa |
English: In His Mercy, He attuned my consciousness to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਏਕੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: satigur mo kau ek bujhaaeaa |5|
English: The True Guru has led me to understand the One Lord. ||5||

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: ek niranjan guramukh jaataa |
English: The Gurmukh knows the One Immaculate Lord.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: doojaa maar sabad pachhaataa |6|
English: Subduing duality, one comes to realize the Word of the Shabad. ||6||

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਲੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: eko hukam varatai sabh loee |
English: The Command of the One Lord prevails throughout all the worlds.

Gurbani: ਏਕਸੁ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਓਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: ekas te sabh opat hoee |7|
English: From the One, all have arisen. ||7||

Gurbani: ਰਾਹ ਦੋਵੈ ਖਸਮੁ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: raah dovai khasam eko jaan |
English: There are two routes, but remember that their Lord and Master is only One.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad hukam pachhaan |8|
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, recognize the Hukam of the Lord's Command. ||8||

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਰੂਪ ਵਰਨ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: sagal roop varan man maahee |
English: He is contained in all forms, colors and minds.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥੯॥੫॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak eko saalaahee |9|5|
English: Says Nanak, praise the One Lord. ||9||5||

[Ang 223 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 1 |
English: Gauree, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਧਿਆਤਮ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਸਾਚਾ ॥
Transliteration: adhiaatam karam kare taa saachaa |
English: Those who live a spiritual lifestyle - they alone are true.

Gurbani: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭੇਦੁ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਾਚਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mukat bhed kiaa jaanai kaachaa |1|
English: What can the false know about the secrets of liberation? ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਜੋਗੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa jogee jugat beechaarai |
English: Those who contemplate the Way are Yogis.

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: panch maar saach ur dhaarai |1| rahaau |
English: They conquer the five thieves, and enshrine the True Lord in the heart. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਵਸਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jis kai antar saach vasaavai |
English: Those who enshrine the True Lord deep within,

Gurbani: ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jog jugat kee keemat paavai |2|
English: realize the value of the Way of Yoga. ||2||

Gurbani: ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਏਕੋ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਉਦਿਆਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: rav sas eko grih udiaanai |
English: The sun and the moon are one and the same for them, as are household and wilderness.

Gurbani: ਕਰਣੀ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਰਮ ਸਮਾਨੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: karanee keerat karam samaanai |3|
English: The karma of their daily practice is to praise the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਸਬਦ ਇਕ ਭਿਖਿਆ ਮਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: ek sabad ik bhikhiaa maagai |
English: They beg for the alms of the one and only Shabad.

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਗੈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: giaan dhiaan jugat sach jaagai |4|
English: They remain awake and aware in spiritual wisdom and meditation, and the true way of life. ||4||

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਰਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhai rach rahai na baahar jaae |
English: They remain absorbed in the fear of God; they never leave it.

Gurbani: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਉਣ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: keemat kaun rahai liv laae |5|
English: Who can estimate their value? They remain lovingly absorbed in the Lord. ||5||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aape mele bharam chukaae |
English: The Lord unites them with Himself, dispelling their doubts.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: gur parasaad param pad paae |6|
English: By Guru's Grace, the supreme status is obtained. ||6||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur kee sevaa sabad veechaar |
English: In the Guru's service is reflection upon the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੇ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: haumai maare karanee saar |7|
English: Subduing ego, practice pure actions. ||7||

Gurbani: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਪਾਠ ਪੁਰਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: jap tap sanjam paatth puraan |
English: Chanting, meditation, austere self-discipline and the reading of the Puraanas,

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੮॥੬॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak aparanpar maan |8|6|
English: says Nanak, are contained in surrender to the Unlimited Lord. ||8||6||

[Ang 223 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 1 |
English: Gauree, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਖਿਮਾ ਗਹੀ ਬ੍ਰਤੁ ਸੀਲ ਸੰਤੋਖੰ ॥
Transliteration: khimaa gahee brat seel santokhan |
English: To practice forgiveness is the true fast, good conduct and contentment.

Gurbani: ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਨਾ ਜਮ ਦੋਖੰ ॥
Transliteration: rog na biaapai naa jam dokhan |
English: Disease does not afflict me, nor does the pain of death.

Gurbani: ਮੁਕਤ ਭਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰੂਪ ਨ ਰੇਖੰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mukat bhe prabh roop na rekhan |1|
English: I am liberated, and absorbed into God, who has no form or feature. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੋਗੀ ਕਉ ਕੈਸਾ ਡਰੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jogee kau kaisaa ddar hoe |
English: What fear does the Yogi have?

Gurbani: ਰੂਖਿ ਬਿਰਖਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: rookh birakh grihi baahar soe |1| rahaau |
English: The Lord is among the trees and the plants, within the household and outside as well. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਜੋਗੀ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: nirbhau jogee niranjan dhiaavai |
English: The Yogis meditate on the Fearless, Immaculate Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ ਸਚਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: anadin jaagai sach liv laavai |
English: Night and day, they remain awake and aware, embracing love for the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਜੋਗੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: so jogee merai man bhaavai |2|
English: Those Yogis are pleasing to my mind. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਾਲੁ ਜਾਲੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਗਨੀ ਜਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kaal jaal braham aganee jaare |
English: The trap of death is burnt by the Fire of God.

Gurbani: ਜਰਾ ਮਰਣ ਗਤੁ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jaraa maran gat garab nivaare |
English: Old age, death and pride are conquered.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਪਿਤਰੀ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aap tarai pitaree nisataare |3|
English: They swim across, and save their ancestors as well. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਜੋਗੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur seve so jogee hoe |
English: Those who serve the True Guru are the Yogis.

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਰਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਸੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhai rach rahai su nirbhau hoe |
English: Those who remain immersed in the Fear of God become fearless.

Gurbani: ਜੈਸਾ ਸੇਵੈ ਤੈਸੋ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jaisaa sevai taiso hoe |4|
English: They become just like the One they serve. ||4||

Gurbani: ਨਰ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: nar nihakeval nirbhau naau |
English: The Name makes a man pure and fearless.

Gurbani: ਅਨਾਥਹ ਨਾਥ ਕਰੇ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: anaathah naath kare bal jaau |
English: It makes the masterless become the master of all. I am a sacrifice to him.

Gurbani: ਪੁਨਰਪਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: punarap janam naahee gun gaau |5|
English: Such a person is not reincarnated again; he sings the Glories of God. ||5||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: antar baahar eko jaanai |
English: Inwardly and outwardly, he knows the One Lord;

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabade aap pachhaanai |
English: through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he realizes himself.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਦਰਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: saachai sabad dar neesaanai |6|
English: He bears the Banner and Insignia of the True Shabad in the Lord's Court. ||6||

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabad marai tis nij ghar vaasaa |
English: One who dies in the Shabad abides in his own home within.

Gurbani: ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ਚੂਕੈ ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aavai na jaavai chookai aasaa |
English: He does not come or go in reincarnation, and his hopes are subdued.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad kamal paragaasaa |7|
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, his heart-lotus blossoms forth. ||7||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo deesai so aas niraasaa |
English: Whoever is seen, is driven by hope and despair,

Gurbani: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਬਿਖੁ ਭੂਖ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh bikh bhookh piaasaa |
English: by sexual desire, anger, corruption, hunger and thirst.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਰਲੇ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥੮॥੭॥
Transliteration: naanak birale mileh udaasaa |8|7|
English: O Nanak, those detached recluses who meet the Lord are so very rare. ||8||7||

[Ang 224 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 1 |
English: Gauree, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਐਸੋ ਦਾਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aiso daas milai sukh hoee |
English: Meeting such a slave, peace is obtained.

Gurbani: ਦੁਖੁ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਪਾਵੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dukh visarai paavai sach soee |1|
English: Pain is forgotten, when the True Lord is found. ||1||

Gurbani: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਭਈ ਮਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: darasan dekh bhee mat pooree |
English: Beholding the blessed vision of his darshan, my understanding has become perfect.

Gurbani: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਮਜਨੁ ਚਰਨਹ ਧੂਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: atthasatth majan charanah dhooree |1| rahaau |
English: The cleansing baths at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage are in the dust of his feet. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਸੰਤੋਖੇ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਤਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: netr santokhe ek liv taaraa |
English: My eyes are contented with the constant love of the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਸੂਚੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਸਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jihavaa soochee har ras saaraa |2|
English: My tongue is purified by the most sublime essence of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਅਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: sach karanee abh antar sevaa |
English: True are my actions, and deep within my being, I serve Him.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸਿਆ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: man tripataasiaa alakh abhevaa |3|
English: My mind is satisfied by the Inscrutable, Mysterious Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਸਾਚਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeh jeh dekhau teh teh saachaa |
English: Wherever I look, there I find the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਝਗਰਤ ਜਗੁ ਕਾਚਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: bin boojhe jhagarat jag kaachaa |4|
English: Without understanding, the world argues in falsehood. ||4||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਮਝਾਵੈ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur samajhaavai sojhee hoee |
English: When the Guru instructs, understanding is obtained.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: guramukh viralaa boojhai koee |5|
English: How rare is that Gurmukh who understands. ||5||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਖਵਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa raakhahu rakhavaale |
English: Show Your Mercy, and save me, O Savior Lord!

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਪਸੂ ਭਏ ਬੇਤਾਲੇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: bin boojhe pasoo bhe betaale |6|
English: Without understanding, people become beasts and demons. ||6||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur kahiaa avar nahee doojaa |
English: The Guru has said that there is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਕਿਸੁ ਕਹੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਕਰਉ ਅਨ ਪੂਜਾ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: kis kahu dekh krau an poojaa |7|
English: So tell me, who should I see, and who should I worship? ||7||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਹੇਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sant het prabh tribhavan dhaare |
English: For the sake of the Saints, God has established the three worlds.

Gurbani: ਆਤਮੁ ਚੀਨੈ ਸੁ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: aatam cheenai su tat beechaare |8|
English: One who understands his own soul, contemplates the essence of reality. ||8||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਚੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: saach ridai sach prem nivaas |
English: One whose heart is filled with Truth and true love

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਮ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ॥੯॥੮॥
Transliteration: pranavat naanak ham taa ke daas |9|8|
English: - prays Nanak, I am his servant. ||9||8||

[Ang 224 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 1 |
English: Gauree, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਕੀਆ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: brahamai garab keea nahee jaaniaa |
English: Brahma acted in pride, and did not understand.

Gurbani: ਬੇਦ ਕੀ ਬਿਪਤਿ ਪੜੀ ਪਛੁਤਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: bed kee bipat parree pachhutaaniaa |
English: Only when he was faced with the downfall of the Vedas did he repent.

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਮਰੇ ਤਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jeh prabh simare tahee man maaniaa |1|
English: Remembering God in meditation, the mind is conciliated. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਗਰਬੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਸੰਸਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa garab buraa sansaarai |
English: Such is the horrible pride of the world.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jis gur milai tis garab nivaarai |1| rahaau |
English: The Guru eliminates the pride of those who meet Him. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਲਿ ਰਾਜਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: bal raajaa maaeaa ahankaaree |
English: Bal the King, in Maya and egotism,

Gurbani: ਜਗਨ ਕਰੈ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਰ ਅਫਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jagan karai bahu bhaar afaaree |
English: held his ceremonial feasts, but he was puffed up with pride.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਛੇ ਜਾਇ ਪਇਆਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bin gur poochhe jaae peaaree |2|
English: Without the Guru's advice, he had to go to the underworld. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰੀਚੰਦੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਕਰੈ ਜਸੁ ਲੇਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: hareechand daan karai jas levai |
English: Hari Chand gave in charity, and earned public praise.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ਅਭੇਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: bin gur ant na paae abhevai |
English: But without the Guru, he did not find the limits of the Mysterious Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ਆਪੇ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਵੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aap bhulaae aape mat devai |3|
English: The Lord Himself misleads people, and He Himself imparts understanding. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਣਾਖਸੁ ਦੁਰਾਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: duramat haranaakhas duraachaaree |
English: The evil-minded Harnaakhash committed evil deeds.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਗਰਬ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: prabh naaraaein garab prahaaree |
English: God, the Lord of all, is the Destroyer of pride.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: prahalaad udhaare kirapaa dhaaree |4|
English: He bestowed His Mercy, and saved Prahlaad. ||4||

Gurbani: ਭੂਲੋ ਰਾਵਣੁ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਅਚੇਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: bhoolo raavan mugadh achet |
English: Raawan was deluded, foolish and unwise.

Gurbani: ਲੂਟੀ ਲੰਕਾ ਸੀਸ ਸਮੇਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: loottee lankaa sees samet |
English: Sri Lanka was plundered, and he lost his head.

Gurbani: ਗਰਬਿ ਗਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹੇਤਿ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: garab geaa bin satigur het |5|
English: He indulged in ego, and lacked the love of the True Guru. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸਹਸਬਾਹੁ ਮਧੁ ਕੀਟ ਮਹਿਖਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: sahasabaahu madh keett mahikhaasaa |
English: The Lord killed the thousand-armed Arjun, and the demons Madhu-keetab and Meh-khaasaa.

Gurbani: ਹਰਣਾਖਸੁ ਲੇ ਨਖਹੁ ਬਿਧਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: haranaakhas le nakhahu bidhaasaa |
English: He seized Harnaakhash and tore him apart with his nails.

Gurbani: ਦੈਤ ਸੰਘਾਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਅਭਿਆਸਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: dait sanghaare bin bhagat abhiaasaa |6|
English: The demons were slain; they did not practice devotional worship. ||6||

Gurbani: ਜਰਾਸੰਧਿ ਕਾਲਜਮੁਨ ਸੰਘਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jaraasandh kaalajamun sanghaare |
English: The demons Jaraa-sandh and Kaal-jamun were destroyed.

Gurbani: ਰਕਤਬੀਜੁ ਕਾਲੁਨੇਮੁ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: rakatabeej kaalunem bidaare |
English: Rakat-beej and Kaal-naym were annihilated.

Gurbani: ਦੈਤ ਸੰਘਾਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: dait sanghaar sant nisataare |7|
English: Slaying the demons, the Lord saved His Saints. ||7||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aape satigur sabad beechaare |
English: He Himself, as the True Guru, contemplates the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੈਤ ਸੰਘਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: doojai bhaae dait sanghaare |
English: Because of the love of duality, God killed the demons.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: guramukh saach bhagat nisataare |8|
English: By their true devotion, the Gurmukhs have been saved. ||8||

Gurbani: ਬੂਡਾ ਦੁਰਜੋਧਨੁ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: booddaa durajodhan pat khoee |
English: Sinking down, Durodhan lost his honor.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: raam na jaaniaa karataa soee |
English: He did not know the Creator Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਕਉ ਦੂਖਿ ਪਚੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: jan kau dookh pachai dukh hoee |9|
English: One who makes the Lord's humble servant suffer, shall himself suffer and rot. ||9||

Gurbani: ਜਨਮੇਜੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: janamejai gurasabad na jaaniaa |
English: Janameja did not know the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: kiau sukh paavai bharam bhulaaniaa |
English: Deluded by doubt, how could he find peace?

Gurbani: ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਭੂਲੇ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਨਿਆ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: eik til bhoole bahur pachhutaaniaa |10|
English: Making a mistake, for even an instant, you shall regret and repent later on. ||10||

Gurbani: ਕੰਸੁ ਕੇਸੁ ਚਾਂਡੂਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: kans kes chaanddoor na koee |
English: Kansa the King and his warriors Kays and Chandoor had no equals.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੀਨਿਆ ਅਪਨੀ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: raam na cheeniaa apanee pat khoee |
English: But they did not remember the Lord, and they lost their honor.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਨ ਰਾਖੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: bin jagadees na raakhai koee |11|
English: Without the Lord of the Universe, no one can be saved. ||11||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਰਬੁ ਨ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin gur garab na mettiaa jaae |
English: Without the Guru, pride cannot be eradicated.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਧਰਮੁ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramat dharam dheeraj har naae |
English: Following the Guru's Teachings, one obtains Dharmic faith, composure and the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੧੨॥੯॥
Transliteration: naanak naam milai gun gaae |12|9|
English: O Nanak, singing the Glories of God, His Name is received. ||12||9||

[Ang 225 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 1 |
English: Gauree, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਅੰਕਿ ਚੜਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: choaa chandan ank charraavau |
English: I may anoint my limbs with sandalwood oil.

Gurbani: ਪਾਟ ਪਟੰਬਰ ਪਹਿਰਿ ਹਢਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: paatt pattanbar pahir hadtaavau |
English: I may dress up and wear silk and satin clothes.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bin har naam kahaa sukh paavau |1|
English: But without the Lord's Name, where would I find peace? ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਪਹਿਰਉ ਕਿਆ ਓਢਿ ਦਿਖਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa pahirau kiaa odt dikhaavau |
English: So what should I wear? In what clothes should I display myself?

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਕਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bin jagadees kahaa sukh paavau |1| rahaau |
English: Without the Lord of the Universe, how can I find peace? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਾਨੀ ਕੁੰਡਲ ਗਲਿ ਮੋਤੀਅਨ ਕੀ ਮਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaanee kunddal gal moteean kee maalaa |
English: I may wear ear-rings, and a pearl necklace around my neck;

Gurbani: ਲਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲੀ ਫੂਲ ਗੁਲਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: laal nihaalee fool gulaalaa |
English: my bed may be adorned with red blankets, flowers and red powder;

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਕਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਭਾਲਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bin jagadees kahaa sukh bhaalaa |2|
English: but without the Lord of the Universe, where can I search for peace? ||2||

Gurbani: ਨੈਨ ਸਲੋਨੀ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: nain salonee sundar naaree |
English: I may have a beautiful woman with fascinating eyes;

Gurbani: ਖੋੜ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਕਰੈ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: khorr seegaar karai at piaaree |
English: she may decorate herself with the sixteen adornments, and make herself appear gorgeous.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਭਜੇ ਨਿਤ ਖੁਆਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bin jagadees bhaje nit khuaaree |3|
English: But without meditating on the Lord of the Universe, there is only continual suffering. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦਰ ਘਰ ਮਹਲਾ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: dar ghar mahalaa sej sukhaalee |
English: In his hearth and home, in his palace, upon his soft and comfortable bed,

Gurbani: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਫੂਲ ਬਿਛਾਵੈ ਮਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: ahinis fool bichhaavai maalee |
English: day and night, the flower-girls scatter flower petals;

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਸੁ ਦੇਹ ਦੁਖਾਲੀ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: bin har naam su deh dukhaalee |4|
English: but without the Lord's Name, the body is miserable. ||4||

Gurbani: ਹੈਵਰ ਗੈਵਰ ਨੇਜੇ ਵਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: haivar gaivar neje vaaje |
English: Horses, elephants, lances, marching bands,

Gurbani: ਲਸਕਰ ਨੇਬ ਖਵਾਸੀ ਪਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: lasakar neb khavaasee paaje |
English: armies, standard bearers, royal attendants and ostentatious displays

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਝੂਠੇ ਦਿਵਾਜੇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: bin jagadees jhootthe divaaje |5|
English: - without the Lord of the Universe, these undertakings are all useless. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸਿਧੁ ਕਹਾਵਉ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਬੁਲਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: sidh kahaavau ridh sidh bulaavau |
English: He may be called a Siddha, a man of spiritual perfection, and he may summon riches and supernatural powers;

Gurbani: ਤਾਜ ਕੁਲਹ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਤ੍ਰੁ ਬਨਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: taaj kulah sir chhatru banaavau |
English: he may place a crown upon his head, and carry a royal umbrella;

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਕਹਾ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: bin jagadees kahaa sach paavau |6|
English: but without the Lord of the Universe, where can Truth be found? ||6||

Gurbani: ਖਾਨੁ ਮਲੂਕੁ ਕਹਾਵਉ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: khaan malook kahaavau raajaa |
English: He may be called an emperor, a lord, and a king;

Gurbani: ਅਬੇ ਤਬੇ ਕੂੜੇ ਹੈ ਪਾਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: abe tabe koorre hai paajaa |
English: he may give orders - "Do this now, do this then" - but this is a false display.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਨ ਸਵਰਸਿ ਕਾਜਾ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: bin gurasabad na savaras kaajaa |7|
English: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, his works are not accomplished. ||7||

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: haumai mamataa gur sabad visaaree |
English: Egotism and possessiveness are dispelled by the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਰਿਦੈ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: guramat jaaniaa ridai muraaree |
English: With the Guru's Teachings in my heart, I have come to know the Lord.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੮॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: pranavat naanak saran tumaaree |8|10|
English: Prays Nanak, I seek Your Sanctuary. ||8||10||

[Ang 225 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 1 |
English: Gauree, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਾ ਏਕ ਨ ਜਾਨਸਿ ਅਵਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sevaa ek na jaanas avare |
English: Those who serve the One Lord, do not know any other.

Gurbani: ਪਰਪੰਚ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਤਿਆਗੈ ਕਵਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: parapanch biaadh tiaagai kavare |
English: They abandon the bitter worldly conflicts.

Gurbani: ਭਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਚੁ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bhaae milai sach saachai sach re |1|
English: Through love and truth, they meet the Truest of the True. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤੁ ਜਨੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa raam bhagat jan hoee |
English: Such are the humble devotees of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har gun gaae milai mal dhoee |1| rahaau |
English: They sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and their pollution is washed away. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਊਂਧੋ ਕਵਲੁ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: aoondho kaval sagal sansaarai |
English: The heart-lotus of the entire universe is upside-down.

Gurbani: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਗਤ ਪਰਜਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: duramat agan jagat parajaarai |
English: The fire of evil-mindedness is burning up the world.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਉਬਰੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: so ubarai gurasabad beechaarai |2|
English: They alone are saved, who contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2||

Gurbani: ਭ੍ਰਿੰਗ ਪਤੰਗੁ ਕੁੰਚਰੁ ਅਰੁ ਮੀਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: bhring patang kunchar ar meenaa |
English: The bumble bee, the moth, the elephant, the fish

Gurbani: ਮਿਰਗੁ ਮਰੈ ਸਹਿ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: mirag marai seh apunaa keenaa |
English: and the deer - all suffer for their actions, and die.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਰਾਚਿ ਤਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਬੀਨਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: trisanaa raach tat nahee beenaa |3|
English: Trapped by desire, they cannot see reality. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਾਮੁ ਚਿਤੈ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਹਿਤਕਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kaam chitai kaaman hitakaaree |
English: The lover of women is obsessed with sex.

Gurbani: ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ ਸਗਲ ਵਿਕਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: krodh binaasai sagal vikaaree |
English: All the wicked are ruined by their anger.

Gurbani: ਪਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਖੋਵਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: pat mat khoveh naam visaaree |4|
English: Honor and good sense are lost, when one forgets the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||

Gurbani: ਪਰ ਘਰਿ ਚੀਤੁ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਡੋਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: par ghar cheet manamukh ddolaae |
English: The self-willed manmukh is lured by another man's wife.

Gurbani: ਗਲਿ ਜੇਵਰੀ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਪਟਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gal jevaree dhandhai lapattaae |
English: The noose is around his neck, and he is entangled in petty conflicts.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: guramukh chhoottas har gun gaae |5|
English: The Gurmukh is emancipated, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||5||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਤਨੁ ਬਿਧਵਾ ਪਰ ਕਉ ਦੇਈ ॥
Transliteration: jiau tan bidhavaa par kau deee |
English: The lonely widow gives her body to a stranger;

Gurbani: ਕਾਮਿ ਦਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਪਰ ਵਸਿ ਸੇਈ ॥
Transliteration: kaam daam chit par vas seee |
English: she allows her mind to be controlled by others for lust or money

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: bin pir tripat na kabahoon hoee |6|
English: , but without her husband, she is never satisfied. ||6||

Gurbani: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੋਥੀ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪਾਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: parr parr pothee sinmrit paatthaa |
English: You may read, recite and study the scriptures,

Gurbani: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਪੜੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਥਾਟਾ ॥
Transliteration: bed puraan parrai sun thaattaa |
English: The Simritees, Vedas and Puraanas;

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਰਸ ਰਾਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਬਹੁ ਨਾਟਾ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: bin ras raate man bahu naattaa |7|
English: but without being imbued with the Lord's essence, the mind wanders endlessly. ||7||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਜਲ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: jiau chaatrik jal prem piaasaa |
English: As the rainbird thirsts longingly for the drop of rain,

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਮੀਨਾ ਜਲ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਲਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: jiau meenaa jal maeh ulaasaa |
English: and as the fish delights in the water,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸਾ ॥੮॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: naanak har ras pee tripataasaa |8|11|
English: Nanak is satisfied by the sublime essence of the Lord. ||8||11||

[Ang 226 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 1 |
English: Gauree, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਠੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਲੇਖੈ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: hatth kar marai na lekhai paavai |
English: One who dies in stubbornness shall not be approved,

Gurbani: ਵੇਸ ਕਰੈ ਬਹੁ ਭਸਮ ਲਗਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: ves karai bahu bhasam lagaavai |
English: even though he may wear religious robes and smear his body all over with ashes.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naam bisaar bahur pachhutaavai |1|
English: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he comes to regret and repent in the end. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੂੰ ਮਨਿ ਸੂਖ ॥
Transliteration: toon man har jeeo toon man sookh |
English: Believe in the Dear Lord, and you shall find peace of mind.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਸਹਹਿ ਜਮ ਦੂਖ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: naam bisaar saheh jam dookh |1| rahaau |
English: Forgetting the Naam, you shall have to endure the pain of death. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨ ਅਗਰ ਕਪੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: choaa chandan agar kapoor |
English: The smell of musk, sandalwood and camphor,

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਗਨੁ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa magan param pad door |
English: and the intoxication of Maya, takes one far away from the state of supreme dignity.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਿ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਐ ਸਭੁ ਕੂੜੋ ਕੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naam bisaariai sabh koorro koor |2|
English: Forgetting the Naam, one becomes the most false of all the false. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨੇਜੇ ਵਾਜੇ ਤਖਤਿ ਸਲਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: neje vaaje takhat salaam |
English: Lances and swords, marching bands, thrones and the salutes of others

Gurbani: ਅਧਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਕਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: adhakee trisanaa viaapai kaam |
English: only increase his desire; he is engrossed in sexual desire.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਚੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bin har jaache bhagat na naam |3|
English: Without seeking the Lord, neither devotional worship nor the Naam are obtained. ||3||

Gurbani: ਵਾਦਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: vaad ahankaar naahee prabh melaa |
English: Union with God is not obtained by arguments and egotism.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਦੇ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: man de paaveh naam suhelaa |
English: But by offering your mind, the comfort of the Naam is obtained.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: doojai bhaae agiaan duhelaa |4|
English: In the love of duality and ignorance, you shall suffer. ||4||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਦਮ ਕੇ ਸਉਦਾ ਨਹੀ ਹਾਟ ॥
Transliteration: bin dam ke saudaa nahee haatt |
English: Without money, you cannot buy anything in the store.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਸਾਗਰ ਨਹੀ ਵਾਟ ॥
Transliteration: bin bohith saagar nahee vaatt |
English: Without a boat, you cannot cross over the ocean.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਘਾਟੇ ਘਾਟਿ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: bin gur seve ghaatte ghaatt |5|
English: Without serving the Guru, everything is lost. ||5||

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਜਿ ਵਾਟ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: tis kau vaahu vaahu ji vaatt dikhaavai |
English: Waaho! Waaho! - Hail, hail, to the one who shows us the Way.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਜਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: tis kau vaahu vaahu ji sabad sunaavai |
English: Waaho! Waaho! - Hail, hail, to the one who teaches the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਜਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: tis kau vaahu vaahu ji mel milaavai |6|
English: Waaho! Waaho! - Hail, hail, to the one who unites me in the Lord's Union. ||6||

Gurbani: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: vaahu vaahu tis kau jis kaa ihu jeeo |
English: Waaho! Waaho! - Hail, hail, to the one who is the Keeper of this soul.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮਥਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: gurasabadee math amrit peeo |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, contemplate this Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਵਡਾਈ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣੈ ਦੀਉ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: naam vaddaaee tudh bhaanai deeo |7|
English: The Glorious Greatness of the Naam is bestowed according to the Pleasure of Your Will. ||7||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕਿਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: naam binaa kiau jeevaa maae |
English: Without the Naam, how can I live, O mother?

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਪਤੁ ਰਹਉ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: anadin japat rhau teree saranaae |
English: Night and day, I chant it; I remain in the Protection of Your Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੮॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naam rate pat paae |8|12|
English: O Nanak, attuned to the Naam, honor is attained. ||8||12||

[Ang 226 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 1 |
English: Gauree, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਤ ਭੇਖੀ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: haumai karat bhekhee nahee jaaniaa |
English: Acting in egotism, the Lord is not known, even by wearing religious robes.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: guramukh bhagat virale man maaniaa |1|
English: How rare is that Gurmukh, who surrenders his mind in devotional worship. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤ ਨਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: hau hau karat nahee sach paaeeai |
English: By actions done in egotism, selfishness and conceit, the True Lord is not obtained.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: haumai jaae param pad paaeeai |1| rahaau |
English: But when egotism departs, then the state of supreme dignity is obtained. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਬਹੁ ਧਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: haumai kar raaje bahu dhaaveh |
English: The kings act in egotism, and undertake all sorts of expeditions.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਖਪਹਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰਿ ਆਵਹਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: haumai khapeh janam mar aaveh |2|
English: But through their egotism, they are ruined; they die, only to be reborn over and over again. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਨਿਵਰੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: haumai nivarai gurasabad veechaarai |
English: Egotism is overcome only by contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਚੰਚਲ ਮਤਿ ਤਿਆਗੈ ਪੰਚ ਸੰਘਾਰੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: chanchal mat tiaagai panch sanghaarai |3|
English: One who restrains his fickle mind subdues the five passions. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਹਜ ਘਰਿ ਆਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: antar saach sehaj ghar aaveh |
English: With the True Lord deep within the self, the Celestial Mansion is intuitively found.

Gurbani: ਰਾਜਨੁ ਜਾਣਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: raajan jaan param gat paaveh |4|
English: Understanding the Sovereign Lord, the state of supreme dignity is obtained. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: sach karanee gur bharam chukaavai |
English: The Guru dispels the doubts of those whose actions are true.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: nirbhau kai ghar taarree laavai |5|
English: They focus their attention on the Home of the Fearless Lord. ||5||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਿ ਮਰਣਾ ਕਿਆ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: hau hau kar maranaa kiaa paavai |
English: Those who act in egotism, selfishness and conceit die; what do they gain?

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਸੋ ਝਗਰੁ ਚੁਕਾਵੈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: pooraa gur bhette so jhagar chukaavai |6|
English: Those who meet the Perfect Guru are rid of all conflicts. ||6||

Gurbani: ਜੇਤੀ ਹੈ ਤੇਤੀ ਕਿਹੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jetee hai tetee kihu naahee |
English: Whatever exists, is in reality nothing.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਭੇਟਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹੀ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: guramukh giaan bhett gun gaahee |7|
English: Obtaining spiritual wisdom from the Guru, I sing the Glories of God. ||7||

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਬੰਧਨ ਬੰਧਿ ਭਵਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: haumai bandhan bandh bhavaavai |
English: Egotism binds people in bondage, and causes them to wander around lost.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੮॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: naanak raam bhagat sukh paavai |8|13|
English: O Nanak, peace is obtained through devotional worship of the Lord. ||8||13||

[Ang 227 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 1 |
English: Gauree, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਥਮੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਕਾਲੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: prathame brahamaa kaalai ghar aaeaa |
English: First, Brahma entered the house of Death.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਮਲੁ ਪਇਆਲਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: braham kamal peaal na paaeaa |
English: Brahma entered the lotus, and searched the nether regions, but he did not find the end of it.

Gurbani: ਆਗਿਆ ਨਹੀ ਲੀਨੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aagiaa nahee leenee bharam bhulaaeaa |1|
English: He did not accept the Lord's Order - he was deluded by doubt. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਉਪਜੈ ਸੋ ਕਾਲਿ ਸੰਘਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jo upajai so kaal sanghaariaa |
English: Whoever is created, shall be destroyed by Death.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ham har raakhe gurasabad beechaariaa |1| rahaau |
English: But I am protected by the Lord; I contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੇ ਦੇਵੀ ਸਭਿ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohe devee sabh devaa |
English: All the gods and goddesses are enticed by Maya.

Gurbani: ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaal na chhoddai bin gur kee sevaa |
English: Death cannot be avoided, without serving the Guru.

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ohu abinaasee alakh abhevaa |2|
English: That Lord is Imperishable, Invisible and Inscrutable. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੁਲਤਾਨ ਖਾਨ ਬਾਦਿਸਾਹ ਨਹੀ ਰਹਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: sulataan khaan baadisaah nahee rahanaa |
English: The sultans, emperors and kings shall not remain.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਹੁ ਭੂਲੈ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਹਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: naamahu bhoolai jam kaa dukh sahanaa |
English: Forgetting the Name, they shall endure the pain of death.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਧਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਹਨਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: mai dhar naam jiau raakhahu rahanaa |3|
English: My only Support is the Naam, the Name of the Lord; as He keeps me, I survive. ||3||

Gurbani: ਚਉਧਰੀ ਰਾਜੇ ਨਹੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਮੁਕਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: chaudharee raaje nahee kisai mukaam |
English: The leaders and kings shall not remain.

Gurbani: ਸਾਹ ਮਰਹਿ ਸੰਚਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਦਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: saah mareh sancheh maaeaa daam |
English: The bankers shall die, after accumulating their wealth and money.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਧਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: mai dhan deejai har amrit naam |4|
English: Grant me, O Lord, the wealth of Your Ambrosial Naam. ||4||

Gurbani: ਰਯਤਿ ਮਹਰ ਮੁਕਦਮ ਸਿਕਦਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: rayat mehar mukadam sikadaarai |
English: The people, rulers, leaders and chiefs

Gurbani: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਦਿਸੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: nihachal koe na disai sansaarai |
English: none of them shall be able to remain in the world.

Gurbani: ਅਫਰਿਉ ਕਾਲੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰੈ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: afariau kaal koorr sir maarai |5|
English: Death is inevitable; it strikes the heads of the false. ||5||

Gurbani: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਏਕੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: nihachal ek sachaa sach soee |
English: Only the One Lord, the Truest of the True, is permanent.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਜੀ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਸਭ ਗੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jin kar saajee tineh sabh goee |
English: He who created and fashioned everything, shall destroy it.

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਪੈ ਤਾਂ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: ohu guramukh jaapai taan pat hoee |6|
English: One who becomes Gurmukh and meditates on the Lord is honored. ||6||

Gurbani: ਕਾਜੀ ਸੇਖ ਭੇਖ ਫਕੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaajee sekh bhekh fakeeraa |
English: The Qazis, Shaykhs and Fakeers in religious robes

Gurbani: ਵਡੇ ਕਹਾਵਹਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਨਿ ਪੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: vadde kahaaveh haumai tan peeraa |
English: call themselves great; but through their egotism, their bodies are suffering in pain.

Gurbani: ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਧੀਰਾ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: kaal na chhoddai bin satigur kee dheeraa |7|
English: Death does not spare them, without the Support of the True Guru. ||7||

Gurbani: ਕਾਲੁ ਜਾਲੁ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਅਰੁ ਨੈਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: kaal jaal jihavaa ar nainee |
English: The trap of Death is hanging over their tongues and eyes.

Gurbani: ਕਾਨੀ ਕਾਲੁ ਸੁਣੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਬੈਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: kaanee kaal sunai bikh bainee |
English: Death is over their ears, when they hear talk of evil.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਮੂਠੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣੀ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: bin sabadai mootthe din rainee |8|
English: Without the Shabad, they are plundered, day and night. ||8||

Gurbani: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਵਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: hiradai saach vasai har naae |
English: Death cannot touch those whose hearts are filled with the True Name of the Lord,

Gurbani: ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਜੋਹਿ ਸਕੈ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kaal na johi sakai gun gaae |
English: And who sing the Glories of God.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੯॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh sabad samaae |9|14|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is absorbed in the Word of the Shabad. ||9||14||

[Ang 227 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 1 |
English: Gauree, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬੋਲਹਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਨਹੀ ਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: boleh saach mithiaa nahee raaee |
English: They speak the Truth - not an iota of falsehood.

Gurbani: ਚਾਲਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: chaaleh guramukh hukam rajaaee |
English: The Gurmukhs walk in the Way of the Lord's Command.

Gurbani: ਰਹਹਿ ਅਤੀਤ ਸਚੇ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: raheh ateet sache saranaaee |1|
English: They remain unattached, in the Sanctuary of the True Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਚ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਸੈ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਜੋਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: sach ghar baisai kaal na johai |
English: They dwell in their true home, and Death does not touch them.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਉ ਆਵਤ ਜਾਵਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਮੋਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh kau aavat jaavat dukh mohai |1| rahaau |
English: The self-willed manmukhs come and go, in the pain of emotional attachment. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀਅਉ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: apiau peeo akath kath raheeai |
English: So, drink deeply of this Nectar, and speak the Unspoken Speech.

Gurbani: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਸਿ ਸਹਜ ਘਰੁ ਲਹੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: nij ghar bais sehaj ghar laheeai |
English: Dwelling in the home of your own being within, you shall find the home of intuitive peace.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਮਾਤੇ ਇਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਕਹੀਐ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har ras maate ihu sukh kaheeai |2|
English: One who is imbued with the Lord's sublime essence, is said to experience this peace. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਚਾਲ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਨਹੀ ਡੋਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: guramat chaal nihachal nahee ddolai |
English: Following the Guru's Teachings, one becomes perfectly stable, and never wavers.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: guramat saach sehaj har bolai |
English: Following the Guru's Teachings, one intuitively chants the Name of the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਪੀਵੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤਤੁ ਵਿਰੋਲੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: peevai amrit tat virolai |3|
English: Drinking in this Ambrosial Nectar, and churning it, the essential reality is discerned. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਲੀਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: satigur dekhiaa deekhiaa leenee |
English: Beholding the True Guru, I have received His Teachings.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿਓ ਅੰਤਰਗਤਿ ਕੀਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: man tan arapio antaragat keenee |
English: I have offered my mind and body, after searching deep within my own being.

Gurbani: ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਆਤਮੁ ਚੀਨੀ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: gat mit paaee aatam cheenee |4|
English: I have come to realize the value of understanding my own soul. ||4||

Gurbani: ਭੋਜਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: bhojan naam niranjan saar |
English: The Naam, the Name of the Immaculate Lord, is the most excellent and sublime food.

Gurbani: ਪਰਮ ਹੰਸੁ ਸਚੁ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: param hans sach jot apaar |
English: The pure swan-souls see the True Light of the Infinite Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਹ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: jeh dekhau teh ekankaar |5|
English: Wherever I look, I see the One and Only Lord. ||5||

Gurbani: ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਏਕਾ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: rahai niraalam ekaa sach karanee |
English: One who remains pure and unblemished and practices only true deeds,

Gurbani: ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੇਵਾ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: param pad paaeaa sevaa gur charanee |
English: obtains the supreme status, serving at the Guru's Feet.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਚੂਕੀ ਅਹੰ ਭ੍ਰਮਣੀ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: man te man maaniaa chookee ahan bhramanee |6|
English: The mind is reconciliated with the mind, and the ego's wandering ways come to an end. ||6||

Gurbani: ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਉਣੁ ਕਉਣੁ ਨਹੀ ਤਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: ein bidh kaun kaun nahee taariaa |
English: In this way, who - who has not been saved?

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਸਿ ਸੰਤ ਭਗਤ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: har jas sant bhagat nisataariaa |
English: The Lord's Praises have saved His Saints and devotees.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਏ ਹਮ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਰਿਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: prabh paae ham avar na bhaariaa |7|
English: I have found God - I am not searching for any other. ||7||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚ ਮਹਲਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: saach mehal gur alakh lakhaaeaa |
English: The Guru has shown me the unseen Mansion of the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਿਹਚਲ ਮਹਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਛਾਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: nihachal mehal nahee chhaaeaa maaeaa |
English: His Mansion is eternal and unchanging; it is not a mere reflection of Maya.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: saach santokhe bharam chukaaeaa |8|
English: Through truth and contentment, doubt is dispelled. ||8||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jin kai man vasiaa sach soee |
English: That person, within whose mind the True Lord dwells

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: tin kee sangat guramukh hoee |
English: in his company, one becomes Gurmukh.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਲੁ ਖੋਈ ॥੯॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: naanak saach naam mal khoee |9|15|
English: O Nanak, the True Name washes off the pollution. ||9||15||

[Ang 228 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 1 |
English: Gauree, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਾਮਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਰਾਪੈ ਜਾ ਕਾ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam chit raapai jaa kaa |
English: One whose consciousness is permeated with the Lord's Name

Gurbani: ਉਪਜੰਪਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਤਾ ਕਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aupajanp darasan keejai taa kaa |1|
English: - receive the blessing of his darshan in the early light of dawn. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨ ਜਪਹੁ ਅਭਾਗੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: raam na japahu abhaag tumaaraa |
English: If you do not meditate on the Lord, it is your own misfortune.

Gurbani: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jug jug daataa prabh raam hamaaraa |1| rahaau |
English: In each and every age, the Great Giver is my Lord God. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਜਨੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: guramat raam japai jan pooraa |
English: Following the Guru's Teachings, the perfect humble beings meditate on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਿਤੁ ਘਟ ਅਨਹਤ ਬਾਜੇ ਤੂਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tit ghatt anahat baaje tooraa |2|
English: Within their hearts, the unstruck melody vibrates. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jo jan raam bhagat har piaar |
English: Those who worship the Lord and love the Lord

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: se prabh raakhe kirapaa dhaar |3|
English: - showering His Mercy, God protects them. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jin kai hiradai har har soee |
English: Those whose hearts are filled with the Lord, Har, Har

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਪਰਸਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: tin kaa daras paras sukh hoee |4|
English: - gazing upon the blessed vision of their darshan, peace is obtained. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੋ ਰਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: sarab jeea meh eko ravai |
English: Among all beings, the One Lord is pervading.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਭਵੈ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: manamukh ahankaaree fir joonee bhavai |5|
English: The eogtistical, self-willed manmukhs wander in reincarnation. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: so boojhai jo satigur paae |
English: They alone understand, who have found the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੇ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੇ ਪਾਏ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: haumai maare gurasabade paae |6|
English: Subduing their ego, they receive the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||6||

Gurbani: ਅਰਧ ਉਰਧ ਕੀ ਸੰਧਿ ਕਿਉ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: aradh uradh kee sandh kiau jaanai |
English: How can anyone know of the Union between the being below and the Supreme Being above?

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: guramukh sandh milai man maanai |7|
English: The Gurmukhs obtain this Union; their minds are reconciliated. ||7||

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਕਉ ਗੁਣੁ ਕਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: ham paapee niragun kau gun kareeai |
English: I am a worthless sinner, without merit. What merit do I have?

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਤਰੀਐ ॥੮॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: prabh hoe deaal naanak jan tareeai |8|16|
English: When God showers His Mercy, servant Nanak is emancipated. ||8||16||

Gurbani: ਸੋਲਹ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਗਉੜੀ ਕੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: solah asattapadeea guaareree gaurree keea |
English: Sixteen Ashtpadheeyaa Of Gwaarayree Gauree||

[Ang 228 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree bairaagan mahalaa 1 |
English: Gauree Bairaagan, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਗਾਈ ਕਉ ਗੋਇਲੀ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jiau gaaee kau goeilee raakheh kar saaraa |
English: As the dairy farmer watches over and protects his cows, so does the Lord cherish and protect us, night and day. He blesses the soul with peace. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਪਾਲਹਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹਿ ਆਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ahinis paaleh raakh lehi aatam sukh dhaaraa |1|
English: Please protect me here and hereafter, O Lord, Merciful to the meek.

Gurbani: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: eit ut raakhahu deen deaalaa |
English: I seek Your Sanctuary; please bless me with Your Glance of Grace. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tau saranaagat nadar nihaalaa |1| rahaau |
English: Wherever I look, there You are. Save me, O Savior Lord!

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਹ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਰਖੁ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeh dekhau teh rav rahe rakh raakhanahaaraa |
English: You are the Giver, and You are the Enjoyer;

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਤਾ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: toon daataa bhugataa toonhai toon praan adhaaraa |2|
English: You are the Support of the breath of life. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਤੁ ਪਇਆ ਅਧ ਊਰਧੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kirat peaa adh aooradhee bin giaan beechaaraa |
English: According to the karma of past actions, people descend to the depths or rise to the heights, unless they contemplate spiritual wisdom.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਉਪਮਾ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਕੀ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਨ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bin upamaa jagadees kee binasai na andhiaaraa |3|
English: Without the Praises of the Lord of the Universe, the darkness is not dispelled. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਗੁ ਬਿਨਸਤ ਹਮ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਲੋਭੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jag binasat ham dekhiaa lobhe ahankaaraa |
English: I have seen the world being destroyed by greed and egotism.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: gur sevaa prabh paaeaa sach mukat duaaraa |4|
English: Only by serving the Guru is God obtained, and the true gate of liberation found. ||4||

Gurbani: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਅਪਾਰ ਕੋ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: nij ghar mehal apaar ko aparanpar soee |
English: The Mansion of the Infinite Lord's Presence is within the home of one's own being. He is beyond any boundaries.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਥਿਰੁ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: bin sabadai thir ko nahee boojhai sukh hoee |5|
English: Without the Word of the Shabad, nothing shall endure. Through understanding, peace is obtained. ||5||

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਲੈ ਆਇਆ ਲੇ ਜਾਇ ਕਿਆ ਫਾਸਹਿ ਜਮ ਜਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa lai aaeaa le jaae kiaa faaseh jam jaalaa |
English: What have you brought, and what will you take away, when you are caught by the noose of Death?

Gurbani: ਡੋਲੁ ਬਧਾ ਕਸਿ ਜੇਵਰੀ ਆਕਾਸਿ ਪਤਾਲਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: ddol badhaa kas jevaree aakaas pataalaa |6|
English: Like the bucket tied to the rope in the well, you are pulled up to the Akaashic Ethers, and then lowered down to the nether regions of the underworld. ||6||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: guramat naam na veesarai sahaje pat paaeeai |
English: Follow the Guru's Teachings, and do not forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord; you shall automatically obtain honor.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: antar sabad nidhaan hai mil aap gavaaeeai |7|
English: Deep within the self is the treasure of the Shabad; it is obtained only by eradicating selfishness and conceit. ||7||

Gurbani: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਗੁਣ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: nadar kare prabh aapanee gun ank samaavai |
English: When God bestows His Glance of Grace, people settle in the Lap of the Virtuous Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲੁ ਨ ਚੂਕਈ ਲਾਹਾ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੮॥੧॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: naanak mel na chookee laahaa sach paavai |8|1|17|
English: O Nanak, this Union cannot be broken; the true profit is obtained. ||8||1||17||

[Ang 229 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 1 |
English: Gauree, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੂਝਿ ਲੇ ਤਉ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee boojh le tau hoe niberaa |
English: By Guru's Grace, one comes to understand, and then, the account is settled.

Gurbani: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਾ ਸੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ghar ghar naam niranjanaa so tthaakur meraa |1|
English: In each and every heart is the Name of the Immaculate Lord; He is my Lord and Master. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਨ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: bin gurasabad na chhootteeai dekhahu veechaaraa |
English: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, no one is emancipated. See this, and reflect upon it.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਲਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਹੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: je lakh karam kamaavahee bin gur andhiaaraa |1| rahaau |
English: Even though you may perform hundreds of thousands of rituals, without the Guru, there is only darkness. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅੰਧੇ ਅਕਲੀ ਬਾਹਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਸਿਉ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: andhe akalee baahare kiaa tin siau kaheeai |
English: What can you say, to one who is blind and without wisdom?

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੰਥੁ ਨ ਸੂਝਈ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਿਰਬਹੀਐ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bin gur panth na soojhee kit bidh nirabaheeai |2|
English: Without the Guru, the Path cannot be seen. How can anyone proceed? ||2||

Gurbani: ਖੋਟੇ ਕਉ ਖਰਾ ਕਹੈ ਖਰੇ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: khotte kau kharaa kahai khare saar na jaanai |
English: He calls the counterfeit genuine, and does not know the value of the genuine.

Gurbani: ਅੰਧੇ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਰਖੂ ਕਲੀ ਕਾਲ ਵਿਡਾਣੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: andhe kaa naau paarakhoo kalee kaal viddaanai |3|
English: The blind man is known as an appraiser; this Dark Age of Kali Yuga is so strange! ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੂਤੇ ਕਉ ਜਾਗਤੁ ਕਹੈ ਜਾਗਤ ਕਉ ਸੂਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: soote kau jaagat kahai jaagat kau sootaa |
English: The sleeper is said to be awake, and those who are awake are like sleepers.

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਤ ਕਉ ਮੂਆ ਕਹੈ ਮੂਏ ਨਹੀ ਰੋਤਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jeevat kau mooaa kahai mooe nahee rotaa |4|
English: The living are said to be dead, and no one mourns for those who have died. ||4||

Gurbani: ਆਵਤ ਕਉ ਜਾਤਾ ਕਹੈ ਜਾਤੇ ਕਉ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aavat kau jaataa kahai jaate kau aaeaa |
English: One who is coming is said to be going, and one who is gone is said to have come.

Gurbani: ਪਰ ਕੀ ਕਉ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕਹੈ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: par kee kau apunee kahai apuno nahee bhaaeaa |5|
English: That which belongs to others, he calls his own, but he has no liking for that which is his. ||5||

Gurbani: ਮੀਠੇ ਕਉ ਕਉੜਾ ਕਹੈ ਕੜੂਏ ਕਉ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: meetthe kau kaurraa kahai karrooe kau meetthaa |
English: That which is sweet is said to be bitter, and the bitter is said to be sweet.

Gurbani: ਰਾਤੇ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਐਸਾ ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: raate kee nindaa kareh aisaa kal meh ddeetthaa |6|
English: One who is imbued with the Lord's Love is slandered - this is what I have seen in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||6||

Gurbani: ਚੇਰੀ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਦੀਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: cheree kee sevaa kareh tthaakur nahee deesai |
English: He serves the maid, and does not see his Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਪੋਖਰੁ ਨੀਰੁ ਵਿਰੋਲੀਐ ਮਾਖਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਰੀਸੈ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: pokhar neer viroleeai maakhan nahee reesai |7|
English: Churning the water in the pond, no butter is produced. ||7||

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਪਦ ਜੋ ਅਰਥਾਇ ਲੇਇ ਸੋ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: eis pad jo arathaae lee so guroo hamaaraa |
English: One who understands the meaning of this verse is my Guru.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਚੀਨੈ ਆਪ ਕਉ ਸੋ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: naanak cheenai aap kau so apar apaaraa |8|
English: O Nanak, one who knows his own self, is infinite and incomparable. ||8||

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabh aape aap varatadaa aape bharamaaeaa |
English: He Himself is All-pervading; He Himself misleads the people.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਬੂਝੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੯॥੨॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: gur kirapaa te boojheeai sabh braham samaaeaa |9|2|18|
English: By Guru's Grace, one comes to understand, that God is contained in all. ||9||2||18||

[Ang 229 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: raag gaurree guaareree mahalaa 3 asattapadeea |
English: Raag Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: man kaa sootak doojaa bhaau |
English: The pollution of the mind is the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲੇ ਆਵਉ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bharame bhoole aavau jaau |1|
English: Deluded by doubt, people come and go in reincarnation. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh sootak kabeh na jaae |
English: The pollution of the self-willed manmukhs will never go away,

Gurbani: ਜਿਚਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jichar sabad na bheejai har kai naae |1| rahaau |
English: as long as they do not dwell on the Shabad, and the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਭੋ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਜੇਤਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sabho sootak jetaa mohu aakaar |
English: All the created beings are contaminated by emotional attachment;

Gurbani: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mar mar jamai vaaro vaar |2|
English: they die and are reborn, only to die over and over again. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੂਤਕੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਪਉਣੈ ਪਾਣੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: sootak agan paunai paanee maeh |
English: Fire, air and water are polluted.

Gurbani: ਸੂਤਕੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਜੇਤਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਖਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sootak bhojan jetaa kichh khaeh |3|
English: The food which is eaten is polluted. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੂਤਕਿ ਕਰਮ ਨ ਪੂਜਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sootak karam na poojaa hoe |
English: The actions of those who do not worship the Lord are polluted.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: naam rate man niramal hoe |4|
English: Attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind becomes immaculate. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur seviai sootak jaae |
English: Serving the True Guru, pollution is eradicated,

Gurbani: ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਨਮੈ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: marai na janamai kaal na khaae |5|
English: and then, one does not suffer death and rebirth, or get devoured by death. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਤ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸੋਧਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: saasat sinmrit sodh dekhahu koe |
English: You may study and examine the Shaastras and the Simritees,

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: vin naavai ko mukat na hoe |6|
English: but without the Name, no one is liberated. ||6||

Gurbani: ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਤਮੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jug chaare naam utam sabad beechaar |
English: Throughout the four ages, the Naam is the ultimate; reflect upon the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: kal meh guramukh utaras paar |7|
English: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, only the Gurmukhs cross over. ||7||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਾ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: saachaa marai na aavai jaae |
English: The True Lord does not die; He does not come or go.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੮॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh rahai samaae |8|1|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh remains absorbed in the Lord. ||8||1||

[Ang 229 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 3 |
English: Gauree, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh sevaa praan adhaaraa |
English: Selfless service is the support of the breath of life of the Gurmukh.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har jeeo raakhahu hiradai ur dhaaraa |
English: Keep the Dear Lord enshrined in your heart.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਸਾਚ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: guramukh sobhaa saach duaaraa |1|
English: The Gurmukh is honored in the Court of the True Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਪੜੁ ਤਜਹੁ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: panddit har parr tajahu vikaaraa |
English: O Pandit, O religious scholar, read about the Lord, and renounce your corrupt ways.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਉਤਰਹੁ ਪਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh bhaujal utarahu paaraa |1| rahaau |
English: The Gurmukh crosses over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh vichahu haumai jaae |
English: The Gurmukh eradicates egotism from within.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh mail na laagai aae |
English: No filth sticks to the Gurmukh.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: guramukh naam vasai man aae |2|
English: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to dwell within the mind of the Gurmukh. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਸਚਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh karam dharam sach hoee |
English: Through karma and Dharma, good actions and righteous faith, the Gurmukh becomes true.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਜਲਾਏ ਦੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh ahankaar jalaae doee |
English: The Gurmukh burns away egotism and duality.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: guramukh naam rate sukh hoee |3|
English: The Gurmukh is attuned to the Naam, and is at peace. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਪਣਾ ਮਨੁ ਪਰਬੋਧਹੁ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aapanaa man parabodhahu boojhahu soee |
English: Instruct your own mind, and understand Him.

Gurbani: ਲੋਕ ਸਮਝਾਵਹੁ ਸੁਣੇ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: lok samajhaavahu sune na koee |
English: You may preach to other people, but no one will listen.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਮਝਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: guramukh samajhahu sadaa sukh hoee |4|
English: The Gurmukh understands, and is always at peace. ||4||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਡੰਫੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh ddanf bahut chaturaaee |
English: The self-willed manmukhs are such clever hypocrites.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jo kichh kamaavai su thaae na paaee |
English: No matter what they do, it is not acceptable.

Gurbani: ਆਵੈ ਜਾਵੈ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: aavai jaavai tthaur na kaaee |5|
English: They come and go in reincarnation, and find no place of rest. ||5||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh karam kare bahut abhimaanaa |
English: The manmukhs perform their rituals, but they are totally selfish and conceited.

Gurbani: ਬਗ ਜਿਉ ਲਾਇ ਬਹੈ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: bag jiau laae bahai nit dhiaanaa |
English: They sit there, like storks, pretending to meditate.

Gurbani: ਜਮਿ ਪਕੜਿਆ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਪਛੁਤਾਨਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: jam pakarriaa tab hee pachhutaanaa |6|
English: Caught by the Messenger of Death, they shall regret and repent in the end. ||6||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: bin satigur seve mukat na hoee |
English: Without serving the True Guru, liberation is not obtained.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee milai har soee |
English: By Guru's Grace, one meets the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਹੋਈ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: gur daataa jug chaare hoee |7|
English: The Guru is the Great Giver, throughout the four ages. ||7||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh jaat pat naame vaddiaaee |
English: For the Gurmukh, the Naam is social status, honor and glorious greatness.

Gurbani: ਸਾਇਰ ਕੀ ਪੁਤ੍ਰੀ ਬਿਦਾਰਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: saaeir kee putree bidaar gavaaee |
English: Maya, the daughter of the ocean, has been slain.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਝੂਠੀ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥੮॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak bin naavai jhootthee chaturaaee |8|2|
English: O Nanak, without the Name, all clever tricks are false. ||8||2||

[Ang 230 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 3 |
English: Gauree, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਕਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਪੜਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: eis jug kaa dharam parrahu tum bhaaee |
English: Learn the Dharma of this age, O Siblings of Destiny;

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਭ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: poorai gur sabh sojhee paaee |
English: all understanding is obtained from the Perfect Guru.

Gurbani: ਐਥੈ ਅਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aithai agai har naam sakhaaee |1|
English: Here and hereafter, the Lord's Name is our Companion. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਪੜਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: raam parrahu man karahu beechaar |
English: Learn of the Lord, and contemplate Him in your mind.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਉਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee mail utaar |1| rahaau |
English: By Guru's Grace, your filth shall be washed away. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਵਾਦਿ ਵਿਰੋਧਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: vaad virodh na paaeaa jaae |
English: Through argument and debate, He cannot be found.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਫੀਕਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man tan feekaa doojai bhaae |
English: The mind and body are made insipid through the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad sach liv laae |2|
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, lovingly attune yourself to the True Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲਾ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: haumai mailaa ihu sansaaraa |
English: This world is polluted with egotism.

Gurbani: ਨਿਤ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: nit teerath naavai na jaae ahankaaraa |
English: By taking cleansing baths daily at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, egotism is not eliminated.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਜਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਆਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bin gur bhette jam kare khuaaraa |3|
English: Without meeting the Guru, they are tortured by Death. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਜਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: so jan saachaa ji haumai maarai |
English: Those humble beings are true, who conquer their ego.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪੰਚ ਸੰਘਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad panch sanghaarai |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they conquer the five thieves.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: aap tarai sagale kul taarai |4|
English: They save themselves, and save all their generations as well. ||4||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਟਿ ਬਾਜੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohi natt baajee paaee |
English: The Actor has staged the drama of emotional attachment to Maya.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧ ਰਹੇ ਲਪਟਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh andh rahe lapattaaee |
English: The self-willed manmukhs cling blindly to it.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਲਿਪਤ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: guramukh alipat rahe liv laaee |5|
English: The Gurmukhs remain detached, and lovingly attune themselves to the Lord. ||5||

Gurbani: ਬਹੁਤੇ ਭੇਖ ਕਰੈ ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: bahute bhekh karai bhekhadhaaree |
English: The disguisers put on their various disguises.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: antar tisanaa firai ahankaaree |
English: Desire rages within them, and they carry on egotistically.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੈ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: aap na cheenai baajee haaree |6|
English: They do not understand themselves, and they lose the game of life. ||6||

Gurbani: ਕਾਪੜ ਪਹਿਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kaaparr pahir kare chaturaaee |
English: Putting on religious robes, they act so clever,

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਅਤਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohi at bharam bhulaaee |
English: but they are totally deluded by doubt and emotional attachment to Maya.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: bin gur seve bahut dukh paaee |7|
English: Without serving the Guru, they suffer in terrible pain. ||7||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: naam rate sadaa bairaagee |
English: Those who are attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, remain detached forever.

Gurbani: ਗ੍ਰਿਹੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: grihee antar saach liv laagee |
English: Even as householders, they lovingly attune themselves to the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥੮॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak satigur seveh se vaddabhaagee |8|3|
English: O Nanak, those who serve the True Guru are blessed and very fortunate. ||8||3||

[Ang 230 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 3 |
English: Gauree, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਵੇਦ ਅਭਿਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: brahamaa mool ved abhiaasaa |
English: Brahma is the founder of the study of the Vedas.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੇ ਦੇਵ ਮੋਹ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: tis te upaje dev moh piaasaa |
English: From him emanated the gods, enticed by desire.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਭਰਮੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: trai gun bharame naahee nij ghar vaasaa |1|
English: They wander in the three qualities, and they do not dwell within their own home. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: ham har raakhe satiguroo milaaeaa |
English: The Lord has saved me; I have met the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: anadin bhagat har naam drirraaeaa |1| rahaau |
English: He has implanted devotional worship of the Lord's Name, night and day. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਬਾਣੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: trai gun baanee braham janjaalaa |
English: The songs of Brahma entangle people in the three qualities.

Gurbani: ਪੜਿ ਵਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਜਮਕਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: parr vaad vakhaaneh sir maare jamakaalaa |
English: Reading about the debates and disputes, they are hit over the head by the Messenger of Death.

Gurbani: ਤਤੁ ਨ ਚੀਨਹਿ ਬੰਨਹਿ ਪੰਡ ਪਰਾਲਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tat na cheeneh baneh pandd paraalaa |2|
English: They do not understand the essence of reality, and they gather their worthless bundles of straw. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅਗਿਆਨਿ ਕੁਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh agiaan kumaarag paae |
English: The self-willed manmukhs, in ignorance, take the path of evil.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: har naam bisaariaa bahu karam drirraae |
English: They forget the Lord's Name, and in its place, they establish all sorts of rituals.

Gurbani: ਭਵਜਲਿ ਡੂਬੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bhavajal ddoobe doojai bhaae |3|
English: They drown in the terrifying world-ocean, in the love of duality. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਮੁਹਤਾਜੁ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa kaa muhataaj panddit kahaavai |
English: Driven crazy, infatuated by Maya, they call themselves Pandits - religious scholars;

Gurbani: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਾਤਾ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: bikhiaa raataa bahut dukh paavai |
English: stained with corruption, they suffer terrible pain.

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਕਾ ਗਲਿ ਜੇਵੜਾ ਨਿਤ ਕਾਲੁ ਸੰਤਾਵੈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jam kaa gal jevarraa nit kaal santaavai |4|
English: The noose of the Messenger of Death is around their necks; they are constantly tormented by death. ||4||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh jamakaal nerr na aavai |
English: The Messenger of Death does not even approach the Gurmukhs.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: haumai doojaa sabad jalaavai |
English: Through the Word of the Shabad, they burn away their ego and duality.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੇ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: naame raate har gun gaavai |5|
English: Attuned to the Name, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||5||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਦਾਸੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa daasee bhagataa kee kaar kamaavai |
English: Maya is the slave of the Lord's devotees; it works for them.

Gurbani: ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: charanee laagai taa mehal paavai |
English: One who falls at their feet attains the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

Gurbani: ਸਦ ਹੀ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: sad hee niramal sehaj samaavai |6|
English: He is forever immaculate; he is absorbed in intuitive peace. ||6||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਹਿ ਸੇ ਧਨਵੰਤ ਦਿਸਹਿ ਜੁਗ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: har kathaa suneh se dhanavant diseh jug maahee |
English: Those who listen to the Lord's Sermon are seen to be the wealthy people in this world.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਵਹਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: tin kau sabh niveh anadin pooj karaahee |
English: Everyone bows down to them, and adores them, night and day.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਹਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: sahaje gun raveh saache man maahee |7|
English: They intuitively savor the Glories of the True Lord within their minds. ||7||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: poorai satigur sabad sunaaeaa |
English: The Perfect True Guru has revealed the Shabad;

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮੇਟੇ ਚਉਥੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: trai gun mette chauthai chit laaeaa |
English: it eradicates the three qualities, and attunes the consciousness to the fourth state.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੮॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak haumai maar braham milaaeaa |8|4|
English: O Nanak, subduing egotism, one is absorbed into God. ||8||4||

[Ang 231 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 3 |
English: Gauree, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਵੇਦੁ ਪੜੈ ਵਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: brahamaa ved parrai vaad vakhaanai |
English: Brahma studied the Vedas, but these lead only to debates and disputes.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤਾਮਸੁ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: antar taamas aap na pachhaanai |
English: He is filled with darkness; he does not understand himself.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: taa prabh paae gurasabad vakhaanai |1|
English: And yet, if he chants the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he finds God. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਉ ਫਿਰਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur sevaa krau fir kaal na khaae |
English: So serve the Guru, and you shall not be consumed by death.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਖਾਧੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh khaadhe doojai bhaae |1| rahaau |
English: The self-willed manmukhs have been consumed by the love of duality. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਸੀਧੇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh praanee aparaadhee seedhe |
English: Becoming Gurmukh, the sinful mortals are purified.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਰੀਧੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad antar sehaj reedhe |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they find intuitive peace and poise deep within.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਧੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: meraa prabh paaeaa gur kai sabad seedhe |2|
English: I have found my God, through the Guru's Shabad, and I have been reformed. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: satigur mele prabh aap milaae |
English: God Himself unites us in Union with the True Guru,

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: mere prabh saache kai man bhaae |
English: when we become pleasing to the Mind of my True God.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har gun gaaveh sehaj subhaae |3|
English: They sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, in the poise of celestial peace. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: bin gur saache bharam bhulaae |
English: Without the True Guru, they are deluded by doubt.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧੇ ਸਦਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh andhe sadaa bikh khaae |
English: The blind, self-willed manmukhs constantly eat poison.

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਸਹਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jam ddandd saheh sadaa dukh paae |4|
English: They are beaten by the Messenger of Death with his rod, and they suffer in constant pain. ||4||

Gurbani: ਜਮੂਆ ਨ ਜੋਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jamooaa na johai har kee saranaaee |
English: The Messenger of Death does not catch sight of those who enter the Sanctuary of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਚਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: haumai maar sach liv laaee |
English: Subduing egotism, they lovingly center their consciousness on the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: sadaa rahai har naam liv laaee |5|
English: They keep their consciousness constantly focused on the Lord's Name. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਪਵਿਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: satigur seveh se jan niramal pavitaa |
English: Those humble beings who serve the True Guru are pure and immaculate.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਜੀਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: man siau man milaae sabh jag jeetaa |
English: Merging their minds into the Mind, they conquer the entire world.

Gurbani: ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: ein bidh kusal terai mere meetaa |6|
English: In this way, you too shall find happiness, O my friend. ||6||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: satiguroo seve so fal paae |
English: Those who serve the True Guru are blessed with fruitful rewards.

Gurbani: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: hiradai naam vichahu aap gavaae |
English: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides in their hearts; selfishness and conceit depart from within them.

Gurbani: ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਏ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: anahad baanee sabad vajaae |7|
English: The unstruck melody of the Shabad vibrates for them. ||7||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਕਵਨੁ ਕਵਨੁ ਨ ਸੀਧੋ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur te kavan kavan na seedho mere bhaaee |
English: Who - who has not been purified by the True Guru, O my Siblings of Destiny?

Gurbani: ਭਗਤੀ ਸੀਧੇ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: bhagatee seedhe dar sobhaa paaee |
English: The devotees are purified, and honored in His Court.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੮॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak raam naam vaddiaaee |8|5|
English: O Nanak, greatness is in the Lord's Name. ||8||5||

[Ang 231 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 3 |
English: Gauree, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: trai gun vakhaanai bharam na jaae |
English: Those who speak of the three qualities - their doubts do not depart.

Gurbani: ਬੰਧਨ ਨ ਤੂਟਹਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bandhan na tootteh mukat na paae |
English: Their bonds are not broken, and they do not obtain liberation.

Gurbani: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mukat daataa satigur jug maeh |1|
English: The True Guru is the Bestower of liberation in this age. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh praanee bharam gavaae |
English: Those mortals who become Gurmukh give up their doubts.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj dhun upajai har liv laae |1| rahaau |
English: The celestial music wells up, when they lovingly attune their consciousness to the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਕਾਲੈ ਕੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: trai gun kaalai kee sir kaaraa |
English: Those who are controlled by the three qualities have death hovering over their heads.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਉਪਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: naam na cheteh upaavanahaaraa |
English: They do not remember the Name of the Creator Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mar jameh fir vaaro vaaraa |2|
English: They die, and are reborn, over and over, again and again. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅੰਧੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: andhe guroo te bharam na jaaee |
English: Those whose guru is spiritually blind - their doubts are not dispelled.

Gurbani: ਮੂਲੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: mool chhodd laage doojai bhaaee |
