English: Abandoning the Source of all, they have become attached to the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਬਿਖੁ ਕਾ ਮਾਤਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bikh kaa maataa bikh maeh samaaee |3|
English: Infected with poison, they are immersed in poison. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਮੂਲੁ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਭਰਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa kar mool jantr bharamaae |
English: Believing Maya to be the source of all, they wander in doubt.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: har jeeo visariaa doojai bhaae |
English: They have forgotten the Dear Lord, and they are in love with duality.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jis nadar kare so param gat paae |4|
English: The supreme status is obtained only by those who are blessed with His Glance of Grace. ||4||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਵਰਤਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: antar saach baahar saach varataae |
English: One who has Truth pervading within, radiates Truth outwardly as well.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੁ ਨ ਛਪੈ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਰਖੈ ਛਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: saach na chhapai je ko rakhai chhapaae |
English: The Truth does not remain hidden, even though one may try to hide it.

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: giaanee boojheh sehaj subhaae |5|
English: The spiritually wise know this intuitively. ||5||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh saach rahiaa liv laae |
English: The Gurmukhs keep their consciousness lovingly centered on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: haumai maaeaa sabad jalaae |
English: Ego and Maya are burned away by the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: meraa prabh saachaa mel milaae |6|
English: My True God unites them in His Union. ||6||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: satigur daataa sabad sunaae |
English: The True Guru, The Giver, preaches the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਧਾਵਤੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: dhaavat raakhai tthaak rahaae |
English: He controls, and restrains, and holds still the wandering mind.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਏ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: poore gur te sojhee paae |7|
English: Understanding is obtained through the Perfect Guru. ||7||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਿਰਜਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aape karataa srisatt siraj jin goee |
English: The Creator Himself has created the universe; He Himself shall destroy it.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: tis bin doojaa avar na koee |
English: Without Him, there is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੮॥੬॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh boojhai koee |8|6|
English: O Nanak, how rare are those who, as Gurmukh, understand this! ||8||6||

[Ang 232 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 3 |
English: Gauree, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: naam amolak guramukh paavai |
English: The Gurmukhs obtain the Naam, the Priceless Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੋ ਸੇਵੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: naamo seve naam sehaj samaavai |
English: They serve the Name, and through the Name, they are absorbed in intuitive peace and poise.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: amrit naam rasanaa nit gaavai |
English: With their tongues, they continually sing the Ambrosial Naam.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jis no kripaa kare so har ras paavai |1|
English: They obtain the Lord's Name; the Lord showers His Mercy upon them. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਪਉ ਜਗਦੀਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: anadin hiradai jpau jagadeesaa |
English: Night and day, within your heart, meditate on the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵਉ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਸੂਖਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh paavau param pad sookhaa |1| rahaau |
English: The Gurmukhs obtain the supreme state of peace. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸੂਖੁ ਭਇਆ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: hiradai sookh bheaa paragaas |
English: Peace comes to fill the hearts of those

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh gaaveh sach gunataas |
English: who, as Gurmukh, sing of the True Lord, the treasure of excellence.

Gurbani: ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸ ਨਿਤ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਦਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: daasan daas nit hoveh daas |
English: They become the constant slaves of the slaves of the Lord's slaves.

Gurbani: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਮਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: grih kuttanb meh sadaa udaas |2|
English: Within their households and families, they remain always detached. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੋ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jeevan mukat guramukh ko hoee |
English: How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, become Jivan Mukta - liberated while yet alive.

Gurbani: ਪਰਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: param padaarath paavai soee |
English: They alone obtain the supreme treasure.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮੇਟੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: trai gun mette niramal hoee |
English: Eradicating the three qualities, they become pure.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sahaje saach milai prabh soee |3|
English: They are intuitively absorbed in the True Lord God. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮੋਹ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: moh kuttanb siau preet na hoe |
English: Emotional attachment to family does not exist,

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jaa hiradai vasiaa sach soe |
English: when the True Lord abides within the heart.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh man bedhiaa asathir hoe |
English: The mind of the Gurmukh is pierced through and held steady.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: hukam pachhaanai boojhai sach soe |4|
English: One who recognizes the Hukam of the Lord's Command understands the True Lord. ||4||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: toon karataa mai avar na koe |
English: You are the Creator Lord - there is no other for me.

Gurbani: ਤੁਝੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: tujh sevee tujh te pat hoe |
English: I serve You, and through You, I obtain honor.

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਗਾਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: kirapaa kareh gaavaa prabh soe |
English: God showers His Mercy, and I sing His Praises.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਸਭ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਲੋਇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: naam ratan sabh jag meh loe |5|
English: The light of the jewel of the Naam permeates the entire world. ||5||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਮੀਠੀ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh baanee meetthee laagee |
English: To the Gurmukhs, the Word of God's Bani seems so sweet.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: antar bigasai anadin liv laagee |
English: Deep within, their hearts blossom forth; night and day, they lovingly center themselves on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ॥
Transliteration: sahaje sach miliaa parasaadee |
English: The True Lord is intuitively obtained, by His Grace.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪੂਰੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: satigur paaeaa poorai vaddabhaagee |6|
English: The True Guru is obtained by the destiny of perfect good fortune. ||6||

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੁਖ ਨਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: haumai mamataa duramat dukh naas |
English: Egotism, possessiveness, evil-mindedness and suffering depart,

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: jab hiradai raam naam gunataas |
English: when the Lord's Name, the Ocean of Virtue, comes to dwell within the heart.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh budh pragattee prabh jaas |
English: The intellect of the Gurmukhs is awakened, and they praise God,

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਵਿਆ ਚਰਣ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: jab hiradai raviaa charan nivaas |7|
English: when the Lord's Lotus Feet come to dwell within the heart. ||7||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਇ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jis naam dee soee jan paae |
English: They alone receive the Naam, unto whom it is given.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh mele aap gavaae |
English: The Gurmukhs shed their ego, and merge with the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: hiradai saachaa naam vasaae |
English: The True Name abides within their hearts.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੮॥੭॥
Transliteration: naanak sahaje saach samaae |8|7|
English: O Nanak, they are intuitively absorbed in the True Lord. ||8||7||

[Ang 232 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 3 |
English: Gauree, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ਭੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man hee man savaariaa bhai sehaj subhaae |
English: The mind has intuitively healed itself, through the Fear of God.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗਿਆ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabad man rangiaa liv laae |
English: The mind is attuned to the Word of the Shabad; it is lovingly attuned to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: nij ghar vasiaa prabh kee rajaae |1|
English: It abides within its own home, in harmony with the Lord's Will. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਜਾਇ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: satigur seviai jaae abhimaan |
English: Serving the True Guru, egotistical pride departs,

Gurbani: ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: govid paaeeai gunee nidhaan |1| rahaau |
English: and the Lord of the Universe, the Treasure of Excellence, is obtained. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਜਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਭਉ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man bairaagee jaa sabad bhau khaae |
English: The mind becomes detached and free of desire, when it experiences the Fear of God, through the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਸਭ ਤੈ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: meraa prabh niramalaa sabh tai rahiaa samaae |
English: My Immaculate God is pervading and contained among all.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur kirapaa te milai milaae |2|
English: By Guru's Grace, one is united in His Union. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੋ ਦਾਸੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: har daasan ko daas sukh paae |
English: The slave of the Lord's slave attains peace.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: meraa har prabh in bidh paaeaa jaae |
English: My Lord God is found in this way.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har kirapaa te raam gun gaae |3|
English: By the Grace of the Lord, one comes to sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਬਹੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: dhrig bahu jeevan jit har naam na lagai piaar |
English: Cursed is that long life, during which love for the Lord's Name is not enshrined.

Gurbani: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਮੋਹ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: dhrig sej sukhaalee kaaman moh gubaar |
English: Cursed is that comfortable bed which lures one into the darkness of attachment to sexual desire.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਜਿਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: tin safal janam jin naam adhaar |4|
English: Fruitful is the birth of that person who takes the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||

Gurbani: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: dhrig dhrig grihu kuttanb jit har preet na hoe |
English: Cursed, cursed is that home and family, in which the love of the Lord is not embraced.

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: soee hamaaraa meet jo har gun gaavai soe |
English: He alone is my friend, who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: har naam binaa mai avar na koe |5|
English: Without the Lord's Name, there is no other for me. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur te ham gat pat paaee |
English: From the True Guru, I have obtained salvation and honor.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਦੂਖੁ ਸਗਲ ਮਿਟਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har naam dhiaaeaa dookh sagal mittaaee |
English: I have meditated on the Name of the Lord, and all my sufferings have been erased.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: sadaa anand har naam liv laaee |6|
English: I am in constant bliss, lovingly attuned to the Lord's Name. ||6||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਸਰੀਰ ਸੁਧਿ ਭਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur miliai ham kau sareer sudh bhee |
English: Meeting the Guru, I came to understand my body.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਸਭ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਈ ॥
Transliteration: haumai trisanaa sabh agan bujhee |
English: The fires of ego and desire have been totally quenched.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਸੇ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਖਿਮਾ ਗਹਿ ਲਈ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: binase krodh khimaa geh lee |7|
English: Anger has been dispelled, and I have grasped hold of tolerance. ||7||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: har aape kripaa kare naam devai |
English: The Lord Himself showers His Mercy, and bestows the Naam.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਲੇਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh ratan ko viralaa levai |
English: How rare is that Gurmukh, who receives the jewel of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵੈ ॥੮॥੮॥
Transliteration: naanak gun gaavai har alakh abhevai |8|8|
English: O Nanak, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the Unknowable, the Incomprehensible. ||8||8||

[Ang 233 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: raag gaurree bairaagan mahalaa 3 |
English: Raag Gauree Bairaagan, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਮੁਹ ਫੇਰੇ ਤੇ ਵੇਮੁਖ ਬੁਰੇ ਦਿਸੰਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: satigur te jo muh fere te vemukh bure disan |
English: Those who turn their faces away from the True Guru, are seen to be unfaithful and evil.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਨਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਵੇਲਾ ਨਾ ਲਹੰਨਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: anadin badhe maareean fir velaa naa lahan |1|
English: They shall be bound and beaten night and day; they shall not have this opportunity again. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: har har raakhahu kripaa dhaar |
English: O Lord, please shower Your Mercy upon me, and save me!

Gurbani: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: satasangat melaae prabh har hiradai har gun saar |1| rahaau |
English: O Lord God, please lead me to meet the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, that I may dwell upon the Glorious Praises of the Lord within my heart. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵਦੇ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਾਇ ਚਲੰਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: se bhagat har bhaavade jo guramukh bhaae chalan |
English: Those devotees are pleasing to the Lord, who as Gurmukh, walk in harmony with the Way of the Lord's Will.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਨਿ ਜੀਵਤ ਮੁਏ ਰਹੰਨਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aap chhodd sevaa karan jeevat mue rahan |2|
English: Subduing their selfishness and conceit, and performing selfless service, they remain dead while yet alive. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪਰਾਣ ਹੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: jis daa pindd paraan hai tis kee sir kaar |
English: The body and the breath of life belong to the One - perform the greatest service to Him.

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਰਖੀਐ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ohu kiau manahu visaareeai har rakheeai hiradai dhaar |3|
English: Why forget Him from your mind? Keep the Lord enshrined in your heart. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਮਿ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: naam miliai pat paaeeai naam maniai sukh hoe |
English: Receiving the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one obtains honor; believing in the Naam, one is at peace.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: satigur te naam paaeeai karam milai prabh soe |4|
English: The Naam is obtained from the True Guru; by His Grace, God is found. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਮੁਹੁ ਫੇਰੇ ਓਇ ਭ੍ਰਮਦੇ ਨਾ ਟਿਕੰਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: satigur te jo muhu fere oe bhramade naa ttikan |
English: They turn their faces away from the True Guru; they continue to wander aimlessly.

Gurbani: ਧਰਤਿ ਅਸਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਝਲਈ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਪਏ ਪਚੰਨਿ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: dharat asamaan na jhalee vich visattaa pe pachan |5|
English: They are not accepted by the earth or the sky; they fall into manure, and rot. ||5||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਠਗਉਲੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: eihu jag bharam bhulaaeaa moh tthgaulee paae |
English: This world is deluded by doubt - it has taken the drug of emotional attachment.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਭਿਟੈ ਮਾਇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: jinaa satigur bhettiaa tin nerr na bhittai maae |6|
English: Maya does not draw near those who have met with the True Guru. ||6||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸੋ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sevan so sohane haumai mail gavaae |
English: Those who serve the True Guru are very beautiful; they cast off the filth of selfishness and conceit.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਚਲਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: sabad rate se niramale chaleh satigur bhaae |7|
English: Those who are attuned to the Shabad are immaculate and pure. They walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru. ||7||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਤੂੰ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: har prabh daataa ek toon toon aape bakhas milaae |
English: O Lord God, You are the One and Only Giver; You forgive us, and unite us with Yourself.

Gurbani: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੮॥੧॥੯॥
Transliteration: jan naanak saranaagatee jiau bhaavai tivai chhaddaae |8|1|9|
English: Servant Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary; if it is Your Will, please save him! ||8||1||9||

[Ang 234 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਕਰਹਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: raag gaurree poorabee mahalaa 4 karahale |
English: Raag Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl, Karhalay:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਕਰਹਲੇ ਮਨ ਪਰਦੇਸੀਆ ਕਿਉ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: karahale man paradeseea kiau mileeai har maae |
English: O my wandering mind, you are like a camel - how will you meet the Lord, your Mother?

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਭਾਗਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਗਲਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur bhaag poorai paaeaa gal miliaa piaaraa aae |1|
English: When I found the Guru, by the destiny of perfect good fortune, my Beloved came and embraced me. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: man karahalaa satigur purakh dhiaae |1| rahaau |
English: O camel-like mind, meditate on the True Guru, the Primal Being. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: man karahalaa veechaareea har raam naam dhiaae |
English: O camel-like mind, contemplate the Lord, and meditate on the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਜਿਥੈ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jithai lekhaa mangeeai har aape le chhaddaae |2|
English: When you are called to answer for your account, the Lord Himself shall release you. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: man karahalaa at niramalaa mal laagee haumai aae |
English: O camel-like mind, you were once very pure; the filth of egotism has now attached itself to you.

Gurbani: ਪਰਤਖਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: paratakh pir ghar naal piaaraa vichhurr chottaa khaae |3|
English: Your Beloved Husband is now manifest before you in your own home, but you are separated from Him, and you suffer such pain! ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਭਾਲਿ ਭਾਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man karahalaa mere preetamaa har ridai bhaal bhaalaae |
English: O my beloved camel-like mind, search for the Lord within your own heart.

Gurbani: ਉਪਾਇ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਲਭਈ ਗੁਰੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਖਾਇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: aupaae kitai na labhee gur hiradai har dekhaae |4|
English: He cannot be found by any device; the Guru will show you the Lord within your heart. ||4||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man karahalaa mere preetamaa din rain har liv laae |
English: O my beloved camel-like mind, day and night, lovingly attune yourself to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਘਰੁ ਜਾਇ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਹਲੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਾਇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: ghar jaae paaveh rang mahalee gur mele har melaae |5|
English: Return to your own home, and find the palace of love; meet the Guru, and meet the Lord. ||5||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਤੂੰ ਮੀਤੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਤਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man karahalaa toon meet meraa paakhandd lobh tajaae |
English: O camel-like mind, you are my friend; abandon hypocrisy and greed.

Gurbani: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਲੋਭੀ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: paakhandd lobhee maareeai jam ddandd dee sajaae |6|
English: The hypocritical and the greedy are struck down; the Messenger of Death punishes them with his club. ||6||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਤੂੰ ਮੈਲੁ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man karahalaa mere praan toon mail paakhandd bharam gavaae |
English: O camel-like mind, you are my breath of life; rid yourself of the pollution of hypocrisy and doubt.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰਿਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਮਲੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: har amrit sar gur pooriaa mil sangatee mal leh jaae |7|
English: The Perfect Guru is the Ambrosial Pool of the Lord's Nectar; join the Holy Congregation, and wash away this pollution. ||7||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਇਕ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man karahalaa mere piaariaa ik gur kee sikh sunaae |
English: O my dear beloved camel-like mind, listen only to the Teachings of the Guru.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਇ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: eihu mohu maaeaa pasariaa ant saath na koee jaae |8|
English: This emotional attachment to Maya is so pervasive. Ultimately, nothing shall go along with anyone. ||8||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਜਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਖਰਚੁ ਲੀਆ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man karahalaa mere saajanaa har kharach leea pat paae |
English: O camel-like mind, my good friend, take the supplies of the Lord's Name, and obtain honor.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਨਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਲਇਆ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਇ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: har daragah painaaeaa har aap leaa gal laae |9|
English: In the Court of the Lord, you shall be robed with honor, and the Lord Himself shall embrace you. ||9||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man karahalaa gur maniaa guramukh kaar kamaae |
English: O camel-like mind, one who surrenders to the Guru becomes Gurmukh, and works for the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਕਰਿ ਜੋਦੜੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਾਇ ॥੧੦॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur aagai kar jodarree jan naanak har melaae |10|1|
English: Offer your prayers to the Guru; O servant Nanak, He shall unite you with the Lord. ||10||1||

[Ang 234 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 4 |
English: Gauree, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਆ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਦੇਖੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: man karahalaa veechaareea veechaar dekh samaal |
English: O contemplative camel-like mind, contemplate and look carefully.

Gurbani: ਬਨ ਫਿਰਿ ਥਕੇ ਬਨ ਵਾਸੀਆ ਪਿਰੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ban fir thake ban vaaseea pir guramat ridai nihaal |1|
English: The forest-dwellers have grown weary of wandering in the forests; following the Guru's Teachings, see your Husband Lord within your heart. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: man karahalaa gur govind samaal |1| rahaau |
English: O camel-like mind, dwell upon the Guru and the Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਆ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਫਾਥਿਆ ਮਹਾ ਜਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: man karahalaa veechaareea manamukh faathiaa mahaa jaal |
English: O camel-like contemplative mind, the self-willed manmukhs are caught in the great net.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: guramukh praanee mukat hai har har naam samaal |2|
English: The mortal who becomes Gurmukh is liberated, dwelling upon the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: man karahalaa mere piaariaa satasangat satigur bhaal |
English: O my dear beloved camel-like mind, seek the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਲਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਲੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: satasangat lag har dhiaaeeai har har chalai terai naal |3|
English: Joining the Sat Sangat, meditate on the Lord, and the Lord, Har, Har, shall go along with you. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਏਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: man karahalaa vaddabhaageea har ek nadar nihaal |
English: O very fortunate camel-like mind, with one Glance of Grace from the Lord, you shall be enraptured.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਛਡਾਏ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: aap chhaddaae chhutteeai satigur charan samaal |4|
English: If the Lord Himself saves you, then you shall be saved. Dwell upon the Feet of the True Guru. ||4||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੇਹੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: man karahalaa mere piaariaa vich dehee jot samaal |
English: O my dear beloved camel-like mind, dwell upon the Divine Light within the body.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਖਾਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਦਇਆਲਿ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: gur nau nidh naam vikhaaliaa har daat karee deaal |5|
English: The Guru has shown me the nine treasures of the Naam. The Merciful Lord has bestowed this gift. ||5||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਤੂੰ ਚੰਚਲਾ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਛਡਿ ਵਿਕਰਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: man karahalaa toon chanchalaa chaturaaee chhadd vikaraal |
English: O camel-like mind, you are so fickle; give up your cleverness and corruption.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਤੂੰ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: har har naam samaal toon har mukat kare ant kaal |6|
English: Dwell upon the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; at the very last moment, the Lord shall liberate you. ||6||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ ਤੂੰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: man karahalaa vaddabhaageea toon giaan ratan samaal |
English: O camel-like mind, you are so very fortunate; dwell upon the jewel of spiritual wisdom.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਖੜਗੁ ਹਥਿ ਧਾਰਿਆ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰਿਅੜਾ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: gur giaan kharrag hath dhaariaa jam maariarraa jamakaal |7|
English: You hold in your hands the sword of the Guru's spiritual wisdom; with this destroyer of death, kill the Messenger of Death. ||7||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭਵਹਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: antar nidhaan man karahale bhram bhaveh baahar bhaal |
English: The treasure is deep within, O camel-like mind, but you wander around outside in doubt, searching for it.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਲਧੜਾ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: gur purakh pooraa bhettiaa har sajan ladharraa naal |8|
English: Meeting the Perfect Guru, the Primal Being, you shall discover that the Lord, your Best Friend, is with you. ||8||

Gurbani: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੜੇ ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: rang ratarre man karahale har rang sadaa samaal |
English: You are engrossed in pleasures, O camel-like mind; dwell upon the Lord's lasting love instead!

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: har rang kade na utarai gur sevaa sabad samaal |9|
English: The color of the Lord's Love never fades away; serve the Guru, and dwell upon the Word of the Shabad. ||9||

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਪੰਖੀ ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਤਰਵਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਕਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: ham pankhee man karahale har taravar purakh akaal |
English: We are birds, O camel-like mind; the Lord, the Immortal Primal Being, is the tree.

Gurbani: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੧੦॥੨॥
Transliteration: vaddabhaagee guramukh paaeaa jan naanak naam samaal |10|2|
English: The Gurmukhs are very fortunate - they find it. O servant Nanak, dwell upon the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||10||2||

[Ang 235 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: raag gaurree guaareree mahalaa 5 asattapadeea |
English: Raag Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar sat naam karataa purakh gur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru's Grace:

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਇਹੁ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਰਤ ਗੁਮਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jab ihu man meh karat gumaanaa |
English: When this mind is filled with pride,

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਇਹੁ ਬਾਵਰੁ ਫਿਰਤ ਬਿਗਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: tab ihu baavar firat bigaanaa |
English: then it wanders around like a madman and a lunatic.

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਇਹੁ ਹੂਆ ਸਗਲ ਕੀ ਰੀਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jab ihu hooaa sagal kee reenaa |
English: But when it becomes the dust of all,

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਰਮਈਆ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਚੀਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: taa te rameea ghatt ghatt cheenaa |1|
English: then it recognizes the Lord in each and every heart. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਹਜ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਫਲੁ ਮਸਕੀਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj suhelaa fal masakeenee |
English: The fruit of humility is intuitive peace and pleasure.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਮੋਹਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur apunai mohi daan deenee |1| rahaau |
English: My True Guru has given me this gift. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਇਹੁ ਜਾਨਸਿ ਮੰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: jab kis kau ihu jaanas mandaa |
English: When he believes others to be bad,

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਸਗਲੇ ਇਸੁ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਫੰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: tab sagale is meleh fandaa |
English: then everyone lays traps for him.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰ ਤੇਰ ਜਬ ਇਨਹਿ ਚੁਕਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: mer ter jab ineh chukaaee |
English: But when he stops thinking in terms of 'mine' and 'yours',

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਇਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਹੀ ਬੈਰਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: taa te is sang nahee bairaaee |2|
English: then no one is angry with him. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਇਨਿ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਅਪਨੀ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jab in apunee apanee dhaaree |
English: When he clings to 'my own, my own',

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਇਸ ਕਉ ਹੈ ਮੁਸਕਲੁ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: tab is kau hai musakal bhaaree |
English: then he is in deep trouble.

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਇਨਿ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: jab in karanaihaar pachhaataa |
English: But when he recognizes the Creator Lord,

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਇਸ ਨੋ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਾਤਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tab is no naahee kichh taataa |3|
English: then he is free of torment. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਇਨਿ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਮੋਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: jab in apuno baadhio mohaa |
English: When he entangles himself in emotional attachment,

Gurbani: ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਸਦਾ ਜਮਿ ਜੋਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: aavai jaae sadaa jam johaa |
English: he comes and goes in reincarnation, under the constant gaze of Death.

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਇਸ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਭਰਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: jab is te sabh binase bharamaa |
English: But when all his doubts are removed,

Gurbani: ਭੇਦੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਹੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: bhed naahee hai paarabrahamaa |4|
English: then there is no difference between him and the Supreme Lord God. ||4||

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਇਨਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੇ ਭੇਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: jab in kichh kar maane bhedaa |
English: When he perceives differences,

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਤੇ ਦੂਖ ਡੰਡ ਅਰੁ ਖੇਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: tab te dookh ddandd ar khedaa |
English: then he suffers pain, punishment and sorrow.

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਇਨਿ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੀ ਬੂਝਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jab in eko ekee boojhiaa |
English: But when he recognizes the One and Only Lord,

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਤੇ ਇਸ ਨੋ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝਿਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: tab te is no sabh kichh soojhiaa |5|
English: he understands everything. ||5||

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਇਹੁ ਧਾਵੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਅਰਥੀ ॥
Transliteration: jab ihu dhaavai maaeaa arathee |
English: When he runs around for the sake of Maya and riches,

Gurbani: ਨਹ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵੈ ਨਹ ਤਿਸ ਲਾਥੀ ॥
Transliteration: neh tripataavai neh tis laathee |
English: he is not satisfied, and his desires are not quenched.

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਇਸ ਤੇ ਇਹੁ ਹੋਇਓ ਜਉਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: jab is te ihu hoeo jaulaa |
English: But when he runs away from Maya,

Gurbani: ਪੀਛੈ ਲਾਗਿ ਚਲੀ ਉਠਿ ਕਉਲਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: peechhai laag chalee utth kaulaa |6|
English: then the Goddess of Wealth gets up and follows him. ||6||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa jau satigur milio |
English: When, by His Grace, the True Guru is met,

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਿ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਜਲਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: man mandar meh deepak jalio |
English: the lamp is lit within the temple of the mind.

Gurbani: ਜੀਤ ਹਾਰ ਕੀ ਸੋਝੀ ਕਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jeet haar kee sojhee karee |
English: When he realizes what victory and defeat really are,

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਇਸੁ ਘਰ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਰੀ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: tau is ghar kee keemat paree |7|
English: then he comes to appreciate the true value of his own home. ||7||

Gurbani: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਏਕੈ ॥
Transliteration: karan karaavan sabh kichh ekai |
English: The One Lord is the Creator of all things, the Cause of causes.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਬੁਧਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਬਿਬੇਕੈ ॥
Transliteration: aape budh beechaar bibekai |
English: He Himself is wisdom, contemplation and discerning understanding.

Gurbani: ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਨੇਰੈ ਸਭ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: door na nerai sabh kai sangaa |
English: He is not far away; He is near at hand, with all.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਣੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਾ ॥੮॥੧॥
Transliteration: sach saalaahan naanak har rangaa |8|1|
English: So praise the True One, O Nanak, with love! ||8||1||

[Ang 236 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur sevaa te naame laagaa |
English: Serving the Guru, one is committed to the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: tis kau miliaa jis masatak bhaagaa |
English: It is received only by those who have such good destiny inscribed upon their foreheads.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਵਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: tis kai hiradai raviaa soe |
English: The Lord dwells within their hearts.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: man tan seetal nihachal hoe |1|
English: Their minds and bodies become peaceful and stable. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa keeratan kar man mere |
English: O my mind, sing such Praises of the Lord,

Gurbani: ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਜੋ ਕਾਮਿ ਤੇਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: eehaa aoohaa jo kaam terai |1| rahaau |
English: which shall be of use to you here and hereafter. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਭਉ ਅਪਦਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jaas japat bhau apadaa jaae |
English: Meditating on Him, fear and misfortune depart,

Gurbani: ਧਾਵਤ ਮਨੂਆ ਆਵੈ ਠਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: dhaavat manooaa aavai tthaae |
English: and the wandering mind is held steady.

Gurbani: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: jaas japat fir dookh na laagai |
English: Meditating on Him, suffering shall never again overtake you.

Gurbani: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਇਹ ਹਉਮੈ ਭਾਗੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jaas japat ih haumai bhaagai |2|
English: Meditating on Him, this ego runs away. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਵਸਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਪੰਚਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaas japat vas aaveh panchaa |
English: Meditating on Him, the five passions are overcome.

Gurbani: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਰਿਦੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸੰਚਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaas japat ridai amrit sanchaa |
English: Meditating on Him, Ambrosial Nectar is collected in the heart.

Gurbani: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਇਹ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੁਝੈ ॥
Transliteration: jaas japat ih trisanaa bujhai |
English: Meditating on Him, this desire is quenched.

Gurbani: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਿਝੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jaas japat har daragah sijhai |3|
English: Meditating on Him, one is approved in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਕੋਟਿ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਅਪਰਾਧ ॥
Transliteration: jaas japat kott mitteh aparaadh |
English: Meditating on Him, millions of mistakes are erased.

Gurbani: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਸਾਧ ॥
Transliteration: jaas japat har hoveh saadh |
English: Meditating on Him, one becomes Holy, blessed by the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jaas japat man seetal hovai |
English: Meditating on Him, the mind is cooled and soothed.

Gurbani: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਮਲੁ ਸਗਲੀ ਖੋਵੈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jaas japat mal sagalee khovai |4|
English: Meditating on Him, all filth is washed away. ||4||

Gurbani: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: jaas japat ratan har milai |
English: Meditating on Him, the jewel of the Lord is obtained.

Gurbani: ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਿਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: bahur na chhoddai har sang hilai |
English: One is reconciled with the Lord, and shall not abandon Him again.

Gurbani: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਕਈ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: jaas japat kee baikuntth vaas |
English: Meditating on Him, many acquire a home in the heavens.

Gurbani: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: jaas japat sukh sehaj nivaas |5|
English: Meditating on Him, one abides in intuitive peace. ||5||

Gurbani: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਇਹ ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਪੋਹਤ ॥
Transliteration: jaas japat ih agan na pohat |
English: Meditating on Him, one is not affected by this fire.

Gurbani: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਇਹੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਜੋਹਤ ॥
Transliteration: jaas japat ihu kaal na johat |
English: Meditating on Him, one is not under the gaze of Death.

Gurbani: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮਾਥਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaas japat teraa niramal maathaa |
English: Meditating on Him, your forehead shall be immaculate.

Gurbani: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਸਗਲਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਥਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: jaas japat sagalaa dukh laathaa |6|
English: Meditating on Him, all pains are destroyed. ||6||

Gurbani: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਮੁਸਕਲੁ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਬਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: jaas japat musakal kachhoo na banai |
English: Meditating on Him, no difficulties are encountered.

Gurbani: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਸੁਣਿ ਅਨਹਤ ਧੁਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: jaas japat sun anahat dhunai |
English: Meditating on Him, one hears the unstruck melody.

Gurbani: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਇਹ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jaas japat ih niramal soe |
English: Meditating on Him, one acquires this pure reputation.

Gurbani: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਕਮਲੁ ਸੀਧਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: jaas japat kamal seedhaa hoe |7|
English: Meditating on Him, the heart-lotus is turned upright. ||7||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਸੁਭ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur subh drisatt sabh aoopar karee |
English: The Guru has bestowed His Glance of Grace upon all,

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦੇ ਹਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jis kai hiradai mantru de haree |
English: within whose hearts the Lord has implanted His Mantra.

Gurbani: ਅਖੰਡ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਚੂਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: akhandd keeratan tin bhojan chooraa |
English: The unbroken Kirtan of the Lord's Praises is their food and nourishment.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥੮॥੨॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak jis satigur pooraa |8|2|
English: Says Nanak, they have the Perfect True Guru. ||8||2||

[Ang 236 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa sabad rid antar dhaarai |
English: Those who implant the Word of the Guru's Shabad within their hearts

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਜਨਾ ਸਿਉ ਸੰਗੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: panch janaa siau sang nivaarai |
English: cut their connections with the five passions.

Gurbani: ਦਸ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਵਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: das indree kar raakhai vaas |
English: They keep the ten organs under their control;

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਆਤਮੈ ਹੋਇ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: taa kai aatamai hoe paragaas |1|
English: their souls are enlightened. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸੀ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਤਾ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aisee drirrataa taa kai hoe |
English: They alone acquire such stability,

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦਇਆ ਮਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kau deaa meaa prabh soe |1| rahaau |
English: whom God blesses with His Mercy and Grace. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਜਨੁ ਦੁਸਟੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: saajan dusatt jaa kai ek samaanai |
English: Friend and foe are one and the same to them.

Gurbani: ਜੇਤਾ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਤੇਤਾ ਗਿਆਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: jetaa bolan tetaa giaanai |
English: Whatever they speak is wisdom.

Gurbani: ਜੇਤਾ ਸੁਨਣਾ ਤੇਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: jetaa sunanaa tetaa naam |
English: Whatever they hear is the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜੇਤਾ ਪੇਖਨੁ ਤੇਤਾ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jetaa pekhan tetaa dhiaan |2|
English: Whatever they see is meditation. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਜਾਗਣੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sahaje jaagan sahaje soe |
English: They awaken in peace and poise; they sleep in peace and poise.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੋਤਾ ਜਾਇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sahaje hotaa jaae su hoe |
English: That which is meant to be, automatically happens.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਹਸਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj bairaag sahaje hee hasanaa |
English: In peace and poise, they remain detached; in peace and poise, they laugh.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਚੂਪ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਜਪਨਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sahaje choop sahaje hee japanaa |3|
English: In peace and poise, they remain silent; in peace and poise, they chant. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਭਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sahaje bhojan sahaje bhaau |
English: In peace and poise they eat; in peace and poise they love.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਮਿਟਿਓ ਸਗਲ ਦੁਰਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sahaje mittio sagal duraau |
English: The illusion of duality is easily and totally removed.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੋਆ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: sahaje hoaa saadhoo sang |
English: They naturally join the Saadh Sangat, the Society of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਿਸੰਗੁ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: sehaj milio paarabraham nisang |4|
English: In peace and poise, they meet and merge with the Supreme Lord God. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਉਦਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: sahaje grih meh sehaj udaasee |
English: They are at peace in their homes, and they are at peace while detached.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਤਨ ਕੀ ਨਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: sahaje dubidhaa tan kee naasee |
English: In peace, their bodies' duality is eliminated.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਇਆ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai sehaj man bheaa anand |
English: Bliss comes naturally to their minds.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦੁ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: taa kau bhettiaa paramaanand |5|
English: They meet the Lord, the Embodiment of Supreme Bliss. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਓ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: sahaje amrit peeo naam |
English: In peaceful poise, they drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਕੀਨੋ ਜੀਅ ਕੋ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: sahaje keeno jeea ko daan |
English: In peace and poise, they give to the poor.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜ ਕਥਾ ਮਹਿ ਆਤਮੁ ਰਸਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj kathaa meh aatam rasiaa |
English: Their souls naturally delight in the Lord's Sermon.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਵਸਿਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: taa kai sang abinaasee vasiaa |6|
English: The Imperishable Lord abides with them. ||6||

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਆਸਣੁ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sahaje aasan asathir bhaaeaa |
English: In peace and poise, they assume the unchanging position.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਅਨਹਤ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sahaje anahat sabad vajaaeaa |
English: In peace and poise, the unstruck vibration of the Shabad resounds.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਰੁਣ ਝੁਣਕਾਰੁ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sahaje run jhunakaar suhaaeaa |
English: In peace and poise, the celestial bells resound.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: taa kai ghar paarabraham samaaeaa |7|
English: Within their homes, the Supreme Lord God is pervading. ||7||

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਪਰਿਓ ਕਰਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: sahaje jaa kau pario karamaa |
English: With intuitive ease, they meet the Lord, according to their karma.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਸਚੁ ਧਰਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: sahaje gur bhettio sach dharamaa |
English: With intuitive ease, they meet with the Guru, in the true Dharma.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਹਜੁ ਭਇਆ ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai sehaj bheaa so jaanai |
English: Those who know, attain the poise of intuitive peace.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੈ ॥੮॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak daas taa kai kurabaanai |8|3|
English: Slave Nanak is a sacrifice to them. ||8||3||

[Ang 237 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਥਮੇ ਗਰਭ ਵਾਸ ਤੇ ਟਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: prathame garabh vaas te ttariaa |
English: First, they come forth from the womb.

Gurbani: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸੰਗਿ ਜੁਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: putr kalatr kuttanb sang juriaa |
English: They become attached to their children, spouses and families.

Gurbani: ਭੋਜਨੁ ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਬਹੁ ਕਪਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: bhojan anik prakaar bahu kapare |
English: The foods of various sorts and appearances,

Gurbani: ਸਰਪਰ ਗਵਨੁ ਕਰਹਿਗੇ ਬਪੁਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sarapar gavan karahige bapure |1|
English: will surely pass away, O wretched mortal! ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਵਨੁ ਅਸਥਾਨੁ ਜੋ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਟਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: kavan asathaan jo kabahu na ttarai |
English: What is that place which never perishes?

Gurbani: ਕਵਨੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kavan sabad jit duramat harai |1| rahaau |
English: What is that Word by which the dirt of the mind is removed? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਪੁਰੀ ਮਹਿ ਸਰਪਰ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: eindr puree meh sarapar maranaa |
English: In the Realm of Indra, death is sure and certain.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੁਰੀ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਰਹਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: braham puree nihachal nahee rahanaa |
English: The Realm of Brahma shall not remain permanent.

Gurbani: ਸਿਵ ਪੁਰੀ ਕਾ ਹੋਇਗਾ ਕਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: siv puree kaa hoeigaa kaalaa |
English: The Realm of Shiva shall also perish.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਬਿਤਾਲਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: trai gun maaeaa binas bitaalaa |2|
English: The three dispositions, Maya and the demons shall vanish. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗਿਰਿ ਤਰ ਧਰਣਿ ਗਗਨ ਅਰੁ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gir tar dharan gagan ar taare |
English: The mountains, the trees, the earth, the sky and the stars;

Gurbani: ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਪਵਣੁ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਨੀਰਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: rav sas pavan paavak neeraare |
English: the sun, the moon, the wind, water and fire;

Gurbani: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਬਰਤ ਅਰੁ ਭੇਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: dinas rain barat ar bhedaa |
English: day and night, fasting days and their determination;

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਤ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਬਿਨਸਹਿਗੇ ਬੇਦਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: saasat sinmrit binasahige bedaa |3|
English: the Shaastras, the Simritees and the Vedas shall pass away. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤੀਰਥ ਦੇਵ ਦੇਹੁਰਾ ਪੋਥੀ ॥
Transliteration: teerath dev dehuraa pothee |
English: The sacred shrines of pilgrimage, gods, temples and holy books;

Gurbani: ਮਾਲਾ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਸੋਚ ਪਾਕ ਹੋਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: maalaa tilak soch paak hotee |
English: rosaries, ceremonial tilak marks on the forehead, meditative people, the pure, and the performers of burnt offerings;

Gurbani: ਧੋਤੀ ਡੰਡਉਤਿ ਪਰਸਾਦਨ ਭੋਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: dhotee ddanddaut parasaadan bhogaa |
English: wearing loin cloths, bowing in reverence and the enjoyment of sacred foods

Gurbani: ਗਵਨੁ ਕਰੈਗੋ ਸਗਲੋ ਲੋਗਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: gavan karaigo sagalo logaa |4|
English: - all these, and all people, shall pass away. ||4||

Gurbani: ਜਾਤਿ ਵਰਨ ਤੁਰਕ ਅਰੁ ਹਿੰਦੂ ॥
Transliteration: jaat varan turak ar hindoo |
English: Social classes, races, Muslims and Hindus;

Gurbani: ਪਸੁ ਪੰਖੀ ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਜਿੰਦੂ ॥
Transliteration: pas pankhee anik jon jindoo |
English: beasts, birds and the many varieties of beings and creatures;

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਪਾਸਾਰੁ ਦੀਸੈ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sagal paasaar deesai paasaaraa |
English: the entire world and the visible universe

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇਗੋ ਸਗਲ ਆਕਾਰਾ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: binas jaaeigo sagal aakaaraa |5|
English: - all forms of existence shall pass away. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸਹਜ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj sifat bhagat tat giaanaa |
English: Through the Praises of the Lord, devotional worship, spiritual wisdom and the essence of reality,

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਚੁ ਥਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa anand nihachal sach thaanaa |
English: eternal bliss and the imperishable true place are obtained.

Gurbani: ਤਹਾ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਗੁਣ ਰਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: tahaa sangat saadh gun rasai |
English: There, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Lord's Glorious Praises are sung with love.

Gurbani: ਅਨਭਉ ਨਗਰੁ ਤਹਾ ਸਦ ਵਸੈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: anbhau nagar tahaa sad vasai |6|
English: There, in the city of fearlessness, He dwells forever. ||6||

Gurbani: ਤਹ ਭਉ ਭਰਮਾ ਸੋਗੁ ਨ ਚਿੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: teh bhau bharamaa sog na chintaa |
English: There is no fear, doubt, suffering or anxiety there;

Gurbani: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਵਣੁ ਮਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਹੋਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: aavan jaavan mirat na hotaa |
English: there is no coming or going, and no death there.

Gurbani: ਤਹ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਅਨਹਤ ਆਖਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: teh sadaa anand anahat aakhaare |
English: There is eternal bliss, and the unstruck celestial music there.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤ ਵਸਹਿ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਆਧਾਰੇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: bhagat vaseh keeratan aadhaare |7|
English: The devotees dwell there, with the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises as their support. ||7||

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham kaa ant na paar |
English: There is no end or limitation to the Supreme Lord God.

Gurbani: ਕਉਣੁ ਕਰੈ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: kaun karai taa kaa beechaar |
English: Who can embrace His contemplation?

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak jis kirapaa karai |
English: Says Nanak, when the Lord showers His Mercy,

Gurbani: ਨਿਹਚਲ ਥਾਨੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਤਰੈ ॥੮॥੪॥
Transliteration: nihachal thaan saadhasang tarai |8|4|
English: the imperishable home is obtained; in the Saadh Sangat, you shall be saved. ||8||4||

[Ang 237 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਸੂਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo is maare soee sooraa |
English: One who kills this is a spiritual hero.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo is maare soee pooraa |
English: One who kills this is perfect.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: jo is maare tiseh vaddiaaee |
English: One who kills this obtains glorious greatness.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jo is maare tis kaa dukh jaaee |1|
English: One who kills this is freed of suffering. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਕੋਇ ਜਿ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਗਵਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa koe ji dubidhaa maar gavaavai |
English: How rare is such a person, who kills and casts off duality.

Gurbani: ਇਸਹਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਰਾਜ ਜੋਗੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: eiseh maar raaj jog kamaavai |1| rahaau |
English: Killing it, he attains Raja Yoga, the Yoga of meditation and success. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਭਉ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jo is maare tis kau bhau naeh |
English: One who kills this has no fear.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jo is maare su naam samaeh |
English: One who kills this is absorbed in the Naam.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੁਝੈ ॥
Transliteration: jo is maare tis kee trisanaa bujhai |
English: One who kills this has his desires quenched.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਿਝੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jo is maare su daragah sijhai |2|
English: One who kills this is approved in the Court of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੋ ਧਨਵੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo is maare so dhanavantaa |
English: One who kills this is wealthy and prosperous.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਤਿਵੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo is maare so pativantaa |
English: One who kills this is honorable.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਜਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: jo is maare soee jatee |
English: One who kills this is truly a celibate.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਗਤੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jo is maare tis hovai gatee |3|
English: One who kills this attains salvation. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਆਇਆ ਗਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: jo is maare tis kaa aaeaa ganee |
English: One who kills this - his coming is auspicious.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਧਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: jo is maare su nihachal dhanee |
English: One who kills this is steady and wealthy.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੋ ਵਡਭਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo is maare so vaddabhaagaa |
English: One who kills this is very fortunate.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jo is maare su anadin jaagaa |4|
English: One who kills this remains awake and aware, night and day. ||4||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੁ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo is maare su jeevan mukataa |
English: One who kills this is Jivan Mukta, liberated while yet alive.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo is maare tis kee niramal jugataa |
English: One who kills this lives a pure lifestyle.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: jo is maare soee sugiaanee |
English: One who kills this is spiritually wise.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੁ ਸਹਜ ਧਿਆਨੀ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: jo is maare su sehaj dhiaanee |5|
English: One who kills this meditates intuitively. ||5||

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: eis maaree bin thaae na parai |
English: Without killing this, one is not acceptable,

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਕਰਮ ਜਾਪ ਤਪ ਕਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: kott karam jaap tap karai |
English: Even though one may perform millions of rituals, chants and austerities.

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਮਿਟੈ ॥
Transliteration: eis maaree bin janam na mittai |
English: Without killing this, one does not escape the cycle of reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਨਹੀ ਛੁਟੈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: eis maaree bin jam te nahee chhuttai |6|
English: Without killing this, one does not escape death. ||6||

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: eis maaree bin giaan na hoee |
English: Without killing this, one does not obtain spiritual wisdom.

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਧੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: eis maaree bin jootth na dhoee |
English: Without killing this, one's impurity is not washed off.

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੈਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: eis maaree bin sabh kichh mailaa |
English: Without killing this, everything is filthy.

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਮਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਉਲਾ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: eis maaree bin sabh kichh jaulaa |7|
English: Without killing this, everything is a losing game. ||7||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kau bhe kripaal kripaa nidh |
English: When the Lord, the Treasure of Mercy, bestows His Mercy,

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਭਈ ਖਲਾਸੀ ਹੋਈ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਧਿ ॥
Transliteration: tis bhee khalaasee hoee sagal sidh |
English: one obtains release, and attains total perfection.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਹੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur dubidhaa jaa kee hai maaree |
English: One whose duality has been killed by the Guru,

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੮॥੫॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak so braham beechaaree |8|5|
English: says Nanak, contemplates God. ||8||5||

[Ang 238 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਰੈ ਤ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: har siau jurai ta sabh ko meet |
English: When someone attaches himself to the Lord, then everyone is his friend.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਰੈ ਤ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਚੀਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: har siau jurai ta nihachal cheet |
English: When someone attaches himself to the Lord, then his consciousness is steady.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਰੈ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਕਾੜੑਾ ॥
Transliteration: har siau jurai na viaapai kaarraa |
English: When someone attaches himself to the Lord, he is not afflicted by worries.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਰੈ ਤ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har siau jurai ta hoe nisataaraa |1|
English: When someone attaches himself to the Lord, he is emancipated. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੂੰ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: re man mere toon har siau jor |
English: O my mind, unite yourself with the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਾਜਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਹੋਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kaaj tuhaarai naahee hor |1| rahaau |
English: Nothing else is of any use to you. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਵਡੇ ਵਡੇ ਜੋ ਦੁਨੀਆਦਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: vadde vadde jo duneeaadaar |
English: The great and powerful people of the world

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੂ ਕਾਜਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਗਾਵਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: kaahoo kaaj naahee gaavaar |
English: are of no use, you fool!

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਨੀਚ ਕੁਲੁ ਸੁਣਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa daas neech kul suneh |
English: The Lord's slave may be born of humble origins,

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਉਧਰਹਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tis kai sang khin meh udhareh |2|
English: but in his company, you shall be saved in an instant. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਜਨ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਨਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: kott majan jaa kai sun naam |
English: Hearing the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is equal to millions of cleansing baths.

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹੈ ਧਿਆਨ ॥
Transliteration: kott poojaa jaa kai hai dhiaan |
English: Meditating on it is equal to millions of worship ceremonies.

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਪੁੰਨ ਸੁਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: kott pun sun har kee baanee |
English: Hearing the Word of the Lord's Bani is equal to giving millions in alms.

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਫਲਾ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kott falaa gur te bidh jaanee |3|
English: To know the way, through the Guru, is equal to millions of rewards. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਮਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਚੇਤ ॥
Transliteration: man apune meh fir fir chet |
English: Within your mind, over and over again, think of Him,

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਹੇਤ ॥
Transliteration: binas jaeh maaeaa ke het |
English: and your love of Maya shall depart.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਤੁਮਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: har abinaasee tumarai sang |
English: The Imperishable Lord is always with you.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਚੁ ਰਾਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: man mere rach raam kai rang |4|
English: O my mind, immerse yourself in the Love of the Lord. ||4||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਉਤਰੈ ਸਭ ਭੂਖ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai kaam utarai sabh bhookh |
English: Working for Him, all hunger departs.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਜੋਹਹਿ ਦੂਤ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai kaam na joheh doot |
English: Working for Him, the Messenger of Death will not be watching you.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਵਡ ਗਮਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai kaam teraa vadd gamar |
English: Working for Him, you shall obtain glorious greatness.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਅਮਰੁ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: jaa kai kaam hoveh toon amar |5|
English: Working for Him, you shall become immortal. ||5||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਚਾਕਰ ਕਉ ਨਹੀ ਡਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: jaa ke chaakar kau nahee ddaan |
English: His servant does not suffer punishment.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਚਾਕਰ ਕਉ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: jaa ke chaakar kau nahee baan |
English: His servant suffers no loss.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਦਫਤਰਿ ਪੁਛੈ ਨ ਲੇਖਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai dafatar puchhai na lekhaa |
English: In His Court, His servant does not have to answer for his account.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਕਰਹੁ ਬਿਸੇਖਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: taa kee chaakaree karahu bisekhaa |6|
English: So serve Him with distinction. ||6||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਊਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਾਹੂ ਬਾਤ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai aoon naahee kaahoo baat |
English: He is not lacking in anything.

Gurbani: ਏਕਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਅਨੇਕਹਿ ਭਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: ekeh aap anekeh bhaat |
English: He Himself is One, although He appears in so many forms.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kee drisatt hoe sadaa nihaal |
English: By His Glance of Grace, you shall be happy forever.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਘਾਲ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: man mere kar taa kee ghaal |7|
English: So work for Him, O my mind. ||7||

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਮੂੜਾ ॥
Transliteration: naa ko chatur naahee ko moorraa |
English: No one is clever, and no one is foolish.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੀਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਸੂਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: naa ko heen naahee ko sooraa |
English: No one is weak, and no one is a hero.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: jit ko laaeaa tith hee laagaa |
English: As the Lord attaches someone, so is he attached.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੮॥੬॥
Transliteration: so sevak naanak jis bhaagaa |8|6|
English: He alone is the Lord's servant, O Nanak, who is so blessed. ||8||6||

[Ang 239 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਜੈਸੇ ਸਰਪ ਆਰਜਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: bin simaran jaise sarap aarajaaree |
English: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one's life is like that of a snake.

Gurbani: ਤਿਉ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਸਾਕਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tiau jeeveh saakat naam bisaaree |1|
English: This is how the faithless cynic lives, forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਜੋ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਮਹਿ ਜੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: ek nimakh jo simaran meh jeea |
English: One who lives in meditative remembrance, even for an instant,

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਦਿਨਸ ਲਾਖ ਸਦਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਥੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kott dinas laakh sadaa thir theea |1| rahaau |
English: lives for hundreds of thousands and millions of days, and becomes stable forever. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: bin simaran dhrig karam karaas |
English: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one's actions and works are cursed.

Gurbani: ਕਾਗ ਬਤਨ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਹਿ ਵਾਸ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kaag batan bisattaa meh vaas |2|
English: Like the crow's beak, he dwells in manure. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਭਏ ਕੂਕਰ ਕਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: bin simaran bhe kookar kaam |
English: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one acts like a dog.

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤ ਬੇਸੁਆ ਪੂਤ ਨਿਨਾਮ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: saakat besuaa poot ninaam |3|
English: The faithless cynic is nameless, like the prostitute's son. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਜੈਸੇ ਸੀਙ ਛਤਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: bin simaran jaise seeng chhataaraa |
English: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one is like a horned ram.

Gurbani: ਬੋਲਹਿ ਕੂਰੁ ਸਾਕਤ ਮੁਖੁ ਕਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: boleh koor saakat mukh kaaraa |4|
English: The faithless cynic barks out his lies, and his face is blackened. ||4||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਗਰਧਭ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: bin simaran garadhabh kee niaaee |
English: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one is like a donkey.

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤ ਥਾਨ ਭਰਿਸਟ ਫਿਰਾਹੀ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: saakat thaan bharisatt firaahee |5|
English: The faithless cynic wanders around in polluted places. ||5||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਕੂਕਰ ਹਰਕਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bin simaran kookar harakaaeaa |
English: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one is like a mad dog.

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤ ਲੋਭੀ ਬੰਧੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: saakat lobhee bandh na paaeaa |6|
English: The greedy, faithless cynic falls into entanglements. ||6||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਹੈ ਆਤਮ ਘਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: bin simaran hai aatam ghaatee |
English: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, he murders his own soul.

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤ ਨੀਚ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੁਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤੀ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: saakat neech tis kul nahee jaatee |7|
English: The faithless cynic is wretched, without family or social standing. ||7||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਇਆ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jis bheaa kripaal tis satasang milaaeaa |
English: When the Lord becomes merciful, one joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥੮॥੭॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak gur jagat taraaeaa |8|7|
English: Says Nanak, the Guru has saved the world. ||8||7||

[Ang 239 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai bachan mohi param gat paaee |
English: Through the Guru's Word, I have attained the supreme status.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur poorai meree paij rakhaaee |1|
English: The Perfect Guru has preserved my honor. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai bachan dhiaaeo mohi naau |
English: Through the Guru's Word, I meditate on the Name.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaad mohi miliaa thaau |1| rahaau |
English: By Guru's Grace, I have obtained a place of rest. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਰਸਨ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai bachan sun rasan vakhaanee |
English: I listen to the Guru's Word, and chant it with my tongue.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਮੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur kirapaa te amrit meree baanee |2|
English: By Guru's Grace, my speech is like nectar. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਆਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai bachan mittiaa meraa aap |
English: Through the Guru's Word, my selfishness and conceit have been removed.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਦਇਆ ਤੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਵਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur kee deaa te meraa vadd parataap |3|
English: Through the Guru's kindness, I have obtained glorious greatness. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਭਰਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai bachan mittiaa meraa bharam |
English: Through the Guru's Word, my doubts have been removed.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਸਭੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: gur kai bachan pekhio sabh braham |4|
English: Through the Guru's Word, I see God everywhere. ||4||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਕੀਨੋ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai bachan keeno raaj jog |
English: Through the Guru's Word, I practice Raja Yoga, the Yoga of meditation and success.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਰਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਗੁ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: gur kai sang tariaa sabh log |5|
English: In the Company of the Guru, all the people of the world are saved. ||5||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਿਧਿ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai bachan mere kaaraj sidh |
English: Through the Guru's Word, my affairs are resolved.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਉ ਨਿਧਿ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: gur kai bachan paaeaa naau nidh |6|
English: Through the Guru's Word, I have obtained the nine treasures. ||6||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: jin jin keenee mere gur kee aasaa |
English: Whoever places his hopes in my Guru,

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕਟੀਐ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਾ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: tis kee katteeai jam kee faasaa |7|
English: has the noose of death cut away. ||7||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਜਾਗਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai bachan jaagiaa meraa karam |
English: Through the Guru's Word, my good karma has been awakened.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ॥੮॥੮॥
Transliteration: naanak gur bhettiaa paarabraham |8|8|
English: O Nanak, meeting with the Guru, I have found the Supreme Lord God. ||8||8||

[Ang 239 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਉ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: tis gur kau simrau saas saas |
English: I remember the Guru with each and every breath.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur mere praan satigur meree raas |1| rahaau |
English: The Guru is my breath of life, the True Guru is my wealth. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਜੀਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa darasan dekh dekh jeevaa |
English: Beholding the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan, I live.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਧੋਇ ਧੋਇ ਪੀਵਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur ke charan dhoe dhoe peevaa |1|
English: I wash the Guru's Feet, and drink in this water. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਨਿਤ ਮਜਨੁ ਕਰਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur kee ren nit majan krau |
English: I take my daily bath in the dust of the Guru's Feet.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਹਰਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: janam janam kee haumai mal hrau |2|
English: The egotistical filth of countless incarnations is washed off. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਝੂਲਾਵਉ ਪਾਖਾ ॥
Transliteration: tis gur kau jhoolaavau paakhaa |
English: I wave the fan over the Guru.

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਤੇ ਹਾਥੁ ਦੇ ਰਾਖਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: mahaa agan te haath de raakhaa |3|
English: Giving me His Hand, He has saved me from the great fire. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਢੋਵਉ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: tis gur kai grihi dtovau paanee |
English: I carry water for the Guru's household;

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਅਕਲ ਗਤਿ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jis gur te akal gat jaanee |4|
English: from the Guru, I have learned the Way of the One Lord. ||4||

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਪੀਸਉ ਨੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: tis gur kai grihi peesau neet |
English: I grind the corn for the Guru's household.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਵੈਰੀ ਸਭ ਮੀਤ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: jis parasaad vairee sabh meet |5|
English: By His Grace, all my enemies have become friends. ||5||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੀਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: jin gur mo kau deenaa jeeo |
English: The Guru who gave me my soul,

Gurbani: ਆਪੁਨਾ ਦਾਸਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਮੁਲਿ ਲੀਉ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: aapunaa daasaraa aape mul leeo |6|
English: has Himself purchased me, and made me His slave. ||6||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਲਾਇਓ ਅਪਨਾ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape laaeo apanaa piaar |
English: He Himself has blessed me with His Love.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਕਰੀ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa tis gur kau karee namasakaar |7|
English: Forever and ever, I humbly bow to the Guru. ||7||

Gurbani: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਭੈ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਦੁਖ ਲਾਥਾ ॥
Transliteration: kal kales bhai bhram dukh laathaa |
English: My troubles, conflicts, fears, doubts and pains have been dispelled;

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਮਰਾਥਾ ॥੮॥੯॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak meraa gur samaraathaa |8|9|
English: says Nanak, my Guru is All-powerful. ||8||9||

[Ang 240 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਿਲੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਅਪਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: mil mere gobind apanaa naam dehu |
English: Meet me, O my Lord of the Universe. Please bless me with Your Name.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਅਸਨੇਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: naam binaa dhrig dhrig asanehu |1| rahaau |
English: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, cursed, cursed is love and intimacy. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਜੋ ਪਹਿਰੈ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: naam binaa jo pahirai khaae |
English: Without the Naam, one who dresses and eats well

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਕੂਕਰੁ ਜੂਠਨ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jiau kookar jootthan meh paae |1|
English: is like a dog, who falls in and eats impure foods. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਜੇਤਾ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: naam binaa jetaa biauhaar |
English: Without the Naam, all occupations are useless,

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਮਿਰਤਕ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jiau miratak mithiaa seegaar |2|
English: Like decorations on a dead body. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: naam bisaar kare ras bhog |
English: One who forgets the Naam and indulges in pleasures,

Gurbani: ਸੁਖੁ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਨਹੀ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਰੋਗ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sukh supanai nahee tan meh rog |3|
English: shall find no peace, even in dreams; his body shall become diseased. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਕਰੇ ਅਨ ਕਾਜ ॥
Transliteration: naam tiaag kare an kaaj |
English: One who renounces the Naam and engages in other occupations,

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਝੂਠੇ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਜ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: binas jaae jhootthe sabh paaj |4|
English: shall see all of his false pretenses fall away. ||4||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: naam sang man preet na laavai |
English: One whose mind does not embrace love for the Naam

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਤੋ ਨਰਕਿ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: kott karam karato narak jaavai |5|
English: shall go to hell, even though he may perform millions of ceremonial rituals. ||5||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਮਨਿ ਨ ਆਰਾਧਾ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam jin man na aaraadhaa |
English: One whose mind does not contemplate the Name of the Lord

Gurbani: ਚੋਰ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਾਧਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: chor kee niaaee jam pur baadhaa |6|
English: is bound like a thief, in the City of Death. ||6||

Gurbani: ਲਾਖ ਅਡੰਬਰ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਿਸਥਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: laakh addanbar bahut bisathaaraa |
English: Hundreds of thousands of ostentatious shows and great expanses

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਝੂਠੇ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: naam binaa jhootthe paasaaraa |7|
English: - without the Naam, all these displays are false. ||7||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਲੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam soee jan lee |
English: That humble being repeats the Name of the Lord,

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਇ ॥੮॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa naanak jis dee |8|10|
English: O Nanak, whom the Lord blesses with His Mercy. ||8||10||

[Ang 240 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਜੋ ਅੰਤਿ ਨਿਬਾਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: aad madh jo ant nibaahai |
English: My mind longs for that Friend,

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਚਾਹੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: so saajan meraa man chaahai |1|
English: Who shall stand by me in the beginning, in the middle and in the end. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਚਾਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: har kee preet sadaa sang chaalai |
English: The Lord's Love goes with us forever.

Gurbani: ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: deaal purakh pooran pratipaalai |1| rahaau |
English: The Perfect and Merciful Lord cherishes all. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਸਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: binasat naahee chhodd na jaae |
English: He shall never perish, and He shall never abandon me.

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਪੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jeh pekhaa teh rahiaa samaae |2|
English: Wherever I look, there I see Him pervading and permeating. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਜੀਅ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: sundar sugharr chatur jeea daataa |
English: He is Beautiful, All-knowing, the most Clever, the Giver of life.

Gurbani: ਭਾਈ ਪੂਤੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਾਤਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bhaaee poot pitaa prabh maataa |3|
English: God is my Brother, Son, Father and Mother. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰ ਮੇਰੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: jeevan praan adhaar meree raas |
English: He is the Support of the breath of life; He is my Wealth.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਈ ਕਰਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਵਾਸਿ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: preet laaee kar ridai nivaas |4|
English: Abiding within my heart, He inspires me to enshrine love for Him. ||4||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਸਿਲਕ ਕਾਟੀ ਗੋਪਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa silak kaattee gopaal |
English: The Lord of the World has cut away the noose of Maya.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਲੀਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: kar apunaa leeno nadar nihaal |5|
English: He has made me His own, blessing me with His Glance of Grace. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਕਾਟੇ ਸਭਿ ਰੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: simar simar kaatte sabh rog |
English: Remembering, remembering Him in meditation, all diseases are healed.

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਭੋਗ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: charan dhiaan sarab sukh bhog |6|
English: Meditating on His Feet, all comforts are enjoyed. ||6||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਵਤਨੁ ਨਿਤ ਬਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: pooran purakh navatan nit baalaa |
English: The Perfect Primal Lord is Ever-fresh and Ever-young.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: har antar baahar sang rakhavaalaa |7|
English: The Lord is with me, inwardly and outwardly, as my Protector. ||7||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਦੁ ਚੀਨ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak har har pad cheen |
English: Says Nanak, that devotee who realizes the state of the Lord, Har, Har,

Gurbani: ਸਰਬਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਗਤ ਕਉ ਦੀਨ ॥੮॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: sarabas naam bhagat kau deen |8|11|
English: is blessed with the treasure of the Naam. ||8||11||

[Ang 240 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raag gaurree maajh mahalaa 5 |
English: Raag Gauree Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਖੋਜਤ ਫਿਰੇ ਅਸੰਖ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: khojat fire asankh ant na paareea |
English: Countless are those who wander around searching for You, but they do not find Your limits.

Gurbani: ਸੇਈ ਹੋਏ ਭਗਤ ਜਿਨਾ ਕਿਰਪਾਰੀਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: seee hoe bhagat jinaa kirapaareea |1|
English: They alone are Your devotees, who are blessed by Your Grace. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਵਾਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hau vaareea har vaareea |1| rahaau |
English: I am a sacrifice, I am a sacrifice to You. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਡਰਾਉ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਭੈਹਾਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: sun sun panth ddaraau bahut bhaihaareea |
English: Continually hearing of the terrifying path, I am so afraid.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਤਕੀ ਓਟ ਸੰਤਾਹ ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੀਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mai takee ott santaah lehu ubaareea |2|
English: I have sought the Protection of the Saints; please, save me! ||2||

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਨ ਲਾਲ ਅਨੂਪ ਸਰਬ ਸਾਧਾਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: mohan laal anoop sarab saadhaareea |
English: The Fascinating and Beauteous Beloved is the Giver of support to all.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਿਖਾਰੀਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur niv niv laagau paae dehu dikhaareea |3|
English: I bow low and fall at the Feet of the Guru; if only I could see the Lord! ||3||

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਕੀਏ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਅਨੇਕ ਇਕਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: mai kee mitr anek ikas balihaareea |
English: I have made many friends, but I am a sacrifice to the One alone.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਗੁਣ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਨਾਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰ ਭੰਡਾਰੀਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: sabh gun kis hee naeh har poor bhanddaareea |4|
English: No one has all virtues; the Lord alone is filled to overflowing with them. ||4||

Gurbani: ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਨਾਉ ਸੂਖਿ ਸਵਾਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: chahu dis japeeai naau sookh savaareea |
English: His Name is chanted in the four directions; those who chant it are embellished with peace.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਆਹੀ ਓੜਿ ਤੁਹਾਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: mai aahee orr tuhaar naanak balihaareea |5|
English: I seek Your Protection; Nanak is a sacrifice to You. ||5||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਢਿਓ ਭੁਜਾ ਪਸਾਰਿ ਮੋਹ ਕੂਪਾਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaadtio bhujaa pasaar moh koopaareea |
English: The Guru reached out to me, and gave me His Arm; He lifted me up, out of the pit of emotional attachment.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਜੀਤਿਓ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਹਾਰੀਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: mai jeetio janam apaar bahur na haareea |6|
English: I have won the incomparable life, and I shall not lose it again. ||6||

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥਾਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: mai paaeo sarab nidhaan akath kathaareea |
English: I have obtained the treasure of all; His Speech is unspoken and subtle.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤ ਬਾਹ ਲੁਡਾਰੀਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: har daragah sobhaavant baah luddaareea |7|
English: In the Court of the Lord, I am honored and glorified; I swing my arms in joy. ||7||

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਧਾ ਰਤਨੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਅਪਾਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: jan naanak ladhaa ratan amol apaareea |
English: Servant Nanak has received the invaluable and incomparable jewel.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰੀਐ ਕਹਉ ਪੁਕਾਰੀਆ ॥੮॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: gur sevaa bhaujal tareeai khau pukaareea |8|12|
English: Serving the Guru, I cross over the terrifying world-ocean; I proclaim this loudly to all. ||8||12||

[Ang 241 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਰੰਗੋ ॥
Transliteration: naaraaein har rang rango |
English: Dye yourself in the color of the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਏਕ ਮੰਗੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jap jihavaa har ek mango |1| rahaau |
English: Chant the Name of the One Lord with your tongue, and ask for Him alone. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤਜਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਭਜੋ ॥
Transliteration: taj haumai gur giaan bhajo |
English: Renounce your ego, and dwell upon the spiritual wisdom of the Guru.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਮ ਲਿਖਿਓ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mil sangat dhur karam likhio |1|
English: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny, join the Sangat, the Holy Congregation. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਗਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: jo deesai so sang na geo |
English: Whatever you see, shall not go with you.

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤੁ ਮੂੜੁ ਲਗੇ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਇਓ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saakat moorr lage pach mueo |2|
English: The foolish, faithless cynics are attached - they waste away and die. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: mohan naam sadaa rav rahio |
English: The Name of the Fascinating Lord is all-pervading forever.

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਕਿਨੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਹਿਓ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kott madhe kinai guramukh lahio |3|
English: Among millions, how rare is that Gurmukh who attains the Name. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਨਮੋ ਨਮੋ ॥
Transliteration: har santan kar namo namo |
English: Greet the Lord's Saints humbly, with deep respect.

Gurbani: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਸੁਖੋ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: nau nidh paaveh atul sukho |4|
English: You shall obtain the nine treasures, and receive infinite peace. ||4||

Gurbani: ਨੈਨ ਅਲੋਵਉ ਸਾਧ ਜਨੋ ॥
Transliteration: nain alovau saadh jano |
English: With your eyes, behold the holy people;

Gurbani: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਧੋ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: hiradai gaavahu naam nidho |5|
English: in your heart, sing the treasure of the Naam. ||5||

Gurbani: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਤਜੋ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh lobh mohu tajo |
English: Abandon sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਹੁ ਤੇ ਰਹਿਓ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: janam maran duhu te rahio |6|
English: Thus you shall be rid of both birth and death. ||6||

Gurbani: ਦੂਖੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਘਰ ਤੇ ਮਿਟਿਓ ॥
