Transliteration: dookh andheraa ghar te mittio |
English: Pain and darkness shall depart from your home,

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਓ ਦੀਪ ਬਲਿਓ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: gur giaan drirraaeo deep balio |7|
English: when the Guru implants spiritual wisdom within you, and lights that lamp. ||7||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਸੋ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: jin seviaa so paar pario |
English: One who serves the Lord crosses over to the other side.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਿਓ ॥੮॥੧॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: jan naanak guramukh jagat tario |8|1|13|
English: O servant Nanak, the Gurmukh saves the world. ||8||1||13||

[Ang 241 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਗਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 gaurree |
English: Fifth Mehl, Gauree:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤ ਭਰਮ ਗਏ ॥
Transliteration: har har gur gur karat bharam ge |
English: Dwelling upon the Lord, Har, Har, and the Guru, the Guru, my doubts have been dispelled.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: merai man sabh sukh paaeo |1| rahaau |
English: My mind has obtained all comforts. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਲਤੋ ਜਲਤੋ ਤਉਕਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਸੀਤਲਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: balato jalato taukiaa gur chandan seetalaaeo |1|
English: I was burning, on fire, and the Guru poured water on me; He is cooling and soothing, like the sandalwood tree. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਦੀਪਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: agiaan andheraa mitt geaa gur giaan deepaaeo |2|
English: The darkness of ignorance has been dispelled; the Guru has lit the lamp of spiritual wisdom. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪਾਵਕੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਗਹਰੋ ਚਰਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਨਾਵ ਤਰਾਇਓ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: paavak saagar gaharo char santan naav taraaeo |3|
English: The ocean of fire is so deep; the Saints have crossed over, in the boat of the Lord's Name. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਹਮ ਕਰਮ ਨ ਧਰਮ ਸੁਚ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਗਹਿ ਭੁਜਾ ਆਪਾਇਓ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: naa ham karam na dharam such prabh geh bhujaa aapaaeo |4|
English: I have no good karma; I have no Dharmic faith or purity. But God has taken me by the arm, and made me His own. ||4||

Gurbani: ਭਉ ਖੰਡਨੁ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੋ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇਓ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: bhau khanddan dukh bhanjano bhagat vachhal har naaeo |5|
English: The Destroyer of fear, the Dispeller of pain, the Lover of His Saints - these are the Names of the Lord. ||5||

Gurbani: ਅਨਾਥਹ ਨਾਥ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦੀਨ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਿਥ ਸੰਤ ਓਟਾਇਓ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: anaathah naath kripaal deen samrith sant ottaaeo |6|
English: He is the Master of the masterless, Merciful to the meek, All-powerful, the Support of His Saints. ||6||

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਗੁਨੀਆਰੇ ਕੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਓ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: niraguneeaare kee benatee dehu daras har raaeo |7|
English: I am worthless - I offer this prayer, O my Lord King: "Please, grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan." ||7||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਆਇਓ ॥੮॥੨॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: naanak saran tuhaaree tthaakur sevak duaarai aaeo |8|2|14|
English: Nanak has come to Your Sanctuary, O my Lord and Master; Your servant has come to Your Door. ||8||2||14||

[Ang 242 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰੰਗ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕੇ ਭੋਗਾ ਇਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਅੰਧ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: rang sang bikhiaa ke bhogaa in sang andh na jaanee |1|
English: He is immersed in the enjoyment of corrupt pleasures; engrossed in them, the blind fool does not understand. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਸੰਚਉ ਹਉ ਖਾਟਤਾ ਸਗਲੀ ਅਵਧ ਬਿਹਾਨੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hau sanchau hau khaattataa sagalee avadh bihaanee | rahaau |
English: "I am earning profits, I am getting rich", he says, as his life passes away. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਸੂਰਾ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਹਉ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੁਝਹਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: hau sooraa paradhaan hau ko naahee mujheh samaanee |2|
English: "I am a hero, I am famous and distinguished; no one is equal to me." ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੋਬਨਵੰਤ ਅਚਾਰ ਕੁਲੀਨਾ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਗੁਮਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jobanavant achaar kuleenaa man meh hoe gumaanee |3|
English: "I am young, cultured, and born of a good family." In his mind, he is proud and arrogant like this. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਉਲਝਾਇਓ ਬਾਧ ਬੁਧਿ ਕਾ ਮਰਤਿਆ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਸਰਾਨੀ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jiau ulajhaaeo baadh budh kaa maratiaa nahee bisaraanee |4|
English: He is trapped by his false intellect, and he does not forget this until he dies. ||4||

Gurbani: ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤ ਬੰਧਪ ਸਖੇ ਪਾਛੇ ਤਿਨਹੂ ਕਉ ਸੰਪਾਨੀ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: bhaaee meet bandhap sakhe paachhe tinahoo kau sanpaanee |5|
English: Brothers, friends, relatives and companions who live after him - he entrusts his wealth to them. ||5||

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਗੋ ਮਨੁ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਨੀ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: jit laago man baasanaa ant saaee pragattaanee |6|
English: That desire, to which the mind is attached, at the last moment, becomes manifest. ||6||

Gurbani: ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਸੁਚਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਇਹ ਬੰਧਨ ਬੰਧਾਨੀ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: ahanbudh such karam kar ih bandhan bandhaanee |7|
English: He may perform religious deeds, but his mind is egotistical, and he is bound by these bonds. ||7||

Gurbani: ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਨੀ ॥੮॥੩॥੧੫॥੪੪॥ ਜੁਮਲਾ
Transliteration: deaal purakh kirapaa karahu naanak daas dasaanee |8|3|15|44| jumalaa
English: O Merciful Lord, please bless me Your Mercy, that Nanak may become the slave of Your slaves. ||8||3||15||44||Total||

[Ang 242 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar sat naam karataa purakh gur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru's Grace:

Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raag gaurree poorabee chhant mahalaa 1 |
English: Raag Gauree Poorbee, Chhant, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੁੰਧ ਰੈਣਿ ਦੁਹੇਲੜੀਆ ਜੀਉ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: mundh rain duhelarreea jeeo need na aavai |
English: For the bride, the night is painful; sleep does not come.

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਦੁਬਲੀਆ ਜੀਉ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਹਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: saa dhan dubaleea jeeo pir kai haavai |
English: The soul-bride has grown weak, in the pain of separation from her Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਧਨ ਥੀਈ ਦੁਬਲਿ ਕੰਤ ਹਾਵੈ ਕੇਵ ਨੈਣੀ ਦੇਖਏ ॥
Transliteration: dhan theeee dubal kant haavai kev nainee dekhe |
English: The soul-bride is wasting away, in the pain of separation from her Husband; how can she see Him with her eyes?

Gurbani: ਸੀਗਾਰ ਮਿਠ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਭੋਜਨ ਸਭੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਲੇਖਏ ॥
Transliteration: seegaar mitth ras bhog bhojan sabh jhootth kitai na lekhe |
English: Her decorations, sweet foods, sensuous pleasures and delicacies are all false; they are of no account at all.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਮਤ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਗਰਬਿ ਗਾਲੀ ਦੁਧਾ ਥਣੀ ਨ ਆਵਏ ॥
Transliteration: mai mat joban garab gaalee dudhaa thanee na aave |
English: Intoxicated with the wine of youthful pride, she has been ruined, and her breasts no longer yield milk.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਆਵਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak saa dhan milai milaaee bin pir need na aave |1|
English: O Nanak, the soul-bride meets her Husband Lord, when He causes her to meet Him; without Him, sleep does not come to her. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੁੰਧ ਨਿਮਾਨੜੀਆ ਜੀਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਧਨੀ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: mundh nimaanarreea jeeo bin dhanee piaare |
English: The bride is dishonored without her Beloved Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈਗੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kiau sukh paavaigee bin ur dhaare |
English: How can she find peace, without enshrining Him in her heart?

Gurbani: ਨਾਹ ਬਿਨੁ ਘਰ ਵਾਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਪੁਛਹੁ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: naah bin ghar vaas naahee puchhahu sakhee saheleea |
English: Without her Husband, her home is not worth living in; go and ask your sisters and companions.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਵਸਹਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: bin naam preet piaar naahee vaseh saach suheleea |
English: Without Naam, the Name of the Lord, there is no love and affection; but with her True Lord, she abides in peace.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਸਜਨ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਮੇਲਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਹੁ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sach man sajan santokh melaa guramatee sahu jaaniaa |
English: Through mental truth and contentment, union with the True Friend is attained; through the Guru's Teachings, the Husband Lord is known.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣੀਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naam na chhoddai saa dhan naam sehaj samaaneea |2|
English: O Nanak, that soul-bride who does not abandon the Naam, is intuitively absorbed in the Naam. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਿਲੁ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੜੀਹੋ ਹਮ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: mil sakhee sahelarreeho ham pir raavehaa |
English: Come, O my sisters and companions - let's enjoy our Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪੁਛਿ ਲਿਖਉਗੀ ਜੀਉ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਨੇਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur puchh likhaugee jeeo sabad sanehaa |
English: I will ask the Guru, and write His Word as my love-note.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਮਨਮੁਖੀ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabad saachaa gur dikhaaeaa manamukhee pachhutaaneea |
English: The Guru has shown me the True Word of the Shabad. The self-willed manmukhs will regret and repent.

Gurbani: ਨਿਕਸਿ ਜਾਤਉ ਰਹੈ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਜਾਮਿ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: nikas jaatau rahai asathir jaam sach pachhaaniaa |
English: My wandering mind became steady, when I recognized the True One.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਨਉਤਨ ਸਬਦਿ ਨੇਹੁ ਨਵੇਲਓ ॥
Transliteration: saach kee mat sadaa nautan sabad nehu navelo |
English: The Teachings of Truth are forever new; the love of the Shabad is forever fresh.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀਹੋ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak nadaree sehaj saachaa milahu sakhee saheleeho |3|
English: O Nanak, through the Glance of Grace of the True Lord, celestial peace is obtained; let's meet Him, O my sisters and companions. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੀ ਇਛ ਪੁਨੀ ਜੀਉ ਹਮ ਘਰਿ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: meree ichh punee jeeo ham ghar saajan aaeaa |
English: My desire has been fulfilled - my Friend has come to my home.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਵਰੁ ਨਾਰੀ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: mil var naaree mangal gaaeaa |
English: At the Union of husband and wife, the songs of rejoicing were sung.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਰਹਸੀ ਮੁੰਧ ਮਨਿ ਓਮਾਹਓ ॥
Transliteration: gun gaae mangal prem rahasee mundh man omaaho |
English: Singing the songs of joyful praise and love to Him, the soul-bride's mind is thrilled and delighted.

Gurbani: ਸਾਜਨ ਰਹੰਸੇ ਦੁਸਟ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਜਪਿ ਸਚੁ ਲਾਹਓ ॥
Transliteration: saajan rahanse dusatt viaape saach jap sach laaho |
English: My friends are happy, and my enemies are unhappy; meditating on the True Lord, the true profit is obtained.

Gurbani: ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਨਤੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਸਿ ਭਿੰਨੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: kar jorr saa dhan karai binatee rain din ras bhineea |
English: With her palms pressed together, the soul-bride prays, that she may remain immersed in the Love of her Lord, night and day.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਰੁ ਧਨ ਕਰਹਿ ਰਲੀਆ ਇਛ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੁੰਨੀਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak pir dhan kareh raleea ichh meree puneea |4|1|
English: O Nanak, the Husband Lord and the soul-bride revel together; my desires are fulfilled. ||4||1||

[Ang 243 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree chhant mahalaa 1 |
English: Gauree, Chhant, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਨਾਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਜੀਉ ਏਕਲੜੀ ਬਨ ਮਾਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: sun naah prabhoo jeeo ekalarree ban maahe |
English: Hear me, O my Dear Husband God - I am all alone in the wilderness.

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਧੀਰੈਗੀ ਨਾਹ ਬਿਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: kiau dheeraigee naah binaa prabh veparavaahe |
English: How can I find comfort without You, O my Carefree Husband God?

Gurbani: ਧਨ ਨਾਹ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਬਿਖਮ ਰੈਣਿ ਘਣੇਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: dhan naah baajhahu reh na saakai bikham rain ghanereea |
English: The soul-bride cannot live without her Husband; the night is so painful for her.

Gurbani: ਨਹ ਨੀਦ ਆਵੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਮੇਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: neh need aavai prem bhaavai sun benantee mereea |
English: Sleep does not come. I am in love with my Beloved. Please, listen to my prayer!

Gurbani: ਬਾਝਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਾਰੇ ਏਕਲੜੀ ਕੁਰਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: baajhahu piaare koe na saare ekalarree kuralaae |
English: Other than my Beloved, no one cares for me; I cry all alone in the wilderness.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak saa dhan milai milaaee bin preetam dukh paae |1|
English: O Nanak, the bride meets Him when He causes her to meet Him; without her Beloved, she suffers in pain. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪਿਰਿ ਛੋਡਿਅੜੀ ਜੀਉ ਕਵਣੁ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: pir chhoddiarree jeeo kavan milaavai |
English: She is separated from her Husband Lord - who can unite her with Him?

Gurbani: ਰਸਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਜੀਉ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: ras prem milee jeeo sabad suhaavai |
English: Tasting His Love, she meets Him, through the Beautiful Word of His Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੇ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਦੀਪਕ ਦੇਹ ਉਜਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: sabade suhaavai taa pat paavai deepak deh ujaarai |
English: Adorned with the Shabad, she obtains her Husband, and her body is illuminated with the lamp of spiritual wisdom.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਸਾਚਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: sun sakhee sahelee saach suhelee saache ke gun saarai |
English: Listen, O my friends and companions - she who is at peace dwells upon the True Lord and His True Praises.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਤਾ ਪਿਰਿ ਰਾਵੀ ਬਿਗਸੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: satigur melee taa pir raavee bigasee amrit baanee |
English: Meeting the True Guru, she is ravished and enjoyed by her Husband Lord; she blossoms forth with the Ambrosial Word of His Bani.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਤਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਜਾ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak saa dhan taa pir raave jaa tis kai man bhaanee |2|
English: O Nanak, the Husband Lord enjoys His bride when she is pleasing to His Mind. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਨੀਘਰੀਆ ਜੀਉ ਕੂੜਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohanee neeghareea jeeo koorr mutthee koorriaare |
English: Fascination with Maya made her homeless; the false are cheated by falsehood.

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਖੂਲੈ ਗਲ ਜੇਵੜੀਆ ਜੀਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kiau khoolai gal jevarreea jeeo bin gur at piaare |
English: How can the noose around her neck be untied, without the Most Beloved Guru?

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕਾ ਸੋ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: har preet piaare sabad veechaare tis hee kaa so hovai |
English: One who loves the Beloved Lord, and reflects upon the Shabad, belongs to Him.

Gurbani: ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਅਨੇਕ ਨਾਵਣ ਕਿਉ ਅੰਤਰ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: pun daan anek naavan kiau antar mal dhovai |
English: How can giving donations to charities and countless cleansing baths wash off the filth within the heart?

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਗਤਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਹਠਿ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਬੇਬਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: naam binaa gat koe na paavai hatth nigreh bebaanai |
English: Without the Naam, no one attains salvation. Stubborn self-discipline and living in the wilderness are of no use at all.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚ ਘਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਿਞਾਪੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਕਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak sach ghar sabad siyaapai dubidhaa mehal ki jaanai |3|
English: O Nanak, the home of Truth is attained through the Shabad. How can the Mansion of His Presence be known through duality? ||3||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਜੀਉ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: teraa naam sachaa jeeo sabad sachaa veechaaro |
English: True is Your Name, O Dear Lord; True is contemplation of Your Shabad.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਸਚਾ ਜੀਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: teraa mehal sachaa jeeo naam sachaa vaapaaro |
English: True is the Mansion of Your Presence, O Dear Lord, and True is trade in Your Name.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੋ ॥
Transliteration: naam kaa vaapaar meetthaa bhagat laahaa anadino |
English: Trade in Your Name is very sweet; the devotees earn this profit night and day.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਾਝੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੋ ॥
Transliteration: tis baajh vakhar koe na soojhai naam levahu khin khino |
English: Other than this, I can think of no other merchandise. So chant the Naam each and every moment.

Gurbani: ਪਰਖਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਕਰਮਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: parakh lekhaa nadar saachee karam poorai paaeaa |
English: The account is read; by the Grace of the True Lord and good karma, the Perfect Lord is obtained.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naam mahaa ras meetthaa gur poorai sach paaeaa |4|2|
English: O Nanak, the Nectar of the Name is so sweet. Through the Perfect True Guru, it is obtained. ||4||2||

[Ang 243 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: raag gaurree poorabee chhant mahalaa 3 |
English: Raag Gauree Poorbee, Chhant, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar sat naam karataa purakh gur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru's Grace:

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰੇ ਜੀਉ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: saa dhan binau kare jeeo har ke gun saare |
English: The soul-bride offers her prayers to her Dear Lord; she dwells upon His Glorious Virtues.

Gurbani: ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਜੀਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: khin pal reh na sakai jeeo bin har piaare |
English: She cannot live without her Beloved Lord, for a moment, even for an instant.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: bin har piaare reh na saakai gur bin mehal na paaeeai |
English: She cannot live without her Beloved Lord; without the Guru, the Mansion of His Presence is not found.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਪਰੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: jo gur kahai soee par keejai tisanaa agan bujhaaeeai |
English: Whatever the Guru says, she should surely do, to extinguish the fire of desire.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: har saachaa soee tis bin avar na koee bin seviai sukh na paae |
English: The Lord is True; there is no one except Him. Without serving Him, peace is not found.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak saa dhan milai milaaee jis no aap milaae |1|
English: O Nanak, that soul-bride, whom the Lord Himself unites, is united with Him; He Himself merges with her. ||1||

Gurbani: ਧਨ ਰੈਣਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੜੀਏ ਜੀਉ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: dhan rain suhelarree jeeo har siau chit laae |
English: The life-night of the soul-bride is blessed and joyful, when she focuses her consciousness on her Dear Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਭਾਉ ਕਰੇ ਜੀਉ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: satigur seve bhaau kare jeeo vichahu aap gavaae |
English: She serves the True Guru with love; she eradicates selfishness from within.

Gurbani: ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਭਾਓ ॥
Transliteration: vichahu aap gavaae har gun gaae anadin laagaa bhaao |
English: Eradicating selfishness and conceit from within, and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, she is in love with the Lord, night and day.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਮੇਲੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਓ ॥
Transliteration: sun sakhee sahelee jeea kee melee gur kai sabad samaao |
English: Listen, dear friends and companions of the soul - immerse yourselves in the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੀ ਤਾ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਨਾਮੇ ਧਰੀ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: har gun saaree taa kant piaaree naame dharee piaaro |
English: Dwell upon the Lord's Glories, and you shall be loved by your Husband, embracing love for the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਨਾਹ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਗਲਿ ਹਾਰੋ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak kaaman naah piaaree raam naam gal haaro |2|
English: O Nanak, the soul-bride who wears the necklace of the Lord's Name around her neck is loved by her Husband Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਧਨ ਏਕਲੜੀ ਜੀਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਹ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: dhan ekalarree jeeo bin naah piaare |
English: The soul-bride who is without her beloved Husband is all alone.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਮੁਠੀ ਜੀਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਕਰਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: doojai bhaae mutthee jeeo bin gurasabad karaare |
English: She is cheated by the love of duality, without the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕਉਣੁ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਖੁਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: bin sabad piaare kaun dutar taare maaeaa mohi khuaaee |
English: Without the Shabad of her Beloved, how can she cross over the treacherous ocean? Attachment to Maya has led her astray.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜਿ ਵਿਗੁਤੀ ਤਾ ਪਿਰਿ ਮੁਤੀ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: koorr vigutee taa pir mutee saa dhan mehal na paaee |
English: Ruined by falsehood, she is deserted by her Husband Lord. The soul-bride does not attain the Mansion of His Presence.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੇ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gurasabade raatee sahaje maatee anadin rahai samaae |
English: But she who is attuned to the Guru's Shabad is intoxicated with celestial love; night and day, she remains absorbed in Him.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak kaaman sadaa rang raatee har jeeo aap milaae |3|
English: O Nanak, that soul-bride who remains constantly steeped in His Love, is blended by the Lord into Himself. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਜੀਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਵਣੁ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: taa mileeai har mele jeeo har bin kavan milaae |
English: If the Lord merges us with Himself, we are merged with Him. Without the Dear Lord, who can merge us with Him?

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਆਪਣੇ ਜੀਉ ਕਉਣੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: bin gur preetam aapane jeeo kaun bharam chukaae |
English: Without our Beloved Guru, who can dispel our doubt?

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ਇਉ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਮਾਏ ਤਾ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur bharam chukaae iau mileeai maae taa saa dhan sukh paae |
English: Through the Guru, doubt is dispelled. O my mother, this is the way to meet Him; this is how the soul-bride finds peace.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur sevaa bin ghor andhaar bin gur mag na paae |
English: Without serving the Guru, there is only pitch darkness. Without the Guru, the Way is not found.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kaaman rang raatee sahaje maatee gur kai sabad veechaare |
English: That wife who is intuitively imbued with the color of His Love, contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak kaaman har var paaeaa gur kai bhaae piaare |4|1|
English: O Nanak, the soul-bride obtains the Lord as her Husband, by enshrining love for the Beloved Guru. ||4||1||

[Ang 244 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 3 |
English: Gauree, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਖਰੀ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਜੀਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਕਿਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: pir bin kharee nimaanee jeeo bin pir kiau jeevaa meree maaee |
English: Without my Husband, I am utterly dishonored. Without my Husband Lord, how can I live, O my mother?

Gurbani: ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜੀਉ ਕਾਪੜੁ ਤਨਿ ਨ ਸੁਹਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: pir bin need na aavai jeeo kaaparr tan na suhaaee |
English: Without my Husband, sleep does not come, and my body is not adorned with my bridal dress.

Gurbani: ਕਾਪਰੁ ਤਨਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ਜਾ ਪਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: kaapar tan suhaavai jaa pir bhaavai guramatee chit laaeeai |
English: The bridal dress looks beautiful upon my body, when I am pleasing to my Husband Lord. Following the Guru's Teachings, my consciousness is focused on Him.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa suhaagan jaa satigur seve gur kai ank samaaeeai |
English: I become His happy soul-bride forever, when I serve the True Guru; I sit in the Lap of the Guru.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੈ ਮੇਲਾ ਤਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੀ ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gurasabadai melaa taa pir raavee laahaa naam sansaare |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the soul-bride meets her Husband Lord, who ravishes and enjoys her. The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the only profit in this world.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਨਾਹ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak kaaman naah piaaree jaa har ke gun saare |1|
English: O Nanak, the soul-bride is loved by her Husband, when she dwells upon the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੇ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਣੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: saa dhan rang maane jeeo aapane naal piaare |
English: The soul-bride enjoys the Love of her Beloved.

Gurbani: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਜੀਉ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: ahinis rang raatee jeeo gurasabad veechaare |
English: Imbued with His Love night and day, she contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੇ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gurasabad veechaare haumai maare in bidh milahu piaare |
English: Contemplating the Guru's Shabad, she conquers her ego, and in this way, she meets her Beloved.

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: saa dhan sohaagan sadaa rang raatee saachai naam piaare |
English: She is the happy soul-bride of her Lord, who is forever imbued with the Love of the True Name of her Beloved.

Gurbani: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗਹੀਐ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: apune gur mil raheeai amrit gaheeai dubidhaa maar nivaare |
English: Abiding in the Company of our Guru, we grasp the Ambrosial Nectar; we conquer and cast out our sense of duality.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਵਿਸਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak kaaman har var paaeaa sagale dookh visaare |2|
English: O Nanak, the soul-bride attains her Husband Lord, and forgets all her pains. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਪਿਰਹੁ ਭੁਲੀ ਜੀਉ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kaaman pirahu bhulee jeeo maaeaa mohi piaare |
English: The soul-bride has forgotten her Husband Lord, because of love and emotional attachment to Maya.

Gurbani: ਝੂਠੀ ਝੂਠਿ ਲਗੀ ਜੀਉ ਕੂੜਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jhootthee jhootth lagee jeeo koorr mutthee koorriaare |
English: The false bride is attached to falsehood; the insincere one is cheated by insincerity.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਰੇ ਜੂਐ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: koorr nivaare guramat saare jooai janam na haare |
English: She who drives out her falsehood, and acts according to the Guru's Teachings, does not lose her life in the gamble.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gurasabad seve sach samaavai vichahu haumai maare |
English: One who serves the Word of the Guru's Shabad is absorbed in the True Lord; she eradicates egotism from within.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਏ ਐਸਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੀਗਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam ridai vasaae aisaa kare seegaaro |
English: So let the Name of the Lord abide within your heart; decorate yourself in this way.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੋ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak kaaman sehaj samaanee jis saachaa naam adhaaro |3|
English: O Nanak, the soul-bride who takes the Support of the True Name is intuitively absorbed in the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਿਲੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਾ ਜੀਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਖਰੀ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: mil mere preetamaa jeeo tudh bin kharee nimaanee |
English: Meet me, O my Dear Beloved. Without You, I am totally dishonored.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਨੈਣੀ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜੀਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਅੰਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: mai nainee need na aavai jeeo bhaavai an na paanee |
English: Sleep does not come to my eyes, and I have no desire for food or water.

Gurbani: ਪਾਣੀ ਅੰਨੁ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਮਰੀਐ ਹਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: paanee an na bhaavai mareeai haavai bin pir kiau sukh paaeeai |
English: I have no desire for food or water, and I am dying from the pain of separation. Without my Husband Lord, how can I find peace?

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਕਰਉ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਜੇ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਜਿਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਮਿਲਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: gur aagai krau binantee je gur bhaavai jiau milai tivai milaaeeai |
English: I offer my prayers to the Guru; if it pleases the Guru, He shall unite me with Himself.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: aape mel le sukhadaataa aap miliaa ghar aae |
English: The Giver of peace has united me with Himself; He Himself has come to my home to meet me.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak kaaman sadaa suhaagan naa pir marai na jaae |4|2|
English: O Nanak, the soul-bride is forever the Lord's favorite wife; her Husband Lord does not die, and He shall never leave. ||4||2||

[Ang 245 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 3 |
English: Gauree, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਬੇਧੀ ਜੀਉ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: kaaman har ras bedhee jeeo har kai sehaj subhaae |
English: The soul-bride is pierced through with the sublime essence of the Lord, in intuitive peace and poise.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਨਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੀਆ ਜੀਉ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: man mohan mohi leea jeeo dubidhaa sehaj samaae |
English: The Enticer of hearts has enticed her, and her sense of duality has been easily dispelled.

Gurbani: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: dubidhaa sehaj samaae kaaman var paae guramatee rang laae |
English: Her sense of duality has been easily dispelled, and the soul-bride obtains her Husband Lord; following the Guru's Teachings, she makes merry.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਕੂੜਿ ਕੁਸਤਿ ਭਰਿਆ ਗਲ ਤਾਈ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: eihu sareer koorr kusat bhariaa gal taaee paap kamaae |
English: This body is filled to overflowing with falsehood, deception and the commission of sins.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh bhagat jit sehaj dhun upajai bin bhagatee mail na jaae |
English: The Gurmukh practices that devotional worship, by which the celestial music wells up; without this devotional worship, filth is not removed.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਪਿਰਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak kaaman pireh piaaree vichahu aap gavaae |1|
English: O Nanak, the soul-bride who sheds selfishness and conceit from within, is dear to her Beloved. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kaaman pir paaeaa jeeo gur kai bhaae piaare |
English: The soul-bride has found her Husband Lord, through the love and affection of the Guru.

Gurbani: ਰੈਣਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੁਤੀ ਜੀਉ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: rain sukh sutee jeeo antar ur dhaare |
English: She passes her life-night sleeping in peace, enshrining the Lord in her heart.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: antar ur dhaare mileeai piaare anadin dukh nivaare |
English: Enshrining Him deep within her heart night and day, she meets her Beloved, and her pains depart.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: antar mehal pir raave kaaman guramatee veechaare |
English: Deep within the mansion of her inner being, she enjoys her Husband Lord, reflecting upon the Guru's Teachings.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੀਆ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: amrit naam peea din raatee dubidhaa maar nivaare |
English: She drinks deeply of the Nectar of the Naam, day and night; she conquers and casts off her sense of duality.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak sach milee sohaagan gur kai het apaare |2|
English: O Nanak, the happy soul-bride meets her True Lord, through the Infinite Love of the Guru. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਵਹੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aavahu deaa kare jeeo preetam at piaare |
English: Come, and shower Your Mercy upon me, my most Darling, Dear Beloved.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰੇ ਜੀਉ ਸਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kaaman binau kare jeeo sach sabad seegaare |
English: The soul-bride offers her prayers to You, to adorn her with the True Word of Your Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sach sabad seegaare haumai maare guramukh kaaraj savaare |
English: Adorned with the True Word of Your Shabad, she conquers her ego, and as Gurmukh, her affairs are resolved.

Gurbani: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਏਕੋ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jug jug eko sachaa soee boojhai gur beechaare |
English: Throughout the ages, the One Lord is True; through the Guru's Wisdom, He is known.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਮਿ ਵਿਆਪੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਸੰਤਾਪੀ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਜਾਇ ਪੁਕਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh kaam viaapee mohi santaapee kis aagai jaae pukaare |
English: The self-willed manmukh is engrossed in sexual desire, and tormented by emotional attachment. With whom should she lodge her complaints?

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਥਾਉ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak manamukh thaau na paae bin gur at piaare |3|
English: O Nanak, the self-willed manmukh finds no place of rest, without the most Beloved Guru. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮੁੰਧ ਇਆਣੀ ਭੋਲੀ ਨਿਗੁਣੀਆ ਜੀਉ ਪਿਰੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: mundh eaanee bholee niguneea jeeo pir agam apaaraa |
English: The bride is foolish, ignorant and unworthy. Her Husband Lord is Unapproachable and Incomparable.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਜੀਉ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape mel mileeai jeeo aape bakhasanahaaraa |
English: He Himself unites us in His Union; He Himself forgives us.

Gurbani: ਅਵਗਣ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰਾ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਕੰਤੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: avagan bakhasanahaaraa kaaman kant piaaraa ghatt ghatt rahiaa samaaee |
English: The soul-bride's Beloved Husband Lord is the Forgiver of sins; He is contained in each and every heart.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: prem preet bhaae bhagatee paaeeai satigur boojh bujhaaee |
English: The True Guru has made me understand this understanding, that the Lord is obtained through love, affection and loving devotion.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa anand rahai din raatee anadin rahai liv laaee |
English: She remains forever in bliss, day and night; she remains immersed in His Love, night and day.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak sahaje har var paaeaa saa dhan nau nidh paaee |4|3|
English: O Nanak, that soul-bride who obtains the nine treasures, intuitively obtains her Husband Lord. ||4||3||

[Ang 245 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 3 |
English: Gauree, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਸਰੁ ਸਬਲੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਜੀਉ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa sar sabal varatai jeeo kiau kar dutar tariaa jaae |
English: The sea of Maya is agitated and turbulent; how can anyone cross over this terrifying world-ocean?

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਜੀਉ ਸਬਦੁ ਖੇਵਟੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam kar bohithaa jeeo sabad khevatt vich paae |
English: Make the Lord's Name your boat, and install the Word of the Shabad as the boatman.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੁ ਖੇਵਟੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਲਘਾਏ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: sabad khevatt vich paae har aap laghaae in bidh dutar tareeai |
English: With the Shabad installed as the boatman, the Lord Himself shall take you across. In this way, the difficult ocean is crossed.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੀਵਤਿਆ ਇਉ ਮਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh bhagat paraapat hovai jeevatiaa iau mareeai |
English: The Gurmukh obtains devotional worship of the Lord, and thus remains dead while yet alive.

Gurbani: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਾਟੇ ਭਏ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: khin meh raam naam kilavikh kaatte bhe pavit sareeraa |
English: In an instant, the Lord's Name erases his sinful mistakes, and his body becomes pure.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਕੰਚਨ ਭਏ ਮਨੂਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak raam naam nisataaraa kanchan bhe manooraa |1|
English: O Nanak, through the Lord's Name, emancipation is obtained, and the slag iron is transformed into gold. ||1||

Gurbani: ਇਸਤਰੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਾਮਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਜੀਉ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: eisataree purakh kaam viaape jeeo raam naam kee bidh nahee jaanee |
English: Men and women are obsessed with sex; they do not know the Way of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਭਾਈ ਖਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜੀਉ ਡੂਬਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: maat pitaa sut bhaaee khare piaare jeeo ddoob mue bin paanee |
English: Mother, father, children and siblings are very dear, but they drown, even without water.

Gurbani: ਡੂਬਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਧਾਤੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: ddoob mue bin paanee gat nahee jaanee haumai dhaat sansaare |
English: They are drowned to death without water - they do not know the path of salvation, and they wander around the world in egotism.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਆਇਆ ਸੋ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਜਾਸੀ ਉਬਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jo aaeaa so sabh ko jaasee ubare gur veechaare |
English: All those who come into the world shall depart. Only those who contemplate the Guru shall be saved.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh hovai raam naam vakhaanai aap tarai kul taare |
English: Those who become Gurmukh and chant the Lord's Name, save themselves and save their families as well.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naam vasai ghatt antar guramat mile piaare |2|
English: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within their hearts; through the Guru's Teachings, they meet their Beloved. ||2||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ਬਾਜੀ ਹੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam bin ko thir naahee jeeo baajee hai sansaaraa |
English: Without the Lord's Name, nothing is stable. This world is just a drama.

Gurbani: ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਚੀ ਜੀਉ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: drirr bhagat sachee jeeo raam naam vaapaaraa |
English: Implant true devotional worship within your heart, and trade in the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam vaapaaraa agam apaaraa guramatee dhan paaeeai |
English: Trade in the Lord's Name is infinite and unfathomable. Through the Guru's Teachings, this wealth is obtained.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਇਹ ਸਾਚੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: sevaa surat bhagat ih saachee vichahu aap gavaaeeai |
English: This selfless service, meditation and devotion is true, if you eliminate selfishness and conceit from within.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਮਤਿ ਹੀਣ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਅੰਧੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: ham mat heen moorakh mugadh andhe satigur maarag paae |
English: I am senseless, foolish, idiotic and blind, but the True Guru has placed me on the Path.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh sabad suhaave anadin har gun gaae |3|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are adorned with the Shabad; night and day, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aap karaae kare aap jeeo aape sabad savaare |
English: He Himself acts, and inspires others to act; He Himself embellishes us with the Word of His Shabad.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਪਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਜੀਉ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਭਗਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aape satigur aap sabad jeeo jug jug bhagat piaare |
English: He Himself is the True Guru, and He Himself is the Shabad; in each and every age, He loves His devotees.

Gurbani: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਭਗਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jug jug bhagat piaare har aap savaare aape bhagatee laae |
English: In age after age, He loves His devotees; the Lord Himself adorns them, and He Himself enjoins them to worship Him with devotion.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਦਾਨਾ ਆਪੇ ਬੀਨਾ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aape daanaa aape beenaa aape sev karaae |
English: He Himself is All-knowing, and He Himself is All-seeing; He inspires us to serve Him.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਕਾਟੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aape gunadaataa avagun kaatte hiradai naam vasaae |
English: He Himself is the Giver of merits, and the Destroyer of demerits; He causes His Name to dwell within our hearts.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਚੇ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ॥੪॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak sad balihaaree sache vittahu aape kare karaae |4|4|
English: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to the True Lord, who Himself is the Doer, the Cause of causes. ||4||4||

[Ang 246 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 3 |
English: Gauree, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਿ ਪਿਰਾ ਜੀਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur kee sevaa kar piraa jeeo har naam dhiaae |
English: Serve the Guru, O my dear soul; meditate on the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਮੰਞਹੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ਪਿਰਾ ਜੀਉ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਠਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: manyahu door na jaeh piraa jeeo ghar baitthiaa har paae |
English: Do not leave me, O my dear soul - you shall find the Lord while sitting within the home of your own being.

Gurbani: ਘਰਿ ਬੈਠਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ਸਦਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਤਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: ghar baitthiaa har paae sadaa chit laae sahaje sat subhaae |
English: You shall obtain the Lord while sitting within the home of your own being, focusing your consciousness constantly upon the Lord, with true intuitive faith.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਖਰੀ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur kee sevaa kharee sukhaalee jis no aap karaae |
English: Serving the Guru brings great peace; they alone do it, whom the Lord inspires to do so.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੋ ਬੀਜੇ ਨਾਮੋ ਜੰਮੈ ਨਾਮੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: naamo beeje naamo jamai naamo man vasaae |
English: They plant the seed of the Name, and the Name sprouts within; the Name abides within the mind.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak sach naam vaddiaaee poorab likhiaa paae |1|
English: O Nanak, glorious greatness rests in the True Name; It is obtained by perfect pre-ordained destiny. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਪਿਰਾ ਜੀਉ ਜਾ ਚਾਖਹਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam meetthaa piraa jeeo jaa chaakheh chit laae |
English: The Name of the Lord is so sweet, O my dear; taste it, and focus your consciousness on it.

Gurbani: ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੁ ਮੁਯੇ ਜੀਉ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਸਾਦ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: rasanaa har ras chaakh muye jeeo an ras saad gavaae |
English: Taste the sublime essence of the Lord with your tongue, my dear, and renounce the pleasures of other tastes.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਏ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਏ ਰਸਨਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa har ras paae jaa har bhaae rasanaa sabad suhaae |
English: You shall obtain the everlasting essence of the Lord when it pleases the Lord; your tongue shall be adorned with the Word of His Shabad.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: naam dhiaae sadaa sukh paae naam rahai liv laae |
English: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, a lasting peace is obtained; so remain lovingly focused on the Naam.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੇ ਉਪਜੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: naame upajai naame binasai naame sach samaae |
English: From the Naam we originate, and into the Naam we shall pass; through the Naam, we are absorbed in the Truth.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਲਵਾਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naam guramatee paaeeai aape le lavaae |2|
English: O Nanak, the Naam is obtained through the Guru's Teachings; He Himself attaches us to it. ||2||

Gurbani: ਏਹ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਪਿਰਾ ਜੀਉ ਧਨ ਛੋਡਿ ਪਰਦੇਸਿ ਸਿਧਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: eeh viddaanee chaakaree piraa jeeo dhan chhodd parades sidhaae |
English: Working for someone else, O my dear, is like forsaking the bride, and going to foreign countries.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਪਿਰਾ ਜੀਉ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਲੋਭਿ ਲੁਭਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: doojai kinai sukh na paaeo piraa jeeo bikhiaa lobh lubhaae |
English: In duality, no one has ever found peace, O my dear; you are greedy for corruption and greed.

Gurbani: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਲੋਭਿ ਲੁਭਾਏ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਓਹੁ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: bikhiaa lobh lubhaae bharam bhulaae ohu kiau kar sukh paae |
English: Greedy for corruption and greed, and deluded by doubt, how can anyone find peace?

Gurbani: ਚਾਕਰੀ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ਖਰੀ ਦੁਖਾਲੀ ਆਪੁ ਵੇਚਿ ਧਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: chaakaree viddaanee kharee dukhaalee aap vech dharam gavaae |
English: Working for strangers is very painful; doing so, one sells himself and loses his faith in the Dharma.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਬੰਧਨ ਟਿਕੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੰਤਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa bandhan ttikai naahee khin khin dukh santaae |
English: Bound by Maya, the mind is not stable. Each and every moment, it suffers in pain.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਤਦੇ ਚੂਕੈ ਜਾ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak maaeaa kaa dukh tade chookai jaa gurasabadee chit laae |3|
English: O Nanak, the pain of Maya is taken away by focusing one's consciousness on the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਗਾਵਾਰੁ ਪਿਰਾ ਜੀਉ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨਿ ਨ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh mugadh gaavaar piraa jeeo sabad man na vasaae |
English: The self-willed manmukhs are foolish and crazy, O my dear; they do not enshrine the Shabad within their minds.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਪਿਰਾ ਜੀਉ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa kaa bhram andh piraa jeeo har maarag kiau paae |
English: The delusion of Maya has made them blind, O my dear; how can they find the Way of the Lord?

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪਾਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਏ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: kiau maarag paae bin satigur bhaae manamukh aap ganaae |
English: How can they find the Way, without the Will of the True Guru? The manmukhs foolishly display themselves.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਾਕਰ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: har ke chaakar sadaa suhele gur charanee chit laae |
English: The Lord's servants are forever comfortable. They focus their consciousness on the Guru's Feet.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jis no har jeeo kare kirapaa sadaa har ke gun gaae |
English: Those unto whom the Lord shows His Mercy, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord forever.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਜਗਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥੪॥੫॥੭॥
Transliteration: naanak naam ratan jag laahaa guramukh aap bujhaae |4|5|7|
English: O Nanak, the jewel of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the only profit in this world. The Lord Himself imparts this understanding to the Gurmukh. ||4||5||7||

[Ang 247 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ₁ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raag gaurree₁ chhant mahalaa 5 |
English: Raag Gauree, Chhant, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਭਇਆ ਜੀਉ ਕਿਉ ਦੇਖਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: merai man bairaag bheaa jeeo kiau dekhaa prabh daate |
English: My mind has become sad and depressed; how can I see God, the Great Giver?

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ਸਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: mere meet sakhaa har jeeo gur purakh bidhaate |
English: My Friend and Companion is the Dear Lord, the Guru, the Architect of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਪੁਰਖੋ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰੁ ਕਿਉ ਮਿਲਹ ਤੁਝੈ ਉਡੀਣੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: purakho bidhaataa ek sreedhar kiau milah tujhai uddeeneea |
English: The One Lord, the Architect of Destiny, is the Master of the Goddess of Wealth; how can I, in my sadness, meet You?

Gurbani: ਕਰ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੀਸੁ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਨਿ ਆਸ ਦਰਸ ਨਿਮਾਣੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: kar kareh sevaa sees charanee man aas daras nimaaneea |
English: My hands serve You, and my head is at Your Feet. My mind, dishonored, yearns for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਨ ਘੜੀ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਪਲੁ ਮੂਰਤੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: saas saas na gharree visarai pal moorat din raate |
English: With each and every breath, I think of You, day and night; I do not forget You, for an instant, even for a moment.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਰਿੰਗ ਜਿਉ ਪਿਆਸੇ ਕਿਉ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak saaring jiau piaase kiau mileeai prabh daate |1|
English: O Nanak, I am thirsty, like the rainbird; how can I meet God, the Great Giver? ||1||

Gurbani: ਇਕ ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰਉ ਜੀਉ ਸੁਣਿ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: eik binau krau jeeo sun kant piaare |
English: I offer this one prayer - please listen, O my Beloved Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੀਆ ਜੀਉ ਦੇਖਿ ਚਲਤ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: meraa man tan mohi leea jeeo dekh chalat tumaare |
English: My mind and body are enticed, beholding Your wondrous play.

Gurbani: ਚਲਤਾ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਦੇਖਿ ਮੋਹੀ ਉਦਾਸ ਧਨ ਕਿਉ ਧੀਰਏ ॥
Transliteration: chalataa tumaare dekh mohee udaas dhan kiau dheere |
English: Beholding Your wondrous play, I am enticed; but how can the sad, forlorn bride find contentment?

Gurbani: ਗੁਣਵੰਤ ਨਾਹ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਬਾਲਾ ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣ ਭਰਪੂਰਏ ॥
Transliteration: gunavant naah deaal baalaa sarab gun bharapoore |
English: My Lord is Meritorious, Merciful and Eternally Young; He is overflowing with all excellences.

Gurbani: ਪਿਰ ਦੋਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੁਖਹ ਦਾਤੇ ਹਉ ਵਿਛੁੜੀ ਬੁਰਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: pir dos naahee sukhah daate hau vichhurree buriaare |
English: The fault is not with my Husband Lord, the Giver of peace; I am separated from Him by my own mistakes.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਵਹੁ ਨਾਹ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak deaa dhaarahu ghar aavahu naah piaare |2|
English: Prays Nanak, please be merciful to me, and return home, O my Beloved Husband Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪੀ ਸਭੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪੀ ਅਰਪੀ ਸਭਿ ਦੇਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: hau man arapee sabh tan arapee arapee sabh desaa |
English: I surrender my mind, I surrender my whole body; I surrender all my lands.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਸਿਰੁ ਅਰਪੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੀਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਇ ਸਦੇਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: hau sir arapee tis meet piaare jo prabh dee sadesaa |
English: I surrender my head to that beloved friend, who brings me news of God.

Gurbani: ਅਰਪਿਆ ਤ ਸੀਸੁ ਸੁਥਾਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: arapiaa ta sees suthaan gur peh sang prabhoo dikhaaeaa |
English: I have offered my head to the Guru, the most exalted; He has shown me that God is with me.

Gurbani: ਖਿਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਗਲਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਮਨਹੁ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: khin maeh sagalaa dookh mittiaa manahu chindiaa paaeaa |
English: In an instant, all suffering is removed. I have obtained all my mind's desires.

Gurbani: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਰਲੀਆ ਕਰੈ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਮਿਟੇ ਸਗਲ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: din rain raleea karai kaaman mitte sagal andesaa |
English: Day and night, the soul-bride makes merry; all her anxieties are erased.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕੰਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਲੋੜਤੇ ਹਮ ਜੈਸਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak kant miliaa lorrate ham jaisaa |3|
English: Prays Nanak, I have met the Husband Lord of my longing. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਜੀਉ ਵਜੀ ਵਾਧਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: merai man anad bheaa jeeo vajee vaadhaaee |
English: My mind is filled with bliss, and congratulations are pouring in.

Gurbani: ਘਰਿ ਲਾਲੁ ਆਇਆ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸਭ ਤਿਖਾ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ghar laal aaeaa piaaraa sabh tikhaa bujhaaee |
English: My Darling Beloved has come home to me, and all my desires have been satisfied.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤ ਲਾਲੁ ਗੁਪਾਲੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਖੀ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: miliaa ta laal gupaal tthaakur sakhee mangal gaaeaa |
English: I have met my Sweet Lord and Master of the Universe, and my companions sing the songs of joy.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਮੀਤ ਬੰਧਪ ਹਰਖੁ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਦੂਤ ਥਾਉ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabh meet bandhap harakh upajiaa doot thaau gavaaeaa |
English: All my friends and relatives are happy, and all traces of my enemies have been removed.

Gurbani: ਅਨਹਤ ਵਾਜੇ ਵਜਹਿ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਪਿਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੇਜ ਵਿਛਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: anahat vaaje vajeh ghar meh pir sang sej vichhaaee |
English: The unstruck melody vibrates in my home, and the bed has been made up for my Beloved.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਰਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕੰਤੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak sehaj rahai har miliaa kant sukhadaaee |4|1|
English: Prays Nanak, I am in celestial bliss. I have obtained the Lord, the Giver of peace, as my Husband. ||4||1||

[Ang 248 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ₂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree₂ mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਊਚੇ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਲ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: mohan tere aooche mandar mehal apaaraa |
English: O Mohan, your temple is so lofty, and your mansion is unsurpassed.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਦੁਆਰ ਜੀਉ ਸੰਤ ਧਰਮ ਸਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: mohan tere sohan duaar jeeo sant dharam saalaa |
English: O Mohan, your gates are so beautiful. They are the worship-houses of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਧਰਮ ਸਾਲ ਅਪਾਰ ਦੈਆਰ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਦਾ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਵਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: dharam saal apaar daiaar tthaakur sadaa keeratan gaavahe |
English: In these incomparable worship-houses, they continually sing Kirtan, the Praises of their Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਤ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤਹਾ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: jeh saadh sant ikatr hoveh tahaa tujheh dhiaavahe |
English: Where the Saints and the Holy gather together, there they meditate on you.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਮਇਆ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹੋਹੁ ਦੀਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kar deaa meaa deaal suaamee hohu deen kripaaraa |
English: Be Kind and Compassionate, O Merciful Lord; be Merciful to the meek.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak daras piaase mil darasan sukh saaraa |1|
English: Prays Nanak, I thirst for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; receiving Your Darshan, I am totally at peace. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਬਚਨ ਅਨੂਪ ਚਾਲ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: mohan tere bachan anoop chaal niraalee |
English: O Mohan, your speech is incomparable; wondrous are your ways.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਨ ਤੂੰ ਮਾਨਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਜੀ ਅਵਰ ਸਭ ਰਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: mohan toon maaneh ek jee avar sabh raalee |
English: O Mohan, you believe in the One. Everything else is dust to you.

Gurbani: ਮਾਨਹਿ ਤ ਏਕੁ ਅਲੇਖੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਜਿਨਹਿ ਸਭ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: maaneh ta ek alekh tthaakur jineh sabh kal dhaareea |
English: You adore the One Lord, the Unknowable Lord and Master; His Power gives Support to all.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਚਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਆ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਨਵਾਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: tudh bachan gur kai vas keea aad purakh banavaareea |
English: Through the Guru's Word, you have captured the heart of the Primal Being, the Lord of the World.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਆਪਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਸਭ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: toon aap chaliaa aap rahiaa aap sabh kal dhaareea |
English: You Yourself move, and You Yourself stand still; You Yourself support the whole creation.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੈਜ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਭ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak paij raakhahu sabh sevak saran tumaareea |2|
English: Prays Nanak, please preserve my honor; all Your servants seek the Protection of Your Sanctuary. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਨ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: mohan tudh satasangat dhiaavai daras dhiaanaa |
English: O Mohan, the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, meditates on you; they meditate on the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਨ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਜਪਹਿ ਨਿਦਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: mohan jam nerr na aavai tudh japeh nidaanaa |
English: O Mohan, the Messenger of Death does not even approach those who meditate on You, at the last moment.

Gurbani: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਲਗੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਜੋ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: jamakaal tin kau lagai naahee jo ik man dhiaavahe |
English: The Messenger of Death cannot touch those who meditate on You single-mindedly.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਬਚਨਿ ਕਰਮਿ ਜਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ ਸੇ ਸਭੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: man bachan karam ji tudh araadheh se sabhe fal paavahe |
English: Those who worship and adore You in thought, word and deed, obtain all fruits and rewards.

Gurbani: ਮਲ ਮੂਤ ਮੂੜ ਜਿ ਮੁਗਧ ਹੋਤੇ ਸਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਸੁਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: mal moot moorr ji mugadh hote si dekh daras sugiaanaa |
English: Those who are foolish and stupid, filthy with urine and manure, become all-knowing upon gaining the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਜੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਭਗਵਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak raaj nihachal pooran purakh bhagavaanaa |3|
English: Prays Nanak, Your Kingdom is Eternal, O Perfect Primal Lord God. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਨ ਤੂੰ ਸੁਫਲੁ ਫਲਿਆ ਸਣੁ ਪਰਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: mohan toon sufal faliaa san paravaare |
English: O Mohan, you have blossomed forth with the flower of your family.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਨ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਮੀਤ ਭਾਈ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਭਿ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: mohan putr meet bhaaee kuttanb sabh taare |
English: O Mohan, your children, friends, siblings and relatives have all been saved.

Gurbani: ਤਾਰਿਆ ਜਹਾਨੁ ਲਹਿਆ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: taariaa jahaan lahiaa abhimaan jinee darasan paaeaa |
English: You save those who give up their egotistical pride, upon gaining the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਧੰਨੁ ਕਹਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jinee tudhano dhan kahiaa tin jam nerr na aaeaa |
English: The Messenger of Death does not even approach those who call you 'blessed'.

Gurbani: ਬੇਅੰਤ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਥੇ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: beant gun tere kathe na jaahee satigur purakh muraare |
English: Your Virtues are unlimited - they cannot be described, O True Guru, Primal Being, Destroyer of demons.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਟੇਕ ਰਾਖੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਗਿ ਤਰਿਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak ttek raakhee jit lag tariaa sansaare |4|2|
English: Prays Nanak, Yours is that Anchor, holding onto which the whole world is saved. ||4||2||

[Ang 248 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ₃ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree₃ mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl,

Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਪਤਿਤ ਅਸੰਖ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਕਰਿ ਪੁਨਹ ਪੁਨਹ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: patit asankh puneet kar punah punah balihaar |
English: Countless sinners have been purified; I am a sacrifice, over and over again, to You.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਪਾਵਕੋ ਤਿਨ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਦਾਹਨਹਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak raam naam jap paavako tin kilabikh daahanahaar |1|
English: O Nanak, meditation on the Lord's Name is the fire which burns away sinful mistakes like straw. ||1||

[Ang 248 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਛੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: chhant |
English: Chhant:

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਮਨਾ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਮ ਨਰਾਇਣੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਧੋ ॥
Transliteration: jap manaa toon raam naraaein govindaa har maadho |
English: Meditate, O my mind, on the Lord God, the Lord of the Universe, the Lord, the Master of Wealth.

Gurbani: ਧਿਆਇ ਮਨਾ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ਮੁਕੰਦੇ ਕਟੀਐ ਕਾਲ ਦੁਖ ਫਾਧੋ ॥
Transliteration: dhiaae manaa muraar mukande katteeai kaal dukh faadho |
English: Meditate, O my mind, on the Lord, the Destroyer of ego, the Giver of salvation, who cuts away the noose of agonizing death.

Gurbani: ਦੁਖਹਰਣ ਦੀਨ ਸਰਣ ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਅਰਾਧੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: dukhaharan deen saran sreedhar charan kamal araadheeai |
English: Meditate lovingly on the Lotus Feet of the Lord, the Destroyer of distress, the Protector of the poor, the Lord of excellence.

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਪੰਥੁ ਬਿਖੜਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਨਿਮਖ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਾਧੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: jam panth bikharraa agan saagar nimakh simarat saadheeai |
English: The treacherous path of death and the terrifying ocean of fire are crossed over by meditating in remembrance on the Lord, even for an instant.

Gurbani: ਕਲਿਮਲਹ ਦਹਤਾ ਸੁਧੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਅਰਾਧੋ ॥
Transliteration: kalimalah dahataa sudh karataa dinas rain araadho |
English: Meditate day and night on the Lord, the Destroyer of desire, the Purifier of pollution.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਮਾਧੋ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak karahu kirapaa gopaal gobind maadho |1|
English: Prays Nanak, please be Merciful to me, O Cherisher of the world, Lord of the Universe, Lord of wealth. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਮਨਾ ਦਾਮੋਦਰੁ ਦੁਖਹਰੁ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: simar manaa daamodar dukhahar bhai bhanjan har raaeaa |
English: O my mind, remember the Lord in meditation; He is the Destroyer of pain, the Eradicator of fear, the Sovereign Lord King.

Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰੀਰੰਗੋ ਦਇਆਲ ਮਨੋਹਰੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਬਿਰਦਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sreerango deaal manohar bhagat vachhal biradaaeaa |
English: He is the Greatest Lover, the Merciful Master, the Enticer of the mind, the Support of His devotees - this is His very nature.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਪੂਰਨ ਮਨਹਿ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat vachhal purakh pooran maneh chindiaa paaeeai |
English: The Perfect Lord is the Lover of His devotees; He fulfills the desires of the mind.

Gurbani: ਤਮ ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਉਧਾਰੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: tam andh koop te udhaarai naam man vasaaeeai |
English: He lifts us up out of the deep, dark pit; enshrine His Name within your mind.

Gurbani: ਸੁਰ ਸਿਧ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਗੁਣ ਅਨਿਕ ਭਗਤੀ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sur sidh gan gandharab mun jan gun anik bhagatee gaaeaa |
English: The gods, the Siddhas, the angels, the heavenly singers, the silent sages and the devotees sing Your countless Glorious Praises.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak karahu kirapaa paarabraham har raaeaa |2|
English: Prays Nanak, please be merciful to me, O Supreme Lord God, my King. ||2||

Gurbani: ਚੇਤਿ ਮਨਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: chet manaa paarabraham paramesar sarab kalaa jin dhaaree |
English: O my mind, be conscious of the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, who wields all power.

Gurbani: ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: karunaa mai samarath suaamee ghatt ghatt praan adhaaree |
English: He is All-powerful, the Embodiment of compassion. He is the Master of each and every heart;

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਜੀਅ ਦਾਤਾ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: praan man tan jeea daataa beant agam apaaro |
English: He is the Support of the breath of life. He is the Giver of the breath of life, of mind, body and soul. He is Infinite, Inaccessible and Unfathomable.

Gurbani: ਸਰਣਿ ਜੋਗੁ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਮੋਹਨੁ ਸਰਬ ਦੋਖ ਬਿਦਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: saran jog samarath mohan sarab dokh bidaaro |
English: The All-powerful Lord is our Sanctuary; He is the Enticer of the mind, who banishes all sorrows.

Gurbani: ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਸਭਿ ਦੋਖ ਬਿਨਸਹਿ ਜਪਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: rog sog sabh dokh binaseh japat naam muraaree |
English: All illnesses, sufferings and pains are dispelled, by chanting the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਮਰਥ ਸਭ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak karahu kirapaa samarath sabh kal dhaaree |3|
English: Prays Nanak, please be merciful to me, All-powerful Lord; You are the Wielder of all power. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ਮਨਾ ਅਚੁਤ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: gun gaau manaa achut abinaasee sabh te aooch deaalaa |
English: O my mind, sing the Glorious Praises of the Imperishable, Eternal, Merciful Master, the Highest of all.

Gurbani: ਬਿਸੰਭਰੁ ਦੇਵਨ ਕਉ ਏਕੈ ਸਰਬ ਕਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: bisanbhar devan kau ekai sarab karai pratipaalaa |
English: The One Lord is the Sustainer of the Universe, the Great Giver; He is the Cherisher of all.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਮਹਾ ਦਇਆਲ ਦਾਨਾ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰੇ ਸਭ ਕਿਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: pratipaal mahaa deaal daanaa deaa dhaare sabh kisai |
English: The Cherisher Lord is so very merciful and wise; He is compassionate to all.

Gurbani: ਕਾਲੁ ਕੰਟਕੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਨਾਸੈ ਜੀਅ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: kaal kanttak lobh mohu naasai jeea jaa kai prabh basai |
English: The pains of death, greed and emotional attachment simply vanish, when God comes to dwell in the soul.

Gurbani: ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਦੇਵਾ ਸਫਲ ਸੇਵਾ ਭਈ ਪੂਰਨ ਘਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: suprasan devaa safal sevaa bhee pooran ghaalaa |
English: When the Lord is thoroughly pleased, then one's service becomes perfectly fruitful.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਛ ਪੁਨੀ ਜਪਤ ਦੀਨ ਦੈਆਲਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak ichh punee japat deen daiaalaa |4|3|
English: Prays Nanak, my desires are fulfilled by meditating on the Lord, Merciful to the meek. ||4||3||

[Ang 249 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਖੀਏ ਮਿਲਿ ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰੇਹਾ ਮਨਾਇ ਲੈਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਤੈ ॥
Transliteration: sun sakhee mil udam karehaa manaae laihi har kantai |
English: Listen, O my companions: let's join together and make the effort, to surrender to our Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਾਨੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਕਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਮੋਹਹ ਸਾਧੂ ਮੰਤੈ ॥
Transliteration: maan tiaag kar bhagat tthgauree mohah saadhoo mantai |
English: Renouncing our pride, let's charm Him with the potion of devotional worship, and the mantra of the Holy Saints.

Gurbani: ਸਖੀ ਵਸਿ ਆਇਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਇਹ ਰੀਤਿ ਭਲੀ ਭਗਵੰਤੈ ॥
Transliteration: sakhee vas aaeaa fir chhodd na jaaee ih reet bhalee bhagavantai |
English: O my companions, when He comes under our power, He shall never leave us again. This is the good nature of the Lord God.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਰਾ ਮਰਣ ਭੈ ਨਰਕ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਕਰੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੰਤੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak jaraa maran bhai narak nivaarai puneet karai tis jantai |1|
English: O Nanak, God dispels the fear of old age, death and hell; He purifies His beings. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਖੀਏ ਇਹ ਭਲੀ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਏਹੁ ਮਤਾਂਤੁ ਪਕਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: sun sakhee ih bhalee binantee ehu mataant pakaaeeai |
English: Listen, O my companions, to my sincere prayer: let's make this firm resolve.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਰਹਤ ਹੋਇ ਗੀਤ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਹਿ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj subhaae upaadh rehat hoe geet govindeh gaaeeai |
English: In the peaceful poise of intuitive bliss, violence will be gone, as we sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਨਾਸਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: kal kales mitteh bhram naaseh man chindiaa fal paaeeai |
English: Our pains and troubles shall be eradicated, and our doubts shall be dispelled; we will receive the fruits of our minds' desires.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: paarabraham pooran paramesar naanak naam dhiaaeeai |2|
English: O Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Supreme Lord God, the Perfect, Transcendent Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਖੀ ਇਛ ਕਰੀ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਖ ਮਨਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੀ ਆਸ ਪੁਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sakhee ichh karee nit sukh manaaee prabh meree aas pujaae |
English: O my companions, I yearn for Him continually; I invoke His Blessings, and pray that God may fulfill my hopes.

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਪਿਆਸੀ ਦਰਸ ਬੈਰਾਗਨਿ ਪੇਖਉ ਥਾਨ ਸਬਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: charan piaasee daras bairaagan pekhau thaan sabaae |
English: I thirst for His Feet, and I long for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; I look for Him everywhere.

Gurbani: ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਿਥ ਪੁਰਖ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: khoj lhau har sant janaa sang samrith purakh milaae |
English: I search for traces of the Lord in the Society of the Saints; they will unite me with the All-powerful Primal Lord God.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਰਿਜਨੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak tin miliaa surijan sukhadaataa se vaddabhaagee maae |3|
English: O Nanak, those humble, noble beings who meet the Lord, the Giver of peace, are very blessed, O my mother. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਖੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਵਸਾ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਨਾਹ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਿਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sakhee naal vasaa apune naah piaare meraa man tan har sang hiliaa |
English: O my companions, now I dwell with my Beloved Husband; my mind and body are attuned to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਖੀਏ ਮੇਰੀ ਨੀਦ ਭਲੀ ਮੈ ਆਪਨੜਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sun sakhee meree need bhalee mai aapanarraa pir miliaa |
English: Listen, O my companions: now I sleep well, since I found my Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਖੋਇਓ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਭਇਆ ਕਉਲੁ ਖਿਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: bhram khoeo saant sehaj suaamee paragaas bheaa kaul khiliaa |
English: My doubts have been dispelled, and I have found intuitive peace and tranquility through my Lord and Master. I have been enlightened, and my heart-lotus has blossomed forth.

Gurbani: ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ਨ ਟਲਿਆ ॥੪॥੪॥੨॥੫॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: var paaeaa prabh antarajaamee naanak sohaag na ttaliaa |4|4|2|5|11|
English: I have obtained God, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, as my Husband; O Nanak, my marriage shall last forever. ||4||4||2||5||11||

[Ang 250 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਬਾਵਨ ਅਖਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree baavan akharee mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Baavan Akhree ~ The 52 Letters, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਮਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਪਿਤਾ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: guradev maataa guradev pitaa guradev suaamee paramesuraa |
English: The Divine Guru is my mother, the Divine Guru is my father; the Divine Guru is my Transcendent Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸਖਾ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਬੰਧਿਪ ਸਹੋਦਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: guradev sakhaa agiaan bhanjan guradev bandhip sahodaraa |
English: The Divine Guru is my companion, the Destroyer of ignorance; the Divine Guru is my relative and brother.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੈ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਮੰਤੁ ਨਿਰੋਧਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: guradev daataa har naam upadesai guradev mant nirodharaa |
English: The Divine Guru is the Giver, the Teacher of the Lord's Name. The Divine Guru is the Mantra which never fails.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸ ਪਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: guradev saant sat budh moorat guradev paaras paras paraa |
English: The Divine Guru is the Image of peace, truth and wisdom. The Divine Guru is the Philosopher's Stone - touching it, one is transformed.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੋਵਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਮਜਨੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: guradev teerath amrit sarovar gur giaan majan aparanparaa |
English: The Divine Guru is the sacred shrine of pilgrimage, and the pool of divine ambrosia; bathing in the Guru's wisdom, one experiences the Infinite.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਪ ਹਰਤਾ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵਿਤ ਕਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: guradev karataa sabh paap harataa guradev patit pavit karaa |
English: The Divine Guru is the Creator, and the Destroyer of all sins; the Divine Guru is the Purifier of sinners.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਮੰਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਉਧਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: guradev aad jugaad jug jug guradev mant har jap udharaa |
English: The Divine Guru existed at the primal beginning, throughout the ages, in each and every age. The Divine Guru is the Mantra of the Lord's Name; chanting it, one is saved.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਲਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਮ ਮੂੜ ਪਾਪੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਗਿ ਤਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: guradev sangat prabh mel kar kirapaa ham moorr paapee jit lag taraa |
English: O God, please be merciful to me, that I may be with the Divine Guru; I am a foolish sinner, but holding onto Him, I am carried across.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਮਸਕਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: guradev satigur paarabraham paramesar guradev naanak har namasakaraa |1|
English: The Divine Guru is the True Guru, the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord; Nanak bows in humble reverence to the Lord, the Divine Guru. ||1||

[Ang 250 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਆਪਹਿ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਾਇਆ ਆਪਹਿ ਕਰਨੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: aapeh keea karaaeaa aapeh karanai jog |
English: He Himself acts, and causes others to act; He Himself can do everything.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਦੂਸਰ ਹੋਆ ਨ ਹੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak eko rav rahiaa doosar hoaa na hog |1|
English: O Nanak, the One Lord is pervading everywhere; there has never been any other, and there never shall be. ||1||

[Ang 250 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਓਅੰ ਸਾਧ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੰ ॥
Transliteration: oan saadh satigur namasakaaran |
English: ONG: I humbly bow in reverence to the One Universal Creator, to the Holy True Guru.

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੰ ॥
Transliteration: aad madh ant nirankaaran |
English: In the beginning, in the middle, and in the end, He is the Formless Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਪਹਿ ਸੁੰਨ ਆਪਹਿ ਸੁਖ ਆਸਨ ॥
Transliteration: aapeh sun aapeh sukh aasan |
English: He Himself is in the absolute state of primal meditation; He Himself is in the seat of peace.

Gurbani: ਆਪਹਿ ਸੁਨਤ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਜਾਸਨ ॥
Transliteration: aapeh sunat aap hee jaasan |
English: He Himself listens to His Own Praises.

Gurbani: ਆਪਨ ਆਪੁ ਆਪਹਿ ਉਪਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: aapan aap aapeh upaaeo |
English: He Himself created Himself.

Gurbani: ਆਪਹਿ ਬਾਪ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਮਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: aapeh baap aap hee maaeo |
English: He is His Own Father, He is His Own Mother.

Gurbani: ਆਪਹਿ ਸੂਖਮ ਆਪਹਿ ਅਸਥੂਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: aapeh sookham aapeh asathoolaa |
English: He Himself is subtle and etheric; He Himself is manifest and obvious.

Gurbani: ਲਖੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੀਲਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: lakhee na jaaee naanak leelaa |1|
English: O Nanak, His wondrous play cannot be understood. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh deen deaalaa |
English: O God, Merciful to the meek, please be kind to me,

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੇ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਰਵਾਲਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tere santan kee man hoe ravaalaa | rahaau |
English: that my mind might become the dust of the feet of Your Saints. ||Pause||

[Ang 250 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਆਕਾਰ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਸਰਗੁਨ ਏਕ ॥
Transliteration: nirankaar aakaar aap niragun saragun ek |
English: He Himself is formless, and also formed; the One Lord is without attributes, and also with attributes.

Gurbani: ਏਕਹਿ ਏਕ ਬਖਾਨਨੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕ ਅਨੇਕ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ekeh ek bakhaanano naanak ek anek |1|
English: Describe the One Lord as One, and Only One; O Nanak, He is the One, and the many. ||1||

[Ang 250 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਓਅੰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੀਓ ਅਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: oan guramukh keeo akaaraa |
English: ONG: The One Universal Creator created the Creation through the Word of the Primal Guru.

Gurbani: ਏਕਹਿ ਸੂਤਿ ਪਰੋਵਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: ekeh soot parovanahaaraa |
English: He strung it upon His one thread.

Gurbani: ਭਿੰਨ ਭਿੰਨ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੰ ॥
Transliteration: bhin bhin trai gun bisathaaran |
English: He created the diverse expanse of the three qualities.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਤੇ ਸਰਗੁਨ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਰੰ ॥
Transliteration: niragun te saragun drisattaaran |
English: From formless, He appeared as form.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਭਾਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਉਪਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: sagal bhaat kar kareh upaaeo |
English: The Creator has created the creation of all sorts.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਮਨ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਢਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: janam maran man mohu badtaaeo |
English: The attachment of the mind has led to birth and death.

Gurbani: ਦੁਹੂ ਭਾਤਿ ਤੇ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: duhoo bhaat te aap niraaraa |
English: He Himself is above both, untouched and unaffected.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak ant na paaraavaaraa |2|
English: O Nanak, He has no end or limitation. ||2||

[Ang 250 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਸੇਈ ਸਾਹ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਸੇ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਪੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: seee saah bhagavant se sach sanpai har raas |
English: Those who gather Truth, and the riches of the Lord's Name, are rich and very fortunate.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਚਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਤਿਹ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak sach such paaeeai tih santan kai paas |1|
English: O Nanak, truthfulness and purity are obtained from Saints such as these. ||1||

[Ang 250 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਵੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: pavarree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸਸਾ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸੋਊ ॥
Transliteration: sasaa sat sat sat soaoo |
English: SASSA: True, True, True is that Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਤੇ ਭਿੰਨ ਨ ਕੋਊ ॥
Transliteration: sat purakh te bhin na koaoo |
English: No one is separate from the True Primal Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੋਊ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੈ ਜਿਹ ਪਾਯੰ ॥
Transliteration: soaoo saran parai jih paayan |
English: They alone enter the Lord's Sanctuary, whom the Lord inspires to enter.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਸੁਨਾਯੰ ॥
Transliteration: simar simar gun gaae sunaayan |
English: Meditating, meditating in remembrance, they sing and preach the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੰਸੈ ਭਰਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਬਿਆਪਤ ॥
Transliteration: sansai bharam nahee kachh biaapat |
English: Doubt and skepticism do not affect them at all.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ਤਾਹੂ ਕੋ ਜਾਪਤ ॥
Transliteration: pragatt prataap taahoo ko jaapat |
English: They behold the manifest glory of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਾਧੂ ਇਹ ਪਹੁਚਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: so saadhoo ih pahuchanahaaraa |
English: They are the Holy Saints - they reach this destination.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak taa kai sad balihaaraa |3|
English: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to them. ||3||

[Ang 250 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਪੁਕਾਰਤੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਸਭ ਕੂਰ ॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan kahaa pukaarate maaeaa moh sabh koor |
English: Why are you crying out for riches and wealth? All this emotional attachment to Maya is false.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਨੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਹੋਤ ਜਾਤ ਸਭੁ ਧੂਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naam bihoone naanakaa hot jaat sabh dhoor |1|
English: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O Nanak, all are reduced to dust. ||1||

[Ang 251 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਵੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: pavarree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਧਧਾ ਧੂਰਿ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨੂਆ ॥
Transliteration: dhadhaa dhoor puneet tere janooaa |
English: DHADHA: The dust of the feet of the Saints is sacred.

Gurbani: ਧਨਿ ਤੇਊ ਜਿਹ ਰੁਚ ਇਆ ਮਨੂਆ ॥
Transliteration: dhan teaoo jih ruch eaa manooaa |
English: Blessed are those whose minds are filled with this longing.

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਛਹਿ ਸੁਰਗ ਨ ਆਛਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: dhan nahee baachheh surag na aachheh |
English: They do not seek wealth, and they do not desire paradise.

Gurbani: ਅਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਰਜ ਰਾਚਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: at pria preet saadh raj raacheh |
English: They are immersed in the deep love of their Beloved, and the dust of the feet of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਧੰਧੇ ਕਹਾ ਬਿਆਪਹਿ ਤਾਹੂ ॥
Transliteration: dhandhe kahaa biaapeh taahoo |
English: How can worldly affairs affect those,

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਏਕ ਛਾਡਿ ਅਨ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਹੂ ॥
Transliteration: jo ek chhaadd an kateh na jaahoo |
English: Who do not abandon the One Lord, and who go nowhere else?

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹੀਐ ਦੀਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai heeai deeo prabh naam |
English: One whose heart is filled with God's Name,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak saadh pooran bhagavaan |4|
English: O Nanak, is a perfect spiritual being of God. ||4||

[Ang 251 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਭੇਖ ਅਰੁ ਙਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਮਨਹਠਿ ਮਿਲਿਅਉ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: anik bhekh ar ngiaan dhiaan manahatth miliaau na koe |
English: By all sorts of religious robes, knowledge, meditation and stubborn-mindedness, no one has ever met God.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਈ ਭਗਤੁ ਙਿਆਨੀ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak kirapaa bhee bhagat ngiaanee soe |1|
English: Says Nanak, those upon whom God showers His Mercy, are devotees of spiritual wisdom. ||1||

[Ang 251 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਙੰਙਾ ਙਿਆਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਮੁਖ ਬਾਤਉ ॥
Transliteration: ngangaa ngiaan nahee mukh baatau |
English: NGANGA: Spiritual wisdom is not obtained by mere words of mouth.

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਤਉ ॥
Transliteration: anik jugat saasatr kar bhaatau |
English: It is not obtained through the various debates of the Shaastras and scriptures.

Gurbani: ਙਿਆਨੀ ਸੋਇ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਦ੍ਰਿੜ ਸੋਊ ॥
Transliteration: ngiaanee soe jaa kai drirr soaoo |
English: They alone are spiritually wise, whose minds are firmly fixed on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਹਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਕਛੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਊ ॥
Transliteration: kehat sunat kachh jog na hoaoo |
English: Hearing and telling stories, no one attains Yoga.

Gurbani: ਙਿਆਨੀ ਰਹਤ ਆਗਿਆ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ॥
Transliteration: ngiaanee rehat aagiaa drirr jaa kai |
English: They alone are spiritually wise, who remain firmly committed to the Lord's Command.

Gurbani: ਉਸਨ ਸੀਤ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਸਭ ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥
Transliteration: ausan seet samasar sabh taa kai |
English: Heat and cold are all the same to them.

Gurbani: ਙਿਆਨੀ ਤਤੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: ngiaanee tat guramukh beechaaree |
English: The true people of spiritual wisdom are the Gurmukhs, who contemplate the essence of reality;

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak jaa kau kirapaa dhaaree |5|
English: O Nanak, the Lord showers His Mercy upon them. ||5||

[Ang 251 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:
