Gurbani: ਆਵਨ ਆਏ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਪਸੁ ਢੋਰ ॥
Transliteration: aavan aae srisatt meh bin boojhe pas dtor |
English: Those who have come into the world without understanding are like animals and beasts.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋ ਬੁਝੈ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਭਾਗ ਮਥੋਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh so bujhai jaa kai bhaag mathor |1|
English: O Nanak, those who become Gurmukh understand; upon their foreheads is such pre-ordained destiny. ||1||

[Ang 251 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਯਾ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਏਕਹਿ ਕਉ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: yaa jug meh ekeh kau aaeaa |
English: They have come into this world to meditate on the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮਤ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: janamat mohio mohanee maaeaa |
English: But ever since their birth, they have been enticed by the fascination of Maya.

Gurbani: ਗਰਭ ਕੁੰਟ ਮਹਿ ਉਰਧ ਤਪ ਕਰਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: garabh kuntt meh uradh tap karate |
English: Upside-down in the chamber of the womb, they performed intense meditation.

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਹਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: saas saas simarat prabh rahate |
English: They remembered God in meditation with each and every breath.

Gurbani: ਉਰਝਿ ਪਰੇ ਜੋ ਛੋਡਿ ਛਡਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: aurajh pare jo chhodd chhaddaanaa |
English: But now, they are entangled in things which they must leave behind.

Gurbani: ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਬਿਸਰਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: devanahaar maneh bisaraanaa |
English: They forget the Great Giver from their minds.

Gurbani: ਧਾਰਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: dhaarahu kirapaa jiseh gusaaee |
English: O Nanak, those upon whom the Lord showers His Mercy,

Gurbani: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਸਰਹੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: eit ut naanak tis bisarahu naahee |6|
English: do not forget Him, here or hereafter. ||6||

[Ang 251 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਆਵਤ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਬਿਨਾਸ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਆਗਿਆ ਭਿੰਨ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aavat hukam binaas hukam aagiaa bhin na koe |
English: By His Command, we come, and by His Command, we go; no one is beyond His Command.

Gurbani: ਆਵਨ ਜਾਨਾ ਤਿਹ ਮਿਟੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਹ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aavan jaanaa tih mittai naanak jih man soe |1|
English: Coming and going in reincarnation is ended, O Nanak, for those whose minds are filled with the Lord. ||1||

[Ang 251 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਏਊ ਜੀਅ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਗ੍ਰਭ ਵਾਸੇ ॥
Transliteration: eaoo jeea bahut grabh vaase |
English: This soul has lived in many wombs.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਮੀਠ ਜੋਨਿ ਫਾਸੇ ॥
Transliteration: moh magan meetth jon faase |
English: Enticed by sweet attachment, it has been trapped in reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਇਨਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਬਸਿ ਕੀਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: ein maaeaa trai gun bas keene |
English: This Maya has subjugated beings through the three qualities.

Gurbani: ਆਪਨ ਮੋਹ ਘਟੇ ਘਟਿ ਦੀਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: aapan moh ghatte ghatt deene |
English: Maya has infused attachment to itself in each and every heart.

Gurbani: ਏ ਸਾਜਨ ਕਛੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: e saajan kachh kahahu upaaeaa |
English: O friend, tell me some way,

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਤਰਉ ਬਿਖਮ ਇਹ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jaa te trau bikham ih maaeaa |
English: by which I may swim across this treacherous ocean of Maya.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa satasang milaae |
English: The Lord showers His Mercy, and leads us to join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਮਾਏ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: naanak taa kai nikatt na maae |7|
English: O Nanak, Maya does not even come near. ||7||

[Ang 251 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਤ ਕਮਾਵਨ ਸੁਭ ਅਸੁਭ ਕੀਨੇ ਤਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: kirat kamaavan subh asubh keene tin prabh aap |
English: God Himself causes one to perform good and bad actions.

Gurbani: ਪਸੁ ਆਪਨ ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਹਾ ਕਮਾਤਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: pas aapan hau hau karai naanak bin har kahaa kamaat |1|
English: The beast indulges in egotism, selfishness and conceit; O Nanak, without the Lord, what can anyone do? ||1||

[Ang 251 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਏਕਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਵਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: ekeh aap karaavanahaaraa |
English: The One Lord Himself is the Cause of all actions.

Gurbani: ਆਪਹਿ ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਬਿਸਥਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aapeh paap pun bisathaaraa |
English: He Himself distributes sins and noble acts.

Gurbani: ਇਆ ਜੁਗ ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਆਪਹਿ ਲਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: eaa jug jit jit aapeh laaeo |
English: In this age, people are attached as the Lord attaches them.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸੋ ਪਾਇਓ ਜੁ ਆਪਿ ਦਿਵਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: so so paaeo ju aap divaaeo |
English: They receive that which the Lord Himself gives.

Gurbani: ਉਆ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਊ ॥
Transliteration: auaa kaa ant na jaanai koaoo |
English: No one knows His limits.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਰੈ ਸੋਊ ਫੁਨਿ ਹੋਊ ॥
Transliteration: jo jo karai soaoo fun hoaoo |
English: Whatever He does, comes to pass.

Gurbani: ਏਕਹਿ ਤੇ ਸਗਲਾ ਬਿਸਥਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: ekeh te sagalaa bisathaaraa |
English: From the One, the entire expanse of the Universe emanated.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰਨਹਾਰਾ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: naanak aap savaaranahaaraa |8|
English: O Nanak, He Himself is our Saving Grace. ||8||

[Ang 251 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਰਾਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਕੁਸਮ ਰੰਗ ਬਿਖ ਸੋਰ ॥
Transliteration: raach rahe banitaa binod kusam rang bikh sor |
English: Man remains engrossed in women and playful pleasures; the tumult of his passion is like the dye of the safflower, which fades away all too soon.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਹ ਸਰਨੀ ਪਰਉ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਮੈ ਮੋਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak tih saranee prau binas jaae mai mor |1|
English: O Nanak, seek God's Sanctuary, and your selfishness and conceit shall be taken away. ||1||

[Ang 252 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਹ ਰਚਹੁ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਬੰਧਨ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: re man bin har jeh rachahu teh teh bandhan paeh |
English: O mind: without the Lord, whatever you are involved in shall bind you in chains.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਤਹੂ ਨ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਸਾਕਤ ਤੇਊ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jih bidh katahoo na chhootteeai saakat teaoo kamaeh |
English: The faithless cynic does those deeds which will never allow him to be emancipated.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਰਮ ਰਤ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਭਾਰੁ ਅਫਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: hau hau karate karam rat taa ko bhaar afaar |
English: Acting in egotism, selfishness and conceit, the lovers of rituals carry the unbearable load.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਉ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਤਉ ਏਊ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: preet nahee jau naam siau tau eaoo karam bikaar |
English: When there is no love for the Naam, then these rituals are corrupt.

Gurbani: ਬਾਧੇ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਜੇਵਰੀ ਮੀਠੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ॥
Transliteration: baadhe jam kee jevaree meetthee maaeaa rang |
English: The rope of death binds those who are in love with the sweet taste of Maya.

Gurbani: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੇ ਮੋਹੇ ਨਹ ਬੁਝਹਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਹੂ ਸੰਗ ॥
Transliteration: bhram ke mohe neh bujheh so prabh sadahoo sang |
English: Deluded by doubt, they do not understand that God is always with them.

Gurbani: ਲੇਖੈ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਕਾਚੀ ਭੀਤਿ ਨ ਸੁਧਿ ॥
Transliteration: lekhai ganat na chhootteeai kaachee bheet na sudh |
English: When their accounts are called for, they shall not be released; their wall of mud cannot be washed clean.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਤਿਹ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬੁਧਿ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: jiseh bujhaae naanakaa tih guramukh niramal budh |9|
English: One who is made to understand - O Nanak, that Gurmukh obtains immaculate understanding. ||9||

[Ang 252 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਟੂਟੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਜਾਸੁ ਕੇ ਹੋਆ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: ttootte bandhan jaas ke hoaa saadhoo sang |
English: One whose bonds are cut away joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਰਾਤੇ ਰੰਗ ਏਕ ਕੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੂੜਾ ਰੰਗੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jo raate rang ek kai naanak goorraa rang |1|
English: Those who are imbued with the Love of the One Lord, O Nanak, take on the deep and lasting color of His Love. ||1||

[Ang 252 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਰਾਰਾ ਰੰਗਹੁ ਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: raaraa rangahu eaa man apanaa |
English: RARRA: Dye this heart of yours in the color of the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਜਪੁ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam japahu jap rasanaa |
English: Meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har - chant it with your tongue.

Gurbani: ਰੇ ਰੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਕਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਊ ॥
Transliteration: re re daragah kahai na koaoo |
English: In the Court of the Lord, no one shall speak harshly to you.

Gurbani: ਆਉ ਬੈਠੁ ਆਦਰੁ ਸੁਭ ਦੇਊ ॥
Transliteration: aau baitth aadar subh deaoo |
English: Everyone shall welcome you, saying, "Come, and sit down."

Gurbani: ਉਆ ਮਹਲੀ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਤੂ ਬਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: auaa mahalee paaveh too baasaa |
English: In that Mansion of the Lord's Presence, you shall find a home.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਨਹ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਨਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: janam maran neh hoe binaasaa |
English: There is no birth or death, or destruction there.

Gurbani: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਲਿਖਿਓ ਧੁਰਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ॥
Transliteration: masatak karam likhio dhur jaa kai |
English: One who has such karma written on his forehead,

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਪੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਘਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: har sanpai naanak ghar taa kai |10|
English: O Nanak, has the wealth of the Lord in his home. ||10||

[Ang 252 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਲਾਲਚ ਝੂਠ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਮੂੜੇ ਅੰਧ ॥
Transliteration: laalach jhootth bikaar moh biaapat moorre andh |
English: Greed, falsehood, corruption and emotional attachment entangle the blind and the foolish.

Gurbani: ਲਾਗਿ ਪਰੇ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਸਿਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਬੰਧ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: laag pare duragandh siau naanak maaeaa bandh |1|
English: Bound down by Maya, O Nanak, a foul odor clings to them. ||1||

[Ang 252 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਲਲਾ ਲਪਟਿ ਬਿਖੈ ਰਸ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: lalaa lapatt bikhai ras raate |
English: LALLA: People are entangled in the love of corrupt pleasures;

Gurbani: ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦ ਮਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: ahanbudh maaeaa mad maate |
English: they are drunk with the wine of egotistical intellect and Maya.

Gurbani: ਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਮਰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: eaa maaeaa meh janameh maranaa |
English: In this Maya, they are born and die.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਤਿਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jiau jiau hukam tivai tiau karanaa |
English: People act according to the Hukam of the Lord's Command.

Gurbani: ਕੋਊ ਊਨ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: koaoo aoon na koaoo pooraa |
English: No one is perfect, and no one is imperfect.

Gurbani: ਕੋਊ ਸੁਘਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਮੂਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: koaoo sughar na koaoo mooraa |
English: No one is wise, and no one is foolish.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jit jit laavahu tith tit laganaa |
English: Wherever the Lord engages someone, there he is engaged.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਦਾ ਅਲਿਪਨਾ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: naanak tthaakur sadaa alipanaa |11|
English: O Nanak, our Lord and Master is forever detached. ||11||

[Ang 252 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਲਾਲ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਅਥਾਹ ॥
Transliteration: laal gupaal gobind prabh gahir ganbheer athaah |
English: My Beloved God, the Sustainer of the World, the Lord of the Universe, is deep, profound and unfathomable.

Gurbani: ਦੂਸਰ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਵਰ ਕੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: doosar naahee avar ko naanak beparavaah |1|
English: There is no other like Him; O Nanak, He is not worried. ||1||

[Ang 252 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਲਲਾ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਕੋਊ ॥
Transliteration: lalaa taa kai lavai na koaoo |
English: LALLA: There is no one equal to Him.

Gurbani: ਏਕਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਅਵਰ ਨਹ ਹੋਊ ॥
Transliteration: ekeh aap avar neh hoaoo |
English: He Himself is the One; there shall never be any other.

Gurbani: ਹੋਵਨਹਾਰੁ ਹੋਤ ਸਦ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: hovanahaar hot sad aaeaa |
English: He is now, He has been, and He shall always be.

Gurbani: ਉਆ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: auaa kaa ant na kaahoo paaeaa |
English: No one has ever found His limit.

Gurbani: ਕੀਟ ਹਸਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਪੂਰ ਸਮਾਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: keett hasat meh poor samaane |
English: In the ant and in the elephant, He is totally pervading.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪੁਰਖ ਸਭ ਠਾਊ ਜਾਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: pragatt purakh sabh tthaaoo jaane |
English: The Lord, the Primal Being, is known by everyone everywhere.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦੀਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kau deeno har ras apanaa |
English: That one, unto whom the Lord has given His Love

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਹ ਜਪਨਾ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh har har tih japanaa |12|
English: - O Nanak, that Gurmukh chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||12||

[Ang 252 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਆਤਮ ਰਸੁ ਜਿਹ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: aatam ras jih jaaniaa har rang sahaje maan |
English: One who knows the taste of the Lord's sublime essence, intuitively enjoys the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਧਨਿ ਧਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਜਨ ਆਏ ਤੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak dhan dhan dhan jan aae te paravaan |1|
English: O Nanak, blessed, blessed, blessed are the Lord's humble servants; how fortunate is their coming into the world! ||1||

[Ang 252 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਆਇਆ ਸਫਲ ਤਾਹੂ ਕੋ ਗਨੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: aaeaa safal taahoo ko ganeeai |
English: How fruitful is the coming into the world, of those

Gurbani: ਜਾਸੁ ਰਸਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਭਨੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: jaas rasan har har jas bhaneeai |
English: whose tongues celebrate the Praises of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਆਇ ਬਸਹਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਸੰਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: aae baseh saadhoo kai sange |
English: They come and dwell with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy;

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਰੰਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: anadin naam dhiaaveh range |
English: night and day, they lovingly meditate on the Naam.

Gurbani: ਆਵਤ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਮਹਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: aavat so jan naameh raataa |
English: Blessed is the birth of those humble beings who are attuned to the Naam;

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦਇਆ ਮਇਆ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kau deaa meaa bidhaataa |
English: the Lord, the Architect of Destiny, bestows His Kind Mercy upon them.

Gurbani: ਏਕਹਿ ਆਵਨ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: ekeh aavan fir jon na aaeaa |
English: They are born only once - they shall not be reincarnated again.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਦਰਸਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: naanak har kai daras samaaeaa |13|
English: O Nanak, they are absorbed into the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||13||

[Ang 252 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਯਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: yaas japat man hoe anand binasai doojaa bhaau |
English: Chanting it, the mind is filled with bliss; love of duality is eliminated, and pain, distress and desires are quenched.

Gurbani: ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੁਝੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dookh darad trisanaa bujhai naanak naam samaau |1|
English: O Nanak, immerse yourself in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

[Ang 253 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਯਯਾ ਜਾਰਉ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੋਊ ॥
Transliteration: yayaa jaarau duramat doaoo |
English: YAYYA: Burn away duality and evil-mindedness.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੋਊ ॥
Transliteration: tiseh tiaag sukh sahaje soaoo |
English: Give them up, and sleep in intuitive peace and poise.

Gurbani: ਯਯਾ ਜਾਇ ਪਰਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਸਰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: yayaa jaae parahu sant saranaa |
English: Yaya: Go, and seek the Sanctuary of the Saints;

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਆਸਰ ਇਆ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jih aasar eaa bhavajal taranaa |
English: with their help, you shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਯਯਾ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਸੋਊ ॥
Transliteration: yayaa janam na aavai soaoo |
English: Yaya: One who weaves the One Name into his heart,

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਨਾਮ ਲੇ ਮਨਹਿ ਪਰੋਊ ॥
Transliteration: ek naam le maneh paroaoo |
English: Does not have to take birth again.

Gurbani: ਯਯਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹਾਰੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ॥
Transliteration: yayaa janam na haareeai gur poore kee ttek |
English: Yaya: This human life shall not be wasted, if you take the Support of the Perfect Guru.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਹ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਏਕ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: naanak tih sukh paaeaa jaa kai heearai ek |14|
English: O Nanak, one whose heart is filled with the One Lord finds peace. ||14||

[Ang 253 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਬਸਿ ਰਹੇ ਈਤ ਊਤ ਕੇ ਮੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: antar man tan bas rahe eet aoot ke meet |
English: The One who dwells deep within the mind and body is your friend here and hereafter.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪੀਐ ਨੀਤ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur poorai upadesiaa naanak japeeai neet |1|
English: The Perfect Guru has taught me, O Nanak, to chant His Name continually. ||1||

[Ang 253 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਤਾਸੁ ਕਉ ਜੋ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: anadin simarahu taas kau jo ant sahaaee hoe |
English: Night and day, meditate in remembrance on the One who will be your Help and Support in the end.

Gurbani: ਇਹ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ਛਿਅ ਛਾਡਿ ਚਲਿਓ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: eih bikhiaa din chaar chhia chhaadd chalio sabh koe |
English: This poison shall last for only a few days; everyone must depart, and leave it behind.

Gurbani: ਕਾ ਕੋ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਧੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: kaa ko maat pitaa sut dheea |
English: Who is our mother, father, son and daughter?

Gurbani: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਕਛੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਲੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: grih banitaa kachh sang na leea |
English: Household, wife, and other things shall not go along with you.

Gurbani: ਐਸੀ ਸੰਚਿ ਜੁ ਬਿਨਸਤ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: aisee sanch ju binasat naahee |
English: So gather that wealth which shall never perish,

Gurbani: ਪਤਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: pat setee apunai ghar jaahee |
English: so that you may go to your true home with honor.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਕਲਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang kal keeratan gaaeaa |
English: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, those who sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਤੇ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: naanak te te bahur na aaeaa |15|
English: - O Nanak, they do not have to endure reincarnation again. ||15||

[Ang 253 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਅਤਿ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਕੁਲੀਨ ਚਤੁਰ ਮੁਖਿ ਙਿਆਨੀ ਧਨਵੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: at sundar kuleen chatur mukh ngiaanee dhanavant |
English: He may be very handsome, born into a highly respected family, very wise, a famous spiritual teacher, prosperous and wealthy;

Gurbani: ਮਿਰਤਕ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: miratak kaheeeh naanakaa jih preet nahee bhagavant |1|
English: but even so, he is looked upon as a corpse, O Nanak, if he does not love the Lord God. ||1||

[Ang 253 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਙੰਙਾ ਖਟੁ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਹੋਇ ਙਿਆਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: ngangaa khatt saasatr hoe ngiaataa |
English: NGANGA: He may be a scholar of the six Shaastras.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਕੁ ਕੁੰਭਕ ਰੇਚਕ ਕਰਮਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: poorak kunbhak rechak karamaataa |
English: He may practice inhaling, exhaling and holding the breath.

Gurbani: ਙਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਤੀਰਥ ਇਸਨਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: ngiaan dhiaan teerath isanaanee |
English: He may practice spiritual wisdom, meditation, pilgrimages to sacred shrines and ritual cleansing baths.

Gurbani: ਸੋਮਪਾਕ ਅਪਰਸ ਉਦਿਆਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: somapaak aparas udiaanee |
English: He may cook his own food, and never touch anyone else's; he may live in the wilderness like a hermit.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਹੇਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam sang man nahee hetaa |
English: But if he does not enshrine love for the Lord's Name within his heart,

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਛੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਸੋਊ ਅਨੇਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo kachh keeno soaoo anetaa |
English: then everything he does is transitory.

Gurbani: ਉਆ ਤੇ ਊਤਮੁ ਗਨਉ ਚੰਡਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: auaa te aootam gnau chanddaalaa |
English: Even an untouchable pariah is superior to him,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਹ ਮਨਿ ਬਸਹਿ ਗੁਪਾਲਾ ॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: naanak jih man baseh gupaalaa |16|
English: O Nanak, if the Lord of the World abides in his mind. ||16||

[Ang 253 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਕੁੰਟ ਚਾਰਿ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕੀ ਰੇਖ ॥
Transliteration: kuntt chaar deh dis bhrame karam kirat kee rekh |
English: He wanders around in the four quarters and in the ten directions, according to the dictates of his karma.

Gurbani: ਸੂਖ ਦੂਖ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਖਿਓ ਲੇਖ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sookh dookh mukat jon naanak likhio lekh |1|
English: Pleasure and pain, liberation and reincarnation, O Nanak, come according to one's pre-ordained destiny. ||1||

[Ang 253 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਵੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: pavarree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਕਕਾ ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੋਊ ॥
Transliteration: kakaa kaaran karataa soaoo |
English: KAKKA: He is the Creator, the Cause of causes.

Gurbani: ਲਿਖਿਓ ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਮੇਟਤ ਕੋਊ ॥
Transliteration: likhio lekh na mettat koaoo |
English: No one can erase His pre-ordained plan.

Gurbani: ਨਹੀ ਹੋਤ ਕਛੁ ਦੋਊ ਬਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: nahee hot kachh doaoo baaraa |
English: Nothing can be done a second time.

Gurbani: ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੁ ਨ ਭੂਲਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: karanaihaar na bhoolanahaaraa |
English: The Creator Lord does not make mistakes.

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੂ ਪੰਥੁ ਦਿਖਾਰੈ ਆਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: kaahoo panth dikhaarai aapai |
English: To some, He Himself shows the Way.

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੂ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਪਛੁਤਾਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: kaahoo udiaan bhramat pachhutaapai |
English: While He causes others to wander miserably in the wilderness.

Gurbani: ਆਪਨ ਖੇਲੁ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਕੀਨੋ ॥
Transliteration: aapan khel aap hee keeno |
English: He Himself has set His own play in motion.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਦੀਨੋ ਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੀਨੋ ॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: jo jo deeno su naanak leeno |17|
English: Whatever He gives, O Nanak, that is what we receive. ||17||

[Ang 253 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਖਾਤ ਖਰਚਤ ਬਿਲਛਤ ਰਹੇ ਟੂਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: khaat kharachat bilachhat rahe ttoott na jaeh bhanddaar |
English: People continue to eat and consume and enjoy, but the Lord's warehouses are never exhausted.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤ ਅਨੇਕ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਹਿ ਸੁਮਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har har japat anek jan naanak naeh sumaar |1|
English: So many chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; O Nanak, they cannot be counted. ||1||

[Ang 253 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਖਖਾ ਖੂਨਾ ਕਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥ ਕੈ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: khakhaa khoonaa kachh nahee tis samrath kai paeh |
English: KHAKHA: The All-powerful Lord lacks nothing;

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਦੇਨਾ ਸੋ ਦੇ ਰਹਿਓ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jo denaa so de rahio bhaavai teh teh jaeh |
English: whatever He is to give, He continues to give - let anyone go anywhere he pleases.

Gurbani: ਖਰਚੁ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਇਆ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: kharach khajaanaa naam dhan eaa bhagatan kee raas |
English: The wealth of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is a treasure to spend; it is the capital of His devotees.

Gurbani: ਖਿਮਾ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਅਨਦ ਸਹਜ ਜਪਤ ਰਹਹਿ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: khimaa gareebee anad sehaj japat raheh gunataas |
English: With tolerance, humility, bliss and intuitive poise, they continue to meditate on the Lord, the Treasure of excellence.

Gurbani: ਖੇਲਹਿ ਬਿਗਸਹਿ ਅਨਦ ਸਿਉ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹੋਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: kheleh bigaseh anad siau jaa kau hot kripaal |
English: Those, unto whom the Lord shows His Mercy, play happily and blossom forth.

Gurbani: ਸਦੀਵ ਗਨੀਵ ਸੁਹਾਵਨੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਮਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: sadeev ganeev suhaavane raam naam grihi maal |
English: Those who have the wealth of the Lord's Name in their homes are forever wealthy and beautiful.

Gurbani: ਖੇਦੁ ਨ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਡਾਨੁ ਤਿਹ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: khed na dookh na ddaan tih jaa kau nadar karee |
English: Those who are blessed with the Lord's Glance of Grace suffer neither torture, nor pain, nor punishment.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣਿਆ ਪੂਰੀ ਤਿਨਾ ਪਰੀ ॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: naanak jo prabh bhaaniaa pooree tinaa paree |18|
English: O Nanak, those who are pleasing to God become perfectly successful. ||18||

[Ang 254 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਗਨਿ ਮਿਨਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਮਨੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਰਪਰ ਚਲਨੋ ਲੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: gan min dekhahu manai maeh sarapar chalano log |
English: See, that even by calculating and scheming in their minds, people must surely depart in the end.

Gurbani: ਆਸ ਅਨਿਤ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਟੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਅਰੋਗ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aas anit guramukh mittai naanak naam arog |1|
English: Hopes and desires for transitory things are erased for the Gurmukh; O Nanak, the Name alone brings true health. ||1||

[Ang 254 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਗਗਾ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਹੁ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਜਪਿ ਨੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: gagaa gobid gun ravahu saas saas jap neet |
English: GAGGA: Chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe with each and every breath; meditate on Him forever.

Gurbani: ਕਹਾ ਬਿਸਾਸਾ ਦੇਹ ਕਾ ਬਿਲਮ ਨ ਕਰਿਹੋ ਮੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: kahaa bisaasaa deh kaa bilam na kariho meet |
English: How can you rely on the body? Do not delay, my friend;

Gurbani: ਨਹ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਨਹ ਜੋਬਨੈ ਨਹ ਬਿਰਧੀ ਕਛੁ ਬੰਧੁ ॥
Transliteration: neh baarik neh jobanai neh biradhee kachh bandh |
English: there is nothing to stand in Death's way - neither in childhood, nor in youth, nor in old age.

Gurbani: ਓਹ ਬੇਰਾ ਨਹ ਬੂਝੀਐ ਜਉ ਆਇ ਪਰੈ ਜਮ ਫੰਧੁ ॥
Transliteration: oeh beraa neh boojheeai jau aae parai jam fandh |
English: That time is not known, when the noose of Death shall come and fall on you.

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਚਤੁਰ ਪੇਖਿ ਰਹਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਇਹ ਠਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: giaanee dhiaanee chatur pekh rehan nahee ih tthaae |
English: See, that even spiritual scholars, those who meditate, and those who are clever shall not stay in this place.

Gurbani: ਛਾਡਿ ਛਾਡਿ ਸਗਲੀ ਗਈ ਮੂੜ ਤਹਾ ਲਪਟਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: chhaadd chhaadd sagalee gee moorr tahaa lapattaeh |
English: Only the fool clings to that, which everyone else has abandoned and left behind.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਰਹੈ ਜਾਹੂ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗ ॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad simarat rahai jaahoo masatak bhaag |
English: By Guru's Grace, one who has such good destiny written on his forehead remembers the Lord in meditation.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਏ ਸਫਲ ਤੇ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਅਹਿ ਸੁਹਾਗ ॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: naanak aae safal te jaa kau prieh suhaag |19|
English: O Nanak, blessed and fruitful is the coming of those who obtain the Beloved Lord as their Husband. ||19||

[Ang 254 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਘੋਖੇ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੇਦ ਸਭ ਆਨ ਨ ਕਥਤਉ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: ghokhe saasatr bed sabh aan na kathtau koe |
English: I have searched all the Shaastras and the Vedas, and they say nothing except this:

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਹੁਣਿ ਹੋਵਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aad jugaadee hun hovat naanak ekai soe |1|
English: "In the beginning, throughout the ages, now and forevermore, O Nanak, the One Lord alone exists." ||1||

[Ang 254 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਘਘਾ ਘਾਲਹੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਏਹ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਦੂਸਰ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: ghaghaa ghaalahu maneh eeh bin har doosar naeh |
English: GHAGHA: Put this into your mind, that there is no one except the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਹ ਹੋਆ ਨਹ ਹੋਵਨਾ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਓਹੀ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: neh hoaa neh hovanaa jat kat ohee samaeh |
English: There never was, and there never shall be. He is pervading everywhere.

Gurbani: ਘੂਲਹਿ ਤਉ ਮਨ ਜਉ ਆਵਹਿ ਸਰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: ghooleh tau man jau aaveh saranaa |
English: You shall be absorbed into Him, O mind, if you come to His Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਤਤੁ ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਪੁਨਹਚਰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: naam tat kal meh punahacharanaa |
English: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, only the Naam, the Name of the Lord, shall be of any real use to you.

Gurbani: ਘਾਲਿ ਘਾਲਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: ghaal ghaal anik pachhutaaveh |
English: So many work and slave continually, but they come to regret and repent in the end.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਹਾ ਥਿਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: bin har bhagat kahaa thit paaveh |
English: Without devotional worship of the Lord, how can they find stability?

Gurbani: ਘੋਲਿ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤਿਹ ਪੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: ghol mahaa ras amrit tih peea |
English: They alone taste the supreme essence, and drink in the Ambrosial Nectar,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦੀਆ ॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: naanak har gur jaa kau deea |20|
English: O Nanak, unto whom the Lord, the Guru, gives it. ||20||

[Ang 254 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਙਣਿ ਘਾਲੇ ਸਭ ਦਿਵਸ ਸਾਸ ਨਹ ਬਢਨ ਘਟਨ ਤਿਲੁ ਸਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: ngan ghaale sabh divas saas neh badtan ghattan til saar |
English: He has counted all the days and the breaths, and placed them in people's destiny; they do not increase or decrease one little bit.

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਨ ਲੋਰਹਿ ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇਊ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jeevan loreh bharam moh naanak teaoo gavaar |1|
English: Those who long to live in doubt and emotional attachment, O Nanak, are total fools. ||1||

[Ang 254 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਙੰਙਾ ਙ੍ਰਾਸੈ ਕਾਲੁ ਤਿਹ ਜੋ ਸਾਕਤ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨ ॥
Transliteration: ngangaa ngraasai kaal tih jo saakat prabh keen |
English: NGANGA: Death seizes those whom God has made into faithless cynics.

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੀਨ ॥
Transliteration: anik jon janameh mareh aatam raam na cheen |
English: They are born and they die, enduring countless incarnations; they do not realize the Lord, the Supreme Soul.

Gurbani: ਙਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਤਾਹੂ ਕਉ ਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: ngiaan dhiaan taahoo kau aae |
English: They alone find spiritual wisdom and meditation,

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਹ ਆਪਿ ਦਿਵਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa jih aap divaae |
English: whom the Lord blesses with His Mercy;

Gurbani: ਙਣਤੀ ਙਣੀ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਊ ਛੂਟੈ ॥
Transliteration: nganatee nganee nahee koaoo chhoottai |
English: no one is emancipated by counting and calculating.

Gurbani: ਕਾਚੀ ਗਾਗਰਿ ਸਰਪਰ ਫੂਟੈ ॥
Transliteration: kaachee gaagar sarapar foottai |
English: The vessel of clay shall surely break.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਜੀਵਤ ਜਿਹ ਜੀਵਤ ਜਪਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: so jeevat jih jeevat japiaa |
English: They alone live, who, while alive, meditate on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਹ ਛਪਿਆ ॥੨੧॥
Transliteration: pragatt bhe naanak neh chhapiaa |21|
English: They are respected, O Nanak, and do not remain hidden. ||21||

[Ang 254 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਚਿਤਿ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਚਰਣਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਊਧ ਕਵਲ ਬਿਗਸਾਂਤ ॥
Transliteration: chit chitvau charanaarabind aoodh kaval bigasaant |
English: Focus your consciousness on His Lotus Feet, and the inverted lotus of your heart shall blossom forth.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਏ ਆਪਹਿ ਗੋੁਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਮਤਾਂਤ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: pragatt bhe aapeh guobind naanak sant mataant |1|
English: The Lord of the Universe Himself becomes manifest, O Nanak, through the Teachings of the Saints. ||1||

[Ang 254 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਚਚਾ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਗੁਰ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: chachaa charan kamal gur laagaa |
English: CHACHA: Blessed, blessed is that day,

Gurbani: ਧਨਿ ਧਨਿ ਉਆ ਦਿਨ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਸਭਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan uaa din sanjog sabhaagaa |
English: when I became attached to the Lord's Lotus Feet.

Gurbani: ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: chaar kuntt deh dis bhram aaeo |
English: After wandering around in the four quarters and the ten directions,

Gurbani: ਭਈ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤਬ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: bhee kripaa tab darasan paaeo |
English: God showed His Mercy to me, and then I obtained the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

Gurbani: ਚਾਰ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਸਭ ਦੂਆ ॥
Transliteration: chaar bichaar binasio sabh dooaa |
English: By pure lifestyle and meditation, all duality is removed.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੂਆ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang man niramal hooaa |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the mind becomes immaculate.

Gurbani: ਚਿੰਤ ਬਿਸਾਰੀ ਏਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੇਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: chint bisaaree ek drisattetaa |
English: Anxieties are forgotten, and the One Lord alone is seen,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਜਿਹ ਨੇਤ੍ਰਾ ॥੨੨॥
Transliteration: naanak giaan anjan jih netraa |22|
English: O Nanak, by those whose eyes are anointed with the ointment of spiritual wisdom. ||22||

[Ang 254 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਛਾਤੀ ਸੀਤਲ ਮਨੁ ਸੁਖੀ ਛੰਤ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: chhaatee seetal man sukhee chhant gobid gun gaae |
English: The heart is cooled and soothed, and the mind is at peace, chanting and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਐਸੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aisee kirapaa karahu prabh naanak daas dasaae |1|
English: Show such Mercy, O God, that Nanak may become the slave of Your slaves. ||1||

[Ang 254 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਛਛਾ ਛੋਹਰੇ ਦਾਸ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: chhachhaa chhohare daas tumaare |
English: CHHACHHA: I am Your child-slave.

Gurbani: ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੇ ਪਾਨੀਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: daas daasan ke paaneehaare |
English: I am the water-carrier of the slave of Your slaves.

Gurbani: ਛਛਾ ਛਾਰੁ ਹੋਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਸੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: chhachhaa chhaar hot tere santaa |
English: Chhachha: I long to become the dust under the feet of Your Saints.

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: apanee kripaa karahu bhagavantaa |
English: Please shower me with Your Mercy, O Lord God!

Gurbani: ਛਾਡਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਬਹੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: chhaadd siaanap bahu chaturaaee |
English: I have given up my excessive cleverness and scheming,

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਮਨ ਟੇਕ ਟਿਕਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: santan kee man ttek ttikaaee |
English: and I have taken the support of the Saints as my mind's support.

Gurbani: ਛਾਰੁ ਕੀ ਪੁਤਰੀ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: chhaar kee putaree param gat paaee |
English: Even a puppet of ashes attains the supreme status,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੨੩॥
Transliteration: naanak jaa kau sant sahaaee |23|
English: O Nanak, if it has the help and support of the Saints. ||23||

[Ang 255 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਜੋਰ ਜੁਲਮ ਫੂਲਹਿ ਘਨੋ ਕਾਚੀ ਦੇਹ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: jor julam fooleh ghano kaachee deh bikaar |
English: Practicing oppression and tyranny, he puffs himself up; he acts in corruption with his frail, perishable body.

Gurbani: ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਪਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਛੁਟਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ahanbudh bandhan pare naanak naam chhuttaar |1|
English: He is bound by his egotistical intellect; O Nanak, salvation comes only through the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

[Ang 255 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਜਜਾ ਜਾਨੈ ਹਉ ਕਛੁ ਹੂਆ ॥
Transliteration: jajaa jaanai hau kachh hooaa |
English: JAJJA: When someone, in his ego, believes that he has become something,

Gurbani: ਬਾਧਿਓ ਜਿਉ ਨਲਿਨੀ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਸੂਆ ॥
Transliteration: baadhio jiau nalinee bhram sooaa |
English: he is caught in his error, like a parrot in a trap.

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਜਾਨੈ ਹਉ ਭਗਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: jau jaanai hau bhagat giaanee |
English: When he believes, in his ego, that he is a devotee and a spiritual teacher,

Gurbani: ਆਗੈ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: aagai tthaakur til nahee maanee |
English: then, in the world hereafter, the Lord of the Universe shall have no regard for him at all.

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਜਾਨੈ ਮੈ ਕਥਨੀ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: jau jaanai mai kathanee karataa |
English: When he believes himself to be a preacher,

Gurbani: ਬਿਆਪਾਰੀ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਜਿਉ ਫਿਰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: biaapaaree basudhaa jiau firataa |
English: he is merely a peddler wandering over the earth.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਿਹ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang jih haumai maaree |
English: But one who conquers his ego in the Company of the Holy,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੇ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੨੪॥
Transliteration: naanak taa kau mile muraaree |24|
English: O Nanak, meets the Lord. ||24||

[Ang 255 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਝਾਲਾਘੇ ਉਠਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਆਰਾਧਿ ॥
Transliteration: jhaalaaghe utth naam jap nis baasur aaraadh |
English: Rise early in the morning, and chant the Naam; worship and adore the Lord, night and day.

Gurbani: ਕਾਰ੍ਹਾ ਤੁਝੈ ਨ ਬਿਆਪਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਟੈ ਉਪਾਧਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kaarhaa tujhai na biaapee naanak mittai upaadh |1|
English: Anxiety shall not afflict you, O Nanak, and your misfortune shall vanish. ||1||

[Ang 255 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਝਝਾ ਝੂਰਨੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਤੁਮਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: jhajhaa jhooran mittai tumaaro |
English: JHAJHA: Your sorrows shall depart,

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam siau kar biauhaaro |
English: when you deal with the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਝੂਰਤ ਝੂਰਤ ਸਾਕਤ ਮੂਆ ॥
Transliteration: jhoorat jhoorat saakat mooaa |
English: The faithless cynic dies in sorrow and pain;

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਹੋਤ ਭਾਉ ਬੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai ridai hot bhaau beea |
English: his heart is filled with the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਝਰਹਿ ਕਸੰਮਲ ਪਾਪ ਤੇਰੇ ਮਨੂਆ ॥
Transliteration: jhareh kasamal paap tere manooaa |
English: Your evil deeds and sins shall fall away, O my mind,

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਥਾ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਨੂਆ ॥
Transliteration: amrit kathaa santasang sunooaa |
English: listening to the ambrosial speech in the Society of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਝਰਹਿ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਦ੍ਰੁਸਟਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jhareh kaam krodh drusattaaee |
English: Sexual desire, anger and wickedness fall away,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥੨੫॥
Transliteration: naanak jaa kau kripaa gusaaee |25|
English: O Nanak, from those who are blessed by the Mercy of the Lord of the World. ||25||

[Ang 255 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਞਤਨ ਕਰਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਿਧਿ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਮੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: yatan karahu tum anik bidh rehan na paavahu meet |
English: You can try all sorts of things, but you still cannot remain here, my friend.

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਤ ਰਹਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jeevat rahahu har har bhajahu naanak naam pareet |1|
English: But you shall live forevermore, O Nanak, if you vibrate and love the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

[Ang 255 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਵੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: pavarree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਞੰਞਾ ਞਾਣਹੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਸਹੀ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਤ ਏਹ ਹੇਤ ॥
Transliteration: yanyaa yaanahu drirr sahee binas jaat eeh het |
English: NYANYA: Know this as absolutely correct, that that this ordinary love shall come to an end.

Gurbani: ਗਣਤੀ ਗਣਉ ਨ ਗਣਿ ਸਕਉ ਊਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਰੇ ਕੇਤ ॥
Transliteration: ganatee gnau na gan skau aootth sidhaare ket |
English: You may count and calculate as much as you want, but you cannot count how many have arisen and departed.

Gurbani: ਞੋ ਪੇਖਉ ਸੋ ਬਿਨਸਤਉ ਕਾ ਸਿਉ ਕਰੀਐ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: yo pekhau so binastau kaa siau kareeai sang |
English: Whoever I see shall perish. With whom should I associate?

Gurbani: ਞਾਣਹੁ ਇਆ ਬਿਧਿ ਸਹੀ ਚਿਤ ਝੂਠਉ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: yaanahu eaa bidh sahee chit jhootthau maaeaa rang |
English: Know this as true in your consciousness, that the love of Maya is false.

Gurbani: ਞਾਣਤ ਸੋਈ ਸੰਤੁ ਸੁਇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਤੇ ਕੀਚਿਤ ਭਿੰਨ ॥
Transliteration: yaanat soee sant sue bhram te keechit bhin |
English: He alone knows, and he alone is a Saint, who is free of doubt.

Gurbani: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਤਿਹ ਕਢਹੁ ਜਿਹ ਹੋਵਹੁ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ॥
Transliteration: andh koop te tih kadtahu jih hovahu suprasan |
English: He is lifted up and out of the deep dark pit; the Lord is totally pleased with him.

Gurbani: ਞਾ ਕੈ ਹਾਥਿ ਸਮਰਥ ਤੇ ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨੈ ਜੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: yaa kai haath samarath te kaaran karanai jog |
English: God's Hand is All-powerful; He is the Creator, the Cause of causes.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਹ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਉ ਞਾਹੂ ਕੀਓ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥੨੬॥
Transliteration: naanak tih usatat krau yaahoo keeo sanjog |26|
English: O Nanak, praise the One, who joins us to Himself. ||26||

[Ang 255 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਟੂਟੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਸਾਧ ਸੇਵ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: ttootte bandhan janam maran saadh sev sukh paae |
English: The bondage of birth and death is broken and peace is obtained, by serving the Holy.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਬੀਸਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਰਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak manahu na beesarai gun nidh gobid raae |1|
English: O Nanak, may I never forget from my mind, the Treasure of Virtue, the Sovereign Lord of the Universe. ||1||

[Ang 255 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਟਹਲ ਕਰਹੁ ਤਉ ਏਕ ਕੀ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: ttehal karahu tau ek kee jaa te brithaa na koe |
English: Work for the One Lord; no one returns empty-handed from Him.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਹੀਐ ਬਸੈ ਜੋ ਚਾਹਹੁ ਸੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: man tan mukh heeai basai jo chaahahu so hoe |
English: When the Lord abides within your mind, body, mouth and heart, then whatever you desire shall come to pass.

Gurbani: ਟਹਲ ਮਹਲ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਸਾਧ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: ttehal mehal taa kau milai jaa kau saadh kripaal |
English: He alone obtains the Lord's service, and the Mansion of His Presence, unto whom the Holy Saint is compassionate.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਤਉ ਬਸੈ ਜਉ ਆਪਨ ਹੋਹਿ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
Transliteration: saadhoo sangat tau basai jau aapan hohi deaal |
English: He joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, only when the Lord Himself shows His Mercy.

Gurbani: ਟੋਹੇ ਟਾਹੇ ਬਹੁ ਭਵਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: ttohe ttaahe bahu bhavan bin naavai sukh naeh |
English: I have searched and searched, across so many worlds, but without the Name, there is no peace.

Gurbani: ਟਲਹਿ ਜਾਮ ਕੇ ਦੂਤ ਤਿਹ ਜੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: ttaleh jaam ke doot tih ju saadhoo sang samaeh |
English: The Messenger of Death retreats from those who dwell in the Saadh Sangat.

Gurbani: ਬਾਰਿ ਬਾਰਿ ਜਾਉ ਸੰਤ ਸਦਕੇ ॥
Transliteration: baar baar jaau sant sadake |
English: Again and again, I am forever devoted to the Saints.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਪ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਕਦਿ ਕੇ ॥੨੭॥
Transliteration: naanak paap binaase kad ke |27|
English: O Nanak, my sins from so long ago have been erased. ||27||

[Ang 255 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਠਾਕ ਨ ਹੋਤੀ ਤਿਨਹੁ ਦਰਿ ਜਿਹ ਹੋਵਹੁ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ॥
Transliteration: tthaak na hotee tinahu dar jih hovahu suprasan |
English: Those beings, with whom the Lord is thoroughly pleased, meet with no obstacles at His Door.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਧਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jo jan prabh apune kare naanak te dhan dhan |1|
English: Those humble beings whom God has made His own, O Nanak, are blessed, so very blessed. ||1||

[Ang 256 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਠਠਾ ਮਨੂਆ ਠਾਹਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: tthatthaa manooaa tthaaheh naahee |
English: T'HAT'HA: Those who have abandoned all else,

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਏਕਹਿ ਲਪਟਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jo sagal tiaag ekeh lapattaahee |
English: and who cling to the One Lord alone, do not make trouble for anyone's mind.

Gurbani: ਠਹਕਿ ਠਹਕਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੂਏ ॥
Transliteration: tthehak tthehak maaeaa sang mooe |
English: Those who are totally absorbed and preoccupied with Maya are dead;

Gurbani: ਉਆ ਕੈ ਕੁਸਲ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਹੂਏ ॥
Transliteration: auaa kai kusal na katahoo hooe |
English: they do not find happiness anywhere.

Gurbani: ਠਾਂਢਿ ਪਰੀ ਸੰਤਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: tthaandt paree santah sang basiaa |
English: One who dwells in the Society of the Saints finds a great peace;

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਹਾ ਜੀਅ ਰਸਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: amrit naam tahaa jeea rasiaa |
English: the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam becomes sweet to his soul.

Gurbani: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tthaakur apune jo jan bhaaeaa |
English: That humble being, who is pleasing to his Lord and Master

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਆ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲਾਇਆ ॥੨੮॥
Transliteration: naanak uaa kaa man seetalaaeaa |28|
English: - O Nanak, his mind is cooled and soothed. ||28||

[Ang 256 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਡੰਡਉਤਿ ਬੰਦਨ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਰ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਸਮਰਥ ॥
Transliteration: ddanddaut bandan anik baar sarab kalaa samarath |
English: I bow down, and fall to the ground in humble adoration, countless times, to the All-powerful Lord, who possesses all powers.

Gurbani: ਡੋਲਨ ਤੇ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਹਥ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ddolan te raakhahu prabhoo naanak de kar hath |1|
English: Please protect me, and save me from wandering, God. Reach out and give Nanak Your Hand. ||1||

[Ang 256 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਡਡਾ ਡੇਰਾ ਇਹੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਹ ਡੇਰਾ ਤਹ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: ddaddaa dderaa ihu nahee jeh dderaa teh jaan |
English: DADDA: This is not your true place; you must know where that place really is.

Gurbani: ਉਆ ਡੇਰਾ ਕਾ ਸੰਜਮੋ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: auaa dderaa kaa sanjamo gur kai sabad pachhaan |
English: You shall come to realize the way to that place, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਇਆ ਡੇਰਾ ਕਉ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਘਾਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: eaa dderaa kau sram kar ghaalai |
English: This place, here, is established by hard work,

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਤਸੂ ਨਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਚਾਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kaa tasoo nahee sang chaalai |
English: but not one iota of this shall go there with you.

Gurbani: ਉਆ ਡੇਰਾ ਕੀ ਸੋ ਮਿਤਿ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: auaa dderaa kee so mit jaanai |
English: The value of that place beyond is known only to those,

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਗਵਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kau drisatt pooran bhagavaanai |
English: upon whom the Perfect Lord God casts His Glance of Grace.

Gurbani: ਡੇਰਾ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: dderaa nihachal sach saadhasang paaeaa |
English: That permanent and true place is obtained in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy;

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਨਹ ਡੋਲਾਇਆ ॥੨੯॥
Transliteration: naanak te jan neh ddolaaeaa |29|
English: O Nanak, those humble beings do not waver or wander. ||29||

[Ang 256 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਢਾਹਨ ਲਾਗੇ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕਿਨਹਿ ਨ ਘਾਲਿਓ ਬੰਧ ॥
Transliteration: dtaahan laage dharam raae kineh na ghaalio bandh |
English: When the Righteous Judge of Dharma begins to destroy someone, no one can place any obstacle in His Way.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਪਿ ਹਰੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸਨਬੰਧ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak ubare jap haree saadhasang sanabandh |1|
English: O Nanak, those who join the Saadh Sangat and meditate on the Lord are saved. ||1||

[Ang 256 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਢਢਾ ਢੂਢਤ ਕਹ ਫਿਰਹੁ ਢੂਢਨੁ ਇਆ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: dtadtaa dtoodtat keh firahu dtoodtan eaa man maeh |
English: DHADHA: Where are you going, wandering and searching? Search instead within your own mind.

Gurbani: ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਸੈ ਬਨੁ ਬਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਫਿਰਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: sang tuhaarai prabh basai ban ban kahaa firaeh |
English: God is with you, so why do you wander around from forest to forest?

Gurbani: ਢੇਰੀ ਢਾਹਹੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: dteree dtaahahu saadhasang ahanbudh bikaraal |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, tear down the mound of your frightful, egotistical pride.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਬਸਹੁ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: sukh paavahu sahaje basahu darasan dekh nihaal |
English: You shall find peace, and abide in intuitive bliss; gazing upon the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan, you shall be delighted.

Gurbani: ਢੇਰੀ ਜਾਮੈ ਜਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: dteree jaamai jam marai garabh jon dukh paae |
English: One who has such a mound as this, dies and suffers the pain of reincarnation through the womb.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਲਪਟਤ ਰਹੈ ਹਉ ਹਉ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: moh magan lapattat rahai hau hau aavai jaae |
English: One who is intoxicated by emotional attachment, entangled in egotism, selfishness and conceit, shall continue coming and going in reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਢਹਤ ਢਹਤ ਅਬ ਢਹਿ ਪਰੇ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਸਰਨਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: dtehat dtehat ab dteh pare saadh janaa saranaae |
English: Slowly and steadily, I have now surrendered to the Holy Saints; I have come to their Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਦੁਖ ਕੇ ਫਾਹੇ ਕਾਟਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੀਏ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩੦॥
Transliteration: dukh ke faahe kaattiaa naanak lee samaae |30|
English: God has cut away the noose of my pain; O Nanak, He has merged me into Himself. ||30||

[Ang 256 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਸਾਧੂ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਭਜਨੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: jeh saadhoo gobid bhajan keeratan naanak neet |
English: Where the Holy people constantly vibrate the Kirtan of the Praises of the Lord of the Universe, O Nanak

Gurbani: ਣਾ ਹਉ ਣਾ ਤੂੰ ਣਹ ਛੁਟਹਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਈਅਹੁ ਦੂਤ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naa hau naa toon neh chhutteh nikatt na jaaeeahu doot |1|
English: - the Righteous Judge says, "Do not approach that place, O Messenger of Death, or else neither you nor I shall escape!" ||1||

[Ang 256 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਣਾਣਾ ਰਣ ਤੇ ਸੀਝੀਐ ਆਤਮ ਜੀਤੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanaa ran te seejheeai aatam jeetai koe |
English: NANNA: One who conquers his own soul, wins the battle of life.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਅਨ ਸਿਉ ਲਰਿ ਮਰੈ ਸੋ ਸੋਭਾ ਦੂ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: haumai an siau lar marai so sobhaa doo hoe |
English: One who dies, while fighting against egotism and alienation, becomes sublime and beautiful.

Gurbani: ਮਣੀ ਮਿਟਾਇ ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਉਪਦੇਸ ॥
Transliteration: manee mittaae jeevat marai gur poore upades |
English: One who eradicates his ego, remains dead while yet alive, through the Teachings of the Perfect Guru.

Gurbani: ਮਨੂਆ ਜੀਤੈ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਹ ਸੂਰਤਣ ਵੇਸ ॥
Transliteration: manooaa jeetai har milai tih sooratan ves |
English: He conquers his mind, and meets the Lord; he is dressed in robes of honor.

Gurbani: ਣਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਣੋ ਏਕਹਿ ਟੇਕ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: naa ko jaanai aapano ekeh ttek adhaar |
English: He does not claim anything as his own; the One Lord is his Anchor and Support.

Gurbani: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਣਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਰਹੈ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: rain dinas simarat rahai so prabh purakh apaar |
English: Night and day, he continually contemplates the Almighty, Infinite Lord God.

Gurbani: ਰੇਣ ਸਗਲ ਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਕਰੈ ਏਊ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: ren sagal eaa man karai eaoo karam kamaae |
English: He makes his mind the dust of all; such is the karma of the deeds he does.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇ ॥੩੧॥
Transliteration: hukamai boojhai sadaa sukh naanak likhiaa paae |31|
English: Understanding the Hukam of the Lord's Command, he attains everlasting peace. O Nanak, such is his pre-ordained destiny. ||31||

[Ang 256 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਅਰਪਉ ਤਿਸੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਮੋਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: tan man dhan arpau tisai prabhoo milaavai mohi |
English: I offer my body, mind and wealth to anyone who can unite me with God.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭਉ ਕਾਟੀਐ ਚੂਕੈ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਜੋਹ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak bhram bhau kaatteeai chookai jam kee joh |1|
English: O Nanak, my doubts and fears have been dispelled, and the Messenger of Death does not see me any longer. ||1||

[Ang 256 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਤਤਾ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਰਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: tataa taa siau preet kar gun nidh gobid raae |
English: TATTA: Embrace love for the Treasure of Excellence, the Sovereign Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਨ ਬਾਛਤੇ ਤਪਤਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: fal paaveh man baachhate tapat tuhaaree jaae |
English: You shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires, and your burning thirst shall be quenched.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਮਿਟੈ ਜਮ ਪੰਥ ਕੀ ਜਾਸੁ ਬਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: traas mittai jam panth kee jaas basai man naau |
English: One whose heart is filled with the Name shall have no fear on the path of death.

Gurbani: ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਮਹਲੀ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਠਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gat paaveh mat hoe pragaas mahalee paaveh tthaau |
English: He shall obtain salvation, and his intellect shall be enlightened; he will find his place in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

Gurbani: ਤਾਹੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਧਨੁ ਚਲੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਜੋਬਨ ਨਹ ਰਾਜ ॥
Transliteration: taahoo sang na dhan chalai grih joban neh raaj |
English: Neither wealth, nor household, nor youth, nor power shall go along with you.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਰਹਹੁ ਇਹੈ ਤੁਹਾਰੈ ਕਾਜ ॥
Transliteration: santasang simarat rahahu ihai tuhaarai kaaj |
English: In the Society of the Saints, meditate in remembrance on the Lord. This alone shall be of use to you.

Gurbani: ਤਾਤਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਜਉ ਤਾਪ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਆਪ ॥
Transliteration: taataa kachhoo na hoee hai jau taap nivaarai aap |
English: There will be no burning at all, when He Himself takes away your fever.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਮਹਿ ਆਪਹਿ ਮਾਈ ਬਾਪ ॥੩੨॥
Transliteration: pratipaalai naanak hameh aapeh maaee baap |32|
English: O Nanak, the Lord Himself cherishes us; He is our Mother and Father. ||32||

[Ang 257 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਥਾਕੇ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਘਾਲਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਲਾਥ ॥
Transliteration: thaake bahu bidh ghaalate tripat na trisanaa laath |
English: They have grown weary, struggling in all sorts of ways; but they are not satisfied, and their thirst is not quenched.

Gurbani: ਸੰਚਿ ਸੰਚਿ ਸਾਕਤ ਮੂਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਨ ਸਾਥ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sanch sanch saakat mooe naanak maaeaa na saath |1|
English: Gathering in and hoarding what they can, the faithless cynics die, O Nanak, but the wealth of Maya does not go with them in the end. ||1||

[Ang 257 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਥਥਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਕੋਊ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਇ ਪਸਾਰਹੁ ਪਾਵ ॥
Transliteration: thathaa thir koaoo nahee kaae pasaarahu paav |
English: T'HAT'HA: Nothing is permanent - why do you stretch out your feet?

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਬੰਚ ਬਲ ਛਲ ਕਰਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਏਕ ਉਪਾਵ ॥
Transliteration: anik banch bal chhal karahu maaeaa ek upaav |
English: You commit so many fraudulent and deceitful actions as you chase after Maya.

Gurbani: ਥੈਲੀ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਥਾਕਿ ਪਰਹੁ ਗਾਵਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: thailee sanchahu sram karahu thaak parahu gaavaar |
English: You work to fill up your bag, you fool, and then you fall down exhausted.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਅੰਤੇ ਅਉਸਰ ਬਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: man kai kaam na aavee ante aausar baar |
English: But this shall be of no use to you at all at that very last instant.

Gurbani: ਥਿਤਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਭਜਹੁ ਸੰਤਹ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਲੇਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: thit paavahu gobid bhajahu santah kee sikh lehu |
English: You shall find stability only by vibrating upon the Lord of the Universe, and accepting the Teachings of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਸਦ ਏਕ ਸਿਉ ਇਆ ਸਾਚਾ ਅਸਨੇਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: preet karahu sad ek siau eaa saachaa asanehu |
English: Embrace love for the One Lord forever - this is true love!

Gurbani: ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨੋ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਏਕੈ ਹਾਥ ॥
Transliteration: kaaran karan karaavano sabh bidh ekai haath |
English: He is the Doer, the Cause of causes. All ways and means are in His Hands alone.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੰਤ ਅਨਾਥ ॥੩੩॥
Transliteration: jit jit laavahu tith tit lageh naanak jant anaath |33|
English: Whatever You attach me to, to that I am attached; O Nanak, I am just a helpless creature. ||33||

[Ang 257 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਦਾਸਹ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਹਾਰਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: daasah ek nihaariaa sabh kachh devanahaar |
English: His slaves have gazed upon the One Lord, the Giver of everything.

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਰਹਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸ ਅਧਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saas saas simarat raheh naanak daras adhaar |1|
English: They continue to contemplate Him with each and every breath; O Nanak, the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is their Support. ||1||

[Ang 257 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਦਦਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਕਉ ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: dadaa daataa ek hai sabh kau devanahaar |
English: DADDA: The One Lord is the Great Giver; He is the Giver to all.

Gurbani: ਦੇਂਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਅਗਨਤ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: dende tott na aavee aganat bhare bhanddaar |
English: There is no limit to His Giving. His countless warehouses are filled to overflowing.

Gurbani: ਦੈਨਹਾਰੁ ਸਦ ਜੀਵਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: dainahaar sad jeevanahaaraa |
English: The Great Giver is alive forever.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮੂਰਖ ਕਿਉ ਤਾਹਿ ਬਿਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: man moorakh kiau taeh bisaaraa |
English: O foolish mind, why have you forgotten Him?

Gurbani: ਦੋਸੁ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਹੂ ਕਉ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: dos nahee kaahoo kau meetaa |
English: No one is at fault, my friend.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਬੰਧੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa moh bandh prabh keetaa |
English: God created the bondage of emotional attachment to Maya.

Gurbani: ਦਰਦ ਨਿਵਾਰਹਿ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਆਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: darad nivaareh jaa ke aape |
English: He Himself removes the pains of the Gurmukh;

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਤੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੇ ॥੩੪॥
Transliteration: naanak te te guramukh dhraape |34|
English: O Nanak, he is fulfilled. ||34||

[Ang 257 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਧਰ ਜੀਅਰੇ ਇਕ ਟੇਕ ਤੂ ਲਾਹਿ ਬਿਡਾਨੀ ਆਸ ॥
Transliteration: dhar jeeare ik ttek too laeh biddaanee aas |
English: O my soul, grasp the Support of the One Lord; give up your hopes in others.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਆਵੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak naam dhiaaeeai kaaraj aavai raas |1|
English: O Nanak, meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, your affairs shall be resolved. ||1||

[Ang 257 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਧਧਾ ਧਾਵਤ ਤਉ ਮਿਟੈ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਹੋਇ ਬਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: dhadhaa dhaavat tau mittai santasang hoe baas |
English: DHADHA: The mind's wanderings cease, when one comes to dwell in the Society of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਧੁਰ ਤੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਤਉ ਹੋਇ ਮਨਹਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: dhur te kirapaa karahu aap tau hoe maneh paragaas |
English: If the Lord is Merciful from the very beginning, then one's mind is enlightened.

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਤੇਊ ਸਚ ਸਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: dhan saachaa teaoo sach saahaa |
English: Those who have the true wealth are the true bankers.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਸਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: har har poonjee naam bisaahaa |
English: The Lord, Har, Har, is their wealth, and they trade in His Name.

Gurbani: ਧੀਰਜੁ ਜਸੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਤਿਹ ਬਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: dheeraj jas sobhaa tih baniaa |
English: Patience, glory and honor come to those

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਜਿਹ ਸੁਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam sravan jih suniaa |
English: who listen to the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਹ ਘਟਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh jih ghatt rahe samaaee |
English: That Gurmukh whose heart remains merged with the Lord,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਹ ਜਨ ਮਿਲੀ ਵਡਾਈ ॥੩੫॥
Transliteration: naanak tih jan milee vaddaaee |35|
English: O Nanak, obtains glorious greatness. ||35||

[Ang 257 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਿਆ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: naanak naam naam jap japiaa antar baahar rang |
English: O Nanak, one who chants the Naam, and meditates on the Naam with love inwardly and outwardly,

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਨਰਕੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur poorai upadesiaa narak naeh saadhasang |1|
English: receives the Teachings from the Perfect Guru; he joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and does not fall into hell. ||1||

[Ang 257 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਨੰਨਾ ਨਰਕਿ ਪਰਹਿ ਤੇ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: nanaa narak pareh te naahee |
English: NANNA: Those whose minds and bodies are filled with the Naam,

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਸਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai man tan naam basaahee |
English: The Name of the Lord, shall not fall into hell.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋ ਜਪਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: naam nidhaan guramukh jo japate |
English: Those Gurmukhs who chant the treasure of the Naam,

Gurbani: ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਿ ਨਾ ਓਇ ਖਪਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: bikh maaeaa meh naa oe khapate |
English: are not destroyed by the poison of Maya.

Gurbani: ਨੰਨਾਕਾਰੁ ਨ ਹੋਤਾ ਤਾ ਕਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: nanaakaar na hotaa taa kahu |
English: Those who have been given the Mantra of the Naam by the Guru,

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੋ ਜਾ ਕਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: naam mantru gur deeno jaa kahu |
English: Shall not be turned away.

Gurbani: ਨਿਧਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: nidh nidhaan har amrit poore |
English: They are filled and fulfilled with the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord, the Treasure of sublime wealth;

Gurbani: ਤਹ ਬਾਜੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਹਦ ਤੂਰੇ ॥੩੬॥
Transliteration: teh baaje naanak anahad toore |36|
English: O Nanak, the unstruck celestial melody vibrates for them. ||36||

[Ang 258 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਤਜਿ ਪਰਪੰਚ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: pat raakhee gur paarabraham taj parapanch moh bikaar |
English: The Guru, the Supreme Lord God, preserved my honor, when I renounced hypocrisy, emotional attachment and corruption.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਊ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak soaoo aaraadheeai ant na paaraavaar |1|
English: O Nanak, worship and adore the One, who has no end or limitation. ||1||

[Ang 258 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਪਪਾ ਪਰਮਿਤਿ ਪਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: papaa paramit paar na paaeaa |
English: PAPPA: He is beyond estimation; His limits cannot be found.

Gurbani: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਅਗਮ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: patit paavan agam har raaeaa |
English: The Sovereign Lord King is inaccessible;

Gurbani: ਹੋਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਕੋਟ ਅਪਰਾਧੂ ॥
Transliteration: hot puneet kott aparaadhoo |
English: He is the Purifier of sinners. Millions of sinners are purified;

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ॥
Transliteration: amrit naam japeh mil saadhoo |
English: they meet the Holy, and chant the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਪਰਪਚ ਧ੍ਰੋਹ ਮੋਹ ਮਿਟਨਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: parapach dhroh moh mittanaaee |
English: Deception, fraud and emotional attachment are eliminated,

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kau raakhahu aap gusaaee |
English: by those who are protected by the Lord of the World.

Gurbani: ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਸਿਰ ਸੋਊ ॥
Transliteration: paatisaahu chhatr sir soaoo |
English: He is the Supreme King, with the royal canopy above His Head.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੂਸਰ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ॥੩੭॥
Transliteration: naanak doosar avar na koaoo |37|
English: O Nanak, there is no other at all. ||37||

[Ang 258 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਫਾਹੇ ਕਾਟੇ ਮਿਟੇ ਗਵਨ ਫਤਿਹ ਭਈ ਮਨਿ ਜੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: faahe kaatte mitte gavan fatih bhee man jeet |
English: The noose of Death is cut, and one's wanderings cease; victory is obtained, when one conquers his own mind.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਥਿਤ ਪਾਈ ਫਿਰਨ ਮਿਟੇ ਨਿਤ ਨੀਤ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak gur te thit paaee firan mitte nit neet |1|
English: O Nanak, eternal stability is obtained from the Guru, and one's day-to-day wanderings cease. ||1||

[Ang 258 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਫਫਾ ਫਿਰਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਤੂ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: fafaa firat firat too aaeaa |
English: FAFFA: After wandering and wandering for so long, you have come;

Gurbani: ਦ੍ਰੁਲਭ ਦੇਹ ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: drulabh deh kalijug meh paaeaa |
English: in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, you have obtained this human body, so very difficult to obtain.

Gurbani: ਫਿਰਿ ਇਆ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਚਰੈ ਨ ਹਾਥਾ ॥
Transliteration: fir eaa aausar charai na haathaa |
English: This opportunity shall not come into your hands again.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਤਉ ਕਟੀਅਹਿ ਫਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: naam japahu tau katteeeh faasaa |
English: So chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and the noose of Death shall be cut away.

Gurbani: ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਨ ਜਾਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: fir fir aavan jaan na hoee |
English: You shall not have to come and go in reincarnation over and over again,

Gurbani: ਏਕਹਿ ਏਕ ਜਪਹੁ ਜਪੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: ekeh ek japahu jap soee |
English: if you chant and meditate on the One and Only Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: karahu kripaa prabh karanaihaare |
English: Shower Your Mercy, O God, Creator Lord,

Gurbani: ਮੇਲਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬੇਚਾਰੇ ॥੩੮॥
Transliteration: mel lehu naanak bechaare |38|
English: and unite poor Nanak with Yourself. ||38||

[Ang 258 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਉ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: binau sunahu tum paarabraham deen deaal gupaal |
English: Hear my prayer, O Supreme Lord God, Merciful to the meek, Lord of the World.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪੈ ਬਹੁ ਭੋਗ ਰਸ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਰਵਾਲ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sukh sanpai bahu bhog ras naanak saadh ravaal |1|
English: The dust of the feet of the Holy is peace, wealth, great enjoyment and pleasure for Nanak. ||1||

[Ang 258 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਬਬਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਾਨਤ ਤੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: babaa braham jaanat te brahamaa |
English: BABBA: One who knows God is a Brahmin.

Gurbani: ਬੈਸਨੋ ਤੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਚ ਧਰਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: baisano te guramukh such dharamaa |
English: A Vaishnaav is one who, as Gurmukh, lives the righteous life of Dharma.

Gurbani: ਬੀਰਾ ਆਪਨ ਬੁਰਾ ਮਿਟਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: beeraa aapan buraa mittaavai |
English: One who eradicates his own evil is a brave warrior;

Gurbani: ਤਾਹੂ ਬੁਰਾ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: taahoo buraa nikatt nahee aavai |
English: no evil even approaches him.

Gurbani: ਬਾਧਿਓ ਆਪਨ ਹਉ ਹਉ ਬੰਧਾ ॥
Transliteration: baadhio aapan hau hau bandhaa |
English: Man is bound by the chains of his own egotism, selfishness and conceit.

Gurbani: ਦੋਸੁ ਦੇਤ ਆਗਹ ਕਉ ਅੰਧਾ ॥
Transliteration: dos det aagah kau andhaa |
English: The spiritually blind place the blame on others.

Gurbani: ਬਾਤ ਚੀਤ ਸਭ ਰਹੀ ਸਿਆਨਪ ॥
Transliteration: baat cheet sabh rahee siaanap |
English: But all debates and clever tricks are of no use at all.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਜਨਾਵਹੁ ਸੋ ਜਾਨੈ ਨਾਨਕ ॥੩੯॥
Transliteration: jiseh janaavahu so jaanai naanak |39|
English: O Nanak, he alone comes to know, whom the Lord inspires to know. ||39||

[Ang 258 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ ਅਘ ਦੂਖ ਨਾਸ ਮਨਹਿ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਹਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: bhai bhanjan agh dookh naas maneh araadh hare |
English: The Destroyer of fear, the Eradicator of sin and sorrow - enshrine that Lord in your mind.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਸੰਗ ਜਿਹ ਰਿਦ ਬਸਿਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਨ ਭ੍ਰਮੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: santasang jih rid basio naanak te na bhrame |1|
English: One whose heart abides in the Society of the Saints, O Nanak, does not wander around in doubt. ||1||

[Ang 258 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਭਭਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਮਿਟਾਵਹੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: bhabhaa bharam mittaavahu apanaa |
English: BHABHA: Cast out your doubt and delusion

Gurbani: ਇਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਹੈ ਸੁਪਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: eaa sansaar sagal hai supanaa |
English: this world is just a dream.

Gurbani: ਭਰਮੇ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: bharame sur nar devee devaa |
English: The angelic beings, goddesses and gods are deluded by doubt.

Gurbani: ਭਰਮੇ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: bharame sidh saadhik brahamevaa |
English: The Siddhas and seekers, and even Brahma are deluded by doubt.

Gurbani: ਭਰਮਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਡਹਕਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: bharam bharam maanukh ddahakaae |
English: Wandering around, deluded by doubt, people are ruined.

Gurbani: ਦੁਤਰ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਮ ਇਹ ਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: dutar mahaa bikham ih maae |
English: It is so very difficult and treacherous to cross over this ocean of Maya.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੈ ਮੋਹ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh bhram bhai moh mittaaeaa |
English: That Gurmukh who has eradicated doubt, fear and attachment,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇਹ ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪੦॥
Transliteration: naanak teh param sukh paaeaa |40|
English: O Nanak, obtains supreme peace. ||40||

[Ang 258 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਡੋਲੈ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਪਟਿਓ ਤਿਹ ਸੰਗ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa ddolai bahu bidhee man lapattio tih sang |
English: Maya clings to the mind, and causes it to waver in so many ways.

Gurbani: ਮਾਗਨ ਤੇ ਜਿਹ ਤੁਮ ਰਖਹੁ ਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਹਿ ਰੰਗ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: maagan te jih tum rakhahu su naanak naameh rang |1|
English: When You, O Lord, restrain someone from asking for wealth, then, O Nanak, he comes to love the Name. ||1||

[Ang 258 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਮਮਾ ਮਾਗਨਹਾਰ ਇਆਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: mamaa maaganahaar eaanaa |
English: MAMMA: The beggar is so ignorant

Gurbani: ਦੇਨਹਾਰ ਦੇ ਰਹਿਓ ਸੁਜਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: denahaar de rahio sujaanaa |
English: the Great Giver continues to give. He is All-knowing.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਦੀਨੋ ਸੋ ਏਕਹਿ ਬਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: jo deeno so ekeh baar |
English: Whatever He gives, He gives once and for all.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮੂਰਖ ਕਹ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: man moorakh keh kareh pukaar |
English: O foolish mind, why do you complain, and cry out so loud?

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਤਉ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਬੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: jau maageh tau maageh beea |
English: Whenever you ask for something, you ask for worldly things;

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਕੁਸਲ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਥੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: jaa te kusal na kaahoo theea |
English: no one has obtained happiness from these.

Gurbani: ਮਾਗਨਿ ਮਾਗ ਤ ਏਕਹਿ ਮਾਗ ॥
Transliteration: maagan maag ta ekeh maag |
English: If you must ask for a gift, then ask for the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਪਰਹਿ ਪਰਾਗ ॥੪੧॥
Transliteration: naanak jaa te pareh paraag |41|
English: O Nanak, by Him, you shall be saved. ||41||

[Ang 259 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਮਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਪਰਧਾਨ ਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: mat pooree paradhaan te gur poore man mant |
English: Perfect is the intellect, and most distinguished is the reputation, of those whose minds are filled with the Mantra of the Perfect Guru.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੁਨਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jih jaanio prabh aapunaa naanak te bhagavant |1|
English: Those who come to know their God, O Nanak, are very fortunate. ||1||

[Ang 259 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਮਮਾ ਜਾਹੂ ਮਰਮੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: mamaa jaahoo maram pachhaanaa |
English: MAMMA: Those who understand God's mystery are satisfied,

Gurbani: ਭੇਟਤ ਸਾਧਸੰਗ ਪਤੀਆਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: bhettat saadhasang pateeaanaa |
English: joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਉਆ ਕੈ ਸਮਤ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: dukh sukh uaa kai samat beechaaraa |
English: They look upon pleasure and pain as the same.

Gurbani: ਨਰਕ ਸੁਰਗ ਰਹਤ ਅਉਤਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: narak surag rehat aautaaraa |
English: They are exempt from incarnation into heaven or hell.

Gurbani: ਤਾਹੂ ਸੰਗ ਤਾਹੂ ਨਿਰਲੇਪਾ ॥
Transliteration: taahoo sang taahoo niralepaa |
English: They live in the world, and yet they are detached from it.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਸੇਖਾ ॥
Transliteration: pooran ghatt ghatt purakh bisekhaa |
English: The Sublime Lord, the Primal Being, is totally pervading each and every heart.

Gurbani: ਉਆ ਰਸ ਮਹਿ ਉਆਹੂ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: auaa ras meh uaahoo sukh paaeaa |
English: In His Love, they find peace.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਪਤ ਨਹੀ ਤਿਹ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੪੨॥
Transliteration: naanak lipat nahee tih maaeaa |42|
English: O Nanak, Maya does not cling to them at all. ||42||

[Ang 259 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਯਾਰ ਮੀਤ ਸੁਨਿ ਸਾਜਨਹੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਛੂਟਨੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: yaar meet sun saajanahu bin har chhoottan naeh |
English: Listen, my dear friends and companions: without the Lord, there is no salvation.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਹ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਟੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਨੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak tih bandhan katte gur kee charanee paeh |1|
English: O Nanak, one who falls at the Feet of the Guru, has his bonds cut away. ||1||

[Ang 259 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਵੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: pavarree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਯਯਾ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਤ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: yayaa jatan karat bahu bidheea |
English: YAYYA: People try all sorts of things,

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਹ ਲਉ ਸਿਧੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: ek naam bin keh lau sidheea |
English: but without the One Name, how far can they succeed?

Gurbani: ਯਾਹੂ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਹੋਤ ਛੁਟਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: yaahoo jatan kar hot chhuttaaraa |
English: Those efforts, by which emancipation may be attained

Gurbani: ਉਆਹੂ ਜਤਨ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: auaahoo jatan saadh sangaaraa |
English: those efforts are made in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਯਾ ਉਬਰਨ ਧਾਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਊ ॥
Transliteration: yaa ubaran dhaarai sabh koaoo |
English: Everyone has this idea of salvation,

Gurbani: ਉਆਹਿ ਜਪੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਉਬਰ ਨ ਹੋਊ ॥
Transliteration: auaaeh jape bin ubar na hoaoo |
English: but without meditation, there can be no salvation.

Gurbani: ਯਾਹੂ ਤਰਨ ਤਾਰਨ ਸਮਰਾਥਾ ॥
Transliteration: yaahoo taran taaran samaraathaa |
English: The All-powerful Lord is the boat to carry us across.

Gurbani: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਨਰਨਾਥਾ ॥
Transliteration: raakh lehu niragun naranaathaa |
English: O Lord, please save these worthless beings!

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਜਿਹ ਆਪਿ ਜਨਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: man bach kram jih aap janaaee |
English: Those whom the Lord Himself instructs in thought, word and deed

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਹ ਮਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀ ਆਈ ॥੪੩॥
Transliteration: naanak tih mat pragattee aaee |43|
English: - O Nanak, their intellect is enlightened. ||43||

[Ang 259 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਰੋਸੁ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਸੰਗ ਕਰਹੁ ਆਪਨ ਆਪੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: ros na kaahoo sang karahu aapan aap beechaar |
English: Do not be angry with anyone else; look within your own self instead.

Gurbani: ਹੋਇ ਨਿਮਾਨਾ ਜਗਿ ਰਹਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: hoe nimaanaa jag rahahu naanak nadaree paar |1|
English: Be humble in this world, O Nanak, and by His Grace you shall be carried across. ||1||

[Ang 259 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਰਾਰਾ ਰੇਨ ਹੋਤ ਸਭ ਜਾ ਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: raaraa ren hot sabh jaa kee |
English: RARRA: Be the dust under the feet of all.

Gurbani: ਤਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਛੁਟੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: taj abhimaan chhuttai teree baakee |
English: Give up your egotistical pride, and the balance of your account shall be written off.

Gurbani: ਰਣਿ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਤਉ ਸੀਝਹਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ran darageh tau seejheh bhaaee |
English: Then, you shall win the battle in the Court of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jau guramukh raam naam liv laaee |
English: As Gurmukh, lovingly attune yourself to the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਰਹਤ ਰਹਤ ਰਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਬਿਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: rehat rehat reh jaeh bikaaraa |
English: Your evil ways shall be slowly and steadily blotted out,

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur poore kai sabad apaaraa |
English: By the Shabad, the Incomparable Word of the Perfect Guru.

Gurbani: ਰਾਤੇ ਰੰਗ ਨਾਮ ਰਸ ਮਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: raate rang naam ras maate |
English: You shall be imbued with the Lord's Love, and intoxicated with the Nectar of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੀਨੀ ਦਾਤੇ ॥੪੪॥
Transliteration: naanak har gur keenee daate |44|
English: O Nanak, the Lord, the Guru, has given this gift. ||44||

[Ang 259 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਲਾਲਚ ਝੂਠ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਇਆ ਦੇਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਬਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: laalach jhootth bikhai biaadh eaa dehee meh baas |
English: The afflictions of greed, falsehood and corruption abide in this body.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੀਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੂਖਿ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har har amrit guramukh peea naanak sookh nivaas |1|
English: Drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, O Nanak, the Gurmukh abides in peace. ||1||

[Ang 259 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਲਲਾ ਲਾਵਉ ਅਉਖਧ ਜਾਹੂ ॥
Transliteration: lalaa laavau aaukhadh jaahoo |
English: LALLA: One who takes the medicine of the Naam, the Name of the Lord,

Gurbani: ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਤਿਹ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਖਿਨਾਹੂ ॥
Transliteration: dookh darad tih mitteh khinaahoo |
English: is cured of his pain and sorrow in an instant.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਜਿਹ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਿਤਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: naam aaukhadh jih ridai hitaavai |
English: One whose heart is filled with the medicine of the Naam,

Gurbani: ਤਾਹਿ ਰੋਗੁ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: taeh rog supanai nahee aavai |
English: is not infested with disease, even in his dreams.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਸਭ ਘਟ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har aaukhadh sabh ghatt hai bhaaee |
English: The medicine of the Lord's Name is in all hearts, O Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਨ ਬਨਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur poore bin bidh na banaaee |
English: Without the Perfect Guru, no one knows how to prepare it.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਆ ॥
