Transliteration: gur poorai sanjam kar deea |
English: When the Perfect Guru gives the instructions to prepare it,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਉ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖ ਨ ਥੀਆ ॥੪੫॥
Transliteration: naanak tau fir dookh na theea |45|
English: then, O Nanak, one does not suffer illness again. ||45||

[Ang 259 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਵਾਸੁਦੇਵ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਮੈ ਊਨ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਠਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: vaasudev sarabatr mai aoon na katahoo tthaae |
English: The All-pervading Lord is in all places. There is no place where He does not exist.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਇ ਦੁਰਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: antar baahar sang hai naanak kaae duraae |1|
English: Inside and outside, He is with you. O Nanak, what can be hidden from Him? ||1||

[Ang 259 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਵਵਾ ਵੈਰੁ ਨ ਕਰੀਐ ਕਾਹੂ ॥
Transliteration: vavaa vair na kareeai kaahoo |
English: WAWWA: Do not harbor hatred against anyone.

Gurbani: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਮਾਹੂ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt antar braham samaahoo |
English: In each and every heart, God is contained.

Gurbani: ਵਾਸੁਦੇਵ ਜਲ ਥਲ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: vaasudev jal thal meh raviaa |
English: The All-pervading Lord is permeating and pervading the oceans and the land.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਹੀ ਗਵਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad viralai hee gaviaa |
English: How rare are those who, by Guru's Grace, sing of Him.

Gurbani: ਵੈਰ ਵਿਰੋਧ ਮਿਟੇ ਤਿਹ ਮਨ ਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: vair virodh mitte tih man te |
English: Hatred and alienation depart from those

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋ ਸੁਨਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: har keeratan guramukh jo sunate |
English: who, as Gurmukh, listen to the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

Gurbani: ਵਰਨ ਚਿਹਨ ਸਗਲਹ ਤੇ ਰਹਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: varan chihan sagalah te rahataa |
English: O Nanak, one who becomes Gurmukh chants the Name of the Lord,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋ ਕਹਤਾ ॥੪੬॥
Transliteration: naanak har har guramukh jo kahataa |46|
English: Har, Har, and rises above all social classes and status symbols. ||46||

[Ang 260 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਹਾਨੀਆ ਸਾਕਤ ਮੁਗਧ ਅਜਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: hau hau karat bihaaneea saakat mugadh ajaan |
English: Acting in egotism, selfishness and conceit, the foolish, ignorant, faithless cynic wastes his life.

Gurbani: ੜੜਕਿ ਮੁਏ ਜਿਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾਵੰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਨ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: rrarrak mue jiau trikhaavant naanak kirat kamaan |1|
English: He dies in agony, like one dying of thirst; O Nanak, this is because of the deeds he has done. ||1||

[Ang 260 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ੜਾੜਾ ੜਾੜਿ ਮਿਟੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧੂ ॥
Transliteration: rraarraa rraarr mittai sang saadhoo |
English: RARRA: Conflict is eliminated in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy;

Gurbani: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਤਤੁ ਨਾਮ ਅਰਾਧੂ ॥
Transliteration: karam dharam tat naam araadhoo |
English: meditate in adoration on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the essence of karma and Dharma.

Gurbani: ਰੂੜੋ ਜਿਹ ਬਸਿਓ ਰਿਦ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: roorro jih basio rid maahee |
English: When the Beautiful Lord abides within the heart,

Gurbani: ਉਆ ਕੀ ੜਾੜਿ ਮਿਟਤ ਬਿਨਸਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: auaa kee rraarr mittat binasaahee |
English: conflict is erased and ended.

Gurbani: ੜਾੜਿ ਕਰਤ ਸਾਕਤ ਗਾਵਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: rraarr karat saakat gaavaaraa |
English: The foolish, faithless cynic picks arguments

Gurbani: ਜੇਹ ਹੀਐ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeh heeai ahanbudh bikaaraa |
English: his heart is filled with corruption and egotistical intellect.

Gurbani: ੜਾੜਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ੜਾੜਿ ਮਿਟਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: rraarraa guramukh rraarr mittaaee |
English: RARRA: For the Gurmukh, conflict is eliminated in an instant,

Gurbani: ਨਿਮਖ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਮਝਾਈ ॥੪੭॥
Transliteration: nimakh maeh naanak samajhaaee |47|
English: O Nanak, through the Teachings. ||47||

[Ang 260 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਮਨ ਓਟ ਗਹੁ ਉਕਤਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਤਿਆਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: saadhoo kee man ott gahu ukat siaanap tiaag |
English: O mind, grasp the Support of the Holy Saint; give up your clever arguments.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਜਿਹ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur deekhiaa jih man basai naanak masatak bhaag |1|
English: One who has the Guru's Teachings within his mind, O Nanak, has good destiny inscribed upon his forehead. ||1||

[Ang 260 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸਸਾ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੇ ਅਬ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sasaa saran pare ab haare |
English: SASSA: I have now entered Your Sanctuary, Lord;

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਬੇਦ ਪੂਕਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: saasatr simrit bed pookaare |
English: I am so tired of reciting the Shaastras, the Simritees and the Vedas.

Gurbani: ਸੋਧਤ ਸੋਧਤ ਸੋਧਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sodhat sodhat sodh beechaaraa |
English: I searched and searched and searched, and now I have come to realize,

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨ ਨਹੀ ਛੁਟਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: bin har bhajan nahee chhuttakaaraa |
English: that without meditating on the Lord, there is no emancipation.

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਹਮ ਭੂਲਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: saas saas ham bhoolanahaare |
English: With each and every breath, I make mistakes.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਸਮਰਥ ਅਗਨਤ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: tum samarath aganat apaare |
English: You are All-powerful, endless and infinite.

Gurbani: ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੇ ਕੀ ਰਾਖੁ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: saran pare kee raakh deaalaa |
English: I seek Your Sanctuary - please save me, Merciful Lord!

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਬਾਲ ਗੁਪਾਲਾ ॥੪੮॥
Transliteration: naanak tumare baal gupaalaa |48|
English: Nanak is Your child, O Lord of the World. ||48||

[Ang 260 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਖੁਦੀ ਮਿਟੀ ਤਬ ਸੁਖ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਭਏ ਅਰੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: khudee mittee tab sukh bhe man tan bhe arog |
English: When selfishness and conceit are erased, peace comes, and the mind and body are healed.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੀ ਆਇਆ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਨੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak drisattee aaeaa usatat karanai jog |1|
English: O Nanak, then He comes to be seen - the One who is worthy of praise. ||1||

[Ang 260 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਖਖਾ ਖਰਾ ਸਰਾਹਉ ਤਾਹੂ ॥
Transliteration: khakhaa kharaa saraahau taahoo |
English: KHAKHA: Praise and extol Him on High,

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਊਨੇ ਸੁਭਰ ਭਰਾਹੂ ॥
Transliteration: jo khin meh aoone subhar bharaahoo |
English: who fills the empty to over-flowing in an instant.

Gurbani: ਖਰਾ ਨਿਮਾਨਾ ਹੋਤ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: kharaa nimaanaa hot paraanee |
English: When the mortal being becomes totally humble,

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਪੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਿਰਬਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: anadin jaapai prabh nirabaanee |
English: then he meditates night and day on God, the Detached Lord of Nirvaanaa.

Gurbani: ਭਾਵੈ ਖਸਮ ਤ ਉਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: bhaavai khasam ta uaa sukh detaa |
English: If it pleases the Will of our Lord and Master, then He blesses us with peace.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਐਸੋ ਆਗਨਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham aiso aaganataa |
English: Such is the Infinite, Supreme Lord God.

Gurbani: ਅਸੰਖ ਖਤੇ ਖਿਨ ਬਖਸਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: asankh khate khin bakhasanahaaraa |
English: He forgives countless sins in an instant.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਰਾ ॥੪੯॥
Transliteration: naanak saahib sadaa deaaraa |49|
English: O Nanak, our Lord and Master is merciful forever. ||49||

[Ang 260 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿ ਕਹਉ ਸੁਨਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sat khau sun man mere saran parahu har raae |
English: I speak the Truth - listen, O my mind: take to the Sanctuary of the Sovereign Lord King.

Gurbani: ਉਕਤਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਏ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aukat siaanap sagal tiaag naanak le samaae |1|
English: Give up all your clever tricks, O Nanak, and He shall absorb you into Himself. ||1||

[Ang 260 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸਸਾ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਛਾਡੁ ਇਆਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: sasaa siaanap chhaadd eaanaa |
English: SASSA: Give up your clever tricks, you ignorant fool!

Gurbani: ਹਿਕਮਤਿ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਤੀਆਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: hikamat hukam na prabh pateeaanaa |
English: God is not pleased with clever tricks and commands.

Gurbani: ਸਹਸ ਭਾਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sehas bhaat kareh chaturaaee |
English: You may practice a thousand forms of cleverness,

Gurbani: ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੈ ਏਕ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sang tuhaarai ek na jaaee |
English: but not even one will go along with you in the end.

Gurbani: ਸੋਊ ਸੋਊ ਜਪਿ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: soaoo soaoo jap din raatee |
English: Meditate on that Lord, that Lord, day and night.

Gurbani: ਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਚਲੈ ਤੁਹਾਰੈ ਸਾਥੀ ॥
Transliteration: re jeea chalai tuhaarai saathee |
English: O soul, He alone shall go along with you.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਵੈ ਜਿਹ ਆਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: saadh sevaa laavai jih aapai |
English: Those whom the Lord Himself commits to the service of the Holy,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥੫੦॥
Transliteration: naanak taa kau dookh na biaapai |50|
English: O Nanak, are not afflicted by suffering. ||50||

[Ang 260 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਬੋਲਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਵੂਠੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: har har mukh te bolanaa man vootthai sukh hoe |
English: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and keeping it in your mind, you shall find peace.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak sabh meh rav rahiaa thaan thanantar soe |1|
English: O Nanak, the Lord is pervading everywhere; He is contained in all spaces and interspaces. ||1||

[Ang 260 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਹੇਰਉ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਗਲ ਕੈ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: herau ghatt ghatt sagal kai poor rahe bhagavaan |
English: Behold! The Lord God is totally pervading each and every heart.

Gurbani: ਹੋਵਤ ਆਏ ਸਦ ਸਦੀਵ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ॥
Transliteration: hovat aae sad sadeev dukh bhanjan gur giaan |
English: Forever and ever, the Guru's wisdom has been the Destroyer of pain.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਛੁਟਕੈ ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਤਿਹ ਹਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਹ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: hau chhuttakai hoe anand tih hau naahee teh aap |
English: Quieting the ego, ecstasy is obtained. Where the ego does not exist, God Himself is there.

Gurbani: ਹਤੇ ਦੂਖ ਜਨਮਹ ਮਰਨ ਸੰਤਸੰਗ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥
Transliteration: hate dookh janamah maran santasang parataap |
English: The pain of birth and death is removed, by the power of the Society of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਹਿਤ ਕਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੈ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: hit kar naam drirrai deaalaa |
English: He becomes kind to those who lovingly enshrine the Name of the Merciful Lord within their hearts,

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੋਤ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: santah sang hot kirapaalaa |
English: In the Society of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਓਰੈ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਕਿਨਹੂ ਕੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: orai kachhoo na kinahoo keea |
English: In this world, no one accomplishes anything by himself.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ਹੂਆ ॥੫੧॥
Transliteration: naanak sabh kachh prabh te hooaa |51|
English: O Nanak, everything is done by God. ||51||

[Ang 261 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਲੇਖੈ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਭੂਲਨਹਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: lekhai kateh na chhootteeai khin khin bhoolanahaar |
English: Because of the balance due on his account, he can never be released; he makes mistakes each and every moment.

Gurbani: ਬਖਸਨਹਾਰ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bakhasanahaar bakhas lai naanak paar utaar |1|
English: O Forgiving Lord, please forgive me, and carry Nanak across. ||1||

[Ang 261 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਲੂਣ ਹਰਾਮੀ ਗੁਨਹਗਾਰ ਬੇਗਾਨਾ ਅਲਪ ਮਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: loon haraamee gunahagaar begaanaa alap mat |
English: The sinner is unfaithful to himself; he is ignorant, with shallow understanding.

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸੁਖ ਦੀਏ ਤਾਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਨਤ ਤਤ ॥
Transliteration: jeeo pindd jin sukh dee taeh na jaanat tat |
English: He does not know the essence of all, the One who gave him body, soul and peace.

Gurbani: ਲਾਹਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਨੇ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਢੂਢਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: laahaa maaeaa kaarane deh dis dtoodtan jaae |
English: For the sake of personal profit and Maya, he goes out, searching in the ten directions.

Gurbani: ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰ ਦਾਤਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਮਨਹਿ ਬਸਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: devanahaar daataar prabh nimakh na maneh basaae |
English: He does not enshrine the Generous Lord God, the Great Giver, in his mind, even for an instant.

Gurbani: ਲਾਲਚ ਝੂਠ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮੋਹ ਇਆ ਸੰਪੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: laalach jhootth bikaar moh eaa sanpai man maeh |
English: Greed, falsehood, corruption and emotional attachment - these are what he collects within his mind.

Gurbani: ਲੰਪਟ ਚੋਰ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਮਹਾ ਤਿਨਹੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਿਹਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: lanpatt chor nindak mahaa tinahoo sang bihaae |
English: The worst perverts, thieves and slanderers - he passes his time with them.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਖੋਟੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਖਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: tudh bhaavai taa bakhas laihi khotte sang khare |
English: But if it pleases You, Lord, then You forgive the counterfeit along with the genuine.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਾਵੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਾਹਨ ਨੀਰਿ ਤਰੇ ॥੫੨॥
Transliteration: naanak bhaavai paarabraham paahan neer tare |52|
English: O Nanak, if it pleases the Supreme Lord God, then even a stone will float on water. ||52||

[Ang 261 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਖਾਤ ਪੀਤ ਖੇਲਤ ਹਸਤ ਭਰਮੇ ਜਨਮ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
Transliteration: khaat peet khelat hasat bharame janam anek |
English: Eating, drinking, playing and laughing, I have wandered through countless incarnations.

Gurbani: ਭਵਜਲ ਤੇ ਕਾਢਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bhavajal te kaadtahu prabhoo naanak teree ttek |1|
English: Please, God, lift me up and out of the terrifying world-ocean. Nanak seeks Your Support. ||1||

[Ang 261 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਖੇਲਤ ਖੇਲਤ ਆਇਓ ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: khelat khelat aaeo anik jon dukh paae |
English: Playing, playing, I have been reincarnated countless times, but this has only brought pain.

Gurbani: ਖੇਦ ਮਿਟੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਮਿਲਤ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: khed mitte saadhoo milat satigur bachan samaae |
English: Troubles are removed, when one meets with the Holy; immerse yourself in the Word of the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਖਿਮਾ ਗਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਚਿਓ ਖਾਇਓ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: khimaa gahee sach sanchio khaaeo amrit naam |
English: Adopting an attitude of tolerance, and gathering truth, partake of the Ambrosial Nectar of the Name.

Gurbani: ਖਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਈ ਅਨਦ ਸੂਖ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: kharee kripaa tthaakur bhee anad sookh bisraam |
English: When my Lord and Master showed His Great Mercy, I found peace, happiness and bliss.

Gurbani: ਖੇਪ ਨਿਬਾਹੀ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਲਾਭ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ਪਤਿਵੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: khep nibaahee bahut laabh ghar aae pativant |
English: My merchandise has arrived safely, and I have made a great profit; I have returned home with honor.

Gurbani: ਖਰਾ ਦਿਲਾਸਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੇ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: kharaa dilaasaa gur deea aae mile bhagavant |
English: The Guru has given me great consolation, and the Lord God has come to meet me.

Gurbani: ਆਪਨ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਆਗੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: aapan keea kareh aap aagai paachhai aap |
English: He Himself has acted, and He Himself acts. He was in the past, and He shall be in the future.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਊ ਸਰਾਹੀਐ ਜਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਿਆਪਿ ॥੫੩॥
Transliteration: naanak soaoo saraaheeai ji ghatt ghatt rahiaa biaap |53|
English: O Nanak, praise the One, who is contained in each and every heart. ||53||

[Ang 261 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਆਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਨਾਗਤੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
Transliteration: aae prabh saranaagatee kirapaa nidh deaal |
English: O God, I have come to Your Sanctuary, O Merciful Lord, Ocean of compassion.

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਅਖਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਬਸਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਹੋਤ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ek akhar har man basat naanak hot nihaal |1|
English: One whose mind is filled with the One Word of the Lord, O Nanak, becomes totally blissful. ||1||

[Ang 261 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਅਖਰ ਮਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: akhar meh tribhavan prabh dhaare |
English: In the Word, God established the three worlds.

Gurbani: ਅਖਰ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: akhar kar kar bed beechaare |
English: Created from the Word, the Vedas are contemplated.

Gurbani: ਅਖਰ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪੁਰਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: akhar saasatr sinmrit puraanaa |
English: From the Word, came the Shaastras, Simritees and Puraanas.

Gurbani: ਅਖਰ ਨਾਦ ਕਥਨ ਵਖੵਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: akhar naad kathan vakhayaanaa |
English: From the Word, came the sound current of the Naad, speeches and explanations.

Gurbani: ਅਖਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਭੈ ਭਰਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: akhar mukat jugat bhai bharamaa |
English: From the Word, comes the way of liberation from fear and doubt.

Gurbani: ਅਖਰ ਕਰਮ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਸੁਚ ਧਰਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: akhar karam kirat such dharamaa |
English: From the Word, come religious rituals, karma, sacredness and Dharma.

Gurbani: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿਮਾਨ ਅਖਰ ਹੈ ਜੇਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: drisattimaan akhar hai jetaa |
English: In the visible universe, the Word is seen.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਿਰਲੇਪਾ ॥੫੪॥
Transliteration: naanak paarabraham niralepaa |54|
English: O Nanak, the Supreme Lord God remains unattached and untouched. ||54||

[Ang 261 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਹਥਿ ਕਲੰਮ ਅਗੰਮ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਾਵਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: hath kalam agam masatak likhaavatee |
English: With pen in hand, the Inaccessible Lord writes man's destiny on his forehead.

Gurbani: ਉਰਝਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪਾਵਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: aurajh rahio sabh sang anoop roopaavatee |
English: The Lord of Incomparable Beauty is involved with all.

Gurbani: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਤੁਹਾਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: ausatat kehan na jaae mukhahu tuhaareea |
English: I cannot describe Your Praises with my mouth, O Lord.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mohee dekh daras naanak balihaareea |1|
English: Nanak is fascinated, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; he is a sacrifice to You. ||1||

[Ang 261 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਹੇ ਅਚੁਤ ਹੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਘਨਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: he achut he paarabraham abinaasee aghanaas |
English: O Immovable Lord, O Supreme Lord God, Imperishable, Destroyer of sins:

Gurbani: ਹੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੇ ਸਰਬ ਮੈ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: he pooran he sarab mai dukh bhanjan gunataas |
English: O Perfect, All-pervading Lord, Destroyer of pain, Treasure of virtue:

Gurbani: ਹੇ ਸੰਗੀ ਹੇ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਹੇ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਸਭ ਟੇਕ ॥
Transliteration: he sangee he nirankaar he niragun sabh ttek |
English: O Companion, Formless, Absolute Lord, Support of all:

Gurbani: ਹੇ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਹੇ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਦਾ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥
Transliteration: he gobid he gun nidhaan jaa kai sadaa bibek |
English: O Lord of the Universe, Treasure of excellence, with clear eternal understanding:

Gurbani: ਹੇ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਹਹਿ ਭੀ ਹੋਵਨਹਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: he aparanpar har hare heh bhee hovanahaar |
English: Most Remote of the Remote, Lord God: You are, You were, and You shall always be.

Gurbani: ਹੇ ਸੰਤਹ ਕੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਧਾਰਾ ਆਧਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: he santah kai sadaa sang nidhaaraa aadhaar |
English: O Constant Companion of the Saints, You are the Support of the unsupported.

Gurbani: ਹੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਉ ਦਾਸਰੋ ਮੈ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਗੁਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: he tthaakur hau daasaro mai niragun gun nahee koe |
English: O my Lord and Master, I am Your slave. I am worthless, I have no worth at all.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਰਾਖਉ ਹੀਐ ਪਰੋਇ ॥੫੫॥
Transliteration: naanak deejai naam daan raakhau heeai paroe |55|
English: Nanak: grant me the Gift of Your Name, Lord, that I may string it and keep it within my heart. ||55||

[Ang 262 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਮਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਪਿਤਾ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: guradev maataa guradev pitaa guradev suaamee paramesuraa |
English: The Divine Guru is our mother, the Divine Guru is our father; the Divine Guru is our Lord and Master, the Transcendent Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸਖਾ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਬੰਧਿਪ ਸਹੋਦਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: guradev sakhaa agiaan bhanjan guradev bandhip sahodaraa |
English: The Divine Guru is my companion, the Destroyer of ignorance; the Divine Guru is my relative and brother.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੈ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਮੰਤੁ ਨਿਰੋਧਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: guradev daataa har naam upadesai guradev mant nirodharaa |
English: The Divine Guru is the Giver, the Teacher of the Lord's Name. The Divine Guru is the Mantra which never fails.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸ ਪਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: guradev saant sat budh moorat guradev paaras paras paraa |
English: The Divine Guru is the image of peace, truth and wisdom. The Divine Guru is the Philosopher's Stone - touching it, one is transformed.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੋਵਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਮਜਨੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: guradev teerath amrit sarovar gur giaan majan aparanparaa |
English: The Divine Guru is the sacred shrine of pilgrimage, and the pool of divine nectar; bathing in the Guru's wisdom, one experiences the Infinite.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਪ ਹਰਤਾ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵਿਤ ਕਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: guradev karataa sabh paap harataa guradev patit pavit karaa |
English: The Divine Guru is the Creator, and the Destroyer of all sins; the Divine Guru is the Purifier of sinners.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਮੰਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਉਧਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: guradev aad jugaad jug jug guradev mant har jap udharaa |
English: The Divine Guru existed in the very beginning, throughout the ages, in each and every age. The Divine Guru is the Mantra of the Lord's Name; chanting it, one is saved.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਲਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਮ ਮੂੜ ਪਾਪੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਗਿ ਤਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: guradev sangat prabh mel kar kirapaa ham moorr paapee jit lag taraa |
English: O God, please be merciful to me, that I may be with the Divine Guru; I am a foolish sinner, but holding onto Him, I will be carried across.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਮਸਕਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: guradev satigur paarabraham paramesar guradev naanak har namasakaraa |1|
English: The Divine Guru is the True Guru, the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord; Nanak bows in humble reverence to the Lord, the Divine Guru. ||1||

Gurbani: ਏਹੁ ਸਲੋਕੁ ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਪੜਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: ehu salok aad ant parranaa |
English: Read this Salok at the beginning, and at the end. ||

[Ang 262 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਸੁਖਮਨੀ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree sukhamanee mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree Sukhmani, Fifth Mehl,

Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਗੁਰਏ ਨਮਹ ॥
Transliteration: aad gure namah |
English: I bow to the Primal Guru.

Gurbani: ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਗੁਰਏ ਨਮਹ ॥
Transliteration: jugaad gure namah |
English: I bow to the Guru of the ages.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਏ ਨਮਹ ॥
Transliteration: satigure namah |
English: I bow to the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰਦੇਵਏ ਨਮਹ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sree guradeve namah |1|
English: I bow to the Great, Divine Guru. ||1||

[Ang 262 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
Transliteration: asattapadee |
English: Ashtapadee:

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਉ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: simrau simar simar sukh paavau |
English: Meditate, meditate, meditate in remembrance of Him, and find peace.

Gurbani: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਤਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਮਿਟਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: kal kales tan maeh mittaavau |
English: Worry and anguish shall be dispelled from your body.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਉ ਜਾਸੁ ਬਿਸੁੰਭਰ ਏਕੈ ॥
Transliteration: simrau jaas bisunbhar ekai |
English: Remember in praise the One who pervades the whole Universe.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਅਗਨਤ ਅਨੇਕੈ ॥
Transliteration: naam japat aganat anekai |
English: His Name is chanted by countless people, in so many ways.

Gurbani: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸੁਧਾਖੵਰ ॥
Transliteration: bed puraan sinmrit sudhaakhayar |
English: The Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees, the purest of utterances,

Gurbani: ਕੀਨੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਇਕ ਆਖੵਰ ॥
Transliteration: keene raam naam ik aakhayar |
English: were created from the One Word of the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਿਨਕਾ ਏਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਜੀਅ ਬਸਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: kinakaa ek jis jeea basaavai |
English: That one, in whose soul the One Lord dwells

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਗਨੀ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: taa kee mahimaa ganee na aavai |
English: the praises of his glory cannot be recounted.

Gurbani: ਕਾਂਖੀ ਏਕੈ ਦਰਸ ਤੁਹਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: kaankhee ekai daras tuhaaro |
English: Those who yearn only for the blessing of Your Darshan

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਉਧਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak un sang mohi udhaaro |1|
English: - Nanak: save me along with them! ||1||

[Ang 262 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੁਖਮਨੀ ਸੁਖ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: sukhamanee sukh amrit prabh naam |
English: Sukhmani: Peace of Mind, the Nectar of the Name of God.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat janaa kai man bisraam | rahaau |
English: The minds of the devotees abide in a joyful peace. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਗਰਭਿ ਨ ਬਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kai simaran garabh na basai |
English: Remembering God, one does not have to enter into the womb again.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਜਮੁ ਨਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kai simaran dookh jam nasai |
English: Remembering God, the pain of death is dispelled.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਪਰਹਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kai simaran kaal paraharai |
English: Remembering God, death is eliminated.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਦੁਸਮਨੁ ਟਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kai simaran dusaman ttarai |
English: Remembering God, one's enemies are repelled.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਕਛੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: prabh simarat kachh bighan na laagai |
English: Remembering God, no obstacles are met.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kai simaran anadin jaagai |
English: Remembering God, one remains awake and aware, night and day.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਭਉ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kai simaran bhau na biaapai |
English: Remembering God, one is not touched by fear.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kai simaran dukh na santaapai |
English: Remembering God, one does not suffer sorrow.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kaa simaran saadh kai sang |
English: The meditative remembrance of God is in the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sarab nidhaan naanak har rang |2|
English: All treasures, O Nanak, are in the Love of the Lord. ||2||

[Ang 262 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kai simaran ridh sidh nau nidh |
English: In the remembrance of God are wealth, miraculous spiritual powers and the nine treasures.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਤਤੁ ਬੁਧਿ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kai simaran giaan dhiaan tat budh |
English: In the remembrance of God are knowledge, meditation and the essence of wisdom.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kai simaran jap tap poojaa |
English: In the remembrance of God are chanting, intense meditation and devotional worship.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kai simaran binasai doojaa |
English: In the remembrance of God, duality is removed.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਇਸਨਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kai simaran teerath isanaanee |
English: In the remembrance of God are purifying baths at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kai simaran daragah maanee |
English: In the remembrance of God, one attains honor in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਭਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kai simaran hoe su bhalaa |
English: In the remembrance of God, one becomes good.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਸੁਫਲ ਫਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kai simaran sufal falaa |
English: In the remembrance of God, one flowers in fruition.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਆਪਿ ਸਿਮਰਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: se simareh jin aap simaraae |
English: They alone remember Him in meditation, whom He inspires to meditate.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak taa kai laagau paae |3|
English: Nanak grasps the feet of those humble beings. ||3||

[Ang 263 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kaa simaran sabh te aoochaa |
English: The remembrance of God is the highest and most exalted of all.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਉਧਰੇ ਮੂਚਾ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kai simaran udhare moochaa |
English: In the remembrance of God, many are saved.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੁਝੈ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kai simaran trisanaa bujhai |
English: In the remembrance of God, thirst is quenched.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੁਝੈ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kai simaran sabh kichh sujhai |
English: In the remembrance of God, all things are known.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਮ ਤ੍ਰਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kai simaran naahee jam traasaa |
English: In the remembrance of God, there is no fear of death.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kai simaran pooran aasaa |
English: In the remembrance of God, hopes are fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kai simaran man kee mal jaae |
English: In the remembrance of God, the filth of the mind is removed.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: amrit naam rid maeh samaae |
English: The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, is absorbed into the heart.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਬਸਹਿ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: prabh jee baseh saadh kee rasanaa |
English: God abides upon the tongues of His Saints.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਸਨਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak jan kaa daasan dasanaa |4|
English: Nanak is the servant of the slave of His slaves. ||4||

[Ang 263 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਧਨਵੰਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kau simareh se dhanavante |
English: Those who remember God are wealthy.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਪਤਿਵੰਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kau simareh se pativante |
English: Those who remember God are honorable.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਵਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kau simareh se jan paravaan |
English: Those who remember God are approved.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਪੁਰਖ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kau simareh se purakh pradhaan |
English: Those who remember God are the most distinguished persons.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸਿ ਬੇਮੁਹਤਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kau simareh si bemuhataaje |
English: Those who remember God are not lacking.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸਿ ਸਰਬ ਕੇ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kau simareh si sarab ke raaje |
English: Those who remember God are the rulers of all.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਸੁਖਵਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kau simareh se sukhavaasee |
English: Those who remember God dwell in peace.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kau simareh sadaa abinaasee |
English: Those who remember God are immortal and eternal.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਨ ਤੇ ਲਾਗੇ ਜਿਨ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: simaran te laage jin aap deaalaa |
English: They alone hold to the remembrance of Him, unto whom He Himself shows His Mercy.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਮੰਗੈ ਰਵਾਲਾ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak jan kee mangai ravaalaa |5|
English: Nanak begs for the dust of their feet. ||5||

[Ang 263 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kau simareh se praupakaaree |
English: Those who remember God generously help others.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kau simareh tin sad balihaaree |
English: Those who remember God - to them, I am forever a sacrifice.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਮੁਖ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kau simareh se mukh suhaave |
English: Those who remember God - their faces are beautiful.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਸੂਖਿ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kau simareh tin sookh bihaavai |
English: Those who remember God abide in peace.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਆਤਮੁ ਜੀਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kau simareh tin aatam jeetaa |
English: Those who remember God conquer their souls.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kau simareh tin niramal reetaa |
English: Those who remember God have a pure and spotless lifestyle.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਅਨਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kau simareh tin anad ghanere |
English: Those who remember God experience all sorts of joys.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਬਸਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kau simareh baseh har nere |
English: Those who remember God abide near the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: sant kripaa te anadin jaag |
English: By the Grace of the Saints, one remains awake and aware, night and day.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: naanak simaran poorai bhaag |6|
English: O Nanak, this meditative remembrance comes only by perfect destiny. ||6||

[Ang 263 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਕਾਰਜ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kai simaran kaaraj poore |
English: Remembering God, one's works are accomplished.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਝੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kai simaran kabahu na jhoore |
English: Remembering God, one never grieves.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kai simaran har gun baanee |
English: Remembering God, one speaks the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kai simaran sehaj samaanee |
English: Remembering God, one is absorbed into the state of intuitive ease.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਆਸਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kai simaran nihachal aasan |
English: Remembering God, one attains the unchanging position.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਕਮਲ ਬਿਗਾਸਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kai simaran kamal bigaasan |
English: Remembering God, the heart-lotus blossoms forth.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਝੁਨਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kai simaran anahad jhunakaar |
English: Remembering God, the unstruck melody vibrates.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: sukh prabh simaran kaa ant na paar |
English: The peace of the meditative remembrance of God has no end or limitation.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: simareh se jan jin kau prabh meaa |
English: They alone remember Him, upon whom God bestows His Grace.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਜਨ ਸਰਨੀ ਪਇਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: naanak tin jan saranee peaa |7|
English: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of those humble beings. ||7||

[Ang 263 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: har simaran kar bhagat pragattaae |
English: Remembering the Lord, His devotees are famous and radiant.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਲਗਿ ਬੇਦ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: har simaran lag bed upaae |
English: Remembering the Lord, the Vedas were composed.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਭਏ ਸਿਧ ਜਤੀ ਦਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: har simaran bhe sidh jatee daate |
English: Remembering the Lord, we become Siddhas, celibates and givers.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਨੀਚ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਟ ਜਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: har simaran neech chahu kuntt jaate |
English: Remembering the Lord, the lowly become known in all four directions.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਸਭ ਧਰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: har simaran dhaaree sabh dharanaa |
English: For the remembrance of the Lord, the whole world was established.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: simar simar har kaaran karanaa |
English: Remember, remember in meditation the Lord, the Creator, the Cause of causes.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਕੀਓ ਸਗਲ ਅਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har simaran keeo sagal akaaraa |
English: For the remembrance of the Lord, He created the whole creation.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਮਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har simaran meh aap nirankaaraa |
English: In the remembrance of the Lord, He Himself is Formless.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa jis aap bujhaaeaa |
English: By His Grace, He Himself bestows understanding.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੮॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh har simaran tin paaeaa |8|1|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh attains the remembrance of the Lord. ||8||1||

[Ang 263 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਦੀਨ ਦਰਦ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨਾ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਨਾਥ ਅਨਾਥ ॥
Transliteration: deen darad dukh bhanjanaa ghatt ghatt naath anaath |
English: O Destroyer of the pains and the suffering of the poor, O Master of each and every heart, O Masterless One:

Gurbani: ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ਆਇਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਥ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saran tumaaree aaeo naanak ke prabh saath |1|
English: I have come seeking Your Sanctuary. O God, please be with Nanak! ||1||

[Ang 264 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
Transliteration: asattapadee |
English: Ashtapadee:

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਮੀਤ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jeh maat pitaa sut meet na bhaaee |
English: Where there is no mother, father, children, friends or siblings

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਊਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: man aoohaa naam terai sang sahaaee |
English: O my mind, there, only the Naam, the Name of the Lord, shall be with you as your help and support.

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਮਹਾ ਭਇਆਨ ਦੂਤ ਜਮ ਦਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: jeh mahaa bheaan doot jam dalai |
English: Where the great and terrible Messenger of Death shall try to crush you,

Gurbani: ਤਹ ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਚਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: teh keval naam sang terai chalai |
English: there, only the Naam shall go along with you.

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਮੁਸਕਲ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jeh musakal hovai at bhaaree |
English: Where the obstacles are so very heavy,

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਖਿਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: har ko naam khin maeh udhaaree |
English: the Name of the Lord shall rescue you in an instant.

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਪੁਨਹਚਰਨ ਕਰਤ ਨਹੀ ਤਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: anik punahacharan karat nahee tarai |
English: By performing countless religious rituals, you shall not be saved.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਾਪ ਪਰਹਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: har ko naam kott paap paraharai |
English: The Name of the Lord washes off millions of sins.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh naam japahu man mere |
English: As Gurmukh, chant the Naam, O my mind.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸੂਖ ਘਨੇਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak paavahu sookh ghanere |1|
English: O Nanak, you shall obtain countless joys. ||1||

[Ang 264 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕੋ ਰਾਜਾ ਦੁਖੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: sagal srisatt ko raajaa dukheea |
English: The rulers of the all the world are unhappy;

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਖੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam japat hoe sukheea |
English: one who chants the Name of the Lord becomes happy.

Gurbani: ਲਾਖ ਕਰੋਰੀ ਬੰਧੁ ਨ ਪਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: laakh karoree bandh na parai |
English: Acquiring hundreds of thousands and millions, your desires shall not be contained.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਨਿਸਤਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam japat nisatarai |
English: Chanting the Name of the Lord, you shall find release.

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ਤਿਖ ਨ ਬੁਝਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: anik maaeaa rang tikh na bujhaavai |
English: By the countless pleasures of Maya, your thirst shall not be quenched.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਆਘਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam japat aaghaavai |
English: Chanting the Name of the Lord, you shall be satisfied.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਇਹੁ ਜਾਤ ਇਕੇਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: jih maarag ihu jaat ikelaa |
English: Upon that path where you must go all alone,

Gurbani: ਤਹ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੋਤ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: teh har naam sang hot suhelaa |
English: there, only the Lord's Name shall go with you to sustain you.

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa naam man sadaa dhiaaeeai |
English: On such a Name, O my mind, meditate forever.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh param gat paaeeai |2|
English: O Nanak, as Gurmukh, you shall obtain the state of supreme dignity. ||2||

[Ang 264 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਛੂਟਤ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਟਿ ਲਖ ਬਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: chhoottat nahee kott lakh baahee |
English: You shall not be saved by hundreds of thousands and millions of helping hands.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਤਹ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: naam japat teh paar paraahee |
English: Chanting the Naam, you shall be lifted up and carried across.

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਿਘਨ ਜਹ ਆਇ ਸੰਘਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: anik bighan jeh aae sanghaarai |
English: Where countless misfortunes threaten to destroy you,

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਤਕਾਲ ਉਧਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam tatakaal udhaarai |
English: the Name of the Lord shall rescue you in an instant.

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: anik jon janamai mar jaam |
English: Through countless incarnations, people are born and die.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਪਾਵੈ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: naam japat paavai bisraam |
English: Chanting the Name of the Lord, you shall come to rest in peace.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਮੈਲਾ ਮਲੁ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: hau mailaa mal kabahu na dhovai |
English: The ego is polluted by a filth which can never be washed off.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਾਪ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam kott paap khovai |
English: The Name of the Lord erases millions of sins.

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮਨ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa naam japahu man rang |
English: Chant such a Name with love, O my mind.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak paaeeai saadh kai sang |3|
English: O Nanak, it is obtained in the Company of the Holy. ||3||

[Ang 264 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਮਾਰਗ ਕੇ ਗਨੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਨ ਕੋਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: jih maarag ke gane jaeh na kosaa |
English: On that path where the miles cannot be counted,

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਊਹਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੋਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam aoohaa sang tosaa |
English: there, the Name of the Lord shall be your sustenance.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਪੈਡੈ ਮਹਾ ਅੰਧ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jih paiddai mahaa andh gubaaraa |
English: On that journey of total, pitch-black darkness,

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਜੀਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam sang ujeeaaraa |
English: the Name of the Lord shall be the Light with you.

Gurbani: ਜਹਾ ਪੰਥਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੋ ਨ ਸਿਞਾਨੂ ॥
Transliteration: jahaa panth teraa ko na siyaanoo |
English: On that journey where no one knows you,

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਹ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਛਾਨੂ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam teh naal pachhaanoo |
English: with the Name of the Lord, you shall be recognized.

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਮਹਾ ਭਇਆਨ ਤਪਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਘਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: jeh mahaa bheaan tapat bahu ghaam |
English: Where there is awesome and terrible heat and blazing sunshine,

Gurbani: ਤਹ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਤੁਮ ਊਪਰਿ ਛਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: teh har ke naam kee tum aoopar chhaam |
English: there, the Name of the Lord will give you shade.

Gurbani: ਜਹਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾ ਮਨ ਤੁਝੁ ਆਕਰਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: jahaa trikhaa man tujh aakarakhai |
English: Where thirst, O my mind, torments you to cry out,

Gurbani: ਤਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬਰਖੈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: teh naanak har har amrit barakhai |4|
English: there, O Nanak, the Ambrosial Name, Har, Har, shall rain down upon you. ||4||

[Ang 264 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਬਰਤਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat janaa kee baratan naam |
English: Unto the devotee, the Naam is an article of daily use.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: sant janaa kai man bisraam |
English: The minds of the humble Saints are at peace.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਓਟ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam daas kee ott |
English: The Name of the Lord is the Support of His servants.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਉਧਰੇ ਜਨ ਕੋਟਿ ॥
Transliteration: har kai naam udhare jan kott |
English: By the Name of the Lord, millions have been saved.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਰਤ ਸੰਤ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: har jas karat sant din raat |
English: The Saints chant the Praises of the Lord, day and night.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਸਾਧ ਕਮਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: har har aaukhadh saadh kamaat |
English: Har, Har - the Lord's Name - the Holy use it as their healing medicine.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: har jan kai har naam nidhaan |
English: The Lord's Name is the treasure of the Lord's servant.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਜਨ ਕੀਨੋ ਦਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham jan keeno daan |
English: The Supreme Lord God has blessed His humble servant with this gift.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗ ਏਕੈ ॥
Transliteration: man tan rang rate rang ekai |
English: Mind and body are imbued with ecstasy in the Love of the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਬਿਰਤਿ ਬਿਬੇਕੈ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak jan kai birat bibekai |5|
English: O Nanak, careful and discerning understanding is the way of the Lord's humble servant. ||5||

[Ang 264 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam jan kau mukat jugat |
English: The Name of the Lord is the path of liberation for His humble servants.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਭੁਗਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: har kai naam jan kau tripat bhugat |
English: With the food of the Name of the Lord, His servants are satisfied.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam jan kaa roop rang |
English: The Name of the Lord is the beauty and delight of His servants.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਕਬ ਪਰੈ ਨ ਭੰਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: har naam japat kab parai na bhang |
English: Chanting the Lord's Name, one is never blocked by obstacles.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam jan kee vaddiaaee |
English: The Name of the Lord is the glorious greatness of His servants.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਜਨ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har kai naam jan sobhaa paaee |
English: Through the Name of the Lord, His servants obtain honor.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਭੋਗ ਜੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam jan kau bhog jog |
English: The Name of the Lord is the enjoyment and Yoga of His servants.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਕਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਬਿਓਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: har naam japat kachh naeh biog |
English: Chanting the Lord's Name, there is no separation from Him.

Gurbani: ਜਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: jan raataa har naam kee sevaa |
English: His servants are imbued with the service of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: naanak poojai har har devaa |6|
English: O Nanak, worship the Lord, the Lord Divine, Har, Har. ||6||

[Ang 265 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਮਾਲੁ ਖਜੀਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: har har jan kai maal khajeenaa |
English: The Lord's Name, Har, Har, is the treasure of wealth of His servants.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: har dhan jan kau aap prabh deenaa |
English: The treasure of the Lord has been bestowed on His servants by God Himself.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਓਟ ਸਤਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: har har jan kai ott sataanee |
English: The Lord, Har, Har is the All-powerful Protection of His servants.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪਿ ਜਨ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: har prataap jan avar na jaanee |
English: His servants know no other than the Lord's Magnificence.

Gurbani: ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: ot pot jan har ras raate |
English: Through and through, His servants are imbued with the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਸ ਮਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: sun samaadh naam ras maate |
English: In deepest Samaadhi, they are intoxicated with the essence of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar jan har har japai |
English: Twenty-four hours a day, His servants chant Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਭਗਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਨਹੀ ਛਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa bhagat pragatt nahee chhapai |
English: The devotees of the Lord are known and respected; they do not hide in secrecy.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਕਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har kee bhagat mukat bahu kare |
English: Through devotion to the Lord, many have been liberated.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਤਰੇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: naanak jan sang kete tare |7|
English: O Nanak, along with His servants, many others are saved. ||7||

[Ang 265 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਾਰਜਾਤੁ ਇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: paarajaat ihu har ko naam |
English: This Elysian Tree of miraculous powers is the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮਧੇਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: kaamadhen har har gun gaam |
English: The Khaamadhayn, the cow of miraculous powers, is the singing of the Glory of the Lord's Name, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਤਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabh te aootam har kee kathaa |
English: Highest of all is the Lord's Speech.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਤ ਦਰਦ ਦੁਖ ਲਥਾ ॥
Transliteration: naam sunat darad dukh lathaa |
English: Hearing the Naam, pain and sorrow are removed.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਸੰਤ ਰਿਦ ਵਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: naam kee mahimaa sant rid vasai |
English: The Glory of the Naam abides in the hearts of His Saints.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪਿ ਦੁਰਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਨਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: sant prataap durat sabh nasai |
English: By the Saint's kind intervention, all guilt is dispelled.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: sant kaa sang vaddabhaagee paaeeai |
English: The Society of the Saints is obtained by great good fortune.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: sant kee sevaa naam dhiaaeeai |
English: Serving the Saint, one meditates on the Naam.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਤੁਲਿ ਕਛੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: naam tul kachh avar na hoe |
English: There is nothing equal to the Naam.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੮॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh naam paavai jan koe |8|2|
English: O Nanak, rare are those, who, as Gurmukh, obtain the Naam. ||8||2||

[Ang 265 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਬਹੁ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬਹੁ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤੀ ਪੇਖੇ ਸਰਬ ਢਢੋਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: bahu saasatr bahu simritee pekhe sarab dtadtol |
English: The many Shaastras and the many Simritees - I have seen and searched through them all.

Gurbani: ਪੂਜਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਅਮੋਲ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: poojas naahee har hare naanak naam amol |1|
English: They are not equal to Har, Haray - O Nanak, the Lord's Invaluable Name. ||1||

[Ang 265 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
Transliteration: asattapadee |
English: Ashtapadee:

Gurbani: ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਗਿਆਨ ਸਭਿ ਧਿਆਨ ॥
Transliteration: jaap taap giaan sabh dhiaan |
English: Chanting, intense meditation, spiritual wisdom and all meditations;

Gurbani: ਖਟ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਵਖਿਆਨ ॥
Transliteration: khatt saasatr simrit vakhiaan |
English: the six schools of philosophy and sermons on the scriptures;

Gurbani: ਜੋਗ ਅਭਿਆਸ ਕਰਮ ਧ੍ਰਮ ਕਿਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jog abhiaas karam dhram kiriaa |
English: the practice of Yoga and righteous conduct;

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਬਨ ਮਧੇ ਫਿਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sagal tiaag ban madhe firiaa |
English: the renunciation of everything and wandering around in the wilderness;

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਕੀਏ ਬਹੁ ਜਤਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: anik prakaar kee bahu jatanaa |
English: the performance of all sorts of works;

Gurbani: ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਹੋਮੇ ਬਹੁ ਰਤਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: pun daan home bahu ratanaa |
English: donations to charities and offerings of jewels to fire;

Gurbani: ਸਰੀਰੁ ਕਟਾਇ ਹੋਮੈ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: sareer kattaae homai kar raatee |
English: cutting the body apart and making the pieces into ceremonial fire offerings;

Gurbani: ਵਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਕਰੈ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: varat nem karai bahu bhaatee |
English: keeping fasts and making vows of all sorts

Gurbani: ਨਹੀ ਤੁਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: nahee tul raam naam beechaar |
English: - none of these are equal to the contemplation of the Name of the Lord,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਇਕ ਬਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh naam japeeai ik baar |1|
English: O Nanak, if, as Gurmukh, one chants the Naam, even once. ||1||

[Ang 265 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਨਉ ਖੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੀ ਫਿਰੈ ਚਿਰੁ ਜੀਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: nau khandd prithamee firai chir jeevai |
English: You may roam over the nine continents of the world and live a very long life;

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਉਦਾਸੁ ਤਪੀਸਰੁ ਥੀਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: mahaa udaas tapeesar theevai |
English: you may become a great ascetic and a master of disciplined meditation

Gurbani: ਅਗਨਿ ਮਾਹਿ ਹੋਮਤ ਪਰਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: agan maeh homat paraan |
English: and burn yourself in fire;

Gurbani: ਕਨਿਕ ਅਸ੍ਵ ਹੈਵਰ ਭੂਮਿ ਦਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: kanik asv haivar bhoom daan |
English: you may give away gold, horses, elephants and land;

Gurbani: ਨਿਉਲੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਬਹੁ ਆਸਨ ॥
Transliteration: niaulee karam karai bahu aasan |
English: you may practice techniques of inner cleansing and all sorts of Yogic postures;

Gurbani: ਜੈਨ ਮਾਰਗ ਸੰਜਮ ਅਤਿ ਸਾਧਨ ॥
Transliteration: jain maarag sanjam at saadhan |
English: you may adopt the self-mortifying ways of the Jains and great spiritual disciplines;

Gurbani: ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਕਰਿ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਕਟਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: nimakh nimakh kar sareer kattaavai |
English: piece by piece, you may cut your body apart;

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਭੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: tau bhee haumai mail na jaavai |
English: but even so, the filth of your ego shall not depart.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਕਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: har ke naam samasar kachh naeh |
English: There is nothing equal to the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh naam japat gat paeh |2|
English: O Nanak, as Gurmukh, chant the Naam, and obtain salvation. ||2||

[Ang 265 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਤੀਰਥ ਦੇਹ ਛੁਟੈ ॥
Transliteration: man kaamanaa teerath deh chhuttai |
English: With your mind filled with desire, you may give up your body at a sacred shrine of pilgrimage;

Gurbani: ਗਰਬੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਹੁਟੈ ॥
Transliteration: garab gumaan na man te huttai |
English: but even so, egotistical pride shall not be removed from your mind.

Gurbani: ਸੋਚ ਕਰੈ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਅਰੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: soch karai dinas ar raat |
English: You may practice cleansing day and night,

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਜਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: man kee mail na tan te jaat |
English: but the filth of your mind shall not leave your body.

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਕਉ ਬਹੁ ਸਾਧਨਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: eis dehee kau bahu saadhanaa karai |
English: You may subject your body to all sorts of disciplines,

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਤੇ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਟਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: man te kabahoo na bikhiaa ttarai |
English: but your mind will never be rid of its corruption.

Gurbani: ਜਲਿ ਧੋਵੈ ਬਹੁ ਦੇਹ ਅਨੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: jal dhovai bahu deh aneet |
English: You may wash this transitory body with loads of water,

Gurbani: ਸੁਧ ਕਹਾ ਹੋਇ ਕਾਚੀ ਭੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: sudh kahaa hoe kaachee bheet |
English: but how can a wall of mud be washed clean?

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਊਚ ॥
Transliteration: man har ke naam kee mahimaa aooch |
English: O my mind, the Glorious Praise of the Name of the Lord is the highest;

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਉਧਰੇ ਪਤਿਤ ਬਹੁ ਮੂਚ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak naam udhare patit bahu mooch |3|
English: O Nanak, the Naam has saved so many of the worst sinners. ||3||

[Ang 265 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: bahut siaanap jam kaa bhau biaapai |
English: Even with great cleverness, the fear of death clings to you.

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਨਾ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: anik jatan kar trisan naa dhraapai |
English: You try all sorts of things, but your thirst is still not satisfied.

Gurbani: ਭੇਖ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਗਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਬੁਝੈ ॥
Transliteration: bhekh anek agan nahee bujhai |
English: Wearing various religious robes, the fire is not extinguished.

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਉਪਾਵ ਦਰਗਹ ਨਹੀ ਸਿਝੈ ॥
Transliteration: kott upaav daragah nahee sijhai |
English: Even making millions of efforts, you shall not be accepted in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਛੂਟਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਊਭ ਪਇਆਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: chhoottas naahee aoobh peaal |
English: You cannot escape to the heavens, or to the nether regions,

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਬਿਆਪਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: mohi biaapeh maaeaa jaal |
English: if you are entangled in emotional attachment and the net of Maya.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰ ਕਰਤੂਤਿ ਸਗਲੀ ਜਮੁ ਡਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: avar karatoot sagalee jam ddaanai |
English: All other efforts are punished by the Messenger of Death,

Gurbani: ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: govind bhajan bin til nahee maanai |
English: which accepts nothing at all, except meditation on the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam japat dukh jaae |
English: Chanting the Name of the Lord, sorrow is dispelled.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬੋਲੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak bolai sehaj subhaae |4|
English: O Nanak, chant it with intuitive ease. ||4||

[Ang 266 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਮਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: chaar padaarath je ko maagai |
English: One who prays for the four cardinal blessings

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: saadh janaa kee sevaa laagai |
English: should commit himself to the service of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਆਪੁਨਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਮਿਟਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: je ko aapunaa dookh mittaavai |
English: If you wish to erase your sorrows,

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਦ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam ridai sad gaavai |
English: sing the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, within your heart.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਲੋਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: je ko apunee sobhaa lorai |
English: If you long for honor for yourself,

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਇਹ ਹਉਮੈ ਛੋਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang ih haumai chhorai |
English: then renounce your ego in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਤੇ ਡਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: je ko janam maran te ddarai |
English: If you fear the cycle of birth and death,

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਨੀ ਪਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: saadh janaa kee saranee parai |
English: then seek the Sanctuary of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: jis jan kau prabh daras piaasaa |
English: Those who thirst for the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਸਾ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak taa kai bal bal jaasaa |5|
English: - Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to them. ||5||

[Ang 266 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਮਹਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: sagal purakh meh purakh pradhaan |
English: Among all persons, the supreme person is the one

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਿਟੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang jaa kaa mittai abhimaan |
English: who gives up his egotistical pride in the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਜੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਨੀਚਾ ॥
Transliteration: aapas kau jo jaanai neechaa |
English: One who sees himself as lowly,

Gurbani: ਸੋਊ ਗਨੀਐ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ॥
Transliteration: soaoo ganeeai sabh te aoochaa |
English: shall be accounted as the highest of all.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਗਲ ਕੀ ਰੀਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kaa man hoe sagal kee reenaa |
English: One whose mind is the dust of all,

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਚੀਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam tin ghatt ghatt cheenaa |
English: recognizes the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in each and every heart.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਤੇ ਬੁਰਾ ਮਿਟਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: man apune te buraa mittaanaa |
English: One who eradicates cruelty from within his own mind,

Gurbani: ਪੇਖੈ ਸਗਲ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਾਜਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: pekhai sagal srisatt saajanaa |
English: looks upon all the world as his friend.

Gurbani: ਸੂਖ ਦੂਖ ਜਨ ਸਮ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੇਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: sookh dookh jan sam drisattetaa |
English: One who looks upon pleasure and pain as one and the same,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਨਹੀ ਲੇਪਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: naanak paap pun nahee lepaa |6|
English: O Nanak, is not affected by sin or virtue. ||6||

[Ang 266 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਨਿਰਧਨ ਕਉ ਧਨੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: niradhan kau dhan tero naau |
English: To the poor, Your Name is wealth.

Gurbani: ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਕਉ ਨਾਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਥਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: nithaave kau naau teraa thaau |
English: To the homeless, Your Name is home.

Gurbani: ਨਿਮਾਨੇ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੋ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: nimaane kau prabh tero maan |
English: To the dishonored, You, O God, are honor.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਕਉ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: sagal ghattaa kau devahu daan |
English: To all, You are the Giver of gifts.

Gurbani: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨਹਾਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: karan karaavanahaar suaamee |
English: O Creator Lord, Cause of causes, O Lord and Master,

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਕੇ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: sagal ghattaa ke antarajaamee |
English: Inner-knower, Searcher of all hearts:

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਆਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: apanee gat mit jaanahu aape |
English: You alone know Your own condition and state.

Gurbani: ਆਪਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: aapan sang aap prabh raate |
English: You Yourself, God, are imbued with Yourself.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: tumaree usatat tum te hoe |
English: You alone can celebrate Your Praises.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਸਿ ਕੋਇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: naanak avar na jaanas koe |7|
English: O Nanak, no one else knows. ||7||

[Ang 266 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਧਰਮ ਮਹਿ ਸ੍ਰੇਸਟ ਧਰਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: sarab dharam meh sresatt dharam |
English: Of all religions, the best religion

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: har ko naam jap niramal karam |
English: is to chant the Name of the Lord and maintain pure conduct.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਆ ਮਹਿ ਊਤਮ ਕਿਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sagal kriaa meh aootam kiriaa |
English: Of all religious rituals, the most sublime ritual

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਲੁ ਹਿਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang duramat mal hiriaa |
English: is to erase the filth of the dirty mind in the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਉਦਮ ਮਹਿ ਉਦਮੁ ਭਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: sagal udam meh udam bhalaa |
English: Of all efforts, the best effort

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਜੀਅ ਸਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam japahu jeea sadaa |
English: is to chant the Name of the Lord in the heart, forever.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਬਾਨੀ ਮਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: sagal baanee meh amrit baanee |
English: Of all speech, the most ambrosial speech

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨਿ ਰਸਨ ਬਖਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: har ko jas sun rasan bakhaanee |
English: is to hear the Lord's Praise and chant it with the tongue.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਥਾਨ ਤੇ ਓਹੁ ਊਤਮ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: sagal thaan te ohu aootam thaan |
English: Of all places, the most sublime place,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਹ ਘਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੮॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak jih ghatt vasai har naam |8|3|
English: O Nanak, is that heart in which the Name of the Lord abides. ||8||3||

[Ang 266 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਗੁਨੀਆਰ ਇਆਨਿਆ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: niraguneeaar eaaniaa so prabh sadaa samaal |
English: You worthless, ignorant fool - dwell upon God forever.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਰਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਬਹੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jin keea tis cheet rakh naanak nibahee naal |1|
English: Cherish in your consciousness the One who created you; O Nanak, He alone shall go along with you. ||1||

[Ang 266 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
Transliteration: asattapadee |
English: Ashtapadee:

Gurbani: ਰਮਈਆ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਚੇਤਿ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: rameea ke gun chet paraanee |
English: Think of the Glory of the All-pervading Lord, O mortal;

Gurbani: ਕਵਨ ਮੂਲ ਤੇ ਕਵਨ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: kavan mool te kavan drisattaanee |
English: what is your origin, and what is your appearance?

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ਸੀਗਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jin toon saaj savaar seegaariaa |
English: He who fashioned, adorned and decorated you

Gurbani: ਗਰਭ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਜਿਨਹਿ ਉਬਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: garabh agan meh jineh ubaariaa |
English: in the fire of the womb, He preserved you.

Gurbani: ਬਾਰ ਬਿਵਸਥਾ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੈ ਦੂਧ ॥
Transliteration: baar bivasathaa tujheh piaarai doodh |
English: In your infancy, He gave you milk to drink.

Gurbani: ਭਰਿ ਜੋਬਨ ਭੋਜਨ ਸੁਖ ਸੂਧ ॥
Transliteration: bhar joban bhojan sukh soodh |
English: In the flower of your youth, He gave you food, pleasure and understanding.

Gurbani: ਬਿਰਧਿ ਭਇਆ ਊਪਰਿ ਸਾਕ ਸੈਨ ॥
Transliteration: biradh bheaa aoopar saak sain |
English: As you grow old, family and friends,

Gurbani: ਮੁਖਿ ਅਪਿਆਉ ਬੈਠ ਕਉ ਦੈਨ ॥
Transliteration: mukh apiaau baitth kau dain |
English: Are there to feed you as you rest.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਨਿਰਗੁਨੁ ਗੁਨੁ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
Transliteration: eihu niragun gun kachhoo na boojhai |
English: This worthless person has not appreciated in the least, all the good deeds done for him.

Gurbani: ਬਖਸਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੀਝੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bakhas lehu tau naanak seejhai |1|
English: If you bless him with forgiveness, O Nanak, only then will he be saved. ||1||

[Ang 267 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਧਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਬਸਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jih prasaad dhar aoopar sukh baseh |
English: By His Grace, you abide in comfort upon the earth.

Gurbani: ਸੁਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਮੀਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਸਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: sut bhraat meet banitaa sang haseh |
English: With your children, siblings, friends and spouse, you laugh.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਪੀਵਹਿ ਸੀਤਲ ਜਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: jih prasaad peeveh seetal jalaa |
English: By His Grace, you drink in cool water.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਪਵਨੁ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਅਮੁਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: sukhadaaee pavan paavak amulaa |
English: You have peaceful breezes and priceless fire.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਭੋਗਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਰਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: jih prasaad bhogeh sabh rasaa |
English: By His Grace, you enjoy all sorts of pleasures.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਥਿ ਬਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: sagal samagree sang saath basaa |
English: You are provided with all the necessities of life.

Gurbani: ਦੀਨੇ ਹਸਤ ਪਾਵ ਕਰਨ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: deene hasat paav karan netr rasanaa |
English: He gave you hands, feet, ears, eyes and tongue,

Gurbani: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਅਵਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਚਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: tiseh tiaag avar sang rachanaa |
English: and yet, you forsake Him and attach yourself to others.

Gurbani: ਐਸੇ ਦੋਖ ਮੂੜ ਅੰਧ ਬਿਆਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: aise dokh moorr andh biaape |
English: Such sinful mistakes cling to the blind fools;

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak kaadt lehu prabh aape |2|
English: Nanak: uplift and save them, God! ||2||

[Ang 267 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਜੋ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: aad ant jo raakhanahaar |
English: From beginning to end, He is our Protector,

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਕਰੈ ਗਵਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: tis siau preet na karai gavaar |
English: and yet, the ignorant do not give their love to Him.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kee sevaa nav nidh paavai |
English: Serving Him, the nine treasures are obtained,

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਮੂੜਾ ਮਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: taa siau moorraa man nahee laavai |
English: and yet, the foolish do not link their minds with Him.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jo tthaakur sad sadaa hajoore |
English: Our Lord and Master is Ever-present, forever and ever,

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਅੰਧਾ ਜਾਨਤ ਦੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: taa kau andhaa jaanat doore |
English: and yet, the spiritually blind believe that He is far away.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਪਾਵੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kee ttehal paavai daragah maan |
English: In His service, one obtains honor in the Court of the Lord,

Gurbani: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਬਿਸਾਰੈ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਅਜਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: tiseh bisaarai mugadh ajaan |
English: and yet, the ignorant fool forgets Him.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਇਹੁ ਭੂਲਨਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa ihu bhoolanahaar |
English: Forever and ever, this person makes mistakes;

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak raakhanahaar apaar |3|
English: O Nanak, the Infinite Lord is our Saving Grace. ||3||

[Ang 267 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਤਨੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਕਉਡੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਚੈ ॥
Transliteration: ratan tiaag kauddee sang rachai |
English: Forsaking the jewel, they are engrossed with a shell.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਝੂਠ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਚੈ ॥
Transliteration: saach chhodd jhootth sang machai |
English: They renounce Truth and embrace falsehood.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਛਡਨਾ ਸੁ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: jo chhaddanaa su asathir kar maanai |
English: That which passes away, they believe to be permanent.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਹੋਵਨੁ ਸੋ ਦੂਰਿ ਪਰਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: jo hovan so door paraanai |
English: That which is immanent, they believe to be far off.

Gurbani: ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਇ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: chhodd jaae tis kaa sram karai |
English: They struggle for what they must eventually leave.

Gurbani: ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਰਹਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: sang sahaaee tis paraharai |
English: They turn away from the Lord, their Help and Support, who is always with them.

Gurbani: ਚੰਦਨ ਲੇਪੁ ਉਤਾਰੈ ਧੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: chandan lep utaarai dhoe |
English: They wash off the sandalwood paste;

Gurbani: ਗਰਧਬ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਭਸਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: garadhab preet bhasam sang hoe |
English: like donkeys, they are in love with the mud.

Gurbani: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: andh koop meh patit bikaraal |
English: They have fallen into the deep, dark pit.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak kaadt lehu prabh deaal |4|
English: Nanak: lift them up and save them, O Merciful Lord God! ||4||

[Ang 267 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਕਰਤੂਤਿ ਪਸੂ ਕੀ ਮਾਨਸ ਜਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: karatoot pasoo kee maanas jaat |
English: They belong to the human species, but they act like animals.

Gurbani: ਲੋਕ ਪਚਾਰਾ ਕਰੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: lok pachaaraa karai din raat |
English: They curse others day and night.

Gurbani: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭੇਖ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਲੁ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: baahar bhekh antar mal maaeaa |
English: Outwardly, they wear religious robes, but within is the filth of Maya.

Gurbani: ਛਪਸਿ ਨਾਹਿ ਕਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਛਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: chhapas naeh kachh karai chhapaaeaa |
English: They cannot conceal this, no matter how hard they try.

Gurbani: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਇਸਨਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: baahar giaan dhiaan isanaan |
English: Outwardly, they display knowledge, meditation and purification,

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਲੋਭੁ ਸੁਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: antar biaapai lobh suaan |
English: but within clings the dog of greed.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਤਨੁ ਸੁਆਹ ॥
Transliteration: antar agan baahar tan suaah |
English: The fire of desire rages within; outwardly they apply ashes to their bodies.

Gurbani: ਗਲਿ ਪਾਥਰ ਕੈਸੇ ਤਰੈ ਅਥਾਹ ॥
Transliteration: gal paathar kaise tarai athaah |
English: There is a stone around their neck - how can they cross the unfathomable ocean?

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਸੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai antar basai prabh aap |
English: Those, within whom God Himself abides

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਤਿ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak te jan sehaj samaat |5|
English: - O Nanak, those humble beings are intuitively absorbed in the Lord. ||5||

[Ang 267 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੁਨਿ ਅੰਧਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: sun andhaa kaise maarag paavai |
English: By listening, how can the blind find the path?

Gurbani: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਓੜਿ ਨਿਬਹਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: kar geh lehu orr nibahaavai |
English: Take hold of his hand, and then he can reach his destination.

Gurbani: ਕਹਾ ਬੁਝਾਰਤਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਡੋਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kahaa bujhaarat boojhai ddoraa |
English: How can a riddle be understood by the deaf?

Gurbani: ਨਿਸਿ ਕਹੀਐ ਤਉ ਸਮਝੈ ਭੋਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: nis kaheeai tau samajhai bhoraa |
English: Say 'night', and he thinks you said 'day'.

Gurbani: ਕਹਾ ਬਿਸਨਪਦ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁੰਗ ॥
Transliteration: kahaa bisanapad gaavai gung |
English: How can the mute sing the Songs of the Lord?

Gurbani: ਜਤਨ ਕਰੈ ਤਉ ਭੀ ਸੁਰ ਭੰਗ ॥
Transliteration: jatan karai tau bhee sur bhang |
English: He may try, but his voice will fail him.

Gurbani: ਕਹ ਪਿੰਗੁਲ ਪਰਬਤ ਪਰ ਭਵਨ ॥
Transliteration: keh pingul parabat par bhavan |
English: How can the cripple climb up the mountain?

Gurbani: ਨਹੀ ਹੋਤ ਊਹਾ ਉਸੁ ਗਵਨ ॥
Transliteration: nahee hot aoohaa us gavan |
English: He simply cannot go there.

Gurbani: ਕਰਤਾਰ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਦੀਨੁ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: karataar karunaa mai deen benatee karai |
English: O Creator, Lord of Mercy - Your humble servant prays;

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤਰੈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: naanak tumaree kirapaa tarai |6|
English: Nanak: by Your Grace, please save me. ||6||

[Ang 267 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਸੁ ਆਵੈ ਨ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: sang sahaaee su aavai na cheet |
English: The Lord, our Help and Support, is always with us, but the mortal does not remember Him.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਬੈਰਾਈ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: jo bairaaee taa siau preet |
English: He shows love to his enemies.

Gurbani: ਬਲੂਆ ਕੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਬਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: balooaa ke grih bheetar basai |
English: He lives in a castle of sand.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦ ਕੇਲ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: anad kel maaeaa rang rasai |
English: He enjoys the games of pleasure and the tastes of Maya.

Gurbani: ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੈ ਮਨਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: drirr kar maanai maneh prateet |
English: He believes them to be permanent - this is the belief of his mind.

Gurbani: ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਮੂੜੇ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: kaal na aavai moorre cheet |
English: Death does not even come to mind for the fool.

Gurbani: ਬੈਰ ਬਿਰੋਧ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮੋਹ ॥
Transliteration: bair birodh kaam krodh moh |
English: Hate, conflict, sexual desire, anger, emotional attachment,

Gurbani: ਝੂਠ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮਹਾ ਲੋਭ ਧ੍ਰੋਹ ॥
Transliteration: jhootth bikaar mahaa lobh dhroh |
English: falsehood, corruption, immense greed and deceit:

Gurbani: ਇਆਹੂ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਬਿਹਾਨੇ ਕਈ ਜਨਮ ॥
Transliteration: eaahoo jugat bihaane kee janam |
English: So many lifetimes are wasted in these ways.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਆਪਨ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਮ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: naanak raakh lehu aapan kar karam |7|
English: Nanak: uplift them, and redeem them, O Lord - show Your Mercy! ||7||

[Ang 268 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਤੂ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਤੁਮ ਪਹਿ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: too tthaakur tum peh aradaas |
English: You are our Lord and Master; to You, I offer this prayer.

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: jeeo pindd sabh teree raas |
English: This body and soul are all Your property.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: tum maat pitaa ham baarik tere |
English: You are our mother and father; we are Your children.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਮਹਿ ਸੂਖ ਘਨੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: tumaree kripaa meh sookh ghanere |
English: In Your Grace, there are so many joys!

Gurbani: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: koe na jaanai tumaraa ant |
English: No one knows Your limits.

Gurbani: ਊਚੇ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: aooche te aoochaa bhagavant |
English: O Highest of the High, Most Generous God,

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਤੁਮਰੈ ਸੂਤ੍ਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: sagal samagree tumarai sootr dhaaree |
English: the whole creation is strung on Your thread.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: tum te hoe su aagiaakaaree |
English: That which has come from You is under Your Command.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: tumaree gat mit tum hee jaanee |
English: You alone know Your state and extent.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਦਾ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੀ ॥੮॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak daas sadaa kurabaanee |8|4|
English: Nanak, Your slave, is forever a sacrifice. ||8||4||

[Ang 268 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਦੇਨਹਾਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਛੋਡਿ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਹਿ ਆਨ ਸੁਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: denahaar prabh chhodd kai laageh aan suaae |
English: One who renounces God the Giver, and attaches himself to other affairs

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹੂ ਨ ਸੀਝਈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak kahoo na seejhee bin naavai pat jaae |1|
English: - O Nanak, he shall never succeed. Without the Name, he shall lose his honor. ||1||

[Ang 268 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
Transliteration: asattapadee |
English: Ashtapadee:

Gurbani: ਦਸ ਬਸਤੂ ਲੇ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: das basatoo le paachhai paavai |
English: He obtains ten things, and puts them behind him;

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਬਸਤੁ ਕਾਰਨਿ ਬਿਖੋਟਿ ਗਵਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: ek basat kaaran bikhott gavaavai |
English: for the sake of one thing withheld, he forfeits his faith.

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਭੀ ਨ ਦੇਇ ਦਸ ਭੀ ਹਿਰਿ ਲੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: ek bhee na dee das bhee hir lee |
English: But what if that one thing were not given, and the ten were taken away?

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਮੂੜਾ ਕਹੁ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: tau moorraa kahu kahaa karee |
English: Then, what could the fool say or do?

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jis tthaakur siau naahee chaaraa |
English: Our Lord and Master cannot be moved by force.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕੀਜੈ ਸਦ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: taa kau keejai sad namasakaaraa |
English: Unto Him, bow forever in adoration.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai man laagaa prabh meetthaa |
English: That one, unto whose mind God seems sweet

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਤਾਹੂ ਮਨਿ ਵੂਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: sarab sookh taahoo man vootthaa |
English: all pleasures come to abide in his mind.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਅਪਨਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jis jan apanaa hukam manaaeaa |
English: One who abides by the Lord's Will,

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਥੋਕ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sarab thok naanak tin paaeaa |1|
English: O Nanak, obtains all things. ||1||

[Ang 268 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਅਗਨਤ ਸਾਹੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਦੇ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: aganat saahu apanee de raas |
English: God the Banker gives endless capital to the mortal,

Gurbani: ਖਾਤ ਪੀਤ ਬਰਤੈ ਅਨਦ ਉਲਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: khaat peet baratai anad ulaas |
English: who eats, drinks and expends it with pleasure and joy.

Gurbani: ਅਪੁਨੀ ਅਮਾਨ ਕਛੁ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਸਾਹੁ ਲੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: apunee amaan kachh bahur saahu lee |
English: If some of this capital is later taken back by the Banker,

Gurbani: ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਮਨਿ ਰੋਸੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: agiaanee man ros karee |
English: the ignorant person shows his anger.

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੀ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: apanee parateet aap hee khovai |
English: He himself destroys his own credibility,

Gurbani: ਬਹੁਰਿ ਉਸ ਕਾ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: bahur us kaa bisvaas na hovai |
English: and he shall not again be trusted.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਬਸਤੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: jis kee basat tis aagai raakhai |
English: When one offers to the Lord, that which belongs to the Lord,

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਮਾਨੈ ਮਾਥੈ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kee aagiaa maanai maathai |
English: and willingly abides by the Will of God's Order,
