Gurbani: ਉਸ ਤੇ ਚਉਗੁਨ ਕਰੈ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: aus te chaugun karai nihaal |
English: the Lord will make him happy four times over.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak saahib sadaa deaal |2|
English: O Nanak, our Lord and Master is merciful forever. ||2||

[Ang 268 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਤਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਹੇਤ ॥
Transliteration: anik bhaat maaeaa ke het |
English: The many forms of attachment to Maya shall surely pass away

Gurbani: ਸਰਪਰ ਹੋਵਤ ਜਾਨੁ ਅਨੇਤ ॥
Transliteration: sarapar hovat jaan anet |
English: - know that they are transitory.

Gurbani: ਬਿਰਖ ਕੀ ਛਾਇਆ ਸਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: birakh kee chhaaeaa siau rang laavai |
English: People fall in love with the shade of the tree,

Gurbani: ਓਹ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਉਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: oeh binasai uhu man pachhutaavai |
English: and when it passes away, they feel regret in their minds.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਚਾਲਨਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jo deesai so chaalanahaar |
English: Whatever is seen, shall pass away;

Gurbani: ਲਪਟਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਤਹ ਅੰਧ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: lapatt rahio teh andh andhaar |
English: and yet, the blindest of the blind cling to it.

Gurbani: ਬਟਾਊ ਸਿਉ ਜੋ ਲਾਵੈ ਨੇਹ ॥
Transliteration: battaaoo siau jo laavai neh |
English: One who gives her love to a passing traveler

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਹਾਥਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕੇਹ ॥
Transliteration: taa kau haath na aavai keh |
English: nothing shall come into her hands in this way.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: man har ke naam kee preet sukhadaaee |
English: O mind, the love of the Name of the Lord bestows peace.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਲਏ ਲਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa naanak aap le laaee |3|
English: O Nanak, the Lord, in His Mercy, unites us with Himself. ||3||

[Ang 268 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: mithiaa tan dhan kuttanb sabaaeaa |
English: False are body, wealth, and all relations.

Gurbani: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: mithiaa haumai mamataa maaeaa |
English: False are ego, possessiveness and Maya.

Gurbani: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਰਾਜ ਜੋਬਨ ਧਨ ਮਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: mithiaa raaj joban dhan maal |
English: False are power, youth, wealth and property.

Gurbani: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: mithiaa kaam krodh bikaraal |
English: False are sexual desire and wild anger.

Gurbani: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਰਥ ਹਸਤੀ ਅਸ੍ਵ ਬਸਤ੍ਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: mithiaa rath hasatee asv basatraa |
English: False are chariots, elephants, horses and expensive clothes.

Gurbani: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਰੰਗ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਪੇਖਿ ਹਸਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: mithiaa rang sang maaeaa pekh hasataa |
English: False is the love of gathering wealth, and reveling in the sight of it.

Gurbani: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਧ੍ਰੋਹ ਮੋਹ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: mithiaa dhroh moh abhimaan |
English: False are deception, emotional attachment and egotistical pride.

Gurbani: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਆਪਸ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਰਤ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: mithiaa aapas aoopar karat gumaan |
English: False are pride and self-conceit.

Gurbani: ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸਰਨ ॥
Transliteration: asathir bhagat saadh kee saran |
English: Only devotional worship is permanent, and the Sanctuary of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak jap jap jeevai har ke charan |4|
English: Nanak lives by meditating, meditating on the Lotus Feet of the Lord. ||4||

[Ang 268 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਸੁਨਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: mithiaa sravan par nindaa suneh |
English: False are the ears which listen to the slander of others.

Gurbani: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਹਸਤ ਪਰ ਦਰਬ ਕਉ ਹਿਰਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: mithiaa hasat par darab kau hireh |
English: False are the hands which steal the wealth of others.

Gurbani: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਪੇਖਤ ਪਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਅ ਰੂਪਾਦ ॥
Transliteration: mithiaa netr pekhat par tria roopaad |
English: False are the eyes which gaze upon the beauty of another's wife.

Gurbani: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਰਸਨਾ ਭੋਜਨ ਅਨ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ॥
Transliteration: mithiaa rasanaa bhojan an svaad |
English: False is the tongue which enjoys delicacies and external tastes.

Gurbani: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਚਰਨ ਪਰ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਕਉ ਧਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: mithiaa charan par bikaar kau dhaaveh |
English: False are the feet which run to do evil to others.

Gurbani: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਮਨ ਪਰ ਲੋਭ ਲੁਭਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: mithiaa man par lobh lubhaaveh |
English: False is the mind which covets the wealth of others.

Gurbani: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਤਨ ਨਹੀ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: mithiaa tan nahee praupakaaraa |
English: False is the body which does not do good to others.

Gurbani: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਬਾਸੁ ਲੇਤ ਬਿਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: mithiaa baas let bikaaraa |
English: False is the nose which inhales corruption.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਸਭ ਭਏ ॥
Transliteration: bin boojhe mithiaa sabh bhe |
English: Without understanding, everything is false.

Gurbani: ਸਫਲ ਦੇਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਲਏ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: safal deh naanak har har naam le |5|
English: Fruitful is the body, O Nanak, which takes to the Lord's Name. ||5||

[Ang 269 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਰਥੀ ਸਾਕਤ ਕੀ ਆਰਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: birathee saakat kee aarajaa |
English: The life of the faithless cynic is totally useless.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚ ਬਿਨਾ ਕਹ ਹੋਵਤ ਸੂਚਾ ॥
Transliteration: saach binaa keh hovat soochaa |
English: Without the Truth, how can anyone be pure?

Gurbani: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਤਨੁ ਅੰਧ ॥
Transliteration: birathaa naam binaa tan andh |
English: Useless is the body of the spiritually blind, without the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮੁਖਿ ਆਵਤ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ॥
Transliteration: mukh aavat taa kai duragandh |
English: From his mouth, a foul smell issues forth.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਬਿਹਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin simaran din rain brithaa bihaae |
English: Without the remembrance of the Lord, day and night pass in vain,

Gurbani: ਮੇਘ ਬਿਨਾ ਜਿਉ ਖੇਤੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: megh binaa jiau khetee jaae |
English: like the crop which withers without rain.

Gurbani: ਗੋਬਿਦ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਬ੍ਰਿਥੇ ਸਭ ਕਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: gobid bhajan bin brithe sabh kaam |
English: Without meditation on the Lord of the Universe, all works are in vain,

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਕਿਰਪਨ ਕੇ ਨਿਰਾਰਥ ਦਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: jiau kirapan ke niraarath daam |
English: like the wealth of a miser, which lies useless.

Gurbani: ਧੰਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਜਿਹ ਘਟਿ ਬਸਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan te jan jih ghatt basio har naau |
English: Blessed, blessed are those, whose hearts are filled with the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: naanak taa kai bal bal jaau |6|
English: Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to them. ||6||

[Ang 269 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਹਤ ਅਵਰ ਕਛੁ ਅਵਰ ਕਮਾਵਤ ॥
Transliteration: rehat avar kachh avar kamaavat |
English: He says one thing, and does something else.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਗੰਢ ਲਾਵਤ ॥
Transliteration: man nahee preet mukhahu gandt laavat |
English: There is no love in his heart, and yet with his mouth he talks tall.

Gurbani: ਜਾਨਨਹਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਪਰਬੀਨ ॥
Transliteration: jaananahaar prabhoo parabeen |
English: The Omniscient Lord God is the Knower of all.

Gurbani: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭੇਖ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਭੀਨ ॥
Transliteration: baahar bhekh na kaahoo bheen |
English: He is not impressed by outward display.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੈ ਆਪਿ ਨ ਕਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: avar upadesai aap na karai |
English: One who does not practice what he preaches to others,

Gurbani: ਆਵਤ ਜਾਵਤ ਜਨਮੈ ਮਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: aavat jaavat janamai marai |
English: shall come and go in reincarnation, through birth and death.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਸੈ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jis kai antar basai nirankaar |
English: One whose inner being is filled with the Formless Lord

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੀਖ ਤਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: tis kee seekh tarai sansaar |
English: by his teachings, the world is saved.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੁਮ ਭਾਨੇ ਤਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo tum bhaane tin prabh jaataa |
English: Those who are pleasing to You, God, know You.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਨ ਜਨ ਚਰਨ ਪਰਾਤਾ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: naanak un jan charan paraataa |7|
English: Nanak falls at their feet. ||7||

[Ang 269 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: krau benatee paarabraham sabh jaanai |
English: Offer your prayers to the Supreme Lord God, who knows everything.

Gurbani: ਅਪਨਾ ਕੀਆ ਆਪਹਿ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: apanaa keea aapeh maanai |
English: He Himself values His own creatures.

Gurbani: ਆਪਹਿ ਆਪ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਤ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aapeh aap aap karat niberaa |
English: He Himself, by Himself, makes the decisions.

Gurbani: ਕਿਸੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਜਨਾਵਤ ਕਿਸੈ ਬੁਝਾਵਤ ਨੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kisai door janaavat kisai bujhaavat neraa |
English: To some, He appears far away, while others perceive Him near at hand.

Gurbani: ਉਪਾਵ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਸਗਲ ਤੇ ਰਹਤ ॥
Transliteration: aupaav siaanap sagal te rehat |
English: He is beyond all efforts and clever tricks.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਆਤਮ ਕੀ ਰਹਤ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kachh jaanai aatam kee rehat |
English: He knows all the ways and means of the soul.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਏ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jis bhaavai tis le larr laae |
English: Those with whom He is pleased are attached to the hem of His robe.

Gurbani: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: thaan thanantar rahiaa samaae |
English: He is pervading all places and interspaces.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: so sevak jis kirapaa karee |
English: Those upon whom He bestows His favor, become His servants.

Gurbani: ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰੀ ॥੮॥੫॥
Transliteration: nimakh nimakh jap naanak haree |8|5|
English: Each and every moment, O Nanak, meditate on the Lord. ||8||5||

[Ang 269 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਅਰੁ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਅਹੰਮੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh ar lobh moh binas jaae ahamev |
English: Sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment - may these be gone, and egotism as well.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੁ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak prabh saranaagatee kar prasaad guradev |1|
English: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God; please bless me with Your Grace, O Divine Guru. ||1||

[Ang 269 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
Transliteration: asattapadee |
English: Ashtapadee:

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਛਤੀਹ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jih prasaad chhateeh amrit khaeh |
English: By His Grace, you partake of the thirty-six delicacies;

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਉ ਰਖੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: tis tthaakur kau rakh man maeh |
English: enshrine that Lord and Master within your mind.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸੁਗੰਧਤ ਤਨਿ ਲਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jih prasaad sugandhat tan laaveh |
English: By His Grace, you apply scented oils to your body;

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: tis kau simarat param gat paaveh |
English: remembering Him, the supreme status is obtained.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਬਸਹਿ ਸੁਖ ਮੰਦਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jih prasaad baseh sukh mandar |
English: By His Grace, you dwell in the palace of peace;

Gurbani: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਦਾ ਮਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: tiseh dhiaae sadaa man andar |
English: meditate forever on Him within your mind.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਖ ਬਸਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jih prasaad grih sang sukh basanaa |
English: By His Grace, you abide with your family in peace;

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar simarahu tis rasanaa |
English: keep His remembrance upon your tongue, twenty-four hours a day.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਰੰਗ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: jih prasaad rang ras bhog |
English: By His Grace, you enjoy tastes and pleasures;

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਧਿਆਵਨ ਜੋਗ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak sadaa dhiaaeeai dhiaavan jog |1|
English: O Nanak, meditate forever on the One, who is worthy of meditation. ||1||

[Ang 269 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਾਟ ਪਟੰਬਰ ਹਢਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jih prasaad paatt pattanbar hadtaaveh |
English: By His Grace, you wear silks and satins;

Gurbani: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਕਤ ਅਵਰ ਲੁਭਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: tiseh tiaag kat avar lubhaaveh |
English: why abandon Him, to attach yourself to another?

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੇਜ ਸੋਈਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: jih prasaad sukh sej soeejai |
English: By His Grace, you sleep in a cozy bed;

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: man aatth pehar taa kaa jas gaaveejai |
English: O my mind, sing His Praises, twenty-four hours a day.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤੁਝੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਊ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: jih prasaad tujh sabh koaoo maanai |
English: By His Grace, you are honored by everyone;

Gurbani: ਮੁਖਿ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਜਸੁ ਰਸਨ ਬਖਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: mukh taa ko jas rasan bakhaanai |
English: with your mouth and with your tongue, chant His Praises.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤੇਰੋ ਰਹਤਾ ਧਰਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: jih prasaad tero rahataa dharam |
English: By His Grace, you remain in the Dharma;

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇ ਕੇਵਲ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: man sadaa dhiaae keval paarabraham |
English: O mind, meditate continually on the Supreme Lord God.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਜਪਤ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: prabh jee japat daragah maan paaveh |
English: Meditating on God, you shall be honored in His Court;

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਤਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak pat setee ghar jaaveh |2|
English: O Nanak, you shall return to your true home with honor. ||2||

[Ang 270 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਆਰੋਗ ਕੰਚਨ ਦੇਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jih prasaad aarog kanchan dehee |
English: By His Grace, you have a healthy, golden body;

Gurbani: ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਰਾਮ ਸਨੇਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: liv laavahu tis raam sanehee |
English: attune yourself to that Loving Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਓਲਾ ਰਹਤ ॥
Transliteration: jih prasaad teraa olaa rehat |
English: By His Grace, your honor is preserved;

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਹਤ ॥
Transliteration: man sukh paaveh har har jas kehat |
English: O mind, chant the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, and find peace.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਢਾਕੇ ॥
Transliteration: jih prasaad tere sagal chhidr dtaake |
English: By His Grace, all your deficits are covered;

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਸਰਨੀ ਪਰੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥
Transliteration: man saranee par tthaakur prabh taa kai |
English: O mind, seek the Sanctuary of God, our Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤੁਝੁ ਕੋ ਨ ਪਹੂਚੈ ॥
Transliteration: jih prasaad tujh ko na pahoochai |
English: By His Grace, no one can rival you;

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਊਚੇ ॥
Transliteration: man saas saas simarahu prabh aooche |
English: O mind, with each and every breath, remember God on High.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਾਈ ਦ੍ਰੁਲਭ ਦੇਹ ॥
Transliteration: jih prasaad paaee drulabh deh |
English: By His Grace, you obtained this precious human body;

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇਹ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak taa kee bhagat kareh |3|
English: O Nanak, worship Him with devotion. ||3||

[Ang 270 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਆਭੂਖਨ ਪਹਿਰੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: jih prasaad aabhookhan pahireejai |
English: By His Grace, you wear decorations;

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਕਿਉ ਆਲਸੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: man tis simarat kiau aalas keejai |
English: O mind, why are you so lazy? Why don't you remember Him in meditation?

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਅਸ੍ਵ ਹਸਤਿ ਅਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jih prasaad asv hasat asavaaree |
English: By His Grace, you have horses and elephants to ride;

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਬਿਸਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: man tis prabh kau kabahoo na bisaaree |
English: O mind, never forget that God.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਬਾਗ ਮਿਲਖ ਧਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jih prasaad baag milakh dhanaa |
English: By His Grace, you have land, gardens and wealth;

Gurbani: ਰਾਖੁ ਪਰੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਮਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: raakh paroe prabh apune manaa |
English: keep God enshrined in your heart.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਮਨ ਬਨਤ ਬਨਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jin teree man banat banaaee |
English: O mind, the One who formed your form

Gurbani: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸਦ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: aootthat baitthat sad tiseh dhiaaee |
English: standing up and sitting down, meditate always on Him.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਜੋ ਏਕ ਅਲਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: tiseh dhiaae jo ek alakhai |
English: Meditate on Him - the One Invisible Lord;

Gurbani: ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਖੈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: eehaa aoohaa naanak teree rakhai |4|
English: here and hereafter, O Nanak, He shall save you. ||4||

[Ang 270 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੁੰਨ ਬਹੁ ਦਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: jih prasaad kareh pun bahu daan |
English: By His Grace, you give donations in abundance to charities;

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਕਰਿ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਧਿਆਨ ॥
Transliteration: man aatth pehar kar tis kaa dhiaan |
English: O mind, meditate on Him, twenty-four hours a day.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤੂ ਆਚਾਰ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jih prasaad too aachaar biauhaaree |
English: By His Grace, you perform religious rituals and worldly duties;

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਚਿਤਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: tis prabh kau saas saas chitaaree |
English: think of God with each and every breath.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਰੂਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: jih prasaad teraa sundar roop |
English: By His Grace, your form is so beautiful;

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੂਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: so prabh simarahu sadaa anoop |
English: constantly remember God, the Incomparably Beautiful One.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਨੀਕੀ ਜਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: jih prasaad teree neekee jaat |
English: By His Grace, you have such high social status;

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: so prabh simar sadaa din raat |
English: remember God always, day and night.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਪਤਿ ਰਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: jih prasaad teree pat rahai |
English: By His Grace, your honor is preserved;

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਸੁ ਕਹੈ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad naanak jas kahai |5|
English: by Guru's Grace, O Nanak, chant His Praises. ||5||

[Ang 270 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸੁਨਹਿ ਕਰਨ ਨਾਦ ॥
Transliteration: jih prasaad suneh karan naad |
English: By His Grace, you listen to the sound current of the Naad.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਪੇਖਹਿ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥
Transliteration: jih prasaad pekheh bisamaad |
English: By His Grace, you behold amazing wonders.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jih prasaad boleh amrit rasanaa |
English: By His Grace, you speak ambrosial words with your tongue.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਬਸਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jih prasaad sukh sahaje basanaa |
English: By His Grace, you abide in peace and ease.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਸਤ ਕਰ ਚਲਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jih prasaad hasat kar chaleh |
English: By His Grace, your hands move and work.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸੰਪੂਰਨ ਫਲਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jih prasaad sanpooran faleh |
English: By His Grace, you are completely fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jih prasaad param gat paaveh |
English: By His Grace, you obtain the supreme status.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jih prasaad sukh sehaj samaaveh |
English: By His Grace, you are absorbed into celestial peace.

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਅਵਰ ਕਤ ਲਾਗਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa prabh tiaag avar kat laagahu |
English: Why forsake God, and attach yourself to another?

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਜਾਗਹੁ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad naanak man jaagahu |6|
English: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, awaken your mind! ||6||

[Ang 270 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jih prasaad toon pragatt sansaar |
English: By His Grace, you are famous all over the world;

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਮਨਹੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: tis prabh kau mool na manahu bisaar |
English: never forget God from your mind.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: jih prasaad teraa parataap |
English: By His Grace, you have prestige;

Gurbani: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੂੜ ਤੂ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਜਾਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: re man moorr too taa kau jaap |
English: O foolish mind, meditate on Him!

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jih prasaad tere kaaraj poore |
English: By His Grace, your works are completed;

Gurbani: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਜਾਨੁ ਮਨ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: tiseh jaan man sadaa hajoore |
English: O mind, know Him to be close at hand.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤੂੰ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸਾਚੁ ॥
Transliteration: jih prasaad toon paaveh saach |
English: By His Grace, you find the Truth;

Gurbani: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੂੰ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਚੁ ॥
Transliteration: re man mere toon taa siau raach |
English: O my mind, merge yourself into Him.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸਭ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jih prasaad sabh kee gat hoe |
English: By His Grace, everyone is saved;

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਪੁ ਜਪੈ ਜਪੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: naanak jaap japai jap soe |7|
English: O Nanak, meditate, and chant His Chant. ||7||

[Ang 270 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਜਪਾਏ ਜਪੈ ਸੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aap japaae japai so naau |
English: Those, whom He inspires to chant, chant His Name.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਗਾਵਾਏ ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aap gaavaae su har gun gaau |
English: Those, whom He inspires to sing, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kirapaa te hoe pragaas |
English: By God's Grace, enlightenment comes.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਇਆ ਤੇ ਕਮਲ ਬਿਗਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: prabhoo deaa te kamal bigaas |
English: By God's Kind Mercy, the heart-lotus blossoms forth.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਬਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: prabh suprasan basai man soe |
English: When God is totally pleased, He comes to dwell in the mind.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਇਆ ਤੇ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: prabh deaa te mat aootam hoe |
English: By God's Kind Mercy, the intellect is exalted.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਮਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sarab nidhaan prabh teree meaa |
English: All treasures, O Lord, come by Your Kind Mercy.

Gurbani: ਆਪਹੁ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਕਿਨਹੂ ਲਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aapahu kachhoo na kinahoo leaa |
English: No one obtains anything by himself.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਥ ॥
Transliteration: jit jit laavahu tith lageh har naath |
English: As You have delegated, so do we apply ourselves, O Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਨ ਕੈ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹਾਥ ॥੮॥੬॥
Transliteration: naanak in kai kachhoo na haath |8|6|
English: O Nanak, nothing is in our hands. ||8||6||

[Ang 271 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: agam agaadh paarabraham soe |
English: Unapproachable and Unfathomable is the Supreme Lord God;

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਹੈ ਸੁ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jo jo kahai su mukataa hoe |
English: whoever speaks of Him shall be liberated.

Gurbani: ਸੁਨਿ ਮੀਤਾ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬਿਨਵੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: sun meetaa naanak binavantaa |
English: Listen, O friends, Nanak prays,

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਅਚਰਜ ਕਥਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saadh janaa kee acharaj kathaa |1|
English: To the wonderful story of the Holy. ||1||

[Ang 271 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
Transliteration: asattapadee |
English: Ashtapadee:

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਹੋਤ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kai sang mukh aoojal hot |
English: In the Company of the Holy, one's face becomes radiant.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਲੁ ਸਗਲੀ ਖੋਤ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang mal sagalee khot |
English: In the Company of the Holy, all filth is removed.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਟੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kai sang mittai abhimaan |
English: In the Company of the Holy, egotism is eliminated.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੈ ਸੁਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kai sang pragattai sugiaan |
English: In the Company of the Holy, spiritual wisdom is revealed.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਬੁਝੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kai sang bujhai prabh neraa |
English: In the Company of the Holy, God is understood to be near at hand.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸਭੁ ਹੋਤ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang sabh hot niberaa |
English: In the Company of the Holy, all conflicts are settled.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kai sang paae naam ratan |
English: In the Company of the Holy, one obtains the jewel of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਏਕ ਊਪਰਿ ਜਤਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kai sang ek aoopar jatan |
English: In the Company of the Holy, one's efforts are directed toward the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਬਰਨੈ ਕਉਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kee mahimaa baranai kaun praanee |
English: What mortal can speak of the Glorious Praises of the Holy?

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak saadh kee sobhaa prabh maeh samaanee |1|
English: O Nanak, the glory of the Holy people merges into God. ||1||

[Ang 271 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kai sang agochar milai |
English: In the Company of the Holy, one meets the Incomprehensible Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਦਾ ਪਰਫੁਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kai sang sadaa parafulai |
English: In the Company of the Holy, one flourishes forever.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਬਸਿ ਪੰਚਾ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kai sang aaveh bas panchaa |
English: In the Company of the Holy, the five passions are brought to rest.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਭੁੰਚਾ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang amrit ras bhunchaa |
English: In the Company of the Holy, one enjoys the essence of ambrosia.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਭ ਕੀ ਰੇਨ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang hoe sabh kee ren |
English: In the Company of the Holy, one becomes the dust of all.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਨੋਹਰ ਬੈਨ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kai sang manohar bain |
English: In the Company of the Holy, one's speech is enticing.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kai sang na katahoon dhaavai |
English: In the Company of the Holy, the mind does not wander.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਅਸਥਿਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang asathit man paavai |
English: In the Company of the Holy, the mind becomes stable.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਭਿੰਨ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kai sang maaeaa te bhin |
English: In the Company of the Holy, one is rid of Maya.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saadhasang naanak prabh suprasan |2|
English: In the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, God is totally pleased. ||2||

[Ang 271 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਦੁਸਮਨ ਸਭਿ ਮੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang dusaman sabh meet |
English: In the Company of the Holy, all one's enemies become friends.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਹਾ ਪੁਨੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: saadhoo kai sang mahaa puneet |
English: In the Company of the Holy, there is great purity.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਕਿਸ ਸਿਉ ਨਹੀ ਬੈਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang kis siau nahee bair |
English: In the Company of the Holy, no one is hated.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਬੀਗਾ ਪੈਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kai sang na beegaa pair |
English: In the Company of the Holy, one's feet do not wander.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਮੰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kai sang naahee ko mandaa |
English: In the Company of the Holy, no one seems evil.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਾਨੇ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang jaane paramaanandaa |
English: In the Company of the Holy, supreme bliss is known.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਉ ਤਾਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kai sang naahee hau taap |
English: In the Company of the Holy, the fever of ego departs.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਜੈ ਸਭੁ ਆਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kai sang tajai sabh aap |
English: In the Company of the Holy, one renounces all selfishness.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਨੈ ਸਾਧ ਬਡਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aape jaanai saadh baddaaee |
English: He Himself knows the greatness of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak saadh prabhoo ban aaee |3|
English: O Nanak, the Holy are at one with God. ||3||

[Ang 271 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kai sang na kabahoo dhaavai |
English: In the Company of the Holy, the mind never wanders.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kai sang sadaa sukh paavai |
English: In the Company of the Holy, one obtains everlasting peace.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਬਸਤੁ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਲਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang basat agochar lahai |
English: In the Company of the Holy, one grasps the Incomprehensible.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਅਜਰੁ ਸਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: saadhoo kai sang ajar sahai |
English: In the Company of the Holy, one can endure the unendurable.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸੈ ਥਾਨਿ ਊਚੈ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kai sang basai thaan aoochai |
English: In the Company of the Holy, one abides in the loftiest place.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਹਲਿ ਪਹੂਚੈ ॥
Transliteration: saadhoo kai sang mehal pahoochai |
English: In the Company of the Holy, one attains the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੈ ਸਭਿ ਧਰਮ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kai sang drirrai sabh dharam |
English: In the Company of the Holy, one's Dharmic faith is firmly established.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਕੇਵਲ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kai sang keval paarabraham |
English: In the Company of the Holy, one dwells with the Supreme Lord God.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kai sang paae naam nidhaan |
English: In the Company of the Holy, one obtains the treasure of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak saadhoo kai kurabaan |4|
English: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Holy. ||4||

[Ang 271 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਭ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kai sang sabh kul udhaarai |
English: In the Company of the Holy, all one's family is saved.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਮੀਤ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang saajan meet kuttanb nisataarai |
English: In the Company of the Holy, one's friends, acquaintances and relatives are redeemed.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: saadhoo kai sang so dhan paavai |
English: In the Company of the Holy, that wealth is obtained.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਧਨ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਵਰਸਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jis dhan te sabh ko varasaavai |
English: Everyone benefits from that wealth.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕਰੇ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang dharam raae kare sevaa |
English: In the Company of the Holy, the Lord of Dharma serves.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਸੁਰਦੇਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kai sang sobhaa suradevaa |
English: In the Company of the Holy, the divine, angelic beings sing God's Praises.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਪ ਪਲਾਇਨ ॥
Transliteration: saadhoo kai sang paap palaaein |
English: In the Company of the Holy, one's sins fly away.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇਨ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang amrit gun gaaein |
English: In the Company of the Holy, one sings the Ambrosial Glories.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਥਾਨ ਗੰਮਿ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kai sang srab thaan gam |
English: In the Company of the Holy, all places are within reach.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਫਲ ਜਨੰਮ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak saadh kai sang safal janam |5|
English: O Nanak, in the Company of the Holy, one's life becomes fruitful. ||5||

[Ang 272 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਘਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kai sang nahee kachh ghaal |
English: In the Company of the Holy, there is no suffering.

Gurbani: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਹੋਤ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: darasan bhettat hot nihaal |
English: The Blessed Vision of their Darshan brings a sublime, happy peace.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਲੂਖਤ ਹਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kai sang kalookhat harai |
English: In the Company of the Holy, blemishes are removed.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਰਕ ਪਰਹਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kai sang narak paraharai |
English: In the Company of the Holy, hell is far away.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kai sang eehaa aoohaa suhelaa |
English: In the Company of the Holy, one is happy here and hereafter.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang bichhurat har melaa |
English: In the Company of the Holy, the separated ones are reunited with the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਇਛੈ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jo ichhai soee fal paavai |
English: The fruits of one's desires are obtained.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kai sang na birathaa jaavai |
English: In the Company of the Holy, no one goes empty-handed.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸਾਧ ਰਿਦ ਬਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham saadh rid basai |
English: The Supreme Lord God dwells in the hearts of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਧਰੈ ਸਾਧ ਸੁਨਿ ਰਸੈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: naanak udharai saadh sun rasai |6|
English: O Nanak, listening to the sweet words of the Holy, one is saved. ||6||

[Ang 272 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਨਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kai sang sunau har naau |
English: In the Company of the Holy, listen to the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang har ke gun gaau |
English: In the Company of the Holy, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਬਿਸਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kai sang na man te bisarai |
English: In the Company of the Holy, do not forget Him from your mind.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸਰਪਰ ਨਿਸਤਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang sarapar nisatarai |
English: In the Company of the Holy, you shall surely be saved.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਗੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kai sang lagai prabh meetthaa |
English: In the Company of the Holy, God seems very sweet.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਡੀਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: saadhoo kai sang ghatt ghatt ddeetthaa |
English: In the Company of the Holy, He is seen in each and every heart.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਭਏ ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang bhe aagiaakaaree |
English: In the Company of the Holy, we become obedient to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਗਤਿ ਭਈ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang gat bhee hamaaree |
English: In the Company of the Holy, we obtain the state of salvation.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਟੇ ਸਭਿ ਰੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kai sang mitte sabh rog |
English: In the Company of the Holy, all diseases are cured.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਭੇਟੇ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: naanak saadh bhette sanjog |7|
English: O Nanak, one meets with the Holy, by highest destiny. ||7||

[Ang 272 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਬੇਦ ਨ ਜਾਨਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kee mahimaa bed na jaaneh |
English: The glory of the Holy people is not known to the Vedas.

Gurbani: ਜੇਤਾ ਸੁਨਹਿ ਤੇਤਾ ਬਖਿਆਨਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jetaa suneh tetaa bakhiaaneh |
English: They can describe only what they have heard.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਤਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kee upamaa tihu gun te door |
English: The greatness of the Holy people is beyond the three qualities.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਰਹੀ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kee upamaa rahee bharapoor |
English: The greatness of the Holy people is all-pervading.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਅੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kee sobhaa kaa naahee ant |
English: The glory of the Holy people has no limit.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਸਦਾ ਬੇਅੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kee sobhaa sadaa beant |
English: The glory of the Holy people is infinite and eternal.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਊਚ ਤੇ ਊਚੀ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kee sobhaa aooch te aoochee |
English: The glory of the Holy people is the highest of the high.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਮੂਚ ਤੇ ਮੂਚੀ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kee sobhaa mooch te moochee |
English: The glory of the Holy people is the greatest of the great.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਸਾਧ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kee sobhaa saadh ban aaee |
English: The glory of the Holy people is theirs alone;

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥੮॥੭॥
Transliteration: naanak saadh prabh bhed na bhaaee |8|7|
English: O Nanak, there is no difference between the Holy people and God. ||8||7||

[Ang 272 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: man saachaa mukh saachaa soe |
English: The True One is on his mind, and the True One is upon his lips.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਪੇਖੈ ਏਕਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: avar na pekhai ekas bin koe |
English: He sees only the One.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹ ਲਛਣ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak ih lachhan braham giaanee hoe |1|
English: O Nanak, these are the qualities of the God-conscious being. ||1||

[Ang 272 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
Transliteration: asattapadee |
English: Ashtapadee:

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਲੇਪ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee sadaa niralep |
English: The God-conscious being is always unattached,

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਕਮਲ ਅਲੇਪ ॥
Transliteration: jaise jal meh kamal alep |
English: as the lotus in the water remains detached.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਦੋਖ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee sadaa niradokh |
English: The God-conscious being is always unstained,

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੇ ਸੂਰੁ ਸਰਬ ਕਉ ਸੋਖ ॥
Transliteration: jaise soor sarab kau sokh |
English: like the sun, which gives its comfort and warmth to all.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਮਾਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee kai drisatt samaan |
English: The God-conscious being looks upon all alike,

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੇ ਰਾਜ ਰੰਕ ਕਉ ਲਾਗੈ ਤੁਲਿ ਪਵਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: jaise raaj rank kau laagai tul pavaan |
English: like the wind, which blows equally upon the king and the poor beggar.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਏਕ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee kai dheeraj ek |
English: The God-conscious being has a steady patience,

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਕੋਊ ਖੋਦੈ ਕੋਊ ਚੰਦਨ ਲੇਪ ॥
Transliteration: jiau basudhaa koaoo khodai koaoo chandan lep |
English: like the earth, which is dug up by one, and anointed with sandal paste by another.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਇਹੈ ਗੁਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee kaa ihai gunaau |
English: This is the quality of the God-conscious being:

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਉ ਪਾਵਕ ਕਾ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak jiau paavak kaa sehaj subhaau |1|
English: O Nanak, his inherent nature is like a warming fire. ||1||

[Ang 272 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee niramal te niramalaa |
English: The God-conscious being is the purest of the pure;

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੇ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਜਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaise mail na laagai jalaa |
English: filth does not stick to water.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee kai man hoe pragaas |
English: The God-conscious being's mind is enlightened,

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੇ ਧਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਆਕਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: jaise dhar aoopar aakaas |
English: like the sky above the earth.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਮਾਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee kai mitr satru samaan |
English: To the God-conscious being, friend and foe are the same.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee kai naahee abhimaan |
English: The God-conscious being has no egotistical pride.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਊਚ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee aooch te aoochaa |
English: The God-conscious being is the highest of the high.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਅਪਨੈ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਨੀਚਾ ॥
Transliteration: man apanai hai sabh te neechaa |
English: Within his own mind, he is the most humble of all.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਭਏ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee se jan bhe |
English: They alone become God-conscious beings,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak jin prabh aap karee |2|
English: O Nanak, whom God Himself makes so. ||2||

[Ang 272 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸਗਲ ਕੀ ਰੀਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee sagal kee reenaa |
English: The God-conscious being is the dust of all.

Gurbani: ਆਤਮ ਰਸੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਚੀਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: aatam ras braham giaanee cheenaa |
English: The God-conscious being knows the nature of the soul.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਮਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee kee sabh aoopar meaa |
English: The God-conscious being shows kindness to all.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਤੇ ਕਛੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਭਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee te kachh buraa na bheaa |
English: No evil comes from the God-conscious being.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee sadaa samadarasee |
English: The God-conscious being is always impartial.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬਰਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee kee drisatt amrit barasee |
English: Nectar rains down from the glance of the God-conscious being.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੇ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee bandhan te mukataa |
English: The God-conscious being is free from entanglements.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee kee niramal jugataa |
English: The lifestyle of the God-conscious being is spotlessly pure.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਗਿਆਨ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee kaa bhojan giaan |
English: Spiritual wisdom is the food of the God-conscious being.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak braham giaanee kaa braham dhiaan |3|
English: O Nanak, the God-conscious being is absorbed in God's meditation. ||3||

[Ang 273 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਏਕ ਊਪਰਿ ਆਸ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee ek aoopar aas |
English: The God-conscious being centers his hopes on the One alone.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਨਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee kaa nahee binaas |
English: The God-conscious being shall never perish.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਸਮਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee kai gareebee samaahaa |
English: The God-conscious being is steeped in humility.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਉਮਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee praupakaar umaahaa |
English: The God-conscious being delights in doing good to others.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਧੰਧਾ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee kai naahee dhandhaa |
English: The God-conscious being has no worldly entanglements.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਲੇ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਬੰਧਾ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee le dhaavat bandhaa |
English: The God-conscious being holds his wandering mind under control.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਭਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee kai hoe su bhalaa |
English: The God-conscious being acts in the common good.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸੁਫਲ ਫਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee sufal falaa |
English: The God-conscious being blossoms in fruitfulness.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਗਲ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee sang sagal udhaar |
English: In the Company of the God-conscious being, all are saved.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਪੈ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak braham giaanee japai sagal sansaar |4|
English: O Nanak, through the God-conscious being, the whole world meditates on God. ||4||

[Ang 273 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਏਕੈ ਰੰਗ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee kai ekai rang |
English: The God-conscious being loves the One Lord alone.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਬਸੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੰਗ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee kai basai prabh sang |
English: The God-conscious being dwells with God.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee kai naam aadhaar |
English: The God-conscious being takes the Naam as his Support.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee kai naam paravaar |
English: The God-conscious being has the Naam as his Family.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਦ ਜਾਗਤ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee sadaa sad jaagat |
English: The God-conscious being is awake and aware, forever and ever.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਤਿਆਗਤ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee ahanbudh tiaagat |
English: The God-conscious being renounces his proud ego.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee kai man paramaanand |
English: In the mind of the God-conscious being, there is supreme bliss.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee kai ghar sadaa anand |
English: In the home of the God-conscious being, there is everlasting bliss.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee sukh sehaj nivaas |
English: The God-conscious being dwells in peaceful ease.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਨਾਸ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak braham giaanee kaa nahee binaas |5|
English: O Nanak, the God-conscious being shall never perish. ||5||

[Ang 273 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਾ ਬੇਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee braham kaa betaa |
English: The God-conscious being knows God.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਏਕ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੇਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee ek sang hetaa |
English: The God-conscious being is in love with the One alone.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਹੋਇ ਅਚਿੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee kai hoe achint |
English: The God-conscious being is carefree.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee kaa niramal mant |
English: Pure are the Teachings of the God-conscious being.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee jis karai prabh aap |
English: The God-conscious being is made so by God Himself.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਬਡ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee kaa badd parataap |
English: The God-conscious being is gloriously great.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee kaa daras baddabhaagee paaeeai |
English: The Darshan, the Blessed Vision of the God-conscious being, is obtained by great good fortune.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee kau bal bal jaaeeai |
English: To the God-conscious being, I make my life a sacrifice.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਉ ਖੋਜਹਿ ਮਹੇਸੁਰ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee kau khojeh mahesur |
English: The God-conscious being is sought by the great god Shiva.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਆਪਿ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: naanak braham giaanee aap paramesur |6|
English: O Nanak, the God-conscious being is Himself the Supreme Lord God. ||6||

[Ang 273 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee kee keemat naeh |
English: The God-conscious being cannot be appraised.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਸਗਲ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee kai sagal man maeh |
English: The God-conscious being has all within his mind.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਕਉਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਭੇਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee kaa kaun jaanai bhed |
English: Who can know the mystery of the God-conscious being?

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਅਦੇਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee kau sadaa ades |
English: Forever bow to the God-conscious being.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਕਥਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਅਧਾਖੵਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee kaa kathiaa na jaae adhaakhayar |
English: The God-conscious being cannot be described in words.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸਰਬ ਕਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee sarab kaa tthaakur |
English: The God-conscious being is the Lord and Master of all.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੀ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਉਨੁ ਬਖਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee kee mit kaun bakhaanai |
English: Who can describe the limits of the God-conscious being?

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee kee gat braham giaanee jaanai |
English: Only the God-conscious being can know the state of the God-conscious being.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee kaa ant na paar |
English: The God-conscious being has no end or limitation.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: naanak braham giaanee kau sadaa namasakaar |7|
English: O Nanak, to the God-conscious being, bow forever in reverence. ||7||

[Ang 273 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਾ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee sabh srisatt kaa karataa |
English: The God-conscious being is the Creator of all the world.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸਦ ਜੀਵੈ ਨਹੀ ਮਰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee sad jeevai nahee marataa |
English: The God-conscious being lives forever, and does not die.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee mukat jugat jeea kaa daataa |
English: The God-conscious being is the Giver of the way of liberation of the soul.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee pooran purakh bidhaataa |
English: The God-conscious being is the Perfect Supreme Being, who orchestrates all.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਅਨਾਥ ਕਾ ਨਾਥੁ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee anaath kaa naath |
English: The God-conscious being is the helper of the helpless.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਹਾਥੁ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee kaa sabh aoopar haath |
English: The God-conscious being extends his hand to all.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਸਗਲ ਅਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee kaa sagal akaar |
English: The God-conscious being owns the entire creation.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee aap nirankaar |
English: The God-conscious being is himself the Formless Lord.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਬਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee kee sobhaa braham giaanee banee |
English: The glory of the God-conscious being belongs to the God-conscious being alone.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸਰਬ ਕਾ ਧਨੀ ॥੮॥੮॥
Transliteration: naanak braham giaanee sarab kaa dhanee |8|8|
English: O Nanak, the God-conscious being is the Lord of all. ||8||8||

[Ang 274 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੈ ਜੋ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: aur dhaarai jo antar naam |
English: One who enshrines the Naam within the heart,

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਮੈ ਪੇਖੈ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: sarab mai pekhai bhagavaan |
English: who sees the Lord God in all,

Gurbani: ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: nimakh nimakh tthaakur namasakaarai |
English: who, each and every moment, bows in reverence to the Lord Master

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਓਹੁ ਅਪਰਸੁ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak ohu aparas sagal nisataarai |1|
English: - O Nanak, such a one is the true 'touch-nothing Saint', who emancipates everyone. ||1||

[Ang 274 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
Transliteration: asattapadee |
English: Ashtapadee:

Gurbani: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਨਾਹੀ ਰਸਨਾ ਪਰਸ ॥
Transliteration: mithiaa naahee rasanaa paras |
English: One whose tongue does not touch falsehood;

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਦਰਸ ॥
Transliteration: man meh preet niranjan daras |
English: whose mind is filled with love for the Blessed Vision of the Pure Lord,

Gurbani: ਪਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਅ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਪੇਖੈ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ॥
Transliteration: par tria roop na pekhai netr |
English: whose eyes do not gaze upon the beauty of others' wives,

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਹੇਤ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kee ttehal santasang het |
English: who serves the Holy and loves the Saints' Congregation,

Gurbani: ਕਰਨ ਨ ਸੁਨੈ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: karan na sunai kaahoo kee nindaa |
English: whose ears do not listen to slander against anyone,

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਜਾਨੈ ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਮੰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabh te jaanai aapas kau mandaa |
English: who deems himself to be the worst of all,

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਪਰਹਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad bikhiaa paraharai |
English: who, by Guru's Grace, renounces corruption,

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਟਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: man kee baasanaa man te ttarai |
English: who banishes the mind's evil desires from his mind,

Gurbani: ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਜਿਤ ਪੰਚ ਦੋਖ ਤੇ ਰਹਤ ॥
Transliteration: eindree jit panch dokh te rehat |
English: who conquers his sexual instincts and is free of the five sinful passions

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਕੋ ਐਸਾ ਅਪਰਸ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak kott madhe ko aisaa aparas |1|
English: - O Nanak, among millions, there is scarcely one such 'touch-nothing Saint'. ||1||

[Ang 274 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬੈਸਨੋ ਸੋ ਜਿਸੁ ਊਪਰਿ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ॥
Transliteration: baisano so jis aoopar suprasan |
English: The true Vaishnaav, the devotee of Vishnu, is the one with whom God is thoroughly pleased.

Gurbani: ਬਿਸਨ ਕੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਭਿੰਨ ॥
Transliteration: bisan kee maaeaa te hoe bhin |
English: He dwells apart from Maya.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮ ਕਰਤ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਿਹਕਰਮ ॥
Transliteration: karam karat hovai nihakaram |
English: Performing good deeds, he does not seek rewards.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਬੈਸਨੋ ਕਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਧਰਮ ॥
Transliteration: tis baisano kaa niramal dharam |
English: Spotlessly pure is the religion of such a Vaishnaav;

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੂ ਫਲ ਕੀ ਇਛਾ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਛੈ ॥
Transliteration: kaahoo fal kee ichhaa nahee baachhai |
English: he has no desire for the fruits of his labors.

Gurbani: ਕੇਵਲ ਭਗਤਿ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਚੈ ॥
Transliteration: keval bhagat keeratan sang raachai |
English: He is absorbed in devotional worship and the singing of Kirtan, the songs of the Lord's Glory.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: man tan antar simaran gopaal |
English: Within his mind and body, he meditates in remembrance on the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਹੋਵਤ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: sabh aoopar hovat kirapaal |
English: He is kind to all creatures.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੈ ਅਵਰਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: aap drirrai avarah naam japaavai |
English: He holds fast to the Naam, and inspires others to chant it.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਓਹੁ ਬੈਸਨੋ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak ohu baisano param gat paavai |2|
English: O Nanak, such a Vaishnaav obtains the supreme status. ||2||

[Ang 274 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਭਗਉਤੀ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਾ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: bhgautee bhagavant bhagat kaa rang |
English: The true Bhagaautee, the devotee of Adi Shakti, loves the devotional worship of God.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗੈ ਦੁਸਟ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: sagal tiaagai dusatt kaa sang |
English: He forsakes the company of all wicked people.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਤੇ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਸਗਲਾ ਭਰਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: man te binasai sagalaa bharam |
English: All doubts are removed from his mind.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਪੂਜੈ ਸਗਲ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: kar poojai sagal paarabraham |
English: He performs devotional service to the Supreme Lord God in all.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਪਾ ਮਲੁ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang paapaa mal khovai |
English: In the Company of the Holy, the filth of sin is washed away.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਭਗਉਤੀ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: tis bhgautee kee mat aootam hovai |
English: The wisdom of such a Bhagaautee becomes supreme.

Gurbani: ਭਗਵੰਤ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਕਰੈ ਨਿਤ ਨੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: bhagavant kee ttehal karai nit neet |
English: He constantly performs the service of the Supreme Lord God.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪੈ ਬਿਸਨ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: man tan arapai bisan pareet |
English: He dedicates his mind and body to the Love of God.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਸਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: har ke charan hiradai basaavai |
English: The Lotus Feet of the Lord abide in his heart.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਐਸਾ ਭਗਉਤੀ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਕਉ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak aisaa bhgautee bhagavant kau paavai |3|
English: O Nanak, such a Bhagaautee attains the Lord God. ||3||

[Ang 274 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਜੋ ਮਨੁ ਪਰਬੋਧੈ ॥
Transliteration: so panddit jo man parabodhai |
English: He is a true Pandit, a religious scholar, who instructs his own mind.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਤਮ ਮਹਿ ਸੋਧੈ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam aatam meh sodhai |
English: He searches for the Lord's Name within his own soul.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਾਰੁ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam saar ras peevai |
English: He drinks in the Exquisite Nectar of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਉਸੁ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਕੈ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਜਗੁ ਜੀਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: aus panddit kai upades jag jeevai |
English: By that Pandit's teachings, the world lives.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਸਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: har kee kathaa hiradai basaavai |
English: He implants the Sermon of the Lord in his heart.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: so panddit fir jon na aavai |
English: Such a Pandit is not cast into the womb of reincarnation again.

Gurbani: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਮੂਲ ॥
Transliteration: bed puraan simrit boojhai mool |
English: He understands the fundamental essence of the Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees.

Gurbani: ਸੂਖਮ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਅਸਥੂਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: sookham meh jaanai asathool |
English: In the unmanifest, he sees the manifest world to exist.

Gurbani: ਚਹੁ ਵਰਨਾ ਕਉ ਦੇ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: chahu varanaa kau de upades |
English: He gives instruction to people of all castes and social classes.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਸੁ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਅਦੇਸੁ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak us panddit kau sadaa ades |4|
English: O Nanak, to such a Pandit, I bow in salutation forever. ||4||

[Ang 274 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬੀਜ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਰਬ ਕੋ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: beej mantru sarab ko giaan |
English: The Beej Mantra, the Seed Mantra, is spiritual wisdom for everyone.

Gurbani: ਚਹੁ ਵਰਨਾ ਮਹਿ ਜਪੈ ਕੋਊ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: chahu varanaa meh japai koaoo naam |
English: Anyone, from any class, may chant the Naam.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਜਪੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jo jo japai tis kee gat hoe |
English: Whoever chants it, is emancipated.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang paavai jan koe |
English: And yet, rare are those who attain it, in the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa antar ur dhaarai |
English: By His Grace, He enshrines it within.

Gurbani: ਪਸੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਮੁਘਦ ਪਾਥਰ ਕਉ ਤਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: pas pret mughad paathar kau taarai |
English: Even beasts, ghosts and the stone-hearted are saved.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਰੋਗ ਕਾ ਅਉਖਦੁ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: sarab rog kaa aaukhad naam |
English: The Naam is the panacea, the remedy to cure all ills.

Gurbani: ਕਲਿਆਣ ਰੂਪ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: kaliaan roop mangal gun gaam |
English: Singing the Glory of God is the embodiment of bliss and emancipation.

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੂ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਧਰਮਿ ॥
Transliteration: kaahoo jugat kitai na paaeeai dharam |
English: It cannot be obtained by any religious rituals.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਮਿ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak tis milai jis likhiaa dhur karam |5|
English: O Nanak, he alone obtains it, whose karma is so pre-ordained. ||5||

[Ang 274 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਾ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: jis kai man paarabraham kaa nivaas |
English: One whose mind is a home for the Supreme Lord God

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਤਿ ਰਾਮਦਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: tis kaa naam sat raamadaas |
English: - his name is truly Ram Das, the Lord's servant.

Gurbani: ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aatam raam tis nadaree aaeaa |
English: He comes to have the Vision of the Lord, the Supreme Soul.

Gurbani: ਦਾਸ ਦਸੰਤਣ ਭਾਇ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: daas dasantan bhaae tin paaeaa |
English: Deeming himself to be the slave of the Lord's slaves, he obtains it.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa nikatt nikatt har jaan |
English: He knows the Lord to be Ever-present, close at hand.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਦਾਸੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: so daas daragah paravaan |
English: Such a servant is honored in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਆਪਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: apune daas kau aap kirapaa karai |
English: To His servant, He Himself shows His Mercy.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਸਭ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: tis daas kau sabh sojhee parai |
English: Such a servant understands everything.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਆਤਮ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: sagal sang aatam udaas |
English: Amidst all, his soul is unattached.

Gurbani: ਐਸੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮਦਾਸੁ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: aisee jugat naanak raamadaas |6|
English: Such is the way, O Nanak, of the Lord's servant. ||6||

[Ang 275 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਆਤਮ ਹਿਤਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kee aagiaa aatam hitaavai |
English: One who, in his soul, loves the Will of God,

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਸੋਊ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jeevan mukat soaoo kahaavai |
English: is said to be Jivan Mukta - liberated while yet alive.

Gurbani: ਤੈਸਾ ਹਰਖੁ ਤੈਸਾ ਉਸੁ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: taisaa harakh taisaa us sog |
English: As is joy, so is sorrow to him.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਤਹ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਓਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa anand teh nahee biog |
English: He is in eternal bliss, and is not separated from God.

Gurbani: ਤੈਸਾ ਸੁਵਰਨੁ ਤੈਸੀ ਉਸੁ ਮਾਟੀ ॥
Transliteration: taisaa suvaran taisee us maattee |
English: As is gold, so is dust to him.

Gurbani: ਤੈਸਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤੈਸੀ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਟੀ ॥
Transliteration: taisaa amrit taisee bikh khaattee |
English: As is ambrosial nectar, so is bitter poison to him.

Gurbani: ਤੈਸਾ ਮਾਨੁ ਤੈਸਾ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: taisaa maan taisaa abhimaan |
English: As is honor, so is dishonor.

Gurbani: ਤੈਸਾ ਰੰਕੁ ਤੈਸਾ ਰਾਜਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: taisaa rank taisaa raajaan |
English: As is the beggar, so is the king.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਵਰਤਾਏ ਸਾਈ ਜੁਗਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: jo varataae saaee jugat |
English: Whatever God ordains, that is his way.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਓਹੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: naanak ohu purakh kaheeai jeevan mukat |7|
English: O Nanak, that being is known as Jivan Mukta. ||7||

[Ang 275 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਠਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham ke sagale tthaau |
English: All places belong to the Supreme Lord God.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਤੈਸਾ ਤਿਨ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jit jit ghar raakhai taisaa tin naau |
English: According to the homes in which they are placed, so are His creatures named.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape karan karaavan jog |
English: He Himself is the Doer, the Cause of causes.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਫੁਨਿ ਹੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: prabh bhaavai soee fun hog |
English: Whatever pleases God, ultimately comes to pass.

Gurbani: ਪਸਰਿਓ ਆਪਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਨਤ ਤਰੰਗ ॥
Transliteration: pasario aap hoe anat tarang |
English: He Himself is All-pervading, in endless waves.

Gurbani: ਲਖੇ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੇ ਰੰਗ ॥
Transliteration: lakhe na jaeh paarabraham ke rang |
English: The playful sport of the Supreme Lord God cannot be known.

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੀ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਇ ਤੈਸਾ ਪਰਗਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: jaisee mat dee taisaa paragaas |
English: As the understanding is given, so is one enlightened.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਅਬਿਨਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham karataa abinaas |
English: The Supreme Lord God, the Creator, is eternal and everlasting.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa sadaa deaal |
English: Forever, forever and ever, He is merciful.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੮॥੯॥
Transliteration: simar simar naanak bhe nihaal |8|9|
English: Remembering Him, remembering Him in meditation, O Nanak, one is blessed with ecstasy. ||8||9||

[Ang 275 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਨੇਕ ਜਨ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: ausatat kareh anek jan ant na paaraavaar |
English: Many people praise the Lord. He has no end or limitation.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਚਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਚੀ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak rachanaa prabh rachee bahu bidh anik prakaar |1|
English: O Nanak, God created the creation, with its many ways and various species. ||1||

[Ang 275 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
Transliteration: asattapadee |
English: Ashtapadee:

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਹੋਏ ਪੂਜਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott hoe poojaaree |
English: Many millions are His devotees.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਆਚਾਰ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott aachaar biauhaaree |
English: Many millions perform religious rituals and worldly duties.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਭਏ ਤੀਰਥ ਵਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott bhe teerath vaasee |
English: Many millions become dwellers at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਬਨ ਭ੍ਰਮਹਿ ਉਦਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott ban bhrameh udaasee |
English: Many millions wander as renunciates in the wilderness.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਬੇਦ ਕੇ ਸ੍ਰੋਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott bed ke srote |
English: Many millions listen to the Vedas.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਤਪੀਸੁਰ ਹੋਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott tapeesur hote |
English: Many millions become austere penitents.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਆਤਮ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਾਰਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott aatam dhiaan dhaareh |
English: Many millions enshrine meditation within their souls.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਕਬਿ ਕਾਬਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott kab kaab beechaareh |
English: Many millions of poets contemplate Him through poetry.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਨਵਤਨ ਨਾਮ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott navatan naam dhiaaveh |
English: Many millions meditate on His eternally new Naam.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak karate kaa ant na paaveh |1|
English: O Nanak, none can find the limits of the Creator. ||1||

[Ang 275 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਭਏ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott bhe abhimaanee |
English: Many millions become self-centered.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਅੰਧ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott andh agiaanee |
English: Many millions are blinded by ignorance.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਕਿਰਪਨ ਕਠੋਰ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott kirapan katthor |
English: Many millions are stone-hearted misers.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਭਿਗ ਆਤਮ ਨਿਕੋਰ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott abhig aatam nikor |
English: Many millions are heartless, with dry, withered souls.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰ ਦਰਬ ਕਉ ਹਿਰਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott par darab kau hireh |
English: Many millions steal the wealth of others.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰ ਦੂਖਨਾ ਕਰਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott par dookhanaa kareh |
English: Many millions slander others.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਸ੍ਰਮ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott maaeaa sram maeh |
English: Many millions struggle in Maya.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰਦੇਸ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott parades bhramaeh |
English: Many millions wander in foreign lands.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jit jit laavahu tith tit laganaa |
English: Whatever God attaches them to - with that they are engaged.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀ ਜਾਨੈ ਕਰਤਾ ਰਚਨਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak karate kee jaanai karataa rachanaa |2|
English: O Nanak, the Creator alone knows the workings of His creation. ||2||

[Ang 275 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਸਿਧ ਜਤੀ ਜੋਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott sidh jatee jogee |
English: Many millions are Siddhas, celibates and Yogis.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਰਸ ਭੋਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott raaje ras bhogee |
English: Many millions are kings, enjoying worldly pleasures.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਪੰਖੀ ਸਰਪ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott pankhee sarap upaae |
English: Many millions of birds and snakes have been created.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਾਥਰ ਬਿਰਖ ਨਿਪਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott paathar birakh nipajaae |
English: Many millions of stones and trees have been produced.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਵਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott pavan paanee baisantar |
English: Many millions are the winds, waters and fires.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਦੇਸ ਭੂ ਮੰਡਲ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott des bhoo manddal |
English: Many millions are the countries and realms of the world.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਸਸੀਅਰ ਸੂਰ ਨਖੵਤ੍ਰ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott saseear soor nakhayatr |
English: Many millions are the moons, suns and stars.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਦੇਵ ਦਾਨਵ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਤ੍ਰ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott dev daanav indr sir chhatr |
English: Many millions are the demi-gods, demons and Indras, under their regal canopies.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਅਪਨੈ ਸੂਤਿ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: sagal samagree apanai soot dhaarai |
English: He has strung the entire creation upon His thread.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak jis jis bhaavai tis tis nisataarai |3|
English: O Nanak, He emancipates those with whom He is pleased. ||3||

[Ang 276 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਰਾਜਸ ਤਾਮਸ ਸਾਤਕ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott raajas taamas saatak |
English: Many millions abide in heated activity, slothful darkness and peaceful light.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਅਰੁ ਸਾਸਤ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott bed puraan simrit ar saasat |
English: Many millions are the Vedas, Puraanas, Simritees and Shaastras.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਕੀਏ ਰਤਨ ਸਮੁਦ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott kee ratan samud |
English: Many millions are the pearls of the oceans.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਨਾਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਜੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott naanaa prakaar jant |
English: Many millions are the beings of so many descriptions.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਕੀਏ ਚਿਰ ਜੀਵੇ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott kee chir jeeve |
English: Many millions are made long-lived.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਗਿਰੀ ਮੇਰ ਸੁਵਰਨ ਥੀਵੇ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott giree mer suvaran theeve |
English: Many millions of hills and mountains have been made of gold.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਜਖੵ ਕਿੰਨਰ ਪਿਸਾਚ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott jakhay kinar pisaach |
English: Many millions are the Yakhshas - the servants of the god of wealth, the Kinnars - the gods of celestial music, and the evil spirits of the Pisaach.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਭੂਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਸੂਕਰ ਮ੍ਰਿਗਾਚ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott bhoot pret sookar mrigaach |
English: Many millions are the evil nature-spirits, ghosts, pigs and tigers.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਨੇਰੈ ਸਭਹੂ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: sabh te nerai sabhahoo te door |
English: He is near to all, and yet far from all;

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak aap alipat rahiaa bharapoor |4|
English: O Nanak, He Himself remains distinct, while yet pervading all. ||4||

[Ang 276 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਾਤਾਲ ਕੇ ਵਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott paataal ke vaasee |
English: Many millions inhabit the nether regions.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਨਰਕ ਸੁਰਗ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott narak surag nivaasee |
English: Many millions dwell in heaven and hell.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਮਰਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott janameh jeeveh mareh |
English: Many millions are born, live and die.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਫਿਰਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott bahu jonee fireh |
English: Many millions are reincarnated, over and over again.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਬੈਠਤ ਹੀ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott baitthat hee khaeh |
English: Many millions eat while sitting at ease.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਘਾਲਹਿ ਥਕਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott ghaaleh thak paeh |
English: Many millions are exhausted by their labors.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਕੀਏ ਧਨਵੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott kee dhanavant |
English: Many millions are created wealthy.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਿ ਚਿੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott maaeaa meh chint |
English: Many millions are anxiously involved in Maya.

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
Transliteration: jeh jeh bhaanaa teh teh raakhe |
English: Wherever He wills, there He keeps us.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਹਾਥੇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak sabh kichh prabh kai haathe |5|
English: O Nanak, everything is in the Hands of God. ||5||

[Ang 276 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਭਏ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott bhe bairaagee |
English: Many millions become Bairaagees, who renounce the world.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam sang tin liv laagee |
English: They have attached themselves to the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਖੋਜੰਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott prabh kau khojante |
English: Many millions are searching for God.

Gurbani: ਆਤਮ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਲਹੰਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: aatam meh paarabraham lahante |
English: Within their souls, they find the Supreme Lord God.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott darasan prabh piaas |
English: Many millions thirst for the Blessing of God's Darshan.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: tin kau milio prabh abinaas |
English: They meet with God, the Eternal.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਸਤਸੰਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott maageh satasang |
English: Many millions pray for the Society of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਤਿਨ ਲਾਗਾ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham tin laagaa rang |
English: They are imbued with the Love of the Supreme Lord God.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਹੋਏ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ॥
Transliteration: jin kau hoe aap suprasan |
English: Those with whom He Himself is pleased,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਸਦਾ ਧਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: naanak te jan sadaa dhan dhan |6|
English: O Nanak, are blessed, forever blessed. ||6||

[Ang 276 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਖਾਣੀ ਅਰੁ ਖੰਡ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott khaanee ar khandd |
English: Many millions are the fields of creation and the galaxies.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਕਾਸ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott akaas brahamandd |
English: Many millions are the etheric skies and the solar systems.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਹੋਏ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott hoe avataar |
English: Many millions are the divine incarnations.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਕੀਨੋ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: kee jugat keeno bisathaar |
English: In so many ways, He has unfolded Himself.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਬਾਰ ਪਸਰਿਓ ਪਾਸਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: kee baar pasario paasaar |
English: So many times, He has expanded His expansion.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਇਕੁ ਏਕੰਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa ik ekankaar |
English: Forever and ever, He is the One, the One Universal Creator.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਕੀਨੇ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott keene bahu bhaat |
English: Many millions are created in various forms.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ਹੋਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: prabh te hoe prabh maeh samaat |
English: From God they emanate, and into God they merge once again.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: taa kaa ant na jaanai koe |
English: His limits are not known to anyone.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: aape aap naanak prabh soe |7|
English: Of Himself, and by Himself, O Nanak, God exists. ||7||

[Ang 276 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott paarabraham ke daas |
English: Many millions are the servants of the Supreme Lord God.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਹੋਵਤ ਆਤਮ ਪਰਗਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: tin hovat aatam paragaas |
English: Their souls are enlightened.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਤਤ ਕੇ ਬੇਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott tat ke bete |
English: Many millions know the essence of reality.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਾਰਹਿ ਏਕੋ ਨੇਤ੍ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa nihaareh eko netre |
English: Their eyes gaze forever on the One alone.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott naam ras peeveh |
English: Many millions drink in the essence of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਅਮਰ ਭਏ ਸਦ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਜੀਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: amar bhe sad sad hee jeeveh |
English: They become immortal; they live forever and ever.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: kee kott naam gun gaaveh |
English: Many millions sing the Glorious Praises of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਆਤਮ ਰਸਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: aatam ras sukh sehaj samaaveh |
English: They are absorbed in intuitive peace and pleasure.

Gurbani: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਮਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: apune jan kau saas saas samaare |
English: He remembers His servants with each and every breath.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਓਇ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਕੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੮॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: naanak oe paramesur ke piaare |8|10|
English: O Nanak, they are the beloveds of the Transcendent Lord God. ||8||10||

[Ang 276 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਸਰ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: karan kaaran prabh ek hai doosar naahee koe |
English: God alone is the Doer of deeds - there is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak tis balihaaranai jal thal maheeal soe |1|
English: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the One, who pervades the waters, the lands, the sky and all space. ||1||

[Ang 276 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
Transliteration: asattapadee |
English: Ashtapadee:

Gurbani: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਕਰਨੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: karan karaavan karanai jog |
English: The Doer, the Cause of causes, is potent to do anything.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਹੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: jo tis bhaavai soee hog |
English: That which pleases Him, comes to pass.

Gurbani: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: khin meh thaap uthaapanahaaraa |
English: In an instant, He creates and destroys.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: ant nahee kichh paaraavaaraa |
English: He has no end or limitation.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਧਾਰਿ ਅਧਰ ਰਹਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: hukame dhaar adhar rahaavai |
English: By His Order, He established the earth, and He maintains it unsupported.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਉਪਜੈ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: hukame upajai hukam samaavai |
English: By His Order, the world was created; by His Order, it shall merge again into Him.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: hukame aooch neech biauhaar |
English: By His Order, one's occupation is high or low.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਅਨਿਕ ਰੰਗ ਪਰਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: hukame anik rang parakaar |
English: By His Order, there are so many colors and forms.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਅਪਨੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: kar kar dekhai apanee vaddiaaee |
English: Having created the Creation, He beholds His own greatness.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak sabh meh rahiaa samaaee |1|
English: O Nanak, He is pervading in all. ||1||

[Ang 277 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: prabh bhaavai maanukh gat paavai |
English: If it pleases God, one attains salvation.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਪਾਥਰ ਤਰਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: prabh bhaavai taa paathar taraavai |
English: If it pleases God, then even stones can swim.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਸ ਤੇ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: prabh bhaavai bin saas te raakhai |
English: If it pleases God, the body is preserved, even without the breath of life.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਭਾਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: prabh bhaavai taa har gun bhaakhai |
English: If it pleases God, then one chants the Lord's Glorious Praises.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: prabh bhaavai taa patit udhaarai |
English: If it pleases God, then even sinners are saved.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੈ ਆਪਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: aap karai aapan beechaarai |
English: He Himself acts, and He Himself contemplates.

Gurbani: ਦੁਹਾ ਸਿਰਿਆ ਕਾ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: duhaa siriaa kaa aap suaamee |
English: He Himself is the Master of both worlds.

Gurbani: ਖੇਲੈ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: khelai bigasai antarajaamee |
English: He plays and He enjoys; He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jo bhaavai so kaar karaavai |
English: As He wills, He causes actions to be done.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੀ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak drisattee avar na aavai |2|
English: Nanak sees no other than Him. ||2||

[Ang 277 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਤੇ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਇ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: kahu maanukh te kiaa hoe aavai |
English: Tell me - what can a mere mortal do?

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jo tis bhaavai soee karaavai |
English: Whatever pleases God is what He causes us to do.

Gurbani: ਇਸ ਕੈ ਹਾਥਿ ਹੋਇ ਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਲੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: eis kai haath hoe taa sabh kichh lee |
English: If it were in our hands, we would grab up everything.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: jo tis bhaavai soee karee |
English: Whatever pleases God - that is what He does.

Gurbani: ਅਨਜਾਨਤ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਹਿ ਰਚੈ ॥
Transliteration: anajaanat bikhiaa meh rachai |
English: Through ignorance, people are engrossed in corruption.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਜਾਨਤ ਆਪਨ ਆਪ ਬਚੈ ॥
Transliteration: je jaanat aapan aap bachai |
English: If they knew better, they would save themselves.

Gurbani: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: bharame bhoolaa deh dis dhaavai |
English: Deluded by doubt, they wander around in the ten directions.

Gurbani: ਨਿਮਖ ਮਾਹਿ ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: nimakh maeh chaar kuntt fir aavai |
