English: In an instant, their minds go around the four corners of the world and come back again.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਦੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa jis apanee bhagat dee |
English: Those whom the Lord mercifully blesses with His devotional worship

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੇਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak te jan naam milee |3|
English: - O Nanak, they are absorbed into the Naam. ||3||

[Ang 277 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਨੀਚ ਕੀਟ ਕਉ ਰਾਜ ॥
Transliteration: khin meh neech keett kau raaj |
English: In an instant, the lowly worm is transformed into a king.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਰੀਬ ਨਿਵਾਜ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham gareeb nivaaj |
English: The Supreme Lord God is the Protector of the humble.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kaa drisatt kachhoo na aavai |
English: Even one who has never been seen at all,

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਤਤਕਾਲ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: tis tatakaal deh dis pragattaavai |
English: becomes instantly famous in the ten directions.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕਰੈ ਬਖਸੀਸ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kau apunee karai bakhasees |
English: And that one upon whom He bestows His blessings

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਲੇਖਾ ਨ ਗਨੈ ਜਗਦੀਸ ॥
Transliteration: taa kaa lekhaa na ganai jagadees |
English: the Lord of the world does not hold him to his account.

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: jeeo pindd sabh tis kee raas |
English: Soul and body are all His property.

Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt pooran braham pragaas |
English: Each and every heart is illuminated by the Perfect Lord God.

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੀ ਬਣਤ ਆਪਿ ਬਨਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: apanee banat aap banaaee |
English: He Himself fashioned His own handiwork.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵੈ ਦੇਖਿ ਬਡਾਈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak jeevai dekh baddaaee |4|
English: Nanak lives by beholding His greatness. ||4||

[Ang 277 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਇਸ ਕਾ ਬਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਇਸੁ ਹਾਥ ॥
Transliteration: eis kaa bal naahee is haath |
English: There is no power in the hands of mortal beings;

Gurbani: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਸਰਬ ਕੋ ਨਾਥ ॥
Transliteration: karan karaavan sarab ko naath |
English: the Doer, the Cause of causes is the Lord of all.

Gurbani: ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ਬਪੁਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: aagiaakaaree bapuraa jeeo |
English: The helpless beings are subject to His Command.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਫੁਨਿ ਥੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo tis bhaavai soee fun theeo |
English: That which pleases Him, ultimately comes to pass.

Gurbani: ਕਬਹੂ ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਮਹਿ ਬਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: kabahoo aooch neech meh basai |
English: Sometimes, they abide in exaltation; sometimes, they are depressed.

Gurbani: ਕਬਹੂ ਸੋਗ ਹਰਖ ਰੰਗਿ ਹਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: kabahoo sog harakh rang hasai |
English: Sometimes, they are sad, and sometimes they laugh with joy and delight.

Gurbani: ਕਬਹੂ ਨਿੰਦ ਚਿੰਦ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: kabahoo nind chind biauhaar |
English: Sometimes, they are occupied with slander and anxiety.

Gurbani: ਕਬਹੂ ਊਭ ਅਕਾਸ ਪਇਆਲ ॥
Transliteration: kabahoo aoobh akaas peaal |
English: Sometimes, they are high in the Akaashic Ethers, sometimes in the nether regions of the underworld.

Gurbani: ਕਬਹੂ ਬੇਤਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: kabahoo betaa braham beechaar |
English: Sometimes, they know the contemplation of God.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਹਾਰ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak aap milaavanahaar |5|
English: O Nanak, God Himself unites them with Himself. ||5||

[Ang 277 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਕਬਹੂ ਨਿਰਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: kabahoo nirat karai bahu bhaat |
English: Sometimes, they dance in various ways.

Gurbani: ਕਬਹੂ ਸੋਇ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: kabahoo soe rahai din raat |
English: Sometimes, they remain asleep day and night.

Gurbani: ਕਬਹੂ ਮਹਾ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: kabahoo mahaa krodh bikaraal |
English: Sometimes, they are awesome, in terrible rage.

Gurbani: ਕਬਹੂੰ ਸਰਬ ਕੀ ਹੋਤ ਰਵਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: kabahoon sarab kee hot ravaal |
English: Sometimes, they are the dust of the feet of all.

Gurbani: ਕਬਹੂ ਹੋਇ ਬਹੈ ਬਡ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: kabahoo hoe bahai badd raajaa |
English: Sometimes, they sit as great kings.

Gurbani: ਕਬਹੁ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ਨੀਚ ਕਾ ਸਾਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: kabahu bhekhaaree neech kaa saajaa |
English: Sometimes, they wear the coat of a lowly beggar.

Gurbani: ਕਬਹੂ ਅਪਕੀਰਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: kabahoo apakeerat meh aavai |
English: Sometimes, they come to have evil reputations.

Gurbani: ਕਬਹੂ ਭਲਾ ਭਲਾ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: kabahoo bhalaa bhalaa kahaavai |
English: Sometimes, they are known as very, very good.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਵ ਹੀ ਰਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: jiau prabh raakhai tiv hee rahai |
English: As God keeps them, so they remain.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad naanak sach kahai |6|
English: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, the Truth is told. ||6||

[Ang 277 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਕਬਹੂ ਹੋਇ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਕਰੇ ਬਖੵਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: kabahoo hoe panddit kare bakhayaan |
English: Sometimes, as scholars, they deliver lectures.

Gurbani: ਕਬਹੂ ਮੋਨਿਧਾਰੀ ਲਾਵੈ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: kabahoo monidhaaree laavai dhiaan |
English: Sometimes, they hold to silence in deep meditation.

Gurbani: ਕਬਹੂ ਤਟ ਤੀਰਥ ਇਸਨਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: kabahoo tatt teerath isanaan |
English: Sometimes, they take cleansing baths at places of pilgrimage.

Gurbani: ਕਬਹੂ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨ ॥
Transliteration: kabahoo sidh saadhik mukh giaan |
English: Sometimes, as Siddhas or seekers, they impart spiritual wisdom.

Gurbani: ਕਬਹੂ ਕੀਟ ਹਸਤਿ ਪਤੰਗ ਹੋਇ ਜੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: kabahoo keett hasat patang hoe jeea |
English: Sometimes, they becomes worms, elephants, or moths.

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਭਰਮੈ ਭਰਮੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: anik jon bharamai bharameea |
English: They may wander and roam through countless incarnations.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਾ ਰੂਪ ਜਿਉ ਸ੍ਵਾਗੀ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: naanaa roop jiau svaagee dikhaavai |
English: In various costumes, like actors, they appear.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਨਚਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jiau prabh bhaavai tivai nachaavai |
English: As it pleases God, they dance.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jo tis bhaavai soee hoe |
English: Whatever pleases Him, comes to pass.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: naanak doojaa avar na koe |7|
English: O Nanak, there is no other at all. ||7||

[Ang 278 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਕਬਹੂ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਇਹੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: kabahoo saadhasangat ihu paavai |
English: Sometimes, this being attains the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਉਸੁ ਅਸਥਾਨ ਤੇ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: aus asathaan te bahur na aavai |
English: From that place, he does not have to come back again.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਗਿਆਨ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: antar hoe giaan paragaas |
English: The light of spiritual wisdom dawns within.

Gurbani: ਉਸੁ ਅਸਥਾਨ ਕਾ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: aus asathaan kaa nahee binaas |
English: That place does not perish.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਇਕ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: man tan naam rate ik rang |
English: The mind and body are imbued with the Love of the Naam, the Name of the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਬਸਹਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa baseh paarabraham kai sang |
English: He dwells forever with the Supreme Lord God.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਜਲੁ ਆਇ ਖਟਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jiau jal meh jal aae khattaanaa |
English: As water comes to blend with water,

Gurbani: ਤਿਉ ਜੋਤੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: tiau jotee sang jot samaanaa |
English: his light blends into the Light.

Gurbani: ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਗਵਨ ਪਾਏ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: mitt ge gavan paae bisraam |
English: Reincarnation is ended, and eternal peace is found.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ॥੮॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: naanak prabh kai sad kurabaan |8|11|
English: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to God. ||8||11||

[Ang 278 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਸੁਖੀ ਬਸੈ ਮਸਕੀਨੀਆ ਆਪੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਤਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: sukhee basai masakeeneea aap nivaar tale |
English: The humble beings abide in peace; subduing egotism, they are meek.

Gurbani: ਬਡੇ ਬਡੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਗਰਬਿ ਗਲੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: badde badde ahankaareea naanak garab gale |1|
English: The very proud and arrogant persons, O Nanak, are consumed by their own pride. ||1||

[Ang 278 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
Transliteration: asattapadee |
English: Ashtapadee:

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਾਜ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: jis kai antar raaj abhimaan |
English: One who has the pride of power within,

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਨਰਕਪਾਤੀ ਹੋਵਤ ਸੁਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: so narakapaatee hovat suaan |
English: shall dwell in hell, and become a dog.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜਾਨੈ ਮੈ ਜੋਬਨਵੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: jo jaanai mai jobanavant |
English: One who deems himself to have the beauty of youth,

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਹੋਵਤ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕਾ ਜੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: so hovat bisattaa kaa jant |
English: shall become a maggot in manure.

Gurbani: ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਕਰਮਵੰਤੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: aapas kau karamavant kahaavai |
English: One who claims to act virtuously,

Gurbani: ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: janam marai bahu jon bhramaavai |
English: shall live and die, wandering through countless reincarnations.

Gurbani: ਧਨ ਭੂਮਿ ਕਾ ਜੋ ਕਰੈ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: dhan bhoom kaa jo karai gumaan |
English: One who takes pride in wealth and lands

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਅੰਧਾ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: so moorakh andhaa agiaan |
English: is a fool, blind and ignorant.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਬਸਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa jis kai hiradai gareebee basaavai |
English: One whose heart is mercifully blessed with abiding humility,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਈਹਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਆਗੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak eehaa mukat aagai sukh paavai |1|
English: O Nanak, is liberated here, and obtains peace hereafter. ||1||

[Ang 278 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਵੰਤਾ ਹੋਇ ਕਰਿ ਗਰਬਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: dhanavantaa hoe kar garabaavai |
English: One who becomes wealthy and takes pride in it

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਕਛੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: trin samaan kachh sang na jaavai |
English: not even a piece of straw shall go along with him.

Gurbani: ਬਹੁ ਲਸਕਰ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਆਸ ॥
Transliteration: bahu lasakar maanukh aoopar kare aas |
English: He may place his hopes on a large army of men,

Gurbani: ਪਲ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਨਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: pal bheetar taa kaa hoe binaas |
English: but he shall vanish in an instant.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਆਪ ਜਾਨੈ ਬਲਵੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: sabh te aap jaanai balavant |
English: One who deems himself to be the strongest of all,

Gurbani: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਇ ਭਸਮੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: khin meh hoe jaae bhasamant |
English: in an instant, shall be reduced to ashes.

Gurbani: ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਬਦੈ ਆਪਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kisai na badai aap ahankaaree |
English: One who thinks of no one else except his own prideful self

Gurbani: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਆਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: dharam raae tis kare khuaaree |
English: the Righteous Judge of Dharma shall expose his disgrace.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਿਟੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad jaa kaa mittai abhimaan |
English: One who, by Guru's Grace, eliminates his ego,

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: so jan naanak daragah paravaan |2|
English: O Nanak, becomes acceptable in the Court of the Lord. ||2||

[Ang 278 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਹਉ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kott karam karai hau dhaare |
English: If someone does millions of good deeds, while acting in ego,

Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਬਿਰਥਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sram paavai sagale birathaare |
English: he shall incur only trouble; all this is in vain.

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਤਪਸਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: anik tapasiaa kare ahankaar |
English: If someone performs great penance, while acting in selfishness and conceit,

Gurbani: ਨਰਕ ਸੁਰਗ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: narak surag fir fir avataar |
English: he shall be reincarnated into heaven and hell, over and over again.

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਆਤਮ ਨਹੀ ਦ੍ਰਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: anik jatan kar aatam nahee dravai |
English: He makes all sorts of efforts, but his soul is still not softened

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਕਹੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਗਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: har daragah kahu kaise gavai |
English: how can he go to the Court of the Lord?

Gurbani: ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਜੋ ਭਲਾ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: aapas kau jo bhalaa kahaavai |
English: One who calls himself good

Gurbani: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਭਲਾਈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: tiseh bhalaaee nikatt na aavai |
English: goodness shall not draw near him.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਕੀ ਰੇਨ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sarab kee ren jaa kaa man hoe |
English: One whose mind is the dust of all

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak taa kee niramal soe |3|
English: - says Nanak, his reputation is spotlessly pure. ||3||

[Ang 278 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਮੁਝ ਤੇ ਕਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jab lag jaanai mujh te kachh hoe |
English: As long as someone thinks that he is the one who acts,

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਇਸ ਕਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: tab is kau sukh naahee koe |
English: he shall have no peace.

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਇਹ ਜਾਨੈ ਮੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: jab ih jaanai mai kichh karataa |
English: As long as this mortal thinks that he is the one who does things,

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਫਿਰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: tab lag garabh jon meh firataa |
English: he shall wander in reincarnation through the womb.

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਧਾਰੈ ਕੋਊ ਬੈਰੀ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: jab dhaarai koaoo bairee meet |
English: As long as he considers one an enemy, and another a friend,

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਚੀਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: tab lag nihachal naahee cheet |
English: his mind shall not come to rest.

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jab lag moh magan sang maae |
English: As long as he is intoxicated with attachment to Maya,

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: tab lag dharam raae dee sajaae |
English: the Righteous Judge shall punish him.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੂਟੈ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kirapaa te bandhan toottai |
English: By God's Grace, his bonds are shattered;

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉ ਛੂਟੈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad naanak hau chhoottai |4|
English: by Guru's Grace, O Nanak, his ego is eliminated. ||4||

[Ang 278 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਹਸ ਖਟੇ ਲਖ ਕਉ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: sehas khatte lakh kau utth dhaavai |
English: Earning a thousand, he runs after a hundred thousand.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: tripat na aavai maaeaa paachhai paavai |
English: Satisfaction is not obtained by chasing after Maya.

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਭੋਗ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕੇ ਕਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: anik bhog bikhiaa ke karai |
English: He may enjoy all sorts of corrupt pleasures,

Gurbani: ਨਹ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵੈ ਖਪਿ ਖਪਿ ਮਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: neh tripataavai khap khap marai |
English: but he is still not satisfied; he indulges again and again, wearing himself out, until he dies.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਾ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਊ ਰਾਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: binaa santokh nahee koaoo raajai |
English: Without contentment, no one is satisfied.

Gurbani: ਸੁਪਨ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਬ੍ਰਿਥੇ ਸਭ ਕਾਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: supan manorath brithe sabh kaajai |
English: Like the objects in a dream, all his efforts are in vain.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: naam rang sarab sukh hoe |
English: Through the love of the Naam, all peace is obtained.

Gurbani: ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: baddabhaagee kisai paraapat hoe |
English: Only a few obtain this, by great good fortune.

Gurbani: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: karan karaavan aape aap |
English: He Himself is Himself the Cause of causes.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa naanak har jaap |5|
English: Forever and ever, O Nanak, chant the Lord's Name. ||5||

[Ang 279 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: karan karaavan karanaihaar |
English: The Doer, the Cause of causes, is the Creator Lord.

Gurbani: ਇਸ ਕੈ ਹਾਥਿ ਕਹਾ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: eis kai haath kahaa beechaar |
English: What deliberations are in the hands of mortal beings?

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਰੇ ਤੈਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jaisee drisatt kare taisaa hoe |
English: As God casts His Glance of Grace, they come to be.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aape aap aap prabh soe |
English: God Himself, of Himself, is unto Himself.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਸੁ ਅਪਨੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: jo kichh keeno su apanai rang |
English: Whatever He created, was by His Own Pleasure.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ ਸਭਹੂ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: sabh te door sabhahoo kai sang |
English: He is far from all, and yet with all.

Gurbani: ਬੂਝੈ ਦੇਖੈ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥
Transliteration: boojhai dekhai karai bibek |
English: He understands, He sees, and He passes judgment.

Gurbani: ਆਪਹਿ ਏਕ ਆਪਹਿ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
Transliteration: aapeh ek aapeh anek |
English: He Himself is the One, and He Himself is the many.

Gurbani: ਮਰੈ ਨ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: marai na binasai aavai na jaae |
English: He does not die or perish; He does not come or go.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: naanak sad hee rahiaa samaae |6|
English: O Nanak, He remains forever All-pervading. ||6||

[Ang 279 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੈ ਸਮਝੈ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: aap upadesai samajhai aap |
English: He Himself instructs, and He Himself learns.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਰਚਿਆ ਸਭ ਕੈ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
Transliteration: aape rachiaa sabh kai saath |
English: He Himself mingles with all.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਕੀਨੋ ਆਪਨ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: aap keeno aapan bisathaar |
English: He Himself created His own expanse.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਉਸ ਕਾ ਓਹੁ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kachh us kaa ohu karanaihaar |
English: All things are His; He is the Creator.

Gurbani: ਉਸ ਤੇ ਭਿੰਨ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aus te bhin kahahu kichh hoe |
English: Without Him, what could be done?

Gurbani: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਏਕੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: thaan thanantar ekai soe |
English: In the spaces and interspaces, He is the One.

Gurbani: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਚਲਿਤ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: apune chalit aap karanaihaar |
English: In His own play, He Himself is the Actor.

Gurbani: ਕਉਤਕ ਕਰੈ ਰੰਗ ਆਪਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: kautak karai rang aapaar |
English: He produces His plays with infinite variety.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: man meh aap man apune maeh |
English: He Himself is in the mind, and the mind is in Him.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: naanak keemat kehan na jaae |7|
English: O Nanak, His worth cannot be estimated. ||7||

[Ang 279 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: sat sat sat prabh suaamee |
English: True, True, True is God, our Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਖਿਆਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaad kinai vakhiaanee |
English: By Guru's Grace, some speak of Him.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: sach sach sach sabh keenaa |
English: True, True, True is the Creator of all.

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਕਿਨੈ ਬਿਰਲੈ ਚੀਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: kott madhe kinai biralai cheenaa |
English: Out of millions, scarcely anyone knows Him.

Gurbani: ਭਲਾ ਭਲਾ ਭਲਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਰੂਪ ॥
Transliteration: bhalaa bhalaa bhalaa teraa roop |
English: Beautiful, Beautiful, Beautiful is Your Sublime Form.

Gurbani: ਅਤਿ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਨੂਪ ॥
Transliteration: at sundar apaar anoop |
English: You are Exquisitely Beautiful, Infinite and Incomparable.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: niramal niramal niramal teree baanee |
English: Pure, Pure, Pure is the Word of Your Bani,

Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸੁਨੀ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਬਖੵਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt sunee sravan bakhayaanee |
English: heard in each and every heart, spoken to the ears.

Gurbani: ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਪੁਨੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: pavitr pavitr pavitr puneet |
English: Holy, Holy, Holy and Sublimely Pure

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥੮॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: naam japai naanak man preet |8|12|
English: - chant the Naam, O Nanak, with heart-felt love. ||8||12||

[Ang 279 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਸਰਨਿ ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਪਰੈ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਉਧਰਨਹਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: sant saran jo jan parai so jan udharanahaar |
English: One who seeks the Sanctuary of the Saints shall be saved.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sant kee nindaa naanakaa bahur bahur avataar |1|
English: One who slanders the Saints, O Nanak, shall be reincarnated over and over again. ||1||

[Ang 279 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
Transliteration: asattapadee |
English: Ashtapadee:

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਆਰਜਾ ਘਟੈ ॥
Transliteration: sant kai dookhan aarajaa ghattai |
English: Slandering the Saints, one's life is cut short.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਨਹੀ ਛੁਟੈ ॥
Transliteration: sant kai dookhan jam te nahee chhuttai |
English: Slandering the Saints, one shall not escape the Messenger of Death.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sant kai dookhan sukh sabh jaae |
English: Slandering the Saints, all happiness vanishes.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਨਰਕ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sant kai dookhan narak meh paae |
English: Slandering the Saints, one falls into hell.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਮਲੀਨ ॥
Transliteration: sant kai dookhan mat hoe maleen |
English: Slandering the Saints, the intellect is polluted.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਤੇ ਹੀਨ ॥
Transliteration: sant kai dookhan sobhaa te heen |
English: Slandering the Saints, one's reputation is lost.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਹਤੇ ਕਉ ਰਖੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sant ke hate kau rakhai na koe |
English: One who is cursed by a Saint cannot be saved.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਥਾਨ ਭ੍ਰਸਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sant kai dookhan thaan bhrasatt hoe |
English: Slandering the Saints, one's place is defiled.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਜੇ ਕਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: sant kripaal kripaa je karai |
English: But if the Compassionate Saint shows His Kindness,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਭੀ ਤਰੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak santasang nindak bhee tarai |1|
English: O Nanak, in the Company of the Saints, the slanderer may still be saved. ||1||

[Ang 279 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੂਖਨ ਤੇ ਮੁਖੁ ਭਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: sant ke dookhan te mukh bhavai |
English: Slandering the Saints, one becomes a wry-faced malcontent.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਕਾਗ ਜਿਉ ਲਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: santan kai dookhan kaag jiau lavai |
English: Slandering the Saints, one croaks like a raven.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਸਰਪ ਜੋਨਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: santan kai dookhan sarap jon paae |
English: Slandering the Saints, one is reincarnated as a snake.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਗਦ ਜੋਨਿ ਕਿਰਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sant kai dookhan trigad jon kiramaae |
English: Slandering the Saints, one is reincarnated as a wiggling worm.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਹਿ ਜਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: santan kai dookhan trisanaa meh jalai |
English: Slandering the Saints, one burns in the fire of desire.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਛਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: sant kai dookhan sabh ko chhalai |
English: Slandering the Saints, one tries to deceive everyone.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਤੇਜੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sant kai dookhan tej sabh jaae |
English: Slandering the Saints, all one's influence vanishes.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਨੀਚੁ ਨੀਚਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sant kai dookhan neech neechaae |
English: Slandering the Saints, one becomes the lowest of the low.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਾ ਥਾਉ ਕੋ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: sant dokhee kaa thaau ko naeh |
English: For the slanderer of the Saint, there is no place of rest.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਓਇ ਭੀ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak sant bhaavai taa oe bhee gat paeh |2|
English: O Nanak, if it pleases the Saint, even then, he may be saved. ||2||

[Ang 280 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਮਹਾ ਅਤਤਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sant kaa nindak mahaa atataaee |
English: The slanderer of the Saint is the worst evil-doer.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਟਿਕਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sant kaa nindak khin ttikan na paaee |
English: The slanderer of the Saint has not even a moment's rest.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਮਹਾ ਹਤਿਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sant kaa nindak mahaa hatiaaraa |
English: The slanderer of the Saint is a brutal butcher.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰਿ ਮਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sant kaa nindak paramesur maaraa |
English: The slanderer of the Saint is cursed by the Transcendent Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਰਾਜ ਤੇ ਹੀਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: sant kaa nindak raaj te heen |
English: The slanderer of the Saint has no kingdom.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਅਰੁ ਦੀਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: sant kaa nindak dukheea ar deen |
English: The slanderer of the Saint becomes miserable and poor.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਉ ਸਰਬ ਰੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: sant ke nindak kau sarab rog |
English: The slanderer of the Saint contracts all diseases.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਬਿਜੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: sant ke nindak kau sadaa bijog |
English: The slanderer of the Saint is forever separated.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਦੋਖ ਮਹਿ ਦੋਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: sant kee nindaa dokh meh dokh |
English: To slander a Saint is the worst sin of sins.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਉਸ ਕਾ ਭੀ ਹੋਇ ਮੋਖੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak sant bhaavai taa us kaa bhee hoe mokh |3|
English: O Nanak, if it pleases the Saint, then even this one may be liberated. ||3||

[Ang 280 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਸਦਾ ਅਪਵਿਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: sant kaa dokhee sadaa apavit |
English: The slanderer of the Saint is forever impure.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਨਹੀ ਮਿਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: sant kaa dokhee kisai kaa nahee mit |
English: The slanderer of the Saint is nobody's friend.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਉ ਡਾਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: sant ke dokhee kau ddaan laagai |
English: The slanderer of the Saint shall be punished.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਉ ਸਭ ਤਿਆਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: sant ke dokhee kau sabh tiaagai |
English: The slanderer of the Saint is abandoned by all.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਮਹਾ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: sant kaa dokhee mahaa ahankaaree |
English: The slanderer of the Saint is totally egocentric.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਸਦਾ ਬਿਕਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: sant kaa dokhee sadaa bikaaree |
English: The slanderer of the Saint is forever corrupt.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਜਨਮੈ ਮਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: sant kaa dokhee janamai marai |
English: The slanderer of the Saint must endure birth and death.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਦੂਖਨਾ ਸੁਖ ਤੇ ਟਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: sant kee dookhanaa sukh te ttarai |
English: The slanderer of the Saint is devoid of peace.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਠਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sant ke dokhee kau naahee tthaau |
English: The slanderer of the Saint has no place of rest.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak sant bhaavai taa le milaae |4|
English: O Nanak, if it pleases the Saint, then even such a one may merge in union. ||4||

[Ang 280 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਅਧ ਬੀਚ ਤੇ ਟੂਟੈ ॥
Transliteration: sant kaa dokhee adh beech te ttoottai |
English: The slanderer of the Saint breaks down mid-way.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਿਤੈ ਕਾਜਿ ਨ ਪਹੂਚੈ ॥
Transliteration: sant kaa dokhee kitai kaaj na pahoochai |
English: The slanderer of the Saint cannot accomplish his tasks.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਉ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: sant ke dokhee kau udiaan bhramaaeeai |
English: The slanderer of the Saint wanders in the wilderness.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਉਝੜਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: sant kaa dokhee ujharr paaeeai |
English: The slanderer of the Saint is misled into desolation.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਅੰਤਰ ਤੇ ਥੋਥਾ ॥
Transliteration: sant kaa dokhee antar te thothaa |
English: The slanderer of the Saint is empty inside,

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਸਾਸ ਬਿਨਾ ਮਿਰਤਕ ਕੀ ਲੋਥਾ ॥
Transliteration: jiau saas binaa miratak kee lothaa |
English: like the corpse of a dead man, without the breath of life.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕੀ ਜੜ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: sant ke dokhee kee jarr kichh naeh |
English: The slanderer of the Saint has no heritage at all.

Gurbani: ਆਪਨ ਬੀਜਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: aapan beej aape hee khaeh |
English: He himself must eat what he has planted.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਉ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sant ke dokhee kau avar na raakhanahaar |
English: The slanderer of the Saint cannot be saved by anyone else.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਲਏ ਉਬਾਰਿ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak sant bhaavai taa le ubaar |5|
English: O Nanak, if it pleases the Saint, then even he may be saved. ||5||

[Ang 280 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਇਉ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sant kaa dokhee iau bilalaae |
English: The slanderer of the Saint bewails like this

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਤੜਫੜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jiau jal bihoon machhulee tarrafarraae |
English: like a fish, out of water, writhing in agony.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਭੂਖਾ ਨਹੀ ਰਾਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: sant kaa dokhee bhookhaa nahee raajai |
English: The slanderer of the Saint is hungry and is never satisfied,

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਈਧਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: jiau paavak eedhan nahee dhraapai |
English: as fire is not satisfied by fuel.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਛੁਟੈ ਇਕੇਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: sant kaa dokhee chhuttai ikelaa |
English: The slanderer of the Saint is left all alone,

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਬੂਆੜੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਖੇਤ ਮਾਹਿ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: jiau booaarr til khet maeh duhelaa |
English: like the miserable barren sesame stalk abandoned in the field.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਧਰਮ ਤੇ ਰਹਤ ॥
Transliteration: sant kaa dokhee dharam te rehat |
English: The slanderer of the Saint is devoid of faith.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਸਦ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਕਹਤ ॥
Transliteration: sant kaa dokhee sad mithiaa kehat |
English: The slanderer of the Saint constantly lies.

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਾ ਧੁਰਿ ਹੀ ਪਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kirat nindak kaa dhur hee peaa |
English: The fate of the slanderer is pre-ordained from the very beginning of time.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਥਿਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: naanak jo tis bhaavai soee thiaa |6|
English: O Nanak, whatever pleases God's Will comes to pass. ||6||

[Ang 280 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਬਿਗੜ ਰੂਪੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sant kaa dokhee bigarr roop hoe jaae |
English: The slanderer of the Saint becomes deformed.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਉ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sant ke dokhee kau daragah milai sajaae |
English: The slanderer of the Saint receives his punishment in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਕਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: sant kaa dokhee sadaa sahakaaeeai |
English: The slanderer of the Saint is eternally in limbo.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਨ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜੀਵਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: sant kaa dokhee na marai na jeevaaeeai |
English: He does not die, but he does not live either.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕੀ ਪੁਜੈ ਨ ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: sant ke dokhee kee pujai na aasaa |
English: The hopes of the slanderer of the Saint are not fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਉਠਿ ਚਲੈ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: sant kaa dokhee utth chalai niraasaa |
English: The slanderer of the Saint departs disappointed.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੋਖਿ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sant kai dokh na trisattai koe |
English: Slandering the Saint, no one attains satisfaction.

Gurbani: ਜੈਸਾ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈਸਾ ਕੋਈ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jaisaa bhaavai taisaa koee hoe |
English: As it pleases the Lord, so do people become;

Gurbani: ਪਇਆ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: peaa kirat na mettai koe |
English: no one can erase their past actions.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਨੈ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: naanak jaanai sachaa soe |7|
English: O Nanak, the True Lord alone knows all. ||7||

[Ang 280 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਭ ਘਟ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਓਹੁ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sabh ghatt tis ke ohu karanaihaar |
English: All hearts are His; He is the Creator.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa tis kau namasakaar |
English: Forever and ever, I bow to Him in reverence.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kee usatat karahu din raat |
English: Praise God, day and night.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: tiseh dhiaavahu saas giraas |
English: Meditate on Him with every breath and morsel of food.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kachh varatai tis kaa keea |
English: Everything happens as He wills.

Gurbani: ਜੈਸਾ ਕਰੇ ਤੈਸਾ ਕੋ ਥੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: jaisaa kare taisaa ko theea |
English: As He wills, so people become.

Gurbani: ਅਪਨਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: apanaa khel aap karanaihaar |
English: He Himself is the play, and He Himself is the actor.

Gurbani: ਦੂਸਰ ਕਉਨੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: doosar kaun kahai beechaar |
English: Who else can speak or deliberate upon this?

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਪਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: jis no kripaa karai tis aapan naam dee |
English: He Himself gives His Name to those, upon whom He bestows His Mercy.

Gurbani: ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਸੇਇ ॥੮॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: baddabhaagee naanak jan see |8|13|
English: Very fortunate, O Nanak, are those people. ||8||13||

[Ang 281 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਤਜਹੁ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਸੁਰਿ ਜਨਹੁ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: tajahu siaanap sur janahu simarahu har har raae |
English: Give up your cleverness, good people - remember the Lord God, your King!

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਆਸ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਰਖਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੂਖੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ek aas har man rakhahu naanak dookh bharam bhau jaae |1|
English: Enshrine in your heart, your hopes in the One Lord. O Nanak, your pain, doubt and fear shall depart. ||1||

[Ang 281 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
Transliteration: asattapadee |
English: Ashtapadee:

Gurbani: ਮਾਨੁਖ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਬ੍ਰਿਥੀ ਸਭ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: maanukh kee ttek brithee sabh jaan |
English: Reliance on mortals is in vain - know this well.

Gurbani: ਦੇਵਨ ਕਉ ਏਕੈ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: devan kau ekai bhagavaan |
English: The Great Giver is the One Lord God.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਦੀਐ ਰਹੈ ਅਘਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jis kai deeai rahai aghaae |
English: By His gifts, we are satisfied,

Gurbani: ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: bahur na trisanaa laagai aae |
English: and we suffer from thirst no longer.

Gurbani: ਮਾਰੈ ਰਾਖੈ ਏਕੋ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: maarai raakhai eko aap |
English: The One Lord Himself destroys and also preserves.

Gurbani: ਮਾਨੁਖ ਕੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
Transliteration: maanukh kai kichh naahee haath |
English: Nothing at all is in the hands of mortal beings.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੂਝਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: tis kaa hukam boojh sukh hoe |
English: Understanding His Order, there is peace.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖੁ ਕੰਠਿ ਪਰੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: tis kaa naam rakh kantth paroe |
English: So take His Name, and wear it as your necklace.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: simar simar simar prabh soe |
English: Remember, remember, remember God in meditation.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak bighan na laagai koe |1|
English: O Nanak, no obstacle shall stand in your way. ||1||

[Ang 281 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: ausatat man meh kar nirankaar |
English: Praise the Formless Lord in your mind.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: kar man mere sat biauhaar |
English: O my mind, make this your true occupation.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰਸਨਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: niramal rasanaa amrit peeo |
English: Let your tongue become pure, drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਲੇਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa suhelaa kar lehi jeeo |
English: Your soul shall be forever peaceful.

Gurbani: ਨੈਨਹੁ ਪੇਖੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਾ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: nainahu pekh tthaakur kaa rang |
English: With your eyes, see the wondrous play of your Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਸਭ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang binasai sabh sang |
English: In the Company of the Holy, all other associations vanish.

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਚਲਉ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: charan chlau maarag gobind |
English: With your feet, walk in the Way of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਿਟਹਿ ਪਾਪ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਬਿੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: mitteh paap japeeai har bind |
English: Sins are washed away, chanting the Lord's Name, even for a moment.

Gurbani: ਕਰ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਮ ਸ੍ਰਵਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ॥
Transliteration: kar har karam sravan har kathaa |
English: So do the Lord's Work, and listen to the Lord's Sermon.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਊਜਲ ਮਥਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har daragah naanak aoojal mathaa |2|
English: In the Lord's Court, O Nanak, your face shall be radiant. ||2||

[Ang 281 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਜਗ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: baddabhaagee te jan jag maeh |
English: Very fortunate are those humble beings in this world,

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa har ke gun gaeh |
English: who sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, forever and ever.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਜੋ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam jo kareh beechaar |
English: Those who dwell upon the Lord's Name,

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਧਨਵੰਤ ਗਨੀ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: se dhanavant ganee sansaar |
English: are the most wealthy and prosperous in the world.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਖੀ ॥
Transliteration: man tan mukh boleh har mukhee |
English: Those who speak of the Supreme Lord in thought, word and deed

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੀ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa jaanahu te sukhee |
English: know that they are peaceful and happy, forever and ever.

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: eko ek ek pachhaanai |
English: One who recognizes the One and only Lord as One,

Gurbani: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਕੀ ਓਹੁ ਸੋਝੀ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: eit ut kee ohu sojhee jaanai |
English: understands this world and the next.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: naam sang jis kaa man maaniaa |
English: One whose mind accepts the Company of the Naam,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak tineh niranjan jaaniaa |3|
English: the Name of the Lord, O Nanak, knows the Immaculate Lord. ||3||

[Ang 281 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਆਪਨ ਆਪੁ ਸੁਝੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad aapan aap sujhai |
English: By Guru's Grace, one understands himself;

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੁਝੈ ॥
Transliteration: tis kee jaanahu trisanaa bujhai |
English: know that then, his thirst is quenched.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਹਤ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang har har jas kehat |
English: In the Company of the Holy, one chants the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਰੋਗ ਤੇ ਓਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਰਹਤ ॥
Transliteration: sarab rog te ohu har jan rehat |
English: Such a devotee of the Lord is free of all disease.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕੇਵਲ ਬਖੵਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: anadin keeratan keval bakhayaan |
English: Night and day, sing the Kirtan, the Praises of the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਗ੍ਰਿਹਸਤ ਮਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਨਿਰਬਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: grihasat meh soee nirabaan |
English: In the midst of your household, remain balanced and unattached.

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਊਪਰਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: ek aoopar jis jan kee aasaa |
English: One who places his hopes in the One Lord

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕਟੀਐ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: tis kee katteeai jam kee faasaa |
English: the noose of Death is cut away from his neck.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਭੂਖ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham kee jis man bhookh |
English: One whose mind hungers for the Supreme Lord God,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਲਾਗਹਿ ਦੂਖ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak tiseh na laageh dookh |4|
English: O Nanak, shall not suffer pain. ||4||

[Ang 281 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jis kau har prabh man chit aavai |
English: One who focuses his conscious mind on the Lord God

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸੰਤੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਨਹੀ ਡੁਲਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: so sant suhelaa nahee ddulaavai |
English: - that Saint is at peace; he does not waver.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: jis prabh apunaa kirapaa karai |
English: Those unto whom God has granted His Grace

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਸ ਤੇ ਡਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: so sevak kahu kis te ddarai |
English: who do those servants need to fear?

Gurbani: ਜੈਸਾ ਸਾ ਤੈਸਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jaisaa saa taisaa drisattaaeaa |
English: As God is, so does He appear;

Gurbani: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਮਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: apune kaaraj meh aap samaaeaa |
English: in His Own creation, He Himself is pervading.

Gurbani: ਸੋਧਤ ਸੋਧਤ ਸੋਧਤ ਸੀਝਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sodhat sodhat sodhat seejhiaa |
English: Searching, searching, searching, and finally, success!

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਬੂਝਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad tat sabh boojhiaa |
English: By Guru's Grace, the essence of all reality is understood.

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਬ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੂਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: jab dekhau tab sabh kichh mool |
English: Wherever I look, there I see Him, at the root of all things.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸੂਖਮੁ ਸੋਈ ਅਸਥੂਲੁ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak so sookham soee asathool |5|
English: O Nanak, He is the subtle, and He is also the manifest. ||5||

[Ang 281 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਨਹ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਨਮੈ ਨਹ ਕਿਛੁ ਮਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: neh kichh janamai neh kichh marai |
English: Nothing is born, and nothing dies.

Gurbani: ਆਪਨ ਚਲਿਤੁ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਕਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: aapan chalit aap hee karai |
English: He Himself stages His own drama.

Gurbani: ਆਵਨੁ ਜਾਵਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਅਨਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ॥
Transliteration: aavan jaavan drisatt anadrisatt |
English: Coming and going, seen and unseen,

Gurbani: ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ਧਾਰੀ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ॥
Transliteration: aagiaakaaree dhaaree sabh srisatt |
English: all the world is obedient to His Will.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਸਗਲ ਮਹਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: aape aap sagal meh aap |
English: He Himself is All-in-Himself.

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਰਚਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: anik jugat rach thaap uthaap |
English: In His many ways, He establishes and disestablishes.

Gurbani: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਖੰਡ ॥
Transliteration: abinaasee naahee kichh khandd |
English: He is Imperishable; nothing can be broken.

Gurbani: ਧਾਰਣ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ॥
Transliteration: dhaaran dhaar rahio brahamandd |
English: He lends His Support to maintain the Universe.

Gurbani: ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵ ਪੁਰਖ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥
Transliteration: alakh abhev purakh parataap |
English: Unfathomable and Inscrutable is the Glory of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਜਪਾਏ ਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਪ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: aap japaae ta naanak jaap |6|
English: As He inspires us to meditate, O Nanak, so do we meditate. ||6||

[Ang 282 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਸੁ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: jin prabh jaataa su sobhaavant |
English: Those who know God are glorious.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਉਧਰੈ ਤਿਨ ਮੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: sagal sansaar udharai tin mant |
English: The whole world is redeemed by their teachings.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਗਲ ਉਧਾਰਨ ॥
Transliteration: prabh ke sevak sagal udhaaran |
English: God's servants redeem all.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਸਾਰਨ ॥
Transliteration: prabh ke sevak dookh bisaaran |
English: God's servants cause sorrows to be forgotten.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: aape mel le kirapaal |
English: The Merciful Lord unites them with Himself.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਜਪਿ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa sabad jap bhe nihaal |
English: Chanting the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they become ecstatic.

Gurbani: ਉਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋਈ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: aun kee sevaa soee laagai |
English: He alone is committed to serve them,

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਡਭਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: jis no kripaa kareh baddabhaagai |
English: upon whom God bestows His Mercy, by great good fortune.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: naam japat paaveh bisraam |
English: Those who chant the Naam find their place of rest.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਉ ਊਤਮ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: naanak tin purakh kau aootam kar maan |7|
English: O Nanak, respect those persons as the most noble. ||7||

[Ang 282 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: jo kichh karai su prabh kai rang |
English: Whatever you do, do it for the Love of God.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਬਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa basai har sang |
English: Forever and ever, abide with the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj subhaae hovai so hoe |
English: By its own natural course, whatever will be will be.

Gurbani: ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: karanaihaar pachhaanai soe |
English: Acknowledge that Creator Lord;

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਜਨ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kaa keea jan meetth lagaanaa |
English: God's doings are sweet to His humble servant.

Gurbani: ਜੈਸਾ ਸਾ ਤੈਸਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaisaa saa taisaa drisattaanaa |
English: As He is, so does He appear.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jis te upaje tis maeh samaae |
English: From Him we came, and into Him we shall merge again.

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਉਨਹੂ ਬਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: oe sukh nidhaan unahoo ban aae |
English: He is the treasure of peace, and so does His servant become.

Gurbani: ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਆਪਿ ਦੀਨੋ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: aapas kau aap deeno maan |
English: Unto His own, He has given His honor.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਨੁ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਨੁ ॥੮॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: naanak prabh jan eko jaan |8|14|
English: O Nanak, know that God and His humble servant are one and the same. ||8||14||

[Ang 282 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਭਰਪੂਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਨਨਹਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: sarab kalaa bharapoor prabh birathaa jaananahaar |
English: God is totally imbued with all powers; He is the Knower of our troubles.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਉਧਰੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jaa kai simaran udhareeai naanak tis balihaar |1|
English: Meditating in remembrance on Him, we are saved; Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||1||

[Ang 282 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
Transliteration: asattapadee |
English: Ashtapadee:

Gurbani: ਟੂਟੀ ਗਾਢਨਹਾਰ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: ttoottee gaadtanahaar guopaal |
English: The Lord of the World is the Mender of the broken.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਆਪੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: sarab jeea aape pratipaal |
English: He Himself cherishes all beings.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: sagal kee chintaa jis man maeh |
English: The cares of all are on His Mind;

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: tis te birathaa koee naeh |
English: no one is turned away from Him.

Gurbani: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: re man mere sadaa har jaap |
English: O my mind, meditate forever on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: abinaasee prabh aape aap |
English: The Imperishable Lord God is Himself All-in-all.

Gurbani: ਆਪਨ ਕੀਆ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aapan keea kachhoo na hoe |
English: By one's own actions, nothing is accomplished,

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਲੋਚੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: je sau praanee lochai koe |
English: even though the mortal may wish it so, hundreds of times.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੇਰੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: tis bin naahee terai kichh kaam |
English: Without Him, nothing is of any use to you.

Gurbani: ਗਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪਿ ਏਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gat naanak jap ek har naam |1|
English: Salvation, O Nanak, is attained by chanting the Name of the One Lord. ||1||

[Ang 282 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰੂਪਵੰਤੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੋਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: roopavant hoe naahee mohai |
English: One who is good-looking should not be vain;

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਗਲ ਘਟ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kee jot sagal ghatt sohai |
English: the Light of God is in all hearts.

Gurbani: ਧਨਵੰਤਾ ਹੋਇ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਗਰਬੈ ॥
Transliteration: dhanavantaa hoe kiaa ko garabai |
English: Why should anyone be proud of being rich?

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਦੀਆ ਦਰਬੈ ॥
Transliteration: jaa sabh kichh tis kaa deea darabai |
English: All riches are His gifts.

Gurbani: ਅਤਿ ਸੂਰਾ ਜੇ ਕੋਊ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: at sooraa je koaoo kahaavai |
English: One may call himself a great hero,

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਕਲਾ ਬਿਨਾ ਕਹ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kee kalaa binaa keh dhaavai |
English: but without God's Power, what can anyone do?

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਹੋਇ ਬਹੈ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: je ko hoe bahai daataar |
English: One who brags about giving to charities

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਨਹਾਰੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਗਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: tis denahaar jaanai gaavaar |
English: the Great Giver shall judge him to be a fool.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤੂਟੈ ਹਉ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: jis gur prasaad toottai hau rog |
English: One who, by Guru's Grace, is cured of the disease of ego

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਅਰੋਗੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak so jan sadaa arog |2|
English: - O Nanak, that person is forever healthy. ||2||

[Ang 282 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਮੰਦਰ ਕਉ ਥਾਮੈ ਥੰਮਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: jiau mandar kau thaamai thaman |
English: As a palace is supported by its pillars,

Gurbani: ਤਿਉ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਅਸਥੰਮਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: tiau gur kaa sabad maneh asathaman |
English: so does the Guru's Word support the mind.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਪਾਖਾਣੁ ਨਾਵ ਚੜਿ ਤਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: jiau paakhaan naav charr tarai |
English: As a stone placed in a boat can cross over the river,

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਲਗਤੁ ਨਿਸਤਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: praanee gur charan lagat nisatarai |
English: so is the mortal saved, grasping hold of the Guru's Feet.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਦੀਪਕ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: jiau andhakaar deepak paragaas |
English: As the darkness is illuminated by the lamp,

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਗਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur darasan dekh man hoe bigaas |
English: so does the mind blossom forth, beholding the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਮਹਾ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jiau mahaa udiaan meh maarag paavai |
English: The path is found through the great wilderness by joining the Saadh Sangat,

Gurbani: ਤਿਉ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: tiau saadhoo sang mil jot pragattaavai |
English: The Company of the Holy, and one's light shines forth.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਛਉ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: tin santan kee baachhau dhoor |
English: I seek the dust of the feet of those Saints;

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਲੋਚਾ ਪੂਰਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak kee har lochaa poor |3|
English: O Lord, fulfill Nanak's longing! ||3||

[Ang 282 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮੂਰਖ ਕਾਹੇ ਬਿਲਲਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: man moorakh kaahe bilalaaeeai |
English: O foolish mind, why do you cry and bewail?

Gurbani: ਪੁਰਬ ਲਿਖੇ ਕਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: purab likhe kaa likhiaa paaeeai |
English: You shall obtain your pre-ordained destiny.

Gurbani: ਦੂਖ ਸੂਖ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: dookh sookh prabh devanahaar |
English: God is the Giver of pain and pleasure.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਤੂ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਚਿਤਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: avar tiaag too tiseh chitaar |
English: Abandon others, and think of Him alone.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: jo kachh karai soee sukh maan |
English: Whatever He does - take comfort in that.

Gurbani: ਭੂਲਾ ਕਾਹੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਅਜਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: bhoolaa kaahe fireh ajaan |
English: Why do you wander around, you ignorant fool?

Gurbani: ਕਉਨ ਬਸਤੁ ਆਈ ਤੇਰੈ ਸੰਗ ॥
Transliteration: kaun basat aaee terai sang |
English: What things did you bring with you?

Gurbani: ਲਪਟਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਰਸਿ ਲੋਭੀ ਪਤੰਗ ॥
Transliteration: lapatt rahio ras lobhee patang |
English: You cling to worldly pleasures like a greedy moth.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਜਪਿ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam jap hirade maeh |
English: Dwell upon the Lord's Name in your heart.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਤਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak pat setee ghar jaeh |4|
English: O Nanak, thus you shall return to your home with honor. ||4||

[Ang 283 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਵਖਰ ਕਉ ਲੈਨਿ ਤੂ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jis vakhar kau lain too aaeaa |
English: This merchandise, which you have come to obtain

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam santan ghar paaeaa |
English: - the Lord's Name is obtained in the home of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਤਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਲੇਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੋਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: taj abhimaan lehu man mol |
English: Renounce your egotistical pride, and with your mind,

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਮਹਿ ਤੋਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam hirade meh tol |
English: Purchase the Lord's Name - measure it out within your heart.

Gurbani: ਲਾਦਿ ਖੇਪ ਸੰਤਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਚਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: laad khep santah sang chaal |
English: Load up this merchandise, and set out with the Saints.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: avar tiaag bikhiaa janjaal |
English: Give up other corrupt entanglements.

Gurbani: ਧੰਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਕਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan kahai sabh koe |
English: "Blessed, blessed", everyone will call you,

Gurbani: ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: mukh aoojal har daragah soe |
English: and your face shall be radiant in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: eihu vaapaar viralaa vaapaarai |
English: In this trade, only a few are trading.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak taa kai sad balihaarai |5|
English: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to them. ||5||

[Ang 283 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਸਾਧ ਕੇ ਧੋਇ ਧੋਇ ਪੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: charan saadh ke dhoe dhoe peeo |
English: Wash the feet of the Holy, and drink in this water.

Gurbani: ਅਰਪਿ ਸਾਧ ਕਉ ਅਪਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: arap saadh kau apanaa jeeo |
English: Dedicate your soul to the Holy.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kee dhoor karahu isanaan |
English: Take your cleansing bath in the dust of the feet of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਊਪਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: saadh aoopar jaaeeai kurabaan |
English: To the Holy, make your life a sacrifice.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਸੇਵਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: saadh sevaa vaddabhaagee paaeeai |
English: Service to the Holy is obtained by great good fortune.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang har keeratan gaaeeai |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise is sung.

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਿਘਨ ਤੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: anik bighan te saadhoo raakhai |
English: From all sorts of dangers, the Saint saves us.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: har gun gaae amrit ras chaakhai |
English: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, we taste the ambrosial essence.

Gurbani: ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਸੰਤਹ ਦਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: ott gahee santah dar aaeaa |
English: Seeking the Protection of the Saints, we have come to their door.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਹ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: sarab sookh naanak tih paaeaa |6|
English: All comforts, O Nanak, are so obtained. ||6||

[Ang 283 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਿਰਤਕ ਕਉ ਜੀਵਾਲਨਹਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: miratak kau jeevaalanahaar |
English: He infuses life back into the dead.

Gurbani: ਭੂਖੇ ਕਉ ਦੇਵਤ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: bhookhe kau devat adhaar |
English: He gives food to the hungry.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: sarab nidhaan jaa kee drisattee maeh |
English: All treasures are within His Glance of Grace.

Gurbani: ਪੁਰਬ ਲਿਖੇ ਕਾ ਲਹਣਾ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: purab likhe kaa lahanaa paeh |
English: People obtain that which they are pre-ordained to receive.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਓਹੁ ਕਰਨੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh tis kaa ohu karanai jog |
English: All things are His; He is the Doer of all.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਸਰ ਹੋਆ ਨ ਹੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: tis bin doosar hoaa na hog |
English: Other than Him, there has never been any other, and there shall never be.

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਜਨ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: jap jan sadaa sadaa din rainee |
English: Meditate on Him forever and ever, day and night.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਇਹ ਕਰਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: sabh te aooch niramal ih karanee |
English: This way of life is exalted and immaculate.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa jis kau naam deea |
English: One whom the Lord, in His Grace, blesses with His Name

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਥੀਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: naanak so jan niramal theea |7|
English: - O Nanak, that person becomes immaculate and pure. ||7||

[Ang 283 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai man gur kee parateet |
English: One who has faith in the Guru in his mind

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: tis jan aavai har prabh cheet |
English: comes to dwell upon the Lord God.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat bhagat suneeai tihu loe |
English: He is acclaimed as a devotee, a humble devotee throughout the three worlds.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਏਕੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai hiradai eko hoe |
English: The One Lord is in his heart.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਰਹਤ ॥
Transliteration: sach karanee sach taa kee rehat |
English: True are his actions; true are his ways.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਤਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਕਹਤ ॥
Transliteration: sach hiradai sat mukh kehat |
English: True is his heart; Truth is what he speaks with his mouth.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: saachee drisatt saachaa aakaar |
English: True is his vision; true is his form.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਪਾਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sach varatai saachaa paasaar |
English: He distributes Truth and he spreads Truth.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham jin sach kar jaataa |
English: One who recognizes the Supreme Lord God as True

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਤਾ ॥੮॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: naanak so jan sach samaataa |8|15|
English: - O Nanak, that humble being is absorbed into the True One. ||8||15||

[Ang 283 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਿੰਨ ॥
Transliteration: roop na rekh na rang kichh trihu gun te prabh bhin |
English: He has no form, no shape, no color; God is beyond the three qualities.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tiseh bujhaae naanakaa jis hovai suprasan |1|
English: They alone understand Him, O Nanak, with whom He is pleased. ||1||

[Ang 283 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
Transliteration: asattapadee |
English: Ashtapadee:

Gurbani: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: abinaasee prabh man meh raakh |
English: Keep the Immortal Lord God enshrined within your mind.

Gurbani: ਮਾਨੁਖ ਕੀ ਤੂ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਤਿਆਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: maanukh kee too preet tiaag |
English: Renounce your love and attachment to people.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਪਰੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: tis te parai naahee kichh koe |
English: Beyond Him, there is nothing at all.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sarab nirantar eko soe |
English: The One Lord is pervading among all.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਬੀਨਾ ਆਪੇ ਦਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape beenaa aape daanaa |
English: He Himself is All-seeing; He Himself is All-knowing,

Gurbani: ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ਗਹੀਰੁ ਸੁਜਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: gahir ganbheer gaheer sujaanaa |
English: Unfathomable, Profound, Deep and All-knowing.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham paramesur gobind |
English: He is the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, the Lord of the Universe,

Gurbani: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਬਖਸੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: kripaa nidhaan deaal bakhasand |
English: the Treasure of mercy, compassion and forgiveness.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਚਰਨੀ ਪਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saadh tere kee charanee paau |
English: To fall at the Feet of Your Holy Beings

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਅਨਰਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak kai man ihu anaraau |1|
English: - this is the longing of Nanak's mind. ||1||

[Ang 284 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਰਨਾ ਜੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: manasaa pooran saranaa jog |
English: He is the Fulfiller of wishes, who can give us Sanctuary;

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋਈ ਹੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: jo kar paaeaa soee hog |
English: That which He has written, comes to pass.

Gurbani: ਹਰਨ ਭਰਨ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਫੋਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: haran bharan jaa kaa netr for |
English: He destroys and creates in the twinkling of an eye.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਹੋਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: tis kaa mantru na jaanai hor |
English: No one else knows the mystery of His ways.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦ ਰੂਪ ਮੰਗਲ ਸਦ ਜਾ ਕੈ ॥
Transliteration: anad roop mangal sad jaa kai |
English: He is the embodiment of ecstasy and everlasting joy.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਥੋਕ ਸੁਨੀਅਹਿ ਘਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥
Transliteration: sarab thok suneeeh ghar taa kai |
English: I have heard that all things are in His home.

Gurbani: ਰਾਜ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: raaj meh raaj jog meh jogee |
English: Among kings, He is the King; among yogis, He is the Yogi.

Gurbani: ਤਪ ਮਹਿ ਤਪੀਸਰੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਸਤ ਮਹਿ ਭੋਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: tap meh tapeesar grihasat meh bhogee |
English: Among ascetics, He is the Ascetic; among householders, He is the Enjoyer.

Gurbani: ਧਿਆਇ ਧਿਆਇ ਭਗਤਹ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: dhiaae dhiaae bhagatah sukh paaeaa |
English: By constant meditation, His devotee finds peace.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਾ ਕਿਨੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak tis purakh kaa kinai ant na paaeaa |2|
English: O Nanak, no one has found the limits of that Supreme Being. ||2||

[Ang 284 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਲੀਲਾ ਕੀ ਮਿਤਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kee leelaa kee mit naeh |
English: There is no limit to His play.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਦੇਵ ਹਾਰੇ ਅਵਗਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: sagal dev haare avagaeh |
English: All the demigods have grown weary of searching for it.

Gurbani: ਪਿਤਾ ਕਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਕਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਪੂਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: pitaa kaa janam ki jaanai poot |
English: What does the son know of his father's birth?

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਪਰੋਈ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਸੂਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: sagal paroee apunai soot |
English: All are strung upon His string.

Gurbani: ਸੁਮਤਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਜਿਨ ਦੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: sumat giaan dhiaan jin dee |
English: He bestows good sense, spiritual wisdom and meditation,

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਦਾਸ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਸੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: jan daas naam dhiaaveh see |
English: On His humble servants and slaves who meditate on the Naam.

Gurbani: ਤਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਰਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: tihu gun meh jaa kau bharamaae |
English: He leads some astray in the three qualities;

Gurbani: ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: janam marai fir aavai jaae |
English: they are born and die, coming and going over and over again.

Gurbani: ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਅਸਥਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: aooch neech tis ke asathaan |
English: The high and the low are His places.

Gurbani: ਜੈਸਾ ਜਨਾਵੈ ਤੈਸਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਨ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jaisaa janaavai taisaa naanak jaan |3|
English: As He inspires us to know Him, O Nanak, so is He known. ||3||

[Ang 284 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਨਾਨਾ ਰੂਪ ਨਾਨਾ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਰੰਗ ॥
Transliteration: naanaa roop naanaa jaa ke rang |
English: Many are His forms; many are His colors.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਾ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਹਿ ਇਕ ਰੰਗ ॥
Transliteration: naanaa bhekh kareh ik rang |
English: Many are the appearances which He assumes, and yet He is still the One.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਾ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੀਨੋ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanaa bidh keeno bisathaar |
English: In so many ways, He has extended Himself.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: prabh abinaasee ekankaar |
English: The Eternal Lord God is the One, the Creator.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਾ ਚਲਿਤ ਕਰੇ ਖਿਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: naanaa chalit kare khin maeh |
English: He performs His many plays in an instant.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਸਭ ਠਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: poor rahio pooran sabh tthaae |
English: The Perfect Lord is pervading all places.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਾ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਨਤ ਬਨਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: naanaa bidh kar banat banaaee |
English: In so many ways, He created the creation.

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: apanee keemat aape paaee |
English: He alone can estimate His worth.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਘਟ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਸਭ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਠਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sabh ghatt tis ke sabh tis ke tthaau |
English: All hearts are His, and all places are His.

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jap jap jeevai naanak har naau |4|
English: Nanak lives by chanting, chanting the Name of the Lord. ||4||

[Ang 284 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਧਾਰੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਜੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: naam ke dhaare sagale jant |
English: The Naam is the Support of all creatures.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਧਾਰੇ ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ॥
Transliteration: naam ke dhaare khandd brahamandd |
English: The Naam is the Support of the earth and solar systems.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਧਾਰੇ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: naam ke dhaare simrit bed puraan |
English: The Naam is the Support of the Simritees, the Vedas and the Puraanas.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਧਾਰੇ ਸੁਨਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ॥
Transliteration: naam ke dhaare sunan giaan dhiaan |
English: The Naam is the Support by which we hear of spiritual wisdom and meditation.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਧਾਰੇ ਆਗਾਸ ਪਾਤਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: naam ke dhaare aagaas paataal |
English: The Naam is the Support of the Akaashic ethers and the nether regions.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਧਾਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਆਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: naam ke dhaare sagal aakaar |
English: The Naam is the Support of all bodies.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਧਾਰੇ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਸਭ ਭਵਨ ॥
Transliteration: naam ke dhaare pureea sabh bhavan |
English: The Naam is the Support of all worlds and realms.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਰੇ ਸੁਨਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ॥
Transliteration: naam kai sang udhare sun sravan |
English: Associating with the Naam, listening to it with the ears, one is saved.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਨੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa jis aapanai naam laae |
English: Those whom the Lord mercifully attaches to His Naam

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਉਥੇ ਪਦ ਮਹਿ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak chauthe pad meh so jan gat paae |5|
English: - O Nanak, in the fourth state, those humble servants attain salvation. ||5||

[Ang 284 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰੂਪੁ ਸਤਿ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਸਤਿ ਅਸਥਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: roop sat jaa kaa sat asathaan |
English: His form is true, and true is His place.

Gurbani: ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਤਿ ਕੇਵਲ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: purakh sat keval paradhaan |
English: His personality is true - He alone is supreme.

Gurbani: ਕਰਤੂਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: karatoot sat sat jaa kee baanee |
English: His acts are true, and true is His Word.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਸਭ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: sat purakh sabh maeh samaanee |
English: The True Lord is permeating all.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਸਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: sat karam jaa kee rachanaa sat |
English: True are His actions; His creation is true.

Gurbani: ਮੂਲੁ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਉਤਪਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: mool sat sat utapat |
English: His root is true, and true is what originates from it.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਮਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: sat karanee niramal niramalee |
English: True is His lifestyle, the purest of the pure.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਸਭ ਭਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: jiseh bujhaae tiseh sabh bhalee |
English: All goes well for those who know Him.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sat naam prabh kaa sukhadaaee |
English: The True Name of God is the Giver of peace.

Gurbani: ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸੁ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: bisvaas sat naanak gur te paaee |6|
English: Nanak has obtained true faith from the Guru. ||6||

[Ang 284 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਤਿ ਬਚਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਉਪਦੇਸ ॥
Transliteration: sat bachan saadhoo upades |
English: True are the Teachings, and the Instructions of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸ ॥
Transliteration: sat te jan jaa kai ridai praves |
English: True are those into whose hearts He enters.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿ ਨਿਰਤਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਜੇ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sat nirat boojhai je koe |
English: One who knows and loves the Truth

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: naam japat taa kee gat hoe |
English: chanting the Naam, he obtains salvation.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਸਤਿ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਸਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: aap sat keea sabh sat |
English: He Himself is True, and all that He has made is true.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਨੈ ਅਪਨੀ ਮਿਤਿ ਗਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: aape jaanai apanee mit gat |
English: He Himself knows His own state and condition.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸੁ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jis kee srisatt su karanaihaar |
English: He is the Creator Lord of His world.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰ ਨ ਬੂਝਿ ਕਰਤ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: avar na boojh karat beechaar |
English: No one else understands Him, although they may try.

Gurbani: ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀ ਮਿਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: karate kee mit na jaanai keea |
English: The created cannot know the extent of the Creator.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਵਰਤੀਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: naanak jo tis bhaavai so varateea |7|
English: O Nanak, whatever pleases Him comes to pass. ||7||

[Ang 285 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਸਮਨ ਬਿਸਮ ਭਏ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥
Transliteration: bisaman bisam bhe bisamaad |
English: Gazing upon His wondrous wonder, I am wonder-struck and amazed!

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਬੂਝਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਇਆ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ॥
Transliteration: jin boojhiaa tis aaeaa svaad |
English: One who realizes this, comes to taste this state of joy.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਚਿ ਜਨ ਰਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kai rang raach jan rahe |
English: God's humble servants remain absorbed in His Love.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਲਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai bachan padaarath lahe |
English: Following the Guru's Teachings, they receive the four cardinal blessings.

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਦਾਤੇ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਟਨਹਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: oe daate dukh kaattanahaar |
English: They are the givers, the dispellers of pain.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai sang tarai sansaar |
English: In their company, the world is saved.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸੋ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: jan kaa sevak so vaddabhaagee |
English: The slave of the Lord's servant is so very blessed.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: jan kai sang ek liv laagee |
English: In the company of His servant, one becomes attached to the Love of the One.

Gurbani: ਗੁਨ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਜਨੁ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: gun gobid keeratan jan gaavai |
English: His humble servant sings the Kirtan, the songs of the glory of God.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੮॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad naanak fal paavai |8|16|
English: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, he receives the fruits of his rewards. ||8||16||

[Ang 285 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਸਚੁ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਸਚੁ ॥
Transliteration: aad sach jugaad sach |
English: True in the beginning, True throughout the ages,

Gurbani: ਹੈ ਭਿ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹੋਸੀ ਭਿ ਸਚੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: hai bhi sach naanak hosee bhi sach |1|
English: True here and now. O Nanak, He shall forever be True. ||1||

[Ang 285 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
Transliteration: asattapadee |
English: Ashtapadee:

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਪਰਸਨਹਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: charan sat sat parasanahaar |
English: His Lotus Feet are True, and True are those who touch Them.

Gurbani: ਪੂਜਾ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸੇਵਦਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: poojaa sat sat sevadaar |
English: His devotional worship is True, and True are those who worship Him.

Gurbani: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਪੇਖਨਹਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: darasan sat sat pekhanahaar |
English: The Blessing of His Vision is True, and True are those who behold it.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਧਿਆਵਨਹਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: naam sat sat dhiaavanahaar |
English: His Naam is True, and True are those who meditate on it.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਭ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: aap sat sat sabh dhaaree |
English: He Himself is True, and True is all that He sustains.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: aape gun aape gunakaaree |
English: He Himself is virtuous goodness, and He Himself is the Bestower of virtue.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੁ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਕਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabad sat sat prabh bakataa |
English: The Word of His Shabad is True, and True are those who speak of God.

Gurbani: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: surat sat sat jas sunataa |
English: Those ears are True, and True are those who listen to His Praises.

Gurbani: ਬੁਝਨਹਾਰ ਕਉ ਸਤਿ ਸਭ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bujhanahaar kau sat sabh hoe |
English: All is True to one who understands.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak sat sat prabh soe |1|
English: O Nanak, True, True is He, the Lord God. ||1||

[Ang 285 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sat saroop ridai jin maaniaa |
English: One who believes in the Embodiment of Truth with all his heart

Gurbani: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਤਿਨਿ ਮੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: karan karaavan tin mool pachhaaniaa |
English: recognizes the Cause of causes as the Root of all.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai ridai bisvaas prabh aaeaa |
English: One whose heart is filled with faith in God

Gurbani: ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tat giaan tis man pragattaaeaa |
English: the essence of spiritual wisdom is revealed to his mind.

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹੋਇ ਬਸਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: bhai te nirbhau hoe basaanaa |
English: Coming out of fear, he comes to live without fear.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jis te upajiaa tis maeh samaanaa |
English: He is absorbed into the One, from whom he originated.

Gurbani: ਬਸਤੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਲੇ ਬਸਤੁ ਗਡਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: basat maeh le basat gaddaaee |
English: When something blends with its own,

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਭਿੰਨ ਨ ਕਹਨਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: taa kau bhin na kahanaa jaaee |
English: it cannot be said to be separate from it.

Gurbani: ਬੂਝੈ ਬੂਝਨਹਾਰੁ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥
Transliteration: boojhai boojhanahaar bibek |
English: This is understood only by one of discerning understanding.

Gurbani: ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naaraaein mile naanak ek |2|
English: Meeting with the Lord, O Nanak, he becomes one with Him. ||2||

[Ang 285 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: tthaakur kaa sevak aagiaakaaree |
English: The servant is obedient to his Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸਦਾ ਪੂਜਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: tthaakur kaa sevak sadaa poojaaree |
English: The servant worships his Lord and Master forever.

Gurbani: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: tthaakur ke sevak kai man parateet |
English: The servant of the Lord Master has faith in his mind.

Gurbani: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: tthaakur ke sevak kee niramal reet |
English: The servant of the Lord Master lives a pure lifestyle.

Gurbani: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਉ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: tthaakur kau sevak jaanai sang |
English: The servant of the Lord Master knows that the Lord is with him.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਨਾਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kaa sevak naam kai rang |
English: God's servant is attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਲਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sevak kau prabh paalanahaaraa |
English: God is the Cherisher of His servant.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਰਾਖੈ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sevak kee raakhai nirankaaraa |
English: The Formless Lord preserves His servant.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਦਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: so sevak jis deaa prabh dhaarai |
English: Unto His servant, God bestows His Mercy.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਮਾਰੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak so sevak saas saas samaarai |3|
English: O Nanak, that servant remembers Him with each and every breath. ||3||

[Ang 285 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਪਰਦਾ ਢਾਕੈ ॥
Transliteration: apune jan kaa paradaa dtaakai |
English: He covers the faults of His servant.

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਸਰਪਰ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: apane sevak kee sarapar raakhai |
English: He surely preserves the honor of His servant.

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: apane daas kau dee vaddaaee |
English: He blesses His slave with greatness.

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: apane sevak kau naam japaaee |
English: He inspires His servant to chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਆਪਿ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: apane sevak kee aap pat raakhai |
English: He Himself preserves the honor of His servant.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਲਾਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: taa kee gat mit koe na laakhai |
English: No one knows His state and extent.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਕੋ ਨ ਪਹੂਚੈ ॥
Transliteration: prabh ke sevak kau ko na pahoochai |
English: No one is equal to the servant of God.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਊਚ ਤੇ ਊਚੇ ॥
Transliteration: prabh ke sevak aooch te aooche |
English: The servant of God is the highest of the high.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jo prabh apanee sevaa laaeaa |
English: One whom God applies to His own service, O Nanak

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak so sevak deh dis pragattaaeaa |4|
English: - that servant is famous in the ten directions. ||4||

[Ang 285 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਨੀਕੀ ਕੀਰੀ ਮਹਿ ਕਲ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: neekee keeree meh kal raakhai |
English: He infuses His Power into the tiny ant;

Gurbani: ਭਸਮ ਕਰੈ ਲਸਕਰ ਕੋਟਿ ਲਾਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: bhasam karai lasakar kott laakhai |
English: it can then reduce the armies of millions to ashes

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾਸੁ ਨ ਕਾਢਤ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: jis kaa saas na kaadtat aap |
English: Those whose breath of life He Himself does not take away

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਰਾਖਤ ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਥ ॥
Transliteration: taa kau raakhat de kar haath |
English: He preserves them, and holds out His Hands to protect them.

Gurbani: ਮਾਨਸ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਤ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: maanas jatan karat bahu bhaat |
English: You may make all sorts of efforts,

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਕਰਤਬ ਬਿਰਥੇ ਜਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: tis ke karatab birathe jaat |
English: but these attempts are in vain.

Gurbani: ਮਾਰੈ ਨ ਰਾਖੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: maarai na raakhai avar na koe |
English: No one else can kill or preserve

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਰਾਖਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sarab jeea kaa raakhaa soe |
English: He is the Protector of all beings.

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੇ ਸੋਚ ਕਰਹਿ ਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: kaahe soch kareh re praanee |
English: So why are you so anxious, O mortal?

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਲਖ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: jap naanak prabh alakh viddaanee |5|
English: Meditate, O Nanak, on God, the invisible, the wonderful! ||5||

[Ang 286 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਾਰੰ ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਪੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: baaran baar baar prabh japeeai |
English: Time after time, again and again, meditate on God.

Gurbani: ਪੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਧ੍ਰਪੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: pee amrit ihu man tan dhrapeeai |
English: Drinking in this Nectar, this mind and body are satisfied.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: naam ratan jin guramukh paaeaa |
English: The jewel of the Naam is obtained by the Gurmukhs;

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tis kichh avar naahee drisattaaeaa |
English: they see no other than God.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਮੋ ਰੂਪੁ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: naam dhan naamo roop rang |
English: Unto them, the Naam is wealth, the Naam is beauty and delight.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: naamo sukh har naam kaa sang |
English: The Naam is peace, the Lord's Name is their companion.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਰਸਿ ਜੋ ਜਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨੇ ॥
