Transliteration: naam ras jo jan tripataane |
English: Those who are satisfied by the essence of the Naam

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਨਾਮਹਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: man tan naameh naam samaane |
English: their minds and bodies are drenched with the Naam.

Gurbani: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਨਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: aootthat baitthat sovat naam |
English: While standing up, sitting down and sleeping, the Naam,

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਕਾਮ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak jan kai sad kaam |6|
English: says Nanak, is forever the occupation of God's humble servant. ||6||

[Ang 286 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬੋਲਹੁ ਜਸੁ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: bolahu jas jihabaa din raat |
English: Chant His Praises with your tongue, day and night.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨੈ ਜਨ ਕੀਨੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: prabh apanai jan keenee daat |
English: God Himself has given this gift to His servants.

Gurbani: ਕਰਹਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਆਤਮ ਕੈ ਚਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kareh bhagat aatam kai chaae |
English: Performing devotional worship with heart-felt love,

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ ਸਿਉ ਰਹਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: prabh apane siau raheh samaae |
English: they remain absorbed in God Himself.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਹੋਆ ਹੋਵਤ ਸੋ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: jo hoaa hovat so jaanai |
English: They know the past and the present.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: prabh apane kaa hukam pachhaanai |
English: They recognize God's Own Command.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕਉਨ ਬਖਾਨਉ ॥
Transliteration: tis kee mahimaa kaun bakhaanau |
English: Who can describe His Glory?

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਗੁਨੁ ਕਹਿ ਏਕ ਨ ਜਾਨਉ ॥
Transliteration: tis kaa gun keh ek na jaanau |
English: I cannot describe even one of His virtuous qualities.

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਸਹਿ ਹਜੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar prabh baseh hajoore |
English: Those who dwell in God's Presence, twenty-four hours a day

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਪੂਰੇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak seee jan poore |7|
English: - says Nanak, they are the perfect persons. ||7||

[Ang 286 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਲੇਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: man mere tin kee ott lehi |
English: O my mind, seek their protection;

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਤਿਨ ਜਨ ਦੇਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: man tan apanaa tin jan dehi |
English: give your mind and body to those humble beings.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਅਪਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: jin jan apanaa prabhoo pachhaataa |
English: Those humble beings who recognizes God

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸਰਬ ਥੋਕ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: so jan sarab thok kaa daataa |
English: are the givers of all things.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: tis kee saran sarab sukh paaveh |
English: In His Sanctuary, all comforts are obtained.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਦਰਸਿ ਸਭ ਪਾਪ ਮਿਟਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: tis kai daras sabh paap mittaaveh |
English: By the Blessing of His Darshan, all sins are erased.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਸਗਲੀ ਛਾਡੁ ॥
Transliteration: avar siaanap sagalee chhaadd |
English: So renounce all other clever devices,

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਤੂ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: tis jan kee too sevaa laag |
English: and enjoin yourself to the service of those servants.

Gurbani: ਆਵਨੁ ਜਾਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aavan jaan na hovee teraa |
English: Your comings and goings shall be ended.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਪੂਜਹੁ ਸਦ ਪੈਰਾ ॥੮॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: naanak tis jan ke poojahu sad pairaa |8|17|
English: O Nanak, worship the feet of God's humble servants forever. ||8||17||

[Ang 286 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sat purakh jin jaaniaa satigur tis kaa naau |
English: The one who knows the True Lord God, is called the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਿਖੁ ਉਧਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tis kai sang sikh udharai naanak har gun gaau |1|
English: In His Company, the Sikh is saved, O Nanak, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

[Ang 286 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
Transliteration: asattapadee |
English: Ashtapadee:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਕੀ ਕਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sikh kee karai pratipaal |
English: The True Guru cherishes His Sikh.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
Transliteration: sevak kau gur sadaa deaal |
English: The Guru is always merciful to His servant.

Gurbani: ਸਿਖ ਕੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਲੁ ਹਿਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: sikh kee gur duramat mal hirai |
English: The Guru washes away the filth of the evil intellect of His Sikh.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਚਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur bachanee har naam ucharai |
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, he chants the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sikh ke bandhan kaattai |
English: The True Guru cuts away the bonds of His Sikh.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਿਖੁ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਤੇ ਹਾਟੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa sikh bikaar te haattai |
English: The Sikh of the Guru abstains from evil deeds.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਕਉ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sikh kau naam dhan dee |
English: The True Guru gives His Sikh the wealth of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਿਖੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa sikh vaddabhaagee he |
English: The Sikh of the Guru is very fortunate.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਕਾ ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਸਵਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sikh kaa halat palat savaarai |
English: The True Guru arranges this world and the next for His Sikh.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਕਉ ਜੀਅ ਨਾਲਿ ਸਮਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak satigur sikh kau jeea naal samaarai |1|
English: O Nanak, with the fullness of His heart, the True Guru mends His Sikh. ||1||

[Ang 286 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜੋ ਰਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai grihi sevak jo rahai |
English: That selfless servant, who lives in the Guru's household,

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur kee aagiaa man meh sahai |
English: is to obey the Guru's Commands with all his mind.

Gurbani: ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਕਰਿ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਜਨਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: aapas kau kar kachh na janaavai |
English: He is not to call attention to himself in any way.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਦ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam ridai sad dhiaavai |
English: He is to meditate constantly within his heart on the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਬੇਚੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: man bechai satigur kai paas |
English: One who sells his mind to the True Guru

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: tis sevak ke kaaraj raas |
English: - that humble servant's affairs are resolved.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਤ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਹਕਾਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: sevaa karat hoe nihakaamee |
English: One who performs selfless service, without thought of reward,

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਹੋਤ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: tis kau hot paraapat suaamee |
English: shall attain his Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: apanee kripaa jis aap karee |
English: He Himself grants His Grace;

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਲੇਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak so sevak gur kee mat lee |2|
English: O Nanak, that selfless servant lives the Guru's Teachings. ||2||

[Ang 287 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬੀਸ ਬਿਸਵੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: bees bisave gur kaa man maanai |
English: One who obeys the Guru's Teachings one hundred per cent

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: so sevak paramesur kee gat jaanai |
English: that selfless servant comes to know the state of the Transcendent Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: so satigur jis ridai har naau |
English: The True Guru's Heart is filled with the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਰ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: anik baar gur kau bal jaau |
English: So many times, I am a sacrifice to the Guru.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: sarab nidhaan jeea kaa daataa |
English: He is the treasure of everything, the Giver of life.

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar paarabraham rang raataa |
English: Twenty-four hours a day, He is imbued with the Love of the Supreme Lord God.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮਹਿ ਜਨੁ ਜਨ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: braham meh jan jan meh paarabraham |
English: The servant is in God, and God is in the servant.

Gurbani: ਏਕਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਨਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਭਰਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: ekeh aap nahee kachh bharam |
English: He Himself is One - there is no doubt about this.

Gurbani: ਸਹਸ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਲਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: sehas siaanap leaa na jaaeeai |
English: By thousands of clever tricks, He is not found.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਐਸਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak aisaa gur baddabhaagee paaeeai |3|
English: O Nanak, such a Guru is obtained by the greatest good fortune. ||3||

[Ang 287 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: safal darasan pekhat puneet |
English: Blessed is His Darshan; receiving it, one is purified.

Gurbani: ਪਰਸਤ ਚਰਨ ਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: parasat charan gat niramal reet |
English: Touching His Feet, one's conduct and lifestyle become pure.

Gurbani: ਭੇਟਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਰਵੇ ॥
Transliteration: bhettat sang raam gun rave |
English: Abiding in His Company, one chants the Lord's Praise,

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਗਵੇ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham kee daragah gave |
English: and reaches the Court of the Supreme Lord God.

Gurbani: ਸੁਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਚਨ ਕਰਨ ਆਘਾਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: sun kar bachan karan aaghaane |
English: Listening to His Teachings, one's ears are satisfied.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਆਤਮ ਪਤੀਆਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: man santokh aatam pateeaane |
English: The mind is contented, and the soul is fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਖੵਓ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ॥
Transliteration: pooraa gur akhayo jaa kaa mantr |
English: The Guru is perfect; His Teachings are everlasting.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਪੇਖੈ ਹੋਇ ਸੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: amrit drisatt pekhai hoe sant |
English: Beholding His Ambrosial Glance, one becomes saintly.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਬਿਅੰਤ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gun biant keemat nahee paae |
English: Endless are His virtuous qualities; His worth cannot be appraised.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak jis bhaavai tis le milaae |4|
English: O Nanak, one who pleases Him is united with Him. ||4||

[Ang 287 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜਿਹਬਾ ਏਕ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
Transliteration: jihabaa ek usatat anek |
English: The tongue is one, but His Praises are many.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਪੂਰਨ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥
Transliteration: sat purakh pooran bibek |
English: The True Lord, of perfect perfection

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੂ ਬੋਲ ਨ ਪਹੁਚਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: kaahoo bol na pahuchat praanee |
English: - no speech can take the mortal to Him.

Gurbani: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਿਰਬਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: agam agochar prabh nirabaanee |
English: God is Inaccessible, Incomprehensible, balanced in the state of Nirvaanaa.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਾਹਾਰ ਨਿਰਵੈਰ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: niraahaar niravair sukhadaaee |
English: He is not sustained by food; He has no hatred or vengeance; He is the Giver of peace.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: taa kee keemat kinai na paaee |
English: No one can estimate His worth.

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਭਗਤ ਬੰਦਨ ਨਿਤ ਕਰਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: anik bhagat bandan nit kareh |
English: Countless devotees continually bow in reverence to Him.

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal hiradai simareh |
English: In their hearts, they meditate on His Lotus Feet.

Gurbani: ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਪਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: sad balihaaree satigur apane |
English: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to the True Guru;

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਐਸਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਪਨੇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak jis prasaad aisaa prabh japane |5|
English: by His Grace, he meditates on God. ||5||

[Ang 287 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: eihu har ras paavai jan koe |
English: Only a few obtain this ambrosial essence of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਅਮਰੁ ਸੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: amrit peevai amar so hoe |
English: Drinking in this Nectar, one becomes immortal.

Gurbani: ਉਸੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਦੇ ਬਿਨਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: aus purakh kaa naahee kade binaas |
English: That person whose mind is illuminated

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਗੁਨਤਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai man pragatte gunataas |
English: By the treasure of excellence, never dies.

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar har kaa naam lee |
English: Twenty-four hours a day, he takes the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਦੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: sach upades sevak kau dee |
English: The Lord gives true instruction to His servant.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਲੇਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: moh maaeaa kai sang na lep |
English: He is not polluted by emotional attachment to Maya.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: man meh raakhai har har ek |
English: In his mind, he cherishes the One Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਦੀਪਕ ਪਰਗਾਸੇ ॥
Transliteration: andhakaar deepak paragaase |
English: In the pitch darkness, a lamp shines forth.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਦੁਖ ਤਹ ਤੇ ਨਾਸੇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: naanak bharam moh dukh teh te naase |6|
English: O Nanak, doubt, emotional attachment and pain are erased. ||6||

[Ang 287 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਤਪਤਿ ਮਾਹਿ ਠਾਢਿ ਵਰਤਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: tapat maeh tthaadt varataaee |
English: In the burning heat, a soothing coolness prevails.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਦੁਖ ਨਾਠੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: anad bheaa dukh naatthe bhaaee |
English: Happiness ensues and pain departs, O Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕੇ ਮਿਟੇ ਅੰਦੇਸੇ ॥
Transliteration: janam maran ke mitte andese |
English: The fear of birth and death is dispelled,

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਉਪਦੇਸੇ ॥
Transliteration: saadhoo ke pooran upadese |
English: by the perfect Teachings of the Holy Saint.

Gurbani: ਭਉ ਚੂਕਾ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹੋਇ ਬਸੇ ॥
Transliteration: bhau chookaa nirbhau hoe base |
English: Fear is lifted, and one abides in fearlessness.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਖੈ ਨਸੇ ॥
Transliteration: sagal biaadh man te khai nase |
English: All evils are dispelled from the mind.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jis kaa saa tin kirapaa dhaaree |
English: He takes us into His favor as His own.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang jap naam muraaree |
English: In the Company of the Holy, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਥਿਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਚੂਕੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਗਵਨ ॥
Transliteration: thit paaee chooke bhram gavan |
English: Stability is attained; doubt and wandering cease,

Gurbani: ਸੁਨਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: sun naanak har har jas sravan |7|
English: O Nanak, listening with one's ears to the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||7||

[Ang 287 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਨਿਰਗੁਨੁ ਆਪਿ ਸਰਗੁਨੁ ਭੀ ਓਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: niragun aap saragun bhee ohee |
English: He Himself is absolute and unrelated; He Himself is also involved and related.

Gurbani: ਕਲਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਗਲੀ ਮੋਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: kalaa dhaar jin sagalee mohee |
English: Manifesting His power, He fascinates the entire world.

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੇ ਚਰਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਬਨਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: apane charit prabh aap banaae |
English: God Himself sets His play in motion.

Gurbani: ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: apunee keemat aape paae |
English: Only He Himself can estimate His worth.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: har bin doojaa naahee koe |
English: There is none, other than the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sarab nirantar eko soe |
English: Permeating all, He is the One.

Gurbani: ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ॥
Transliteration: ot pot raviaa roop rang |
English: Through and through, He pervades in form and color.

Gurbani: ਭਏ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗ ॥
Transliteration: bhe pragaas saadh kai sang |
English: He is revealed in the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਰਚਿ ਰਚਨਾ ਅਪਨੀ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: rach rachanaa apanee kal dhaaree |
English: Having created the creation, He infuses His own power into it.

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੮॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: anik baar naanak balihaaree |8|18|
English: So many times, Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||8||18||

[Ang 288 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸਗਲੀ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: saath na chaalai bin bhajan bikhiaa sagalee chhaar |
English: Nothing shall go along with you, except your devotion. All corruption is like ashes.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਮਾਵਨਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har har naam kamaavanaa naanak ihu dhan saar |1|
English: Practice the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. O Nanak, this is the most excellent wealth. ||1||

[Ang 288 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
Transliteration: asattapadee |
English: Ashtapadee:

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sant janaa mil karahu beechaar |
English: Joining the Company of the Saints, practice deep meditation.

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: ek simar naam aadhaar |
English: Remember the One, and take the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰਿ ਉਪਾਵ ਸਭਿ ਮੀਤ ਬਿਸਾਰਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: avar upaav sabh meet bisaarahu |
English: Forget all other efforts, O my friend

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਿਦ ਮਹਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal rid meh ur dhaarahu |
English: - enshrine the Lord's Lotus Feet within your heart.

Gurbani: ਕਰਨ ਕਾਰਨ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥
Transliteration: karan kaaran so prabh samarath |
English: God is All-powerful; He is the Cause of causes.

Gurbani: ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਗਹਹੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਵਥੁ ॥
Transliteration: drirr kar gahahu naam har vath |
English: Grasp firmly the object of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਹੋਵਹੁ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: eihu dhan sanchahu hovahu bhagavant |
English: Gather this wealth, and become very fortunate.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: sant janaa kaa niramal mant |
English: Pure are the instructions of the humble Saints.

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਆਸ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: ek aas raakhahu man maeh |
English: Keep faith in the One Lord within your mind.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਰੋਗ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਟਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sarab rog naanak mitt jaeh |1|
English: All disease, O Nanak, shall then be dispelled. ||1||

[Ang 288 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਧਨ ਕਉ ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jis dhan kau chaar kuntt utth dhaaveh |
English: The wealth which you chase after in the four directions

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: so dhan har sevaa te paaveh |
English: you shall obtain that wealth by serving the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਸੁਖ ਕਉ ਨਿਤ ਬਾਛਹਿ ਮੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: jis sukh kau nit baachheh meet |
English: The peace, which you always yearn for, O friend

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: so sukh saadhoo sang pareet |
English: that peace comes by the love of the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਕਉ ਕਰਹਿ ਭਲੀ ਕਰਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: jis sobhaa kau kareh bhalee karanee |
English: The glory, for which you perform good deeds

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਸੋਭਾ ਭਜੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: saa sobhaa bhaj har kee saranee |
English: - you shall obtain that glory by seeking the Lord's Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਉਪਾਵੀ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: anik upaavee rog na jaae |
English: All sorts of remedies have not cured the disease

Gurbani: ਰੋਗੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਹਰਿ ਅਵਖਧੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: rog mittai har avakhadh laae |
English: - the disease is cured only by giving the medicine of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: sarab nidhaan meh har naam nidhaan |
English: Of all treasures, the Lord's Name is the supreme treasure.

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jap naanak darageh paravaan |2|
English: Chant it, O Nanak, and be accepted in the Court of the Lord. ||2||

[Ang 288 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਪਰਬੋਧਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man parabodhahu har kai naae |
English: Enlighten your mind with the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਧਾਵਤ ਆਵੈ ਠਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: deh dis dhaavat aavai tthaae |
English: Having wandered around in the ten directions, it comes to its place of rest.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: taa kau bighan na laagai koe |
English: No obstacle stands in the way of one

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai ridai basai har soe |
English: whose heart is filled with the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਲਿ ਤਾਤੀ ਠਾਂਢਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kal taatee tthaandtaa har naau |
English: The Dark Age of Kali Yuga is so hot; the Lord's Name is soothing and cool.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: simar simar sadaa sukh paau |
English: Remember, remember it in meditation, and obtain everlasting peace.

Gurbani: ਭਉ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਇ ਆਸ ॥
Transliteration: bhau binasai pooran hoe aas |
English: Your fear shall be dispelled, and your hopes shall be fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਆਤਮ ਪਰਗਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat bhaae aatam paragaas |
English: By devotional worship and loving adoration, your soul shall be enlightened.

Gurbani: ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਬਸੈ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: tit ghar jaae basai abinaasee |
English: You shall go to that home, and live forever.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਟੀ ਜਮ ਫਾਸੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak kaattee jam faasee |3|
English: Says Nanak, the noose of death is cut away. ||3||

[Ang 288 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਕਹੈ ਜਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ॥
Transliteration: tat beechaar kahai jan saachaa |
English: One who contemplates the essence of reality, is said to be the true person.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਸੋ ਕਾਚੋ ਕਾਚਾ ॥
Transliteration: janam marai so kaacho kaachaa |
English: Birth and death are the lot of the false and the insincere.

Gurbani: ਆਵਾ ਗਵਨੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: aavaa gavan mittai prabh sev |
English: Coming and going in reincarnation is ended by serving God.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: aap tiaag saran guradev |
English: Give up your selfishness and conceit, and seek the Sanctuary of the Divine Guru.

Gurbani: ਇਉ ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: eiau ratan janam kaa hoe udhaar |
English: Thus the jewel of this human life is saved.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: har har simar praan aadhaar |
English: Remember the Lord, Har, Har, the Support of the breath of life.

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਉਪਾਵ ਨ ਛੂਟਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: anik upaav na chhoottanahaare |
English: By all sorts of efforts, people are not saved

Gurbani: ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sinmrit saasat bed beechaare |
English: not by studying the Simritees, the Shaastras or the Vedas.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: har kee bhagat karahu man laae |
English: Worship the Lord with whole-hearted devotion.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਬੰਛਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਫਲ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: man banchhat naanak fal paae |4|
English: O Nanak, you shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desire. ||4||

[Ang 288 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲਸਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਧਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: sang na chaalas terai dhanaa |
English: Your wealth shall not go with you;

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਕਿਆ ਲਪਟਾਵਹਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਮਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: toon kiaa lapattaaveh moorakh manaa |
English: why do you cling to it, you fool?

Gurbani: ਸੁਤ ਮੀਤ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਅਰੁ ਬਨਿਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: sut meet kuttanb ar banitaa |
English: Children, friends, family and spouse

Gurbani: ਇਨ ਤੇ ਕਹਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਕਵਨ ਸਨਾਥਾ ॥
Transliteration: ein te kahahu tum kavan sanaathaa |
English: who of these shall accompany you?

Gurbani: ਰਾਜ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਇਆ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: raaj rang maaeaa bisathaar |
English: Power, pleasure, and the vast expanse of Maya

Gurbani: ਇਨ ਤੇ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਵਨ ਛੁਟਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: ein te kahahu kavan chhuttakaar |
English: who has ever escaped from these?

Gurbani: ਅਸੁ ਹਸਤੀ ਰਥ ਅਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: as hasatee rath asavaaree |
English: Horses, elephants, chariots and pageantry

Gurbani: ਝੂਠਾ ਡੰਫੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਪਾਸਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jhootthaa ddanf jhootth paasaaree |
English: - false shows and false displays.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਬੁਝੈ ਨ ਬਿਗਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jin dee tis bujhai na bigaanaa |
English: The fool does not acknowledge the One who gave this;

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਛੁਤਾਨਾ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: naam bisaar naanak pachhutaanaa |5|
English: forgetting the Naam, O Nanak, he will repent in the end. ||5||

[Ang 288 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਤੂੰ ਲੇਹਿ ਇਆਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur kee mat toon lehi eaane |
English: Take the Guru's advice, you ignorant fool;

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਬਿਨਾ ਬਹੁ ਡੂਬੇ ਸਿਆਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat binaa bahu ddoobe siaane |
English: without devotion, even the clever have drowned.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: har kee bhagat karahu man meet |
English: Worship the Lord with heart-felt devotion, my friend;

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਇ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੋ ਚੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: niramal hoe tumaaro cheet |
English: your consciousness shall become pure.

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal raakhahu man maeh |
English: Enshrine the Lord's Lotus Feet in your mind;

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: janam janam ke kilabikh jaeh |
English: the sins of countless lifetimes shall depart.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਜਪਹੁ ਅਵਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: aap japahu avaraa naam japaavahu |
English: Chant the Naam yourself, and inspire others to chant it as well.

Gurbani: ਸੁਨਤ ਕਹਤ ਰਹਤ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: sunat kehat rehat gat paavahu |
English: Hearing, speaking and living it, emancipation is obtained.

Gurbani: ਸਾਰ ਭੂਤ ਸਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saar bhoot sat har ko naau |
English: The essential reality is the True Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: sehaj subhaae naanak gun gaau |6|
English: With intuitive ease, O Nanak, sing His Glorious Praises. ||6||

[Ang 289 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਤੇਰੀ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਮੈਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: gun gaavat teree utaras mail |
English: Chanting His Glories, your filth shall be washed off.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਫੈਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: binas jaae haumai bikh fail |
English: The all-consuming poison of ego will be gone.

Gurbani: ਹੋਹਿ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਬਸੈ ਸੁਖ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: hohi achint basai sukh naal |
English: You shall become carefree, and you shall dwell in peace.

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਿ ਗ੍ਰਾਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: saas graas har naam samaal |
English: With every breath and every morsel of food, cherish the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਛਾਡਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਸਗਲੀ ਮਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: chhaadd siaanap sagalee manaa |
English: Renounce all clever tricks, O mind.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਧਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang paaveh sach dhanaa |
English: In the Company of the Holy, you shall obtain the true wealth.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸੰਚਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: har poonjee sanch karahu biauhaar |
English: So gather the Lord's Name as your capital, and trade in it.

Gurbani: ਈਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: eehaa sukh daragah jaikaar |
English: In this world you shall be at peace, and in the Court of the Lord, you shall be acclaimed.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਦੇਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: sarab nirantar eko dekh |
English: See the One permeating all;

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak jaa kai masatak lekh |7|
English: says Nanak, your destiny is pre-ordained. ||7||

[Ang 289 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਜਪਿ ਏਕੋ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: eko jap eko saalaeh |
English: Meditate on the One, and worship the One.

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਮਨ ਆਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: ek simar eko man aaeh |
English: Remember the One, and yearn for the One in your mind.

Gurbani: ਏਕਸ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ਅਨੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: ekas ke gun gaau anant |
English: Sing the endless Glorious Praises of the One.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਜਾਪਿ ਏਕ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: man tan jaap ek bhagavant |
English: With mind and body, meditate on the One Lord God.

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਏਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: eko ek ek har aap |
English: The One Lord Himself is the One and Only.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਿਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: pooran poor rahio prabh biaap |
English: The Pervading Lord God is totally permeating all.

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ਏਕ ਤੇ ਭਏ ॥
Transliteration: anik bisathaar ek te bhe |
English: The many expanses of the creation have all come from the One.

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਪਰਾਛਤ ਗਏ ॥
Transliteration: ek araadh paraachhat ge |
English: Adoring the One, past sins are removed.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: man tan antar ek prabh raataa |
English: Mind and body within are imbued with the One God.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਕੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੮॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad naanak ik jaataa |8|19|
English: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, the One is known. ||8||19||

[Ang 289 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਫਿਰਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਇਆ ਪਰਿਆ ਤਉ ਸਰਨਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: firat firat prabh aaeaa pariaa tau saranaae |
English: After wandering and wandering, O God, I have come, and entered Your Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਅਪਨੀ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak kee prabh benatee apanee bhagatee laae |1|
English: This is Nanak's prayer, O God: please, attach me to Your devotional service. ||1||

[Ang 289 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
Transliteration: asattapadee |
English: Ashtapadee:

Gurbani: ਜਾਚਕ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: jaachak jan jaachai prabh daan |
English: I am a beggar; I beg for this gift from You:

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa devahu har naam |
English: please, by Your Mercy, Lord, give me Your Name.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਮਾਗਉ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: saadh janaa kee maagau dhoor |
English: I ask for the dust of the feet of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮੇਰੀ ਸਰਧਾ ਪੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham meree saradhaa poor |
English: O Supreme Lord God, please fulfill my yearning;

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa prabh ke gun gaavau |
English: may I sing the Glorious Praises of God forever and ever.

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: saas saas prabh tumeh dhiaavau |
English: With each and every breath, may I meditate on You, O God.

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal siau laagai preet |
English: May I enshrine affection for Your Lotus Feet.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਨਿਤ ਨੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat krau prabh kee nit neet |
English: May I perform devotional worship to God each and every day.

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਓਟ ਏਕੋ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: ek ott eko aadhaar |
English: You are my only Shelter, my only Support.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak maagai naam prabh saar |1|
English: Nanak asks for the most sublime, the Naam, the Name of God. ||1||

[Ang 289 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kee drisatt mahaa sukh hoe |
English: By God's Gracious Glance, there is great peace.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਬਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: har ras paavai biralaa koe |
English: Rare are those who obtain the juice of the Lord's essence.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: jin chaakhiaa se jan tripataane |
English: Those who taste it are satisfied.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਨਹੀ ਡੋਲਾਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: pooran purakh nahee ddolaane |
English: They are fulfilled and realized beings - they do not waver.

Gurbani: ਸੁਭਰ ਭਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: subhar bhare prem ras rang |
English: They are totally filled to over-flowing with the sweet delight of His Love.

Gurbani: ਉਪਜੈ ਚਾਉ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: aupajai chaau saadh kai sang |
English: Spiritual delight wells up within, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਪਰੇ ਸਰਨਿ ਆਨ ਸਭ ਤਿਆਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: pare saran aan sabh tiaag |
English: Taking to His Sanctuary, they forsake all others.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: antar pragaas anadin liv laag |
English: Deep within, they are enlightened, and they center themselves on Him, day and night.

Gurbani: ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਪਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: baddabhaagee japiaa prabh soe |
English: Most fortunate are those who meditate on God.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naam rate sukh hoe |2|
English: O Nanak, attuned to the Naam, they are at peace. ||2||

[Ang 289 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰੀ ਭਈ ॥
Transliteration: sevak kee manasaa pooree bhee |
English: The wishes of the Lord's servant are fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮਤਿ ਲਈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur te niramal mat lee |
English: From the True Guru, the pure teachings are obtained.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੋਇਓ ਦਇਆਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: jan kau prabh hoeo deaal |
English: Unto His humble servant, God has shown His kindness.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਕੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: sevak keeno sadaa nihaal |
English: He has made His servant eternally happy.

Gurbani: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜਨੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bandhan kaatt mukat jan bheaa |
English: The bonds of His humble servant are cut away, and he is liberated.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੂਖੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: janam maran dookh bhram geaa |
English: The pains of birth and death, and doubt are gone.

Gurbani: ਇਛ ਪੁਨੀ ਸਰਧਾ ਸਭ ਪੂਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: eichh punee saradhaa sabh pooree |
English: Desires are satisfied, and faith is fully rewarded,

Gurbani: ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਦ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਜੂਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: rav rahiaa sad sang hajooree |
English: imbued forever with His all-pervading peace.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਲੀਆ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jis kaa saa tin leea milaae |
English: He is His - he merges in Union with Him.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak bhagatee naam samaae |3|
English: Nanak is absorbed in devotional worship of the Naam. ||3||

[Ang 289 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਜਿ ਘਾਲ ਨ ਭਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: so kiau bisarai ji ghaal na bhaanai |
English: Why forget Him, who does not overlook our efforts?

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਜਿ ਕੀਆ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: so kiau bisarai ji keea jaanai |
English: Why forget Him, who acknowledges what we do?

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: so kiau bisarai jin sabh kichh deea |
English: Why forget Him, who has given us everything?

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਜਿ ਜੀਵਨ ਜੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: so kiau bisarai ji jeevan jeea |
English: Why forget Him, who is the Life of the living beings?

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਜਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: so kiau bisarai ji agan meh raakhai |
English: Why forget Him, who preserves us in the fire of the womb?

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਕੋ ਬਿਰਲਾ ਲਾਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad ko biralaa laakhai |
English: By Guru's Grace, rare is the one who realizes this.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਜਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਤੇ ਕਾਢੈ ॥
Transliteration: so kiau bisarai ji bikh te kaadtai |
English: Why forget Him, who lifts us up out of corruption?

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਟੂਟਾ ਗਾਢੈ ॥
Transliteration: janam janam kaa ttoottaa gaadtai |
English: Those separated from Him for countless lifetimes, are re-united with Him once again.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਤਤੁ ਇਹੈ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur poorai tat ihai bujhaaeaa |
English: Through the Perfect Guru, this essential reality is understood.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: prabh apanaa naanak jan dhiaaeaa |4|
English: O Nanak, God's humble servants meditate on Him. ||4||

[Ang 290 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਜਨ ਸੰਤ ਕਰਹੁ ਇਹੁ ਕਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: saajan sant karahu ihu kaam |
English: O friends, O Saints, make this your work.

Gurbani: ਆਨ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਜਪਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: aan tiaag japahu har naam |
English: Renounce everything else, and chant the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: simar simar simar sukh paavahu |
English: Meditate, meditate, meditate in remembrance of Him, and find peace.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਜਪਹੁ ਅਵਰਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: aap japahu avarah naam japaavahu |
English: Chant the Naam yourself, and inspire others to chant it.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਤਰੀਐ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat bhaae tareeai sansaar |
English: By loving devotional worship, you shall cross over the world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਸੀ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: bin bhagatee tan hosee chhaar |
English: Without devotional meditation, the body will be just ashes.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਸੂਖ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: sarab kaliaan sookh nidh naam |
English: All joys and comforts are in the treasure of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਬੂਡਤ ਜਾਤ ਪਾਏ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: booddat jaat paae bisraam |
English: Even the drowning can reach the place of rest and safety.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਦੂਖ ਕਾ ਹੋਵਤ ਨਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: sagal dookh kaa hovat naas |
English: All sorrows shall vanish.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਗੁਨਤਾਸੁ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak naam japahu gunataas |5|
English: O Nanak, chant the Naam, the treasure of excellence. ||5||

[Ang 290 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਉਪਜੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aupajee preet prem ras chaau |
English: Love and affection, and the taste of yearning, have welled up within;

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਇਹੀ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
Transliteration: man tan antar ihee suaau |
English: within my mind and body, this is my purpose:

Gurbani: ਨੇਤ੍ਰਹੁ ਪੇਖਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: netrahu pekh daras sukh hoe |
English: beholding with my eyes His Blessed Vision, I am at peace.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਸਾਧ ਚਰਨ ਧੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: man bigasai saadh charan dhoe |
English: My mind blossoms forth in ecstasy, washing the feet of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat janaa kai man tan rang |
English: The minds and bodies of His devotees are infused with His Love.

Gurbani: ਬਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਊ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: biralaa koaoo paavai sang |
English: Rare is the one who obtains their company.

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਬਸਤੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਕਰਿ ਮਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: ek basat deejai kar meaa |
English: Show Your mercy - please, grant me this one request:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad naam jap leaa |
English: by Guru's Grace, may I chant the Naam.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: taa kee upamaa kahee na jaae |
English: His Praises cannot be spoken;

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: naanak rahiaa sarab samaae |6|
English: O Nanak, He is contained among all. ||6||

[Ang 290 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਖਸੰਦ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
Transliteration: prabh bakhasand deen deaal |
English: God, the Forgiving Lord, is kind to the poor.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਸਦਾ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat vachhal sadaa kirapaal |
English: He loves His devotees, and He is always merciful to them.

Gurbani: ਅਨਾਥ ਨਾਥ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: anaath naath gobind gupaal |
English: The Patron of the patronless, the Lord of the Universe, the Sustainer of the world,

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਘਟਾ ਕਰਤ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: sarab ghattaa karat pratipaal |
English: the Nourisher of all beings.

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: aad purakh kaaran karataar |
English: The Primal Being, the Creator of the Creation.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat janaa ke praan adhaar |
English: The Support of the breath of life of His devotees.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਜਪੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਪੁਨੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: jo jo japai su hoe puneet |
English: Whoever meditates on Him is sanctified,

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਲਾਵੈ ਮਨ ਹੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat bhaae laavai man heet |
English: focusing the mind in loving devotional worship.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਨਿਰਗੁਨੀਆਰ ਨੀਚ ਅਜਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: ham niraguneeaar neech ajaan |
English: I am unworthy, lowly and ignorant.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: naanak tumaree saran purakh bhagavaan |7|
English: Nanak has entered Your Sanctuary, O Supreme Lord God. ||7||

[Ang 290 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਮੋਖ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sarab baikuntth mukat mokh paae |
English: Everything is obtained: the heavens, liberation and deliverance,

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: ek nimakh har ke gun gaae |
English: if one sings the Lord's Glories, even for an instant.

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਰਾਜ ਭੋਗ ਬਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: anik raaj bhog baddiaaee |
English: So many realms of power, pleasures and great glories,

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har ke naam kee kathaa man bhaaee |
English: come to one whose mind is pleased with the Sermon of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਬਹੁ ਭੋਜਨ ਕਾਪਰ ਸੰਗੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: bahu bhojan kaapar sangeet |
English: Abundant foods, clothes and music

Gurbani: ਰਸਨਾ ਜਪਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: rasanaa japatee har har neet |
English: come to one whose tongue continually chants the Lord's Name, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਭਲੀ ਸੁ ਕਰਨੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਧਨਵੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: bhalee su karanee sobhaa dhanavant |
English: His actions are good, he is glorious and wealthy;

Gurbani: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਸੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: hiradai base pooran gur mant |
English: the Mantra of the Perfect Guru dwells within his heart.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਹੁ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang prabh dehu nivaas |
English: O God, grant me a home in the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰਗਾਸ ॥੮॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: sarab sookh naanak paragaas |8|20|
English: All pleasures, O Nanak, are so revealed. ||8||20||

[Ang 290 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਸਰਗੁਨ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧੀ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: saragun niragun nirankaar sun samaadhee aap |
English: He possesses all qualities; He transcends all qualities; He is the Formless Lord. He Himself is in Primal Samaadhi.

Gurbani: ਆਪਨ ਕੀਆ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aapan keea naanakaa aape hee fir jaap |1|
English: Through His Creation, O Nanak, He meditates on Himself. ||1||

[Ang 290 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
Transliteration: asattapadee |
English: Ashtapadee:

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਅਕਾਰੁ ਇਹੁ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੇਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: jab akaar ihu kachh na drisattetaa |
English: When this world had not yet appeared in any form,

Gurbani: ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਤਬ ਕਹ ਤੇ ਹੋਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: paap pun tab keh te hotaa |
English: who then committed sins and performed good deeds?

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਧਾਰੀ ਆਪਨ ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ॥
Transliteration: jab dhaaree aapan sun samaadh |
English: When the Lord Himself was in Profound Samaadhi,

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਬੈਰ ਬਿਰੋਧ ਕਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਮਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: tab bair birodh kis sang kamaat |
English: then against whom were hate and jealousy directed?

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਇਸ ਕਾ ਬਰਨੁ ਚਿਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਪਤ ॥
Transliteration: jab is kaa baran chihan na jaapat |
English: When there was no color or shape to be seen,

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਸਹਿ ਬਿਆਪਤ ॥
Transliteration: tab harakh sog kahu kiseh biaapat |
English: then who experienced joy and sorrow?

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਆਪਨ ਆਪ ਆਪਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ॥
Transliteration: jab aapan aap aap paarabraham |
English: When the Supreme Lord Himself was Himself All-in-all,

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਮੋਹ ਕਹਾ ਕਿਸੁ ਹੋਵਤ ਭਰਮ ॥
Transliteration: tab moh kahaa kis hovat bharam |
English: then where was emotional attachment, and who had doubts?

Gurbani: ਆਪਨ ਖੇਲੁ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤੀਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: aapan khel aap varateejaa |
English: He Himself has staged His own drama;

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak karanaihaar na doojaa |1|
English: O Nanak, there is no other Creator. ||1||

[Ang 291 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜਬ ਹੋਵਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਵਲ ਧਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: jab hovat prabh keval dhanee |
English: When there was only God the Master,

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਬੰਧ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਗਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: tab bandh mukat kahu kis kau ganee |
English: then who was called bound or liberated?

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਏਕਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: jab ekeh har agam apaar |
English: When there was only the Lord, Unfathomable and Infinite,

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਨਰਕ ਸੁਰਗ ਕਹੁ ਕਉਨ ਅਉਤਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: tab narak surag kahu kaun aautaar |
English: then who entered hell, and who entered heaven?

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jab niragun prabh sehaj subhaae |
English: When God was without attributes, in absolute poise,

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤਿ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਠਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: tab siv sakat kahahu kit tthaae |
English: then where was mind and where was matter - where was Shiva and Shakti?

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਆਪਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਅਪਨੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਧਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: jab aapeh aap apanee jot dharai |
English: When He held His Own Light unto Himself,

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਕਵਨ ਨਿਡਰੁ ਕਵਨ ਕਤ ਡਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: tab kavan niddar kavan kat ddarai |
English: then who was fearless, and who was afraid?

Gurbani: ਆਪਨ ਚਲਿਤ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: aapan chalit aap karanaihaar |
English: He Himself is the Performer in His own plays;

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak tthaakur agam apaar |2|
English: O Nanak, the Lord Master is Unfathomable and Infinite. ||2||

[Ang 291 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਸੁਖ ਆਪਨ ਆਸਨ ॥
Transliteration: abinaasee sukh aapan aasan |
English: When the Immortal Lord was seated at ease,

Gurbani: ਤਹ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕਹੁ ਕਹਾ ਬਿਨਾਸਨ ॥
Transliteration: teh janam maran kahu kahaa binaasan |
English: then where was birth, death and dissolution?

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਰਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jab pooran karataa prabh soe |
English: When there was only God, the Perfect Creator,

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: tab jam kee traas kahahu kis hoe |
English: then who was afraid of death?

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਅਬਿਗਤ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕਾ ॥
Transliteration: jab abigat agochar prabh ekaa |
English: When there was only the One Lord, unmanifest and incomprehensible,

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਪਤ ਕਿਸੁ ਪੂਛਤ ਲੇਖਾ ॥
Transliteration: tab chitr gupat kis poochhat lekhaa |
English: then who was called to account by the recording scribes of the conscious and the subconscious?

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਨਾਥ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਅਗਾਧੇ ॥
Transliteration: jab naath niranjan agochar agaadhe |
English: When there was only the Immaculate, Incomprehensible, Unfathomable Master,

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਕਉਨ ਛੁਟੇ ਕਉਨ ਬੰਧਨ ਬਾਧੇ ॥
Transliteration: tab kaun chhutte kaun bandhan baadhe |
English: then who was emancipated, and who was held in bondage?

Gurbani: ਆਪਨ ਆਪ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਅਚਰਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: aapan aap aap hee acharajaa |
English: He Himself, in and of Himself, is the most wonderful.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਨ ਰੂਪ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਉਪਰਜਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak aapan roop aap hee uparajaa |3|
English: O Nanak, He Himself created His Own Form. ||3||

[Ang 291 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜਹ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeh niramal purakh purakh pat hotaa |
English: When there was only the Immaculate Being, the Lord of beings,

Gurbani: ਤਹ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਧੋਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: teh bin mail kahahu kiaa dhotaa |
English: there was no filth, so what was there to be washed clean?

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਨਿਰਬਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: jeh niranjan nirankaar nirabaan |
English: When there was only the Pure, Formless Lord in Nirvaanaa,

Gurbani: ਤਹ ਕਉਨ ਕਉ ਮਾਨ ਕਉਨ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: teh kaun kau maan kaun abhimaan |
English: then who was honored, and who was dishonored?

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਸਰੂਪ ਕੇਵਲ ਜਗਦੀਸ ॥
Transliteration: jeh saroop keval jagadees |
English: When there was only the Form of the Lord of the Universe,

Gurbani: ਤਹ ਛਲ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਲਗਤ ਕਹੁ ਕੀਸ ॥
Transliteration: teh chhal chhidr lagat kahu kees |
English: then who was tainted by fraud and sin?

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jeh jot saroopee jot sang samaavai |
English: When the Embodiment of Light was immersed in His Own Light,

Gurbani: ਤਹ ਕਿਸਹਿ ਭੂਖ ਕਵਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: teh kiseh bhookh kavan tripataavai |
English: then who was hungry, and who was satisfied?

Gurbani: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: karan karaavan karanaihaar |
English: He is the Cause of causes, the Creator Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਾ ਨਾਹਿ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak karate kaa naeh sumaar |4|
English: O Nanak, the Creator is beyond calculation. ||4||

[Ang 291 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜਬ ਅਪਨੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਆਪਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਨਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jab apanee sobhaa aapan sang banaaee |
English: When His Glory was contained within Himself,

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਕਵਨ ਮਾਇ ਬਾਪ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਤ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: tab kavan maae baap mitr sut bhaaee |
English: then who was mother, father, friend, child or sibling?

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਆਪਹਿ ਪਰਬੀਨ ॥
Transliteration: jeh sarab kalaa aapeh parabeen |
English: When all power and wisdom was latent within Him,

Gurbani: ਤਹ ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਕਹਾ ਕੋਊ ਚੀਨ ॥
Transliteration: teh bed kateb kahaa koaoo cheen |
English: then where were the Vedas and the scriptures, and who was there to read them?

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਆਪਨ ਆਪੁ ਆਪਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: jab aapan aap aap ur dhaarai |
English: When He kept Himself, All-in-all, unto His Own Heart,

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਸਗਨ ਅਪਸਗਨ ਕਹਾ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: tau sagan apasagan kahaa beechaarai |
English: then who considered omens to be good or bad?

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਆਪਨ ਊਚ ਆਪਨ ਆਪਿ ਨੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeh aapan aooch aapan aap neraa |
English: When He Himself was lofty, and He Himself was near at hand,

Gurbani: ਤਹ ਕਉਨ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਚੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: teh kaun tthaakur kaun kaheeai cheraa |
English: then who was called master, and who was called disciple?

Gurbani: ਬਿਸਮਨ ਬਿਸਮ ਰਹੇ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥
Transliteration: bisaman bisam rahe bisamaad |
English: We are wonder-struck at the wondrous wonder of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਪਨੀ ਗਤਿ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਆਪਿ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak apanee gat jaanahu aap |5|
English: O Nanak, He alone knows His own state. ||5||

[Ang 291 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜਹ ਅਛਲ ਅਛੇਦ ਅਭੇਦ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jeh achhal achhed abhed samaaeaa |
English: When the Undeceiveable, Impenetrable, Inscrutable One was self-absorbed,

Gurbani: ਊਹਾ ਕਿਸਹਿ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aoohaa kiseh biaapat maaeaa |
English: then who was swayed by Maya?

Gurbani: ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਆਪਹਿ ਆਦੇਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: aapas kau aapeh aades |
English: When He paid homage to Himself,

Gurbani: ਤਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਕਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਰਵੇਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: tihu gun kaa naahee paraves |
English: then the three qualities were not prevailing.

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਏਕਹਿ ਏਕ ਏਕ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeh ekeh ek ek bhagavantaa |
English: When there was only the One, the One and Only Lord God,

Gurbani: ਤਹ ਕਉਨੁ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਚਿੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: teh kaun achint kis laagai chintaa |
English: then who was not anxious, and who felt anxiety?

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਆਪਨ ਆਪੁ ਆਪਿ ਪਤੀਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeh aapan aap aap pateeaaraa |
English: When He Himself was satisfied with Himself,

Gurbani: ਤਹ ਕਉਨੁ ਕਥੈ ਕਉਨੁ ਸੁਨਨੈਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: teh kaun kathai kaun sunanaihaaraa |
English: then who spoke and who listened?

Gurbani: ਬਹੁ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਊਚ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ॥
Transliteration: bahu beant aooch te aoochaa |
English: He is vast and infinite, the highest of the high.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਆਪਹਿ ਪਹੂਚਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: naanak aapas kau aapeh pahoochaa |6|
English: O Nanak, He alone can reach Himself. ||6||

[Ang 291 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜਹ ਆਪਿ ਰਚਿਓ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਅਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jeh aap rachio parapanch akaar |
English: When He Himself fashioned the visible world of the creation,

Gurbani: ਤਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਕੀਨੋ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: tihu gun meh keeno bisathaar |
English: he made the world subject to the three dispositions.

Gurbani: ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਤਹ ਭਈ ਕਹਾਵਤ ॥
Transliteration: paap pun teh bhee kahaavat |
English: Sin and virtue then began to be spoken of.

Gurbani: ਕੋਊ ਨਰਕ ਕੋਊ ਸੁਰਗ ਬੰਛਾਵਤ ॥
Transliteration: koaoo narak koaoo surag banchhaavat |
English: Some have gone to hell, and some yearn for paradise.

Gurbani: ਆਲ ਜਾਲ ਮਾਇਆ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: aal jaal maaeaa janjaal |
English: Worldly snares and entanglements of Maya,

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੋਹ ਭਰਮ ਭੈ ਭਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: haumai moh bharam bhai bhaar |
English: egotism, attachment, doubt and loads of fear;

Gurbani: ਦੂਖ ਸੂਖ ਮਾਨ ਅਪਮਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: dookh sookh maan apamaan |
English: pain and pleasure, honor and dishonor

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਕੀਓ ਬਖੵਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: anik prakaar keeo bakhayaan |
English: these came to be described in various ways.

Gurbani: ਆਪਨ ਖੇਲੁ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: aapan khel aap kar dekhai |
English: He Himself creates and beholds His own drama.

Gurbani: ਖੇਲੁ ਸੰਕੋਚੈ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੈ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: khel sankochai tau naanak ekai |7|
English: He winds up the drama, and then, O Nanak, He alone remains. ||7||

[Ang 292 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜਹ ਅਬਿਗਤੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਤਹ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: jeh abigat bhagat teh aap |
English: Wherever the Eternal Lord's devotee is, He Himself is there.

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਪਸਰੈ ਪਾਸਾਰੁ ਸੰਤ ਪਰਤਾਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: jeh pasarai paasaar sant parataap |
English: He unfolds the expanse of His creation for the glory of His Saint.

Gurbani: ਦੁਹੂ ਪਾਖ ਕਾ ਆਪਹਿ ਧਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: duhoo paakh kaa aapeh dhanee |
English: He Himself is the Master of both worlds.

Gurbani: ਉਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਉਨਹੂ ਬਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: aun kee sobhaa unahoo banee |
English: His Praise is to Himself alone.

Gurbani: ਆਪਹਿ ਕਉਤਕ ਕਰੈ ਅਨਦ ਚੋਜ ॥
Transliteration: aapeh kautak karai anad choj |
English: He Himself performs and plays His amusements and games.

Gurbani: ਆਪਹਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਨ ਨਿਰਜੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: aapeh ras bhogan nirajog |
English: He Himself enjoys pleasures, and yet He is unaffected and untouched.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਪਨ ਨਾਇ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jis bhaavai tis aapan naae laavai |
English: He attaches whomever He pleases to His Name.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਖੇਲ ਖਿਲਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jis bhaavai tis khel khilaavai |
English: He causes whomever He pleases to play in His play.

Gurbani: ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ ਅਥਾਹ ਅਗਨਤ ਅਤੋਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: besumaar athaah aganat atolai |
English: He is beyond calculation, beyond measure, uncountable and unfathomable.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਬੁਲਾਵਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਬੋਲੈ ॥੮॥੨੧॥
Transliteration: jiau bulaavahu tiau naanak daas bolai |8|21|
English: As You inspire him to speak, O Lord, so does servant Nanak speak. ||8||21||

[Ang 292 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਕੇ ਠਾਕੁਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਵਰਤਣਹਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jant ke tthaakuraa aape varatanahaar |
English: O Lord and Master of all beings and creatures, You Yourself are prevailing everywhere.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੋ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਕਹ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak eko pasariaa doojaa keh drisattaar |1|
English: O Nanak, The One is All-pervading; where is any other to be seen? ||1||

[Ang 292 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
Transliteration: asattapadee |
English: Ashtapadee:

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਕਥੈ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਨਨੈਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: aap kathai aap sunanaihaar |
English: He Himself is the speaker, and He Himself is the listener.

Gurbani: ਆਪਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਆਪਿ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: aapeh ek aap bisathaar |
English: He Himself is the One, and He Himself is the many.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jaa tis bhaavai taa srisatt upaae |
English: When it pleases Him, He creates the world.

Gurbani: ਆਪਨੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਲਏ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aapanai bhaanai le samaae |
English: As He pleases, He absorbs it back into Himself.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਭਿੰਨ ਨਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: tum te bhin nahee kichh hoe |
English: Without You, nothing can be done.

Gurbani: ਆਪਨ ਸੂਤਿ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਪਰੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aapan soot sabh jagat paroe |
English: Upon Your thread, You have strung the whole world.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kau prabh jeeo aap bujhaae |
English: One whom God Himself inspires to understand

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sach naam soee jan paae |
English: - that person obtains the True Name.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਤਤ ਕਾ ਬੇਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: so samadarasee tat kaa betaa |
English: He looks impartially upon all, and he knows the essential reality.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਗਲ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਾ ਜੇਤਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak sagal srisatt kaa jetaa |1|
English: O Nanak, he conquers the whole world. ||1||

[Ang 292 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਸਭ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਹਾਥ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jantr sabh taa kai haath |
English: All beings and creatures are in His Hands.

Gurbani: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਅਨਾਥ ਕੋ ਨਾਥੁ ॥
Transliteration: deen deaal anaath ko naath |
English: He is Merciful to the meek, the Patron of the patronless.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: jis raakhai tis koe na maarai |
English: No one can kill those who are protected by Him.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਮੂਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਬਿਸਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: so mooaa jis manahu bisaarai |
English: One who is forgotten by God, is already dead.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਤਜਿ ਅਵਰ ਕਹਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: tis taj avar kahaa ko jaae |
English: Leaving Him, where else could anyone go?

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਸਿਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਰਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabh sir ek niranjan raae |
English: Over the heads of all is the One, the Immaculate King.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਭ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
Transliteration: jeea kee jugat jaa kai sabh haath |
English: The ways and means of all beings are in His Hands.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
Transliteration: antar baahar jaanahu saath |
English: Inwardly and outwardly, know that He is with you.

Gurbani: ਗੁਨ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: gun nidhaan beant apaar |
English: He is the Ocean of excellence, infinite and endless.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਦਾ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak daas sadaa balihaar |2|
English: Slave Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||

[Ang 292 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
Transliteration: pooran poor rahe deaal |
English: The Perfect, Merciful Lord is pervading everywhere.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਹੋਵਤ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: sabh aoopar hovat kirapaal |
English: His kindness extends to all.

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੇ ਕਰਤਬ ਜਾਨੈ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: apane karatab jaanai aap |
English: He Himself knows His own ways.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਰਹਿਓ ਬਿਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: antarajaamee rahio biaap |
English: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is present everywhere.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੈ ਜੀਅਨ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: pratipaalai jeean bahu bhaat |
English: He cherishes His living beings in so many ways.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਰਚਿਓ ਸੁ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: jo jo rachio su tiseh dhiaat |
English: That which He has created meditates on Him.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jis bhaavai tis le milaae |
English: Whoever pleases Him, He blends into Himself.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat kareh har ke gun gaae |
English: They perform His devotional service and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: man antar bisvaas kar maaniaa |
English: With heart-felt faith, they believe in Him.

Gurbani: ਕਰਨਹਾਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਕੁ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: karanahaar naanak ik jaaniaa |3|
English: O Nanak, they realize the One, the Creator Lord. ||3||

[Ang 292 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੈ ਨਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jan laagaa har ekai naae |
English: The Lord's humble servant is committed to His Name.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਨ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: tis kee aas na birathee jaae |
English: His hopes do not go in vain.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: sevak kau sevaa ban aaee |
English: The servant's purpose is to serve;

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੂਝਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: hukam boojh param pad paaee |
English: obeying the Lord's Command, the supreme status is obtained.

Gurbani: ਇਸ ਤੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: eis te aoopar nahee beechaar |
English: Beyond this, he has no other thought.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਬਸਿਆ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai man basiaa nirankaar |
English: Within his mind, the Formless Lord abides.

Gurbani: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋਰਿ ਭਏ ਨਿਰਵੈਰ ॥
Transliteration: bandhan tor bhe niravair |
English: His bonds are cut away, and he becomes free of hatred.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਪੂਜਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਪੈਰ ॥
Transliteration: anadin poojeh gur ke pair |
English: Night and day, he worships the Feet of the Guru.

Gurbani: ਇਹ ਲੋਕ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਪਰਲੋਕ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: eih lok sukhee paralok suhele |
English: He is at peace in this world, and happy in the next.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਹਿ ਮੇਲੇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak har prabh aapeh mele |4|
English: O Nanak, the Lord God unites him with Himself. ||4||

[Ang 293 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang mil karahu anand |
English: Join the Company of the Holy, and be happy.

Gurbani: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: gun gaavahu prabh paramaanand |
English: Sing the Glories of God, the embodiment of supreme bliss.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਤਤੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam tat karahu beechaar |
English: Contemplate the essence of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਦ੍ਰੁਲਭ ਦੇਹ ਕਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: drulabh deh kaa karahu udhaar |
English: Redeem this human body, so difficult to obtain.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਚਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: amrit bachan har ke gun gaau |
English: Sing the Ambrosial Words of the Lord's Glorious Praises;

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਤਰਨ ਕਾ ਇਹੈ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
Transliteration: praan taran kaa ihai suaau |
English: this is the way to save your mortal soul.

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੇਖਹੁ ਨੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar prabh pekhahu neraa |
English: Behold God near at hand, twenty-four hours a day.

Gurbani: ਮਿਟੈ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: mittai agiaan binasai andheraa |
English: Ignorance shall depart, and darkness shall be dispelled.

Gurbani: ਸੁਨਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਸਾਵਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: sun upades hiradai basaavahu |
English: Listen to the Teachings, and enshrine them in your heart.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: man ichhe naanak fal paavahu |5|
English: O Nanak, you shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires. ||5||

[Ang 293 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਦੁਇ ਲੇਹੁ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: halat palat due lehu savaar |
English: Embellish both this world and the next;

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam antar ur dhaar |
English: enshrine the Lord's Name deep within your heart.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਦੀਖਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: poore gur kee pooree deekhiaa |
English: Perfect are the Teachings of the Perfect Guru.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਰੀਖਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jis man basai tis saach pareekhiaa |
English: That person, within whose mind it abides, realizes the Truth.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man tan naam japahu liv laae |
English: With your mind and body, chant the Naam; lovingly attune yourself to it.

Gurbani: ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਭਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: dookh darad man te bhau jaae |
English: Sorrow, pain and fear shall depart from your mind.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: sach vaapaar karahu vaapaaree |
English: Deal in the true trade, O trader,

Gurbani: ਦਰਗਹ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਖੇਪ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: daragah nibahai khep tumaaree |
English: and your merchandise shall be safe in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਏਕਾ ਟੇਕ ਰਖਹੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: ekaa ttek rakhahu man maeh |
English: Keep the Support of the One in your mind.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: naanak bahur na aaveh jaeh |6|
English: O Nanak, you shall not have to come and go in reincarnation again. ||6||

[Ang 293 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਹਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: tis te door kahaa ko jaae |
English: Where can anyone go, to get away from Him?

Gurbani: ਉਬਰੈ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: aubarai raakhanahaar dhiaae |
English: Meditating on the Protector Lord, you shall be saved.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਜਪੈ ਸਗਲ ਭਉ ਮਿਟੈ ॥
Transliteration: nirbhau japai sagal bhau mittai |
English: Meditating on the Fearless Lord, all fear departs.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਛੁਟੈ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kirapaa te praanee chhuttai |
English: By God's Grace, mortals are released.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੂਖ ॥
Transliteration: jis prabh raakhai tis naahee dookh |
English: One who is protected by God never suffers in pain.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਵਤ ਸੂਖ ॥
Transliteration: naam japat man hovat sookh |
English: Chanting the Naam, the mind becomes peaceful.

Gurbani: ਚਿੰਤਾ ਜਾਇ ਮਿਟੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: chintaa jaae mittai ahankaar |
English: Anxiety departs, and ego is eliminated.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਹੁਚਨਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: tis jan kau koe na pahuchanahaar |
English: No one can equal that humble servant.

Gurbani: ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਠਾਢਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੂਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sir aoopar tthaadtaa gur sooraa |
English: The Brave and Powerful Guru stands over his head.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਪੂਰਾ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: naanak taa ke kaaraj pooraa |7|
English: O Nanak, his efforts are fulfilled. ||7||

[Ang 293 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ॥
Transliteration: mat pooree amrit jaa kee drisatt |
English: His wisdom is perfect, and His Glance is Ambrosial.

Gurbani: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਤ ਉਧਰਤ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ॥
Transliteration: darasan pekhat udharat srisatt |
English: Beholding His Vision, the universe is saved.

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਅਨੂਪ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal jaa ke anoop |
English: His Lotus Feet are incomparably beautiful.

Gurbani: ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਹਰਿ ਰੂਪ ॥
Transliteration: safal darasan sundar har roop |
English: The Blessed Vision of His Darshan is fruitful and rewarding; His Lordly Form is beautiful.

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: dhan sevaa sevak paravaan |
English: Blessed is His service; His servant is famous.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: antarajaamee purakh pradhaan |
English: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is the most exalted Supreme Being.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਤ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: jis man basai su hot nihaal |
English: That one, within whose mind He abides, is blissfully happy.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਤ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: taa kai nikatt na aavat kaal |
English: Death does not draw near him.

Gurbani: ਅਮਰ ਭਏ ਅਮਰਾ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: amar bhe amaraa pad paaeaa |
English: One becomes immortal, and obtains the immortal status,

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੮॥੨੨॥
Transliteration: saadhasang naanak har dhiaaeaa |8|22|
English: meditating on the Lord, O Nanak, in the Company of the Holy. ||8||22||

[Ang 293 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧੇਰ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: giaan anjan gur deea agiaan andher binaas |
English: The Guru has given the healing ointment of spiritual wisdom, and dispelled the darkness of ignorance.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har kirapaa te sant bhettiaa naanak man paragaas |1|
English: By the Lord's Grace, I have met the Saint; O Nanak, my mind is enlightened. ||1||

[Ang 293 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
Transliteration: asattapadee |
English: Ashtapadee:

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਡੀਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: santasang antar prabh ddeetthaa |
English: In the Society of the Saints, I see God deep within my being.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕਾ ਲਾਗਾ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: naam prabhoo kaa laagaa meetthaa |
English: God's Name is sweet to me.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਿਗ੍ਰੀ ਏਕਸੁ ਘਟ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: sagal samigree ekas ghatt maeh |
English: All things are contained in the Heart of the One,

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਰੰਗ ਨਾਨਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: anik rang naanaa drisattaeh |
English: although they appear in so many various colors.

Gurbani: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: nau nidh amrit prabh kaa naam |
English: The nine treasures are in the Ambrosial Name of God.

Gurbani: ਦੇਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਇਸ ਕਾ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: dehee meh is kaa bisraam |
English: Within the human body is its place of rest.

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਅਨਹਤ ਤਹ ਨਾਦ ॥
Transliteration: sun samaadh anahat teh naad |
English: The Deepest Samaadhi, and the unstruck sound current of the Naad are there.

Gurbani: ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਅਚਰਜ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥
Transliteration: kehan na jaaee acharaj bisamaad |
English: The wonder and marvel of it cannot be described.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਦਿਖਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: tin dekhiaa jis aap dikhaae |
English: He alone sees it, unto whom God Himself reveals it.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak tis jan sojhee paae |1|
English: O Nanak, that humble being understands. ||1||

[Ang 293 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੋ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਅਨੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: so antar so baahar anant |
English: The Infinite Lord is inside, and outside as well.

Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਬਿਆਪਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt biaap rahiaa bhagavant |
English: Deep within each and every heart, the Lord God is pervading.

Gurbani: ਧਰਨਿ ਮਾਹਿ ਆਕਾਸ ਪਇਆਲ ॥
Transliteration: dharan maeh aakaas peaal |
English: In the earth, in the Akaashic ethers, and in the nether regions of the underworld

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਲੋਕ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: sarab lok pooran pratipaal |
English: in all worlds, He is the Perfect Cherisher.

Gurbani: ਬਨਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਰਬਤਿ ਹੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: ban tin parabat hai paarabraham |
English: In the forests, fields and mountains, He is the Supreme Lord God.

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਤੈਸਾ ਕਰਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: jaisee aagiaa taisaa karam |
English: As He orders, so do His creatures act.

Gurbani: ਪਉਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: paun paanee baisantar maeh |
English: He permeates the winds and the waters.

Gurbani: ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਦਹ ਦਿਸੇ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: chaar kuntt deh dise samaeh |
English: He is pervading in the four corners and in the ten directions.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਭਿੰਨ ਨਹੀ ਕੋ ਠਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tis te bhin nahee ko tthaau |
English: Without Him, there is no place at all.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad naanak sukh paau |2|
English: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, peace is obtained. ||2||

[Ang 294 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਦੇਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: bed puraan sinmrit meh dekh |
English: See Him in the Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees.

Gurbani: ਸਸੀਅਰ ਸੂਰ ਨਖੵਤ੍ਰ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: saseear soor nakhayatr meh ek |
English: In the moon, the sun and the stars, He is the One.

Gurbani: ਬਾਣੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਬੋਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: baanee prabh kee sabh ko bolai |
English: The Bani of God's Word is spoken by everyone.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਅਡੋਲੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਡੋਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: aap addol na kabahoo ddolai |
English: He Himself is unwavering - He never wavers.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਖੇਲੈ ਖੇਲ ॥
Transliteration: sarab kalaa kar khelai khel |
English: With absolute power, He plays His play.

Gurbani: ਮੋਲਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਣਹ ਅਮੋਲ ॥
Transliteration: mol na paaeeai gunah amol |
English: His value cannot be estimated; His virtues are invaluable.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਜੋਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: sarab jot meh jaa kee jot |
English: In all light, is His Light.

Gurbani: ਧਾਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: dhaar rahio suaamee ot pot |
English: The Lord and Master supports the weave of the fabric of the universe.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਭਰਮ ਕਾ ਨਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaad bharam kaa naas |
English: By Guru's Grace, doubt is dispelled.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਏਹੁ ਬਿਸਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak tin meh ehu bisaas |3|
English: O Nanak, this faith is firmly implanted within. ||3||

[Ang 294 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਪੇਖਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ॥
Transliteration: sant janaa kaa pekhan sabh braham |
English: In the eye of the Saint, everything is God.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਭਿ ਧਰਮ ॥
Transliteration: sant janaa kai hiradai sabh dharam |
English: In the heart of the Saint, everything is Dharma.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਸੁਨਹਿ ਸੁਭ ਬਚਨ ॥
Transliteration: sant janaa suneh subh bachan |
English: The Saint hears words of goodness.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਬਿਆਪੀ ਰਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਚਨ ॥
Transliteration: sarab biaapee raam sang rachan |
English: He is absorbed in the All-pervading Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਇਹ ਰਹਤ ॥
Transliteration: jin jaataa tis kee ih rehat |
English: This is the way of life of one who knows God.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿ ਬਚਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਭਿ ਕਹਤ ॥
Transliteration: sat bachan saadhoo sabh kehat |
English: True are all the words spoken by the Holy.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਹੋਇ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: jo jo hoe soee sukh maanai |
English: Whatever happens, he peacefully accepts.

Gurbani: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨਹਾਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: karan karaavanahaar prabh jaanai |
English: He knows God as the Doer, the Cause of causes.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਸੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭੀ ਓਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: antar base baahar bhee ohee |
English: He dwells inside, and outside as well.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਭ ਮੋਹੀ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak darasan dekh sabh mohee |4|
English: O Nanak, beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, all are fascinated. ||4||

[Ang 294 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਸਤਿ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਸਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: aap sat keea sabh sat |
English: He Himself is True, and all that He has made is True.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ਸਗਲੀ ਉਤਪਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: tis prabh te sagalee utapat |
English: The entire creation came from God.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: tis bhaavai taa kare bisathaar |
English: As it pleases Him, He creates the expanse.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: tis bhaavai taa ekankaar |
English: As it pleases Him, He becomes the One and Only again.

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਕਲਾ ਲਖੀ ਨਹ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: anik kalaa lakhee neh jaae |
English: His powers are so numerous, they cannot be known.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jis bhaavai tis le milaae |
English: As it pleases Him, He merges us into Himself again.

Gurbani: ਕਵਨ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਕਵਨ ਕਹੀਐ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: kavan nikatt kavan kaheeai door |
English: Who is near, and who is far away?

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: aape aap aap bharapoor |
English: He Himself is Himself pervading everywhere.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਗਤਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਜਨਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: antaragat jis aap janaae |
English: One whom God causes to know that He is within the heart

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak tis jan aap bujhaae |5|
English: - O Nanak, He causes that person to understand Him. ||5||

[Ang 294 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਭੂਤ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sarab bhoot aap varataaraa |
English: In all forms, He Himself is pervading.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਨੈਨ ਆਪਿ ਪੇਖਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sarab nain aap pekhanahaaraa |
English: Through all eyes, He Himself is watching.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਤਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: sagal samagree jaa kaa tanaa |
English: All the creation is His Body.

Gurbani: ਆਪਨ ਜਸੁ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਸੁਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: aapan jas aap hee sunaa |
English: He Himself listens to His Own Praise.

Gurbani: ਆਵਨ ਜਾਨੁ ਇਕੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਬਨਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aavan jaan ik khel banaaeaa |
English: The One has created the drama of coming and going.

Gurbani: ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ਕੀਨੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aagiaakaaree keenee maaeaa |
English: He made Maya subservient to His Will.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਕੈ ਮਧਿ ਅਲਿਪਤੋ ਰਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kai madh alipato rahai |
English: In the midst of all, He remains unattached.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣਾ ਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਕਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: jo kichh kahanaa su aape kahai |
English: Whatever is said, He Himself says.

Gurbani: ਆਗਿਆ ਆਵੈ ਆਗਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aagiaa aavai aagiaa jaae |
English: By His Will we come, and by His Will we go.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਲਏ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: naanak jaa bhaavai taa le samaae |6|
English: O Nanak, when it pleases Him, then He absorbs us into Himself. ||6||

[Ang 294 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਇਸ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਬੁਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: eis te hoe su naahee buraa |
English: If it comes from Him, it cannot be bad.

Gurbani: ਓਰੈ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਕਛੁ ਕਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: orai kahahu kinai kachh karaa |
English: Other than Him, who can do anything?

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਭਲਾ ਕਰਤੂਤਿ ਅਤਿ ਨੀਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: aap bhalaa karatoot at neekee |
English: He Himself is good; His actions are the very best.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਨੈ ਅਪਨੇ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: aape jaanai apane jee kee |
English: He Himself knows His Own Being.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਧਾਰੀ ਸਭ ਸਾਚੁ ॥
Transliteration: aap saach dhaaree sabh saach |
English: He Himself is True, and all that He has established is True.

Gurbani: ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਆਪਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਚੁ ॥
Transliteration: ot pot aapan sang raach |
English: Through and through, He is blended with His creation.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: taa kee gat mit kahee na jaae |
English: His state and extent cannot be described.

Gurbani: ਦੂਸਰ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: doosar hoe ta sojhee paae |
English: If there were another like Him, then only he could understand Him.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: tis kaa keea sabh paravaan |
English: His actions are all approved and accepted.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਜਾਨੁ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad naanak ihu jaan |7|
English: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, this is known. ||7||

[Ang 294 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜਾਨੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jo jaanai tis sadaa sukh hoe |
English: One who knows Him, obtains everlasting peace.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਲਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aap milaae le prabh soe |
English: God blends that one into Himself.

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਧਨਵੰਤੁ ਕੁਲਵੰਤੁ ਪਤਿਵੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: ohu dhanavant kulavant pativant |
English: He is wealth and prosperous, and of noble birth.

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਭਗਵੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: jeevan mukat jis ridai bhagavant |
English: He is Jivan Mukta - liberated while yet alive; the Lord God abides in his heart.

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਨੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan dhan jan aaeaa |
English: Blessed, blessed, blessed is the coming of that humble being;

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jis prasaad sabh jagat taraaeaa |
English: by his grace, the whole world is saved.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਆਵਨ ਕਾ ਇਹੈ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
Transliteration: jan aavan kaa ihai suaau |
English: This is his purpose in life;

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jan kai sang chit aavai naau |
English: in the Company of this humble servant, the Lord's Name comes to mind.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: aap mukat mukat karai sansaar |
English: He Himself is liberated, and He liberates the universe.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ॥੮॥੨੩॥
Transliteration: naanak tis jan kau sadaa namasakaar |8|23|
English: O Nanak, to that humble servant, I bow in reverence forever. ||8||23||

[Ang 295 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: pooraa prabh aaraadhiaa pooraa jaa kaa naau |
English: I worship and adore the Perfect Lord God. Perfect is His Name.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak pooraa paaeaa poore ke gun gaau |1|
English: O Nanak, I have obtained the Perfect One; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Perfect Lord. ||1||
