[Ang 295 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
Transliteration: asattapadee |
English: Ashtapadee:

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸੁਨਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: poore gur kaa sun upades |
English: Listen to the Teachings of the Perfect Guru;

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਪੇਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham nikatt kar pekh |
English: see the Supreme Lord God near you.

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: saas saas simarahu gobind |
English: With each and every breath, meditate in remembrance on the Lord of the Universe,

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਉਤਰੈ ਚਿੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: man antar kee utarai chind |
English: and the anxiety within your mind shall depart.

Gurbani: ਆਸ ਅਨਿਤ ਤਿਆਗਹੁ ਤਰੰਗ ॥
Transliteration: aas anit tiaagahu tarang |
English: Abandon the waves of fleeting desire,

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਮਨ ਮੰਗ ॥
Transliteration: sant janaa kee dhoor man mang |
English: and pray for the dust of the feet of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕਰਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: aap chhodd benatee karahu |
English: Renounce your selfishness and conceit and offer your prayers.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang agan saagar tarahu |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, cross over the ocean of fire.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਧਨ ਕੇ ਭਰਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: har dhan ke bhar lehu bhanddaar |
English: Fill your stores with the wealth of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak gur poore namasakaar |1|
English: Nanak bows in humility and reverence to the Perfect Guru. ||1||

[Ang 295 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਖੇਮ ਕੁਸਲ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: khem kusal sehaj aanand |
English: Happiness, intuitive peace, poise and bliss

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਭਜੁ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang bhaj paramaanand |
English: in the Company of the Holy, meditate on the Lord of supreme bliss.

Gurbani: ਨਰਕ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਉਧਾਰਹੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: narak nivaar udhaarahu jeeo |
English: You shall be spared from hell - save your soul!

Gurbani: ਗੁਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: gun gobind amrit ras peeo |
English: Drink in the ambrosial essence of the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਚਿਤਿ ਚਿਤਵਹੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਏਕ ॥
Transliteration: chit chitavahu naaraaein ek |
English: Focus your consciousness on the One, the All-pervading Lord

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਰੂਪ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਰੰਗ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
Transliteration: ek roop jaa ke rang anek |
English: He has One Form, but He has many manifestations.

Gurbani: ਗੋਪਾਲ ਦਾਮੋਦਰ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
Transliteration: gopaal daamodar deen deaal |
English: Sustainer of the Universe, Lord of the world, Kind to the poor,

Gurbani: ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: dukh bhanjan pooran kirapaal |
English: Destroyer of sorrow, perfectly Merciful.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਾਰੰ ਬਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: simar simar naam baaran baar |
English: Meditate, meditate in remembrance on the Naam, again and again.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਇਹੈ ਅਧਾਰ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak jeea kaa ihai adhaar |2|
English: O Nanak, it is the Support of the soul. ||2||

[Ang 295 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਉਤਮ ਸਲੋਕ ਸਾਧ ਕੇ ਬਚਨ ॥
Transliteration: autam salok saadh ke bachan |
English: The most sublime hymns are the Words of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਅਮੁਲੀਕ ਲਾਲ ਏਹਿ ਰਤਨ ॥
Transliteration: amuleek laal ehi ratan |
English: These are priceless rubies and gems.

Gurbani: ਸੁਨਤ ਕਮਾਵਤ ਹੋਤ ਉਧਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: sunat kamaavat hot udhaar |
English: One who listens and acts on them is saved.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਲੋਕਹ ਨਿਸਤਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: aap tarai lokah nisataar |
English: He himself swims across, and saves others as well.

Gurbani: ਸਫਲ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: safal jeevan safal taa kaa sang |
English: His life is prosperous, and his company is fruitful;

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai man laagaa har rang |
English: his mind is imbued with the love of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਨਾਹਦੁ ਵਾਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: jai jai sabad anaahad vaajai |
English: Hail, hail to him, for whom the sound current of the Shabad vibrates.

Gurbani: ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਅਨਦ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਗਾਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: sun sun anad kare prabh gaajai |
English: Hearing it again and again, he is in bliss, proclaiming God's Praises.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਮਹਾਂਤ ਕੈ ਮਾਥੇ ॥
Transliteration: pragatte gupaal mahaant kai maathe |
English: The Lord radiates from the foreheads of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਧਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਾਥੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak udhare tin kai saathe |3|
English: Nanak is saved in their company. ||3||

[Ang 295 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਰਨਿ ਜੋਗੁ ਸੁਨਿ ਸਰਨੀ ਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: saran jog sun saranee aae |
English: Hearing that He can give Sanctuary, I have come seeking His Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh aap milaae |
English: Bestowing His Mercy, God has blended me with Himself.

Gurbani: ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਬੈਰ ਭਏ ਸਭ ਰੇਨ ॥
Transliteration: mitt ge bair bhe sabh ren |
English: Hatred is gone, and I have become the dust of all.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਲੈਨ ॥
Transliteration: amrit naam saadhasang lain |
English: I have received the Ambrosial Naam in the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: suprasan bhe guradev |
English: The Divine Guru is perfectly pleased;

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: pooran hoee sevak kee sev |
English: the service of His servant has been rewarded.

Gurbani: ਆਲ ਜੰਜਾਲ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਤੇ ਰਹਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: aal janjaal bikaar te rahate |
English: I have been released from worldly entanglements and corruption,

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੁਨਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਕਹਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam sun rasanaa kahate |
English: hearing the Lord's Name and chanting it with my tongue.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੁ ਦਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kar prasaad deaa prabh dhaaree |
English: By His Grace, God has bestowed His Mercy.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਬਹੀ ਖੇਪ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak nibahee khep hamaaree |4|
English: O Nanak, my merchandise has arrived save and sound. ||4||

[Ang 295 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਮੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kee usatat karahu sant meet |
English: Sing the Praises of God, O Saints, O friends,

Gurbani: ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਏਕਾਗਰ ਚੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: saavadhaan ekaagar cheet |
English: with total concentration and one-pointedness of mind.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖਮਨੀ ਸਹਜ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਨ ਨਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sukhamanee sehaj gobind gun naam |
English: Sukhmani is the peaceful ease, the Glory of God, the Naam.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: jis man basai su hot nidhaan |
English: When it abides in the mind, one becomes wealthy.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਇਛਾ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sarab ichhaa taa kee pooran hoe |
English: All desires are fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਸਭ ਲੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: pradhaan purakh pragatt sabh loe |
English: One becomes the most respected person, famous all over the world.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਪਾਏ ਅਸਥਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: sabh te aooch paae asathaan |
English: He obtains the highest place of all.

Gurbani: ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਆਵਨ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: bahur na hovai aavan jaan |
English: He does not come and go in reincarnation any longer.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਾਟਿ ਚਲੈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: har dhan khaatt chalai jan soe |
English: One who departs, after earning the wealth of the Lord's Name,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak jiseh paraapat hoe |5|
English: O Nanak, realizes it. ||5||

[Ang 295 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਖੇਮ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ॥
Transliteration: khem saant ridh nav nidh |
English: Comfort, peace and tranquility, wealth and the nine treasures;

Gurbani: ਬੁਧਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਰਬ ਤਹ ਸਿਧਿ ॥
Transliteration: budh giaan sarab teh sidh |
English: wisdom, knowledge, and all spiritual powers;

Gurbani: ਬਿਦਿਆ ਤਪੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: bidiaa tap jog prabh dhiaan |
English: learning, penance, Yoga and meditation on God;

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸ੍ਰੇਸਟ ਊਤਮ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: giaan sresatt aootam isanaan |
English: The most sublime wisdom and purifying baths;

Gurbani: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: chaar padaarath kamal pragaas |
English: the four cardinal blessings, the opening of the heart-lotus;

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਕੈ ਮਧਿ ਸਗਲ ਤੇ ਉਦਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kai madh sagal te udaas |
English: in the midst of all, and yet detached from all;

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਤਤ ਕਾ ਬੇਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: sundar chatur tat kaa betaa |
English: beauty, intelligence, and the realization of reality;

Gurbani: ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਏਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੇਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: samadarasee ek drisattetaa |
English: to look impartially upon all, and to see only the One

Gurbani: ਇਹ ਫਲ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਭਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: eih fal tis jan kai mukh bhane |
English: - these blessings come to one who,

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਬਚਨ ਮਨਿ ਸੁਨੇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: gur naanak naam bachan man sune |6|
English: through Guru Nanak, chants the Naam with his mouth, and hears the Word with his ears. ||6||

[Ang 296 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਜਪੈ ਮਨਿ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: eihu nidhaan japai man koe |
English: One who chants this treasure in his mind

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabh jug meh taa kee gat hoe |
English: in every age, he attains salvation.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਮ ਧੁਨਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: gun gobind naam dhun baanee |
English: In it is the Glory of God, the Naam, the chanting of Gurbani.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੇਦ ਬਖਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: simrit saasatr bed bakhaanee |
English: The Simritees, the Shaastras and the Vedas speak of it.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਮਤਾਂਤ ਕੇਵਲ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sagal mataant keval har naam |
English: The essence of all religion is the Lord's Name alone.

Gurbani: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਗਤ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: gobind bhagat kai man bisraam |
English: It abides in the minds of the devotees of God.

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਅਪ੍ਰਾਧ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਟੈ ॥
Transliteration: kott apraadh saadhasang mittai |
English: Millions of sins are erased, in the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਛੁਟੈ ॥
Transliteration: sant kripaa te jam te chhuttai |
English: By the Grace of the Saint, one escapes the Messenger of Death.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਕਰਮ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai masatak karam prabh paae |
English: Those, who have such pre-ordained destiny on their foreheads,

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਆਏ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: saadh saran naanak te aae |7|
English: O Nanak, enter the Sanctuary of the Saints. ||7||

[Ang 296 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ ਸੁਨੈ ਲਾਇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: jis man basai sunai laae preet |
English: One, within whose mind it abides, and who listens to it with love

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: tis jan aavai har prabh cheet |
English: that humble person consciously remembers the Lord God.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: janam maran taa kaa dookh nivaarai |
English: The pains of birth and death are removed.

Gurbani: ਦੁਲਭ ਦੇਹ ਤਤਕਾਲ ਉਧਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: dulabh deh tatakaal udhaarai |
English: The human body, so difficult to obtain, is instantly redeemed.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਭਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: niramal sobhaa amrit taa kee baanee |
English: Spotlessly pure is his reputation, and ambrosial is his speech.

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: ek naam man maeh samaanee |
English: The One Name permeates his mind.

Gurbani: ਦੂਖ ਰੋਗ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਭੈ ਭਰਮ ॥
Transliteration: dookh rog binase bhai bharam |
English: Sorrow, sickness, fear and doubt depart.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਕਰਮ ॥
Transliteration: saadh naam niramal taa ke karam |
English: He is called a Holy person; his actions are immaculate and pure.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਬਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: sabh te aooch taa kee sobhaa banee |
English: His glory becomes the highest of all.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹ ਗੁਣਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਖਮਨੀ ॥੮॥੨੪॥
Transliteration: naanak ih gun naam sukhamanee |8|24|
English: O Nanak, by these Glorious Virtues, this is named Sukhmani, Peace of mind. ||8||24||

[Ang 296 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਥਿਤੀ ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: thitee gaurree mahalaa 5 |
English: T'hitee ~ The Lunar Days: Gauree, Fifth Mehl,

Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਿਆ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jal thal maheeal pooriaa suaamee sirajanahaar |
English: The Creator Lord and Master is pervading the water, the land, and the sky.

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: anik bhaant hoe pasariaa naanak ekankaar |1|
English: In so many ways, the One, the Universal Creator has diffused Himself, O Nanak. ||1||

[Ang 296 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਏਕਮ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰਉ ਬੰਦਨਾ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: ekam ekankaar prabh krau bandanaa dhiaae |
English: The first day of the lunar cycle: Bow in humility and meditate on the One, the Universal Creator Lord God.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gun gobind gupaal prabh saran prau har raae |
English: Praise God, the Lord of the Universe, the Sustainer of the World; seek the Sanctuary of the Lord, our King.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਸੁਖ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: taa kee aas kaliaan sukh jaa te sabh kachh hoe |
English: Place your hopes in Him, for salvation and peace; all things come from Him.

Gurbani: ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਓ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: chaar kuntt deh dis bhramio tis bin avar na koe |
English: I wandered around the four corners of the world and in the ten directions, but I saw nothing except Him.

Gurbani: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸੁਨੇ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਰਉ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: bed puraan simrit sune bahu bidh krau beechaar |
English: I listened to the Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees, and I pondered over them in so many ways.

Gurbani: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਭੈ ਹਰਨ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: patit udhaaran bhai haran sukh saagar nirankaar |
English: The Saving Grace of sinners, the Destroyer of fear, the Ocean of peace, the Formless Lord.

Gurbani: ਦਾਤਾ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਦੇਨਹਾਰੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: daataa bhugataa denahaar tis bin avar na jaae |
English: The Great Giver, the Enjoyer, the Bestower - there is no place at all without Him.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਚਾਹਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jo chaaheh soee milai naanak har gun gaae |1|
English: You shall obtain all that you desire, O Nanak, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਨੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: gobind jas gaaeeai har neet |
English: Sing the Praises of the Lord, the Lord of the Universe, each and every day.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਭਜੀਐ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mil bhajeeai saadhasang mere meet |1| rahaau |
English: Join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and vibrate, meditate on Him, O my friend. ||1||Pause||

[Ang 296 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਕਰਉ ਬੰਦਨਾ ਅਨਿਕ ਵਾਰ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: krau bandanaa anik vaar saran prau har raae |
English: Bow in humility to the Lord, over and over again, and enter the Sanctuary of the Lord, our King.

Gurbani: ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਭਾਉ ਮਿਟਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bhram katteeai naanak saadhasang duteea bhaau mittaae |2|
English: Doubt is eradicated, O Nanak, in the Company of the Holy, and the love of duality is eliminated. ||2||

[Ang 296 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਦੁਤੀਆ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਿ ਨੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: duteea duramat door kar gur sevaa kar neet |
English: The second day of the lunar cycle: Get rid of your evil-mindedness, and serve the Guru continually.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਸੈ ਤਜਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: raam ratan man tan basai taj kaam krodh lobh meet |
English: The jewel of the Lord's Name shall come to dwell in your mind and body, when you renounce sexual desire, anger and greed, O my friend.

Gurbani: ਮਰਣੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਬਿਨਸਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਕਲੇਸ ॥
Transliteration: maran mittai jeevan milai binaseh sagal kales |
English: Conquer death and obtain eternal life; all your troubles will depart.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਤਜਹੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਜਹੁ ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਰਵੇਸ ॥
Transliteration: aap tajahu gobind bhajahu bhaau bhagat paraves |
English: Renounce your self-conceit and vibrate upon the Lord of the Universe; loving devotion to Him shall permeate your being.

Gurbani: ਲਾਭੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤੋਟਾ ਹਿਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਤਿਵੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: laabh milai tottaa hirai har daragah pativant |
English: You shall earn profit and suffer no loss, and in the Court of the Lord you shall be honored.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਵੈ ਸਾਚ ਸਾਹ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam dhan sanchavai saach saah bhagavant |
English: Those who gather in the riches of the Lord's Name are truly wealthy, and very blessed.

Gurbani: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਹੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: aootthat baitthat har bhajahu saadhoo sang pareet |
English: So, when standing up and sitting down, vibrate upon the Lord, and cherish the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਛੁਟਿ ਗਈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਸੇ ਚੀਤਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak duramat chhutt gee paarabraham base cheet |2|
English: O Nanak, evil-mindedness is eradicated, when the Supreme Lord God comes to dwell in the mind. ||2||

[Ang 297 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਤੀਨਿ ਬਿਆਪਹਿ ਜਗਤ ਕਉ ਤੁਰੀਆ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: teen biaapeh jagat kau tureea paavai koe |
English: The world is in the grip of the three qualities; only a few attain the fourth state of absorption.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਭਏ ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak sant niramal bhe jin man vasiaa soe |3|
English: O Nanak, the Saints are pure and immaculate; the Lord abides within their minds. ||3||

[Ang 297 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਤੀਆ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਬਿਖੈ ਫਲ ਕਬ ਉਤਮ ਕਬ ਨੀਚੁ ॥
Transliteration: triteea trai gun bikhai fal kab utam kab neech |
English: The third day of the lunar cycle: Those who are bound by the three qualities gather poison as their fruit; now they are good, and now they are bad.

Gurbani: ਨਰਕ ਸੁਰਗ ਭ੍ਰਮਤਉ ਘਣੋ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਘਾਰੈ ਮੀਚੁ ॥
Transliteration: narak surag bhramtau ghano sadaa sanghaarai meech |
English: They wander endlessly in heaven and hell, until death annihilates them.

Gurbani: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਸਹਸਾ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਹਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: harakh sog sahasaa sansaar hau hau karat bihaae |
English: In pleasure and pain and worldly cynicism, they pass their lives acting in ego.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਏ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਚਿਤਵਹਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਉਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jin kee tiseh na jaananee chitaveh anik upaae |
English: They do not know the One who created them; they think up all sorts of schemes and plans.

Gurbani: ਆਧਿ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਰਸ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਤੂਟੈ ਤਾਪ ॥
Transliteration: aadh biaadh upaadh ras kabahu na toottai taap |
English: Their minds and bodies are distracted by pleasure and pain, and their fever never departs.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਧਨੀ ਨਹ ਬੂਝੈ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham pooran dhanee neh boojhai parataap |
English: They do not realize the glorious radiance of the Supreme Lord God, the Perfect Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹ ਭਰਮ ਬੂਡਤ ਘਣੋ ਮਹਾ ਨਰਕ ਮਹਿ ਵਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: moh bharam booddat ghano mahaa narak meh vaas |
English: So many are being drowned in emotional attachment and doubt; they dwell in the most horrible hell.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਸ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh raakh lehu naanak teree aas |3|
English: Please bless me with Your Mercy, God, and save me! Nanak places his hopes in You. ||3||

[Ang 297 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਚਤੁਰ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੋਇ ਜਿਨਿ ਤਜਿਆ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: chatur siaanaa sugharr soe jin tajiaa abhimaan |
English: One who renounces egotistical pride is intelligent, wise and refined.

Gurbani: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਅਸਟ ਸਿਧਿ ਭਜੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: chaar padaarath asatt sidh bhaj naanak har naam |4|
English: The four cardinal blessings, and the eight spiritual powers of the Siddhas are obtained, O Nanak, by meditating, vibrating on the Lord's Name. ||4||

[Ang 297 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਚਤੁਰਥਿ ਚਾਰੇ ਬੇਦ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੋਧਿਓ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: chaturath chaare bed sun sodhio tat beechaar |
English: The fourth day of the lunar cycle: Listening to the four Vedas, and contemplating the essence of reality, I have come to realize

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਖੇਮ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sarab khem kaliaan nidh raam naam jap saar |
English: that the treasure of all joy and comfort is found in sublime meditation on the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਨਰਕ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਦੁਖ ਹਰੈ ਤੂਟਹਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਕਲੇਸ ॥
Transliteration: narak nivaarai dukh harai tootteh anik kales |
English: One is saved from hell, suffering is destroyed, countless pains depart,

Gurbani: ਮੀਚੁ ਹੁਟੈ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਛੁਟੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਪਰਵੇਸ ॥
Transliteration: meech huttai jam te chhuttai har keeratan paraves |
English: death is overcome, and one escapes the Messenger of Death, by absorption in the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

Gurbani: ਭਉ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਸੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: bhau binasai amrit rasai rang rate nirankaar |
English: Fear departs, and one savors the Ambrosial Nectar, imbued with the Love of the Formless Lord.

Gurbani: ਦੁਖ ਦਾਰਿਦ ਅਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਤਾ ਨਾਸਹਿ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: dukh daarid apavitrataa naaseh naam adhaar |
English: Pain, poverty and impurity are removed, with the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਖੋਜਤੇ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: sur nar mun jan khojate sukh saagar gopaal |
English: The angels, the seers and the silent sages search for the Ocean of peace, the Sustainer of the world.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲਾ ਹੋਇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਰਵਾਲ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: man niramal mukh aoojalaa hoe naanak saadh ravaal |4|
English: The mind becomes pure, and one's face is radiant, O Nanak, when one becomes the dust of the feet of the Holy. ||4||

[Ang 297 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਸੇ ਰਾਚੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: panch bikaar man meh base raache maaeaa sang |
English: The five evil passions dwell in the mind of one who is engrossed in Maya.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: saadhasang hoe niramalaa naanak prabh kai rang |5|
English: In the Saadh Sangat, one becomes pure, O Nanak, imbued with the Love of God. ||5||

[Ang 297 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਪੰਚਮਿ ਪੰਚ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨ ਤੇ ਜਿਹ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ॥
Transliteration: pancham panch pradhaan te jih jaanio parapanch |
English: The fifth day of the lunar cycle: They are the self-elect, the most distinguished, who know the true nature of the world.

Gurbani: ਕੁਸਮ ਬਾਸ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਘਣੋ ਸਭ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਬਲਬੰਚੁ ॥
Transliteration: kusam baas bahu rang ghano sabh mithiaa balabanch |
English: The many colors and scents of flowers - all worldly deceptions are transitory and false.

Gurbani: ਨਹ ਜਾਪੈ ਨਹ ਬੂਝੀਐ ਨਹ ਕਛੁ ਕਰਤ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: neh jaapai neh boojheeai neh kachh karat beechaar |
English: People do not see, and they do not understand; they do not reflect upon anything.

Gurbani: ਸੁਆਦ ਮੋਹ ਰਸ ਬੇਧਿਓ ਅਗਿਆਨਿ ਰਚਿਓ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: suaad moh ras bedhio agiaan rachio sansaar |
English: The world is pierced through with attachment to tastes and pleasures, engrossed in ignorance.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਣ ਕੀਨੇ ਕਰਮ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
Transliteration: janam maran bahu jon bhraman keene karam anek |
English: Those who perform empty religious rituals will be born, only to die again. They wander through endless incarnations.

Gurbani: ਰਚਨਹਾਰੁ ਨਹ ਸਿਮਰਿਓ ਮਨਿ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥
Transliteration: rachanahaar neh simario man na beechaar bibek |
English: They do not meditate in remembrance on the Creator Lord; their minds do not understand.

Gurbani: ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਲਿਪਤ ਨ ਰੰਚ ॥
Transliteration: bhaau bhagat bhagavaan sang maaeaa lipat na ranch |
English: By loving devotion to the Lord God, you shall not be polluted by Maya at all.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਰਲੇ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ਜੋ ਨ ਰਚਹਿ ਪਰਪੰਚ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak birale paaeeeh jo na racheh parapanch |5|
English: O Nanak, how rare are those, who are not engrossed in worldly entanglements. ||5||

[Ang 297 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਖਟ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਊਚੌ ਕਹਹਿ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: khatt saasatr aoochau kaheh ant na paaraavaar |
English: The six Shaastras proclaim Him to be the greatest; He has no end or limitation.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਦੁਆਰ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: bhagat soheh gun gaavate naanak prabh kai duaar |6|
English: The devotees look beauteous, O Nanak, when they sing the Glories of God at His Door. ||6||

[Ang 297 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਖਸਟਮਿ ਖਟ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਕਹਹਿ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਕਥਹਿ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
Transliteration: khasattam khatt saasatr kaheh sinmrit katheh anek |
English: The sixth day of the lunar cycle: The six Shaastras say, and countless Simritees assert,

Gurbani: ਊਤਮੁ ਊਚੌ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਗੁਣ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸੇਖ ॥
Transliteration: aootam aoochau paarabraham gun ant na jaaneh sekh |
English: that the Supreme Lord God is the most sublime and lofty. Even the thousand-tongued serpent does not know the limits of His Glories.

Gurbani: ਨਾਰਦ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸੁਕ ਬਿਆਸ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਤ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: naarad mun jan suk biaas jas gaavat gobind |
English: Naarad, the humble beings, Suk and Vyaasa sing the Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਰਸ ਗੀਧੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਬੀਧੇ ਭਗਤ ਰਚੇ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: ras geedhe har siau beedhe bhagat rache bhagavant |
English: They are imbued with the Lord's essence; united with Him; they are absorbed in devotional worship of the Lord God.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹ ਮਾਨ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਪਾਈ ਸਰਨਿ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
Transliteration: moh maan bhram binasio paaee saran deaal |
English: Emotional attachment, pride and doubt are eliminated, when one takes to the Sanctuary of the Merciful Lord.

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਸੇ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal man tan base darasan dekh nihaal |
English: His Lotus Feet abide within my mind and body and I am enraptured, beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

Gurbani: ਲਾਭੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤੋਟਾ ਹਿਰੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: laabh milai tottaa hirai saadhasang liv laae |
English: People reap their profits, and suffer no loss, when they embrace love for the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਖਾਟਿ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਹਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: khaatt khajaanaa gun nidh hare naanak naam dhiaae |6|
English: They gather in the treasure of the Lord, the Ocean of Excellence, O Nanak, by meditating on the Naam. ||6||

[Ang 298 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਮੰਡਲ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਥਹਿ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਸਤਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sant manddal har jas katheh boleh sat subhaae |
English: In the gathering of the Saints, chant the Praises of the Lord, and speak the Truth with love.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਐ ਏਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: naanak man santokheeai ekas siau liv laae |7|
English: O Nanak, the mind becomes contented, enshrining love for the One Lord. ||7||

[Ang 298 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸਪਤਮਿ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਟੂਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: sapatam sanchahu naam dhan ttoott na jaeh bhanddaar |
English: The seventh day of the lunar cycle: Gather the wealth of the Naam; this is a treasure which shall never be exhausted.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: santasangat meh paaeeai ant na paaraavaar |
English: In the Society of the Saints, He is obtained; He has no end or limitations.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਤਜਹੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਜਹੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aap tajahu gobind bhajahu saran parahu har raae |
English: Renounce your selfishness and conceit, and meditate, vibrate on the Lord of the Universe; take to the Sanctuary of the Lord, our King.

Gurbani: ਦੂਖ ਹਰੈ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰੈ ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: dookh harai bhavajal tarai man chindiaa fal paae |
English: Your pains shall depart - swim across the terrifying world-ocean, and obtain the fruits of your mind's desires.

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੈ ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar man har japai safal janam paravaan |
English: One who meditates on the Lord twenty-four hours a day - fruitful and blessed is his coming into the world.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: antar baahar sadaa sang karanaihaar pachhaan |
English: Inwardly and outwardly, realize that the Creator Lord is always with you.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਸੋ ਸਖਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: so saajan so sakhaa meet jo har kee mat dee |
English: He is your friend, your companion, your very best friend, who imparts the Teachings of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇਇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: naanak tis balihaaranai har har naam japee |7|
English: Nanak is a sacrifice to one who chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||7||

[Ang 298 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਈਅਹਿ ਤਜੀਅਹਿ ਅਵਰਿ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar gun gaaeeeh tajeeeh avar janjaal |
English: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord twenty-four hours a day; renounce other entanglements.

Gurbani: ਜਮਕੰਕਰੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: jamakankar johi na sakee naanak prabhoo deaal |8|
English: The Minister of Death cannot even see that person, O Nanak, unto whom God is merciful. ||8||

[Ang 298 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਅਸਟਮੀ ਅਸਟ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ॥
Transliteration: asattamee asatt sidh nav nidh |
English: The eighth day of the lunar cycle: The eight spiritual powers of the Siddhas, the nine treasures,

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਪੂਰਨ ਬੁਧਿ ॥
Transliteration: sagal padaarath pooran budh |
English: all precious things, perfect intellect,

Gurbani: ਕਵਲ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਸਦਾ ਆਨੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: kaval pragaas sadaa aanand |
English: the opening of the heart-lotus, eternal bliss,

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ਨਿਰੋਧਰ ਮੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: niramal reet nirodhar mant |
English: pure lifestyle, the infallible Mantra,

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਧਰਮ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: sagal dharam pavitr isanaan |
English: all Dharmic virtues, sacred purifying baths,

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਊਚ ਬਿਸੇਖ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: sabh meh aooch bisekh giaan |
English: the most lofty and sublime spiritual wisdom

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: har har bhajan poore gur sang |
English: these are obtained by meditating, vibrating upon the Lord, Har, Har, in the Company of the Perfect Guru.

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਤਰੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: jap tareeai naanak naam har rang |8|
English: You shall be saved, O Nanak, by lovingly chanting the Lord's Name. ||8||

[Ang 298 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਨਹ ਸਿਮਰਿਓ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਸੁਆਦ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: naaraaein neh simario mohio suaad bikaar |
English: He does not remember the Lord in meditation; he is fascinated by the pleasures of corruption.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਐ ਨਰਕ ਸੁਰਗ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: naanak naam bisaariai narak surag avataar |9|
English: O Nanak, forgetting the Naam, he is reincarnated into heaven and hell. ||9||

[Ang 298 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਨਉਮੀ ਨਵੇ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਅਪਵੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: naumee nave chhidr apaveet |
English: The ninth day of the lunar cycle: The nine holes of the body are defiled.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਪਹਿ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਪਰੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: har naam na japeh karat bipareet |
English: People do not chant the Lord's Name; instead, they practice evil.

Gurbani: ਪਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਅ ਰਮਹਿ ਬਕਹਿ ਸਾਧ ਨਿੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: par tria rameh bakeh saadh nind |
English: They commit adultery, slander the Saints,

Gurbani: ਕਰਨ ਨ ਸੁਨਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਬਿੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: karan na sunahee har jas bind |
English: and do not listen to even a tiny bit of the Lord's Praise.

Gurbani: ਹਿਰਹਿ ਪਰ ਦਰਬੁ ਉਦਰ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: hireh par darab udar kai taaee |
English: They steal others' wealth for the sake of their own bellies,

Gurbani: ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਨਿਵਰੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਨ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: agan na nivarai trisanaa na bujhaaee |
English: but the fire is not extinguished, and their thirst is not quenched.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਏਹ ਫਲ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: har sevaa bin eeh fal laage |
English: Without serving the Lord, these are their rewards.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਮਰਿ ਜਮਹਿ ਅਭਾਗੇ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: naanak prabh bisarat mar jameh abhaage |9|
English: O Nanak, forgetting God, the unfortunate people are born, only to die. ||9||

[Ang 298 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਦਸ ਦਿਸ ਖੋਜਤ ਮੈ ਫਿਰਿਓ ਜਤ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਤ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: das dis khojat mai firio jat dekhau tat soe |
English: I have wandered, searching in the ten directions - wherever I look, there I see Him.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਬਸਿ ਆਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: man bas aavai naanakaa je pooran kirapaa hoe |10|
English: The mind comes to be controlled, O Nanak, if He grants His Perfect Grace. ||10||

[Ang 298 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਦਸਮੀ ਦਸ ਦੁਆਰ ਬਸਿ ਕੀਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: dasamee das duaar bas keene |
English: The tenth day of the lunar cycle: Overpower the ten sensory and motor organs;

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਨਾਮ ਜਪਿ ਲੀਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: man santokh naam jap leene |
English: your mind will be content, as you chant the Naam.

Gurbani: ਕਰਨੀ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਜਸੁ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: karanee suneeai jas gopaal |
English: With your ears, hear the Praises of the Lord of the World;

Gurbani: ਨੈਨੀ ਪੇਖਤ ਸਾਧ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
Transliteration: nainee pekhat saadh deaal |
English: with your eyes, behold the kind, Holy Saints.

Gurbani: ਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ਬੇਅੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: rasanaa gun gaavai beant |
English: With your tongue, sing the Glorious Praises of the Infinite Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: man meh chitavai pooran bhagavant |
English: In your mind, remember the Perfect Lord God.

Gurbani: ਹਸਤ ਚਰਨ ਸੰਤ ਟਹਲ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: hasat charan sant ttehal kamaaeeai |
English: With your hands and feet, work for the Saints.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: naanak ihu sanjam prabh kirapaa paaeeai |10|
English: O Nanak, this way of life is obtained by God's Grace. ||10||

[Ang 299 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਬਖਾਨੀਐ ਬਿਰਲਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਸ੍ਵਾਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: eko ek bakhaaneeai biralaa jaanai svaad |
English: Describe the Lord as the One, the One and Only. How rare are those who know the taste of this essence.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭੁ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: gun gobind na jaaneeai naanak sabh bisamaad |11|
English: The Glories of the Lord of the Universe cannot be known. O Nanak, He is totally amazing and wonderful! ||11||

[Ang 299 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਏਕਾਦਸੀ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਪੇਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: ekaadasee nikatt pekhahu har raam |
English: The eleventh day of the lunar cycle: Behold the Lord, the Lord, near at hand.

Gurbani: ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਬਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: eindree bas kar sunahu har naam |
English: Subdue the desires of your sexual organs, and listen to the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਅ ਦਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: man santokh sarab jeea deaa |
English: Let your mind be content, and be kind to all beings.

Gurbani: ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਰਤੁ ਸੰਪੂਰਨ ਭਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: ein bidh barat sanpooran bheaa |
English: In this way, your fast will be successful.

Gurbani: ਧਾਵਤ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਇਕ ਠਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: dhaavat man raakhai ik tthaae |
English: Keep your wandering mind restrained in one place.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੁਧੁ ਜਪਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man tan sudh japat har naae |
English: Your mind and body shall become pure, chanting the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ॥
Transliteration: sabh meh poor rahe paarabraham |
English: The Supreme Lord God is pervading amongst all.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਅਟਲ ਏਹੁ ਧਰਮ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: naanak har keeratan kar attal ehu dharam |11|
English: O Nanak, sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises; this alone is the eternal faith of Dharma. ||11||

[Ang 299 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੀ ਭੇਟੇ ਸਾਧ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: duramat haree sevaa karee bhette saadh kripaal |
English: Evil-mindedness is eliminated, by meeting with and serving the compassionate Holy Saints.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਗਲ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: naanak prabh siau mil rahe binase sagal janjaal |12|
English: Nanak is merged with God; all his entanglements have come to an end. ||12||

[Ang 299 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਦੁਆਦਸੀ ਦਾਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: duaadasee daan naam isanaan |
English: The twelfth day of the lunar cycle: Dedicate yourself to giving charity, chanting the Naam and purification.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: har kee bhagat karahu taj maan |
English: Worship the Lord with devotion, and get rid of your pride.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪਾਨ ਕਰਹੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: har amrit paan karahu saadhasang |
English: Drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Name, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੈ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: man tripataasai keeratan prabh rang |
English: The mind is satisfied by lovingly singing the Kirtan of God's Praises.

Gurbani: ਕੋਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਭ ਕਉ ਸੰਤੋਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: komal baanee sabh kau santokhai |
English: The Sweet Words of His Bani soothe everyone.

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਭੂ ਆਤਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਸਿ ਪੋਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: panch bhoo aatamaa har naam ras pokhai |
English: The soul, the subtle essence of the five elements, cherishes the Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਏਹ ਨਿਹਚਉ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: gur poore te eeh nihchau paaeeai |
English: This faith is obtained from the Perfect Guru.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਰਮਤ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਆਈਐ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: naanak raam ramat fir jon na aaeeai |12|
English: O Nanak, dwelling upon the Lord, you shall not enter the womb of reincarnation again. ||12||

[Ang 299 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਤੀਨਿ ਗੁਣਾ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਆਪਿਆ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਤ ਨ ਕਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: teen gunaa meh biaapiaa pooran hot na kaam |
English: Engrossed in the three qualities, one's efforts do not succeed.

Gurbani: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਛੂਟੈ ਨਾਮ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: patit udhaaran man basai naanak chhoottai naam |13|
English: When the Saving Grace of sinners dwells in the mind, O Nanak, then one is saved by the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||13||

[Ang 299 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਉਦਸੀ ਤੀਨਿ ਤਾਪ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: traudasee teen taap sansaar |
English: The thirteenth day of the lunar cycle: The world is in the fever of the three qualities.

Gurbani: ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਨਰਕ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: aavat jaat narak avataar |
English: It comes and goes, and is reincarnated in hell.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨੁ ਨ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: har har bhajan na man meh aaeo |
English: Meditation on the Lord, Har, Har, does not enter into the minds of the people.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਗਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: sukh saagar prabh nimakh na gaaeo |
English: They do not sing the Praises of God, the Ocean of peace, even for an instant.

Gurbani: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਕਾ ਦੇਹ ਕਰਿ ਬਾਧਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: harakh sog kaa deh kar baadhio |
English: This body is the embodiment of pleasure and pain.

Gurbani: ਦੀਰਘ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਆਸਾਧਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: deeragh rog maaeaa aasaadhio |
English: It suffers from the chronic and incurable disease of Maya.

Gurbani: ਦਿਨਹਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਕਰਤ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਪਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: dineh bikaar karat sram paaeo |
English: By day, people practice corruption, wearing themselves out.

Gurbani: ਨੈਨੀ ਨੀਦ ਸੁਪਨ ਬਰੜਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: nainee need supan bararraaeo |
English: And then with sleep in their eyes, they mutter in dreams.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਹੋਵਤ ਏਹ ਹਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: har bisarat hovat eeh haal |
English: Forgetting the Lord, this is their condition.

Gurbani: ਸਰਨਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੁਰਖ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: saran naanak prabh purakh deaal |13|
English: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God, the kind and compassionate Primal Being. ||13||

[Ang 299 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਚਉਦਹ ਭਵਨ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: chaar kuntt chaudah bhavan sagal biaapat raam |
English: The Lord is pervading in all the four directions and the fourteen worlds.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਊਨ ਨ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਪੂਰਨ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਕਾਮ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: naanak aoon na dekheeai pooran taa ke kaam |14|
English: O Nanak, He is not seen to be lacking anything; His works are perfectly complete. ||14||

[Ang 299 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਚਉਦਹਿ ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪ ॥
Transliteration: chaudeh chaar kuntt prabh aap |
English: The fourteenth day of the lunar cycle: God Himself is in all four directions.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥
Transliteration: sagal bhavan pooran parataap |
English: On all worlds, His radiant glory is perfect.

Gurbani: ਦਸੇ ਦਿਸਾ ਰਵਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: dase disaa raviaa prabh ek |
English: The One God is diffused in the ten directions.

Gurbani: ਧਰਨਿ ਅਕਾਸ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੇਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: dharan akaas sabh meh prabh pekh |
English: Behold God in all the earth and sky.

Gurbani: ਜਲ ਥਲ ਬਨ ਪਰਬਤ ਪਾਤਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: jal thal ban parabat paataal |
English: In the water, on the land, in the forests and mountains, and in the nether regions of the underworld,

Gurbani: ਪਰਮੇਸ੍ਵਰ ਤਹ ਬਸਹਿ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
Transliteration: paramesvar teh baseh deaal |
English: the Merciful Transcendent Lord is abiding.

Gurbani: ਸੂਖਮ ਅਸਥੂਲ ਸਗਲ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: sookham asathool sagal bhagavaan |
English: The Lord God is in all mind and matter, subtle and manifest.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਨ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh braham pachhaan |14|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh realizes God. ||14||

[Ang 299 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਆਤਮੁ ਜੀਤਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: aatam jeetaa guramatee gun gaae gobind |
English: The soul is conquered, through the Guru's Teachings, singing the Glories of God.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੀ ਭੈ ਮਿਟੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਚਿੰਦ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: sant prasaadee bhai mitte naanak binasee chind |15|
English: By the Grace of the Saints, fear is dispelled, O Nanak, and anxiety is ended. ||15||

[Ang 299 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਅਮਾਵਸ ਆਤਮ ਸੁਖੀ ਭਏ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦੀਆ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: amaavas aatam sukhee bhe santokh deea guradev |
English: The day of the new moon: My soul is at peace; the Divine Guru has blessed me with contentment.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਲਾਗਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: man tan seetal saant sehaj laagaa prabh kee sev |
English: My mind and body are cooled and soothed, in intuitive peace and poise; I have dedicated myself to serving God.

Gurbani: ਟੂਟੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਸਫਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਕਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: ttootte bandhan bahu bikaar safal pooran taa ke kaam |
English: One who meditates in remembrance on the Name of the Lord - his bonds are broken, all his sins are erased,

Gurbani: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਿਟੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਛੁਟੀ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: duramat mittee haumai chhuttee simarat har ko naam |
English: and his works are brought to perfect fruition; his evil-mindedness disappears, and his ego is subdued.

Gurbani: ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਆਵਾ ਗਵਨ ॥
Transliteration: saran gahee paarabraham kee mittiaa aavaa gavan |
English: Taking to the Sanctuary of the Supreme Lord God, his comings and goings in reincarnation are ended.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਤਰਿਆ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਿਉ ਗੁਣ ਗੁਬਿੰਦ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਵਨ ॥
Transliteration: aap tariaa kuttanb siau gun gubind prabh ravan |
English: He saves himself, along with his family, chanting the Praises of God, the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਜਪੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: har kee ttehal kamaavanee japeeai prabh kaa naam |
English: I serve the Lord, and I chant the Name of God.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: gur poore te paaeaa naanak sukh bisraam |15|
English: From the Perfect Guru, Nanak has obtained peace and comfortable ease. ||15||

[Ang 300 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨੁ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਡੋਲਤਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਕੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: pooran kabahu na ddolataa pooraa keea prabh aap |
English: The perfect person never wavers; God Himself made him perfect.

Gurbani: ਦਿਨੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਹੋਤ ਨ ਘਾਟਿ ॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: din din charrai savaaeaa naanak hot na ghaatt |16|
English: Day by day, he prospers; O Nanak, he shall not fail. ||16||

[Ang 300 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨਮਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕੁ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥
Transliteration: pooranamaa pooran prabh ek karan kaaran samarath |
English: The day of the full moon: God alone is Perfect; He is the All-powerful Cause of causes.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਹਥੁ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jant deaal purakh sabh aoopar jaa kaa hath |
English: The Lord is kind and compassionate to all beings and creatures; His Protecting Hand is over all.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਰ ਕੀਆ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: gun nidhaan gobind gur keea jaa kaa hoe |
English: He is the Treasure of Excellence, the Lord of the Universe; through the Guru, He acts.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ਅਲਖ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: antarajaamee prabh sujaan alakh niranjan soe |
English: God, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is All-knowing, Unseen and Immaculately Pure.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੋ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਨਣਹਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham paramesaro sabh bidh jaananahaar |
English: The Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, is the Knower of all ways and means.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ਸਰਨਿ ਜੋਗੁ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: sant sahaaee saran jog aatth pehar namasakaar |
English: He is the Support of His Saints, with the Power to give Sanctuary. Twenty-four hours a day, I bow in reverence to Him.

Gurbani: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਨਹ ਬੂਝੀਐ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ॥
Transliteration: akath kathaa neh boojheeai simarahu har ke charan |
English: His Unspoken Speech cannot be understood; I meditate on the Feet of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਅਨਾਥ ਨਾਥ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਨ ॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: patit udhaaran anaath naath naanak prabh kee saran |16|
English: He is the Saving Grace of sinners, the Master of the masterless; Nanak has entered God's Sanctuary. ||16||

[Ang 300 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਦੁਖ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਹਸਾ ਗਇਓ ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: dukh binase sahasaa geo saran gahee har raae |
English: My pain is gone, and my sorrows have departed, since I took to the Sanctuary of the Lord, my King.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: man chinde fal paaeaa naanak har gun gaae |17|
English: I have obtained the fruits of my mind's desires, O Nanak, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||17||

[Ang 300 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਸੁਣੈ ਕੋਈ ਕਰੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: koee gaavai ko sunai koee karai beechaar |
English: Some sing, some listen, and some contemplate;

Gurbani: ਕੋ ਉਪਦੇਸੈ ਕੋ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੈ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: ko upadesai ko drirrai tis kaa hoe udhaar |
English: some preach, and some implant the Name within; this is how they are saved.

Gurbani: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟੈ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਮਲੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kilabikh kaattai hoe niramalaa janam janam mal jaae |
English: Their sinful mistakes are erased, and they become pure; the filth of countless incarnations is washed away.

Gurbani: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲਾ ਨਹ ਪੋਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: halat palat mukh aoojalaa neh pohai tis maae |
English: In this world and the next, their faces shall be radiant; they shall not be touched by Maya.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸੁਰਤਾ ਸੋ ਬੈਸਨੋ ਸੋ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਧਨਵੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: so surataa so baisano so giaanee dhanavant |
English: They are intuitively wise, and they are Vaishnaavs, worshippers of Vishnu; they are spiritually wise, wealthy and prosperous.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸੂਰਾ ਕੁਲਵੰਤੁ ਸੋਇ ਜਿਨਿ ਭਜਿਆ ਭਗਵੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: so sooraa kulavant soe jin bhajiaa bhagavant |
English: They are spiritual heros, of noble birth, who vibrate upon the Lord God.

Gurbani: ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਸੂਦੁ ਬੈਸੁ ਉਧਰੈ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਚੰਡਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: khatree braahaman sood bais udharai simar chanddaal |
English: The Kh'shatriyas, the Brahmins, the low-caste Soodras, the Vaisha workers and the outcast pariahs are all saved,

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਨਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਰਵਾਲ ॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: jin jaanio prabh aapanaa naanak tiseh ravaal |17|
English: meditating on the Lord. Nanak is the dust of the feet of those who know his God. ||17||

[Ang 300 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree kee vaar mahalaa 4 |
English: Vaar In Gauree, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 4 |
English: Salok Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਮਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur purakh deaal hai jis no samat sabh koe |
English: The True Guru, the Primal Being, is kind and compassionate; all are alike to Him.

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਦਾ ਮਨ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਤੇ ਸਿਧਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: ek drisatt kar dekhadaa man bhaavanee te sidh hoe |
English: He looks upon all impartially; with pure faith in the mind, He is obtained.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਉਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਦੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur vich amrit hai har utam har pad soe |
English: The Ambrosial Nectar is within the True Guru; He is exalted and sublime, of Godly status.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak kirapaa te har dhiaaeeai guramukh paavai koe |1|
English: O Nanak, by His Grace, one meditates on the Lord; the Gurmukhs obtain Him. ||1||

[Ang 300 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 4 |
English: Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਭ ਬਿਖੁ ਹੈ ਨਿਤ ਜਗਿ ਤੋਟਾ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: haumai maaeaa sabh bikh hai nit jag tottaa sansaar |
English: Egotism and Maya are total poison; in these, people continually suffer loss in this world.

Gurbani: ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਟਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: laahaa har dhan khattiaa guramukh sabad veechaar |
English: The Gurmukh earns the profit of the wealth of the Lord's Name, contemplating the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: haumai mail bikh utarai har amrit har ur dhaar |
English: The poisonous filth of egotism is removed, when one enshrines the Ambrosial Name of the Lord within the heart.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਕਾਰਜ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਸਿਧਿ ਹਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kaaraj tin ke sidh heh jin guramukh kirapaa dhaar |
English: All the Gurmukh's affairs are brought to perfect completion; the Lord has showered him with His Mercy.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak jo dhur mile se mil rahe har mele sirajanahaar |2|
English: O Nanak, one who meets the Primal Lord remains blended with the Lord, the Creator Lord. ||2||

[Ang 301 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਗੋਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: too sachaa saahib sach hai sach sachaa gosaaee |
English: You are True, O True Lord and Master. You are the Truest of the True, O Lord of the World.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁਨੋ ਸਭ ਧਿਆਇਦੀ ਸਭ ਲਗੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: tudhuno sabh dhiaaeidee sabh lagai teree paaee |
English: Everyone meditates on You; everyone falls at Your Feet.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸੁਆਲਿਉ ਸਰੂਪ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਲਘਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: teree sifat suaaliau saroop hai jin keetee tis paar laghaaee |
English: Your Praises are graceful and beautiful; You save those who speak them.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukhaa no fal paaeidaa sach naam samaaee |
English: You reward the Gurmukhs, who are absorbed in the True Name.

Gurbani: ਵਡੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਵਡੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: vadde mere saahibaa vaddee teree vaddiaaee |1|
English: O my Great Lord and Master, great is Your glorious greatness. ||1||

[Ang 301 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 4 |
English: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਸਲਾਹਣਾ ਸਭੁ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਫਿਕਾ ਸਾਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: vin naavai hor salaahanaa sabh bolan fikaa saad |
English: Without the Name, all other praise and speech is insipid and tasteless.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਸਲਾਹਦੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਵਾਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh ahankaar salaahade haumai mamataa vaad |
English: The self-willed manmukhs praise their own egos; their attachment to egotism is useless.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਸਾਲਾਹਨਿ ਸੇ ਮਰਹਿ ਖਪਿ ਜਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਅਪਵਾਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: jin saalaahan se mareh khap jaavai sabh apavaad |
English: Those whom they praise, die; they all waste away in conflict.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਰਮਾਨਾਦੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak guramukh ubare jap har har paramaanaad |1|
English: O servant Nanak, the Gurmukhs are saved, chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the Embodiment of Supreme Bliss. ||1||

[Ang 301 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 4 |
English: Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਸਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਮਨਿ ਹਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: satigur har prabh das naam dhiaaee man haree |
English: O True Guru, tell me of my Lord God, that I may meditate on the Naam within my mind.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੀ ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖ ਪਰਹਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naam pavit har mukh bolee sabh dukh paraharee |2|
English: O Nanak, the Lord's Name is sacred and pure; chanting it, all my pain has been taken away. ||2||

[Ang 301 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: too aape aap nirankaar hai niranjan har raaeaa |
English: You Yourself are the Formless Lord, the Immaculate Lord, our Sovereign King.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਤੂ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jinee too ik man sach dhiaaeaa tin kaa sabh dukh gavaaeaa |
English: Those who meditate on You, O True Lord with one-pointed mind, are rid of all their pain.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਸਰੀਕੁ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਵੈ ਲਾਇ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: teraa sareek ko naahee jis no lavai laae sunaaeaa |
English: You have no equal, next to whom I might sit and speak of You.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਤੂਹੈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਾ ਤੂਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tudh jevadd daataa toohai niranjanaa toohai sach merai man bhaaeaa |
English: You are the only Giver as great as Yourself. You are Immaculate; O True Lord, you are pleasing to my mind.

Gurbani: ਸਚੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਸਚੇ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sache mere saahibaa sache sach naaeaa |2|
English: O my True Lord and Master, Your Name is the Truest of the True. ||2||

[Ang 301 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 4 |
English: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦੁਰਜਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: man antar haumai rog hai bhram bhoole manamukh durajanaa |
English: Deep within the mind is the disease of ego; the self-willed manmukhs, the evil beings, are deluded by doubt.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਜਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak rog gavaae mil satigur saadhoo sajanaa |1|
English: O Nanak, this disease is eradicated, only when one meets the True Guru, our Holy Friend. ||1||

[Ang 301 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 4 |
English: Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: man tan rataa rang siau guramukh har gunataas |
English: The mind and body of the Gurmukh are imbued with the Love of the Lord, the Treasure of Virtue.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jan naanak har saranaagatee har mele gur saabaas |2|
English: Servant Nanak has taken to the Sanctuary of the Lord. Hail to the Guru, who has united me with the Lord. ||2||

[Ang 301 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਤੂ ਵੜੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: too karataa purakh agam hai kis naal too varreeai |
English: You are the Personification of Creativity, the Inaccessible Lord. With whom should I compare You?

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਹਾ ਤੂਹੈ ਪੜੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: tudh jevadd hoe su aakheeai tudh jehaa toohai parreeai |
English: If there was anyone else as great as You, I would name him; You alone are like Yourself.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗੜੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: too ghatt ghatt ik varatadaa guramukh paragarreeai |
English: You are the One, permeating each and every heart; You are revealed to the Gurmukh.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਸਚਾ ਸਭਸ ਦਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਦੂ ਤੂ ਚੜੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: too sachaa sabhas daa khasam hai sabh doo too charreeai |
English: You are the True Lord and Master of all; You are the Highest of all.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੁ ਸਚੇ ਹੋਇਸੀ ਤਾ ਕਾਇਤੁ ਕੜੀਐ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: too kareh su sache hoeisee taa kaaeit karreeai |3|
English: Whatever You do, O True Lord - that is what happens, so why should we grieve? ||3||

[Ang 301 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 4 |
English: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਪਿਰੰਮ ਕਾ ਅਠੇ ਪਹਰ ਲਗੰਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: mai man tan prem piram kaa atthe pehar lagan |
English: My mind and body are imbued with the Love of my Beloved, twenty-four hours a day.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸੰਨਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak kirapaa dhaar prabh satigur sukh vasan |1|
English: Shower Your Mercy upon servant Nanak, O God, that he may dwell in peace with the True Guru. ||1||

[Ang 301 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 4 |
English: Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਰੰਮ ਕੀ ਜਿਉ ਬੋਲਨਿ ਤਿਵੈ ਸੋਹੰਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: jin andar preet piram kee jiau bolan tivai sohan |
English: Those whose inner beings are filled with the Love of their Beloved, look beautiful as they speak.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਲਾਈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਰੰਨਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak har aape jaanadaa jin laaee preet piran |2|
English: O Nanak, the Lord Himself knows all; the Beloved Lord has infused His Love. ||2||

[Ang 301 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਅਭੁਲੁ ਹੈ ਭੁਲਣ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: too karataa aap abhul hai bhulan vich naahee |
English: O Creator Lord, You Yourself are infallible; You never make mistakes.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੁ ਸਚੇ ਭਲਾ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: too kareh su sache bhalaa hai gur sabad bujhaahee |
English: Whatever You do is good, O True Lord; this understanding is obtained through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: too karan kaaran samarath hai doojaa ko naahee |
English: You are the Cause of causes, the All-powerful Lord; there is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: too saahib agam deaal hai sabh tudh dhiaahee |
English: O Lord and Master, You are inaccessible and merciful. Everyone meditates on You.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਸਭਸ ਦਾ ਤੂ ਸਭ ਛਡਾਹੀ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: sabh jeea tere too sabhas daa too sabh chhaddaahee |4|
English: All beings are Yours; You belong to all. You deliver all. ||4||

[Ang 302 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 4 |
English: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਸੰਦੇਸਰਾ ਅਖੀ ਤਾਰ ਲਗੰਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: sun saajan prem sandesaraa akhee taar lagan |
English: Listen, O my Friend, to my message of love; my eyes are fixed upon You.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਸਜਣੁ ਮੇਲਿਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਵੰਨਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur tutthai sajan meliaa jan naanak sukh savan |1|
English: The Guru was pleased - He united servant Nanak with his friend, and now he sleeps in peace. ||1||

[Ang 302 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 4 |
English: Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦਇਆ ਸਦਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur daataa deaal hai jis no deaa sadaa hoe |
English: The True Guru is the Merciful Giver; He is always compassionate.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਇਕੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur andarahu niravair hai sabh dekhai braham ik soe |
English: The True Guru has no hatred within Him; He beholds the One God everywhere.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਵੈਰਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਜਿ ਵੈਰੁ ਚਲਾਇਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਤਿਸਟਿਆ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: niravairaa naal ji vair chalaaeide tin vichahu tisattiaa na koe |
English: Anyone who directs hate against the One who has no hate, shall never be satisfied within.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਦਾ ਭਲਾ ਮਨਾਇਦਾ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਬੁਰਾ ਕਿਉ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sabhanaa daa bhalaa manaaeidaa tis daa buraa kiau hoe |
English: The True Guru wishes everyone well; how can anything bad happen to Him?

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨੋ ਜੇਹਾ ਕੋ ਇਛਦਾ ਤੇਹਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur no jehaa ko ichhadaa tehaa fal paae koe |
English: As one feels towards the True Guru, so are the rewards he receives.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਜਿਦੂ ਕਿਛੁ ਗੁਝਾ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak karataa sabh kichh jaanadaa jidoo kichh gujhaa na hoe |2|
English: O Nanak, the Creator knows everything; nothing can be hidden from Him. ||2||

[Ang 302 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਵਡਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਵਡ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: jis no saahib vaddaa kare soee vadd jaanee |
English: One who has been made great by his Lord and Master - know him to be great!

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਸੋ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: jis saahib bhaavai tis bakhas le so saahib man bhaanee |
English: By His Pleasure, the Lord and Master forgives those who are pleasing to His Mind.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਓਸ ਦੀ ਰੀਸ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਮੂੜ ਅਜਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: je ko os dee rees kare so moorr ajaanee |
English: One who tries to compete with Him is a senseless fool.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੁ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: jis no satigur mele su gun ravai gun aakh vakhaanee |
English: One who is united with the Lord by the True Guru, sings His Praises and speaks His Glories.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਬੁਝਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak sachaa sach hai bujh sach samaanee |5|
English: O Nanak, the True Lord is True; one who understands Him is absorbed in Truth. ||5||

[Ang 302 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 4 |
English: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਅਮਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: har sat niranjan amar hai nirbhau niravair nirankaar |
English: The Lord is true, immaculate and eternal; He has no fear, hatred or form.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਜਪਿਆ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕ ਚਿਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਲਥਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਭਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jin japiaa ik man ik chit tin lathaa haumai bhaar |
English: Those who chant and meditate on Him, who single-mindedly focus their consciousness on Him, are rid of the burden of their ego.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jin guramukh har aaraadhiaa tin sant janaa jaikaar |
English: Those Gurmukhs who worship and adore the Lord - hail to those Saintly beings!

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਫਿਟੁ ਫਿਟੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: koee nindaa kare poore satiguroo kee tis no fitt fitt kahai sabh sansaar |
English: If someone slanders the Perfect True Guru, he will be rebuked and reproached by the whole world.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਰਖਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: satigur vich aap varatadaa har aape rakhanahaar |
English: The Lord Himself abides within the True Guru; He Himself is His Protector.

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਦਾ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan guroo gun gaavadaa tis no sadaa sadaa namasakaar |
English: Blessed, Blessed is the Guru, who sings the Glories of God. Unto Him, I bow forever and ever in deepest reverence.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਜਪਿਆ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak tin kau vaariaa jin japiaa sirajanahaar |1|
English: Servant Nanak is a sacrifice to those who have meditated on the Creator Lord. ||1||

[Ang 302 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 4 |
English: Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਕਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape dharatee saajeean aape aakaas |
English: He Himself made the earth; He Himself made the sky.

Gurbani: ਵਿਚਿ ਆਪੇ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇਅਨੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਗਿਰਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: vich aape jant upaaeian mukh aape dee giraas |
English: He Himself created the beings there, and He Himself places food in their mouths.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: sabh aape aap varatadaa aape hee gunataas |
English: He Himself is All-pervading; He Himself is the Treasure of Excellence.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਟੇ ਤਾਸੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jan naanak naam dhiaae too sabh kilavikh katte taas |2|
English: O servant Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; He shall take away all your sinful mistakes. ||2||

[Ang 302 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: too sachaa saahib sach hai sach sache bhaavai |
English: You, O True Lord and Master, are True; the Truth is pleasing to the True One.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਜਮ ਕੰਕਰੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jo tudh sach salaahade tin jam kankar nerr na aavai |
English: The Messenger of Death does not even approach those who praise You, O True Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਦਰਿ ਉਜਲੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਚਾ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: tin ke mukh dar ujale jin har hiradai sachaa bhaavai |
English: Their faces are radiant in the Court of the Lord; the Lord is pleasing to their hearts.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਪਿਛਾਹਾ ਸਟੀਅਨਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਪਟੁ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: koorriaar pichhaahaa satteean koorr hiradai kapatt mahaa dukh paavai |
English: The false ones are left behind; because of the falsehood and deceit in their hearts, they suffer in terrible pain.

Gurbani: ਮੁਹ ਕਾਲੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੀਆ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਕੂੜੋ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: muh kaale koorriaareea koorriaar koorro hoe jaavai |6|
English: Black are the faces of the false; the false remain just false. ||6||

[Ang 302 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 4 |
English: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਧਰਤੀ ਧਰਮ ਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੇਹਾ ਕੋ ਬੀਜੇ ਤੇਹਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: satigur dharatee dharam hai tis vich jehaa ko beeje tehaa fal paae |
English: The True Guru is the field of Dharma; as one plants the seeds there, so are the fruits obtained.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਿਖੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬੀਜਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gurasikhee amrit beejiaa tin amrit fal har paae |
English: The GurSikhs plant ambrosial nectar, and obtain the Lord as their ambrosial fruit.

Gurbani: ਓਨਾ ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਓਇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਚੀ ਪੈਨਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: onaa halat palat mukh ujale oe har daragah sachee painaae |
English: Their faces are radiant in this world and the next; in the Court of the Lord, they are robed with honor.

Gurbani: ਇਕਨੑਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਖੋਟੁ ਨਿਤ ਖੋਟੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਓਹੁ ਜੇਹਾ ਬੀਜੇ ਤੇਹਾ ਫਲੁ ਖਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: eikanaa andar khott nit khott kamaaveh ohu jehaa beeje tehaa fal khaae |
English: Some have cruelty in their hearts - they constantly act in cruelty; as they plant, so are the fruits which they eat.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਰਾਫੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਸੁਆਵਗੀਰ ਸਭਿ ਉਘੜਿ ਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: jaa satigur saraaf nadar kar dekhai suaavageer sabh ugharr aae |
English: When the True Guru, the Tester, observes with His Glance, the selfish ones are all exposed.

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਜੇਹਾ ਚਿਤਵਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਤੇਹਾ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਓਇ ਤੇਹੋ ਜੇਹੇ ਦਯਿ ਵਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: oe jehaa chitaveh nit tehaa paaein oe teho jehe day vajaae |
English: As one thinks, so does he receive, and so does the Lord make him known.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੁਹੀ ਸਿਰੀ ਖਸਮੁ ਆਪੇ ਵਰਤੈ ਨਿਤ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਚਲਤ ਸਬਾਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak duhee siree khasam aape varatai nit kar kar dekhai chalat sabaae |1|
English: O Nanak, the Lord and Master is pervading at both ends; He continually acts, and beholds His own play. ||1||

[Ang 303 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 4 |
English: Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਇਕੁ ਮਨੁ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਗੈ ਸੋ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: eik man ik varatadaa jit lagai so thaae paae |
English: The mortal is of one mind - whatever he dedicates it to, in that he is successful.

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਗਲਾ ਕਰੇ ਘਨੇਰੀਆ ਜਿ ਘਰਿ ਵਥੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਾਈ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: koee galaa kare ghanereea ji ghar vath hovai saaee khaae |
English: Some talk a lot, but they eat only that which is in their own homes.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੋਝੀ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਨ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin satigur sojhee naa pavai ahankaar na vichahu jaae |
English: Without the True Guru, understanding is not obtained, and egotism does not depart from within.

Gurbani: ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀਆ ਨੋ ਦੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਹੈ ਹਥੁ ਤਡਹਿ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮੰਗਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: ahankaareea no dukh bhukh hai hath taddeh ghar ghar mangaae |
English: Suffering and hunger cling to the egotistical people; they hold out their hands and beg from door to door.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜੁ ਠਗੀ ਗੁਝੀ ਨਾ ਰਹੈ ਮੁਲੰਮਾ ਪਾਜੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: koorr tthagee gujhee naa rahai mulamaa paaj leh jaae |
English: Their falsehood and fraud cannot remain concealed; their false appearances fall off in the end.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: jis hovai poorab likhiaa tis satigur milai prabh aae |
English: One who has such pre-ordained destiny comes to meet God through the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਲੋਹਾ ਪਾਰਸਿ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੁਵਰਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jiau lohaa paaras bhetteeai mil sangat suvaran hoe jaae |
English: Just as iron is transmuted into gold by the touch of the Philosopher's Stone, so are people transformed by joining the Sangat, the Holy Congregation.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੂ ਧਣੀ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jan naanak ke prabh too dhanee jiau bhaavai tivai chalaae |2|
English: O God, You are the Master of servant Nanak; as it pleases You, You lead him. ||2||

[Ang 303 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jin har hiradai seviaa tin har aap milaae |
English: One who serves the Lord with all his heart - the Lord Himself unites him with Himself.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਕੀ ਸਾਝਿ ਤਿਨ ਸਿਉ ਕਰੀ ਸਭਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gun kee saajh tin siau karee sabh avagan sabad jalaae |
English: He enters into a partnership with virtue and merit, and burns off all his demerits with the fire of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਅਉਗਣ ਵਿਕਣਿ ਪਲਰੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੁ ਸਚੇ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aaugan vikan palaree jis dehi su sache paae |
English: Demerits are purchased cheap, like straw; he alone gathers merit, who is so blessed by the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਅਉਗਣ ਮੇਟਿ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਟੀਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: balihaaree gur aapane jin aaugan mett gun paragatteeae |
English: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, who has erased my demerits, and revealed my virtuous merits.

Gurbani: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੇ ਕੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਲਾਏ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: vaddee vaddiaaee vadde kee guramukh aalaae |7|
English: The Gurmukh chants the glorious greatness of the great Lord God. ||7||

[Ang 303 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 4 |
English: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜੋ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur vich vaddee vaddiaaee jo anadin har har naam dhiaavai |
English: Great is the greatness within the True Guru, who meditates night and day on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਮਤ ਸੁਚ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam ramat such sanjam har naame hee tripataavai |
English: The repetition of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is his purity and self-restraint; with the Name of the Lord, He is satisfied.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਾਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਰਖ ਕਰਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: har naam taan har naam deebaan har naamo rakh karaavai |
English: The Lord's Name is His power, and the Lord's Name is His Royal Court; the Lord's Name protects Him.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ਪੂਜੇ ਗੁਰ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਸੋ ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jo chit laae pooje gur moorat so man ichhe fal paavai |
English: One who centers his consciousness and worships the Guru, obtains the fruits of his mind's desires.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਮਾਰ ਦਿਵਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jo nindaa kare satigur poore kee tis karataa maar divaavai |
English: But one who slanders the Perfect True Guru, shall be killed and destroyed by the Creator.

Gurbani: ਫੇਰਿ ਓਹ ਵੇਲਾ ਓਸੁ ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਓਹੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਬੀਜਿਆ ਆਪੇ ਖਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: fer oeh velaa os hath na aavai ohu aapanaa beejiaa aape khaavai |
English: This opportunity shall not come into his hands again; he must eat what he himself has planted.

Gurbani: ਨਰਕਿ ਘੋਰਿ ਮੁਹਿ ਕਾਲੈ ਖੜਿਆ ਜਿਉ ਤਸਕਰੁ ਪਾਇ ਗਲਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: narak ghor muhi kaalai kharriaa jiau tasakar paae galaavai |
English: He shall be taken to the most horrible hell, with his face blackened like a thief, and a noose around his neck.

Gurbani: ਫਿਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਵੈ ਤਾ ਉਬਰੈ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: fir satigur kee saranee pavai taa ubarai jaa har har naam dhiaavai |
English: But if he should again take to the Sanctuary of the True Guru, and meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, then he shall be saved.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਬਾਤਾ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਏਵੈ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har baataa aakh sunaae naanak har karate evai bhaavai |1|
English: Nanak speaks and proclaims the Lord's Story; as it pleases the Creator, so does he speak. ||1||

[Ang 303 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 4 |
English: Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਮੰਨੈ ਓਹੁ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਮੁਠਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: poore gur kaa hukam na manai ohu manamukh agiaan mutthaa bikh maaeaa |
English: One who does not obey the Hukam, the Command of the Perfect Guru - that self-willed manmukh is plundered by his ignorance and poisoned by Maya.

Gurbani: ਓਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੂੜੋ ਕਰਿ ਬੁਝੈ ਅਣਹੋਦੇ ਝਗੜੇ ਦਯਿ ਓਸ ਦੈ ਗਲਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: os andar koorr koorro kar bujhai anahode jhagarre day os dai gal paaeaa |
English: Within him is falsehood, and he sees everyone else as false; the Lord has tied these useless conflicts around his neck.

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਗਲ ਫਰੋਸੀ ਕਰੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੀ ਓਸ ਦਾ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: ohu gal farosee kare bahuteree os daa boliaa kisai na bhaaeaa |
English: He babbles on and on, but the words he speaks please no one.

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਹੰਢੈ ਜਿਉ ਰੰਨ ਦੋੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਓਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਮੁਹੁ ਜੋੜੇ ਓਸੁ ਭੀ ਲਛਣੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: ohu ghar ghar handtai jiau ran duohaagan os naal muhu jorre os bhee lachhan laaeaa |
English: He wanders from house to house like an abandoned woman; whoever associates with him is stained by the mark of evil as well.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਅਲਿਪਤੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਓਸ ਦਾ ਪਾਸੁ ਛਡਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ਬਹਿ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh hoe su alipato varatai os daa paas chhadd gur paas beh jaaeaa |
English: Those who become Gurmukh avoid him; they forsake his company and sit near the Guru.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਪੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੁ ਭਲਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਪੰਚਹੁ ਓਨਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਸਭੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jo gur gope aapanaa su bhalaa naahee panchahu on laahaa mool sabh gavaaeaa |
English: O chosen people, O self-elect, one who does not publicly affirm his Guru is not a good person; he loses all his profits and capital.

Gurbani: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਆਗਮੁ ਨਿਗਮੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਉਪਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: pahilaa aagam nigam naanak aakh sunaae poore gur kaa bachan upar aaeaa |
English: People used to chant and recite the Shaastras and the Vedas, O Nanak, but now the Words of the Perfect Guru have come to be the most exalted of all.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਭਾਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਓਹ ਵੇਲਾ ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gurasikhaa vaddiaaee bhaavai gur poore kee manamukhaa oeh velaa hath na aaeaa |2|
English: The glorious greatness of the Perfect Guru is pleasing to the GurSikh; the self-willed manmukhs have lost this opportunity. ||2||

[Ang 304 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਭ ਦੂ ਵਡਾ ਹੈ ਸੋ ਲਏ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਟਿਕੇ ॥
Transliteration: sach sachaa sabh doo vaddaa hai so le jis satigur ttike |
English: The True Lord is truly the greatest of all; he alone obtains Him, who is anointed by the Guru.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਇਕੇ ॥
Transliteration: so satigur ji sach dhiaaeidaa sach sachaa satigur ike |
English: He is the True Guru, who meditates on the True Lord. The True Lord and the True Guru are truly One.

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੰਜੇ ਦੂਤ ਕੀਤੇ ਵਸਿ ਛਿਕੇ ॥
Transliteration: soee satigur purakh hai jin panje doot keete vas chhike |
English: He is the True Guru, the Primal Being, who has totally conquered his five passions.
