Gurbani: ਜਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਫਿਟੁ ਫਿਟੁ ਮੁਹ ਫਿਕੇ ॥
Transliteration: ji bin satigur seve aap ganaaeide tin andar koorr fitt fitt muh fike |
English: One who does not serve the True Guru, and who praises himself, is filled with falsehood within. Cursed, cursed is his ugly face.

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਬੋਲੇ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਮੁਹ ਕਾਲੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਚੁਕੇ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: oe bole kisai na bhaavanee muh kaale satigur te chuke |8|
English: His words are not pleasing to anyone; his face is blackened, and he is separated from the True Guru. ||8||

[Ang 304 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 4 |
English: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਖੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਿਰਸਾਣੀ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: har prabh kaa sabh khet hai har aap kirasaanee laaeaa |
English: Everyone is the field of the Lord God; the Lord Himself cultivates this field.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਖਸਿ ਜਮਾਈਅਨੁ ਮਨਮੁਖੀ ਮੂਲੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh bakhas jamaaeean manamukhee mool gavaaeaa |
English: The Gurmukh grows the crop of forgiveness, while the self-willed manmukh loses even his roots.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਬੀਜੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਭਲੇ ਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਖੇਤੁ ਜਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabh ko beeje aapane bhale no har bhaavai so khet jamaaeaa |
English: They all plant for their own good, but the Lord causes to grow only that field with which He is pleased.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਿਖੀ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬੀਜਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਫਲੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gurasikhee har amrit beejiaa har amrit naam fal amrit paaeaa |
English: The GurSikh plants the seed of the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar, and obtains the Lord's Ambrosial Naam as his Ambrosial Fruit.

Gurbani: ਜਮੁ ਚੂਹਾ ਕਿਰਸ ਨਿਤ ਕੁਰਕਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਢਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jam choohaa kiras nit kurakadaa har karatai maar kadtaaeaa |
English: The mouse of Death is continually gnawing away at the crop, but the Creator Lord has beaten it off and driven it away.

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਸਾਣੀ ਜੰਮੀ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਹਲ ਬਖਸ ਜਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kirasaanee jamee bhaau kar har bohal bakhas jamaaeaa |
English: The farm was successful, by the Love of the Lord, and the crop was produced by God's Grace.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਕਾੜਾ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਸਭੁ ਲਾਹਿਓਨੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tin kaa kaarraa andesaa sabh laahion jinee satigur purakh dhiaaeaa |
English: He has removed all the burning and anxiety of those, who have meditated on the True Guru, the Primal Being.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਤਰਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak naam araadhiaa aap tariaa sabh jagat taraaeaa |1|
English: O servant Nanak, one who worships and adores the Naam, the Name of the Lord, swims across, and saves the whole world as well. ||1||

[Ang 304 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 4 |
English: Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਾਰਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਅਟਿਆ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਰੇ ਗਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: saaraa din laalach attiaa manamukh hore galaa |
English: The self-willed manmukh is occupied with greed all day long, although he may claim otherwise.

Gurbani: ਰਾਤੀ ਊਘੈ ਦਬਿਆ ਨਵੇ ਸੋਤ ਸਭਿ ਢਿਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: raatee aooghai dabiaa nave sot sabh dtilaa |
English: At night, he is overcome by fatigue, and all his nine holes are weakened.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਦੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਜੋਰਾ ਅਮਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਿਤ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਭਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: manamukhaa dai sir joraa amar hai nit deveh bhalaa |
English: Over the head of the manmukh is the order of the woman; to her, he ever holds out his promises of goodness.

Gurbani: ਜੋਰਾ ਦਾ ਆਖਿਆ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਸੇ ਅਪਵਿਤ ਅਮੇਧ ਖਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: joraa daa aakhiaa purakh kamaavade se apavit amedh khalaa |
English: Those men who act according to the orders of women are impure, filthy and foolish.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਕੁਸੁਧ ਨਰ ਸੇ ਜੋਰਾ ਪੁਛਿ ਚਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaam viaape kusudh nar se joraa puchh chalaa |
English: Those impure men are engrossed in sexual desire; they consult their women and walk accordingly.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਆਖਿਐ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਸੋ ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਭਲ ਭਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: satigur kai aakhiai jo chalai so sat purakh bhal bhalaa |
English: One who walks as the True Guru tells him to, is the true man, the best of the best.

Gurbani: ਜੋਰਾ ਪੁਰਖ ਸਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇਅਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਖੇਲ ਸਭਿ ਖਿਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: joraa purakh sabh aap upaaeian har khel sabh khilaa |
English: He Himself created all women and men; the Lord Himself plays every play.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਵਣੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਲ ਭਲਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sabh teree banat banaavanee naanak bhal bhalaa |2|
English: You created the entire creation; O Nanak, it is the best of the best. ||2||

[Ang 304 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਹੈ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਕਿਉ ਤੁਲੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: too veparavaahu athaahu hai atul kiau tuleeai |
English: You are carefree, unfathomable and immeasurable; how can You be measured?

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: se vaddabhaagee ji tudh dhiaaeide jin satigur mileeai |
English: Those who have met the True Guru and who meditate on You are very fortunate.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਬਣੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: satigur kee baanee sat saroop hai gurabaanee baneeai |
English: The Word of the True Guru's Bani is the embodiment of Truth; through Gurbani, one becomes perfect.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਰੀਸੈ ਹੋਰਿ ਕਚੁ ਪਿਚੁ ਬੋਲਦੇ ਸੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਕੂੜੇ ਝੜਿ ਪੜੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: satigur kee reesai hor kach pich bolade se koorriaar koorre jharr parreeai |
English: Jealously emulating the True Guru, some others may speak of good and bad, but the false are destroyed by their falsehood.

Gurbani: ਓਨੑਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹੋਰੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਰੁ ਹੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਨੋ ਝਖਿ ਮਰਦੇ ਕੜੀਐ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: onaa andar hor mukh hor hai bikh maaeaa no jhakh marade karreeai |9|
English: Deep within them is one thing, and in their mouths is another; they suck in the poison of Maya, and then they painfully waste away. ||9||

[Ang 304 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 4 |
English: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਘਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur kee sevaa niramalee niramal jan hoe su sevaa ghaale |
English: Service to the True Guru is immaculate and pure; those humble beings who are pure perform this service.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਓਇ ਆਪੇ ਸਚੈ ਵਖਿ ਕਢੇ ਜਜਮਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: jin andar kapatt vikaar jhootth oe aape sachai vakh kadte jajamaale |
English: Those who have deceit, corruption and falsehood within - the True Lord Himself casts them out like lepers.

Gurbani: ਸਚਿਆਰ ਸਿਖ ਬਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ਘਾਲਨਿ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਨ ਲਭਨੀ ਕਿਤੈ ਥਾਇ ਭਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: sachiaar sikh beh satigur paas ghaalan koorriaar na labhanee kitai thaae bhaale |
English: The truthful Sikhs sit by the True Guru's side and serve Him. The false ones search, but find no place of rest.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਆਖਿਆ ਸੁਖਾਵੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਿਨਾ ਮੁਹ ਭਲੇਰੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਦਯਿ ਗਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: jinaa satigur kaa aakhiaa sukhaavai naahee tinaa muh bhalere fireh day gaale |
English: Those who are not pleased with the Words of the True Guru - their faces are cursed, and they wander around, condemned by God.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਰੀ ਸੇ ਕਿਚਰਕੁ ਵੇਰਾਈਅਨਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬੇਤਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: jin andar preet nahee har keree se kicharak veraaeean manamukh betaale |
English: Those who do not have the Love of the Lord within their hearts - how long can those demonic, self-willed manmukhs be consoled?

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਮਨੁ ਥਾਇ ਰਖੈ ਓਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਆਪਣੀ ਵਥੁ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur no milai su aapanaa man thaae rakhai ohu aap varatai aapanee vath naale |
English: One who meets the True Guru, keeps his mind in its own place; he spends only his own assets.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਕਨਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਇਕਿ ਆਪੇ ਵਖਿ ਕਢੈ ਠਗਵਾਲੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak ikanaa gur mel sukh devai ik aape vakh kadtai tthagavaale |1|
English: O servant Nanak, some are united with the Guru; to some, the Lord grants peace, while others - deceitful cheats - suffer in isolation. ||1||

[Ang 305 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 4 |
English: Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਕਾਜ ਦਯਿ ਆਦੇ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: jinaa andar naam nidhaan har tin ke kaaj day aade raas |
English: Those who have the treasure of the Lord's Name deep within their hearts - the Lord resolves their affairs.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਚੂਕੀ ਮੁਹਤਾਜੀ ਲੋਕਨ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅੰਗੁ ਕਰਿ ਬੈਠਾ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: tin chookee muhataajee lokan kee har prabh ang kar baitthaa paas |
English: They are no longer subservient to other people; the Lord God sits by them, at their side.

Gurbani: ਜਾਂ ਕਰਤਾ ਵਲਿ ਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਵਲਿ ਸਭਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: jaan karataa val taa sabh ko val sabh darasan dekh kareh saabaas |
English: When the Creator is on their side, then everyone is on their side. Beholding their vision, everyone applauds them.

Gurbani: ਸਾਹੁ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭਿ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਆਇ ਕਰਹਿ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: saahu paatisaahu sabh har kaa keea sabh jan kau aae kareh raharaas |
English: Kings and emperors are all created by the Lord; they all come and bow in reverence to the Lord's humble servant.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਵਡਾ ਸੇਵਿ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur poore kee vaddee vaddiaaee har vaddaa sev atul sukh paaeaa |
English: Great is the greatness of the Perfect Guru. Serving the Great Lord, I have obtained immeasurable peace.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਨਿਤ ਬਖਸੇ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur poorai daan deea har nihachal nit bakhase charrai savaaeaa |
English: The Lord has bestowed this eternal gift upon the Perfect Guru; His blessings increase day by day.

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਖਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਸੋ ਕਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਪਚਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: koee nindak vaddiaaee dekh na sakai so karatai aap pachaaeaa |
English: The slanderer, who cannot endure His greatness, is destroyed by the Creator Himself.

Gurbani: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣ ਬੋਲੈ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੇ ਭਗਤਾ ਨੋ ਸਦਾ ਰਖਦਾ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jan naanak gun bolai karate ke bhagataa no sadaa rakhadaa aaeaa |2|
English: Servant Nanak chants the Glorious Praises of the Creator, who protects His devotees forever. ||2||

[Ang 305 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅਗਮ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ਵਡ ਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: too saahib agam deaal hai vadd daataa daanaa |
English: You, O Lord and Master, are inaccessible and merciful; You are the Great Giver, All-knowing.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਮੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਕੋ ਦਿਸਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਤੂਹੈਂ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: tudh jevadd mai hor ko dis na aavee toohain sugharr merai man bhaanaa |
English: I can see no other as great as You; O Lord of Wisdom, You are pleasing to my mind.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਦਿਸਿ ਆਵਦਾ ਸਭੁ ਚਲਣਹਾਰਾ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: mohu kuttanb dis aavadaa sabh chalanahaaraa aavan jaanaa |
English: Emotional attachment to your family and everything you see is temporary, coming and going.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਚੇ ਹੋਰਤੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਦੇ ਸੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਕੂੜਾ ਤਿਨ ਮਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo bin sache horat chit laaeide se koorriaar koorraa tin maanaa |
English: Those who attach their consciousness to anything except the True Lord are false, and false is their pride.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਚੇ ਪਚਿ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਅਜਾਣਾ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: naanak sach dhiaae too bin sache pach pach mue ajaanaa |10|
English: O Nanak, meditate on the True Lord; without the True Lord, the ignorant rot away and putrefy to death. ||10||

[Ang 305 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 4 |
English: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਗੋ ਦੇ ਸਤ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਦਿਚੈ ਪਿਛੋ ਦੇ ਆਖਿਆ ਕੰਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: ago de sat bhaau na dichai pichho de aakhiaa kam na aavai |
English: At first, he did not show respect to the Guru; later, he offered excuses, but it is no use.

Gurbani: ਅਧ ਵਿਚਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ਗਲੀ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: adh vich firai manamukh vechaaraa galee kiau sukh paavai |
English: The wretched, self-willed manmukhs wander around and are stuck mid-way; how can they find peace by mere words?

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੁ ਕੂੜੀ ਆਵੈ ਕੂੜੀ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jis andar preet nahee satigur kee su koorree aavai koorree jaavai |
English: Those who have no love for the True Guru within their hearts come with falsehood, and leave with falsehood.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਤਾਂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: je kripaa kare meraa har prabh karataa taan satigur paarabraham nadaree aavai |
English: When my Lord God, the Creator, grants His Grace, then they come to see the True Guru as the Supreme Lord God.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀਵੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੇਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਾੜਾ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: taa apiau peevai sabad gur keraa sabh kaarraa andesaa bharam chukaavai |
English: Then, they drink in the Nectar, the Word of the Guru's Shabad; all burning, anxiety, and doubts are eliminated.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sadaa anand rahai din raatee jan naanak anadin har gun gaavai |1|
English: They remain in ecstasy forever, day and night; O servant Nanak, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, night and day. ||1||

[Ang 305 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 4 |
English: Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਜੋ ਸਿਖੁ ਅਖਾਏ ਸੁ ਭਲਕੇ ਉਠਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur satigur kaa jo sikh akhaae su bhalake utth har naam dhiaavai |
English: One who calls himself a Sikh of the Guru, the True Guru, shall rise in the early morning hours and meditate on the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਭਲਕੇ ਪਰਭਾਤੀ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: audam kare bhalake parabhaatee isanaan kare amrit sar naavai |
English: Upon arising early in the morning, he is to bathe, and cleanse himself in the pool of nectar.

Gurbani: ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪੈ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਦੋਖ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: aupades guroo har har jap jaapai sabh kilavikh paap dokh leh jaavai |
English: Following the Instructions of the Guru, he is to chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. All sins, misdeeds and negativity shall be erased.

Gurbani: ਫਿਰਿ ਚੜੈ ਦਿਵਸੁ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਗਾਵੈ ਬਹਦਿਆ ਉਠਦਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: fir charrai divas gurabaanee gaavai bahadiaa utthadiaa har naam dhiaavai |
English: Then, at the rising of the sun, he is to sing Gurbani; whether sitting down or standing up, he is to meditate on the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਧਿਆਏ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jo saas giraas dhiaae meraa har har so gurasikh guroo man bhaavai |
English: One who meditates on my Lord, Har, Har, with every breath and every morsel of food - that GurSikh becomes pleasing to the Guru's Mind.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਗੁਰੂ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jis no deaal hovai meraa suaamee tis gurasikh guroo upades sunaavai |
English: That person, unto whom my Lord and Master is kind and compassionate - upon that GurSikh, the Guru's Teachings are bestowed.

Gurbani: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਧੂੜਿ ਮੰਗੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਕੀ ਜੋ ਆਪਿ ਜਪੈ ਅਵਰਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jan naanak dhoorr mangai tis gurasikh kee jo aap japai avarah naam japaavai |2|
English: Servant Nanak begs for the dust of the feet of that GurSikh, who himself chants the Naam, and inspires others to chant it. ||2||

[Ang 306 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਸੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਥੋੜੇ ॥
Transliteration: jo tudh sach dhiaaeide se virale thorre |
English: Those who meditate on You, O True Lord - they are very rare.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਇਕੁ ਅਰਾਧਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਬਰਕਤਿ ਖਾਹਿ ਅਸੰਖ ਕਰੋੜੇ ॥
Transliteration: jo man chit ik araadhade tin kee barakat khaeh asankh karorre |
English: Those who worship and adore the One Lord in their conscious minds - through their generosity, countless millions are fed.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁਨੋ ਸਭ ਧਿਆਇਦੀ ਸੇ ਥਾਇ ਪਏ ਜੋ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਲੋੜੇ ॥
Transliteration: tudhuno sabh dhiaaeidee se thaae pe jo saahib lorre |
English: All meditate on You, but they alone are accepted, who are pleasing to their Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਖਾਦੇ ਪੈਨਦੇ ਸੇ ਮੁਏ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੇ ਕੋੜ੍ਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: jo bin satigur seve khaade painade se mue mar jame korrhe |
English: Those who eat and dress without serving the True Guru die; after death, those wretched lepers are consigned to reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਹਾਜਰੁ ਮਿਠਾ ਬੋਲਦੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਵਿਸੁ ਕਢਹਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਘੋਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: oe haajar mitthaa bolade baahar vis kadteh mukh ghole |
English: In His Sublime Presence, they talk sweetly, but behind His back, they exude poison from their mouths.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਖੋਟੇ ਦਯਿ ਵਿਛੋੜੇ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: man khotte day vichhorre |11|
English: The evil-minded are consigned to separation from the Lord. ||11||

[Ang 306 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 4 |
English: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਲੁ ਜੂਈ ਭਰਿਆ ਨੀਲਾ ਕਾਲਾ ਖਿਧੋਲੜਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਵੇਮੁਖਿ ਵੇਮੁਖੈ ਨੋ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: mal jooee bhariaa neelaa kaalaa khidholarraa tin vemukh vemukhai no paaeaa |
English: The faithless baymukh sent out his faithless servant, wearing a blue-black coat, filled with filth and vermin.

Gurbani: ਪਾਸਿ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਕੋਈ ਬਹਣਿ ਜਗਤ ਮਹਿ ਗੂਹ ਪੜਿ ਸਗਵੀ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਇ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: paas na deee koee behan jagat meh gooh parr sagavee mal laae manamukh aaeaa |
English: No one in the world will sit near him; the self-willed manmukh fell into manure, and returned with even more filth covering him.

Gurbani: ਪਰਾਈ ਜੋ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਚੁਗਲੀ ਨੋ ਵੇਮੁਖੁ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਭੇਜਿਆ ਓਥੈ ਭੀ ਮੁਹੁ ਕਾਲਾ ਦੁਹਾ ਵੇਮੁਖਾ ਦਾ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: paraaee jo nindaa chugalee no vemukh kar kai bhejiaa othai bhee muhu kaalaa duhaa vemukhaa daa karaaeaa |
English: The faithless baymukh was sent to slander and back-bite others, but when he went there, the faces of both he and his faithless master were blackened instead.

Gurbani: ਤੜ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਸਭਤੁ ਜਗਤ ਵਿਚਿ ਭਾਈ ਵੇਮੁਖੁ ਸਣੈ ਨਫਰੈ ਪਉਲੀ ਪਉਦੀ ਫਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਉਠਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tarr suniaa sabhat jagat vich bhaaee vemukh sanai nafarai paulee paudee faavaa hoe kai utth ghar aaeaa |
English: It was immediately heard throughout the whole world, O Siblings of Destiny, that this faithless man, along with his servant, was kicked and beaten with shoes; in humiliation, they got up and returned to their homes.

Gurbani: ਅਗੈ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਕੁੜਮੀ ਵੇਮੁਖੁ ਰਲਣਾ ਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਵਹੁਟੀ ਭਤੀਜਂੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਣਿ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: agai sangatee kurramee vemukh ralanaa na milai taa vahuttee bhateejanee fir aan ghar paaeaa |
English: The faithless baymukh was not allowed to mingle with others; his wife and niece then brought him home to lie down.

Gurbani: ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਦੋਵੈ ਗਏ ਨਿਤ ਭੁਖਾ ਕੂਕੇ ਤਿਹਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: halat palat dovai ge nit bhukhaa kooke tihaaeaa |
English: He has lost both this world and the next; he cries out continually, in hunger and thirst.

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਿਆਉ ਸਚੁ ਬਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan suaamee karataa purakh hai jin niaau sach beh aap karaaeaa |
English: Blessed, blessed is the Creator, the Primal Being, our Lord and Master; He Himself sits and dispenses true justice.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਸੋ ਸਾਚੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਚਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jo nindaa kare satigur poore kee so saachai maar pachaaeaa |
English: One who slanders the Perfect True Guru is punished and destroyed by the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਏਹੁ ਅਖਰੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਆਖਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ehu akhar tin aakhiaa jin jagat sabh upaaeaa |1|
English: This Word is spoken by the One who created the whole universe. ||1||

[Ang 306 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 4 |
English: Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਨੰਗਾ ਭੁਖਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਨਫਰੁ ਕਿਥਹੁ ਰਜਿ ਖਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: saahib jis kaa nangaa bhukhaa hovai tis daa nafar kithahu raj khaae |
English: One who has a poor beggar for a master - how can he be well-fed?

Gurbani: ਜਿ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਵਥੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਨਫਰੈ ਹਥਿ ਆਵੈ ਅਣਹੋਦੀ ਕਿਥਹੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: ji saahib kai ghar vath hovai su nafarai hath aavai anahodee kithahu paae |
English: If there is something in his master's house, he can get it; but how can he get what is not there?

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਦੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕੀਤੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਸਾ ਸੇਵਾ ਅਉਖੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jis dee sevaa keetee fir lekhaa mangeeai saa sevaa aaukhee hoee |
English: Serving him, who will be called to answer for his account? That service is painful and useless.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak sevaa karahu har gur safal darasan kee fir lekhaa mangai na koee |2|
English: O Nanak, serve the Guru, the Lord Incarnate; the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is profitable, and in the end, you shall not be called to account. ||2||

[Ang 306 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਵੀਚਾਰਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਚਾਰਿ ਵੇਦ ਕਹੰਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak veechaareh sant jan chaar ved kahande |
English: O Nanak, the Saints consider, and the four Vedas proclaim,

Gurbani: ਭਗਤ ਮੁਖੈ ਤੇ ਬੋਲਦੇ ਸੇ ਵਚਨ ਹੋਵੰਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat mukhai te bolade se vachan hovande |
English: that whatever the Lord's devotees utter with their mouths, shall come to pass.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪਹਾਰਾ ਜਾਪਦਾ ਸਭਿ ਲੋਕ ਸੁਣੰਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: pragatt pahaaraa jaapadaa sabh lok sunande |
English: He is manifest in His cosmic workshop. All people hear of this.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਮੁਗਧ ਨਰ ਸੰਤ ਨਾਲਿ ਖਹੰਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: sukh na paaein mugadh nar sant naal khahande |
English: The stubborn men who fight with the Saints shall never find peace.

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਲੋਚਨਿ ਓਨਾ ਗੁਣੈ ਨੋ ਓਇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਸੜੰਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: oe lochan onaa gunai no oe ahankaar sarrande |
English: The Saints seek to bless them with virtue, but they only burn in their egos.

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਾ ਭਾਗ ਧੁਰਿ ਮੰਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: oe vichaare kiaa kareh jaa bhaag dhur mande |
English: What can those wretched ones do, since, from the very beginning, their destiny is cursed with evil.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਸੇ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਸੰਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: jo maare tin paarabraham se kisai na sande |
English: Those who are struck down by the Supreme Lord God are of no use to anyone.

Gurbani: ਵੈਰੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਿਰਵੈਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਧਰਮ ਨਿਆਇ ਪਚੰਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: vair kareh niravair naal dharam niaae pachande |
English: Those who hate the One who has no hatred - according to the true justice of Dharma, they shall perish.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸੰਤਿ ਸਰਾਪਿਆ ਸੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਭਵੰਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: jo jo sant saraapiaa se fireh bhavande |
English: Those who are cursed by the Saints will continue wandering aimlessly.

Gurbani: ਪੇਡੁ ਮੁੰਢਾਹੂੰ ਕਟਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਡਾਲ ਸੁਕੰਦੇ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: pedd mundtaahoon kattiaa tis ddaal sukande |12|
English: When the tree is cut off at its roots, the branches wither and die. ||12||

[Ang 306 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 4 |
English: Salok Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: antar har guroo dhiaaeidaa vaddee vaddiaaee |
English: Great is the greatness of the Guru, who meditates on the Lord within.

Gurbani: ਤੁਸਿ ਦਿਤੀ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਘਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੀ ਘਟਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: tus ditee poorai satiguroo ghattai naahee ik til kisai dee ghattaaee |
English: By His Pleasure, the Lord has bestowed this upon the Perfect True Guru; it is not diminished one bit by anyone's efforts.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੈ ਵਲਿ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ ਝਖਿ ਝਖਿ ਮਰੈ ਸਭ ਲੋੁਕਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sach saahib satiguroo kai val hai taan jhakh jhakh marai sabh luokaaee |
English: The True Lord and Master is on the side of the True Guru; and so, all those who oppose Him waste away to death in anger, envy and conflict.

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦਕਾ ਕੇ ਮੁਹ ਕਾਲੇ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਵਧਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: nindakaa ke muh kaale kare har karatai aap vadhaaee |
English: The Lord, the Creator, blackens the faces of the slanderers, and increases the glory of the Guru.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਨਿੰਦ ਕਰਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਤਿਉ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jiau jiau nindak nind kareh tiau tiau nit nit charrai savaaee |
English: As the slanderers spread their slander, so does the Guru's glory increase day by day.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਪੈਰੀ ਆਣਿ ਸਭ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak har aaraadhiaa tin pairee aan sabh paaee |1|
English: Servant Nanak worships the Lord, who makes everyone fall at His Feet. ||1||

[Ang 307 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 4 |
English: Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਗਣਤ ਜਿ ਰਖੈ ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਗਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: satigur setee ganat ji rakhai halat palat sabh tis kaa geaa |
English: One who enters into a calculated relationship with the True Guru loses everything, this world and the next.

Gurbani: ਨਿਤ ਝਹੀਆ ਪਾਏ ਝਗੂ ਸੁਟੇ ਝਖਦਾ ਝਖਦਾ ਝੜਿ ਪਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: nit jhaheea paae jhagoo sutte jhakhadaa jhakhadaa jharr peaa |
English: He grinds his teeth continually and foams at the mouth; screaming in anger, he perishes.

Gurbani: ਨਿਤ ਉਪਾਵ ਕਰੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਧਨ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਅਗਲਾ ਧਨੁ ਭੀ ਉਡਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: nit upaav karai maaeaa dhan kaaran agalaa dhan bhee udd geaa |
English: He continually chases after Maya and wealth, but even his own wealth flies away.

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਓਹੁ ਖਟੇ ਕਿਆ ਓਹੁ ਖਾਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa ohu khatte kiaa ohu khaavai jis andar sahasaa dukh peaa |
English: What shall he earn, and what shall he eat? Within his heart, there is only cynicism and pain.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਵੈਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਜਿ ਵੈਰੁ ਰਚਾਏ ਸਭੁ ਪਾਪੁ ਜਗਤੈ ਕਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: niravairai naal ji vair rachaae sabh paap jagatai kaa tin sir leaa |
English: One who hates the One who has no hatred, shall bear the load of all the sins of the world on his head.

Gurbani: ਓਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਪਿਛੈ ਢੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਮੁਹਿ ਅੰਬੁ ਪਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: os agai pichhai dtoee naahee jis andar nindaa muhi anb peaa |
English: He shall find no shelter here or hereafter; his mouth blisters with the slander in his heart.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਸੁਇਨੇ ਨੋ ਓਹੁ ਹਥੁ ਪਾਏ ਤਾ ਖੇਹੂ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਲਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: je sueine no ohu hath paae taa khehoo setee ral geaa |
English: If gold comes into his hands, it turns to dust.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਓਹੁ ਆਵੈ ਤਾ ਪਿਛਲੇ ਅਉਗਣ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: je gur kee saranee fir ohu aavai taa pichhale aaugan bakhas leaa |
English: But if he should come again to the Sanctuary of the Guru, then even his past sins shall be forgiven.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਗਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jan naanak anadin naam dhiaaeaa har simarat kilavikh paap geaa |2|
English: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, night and day. Remembering the Lord in meditation, wickedness and sins are erased. ||2||

[Ang 307 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਤੂਹੈ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਤੂ ਸਭ ਦੂ ਉਪਰਿ ਤੂ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: toohai sachaa sach too sabh doo upar too deebaan |
English: You are the Truest of the True; Your Regal Court is the most exalted of all.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਸਚੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸਚੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: jo tudh sach dhiaaeide sach sevan sache teraa maan |
English: Those who meditate on You, O True Lord, serve the Truth; O True Lord, they take pride in You.

Gurbani: ਓਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਸਚੁ ਬੋਲਨਿ ਸਚੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: onaa andar sach mukh ujale sach bolan sache teraa taan |
English: Within them is the Truth; their faces are radiant, and they speak the Truth. O True Lord, You are their strength.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: se bhagat jinee guramukh saalaahiaa sach sabad neesaan |
English: Those who, as Gurmukh, praise You are Your devotees; they have the insignia and the banner of the Shabad, the True Word of God.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਜਿ ਸਚੇ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਵਾਰੀ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: sach ji sache sevade tin vaaree sad kurabaan |13|
English: I am truly a sacrifice, forever devoted to those who serve the True Lord. ||13||

[Ang 307 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 4 |
English: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਧੁਰਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸੇਈ ਹੁਣਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: dhur maare poorai satiguroo seee hun satigur maare |
English: Those who were cursed by the Perfect True Guru, from the very beginning, are even now cursed by the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਮੇਲਣ ਨੋ ਬਹੁਤੇਰਾ ਲੋਚੀਐ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਮਿਲਣ ਕਰਤਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: je melan no bahuteraa locheeai na deee milan karataare |
English: Even though they may have a great longing to associate with the Guru, the Creator does not allow it.

Gurbani: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਢੋਈ ਨਾ ਲਹਨਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: satasangat dtoee naa lehan vich sangat gur veechaare |
English: They shall not find shelter in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation; in the Sangat, the Guru has proclaimed this.

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਜਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਹੁਣਿ ਓਨਾ ਨੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਜਮੁ ਜੰਦਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: koee jaae milai hun onaa no tis maare jam jandaare |
English: Whoever goes out to meet them now, will be destroyed by the tyrant, the Messenger of Death.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਬਾਬੈ ਫਿਟਕੇ ਸੇ ਫਿਟੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਅੰਗਦਿ ਕੀਤੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur baabai fittake se fitte gur angad keete koorriaare |
English: Those who were condemned by Guru Nanak were declared counterfeit by Guru Angad as well.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਤੀਜੀ ਪੀੜੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿਆ ਕਿਆ ਹਥਿ ਏਨਾ ਵੇਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur teejee peerree veechaariaa kiaa hath enaa vechaare |
English: The Guru of the third generation thought, "What lies in the hands of these poor people?"

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਚਉਥੀ ਪੀੜੀ ਟਿਕਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਦੁਸਟ ਸਭਿ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur chauthee peerree ttikiaa tin nindak dusatt sabh taare |
English: The Guru of the fourth generation saved all these slanderers and evil-doers.

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਪੁਤੁ ਸਿਖੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਭਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: koee put sikh sevaa kare satiguroo kee tis kaaraj sabh savaare |
English: If any son or Sikh serves the True Guru, then all of his affairs will be resolved.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਇਛੈ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ ਪੁਤੁ ਧਨੁ ਲਖਮੀ ਖੜਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jo ichhai so fal paaeisee put dhan lakhamee kharr mele har nisataare |
English: He obtains the fruits of his desires - children, wealth, property, union with the Lord and emancipation.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sabh nidhaan satiguroo vich jis andar har ur dhaare |
English: All treasures are in the True Guru, who has enshrined the Lord within the heart.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਲਿਲਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: so paae pooraa satiguroo jis likhiaa likhat lilaare |
English: He alone obtains the Perfect True Guru, on whose forehead such blessed destiny is pre-ordained.

Gurbani: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਧੂੜਿ ਤਿਨ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮਿਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak maagai dhoorr tin jo gurasikh mit piaare |1|
English: Servant Nanak begs for the dust of the feet of those GurSikhs who love the Lord, their Friend. ||1||

[Ang 308 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 4 |
English: Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਆਪਿ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਗਤੁ ਭੀ ਆਪੇ ਆਣਿ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jin kau aap dee vaddiaaee jagat bhee aape aan tin kau pairee paae |
English: The Lord Himself bestows glorious greatness; He Himself causes the world to come and fall at their feet.

Gurbani: ਡਰੀਐ ਤਾਂ ਜੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪ ਦੂ ਕੀਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਣੀ ਕਲਾ ਵਧਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: ddareeai taan je kichh aap doo keechai sabh karataa aapanee kalaa vadhaae |
English: We should only be afraid, if we try to do things by ourselves; the Creator is increasing His Power in every way.

Gurbani: ਦੇਖਹੁ ਭਾਈ ਏਹੁ ਅਖਾੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਚੇ ਕਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਜੋਰਿ ਸਭਿ ਆਣਿ ਨਿਵਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: dekhahu bhaaee ehu akhaarraa har preetam sache kaa jin aapanai jor sabh aan nivaae |
English: Behold, O Siblings of Destiny: this is the Arena of the Beloved True Lord; His power brings everyone to bow in humility.

Gurbani: ਆਪਣਿਆ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਰਖ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨਿੰਦਕਾ ਦੁਸਟਾ ਕੇ ਮੁਹ ਕਾਲੇ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aapaniaa bhagataa kee rakh kare har suaamee nindakaa dusattaa ke muh kaale karaae |
English: The Lord, our Lord and Master, preserves and protects His devotees; He blackens the faces of the slanderers and evil-doers.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਨਿਤ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਤ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: satigur kee vaddiaaee nit charrai savaaee har keerat bhagat nit aap karaae |
English: The glorious greatness of the True Guru increases day by day; the Lord inspires His devotees to continually sing the Kirtan of His Praises.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਘਰੀ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: anadin naam japahu gurasikhahu har karataa satigur gharee vasaae |
English: O GurSikhs, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, night and day; through the True Guru, the Creator Lord will come to dwell within the home of your inner being.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਮੁਹਹੁ ਕਢਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: satigur kee baanee sat sat kar jaanahu gurasikhahu har karataa aap muhahu kadtaae |
English: O GurSikhs, know that the Bani, the Word of the True Guru, is true, absolutely true. The Creator Lord Himself causes the Guru to chant it.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਕੇ ਮੁਹ ਉਜਲੇ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਸਭਤੁ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gurasikhaa ke muh ujale kare har piaaraa gur kaa jaikaar sansaar sabhat karaae |
English: The Beloved Lord makes the faces of His GurSikhs radiant; He makes the whole world applaud and acclaim the Guru.

Gurbani: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jan naanak har kaa daas hai har daasan kee har paij rakhaae |2|
English: Servant Nanak is the slave of the Lord; the Lord Himself preserves the honor of His slave. ||2||

[Ang 308 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: too sachaa saahib aap hai sach saah hamaare |
English: O My True Lord and Master, You Yourself are my True Lord King.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਪੂਜੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ਥਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sach poojee naam drirraae prabh vanajaare thaare |
English: Please, implant within me the true treasure of Your Name; O God, I am Your merchant.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਕਥਹ ਨਿਰਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sach seveh sach vananj laihi gun kathah niraare |
English: I serve the True One, and deal in the True One; I chant Your Wondrous Praises.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਕ ਭਾਇ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sevak bhaae se jan mile gur sabad savaare |
English: Those humble beings who serve the Lord with love meet Him; they are adorned with the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਖਾਰੇ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: too sachaa saahib alakh hai gur sabad lakhaare |14|
English: O my True Lord and Master, You are unknowable; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, You are known. ||14||

[Ang 308 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 4 |
English: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤਾਤਿ ਪਰਾਈ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਭਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: jis andar taat paraaee hovai tis daa kade na hovee bhalaa |
English: One whose heart is filled with jealousy of others, never comes to any good.

Gurbani: ਓਸ ਦੈ ਆਖਿਐ ਕੋਈ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਨਿਤ ਓਜਾੜੀ ਪੂਕਾਰੇ ਖਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: os dai aakhiai koee na lagai nit ojaarree pookaare khalaa |
English: No one pays any attention to what he says; he is just a fool, crying out endlessly in the wilderness.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਚੁਗਲੀ ਚੁਗਲੋ ਵਜੈ ਕੀਤਾ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਓਸ ਦਾ ਸਭੁ ਗਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jis andar chugalee chugalo vajai keetaa karatiaa os daa sabh geaa |
English: One whose heart is filled with malicious gossip, is known as a malicious gossip; everything he does is in vain.

Gurbani: ਨਿਤ ਚੁਗਲੀ ਕਰੇ ਅਣਹੋਦੀ ਪਰਾਈ ਮੁਹੁ ਕਢਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਓਸ ਦਾ ਕਾਲਾ ਭਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: nit chugalee kare anahodee paraaee muhu kadt na sakai os daa kaalaa bheaa |
English: Night and day, he continually gossips about others; his face has been blackened, and he cannot show it to anyone.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੇਹਾ ਕੋ ਬੀਜੇ ਤੇਹਾ ਕੋ ਖਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: karam dharatee sareer kalijug vich jehaa ko beeje tehaa ko khaae |
English: The body is the field of action, in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga; as you plant, so shall you harvest.

Gurbani: ਗਲਾ ਉਪਰਿ ਤਪਾਵਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਵਿਸੁ ਖਾਧੀ ਤਤਕਾਲ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: galaa upar tapaavas na hoee vis khaadhee tatakaal mar jaae |
English: Justice is not passed on mere words; if someone eats poison, he dies.

Gurbani: ਭਾਈ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਨਿਆਉ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਾ ਜੇਹਾ ਕੋਈ ਕਰੇ ਤੇਹਾ ਕੋਈ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: bhaaee vekhahu niaau sach karate kaa jehaa koee kare tehaa koee paae |
English: O Siblings of Destiny, behold the justice of the True Creator; as people act, so they are rewarded.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਸਭ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰ ਕੀਆ ਬਾਤਾ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak kau sabh sojhee paaee har dar keea baataa aakh sunaae |1|
English: The Lord has bestowed total understanding upon servant Nanak; he speaks and proclaims the words of the Lord's Court. ||1||

[Ang 308 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 4 |
English: Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹੋਦੈ ਪਰਤਖਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਜੋ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਦਰਿ ਢੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: hodai paratakh guroo jo vichhurre tin kau dar dtoee naahee |
English: Those who separate themselves from the Guru, in spite of His Constant Presence - they find no place of rest in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਜਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਨ ਨਿੰਦਕਾ ਮੁਹ ਫਿਕੇ ਥੁਕ ਥੁਕ ਮੁਹਿ ਪਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: koee jaae milai tin nindakaa muh fike thuk thuk muhi paahee |
English: If someone goes to meet with those dull-faced slanderers, he will find their faces covered with spit.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਫਿਟਕੇ ਸੇ ਸਭ ਜਗਤਿ ਫਿਟਕੇ ਨਿਤ ਭੰਭਲ ਭੂਸੇ ਖਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jo satigur fittake se sabh jagat fittake nit bhanbhal bhoose khaahee |
English: Those who are cursed by the True Guru, are cursed by all the world. They wander around endlessly.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਪਿਆ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੇ ਲੈਦੇ ਢਹਾ ਫਿਰਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jin gur gopiaa aapanaa se laide dtahaa firaahee |
English: Those who do not publicly affirm their Guru wander around, moaning and groaning.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਭੁਖ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਨਿਤ ਭੁਖਾ ਭੁਖ ਕੂਕਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: tin kee bhukh kade na utarai nit bhukhaa bhukh kookaahee |
English: Their hunger shall never depart; afflicted by constant hunger, they cry out in pain.

Gurbani: ਓਨਾ ਦਾ ਆਖਿਆ ਕੋ ਨਾ ਸੁਣੈ ਨਿਤ ਹਉਲੇ ਹਉਲਿ ਮਰਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: onaa daa aakhiaa ko naa sunai nit haule haul maraahee |
English: No one hears what they have to say; they live in constant fear and terror, until they finally die.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵੇਖਿ ਨ ਸਕਨੀ ਓਨਾ ਅਗੈ ਪਿਛੈ ਥਾਉ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: satigur kee vaddiaaee vekh na sakanee onaa agai pichhai thaau naahee |
English: They cannot bear the glorious greatness of the True Guru, and they find no place of rest, here or hereafter.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਜਾਇ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਰਹਦੀ ਖੁਹਦੀ ਸਭ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jo satigur maare tin jaae mileh rahadee khuhadee sabh pat gavaahee |
English: Those who go out to meet with those who have been cursed by the True Guru, lose all remnants of their honor.

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਅਗੈ ਕੁਸਟੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਫਿਟਕੇ ਜਿ ਓਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੁਸਟੁ ਉਠਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: oe agai kusattee gur ke fittake ji os milai tis kusatt utthaahee |
English: They have already become like lepers; cursed by the Guru, whoever meets them is also afflicted with leprosy.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਜੋ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: har tin kaa darasan naa karahu jo doojai bhaae chit laahee |
English: O Lord, I pray that I may not even catch sight of those, who focus their consciousness on the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਕਿਹੁ ਚਾਰਾ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: dhur karatai aap likh paaeaa tis naal kihu chaaraa naahee |
English: That which the Creator pre-ordained from the very beginning - there can be no escape from that.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਤੂ ਤਿਸੁ ਅਪੜਿ ਕੋ ਨ ਸਕਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jan naanak naam araadh too tis aparr ko na sakaahee |
English: O servant Nanak, worship and adore the Naam, the Name of the Lord; no one can equal it.

Gurbani: ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੀ ਹੈ ਨਿਤ ਸਵਾਈ ਚੜੈ ਚੜਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naavai kee vaddiaaee vaddee hai nit savaaee charrai charraahee |2|
English: Great is the greatness of His Name; it increases, day by day. ||2||

[Ang 309 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 4 |
English: Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿ ਹੋਂਦੈ ਗੁਰੂ ਬਹਿ ਟਿਕਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: ji hondai guroo beh ttikiaa tis jan kee vaddiaaee vaddee hoee |
English: Great is the greatness of that humble being, whom the Guru Himself anointed in His Presence.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਕਉ ਜਗਤੁ ਨਿਵਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਇਆ ਜਸੁ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਲੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: tis kau jagat niviaa sabh pairee peaa jas varatiaa loee |
English: All the world comes and bows to him, falling at his feet. His praises spread throughout the world.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹਥੁ ਧਰਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਸੋ ਪੂਰਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: tis kau khandd brahamandd namasakaar kareh jis kai masatak hath dhariaa gur poorai so pooraa hoee |
English: The galaxies and solar systems bow in reverence to him; the Perfect Guru has placed His hand upon his head, and he has become perfect.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਨਿਤ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਈ ਅਪੜਿ ਕੋ ਨ ਸਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur kee vaddiaaee nit charrai savaaee aparr ko na sakoee |
English: The glorious greatness of the Guru increases day by day; no one can equal it.

Gurbani: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਬਹਿ ਟਿਕਿਆ ਆਪੇ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jan naanak har karatai aap beh ttikiaa aape paij rakhai prabh soee |3|
English: O servant Nanak, the Creator Lord Himself established him; God preserves his honor. ||3||

[Ang 309 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋਟੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹਟਨਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa kott apaar hai andar hattanaale |
English: The human body is a great fortress, with its shops and streets within.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਉਦਾ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh saudaa jo kare har vasat samaale |
English: The Gurmukh who comes to trade gathers the cargo of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਵਣਜੀਐ ਹੀਰੇ ਪਰਵਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: naam nidhaan har vanajeeai heere paravaale |
English: He deals in the treasure of the Lord's Name, the jewels and the diamonds.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਜਿ ਹੋਰ ਥੈ ਧਨੁ ਖੋਜਦੇ ਸੇ ਮੂੜ ਬੇਤਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: vin kaaeaa ji hor thai dhan khojade se moorr betaale |
English: Those who search for this treasure outside of the body, in other places, are foolish demons.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਉਝੜਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭਵਾਈਅਹਿ ਜਿਉ ਝਾੜ ਮਿਰਗੁ ਭਾਲੇ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: se ujharr bharam bhavaaeeeh jiau jhaarr mirag bhaale |15|
English: They wander around in the wilderness of doubt, like the deer who searches for the musk in the bushes. ||15||

[Ang 309 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 4 |
English: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਸੁ ਅਉਖਾ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jo nindaa kare satigur poore kee su aaukhaa jag meh hoeaa |
English: One who slanders the Perfect True Guru, shall have difficulty in this world.

Gurbani: ਨਰਕ ਘੋਰੁ ਦੁਖ ਖੂਹੁ ਹੈ ਓਥੈ ਪਕੜਿ ਓਹੁ ਢੋਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: narak ghor dukh khoohu hai othai pakarr ohu dtoeaa |
English: He is caught and thrown into the most horrible hell, the well of pain and suffering.

Gurbani: ਕੂਕ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਕੋ ਨ ਸੁਣੇ ਓਹੁ ਅਉਖਾ ਹੋਇ ਹੋਇ ਰੋਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kook pukaar ko na sune ohu aaukhaa hoe hoe roeaa |
English: No one listens to his shrieks and cries; he cries out in pain and misery.

Gurbani: ਓਨਿ ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਲਾਹਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਸਭੁ ਖੋਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: on halat palat sabh gavaaeaa laahaa mool sabh khoeaa |
English: He totally loses this world and the next; he has lost all of his investment and profit.

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਤੇਲੀ ਸੰਦਾ ਬਲਦੁ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਤ ਭਲਕੇ ਉਠਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਜੋਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: ohu telee sandaa balad kar nit bhalake utth prabh joeaa |
English: He is like the ox at the oil-press; each morning when he rises, God places the yoke upon him.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਸੁਣੈ ਨਿਤ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਦੂ ਕਿਛੁ ਗੁਝਾ ਨ ਹੋਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: har vekhai sunai nit sabh kichh tidoo kichh gujhaa na hoeaa |
English: The Lord always sees and hears everything; nothing can be concealed from Him.

Gurbani: ਜੈਸਾ ਬੀਜੇ ਸੋ ਲੁਣੈ ਜੇਹਾ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਬੋਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jaisaa beeje so lunai jehaa purab kinai boeaa |
English: As you plant, so shall you harvest, according to what you planted in the past.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਧੋਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jis kripaa kare prabh aapanee tis satigur ke charan dhoeaa |
English: One who is blessed by God's Grace washes the feet of the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਿਛੈ ਤਰਿ ਗਇਆ ਜਿਉ ਲੋਹਾ ਕਾਠ ਸੰਗੋਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur satigur pichhai tar geaa jiau lohaa kaatth sangoeaa |
English: He is carried across by the Guru, the True Guru, like iron which is carried across by wood.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak naam dhiaae too jap har har naam sukh hoeaa |1|
English: O servant Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, peace is obtained. ||1||

[Ang 309 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 4 |
English: Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: vaddabhaageea sohaaganee jinaa guramukh miliaa har raae |
English: Very fortunate is the soul-bride, who, as Gurmukh, meets the Lord, her King.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰ ਜੋਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੀਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: antar jot pragaaseea naanak naam samaae |2|
English: Her inner being is illiminated with His Divine Light; O Nanak, she is absorbed in His Name. ||2||

[Ang 309 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੋਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: eihu sareer sabh dharam hai jis andar sache kee vich jot |
English: This body is the home of Dharma; the Divine Light of the True Lord is within it.

Gurbani: ਗੁਹਜ ਰਤਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਲੁਕਿ ਰਹੇ ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਕਢੈ ਖੋਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: guhaj ratan vich luk rahe koee guramukh sevak kadtai khot |
English: Hidden within it are the jewels of mystery; how rare is that Gurmukh, that selfless servant, who digs them out.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਤਾਂ ਇਕੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਇਕੋ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: sabh aatam raam pachhaaniaa taan ik raviaa iko ot pot |
English: When someone realizes the All-pervading Soul, then he sees the One and Only Lord permeating, through and through.

Gurbani: ਇਕੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਇਕੁ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਇਕੋ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਸ੍ਰਵਣ ਸਰੋਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: eik dekhiaa ik maniaa iko suniaa sravan sarot |
English: He sees the One, he believes in the One, and with his ears, he listens only to the One.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਤੂ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਹੋਤਿ ॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: jan naanak naam salaeh too sach sache sevaa teree hot |16|
English: O servant Nanak, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord; this is your service to the Lord, the Truest of the True. ||16||

[Ang 310 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 4 |
English: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: sabh ras tin kai ridai heh jin har vasiaa man maeh |
English: All joy is in the hearts of those, within whose minds the Lord abides.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਸਭਿ ਦੇਖਣ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: har darageh te mukh ujale tin kau sabh dekhan jaeh |
English: In the Court of the Lord, their faces are radiant, and everyone goes to see them.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਭਉ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jin nirbhau naam dhiaaeaa tin kau bhau koee naeh |
English: Those who meditate on the Name of the Fearless Lord have no fear.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਉਤਮੁ ਤਿਨੀ ਸਰੇਵਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਆਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: har utam tinee sareviaa jin kau dhur likhiaa aaeh |
English: Those who have such pre-destined destiny remember the Sublime Lord.

Gurbani: ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਪੈਨਾਈਅਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: te har darageh painaaeeeh jin har vutthaa man maeh |
English: Those, within whose minds the Lord abides, are robed with honor in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਆਪਿ ਤਰੇ ਸਭ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਿਉ ਤਿਨ ਪਿਛੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਛਡਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: oe aap tare sabh kuttanb siau tin pichhai sabh jagat chhaddaeh |
English: They are carried across, along with all their family, and the whole world is saved along with them.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਜਨ ਤਿਨ ਵੇਖਿ ਵੇਖਿ ਹਮ ਜੀਵਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak kau har mel jan tin vekh vekh ham jeevaeh |1|
English: O Lord, please unite servant Nanak with Your humble servants; beholding them, beholding them, I live. ||1||

[Ang 310 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 4 |
English: Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਧਰਤੀ ਭਈ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੀ ਜਿਥੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬੈਠਾ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: saa dharatee bhee hareeaavalee jithai meraa satigur baitthaa aae |
English: That land, where my True Guru comes and sits, becomes green and fertile.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਜੰਤ ਭਏ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੇ ਜਿਨੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: se jant bhe hareeaavale jinee meraa satigur dekhiaa jaae |
English: Those beings who go and behold my True Guru are rejuvenated.

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਕੁਲੁ ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੁ ਜਨਨੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਣਿਆ ਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan pitaa dhan dhan kul dhan dhan su jananee jin guroo janiaa maae |
English: Blessed, blessed is the father; blessed, blessed is the family; blessed, blessed is the mother, who gave birth to the Guru.

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਤਰਿਆ ਜਿਨੀ ਡਿਠਾ ਤਿਨਾ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan guroo jin naam araadhiaa aap tariaa jinee dditthaa tinaa le chhaddaae |
English: Blessed, blessed is the Guru, who worships and adores the Naam; He saves Himself, and emancipates those who see Him.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਧੋਵੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har satigur melahu deaa kar jan naanak dhovai paae |2|
English: O Lord, be kind, and unite me with the True Guru, that servant Nanak may wash His feet. ||2||

[Ang 310 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਮਰੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sach sachaa satigur amar hai jis andar har ur dhaariaa |
English: Truest of the True is the Immortal True Guru; He has enshrined the Lord deep within His heart.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sach sachaa satigur purakh hai jin kaam krodh bikh maariaa |
English: Truest of the True is the True Guru, the Primal Being, who has conquered sexual desire, anger and corruption.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਡਿਠਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਤਾਂ ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jaa dditthaa pooraa satiguroo taan andarahu man saadhaariaa |
English: When I see the Perfect True Guru, then deep within, my mind is comforted and consoled.

Gurbani: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਘੁਮਿ ਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: balihaaree gur aapane sadaa sadaa ghum vaariaa |
English: I am a sacrifice to my True Guru; I am devoted and dedicated to Him, forever and ever.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਤਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਹਾਰਿਆ ॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: guramukh jitaa manamukh haariaa |17|
English: A Gurmukh wins the battle of life whereas a self-willed manmukh loses it. ||17||

[Ang 310 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 4 |
English: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿਓਨੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa satigur melion mukh guramukh naam dhiaaeisee |
English: By His Grace, He leads us to meet the True Guru; then, as Gurmukh, we chant the Lord's Name, and meditate on it.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਵਸੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਘਰੀ ਵਸਾਇਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: so kare ji satigur bhaavasee gur pooraa gharee vasaaeisee |
English: We do that which pleases the True Guru; the Perfect Guru comes to dwell in the home of the heart.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਸਭੁ ਗਵਾਇਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: jin andar naam nidhaan hai tin kaa bhau sabh gavaaeisee |
English: Those who have the treasure of the Naam deep within - all their fears are removed.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਰਖਣ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਹੋਇ ਹੋਰ ਕੇਤੀ ਝਖਿ ਝਖਿ ਜਾਇਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: jin rakhan kau har aap hoe hor ketee jhakh jhakh jaaeisee |
English: They are protected by the Lord Himself; others struggle and fight against them, but they only come to death.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਛੋਡਾਇਸੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak naam dhiaae too har halat palat chhoddaaeisee |1|
English: O servant Nanak, meditate on the Naam; the Lord shall deliver you, here and hereafter. ||1||

[Ang 310 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 4 |
English: Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਦੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: gurasikhaa kai man bhaavadee gur satigur kee vaddiaaee |
English: The glorious greatness of the Guru, the True Guru, is pleasing to the GurSikh's mind.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਪੈਜ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ ਨਿਤ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har raakhahu paij satiguroo kee nit charrai savaaee |
English: The Lord preserves the honor of the True Guru, which increases day by day.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਛਡਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur satigur kai man paarabraham hai paarabraham chhaddaaee |
English: The Supreme Lord God is in the Mind of the Guru, the True Guru; the Supreme Lord God saves Him.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤਾਣੁ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਭ ਆਣਿ ਨਿਵਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur satigur taan deebaan har tin sabh aan nivaaee |
English: The Lord is the Power and Support of the Guru, the True Guru; all come to bow before Him.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਡਿਠਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਪ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jinee dditthaa meraa satigur bhaau kar tin ke sabh paap gavaaee |
English: Those who have gazed lovingly upon my True Guru - all their sins are taken away.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਬਹੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har daragah te mukh ujale bahu sobhaa paaee |
English: Their faces are radiant in the Court of the Lord, and they obtain great glory.

Gurbani: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਧੂੜਿ ਤਿਨ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਸਿਖ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jan naanak mangai dhoorr tin jo gur ke sikh mere bhaaee |2|
English: Servant Nanak begs for the dust of the feet of those GurSikhs, O my Siblings of Destiny. ||2||

[Ang 310 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਆਖਿ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: hau aakh salaahee sifat sach sach sache kee vaddiaaee |
English: I chant the Praises and Glories of the True One. True is the glorious greatness of the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: saalaahee sach salaah sach sach keemat kinai na paaee |
English: I praise the True Lord, and the Praises of the True Lord. His worth cannot be estimated.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਰਸੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਚਖਿਆ ਸੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਰਹੇ ਆਘਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sach sachaa ras jinee chakhiaa se tripat rahe aaghaaee |
English: Those who have tasted the true essence of the True Lord, remain satisfied and fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਸੇਈ ਜਾਣਦੇ ਜਿਉ ਗੂੰਗੈ ਮਿਠਿਆਈ ਖਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: eihu har ras seee jaanade jiau goongai mitthiaaee khaaee |
English: They know this essence of the Lord, but they say nothing, like the mute who tastes the sweet candy, and says nothing.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਵਜੀ ਵਾਧਾਈ ॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: gur poorai har prabh seviaa man vajee vaadhaaee |18|
English: The Perfect Guru serves the Lord God; His vibration vibrates and resounds in the mind. ||18||

[Ang 311 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 4 |
English: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਉਮਰਥਲ ਸੇਈ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਸੂਲੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: jinaa andar umarathal seee jaanan sooleea |
English: Those who have a festering boil within - they alone know its pain.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸੇਈ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਸਦ ਘੁਮਿ ਘੋਲੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: har jaaneh seee birahu hau tin vittahu sad ghum gholeea |
English: Those who know the pain of separation from the Lord - I am forever a sacrifice, a sacrifice to them.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਿਰੁ ਤਿਨ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਤਲ ਰੋਲੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: har melahu sajan purakh meraa sir tin vittahu tal roleea |
English: O Lord, please lead me to meet the Guru, the Primal Being, my Friend; my head shall roll in the dust under His feet.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਸਿਖ ਗੁਰ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਹਉ ਗੁਲਮੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਕਾ ਗੋਲੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: jo sikh gur kaar kamaaveh hau gulam tinaa kaa goleea |
English: I am the slave of the slaves of those GurSikhs who serve Him.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੈ ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਭਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਚੋਲੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: har rang chaloolai jo rate tin bhinee har rang choleea |
English: Those who are imbued with the deep crimson color of the Lord's Love - their robes are drenched in the Love of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਸਿਰੁ ਵੇਚਿਆ ਮੋਲੀਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa naanak mel gur peh sir vechiaa moleea |1|
English: Grant Your Grace, and lead Nanak to meet the Guru; I have sold my head to Him. ||1||

[Ang 311 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 4 |
English: Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਉਗਣੀ ਭਰਿਆ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਉ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aauganee bhariaa sareer hai kiau santahu niramal hoe |
English: The body is full of mistakes and misdeeds; how can it become pure, O Saints?

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਣ ਵੇਹਾਝੀਅਹਿ ਮਲੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਢੈ ਧੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh gun vehaajheeeh mal haumai kadtai dhoe |
English: The Gurmukh purchases virtues, which wash off the sin of egotism.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜਹਿ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਸਚੁ ਸਉਦਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sach vananjeh rang siau sach saudaa hoe |
English: True is the trade which purchases the True Lord with love.

Gurbani: ਤੋਟਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: tottaa mool na aavee laahaa har bhaavai soe |
English: No loss will come from this, and the profit comes by the Lord's Will.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜਿਆ ਜਿਨਾ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak tin sach vananjiaa jinaa dhur likhiaa paraapat hoe |2|
English: O Nanak, they alone purchase the Truth, who are blessed with such pre-ordained destiny. ||2||

[Ang 311 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: saalaahee sach saalaahanaa sach sachaa purakh niraale |
English: I praise the True One, who alone is worthy of praise. The True Primal Being is True - this is His unique quality.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਖਵਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: sach sevee sach man vasai sach sachaa har rakhavaale |
English: Serving the True Lord, the Truth comes to dwell in the mind. The Lord, the Truest of the True, is my Protector.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਜਿਨੀ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਸੇ ਜਾਇ ਰਲੇ ਸਚ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: sach sachaa jinee araadhiaa se jaae rale sach naale |
English: Those who worship and adore the Truest of the True, shall go and merge with the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਜਿਨੀ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਸੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂੜ ਬੇਤਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: sach sachaa jinee na seviaa se manamukh moorr betaale |
English: Those who do not serve the Truest of the True - those self-willed manmukhs are foolish demons.

Gurbani: ਓਹ ਆਲੁ ਪਤਾਲੁ ਮੁਹਹੁ ਬੋਲਦੇ ਜਿਉ ਪੀਤੈ ਮਦਿ ਮਤਵਾਲੇ ॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: oeh aal pataal muhahu bolade jiau peetai mad matavaale |19|
English: With their mouths, they babble on about this and that, like the drunkard who has drunk his wine. ||19||

[Ang 311 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਰਾਗਿ ਸੁਲਖਣੀ ਜੇ ਖਸਮੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree raag sulakhanee je khasamai chit karee |
English: Gauree Raga is auspicious, if, through it, one comes to think of his Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੈ ਐਸਾ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhaanai chalai satiguroo kai aisaa seegaar karee |
English: He should walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru; this should be his decoration.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਭਤਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਰਾਵੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa sabad bhataar hai sadaa sadaa raavee |
English: The True Word of the Shabad is our spouse; ravish and enjoy it, forever and ever.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਉਬਲੀ ਮਜੀਠੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਗਹਗਹਾ ਤਿਉ ਸਚੇ ਨੋ ਜੀਉ ਦੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: jiau ubalee majeetthai rang gahagahaa tiau sache no jeeo dee |
English: Like the deep crimson color of the madder plant - such is the dye which shall color you, when you dedicate your soul to the True One.

Gurbani: ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੈ ਅਤਿ ਰਤੀ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਗਾ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: rang chaloolai at ratee sache siau lagaa nehu |
English: One who loves the True Lord is totally imbued with the Lord's Love, like the deep crimson color of the poppy.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜੁ ਠਗੀ ਗੁਝੀ ਨਾ ਰਹੈ ਕੂੜੁ ਮੁਲੰਮਾ ਪਲੇਟਿ ਧਰੇਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: koorr tthagee gujhee naa rahai koorr mulamaa palett dharehu |
English: Falsehood and deception may be covered with false coatings, but they cannot remain hidden.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜੀ ਕਰਨਿ ਵਡਾਈਆ ਕੂੜੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਗਾ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: koorree karan vaddaaeea koorre siau lagaa nehu |
English: False is the uttering of praises, by those who love falsehood.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak sachaa aap hai aape nadar karee |1|
English: O Nanak, He alone is True; He Himself casts His Glance of Grace. ||1||

[Ang 311 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 4 |
English: Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਹੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: satasangat meh har usatat hai sang saadhoo mile piaariaa |
English: In the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, the Lord's Praises are sung. In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Beloved Lord is met.

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਪੁਰਖ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਧੰਨਿ ਜਨ ਹਹਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: oe purakh praanee dhan jan heh upades kareh praupakaariaa |
English: Blessed is that mortal being, who shares the Teachings for the good of others.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਜਗੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: har naam drirraaveh har naam sunaaveh har naame jag nisataariaa |
English: He implants the Name of the Lord, and he preaches the Name of the Lord; through the Name of the Lord, the world is saved.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਵੇਖਣ ਕਉ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਲੋਚੈ ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਜਗਤਿ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur vekhan kau sabh koee lochai nav khandd jagat namasakaariaa |
English: Everyone longs to see the Guru; the world, and the nine continents, bow down to Him.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: tudh aape aap rakhiaa satigur vich gur aape tudh savaariaa |
English: You Yourself have established the True Guru; You Yourself have adorned the Guru.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਪੂਜਹਿ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਵਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: too aape poojeh pooj karaaveh satigur kau sirajanahaariaa |
English: You Yourself worship and adore the True Guru; You inspire others to worship Him as well, O Creator Lord.

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਜਾਇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਲਾ ਮੁਹੁ ਜਮਿ ਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: koee vichhurr jaae satiguroo paasahu tis kaalaa muhu jam maariaa |
English: If someone separates himself from the True Guru, his face is blackened, and he is destroyed by the Messenger of Death.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਪਿਛੈ ਢੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੀ ਮਨਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: tis agai pichhai dtoee naahee gurasikhee man veechaariaa |
English: He shall find no shelter, here or hereafter; the GurSikhs have realized this in their minds.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਨੋ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: satiguroo no mile seee jan ubare jin hiradai naam samaariaa |
English: That humble being who meets the True Guru is saved; he cherishes the Naam, the Name of the Lord, in his heart.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪੁਤਹਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਅਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jan naanak ke gurasikh putahahu har japiahu har nisataariaa |2|
English: Servant Nanak says: O GurSikhs, O my sons, meditate on the Lord; only the Lord shall save you. ||2||

[Ang 312 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਜਗਤੁ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: haumai jagat bhulaaeaa duramat bikhiaa bikaar |
English: Egotism has led the world astray, along with evil-mindedness and the poison of corruption.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਨਦਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧ ਅੰਧਿਆਰ ॥
Transliteration: satigur milai ta nadar hoe manamukh andh andhiaar |
English: Meeting with the True Guru, we are blessed by the Lord's Glance of Grace, while the self-willed manmukh gropes around in the darkness.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਾਏ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak aape mel le jis no sabad laae piaar |3|
English: O Nanak, the Lord absorbs into Himself those whom He inspires to love the Word of His Shabad. ||3||

[Ang 312 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਲਾਹ ਹੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰੁ ਭਿਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: sach sache kee sifat salaah hai so kare jis andar bhijai |
English: True are the Praises and the Glories of the True One; he alone speaks them, whose mind is softened within.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਕੰਧੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਛਿਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: jinee ik man ik araadhiaa tin kaa kandh na kabahoo chhijai |
English: Those who worship the One Lord with single-minded devotion - their bodies shall never perish.

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਜਿਨ ਸਚੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਿਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan purakh saabaas hai jin sach rasanaa amrit pijai |
English: Blessed, blessed and acclaimed is that person, who tastes with his tongue the Ambrosial Nectar of the True Name.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਦਾ ਸੇ ਮਨਿ ਸਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਲਿਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: sach sachaa jin man bhaavadaa se man sachee daragah lijai |
English: One whose mind is pleased with the Truest of the True is accepted in the True Court.

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਚਿਆਰੀਆ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਿਜੈ ॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan janam sachiaareea mukh ujal sach karijai |20|
English: Blessed, blessed is the birth of those true beings; the True Lord brightens their faces. ||20||

[Ang 312 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 4 |
English: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤ ਜਾਇ ਨਿਵਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਮਨਿ ਖੋਟੇ ਕੂੜਿ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: saakat jaae niveh gur aagai man khotte koorr koorriaare |
English: The faithless cynics go and bow before the Guru, but their minds are corrupt and false, totally false.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਹੈ ਉਠਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਬਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਘੁਸਰਿ ਬਗੁਲਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jaa gur kahai utthahu mere bhaaee beh jaeh ghusar bagulaare |
English: When the Guru says, "Rise up, my Siblings of Destiny", they sit down, crowded in like cranes.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਚੁਣਿ ਕਢੇ ਲਧੋਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gurasikhaa andar satigur varatai chun kadte ladhovaare |
English: The True Guru prevails among His GurSikhs; they pick out and expel the wanderers.

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਅਗੈ ਪਿਛੈ ਬਹਿ ਮੁਹੁ ਛਪਾਇਨਿ ਨ ਰਲਨੀ ਖੋਟੇਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: oe agai pichhai beh muhu chhapaaein na ralanee khotteaare |
English: Sitting here and there, they hide their faces; being counterfeit, they cannot mix with the genuine.

Gurbani: ਓਨਾ ਦਾ ਭਖੁ ਸੁ ਓਥੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ਕੂੜੁ ਲਹਨਿ ਭੇਡਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: onaa daa bhakh su othai naahee jaae koorr lehan bheddaare |
English: There is no food for them there; the false go into the filth like sheep.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਸਾਕਤੁ ਨਰੁ ਖਾਵਾਈਐ ਲੋਚੀਐ ਬਿਖੁ ਕਢੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਉਗਲਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: je saakat nar khaavaaeeai locheeai bikh kadtai mukh ugalaare |
English: If you try to feed the faithless cynic, he will spit out poison from his mouth.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਕਤ ਸੇਤੀ ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਕਰੀਅਹੁ ਓਇ ਮਾਰੇ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har saakat setee sang na kareeahu oe maare sirajanahaare |
English: O Lord, let me not be in the company of the faithless cynic, who is cursed by the Creator Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jis kaa ihu khel soee kar vekhai jan naanak naam samaare |1|
English: This drama belongs to the Lord; He performs it, and He watches over it. Servant Nanak cherishes the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

[Ang 312 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 4 |
English: Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: satigur purakh agam hai jis andar har ur dhaariaa |
English: The True Guru, the Primal Being, is inaccessible; He has enshrined the Lord's Name within His heart.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਨੋ ਅਪੜਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਕਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਲਿ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: satiguroo no aparr koe na sakee jis val sirajanahaariaa |
English: No one can equal the True Guru; the Creator Lord is on His side.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕਾ ਖੜਗੁ ਸੰਜੋਉ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਕੰਟਕੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਵਿਡਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: satiguroo kaa kharrag sanjoau har bhagat hai jit kaal kanttak maar viddaariaa |
English: Devotional worship of the Lord is the sword and armor of the True Guru; He has killed and cast out Death, the torturer.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕਾ ਰਖਣਹਾਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੈ ਪਿਛੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਭਿ ਉਬਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: satiguroo kaa rakhanahaaraa har aap hai satiguroo kai pichhai har sabh ubaariaa |
English: The Lord Himself is the Protector of the True Guru. The Lord saves all those who follow in the footsteps of the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਮੰਦਾ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕਾ ਸੋ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਵਣਹਾਰੈ ਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jo mandaa chitavai poore satiguroo kaa so aap upaavanahaarai maariaa |
English: One who thinks evil of the Perfect True Guru - the Creator Lord Himself destroys him.

Gurbani: ਏਹ ਗਲ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਗਮੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: eeh gal hovai har daragah sache kee jan naanak agam veechaariaa |2|
English: These words will be confirmed as true in the Court of the Lord; servant Nanak reveals this mystery. ||2||

[Ang 312 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸੁਤਿਆ ਜਿਨੀ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਜਾ ਉਠੇ ਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਚਵੇ ॥
Transliteration: sach sutiaa jinee araadhiaa jaa utthe taa sach chave |
English: Those who dwell upon the True Lord while asleep, utter the True Name when they are awake.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਰਵੇ ॥
Transliteration: se virale jug meh jaaneeeh jo guramukh sach rave |
English: How rare in the world are those Gurmukhs who dwell upon the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਜਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਲਵੇ ॥
Transliteration: hau balihaaree tin kau ji anadin sach lave |
English: I am a sacrifice to those who chant the True Name, night and day.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸਚਾ ਭਾਵਦਾ ਸੇ ਸਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਗਵੇ ॥
Transliteration: jin man tan sachaa bhaavadaa se sachee daragah gave |
English: The True Lord is pleasing to their minds and bodies; they go to the Court of the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਵੇ ॥੨੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak bolai sach naam sach sachaa sadaa nave |21|
English: Servant Nanak chants the True Name; truly, the True Lord is forever brand new. ||21||

[Ang 312 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 4 |
English: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਸਵਣਾ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਗਣਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa savanaa kiaa jaaganaa guramukh te paravaan |
English: Who is asleep, and who is awake? Those who are Gurmukh are approved.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਾ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਪੁਰਖ ਪਰਧਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: jinaa saas giraas na visarai se poore purakh paradhaan |
English: Those who do not forget the Lord, with each and every breath and morsel of food, are the perfect and famous persons.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਗੈ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: karamee satigur paaeeai anadin lagai dhiaan |
English: By His Grace they find the True Guru; night and day, they meditate.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਈ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: tin kee sangat mil rahaa daragah paaee maan |
English: I join the society of those persons, and in so doing, I am honored in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਉਦੇ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਉਚਰਹਿ ਉਠਦੇ ਭੀ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: saude vaahu vaahu uchareh utthade bhee vaahu karen |
English: While asleep, they chant, "Waaho! Waaho!", and while awake, they chant, "Waaho!" as well.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਜਿ ਨਿਤ ਉਠਿ ਸੰਮਾਲੇਨਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak te mukh ujale ji nit utth samaalen |1|
English: O Nanak, radiant are the faces of those, who rise up early each day, and dwell upon the Lord. ||1||

[Ang 313 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 4 |
English: Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਆਪਣਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: satigur seveeai aapanaa paaeeai naam apaar |
English: Serving his True Guru, one obtains the Naam, the Name of the Infinite Lord.

Gurbani: ਭਉਜਲਿ ਡੁਬਦਿਆ ਕਢਿ ਲਏ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: bhaujal ddubadiaa kadt le har daat kare daataar |
English: The drowning person is lifted up and out of the terrifying world-ocean; the Great Giver gives the gift of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੇ ਸਾਹ ਹੈ ਜਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan se saah hai ji naam kareh vaapaar |
English: Blessed, blessed are those bankers who trade the Naam.

Gurbani: ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ਸਿਖ ਆਵਦੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਘਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: vanajaare sikh aavade sabad laghaavanahaar |
English: The Sikhs, the traders come, and through the Word of His Shabad, they are carried across.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਭਈ ਤਿਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jan naanak jin kau kripaa bhee tin seviaa sirajanahaar |2|
English: O servant Nanak, they alone serve the Creator Lord, who are blessed by His Grace. ||2||

[Ang 313 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਭਗਤ ਹਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਜਿਨੀ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sach sache ke jan bhagat heh sach sachaa jinee araadhiaa |
English: Those who truly worship and adore the True Lord, are truly the humble devotees of the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਜਿ ਢੰਢੋਲਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਲਾਧਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jin guramukh khoj dtandtoliaa tin andarahu hee sach laadhiaa |
English: Those Gurmukhs who search and seek, find the True One within themselves.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਕਾਲੁ ਕੰਟਕੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਤਿਨੀ ਸਾਧਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sach saahib sach jinee seviaa kaal kanttak maar tinee saadhiaa |
English: Those who truly serve their True Lord and Master, overwhelm and conquer Death, the torturer.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਭ ਦੂ ਵਡਾ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸੇ ਸਚਿ ਰਲਾਧਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sach sachaa sabh doo vaddaa hai sach sevan se sach ralaadhiaa |
English: The True One is truly the greatest of all; those who serve the True One are blended with the True One.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਨੋ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਸੇਵਿ ਫਲਾਧਿਆ ॥੨੨॥
Transliteration: sach sache no saabaas hai sach sachaa sev falaadhiaa |22|
English: Blessed and acclaimed is the Truest of the True; serving the Truest of the True, one blossoms forth in fruition. ||22||

[Ang 313 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 4 |
English: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮਹੀਣ ਭਰਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh praanee mugadh hai naamaheen bharamaae |
English: The self-willed manmukh is foolish; he wanders around without the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਨੂਆ ਨਾ ਟਿਕੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin gur manooaa naa ttikai fir fir joonee paae |
English: Without the Guru, his mind is not held steady, and he is reincarnated, over and over again.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਹੋਹਿ ਤਾਂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: har prabh aap deaal hohi taan satigur miliaa aae |
English: But when the Lord God Himself becomes merciful to him, then the True Guru comes to meet him.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਤੂ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak naam salaeh too janam maran dukh jaae |1|
English: O servant Nanak, praise the Naam; the pains of birth and death shall come to an end. ||1||

[Ang 313 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 4 |
English: Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur saalaahee aapanaa bahu bidh rang subhaae |
English: I praise my Guru in so many ways, with joyful love and affection.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਰਖਿਆ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur setee man rataa rakhiaa banat banaae |
English: My mind is imbued with the True Guru; He has preserved the make of its making.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਨ ਰਜਈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jihavaa saalaeh na rajee har preetam chit laae |
English: My tongue is not satisfied by praising Him; He has linked my consciousness with the Lord, my Beloved.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਮਨਿ ਭੁਖ ਹੈ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naavai kee man bhukh hai man tripatai har ras khaae |2|
English: O Nanak, my mind hungers for the Name of the Lord; my mind is satisfied, tasting the sublime essence of the Lord. ||2||

[Ang 313 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਬਣਾਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: sach sachaa kudarat jaaneeai din raatee jin banaaeea |
English: The True Lord is truly known for His all-powerful creative nature; He fashioned the days and the nights.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਕੀਆ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: so sach salaahee sadaa sadaa sach sache keea vaddiaaeea |
English: I praise that True Lord, forever and ever; True is the glorious greatness of the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: saalaahee sach salaah sach sach keemat kinai na paaeea |
English: True are the Praises of the Praiseworthy True Lord; the value of the True Lord cannot be appraised.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਤਾ ਹਾਜਰੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: jaa miliaa pooraa satiguroo taa haajar nadaree aaeea |
English: When someone meets the Perfect True Guru, then His Sublime Presence comes to be seen.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਸਲਾਹਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਭੁਖਾ ਸਭਿ ਗਵਾਈਆ ॥੨੩॥
Transliteration: sach guramukh jinee salaahiaa tinaa bhukhaa sabh gavaaeea |23|
English: Those Gurmukhs who praise the True Lord - all their hunger is gone. ||23||

[Ang 313 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 4 |
English: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਖੋਜੇਦਿਆ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਧਾ ਲੋੜਿ ॥
Transliteration: mai man tan khoj khojediaa so prabh ladhaa lorr |
English: Searching and examining my mind and body, I have found that God, whom I longed for.

Gurbani: ਵਿਸਟੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਮੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਿਤਾ ਜੋੜਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: visatt guroo mai paaeaa jin har prabh ditaa jorr |1|
English: I have found the Guru, the Divine Intermediary, who has united me with the Lord God. ||1||

[Ang 313 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆਧਾਰੀ ਅਤਿ ਅੰਨਾ ਬੋਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaadhaaree at anaa bolaa |
English: One who is attached to Maya is totally blind and deaf.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਸੁਣਈ ਬਹੁ ਰੋਲ ਘਚੋਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabad na sunee bahu rol ghacholaa |
