English: He does not listen to the Word of the Shabad; he makes a great uproar and tumult.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਪੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh jaapai sabad liv laae |
English: The Gurmukhs chant and meditate on the Shabad, and lovingly center their consciousness on it.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਨੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: har naam sun mane har naam samaae |
English: They hear and believe in the Name of the Lord; they are absorbed in the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jo tis bhaavai su kare karaaeaa |
English: Whatever pleases God, He causes that to be done.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਜਦਾ ਜੰਤੁ ਵਜਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak vajadaa jant vajaaeaa |2|
English: O Nanak, human beings are the instruments which vibrate as God plays them. ||2||

[Ang 314 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਜੋ ਜੀਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਰਤੈ ॥
Transliteration: too karataa sabh kichh jaanadaa jo jeea andar varatai |
English: You, O Creator, know everything which occurs within our beings.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਅਗਣਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਗਣਤੈ ॥
Transliteration: too karataa aap aganat hai sabh jag vich ganatai |
English: You Yourself, O Creator, are incalculable, while the entire world is within the realm of calculation.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਣਤੈ ॥
Transliteration: sabh keetaa teraa varatadaa sabh teree banatai |
English: Everything happens according to Your Will; You created all.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਚਲਤੈ ॥
Transliteration: too ghatt ghatt ik varatadaa sach saahib chalatai |
English: You are the One, pervading in each and every heart; O True Lord and Master, this is Your play.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨੋ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਪਰਤੈ ॥੨੪॥
Transliteration: satigur no mile su har mile naahee kisai paratai |24|
English: One who meets the True Guru meets the Lord; no one can turn him away. ||24||

[Ang 314 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 4 |
English: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਰਖੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਈਐ ਚਿਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: eihu manooaa drirr kar rakheeai guramukh laaeeai chit |
English: Hold this mind steady and stable; become Gurmukh and focus your consciousness.

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਬਹਦਿਆ ਉਠਦਿਆ ਨਿਤ ॥
Transliteration: kiau saas giraas visaareeai bahadiaa utthadiaa nit |
English: How could you ever forget Him, with each breath and morsel of food, sitting down or standing up?

Gurbani: ਮਰਣ ਜੀਵਣ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਗਈ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਵਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: maran jeevan kee chintaa gee ihu jeearraa har prabh vas |
English: My anxiety about birth and death has ended; this soul is under the control of the Lord God.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਖੁ ਤੂ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਖਸਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jiau bhaavai tiau rakh too jan naanak naam bakhas |1|
English: If it pleases You, then save servant Nanak, and bless him with Your Name. ||1||

[Ang 314 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਆਗੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਪੀਛੈ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh ahankaaree mehal na jaanai khin aagai khin peechhai |
English: The egotistical, self-willed manmukh does not know the Mansion of the Lord's Presence; one moment he is here, and the next moment he is there.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਬੁਲਾਈਐ ਮਹਲਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੀਝੈ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa bulaaeeai mehal na aavai kiau kar daragah seejhai |
English: He is always invited, but he does not go to the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. How shall he be accepted in the Court of the Lord?

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ॥
Transliteration: satigur kaa mehal viralaa jaanai sadaa rahai kar jorr |
English: How rare are those who know the Mansion of the True Guru; they stand with their palms pressed together.

Gurbani: ਆਪਣੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਏ ਬਹੋੜਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aapanee kripaa kare har meraa naanak le bahorr |2|
English: If my Lord grants His Grace, O Nanak, He restores them to Himself. ||2||

[Ang 314 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਸੇਵਾ ਕੀਤੀ ਸਫਲ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੰਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: saa sevaa keetee safal hai jit satigur kaa man mane |
English: Fruitful and rewarding is that service, which is pleasing to the Guru's Mind.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਤਾ ਪਾਪ ਕਸੰਮਲ ਭੰਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: jaa satigur kaa man maniaa taa paap kasamal bhane |
English: When the Mind of the True Guru is pleased, then sins and misdeeds run away.

Gurbani: ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਜਿ ਦਿਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸੋ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਸਿਖੀ ਕੰਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: aupades ji ditaa satiguroo so suniaa sikhee kane |
English: The Sikhs listen to the Teachings imparted by the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਚੜੀ ਚਵਗਣਿ ਵੰਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: jin satigur kaa bhaanaa maniaa tin charree chavagan vane |
English: Those who surrender to the True Guru's Will are imbued with the four-fold Love of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਇਹ ਚਾਲ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖੀ ਗੁਰ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨੁ ਭਿੰਨੇ ॥੨੫॥
Transliteration: eih chaal niraalee guramukhee gur deekhiaa sun man bhine |25|
English: This is the unique and distinct life-style of the Gurmukhs: listening to the Guru's Teachings, their minds blossom forth. ||25||

[Ang 314 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਪਿਆ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਠਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jin gur gopiaa aapanaa tis tthaur na tthaau |
English: Those who do not affirm their Guru shall have no home or place of rest.

Gurbani: ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਦੋਵੈ ਗਏ ਦਰਗਹ ਨਾਹੀ ਥਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: halat palat dovai ge daragah naahee thaau |
English: They lose both this world and the next; they have no place in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਓਹ ਵੇਲਾ ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਲਗਹਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: oeh velaa hath na aavee fir satigur lageh paae |
English: This opportunity to bow at the Feet of the True Guru shall never come again.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਗਣਤੈ ਘੁਸੀਐ ਦੁਖੇ ਦੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur kee ganatai ghuseeai dukhe dukh vihaae |
English: If they miss out on being counted by the True Guru, they shall pass their lives in pain and misery.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur purakh niravair hai aape le jis laae |
English: The True Guru, the Primal Being, has no hatred or vengeance; He unites with Himself those with whom He is pleased.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਜਿਨਾ ਵੇਖਾਲਿਓਨੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak darasan jinaa vekhaalion tinaa daragah le chhaddaae |1|
English: O Nanak, those who behold the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, are emancipated in the Court of the Lord. ||1||

[Ang 314 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh agiaan duramat ahankaaree |
English: The self-willed manmukh is ignorant, evil-minded and egotistical.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਜੂਐ ਮਤਿ ਹਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: antar krodh jooai mat haaree |
English: He is filled with anger within, and he loses his mind in the gamble.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਸਤੁ ਓਹੁ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: koorr kusat ohu paap kamaavai |
English: He commits the sins of fraud and unrighteousness.

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਓਹੁ ਸੁਣੈ ਕਿਆ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa ohu sunai kiaa aakh sunaavai |
English: What can he hear, and what can he tell others?

Gurbani: ਅੰਨਾ ਬੋਲਾ ਖੁਇ ਉਝੜਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: anaa bolaa khue ujharr paae |
English: He is blind and deaf; he loses his way, and wanders lost in the wilderness.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅੰਧਾ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh andhaa aavai jaae |
English: The blind, self-willed manmukh comes and goes in reincarnation;

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin satigur bhette thaae na paae |
English: without meeting the True Guru, he finds no place of rest.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak poorab likhiaa kamaae |2|
English: O Nanak, he acts according to his pre-ordained destiny. ||2||

[Ang 314 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਚਿਤ ਕਠੋਰ ਹਹਿ ਸੇ ਬਹਹਿ ਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: jin ke chit katthor heh se baheh na satigur paas |
English: Those who have hearts as hard as stone, do not sit near the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਓਥੈ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਾ ਚਿਤ ਉਦਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: othai sach varatadaa koorriaaraa chit udaas |
English: Truth prevails there; the false ones do not attune their consciousness to it.

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਵਲੁ ਛਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਝਤਿ ਕਢਦੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਬਹਹਿ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਾ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: oe val chhal kar jhat kadtade fir jaae baheh koorriaaraa paas |
English: By hook or by crook, they pass their time, and then they go back to sit with the false ones again.

Gurbani: ਵਿਚਿ ਸਚੇ ਕੂੜੁ ਨ ਗਡਈ ਮਨਿ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕੋ ਨਿਰਜਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: vich sache koorr na gaddee man vekhahu ko nirajaas |
English: Falsehood does not mix with the Truth; O people, check it out and see.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੀ ਜਾਇ ਰਲੇ ਸਚਿਆਰ ਸਿਖ ਬੈਠੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੨੬॥
Transliteration: koorriaar koorriaaree jaae rale sachiaar sikh baitthe satigur paas |26|
English: The false go and mingle with the false, while the truthful Sikhs sit by the side of the True Guru. ||26||

[Ang 315 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਹਦੇ ਖੁਹਦੇ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਮਾਰਿਅਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਹਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: rahade khuhade nindak maarian kar aape aahar |
English: By their own efforts, the slanderers have destroyed all remnants of themselves.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਜਾਹਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sant sahaaee naanakaa varatai sabh jaahar |1|
English: The Support of the Saints, O Nanak, is manifest, pervading everywhere. ||1||

[Ang 315 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੁੰਢਹੁ ਭੁਲੇ ਮੁੰਢ ਤੇ ਕਿਥੈ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਹਥੁ ॥
Transliteration: mundtahu bhule mundt te kithai paaein hath |
English: Those who went astray from the Primal Being in the very beginning - where can they find refuge?

Gurbani: ਤਿੰਨੈ ਮਾਰੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tinai maare naanakaa ji karan kaaran samarath |2|
English: O Nanak, they are struck down by the All-powerful, the Cause of causes. ||2||

[Ang 315 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: paurree 5 |
English: Pauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਲੈ ਫਾਹੇ ਰਾਤੀ ਤੁਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: lai faahe raatee tureh prabh jaanai praanee |
English: They take the noose in their hands, and go out at night to strangle others, but God knows everything, O mortal.

Gurbani: ਤਕਹਿ ਨਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਈਆ ਲੁਕਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਠਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: takeh naar paraaeea luk andar tthaanee |
English: They spy on other men's women, concealed in their hiding places.

Gurbani: ਸੰਨੑੀ ਦੇਨਿੑ ਵਿਖੰਮ ਥਾਇ ਮਿਠਾ ਮਦੁ ਮਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: sanaee dena vikham thaae mitthaa mad maanee |
English: They break into well-protected places, and revel in sweet wine.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮੀ ਆਪੋ ਆਪਣੀ ਆਪੇ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: karamee aapo aapanee aape pachhutaanee |
English: But they shall come to regret their actions - they create their own karma.

Gurbani: ਅਜਰਾਈਲੁ ਫਰੇਸਤਾ ਤਿਲ ਪੀੜੇ ਘਾਣੀ ॥੨੭॥
Transliteration: ajaraaeel faresataa til peerre ghaanee |27|
English: Azraa-eel, the Angel of Death, shall crush them like sesame seeds in the oil-press. ||27||

[Ang 315 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਕ ਸਚੇ ਸਾਹ ਕੇ ਸੇਈ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: sevak sache saah ke seee paravaan |
English: The servants of the True King are acceptable and approved.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜਾ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸੇ ਪਚਿ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਅਜਾਣ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: doojaa sevan naanakaa se pach pach mue ajaan |1|
English: Those ignorant ones who serve duality, O Nanak, rot, waste away and die. ||1||

[Ang 315 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਟਣਾ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jo dhur likhiaa lekh prabh mettanaa na jaae |
English: That destiny which was pre-ordained by God from the very beginning cannot be erased.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਵਖਰੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: raam naam dhan vakharo naanak sadaa dhiaae |2|
English: The wealth of the Lord's Name is Nanak's capital; he meditates on it forever. ||2||

[Ang 315 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: paurree 5 |
English: Pauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਰਾਇਣਿ ਲਇਆ ਨਾਠੂੰਗੜਾ ਪੈਰ ਕਿਥੈ ਰਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: naaraaein leaa naatthoongarraa pair kithai rakhai |
English: One who has received a kick from the Lord God - where can he place his foot?

Gurbani: ਕਰਦਾ ਪਾਪ ਅਮਿਤਿਆ ਨਿਤ ਵਿਸੋ ਚਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: karadaa paap amitiaa nit viso chakhai |
English: He commits countless sins, and continually eats poison.

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਦਾ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੇਹੀ ਭਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: nindaa karadaa pach muaa vich dehee bhakhai |
English: Slandering others, he wastes away and dies; within his body, he burns.

Gurbani: ਸਚੈ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਕਉਣੁ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਰਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: sachai saahib maariaa kaun tis no rakhai |
English: One who has been struck down by the True Lord and Master - who can save him now?

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਜੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਲਖੈ ॥੨੮॥
Transliteration: naanak tis saranaagatee jo purakh alakhai |28|
English: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Unseen Lord, the Primal Being. ||28||

[Ang 315 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਰਕ ਘੋਰ ਬਹੁ ਦੁਖ ਘਣੇ ਅਕਿਰਤਘਣਾ ਕਾ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: narak ghor bahu dukh ghane akirataghanaa kaa thaan |
English: In the most horrible hell, there is terrible pain and suffering. It is the place of the ungrateful.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਹੋਇ ਮੁਏ ਹਰਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tin prabh maare naanakaa hoe hoe mue haraam |1|
English: They are struck down by God, O Nanak, and they die a most miserable death. ||1||

[Ang 315 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਵਖਧ ਸਭੇ ਕੀਤਿਅਨੁ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਾ ਦਾਰੂ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: avakhadh sabhe keetian nindak kaa daaroo naeh |
English: All kinds of medicines may be prepared, but there is no cure for the slanderer.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਪਚਿ ਪਚਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aap bhulaae naanakaa pach pach jonee paeh |2|
English: Those whom the Lord Himself misleads, O Nanak, putrefy and rot in reincarnation. ||2||

[Ang 315 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: paurree 5 |
English: Pauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤੁਸਿ ਦਿਤਾ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ॥
Transliteration: tus ditaa poorai satiguroo har dhan sach akhutt |
English: By His Pleasure, the True Guru has blessed me with the inexhaustible wealth of the Name of the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਅੰਦੇਸੇ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਛੁਟੁ ॥
Transliteration: sabh andese mitt ge jam kaa bhau chhutt |
English: All my anxiety is ended; I am rid of the fear of death.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਬੁਰਿਆਈਆਂ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਤੁਟੁ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh buriaaeean sang saadhoo tutt |
English: Sexual desire, anger and other evils have been subdued in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਚੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਹੁਇ ਮਰਸਨਿ ਬੁਟੁ ॥
Transliteration: vin sache doojaa sevade hue marasan butt |
English: Those who serve another, instead of the True Lord, die unfulfilled in the end.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਬਖਸਿਆ ਨਾਮੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਜੁਟੁ ॥੨੯॥
Transliteration: naanak kau gur bakhasiaa naamai sang jutt |29|
English: The Guru has blessed Nanak with forgiveness; he is united with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||29||

[Ang 315 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 4 |
English: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤਪਾ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਅੰਦ੍ਰਹੁ ਲੋਭੀ ਨਿਤ ਮਾਇਆ ਨੋ ਫਿਰੈ ਜਜਮਾਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: tapaa na hovai andrahu lobhee nit maaeaa no firai jajamaaliaa |
English: He is not a penitent, who is greedy within his heart, and who constantly chases after Maya like a leper.

Gurbani: ਅਗੋ ਦੇ ਸਦਿਆ ਸਤੈ ਦੀ ਭਿਖਿਆ ਲਏ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਿਛੋ ਦੇ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ਕੈ ਆਣਿ ਤਪੈ ਪੁਤੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਬਹਾਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: ago de sadiaa satai dee bhikhiaa le naahee pichho de pachhutaae kai aan tapai put vich bahaaliaa |
English: When this penitent was first invited, he refused our charity; but later he repented and sent his son, who was seated in the congregation.

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਲੋਗ ਸਭਿ ਹਸਣ ਲਗੇ ਤਪਾ ਲੋਭਿ ਲਹਰਿ ਹੈ ਗਾਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: panch log sabh hasan lage tapaa lobh lehar hai gaaliaa |
English: The village elders all laughed, saying that the waves of greed have destroyed this penitent.

Gurbani: ਜਿਥੈ ਥੋੜਾ ਧਨੁ ਵੇਖੈ ਤਿਥੈ ਤਪਾ ਭਿਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਧਨਿ ਬਹੁਤੈ ਡਿਠੈ ਤਪੈ ਧਰਮੁ ਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jithai thorraa dhan vekhai tithai tapaa bhittai naahee dhan bahutai dditthai tapai dharam haariaa |
English: If he sees only a little wealth, he does not bother to go there; but when he sees a lot of wealth, the penitent forsakes his vows.

Gurbani: ਭਾਈ ਏਹੁ ਤਪਾ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਬਗੁਲਾ ਹੈ ਬਹਿ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਵੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: bhaaee ehu tapaa na hovee bagulaa hai beh saadh janaa veechaariaa |
English: O Siblings of Destiny, he is not a penitent - he is only a stork. Sitting together, the Holy Congregation has so decided.

Gurbani: ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖ ਕੀ ਤਪਾ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੈ ਕੀ ਉਸਤਤੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਏਤੁ ਦੋਖੈ ਤਪਾ ਦਯਿ ਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sat purakh kee tapaa nindaa karai sansaarai kee usatatee vich hovai et dokhai tapaa day maariaa |
English: The penitent slanders the True Primal Being, and sings the praises of the material world. For this sin, he is cursed by the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਪੁਰਖਾਂ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਾ ਵੇਖੁ ਜਿ ਤਪੇ ਨੋ ਫਲੁ ਲਗਾ ਸਭੁ ਗਇਆ ਤਪੇ ਕਾ ਘਾਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: mahaa purakhaan kee nindaa kaa vekh ji tape no fal lagaa sabh geaa tape kaa ghaaliaa |
English: Behold the fruit the penitent gathers, for slandering the Great Primal Being; all his labors have gone in vain.

Gurbani: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਬਹੈ ਪੰਚਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਤਪਾ ਸਦਾਏ ॥ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਬਹੈ ਤਪਾ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਏ ॥ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਦਰਲਾ ਪਾਪੁ ਪੰਚਾ ਨੋ ਉਘਾ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖਾਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: baahar bahai panchaa vich tapaa sadaae | andar bahai tapaa paap kamaae | har andaralaa paap panchaa no ughaa kar vekhaaliaa |
English: When he sits outside among the elders, he is called a penitent; But when he sits within the congregation, the penitent commits sin. The Lord has exposed the penitent's secret sin to the elders.

Gurbani: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਜਮਕੰਕਰਾ ਨੋ ਆਖਿ ਛਡਿਆ ਏਸੁ ਤਪੇ ਨੋ ਤਿਥੈ ਖੜਿ ਪਾਇਹੁ ਜਿਥੈ ਮਹਾ ਮਹਾਂ ਹਤਿਆਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: dharam raae jamakankaraa no aakh chhaddiaa es tape no tithai kharr paaeihu jithai mahaa mahaan hatiaariaa |
English: The Righteous Judge of Dharma said to the Messenger of Death, "Take this penitent and put him with the worst of the worst murderers."

Gurbani: ਫਿਰਿ ਏਸੁ ਤਪੇ ਦੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਕੋਈ ਲਗਹੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਏਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਹੈ ਫਿਟਕਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: fir es tape dai muhi koee lagahu naahee ehu satigur hai fittakaariaa |
English: No one is to look at the face of this penitent again. He has been cursed by the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਸੁ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥ ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਜੁ ਦਯਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har kai dar varatiaa su naanak aakh sunaaeaa | so boojhai ju day savaariaa |1|
English: Nanak speaks and reveals what has taken place in the Court of the Lord. He alone understands, who is blessed and adorned by the Lord. ||1||

[Ang 316 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 4 |
English: Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾਂ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: har bhagataan har aaraadhiaa har kee vaddiaaee |
English: The devotees of the Lord worship and adore the Lord, and the glorious greatness of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਭਗਤ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਂਵਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har keeratan bhagat nit gaanvade har naam sukhadaaee |
English: The Lord's devotees continually sing the Kirtan of His Praises; the Name of the Lord is the Giver of peace.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾਂ ਨੋ ਨਿਤ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਬਖਸੀਅਨੁ ਨਿਤ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har bhagataan no nit naavai dee vaddiaaee bakhaseean nit charrai savaaee |
English: The Lord ever bestows upon His devotees the glorious greatness of His Name, which increases day by day.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾਂ ਨੋ ਥਿਰੁ ਘਰੀ ਬਹਾਲਿਅਨੁ ਅਪਣੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har bhagataan no thir gharee bahaalian apanee paij rakhaaee |
English: The Lord inspires His devotees to sit, steady and stable, in the home of their inner being. He preserves their honor.

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦਕਾਂ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗਸੀ ਬਹੁ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: nindakaan paasahu har lekhaa mangasee bahu dee sajaaee |
English: The Lord summons the slanderers to answer for their accounts, and He punishes them severely.

Gurbani: ਜੇਹਾ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਅਪਣੈ ਜੀਇ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਤੇਹੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jehaa nindak apanai jee kamaavade teho fal paaee |
English: As the slanderers think of acting, so are the fruits they obtain.

Gurbani: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਮਾਣਾ ਸਰਪਰ ਉਘੜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ਬਹਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: andar kamaanaa sarapar ugharrai bhaavai koee beh dharatee vich kamaaee |
English: Actions done in secrecy are sure to come to light, even if one does it underground.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jan naanak dekh vigasiaa har kee vaddiaaee |2|
English: Servant Nanak blossoms forth in joy, beholding the glorious greatness of the Lord. ||2||

[Ang 316 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: paurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Pauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾਂ ਕਾ ਰਾਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਕਿਆ ਪਾਪੀ ਕਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat janaan kaa raakhaa har aap hai kiaa paapee kareeai |
English: The Lord Himself is the Protector of His devotees; what can the sinner do to them?

Gurbani: ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਮੂੜ ਗੁਮਾਨੀਆ ਵਿਸੁ ਖਾਧੀ ਮਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: gumaan kareh moorr gumaaneea vis khaadhee mareeai |
English: The proud fool acts in pride, and eating his own poison, he dies.

Gurbani: ਆਇ ਲਗੇ ਨੀ ਦਿਹ ਥੋੜੜੇ ਜਿਉ ਪਕਾ ਖੇਤੁ ਲੁਣੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: aae lage nee dih thorrarre jiau pakaa khet luneeai |
English: His few days have come to an end, and he is cut down like the crop at harvest.

Gurbani: ਜੇਹੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਤੇਵੇਹੋ ਭਣੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: jehe karam kamaavade teveho bhaneeai |
English: According to one's actions, so is one spoken of.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਵਡਾ ਹੈ ਸਭਨਾ ਦਾ ਧਣੀਐ ॥੩੦॥
Transliteration: jan naanak kaa khasam vaddaa hai sabhanaa daa dhaneeai |30|
English: Glorious and great is the Lord and Master of servant Nanak; He is the Master of all. ||30||

[Ang 316 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 4 |
English: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂਲਹੁ ਭੁਲਿਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh moolahu bhuliaa vich lab lobh ahankaar |
English: The self-willed manmukhs forget the Primal Lord, the Source of all; they are caught in greed and egotism.

Gurbani: ਝਗੜਾ ਕਰਦਿਆ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਦਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਕਰਹਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jhagarraa karadiaa anadin gudarai sabad na kareh veechaar |
English: They pass their nights and days in conflict and struggle; they do not contemplate the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸੁਧਿ ਮਤਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਹਿਰਿ ਲਈ ਬੋਲਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sudh mat karatai sabh hir lee bolan sabh vikaar |
English: The Creator has taken away all their understanding and purity; all their speech is evil and corrupt.

Gurbani: ਦਿਤੈ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਅਹਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਬਹੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੵਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: ditai kitai na santokheeeh antar tisanaa bahu agiaan andhayaar |
English: No matter what they are given, they are not satisfied; within their hearts there is great desire, ignorance and darkness.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਨਾਲੋ ਤੁਟੀ ਭਲੀ ਜਿਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak manamukhaa naalo tuttee bhalee jin maaeaa moh piaar |1|
English: O Nanak, it is good to break away from the self-willed manmukhs, who have love and attachment to Maya. ||1||

[Ang 316 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 4 |
English: Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਹੈ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jinaa andar doojaa bhaau hai tinaa guramukh preet na hoe |
English: Those whose hearts are filled with the love of duality, do not love the Gurmukhs.

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਭਵਾਈਐ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: ohu aavai jaae bhavaaeeai supanai sukh na koe |
English: They come and go, and wander in reincarnation; even in their dreams, they find no peace.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਕੂੜੁ ਉਚਰੈ ਕੂੜਿ ਲਗਿਆ ਕੂੜੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: koorr kamaavai koorr ucharai koorr lagiaa koorr hoe |
English: They practice falsehood and they speak falsehood; attached to falsehood, they become false.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਦੁਖਿ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਰੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohu sabh dukh hai dukh binasai dukh roe |
English: The love of Maya is total pain; in pain they perish, and in pain they cry out.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਧਾਤੁ ਲਿਵੈ ਜੋੜੁ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak dhaat livai jorr na aavee je lochai sabh koe |
English: O Nanak, there can be no union between the love of worldliness and the love of the Lord, no matter how much everyone may desire it.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੋਤੈ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਪਇਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jin kau potai pun peaa tinaa gurasabadee sukh hoe |2|
English: Those who have the treasure of virtuous deeds find peace through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2||

[Ang 316 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: paurree mahalaa 5 |
English: Pauree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਵੀਚਾਰਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨਾਂ ਚਾਰਿ ਵੇਦ ਕਹੰਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak veechaareh sant mun janaan chaar ved kahande |
English: O Nanak, the Saints and the silent sages think, and the four Vedas proclaim,

Gurbani: ਭਗਤ ਮੁਖੈ ਤੇ ਬੋਲਦੇ ਸੇ ਵਚਨ ਹੋਵੰਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat mukhai te bolade se vachan hovande |
English: that whatever the Lord's devotees speak comes to pass.

Gurbani: ਪਰਗਟ ਪਾਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਪਦੇ ਸਭਿ ਲੋਕ ਸੁਣੰਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: paragatt paahaarai jaapade sabh lok sunande |
English: He is revealed in His cosmic workshop; all people hear of it.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਮੁਗਧ ਨਰ ਸੰਤ ਨਾਲਿ ਖਹੰਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: sukh na paaein mugadh nar sant naal khahande |
English: The foolish people, who fight with the Saints, find no peace.

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਲੋਚਨਿ ਓਨਾ ਗੁਣਾ ਨੋ ਓਇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਸੜੰਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: oe lochan onaa gunaa no oe ahankaar sarrande |
English: The Saints seek to bless them with virtue, but they are burning with egotism.

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਵੇਚਾਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਾਂ ਭਾਗ ਧੁਰਿ ਮੰਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: oe vechaare kiaa kareh jaan bhaag dhur mande |
English: What can those wretched ones do? Their evil destiny was pre-ordained.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਸੇ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਸੰਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: jo maare tin paarabraham se kisai na sande |
English: Those who are struck down by the Supreme Lord God do not belong to anyone.

Gurbani: ਵੈਰੁ ਕਰਨਿ ਨਿਰਵੈਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਧਰਮਿ ਨਿਆਇ ਪਚੰਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: vair karan niravair naal dharam niaae pachande |
English: Those who hate the One who has no hatred, are destroyed by righteous justice.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸੰਤਿ ਸਰਾਪਿਆ ਸੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਭਵੰਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: jo jo sant saraapiaa se fireh bhavande |
English: Those who are cursed by the Saints wander around lost.

Gurbani: ਪੇਡੁ ਮੁੰਢਾਹੂ ਕਟਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਡਾਲ ਸੁਕੰਦੇ ॥੩੧॥
Transliteration: pedd mundtaahoo kattiaa tis ddaal sukande |31|
English: When the tree is cut off at its roots, the branches wither and die. ||31||

[Ang 317 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਭੰਨਣ ਘੜਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur naanak har naam drirraaeaa bhanan gharran samarath |
English: Guru Nanak implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me; He is All-powerful, to create and destroy.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲਹਿ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਤੂ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ਲਥੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: prabh sadaa samaaleh mitr too dukh sabaaeaa lath |1|
English: Remember God forever, my friend, and all your suffering will disappear. ||1||

[Ang 317 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਖੁਧਿਆਵੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਲਾਜ ਕੁਲਾਜ ਕੁਬੋਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: khudhiaavant na jaanee laaj kulaaj kubol |
English: The hungry person does not care about honor, dishonor or harsh words.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak maangai naam har kar kirapaa sanjog |2|
English: Nanak begs for the Name of the Lord; please grant Your Grace, and unite me with Yourself. ||2||

[Ang 317 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਜੇਵੇਹੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਦਾ ਤੇਵੇਹੇ ਫਲਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: jevehe karam kamaavadaa tevehe falate |
English: According to the deeds which one does, so are the fruits one obtains.

Gurbani: ਚਬੇ ਤਤਾ ਲੋਹ ਸਾਰੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੰਘੈ ਪਲਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: chabe tataa loh saar vich sanghai palate |
English: If someone chews on red-hot iron, his throat will be burned.

Gurbani: ਘਤਿ ਗਲਾਵਾਂ ਚਾਲਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਦੂਤਿ ਅਮਲ ਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: ghat galaavaan chaaliaa tin doot amal te |
English: The halter is put around his neck and he is led away, because of the evil deeds he has done.

Gurbani: ਕਾਈ ਆਸ ਨ ਪੁੰਨੀਆ ਨਿਤ ਪਰ ਮਲੁ ਹਿਰਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: kaaee aas na puneea nit par mal hirate |
English: None of his desires are fulfilled; he continually steals the filth of others.

Gurbani: ਕੀਆ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਅਕਿਰਤਘਣ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਫਿਰਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: keea na jaanai akirataghan vich jonee firate |
English: The ungrateful wretch does not appreciate what he has been given; he wanders lost in reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਸਭੇ ਧਿਰਾਂ ਨਿਖੁਟੀਅਸੁ ਹਿਰਿ ਲਈਅਸੁ ਧਰ ਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: sabhe dhiraan nikhutteeas hir leeas dhar te |
English: He loses all support, when the Support of the Lord is taken away from him.

Gurbani: ਵਿਝਣ ਕਲਹ ਨ ਦੇਵਦਾ ਤਾਂ ਲਇਆ ਕਰਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: vijhan kalah na devadaa taan leaa karate |
English: He does not let the embers of strife die down, and so the Creator destroys him.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਰਤੇ ਅਹੰਮੇਉ ਝੜਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਪੜਤੇ ॥੩੨॥
Transliteration: jo jo karate ahameo jharr dharatee parrate |32|
English: Those who indulge in egotism crumble and fall to the ground. ||32||

[Ang 317 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੁਧਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh giaan bibek budh hoe |
English: The Gurmukh is blessed with spiritual wisdom and a discerning intellect.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਾਰੁ ਪਰੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: har gun gaavai hiradai haar paroe |
English: He sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and weaves this garland into his heart.

Gurbani: ਪਵਿਤੁ ਪਾਵਨੁ ਪਰਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: pavit paavan param beechaaree |
English: He becomes the purest of the pure, a being of supreme understanding.

Gurbani: ਜਿ ਓਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: ji os milai tis paar utaaree |
English: Whoever he meets, he saves and carries across.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: antar har naam baasanaa samaanee |
English: The fragrance of the Lord's Name permeates his being deep within.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਮਹਾ ਉਤਮ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: har dar sobhaa mahaa utam baanee |
English: He is honored in the Court of the Lord, and his speech is the most sublime.

Gurbani: ਜਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਣੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: ji purakh sunai su hoe nihaal |
English: Those who hear him are delighted.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak satigur miliai paaeaa naam dhan maal |1|
English: O Nanak, meeting the True Guru, one obtains the wealth and property of the Naam. ||1||

[Ang 317 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 4 |
English: Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ਕਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur ke jeea kee saar na jaapai ki poorai satigur bhaavai |
English: The sublime state of the True Guru is not known; no one knows what pleases the Perfect True Guru.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾਂ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਵਰਤੈ ਜੋ ਸਿਖਾਂ ਨੋ ਲੋਚੈ ਸੋ ਗੁਰ ਖੁਸੀ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: gurasikhaan andar satiguroo varatai jo sikhaan no lochai so gur khusee aavai |
English: Deep within the hearts of His GurSikhs, the True Guru is pervading. The Guru is pleased with those who long for His Sikhs.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਖੈ ਸੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਨਿ ਸੁ ਜਪੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾਂ ਕੀ ਘਾਲ ਸਚਾ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur aakhai su kaar kamaavan su jap kamaaveh gurasikhaan kee ghaal sachaa thaae paavai |
English: As the True Guru directs them, they do their work and chant their prayers. The True Lord accepts the service of His GurSikhs.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾਂ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਕੰਮੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ ਲੋੜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: vin satigur ke hukamai ji gurasikhaan paasahu kam karaaeaa lorre tis gurasikh fir nerr na aavai |
English: But those who want the GurSikhs to work for them, without the Order of the True Guru - the Guru's Sikhs shall not come near them again.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਗੈ ਕੋ ਜੀਉ ਲਾਇ ਘਾਲੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur satigur agai ko jeeo laae ghaalai tis agai gurasikh kaar kamaavai |
English: One who works diligently for the Guru, the True Guru - the GurSikhs work for him.

Gurbani: ਜਿ ਠਗੀ ਆਵੈ ਠਗੀ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਇ ਤਿਸੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: ji tthagee aavai tthagee utth jaae tis nerrai gurasikh mool na aavai |
English: One who comes to deceive, who rises up and goes out to deceive - the GurSikhs shall never come near him.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥ ਜਿ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਮਨੁ ਮੰਨੇ ਕੰਮੁ ਕਰਾਏ ਸੋ ਜੰਤੁ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: braham beechaar naanak aakh sunaavai | ji vin satigur ke man mane kam karaae so jant mahaa dukh paavai |2|
English: Nanak proclaims and announces this wisdom of God. One who is not pleasing to the Mind of the True Guru may do his deeds, but that being will only suffer in terrible pain. ||2||

[Ang 317 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅਤਿ ਵਡਾ ਤੁਹਿ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਤੂੰ ਵਡ ਵਡੇ ॥
Transliteration: toon sachaa saahib at vaddaa tuhi jevadd toon vadd vadde |
English: O True Lord and Master, You are so very great. As great as You are, You are the greatest of the great.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਸੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਛਡੇ ॥
Transliteration: jis toon meleh so tudh milai toon aape bakhas laihi lekhaa chhadde |
English: He alone is united with You, whom You unite with Yourself. You Yourself bless and forgive us, and tear up our accounts.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂੰ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਮਨੁ ਗਡ ਗਡੇ ॥
Transliteration: jis no toon aap milaaeidaa so satigur seve man gadd gadde |
English: One whom You unite with Yourself, whole-heartedly serves the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਤੂ ਸਭੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਚੰਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਹਡੇ ॥
Transliteration: toon sachaa saahib sach too sabh jeeo pindd cham teraa hadde |
English: You are the True One, the True Lord and Master; my soul, body, flesh and bones are all Yours.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਖੁ ਤੂੰ ਸਚਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਆਸ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡ ਵਡੇ ॥੩੩॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ ॥
Transliteration: jiau bhaavai tiau rakh toon sachiaa naanak man aas teree vadd vadde |33|1| sudh |
English: If it pleases You, then save me, True Lord. Nanak places the hopes of his mind in You alone, O greatest of the great! ||33||1|| Sudh||

[Ang 318 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਰਾਇ ਕਮਾਲਦੀ ਮੋਜਦੀ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਕੀ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਰਿ ਗਾਵਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree kee vaar mahalaa 5 raae kamaaladee mojadee kee vaar kee dhun upar gaavanee |
English: Gauree Kee Vaar, Fifth Mehl: Sung To The Tune Of Vaar Of Raa-I Kamaaldee-Mojadee:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਜਪੈ ਸੋ ਆਇਆ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam jo jan japai so aaeaa paravaan |
English: Auspicious and approved is the birth of that humble being who chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਭਜਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: tis jan kai balihaaranai jin bhajiaa prabh nirabaan |
English: I am a sacrifice to that humble being who vibrates and meditates on God, the Lord of Nirvaanaa.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਟਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: janam maran dukh kattiaa har bhettiaa purakh sujaan |
English: The pains of birth and death are eradicated, upon meeting the All-knowing Lord, the Primal Being.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sant sang saagar tare jan naanak sachaa taan |1|
English: In the Society of the Saints, he crosses over the world-ocean; O servant Nanak, he has the strength and support of the True Lord. ||1||

[Ang 318 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਭਲਕੇ ਉਠਿ ਪਰਾਹੁਣਾ ਮੇਰੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhalake utth paraahunaa merai ghar aavau |
English: I rise up in the early morning hours, and the Holy Guest comes into my home.

Gurbani: ਪਾਉ ਪਖਾਲਾ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਿਤ ਭਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: paau pakhaalaa tis ke man tan nit bhaavau |
English: I wash His feet; He is always pleasing to my mind and body.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: naam sune naam sangrahai naame liv laavau |
English: I hear the Naam, and I gather in the Naam; I am lovingly attuned to the Naam.

Gurbani: ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: grihu dhan sabh pavitru hoe har ke gun gaavau |
English: My home and wealth are totally sanctified as I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har naam vaapaaree naanakaa vaddabhaagee paavau |2|
English: The Trader in the Lord's Name, O Nanak, is found by great good fortune. ||2||

[Ang 318 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਭਲਾ ਸਚੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai so bhalaa sach teraa bhaanaa |
English: Whatever pleases You is good; True is the Pleasure of Your Will.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਸਭ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: too sabh meh ek varatadaa sabh maeh samaanaa |
English: You are the One, pervading in all; You are contained in all.

Gurbani: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਜੀਅ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: thaan thanantar rav rahiaa jeea andar jaanaa |
English: You are diffused throughout and permeating all places and interspaces; You are known to be deep within the hearts of all beings.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਨਿ ਸਚੇ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang mil paaeeai man sache bhaanaa |
English: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and submitting to His Will, the True Lord is found.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਸਦ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak prabh saranaagatee sad sad kurabaanaa |1|
English: Nanak takes to the Sanctuary of God; he is forever and ever a sacrifice to Him. ||1||

[Ang 318 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਚੇਤਾ ਈ ਤਾਂ ਚੇਤਿ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚਾ ਸੋ ਧਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: chetaa ee taan chet saahib sachaa so dhanee |
English: If you are conscious, then be conscious of the True Lord, Your Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਚੜਿ ਬੋਹਿਥਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak satigur sev charr bohith bhaujal paar pau |1|
English: O Nanak, come aboard upon the boat of the service of the True Guru, and cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||

[Ang 318 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਵਾਊ ਸੰਦੇ ਕਪੜੇ ਪਹਿਰਹਿ ਗਰਬਿ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: vaaoo sande kaparre pahireh garab gavaar |
English: He wears his body, like clothes of wind - what a proud fool he is!

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲਨੀ ਜਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਹੋਏ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naal na chalanee jal bal hoe chhaar |2|
English: O Nanak, they will not go with him in the end; they shall be burnt to ashes. ||2||

[Ang 318 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸੇਈ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਗੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੋ ਸਚੈ ਰਖੇ ॥
Transliteration: seee ubare jagai vich jo sachai rakhe |
English: They alone are delivered from the world, who are preserved and protected by the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਮੁਹਿ ਡਿਠੈ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਜੀਵੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਚਖੇ ॥
Transliteration: muhi dditthai tin kai jeeveeai har amrit chakhe |
English: I live by beholding the faces of those who taste the Ambrosial Essence of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧਾ ਭਖੇ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh lobh mohu sang saadhaa bhakhe |
English: Sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment are burnt away, in the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਪਰਖੇ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh aapanee har aap parakhe |
English: God grants His Grace, and the Lord Himself tests them.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਲਤ ਨ ਜਾਪਨੀ ਕੋ ਸਕੈ ਨ ਲਖੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak chalat na jaapanee ko sakai na lakhe |2|
English: O Nanak, His play is not known; no one can understand it. ||2||

[Ang 318 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਈ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਸੁਹਾਵੜਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਵੈ ਚਿਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: naanak soee dinas suhaavarraa jit prabh aavai chit |
English: O Nanak, that day is beautiful, when God comes to mind.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਦਿਨਿ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਫਿਟੁ ਭਲੇਰੀ ਰੁਤਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jit din visarai paarabraham fitt bhaleree rut |1|
English: Cursed is that day, no matter how pleasant the season, when the Supreme Lord God is forgotten. ||1||

[Ang 318 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
Transliteration: naanak mitraaee tis siau sabh kichh jis kai haath |
English: O Nanak, become friends with the One, who holds everything in His hands.

Gurbani: ਕੁਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਸੇਈ ਕਾਂਢੀਅਹਿ ਇਕ ਵਿਖ ਨ ਚਲਹਿ ਸਾਥਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kumitraa seee kaandteeeh ik vikh na chaleh saath |2|
English: They are accounted as false friends, who do not go with you, for even one step. ||2||

[Ang 318 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਪੀਵਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: amrit naam nidhaan hai mil peevahu bhaaee |
English: The treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is Ambrosial Nectar; meet together and drink it in, O Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਭ ਤਿਖਾ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jis simarat sukh paaeeai sabh tikhaa bujhaaee |
English: Remembering Him in meditation, peace is found, and all thirst is quenched.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਭੁਖ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kar sevaa paarabraham gur bhukh rahai na kaaee |
English: So serve the Supreme Lord God and the Guru, and you shall never be hungry again.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੁੰਨਿਆ ਅਮਰਾ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sagal manorath puniaa amaraa pad paaee |
English: All your desires shall be fulfilled, and you shall obtain the status of immortality.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tudh jevadd toohai paarabraham naanak saranaaee |3|
English: You alone are as great as Yourself, O Supreme Lord God; Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary. ||3||

[Ang 318 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਡਿਠੜੋ ਹਭ ਠਾਇ ਊਣ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: ddittharro habh tthaae aoon na kaaee jaae |
English: I have seen all places; there is no place without Him.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਧਾ ਤਿਨ ਸੁਆਉ ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak ladhaa tin suaau jinaa satigur bhettiaa |1|
English: O Nanak, those who meet with the True Guru find the object of life. ||1||

[Ang 319 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦਾਮਨੀ ਚਮਤਕਾਰ ਤਿਉ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ਜਗ ਖੇ ॥
Transliteration: daamanee chamatakaar tiau varataaraa jag khe |
English: Like the flash of lightning, worldly affairs last only for a moment.

Gurbani: ਵਥੁ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸਾਇ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਉ ਜਪੰਦੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਧਣੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: vath suhaavee saae naanak naau japando tis dhanee |2|
English: The only thing which is pleasing, O Nanak, is that which inspires one to meditate on the Name of the Master. ||2||

[Ang 319 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸੋਧਿ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: simrit saasatr sodh sabh kinai keem na jaanee |
English: People have searched all the Simritees and Shaastras, but no one knows the Lord's value.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: jo jan bhettai saadhasang so har rang maanee |
English: That being, who joins the Saadh Sangat enjoys the Love of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਏਹ ਰਤਨਾ ਖਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: sach naam karataa purakh eeh ratanaa khaanee |
English: True is the Naam, the Name of the Creator, the Primal Being. It is the mine of precious jewels.

Gurbani: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪਰਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: masatak hovai likhiaa har simar paraanee |
English: That mortal, who has such pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon his forehead, meditates in remembrance on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਤੋਸਾ ਦਿਚੈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਹਮਾਣੀ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: tosaa dichai sach naam naanak mihamaanee |4|
English: O Lord, please bless Nanak, Your humble guest, with the supplies of the True Name. ||4||

[Ang 319 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਨੈਣੀ ਸੁਖੀ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਭੁਖ ॥
Transliteration: antar chintaa nainee sukhee mool na utarai bhukh |
English: He harbors anxiety within himself, but to the eyes, he appears to be happy; his hunger never departs.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਲਥੋ ਦੁਖੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak sache naam bin kisai na latho dukh |1|
English: O Nanak, without the True Name, no one's sorrows have ever departed. ||1||

[Ang 319 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੁਠੜੇ ਸੇਈ ਸਾਥ ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਲਦਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: muttharre seee saath jinee sach na ladiaa |
English: Those caravans which did not load the Truth have been plundered.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਇਕੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak se saabaas jinee gur mil ik pachhaaniaa |2|
English: O Nanak, those who meet the True Guru, and acknowledge the One Lord, are congratulated. ||2||

[Ang 319 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਜਿਥੈ ਬੈਸਨਿ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹੰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: jithai baisan saadh jan so thaan suhandaa |
English: Beautiful is that place, where the Holy people dwell.

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਿਥੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਸਭੁ ਮੰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: oe sevan samrith aapanaa binasai sabh mandaa |
English: They serve their All-powerful Lord, and they give up all their evil ways.

Gurbani: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੰਤ ਬੇਦੁ ਕਹੰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: patit udhaaran paarabraham sant bed kahandaa |
English: The Saints and the Vedas proclaim, that the Supreme Lord God is the Saving Grace of sinners.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਹੈ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਵਰਤੰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat vachhal teraa birad hai jug jug varatandaa |
English: You are the Lover of Your devotees - this is Your natural way, in each and every age.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਭਾਵੰਦਾ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak jaachai ek naam man tan bhaavandaa |5|
English: Nanak asks for the One Name, which is pleasing to his mind and body. ||5||

[Ang 319 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਚਿੜੀ ਚੁਹਕੀ ਪਹੁ ਫੁਟੀ ਵਗਨਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਤਰੰਗ ॥
Transliteration: chirree chuhakee pahu futtee vagan bahut tarang |
English: The sparrows are chirping, and dawn has come; the wind stirs up the waves.

Gurbani: ਅਚਰਜ ਰੂਪ ਸੰਤਨ ਰਚੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਹਿ ਰੰਗ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: acharaj roop santan rache naanak naameh rang |1|
English: Such a wondrous thing the Saints have fashioned, O Nanak, in the Love of the Naam. ||1||

[Ang 319 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਤਹੀ ਜਹ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਚਿਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: ghar mandar khuseea tahee jeh too aaveh chit |
English: Homes, palaces and pleasures are there, where You, O Lord, come to mind.

Gurbani: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕੀਆ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭਿ ਕੁਮਿਤ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: duneea keea vaddiaaeea naanak sabh kumit |2|
English: All worldly grandeur, O Nanak, is like false and evil friends. ||2||

[Ang 319 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸਚੀ ਰਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: har dhan sachee raas hai kinai viralai jaataa |
English: The wealth of the Lord is the true capital; how rare are those who understand this.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੈ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਭਾਇਰਹੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਇ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: tisai paraapat bhaaeirahu jis dee bidhaataa |
English: He alone receives it, O Siblings of Destiny, unto whom the Architect of Destiny gives it.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਮਉਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਜਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: man tan bheetar mauliaa har rang jan raataa |
English: His servant is imbued with the Love of the Lord; his body and mind blossom forth.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ਸਭਿ ਦੋਖਹ ਖਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang gun gaaeaa sabh dokhah khaataa |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and all of his sufferings are removed.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਈ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਇਕੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: naanak soee jeeviaa jin ik pachhaataa |6|
English: O Nanak, he alone lives, who acknowledges the One Lord. ||6||

[Ang 319 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਖਖੜੀਆ ਸੁਹਾਵੀਆ ਲਗੜੀਆ ਅਕ ਕੰਠਿ ॥
Transliteration: khakharreea suhaaveea lagarreea ak kantth |
English: The fruit of the swallow-wort plant looks beautiful, attached to the branch of the tree;

Gurbani: ਬਿਰਹ ਵਿਛੋੜਾ ਧਣੀ ਸਿਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਸੈ ਗੰਠਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: birah vichhorraa dhanee siau naanak sahasai gantth |1|
English: but when it is separated from the stem of its Master, O Nanak, it breaks apart into thousands of fragments. ||1||

[Ang 319 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਵਿਸਾਰੇਦੇ ਮਰਿ ਗਏ ਮਰਿ ਭਿ ਨ ਸਕਹਿ ਮੂਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: visaarede mar ge mar bhi na sakeh mool |
English: Those who forget the Lord die, but they cannot die a complete death.

Gurbani: ਵੇਮੁਖ ਹੋਏ ਰਾਮ ਤੇ ਜਿਉ ਤਸਕਰ ਉਪਰਿ ਸੂਲਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: vemukh hoe raam te jiau tasakar upar sool |2|
English: Those who turn their backs on the Lord suffer, like the thief impaled on the gallows. ||2||

[Ang 319 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਸੁਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sukh nidhaan prabh ek hai abinaasee suniaa |
English: The One God is the treasure of peace; I have heard that He is eternal and imperishable.

Gurbani: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਿਆ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jal thal maheeal pooriaa ghatt ghatt har bhaniaa |
English: He is totally pervading the water, the land and the sky; the Lord is said to be permeating each and every heart.

Gurbani: ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਸਭ ਇਕ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਕੀਟ ਹਸਤੀ ਬਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: aooch neech sabh ik samaan keett hasatee baniaa |
English: He looks alike upon the high and the low, the ant and the elephant.

Gurbani: ਮੀਤ ਸਖਾ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਿਪੋ ਸਭਿ ਤਿਸ ਦੇ ਜਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: meet sakhaa sut bandhipo sabh tis de janiaa |
English: Friends, companions, children and relatives are all created by Him.

Gurbani: ਤੁਸਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: tus naanak devai jis naam tin har rang maniaa |7|
English: O Nanak, one who is blessed with the Naam, enjoys the Lord's love and affection. ||7||

[Ang 319 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਾ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾਂ ਮਨਿ ਮੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: jinaa saas giraas na visarai har naamaan man mant |
English: Those who do not forget the Lord, with each breath and morsel of food, whose minds are filled with the Mantra of the Lord's Name

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਸਿ ਸੇਈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਸੋਈ ਸੰਤੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dhan si seee naanakaa pooran soee sant |1|
English: - they alone are blessed; O Nanak, they are the perfect Saints. ||1||

[Ang 319 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਠੇ ਪਹਰ ਭਉਦਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਖਾਵਣ ਸੰਦੜੈ ਸੂਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: atthe pehar bhaudaa firai khaavan sandarrai sool |
English: Twenty-four hours a day, he wanders around, driven by his hunger for food.

Gurbani: ਦੋਜਕਿ ਪਉਦਾ ਕਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਜਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਰਸੂਲਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: dojak paudaa kiau rahai jaa chit na hoe rasool |2|
English: How can he escape from falling into hell, when he does not remember the Prophet? ||2||

[Ang 320 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੈ ਸਰੇਵਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀਹੋ ਜਿਸ ਦੈ ਨਾਉ ਪਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: tisai sarevahu praaneeho jis dai naau palai |
English: Serve Him, O mortals, who has the Lord's Name in His lap.

Gurbani: ਐਥੈ ਰਹਹੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਿਆ ਅਗੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਚਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: aithai rahahu suheliaa agai naal chalai |
English: You shall dwell in peace and ease in this world; in the world hereafter, it shall go with you.

Gurbani: ਘਰੁ ਬੰਧਹੁ ਸਚ ਧਰਮ ਕਾ ਗਡਿ ਥੰਮੁ ਅਹਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: ghar bandhahu sach dharam kaa gadd tham ahalai |
English: So build your home of true righteousness, with the unshakable pillars of Dharma.

Gurbani: ਓਟ ਲੈਹੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੈ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਝਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: ott laihu naaraaeinai deen duneea jhalai |
English: Take the Support of the Lord, who gives support in the spiritual and material worlds.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਕੜੇ ਚਰਣ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਲੈ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: naanak pakarre charan har tis daragah malai |8|
English: Nanak grasps the Lotus Feet of the Lord; he humbly bows in His Court. ||8||

[Ang 320 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਾਚਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jaachak mangai daan dehi piaariaa |
English: The beggar begs for charity: give to me, O my Beloved!

Gurbani: ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਮੈ ਨਿਤ ਚਿਤਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: devanahaar daataar mai nit chitaariaa |
English: O Great Giver, O Giving Lord, my consciousness is continually centered on You.

Gurbani: ਨਿਖੁਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਮੂਲਿ ਅਤੁਲ ਭੰਡਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: nikhutt na jaaee mool atul bhanddaariaa |
English: The immeasurable warehouses of the Lord can never be emptied out.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak sabad apaar tin sabh kichh saariaa |1|
English: O Nanak, the Word of the Shabad is infinite; it has arranged everything perfectly. ||1||

[Ang 320 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਿਖਹੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਿਆਰਿਹੋ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ॥
Transliteration: sikhahu sabad piaariho janam maran kee ttek |
English: O Sikhs, love the Word of the Shabad; in life and death, it is our only support.

Gurbani: ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਏਕ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mukh aoojal sadaa sukhee naanak simarat ek |2|
English: Your face shall be radiant, and you shall find a lasting peace, O Nanak, remembering the One Lord in meditation. ||2||

[Ang 320 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਓਥੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵੰਡੀਐ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: othai amrit vanddeeai sukheea har karane |
English: There, the Ambrosial Nectar is distributed; the Lord is the Bringer of peace.

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਕੈ ਪੰਥਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਰਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: jam kai panth na paaeeeh fir naahee marane |
English: They are not placed upon the path of Death, and they shall not have to die again.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਇਆ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਹੀ ਜਰਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: jis no aaeaa prem ras tisai hee jarane |
English: One who comes to savor the Lord's Love experiences it.

Gurbani: ਬਾਣੀ ਉਚਰਹਿ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਅਮਿਉ ਚਲਹਿ ਝਰਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: baanee uchareh saadh jan amiau chaleh jharane |
English: The Holy beings chant the Bani of the Word, like nectar flowing from a spring.

Gurbani: ਪੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਮਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਧਰਣੇ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: pekh darasan naanak jeeviaa man andar dharane |9|
English: Nanak lives by beholding the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of those who have implanted the Lord's Name within their minds. ||9||

[Ang 320 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਦੂਖਾ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਨਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: satigur poorai seviai dookhaa kaa hoe naas |
English: Serving the Perfect True Guru, suffering ends.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਅਰਾਧਿਐ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਆਵੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak naam araadhiai kaaraj aavai raas |1|
English: O Nanak, worshipping the Naam in adoration, one's affairs come to be resolved. ||1||

[Ang 320 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸੰਕਟ ਛੁਟਹਿ ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: jis simarat sankatt chhutteh anad mangal bisraam |
English: Remembering Him in meditation, misfortune departs, and one comes to abide in peace and bliss.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪੀਐ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਬਿਸਰਉ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak japeeai sadaa har nimakh na bisrau naam |2|
English: O Nanak, meditate forever on the Lord - do not forget Him, even for an instant. ||2||

[Ang 320 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਕਿਆ ਗਣੀ ਜਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਧਾ ॥
Transliteration: tin kee sobhaa kiaa ganee jinee har har ladhaa |
English: How can I estimate the glory of those, who have found the Lord, Har, Har?

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਾ ਸਰਣੀ ਜੋ ਪਵੈ ਸੋ ਛੁਟੈ ਬਧਾ ॥
Transliteration: saadhaa saranee jo pavai so chhuttai badhaa |
English: One who seeks the Sanctuary of the Holy is released from bondage.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀਐ ਜੋਨਿ ਗਰਭਿ ਨ ਦਧਾ ॥
Transliteration: gun gaavai abinaaseeai jon garabh na dadhaa |
English: One who sings the Glorious Praises of the Imperishable Lord does not burn in the womb of reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਪੜਿ ਬੁਝਿ ਸਮਧਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur bhettiaa paarabraham har parr bujh samadhaa |
English: One who meets the Guru and the Supreme Lord God, who reads and understands, enters the state of Samaadhi.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋ ਧਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਧਾ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: naanak paaeaa so dhanee har agam agadhaa |10|
English: Nanak has obtained that Lord Master, who is inaccessible and unfathomable. ||10||

[Ang 320 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਰਹੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਅਵਤਾ ਲੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: kaam na karahee aapanaa fireh avataa loe |
English: People do not perform their duties, but instead, they wander around aimlessly.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਇ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਕਿਨੇਹਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak naae visaariai sukh kinehaa hoe |1|
English: O Nanak, if they forget the Name, how can they ever find peace? ||1||

[Ang 320 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬਿਖੈ ਕਉੜਤਣਿ ਸਗਲ ਮਾਹਿ ਜਗਤਿ ਰਹੀ ਲਪਟਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bikhai kaurratan sagal maeh jagat rahee lapattaae |
English: The bitter poison of corruption is everywhere; it clings to the substance of the world.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿਆ ਮੀਠਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak jan veechaariaa meetthaa har kaa naau |2|
English: O Nanak, the humble being has realized that the Name of the Lord alone is sweet. ||2||

[Ang 320 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਇਹ ਨੀਸਾਣੀ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਤਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: eih neesaanee saadh kee jis bhettat tareeai |
English: This is the distinguishing sign of the Holy Saint, that by meeting with him, one is saved.

Gurbani: ਜਮਕੰਕਰੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਮਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: jamakankar nerr na aavee fir bahurr na mareeai |
English: The Messenger of Death does not come near him; he never has to die again.

Gurbani: ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਸੋ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: bhav saagar sansaar bikh so paar utareeai |
English: He crosses over the terrifying, poisonous world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗੁੰਫਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਲ ਹਰਿ ਸਭ ਮਲੁ ਪਰਹਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: har gun gunfahu man maal har sabh mal parahareeai |
English: So weave the garland of the Lord's Glorious Praises into your mind, and all your filth shall be washed away.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਰਹਰੀਐ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: naanak preetam mil rahe paarabraham narahareeai |11|
English: Nanak remains blended with his Beloved, the Supreme Lord God. ||11||

[Ang 320 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਏ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਚਿਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: naanak aae se paravaan hai jin har vutthaa chit |
English: O Nanak, approved is the birth of those, within whose consciousness the Lord abides.

Gurbani: ਗਾਲੑੀ ਅਲ ਪਲਾਲੀਆ ਕੰਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਮਿਤ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gaalaee al palaaleea kam na aaveh mit |1|
English: Useless talk and babbling is useless, my friend. ||1||

[Ang 320 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੀ ਆਇਆ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਗਮ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham prabh drisattee aaeaa pooran agam bisamaad |
English: I have come to see the Supreme Lord God, the Perfect, Inaccessible, Wonderful Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak raam naam dhan keetaa poore gur parasaad |2|
English: Nanak has made the Lord's Name his wealth, by the Grace of the Perfect Guru. ||2||

[Ang 321 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਧੋਹੁ ਨ ਚਲੀ ਖਸਮ ਨਾਲਿ ਲਬਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਗੁਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: dhohu na chalee khasam naal lab mohi vigute |
English: Deception does not work with our Lord and Master; through their greed and emotional attachment, people are ruined.

Gurbani: ਕਰਤਬ ਕਰਨਿ ਭਲੇਰਿਆ ਮਦਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੁਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: karatab karan bhaleriaa mad maaeaa sute |
English: They do their evil deeds, and sleep in the intoxication of Maya.

Gurbani: ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨਿ ਭਵਾਈਅਨਿ ਜਮ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਮੁਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: fir fir joon bhavaaeean jam maarag mute |
English: Time and time again, they are consigned to reincarnation, and abandoned on the path of Death.

Gurbani: ਕੀਤਾ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਦੁਖ ਸੇਤੀ ਜੁਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: keetaa paaein aapanaa dukh setee jute |
English: They receive the consequences of their own actions, and are yoked to their pain.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਇ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਐ ਸਭ ਮੰਦੀ ਰੁਤੇ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naae visaariai sabh mandee rute |12|
English: O Nanak, if one forgets the Name, all the seasons are evil. ||12||

[Ang 321 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਉਠੰਦਿਆ ਬਹੰਦਿਆ ਸਵੰਦਿਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: autthandiaa bahandiaa savandiaa sukh soe |
English: While standing up, sitting down and sleeping, be at peace;

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਲਾਹਿਐ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak naam salaahiai man tan seetal hoe |1|
English: O Nanak, praising the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind and body are cooled and soothed. ||1||

[Ang 321 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਲਾਲਚਿ ਅਟਿਆ ਨਿਤ ਫਿਰੈ ਸੁਆਰਥੁ ਕਰੇ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: laalach attiaa nit firai suaarath kare na koe |
English: Filled with greed, he constantly wanders around; he does not do any good deeds.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jis gur bhettai naanakaa tis man vasiaa soe |2|
English: O Nanak, the Lord abides within the mind of one who meets with the Guru. ||2||

[Ang 321 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸਭੇ ਵਸਤੂ ਕਉੜੀਆ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਉ ਮਿਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabhe vasatoo kaurreea sache naau mitthaa |
English: All material things are bitter; the True Name alone is sweet.

Gurbani: ਸਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਨਾਂ ਚਖਿ ਸਾਧੀ ਡਿਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: saad aaeaa tin har janaan chakh saadhee dditthaa |
English: Those humble servants of the Lord who taste it, come to savor its flavor.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਵੁਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham jis likhiaa man tisai vutthaa |
English: It comes to dwell within the mind of those who are so pre-destined by the Supreme Lord God.

Gurbani: ਇਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਾਉ ਦੁਯਾ ਕੁਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: eik niranjan rav rahiaa bhaau duyaa kutthaa |
English: The One Immaculate Lord is pervading everywhere; He destroys the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਜੋੜਿ ਕਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਤੁਠਾ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: har naanak mangai jorr kar prabh devai tutthaa |13|
English: Nanak begs for the Lord's Name, with his palms pressed together; by His Pleasure, God has granted it. ||13||

[Ang 321 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਾਚੜੀ ਸਾ ਸਾਰੁ ਜੋ ਜਾਚੰਦੀ ਹੇਕੜੋ ॥
Transliteration: jaacharree saa saar jo jaachandee hekarro |
English: The most excellent begging is begging for the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਗਾਲੑੀ ਬਿਆ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਧਣੀ ਵਿਹੂਣੀਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gaalaee biaa vikaar naanak dhanee vihooneea |1|
English: Other talk is corrupt, O Nanak, except that of the Lord Master. ||1||

[Ang 321 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨੀਹਿ ਜਿ ਵਿਧਾ ਮੰਨੁ ਪਛਾਣੂ ਵਿਰਲੋ ਥਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: neehi ji vidhaa man pachhaanoo viralo thio |
English: One who recognizes the Lord is very rare; his mind is pierced through with the Love of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜੋੜਣਹਾਰਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਧਰੁ ਪਧਰੋ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jorranahaaraa sant naanak paadhar padharo |2|
English: Such a Saint is the Uniter, O Nanak - he straightens out the path. ||2||

[Ang 321 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਦਾਤਾ ਬਖਸਿੰਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: soee sevihu jeearre daataa bakhasind |
English: Serve Him, O my soul, who is the Giver and the Forgiver.

Gurbani: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਸਭਿ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ਹੋਨਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: kilavikh sabh binaas hon simarat govind |
English: All sinful mistakes are erased, by meditating in remembrance on the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਦਸਿਆ ਜਪੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: har maarag saadhoo dasiaa japeeai guramant |
English: The Holy Saint has shown me the Way to the Lord; I chant the GurMantra.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਸੁਆਦ ਸਭਿ ਫਿਕਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੰਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa suaad sabh fikiaa har man bhaavand |
English: The taste of Maya is totally bland and insipid; the Lord alone is pleasing to my mind.

Gurbani: ਧਿਆਇ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਦਿਤੀ ਜਿੰਦੁ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: dhiaae naanak paramesarai jin ditee jind |14|
English: Meditate, O Nanak, on the Transcendent Lord, who has blessed you with your soul and your life. ||14||

[Ang 321 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਵਤ ਲਗੀ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਜੋ ਬੀਜੇ ਸੋ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: vat lagee sache naam kee jo beeje so khaae |
English: The time has come to plant the seed of the Lord's Name; one who plants it, shall eat its fruit.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tiseh paraapat naanakaa jis no likhiaa aae |1|
English: He alone receives it, O Nanak, whose destiny is so pre-ordained. ||1||

[Ang 321 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੰਗਣਾ ਤ ਸਚੁ ਇਕੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਤੁਸਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: manganaa ta sach ik jis tus devai aap |
English: If one begs, then he should beg for the Name of the True One, which is given only by His Pleasure.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਖਾਧੈ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਦਾਤਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jit khaadhai man tripateeai naanak saahib daat |2|
English: Eating this gift from the Lord and Master, O Nanak, the mind is satisfied. ||2||

[Ang 321 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਲਾਹਾ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਸੇ ਖਟਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: laahaa jag meh se khatteh jin har dhan raas |
English: They alone earn profit in this world, who have the wealth of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਦੁਤੀਆ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਸਚੇ ਦੀ ਆਸ ॥
Transliteration: duteea bhaau na jaananee sache dee aas |
English: They do not know the love of duality; they place their hopes in the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਏਕੁ ਸਰੇਵਿਆ ਹੋਰੁ ਸਭ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: nihachal ek sareviaa hor sabh vinaas |
English: They serve the One Eternal Lord, and give up everything else.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਸਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham jis visarai tis birathaa saas |
English: One who forgets the Supreme Lord God - useless is his breath.

Gurbani: ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਜਨ ਰਖਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਸੁ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: kantth laae jan rakhiaa naanak bal jaas |15|
English: God draws His humble servant close in His loving embrace and protects him - Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||15||

[Ang 321 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ਮੀਹੁ ਵੁਠਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham furamaaeaa meehu vutthaa sehaj subhaae |
English: The Supreme Lord God gave the Order, and the rain automatically began to fall.

Gurbani: ਅੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੀ ਰਜੀ ਤਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: an dhan bahut upajiaa prithamee rajee tipat aghaae |
English: Grain and wealth were produced in abundance; the earth was totally satisfied and satiated.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਦਾਲਦੁ ਗਇਆ ਬਿਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa gun ucharai dukh daalad geaa bilaae |
English: Forever and ever, chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and pain and poverty shall run away.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਿਸੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: poorab likhiaa paaeaa miliaa tisai rajaae |
English: People obtain that which they are pre-ordained to receive, according to the Will of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੈ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: paramesar jeevaaliaa naanak tisai dhiaae |1|
English: The Transcendent Lord keeps you alive; O Nanak, meditate on Him. ||1||

[Ang 321 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ਇਕੋ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: jeevan pad nirabaan iko simareeai |
English: To obtain the state of life of Nirvaanaa, meditate in remembrance on the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਧੀਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: doojee naahee jaae kin bidh dheereeai |
English: There is no other place; how else can we be comforted?

Gurbani: ਡਿਠਾ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: dditthaa sabh sansaar sukh na naam bin |
English: I have seen the whole world - without the Lord's Name, there is no peace at all.

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਹੋਸੀ ਛਾਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ਜਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: tan dhan hosee chhaar jaanai koe jan |
English: Body and wealth shall return to dust - hardly anyone realizes this.

Gurbani: ਰੰਗ ਰੂਪ ਰਸ ਬਾਦਿ ਕਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰਾਣੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: rang roop ras baad ki kareh paraaneea |
English: Pleasure, beauty and delicious tastes are useless; what are you doing, O mortal?

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਲ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: jis bhulaae aap tis kal nahee jaaneea |
English: One whom the Lord Himself misleads, does not understand His awesome power.

Gurbani: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ਸਚਾ ਗਾਵਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: rang rate nirabaan sachaa gaavahee |
English: Those who are imbued with the Love of the Lord attain Nirvaanaa, singing the Praises of the True One.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak saran duaar je tudh bhaavahee |2|
English: Nanak: those who are pleasing to Your Will, O Lord, seek Sanctuary at Your Door. ||2||

[Ang 322 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: jaman maran na tina kau jo har larr laage |
English: Those who are attached to the hem of the Lord's robe, do not suffer birth and death.

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਤ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੋਏ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨਿ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: jeevat se paravaan hoe har keeratan jaage |
English: Those who remain awake to the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises - their lives are approved.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਜਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੇਈ ਵਡਭਾਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang jin paaeaa seee vaddabhaage |
English: Those who attain the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, are very fortunate.

Gurbani: ਨਾਇ ਵਿਸਰਿਐ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣਾ ਤੂਟੇ ਕਚ ਧਾਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: naae visariai dhrig jeevanaa tootte kach dhaage |
English: But those who forget the Name - their lives are cursed, and broken like thin strands of thread.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਧੂੜਿ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਸਾਧ ਲਖ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਿਰਾਗੇ ॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: naanak dhoorr puneet saadh lakh kott piraage |16|
English: O Nanak, the dust of the feet of the Holy is more sacred than hundreds of thousands, even millions of cleansing baths at sacred shrines. ||16||

[Ang 322 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਧਰਣਿ ਸੁਵੰਨੀ ਖੜ ਰਤਨ ਜੜਾਵੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: dharan suvanee kharr ratan jarraavee har prem purakh man vutthaa |
English: Like the beautiful earth, adorned with jewels of grass - such is the mind, within which the Love of the Lord abides.

Gurbani: ਸਭੇ ਕਾਜ ਸੁਹੇਲੜੇ ਥੀਏ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sabhe kaaj suhelarre thee gur naanak satigur tutthaa |1|
English: All one's affairs are easily resolved, O Nanak, when the Guru, the True Guru, is pleased. ||1||

[Ang 322 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਫਿਰਦੀ ਫਿਰਦੀ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਾ ਜਲ ਪਰਬਤ ਬਨਰਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: firadee firadee deh disaa jal parabat banaraae |
English: Roaming and wandering in the ten directions, over water, mountains and forests

Gurbani: ਜਿਥੈ ਡਿਠਾ ਮਿਰਤਕੋ ਇਲ ਬਹਿਠੀ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jithai dditthaa miratako il bahitthee aae |2|
English: - wherever the vulture sees a dead body, he flies down and lands. ||2||

[Ang 322 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਫਲ ਲੋੜੀਅਹਿ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: jis sarab sukhaa fal lorreeeh so sach kamaavau |
English: One who longs for all comforts and rewards should practice Truth.

Gurbani: ਨੇੜੈ ਦੇਖਉ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: nerrai dekhau paarabraham ik naam dhiaavau |
English: Behold the Supreme Lord God near you, and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਹੋਇ ਸਗਲ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: hoe sagal kee renukaa har sang samaavau |
English: Become the dust of all men's feet, and so merge with the Lord.

Gurbani: ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਕਿਸੈ ਜੀਅ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: dookh na deee kisai jeea pat siau ghar jaavau |
English: Do not cause any being to suffer, and you shall go to your true home with honor.

Gurbani: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਣਾਵਉ ॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: patit puneet karataa purakh naanak sunaavau |17|
English: Nanak speaks of the Purifier of sinners, the Creator, the Primal Being. ||17||

[Ang 322 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਦੋਹਾ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok dohaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Dohaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਜਿ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੈ ਕੀਆ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥
Transliteration: ek ji saajan mai keea sarab kalaa samarath |
English: I have made the One Lord my Friend; He is All-powerful to do everything.

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਸੰਦੜੀ ਵਥੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jeeo hamaaraa khaneeai har man tan sandarree vath |1|
English: My soul is a sacrifice to Him; the Lord is the treasure of my mind and body. ||1||

[Ang 322 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਕਰੁ ਗਹਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਾ ਮੂਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: je kar gaheh piaararre tudh na chhoddaa mool |
English: Take my hand, O my Beloved; I shall never forsake You.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਛੋਡਨਿ ਸੇ ਦੁਰਜਨਾ ਪੜਹਿ ਦੋਜਕ ਕੈ ਸੂਲਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har chhoddan se durajanaa parreh dojak kai sool |2|
English: Those who forsake the Lord, are the most evil people; they shall fall into the horrible pit of hell. ||2||

[Ang 322 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਘਰਿ ਜਿਸ ਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: sabh nidhaan ghar jis dai har kare su hovai |
English: All treasures are in His Home; whatever the Lord does, comes to pass.

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਪਾਪਾ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jap jap jeeveh sant jan paapaa mal dhovai |
English: The Saints live by chanting and meditating on the Lord, washing off the filth of their sins.

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਹਿ ਸੰਕਟ ਸਭਿ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal hiradai vaseh sankatt sabh khovai |
English: With the Lotus Feet of the Lord dwelling within the heart, all misfortune is taken away.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਰੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur pooraa jis bhetteeai mar janam na rovai |
English: One who meets the Perfect Guru, shall not have to suffer through birth and death.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸ ਨਾਨਕ ਘਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਵੈ ॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: prabh daras piaas naanak ghanee kirapaa kar devai |18|
English: Nanak is thirsty for the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan; by His Grace, He has bestowed it. ||18||

[Ang 322 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਡਖਣਾ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok ddakhanaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Dakhanaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਭੋਰੀ ਭਰਮੁ ਵਞਾਇ ਪਿਰੀ ਮੁਹਬਤਿ ਹਿਕੁ ਤੂ ॥
Transliteration: bhoree bharam vayaae piree muhabat hik too |
English: If you can dispel your doubts, even for an instant, and love your only Beloved,

Gurbani: ਜਿਥਹੁ ਵੰਞੈ ਜਾਇ ਤਿਥਾਊ ਮਉਜੂਦੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jithahu vanyai jaae tithaaoo maujood soe |1|
English: then wherever you go, there you shall find Him. ||1||

[Ang 322 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
