Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਚੜਿ ਕੈ ਘੋੜੜੈ ਕੁੰਦੇ ਪਕੜਹਿ ਖੂੰਡੀ ਦੀ ਖੇਡਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: charr kai ghorrarrai kunde pakarreh khoonddee dee kheddaaree |
English: Can they mount horses and handle guns, if all they know is the game of polo?

Gurbani: ਹੰਸਾ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਉਲਾਸਹਿ ਕੁਕੜ ਦੀ ਓਡਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: hansaa setee chit ulaaseh kukarr dee oddaaree |2|
English: Can they be swans, and fulfill their conscious desires, if they can only fly like chickens? ||2||

[Ang 322 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਰਸਨਾ ਉਚਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਸੁਣੈ ਸੋ ਉਧਰੈ ਮਿਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: rasanaa ucharai har sravanee sunai so udharai mitaa |
English: Those who chant the Lord's Name with their tongues and hear it with their ears are saved, O my friend.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਲਿਖਹਿ ਲਾਇ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਸੇ ਹਸਤ ਪਵਿਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: har jas likheh laae bhaavanee se hasat pavitaa |
English: Those hands which lovingly write the Praises of the Lord are pure.

Gurbani: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਮਜਨਾ ਸਭਿ ਪੁੰਨ ਤਿਨਿ ਕਿਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: atthasatth teerath majanaa sabh pun tin kitaa |
English: It is like performing all sorts of virtuous deeds, and bathing at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

Gurbani: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਤੇ ਉਧਰੇ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਗੜੁ ਜਿਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: sansaar saagar te udhare bikhiaa garr jitaa |
English: They cross over the world-ocean, and conquer the fortress of corruption.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ਉਧਾਰਿਅਨੁ ਦਯੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਅਮਿਤਾ ॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: naanak larr laae udhaarian day sev amitaa |19|
English: O Nanak, serve the Infinite Lord; grasp the hem of His robe, and He will save you. ||19||

[Ang 323 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਧੰਧੜੇ ਕੁਲਾਹ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹੇਕੜੋ ॥
Transliteration: dhandharre kulaah chit na aavai hekarro |
English: Worldly affairs are unprofitable, if the One Lord does not come to mind.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਈ ਤੰਨ ਫੁਟੰਨਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਸਾਂਈ ਵਿਸਰੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak seee tan futtan jinaa saanee visarai |1|
English: O Nanak, the bodies of those who forget their Master shall burst apart. ||1||

[Ang 323 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪਰੇਤਹੁ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਦੇਵਤਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: paretahu keeton devataa tin karanaihaare |
English: The ghost has been transformed into an angel by the Creator Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਭੇ ਸਿਖ ਉਬਾਰਿਅਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sabhe sikh ubaarian prabh kaaj savaare |
English: God has emancipated all the Sikhs and resolved their affairs.

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਪਕੜਿ ਪਛਾੜਿਅਨੁ ਝੂਠੇ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: nindak pakarr pachhaarrian jhootthe darabaare |
English: He has seized the slanderers and thrown them to the ground, and declared them false in His Court.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਵਡਾ ਹੈ ਆਪਿ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak kaa prabh vaddaa hai aap saaj savaare |2|
English: Nanak's God is glorious and great; He Himself creates and adorns. ||2||

[Ang 323 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: prabh beant kichh ant naeh sabh tisai karanaa |
English: God is unlimited; He has no limit; He is the One who does everything.

Gurbani: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੋ ਜੀਆਂ ਕਾ ਪਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: agam agochar saahibo jeean kaa paranaa |
English: The Inaccessible and Unapproachable Lord and Master is the Support of His beings.

Gurbani: ਹਸਤ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਦਾ ਭਰਣ ਪੋਖਣੁ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: hasat dee pratipaaladaa bharan pokhan karanaa |
English: Giving His Hand, He nurtures and cherishes; He is the Filler and Fulfiller.

Gurbani: ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ਬਖਸਿੰਦੁ ਆਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਸਚੇ ਤਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: miharavaan bakhasind aap jap sache taranaa |
English: He Himself is Merciful and Forgiving. Chanting the True Name, one is saved.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਭਲਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਰਣਾ ॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai so bhalaa naanak daas saranaa |20|
English: Whatever pleases You - that alone is good; slave Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary. ||20||

[Ang 323 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤਿੰਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਕਾ ਰਹੀ ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: tinaa bhukh na kaa rahee jis daa prabh hai soe |
English: One who belongs to God has no hunger.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਗਿਆ ਉਧਰੈ ਸਭੋ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak charanee lagiaa udharai sabho koe |1|
English: O Nanak, everyone who falls at his feet is saved. ||1||

[Ang 323 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਾਚਿਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਨਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਕਰੇ ਕਬੂਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: jaachik mangai nit naam saahib kare kabool |
English: If the beggar begs for the Lord's Name every day, his Lord and Master will grant his request.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਜਜਮਾਨੁ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਮੂਲਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak paramesar jajamaan tiseh bhukh na mool |2|
English: O Nanak, the Transcendent Lord is the most generous host; He does not lack anything at all. ||2||

[Ang 323 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਚੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਜੋੜੇ ॥
Transliteration: man rataa govind sang sach bhojan jorre |
English: To imbue the mind with the Lord of the Universe is the true food and dress.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਏ ਹਸਤੀ ਘੋੜੇ ॥
Transliteration: preet lagee har naam siau e hasatee ghorre |
English: To embrace love for the Name of the Lord is to possess horses and elephants.

Gurbani: ਰਾਜ ਮਿਲਖ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਘਣੀ ਧਿਆਇ ਮੁਖੁ ਨ ਮੋੜੇ ॥
Transliteration: raaj milakh khuseea ghanee dhiaae mukh na morre |
English: To meditate on the Lord steadfastly is to rule over kingdoms of property and enjoy all sorts of pleasures.

Gurbani: ਢਾਢੀ ਦਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੰਗਣਾ ਦਰੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਛੋੜੇ ॥
Transliteration: dtaadtee dar prabh manganaa dar kade na chhorre |
English: The minstrel begs at God's Door - he shall never leave that Door.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਏਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਲੋੜੇ ॥੨੧॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ ਕੀਚੇ
Transliteration: naanak man tan chaau ehu nit prabh kau lorre |21|1| sudh keeche
English: Nanak has this yearning in his mind and body - he longs continually for God. ||21||1|| Sudh Keechay||

[Ang 323 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਭਗਤਾਂ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: raag gaurree bhagataan kee baanee |
English: Raag Gauree, The Word Of The Devotees:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar sat naam karataa purakh gur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru's Grace:

Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ ਚਉਪਦੇ ੧੪ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree sree kabeer jeeo ke chaupade 14 |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fourteen Chau-Padhay Of Kabeer Jee:

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਜਲਤ ਰਾਮ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: ab mohi jalat raam jal paaeaa |
English: I was on fire, but now I have found the Water of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਉਦਕਿ ਤਨੁ ਜਲਤ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raam udak tan jalat bujhaaeaa |1| rahaau |
English: This Water of the Lord's Name has cooled my burning body. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਣ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਬਨ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: man maaran kaaran ban jaaeeai |
English: To subdue their minds, some go off into the forests;

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਜਲੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: so jal bin bhagavant na paaeeai |1|
English: but that Water is not found without the Lord God. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਪਾਵਕ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਹੈ ਜਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jih paavak sur nar hai jaare |
English: That fire has consumed angels and mortal beings,

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਉਦਕਿ ਜਨ ਜਲਤ ਉਬਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: raam udak jan jalat ubaare |2|
English: but the Water of the Lord's Name saves His humble servants from burning. ||2||

Gurbani: ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: bhav saagar sukh saagar maahee |
English: In the terrifying world-ocean, there is an ocean of peace.

Gurbani: ਪੀਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਜਲ ਨਿਖੁਟਤ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: peev rahe jal nikhuttat naahee |3|
English: I continue to drink it in, but this Water is never exhausted. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਭਜੁ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਪਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: keh kabeer bhaj saaringapaanee |
English: Says Kabeer, meditate and vibrate upon the Lord, like the rainbird remembering the water.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਉਦਕਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਤਿਖਾ ਬੁਝਾਨੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: raam udak meree tikhaa bujhaanee |4|1|
English: The Water of the Lord's Name has quenched my thirst. ||4||1||

[Ang 323 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree kabeer jee |
English: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

Gurbani: ਮਾਧਉ ਜਲ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: maadhau jal kee piaas na jaae |
English: O Lord, my thirst for the Water of Your Name will not go away.

Gurbani: ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਉਠੀ ਅਧਿਕਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jal meh agan utthee adhikaae |1| rahaau |
English: The fire of my thirst burns even more brightly in that Water. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਜਲਨਿਧਿ ਹਉ ਜਲ ਕਾ ਮੀਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: toon jalanidh hau jal kaa meen |
English: You are the Ocean of Water, and I am just a fish in that Water.

Gurbani: ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਉ ਜਲਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਖੀਨੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jal meh rhau jaleh bin kheen |1|
English: In that Water, I remain; without that Water, I would perish. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਪਿੰਜਰੁ ਹਉ ਸੂਅਟਾ ਤੋਰ ॥
Transliteration: toon pinjar hau sooattaa tor |
English: You are the cage, and I am Your parrot.

Gurbani: ਜਮੁ ਮੰਜਾਰੁ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੈ ਮੋਰ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jam manjaar kahaa karai mor |2|
English: So what can the cat of death do to me? ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਤਰਵਰੁ ਹਉ ਪੰਖੀ ਆਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: toon taravar hau pankhee aaeh |
English: You are the tree, and I am the bird.

Gurbani: ਮੰਦਭਾਗੀ ਤੇਰੋ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: mandabhaagee tero darasan naeh |3|
English: I am so unfortunate - I cannot see the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan! ||3||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹਉ ਨਉਤਨੁ ਚੇਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: toon satigur hau nautan chelaa |
English: You are the True Guru, and I am Your new disciple.

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਮਿਲੁ ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਬੇਲਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: keh kabeer mil ant kee belaa |4|2|
English: Says Kabeer, O Lord, please meet me - this is my very last chance! ||4||2||

[Ang 324 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree kabeer jee |
English: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਹਮ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jab ham eko ek kar jaaniaa |
English: When I realize that there is One, and only One Lord,

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਲੋਗਹ ਕਾਹੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tab logah kaahe dukh maaniaa |1|
English: why then should the people be upset? ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਅਪਤਹ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: ham apatah apunee pat khoee |
English: I am dishonored; I have lost my honor.

Gurbani: ਹਮਰੈ ਖੋਜਿ ਪਰਹੁ ਮਤਿ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hamarai khoj parahu mat koee |1| rahaau |
English: No one should follow in my footsteps. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਮੰਦੇ ਮੰਦੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: ham mande mande man maahee |
English: I am bad, and bad in my mind as well.

Gurbani: ਸਾਝ ਪਾਤਿ ਕਾਹੂ ਸਿਉ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saajh paat kaahoo siau naahee |2|
English: I have no partnership with anyone. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪਤਿ ਅਪਤਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਨਹੀ ਲਾਜ ॥
Transliteration: pat apat taa kee nahee laaj |
English: I have no shame about honor or dishonor.

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਜਾਨਹੁਗੇ ਜਬ ਉਘਰੈਗੋ ਪਾਜ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tab jaanahuge jab ugharaigo paaj |3|
English: But you shall know, when your own false covering is laid bare. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਪਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer pat har paravaan |
English: Says Kabeer, honor is that which is accepted by the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਭਜੁ ਕੇਵਲ ਰਾਮੁ ॥੪॥੩॥
Transliteration: sarab tiaag bhaj keval raam |4|3|
English: Give up everything - meditate, vibrate upon the Lord alone. ||4||3||

[Ang 324 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree kabeer jee |
English: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

Gurbani: ਨਗਨ ਫਿਰਤ ਜੌ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: nagan firat jau paaeeai jog |
English: If Yoga could be obtained by wandering around naked,

Gurbani: ਬਨ ਕਾ ਮਿਰਗੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਸਭੁ ਹੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ban kaa mirag mukat sabh hog |1|
English: then all the deer of the forest would be liberated. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਨਾਗੇ ਕਿਆ ਬਾਧੇ ਚਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa naage kiaa baadhe chaam |
English: What does it matter whether someone goes naked, or wears a deer skin,

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਨਹੀ ਚੀਨਸਿ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jab nahee cheenas aatam raam |1| rahaau |
English: if he does not remember the Lord within his soul? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੂਡ ਮੁੰਡਾਏ ਜੌ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: moodd munddaae jau sidh paaee |
English: If the spiritual perfection of the Siddhas could be obtained by shaving the head,

Gurbani: ਮੁਕਤੀ ਭੇਡ ਨ ਗਈਆ ਕਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mukatee bhedd na geea kaaee |2|
English: then why haven't sheep found liberation? ||2||

Gurbani: ਬਿੰਦੁ ਰਾਖਿ ਜੌ ਤਰੀਐ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: bind raakh jau tareeai bhaaee |
English: If someone could save himself by celibacy, O Siblings of Destiny,

Gurbani: ਖੁਸਰੈ ਕਿਉ ਨ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: khusarai kiau na param gat paaee |3|
English: why then haven't eunuchs obtained the state of supreme dignity? ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਨਰ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer sunahu nar bhaaee |
English: Says Kabeer, listen, O men, O Siblings of Destiny:

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਨਿ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੪॥
Transliteration: raam naam bin kin gat paaee |4|4|
English: without the Lord's Name, who has ever found salvation? ||4||4||

[Ang 324 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree kabeer jee |
English: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

Gurbani: ਸੰਧਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਾਤ ਇਸ੍ਨਾਨੁ ਕਰਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: sandhiaa praat isanaan karaahee |
English: Those who take their ritual baths in the evening and the morning

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਭਏ ਦਾਦੁਰ ਪਾਨੀ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jiau bhe daadur paanee maahee |1|
English: are like the frogs in the water. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਪੈ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jau pai raam raam rat naahee |
English: When people do not love the Lord's Name,

Gurbani: ਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੈ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: te sabh dharam raae kai jaahee |1| rahaau |
English: they must all go to the Righteous Judge of Dharma. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਰਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਰੂਪ ਰਚਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa rat bahu roop rachaahee |
English: Those who love their bodies and try different looks,

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਦਇਆ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਭੀ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tin kau deaa supanai bhee naahee |2|
English: do not feel compassion, even in dreams. ||2||

Gurbani: ਚਾਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਕਹਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਆਗਰ ॥
Transliteration: chaar charan kaheh bahu aagar |
English: The wise men call them four-footed creatures;

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਕਲਿ ਸਾਗਰ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: saadhoo sukh paaveh kal saagar |3|
English: the Holy find peace in this ocean of pain. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਬਹੁ ਕਾਇ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer bahu kaae kareejai |
English: Says Kabeer, why do you perform so many rituals?

Gurbani: ਸਰਬਸੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੪॥੫॥
Transliteration: sarabas chhodd mahaa ras peejai |4|5|
English: Renounce everything, and drink in the supreme essence of the Lord. ||4||5||

[Ang 324 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਗਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: kabeer jee gaurree |
English: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਜਪੁ ਕਿਆ ਤਪੁ ਕਿਆ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa jap kiaa tap kiaa brat poojaa |
English: What use is chanting, and what use is penance, fasting or devotional worship,

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਭਾਉ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jaa kai ridai bhaau hai doojaa |1|
English: to one whose heart is filled with the love of duality? ||1||

Gurbani: ਰੇ ਜਨ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਧਉ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: re jan man maadhau siau laaeeai |
English: O humble people, link your mind to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਨ ਚਤੁਰਭੁਜੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: chaturaaee na chaturabhuj paaeeai | rahaau |
English: Through cleverness, the four-armed Lord is not obtained. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪਰਹਰੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਅਰੁ ਲੋਕਾਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: parahar lobh ar lokaachaar |
English: Set aside your greed and worldly ways.

Gurbani: ਪਰਹਰੁ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: parahar kaam krodh ahankaar |2|
English: Set aside sexual desire, anger and egotism. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਰਮ ਕਰਤ ਬਧੇ ਅਹੰਮੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: karam karat badhe ahamev |
English: Ritual practices bind people in egotism;

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਥਰ ਕੀ ਕਰਹੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: mil paathar kee karahee sev |3|
English: meeting together, they worship stones. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer bhagat kar paaeaa |
English: Says Kabeer, He is obtained only by devotional worship.

Gurbani: ਭੋਲੇ ਭਾਇ ਮਿਲੇ ਰਘੁਰਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੬॥
Transliteration: bhole bhaae mile raghuraaeaa |4|6|
English: Through innocent love, the Lord is met. ||4||6||

[Ang 324 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree kabeer jee |
English: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

Gurbani: ਗਰਭ ਵਾਸ ਮਹਿ ਕੁਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: garabh vaas meh kul nahee jaatee |
English: In the dwelling of the womb, there is no ancestry or social status.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਉਤਪਾਤੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: braham bind te sabh utapaatee |1|
English: All have originated from the Seed of God. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਰੇ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਬਾਮਨ ਕਬ ਕੇ ਹੋਏ ॥
Transliteration: kahu re panddit baaman kab ke hoe |
English: Tell me, O Pandit, O religious scholar: since when have you been a Brahmin?

Gurbani: ਬਾਮਨ ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਮਤ ਖੋਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: baaman keh keh janam mat khoe |1| rahaau |
English: Don't waste your life by continually claiming to be a Brahmin. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੌ ਤੂੰ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣੀ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jau toon braahaman brahamanee jaaeaa |
English: If you are indeed a Brahmin, born of a Brahmin mother,

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਆਨ ਬਾਟ ਕਾਹੇ ਨਹੀ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tau aan baatt kaahe nahee aaeaa |2|
English: then why didn't you come by some other way? ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਕਤ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣ ਹਮ ਕਤ ਸੂਦ ॥
Transliteration: tum kat braahaman ham kat sood |
English: How is it that you are a Brahmin, and I am of a low social status?

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਕਤ ਲੋਹੂ ਤੁਮ ਕਤ ਦੂਧ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ham kat lohoo tum kat doodh |3|
English: How is it that I am formed of blood, and you are made of milk? ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੋ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer jo braham beechaarai |
English: Says Kabeer, one who contemplates God,

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਕਹੀਅਤੁ ਹੈ ਹਮਾਰੈ ॥੪॥੭॥
Transliteration: so braahaman kaheeat hai hamaarai |4|7|
English: is said to be a Brahmin among us. ||4||7||

[Ang 325 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree kabeer jee |
English: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

Gurbani: ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਸੁਖਿ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਸੋਈ ਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: andhakaar sukh kabeh na soee hai |
English: In the darkness, no one can sleep in peace.

Gurbani: ਰਾਜਾ ਰੰਕੁ ਦੋਊ ਮਿਲਿ ਰੋਈ ਹੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: raajaa rank doaoo mil roee hai |1|
English: The king and the pauper both weep and cry. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਪੈ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਹਿਬੋ ॥
Transliteration: jau pai rasanaa raam na kahibo |
English: As long as the tongue does not chant the Lord's Name,

Gurbani: ਉਪਜਤ ਬਿਨਸਤ ਰੋਵਤ ਰਹਿਬੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aupajat binasat rovat rahibo |1| rahaau |
English: the person continues coming and going in reincarnation, crying out in pain. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਸ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਤਰਵਰ ਕੀ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jas dekheeai taravar kee chhaaeaa |
English: It is like the shadow of a tree;

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਗਏ ਕਹੁ ਕਾ ਕੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: praan ge kahu kaa kee maaeaa |2|
English: when the breath of life passes out of the mortal being, tell me, what becomes of his wealth? ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਸ ਜੰਤੀ ਮਹਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jas jantee meh jeeo samaanaa |
English: It is like the music contained in the instrument;

Gurbani: ਮੂਏ ਮਰਮੁ ਕੋ ਕਾ ਕਰ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: mooe maram ko kaa kar jaanaa |3|
English: how can anyone know the secret of the dead? ||3||

Gurbani: ਹੰਸਾ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: hansaa saravar kaal sareer |
English: Like the swan on the lake, death hovers over the body.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਨ ਪੀਉ ਰੇ ਕਬੀਰ ॥੪॥੮॥
Transliteration: raam rasaaein peeo re kabeer |4|8|
English: Drink in the Lord's sweet elixir, Kabeer. ||4||8||

[Ang 325 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree kabeer jee |
English: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

Gurbani: ਜੋਤਿ ਕੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਜਾਤਿ ਕੀ ਜੋਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: jot kee jaat jaat kee jotee |
English: The creation is born of the Light, and the Light is in the creation.

Gurbani: ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਗੇ ਕੰਚੂਆ ਫਲ ਮੋਤੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tit laage kanchooaa fal motee |1|
English: It bears two fruits: the false glass and the true pearl. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਘਰੁ ਜੋ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: kavan su ghar jo nirbhau kaheeai |
English: Where is that home, which is said to be free of fear?

Gurbani: ਭਉ ਭਜਿ ਜਾਇ ਅਭੈ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhau bhaj jaae abhai hoe raheeai |1| rahaau |
English: There, fear is dispelled and one lives without fear. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤਟਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਪਤੀਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: tatt teerath nahee man pateeae |
English: On the banks of sacred rivers, the mind is not appeased.

Gurbani: ਚਾਰ ਅਚਾਰ ਰਹੇ ਉਰਝਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: chaar achaar rahe urajhaae |2|
English: People remain entangled in good and bad deeds. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਦੁਇ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: paap pun due ek samaan |
English: Sin and virtue are both the same.

Gurbani: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਤਜਹੁ ਗੁਨ ਆਨ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: nij ghar paaras tajahu gun aan |3|
English: In the home of your own being, is the Philosopher's Stone; renounce your search for any other virtue. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਬੀਰ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਰੋਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: kabeer niragun naam na ros |
English: Kabeer: O worthless mortal, do not lose the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਪਰਚਾਇ ਪਰਚਿ ਰਹੁ ਏਸੁ ॥੪॥੯॥
Transliteration: eis parachaae parach rahu es |4|9|
English: Keep this mind of yours involved in this involvement. ||4||9||

[Ang 325 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree kabeer jee |
English: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਪਰਮਿਤਿ ਪਰਮਨੁ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo jan paramit paraman jaanaa |
English: He claims to know the Lord, who is beyond measure and beyond thought;

Gurbani: ਬਾਤਨ ਹੀ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: baatan hee baikuntth samaanaa |1|
English: by mere words, he plans to enter heaven. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਜਾਨਾ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਕਹਾ ਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: naa jaanaa baikuntth kahaa hee |
English: I do not know where heaven is.

Gurbani: ਜਾਨੁ ਜਾਨੁ ਸਭਿ ਕਹਹਿ ਤਹਾ ਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaan jaan sabh kaheh tahaa hee |1| rahaau |
English: Everyone claims that he plans to go there. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਹਨ ਕਹਾਵਨ ਨਹ ਪਤੀਅਈ ਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: kehan kahaavan neh pateeaee hai |
English: By mere talk, the mind is not appeased.

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਈ ਹੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tau man maanai jaa te haumai jee hai |2|
English: The mind is only appeased, when egotism is conquered. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਮਨਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਕੀ ਆਸ ॥
Transliteration: jab lag man baikuntth kee aas |
English: As long as the mind is filled with the desire for heaven,

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਹੀ ਚਰਨ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tab lag hoe nahee charan nivaas |3|
English: he does not dwell at the Lord's Feet. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਇਹ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer ih kaheeai kaeh |
English: Says Kabeer, unto whom should I tell this?

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠੈ ਆਹਿ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: saadhasangat baikuntthai aaeh |4|10|
English: The Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is heaven. ||4||10||

[Ang 325 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree kabeer jee |
English: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

Gurbani: ਉਪਜੈ ਨਿਪਜੈ ਨਿਪਜਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aupajai nipajai nipaj samaaee |
English: We are born, and we grow, and having grown, we pass away.

Gurbani: ਨੈਨਹ ਦੇਖਤ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: nainah dekhat ihu jag jaaee |1|
English: Before our very eyes, this world is passing away. ||1||

Gurbani: ਲਾਜ ਨ ਮਰਹੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਘਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: laaj na marahu kahahu ghar meraa |
English: How can you not die of shame, claiming, This world is mine?

Gurbani: ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਬਾਰ ਨਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ant kee baar nahee kachh teraa |1| rahaau |
English: At the very last moment, nothing is yours. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਪਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: anik jatan kar kaaeaa paalee |
English: Trying various methods, you cherish your body,

Gurbani: ਮਰਤੀ ਬਾਰ ਅਗਨਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਾਲੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: maratee baar agan sang jaalee |2|
English: but at the time of death, it is burned in the fire. ||2||

Gurbani: ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਮਰਦਨ ਅੰਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: choaa chandan maradan angaa |
English: You apply sandalwood oil to your limbs,

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਤਨੁ ਜਲੈ ਕਾਠ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: so tan jalai kaatth kai sangaa |3|
English: but that body is burned with the firewood. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਗੁਨੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer sunahu re guneea |
English: Says Kabeer, listen, O virtuous people:

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਸੈਗੋ ਰੂਪੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਸਭ ਦੁਨੀਆ ॥੪॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: binasaigo roop dekhai sabh duneea |4|11|
English: your beauty shall vanish, as the whole world watches. ||4||11||

[Ang 325 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree kabeer jee |
English: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

Gurbani: ਅਵਰ ਮੂਏ ਕਿਆ ਸੋਗੁ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: avar mooe kiaa sog kareejai |
English: Why do you cry and mourn, when another person dies?

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਕੀਜੈ ਜਉ ਆਪਨ ਜੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tau keejai jau aapan jeejai |1|
English: Do so only if you yourself are to live. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਨ ਮਰਉ ਮਰਿਬੋ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: mai na mrau maribo sansaaraa |
English: I shall not die as the rest of the world dies,

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਹੈ ਜੀਆਵਨਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ab mohi milio hai jeeaavanahaaraa |1| rahaau |
English: for now I have met the life-giving Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਇਆ ਦੇਹੀ ਪਰਮਲ ਮਹਕੰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: eaa dehee paramal mahakandaa |
English: People anoint their bodies with fragrant oils,

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਸੁਖ ਬਿਸਰੇ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: taa sukh bisare paramaanandaa |2|
English: and in that pleasure, they forget the supreme bliss. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕੂਅਟਾ ਏਕੁ ਪੰਚ ਪਨਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kooattaa ek panch panihaaree |
English: There is one well, and five water-carriers.

Gurbani: ਟੂਟੀ ਲਾਜੁ ਭਰੈ ਮਤਿ ਹਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ttoottee laaj bharai mat haaree |3|
English: Even though the rope is broken, the fools continue trying to draw water. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਇਕ ਬੁਧਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer ik budh beechaaree |
English: Says Kabeer, through contemplation, I have obtained this one understanding.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਕੂਅਟਾ ਨਾ ਪਨਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: naa ohu kooattaa naa panihaaree |4|12|
English: There is no well, and no water-carrier. ||4||12||

[Ang 325 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree kabeer jee |
English: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

Gurbani: ਅਸਥਾਵਰ ਜੰਗਮ ਕੀਟ ਪਤੰਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: asathaavar jangam keett patangaa |
English: The mobile and immobile creatures, insects and moths

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਨਮ ਕੀਏ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: anik janam kee bahu rangaa |1|
English: - in numerous lifetimes, I have passed through those many forms. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸੇ ਘਰ ਹਮ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aise ghar ham bahut basaae |
English: I lived in many such homes, O Lord,

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਹਮ ਰਾਮ ਗਰਭ ਹੋਇ ਆਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jab ham raam garabh hoe aae |1| rahaau |
English: before I came into the womb this time. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੋਗੀ ਜਤੀ ਤਪੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jogee jatee tapee brahamachaaree |
English: I was a Yogi, a celibate, a penitent, and a Brahmchaaree, with strict self-discipline.

Gurbani: ਕਬਹੂ ਰਾਜਾ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤਿ ਕਬਹੂ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kabahoo raajaa chhatrapat kabahoo bhekhaaree |2|
English: Sometimes I was a king, sitting on the throne, and sometimes I was a beggar. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤ ਮਰਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਜੀਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: saakat mareh sant sabh jeeveh |
English: The faithless cynics shall die, while the Saints shall all survive.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਨੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਪੀਵਹਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: raam rasaaein rasanaa peeveh |3|
English: They drink in the Lord's Ambrosial Essence with their tongues. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer prabh kirapaa keejai |
English: Says Kabeer, O God, have mercy on me.

Gurbani: ਹਾਰਿ ਪਰੇ ਅਬ ਪੂਰਾ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੪॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: haar pare ab pooraa deejai |4|13|
English: I am so tired; now, please bless me with Your perfection. ||4||13||

[Ang 326 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਕੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਰਲਾਇ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree kabeer jee kee naal ralaae likhiaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Gauree, Kabeer Jee, With Writings Of The Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਐਸੋ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਕਬੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: aiso acharaj dekhio kabeer |
English: Kabeer has seen such wonders!

Gurbani: ਦਧਿ ਕੈ ਭੋਲੈ ਬਿਰੋਲੈ ਨੀਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dadh kai bholai birolai neer |1| rahaau |
English: Mistaking it for cream, the people are churning water. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰੀ ਅੰਗੂਰੀ ਗਦਹਾ ਚਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: haree angooree gadahaa charai |
English: The donkey grazes upon the green grass;

Gurbani: ਨਿਤ ਉਠਿ ਹਾਸੈ ਹੀਗੈ ਮਰੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: nit utth haasai heegai marai |1|
English: arising each day, he laughs and brays, and then dies. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਾਤਾ ਭੈਸਾ ਅੰਮੁਹਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: maataa bhaisaa amuhaa jaae |
English: The bull is intoxicated, and runs around wildly.

Gurbani: ਕੁਦਿ ਕੁਦਿ ਚਰੈ ਰਸਾਤਲਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kud kud charai rasaatal paae |2|
English: He romps and eats and then falls into hell. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਭਈ ਖੇਡ ॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer paragatt bhee khedd |
English: Says Kabeer, a strange sport has become manifest:

Gurbani: ਲੇਲੇ ਕਉ ਚੂਘੈ ਨਿਤ ਭੇਡ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: lele kau chooghai nit bhedd |3|
English: the sheep is sucking the milk of her lamb. ||3||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਰਮਤ ਮਤਿ ਪਰਗਟੀ ਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: raam ramat mat paragattee aaee |
English: Chanting the Lord's Name, my intellect is enlightened.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਗੁਰਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer gur sojhee paaee |4|1|14|
English: Says Kabeer, the Guru has blessed me with this understanding. ||4||1||14||

[Ang 326 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਪੰਚਪਦੇ₂ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree kabeer jee panchapade₂ |
English: Gauree, Kabeer Jee, Panch-Padhay:

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਛੋਡਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭਇਓ ਮੀਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jiau jal chhodd baahar bheo meenaa |
English: I am like a fish out of water,

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਬ ਜਨਮ ਹਉ ਤਪ ਕਾ ਹੀਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: poorab janam hau tap kaa heenaa |1|
English: because in my previous life, I did not practice penance and intense meditation. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਕਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਕਵਨ ਗਤਿ ਮੋਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: ab kahu raam kavan gat moree |
English: Now tell me, Lord, what will my condition be?

Gurbani: ਤਜੀ ਲੇ ਬਨਾਰਸ ਮਤਿ ਭਈ ਥੋਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tajee le banaaras mat bhee thoree |1| rahaau |
English: I left Benares - I had little common sense. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਿਵ ਪੁਰੀ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sagal janam siv puree gavaaeaa |
English: I wasted my whole life in the city of Shiva;

Gurbani: ਮਰਤੀ ਬਾਰ ਮਗਹਰਿ ਉਠਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: maratee baar magahar utth aaeaa |2|
English: at the time of my death, I moved to Magahar. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਰਸ ਤਪੁ ਕੀਆ ਕਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: bahut baras tap keea kaasee |
English: For many years, I practiced penance and intense meditation at Kaashi;

Gurbani: ਮਰਨੁ ਭਇਆ ਮਗਹਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਸੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: maran bheaa magahar kee baasee |3|
English: now that my time to die has come, I have come to dwell at Magahar! ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਾਸੀ ਮਗਹਰ ਸਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kaasee magahar sam beechaaree |
English: Kaashi and Magahar - I consider them the same.

Gurbani: ਓਛੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕੈਸੇ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਪਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: ochhee bhagat kaise utaras paaree |4|
English: With inadequate devotion, how can anyone swim across? ||4||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਜ ਸਿਵ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: kahu gur gaj siv sabh ko jaanai |
English: Says Kabeer, the Guru and Ganaysha and Shiva all know

Gurbani: ਮੁਆ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਰਮਤ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਾਮੈ ॥੫॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: muaa kabeer ramat sree raamai |5|15|
English: that Kabeer died chanting the Lord's Name. ||5||15||

[Ang 326 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree kabeer jee |
English: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

Gurbani: ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨ ਮਰਦਨ ਅੰਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: choaa chandan maradan angaa |
English: You may anoint your limbs with sandalwood oil,

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਤਨੁ ਜਲੈ ਕਾਠ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: so tan jalai kaatth kai sangaa |1|
English: but in the end, that body will be burned with the firewood. ||1||

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਧਨ ਕੀ ਕਵਨ ਬਡਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: eis tan dhan kee kavan baddaaee |
English: Why should anyone take pride in this body or wealth?

Gurbani: ਧਰਨਿ ਪਰੈ ਉਰਵਾਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dharan parai uravaar na jaaee |1| rahaau |
English: They shall end up lying on the ground; they shall not go along with you to the world beyond. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਰਾਤਿ ਜਿ ਸੋਵਹਿ ਦਿਨ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: raat ji soveh din kareh kaam |
English: They sleep by night and work during the day,

Gurbani: ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਲੇਹਿ ਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: eik khin lehi na har ko naam |2|
English: but they do not chant the Lord's Name, even for an instant. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਾਥਿ ਤ ਡੋਰ ਮੁਖਿ ਖਾਇਓ ਤੰਬੋਰ ॥
Transliteration: haath ta ddor mukh khaaeo tanbor |
English: They hold the string of the kite in their hands, and chew betel leaves in their mouths,

Gurbani: ਮਰਤੀ ਬਾਰ ਕਸਿ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਚੋਰ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: maratee baar kas baadhio chor |3|
English: but at the time of death, they shall be tied up tight, like thieves. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: guramat ras ras har gun gaavai |
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, and immersed in His Love, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮੈ ਰਾਮ ਰਮਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: raamai raam ramat sukh paavai |4|
English: Chant the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, and find peace. ||4||

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kirapaa kar kai naam drirraaee |
English: In His Mercy, He implants the Naam within us;

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਸੁ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਬਸਾਈ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: har har baas sugandh basaaee |5|
English: inhale deeply the sweet aroma and fragrance of the Lord, Har, Har. ||5||

Gurbani: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਚੇਤਿ ਰੇ ਅੰਧਾ ॥
Transliteration: kehat kabeer chet re andhaa |
English: Says Kabeer, remember Him, you blind fool!

Gurbani: ਸਤਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਝੂਠਾ ਸਭੁ ਧੰਧਾ ॥੬॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: sat raam jhootthaa sabh dhandhaa |6|16|
English: The Lord is True; all worldly affairs are false. ||6||16||

[Ang 326 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਤਿਪਦੇ ਚਾਰਤੁਕੇ₂ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree kabeer jee tipade chaaratuke₂ |
English: Gauree, Kabeer Jee, Thi-Padhay And Chau-Thukay:

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਤੇ ਉਲਟਿ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: jam te ulatt bhe hai raam |
English: I have turned away from death and turned to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਦੁਖ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸੁਖ ਕੀਓ ਬਿਸਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: dukh binase sukh keeo bisaraam |
English: Pain has been eliminated, and I dwell in peac and comfort.

Gurbani: ਬੈਰੀ ਉਲਟਿ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: bairee ulatt bhe hai meetaa |
English: My enemies have been transformed into friends.

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤ ਉਲਟਿ ਸੁਜਨ ਭਏ ਚੀਤਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saakat ulatt sujan bhe cheetaa |1|
English: The faithless cynics have been transformed into good-hearted people. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਕੁਸਲ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: ab mohi sarab kusal kar maaniaa |
English: Now, I feel that everything brings me peace.

Gurbani: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਭਈ ਜਬ ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saant bhee jab gobid jaaniaa |1| rahaau |
English: Peace and tranquility have come, since I realized the Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਤੀ ਕੋਟਿ ਉਪਾਧਿ ॥
Transliteration: tan meh hotee kott upaadh |
English: My body was afflicted with millions of diseases.

Gurbani: ਉਲਟਿ ਭਈ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ॥
Transliteration: aulatt bhee sukh sehaj samaadh |
English: They have been transformed into the peaceful, tranquil concentration of Samaadhi.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਨੈ ਆਪੈ ਆਪ ॥
Transliteration: aap pachhaanai aapai aap |
English: When someone understands his own self,

Gurbani: ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਤੀਨੌ ਤਾਪ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: rog na biaapai teenau taap |2|
English: he no longer suffers from illness and the three fevers. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਮਨੁ ਉਲਟਿ ਸਨਾਤਨੁ ਹੂਆ ॥
Transliteration: ab man ulatt sanaatan hooaa |
English: My mind has now been restored to its original purity.

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਜਬ ਜੀਵਤ ਮੂਆ ॥
Transliteration: tab jaaniaa jab jeevat mooaa |
English: When I became dead while yet alive, only then did I come to know the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer sukh sehaj samaavau |
English: Says Kabeer, I am now immersed in intuitive peace and poise.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਨ ਡਰਉ ਨ ਅਵਰ ਡਰਾਵਉ ॥੩॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: aap na ddrau na avar ddaraavau |3|17|
English: I do not fear anyone, and I do not strike fear into anyone else. ||3||17||

[Ang 327 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree kabeer jee |
English: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

Gurbani: ਪਿੰਡਿ ਮੂਐ ਜੀਉ ਕਿਹ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: pindd mooai jeeo kih ghar jaataa |
English: When the body dies, where does the soul go?

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਅਤੀਤਿ ਅਨਾਹਦਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabad ateet anaahad raataa |
English: It is absorbed into the untouched, unstruck melody of the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jin raam jaaniaa tineh pachhaaniaa |
English: Only one who knows the Lord realizes Him.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਗੂੰਗੇ ਸਾਕਰ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jiau goonge saakar man maaniaa |1|
English: The mind is satisfied and satiated, like the mute who eats the sugar candy and just smiles, without speaking. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਕਥੈ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa giaan kathai banavaaree |
English: Such is the spiritual wisdom which the Lord has imparted.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਪਵਨ ਦ੍ਰਿੜ ਸੁਖਮਨ ਨਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: man re pavan drirr sukhaman naaree |1| rahaau |
English: O mind, hold your breath steady within the central channel of the Sushmanaa. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਜਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: so gur karahu ji bahur na karanaa |
English: Adopt such a Guru, that you shall not have to adopt another again.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਪਦੁ ਰਵਹੁ ਜਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਰਵਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: so pad ravahu ji bahur na ravanaa |
English: Dwell in such a state, that you shall never have to dwell in any other.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰਹੁ ਜਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਧਰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: so dhiaan dharahu ji bahur na dharanaa |
English: Embrace such a meditation, that you shall never have to embrace any other.

Gurbani: ਐਸੇ ਮਰਹੁ ਜਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਮਰਨਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aise marahu ji bahur na maranaa |2|
English: Die in such a way, that you shall never have to die again. ||2||

Gurbani: ਉਲਟੀ ਗੰਗਾ ਜਮੁਨ ਮਿਲਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: aulattee gangaa jamun milaavau |
English: Turn your breath away from the left channel, and away from the right channel, and unite them in the central channel of the Sushmanaa.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਸੰਗਮ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਨੑਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: bin jal sangam man meh naavau |
English: At their confluence within your mind, take your bath there without water.

Gurbani: ਲੋਚਾ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਇਹੁ ਬਿਉਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: lochaa samasar ihu biauhaaraa |
English: To look upon all with an impartial eye - let this be your daily occupation.

Gurbani: ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਕਿਆ ਅਵਰਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tat beechaar kiaa avar beechaaraa |3|
English: Contemplate this essence of reality - what else is there to contemplate? ||3||

Gurbani: ਅਪੁ ਤੇਜੁ ਬਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੀ ਆਕਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: ap tej baae prithamee aakaasaa |
English: Water, fire, wind, earth and ether

Gurbani: ਐਸੀ ਰਹਤ ਰਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aisee rehat rhau har paasaa |
English: adopt such a way of life and you shall be close to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: kahai kabeer niranjan dhiaavau |
English: Says Kabeer, meditate on the Immaculate Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਉ ਜਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਉ ॥੪॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: tit ghar jaau ji bahur na aavau |4|18|
English: Go to that home, which you shall never have to leave. ||4||18||

[Ang 327 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਤਿਪਦੇ₁₅ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree kabeer jee tipade₁₅ |
English: Gauree, Kabeer Jee, Thi-Padhay:

Gurbani: ਕੰਚਨ ਸਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਹੀ ਤੋਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: kanchan siau paaeeai nahee tol |
English: He cannot be obtained by offering your weight in gold.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਦੇ ਰਾਮੁ ਲੀਆ ਹੈ ਮੋਲਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: man de raam leea hai mol |1|
English: But I have bought the Lord by giving my mind to Him. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: ab mohi raam apunaa kar jaaniaa |
English: Now I recognize that He is my Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj subhaae meraa man maaniaa |1| rahaau |
English: My mind is intuitively pleased with Him. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੈ ਕਥਿ ਕਥਿ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: brahamai kath kath ant na paaeaa |
English: Brahma spoke of Him continually, but could not find His limit.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਬੈਠੇ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: raam bhagat baitthe ghar aaeaa |2|
English: Because of my devotion to the Lord, He has come to sit within the home of my inner being. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਚੰਚਲ ਮਤਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer chanchal mat tiaagee |
English: Says Kabeer, I have renounced my restless intellect.

Gurbani: ਕੇਵਲ ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਜ ਭਾਗੀ ॥੩॥੧॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: keval raam bhagat nij bhaagee |3|1|19|
English: It is my destiny to worship the Lord alone. ||3||1||19||

[Ang 327 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree kabeer jee |
English: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਮਰਨੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਾਸਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jih maranai sabh jagat taraasiaa |
English: That death which terrifies the entire world

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਮਰਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: so maranaa gur sabad pragaasiaa |1|
English: - the nature of that death has been revealed to me, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਕੈਸੇ ਮਰਉ ਮਰਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: ab kaise mrau maran man maaniaa |
English: Now, how shall I die? My mind has already accepted death.

Gurbani: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਤੇ ਜਿਨ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mar mar jaate jin raam na jaaniaa |1| rahaau |
English: Those who do not know the Lord, die over and over again, and then depart. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਰਨੋ ਮਰਨੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: marano maran kahai sabh koee |
English: Everyone says, I will die, I will die.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਮਰੈ ਅਮਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sahaje marai amar hoe soee |2|
English: But he alone becomes immortal, who dies with intuitive understanding. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਮਨਿ ਭਇਆ ਅਨੰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer man bheaa anandaa |
English: Says Kabeer, my mind is filled with bliss;

Gurbani: ਗਇਆ ਭਰਮੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ॥੩॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: geaa bharam rahiaa paramaanandaa |3|20|
English: my doubts have been eliminated, and I am in ecstasy. ||3||20||

[Ang 327 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree kabeer jee |
English: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

Gurbani: ਕਤ ਨਹੀ ਠਉਰ ਮੂਲੁ ਕਤ ਲਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: kat nahee tthaur mool kat laavau |
English: There is no special place where the soul aches; where should I apply the ointment?

Gurbani: ਖੋਜਤ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: khojat tan meh tthaur na paavau |1|
English: I have searched the body, but I have not found such a place. ||1||

Gurbani: ਲਾਗੀ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਪੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: laagee hoe su jaanai peer |
English: He alone knows it, who feels the pain of such love;

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਅਨੀਆਲੇ ਤੀਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raam bhagat aneeaale teer |1| rahaau |
English: the arrows of the Lord's devotional worship are so sharp! ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਭਾਇ ਦੇਖਉ ਸਭ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: ek bhaae dekhau sabh naaree |
English: I look upon all His soul-brides with an impartial eye;

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਜਾਨਉ ਸਹ ਕਉਨ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kiaa jaanau seh kaun piaaree |2|
English: how can I know which ones are dear to the Husband Lord? ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer jaa kai masatak bhaag |
English: Says Kabeer, one who has such destiny inscribed upon her forehead

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਹਾਗੁ ॥੩॥੨੧॥
Transliteration: sabh parahar taa kau milai suhaag |3|21|
English: - her Husband Lord turns all others away, and meets with her. ||3||21||

[Ang 328 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree kabeer jee |
English: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai har saa tthaakur bhaaee |
English: One who has the Lord as his Master, O Siblings of Destiny

Gurbani: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਅਨੰਤ ਪੁਕਾਰਣਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mukat anant pukaaran jaaee |1|
English: - countless liberations knock at his door. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਕਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਭਰੋਸਾ ਤੋਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: ab kahu raam bharosaa toraa |
English: If I say now that my trust is in You alone, Lord,

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਕਾਹੂ ਕਾ ਕਵਨੁ ਨਿਹੋਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tab kaahoo kaa kavan nihoraa |1| rahaau |
English: then what obligation do I have to anyone else? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੀਨਿ ਲੋਕ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਹਿ ਭਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: teen lok jaa kai heh bhaar |
English: He bears the burden of the three worlds;

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਕਾਹੇ ਨ ਕਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: so kaahe na karai pratipaar |2|
English: why should He not cherish you also? ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਇਕ ਬੁਧਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer ik budh beechaaree |
English: Says Kabeer, through contemplation, I have obtained this one understanding.

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਬਸੁ ਜਉ ਬਿਖੁ ਦੇ ਮਹਤਾਰੀ ॥੩॥੨੨॥
Transliteration: kiaa bas jau bikh de mahataaree |3|22|
English: If the mother poisons her own child, what can anyone do? ||3||22||

[Ang 328 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree kabeer jee |
English: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤ ਸਤੀ ਹੋਇ ਕੈਸੇ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: bin sat satee hoe kaise naar |
English: Without Truth, how can the woman be a true satee - a widow who burns herself on her husband's funeral pyre?

Gurbani: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: panddit dekhahu ridai beechaar |1|
English: O Pandit, O religious scholar, see this and contemplate it within your heart. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਬਧੈ ਸਨੇਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: preet binaa kaise badhai sanehu |
English: Without love, how can one's affection increase?

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਰਸੁ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਨਹੀ ਨੇਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jab lag ras tab lag nahee nehu |1| rahaau |
English: As long as there is attachment to pleasure, there can be no spiritual love. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਹਨਿ ਸਤੁ ਕਰੈ ਜੀਅ ਅਪਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: saahan sat karai jeea apanai |
English: One who, in his own soul, believes the Queen Maya to be true,

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਰਮਯੇ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਨ ਸੁਪਨੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: so ramaye kau milai na supanai |2|
English: does not meet the Lord, even in dreams. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਸਉਪਿ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: tan man dhan grihu saup sareer |
English: One who surrenders her body, mind, wealth, home and self

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰੁ ॥੩॥੨੩॥
Transliteration: soee suhaagan kahai kabeer |3|23|
English: - she is the true soul-bride, says Kabeer. ||3||23||

[Ang 328 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree kabeer jee |
English: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

Gurbani: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਆਪਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: bikhiaa biaapiaa sagal sansaar |
English: The whole world is engrossed in corruption.

Gurbani: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਲੈ ਡੂਬੀ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bikhiaa lai ddoobee paravaar |1|
English: This corruption has drowned entire families. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰੇ ਨਰ ਨਾਵ ਚਉੜਿ ਕਤ ਬੋੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: re nar naav chaurr kat borree |
English: O man, why have you wrecked your boat and sunk it?

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਤੋੜਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਜੋੜੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har siau torr bikhiaa sang jorree |1| rahaau |
English: You have broken with the Lord, and joined hands with corruption. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਦਾਧੇ ਲਾਗੀ ਆਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: sur nar daadhe laagee aag |
English: Angels and human beings alike are burning in the raging fire.

Gurbani: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨੀਰੁ ਪਸੁ ਪੀਵਸਿ ਨ ਝਾਗਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: nikatt neer pas peevas na jhaag |2|
English: The water is near at hand, but the beast does not drink it in. ||2||

Gurbani: ਚੇਤਤ ਚੇਤਤ ਨਿਕਸਿਓ ਨੀਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: chetat chetat nikasio neer |
English: By constant contemplation and awareness, the water is brought forth.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਜਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਕਥਤ ਕਬੀਰੁ ॥੩॥੨੪॥
Transliteration: so jal niramal kathat kabeer |3|24|
English: That water is immaculate and pure, says Kabeer. ||3||24||

[Ang 328 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree kabeer jee |
English: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਕੁਲਿ ਪੂਤੁ ਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jih kul poot na giaan beechaaree |
English: That family, whose son has no spiritual wisdom or contemplation

Gurbani: ਬਿਧਵਾ ਕਸ ਨ ਭਈ ਮਹਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bidhavaa kas na bhee mahataaree |1|
English: - why didn't his mother just become a widow? ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਨਰ ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਹਿ ਸਾਧੀ ॥
Transliteration: jih nar raam bhagat neh saadhee |
English: That man who has not practiced devotional worship of the Lord

Gurbani: ਜਨਮਤ ਕਸ ਨ ਮੁਓ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: janamat kas na muo aparaadhee |1| rahaau |
English: - why didn't such a sinful man die at birth? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੁਚੁ ਮੁਚੁ ਗਰਭ ਗਏ ਕੀਨ ਬਚਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: much much garabh ge keen bachiaa |
English: So many pregnancies end in miscarriage - why was this one spared?

Gurbani: ਬੁਡਭੁਜ ਰੂਪ ਜੀਵੇ ਜਗ ਮਝਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: buddabhuj roop jeeve jag majhiaa |2|
English: He lives his life in this world like a deformed amputee. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੈਸੇ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸਰੂਪ ॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer jaise sundar saroop |
English: Says Kabeer, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord,

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਜੈਸੇ ਕੁਬਜ ਕੁਰੂਪ ॥੩॥੨੫॥
Transliteration: naam binaa jaise kubaj kuroop |3|25|
English: Beautiful and handsome people are just ugly hunch-backs. ||3||25||

[Ang 328 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree kabeer jee |
English: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਲੇਹਿ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo jan lehi khasam kaa naau |
English: I am forever a sacrifice to those humble beings

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tin kai sad balihaarai jaau |1|
English: Who take the Name of their Lord and Master. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: so niramal niramal har gun gaavai |
English: Those who sing the Glorious Praises of the Pure Lord are pure.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਭਾਈ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: so bhaaee merai man bhaavai |1| rahaau |
English: They are my Siblings of Destiny, so dear to my heart. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਘਟ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jih ghatt raam rahiaa bharapoor |
English: I am the dust of the lotus feet of those

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਪਗ ਪੰਕਜ ਹਮ ਧੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tin kee pag pankaj ham dhoor |2|
English: Whose hearts are filled with the All-pervading Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਾਤਿ ਜੁਲਾਹਾ ਮਤਿ ਕਾ ਧੀਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jaat julaahaa mat kaa dheer |
English: I am a weaver by birth, and patient of mind.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਮੈ ਕਬੀਰੁ ॥੩॥੨੬॥
Transliteration: sehaj sehaj gun ramai kabeer |3|26|
English: Slowly, steadily, Kabeer chants the Glories of God. ||3||26||

[Ang 328 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree kabeer jee |
English: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

Gurbani: ਗਗਨਿ ਰਸਾਲ ਚੁਐ ਮੇਰੀ ਭਾਠੀ ॥
Transliteration: gagan rasaal chuai meree bhaatthee |
English: From the Sky of the Tenth Gate, the nectar trickles down, distilled from my furnace.

Gurbani: ਸੰਚਿ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਤਨੁ ਭਇਆ ਕਾਠੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sanch mahaa ras tan bheaa kaatthee |1|
English: I have gathered in this most sublime essence, making my body into firewood. ||1||

Gurbani: ਉਆ ਕਉ ਕਹੀਐ ਸਹਜ ਮਤਵਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: auaa kau kaheeai sehaj matavaaraa |
English: He alone is called intoxicated with intuitive peace and poise,

Gurbani: ਪੀਵਤ ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: peevat raam ras giaan beechaaraa |1| rahaau |
English: who drinks in the juice of the Lord's essence, contemplating spiritual wisdom. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਹਜ ਕਲਾਲਨਿ ਜਉ ਮਿਲਿ ਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj kalaalan jau mil aaee |
English: Intuitive poise is the bar-maid who comes to serve it.

Gurbani: ਆਨੰਦਿ ਮਾਤੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aanand maate anadin jaaee |2|
English: I pass my nights and days in ecstasy. ||2||

Gurbani: ਚੀਨਤ ਚੀਤੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: cheenat cheet niranjan laaeaa |
English: Through conscious meditation, I linked my consciousness with the Immaculate Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਤੌ ਅਨਭਉ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥੨੭॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer tau anbhau paaeaa |3|27|
English: Says Kabeer, then I obtained the Fearless Lord. ||3||27||

[Ang 328 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree kabeer jee |
English: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਮਨਹਿ ਬਿਆਪੀ ॥
Transliteration: man kaa subhaau maneh biaapee |
English: The natural tendency of the mind is to chase the mind.

Gurbani: ਮਨਹਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਵਨ ਸਿਧਿ ਥਾਪੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: maneh maar kavan sidh thaapee |1|
English: Who has established himself as a Siddha, a being of miraculous spiritual powers, by killing his mind? ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਮੁਨਿ ਜੋ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: kavan su mun jo man maarai |
English: Who is that silent sage, who has killed his mind?

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕਉ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਤਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: man kau maar kahahu kis taarai |1| rahaau |
English: By killing the mind, tell me, who is saved? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬੋਲੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: man antar bolai sabh koee |
English: Everyone speaks through the mind.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮਾਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: man maare bin bhagat na hoee |2|
English: Without killing the mind, devotional worship is not performed. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੋ ਜਾਨੈ ਭੇਉ ॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer jo jaanai bheo |
English: Says Kabeer, one who knows the secret of this mystery,

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਦੇਉ ॥੩॥੨੮॥
Transliteration: man madhusoodan tribhavan deo |3|28|
English: beholds within his own mind the Lord of the three worlds. ||3||28||

[Ang 329 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree kabeer jee |
English: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਜੁ ਦੀਸਹਿ ਅੰਬਰਿ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: oe ju deeseh anbar taare |
English: The stars which are seen in the sky

Gurbani: ਕਿਨਿ ਓਇ ਚੀਤੇ ਚੀਤਨਹਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kin oe cheete cheetanahaare |1|
English: - who is the painter who painted them? ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਰੇ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਅੰਬਰੁ ਕਾ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: kahu re panddit anbar kaa siau laagaa |
English: Tell me, O Pandit, what is the sky attached to?

Gurbani: ਬੂਝੈ ਬੂਝਨਹਾਰੁ ਸਭਾਗਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: boojhai boojhanahaar sabhaagaa |1| rahaau |
English: Very fortunate is the knower who knows this. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੂਰਜ ਚੰਦੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਉਜੀਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sooraj chand kareh ujeeaaraa |
English: The sun and the moon give their light;

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sabh meh pasariaa braham pasaaraa |2|
English: God's creative extension extends everywhere. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਾਨੈਗਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer jaanaigaa soe |
English: Says Kabeer, he alone knows this,

Gurbani: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮੈ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥੨੯॥
Transliteration: hiradai raam mukh raamai hoe |3|29|
English: whose heart is filled with the Lord, and whose mouth is also filled with the Lord. ||3||29||

[Ang 329 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree kabeer jee |
English: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

Gurbani: ਬੇਦ ਕੀ ਪੁਤ੍ਰੀ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: bed kee putree sinmrit bhaaee |
English: The Simritee is the daughter of the Vedas, O Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਸਾਂਕਲ ਜੇਵਰੀ ਲੈ ਹੈ ਆਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saankal jevaree lai hai aaee |1|
English: She has brought a chain and a rope. ||1||

Gurbani: ਆਪਨ ਨਗਰੁ ਆਪ ਤੇ ਬਾਧਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: aapan nagar aap te baadhiaa |
English: She has imprisoned the people in her own city.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹ ਕੈ ਫਾਧਿ ਕਾਲ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਂਧਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: moh kai faadh kaal sar saandhiaa |1| rahaau |
English: She has tightened the noose of emotional attachment and shot the arrow of death. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਟੀ ਨ ਕਟੈ ਤੂਟਿ ਨਹ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kattee na kattai toott neh jaaee |
English: By cutting, she cannot be cut, and she cannot be broken.

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਸਾਪਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਜਗ ਕਉ ਖਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saa saapan hoe jag kau khaaee |2|
English: She has become a serpent, and she is eating the world. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਦੇਖਤ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਲੂਟਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: ham dekhat jin sabh jag loottiaa |
English: Before my very eyes, she has plundered the entire world.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਮੈ ਰਾਮ ਕਹਿ ਛੂਟਿਆ ॥੩॥੩੦॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer mai raam keh chhoottiaa |3|30|
English: Says Kabeer, chanting the Lord's Name, I have escaped her. ||3||30||

[Ang 329 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree kabeer jee |
English: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

Gurbani: ਦੇਇ ਮੁਹਾਰ ਲਗਾਮੁ ਪਹਿਰਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: dee muhaar lagaam pahiraavau |
English: I have grasped the reins and attached the bridle;

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਤ ਜੀਨੁ ਗਗਨ ਦਉਰਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sagal ta jeen gagan dauraavau |1|
English: abandoning everything, I now ride through the skies. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੈ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਅਸਵਾਰੀ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: apanai beechaar asavaaree keejai |
English: I made self-reflection my mount,

Gurbani: ਸਹਜ ਕੈ ਪਾਵੜੈ ਪਗੁ ਧਰਿ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj kai paavarrai pag dhar leejai |1| rahaau |
English: and in the stirrups of intuitive poise, I placed my feet. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਚਲੁ ਰੇ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਲੇ ਤਾਰਉ ॥
Transliteration: chal re baikuntth tujheh le taarau |
English: Come, and let me ride you to heaven.

Gurbani: ਹਿਚਹਿ ਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੈ ਚਾਬੁਕ ਮਾਰਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: hicheh ta prem kai chaabuk maarau |2|
English: If you hold back, then I shall strike you with the whip of spiritual love. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਭਲੇ ਅਸਵਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kehat kabeer bhale asavaaraa |
English: Says Kabeer, those who remain detached from the

Gurbani: ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਤੇ ਰਹਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਰਾ ॥੩॥੩੧॥
Transliteration: bed kateb te raheh niraaraa |3|31|
English: Vedas, the Koran and the Bible are the best riders. ||3||31||

[Ang 329 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree kabeer jee |
English: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਂਚਉ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਖਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jih mukh paanchau amrit khaae |
English: That mouth, which used to eat the five delicacies

Gurbani: ਤਿਹ ਮੁਖ ਦੇਖਤ ਲੂਕਟ ਲਾਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tih mukh dekhat lookatt laae |1|
English: - I have seen the flames being applied to that mouth. ||1||

Gurbani: ਇਕੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਕਾਟਹੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: eik dukh raam raae kaattahu meraa |
English: O Lord, my King, please rid me of this one affliction:

Gurbani: ਅਗਨਿ ਦਹੈ ਅਰੁ ਗਰਭ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: agan dahai ar garabh baseraa |1| rahaau |
English: may I not be burned in fire, or cast into the womb again. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਬਿਗੂਤੀ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਭਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa bigootee bahu bidh bhaatee |
English: The body is destroyed by so many ways and means.

Gurbani: ਕੋ ਜਾਰੇ ਕੋ ਗਡਿ ਲੇ ਮਾਟੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ko jaare ko gadd le maattee |2|
English: Some burn it, and some bury it in the earth. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਦਿਖਾਵਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer har charan dikhaavahu |
English: Says Kabeer, O Lord, please reveal to me Your Lotus Feet;

Gurbani: ਪਾਛੈ ਤੇ ਜਮੁ ਕਿਉ ਨ ਪਠਾਵਹੁ ॥੩॥੩੨॥
Transliteration: paachhai te jam kiau na patthaavahu |3|32|
English: after that, go ahead and send me to my death. ||3||32||

[Ang 329 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree kabeer jee |
English: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਆਪੇ ਪਵਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape paavak aape pavanaa |
English: He Himself is the fire, and He Himself is the wind.

Gurbani: ਜਾਰੈ ਖਸਮੁ ਤ ਰਾਖੈ ਕਵਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jaarai khasam ta raakhai kavanaa |1|
English: When our Lord and Master wishes to burn someone, then who can save him? ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਜਪਤ ਤਨੁ ਜਰਿ ਕੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: raam japat tan jar kee na jaae |
English: When I chant the Lord's Name, what does it matter if my body burns?

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਚਿਤੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam chit rahiaa samaae |1| rahaau |
English: My consciousness remains absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਾ ਕੋ ਜਰੈ ਕਾਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਹਾਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: kaa ko jarai kaeh hoe haan |
English: Who is burned, and who suffers loss?

Gurbani: ਨਟ ਵਟ ਖੇਲੈ ਸਾਰਿਗਪਾਨਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: natt vatt khelai saarigapaan |2|
English: The Lord plays, like the juggler with his ball. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਅਖਰ ਦੁਇ ਭਾਖਿ ॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer akhar due bhaakh |
English: Says Kabeer, chant the two letters of the Lord's Name - Raa Maa.

Gurbani: ਹੋਇਗਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਤ ਲੇਇਗਾ ਰਾਖਿ ॥੩॥੩੩॥
Transliteration: hoeigaa khasam ta leeigaa raakh |3|33|
English: If He is your Lord and Master, He will protect you. ||3||33||

[Ang 329 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਦੁਪਦੇ₂ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree kabeer jee dupade₂ |
English: Gauree, Kabeer Jee, Dho-Padhay:

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਮੈ ਜੋਗ ਧਿਆਨ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: naa mai jog dhiaan chit laaeaa |
English: I have not practiced Yoga, or focused my consciousness on meditation.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗ ਨ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bin bairaag na chhoottas maaeaa |1|
English: Without renunciation, I cannot escape Maya. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕੈਸੇ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaise jeevan hoe hamaaraa |
English: How have I passed my life?

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jab na hoe raam naam adhaaraa |1| rahaau |
English: I have not taken the Lord's Name as my Support. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਖੋਜਉ ਅਸਮਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer khojau asamaan |
English: Says Kabeer, I have searched the skies,

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਸਮਾਨ ਨ ਦੇਖਉ ਆਨ ॥੨॥੩੪॥
Transliteration: raam samaan na dekhau aan |2|34|
English: and have not seen another, equal to the Lord. ||2||34||

[Ang 330 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree kabeer jee |
English: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਸਿਰਿ ਰਚਿ ਰਚਿ ਬਾਧਤ ਪਾਗ ॥
Transliteration: jih sir rach rach baadhat paag |
English: That head which was once embellished with the finest turban

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਿਰੁ ਚੁੰਚ ਸਵਾਰਹਿ ਕਾਗ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: so sir chunch savaareh kaag |1|
English: - upon that head, the crow now cleans his beak. ||1||

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਧਨ ਕੋ ਕਿਆ ਗਰਬਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: eis tan dhan ko kiaa garabeea |
English: What pride should we take in this body and wealth?

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਾਹੇ ਨ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੑੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam kaahe na drirraeea |1| rahaau |
English: Why not hold tight to the Lord's Name instead? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kehat kabeer sunahu man mere |
English: Says Kabeer, listen, O my mind:

Gurbani: ਇਹੀ ਹਵਾਲ ਹੋਹਿਗੇ ਤੇਰੇ ॥੨॥੩੫॥
Transliteration: eihee havaal hohige tere |2|35|
English: this may be your fate as well! ||2||35||

Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਕੇ ਪਦੇ ਪੈਤੀਸ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree ke pade paitees |
English: Thirty-Five Steps Of Gauree Gwaarayree. ||

[Ang 330 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: raag gaurree guaareree asattapadee kabeer jee kee |
English: Raag Gauree Gwaarayree, Ashtpadheeyaa Of Kabeer Jee:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਂਗਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਆਗੈ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: sukh maangat dukh aagai aavai |
English: People beg for pleasure, but pain comes instead.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਹਮਹੁ ਨ ਮਾਂਗਿਆ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: so sukh hamahu na maangiaa bhaavai |1|
English: I would rather not beg for that pleasure. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਅਜਹੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਖ ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: bikhiaa ajahu surat sukh aasaa |
English: People are involved in corruption, but still, they hope for pleasure.

Gurbani: ਕੈਸੇ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kaise hoee hai raajaa raam nivaasaa |1| rahaau |
English: How will they find their home in the Sovereign Lord King? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਸੁਖ ਤੇ ਸਿਵ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਡਰਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: eis sukh te siv braham ddaraanaa |
English: Even Shiva and Brahma are afraid of this pleasure,

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਹਮਹੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: so sukh hamahu saach kar jaanaa |2|
English: but I have judged that pleasure to be true. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਨਕਾਦਿਕ ਨਾਰਦ ਮੁਨਿ ਸੇਖਾ ॥
Transliteration: sanakaadik naarad mun sekhaa |
English: Even sages like Sanak and Naarad, and the thousand-headed serpent,

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਭੀ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਪੇਖਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tin bhee tan meh man nahee pekhaa |3|
English: did not see the mind within the body. ||3||

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਕੋਈ ਖੋਜਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: eis man kau koee khojahu bhaaee |
English: Anyone can search for this mind, O Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਤਨ ਛੂਟੇ ਮਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: tan chhootte man kahaa samaaee |4|
English: When it escapes from the body, where does the mind go? ||4||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜੈਦੇਉ ਨਾਮਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee jaideo naamaan |
English: By Guru's Grace, Jai Dayv and Naam Dayv

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਇਨ ਹੀ ਹੈ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: bhagat kai prem in hee hai jaanaan |5|
English: came to know this, through loving devotional worship of the Lord. ||5||

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਨਹੀ ਆਵਨ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: eis man kau nahee aavan jaanaa |
English: This mind does not come or go.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: jis kaa bharam geaa tin saach pachhaanaa |6|
English: One whose doubt is dispelled, knows the Truth. ||6||

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਕਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: eis man kau roop na rekhiaa kaaee |
English: This mind has no form or outline.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹੋਇਆ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੂਝਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: hukame hoeaa hukam boojh samaaee |7|
English: By God's Command it was created; understanding God's Command, it will be absorbed into Him again. ||7||

Gurbani: ਇਸ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਨੈ ਭੇਉ ॥
Transliteration: eis man kaa koee jaanai bheo |
English: Does anyone know the secret of this mind?

Gurbani: ਇਹ ਮਨਿ ਲੀਣ ਭਏ ਸੁਖਦੇਉ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: eih man leen bhe sukhadeo |8|
English: This mind shall merge into the Lord, the Giver of peace and pleasure. ||8||

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਏਕੁ ਅਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeeo ek ar sagal sareeraa |
English: There is One Soul, and it pervades all bodies.

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਕਬੀਰਾ ॥੯॥੧॥੩੬॥
Transliteration: eis man kau rav rahe kabeeraa |9|1|36|
English: Kabeer dwells upon this Mind. ||9||1||36||

[Ang 330 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree guaareree |
English: Gauree Gwaarayree:

Gurbani: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਏਕ ਨਾਮ ਜੋ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: ahinis ek naam jo jaage |
English: Those who are awake to the One Name, day and night

Gurbani: ਕੇਤਕ ਸਿਧ ਭਏ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ketak sidh bhe liv laage |1| rahaau |
English: - many of them have become Siddhas - perfect spiritual beings - with their consciousness attuned to the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਕ ਸਿਧ ਸਗਲ ਮੁਨਿ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: saadhak sidh sagal mun haare |
English: The seekers, the Siddhas and the silent sages have all lost the game.

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਨਾਮ ਕਲਿਪ ਤਰ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ek naam kalip tar taare |1|
English: The One Name is the wish-fulfilling Elysian Tree, which saves them and carries them across. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਹਿ ਨ ਆਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo har hare su hohi na aanaa |
English: Those who are rejuvenated by the Lord, do not belong to any other.

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥੨॥੩੭॥
Transliteration: keh kabeer raam naam pachhaanaa |2|37|
English: Says Kabeer, they realize the Name of the Lord. ||2||37||

[Ang 330 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਭੀ ਸੋਰਠਿ ਭੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree bhee soratth bhee |
English: Gauree And Also Sorat'h:

Gurbani: ਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਨਿਲਜ ਲਾਜ ਤੋੁਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: re jeea nilaj laaj tuohi naahee |
English: O shameless being, don't you feel ashamed?

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਤਜਿ ਕਤ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੇ ਜਾਂਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har taj kat kaahoo ke jaanhee |1| rahaau |
English: You have forsaken the Lord - now where will you go? Unto whom will you turn? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਊਚਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jaa ko tthaakur aoochaa hoee |
English: One whose Lord and Master is the highest and most exalted

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਪਰ ਘਰ ਜਾਤ ਨ ਸੋਹੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: so jan par ghar jaat na sohee |1|
English: - it is not proper for him to go to the house of another. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: so saahib rahiaa bharapoor |
English: That Lord and Master is pervading everywhere.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sadaa sang naahee har door |2|
English: The Lord is always with us; He is never far away. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਵਲਾ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਕੇ ॥
Transliteration: kavalaa charan saran hai jaa ke |
English: Even Maya takes to the Sanctuary of His Lotus Feet.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਘਰ ਤਾ ਕੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kahu jan kaa naahee ghar taa ke |3|
English: Tell me, what is there which is not in His home? ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕੋਊ ਕਹੈ ਜਾਸੁ ਕੀ ਬਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabh koaoo kahai jaas kee baataa |
English: Everyone speaks of Him; He is All-powerful.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥੁ ਨਿਜ ਪਤਿ ਹੈ ਦਾਤਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: so samrath nij pat hai daataa |4|
English: He is His Own Master; He is the Giver. ||4||

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਜਗ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: kahai kabeer pooran jag soee |
English: Says Kabeer, he alone is perfect in this world,

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੫॥੩੮॥
Transliteration: jaa ke hiradai avar na hoee |5|38|
English: in whose heart there is none other than the Lord. ||5||38||

[Ang 331 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਕਉਨੁ ਕੋ ਪੂਤੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਕੋ ਕਾ ਕੋ ॥
Transliteration: kaun ko poot pitaa ko kaa ko |
English: Whose son is he? Whose father is he?

Gurbani: ਕਉਨੁ ਮਰੈ ਕੋ ਦੇਇ ਸੰਤਾਪੋ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kaun marai ko dee santaapo |1|
English: Who dies? Who inflicts pain? ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਠਗ ਜਗ ਕਉ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har tthag jag kau tthgauree laaee |
English: The Lord is the thug, who has drugged and robbed the whole world.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਬਿਓਗ ਕੈਸੇ ਜੀਅਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har ke biog kaise jeeo meree maaee |1| rahaau |
English: I am separated from the Lord; how can I survive, O my mother? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਉਨ ਕੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਕਉਨ ਕੀ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kaun ko purakh kaun kee naaree |
English: Whose husband is he? Whose wife is she?

Gurbani: ਇਆ ਤਤ ਲੇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰ ਬਿਚਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: eaa tat lehu sareer bichaaree |2|
English: Contemplate this reality within your body. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਠਗ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: keh kabeer tthag siau man maaniaa |
English: Says Kabeer, my mind is pleased and satisfied with the thug.

Gurbani: ਗਈ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਠਗੁ ਪਹਿਚਾਨਿਆ ॥੩॥੩੯॥
Transliteration: gee tthgauree tthag pahichaaniaa |3|39|
English: The effects of the drug have vanished, since I recognized the thug. ||3||39||

[Ang 331 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਅਬ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਭਏ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ab mo kau bhe raajaa raam sahaaee |
English: Now, the Lord, my King, has become my help and support.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕਟਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: janam maran katt param gat paaee |1| rahaau |
English: I have cut away birth and death, and attained the supreme status. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਦੀਓ ਰਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: saadhoo sangat deeo ralaae |
English: He has united me with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਤੇ ਲੀਓ ਛਡਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: panch doot te leeo chhaddaae |
English: He has rescued me from the five demons.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਉ ਜਪੁ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: amrit naam jpau jap rasanaa |
English: I chant with my tongue and meditate on the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਮੋਲ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਨੋ ਅਪਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: amol daas kar leeno apanaa |1|
English: He has made me his own slave. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀਨੋ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: satigur keeno praupakaar |
English: The True Guru has blessed me with His generosity.

Gurbani: ਕਾਢਿ ਲੀਨ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: kaadt leen saagar sansaar |
English: He has lifted me up, out of the world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal siau laagee preet |
English: I have fallen in love with His Lotus Feet.

Gurbani: ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਬਸੈ ਨਿਤਾ ਨਿਤ ਚੀਤ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gobind basai nitaa nit cheet |2|
English: The Lord of the Universe dwells continually within my consciousness. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਤਪਤਿ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਅੰਗਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa tapat bujhiaa angiaar |
English: The burning fire of Maya has been extinguished.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: man santokh naam aadhaar |
English: My mind is contented with the Support of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: jal thal poor rahe prabh suaamee |
English: God, the Lord and Master, is totally permeating the water and the land.

Gurbani: ਜਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਤਤ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jat pekhau tat antarajaamee |3|
English: Wherever I look, there is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: apanee bhagat aap hee drirraaee |
English: He Himself has implanted His devotional worship within me.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਬ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: poorab likhat miliaa mere bhaaee |
English: By pre-ordained destiny, one meets Him, O my Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਾਜ ॥
Transliteration: jis kripaa kare tis pooran saaj |
English: When He grants His Grace, one is perfectly fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਕਬੀਰ ਕੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਗਰੀਬ ਨਿਵਾਜ ॥੪॥੪੦॥
Transliteration: kabeer ko suaamee gareeb nivaaj |4|40|
English: Kabeer's Lord and Master is the Cherisher of the poor. ||4||40||

[Ang 331 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਜਲਿ ਹੈ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਥਲਿ ਹੈ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਸੂਤਕ ਓਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jal hai sootak thal hai sootak sootak opat hoee |
English: There is pollution in the water, and pollution on the land; whatever is born is polluted.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮੇ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਮੂਏ ਫੁਨਿ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਸੂਤਕ ਪਰਜ ਬਿਗੋਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: janame sootak mooe fun sootak sootak paraj bigoee |1|
English: There is pollution in birth, and more pollution in death; all beings are ruined by pollution. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਰੇ ਪੰਡੀਆ ਕਉਨ ਪਵੀਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: kahu re panddeea kaun paveetaa |
English: Tell me, O Pandit, O religious scholar: who is clean and pure?

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa giaan japahu mere meetaa |1| rahaau |
English: Meditate on such spiritual wisdom, O my friend. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨੈਨਹੁ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਬੈਨਹੁ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਨੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: nainahu sootak bainahu sootak sootak sravanee hoee |
English: There is pollution in the eyes, and pollution in speech; there is pollution in the ears as well.

Gurbani: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਪਰੈ ਰਸੋਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aootthat baitthat sootak laagai sootak parai rasoee |2|
English: Standing up and sitting down, one is polluted; one's kitchen is polluted as well. ||2||

Gurbani: ਫਾਸਨ ਕੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਊ ਜਾਨੈ ਛੂਟਨ ਕੀ ਇਕੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: faasan kee bidh sabh koaoo jaanai chhoottan kee ik koee |
English: Everyone knows how to be caught, but hardly anyone knows how to escape.

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਿਚਾਰੈ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਤਿਨੈ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥੪੧॥
Transliteration: keh kabeer raam ridai bichaarai sootak tinai na hoee |3|41|
English: Says Kabeer, those who meditate on the Lord within their hearts, are not polluted. ||3||41||

[Ang 331 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree |
English: Gauree:

Gurbani: ਝਗਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਬੇਰਹੁ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: jhagaraa ek niberahu raam |
English: Resolve this one conflict for me, O Lord,

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਤੁਮ ਅਪਨੇ ਜਨ ਸੌ ਕਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jau tum apane jan sau kaam |1| rahaau |
English: if you require any work from Your humble servant. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਬਡਾ ਕਿ ਜਾ ਸਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: eihu man baddaa ki jaa sau man maaniaa |
English: Is this mind greater, or the One to whom the mind is attuned?

Gurbani: ਰਾਮੁ ਬਡਾ ਕੈ ਰਾਮਹਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: raam baddaa kai raameh jaaniaa |1|
English: Is the Lord greater, or one who knows the Lord? ||1||

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਡਾ ਕਿ ਜਾਸੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: brahamaa baddaa ki jaas upaaeaa |
English: Is Brahma greater, or the One who created Him?

Gurbani: ਬੇਦੁ ਬਡਾ ਕਿ ਜਹਾਂ ਤੇ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bed baddaa ki jahaan te aaeaa |2|
English: Are the Vedas greater, or the One from which they came? ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਹਉ ਭਇਆ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: keh kabeer hau bheaa udaas |
English: Says Kabeer, I have become depressed;

Gurbani: ਤੀਰਥੁ ਬਡਾ ਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ॥੩॥੪੨॥
Transliteration: teerath baddaa ki har kaa daas |3|42|
English: is the sacred shrine of pilgrimage greater, or the slave of the Lord? ||3||42||

[Ang 331 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਚੇਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: raag gaurree chetee |
English: Raag Gauree Chaytee:

Gurbani: ਦੇਖੌ ਭਾਈ ਗੵਾਨ ਕੀ ਆਈ ਆਂਧੀ ॥
Transliteration: dekhau bhaaee gayaan kee aaee aandhee |
English: Behold, O Siblings of Destiny, the storm of spiritual wisdom has come.

Gurbani: ਸਭੈ ਉਡਾਨੀ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੀ ਟਾਟੀ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਬਾਂਧੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sabhai uddaanee bhram kee ttaattee rahai na maaeaa baandhee |1| rahaau |
English: It has totally blown away the thatched huts of doubt, and torn apart the bonds of Maya. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦੁਚਿਤੇ ਕੀ ਦੁਇ ਥੂਨਿ ਗਿਰਾਨੀ ਮੋਹ ਬਲੇਡਾ ਟੂਟਾ ॥
Transliteration: duchite kee due thoon giraanee moh baleddaa ttoottaa |
English: The two pillars of double-mindedness have fallen, and the beams of emotional attachment have come crashing down.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸਨਾ ਛਾਨਿ ਪਰੀ ਧਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਾਂਡਾ ਫੂਟਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tisanaa chhaan paree dhar aoopar duramat bhaanddaa foottaa |1|
English: The thatched roof of greed has caved in, and the pitcher of evil-mindedness has been broken. ||1||

Gurbani: ਆਂਧੀ ਪਾਛੇ ਜੋ ਜਲੁ ਬਰਖੈ ਤਿਹਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਨੁ ਭੀਨਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: aandhee paachhe jo jal barakhai tihi teraa jan bheenaan |
English: Your servant is drenched with the rain that has fallen in this storm.

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਮਨਿ ਭਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ ਉਦੈ ਭਾਨੁ ਜਬ ਚੀਨਾ ॥੨॥੪੩॥
Transliteration: keh kabeer man bheaa pragaasaa udai bhaan jab cheenaa |2|43|
English: Says Kabeer, my mind became enlightened, when I saw the sun rise. ||2||43||

[Ang 332 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਚੇਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree chetee |
