English: Gauree Chaytee:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨਹਿ ਨ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: har jas suneh na har gun gaaveh |
English: They do not listen to the Lord's Praises, and they do not sing the Lord's Glories,

Gurbani: ਬਾਤਨ ਹੀ ਅਸਮਾਨੁ ਗਿਰਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: baatan hee asamaan giraaveh |1|
English: but they try to bring down the sky with their talk. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸੇ ਲੋਗਨ ਸਿਉ ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: aise logan siau kiaa kaheeai |
English: What can anyone say to such people?

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਏ ਭਗਤਿ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਜ ਤਿਨ ਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਡਰਾਨੇ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo prabh kee bhagat te baahaj tin te sadaa ddaraane raheeai |1| rahaau |
English: You should always be careful around those whom God has excluded from His devotional worship. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਨ ਦੇਹਿ ਚੁਰੂ ਭਰਿ ਪਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: aap na dehi churoo bhar paanee |
English: They do not offer even a handful of water,

Gurbani: ਤਿਹ ਨਿੰਦਹਿ ਜਿਹ ਗੰਗਾ ਆਨੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tih nindeh jih gangaa aanee |2|
English: while they slander the one who brought forth the Ganges. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬੈਠਤ ਉਠਤ ਕੁਟਿਲਤਾ ਚਾਲਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: baitthat utthat kuttilataa chaaleh |
English: Sitting down or standing up, their ways are crooked and evil.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਗਏ ਅਉਰਨ ਹੂ ਘਾਲਹਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aap ge aauran hoo ghaaleh |3|
English: They ruin themselves, and then they ruin others. ||3||

Gurbani: ਛਾਡਿ ਕੁਚਰਚਾ ਆਨ ਨ ਜਾਨਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: chhaadd kucharachaa aan na jaaneh |
English: They know nothing except evil talk.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਹੂ ਕੋ ਕਹਿਓ ਨ ਮਾਨਹਿ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: brahamaa hoo ko kahio na maaneh |4|
English: They would not even obey Brahma's orders. ||4||

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਗਏ ਅਉਰਨ ਹੂ ਖੋਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: aap ge aauran hoo khoveh |
English: They themselves are lost, and they mislead others as well.

Gurbani: ਆਗਿ ਲਗਾਇ ਮੰਦਰ ਮੈ ਸੋਵਹਿ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: aag lagaae mandar mai soveh |5|
English: They set their own temple on fire, and then they fall asleep within it. ||5||

Gurbani: ਅਵਰਨ ਹਸਤ ਆਪ ਹਹਿ ਕਾਂਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: avaran hasat aap heh kaane |
English: They laugh at others, while they themselves are one-eyed.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਦੇਖਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਲਜਾਨੇ ॥੬॥੧॥੪੪॥
Transliteration: tin kau dekh kabeer lajaane |6|1|44|
English: Seeing them, Kabeer is embarrassed. ||6||1||44||

[Ang 332 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ₁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: raag gaurree bairaagana₁ kabeer jee |
English: Raag Gauree Bairaagan, Kabeer Jee:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਤ ਪਿਤਰ ਨ ਮਾਨੈ ਕੋਊ ਮੂਏਂ ਸਿਰਾਧ ਕਰਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jeevat pitar na maanai koaoo mooen siraadh karaahee |
English: He does not honor his ancestors while they are alive, but he holds feasts in their honor after they have died.

Gurbani: ਪਿਤਰ ਭੀ ਬਪੁਰੇ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਕਊਆ ਕੂਕਰ ਖਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: pitar bhee bapure kahu kiau paaveh kaooaa kookar khaahee |1|
English: Tell me, how can his poor ancestors receive what the crows and the dogs have eaten up? ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਬਤਾਵਹੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: mo kau kusal bataavahu koee |
English: If only someone would tell me what real happiness is!

Gurbani: ਕੁਸਲੁ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਜਗੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਭੀ ਕੈਸੇ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kusal kusal karate jag binasai kusal bhee kaise hoee |1| rahaau |
English: Speaking of happiness and joy, the world is perishing. How can happiness be found? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਾਟੀ ਕੇ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਜੀਉ ਦੇਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: maattee ke kar devee devaa tis aagai jeeo dehee |
English: Making gods and goddesses out of clay, people sacrifice living beings to them.

Gurbani: ਐਸੇ ਪਿਤਰ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਆਪਨ ਕਹਿਆ ਨ ਲੇਹੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aise pitar tumaare kaheeeh aapan kahiaa na lehee |2|
English: Such are your dead ancestors, who cannot ask for what they want. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਰਜੀਉ ਕਾਟਹਿ ਨਿਰਜੀਉ ਪੂਜਹਿ ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲ ਕਉ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: sarajeeo kaatteh nirajeeo poojeh ant kaal kau bhaaree |
English: You murder living beings and worship lifeless things; at your very last moment, you shall suffer in terrible pain.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ਭੈ ਡੂਬੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: raam naam kee gat nahee jaanee bhai ddoobe sansaaree |3|
English: You do not know the value of the Lord's Name; you shall drown in the terrifying world-ocean. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵਾ ਪੂਜਹਿ ਡੋਲਹਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: devee devaa poojeh ddoleh paarabraham nahee jaanaa |
English: You worship gods and goddesses, but you do not know the Supreme Lord God.

Gurbani: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਅਕੁਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਚੇਤਿਆ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸਿਉ ਲਪਟਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੪੫॥
Transliteration: kehat kabeer akul nahee chetiaa bikhiaa siau lapattaanaa |4|1|45|
English: Says Kabeer, you have not remembered the Lord who has no ancestors; you are clinging to your corrupt ways. ||4||1||45||

[Ang 332 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree |
English: Gauree:

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰੈ ਮਰੈ ਫੁਨਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਐਸੇ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jeevat marai marai fun jeevai aise sun samaaeaa |
English: One who remains dead while yet alive, will live even after death; thus he merges into the Primal Void of the Absolute Lord.

Gurbani: ਅੰਜਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਭਵਜਲਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: anjan maeh niranjan raheeai bahurr na bhavajal paaeaa |1|
English: Remaining pure in the midst of impurity, he will never again fall into the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਐਸਾ ਖੀਰੁ ਬਿਲੋਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: mere raam aisaa kheer biloeeai |
English: O my Lord, this is the milk to be churned.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਓਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: guramat manooaa asathir raakhahu in bidh amrit peeoeeai |1| rahaau |
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, hold your mind steady and stable, and in this way, drink in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਾਣਿ ਬਜਰ ਕਲ ਛੇਦੀ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਆ ਪਦੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai baan bajar kal chhedee pragattiaa pad paragaasaa |
English: The Guru's arrow has pierced the hard core of this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, and the state of enlightenment has dawned.

Gurbani: ਸਕਤਿ ਅਧੇਰ ਜੇਵੜੀ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਚੂਕਾ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਿਵ ਘਰਿ ਬਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sakat adher jevarree bhram chookaa nihachal siv ghar baasaa |2|
English: In the darkness of Maya, I mistook the rope for the snake, but that is over, and now I dwell in the eternal home of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤਿਨਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਾਣੈ ਧਨਖੁ ਚਢਾਈਐ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: tin bin baanai dhanakh chadtaaeeai ihu jag bedhiaa bhaaee |
English: Maya has drawn her bow without an arrow, and has pierced this world, O Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਬੂਡੀ ਪਵਨੁ ਝੁਲਾਵੈ ਡੋਰਿ ਰਹੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: deh dis booddee pavan jhulaavai ddor rahee liv laaee |3|
English: The drowning person is blown around in the ten directions by the wind, but I hold tight to the string of the Lord's Love. ||3||

Gurbani: ਉਨਮਨਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: aunaman manooaa sun samaanaa dubidhaa duramat bhaagee |
English: The disturbed mind has been absorbed in the Lord; duality and evil-mindedness have run away.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਅਨਭਉ ਇਕੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੪॥੨॥੪੬॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer anbhau ik dekhiaa raam naam liv laagee |4|2|46|
English: Says Kabeer, I have seen the One Lord, the Fearless One; I am attuned to the Name of the Lord. ||4||2||46||

[Ang 333 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਤਿਪਦੇ₃ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree bairaagan tipade₃ |
English: Gauree Bairaagan, Thi-Padhay:

Gurbani: ਉਲਟਤ ਪਵਨ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਖਟੁ ਭੇਦੇ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁੰਨ ਅਨਰਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: aulattat pavan chakr khatt bhede surat sun anaraagee |
English: I turned my breath inwards, and pierced through the six chakras of the body, and my awareness was centered on the Primal Void of the Absolute Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜੀਵੈ ਤਾਸੁ ਖੋਜੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aavai na jaae marai na jeevai taas khoj bairaagee |1|
English: Search for the One who does not come or go, who does not die and is not born, O renunciate. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਉਲਟਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: mere man man hee ulatt samaanaa |
English: My mind has turned away from the world, and is absorbed in the Mind of God.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਅਕਲਿ ਭਈ ਅਵਰੈ ਨਾਤਰੁ ਥਾ ਬੇਗਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaad akal bhee avarai naatar thaa begaanaa |1| rahaau |
English: By Guru's Grace, my understanding has been changed; otherwise, I was totally ignorant. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਿਵਰੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਨਿਵਰੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਜੈਸਾ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: nivarai door door fun nivarai jin jaisaa kar maaniaa |
English: That which was near has become distant, and again, that which was distant is near, for those who realize the Lord as He is.

Gurbani: ਅਲਉਤੀ ਕਾ ਜੈਸੇ ਭਇਆ ਬਰੇਡਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੀਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: alautee kaa jaise bheaa bareddaa jin peea tin jaaniaa |2|
English: It is like the sugar water made from the candy; only one who drinks it knows its taste. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੀ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਕਥਾ ਕਾਇ ਸਿਉ ਕਹੀਐ ਐਸਾ ਕੋਇ ਬਿਬੇਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: teree niragun kathaa kaae siau kaheeai aisaa koe bibekee |
English: Unto whom should I speak Your speech, O Lord; it is beyond the three qualities. Is there anyone with such discerning wisdom?

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਪਲੀਤਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਤੈਸੀ ਝਲ ਦੇਖੀ ॥੩॥੩॥੪੭॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer jin deea paleetaa tin taisee jhal dekhee |3|3|47|
English: Says Kabeer, as is the fuse which you apply, so is the flash you will see. ||3||3||47||

[Ang 333 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree |
English: Gauree:

Gurbani: ਤਹ ਪਾਵਸ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਧੂਪ ਨਹੀ ਛਹੀਆ ਤਹ ਉਤਪਤਿ ਪਰਲਉ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: teh paavas sindh dhoop nahee chhaheea teh utapat parlau naahee |
English: There is no rainy season, ocean, sunshine or shade, no creation or destruction there.

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਨ ਮਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਦੋਊ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jeevan mirat na dukh sukh biaapai sun samaadh doaoo teh naahee |1|
English: No life or death, no pain or pleasure is felt there. There is only the Primal Trance of Samaadhi, and no duality. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਹਜ ਕੀ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj kee akath kathaa hai niraaree |
English: The description of the state of intuitive poise is indescribable and sublime.

Gurbani: ਤੁਲਿ ਨਹੀ ਚਢੈ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਮੁਕਾਤੀ ਹਲੁਕੀ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਭਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tul nahee chadtai jaae na mukaatee halukee lagai na bhaaree |1| rahaau |
English: It is not measured, and it is not exhausted. It is neither light nor heavy. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਰਧ ਉਰਧ ਦੋਊ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: aradh uradh doaoo teh naahee raat dinas teh naahee |
English: Neither lower nor upper worlds are there; neither day nor night are there.

Gurbani: ਜਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਵਨੁ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਫੁਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤਹਾ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jal nahee pavan paavak fun naahee satigur tahaa samaahee |2|
English: There is no water, wind or fire; there, the True Guru is contained. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਲਹੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: agam agochar rahai nirantar gur kirapaa te laheeai |
English: The Inaccessible and Unfathomable Lord dwells there within Himself; by Guru's Grace, He is found.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੩॥੪॥੪੮॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer bal jaau gur apune satasangat mil raheeai |3|4|48|
English: Says Kabeer, I am a sacrifice to my Guru; I remain in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||3||4||48||

[Ang 333 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ₂ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree₂ |
English: Gauree:

Gurbani: ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਦੁਇ ਬੈਲ ਬਿਸਾਹੇ ਪਵਨੁ ਪੂਜੀ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: paap pun due bail bisaahe pavan poojee paragaasio |
English: With both sin and virtue, the ox of the body is purchased; the air of the breath is the capital which has appeared.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਗੂਣਿ ਭਰੀ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਟਾਂਡ ਬਿਸਾਹਿਓ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: trisanaa goon bharee ghatt bheetar in bidh ttaandd bisaahio |1|
English: The bag on its back is filled with desire; this is how we purchase the herd. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਨਾਇਕੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa naaeik raam hamaaraa |
English: My Lord is such a wealthy merchant!

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਕੀਓ ਬਨਜਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sagal sansaar keeo banajaaraa |1| rahaau |
English: He has made the whole world his peddler. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਦੁਇ ਭਏ ਜਗਾਤੀ ਮਨ ਤਰੰਗ ਬਟਵਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh due bhe jagaatee man tarang battavaaraa |
English: Sexual desire and anger are the tax-collectors, and the waves of the mind are the highway robbers.

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਨਿਬੇਰਹਿ ਟਾਂਡਾ ਉਤਰਿਓ ਪਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: panch tat mil daan nibereh ttaanddaa utario paaraa |2|
English: The five elements join together and divide up their loot. This is how our herd is disposed of! ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਅਬ ਐਸੀ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: kehat kabeer sunahu re santahu ab aisee ban aaee |
English: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints: This is the state of affairs now!

Gurbani: ਘਾਟੀ ਚਢਤ ਬੈਲੁ ਇਕੁ ਥਾਕਾ ਚਲੋ ਗੋਨਿ ਛਿਟਕਾਈ ॥੩॥੫॥੪੯॥
Transliteration: ghaattee chadtat bail ik thaakaa chalo gon chhittakaaee |3|5|49|
English: Going uphill, the ox has grown weary; throwing off his load, he continues on his journey. ||3||5||49||

[Ang 333 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੰਚਪਦਾ₃ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree panchapadaa₃ |
English: Gauree, Panch-Padhay:

Gurbani: ਪੇਵਕੜੈ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ਹੈ ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: pevakarrai din chaar hai saahurarrai jaanaa |
English: For a few short days, the soul-bride stays in her parent's house; then, she must go to her in-laws.

Gurbani: ਅੰਧਾ ਲੋਕੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਏਆਣਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: andhaa lok na jaanee moorakh eaanaa |1|
English: The blind, foolish and ignorant people do not know this. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਡਡੀਆ ਬਾਧੈ ਧਨ ਖੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: kahu ddaddeea baadhai dhan kharree |
English: Tell me, why is the bride wearing her ordinary clothes?

Gurbani: ਪਾਹੂ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ਮੁਕਲਾਊ ਆਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: paahoo ghar aae mukalaaoo aae |1| rahaau |
English: The guests have arrived at her home, and her Husband has come to take her away. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਓਹ ਜਿ ਦਿਸੈ ਖੂਹੜੀ ਕਉਨ ਲਾਜੁ ਵਹਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: oeh ji disai khooharree kaun laaj vahaaree |
English: Who has lowered the rope of the breath down, into the well of the world which we see?

Gurbani: ਲਾਜੁ ਘੜੀ ਸਿਉ ਤੂਟਿ ਪੜੀ ਉਠਿ ਚਲੀ ਪਨਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: laaj gharree siau toott parree utth chalee panihaaree |2|
English: The rope of the breath breaks away from the pitcher of the body, and the water-carrier gets up and departs. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: saahib hoe deaal kripaa kare apunaa kaaraj savaare |
English: When the Lord and Master is kind and grants His Grace, then her affairs are all resolved.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: taa sohaagan jaaneeai gurasabad beechaare |3|
English: Then she is known as the happy soul-bride, if she contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਤ ਕੀ ਬਾਂਧੀ ਸਭ ਫਿਰੈ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kirat kee baandhee sabh firai dekhahu beechaaree |
English: Bound by the actions she has committed, she wanders around - see this and understand.

Gurbani: ਏਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਆ ਆਖੀਐ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਵਿਚਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: es no kiaa aakheeai kiaa kare vichaaree |4|
English: What can we say to her? What can the poor soul-bride do? ||4||

Gurbani: ਭਈ ਨਿਰਾਸੀ ਉਠਿ ਚਲੀ ਚਿਤ ਬੰਧਿ ਨ ਧੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: bhee niraasee utth chalee chit bandh na dheeraa |
English: Disappointed and hopeless, she gets up and departs. There is no support or encouragement in her consciousness.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੁ ਭਜੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਕਬੀਰਾ ॥੫॥੬॥੫੦॥
Transliteration: har kee charanee laag rahu bhaj saran kabeeraa |5|6|50|
English: So remain attached to the Lord's Lotus Feet, and hurry to His Sanctuary, Kabeer! ||5||6||50||

[Ang 334 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ₂ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree₂ |
English: Gauree :

Gurbani: ਜੋਗੀ ਕਹਹਿ ਜੋਗੁ ਭਲ ਮੀਠਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jogee kaheh jog bhal meetthaa avar na doojaa bhaaee |
English: The Yogi says that Yoga is good and sweet, and nothing else is, O Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਰੁੰਡਿਤ ਮੁੰਡਿਤ ਏਕੈ ਸਬਦੀ ਏਇ ਕਹਹਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: runddit munddit ekai sabadee ee kaheh sidh paaee |1|
English: Those who shave their heads, and those who amputate their limbs, and those who utter only a single word, all say that they have attained the spiritual perfection of the Siddhas. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਨੇ ਅੰਧਾ ॥
Transliteration: har bin bharam bhulaane andhaa |
English: Without the Lord, the blind ones are deluded by doubt.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਉ ਆਪੁ ਛੁਟਕਾਵਨਿ ਤੇ ਬਾਧੇ ਬਹੁ ਫੰਧਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaa peh jaau aap chhuttakaavan te baadhe bahu fandhaa |1| rahaau |
English: And those, to whom I go to find release - they themselves are bound by all sorts of chains. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੀ ਤਹੀ ਸਮਾਨੀ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਸਰੀ ਤਬ ਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jeh te upajee tahee samaanee ih bidh bisaree tab hee |
English: The soul is re-absorbed into that from which it originated, when one leaves this path of errors.

Gurbani: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਗੁਣੀ ਸੂਰ ਹਮ ਦਾਤੇ ਏਹਿ ਕਹਹਿ ਬਡ ਹਮ ਹੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: panddit gunee soor ham daate ehi kaheh badd ham hee |2|
English: The scholarly Pandits, the virtuous, the brave and the generous, all assert that they alone are great. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਕਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: jiseh bujhaae soee boojhai bin boojhe kiau raheeai |
English: He alone understands, whom the Lord inspires to understand. Without understanding, what can anyone do?

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਚੂਕੈ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: satigur milai andheraa chookai in bidh maanak laheeai |3|
English: Meeting the True Guru, the darkness is dispelled, and in this way, the jewel is obtained. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤਜਿ ਬਾਵੇ ਦਾਹਨੇ ਬਿਕਾਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਦੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: taj baave daahane bikaaraa har pad drirr kar raheeai |
English: Give up the evil actions of your left and right hands, and grasp hold of the Feet of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਗੂੰਗੈ ਗੁੜੁ ਖਾਇਆ ਪੂਛੇ ਤੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ॥੪॥੭॥੫੧॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer goongai gurr khaaeaa poochhe te kiaa kaheeai |4|7|51|
English: Says Kabeer, the mute has tasted the molasses, but what can he say about it if he is asked? ||4||7||51||

[Ang 334 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ₁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: raag gaurree poorabee₁ kabeer jee |
English: Raag Gauree Poorbee, Kabeer Jee:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਕਛੁ ਅਹਾ ਤਹਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jeh kachh ahaa tahaa kichh naahee panch tat teh naahee |
English: Where something existed, now there is nothing. The five elements are no longer there.

Gurbani: ਇੜਾ ਪਿੰਗੁਲਾ ਸੁਖਮਨ ਬੰਦੇ ਏ ਅਵਗਨ ਕਤ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: eirraa pingulaa sukhaman bande e avagan kat jaahee |1|
English: The Ida, the Pingala and the Sushmanaa - O human being, how can the breaths through these be counted now? ||1||

Gurbani: ਤਾਗਾ ਤੂਟਾ ਗਗਨੁ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਗਇਆ ਤੇਰਾ ਬੋਲਤੁ ਕਹਾ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: taagaa toottaa gagan binas geaa teraa bolat kahaa samaaee |
English: The string has been broken, and the Sky of the Tenth Gate has been destroyed. Where has your speech gone?

Gurbani: ਏਹ ਸੰਸਾ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕੋ ਨ ਕਹੈ ਸਮਝਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: eeh sansaa mo kau anadin biaapai mo kau ko na kahai samajhaaee |1| rahaau |
English: This cynicism afflicts me, night and day; who can explain this to me and help me understand? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਬਰਭੰਡੁ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ ਰਚਨਹਾਰੁ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jeh barabhandd pindd teh naahee rachanahaar teh naahee |
English: Where the world is - the body is not there; the mind is not there either.

Gurbani: ਜੋੜਨਹਾਰੋ ਸਦਾ ਅਤੀਤਾ ਇਹ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਸੁ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jorranahaaro sadaa ateetaa ih kaheeai kis maahee |2|
English: The Joiner is forever unattached; now, within whom is the soul said to be contained? ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੋੜੀ ਜੁੜੈ ਨ ਤੋੜੀ ਤੂਟੈ ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: jorree jurrai na torree toottai jab lag hoe binaasee |
English: By joining the elements, people cannot join them, and by breaking, they cannot be broken, until the body perishes.

Gurbani: ਕਾ ਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕਾ ਕੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਕੋ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੈ ਜਾਸੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kaa ko tthaakur kaa ko sevak ko kaahoo kai jaasee |3|
English: Of whom is the soul the master, and of whom is it the servant? Where, and to whom does it go? ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੀ ਹੈ ਜਹਾ ਬਸੇ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer liv laag rahee hai jahaa base din raatee |
English: Says Kabeer, I have lovingly focused my attention on that place where the Lord dwells, day and night.

Gurbani: ਉਆ ਕਾ ਮਰਮੁ ਓਹੀ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਓਹੁ ਤਉ ਸਦਾ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੫੨॥
Transliteration: auaa kaa maram ohee par jaanai ohu tau sadaa abinaasee |4|1|52|
English: Only He Himself truly knows the secrets of His mystery; He is eternal and indestructible. ||4||1||52||

[Ang 334 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree |
English: Gauree:

Gurbani: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਦੁਇ ਕੰਨੀ ਮੁੰਦਾ ਪਰਮਿਤਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਖਿੰਥਾ ॥
Transliteration: surat simrit due kanee mundaa paramit baahar khinthaa |
English: Let contemplation and intuitive meditation be your two ear-rings, and true wisdom your patched overcoat.

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਨ ਗੁਫਾ ਮਹਿ ਆਸਣੁ ਬੈਸਣੁ ਕਲਪ ਬਿਬਰਜਿਤ ਪੰਥਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sun gufaa meh aasan baisan kalap bibarajit panthaa |1|
English: In the cave of silence, dwell in your Yogic posture; let the subjugation of desire be your spiritual path. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਜਨ ਮੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਜੋਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: mere raajan mai bairaagee jogee |
English: O my King, I am a Yogi, a hermit, a renunciate.

Gurbani: ਮਰਤ ਨ ਸੋਗ ਬਿਓਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: marat na sog biogee |1| rahaau |
English: I do not die or suffer pain or separation. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਮਹਿ ਸਿੰਙੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਬਟੂਆ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਭਸਮਾਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: khandd brahamandd meh singee meraa battooaa sabh jag bhasamaadhaaree |
English: The solar systems and galaxies are my horn; the whole world is the bag to carry my ashes.

Gurbani: ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਗੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਲੁ ਪਲਟੀਐ ਛੂਟੈ ਹੋਇ ਪਸਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: taarree laagee tripal palatteeai chhoottai hoe pasaaree |2|
English: Eliminating the three qualities and finding release from this world is my deep meditation. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਪਵਨੁ ਦੁਇ ਤੂੰਬਾ ਕਰੀ ਹੈ ਜੁਗ ਜੁਗ ਸਾਰਦ ਸਾਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: man pavan due toonbaa karee hai jug jug saarad saajee |
English: My mind and breath are the two gourds of my fiddle, and the Lord of all the ages is its frame.

Gurbani: ਥਿਰੁ ਭਈ ਤੰਤੀ ਤੂਟਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਨਹਦ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਬਾਜੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: thir bhee tantee toottas naahee anahad kinguree baajee |3|
English: The string has become steady, and it does not break; this guitar vibrates with the unstruck melody. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੁਨਿ ਮਨ ਮਗਨ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਡੋਲ ਨ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: sun man magan bhe hai poore maaeaa ddol na laagee |
English: Hearing it, the mind is enraptured and becomes perfect; it does not waver, and it is not affected by Maya.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਪੁਨਰਪਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਖੇਲਿ ਗਇਓ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥੪॥੨॥੫੩॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer taa kau punarap janam nahee khel geo bairaagee |4|2|53|
English: Says Kabeer, the bairaagee, the renunciate, who has played such a game, is not reincarnated again into the world of form and substance. ||4||2||53||

[Ang 335 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree |
English: Gauree:

Gurbani: ਗਜ ਨਵ ਗਜ ਦਸ ਗਜ ਇਕੀਸ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਏਕ ਤਨਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: gaj nav gaj das gaj ikees pureea ek tanaaee |
English: Nine yards, ten yards, and twenty-one yards - weave these into the full piece of cloth;

Gurbani: ਸਾਠ ਸੂਤ ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਬਹਤਰਿ ਪਾਟੁ ਲਗੋ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saatth soot nav khandd bahatar paatt lago adhikaaee |1|
English: take the sixty threads and add nine joints to the seventy-two on the loom. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗਈ ਬੁਨਾਵਨ ਮਾਹੋ ॥
Transliteration: gee bunaavan maaho |
English: Life weaves itself into its patterns.

Gurbani: ਘਰ ਛੋਡਿਐ ਜਾਇ ਜੁਲਾਹੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ghar chhoddiai jaae julaaho |1| rahaau |
English: Leaving her home, the soul goes to the world of the weaver. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗਜੀ ਨ ਮਿਨੀਐ ਤੋਲਿ ਨ ਤੁਲੀਐ ਪਾਚਨੁ ਸੇਰ ਅਢਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: gajee na mineeai tol na tuleeai paachan ser adtaaee |
English: This cloth cannot be measured in yards or weighed with weights; its food is two and a half measures.

Gurbani: ਜੌ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਚਨੁ ਬੇਗਿ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਝਗਰੁ ਕਰੈ ਘਰਹਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jau kar paachan beg na paavai jhagar karai gharahaaee |2|
English: If it does not obtain food right away, it quarrels with the master of the house. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦਿਨ ਕੀ ਬੈਠ ਖਸਮ ਕੀ ਬਰਕਸ ਇਹ ਬੇਲਾ ਕਤ ਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: din kee baitth khasam kee barakas ih belaa kat aaee |
English: How many days will you sit here, in opposition to your Lord and Master? When will this opportunity come again?

Gurbani: ਛੂਟੇ ਕੂੰਡੇ ਭੀਗੈ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਚਲਿਓ ਜੁਲਾਹੋ ਰੀਸਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: chhootte koondde bheegai pureea chalio julaaho reesaaee |3|
English: Leaving his pots and pans, and the bobbins wet with his tears, the weaver soul departs in jealous anger. ||3||

Gurbani: ਛੋਛੀ ਨਲੀ ਤੰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਨਤਰ ਰਹੀ ਉਰਝਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: chhochhee nalee tant nahee nikasai natar rahee urajhaaee |
English: The wind-pipe is empty now; the thread of the breath does not come out any longer. The thread is tangled; it has run out.

Gurbani: ਛੋਡਿ ਪਸਾਰੁ ਈਹਾ ਰਹੁ ਬਪੁਰੀ ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਸਮਝਾਈ ॥੪॥੩॥੫੪॥
Transliteration: chhodd pasaar eehaa rahu bapuree kahu kabeer samajhaaee |4|3|54|
English: So renounce the world of form and substance while you remain here, O poor soul; says Kabeer: you must understand this! ||4||3||54||

[Ang 335 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree |
English: Gauree:

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਜੋਤਿ ਏਕਾ ਮਿਲੀ ਕਿੰਬਾ ਹੋਇ ਮਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: ek jot ekaa milee kinbaa hoe mahoe |
English: When one light merges into another, what becomes of it then?

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਫੂਟਿ ਮਰੈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jit ghatt naam na aoopajai foott marai jan soe |1|
English: That person, within whose heart the Lord's Name does not well up - may that person burst and die! ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਾਵਲ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਰਾਮਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: saaval sundar raameea |
English: O my dark and beautiful Lord,

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਤੋਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: meraa man laagaa tohi |1| rahaau |
English: my mind is attached to You. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਿ ਏਹੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਕਿ ਭੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: saadh milai sidh paaeeai ki ehu jog ki bhog |
English: Meeting with the Holy, the perfection of the Siddhas is obtained. What good is Yoga or indulgence in pleasures?

Gurbani: ਦੁਹੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: duhu mil kaaraj aoopajai raam naam sanjog |2|
English: When the two meet together, the business is conducted, and the link with the Lord's Name is established. ||2||

Gurbani: ਲੋਗੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਇਹੁ ਗੀਤੁ ਹੈ ਇਹੁ ਤਉ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: log jaanai ihu geet hai ihu tau braham beechaar |
English: People believe that this is just a song, but it is a meditation on God.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਕਾਸੀ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਾਨਸ ਮਰਤੀ ਬਾਰ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jiau kaasee upades hoe maanas maratee baar |3|
English: It is like the instructions given to the dying man at Benares. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਸੁਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: koee gaavai ko sunai har naamaa chit laae |
English: Whoever sings or listens to the Lord's Name with conscious awareness

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੰਸਾ ਨਹੀ ਅੰਤਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੪॥੫੫॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer sansaa nahee ant param gat paae |4|1|4|55|
English: - says Kabeer, without a doubt, in the end, he obtains the highest status. ||4||1||4||55||

[Ang 335 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree |
English: Gauree:

Gurbani: ਜੇਤੇ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਤ ਤੇ ਡੂਬੇ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਤਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jete jatan karat te ddoobe bhav saagar nahee taario re |
English: Those who try to do things by their own efforts are drowned in the terrifying world-ocean; they cannot cross over.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਕਰਤੇ ਬਹੁ ਸੰਜਮ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਮਨੁ ਜਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: karam dharam karate bahu sanjam ahanbudh man jaario re |1|
English: Those who practice religious rituals and strict self-discipline - their egotistical pride shall consume their minds. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਾਸ ਗ੍ਰਾਸ ਕੋ ਦਾਤੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: saas graas ko daato tthaakur so kiau manahu bisaario re |
English: Your Lord and Master has given you the breath of life and food to sustain you; Oh, why have you forgotten Him?

Gurbani: ਹੀਰਾ ਲਾਲੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਹੈ ਕਉਡੀ ਬਦਲੈ ਹਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: heeraa laal amol janam hai kauddee badalai haario re |1| rahaau |
English: Human birth is a priceless jewel, which has been squandered in exchange for a worthless shell. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾ ਭੂਖ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: trisanaa trikhaa bhookh bhram laagee hiradai naeh beechaario re |
English: The thirst of desire and the hunger of doubt afflict you; you do not contemplate the Lord in your heart.

Gurbani: ਉਨਮਤ ਮਾਨ ਹਿਰਿਓ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aunamat maan hirio man maahee gur kaa sabad na dhaario re |2|
English: Intoxicated with pride, you cheat yourself; you have not enshrined the Word of the Guru's Shabad within your mind. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੁਆਦ ਲੁਭਤ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਰਸ ਪ੍ਰੇਰਿਓ ਮਦ ਰਸ ਲੈਤ ਬਿਕਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: suaad lubhat indree ras prerio mad ras lait bikaario re |
English: Those who are deluded by sensual pleasures, who are tempted by sexual delights and enjoy wine are corrupt.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮ ਭਾਗ ਸੰਤਨ ਸੰਗਾਨੇ ਕਾਸਟ ਲੋਹ ਉਧਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: karam bhaag santan sangaane kaasatt loh udhaario re |3|
English: But those who, through destiny and good karma, join the Society of the Saints, float over the ocean, like iron attached to wood. ||3||

Gurbani: ਧਾਵਤ ਜੋਨਿ ਜਨਮ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਅਬ ਦੁਖ ਕਰਿ ਹਮ ਹਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: dhaavat jon janam bhram thaake ab dukh kar ham haario re |
English: I have wandered in doubt and confusion, through birth and reincarnation; now, I am so tired. I am suffering in pain and wasting away.

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਤ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥੫॥੫੬॥
Transliteration: keh kabeer gur milat mahaa ras prem bhagat nisataario re |4|1|5|56|
English: Says Kabeer, meeting with the Guru, I have obtained supreme joy; my love and devotion have saved me. ||4||1||5||56||

[Ang 335 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree |
English: Gauree:

Gurbani: ਕਾਲਬੂਤ ਕੀ ਹਸਤਨੀ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ਚਲਤੁ ਰਚਿਓ ਜਗਦੀਸ ॥
Transliteration: kaalaboot kee hasatanee man bauraa re chalat rachio jagadees |
English: Like the straw figure of a female elephant, fashioned to trap the bull elephant, O crazy mind, the Lord of the Universe has staged the drama of this world.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮ ਸੁਆਇ ਗਜ ਬਸਿ ਪਰੇ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ਅੰਕਸੁ ਸਹਿਓ ਸੀਸ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kaam suaae gaj bas pare man bauraa re ankas sahio sees |1|
English: Attracted by the lure of sexual desire, the elephant is captured, O crazy mind, and now the halter is placed around its neck. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਿਖੈ ਬਾਚੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਚੁ ਸਮਝੁ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: bikhai baach har raach samajh man bauraa re |
English: So escape from corruption and immerse yourself in the Lord; take this advice, O crazy mind.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਭੈ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੇ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ਗਹਿਓ ਨ ਰਾਮ ਜਹਾਜੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: nirabhai hoe na har bhaje man bauraa re gahio na raam jahaaj |1| rahaau |
English: You have not meditated fearlessly on the Lord, O crazy mind; you have not embarked upon the Lord's Boat. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਰਕਟ ਮੁਸਟੀ ਅਨਾਜ ਕੀ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ਲੀਨੀ ਹਾਥੁ ਪਸਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: marakatt musattee anaaj kee man bauraa re leenee haath pasaar |
English: The monkey stretches out its hand, O crazy mind, and takes a handful of corn;

Gurbani: ਛੂਟਨ ਕੋ ਸਹਸਾ ਪਰਿਆ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ਨਾਚਿਓ ਘਰ ਘਰ ਬਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: chhoottan ko sahasaa pariaa man bauraa re naachio ghar ghar baar |2|
English: now unable to escape, O crazy mind, it is made to dance door to door. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਨਲਨੀ ਸੂਅਟਾ ਗਹਿਓ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ਮਾਯਾ ਇਹੁ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jiau nalanee sooattaa gahio man bauraa re maayaa ihu biauhaar |
English: Like the parrot caught in the trap, O crazy mind, you trapped by the affairs of Maya.

Gurbani: ਜੈਸਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਕਾ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ਤਿਉ ਪਸਰਿਓ ਪਾਸਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jaisaa rang kasunbh kaa man bauraa re tiau pasario paasaar |3|
English: Like the weak dye of the safflower, O crazy mind, so is the expanse of this world of form and substance. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਵਨ ਕਉ ਤੀਰਥ ਘਨੇ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ਪੂਜਨ ਕਉ ਬਹੁ ਦੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: naavan kau teerath ghane man bauraa re poojan kau bahu dev |
English: There are so many holy shrines in which to bathe, O crazy mind, and so many gods to worship.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਛੂਟਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ਛੂਟਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੪॥੧॥੬॥੫੭॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer chhoottan nahee man bauraa re chhoottan har kee sev |4|1|6|57|
English: Says Kabeer, you shall not be saved like this, O crazy mind; only by serving the Lord will you find release. ||4||1||6||57||

[Ang 336 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree |
English: Gauree:

Gurbani: ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਦਹੈ ਪਵਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਗਨੈ ਤਸਕਰੁ ਨੇਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: agan na dahai pavan nahee maganai tasakar ner na aavai |
English: Fire does not burn it, and the wind does not blow it away; thieves cannot get near it.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਚਉਨੀ ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਕਤ ਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: raam naam dhan kar sanchaunee so dhan kat hee na jaavai |1|
English: Accumulate the wealth of the Lord's Name; that wealth does not go anywhere. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਮਰਾ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਧਉ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਧਰਣੀਧਰੁ ਇਹੈ ਸਾਰ ਧਨੁ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: hamaraa dhan maadhau gobind dharaneedhar ihai saar dhan kaheeai |
English: My wealth is God, the Lord of Wealth, the Lord of the Universe, the Support of the earth: this is called the most excellent wealth.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਰਾਜਿ ਨ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo sukh prabh gobind kee sevaa so sukh raaj na laheeai |1| rahaau |
English: The peace which is obtained by serving God, the Lord of the Universe - that peace cannot be found in kingdoms or power. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਧਨ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਸਿਵ ਸਨਕਾਦਿਕ ਖੋਜਤ ਭਏ ਉਦਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: eis dhan kaaran siv sanakaadik khojat bhe udaasee |
English: Shiva and Sanak, in their search for this wealth, became Udaasees, and renounced the world.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਮੁਕੰਦੁ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਨਾਰਾਇਨੁ ਪਰੈ ਨ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: man mukand jihabaa naaraaein parai na jam kee faasee |2|
English: One whose mind is filled with the Lord of liberation, and whose tongue chants the Name of the Lord, shall not be caught by the noose of Death. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਿਜ ਧਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਤਾਸੁ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: nij dhan giaan bhagat gur deenee taas sumat man laagaa |
English: My own wealth is the spiritual wisdom and devotion given by the Guru; my mind is held steady in perfect neutral balance.

Gurbani: ਜਲਤ ਅੰਭ ਥੰਭਿ ਮਨੁ ਧਾਵਤ ਭਰਮ ਬੰਧਨ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jalat anbh thanbh man dhaavat bharam bandhan bhau bhaagaa |3|
English: It is like water for the burning soul, like an anchoring support for the wandering mind; the bondage of doubt and fear is dispelled. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਮਦਨ ਕੇ ਮਾਤੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦੇਖੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kahai kabeer madan ke maate hiradai dekh beechaaree |
English: Says Kabeer: O you who are intoxicated with sexual desire, reflect upon this in your heart, and see.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਘਰਿ ਲਾਖ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਸ੍ਵ ਹਸਤੀ ਹਮ ਘਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੭॥੫੮॥
Transliteration: tum ghar laakh kott asv hasatee ham ghar ek muraaree |4|1|7|58|
English: Within your home there are hundreds of thousands, millions of horses and elephants; but within my home is the One Lord. ||4||1||7||58||

[Ang 336 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree |
English: Gauree:

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਕਪਿ ਕੇ ਕਰ ਮੁਸਟਿ ਚਨਨ ਕੀ ਲੁਬਧਿ ਨ ਤਿਆਗੁ ਦਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: jiau kap ke kar musatt chanan kee lubadh na tiaag deo |
English: Like the monkey with a handful of grain, who will not let go because of greed

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਰਮ ਕੀਏ ਲਾਲਚ ਸਿਉ ਤੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਗਰਹਿ ਪਰਿਓ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jo jo karam kee laalach siau te fir gareh pario |1|
English: - just so, all the deeds committed in greed ultimately become a noose around one's neck. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਿਰਥੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat bin birathe janam geo |
English: Without devotional worship, human life passes away in vain.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਸਚੁ ਰਹਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasangat bhagavaan bhajan bin kahee na sach rahio |1| rahaau |
English: Without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, without vibrating and meditating on the Lord God, one does not abide in Truth. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਕੁਸਮ ਪਰਫੁਲਿਤ ਕਿਨਹਿ ਨ ਘ੍ਰਾਉ ਲਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: jiau udiaan kusam parafulit kineh na ghraau leo |
English: Like the flower which blossoms in the wilderness with no one to enjoy its fragrance,

Gurbani: ਤੈਸੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਅਨੇਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਕਾਲ ਹਇਓ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: taise bhramat anek jon meh fir fir kaal heo |2|
English: so do people wander in reincarnation; over and over again, they are destroyed by Death. ||2||

Gurbani: ਇਆ ਧਨ ਜੋਬਨ ਅਰੁ ਸੁਤ ਦਾਰਾ ਪੇਖਨ ਕਉ ਜੁ ਦਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: eaa dhan joban ar sut daaraa pekhan kau ju deo |
English: This wealth, youth, children and spouse which the Lord has given you - this is all just a passing show.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਅਟਕਿ ਜੋ ਉਰਝੇ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਰਿ ਲਇਓ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tin hee maeh attak jo urajhe indree prer leo |3|
English: Those who are caught and entangled in these are carried away by sensual desire. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅਉਧ ਅਨਲ ਤਨੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੋ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸ ਠਾਟੁ ਠਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: aaudh anal tan tin ko mandar chahu dis tthaatt ttheo |
English: Age is the fire, and the body is the house of straw; on all four sides, this play is being played out.

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰ ਤਰਨ ਕਉ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਓਟ ਲਇਓ ॥੪॥੧॥੮॥੫੯॥
Transliteration: keh kabeer bhai saagar taran kau mai satigur ott leo |4|1|8|59|
English: Says Kabeer, to cross over the terriffying world-ocean, I have taken to the Shelter of the True Guru. ||4||1||8||59||

[Ang 336 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ₈ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree₈ |
English: Gauree:

Gurbani: ਪਾਨੀ ਮੈਲਾ ਮਾਟੀ ਗੋਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: paanee mailaa maattee goree |
English: The water of the sperm is cloudy, and the egg of the ovary is crimson.

Gurbani: ਇਸ ਮਾਟੀ ਕੀ ਪੁਤਰੀ ਜੋਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: eis maattee kee putaree joree |1|
English: From this clay, the puppet is fashioned. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਆਹਿ ਨ ਮੋਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: mai naahee kachh aaeh na moraa |
English: I am nothing, and nothing is mine.

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਰਸੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਤੋਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tan dhan sabh ras gobind toraa |1| rahaau |
English: This body, wealth, and all delicacies are Yours, O Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਇਸ ਮਾਟੀ ਮਹਿ ਪਵਨੁ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: eis maattee meh pavan samaaeaa |
English: Into this clay, the breath is infused.

Gurbani: ਝੂਠਾ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਜੋਰਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jhootthaa parapanch jor chalaaeaa |2|
English: By Your Power, You have set this false contrivance in motion. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਿਨਹੂ ਲਾਖ ਪਾਂਚ ਕੀ ਜੋਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kinahoo laakh paanch kee joree |
English: Some collect hundreds of thousands of dollars,

Gurbani: ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਬਾਰ ਗਗਰੀਆ ਫੋਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ant kee baar gagareea foree |3|
English: but in the end, the pitcher of the body bursts. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਇਕ ਨੀਵ ਉਸਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: keh kabeer ik neev usaaree |
English: Says Kabeer, that single foundation which you have laid

Gurbani: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੯॥੬੦॥
Transliteration: khin meh binas jaae ahankaaree |4|1|9|60|
English: will be destroyed in an instant - you are so egotistical. ||4||1||9||60||

[Ang 337 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree |
English: Gauree:

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਜਪਉ ਜੀਅ ਐਸੇ ਐਸੇ ॥
Transliteration: raam jpau jeea aise aise |
English: Just as Dhroo and Prahlaad meditated on the Lord,

Gurbani: ਧ੍ਰੂ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦ ਜਪਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਜੈਸੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dhraoo prahilaad japio har jaise |1|
English: So should you meditate on the Lord, O my soul. ||1||

Gurbani: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਭਰੋਸੇ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: deen deaal bharose tere |
English: O Lord, Merciful to the meek, I have placed my faith in You;

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ਚੜਾਇਆ ਬੇੜੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sabh paravaar charraaeaa berre |1| rahaau |
English: along with all my family, I have come aboard Your boat. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jaa tis bhaavai taa hukam manaavai |
English: When it is pleasing to Him, then He inspires us to obey the Hukam of His Command.

Gurbani: ਇਸ ਬੇੜੇ ਕਉ ਪਾਰਿ ਲਘਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: eis berre kau paar laghaavai |2|
English: He causes this boat to cross over. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਐਸੀ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaad aisee budh samaanee |
English: By Guru's Grace, such understanding is infused into me;

Gurbani: ਚੂਕਿ ਗਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਨ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: chook gee fir aavan jaanee |3|
English: my comings and goings in reincarnation have ended. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਭਜੁ ਸਾਰਿਗਪਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer bhaj saarigapaanee |
English: Says Kabeer, meditate, vibrate upon the Lord, the Sustainer of the earth.

Gurbani: ਉਰਵਾਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਸਭ ਏਕੋ ਦਾਨੀ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੦॥੬੧॥
Transliteration: auravaar paar sabh eko daanee |4|2|10|61|
English: In this world, in the world beyond and everywhere, He alone is the Giver. ||4||2||10||61||

[Ang 337 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree 9 |
English: Gauree 9:

Gurbani: ਜੋਨਿ ਛਾਡਿ ਜਉ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: jon chhaadd jau jag meh aaeo |
English: He leaves the womb, and comes into the world;

Gurbani: ਲਾਗਤ ਪਵਨ ਖਸਮੁ ਬਿਸਰਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: laagat pavan khasam bisaraaeo |1|
English: as soon as the air touches him, he forgets his Lord and Master. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੀਅਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨਾ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jeearaa har ke gunaa gaau |1| rahaau |
English: O my soul, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਉਰਧ ਤਪੁ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: garabh jon meh uradh tap karataa |
English: You were upside-down, living in the womb; you generated the intense meditative heat of 'tapas'.

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਜਠਰ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਤਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tau jatthar agan meh rahataa |2|
English: Then, you escaped the fire of the belly. ||2||

Gurbani: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh jon bhram aaeo |
English: After wandering through 8.4 million incarnations, you came.

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਕੇ ਛੁਟਕੇ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਠਾਇਓ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ab ke chhuttake tthaur na tthaaeo |3|
English: If you stumble and fall now, you shall find no home or place of rest. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਭਜੁ ਸਾਰਿਗਪਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer bhaj saarigapaanee |
English: Says Kabeer, meditate, vibrate upon the Lord, the Sustainer of the earth.

Gurbani: ਆਵਤ ਦੀਸੈ ਜਾਤ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੧॥੬੨॥
Transliteration: aavat deesai jaat na jaanee |4|1|11|62|
English: He is not seen to be coming or going; He is the Knower of all. ||4||1||11||62||

[Ang 337 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree poorabee |
English: Gauree Poorbee:

Gurbani: ਸੁਰਗ ਬਾਸੁ ਨ ਬਾਛੀਐ ਡਰੀਐ ਨ ਨਰਕਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: surag baas na baachheeai ddareeai na narak nivaas |
English: Don't wish for a home in heaven, and don't be afraid to live in hell.

Gurbani: ਹੋਨਾ ਹੈ ਸੋ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਮਨਹਿ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਆਸ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: honaa hai so hoee hai maneh na keejai aas |1|
English: Whatever will be will be, so don't get your hopes up in your mind. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਮਈਆ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: rameea gun gaaeeai |
English: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord,

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaa te paaeeai param nidhaan |1| rahaau |
English: from whom the most excellent treasure is obtained. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਜਪੁ ਕਿਆ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੋ ਕਿਆ ਬਰਤੁ ਕਿਆ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa jap kiaa tap sanjamo kiaa barat kiaa isanaan |
English: What good is chanting, penance or self-mortification? What good is fasting or cleansing baths,

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jab lag jugat na jaaneeai bhaau bhagat bhagavaan |2|
English: unless you know the way to worship the Lord God with loving devotion? ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੰਪੈ ਦੇਖਿ ਨ ਹਰਖੀਐ ਬਿਪਤਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਨ ਰੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sanpai dekh na harakheeai bipat dekh na roe |
English: Don't feel so delighted at the sight of wealth, and don't weep at the sight of suffering and adversity.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਸੰਪੈ ਤਿਉ ਬਿਪਤਿ ਹੈ ਬਿਧ ਨੇ ਰਚਿਆ ਸੋ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jiau sanpai tiau bipat hai bidh ne rachiaa so hoe |3|
English: As is wealth, so is adversity; whatever the Lord proposes, comes to pass. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਅਬ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਸੰਤਨ ਰਿਦੈ ਮਝਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: keh kabeer ab jaaniaa santan ridai majhaar |
English: Says Kabeer, now I know that the Lord dwells within the hearts of His Saints;

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਕ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਾ ਭਲੇ ਜਿਹ ਘਟ ਬਸੈ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੨॥੬੩॥
Transliteration: sevak so sevaa bhale jih ghatt basai muraar |4|1|12|63|
English: that servant performs the best service, whose heart is filled with the Lord. ||4||1||12||63||

[Ang 337 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree |
English: Gauree:

Gurbani: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਤੇਰੋ ਕੋਇ ਨਹੀ ਖਿੰਚਿ ਲੇਇ ਜਿਨਿ ਭਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: re man tero koe nahee khinch lee jin bhaar |
English: O my mind, even if you carry someone's burden, they don't belong to you.

Gurbani: ਬਿਰਖ ਬਸੇਰੋ ਪੰਖਿ ਕੋ ਤੈਸੋ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: birakh basero pankh ko taiso ihu sansaar |1|
English: This world is like the perch of the bird on the tree. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: raam ras peea re |
English: I drink in the sublime essence of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਰਸ ਬਿਸਰਿ ਗਏ ਰਸ ਅਉਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jih ras bisar ge ras aaur |1| rahaau |
English: With the taste of this essence, I have forgotten all other tastes. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਉਰ ਮੁਏ ਕਿਆ ਰੋਈਐ ਜਉ ਆਪਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aaur mue kiaa roeeai jau aapaa thir na rahaae |
English: Why should we weep at the death of others, when we ourselves are not permanent?

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਉਪਜੈ ਸੋ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਹੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਰਿ ਰੋਵੈ ਬਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jo upajai so binas hai dukh kar rovai balaae |2|
English: Whoever is born shall pass away; why should we cry out in grief? ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਕੀ ਉਪਜੀ ਤਹ ਰਚੀ ਪੀਵਤ ਮਰਦਨ ਲਾਗ ॥
Transliteration: jeh kee upajee teh rachee peevat maradan laag |
English: We are re-absorbed into the One from whom we came; drink in the Lord's essence, and remain attached to Him.

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਚਿਤਿ ਚੇਤਿਆ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਬੈਰਾਗ ॥੩॥੨॥੧੩॥੬੪॥
Transliteration: keh kabeer chit chetiaa raam simar bairaag |3|2|13|64|
English: Says Kabeer, my consciousness is filled with thoughts of remembrance of the Lord; I have become detached from the world. ||3||2||13||64||

[Ang 337 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: raag gaurree |
English: Raag Gauree:

Gurbani: ਪੰਥੁ ਨਿਹਾਰੈ ਕਾਮਨੀ ਲੋਚਨ ਭਰੀ ਲੇ ਉਸਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: panth nihaarai kaamanee lochan bharee le usaasaa |
English: The bride gazes at the path, and sighs with tearful eyes.

Gurbani: ਉਰ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਪਗੁ ਨਾ ਖਿਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aur na bheejai pag naa khisai har darasan kee aasaa |1|
English: Her heart is not happy, but she does not retrace her steps, in hopes of seeing the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||1||

Gurbani: ਉਡਹੁ ਨ ਕਾਗਾ ਕਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: auddahu na kaagaa kaare |
English: So fly away, black crow,

Gurbani: ਬੇਗਿ ਮਿਲੀਜੈ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: beg mileejai apune raam piaare |1| rahaau |
English: so that I may quickly meet my Beloved Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦ ਕਾਰਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: keh kabeer jeevan pad kaaran har kee bhagat kareejai |
English: Says Kabeer, to obtain the status of eternal life, worship the Lord with devotion.

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੪॥੬੫॥
Transliteration: ek aadhaar naam naaraaein rasanaa raam raveejai |2|1|14|65|
English: The Name of the Lord is my only Support; with my tongue, I chant the Lord's Name. ||2||1||14||65||

[Ang 338 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ੧੧ ॥
Transliteration: raag gaurree 11 |
English: Raag Gauree 11:

Gurbani: ਆਸ ਪਾਸ ਘਨ ਤੁਰਸੀ ਕਾ ਬਿਰਵਾ ਮਾਝ ਬਨਾ ਰਸਿ ਗਾਊਂ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aas paas ghan turasee kaa biravaa maajh banaa ras gaaoon re |
English: All around, there are thick bushes of sweet basil, and there in the midst of the forest, the Lord is singing with joy.

Gurbani: ਉਆ ਕਾ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਮੋਹੀ ਗੁਆਰਨਿ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਆਉ ਨ ਜਾਹੂ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: auaa kaa saroop dekh mohee guaaran mo kau chhodd na aau na jaahoo re |1|
English: Beholding His wondrous beauty, the milk-maid was entranced, and said, "Please don't leave me; please don't come and go!" ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੋਹਿ ਚਰਨ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗੋ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਧਰ ॥
Transliteration: tohi charan man laago saaringadhar |
English: My mind is attached to Your Feet, O Archer of the Universe;

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਜੋ ਬਡਭਾਗੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: so milai jo baddabhaago |1| rahaau |
English: he alone meets You, who is blessed by great good fortune. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਿੰਦ੍ਰਾਬਨ ਮਨ ਹਰਨ ਮਨੋਹਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਚਰਾਵਤ ਗਾਊ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: bindraaban man haran manohar krisan charaavat gaaoo re |
English: In Brindaaban, where Krishna grazes his cows, he entices and fascinates my mind.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਤੁਹੀ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਧਰ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਨਾਊ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੫॥੬੬॥
Transliteration: jaa kaa tthaakur tuhee saaringadhar mohi kabeeraa naaoo re |2|2|15|66|
English: You are my Lord Master, the Archer of the Universe; my name is Kabeer. ||2||2||15||66||

[Ang 338 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ੧੨ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree poorabee 12 |
English: Gauree Poorbee 12:

Gurbani: ਬਿਪਲ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਹੈ ਪਹਿਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਬਨ ਮਧੇ ਬਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: bipal basatr kete hai pahire kiaa ban madhe baasaa |
English: Many people wear various robes, but what is the use of living in the forest?

Gurbani: ਕਹਾ ਭਇਆ ਨਰ ਦੇਵਾ ਧੋਖੇ ਕਿਆ ਜਲਿ ਬੋਰਿਓ ਗਿਆਤਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kahaa bheaa nar devaa dhokhe kiaa jal borio giaataa |1|
English: What good does it do if a man burns incense before his gods? What good does it do to dip one's body in water? ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੀਅਰੇ ਜਾਹਿਗਾ ਮੈ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: jeeare jaahigaa mai jaanaan |
English: O soul, I know that I will have to depart.

Gurbani: ਅਬਿਗਤ ਸਮਝੁ ਇਆਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: abigat samajh eaanaa |
English: You ignorant idiot: understand the Imperishable Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਤ ਜਤ ਦੇਖਉ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਪੇਖਉ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਲਪਟਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jat jat dekhau bahur na pekhau sang maaeaa lapattaanaa |1| rahaau |
English: Whatever you see, you will not see that again, but still, you cling to Maya. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਬਹੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੀ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਸਗਲੋ ਧੰਧਾ ॥
Transliteration: giaanee dhiaanee bahu upadesee ihu jag sagalo dhandhaa |
English: The spiritual teachers, meditators and the great preachers are all engrossed in these worldly affairs.

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਇਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਇਆ ਜਗੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਅੰਧਾ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੬॥੬੭॥
Transliteration: keh kabeer ik raam naam bin eaa jag maaeaa andhaa |2|1|16|67|
English: Says Kabeer, without the Name of the One Lord, this world is blinded by Maya. ||2||1||16||67||

[Ang 338 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ੧੨ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree 12 |
English: Gauree 12:

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਛਾਡਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਹੋਇ ਨਾਚਹੁ ਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਡਾਂਡੇ ॥
Transliteration: man re chhaaddahu bharam pragatt hoe naachahu eaa maaeaa ke ddaandde |
English: O people, O victims of this Maya, abandon your doubts and dance out in the open.

Gurbani: ਸੂਰੁ ਕਿ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਰਨ ਤੇ ਡਰਪੈ ਸਤੀ ਕਿ ਸਾਂਚੈ ਭਾਂਡੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: soor ki sanamukh ran te ddarapai satee ki saanchai bhaandde |1|
English: What sort of a hero is one who is afraid to face the battle? What sort of satee is she who, when her time comes, starts collecting her pots and pans? ||1||

Gurbani: ਡਗਮਗ ਛਾਡਿ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: ddagamag chhaadd re man bauraa |
English: Stop your wavering, O crazy people!

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਤਉ ਜਰੇ ਮਰੇ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਲੀਨੋ ਹਾਥਿ ਸੰਧਉਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ab tau jare mare sidh paaeeai leeno haath sandhauraa |1| rahaau |
English: Now that you have taken up the challenge of death, let yourself burn and die, and attain perfection. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਲੀਨੇ ਇਆ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਬਿਗੂਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh maaeaa ke leene eaa bidh jagat bigootaa |
English: The world is engrossed in sexual desire, anger and Maya; in this way it is plundered and ruined.

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਨ ਛੋਡਉ ਸਗਲ ਊਚ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੭॥੬੮॥
Transliteration: keh kabeer raajaa raam na chhoddau sagal aooch te aoochaa |2|2|17|68|
English: Says Kabeer, do not forsake the Lord, your Sovereign King, the Highest of the High. ||2||2||17||68||

[Ang 338 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ੧੩ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree 13 |
English: Gauree 13:

Gurbani: ਫੁਰਮਾਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਿਰੈ ਊਪਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਨ ਕਰਤ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: furamaan teraa sirai aoopar fir na karat beechaar |
English: Your Command is upon my head, and I no longer question it.

Gurbani: ਤੁਹੀ ਦਰੀਆ ਤੁਹੀ ਕਰੀਆ ਤੁਝੈ ਤੇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tuhee dareea tuhee kareea tujhai te nisataar |1|
English: You are the river, and You are the boatman; salvation comes from You. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬੰਦੇ ਬੰਦਗੀ ਇਕਤੀਆਰ ॥
Transliteration: bande bandagee ikateeaar |
English: O human being, embrace the Lord's meditation,

Gurbani: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਰੋਸੁ ਧਰਉ ਕਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saahib ros dhrau ki piaar |1| rahaau |
English: whether your Lord and Master is angry with you or in love with you. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਜਿਉ ਫੂਲੁ ਜਈ ਹੈ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: naam teraa aadhaar meraa jiau fool jee hai naar |
English: Your Name is my Support, like the flower blossoming in the water.

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਗੁਲਾਮੁ ਘਰ ਕਾ ਜੀਆਇ ਭਾਵੈ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੧੮॥੬੯॥
Transliteration: keh kabeer gulaam ghar kaa jeeae bhaavai maar |2|18|69|
English: Says Kabeer, I am the slave of Your home; I live or die as You will. ||2||18||69||

[Ang 338 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ₅ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree₅ |
English: Gauree:

Gurbani: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜੀਅ ਜੋਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਨੰਦੁ ਬਹੁ ਥਾਕੋ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh jeea jon meh bhramat nand bahu thaako re |
English: Wandering through 8.4 million incarnations, Krishna's father Nand was totally exhausted.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਵਤਾਰੁ ਲੀਓ ਹੈ ਭਾਗੁ ਬਡੋ ਬਪੁਰਾ ਕੋ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bhagat het avataar leeo hai bhaag baddo bapuraa ko re |1|
English: Because of his devotion, Krishna was incarnated in his home; how great was the good fortune of this poor man! ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮੑ ਜੁ ਕਹਤ ਹਉ ਨੰਦ ਕੋ ਨੰਦਨੁ ਨੰਦ ਸੁ ਨੰਦਨੁ ਕਾ ਕੋ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: tuma ju kehat hau nand ko nandan nand su nandan kaa ko re |
English: You say that Krishna was Nand's son, but whose son was Nand himself?

Gurbani: ਧਰਨਿ ਅਕਾਸੁ ਦਸੋ ਦਿਸ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਬ ਇਹੁ ਨੰਦੁ ਕਹਾ ਥੋ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dharan akaas daso dis naahee tab ihu nand kahaa tho re |1| rahaau |
English: When there was no earth or ether or the ten directions, where was this Nand then? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੰਕਟਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਰੈ ਜੋਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sankatt nahee parai jon nahee aavai naam niranjan jaa ko re |
English: He does not fall into misfortune, and He does not take birth; His Name is the Immaculate Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਬੀਰ ਕੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਐਸੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਾਈ ਨ ਬਾਪੋ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੧੯॥੭੦॥
Transliteration: kabeer ko suaamee aiso tthaakur jaa kai maaee na baapo re |2|19|70|
English: Kabeer's Lord is such a Lord and Master, who has no mother or father. ||2||19||70||

[Ang 339 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree |
English: Gauree:

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦਉ ਨਿੰਦਉ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਲੋਗੁ ਨਿੰਦਉ ॥
Transliteration: nindau nindau mo kau log nindau |
English: Slander me, slander me - go ahead, people, and slander me.

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਖਰੀ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: nindaa jan kau kharee piaaree |
English: Slander is pleasing to the Lord's humble servant.

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਬਾਪੁ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਮਹਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: nindaa baap nindaa mahataaree |1| rahaau |
English: Slander is my father, slander is my mother. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਬੈਕੁੰਠਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: nindaa hoe ta baikuntth jaaeeai |
English: If I am slandered, I go to heaven;

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਬਸਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: naam padaarath maneh basaaeeai |
English: the wealth of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides within my mind.

Gurbani: ਰਿਦੈ ਸੁਧ ਜਉ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: ridai sudh jau nindaa hoe |
English: If my heart is pure, and I am slandered,

Gurbani: ਹਮਰੇ ਕਪਰੇ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਧੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: hamare kapare nindak dhoe |1|
English: then the slanderer washes my clothes. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਹਮਰਾ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: nindaa karai su hamaraa meet |
English: One who slanders me is my friend;

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਮਾਹਿ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਚੀਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: nindak maeh hamaaraa cheet |
English: the slanderer is in my thoughts.

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਸੋ ਜੋ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਹੋਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: nindak so jo nindaa horai |
English: The slanderer is the one who prevents me from being slandered.

Gurbani: ਹਮਰਾ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਲੋਰੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: hamaraa jeevan nindak lorai |2|
English: The slanderer wishes me long life. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਹਮਰੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: nindaa hamaree prem piaar |
English: I have love and affection for the slanderer.

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਹਮਰਾ ਕਰੈ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: nindaa hamaraa karai udhaar |
English: Slander is my salvation.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਕਬੀਰ ਕਉ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jan kabeer kau nindaa saar |
English: Slander is the best thing for servant Kabeer.

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਡੂਬਾ ਹਮ ਉਤਰੇ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੩॥੨੦॥੭੧॥
Transliteration: nindak ddoobaa ham utare paar |3|20|71|
English: The slanderer is drowned, while I am carried across. ||3||20||71||

[Ang 339 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਤੂੰ ਐਸਾ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਤਰਨ ਤਾਰਨ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raajaa raam toon aisaa nirbhau taran taaran raam raaeaa |1| rahaau |
English: O my Sovereign Lord King, You are Fearless; You are the Carrier to carry us across, O my Lord King. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਹਮ ਹੋਤੇ ਤਬ ਤੁਮ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਬ ਤੁਮ ਹਹੁ ਹਮ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jab ham hote tab tum naahee ab tum hahu ham naahee |
English: When I was, then You were not; now that You are, I am not.

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਏਕ ਭਏ ਹਹਿ ਏਕੈ ਦੇਖਤ ਮਨੁ ਪਤੀਆਹੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ab ham tum ek bhe heh ekai dekhat man pateeaahee |1|
English: Now, You and I have become one; seeing this, my mind is content. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਬੁਧਿ ਹੋਤੀ ਤਬ ਬਲੁ ਕੈਸਾ ਅਬ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਲੁ ਨ ਖਟਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jab budh hotee tab bal kaisaa ab budh bal na khattaaee |
English: When there was wisdom, how could there be strength? Now that there is wisdom, strength cannot prevail.

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਬੁਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਈ ਮੇਰੀ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਦਲੀ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥੨੧॥੭੨॥
Transliteration: keh kabeer budh har lee meree budh badalee sidh paaee |2|21|72|
English: Says Kabeer, the Lord has taken away my wisdom, and I have attained spiritual perfection. ||2||21||72||

[Ang 339 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree |
English: Gauree:

Gurbani: ਖਟ ਨੇਮ ਕਰਿ ਕੋਠੜੀ ਬਾਂਧੀ ਬਸਤੁ ਅਨੂਪੁ ਬੀਚ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: khatt nem kar kottharree baandhee basat anoop beech paaee |
English: He fashioned the body chamber with six rings, and placed within it the incomparable thing.

Gurbani: ਕੁੰਜੀ ਕੁਲਫੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਕਰਤੇ ਬਾਰ ਨ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kunjee kulaf praan kar raakhe karate baar na laaee |1|
English: He made the breath of life the watchman, with lock and key to protect it; the Creator did this in no time at all. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਮਨ ਜਾਗਤ ਰਹੁ ਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ab man jaagat rahu re bhaaee |
English: Keep your mind awake and aware now, O Sibling of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਗਾਫਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਓ ਚੋਰੁ ਮੁਸੈ ਘਰੁ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gaafal hoe kai janam gavaaeo chor musai ghar jaaee |1| rahaau |
English: You were careless, and you have wasted your life; your home is being plundered by thieves. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਪਹਰੂਆ ਦਰ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਨਹੀ ਪਤੀਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: panch paharooaa dar meh rahate tin kaa nahee pateeaaraa |
English: The five senses stand as guards at the gate, but now can they be trusted?

Gurbani: ਚੇਤਿ ਸੁਚੇਤ ਚਿਤ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੁ ਤਉ ਲੈ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਉਜਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: chet suchet chit hoe rahu tau lai paragaas ujaaraa |2|
English: When you are conscious in your consciousness, you shall be enlightened and illuminated. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਉ ਘਰ ਦੇਖਿ ਜੁ ਕਾਮਨਿ ਭੂਲੀ ਬਸਤੁ ਅਨੂਪ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: nau ghar dekh ju kaaman bhoolee basat anoop na paaee |
English: Seeing the nine openings of the body, the soul-bride is led astray; she does not obtain that incomparable thing.

Gurbani: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਨਵੈ ਘਰ ਮੂਸੇ ਦਸਵੈਂ ਤਤੁ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੩॥੨੨॥੭੩॥
Transliteration: kehat kabeer navai ghar moose dasavain tat samaaee |3|22|73|
English: Says Kabeer, the nine openings of the body are being plundered; rise up to the Tenth Gate, and discover the true essence. ||3||22||73||

[Ang 339 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree |
English: Gauree:

Gurbani: ਮਾਈ ਮੋਹਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਆਨਾਨਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: maaee mohi avar na jaanio aanaanaan |
English: O mother, I do not know any other, except Him.

Gurbani: ਸਿਵ ਸਨਕਾਦਿ ਜਾਸੁ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਤਾਸੁ ਬਸਹਿ ਮੋਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਾਨਾਂ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: siv sanakaad jaas gun gaaveh taas baseh more praanaanaan | rahaau |
English: My breath of life resides in Him, whose praises are sung by Shiva and Sanak and so many others. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਿਰਦੇ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਗੰਮਿਤ ਗਗਨ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ ਧਿਆਨਾਨਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: hirade pragaas giaan gur gamit gagan manddal meh dhiaanaanaan |
English: My heart is illuminated by spiritual wisdom; meeting the Guru, I meditate in the Sky of the Tenth Gate.

Gurbani: ਬਿਖੈ ਰੋਗ ਭੈ ਬੰਧਨ ਭਾਗੇ ਮਨ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾਨਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bikhai rog bhai bandhan bhaage man nij ghar sukh jaanaanaa |1|
English: The diseases of corruption, fear and bondage have run away; my mind has come to know peace in its own true home. ||1||

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਰਤਿ ਜਾਨਿ ਮਾਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੂਸਰ ਮਨਹਿ ਨ ਆਨਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: ek sumat rat jaan maan prabh doosar maneh na aanaanaa |
English: Imbued with a balanced single-mindedness, I know and obey God; nothing else enters my mind.

Gurbani: ਚੰਦਨ ਬਾਸੁ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਬਾਸਨ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਘਟਿਓ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: chandan baas bhe man baasan tiaag ghattio abhimaanaanaa |2|
English: My mind has become fragrant with the scent of sandalwood; I have renounced egotistical selfishness and conceit. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਗਾਇ ਧਿਆਇ ਜਸੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤਾਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹੈ ਥਾਨਾਨਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: jo jan gaae dhiaae jas tthaakur taas prabhoo hai thaanaanaan |
English: That humble being, who sings and meditates on the Praises of his Lord and Master, is the dwelling-place of God.

Gurbani: ਤਿਹ ਬਡ ਭਾਗ ਬਸਿਓ ਮਨਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਰਮ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨ ਮਥਾਨਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tih badd bhaag basio man jaa kai karam pradhaan mathaanaanaa |3|
English: He is blessed with great good fortune; the Lord abides in his mind. Good karma radiates from his forehead. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਾਟਿ ਸਕਤਿ ਸਿਵ ਸਹਜੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਓ ਏਕੈ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaatt sakat siv sehaj pragaasio ekai ek samaanaanaa |
English: I have broken the bonds of Maya; the intuitive peace and poise of Shiva has dawned within me, and I am merged in oneness with the One.

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟਿ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਰਹੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਾਨਾਂ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੭੪॥
Transliteration: keh kabeer gur bhett mahaa sukh bhramat rahe man maanaanaan |4|23|74|
English: Says Kabeer, meeting the Guru, I have found absolute peace. My mind has ceased its wanderings; I am happy. ||4||23||74||

[Ang 340 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਬਾਵਨ ਅਖਰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: raag gaurree poorabee baavan akharee kabeer jeeo kee |
English: Raag Gauree Poorbee, Baawan Akhree Of Kabeer Jee:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar sat naam karataa purakh gur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru's Grace:

Gurbani: ਬਾਵਨ ਅਛਰ ਲੋਕ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਇਨ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: baavan achhar lok trai sabh kachh in hee maeh |
English: Through these fifty-two letters, the three worlds and all things are described.

Gurbani: ਏ ਅਖਰ ਖਿਰਿ ਜਾਹਿਗੇ ਓਇ ਅਖਰ ਇਨ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: e akhar khir jaahige oe akhar in meh naeh |1|
English: These letters shall perish; they cannot describe the Imperishable Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਹਾ ਬੋਲ ਤਹ ਅਛਰ ਆਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: jahaa bol teh achhar aavaa |
English: Wherever there is speech, there are letters.

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਅਬੋਲ ਤਹ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਰਹਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeh abol teh man na rahaavaa |
English: Where there is no speech, there, the mind rests on nothing.

Gurbani: ਬੋਲ ਅਬੋਲ ਮਧਿ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: bol abol madh hai soee |
English: He is in both speech and silence.

Gurbani: ਜਸ ਓਹੁ ਹੈ ਤਸ ਲਖੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jas ohu hai tas lakhai na koee |2|
English: No one can know Him as He is. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਲਹ ਲਹਉ ਤਉ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਉ ਕਹਉ ਤ ਕੋ ਉਪਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: alah lhau tau kiaa khau khau ta ko upakaar |
English: If I come to know the Lord, what can I say; what good does it do to speak?

Gurbani: ਬਟਕ ਬੀਜ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਤੀਨਿ ਲੋਕ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: battak beej meh rav rahio jaa ko teen lok bisathaar |3|
English: He is contained in the seed of the banyan-tree, and yet, His expanse spreads across the three worlds. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅਲਹ ਲਹੰਤਾ ਭੇਦ ਛੈ ਕਛੁ ਕਛੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਭੇਦ ॥
Transliteration: alah lahantaa bhed chhai kachh kachh paaeo bhed |
English: One who knows the Lord understands His mystery, and bit by bit, the mystery disappears.

Gurbani: ਉਲਟਿ ਭੇਦ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਓ ਪਾਇਓ ਅਭੰਗ ਅਛੇਦ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: aulatt bhed man bedhio paaeo abhang achhed |4|
English: Turning away from the world, one's mind is pierced through with this mystery, and one obtains the Indestructible, Impenetrable Lord. ||4||

Gurbani: ਤੁਰਕ ਤਰੀਕਤਿ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: turak tareekat jaaneeai hindoo bed puraan |
English: The Muslim knows the Muslim way of life; the Hindu knows the Vedas and Puraanas.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਸਮਝਾਵਨ ਕਾਰਨੇ ਕਛੂਅਕ ਪੜੀਐ ਗਿਆਨ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: man samajhaavan kaarane kachhooak parreeai giaan |5|
English: To instruct their minds, people ought to study some sort of spiritual wisdom. ||5||

Gurbani: ਓਅੰਕਾਰ ਆਦਿ ਮੈ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: oankaar aad mai jaanaa |
English: I know only the One, the Universal Creator, the Primal Being.

Gurbani: ਲਿਖਿ ਅਰੁ ਮੇਟੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਨ ਮਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: likh ar mettai taeh na maanaa |
English: I do not believe in anyone whom the Lord writes and erases.

Gurbani: ਓਅੰਕਾਰ ਲਖੈ ਜਉ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: oankaar lakhai jau koee |
English: If someone knows the One, the Universal Creator,

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਲਖਿ ਮੇਟਣਾ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: soee lakh mettanaa na hoee |6|
English: he shall not perish, since he knows Him. ||6||

Gurbani: ਕਕਾ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਕਮਲ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: kakaa kiran kamal meh paavaa |
English: KAKKA: When the rays of Divine Light come into the heart-lotus,

Gurbani: ਸਸਿ ਬਿਗਾਸ ਸੰਪਟ ਨਹੀ ਆਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: sas bigaas sanpatt nahee aavaa |
English: the moon-light of Maya cannot enter the basket of the mind.

Gurbani: ਅਰੁ ਜੇ ਤਹਾ ਕੁਸਮ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: ar je tahaa kusam ras paavaa |
English: And if one obtains the subtle fragrance of that spiritual flower,

Gurbani: ਅਕਹ ਕਹਾ ਕਹਿ ਕਾ ਸਮਝਾਵਾ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: akah kahaa keh kaa samajhaavaa |7|
English: he cannot describe the indescribable; he could speak, but who would understand? ||7||

Gurbani: ਖਖਾ ਇਹੈ ਖੋੜਿ ਮਨ ਆਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: khakhaa ihai khorr man aavaa |
English: KHAKHA: The mind has entered this cave.

Gurbani: ਖੋੜੇ ਛਾਡਿ ਨ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: khorre chhaadd na deh dis dhaavaa |
English: It does not leave this cave to wander in the ten directions.

Gurbani: ਖਸਮਹਿ ਜਾਣਿ ਖਿਮਾ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: khasameh jaan khimaa kar rahai |
English: Knowing their Lord and Master, people show compassion;

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਖਿਅਉ ਅਖੈ ਪਦੁ ਲਹੈ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: tau hoe nikhiaau akhai pad lahai |8|
English: then, they become immortal, and attain the state of eternal dignity. ||8||

Gurbani: ਗਗਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਬਚਨ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: gagaa gur ke bachan pachhaanaa |
English: GAGGA: One who understands the Guru's Word

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੀ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਧਰਈ ਕਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: doojee baat na dharee kaanaa |
English: does not listen to anything else.

Gurbani: ਰਹੈ ਬਿਹੰਗਮ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: rahai bihangam kateh na jaaee |
English: He remains like a hermit and does not go anywhere,

Gurbani: ਅਗਹ ਗਹੈ ਗਹਿ ਗਗਨ ਰਹਾਈ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: agah gahai geh gagan rahaaee |9|
English: when he grasps the Ungraspable Lord and dwells in the sky of the Tenth Gate. ||9||

Gurbani: ਘਘਾ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਨਿਮਸੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: ghaghaa ghatt ghatt nimasai soee |
English: GHAGHA: He dwells in each and every heart.

Gurbani: ਘਟ ਫੂਟੇ ਘਟਿ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt footte ghatt kabeh na hoee |
English: Even when the body-pitcher bursts, he does not diminish.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਘਟ ਮਾਹਿ ਘਾਟ ਜਉ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: taa ghatt maeh ghaatt jau paavaa |
English: When someone finds the Path to the Lord within his own heart,

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਘਟੁ ਛਾਡਿ ਅਵਘਟ ਕਤ ਧਾਵਾ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: so ghatt chhaadd avaghatt kat dhaavaa |10|
English: why should he abandon that Path to follow some other path? ||10||

Gurbani: ਙੰਙਾ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਸਨੇਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਰਵਾਰੋ ਸੰਦੇਹ ॥
Transliteration: ngangaa nigreh sanehu kar niravaaro sandeh |
English: NGANGA: Restrain yourself, love the Lord, and dismiss your doubts.

Gurbani: ਨਾਹੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਨ ਭਾਜੀਐ ਪਰਮ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਏਹ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: naahee dekh na bhaajeeai param siaanap eh |11|
English: Even if you do not see the Path, do not run away; this is the highest wisdom. ||11||

Gurbani: ਚਚਾ ਰਚਿਤ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਹੈ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: chachaa rachit chitr hai bhaaree |
English: CHACHA: He painted the great picture of the world.

Gurbani: ਤਜਿ ਚਿਤ੍ਰੈ ਚੇਤਹੁ ਚਿਤਕਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: taj chitrai chetahu chitakaaree |
English: Forget this picture, and remember the Painter.

Gurbani: ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਇਹੈ ਅਵਝੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: chitr bachitr ihai avajheraa |
English: This wondrous painting is now the problem.

Gurbani: ਤਜਿ ਚਿਤ੍ਰੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਰਾਖਿ ਚਿਤੇਰਾ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: taj chitrai chit raakh chiteraa |12|
English: Forget this picture and focus your consciousness on the Painter. ||12||

Gurbani: ਛਛਾ ਇਹੈ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤਿ ਪਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: chhachhaa ihai chhatrapat paasaa |
English: CHHACHHA: The Sovereign Lord of the Universe is here with you.

Gurbani: ਛਕਿ ਕਿ ਨ ਰਹਹੁ ਛਾਡਿ ਕਿ ਨ ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: chhak ki na rahahu chhaadd ki na aasaa |
English: Why are you so unhappy? Why don't you abandon your desires?

Gurbani: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੈ ਤਉ ਛਿਨ ਛਿਨ ਸਮਝਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: re man mai tau chhin chhin samajhaavaa |
English: O my mind, each and every moment I try to instruct you,

Gurbani: ਤਾਹਿ ਛਾਡਿ ਕਤ ਆਪੁ ਬਧਾਵਾ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: taeh chhaadd kat aap badhaavaa |13|
English: but you forsake Him, and entangle yourself with others. ||13||

Gurbani: ਜਜਾ ਜਉ ਤਨ ਜੀਵਤ ਜਰਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jajaa jau tan jeevat jaraavai |
English: JAJJA: If someone burns his body while he is still alive,

Gurbani: ਜੋਬਨ ਜਾਰਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: joban jaar jugat so paavai |
English: and burns away the desires of his youth, then he finds the right way.

Gurbani: ਅਸ ਜਰਿ ਪਰ ਜਰਿ ਜਰਿ ਜਬ ਰਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: as jar par jar jar jab rahai |
English: When he burns his desire for his own wealth, and that of others,

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਜਾਇ ਜੋਤਿ ਉਜਾਰਉ ਲਹੈ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: tab jaae jot ujaarau lahai |14|
English: then he finds the Divine Light. ||14||

Gurbani: ਝਝਾ ਉਰਝਿ ਸੁਰਝਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jhajhaa urajh surajh nahee jaanaa |
English: JHAJHA: You are entangled in the world, and you do not know how to get untangled.

Gurbani: ਰਹਿਓ ਝਝਕਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: rahio jhajhak naahee paravaanaa |
English: You hold back in fear, and are not approved by the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਤ ਝਖਿ ਝਖਿ ਅਉਰਨ ਸਮਝਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: kat jhakh jhakh aauran samajhaavaa |
English: Why do you talk such nonsense, trying to convince others?

Gurbani: ਝਗਰੁ ਕੀਏ ਝਗਰਉ ਹੀ ਪਾਵਾ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: jhagar kee jhagrau hee paavaa |15|
English: Stirring up arguments, you shall only obtain more arguments. ||15||

Gurbani: ਞੰਞਾ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਜੁ ਘਟ ਰਹਿਓ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਹਾ ਤਜਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: yanyaa nikatt ju ghatt rahio door kahaa taj jaae |
English: NYANYA: He dwells near you, deep within your heart; why do you leave Him and go far away?

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਜਗੁ ਢੂਢਿਅਉ ਨੇਰਉ ਪਾਇਅਉ ਤਾਹਿ ॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: jaa kaaran jag dtoodtiaau nerau paaeaau taeh |16|
English: I searched the whole world for Him, but I found Him near myself. ||16||

Gurbani: ਟਟਾ ਬਿਕਟ ਘਾਟ ਘਟ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: ttattaa bikatt ghaatt ghatt maahee |
English: TATTA: It is such a difficult path, to find Him within your own heart.

Gurbani: ਖੋਲਿ ਕਪਾਟ ਮਹਲਿ ਕਿ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: khol kapaatt mehal ki na jaahee |
English: Open the doors within, and enter the Mansion of His Presence.

Gurbani: ਦੇਖਿ ਅਟਲ ਟਲਿ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: dekh attal ttal kateh na jaavaa |
English: Beholding the Immovable Lord, you shall not slip and go anywhere else.

Gurbani: ਰਹੈ ਲਪਟਿ ਘਟ ਪਰਚਉ ਪਾਵਾ ॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: rahai lapatt ghatt parchau paavaa |17|
English: You shall remain firmly attached to the Lord, and your heart will be happy. ||17||

Gurbani: ਠਠਾ ਇਹੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਠਗ ਨੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: tthatthaa ihai door tthag neeraa |
English: T'HAT'HA: Keep yourself far away from this mirage.

Gurbani: ਨੀਠਿ ਨੀਠਿ ਮਨੁ ਕੀਆ ਧੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: neetth neetth man keea dheeraa |
English: With great difficulty, I have calmed my mind.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਠਗਿ ਠਗਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਜਗੁ ਖਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: jin tthag tthagiaa sagal jag khaavaa |
English: That cheater, who cheated and devoured the whole world

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਠਗੁ ਠਗਿਆ ਠਉਰ ਮਨੁ ਆਵਾ ॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: so tthag tthagiaa tthaur man aavaa |18|
English: - I have cheated that cheater, and my mind is now at peace. ||18||

Gurbani: ਡਡਾ ਡਰ ਉਪਜੇ ਡਰੁ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ddaddaa ddar upaje ddar jaaee |
English: DADDA: When the Fear of God wells up, other fears depart.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਡਰ ਮਹਿ ਡਰੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: taa ddar meh ddar rahiaa samaaee |
English: Other fears are absorbed into that Fear.

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਡਰ ਡਰੈ ਤ ਫਿਰਿ ਡਰੁ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: jau ddar ddarai ta fir ddar laagai |
English: When one rejects the Fear of God, then other fears cling to him.

Gurbani: ਨਿਡਰ ਹੂਆ ਡਰੁ ਉਰ ਹੋਇ ਭਾਗੈ ॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: niddar hooaa ddar ur hoe bhaagai |19|
English: But if he becomes fearless, the fears of his heart run away. ||19||

Gurbani: ਢਢਾ ਢਿਗ ਢੂਢਹਿ ਕਤ ਆਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: dtadtaa dtig dtoodteh kat aanaa |
English: DHADHA: Why do you search in other directions?

Gurbani: ਢੂਢਤ ਹੀ ਢਹਿ ਗਏ ਪਰਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: dtoodtat hee dteh ge paraanaa |
English: Searching for Him like this, the breath of life runs out.

Gurbani: ਚੜਿ ਸੁਮੇਰਿ ਢੂਢਿ ਜਬ ਆਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: charr sumer dtoodt jab aavaa |
English: When I returned after climbing the mountain,

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਗੜੁ ਗੜਿਓ ਸੁ ਗੜ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਵਾ ॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: jih garr garrio su garr meh paavaa |20|
English: I found Him in the fortress - the fortress which He Himself made. ||20||

Gurbani: ਣਾਣਾ ਰਣਿ ਰੂਤਉ ਨਰ ਨੇਹੀ ਕਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: naanaa ran rootau nar nehee karai |
English: NANNA: The warrior who fights on the battle-field should keep up and press on.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਨਿਵੈ ਨਾ ਫੁਨਿ ਸੰਚਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: naa nivai naa fun sancharai |
English: He should not yield, and he should not retreat.

Gurbani: ਧੰਨਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਗਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: dhan janam taahee ko ganai |
English: Blessed is the coming of one

Gurbani: ਮਾਰੈ ਏਕਹਿ ਤਜਿ ਜਾਇ ਘਣੈ ॥੨੧॥
Transliteration: maarai ekeh taj jaae ghanai |21|
English: who conquers the one and renounces the many. ||21||

Gurbani: ਤਤਾ ਅਤਰ ਤਰਿਓ ਨਹ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: tataa atar tario neh jaaee |
English: TATTA: The impassable world-ocean cannot be crossed over;

Gurbani: ਤਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: tan tribhavan meh rahio samaaee |
English: the body remains embroiled in the three worlds.

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਤਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: jau tribhavan tan maeh samaavaa |
English: But when the Lord of the three worlds enters into the body,

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਤਤਹਿ ਤਤ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵਾ ॥੨੨॥
Transliteration: tau tateh tat miliaa sach paavaa |22|
English: then one's essence merges with the essence of reality, and the True Lord is attained. ||22||

Gurbani: ਥਥਾ ਅਥਾਹ ਥਾਹ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: thathaa athaah thaah nahee paavaa |
English: T'HAT'HA: He is Unfathomable; His depths cannot be fathomed.

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਅਥਾਹ ਇਹੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: ohu athaah ihu thir na rahaavaa |
English: He is Unfathomable; this body is impermanent, and unstable.

Gurbani: ਥੋੜੈ ਥਲਿ ਥਾਨਕ ਆਰੰਭੈ ॥
Transliteration: thorrai thal thaanak aaranbhai |
English: The mortal builds his dwelling upon this tiny space;

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਹੀ ਥਾਭਹ ਮੰਦਿਰੁ ਥੰਭੈ ॥੨੩॥
Transliteration: bin hee thaabhah mandir thanbhai |23|
English: without any pillars, he wishes to support a mansion. ||23||

Gurbani: ਦਦਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਜੁ ਬਿਨਸਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: dadaa dekh ju binasanahaaraa |
English: DADDA: Whatever is seen shall perish.

Gurbani: ਜਸ ਅਦੇਖਿ ਤਸ ਰਾਖਿ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jas adekh tas raakh bichaaraa |
English: Contemplate the One who is unseen.

Gurbani: ਦਸਵੈ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਕੁੰਚੀ ਜਬ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: dasavai duaar kunchee jab deejai |
English: When the key is inserted in the Tenth Gate,

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਦਇਆਲ ਕੋ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੨੪॥
Transliteration: tau deaal ko darasan keejai |24|
English: then the Blessed Vision of the Merciful Lord's Darshan is seen. ||24||

Gurbani: ਧਧਾ ਅਰਧਹਿ ਉਰਧ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: dhadhaa aradheh uradh niberaa |
English: DHADHA: When one ascends from the lower realms of the earth to the higher realms of the heavens, then everything is resolved.

Gurbani: ਅਰਧਹਿ ਉਰਧਹ ਮੰਝਿ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aradheh uradhah manjh baseraa |
English: The Lord dwells in both the lower and higher worlds.

Gurbani: ਅਰਧਹ ਛਾਡਿ ਉਰਧ ਜਉ ਆਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: aradhah chhaadd uradh jau aavaa |
English: Leaving the earth, the soul ascends to the heavens;

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਅਰਧਹਿ ਉਰਧ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਾ ॥੨੫॥
Transliteration: tau aradheh uradh miliaa sukh paavaa |25|
English: then, the lower and higher join together, and peace is obtained. ||25||

Gurbani: ਨੰਨਾ ਨਿਸਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਨਿਰਖਤ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: nanaa nis din nirakhat jaaee |
English: NANNA: The days and nights go by; I am looking for the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਖਤ ਨੈਨ ਰਹੇ ਰਤਵਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: nirakhat nain rahe ratavaaee |
English: Looking for Him, my eyes have become blood-shot.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਖਤ ਨਿਰਖਤ ਜਬ ਜਾਇ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: nirakhat nirakhat jab jaae paavaa |
English: After looking and looking,when He is finally found,

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਲੇ ਨਿਰਖਹਿ ਨਿਰਖ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ॥੨੬॥
Transliteration: tab le nirakheh nirakh milaavaa |26|
English: then the one who was looking merges into the One who was looked for. ||26||

Gurbani: ਪਪਾ ਅਪਰ ਪਾਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: papaa apar paar nahee paavaa |
English: PAPPA: He is limitless; His limits cannot be found.

Gurbani: ਪਰਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਪਰਚਉ ਲਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: param jot siau parchau laavaa |
