English: I have attuned myself to the Supreme Light.

Gurbani: ਪਾਂਚਉ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹ ਕਰਈ ॥
Transliteration: paanchau indree nigrah karee |
English: One who controls his five senses

Gurbani: ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਦੋਊ ਨਿਰਵਰਈ ॥੨੭॥
Transliteration: paap pun doaoo niravaree |27|
English: rises above both sin and virtue. ||27||

Gurbani: ਫਫਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਫੂਲਹ ਫਲੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: fafaa bin foolah fal hoee |
English: FAFFA: Even without the flower, the fruit is produced.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਫਲ ਫੰਕ ਲਖੈ ਜਉ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: taa fal fank lakhai jau koee |
English: One who looks at a slice of that fruit

Gurbani: ਦੂਣਿ ਨ ਪਰਈ ਫੰਕ ਬਿਚਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: doon na paree fank bichaarai |
English: and reflects on it, will not be consigned to reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਫਲ ਫੰਕ ਸਭੈ ਤਨ ਫਾਰੈ ॥੨੮॥
Transliteration: taa fal fank sabhai tan faarai |28|
English: A slice of that fruit slices all bodies. ||28||

Gurbani: ਬਬਾ ਬਿੰਦਹਿ ਬਿੰਦ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: babaa bindeh bind milaavaa |
English: BABBA: When one drop blends with another drop,

Gurbani: ਬਿੰਦਹਿ ਬਿੰਦਿ ਨ ਬਿਛੁਰਨ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: bindeh bind na bichhuran paavaa |
English: then these drops cannot be separated again.

Gurbani: ਬੰਦਉ ਹੋਇ ਬੰਦਗੀ ਗਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: bandau hoe bandagee gahai |
English: Become the Lord's slave, and hold tight to His meditation.

Gurbani: ਬੰਦਕ ਹੋਇ ਬੰਧ ਸੁਧਿ ਲਹੈ ॥੨੯॥
Transliteration: bandak hoe bandh sudh lahai |29|
English: If you turn your thoughts to the Lord, the Lord will take care of you like a relative. ||29||

Gurbani: ਭਭਾ ਭੇਦਹਿ ਭੇਦ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: bhabhaa bhedeh bhed milaavaa |
English: BHABHA: When doubt is pierced, union is achieved.

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਭਉ ਭਾਨਿ ਭਰੋਸਉ ਆਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: ab bhau bhaan bharosau aavaa |
English: I have shattered my fear, and now I have come to have faith.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੋ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jo baahar so bheetar jaaniaa |
English: I thought that He was outside of me, but now I know that He is within me.

Gurbani: ਭਇਆ ਭੇਦੁ ਭੂਪਤਿ ਪਹਿਚਾਨਿਆ ॥੩੦॥
Transliteration: bheaa bhed bhoopat pahichaaniaa |30|
English: When I came to understand this mystery, then I recognized the Lord. ||30||

Gurbani: ਮਮਾ ਮੂਲ ਗਹਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: mamaa mool gahiaa man maanai |
English: MAMMA: Clinging to the source, the mind is satisfied.

Gurbani: ਮਰਮੀ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: maramee hoe su man kau jaanai |
English: One who knows this mystery understands his own mind.

Gurbani: ਮਤ ਕੋਈ ਮਨ ਮਿਲਤਾ ਬਿਲਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: mat koee man milataa bilamaavai |
English: Let no one delay in uniting his mind.

Gurbani: ਮਗਨ ਭਇਆ ਤੇ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩੧॥
Transliteration: magan bheaa te so sach paavai |31|
English: Those who obtain the True Lord are immersed in delight. ||31||

Gurbani: ਮਮਾ ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਕਾਜੁ ਹੈ ਮਨ ਸਾਧੇ ਸਿਧਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: mamaa man siau kaaj hai man saadhe sidh hoe |
English: MAMMA: The mortal's business is with his own mind; one who disciplines his mind attains perfection.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਮਨ ਸਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੩੨॥
Transliteration: man hee man siau kahai kabeeraa man saa miliaa na koe |32|
English: Only the mind can deal with the mind; says Kabeer, I have not met anything like the mind. ||32||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਕਤੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: eihu man sakatee ihu man seeo |
English: This mind is Shakti; this mind is Shiva.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਪੰਚ ਤਤ ਕੋ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: eihu man panch tat ko jeeo |
English: This mind is the life of the five elements.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲੇ ਜਉ ਉਨਮਨਿ ਰਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: eihu man le jau unaman rahai |
English: When this mind is channeled, and guided to enlightenment,

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਤੀਨਿ ਲੋਕ ਕੀ ਬਾਤੈ ਕਹੈ ॥੩੩॥
Transliteration: tau teen lok kee baatai kahai |33|
English: it can describe the secrets of the three worlds. ||33||

Gurbani: ਯਯਾ ਜਉ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਤਉ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਸਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਗਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: yayaa jau jaaneh tau duramat han kar bas kaaeaa gaau |
English: YAYYA: If you know anything, then destroy your evil-mindedness, and subjugate the body-village.

Gurbani: ਰਣਿ ਰੂਤਉ ਭਾਜੈ ਨਹੀ ਸੂਰਉ ਥਾਰਉ ਨਾਉ ॥੩੪॥
Transliteration: ran rootau bhaajai nahee soorau thaarau naau |34|
English: When you are engaged in the battle, don't run away; then, you shall be known as a spiritual hero. ||34||

Gurbani: ਰਾਰਾ ਰਸੁ ਨਿਰਸ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: raaraa ras niras kar jaaniaa |
English: RARRA: I have found tastes to be tasteless.

Gurbani: ਹੋਇ ਨਿਰਸ ਸੁ ਰਸੁ ਪਹਿਚਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: hoe niras su ras pahichaaniaa |
English: Becoming tasteless, I have realized that taste.

Gurbani: ਇਹ ਰਸ ਛਾਡੇ ਉਹ ਰਸੁ ਆਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: eih ras chhaadde uh ras aavaa |
English: Abandoning these tastes, I have found that taste.

Gurbani: ਉਹ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ ਇਹ ਰਸੁ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਵਾ ॥੩੫॥
Transliteration: auh ras peea ih ras nahee bhaavaa |35|
English: Drinking in that taste, this taste is no longer pleasing. ||35||

Gurbani: ਲਲਾ ਐਸੇ ਲਿਵ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: lalaa aise liv man laavai |
English: LALLA: Embrace such love for the Lord in your mind,

Gurbani: ਅਨਤ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਪਰਮ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: anat na jaae param sach paavai |
English: that you shall not have to go to any other; you shall attain the supreme truth.

Gurbani: ਅਰੁ ਜਉ ਤਹਾ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: ar jau tahaa prem liv laavai |
English: And if you embrace love and affection for Him there,

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਅਲਹ ਲਹੈ ਲਹਿ ਚਰਨ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੩੬॥
Transliteration: tau alah lahai leh charan samaavai |36|
English: then you shall obtain the Lord; obtaining Him, you shall be absorbed in His Feet. ||36||

Gurbani: ਵਵਾ ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ਬਿਸਨ ਸਮ੍ਹਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: vavaa baar baar bisan samhaar |
English: WAWA: Time and time again, dwell upon the Lord.

Gurbani: ਬਿਸਨ ਸੰਮ੍ਹਾਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: bisan samhaar na aavai haar |
English: Dwelling upon the Lord, defeat shall not come to you.

Gurbani: ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜੇ ਬਿਸਨਤਨਾ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: bal bal je bisanatanaa jas gaavai |
English: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to those, who sing the praises of the Saints, the sons of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਵਿਸਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩੭॥
Transliteration: visan mile sabh hee sach paavai |37|
English: Meeting the Lord, total Truth is obtained. ||37||

Gurbani: ਵਾਵਾ ਵਾਹੀ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਵਾ ਜਾਨੇ ਇਹੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: vaavaa vaahee jaaneeai vaa jaane ihu hoe |
English: WAWA: Know Him. By knowing Him, this mortal becomes Him.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਅਰੁ ਓਹੁ ਜਬ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਬ ਮਿਲਤ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੩੮॥
Transliteration: eihu ar ohu jab milai tab milat na jaanai koe |38|
English: When this soul and that Lord are blended, then, having been blended, they cannot be known separately. ||38||

Gurbani: ਸਸਾ ਸੋ ਨੀਕਾ ਕਰਿ ਸੋਧਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: sasaa so neekaa kar sodhahu |
English: SASSA: Discipline your mind with sublime perfection.

Gurbani: ਘਟ ਪਰਚਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ਨਿਰੋਧਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt parachaa kee baat nirodhahu |
English: Refrain from that talk which attracts the heart.

Gurbani: ਘਟ ਪਰਚੈ ਜਉ ਉਪਜੈ ਭਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt parachai jau upajai bhaau |
English: The heart is attracted, when love wells up.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਤਹ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਰਾਉ ॥੩੯॥
Transliteration: poor rahiaa teh tribhavan raau |39|
English: The King of the three worlds is perfectly pervading and permeating there. ||39||

Gurbani: ਖਖਾ ਖੋਜਿ ਪਰੈ ਜਉ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: khakhaa khoj parai jau koee |
English: KHAKHA: Anyone who seeks Him, and by seeking Him,

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਖੋਜੈ ਸੋ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jo khojai so bahur na hoee |
English: finds Him, shall not be born again.

Gurbani: ਖੋਜ ਬੂਝਿ ਜਉ ਕਰੈ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: khoj boojh jau karai beechaaraa |
English: When someone seeks Him, and comes to understand and contemplate Him,

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਭਵਜਲ ਤਰਤ ਨ ਲਾਵੈ ਬਾਰਾ ॥੪੦॥
Transliteration: tau bhavajal tarat na laavai baaraa |40|
English: then he crosses over the terrifying world-ocean in an instant. ||40||

Gurbani: ਸਸਾ ਸੋ ਸਹ ਸੇਜ ਸਵਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: sasaa so seh sej savaarai |
English: SASSA: The bed of the soul-bride is adorned by her Husband Lord;

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਸਹੀ ਸੰਦੇਹ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: soee sahee sandeh nivaarai |
English: her skepticism is dispelled.

Gurbani: ਅਲਪ ਸੁਖ ਛਾਡਿ ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: alap sukh chhaadd param sukh paavaa |
English: Renouncing the shallow pleasures of the world, she obtains the supreme delight.

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਇਹ ਤ੍ਰੀਅ ਓੁਹੁ ਕੰਤੁ ਕਹਾਵਾ ॥੪੧॥
Transliteration: tab ih treea ouhu kant kahaavaa |41|
English: Then, she is the soul-bride; He is called her Husband Lord. ||41||

Gurbani: ਹਾਹਾ ਹੋਤ ਹੋਇ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: haahaa hot hoe nahee jaanaa |
English: HAHA: He exists, but He is not known to exist.

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਹੋਇ ਤਬਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jab hee hoe tabeh man maanaa |
English: When He is known to exist, then the mind is pleased and appeased.

Gurbani: ਹੈ ਤਉ ਸਹੀ ਲਖੈ ਜਉ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: hai tau sahee lakhai jau koee |
English: Of course the Lord exists, if one could only understand Him.

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਓਹੀ ਉਹੁ ਏਹੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੪੨॥
Transliteration: tab ohee uhu ehu na hoee |42|
English: Then, He alone exists, and not this mortal being. ||42||

Gurbani: ਲਿੰਉ ਲਿੰਉ ਕਰਤ ਫਿਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: linau linau karat firai sabh log |
English: Everyone goes around saying, I'll take this, and I'll take that.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਬਹੁ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: taa kaaran biaapai bahu sog |
English: Because of that, they suffer in terrible pain.

Gurbani: ਲਖਿਮੀ ਬਰ ਸਿਉ ਜਉ ਲਿਉ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: lakhimee bar siau jau liau laavai |
English: When someone comes to love the Lord of Lakhshmi,

Gurbani: ਸੋਗੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੪੩॥
Transliteration: sog mittai sabh hee sukh paavai |43|
English: his sorrow departs, and he obtains total peace. ||43||

Gurbani: ਖਖਾ ਖਿਰਤ ਖਪਤ ਗਏ ਕੇਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: khakhaa khirat khapat ge kete |
English: KHAKHA: Many have wasted their lives, and then perished.

Gurbani: ਖਿਰਤ ਖਪਤ ਅਜਹੂੰ ਨਹ ਚੇਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: khirat khapat ajahoon neh chete |
English: Wasting away, they do not remember the Lord, even now.

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਜਗੁ ਜਾਨਿ ਜਉ ਮਨਾ ਰਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: ab jag jaan jau manaa rahai |
English: But if someone, even now, comes to know the transitory nature of the world and restrain his mind,

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਕਾ ਬਿਛੁਰਾ ਤਹ ਥਿਰੁ ਲਹੈ ॥੪੪॥
Transliteration: jeh kaa bichhuraa teh thir lahai |44|
English: he shall find his permanent home, from which he was separated. ||44||

Gurbani: ਬਾਵਨ ਅਖਰ ਜੋਰੇ ਆਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: baavan akhar jore aan |
English: The fifty-two letters have been joined together.

Gurbani: ਸਕਿਆ ਨ ਅਖਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: sakiaa na akhar ek pachhaan |
English: But people cannot recognize the One Word of God.

Gurbani: ਸਤ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਕਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: sat kaa sabad kabeeraa kahai |
English: Kabeer speaks the Shabad, the Word of Truth.

Gurbani: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਅਨਭੈ ਰਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: panddit hoe su anabhai rahai |
English: One who is a Pandit, a religious scholar, must remain fearless.

Gurbani: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਲੋਗਹ ਕਉ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: panddit logah kau biauhaar |
English: It is the business of the scholarly person to join letters.

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨਵੰਤ ਕਉ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: giaanavant kau tat beechaar |
English: The spiritual person contemplates the essence of reality.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਜੀਅ ਜੈਸੀ ਬੁਧਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai jeea jaisee budh hoee |
English: According to the wisdom within the mind,

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਾਨੈਗਾ ਸੋਈ ॥੪੫॥
Transliteration: keh kabeer jaanaigaa soee |45|
English: says Kabeer, so does one come to understand. ||45||

[Ang 343 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਥਿਤੰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਕੰੀ ॥
Transliteration: raag gaurree thitanee kabeer jee kanee |
English: Raag Gauree, T'hitee ~ The Lunar Days Of Kabeer Jee:

Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਪੰਦ੍ਰਹ ਥਿਤੰੀ ਸਾਤ ਵਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: pandrah thitanee saat vaar |
English: There are fifteen lunar days, and seven days of the week.

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਉਰਵਾਰ ਨ ਪਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: keh kabeer uravaar na paar |
English: Says Kabeer, it is neither here nor there.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਲਖੈ ਜਉ ਭੇਉ ॥
Transliteration: saadhik sidh lakhai jau bheo |
English: When the Siddhas and seekers come to know the Lord's mystery,

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aape karataa aape deo |1|
English: they themselves become the Creator; they themselves become the Divine Lord. ||1||

[Ang 343 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਥਿਤੰੀ ॥
Transliteration: thitanee |
English: T'hitee:

Gurbani: ਅੰਮਾਵਸ ਮਹਿ ਆਸ ਨਿਵਾਰਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: amaavas meh aas nivaarahu |
English: On the day of the new moon, give up your hopes.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਰਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: antarajaamee raam samaarahu |
English: Remember the Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਤ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
Transliteration: jeevat paavahu mokh duaar |
English: You shall attain the Gate of Liberation while yet alive.

Gurbani: ਅਨਭਉ ਸਬਦੁ ਤਤੁ ਨਿਜੁ ਸਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: anbhau sabad tat nij saar |1|
English: You shall come to know the Shabad, the Word of the Fearless Lord, and the essence of your own inner being. ||1||

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal gobind rang laagaa |
English: One who enshrines love for the Lotus Feet of the Lord of the Universe

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sant prasaad bhe man niramal har keeratan meh anadin jaagaa |1| rahaau |
English: - by the Grace of the Saints, her mind becomes pure; night and day, she remains awake and aware, singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪਰਿਵਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: parivaa preetam karahu beechaar |
English: On the first day of the lunar cycle, contemplate the Beloved Lord.

Gurbani: ਘਟ ਮਹਿ ਖੇਲੈ ਅਘਟ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt meh khelai aghatt apaar |
English: He is playing within the heart; He has no body - He is Infinite.

Gurbani: ਕਾਲ ਕਲਪਨਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kaal kalapanaa kade na khaae |
English: The pain of death never consumes that person

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਮਹਿ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aad purakh meh rahai samaae |2|
English: who remains absorbed in the Primal Lord God. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦੁਤੀਆ ਦੁਹ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਅੰਗ ॥
Transliteration: duteea duh kar jaanai ang |
English: On the second day of the lunar cycle, know that there are two beings within the fiber of the body.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਰਮੈ ਸਭ ਸੰਗ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa braham ramai sabh sang |
English: Maya and God are blended with everything.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਬਢੈ ਨ ਘਟਤਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: naa ohu badtai na ghattataa jaae |
English: God does not increase or decrease.

Gurbani: ਅਕੁਲ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਏਕੈ ਭਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: akul niranjan ekai bhaae |3|
English: He is unknowable and immaculate; He does not change. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਤੀਆ ਤੀਨੇ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਲਿਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: triteea teene sam kar liaavai |
English: On the third day of the lunar cycle, one who maintains his equilibrium amidst the three modes

Gurbani: ਆਨਦ ਮੂਲ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: aanad mool param pad paavai |
English: finds the source of ecstasy and the highest status.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasangat upajai bisvaas |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, faith wells up.

Gurbani: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: baahar bheetar sadaa pragaas |4|
English: Outwardly, and deep within, God's Light is always radiant. ||4||

Gurbani: ਚਉਥਹਿ ਚੰਚਲ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਗਹਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: chautheh chanchal man kau gahahu |
English: On the fourth day of the lunar cycle, restrain your fickle mind,

Gurbani: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਬਹਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh sang kabahu na bahahu |
English: and do not ever associate with sexual desire or anger.

Gurbani: ਜਲ ਥਲ ਮਾਹੇ ਆਪਹਿ ਆਪ ॥
Transliteration: jal thal maahe aapeh aap |
English: On land and sea, He Himself is in Himself.

Gurbani: ਆਪੈ ਜਪਹੁ ਆਪਨਾ ਜਾਪ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: aapai japahu aapanaa jaap |5|
English: He Himself meditates and chants His Chant. ||5||

Gurbani: ਪਾਂਚੈ ਪੰਚ ਤਤ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: paanchai panch tat bisathaar |
English: On the fifth day of the lunar cycle, the five elements expand outward.

Gurbani: ਕਨਿਕ ਕਾਮਿਨੀ ਜੁਗ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: kanik kaaminee jug biauhaar |
English: Men are occupied in the pursuit of gold and women.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਸੁਧਾ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: prem sudhaa ras peevai koe |
English: How rare are those who drink in the pure essence of the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਜਰਾ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਫੇਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: jaraa maran dukh fer na hoe |6|
English: They shall never again suffer the pains of old age and death. ||6||

Gurbani: ਛਠਿ ਖਟੁ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਛਹੂੰ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: chhatth khatt chakr chhahoon dis dhaae |
English: On the sixth day of the lunar cycle, the six chakras run in six directions.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਪਰਚੈ ਨਹੀ ਥਿਰਾ ਰਹਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin parachai nahee thiraa rahaae |
English: Without enlightenment, the body does not remain steady.

Gurbani: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮੇਟਿ ਖਿਮਾ ਗਹਿ ਰਹਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: dubidhaa mett khimaa geh rahahu |
English: So erase your duality and hold tight to forgiveness,

Gurbani: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਕੀ ਸੂਲ ਨ ਸਹਹੁ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: karam dharam kee sool na sahahu |7|
English: and you will not have to endure the torture of karma or religious rituals. ||7||

Gurbani: ਸਾਤੈਂ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਾਚਾ ਜਾਣਿ ॥
Transliteration: saatain sat kar baachaa jaan |
English: On the seventh day of the lunar cycle, know the Word as True,

Gurbani: ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਲੇਹੁ ਪਰਵਾਣਿ ॥
Transliteration: aatam raam lehu paravaan |
English: and you shall be accepted by the Lord, the Supreme Soul.

Gurbani: ਛੂਟੈ ਸੰਸਾ ਮਿਟਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਦੁਖ ॥
Transliteration: chhoottai sansaa mitt jaeh dukh |
English: Your doubts shall be eradicated, and your pains eliminated,

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਨ ਸਰੋਵਰਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸੁਖ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: sun sarovar paavahu sukh |8|
English: and in the ocean of the celestial void, you shall find peace. ||8||

Gurbani: ਅਸਟਮੀ ਅਸਟ ਧਾਤੁ ਕੀ ਕਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: asattamee asatt dhaat kee kaaeaa |
English: On the eighth day of the lunar cycle, the body is made of the eight ingredients.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਅਕੁਲ ਮਹਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: taa meh akul mahaa nidh raaeaa |
English: Within it is the Unknowable Lord, the King of the supreme treasure.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਗਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਬਤਾਵੈ ਭੇਦ ॥
Transliteration: gur gam giaan bataavai bhed |
English: The Guru, who knows this spiritual wisdom, reveals the secret of this mystery.

Gurbani: ਉਲਟਾ ਰਹੈ ਅਭੰਗ ਅਛੇਦ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: aulattaa rahai abhang achhed |9|
English: Turning away from the world, He abides in the Unbreakable and Impenetrable Lord. ||9||

Gurbani: ਨਉਮੀ ਨਵੈ ਦੁਆਰ ਕਉ ਸਾਧਿ ॥
Transliteration: naumee navai duaar kau saadh |
English: On the ninth day of the lunar cycle, discipline the nine gates of the body.

Gurbani: ਬਹਤੀ ਮਨਸਾ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਬਾਂਧਿ ॥
Transliteration: bahatee manasaa raakhahu baandh |
English: Keep your pulsating desires restrained.

Gurbani: ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਸਭ ਬੀਸਰਿ ਜਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: lobh moh sabh beesar jaahu |
English: Forget all your greed and emotional attachment;

Gurbani: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੀਵਹੁ ਅਮਰ ਫਲ ਖਾਹੁ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: jug jug jeevahu amar fal khaahu |10|
English: you shall live throughout the ages, eating the fruit of immortality. ||10||

Gurbani: ਦਸਮੀ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: dasamee deh dis hoe anand |
English: On the tenth day of the lunar cycle, there is ecstasy in all directions.

Gurbani: ਛੂਟੈ ਭਰਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: chhoottai bharam milai gobind |
English: Doubt is dispelled, and the Lord of the Universe is met.

Gurbani: ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੀ ਤਤ ਅਨੂਪ ॥
Transliteration: jot saroopee tat anoop |
English: He is the Embodiment of light, the incomparable essence.

Gurbani: ਅਮਲ ਨ ਮਲ ਨ ਛਾਹ ਨਹੀ ਧੂਪ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: amal na mal na chhaah nahee dhoop |11|
English: He is stainless, without stain, beyond both sunshine and shade. ||11||

Gurbani: ਏਕਾਦਸੀ ਏਕ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: ekaadasee ek dis dhaavai |
English: On the eleventh day of the lunar cycle, if you run in the direction of the One,

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਜੋਨੀ ਸੰਕਟ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: tau jonee sankatt bahur na aavai |
English: you will not have to suffer the pains of reincarnation again.

Gurbani: ਸੀਤਲ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਭਇਆ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: seetal niramal bheaa sareeraa |
English: Your body will become cool, immaculate and pure.

Gurbani: ਦੂਰਿ ਬਤਾਵਤ ਪਾਇਆ ਨੀਰਾ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: door bataavat paaeaa neeraa |12|
English: The Lord was said to be far away, but He is found near at hand. ||12||

Gurbani: ਬਾਰਸਿ ਬਾਰਹ ਉਗਵੈ ਸੂਰ ॥
Transliteration: baaras baarah ugavai soor |
English: On the twelfth day of the lunar cycle, twelve suns rise.

Gurbani: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਤੂਰ ॥
Transliteration: ahinis baaje anahad toor |
English: Day and night, the celestial bugles vibrate the unstruck melody.

Gurbani: ਦੇਖਿਆ ਤਿਹੂੰ ਲੋਕ ਕਾ ਪੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: dekhiaa tihoon lok kaa peeo |
English: Then, one beholds the Father of the three worlds.

Gurbani: ਅਚਰਜੁ ਭਇਆ ਜੀਵ ਤੇ ਸੀਉ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: acharaj bheaa jeev te seeo |13|
English: This is wonderful! The human being has become God! ||13||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਸਿ ਤੇਰਹ ਅਗਮ ਬਖਾਣਿ ॥
Transliteration: teras terah agam bakhaan |
English: On the thirteenth day of the lunar cycle, the thirteen holy books proclaim

Gurbani: ਅਰਧ ਉਰਧ ਬਿਚਿ ਸਮ ਪਹਿਚਾਣਿ ॥
Transliteration: aradh uradh bich sam pahichaan |
English: that you must recognize the Lord in the nether regions of the underworld as well as the heavens.

Gurbani: ਨੀਚ ਊਚ ਨਹੀ ਮਾਨ ਅਮਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: neech aooch nahee maan amaan |
English: There is no high or low, no honor or dishonor.

Gurbani: ਬਿਆਪਿਕ ਰਾਮ ਸਗਲ ਸਾਮਾਨ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: biaapik raam sagal saamaan |14|
English: The Lord is pervading and permeating all. ||14||

Gurbani: ਚਉਦਸਿ ਚਉਦਹ ਲੋਕ ਮਝਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: chaudas chaudah lok majhaar |
English: On the fourteenth day of the lunar cycle, in the fourteen worlds

Gurbani: ਰੋਮ ਰੋਮ ਮਹਿ ਬਸਹਿ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: rom rom meh baseh muraar |
English: and on each and every hair, the Lord abides.

Gurbani: ਸਤ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਕਾ ਧਰਹੁ ਧਿਆਨ ॥
Transliteration: sat santokh kaa dharahu dhiaan |
English: Center yourself and meditate on truth and contentment.

Gurbani: ਕਥਨੀ ਕਥੀਐ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: kathanee katheeai braham giaan |15|
English: Speak the speech of God's spiritual wisdom. ||15||

Gurbani: ਪੂਨਿਉ ਪੂਰਾ ਚੰਦ ਅਕਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: pooniau pooraa chand akaas |
English: On the day of the full moon, the full moon fills the heavens.

Gurbani: ਪਸਰਹਿ ਕਲਾ ਸਹਜ ਪਰਗਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: pasareh kalaa sehaj paragaas |
English: Its power is diffused through its gentle light.

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਮਧਿ ਹੋਇ ਰਹਿਆ ਥੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: aad ant madh hoe rahiaa theer |
English: In the beginning, in the end, and in the middle, God remains firm and steady.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਰਮਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: sukh saagar meh rameh kabeer |16|
English: Kabeer is immersed in the ocean of peace. ||16||

[Ang 344 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਵਾਰ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ ੭ ॥
Transliteration: raag gaurree vaar kabeer jeeo ke 7 |
English: Raag Gauree, The Seven Days Of The Week Of Kabeer Jee:

Gurbani: ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: baar baar har ke gun gaavau |
English: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord each and every day.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਗਮਿ ਭੇਦੁ ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur gam bhed su har kaa paavau |1| rahaau |
English: Meeting with the Guru, you shall come to know the mystery of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਦਿਤ ਕਰੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਆਰੰਭ ॥
Transliteration: aadit karai bhagat aaranbh |
English: On Sunday, begin the devotional worship of the Lord,

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਨਸਾ ਥੰਭ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa mandar manasaa thanbh |
English: and restrain the desires within the temple of the body.

Gurbani: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਅਖੰਡ ਸੁਰਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: ahinis akhandd surahee jaae |
English: When your attention is focused day and night upon that imperishable place,

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਅਨਹਦ ਬੇਣੁ ਸਹਜ ਮਹਿ ਬਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tau anahad ben sehaj meh baae |1|
English: then the celestial flutes play the unstruck melody in tranquil peace and poise. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੋਮਵਾਰਿ ਸਸਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਝਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: somavaar sas amrit jharai |
English: On Monday, the Ambrosial Nectar trickles down from the moon.

Gurbani: ਚਾਖਤ ਬੇਗਿ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਖ ਹਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: chaakhat beg sagal bikh harai |
English: Tasting it, all poisons are removed in an instant.

Gurbani: ਬਾਣੀ ਰੋਕਿਆ ਰਹੈ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
Transliteration: baanee rokiaa rahai duaar |
English: Restrained by Gurbani, the mind remains indoors;

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਤਵਾਰੋ ਪੀਵਨਹਾਰ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tau man matavaaro peevanahaar |2|
English: drinking in this Nectar, it is intoxicated. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮੰਗਲਵਾਰੇ ਲੇ ਮਾਹੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: mangalavaare le maaheet |
English: On Tuesday, understand reality;

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਕੀ ਜਾਣੈ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: panch chor kee jaanai reet |
English: you must know the way the five thieves work.

Gurbani: ਘਰ ਛੋਡੇਂ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: ghar chhodden baahar jin jaae |
English: Those who leave their own home to go out wandering

Gurbani: ਨਾਤਰੁ ਖਰਾ ਰਿਸੈ ਹੈ ਰਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naatar kharaa risai hai raae |3|
English: shall feel the terrible wrath of the Lord, their King. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬੁਧਵਾਰਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਕਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: budhavaar budh karai pragaas |
English: On Wednesday, one's understanding is enlightened.

Gurbani: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਮਲ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਬਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: hiradai kamal meh har kaa baas |
English: The Lord comes to dwell in the lotus of the heart.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਦੋਊ ਏਕ ਸਮ ਧਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur mil doaoo ek sam dharai |
English: Meeting the Guru, one comes to look alike upon pleasure and pain,

Gurbani: ਉਰਧ ਪੰਕ ਲੈ ਸੂਧਾ ਕਰੈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: auradh pank lai soodhaa karai |4|
English: and the inverted lotus is turned upright. ||4||

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਿਹਸਪਤਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਦੇਇ ਬਹਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: brihasapat bikhiaa dee bahaae |
English: On Thursday, wash off your corruption.

Gurbani: ਤੀਨਿ ਦੇਵ ਏਕ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: teen dev ek sang laae |
English: Forsake the trinity, and attach yourself to the One God.

Gurbani: ਤੀਨਿ ਨਦੀ ਤਹ ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: teen nadee teh trikuttee maeh |
English: At the confluence of the three rivers of knowledge, right action and devotion, there,

Gurbani: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਕਸਮਲ ਧੋਵਹਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: ahinis kasamal dhoveh naeh |5|
English: why not wash away your sinful mistakes? ||5||

Gurbani: ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਹਾਰੈ ਸੁ ਇਹ ਬ੍ਰਤਿ ਚੜੈ ॥
Transliteration: sukrit sahaarai su ih brat charrai |
English: On Friday, keep up and complete your fast;

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨ ਆਪਿ ਆਪ ਸਿਉ ਲੜੈ ॥
Transliteration: anadin aap aap siau larrai |
English: day and night, you must fight against your own self.

Gurbani: ਸੁਰਖੀ ਪਾਂਚਉ ਰਾਖੈ ਸਬੈ ॥
Transliteration: surakhee paanchau raakhai sabai |
English: If you restrain your five senses,

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਦੂਜੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨ ਪੈਸੈ ਕਬੈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: tau doojee drisatt na paisai kabai |6|
English: then you shall not cast your glance on another. ||6||

Gurbani: ਥਾਵਰ ਥਿਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: thaavar thir kar raakhai soe |
English: On Saturday, keep the candle of God's Light

Gurbani: ਜੋਤਿ ਦੀ ਵਟੀ ਘਟ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jot dee vattee ghatt meh joe |
English: Steady within your heart;

Gurbani: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਭਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: baahar bheetar bheaa pragaas |
English: you will be enlightened, inwardly and outwardly.

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਹੂਆ ਸਗਲ ਕਰਮ ਕਾ ਨਾਸੁ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: tab hooaa sagal karam kaa naas |7|
English: All your karma will be erased. ||7||

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਘਟ ਮਹਿ ਦੂਜੀ ਆਨ ॥
Transliteration: jab lag ghatt meh doojee aan |
English: Know that as long as you place your hopes in others,

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਲਉ ਮਹਲਿ ਨ ਲਾਭੈ ਜਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: tau lau mehal na laabhai jaan |
English: you shall not find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

Gurbani: ਰਮਤ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੋ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: ramat raam siau laago rang |
English: When you embrace love for the Lord,

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਤਬ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਅੰਗ ॥੮॥੧॥
Transliteration: keh kabeer tab niramal ang |8|1|
English: says Kabeer, then, you shall become pure in your very fiber. ||8||1||

[Ang 345 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Namdev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਚੇਤੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: raag gaurree chetee baanee naamadeo jeeo kee |
English: Raag Gauree Chaytee, The Word Of Naam Dayv Jee:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਦੇਵਾ ਪਾਹਨ ਤਾਰੀਅਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: devaa paahan taareeale |
English: God makes even stones float.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਕਹਤ ਜਨ ਕਸ ਨ ਤਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raam kehat jan kas na tare |1| rahaau |
English: So why shouldn't Your humble slave also float across, chanting Your Name, O Lord? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤਾਰੀਲੇ ਗਨਿਕਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਰੂਪ ਕੁਬਿਜਾ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਅਜਾਮਲੁ ਤਾਰੀਅਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: taareele ganikaa bin roop kubijaa biaadh ajaamal taareeale |
English: You saved the prostitute, and the ugly hunch-back; You helped the hunter and Ajaamal swim across as well.

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਬਧਿਕ ਜਨ ਤੇਊ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਏ ॥
Transliteration: charan badhik jan teaoo mukat bhe |
English: The hunter who shot Krishna in the foot - even he was liberated.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਿਨ ਰਾਮ ਕਹੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: hau bal bal jin raam kahe |1|
English: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to those who chant the Lord's Name. ||1||

Gurbani: ਦਾਸੀ ਸੁਤ ਜਨੁ ਬਿਦਰੁ ਸੁਦਾਮਾ ਉਗ੍ਰਸੈਨ ਕਉ ਰਾਜ ਦੀਏ ॥
Transliteration: daasee sut jan bidar sudaamaa ugrasain kau raaj dee |
English: You saved Bidur, the son of the slave-girl, and Sudama; You restored Ugrasain to his throne.

Gurbani: ਜਪ ਹੀਨ ਤਪ ਹੀਨ ਕੁਲ ਹੀਨ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਹੀਨ ਨਾਮੇ ਕੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੇਊ ਤਰੇ ॥੨॥੧॥
Transliteration: jap heen tap heen kul heen kram heen naame ke suaamee teaoo tare |2|1|
English: Without meditation, without penance, without a good family, without good deeds, Naam Dayv's Lord and Master saved them all. ||2||1||

[Ang 345 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Ravidas Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਕੇ ਪਦੇ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: raag gaurree ravidaas jee ke pade gaurree guaareree |
English: Raag Gauree, Padhay Of Ravi Daas Jee, Gauree Gwaarayree:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar sat naam karataa purakh gur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru's Grace:

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪੋਚ ਸੋਚ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: meree sangat poch soch din raatee |
English: The company I keep is wretched and low, and I am anxious day and night;

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਮੁ ਕੁਟਿਲਤਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਕੁਭਾਂਤੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: meraa karam kuttilataa janam kubhaantee |1|
English: my actions are crooked, and I am of lowly birth. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਗੁਸਈਆ ਜੀਅ ਕੇ ਜੀਵਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: raam guseea jeea ke jeevanaa |
English: O Lord, Master of the earth, Life of the soul,

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਨ ਬਿਸਾਰਹੁ ਮੈ ਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mohi na bisaarahu mai jan teraa |1| rahaau |
English: please do not forget me! I am Your humble servant. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੀ ਹਰਹੁ ਬਿਪਤਿ ਜਨ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: meree harahu bipat jan karahu subhaaee |
English: Take away my pains, and bless Your humble servant with Your Sublime Love.

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਨ ਛਾਡਉ ਸਰੀਰ ਕਲ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: charan na chhaaddau sareer kal jaaee |2|
English: I shall not leave Your Feet, even though my body may perish. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਪਰਉ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਾਭਾ ॥
Transliteration: kahu ravidaas prau teree saabhaa |
English: Says Ravi Daas, I seek the protection of Your Sanctuary;

Gurbani: ਬੇਗਿ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਜਨ ਕਰਿ ਨ ਬਿਲਾਂਬਾ ॥੩॥੧॥
Transliteration: beg milahu jan kar na bilaanbaa |3|1|
English: please, meet Your humble servant - do not delay! ||3||1||

Gurbani: ਬੇਗਮ ਪੁਰਾ ਸਹਰ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: begam puraa sehar ko naau |
English: Baygumpura, 'the city without sorrow', is the name of the town.

Gurbani: ਦੂਖੁ ਅੰਦੋਹੁ ਨਹੀ ਤਿਹਿ ਠਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dookh andohu nahee tihi tthaau |
English: There is no suffering or anxiety there.

Gurbani: ਨਾਂ ਤਸਵੀਸ ਖਿਰਾਜੁ ਨ ਮਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: naan tasavees khiraaj na maal |
English: There are no troubles or taxes on commodities there.

Gurbani: ਖਉਫੁ ਨ ਖਤਾ ਨ ਤਰਸੁ ਜਵਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: khauf na khataa na taras javaal |1|
English: There is no fear, blemish or downfall there. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਖੂਬ ਵਤਨ ਗਹ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ab mohi khoob vatan geh paaee |
English: Now, I have found this most excellent city.

Gurbani: ਊਹਾਂ ਖੈਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aoohaan khair sadaa mere bhaaee |1| rahaau |
English: There is lasting peace and safety there, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਮੁ ਦਾਇਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeim daaeim sadaa paatisaahee |
English: God's Kingdom is steady, stable and eternal.

Gurbani: ਦੋਮ ਨ ਸੇਮ ਏਕ ਸੋ ਆਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: dom na sem ek so aahee |
English: There is no second or third status; all are equal there.

Gurbani: ਆਬਾਦਾਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਸਹੂਰ ॥
Transliteration: aabaadaan sadaa masahoor |
English: That city is populous and eternally famous.

Gurbani: ਊਹਾਂ ਗਨੀ ਬਸਹਿ ਮਾਮੂਰ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aoohaan ganee baseh maamoor |2|
English: Those who live there are wealthy and contented. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤਿਉ ਤਿਉ ਸੈਲ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: tiau tiau sail kareh jiau bhaavai |
English: They stroll about freely, just as they please.

Gurbani: ਮਹਰਮ ਮਹਲ ਨ ਕੋ ਅਟਕਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: maharam mehal na ko attakaavai |
English: They know the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and no one blocks their way.

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਖਲਾਸ ਚਮਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: keh ravidaas khalaas chamaaraa |
English: Says Ravi Daas, the emancipated shoe-maker:

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਹਮ ਸਹਰੀ ਸੁ ਮੀਤੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੩॥੨॥
Transliteration: jo ham saharee su meet hamaaraa |3|2|
English: whoever is a citizen there, is a friend of mine. ||3||2||

[Ang 345 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Ravidas Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree bairaagan ravidaas jeeo |
English: Gauree Bairaagan, Ravi Daas Jee:

Gurbani: ਘਟ ਅਵਘਟ ਡੂਗਰ ਘਣਾ ਇਕੁ ਨਿਰਗੁਣੁ ਬੈਲੁ ਹਮਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt avaghatt ddoogar ghanaa ik niragun bail hamaar |
English: The path to God is very treacherous and mountainous, and all I have is this worthless ox.

Gurbani: ਰਮਈਏ ਸਿਉ ਇਕ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਰਾਖੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: rameee siau ik benatee meree poonjee raakh muraar |1|
English: I offer this one prayer to the Lord, to preserve my capital. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕੋ ਬਨਜਾਰੋ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਟਾਂਡਾ ਲਾਦਿਆ ਜਾਇ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ko banajaaro raam ko meraa ttaanddaa laadiaa jaae re |1| rahaau |
English: Is there any merchant of the Lord to join me? My cargo is loaded, and now I am leaving. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਬਨਜਾਰੋ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਸਹਜ ਕਰਉ ਬੵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: hau banajaaro raam ko sehaj krau bayaapaar |
English: I am the merchant of the Lord; I deal in spiritual wisdom.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਲਾਦਿਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਲਾਦੀ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mai raam naam dhan laadiaa bikh laadee sansaar |2|
English: I have loaded the Wealth of the Lord's Name; the world has loaded poison. ||2||

Gurbani: ਉਰਵਾਰ ਪਾਰ ਕੇ ਦਾਨੀਆ ਲਿਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਆਲ ਪਤਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: auravaar paar ke daaneea likh lehu aal pataal |
English: O you who know this world and the world beyond: write whatever nonsense you please about me.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਨ ਲਾਗਈ ਤਜੀਲੇ ਸਰਬ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: mohi jam ddandd na laagee tajeele sarab janjaal |3|
English: The club of the Messenger of Death shall not strike me, since I have cast off all entanglements. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੈਸਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਕਾ ਤੈਸਾ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jaisaa rang kasunbh kaa taisaa ihu sansaar |
English: Love of this world is like the pale, temporary color of the safflower.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਮਈਏ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਜੀਠ ਕਾ ਕਹੁ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਚਮਾਰ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: mere rameee rang majeetth kaa kahu ravidaas chamaar |4|1|
English: The color of my Lord's Love, however, is permanent, like the dye of the madder plant. So says Ravi Daas, the tanner. ||4||1||

[Ang 346 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Ravidas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree poorabee ravidaas jeeo |
English: Gauree Poorbee, Ravi Daas Jee:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਕੂਪੁ ਭਰਿਓ ਜੈਸੇ ਦਾਦਿਰਾ ਕਛੁ ਦੇਸੁ ਬਿਦੇਸੁ ਨ ਬੂਝ ॥
Transliteration: koop bhario jaise daadiraa kachh des bides na boojh |
English: The frog in the deep well knows nothing of its own country or other lands;

Gurbani: ਐਸੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਮੋਹਿਆ ਕਛੁ ਆਰਾ ਪਾਰੁ ਨ ਸੂਝ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aise meraa man bikhiaa bimohiaa kachh aaraa paar na soojh |1|
English: just so, my mind, infatuated with corruption, understands nothing about this world or the next. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਕੇ ਨਾਇਕਾ ਇਕੁ ਛਿਨੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਇ ਜੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sagal bhavan ke naaeikaa ik chhin daras dikhaae jee |1| rahaau |
English: O Lord of all worlds: reveal to me, even for an instant, the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਲਿਨ ਭਈ ਮਤਿ ਮਾਧਵਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਲਖੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: malin bhee mat maadhavaa teree gat lakhee na jaae |
English: My intellect is polluted; I cannot understand Your state, O Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਚੂਕਈ ਮੈ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: karahu kripaa bhram chookee mai sumat dehu samajhaae |2|
English: Take pity on me, dispel my doubts, and teach me true wisdom. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੋਗੀਸਰ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਨਹੀ ਤੁਅ ਗੁਣ ਕਥਨੁ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: jogeesar paaveh nahee tua gun kathan apaar |
English: Even the great Yogis cannot describe Your Glorious Virtues; they are beyond words.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਕਾਰਣੈ ਕਹੁ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਚਮਾਰ ॥੩॥੧॥
Transliteration: prem bhagat kai kaaranai kahu ravidaas chamaar |3|1|
English: I am dedicated to Your loving devotional worship, says Ravi Daas the tanner. ||3||1||

[Ang 346 | Raag: Raag Gauree | Author: Bhagat Ravidas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ॥
Transliteration: gaurree bairaagan |
English: Gauree Bairaagan:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸਤਜੁਗਿ ਸਤੁ ਤੇਤਾ ਜਗੀ ਦੁਆਪਰਿ ਪੂਜਾਚਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: satajug sat tetaa jagee duaapar poojaachaar |
English: In the Golden Age of Sat Yuga, was Truth; in the Silver Age of Trayta Yuga, charitable feasts; in the Brass Age of Dwaapar Yuga, there was worship.

Gurbani: ਤੀਨੌ ਜੁਗ ਤੀਨੌ ਦਿੜੇ ਕਲਿ ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: teenau jug teenau dirre kal keval naam adhaar |1|
English: In those three ages, people held to these three ways. But in the Iron Age of Kali Yuga, the Name of the Lord is your only Support. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪਾਰੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਪਾਇਬੋ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: paar kaise paaeibo re |
English: How can I swim across?

Gurbani: ਮੋ ਸਉ ਕੋਊ ਨ ਕਹੈ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: mo sau koaoo na kahai samajhaae |
English: No one has explained to me,

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਆਵਾ ਗਵਨੁ ਬਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaa te aavaa gavan bilaae |1| rahaau |
English: so that I might understand how I can escape reincarnation. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਧਰਮ ਨਿਰੂਪੀਐ ਕਰਤਾ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਭ ਲੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bahu bidh dharam niroopeeai karataa deesai sabh loe |
English: So many forms of religion have been described; the whole world is practicing them.

Gurbani: ਕਵਨ ਕਰਮ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਜਿਹ ਸਾਧੇ ਸਭ ਸਿਧਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kavan karam te chhootteeai jih saadhe sabh sidh hoe |2|
English: What actions will bring emancipation, and total perfection? ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਰਮ ਅਕਰਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਸੰਕਾ ਸੁਨਿ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: karam akaram beechaareeai sankaa sun bed puraan |
English: One may distinguish between good and evil actions, and listen to the Vedas and the Puraanas,

Gurbani: ਸੰਸਾ ਸਦ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਸੈ ਕਉਨੁ ਹਿਰੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sansaa sad hiradai basai kaun hirai abhimaan |3|
English: but doubt still persists. Skepticism continually dwells in the heart, so who can eradicate egotistical pride? ||3||

Gurbani: ਬਾਹਰੁ ਉਦਕਿ ਪਖਾਰੀਐ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਬਿਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: baahar udak pakhaareeai ghatt bheetar bibidh bikaar |
English: Outwardly, he washes with water, but deep within, his heart is tarnished by all sorts of vices.

Gurbani: ਸੁਧ ਕਵਨ ਪਰ ਹੋਇਬੋ ਸੁਚ ਕੁੰਚਰ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: sudh kavan par hoeibo such kunchar bidh biauhaar |4|
English: So how can he become pure? His method of purification is like that of an elephant, covering himself with dust right after his bath! ||4||

Gurbani: ਰਵਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਰਜਨੀ ਜਥਾ ਗਤਿ ਜਾਨਤ ਸਭ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: rav pragaas rajanee jathaa gat jaanat sabh sansaar |
English: With the rising of the sun, the night is brought to its end; the whole world knows this.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਸ ਮਾਨੋ ਤਾਬੋ ਛੁਏ ਕਨਕ ਹੋਤ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਰ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: paaras maano taabo chhue kanak hot nahee baar |5|
English: It is believed that with the touch of the Philosopher's Stone, copper is immediately transformed into gold. ||5||

Gurbani: ਪਰਮ ਪਰਸ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਪੂਰਬ ਲਿਖਤ ਲਿਲਾਟ ॥
Transliteration: param paras gur bhetteeai poorab likhat lilaatt |
English: When one meets the Supreme Philosopher's Stone, the Guru, if such pre-ordained destiny is written on one's forehead,

Gurbani: ਉਨਮਨ ਮਨ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਿਲੇ ਛੁਟਕਤ ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: aunaman man man hee mile chhuttakat bajar kapaatt |6|
English: then the soul blends with the Supreme Soul, and the stubborn doors are opened wide. ||6||

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat jugat mat sat karee bhram bandhan kaatt bikaar |
English: Through the way of devotion, the intellect is imbued with Truth; doubts, entanglements and vices are cut away.

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਬਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਮਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਨ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਏਕ ਬਿਚਾਰ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: soee bas ras man mile gun niragun ek bichaar |7|
English: The mind is restrained, and one attains joy, contemplating the One Lord, who is both with and without qualities. ||7||

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹ ਕੀਏ ਟਾਰੀ ਨ ਟਰੈ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਫਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: anik jatan nigrah kee ttaaree na ttarai bhram faas |
English: I have tried many methods, but by turning it away, the noose of doubt is not turned away.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਊਪਜੈ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਉਦਾਸ ॥੮॥੧॥
Transliteration: prem bhagat nahee aoopajai taa te ravidaas udaas |8|1|
English: Love and devotion have not welled up within me, and so Ravi Daas is sad and depressed. ||8||1||

[Ang 347 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirbhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibhan gur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: raag aasaa mahalaa 1 ghar 1 so dar |
English: Raag Aasaa, First Mehl, First House, So Dar ~ That Gate:

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੇਹਾ ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਬਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: so dar teraa kehaa so ghar kehaa jit beh sarab samaale |
English: What is that Gate, and what is that Home, in which You sit and take care of all?

Gurbani: ਵਾਜੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਦ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਸੰਖਾ ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਵਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: vaaje tere naad anek asankhaa kete tere vaavanahaare |
English: Countless musical instruments of so many various kinds vibrate there for You; so many are the musicians there for You.

Gurbani: ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਰਾਗ ਪਰੀ ਸਿਉ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਗਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kete tere raag paree siau kaheeeh kete tere gaavanahaare |
English: There are so many Ragas there for You, along with their accompanying harmonies; so many minstrels sing to You.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਨਿੑ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਰਾਜਾ ਧਰਮ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gaavana tudhano paun paanee baisantar gaavai raajaa dharam duaare |
English: The winds sing to You, as do water and fire; the Righteous Judge of Dharma sings at Your Door.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਨਿੑ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਚਿਤੁ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਲਿਖਿ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਧਰਮੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gaavana tudhano chit gupat likh jaanan likh likh dharam veechaare |
English: Chitar and Gupat, the recording angels of the conscious and the subconscious, sing to You; they know, and they write, and on the basis of what they write, the Lord of Dharma passes judgement.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਨਿੑ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਈਸਰੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਦੇਵੀ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gaavana tudhano eesar brahamaa devee sohan tere sadaa savaare |
English: Shiva and Brahma and the Goddess Parvaati, so beautiful and ever adorned by You, sing to You.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਨਿੑ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਸਣਿ ਬੈਠੇ ਦੇਵਤਿਆ ਦਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: gaavana tudhano indr indraasan baitthe devatiaa dar naale |
English: The Indras, seated upon their celestial thrones, with the deities at Your Gate, sing to You.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਨਿੑ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਗਾਵਨਿੑ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਸਾਧ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gaavana tudhano sidh samaadhee andar gaavana tudhano saadh beechaare |
English: The Siddhas in Samaadhi sing to You, and the Holy Saints, in their contemplative meditation, sing to You.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਨਿੑ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਵੀਰ ਕਰਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gaavana tudhano jatee satee santokhee gaavan tudhano veer karaare |
English: The celibates, the truthful and the patient beings sing to You, and the mighty warriors sing to You.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜੇ ਰਖੀਸੁਰ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਬੇਦਾ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: gaavan tudhano panddit parre rakheesur jug jug bedaa naale |
English: The scholarly Pandits sing to You, along with the holy Rishis and the readers of the Vedas throughout the ages.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਮੋਹਣੀਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਨਿ ਸੁਰਗੁ ਮਛੁ ਪਇਆਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: gaavan tudhano mohaneea man mohan surag machh peaale |
English: The Mohinis, the heavenly beauties who entice the heart in paradise, in this world and in the nether regions, sing to You.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਨਿੑ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਰਤਨ ਉਪਾਏ ਤੇਰੇ ਜੇਤੇ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: gaavana tudhano ratan upaae tere jete atthasatth teerath naale |
English: The fourteen priceless jewels created by You, and the sixty-eight holy places of pilgrimage, sing to You.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਨਿੑ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਜੋਧ ਮਹਾਬਲ ਸੂਰਾ ਗਾਵਨਿੑ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਖਾਣੀ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gaavana tudhano jodh mahaabal sooraa gaavana tudhano khaanee chaare |
English: The mighty warriors and the divine heroes sing to You, and the four sources of creation sing to You.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਨਿੑ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਖੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gaavana tudhano khandd manddal brahamanddaa kar kar rakhe tere dhaare |
English: The continents, the worlds and the solar systems, created and installed by Your Hand, sing to You.

Gurbani: ਸੇਈ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਗਾਵਨਿੑ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਨਿੑ ਰਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਰਸਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: seee tudhano gaavana jo tudh bhaavana rate tere bhagat rasaale |
English: They alone sing to You, who are pleasing to Your Will, and who are imbued with the nectar of Your devotional worship.

Gurbani: ਹੋਰਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਸੇ ਮੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਨਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਿਆ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: hor kete tudhano gaavan se mai chit na aavan naanak kiaa beechaare |
English: So many others sing to You, they do not come into my mind; how can Nanak think of them?

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: soee soee sadaa sach saahib saachaa saachee naaee |
English: That Lord and Master - He is True, forever True; He is True, and True is His Name.

Gurbani: ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਜਾਸੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: hai bhee hosee jaae na jaasee rachanaa jin rachaaee |
English: He who created the creation is True, and He shall always be True; He shall not depart, even when the creation departs.

Gurbani: ਰੰਗੀ ਰੰਗੀ ਭਾਤੀ ਜਿਨਸੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: rangee rangee bhaatee jinasee maaeaa jin upaaee |
English: He created the world of Maya with its various colors and species.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਕੀਤਾ ਅਪਣਾ ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: kar kar dekhai keetaa apanaa jiau tis dee vaddiaaee |
English: Having created the creation, He Himself watches over it, as it pleases His Greatness.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਸੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jo tis bhaavai soee karasee fir hukam na karanaa jaaee |
English: Whatever pleases Him, that is what He does. No one can issue any commands to Him.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਤਿ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਹਣੁ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੧॥੧॥
Transliteration: so paatisaahu saahaa pat saahib naanak rehan rajaaee |1|1|
English: He is the King, the King of Kings, the Emperor of Kings! Nanak lives in surrender to His Will. ||1||1||

[Ang 348 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 |
English: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: so purakh niranjan har purakh niranjan har agamaa agam apaaraa |
English: That Lord is Immaculate; the Lord God is Immaculate. The Lord is Unapproachable, Unfathomable and Incomparable.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabh dhiaaveh sabh dhiaaveh tudh jee har sache sirajanahaaraa |
English: All meditate, all meditate on You, O Dear Lord, O True Creator.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਜੀ ਤੂੰ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabh jeea tumaare jee toon jeea kaa daataaraa |
English: All beings are Yours; You are the Giver of all beings.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਜੀ ਸਭਿ ਦੂਖ ਵਿਸਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har dhiaavahu santahu jee sabh dookh visaaranahaaraa |
English: So meditate on the Lord, O Saints; He is the One who takes away all pain.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜੀ ਕਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har aape tthaakur har aape sevak jee kiaa naanak jant vichaaraa |1|
English: The Lord Himself is the Master, and He Himself is His own servant. O Nanak, how insignificant are mortal beings! ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: toon ghatt ghatt antar sarab nirantar jee har eko purakh samaanaa |
English: You are totally pervading within each and every heart; O Lord, You are the One Primal Being, All-permeating.

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਦਾਤੇ ਇਕਿ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ਜੀ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: eik daate ik bhekhaaree jee sabh tere choj viddaanaa |
English: Some are givers, and some are beggars; all of this is Your wondrous play!

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਦਾਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਜੀ ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: toon aape daataa aape bhugataa jee hau tudh bin avar na jaanaa |
English: You Yourself are the Giver, and You Yourself are the Enjoyer. I know of no other than You.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਜੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: toon paarabraham beant beant jee tere kiaa gun aakh vakhaanaa |
English: You are the Supreme Lord God, Infinite and Eternal; what Glorious Praises of Yours should I speak and chant?

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਜੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨੑ ਕੁਰਬਾਣਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jo seveh jo seveh tudh jee jan naanak tina kurabaanaa |2|
English: Unto those who serve, unto those who serve You, slave Nanak is a sacrifice. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਸੁਖ ਵਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: har dhiaaveh har dhiaaveh tudh jee se jan jug meh sukh vaasee |
English: Those who meditate on the Lord, those who meditate on You, O Dear Lord, those humble beings dwell in peace in this world.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਸੇ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਭਏ ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜੀਉ ਤਿਨ ਟੂਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: se mukat se mukat bhe jina har dhiaaeaa jeeo tin ttoottee jam kee faasee |
English: They are liberated, they are liberated, who meditate on the Lord; the noose of Death is cut away from them.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜੀਉ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਸਭੁ ਗਵਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: jin nirbhau jina har nirbhau dhiaaeaa jeeo tin kaa bhau sabh gavaasee |
English: Those who meditate on the Fearless One, on the Fearless Lord, all their fears are dispelled.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਜਿਨੑ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੂਪਿ ਸਮਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: jina seviaa jina seviaa meraa har jeeo te har har roop samaasee |
English: Those who have served, those who have served my Dear Lord, are absorbed into the Being of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੇ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜੀਉ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਸੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: se dhan se dhan jin har dhiaaeaa jeeo jan naanak tin bal jaasee |3|
English: Blessed are they, blessed are they, who have meditated on the Dear Lord; slave Nanak is a sacrifice to them. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਜੀ ਭਰੇ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਬੇਅੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: teree bhagat teree bhagat bhanddaar jee bhare beant beantaa |
English: Devotion to You, devotion to You, is a treasure, overflowing, infinite and endless.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਨੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: tere bhagat tere bhagat salaahan tudh jee har anik anek anantaa |
English: Your devotees, Your devotees praise You, O Dear Lord, in many and various ways.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੀ ਅਨਿਕ ਤੇਰੀ ਅਨਿਕ ਕਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਜੀ ਤਪੁ ਤਾਪਹਿ ਜਪਹਿ ਬੇਅੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: teree anik teree anik kareh har poojaa jee tap taapeh japeh beantaa |
English: For You, so many, for You, so very many, O Dear Lord, perform worship and adoration; they practice penance and endlessly chant in meditation.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਤੇਰੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਪੜਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਜੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: tere anek tere anek parreh bahu sinmrit saasat jee kar kiriaa khatt karam karantaa |
English: For You, many - for You, so very many read the various Simritees and Shaastras; they perform religious rituals and the six ceremonies.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਭਲੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀ ਜੋ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: se bhagat se bhagat bhale jan naanak jee jo bhaaveh mere har bhagavantaa |4|
English: Those devotees, those devotees are good, O servant Nanak, who are pleasing to my Lord God. ||4||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਜੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: toon aad purakh aparanpar karataa jee tudh jevadd avar na koee |
English: You are the Primal Being, the Unrivalled Creator Lord; there is no other as Great as You.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੂੰ ਏਕੋ ਜੀ ਤੂੰ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: toon jug jug eko sadaa sadaa toon eko jee toon nihachal karataa soee |
English: You are the One, age after age; forever and ever, You are One and the same. You are the Eternal, Unchanging Creator.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਵਰਤੈ ਜੀ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: tudh aape bhaavai soee varatai jee toon aape kareh su hoee |
English: Whatever pleases You comes to pass. Whatever You Yourself do, happens.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਉਪਾਈ ਜੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਿਰਜਿ ਸਭ ਗੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: tudh aape srisatt sabh upaaee jee tudh aape siraj sabh goee |
English: You Yourself created the entire Universe, and having done so, You Yourself shall destroy it all.

Gurbani: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੇ ਜੀ ਜੋ ਸਭਸੈ ਕਾ ਜਾਣੋਈ ॥੫॥੨॥
Transliteration: jan naanak gun gaavai karate ke jee jo sabhasai kaa jaanoee |5|2|
English: Servant Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Creator, the Knower of all. ||5||2||

[Ang 348 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: raag aasaa mahalaa 1 chaupade ghar 2 |
English: Raag Aasaa, First Mehl, Chaupadhay, Second House:

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਵਡਾ ਆਖੈ ਸਭ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: sun vaddaa aakhai sabh koee |
English: Hearing, everyone calls You Great,

Gurbani: ਕੇਵਡੁ ਵਡਾ ਡੀਠਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: kevadd vaddaa ddeetthaa hoee |
English: but only one who has seen You, knows just how Great You are.

Gurbani: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇ ਨ ਕਹਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: keemat paae na kahiaa jaae |
English: No one can measure Your Worth, or describe You.

Gurbani: ਕਹਣੈ ਵਾਲੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kahanai vaale tere rahe samaae |1|
English: Those who describe You, remain absorbed in You. ||1||

Gurbani: ਵਡੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: vadde mere saahibaa gahir ganbheeraa gunee gaheeraa |
English: O my Great Lord and Master of Unfathomable Depth, You are the Ocean of Excellence.

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੇਤਾ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਚੀਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: koee na jaanai teraa ketaa kevadd cheeraa |1| rahaau |
English: No one knows the greatness of Your expanse. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਰਤੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sabh suratee mil surat kamaaee |
English: All the contemplators met together and practiced contemplation;

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sabh keemat mil keemat paaee |
English: all the appraisers met together and tried to appraise You.

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਗੁਰ ਹਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: giaanee dhiaanee gur gur haaee |
English: The theologians, the meditators and the teachers of teachers

Gurbani: ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਤੇਰੀ ਤਿਲੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kehan na jaaee teree til vaddiaaee |2|
English: could not express even an iota of Your Greatness. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਸਤ ਸਭਿ ਤਪ ਸਭਿ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabh sat sabh tap sabh changiaaeea |
English: All Truth, all austerities, all goodness,

Gurbani: ਸਿਧਾ ਪੁਰਖਾ ਕੀਆ ਵਡਿਆਈਆਂ ॥
Transliteration: sidhaa purakhaa keea vaddiaaeean |
English: and the greatness of the Siddhas, the beings of perfect spiritual powers

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਿਧੀ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: tudh vin sidhee kinai na paaeea |
English: without You, none has attained such spiritual powers.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਈਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: karam milai naahee tthaak rahaaeea |3|
English: They are obtained by Your Grace; their flow cannot be blocked. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਖਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਕਿਆ ਬੇਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aakhan vaalaa kiaa bechaaraa |
English: What can the helpless speaker do?

Gurbani: ਸਿਫਤੀ ਭਰੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sifatee bhare tere bhanddaaraa |
English: Your bounties are overflowing with Your Praises.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਿਆ ਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jis toon dehi tisai kiaa chaaraa |
English: And the one, unto whom You give - why should he think of any other?

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak sach savaaranahaaraa |4|1|
English: O Nanak, the True Lord is the Embellisher. ||4||1||

[Ang 349 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਖਾ ਜੀਵਾ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aakhaa jeevaa visarai mar jaau |
English: Chanting the Name, I live; forgetting it, I die.

Gurbani: ਆਖਣਿ ਅਉਖਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aakhan aaukhaa saachaa naau |
English: It is so difficult to chant the True Name.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਲਾਗੈ ਭੂਖ ॥
Transliteration: saache naam kee laagai bhookh |
English: If someone feels hunger for the True Name,

Gurbani: ਤਿਤੁ ਭੂਖੈ ਖਾਇ ਚਲੀਅਹਿ ਦੂਖ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tit bhookhai khaae chaleeeh dookh |1|
English: then that hunger shall consume his pains. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: so kiau visarai meree maae |
English: So how could I ever forget Him, O my Mother?

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saachaa saahib saachai naae |1| rahaau |
English: True is the Master, and True is His Name. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਤਿਲੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: saache naam kee til vaddiaaee |
English: People have grown weary of trying to appraise the greatness of the True Name,

Gurbani: ਆਖਿ ਥਕੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aakh thake keemat nahee paaee |
English: But they have not been able to appraise even an iota of it.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਸਭਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੈ ਆਖਣ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: je sabh mil kai aakhan paeh |
English: Even if they were all to meet together and recount them,

Gurbani: ਵਡਾ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਘਾਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: vaddaa na hovai ghaatt na jaae |2|
English: You would not be made any greater or lesser. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: naa ohu marai na hovai sog |
English: He does not die - there is no reason to mourn.

Gurbani: ਦੇਂਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ਭੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: dendaa rahai na chookai bhog |
English: He continues to give, but His Provisions are never exhausted.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣੁ ਏਹੋ ਹੋਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: gun eho hor naahee koe |
English: This Glorious Virtue is His alone - no one else is like Him;

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਆ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naa ko hoaa naa ko hoe |3|
English: there has never been anyone like Him, and there never shall be. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੇਵਡੁ ਆਪਿ ਤੇਵਡ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: jevadd aap tevadd teree daat |
English: As Great as You Yourself are, so Great are Your Gifts.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਕੀਤੀ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: jin din kar kai keetee raat |
English: It is You who created day and night as well.

Gurbani: ਖਸਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਹਿ ਤੇ ਕਮਜਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: khasam visaareh te kamajaat |
English: Those who forget their Lord and Master are vile and despicable.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਾਝੁ ਸਨਾਤਿ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naavai baajh sanaat |4|2|
English: O Nanak, without the Name, people are wretched outcasts. ||4||2||

[Ang 349 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਦਰਿ ਮਾਂਗਤੁ ਕੂਕ ਕਰੇ ਮਹਲੀ ਖਸਮੁ ਸੁਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: je dar maangat kook kare mahalee khasam sune |
English: If a beggar cries out at the door, the Master hears it in His Mansion.

Gurbani: ਭਾਵੈ ਧੀਰਕ ਭਾਵੈ ਧਕੇ ਏਕ ਵਡਾਈ ਦੇਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bhaavai dheerak bhaavai dhake ek vaddaaee dee |1|
English: Whether He receives him or pushes him away, it is the Gift of the Lord's Greatness. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਾਣਹੁ ਜੋਤਿ ਨ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਜਾਤੀ ਆਗੈ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaanahu jot na poochhahu jaatee aagai jaat na he |1| rahaau |
English: Recognize the Lord's Light within all, and do not consider social class or status; there are no classes or castes in the world hereafter. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: aap karaae aap karee |
English: He Himself acts, and He Himself inspires us to act.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਉਲਾਮੑੇ ਚਿਤਿ ਧਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: aap ulaamae chit dharee |
English: He Himself considers our complaints.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jaa toon karanahaar karataar |
English: Since You, O Creator Lord, are the Doer,

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹਤਾਜੀ ਕਿਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kiaa muhataajee kiaa sansaar |2|
English: why should I submit to the world? ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: aap upaae aape dee |
English: You Yourself created and You Yourself give.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਨਹਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: aape duramat maneh karee |
English: You Yourself eliminate evil-mindedness;

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaad vasai man aae |
English: by Guru's Grace, You come to abide in our minds,

Gurbani: ਦੁਖੁ ਅਨੑੇਰਾ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: dukh anaeraa vichahu jaae |3|
English: and then, pain and darkness are dispelled from within. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: saach piaaraa aap karee |
English: He Himself infuses love for the Truth.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰੀ ਕਉ ਸਾਚੁ ਨ ਦੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: avaree kau saach na dee |
English: Unto others, the Truth is not bestowed.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੇਇ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਗੈ ਪੂਛ ਨ ਲੇਇ ॥੪॥੩॥
Transliteration: je kisai dee vakhaanai naanak aagai poochh na lee |4|3|
English: If He bestows it upon someone, says Nanak, then, in the world hereafter, that person is not called to account. ||4||3||

[Ang 349 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤਾਲ ਮਦੀਰੇ ਘਟ ਕੇ ਘਾਟ ॥
Transliteration: taal madeere ghatt ke ghaatt |
English: The urges of the heart are like cymbals and ankle-bells;

Gurbani: ਦੋਲਕ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਵਾਜਹਿ ਵਾਜ ॥
Transliteration: dolak duneea vaajeh vaaj |
English: the drum of the world resounds with the beat.

Gurbani: ਨਾਰਦੁ ਨਾਚੈ ਕਲਿ ਕਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: naarad naachai kal kaa bhaau |
English: Naarad dances to the tune of the Dark Age of Kali Yuga;

Gurbani: ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਕਹ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਪਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jatee satee keh raakheh paau |1|
English: where can the celibates and the men of truth place their feet? ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak naam vittahu kurabaan |
English: Nanak is a sacrifice to the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਅੰਧੀ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: andhee duneea saahib jaan |1| rahaau |
English: The world is blind; our Lord and Master is All-seeing. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੂ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਚੇਲਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: guroo paasahu fir chelaa khaae |
English: The disciple feeds on the Guru;

Gurbani: ਤਾਮਿ ਪਰੀਤਿ ਵਸੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: taam pareet vasai ghar aae |
English: out of love for bread, he comes to dwell in his home.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਵਰ੍ਹਿਆ ਜੀਵਣ ਖਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: je sau varhiaa jeevan khaan |
English: If one were to live and eat for hundreds of years,

Gurbani: ਖਸਮ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸੋ ਦਿਨੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: khasam pachhaanai so din paravaan |2|
English: that day alone would be auspicious, when he recognizes his Lord and Master. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦਰਸਨਿ ਦੇਖਿਐ ਦਇਆ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: darasan dekhiai deaa na hoe |
English: Beholding the sight of the petitioner, compassion is not aroused.

Gurbani: ਲਏ ਦਿਤੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: le dite vin rahai na koe |
English: No one lives without give and take.

Gurbani: ਰਾਜਾ ਨਿਆਉ ਕਰੇ ਹਥਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: raajaa niaau kare hath hoe |
English: The king administers justice only if his palm is greased.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਨ ਮਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kahai khudaae na maanai koe |3|
English: No one is moved by the Name of God. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਾਣਸ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: maanas moorat naanak naam |
English: O Nanak, they are human beings in form and name only;

Gurbani: ਕਰਣੀ ਕੁਤਾ ਦਰਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: karanee kutaa dar furamaan |
English: by their deeds they are dogs - this is the Command of the Lord's Court.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਮਿਹਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaad jaanai mihamaan |
English: By Guru's Grace, if one sees himself as a guest in this world,

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੪॥੪॥
Transliteration: taa kichh daragah paavai maan |4|4|
English: then he gains honor in the Court of the Lord. ||4||4||

[Ang 350 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੇਤਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਧੁਨਿ ਤੇਤੀ ਜੇਤਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jetaa sabad surat dhun tetee jetaa roop kaaeaa teree |
English: As much as the Shabad is in the mind, so much is Your melody; as much as the form of the universe is, so much is Your body, Lord.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਰਸਨਾ ਆਪੇ ਬਸਨਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕਹਉ ਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: toon aape rasanaa aape basanaa avar na doojaa khau maaee |1|
English: You Yourself are the tongue, and You Yourself are the nose. Do not speak of any other, O my mother. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਏਕੋ ਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: saahib meraa eko hai |
English: My Lord and Master is One;

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਏਕੋ ਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: eko hai bhaaee eko hai |1| rahaau |
English: He is the One and Only; O Siblings of Destiny, He is the One alone. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਛੋਡੈ ਆਪੇ ਲੇਵੈ ਦੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: aape maare aape chhoddai aape levai dee |
English: He Himself kills, and He Himself emancipates; He Himself gives and takes.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਆਪੇ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aape vekhai aape vigasai aape nadar karee |2|
English: He Himself beholds, and He Himself rejoices; He Himself bestows His Glance of Grace. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੋ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jo kichh karanaa so kar rahiaa avar na karanaa jaaee |
English: Whatever He is to do, that is what He is doing. No one else can do anything.

Gurbani: ਜੈਸਾ ਵਰਤੈ ਤੈਸੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jaisaa varatai taiso kaheeai sabh teree vaddiaaee |3|
English: As He projects Himself, so do we describe Him; this is all Your Glorious Greatness, Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਲਿ ਕਲਵਾਲੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਤਵਾਲਾ ਪੀਵਤੁ ਰਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: kal kalavaalee maaeaa mad meetthaa man matavaalaa peevat rahai |
English: The Dark Age of Kali Yuga is the bottle of wine; Maya is the sweet wine, and the intoxicated mind continues to drink it in.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਰੂਪ ਕਰੇ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਂਤੀਂ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬਪੁੜਾ ਏਵ ਕਹੈ ॥੪॥੫॥
Transliteration: aape roop kare bahu bhaanteen naanak bapurraa ev kahai |4|5|
English: He Himself assumes all sorts of forms; thus poor Nanak speaks. ||4||5||

[Ang 350 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਵਾਜਾ ਮਤਿ ਪਖਾਵਜੁ ਭਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: vaajaa mat pakhaavaj bhaau |
English: Make your intellect your instrument, and love your tambourine;

Gurbani: ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hoe anand sadaa man chaau |
English: thus bliss and lasting pleasure shall be produced in your mind.

Gurbani: ਏਹਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਏਹੋ ਤਪ ਤਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ehaa bhagat eho tap taau |
English: This is devotional worship, and this is the practice of penance.

Gurbani: ਇਤੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਨਾਚਹੁ ਰਖਿ ਰਖਿ ਪਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: eit rang naachahu rakh rakh paau |1|
English: So dance in this love, and keep the beat with your feet. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਤਾਲ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਾਲਾਹ ॥
Transliteration: poore taal jaanai saalaah |
English: Know that the perfect beat is the Praise of the Lord;

Gurbani: ਹੋਰੁ ਨਚਣਾ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਮਨ ਮਾਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hor nachanaa khuseea man maah |1| rahaau |
English: other dances produce only temporary pleasure in the mind. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਵਜਹਿ ਦੁਇ ਤਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: sat santokh vajeh due taal |
English: Play the two cymbals of truth and contentment.

Gurbani: ਪੈਰੀ ਵਾਜਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: pairee vaajaa sadaa nihaal |
English: Let your ankle bells be the lasting Vision of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਨਾਦੁ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raag naad nahee doojaa bhaau |
English: Let your harmony and music be the elimination of duality.

Gurbani: ਇਤੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਨਾਚਹੁ ਰਖਿ ਰਖਿ ਪਾਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: eit rang naachahu rakh rakh paau |2|
English: So dance in this love, and keep the beat with your feet. ||2||

Gurbani: ਭਉ ਫੇਰੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਮਨ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: bhau feree hovai man cheet |
English: Let the fear of God within your heart and mind be your spinning dance,

Gurbani: ਬਹਦਿਆ ਉਠਦਿਆ ਨੀਤਾ ਨੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: bahadiaa utthadiaa neetaa neet |
English: and keep up, whether sitting or standing.

Gurbani: ਲੇਟਣਿ ਲੇਟਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਤਨੁ ਸੁਆਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: lettan lett jaanai tan suaahu |
English: To roll around in the dust is to know that the body is only ashes.

Gurbani: ਇਤੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਨਾਚਹੁ ਰਖਿ ਰਖਿ ਪਾਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: eit rang naachahu rakh rakh paau |3|
English: So dance in this love, and keep the beat with your feet. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਿਖ ਸਭਾ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਕਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sikh sabhaa deekhiaa kaa bhaau |
English: Keep the company of the disciples, the students who love the teachings.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਣਣਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh sunanaa saachaa naau |
English: As Gurmukh, listen to the True Name.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਖਣੁ ਵੇਰਾ ਵੇਰ ॥
Transliteration: naanak aakhan veraa ver |
English: O Nanak, chant it, over and over again.

Gurbani: ਇਤੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਨਾਚਹੁ ਰਖਿ ਰਖਿ ਪੈਰ ॥੪॥੬॥
Transliteration: eit rang naachahu rakh rakh pair |4|6|
English: So dance in this love, and keep the beat with your feet. ||4||6||

[Ang 350 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪਉਣੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਧਰੀ ਸਭ ਧਰਤੀ ਜਲ ਅਗਨੀ ਕਾ ਬੰਧੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: paun upaae dharee sabh dharatee jal aganee kaa bandh keea |
English: He created the air, and He supports the whole world; he bound water and fire together.

Gurbani: ਅੰਧੁਲੈ ਦਹਸਿਰਿ ਮੂੰਡੁ ਕਟਾਇਆ ਰਾਵਣੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਿਆ ਵਡਾ ਭਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: andhulai dahasir moondd kattaaeaa raavan maar kiaa vaddaa bheaa |1|
English: The blind, ten-headed Raavan had his heads cut off, but what greatness was obtained by killing him? ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਉਪਮਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਖੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa upamaa teree aakhee jaae |
English: What Glories of Yours can be chanted?

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਸਰਬੇ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: toon sarabe poor rahiaa liv laae |1| rahaau |
English: You are totally pervading everywhere; You love and cherish all. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਉਪਾਇ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਹਥਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਕਾਲੀ ਨਥਿ ਕਿਆ ਵਡਾ ਭਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jeea upaae jugat hath keenee kaalee nath kiaa vaddaa bheaa |
English: You created all beings, and You hold the world in Your Hands; what greatness is it to put a ring in the nose of the black cobra, as Krishna did?

Gurbani: ਕਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਜੋਰੂ ਕਉਣ ਕਹੀਐ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kis toon purakh joroo kaun kaheeai sarab nirantar rav rahiaa |2|
English: Whose Husband are You? Who is Your wife? You are subtly diffused and pervading in all. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਾਲਿ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਸਾਥਿ ਵਰਦਾਤਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਭਾਲਣ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: naal kuttanb saath varadaataa brahamaa bhaalan srisatt geaa |
English: Brahma, the bestower of blessings, entered the stem of the lotus, with his relatives, to find the extent of the universe.

Gurbani: ਆਗੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਕੰਸੁ ਛੇਦਿ ਕਿਆ ਵਡਾ ਭਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aagai ant na paaeo taa kaa kans chhed kiaa vaddaa bheaa |3|
English: Proceeding on, he could not find its limits; what glory was obtained by killing Kansa, the king? ||3||

Gurbani: ਰਤਨ ਉਪਾਇ ਧਰੇ ਖੀਰੁ ਮਥਿਆ ਹੋਰਿ ਭਖਲਾਏ ਜਿ ਅਸੀ ਕੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: ratan upaae dhare kheer mathiaa hor bhakhalaae ji asee keea |
English: The jewels were produced and brought forth by churning the ocean of milk. The other gods proclaimed We are the ones who did this!

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਛਪੈ ਕਿਉ ਛਪਿਆ ਏਕੀ ਏਕੀ ਵੰਡਿ ਦੀਆ ॥੪॥੭॥
Transliteration: kahai naanak chhapai kiau chhapiaa ekee ekee vandd deea |4|7|
English: Says Nanak, by hiding, how can the Lord be hidden? He has given each their share, one by one. ||4||7||

[Ang 351 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਰਮ ਕਰਤੂਤਿ ਬੇਲਿ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਫਲੁ ਹੂਆ ॥
Transliteration: karam karatoot bel bisathaaree raam naam fal hooaa |
English: The vine of good actions and character has spread out, and it bears the fruit of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖ ਅਨਾਹਦੁ ਵਾਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਿ ਕੀਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tis roop na rekh anaahad vaajai sabad niranjan keea |1|
English: The Name has no form or outline; it vibrates with the unstruck Sound Current; through the Word of the Shabad, the Immaculate Lord is revealed. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਰੇ ਵਖਿਆਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: kare vakhiaan jaanai je koee |
English: One can speak on this only when he knows it.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: amrit peevai soee |1| rahaau |
English: He alone drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑ ਪੀਆ ਸੇ ਮਸਤ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਤੂਟੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਫਾਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: jina peea se masat bhe hai tootte bandhan faahe |
English: Those who drink it in are enraptured; their bonds and shackles are cut away.

Gurbani: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਤਾ ਛੋਡੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਲਾਹੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jotee jot samaanee bheetar taa chhodde maaeaa ke laahe |2|
English: When one's light blends into the Divine Light, then the desire for Maya is ended. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਜੋਤਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਤੇਰੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sarab jot roop teraa dekhiaa sagal bhavan teree maaeaa |
English: Among all lights, I behold Your Form; all the worlds are Your Maya.

Gurbani: ਰਾਰੈ ਰੂਪਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਬੈਠਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਛਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: raarai roop niraalam baitthaa nadar kare vich chhaaeaa |3|
English: Among the tumults and forms, He sits in serene detachment; He bestows His Glance of Grace upon those who are engrossed in the illusion. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬੀਣਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਵੈ ਜੋਗੀ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਰੂਪਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: beenaa sabad vajaavai jogee darasan roop apaaraa |
English: The Yogi who plays on the instrument of the Shabad gains the Blessed Vision of the Infinitely Beautiful Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਅਨਾਹਦਿ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੮॥
Transliteration: sabad anaahad so sahu raataa naanak kahai vichaaraa |4|8|
English: He, the Lord, is immersed in the Unstruck Shabad of the Word, says Nanak, the humble and meek. ||4||8||

[Ang 351 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਗੁਣ ਗਲਾ ਕੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: mai gun galaa ke sir bhaar |
English: My virtue is that I carry the load of my words upon my head.

Gurbani: ਗਲੀ ਗਲਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: galee galaa sirajanahaar |
English: The real words are the Words of the Creator Lord.

Gurbani: ਖਾਣਾ ਪੀਣਾ ਹਸਣਾ ਬਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: khaanaa peenaa hasanaa baad |
English: How useless are eating, drinking and laughing,

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਯਾਦਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jab lag ridai na aaveh yaad |1|
English: if the Lord is not cherished in the heart! ||1||

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਪਰਵਾਹ ਕੇਹੀ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: tau paravaah kehee kiaa keejai |
English: Why should someone care for anything else,

Gurbani: ਜਨਮਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਲੀਜੀ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: janam janam kichh leejee leejai |1| rahaau |
English: if throughout his life, he gathers in that which is truly worth gathering? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਮਤਾਗਲੁ ਮਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: man kee mat mataagal mataa |
English: The intellect of the mind is like a drunken elephant.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਬੋਲੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਖਤੋ ਖਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo kichh boleeai sabh khato khataa |
English: Whatever one utters is totally false, the most false of the false.

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਲੈ ਕੀਚੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa muhu lai keechai aradaas |
English: So what face should we put on to offer our prayer,

Gurbani: ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਦੁਇ ਸਾਖੀ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: paap pun due saakhee paas |2|
English: when both virtue and vice are close at hand as witnesses? ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੈਸਾ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੈਸਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jaisaa toon kareh taisaa ko hoe |
English: As You make us, so we become.

Gurbani: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: tujh bin doojaa naahee koe |
English: Without You, there is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਜੇਹੀ ਤੂੰ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਤੇਹੀ ਕੋ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jehee toon mat dehi tehee ko paavai |
English: As is the understanding which You bestow, so do we receive.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tudh aape bhaavai tivai chalaavai |3|
English: As it pleases Your Will, so do You lead us. ||3||

Gurbani: ਰਾਗ ਰਤਨ ਪਰੀਆ ਪਰਵਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: raag ratan pareea paravaar |
English: The divine crystalline harmonies, their consorts, and their celestial families

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: tis vich upajai amrit saar |
English: from them, the essence of Ambrosial Nectar is produced.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak karate kaa ihu dhan maal |
English: O Nanak, this is the wealth and property of the Creator Lord.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਏਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੯॥
Transliteration: je ko boojhai ehu beechaar |4|9|
English: If only this essential reality were understood! ||4||9||

[Ang 351 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪਨੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਤਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਖੀਆ ਕਾਜੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa apanai ghar aaeaa taa mil sakheea kaaj rachaaeaa |
English: When by His Grace He came to my home, then my companions met together to celebrate my marriage.

Gurbani: ਖੇਲੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਸਹੁ ਵੀਆਹਣ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: khel dekh man anad bheaa sahu veeaahan aaeaa |1|
English: Beholding this play, my mind became blissful; my Husband Lord has come to marry me. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਹੁ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: gaavahu gaavahu kaamanee bibek beechaar |
