English: So sing - yes, sing the songs of wisdom and reflection, O brides.

Gurbani: ਹਮਰੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hamarai ghar aaeaa jagajeevan bhataar |1| rahaau |
English: My spouse, the Life of the world, has come into my home. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਹਮਰਾ ਵੀਆਹੁ ਜਿ ਹੋਆ ਜਾਂ ਸਹੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਾਂ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: guroo duaarai hamaraa veeaahu ji hoaa jaan sahu miliaa taan jaaniaa |
English: When I was married within the Gurdwara, the Guru's Gate, I met my Husband Lord, and I came to know Him.

Gurbani: ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਕਾ ਮਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਹੈ ਆਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tihu lokaa meh sabad raviaa hai aap geaa man maaniaa |2|
English: The Word of His Shabad is pervading the three worlds; when my ego was quieted, my mind became happy. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਪਣਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਹੋਰਨਿ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aapanaa kaaraj aap savaare horan kaaraj na hoee |
English: He Himself arranges His own affairs; His affairs cannot be arranged by anyone else.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਕਾਰਜਿ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jit kaaraj sat santokh deaa dharam hai guramukh boojhai koee |3|
English: By the affair of this marriage, truth, contentment, mercy and faith are produced; but how rare is that Gurmukh who understands it! ||3||

Gurbani: ਭਨਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhanat naanak sabhanaa kaa pir eko soe |
English: Says Nanak, that Lord alone is the Husband of all.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: jis no nadar kare saa sohaagan hoe |4|10|
English: She, upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace, becomes the happy soul-bride. ||4||10||

[Ang 351 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਬਨੁ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: grihu ban samasar sehaj subhaae |
English: Home and forest are the same, for one who dwells in the balance of intuitive peace and poise.

Gurbani: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਗਤੁ ਭਈ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਠਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: duramat gat bhee keerat tthaae |
English: His evil-mindedness departs, and the Praises of God take its place.

Gurbani: ਸਚ ਪਉੜੀ ਸਾਚਉ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਂਉ ॥
Transliteration: sach paurree saachau mukh naanau |
English: To chant the True Name with one's mouth is the true ladder.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਪਾਏ ਨਿਜ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: satigur sev paae nij thaau |1|
English: Serving the True Guru, one finds one's own place within the self. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਚੂਰੇ ਖਟੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: man choore khatt darasan jaan |
English: To conquer the mind is the knowledge of the six Shaastras.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਜੋਤਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sarab jot pooran bhagavaan |1| rahaau |
English: The Divine Light of the Lord God is perfectly pervading. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਧਿਕ ਤਿਆਸ ਭੇਖ ਬਹੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: adhik tiaas bhekh bahu karai |
English: Excessive thirst for Maya makes people wear all sorts of religious robes.

Gurbani: ਦੁਖੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਤਨਿ ਪਰਹਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: dukh bikhiaa sukh tan paraharai |
English: The pain of corruption destroys the body's peace.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਹਿਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh antar dhan hirai |
English: Sexual desire and anger steal the wealth of the self within.

Gurbani: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਛੋਡਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਰੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: dubidhaa chhodd naam nisatarai |2|
English: But by abandoning duality, one is emancipated through the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਲਾਹਣੁ ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: sifat salaahan sehaj anand |
English: In the Lord's Praise and adoration is intuitive peace, poise and bliss.

Gurbani: ਸਖਾ ਸੈਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: sakhaa sain prem gobind |
English: The Love of the Lord God is one's family and friends.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿੰਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape kare aape bakhasind |
English: He Himself is the Doer, and He Himself is the Forgiver.

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਹਿ ਆਗੈ ਜਿੰਦੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tan man har peh aagai jind |3|
English: My body and mind belong to the Lord; my life is at His Command. ||3||

Gurbani: ਝੂਠ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੇਹ ॥
Transliteration: jhootth vikaar mahaa dukh deh |
English: Falsehood and corruption cause terrible suffering.

Gurbani: ਭੇਖ ਵਰਨ ਦੀਸਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਖੇਹ ॥
Transliteration: bhekh varan deeseh sabh kheh |
English: All the religious robes and social classes look just like dust.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਉਪਜੈ ਸੋ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jo upajai so aavai jaae |
English: Whoever is born, continues to come and go.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: naanak asathir naam rajaae |4|11|
English: O Nanak, only the Naam and the Lord's Command are eternal and everlasting. ||4||11||

[Ang 352 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਕਮਲ ਅਨੂਪ ॥
Transliteration: eko saravar kamal anoop |
English: In the pool is the one incomparably beautiful lotus.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਬਿਗਾਸੈ ਪਰਮਲ ਰੂਪ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa bigaasai paramal roop |
English: It blossoms continually; its form is pure and fragrant.

Gurbani: ਊਜਲ ਮੋਤੀ ਚੂਗਹਿ ਹੰਸ ॥
Transliteration: aoojal motee choogeh hans |
English: The swans pick up the bright jewels.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਜਗਦੀਸੈ ਅੰਸ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sarab kalaa jagadeesai ans |1|
English: They take on the essence of the All-powerful Lord of the Universe. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਿਨਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: jo deesai so upajai binasai |
English: Whoever is seen, is subject to birth and death.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਸਰਵਰਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bin jal saravar kamal na deesai |1| rahaau |
English: In the pool without water, the lotus is not seen. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਪਾਵੈ ਭੇਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: biralaa boojhai paavai bhed |
English: How rare are those who know and understand this secret.

Gurbani: ਸਾਖਾ ਤੀਨਿ ਕਹੈ ਨਿਤ ਬੇਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: saakhaa teen kahai nit bed |
English: The Vedas continually speak of the three branches.

Gurbani: ਨਾਦ ਬਿੰਦ ਕੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: naad bind kee surat samaae |
English: One who merges into the knowledge of the Lord as absolute and related,

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: satigur sev param pad paae |2|
English: serves the True Guru and obtains the supreme status. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮੁਕਤੋ ਰਾਤਉ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਵਾਂਤਉ ॥
Transliteration: mukato raatau rang ravaantau |
English: One who is imbued with the Love of the Lord and dwells continually upon Him is liberated.

Gurbani: ਰਾਜਨ ਰਾਜਿ ਸਦਾ ਬਿਗਸਾਂਤਉ ॥
Transliteration: raajan raaj sadaa bigasaantau |
English: He is the king of kings, and blossoms forth continually.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jis toon raakheh kirapaa dhaar |
English: That one whom You preserve, by bestowing Your Mercy, O Lord,

Gurbani: ਬੂਡਤ ਪਾਹਨ ਤਾਰਹਿ ਤਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: booddat paahan taareh taar |3|
English: even the sinking stone - You float that one across. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: tribhavan meh jot tribhavan meh jaaniaa |
English: Your Light is pervading the three worlds; I know that You are permeating the three worlds.

Gurbani: ਉਲਟ ਭਈ ਘਰੁ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: aulatt bhee ghar ghar meh aaniaa |
English: When my mind turned away from Maya, I came to dwell in my own home.

Gurbani: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: ahinis bhagat kare liv laae |
English: Nanak falls at the feet of that person who immerses himself in the Lord's Love,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਲਾਗੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: naanak tin kai laagai paae |4|12|
English: And performs devotional worship night and day. ||4||12||

[Ang 352 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਹੁਜਤਿ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: guramat saachee hujat door |
English: Receiving the True Teachings from the Guru, arguments depart.

Gurbani: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਲਾਗੈ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: bahut siaanap laagai dhoor |
English: But through excessive cleverness, one is only plastered with dirt.

Gurbani: ਲਾਗੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਸਚ ਨਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: laagee mail mittai sach naae |
English: The filth of attachment is removed by the True Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur parasaad rahai liv laae |1|
English: By Guru's Grace, one remains lovingly attached to the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹੈ ਹਜੂਰਿ ਹਾਜਰੁ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: hai hajoor haajar aradaas |
English: He is the Presence Ever-present; offer your prayers to Him.

Gurbani: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dukh sukh saach karate prabh paas |1| rahaau |
English: Pain and pleasure are in the Hands of God, the True Creator. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: koorr kamaavai aavai jaavai |
English: One who practices falsehood comes and goes.

Gurbani: ਕਹਣਿ ਕਥਨਿ ਵਾਰਾ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: kehan kathan vaaraa nahee aavai |
English: By speaking and talking, His limits cannot be found.

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਦੇਖਾ ਸੂਝ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa dekhaa soojh boojh na paavai |
English: Whatever one sees, is not understood.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bin naavai man tripat na aavai |2|
English: Without the Name, satisfaction does not enter into the mind. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜਨਮੇ ਸੇ ਰੋਗਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: jo janame se rog viaape |
English: Whoever is born is afflicted by disease,

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੂਖਿ ਸੰਤਾਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: haumai maaeaa dookh santaape |
English: tortured by the pain of egotism and Maya.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਬਾਚੇ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
Transliteration: se jan baache jo prabh raakhe |
English: They alone are saved, who are protected by God.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: satigur sev amrit ras chaakhe |3|
English: Serving the True Guru, they drink in the Amrit, the Ambrosial Nectar. ||3||

Gurbani: ਚਲਤਉ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਚਾਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: chaltau man raakhai amrit chaakhai |
English: The unstable mind is restrained by tasting this Nectar.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਬਦੁ ਭਾਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sev amrit sabad bhaakhai |
English: Serving the True Guru, one comes to cherish the Ambrosial Nectar of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: saachai sabad mukat gat paae |
English: Through the True Word of the Shabad, the state of liberation is obtained.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥੪॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: naanak vichahu aap gavaae |4|13|
English: O Nanak, self-conceit is eradicated from within. ||4||13||

[Ang 352 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਥੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: jo tin keea so sach theea |
English: Whatever He has done, has proved to be true.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: amrit naam satigur deea |
English: The True Guru bestows the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨਿ ਭੰਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: hiradai naam naahee man bhang |
English: With the Naam in the heart, the mind is not separated from the Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸੰਗੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: anadin naal piaare sang |1|
English: Night and day, one dwells with the Beloved. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har jeeo raakhahu apanee saranaaee |
English: O Lord, please keep me in the Protection of Your Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee har ras paaeaa naam padaarath nau nidh paaee |1| rahaau |
English: By Guru's Grace, I have obtained the sublime essence of the Lord; I have received the wealth of the Naam and the nine treasures. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: karam dharam sach saachaa naau |
English: Those whose karma and Dharma - whose actions and faith - are in the True Name of the True Lord

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: taa kai sad balihaarai jaau |
English: I am forever a sacrifice to them.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: jo har raate se jan paravaan |
English: Those who are imbued with the Lord are accepted and respected.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tin kee sangat param nidhaan |2|
English: In their company, the supreme wealth is obtained. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਧਨ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: har var jin paaeaa dhan naaree |
English: Blessed is that bride, who has obtained the Lord as her Husband.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: har siau raatee sabad veechaaree |
English: She is imbued with the Lord, and she reflects upon the Word of His Shabad.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: aap tarai sangat kul taarai |
English: She saves herself, and saves her family and friends as well.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਤਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: satigur sev tat veechaarai |3|
English: She serves the True Guru, and contemplates the essence of reality. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਮਰੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hamaree jaat pat sach naau |
English: The True Name is my social status and honor.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਤ ਭਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: karam dharam sanjam sat bhaau |
English: The love of the Truth is my karma and Dharma - my faith and my actions, and my self-control.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸੇ ਪੂਛ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak bakhase poochh na hoe |
English: O Nanak, one who is forgiven by the Lord is not called to account.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜਾ ਮੇਟੇ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: doojaa mette eko soe |4|14|
English: The One Lord erases duality. ||4||14||

[Ang 353 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: eik aaveh ik jaaveh aaee |
English: Some come, and after they come, they go.

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਰਹਹਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: eik har raate raheh samaaee |
English: Some are imbued with the Lord; they remain absorbed in Him.

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਧਰਨਿ ਗਗਨ ਮਹਿ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: eik dharan gagan meh tthaur na paaveh |
English: Some find no place of rest at all, on the earth or in the sky.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਕਰਮਹੀਣ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: se karamaheen har naam na dhiaaveh |1|
English: Those who do not meditate on the Name of the Lord are the most unfortunate. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur poore te gat mit paaee |
English: From the Perfect Guru, the way to salvation is obtained.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਵਤ ਅਤਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: eihu sansaar bikh vat at bhaujal gurasabadee har paar langhaaee |1| rahaau |
English: This world is a terrifying ocean of poison; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord helps us cross over. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਆਪਿ ਲਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: jina kau aap le prabh mel |
English: Those, whom God unites with Himself,

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਪੇਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: tin kau kaal na saakai pel |
English: cannot be crushed by death.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰਹਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh niramal raheh piaare |
English: The beloved Gurmukhs remain immaculately pure,

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਅੰਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਮਲ ਨਿਰਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jiau jal anbh aoopar kamal niraare |2|
English: like the lotus in the water, which remains untouched. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: buraa bhalaa kahu kis no kaheeai |
English: Tell me: who should we call good or bad?

Gurbani: ਦੀਸੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਲਹੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: deesai braham guramukh sach laheeai |
English: Behold the Lord God; the truth is revealed to the Gurmukh.

Gurbani: ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥਉ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: akath kthau guramat veechaar |
English: I speak the Unspoken Speech of the Lord, contemplating the Guru's Teachings.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਉ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: mil gur sangat paavau paar |3|
English: I join the Sangat, the Guru's Congregation, and I find God's limits. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਤ ਬੇਦ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਭੇਦ ॥
Transliteration: saasat bed sinmrit bahu bhed |
English: The Shaastras, the Vedas, the Simritees and all their many secrets;

Gurbani: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਮਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਰੇਦ ॥
Transliteration: atthasatth majan har ras red |
English: bathing at the sixty-eight holy places of pilgrimage - all this is found by enshrining the sublime essence of the Lord in the heart.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh niramal mail na laagai |
English: The Gurmukhs are immaculately pure; no filth sticks to them.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡੇ ਧੁਰਿ ਭਾਗੈ ॥੪॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: naanak hiradai naam vadde dhur bhaagai |4|15|
English: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides in the heart, by the greatest pre-ordained destiny. ||4||15||

[Ang 353 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਪਾਇ ਲਗਉ ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਨਿਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: niv niv paae lgau gur apune aatam raam nihaariaa |
English: Bowing down, again and again, I fall at the Feet of my Guru; through Him, I have seen the Lord, the Divine Self, within.

Gurbani: ਕਰਤ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦੇਖਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: karat beechaar hiradai har raviaa hiradai dekh beechaariaa |1|
English: Through contemplation and meditation, the Lord dwells within the heart; see this, and understand. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬੋਲਹੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: bolahu raam kare nisataaraa |
English: So speak the Lord's Name, which shall emancipate you.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਭੈ ਮਿਟੈ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਉਜੀਆਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaad ratan har laabhai mittai agiaan hoe ujeeaaraa |1| rahaau |
English: By Guru's Grace, the jewel of the Lord is found; ignorance is dispelled, and the Divine Light shines forth. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਰਵਨੀ ਰਵੈ ਬੰਧਨ ਨਹੀ ਤੂਟਹਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ravanee ravai bandhan nahee tootteh vich haumai bharam na jaaee |
English: By merely saying it with the tongue, one's bonds are not broken, and egotism and doubt do not depart from within.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਹਉਮੈ ਤੂਟੈ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਲੇਖੈ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: satigur milai ta haumai toottai taa ko lekhai paaee |2|
English: But when one meets the True Guru, egotism departs, and then, one realizes his destiny. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam bhagat pria preetam sukh saagar ur dhaare |
English: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is sweet and dear to His devotees; it is the ocean of peace - enshrine it within the heart.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bhagat vachhal jagajeevan daataa mat guramat har nisataare |3|
English: The Lover of His devotees, the Life of the World, the Lord bestows the Guru's Teachings upon the intellect, and one is emancipated. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਜੂਝਿ ਮਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਏ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: man siau joojh marai prabh paae manasaa maneh samaae |
English: One who dies fighting against his own stubborn mind finds God, and the desires of the mind are quieted.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਸਹਜ ਭਾਇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥੪॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: naanak kripaa kare jagajeevan sehaj bhaae liv laae |4|16|
English: O Nanak, if the Life of the World bestows His Mercy, one is intuitively attuned to the Love of the Lord. ||4||16||

[Ang 353 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਕਹਹਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਹਿ ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਕਿਸੁ ਸਮਝਾਵਹਿ ਸਮਝਿ ਰਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: kis kau kaheh sunaaveh kis kau kis samajhaaveh samajh rahe |
English: Unto whom do they speak? Unto whom do they preach? Who understands? Let them understand themselves.

Gurbani: ਕਿਸੈ ਪੜਾਵਹਿ ਪੜਿ ਗੁਣਿ ਬੂਝੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਰਹੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kisai parraaveh parr gun boojhe satigur sabad santokh rahe |1|
English: Who do they teach? Through study, they come to realize the Lord's Glorious Virtues. Through the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru, they come to dwell in contentment. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਮਤੁ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa guramat ramat sareeraa |
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, realize that He is pervading in all bodies;

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har bhaj mere man gahir ganbheeraa |1| rahaau |
English: O my soul, vibrate on the Profound, Unfathomable Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਨਤ ਤਰੰਗ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: anat tarang bhagat har rangaa |
English: Loving devotion to the Lord brings endless waves of joy and delight.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੂਚੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: anadin sooche har gun sangaa |
English: One who dwells with the Glorious Praises of the Lord, night and day, is sanctified.

Gurbani: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਾਕਤ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: mithiaa janam saakat sansaaraa |
English: The birth into the world of the faithless cynic is totally useless.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: raam bhagat jan rahai niraaraa |2|
English: The humble devotee of the Lord remains unattached. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੂਚੀ ਕਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: soochee kaaeaa har gun gaaeaa |
English: The body which sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord is sanctified.

Gurbani: ਆਤਮੁ ਚੀਨਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aatam cheen rahai liv laaeaa |
English: The soul remains conscious of the Lord, absorbed in His Love.

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਹੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aad apaar aparanpar heeraa |
English: The Lord is the Infinite Primal Being, beyond the beyond, the priceless jewel.

Gurbani: ਲਾਲਿ ਰਤਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: laal rataa meraa man dheeraa |3|
English: My mind is totally content, imbued with my Beloved. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਥਨੀ ਕਹਹਿ ਕਹਹਿ ਸੇ ਮੂਏ ॥
Transliteration: kathanee kaheh kaheh se mooe |
English: Those who speak and babble on and on, are truly dead.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤੂੰ ਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: so prabh door naahee prabh toon hai |
English: God is not far away - O God, You are right here.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabh jag dekhiaa maaeaa chhaaeaa |
English: I have seen that the whole world is engrossed in Maya.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: naanak guramat naam dhiaaeaa |4|17|
English: O Nanak, through the Guru's Teachings, I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||17||

[Ang 354 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਤਿਤੁਕਾ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 titukaa |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl, Thi-Thukay:

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਭੀਖਕੁ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: koee bheekhak bheekhiaa khaae |
English: One is a beggar, living on charity;

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: koee raajaa rahiaa samaae |
English: another is a king, absorbed in himself.

Gurbani: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਮਾਨੁ ਕਿਸੈ ਅਪਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: kis hee maan kisai apamaan |
English: One receives honor, and another dishonor.

Gurbani: ਢਾਹਿ ਉਸਾਰੇ ਧਰੇ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: dtaeh usaare dhare dhiaan |
English: The Lord destroys and creates; He is enshrined in His meditation.

Gurbani: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਵਡਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: tujh te vaddaa naahee koe |
English: There is no other as great as You.

Gurbani: ਕਿਸੁ ਵੇਖਾਲੀ ਚੰਗਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kis vekhaalee changaa hoe |1|
English: So whom should I present to You? Who is good enough? ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਤਾਂ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: mai taan naam teraa aadhaar |
English: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is my only Support.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਤਾ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: toon daataa karanahaar karataar |1| rahaau |
English: You are the Great Giver, the Doer, the Creator. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਵਾਟ ਨ ਪਾਵਉ ਵੀਗਾ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: vaatt na paavau veegaa jaau |
English: I have not walked on Your Path; I have followed the crooked path.

Gurbani: ਦਰਗਹ ਬੈਸਣ ਨਾਹੀ ਥਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: daragah baisan naahee thaau |
English: In the Court of the Lord, I find no place to sit.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਅੰਧੁਲਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਬੰਧੁ ॥
Transliteration: man kaa andhulaa maaeaa kaa bandh |
English: I am mentally blind, in the bondage of Maya.

Gurbani: ਖੀਨ ਖਰਾਬੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਕੰਧੁ ॥
Transliteration: kheen kharaab hovai nit kandh |
English: The wall of my body is breaking down, wearing away, growing weaker.

Gurbani: ਖਾਣ ਜੀਵਣ ਕੀ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਆਸ ॥
Transliteration: khaan jeevan kee bahutee aas |
English: You have such high hopes of eating and living

Gurbani: ਲੇਖੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: lekhai terai saas giraas |2|
English: - your breaths and morsels of food are already counted! ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: ahinis andhule deepak dee |
English: Night and day they are blind - please, bless them with Your Light.

Gurbani: ਭਉਜਲ ਡੂਬਤ ਚਿੰਤ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhaujal ddoobat chint karee |
English: They are drowning in the terrifying world-ocean, crying out in pain.

Gurbani: ਕਹਹਿ ਸੁਣਹਿ ਜੋ ਮਾਨਹਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kaheh suneh jo maaneh naau |
English: I am a sacrifice to those who chant,

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hau balihaarai taa kai jaau |
English: Hear and believe in the Name.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਏਕ ਕਹੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: naanak ek kahai aradaas |
English: Nanak utters this one prayer;

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jeeo pindd sabh terai paas |3|
English: soul and body, all belong to You, Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਾਂ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਜਪੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaan toon dehi japee teraa naau |
English: When You bless me, I chant Your Name.

Gurbani: ਦਰਗਹ ਬੈਸਣ ਹੋਵੈ ਥਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: daragah baisan hovai thaau |
English: Thus I find my seat in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਾਂ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jaan tudh bhaavai taa duramat jaae |
English: When it pleases You, evil-mindedness departs,

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: giaan ratan man vasai aae |
English: and the jewel of spiritual wisdom comes to dwell in the mind.

Gurbani: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: nadar kare taa satigur milai |
English: When the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, then one comes to meet the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰੈ ॥੪॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: pranavat naanak bhavajal tarai |4|18|
English: Prays Nanak, carry us across the terrifying world-ocean. ||4||18||

[Ang 354 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਪੰਚਪਦੇ₆ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 panchapade₆ |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl, Panch-Padhay:

Gurbani: ਦੁਧ ਬਿਨੁ ਧੇਨੁ ਪੰਖ ਬਿਨੁ ਪੰਖੀ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਉਤਭੁਜ ਕਾਮਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: dudh bin dhen pankh bin pankhee jal bin utabhuj kaam naahee |
English: A cow without milk; a bird without wings; a garden without water - totally useless!

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਸੁਲਤਾਨੁ ਸਲਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣਾ ਅੰਧੀ ਕੋਠੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kiaa sulataan salaam vihoonaa andhee kotthee teraa naam naahee |1|
English: What is an emperor, without respect? The chamber of the soul is so dark, without the Name of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕੀ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: kee visareh dukh bahutaa laagai |
English: How could I ever forget You? It would be so painful!

Gurbani: ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਤੂੰ ਵਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dukh laagai toon visar naahee |1| rahaau |
English: I would suffer such pain - no, I shall not forget You! ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਖੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਜੀਭ ਰਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੰਨੀ ਪਵਣੁ ਨ ਵਾਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: akhee andh jeebh ras naahee kanee pavan na vaajai |
English: The eyes grow blind, the tongue does not taste, and the ears do not hear any sound.

Gurbani: ਚਰਣੀ ਚਲੈ ਪਜੂਤਾ ਆਗੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਫਲ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: charanee chalai pajootaa aagai vin sevaa fal laage |2|
English: He walks on his feet only when supported by someone else; without serving the Lord, such are the fruits of life. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਖਰ ਬਿਰਖ ਬਾਗ ਭੁਇ ਚੋਖੀ ਸਿੰਚਿਤ ਭਾਉ ਕਰੇਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: akhar birakh baag bhue chokhee sinchit bhaau karehee |
English: The Word is the tree; the garden of the heart is the farm; tend it, and irrigate it with the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਸਭਨਾ ਫਲੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਏਕੋ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਲੇਹੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sabhanaa fal laagai naam eko bin karamaa kaise lehee |3|
English: All these trees bear the fruit of the Name of the One Lord; but without the karma of good actions, how can anyone obtain it? ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੇਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਫਲੁ ਕਿਸੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jete jeea tete sabh tere vin sevaa fal kisai naahee |
English: As many living beings are there are, they are all Yours. Without selfless service, no one obtains any reward.

Gurbani: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ ਰਹੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: dukh sukh bhaanaa teraa hovai vin naavai jeeo rahai naahee |4|
English: Pain and pleasure come by Your Will; without the Name, the soul does not even exist. ||4||

Gurbani: ਮਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਕੈਸਾ ਜਾ ਜੀਵਾ ਤਾਂ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: mat vich maran jeevan hor kaisaa jaa jeevaa taan jugat naahee |
English: To die in the Teachings is to live. Otherwise, what is life? That is not the way.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜੀਵਾਲੇ ਜੀਆ ਜਹ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਹ ਰਾਖੁ ਤੁਹੀ ॥੫॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: kahai naanak jeevaale jeea jeh bhaavai teh raakh tuhee |5|19|
English: Says Nanak, He grants life to the living beings; O Lord, please keep me according to Your Will. ||5||19||

[Ang 355 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਮਨੁ ਹੈ ਧੋਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa brahamaa man hai dhotee |
English: Let the body be the Brahmin, and let the mind be the loin-cloth;

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਜਨੇਊ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਕੁਸਪਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: giaan janeaoo dhiaan kusapaatee |
English: let spiritual wisdom be the sacred thread, and meditation the ceremonial ring.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਜਸੁ ਜਾਚਉ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har naamaa jas jaachau naau |
English: I seek the Name of the Lord and His Praise as my cleansing bath.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee braham samaau |1|
English: By Guru's Grace, I am absorbed into God. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪਾਂਡੇ ਐਸਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: paandde aisaa braham beechaar |
English: O Pandit, O religious scholar, contemplate God in such a way

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੇ ਸੁਚਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਪੜਉ ਨਾਮੇ ਚਜੁ ਆਚਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: naame such naamo prrau naame chaj aachaar |1| rahaau |
English: that His Name may sanctify you, that His Name may be your study, and His Name your wisdom and way of life. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਨੇਊ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਜੋਤਿ ਹੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: baahar janeaoo jichar jot hai naal |
English: The outer sacred thread is worthwhile only as long as the Divine Light is within.

Gurbani: ਧੋਤੀ ਟਿਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: dhotee ttikaa naam samaal |
English: So make the remembrance of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, your loin-cloth and the ceremonial mark on your forehead.

Gurbani: ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਨਿਬਹੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: aithai othai nibahee naal |
English: Here and hereafter, the Name alone shall stand by you.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਹੋਰਿ ਕਰਮ ਨ ਭਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: vin naavai hor karam na bhaal |2|
English: Do not seek any other actions, except the Name. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪੂਜਾ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਮਾਇਆ ਪਰਜਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: poojaa prem maaeaa parajaal |
English: Worship the Lord in loving adoration, and burn your desire for Maya.

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: eko vekhahu avar na bhaal |
English: Behold only the One Lord, and do not seek out any other.

Gurbani: ਚੀਨੑੈ ਤਤੁ ਗਗਨ ਦਸ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
Transliteration: cheenai tat gagan das duaar |
English: Become aware of reality, in the Sky of the Tenth Gate;

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਠ ਪੜੈ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har mukh paatth parrai beechaar |3|
English: read aloud the Lord's Word, and contemplate it. ||3||

Gurbani: ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭਾਉ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: bhojan bhaau bharam bhau bhaagai |
English: With the diet of His Love, doubt and fear depart.

Gurbani: ਪਾਹਰੂਅਰਾ ਛਬਿ ਚੋਰੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: paaharooaraa chhab chor na laagai |
English: With the Lord as your night watchman, no thief will dare to break in.

Gurbani: ਤਿਲਕੁ ਲਿਲਾਟਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: tilak lilaatt jaanai prabh ek |
English: Let the knowledge of the One God be the ceremonial mark on your forehead.

Gurbani: ਬੂਝੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਿਬੇਕੁ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: boojhai braham antar bibek |4|
English: Let the realization that God is within you be your discrimination. ||4||

Gurbani: ਆਚਾਰੀ ਨਹੀ ਜੀਤਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aachaaree nahee jeetiaa jaae |
English: Through ritual actions, God cannot be won over;

Gurbani: ਪਾਠ ਪੜੈ ਨਹੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: paatth parrai nahee keemat paae |
English: by reciting sacred scriptures, His value cannot be estimated.

Gurbani: ਅਸਟ ਦਸੀ ਚਹੁ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: asatt dasee chahu bhed na paaeaa |
English: The eighteen Puraanas and the four Vedas do not know His mystery.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥੫॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: naanak satigur braham dikhaaeaa |5|20|
English: O Nanak, the True Guru has shown me the Lord God. ||5||20||

[Ang 355 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: sevak daas bhagat jan soee |
English: He alone is the selfless servant, slave and humble devotee,

Gurbani: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: tthaakur kaa daas guramukh hoee |
English: who as Gurmukh, becomes the slave of his Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਜੀ ਤਿਨਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਗੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jin sir saajee tin fun goee |
English: He, who created the Universe, shall ultimately destroy it.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tis bin doojaa avar na koee |1|
English: Without Him, there is no other at all. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: saach naam gur sabad veechaar |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Gurmukh reflects upon the True Name;

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh saache saachai darabaar |1| rahaau |
English: In the True Court, he is found to be true. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਅਰਜੁ ਸਚੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa araj sachee aradaas |
English: The true supplication, the true prayer

Gurbani: ਮਹਲੀ ਖਸਮੁ ਸੁਣੇ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: mahalee khasam sune saabaas |
English: - within the Mansion of His Sublime Presence, the True Lord Master hears and applauds these.

Gurbani: ਸਚੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਬੁਲਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sachai takhat bulaavai soe |
English: He summons the truthful to His Heavenly Throne

Gurbani: ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: de vaddiaaee kare su hoe |2|
English: and bestows glorious greatness upon them; that which He wills, comes to pass. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਤਾਣੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: teraa taan toohai deebaan |
English: The Power is Yours; You are my only Support.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa sabad sach neesaan |
English: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is my true password.

Gurbani: ਮੰਨੇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: mane hukam su paragatt jaae |
English: One who obeys the Hukam of the Lord's Command, goes to Him openly.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੈ ਠਾਕ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sach neesaanai tthaak na paae |3|
English: With the password of truth, his way is not blocked. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਹਿ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਵੇਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: panddit parreh vakhaaneh ved |
English: The Pandit reads and expounds on the Vedas,

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਭੇਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: antar vasat na jaaneh bhed |
English: but he does not know the secret of the thing within himself.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੋਝੀ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur bin sojhee boojh na hoe |
English: Without the Guru, understanding and realization are not obtained;

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਾ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: saachaa rav rahiaa prabh soe |4|
English: but still God is True, pervading everywhere. ||4||

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਹਉ ਆਖਾ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa hau aakhaa aakh vakhaanee |
English: What should I say, or speak or describe?

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: toon aape jaaneh sarab viddaanee |
English: Only You Yourself know, O Lord of total wonder.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੋ ਦਰੁ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak eko dar deebaan |
English: Nanak takes the Support of the Door of the One God.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਤਹਾ ਗੁਦਰਾਣੁ ॥੫॥੨੧॥
Transliteration: guramukh saach tahaa gudaraan |5|21|
English: There, at the True Door, the Gurmukhs sustain themselves. ||5||21||

[Ang 355 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਾਚੀ ਗਾਗਰਿ ਦੇਹ ਦੁਹੇਲੀ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kaachee gaagar deh duhelee upajai binasai dukh paaee |
English: The clay pitcher of the body is miserable; it suffers in pain through birth and death.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਕਿਉ ਤਰੀਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: eihu jag saagar dutar kiau tareeai bin har gur paar na paaee |1|
English: How can this terrifying world-ocean be crossed over? Without the Lord - Guru, it cannot be crossed. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਹਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: tujh bin avar na koee mere piaare tujh bin avar na koe hare |
English: Without You, there is no other at all, O my Beloved; without you, there is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬੀ ਰੰਗੀ ਰੂਪੀ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sarabee rangee roopee toonhai tis bakhase jis nadar kare |1| rahaau |
English: You are in all colors and forms; he alone is forgiven, upon whom You bestow Your Glance of Grace. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਸੁ ਬੁਰੀ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਨ ਦੇਵੈ ਪਿਰ ਸਿਉ ਮਿਲਣ ਨ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: saas buree ghar vaas na devai pir siau milan na dee buree |
English: Maya, my mother-in-law, is evil; she does not let me live in my own home. The vicious one does not let me meet with my Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਖੀ ਸਾਜਨੀ ਕੇ ਹਉ ਚਰਨ ਸਰੇਵਉ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਧਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sakhee saajanee ke hau charan sarevau har gur kirapaa te nadar dharee |2|
English: I serve at the feet of my companions and friends; the Lord has showered me with His Mercy, through Guru's Grace. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਤੁਮ ਸਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਨ ਅਵਰੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aap beechaar maar man dekhiaa tum saa meet na avar koee |
English: Reflecting upon my self, and conquering my mind, I have seen that there is no other friend like You.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਵ ਹੀ ਰਹਣਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jiau toon raakheh tiv hee rahanaa dukh sukh deveh kareh soee |3|
English: As You keep me, so do I live. You are the Giver of peace and pleasure. Whatever You do, comes to pass. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਦੋਊ ਬਿਨਾਸਤ ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਭਈ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa manasaa doaoo binaasat trihu gun aas niraas bhee |
English: Hope and desire have both been dispelled; I have renounced my longing for the three qualities.

Gurbani: ਤੁਰੀਆਵਸਥਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਲਹੀ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: tureeaavasathaa guramukh paaeeai sant sabhaa kee ott lahee |4|
English: The Gurmukh obtains the state of ecstasy, taking to the Shelter of the Saints' Congregation. ||4||

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਗਲੇ ਸਭਿ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: giaan dhiaan sagale sabh jap tap jis har hiradai alakh abhevaa |
English: All wisdom and meditation, all chanting and penance, come to one whose heart is filled with the Invisible, Inscrutable Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਸਹਜ ਸੇਵਾ ॥੫॥੨੨॥
Transliteration: naanak raam naam man raataa guramat paae sehaj sevaa |5|22|
English: O Nanak, one whose mind is imbued with the Lord's Name, finds the Guru's Teachings, and intuitively serves. ||5||22||

[Ang 356 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਪੰਚਪਦੇ₂ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 panchapade₂ |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl, Panch-Padhay:

Gurbani: ਮੋਹੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਭ ਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: mohu kuttanb mohu sabh kaar |
English: Your attachment to your family, your attachment to all your affairs

Gurbani: ਮੋਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਤਜਹੁ ਸਗਲ ਵੇਕਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mohu tum tajahu sagal vekaar |1|
English: - renounce all your attachments, for they are all corrupt. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੋਹੁ ਅਰੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਤਜਹੁ ਤੁਮੑ ਬੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: mohu ar bharam tajahu tuma beer |
English: Renounce your attachments and doubts, O brother,

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੇ ਰਵੈ ਸਰੀਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saach naam ride ravai sareer |1| rahaau |
English: and dwell upon the True Name within your heart and body. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਾ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sach naam jaa nav nidh paaee |
English: When one receives the nine treasures of the True Name,

Gurbani: ਰੋਵੈ ਪੂਤੁ ਨ ਕਲਪੈ ਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: rovai poot na kalapai maaee |2|
English: his children do not weep, and his mother does not grieve. ||2||

Gurbani: ਏਤੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਡੂਬਾ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: et mohi ddoobaa sansaar |
English: In this attachment, the world is drowning.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੋਈ ਉਤਰੈ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: guramukh koee utarai paar |3|
English: Few are the Gurmukhs who swim across. ||3||

Gurbani: ਏਤੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: et mohi fir joonee paeh |
English: In this attachment, people are reincarnated over and over again.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹੇ ਲਾਗਾ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: mohe laagaa jam pur jaeh |4|
English: Attached to emotional attachment, they go to the city of Death. ||4||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਲੇ ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: gur deekhiaa le jap tap kamaeh |
English: You have received the Guru's Teachings - now practice meditation and penance.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਤੂਟੈ ਨਾ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: naa mohu toottai naa thaae paeh |5|
English: If attachment is not broken, no one is approved. ||5||

Gurbani: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਏਹੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: nadar kare taa ehu mohu jaae |
English: But if He bestows His Glance of Grace, then this attachment departs.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੬॥੨੩॥
Transliteration: naanak har siau rahai samaae |6|23|
English: O Nanak, then one remains merged in the Lord. ||6||23||

[Ang 356 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਸਚੁ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: aap kare sach alakh apaar |
English: He Himself does everything, the True, Invisible, Infinite Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਪਾਪੀ ਤੂੰ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: hau paapee toon bakhasanahaar |1|
English: I am a sinner, You are the Forgiver. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: teraa bhaanaa sabh kichh hovai |
English: By Your Will, everything come to pass.

Gurbani: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕੀਚੈ ਅੰਤਿ ਵਿਗੋਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: manahatth keechai ant vigovai |1| rahaau |
English: One who acts in stubborn-mindedness is ruined in the end. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਕੂੜਿ ਵਿਆਪੀ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh kee mat koorr viaapee |
English: The intellect of the self-willed manmukh is engrossed in falsehood.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਪਾਪਿ ਸੰਤਾਪੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bin har simaran paap santaapee |2|
English: Without the meditative remembrance of the Lord, it suffers in sin. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਲੇਵਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: duramat tiaag laahaa kichh levahu |
English: Renounce evil-mindedness, and you shall reap the rewards.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਉਪਜੈ ਸੋ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਹੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jo upajai so alakh abhevahu |3|
English: Whoever is born, comes through the Unknowable and Mysterious Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਹਮਰਾ ਸਖਾ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa hamaraa sakhaa sahaaee |
English: Such is my Friend and Companion;

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: gur har miliaa bhagat drirraaee |4|
English: meeting with the Guru, the Lord, devotion was implanted within me. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਗਲਂੀ ਸਉਦਂੀ ਤੋਟਾ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: sagalanee saudanee tottaa aavai |
English: In all other transactions, one suffers loss.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੫॥੨੪॥
Transliteration: naanak raam naam man bhaavai |5|24|
English: The Name of the Lord is pleasing to Nanak's mind. ||5||24||

[Ang 356 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ₄ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 chaupade₄ |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl, Chau-Padhay:

Gurbani: ਵਿਦਿਆ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਤਾਂ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: vidiaa veechaaree taan praupakaaree |
English: Contemplate and reflect upon knowledge, and you will become a benefactor to others.

Gurbani: ਜਾਂ ਪੰਚ ਰਾਸੀ ਤਾਂ ਤੀਰਥ ਵਾਸੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jaan panch raasee taan teerath vaasee |1|
English: When you conquer the five passions, then you shall come to dwell at the sacred shrine of pilgrimage. ||1||

Gurbani: ਘੁੰਘਰੂ ਵਾਜੈ ਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: ghungharoo vaajai je man laagai |
English: You shall hear the vibrations of the tinkling bells, when your mind is held steady.

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਜਮੁ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੇ ਮੋ ਸਿਉ ਆਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tau jam kahaa kare mo siau aagai |1| rahaau |
English: So what can the Messenger of Death do to me hereafter? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸੀ ਤਉ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: aas niraasee tau saniaasee |
English: When you abandon hope and desire, then you become a true Sannyaasi.

Gurbani: ਜਾਂ ਜਤੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਤਾਂ ਕਾਇਆ ਭੋਗੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jaan jat jogee taan kaaeaa bhogee |2|
English: When the Yogi practices abstinence, then he enjoys his body. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦਇਆ ਦਿਗੰਬਰੁ ਦੇਹ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: deaa diganbar deh beechaaree |
English: Through compassion, the naked hermit reflects upon his inner self.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਮਰੈ ਅਵਰਾ ਨਹ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aap marai avaraa neh maaree |3|
English: He slays his own self, instead of slaying others. ||3||

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਤੂ ਹੋਰਿ ਵੇਸ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: ek too hor ves bahutere |
English: You, O Lord, are the One, but You have so many Forms.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਚੋਜ ਨ ਤੇਰੇ ॥੪॥੨੫॥
Transliteration: naanak jaanai choj na tere |4|25|
English: Nanak does not know Your wondrous plays. ||4||25||

[Ang 356 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਨ ਭਰੀਆ ਗੁਣ ਕਰਿ ਧੋਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: ek na bhareea gun kar dhovaa |
English: I am not stained by only one sin, that could be washed clean by virtue.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਸਹੁ ਜਾਗੈ ਹਉ ਨਿਸਿ ਭਰਿ ਸੋਵਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: meraa sahu jaagai hau nis bhar sovaa |1|
English: My Husband Lord is awake, while I sleep through the entire night of my life. ||1||

Gurbani: ਇਉ ਕਿਉ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਹੋਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: eiau kiau kant piaaree hovaa |
English: In this way, how can I become dear to my Husband Lord?

Gurbani: ਸਹੁ ਜਾਗੈ ਹਉ ਨਿਸ ਭਰਿ ਸੋਵਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sahu jaagai hau nis bhar sovaa |1| rahaau |
English: My Husband Lord remains awake, while I sleep through the entire night of my life. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਸ ਪਿਆਸੀ ਸੇਜੈ ਆਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: aas piaasee sejai aavaa |
English: With hope and desire, I approach His Bed,

Gurbani: ਆਗੈ ਸਹ ਭਾਵਾ ਕਿ ਨ ਭਾਵਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aagai seh bhaavaa ki na bhaavaa |2|
English: but I do not know whether He will be pleased with me or not. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਜਾਨਾ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਇਗਾ ਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa jaanaa kiaa hoeigaa ree maaee |
English: How do I know what will happen to me, O my mother?

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har darasan bin rehan na jaaee |1| rahaau |
English: Without the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, I cannot survive. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਨ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਤਿਸ ਨ ਬੁਝਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: prem na chaakhiaa meree tis na bujhaanee |
English: I have not tasted His Love, and my thirst is not quenched.

Gurbani: ਗਇਆ ਸੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਧਨ ਪਛੁਤਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: geaa su joban dhan pachhutaanee |3|
English: My beautiful youth has run away, and now I, the soul-bride, repent and regret. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅਜੈ ਸੁ ਜਾਗਉ ਆਸ ਪਿਆਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: ajai su jaagau aas piaasee |
English: Even now, I am held by hope and desire.

Gurbani: ਭਈਲੇ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਰਹਉ ਨਿਰਾਸੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bheele udaasee rhau niraasee |1| rahaau |
English: I am depressed; I have no hope at all. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਖੋਇ ਕਰੇ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: haumai khoe kare seegaar |
English: She overcomes her egotism, and adorns herself;

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਸੇਜੈ ਰਵੈ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: tau kaaman sejai ravai bhataar |4|
English: the Husband Lord now ravishes and enjoys the soul-bride on His Bed. ||4||

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੰਤੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: tau naanak kantai man bhaavai |
English: Then, O Nanak, the bride becomes pleasing to the Mind of her Husband Lord;

Gurbani: ਛੋਡਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਅਪਣੇ ਖਸਮ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥੨੬॥
Transliteration: chhodd vaddaaee apane khasam samaavai |1| rahaau |26|
English: she sheds her self-conceit, and is absorbed in her Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||26||

[Ang 357 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪੇਵਕੜੈ ਧਨ ਖਰੀ ਇਆਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: pevakarrai dhan kharee eaanee |
English: In this world of my father's house, I, the soul-bride, have been very childish;

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਹ ਕੀ ਮੈ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tis seh kee mai saar na jaanee |1|
English: I did not realize the value of my Husband Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਹੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: sahu meraa ek doojaa nahee koee |
English: My Husband is the One; there is no other like Him.

Gurbani: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: nadar kare melaavaa hoee |1| rahaau |
English: If He bestows His Glance of Grace, then I shall meet Him. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਧਨ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: saahurarrai dhan saach pachhaaniaa |
English: In the next world of my in-law's house, I, the the soul-bride, shall realize Truth;

Gurbani: ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਅਪਣਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sehaj subhaae apanaa pir jaaniaa |2|
English: I shall come to know the celestial peace of my Husband Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਐਸੀ ਮਤਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee aisee mat aavai |
English: By Guru's Grace, such wisdom comes to me,

Gurbani: ਤਾਂ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਕੰਤੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: taan kaaman kantai man bhaavai |3|
English: so that the soul-bride becomes pleasing to the Mind of the Husband Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹਤੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਭੈ ਭਾਵ ਕਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: kehat naanak bhai bhaav kaa kare seegaar |
English: Says Nanak, she who adorns herself with the Love and the Fear of God,

Gurbani: ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੇਜੈ ਰਵੈ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੨੭॥
Transliteration: sad hee sejai ravai bhataar |4|27|
English: enjoys her Husband Lord forever on His Bed. ||4||27||

[Ang 357 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨ ਕਿਸ ਕਾ ਪੂਤੁ ਨ ਕਿਸ ਕੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: n kis kaa poot na kis kee maaee |
English: No one is anyone else's son, and no one is anyone else's mother.

Gurbani: ਝੂਠੈ ਮੋਹਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jhootthai mohi bharam bhulaaee |1|
English: Through false attachments, people wander around in doubt. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਹਉ ਕੀਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: mere saahib hau keetaa teraa |
English: O My Lord and Master, I am created by You.

Gurbani: ਜਾਂ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਜਪੀ ਨਾਉ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaan toon dehi japee naau teraa |1| rahaau |
English: If You give it to me, I will chant Your Name. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਹੁਤੇ ਅਉਗਣ ਕੂਕੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: bahute aaugan kookai koee |
English: That person who is filled with all sorts of sins may pray at the Lord's Door,

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਬਖਸੇ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jaa tis bhaavai bakhase soee |2|
English: but he is forgiven only when the Lord so wills. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee duramat khoee |
English: By Guru's Grace, evil-mindedness is destroyed.

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jeh dekhaa teh eko soee |3|
English: Wherever I look, there I find the One Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਐਸੀ ਮਤਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: kehat naanak aisee mat aavai |
English: Says Nanak, if one comes to such an understanding,

Gurbani: ਤਾਂ ਕੋ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੨੮॥
Transliteration: taan ko sache sach samaavai |4|28|
English: then he is absorbed into the Truest of the True. ||4||28||

[Ang 357 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 dupade |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl, Dho-Padhay:

Gurbani: ਤਿਤੁ ਸਰਵਰੜੈ ਭਈਲੇ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਕੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: tit saravararrai bheele nivaasaa paanee paavak tineh keea |
English: In that pool of the world, the people have their homes; there, the Lord has created water and fire.

Gurbani: ਪੰਕਜੁ ਮੋਹ ਪਗੁ ਨਹੀ ਚਾਲੈ ਹਮ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਡੂਬੀਅਲੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: pankaj moh pag nahee chaalai ham dekhaa teh ddoobeeale |1|
English: In the mud of earthly attachment, their feet have become mired, and I have seen them drowning there. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਏਕੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਸਿ ਮੂੜ ਮਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: man ek na chetas moorr manaa |
English: O foolish people, why don't you remember the One Lord?

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਲਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har bisarat tere gun galiaa |1| rahaau |
English: Forgetting the Lord, your virtues shall wither away. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਹਉ ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਨਹੀ ਪੜਿਆ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: naa hau jatee satee nahee parriaa moorakh mugadhaa janam bheaa |
English: I am not a celibate, nor am I truthful, nor a scholar; I was born foolish and ignorant.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾ ਜਿਨੑ ਤੂੰ ਨਾਹੀ ਵੀਸਰਿਆ ॥੨॥੨੯॥
Transliteration: pranavat naanak tina kee saranaa jina toon naahee veesariaa |2|29|
English: Prays Nanak, I seek the Sanctuary of those who do not forget You, Lord. ||2||29||

[Ang 357 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਛਿਅ ਘਰ ਛਿਅ ਗੁਰ ਛਿਅ ਉਪਦੇਸ ॥
Transliteration: chhia ghar chhia gur chhia upades |
English: There are six systems of philosophy, six teachers, and six doctrines;

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਗੁਰੁ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਸ ਅਨੇਕ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur gur eko ves anek |1|
English: but the Teacher of teachers is the One Lord, who appears in so many forms. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੈ ਘਰਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jai ghar karate keerat hoe |
English: That system, where the Praises of the Creator are sung

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਤੋਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: so ghar raakh vaddaaee tohi |1| rahaau |
English: - follow that system; in it rests greatness. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਵਿਸੁਏ ਚਸਿਆ ਘੜੀਆ ਪਹਰਾ ਥਿਤੀ ਵਾਰੀ ਮਾਹੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: visue chasiaa gharreea paharaa thitee vaaree maahu bheaa |
English: As the seconds, minutes, hours, days, weekdays months

Gurbani: ਸੂਰਜੁ ਏਕੋ ਰੁਤਿ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
Transliteration: sooraj eko rut anek |
English: And seasons all originate from the one sun,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਵੇਸ ॥੨॥੩੦॥
Transliteration: naanak karate ke kete ves |2|30|
English: O Nanak, so do all forms originate from the One Creator. ||2||30||

[Ang 358 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੩ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa ghar 3 mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, Third House, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਲਖ ਲਸਕਰ ਲਖ ਵਾਜੇ ਨੇਜੇ ਲਖ ਉਠਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਲਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: lakh lasakar lakh vaaje neje lakh utth kareh salaam |
English: You may have thousands of armies, thousands of marching bands and lances, and thousands of men to rise and salute you.

Gurbani: ਲਖਾ ਉਪਰਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਸਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਲਖ ਉਠਿ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: lakhaa upar furamaaeis teree lakh utth raakheh maan |
English: Your rule may extend over thousands of miles, and thousands of men may rise to honor you.

Gurbani: ਜਾਂ ਪਤਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਰਾਫਲ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jaan pat lekhai naa pavai taan sabh niraafal kaam |1|
English: But, if your honor is of no account to the Lord, then all of your ostentatious show is useless. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਜਗੁ ਧੰਧਾ ॥
Transliteration: har ke naam binaa jag dhandhaa |
English: Without the Name of the Lord, the world is in turmoil.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਭੋਲਾ ਭੀ ਸੋ ਅੰਧੋ ਅੰਧਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: je bahutaa samajhaaeeai bholaa bhee so andho andhaa |1| rahaau |
English: Even though the fool may be taught again and again, he remains the blindest of the blind. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਲਖ ਖਟੀਅਹਿ ਲਖ ਸੰਜੀਅਹਿ ਖਾਜਹਿ ਲਖ ਆਵਹਿ ਲਖ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: lakh khatteeeh lakh sanjeeeh khaajeh lakh aaveh lakh jaeh |
English: You may earn thousands, collect thousands, and spend thousands of dollars; thousands may come, and thousands may go.

Gurbani: ਜਾਂ ਪਤਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਜੀਅ ਕਿਥੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jaan pat lekhai naa pavai taan jeea kithai fir paeh |2|
English: But, if your honor is of no account to the Lord, then where will you go to find a safe haven? ||2||

Gurbani: ਲਖ ਸਾਸਤ ਸਮਝਾਵਣੀ ਲਖ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਹਿ ਪੁਰਾਣ ॥
Transliteration: lakh saasat samajhaavanee lakh panddit parreh puraan |
English: Thousands of Shaastras may be explained to the mortal, and thousands of Pandits may read the Puraanas to him;

Gurbani: ਜਾਂ ਪਤਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਭੇ ਕੁਪਰਵਾਣ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jaan pat lekhai naa pavai taan sabhe kuparavaan |3|
English: but, if his honor is of no account to the Lord, then all of this is unacceptable. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਚ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sach naam pat aoopajai karam naam karataar |
English: Honor comes from the True Name, the Name of the Merciful Creator.

Gurbani: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜੇ ਵਸੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੧॥
Transliteration: ahinis hiradai je vasai naanak nadaree paar |4|1|31|
English: If it abides in the heart, day and night, O Nanak, then the mortal shall swim across, by His Grace. ||4||1||31||

[Ang 358 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦੀਵਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: deevaa meraa ek naam dukh vich paaeaa tel |
English: The One Name is my lamp; I have put the oil of suffering into it.

Gurbani: ਉਨਿ ਚਾਨਣਿ ਓਹੁ ਸੋਖਿਆ ਚੂਕਾ ਜਮ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਲੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aun chaanan ohu sokhiaa chookaa jam siau mel |1|
English: Its flame has dried up this oil, and I have escaped my meeting with the Messenger of Death. ||1||

Gurbani: ਲੋਕਾ ਮਤ ਕੋ ਫਕੜਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: lokaa mat ko fakarr paae |
English: O people, do not make fun of me.

Gurbani: ਲਖ ਮੜਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਏਕਠੇ ਏਕ ਰਤੀ ਲੇ ਭਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: lakh marriaa kar ekatthe ek ratee le bhaeh |1| rahaau |
English: Thousands of wooden logs, piled up together, need only a tiny flame to burn. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪਤਲਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਕੇਸਉ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: pindd patal meree kesau kiriaa sach naam karataar |
English: The Lord is my festive dish, of rice balls on leafy plates; the True Name of the Creator Lord is my funeral ceremony.

Gurbani: ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਆਗੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਏਹੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aithai othai aagai paachhai ehu meraa aadhaar |2|
English: Here and hereafter, in the past and in the future, this is my support. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੰਗ ਬਨਾਰਸਿ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਨਾਵੈ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gang banaaras sifat tumaaree naavai aatam raau |
English: The Lord's Praise is my River Ganges and my city of Benares; my soul takes its sacred cleansing bath there.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਨਾਵਣੁ ਤਾਂ ਥੀਐ ਜਾਂ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਭਾਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sachaa naavan taan theeai jaan ahinis laagai bhaau |3|
English: That becomes my true cleansing bath, if night and day, I enshrine love for You. ||3||

Gurbani: ਇਕ ਲੋਕੀ ਹੋਰੁ ਛਮਿਛਰੀ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਵਟਿ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: eik lokee hor chhamichharee braahaman vatt pindd khaae |
English: The rice balls are offered to the gods and the dead ancestors, but it is the Brahmins who eat them!

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਬਖਸੀਸ ਕਾ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨਿਖੂਟਸਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੪॥੨॥੩੨॥
Transliteration: naanak pindd bakhasees kaa kabahoon nikhoottas naeh |4|2|32|
English: O Nanak, the rice balls of the Lord are a gift which is never exhausted. ||4||2||32||

[Ang 358 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੪ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa ghar 4 mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, Fourth House, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਦੇਵਤਿਆ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਤੀਰਥ ਕੀਏ ॥
Transliteration: devatiaa darasan kai taaee dookh bhookh teerath kee |
English: The Gods, yearning for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, suffered through pain and hunger at the sacred shrines.

Gurbani: ਜੋਗੀ ਜਤੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਤੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਭਗਵੇ ਭੇਖ ਭਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jogee jatee jugat meh rahate kar kar bhagave bhekh bhe |1|
English: The yogis and the celibates live their disciplined lifestyle, while others wear saffron robes and become hermits. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: tau kaaran saahibaa rang rate |
English: For Your sake, O Lord Master, they are imbued with love.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਅਨੇਕਾ ਰੂਪ ਅਨੰਤਾ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਕੇਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tere naam anekaa roop anantaa kehan na jaahee tere gun kete |1| rahaau |
English: Your Names are so many, and Your Forms are endless. No one can tell how may Glorious Virtues You have. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦਰ ਘਰ ਮਹਲਾ ਹਸਤੀ ਘੋੜੇ ਛੋਡਿ ਵਿਲਾਇਤਿ ਦੇਸ ਗਏ ॥
Transliteration: dar ghar mahalaa hasatee ghorre chhodd vilaaeit des ge |
English: Leaving behind hearth and home, palaces, elephants, horses and native lands, mortals have journeyed to foreign lands.

Gurbani: ਪੀਰ ਪੇਕਾਂਬਰ ਸਾਲਿਕ ਸਾਦਿਕ ਛੋਡੀ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਥਾਇ ਪਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: peer pekaanbar saalik saadik chhoddee duneea thaae pe |2|
English: The spiritual leaders, prophets, seers and men of faith renounced the world, and became acceptable. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਾਦ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਤਜੀਅਲੇ ਕਾਪੜ ਛੋਡੇ ਚਮੜ ਲੀਏ ॥
Transliteration: saad sehaj sukh ras kas tajeeale kaaparr chhodde chamarr lee |
English: Renouncing tasty delicacies, comfort, happiness and pleasures, some have abandoned their clothes and now wear skins.

Gurbani: ਦੁਖੀਏ ਦਰਦਵੰਦ ਦਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਦਰਵੇਸ ਭਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: dukhee daradavand dar terai naam rate daraves bhe |3|
English: Those who suffer in pain, imbued with Your Name, have become beggars at Your Door. ||3||

Gurbani: ਖਲੜੀ ਖਪਰੀ ਲਕੜੀ ਚਮੜੀ ਸਿਖਾ ਸੂਤੁ ਧੋਤੀ ਕੀਨੑੀ ॥
Transliteration: khalarree khaparee lakarree chamarree sikhaa soot dhotee keenaee |
English: Some wear skins, and carry begging bowls, bearing wooden staffs, and sitting on deer skins. Others raise their hair in tufts and wear sacred threads and loin-cloths.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਹਉ ਸਾਂਗੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਕੈਸੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੩॥
Transliteration: toon saahib hau saangee teraa pranavai naanak jaat kaisee |4|1|33|
English: You are the Lord Master, I am just Your puppet. Prays Nanak, what is my social status to be? ||4||1||33||

[Ang 359 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੫ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa ghar 5 mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth House, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਭੀਤਰਿ ਪੰਚ ਗੁਪਤ ਮਨਿ ਵਾਸੇ ॥
Transliteration: bheetar panch gupat man vaase |
English: The five evil passions dwell hidden within the mind.

Gurbani: ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਹਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਭਵਹਿ ਉਦਾਸੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: thir na raheh jaise bhaveh udaase |1|
English: They do not remain still, but move around like wanderers. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੇਤੀ ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: man meraa deaal setee thir na rahai |
English: My soul does not stay held by the Merciful Lord.

Gurbani: ਲੋਭੀ ਕਪਟੀ ਪਾਪੀ ਪਾਖੰਡੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਅਧਿਕ ਲਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: lobhee kapattee paapee paakhanddee maaeaa adhik lagai |1| rahaau |
English: It is greedy, deceitful, sinful and hypocritical, and totally attached to Maya. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਫੂਲ ਮਾਲਾ ਗਲਿ ਪਹਿਰਉਗੀ ਹਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: fool maalaa gal pahiraugee haaro |
English: I will decorate my neck with garlands of flowers.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲੈਗਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਤਬ ਕਰਉਗੀ ਸੀਗਾਰੋ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: milaigaa preetam tab kraugee seegaaro |2|
English: When I meet my Beloved, then I will put on my decorations. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਸਖੀ ਹਮ ਏਕੁ ਭਤਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: panch sakhee ham ek bhataaro |
English: I have five companions and one Spouse.

Gurbani: ਪੇਡਿ ਲਗੀ ਹੈ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਚਾਲਣਹਾਰੋ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: pedd lagee hai jeearraa chaalanahaaro |3|
English: It is ordained from the very beginning, that the soul must ultimately depart. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਸਖੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਰੁਦਨੁ ਕਰੇਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: panch sakhee mil rudan karehaa |
English: The five companions will lament together.

Gurbani: ਸਾਹੁ ਪਜੂਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੇਖਾ ਦੇਹਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੪॥
Transliteration: saahu pajootaa pranavat naanak lekhaa dehaa |4|1|34|
English: When the soul is trapped, prays Nanak, it is called to account. ||4||1||34||

[Ang 359 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੬ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa ghar 6 mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, Sixth House, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਮੋਤੀ ਜੇ ਗਹਣਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਉਣੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੂਤ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: man motee je gahanaa hovai paun hovai soot dhaaree |
English: If the pearl of the mind is strung like a jewel on the thread of the breath,

Gurbani: ਖਿਮਾ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਤਨਿ ਪਹਿਰੈ ਰਾਵੈ ਲਾਲ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: khimaa seegaar kaaman tan pahirai raavai laal piaaree |1|
English: and the soul-bride adorns her body with compassion, then the Beloved Lord will enjoy His lovely bride. ||1||

Gurbani: ਲਾਲ ਬਹੁ ਗੁਣਿ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਮੋਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: laal bahu gun kaaman mohee |
English: O my Love, I am fascinated by Your many glories;

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਹੋਹਿ ਨ ਅਵਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tere gun hohi na avaree |1| rahaau |
English: Your Glorious Virtues are not found in any other. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਾਰੁ ਕੰਠਿ ਲੇ ਪਹਿਰੈ ਦਾਮੋਦਰੁ ਦੰਤੁ ਲੇਈ ॥
Transliteration: har har haar kantth le pahirai daamodar dant leee |
English: If the bride wears the garland of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, around her neck, and if she uses the toothbrush of the Lord;

Gurbani: ਕਰ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਕੰਗਨ ਪਹਿਰੈ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਧਰੇਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kar kar karataa kangan pahirai in bidh chit dhareee |2|
English: and if she fashions and wears the bracelet of the Creator Lord around her wrist, then she shall hold her consciousness steady. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨੁ ਕਰ ਮੁੰਦਰੀ ਪਹਿਰੈ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਪਟੁ ਲੇਈ ॥
Transliteration: madhusoodan kar mundaree pahirai paramesar patt leee |
English: She should make the Lord, the Slayer of demons, her ring, and take the Transcendent Lord as her silken clothes.

Gurbani: ਧੀਰਜੁ ਧੜੀ ਬੰਧਾਵੈ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਸ੍ਰੀਰੰਗੁ ਸੁਰਮਾ ਦੇਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: dheeraj dharree bandhaavai kaaman sreerang suramaa deee |3|
English: The soul-bride should weave patience into the braids of her hair, and apply the lotion of the Lord, the Great Lover. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਜੇ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਜਾਲੇ ਕਾਇਆ ਸੇਜ ਕਰੇਈ ॥
Transliteration: man mandar je deepak jaale kaaeaa sej kareee |
English: If she lights the lamp in the mansion of her mind, and makes her body the bed of the Lord,

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨ ਰਾਉ ਜਬ ਸੇਜੈ ਆਵੈ ਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਭੋਗੁ ਕਰੇਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੫॥
Transliteration: giaan raau jab sejai aavai ta naanak bhog kareee |4|1|35|
English: then, when the King of spiritual wisdom comes to her bed, He shall take her, and enjoy her. ||4||1||35||

[Ang 359 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕੀਤਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: keetaa hovai kare karaaeaa tis kiaa kaheeai bhaaee |
English: The created being acts as he is made to act; what can be said to him, O Siblings of Destiny?

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੋ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਕੀਤੇ ਕਿਆ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jo kichh karanaa so kar rahiaa keete kiaa chaturaaee |1|
English: Whatever the Lord is to do, He is doing; what cleverness could be used to affect Him? ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਭਲਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: teraa hukam bhalaa tudh bhaavai |
English: The Order of Your Will is so sweet, O Lord; this is pleasing to You.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: naanak taa kau milai vaddaaee saache naam samaavai |1| rahaau |
English: O Nanak, he alone is honored with greatness, who is absorbed in the True Name. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਤੁ ਪਇਆ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: kirat peaa paravaanaa likhiaa baahurr hukam na hoee |
English: The deeds are done according to pre-ordained destiny; no one can turn back this Order.

Gurbani: ਜੈਸਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤੈਸਾ ਪੜਿਆ ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jaisaa likhiaa taisaa parriaa mett na sakai koee |2|
English: As it is written, so it comes to pass; no one can erase it. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਦਰਗਹ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਬੋਲੈ ਨਾਉ ਪਵੈ ਬਾਜਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: je ko daragah bahutaa bolai naau pavai baajaaree |
English: He who talks on and on in the Lord's Court is known as a joker.

Gurbani: ਸਤਰੰਜ ਬਾਜੀ ਪਕੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਚੀ ਆਵੈ ਸਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sataranj baajee pakai naahee kachee aavai saaree |3|
English: He is not successful in the game of chess, and his chessmen do not reach their goal. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਪੜਿਆ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਬੀਨਾ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਮੰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: naa ko parriaa panddit beenaa naa ko moorakh mandaa |
English: By himself, no one is literate, learned or wise; no one is ignorant or evil.

Gurbani: ਬੰਦੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕਹੀਐ ਬੰਦਾ ॥੪॥੨॥੩੬॥
Transliteration: bandee andar sifat karaae taa kau kaheeai bandaa |4|2|36|
English: When, as a slave, one praises the Lord, only then is he known as a human being. ||4||2||36||

[Ang 359 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨੈ ਮਹਿ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਖਿੰਥਾ ਖਿਮਾ ਹਢਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa sabad manai meh mundraa khinthaa khimaa hadtaavau |
English: Let the Word of the Guru's Shabad be the ear-rings in your mind, and wear the patched coat of tolerance.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਭਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਉ ਸਹਜ ਜੋਗ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jo kichh karai bhalaa kar maanau sehaj jog nidh paavau |1|
English: Whatever the Lord does, look upon that as good; thus you shall obtain the treasure of Sehj Yoga. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਾਬਾ ਜੁਗਤਾ ਜੀਉ ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗ ਜੋਗੀ ਪਰਮ ਤੰਤ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਗੰ ॥
Transliteration: baabaa jugataa jeeo jugah jug jogee param tant meh jogan |
English: O father, the soul which is united in union as a Yogi, remains united in the supreme essence throughout the ages.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਗਿਆਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਰਸ ਭੋਗੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: amrit naam niranjan paaeaa giaan kaaeaa ras bhogan |1| rahaau |
English: One who has obtained the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Immaculate Lord - his body enjoys the pleasure of spiritual wisdom. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਿਵ ਨਗਰੀ ਮਹਿ ਆਸਣਿ ਬੈਸਉ ਕਲਪ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਬਾਦੰ ॥
Transliteration: siv nagaree meh aasan baisau kalap tiaagee baadan |
English: In the Lord's City, he sits in his Yogic posture, and he forsakes his desires and conflicts.

Gurbani: ਸਿੰਙੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਧੁਨਿ ਸੋਹੈ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਦੰ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: singee sabad sadaa dhun sohai ahinis poorai naadan |2|
English: The sound of the horn ever rings out its beautiful melody, and day and night, he is filled with the sound current of the Naad. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਮਤਿ ਡੰਡਾ ਵਰਤਮਾਨ ਬਿਭੂਤੰ ॥
Transliteration: pat veechaar giaan mat ddanddaa varatamaan bibhootan |
English: My cup is reflective meditation, and spiritual wisdom is my walking stick; to dwell in the Lord's Presence is the ashes I apply to my body.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਅਤੀਤੰ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har keerat raharaas hamaaree guramukh panth ateetan |3|
English: The Praise of the Lord is my occupation; and to live as Gurmukh is my pure religion. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਗਲੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਸੰਮਿਆ ਨਾਨਾ ਵਰਨ ਅਨੇਕੰ ॥
Transliteration: sagalee jot hamaaree samiaa naanaa varan anekan |
English: My arm-rest is to see the Lord's Light in all, although their forms and colors are so numerous.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਣਿ ਭਰਥਰਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਲਿਵ ਏਕੰ ॥੪॥੩॥੩੭॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak sun bharathar jogee paarabraham liv ekan |4|3|37|
English: Says Nanak, listen, O Bharthari Yogi: love only the Supreme Lord God. ||4||3||37||

[Ang 360 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਧਾਵੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: gurr kar giaan dhiaan kar dhaavai kar karanee kas paaeeai |
English: Make spiritual wisdom your molasses, and meditation your scented flowers; let good deeds be the herbs.

Gurbani: ਭਾਠੀ ਭਵਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕਾ ਪੋਚਾ ਇਤੁ ਰਸਿ ਅਮਿਉ ਚੁਆਈਐ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bhaatthee bhavan prem kaa pochaa it ras amiau chuaaeeai |1|
English: Let devotional faith be the distilling fire, and your love the ceramic cup. Thus the sweet nectar of life is distilled. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਾਬਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਤਵਾਰੋ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਸਹਜ ਰੰਗ ਰਚਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: baabaa man matavaaro naam ras peevai sehaj rang rach rahiaa |
English: O Baba, the mind is intoxicated with the Naam, drinking in its Nectar. It remains absorbed in the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਬਨੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਨਾਹਦ ਗਹਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ahinis banee prem liv laagee sabad anaahad gahiaa |1| rahaau |
English: Night and day, remaining attached to the Love of the Lord, the celestial music of the Shabad resounds. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪੀਆਏ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: pooraa saach piaalaa sahaje tiseh peeae jaa kau nadar kare |
English: The Perfect Lord naturally gives the cup of Truth, to the one upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਿਆ ਮਦਿ ਛੂਛੈ ਭਾਉ ਧਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: amrit kaa vaapaaree hovai kiaa mad chhoochhai bhaau dhare |2|
English: One who trades in this Nectar - how could he ever love the wine of the world? ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਖੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਪੀਵਤ ਹੀ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur kee saakhee amrit baanee peevat hee paravaan bheaa |
English: The Teachings of the Guru, the Ambrosial Bani - drinking them in, one becomes acceptable and renowned.

Gurbani: ਦਰ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠੈ ਕਰੈ ਕਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: dar darasan kaa preetam hovai mukat baikuntthai karai kiaa |3|
English: Unto the one who loves the Lord's Court, and the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, of what use is liberation or paradise? ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਿਫਤੀ ਰਤਾ ਸਦ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਜੂਐ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: sifatee rataa sad bairaagee jooai janam na haarai |
English: Imbued with the Lord's Praises, one is forever a Bairaagee, a renunciate, and one's life is not lost in the gamble.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਣਿ ਭਰਥਰਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਖੀਵਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰੈ ॥੪॥੪॥੩੮॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak sun bharathar jogee kheevaa amrit dhaarai |4|4|38|
English: Says Nanak, listen, O Bharthari Yogi: drink in the intoxicating nectar of the Lord. ||4||4||38||

[Ang 360 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਖੁਰਾਸਾਨ ਖਸਮਾਨਾ ਕੀਆ ਹਿੰਦੁਸਤਾਨੁ ਡਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: khuraasaan khasamaanaa keea hindusataan ddaraaeaa |
English: Having attacked Khuraasaan, Baabar terrified Hindustan.

Gurbani: ਆਪੈ ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਗਲੁ ਚੜਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aapai dos na deee karataa jam kar mugal charraaeaa |
English: The Creator Himself does not take the blame, but has sent the Mugal as the messenger of death.

Gurbani: ਏਤੀ ਮਾਰ ਪਈ ਕਰਲਾਣੇ ਤੈਂ ਕੀ ਦਰਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: etee maar pee karalaane tain kee darad na aaeaa |1|
English: There was so much slaughter that the people screamed. Didn't You feel compassion, Lord? ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਰਤਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: karataa toon sabhanaa kaa soee |
English: O Creator Lord, You are the Master of all.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਸਕਤਾ ਸਕਤੇ ਕਉ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਰੋਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: je sakataa sakate kau maare taa man ros na hoee |1| rahaau |
English: If some powerful man strikes out against another man, then no one feels any grief in their mind. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਕਤਾ ਸੀਹੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਪੈ ਵਗੈ ਖਸਮੈ ਸਾ ਪੁਰਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sakataa seehu maare pai vagai khasamai saa purasaaee |
English: But if a powerful tiger attacks a flock of sheep and kills them, then its master must answer for it.

Gurbani: ਰਤਨ ਵਿਗਾੜਿ ਵਿਗੋਏ ਕੁਤਂੀ ਮੁਇਆ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ratan vigaarr vigoe kutanee mueaa saar na kaaee |
English: This priceless country has been laid waste and defiled by dogs, and no one pays any attention to the dead.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਜੋੜਿ ਵਿਛੋੜੇ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aape jorr vichhorre aape vekh teree vaddiaaee |2|
English: You Yourself unite, and You Yourself separate; I gaze upon Your Glorious Greatness. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ਧਰਾਏ ਵਡਾ ਸਾਦ ਕਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: je ko naau dharaae vaddaa saad kare man bhaane |
English: One may give himself a great name, and revel in the pleasures of the mind,

Gurbani: ਖਸਮੈ ਨਦਰੀ ਕੀੜਾ ਆਵੈ ਜੇਤੇ ਚੁਗੈ ਦਾਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: khasamai nadaree keerraa aavai jete chugai daane |
English: but in the Eyes of the Lord and Master, he is just a worm, for all the corn that he eats.

Gurbani: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਤਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੇ ॥੩॥੫॥੩੯॥
Transliteration: mar mar jeevai taa kichh paae naanak naam vakhaane |3|5|39|
English: Only one who dies to his ego while yet alive, obtains the blessings, O Nanak, by chanting the Lord's Name. ||3||5||39||

[Ang 360 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: raag aasaa ghar 2 mahalaa 3 |
English: Raag Aasaa, Second House, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: har darasan paavai vaddabhaag |
English: The Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan is obtained by great good fortune.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਬੈਰਾਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad sachai bairaag |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, true detachment is obtained.

Gurbani: ਖਟੁ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: khatt darasan varatai varataaraa |
English: The six systems of philosophy are pervasive,

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur kaa darasan agam apaaraa |1|
English: but the Guru's system is profound and unequalled. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai darasan mukat gat hoe |
English: The Guru's system is the way to liberation.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਾ ਆਪਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saachaa aap vasai man soe |1| rahaau |
English: The True Lord Himself comes to dwell in the mind. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਉਧਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur darasan udharai sansaaraa |
English: Through the Guru's system, the world is saved,

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਲਾਏ ਭਾਉ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: je ko laae bhaau piaaraa |
English: if it is embraced with love and affection.

Gurbani: ਭਾਉ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਲਾਏ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhaau piaaraa laae viralaa koe |
English: How rare is that person who truly loves the Guru's Way.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur kai darasan sadaa sukh hoe |2|
English: Through the Guru's system, everlasting peace is obtained. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai darasan mokh duaar |
English: Through the Guru's system, the Door of Salvation is obtained.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੈ ਪਰਵਾਰ ਸਾਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sevai paravaar saadhaar |
English: Serving the True Guru, one's family is saved.

Gurbani: ਨਿਗੁਰੇ ਕਉ ਗਤਿ ਕਾਈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: nigure kau gat kaaee naahee |
