English: There is no salvation for those who have no Guru.

Gurbani: ਅਵਗਣਿ ਮੁਠੇ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਹੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: avagan mutthe chottaa khaahee |3|
English: Beguiled by worthless sins, they are struck down. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad sukh saant sareer |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the body finds peace and tranquility.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਪੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh taa kau lagai na peer |
English: The Gurmukh is not afflicted by pain.

Gurbani: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jamakaal tis nerr na aavai |
English: The Messenger of Death does not come near him.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੧॥੪੦॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh saach samaavai |4|1|40|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is absorbed in the True Lord. ||4||1||40||

[Ang 361 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 |
English: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਮੁਆ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabad muaa vichahu aap gavaae |
English: One who dies in the Word of the Shabad, eradicates his self-conceit from within.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur seve til na tamaae |
English: He serves the True Guru, with no iota of self-interest.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: nirbhau daataa sadaa man hoe |
English: The Fearless Lord, the Great Giver, ever abides in his mind.

Gurbani: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਪਾਏ ਭਾਗਿ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sachee baanee paae bhaag koe |1|
English: The True Bani of the Word is obtained only by good destiny. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਅਉਗੁਣ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: gun sangrahu vichahu aaugun jaeh |
English: So gather merits, and let your demerits depart from within you.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: poore gur kai sabad samaeh |1| rahaau |
English: You shall be absorbed into the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect Guru. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਣਾ ਕਾ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਗੁਣ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: gunaa kaa gaahak hovai so gun jaanai |
English: One who purchases merits, knows the value of these merits.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: amrit sabad naam vakhaanai |
English: He chants the Ambrosial Nectar of the Word, and the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸੂਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: saachee baanee soochaa hoe |
English: Through the True Bani of the Word, he becomes pure.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gun te naam paraapat hoe |2|
English: Through merit, the Name is obtained. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਅਮੋਲਕ ਪਾਏ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: gun amolak paae na jaeh |
English: The invaluable merits cannot be acquired.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: man niramal saachai sabad samaeh |
English: The pure mind is absorbed into the True Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿਨੑ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: se vaddabhaagee jina naam dhiaaeaa |
English: How very fortunate are those who meditate on the Naam,

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sadaa gunadaataa man vasaaeaa |3|
English: and ever enshrine in their minds the Lord, the Giver of merit. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ ਤਿਨੑ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo gun sangrahai tina balihaarai jaau |
English: I am a sacrifice to those who gather merits.

Gurbani: ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dar saachai saache gun gaau |
English: At the Gate of Truth, I sing the Glorious Praises of the True One.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aape devai sehaj subhaae |
English: He Himself spontaneously bestows His gifts.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੨॥੪੧॥
Transliteration: naanak keemat kehan na jaae |4|2|41|
English: O Nanak, the value of the Lord cannot be described. ||4||2||41||

[Ang 361 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 |
English: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur vich vaddee vaddiaaee |
English: Great is the greatness of the True Guru;

Gurbani: ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: chiree vichhune mel milaaee |
English: He merges in His Merger, those who have been separated for so long.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aape mele mel milaae |
English: He Himself merges the merged in His Merger.

Gurbani: ਆਪਣੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aapanee keemat aape paae |1|
English: He Himself knows His own worth. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: har kee keemat kin bidh hoe |
English: How can anyone appraise the Lord's worth?

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har aparanpar agam agochar gur kai sabad milai jan koe |1| rahaau |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one may merge with the Infinite, Unapproachable and Incomprehensible Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh keemat jaanai koe |
English: Few are the Gurmukhs who know His worth.

Gurbani: ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: virale karam paraapat hoe |
English: How rare are those who receive the Lord's Grace.

Gurbani: ਊਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਊਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aoochee baanee aoochaa hoe |
English: Through the Sublime Bani of His Word, one becomes sublime.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: guramukh sabad vakhaanai koe |2|
English: The Gurmukh chants the Word of the Shabad. ||2||

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਸਰੀਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: vin naavai dukh darad sareer |
English: Without the Name, the body suffers in pain;

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਤਾ ਉਤਰੈ ਪੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: satigur bhette taa utarai peer |
English: but when one meets the True Guru, then that pain is removed.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin gur bhette dukh kamaae |
English: Without meeting the Guru, the mortal earns only pain.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: manamukh bahutee milai sajaae |3|
English: The self-willed manmukh receives only more punishment. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਅਤਿ ਰਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam meetthaa at ras hoe |
English: The essence of the Lord's Name is so very sweet;

Gurbani: ਪੀਵਤ ਰਹੈ ਪੀਆਏ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: peevat rahai peeae soe |
English: he alone drinks it, whom the Lord causes to drink it.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur kirapaa te har ras paae |
English: By Guru's Grace, the essence of the Lord is obtained.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੩॥੪੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naam rate gat paae |4|3|42|
English: O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, salvation is attained. ||4||3||42||

[Ang 361 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 |
English: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: meraa prabh saachaa gahir ganbheer |
English: My God is True, deep and profound.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਤ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: sevat hee sukh saant sareer |
English: Serving Him, the body acquires peace and tranquility.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਤਰੇ ਜਨ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabad tare jan sehaj subhaae |
English: Through the Word of the Shabad, His humble servants easily swim across.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਮ ਸਦ ਲਾਗਹ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tin kai ham sad laagah paae |1|
English: I fall at their feet forever and ever. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਮਨਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jo man raate har rang laae |
English: Those being whose minds are imbued and drenched with the Lord's Love

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਥਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tin kaa janam maran dukh laathaa te har daragah mile subhaae |1| rahaau |
English: - their pains of birth and death are taken away. They are automatically ushered into the Court of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੁ ਚਾਖੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਦੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sabad chaakhai saachaa saad paae |
English: One who has tasted the Shabad, obtains the true flavor.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam man vasaae |
English: The Name of the Lord abides within his mind.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: har prabh sadaa rahiaa bharapoor |
English: The Lord God is Eternal and All-pervading.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਨੇੜੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aape nerrai aape door |2|
English: He Himself is near, and He Himself is far away. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਖਣਿ ਆਖੈ ਬਕੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aakhan aakhai bakai sabh koe |
English: Everyone talks and speaks through speech;

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aape bakhas milaae soe |
English: the Lord Himself forgives, and unites us with Himself.

Gurbani: ਕਹਣੈ ਕਥਨਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kahanai kathan na paaeaa jaae |
English: By merely speaking and talking, He is not obtained.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur parasaad vasai man aae |3|
English: By Guru's Grace, He comes to abide in the mind. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh vichahu aap gavaae |
English: The Gurmukh eradicates his self-conceit from within.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: har rang raate mohu chukaae |
English: He is imbued with the Lord's Love, having discarded worldly attachment.

Gurbani: ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: at niramal gurasabad veechaar |
English: He contemplates the utterly Immaculate Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰ ॥੪॥੪॥੪੩॥
Transliteration: naanak naam savaaranahaar |4|4|43|
English: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is our Salvation. ||4||4||43||

[Ang 362 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 |
English: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਲਗੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: doojai bhaae lage dukh paaeaa |
English: Attached to the love of duality, one only incurs pain.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bin sabadai birathaa janam gavaaeaa |
English: Without the Word of the Shabad, one's life is wasted away in vain.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੈ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sevai sojhee hoe |
English: Serving the True Guru, understanding is obtained,

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: doojai bhaae na laagai koe |1|
English: and then, one is not attached to the love of duality. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੂਲਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: mool laage se jan paravaan |
English: Those who hold fast to their roots, become acceptable.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: anadin raam naam jap hiradai gurasabadee har eko jaan |1| rahaau |
English: Night and day, they meditate within their hearts on the Lord's Name; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they know the One Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਡਾਲੀ ਲਾਗੈ ਨਿਹਫਲੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: ddaalee laagai nihafal jaae |
English: One who is attached to the branch, does not receive the fruits.

Gurbani: ਅੰਧਂੀ ਕੰਮੀ ਅੰਧ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: andhanee kamee andh sajaae |
English: For blind actions, blind punishment is received.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅੰਧਾ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh andhaa tthaur na paae |
English: The blind, self-willed manmukh finds no place of rest.

Gurbani: ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕਾ ਕੀੜਾ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਪਚਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bisattaa kaa keerraa bisattaa maeh pachaae |2|
English: He is a maggot in manure, and in manure he shall rot away. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur kee sevaa sadaa sukh paae |
English: Serving the Guru, everlasting peace is obtained.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: santasangat mil har gun gaae |
English: Joining the True Congregation, the Sat Sangat, the Glorious Praises of the Lord are sung.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: naame naam kare veechaar |
English: One who contemplates the Naam, the Name of the Lord,

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aap tarai kul udharanahaar |3|
English: saves himself, and his family as well. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur kee baanee naam vajaae |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Bani, the Naam resounds;

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਹਲੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: naanak mehal sabad ghar paae |
English: O Nanak, through the Word of the Shabad, one finds the Mansion of the Lord's Presence within the home of the heart.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤ ਸਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਲਿ ਨਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: guramat sat sar har jal naaeaa |
English: Under Guru's Instruction, bathe in the Pool of Truth, in the Water of the Lord;

Gurbani: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਰਤੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੫॥੪੪॥
Transliteration: duramat mail sabh durat gavaaeaa |4|5|44|
English: thus the filth of evil-mindedness and sin shall all be washed away. ||4||5||44||

[Ang 362 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 |
English: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਰਹਿ ਮਰਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਵਿਗਾੜਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh mareh mar maran vigaarreh |
English: The self-willed manmukhs are dying; they are wasting away in death.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਆਤਮ ਸੰਘਾਰਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: doojai bhaae aatam sanghaareh |
English: In the love of duality, they murder their own souls.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵਿਗੂਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: meraa meraa kar kar vigootaa |
English: Crying out, Mine, mine!, they are ruined.

Gurbani: ਆਤਮੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੑੈ ਭਰਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੂਤਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aatam na cheenai bharamai vich sootaa |1|
English: They do not remember their souls; they are asleep in superstition. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਰੁ ਮੁਇਆ ਸਬਦੇ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: mar mueaa sabade mar jaae |
English: He alone dies a real death, who dies in the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਮ ਜਾਣਾਈ ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ausatat nindaa gur sam jaanaaee is jug meh laahaa har jap lai jaae |1| rahaau |
English: The Guru has inspired me to realize, that praise and slander are one and the same; in this world, the profit is obtained by chanting the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣ ਗਰਭ ਗਲਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: naam vihoon garabh gal jaae |
English: Those who lack the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are dissolved within the womb.

Gurbani: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਲੋਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: birathaa janam doojai lobhaae |
English: Useless is the birth of those who are lured by duality.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਣੀ ਦੁਖਿ ਜਲੈ ਸਬਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: naam bihoonee dukh jalai sabaaee |
English: Without the Naam, all are burning in pain.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: satigur poorai boojh bujhaaee |2|
English: The Perfect True Guru has given me this understanding. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਚੰਚਲੁ ਬਹੁ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man chanchal bahu chottaa khaae |
English: The fickle mind is struck down so many times.

Gurbani: ਏਥਹੁ ਛੁੜਕਿਆ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: ethahu chhurrakiaa tthaur na paae |
English: Having lost this opportunity, no place of rest shall be found.

Gurbani: ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਕਾ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: garabh jon visattaa kaa vaas |
English: Cast into the womb of reincarnation, the mortal lives in manure;

Gurbani: ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tit ghar manamukh kare nivaas |3|
English: in such a home, the self-willed manmukh takes up residence. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: apune satigur kau sadaa bal jaaee |
English: I am forever a sacrifice to my True Guru;

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh jotee jot milaaee |
English: the light of the Gurmukh blends with the Divine Light of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: niramal baanee nij ghar vaasaa |
English: Through the Immaculate Bani of the Word, the mortal dwells within the home of his own inner self.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥੪॥੬॥੪੫॥
Transliteration: naanak haumai maare sadaa udaasaa |4|6|45|
English: O Nanak, he conquers his ego, and remains forever detached. ||4||6||45||

[Ang 362 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 |
English: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਲਾਲੈ ਆਪਣੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: laalai aapanee jaat gavaaee |
English: The Lord's slave sets aside his own social status.

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: tan man arape satigur saranaaee |
English: He dedicates his mind and body to the True Guru, and seeks His Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: hiradai naam vaddee vaddiaaee |
English: His greatest greatness is that the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is in his heart.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sadaa preetam prabh hoe sakhaaee |1|
English: The Beloved Lord God is his constant companion. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਲਾਲਾ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: so laalaa jeevat marai |
English: He alone is the Lord's slave, who remains dead while yet alive.

Gurbani: ਸੋਗੁ ਹਰਖੁ ਦੁਇ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਉਧਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sog harakh due sam kar jaanai gur parasaadee sabad udharai |1| rahaau |
English: He looks upon pleasure and pain alike; by Guru's Grace, he is saved through the Word of the Shabad. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਰ ਧੁਰਹੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: karanee kaar dhurahu furamaaee |
English: He does his deeds according to the Lord's Primal Command.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਕੋ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: bin sabadai ko thaae na paaee |
English: Without the Shabad, no one is approved.

Gurbani: ਕਰਣੀ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: karanee keerat naam vasaaee |
English: Singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, the Naam abides within the mind.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਢਿਲ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aape devai dtil na paaee |2|
English: He Himself gives His gifts, without hesitation. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh bharam bhulai sansaar |
English: The self-willed manmukh wanders around the world in doubt.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਰਾਸੀ ਕੂੜਾ ਕਰੇ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: bin raasee koorraa kare vaapaar |
English: Without any capital, he makes false transactions.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਰਾਸੀ ਵਖਰੁ ਪਲੈ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: vin raasee vakhar palai na paae |
English: Without any capital, he does not obtain any merchandise.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਭੁਲਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: manamukh bhulaa janam gavaae |3|
English: The mistaken manmukh wastes away his life. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੁ ਲਾਲਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur seve su laalaa hoe |
English: One who serves the True Guru is the Lord's slave.

Gurbani: ਊਤਮ ਜਾਤੀ ਊਤਮੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aootam jaatee aootam soe |
English: His social status is exalted, and his reputation is exalted.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਉੜੀ ਸਭ ਦੂ ਊਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur paurree sabh doo aoochaa hoe |
English: Climbing the Guru's Ladder, he becomes the most exalted of all.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੭॥੪੬॥
Transliteration: naanak naam vaddaaee hoe |4|7|46|
English: O Nanak, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, greatness is obtained. ||4||7||46||

[Ang 363 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 |
English: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਝੂਠੋ ਝੂਠੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh jhoottho jhootth kamaavai |
English: The self-willed manmukh practices falsehood, only falsehood.

Gurbani: ਖਸਮੈ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: khasamai kaa mehal kade na paavai |
English: He never attains the Mansion of the Lord Presence.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: doojai lagee bharam bhulaavai |
English: Attached to duality, he wanders, deluded by doubt.

Gurbani: ਮਮਤਾ ਬਾਧਾ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mamataa baadhaa aavai jaavai |1|
English: Entangled in worldly attachments, he comes and goes. ||1||

Gurbani: ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਕਾ ਮਨ ਦੇਖੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: dohaaganee kaa man dekh seegaar |
English: Behold, the decorations of the discarded bride!

Gurbani: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤਿ ਧਨਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ਝੂਠੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਪਾਖੰਡ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: putr kalat dhan maaeaa chit laae jhootth mohu paakhandd vikaar |1| rahaau |
English: Her consciousness is attached to children, spouse, wealth, and Maya, falsehood, emotional attachment, hypocrisy and corruption. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sohaagan jo prabh bhaavai |
English: She who is pleasing to God is forever a happy soul-bride.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: gurasabadee seegaar banaavai |
English: She makes the Word of the Guru's Shabad her decoration.

Gurbani: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: sej sukhaalee anadin har raavai |
English: Her bed is so comfortable; she enjoys her Lord, night and day.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mil preetam sadaa sukh paavai |2|
English: Meeting her Beloved, the obtains eternal peace. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: saa sohaagan saachee jis saach piaar |
English: She is a true, virtuous soul-bride, who enshrines love for the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਪਣਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਸਦਾ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: apanaa pir raakhai sadaa ur dhaar |
English: She keeps her Husband Lord always clasped to her heart.

Gurbani: ਨੇੜੈ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਦਾ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: nerrai vekhai sadaa hadoor |
English: She sees Him near at hand, ever-present.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਰਬ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: meraa prabh sarab rahiaa bharapoor |3|
English: My God is all-pervading everywhere. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਗੈ ਜਾਤਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aagai jaat roop na jaae |
English: Social status and beauty will not go with you hereafter.

Gurbani: ਤੇਹਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੇਹੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: tehaa hovai jehe karam kamaae |
English: As are the deeds done here, so does one become.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੇ ਊਚੋ ਊਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabade aoocho aoochaa hoe |
English: Through the Word of the Shabad, one becomes the highest of the high.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੮॥੪੭॥
Transliteration: naanak saach samaavai soe |4|8|47|
English: O Nanak, he is absorbed in the True Lord. ||4||8||47||

[Ang 363 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 |
English: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਰਤਾ ਜਨੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat rataa jan sehaj subhaae |
English: The Lord's humble servant is imbued with devotional love, effortlessly and spontaneously.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭੈ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai bhai saachai saach samaae |
English: Through awe and fear of the Guru, he is truly absorbed in the True One.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin gur poore bhagat na hoe |
English: Without the Perfect Guru, devotional love is not obtained.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਰੁੰਨੇ ਅਪਨੀ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: manamukh rune apanee pat khoe |1|
English: The self-willed manmukhs lose their honor, and cry out in pain. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: mere man har jap sadaa dhiaae |
English: O my mind, chant the Lord's Name, and meditate on Him forever.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਜੋ ਇਛੈ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa anand hovai din raatee jo ichhai soee fal paae |1| rahaau |
English: You shall always be in ecstasy, day and night, and you shall obtain the fruits of your desires. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur poore te pooraa paae |
English: Through the Perfect Guru, the Perfect Lord is obtained,

Gurbani: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: hiradai sabad sach naam vasaae |
English: and the Shabad, the True Name, is enshrined in the mind.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: antar niramal amrit sar naae |
English: One who bathes in the Pool of Ambrosial Nectar becomes immaculately pure within.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸੂਚੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sadaa sooche saach samaae |2|
English: He becomes forever sanctified, and is absorbed in the True Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: har prabh vekhai sadaa hajoor |
English: He sees the Lord God ever-present.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaad rahiaa bharapoor |
English: By Guru's Grace, he sees the Lord permeating and pervading everywhere.

Gurbani: ਜਹਾ ਜਾਉ ਤਹ ਵੇਖਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jahaa jaau teh vekhaa soe |
English: Wherever I go, there I see Him.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur bin daataa avar na koe |3|
English: Without the Guru, there is no other Giver. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: gur saagar pooraa bhanddaar |
English: The Guru is the ocean, the perfect treasure,

Gurbani: ਊਤਮ ਰਤਨ ਜਵਾਹਰ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: aootam ratan javaahar apaar |
English: the most precious jewel and priceless ruby.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee devanahaar |
English: By Guru's Grace, the Great Giver blesses us;

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੯॥੪੮॥
Transliteration: naanak bakhase bakhasanahaar |4|9|48|
English: O Nanak, the Forgiving Lord forgives us. ||4||9||48||

[Ang 363 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 |
English: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਇਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur saaeir satigur sach soe |
English: The Guru is the Ocean; the True Guru is the Embodiment of Truth.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: poorai bhaag gur sevaa hoe |
English: Through perfect good destiny, one serves the Guru.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: so boojhai jis aap bujhaae |
English: He alone understands, whom the Lord Himself inspires to understand.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਾਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee sev karaae |1|
English: By Guru's Grace, one serves Him. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨਿ ਸਭ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: giaan ratan sabh sojhee hoe |
English: With the jewel of spiritual wisdom, total understanding is obtained.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaad agiaan binaasai anadin jaagai vekhai sach soe |1| rahaau |
English: By Guru's Grace, ignorance is dispelled; one then remains wakeful, night and day, and beholds the True Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: mohu gumaan gur sabad jalaae |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, attachment and pride are burnt away.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: poore gur te sojhee paae |
English: From the Perfect Guru, true understanding is obtained.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: antar mehal gur sabad pachhaanai |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one realizes the Lord's Presence within.

Gurbani: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਰਹੈ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aavan jaan rahai thir naam samaane |2|
English: Then, one's coming and going cease, and one becomes stable, absorbed in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਹੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jaman maranaa hai sansaar |
English: The world is tied to birth and death.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅਚੇਤੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh achet maaeaa mohu gubaar |
English: The unconscious, self-willed manmukh is enveloped in the darkness of Maya and emotional attachment.

Gurbani: ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਬਹੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: par nindaa bahu koorr kamaavai |
English: He slanders others, and practices utter falsehood.

Gurbani: ਵਿਸਟਾ ਕਾ ਕੀੜਾ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: visattaa kaa keerraa visattaa maeh samaavai |3|
English: He is a maggot in manure, and into manure he is absorbed. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਭ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: satasangat mil sabh sojhee paae |
English: Joining the True Congregation, the Sat Sangat, total understanding is obtained.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa sabad har bhagat drirraae |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, devotional love for the Lord is implanted.

Gurbani: ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhaanaa mane sadaa sukh hoe |
English: One who surrenders to the Lord's Will is peaceful forever.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੪੯॥
Transliteration: naanak sach samaavai soe |4|10|49|
English: O Nanak, he is absorbed into the True Lord. ||4||10||49||

[Ang 364 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਪੰਚਪਦੇ₂ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 panchapade₂ |
English: Aasaa, Third Mehl, Panch-Padhay:

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: sabad marai tis sadaa anand |
English: One who dies in the Word of the Shabad, finds eternal bliss.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: satigur bhette gur gobind |
English: He is united with the True Guru, the Guru, the Lord God.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: naa fir marai na aavai jaae |
English: He does not die any more, and he does not come or go.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: poore gur te saach samaae |1|
English: Through the Perfect Guru, he merges with the True Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਲੇਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: jina kau naam likhiaa dhur lekh |
English: One who has the Naam, the Name of the Lord, written in his pre-ordained destiny,

Gurbani: ਤੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਿਸੇਖੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: te anadin naam sadaa dhiaaveh gur poore te bhagat visekh |1| rahaau |
English: night and day, meditates forever on the Naam; he obtains the wondrous blessing of devotional love from the Perfect Guru. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jina kau har prabh le milaae |
English: Those, whom the Lord God has blended with Himself

Gurbani: ਤਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਗਹਣ ਗਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: tina kee gehan gat kahee na jaae |
English: their sublime state cannot be described.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਿਤੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: poorai satigur ditee vaddiaaee |
English: The Perfect True Guru has given the Glorious Greatness,

Gurbani: ਊਤਮ ਪਦਵੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aootam padavee har naam samaaee |2|
English: of the most exalted order, and I am absorbed into the Lord's Name. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: jo kichh kare su aape aap |
English: Whatever the Lord does, He does all by Himself.

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਘੜੀ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: ek gharree meh thaap uthaap |
English: In an instant, He establishes, and disestablishes.

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਕਹਣਾ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: keh keh kahanaa aakh sunaae |
English: By merely speaking, talking, shouting and preaching about the Lord,

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਘਾਲੇ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: je sau ghaale thaae na paae |3|
English: Even hundreds of times, the mortal is not approved. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑ ਕੈ ਪੋਤੈ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jina kai potai pun tinaa guroo milaae |
English: The Guru meets with those, who take virtue as their treasure;

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sach baanee gur sabad sunaae |
English: they listen to the True Word of the Guru's Bani, the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਜਹਾਂ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸੈ ਤਹਾਂ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jahaan sabad vasai tahaan dukh jaae |
English: Pain departs, from that place where the Shabad abides.

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨਿ ਰਤਨਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: giaan ratan saachai sehaj samaae |4|
English: By the jewel of spiritual wisdom, one is easily absorbed into the True Lord. ||4||

Gurbani: ਨਾਵੈ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: naavai jevadd hor dhan naahee koe |
English: No other wealth is as great as the Naam.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਖਸੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jis no bakhase saachaa soe |
English: It is bestowed only by the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: poorai sabad man vasaae |
English: Through the Perfect Word of the Shabad, it abides in the mind.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੫॥੧੧॥੫੦॥
Transliteration: naanak naam rate sukh paae |5|11|50|
English: O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, peace is obtained. ||5||11||50||

[Ang 364 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 |
English: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਬਹੁ ਵਾਜੇ ਵਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: nirat kare bahu vaaje vajaae |
English: One may dance and play numerous instruments;

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਅੰਧਾ ਬੋਲਾ ਹੈ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: eihu man andhaa bolaa hai kis aakh sunaae |
English: but this mind is blind and deaf, so for whose benefit is this speaking and preaching?

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਅਨਲ ਵਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: antar lobh bharam anal vaau |
English: Deep within is the fire of greed, and the dust-storm of doubt.

Gurbani: ਦੀਵਾ ਬਲੈ ਨ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: deevaa balai na sojhee paae |1|
English: The lamp of knowledge is not burning, and understanding is not obtained. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh bhagat ghatt chaanan hoe |
English: The Gurmukh has the light of devotional worship within his heart.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aap pachhaan milai prabh soe |1| rahaau |
English: Understanding his own self, he meets God. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਰਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਭਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh nirat har laagai bhaau |
English: The Gurmukh's dance is to embrace love for the Lord;

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਤਾਲ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: poore taal vichahu aap gavaae |
English: to the beat of the drum, he sheds his ego from within.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: meraa prabh saachaa aape jaan |
English: My God is True; He Himself is the Knower of all.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad antar braham pachhaan |2|
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, recognize the Creator Lord within yourself. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh bhagat antar preet piaar |
English: The Gurmukh is filled with devotional love for the Beloved Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa sabad sehaj veechaar |
English: He intuitively reflects upon the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh bhagat jugat sach soe |
English: For the Gurmukh, loving devotional worship is the way to the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਤਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: paakhandd bhagat nirat dukh hoe |3|
English: But the dances and the worship of the hypocrites bring only pain. ||3||

Gurbani: ਏਹਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਨੁ ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: ehaa bhagat jan jeevat marai |
English: True Devotion is to remain dead while yet alive.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee bhavajal tarai |
English: By Guru's Grace, one crosses over the terrible world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai bachan bhagat thaae paae |
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, one's devotion is accepted,

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: har jeeo aap vasai man aae |4|
English: and then, the Dear Lord Himself comes to dwell in the mind. ||4||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: har kripaa kare satiguroo milaae |
English: When the Lord bestows His Mercy, He leads us to meet the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਨਿਹਚਲ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: nihachal bhagat har siau chit laae |
English: Then, one's devotion becomes steady, and the consciousness is centered upon the Lord.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਰਤੇ ਤਿਨੑ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat rate tina sachee soe |
English: Those who are imbued with Devotion have truthful reputations.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥੧੨॥੫੧॥
Transliteration: naanak naam rate sukh hoe |5|12|51|
English: O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, peace is obtained. ||5||12||51||

[Ang 365 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੮ ਕਾਫੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa ghar 8 kaafee mahalaa 3 |
English: Aasaa, Eighth House, Kaafee, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: har kai bhaanai satigur milai sach sojhee hoee |
English: By the Pleasure of the Lord's Will, one meets the True Guru, and true understanding is obtained.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee man vasai har boojhai soee |1|
English: By Guru's Grace, the Lord abides in the mind, and one comes to understand the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਸਹੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: mai sahu daataa ek hai avar naahee koee |
English: My Husband Lord, the Great Giver, is One. There is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur kirapaa te man vasai taa sadaa sukh hoee |1| rahaau |
English: By Guru's merciful favor, He abides in the mind, and then, a lasting peace ensues. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: eis jug meh nirbhau har naam hai paaeeai gur veechaar |
English: In this age, the Lord's Name is fearless; it is obtained by meditative reflection upon the Guru.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧ ਗਵਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bin naavai jam kai vas hai manamukh andh gavaar |2|
English: Without the Name, the blind, foolish, self-willed manmukh is under Death's power. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: har kai bhaanai jan sevaa karai boojhai sach soee |
English: By the Pleasure of the Lord's Will, the humble being performs His service, and understands the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਭਾਣੈ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har kai bhaanai saalaaheeai bhaanai maniai sukh hoee |3|
English: By the Pleasure of the Lord's Will, He is to be praised; surrendering to His Will, peace ensues. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: har kai bhaanai janam padaarath paaeaa mat aootam hoee |
English: By the Pleasure of the Lord's Will, the prize of this human birth is obtained, and the intellect is exalted.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੩੯॥੧੩॥੫੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naam salaeh toon guramukh gat hoee |4|39|13|52|
English: O Nanak, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord; as Gurmukh, you shall be emancipated. ||4||39||13||52||

[Ang 365 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 ghar 2 |
English: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl, Second House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ਮੈਡਾ ਸਾਂਈ ॥
Transliteration: toon karataa sachiaar maiddaa saanee |
English: You are the True Creator, my Lord Master.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਥੀਸੀ ਜੋ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਹਉ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo tau bhaavai soee theesee jo toon dehi soee hau paaee |1| rahaau |
English: That which is pleasing to Your Will, comes to pass. Whatever You give, that is what I receive. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabh teree toon sabhanee dhiaaeaa |
English: All are Yours; all meditate on You.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jis no kripaa kareh tin naam ratan paaeaa |
English: He alone, whom You bless with Your Mercy, obtains the jewel of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਧਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh laadhaa manamukh gavaaeaa |
English: The Gurmukhs obtain it, and the self-willed manmukhs lose it.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tudh aap vichhorriaa aap milaaeaa |1|
English: You Yourself separate the mortals, and You Yourself unite them. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਸਭ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: toon dareeaau sabh tujh hee maeh |
English: You are the River - all are within You.

Gurbani: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: tujh bin doojaa koee naeh |
English: Other than You, there is no one at all.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਖੇਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jant sabh teraa khel |
English: All beings and creatures are your play-things.

Gurbani: ਵਿਜੋਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਮੇਲੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: vijog mil vichhurriaa sanjogee mel |2|
English: The united ones are separated, and the separated ones are re-united. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਜਾਣਾਇਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: jis no too jaanaaeihi soee jan jaanai |
English: That humble being, whom You inspire to understand, understands;

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: har gun sad hee aakh vakhaanai |
English: he continually speaks and chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jin har seviaa tin sukh paaeaa |
English: One who serves the Lord, obtains peace.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sahaje hee har naam samaaeaa |3|
English: He is easily absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: too aape karataa teraa keea sabh hoe |
English: You Yourself are the Creator; by Your doing, all things come to be.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: tudh bin doojaa avar na koe |
English: Without You, there is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: too kar kar vekheh jaaneh soe |
English: You watch over the creation, and understand it.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੫੩॥
Transliteration: jan naanak guramukh paragatt hoe |4|1|53|
English: O servant Nanak, the Lord is revealed to the Gurmukh. ||4||1||53||

[Ang 366 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: raag aasaa ghar 2 mahalaa 4 |
English: Raag Aasaa, Second House, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਧੜਾ ਕੀਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਤ ਨਾਲਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kis hee dharraa keea mitr sut naal bhaaee |
English: Some form alliances with friends, children and siblings.

Gurbani: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਧੜਾ ਕੀਆ ਕੁੜਮ ਸਕੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਜਵਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kis hee dharraa keea kurram sake naal javaaee |
English: Some form alliances with in-laws and relatives.

Gurbani: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਧੜਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਿਕਦਾਰ ਚਉਧਰੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਸੁਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: kis hee dharraa keea sikadaar chaudharee naal aapanai suaaee |
English: Some form alliances with chiefs and leaders for their own selfish motives.

Gurbani: ਹਮਾਰਾ ਧੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: hamaaraa dharraa har rahiaa samaaee |1|
English: My alliance is with the Lord, who is pervading everywhere. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਧੜਾ ਕੀਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਟੇਕ ॥
Transliteration: ham har siau dharraa keea meree har ttek |
English: I have formed my alliance with the Lord; the Lord is my only support.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਖੁ ਧੜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਅਸੰਖ ਅਨੇਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mai har bin pakh dharraa avar na koee hau har gun gaavaa asankh anek |1| rahaau |
English: Other than the Lord, I have no other faction or alliance; I sing of the countless and endless Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑ ਸਿਉ ਧੜੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jina siau dharre kareh se jaeh |
English: Those with whom you form alliances, shall perish.

Gurbani: ਝੂਠੁ ਧੜੇ ਕਰਿ ਪਛੋਤਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jhootth dharre kar pachhotaeh |
English: Making false alliances, the mortals repent and regret in the end.

Gurbani: ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਖੋਟੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: thir na raheh man khott kamaeh |
English: Those who practice falsehood shall not last.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਧੜਾ ਕੀਆ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਕੋਈ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ham har siau dharraa keea jis kaa koee samarath naeh |2|
English: I have formed my alliance with the Lord; there is no one more powerful than Him. ||2||

Gurbani: ਏਹ ਸਭਿ ਧੜੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਸਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: eeh sabh dharre maaeaa moh pasaaree |
English: All these alliances are mere extensions of the love of Maya.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਉ ਲੂਝਹਿ ਗਾਵਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa kau loojheh gaavaaree |
English: Only fools argue over Maya.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਜੂਐ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: janam mareh jooai baajee haaree |
English: They are born, and they die, and they lose the game of life in the gamble.

Gurbani: ਹਮਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਧੜਾ ਜਿ ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: hamarai har dharraa ji halat palat sabh savaaree |3|
English: My alliance is with the Lord, who embellishes all, in this world and the next. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਧੜੇ ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਝਗੜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: kalijug meh dharre panch chor jhagarraae |
English: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the five thieves instigate alliances and conflicts.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਵਧਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh lobh mohu abhimaan vadhaae |
English: Sexual desire, anger, greed, emotional attachment and self-conceit have increased.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jis no kripaa kare tis satasang milaae |
English: One who is blessed by the Lord's Grace, joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

Gurbani: ਹਮਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਧੜਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹ ਧੜੇ ਸਭਿ ਗਵਾਏ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: hamaraa har dharraa jin eeh dharre sabh gavaae |4|
English: My alliance is with the Lord, who has destroyed all these alliances. ||4||

Gurbani: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਧੜੇ ਬਹਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: mithiaa doojaa bhaau dharre beh paavai |
English: In the false love of duality, people sit and form alliances.

Gurbani: ਪਰਾਇਆ ਛਿਦ੍ਰੁ ਅਟਕਲੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਵਧਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: paraaeaa chhidru attakalai aapanaa ahankaar vadhaavai |
English: They complain about other peoples' faults, while their own self-conceit only increases.

Gurbani: ਜੈਸਾ ਬੀਜੈ ਤੈਸਾ ਖਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jaisaa beejai taisaa khaavai |
English: As they plant, so shall they harvest.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਧੜਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਜਿਣਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੫॥੨॥੫੪॥
Transliteration: jan naanak kaa har dharraa dharam sabh srisatt jin aavai |5|2|54|
English: Servant Nanak has joined the Lord's alliance of Dharma, which shall conquer the whole world. ||5||2||54||

[Ang 366 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 |
English: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: hiradai sun sun man amrit bhaaeaa |
English: Constantly listening to the Ambrosial Gurbani in the heart, it becomes pleasing to the mind.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gurabaanee har alakh lakhaaeaa |1|
English: Through Gurbani, the Incomprehensible Lord is comprehended. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਭੈਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh naam sunahu meree bhainaa |
English: As Gurmukh, listen to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O my sisters.

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬੈਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: eko rav rahiaa ghatt antar mukh bolahu gur amrit bainaa |1| rahaau |
English: The One Lord is pervading and permeating deep within the heart; with your mouth, recite the Ambrosial Hymns of the Guru. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: mai man tan prem mahaa bairaag |
English: My mind and body are filled with divine love, and great sadness.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: satigur purakh paaeaa vaddabhaag |2|
English: By great good fortune, I have obtained the True Guru, the Primal Being. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਵਹਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: doojai bhaae bhaveh bikh maaeaa |
English: In the love of duality, the mortals wander through poisonous Maya.

Gurbani: ਭਾਗਹੀਨ ਨਹੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bhaagaheen nahee satigur paaeaa |3|
English: The unfortunate ones do not meet the True Guru. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਪੀਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: amrit har ras har aap peeaeaa |
English: The Lord Himself inspires us to drink in the Lord's Ambrosial Elixir.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੩॥੫੫॥
Transliteration: gur poorai naanak har paaeaa |4|3|55|
English: Through the Perfect Guru, O Nanak, the Lord is obtained. ||4||3||55||

[Ang 366 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 |
English: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: merai man tan prem naam aadhaar |
English: The Love of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the Support of my mind and body.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀ ਨਾਮੋ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naam japee naamo sukh saar |1|
English: I chant the Naam; the Naam is the essence of peace. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਜਨ ਸੈਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: naam japahu mere saajan sainaa |
English: So chant the Naam, O my friends and companions.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਲੈਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: naam binaa mai avar na koee vaddai bhaag guramukh har lainaa |1| rahaau |
English: Without the Naam, there is nothing else for me. By great good fortune, as Gurmukh, I have received the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਹੀ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: naam binaa nahee jeeviaa jaae |
English: Without the Naam, I cannot live.

Gurbani: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: vaddai bhaag guramukh har paae |2|
English: By great good fortune, the Gurmukhs obtain the Naam. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਹੀਨ ਕਾਲਖ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: naamaheen kaalakh mukh maaeaa |
English: Those who lack the Naam have their faces rubbed in the dirt of Maya.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naam binaa dhrig dhrig jeevaaeaa |3|
English: Without the Naam, cursed, cursed are their lives. ||3||

Gurbani: ਵਡਾ ਵਡਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਗ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: vaddaa vaddaa har bhaag kar paaeaa |
English: The Great Lord is obtained by great good destiny.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿਵਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੪॥੫੬॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh naam divaaeaa |4|4|56|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is blessed with the Naam. ||4||4||56||

[Ang 367 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 |
English: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਗੁਣ ਬੋਲੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: gun gaavaa gun bolee baanee |
English: I sing His Glorious Praises, and through the Word of His Bani, I speak His Glorious Praises.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: guramukh har gun aakh vakhaanee |1|
English: As Gurmukh, I chant and recite the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਇਆ ਅਨੰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: jap jap naam man bheaa anandaa |
English: Chanting and meditating on the Naam, my mind becomes blissful.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ ਰਸਿ ਗਾਏ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sat sat satigur naam dirraaeaa ras gaae gun paramaanandaa |1| rahaau |
English: The True Guru has implanted the True Name of the True Lord within me; I sing His Glorious Praises, and taste the supreme ecstasy. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਲੋਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: har gun gaavai har jan logaa |
English: The humble servants of the Lord sing the Lord's Glorious Praises.

Gurbani: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਜੋਗਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: vaddai bhaag paae har nirajogaa |2|
English: By great good fortune, the detached, absolute Lord is obtained. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਵਿਹੂਣ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਲੁ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: gun vihoon maaeaa mal dhaaree |
English: Those without virtue are stained by Maya's filth.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਣ ਜਨਮਿ ਮੁਏ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: vin gun janam mue ahankaaree |3|
English: Lacking virtue, the egotistical die, and suffer reincarnation. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਰੀਰਿ ਸਰੋਵਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਟਿ ਕੀਏ ॥
Transliteration: sareer sarovar gun paragatt kee |
English: The ocean of the body yields pearls of virtue.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਥਿ ਤਤੁ ਕਢੀਏ ॥੪॥੫॥੫੭॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh math tat kadtee |4|5|57|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh churns this ocean, and discovers this essence. ||4||5||57||

[Ang 367 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 |
English: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣੀ ਨਾਮੋ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: naam sunee naamo man bhaavai |
English: I listen to the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the Naam is pleasing to my mind.

Gurbani: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: vaddai bhaag guramukh har paavai |1|
English: By great good fortune, the Gurmukh obtains the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: naam japahu guramukh paragaasaa |
English: Chant the Naam, as Gurmukh, and be exalted.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਮੈ ਧਰ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਭ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: naam binaa mai dhar nahee kaaee naam raviaa sabh saas giraasaa |1| rahaau |
English: Without the Naam, I have no other support; the Naam is woven into all my breaths and morsels of food. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੈ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਨੀ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: naamai surat sunee man bhaaee |
English: The Naam illuminates my mind; listening to it, my mind is pleased.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jo naam sunaavai so meraa meet sakhaaee |2|
English: One who speaks the Naam - he alone is my friend and companion. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਹੀਣ ਗਏ ਮੂੜ ਨੰਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: naamaheen ge moorr nangaa |
English: Without the Naam, the fools depart naked.

Gurbani: ਪਚਿ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਖੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਤੰਗਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: pach pach mue bikh dekh patangaa |3|
English: They burn away to death, chasing the poison of Maya, like the moth chasing the flame. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਥਾਪੇ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: aape thaape thaap uthaape |
English: He Himself establishes, and, having established, disestablishes.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ॥੪॥੬॥੫੮॥
Transliteration: naanak naam devai har aape |4|6|58|
English: O Nanak, the Lord Himself bestows the Naam. ||4||6||58||

[Ang 367 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 |
English: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਵੇਲਿ ਵਧਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh har har vel vadhaaee |
English: The vine of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, has taken root in the Gurmukh.

Gurbani: ਫਲ ਲਾਗੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਕ ਰਸਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: fal laage har rasak rasaaee |1|
English: It bears the fruit of the Lord; its taste is so tasty! ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਅਨਤ ਤਰੰਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam jap anat tarangaa |
English: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in endless waves of joy.

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਕਾਲੁ ਜਮਕੰਕਰ ਭੁਇਅੰਗਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jap jap naam guramat saalaahee maariaa kaal jamakankar bhueiangaa |1| rahaau |
English: Chant and repeat the Naam; through the Guru's Teachings praise the Lord, and slay the horrible serpent of the Messenger of Death. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਮਹਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਖਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har har gur meh bhagat rakhaaee |
English: The Lord has implanted His devotional worship in the Guru.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਸਿਖ ਦੇਵੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur tutthaa sikh devai mere bhaaee |2|
English: When the Guru is pleased, He bestows it upon His Sikh, O my siblings of Destiny. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਿਛੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: haumai karam kichh bidh nahee jaanai |
English: One who acts in ego, knows nothing about the Way.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਕੁੰਚਰੁ ਨਾਇ ਖਾਕੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਾਣੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jiau kunchar naae khaak sir chhaanai |3|
English: He acts like an elephant, who takes a bath, and then throws dust on his head. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਵਡ ਭਾਗ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਵਡ ਊਚੇ ॥
Transliteration: je vadd bhaag hoveh vadd aooche |
English: If one's destiny is great and exalted,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹਿ ਸਚਿ ਸੂਚੇ ॥੪॥੭॥੫੯॥
Transliteration: naanak naam japeh sach sooche |4|7|59|
English: O Nanak, one chants the Naam, the Name of the Immaculate, True Lord. ||4||7||59||

[Ang 367 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 |
English: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਮਨਿ ਭੂਖ ਲਗਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam kee man bhookh lagaaee |
English: My mind suffers hunger for the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਨਿਐ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naam suniai man tripatai mere bhaaee |1|
English: Hearing the Naam, my mind is satisfied, O my Siblings of Destiny. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: naam japahu mere gurasikh meetaa |
English: Chant the Naam, O my friends, O GurSikhs.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖਹੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਚੀਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: naam japahu naame sukh paavahu naam rakhahu guramat man cheetaa |1| rahaau |
English: Chant the Naam, and through the Naam, obtain peace; through the Guru's Teachings, enshrine the Naam in your heart and mind. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਸਰਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: naamo naam sunee man sarasaa |
English: Hearing the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind is in bliss.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਲੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਬਿਗਸਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naam laahaa lai guramat bigasaa |2|
English: Reaping the profit of the Naam, through the Guru's Teachings, my soul has blossomed forth. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੁਸਟੀ ਮੋਹ ਅੰਧਾ ॥
Transliteration: naam binaa kusattee moh andhaa |
English: Without the Naam, the mortal is a leper, blinded by emotional attachment.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਕਰਮ ਕੀਏ ਦੁਖੁ ਧੰਧਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sabh nihafal karam kee dukh dhandhaa |3|
English: All his actions are fruitless; they lead only to painful entanglements. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਜਪੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: har har har jas japai vaddabhaagee |
English: The very fortunate ones chant the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੪॥੮॥੬੦॥
Transliteration: naanak guramat naam liv laagee |4|8|60|
English: O Nanak, through the Guru's Teachings, one embraces love for the Naam. ||4||8||60||

[Ang 368 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੬ ਕੇ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 4 raag aasaa ghar 6 ke 3 |
English: Fourth Mehl, Raag Aasaa, 3 Of Sixth House :

Gurbani: ਹਥਿ ਕਰਿ ਤੰਤੁ ਵਜਾਵੈ ਜੋਗੀ ਥੋਥਰ ਵਾਜੈ ਬੇਨ ॥
Transliteration: hath kar tant vajaavai jogee thothar vaajai ben |
English: You may pluck the strings with your hand, O Yogi, but your playing of the harp is in vain.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਭੇਨ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: guramat har gun bolahu jogee ihu manooaa har rang bhen |1|
English: Under Guru's Instruction, chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, O Yogi, and this mind of yours shall be imbued with the Lord's Love. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੋਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਤੀ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: jogee har dehu matee upades |
English: O Yogi, give your intellect the Teachings of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਹਮ ਆਦੇਸੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jug jug har har eko varatai tis aagai ham aades |1| rahaau |
English: The Lord, the One Lord, is pervading throughout all the ages; I humbly bow down to Him. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਰਾਗ ਭਾਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਖੇਲੈ ਖੇਲ ॥
Transliteration: gaaveh raag bhaat bahu boleh ihu manooaa khelai khel |
English: You sing in so many Ragas and harmonies, and you talk so much, but this mind of yours is only playing a game.

Gurbani: ਜੋਵਹਿ ਕੂਪ ਸਿੰਚਨ ਕਉ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਉਠਿ ਬੈਲ ਗਏ ਚਰਿ ਬੇਲ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: joveh koop sinchan kau basudhaa utth bail ge char bel |2|
English: You work the well and irrigate the fields, but the oxen have already left to graze in the jungle. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਕਰਮ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਮੈ ਹਰਿਆ ਖੇਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa nagar meh karam har bovahu har jaamai hariaa khet |
English: In the field of the body, plant the Lord's Name, and the Lord will sprout there, like a lush green field.

Gurbani: ਮਨੂਆ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਬੈਲੁ ਮਨੁ ਜੋਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿੰਚਹੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜੇਤੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: manooaa asathir bail man jovahu har sinchahu guramat jet |3|
English: O mortal, hook up your unstable mind like an ox, and irrigate your fields with the Lord's Name, through the Guru's Teachings. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੋਗੀ ਜੰਗਮ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਜੋ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਤੀ ਤਿਤੁ ਚੇਲ ॥
Transliteration: jogee jangam srisatt sabh tumaree jo dehu matee tith chel |
English: The Yogis, the wandering Jangams, and all the world is Yours, O Lord. According to the wisdom which You give them, so do they follow their ways.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਪੇਲ ॥੪॥੯॥੬੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak ke prabh antarajaamee har laavahu manooaa pel |4|9|61|
English: O Lord God of servant Nanak, O Inner-knower, Searcher of hearts, please link my mind to You. ||4||9||61||

[Ang 368 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 |
English: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਬ ਕੋ ਭਾਲੈ ਘੁੰਘਰੂ ਤਾਲਾ ਕਬ ਕੋ ਬਜਾਵੈ ਰਬਾਬੁ ॥
Transliteration: kab ko bhaalai ghungharoo taalaa kab ko bajaavai rabaab |
English: How long must one search for angle bells and cymbals, and how long must one play the guitar?

Gurbani: ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਬਾਰ ਖਿਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਹਉ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਮਾਰਉ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aavat jaat baar khin laagai hau tab lag samaarau naam |1|
English: In the brief instant between coming and going, I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਐਸੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: merai man aisee bhagat ban aaee |
English: Such is the devotional love which has been produced in my mind.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੀਨੁ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hau har bin khin pal reh na skau jaise jal bin meen mar jaaee |1| rahaau |
English: Without the Lord, I cannot live even for an instant, like the fish which dies without water. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਬ ਕੋਊ ਮੇਲੈ ਪੰਚ ਸਤ ਗਾਇਣ ਕਬ ਕੋ ਰਾਗ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਠਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: kab koaoo melai panch sat gaaein kab ko raag dhun utthaavai |
English: How long must one tune the five strings, and assemble the seven singers, and how long will they raise their voices in song?

Gurbani: ਮੇਲਤ ਚੁਨਤ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਚਸਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: melat chunat khin pal chasaa laagai tab lag meraa man raam gun gaavai |2|
English: In the time it takes to select and assemble these musicians, a moment elapses, and my mind sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਬ ਕੋ ਨਾਚੈ ਪਾਵ ਪਸਾਰੈ ਕਬ ਕੋ ਹਾਥ ਪਸਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: kab ko naachai paav pasaarai kab ko haath pasaarai |
English: How long must one dance and stretch out one's feet, and how long must one reach out with one's hands?

Gurbani: ਹਾਥ ਪਾਵ ਪਸਾਰਤ ਬਿਲਮੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਸਮੑਾਰੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: haath paav pasaarat bilam til laagai tab lag meraa man raam samaarai |3|
English: Stretching out one's hands and feet, there is a moment's delay; and then, my mind meditates on the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਬ ਕੋਊ ਲੋਗਨ ਕਉ ਪਤੀਆਵੈ ਲੋਕਿ ਪਤੀਣੈ ਨਾ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: kab koaoo logan kau pateeaavai lok pateenai naa pat hoe |
English: How long must one satisfy the people, in order to obtain honor?

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਦ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਤਾ ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਰੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੬੨॥
Transliteration: jan naanak har hiradai sad dhiaavahu taa jai jai kare sabh koe |4|10|62|
English: O servant Nanak, meditate forever in your heart on the Lord, and then everyone will congratulate you. ||4||10||62||

[Ang 368 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 |
English: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: satasangat mileeai har saadhoo mil sangat har gun gaae |
English: Join the Sat Sangat, the Lord's True Congregation; joining the Company of the Holy, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ ਬਲਿਆ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: giaan ratan baliaa ghatt chaanan agiaan andheraa jaae |1|
English: With the sparkling jewel of spiritual wisdom, the heart is illumined, and ignorance is dispelled. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਚਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: har jan naachahu har har dhiaae |
English: O humble servant of the Lord, let your dancing be meditation on the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਐਸੇ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਹਮ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਧੋਵਹ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aise sant mileh mere bhaaee ham jan ke dhovah paae |1| rahaau |
English: If only I cold meet such Saints, O my Siblings of Destiny; I would wash the feet of such servants. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam japahu man mere anadin har liv laae |
English: Meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O my mind; night and day, center your consciousness on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਇਛਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jo ichhahu soee fal paavahu fir bhookh na laagai aae |2|
English: You shall have the fruits of your desires, and you shall never feel hunger again. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਬੋਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aape har aparanpar karataa har aape bol bulaae |
English: The Infinite Lord Himself is the Creator; the Lord Himself speaks, and causes us to speak.

Gurbani: ਸੇਈ ਸੰਤ ਭਲੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਜਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਥਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: seee sant bhale tudh bhaaveh jina kee pat paaveh thaae |3|
English: The Saints are good, who are pleasing to Your Will; their honor is approved by You. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖਿ ਨ ਰਾਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਜਿਉ ਆਖੈ ਤਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak aakh na raajai har gun jiau aakhai tiau sukh paae |
English: Nanak is not satisfied by chanting the Lord's Glorious Praises; the more he chants them, the more he is at peace.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਦੀਏ ਹਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਵਣਜਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੬੩॥
Transliteration: bhagat bhanddaar dee har apune gun gaahak vanaj lai jaae |4|11|63|
English: The Lord Himself has bestowed the treasure of devotional love; His customers purchase virtues, and carry them home. ||4||11||63||

[Ang 369 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੮ ਕੇ ਕਾਫੀ₂ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: raag aasaa ghar 8 ke kaafee₂ mahalaa 4 |
English: Raag Aasaa, Eighth House, Kaafee, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਇਆ ਮਰਣੁ ਧੁਰਾਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: aaeaa maran dhuraahu haumai roeeai |
English: Death is ordained from the very beginning, and yet ego makes us cry.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਹੋਈਐ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: guramukh naam dhiaae asathir hoeeai |1|
English: Meditating on the Naam, as Gurmukh, one becomes stable and steady. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਚਲਣੁ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur poore saabaas chalan jaaniaa |
English: Blessed is the Perfect Guru, through whom the way of Death is known.

Gurbani: ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: laahaa naam su saar sabad samaaniaa |1| rahaau |
English: The sublime people earn the profit of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; they are absorbed in the Word of the Shabad. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖੇ ਡੇਹ ਸਿ ਆਏ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: poorab likhe ddeh si aae maaeaa |
English: The days of one's life are pre-ordained; they will come to their end, O mother.

Gurbani: ਚਲਣੁ ਅਜੁ ਕਿ ਕਲਿੑ ਧੁਰਹੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: chalan aj ki kala dhurahu furamaaeaa |2|
English: One must depart, today or tomorrow, according to the Lord's Primal Order. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: birathaa janam tinaa jinaee naam visaariaa |
English: Useless are the lives of those, who have forgotten the Naam.

Gurbani: ਜੂਐ ਖੇਲਣੁ ਜਗਿ ਕਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਾਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jooai khelan jag ki ihu man haariaa |3|
English: They play the game of chance in this world, and lose their mind. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਣਿ ਮਰਣਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jeevan maran sukh hoe jinaa gur paaeaa |
English: Those who have found the Guru are at peace, in life and in death.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੬੪॥
Transliteration: naanak sache sach sach samaaeaa |4|12|64|
English: O Nanak, the true ones are truly absorbed into the True Lord. ||4||12||64||

[Ang 369 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 |
English: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: janam padaarath paae naam dhiaaeaa |
English: Having obtained the treasure of this human birth, I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੁਝਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee bujh sach samaaeaa |1|
English: By Guru's Grace, I understand, and I am absorbed into the True Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jina dhur likhiaa lekh tinaee naam kamaaeaa |
English: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny practice the Naam.

Gurbani: ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dar sachai sachiaar mehal bulaaeaa |1| rahaau |
English: The True Lord summons the truthful to the Mansion of His Presence. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: antar naam nidhaan guramukh paaeeai |
English: Deep within is the treasure of the Naam; it is obtained by the Gurmukh.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: anadin naam dhiaae har gun gaaeeai |2|
English: Night and day, meditate on the Naam, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਅਨੇਕ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: antar vasat anek manamukh nahee paaeeai |
English: Deep within are infinite substances, but the self-willed manmukh does not find them.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਈਐ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: haumai garabai garab aap khuaaeeai |3|
English: In egotism and pride, the mortal's proud self consumes him. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: naanak aape aap aap khuaaeeai |
English: O Nanak, his identity consumes his identical identity.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੬੫॥
Transliteration: guramat man paragaas sachaa paaeeai |4|13|65|
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, the mind is illumined, and meets the True Lord. ||4||13||65||

[Ang 369 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾਵਰੀ ਘਰੁ ੧੬ ਕੇ ੨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਸੁਧੰਗ ॥
Transliteration: raag aasaavaree ghar 16 ke 2 mahalaa 4 sudhang |
English: Raag Aasaavaree, 2 Of Sixteenth House, Fourth Mehl, Sudhang:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕਰਉ ॥
Transliteration: hau anadin har naam keeratan krau |
English: Night and day, I sing the Kirtan, the Praises of the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਤਾਇਆ ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur mo kau har naam bataaeaa hau har bin khin pal reh na skau |1| rahaau |
English: The True Guru has revealed to me the Name of the Lord; without the Lord, I cannot live, for a moment, even an instant. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਮਰੈ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੁ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਹਉ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: hamarai sravan simaran har keeratan hau har bin reh na skau hau ik khin |
English: My ears hear the Lord's Kirtan, and I contemplate Him; without the Lord, I cannot live, even for an instant.

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੇ ਹੰਸੁ ਸਰਵਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਤੈਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਿਨੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jaise hans saravar bin reh na sakai taise har jan kiau rahai har sevaa bin |1|
English: As the swan cannot live without the lake, how can the Lord's slave live without serving Him? ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਿਨਹੂੰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਈ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਰਿਦ ਧਾਰਿ ਕਿਨਹੂੰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਈ ਮੋਹ ਅਪਮਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: kinahoon preet laaee doojaa bhaau rid dhaar kinahoon preet laaee moh apamaan |
English: Some enshrine love for duality in their hearts, and some pledge love for worldly attachments and ego.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਬਾਣ ਪਦ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੨॥੧੪॥੬੬॥
Transliteration: har jan preet laaee har nirabaan pad naanak simarat har har bhagavaan |2|14|66|
English: The Lord's servant embraces love for the Lord and the state of Nirvaanaa; Nanak contemplates the Lord, the Lord God. ||2||14||66||

[Ang 369 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾਵਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: aasaavaree mahalaa 4 |
English: Aasaavaree, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਾਈ ਮੋਰੋ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਬਤਾਵਹੁ ਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: maaee moro preetam raam bataavahu ree maaee |
English: O mother, my mother, tell me about my Beloved Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਕਰਹਲੁ ਬੇਲਿ ਰੀਝਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hau har bin khin pal reh na skau jaise karahal bel reejhaaee |1| rahaau |
English: Without the Lord, I cannot live for a moment, even an instant; I love Him, like the camel loves the vine. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਮਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗ ਬਿਰਕਤੁ ਭਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਮੀਤ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: hamaraa man bairaag birakat bheo har darasan meet kai taaee |
English: My mind has become sad and distant, longing for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, my Friend.

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੇ ਅਲਿ ਕਮਲਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਤੈਸੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jaise al kamalaa bin reh na sakai taise mohi har bin rehan na jaaee |1|
English: As the bumblebee cannot live without the lotus, I cannot live without the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਖੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਰਧਾ ਪੂਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: raakh saran jagadeesur piaare mohi saradhaa poor har gusaaee |
English: Keep me under Your Protection, O Beloved Master of the Universe; fulfill my faith, O Lord of the World.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਹੋਤ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਿਮਖ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥੨॥੩੯॥੧੩॥੧੫॥੬੭॥
Transliteration: jan naanak kai man anad hot hai har darasan nimakh dikhaaee |2|39|13|15|67|
English: Servant Nanak's mind is filled with bliss, when he beholds the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, even for an instant. ||2||39||13||15||67||

[Ang 370 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raag aasaa ghar 2 mahalaa 5 |
English: Raag Aasaa, Second House, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਲਾਈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸੋਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jin laaee preet soee fir khaaeaa |
English: One who loves her, is ultimately devoured.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਬੈਠਾਲੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਉ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jin sukh baitthaalee tis bhau bahut dikhaaeaa |
English: One who seats her in comfort, is totally terrified by her.

Gurbani: ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਦੇਖਿ ਬਿਬਾਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: bhaaee meet kuttanb dekh bibaade |
English: Siblings, friends and family, beholding her, argue.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਆਈ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ham aaee vasagat gur parasaade |1|
English: But she has come under my control, by Guru's Grace. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਬਿਮੋਹਿਤ ਹੋਏ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa dekh bimohit hoe |
English: Beholding her, all are bewitched:

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਸੁਰਦੇਵ ਮਨੁਖਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਭਿ ਧ੍ਰੋਹਨਿ ਧ੍ਰੋਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saadhik sidh suradev manukhaa bin saadhoo sabh dhrohan dhrohe |1| rahaau |
English: the strivers, the Siddhas, the demi-gods, angels and mortals. All, except the Saadhus, are deceived by her deception. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਾਮਿ ਵਿਆਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: eik fireh udaasee tina kaam viaapai |
English: Some wander around as renunciates, but they are engrossed in sexual desire.

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਸੰਚਹਿ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਤਿਨੑ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਆਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: eik sancheh girahee tina hoe na aapai |
English: Some grow rich as householders, but she does not belong to them.

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਸਤੀ ਕਹਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਨੑ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕਲਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: eik satee kahaaveh tina bahut kalapaavai |
English: Some call themselves men of charity, and she torments them terribly.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਲਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ham har raakhe lag satigur paavai |2|
English: The Lord has saved me, by attaching me to the Feet of the True Guru. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤਪੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਤਪਸੀ ਭੂਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: tap karate tapasee bhoolaae |
English: She leads astray the penitents who practice penance.

Gurbani: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮੋਹੇ ਲੋਭਿ ਸਬਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: panddit mohe lobh sabaae |
English: The scholarly Pandits are all seduced by greed.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮੋਹੇ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਆਕਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: trai gun mohe mohiaa aakaas |
English: The world of the three qualities is enticed, and the heavens are enticed.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਰਾਖੇ ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਥੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ham satigur raakhe de kar haath |3|
English: The True Guru has saved me, by giving me His Hand. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੀ ਹੋਇ ਵਰਤੀ ਦਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: giaanee kee hoe varatee daas |
English: She is the slave of those who are spiritually wise.

Gurbani: ਕਰ ਜੋੜੇ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: kar jorre sevaa kare aradaas |
English: With her palms pressed together, she serves them and offers her prayer:

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੂੰ ਕਹਹਿ ਸੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo toon kaheh su kaar kamaavaa |
English: "Whatever you wish, that is what I shall do."

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak guramukh nerr na aavaa |4|1|
English: O servant Nanak, she does not draw near to the Gurmukh. ||4||1||

[Ang 370 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਸੂ ਤੇ ਪਿਰਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਵਾਖਿ ॥
Transliteration: sasoo te pir keenee vaakh |
English: I have been separated from my Beloved by Maya (my mother-in-law).

Gurbani: ਦੇਰ ਜਿਠਾਣੀ ਮੁਈ ਦੂਖਿ ਸੰਤਾਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: der jitthaanee muee dookh santaap |
English: Hope and desire (my younger brother-in-law and sister-in-law) are dying of grief.

Gurbani: ਘਰ ਕੇ ਜਿਠੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਚੂਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ॥
Transliteration: ghar ke jitthere kee chookee kaan |
English: I am no longer swayed by the fear of Death (my elder brother-in-law).

Gurbani: ਪਿਰਿ ਰਖਿਆ ਕੀਨੀ ਸੁਘੜ ਸੁਜਾਣਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: pir rakhiaa keenee sugharr sujaan |1|
English: I am protected by my All-knowing, Wise Husband Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਲੋਕਾ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sunahu lokaa mai prem ras paaeaa |
English: Listen, O people: I have tasted the elixir of love.

Gurbani: ਦੁਰਜਨ ਮਾਰੇ ਵੈਰੀ ਸੰਘਾਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: durajan maare vairee sanghaare satigur mo kau har naam divaaeaa |1| rahaau |
English: The evil ones are dead, and my enemies are destroyed. The True Guru has given me the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਥਮੇ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: prathame tiaagee haumai preet |
English: First, I renounced my egotistical love of myself.

Gurbani: ਦੁਤੀਆ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਲੋਗਾ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: duteea tiaagee logaa reet |
English: Second, I renounced the ways of the world.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਦੁਰਜਨ ਮੀਤ ਸਮਾਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: trai gun tiaag durajan meet samaane |
English: Renouncing the three qualities, I look alike upon friend and enemy.

Gurbani: ਤੁਰੀਆ ਗੁਣੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧ ਪਛਾਨੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tureea gun mil saadh pachhaane |2|
English: And then, the fourth state of bliss was revealed to me by the Holy One. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਹਜ ਗੁਫਾ ਮਹਿ ਆਸਣੁ ਬਾਧਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj gufaa meh aasan baadhiaa |
English: In the cave of celestial bliss, I have obtained a seat.

Gurbani: ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪ ਅਨਾਹਦੁ ਵਾਜਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jot saroop anaahad vaajiaa |
English: The Lord of Light plays the unstruck melody of bliss.

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: mahaa anand gurasabad veechaar |
English: I am in ecstasy, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਤੀ ਧਨ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: pria siau raatee dhan sohaagan naar |3|
English: Imbued with my Beloved Husband Lord, I am the blessed, happy soul-bride. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jan naanak bole braham beechaar |
English: Servant Nanak chants the wisdom of God;

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਸੁਣੇ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jo sune kamaavai su utarai paar |
English: one who listens and practices it, is carried across and saved.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: janam na marai na aavai na jaae |
English: He is not born, and he does not die; he does not come or go.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਓਹੁ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੨॥
