Transliteration: har setee ohu rahai samaae |4|2|
English: He remains blended with the Lord. ||4||2||

[Ang 370 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਿਜ ਭਗਤੀ ਸੀਲਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: nij bhagatee seelavantee naar |
English: The bride shows such special devotion, and has such an agreeable disposition.

Gurbani: ਰੂਪਿ ਅਨੂਪ ਪੂਰੀ ਆਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: roop anoop pooree aachaar |
English: Her beauty is incomparable, and her character is perfect.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਵਸੈ ਸੋ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: jit grihi vasai so grihu sobhaavantaa |
English: The house in which she dwells is such a praiseworthy house.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਜੰਤਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: guramukh paaee kinai viralai jantaa |1|
English: But rare are those who, as Gurmukh, attain that state||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਮ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sukaranee kaaman gur mil ham paaee |
English: As the soul-bride of pure actions, I have met with the Guru.

Gurbani: ਜਜਿ ਕਾਜਿ ਪਰਥਾਇ ਸੁਹਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaj kaaj parathaae suhaaee |1| rahaau |
English: In worship, marriage and in the next world, such a soul-bride looks beautiful. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਚਰੁ ਵਸੀ ਪਿਤਾ ਕੈ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
Transliteration: jichar vasee pitaa kai saath |
English: As long as she lived with her father,

Gurbani: ਤਿਚਰੁ ਕੰਤੁ ਬਹੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਉਦਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: tichar kant bahu firai udaas |
English: her Husband wandered around in sadness.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਨਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kar sevaa sat purakh manaaeaa |
English: I served and surrendered to the Lord, the True Being;

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਆਣੀ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਤਾ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur aanee ghar meh taa sarab sukh paaeaa |2|
English: the Guru brought my bride to my home, and I obtained total happiness. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬਤੀਹ ਸੁਲਖਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਤਤਿ ਪੂਤ ॥
Transliteration: bateeh sulakhanee sach santat poot |
English: She is blessed with all sublime attributes,

Gurbani: ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ਸੁਘੜ ਸਰੂਪ ॥
Transliteration: aagiaakaaree sugharr saroop |
English: And her generations are unblemished.

Gurbani: ਇਛ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਨ ਕੰਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: eichh poore man kant suaamee |
English: Her Husband, her Lord and Master, fulfills her heart's desires.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਸੰਤੋਖੀ ਦੇਰ ਜੇਠਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sagal santokhee der jetthaanee |3|
English: Hope and desire (my younger brother-in-law and sister-in-law) are now totally content. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਪਰਵਾਰੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਰੇਸਟ ॥
Transliteration: sabh paravaarai maeh saresatt |
English: She is the most noble of all the family.

Gurbani: ਮਤੀ ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵਰ ਜੇਸਟ ॥
Transliteration: matee devee devar jesatt |
English: She counsels and advises her hope and desire.

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: dhan su grihu jit pragattee aae |
English: How blessed is that household, in which she has appeared.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥੪॥੩॥
Transliteration: jan naanak sukhe sukh vihaae |4|3|
English: O servant Nanak, she passes her time in perfect peace and comfort. ||4||3||

[Ang 371 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਤਾ ਕਰਉ ਸੋ ਪਕਨਿ ਨ ਦੇਈ ॥
Transliteration: mataa krau so pakan na deee |
English: Whatever I resolve, she does not allow it to come to pass.

Gurbani: ਸੀਲ ਸੰਜਮ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਖਲੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: seel sanjam kai nikatt khaloee |
English: She stands blocking the way of goodness and self-discipline.

Gurbani: ਵੇਸ ਕਰੇ ਬਹੁ ਰੂਪ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: ves kare bahu roop dikhaavai |
English: She wears many disguises, and assumes many forms,

Gurbani: ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਬਸਨਿ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਵਖਿ ਵਖਿ ਭਰਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: grihi basan na deee vakh vakh bharamaavai |1|
English: and she does not allow me to dwell in my own home. She forces me to wander around in different directions. ||1||

Gurbani: ਘਰ ਕੀ ਨਾਇਕਿ ਘਰ ਵਾਸੁ ਨ ਦੇਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: ghar kee naaeik ghar vaas na devai |
English: She has become the mistress of my home, and she does not allow me to live in it.

Gurbani: ਜਤਨ ਕਰਉ ਉਰਝਾਇ ਪਰੇਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jatan krau urajhaae parevai |1| rahaau |
English: If I try, she fights with me. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਧੁਰ ਕੀ ਭੇਜੀ ਆਈ ਆਮਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: dhur kee bhejee aaee aamar |
English: In the beginning, she was sent as a helper,

Gurbani: ਨਉ ਖੰਡ ਜੀਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰ ॥
Transliteration: nau khandd jeete sabh thaan thanantar |
English: but she has overwhelmed the nine continents, all places and interspaces.

Gurbani: ਤਟਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਜੋਗ ਸੰਨਿਆਸ ॥
Transliteration: tatt teerath na chhoddai jog saniaas |
English: She has not spared even the river banks, the sacred shrines of pilgrimage, the Yogis and Sannyaasees,

Gurbani: ਪੜਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਬੇਦ ਅਭਿਆਸ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: parr thaake sinmrit bed abhiaas |2|
English: or those who tirelessly read the Simritees and study the Vedas. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਬੈਸਉ ਤਹ ਨਾਲੇ ਬੈਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: jeh baisau teh naale baisai |
English: Wherever I sit, she sits there with me.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਬਲ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: sagal bhavan meh sabal pravesai |
English: She has imposed her power upon the whole world.

Gurbani: ਹੋਛੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: hochhee saran peaa rehan na paaee |
English: Seeking meager protection, I am not protected from her.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਮੀਤਾ ਹਉ ਕੈ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kahu meetaa hau kai peh jaaee |3|
English: Tell me, O my friend: unto whom should I turn for protection? ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sun upades satigur peh aaeaa |
English: I heard of His Teachings, and so I have come to the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur har har naam mohi mantru drirraaeaa |
English: The Guru has implanted the Mantra of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, within me.

Gurbani: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਅਨੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: nij ghar vasiaa gun gaae anantaa |
English: And now, I dwell in the home of my own inner self; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Infinite Lord.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਏ ਅਚਿੰਤਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: prabh milio naanak bhe achintaa |4|
English: I have met God, O Nanak, and I have become care-free. ||4||

Gurbani: ਘਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਇਹ ਨਾਇਕਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: ghar meraa ih naaeik hamaaree |
English: My home is now my own, and she is now my mistress.

Gurbani: ਇਹ ਆਮਰਿ ਹਮ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਦਰਬਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੪॥੪॥
Transliteration: eih aamar ham gur kee darabaaree |1| rahaau doojaa |4|4|
English: She is now my servant, and the Guru has made me intimate with the Lord. ||1||Second Pause||4||4||

[Ang 371 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਥਮੇ ਮਤਾ ਜਿ ਪਤ੍ਰੀ ਚਲਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: prathame mataa ji patree chalaavau |
English: First, they advised me to send a letter.

Gurbani: ਦੁਤੀਏ ਮਤਾ ਦੁਇ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਪਹੁਚਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: dutee mataa due maanukh pahuchaavau |
English: Second, they advised me to send two men.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਤੀਏ ਮਤਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਉ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tritee mataa kichh krau upaaeaa |
English: Third, they advised me to make the effort and do something.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਹੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mai sabh kichh chhodd prabh tuhee dhiaaeaa |1|
English: But I have renounced everything, and I meditate only on You, God. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਅਚਿੰਤ ਸਹਜਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: mahaa anand achint sahajaaeaa |
English: Now, I am totally blissful, carefree and at ease.

Gurbani: ਦੁਸਮਨ ਦੂਤ ਮੁਏ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dusaman doot mue sukh paaeaa |1| rahaau |
English: The enemies and evil-doers have perished, and I have obtained peace. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੀਆ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: satigur mo kau deea upades |
English: The True Guru has imparted the Teachings to me.

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦੇਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: jeeo pindd sabh har kaa des |
English: My soul, body and everything belong to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੀ ਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: jo kichh karee su teraa taan |
English: Whatever I do, is by Your Almighty Power.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਓਟ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: toon meree ott toonhai deebaan |2|
English: You are my only Support, You are my only Court. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੁਧਨੋ ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈਂ ਧਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: tudhano chhodd jaaeeai prabh kain dhar |
English: If I were to renounce You, God, unto whom could I turn?

Gurbani: ਆਨ ਨ ਬੀਆ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਮਸਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: aan na beea teree samasar |
English: There is no other, comparable to You.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਕਿਸ ਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ॥
Transliteration: tere sevak kau kis kee kaan |
English: Who else is Your servant to serve?

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤੁ ਭੂਲਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਬੇਬਾਣਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: saakat bhoolaa firai bebaan |3|
English: The faithless cynics are deluded; they wander around in the wilderness. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: teree vaddiaaee kahee na jaae |
English: Your Glorious Greatness cannot be described.

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਕਹ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jeh keh raakh laihi gal laae |
English: Wherever I am, you save me, hugging me close in Your embrace.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: naanak daas teree saranaaee |
English: Nanak, Your slave, has entered Your Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਪੈਜ ਵਜੀ ਵਾਧਾਈ ॥੪॥੫॥
Transliteration: prabh raakhee paij vajee vaadhaaee |4|5|
English: God has preserved his honor, and congratulations are pouring in. ||4||5||

[Ang 372 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪਰਦੇਸੁ ਝਾਗਿ ਸਉਦੇ ਕਉ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: parades jhaag saude kau aaeaa |
English: Having wandered through foreign lands, I have come here to do business.

Gurbani: ਵਸਤੁ ਅਨੂਪ ਸੁਣੀ ਲਾਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: vasat anoop sunee laabhaaeaa |
English: I heard of the incomparable and profitable merchandise.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਰਾਸਿ ਬੰਨਿੑ ਪਲੈ ਆਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: gun raas bana palai aanee |
English: I have gathered in my pockets my capital of virtue, and I have brought it here with me.

Gurbani: ਦੇਖਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਪਟਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dekh ratan ihu man lapattaanee |1|
English: Beholding the jewel, this mind is fascinated. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਾਹ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: saah vaapaaree duaarai aae |
English: I have come to the door of the Trader.

Gurbani: ਵਖਰੁ ਕਾਢਹੁ ਸਉਦਾ ਕਰਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: vakhar kaadtahu saudaa karaae |1| rahaau |
English: Please display the merchandise, so that the business may be transacted. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਹਿ ਪਠਾਇਆ ਸਾਹੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: saeh patthaaeaa saahai paas |
English: The Trader has sent me to the Banker.

Gurbani: ਅਮੋਲ ਰਤਨ ਅਮੋਲਾ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: amol ratan amolaa raas |
English: The jewel is priceless, and the capital is priceless.

Gurbani: ਵਿਸਟੁ ਸੁਭਾਈ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: visatt subhaaee paaeaa meet |
English: O my gentle brother, mediator and friend

Gurbani: ਸਉਦਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਚੀਤ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saudaa miliaa nihachal cheet |2|
English: - I have obtained the merchandise, and my consciousness is now steady and stable. ||2||

Gurbani: ਭਉ ਨਹੀ ਤਸਕਰ ਪਉਣ ਨ ਪਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: bhau nahee tasakar paun na paanee |
English: I have no fear of thieves, of wind or water.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜਿ ਵਿਹਾਝੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj vihaajhee sehaj lai jaanee |
English: I have easily made my purchase, and I easily take it away.

Gurbani: ਸਤ ਕੈ ਖਟਿਐ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sat kai khattiai dukh nahee paaeaa |
English: I have earned Truth, and I shall have no pain.

Gurbani: ਸਹੀ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਘਰਿ ਲੈ ਆਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sahee salaamat ghar lai aaeaa |3|
English: I have brought this merchandise home, safe and sound. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿਆ ਲਾਹਾ ਭਏ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: miliaa laahaa bhe anand |
English: I have earned the profit, and I am happy.

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਸਾਹ ਪੂਰੇ ਬਖਸਿੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: dhan saah poore bakhasind |
English: Blessed is the Banker, the Perfect Bestower.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਸਉਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: eihu saudaa guramukh kinai viralai paaeaa |
English: How rare is the Gurmukh who obtains this merchandise;

Gurbani: ਸਹਲੀ ਖੇਪ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਲੈ ਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੬॥
Transliteration: sahalee khep naanak lai aaeaa |4|6|
English: Nanak has brought this profitable merchandise home. ||4||6||

[Ang 372 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਨੁ ਅਵਗਨੁ ਮੇਰੋ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: gun avagan mero kachh na beechaaro |
English: He does not consider my merits or demerits.

Gurbani: ਨਹ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਸਂੀਗਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: neh dekhio roop rang saneegaaro |
English: He does not look at my beauty, color or decorations.

Gurbani: ਚਜ ਅਚਾਰ ਕਿਛੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: chaj achaar kichh bidh nahee jaanee |
English: I do not know the ways of wisdom and good conduct.

Gurbani: ਬਾਹ ਪਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੇਜੈ ਆਨੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: baah pakar pria sejai aanee |1|
English: But taking me by the arm, my Husband Lord has led me to His Bed. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁਨਿਬੋ ਸਖੀ ਕੰਤਿ ਹਮਾਰੋ ਕੀਅਲੋ ਖਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: sunibo sakhee kant hamaaro keealo khasamaanaa |
English: Hear, O my companions, my Husband, my Lord Master, possesses me.

Gurbani: ਕਰੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਕਰਿ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਨੈ ਇਹੁ ਲੋਕੁ ਅਜਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kar masatak dhaar raakhio kar apunaa kiaa jaanai ihu lok ajaanaa |1| rahaau |
English: Placing His Hand upon my forehead, He protects me as His Own. What do these ignorant people know? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੁਹਾਗੁ ਹਮਾਰੋ ਅਬ ਹੁਣਿ ਸੋਹਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: suhaag hamaaro ab hun sohio |
English: My married life now appears so beauteous;

Gurbani: ਕੰਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਮੇਰੋ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਜੋਹਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: kant milio mero sabh dukh johio |
English: my Husband Lord has met me, and He sees all my pains.

Gurbani: ਆਂਗਨਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਚੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: aangan merai sobhaa chand |
English: Within the courtyard of my heart, the glory of the moon shines.

Gurbani: ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੰਗਿ ਅਨੰਦ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: nis baasur pria sang anand |2|
English: Night and day, I have fun with my Beloved. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲ ॥
Transliteration: basatr hamaare rang chalool |
English: My clothes are dyed the deep crimson color of the poppy.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਆਭਰਣ ਸੋਭਾ ਕੰਠਿ ਫੂਲ ॥
Transliteration: sagal aabharan sobhaa kantth fool |
English: All the ornaments and garlands around my neck adorn me.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪੇਖੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਪਾਏ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: pria pekhee drisatt paae sagal nidhaan |
English: Gazing upon my Beloved with my eyes, I have obtained all treasures;

Gurbani: ਦੁਸਟ ਦੂਤ ਕੀ ਚੂਕੀ ਕਾਨਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: dusatt doot kee chookee kaan |3|
English: I have shaken off the power of the evil demons. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਦ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: sad khuseea sadaa rang maane |
English: I have obtained eternal bliss, and I constantly celebrate.

Gurbani: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: nau nidh naam grih meh tripataane |
English: With the nine treasures of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, I am satisfied in my own home.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਉ ਪਿਰਹਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak jau pireh seegaaree |
English: Says Nanak, when the happy soul-bride is adorned by her Beloved,

Gurbani: ਥਿਰੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਨਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਭਤਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੭॥
Transliteration: thir sohaagan sang bhataaree |4|7|
English: she is forever happy with her Husband Lord. ||4||7||

[Ang 372 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਕਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: daan dee kar poojaa karanaa |
English: They give you donations and worship you.

Gurbani: ਲੈਤ ਦੇਤ ਉਨੑ ਮੂਕਰਿ ਪਰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: lait det una mookar paranaa |
English: You take from them, and then deny that they have given anything to you.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਦਰਿ ਤੁਮੑ ਹੈ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: jit dar tuma hai braahaman jaanaa |
English: That door, through which you must ultimately go, O Brahmin

Gurbani: ਤਿਤੁ ਦਰਿ ਤੂੰਹੀ ਹੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਣਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tit dar toonhee hai pachhutaanaa |1|
English: - at that door, you will come to regret and repent. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸੇ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣ ਡੂਬੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aise braahaman ddoobe bhaaee |
English: Such Brahmins shall drown, O Siblings of Destiny;

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਾਪਰਾਧ ਚਿਤਵਹਿ ਬੁਰਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: niraaparaadh chitaveh buriaaee |1| rahaau |
English: they think of doing evil to the innocent. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਹਲਕਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: antar lobh fireh halakaae |
English: Within them is greed, and they wander around like mad dogs.

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰੁ ਉਠਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: nindaa kareh sir bhaar utthaae |
English: They slander others and carry loads of sin upon their heads.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੂਠਾ ਚੇਤੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mootthaa chetai naahee |
English: Intoxicated by Maya, they do not think of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਰਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bharame bhoolaa bahutee raahee |2|
English: Deluded by doubt, they wander off on many paths. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਹਿ ਘਨੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: baahar bhekh kareh ghanere |
English: Outwardly, they wear various religious robes,

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਉਤਰੀ ਘੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: antar bikhiaa utaree ghere |
English: but within, they are enveloped by poison.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੈ ਆਪਿ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
Transliteration: avar upadesai aap na boojhai |
English: They instruct others, but do not understand themselves.

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਸੀਝੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aisaa braahaman kahee na seejhai |3|
English: Such Brahmins will never be emancipated. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮੂਰਖ ਬਾਮਣ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: moorakh baaman prabhoo samaal |
English: O foolish Brahmin, reflect upon God.

Gurbani: ਦੇਖਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਤੇਰੈ ਹੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: dekhat sunat terai hai naal |
English: He watches and hears, and is always with you.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੇ ਹੋਵੀ ਭਾਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak je hovee bhaag |
English: Says Nanak, if this is your destiny,

Gurbani: ਮਾਨੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੁ ॥੪॥੮॥
Transliteration: maan chhodd gur charanee laag |4|8|
English: renounce your pride, and grasp the Guru's Feet. ||4||8||

[Ang 372 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦੂਖ ਰੋਗ ਭਏ ਗਤੁ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: dookh rog bhe gat tan te man niramal har har gun gaae |
English: Pain and disease have left my body, and my mind has become pure; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਭਏ ਅਨੰਦ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਅਬ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਕਤ ਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bhe anand mil saadhoo sang ab meraa man kat hee na jaae |1|
English: I am in bliss, meeting with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and now, my mind does not go wandering. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤਪਤਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: tapat bujhee gurasabadee maae |
English: My burning desires are quenched, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, O mother.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਸਿ ਗਇਓ ਤਾਪ ਸਭ ਸਹਸਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: binas geo taap sabh sahasaa gur seetal milio sehaj subhaae |1| rahaau |
English: The fever of doubt has been totally eliminated; meeting the Guru, I am cooled and soothed, with intuitive ease. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਧਾਵਤ ਰਹੇ ਏਕੁ ਇਕੁ ਬੂਝਿਆ ਆਇ ਬਸੇ ਅਬ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਥਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: dhaavat rahe ek ik boojhiaa aae base ab nihachal thaae |
English: My wandering has ended, since I have realized the One and Only Lord; now, I have come to dwell in the eternal place.

Gurbani: ਜਗਤੁ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਸੰਤ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਤ ਰਹੇ ਅਘਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jagat udhaaran sant tumaare darasan pekhat rahe aghaae |2|
English: Your Saints are the Saving Grace of the world; beholding the Blessed Vision of their Darshan, I remain satisfied. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਦੋਖ ਪਰੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਾਛੈ ਅਬ ਪਕਰੇ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: janam dokh pare mere paachhai ab pakare nihachal saadhoo paae |
English: I have left behind the sins of countless incarnations, now that I have grasped the feet of the eternal Holy Guru.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਮੰਗਲ ਮਨੂਆ ਅਬ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਫੁਨਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sehaj dhun gaavai mangal manooaa ab taa kau fun kaal na khaae |3|
English: My mind sings the celestial melody of bliss, and death shall no longer consume it. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਰਨ ਕਾਰਨ ਸਮਰਥ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: karan kaaran samarath hamaare sukhadaaee mere har har raae |
English: My Lord, the Cause of all causes, is All-powerful, the Giver of peace; He is my Lord, my Lord King.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਇ ॥੪॥੯॥
Transliteration: naam teraa jap jeevai naanak ot pot merai sang sahaae |4|9|
English: Nanak lives by chanting Your Name, O Lord; You are my helper, with me, through and through. ||4||9||

[Ang 373 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਰੜਾਵੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਵੈ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: ararraavai bilalaavai nindak |
English: The slanderer cries out and bewails.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਬਿਸਰਿਆ ਅਪਣਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਪਾਵੈ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham paramesar bisariaa apanaa keetaa paavai nindak |1| rahaau |
English: He has forgotten the Supreme Lord, the Transcendent Lord; the slanderer reaps the rewards of his own actions. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ਉਸ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਲੇ ਲਏ ਸਿਧਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: je koee us kaa sangee hovai naale le sidhaavai |
English: If someone is his companion, then he shall be taken along with him.

Gurbani: ਅਣਹੋਦਾ ਅਜਗਰੁ ਭਾਰੁ ਉਠਾਏ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਅਗਨੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਜਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: anahodaa ajagar bhaar utthaae nindak aganee maeh jalaavai |1|
English: Like the dragon, the slanderer carries his huge, useless loads, and burns in his own fire. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਕੈ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਜਿ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਤੀਤੈ ਸੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: paramesar kai duaarai ji hoe biteetai su naanak aakh sunaavai |
English: Nanak proclaims and announces what happens at the Door of the Transcendent Lord.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਇ ਬਿਗਸਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: bhagat janaa kau sadaa anand hai har keeratan gaae bigasaavai |2|10|
English: The humble devotees of the Lord are forever in bliss; singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, they blossom forth. ||2||10||

[Ang 373 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਮੈ ਕੀਓ ਸਗਲ ਸੀਗਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jau mai keeo sagal seegaaraa |
English: Even though I totally decorated myself,

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਭੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਪਤੀਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: tau bhee meraa man na pateeaaraa |
English: still, my mind was not satisfied.

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਸੁਗੰਧਤ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਲਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: anik sugandhat tan meh laavau |
English: I applied various scented oils to my body,

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: ohu sukh til samaan nahee paavau |
English: and yet, I did not obtain even a tiny bit of pleasure from this.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਐਸੀ ਆਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: man meh chitvau aisee aasaaee |
English: Within my mind, I hold such a desire,

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਦੇਖਤ ਜੀਵਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: pria dekhat jeevau meree maaee |1|
English: that I may live only to behold my Beloved, O my mother. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਾਈ ਕਹਾ ਕਰਉ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਧੀਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: maaee kahaa krau ihu man na dheerai |
English: O mother, what should I do? This mind cannot rest.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਹਿਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: pria preetam bairaag hirai |1| rahaau |
English: It is bewitched by the tender love of my Beloved. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਬਿਭੂਖਨ ਸੁਖ ਬਹੁਤ ਬਿਸੇਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: basatr bibhookhan sukh bahut bisekhai |
English: Garments, ornaments, and such exquisite pleasures

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਭੀ ਜਾਨਉ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਲੇਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: oe bhee jaanau kitai na lekhai |
English: I look upon these as of no account.

Gurbani: ਪਤਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਅਰੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਮਹਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: pat sobhaa ar maan mehat |
English: Likewise, honor, fame, dignity and greatness,

Gurbani: ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ਸਗਲ ਜਗਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: aagiaakaaree sagal jagat |
English: obedience by the whole world,

Gurbani: ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਐਸਾ ਹੈ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਲਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: grihu aisaa hai sundar laal |
English: and a household as beautiful as a jewel.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਾ ਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: prabh bhaavaa taa sadaa nihaal |2|
English: If I am pleasing to God's Will, then I shall be blessed, and forever in bliss. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬਿੰਜਨ ਭੋਜਨ ਅਨਿਕ ਪਰਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: binjan bhojan anik parakaar |
English: With foods and delicacies of so many different kinds,

Gurbani: ਰੰਗ ਤਮਾਸੇ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: rang tamaase bahut bisathaar |
English: and such abundant pleasures and entertainments,

Gurbani: ਰਾਜ ਮਿਲਖ ਅਰੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: raaj milakh ar bahut furamaaeis |
English: power and property and absolute command

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਨ ਜਾਇਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: man nahee dhraapai trisanaa na jaaeis |
English: with these, the mind is not satisfied, and its thirst is not quenched.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਮਿਲਬੇ ਇਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਨ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: bin milabe ihu din na bihaavai |
English: Without meeting Him, this day does not pass.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤਾ ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: milai prabhoo taa sabh sukh paavai |3|
English: Meeting God, I find peace. ||3||

Gurbani: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਸੁਨੀ ਇਹ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: khojat khojat sunee ih soe |
English: By searching and seeking, I have heard this news,

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਤਰਿਓ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasangat bin tario na koe |
English: that without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, no one swims across.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jis masatak bhaag tin satigur paaeaa |
English: One who has this good destiny written upon his forehead, finds the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੀ ਆਸਾ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: pooree aasaa man tripataaeaa |
English: His hopes are fulfilled, and his mind is satisfied.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਾ ਚੂਕੀ ਡੰਝਾ ॥
Transliteration: prabh miliaa taa chookee ddanjhaa |
English: When one meets God, then his thirst is quenched.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਧਾ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਮੰਝਾ ॥੪॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: naanak ladhaa man tan manjhaa |4|11|
English: Nanak has found the Lord, within his mind and body. ||4||11||

[Ang 373 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਪੰਚਪਦੇ₃ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 panchapade₃ |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Panch-Padhay:

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਥਮੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਨੀਕੀ ਜਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: prathame teree neekee jaat |
English: First, your social status is high.

Gurbani: ਦੁਤੀਆ ਤੇਰੀ ਮਨੀਐ ਪਾਂਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: duteea teree maneeai paant |
English: Second, you are honored in society.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਤੀਆ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: triteea teraa sundar thaan |
English: Third, your home is beautiful.

Gurbani: ਬਿਗੜ ਰੂਪੁ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bigarr roop man meh abhimaan |1|
English: But you are so ugly, with self-conceit in your mind. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੋਹਨੀ ਸਰੂਪਿ ਸੁਜਾਣਿ ਬਿਚਖਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: sohanee saroop sujaan bichakhan |
English: O beautiful, attractive, wise and clever woman:

Gurbani: ਅਤਿ ਗਰਬੈ ਮੋਹਿ ਫਾਕੀ ਤੂੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: at garabai mohi faakee toon |1| rahaau |
English: you have been trapped by your pride and attachment. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਤਿ ਸੂਚੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਪਾਕਸਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: at soochee teree paakasaal |
English: Your kitchen is so clean.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਪੂਜਾ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਲਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: kar isanaan poojaa tilak laal |
English: You take your bath, and worship, and apply the crimson mark upon your forehead;

Gurbani: ਗਲੀ ਗਰਬਹਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਗੋਵਹਿ ਗਿਆਨ ॥
Transliteration: galee garabeh mukh goveh giaan |
English: with your mouth you speak wisdom, but you are destroyed by pride.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਖੋਈ ਲੋਭਿ ਸੁਆਨ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sabh bidh khoee lobh suaan |2|
English: The dog of greed has ruined you in every way. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਾਪਰ ਪਹਿਰਹਿ ਭੋਗਹਿ ਭੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: kaapar pahireh bhogeh bhog |
English: You wear your robes and enjoy pleasures;

Gurbani: ਆਚਾਰ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਮਹਿ ਲੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: aachaar kareh sobhaa meh log |
English: you practice good conduct to impress people;

Gurbani: ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: choaa chandan sugandh bisathaar |
English: you apply scented oils of sandalwood and musk,

Gurbani: ਸੰਗੀ ਖੋਟਾ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਚੰਡਾਲ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sangee khottaa krodh chanddaal |3|
English: but your constant companion is the demon of anger. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅਵਰ ਜੋਨਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਪਨਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: avar jon teree panihaaree |
English: Other people may be your water-carriers;

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਧਰਤੀ ਮਹਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਿਕਦਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: eis dharatee meh teree sikadaaree |
English: in this world, you may be a ruler.

Gurbani: ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੂਪਾ ਤੁਝ ਪਹਿ ਦਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sueinaa roopaa tujh peh daam |
English: Gold, silver and wealth may be yours,

Gurbani: ਸੀਲੁ ਬਿਗਾਰਿਓ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਾਮ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: seel bigaario teraa kaam |4|
English: but the goodness of your conduct has been destroyed by sexual promiscuity. ||4||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਮਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kau drisatt meaa har raae |
English: That soul, upon whom the Lord has bestowed His Glance of Grace,

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਬੰਦੀ ਤੇ ਲਈ ਛਡਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: saa bandee te lee chhaddaae |
English: is delivered from bondage.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang mil har ras paaeaa |
English: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Lord's sublime essence is obtained.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਫਲ ਓਹ ਕਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak safal oeh kaaeaa |5|
English: Says Nanak, how fruitful is that body. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਰੂਪ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਬਨੇ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: sabh roop sabh sukh bane suhaagan |
English: All graces and all comforts shall come to you, as the happy soul-bride;

Gurbani: ਅਤਿ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਬਿਚਖਨਿ ਤੂੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: at sundar bichakhan toon |1| rahaau doojaa |12|
English: you shall be supremely beautiful and wise. ||1||Second Pause||12||

[Ang 374 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਇਕਤੁਕੇ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ikatuke 2 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Ek-Thukay 2 :

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਤ ਦੀਸੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਪਰ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeevat deesai tis sarapar maranaa |
English: One who is seen to be alive, shall surely die.

Gurbani: ਮੁਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਰਹਣਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: muaa hovai tis nihachal rahanaa |1|
English: But he who is dead shall remain ever-lasting. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਤ ਮੁਏ ਮੁਏ ਸੇ ਜੀਵੇ ॥
Transliteration: jeevat mue mue se jeeve |
English: Those who die while yet alive, shall through this death, live on.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਵਖਧੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam avakhadh mukh paaeaa gurasabadee ras amrit peeve |1| rahaau |
English: They place the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, as medicine in their mouths, and through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they drink in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਾਚੀ ਮਟੁਕੀ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਬਿਨਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaachee mattukee binas binaasaa |
English: The clay pot of the body shall be broken.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਛੂਟੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jis chhoottai trikuttee tis nij ghar vaasaa |2|
English: One who has eliminated the three qualities dwells in the home of his inner self. ||2||

Gurbani: ਊਚਾ ਚੜੈ ਸੁ ਪਵੈ ਪਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: aoochaa charrai su pavai peaalaa |
English: One who climbs high, shall fall into the nether regions of the underworld.

Gurbani: ਧਰਨਿ ਪੜੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਕਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: dharan parrai tis lagai na kaalaa |3|
English: One who lies upon the ground, shall not be touched by death. ||3||

Gurbani: ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਫਿਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bhramat fire tin kichhoo na paaeaa |
English: Those who continue to wander around, achieve nothing.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਅਸਥਿਰ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: se asathir jin gurasabad kamaaeaa |4|
English: Those who practice the Guru's Teachings, become steady and stable. ||4||

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: jeeo pindd sabh har kaa maal |
English: This body and soul all belong to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੫॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: naanak gur mil bhe nihaal |5|13|
English: O Nanak, meeting the Guru, I am enraptured. ||5||13||

[Ang 374 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪੁਤਰੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਟੀ ॥
Transliteration: putaree teree bidh kar thaattee |
English: The puppet of the body has been fashioned with great skill.

Gurbani: ਜਾਨੁ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਹੋਇਗੀ ਮਾਟੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jaan sat kar hoeigee maattee |1|
English: Know for sure that it shall turn to dust. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੂਲੁ ਸਮਾਲਹੁ ਅਚੇਤ ਗਵਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: mool samaalahu achet gavaaraa |
English: Remember your origins, O thoughtless fool.

Gurbani: ਇਤਨੇ ਕਉ ਤੁਮੑ ਕਿਆ ਗਰਬੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: eitane kau tuma kiaa garabe |1| rahaau |
English: Why are you so proud of yourself? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੀਨਿ ਸੇਰ ਕਾ ਦਿਹਾੜੀ ਮਿਹਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: teen ser kaa dihaarree mihamaan |
English: You are a guest, given three meals a day;

Gurbani: ਅਵਰ ਵਸਤੁ ਤੁਝ ਪਾਹਿ ਅਮਾਨ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: avar vasat tujh paeh amaan |2|
English: other things are entrusted to you. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬਿਸਟਾ ਅਸਤ ਰਕਤੁ ਪਰੇਟੇ ਚਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: bisattaa asat rakat parette chaam |
English: you are just excrement, bones and blood, wrapped up in skin

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਊਪਰਿ ਲੇ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਗੁਮਾਨ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: eis aoopar le raakhio gumaan |3|
English: - this is what you are taking such pride in! ||3||

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਵਸਤੁ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਤਾ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਪਾਕ ॥
Transliteration: ek vasat boojheh taa hoveh paak |
English: If you could understand even one thing, then you would be pure.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਤੂੰ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਪਾਕ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: bin boojhe toon sadaa naapaak |4|
English: Without understanding, you shall be forever impure. ||4||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak gur kau kurabaan |
English: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Guru;

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ॥੫॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: jis te paaeeai har purakh sujaan |5|14|
English: through Him, I obtain the Lord, the All-knowing Primal Being. ||5||14||

Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਇਕਤੁਕੇ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ikatuke chaupade |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Ek-Thukay, Chau-Padhay:

Gurbani: ਇਕ ਘੜੀ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦਿਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: eik gharree dinas mo kau bahut dihaare |
English: One moment, one day, is for me many days.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਨ ਰਹੈ ਕੈਸੇ ਮਿਲਉ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: man na rahai kaise milau piaare |1|
English: My mind cannot survive - how can I meet my Beloved? ||1||

Gurbani: ਇਕੁ ਪਲੁ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: eik pal dinas mo kau kabahu na bihaavai |
English: I cannot endure one day, even one instant without Him.

Gurbani: ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਮਨਿ ਆਸ ਘਨੇਰੀ ਕੋਈ ਐਸਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਪਿਰਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: darasan kee man aas ghaneree koee aisaa sant mo kau pireh milaavai |1| rahaau |
English: My mind's desire for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is so great. Is there any Saint who can lead me to meet my Beloved? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਹਰ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗਹ ਸਮਾਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: chaar pehar chahu jugah samaane |
English: The four watches of the day are like the four ages.

Gurbani: ਰੈਣਿ ਭਈ ਤਬ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: rain bhee tab ant na jaane |2|
English: And when night comes, I think that it shall never end. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਿਰਹੁ ਵਿਛੋੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: panch doot mil pirahu vichhorree |
English: The five demons have joined together, to separate me from my Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਰੋਵੈ ਹਾਥ ਪਛੋੜੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bhram bhram rovai haath pachhorree |3|
English: Wandering and rambling, I cry out and wring my hands. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jan naanak kau har daras dikhaaeaa |
English: The Lord has revealed the Blessed Vision of His Darshan to servant Nanak;

Gurbani: ਆਤਮੁ ਚੀਨਿੑ ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: aatam cheena param sukh paaeaa |4|15|
English: realizing his own self, he has obtained supreme peace. ||4||15||

[Ang 375 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਮਹਿ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: har sevaa meh param nidhaan |
English: In the Lord's service, are the greatest treasures.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har sevaa mukh amrit naam |1|
English: Serving the Lord, the Ambrosial Naam comes into one's mouth. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਥੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har meraa saathee sang sakhaaee |
English: The Lord is my Companion; He is with me, as my Help and Support.

Gurbani: ਦੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਿਮਰੀ ਤਹ ਮਉਜੂਦੁ ਜਮੁ ਬਪੁਰਾ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਹਾ ਡਰਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dukh sukh simaree teh maujood jam bapuraa mo kau kahaa ddaraaee |1| rahaau |
English: In pain and pleasure, whenever I remember Him, He is present. How can the poor Messenger of Death frighten me now? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਓਟ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: har meree ott mai har kaa taan |
English: The Lord is my Support; the Lord is my Power.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਖਾ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har meraa sakhaa man maeh deebaan |2|
English: The Lord is my Friend; He is my mind's advisor. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: har meree poonjee meraa har vesaahu |
English: The Lord is my capital; the Lord is my credit.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਟੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਹੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: guramukh dhan khattee har meraa saahu |3|
English: As Gurmukh, I earn the wealth, with the Lord as my Banker. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur kirapaa te ih mat aavai |
English: By Guru's Grace, this wisdom has come.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: jan naanak har kai ank samaavai |4|16|
English: Servant Nanak has merged into the Being of the Lord. ||4||16||

[Ang 375 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਤ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: prabh hoe kripaal ta ihu man laaee |
English: When God shows His Mercy, then this mind is focused on Him.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਭੈ ਫਲ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: satigur sev sabhai fal paaee |1|
English: Serving the True Guru, all rewards are obtained. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕਿਉ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਕਰਹਿਗਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: man kiau bairaag karahigaa satigur meraa pooraa |
English: O my mind, why are you so sad? My True Guru is Perfect.

Gurbani: ਮਨਸਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਭਰਪੂਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: manasaa kaa daataa sabh sukh nidhaan amrit sar sad hee bharapooraa |1| rahaau |
English: He is the Giver of blessings, the treasure of all comforts; His Ambrosial Pool of Nectar is always overflowing. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal rid antar dhaare |
English: One who enshrines His Lotus Feet within the heart,

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: pragattee jot mile raam piaare |2|
English: meets the Beloved Lord; the Divine Light is revealed to him. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਸਖੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: panch sakhee mil mangal gaaeaa |
English: The five companions have met together to sing the songs of joy.

Gurbani: ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਦੁ ਵਜਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: anahad baanee naad vajaaeaa |3|
English: The unstruck melody, the sound current of the Naad, vibrates and resounds. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur naanak tutthaa miliaa har raae |
English: O Nanak, when the Guru is totally pleased, one meets the Lord, the King.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖਿ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: sukh rain vihaanee sehaj subhaae |4|17|
English: Then, the night of one's life passes in peace and natural ease. ||4||17||

[Ang 375 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਰਗਟੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa har paragattee aaeaa |
English: Showing His Mercy, the Lord has revealed Himself to me.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਧਨੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mil satigur dhan pooraa paaeaa |1|
English: Meeting the True Guru, I have received the perfect wealth. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚੀਐ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa har dhan sancheeai bhaaee |
English: Gather such a wealth of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਭਾਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਲੈ ਜਲਿ ਨਹੀ ਡੂਬੈ ਸੰਗੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਤਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhaeh na jaalai jal nahee ddoobai sang chhodd kar katahu na jaaee |1| rahaau |
English: It cannot be burned by fire, and water cannot drown it; it does not forsake society, or go anywhere else. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨਿਖੁਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: tott na aavai nikhutt na jaae |
English: It does not run short, and it does not run out.

Gurbani: ਖਾਇ ਖਰਚਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਅਘਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: khaae kharach man rahiaa aghaae |2|
English: Eating and consuming it, the mind remains satisfied. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਘਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: so sach saahu jis ghar har dhan sanchaanaa |
English: He is the true banker, who gathers the wealth of the Lord within his own home.

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਧਨ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਵਰਸਾਣਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: eis dhan te sabh jag varasaanaa |3|
English: With this wealth, the whole world profits. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਪੁਰਬ ਲਿਖੇ ਕਾ ਲਹਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: tin har dhan paaeaa jis purab likhe kaa lahanaa |
English: He alone receives the Lord's wealth, who is pre-ordained to receive it.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਤਿ ਵਾਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਗਹਣਾ ॥੪॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: jan naanak ant vaar naam gahanaa |4|18|
English: O servant Nanak, at that very last moment, the Naam shall be your only decoration. ||4||18||

[Ang 375 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੇ ਕਿਰਸਾਣੁ ਬੋਵੈ ਕਿਰਸਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: jaise kirasaan bovai kirasaanee |
English: Just like the farmer, He plants His crop,

Gurbani: ਕਾਚੀ ਪਾਕੀ ਬਾਢਿ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kaachee paakee baadt paraanee |1|
English: and, whether it is ripe or unripe, He cuts it down. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜਨਮੈ ਸੋ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਮੂਆ ॥
Transliteration: jo janamai so jaanahu mooaa |
English: Just so, you must know this well, that whoever is born, shall die.

Gurbani: ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਭਗਤੁ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਹੈ ਥੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: govind bhagat asathir hai theea |1| rahaau |
English: Only the devotee of the Lord of the Universe becomes stable and permanent. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦਿਨ ਤੇ ਸਰਪਰ ਪਉਸੀ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: din te sarapar pausee raat |
English: The day shall certainly be followed by the night.

Gurbani: ਰੈਣਿ ਗਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਪਰਭਾਤਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: rain gee fir hoe parabhaat |2|
English: And when the night passes, the morning shall again dawn. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਸੋਇ ਰਹੇ ਅਭਾਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohi soe rahe abhaage |
English: In the love of Maya, the unfortunate ones remain in sleep.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਜਾਗੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad ko viralaa jaage |3|
English: By Guru's Grace, a rare few remain awake and aware. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਅਹਿ ਨੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak gun gaaeeeh neet |
English: Says Nanak, sing continually the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਚੀਤ ॥੪॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: mukh aoojal hoe niramal cheet |4|19|
English: Your face shall be radiant, and your consciousness shall be immaculately pure. ||4||19||

[Ang 376 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: nau nidh terai sagal nidhaan |
English: The nine treasures are Yours - all treasures are Yours.

Gurbani: ਇਛਾ ਪੂਰਕੁ ਰਖੈ ਨਿਦਾਨ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: eichhaa poorak rakhai nidaan |1|
English: The Fulfiller of desires saves mortals in the end. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੋ ਪਿਆਰੋ ਤਾ ਕੈਸੀ ਭੂਖਾ ॥
Transliteration: toon mero piaaro taa kaisee bhookhaa |
English: You are my Beloved, so what hunger can I have?

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਦੂਖਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: toon man vasiaa lagai na dookhaa |1| rahaau |
English: When You dwell within my mind, pain does not touch me. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: jo toon kareh soee paravaan |
English: Whatever You do, is acceptable to me.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਚੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saache saahib teraa sach furamaan |2|
English: O True Lord and Master, True is Your Order. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaa tudh bhaavai taa har gun gaau |
English: When it is pleasing to Your Will, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੈ ਘਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਨਿਆਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: terai ghar sadaa sadaa hai niaau |3|
English: Within Your Home, there is justice, forever and ever. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: saache saahib alakh abhev |
English: O True Lord and Master, You are unknowable and mysterious.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਾਇਆ ਲਾਗਾ ਸੇਵ ॥੪॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: naanak laaeaa laagaa sev |4|20|
English: Nanak is committed to Your service. ||4||20||

[Ang 376 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: nikatt jeea kai sad hee sangaa |
English: He is near at hand; He is the eternal Companion of the soul.

Gurbani: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਰੂਪ ਅਰੁ ਰੰਗਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kudarat varatai roop ar rangaa |1|
English: His Creative Power is all-pervading, in form and color. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਰ੍ਹੈ ਨ ਝੁਰੈ ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਰੋਵਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: karhai na jhurai naa man rovanahaaraa |
English: My mind does not worry; it does not grieve, or cry out.

Gurbani: ਅਵਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਵਿਗਤੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: avinaasee avigat agochar sadaa salaamat khasam hamaaraa |1| rahaau |
English: Imperishable, Unshakable, Unapproachable and forever safe and sound is my Husband Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸਰੇ ਕਉ ਕਿਸ ਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ॥
Transliteration: tere daasare kau kis kee kaan |
English: Unto whom does Your servant pay homage?

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਮੀਰਾ ਰਾਖੈ ਆਣਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jis kee meeraa raakhai aan |2|
English: His King preserves his honor. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਲਉਡਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਆ ਅਜਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: jo lauddaa prabh keea ajaat |
English: That slave, whom God has released from the restrictions of social status

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਲਉਡੇ ਕਉ ਕਿਸ ਕੀ ਤਾਤਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tis laudde kau kis kee taat |3|
English: - who can now hold him in bondage? ||3||

Gurbani: ਵੇਮੁਹਤਾਜਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: vemuhataajaa veparavaahu |
English: The Lord is absolutely independent, and totally care-free;

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਕਹਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਵਾਹੁ ॥੪॥੨੧॥
Transliteration: naanak daas kahahu gur vaahu |4|21|
English: O servant Nanak, chant His Glorious Praises. ||4||21||

[Ang 376 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਹੋਛੈ ਰਸਿ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: har ras chhodd hochhai ras maataa |
English: Forsaking the Lord's sublime essence, the mortal is intoxicated with false essences.

Gurbani: ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ghar meh vasat baahar utth jaataa |1|
English: The substance is within the home of the self, but the mortal goes out to find it. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁਨੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਸਚੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਾਥਾ ॥
Transliteration: sunee na jaaee sach amrit kaathaa |
English: He cannot hear the true ambrosial discourse.

Gurbani: ਰਾਰਿ ਕਰਤ ਝੂਠੀ ਲਗਿ ਗਾਥਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raar karat jhootthee lag gaathaa |1| rahaau |
English: Attached to false scriptures, he is engaged in argument. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਵਜਹੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕਾ ਸੇਵ ਬਿਰਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: vajahu saahib kaa sev biraanee |
English: He takes his wages from his Lord and Master, but he serves another.

Gurbani: ਐਸੇ ਗੁਨਹ ਅਛਾਦਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aise gunah achhaadio praanee |2|
English: With such sins, the mortal is engrossed. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲੂਕ ਜੋ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੰਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: tis siau look jo sad hee sangee |
English: He tries to hide from the One who is always with him.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਸੋ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਮੰਗੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kaam na aavai so fir fir mangee |3|
English: He begs from Him, again and again. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak prabh deen deaalaa |
English: Says Nanak, God is merciful to the meek.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥੪॥੨੨॥
Transliteration: jiau bhaavai tiau kar pratipaalaa |4|22|
English: As it pleases Him, He cherishes us. ||4||22||

[Ang 376 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਧਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: jeea praan dhan har ko naam |
English: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is my soul, my life, my wealth.

Gurbani: ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾਂ ਉਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: eehaa aoohaan un sang kaam |1|
English: Here and hereafter, it is with me, to help me. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਅਵਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਥੋਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: bin har naam avar sabh thoraa |
English: Without the Lord's Name, everything else is useless.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tripat aghaavai har darasan man moraa |1| rahaau |
English: My mind is satisfied and satiated by the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਲਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat bhanddaar gurabaanee laal |
English: Gurbani is the jewel, the treasure of devotion.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਕਮਾਵਤ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gaavat sunat kamaavat nihaal |2|
English: Singing, hearing and acting upon it, one is enraptured. ||2||

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੋ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal siau laago maan |
English: My mind is attached to the Lord's Lotus Feet.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਤੂਠੈ ਕੀਨੋ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: satigur tootthai keeno daan |3|
English: The True Guru, in His Pleasure, has given this gift. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਦੀਨੑ ॥
Transliteration: naanak kau gur deekhiaa deena |
English: Unto Nanak, the Guru has revealed these instructions:

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਚੀਨੑ ॥੪॥੨੩॥
Transliteration: prabh abinaasee ghatt ghatt cheena |4|23|
English: recognize the Imperishable Lord God in each and every heart. ||4||23||

[Ang 376 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਭਰੇਪੁਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: anad binod bharepur dhaariaa |
English: The All-pervading Lord has established joys and celebrations.

Gurbani: ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: apunaa kaaraj aap savaariaa |1|
English: He Himself embellishes His own works. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਪੂਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: poor samagree poore tthaakur kee |
English: Perfect is the Creation of the Perfect Lord Master.

Gurbani: ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਹੀ ਸੋਭ ਜਾ ਕੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bharipur dhaar rahee sobh jaa kee |1| rahaau |
English: His magnificent greatness is totally all-pervading. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: naam nidhaan jaa kee niramal soe |
English: His Name is the treasure; His reputation is immaculate.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aape karataa avar na koe |2|
English: He Himself is the Creator; there is no other. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jant sabh taa kai haath |
English: All beings and creatures are in His Hands.

Gurbani: ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭ ਕੈ ਸਾਥਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: rav rahiaa prabh sabh kai saath |3|
English: God is pervading in all, and is always with them. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰੀ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: pooraa gur pooree banat banaaee |
English: The Perfect Guru has fashioned His perfect fashion.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤ ਮਿਲੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੪॥੨੪॥
Transliteration: naanak bhagat milee vaddiaaee |4|24|
English: O Nanak, the Lord's devotees are blessed with glorious greatness. ||4||24||

[Ang 377 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਬਨਾਵਹੁ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad banaavahu ihu man |
English: I have shaped this mind in the mold of the Guru's Word.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur kaa darasan sanchahu har dhan |1|
English: Beholding the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan, I have gathered the wealth of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਊਤਮ ਮਤਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਤੂੰ ਆਉ ॥
Transliteration: aootam mat merai ridai toon aau |
English: O sublime understanding, come, enter into my mind,

Gurbani: ਧਿਆਵਉ ਗਾਵਉ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਅਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮੋਹਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dhiaavau gaavau gun govindaa at preetam mohi laagai naau |1| rahaau |
English: that I may meditate and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, and love so dearly the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਵਨੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: tripat aghaavan saachai naae |
English: I am satisfied and satiated by the True Name.

Gurbani: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਮਜਨੁ ਸੰਤ ਧੂਰਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: atthasatth majan sant dhooraae |2|
English: My cleansing bath at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage is the dust of the Saints. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਨਉ ਕਰਤਾ ਏਕ ॥
Transliteration: sabh meh jaanau karataa ek |
English: I recognize that the One Creator is contained in all.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: saadhasangat mil budh bibek |3|
English: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, my understanding is refined. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦਾਸੁ ਸਗਲ ਕਾ ਛੋਡਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: daas sagal kaa chhodd abhimaan |
English: I have become the servant of all; I have renounced my ego and pride.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੋ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੪॥੨੫॥
Transliteration: naanak kau gur deeno daan |4|25|
English: The Guru has given this gift to Nanak. ||4||25||

[Ang 377 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬੁਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਭਈ ਮਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: budh pragaas bhee mat pooree |
English: My intellect has been enlightened, and my understanding is perfect.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੂਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: taa te binasee duramat dooree |1|
English: Thus my evil-mindedness, which kept me far from Him, has been removed. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਈਅਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: aisee guramat paaeeale |
English: Such are the Teachings which I have received from the Guru;

Gurbani: ਬੂਡਤ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਿ ਨਿਕਸਿਓ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: booddat ghor andh koop meh nikasio mere bhaaee re |1| rahaau |
English: while I was drowning in the pitch black well, I was saved, O my Siblings of Destiny. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਅਗਾਹ ਅਗਨਿ ਕਾ ਸਾਗਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: mahaa agaah agan kaa saagar |
English: The Guru is the boat to cross over the totally unfathomable ocean of fire;

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਤਾਰੇ ਰਤਨਾਗਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur bohith taare ratanaagar |2|
English: He is treasure of jewels. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦੁਤਰ ਅੰਧ ਬਿਖਮ ਇਹ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: dutar andh bikham ih maaeaa |
English: This ocean of Maya is dark and treacherous.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur poorai paragatt maarag dikhaaeaa |3|
English: The Perfect Guru has revealed the way to cross over it. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਕਛੁ ਉਕਤਿ ਨ ਮੋਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jaap taap kachh ukat na moree |
English: I do not have the ability to chant or practice intense meditation.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਤੋਰੀ ॥੪॥੨੬॥
Transliteration: gur naanak saranaagat toree |4|26|
English: Guru Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary. ||4||26||

[Ang 377 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਤਿਪਦੇ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 tipade 2 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Thi-Padhay:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਤ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: har ras peevat sad hee raataa |
English: One who drinks in the Lord's sublime essence is forever imbued with it,

Gurbani: ਆਨ ਰਸਾ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: aan rasaa khin meh leh jaataa |
English: while other essences wear off in an instant.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਕੇ ਮਾਤੇ ਮਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: har ras ke maate man sadaa anand |
English: Intoxicated with the Lord's sublime essence, the mind is forever in ecstasy.

Gurbani: ਆਨ ਰਸਾ ਮਹਿ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਚਿੰਦ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aan rasaa meh viaapai chind |1|
English: Other essences bring only anxiety. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਅਲਮਸਤੁ ਮਤਵਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har ras peevai alamasat matavaaraa |
English: One who drinks in the Lord's sublime essence, is intoxicated and enraptured;

Gurbani: ਆਨ ਰਸਾ ਸਭਿ ਹੋਛੇ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aan rasaa sabh hochhe re |1| rahaau |
English: all other essences have no effect. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: har ras kee keemat kahee na jaae |
English: The value of the Lord's sublime essence cannot be described.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਹਾਟਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: har ras saadhoo haatt samaae |
English: The Lord's sublime essence permeates the homes of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਲਾਖ ਕਰੋਰੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਨ ਕੇਹ ॥
Transliteration: laakh karoree milai na keh |
English: One may spend thousands and millions, but it cannot be purchased.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਦੇਹਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jiseh paraapat tis hee dehi |2|
English: He alone obtains it, who is so pre-ordained. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਾਖਿ ਭਏ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak chaakh bhe bisamaad |
English: Tasting it, Nanak is wonder-struck.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਆਇਆ ਸਾਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak gur te aaeaa saad |
English: Through the Guru, Nanak has obtained this taste.

Gurbani: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਕਤ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: eet aoot kat chhodd na jaae |
English: Here and hereafter, it does not leave him.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੀਧਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੩॥੨੭॥
Transliteration: naanak geedhaa har ras maeh |3|27|
English: Nanak is imbued and enraptured with the Lord's subtle essence. ||3||27||

[Ang 377 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਿਟਾਵੈ ਛੁਟਕੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh lobh mohu mittaavai chhuttakai duramat apunee dhaaree |
English: If she renounces and eliminates her sexual desire, anger, greed and attachment, and her evil-mindedness and self-conceit as well;

Gurbani: ਹੋਇ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: hoe nimaanee sev kamaaveh taa preetam hoveh man piaaree |1|
English: and if, becoming humble, she serves Him, then she becomes dear to her Beloved's Heart. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਬਚਨ ਉਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: sun sundar saadhoo bachan udhaaree |
English: Listen, O beautiful soul-bride: By the Word of the Holy Saint, you shall be saved.

Gurbani: ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਮਿਟੈ ਤੇਰੋ ਸਹਸਾ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਸੁਖਮਨਿ ਨਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dookh bhookh mittai tero sahasaa sukh paaveh toon sukhaman naaree |1| rahaau |
English: Your pain, hunger and doubt shall vanish, and you shall obtain peace, O happy soul-bride. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਪਖਾਰਿ ਕਰਉ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਆਤਮ ਸੁਧੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਤਿਆਸ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: charan pakhaar krau gur sevaa aatam sudh bikh tiaas nivaaree |
English: Washing the Guru's feet, and serving Him, the soul is sanctified, and the thirst for sin is quenched.

Gurbani: ਦਾਸਨ ਕੀ ਹੋਇ ਦਾਸਿ ਦਾਸਰੀ ਤਾ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: daasan kee hoe daas daasaree taa paaveh sobhaa har duaaree |2|
English: If you become the slave of the slave of the Lord's slaves, then you shall obtain honor in the Court of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਇਹੀ ਅਚਾਰ ਇਹੀ ਬਿਉਹਾਰਾ ਆਗਿਆ ਮਾਨਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: eihee achaar ihee biauhaaraa aagiaa maan bhagat hoe tumaaree |
English: This is right conduct, and this is the correct lifestyle, to obey the Command of the Lord's Will; this is your devotional worship.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਇਹੁ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੀ ॥੩॥੨੮॥
Transliteration: jo ihu mantru kamaavai naanak so bhaujal paar utaaree |3|28|
English: One who practices this Mantra, O Nanak, swims across the terrifying world-ocean. ||3||28||

[Ang 378 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 dupade |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Dho-Padhay:

Gurbani: ਭਈ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਦੇਹੁਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: bhee paraapat maanukh dehureea |
English: You have been blessed with this human body.

Gurbani: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਮਿਲਣ ਕੀ ਇਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: gobind milan kee ih teree bareea |
English: This is your chance to meet the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰਿ ਕਾਜ ਤੇਰੈ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਕਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: avar kaaj terai kitai na kaam |
English: Other efforts are of no use to you.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਭਜੁ ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mil saadhasangat bhaj keval naam |1|
English: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, vibrate and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਰੰਜਾਮਿ ਲਾਗੁ ਭਵਜਲ ਤਰਨ ਕੈ ॥
Transliteration: saranjaam laag bhavajal taran kai |
English: Make the effort, and cross over the terrifying world ocean.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮੁ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਜਾਤ ਰੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: janam brithaa jaat rang maaeaa kai |1| rahaau |
English: This human life is passing away in vain, in the love of Maya. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਨ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jap tap sanjam dharam na kamaaeaa |
English: I have not practiced meditation, penance, self-restraint or righteous living;

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਾ ਸਾਧ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sevaa saadh na jaaniaa har raaeaa |
English: I have not served the Holy Saints, and I do not know the Lord, my King.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਮ ਨੀਚ ਕਰੰਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak ham neech karamaa |
English: Says Nanak, my actions are vile and despicable;

Gurbani: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਕੀ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਰਮਾ ॥੨॥੨੯॥
Transliteration: saran pare kee raakhahu saramaa |2|29|
English: O Lord, I seek Your Sanctuary - please, preserve my honor. ||2||29||

[Ang 378 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: tujh bin avar naahee mai doojaa toon mere man maahee |
English: Without You, there is no other for me; You alone are in my mind.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਸੰਗੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਾਹੇ ਜੀਅ ਡਰਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: toon saajan sangee prabh meraa kaahe jeea ddaraahee |1|
English: You are my Friend and Companion, God; why should my soul be afraid? ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਓਟ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: tumaree ott tumaaree aasaa |
English: You are my support, You are my hope.

Gurbani: ਬੈਠਤ ਊਠਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਜਾਗਤ ਵਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: baitthat aootthat sovat jaagat visar naahee toon saas giraasaa |1| rahaau |
English: While sitting down or standing up, while sleeping or waking, with every breath and morsel of food, I never forget You. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਵਿਕਰਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: raakh raakh saran prabh apanee agan saagar vikaraalaa |
English: Protect me, please protect me, O God; I have come to Your Sanctuary; the ocean of fire is so horrible.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਮ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਬਾਲ ਗੁਪਾਲਾ ॥੨॥੩੦॥
Transliteration: naanak ke sukhadaate satigur ham tumare baal gupaalaa |2|30|
English: The True Guru is the Giver of peace to Nanak; I am Your child, O Lord of the World. ||2||30||

[Ang 378 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਲੀਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਛਡਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: har jan leene prabhoo chhaddaae |
English: The Lord God has saved me, His slave.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਰੋ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਤਾਪੁ ਮੁਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: preetam siau mero man maaniaa taap muaa bikh khaae |1| rahaau |
English: My mind has surrendered to my Beloved; my fever has taken poison and died. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪਾਲਾ ਤਾਊ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: paalaa taaoo kachhoo na biaapai raam naam gun gaae |
English: Cold and heat do not touch me at all, when I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਡਾਕੀ ਕੋ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਰਨਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ddaakee ko chit kachhoo na laagai charan kamal saranaae |1|
English: My consciousness is not affected by the witch, Maya; I take to the Sanctuary of the Lord's Lotus Feet. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਭਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ਹੋਏ ਆਪਿ ਸਹਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sant prasaad bhe kirapaalaa hoe aap sahaae |
English: By the Grace of the Saints, the Lord has shown His Mercy to me; He Himself is my Help and Support.

Gurbani: ਗੁਨ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਿਤਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਮਿਟਾਇ ॥੨॥੩੧॥
Transliteration: gun nidhaan nit gaavai naanak sahasaa dukh mittaae |2|31|
English: Nanak ever sings the Praises of the Lord, the treasure of excellence; his doubts and pains are eliminated. ||2||31||

[Ang 378 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਉਖਧੁ ਖਾਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aaukhadh khaaeo har ko naau |
English: I have taken the medicine of the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ਦੁਖ ਬਿਨਸਿਆ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sukh paae dukh binasiaa thaau |1|
English: I have found peace, and the seat of pain has been removed. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤਾਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਬਚਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: taap geaa bachan gur poore |
English: The fever has been broken, by the Teachings of the Perfect Guru.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਸਭਿ ਮਿਟੇ ਵਿਸੂਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: anad bheaa sabh mitte visoore |1| rahaau |
English: I am in ecstasy, and all of my sorrows have been dispelled. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਗਲ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jant sagal sukh paaeaa |
English: All beings and creatures obtain peace,

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੨॥੩੨॥
Transliteration: paarabraham naanak man dhiaaeaa |2|32|
English: O Nanak, meditating on the Supreme Lord God. ||2||32||

[Ang 378 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬਾਂਛਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੁ ਬੇਲਾ ਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: baanchhat naahee su belaa aaee |
English: That time, which the mortal does not wish for, eventually comes.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਕਿਉ ਬੁਝੈ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bin hukamai kiau bujhai bujhaaee |1|
English: Without the Lord's Command, how can understanding be understood? ||1||

Gurbani: ਠੰਢੀ ਤਾਤੀ ਮਿਟੀ ਖਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: tthandtee taatee mittee khaaee |
English: The body is consumed by water, fire and earth.

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਨ ਬਾਲਾ ਬੂਢਾ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ohu na baalaa boodtaa bhaaee |1| rahaau |
English: But the soul is neither young nor old, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਾਧ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: naanak daas saadh saranaaee |
English: Servant Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਭਉ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਈ ॥੨॥੩੩॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad bhau paar paraaee |2|33|
English: By Guru's Grace, he has shaken off the fear of death. ||2||33||

[Ang 378 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਆਤਮ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa aatam paragaas |
English: Forever and ever, the soul is illumined;

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saadhasangat har charan nivaas |1|
English: in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, it dwells at the Feet of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਤਿ ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam nit jap man mere |
English: Chant the Lord's Name each and every day, O my mind.

Gurbani: ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਜਾਹਿ ਸਭੇ ਮਨ ਤੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: seetal saant sadaa sukh paaveh kilavikh jaeh sabhe man tere |1| rahaau |
English: You shall find lasting peace, contentment and tranquility, and all your sins shall depart. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਰਮ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak jaa ke pooran karam |
English: Says Nanak, one who is blessed with perfect good karma,

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ॥੨॥੩੪॥
Transliteration: satigur bhette pooran paarabraham |2|34|
English: meets the True Guru, and obtains the Perfect Supreme Lord God. ||2||34||

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੇ ਘਰ ਕੇ ਚਉਤੀਸ ॥
Transliteration: dooje ghar ke chautees |
English: Thirty-four Shabads in Second House. ||

[Ang 378 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬੇਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kaa har suaamee prabh belee |
English: She who has the Lord God as her Friend

Gurbani: ਪੀੜ ਗਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਦੁਹੇਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: peerr gee fir nahee duhelee |1| rahaau |
English: her pain is dispelled, and she shall not become sad again. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਚਰਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa charan sang melee |
English: Showing His Mercy, He joins her with His Feet,

Gurbani: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sookh sehaj aanand suhelee |1|
English: and she attains celestial peace, joy and comfort. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਅਤੋਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang gun gaae atolee |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, she sings the Glorious Praises of the Immeasurable Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਈ ਅਮੋਲੀ ॥੨॥੩੫॥
Transliteration: har simarat naanak bhee amolee |2|35|
English: Remembering the Lord in meditation, O Nanak, she becomes invaluable. ||2||35||

[Ang 379 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦ ਮਤਸਰ ਏ ਖੇਲਤ ਸਭਿ ਜੂਐ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh maaeaa mad matasar e khelat sabh jooai haare |
English: Sexual desire, anger, intoxication with Maya and jealousy - I have lost all of these in the game of chance.

Gurbani: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ ਸਚੁ ਇਹ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sat santokh deaa dharam sach ih apunai grih bheetar vaare |1|
English: Purity, contentment, compassion, faith and truthfulness - I have ushered these into the home of my self. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਚੂਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਭਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: janam maran chooke sabh bhaare |
English: All the loads of birth and death have been removed.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਭਇਓ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਲੈ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: milat sang bheo man niramal gur poorai lai khin meh taare |1| rahaau |
English: Joining the Saints' Society, my mind has become pure; the Perfect Guru has saved me in an instant. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਕੀ ਰੇਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੈ ਮਨੂਆ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੀਸਹਿ ਮੀਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kee ren hoe rahai manooaa sagale deeseh meet piaare |
English: My mind has become the dust of all, and everyone seems a sweet friend to me.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਮਧੇ ਰਵਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਤ ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਸਮੑਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sabh madhe raviaa meraa tthaakur daan det sabh jeea samaare |2|
English: My Lord and Master is contained in all. He gives His Gifts to all beings, and cherishes them. ||2||

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਆਪਿ ਇਕੁ ਏਕੈ ਏਕੈ ਹੈ ਸਗਲਾ ਪਾਸਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: eko ek aap ik ekai ekai hai sagalaa paasaare |
English: He Himself is the One and only; from the One, the One and only, came the expanse of the entire creation.

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਹੋਏ ਸਗਲ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jap jap hoe sagal saadh jan ek naam dhiaae bahut udhaare |3|
English: Chanting and meditating, all the humble beings have become Holy; meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, so many have been saved. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਬਿਅੰਤ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gahir ganbheer biant gusaaee ant nahee kichh paaraavaare |
English: The Lord of the Universe is deep, profound and infinite; He has no end or limitation.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਧਿਆਇ ਧਿਆਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੩੬॥
Transliteration: tumaree kripaa te gun gaavai naanak dhiaae dhiaae prabh kau namasakaare |4|36|
English: By Your Grace, Nanak sings Your Glorious Praises; meditating, meditating, he humbly bows to God. ||4||36||

[Ang 379 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਬਿਅੰਤੁ ਅਵਿਗਤੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਇਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: too biant avigat agochar ihu sabh teraa aakaar |
English: You are Infinite, Eternal and Incomprehensible; all this is Your Creation.

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਹਮ ਜੰਤ ਕਰਹ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਜਾਂ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਝੈ ਮਝਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kiaa ham jant karah chaturaaee jaan sabh kichh tujhai majhaar |1|
English: What clever games can we play, when everything is contained in You? ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਪਨੇ ਬਾਲਿਕ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਲੀਲਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: mere satigur apane baalik raakhahu leelaa dhaar |
English: O my True Guru, protect me, Your child, through the power of Your play.

Gurbani: ਦੇਹੁ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dehu sumat sadaa gun gaavaa mere tthaakur agam apaar |1| rahaau |
English: Grant me the good sense to ever sing Your Glorious Praises, O my Inaccessible and Infinite Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੇ ਜਨਨਿ ਜਠਰ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਓਹੁ ਰਹਤਾ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jaise janan jatthar meh praanee ohu rahataa naam adhaar |
English: The mortal is preserved in the womb of his mother, by the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord;

Gurbani: ਅਨਦੁ ਕਰੈ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਮੑਾਰੈ ਨਾ ਪੋਹੈ ਅਗਨਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: anad karai saas saas samaarai naa pohai aganaar |2|
English: he makes merry, and with each and every breath he remembers the Lord, and the fire does not touch him. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰ ਦਾਰਾ ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਇਨ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: par dhan par daaraa par nindaa in siau preet nivaar |
English: Others' wealth, others' wives, and the slander of others - renounce your craving for these.

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸੇਵੀ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੈ ਆਧਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: charan kamal sevee rid antar gur poore kai aadhaar |3|
English: Serve the Lord's Lotus Feet within your heart, and hold to the Support of the Perfect Guru. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਲਾ ਜੋ ਦੀਸਹਿ ਨਾ ਕੋਈ ਸੰਗਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: grihu mandar mahalaa jo deeseh naa koee sangaar |
English: Houses, mansions and palaces which you see - none of these shall go with you.

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਕਲੀ ਕਾਲ ਮਹਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੩੭॥
Transliteration: jab lag jeeveh kalee kaal meh jan naanak naam samaar |4|37|
English: As long as you live in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, O servant Nanak, remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||37||

[Ang 379 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੩ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa ghar 3 mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Third House, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਰਾਜ ਮਿਲਕ ਜੋਬਨ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਸੋਭਾ ਰੂਪਵੰਤੁ ਜੋੁਆਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: raaj milak joban grih sobhaa roopavant juoaanee |
English: Power, property, youth, household, fame and the beauty of youth;

Gurbani: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦਰਬੁ ਹਸਤੀ ਅਰੁ ਘੋੜੇ ਲਾਲ ਲਾਖ ਬੈ ਆਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: bahut darab hasatee ar ghorre laal laakh bai aanee |
English: great wealth, elephants, horses and jewels, purchased with tens of thousands of dollars;

Gurbani: ਆਗੈ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਲੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aagai darageh kaam na aavai chhodd chalai abhimaanee |1|
English: hereafter, these shall be of no avail in the Court of the Lord; the proud must depart, leaving them behind. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੇ ਏਕ ਬਿਨਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: kaahe ek binaa chit laaeeai |
English: Why center your consciousness on any other than the Lord?

Gurbani: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਜਾਗਤ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aootthat baitthat sovat jaagat sadaa sadaa har dhiaaeeai |1| rahaau |
English: Sitting down, standing up, sleeping and waking, forever and ever, meditate on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਆਖਾੜੇ ਰਣ ਮਹਿ ਜਿਤੇ ਪਵਾੜੇ ॥
Transliteration: mahaa bachitr sundar aakhaarre ran meh jite pavaarre |
English: He may have the most wondrous and beautiful arenas, and be victorious on the field of battle.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਮਾਰਉ ਹਉ ਬੰਧਉ ਛੋਡਉ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਏਵ ਬਬਾੜੇ ॥
Transliteration: hau maarau hau bandhau chhoddau mukh te ev babaarre |
English: He may proclaim, "I can kill anyone, I can capture anyone, and I can release anyone."

Gurbani: ਆਇਆ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਾ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਏਕ ਦਿਹਾੜੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aaeaa hukam paarabraham kaa chhodd chaliaa ek dihaarre |2|
English: But when the Order comes from the Supreme Lord God, he departs and leaves in a day. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: karam dharam jugat bahu karataa karanaihaar na jaanai |
English: He may perform all sorts of religious rituals and good actions, but he does not know the Creator Lord, the Doer of all.

Gurbani: ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਰੈ ਆਪਿ ਨ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਤਤੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: aupades karai aap na kamaavai tat sabad na pachhaanai |
English: He teaches, but does not practice what he preaches; he does not realize the essential reality of the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਨਾਂਗਾ ਆਇਆ ਨਾਂਗੋ ਜਾਸੀ ਜਿਉ ਹਸਤੀ ਖਾਕੁ ਛਾਨੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naangaa aaeaa naango jaasee jiau hasatee khaak chhaanai |3|
English: Naked he came, and naked he shall depart; he is like an elephant, throwing dust on himself. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਸਜਨ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਸਭਿ ਮੀਤਾ ਝੂਠਾ ਏਹੁ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sant sajan sunahu sabh meetaa jhootthaa ehu pasaaraa |
English: O Saints, and friends, listen to me: all this world is false.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਡੂਬੇ ਖਪਿ ਖਪਿ ਮੁਏ ਗਵਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: meree meree kar kar ddoobe khap khap mue gavaaraa |
English: Continually claiming, "Mine, mine", the mortals are drowned; the fools waste away and die.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਸਾਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੮॥
Transliteration: gur mil naanak naam dhiaaeaa saach naam nisataaraa |4|1|38|
English: Meeting the Guru, O Nanak, I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; through the True Name, I am emancipated. ||4||1||38||

[Ang 380 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੫ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raag aasaa ghar 5 mahalaa 5 |
English: Raag Aasaa, Fifth House, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਮਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਸਗਲ ਜਗਤ ਧੰਧ ਅੰਧ ॥ ਕੋਊ ਜਾਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bhram meh soee sagal jagat dhandh andh | koaoo jaagai har jan |1|
English: The whole world is asleep in doubt; it is blinded by worldly entanglements. How rare is that humble servant of the Lord who is awake and aware. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਮਗਨ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥ ਕੋਊ ਤਿਆਗੈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mahaa mohanee magan pria preet praan | koaoo tiaagai viralaa |2|
English: The mortal is intoxicated with the great enticement of Maya, which is dearer to him than life. How rare is the one who renounces it. ||2||

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਆਨੂਪ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਮੰਤ ॥ ਕੋਊ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਾਧੂ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: charan kamal aanoop har sant mant | koaoo laagai saadhoo |3|
English: The Lord's Lotus Feet are incomparably beautiful; so is the Mantra of the Saint. How rare is that holy person who is attached to them. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਾਗੇ ਗਿਆਨ ਰੰਗਿ ॥ ਵਡਭਾਗੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੯॥
Transliteration: naanak saadhoo sang jaage giaan rang | vaddabhaage kirapaa |4|1|39|
