English: O Nanak, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the love of divine knowledge is awakened; The Lord's Mercy is bestowed upon those who are blessed with such good destiny. ||4||1||39||

[Ang 380 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੬ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raag aasaa ghar 6 mahalaa 5 |
English: Raag Aasaa, Sixth House, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ਸੂਖੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai so paravaanaa sookh sehaj man soee |
English: Whatever pleases You is acceptable to me; that alone brings peace and ease to my mind.

Gurbani: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਰੇ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: karan kaaran samarath apaaraa avar naahee re koee |1|
English: You are the Doer, the Cause of causes, All-powerful and Infinite; there is none other than You. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: tere jan rasak rasak gun gaaveh |
English: Your humble servants sing Your Glorious Praises with enthusiasm and love.

Gurbani: ਮਸਲਤਿ ਮਤਾ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਜੋ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਰਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: masalat mataa siaanap jan kee jo toon kareh karaaveh |1| rahaau |
English: That alone is good advice, wisdom and cleverness for Your humble servant, which You do or cause to be done. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: amrit naam tumaaraa piaare saadhasang ras paaeaa |
English: Your Name is Ambrosial Nectar, O Beloved Lord; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I have obtained its sublime essence.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਇ ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਪੂਰੇ ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tripat aghaae seee jan poore sukh nidhaan har gaaeaa |2|
English: Those humble beings are satisfied and fulfilled, singing the Praises of the Lord, the treasure of peace. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਟੇਕ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kau ttek tumaaree suaamee taa kau naahee chintaa |
English: One who has Your Support, O Lord Master, is not afflicted by anxiety.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦਇਆ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਹੋਈ ਸੇ ਸਾਹ ਭਲੇ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jaa kau deaa tumaaree hoee se saah bhale bhagavantaa |3|
English: One who is blessed by Your Kind Mercy, is the best, the most fortunate king. ||3||

Gurbani: ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਧ੍ਰੋਹ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਕਸੇ ਜਬ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bharam moh dhroh sabh nikase jab kaa darasan paaeaa |
English: Doubt, attachment, and deceit have all disappeared, since I obtained the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

Gurbani: ਵਰਤਣਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਕੀਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੪੦॥
Transliteration: varatan naam naanak sach keenaa har naame rang samaaeaa |4|1|40|
English: Dealing in the Naam, O Nanak, we become truthful, and in the Love of the Lord's Name, we are absorbed. ||4||1 | 40||

[Ang 380 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਵੈ ਪਰਾਈ ਆਪਣਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: janam janam kee mal dhovai paraaee aapanaa keetaa paavai |
English: He washes off the filth of other peoples' incarnations, but he obtains the rewards of his own actions.

Gurbani: ਈਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਢੋਈ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਪਚਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: eehaa sukh nahee daragah dtoee jam pur jaae pachaavai |1|
English: He has no peace in this world, and he has no place in the Court of the Lord. In the City of Death, he is tortured. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦਕਿ ਅਹਿਲਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: nindak ahilaa janam gavaaeaa |
English: The slanderer loses his life in vain.

Gurbani: ਪਹੁਚਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਕਾਹੂ ਬਾਤੈ ਆਗੈ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: pahuch na saakai kaahoo baatai aagai tthaur na paaeaa |1| rahaau |
English: He cannot succeed in anything, and in the world hereafter, he finds no place at all. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਤੁ ਪਇਆ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਬਪੁਰੇ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਓਹੁ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kirat peaa nindak bapure kaa kiaa ohu karai bichaaraa |
English: Such is the fate of the wretched slanderer - what can the poor creature do?

Gurbani: ਤਹਾ ਬਿਗੂਤਾ ਜਹ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਰਾਖੈ ਓਹੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਕਰੇ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tahaa bigootaa jeh koe na raakhai ohu kis peh kare pukaaraa |2|
English: He is ruined there, where no one can protect him; with whom should he lodge his complaint? ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਨਾਹੀ ਖਸਮੈ ਏਵੈ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: nindak kee gat katahoon naahee khasamai evai bhaanaa |
English: The slanderer shall never attain emancipation; this is the Will of the Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਨਿੰਦ ਕਰੇ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਤਿਉ ਸੰਤਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jo jo nind kare santan kee tiau santan sukh maanaa |3|
English: The more the Saints are slandered, the more they dwell in peace. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਾ ਟੇਕ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੂੰ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: santaa ttek tumaaree suaamee toon santan kaa sahaaee |
English: The Saints have Your Support, O Lord and Master; You are the Saints' Help and Support.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਦੀਏ ਰੁੜਾਈ ॥੪॥੨॥੪੧॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak sant har raakhe nindak dee rurraaee |4|2|41|
English: Says Nanak, the Saints are saved by the Lord; the slanderers are drowned in the deep. ||4||2||41||

[Ang 381 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬਾਹਰੁ ਧੋਇ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਦੁਇ ਠਉਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਖੋਏ ॥
Transliteration: baahar dhoe antar man mailaa due tthaur apune khoe |
English: He washes outwardly, but within, his mind is filthy; thus he loses his place in both worlds.

Gurbani: ਈਹਾ ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਆਗੈ ਮੁਸਿ ਮੁਸਿ ਰੋਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: eehaa kaam krodh mohi viaapiaa aagai mus mus roe |1|
English: Here, he is engrossed in sexual desire, anger and emotional attachment; hereafter, he shall sigh and weep. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਭਜਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਹੈ ਹੋਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: govind bhajan kee mat hai horaa |
English: The way to vibrate and meditate on the Lord of the Universe is different.

Gurbani: ਵਰਮੀ ਮਾਰੀ ਸਾਪੁ ਨ ਮਰਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਸੁਨਈ ਡੋਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: varamee maaree saap na maree naam na sunee ddoraa |1| rahaau |
English: Destroying the snake-hole, the snake is not killed; the deaf person does not hear the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਕੀ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਗਵਾਈ ਭਗਤੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa kee kirat chhodd gavaaee bhagatee saar na jaanai |
English: He renounces the affairs of Maya, but he does not appreciate the value of devotional worship.

Gurbani: ਬੇਦ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਕਉ ਤਰਕਨਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਤਤੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bed saasatr kau tarakan laagaa tat jog na pachhaanai |2|
English: He finds fault with the Vedas and the Shaastras, and does not know the essence of Yoga. ||2||

Gurbani: ਉਘਰਿ ਗਇਆ ਜੈਸਾ ਖੋਟਾ ਢਬੂਆ ਨਦਰਿ ਸਰਾਫਾ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aughar geaa jaisaa khottaa dtabooaa nadar saraafaa aaeaa |
English: He stands exposed, like a counterfeit coin, when inspected by the Lord, the Assayer.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਉਸ ਤੇ ਕਹਾ ਛਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: antarajaamee sabh kichh jaanai us te kahaa chhapaaeaa |3|
English: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, knows everything; how can we hide anything from Him? ||3||

Gurbani: ਕੂੜਿ ਕਪਟਿ ਬੰਚਿ ਨਿੰਮੁਨੀਆਦਾ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਗਇਆ ਤਤਕਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: koorr kapatt banch ninmuneeaadaa binas geaa tatakaale |
English: Through falsehood, fraud and deceit, the mortal collapses in an instant - he has no foundation at all.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਅਪਨੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦੇਖੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥੪॥੩॥੪੨॥
Transliteration: sat sat sat naanak kahiaa apanai hiradai dekh samaale |4|3|42|
English: Truly, truly, truly, Nanak speaks; look within your own heart, and realize this. ||4||3||42||

[Ang 381 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਤ ਹੋਵੈ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਚੈ ਆਪੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: audam karat hovai man niramal naachai aap nivaare |
English: Making the effort, the mind becomes pure; in this dance, the self is silenced.

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਜਨਾ ਲੇ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: panch janaa le vasagat raakhai man meh ekankaare |1|
English: The five passions are kept under control, and the One Lord dwells in the mind. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: teraa jan nirat kare gun gaavai |
English: Your humble servant dances and sings Your Glorious Praises.

Gurbani: ਰਬਾਬੁ ਪਖਾਵਜ ਤਾਲ ਘੁੰਘਰੂ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: rabaab pakhaavaj taal ghungharoo anahad sabad vajaavai |1| rahaau |
English: He plays upon the guitar, tambourine and cymbals, and the unstruck sound current of the Shabad resounds. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਥਮੇ ਮਨੁ ਪਰਬੋਧੈ ਅਪਨਾ ਪਾਛੈ ਅਵਰ ਰੀਝਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: prathame man parabodhai apanaa paachhai avar reejhaavai |
English: First, he instructs his own mind, and then, he leads others.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਜਪੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਾਪੈ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਸਗਲ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: raam naam jap hiradai jaapai mukh te sagal sunaavai |2|
English: He chants the Lord's Name and meditates on it in his heart; with his mouth, he announces it to all. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਰੈ ਸੰਤ ਧੂਰਿ ਤਨਿ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: kar sang saadhoo charan pakhaarai sant dhoor tan laavai |
English: He joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and washes their feet; he applies the dust of the Saints to his body

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਧਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਸਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: man tan arap dhare gur aagai sat padaarath paavai |3|
English: He surrenders his mind and body, and places them before the Guru; thus, he obtains the true wealth. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸੁਨੈ ਪੇਖੈ ਲਾਇ ਸਰਧਾ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: jo jo sunai pekhai laae saradhaa taa kaa janam maran dukh bhaagai |
English: Whoever listens to, and beholds the Guru with faith, shall see his pains of birth and death taken away.

Gurbani: ਐਸੀ ਨਿਰਤਿ ਨਰਕ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਗੈ ॥੪॥੪॥੪੩॥
Transliteration: aisee nirat narak nivaarai naanak guramukh jaagai |4|4|43|
English: Such a dance eliminates hell; O Nanak, the Gurmukh remains wakeful. ||4||4||43||

[Ang 381 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਧਮ ਚੰਡਾਲੀ ਭਈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣੀ ਸੂਦੀ ਤੇ ਸ੍ਰੇਸਟਾਈ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: adham chanddaalee bhee brahamanee soodee te sresattaaee re |
English: The lowly outcaste becomes a Brahmin, and the untouchable sweeper becomes pure and sublime.

Gurbani: ਪਾਤਾਲੀ ਆਕਾਸੀ ਸਖਨੀ ਲਹਬਰ ਬੂਝੀ ਖਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: paataalee aakaasee sakhanee lahabar boojhee khaaee re |1|
English: The burning desire of the nether regions and the etheric realms is finally quenched and extinguished. ||1||

Gurbani: ਘਰ ਕੀ ਬਿਲਾਈ ਅਵਰ ਸਿਖਾਈ ਮੂਸਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਡਰਾਈ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: ghar kee bilaaee avar sikhaaee moosaa dekh ddaraaee re |
English: The house-cat has been taught otherwise, and is terrified upon seeing the mouse.

Gurbani: ਅਜ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੋ ਕੇਹਰਿ ਕੂਕਰ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਲਗਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aj kai vas gur keeno kehar kookar tineh lagaaee re |1| rahaau |
English: The Guru has put the tiger under the control of the sheep, and now, the dog eats grass. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਾਝੁ ਥੂਨੀਆ ਛਪਰਾ ਥਾਮਿੑਆ ਨੀਘਰਿਆ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: baajh thooneea chhaparaa thaamaa neeghariaa ghar paaeaa re |
English: Without pillars, the roof is supported, and the homeless have found a home.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਜੜੀਏ ਲੈ ਜੜਿਓ ਜੜਾਵਾ ਥੇਵਾ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bin jarree lai jarrio jarraavaa thevaa acharaj laaeaa re |2|
English: Without the jeweller, the jewel has been set, and the wonderful stone shines forth. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦਾਦੀ ਦਾਦਿ ਨ ਪਹੁਚਨਹਾਰਾ ਚੂਪੀ ਨਿਰਨਉ ਪਾਇਆ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: daadee daad na pahuchanahaaraa choopee nirnau paaeaa re |
English: The claimant does not succeed by placing his claim, but by keeping silent, he obtains justice.

Gurbani: ਮਾਲਿ ਦੁਲੀਚੈ ਬੈਠੀ ਲੇ ਮਿਰਤਕੁ ਨੈਨ ਦਿਖਾਲਨੁ ਧਾਇਆ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: maal duleechai baitthee le miratak nain dikhaalan dhaaeaa re |3|
English: The dead sit on costly carpets, and what is seen with the eyes shall vanish. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਅਜਾਣੁ ਕਹੈ ਮੈ ਜਾਨਾ ਜਾਨਣਹਾਰੁ ਨ ਛਾਨਾ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: soee ajaan kahai mai jaanaa jaananahaar na chhaanaa re |
English: One who claims to know, is ignorant; he does not know the Knower of all.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਅਮਿਉ ਪੀਆਇਆ ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਬਿਗਸਾਨਾ ਰੇ ॥੪॥੫॥੪੪॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak gur amiau peeaeaa rasak rasak bigasaanaa re |4|5|44|
English: Says Nanak, the Guru has given me the Ambrosial Nectar to drink in; savoring it and relishing it, I blossom forth in bliss. ||4||5||44||

[Ang 382 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਬਿਸਾਰੇ ਅਉਗਨ ਅਪਨਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸਮੑਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: bandhan kaatt bisaare aaugan apanaa birad samaariaa |
English: He has cut away my bonds, and overlooked my shortcomings, and so He has confirmed His nature.

Gurbani: ਹੋਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤ ਨਿਆਈ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: hoe kripaal maat pit niaaee baarik jiau pratipaariaa |1|
English: Becoming merciful to me, like a mother or a father, he has come to cherish me as His own child. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਰਾਖੇ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: gurasikh raakhe gur gopaal |
English: The GurSikhs are preserved by the Guru, by the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਕਾਢਿ ਲੀਏ ਮਹਾ ਭਵਜਲ ਤੇ ਅਪਨੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kaadt lee mahaa bhavajal te apanee nadar nihaal |1| rahaau |
English: He rescues them from the terrible world ocean, casting His Glance of Grace upon them. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai simaran jam te chhutteeai halat palat sukh paaeeai |
English: Meditating in remembrance on Him, we escape from the Messenger of Death; here and hereafter, we obtain peace.

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਜਪਹੁ ਜਪੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਨੀਤ ਨੀਤ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saas giraas japahu jap rasanaa neet neet gun gaaeeai |2|
English: With every breath and morsel of food, meditate, and chant with your tongue, continually, each and every day; sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਦੁਖ ਨਾਠੇ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat prem param pad paaeaa saadhasang dukh naatthe |
English: Through loving devotional worship, the supreme status is obtained, and in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, sorrows are dispelled.

Gurbani: ਛਿਜੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਕਿਛੁ ਭਉ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਗਾਠੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: chhijai na jaae kichh bhau na biaape har dhan niramal gaatthe |3|
English: I am not worn down, I do not die, and nothing strikes fear in me, since I have the wealth of the Lord's Immaculate Name in my purse. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਸਹਾਈ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: ant kaal prabh bhe sahaaee it ut raakhanahaare |
English: At the very last moment, God becomes the mortal's Help and Support; here and hereafter, He is the Savior Lord.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮੀਤ ਹੀਤ ਧਨੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੬॥੪੫॥
Transliteration: praan meet heet dhan merai naanak sad balihaare |4|6|45|
English: He is my breath of life, my friend, support and wealth; O Nanak, I am forever a sacrifice to Him. ||4||6||45||

[Ang 382 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਤਾ ਭਉ ਕੇਹਾ ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jaa toon saahib taa bhau kehaa hau tudh bin kis saalaahee |
English: Since You are my Lord and Master, what is there for me to fear? Other than You, who else should I praise?

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਤੂੰ ਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੈ ਮੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ek toon taa sabh kichh hai mai tudh bin doojaa naahee |1|
English: You are the One and only, and so do all things exist; without You, there is nothing at all for me. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਾਬਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: baabaa bikh dekhiaa sansaar |
English: O Father, I have seen that the world is poison.

Gurbani: ਰਖਿਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: rakhiaa karahu gusaaee mere mai naam teraa aadhaar |1| rahaau |
English: Save me, O Lord of the Universe! Your Name is my only Support. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਾਣਹਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਸਭਾ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਹੋਰੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: jaaneh birathaa sabhaa man kee hor kis peh aakh sunaaeeai |
English: You know completely the condition of my mind; who else could I go to tell of it?

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਬਉਰਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: vin naavai sabh jag bauraaeaa naam milai sukh paaeeai |2|
English: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the whole world has gone crazy; obtaining the Naam, it finds peace. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ਜਿ ਕਹਣਾ ਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa kaheeai kis aakh sunaaeeai ji kahanaa su prabh jee paas |
English: What shall I say? Unto whom shall I speak? What I have to say, I say to God.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਸ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh keetaa teraa varatai sadaa sadaa teree aas |3|
English: Everything which exists was created by You. You are my hope, forever and ever. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਦੇਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਤਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਧਿਆਉ ॥
Transliteration: je dehi vaddiaaee taa teree vaddiaaee it ut tujheh dhiaau |
English: If you bestow greatness, then it is Your greatness; here and hereafter, I meditate on You.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਮੈ ਤਾਣੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥੭॥੪੬॥
Transliteration: naanak ke prabh sadaa sukhadaate mai taan teraa ik naau |4|7|46|
English: The Lord God of Nanak is forever the Giver of peace; Your Name is my only strength. ||4||7||46||

[Ang 382 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਏਹੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਜਨਹਿ ਪੀਓ ॥
Transliteration: amrit naam tumaaraa tthaakur ehu mahaa ras janeh peeo |
English: Your Name is Ambrosial Nectar, O Lord Master; Your humble servant drinks in this supreme elixir.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਚੂਕੇ ਭੈ ਭਾਰੇ ਦੁਰਤੁ ਬਿਨਾਸਿਓ ਭਰਮੁ ਬੀਓ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: janam janam chooke bhai bhaare durat binaasio bharam beeo |1|
English: The fearful load of sins from countless incarnations has vanished; doubt and duality are also dispelled. ||1||

Gurbani: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਤ ਮੈ ਜੀਓ ॥
Transliteration: darasan pekhat mai jeeo |
English: I live by beholding the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

Gurbani: ਸੁਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਚਨ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਰੁ ਥੀਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sun kar bachan tumaare satigur man tan meraa tthaar theeo |1| rahaau |
English: Listening to Your Words, O True Guru, my mind and body are cooled and soothed. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਭਇਓ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਏਹੁ ਕਾਜੁ ਤੁਮੑ ਆਪਿ ਕੀਓ ॥
Transliteration: tumaree kripaa te bheo saadhasang ehu kaaj tuma aap keeo |
English: By Your Grace, I have joined the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; You Yourself have caused this to happen.

Gurbani: ਦਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਗਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮੑਰੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਭਈ ਖੀਓ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: dirr kar charan gahe prabh tumare sahaje bikhiaa bhee kheeo |2|
English: Holding fast to Your Feet, O God, the poison is easily neutralized. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਏਹੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਲੀਓ ॥
Transliteration: sukh nidhaan naam prabh tumaraa ehu abinaasee mantru leeo |
English: Your Name, O God, is the treasure of peace; I have received this everlasting Mantra.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨਾ ਤਾਪੁ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਬੈਰੁ ਗੀਓ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa mohi satigur deenaa taap santaap meraa bair geeo |3|
English: Showing His Mercy, the True Guru has given it to me, and my fever and pain and hatred are annulled. ||3||

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਮਾਣਸ ਦੇਹੀ ਪਾਈ ਜਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨੈ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੀਓ ॥
Transliteration: dhan su maanas dehee paaee jit prabh apanai mel leeo |
English: Blessed is the attainment of this human body, by which God blends Himself with me.

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਕਲਿਜੁਗੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਈਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਹੀਓ ॥੪॥੮॥੪੭॥
Transliteration: dhan su kalijug saadhasang keeratan gaaeeai naanak naam adhaar heeo |4|8|47|
English: Blessed, in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, is the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, where the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises are sung.O Nanak, the Naam is my only Support. ||4||8||47||

[Ang 383 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਗੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੂਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: aagai hee te sabh kichh hooaa avar ki jaanai giaanaa |
English: Everything is pre-ordained; what else can be known through study?

Gurbani: ਭੂਲ ਚੂਕ ਅਪਨਾ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਬਖਸਿਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਭਗਵਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bhool chook apanaa baarik bakhasiaa paarabraham bhagavaanaa |1|
English: The errant child has been forgiven by the Supreme Lord God. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਦੀਨ ਕਉ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: satigur meraa sadaa deaalaa mohi deen kau raakh leea |
English: My True Guru is always merciful; He has saved me, the meek one.

Gurbani: ਕਾਟਿਆ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kaattiaa rog mahaa sukh paaeaa har amrit mukh naam deea |1| rahaau |
English: He has cured me of my disease, and I have obtained the greatest peace; He has placed the Ambrosial Name of the Lord in my mouth. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਪਾਪ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰਹਰਿਆ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੇ ਮੁਕਤ ਭਏ ॥
Transliteration: anik paap mere parahariaa bandhan kaatte mukat bhe |
English: He has washed away my countless sins; He has cut away my bonds, and I am liberated.

Gurbani: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਾ ਘੋਰ ਤੇ ਬਾਹ ਪਕਰਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੀਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: andh koop mahaa ghor te baah pakar gur kaadt lee |2|
English: He has taken me by the arm, and pulled me out of the terrible, deep dark pit. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਸਗਲ ਭਉ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਰਾਖੇ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: nirbhau bhe sagal bhau mittiaa raakhe raakhanahaare |
English: I have become fearless, and all my fears have been erased. The Savior Lord has saved me.

Gurbani: ਐਸੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aisee daat teree prabh mere kaaraj sagal savaare |3|
English: Such is Your generosity, O my God, that You have resolved all my affairs. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਮਨਿ ਮੇਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: gun nidhaan saahib man melaa |
English: My mind has met with my Lord and Master, the treasure of excellence.

Gurbani: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋੁਹੇਲਾ ॥੪॥੯॥੪੮॥
Transliteration: saran peaa naanak suohelaa |4|9|48|
English: Taking to His Sanctuary, Nanak has become blissful. ||4||9||48||

[Ang 383 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਤਾਂ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਗੂ ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਤਾਂ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: toon visareh taan sabh ko laagoo cheet aaveh taan sevaa |
English: If I forget You, then everyone becomes my enemy. When You come to mind, then they serve me.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਦੂਜਾ ਸੂਝੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: avar na koaoo doojaa soojhai saache alakh abhevaa |1|
English: I do not know any other at all, O True, Invisible, Inscrutable Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਲੋਗਨ ਕਿਆ ਵੇਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: cheet aavai taan sadaa deaalaa logan kiaa vechaare |
English: When You come to mind, You are always merciful to me; what can the poor people do to me?

Gurbani: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਸਗਲੇ ਜੀਅ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: buraa bhalaa kahu kis no kaheeai sagale jeea tumaare |1| rahaau |
English: Tell me, who should I call good or bad, since all beings are Yours? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰਾ ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: teree ttek teraa aadhaaraa haath dee toon raakheh |
English: You are my Shelter, You are my Support; giving me Your hand, You protect me.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਬਿਪੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਭਾਖੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jis jan aoopar teree kirapaa tis kau bip na koaoo bhaakhai |2|
English: That humble being, upon whom You bestow Your Grace, is not touched by slander or suffering. ||2||

Gurbani: ਓਹੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਓਹਾ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: oho sukh ohaa vaddiaaee jo prabh jee man bhaanee |
English: That is peace, and that is greatness, which is pleasing to the mind of the Dear Lord God.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਨਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਦ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: toon daanaa toon sad miharavaanaa naam milai rang maanee |3|
English: You are all-knowing, You are forever compassionate; obtaining Your Name, I revel in it and make merry. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਗੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: tudh aagai aradaas hamaaree jeeo pindd sabh teraa |
English: I offer my prayer to You; my body and soul are all Yours.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਉ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੪੯॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak sabh teree vaddiaaee koee naau na jaanai meraa |4|10|49|
English: Says Nanak, this is all Your greatness; no one even knows my name. ||4||10||49||

[Ang 383 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh antarajaamee saadhasang har paaeeai |
English: Show Your Mercy, O God, O Searcher of hearts, that in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I might obtain You, Lord.

Gurbani: ਖੋਲਿ ਕਿਵਾਰ ਦਿਖਾਲੇ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੁਨਰਪਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਈਐ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: khol kivaar dikhaale darasan punarap janam na aaeeai |1|
English: When You open Your Door, and reveal the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, the mortal is not relegated to reincarnation again. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਉ ਪਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਹਰਉ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: milau pareetam suaamee apune sagale dookh hrau re |
English: Meeting with my Beloved Lord aand Master, all my pains are taken away.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਿਨਿੑ ਰਿਦੈ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਰਉ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham jina ridai araadhiaa taa kai sang trau re |1| rahaau |
English: I am saved and carried across, in the company of those who remember the Supreme Lord God in their hearts. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਪਾਵਕ ਸਾਗਰ ਭਏ ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਮਹਿ ਬਸਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: mahaa udiaan paavak saagar bhe harakh sog meh basanaa |
English: This world is a great wilderness, an ocean of fire, in which mortals abide, in pleasure and pain.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿ ਭਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਜਪਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: satigur bhett bheaa man niramal jap amrit har rasanaa |2|
English: Meeting with the True Guru, the mortal becomes immaculately pure; with his tongue, he chants the Ambrosial Name of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਥਾਪਿ ਕੀਓ ਸਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਕੋਮਲ ਬੰਧਨ ਬਾਂਧਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: tan dhan thaap keeo sabh apanaa komal bandhan baandhiaa |
English: He preserves his body and wealth, and takes everything as his own; such are the subtle bonds which bind him.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਭਏ ਜਨ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur parasaad bhe jan mukate har har naam araadhiaa |3|
English: By Guru's Grace, the mortal becomes liberated, meditating on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

Gurbani: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੈ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: raakh lee prabh raakhanahaarai jo prabh apune bhaane |
English: God, the Savior, has saved those, who are pleasing to the Will of God.

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੁਮੑਰਾ ਦਾਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੇ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੫੦॥
Transliteration: jeeo pindd sabh tumaraa daate naanak sad kurabaane |4|11|50|
English: The soul and body are all Yours, O Great Giver; O Nanak, I am forever a sacrifice. ||4||11||50||

[Ang 383 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੋਹ ਮਲਨ ਨੀਦ ਤੇ ਛੁਟਕੀ ਕਉਨੁ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਭਇਓ ਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: moh malan need te chhuttakee kaun anugrahu bheo ree |
English: You have avoided the slumber of attachment and impurity - by whose favor has this happened?

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਲਸੁ ਕਹਾ ਗਇਓ ਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mahaa mohanee tudh na viaapai teraa aalas kahaa geo ree |1| rahaau |
English: The great enticer does not affect you. Where has your laziness gone? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਗਾਖਰੋ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਕਉਨ ਛੁਟਿਓ ਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh ahankaar gaakharo sanjam kaun chhuttio ree |
English: How have you escaped from the treachery of sexual desire, anger and egotism?

Gurbani: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਦੇਵ ਅਸੁਰ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਨੀਆ ਸਗਲੋ ਭਵਨੁ ਲੁਟਿਓ ਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sur nar dev asur trai guneea sagalo bhavan luttio ree |1|
English: The holy beings, angels and demons of the three qualities, and all the worlds have been plundered. ||1||

Gurbani: ਦਾਵਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਜਾਲੇ ਕੋਈ ਹਰਿਆ ਬੂਟੁ ਰਹਿਓ ਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: daavaa agan bahut trin jaale koee hariaa boott rahio ree |
English: The forest fire has burnt down so much of the grass; how rare are the plants which have remained green.

Gurbani: ਐਸੋ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਵਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਜਾਤ ਨ ਕਹਿਓ ਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aiso samarath varan na saakau taa kee upamaa jaat na kahio ree |2|
English: He is so All-powerful, that I cannot even describe Him; no one can chant His Praises. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਾਜਰ ਕੋਠ ਮਹਿ ਭਈ ਨ ਕਾਰੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਰਨੁ ਬਨਿਓ ਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kaajar kotth meh bhee na kaaree niramal baran banio ree |
English: In the store-room of the lamp-black, I did not turn black; my color remained immaculate and pure.

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਸਿਓ ਅਚਰਜ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਿਓ ਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: mahaa mantru gur hiradai basio acharaj naam sunio ree |3|
English: The Guru has implanted the Maha Mantra, the Great Mantra, within my heart, and I have heard the wondrous Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਦਰਿ ਅਵਲੋਕਨ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਚਰਣਿ ਲਗਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh nadar avalokan apunai charan lagaaee |
English: Showing His Mercy, God has looked upon me with favor, and He has attached me to His feet.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੫੧॥
Transliteration: prem bhagat naanak sukh paaeaa saadhoo sang samaaee |4|12|51|
English: Through loving devotional worship, O Nanak, I have obtained peace; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I am absorbed into the Lord. ||4||12||51||

[Ang 384 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੭ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raag aasaa ghar 7 mahalaa 5 |
English: Raag Aasaa, Seventh House, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਲਾਲੁ ਚੋਲਨਾ ਤੈ ਤਨਿ ਸੋਹਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: laal cholanaa tai tan sohiaa |
English: That red dress looks so beautiful on your body.

Gurbani: ਸੁਰਿਜਨ ਭਾਨੀ ਤਾਂ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: surijan bhaanee taan man mohiaa |1|
English: Your Husband Lord is pleased, and His heart is enticed. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਵਨ ਬਨੀ ਰੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਲਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: kavan banee ree teree laalee |
English: Whose handiwork is this red beauty of yours?

Gurbani: ਕਵਨ ਰੰਗਿ ਤੂੰ ਭਈ ਗੁਲਾਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kavan rang toon bhee gulaalee |1| rahaau |
English: Whose love has rendered the poppy so red? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਸੁਹਾਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: tum hee sundar tumeh suhaag |
English: You are so beautiful; you are the happy soul-bride.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਘਰਿ ਲਾਲਨੁ ਤੁਮ ਘਰਿ ਭਾਗੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tum ghar laalan tum ghar bhaag |2|
English: Your Beloved is in your home; good fortune is in your home. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਸਤਵੰਤੀ ਤੂੰ ਪਰਧਾਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: toon satavantee toon paradhaan |
English: You are pure and chaste, you are most distinguished.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਭਾਨੀ ਤੁਹੀ ਸੁਰ ਗਿਆਨਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: toon preetam bhaanee tuhee sur giaan |3|
English: You are pleasing to Your Beloved, and you have sublime understanding. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਭਾਨੀ ਤਾਂ ਰੰਗਿ ਗੁਲਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: preetam bhaanee taan rang gulaal |
English: I am pleasing to my Beloved, and so I am imbued with the deep red color.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਭ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak subh drisatt nihaal |4|
English: Says Nanak, I have been totally blessed with the Lord's Glance of Grace. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸੁਨਿ ਰੀ ਸਖੀ ਇਹ ਹਮਰੀ ਘਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: sun ree sakhee ih hamaree ghaal |
English: Listen, O companions: this is my only work;

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਿ ਸੀਗਾਰਿ ਸਵਾਰਨਹਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥੫੨॥
Transliteration: prabh aap seegaar savaaranahaar |1| rahaau doojaa |1|52|
English: God Himself is the One who embellishes and adorns. ||1||Second Pause||1||52||

[Ang 384 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦੂਖੁ ਘਨੋ ਜਬ ਹੋਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: dookh ghano jab hote door |
English: I suffered in pain, when I thought He was far away;

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਮਸਲਤਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ab masalat mohi milee hadoor |1|
English: but now, He is Ever-present, and I receive His instructions. ||1||

Gurbani: ਚੁਕਾ ਨਿਹੋਰਾ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: chukaa nihoraa sakhee saheree |
English: My pride is gone, O friends and companions;

Gurbani: ਭਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਿਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bharam geaa gur pir sang meree |1| rahaau |
English: my doubt is dispelled, and the Guru has united me with my Beloved. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਆਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੇਜ ਧਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: nikatt aan pria sej dharee |
English: My Beloved has drawn me near to Him, and seated me on His Bed;

Gurbani: ਕਾਣਿ ਕਢਨ ਤੇ ਛੂਟਿ ਪਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kaan kadtan te chhoott paree |2|
English: I have escaped the clutches of others. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮੰਦਰਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਉਜਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: mandar merai sabad ujaaraa |
English: In the mansion of my heart, shines the Light of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦੀ ਖਸਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: anad binodee khasam hamaaraa |3|
English: My Husband Lord is blissful and playful. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਮੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: masatak bhaag mai pir ghar aaeaa |
English: According to the destiny written upon my forehead, my Husband Lord has come home to me.

Gurbani: ਥਿਰੁ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੨॥੫੩॥
Transliteration: thir sohaag naanak jan paaeaa |4|2|53|
English: Servant Nanak has obtained the eternal marriage. ||4||2||53||

[Ang 384 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: saach naam meraa man laagaa |
English: My mind is attached to the True Name.

Gurbani: ਲੋਗਨ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਠਾ ਬਾਗਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: logan siau meraa tthaatthaa baagaa |1|
English: My dealings with other people are only superficial. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੂਤੁ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਉ ਮਉਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: baahar soot sagal siau maulaa |
English: Outwardly, I am on good terms with all;

Gurbani: ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਰਹਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਕਉਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: alipat rhau jaise jal meh kaulaa |1| rahaau |
English: but I remain detached, like the lotus upon the water. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੁਖ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਉ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: mukh kee baat sagal siau karataa |
English: By word of mouth, I talk with everyone;

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਧਰਤਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jeea sang prabh apunaa dharataa |2|
English: but I keep God clasped to my heart. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦੀਸਿ ਆਵਤ ਹੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਭੀਹਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: dees aavat hai bahut bheehaalaa |
English: I may appear utterly terrible,

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਚਰਨ ਕੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sagal charan kee ihu man raalaa |3|
English: but my mind is the dust of all men's feet.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: naanak jan gur pooraa paaeaa |
English: Servant Nanak has found the Perfect Guru.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੩॥੫੪॥
Transliteration: antar baahar ek dikhaaeaa |4|3|54|
English: Inwardly and outwardly, He has shown me the One Lord. ||4||3||54||

[Ang 385 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪਾਵਤੁ ਰਲੀਆ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਬਲੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: paavat raleea joban baleea |
English: The mortal revels in joy, in the vigor of youth;

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਮਾਟੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਲੀਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naam binaa maattee sang raleea |1|
English: but without the Name, he mingles with dust. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਾਨ ਕੁੰਡਲੀਆ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਓਢਲੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: kaan kunddaleea basatr odtaleea |
English: He may wear ear-rings and fine clothes,

Gurbani: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਲੀਆ ਮਨਿ ਗਰਬਲੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sej sukhaleea man garabaleea |1| rahaau |
English: and have a comfortable bed, and his mind may be so proud. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤਲੈ ਕੁੰਚਰੀਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਨਿਕ ਛਤਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: talai kunchareea sir kanik chhatareea |
English: He may have elephants to ride, and golden umbrellas over his head;

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਿਨਾ ਲੇ ਧਰਨਿ ਗਡਲੀਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har bhagat binaa le dharan gaddaleea |2|
English: but without devotional worship to the Lord, he is buried beneath the dirt. ||2||

Gurbani: ਰੂਪ ਸੁੰਦਰੀਆ ਅਨਿਕ ਇਸਤਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: roop sundareea anik isatareea |
English: He may enjoy many women, of exquisite beauty;

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਆਦ ਫਿਕਰੀਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har ras bin sabh suaad fikareea |3|
English: but without the sublime essence of the Lord, all tastes are tasteless. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਛਲੀਆ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਬਿਖਲੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa chhaleea bikaar bikhaleea |
English: Deluded by Maya, the mortal is led into sin and corruption.

Gurbani: ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੁਰਖ ਦਇਅਲੀਆ ॥੪॥੪॥੫੫॥
Transliteration: saran naanak prabh purakh deialeea |4|4|55|
English: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God, the All-powerful, Compassionate Lord. ||4||4||55||

[Ang 385 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਬਗੀਚਾ ਪੇਡ ਘਨ ਕਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: ek bageechaa pedd ghan kariaa |
English: There is a garden, in which so many plants have grown.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਹਾ ਮਹਿ ਫਲਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: amrit naam tahaa meh faliaa |1|
English: They bear the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam as their fruit. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa karahu beechaar giaanee |
English: Consider this, O wise one,

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: jaa te paaeeai pad nirabaanee |
English: by which you may attain the state of Nirvaanaa.

Gurbani: ਆਸਿ ਪਾਸਿ ਬਿਖੂਆ ਕੇ ਕੁੰਟਾ ਬੀਚਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aas paas bikhooaa ke kunttaa beech amrit hai bhaaee re |1| rahaau |
English: All around this garden are pools of poison, but within it is the Ambrosial Nectar, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਿੰਚਨਹਾਰੇ ਏਕੈ ਮਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: sinchanahaare ekai maalee |
English: There is only one gardener who tends it.

Gurbani: ਖਬਰਿ ਕਰਤੁ ਹੈ ਪਾਤ ਪਤ ਡਾਲੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: khabar karat hai paat pat ddaalee |2|
English: He takes care of every leaf and branch. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਬਨਸਪਤਿ ਆਣਿ ਜੜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sagal banasapat aan jarraaee |
English: He brings all sorts of plants and plants them there.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲੀ ਫੂਲੀ ਨਿਫਲ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sagalee foolee nifal na kaaee |3|
English: They all bear fruit - none is without fruit. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: amrit fal naam jin gur te paaeaa |
English: One who receives the Ambrosial Fruit of the Naam from the Guru

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤਰੀ ਤਿਨਿ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੫॥੫੬॥
Transliteration: naanak daas taree tin maaeaa |4|5|56|
English: - O Nanak, such a servant crosses over the ocean of Maya. ||4||5||56||

[Ang 385 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਾਜ ਲੀਲਾ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਬਨਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: raaj leelaa terai naam banaaee |
English: The pleasures of royalty are derived from Your Name.

Gurbani: ਜੋਗੁ ਬਨਿਆ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jog baniaa teraa keeratan gaaee |1|
English: I attain Yoga, singing the Kirtan of Your Praises. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਬਨੇ ਤੇਰੈ ਓਲੑੈ ॥
Transliteration: sarab sukhaa bane terai olai |
English: All comforts are obtained in Your Shelter.

Gurbani: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੇ ਪਰਦੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਖੋਲੑੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhram ke parade satigur kholae |1| rahaau |
English: The True Guru has removed the veil of doubt. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੂਝਿ ਰੰਗ ਰਸ ਮਾਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: hukam boojh rang ras maane |
English: Understanding the Command of the Lord's Will, I revel in pleasure and joy.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਮਹਾ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: satigur sevaa mahaa nirabaane |2|
English: Serving the True Guru, I obtain the supreme state of Nirvaanaa. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂੰ ਜਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਗਿਰਸਤ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: jin toon jaataa so girasat udaasee paravaan |
English: One who recognizes You is recognized as a householder, and as a renunciate.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤਾ ਸੋਈ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naam rataa soee nirabaan |3|
English: Imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he dwells in Nirvaanaa. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kau milio naam nidhaanaa |
English: One who has obtained the treasure of the Naam

Gurbani: ਭਨਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਪੂਰ ਖਜਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੬॥੫੭॥
Transliteration: bhanat naanak taa kaa poor khajaanaa |4|6|57|
English: - prays Nanak, his treasure-house is filled to overflowing. ||4||6||57||

[Ang 385 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਜਾਉ ਤ ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: teerath jaau ta hau hau karate |
English: Journeying to sacred shrines of pilgrimage, I see the mortals acting in ego.

Gurbani: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੂਛਉ ਤ ਮਾਇਆ ਰਾਤੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: panddit poochhau ta maaeaa raate |1|
English: If I ask the Pandits, I find them tainted by Maya. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਅਸਥਾਨੁ ਬਤਾਵਹੁ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: so asathaan bataavahu meetaa |
English: Show me that place, O friend,

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਨੀਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai har har keeratan neetaa |1| rahaau |
English: where the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises are forever sung. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੇਦ ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: saasatr bed paap pun veechaar |
English: The Shaastras and the Vedas speak of sin and virtue;

Gurbani: ਨਰਕਿ ਸੁਰਗਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਅਉਤਾਰ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: narak surag fir fir aautaar |2|
English: they say that mortals are reincarnated into heaven and hell, over and over again. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗਿਰਸਤ ਮਹਿ ਚਿੰਤ ਉਦਾਸ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: girasat meh chint udaas ahankaar |
English: In the householder's life, there is anxiety, and in the life of the renunciate, there is egotism.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮ ਕਰਤ ਜੀਅ ਕਉ ਜੰਜਾਰ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: karam karat jeea kau janjaar |3|
English: Performing religious rituals, the soul is entangled. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਵਸਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kirapaa te man vas aaeaa |
English: By God's Grace, the mind is brought under control;

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਰੀ ਤਿਨਿ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh taree tin maaeaa |4|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh crosses over the ocean of Maya. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang har keeratan gaaeeai |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਅਸਥਾਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੭॥੫੮॥
Transliteration: eihu asathaan guroo te paaeeai |1| rahaau doojaa |7|58|
English: This place is found through the Guru. ||1||Second Pause||7||58||

[Ang 385 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਸੂਖ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਸੂਖਾ ॥
Transliteration: ghar meh sookh baahar fun sookhaa |
English: Within my home there is peace, and outwardly there is peace as well.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਦੂਖਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har simarat sagal binaase dookhaa |1|
English: Remembering the Lord in meditation, all pains are erased. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਸੂਖ ਜਾਂ ਤੂੰ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਂਵੈਂ ॥
Transliteration: sagal sookh jaan toon chit aanvain |
English: There is total peace, when You come into my mind.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: so naam japai jo jan tudh bhaavai |1| rahaau |
English: He alone is pleasing to Your Will, who chants the Naam. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: tan man seetal jap naam teraa |
English: My body and mind are cooled and soothed, chanting the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤ ਢਹੈ ਦੁਖ ਡੇਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har har japat dtahai dukh dderaa |2|
English: Meditating on the Lord, Har, Har, the house of pain is demolished. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋਈ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: hukam boojhai soee paravaan |
English: He alone, who understands the Command of the Lord's Will, is approved.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨੀਸਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: saach sabad jaa kaa neesaan |3|
English: The True Shabad of the Word of God is his trademark and insignia. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur poorai har naam drirraaeaa |
English: The Perfect Guru has implanted the Lord's Name within me.

Gurbani: ਭਨਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੮॥੫੯॥
Transliteration: bhanat naanak merai man sukh paaeaa |4|8|59|
English: Prays Nanak, my mind has found peace. ||4||8||59||

[Ang 386 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਹਾ ਪਠਾਵਹੁ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਜਾੲਂੀ ॥
Transliteration: jahaa patthaavahu teh teh jaaenee |
English: Wherever You send me, there I go.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੁਮ ਦੇਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾੲਂੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jo tum dehu soee sukh paaenee |1|
English: Whatever You give me, brings me peace. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਚੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੋਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa chere govind gosaaee |
English: I am forever the chaylaa, the humble disciple, of the Lord of the Universe, the Sustainer of the World.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾੲਂੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tumaree kripaa te tripat aghaaenee |1| rahaau |
English: By Your Grace, I am satisfied and satiated. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮਰਾ ਦੀਆ ਪੈਨੑਉ ਖਾੲਂੀ ॥
Transliteration: tumaraa deea painau khaaenee |
English: Whatever You give me, I wear and eat.

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਖੀ ਵਲਾੲਂੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tau prasaad prabh sukhee valaaenee |2|
English: By Your Grace, O God, my life passes peacefully. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੁਝੈ ਧਿਆੲਂੀ ॥
Transliteration: man tan antar tujhai dhiaaenee |
English: Deep within my mind and body, I meditate on You.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮੑਰੈ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਲਾੲਂੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tumarai lavai na koaoo laaenee |3|
English: I recognize none as equal to You. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਤ ਇਵੈ ਧਿਆੲਂੀ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak nit ivai dhiaaenee |
English: Says Nanak, this is my continual meditation:

Gurbani: ਗਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੰਤਹ ਲਗਿ ਪਾੲਂੀ ॥੪॥੯॥੬੦॥
Transliteration: gat hovai santah lag paaenee |4|9|60|
English: that I may be emancipated, clinging to the Feet of the Saints. ||4||9||60||

[Ang 386 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: aootthat baitthat sovat dhiaaeeai |
English: While standing up, and sitting down, and even while asleep, meditate on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਲਤ ਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: maarag chalat hare har gaaeeai |1|
English: Walking on the Way, sing the Praises of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸੁਨੀਜੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਥਾ ॥
Transliteration: sravan suneejai amrit kathaa |
English: With your ears, listen to the Ambrosial Sermon.

Gurbani: ਜਾਸੁ ਸੁਨੀ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਦੂਖ ਰੋਗ ਮਨ ਸਗਲੇ ਲਥਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaas sunee man hoe anandaa dookh rog man sagale lathaa |1| rahaau |
English: Listening to it, your mind shall be filled with bliss, and the troubles and diseases of your mind shall all depart. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਾਰਜਿ ਕਾਮਿ ਬਾਟ ਘਾਟ ਜਪੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: kaaraj kaam baatt ghaatt japeejai |
English: While you work at your job, on the road and at the beach, meditate and chant.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad har amrit peejai |2|
English: By Guru's Grace, drink in the Ambrosial Essence of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: dinas rain har keeratan gaaeeai |
English: The humble being who sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, day and night,

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਵਾਟ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: so jan jam kee vaatt na paaeeai |3|
English: does not have to go with the Messenger of Death. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar jis visareh naahee |
English: One who does not forget the Lord, twenty-four hours a day, is emancipated;

Gurbani: ਗਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਗਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੬੧॥
Transliteration: gat hovai naanak tis lag paaee |4|10|61|
English: O Nanak, I fall at his feet. ||4||10||61||

[Ang 386 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਸੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai simaran sookh nivaas |
English: Remembering Him in meditation, one abides in peace;

Gurbani: ਭਈ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਦੁਖ ਹੋਵਤ ਨਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bhee kaliaan dukh hovat naas |1|
English: one becomes happy, and suffering is ended. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਨਦੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: anad karahu prabh ke gun gaavahu |
English: Celebrate, make merry, and sing God's Glories.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur apanaa sad sadaa manaavahu |1| rahaau |
English: Forever and ever, surrender to the True Guru. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਵਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: satigur kaa sach sabad kamaavahu |
English: Act in accordance with the Shabad, the True Word of the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਥਿਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਠੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: thir ghar baitthe prabh apanaa paavahu |2|
English: Remain steady and stable within the home of your own self, and find God. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪਰ ਕਾ ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਚੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: par kaa buraa na raakhahu cheet |
English: Do not harbor evil intentions against others in your mind,

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਕਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tum kau dukh nahee bhaaee meet |3|
English: and you shall not be troubled, O Siblings of Destiny, O friends. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤੰਤੁ ਮੰਤੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੑਾ ॥
Transliteration: har har tant mant gur deenaa |
English: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is the Tantric exercise, and the Mantra, given by the Guru.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਚੀਨੑਾ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੬੨॥
Transliteration: eihu sukh naanak anadin cheenaa |4|11|62|
English: Nanak knows this peace alone, night and day. ||4||11||62||

[Ang 386 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਨੀਚ ਕਉ ਕੋਈ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: jis neech kau koee na jaanai |
English: That wretched being, whom no one knows

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਉਹੁ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਟ ਮਾਨੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naam japat uhu chahu kuntt maanai |1|
English: - chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he is honored in the four directions. ||1||

Gurbani: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਮਾਗਉ ਦੇਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: darasan maagau dehi piaare |
English: I beg for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; please, give it to me, O Beloved!

Gurbani: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਉਨ ਕਉਨ ਨ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tumaree sevaa kaun kaun na taare |1| rahaau |
English: Serving You, who, who has not been saved? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai nikatt na aavai koee |
English: That person, whom no one wants to be near

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਆ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਮਲਿ ਧੋਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sagal srisatt uaa ke charan mal dhoee |2|
English: - the whole world comes to wash the dirt of his feet. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਕਾਹੂ ਨ ਆਵਤ ਕਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: jo praanee kaahoo na aavat kaam |
English: That mortal, who is of no use to anyone at all

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਜਪੀਐ ਨਾਮ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sant prasaad taa ko japeeai naam |3|
English: - by the Grace of the Saints, he meditates on the Naam. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਨ ਸੋਵਤ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang man sovat jaage |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the sleeping mind awakens.

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੀਠੇ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੬੩॥
Transliteration: tab prabh naanak meetthe laage |4|12|63|
English: Then, O Nanak, God seems sweet. ||4||12||63||

[Ang 386 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਏਕੀ ਨੈਨ ਨਿਹਾਰਉ ॥
Transliteration: eko ekee nain nihaarau |
English: With my eyes, I behold the One and Only Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਰਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa har naam samaarau |1|
English: Forever and ever, I contemplate the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮਾ ਰਾਮਾ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: raam raamaa raamaa gun gaavau |
English: I sing the Praises of the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪਿ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਉ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sant prataap saadh kai sange har har naam dhiaavau re |1| rahaau |
English: By the graceful favor of the Saints, I meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੂਤਿ ਪਰੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: sagal samagree jaa kai soot paroee |
English: Everything is strung on His string.

Gurbani: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt antar raviaa soee |2|
English: He is contained in each and every heart. ||2||

Gurbani: ਓਪਤਿ ਪਰਲਉ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: opat parlau khin meh karataa |
English: He creates and destroys in an instant.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਅਲੇਪਾ ਨਿਰਗੁਨੁ ਰਹਤਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aap alepaa niragun rahataa |3|
English: He Himself remains unattached, and without attributes. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: karan karaavan antarajaamee |
English: He is the Creator, the Cause of causes, the Searcher of hearts.

Gurbani: ਅਨੰਦ ਕਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੬੪॥
Transliteration: anand karai naanak kaa suaamee |4|13|64|
English: Nanak's Lord and Master celebrates in bliss. ||4||13||64||

[Ang 387 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਰਹੇ ਭਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kott janam ke rahe bhavaare |
English: My wandering through millions of births has ended.

Gurbani: ਦੁਲਭ ਦੇਹ ਜੀਤੀ ਨਹੀ ਹਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dulabh deh jeetee nahee haare |1|
English: I have won, and not lost, this human body, so difficult to obtain. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਦੁਖ ਦਰਦ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: kilabikh binaase dukh darad door |
English: My sins have been erased, and my sufferings and pains are gone.

Gurbani: ਭਏ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhe puneet santan kee dhoor |1| rahaau |
English: I have been sanctified by the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਜੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: prabh ke sant udhaaran jog |
English: The Saints of God have the ability to save us;

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tis bhette jis dhur sanjog |2|
English: they meet with those of us who have such pre-ordained destiny. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: man aanand mantru gur deea |
English: My mind is filled with bliss, since the Guru gave me the Mantra of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਬੁਝੀ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਥੀਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: trisan bujhee man nihachal theea |3|
English: My thirst has been quenched, and my mind has become steady and stable. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ॥
Transliteration: naam padaarath nau nidh sidh |
English: The wealth of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is for me the nine treasures, and the spiritual powers of the Siddhas.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ਬੁਧਿ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੬੫॥
Transliteration: naanak gur te paaee budh |4|14|65|
English: O Nanak, I have obtained understanding from the Guru. ||4||14||65||

[Ang 387 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਿਟੀ ਤਿਆਸ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: mittee tiaas agiaan andhere |
English: My thirst, and the darkness of ignorance have been removed.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਸੇਵਾ ਅਘ ਕਟੇ ਘਨੇਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saadh sevaa agh katte ghanere |1|
English: Serving the Holy Saints, countless sins are obliterated. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਘਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: sookh sehaj aanand ghanaa |
English: I have obtained celestial peace and immense joy.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur sevaa te bhe man niramal har har har har naam sunaa |1| rahaau |
English: Serving the Guru, my mind has become immaculately pure, and I have heard the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਢੀਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: binasio man kaa moorakh dteetthaa |
English: The stubborn foolishness of my mind is gone;

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਲਾਗਾ ਮੀਠਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: prabh kaa bhaanaa laagaa meetthaa |2|
English: God's Will has become sweet to me. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਗਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur poore ke charan gahe |
English: I have grasped the Feet of the Perfect Guru,

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਲਹੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kott janam ke paap lahe |3|
English: and the sins of countless incarnations have been washed away. ||3||

Gurbani: ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਇਹੁ ਸਫਲ ਭਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: ratan janam ihu safal bheaa |
English: The jewel of this life has become fruitful.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰੀ ਮਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੬੬॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak prabh karee meaa |4|15|66|
English: Says Nanak, God has shown mercy to me. ||4||15||66||

[Ang 387 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਸਮੑਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur apanaa sad sadaa samaare |
English: I contemplate, forever and ever, the True Guru;

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਕੇਸ ਸੰਗਿ ਝਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur ke charan kes sang jhaare |1|
English: with my hair, I dust the feet of the Guru. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਾਗੁ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਾਗਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jaag re man jaaganahaare |
English: Be wakeful, O my awakening mind!

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਆਵਸਿ ਕਾਮਾ ਝੂਠਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਪਸਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bin har avar na aavas kaamaa jhootthaa mohu mithiaa pasaare |1| rahaau |
English: Without the Lord, nothing else shall be of use to you; false is emotional attachment, and useless are worldly entanglements. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur kee baanee siau rang laae |
English: Embrace love for the Word of the Guru's Bani.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur kirapaal hoe dukh jaae |2|
English: When the Guru shows His Mercy, pain is destroyed. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਥਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur bin doojaa naahee thaau |
English: Without the Guru, there is no other place of rest.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਨਾਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur daataa gur devai naau |3|
English: The Guru is the Giver, the Guru gives the Name. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: gur paarabraham paramesar aap |
English: The Guru is the Supreme Lord God; He Himself is the Transcendent Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੬੭॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar naanak gur jaap |4|16|67|
English: Twenty-four hours a day, O Nanak, meditate on the Guru. ||4||16||67||

[Ang 387 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਪੇਡੁ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੀ ਸਾਖ ॥
Transliteration: aape pedd bisathaaree saakh |
English: He Himself is the tree, and the branches extending out.

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੀ ਖੇਤੀ ਆਪੇ ਰਾਖ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: apanee khetee aape raakh |1|
English: He Himself preserves His own crop. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਏਕੈ ਓਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jat kat pekhau ekai ohee |
English: Wherever I look, I see that One Lord alone.

Gurbani: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt antar aape soee |1| rahaau |
English: Deep within each and every heart, He Himself is contained. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸੂਰੁ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape soor kiran bisathaar |
English: He Himself is the sun, and the rays emanating from it.

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਸੋਈ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: soee gupat soee aakaar |2|
English: He is concealed, and He is revealed. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਰਗੁਣ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਥਾਪੈ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saragun niragun thaapai naau |
English: He is said to be of the highest attributes, and without attributes.

Gurbani: ਦੁਹ ਮਿਲਿ ਏਕੈ ਕੀਨੋ ਠਾਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: duh mil ekai keeno tthaau |3|
English: Both converge onto His single point. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਖੋਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak gur bhram bhau khoeaa |
English: Says Nanak, the Guru has dispelled my doubt and fear.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦ ਰੂਪੁ ਸਭੁ ਨੈਨ ਅਲੋਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੭॥੬੮॥
Transliteration: anad roop sabh nain aloeaa |4|17|68|
English: With my eyes, I perceive the Lord, the embodiment of bliss, to be everywhere. ||4||17||68||

[Ang 387 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਉਕਤਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: aukat siaanap kichhoo na jaanaa |
English: I know nothing of arguments or cleverness.

Gurbani: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: din rain teraa naam vakhaanaa |1|
English: Day and night, I chant Your Name. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: mai niragun gun naahee koe |
English: I am worthless; I have no virtue at all.

Gurbani: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨਹਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: karan karaavanahaar prabh soe |1| rahaau |
English: God is the Creator, the Cause of all causes. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: moorakh mugadh agiaan aveechaaree |
English: I am foolish, stupid, ignorant and thoughtless;

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਮਨਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naam tere kee aas man dhaaree |2|
English: Your Name is my mind's only hope. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਰਮ ਨ ਸਾਧਾ ॥
Transliteration: jap tap sanjam karam na saadhaa |
English: I have not practiced chanting, deep meditation, self-discipline or good actions;

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਅਰਾਧਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naam prabhoo kaa maneh araadhaa |3|
English: but within my mind, I have worshipped God's Name. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ਮਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਥੋਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kichhoo na jaanaa mat meree thoree |
English: I know nothing, and my intellect is inadequate.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਓਟ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੋਰੀ ॥੪॥੧੮॥੬੯॥
Transliteration: binavat naanak ott prabh toree |4|18|69|
English: Prays Nanak, O God, You are my only Support. ||4||18||69||

[Ang 388 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਖਰ ਦੁਇ ਇਹ ਮਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: har har akhar due ih maalaa |
English: These two words, Har, Har, make up my maalaa.

Gurbani: ਜਪਤ ਜਪਤ ਭਏ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: japat japat bhe deen deaalaa |1|
English: Continually chanting and reciting this rosary, God has become merciful to me, His humble servant. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: krau benatee satigur apunee |
English: I offer my prayer to the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੇਹੁ ਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa raakhahu saranaaee mo kau dehu hare har japanee |1| rahaau |
English: Shower Your Mercy upon me, and keep me safe in Your Sanctuary; please, give me the maalaa, the rosary of Har, Har. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਮਾਲਾ ਉਰ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: har maalaa ur antar dhaarai |
English: One who enshrines this rosary of the Lord's Name within his heart,

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: janam maran kaa dookh nivaarai |2|
English: is freed of the pains of birth and death. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਮਾਲੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: hiradai samaalai mukh har har bolai |
English: The humble being who contemplates the Lord within his heart, and chants the Lord's Name, Har, Har, with his mouth,

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਡੋਲੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: so jan it ut kateh na ddolai |3|
English: never wavers, here or hereafter. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਰਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak jo raachai naae |
English: Says Nanak, one who is imbued with the Name,

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਮਾਲਾ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੯॥੭੦॥
Transliteration: har maalaa taa kai sang jaae |4|19|70|
English: goes to the next world with the maalaa of the Lord's Name. ||4||19||70||

[Ang 388 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jis kaa sabh kichh tis kaa hoe |
English: All things belong to Him - let yourself belong to Him as well.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਲੇਪੁ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tis jan lep na biaapai koe |1|
English: No stain clings to such a humble being. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa sevak sad hee mukataa |
English: The Lord's servant is liberated forever.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo kichh karai soee bhal jan kai at niramal daas kee jugataa |1| rahaau |
English: Whatever He does, is pleasing to His servant; the way of life of His slave is immaculately pure. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sagal tiaag har saranee aaeaa |
English: One who renounces everything, and enters the Lord's Sanctuary

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਹਾ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tis jan kahaa biaapai maaeaa |2|
English: - how can Maya cling to him? ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: naam nidhaan jaa ke man maeh |
English: With the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, in his mind,

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tis kau chintaa supanai naeh |3|
English: he suffers no anxiety, even in dreams. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak gur pooraa paaeaa |
English: Says Nanak, I have found the Perfect Guru.

Gurbani: ਭਰਮੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਸਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੨੦॥੭੧॥
Transliteration: bharam mohu sagal binasaaeaa |4|20|71|
English: My doubts and attachments have been totally obliterated. ||4||20||71||

[Ang 388 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਹੋਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jau suprasan hoeo prabh meraa |
English: When my God is totally pleased with me,

Gurbani: ਤਾਂ ਦੂਖੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਕਹੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਨੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: taan dookh bharam kahu kaise neraa |1|
English: then, tell me, how can suffering or doubt draw near me? ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਸੋਇ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: sun sun jeevaa soe tumaaree |
English: Continually listening to Your Glory, I live.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਕਉ ਲੇਹੁ ਉਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mohi niragun kau lehu udhaaree |1| rahaau |
English: I am worthless - save me, O Lord! ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਿਟਿ ਗਇਆ ਦੂਖੁ ਬਿਸਾਰੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: mitt geaa dookh bisaaree chintaa |
English: My suffering has been ended, and my anxiety is forgotten.

Gurbani: ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਪਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੰਤਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: fal paaeaa jap satigur mantaa |2|
English: I have obtained my reward, chanting the Mantra of the True Guru. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਹੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: soee sat sat hai soe |
English: He is True, and True is His glory.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਰਖੁ ਕੰਠਿ ਪਰੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: simar simar rakh kantth paroe |3|
English: Remembering, remembering Him in meditation, keep Him clasped to your heart. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉਨ ਉਹ ਕਰਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak kaun uh karamaa |
English: Says Nanak, what action is there left to do,

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੪॥੨੧॥੭੨॥
Transliteration: jaa kai man vasiaa har naamaa |4|21|72|
English: by one whose mind is filled with the Lord's Name? ||4||21||72||

[Ang 388 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਵਿਗੂਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh ahankaar vigoote |
English: Sexual desire, anger, and egotism lead to ruin.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਛੂਟੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har simaran kar har jan chhootte |1|
English: Meditating on the Lord, the Lord's humble servants are redeemed. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੋਇ ਰਹੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦ ਮਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: soe rahe maaeaa mad maate |
English: The mortals are asleep, intoxicated with the wine of Maya.

Gurbani: ਜਾਗਤ ਭਗਤ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaagat bhagat simarat har raate |1| rahaau |
English: The devotees remain awake, imbued with the Lord's meditation. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੋਹ ਭਰਮਿ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨਿ ਭਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: moh bharam bahu jon bhavaaeaa |
English: In emotional attachment and doubt, the mortals wander through countless incarnations.

Gurbani: ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਭਗਤ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: asathir bhagat har charan dhiaaeaa |2|
English: The devotees remain ever-stable, meditating on the Lord's Lotus Feet. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬੰਧਨ ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: bandhan andh koop grih meraa |
English: Bound to household and possessions, the mortals are lost in the deep, dark pit.

Gurbani: ਮੁਕਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਬੁਝਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: mukate sant bujheh har neraa |3|
English: The Saints are liberated, knowing the Lord to be near at hand. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak jo prabh saranaaee |
English: Says Nanak, one who has taken to God's Sanctuary,

Gurbani: ਈਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਆਗੈ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੨੨॥੭੩॥
Transliteration: eehaa sukh aagai gat paaee |4|22|73|
English: obtains peace in this world, and salvation in the world hereafter. ||4||22||73||

[Ang 389 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਤਰੰਗੁ ਹਮ ਮੀਨ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: too meraa tarang ham meen tumaare |
English: You are my waves, and I am Your fish.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਹਮ ਤੇਰੈ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: too meraa tthaakur ham terai duaare |1|
English: You are my Lord and Master; I wait at Your Door. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਹਉ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: toon meraa karataa hau sevak teraa |
English: You are my Creator, and I am Your servant.

Gurbani: ਸਰਣਿ ਗਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਨੀ ਗਹੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saran gahee prabh gunee gaheraa |1| rahaau |
English: I have taken to Your Sanctuary, O God, most profound and excellent. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਤੂ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: too meraa jeevan too aadhaar |
English: You are my life, You are my Support.

Gurbani: ਤੁਝਹਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਕਉਲਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tujheh pekh bigasai kaulaar |2|
English: Beholding You, my heart-lotus blossoms forth. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਮੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਤੂ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: too meree gat pat too paravaan |
English: You are my salvation and honor; You make me acceptable.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਮੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: too samarath mai teraa taan |3|
English: You are All-powerful, You are my strength. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਪਉ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: anadin jpau naam gunataas |
English: Night and day, I chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the treasure of excellence.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਹਿ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੭੪॥
Transliteration: naanak kee prabh peh aradaas |4|23|74|
English: This is Nanak's prayer to God. ||4||23||74||

[Ang 389 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰੋਵਨਹਾਰੈ ਝੂਠੁ ਕਮਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: rovanahaarai jhootth kamaanaa |
English: The mourner practices falsehood;

Gurbani: ਹਸਿ ਹਸਿ ਸੋਗੁ ਕਰਤ ਬੇਗਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: has has sog karat begaanaa |1|
English: he laughs with glee, while mourning for others. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕੋ ਮੂਆ ਕਾ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਗਾਵਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: ko mooaa kaa kai ghar gaavan |
English: Someone has died, while there is singing in someone else's house.

Gurbani: ਕੋ ਰੋਵੈ ਕੋ ਹਸਿ ਹਸਿ ਪਾਵਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ko rovai ko has has paavan |1| rahaau |
English: One mourns and bewails, while another laughs with glee. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਾਲ ਬਿਵਸਥਾ ਤੇ ਬਿਰਧਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: baal bivasathaa te biradhaanaa |
English: From childhood to old age,

Gurbani: ਪਹੁਚਿ ਨ ਮੂਕਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: pahuch na mookaa fir pachhutaanaa |2|
English: the mortal does not attain his goals, and he comes to regret in the end. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: trihu gun meh varatai sansaaraa |
English: The world is under the influence of the three qualities.

Gurbani: ਨਰਕ ਸੁਰਗ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਅਉਤਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: narak surag fir fir aautaaraa |3|
English: The mortal is reincarnated, again and again, into heaven and hell. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਲਾਇਆ ਨਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak jo laaeaa naam |
English: Says Nanak, one who is attached to the Naam, the Name of the Lord,

Gurbani: ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਪਰਵਾਨ ॥੪॥੨੪॥੭੫॥
Transliteration: safal janam taa kaa paravaan |4|24|75|
English: becomes acceptable, and his life becomes fruitful. ||4||24||75||

[Ang 389 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੋਇ ਰਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: soe rahee prabh khabar na jaanee |
English: She remains asleep, and does not know the news of God.

Gurbani: ਭੋਰੁ ਭਇਆ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bhor bheaa bahur pachhutaanee |1|
English: The day dawns, and then, she regrets. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਧਰਉ ਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: pria prem sehaj man anad dhrau ree |
English: Loving the Beloved, the mind is filled with celestial bliss.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਬੇ ਕੀ ਲਾਲਸਾ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਆਲਸੁ ਕਹਾ ਕਰਉ ਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: prabh milabe kee laalasaa taa te aalas kahaa krau ree |1| rahaau |
English: You yearn to meet with God, so why do you delay? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਰ ਮਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਆਣਿ ਨਿਸਾਰਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: kar meh amrit aan nisaario |
English: He came and poured His Ambrosial Nectar into your hands,

Gurbani: ਖਿਸਰਿ ਗਇਓ ਭੂਮ ਪਰਿ ਡਾਰਿਓ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: khisar geo bhoom par ddaario |2|
English: but it slipped through your fingers, and fell onto the ground. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਾਦਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਲਾਦੀ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: saad mohi laadee ahankaare |
English: You are burdened with desire, emotional attachment and egotism;

Gurbani: ਦੋਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: dos naahee prabh karanaihaare |3|
English: it is not the fault of God the Creator. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਟੇ ਭਰਮ ਅੰਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang mitte bharam andhaare |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the darkness of doubt is dispelled.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲੀ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੨੫॥੭੬॥
Transliteration: naanak melee sirajanahaare |4|25|76|
English: O Nanak, the Creator Lord blends us with Himself. ||4||25||76||

[Ang 389 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal kee aas piaare |
English: I long for the Lotus Feet of my Beloved Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਮਕੰਕਰ ਨਸਿ ਗਏ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jamakankar nas ge vichaare |1|
English: The wretched Messenger of Death has run away from me. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਮਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: too chit aaveh teree meaa |
English: You enter into my mind, by Your Kind Mercy.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮ ਸਗਲ ਰੋਗ ਖਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: simarat naam sagal rog kheaa |1| rahaau |
English: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, all diseases are destroyed. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਦੂਖ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਅਵਰਾ ਕਉ ॥
Transliteration: anik dookh deveh avaraa kau |
English: Death gives so much pain to others,

Gurbani: ਪਹੁਚਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਹਿ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: pahuch na saakeh jan tere kau |2|
English: but it cannot even come near Your slave. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦਰਸ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: daras tere kee piaas man laagee |
English: My mind thirsts for Your Vision;

Gurbani: ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦ ਬਸੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sehaj anand basai bairaagee |3|
English: in peaceful ease and bliss, I dwell in detachment. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਸੁਣੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: naanak kee aradaas suneejai |
English: Hear this prayer of Nanak:

Gurbani: ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੇ ਮਹਿ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੪॥੨੬॥੭੭॥
Transliteration: keval naam ride meh deejai |4|26|77|
English: please, infuse Your Name into his heart. ||4||26||77||

[Ang 389 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨੋ ਮਿਟੇ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: man tripataano mitte janjaal |
English: My mind is satisfied, and my entanglements have been dissolved.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਹੋਇਆ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: prabh apunaa hoeaa kirapaal |1|
English: God has become merciful to me. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਭਲੀ ਬਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: sant prasaad bhalee banee |
English: By the Grace of the Saints, everything has turned out well.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਸੋ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਧਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai grihi sabh kichh hai pooran so bhettiaa nirabhai dhanee |1| rahaau |
English: His House is overflowing with all things; I have met Him, the Fearless Master. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਸਾਧ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: naam drirraaeaa saadh kripaal |
English: By the Kind Mercy of the Holy Saints, the Naam has been implanted within me.

Gurbani: ਮਿਟਿ ਗਈ ਭੂਖ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mitt gee bhookh mahaa bikaraal |2|
English: The most dreadful desires have been eliminated. ||2||

Gurbani: ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਕੀਨੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: tthaakur apunai keenee daat |
English: My Master has given me a gift;

Gurbani: ਜਲਨਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਈ ਸਾਂਤਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jalan bujhee man hoee saant |3|
English: the fire has been extinguished, and my mind is now at peace. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਿਟਿ ਗਈ ਭਾਲ ਮਨੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: mitt gee bhaal man sehaj samaanaa |
English: My search has ended, and my mind is absorbed in celestial bliss.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮ ਖਜਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੨੭॥੭੮॥
Transliteration: naanak paaeaa naam khajaanaa |4|27|78|
English: Nanak has obtained the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||27||78||

[Ang 390 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: tthaakur siau jaa kee ban aaee |
English: Those who are attuned to their Lord and Master

Gurbani: ਭੋਜਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਰਹੇ ਅਘਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bhojan pooran rahe aghaaee |1|
English: are satisfied and fulfilled with the perfect food. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਛੂ ਨ ਥੋਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਉ ॥
Transliteration: kachhoo na thoraa har bhagatan kau |
English: The Lord's devotees never run short of anything.

Gurbani: ਖਾਤ ਖਰਚਤ ਬਿਲਛਤ ਦੇਵਨ ਕਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: khaat kharachat bilachhat devan kau |1| rahaau |
English: They have plenty to eat, spend, enjoy and give. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਧਨੀ ਅਗਮ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kaa dhanee agam gusaaee |
English: One who has the Unfathomable Lord of the Universe as his Master

Gurbani: ਮਾਨੁਖ ਕੀ ਕਹੁ ਕੇਤ ਚਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: maanukh kee kahu ket chalaaee |2|
English: - how can any mere mortal stand up to him? ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਦਸ ਅਸਟ ਸਿਧਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kee sevaa das asatt sidhaaee |
English: One who is served by the eighteen supernatural powers of the Siddhas

Gurbani: ਪਲਕ ਦਿਸਟਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਲਾਗਹੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: palak disatt taa kee laagahu paaee |3|
English: - grasp his feet, even for an instant. ||3||
