Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kau deaa karahu mere suaamee |
English: That one, upon whom You have showered Your Mercy, O my Lord Master

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਿਨ ਕਾਮੀ ॥੪॥੨੮॥੭੯॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak naahee tin kaamee |4|28|79|
English: - says Nanak, he does not lack anything. ||4||28||79||

[Ang 390 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਮੈ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jau mai apunaa satigur dhiaaeaa |
English: When I meditate on my True Guru,

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tab merai man mahaa sukh paaeaa |1|
English: my mind becomes supremely peaceful. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਿਟਿ ਗਈ ਗਣਤ ਬਿਨਾਸਿਉ ਸੰਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: mitt gee ganat binaasiau sansaa |
English: The record of my account is erased, and my doubts are dispelled.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਜਨ ਭਏ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: naam rate jan bhe bhagavantaa |1| rahaau |
English: Imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, His humble servant is blessed with good fortune. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਮੈ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: jau mai apunaa saahib cheet |
English: When I remember my Lord and Master,

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਭਉ ਮਿਟਿਓ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tau bhau mittio mere meet |2|
English: my fears are dispelled, O my friend. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਮੈ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jau mai ott gahee prabh teree |
English: When I took to Your Protection, O God,

Gurbani: ਤਾਂ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਮਨਸਾ ਮੇਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: taan pooran hoee manasaa meree |3|
English: my desires were fulfilled. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦੇਖਿ ਚਲਿਤ ਮਨਿ ਭਏ ਦਿਲਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: dekh chalit man bhe dilaasaa |
English: Gazing upon the wonder of Your play, my mind has become encouraged.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ॥੪॥੨੯॥੮੦॥
Transliteration: naanak daas teraa bharavaasaa |4|29|80|
English: Servant Nanak relies on You alone. ||4||29||80||

[Ang 390 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਮੂਸਾ ਲਾਜੁ ਟੁਕਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: anadin moosaa laaj ttukaaee |
English: Night and day, the mouse of time gnaws away at the rope of life.

Gurbani: ਗਿਰਤ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਿ ਖਾਹਿ ਮਿਠਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: girat koop meh khaeh mitthaaee |1|
English: Falling into the well, the mortal eats the sweet treats of Maya. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੋਚਤ ਸਾਚਤ ਰੈਨਿ ਬਿਹਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: sochat saachat rain bihaanee |
English: Thinking and planning, the night of the life is passing away.

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਪਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: anik rang maaeaa ke chitavat kabahoo na simarai saaringapaanee |1| rahaau |
English: Thinking of the many pleasures of Maya, the mortal never remembers the Lord, the Sustainer of the earth. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਕੀ ਛਾਇਆ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਬਾਂਧਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: drum kee chhaaeaa nihachal grihu baandhiaa |
English: Believing the shade of the tree to be permanent, he builds his house beneath it.

Gurbani: ਕਾਲ ਕੈ ਫਾਂਸਿ ਸਕਤ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਂਧਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kaal kai faans sakat sar saandhiaa |2|
English: But the noose of death is around his neck, and Shakti, the power of Maya, has aimed her arrows at him. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬਾਲੂ ਕਨਾਰਾ ਤਰੰਗ ਮੁਖਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: baaloo kanaaraa tarang mukh aaeaa |
English: The sandy shore is being washed away by the waves,

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਮੂੜਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: so thaan moorr nihachal kar paaeaa |3|
English: but the fool still believes that place to be permanent. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang japio har raae |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, chant the Name of the Lord, the King.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੪॥੩੦॥੮੧॥
Transliteration: naanak jeevai har gun gaae |4|30|81|
English: Nanak lives by singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||30||81||

[Ang 390 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਤੁਕੇ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 dutuke 9 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Dho-Thukay 9:

Gurbani: ਉਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੂ ਕਰਤੀ ਕੇਲ ॥
Transliteration: aun kai sang too karatee kel |
English: With that, you are engaged in playful sport;

Gurbani: ਉਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਲ ॥
Transliteration: aun kai sang ham tum sang mel |
English: with that, I am joined to you.

Gurbani: ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਮ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਊ ਲੋਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: auna kai sang tum sabh koaoo lorai |
English: With that, everyone longs for you;

Gurbani: ਓਸੁ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੋਊ ਮੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਜੋਰੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: os binaa koaoo mukh nahee jorai |1|
English: without it, no one would even look at your face. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਕਹਾ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: te bairaagee kahaa samaae |
English: Where is that detached soul now contained?

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਤੁਹੀ ਦੁਹੇਰੀ ਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tis bin tuhee duheree ree |1| rahaau |
English: Without it, you are miserable. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੂ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਹਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: auna kai sang too grih meh maahar |
English: With that, you are the woman of the house;

Gurbani: ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੂ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਜਾਹਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: auna kai sang too hoee hai jaahar |
English: with that, you are respected.

Gurbani: ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੂ ਰਖੀ ਪਪੋਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: auna kai sang too rakhee papol |
English: With that, you are caressed;

Gurbani: ਓਸੁ ਬਿਨਾ ਤੂੰ ਛੁਟਕੀ ਰੋਲਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: os binaa toon chhuttakee rol |2|
English: without it, you are reduced to dust. ||2||

Gurbani: ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਮਾਨੁ ਮਹਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: auna kai sang teraa maan mehat |
English: With that, you have honor and respect;

Gurbani: ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਮ ਸਾਕੁ ਜਗਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: auna kai sang tum saak jagat |
English: with that, you have relatives in the world.

Gurbani: ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਥਾਟੀ ॥
Transliteration: auna kai sang teree sabh bidh thaattee |
English: With that, you are adorned in every way;

Gurbani: ਓਸੁ ਬਿਨਾ ਤੂੰ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਮਾਟੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: os binaa toon hoee hai maattee |3|
English: without it, you are reduced to dust. ||3||

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: ohu bairaagee marai na jaae |
English: That detached soul is neither born, nor dies.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਬਾਧਾ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: hukame baadhaa kaar kamaae |
English: It acts according to the Command of the Lord's Will.

Gurbani: ਜੋੜਿ ਵਿਛੋੜੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਥਾਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: jorr vichhorre naanak thaap |
English: O Nanak, having fashioned the body, the Lord unites the soul with it, and separates them again;

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਿ ॥੪॥੩੧॥੮੨॥
Transliteration: apanee kudarat jaanai aap |4|31|82|
English: He alone knows His All-powerful creative nature. ||4||31||82||

[Ang 390 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰਤਾ ਨਾ ਹਮ ਡਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: naa ohu marataa naa ham ddariaa |
English: He does not die, so I do not fear.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਨਾ ਹਮ ਕੜਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: naa ohu binasai naa ham karriaa |
English: He does not perish, so I do not grieve.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਨਿਰਧਨੁ ਨਾ ਹਮ ਭੂਖੇ ॥
Transliteration: naa ohu niradhan naa ham bhookhe |
English: He is not poor, so I do not hunger.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਓਸੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਦੂਖੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naa os dookh na ham kau dookhe |1|
English: He is not in pain, so I do not suffer. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਮਾਰਨਵਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: avar na koaoo maaranavaaraa |
English: There is no other Destroyer than Him.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅਉ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਜੀਉ ਦੇਨਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jeeo hamaaraa jeeo denahaaraa |1| rahaau |
English: He is my very life, the Giver of life. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਉਸੁ ਬੰਧਨ ਨਾ ਹਮ ਬਾਧੇ ॥
Transliteration: naa us bandhan naa ham baadhe |
English: He is not bound, so I am not in bondage.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਉਸੁ ਧੰਧਾ ਨਾ ਹਮ ਧਾਧੇ ॥
Transliteration: naa us dhandhaa naa ham dhaadhe |
English: He has no occupation, so I have no entanglements.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਉਸੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਮੈਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: naa us mail na ham kau mailaa |
English: He has no impurities, so I have no impurities.

Gurbani: ਓਸੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਤ ਹਮ ਸਦ ਕੇਲਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: os anand ta ham sad kelaa |2|
English: He is in ecstasy, so I am always happy. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਉਸੁ ਸੋਚੁ ਨ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਸੋਚਾ ॥
Transliteration: naa us soch na ham kau sochaa |
English: He has no anxiety, so I have no cares.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਉਸੁ ਲੇਪੁ ਨ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਪੋਚਾ ॥
Transliteration: naa us lep na ham kau pochaa |
English: He has no stain, so I have no pollution.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਉਸੁ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: naa us bhookh na ham kau trisanaa |
English: He has no hunger, so I have no thirst.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਉਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਤਾਂ ਹਮ ਜਚਨਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jaa uhu niramal taan ham jachanaa |3|
English: Since He is immaculately pure, I correspond to Him. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਏਕੈ ਓਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: ham kichh naahee ekai ohee |
English: I am nothing; He is the One and only.

Gurbani: ਆਗੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aagai paachhai eko soee |
English: Before and after, He alone exists.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਏ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੰਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: naanak gur khoe bhram bhangaa |
English: O Nanak, the Guru has taken away my doubts and mistakes;

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਓਇ ਮਿਲਿ ਹੋਏ ਇਕ ਰੰਗਾ ॥੪॥੩੨॥੮੩॥
Transliteration: ham oe mil hoe ik rangaa |4|32|83|
English: He and I, joining together, are of the same color. ||4||32||83||

[Ang 391 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: anik bhaant kar sevaa kareeai |
English: Serve Him in many different ways;

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਧਨੁ ਆਗੈ ਧਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: jeeo praan dhan aagai dhareeai |
English: Dedicate your soul, your breath of life and your wealth to Him.

Gurbani: ਪਾਨੀ ਪਖਾ ਕਰਉ ਤਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: paanee pakhaa krau taj abhimaan |
English: Carry water for Him, and wave the fan over Him - renounce your ego.

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਰ ਜਾਈਐ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: anik baar jaaeeai kurabaan |1|
English: Make yourself a sacrifice to Him, time and time again. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਾਈ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: saaee suhaagan jo prabh bhaaee |
English: She alone is the happy soul-bride, who is pleasing to God.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tis kai sang milau meree maaee |1| rahaau |
English: In her company, I may meet Him, O my mother. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੀ ਕੀ ਪਨਿਹਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: daasan daasee kee panihaar |
English: I am the water-carrier of the slaves of His slaves.

Gurbani: ਉਨੑ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਬਸੈ ਜੀਅ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: auna kee ren basai jeea naal |
English: I treasure in my soul the dust of their feet.

Gurbani: ਮਾਥੈ ਭਾਗੁ ਤ ਪਾਵਉ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: maathai bhaag ta paavau sang |
English: By that good destiny inscribed upon my forehead, I obtain their society.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: milai suaamee apunai rang |2|
English: Through His Love, the Lord Master meets me. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਦੇਵਉ ਸਭ ਨੇਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaap taap devau sabh nemaa |
English: I dedicate all to Him - chanting and meditation, austerity and religious observances.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਅਰਪਉ ਸਭ ਹੋਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: karam dharam arpau sabh homaa |
English: I offer all to Him - good actions, righteous conduct and incense burning.

Gurbani: ਗਰਬੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਤਜਿ ਹੋਵਉ ਰੇਨ ॥
Transliteration: garab mohu taj hovau ren |
English: Renouncing pride and attachment, I become the dust of the feet of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਦੇਖਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨੈਨ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: auna kai sang dekhau prabh nain |3|
English: In their society, I behold God with my eyes. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਏਹੀ ਆਰਾਧਉ ॥
Transliteration: nimakh nimakh ehee aaraadhau |
English: Each and every moment, I contemplate and adore Him.

Gurbani: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਏਹ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਾਧਉ ॥
Transliteration: dinas rain eeh sevaa saadhau |
English: Day and night, I serve Him like this.

Gurbani: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: bhe kripaal gupaal gobind |
English: The Lord of the Universe, the Cherisher of the World, has become merciful;

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸਿੰਦ ॥੪॥੩੩॥੮੪॥
Transliteration: saadhasang naanak bakhasind |4|33|84|
English: in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, He forgives us. ||4||33||84||

[Ang 391 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kee preet sadaa sukh hoe |
English: In the Love of God, eternal peace is obtained.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kee preet dukh lagai na koe |
English: In the Love of God, one is not touched by pain.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਖੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kee preet haumai mal khoe |
English: In the Love of God, the filth of ego is washed away.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਦ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: prabh kee preet sad niramal hoe |1|
English: In the Love of God, one becomes forever immaculate. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਮੀਤ ਐਸਾ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sunahu meet aisaa prem piaar |
English: Listen, O friend: show such love and affection to God,

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jeea praan ghatt ghatt aadhaar |1| rahaau |
English: the Support of the soul, the breath of life, of each and every heart. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਭਏ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kee preet bhe sagal nidhaan |
English: In the Love of God, all treasures are obtained.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kee preet ridai niramal naam |
English: In the Love of God, the Immaculate Naam fills the heart.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਦ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kee preet sad sobhaavant |
English: In the Love of God, one is eternally embellished.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਭ ਮਿਟੀ ਹੈ ਚਿੰਤ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: prabh kee preet sabh mittee hai chint |2|
English: In the Love of God, all anxiety is ended. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਇਹੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kee preet ihu bhavajal tarai |
English: In the Love of God, one crosses over this terrible world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਨਹੀ ਡਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kee preet jam te nahee ddarai |
English: In the Love of God, one does not fear death.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਗਲ ਉਧਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kee preet sagal udhaarai |
English: In the Love of God, all are saved.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਚਲੈ ਸੰਗਾਰੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: prabh kee preet chalai sangaarai |3|
English: The Love of God shall go along with you. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਪਹੁ ਕੋਈ ਮਿਲੈ ਨ ਭੂਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: aapahu koee milai na bhoolai |
English: By himself, no one is united, and no one goes astray.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਘੂਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: jis kripaal tis saadhasang ghoolai |
English: One who is blessed by God's Mercy, joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇਰੈ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak terai kurabaan |
English: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to You.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਓਟ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੩੪॥੮੫॥
Transliteration: sant ott prabh teraa taan |4|34|85|
English: O God, You are the Support and the Strength of the Saints. ||4||34||85||

[Ang 391 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਭੂਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bhoopat hoe kai raaj kamaaeaa |
English: Becoming a king, the mortal wields his royal authority;

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਅਨਰਥ ਵਿਹਾਝੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kar kar anarath vihaajhee maaeaa |
English: oppressing the people, he gathers wealth.

Gurbani: ਸੰਚਤ ਸੰਚਤ ਥੈਲੀ ਕੀਨੑੀ ॥
Transliteration: sanchat sanchat thailee keenaee |
English: Gathering it and collecting it, he fills his bags.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਉਸ ਤੇ ਡਾਰਿ ਅਵਰ ਕਉ ਦੀਨੑੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: prabh us te ddaar avar kau deenaee |1|
English: But God takes it away from him, and gives it to another. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਾਚ ਗਗਰੀਆ ਅੰਭ ਮਝਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: kaach gagareea anbh majhareea |
English: The mortal is like an unbaked clay pot in water;

Gurbani: ਗਰਬਿ ਗਰਬਿ ਉਆਹੂ ਮਹਿ ਪਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: garab garab uaahoo meh pareea |1| rahaau |
English: indulging in pride and egotism, he crumbles down and dissolves. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹੋਇਓ ਭਇਆ ਨਿਹੰਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: nirbhau hoeo bheaa nihangaa |
English: Being fearless, he becomes unrestrained.

Gurbani: ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੰਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: cheet na aaeo karataa sangaa |
English: He does not think of the Creator, who is ever with him.

Gurbani: ਲਸਕਰ ਜੋੜੇ ਕੀਆ ਸੰਬਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: lasakar jorre keea sanbaahaa |
English: He raises armies, and collects arms.

Gurbani: ਨਿਕਸਿਆ ਫੂਕ ਤ ਹੋਇ ਗਇਓ ਸੁਆਹਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: nikasiaa fook ta hoe geo suaahaa |2|
English: But when the breath leaves him, he turns to ashes. ||2||

Gurbani: ਊਚੇ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਲ ਅਰੁ ਰਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: aooche mandar mehal ar raanee |
English: He has lofty palaces, mansions and queens,

Gurbani: ਹਸਤਿ ਘੋੜੇ ਜੋੜੇ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: hasat ghorre jorre man bhaanee |
English: elephants and pairs of horses, delighting the mind;

Gurbani: ਵਡ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ਪੂਤ ਅਰੁ ਧੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: vadd paravaar poot ar dheea |
English: he is blessed with a great family of sons and daughters.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਪਚੇ ਪਚਿ ਅੰਧਾ ਮੂਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: mohi pache pach andhaa mooaa |3|
English: But, engrossed in attachment, the blind fool wastes away to death. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਹਿ ਉਪਾਹਾ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਬਿਨਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: jineh upaahaa tineh binaahaa |
English: The One who created him destroys him.

Gurbani: ਰੰਗ ਰਸਾ ਜੈਸੇ ਸੁਪਨਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: rang rasaa jaise supanaahaa |
English: Enjoyments and pleasures are like just a dream.

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਰਾਜੁ ਮਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: soee mukataa tis raaj maal |
English: He alone is liberated, and possesses regal power and wealth,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਜਿਸੁ ਖਸਮੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ॥੪॥੩੫॥੮੬॥
Transliteration: naanak daas jis khasam deaal |4|35|86|
English: O Nanak, whom the Lord Master blesses with His Mercy. ||4||35||86||

[Ang 392 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਇਨੑ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਘਨੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: eina siau preet karee ghaneree |
English: The mortal is in love with this,

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਤਉ ਵਧੈ ਵਧੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jau mileeai tau vadhai vadheree |
English: but the more he has, the more he longs for more.

Gurbani: ਗਲਿ ਚਮੜੀ ਜਉ ਛੋਡੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: gal chamarree jau chhoddai naahee |
English: It hangs around his neck, and does not leave him.

Gurbani: ਲਾਗਿ ਛੁਟੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: laag chhutto satigur kee paaee |1|
English: But falling at the feet of the True Guru, he is saved. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਗ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਹਮ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jag mohanee ham tiaag gavaaee |
English: I have renounced and discarded Maya, the Enticer of the world.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਗੁਨੁ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਵਜੀ ਵਧਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: niragun milio vajee vadhaaee |1| rahaau |
English: I have met the Absolute Lord, and congratulations are pouring in. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਐਸੀ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਮੋਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: aisee sundar man kau mohai |
English: She is so beautiful, she captivates the mind.

Gurbani: ਬਾਟਿ ਘਾਟਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਬਨਿ ਬਨਿ ਜੋਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: baatt ghaatt grihi ban ban johai |
English: On the road, and the beach, at home, in the forest and in the wilderness, she touches us.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਮੀਠੀ ॥
Transliteration: man tan laagai hoe kai meetthee |
English: She seems so sweet to the mind and body.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮੈ ਖੋਟੀ ਡੀਠੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad mai khottee ddeetthee |2|
English: But by Guru's Grace, I have seen her to be deceptive. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਗਰਕ ਉਸ ਕੇ ਵਡੇ ਠਗਾਊ ॥
Transliteration: agarak us ke vadde tthagaaoo |
English: Her courtiers are also great deceivers.

Gurbani: ਛੋਡਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਾਪ ਨ ਮਾਊ ॥
Transliteration: chhoddeh naahee baap na maaoo |
English: They do not spare even their fathers or mothers.

Gurbani: ਮੇਲੀ ਅਪਨੇ ਉਨਿ ਲੇ ਬਾਂਧੇ ॥
Transliteration: melee apane un le baandhe |
English: They have enslaved their companions.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਮੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਸਾਧੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur kirapaa te mai sagale saadhe |3|
English: By Guru's Grace, I have subjugated them all. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਮੋਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਇਆ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: ab morai man bheaa anand |
English: Now, my mind is filled with bliss;

Gurbani: ਭਉ ਚੂਕਾ ਟੂਟੇ ਸਭਿ ਫੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: bhau chookaa ttootte sabh fand |
English: my fear is gone, and the noose is cut away.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak jaa satigur paaeaa |
English: Says Nanak, when I met the True Guru,

Gurbani: ਘਰੁ ਸਗਲਾ ਮੈ ਸੁਖੀ ਬਸਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੩੬॥੮੭॥
Transliteration: ghar sagalaa mai sukhee basaaeaa |4|36|87|
English: I came to dwell within my home in absolute peace. ||4||36||87||

[Ang 392 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar nikatt kar jaanai |
English: Twenty-four hours a day, he knows the Lord to be near at hand;

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਮੀਠਾ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kaa keea meetthaa maanai |
English: he surrenders to the Sweet Will of God.

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: ek naam santan aadhaar |
English: The One Name is the Support of the Saints;

Gurbani: ਹੋਇ ਰਹੇ ਸਭ ਕੀ ਪਗ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: hoe rahe sabh kee pag chhaar |1|
English: they remain the dust of the feet of all. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਰਹਤ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sant rehat sunahu mere bhaaee |
English: Listen, to the way of life of the Saints, O my Siblings of Destiny;

Gurbani: ਉਆ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: auaa kee mahimaa kathan na jaaee |1| rahaau |
English: their praises cannot be described. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਵਰਤਣਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: varatan jaa kai keval naam |
English: Their occupation is the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦ ਰੂਪ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: anad roop keeratan bisraam |
English: The Kirtan, the Praise of the Lord, the embodiment of bliss, is their rest.

Gurbani: ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: mitr satru jaa kai ek samaanai |
English: Friends and enemies are one and the same to them.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: prabh apune bin avar na jaanai |2|
English: They know of no other than God. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਘ ਕਾਟਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kott kott agh kaattanahaaraa |
English: They erase millions upon millions of sins.

Gurbani: ਦੁਖ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਨ ਜੀਅ ਕੇ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: dukh door karan jeea ke daataaraa |
English: They dispel suffering; they are givers of the life of the soul.

Gurbani: ਸੂਰਬੀਰ ਬਚਨ ਕੇ ਬਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: soorabeer bachan ke balee |
English: They are so brave; they are men of their word.

Gurbani: ਕਉਲਾ ਬਪੁਰੀ ਸੰਤੀ ਛਲੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kaulaa bapuree santee chhalee |3|
English: The Saints have enticed Maya herself. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਬਾਛਹਿ ਸੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: taa kaa sang baachheh suradev |
English: Their company is cherished even by the gods and the angels.

Gurbani: ਅਮੋਘ ਦਰਸੁ ਸਫਲ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: amogh daras safal jaa kee sev |
English: Blessed is their Darshan, and fruitful is their service.

Gurbani: ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਰੇ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: kar jorr naanak kare aradaas |
English: With his palms pressed together, Nanak offers his prayer:

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਸੰਤਹ ਟਹਲ ਦੀਜੈ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੩੭॥੮੮॥
Transliteration: mohi santah ttehal deejai gunataas |4|37|88|
English: O Lord, Treasure of Excellence, please bless me with the service of the Saints. ||4||37||88||

[Ang 392 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਸੂਖ ਜਪਿ ਏਕੈ ਨਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sagal sookh jap ekai naam |
English: All peace and comforts are in the meditation of the One Name.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਧਰਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sagal dharam har ke gun gaam |
English: All righteous actions of Dharma are in the singing of the Lord's Glorious Praises.

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਾਧ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: mahaa pavitr saadh kaa sang |
English: The Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is so very pure and sacred.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਲਾਗੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰੰਗੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jis bhettat laagai prabh rang |1|
English: Meeting with them, love for God is embraced. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਓਇ ਆਨੰਦ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad oe aanand paavai |
English: By Guru's Grace, bliss is obtained.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jis simarat man hoe pragaasaa taa kee gat mit kehan na jaavai |1| rahaau |
English: Meditating upon Him in remembrance, the mind is illumined; his state and condition cannot be described. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਵਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਮਜਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: varat nem majan tis poojaa |
English: Fasts, religious vows, cleansing baths, and worship to Him;

Gurbani: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸੁਨੀਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: bed puraan tin sinmrit suneejaa |
English: listening to the Vedas, Puraanas, and Shaastras.

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: mahaa puneet jaa kaa niramal thaan |
English: Extremely pure is he, and immaculate is his place,

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saadhasangat jaa kai har har naam |2|
English: who meditates upon the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in the Saadh Sangat. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਓ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸਗਲੇ ਭਵਨ ॥
Transliteration: pragattio so jan sagale bhavan |
English: That humble being becomes renowned all over the world.

Gurbani: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਪਗ ਰੇਨ ॥
Transliteration: patit puneet taa kee pag ren |
English: Even sinners are purified, by the dust of his feet.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kau bhettio har har raae |
English: One who has met the Lord, the Lord our King,

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: taa kee gat mit kathan na jaae |3|
English: his condition and state cannot be described. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar kar jorr dhiaavau |
English: Twenty-four hours a day, with palms pressed together, I meditate;

Gurbani: ਉਨ ਸਾਧਾ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: aun saadhaa kaa darasan paavau |
English: I yearn to obtain the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of those Holy Saints.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਗਰੀਬ ਕਉ ਲੇਹੁ ਰਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: mohi gareeb kau lehu ralaae |
English: Merge me, the poor one, with You, O Lord;

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਇ ਪਏ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥੪॥੩੮॥੮੯॥
Transliteration: naanak aae pe saranaae |4|38|89|
English: Nanak has come to Your Sanctuary. ||4||38||89||

[Ang 393 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਉਦਕ ਇਸਨਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar udak isanaanee |
English: Twenty-four hours a day, he takes his cleansing bath in water;

Gurbani: ਸਦ ਹੀ ਭੋਗੁ ਲਗਾਇ ਸੁਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: sad hee bhog lagaae sugiaanee |
English: he makes continual offerings to the Lord; he is a true man of wisdom.

Gurbani: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕਾਹੂ ਛੋਡੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: birathaa kaahoo chhoddai naahee |
English: He never leaves anything uselessly.

Gurbani: ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਾਗਹ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bahur bahur tis laagah paaee |1|
English: Again and again, he falls at the Lord's Feet. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਾਲਗਿਰਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: saalagiraam hamaarai sevaa |
English: Such is the Saalagraam, the stone idol, which I serve;

Gurbani: ਪੂਜਾ ਅਰਚਾ ਬੰਦਨ ਦੇਵਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: poojaa arachaa bandan devaa |1| rahaau |
English: such is my worship, flower-offerings and divine adoration as well. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਘੰਟਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਟ ॥
Transliteration: ghanttaa jaa kaa suneeai chahu kuntt |
English: His bell resounds to the four corners of the world.

Gurbani: ਆਸਨੁ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਸਦਾ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ॥
Transliteration: aasan jaa kaa sadaa baikuntth |
English: His seat is forever in heaven.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਚਵਰੁ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਝੂਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kaa chavar sabh aoopar jhoolai |
English: His chauri, his fly-brush, waves over all.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਧੂਪੁ ਸਦਾ ਪਰਫੁਲੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: taa kaa dhoop sadaa parafulai |2|
English: His incense is ever-fragrant. ||2||

Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸੰਪਟੁ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਜਾ ਕਾ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt sanpatt hai re jaa kaa |
English: He is treasured in each and every heart.

Gurbani: ਅਭਗ ਸਭਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੈ ਸਾਧਾ ॥
Transliteration: abhag sabhaa sang hai saadhaa |
English: The Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is His Eternal Court.

Gurbani: ਆਰਤੀ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: aaratee keeratan sadaa anand |
English: His Aartee, his lamp-lit worship service, is the Kirtan of His Praises, which brings lasting bliss.

Gurbani: ਮਹਿਮਾ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸਦਾ ਬੇਅੰਤ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: mahimaa sundar sadaa beant |3|
English: His Greatness is so beautiful, and ever limitless. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਲਹਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jiseh paraapat tis hee lahanaa |
English: He alone obtains it, who is so pre-ordained;

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਚਰਨ ਓਹੁ ਆਇਓ ਸਰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: sant charan ohu aaeo saranaa |
English: he takes to the Sanctuary of the Saints' Feet.

Gurbani: ਹਾਥਿ ਚੜਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਲਗਿਰਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: haath charrio har saalagiraam |
English: I hold in my hands the Saalagraam of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੋ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੪॥੩੯॥੯੦॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak gur keeno daan |4|39|90|
English: Says Nanak, the Guru has given me this Gift. ||4||39||90||

[Ang 393 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਪੰਚਪਦਾ₁ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 panchapadaa₁ |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Panch-Pada:

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਪੈਡੈ ਲੂਟੀ ਪਨਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jih paiddai loottee panihaaree |
English: That highway, upon which the water-carrier is plundered

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਦੂਰਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: so maarag santan dooraaree |1|
English: - that way is far removed from the Saints. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: satigur poorai saach kahiaa |
English: The True Guru has spoken the Truth.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਬੀਥੀ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: naam tere kee mukate beethee jam kaa maarag door rahiaa |1| rahaau |
English: Your Name, O Lord, is the Way to Salvation; the road of the Messenger of Death is far away. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਲਾਲਚ ਜਾਗਾਤੀ ਘਾਟ ॥
Transliteration: jeh laalach jaagaatee ghaatt |
English: That place, where the greedy toll-collector dwells

Gurbani: ਦੂਰਿ ਰਹੀ ਉਹ ਜਨ ਤੇ ਬਾਟ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: door rahee uh jan te baatt |2|
English: - that path remains far removed from the Lord's humble servant. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਆਵਟੇ ਬਹੁਤ ਘਨ ਸਾਥ ॥
Transliteration: jeh aavatte bahut ghan saath |
English: There, where so very many caravans of men are caught,

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੇ ਸੰਗੀ ਸਾਧ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: paarabraham ke sangee saadh |3|
English: the Holy Saints remain with the Supreme Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਸਭ ਲਿਖਤੇ ਲੇਖਾ ॥
Transliteration: chitr gupat sabh likhate lekhaa |
English: Chitra and Gupat, the recording angels of the conscious and the unconscious, write the accounts of all mortal beings,

Gurbani: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨ ਪੇਖਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: bhagat janaa kau drisatt na pekhaa |4|
English: but they cannot even see the Lord's humble devotees. ||4||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak jis satigur pooraa |
English: Says Nanak, one whose True Guru is Perfect

Gurbani: ਵਾਜੇ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਅਨਹਦ ਤੂਰਾ ॥੫॥੪੦॥੯੧॥
Transliteration: vaaje taa kai anahad tooraa |5|40|91|
English: - the unblown bugles of ecstasy vibrate for him. ||5||40||91||

[Ang 393 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਪਦਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 dupadaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Du-Pada 1:

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਿਖਾਇਓ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: saadhoo sang sikhaaeo naam |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Naam is learned;

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sarab manorath pooran kaam |
English: all desires and tasks are fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਬੁਝਿ ਗਈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸਹਿ ਅਘਾਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: bujh gee trisanaa har jaseh aghaane |
English: My thirst has been quenched, and I am satiated with the Lord's Praise.

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਸਾਰਿਗਪਾਨੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jap jap jeevaa saarigapaane |1|
English: I live by chanting and meditating upon the Lord, the Sustainer of the earth. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: karan karaavan saran pariaa |
English: I have entered the Sanctuary of the Creator, the Cause of all causes.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਸਹਜ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਚੰਦੁ ਚੜਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaad sehaj ghar paaeaa mittiaa andheraa chand charriaa |1| rahaau |
English: By Guru's Grace, I have entered the home of celestial bliss. Darkness is dispelled, and the moon of wisdom has risen. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਲਾਲ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: laal javehar bhare bhanddaar |
English: My treasure-house is overflowing with rubies and jewels;

Gurbani: ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: tott na aavai jap nirankaar |
English: I meditate on the Formless Lord, and so they never run short.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਬਦੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: amrit sabad peevai jan koe |
English: How rare is that humble being, who drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥੪੧॥੯੨॥
Transliteration: naanak taa kee param gat hoe |2|41|92|
English: O Nanak, he attains the state of highest dignity. ||2||41||92||

[Ang 394 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੭ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa ghar 7 mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Seventh House, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam ridai nit dhiaaee |
English: Meditate continually on the Name of the Lord within your heart.

Gurbani: ਸੰਗੀ ਸਾਥੀ ਸਗਲ ਤਰਾਂਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sangee saathee sagal taraanee |1|
English: Thus you shall save all your companions and associates. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur merai sang sadaa hai naale |
English: My Guru is always with me, near at hand.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: simar simar tis sadaa samaale |1| rahaau |
English: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on Him, I cherish Him forever. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਆ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: teraa keea meetthaa laagai |
English: Your actions seem so sweet to me.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਾਂਗੈ ॥੨॥੪੨॥੯੩॥
Transliteration: har naam padaarath naanak maangai |2|42|93|
English: Nanak begs for the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||42||93||

[Ang 394 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਤਰਿਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: saadhoo sangat tariaa sansaar |
English: The world is saved by the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam maneh aadhaar |1|
English: The Name of the Lord is the Support of the mind. ||1||

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal guradev piaare |
English: The Saints worship and adore the Lotus Feet of the Divine Guru;

Gurbani: ਪੂਜਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: poojeh sant har preet piaare |1| rahaau |
English: they love the Beloved Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਭਾਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai masatak likhiaa bhaag |
English: She who has such good destiny written upon her forehead,

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ॥੨॥੪੩॥੯੪॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak taa kaa thir sohaag |2|43|94|
English: says Nanak, is blessed with the eternal happy marriage with the Lord. ||2||43||94||

[Ang 394 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੀਠੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਪਿਰ ਕੀ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: meetthee aagiaa pir kee laagee |
English: The Order of my Husband Lord seems so sweet to me.

Gurbani: ਸਉਕਨਿ ਘਰ ਕੀ ਕੰਤਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: saukan ghar kee kant tiaagee |
English: My Husband Lord has driven out the one who was my rival.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੋਹਾਗਨਿ ਸੀਗਾਰਿ ਕਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: pria sohaagan seegaar karee |
English: My Beloved Husband has decorated me, His happy soul-bride.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਤਪਤਿ ਹਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: man mere kee tapat haree |1|
English: He has quieted the burning thirst of my mind. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਲੋ ਭਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਕਹਿਆ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: bhalo bheo pria kahiaa maaniaa |
English: It is good that I submitted to the Will of my Beloved Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੂਖੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਇਸੁ ਘਰ ਕਾ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sookh sehaj is ghar kaa jaaniaa | rahaau |
English: I have realized celestial peace and poise within this home of mine. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਬੰਦੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਖਿਜਮਤਦਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: hau bandee pria khijamatadaar |
English: I am the hand-maiden, the attendant of my Beloved Lord.

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: ohu abinaasee agam apaar |
English: He is eternal and imperishable, inaccessible and infinite.

Gurbani: ਲੇ ਪਖਾ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਝਲਉ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: le pakhaa pria jhlau paae |
English: Holding the fan, sitting at His Feet, I wave it over my Beloved.

Gurbani: ਭਾਗਿ ਗਏ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਲਾਵੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bhaag ge panch doot laave |2|
English: The five demons who tortured me have run away. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਮੈ ਕੁਲੁ ਨਾ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: naa mai kul naa sobhaavant |
English: I am not from a noble family, and I am not beautiful.

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਜਾਨਾ ਕਿਉ ਭਾਨੀ ਕੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa jaanaa kiau bhaanee kant |
English: What do I know? Why am I pleasing to my Beloved?

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਅਨਾਥ ਗਰੀਬ ਨਿਮਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: mohi anaath gareeb nimaanee |
English: I am a poor orphan, destitute and dishonored.

Gurbani: ਕੰਤ ਪਕਰਿ ਹਮ ਕੀਨੀ ਰਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kant pakar ham keenee raanee |3|
English: My Husband took me in, and made me His queen. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: jab mukh preetam saajan laagaa |
English: When I saw my Beloved's face before me,

Gurbani: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਮੇਰਾ ਧਨੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: sookh sehaj meraa dhan sohaagaa |
English: I became so happy and peaceful; my married life was blessed.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੋਰੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak moree pooran aasaa |
English: Says Nanak, my desires are fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੇਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੯੫॥
Transliteration: satigur melee prabh gunataasaa |4|1|95|
English: The True Guru has united me with God, the treasure of excellence. ||4||1||95||

[Ang 394 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਾਥੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਰੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: maathai trikuttee drisatt karoor |
English: A frown creases her forehead, and her look is evil.

Gurbani: ਬੋਲੈ ਕਉੜਾ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਕੀ ਫੂੜਿ ॥
Transliteration: bolai kaurraa jihabaa kee foorr |
English: Her speech is bitter, and her tongue is rude.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਭੂਖੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਦੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sadaa bhookhee pir jaanai door |1|
English: She is always hungry, and she believes her Husband to be far away. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸੀ ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਇਕ ਰਾਮਿ ਉਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aisee isatree ik raam upaaee |
English: Such is Maya, the woman, which the One Lord has created.

Gurbani: ਉਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਖਾਇਆ ਹਮ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aun sabh jag khaaeaa ham gur raakhe mere bhaaee | rahaau |
English: She is devouring the whole world, but the Guru has saved me, O my Siblings of Destiny. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪਾਇ ਠਗਉਲੀ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਜੋਹਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: paae tthgaulee sabh jag johiaa |
English: Administering her poisons, she has overcome the whole world.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹਾਦੇਉ ਮੋਹਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: brahamaa bisan mahaadeo mohiaa |
English: She has bewitched Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗੇ ਸੇ ਸੋਹਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: guramukh naam lage se sohiaa |2|
English: Only those Gurmukhs who are attuned to the Naam are blessed. ||2||

Gurbani: ਵਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਪੁਨਹਚਰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: varat nem kar thaake punahacharanaa |
English: Performing fasts, religious observances and atonements, the mortals have grown weary.

Gurbani: ਤਟ ਤੀਰਥ ਭਵੇ ਸਭ ਧਰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: tatt teerath bhave sabh dharanaa |
English: They wander over the entire planet, on pilgrimages to the banks of sacred rivers.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: se ubare ji satigur kee saranaa |3|
English: But they alone are saved, who seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਭੋ ਜਗੁ ਬਾਧਾ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohi sabho jag baadhaa |
English: Attached to Maya, the whole world is in bondage.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਪਚੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂਰਾਖਾ ॥
Transliteration: haumai pachai manamukh mooraakhaa |
English: The foolish self-willed manmukhs are consumed by their egotism.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਹ ਪਕਰਿ ਹਮ ਰਾਖਾ ॥੪॥੨॥੯੬॥
Transliteration: gur naanak baah pakar ham raakhaa |4|2|96|
English: Taking me by the arm, Guru Nanak has saved me. ||4||2||96||

[Ang 394 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਦੂਖ ਜਬ ਬਿਸਰਹਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: sarab dookh jab bisareh suaamee |
English: Everything is painful, when one forgets the Lord Master.

Gurbani: ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: eehaa aoohaa kaam na praanee |1|
English: Here and hereafter, such a mortal is useless. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧੵਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sant tripataase har har dhayaae |
English: The Saints are satisfied, meditating on the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਨਾਇ ਲਾਏ ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਰਜਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa apunai naae laae sarab sookh prabh tumaree rajaae | rahaau |
English: Bestowing Your Mercy, God, You attach us to Your Name; all peace comes by Your Will. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੰਗਿ ਹੋਵਤ ਕਉ ਜਾਨਤ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: sang hovat kau jaanat door |
English: The Lord is Ever-present; one who deems Him to be far away,

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਮਰਤਾ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਝੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: so jan marataa nit nit jhoor |2|
English: Dies again and again, repenting. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੀਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jin sabh kichh deea tis chitavat naeh |
English: The mortals do not remember the One, who has given them everything.

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: mahaa bikhiaa meh din rain jaeh |3|
English: Engrossed in such terrible corruption, their days and nights waste away. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਏਕ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak prabh simarahu ek |
English: Says Nanak, meditate in remembrance of the One Lord God.

Gurbani: ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਟੇਕ ॥੪॥੩॥੯੭॥
Transliteration: gat paaeeai gur poore ttek |4|3|97|
English: Salvation is obtained, in the Shelter of the Perfect Guru. ||4||3||97||

[Ang 395 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: naam japat man tan sabh hariaa |
English: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind and body are totally rejuvenated.

Gurbani: ਕਲਮਲ ਦੋਖ ਸਗਲ ਪਰਹਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kalamal dokh sagal parahariaa |1|
English: All sins and sorrows are washed away. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਦਿਵਸੁ ਭਲਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: soee divas bhalaa mere bhaaee |
English: How blessed is that day, O my Siblings of Destiny,

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har gun gaae param gat paaee | rahaau |
English: when the Glorious Praises of the Lord are sung, and the supreme status is obtained. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਜੇ ਪੈਰ ॥
Transliteration: saadh janaa ke pooje pair |
English: Worshipping the feet of the Holy Saints,

Gurbani: ਮਿਟੇ ਉਪਦ੍ਰਹ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਬੈਰ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mitte upadrah man te bair |2|
English: troubles and hatred are eliminated from the mind. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਝਗਰੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur poore mil jhagar chukaaeaa |
English: Meeting with the Perfect Guru, conflict is ended,

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਸਭਿ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: panch doot sabh vasagat aaeaa |3|
English: and the five demons are totally subdued. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: jis man vasiaa har kaa naam |
English: One whose mind is filled with the Name of the Lord,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਊਪਰਿ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ॥੪॥੪॥੯੮॥
Transliteration: naanak tis aoopar kurabaan |4|4|98|
English: O Nanak - I am a sacrifice to him. ||4||4||98||

[Ang 395 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਿ ਲੇਹਿ ਤੂ ਗਾਵਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gaav lehi too gaavanahaare |
English: O singer, sing of the One,

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਪਿੰਡ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jeea pindd ke praan adhaare |
English: who is the Support of the soul, the body and the breath of life.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kee sevaa sarab sukh paaveh |
English: Serving Him, all peace is obtained.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰ ਕਾਹੂ ਪਹਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਜਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: avar kaahoo peh bahurr na jaaveh |1|
English: You shall no longer go to any other. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਅਨੰਦੀ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਗੁਨ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਜਾਪੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa anand anandee saahib gun nidhaan nit nit jaapeeai |
English: My Blissful Lord Master is forever in bliss; meditate continually and forever, on the Lord, the treasure of excellence.

Gurbani: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਾਸੀਐ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: balihaaree tis sant piaare jis prasaad prabh man vaaseeai | rahaau |
English: I am a sacrifice to the Beloved Saints; by their kind favor, God comes to dwell in the mind. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਨੁ ਨਿਖੂਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kaa daan nikhoottai naahee |
English: His gifts are never exhausted.

Gurbani: ਭਲੀ ਭਾਤਿ ਸਭ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: bhalee bhaat sabh sehaj samaahee |
English: In His subtle way, He easily absorbs all.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬਖਸ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kee bakhas na mettai koee |
English: His benevolence cannot be erased.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਵਾਸਾਈਐ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: man vaasaaeeai saachaa soee |2|
English: So enshrine that True Lord within your mind. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਪੂਰਨ ॥
Transliteration: sagal samagree grih jaa kai pooran |
English: His house is filled with all sorts of articles;

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਦੂਖ ਨ ਝੂਰਨ ॥
Transliteration: prabh ke sevak dookh na jhooran |
English: God's servants never suffer pain.

Gurbani: ਓਟਿ ਗਹੀ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: ott gahee nirbhau pad paaeeai |
English: Holding to His Support, the state of fearless dignity is obtained.

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸੋ ਗੁਨ ਨਿਧਿ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: saas saas so gun nidh gaaeeai |3|
English: With each and every breath, sing of the Lord, the treasure of excellence. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਕਤਹੂ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: door na hoee katahoo jaaeeai |
English: He is not far from us, wherever we go.

Gurbani: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: nadar kare taa har har paaeeai |
English: When He shows His Mercy, we obtain the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਕਰੀ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: aradaas karee poore gur paas |
English: I offer this prayer to the Perfect Guru.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੫॥੯੯॥
Transliteration: naanak mangai har dhan raas |4|5|99|
English: Nanak begs for the treasure of the Lord's Name. ||4||5||99||

[Ang 395 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਥਮੇ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਤਨ ਕਾ ਦੂਖ ॥
Transliteration: prathame mittiaa tan kaa dookh |
English: First, the pains of the body vanish;

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਸਗਲ ਕਉ ਹੋਆ ਸੂਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: man sagal kau hoaa sookh |
English: then, the mind becomes totally peaceful.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰ ਦੀਨੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa gur deeno naau |
English: In His Mercy, the Guru bestows the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bal bal tis satigur kau jaau |1|
English: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to that True Guru. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਓ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur pooraa paaeo mere bhaaee |
English: I have obtained the Perfect Guru, O my Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਸਭ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: rog sog sabh dookh binaase satigur kee saranaaee | rahaau |
English: All illness, sorrows and sufferings are dispelled, in the Sanctuary of the True Guru. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur ke charan hiradai vasaae |
English: The feet of the Guru abide within my heart;

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਤਤ ਸਗਲੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: man chintat sagale fal paae |
English: I have received all the fruits of my heart's desires.

Gurbani: ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਸਭ ਹੋਈ ਸਾਂਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: agan bujhee sabh hoee saant |
English: The fire is extinguished, and I am totally peaceful.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa gur keenee daat |2|
English: Showering His Mercy, the Guru has given this gift. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੋ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: nithaave kau gur deeno thaan |
English: The Guru has given shelter to the shelterless.

Gurbani: ਨਿਮਾਨੇ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੋ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: nimaane kau gur keeno maan |
English: The Guru has given honor to the dishonored.

Gurbani: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
Transliteration: bandhan kaatt sevak kar raakhe |
English: Shattering his bonds, the Guru has saved His servant.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਨੀ ਰਸਨਾ ਚਾਖੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: amrit baanee rasanaa chaakhe |3|
English: I taste with my tongue the Ambrosial Bani of His Word. ||3||

Gurbani: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਪੂਜ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: vaddai bhaag pooj gur charanaa |
English: By great good fortune, I worship the Guru's feet.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਪਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: sagal tiaag paaee prabh saranaa |
English: Forsaking everything, I have obtained God's Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਇਆ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur naanak jaa kau bheaa deaalaa |
English: That humble being, O Nanak, unto whom the Guru grants His Mercy,

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੦੦॥
Transliteration: so jan hoaa sadaa nihaalaa |4|6|100|
English: Is forever enraptured. ||4||6||100||

[Ang 396 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਚੈ ਦੀਆ ਭੇਜਿ ॥
Transliteration: satigur saachai deea bhej |
English: The True Guru has truly given a child.

Gurbani: ਚਿਰੁ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਸੰਜੋਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: chir jeevan upajiaa sanjog |
English: The long-lived one has been born to this destiny.

Gurbani: ਉਦਰੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਆਇ ਕੀਆ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: audarai maeh aae keea nivaas |
English: He came to acquire a home in the womb,

Gurbani: ਮਾਤਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਿਗਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: maataa kai man bahut bigaas |1|
English: and his mother's heart is so very glad. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੰਮਿਆ ਪੂਤੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕਾ ॥
Transliteration: jamiaa poot bhagat govind kaa |
English: A son is born - a devotee of the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਆ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰ ਕਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: pragattiaa sabh meh likhiaa dhur kaa | rahaau |
English: This pre-ordained destiny has been revealed to all. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦਸੀ ਮਾਸੀ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਬਾਲਕ ਜਨਮੁ ਲੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: dasee maasee hukam baalak janam leea |
English: In the tenth month, by the Lord's Order, the baby has been born.

Gurbani: ਮਿਟਿਆ ਸੋਗੁ ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਥੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: mittiaa sog mahaa anand theea |
English: Sorrow is dispelled, and great joy has ensued.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਸਖੀ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: gurabaanee sakhee anand gaavai |
English: The companions blissfully sing the songs of the Guru's Bani.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saache saahib kai man bhaavai |2|
English: This is pleasing to the Lord Master. ||2||

Gurbani: ਵਧੀ ਵੇਲਿ ਬਹੁ ਪੀੜੀ ਚਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: vadhee vel bahu peerree chaalee |
English: The vine has grown, and shall last for many generations.

Gurbani: ਧਰਮ ਕਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਬਹਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: dharam kalaa har bandh bahaalee |
English: The Power of the Dharma has been firmly established by the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: man chindiaa satiguroo divaaeaa |
English: That which my mind wishes for, the True Guru has granted.

Gurbani: ਭਏ ਅਚਿੰਤ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bhe achint ek liv laaeaa |3|
English: I have become carefree, and I fix my attention on the One Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਬਾਲਕੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: jiau baalak pitaa aoopar kare bahu maan |
English: As the child places so much faith in his father,

Gurbani: ਬੁਲਾਇਆ ਬੋਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣਿ ॥
Transliteration: bulaaeaa bolai gur kai bhaan |
English: I speak as it pleases the Guru to have me speak.

Gurbani: ਗੁਝੀ ਛੰਨੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਾਤ ॥
Transliteration: gujhee chhanee naahee baat |
English: This is not a hidden secret;

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਕੀਨੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੦੧॥
Transliteration: gur naanak tutthaa keenee daat |4|7|101|
English: Guru Nanak, greatly pleased, has bestowed this gift. ||4||7||101||

[Ang 396 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਦੇ ਹਾਥ ॥
Transliteration: gur poore raakhiaa de haath |
English: Giving His Hand, the Perfect Guru has protected the child.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਭਇਆ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: pragatt bheaa jan kaa parataap |1|
English: The glory of His servant has become manifest. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਜਪੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur gur japee guroo gur dhiaaee |
English: I contemplate the Guru, the Guru; I meditate on the Guru, the Guru.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਹਿ ਪਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jeea kee aradaas guroo peh paaee | rahaau |
English: I offer my heart-felt prayer to the Guru, and it is answered. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੇ ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: saran pare saache guradev |
English: I have taken to the Sanctuary of the True Divine Guru.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਵ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: pooran hoee sevak sev |2|
English: The service of His servant has been fulfilled. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: jeeo pindd joban raakhai praan |
English: He has preserved my soul, body, youth and breath of life.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ॥੩॥੮॥੧੦੨॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak gur kau kurabaan |3|8|102|
English: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Guru. ||3||8||102||

[Ang 396 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੮ ਕਾਫੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa ghar 8 kaafee mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Eighth House, Kaafee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਬੰਦਾ ਬੈ ਖਰੀਦੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: mai bandaa bai khareed sach saahib meraa |
English: I am Your purchased slave, O True Lord Master.

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੈ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jeeo pindd sabh tis daa sabh kichh hai teraa |1|
English: My soul and body, and all of this, everything is Yours. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੇ ਤੂੰ ਧਣੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: maan nimaane toon dhanee teraa bharavaasaa |
English: You are the honor of the dishonored. O Master, in You I place my trust.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਅਨ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਸੋ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਕਾਚਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bin saache an ttek hai so jaanahu kaachaa |1| rahaau |
English: Without the True One, any other support is false - know this well. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਅਪਾਰ ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: teraa hukam apaar hai koee ant na paae |
English: Your Command is infinite; no one can find its limit.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਸੀ ਸੋ ਚਲੈ ਰਜਾਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jis gur pooraa bhettasee so chalai rajaae |2|
English: One who meets with the Perfect Guru, walks in the Way of the Lord's Will. ||2||

Gurbani: ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਕਿਤੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: chaturaaee siaanapaa kitai kaam na aaeeai |
English: Cunning and cleverness are of no use.

Gurbani: ਤੁਠਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਜੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tutthaa saahib jo devai soee sukh paaeeai |3|
English: That which the Lord Master gives, by the Pleasure of His Will - that is pleasing to me. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਲਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਈਅਹਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਵੈ ਨ ਬੰਧਾ ॥
Transliteration: je lakh karam kamaaeeeh kichh pavai na bandhaa |
English: One may perform tens of thousands of actions, but attachment to things is not satisfied.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਰ ਹੋਰੁ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਧੰਧਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੦੩॥
Transliteration: jan naanak keetaa naam dhar hor chhoddiaa dhandhaa |4|1|103|
English: Servant Nanak has made the Naam his Support. He has renounced other entanglements. ||4||1||103||

[Ang 396 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਮੈ ਭਾਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: sarab sukhaa mai bhaaliaa har jevadd na koee |
English: I have pursued all pleasures, but none is as great as the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਤੁਠੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur tutthe te paaeeai sach saahib soee |1|
English: By the Pleasure of the Guru's Will, the True Lord Master is obtained. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਸਦ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: balihaaree gur aapane sad sad kurabaanaa |
English: I am a sacrifice to my Guru; I am forever and ever a sacrifice to Him.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਰਉ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਚਸਾ ਇਹੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਦਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: naam na visrau ik khin chasaa ihu keejai daanaa |1| rahaau |
English: Please, grant me this one blessing, that I may never, even for an instant, forget Your Name. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਭਾਗਠੁ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: bhaagatth sachaa soe hai jis har dhan antar |
English: How very fortunate are those who have the wealth of the Lord deep within the heart.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਛੂਟੈ ਮਹਾ ਜਾਲ ਤੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: so chhoottai mahaa jaal te jis gurasabad nirantar |2|
English: They escape from the great noose of death; they are permeated with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਸਤ ਸਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur kee mahimaa kiaa kahaa gur bibek sat sar |
English: How can I chant the Glorious Praises of the Guru? The Guru is the ocean of Truth and clear understanding.

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ohu aad jugaadee jugah jug pooraa paramesar |3|
English: He is the Perfect Transcendent Lord, from the very beginning, and throughout the ages. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: naam dhiaavahu sad sadaa har har man range |
English: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, forever and ever, my mind is filled with the Love of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਧਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੈ ਸੰਗੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੦੪॥
Transliteration: jeeo praan dhan guroo hai naanak kai sange |4|2|104|
English: The Guru is my soul, my breath of life, and wealth; O Nanak, He is with me forever. ||4||2||104||

[Ang 397 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਾਈ ਅਲਖੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਭੋਰੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: saaee alakh apaar bhoree man vasai |
English: If the Invisible and Infinite Lord dwells within my mind, even for a moment,

Gurbani: ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਾਇ ਮੈਡਾ ਹਭੁ ਨਸੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dookh darad rog maae maiddaa habh nasai |1|
English: then all my pains, troubles, and diseases vanish. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵੰਞਾ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਸਾਈ ਆਪਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: hau vanyaa kurabaan saaee aapane |
English: I am a sacrifice to my Lord Master.

Gurbani: ਹੋਵੈ ਅਨਦੁ ਘਣਾ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਜਾਪਣੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hovai anad ghanaa man tan jaapane |1| rahaau |
English: Meditating on Him, a great joy wells up within my mind and body. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਿੰਦਕ ਗਾਲਿੑ ਸੁਣੀ ਸਚੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਧਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: bindak gaala sunee sache tis dhanee |
English: I have heard only a little bit of news about the True Lord Master.

Gurbani: ਸੂਖੀ ਹੂੰ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ਮਾਇ ਨ ਕੀਮ ਗਣੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sookhee hoon sukh paae maae na keem ganee |2|
English: I have obtained the peace of all peace, O my mother; I cannot estimate its worth. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨੈਣ ਪਸੰਦੋ ਸੋਇ ਪੇਖਿ ਮੁਸਤਾਕ ਭਈ ॥
Transliteration: nain pasando soe pekh musataak bhee |
English: He is so beautiful to my eyes; beholding Him, I have been bewitched.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਨਿਰਗੁਣਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ ਆਪਿ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ਲਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: mai niragun meree maae aap larr laae lee |3|
English: I am worthless, O my mother; He Himself has attached me to the hem of His robe. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਹਭਾ ਹੂੰ ਬਾਹਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: bed kateb sansaar habhaa hoon baaharaa |
English: He is beyond the world of the Vedas, the Koran and the Bible.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਦਿਸੈ ਜਾਹਰਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੦੫॥
Transliteration: naanak kaa paatisaahu disai jaaharaa |4|3|105|
English: The Supreme King of Nanak is immanent and manifest. ||4||3||105||

[Ang 397 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਲਾਖ ਭਗਤ ਆਰਾਧਹਿ ਜਪਤੇ ਪੀਉ ਪੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: laakh bhagat aaraadheh japate peeo peeo |
English: Tens of thousands of devotees worship and adore You, chanting, "Beloved, Beloved."

Gurbani: ਕਵਨ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਾਵਉ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਬਿਖਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kavan jugat melaavau niragun bikhee jeeo |1|
English: How shall You unite me, the worthless and corrupt soul, with Yourself. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ॥
Transliteration: teree ttek govind gupaal deaal prabh |
English: You are my Support, O Merciful God, Lord of the Universe, Sustainer of the World.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨਾ ਕੇ ਨਾਥ ਤੇਰੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: toon sabhanaa ke naath teree srisatt sabh |1| rahaau |
English: You are the Master of all; the entire creation is Yours. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਸੰਤ ਪੇਖਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sahaaee sant pekheh sadaa hajoor |
English: You are the constant help and support of the Saints, who behold You Ever-present.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਨੜਿਆ ਸੇ ਮਰਨਿੑ ਵਿਸੂਰਿ ਵਿਸੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naam bihoonarriaa se marana visoor visoor |2|
English: Those who lack the Naam, the Name of the Lord, shall die, engulfed in sorrow and pain. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਤਣ ਭਾਇ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਗਉਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: daas daasatan bhaae mittiaa tinaa gaun |
English: Those servants, who lovingly perform the Lord's service, are freed from the cycle of reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨਾੜਾ ਹਾਲੁ ਕਉਣੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: visariaa jinaa naam tinaarraa haal kaun |3|
English: What shall be the fate of those who forget the Naam? ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੇ ਪਸੁ ਹਰਿੑਆਉ ਤੈਸਾ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਭ ॥
Transliteration: jaise pas haraaau taisaa sansaar sabh |
English: As are the cattle which have strayed, so is the entire world.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੦੬॥
Transliteration: naanak bandhan kaatt milaavahu aap prabh |4|4|106|
English: O God, please cut away Nanak's bonds, and unite him with Yourself. ||4||4||106||

[Ang 397 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਭੇ ਥੋਕ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਹਿਕੋ ਖਿਆਲੁ ਕਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: habhe thok visaar hiko khiaal kar |
English: Forget all other things, and dwell upon the Lord alone.

Gurbani: ਝੂਠਾ ਲਾਹਿ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਧਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jhootthaa laeh gumaan man tan arap dhar |1|
English: Lay aside your false pride, and dedicate your mind and body to Him. ||1||

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰ ਤੂੰ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar saalaeh sirajanahaar toon |
English: Twenty-four hours a day, praise the Creator Lord.

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਾਂ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਮੂੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jeevaan teree daat kirapaa karahu moon |1| rahaau |
English: I live by Your bountiful gifts - please, shower me with Your Mercy! ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਕੰਮੁ ਕਮਾਇ ਜਿਤੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਉਜਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: soee kam kamaae jit mukh ujalaa |
English: So, do that work, by which your face shall be made radiant.

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਲਗੈ ਸਚਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਅਲਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: soee lagai sach jis toon dehi alaa |2|
English: He alone becomes attached to the Truth, O Lord, unto whom You give it. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਨ ਢਹੰਦੋ ਮੂਲਿ ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਕਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jo na dtahando mool so ghar raas kar |
English: So build and adorn that house, which shall never be destroyed.

Gurbani: ਹਿਕੋ ਚਿਤਿ ਵਸਾਇ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਮਰਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: hiko chit vasaae kade na jaae mar |3|
English: Enshrine the One Lord within your consciousness; He shall never die. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤਿਨੑਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: tinaa piaaraa raam jo prabh bhaaniaa |
English: The Lord is dear to those, who are pleasing to the Will of God.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਅਕਥੁ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਵਖਾਣਿਆ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੦੭॥
Transliteration: gur parasaad akath naanak vakhaaniaa |4|5|107|
English: By Guru's Grace, Nanak describes the indescribable. ||4||5||107||

[Ang 397 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੇ ਕਿਨੇਹਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jinaa na visarai naam se kinehiaa |
English: What are they like - those who do not forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord?

Gurbani: ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਮੂਲਿ ਸਾਂਈ ਜੇਹਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bhed na jaanahu mool saanee jehiaa |1|
English: Know that there is absolutely no difference; they are exactly like the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਤੁਮੑ ਸੰਗਿ ਭੇਟਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: man tan hoe nihaal tuma sang bhettiaa |
English: The mind and body are enraptured, meeting with You, O Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਭੁ ਮੇਟਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sukh paaeaa jan parasaad dukh sabh mettiaa |1| rahaau |
English: Peace is obtained, by the favor of the Lord's humble servant; all pains are taken away. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੇਤੇ ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਤਿੰਨੑ ਖੇ ॥
Transliteration: jete khandd brahamandd udhaare tina khe |
English: As many as are the continents of the world, so many have been saved.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਆਪਿ ਪੂਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਸੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jina man vutthaa aap poore bhagat se |2|
English: Those, in whose minds You Yourself dwell, O Lord, are the perfect devotees. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਮੰਨੇ ਆਪਿ ਸੋਈ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: jis no mane aap soee maaneeai |
English: Those whom You approve, are approved.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: pragatt purakh paravaan sabh tthaaee jaaneeai |3|
English: Such a celebrated and honored person is known everywhere. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਆਰਾਧਿ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ਸਾਹ ਸਾਹ ॥
Transliteration: dinas rain aaraadh samaale saah saah |
English: Day and night, with every breath to worship and adore the Lord

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਲੋਚਾ ਪੂਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੦੮॥
Transliteration: naanak kee lochaa poor sache paatisaah |4|6|108|
English: - please, O True Supreme King, fulfill this, Nanak's desire. ||4||6||108||

[Ang 398 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਠਾਇ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: poor rahiaa srab tthaae hamaaraa khasam soe |
English: He, my Lord Master, is fully pervading all places.

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਤੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ek saahib sir chhat doojaa naeh koe |1|
English: He is the One Lord Master, the roof over our heads; there is no other than Him. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖਣਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jiau bhaavai tiau raakh raakhanahaariaa |
English: As it pleases Your Will, please save me, O Savior Lord.

Gurbani: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tujh bin avar na koe nadar nihaariaa |1| rahaau |
English: Without You, my eyes see no other at all. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਾਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: pratipaale prabh aap ghatt ghatt saareeai |
English: God Himself is the Cherisher; He takes care of each and every heart.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਆਪਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jis man vutthaa aap tis na visaareeai |2|
English: That person, within whose mind You Yourself dwell, never forgets You. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਣ ਭਾਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jo kichh kare su aap aapan bhaaniaa |
English: He does that which is pleasing to Himself.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਾ ਕਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bhagataa kaa sahaaee jug jug jaaniaa |3|
English: He is known as the help and support of His devotees, throughout the ages. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਝੂਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: jap jap har kaa naam kade na jhooreeai |
English: Chanting and meditating up the Lord's Name, the mortal never comes to regret anything.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸ ਲੋਚਾ ਪੂਰੀਐ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੦੯॥
Transliteration: naanak daras piaas lochaa pooreeai |4|7|109|
English: O Nanak, I thirst for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; please, fulfill my desire, O Lord. ||4||7||109||

[Ang 398 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਸੋਵਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਗਾਫਲ ਗਹਿਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa soveh naam visaar gaafal gahiliaa |
English: Why are you sleeping, and forgetting the Name, O careless and foolish mortal?

Gurbani: ਕਿਤਂੀ ਇਤੁ ਦਰੀਆਇ ਵੰਞਨਿੑ ਵਹਦਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kitanee it dareeae vanyana vahadiaa |1|
English: So many have been washed away and carried off by this river of life. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬੋਹਿਥੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਮਨ ਚੜਿ ਲੰਘੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: bohitharraa har charan man charr langheeai |
English: O mortal, get aboard the boat of the Lord's Lotus Feet, and cross over.

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar gun gaae saadhoo sangeeai |1| rahaau |
English: Twenty-four hours a day, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਭੋਗਹਿ ਭੋਗ ਅਨੇਕ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸੁੰਞਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: bhogeh bhog anek vin naavai sunyiaa |
English: You may enjoy various pleasures, but they are useless without the Name.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਿਨਾ ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਰੁੰਨਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har kee bhagat binaa mar mar runiaa |2|
English: Without devotion to the Lord, you shall die in sorrow, again and again. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਪੜ ਭੋਗ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਤਨਿ ਮਰਦਨ ਮਾਲਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaparr bhog sugandh tan maradan maalanaa |
English: You may dress and eat and apply scented oils to your body,

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਤਨੁ ਛਾਰੁ ਸਰਪਰ ਚਾਲਣਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bin simaran tan chhaar sarapar chaalanaa |3|
English: but without the meditative remembrance of the Lord, your body shall surely turn to dust, and you shall have to depart. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਪੇਖਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: mahaa bikham sansaar viralai pekhiaa |
English: How very treacherous is this world-ocean; how very few realize this!

Gurbani: ਛੂਟਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੇਖਿਆ ॥੪॥੮॥੧੧੦॥
Transliteration: chhoottan har kee saran lekh naanak lekhiaa |4|8|110|
English: Salvation rests in the Lord's Sanctuary; O Nanak, this is your pre-ordained destiny. ||4||8||110||

[Ang 398 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਗਰਬੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: koe na kis hee sang kaahe garabeeai |
English: No one is anyone's companion; why take any pride in others?

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰਬੀਐ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ek naam aadhaar bhaujal tarabeeai |1|
English: With the Support of the One Name, this terrible world-ocean is crossed over. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਗਰੀਬ ਸਚੁ ਟੇਕ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: mai gareeb sach ttek toon mere satigur poore |
English: You are the True Support of me, the poor mortal, O my Perfect True Guru.

Gurbani: ਦੇਖਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ਦਰਸਨੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dekh tumaaraa darasano meraa man dheere |1| rahaau |
English: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, my mind is encouraged. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਰਾਜੁ ਮਾਲੁ ਜੰਜਾਲੁ ਕਾਜਿ ਨ ਕਿਤੈ ਗਨੋੁ ॥
Transliteration: raaj maal janjaal kaaj na kitai ganuo |
English: Royal powers, wealth, and worldly involvements are of no use at all.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਏਹੁ ਧਨੋੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har keeratan aadhaar nihachal ehu dhanuo |2|
English: The Kirtan of the Lord's Praise is my Support; this wealth is everlasting. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੇਤੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ਤੇਤ ਪਛਾਵਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jete maaeaa rang tet pachhaaviaa |
English: As many as are the pleasures of Maya, so many are the shadows they leave.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਵਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sukh kaa naam nidhaan guramukh gaaviaa |3|
English: The Gurmukhs sing of the Naam, the treasure of peace. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa gunee nidhaan toon prabh gahir ganbheere |
English: You are the True Lord, the treasure of excellence; O God, You are deep and unfathomable.

Gurbani: ਆਸ ਭਰੋਸਾ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਜੀਅਰੇ ॥੪॥੯॥੧੧੧॥
Transliteration: aas bharosaa khasam kaa naanak ke jeeare |4|9|111|
English: The Lord Master is the hope and support of Nanak's mind. ||4||9||111||

[Ang 398 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: jis simarat dukh jaae sehaj sukh paaeeai |
English: Remembering Him, suffering is removed, and celestial peace is obtained.

Gurbani: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: rain dinas kar jorr har har dhiaaeeai |1|
English: Night and day, with your palms pressed together, meditate on the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak kaa prabh soe jis kaa sabh koe |
English: He alone is Nanak's God, unto whom all beings belong.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sarab rahiaa bharapoor sachaa sach soe |1| rahaau |
English: He is totally pervading everywhere, the Truest of the True. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਗਿਆਨ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: antar baahar sang sahaaee giaan jog |
English: Inwardly and outwardly, He is my companion and my helper; He is the One to be realized.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਮਨਾ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ ਸਗਲ ਰੋਗੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tiseh araadh manaa binaasai sagal rog |2|
English: Adoring Him, my mind is cured of all its ailments. ||2||

Gurbani: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: raakhanahaar apaar raakhai agan maeh |
English: The Savior Lord is infinite; He saves us from the fire of the womb.

Gurbani: ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਤਪਤਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: seetal har har naam simarat tapat jaae |3|
English: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is soothing and cool; remembering it in meditation, the inner fire is quenched. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਘਣਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਧੂਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sookh sehaj aanand ghanaa naanak jan dhooraa |
English: Peace, poise, and immense bliss, O Nanak, are obtained, when one becomes the dust of the feet of the humble servants of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲੇ ਸਿਧਿ ਭਏ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੧੧੨॥
Transliteration: kaaraj sagale sidh bhe bhettiaa gur pooraa |4|10|112|
English: All of one's affairs are perfectly resolved, meeting with the Perfect Guru. ||4||10||112||

[Ang 399 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: gobind gunee nidhaan guramukh jaaneeai |
English: The Lord of the Universe is the treasure of excellence; He is known only to the Gurmukh.

Gurbani: ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀਐ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: hoe kripaal deaal har rang maaneeai |1|
English: When He shows His Mercy and Kindness, we revel in the Lord's Love. ||1||

Gurbani: ਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਾਹ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਕਹਾਣੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: aavahu sant milaah har kathaa kahaaneea |
English: Come, O Saints - let us join together and speak the Sermon of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਜਿ ਲਾਜ ਲੋਕਾਣੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: anadin simarah naam taj laaj lokaaneea |1| rahaau |
English: Night and day, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and ignore the criticism of others. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਨਦੁ ਘਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: jap jap jeevaa naam hovai anad ghanaa |
English: I live by chanting and meditating on the Naam, and so I obtain immense bliss.

Gurbani: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਝੂਠਾ ਵਿਣਸਣਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mithiaa mohu sansaar jhootthaa vinasanaa |2|
English: Attachment to the world is useless and vain; it is false, and perishes in the end. ||2||

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਨੇਹੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal sang nehu kinai viralai laaeaa |
English: How rare are those who embrace love for the Lord's Lotus Feet.

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਮੁਖੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: dhan suhaavaa mukh jin har dhiaaeaa |3|
English: Blessed and beautiful is that mouth, which meditates on the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਲ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮਿਟਿ ਜਾਵਈ ॥
Transliteration: janam maran dukh kaal simarat mitt jaavee |
English: The pains of birth, death and reincarnation are erased by meditating on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਸੋਇ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਈ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੧੧੩॥
Transliteration: naanak kai sukh soe jo prabh bhaavee |4|11|113|
English: That alone is Nanak's joy, which is pleasing to God. ||4||11||113||

[Ang 399 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਵਹੁ ਮੀਤ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਹੋਇ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਸਭਿ ਭੁੰਚਹ ॥
Transliteration: aavahu meet ikatr hoe ras kas sabh bhunchah |
English: Come, O friends: let us meet together and enjoy all the tastes and flavors.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਹ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਪਾ ਮੁੰਚਹ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: amrit naam har har japah mil paapaa munchah |1|
English: Let us join together and chant the Ambrosial Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and so wipe away our sins. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਹੁ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: tat veechaarahu sant janahu taa te bighan na laagai |
English: Reflect upon the essence of reality, O Saintly beings, and no troubles shall afflict you.

Gurbani: ਖੀਨ ਭਏ ਸਭਿ ਤਸਕਰਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kheen bhe sabh tasakaraa guramukh jan jaagai |1| rahaau |
English: All of the thieves shall be destroyed, as the Gurmukhs remain wakeful. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬੁਧਿ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਖਰਚੁ ਲੈਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਜਾਰਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: budh gareebee kharach laihu haumai bikh jaarahu |
English: Take wisdom and humility as your supplies, and burn away the poison of pride.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਾ ਹਟੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਉਦਾ ਵਖਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਾਪਾਰਹੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saachaa hatt pooraa saudaa vakhar naam vaapaarahu |2|
English: True is that shop, and perfect the transaction; deal only in the merchandise of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਧਨੁ ਅਰਪਿਆ ਸੇਈ ਪਤਿਵੰਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: jeeo pindd dhan arapiaa seee pativante |
English: They alone are accepted and approved, who dedicate their souls, bodies and wealth.

Gurbani: ਆਪਨੜੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣਿਆ ਨਿਤ ਕੇਲ ਕਰੰਤੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aapanarre prabh bhaaniaa nit kel karante |3|
English: Those who are pleasing to their God, celebrate in happiness. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਦੁ ਜੋ ਪੀਵਤੇ ਬਿਖਲੀ ਪਤਿ ਕਮਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: duramat mad jo peevate bikhalee pat kamalee |
English: Those fools, who drink in the wine of evil-mindedness, become the husbands of prostitutes.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣਿ ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚ ਅਮਲੀ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੧੧੪॥
