Transliteration: raam rasaaein jo rate naanak sach amalee |4|12|114|
English: But those who are imbued with the sublime essence of the Lord, O Nanak, are intoxicated with the Truth. ||4||12||114||

[Ang 399 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਉਦਮੁ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਾਇਆ ਆਰੰਭੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: audam keea karaaeaa aaranbh rachaaeaa |
English: I made the effort; I did it, and made a beginning.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਣਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naam jape jap jeevanaa gur mantru drirraaeaa |1|
English: I live by chanting and meditating on the Naam. The Guru has implanted this Mantra within me. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪਾਇ ਪਰਹ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਬਿਦਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: paae parah satiguroo kai jin bharam bidaariaa |
English: I fall at the Feet of the True Guru, who has dispelled my doubts.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh aapanee sach saaj savaariaa |1| rahaau |
English: Bestowing His Mercy, God has dressed me, and decorated me with the Truth. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਸਚੁ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kar geh leene aapane sach hukam rajaaee |
English: Taking me by the hand, He made me His own, through the True Order of His Command.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦਿਤੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਸਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jo prabh ditee daat saa pooran vaddiaaee |2|
English: That gift which God gave to me, is perfect greatness. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਅਹਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa gun gaaeeeh jap naam muraaree |
English: Forever and ever, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and chant the Name of the Destroyer of ego.

Gurbani: ਨੇਮੁ ਨਿਬਾਹਿਓ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: nem nibaahio satiguroo prabh kirapaa dhaaree |3|
English: My vows have been honored, by the Grace of God and the True Guru, who has showered His Mercy. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ਲਾਭੁ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: naam dhan gun gaau laabh poorai gur ditaa |
English: The Perfect Guru has given the wealth of the Naam, and the profit of singing the Lord's Glorious Praises.

Gurbani: ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ਸੰਤ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਹੁ ਅਮਿਤਾ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੧੧੫॥
Transliteration: vanajaare sant naanakaa prabh saahu amitaa |4|13|115|
English: The Saints are the traders, O Nanak, and the Infinite Lord God is their Banker. ||4||13||115||

[Ang 399 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਤੁਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਵਡਭਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kaa tthaakur tuhee prabh taa ke vaddabhaagaa |
English: One who has You as His Master, O God, is blessed with great destiny.

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਸਦ ਸੁਖੀ ਸਭੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ohu suhelaa sad sukhee sabh bhram bhau bhaagaa |1|
English: He is happy, and forever at peace; his doubts and fears are all dispelled. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਚਾਕਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਭਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: ham chaakar gobind ke tthaakur meraa bhaaraa |
English: I am the slave of the Lord of the Universe; my Master is the greatest of all.

Gurbani: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਧਿ ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: karan karaavan sagal bidh so satiguroo hamaaraa |1| rahaau |
English: He is the Creator, the Cause of causes; He is my True Guru. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਉਰੁ ਕੋ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਕਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: doojaa naahee aaur ko taa kaa bhau kareeai |
English: There is no other whom I should fear.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਗੁ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰੀਐ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur sevaa mehal paaeeai jag dutar tareeai |2|
English: Serving the Guru, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is obtained, and the impassable world-ocean is crossed over. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: drisatt teree sukh paaeeai man maeh nidhaanaa |
English: By Your Glance of Grace, peace is obtained, and the treasure fills the mind.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਭਏ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jaa kau tum kirapaal bhe sevak se paravaanaa |3|
English: That servant, unto whom You bestow Your Mercy, is approved and accepted. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੋ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਪੀਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: amrit ras har keeratano ko viralaa peevai |
English: How rare is that person who drinks in the Ambrosial Essence of the Lord's Kirtan.

Gurbani: ਵਜਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲੈ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵੈ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੧੧੬॥
Transliteration: vajahu naanak milai ek naam rid jap jap jeevai |4|14|116|
English: Nanak has obtained the commodity of the One Name; he lives by chanting and meditating on it within his heart. ||4||14||116||

[Ang 400 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਹਉ ਚੇਰੁਲੀ ਸੋ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaa prabh kee hau cherulee so sabh te aoochaa |
English: I am God's maid-servant; He is the highest of all.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਕਾਂਢੀਐ ਥੋਰਾ ਅਰੁ ਮੂਚਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh taa kaa kaandteeai thoraa ar moochaa |1|
English: All things, big and small, are said to belong to Him. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮੇਰਾ ਧਨੋ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੀ ਮਨੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: jeea praan meraa dhano saahib kee maneea |
English: I surrender my soul, my breath of life, and my wealth, to my Lord Master.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਿ ਜਿਸੈ ਕੈ ਊਜਲੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਦਾਸੀ ਗਨੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: naam jisai kai aoojalee tis daasee ganeea |1| rahaau |
English: Through His Name, I become radiant; I am known as His slave. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਅਨੰਦ ਮੈ ਨਾਉ ਮਾਣਕ ਹੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: veparavaahu anand mai naau maanak heeraa |
English: You are Carefree, the Embodiment of Bliss. Your Name is a gem, a jewel.

Gurbani: ਰਜੀ ਧਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਤੂੰ ਮੀਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: rajee dhaaee sadaa sukh jaa kaa toon meeraa |2|
English: One who has You as her Master, is satisfied, satiated and happy forever. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਰੀ ਸੰਗ ਕੀ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: sakhee saheree sang kee sumat drirraavau |
English: O my companions and fellow maidens, please implant that balanced understanding within me.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਤਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sevahu saadhoo bhaau kar tau nidh har paavau |3|
English: Serve the Holy Saints lovingly, and find the treasure of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਗਲੀ ਦਾਸੀ ਠਾਕੁਰੈ ਸਭ ਕਹਤੀ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sagalee daasee tthaakurai sabh kahatee meraa |
English: All are servants of the Lord Master, and all call Him their own.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੁਖਹਿ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੧੧੭॥
Transliteration: jiseh seegaare naanakaa tis sukheh baseraa |4|15|117|
English: She alone dwells in peace, O Nanak, whom the Lord adorns. ||4||15||117||

[Ang 400 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਾ ਕੀ ਹੋਇ ਦਾਸਰੀ ਏਹੁ ਅਚਾਰਾ ਸਿਖੁ ਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: santaa kee hoe daasaree ehu achaaraa sikh ree |
English: Become the servant of the Saints, and learn this way of life.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਗੁਣਾ ਗੁਣ ਊਤਮੋ ਭਰਤਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਪਿਖੁ ਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sagal gunaa gun aootamo bharataa door na pikh ree |1|
English: Of all virtues, the most sublime virtue is to see your Husband Lord near at hand. ||1||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਜੀਠੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: eihu man sundar aapanaa har naam majeetthai rang ree |
English: So, dye this mind of yours with the color of the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਚਾਤੁਰੀ ਤੂੰ ਜਾਣੁ ਗੁਪਾਲਹਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tiaag siaanap chaaturee toon jaan gupaaleh sang ree |1| rahaau |
English: Renounce cleverness and cunning, and know that the Sustainer of the world is with you. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਭਰਤਾ ਕਹੈ ਸੁ ਮਾਨੀਐ ਏਹੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਇ ਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: bharataa kahai su maaneeai ehu seegaar banaae ree |
English: Whatever your Husband Lord says, accept that, and make it your decoration.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਏਹੁ ਤੰਬੋਲਾ ਖਾਇ ਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: doojaa bhaau visaareeai ehu tanbolaa khaae ree |2|
English: Forget the love of duality, and chew upon this betel leaf. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਪਕੋ ਇਹ ਸਤ ਕੀ ਸੇਜ ਬਿਛਾਇ ਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa sabad kar deepako ih sat kee sej bichhaae ree |
English: Make the Word of the Guru's Shabad your lamp, and let your bed be Truth.

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਰਹੁ ਤਉ ਭੇਟੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar kar jorr rahu tau bhettai har raae ree |3|
English: Twenty-four hours a day, stand with your palms pressed together, and the Lord, your King, shall meet you. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਚਜੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਈ ਰੂਪਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: tis hee chaj seegaar sabh saaee roop apaar ree |
English: She alone is cultured and embellished, and she alone is of incomparable beauty.

Gurbani: ਸਾਈ ਸੋੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜੋ ਭਾਣੀ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ਰੀ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੧੧੮॥
Transliteration: saaee suohaagan naanakaa jo bhaanee karataar ree |4|16|118|
English: She alone is the happy soul-bride, O Nanak, who is pleasing to the Creator Lord. ||4||16||118||

[Ang 400 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਡੀਗਨ ਡੋਲਾ ਤਊ ਲਉ ਜਉ ਮਨ ਕੇ ਭਰਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: ddeegan ddolaa taoo lau jau man ke bharamaa |
English: As long as there are doubts in the mind, the mortal staggers and falls.

Gurbani: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕਾਟੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਪਾਏ ਬਿਸਰਾਮਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bhram kaatte gur aapanai paae bisaraamaa |1|
English: The Guru removed my doubts, and I have obtained my place of rest. ||1||

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਬਿਖਾਦੀ ਦੋਖੀਆ ਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹੂਟੇ ॥
Transliteration: oe bikhaadee dokheea te gur te hootte |
English: Those quarrelsome enemies have been overcome, through the Guru.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਛੂਟੇ ਅਬ ਉਨੑਾ ਤੇ ਓਇ ਹਮ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ham chhootte ab unaa te oe ham te chhootte |1| rahaau |
English: I have now escaped from them, and they have run away from me. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਾਨਤਾ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਬੰਧਾ ॥
Transliteration: meraa teraa jaanataa tab hee te bandhaa |
English: He is concerned with 'mine and yours', and so he is held in bondage.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਟੀ ਅਗਿਆਨਤਾ ਤਬ ਛੁਟਕੇ ਫੰਧਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur kaattee agiaanataa tab chhuttake fandhaa |2|
English: When the Guru dispelled my ignorance, then the noose of death was cut away from my neck. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝਤਾ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਲਉ ਦੁਖੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: jab lag hukam na boojhataa tab hee lau dukheea |
English: As long as he does not understand the Command of God's Will, he remains miserable.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੀਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur mil hukam pachhaaniaa tab hee te sukheea |3|
English: Meeting with the Guru, he comes to recognize God's Will, and then, he becomes happy. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਦੁਸਮਨੁ ਦੋਖੀਆ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਮੰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: naa ko dusaman dokheea naahee ko mandaa |
English: I have no enemies and no adversaries; no one is wicked to me.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੇਵਕੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਖਸਮੈ ਬੰਦਾ ॥੪॥੧੭॥੧੧੯॥
Transliteration: gur kee sevaa sevako naanak khasamai bandaa |4|17|119|
English: That servant, who performs the Lord's service, O Nanak, is the slave of the Lord Master. ||4||17||119||

[Ang 400 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨਦੁ ਘਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sookh sehaj aanad ghanaa har keeratan gaau |
English: Peace, celestial poise and absolute bliss are obtained, singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

Gurbani: ਗਰਹ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦੇ ਅਪਣਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: garah nivaare satiguroo de apanaa naau |1|
English: Bestowing His Name, the True Guru removes the evil omens. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਸਦ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: balihaaree gur aapane sad sad bal jaau |
English: I am a sacrifice to my Guru; forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to Him.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੂ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਹਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: guroo vittahu hau vaariaa jis mil sach suaau |1| rahaau |
English: I am a sacrifice to the Guru; meeting Him, I am absorbed into the True Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਗੁਨ ਅਪਸਗੁਨ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਲਗਹਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: sagun apasagun tis kau lageh jis cheet na aavai |
English: Good omens and bad omens affect those who do not keep the Lord in the mind.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tis jam nerr na aavee jo har prabh bhaavai |2|
English: The Messenger of Death does not approach those who are pleasing to the Lord God. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਜੇਤੇ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: pun daan jap tap jete sabh aoopar naam |
English: Donations to charity, meditation and penance - above all of them is the Naam.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਜੋ ਜਪੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har har rasanaa jo japai tis pooran kaam |3|
English: One who chants with his tongue the Name of the Lord, Har, Har - his works are brought to perfect completion. ||3||

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਗਏ ਕੋ ਦਿਸੈ ਨ ਬੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: bhai binase bhram moh ge ko disai na beea |
English: His fears are removed, and his doubts and attachments are gone; he sees none other than God.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਖੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਥੀਆ ॥੪॥੧੮॥੧੨੦॥
Transliteration: naanak raakhe paarabraham fir dookh na theea |4|18|120|
English: O Nanak, the Supreme Lord God preserves him, and no pain or sorrow afflicts him any longer. ||4||18||120||

[Ang 401 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੯ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa ghar 9 mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Ninth House, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਚਿਤਵਉ ਚਿਤਵਿ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਉ ਆਗੈ ਭਾਵਉ ਕਿ ਨ ਭਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: chitvau chitav sarab sukh paavau aagai bhaavau ki na bhaavau |
English: Contemplating Him within my consciousness, I obtain total peace; but hereafter, will I be pleasing to Him or not?

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਹੈ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਦੂਸਰ ਕੈ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ek daataar sagal hai jaachik doosar kai peh jaavau |1|
English: There is only One Giver; all others are beggars. Who else can we turn to? ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਮਾਗਉ ਆਨ ਲਜਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: hau maagau aan lajaavau |
English: When I beg from others, I am ashamed.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤਿ ਏਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਲਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sagal chhatrapat eko tthaakur kaun samasar laavau |1| rahaau |
English: The One Lord Master is the Supreme King of all; who else is equal to Him? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਊਠਉ ਬੈਸਉ ਰਹਿ ਭਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਖੋਜਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: aootthau baisau reh bhi na saakau darasan khoj khojaavau |
English: Standing up and sitting down, I cannot live without Him. I search and search for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿਕ ਸਨਕਾਦਿਕ ਸਨਕ ਸਨੰਦਨ ਸਨਾਤਨ ਸਨਤਕੁਮਾਰ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਮਹਲੁ ਦੁਲਭਾਵਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: brahamaadik sanakaadik sanak sanandan sanaatan sanatakumaar tina kau mehal dulabhaavau |2|
English: Even Brahma and the sages Sanak, Sanandan, Sanaatan and Sanat Kumar, find it difficult to obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਗਮ ਅਗਮ ਆਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਰੈ ਨ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: agam agam aagaadh bodh keemat parai na paavau |
English: He is unapproachable and unfathomable; His wisdom is deep and profound; His value cannot be appraised.

Gurbani: ਤਾਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਕੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: taakee saran sat purakh kee satigur purakh dhiaavau |3|
English: I have taken to the Sanctuary of the True Lord, the Primal Being, and I meditate on the True Guru. ||3||

Gurbani: ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕਾਟਿਓ ਬੰਧੁ ਗਰਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: bheo kripaal deaal prabh tthaakur kaattio bandh garaavau |
English: God, the Lord Master, has become kind and compassionate; He has cut the noose of death away from my neck.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਉ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਤਉ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਉ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੨੧॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak jau saadhasang paaeo tau fir janam na aavau |4|1|121|
English: Says Nanak, now that I have obtained the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I shall not have to be reincarnated again. ||4||1||121||

[Ang 401 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗਾਵਉ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਗਾਵਉ ਗਾਵਉ ਜਾਗਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: antar gaavau baahar gaavau gaavau jaag savaaree |
English: Inwardly, I sing His Praises, and outwardly, I sing His Praises; I sing His Praises while awake and asleep.

Gurbani: ਸੰਗਿ ਚਲਨ ਕਉ ਤੋਸਾ ਦੀਨੑਾ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sang chalan kau tosaa deenaa gobind naam ke biauhaaree |1|
English: I am a trader in the Name of the Lord of the Universe; He has given it to me as my supplies, to carry with me. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਵਰ ਬਿਸਾਰੀ ਬਿਸਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: avar bisaaree bisaaree |
English: I have forgotten and forsaken other things.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੀਓ ਮੈ ਏਹੋ ਆਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: naam daan gur poorai deeo mai eho aadhaaree |1| rahaau |
English: The Perfect Guru has given me the Gift of the Naam; this alone is my Support. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦੂਖਨਿ ਗਾਵਉ ਸੁਖਿ ਭੀ ਗਾਵਉ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪੰਥਿ ਸਮੑਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: dookhan gaavau sukh bhee gaavau maarag panth samaaree |
English: I sing His Praises while suffering, and I sing His Praises while I am at peace as well. I contemplate Him while I walk along the Path.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਦੀਆ ਮੋਰੀ ਤਿਸਾ ਬੁਝਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naam drirr gur man meh deea moree tisaa bujhaaree |2|
English: The Guru has implanted the Naam within my mind, and my thirst has been quenched. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦਿਨੁ ਭੀ ਗਾਵਉ ਰੈਨੀ ਗਾਵਉ ਗਾਵਉ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਰਸਨਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: din bhee gaavau rainee gaavau gaavau saas saas rasanaaree |
English: I sing His Praises during the day, and I sing His Praises during the night; I sing them with each and every breath.

Gurbani: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਸਾਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰਤ ਸੰਗਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: satasangat meh bisaas hoe har jeevat marat sangaaree |3|
English: In the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, this faith is established, that the Lord is with us, in life and in death. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਇਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਵਉ ਸੰਤ ਰੇਨ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jan naanak kau ihu daan dehu prabh paavau sant ren ur dhaaree |
English: Bless servant Nanak with this gift, O God, that he may obtain, and enshrine in his heart, the dust of the feet of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰਵਨੀ ਕਥਾ ਨੈਨ ਦਰਸੁ ਪੇਖਉ ਮਸਤਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੨੨॥
Transliteration: sravanee kathaa nain daras pekhau masatak gur charanaaree |4|2|122|
English: Hear the Lord's Sermon with your ears, and behold the Blessed Vision of His Darshan with your eyes; place your forehead upon the Guru's Feet. ||4||2||122||

[Ang 401 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: Aasaa, Tenth House, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੧੦ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa ghar 10 mahalaa 5 |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru: Aasaa, Tenth House, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂੰ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਹਿ ਤੇ ਪਾਹੁਨ ਦੋ ਦਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: jis no toon asathir kar maaneh te paahun do daahaa |
English: That which you believe to be permanent, is a guest here for only a few days.

Gurbani: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਸਭ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਅਸਨਾਹਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: putr kalatr grih sagal samagree sabh mithiaa asanaahaa |1|
English: Children, wives, homes, and all possessions - attachment to all of these is false. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਹੈ ਹਾ ਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: re man kiaa kareh hai haa haa |
English: O mind, why do you burst out laughing?

Gurbani: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦੇਖੁ ਜੈਸੇ ਹਰਿਚੰਦਉਰੀ ਇਕੁ ਰਾਮ ਭਜਨੁ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: drisatt dekh jaise harichandauree ik raam bhajan lai laahaa |1| rahaau |
English: See with your eyes, that these things are only mirages. So earn the profit of meditation on the One Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੇ ਬਸਤਰ ਦੇਹ ਓਢਾਨੇ ਦਿਨ ਦੋਇ ਚਾਰਿ ਭੋਰਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaise basatar deh odtaane din doe chaar bhoraahaa |
English: It is like the clothes which you wear on your body - they wear off in a few days.

Gurbani: ਭੀਤਿ ਊਪਰੇ ਕੇਤਕੁ ਧਾਈਐ ਅੰਤਿ ਓਰਕੋ ਆਹਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bheet aoopare ketak dhaaeeai ant orako aahaa |2|
English: How long can you run upon a wall? Ultimately, you come to its end. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੇ ਅੰਭ ਕੁੰਡ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਪਰਤ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਗਲਿ ਜਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaise anbh kundd kar raakhio parat sindh gal jaahaa |
English: It is like salt, preserved in its container; when it is put into water, it dissolves.

Gurbani: ਆਵਗਿ ਆਗਿਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਸੀ ਮੁਹਤ ਚਸਾਹਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aavag aagiaa paarabraham kee utth jaasee muhat chasaahaa |3|
English: When the Order of the Supreme Lord God comes, the soul arises, and departs in an instant. ||3||

Gurbani: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਲੇਖੈ ਚਾਲਹਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਬੈਸਹਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਲੈਦਾ ਸਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: re man lekhai chaaleh lekhai baiseh lekhai laidaa saahaa |
English: O mind, your steps are numbered, your moments spent sitting are numbered, and the breaths you are to take are numbered.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਓਟਾਹਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੨੩॥
Transliteration: sadaa keerat kar naanak har kee ubare satigur charan ottaahaa |4|1|123|
English: Sing forever the Praises of the Lord, O Nanak, and you shall be saved, under the Shelter of the Feet of the True Guru. ||4||1||123||

[Ang 402 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਪੁਸਟ ਬਾਤ ਤੇ ਭਈ ਸੀਧਰੀ ਦੂਤ ਦੁਸਟ ਸਜਨਈ ॥
Transliteration: apusatt baat te bhee seedharee doot dusatt sajanee |
English: That which was upside-down has been set upright; the deadly enemies and adversaries have become friends.

Gurbani: ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਮਹਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਓ ਮਲੀਨ ਬੁਧਿ ਹਛਨਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: andhakaar meh ratan pragaasio maleen budh hachhanee |1|
English: In the darkness, the jewel shines forth, and the impure understanding has become pure. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਈ ॥
Transliteration: jau kirapaa gobind bhee |
English: When the Lord of the Universe became merciful,

Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sukh sanpat har naam fal paae satigur milee |1| rahaau |
English: I found peace, wealth and the fruit of the Lord's Name; I have met the True Guru. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਕਿਰਪਨ ਕਉ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਨਤ ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਈ ॥
Transliteration: mohi kirapan kau koe na jaanat sagal bhavan pragattee |
English: No one knew me, the miserable miser, but now, I have become famous all over the world.

Gurbani: ਸੰਗਿ ਬੈਠਨੋ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਪਾਵਤ ਹੁਣਿ ਸਗਲ ਚਰਣ ਸੇਵਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sang baitthano kahee na paavat hun sagal charan sevee |2|
English: Before, no one would even sit with me, but now, all worship my feet. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਢ ਆਢ ਕਉ ਫਿਰਤ ਢੂੰਢਤੇ ਮਨ ਸਗਲ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਬੁਝਿ ਗਈ ॥
Transliteration: aadt aadt kau firat dtoondtate man sagal trisan bujh gee |
English: I used to wander in search of pennies, but now, all the desires of my mind are satisfied.

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਬੋਲੁ ਭੀ ਖਵਤੋ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੀਤਲਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ek bol bhee khavato naahee saadhasangat seetalee |3|
English: I could not bear even one criticism, but now, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I am cooled and soothed. ||3||

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਜੀਹ ਗੁਣ ਕਵਨ ਵਖਾਨੈ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਮਈ ॥
Transliteration: ek jeeh gun kavan vakhaanai agam agam agamee |
English: What Glorious Virtues of the Inaccessible, Unfathomable, Profound Lord can one mere tongue describe?

Gurbani: ਦਾਸੁ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸ ਕੋ ਕਰੀਅਹੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਈ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੨੪॥
Transliteration: daas daas daas ko kareeahu jan naanak har saranee |4|2|124|
English: Please, make me the slave of the slave of Your slaves; servant Nanak seeks the Lord's Sanctuary. ||4||2||124||

[Ang 402 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰੇ ਮੂੜੇ ਲਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਤੂੰ ਢੀਲਾ ਢੀਲਾ ਤੋਟੇ ਕਉ ਬੇਗਿ ਧਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: re moorre laahe kau toon dteelaa dteelaa totte kau beg dhaaeaa |
English: O fool, you are so slow to earn your profits, and so quick to run up losses.

Gurbani: ਸਸਤ ਵਖਰੁ ਤੂੰ ਘਿੰਨਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਾਪੀ ਬਾਧਾ ਰੇਨਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sasat vakhar toon ghineh naahee paapee baadhaa renaaeaa |1|
English: You do not purchase the inexpensive merchandise; O sinner, you are tied to your debts. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਸਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: satigur teree aasaaeaa |
English: O True Guru, You are my only hope.

Gurbani: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮੈ ਏਹਾ ਓਟਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: patit paavan tero naam paarabraham mai ehaa ottaaeaa |1| rahaau |
English: Your Name is the Purifier of sinners, O Supreme Lord God; You are my only Shelter. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੰਧਣ ਵੈਣ ਸੁਣਹਿ ਉਰਝਾਵਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਅਲਕਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gandhan vain suneh urajhaaveh naam lait alakaaeaa |
English: Listening to the evil talk, you are caught up in it, but you are hesitant to chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦ ਚਿੰਦ ਕਉ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਉਮਾਹਿਓ ਬੂਝੀ ਉਲਟਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: nind chind kau bahut umaahio boojhee ulattaaeaa |2|
English: You are delighted by slanderous talk; your understanding is corrupt. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰ ਤਨ ਪਰ ਤੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਅਖਾਧਿ ਖਾਹਿ ਹਰਕਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: par dhan par tan par tee nindaa akhaadh khaeh harakaaeaa |
English: Others' wealth, others' wives and the slander of others - eating the uneatable, you have gone crazy.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚ ਧਰਮ ਸਿਉ ਰੁਚਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ਸਤਿ ਸੁਨਤ ਛੋਹਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: saach dharam siau ruch nahee aavai sat sunat chhohaaeaa |3|
English: You have not enshrined love for the True Faith of Dharma; hearing the Truth, you are enraged. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਗਤ ਟੇਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: deen deaal kripaal prabh tthaakur bhagat ttek har naaeaa |
English: O God, Merciful to the meek, Compassionate Lord Master, Your Name is the Support of Your devotees.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਹਿ ਸਰਣ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਇਓ ਰਾਖੁ ਲਾਜ ਅਪਨਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੨੫॥
Transliteration: naanak aaeh saran prabh aaeo raakh laaj apanaaeaa |4|3|125|
English: Nanak has come to Your Sanctuary; O God, make him Your Own, and preserve his honor. ||4||3||125||

[Ang 402 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਪਟਾਏ ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਬਾਧੇ ॥
Transliteration: mithiaa sang sang lapattaae moh maaeaa kar baadhe |
English: They are attached to falsehood; clinging to the transitory, they are trapped in emotional attachment to Maya.

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਜਾਨੋ ਸੋ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਭਏ ਆਂਧੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jeh jaano so cheet na aavai ahanbudh bhe aandhe |1|
English: Wherever they go, they do not think of the Lord; they are blinded by intellectual egotism. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਕਿਉ ਨ ਅਰਾਧੇ ॥
Transliteration: man bairaagee kiau na araadhe |
English: O mind, O renunciate, why don't you adore Him?

Gurbani: ਕਾਚ ਕੋਠਰੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਬਸਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਖੈ ਕੀ ਬਿਆਧੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kaach kottharee maeh toon basataa sang sagal bikhai kee biaadhe |1| rahaau |
English: You dwell in that flimsy chamber, with all the sins of corruption. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਤ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਪਲੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਛੀਜੈ ਅਰਜਾਧੇ ॥
Transliteration: meree meree karat din rain bihaavai pal khin chheejai arajaadhe |
English: Crying out, "Mine, mine", your days and nights pass away; moment by moment, your life is running out.

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੇ ਮੀਠੈ ਸਾਦਿ ਲੋਭਾਏ ਝੂਠ ਧੰਧਿ ਦੁਰਗਾਧੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jaise meetthai saad lobhaae jhootth dhandh duragaadhe |2|
English: The sweet flavors tempt you, and you are occupied by your false and filthy business. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਅਰੁ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਇਹ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਰਸਿ ਲਪਟਾਧੇ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh ar lobh moh ih indree ras lapattaadhe |
English: Your senses are beguiled by sensual pleasures of sex, by anger, greed and emotional attachment.

Gurbani: ਦੀਈ ਭਵਾਰੀ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਬਿਧਾਤੈ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਜਨਮਾਧੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: deeee bhavaaree purakh bidhaatai bahur bahur janamaadhe |3|
English: The All-powerful Architect of Destiny has ordained that you shall be reincarnated over and over again. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਤਉ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਲਾਧੇ ॥
Transliteration: jau bheo kripaal deen dukh bhanjan tau gur mil sabh sukh laadhe |
English: When the Destroyer of the pains of the poor becomes merciful, then, as Gurmukh, you shall find absolute peace.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਧਿਆਵਉ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਾਢੀ ਸਗਲ ਉਪਾਧੇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak din rain dhiaavau maar kaadtee sagal upaadhe |4|
English: Says Nanak, meditate on the Lord, day and night, and all your sickness shall be banished. ||4||

Gurbani: ਇਉ ਜਪਿਓ ਭਾਈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: eiau japio bhaaee purakh bidhaate |
English: Meditate in this way, O Siblings of Destiny, on the Lord, the Architect of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖ ਲਾਥੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੨੬॥
Transliteration: bheo kripaal deen dukh bhanjan janam maran dukh laathe |1| rahaau doojaa |4|4|126|
English: The Destroyer of the pains of the poor has become merciful; He has removed the pains of birth and death. ||1||Second Pause||4||4||126||

[Ang 403 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਿਮਖ ਕਾਮ ਸੁਆਦ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਦਿਨਸ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: nimakh kaam suaad kaaran kott dinas dukh paaveh |
English: For a moment of sexual pleasure, you shall suffer in pain for millions of days.

Gurbani: ਘਰੀ ਮੁਹਤ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gharee muhat rang maaneh fir bahur bahur pachhutaaveh |1|
English: For an instant, you may savor pleasure, but afterwards, you shall regret it, again and again. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅੰਧੇ ਚੇਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: andhe chet har har raaeaa |
English: O blind man, meditate on the Lord, the Lord, your King.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਸੋ ਦਿਨੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: teraa so din nerrai aaeaa |1| rahaau |
English: Your day is drawing near. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪਲਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੂਲੋ ਆਕ ਨੀਮ ਕੋ ਤੂੰਮਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: palak drisatt dekh bhoolo aak neem ko toonmar |
English: You are deceived, beholding with your eyes, the bitter melon and swallow-wort.

Gurbani: ਜੈਸਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਬਿਸੀਅਰ ਸਿਉ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਤੈਸੋ ਹੀ ਇਹੁ ਪਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jaisaa sang biseear siau hai re taiso hee ihu par grihu |2|
English: But, like the companionship of a poisonous snake, so is the desire for another's spouse. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬੈਰੀ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਪਾਪ ਕਰਤਾ ਬਸਤੁ ਰਹੀ ਅਮਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: bairee kaaran paap karataa basat rahee amaanaa |
English: For the sake of your enemy, you commit sins, while you neglect the reality of your faith.

Gurbani: ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਸਿਉ ਸੰਗੀ ਸਾਜਨ ਸਿਉ ਬੈਰਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: chhodd jaeh tin hee siau sangee saajan siau bairaanaa |3|
English: Your friendship is with those who abandon you, and you are angry with your friends. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਇਹੈ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਆਪਿਓ ਸੋ ਉਬਰਿਓ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sagal sansaar ihai bidh biaapio so ubario jis gur pooraa |
English: The entire world is entangled in this way; he alone is saved, who has the Perfect Guru.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਿਓ ਭਏ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੨੭॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak bhav saagar tario bhe puneet sareeraa |4|5|127|
English: Says Nanak, I have crossed over the terrifying world-ocean; my body has become sanctified. ||4||5||127||

[Ang 403 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 dupade |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl Dho-Padhay:

Gurbani: ਲੂਕਿ ਕਮਾਨੋ ਸੋਈ ਤੁਮੑ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ ਮੁਕਰਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: look kamaano soee tuma pekhio moorr mugadh mukaraanee |
English: O Lord, You behold whatever we do in secrecy; the fool may stubbornly deny it.

Gurbani: ਆਪ ਕਮਾਨੇ ਕਉ ਲੇ ਬਾਂਧੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aap kamaane kau le baandhe fir paachhai pachhutaanee |1|
English: By his own actions, he is tied down, and in the end, he regrets and repents. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਆਗੈ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: prabh mere sabh bidh aagai jaanee |
English: My God knows, ahead of time, all things.

Gurbani: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੇ ਮੂਸੇ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਤ ਪਰਦਾ ਪਾਛੈ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਮਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhram ke moose toon raakhat paradaa paachhai jeea kee maanee |1| rahaau |
English: Deceived by doubt, you may hide your actions, but in the end, you shall have to confess the secrets of your mind. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਗੇ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਰੈ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: jit jit laae tith tit laage kiaa ko karai paraanee |
English: Whatever they are attached to, they remain joined to that. What can any mere mortal do?

Gurbani: ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੀ ॥੨॥੬॥੧੨੮॥
Transliteration: bakhas laihu paarabraham suaamee naanak sad kurabaanee |2|6|128|
English: Please, forgive me, O Supreme Lord Master. Nanak is forever a sacrifice to You. ||2||6||128||

[Ang 403 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਆਪੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਆਪੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: apune sevak kee aape raakhai aape naam japaavai |
English: He Himself preserves His servants; He causes them to chant His Name.

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਕਾਜ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਤਹਾ ਤਹਾ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jeh jeh kaaj kirat sevak kee tahaa tahaa utth dhaavai |1|
English: Wherever the business and affairs of His servants are, there the Lord hurries to be. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਨਿਕਟੀ ਹੋਇ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: sevak kau nikattee hoe dikhaavai |
English: The Lord appears near at hand to His servant.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਹੈ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਤਤਕਾਲ ਹੋਇ ਆਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo jo kahai tthaakur peh sevak tatakaal hoe aavai |1| rahaau |
English: Whatever the servant asks of his Lord and Master, immediately comes to pass. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਜੋ ਅਪਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: tis sevak kai hau balihaaree jo apane prabh bhaavai |
English: I am a sacrifice to that servant, who is pleasing to his God.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੋਇ ਸੁਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰਸਣਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੨੯॥
Transliteration: tis kee soe sunee man hariaa tis naanak parasan aavai |2|7|129|
English: Hearing of his glory, the mind is rejuvenated; Nanak comes to touch his feet. ||2||7||129||

[Ang 403 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੧੧ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa ghar 11 mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Eleventh House, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਨਟੂਆ ਭੇਖ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਜੈਸਾ ਹੈ ਓਹੁ ਤੈਸਾ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: nattooaa bhekh dikhaavai bahu bidh jaisaa hai ohu taisaa re |
English: The actor displays himself in many disguises, but he remains just as he is.

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਓ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸੁਖਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਰਵੇਸਾ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: anik jon bhramio bhram bheetar sukheh naahee paravesaa re |1|
English: The soul wanders through countless incarnations in doubt, but it does not come to dwell in peace. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਾਜਨ ਸੰਤ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਨੀਤਾ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: saajan sant hamaare meetaa bin har har aaneetaa re |
English: O Saints, my friends and companions, without the Lord, Har, Har, you shall perish.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਇਹੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜੀਤਾ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang mil har gun gaae ihu janam padaarath jeetaa re |1| rahaau |
English: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and win this precious treasure of human life. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਕੀਨੑੀ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਵਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਤਰੀਐ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: trai gun maaeaa braham kee keenaee kahahu kavan bidh tareeai re |
English: God has created Maya of the three qualities; tell me, how can it be crossed over?

Gurbani: ਘੂਮਨ ਘੇਰ ਅਗਾਹ ਗਾਖਰੀ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਰੀਐ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ghooman gher agaah gaakharee gurasabadee paar utareeai re |2|
English: The whirlpool is awesome and unfathomable; only through the Word of the Guru's Shabad is one carried across. ||2||

Gurbani: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਤਤੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਜਾਨਾ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: khojat khojat khoj beechaario tat naanak ihu jaanaa re |
English: Searching and searching endlessly, seeking and deliberating, Nanak has realized the true essence of reality.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਪਤੀਆਨਾ ਰੇ ॥੩॥੧॥੧੩੦॥
Transliteration: simarat naam nidhaan niramolak man maanak pateeaanaa re |3|1|130|
English: Meditating on the invaluable treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the jewel of the mind is satisfied. ||3||1||130||

[Ang 404 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 dupade |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Dho-Padhay:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਜੋ ਮਾਗਉ ਸੋ ਪਾਵਉ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaad merai man vasiaa jo maagau so paavau re |
English: By Guru's Grace, He dwells within my mind; whatever I ask for, I receive.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨਾ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਧਾਵਉ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naam rang ihu man tripataanaa bahur na katahoon dhaavau re |1|
English: This mind is satisfied with the Love of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; it does not go out, anywhere, anymore. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਮਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਗਾਵਉ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: hamaraa tthaakur sabh te aoochaa rain dinas tis gaavau re |
English: My Lord and Master is the highest of all; night and day, I sing the Glories of His Praises.

Gurbani: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਨਹਾਰਾ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਡਰਾਵਉ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: khin meh thaap uthaapanahaaraa tis te tujheh ddaraavau re |1| rahaau |
English: In an instant, He establishes and disestablishes; through Him, I frighten you. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਦੇਖਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਉ ਅਵਰਹਿ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਉ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jab dekhau prabh apunaa suaamee tau avareh cheet na paavau re |
English: When I behold my God, my Lord and Master, I do not pay any attention to any other.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਪਹਿਰਾਇਆ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਮੇਟਿ ਲਿਖਾਵਉ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੩੧॥
Transliteration: naanak daas prabh aap pahiraaeaa bhram bhau mett likhaavau re |2|2|131|
English: God Himself has adorned servant Nanak; his doubts and fears have been dispelled, and he writes the account of the Lord. ||2||2||131||

[Ang 404 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਚਾਰਿ ਬਰਨ ਚਉਹਾ ਕੇ ਮਰਦਨ ਖਟੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਰ ਤਲੀ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: chaar baran chauhaa ke maradan khatt darasan kar talee re |
English: The four castes and social classes, and the preachers with the six Shaastras on their finger-tips,

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸੁਘਰ ਸਰੂਪ ਸਿਆਨੇ ਪੰਚਹੁ ਹੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਛਲੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sundar sughar saroop siaane panchahu hee mohi chhalee re |1|
English: the beautiful, the refined, the shapely and the wise - the five passions have enticed and beguiled them all. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਪੰਚ ਸੂਰਬੀਰ ਐਸੋ ਕਉਨੁ ਬਲੀ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jin mil maare panch soorabeer aiso kaun balee re |
English: Who has seized and conquered the five powerful fighters? Is there anyone strong enough?

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਪੰਚ ਮਾਰਿ ਬਿਦਾਰਿ ਗੁਦਾਰੇ ਸੋ ਪੂਰਾ ਇਹ ਕਲੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jin panch maar bidaar gudaare so pooraa ih kalee re |1| rahaau |
English: He alone, who conquers and defeats the five demons, is perfect in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਵਡੀ ਕੋਮ ਵਸਿ ਭਾਗਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੁਹਕਮ ਫਉਜ ਹਠਲੀ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: vaddee kom vas bhaageh naahee muhakam fauj hatthalee re |
English: They are so awesome and great; they cannot be controlled, and they do not run away. Their army is mighty and unyielding.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਨਿਰਦਲਿਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਝਲੀ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੩॥੧੩੨॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak tin jan niradaliaa saadhasangat kai jhalee re |2|3|132|
English: Says Nanak, that humble being who is under the protection of the Saadh Sangat, crushes those terrible demons. ||2||3||132||

[Ang 404 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨੀਕੀ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਊਤਮ ਆਨ ਸਗਲ ਰਸ ਫੀਕੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: neekee jeea kee har kathaa aootam aan sagal ras feekee re |1| rahaau |
English: The Sublime Sermon of the Lord is the best thing for the soul. All other tastes are insipid. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਹੁ ਗੁਨਿ ਧੁਨਿ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਖਟੁ ਬੇਤੇ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਿਛੁ ਲਾਈਕੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bahu gun dhun mun jan khatt bete avar na kichh laaeekee re |1|
English: The worthy beings, heavenly singers, silent sages and the knowers of the six Shaastras proclaim that nothing else is worthy of consideration. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਿਖਾਰੀ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ਅਪਾਰੀ ਸਹਜਾਰੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੀਕੀ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੪॥੧੩੩॥
Transliteration: bikhaaree niraaree apaaree sahajaaree saadhasang naanak peekee re |2|4|133|
English: It is the cure for evil passions, unique, unequalled and peace-giving; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, drink it in. ||2||4||133||

[Ang 404 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਮਾਰੀ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਟਾਰੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hamaaree piaaree amrit dhaaree gur nimakh na man te ttaaree re |1| rahaau |
English: My Beloved has brought forth a river of nectar. The Guru has not held it back from my mind, even for an instant. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦਰਸਨ ਪਰਸਨ ਸਰਸਨ ਹਰਸਨ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗੀ ਕਰਤਾਰੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: darasan parasan sarasan harasan rang rangee karataaree re |1|
English: Beholding it, and touching it, I am sweetened and delighted. It is imbued with the Creator's Love. ||1||

Gurbani: ਖਿਨੁ ਰਮ ਗੁਰ ਗਮ ਹਰਿ ਦਮ ਨਹ ਜਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਠਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਉਰਿ ਹਾਰੀ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੫॥੧੩੪॥
Transliteration: khin ram gur gam har dam neh jam har kantth naanak ur haaree re |2|5|134|
English: Chanting it even for a moment, I rise to the Guru; meditating on it, one is not trapped by the Messenger of Death. The Lord has placed it as a garland around Nanak's neck, and within his heart. ||2||5||134||

[Ang 404 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨੀਕੀ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਾਨੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: neekee saadh sangaanee | rahaau |
English: The Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is exalted and sublime. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪਹਰ ਮੂਰਤ ਪਲ ਗਾਵਤ ਗਾਵਤ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਵਖਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: pehar moorat pal gaavat gaavat govind govind vakhaanee |1|
English: Every day, hour and moment, I continually sing and speak of Govind, Govind, the Lord of the Universe. ||1||

Gurbani: ਚਾਲਤ ਬੈਸਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਚਰਨ ਖਟਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: chaalat baisat sovat har jas man tan charan khattaanee |2|
English: Walking, sitting and sleeping, I chant the Lord's Praises; I treasure His Feet in my mind and body. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਂਉ ਹਉਰੋ ਤੂ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਗਉਰੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਛਾਨੀ ॥੩॥੬॥੧੩੫॥
Transliteration: hnau hauro too tthaakur gauro naanak saran pachhaanee |3|6|135|
English: I am so small, and You are so great, O Lord and Master; Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary. ||3||6||135||

[Ang 405 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧੨ ॥
Transliteration: raag aasaa mahalaa 5 ghar 12 |
English: Raag Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Twelfth House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਆਨਪਾ ਭਜੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: tiaag sagal siaanapaa bhaj paarabraham nirankaar |
English: Renounce all your cleverness and remember the Supreme, Formless Lord God.

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਸਗਲ ਦੀਸੈ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ek saache naam baajhahu sagal deesai chhaar |1|
English: Without the One True Name, everything appears as dust. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਸਦ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: so prabh jaaneeai sad sang |
English: Know that God is always with you.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੂਝੀਐ ਏਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur prasaadee boojheeai ek har kai rang |1| rahaau |
English: By Guru's Grace, one understands, and is imbued with the Love of the One Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਰਣਿ ਸਮਰਥ ਏਕ ਕੇਰੀ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਠਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saran samarath ek keree doojaa naahee tthaau |
English: Seek the Shelter of the One All-powerful Lord; there is no other place of rest.

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਲੰਘੀਐ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mahaa bhaujal langheeai sadaa har gun gaau |2|
English: The vast and terrifying world-ocean is crossed over, singing continually the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੀਐ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: janam maran nivaareeai dukh na jam pur hoe |
English: Birth and death are overcome, and one does not have to suffer in the City of Death.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naam nidhaan soee paae kripaa kare prabh soe |3|
English: He alone obtains the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, unto whom God shows His Mercy. ||3||

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਏਕੋ ਏਕ ਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: ek ttek adhaar eko ek kaa man jor |
English: The One Lord is my Anchor and Support; the One Lord alone is the power of my mind.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪੀਐ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਹੋਰੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੩੬॥
Transliteration: naanak japeeai mil saadhasangat har bin avar na hor |4|1|136|
English: O Nanak, joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, meditate on Him; without the Lord, there is no other at all. ||4||1||136||

[Ang 405 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਦੀਏ ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: jeeo man tan praan prabh ke dee sabh ras bhog |
English: The soul, the mind, the body and the breath of life belong to God. He has given all tastes and pleasures.

Gurbani: ਦੀਨ ਬੰਧਪ ਜੀਅ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਰਣਿ ਰਾਖਣ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: deen bandhap jeea daataa saran raakhan jog |1|
English: He is the Friend of the poor, the Giver of life, the Protector of those who seek His Sanctuary. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mere man dhiaae har har naau |
English: O my mind, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਸਹਾਇ ਸੰਗੇ ਏਕ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: halat palat sahaae sange ek siau liv laau |1| rahaau |
English: Here and hereafter, He is our Helper and Companion; embrace love and affection for the One Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬੇਦ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਜਨ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਤਰਣ ਕਉ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: bed saasatr jan dhiaaveh taran kau sansaar |
English: They meditate on the Vedas and the Shaastras, to swim across the world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਅਨੇਕ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਚਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: karam dharam anek kiriaa sabh aoopar naam achaar |2|
English: The many religious rituals, good deeds of karma and Dharmic worship - above all of these is the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh ahankaar binasai milai satigur dev |
English: Sexual desire, anger, and egotism depart, meeting with the Divine True Guru.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naam drirr kar bhagat har kee bhalee prabh kee sev |3|
English: Implant the Naam within, perform devotional worship to the Lord and serve God - this is good. ||3||

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਦਇਆਲ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂੰ ਨਿਮਾਣੇ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: charan saran deaal teree toon nimaane maan |
English: I seek the Sanctuary of Your Feet, O Merciful Lord; You are the Honor of the dishonored.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੩੭॥
Transliteration: jeea praan adhaar teraa naanak kaa prabh taan |4|2|137|
English: You are the Support of my soul, my breath of life; O God, You are Nanak's strength. ||4||2||137||

[Ang 405 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਡੋਲਿ ਡੋਲਿ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਿਨਾ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗ ॥
Transliteration: ddol ddol mahaa dukh paaeaa binaa saadhoo sang |
English: He wavers and falters, and suffers such great pain, without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਖਾਟਿ ਲਾਭੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਇਕ ਰੰਗ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: khaatt laabh gobind har ras paarabraham ik rang |1|
English: The profit of the sublime essence of the Lord of the Universe is obtained, by the Love of the One Supreme Lord God. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਨੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: har ko naam japeeai neet |
English: Chant continually the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਅਵਰ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saas saas dhiaae so prabh tiaag avar pareet |1| rahaau |
English: With each and every breath, meditate on God, and renounce other love. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜੀਅ ਦਾਤਾ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: karan kaaran samarath so prabh jeea daataa aap |
English: God is the Doer, the All-powerful Cause of causes; He Himself is the Giver of life.

Gurbani: ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tiaag sagal siaanapaa aatth pehar prabh jaap |2|
English: So renounce all your cleverness, and meditate on God, twenty-four hours a day. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮੀਤੁ ਸਖਾ ਸਹਾਇ ਸੰਗੀ ਊਚ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: meet sakhaa sahaae sangee aooch agam apaar |
English: He is our best friend and companion, our help and support; He is lofty, inaccessible and infinite.

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਬਸਾਇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜੀਅ ਕੋ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: charan kamal basaae hiradai jeea ko aadhaar |3|
English: Enshrine His Lotus Feet within your heart; He is the Support of the soul. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh paarabraham gun teraa jas gaau |
English: Show Your Mercy, O Supreme Lord God, that I may sing Your Glorious Praises.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੩੮॥
Transliteration: sarab sookh vaddee vaddiaaee jap jeevai naanak naau |4|3|138|
English: Total peace, and the greatest greatness, O Nanak, are obtained by living to chant the Name of the Lord. ||4||3||138||

[Ang 405 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਉ ਕਰਾਵਹੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪੇਖਤ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: audam krau karaavahu tthaakur pekhat saadhoo sang |
English: I make the effort, as You cause me to do, my Lord and Master, to behold You in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਰਾਵਹੁ ਰੰਗਨਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har har naam charaavahu rangan aape hee prabh rang |1|
English: I am imbued with the color of the Love of the Lord, Har, Har; God Himself has colored me in His Love. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: man meh raam naamaa jaap |
English: I chant the Lord's Name within my mind.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਵਸਹੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹੋਇ ਸਹਾਈ ਆਪਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa vasahu merai hiradai hoe sahaaee aap |1| rahaau |
English: Bestow Your Mercy, and dwell within my heart; please, become my Helper. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੇਖਨ ਕਾ ਚਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sun sun naam tumaaraa preetam prabh pekhan kaa chaau |
English: Listening continually to Your Name, O Beloved God, I yearn to behold You.

Gurbani: ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਰਮ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਉ ਇਹੈ ਮਨੋਰਥੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: deaa karahu kiram apune kau ihai manorath suaau |2|
English: Please, be kind to me - I am just a worm. This is my object and purpose. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਮਰੈ ਵਸਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: tan dhan teraa toon prabh meraa hamarai vas kichh naeh |
English: My body and wealth are Yours; You are my God - nothing is in my power.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਤਿਉ ਰਹਣਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਦੀਆ ਖਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jiau jiau raakheh tiau tiau rahanaa teraa deea khaeh |3|
English: As You keep me, so do I live; I eat what You give me. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਾਟੈ ਮਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: janam janam ke kilavikh kaattai majan har jan dhoor |
English: The sins of countless incarnations are washed away, by bathing in the dust of the Lord's humble servants.

Gurbani: ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰਮ ਭਉ ਨਾਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੩੯॥
Transliteration: bhaae bhagat bharam bhau naasai har naanak sadaa hajoor |4|4|139|
English: By loving devotional worship, doubt and fear depart; O Nanak, the Lord is Ever-present. ||4||4||139||

[Ang 406 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: agam agochar daras teraa so paae jis masatak bhaag |
English: The Blessed Vision of Your Darshan is unapproachable and incomprehensible; he alone obtains it, who has such good destiny recorded upon his forehead.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬਖਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aap kripaal kripaa prabh dhaaree satigur bakhasiaa har naam |1|
English: The Merciful Lord God has bestowed His Mercy, and the True Guru has granted the Lord's Name. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਲਿਜੁਗੁ ਉਧਾਰਿਆ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: kalijug udhaariaa guradev |
English: The Divine Guru is the Saving Grace in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.

Gurbani: ਮਲ ਮੂਤ ਮੂੜ ਜਿ ਮੁਘਦ ਹੋਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਲਗੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mal moot moorr ji mughad hote sabh lage teree sev |1| rahaau |
English: Even those fools and idiots, stained with feces and urine, have all taken to Your service. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਰਤਾ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: too aap karataa sabh srisatt dharataa sabh meh rahiaa samaae |
English: You Yourself are the Creator, who established the entire world. You are contained in all.

Gurbani: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਜਾ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਭ ਪਈ ਪੈਰੀ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: dharam raajaa bisamaad hoaa sabh pee pairee aae |2|
English: The Righteous Judge of Dharma is wonder-struck, at the sight of everyone falling at the Lord's Feet. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਤਜੁਗੁ ਤ੍ਰੇਤਾ ਦੁਆਪਰੁ ਭਣੀਐ ਕਲਿਜੁਗੁ ਊਤਮੋ ਜੁਗਾ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: satajug tretaa duaapar bhaneeai kalijug aootamo jugaa maeh |
English: The Golden Age of Sat Yuga, the Silver Age of Trayta Yuga, and the Brass Age of Dwaapar Yuga are good; but the best is the Dark Age, the Iron Age, of Kali Yuga.

Gurbani: ਅਹਿ ਕਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਅਹਿ ਕਰੁ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਈ ਨ ਪਕੜੀਐ ਕਿਸੈ ਥਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: eh kar kare su eh kar paae koee na pakarreeai kisai thaae |3|
English: As we act, so are the rewards we receive; no one can take the place of another. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਿ ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਾਚਹਿ ਏਹੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: har jeeo soee kareh ji bhagat tere jaacheh ehu teraa birad |
English: O Dear Lord, whatever Your devotees ask for, You do. This is Your Way, Your very nature.

Gurbani: ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਨੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਅਪਣਿਆ ਸੰਤਾ ਦੇਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸੁ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੪੦॥
Transliteration: kar jorr naanak daan maagai apaniaa santaa dehi har daras |4|5|140|
English: With my palms pressed together, O Nanak, I beg for this gift; Lord, please bless Your Saints with Your Vision. ||4||5||140||

[Ang 406 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧੩ ॥
Transliteration: raag aasaa mahalaa 5 ghar 13 |
English: Raag Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Thirteenth House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur bachan tumaare |
English: O True Guru, by Your Words,

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: niragun nisataare |1| rahaau |
English: even the worthless have been saved. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਾਦੀ ਦੁਸਟ ਅਪਵਾਦੀ ਤੇ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਸੰਗਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mahaa bikhaadee dusatt apavaadee te puneet sangaare |1|
English: Even the most argumentative, vicious and indecent people, have been purified in Your company. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਭਵੰਤੇ ਨਰਕਿ ਪੜੰਤੇ ਤਿਨੑ ਕੇ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: janam bhavante narak parrante tina ke kul udhaare |2|
English: Those who have wandered in reincarnation, and those who have been consigned to hell - even their families have been redeemed. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮਾਨੈ ਸੇ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: koe na jaanai koe na maanai se paragatt har duaare |3|
English: Those whom no one knew, and those whom no one respected - even they have become famous and respected at the Court of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਵਨ ਉਪਮਾ ਦੇਉ ਕਵਨ ਵਡਾਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਵਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੪੧॥
Transliteration: kavan upamaa deo kavan vaddaaee naanak khin khin vaare |4|1|141|
English: What praise, and what greatness should I attribute to You? Nanak is a sacrifice to You, each and every moment. ||4||1||141||

[Ang 406 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬਾਵਰ ਸੋਇ ਰਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: baavar soe rahe |1| rahaau |
English: The crazy people are asleep. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੋਹ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਬਿਖੈ ਰਸ ਮਾਤੇ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਗਹਨ ਗਹੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: moh kuttanb bikhai ras maate mithiaa gehan gahe |1|
English: They are intoxicated with attachment to their families and sensory pleasures; they are held in the grip of falsehood. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਿਥਨ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਸੁਪਨ ਆਨੰਦ ਉਲਾਸ ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਹੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mithan manorath supan aanand ulaas man mukh sat kahe |2|
English: The false desires, and the dream-like delights and pleasures - these, the self-willed manmukhs call true. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਸੰਗੇ ਤਿਲੁ ਮਰਮੁ ਨ ਲਹੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: amrit naam padaarath sange til maram na lahe |3|
English: The wealth of the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, is with them, but they do not find even a tiny bit of its mystery. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਾਖੇ ਸਤਸੰਗੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਆਹੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੪੨॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa raakhe satasange naanak saran aahe |4|2|142|
English: By Your Grace, O Lord, You save those, who take to the Sanctuary of the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. ||4||2||142||

[Ang 406 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਤਿਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 tipade |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Thi-Padhay:

Gurbani: ਓਹਾ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ohaa prem piree |1| rahaau |
English: I seek the Love of my Beloved. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਨਿਕ ਮਾਣਿਕ ਗਜ ਮੋਤੀਅਨ ਲਾਲਨ ਨਹ ਨਾਹ ਨਹੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kanik maanik gaj moteean laalan neh naah nahee |1|
English: Gold, jewels, giant pearls and rubies - I have no need for them. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਜ ਨ ਭਾਗ ਨ ਹੁਕਮ ਨ ਸਾਦਨ ॥ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਚਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: raaj na bhaag na hukam na saadan | kichh kichh na chaahee |2|
English: Imperial power, fortunes, royal command and mansions - I have no desire for these. ||2||

Gurbani: ਚਰਨਨ ਸਰਨਨ ਸੰਤਨ ਬੰਦਨ ॥ ਸੁਖੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਹੀ ॥ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਪਤਿ ਹਰੀ ॥ ਮਿਲੇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਰੀ ॥੩॥੩॥੧੪੩॥
Transliteration: charanan saranan santan bandan | sukho sukh paahee | naanak tapat haree | mile prem piree |3|3|143|
English: The Sanctuary of the Lord's Feet, and dedication to the Saints these bring me peace and pleasure. O Nanak, my burning fire has been put out, obtaining the Love of the Beloved. ||3||3||143||

[Ang 407 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ਲੋਇਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gureh dikhaaeo loeinaa |1| rahaau |
English: The Guru has revealed Him to my eyes. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਈਤਹਿ ਊਤਹਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਤੂੰਹੀ ਤੂੰਹੀ ਮੋਹਿਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: eeteh aooteh ghatt ghatt ghatt ghatt toonhee toonhee mohinaa |1|
English: Here and there, in each and every heart, and each and every being, You, O Fascinating Lord, You exist. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨਾ ਧਾਰਨ ਧਰਨਾ ਏਕੈ ਏਕੈ ਸੋਹਿਨਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kaaran karanaa dhaaran dharanaa ekai ekai sohinaa |2|
English: You are the Creator, the Cause of causes, the Support of the earth; You are the One and only, Beauteous Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਨ ਪਰਸਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਦਰਸਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੋਇਨਾ ॥੩॥੪॥੧੪੪॥
Transliteration: santan parasan balihaaree darasan naanak sukh sukh soeinaa |3|4|144|
English: Meeting the Saints, and beholding the Blessed Vision of their Darshan, Nanak is a sacrifice to them; he sleeps in absolute peace. ||3||4||144||

[Ang 407 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam amolaa |
English: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is priceless.

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ohu sehaj suhelaa |1| rahaau |
English: It brings peace and poise. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਓਹੁ ਅਗਹ ਅਤੋਲਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sang sahaaee chhodd na jaaee ohu agah atolaa |1|
English: The Lord is my Companion and Helper; He shall not forsake me or leave me. He is unfathomable and unequalled. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਭਾਈ ਬਾਪੁ ਮੋਰੋ ਮਾਈ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਾ ਓਲੑਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: preetam bhaaee baap moro maaee bhagatan kaa olaa |2|
English: He is my Beloved, my brother, father and mother; He is the Support of His devotees. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਚੋਲੑਾ ॥੩॥੫॥੧੪੫॥
Transliteration: alakh lakhaaeaa gur te paaeaa naanak ihu har kaa cholaa |3|5|145|
English: The Invisible Lord is seen through the Guru; O Nanak, this is the wondrous play of the Lord. ||3||5||145||

[Ang 407 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਪੁਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਬਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: aapunee bhagat nibaeh |
English: Please help me sustain my devotion.

Gurbani: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਆਇਓ ਆਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tthaakur aaeo aaeh |1| rahaau |
English: O Lord Master, I have come to You. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਕਾਰਥੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਚਰਨ ਬਸਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naam padaarath hoe sakaarath hiradai charan basaeh |1|
English: With the wealth of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, life becomes fruitful. Lord, please place Your Feet within my heart. ||1||

Gurbani: ਏਹ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਏਹ ਜੁਗਤਾ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: eeh mukataa eeh jugataa raakhahu sant sangaeh |2|
English: This is liberation, and this is the best way of life; please, keep me in the Society of the Saints. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਉ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਹਿ ॥੩॥੬॥੧੪੬॥
Transliteration: naam dhiaavau sehaj samaavau naanak har gun gaeh |3|6|146|
English: Meditating on the Naam, I am absorbed in celestial peace; O Nanak, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||6||146||

[Ang 407 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ ॥
Transliteration: tthaakur charan suhaave |
English: The Feet of my Lord and Master are so Beautiful!

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਪਾਵੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har santan paave |1| rahaau |
English: The Lord's Saints obtain them. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਇਆ ਗੁਨ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਗਾਵੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aap gavaaeaa sev kamaaeaa gun ras ras gaave |1|
English: They eradicate their self-conceit and serve the Lord; drenched in His Love, they sing His Glorious Praises. ||1||

Gurbani: ਏਕਹਿ ਆਸਾ ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸਾ ਆਨ ਨ ਭਾਵੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ekeh aasaa daras piaasaa aan na bhaave |2|
English: They place their hopes in Him, and they thirst for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. Nothing else is pleasing to them. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦਇਆ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ ਕਿਆ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਵੇ ॥੩॥੭॥੧੪੭॥
Transliteration: deaa tuhaaree kiaa jant vichaaree naanak bal bal jaave |3|7|147|
English: This is Your Mercy, Lord; what can Your poor creatures do? Nanak is devoted, a sacrifice to You. ||3||7||147||

[Ang 407 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ek simar man maahee |1| rahaau |
English: Remember the One Lord in meditation within your mind. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸਾਵਹੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naam dhiaavahu ridai basaavahu tis bin ko naahee |1|
English: Meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and enshrine Him within your heart. Without Him there is no other. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਨੀ ਆਈਐ ਸਰਬ ਫਲ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੁਖ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: prabh saranee aaeeai sarab fal paaeeai sagale dukh jaahee |2|
English: Entering God's Sanctuary, all rewards are obtained, and all pains are taken away. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੀਅਨ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਆਹੀ ॥੩॥੮॥੧੪੮॥
Transliteration: jeean ko daataa purakh bidhaataa naanak ghatt ghatt aahee |3|8|148|
English: He is the Giver of all beings, the Architect of Destiny; O Nanak, He is contained in each and every heart. ||3||8||148||

[Ang 407 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਸੋ ਮੂਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har bisarat so mooaa |1| rahaau |
English: One who forgets the Lord is dead. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਸਰਬ ਫਲ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਹੂਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naam dhiaavai sarab fal paavai so jan sukheea hooaa |1|
English: One who meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, obtains all rewards. That person becomes happy. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਜੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਹਉ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਨਲਿਨੀ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਸੂਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: raaj kahaavai hau karam kamaavai baadhio nalinee bhram sooaa |2|
English: One who calls himself a king, and acts in ego and pride, is caught by his doubts, like a parrot in a trap. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਥੀਆ ॥੩॥੯॥੧੪੯॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak jis satigur bhettiaa so jan nihachal theea |3|9|149|
English: Says Nanak, one who meets the True Guru, becomes permanent and immortal. ||3||9||149||

[Ang 407 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧੪ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ghar 14 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Fourteenth House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਨੇਹੁ ਨਵੇਲਾ ॥ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ohu nehu navelaa | apune preetam siau laag rahai |1| rahaau |
English: That love is forever fresh and new, Which is for the Beloved Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰਚੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jo prabh bhaavai janam na aavai | har prem bhagat har preet rachai |1|
English: One who is pleasing to God shall not be reincarnated again. He remains absorbed in the loving devotional worship of the Lord, in the Love of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲੀਜੈ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਅਪਨੀ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੫੦॥
Transliteration: prabh sang mileejai ihu man deejai | naanak naam milai apanee deaa karahu |2|1|150|
English: He is blended with God, by dedicating his mind to Him. Bless Nanak with Your Name, O Lord - please, shower Your Mercy upon him! ||2||1||150||

[Ang 408 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਿਲੁ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤੁਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਕੋ ਨ ਕਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mil raam piaare tum bin dheeraj ko na karai |1| rahaau |
English: Please, come to me, O Beloved Lord; without You, no one can comfort me. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਦਰਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sinmrit saasatr bahu karam kamaae prabh tumare daras bin sukh naahee |1|
English: One may read the Simritees and the Shaastras, and perform all sorts of religious rituals; and yet, without the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, God, there is no peace at all. ||1||

Gurbani: ਵਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਸੰਜਮ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਸਰਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਵਸੈ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੫੧॥
Transliteration: varat nem sanjam kar thaake naanak saadh saran prabh sang vasai |2|2|151|
English: People have grown weary of observing fasts, vows and rigorous self-discipline; Nanak abides with God, in the Sanctuary of the Saints. ||2||2||151||

[Ang 408 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧੫ ਪੜਤਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ghar 15 parrataal |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Fifteenth House, Partaal:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਾਦਿ ਸੋਇਓ ਸੂਝ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: bikaar maaeaa maad soeo soojh boojh na aavai |
English: He sleeps, intoxicated by corruption and Maya; he does not come to realize or understand.

Gurbani: ਪਕਰਿ ਕੇਸ ਜਮਿ ਉਠਾਰਿਓ ਤਦ ਹੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: pakar kes jam utthaario tad hee ghar jaavai |1|
English: Seizing him by the hair, the Messenger of Death pulls him up; then, he comes to his senses. ||1||

Gurbani: ਲੋਭ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਖੈ ਲਾਗੇ ਹਿਰਿ ਵਿਤ ਚਿਤ ਦੁਖਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: lobh bikhiaa bikhai laage hir vit chit dukhaahee |
English: Those who are attached to the poison of greed and sin grab at the wealth of others; they only bring pain on themselves.

Gurbani: ਖਿਨ ਭੰਗੁਨਾ ਕੈ ਮਾਨਿ ਮਾਤੇ ਅਸੁਰ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: khin bhangunaa kai maan maate asur jaaneh naahee |1| rahaau |
English: They are intoxicated by their pride in those things which shall be destroyed in an instant; those demons do not understand. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬੇਦ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਜਨ ਪੁਕਾਰਹਿ ਸੁਨੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਡੋਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: bed saasatr jan pukaareh sunai naahee ddoraa |
English: The Vedas, the Shaastras and the holy men proclaim it, but the deaf do not hear it.

Gurbani: ਨਿਪਟਿ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰਿ ਮੂਕਾ ਪਛੁਤਾਇਓ ਮਨਿ ਭੋਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: nipatt baajee haar mookaa pachhutaaeo man bhoraa |2|
English: When the game of life is over, and he has lost, and he breathes his last, then the fool regrets and repents in his mind. ||2||

Gurbani: ਡਾਨੁ ਸਗਲ ਗੈਰ ਵਜਹਿ ਭਰਿਆ ਦੀਵਾਨ ਲੇਖੈ ਨ ਪਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: ddaan sagal gair vajeh bhariaa deevaan lekhai na pariaa |
English: He paid the fine, but it is in vain - in the Court of the Lord, his account is not credited.

Gurbani: ਜੇਂਹ ਕਾਰਜਿ ਰਹੈ ਓਲੑਾ ਸੋਇ ਕਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jenh kaaraj rahai olaa soe kaam na kariaa |3|
English: Those deeds which would have covered him - those deeds, he has not done. ||3||

Gurbani: ਐਸੋ ਜਗੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ਤਉ ਏਕ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aiso jag mohi gur dikhaaeo tau ek keerat gaaeaa |
English: The Guru has shown me the world to be thus; I sing the Kirtan of the Praises of the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਾਨੁ ਤਾਨੁ ਤਜਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੫੨॥
Transliteration: maan taan taj siaanap saran naanak aaeaa |4|1|152|
English: Renouncing his pride in strength and cleverness, Nanak has come to the Lord's Sanctuary. ||4||1||152||

[Ang 408 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬਾਪਾਰਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਨਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: baapaar govind naae |
English: Dealing in the Name of the Lord of the Universe,

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਸੰਤ ਮਨਾਏ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ਪੰਚ ਨਾਦ ਤੂਰ ਬਜਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saadh sant manaae pria paae gun gaae panch naad toor bajaae |1| rahaau |
English: and pleasing the Saints and holy men, obtain the Beloved Lord and sing His Glorious Praises; play the sound current of the Naad with the five instruments. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਾਏ ਸਹਜਾਏ ਦਰਸਾਏ ਅਬ ਰਾਤਿਆ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਸਿਉ ॥
Transliteration: kirapaa paae sahajaae darasaae ab raatiaa govind siau |
English: Obtaining His Mercy, I easily gained the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; now, I am imbued with the Love of the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਸੇਵਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਾਥ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਲਨ ਲਾਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sant sev preet naath rang laalan laae |1|
English: Serving the Saints, I feel love and affection for my Beloved Lord Master. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਰਹਸਾਏ ਨਹੀ ਆਏ ਸਹਜਾਏ ਮਨਿ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur giaan man drirraae rahasaae nahee aae sahajaae man nidhaan paae |
English: The Guru has implanted spiritual wisdom within my mind, and I rejoice that I shall not have to come back again. I have obtained celestial poise, and the treasure within my mind.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਤਜੀ ਮਨੈ ਕੀ ਕਾਮ ਕਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabh tajee manai kee kaam karaa |
English: I have renounced all of the affairs of my mind's desires.

Gurbani: ਚਿਰੁ ਚਿਰੁ ਚਿਰੁ ਚਿਰੁ ਭਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪਿਆਸ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: chir chir chir chir bheaa man bahut piaas laagee |
English: It has been so long, so long, so long, so very long, since my mind has felt such a great thirst.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੋ ਦਿਖਾਵਹੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਬਤਾਵਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: har darasano dikhaavahu mohi tum bataavahu |
English: Please, reveal to me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, and show Yourself to me.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਨ ਸਰਣਿ ਆਏ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਏ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੫੩॥
Transliteration: naanak deen saran aae gal laae |2|2|153|
English: Nanak the meek has entered Your Sanctuary; please, take me in Your embrace. ||2||2||153||

[Ang 408 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕੋਊ ਬਿਖਮ ਗਾਰ ਤੋਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: koaoo bikham gaar torai |
English: Who can destroy the fortress of sin,

Gurbani: ਆਸ ਪਿਆਸ ਧੋਹ ਮੋਹ ਭਰਮ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਹੋਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aas piaas dhoh moh bharam hee te horai |1| rahaau |
English: and release me from hope, thirst, deception, attachment and doubt? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮਾਨ ਇਹ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਛੋਰੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh lobh maan ih biaadh chhorai |1|
English: How can I escape the afflictions of sexual desire, anger, greed and pride? ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਗੁਨ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: santasang naam rang gun govind gaavau |
English: In the Society of the Saints, love the Naam, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: anadino prabh dhiaavau |
English: Night and day, meditate on God.

Gurbani: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੀਤਿ ਜੀਤਿ ਮਿਟਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhram bheet jeet mittaavau |
English: I have captured and demolished the walls of doubt.

Gurbani: ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੋਰੈ ॥੨॥੩॥੧੫੪॥
Transliteration: nidh naam naanak morai |2|3|154|
English: O Nanak, the Naam is my only treasure. ||2||3||154||

[Ang 408 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਤਿਆਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh lobh tiaag |
English: Renounce sexual desire, anger and greed;

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: man simar gobind naam |
English: remember the Name of the Lord of the Universe in your mind.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨ ਸਫਲ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har bhajan safal kaam |1| rahaau |
English: Meditation on the Lord is the only fruitful action. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਜਪਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: taj maan moh vikaar mithiaa jap raam raam raam |
English: Renounce pride, attachment, corruption and falsehood, and chant the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਸੰਤਨਾ ਕੈ ਚਰਨਿ ਲਾਗੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: man santanaa kai charan laag |1|
English: O mortal, attach yourself to the Feet of the Saints. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਜਾਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: prabh gopaal deen deaal patit paavan paarabraham har charan simar jaag |
English: God is the Sustainer of the world, Merciful to the meek, the Purifier of sinners, the Transcendent Lord God. Awaken, and meditate on His Feet.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਾਗੁ ॥੨॥੪॥੧੫੫॥
Transliteration: kar bhagat naanak pooran bhaag |2|4|155|
English: Perform His devotional worship, O Nanak, and your destiny shall be fulfilled. ||2||4||155||

[Ang 409 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਬੈਰਾਗ ਅਨੰਦੀ ਖੇਲੁ ਰੀ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: harakh sog bairaag anandee khel ree dikhaaeo |1| rahaau |
English: Pleasure and pain, detachment and ecstasy - the Lord has revealed His Play. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਖਿਨਹੂੰ ਭੈ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਖਿਨਹੂੰ ਖਿਨਹੂੰ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: khinahoon bhai nirabhai khinahoon khinahoon utth dhaaeo |
English: One moment, the mortal is in fear, and the next moment he is fearless; in a moment, he gets up and departs.

Gurbani: ਖਿਨਹੂੰ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਨ ਖਿਨਹੂੰ ਖਿਨਹੂ ਤਜਿ ਜਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: khinahoon ras bhogan khinahoon khinahoo taj jaaeo |1|
English: One moment, he enjoys pleasures, and the next moment, he leaves and goes away. ||1||

Gurbani: ਖਿਨਹੂੰ ਜੋਗ ਤਾਪ ਬਹੁ ਪੂਜਾ ਖਿਨਹੂੰ ਭਰਮਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: khinahoon jog taap bahu poojaa khinahoon bharamaaeo |
English: One moment, he practices Yoga and intense meditation, and all sorts of worship; the next moment, he wanders in doubt.

Gurbani: ਖਿਨਹੂੰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇਓ ॥੨॥੫॥੧੫੬॥
Transliteration: khinahoon kirapaa saadhoo sang naanak har rang laaeo |2|5|156|
English: One moment, O Nanak, the Lord bestows His Mercy and blesses him with His Love, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||5||156||

[Ang 409 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧੭ ਆਸਾਵਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: raag aasaa mahalaa 5 ghar 17 aasaavaree |
English: Raag Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Seventeenth House, Aasaavaree:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: gobind gobind kar haan |
English: Meditate on the Lord, the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: har har man piaar haan |
English: Cherish the Beloved Lord, Har, Har, in your mind.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਸੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਧਰਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: gur kahiaa su chit dhar haan |
English: The Guru says to install it in your consciousness.

Gurbani: ਅਨ ਸਿਉ ਤੋਰਿ ਫੇਰਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: an siau tor fer haan |
English: Turn away from others, and turn to Him.

Gurbani: ਐਸੇ ਲਾਲਨੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਰੀ ਸਖੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aise laalan paaeo ree sakhee |1| rahaau |
English: Thus you shall obtain your Beloved, O my companion. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪੰਕਜ ਮੋਹ ਸਰਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: pankaj moh sar haan |
English: In the pool of the world is the mud of attachment.

Gurbani: ਪਗੁ ਨਹੀ ਚਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: pag nahee chalai har haan |
English: Stuck in it, his feet cannot walk towards the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗਹਡਿਓ ਮੂੜ ਨਰਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: gahaddio moorr nar haan |
English: The fool is stuck;

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਨ ਉਪਾਵ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: anin upaav kar haan |
English: he cannot do anything else.

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਸਰਨਿ ਪੈ ਰੀ ਸਖੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tau nikasai saran pai ree sakhee |1|
English: Only by entering the Lord's Sanctuary, O my companion, will you be released. ||1||

Gurbani: ਥਿਰ ਥਿਰ ਚਿਤ ਥਿਰ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: thir thir chit thir haan |
English: Thus your consciousness shall be stable and steady and firm.

Gurbani: ਬਨੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: ban grihu samasar haan |
English: Wilderness and household are the same.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਏਕ ਪਿਰ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: antar ek pir haan |
English: Deep within dwells the One Husband Lord;

Gurbani: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਅਨੇਕ ਧਰਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: baahar anek dhar haan |
English: outwardly, there are many distractions.

Gurbani: ਰਾਜਨ ਜੋਗੁ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: raajan jog kar haan |
English: Practice Raja Yoga, the Yoga of meditation and success.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੋਗ ਅਲੋਗੀ ਰੀ ਸਖੀ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੫੭॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak log alogee ree sakhee |2|1|157|
English: Says Nanak, this is the way to dwell with the people, and yet remain apart from them. ||2||1||157||

[Ang 409 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾਵਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaavaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaavaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨਸਾ ਏਕ ਮਾਨਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: manasaa ek maan haan |
English: Cherish one desire only:
