Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਤ ਧਿਆਨਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: gur siau net dhiaan haan |
English: meditate continually on the Guru.

Gurbani: ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਸੰਤ ਮੰਤ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: drirr sant mant giaan haan |
English: Install the wisdom of the Saints' Mantra.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਾ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਾਨਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: sevaa gur charaan haan |
English: Serve the Feet of the Guru,

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਨਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tau mileeai gur kripaan mere manaa |1| rahaau |
English: and you shall meet Him, by Guru's Grace, O my mind. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਟੂਟੇ ਅਨ ਭਰਾਨਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: ttootte an bharaan haan |
English: All doubts are dispelled,

Gurbani: ਰਵਿਓ ਸਰਬ ਥਾਨਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: ravio sarab thaan haan |
English: and the Lord is seen to be pervading all places.

Gurbani: ਲਹਿਓ ਜਮ ਭਇਆਨਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: lahio jam bheaan haan |
English: The fear of death is dispelled,

Gurbani: ਪਾਇਓ ਪੇਡ ਥਾਨਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: paaeo pedd thaan haan |
English: and the primal place is obtained.

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਚੂਕੀ ਸਗਲ ਕਾਨਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tau chookee sagal kaan |1|
English: Then, all subservience is removed. ||1||

Gurbani: ਲਹਨੋ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਥਾਨਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: lahano jis mathaan haan |
English: One who has such destiny recorded upon his forehead, obtains it;

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਪਾਵਕ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਨਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: bhai paavak paar paraan haan |
English: he crosses over the terrifying ocean of fire.

Gurbani: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਥਾਨਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: nij ghar tiseh thaan haan |
English: He obtains a place in the home of his own self,

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਰਸਹਿ ਮਾਨਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: har ras raseh maan haan |
English: and enjoys the most sublime essence of the Lord's essence.

Gurbani: ਲਾਥੀ ਤਿਸ ਭੁਖਾਨਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: laathee tis bhukhaan haan |
English: His hunger is appeased;

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਓ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੫੮॥
Transliteration: naanak sehaj samaaeo re manaa |2|2|158|
English: Nanak, he is absorbed in celestial peace, O my mind. ||2||2||158||

[Ang 409 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾਵਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaavaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaavaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨੀ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: har har har gunee haan |
English: Sing the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਜਪੀਐ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨੀ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: japeeai sehaj dhunee haan |
English: Meditate on the celestial music.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਰਸਨ ਭਨੀ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: saadhoo rasan bhanee haan |
English: The tongues of the holy Saints repeat it.

Gurbani: ਛੂਟਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਸੁਨੀ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: chhoottan bidh sunee haan |
English: I have heard that this is the way to emancipation.

Gurbani: ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡ ਪੁਨੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: paaeeai vadd punee mere manaa |1| rahaau |
English: This is found by the greatest merit, O my mind. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਖੋਜਹਿ ਜਨ ਮੁਨੀ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: khojeh jan munee haan |
English: The silent sages search for Him.

Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰਬ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਨੀ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: srab kaa prabh dhanee haan |
English: God is the Master of all.

Gurbani: ਦੁਲਭ ਕਲਿ ਦੁਨੀ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: dulabh kal dunee haan |
English: It is so difficult to find Him in this world, in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.

Gurbani: ਦੂਖ ਬਿਨਾਸਨੀ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: dookh binaasanee haan |
English: He is the Dispeller of distress.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਨੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: prabh pooran aasanee mere manaa |1|
English: God is the Fulfiller of desires, O my mind. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਸੋ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: man so seveeai haan |
English: O my mind, serve Him.

Gurbani: ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵੀਐ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: alakh abheveeai haan |
English: He is unknowable and inscrutable.

Gurbani: ਤਾਂ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: taan siau preet kar haan |
English: Enshrine love for Him.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਸਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਮਰਿ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: binas na jaae mar haan |
English: He does not perish, or go away, or die.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: gur te jaaniaa haan |
English: He is known only through the Guru.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੨॥੩॥੧੫੯॥
Transliteration: naanak man maaniaa mere manaa |2|3|159|
English: Nanak, my mind is satisfied with the Lord, O my mind. ||2||3||159||

[Ang 410 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾਵਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaavaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaavaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਏਕਾ ਓਟ ਗਹੁ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: ekaa ott gahu haan |
English: Grab hold of the Support of the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਹੁ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa sabad kahu haan |
English: Chant the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਆਗਿਆ ਸਤਿ ਸਹੁ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: aagiaa sat sahu haan |
English: Submit to the Order of the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਨਹਿ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਲਹੁ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: maneh nidhaan lahu haan |
English: Receive the treasure in your mind.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖਹਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sukheh samaaeeai mere manaa |1| rahaau |
English: Thus you shall be absorbed in peace, O my mind. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਤ ਜੋ ਮਰੈ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: jeevat jo marai haan |
English: One who is dead while yet alive,

Gurbani: ਦੁਤਰੁ ਸੋ ਤਰੈ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: dutar so tarai haan |
English: crosses over the terrifying world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਕੀ ਰੇਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kee ren hoe haan |
English: One who becomes the dust of all

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕਹਉ ਸੋਇ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: nirbhau khau soe haan |
English: he alone is called fearless.

Gurbani: ਮਿਟੇ ਅੰਦੇਸਿਆ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: mitte andesiaa haan |
English: His anxieties are removed

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sant upadesiaa mere manaa |1|
English: by the Teachings of the Saints, O my mind. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: jis jan naam sukh haan |
English: That humble being, who takes happiness in the Naam, the Name of the Lord

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਕਦੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: tis nikatt na kade dukh haan |
English: pain never draws near him.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨੇ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: jo har har jas sune haan |
English: One who listens to the Praise of the Lord, Har, Har,

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੰਨੇ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: sabh ko tis mane haan |
English: is obeyed by all men.

Gurbani: ਸਫਲੁ ਸੁ ਆਇਆ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: safal su aaeaa haan |
English: How fortunate it is that he came into the world;

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੨॥੪॥੧੬੦॥
Transliteration: naanak prabh bhaaeaa mere manaa |2|4|160|
English: Nanak, he is pleasing to God, O my mind. ||2||4||160||

[Ang 410 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾਵਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaavaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaavaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਈਐ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: mil har jas gaaeeai haan |
English: Meeting together, let us sing the Praises of the Lord,

Gurbani: ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: param pad paaeeai haan |
English: and attain the supreme state.

Gurbani: ਉਆ ਰਸ ਜੋ ਬਿਧੇ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: auaa ras jo bidhe haan |
English: Those who obtain that sublime essence,

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਧੇ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: taa kau sagal sidhe haan |
English: obtain all of the spiritual powers of the Siddhas.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਿਆ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: anadin jaagiaa haan |
English: They remain awake and aware night and day;

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਡਭਾਗਿਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: naanak baddabhaagiaa mere manaa |1| rahaau |
English: Nanak, they are blessed by great good fortune, O my mind. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਪਗ ਧੋਈਐ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: sant pag dhoeeai haan |
English: Let us wash the feet of the Saints;

Gurbani: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਖੋਈਐ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: duramat khoeeai haan |
English: our evil-mindedness shall be cleansed.

Gurbani: ਦਾਸਹ ਰੇਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: daasah ren hoe haan |
English: Becoming the dust of the feet of the Lord's slaves,

Gurbani: ਬਿਆਪੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: biaapai dukh na koe haan |
English: one shall not be afflicted with pain.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਾਂ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੁ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: bhagataan saran par haan |
English: Taking to the Sanctuary of His devotees,

Gurbani: ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਕਦੇ ਮਰੁ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: janam na kade mar haan |
English: he is no longer subject to birth and death.

Gurbani: ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਸੇ ਭਏ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: asathir se bhe haan |
English: They alone become eternal,

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਿਨੑ ਜਪਿ ਲਏ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har har jina jap le mere manaa |1|
English: who chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੀਤੁ ਤੂੰ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: saajan meet toon haan |
English: You are my Friend, my Best Friend.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇ ਮੂੰ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: naam drirraae moon haan |
English: Please, implant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋਇ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: tis bin naeh koe haan |
English: Without Him, there is not any other.

Gurbani: ਮਨਹਿ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਸੋਇ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: maneh araadh soe haan |
English: Within my mind, I worship Him in adoration.

Gurbani: ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: nimakh na veesarai haan |
English: I do not forget Him, even for an instant.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਸਰੈ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: tis bin kiau sarai haan |
English: How can I live without Him?

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ਜਾਉ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: gur kau kurabaan jaau haan |
English: I am a sacrifice to the Guru.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਪੇ ਨਾਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੨॥੫॥੧੬੧॥
Transliteration: naanak jape naau mere manaa |2|5|161|
English: Nanak, chant the Name, O my mind. ||2||5||161||

[Ang 410 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾਵਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaavaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaavaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨ ਤੂੰ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: kaaran karan toon haan |
English: You are the Creator, the Cause of causes.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾ ਸੁਝੈ ਮੂੰ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: avar naa sujhai moon haan |
English: I cannot think of any other.

Gurbani: ਕਰਹਿ ਸੁ ਹੋਈਐ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: kareh su hoeeai haan |
English: Whatever You do, comes to pass.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੋਈਐ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj sukh soeeai haan |
English: I sleep in peace and poise.

Gurbani: ਧੀਰਜ ਮਨਿ ਭਏ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: dheeraj man bhe haan |
English: My mind has become patient,

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਪਏ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kai dar pe mere manaa |1| rahaau |
English: since I fell at God's Door, O my mind. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਮੇ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: saadhoo sangame haan |
English: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy,

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਸੰਜਮੇ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: pooran sanjame haan |
English: I gained perfect control over my senses.

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਛੁਟੇ ਆਪ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: jab te chhutte aap haan |
English: Ever since I rid myself of my self-conceit,

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਤੇ ਮਿਟੇ ਤਾਪ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: tab te mitte taap haan |
English: my sufferings have ended.

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀਆ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: kirapaa dhaareea haan |
English: He has showered His Mercy upon me.

Gurbani: ਪਤਿ ਰਖੁ ਬਨਵਾਰੀਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: pat rakh banavaareea mere manaa |1|
English: The Creator Lord has preserved my honor, O my mind. ||1||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: eihu sukh jaaneeai haan |
English: Know that this is the only peace;

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਮਾਨੀਐ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: har kare su maaneeai haan |
English: accept whatever the Lord does.

Gurbani: ਮੰਦਾ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋਇ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: mandaa naeh koe haan |
English: No one is bad.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਰੇਨ ਹੋਇ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: sant kee ren hoe haan |
English: Become the dust of the Feet of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਰਖੈ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: aape jis rakhai haan |
English: He Himself preserves those

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸੋ ਚਖੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har amrit so chakhai mere manaa |2|
English: who taste the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord, O my mind. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋਇ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: jis kaa naeh koe haan |
English: One who has no one to call his own

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸੋਇ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: tis kaa prabhoo soe haan |
English: God belongs to him.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਗਤਿ ਬੁਝੈ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: antaragat bujhai haan |
English: God knows the state of our innermost being.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੁਝੈ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh tis sujhai haan |
English: He knows everything.

Gurbani: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: patit udhaar lehu haan |
English: Please, Lord, save the sinners.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਏਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੩॥੬॥੧੬੨॥
Transliteration: naanak aradaas ehu mere manaa |3|6|162|
English: This is Nanak's prayer, O my mind. ||3||6||162||

[Ang 410 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾਵਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਇਕਤੁਕਾ ॥
Transliteration: aasaavaree mahalaa 5 ikatukaa |
English: Aasaavaree, Fifth Mehl, Ek-Thukay:

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਪਰਦੇਸੀਆ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: oe paradeseea haan |
English: O my stranger soul,

Gurbani: ਸੁਨਤ ਸੰਦੇਸਿਆ ਹਾਂ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sunat sandesiaa haan |1| rahaau |
English: listen to the call. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਸਿਉ ਰਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: jaa siau rach rahe haan |
English: Whatever you are attached to,

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਕਉ ਤਜਿ ਗਏ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kau taj ge haan |
English: you shall have to leave it all behind.

Gurbani: ਸੁਪਨਾ ਜਿਉ ਭਏ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: supanaa jiau bhe haan |
English: These things seem like only a dream,

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਨਿੑ ਲਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har naam jina le |1|
English: to one who takes the Lord's Name. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਤਜਿ ਅਨ ਲਗੇ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: har taj an lage haan |
English: Forsaking the Lord, and clinging to another,

Gurbani: ਜਨਮਹਿ ਮਰਿ ਭਗੇ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: janameh mar bhage haan |
English: they run toward death and reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨਿ ਲਹੇ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: har har jan lahe haan |
English: But those humble beings, who attach themselves to the Lord, Har, Har,

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਤ ਸੇ ਰਹੇ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: jeevat se rahe haan |
English: continue to live.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: jiseh kripaal hoe haan |
English: One who is blessed with the Lord's Mercy,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੬੩॥੨੩੨॥
Transliteration: naanak bhagat soe |2|7|163|232|
English: O Nanak, becomes His devotee. ||2||7||163||232||

[Ang 411 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: raag aasaa mahalaa 9 |
English: Raag Aasaa, Ninth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕਹਉ ਕਉਨ ਸਿਉ ਮਨ ਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: birathaa khau kaun siau man kee |
English: Who should I tell the condition of the mind?

Gurbani: ਲੋਭਿ ਗ੍ਰਸਿਓ ਦਸ ਹੂ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਵਤ ਆਸਾ ਲਾਗਿਓ ਧਨ ਕੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: lobh grasio das hoo dis dhaavat aasaa laagio dhan kee |1| rahaau |
English: Engrossed in greed, running around in the ten directions, you hold to your hopes of wealth. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਤ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਤ ਜਨ ਜਨ ਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: sukh kai het bahut dukh paavat sev karat jan jan kee |
English: For the sake of pleasure, you suffer such great pain, and you have to serve each and every person.

Gurbani: ਦੁਆਰਹਿ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਸੁਆਨ ਜਿਉ ਡੋਲਤ ਨਹ ਸੁਧ ਰਾਮ ਭਜਨ ਕੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: duaareh duaar suaan jiau ddolat neh sudh raam bhajan kee |1|
English: You wander from door to door like a dog, unconscious of the Lord's meditation. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮ ਅਕਾਰਥ ਖੋਵਤ ਲਾਜ ਨ ਲੋਕ ਹਸਨ ਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: maanas janam akaarath khovat laaj na lok hasan kee |
English: You lose this human life in vain, and You are not even ashamed when others laugh at you.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਿਉ ਨਹੀ ਗਾਵਤ ਕੁਮਤਿ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ ਤਨ ਕੀ ॥੨॥੧॥੨੩੩॥
Transliteration: naanak har jas kiau nahee gaavat kumat binaasai tan kee |2|1|233|
English: O Nanak, why not sing the Lord's Praises, so that you may be rid of the body's evil disposition? ||2||1||233||

[Ang 411 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: raag aasaa mahalaa 1 asattapadeea ghar 2 |
English: Raag Aasaa, First Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa, Second House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਉਤਰਿ ਅਵਘਟਿ ਸਰਵਰਿ ਨੑਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: autar avaghatt saravar naavai |
English: He descends the treacherous precipice, to bathe in the cleansing pool;

Gurbani: ਬਕੈ ਨ ਬੋਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: bakai na bolai har gun gaavai |
English: without speaking or saying anything, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਲੁ ਆਕਾਸੀ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jal aakaasee sun samaavai |
English: Like water vapor in the sky, he remains absorbed in the Lord.

Gurbani: ਰਸੁ ਸਤੁ ਝੋਲਿ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ras sat jhol mahaa ras paavai |1|
English: He churns the true pleasures to obtain the supreme nectar. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਅਭ ਮੋਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa giaan sunahu abh more |
English: Listen to such spiritual wisdom, O my mind.

Gurbani: ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭ ਠਉਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bharipur dhaar rahiaa sabh tthaure |1| rahaau |
English: The Lord is totally pervading and permeating all places. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਬ੍ਰਤੁ ਨੇਮੁ ਨ ਕਾਲੁ ਸੰਤਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: sach brat nem na kaal santaavai |
English: One who makes Truthfulness his fast and religious vows, does not suffer the pain of death.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਕਰੋਧੁ ਜਲਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sabad karodh jalaavai |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he burns away his anger.

Gurbani: ਗਗਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਸਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: gagan nivaas samaadh lagaavai |
English: He dwells in the Tenth Gate, immersed in the Samaadhi of deep meditation.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਰਸਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: paaras paras param pad paavai |2|
English: Touching the philosopher's stone, he obtains the supreme status. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਮਨ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਤਤੁ ਬਿਲੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: sach man kaaran tat bilovai |
English: For the benefit of the mind, churn the true essence of reality;

Gurbani: ਸੁਭਰ ਸਰਵਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: subhar saravar mail na dhovai |
English: bathing in the over-flowing tank of nectar, filth is washed away.

Gurbani: ਜੈ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਤਾ ਤੈਸੋ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jai siau raataa taiso hovai |
English: We become like the One with whom we are imbued.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aape karataa kare su hovai |3|
English: Whatever the Creator does, comes to pass. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਹਿਵ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur hiv seetal agan bujhaavai |
English: The Guru is cool and soothing like ice; He puts out the fire of the mind.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਬਿਭੂਤ ਚੜਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: sevaa surat bibhoot charraavai |
English: Smear your body with the ashes of dedicated service,

Gurbani: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਆਪਿ ਸਹਜ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: darasan aap sehaj ghar aavai |
English: and live in the home of peace - make this your religious order.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਦੁ ਵਜਾਵੈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: niramal baanee naad vajaavai |4|
English: Let the Immaculate Bani of the Word be your playing of the flute. ||4||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: antar giaan mahaa ras saaraa |
English: Spiritual wisdom within is the supreme, sublime nectar.

Gurbani: ਤੀਰਥ ਮਜਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: teerath majan gur veechaaraa |
English: Contemplation of the Guru is one's bathing at holy places of pilgrimage.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਥਾਨੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: antar poojaa thaan muraaraa |
English: Worship and adoration within is the Lord's dwelling.

Gurbani: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: jotee jot milaavanahaaraa |5|
English: He is the One who blends one's light with the Divine Light. ||5||

Gurbani: ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿਆ ਮਤਿ ਏਕੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: ras rasiaa mat ekai bhaae |
English: He delights in the delightful wisdom of loving the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਖਤ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਪੰਚ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: takhat nivaasee panch samaae |
English: He is one of the self-elect - he merges with the Lord, who occupies the throne.

Gurbani: ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈ ਖਸਮ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kaar kamaaee khasam rajaae |
English: He performs his works in obedience to the Will of his Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਅਵਿਗਤ ਨਾਥੁ ਨ ਲਖਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: avigat naath na lakhiaa jaae |6|
English: The Unknowable Lord cannot be understood. ||6||

Gurbani: ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਜਲ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jal meh upajai jal te door |
English: The lotus originates in the water, and yet it remains distinct from the water.

Gurbani: ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jal meh jot rahiaa bharapoor |
English: Just so, the Divine Light pervades and permeates the water of the world.

Gurbani: ਕਿਸੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖਾ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: kis nerrai kis aakhaa door |
English: Who is near, and who is far away?

Gurbani: ਨਿਧਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: nidh gun gaavaa dekh hadoor |7|
English: I sing the Glories of the Lord, the treasure of virtue; I behold Him ever-present. ||7||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: antar baahar avar na koe |
English: Inwardly and outwardly, there is none other than Him.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਫੁਨਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jo tis bhaavai so fun hoe |
English: Whatever pleases Him, comes to pass.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਭਰਥਰਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sun bharathar naanak kahai beechaar |
English: Listen, O Bharthari Yogi - Nanak speaks after deliberation;

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੮॥੧॥
Transliteration: niramal naam meraa aadhaar |8|1|
English: the Immaculate Name is my only Support. ||8||1||

[Ang 412 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਜਪ ਸਭਿ ਤਪ ਸਭ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sabh jap sabh tap sabh chaturaaee |
English: All meditation, all austerities, and all clever tricks,

Gurbani: ਊਝੜਿ ਭਰਮੈ ਰਾਹਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aoojharr bharamai raeh na paaee |
English: lead one to wander in the wilderness, but he does not find the Path.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਕੋ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: bin boojhe ko thaae na paaee |
English: Without understanding, he is not approved;

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਣੈ ਮਾਥੇ ਛਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naam bihoonai maathe chhaaee |1|
English: without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, ashes are thrown upon one's head. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚ ਧਣੀ ਜਗੁ ਆਇ ਬਿਨਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: saach dhanee jag aae binaasaa |
English: True is the Master; the world comes and goes.

Gurbani: ਛੂਟਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: chhoottas praanee guramukh daasaa |1| rahaau |
English: The mortal is emancipated, as Gurmukh, as the Lord's slave. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਗੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਾਧਾ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: jag mohi baadhaa bahutee aasaa |
English: The world is bound by its attachments to the many desires.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਇਕਿ ਭਏ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: guramatee ik bhe udaasaa |
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, some become free of desire.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਮਲੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: antar naam kamal paragaasaa |
English: Within them is the Naam, and their heart lotus blossoms forth.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tina kau naahee jam kee traasaa |2|
English: They have no fear of death. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਗੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਅ ਜਿਤੁ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਹਿਤਕਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jag tria jit kaaman hitakaaree |
English: The men of the world are conquered by woman; they love the ladies.

Gurbani: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਲਗਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: putr kalatr lag naam visaaree |
English: Attached to children and wife, they forget the Naam.

Gurbani: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: birathaa janam gavaaeaa baajee haaree |
English: They waste this human life in vain, and lose the game in the gamble.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: satigur seve karanee saaree |3|
English: Serving the True Guru is the best occupation. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: baaharahu haumai kahai kahaae |
English: One who speaks egotistically in public,

Gurbani: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਲੇਪੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: andarahu mukat lep kade na laae |
English: never attains liberation within.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohu gur sabad jalaae |
English: One who burns away his attachment to Maya, by the Word of the Guru's Shabad,

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਧਿਆਏ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: niramal naam sad hiradai dhiaae |4|
English: meditates forever within his heart on the Immaculate Naam. ||4||

Gurbani: ਧਾਵਤੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: dhaavat raakhai tthaak rahaae |
English: He restrains his wandering mind, and keeps it under control.

Gurbani: ਸਿਖ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sikh sangat karam milaae |
English: The company of such a Sikh is obtained only by Grace.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਭੂਲੋ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur bin bhoolo aavai jaae |
English: Without the Guru, he goes astray and continues coming and going.

Gurbani: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੰਜੋਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: nadar kare sanjog milaae |5|
English: Bestowing His Mercy, the Lord unites him in Union. ||5||

Gurbani: ਰੂੜੋ ਕਹਉ ਨ ਕਹਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: roorro khau na kahiaa jaaee |
English: I cannot describe the Beauteous Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਉ ਨਹ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: akath kthau neh keemat paaee |
English: I speak the unspoken; I cannot estimate His value.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਦੁਖ ਤੇਰੇ ਸੂਖ ਰਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sabh dukh tere sookh rajaaee |
English: All pain and pleasure come by Your Will.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖ ਮੇਟੇ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: sabh dukh mette saachai naaee |6|
English: All pain is eradicated by the True Name. ||6||

Gurbani: ਕਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਵਾਜਾ ਪਗ ਬਿਨੁ ਤਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: kar bin vaajaa pag bin taalaa |
English: He plays the instrument without hands, and dances without feet.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੁਝੈ ਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: je sabad bujhai taa sach nihaalaa |
English: But if he understands the Word of the Shabad, then he shall behold the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਭੇ ਸੁਖ ਨਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: antar saach sabhe sukh naalaa |
English: With the True Lord within the self, all happiness comes.

Gurbani: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: nadar kare raakhai rakhavaalaa |7|
English: Showering His Mercy, the Preserving Lord preserves him. ||7||

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੂਝੈ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: tribhavan soojhai aap gavaavai |
English: He understands the three worlds; he eliminates his self-conceit.

Gurbani: ਬਾਣੀ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: baanee boojhai sach samaavai |
English: He understands the Bani of the Word, and he is absorbed into the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਤਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabad veechaare ek liv taaraa |
English: Contemplating the Shabad, he enshrines love for the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੮॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak dhan savaaranahaaraa |8|2|
English: O Nanak, blessed is the Lord, the Embellisher. ||8||2||

[Ang 412 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਲੇਖ ਅਸੰਖ ਲਿਖਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: lekh asankh likh likh maan |
English: There are innumerable writings; those who write them take pride in them.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਮਾਨਿਐ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਵਖਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: man maaniai sach surat vakhaan |
English: When one's mind accepts the Truth, he understands, and speaks of it.

Gurbani: ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਨੀ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਭਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: kathanee badanee parr parr bhaar |
English: Words, spoken and read again and again, are useless loads.

Gurbani: ਲੇਖ ਅਸੰਖ ਅਲੇਖੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: lekh asankh alekh apaar |1|
English: There are innumerable writings, but the Infinite Lord remains unwritten. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਤੂੰ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa saachaa toon eko jaan |
English: Know that such a True Lord is the One and only.

Gurbani: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaman maranaa hukam pachhaan |1| rahaau |
English: Understand that birth and death come according to the Lord's Will. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਜਗੁ ਬਾਧਾ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohi jag baadhaa jamakaal |
English: Because of attachment to Maya, the world is bound by the Messenger of Death.

Gurbani: ਬਾਂਧਾ ਛੂਟੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: baandhaa chhoottai naam samaal |
English: These bonds are released when one remembers the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: gur sukhadaataa avar na bhaal |
English: The Guru is the Giver of peace; do not look for any other.

Gurbani: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਨਿਬਹੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: halat palat nibahee tudh naal |2|
English: In this world, and the next, He shall stand by you. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਤਾਂ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sabad marai taan ek liv laae |
English: One who dies in the Word of the Shabad, embraces love for the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਚਰੁ ਚਰੈ ਤਾਂ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: achar charai taan bharam chukaae |
English: One who eats the uneatable, has his doubts dispelled.

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jeevan mukat man naam vasaae |
English: He is Jivan Mukta - liberated while yet alive; the Naam abides in his mind.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: guramukh hoe ta sach samaae |3|
English: Becoming Gurmukh, he merges into the True Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਧਰ ਸਾਜੀ ਗਗਨੁ ਅਕਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: jin dhar saajee gagan akaas |
English: The One who created the earth and the Akaashic ethers of the sky,

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਭ ਥਾਪੀ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: jin sabh thaapee thaap uthaap |
English: established all; He establishes and disestablishes.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: sarab nirantar aape aap |
English: He Himself is permeating all.

Gurbani: ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਪੂਛੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਆਪਿ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: kisai na poochhe bakhase aap |4|
English: He does not consult anyone; He Himself forgives. ||4||

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਪੁਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਮਾਣਕ ਹੀਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: too pur saagar maanak heer |
English: You are the Ocean, over-flowing with jewels and rubies.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਚੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: too niramal sach gunee gaheer |
English: You are immaculate and pure, the true treasure of virtue.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਭੇਟੈ ਗੁਰ ਪੀਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sukh maanai bhettai gur peer |
English: Peace is enjoyed, meeting the Guru, the Spiritual Teacher.

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਏਕੁ ਵਜੀਰੁ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: eko saahib ek vajeer |5|
English: The Lord is the only Master; He is the only Minister. ||5||

Gurbani: ਜਗੁ ਬੰਦੀ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਹਉ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jag bandee mukate hau maaree |
English: The world is held in bondage; he alone is emancipated, who conquers his ego.

Gurbani: ਜਗਿ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਆਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jag giaanee viralaa aachaaree |
English: How rare in the world is that wise person, who practices this.

Gurbani: ਜਗਿ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jag panddit viralaa veechaaree |
English: How rare in this world is that scholar who reflects upon this.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਸਭ ਫਿਰੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: bin satigur bhette sabh firai ahankaaree |6|
English: Without meeting the True Guru, all wander in ego. ||6||

Gurbani: ਜਗੁ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jag dukheea sukheea jan koe |
English: The world is unhappy; only a few are happy.

Gurbani: ਜਗੁ ਰੋਗੀ ਭੋਗੀ ਗੁਣ ਰੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jag rogee bhogee gun roe |
English: The world is diseased, from its indulgences; it weeps over its lost virtue.

Gurbani: ਜਗੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jag upajai binasai pat khoe |
English: The world wells up, and then subsides, losing its honor.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: guramukh hovai boojhai soe |7|
English: He alone, who becomes Gurmukh, understands. ||7||

Gurbani: ਮਹਘੋ ਮੋਲਿ ਭਾਰਿ ਅਫਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: mahagho mol bhaar afaar |
English: His price is so costly; His weight is unbearable.

Gurbani: ਅਟਲ ਅਛਲੁ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: attal achhal guramatee dhaar |
English: He is immovable and undeceivable; enshrine Him in your mind, through the Guru's Teachings.

Gurbani: ਭਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਭਇਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: bhaae milai bhaavai bheikaar |
English: Meet Him through love, become pleasing to Him, and act in fear of Him.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੮॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak neech kahai beechaar |8|3|
English: Nanak the lowly says this, after deep contemplation. ||8||3||

[Ang 413 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਮਰੈ ਪੰਚੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਰੋਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: ek marai panche mil roveh |
English: When someone dies, the five passions meet and mourn his death.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: haumai jaae sabad mal dhoveh |
English: Overcoming self-conceit, he washes off his filth with the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਮਝਿ ਸੂਝਿ ਸਹਜ ਘਰਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: samajh soojh sehaj ghar hoveh |
English: One who knows and understands, enters the home of peace and poise.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਸਗਲੀ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਵਹਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bin boojhe sagalee pat khoveh |1|
English: Without understanding, he loses all his honor. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਉਣੁ ਮਰੈ ਕਉਣੁ ਰੋਵੈ ਓਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: kaun marai kaun rovai ohee |
English: Who dies, and who weeps for him?

Gurbani: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਭਸੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਤੋਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: karan kaaran sabhasai sir tohee |1| rahaau |
English: O Lord, Creator, Cause of causes, You are over the heads of all. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੂਏ ਕਉ ਰੋਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: mooe kau rovai dukh koe |
English: Who weeps over the pain of the dead?

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਰੋਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਬੇਦਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: so rovai jis bedan hoe |
English: Those who weep, do so over their own troubles.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਬੀਤੀ ਜਾਣੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jis beetee jaanai prabh soe |
English: God knows the condition of those who are so affected.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aape karataa kare su hoe |2|
English: Whatever the Creator does, comes to pass. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰਣਾ ਤਾਰੇ ਤਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeevat maranaa taare taranaa |
English: One who remains dead while yet alive, is saved, and saves others as well.

Gurbani: ਜੈ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: jai jagadees param gat saranaa |
English: Celebrate the Victory of the Lord; taking to His Sanctuary, the supreme status is obtained.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: hau balihaaree satigur charanaa |
English: I am a sacrifice to the feet of the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਭੈ ਤਰਣਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur bohith sabad bhai taranaa |3|
English: The Guru is the boat; through the Shabad of His Word, the terrifying world-ocean is crossed over. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: nirbhau aap nirantar jot |
English: He Himself is Fearless; His Divine Light is contained in all.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਜਗਿ ਛੋਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: bin naavai sootak jag chhot |
English: Without the Name, the world is defiled and untouchable.

Gurbani: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਿ ਰੋਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: duramat binasai kiaa keh rot |
English: Through evil-mindedness, they are ruined; why should they cry out and weep?

Gurbani: ਜਨਮਿ ਮੂਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਰੋਤਿ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: janam mooe bin bhagat sarot |4|
English: They are born only to die, without hearing the music of devotional worship. ||4||

Gurbani: ਮੂਏ ਕਉ ਸਚੁ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਮੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: mooe kau sach roveh meet |
English: Only one's true friends mourn one's death.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਨੀਤਾ ਨੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: trai gun roveh neetaa neet |
English: Those under the sway of the three dispositions continue to mourn on and on.

Gurbani: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਚੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: dukh sukh parahar sehaj sucheet |
English: Disregarding pain and pleasure, center your consciousness on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਉਪਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: tan man saupau krisan pareet |5|
English: Dedicate your body and mind to the Love of the Lord. ||5||

Gurbani: ਭੀਤਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਸੰਖ ॥
Transliteration: bheetar ek anek asankh |
English: The One Lord dwells within the various and countless beings.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਬਹੁ ਸੰਖ ਅਸੰਖ ॥
Transliteration: karam dharam bahu sankh asankh |
English: There are so many rituals and religious faiths, their number is innumerable.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਭੈ ਭਗਤੀ ਜਨਮੁ ਬਿਰੰਥ ॥
Transliteration: bin bhai bhagatee janam biranth |
English: Without the Fear of God, and devotional worship, one's life is in vain.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਰਮਾਰੰਥ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: har gun gaaveh mil paramaaranth |6|
English: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the supreme wealth is obtained. ||6||

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਮਰੈ ਮਾਰੇ ਭੀ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: aap marai maare bhee aap |
English: He Himself dies, and He Himself kills.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: aap upaae thaap uthaap |
English: He Himself establishes, and having established, disestablishes.

Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਜੋਤੀ ਤੂ ਜਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: srisatt upaaee jotee too jaat |
English: He created the Universe, and by His Divine Nature, instilled His Divine Light into it.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਣੁ ਨਹੀ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਿ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: sabad veechaar milan nahee bhraat |7|
English: One who reflects upon the Word of the Shabad, meets the Lord, without doubt. ||7||

Gurbani: ਸੂਤਕੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਭਖੈ ਜਗੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sootak agan bhakhai jag khaae |
English: Pollution is the burning fire, which is consuming the world.

Gurbani: ਸੂਤਕੁ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਥਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sootak jal thal sabh hee thaae |
English: Pollution is in the water, upon the land, and everywhere.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੂਤਕਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: naanak sootak janam mareejai |
English: O Nanak, people are born and die in pollution.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੮॥੪॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee har ras peejai |8|4|
English: By Guru's Grace, they drink in the Lord's sublime elixir. ||8||4||

[Ang 413 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raag aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੈ ਸੁ ਪਰਖੇ ਹੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aap veechaarai su parakhe heeraa |
English: One who contemplates his own self, tests the worth of the jewel.

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਤਾਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: ek drisatt taare gur pooraa |
English: With a single glance, the Perfect Guru saves him.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur maanai man te man dheeraa |1|
English: When the Guru is pleased, one's mind comforts itself. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਰਾਫੀ ਕਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa saahu saraafee karai |
English: He is such a banker, who tests us.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਤਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saachee nadar ek liv tarai |1| rahaau |
English: By His True Glance of Grace, we are blessed with the Love of the One Lord, and are saved. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: poonjee naam niranjan saar |
English: The capital of the Naam is immaculate and sublime.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤਾ ਪੈਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: niramal saach rataa paikaar |
English: That peddler is rendered pure, who is imbued with the Truth.

Gurbani: ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਘਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sifat sehaj ghar gur karataar |2|
English: Praising the Lord, in the house of poise, he attains the Guru, the Creator. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa manasaa sabad jalaae |
English: One who burns away hope and desire through the Word of the Shabad,

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਰਾਇਣੁ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: raam naraaein kahai kahaae |
English: chants the Lord's Name, and inspires others to chant it as well.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਵਾਟ ਮਹਲੁ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur te vaatt mehal ghar paae |3|
English: Through the Guru, he finds the Path home, to the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕੰਚਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਨੂਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: kanchan kaaeaa jot anoop |
English: His body becomes golden, by the Lord's Incomparable Light.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਦੇਵਾ ਸਗਲ ਸਰੂਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: tribhavan devaa sagal saroop |
English: He beholds the divine beauty in all the three worlds.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਅਖੂਟੁ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: mai so dhan palai saach akhoott |4|
English: That inexhaustible wealth of Truth is now in my lap. ||4||

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਤੀਨਿ ਨਵ ਚਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: panch teen nav chaar samaavai |
English: In the five elements, the three worlds, the nine regions and the four directions, the Lord is pervading.

Gurbani: ਧਰਣਿ ਗਗਨੁ ਕਲ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਹਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: dharan gagan kal dhaar rahaavai |
English: He supports the earth and the sky, exercising His almighty power.

Gurbani: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਾਤਉ ਉਲਟਿ ਪਰਾਵੈ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: baahar jaatau ulatt paraavai |5|
English: He turns the outgoing mind around. ||5||

Gurbani: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਆਖੀ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
Transliteration: moorakh hoe na aakhee soojhai |
English: The fool does not realize what he sees with his eyes.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਰਸੁ ਨਹੀ ਕਹਿਆ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
Transliteration: jihavaa ras nahee kahiaa boojhai |
English: He does not taste with his tongue, and does not understand what is said.

Gurbani: ਬਿਖੁ ਕਾ ਮਾਤਾ ਜਗ ਸਿਉ ਲੂਝੈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: bikh kaa maataa jag siau loojhai |6|
English: Intoxicated with poison, he argues with the world. ||6||

Gurbani: ਊਤਮ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਊਤਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: aootam sangat aootam hovai |
English: In the uplifting society, one is uplifted.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਕਉ ਧਾਵੈ ਅਵਗਣ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: gun kau dhaavai avagan dhovai |
English: He chases after virtue and washes off his sins.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: bin gur seve sehaj na hovai |7|
English: Without serving the Guru, celestial poise is not obtained. ||7||

Gurbani: ਹੀਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਲਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: heeraa naam javehar laal |
English: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is a diamond, a jewel, a ruby.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਮੋਤੀ ਹੈ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਮਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: man motee hai tis kaa maal |
English: The pearl of the mind is the inner wealth.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰਖੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥੮॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak parakhai nadar nihaal |8|5|
English: O Nanak, the Lord tests us, and blesses us with His Glance of Grace. ||8||5||

[Ang 414 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh giaan dhiaan man maan |
English: The Gurmukh obtains spiritual wisdom, meditation and satisfaction of the mind.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਹਲੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਛਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh mahalee mehal pachhaan |
English: The Gurmukh realizes the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: guramukh surat sabad neesaan |1|
English: The Gurmukh is attuned to the Word of the Shabad, as his Insignia. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸੇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: aise prem bhagat veechaaree |
English: Such is the loving devotional worship of the Lord's contemplation.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh saachaa naam muraaree |1| rahaau |
English: The Gurmukh realizes the True Name, the Destroyer of ego. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਥਾਨਿ ਸੁਥਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: ahinis niramal thaan suthaan |
English: Day and night, he remains immaculately pure, and abides in the sublime place.

Gurbani: ਤੀਨ ਭਵਨ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: teen bhavan nihakeval giaan |
English: He gains the wisdom of the three worlds.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saache gur te hukam pachhaan |2|
English: Through the True Guru, the Command of the Lord's Will is realized. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਾ ਹਰਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: saachaa harakh naahee tis sog |
English: He enjoys true pleasure, and suffers no pain.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਭੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: amrit giaan mahaa ras bhog |
English: He enjoys the ambrosial wisdom, and the highest sublime essence.

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਸਮਾਈ ਸੁਖੀ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਗੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: panch samaaee sukhee sabh log |3|
English: He overcomes the five evil passions, and becomes the happiest of all men. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਗਲੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: sagalee jot teraa sabh koee |
English: Your Divine Light is contained in all; everyone belongs to You.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਜੋੜਿ ਵਿਛੋੜੇ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aape jorr vichhorre soee |
English: You Yourself join and separate again.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: aape karataa kare su hoee |4|
English: Whatever the Creator does, comes to pass. ||4||

Gurbani: ਢਾਹਿ ਉਸਾਰੇ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: dtaeh usaare hukam samaavai |
English: He demolishes, and He builds; by His Order, he merges us into Himself.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: hukamo varatai jo tis bhaavai |
English: Whatever is pleasing to His Will, happens.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: gur bin pooraa koe na paavai |5|
English: Without the Guru, no one obtains the Perfect Lord. ||5||

Gurbani: ਬਾਲਕ ਬਿਰਧਿ ਨ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਪਰਾਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: baalak biradh na surat paraan |
English: In childhood and old age, he does not understand.

Gurbani: ਭਰਿ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਬੂਡੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: bhar joban booddai abhimaan |
English: In the prime of youth, he is drowned in his pride.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਆ ਲਹਸਿ ਨਿਦਾਨਿ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: bin naavai kiaa lehas nidaan |6|
English: Without the Name, what can the fool obtain? ||6||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਅਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jis kaa an dhan sehaj na jaanaa |
English: He does not know the One who blesses him with nourishment and wealth.

Gurbani: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਨਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: bharam bhulaanaa fir pachhutaanaa |
English: Deluded by doubt, he later regrets and repents.

Gurbani: ਗਲਿ ਫਾਹੀ ਬਉਰਾ ਬਉਰਾਨਾ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: gal faahee bauraa bauraanaa |7|
English: The noose of death is around the neck of that crazy madman. ||7||

Gurbani: ਬੂਡਤ ਜਗੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਤਉ ਡਰਿ ਭਾਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: booddat jag dekhiaa tau ddar bhaage |
English: I saw the world drowning, and I ran away in fear.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur raakhe se vaddabhaage |
English: How very fortunate are those who have been saved by the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੮॥੬॥
Transliteration: naanak gur kee charanee laage |8|6|
English: O Nanak, they are attached to the feet of the Guru. ||8||6||

[Ang 414 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗੀਤੇ ਚੀਤਿ ਅਨੀਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: gaaveh geete cheet aneete |
English: They sing religious songs, but their consciousness is wicked.

Gurbani: ਰਾਗ ਸੁਣਾਇ ਕਹਾਵਹਿ ਬੀਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: raag sunaae kahaaveh beete |
English: They sing the songs, and call themselves divine,

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਝੂਠੁ ਅਨੀਤੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bin naavai man jhootth aneete |1|
English: but without the Name, their minds are false and wicked. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਹਾ ਚਲਹੁ ਮਨ ਰਹਹੁ ਘਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kahaa chalahu man rahahu ghare |
English: Where are you going? O mind, remain in your own home.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੇ ਖੋਜਤ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh raam naam tripataase khojat paavahu sehaj hare |1| rahaau |
English: The Gurmukhs are satisfied with the Lord's Name; searching, they easily find the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਮਨਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh man mohu sareeraa |
English: Sexual desire, anger and emotional attachment fill the mind and body;

Gurbani: ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਸੁ ਪੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: lab lobh ahankaar su peeraa |
English: greed and egotism lead only to pain.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: raam naam bin kiau man dheeraa |2|
English: How can the mind be comforted without the Lord's Name? ||2||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਵਣੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: antar naavan saach pachhaanai |
English: One who cleanses himself within, knows the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: antar kee gat guramukh jaanai |
English: The Gurmukh knows the condition of his innermost being.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: saach sabad bin mehal na pachhaanai |3|
English: Without the True Word of the Shabad, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is not realized. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: nirankaar meh aakaar samaavai |
English: One who merges his form into the Formless Lord,

Gurbani: ਅਕਲ ਕਲਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਟਿਕਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: akal kalaa sach saach ttikaavai |
English: abides in the True Lord, the Powerful, beyond power.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਨਰੁ ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: so nar garabh jon nahee aavai |4|
English: Such a person does not enter into the womb of reincarnation again. ||4||

Gurbani: ਜਹਾਂ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਹ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jahaan naam milai teh jaau |
English: Go there, where you may obtain the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee karam kamaau |
English: By Guru's Grace, perform good deeds.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੇ ਰਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: naame raataa har gun gaau |5|
English: Imbued with the Naam, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||5||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur sevaa te aap pachhaataa |
English: Serving the Guru, I have come to understand myself.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: amrit naam vasiaa sukhadaataa |
English: The Ambrosial Naam, the Giver of Peace, abides within my mind.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: anadin baanee naame raataa |6|
English: Night and day, I am imbued with the Word of the Guru's Bani, and the Naam. ||6||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਾਏ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: meraa prabh laae taa ko laagai |
English: When my God attaches someone to Him, only then is that person attached.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੇ ਸਬਦੇ ਜਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: haumai maare sabade jaagai |
English: Conquering ego, he remains awake to the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਆਗੈ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: aithai othai sadaa sukh aagai |7|
English: Here and hereafter, he enjoys lasting peace. ||7||

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਚੰਚਲੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: man chanchal bidh naahee jaanai |
English: The fickle mind does not know the way.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮੈਲਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh mailaa sabad na pachhaanai |
English: The filthy self-willed manmukh does not understand the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: guramukh niramal naam vakhaanai |8|
English: The Gurmukh chants the Immaculate Naam. ||8||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਗੈ ਕਰੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: har jeeo aagai karee aradaas |
English: I offer my prayer to the Lord,

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: saadhoo jan sangat hoe nivaas |
English: that I might dwell in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਟੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: kilavikh dukh kaatte har naam pragaas |9|
English: There, sins and sufferings are erased, and one is illumined with the Lord's Name. ||9||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਆਚਾਰੁ ਪਰਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: kar beechaar aachaar paraataa |
English: In reflective meditation, I have come to love good conduct.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: satigur bachanee eko jaataa |
English: Through the Word of the True Guru, I recognize the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੧੦॥੭॥
Transliteration: naanak raam naam man raataa |10|7|
English: O Nanak, my mind is imbued with the Lord's Name. ||10||7||

[Ang 415 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਮੈਗਲੁ ਸਾਕਤੁ ਦੇਵਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: man maigal saakat devaanaa |
English: The mind of the faithless cynic is like a crazy elephant.

Gurbani: ਬਨ ਖੰਡਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਹੈਰਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: ban khandd maaeaa mohi hairaanaa |
English: It wanders around the forest, distracted by attachment to Maya.

Gurbani: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਜਾਹਿ ਕਾਲ ਕੇ ਚਾਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: eit ut jaeh kaal ke chaape |
English: It goes here and there, hounded by death.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹੈ ਘਰੁ ਆਪੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: guramukh khoj lahai ghar aape |1|
English: The Gurmukh seeks, and finds his own home. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੈ ਮਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਠਉਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: bin gurasabadai man nahee tthauraa |
English: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the mind finds no place of rest.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਅਵਰ ਤਿਆਗਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਉਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: simarahu raam naam at niramal avar tiaagahu haumai kauraa |1| rahaau |
English: Remember in meditation the Lord's Name, the most pure and sublime; renounce your bitter egotism. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਉ ਰਹਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: eihu man mugadh kahahu kiau rahasee |
English: Tell me, how can this stupid mind be rescued?

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਮਝੇ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਹਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: bin samajhe jam kaa dukh sahasee |
English: Without understanding, it shall suffer the pains of death.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: aape bakhase satigur melai |
English: The Lord Himself forgives us, and unites us with the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਕਾਲੁ ਕੰਟਕੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸਚੁ ਪੇਲੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kaal kanttak maare sach pelai |2|
English: The True Lord conquers and overcomes the tortures of death. ||2||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਰਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: eihu man karamaa ihu man dharamaa |
English: This mind commits its deeds of karma, and this mind follows the Dharma.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਤੇ ਜਨਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: eihu man panch tat te janamaa |
English: This mind is born of the five elements.

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤੁ ਲੋਭੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੂੜਾ ॥
Transliteration: saakat lobhee ihu man moorraa |
English: This foolish mind is perverted and greedy.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਮਨੁ ਰੂੜਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: guramukh naam japai man roorraa |3|
English: Chanting the Naam, the mind of the Gurmukh becomes beautiful. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਅਸਥਾਨੇ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh man asathaane soee |
English: The mind of the Gurmukh finds the Lord's home.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh tribhavan sojhee hoee |
English: The Gurmukh comes to know the three worlds.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਭੋਗੀ ਤਪੁ ਤਾਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: eihu man jogee bhogee tap taapai |
English: This mind is a Yogi, an enjoyer, a practicer of austerities.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚੀਨੈੑ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: guramukh cheenai har prabh aapai |4|
English: The Gurmukh understands the Lord God Himself. ||4||

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: man bairaagee haumai tiaagee |
English: This mind is a detached renunciate, forsaking egotism.

Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਮਨਸਾ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt manasaa dubidhaa laagee |
English: Desire and duality afflict each and every heart.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਾਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: raam rasaaein guramukh chaakhai |
English: The Gurmukh drinks in the Lord's sublime essence;

Gurbani: ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮਹਲੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੈ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: dar ghar mahalee har pat raakhai |5|
English: at His Door, in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, He preserves his honor. ||5||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਸੂਰ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਾਮਿ ॥
Transliteration: eihu man raajaa soor sangraam |
English: This mind is the king, the hero of cosmic battles.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ॥
Transliteration: eihu man nirbhau guramukh naam |
English: The mind of the Gurmukh becomes fearless through the Naam.

Gurbani: ਮਾਰੇ ਪੰਚ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਏ ॥
Transliteration: maare panch apunai vas kee |
English: Overpowering and subduing the five passions,

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਗ੍ਰਾਸਿ ਇਕਤੁ ਥਾਇ ਕੀਏ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: haumai graas ikat thaae kee |6|
English: holding ego in its grip, it confines them to one place. ||6||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਗ ਸੁਆਦ ਅਨ ਤਿਆਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh raag suaad an tiaage |
English: The Gurmukh renounces other songs and tastes.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh ihu man bhagatee jaage |
English: The mind of the Gurmukh is awakened to devotion.

Gurbani: ਅਨਹਦ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: anahad sun maaniaa sabad veechaaree |
English: Hearing the unstruck music of the sound current, this mind contemplates the Shabad, and accepts it.

Gurbani: ਆਤਮੁ ਚੀਨਿੑ ਭਏ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: aatam cheena bhe nirankaaree |7|
English: Understanding itself, this soul becomes attuned to the Formless Lord. ||7||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: eihu man niramal dar ghar soee |
English: This mind becomes immaculately pure, in the Court and the Home of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਉ ਧੁਨਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh bhagat bhaau dhun hoee |
English: The Gurmukh shows his love through loving devotional worship.

Gurbani: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ahinis har jas gur parasaad |
English: Night and day, by Guru's Grace, sing the Lord's Praises.

Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt so prabh aad jugaad |8|
English: God dwells in each and every heart, since the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages. ||8||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: raam rasaaein ihu man maataa |
English: This mind is intoxicated with the sublime essence of the Lord;

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: sarab rasaaein guramukh jaataa |
English: The Gurmukh realizes the essence of totality.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਹੇਤੁ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat het gur charan nivaasaa |
English: For the sake of devotional worship, he dwells at the Guru's Feet.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੯॥੮॥
Transliteration: naanak har jan ke daasan daasaa |9|8|
English: Nanak is the humble servant of the slave of the Lord's slaves. ||9||8||

[Ang 416 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਧਨੁ ਕਾ ਕੋ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: tan binasai dhan kaa ko kaheeai |
English: When the body perishes, whose wealth is it?

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਤ ਲਹੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: bin gur raam naam kat laheeai |
English: Without the Guru, how can the Lord's Name be obtained?

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam dhan sang sakhaaee |
English: The wealth of the Lord's Name is my Companion and Helper.

Gurbani: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ahinis niramal har liv laaee |1|
English: Night and day, center your loving attention on the Immaculate Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਵਨੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam bin kavan hamaaraa |
English: Without the Lord's Name, who is ours?

Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਉ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sukh dukh sam kar naam na chhoddau aape bakhas milaavanahaaraa |1| rahaau |
English: I look upon pleasure and pain alike; I shall not forsake the Naam, the Name of the Lord. The Lord Himself forgives me, and blends me with Himself. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਨਿਕ ਕਾਮਨੀ ਹੇਤੁ ਗਵਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kanik kaamanee het gavaaraa |
English: The fool loves gold and women.

Gurbani: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਲਾਗੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: dubidhaa laage naam visaaraa |
English: Attached to duality, he has forgotten the Naam.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਬਖਸਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jis toon bakhaseh naam japaae |
English: O Lord, he alone chants the Naam, whom You have forgiven.

Gurbani: ਦੂਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਗਿ ਸਕੈ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: doot na laag sakai gun gaae |2|
English: Death cannot touch one who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਪਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: har gur daataa raam gupaalaa |
English: The Lord, the Guru, is the Giver; the Lord, the Sustainer of the World.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖੁ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: jiau bhaavai tiau raakh deaalaa |
English: If it is pleasing to Your Will, please preserve me, O Merciful Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh raam merai man bhaaeaa |
English: As Gurmukh, my mind is pleased with the Lord.

Gurbani: ਰੋਗ ਮਿਟੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: rog mitte dukh tthaak rahaaeaa |3|
English: My diseases are cured, and my pains are taken away. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਤੰਤ ਨ ਮੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: avar na aaukhadh tant na mantaa |
English: There is no other medicine, Tantric charm or mantra.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਣੁ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਹੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: har har simaran kilavikh hantaa |
English: Meditative remembrance upon the Lord, Har, Har, destroys sins.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਵਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: toon aap bhulaaveh naam visaar |
English: You Yourself cause us to stray from the path, and forget the Naam.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: toon aape raakheh kirapaa dhaar |4|
English: Showering Your Mercy, You Yourself save us. ||4||

Gurbani: ਰੋਗੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਭੇਦੁ ਮਨਿ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: rog bharam bhed man doojaa |
English: The mind is diseased with doubt, superstition and duality.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਜਪਹਿ ਜਪੁ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur bin bharam japeh jap doojaa |
English: Without the Guru, it dwells in doubt, and contemplates duality.

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸ ਨ ਦੇਖਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: aad purakh gur daras na dekheh |
English: The Guru reveals the Darshan, the Blessed Vision of the Primal Lord.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੈ ਜਨਮੁ ਕਿ ਲੇਖਹਿ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: vin gurasabadai janam ki lekheh |5|
English: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, what use is human life? ||5||

Gurbani: ਦੇਖਿ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਰਹੇ ਬਿਸਮਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: dekh acharaj rahe bisamaad |
English: Beholding the Marvellous Lord, I am wonder-struck and astonished.

Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸੁਰ ਨਰ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt sur nar sehaj samaadh |
English: In each and every heart, of the angels and holy men, He dwells in celestial Samaadhi.

Gurbani: ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: bharipur dhaar rahe man maahee |
English: I have enshrined the All-pervading Lord within my mind.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: tum samasar avar ko naahee |6|
English: There is no one else equal to You. ||6||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੇਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kee bhagat het mukh naam |
English: For the sake of devotional worship, we chant Your Name.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਭਗਤ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਰਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: sant bhagat kee sangat raam |
English: The Lord's devotees dwell in the Society of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋਰੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: bandhan tore sehaj dhiaan |
English: Breaking his bonds, one comes to meditate on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਛੂਟੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: chhoottai guramukh har gur giaan |7|
English: The Gurmukhs are emancipated, by the Guru-given knowledge of the Lord. ||7||

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਜਮਦੂਤ ਦੂਖੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: naa jamadoot dookh tis laagai |
English: The Messenger of Death cannot touch him with pain;

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਜਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: jo jan raam naam liv jaagai |
English: the Lord's humble servant remains awake to the Love of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਭਗਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat vachhal bhagataa har sang |
English: The Lord is the Lover of His devotees; He dwells with His devotees.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਏ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੮॥੯॥
Transliteration: naanak mukat bhe har rang |8|9|
English: O Nanak, they are liberated, through the Love of the Lord. ||8||9||

[Ang 416 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਇਕਤੁਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ikatukee |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl, Ik-Tukee:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur seve so tthaakur jaanai |
English: One who serves the Guru, knows his Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਦੂਖੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dookh mittai sach sabad pachhaanai |1|
English: His pains are erased, and he realizes the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਸਖੀ ਸਖੈਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: raam japahu meree sakhee sakhainee |
English: Meditate on the Lord, O my friends and companions.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨੈਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sev dekhahu prabh nainee |1| rahaau |
English: Serving the True Guru, you shall behold God with your eyes. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬੰਧਨ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: bandhan maat pitaa sansaar |
English: People are entangled with mother, father and the world.

Gurbani: ਬੰਧਨ ਸੁਤ ਕੰਨਿਆ ਅਰੁ ਨਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bandhan sut kaniaa ar naar |2|
English: They are entangled with sons, daughters and spouses. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਹਉ ਕੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: bandhan karam dharam hau keea |
English: They are entangled with religious rituals, and religious faith, acting in ego.

Gurbani: ਬੰਧਨ ਪੁਤੁ ਕਲਤੁ ਮਨਿ ਬੀਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bandhan put kalat man beea |3|
English: They are entangled with sons, wives and others in their minds. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਿਰਖੀ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਿਰਸਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: bandhan kirakhee kareh kirasaan |
English: The farmers are entangled by farming.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਡੰਨੁ ਸਹੈ ਰਾਜਾ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: haumai ddan sahai raajaa mangai daan |4|
English: People suffer punishment in ego, and the Lord King exacts the penalty from them. ||4||

Gurbani: ਬੰਧਨ ਸਉਦਾ ਅਣਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: bandhan saudaa anaveechaaree |
English: They are entangled in trade without contemplation.

Gurbani: ਤਿਪਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਸਾਰੀ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: tipat naahee maaeaa moh pasaaree |5|
English: They are not satisfied by attachment to the expanse of Maya. ||5||

Gurbani: ਬੰਧਨ ਸਾਹ ਸੰਚਹਿ ਧਨੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bandhan saah sancheh dhan jaae |
English: They are entangled with that wealth, amassed by bankers.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਪਵਈ ਥਾਇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: bin har bhagat na pavee thaae |6|
English: Without devotion to the Lord, they do not become acceptable. ||6||

Gurbani: ਬੰਧਨ ਬੇਦੁ ਬਾਦੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: bandhan bed baad ahankaar |
English: They are entangled with the Vedas, religious discussions and egotism.

Gurbani: ਬੰਧਨਿ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਮੋਹ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: bandhan binasai moh vikaar |7|
English: They are entangled, and perish in attachment and corruption. ||7||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: naanak raam naam saranaaee |
English: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਬੰਧੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੮॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: satigur raakhe bandh na paaee |8|10|
English: One who is saved by the True Guru, does not suffer entanglement. ||8||10||

[Ang 417 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: raag aasaa mahalaa 1 asattapadeea ghar 3 |
English: Raag Aasaa, First Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa, Third House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਸਿਰਿ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਪਟੀਆ ਮਾਂਗੀ ਪਾਇ ਸੰਧੂਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jin sir sohan patteea maangee paae sandhoor |
English: Those heads adorned with braided hair, with their parts painted with vermillion

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਸਿਰ ਕਾਤੀ ਮੁੰਨੀਅਨਿੑ ਗਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਵੈ ਧੂੜਿ ॥
Transliteration: se sir kaatee muneeana gal vich aavai dhoorr |
English: those heads were shaved with scissors, and their throats were choked with dust.

Gurbani: ਮਹਲਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹੋਦੀਆ ਹੁਣਿ ਬਹਣਿ ਨ ਮਿਲਨਿੑ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mahalaa andar hodeea hun behan na milana hadoor |1|
English: They lived in palatial mansions, but now, they cannot even sit near the palaces. ||1||

Gurbani: ਆਦੇਸੁ ਬਾਬਾ ਆਦੇਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: aades baabaa aades |
English: Hail to You, O Father Lord, Hail to You!

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਵੇਸ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aad purakh teraa ant na paaeaa kar kar dekheh ves |1| rahaau |
English: O Primal Lord. Your limits are not known; You create, and create, and behold the scenes. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਦਹੁ ਸੀਆ ਵੀਆਹੀਆ ਲਾੜੇ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: jadahu seea veeaaheea laarre sohan paas |
English: When they were married, their husbands looked so handsome beside them.

Gurbani: ਹੀਡੋਲੀ ਚੜਿ ਆਈਆ ਦੰਦ ਖੰਡ ਕੀਤੇ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: heeddolee charr aaeea dand khandd keete raas |
English: They came in palanquins, decorated with ivory;

Gurbani: ਉਪਰਹੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਵਾਰੀਐ ਝਲੇ ਝਿਮਕਨਿ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: auparahu paanee vaareeai jhale jhimakan paas |2|
English: water was sprinkled over their heads, and glittering fans were waved above them. ||2||

Gurbani: ਇਕੁ ਲਖੁ ਲਹਨਿੑ ਬਹਿਠੀਆ ਲਖੁ ਲਹਨਿੑ ਖੜੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: eik lakh lehana bahittheea lakh lehana kharreea |
English: They were given hundreds of thousands of coins when they sat, and hundreds of thousands of coins when they stood.

Gurbani: ਗਰੀ ਛੁਹਾਰੇ ਖਾਂਦੀਆ ਮਾਣਨਿੑ ਸੇਜੜੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: garee chhuhaare khaandeea maanana sejarreea |
English: They ate coconuts and dates, and rested comfortably upon their beds.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨੑ ਗਲਿ ਸਿਲਕਾ ਪਾਈਆ ਤੁਟਨਿੑ ਮੋਤਸਰੀਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tina gal silakaa paaeea tuttana motasareea |3|
English: But ropes were put around their necks, and their strings of pearls were broken. ||3||

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਦੁਇ ਵੈਰੀ ਹੋਏ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਰਖੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: dhan joban due vairee hoe jinaee rakhe rang laae |
English: Their wealth and youthful beauty, which gave them so much pleasure, have now become their enemies.

Gurbani: ਦੂਤਾ ਨੋ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ਲੈ ਚਲੇ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: dootaa no furamaaeaa lai chale pat gavaae |
English: The order was given to the soldiers, who dishonored them, and carried them away.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: je tis bhaavai de vaddiaaee je bhaavai dee sajaae |4|
English: If it is pleasing to God's Will, He bestows greatness; if is pleases His Will, He bestows punishment. ||4||

Gurbani: ਅਗੋ ਦੇ ਜੇ ਚੇਤੀਐ ਤਾਂ ਕਾਇਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: ago de je cheteeai taan kaaeit milai sajaae |
English: If someone focuses on the Lord beforehand, then why should he be punished?

Gurbani: ਸਾਹਾਂ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗਵਾਈਆ ਰੰਗਿ ਤਮਾਸੈ ਚਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: saahaan surat gavaaeea rang tamaasai chaae |
English: The kings had lost their higher consciousness, reveling in pleasure and sensuality.

Gurbani: ਬਾਬਰਵਾਣੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਗਈ ਕੁਇਰੁ ਨ ਰੋਟੀ ਖਾਇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: baabaravaanee fir gee kueir na rottee khaae |5|
English: Since Baabar's rule has been proclaimed, even the princes have no food to eat. ||5||

Gurbani: ਇਕਨਾ ਵਖਤ ਖੁਆਈਅਹਿ ਇਕਨੑਾ ਪੂਜਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: eikanaa vakhat khuaaeeeh ikanaa poojaa jaae |
English: The Muslims have lost their five times of daily prayer, and the Hindus have lost their worship as well.

Gurbani: ਚਉਕੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਹਿੰਦਵਾਣੀਆ ਕਿਉ ਟਿਕੇ ਕਢਹਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: chauke vin hindavaaneea kiau ttike kadteh naae |
English: Without their sacred squares, how shall the Hindu women bathe and apply the frontal marks to their foreheads?

Gurbani: ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਹੁਣਿ ਕਹਣਿ ਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: raam na kabahoo chetio hun kehan na milai khudaae |6|
English: They never remembered their Lord as Raam, and now they cannot even chant Khudaa-i||6||

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਇਕਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਪੁਛਹਿ ਸੁਖ ॥
Transliteration: eik ghar aaveh aapanai ik mil mil puchheh sukh |
English: Some have returned to their homes, and meeting their relatives, they ask about their safety.

Gurbani: ਇਕਨੑਾ ਏਹੋ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਬਹਿ ਬਹਿ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਦੁਖ ॥
Transliteration: eikanaa eho likhiaa beh beh roveh dukh |
English: For some, it is pre-ordained that they shall sit and cry out in pain.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਆ ਮਾਨੁਖ ॥੭॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: jo tis bhaavai so theeai naanak kiaa maanukh |7|11|
English: Whatever pleases Him, comes to pass. O Nanak, what is the fate of mankind? ||7||11||

[Ang 417 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਹਾ ਸੁ ਖੇਲ ਤਬੇਲਾ ਘੋੜੇ ਕਹਾ ਭੇਰੀ ਸਹਨਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kahaa su khel tabelaa ghorre kahaa bheree sahanaaee |
English: Where are the games, the stables, the horses? Where are the drums and the bugles?

Gurbani: ਕਹਾ ਸੁ ਤੇਗਬੰਦ ਗਾਡੇਰੜਿ ਕਹਾ ਸੁ ਲਾਲ ਕਵਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kahaa su tegaband gaadderarr kahaa su laal kavaaee |
English: Where are the sword-belts and chariots? Where are those scarlet uniforms?

Gurbani: ਕਹਾ ਸੁ ਆਰਸੀਆ ਮੁਹ ਬੰਕੇ ਐਥੈ ਦਿਸਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kahaa su aaraseea muh banke aithai diseh naahee |1|
English: Where are the rings and the beautiful faces? They are no longer to be seen here. ||1||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਗੋਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: eihu jag teraa too gosaaee |
English: This world is Yours; You are the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਘੜੀ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੇ ਜਰੁ ਵੰਡਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਭਾਂਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ek gharree meh thaap uthaape jar vandd devai bhaanee |1| rahaau |
English: In an instant, You establish and disestablish. You distribute wealth as it pleases You. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਹਾਂ ਸੁ ਘਰ ਦਰ ਮੰਡਪ ਮਹਲਾ ਕਹਾ ਸੁ ਬੰਕ ਸਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kahaan su ghar dar manddap mahalaa kahaa su bank saraaee |
English: Where are the houses, the gates, the hotels and palaces? Where are those beautiful way-stations?

Gurbani: ਕਹਾਂ ਸੁ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਵੇਖਿ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kahaan su sej sukhaalee kaaman jis vekh need na paaee |
English: Where are those beautiful women, reclining on their beds, whose beauty would not allow one to sleep?

Gurbani: ਕਹਾ ਸੁ ਪਾਨ ਤੰਬੋਲੀ ਹਰਮਾ ਹੋਈਆ ਛਾਈ ਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kahaa su paan tanbolee haramaa hoeea chhaaee maaee |2|
English: Where are those betel leaves, their sellers, and the haremees? They have vanished like shadows. ||2||

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਜਰ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਘਣੀ ਵਿਗੁਤੀ ਇਨਿ ਜਰ ਘਣੀ ਖੁਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: eis jar kaaran ghanee vigutee in jar ghanee khuaaee |
English: For the sake of this wealth, so many were ruined; because of this wealth, so many have been disgraced.

Gurbani: ਪਾਪਾ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੁਇਆ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: paapaa baajhahu hovai naahee mueaa saath na jaaee |
English: It was not gathered without sin, and it does not go along with the dead.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਖੁਸਿ ਲਏ ਚੰਗਿਆਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jis no aap khuaae karataa khus le changiaaee |3|
English: Those, whom the Creator Lord would destroy - first He strips them of virtue. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕੋਟੀ ਹੂ ਪੀਰ ਵਰਜਿ ਰਹਾਏ ਜਾ ਮੀਰੁ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਧਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kottee hoo peer varaj rahaae jaa meer suniaa dhaaeaa |
English: Millions of religious leaders failed to halt the invader, when they heard of the Emperor's invasion.

Gurbani: ਥਾਨ ਮੁਕਾਮ ਜਲੇ ਬਿਜ ਮੰਦਰ ਮੁਛਿ ਮੁਛਿ ਕੁਇਰ ਰੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: thaan mukaam jale bij mandar muchh muchh kueir rulaaeaa |
English: He burned the rest-houses and the ancient temples; he cut the princes limb from limb, and cast them into the dust.

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਮੁਗਲੁ ਨ ਹੋਆ ਅੰਧਾ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਰਚਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: koee mugal na hoaa andhaa kinai na parachaa laaeaa |4|
English: None of the Mugals went blind, and no one performed any miracle. ||4||

Gurbani: ਮੁਗਲ ਪਠਾਣਾ ਭਈ ਲੜਾਈ ਰਣ ਮਹਿ ਤੇਗ ਵਗਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: mugal patthaanaa bhee larraaee ran meh teg vagaaee |
English: The battle raged between the Mugals and the Pat'haans, and the swords clashed on the battlefield.

Gurbani: ਓਨੑੀ ਤੁਪਕ ਤਾਣਿ ਚਲਾਈ ਓਨੑੀ ਹਸਤਿ ਚਿੜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: onaee tupak taan chalaaee onaee hasat chirraaee |
English: They took aim and fired their guns, and they attacked with their elephants.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਚੀਰੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਟੀ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਮਰਣਾ ਭਾਈ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: jina kee cheeree daragah paattee tinaa maranaa bhaaee |5|
English: Those men whose letters were torn in the Lord's Court, were destined to die, O Siblings of Destiny. ||5||

Gurbani: ਇਕ ਹਿੰਦਵਾਣੀ ਅਵਰ ਤੁਰਕਾਣੀ ਭਟਿਆਣੀ ਠਕੁਰਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: eik hindavaanee avar turakaanee bhattiaanee tthakuraanee |
English: The Hindu women, the Muslim women, the Bhattis and the Rajputs

Gurbani: ਇਕਨੑਾ ਪੇਰਣ ਸਿਰ ਖੁਰ ਪਾਟੇ ਇਕਨੑਾ ਵਾਸੁ ਮਸਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: eikanaa peran sir khur paatte ikanaa vaas masaanee |
English: some had their robes torn away, from head to foot, while others came to dwell in the cremation ground.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑ ਕੇ ਬੰਕੇ ਘਰੀ ਨ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਿਉ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: jina ke banke gharee na aaeaa tina kiau rain vihaanee |6|
English: Their husbands did not return home - how did they pass their night? ||6||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: aape kare karaae karataa kis no aakh sunaaeeai |
English: The Creator Himself acts, and causes others to act. Unto whom should we complain?

Gurbani: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਿਸ ਥੈ ਜਾਇ ਰੂਆਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: dukh sukh terai bhaanai hovai kis thai jaae rooaaeeai |
English: Pleasure and pain come by Your Will; unto whom should we go and cry?

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਚਲਾਏ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੭॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: hukamee hukam chalaae vigasai naanak likhiaa paaeeai |7|12|
English: The Commander issues His Command, and is pleased. O Nanak, we receive what is written in our destiny. ||7||12||

[Ang 418 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਕਾਫੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੮ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa kaafee mahalaa 1 ghar 8 asattapadeea |
English: Aasaa, Kaafee, First Mehl, Eighth House, Ashtpadheeyaa:

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੇ ਗੋਇਲਿ ਗੋਇਲੀ ਤੈਸੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaise goeil goeilee taise sansaaraa |
English: As the shepherd is in the field for only a short time, so is one in the world.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਆਦਮੀ ਬਾਂਧਹਿ ਘਰ ਬਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: koorr kamaaveh aadamee baandheh ghar baaraa |1|
English: Practicing falsehood, they build their homes. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਾਗਹੁ ਜਾਗਹੁ ਸੂਤਿਹੋ ਚਲਿਆ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaagahu jaagahu sootiho chaliaa vanajaaraa |1| rahaau |
English: Wake up! Wake up! O sleepers, see that the travelling merchant is leaving. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨੀਤ ਨੀਤ ਘਰ ਬਾਂਧੀਅਹਿ ਜੇ ਰਹਣਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: neet neet ghar baandheeeh je rahanaa hoee |
English: Go ahead and build your houses, if you think you will stay here forever and ever.

Gurbani: ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪਵੈ ਜੀਉ ਚਲਸੀ ਜੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: pindd pavai jeeo chalasee je jaanai koee |2|
English: The body shall fall, and the soul shall depart; if only they knew this. ||2||

Gurbani: ਓਹੀ ਓਹੀ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਹੈ ਹੋਸੀ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: ohee ohee kiaa karahu hai hosee soee |
English: Why do you cry out and mourn for the dead? The Lord is, and shall always be.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਰੋਵਹੁਗੇ ਓਸ ਨੋ ਤੁਮੑ ਕਉ ਕਉਣੁ ਰੋਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tum rovahuge os no tuma kau kaun roee |3|
English: You mourn for that person, but who will mourn for you? ||3||

Gurbani: ਧੰਧਾ ਪਿਟਿਹੁ ਭਾਈਹੋ ਤੁਮੑ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: dhandhaa pittihu bhaaeeho tuma koorr kamaavahu |
English: You are engrossed in worldly entanglements, O Siblings of Destiny, and you are practicing falsehood.

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਨ ਸੁਣਈ ਕਤ ਹੀ ਤੁਮੑ ਲੋਕ ਸੁਣਾਵਹੁ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: ohu na sunee kat hee tuma lok sunaavahu |4|
English: The dead person does not hear anything at all; your cries are heard only by other people. ||4||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਸੁਤਾ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਾਗਾਏ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jis te sutaa naanakaa jaagaae soee |
English: Only the Lord, who causes the mortal to sleep, O Nanak, can awaken him again.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਘਰੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਾਂ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: je ghar boojhai aapanaa taan need na hoee |5|
English: One who understands his true home, does not sleep. ||5||

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਚਲਦਾ ਲੈ ਚਲਿਆ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੰਪੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: je chaladaa lai chaliaa kichh sanpai naale |
English: If the departing mortal can take his wealth with him,

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: taa dhan sanchahu dekh kai boojhahu beechaare |6|
English: then go ahead and gather wealth yourself. See this, reflect upon it, and understand. ||6||

Gurbani: ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਮਖਸੂਦੁ ਲੈਹੁ ਮਤ ਪਛੋਤਾਵਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: vanaj karahu makhasood laihu mat pachhotaavahu |
English: Make your deals, and obtain the true merchandise, or else you shall regret it later.

Gurbani: ਅਉਗਣ ਛੋਡਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਕਰਹੁ ਐਸੇ ਤਤੁ ਪਰਾਵਹੁ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: aaugan chhoddahu gun karahu aise tat paraavahu |7|
