English: Abandon your vices, and practice virtue, and you shall obtain the essence of reality. ||7||

Gurbani: ਧਰਮੁ ਭੂਮਿ ਸਤੁ ਬੀਜੁ ਕਰਿ ਐਸੀ ਕਿਰਸ ਕਮਾਵਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: dharam bhoom sat beej kar aisee kiras kamaavahu |
English: Plant the seed of Truth in the soil of Dharmic faith, and practice such farming.

Gurbani: ਤਾਂ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਜਾਣੀਅਹੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਲੈ ਜਾਵਹੁ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: taan vaapaaree jaaneeahu laahaa lai jaavahu |8|
English: Only then will you be known as a merchant, if you take your profits with you. ||8||

Gurbani: ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: karam hovai satigur milai boojhai beechaaraa |
English: If the Lord shows His Mercy, one meets the True Guru; contemplating Him, one comes to understand.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਸੁਣੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਬਿਉਹਾਰਾ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: naam vakhaanai sune naam naame biauhaaraa |9|
English: Then, one chants the Naam, hears the Naam, and deals only in the Naam. ||9||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਲਾਹਾ ਤੋਟਾ ਤਿਵੈ ਵਾਟ ਚਲਦੀ ਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: jiau laahaa tottaa tivai vaatt chaladee aaee |
English: As is the profit, so is the loss; this is the way of the world.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਾਈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧੦॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: jo tis bhaavai naanakaa saaee vaddiaaee |10|13|
English: Whatever pleases His Will, O Nanak, is glory for me. ||10||13||

[Ang 418 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਢੂਢੀਆ ਕੋ ਨੀਮੑੀ ਮੈਡਾ ॥
Transliteration: chaare kunddaa dtoodteea ko neemaee maiddaa |
English: I have searched in the four directions, but no one is mine.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਤੂ ਮੈ ਹਉ ਤੈਡਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: je tudh bhaavai saahibaa too mai hau taiddaa |1|
English: If it pleases You, O Lord Master, then You are mine, and I am Yours. ||1||

Gurbani: ਦਰੁ ਬੀਭਾ ਮੈ ਨੀਮਿੑ ਕੋ ਕੈ ਕਰੀ ਸਲਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: dar beebhaa mai neema ko kai karee salaam |
English: There is no other door for me; where shall I go to worship?

Gurbani: ਹਿਕੋ ਮੈਡਾ ਤੂ ਧਣੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hiko maiddaa too dhanee saachaa mukh naam |1| rahaau |
English: You are my only Lord; Your True Name is in my mouth. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਿਧਾ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸਿਧ ਪੀਰ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ॥
Transliteration: sidhaa sevan sidh peer maageh ridh sidh |
English: Some serve the Siddhas, the beings of spiritual perfection, and some serve spiritual teachers; they beg for wealth and miraculous powers.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਬੁਧਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mai ik naam na veesarai saache gur budh |2|
English: May I never forget the Naam, the Name of the One Lord. This is the wisdom of the True Guru. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੋਗੀ ਭੋਗੀ ਕਾਪੜੀ ਕਿਆ ਭਵਹਿ ਦਿਸੰਤਰ ॥
Transliteration: jogee bhogee kaaparree kiaa bhaveh disantar |
English: Why do the Yogis, the revellers, and the beggars wander in foreign lands?

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੑਹੀ ਤਤੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਨਿਰੰਤਰ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur kaa sabad na cheenahee tat saar nirantar |3|
English: They do not understand the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and the essence of excellence within them. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪਾਧੇ ਜੋਇਸੀ ਨਿਤ ਪੜ੍ਹਹਿ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: panddit paadhe joeisee nit parrheh puraanaa |
English: The Pandits, the religious scholars, the teachers and astrologers, and those who endlessly read the Puraanas,

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੑੀ ਘਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਲੁਕਾਣਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: antar vasat na jaananaee ghatt braham lukaanaa |4|
English: do not know what is within; God is hidden deep within them. ||4||

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਤਪਸੀ ਬਨ ਮਹਿ ਤਪੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਤੀਰਥ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: eik tapasee ban meh tap kareh nit teerath vaasaa |
English: Some penitents perform penance in the forests, and some dwell forever at sacred shrines.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਨ ਚੀਨਹਿ ਤਾਮਸੀ ਕਾਹੇ ਭਏ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: aap na cheeneh taamasee kaahe bhe udaasaa |5|
English: The unenlightened people do not understand themselves - why have they become renunciates? ||5||

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਦੇ ਸੇ ਜਤੀ ਕਹਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: eik bind jatan kar raakhade se jatee kahaaveh |
English: Some control their sexual energy, and are known as celibates.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਨ ਛੂਟਹੀ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: bin gurasabad na chhoottahee bhram aaveh jaaveh |6|
English: But without the Guru's Word, they are not saved, and they wander in reincarnation. ||6||

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਾਧਿਕਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: eik girahee sevak saadhikaa guramatee laage |
English: Some are householders, servants, and seekers, attached to the Guru's Teachings.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੁ ਜਾਗੇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: naam daan isanaan drirr har bhagat su jaage |7|
English: They hold fast to the Naam, to charity, to cleansing and purification; they remain awake in devotion to the Lord. ||7||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਸੋ ਜਾਇ ਸਿਞਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur te dar ghar jaaneeai so jaae siyaanai |
English: Through the Guru, the Gate of the Lord's Home is found, and that place is recognized.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥੮॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: naanak naam na veesarai saache man maanai |8|14|
English: Nanak does not forget the Naam; his mind has surrendered to the True Lord. ||8||14||

[Ang 419 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਲੇ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਸਚਿ ਤਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: manasaa maneh samaaeile bhaujal sach taranaa |
English: Stilling the desires of the mind, the mortal truly crosses over the terrifying world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤੂ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aad jugaad deaal too tthaakur teree saranaa |1|
English: In the very beginning, and throughout the ages, You have been the Merciful Lord and Master; I seek Your Sanctuary. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਦਾਤੌ ਹਮ ਜਾਚਿਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: too daatau ham jaachikaa har darasan deejai |
English: You are the Giver, and I am a mere beggar. Lord, please grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਮਨ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਭੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh naam dhiaaeeai man mandar bheejai |1| rahaau |
English: The Gurmukh meditates on the Naam; the temple of his mind resounds with joy. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕੂੜਾ ਲਾਲਚੁ ਛੋਡੀਐ ਤਉ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: koorraa laalach chhoddeeai tau saach pachhaanai |
English: Renouncing false greed, one comes to realize the Truth.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ਪਰਮਾਰਥੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad samaaeeai paramaarath jaanai |2|
English: So let yourself be absorbed in the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and know this supreme realization. ||2||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਲੋਭੀਆ ਲੁਭਤਉ ਲੋਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: eihu man raajaa lobheea lubhtau lobhaaee |
English: This mind is a greedy king, engrossed in greed.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: guramukh lobh nivaareeai har siau ban aaee |3|
English: The Gurmukh eliminates his greed, and comes to an understanding with the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਲਰਿ ਖੇਤੀ ਬੀਜੀਐ ਕਿਉ ਲਾਹਾ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: kalar khetee beejeeai kiau laahaa paavai |
English: Planting the seeds in the rocky soil, how can one reap a profit?

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਸਚਿ ਨ ਭੀਜਈ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੂੜਿ ਗਡਾਵੈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: manamukh sach na bheejee koorr koorr gaddaavai |4|
English: The self-willed manmukh is not pleased with Truth; the false are buried in falsehood. ||4||

Gurbani: ਲਾਲਚੁ ਛੋਡਹੁ ਅੰਧਿਹੋ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: laalach chhoddahu andhiho laalach dukh bhaaree |
English: So renounce greed - you are blind! Greed only brings pain.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੌ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: saachau saahib man vasai haumai bikh maaree |5|
English: When the True Lord dwells within the mind, the poisonous ego is conquered. ||5||

Gurbani: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਛੋਡਿ ਕੁਵਾਟੜੀ ਮੂਸਹੁਗੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: dubidhaa chhodd kuvaattarree moosahuge bhaaee |
English: Renounce the evil way of duality, or you shall be plundered, O Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: ahinis naam salaaheeai satigur saranaaee |6|
English: Day and night, praise the Naam, in the Sanctuary of the True Guru's protection. ||6||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਪਥਰੁ ਸੈਲੁ ਹੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਫੀਕਾ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh pathar sail hai dhrig jeevan feekaa |
English: The self-willed manmukh is a rock, a stone. His life is cursed and useless.

Gurbani: ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਕੇਤਾ ਰਾਖੀਐ ਅਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੂਕਾ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: jal meh ketaa raakheeai abh antar sookaa |7|
English: No matter now long a stone is kept under water, it still remains dry at its core. ||7||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam nidhaan hai poorai gur deea |
English: The Name of the Lord is the treasure; the Perfect Guru has given it to me.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਮਥਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ॥੮॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: naanak naam na veesarai math amrit peea |8|15|
English: O Nanak, one who does not forget the Naam, churns and drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||8||15||

[Ang 419 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਚਲੇ ਚਲਣਹਾਰ ਵਾਟ ਵਟਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: chale chalanahaar vaatt vattaaeaa |
English: The travellers travel from one road to another.

Gurbani: ਧੰਧੁ ਪਿਟੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dhandh pitte sansaar sach na bhaaeaa |1|
English: The world is engrossed in its entanglements, and does not appreciate the Truth. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਭਵੀਐ ਕਿਆ ਢੂਢੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa bhaveeai kiaa dtoodteeai gur sabad dikhaaeaa |
English: Why wander around, and why go searching, when the Guru's Shabad reveals Him to us?

Gurbani: ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਿਸਰਜਿਆ ਅਪਨੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mamataa mohu visarajiaa apanai ghar aaeaa |1| rahaau |
English: Leaving behind egotism and attachment, I have arrived at my own home. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ਕੂੜਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: sach milai sachiaar koorr na paaeeai |
English: Through Truth, one meets the True One; He is not obtained through falsehood.

Gurbani: ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਆਈਐ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sache siau chit laae bahurr na aaeeai |2|
English: Centering your consciousness on the True Lord, you shall not have to come into the world again. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮੋਇਆ ਕਉ ਕਿਆ ਰੋਵਹੁ ਰੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੂ ॥
Transliteration: moeaa kau kiaa rovahu roe na jaanahoo |
English: Why do you weep for the dead? You do not know how to weep.

Gurbani: ਰੋਵਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਹੂ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: rovahu sach salaeh hukam pachhaanahoo |3|
English: Weep by praising the True Lord, and recognize His Command. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਵਜਹੁ ਲਿਖਾਇ ਆਇਆ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: hukamee vajahu likhaae aaeaa jaaneeai |
English: Blessed is the birth of one who is destined to abide by the Lord's Command.

Gurbani: ਲਾਹਾ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਿਞਾਣੀਐ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: laahaa palai paae hukam siyaaneeai |4|
English: He obtains the true profit, realizing the Lord's Command. ||4||

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਇ ਦਰਗਹ ਭਾਣੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: hukamee paidhaa jaae daragah bhaaneeai |
English: If it pleases the Commander, one goes to His Court, robed in honor.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰ ਬੰਦਿ ਰਬਾਣੀਐ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: hukame hee sir maar band rabaaneeai |5|
English: By His Command, God's slaves are hit over the head. ||5||

Gurbani: ਲਾਹਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਆਉ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: laahaa sach niaau man vasaaeeai |
English: The profit is earned by enshrining Truth and justice in the mind.

Gurbani: ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ਗਰਬੁ ਵਞਾਈਐ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: likhiaa palai paae garab vayaaeeai |6|
English: They obtain what is written in their destiny, and overcome pride. ||6||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖੀਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰ ਵਾਦਿ ਖਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: manamukheea sir maar vaad khapaaeeai |
English: The self-willed manmukhs are hit over the head, and consumed by conflict.

Gurbani: ਠਗਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਬੰਨਿੑ ਚਲਾਈਐ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: tthag mutthee koorriaar bana chalaaeeai |7|
English: The cheaters are plundered by falsehood; they are chained and led away. ||7||

Gurbani: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਇ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਵਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: saahib ridai vasaae na pachhotaavahee |
English: Enshrine the Lord Master in your mind, and you shall not have to repent.

Gurbani: ਗੁਨਹਾਂ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਵਹੀ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: gunahaan bakhasanahaar sabad kamaavahee |8|
English: He forgives our sins, when we practice the Teachings of the Guru's Word. ||8||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਸਚੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਘਾਲੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: naanak mangai sach guramukh ghaaleeai |
English: Nanak begs for the True Name, which is obtained by the Gurmukh.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀਐ ॥੯॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: mai tujh bin avar na koe nadar nihaaleeai |9|16|
English: Without You, I have no other at all; please, bless me with Your Glance of Grace. ||9||16||

[Ang 420 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਜੰਗਲੁ ਢੂਢੀ ਜਾਇ ਮੈ ਘਰਿ ਬਨੁ ਹਰੀਆਵਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa jangal dtoodtee jaae mai ghar ban hareeaavalaa |
English: Why should I go searching in the forests, when the woods of my home are so green?

Gurbani: ਸਚਿ ਟਿਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇ ਸਬਦਿ ਉਤਾਵਲਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sach ttikai ghar aae sabad utaavalaa |1|
English: The True Word of the Shabad has instantaneously come and settled in my heart. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਸੋਇ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: jeh dekhaa teh soe avar na jaaneeai |
English: Wherever I look, there He is; I know no other.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur kee kaar kamaae mehal pachhaaneeai |1| rahaau |
English: Working for the Guru, one realizes the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਈ ॥
Transliteration: aap milaavai sach taa man bhaavee |
English: The True Lord blends us with Himself, when it is pleasing to His Mind.

Gurbani: ਚਲੈ ਸਦਾ ਰਜਾਇ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਵਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: chalai sadaa rajaae ank samaavee |2|
English: One who ever walks in accordance with His Will, merges into His Being. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa saahib man vasai vasiaa man soee |
English: When the True Lord dwells in the mind, that mind flourishes.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aape de vaddiaaeea de tott na hoee |3|
English: He Himself grants greatness; His Gifts are never exhausted. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅਬੇ ਤਬੇ ਕੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਕਿਉ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: abe tabe kee chaakaree kiau daragah paavai |
English: Serving this and that person, how can one obtain the Lord's Court?

Gurbani: ਪਥਰ ਕੀ ਬੇੜੀ ਜੇ ਚੜੈ ਭਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਬੁਡਾਵੈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: pathar kee berree je charrai bhar naal buddaavai |4|
English: If someone embarks on a boat of stone, he shall drown with its cargo. ||4||

Gurbani: ਆਪਨੜਾ ਮਨੁ ਵੇਚੀਐ ਸਿਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: aapanarraa man vecheeai sir deejai naale |
English: So offer your mind, and surrender your head with it.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਅਪਨਾ ਘਰੁ ਭਾਲੇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: guramukh vasat pachhaaneeai apanaa ghar bhaale |5|
English: The Gurmukh realizes the true essence, and finds the home of his own self. ||5||

Gurbani: ਜੰਮਣ ਮਰਣਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਤਿਨਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਕੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: jaman maranaa aakheeai tin karatai keea |
English: People discuss birth and death; the Creator created this.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਮਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਥੀਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: aap gavaaeaa mar rahe fir maran na theea |6|
English: Those who conquer their selfhood and remain dead, shall never have to die again. ||6||

Gurbani: ਸਾਈ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਧੁਰ ਕੀ ਫੁਰਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: saaee kaar kamaavanee dhur kee furamaaee |
English: Do those deeds which the Primal Lord has ordered for you.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਕਿਨਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: je man satigur de milai kin keemat paaee |7|
English: If one surrenders his mind upon meeting the True Guru, who can estimate its value? ||7||

Gurbani: ਰਤਨਾ ਪਾਰਖੁ ਸੋ ਧਣੀ ਤਿਨਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ratanaa paarakh so dhanee tin keemat paaee |
English: That Lord Master is the Assayer of the jewel of the mind; He places the value on it.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੮॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: naanak saahib man vasai sachee vaddiaaee |8|17|
English: O Nanak, True is the Glory of that one, in whose mind the Lord Master dwells. ||8||17||

[Ang 420 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jinaee naam visaariaa doojai bharam bhulaaee |
English: Those who have forgotten the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are deluded by doubt and duality.

Gurbani: ਮੂਲੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਡਾਲੀ ਲਗੇ ਕਿਆ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਛਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mool chhodd ddaalee lage kiaa paaveh chhaaee |1|
English: Those who abandon the roots and cling to the branches, shall obtain only ashes. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਉ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਜੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: bin naavai kiau chhootteeai je jaanai koee |
English: Without the Name, how can one be emancipated? Who knows this?

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh hoe ta chhootteeai manamukh pat khoee |1| rahaau |
English: One who becomes Gurmukh is emancipated; the self-willed manmukhs lose their honor. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਏਕੋ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jinaee eko seviaa pooree mat bhaaee |
English: Those who serve the One Lord become perfect in their understanding, O Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਾ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aad jugaad niranjanaa jan har saranaaee |2|
English: The Lord's humble servant finds Sanctuary in Him, the Immaculate One, from the very beginning, and throughout the ages. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: saahib meraa ek hai avar nahee bhaaee |
English: My Lord and Master is the One; there is no other, O Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਚੇ ਪਰਥਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kirapaa te sukh paaeaa saache parathaaee |3|
English: By the Grace of the True Lord, celestial peace is obtained. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਕੇਤੀ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur bin kinai na paaeo ketee kahai kahaae |
English: Without the Guru, no one has obtained Him, although many may claim to have done so.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਵਾਟੜੀਂ ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: aap dikhaavai vaattarreen sachee bhagat drirraae |4|
English: He Himself reveals the Way, and implants true devotion within. ||4||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਜੇ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਭੀ ਉਝੜਿ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh je samajhaaeeai bhee ujharr jaae |
English: Even if the self-willed manmukh is instructed, he stills goes into the wilderness.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਛੂਟਸੀ ਮਰਿ ਨਰਕ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: bin har naam na chhoottasee mar narak samaae |5|
English: Without the Lord's Name, he shall not be emancipated; he shall die, and sink into hell. ||5||

Gurbani: ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਭਰਮਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਲੇਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: janam marai bharamaaeeai har naam na levai |
English: He wanders through birth and death, and never chants the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵੈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: taa kee keemat naa pavai bin gur kee sevai |6|
English: He never realizes his own value, without serving the Guru. ||6||

Gurbani: ਜੇਹੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਾਈਐ ਕਰਣੀ ਭੀ ਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jehee sev karaaeeai karanee bhee saaee |
English: Whatever service the Lord causes us to do, that is just what we do.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਵੇਖੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: aap kare kis aakheeai vekhai vaddiaaee |7|
English: He Himself acts; who else should be mentioned? He beholds His own greatness. ||7||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur kee sevaa so kare jis aap karaae |
English: He alone serves the Guru, whom the Lord Himself inspires to do so.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਰੁ ਦੇ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੮॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: naanak sir de chhootteeai daragah pat paae |8|18|
English: O Nanak, offering his head, one is emancipated, and honored in the Court of the Lord. ||8||18||

[Ang 421 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰੂੜੋ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮਾਹਰੋ ਰੂੜੀ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: roorro tthaakur maaharo roorree gurabaanee |
English: Beautiful is the Supreme Lord and Master, and beautiful is the Word of the Guru's Bani.

Gurbani: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: vaddai bhaag satigur milai paaeeai pad nirabaanee |1|
English: By great good fortune, one meets the True Guru, and the supreme status of Nirvaanaa is obtained. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਓਲੑਗੀਆ ਓਲੑਗੀ ਹਮ ਛੋਰੂ ਥਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: mai olageea olagee ham chhoroo thaare |
English: I am the lowest slave of Your slaves; I am Your most humble servant.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਰਹਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jiau toon raakheh tiau rahaa mukh naam hamaare |1| rahaau |
English: As You keep me, I live. Your Name is in my mouth. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸਾ ਘਣੀ ਭਾਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: darasan kee piaasaa ghanee bhaanai man bhaaeeai |
English: I have such a great thirst for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; my mind accepts Your Will, and so You are pleased with me.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਾਥਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਭਾਣੈ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mere tthaakur haath vaddiaaeea bhaanai pat paaeeai |2|
English: Greatness is in the Hands of my Lord and Master; by His Will, honor is obtained. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਉ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: saachau door na jaaneeai antar hai soee |
English: Do not think that the True Lord is far away; He is deep within.

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਕਿਨਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jeh dekhaa teh rav rahe kin keemat hoee |3|
English: Wherever I look, there I find Him pervading; how can I estimate His value? ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਹਰੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: aap kare aape hare vekhai vaddiaaee |
English: He Himself does, and He Himself undoes. He Himself beholds His glorious greatness.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਹਾਲੀਐ ਇਉ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: guramukh hoe nihaaleeai iau keemat paaee |4|
English: Becoming Gurmukh, one beholds Him, and so, His value is appraised. ||4||

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਲਾਹਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jeevadiaa laahaa milai gur kaar kamaavai |
English: So earn your profits while you are alive, by serving the Guru.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: poorab hovai likhiaa taa satigur paavai |5|
English: If it is so pre-ordained, then one finds the True Guru. ||5||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਤੋਟਾ ਨਿਤ ਹੈ ਭਰਮਹਿ ਭਰਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh tottaa nit hai bharameh bharamaae |
English: The self-willed manmukhs continually lose, and wander around, deluded by doubt.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਈ ਕਿਉ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: manamukh andh na chetee kiau darasan paae |6|
English: The blind manmukhs do not remember the Lord; how can they obtain the Blessed Vision of His Darshan? ||6||

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਜਗਿ ਆਇਆ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਸਾਚੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: taa jag aaeaa jaaneeai saachai liv laae |
English: One's coming into the world is judged worthwhile only if one lovingly attunes oneself to the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਭਏ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: gur bhette paaras bhe jotee jot milaae |7|
English: Meeting the Guru, one becomes invaluable; his light merges into the Light. ||7||

Gurbani: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੋ ਕਾਰ ਧੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਰਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: ahinis rahai niraalamo kaar dhur kee karanee |
English: Day and night, he remains detached, and serves the Primal Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ॥੮॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: naanak naam santokheea raate har charanee |8|19|
English: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Lord's Lotus Feet, are content with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||8||19||

[Ang 421 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕੇਤਾ ਆਖਣੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਅੰਤ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: ketaa aakhan aakheeai taa ke ant na jaanaa |
English: No matter how much one may describe the Lord, His limits still cannot be known.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਨਿਧਰਿਆ ਧਰ ਏਕ ਤੂੰ ਮੈ ਤਾਣੁ ਸਤਾਣਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mai nidhariaa dhar ek toon mai taan sataanaa |1|
English: I am without any support; You, O Lord, are my only Support; You are my almighty power. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਸਚ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: naanak kee aradaas hai sach naam suhelaa |
English: This is Nanak's prayer, that he may be adorned with the True Name.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮੇਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aap geaa sojhee pee gurasabadee melaa |1| rahaau |
English: When self-conceit is eradicated, and understanding is obtained, one meets the Lord, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ਪਾਈਐ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: haumai garab gavaaeeai paaeeai veechaar |
English: Abandoning egotism and pride, one obtains contemplative understanding.

Gurbani: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਦੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saahib siau man maaniaa de saach adhaar |2|
English: When the mind surrenders to the Lord Master, He bestows the support of the Truth. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ahinis naam santokheea sevaa sach saaee |
English: Day and night, remain content with the Naam, the Name of the Lord; that is the true service.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗਈ ਚਾਲੈ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: taa kau bighan na laagee chaalai hukam rajaaee |3|
English: No misfortune troubles one who follows the Command of the Lord's Will. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਜਾਈ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਸੋ ਪਵੈ ਖਜਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: hukam rajaaee jo chalai so pavai khajaanai |
English: One who follows the Command of the Lord's Will is taken into the Lord's Treasury.

Gurbani: ਖੋਟੇ ਠਵਰ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੀ ਰਲੇ ਜੂਠਾਨੈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: khotte tthavar na paaeinee rale jootthaanai |4|
English: The counterfeit find no place there; they are mixed with the false ones. ||4||

Gurbani: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਖਰਾ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਸਉਦਾ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: nit nit kharaa samaaleeai sach saudaa paaeeai |
English: Forever and ever, the genuine coins are treasured; with them, the true merchandise is purchased.

Gurbani: ਖੋਟੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਨੀ ਲੇ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਲਾਈਐ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: khotte nadar na aavanee le agan jalaaeeai |5|
English: The false ones are not seen in the Lord's Treasury; they are seized and cast into the fire again. ||5||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਆਤਮੁ ਚੀਨਿਆ ਪਰਮਾਤਮੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jinee aatam cheeniaa paramaatam soee |
English: Those who understand their own souls, are themselves the Supreme Soul.

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਫਲੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: eko amrit birakh hai fal amrit hoee |6|
English: The One Lord is the tree of ambrosial nectar, which bears the ambrosial fruit. ||6||

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਅਘਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: amrit fal jinee chaakhiaa sach rahe aghaaee |
English: Those who taste the ambrosial fruit remain satisfied with Truth.

Gurbani: ਤਿੰਨਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਭੇਦੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਈ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: tinaa bharam na bhed hai har rasan rasaaee |7|
English: They have no doubt or sense of separation - their tongues taste the divine taste. ||7||

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਆਇਆ ਚਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: hukam sanjogee aaeaa chal sadaa rajaaee |
English: By His Command, and through your past actions, you came into the world; walk forever according to His Will.

Gurbani: ਅਉਗਣਿਆਰੇ ਕਉ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾਨਕੈ ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ ॥੮॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: aauganiaare kau gun naanakai sach milai vaddaaee |8|20|
English: Please, grant virtue to Nanak, the virtueless one; bless him with the glorious greatness of the Truth. ||8||20||

[Ang 421 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਾਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: man raatau har naae sach vakhaaniaa |
English: One whose mind is attuned to the Lord's Name speaks the truth.

Gurbani: ਲੋਕਾ ਦਾ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਇ ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: lokaa daa kiaa jaae jaa tudh bhaaniaa |1|
English: What would the people lose, if I became pleasing to You, O Lord? ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਲਗੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਰਾਣ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: jau lag jeeo paraan sach dhiaaeeai |
English: As long as there is the breath of life, meditate on the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: laahaa har gun gaae milai sukh paaeeai |1| rahaau |
English: You shall receive the profit of singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and find peace. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਚੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਾਰ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਤੂੰ ॥
Transliteration: sachee teree kaar dehi deaal toon |
English: True is Your Service; bless me with it, O Merciful Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਮੈ ਟੇਕ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਤੂੰ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: hau jeevaa tudh saalaeh mai ttek adhaar toon |2|
English: I live by praising You; You are my Anchor and Support. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦਰਿ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਦਰਵਾਨੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਤੂੰ ਜਾਣਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: dar sevak daravaan darad toon jaanahee |
English: I am Your servant, the gate-keeper at Your Gate; You alone know my pain.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਹੈਰਾਨੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਗਵਾਵਹੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bhagat teree hairaan darad gavaavahee |3|
English: How wonderful is Your devotional worship! It removes all pains. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦਰਗਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: daragah naam hadoor guramukh jaanasee |
English: The Gurmukhs know that by chanting the Naam, they shall dwell in His Court, in His Presence.

Gurbani: ਵੇਲਾ ਸਚੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣਸੀ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: velaa sach paravaan sabad pachhaanasee |4|
English: True and acceptable is that time, when one recognizes the Word of the Shabad. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਉ ਤੋਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: sat santokh kar bhaau tosaa har naam see |
English: Those who practice Truth, contentment and love, obtain the supplies of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਮਨਹੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਦੇਇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: manahu chhodd vikaar sachaa sach dee |5|
English: So banish corruption from your mind, and the True One will grant you Truth. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸਚੇ ਸਚਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਸਚੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sache sachaa nehu sachai laaeaa |
English: The True Lord inspires true love in the truthful.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਆਉ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: aape kare niaau jo tis bhaaeaa |6|
English: He Himself administers justice, as it pleases His Will. ||6||

Gurbani: ਸਚੇ ਸਚੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: sache sachee daat dehi deaal hai |
English: True is the gift of the True, Compassionate Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਹੈ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: tis sevee din raat naam amol hai |7|
English: Day and night, I serve the One whose Name is priceless. ||7||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਉਤਮੁ ਹਉ ਨੀਚੁ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਕਾਂਢੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: toon utam hau neech sevak kaandteea |
English: You are so sublime, and I am so lowly, but I am called Your slave.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਹੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਵਾਂਢੀਆ ॥੮॥੨੧॥
Transliteration: naanak nadar karehu milai sach vaandteea |8|21|
English: Please, shower Nanak with Your Glance of Grace, that he, the separated one, may merge with You again, O Lord. ||8||21||

[Ang 422 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਕਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਕਿਉ ਮੇਲਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aavan jaanaa kiau rahai kiau melaa hoee |
English: How can coming and going, the cycle of reincarnation be ended? And how can one meet the Lord?

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਨਿਤ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੋਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: janam maran kaa dukh ghano nit sahasaa doee |1|
English: The pain of birth and death is so great, in constant skepticism and duality. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਆ ਜੀਵਨਾ ਫਿਟੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: bin naavai kiaa jeevanaa fitt dhrig chaturaaee |
English: Without the Name, what is life? Cleverness is detestable and cursed.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਧੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur saadh na seviaa har bhagat na bhaaee |1| rahaau |
English: One who does not serve the Holy True Guru, is not pleased by devotion to the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਵਣੁ ਤਉ ਰਹੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aavan jaavan tau rahai paaeeai gur pooraa |
English: Coming and going is ended only when one finds the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਦੇਇ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕੂਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: raam naam dhan raas dee binasai bhram kooraa |2|
English: He gives the wealth and capital of the Lord's Name, and false doubt is destroyed. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sant janaa kau mil rahai dhan dhan jas gaae |
English: Joining the humble Saintly beings, let us sing the blessed, blessed Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aad purakh aparanparaa guramukh har paae |3|
English: The Primal Lord, the Infinite, is obtained by the Gurmukh. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਟੂਐ ਸਾਂਗੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਬਾਜੀ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: nattooai saang banaaeaa baajee sansaaraa |
English: The drama of the world is staged like the show of a buffoon.

Gurbani: ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਬਾਜੀ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਉਝਰਤ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: khin pal baajee dekheeai ujharat nahee baaraa |4|
English: For an instant, for a moment, the show is seen, but it disappears in no time at all. ||4||

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਚਉਪੜਿ ਖੇਲਣਾ ਝੂਠੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: haumai chauparr khelanaa jhootthe ahankaaraa |
English: The game of chance is played on the board of egotism, with the pieces of falsehood and ego.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਹਾਰੈ ਸੋ ਜਿਣੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: sabh jag haarai so jinai gurasabad veechaaraa |5|
English: The whole world loses; he alone wins, who reflects upon the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||5||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਅੰਧੁਲੈ ਹਥਿ ਟੋਹਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: jiau andhulai hath ttohanee har naam hamaarai |
English: As is the cane in the hand of the blind man, so is the Lord's Name for me.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਨਿਸਿ ਦਉਤ ਸਵਾਰੈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: raam naam har ttek hai nis daut savaarai |6|
English: The Lord's Name is my Support, night and day and morning. ||6||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਰਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jiau toon raakheh tiau rahaa har naam adhaaraa |
English: As You keep me, Lord, I live; the Lord's Name is my only Support.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: ant sakhaaee paaeaa jan mukat duaaraa |7|
English: It is my only comfort in the end; the gate of salvation is found by His humble servants. ||7||

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: janam maran dukh mettiaa jap naam muraare |
English: The pain of birth and death is removed, by chanting and meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੮॥੨੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naam na veesarai pooraa gur taare |8|22|
English: O Nanak, one who does not forget the Naam, is saved by the Perfect Guru. ||8||22||

[Ang 422 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 asattapadeea ghar 2 |
English: Aasaa, Third Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa, Second House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਤੁ ਬੇਦੁ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੁਰਸਰੀ ਚਰਣ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: saasat bed sinmrit sar teraa surasaree charan samaanee |
English: The Shaastras, the Vedas and the Simritees are contained in the ocean of Your Name; the River Ganges is held in Your Feet.

Gurbani: ਸਾਖਾ ਤੀਨਿ ਮੂਲੁ ਮਤਿ ਰਾਵੈ ਤੂੰ ਤਾਂ ਸਰਬ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saakhaa teen mool mat raavai toon taan sarab viddaanee |1|
English: The intellect can understand the world of the three modes, but You, O Primal Lord, are totally astounding. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਜਪੈ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: taa ke charan japai jan naanak bole amrit baanee |1| rahaau |
English: Servant Nanak meditates on His Feet, and chants the Ambrosial Word of His Bani. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੇਤੀਸ ਕਰੋੜੀ ਦਾਸ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: tetees karorree daas tumaare ridh sidh praan adhaaree |
English: Three hundred thirty million gods are Your servants. You bestow wealth, and the supernatural powers of the Siddhas; You are the Support of the breath of life.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਰੂਪ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ਲਖਣੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਆਖਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: taa ke roop na jaahee lakhane kiaa kar aakh veechaaree |2|
English: His beauteous forms cannot be comprehended; what can anyone accomplish by discussing and debating? ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੀਨਿ ਗੁਣਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਜੁਗ ਹੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚਾਰੇ ਤੇਰੀਆ ਖਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: teen gunaa tere jug hee antar chaare tereea khaanee |
English: Throughout the ages, You are the three qualities, and the four sources of creation.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਥੇ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: karam hovai taa param pad paaeeai kathe akath kahaanee |3|
English: If You show Your Mercy, then one obtains the supreme status, and speaks the Unspoken Speech. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਪਰਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: toon karataa keea sabh teraa kiaa ko kare paraanee |
English: You are the Creator; all are created by You. What can any mortal being do?

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਅਪਣੀ ਸਾਈ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jaa kau nadar kareh toon apanee saaee sach samaanee |4|
English: He alone, upon whom You shower Your Grace, is absorbed into the Truth. ||4||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਲੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਜੇਤੀ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: naam teraa sabh koee let hai jetee aavan jaanee |
English: Everyone who comes and goes chants Your Name.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਹੋਰ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਇਆਣੀ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: jaa tudh bhaavai taa guramukh boojhai hor manamukh firai eaanee |5|
English: When it is pleasing to Your Will, then the Gurmukh understands. Otherwise, the self-willed manmukhs wander in ignorance. ||5||

Gurbani: ਚਾਰੇ ਵੇਦ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਕਉ ਦੀਏ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: chaare ved brahame kau dee parr parr kare veechaaree |
English: You gave the four Vedas to Brahma, for him to read and read continually, and reflect upon.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਬਪੁੜਾ ਨਰਕਿ ਸੁਰਗਿ ਅਵਤਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: taa kaa hukam na boojhai bapurraa narak surag avataaree |6|
English: The wretched one does not understand His Command, and is reincarnated into heaven and hell. ||6||

Gurbani: ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗਹ ਕੇ ਰਾਜੇ ਕੀਏ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਅਵਤਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jugah jugah ke raaje kee gaaveh kar avataaree |
English: In each and every age, He creates the kings, who are sung of as His Incarnations.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਭੀ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਆਖਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: tin bhee ant na paaeaa taa kaa kiaa kar aakh veechaaree |7|
English: Even they have not found His limits; what can I speak of and contemplate? ||7||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਦੇਹਿ ਤ ਸਾਚੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: toon sachaa teraa keea sabh saachaa dehi ta saach vakhaanee |
English: You are True, and all that You do is True. If You bless me with the Truth, I will speak on it.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਸਚੁ ਬੁਝਾਵਹਿ ਅਪਣਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੮॥੧॥੨੩॥
Transliteration: jaa kau sach bujhaaveh apanaa sahaje naam samaanee |8|1|23|
English: One whom You inspire to understand the Truth, is easily absorbed into the Naam. ||8||1||23||

[Ang 423 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 |
English: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਮਰਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: satigur hamaraa bharam gavaaeaa |
English: The True Guru has dispelled my doubts.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: har naam niranjan man vasaaeaa |
English: He has enshrined the Immaculate Name of the Lord within my mind.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੁ ਚੀਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sabad cheen sadaa sukh paaeaa |1|
English: Focusing on the Word of the Shabad, I have obtained lasting peace. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: sun man mere tat giaan |
English: Listen, O my mind, to the essence of spiritual wisdom.

Gurbani: ਦੇਵਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: devan vaalaa sabh bidh jaanai guramukh paaeeai naam nidhaan |1| rahaau |
English: The Great Giver knows our condition completely; the Gurmukh obtains the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur bhette kee vaddiaaee |
English: The great glory of meeting the True Guru is

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਮਮਤਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jin mamataa agan trisanaa bujhaaee |
English: that it has quenched the fire of possessiveness and desire;

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sahaje maataa har gun gaaee |2|
English: imbued with peace and poise, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: vin gur poore koe na jaanee |
English: Without the Perfect Guru, no one knows the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਲੋਭਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohi doojai lobhaanee |
English: Attached to Maya, they are engrossed in duality.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: guramukh naam milai har baanee |3|
English: The Gurmukh receives the Naam, and the Bani of the Lord's Word. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤਪਾਂ ਸਿਰਿ ਤਪੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur sevaa tapaan sir tap saar |
English: Service to the Guru is the most excellent and sublime penance of penances.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਭ ਦੂਖ ਵਿਸਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: har jeeo man vasai sabh dookh visaaranahaar |
English: The Dear Lord dwells in the mind, and all suffering departs.

Gurbani: ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: dar saachai deesai sachiaar |4|
English: Then, at the Gate of the True Lord, one appears truthful. ||4||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur sevaa te tribhavan sojhee hoe |
English: Serving the Guru, one comes to know the three worlds.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aap pachhaan har paavai soe |
English: Understanding his own self, he obtains the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: saachee baanee mehal paraapat hoe |5|
English: Through the True Word of His Bani, we enter the Mansion of His Presence. ||5||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur sevaa te sabh kul udhaare |
English: Serving the Guru, all of one's generations are saved.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: niramal naam rakhai ur dhaare |
English: Keep the Immaculate Naam enshrined within your heart.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਸਾਚਿ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: saachee sobhaa saach duaare |6|
English: In the Court of the True Lord, you shall be adorned with True Glory. ||6||

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: se vaddabhaagee ji gur sevaa laae |
English: How very fortunate are they, who are committed to the Guru's service.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: anadin bhagat sach naam drirraae |
English: Night and day, they are engaged in devotional worship; the True Name is implanted within them.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੇ ਉਧਰੇ ਕੁਲ ਸਬਾਏ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: naame udhare kul sabaae |7|
English: Through the Naam, all of one's generations are saved. ||7||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak saach kahai veechaar |
English: Nanak chants the true thought.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖਹੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam rakhahu ur dhaar |
English: Keep the Name of the Lord enshrined within your heart.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਾਤੇ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੮॥੨॥੨੪॥
Transliteration: har bhagatee raate mokh duaar |8|2|24|
English: Imbued with devotion to the Lord, the gate of salvation is found. ||8||2||24||

[Ang 423 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 |
English: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਆਸ ਕਰੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa aas kare sabh koee |
English: Everyone lives, hoping in hope.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: hukamai boojhai niraasaa hoee |
English: Understanding His Command, one becomes free of desire.

Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੁਤੇ ਕਈ ਲੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa vich sute kee loee |
English: So many are asleep in hope.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਜਾਗੈ ਜਾਗਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: so jaagai jaagaavai soee |1|
English: He alone wakes up, whom the Lord awakens. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur naam bujhaaeaa vin naavai bhukh na jaaee |
English: The True Guru has led me to understand the Naam, the Name of the Lord; without the Naam, hunger does not go away.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: naame trisanaa agan bujhai naam milai tisai rajaaee |1| rahaau |
English: Through the Naam, the fire of desire is extinguished; the Naam is obtained by His Will. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਲਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: kal keerat sabad pachhaan |
English: In the Dark Age of Kali Yuga, realize the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਏਹਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਚੂਕੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: ehaa bhagat chookai abhimaan |
English: By this devotional worship, egotism is eliminated.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: satigur seviai hovai paravaan |
English: Serving the True Guru, one becomes approved.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਆਸਾ ਕੀਤੀ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਜਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jin aasaa keetee tis no jaan |2|
English: So know the One, who created hope and desire. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਦੀਜੈ ਜਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: tis kiaa deejai ji sabad sunaae |
English: What shall we offer to one who proclaims the Word of the Shabad?

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa naam man vasaae |
English: By His Grace, the Naam is enshrined within our minds.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਸਿਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: eihu sir deejai aap gavaae |
English: Offer your head, and shed your self-conceit.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਬੂਝੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: hukamai boojhe sadaa sukh paae |3|
English: One who understands the Lord's Command finds lasting peace. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aap kare tai aap karaae |
English: He Himself does, and causes others to do.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aape guramukh naam vasaae |
English: He Himself enshrines His Name in the mind of the Gurmukh.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਵੈ ਆਪਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aap bhulaavai aap maarag paae |
English: He Himself misleads us, and He Himself puts us back on the Path.

Gurbani: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: sachai sabad sach samaae |4|
English: Through the True Word of the Shabad, we merge into the True Lord. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚੀ ਹੈ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa sabad sachee hai baanee |
English: True is the Shabad, and True is the Word of the Lord's Bani.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh jug jug aakh vakhaanee |
English: In each and every age, the Gurmukhs speak it and chant it.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੋਲਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh mohi bharam bholaanee |
English: The self-willed manmukhs are deluded by doubt and attachment.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਫਿਰੈ ਬਉਰਾਣੀ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: bin naavai sabh firai bauraanee |5|
English: Without the Name, everyone wanders around insane. ||5||

Gurbani: ਤੀਨਿ ਭਵਨ ਮਹਿ ਏਕਾ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: teen bhavan meh ekaa maaeaa |
English: Throughout the three worlds, is the one Maya.

Gurbani: ਮੂਰਖਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: moorakh parr parr doojaa bhaau drirraaeaa |
English: The fool reads and reads, but holds tight to duality.

Gurbani: ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bahu karam kamaavai dukh sabaaeaa |
English: He performs all sorts of rituals, but still suffers terrible pain.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: satigur sev sadaa sukh paaeaa |6|
English: Serving the True Guru, eternal peace is obtained. ||6||

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: amrit meetthaa sabad veechaar |
English: Reflective meditation upon the Shabad is such sweet nectar.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭੋਗੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: anadin bhoge haumai maar |
English: Night and day, one enjoys it, subduing his ego.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜਿ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj anand kirapaa dhaar |
English: When the Lord showers His Mercy, we enjoy celestial bliss.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਚਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: naam rate sadaa sach piaar |7|
English: Imbued with the Naam, love the True Lord forever. ||7||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਪੜੀਐ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: har jap parreeai gurasabad veechaar |
English: Meditate on the Lord, and read and reflect upon the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਪੜੀਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: har jap parreeai haumai maar |
English: Subdue your ego and meditate on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਭਇ ਸਚਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: har japeeai bhe sach piaar |
English: Meditate on the Lord, and be imbued with fear and love of the True One.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੮॥੩॥੨੫॥
Transliteration: naanak naam guramat ur dhaar |8|3|25|
English: O Nanak, enshrine the Naam within your heart, through the Guru's Teachings. ||8||3||25||

[Ang 424 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੮ ਕਾਫੀ ॥
Transliteration: raag aasaa mahalaa 3 asattapadeea ghar 8 kaafee |
English: Raag Aasaa, Third Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa, Eighth House, Kaafee:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur te saant aoopajai jin trisanaa agan bujhaaee |
English: Peace emanates from the Guru; He puts out the fire of desire.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur te naam paaeeai vaddee vaddiaaee |1|
English: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is obtained from the Guru; it is the greatest greatness. ||1||

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੇਤਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: eko naam chet mere bhaaee |
English: Keep the One Name in your consciousness, O my Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਜਗਤੁ ਜਲੰਦਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ ਭਜਿ ਪਏ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jagat jalandaa dekh kai bhaj pe saranaaee |1| rahaau |
English: Seeing the world on fire, I have hurried to the Lord's Sanctuary. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਮਹਾ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur te giaan aoopajai mahaa tat beechaaraa |
English: Spiritual wisdom emanates from the Guru; reflect upon the supreme essence of reality.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਭਗਤੀ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur te ghar dar paaeaa bhagatee bhare bhanddaaraa |2|
English: Through the Guru, the Lord's Mansion and His Court are attained; His devotional worship is overflowing with treasures. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਬੂਝੈ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh naam dhiaaeeai boojhai veechaaraa |
English: The Gurmukh meditates on the Naam; he achieves reflective meditation and understanding.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਲਾਹ ਹੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: guramukh bhagat salaah hai antar sabad apaaraa |3|
English: The Gurmukh is the Lord's devotee, immersed in His Praises; the Infinite Word of the Shabad dwells within him. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੂਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh sookh aoopajai dukh kade na hoee |
English: Happiness emanates from the Gurmukh; he never suffers pain.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: guramukh haumai maareeai man niramal hoee |4|
English: The Gurmukh conquers his ego, and his mind is immaculately pure. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਆਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur miliai aap geaa tribhavan sojhee paaee |
English: Meeting the True Guru, self-conceit is removed, and understanding of the three worlds is obtained.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਪਸਰਿ ਰਹੀ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: niramal jot pasar rahee jotee jot milaaee |5|
English: The Immaculate Divine Light is pervading and permeating everywhere; one's light merges into the Light. ||5||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: poorai gur samajhaaeaa mat aootam hoee |
English: The Perfect Guru instructs, and one's intellect becomes sublime.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਨਾਮੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: antar seetal saant hoe naame sukh hoee |6|
English: A cooling and soothing peace comes within, and through the Naam, peace is obtained. ||6||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਾਂ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਾਂ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਈ ॥
Transliteration: pooraa satigur taan milai jaan nadar kareee |
English: One meets the Perfect True Guru only when the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace.

Gurbani: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਸਭ ਕਟੀਅਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: kilavikh paap sabh katteeeh fir dukh bighan na hoee |7|
English: All sins and vices are eradicated, and one shall never again suffer pain or distress. ||7||

Gurbani: ਆਪਣੈ ਹਥਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਦੇ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aapanai hath vaddiaaeea de naame laae |
English: Glory is in His Hands; He bestows His Name, and attaches us to it.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪਾਏ ॥੮॥੪॥੨੬॥
Transliteration: naanak naam nidhaan man vasiaa vaddiaaee paae |8|4|26|
English: O Nanak, the treasure of the Naam abides within the mind, and glory is obtained. ||8||4||26||

[Ang 425 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 |
English: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sun man man vasaae toon aape aae milai mere bhaaee |
English: Listen, O mortal: enshrine His Name within your mind; He shall come to meet with you, O my Sibling of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: anadin sachee bhagat kar sachai chit laaee |1|
English: Night and day, center your consciousness on true devotional worship of the True Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂੰ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: eko naam dhiaae toon sukh paaveh mere bhaaee |
English: Meditate on the One Naam, and you shall find peace, O my Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: haumai doojaa door kar vaddee vaddiaaee |1| rahaau |
English: Eradicate egotism and duality, and your glory shall be glorious. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਨੋ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਲੋਚਦੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: eis bhagatee no sur nar mun jan lochade vin satigur paaee na jaae |
English: The angels, humans and silent sages long for this devotional worship, but without the True Guru, it cannot be attained.

Gurbani: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਦੇ ਜੋਤਿਕੀ ਤਿਨ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: panddit parrade jotikee tin boojh na paae |2|
English: The Pandits, the religious scholars, and the astrologers read their books, but they do not understand. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਪੈ ਥੈ ਸਭੁ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aapai thai sabh rakhion kichh kehan na jaaee |
English: He Himself keeps all in His Hand; nothing else can be said.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aape dee su paaeeai gur boojh bujhaaee |3|
English: Whatever He gives, is received. The Guru has imparted this understanding to me. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤਿਸ ਦੇ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jant sabh tis de sabhanaa kaa soee |
English: All beings and creatures are His; He belongs to all.

Gurbani: ਮੰਦਾ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: mandaa kis no aakheeai je doojaa hoee |4|
English: So who can we call bad, since there is no other? ||4||

Gurbani: ਇਕੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਏਕਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: eiko hukam varatadaa ekaa sir kaaraa |
English: The Command of the One Lord is pervading throughout; duty to the One Lord is upon the heads of all.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਭਵਾਲੀ ਦਿਤੀਅਨੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: aap bhavaalee diteean antar lobh vikaaraa |5|
English: He Himself has led them astray, and placed greed and corruption within their hearts. ||5||

Gurbani: ਇਕ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੀਤਿਅਨੁ ਬੂਝਨਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: eik aape guramukh keetian boojhan veechaaraa |
English: He has sanctified those few Gurmukhs who understand Him, and reflect upon Him.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਭੀ ਓਨਾ ਨੋ ਬਖਸੀਅਨੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: bhagat bhee onaa no bakhaseean antar bhanddaaraa |6|
English: He grants devotional worship to them, and within them is the treasure. ||6||

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨੀਆ ਨੋ ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: giaaneea no sabh sach hai sach sojhee hoee |
English: The spiritual teachers know nothing but the Truth; they obtain true understanding.

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੇ ਨ ਭੁਲਨੑੀ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਸੋਈ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: oe bhulaae kisai de na bhulanaee sach jaanan soee |7|
English: They are led astray by Him, but they do not go astray, because they know the True Lord. ||7||

Gurbani: ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਪੰਚ ਵਰਤਦੇ ਪੰਚੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: ghar meh panch varatade panche veechaaree |
English: Within the homes of their bodies, the five passions are pervading, but here, the five are well-behaved.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਸਿ ਨ ਆਵਨੑੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੮॥੫॥੨੭॥
Transliteration: naanak bin satigur vas na aavanaee naam haumai maaree |8|5|27|
English: O Nanak, without the True Guru, they are not overcome; through the Naam, the ego is conquered. ||8||5||27||

[Ang 425 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 |
English: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਘਰੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਵਥੁ ਹੈ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: gharai andar sabh vath hai baahar kichh naahee |
English: Everything is within the home of your own self; there is nothing beyond it.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਪਟ ਖੁਲਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee paaeeai antar kapatt khulaahee |1|
English: By Guru's Grace, it is obtained, and the doors of the inner heart are opened wide. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur te har paaeeai bhaaee |
English: From the True Guru, the Lord's Name is obtained, O Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: antar naam nidhaan hai poorai satigur deea dikhaaee |1| rahaau |
English: The treasure of the Naam is within; the Perfect True Guru has shown this to me. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਲਏ ਪਾਏ ਰਤਨੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa gaahak hovai so le paae ratan veechaaraa |
English: One who is a buyer of the Lord's Name, finds it, and obtains the jewel of contemplation.

Gurbani: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਖੋਲੈ ਦਿਬ ਦਿਸਟਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: andar kholai dib disatt dekhai mukat bhanddaaraa |2|
English: He opens the doors deep within, and through the Eyes of Divine Vision, beholds the treasure of liberation. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮਹਲ ਅਨੇਕ ਹਹਿ ਜੀਉ ਕਰੇ ਵਸੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: andar mehal anek heh jeeo kare vaseraa |
English: There are so many mansions within the body; the soul dwells within them.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਫੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: man chindiaa fal paaeisee fir hoe na feraa |3|
English: He obtains the fruits of his mind's desires, and he shall not have to go through reincarnation again. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਖੀਆ ਵਥੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਲਈ ਗੁਰ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: paarakheea vath samaal lee gur sojhee hoee |
English: The appraisers cherish the commodity of the Name; they obtain understanding from the Guru.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਅਮੁਲੁ ਸਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: naam padaarath amul saa guramukh paavai koee |4|
English: The wealth of the Naam is priceless; how few are the Gurmukhs who obtain it. ||4||

Gurbani: ਬਾਹਰੁ ਭਾਲੇ ਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਲਹੈ ਵਥੁ ਘਰੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: baahar bhaale su kiaa lahai vath gharai andar bhaaee |
English: Searching outwardly, what can anyone find? The commodity is deep within the home of the self, O Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: bharame bhoolaa sabh jag firai manamukh pat gavaaee |5|
English: The entire world is wandering around, deluded by doubt; the self-willed manmukhs lose their honor. ||5||

Gurbani: ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਛੋਡੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਪਰ ਘਰਿ ਝੂਠਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ghar dar chhodde aapanaa par ghar jhootthaa jaaee |
English: The false one leaves his own hearth and home, and goes out to another's home.

Gurbani: ਚੋਰੈ ਵਾਂਗੂ ਪਕੜੀਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: chorai vaangoo pakarreeai bin naavai chottaa khaaee |6|
English: Like a thief, he is caught, and without the Naam, he is beaten and struck down. ||6||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਘਰੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੇ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jinaee ghar jaataa aapanaa se sukhee bhaaee |
English: Those who know their own home, are happy, O Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: antar braham pachhaaniaa gur kee vaddiaaee |7|
English: They realize God within their own hearts, through the glorious greatness of the Guru. ||7||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਦਾਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aape daan kare kis aakheeai aape dee bujhaaee |
English: He Himself gives gifts, and He Himself bestows understanding; unto whom can we complain?

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂੰ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥੮॥੬॥੨੮॥
Transliteration: naanak naam dhiaae toon dar sachai sobhaa paaee |8|6|28|
English: O Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and you shall obtain glory in the True Court. ||8||6||28||

[Ang 426 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 |
English: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਸਾਦੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aapai aap pachhaaniaa saad meetthaa bhaaee |
English: Those who recognize their own selves, enjoy the sweet flavor, O Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਚਾਖਿਐ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਭਏ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਸਾਚੋ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har ras chaakhiai mukat bhe jinaa saacho bhaaee |1|
English: Those who drink in the sublime essence of the Lord are emancipated; they love the Truth. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮਨਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: har jeeo niramal niramalaa niramal man vaasaa |
English: The Beloved Lord is the purest of the pure; He comes to dwell in the pure mind.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: guramatee saalaaheeai bikhiaa maeh udaasaa |1| rahaau |
English: Praising the Lord, through the Guru's Teachings, one remains unaffected by corruption. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਜਾਪਈ ਸਭ ਅੰਧੀ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: bin sabadai aap na jaapee sabh andhee bhaaee |
English: Without the Word of the Shabad, they do not understand themselves -they are totally blind, O Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: guramatee ghatt chaananaa naam ant sakhaaee |2|
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, the heart is illuminated, and in the end, only the Naam shall be your companion. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਰਤਦੇ ਨਾਮੇ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: naame hee naam varatade naame varataaraa |
English: They are occupied with the Naam, and only the Naam; they deal only in the Naam.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: antar naam mukh naam hai naame sabad veechaaraa |3|
English: Deep within their hearts is the Naam; upon their lips is the Naam; they contemplate the Word of God, and the Naam. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਨਾਮੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: naam suneeai naam maneeai naame vaddiaaee |
English: They listen to the Naam, believe in the Naam, and through the Naam, they obtain glory.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਮੇ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: naam salaahe sadaa sadaa naame mehal paaee |4|
English: They praise the Naam, forever and ever, and through the Naam, they obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||4||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਨਾਮੇ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: naame hee ghatt chaananaa naame sobhaa paaee |
English: Through the Naam, their hearts are illumined, and through the Naam, they obtain honor.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: naame hee sukh aoopajai naame saranaaee |5|
English: Through the Naam, peace wells up; I seek the Sanctuary of the Naam. ||5||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: bin naavai koe na maneeai manamukh pat gavaaee |
English: Without the Naam, no one is accepted; the self-willed manmukhs lose their honor.

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਾਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: jam pur baadhe maareeeh birathaa janam gavaaee |6|
English: In the City of Death, they are tied down and beaten, and they lose their lives in vain. ||6||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੈ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: naamai kee sabh sevaa karai guramukh naam bujhaaee |
English: Those Gurmukhs who realize the Naam, all serve the Naam.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਹੁ ਹੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਨਾਮੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: naamahu hee naam maneeai naame vaddiaaee |7|
English: So believe in the Naam, and only the Naam; through the Naam, glorious greatness is obtained. ||7||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jis no devai tis milai guramatee naam bujhaaee |
English: He alone receives it, unto whom it is given. Through the Guru's Teachings, the Naam is realized.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਕੋ ਪਾਈ ॥੮॥੭॥੨੯॥
Transliteration: naanak sabh kichh naavai kai vas hai poorai bhaag ko paaee |8|7|29|
English: O Nanak, everything is under the influence of the Naam; by perfect good destiny, a few obtain it. ||8||7||29||

[Ang 426 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 |
English: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੑੀ ਨ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
Transliteration: dohaaganee mehal na paaeinaee na jaanan pir kaa suaau |
English: The deserted brides do not obtain the Mansion of their Husband's Presence, nor do they know His taste.

Gurbani: ਫਿਕਾ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਨਾ ਨਿਵਹਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: fikaa boleh naa niveh doojaa bhaau suaau |1|
English: They speak harsh words, and do not bow to Him; they are in love with another. ||1||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਵਸਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: eihu manooaa kiau kar vas aavai |
English: How can this mind come under control?

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਠਾਕੀਐ ਗਿਆਨ ਮਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee tthaakeeai giaan matee ghar aavai |1| rahaau |
English: By Guru's Grace, it is held in check; instructed in spiritual wisdom, it returns to its home. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੀਓਨੁ ਲਾਇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sohaaganee aap savaareeon laae prem piaar |
English: He Himself adorns the happy soul-brides; they bear Him love and affection.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲਦੀਆ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: satigur kai bhaanai chaladeea naame sehaj seegaar |2|
English: They live in harmony with the Sweet Will of the True Guru, naturally adorned with the Naam. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਰਾਵਹਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਚੀ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa raaveh pir aapanaa sachee sej subhaae |
English: They enjoy their Beloved forever, and their bed is decorated with Truth.

Gurbani: ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਮੋਹੀਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: pir kai prem moheea mil preetam sukh paae |3|
English: They are fascinated with the Love of their Husband Lord; meeting their Beloved, they obtain peace. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: giaan apaar seegaar hai sobhaavantee naar |
English: Spiritual wisdom is the incomparable decoration of the happy soul-bride.

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਸਭਰਾਈ ਸੁੰਦਰੀ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: saa sabharaaee sundaree pir kai het piaar |4|
English: She is so beautiful - she is the queen of all; she enjoys the love and affection of her Husband Lord. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ ਸਚੈ ਅਲਖਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: sohaaganee vich rang rakhion sachai alakh apaar |
English: The True Lord, the Unseen, the Infinite, has infused His Love among the happy soul-brides.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਚੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: satigur sevan aapanaa sachai bhaae piaar |5|
English: They serve their True Guru, with true love and affection. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਗੁਣ ਕਾ ਗਲਿ ਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sohaaganee seegaar banaaeaa gun kaa gal haar |
English: The happy soul-bride has adorned herself with the necklace of virtue.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਰਮਲੁ ਤਨਿ ਲਾਵਣਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: prem piramal tan laavanaa antar ratan veechaar |6|
English: She applies the perfume of love to her body, and within her mind is the jewel of reflective meditation. ||6||

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਊਤਮਾ ਜਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਸਬਦੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat rate se aootamaa jat pat sabade hoe |
English: Those who are imbued with devotional worship are the most exalted. Their social standing and honor come from the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਨੀਚ ਜਾਤਿ ਹੈ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕਾ ਕੀੜਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: bin naavai sabh neech jaat hai bisattaa kaa keerraa hoe |7|
English: Without the Naam, all are low class, like maggots in manure. ||7||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਦੀ ਸਭ ਫਿਰੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਹਉ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: hau hau karadee sabh firai bin sabadai hau na jaae |
English: Everyone proclaims, "Me, me!"; but without the Shabad, the ego does not depart.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਈ ਸਚੈ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੮॥੮॥੩੦॥
Transliteration: naanak naam rate tin haumai gee sachai rahe samaae |8|8|30|
English: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Naam lose their ego; they remain absorbed in the True Lord. ||8||8||30||

[Ang 426 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 |
English: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਚੇ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sache rate se niramale sadaa sachee soe |
English: Those who are imbued with the True Lord are spotless and pure; their reputation is forever true.

Gurbani: ਐਥੈ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਪਦੇ ਆਗੈ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aithai ghar ghar jaapade aagai jug jug paragatt hoe |1|
English: Here, they are known in each and every home, and hereafter, they are famous throughout the ages. ||1||

Gurbani: ਏ ਮਨ ਰੂੜੑੇ ਰੰਗੁਲੇ ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: e man roorrae rangule toon sachaa rang charraae |
English: O beauteous and joyful mind, imbue yourself with your true color.

Gurbani: ਰੂੜੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਜੇ ਰਪੈ ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: roorree baanee je rapai naa ihu rang lahai na jaae |1| rahaau |
English: If you imbue yourself with the Beauteous Word of the Guru's Bani, then this color shall never fade away. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਨੀਚ ਮੈਲੇ ਅਤਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: ham neech maile at abhimaanee doojai bhaae vikaar |
English: I am lowly, filthy, and totally egotistical; I am attached to the corruption of duality.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪਾਰਸਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਹੋਏ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur paaras miliai kanchan hoe niramal jot apaar |2|
English: But meeting with the Guru, the Philosopher's Stone, I am transformed into gold; I am blended with the Pure Light of the Infinite Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਰੰਗੀਐ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bin gur koe na rangeeai gur miliai rang charraau |
English: Without the Guru, no one is imbued with the color of the Lord's Love; meeting with the Guru, this color is applied.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur kai bhai bhaae jo rate sifatee sach samaau |3|
English: Those who are imbued with the Fear, and the Love of the Guru, are absorbed in the Praise of the True Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਲਾਗਿ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhai bin laag na lagee naa man niramal hoe |
English: Without fear, the cloth is not dyed, and the mind is not rendered pure.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਭੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਝੂਠੇ ਠਾਉ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: bin bhai karam kamaavane jhootthe tthaau na koe |4|
English: Without fear, the performance of rituals is false, and one finds no place of rest. ||4||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪੇ ਰੰਗੇ ਸੁ ਰਪਸੀ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jis no aape range su rapasee satasangat milaae |
English: Only those whom the Lord imbues, are so imbued; they join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: poore gur te satasangat aoopajai sahaje sach subhaae |5|
English: From the Perfect Guru, the Sat Sangat emanates, and one easily merges into the Love of the True One. ||5||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਸਭਿ ਐਸੇ ਰਹਹਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਪਸੁ ਢੋਰ ॥
Transliteration: bin sangatee sabh aise raheh jaise pas dtor |
English: Without the Sangat, the Company of the Holy, all remain like beasts and animals.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿੑ ਕੀਤੇ ਤਿਸੈ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੑੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭਿ ਚੋਰ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: jina keete tisai na jaananaee bin naavai sabh chor |6|
English: They do not know the One who created them; without the Name, all are thieves. ||6||

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਗੁਣ ਵਿਹਾਝਹਿ ਅਉਗਣ ਵਿਕਣਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: eik gun vihaajheh aaugan vikaneh gur kai sehaj subhaae |
English: Some purchase merits and sell off their demerits; through the Guru, they obtain peace and poise.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਇਆ ਵੁਠਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਆਇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: gur sevaa te naau paaeaa vutthaa andar aae |7|
English: Serving the Guru, they obtain the Name, which comes to dwell deep within. ||7||

Gurbani: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabhanaa kaa daataa ek hai sir dhandhai laae |
English: The One Lord is the Giver of all; He assigns tasks to each and every person.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਾਇ ਸਵਾਰਿਅਨੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੮॥੯॥੩੧॥
Transliteration: naanak naame laae savaarian sabade le milaae |8|9|31|
English: O Nanak, the Lord embellishes us with the Name; attached to the Word of the Shabad, we are merged into Him. ||8||9||31||

[Ang 427 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 |
English: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਨਾਵੈ ਨੋ ਲੋਚਦੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sabh naavai no lochadee jis kripaa kare so paae |
English: Everyone longs for the Name, but he alone receives it, unto whom the Lord shows His Mercy.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bin naavai sabh dukh hai sukh tis jis man vasaae |1|
English: Without the Name, there is only pain; he alone obtains peace, whose mind is filled with the Name. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: toon beant deaal hai teree saranaaee |
English: You are infinite and merciful; I seek Your Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਮੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur poore te paaeeai naame vaddiaaee |1| rahaau |
English: From the Perfect Guru, the glorious greatness of the Naam is obtained. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: antar baahar ek hai bahu bidh srisatt upaaee |
English: Inwardly and outwardly, there is only the One Lord. He has created the world, with its many varieties.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਕਿਸੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਭਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: hukame kaar karaaeidaa doojaa kis kaheeai bhaaee |2|
English: According to the Order of His Will, He makes us act. What else can we talk about, O Siblings of Destiny? ||2||

Gurbani: ਬੁਝਣਾ ਅਬੁਝਣਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਕੀਆ ਇਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: bujhanaa abujhanaa tudh keea ih teree sir kaar |
English: Knowledge and ignorance are all your making; You have control over these.

Gurbani: ਇਕਨੑਾ ਬਖਸਿਹਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਢੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: eikanaa bakhasihi mel laihi ik daragah maar kadte koorriaar |3|
English: Some, You forgive, and unite with Yourself; while others, the wicked, you strike down and drive out of Your Court. ||3||

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਧੁਰਿ ਪਵਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਹਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: eik dhur pavit paavan heh tudh naame laae |
English: Some, from the very beginning, are pure and pious; You attach them to Your Name.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: gur sevaa te sukh aoopajai sachai sabad bujhaae |4|
English: Serving the Guru, peace wells up; through the True Word of the Shabad, one comes to understand. ||4||

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਕੁਚਲ ਕੁਚੀਲ ਵਿਖਲੀ ਪਤੇ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: eik kuchal kucheel vikhalee pate naavahu aap khuaae |
English: Some are crooked, filthy and vicious; the Lord Himself has led them astray from the Name.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਓਨ ਸਿਧਿ ਨ ਬੁਧਿ ਹੈ ਨ ਸੰਜਮੀ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਉਤਵਤਾਏ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: naa on sidh na budh hai na sanjamee fireh utavataae |5|
English: They have no intuition, no understanding and no self-discipline; they wander around delirious. ||5||

Gurbani: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: nadar kare jis aapanee tis no bhaavanee laae |
English: He grants faith to those whom He has blessed with His Glance of Grace.

Gurbani: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਇਹ ਸੰਜਮੀ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: sat santokh ih sanjamee man niramal sabad sunaae |6|
English: This mind finds truth, contentment and self-discipline, hearing the Immaculate Word of the Shabad. ||6||

Gurbani: ਲੇਖਾ ਪੜਿ ਨ ਪਹੂਚੀਐ ਕਥਿ ਕਹਣੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: lekhaa parr na pahoocheeai kath kahanai ant na paae |
English: By reading books, one cannot reach Him; by speaking and talking, His limits cannot be found.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: gur te keemat paaeeai sach sabad sojhee paae |7|
English: Through the Guru, His value is found; through the True Word of the Shabad, understanding is obtained. ||7||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਸੋਧਿ ਤੂੰ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: eihu man dehee sodh toon gur sabad veechaar |
English: So reform this mind and body, by contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਸੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥੮॥੧੦॥੩੨॥
Transliteration: naanak is dehee vich naam nidhaan hai paaeeai gur kai het apaar |8|10|32|
English: O Nanak, within this body is the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; it is found through the Love of the Infinite Guru. ||8||10||32||

[Ang 427 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 |
English: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਚਿ ਰਤੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: sach rateea sohaaganee jinaa gur kai sabad seegaar |
English: The happy soul-brides are imbued with Truth; they are adorned with the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਸੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ghar hee so pir paaeaa sachai sabad veechaar |1|
English: They find their Husband Lord within their own home, contemplating the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਵਗਣ ਗੁਣੀ ਬਖਸਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: avagan gunee bakhasaaeaa har siau liv laaee |
English: Through merits, their demerits are forgiven, and they embrace love for the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har var paaeaa kaamanee gur mel milaaee |1| rahaau |
English: The soul-bride then obtains the Lord as her Husband; meeting the Guru, this union comes about. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੑੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: eik pir hadoor na jaananaee doojai bharam bhulaae |
English: Some do not know the Presence of their Husband Lord; they are deluded by duality and doubt.

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਪਾਇਨਿੑ ਡੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਦੁਖੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kiau paaeina ddohaaganee dukhee rain vihaae |2|
English: How can the forsaken brides meet Him? Their life night passes in pain. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jin kai man sach vasiaa sachee kaar kamaae |
English: Those whose minds are filled with the True Lord, perform truthful actions.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਹਜ ਸਿਉ ਸਚੇ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: anadin seveh sehaj siau sache maeh samaae |3|
English: Night and day, they serve the Lord with poise, and are absorbed in the True Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈਆ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: dohaaganee bharam bhulaaeea koorr bol bikh khaeh |
English: The forsaken brides wander around, deluded by doubt; telling lies, they eat poison.

Gurbani: ਪਿਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੁੰਞੀ ਸੇਜ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: pir na jaanan aapanaa sunyee sej dukh paeh |4|
English: They do not know their Husband Lord, and upon their deserted bed, they suffer in misery. ||4||
