Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਮਤੁ ਮਨ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa saahib ek hai mat man bharam bhulaeh |
English: The True Lord is the One and only; do not be deluded by doubt, O my mind.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਛਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਹਿ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: gur poochh sevaa kareh sach niramal man vasaeh |5|
English: Consult with the Guru, serve the True Lord, and enshrine the Immaculate Truth within your mind. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sohaaganee sadaa pir paaeaa haumai aap gavaae |
English: The happy soul-bride always finds her Husband Lord; she banishes egotism and self-conceit.

Gurbani: ਪਿਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗਹਿ ਰਹੀ ਸਚੀ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: pir setee anadin geh rahee sachee sej sukh paae |6|
English: She remains attached to her Husband Lord, night and day, and she finds peace upon His Bed of Truth. ||6||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਗਏ ਪਲੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: meree meree kar ge palai kichh na paae |
English: Those who shouted, "Mine, mine!" have departed, without obtaining anything.

Gurbani: ਮਹਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਡੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਈ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: mehal naahee ddohaaganee ant gee pachhutaae |7|
English: The separated one does not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and departs, repenting in the end. ||7||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਏਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: so pir meraa ek hai ekas siau liv laae |
English: That Husband Lord of mine is the One and only; I am in love with the One alone.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇ ॥੮॥੧੧॥੩੩॥
Transliteration: naanak je sukh lorreh kaamanee har kaa naam man vasaae |8|11|33|
English: O Nanak, if the soul-bride longs for peace, she should enshrine the Lord's Name within her mind. ||8||11||33||

[Ang 428 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 |
English: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਚਖਾਇਓਨੁ ਰਸੁ ਆਇਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: amrit jinaa chakhaaeon ras aaeaa sehaj subhaae |
English: Those whom the Lord has caused to drink in the Ambrosial Nectar, naturally, intuitively, enjoy the sublime essence.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sachaa veparavaahu hai tis no til na tamaae |1|
English: The True Lord is care-free; he does not have even an iota of greed. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਚਾ ਵਰਸਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: amrit sachaa varasadaa guramukhaa mukh paae |
English: The True Ambrosial Nectar rains down, and trickles into the mouths of the Gurmukhs.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਹਰੀਆਵਲਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: man sadaa hareeaavalaa sahaje har gun gaae |1| rahaau |
English: Their minds are forever rejuvenated, and they naturally, intuitively, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਦਰਿ ਖੜੀਆ ਬਿਲਲਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh sadaa dohaaganee dar kharreea bilalaeh |
English: The self-willed manmukhs are forever forsaken brides; they cry out and bewail at the Lord's Gate.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਸੁਆਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jinaa pir kaa suaad na aaeo jo dhur likhiaa suo kamaeh |2|
English: Those who do not enjoy the sublime taste of their Husband Lord, act according to their pre-ordained destiny. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੀਜੇ ਸਚੁ ਜਮੈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh beeje sach jamai sach naam vaapaar |
English: The Gurmukh plants the seed of the True Name, and it sprouts. He deals in the True Name alone.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਇਤੁ ਲਾਹੈ ਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਦੇਇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jo it laahai laaeian bhagatee dee bhanddaar |3|
English: Those whom the Lord has attached to this profitable venture, are granted the treasure of devotional worship. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਭੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੀਗਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh sadaa sohaaganee bhai bhagat seegaar |
English: The Gurmukh is forever the true, happy soul-bride; she adorns herself with the fear of God and devotion to Him.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਵਹਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਰਖਹਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: anadin raaveh pir aapanaa sach rakheh ur dhaar |4|
English: Night and day, she enjoys her Husband Lord; she keeps Truth enshrined within her heart. ||4||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jinaa pir raaviaa aapanaa tinaa vittahu bal jaau |
English: I am a sacrifice to those who have enjoyed their Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: sadaa pir kai sang raheh vichahu aap gavaae |5|
English: They dwell forever with their Husband Lord; they eradicate self-conceit from within. ||5||

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: tan man seetal mukh ujale pir kai bhaae piaar |
English: Their bodies and minds are cooled and soothed, and their faces are radiant, from the love and affection of their Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਵੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: sej sukhaalee pir ravai haumai trisanaa maar |6|
English: They enjoy their Husband Lord upon His cozy bed, having conquered their ego and desire. ||6||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa ghar aaeaa gur kai het apaar |
English: Granting His Grace, He comes into our homes, through our infinite Love for the Guru.

Gurbani: ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਕੇਵਲ ਏਕੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: var paaeaa sohaaganee keval ek muraar |7|
English: The happy soul-bride obtains the One Lord as her Husband. ||7||

Gurbani: ਸਭੇ ਗੁਨਹ ਬਖਸਾਇ ਲਇਓਨੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: sabhe gunah bakhasaae leon mele melanahaar |
English: All of her sins are forgiven; the Uniter unites her with Himself.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਖਣੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਜੇ ਸੁਣਿ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੮॥੧੨॥੩੪॥
Transliteration: naanak aakhan aakheeai je sun dhare piaar |8|12|34|
English: O Nanak, chant such chants, that hearing them, He may enshrine love for you. ||8||12||34||

[Ang 428 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 |
English: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਊਪਜੈ ਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur te gun aoopajai jaa prabh melai soe |
English: Merit is obtained from the True Guru, when God causes us to meet Him.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sahaje naam dhiaaeeai giaan paragatt hoe |1|
English: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, with intuitive ease and poise, spiritual wisdom is revealed. ||1||

Gurbani: ਏ ਮਨ ਮਤ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਵੇਖੁ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: e man mat jaaneh har door hai sadaa vekh hadoor |
English: O my mind, do not think of the Lord as being far away; behold Him ever close at hand.

Gurbani: ਸਦ ਸੁਣਦਾ ਸਦ ਵੇਖਦਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sad sunadaa sad vekhadaa sabad rahiaa bharapoor |1| rahaau |
English: He is always listening, and always watching over us; the Word of His Shabad is all-pervading everywhere. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh aap pachhaaniaa tinaee ik man dhiaaeaa |
English: The Gurmukhs understand their own selves; they meditate single-mindedly on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਰਵਹਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sadaa raveh pir aapanaa sachai naam sukh paaeaa |2|
English: They enjoy their Husband Lord continually; through the True Name, they find peace. ||2||

Gurbani: ਏ ਮਨ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: e man teraa ko nahee kar vekh sabad veechaar |
English: O my mind, no one belongs to you; contemplate the Shabad, and see this.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਭਜਿ ਪਉ ਪਾਇਹਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har saranaaee bhaj pau paaeihi mokh duaar |3|
English: So run to the Lord's Sanctuary, and find the gate of salvation. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabad suneeai sabad bujheeai sach rahai liv laae |
English: Listen to the Shabad, and understand the Shabad, and lovingly focus your consciousness on the True One.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਸਚੈ ਮਹਲਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: sabade haumai maareeai sachai mehal sukh paae |4|
English: Through the Shabad, conquer your ego, and in the True Mansion of the Lord's Presence, you shall find peace. ||4||

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸੋਭ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: eis jug meh sobhaa naam kee bin naavai sobh na hoe |
English: In this age, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is glory; without the Name, there is no glory.

Gurbani: ਇਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਚਾਰਿ ਦਿਹਾੜੇ ਜਾਦੀ ਬਿਲਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: eih maaeaa kee sobhaa chaar dihaarre jaadee bilam na hoe |5|
English: The glory of this Maya lasts for only a few days; it disappears in an instant. ||5||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਸੇ ਮੁਏ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jinee naam visaariaa se mue mar jaeh |
English: Those who forget the Naam are already dead, and they continue dying.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: har ras saad na aaeo bisattaa maeh samaeh |6|
English: They do not enjoy the sublime essence of the Lord's taste; they sink into the manure. ||6||

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: eik aape bakhas milaaeian anadin naame laae |
English: Some are forgiven by the Lord; He unites them with Himself, and keeps them attached to the Naam, night and day.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਚਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: sach kamaaveh sach raheh sache sach samaeh |7|
English: They practice Truth, and abide in Truth; being truthful, they merge into Truth. ||7||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਨ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਜਗੁ ਬੋਲਾ ਅੰਨੑਾ ਭਰਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin sabadai suneeai na dekheeai jag bolaa anaa bharamaae |
English: Without the Shabad, the world does not hear, and does not see; deaf and blind, it wanders around.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: bin naavai dukh paaeisee naam milai tisai rajaae |8|
English: Without the Naam, it obtains only misery; the Naam is received only by His Will. ||8||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: jin baanee siau chit laaeaa se jan niramal paravaan |
English: Those persons who link their consciousness with the Word of His Bani, are immaculately pure, and approved by the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਸੇ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੯॥੧੩॥੩੫॥
Transliteration: naanak naam tinaa kade na veesarai se dar sache jaan |9|13|35|
English: O Nanak, they never forget the Naam, and in the Court of the Lord, they are known as true. ||9||13||35||

[Ang 429 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 |
English: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੌ ਹੀ ਭਗਤ ਜਾਪਦੇ ਜਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabadau hee bhagat jaapade jina kee baanee sachee hoe |
English: Through the Word of the Shabad, the devotees are known; their words are true.

Gurbani: ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਨਾਉ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: vichahu aap geaa naau maniaa sach milaavaa hoe |1|
English: They eradicate ego from within themselves; they surrender to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and meet with the True One. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam jan kee pat hoe |
English: Through the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, His humble servants obtain honor.

Gurbani: ਸਫਲੁ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਕਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਨੑ ਮਾਨੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: safal tinaa kaa janam hai tina maanai sabh koe |1| rahaau |
English: How blessed is their coming into the world! Everyone adores them. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਜਾਤਿ ਹੈ ਅਤਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: haumai meraa jaat hai at krodh abhimaan |
English: Ego, self-centeredness, excessive anger and pride are the lot of mankind.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਜਾਤਿ ਜਾਇ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sabad marai taa jaat jaae jotee jot milai bhagavaan |2|
English: If one dies in the Word of the Shabad, then he is rid of this, and his light is merged into the Light of the Lord God. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: pooraa satigur bhettiaa safal janam hamaaraa |
English: Meeting with the Perfect True Guru, my life has been blessed.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਵੈ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਭਰੇ ਅਖੁਟ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naam navai nidh paaeaa bhare akhutt bhanddaaraa |3|
English: I have obtained the nine treasures of the Naam, and my storehouse is inexhaustible, filled to overflowing. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਵਹਿ ਇਸੁ ਰਾਸੀ ਕੇ ਵਾਪਾਰੀਏ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aaveh is raasee ke vaapaaree jinaa naam piaaraa |
English: Those who love the Naam come as dealers in the merchandise of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: guramukh hovai so dhan paae tinaa antar sabad veechaaraa |4|
English: Those who become Gurmukh obtain this wealth; deep within, they contemplate the Shabad. ||4||

Gurbani: ਭਗਤੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੑੀ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: bhagatee saar na jaananaee manamukh ahankaaree |
English: The egotistical, self-willed manmukhs do not appreciate the value of devotional worship.

Gurbani: ਧੁਰਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਇਅਨੁ ਜੂਐ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: dhurahu aap khuaaeian jooai baajee haaree |5|
English: The Primal Lord Himself has beguiled them; they lose their lives in the gamble. ||5||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਆਰੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਰੀਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: bin piaarai bhagat na hovee naa sukh hoe sareer |
English: Without loving affection, devotional worship is not possible, and the body cannot be at peace.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤੀ ਮਨ ਧੀਰਿ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: prem padaarath paaeeai gur bhagatee man dheer |6|
English: The wealth of love is obtained from the Guru; through devotion, the mind becomes steady. ||6||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jis no bhagat karaae so kare gurasabad veechaar |
English: He alone performs devotional worship, whom the Lord so blesses; he contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: hiradai eko naam vasai haumai dubidhaa maar |7|
English: The One Name abides in his heart, and he conquers his ego and duality. ||7||

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਜਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਏਕੋੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: bhagataa kee jat pat ekuo naam hai aape le savaar |
English: The One Name is the social status and honor of the devotees; the Lord Himself adorns them.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਾਰਿ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: sadaa saranaaee tis kee jiau bhaavai tiau kaaraj saar |8|
English: They remain forever in the Protection of His Sanctuary. As it pleases His Will, He arranges their affairs. ||8||

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ਅਲਾਹ ਦੀ ਜਾਪੈ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat niraalee alaah dee jaapai gur veechaar |
English: The worship of the Lord is unique - it is known only by reflecting upon the Guru.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸੈ ਭੈ ਭਗਤੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥੯॥੧੪॥੩੬॥
Transliteration: naanak naam hiradai vasai bhai bhagatee naam savaar |9|14|36|
English: O Nanak, one whose mind is filled with the Naam, through the Lord's Fear and devotion, is embellished with the Naam. ||9||14||36||

[Ang 430 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 |
English: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਨ ਰਸ ਮਹਿ ਭੋਲਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੈ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: an ras meh bholaaeaa bin naamai dukh paae |
English: He wanders around, engrossed in other pleasures, but without the Naam, he suffers in pain.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਜਿ ਸਚੀ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: satigur purakh na bhettio ji sachee boojh bujhaae |1|
English: He does not meet the True Guru, the Primal Being, who imparts true understanding. ||1||

Gurbani: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਵਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਖਿ ਸਾਦੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: e man mere baavale har ras chakh saad paae |
English: O my insane mind, drink in the sublime essence of the Lord, and savor its taste.

Gurbani: ਅਨ ਰਸਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਤੂੰ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: an ras laagaa toon fireh birathaa janam gavaae |1| rahaau |
English: Attached to other pleasures, you wander around, and your life wastes away uselessly. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: eis jug meh guramukh niramale sach naam raheh liv laae |
English: In this age, the Gurmukhs are pure; they remain absorbed in the love of the True Name.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਹੀ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: vin karamaa kichh paaeeai nahee kiaa kar kahiaa jaae |2|
English: Without the destiny of good karma, nothing can be obtained; what can we say or do? ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਮਨਹੁ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: aap pachhaaneh sabad mareh manahu taj vikaar |
English: He understands his own self, and dies in the Word of the Shabad; he banishes corruption from his mind.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਭਜਿ ਪਏ ਬਖਸੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur saranaaee bhaj pe bakhase bakhasanahaar |3|
English: He hurries to the Guru's Sanctuary, and is forgiven by the Forgiving Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin naavai sukh na paaeeai naa dukh vichahu jaae |
English: Without the Name, peace is not obtained, and pain does not depart from within.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: eihu jag maaeaa mohi viaapiaa doojai bharam bhulaae |4|
English: This world is engrossed in attachment to Maya; it has gone astray in duality and doubt. ||4||

Gurbani: ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਪਿਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੀ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: dohaaganee pir kee saar na jaanahee kiaa kar kareh seegaar |
English: The forsaken soul-brides do not know the value of their Husband Lord; how can they decorate themselves?

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਜਲਦੀਆ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਸੇਜੈ ਰਵੈ ਨ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: anadin sadaa jaladeea fireh sejai ravai na bhataar |5|
English: Night and day, they continually burn, and they do not enjoy the Bed of their Husband Lord. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sohaaganee mehal paaeaa vichahu aap gavaae |
English: The happy soul-brides obtain the Mansion of His Presence, eradicating their self-conceit from within.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸੀਗਾਰੀਆ ਅਪਣੇ ਸਹਿ ਲਈਆ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: gurasabadee seegaareea apane seh leea milaae |6|
English: They decorate themselves with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and their Husband Lord unites them with Himself. ||6||

Gurbani: ਮਰਣਾ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: maranaa manahu visaariaa maaeaa mohu gubaar |
English: He has forgotten death, in the darkness of attachment to Maya.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਭੀ ਮਰਹਿ ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਹੋਹਿ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: manamukh mar mar jameh bhee mareh jam dar hohi khuaar |7|
English: The self-willed manmukhs die again and again, and are reborn; they die again, and are miserable at the Gate of Death. ||7||

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਸੇ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: aap milaaeian se mile gur sabad veechaar |
English: They alone are united, whom the Lord unites with Himself; they contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੮॥੨੨॥੧੫॥੩੭॥
Transliteration: naanak naam samaane mukh ujale tith sachai darabaar |8|22|15|37|
English: O Nanak, they are absorbed in the Naam; their faces are radiant, in that True Court. ||8||22||15||37||

[Ang 430 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 asattapadeea ghar 2 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa, Second House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਮਨਾਏ ਪੰਚ ਰੁਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: panch manaae panch rusaae |
English: When the five virtues were reconciled, and the five passions were estranged,

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਵਸਾਏ ਪੰਚ ਗਵਾਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: panch vasaae panch gavaae |1|
English: I enshrined the five within myself, and cast out the other five. ||1||

Gurbani: ਇਨੑ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਗਰੁ ਵੁਠਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: eina bidh nagar vutthaa mere bhaaee |
English: In this way, the village of my body became inhabited, O my Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਦੁਰਤੁ ਗਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: durat geaa gur giaan drirraaee |1| rahaau |
English: Vice departed, and the Guru's spiritual wisdom was implanted within me. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚ ਧਰਮ ਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਵਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: saach dharam kee kar deenee vaar |
English: The fence of true Dharmic religion has been built around it.

Gurbani: ਫਰਹੇ ਮੁਹਕਮ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: farahe muhakam gur giaan beechaar |2|
English: The spiritual wisdom and reflective meditation of the Guru has become its strong gate. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਖੇਤੀ ਬੀਜਹੁ ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: naam khetee beejahu bhaaee meet |
English: So plant the seed of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O friends, O Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਸਉਦਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਨੀਤ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: saudaa karahu gur sevahu neet |3|
English: Deal only in the constant service of the Guru. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਹਾਟ ॥
Transliteration: saant sehaj sukh ke sabh haatt |
English: With intuitive peace and happiness, all the shops are filled.

Gurbani: ਸਾਹ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਏਕੈ ਥਾਟ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: saah vaapaaree ekai thaatt |4|
English: The Banker and the dealers dwell in the same place. ||4||

Gurbani: ਜੇਜੀਆ ਡੰਨੁ ਕੋ ਲਏ ਨ ਜਗਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: jejeea ddan ko le na jagaat |
English: There is no tax on non-believers, nor any fines or taxes at death.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਧੁਰ ਕੀ ਛਾਪ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: satigur kar deenee dhur kee chhaap |5|
English: The True Guru has set the Seal of the Primal Lord upon these goods. ||5||

Gurbani: ਵਖਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਦਿ ਖੇਪ ਚਲਾਵਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: vakhar naam lad khep chalaavahu |
English: So load the merchandise of the Naam, and set sail with your cargo.

Gurbani: ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਵਹੁ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: lai laahaa guramukh ghar aavahu |6|
English: Earn your profit, as Gurmukh, and you shall return to your own home. ||6||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਿਖ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur saahu sikh vanajaare |
English: The True Guru is the Banker, and His Sikhs are the traders.

Gurbani: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਖਾ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਮ੍ਹਾਰੇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: poonjee naam lekhaa saach samhaare |7|
English: Their merchandise is the Naam, and meditation on the True Lord is their account. ||7||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਵਸੈ ਇਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: so vasai it ghar jis gur pooraa sev |
English: One who serves the True Guru dwells in this house.

Gurbani: ਅਬਿਚਲ ਨਗਰੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਵ ॥੮॥੧॥
Transliteration: abichal nagaree naanak dev |8|1|
English: O Nanak, the Divine City is eternal. ||8||1||

[Ang 431 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾਵਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: aasaavaree mahalaa 5 ghar 3 |
English: Aasaavaree, Fifth Mehl, Third House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: mere man har siau laagee preet |
English: My mind is in love with the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਾਚੀ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang har har japat niramal saachee reet |1| rahaau |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I meditate on the Lord, Har, Har; my lifestyle is pure and true. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਘਣੀ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: darasan kee piaas ghanee chitavat anik prakaar |
English: I have such a great thirst for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; I think of him in so many ways.

Gurbani: ਕਰਹੁ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: karahu anugrahu paarabraham har kirapaa dhaar muraar |1|
English: So be Merciful, O Supreme Lord; shower Your Mercy upon me, O Lord, Destroyer of pride. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਪਰਦੇਸੀ ਆਇਆ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: man paradesee aaeaa milio saadh kai sang |
English: My stranger soul has come to join the Saadh Sangat.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਵਖਰ ਕਉ ਚਾਹਤਾ ਸੋ ਪਾਇਓ ਨਾਮਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jis vakhar kau chaahataa so paaeo naameh rang |2|
English: That commodity, which I longed for, I have found in the Love of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੇਤੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ਰਸ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jete maaeaa rang ras binas jaeh khin maeh |
English: There are so many pleasures and delights of Maya, but they pass away in an instant.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤ ਰਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਭੁੰਚਹਿ ਸਭ ਠਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bhagat rate tere naam siau sukh bhuncheh sabh tthaae |3|
English: Your devotees are imbued with Your Name; they enjoy peace everywhere. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਚਲਤਉ ਪੇਖੀਐ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sabh jag chaltau pekheeai nihachal har ko naau |
English: The entire world is seen to be passing away; only the Lord's Name is lasting and stable.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾਈ ਸਾਧ ਸਿਉ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਠਾਉ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: kar mitraaee saadh siau nihachal paaveh tthaau |4|
English: So make friends with the Holy Saints, so that you may obtain a lasting place of rest. ||4||

Gurbani: ਮੀਤ ਸਾਜਨ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪਾ ਕੋਊ ਹੋਤ ਨ ਸਾਥ ॥
Transliteration: meet saajan sut bandhapaa koaoo hot na saath |
English: Friends, acquaintances, children and relatives - none of these shall be your companion.

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਨਿਵਾਹੂ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਦੀਨਾ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਾਥ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: ek nivaahoo raam naam deenaa kaa prabh naath |5|
English: The Lord's Name alone shall go with you; God is the Master of the meek. ||5||

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਭਏ ਲਗਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਿਓ ਤੇਹ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal bohith bhe lag saagar tario teh |
English: The Lord's Lotus Feet are the Boat; attached to Them, you shall cross over the world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਭੇਟਿਓ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸਾਚਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: bhettio pooraa satiguroo saachaa prabh siau neh |6|
English: Meeting with the Perfect True Guru, I embrace True Love for God. ||6||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਜਾਚਨਾ ਵਿਸਰੁ ਨ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: saadh tere kee jaachanaa visar na saas giraas |
English: The prayer of Your Holy Saints is, "May I never forget You, for even one breath or morsel of food."

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਭਲਾ ਤੇਰੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਕਾਰਜ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai so bhalaa terai bhaanai kaaraj raas |7|
English: Whatever is pleasing to Your Will is good; by Your Sweet Will, my affairs are adjusted. ||7||

Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮਿਲੇ ਉਪਜੇ ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: sukh saagar preetam mile upaje mahaa anand |
English: I have met my Beloved, the Ocean of Peace, and Supreme Bliss has welled up within me.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭ ਦੁਖ ਮਿਟੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭੇਟੇ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ ॥੮॥੧॥੨॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak sabh dukh mitte prabh bhette paramaanand |8|1|2|
English: Says Nanak, all my pains have been eradicated, meeting with God, the Lord of Supreme Bliss. ||8||1||2||

[Ang 431 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਬਿਰਹੜੇ ਘਰੁ ੪ ਛੰਤਾ ਕੀ ਜਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 biraharre ghar 4 chhantaa kee jat |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Birharray ~ Songs Of Separation, To Be Sung In The Tune Of The Chhants. Fourth House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: paarabraham prabh simareeai piaare darasan kau bal jaau |1|
English: Remember the Supreme Lord God, O Beloved, and make yourself a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਦੁਖ ਬੀਸਰਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਤਜਣਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jis simarat dukh beesareh piaare so kiau tajanaa jaae |2|
English: Remembering Him, sorrows are forgotten, O Beloved; how can one forsake Him? ||2||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਵੇਚੀ ਸੰਤ ਪਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਦੇਇ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: eihu tan vechee sant peh piaare preetam dee milaae |3|
English: I would sell this body to the Saint, O Beloved, if he would lead me to my Dear Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕੇ ਫੀਕੇ ਤਜਿ ਛੋਡੇ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: sukh seegaar bikhiaa ke feeke taj chhodde meree maae |4|
English: The pleasures and adornments of corruption are insipid and useless; I have forsaken and abandoned them, O my Mother. ||4||

Gurbani: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਤਜਿ ਗਏ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh lobh taj ge piaare satigur charanee paae |5|
English: Lust, anger and greed left me, O Beloved, when I fell at the Feet of the True Guru. ||5||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਰਾਤੇ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਜਾਇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: jo jan raate raam siau piaare anat na kaahoo jaae |6|
English: Those humble beings who are imbued with the Lord, O Beloved, do not go anywhere else. ||6||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਰਹੇ ਆਘਾਇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: har ras jinaee chaakhiaa piaare tripat rahe aaghaae |7|
English: Those who have tasted the Lord's sublime essence, O Beloved, remain satisfied and satiated. ||7||

Gurbani: ਅੰਚਲੁ ਗਹਿਆ ਸਾਧ ਕਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਇ ॥੮॥੧॥੩॥
Transliteration: anchal gahiaa saadh kaa naanak bhai saagar paar paraae |8|1|3|
English: One who grasps the Hem of the Gown of the Holy Saint, O Nanak, crosses over the terrible world-ocean. ||8||1||3||

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਬ ਭੇਟੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: janam maran dukh katteeai piaare jab bhettai har raae |1|
English: The pains of birth and death are removed, O Beloved, when the mortal meets with the Lord, the King. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਸੁਘਰੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sundar sughar sujaan prabh meraa jeevan daras dikhaae |2|
English: God is so Beautiful, so Refined, so Wise - He is my very life! Reveal to me Your Darshan! ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੀਅ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬੀਛੁਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jo jeea tujh te beechhure piaare janam mareh bikh khaae |3|
English: Those beings who are separated from You, O Beloved, are born only to die; they eat the poison of corruption. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jis toon meleh so milai piaare tis kai laagau paae |4|
English: He alone meets You, whom You cause to meet, O Beloved; I fall at his feet. ||4||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਤੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: jo sukh darasan pekhate piaare mukh te kehan na jaae |5|
English: That happiness which one receives by beholding Your Darshan, O Beloved, cannot be described in words. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਤੁਟਈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਰਹੀ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: saachee preet na tuttee piaare jug jug rahee samaae |6|
English: True Love cannot be broken, O Beloved; throughout the ages, it remains. ||6||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਭਲਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਅਮਰੁ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai so bhalaa piaare teree amar rajaae |7|
English: Whatever pleases You is good, O Beloved; Your Will is Eternal. ||7||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮਾਤੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੮॥੨॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak rang rate naaraaeinai piaare maate sehaj subhaae |8|2|4|
English: Nanak, those who are imbued with the Love of the All-Pervading Lord, O Beloved, remain intoxicated with His Love, in natural ease. ||8||2||4||

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਨਤੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਕਹਉ ਸੁਨਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sabh bidh tum hee jaanate piaare kis peh khau sunaae |1|
English: You know all about my condition, O Beloved; who can I speak to about it? ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੀਆ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਿਤਾ ਪਹਿਰਹਿ ਖਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: toon daataa jeea sabhanaa kaa teraa ditaa pahireh khaae |2|
English: You are the Giver of all beings; they eat and wear what You give them. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sukh dukh teree aagiaa piaare doojee naahee jaae |3|
English: Pleasure and pain come by Your Will, O Beloved; they do not come from any other. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਾਵਹਿ ਸੋ ਕਰੀ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jo toon karaaveh so karee piaare avar kichh karan na jaae |4|
English: Whatever You cause me to do, that I do, O Beloved; I cannot do anything else. ||4||

Gurbani: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਸਭ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਿਤੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: din rain sabh suhaavane piaare jit japeeai har naau |5|
English: All my days and nights are blessed, O Beloved, when I chant and meditate on the Lord's Name. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸਾਈ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: saaee kaar kamaavanee piaare dhur masatak lekh likhaae |6|
English: He does the deeds, O Beloved, which are pre-ordained, and inscribed upon his forehead. ||6||

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: eko aap varatadaa piaare ghatt ghatt rahiaa samaae |7|
English: The One is Himself prevailing everywhere, O Beloved; He is pervading in each and every heart. ||7||

Gurbani: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਉਧਰਿ ਲੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥੮॥੩॥੨੨॥੧੫॥੨॥੪੨॥
Transliteration: sansaar koop te udhar lai piaare naanak har saranaae |8|3|22|15|2|42|
English: Lift me up out of the deep pit of the world, O Beloved; Nanak has taken to Your Sanctuary. ||8||3||22||15||2||42||

[Ang 432 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਪਟੀ ਲਿਖੀ ॥
Transliteration: raag aasaa mahalaa 1 pattee likhee |
English: Raag Aasaa, First Mehl, Patee Likhee ~ The Poem Of The Alphabet:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸਸੈ ਸੋਇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਜੀ ਸਭਨਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਏਕੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sasai soe srisatt jin saajee sabhanaa saahib ek bheaa |
English: Sassa: He who created the world, is the One Lord and Master of all.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਤ ਰਹੇ ਚਿਤੁ ਜਿਨੑ ਕਾ ਲਾਗਾ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਾ ਸਫਲੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sevat rahe chit jina kaa laagaa aaeaa tina kaa safal bheaa |1|
English: Those whose consciousness remains committed to His Service - blessed is their birth and their coming into the world. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕਾਹੇ ਭੂਲੇ ਮੂੜ ਮਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: man kaahe bhoole moorr manaa |
English: O mind, why forget Him? You foolish mind!

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਲੇਖਾ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਬੀਰਾ ਤਉ ਪੜਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jab lekhaa deveh beeraa tau parriaa |1| rahaau |
English: When your account is adjusted, O brother, only then shall you be judged wise. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਈਵੜੀ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਦਾਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: eevarree aad purakh hai daataa aape sachaa soee |
English: Eevree: The Primal Lord is the Giver; He alone is True.

Gurbani: ਏਨਾ ਅਖਰਾ ਮਹਿ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: enaa akharaa meh jo guramukh boojhai tis sir lekh na hoee |2|
English: No accounting is due from the Gurmukh who understands the Lord through these letters. ||2||

Gurbani: ਊੜੈ ਉਪਮਾ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਜੈ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aoorrai upamaa taa kee keejai jaa kaa ant na paaeaa |
English: Ooraa: Sing the Praises of the One whose limit cannot be found.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੇਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sevaa kareh seee fal paaveh jinaee sach kamaaeaa |3|
English: Those who perform service and practice truth, obtain the fruits of their rewards. ||3||

Gurbani: ਙੰਙੈ ਙਿਆਨੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ਪੜਿਆ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: ngangai ngiaan boojhai je koee parriaa panddit soee |
English: Nganga: One who understands spiritual wisdom becomes a Pandit, a religious scholar.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਤਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: sarab jeea meh eko jaanai taa haumai kahai na koee |4|
English: One who recognizes the One Lord among all beings does not talk of ego. ||4||

Gurbani: ਕਕੈ ਕੇਸ ਪੁੰਡਰ ਜਬ ਹੂਏ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਾਬੂਣੈ ਉਜਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: kakai kes punddar jab hooe vin saaboonai ujaliaa |
English: Kakka: When the hair grows grey, then it shines without shampoo.

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਰਾਜੇ ਕੇ ਹੇਰੂ ਆਏ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਲਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਲਇਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: jam raaje ke heroo aae maaeaa kai sangal bandh leaa |5|
English: The hunters of the King of Death come, and bind him in the chains of Maya. ||5||

Gurbani: ਖਖੈ ਖੁੰਦਕਾਰੁ ਸਾਹ ਆਲਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਖਰੀਦਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਖਰਚੁ ਦੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: khakhai khundakaar saah aalam kar khareed jin kharach deea |
English: Khakha: The Creator is the King of the world; He enslaves by giving nourishment.

Gurbani: ਬੰਧਨਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਬਾਧਿਆ ਅਵਰੀ ਕਾ ਨਹੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਇਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: bandhan jaa kai sabh jag baadhiaa avaree kaa nahee hukam peaa |6|
English: By His Binding, all the world is bound; no other Command prevails. ||6||

Gurbani: ਗਗੈ ਗੋਇ ਗਾਇ ਜਿਨਿ ਛੋਡੀ ਗਲੀ ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਗਰਬਿ ਭਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gagai goe gaae jin chhoddee galee gobid garab bheaa |
English: Gagga: One who renounces the singing of the songs of the Lord of the Universe, becomes arrogant in his speech.

Gurbani: ਘੜਿ ਭਾਂਡੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਆਵੀ ਸਾਜੀ ਚਾੜਣ ਵਾਹੈ ਤਈ ਕੀਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: gharr bhaandde jin aavee saajee chaarran vaahai tee keea |7|
English: One who has shaped the pots, and made the world the kiln, decides when to put them in it. ||7||

Gurbani: ਘਘੈ ਘਾਲ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜੇ ਘਾਲੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: ghaghai ghaal sevak je ghaalai sabad guroo kai laag rahai |
English: Ghagha: The servant who performs service, remains attached to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਜੇ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਰਮਤੁ ਰਹੈ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: buraa bhalaa je sam kar jaanai in bidh saahib ramat rahai |8|
English: One who recognizes bad and good as one and the same - in this way he is absorbed into the Lord and Master. ||8||

Gurbani: ਚਚੈ ਚਾਰਿ ਵੇਦ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਜੇ ਚਾਰੇ ਖਾਣੀ ਚਾਰਿ ਜੁਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: chachai chaar ved jin saaje chaare khaanee chaar jugaa |
English: Chacha: He created the four Vedas, the four sources of creation, and the four ages

Gurbani: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਖਾਣੀ ਭੋਗੀ ਪੜਿਆ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਆਪਿ ਥੀਆ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: jug jug jogee khaanee bhogee parriaa panddit aap theea |9|
English: - through each and every age, He Himself has been the Yogi, the enjoyer, the Pandit and the scholar. ||9||

Gurbani: ਛਛੈ ਛਾਇਆ ਵਰਤੀ ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਆ ਭਰਮੁ ਹੋਆ ॥
Transliteration: chhachhai chhaaeaa varatee sabh antar teraa keea bharam hoaa |
English: Chhachha: Ignorance exists within everyone; doubt is Your doing, O Lord.

Gurbani: ਭਰਮੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਭੁਲਾਈਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਿਆ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: bharam upaae bhulaaeean aape teraa karam hoaa tina guroo miliaa |10|
English: Having created doubt, You Yourself cause them to wander in delusion; those whom You bless with Your Mercy meet with the Guru. ||10||

Gurbani: ਜਜੈ ਜਾਨੁ ਮੰਗਤ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਭੀਖ ਭਵਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jajai jaan mangat jan jaachai lakh chauraaseeh bheekh bhaviaa |
English: Jajja: That humble being who begs for wisdom has wandered begging through 8.4 million incarnations.

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਲੇਵੈ ਏਕੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਮੈ ਸੁਣਿਆ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: eko levai eko devai avar na doojaa mai suniaa |11|
English: The One Lord takes away, and the One Lord gives; I have not heard of any other. ||11||

Gurbani: ਝਝੈ ਝੂਰਿ ਮਰਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੇਣਾ ਸੁ ਦੇ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jhajhai jhoor marahu kiaa praanee jo kichh denaa su de rahiaa |
English: Jhajha: O mortal being, why are you dying of anxiety? Whatever the Lord is to give, He shall keep on giving.

Gurbani: ਦੇ ਦੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚਲਾਏ ਜਿਉ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਪਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: de de vekhai hukam chalaae jiau jeea kaa rijak peaa |12|
English: He gives, and gives, and watches over us; according to the Orders which He issues, His beings receive nourishment. ||12||

Gurbani: ਞੰਞੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਾ ਦੇਖਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: yanyai nadar kare jaa dekhaa doojaa koee naahee |
English: Nyanya: When the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, then I do not behold any other.

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ਏਕੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: eko rav rahiaa sabh thaaee ek vasiaa man maahee |13|
English: The One Lord is totally pervading everywhere; the One Lord abides within the mind. ||13||

Gurbani: ਟਟੈ ਟੰਚੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਘੜੀ ਕਿ ਮੁਹਤਿ ਕਿ ਉਠਿ ਚਲਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: ttattai ttanch karahu kiaa praanee gharree ki muhat ki utth chalanaa |
English: Tatta: Why do you practice hypocrisy, O mortal? In a moment, in an instant, you shall have to get up and depart.

Gurbani: ਜੂਐ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹਾਰਹੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਭਾਜਿ ਪੜਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: jooai janam na haarahu apanaa bhaaj parrahu tum har saranaa |14|
English: Don't lose your life in the gamble - hurry to the Lord's Sanctuary. ||14||

Gurbani: ਠਠੈ ਠਾਢਿ ਵਰਤੀ ਤਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਜਿਨੑ ਕਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: tthatthai tthaadt varatee tin antar har charanee jina kaa chit laagaa |
English: T'hat'ha: Peace pervades within those who link their consciousness to the Lord's Lotus Feet.

Gurbani: ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਨਿਸਤਰੇ ਤਉ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: chit laagaa seee jan nisatare tau parasaadee sukh paaeaa |15|
English: Those humble beings, whose consciousness is so linked, are saved; by Your Grace, they obtain peace. ||15||

Gurbani: ਡਡੈ ਡੰਫੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਆ ਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਚਲਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: ddaddai ddanf karahu kiaa praanee jo kichh hoaa su sabh chalanaa |
English: Dadda: Why do you make such ostentatious shows, O mortal? Whatever exists, shall all pass away.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੈ ਸਰੇਵਹੁ ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: tisai sarevahu taa sukh paavahu sarab nirantar rav rahiaa |16|
English: So serve Him, who is contained and pervading among everyone, and you shall obtain peace. ||16||

Gurbani: ਢਢੈ ਢਾਹਿ ਉਸਾਰੈ ਆਪੇ ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਕਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: dtadtai dtaeh usaarai aape jiau tis bhaavai tivai kare |
English: Dhadha: He Himself establishes and disestablishes; as it pleases His Will, so does He act.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚਲਾਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: kar kar vekhai hukam chalaae tis nisataare jaa kau nadar kare |17|
English: Having created the creation, He watches over it; He issues His Commands, and emancipates those, upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace. ||17||

Gurbani: ਣਾਣੈ ਰਵਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: naanai ravat rahai ghatt antar har gun gaavai soee |
English: Nanna: One whose heart is filled with the Lord, sings His Glorious Praises.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਨਰਪਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: aape aap milaae karataa punarap janam na hoee |18|
English: One whom the Creator Lord unites with Himself, is not consigned to reincarnation. ||18||

Gurbani: ਤਤੈ ਤਾਰੂ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tatai taaroo bhavajal hoaa taa kaa ant na paaeaa |
English: Tatta: The terrible world-ocean is so very deep; its limits cannot be found.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਤਰ ਨਾ ਤੁਲਹਾ ਹਮ ਬੂਡਸਿ ਤਾਰਿ ਲੇਹਿ ਤਾਰਣ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: naa tar naa tulahaa ham booddas taar lehi taaran raaeaa |19|
English: I do not have a boat, or even a raft; I am drowning - save me, O Savior King! ||19||

Gurbani: ਥਥੈ ਥਾਨਿ ਥਾਨੰਤਰਿ ਸੋਈ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਹੋਆ ॥
Transliteration: thathai thaan thaanantar soee jaa kaa keea sabh hoaa |
English: T'hat'ha: In all places and interspaces, He is; everything which exists, is by His doing.

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਭਰਮੁ ਕਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲਾ ॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: kiaa bharam kiaa maaeaa kaheeai jo tis bhaavai soee bhalaa |20|
English: What is doubt? What is called Maya? Whatever pleases Him is good. ||20||

Gurbani: ਦਦੈ ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਦੇਊ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੋਸੁ ਕਰੰਮਾ ਆਪਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: dadai dos na deaoo kisai dos karamaa aapaniaa |
English: Dadda: Do not blame anyone else; blame instead your own actions.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਮੈ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਮੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਦੀਜੈ ਅਵਰ ਜਨਾ ॥੨੧॥
Transliteration: jo mai keea so mai paaeaa dos na deejai avar janaa |21|
English: Whatever I did, for that I have suffered; I do not blame anyone else. ||21||

Gurbani: ਧਧੈ ਧਾਰਿ ਕਲਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਛੋਡੀ ਹਰਿ ਚੀਜੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਰੰਗ ਕੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: dhadhai dhaar kalaa jin chhoddee har cheejee jin rang keea |
English: Dhadha: His power established and upholds the earth; the Lord has imparted His color to everything.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਦੀਆ ਸਭਨੀ ਲੀਆ ਕਰਮੀ ਕਰਮੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਇਆ ॥੨੨॥
Transliteration: tis daa deea sabhanee leea karamee karamee hukam peaa |22|
English: His gifts are received by everyone; all act according to His Command. ||22||

Gurbani: ਨੰਨੈ ਨਾਹ ਭੋਗ ਨਿਤ ਭੋਗੈ ਨਾ ਡੀਠਾ ਨਾ ਸੰਮ੍ਹਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: nanai naah bhog nit bhogai naa ddeetthaa naa samhaliaa |
English: Nanna: The Husband Lord enjoys eternal pleasures, but He is not seen or understood.

Gurbani: ਗਲੀ ਹਉ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਭੈਣੇ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਮੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ॥੨੩॥
Transliteration: galee hau sohaagan bhaine kant na kabahoon mai miliaa |23|
English: I am called the happy soul-bride, O sister, but my Husband Lord has never met me. ||23||

Gurbani: ਪਪੈ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਵੇਖਣ ਕਉ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: papai paatisaahu paramesar vekhan kau parapanch keea |
English: Pappa: The Supreme King, the Transcendent Lord, created the world, and watches over it.

Gurbani: ਦੇਖੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥੨੪॥
Transliteration: dekhai boojhai sabh kichh jaanai antar baahar rav rahiaa |24|
English: He sees and understands, and knows everything; inwardly and outwardly, he is fully pervading. ||24||

Gurbani: ਫਫੈ ਫਾਹੀ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਫਾਸਾ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਲਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: fafai faahee sabh jag faasaa jam kai sangal bandh leaa |
English: Faffa: The whole world is caught in the noose of Death, and all are bound by its chains.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸੇ ਨਰ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਭਜਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੨੫॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee se nar ubare ji har saranaagat bhaj peaa |25|
English: By Guru's Grace, they alone are saved, who hurry to enter the Lord's Sanctuary. ||25||

Gurbani: ਬਬੈ ਬਾਜੀ ਖੇਲਣ ਲਾਗਾ ਚਉਪੜਿ ਕੀਤੇ ਚਾਰਿ ਜੁਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: babai baajee khelan laagaa chauparr keete chaar jugaa |
English: Babba: He set out to play the game, on the chess-board of the four ages.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭ ਸਾਰੀ ਕੀਤੇ ਪਾਸਾ ਢਾਲਣਿ ਆਪਿ ਲਗਾ ॥੨੬॥
Transliteration: jeea jant sabh saaree keete paasaa dtaalan aap lagaa |26|
English: He made all beings and creatures his chessmen, and He Himself threw the dice. ||26||

Gurbani: ਭਭੈ ਭਾਲਹਿ ਸੇ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਭਉ ਪਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bhabhai bhaaleh se fal paaveh gur parasaadee jina kau bhau peaa |
English: Bhabha: Those who search, find the fruits of their rewards; by Guru's Grace, they live in the Fear of God.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਮੂੜੇ ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਫੇਰੁ ਪਇਆ ॥੨੭॥
Transliteration: manamukh fireh na cheteh moorre lakh chauraaseeh fer peaa |27|
English: The self-willed manmukhs wander around, and they do not remember the Lord; the fools are consigned to the cycle of 8.4 million incarnations. ||27||

Gurbani: ਮੰਮੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਭਇਆ ਤਬ ਚੇਤਵਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: mamai mohu maran madhusoodan maran bheaa tab chetaviaa |
English: Mamma: In emotional attachment, he dies; he only thinks of the Lord, the Love of Nectar, when he dies.

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਅਵਰੋ ਪੜਿਆ ਮੰਮਾ ਅਖਰੁ ਵੀਸਰਿਆ ॥੨੮॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa bheetar avaro parriaa mamaa akhar veesariaa |28|
English: As long as the body is alive, he reads other things, and forgets the letter 'm', which stands for marnaa - death. ||28||

Gurbani: ਯਯੈ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਕਦ ਹੀ ਜੇ ਕਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: yayai janam na hovee kad hee je kar sach pachhaanai |
English: Yaya: He is never reincarnated again, if he recognizes the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਖੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥੨੯॥
Transliteration: guramukh aakhai guramukh boojhai guramukh eko jaanai |29|
English: The Gurmukh speaks, the Gurmukh understands, and the Gurmukh knows only the One Lord. ||29||

Gurbani: ਰਾਰੈ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੇਤੇ ਕੀਏ ਜੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: raarai rav rahiaa sabh antar jete kee jantaa |
English: Rarra: The Lord is contained among all; He created all beings.

Gurbani: ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇ ਧੰਧੈ ਸਭ ਲਾਏ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਆ ਤਿਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਇਆ ॥੩੦॥
Transliteration: jant upaae dhandhai sabh laae karam hoaa tin naam leaa |30|
English: Having created His beings, He has put them all to work; they alone remember the Naam, upon whom He bestows His Grace. ||30||

Gurbani: ਲਲੈ ਲਾਇ ਧੰਧੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਛੋਡੀ ਮੀਠਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: lalai laae dhandhai jin chhoddee meetthaa maaeaa mohu keea |
English: Lalla: He has assigned people to their tasks, and made the love of Maya seem sweet to them.

Gurbani: ਖਾਣਾ ਪੀਣਾ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਸਹਣਾ ਭਾਣੈ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਇਆ ॥੩੧॥
Transliteration: khaanaa peenaa sam kar sahanaa bhaanai taa kai hukam peaa |31|
English: We eat and drink; we should endure equally whatever occurs, by His Will, by His Command. ||31||

Gurbani: ਵਵੈ ਵਾਸੁਦੇਉ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਵੇਖਣ ਕਉ ਜਿਨਿ ਵੇਸੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: vavai vaasudeo paramesar vekhan kau jin ves keea |
English: Wawa: The all-pervading Transcendent Lord beholds the world; He created the form it wears.

Gurbani: ਵੇਖੈ ਚਾਖੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥੩੨॥
Transliteration: vekhai chaakhai sabh kichh jaanai antar baahar rav rahiaa |32|
English: He beholds, tastes, and knows everything; He is pervading and permeating inwardly and outwardly. ||32||

Gurbani: ੜਾੜੈ ਰਾੜਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਜਿ ਅਮਰੁ ਹੋਆ ॥
Transliteration: rraarrai raarr kareh kiaa praanee tiseh dhiaavahu ji amar hoaa |
English: Rarra: Why do you quarrel, O mortal? Meditate on the Imperishable Lord,

Gurbani: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਹੁ ਓਸੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਕੀਆ ॥੩੩॥
Transliteration: tiseh dhiaavahu sach samaavahu os vittahu kurabaan keea |33|
English: and be absorbed into the True One. Become a sacrifice to Him. ||33||

Gurbani: ਹਾਹੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੀਅ ਉਪਾਇ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਦੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: haahai hor na koee daataa jeea upaae jin rijak deea |
English: Haha: There is no other Giver than Him; having created the creatures, He gives them nourishment.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਹੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੀਆ ॥੩੪॥
Transliteration: har naam dhiaavahu har naam samaavahu anadin laahaa har naam leea |34|
English: Meditate on the Lord's Name, be absorbed into the Lord's Name, and night and day, reap the Profit of the Lord's Name. ||34||

Gurbani: ਆਇੜੈ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਛੋਡੀ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: aaeirrai aap kare jin chhoddee jo kichh karanaa su kar rahiaa |
English: Airaa: He Himself created the world; whatever He has to do, He continues to do.

Gurbani: ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਇਰ ਇਵ ਕਹਿਆ ॥੩੫॥੧॥
Transliteration: kare karaae sabh kichh jaanai naanak saaeir iv kahiaa |35|1|
English: He acts, and causes others to act, and He knows everything; so says Nanak, the poet. ||35||1||

[Ang 434 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਪਟੀ ॥
Transliteration: raag aasaa mahalaa 3 pattee |
English: Raag Aasaa, Third Mehl, Patee - The Alphabet:

[Ang 434 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਅਯੋ ਅੰਙੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਆਇਆ ਕਾਖੈ ਘੰਙੈ ਕਾਲੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: ayo angai sabh jag aaeaa kaakhai ghangai kaal bheaa |
English: Ayo, Angai: The whole world which was created - Kaahkai, Ghangai: It shall pass away.

Gurbani: ਰੀਰੀ ਲਲੀ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਣੇ ਪੜਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਗੁਣ ਵੀਸਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: reeree lalee paap kamaane parr avagan gun veesariaa |1|
English: Reeree, Laalee: People commit sins, and falling into vice, forget virtue. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਐਸਾ ਲੇਖਾ ਤੂੰ ਕੀ ਪੜਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: man aisaa lekhaa toon kee parriaa |
English: O mortal, why have you studied such an account,

Gurbani: ਲੇਖਾ ਦੇਣਾ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: lekhaa denaa terai sir rahiaa |1| rahaau |
English: which shall call you to answer for payment? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਿਧੰਙਾਇਐ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਨੰਨੈ ਨਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sidhangaaeiai simareh naahee nanai naa tudh naam leaa |
English: Sidhan, Ngaayiyai: You do not remember the Lord. Nanna: You do not take the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਛਛੈ ਛੀਜਹਿ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਮੂੜੇ ਕਿਉ ਛੂਟਹਿ ਜਮਿ ਪਾਕੜਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: chhachhai chheejeh ahinis moorre kiau chhootteh jam paakarriaa |2|
English: Chhachha: You are wearing away, every night and day; you fool, how will you find release? You are held in the grip of death. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬਬੈ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੂੜੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: babai boojheh naahee moorre bharam bhule teraa janam geaa |
English: Babba: You do not understand, you fool; deluded by doubt, you are wasting your life.

Gurbani: ਅਣਹੋਦਾ ਨਾਉ ਧਰਾਇਓ ਪਾਧਾ ਅਵਰਾ ਕਾ ਭਾਰੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਲਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: anahodaa naau dharaaeo paadhaa avaraa kaa bhaar tudh leaa |3|
English: Without justification, you call yourself a teacher; thus you take on the loads of others. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਜੈ ਜੋਤਿ ਹਿਰਿ ਲਈ ਤੇਰੀ ਮੂੜੇ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਹਿਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: jajai jot hir lee teree moorre ant geaa pachhutaavahigaa |
English: Jajja: You have been robbed of your Light, you fool; in the end, you shall have to depart, and you shall regret and repent.

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਤੂੰ ਚੀਨਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਆਵਹਿਗਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: ek sabad toon cheeneh naahee fir fir joonee aavahigaa |4|
English: You have not remembered the One Word of the Shabad, and so you shall have to enter the womb over and over again. ||4||

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਪੜੁ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਅਵਰਾ ਨੋ ਨ ਸਿਖਾਲਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: tudh sir likhiaa so parr panddit avaraa no na sikhaal bikhiaa |
English: Read that which is written on your forehead, O Pandit, and do not teach wickedness to others.

Gurbani: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਫਾਹਾ ਪਇਆ ਪਾਧੇ ਪਿਛੋ ਦੇ ਗਲਿ ਚਾਟੜਿਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: pahilaa faahaa peaa paadhe pichho de gal chaattarriaa |5|
English: First, the teacher is tied down, and then, the noose is placed around the pupil's neck. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸਸੈ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਗਇਓ ਮੂੜੇ ਏਕੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਕੁਥਾਇ ਲਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sasai sanjam geo moorre ek daan tudh kuthaae leaa |
English: Sassa: You have lost your self-discipline, you fool, and you have accepted an offering under false pretenses.

Gurbani: ਸਾਈ ਪੁਤ੍ਰੀ ਜਜਮਾਨ ਕੀ ਸਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਏਤੁ ਧਾਨਿ ਖਾਧੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਇਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: saaee putree jajamaan kee saa teree et dhaan khaadhai teraa janam geaa |6|
English: The daughter of the alms-giver is just like your own; by accepting this payment for performing the wedding ceremony, you have cursed your own life. ||6||

Gurbani: ਮੰਮੈ ਮਤਿ ਹਿਰਿ ਲਈ ਤੇਰੀ ਮੂੜੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਡਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਪਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: mamai mat hir lee teree moorre haumai vaddaa rog peaa |
English: Mamma: You have been cheated out your intellect, you fool, and you are afflicted with the great disease of ego.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰ ਆਤਮੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨ ਚੀਨਿੑਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਮੁਹਤਾਜੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: antar aatamai braham na cheenaa maaeaa kaa muhataaj bheaa |7|
English: Within your innermost self, you do not recognize God, and you compromise yourself for the sake of Maya. ||7||

Gurbani: ਕਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਭਰਮਿਓਹੁ ਮੂੜੇ ਮਮਤਾ ਲਾਗੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਹਰਿ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: kakai kaam krodh bharamiohu moorre mamataa laage tudh har visariaa |
English: Kakka: You wander around in sexual desire and anger, you fool; attached to possessiveness, you have forgotten the Lord.

Gurbani: ਪੜਹਿ ਗੁਣਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪੁਕਾਰਹਿ ਵਿਣੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਤੂੰ ਡੂਬਿ ਮੁਆ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: parreh guneh toon bahut pukaareh vin boojhe toon ddoob muaa |8|
English: You read, and reflect, and proclaim out loud, but without understanding, you are drowned to death. ||8||

Gurbani: ਤਤੈ ਤਾਮਸਿ ਜਲਿਓਹੁ ਮੂੜੇ ਥਥੈ ਥਾਨ ਭਰਿਸਟੁ ਹੋਆ ॥
Transliteration: tatai taamas jaliohu moorre thathai thaan bharisatt hoaa |
English: Tatta: In anger, you are burnt, you fool. T'hat'ha: That place where you live, is cursed.

Gurbani: ਘਘੈ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਮੂੜੇ ਦਦੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਨ ਤੁਧੁ ਲਇਆ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: ghaghai ghar ghar fireh toon moorre dadai daan na tudh leaa |9|
English: Ghagha: You go begging from door to door, you fool. Dadda: But still, you do not receive the gift. ||9||

Gurbani: ਪਪੈ ਪਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਵਹੀ ਮੂੜੇ ਪਰਪੰਚਿ ਤੂੰ ਪਲਚਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: papai paar na pavahee moorre parapanch toon palach rahiaa |
English: Pappa: You shall not be able to swim across, you fool, since you are engrossed in worldly affairs.

Gurbani: ਸਚੈ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਇਓਹੁ ਮੂੜੇ ਇਹੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਲੇਖੁ ਪਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: sachai aap khuaaeohu moorre ihu sir terai lekh peaa |10|
English: The True Lord Himself has ruined you, you fool; this is the destiny written on your forehead. ||10||

Gurbani: ਭਭੈ ਭਵਜਲਿ ਡੁਬੋਹੁ ਮੂੜੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਗਲਤਾਨੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bhabhai bhavajal ddubohu moorre maaeaa vich galataan bheaa |
English: Bhabha: You have drowned in the terrifying world-ocean, you fool, and you have become engrossed in Maya.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਏਕ ਘੜੀ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee eko jaanai ek gharree meh paar peaa |11|
English: One who comes to know the One Lord, by Guru's Grace, is carried across in an instant. ||11||

Gurbani: ਵਵੈ ਵਾਰੀ ਆਈਆ ਮੂੜੇ ਵਾਸੁਦੇਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਵੀਸਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: vavai vaaree aaeea moorre vaasudeo tudh veesariaa |
English: Wawa: Your turn has come, you fool, but you have forgotten the Lord of Light.

Gurbani: ਏਹ ਵੇਲਾ ਨ ਲਹਸਹਿ ਮੂੜੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਤੂੰ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: eeh velaa na lahaseh moorre fir toon jam kai vas peaa |12|
English: This opportunity shall not come again, you fool; you shall fall under the power of the Messenger of Death. ||12||

Gurbani: ਝਝੈ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਝੂਰਹਿ ਮੂੜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਤੂੰ ਵਿਖਾ ॥
Transliteration: jhajhai kade na jhooreh moorre satigur kaa upades sun toon vikhaa |
English: Jhajha: You shall never have to regret and repent, you fool, if you listen to the Teachings of the True Guru, for even an instant.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਨਿਗੁਰੇ ਕਾ ਹੈ ਨਾਉ ਬੁਰਾ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: satigur baajhahu gur nahee koee nigure kaa hai naau buraa |13|
English: Without the True Guru, there is no Guru at all; one who is without a Guru has a bad reputation. ||13||

Gurbani: ਧਧੈ ਧਾਵਤ ਵਰਜਿ ਰਖੁ ਮੂੜੇ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਪਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: dhadhai dhaavat varaj rakh moorre antar terai nidhaan peaa |
English: Dhadha: Restrain your wandering mind, you fool; deep within you the treasure is to be found.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਹਿ ਜੁਗਾ ਜੁਗੰਤਰਿ ਖਾਹਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: guramukh hoveh taa har ras peeveh jugaa jugantar khaeh peaa |14|
English: When one becomes Gurmukh, then he drinks in the sublime essence of the Lord; throughout the ages, he continues to drink it in. ||14||

Gurbani: ਗਗੈ ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮੂੜੇ ਗਲੀ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gagai gobid chit kar moorre galee kinai na paaeaa |
English: Gagga: Keep the Lord of the Universe in your mind, you fool; by mere words, no one has ever attained Him.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਾਇ ਮੂੜੇ ਪਿਛਲੇ ਗੁਨਹ ਸਭ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਇਆ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: gur ke charan hiradai vasaae moorre pichhale gunah sabh bakhas leaa |15|
English: Enshrine the Guru's feet within your heart, you fool, and all your past sins shall be forgiven. ||15||

Gurbani: ਹਾਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਬੂਝੁ ਤੂੰ ਮੂੜੇ ਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: haahai har kathaa boojh toon moorre taa sadaa sukh hoee |
English: Haha: Understand the Lord's Sermon, you fool; only then shall you attain eternal peace.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪੜਹਿ ਤੇਤਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: manamukh parreh tetaa dukh laagai vin satigur mukat na hoee |16|
English: The more the self-willed manmukhs read, the more pain they suffer. Without the True Guru, liberation is not obtained. ||16||

Gurbani: ਰਾਰੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮੂੜੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਿਨੑ ਕੈ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: raarai raam chit kar moorre hiradai jina kai rav rahiaa |
English: Rarra: Center your consciousness on the Lord, you fool; abide with those whose hearts are filled with the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਰਾਮੁ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਬੂਝਿ ਲਹਿਆ ॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee jinaee raam pachhaataa niragun raam tinaee boojh lahiaa |17|
English: By Guru's Grace, those who recognize the Lord, understand the absolute Lord. ||17||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਲਖਿਆ ਅਕਥੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: teraa ant na jaaee lakhiaa akath na jaaee har kathiaa |
English: Your limits cannot be known; the indescribable Lord cannot be described.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਾ ਲੇਖਾ ਨਿਬੜਿਆ ॥੧੮॥੧॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak jina kau satigur miliaa tina kaa lekhaa nibarriaa |18|1|2|
English: O Nanak, whose who have met the True Guru, have their accounts settled. ||18||1||2||

[Ang 435 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raag aasaa mahalaa 1 chhant ghar 1 |
English: Raag Aasaa, First Mehl, Chhant, First House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਮੁੰਧ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਬਾਲੜੀਏ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਲੀਆਲਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: mundh joban baalarree meraa pir raleeaalaa raam |
English: O beautiful young bride, my Beloved Lord is very playful.

Gurbani: ਧਨ ਪਿਰ ਨੇਹੁ ਘਣਾ ਰਸਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: dhan pir nehu ghanaa ras preet deaalaa raam |
English: When the bride enshrines great love for her Husband Lord, He becomes merciful, and loves her in return.

Gurbani: ਧਨ ਪਿਰਹਿ ਮੇਲਾ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: dhan pireh melaa hoe suaamee aap prabh kirapaa kare |
English: The soul-bride meets her Husband Lord, when the Lord Master Himself showers His favor upon her.

Gurbani: ਸੇਜਾ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਸਾਤ ਸਰ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sejaa suhaavee sang pir kai saat sar amrit bhare |
English: Her bed is decorated in the company of her Beloved, and her seven pools are filled with ambrosial nectar.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਮਇਆ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਓ ॥
Transliteration: kar deaa meaa deaal saache sabad mil gun gaavo |
English: Be kind and compassionate to me, O Merciful True Lord, that I may obtain the Word of the Shabad, and sing Your Glorious Praises.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਬਿਗਸੀ ਮੁੰਧ ਮਨਿ ਓਮਾਹਓ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanakaa har var dekh bigasee mundh man omaaho |1|
English: O Nanak, gazing upon her Husband Lord, the soul-bride is delighted, and her mind is filled with joy. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੁੰਧ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਲੋਨੜੀਏ ਇਕ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: mundh sehaj salonarree ik prem binantee raam |
English: O bride of natural beauty, offer your loving prayers to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਮਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: mai man tan har bhaavai prabh sangam raatee raam |
English: The Lord is pleasing to my mind and body; I am intoxicated in my Lord God's Company.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: prabh prem raatee har binantee naam har kai sukh vasai |
English: Imbued with the Love of God, I pray to the Lord, and through the Lord's Name, I abide in peace.

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਗੁਣ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਗੁਣਹ ਵਸਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਨਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: tau gun pachhaaneh taa prabh jaaneh gunah vas avagan nasai |
English: If you recognize His Glorious Virtues, then you shall come to know God; thus virtue shall dwell in you, and sin shall run away.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਾਝੁ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਾ ਕਹਣਿ ਸੁਨਣਿ ਨ ਧੀਜਏ ॥
Transliteration: tudh baajh ik til reh na saakaa kehan sunan na dheeje |
English: Without You, I cannot survive, even for an instant; by merely talking and listening about You, I am not satisfied.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਪੁਕਾਰੇ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਿ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanakaa priau priau kar pukaare rasan ras man bheeje |2|
English: Nanak proclaims, "O Beloved, O Beloved!" His tongue and mind are drenched with the Lord's sublime essence. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਖੀਹੋ ਸਹੇਲੜੀਹੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sakheeho sahelarreeho meraa pir vanajaaraa raam |
English: O my companions and friends, my Husband Lord is the merchant.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋੁ ਵਣੰਜੜਿਆ ਰਸਿ ਮੋਲਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: har naamuo vananjarriaa ras mol apaaraa raam |
English: I have purchased the Lord's Name; its sweetness and value are unlimited.

Gurbani: ਮੋਲਿ ਅਮੋਲੋ ਸਚ ਘਰਿ ਢੋਲੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਮੁੰਧ ਭਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: mol amolo sach ghar dtolo prabh bhaavai taa mundh bhalee |
English: His value is invaluable; the Beloved dwells in His true home. If it is pleasing to God, then He blesses His bride.

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਕਰਹਿ ਰਲੀਆ ਹਉ ਪੁਕਾਰੀ ਦਰਿ ਖਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: eik sang har kai kareh raleea hau pukaaree dar khalee |
English: Some enjoy sweet pleasures with the Lord, while I stand crying at His door.

Gurbani: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਆਪਿ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਾਰਏ ॥
Transliteration: karan kaaran samarath sreedhar aap kaaraj saare |
English: The Creator, the Cause of causes, the All-powerful Lord Himself arranges our affairs.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਧਨ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਭ ਸਾਧਾਰਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak nadaree dhan sohaagan sabad abh saadhaare |3|
English: O Nanak, blessed is the soul-bride, upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace; she enshrines the Word of the Shabad in her heart. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਘਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਹਿਲੜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਇਅੜੇ ਮੀਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: ham ghar saachaa sohilarraa prabh aaeiarre meetaa raam |
English: In my home, the true songs of rejoicing resound; the Lord God, my Friend, has come to me.

Gurbani: ਰਾਵੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੜਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਅੜਾ ਦੀਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: raave rang raatarriaa man leearraa deetaa raam |
English: He enjoys me, and imbued with His Love, I have captivated His heart, and given mine to Him.

Gurbani: ਆਪਣਾ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਲੀਆ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਵਏ ॥
Transliteration: aapanaa man deea har var leea jiau bhaavai tiau raave |
English: I gave my mind, and obtained the Lord as my Husband; as it pleases His Will, He enjoys me.

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਆਗੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਭਾਗੈ ਘਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਏ ॥
Transliteration: tan man pir aagai sabad sabhaagai ghar amrit fal paave |
English: I have placed my body and mind before my Husband Lord, and through the Shabad, I have been blessed. Within the home of my own self, I have obtained the ambrosial fruit.

Gurbani: ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਠਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਹੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈਐ ਭਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: budh paatth na paaeeai bahu chaturaaeeai bhaae milai man bhaane |
English: He is not obtained by intellectual recitation or great cleverness; only by love does the mind obtain Him.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮੀਤ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਹਮ ਨਾਹੀ ਲੋਕਾਣੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak tthaakur meet hamaare ham naahee lokaane |4|1|
English: O Nanak, the Lord Master is my Best Friend; I am not an ordinary person. ||4||1||

[Ang 436 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਨਹਦੋ ਅਨਹਦੁ ਵਾਜੈ ਰੁਣ ਝੁਣਕਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: anahado anahad vaajai run jhunakaare raam |
English: The unstruck melody of the sound current resounds with the vibrations of the celestial instruments.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਲਾਲ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: meraa mano meraa man raataa laal piaare raam |
English: My mind, my mind is imbued with the Love of my Darling Beloved.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਸੁੰਨ ਮੰਡਲਿ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: anadin raataa man bairaagee sun manddal ghar paaeaa |
English: Night and day, my detached mind remains absorbed in the Lord, and I obtain my home in the profound trance of the celestial void.

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aad purakh aparanpar piaaraa satigur alakh lakhaaeaa |
English: The True Guru has revealed to me the Primal Lord, the Infinite, my Beloved, the Unseen.

Gurbani: ਆਸਣਿ ਬੈਸਣਿ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aasan baisan thir naaraaein tith man raataa veechaare |
English: The Lord's posture and His seat are permanent; my mind is absorbed in reflective contemplation upon Him.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਅਨਹਦ ਰੁਣ ਝੁਣਕਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak naam rate bairaagee anahad run jhunakaare |1|
English: O Nanak, the detached ones are imbued with His Name, the unstruck melody, and the celestial vibrations. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤਿਤੁ ਅਗਮ ਤਿਤੁ ਅਗਮ ਪੁਰੇ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: tit agam tith agam pure kahu kit bidh jaaeeai raam |
English: Tell me, how can I reach that unreachable, that unreachable city?

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੋ ਸਾਰਿ ਗੁਣਾ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sach sanjamo saar gunaa gurasabad kamaaeeai raam |
English: By practicing truthfulness and self-restraint, by contemplating His Glorious Virtues, and living the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: sach sabad kamaaeeai nij ghar jaaeeai paaeeai gunee nidhaanaa |
English: Practicing the True Word of the Shabad, one comes to the home of his own inner being, and obtains the treasure of virtue.

Gurbani: ਤਿਤੁ ਸਾਖਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਪਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਡਾਲੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਪਰਧਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: tit saakhaa mool pat nahee ddaalee sir sabhanaa paradhaanaa |
English: He has no stems, roots, leaves or branches, but He is the Supreme Lord over the heads of all.

Gurbani: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਜਮ ਥਾਕੀ ਹਠਿ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: jap tap kar kar sanjam thaakee hatth nigreh nahee paaeeai |
English: Practicing intensive meditation, chanting and self-discipline, people have grown weary; stubbornly practicing these rituals, they still have not found Him.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak sehaj mile jagajeevan satigur boojh bujhaaeeai |2|
English: O Nanak, through spiritual wisdom, the Lord, the Life of the world, is met; the True Guru imparts this understanding. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੋ ਰਤਨਾਗਰੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਰਤਨ ਘਣੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: gur saagaro ratanaagar tith ratan ghanere raam |
English: The Guru is the ocean, the mountain of jewels, overflowing with jewels.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਮਜਨੋ ਸਪਤ ਸਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: kar majano sapat sare man niramal mere raam |
English: Take your bath in the seven seas, O my mind, and become pure.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਲਿ ਨੑਾਏ ਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਏ ਪੰਚ ਮਿਲੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: niramal jal naae jaa prabh bhaae panch mile veechaare |
English: One bathes in the water of purity when it is pleasing to God, and obtains the five virtues by reflective meditation.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰੋਧੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਤਜਿ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kaam karodh kapatt bikhiaa taj sach naam ur dhaare |
English: Renouncing sexual desire, anger, deceit and corruption, he enshrines the True Name in his heart.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਲੋਭ ਲਹਰਿ ਲਬ ਥਾਕੇ ਪਾਏ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: haumai lobh lehar lab thaake paae deen deaalaa |
English: When the waves of ego, greed and avarice subside, he finds the Lord Master, Merciful to the meek.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak gur samaan teerath nahee koee saache gur gopaalaa |3|
English: O Nanak, there is no place of pilgrimage comparable to the Guru; the True Guru is the Lord of the world. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਬਨੁ ਬਨੋ ਦੇਖਿ ਰਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਬਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: hau ban bano dekh rahee trin dekh sabaaeaa raam |
English: I have searched the jungles and forests, and looked upon all the fields.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੋ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: tribhavano tujheh keea sabh jagat sabaaeaa raam |
English: You created the three worlds, the entire universe, everything.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੀਆ ਤੂੰ ਥਿਰੁ ਥੀਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: teraa sabh keea toon thir theea tudh samaan ko naahee |
English: You created everything; You alone are permanent. Nothing is equal to You.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: toon daataa sabh jaachik tere tudh bin kis saalaahee |
English: You are the Giver - all are Your beggars; without You, who should we praise?

Gurbani: ਅਣਮੰਗਿਆ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਦਾਤੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: anamangiaa daan deejai daate teree bhagat bhare bhanddaaraa |
English: You bestow Your gifts, even when we do not ask for them, O Great Giver; devotion to You is a treasure over-flowing.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: raam naam bin mukat na hoee naanak kahai veechaaraa |4|2|
English: Without the Lord's Name, there is no liberation; so says Nanak, the meek. ||4||2||

[Ang 437 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: meraa mano meraa man raataa raam piaare raam |
English: My mind, my mind is attuned to the Love of my Beloved Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੋ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੋ ਧਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sach saahibo aad purakh aparanparo dhaare raam |
English: The True Lord Master, the Primal Being, the Infinite One, is the Support of the earth.

Gurbani: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਧਾਨੋ ॥
Transliteration: agam agochar apar apaaraa paarabraham paradhaano |
English: He is unfathomable, unapproachable, infinite and incomparable. He is the Supreme Lord God, the Lord above all.

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਅਵਰੁ ਝੂਠਾ ਸਭੁ ਮਾਨੋ ॥
Transliteration: aad jugaadee hai bhee hosee avar jhootthaa sabh maano |
English: He is the Lord, from the beginning, throughout the ages, now and forevermore; know that all else is false.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: karam dharam kee saar na jaanai surat mukat kiau paaeeai |
English: If one does not appreciate the value of good deeds and Dharmic faith, how can one obtain clarity of consciousness and liberation?

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh sabad pachhaanai ahinis naam dhiaaeeai |1|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh realizes the Word of the Shabad; night and day, he meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: meraa mano meraa man maaniaa naam sakhaaee raam |
English: My mind, my mind has come to accept, that the Naam is our only Friend.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: haumai mamataa maaeaa sang na jaaee raam |
English: Egotism, worldly attachment, and the lures of Maya shall not go with you.

Gurbani: ਮਾਤਾ ਪਿਤ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਤ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਸੰਪੈ ਨਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: maataa pit bhaaee sut chaturaaee sang na sanpai naare |
English: Mother, father, famliy, children, cleverness, property and spouses - none of these shall go with you.

Gurbani: ਸਾਇਰ ਕੀ ਪੁਤ੍ਰੀ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਚਰਣ ਤਲੈ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: saaeir kee putree parahar tiaagee charan talai veechaare |
English: I have renounced Maya, the daughter of the ocean; reflecting upon reality, I have trampled it under my feet.

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਇਕੁ ਚਲਤੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aad purakh ik chalat dikhaaeaa jeh dekhaa teh soee |
English: The Primal Lord has revealed this wondrous show; wherever I look, there I see Him.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਛੋਡਉ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak har kee bhagat na chhoddau sahaje hoe su hoee |2|
English: O Nanak, I shall not forsake the Lord's devotional worship; in the natural course, what shall be, shall be. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: meraa mano meraa man niramal saach samaale raam |
English: My mind, my mind has become immaculately pure, contemplating the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਵਗਣ ਮੇਟਿ ਚਲੇ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗਮ ਨਾਲੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: avagan mett chale gun sangam naale raam |
English: I have dispelled my vices, and now I walk in the company of the virtuous.

Gurbani: ਅਵਗਣ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: avagan parahar karanee saaree dar sachai sachiaaro |
English: Discarding my vices, I do good deeds, and in the True Court, I am judged as true.

Gurbani: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਵਣੁ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: aavan jaavan tthaak rahaae guramukh tat veechaaro |
English: My coming and going has come to an end; as Gurmukh, I reflect upon the nature of reality.

Gurbani: ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੀਤੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਸਖਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: saajan meet sujaan sakhaa toon sach milai vaddiaaee |
English: O my Dear Friend, You are my all-knowing companion; grant me the glory of Your True Name.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਐਸੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak naam ratan paragaasiaa aisee guramat paaee |3|
English: O Nanak, the jewel of the Naam has been revealed to me; such are the Teachings I have received from the Guru. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਅੰਜਨੋ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਸਾਰਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sach anjano anjan saar niranjan raataa raam |
English: I have carefully applied the healing ointment to my eyes, and I am attuned to the Immaculate Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: man tan rav rahiaa jagajeevano daataa raam |
English: He is permeating my mind and body, the Life of the world, the Lord, the Great Giver.

Gurbani: ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮੇਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jagajeevan daataa har man raataa sehaj milai melaaeaa |
English: My mind is imbued with the Lord, the Great Giver, the Life of the world; I have merged and blended with Him, with intuitive ease.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਸਭਾ ਸੰਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: saadh sabhaa santaa kee sangat nadar prabhoo sukh paaeaa |
English: In the Company of the Holy, and the Saints' Society, by God's Grace, peace is obtained.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਚੂਕੇ ਮੋਹ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: har kee bhagat rate bairaagee chooke moh piaasaa |
English: The renunciates remain absorbed in devotional worship to the Lord; they are rid of emotional attachment and desire.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਤੀਣੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਦਾਸ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak haumai maar pateene virale daas udaasaa |4|3|
English: O Nanak, how rare is that unattached servant, who conquers his ego, and remains pleased with the Lord. ||4||3||

[Ang 438 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: raag aasaa mahalaa 1 chhant ghar 2 |
English: Raag Aasaa, First Mehl, Chhant, Second House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ਜਿਥੈ ਹਉ ਜਾਈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: toon sabhanee thaaee jithai hau jaaee saachaa sirajanahaar jeeo |
English: You are everywhere, wherever I go, O True Creator Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਸਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: sabhanaa kaa daataa karam bidhaataa dookh bisaaranahaar jeeo |
English: You are the Giver of all, the Architect of Destiny, the Dispeller of distress.

Gurbani: ਦੂਖ ਬਿਸਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: dookh bisaaranahaar suaamee keetaa jaa kaa hovai |
English: The Lord Master is the Dispeller of distress; all that happens is by His doing.

Gurbani: ਕੋਟ ਕੋਟੰਤਰ ਪਾਪਾ ਕੇਰੇ ਏਕ ਘੜੀ ਮਹਿ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: kott kottantar paapaa kere ek gharree meh khovai |
English: Millions upon millions of sins, He destroys in an instant.

Gurbani: ਹੰਸ ਸਿ ਹੰਸਾ ਬਗ ਸਿ ਬਗਾ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: hans si hansaa bag si bagaa ghatt ghatt kare beechaar jeeo |
English: He calls a swan a swan, and a crane a crane; He contemplates each and every heart.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ਜਿਥੈ ਹਉ ਜਾਈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: toon sabhanee thaaee jithai hau jaaee saachaa sirajanahaar jeeo |1|
English: You are everywhere, wherever I go, O True Creator Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: jina ik man dhiaaeaa tina sukh paaeaa te virale sansaar jeeo |
English: Those who meditate on Him single-mindedly obtain peace; how rare are they in this world.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਹਾਰਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: tin jam nerr na aavai gurasabad kamaavai kabahu na aaveh haar jeeo |
English: The Messenger of Death does not draw near those who live the Guru's Teachings; they never return defeated.

Gurbani: ਤੇ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਹਾਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਹਿ ਤਿਨੑ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: te kabahu na haareh har har gun saareh tina jam nerr na aavai |
English: Those who appreciate the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, never suffer defeat; the Messenger of Death does not even approach them.

Gurbani: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਕਾ ਚੂਕਾ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jaman maran tinaa kaa chookaa jo har laage paavai |
English: Birth and death are ended for those who are attached to the feet of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: guramat har ras har fal paaeaa har har naam ur dhaar jeeo |
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, they obtain the sublime essence of the Lord, and the fruit of the Lord; they enshrine the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in their hearts.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jina ik man dhiaaeaa tina sukh paaeaa te virale sansaar jeeo |2|
