English: Those who meditate on Him single-mindedly obtain peace; how rare are they in this world. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਸੈ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: jin jagat upaaeaa dhandhai laaeaa tisai vittahu kurabaan jeeo |
English: He who created the world and assigned all to their tasks - unto Him I am a sacrifice.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੀਜੈ ਲਾਹਾ ਲੀਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: taa kee sev kareejai laahaa leejai har daragah paaeeai maan jeeo |
English: So serve Him, and gather profit, and you shall obtain honor in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੁ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: har daragah maan soee jan paavai jo nar ek pachhaanai |
English: That humble being, who recognizes the One Lord alone, obtains honor in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: ohu nav nidh paavai guramat har dhiaavai nit har gun aakh vakhaanai |
English: One who meditates on the Lord, through the Guru's Teachings, obtains the nine treasures; he chants and repeats continually the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਲੀਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਊਤਮੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: ahinis naam tisai kaa leejai har aootam purakh paradhaan jeeo |
English: Day and night, take the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the most sublime Primal Being.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ ਹਉ ਤਿਸੈ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jin jagat upaaeaa dhandhai laaeaa hau tisai vittahu kurabaan jeeo |3|
English: The One who created the world and assigned all to their tasks - I am a sacrifice to Him. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਨਿ ਸਿ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਮਾਨਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਿਣਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: naam lain si soheh tin sukh fal hoveh maaneh se jin jaeh jeeo |
English: Those who chant the Naam look beautiful; they obtain the fruit of peace. Those who believe in the Name win the game of life.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਫਲ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਜੇ ਜੁਗ ਕੇਤੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: tin fal tott na aavai jaa tis bhaavai je jug kete jaeh jeeo |
English: Their blessings are not exhausted, if it pleases the Lord, even though numerous ages may pass.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਜੁਗ ਕੇਤੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਨ ਫਲ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: je jug kete jaeh suaamee tin fal tott na aavai |
English: Even though numerous ages may pass, O Lord Master, their blessings are not exhausted.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨੑ ਜਰਾ ਨ ਮਰਣਾ ਨਰਕਿ ਨ ਪਰਣਾ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: tina jaraa na maranaa narak na paranaa jo har naam dhiaavai |
English: They do not age, they do not die and fall into hell, if they meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਿ ਸੂਕਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੀੜ ਨ ਖਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har har kareh si sookeh naahee naanak peerr na khaeh jeeo |
English: Those who chant the Lord's Name, Har, Har, do not wither, O Nanak; they are not afflicted by pain.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਨਿੑ ਸਿ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਤਿਨੑ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਮਾਨਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਿਣਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧॥੪॥
Transliteration: naam laina si soheh tina sukh fal hoveh maaneh se jin jaeh jeeo |4|1|4|
English: Those who chant the Naam look beautiful; they obtain the fruit of peace. Those who believe in the Name win the game of life. ||4||1||4||

[Ang 438 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 chhant ghar 3 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl, Chhant, Third House:

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਸੁਣਿ ਹਰਣਾ ਕਾਲਿਆ ਕੀ ਵਾੜੀਐ ਰਾਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: toon sun haranaa kaaliaa kee vaarreeai raataa raam |
English: Listen, O black deer: why are you so attached to the orchard of passion?

Gurbani: ਬਿਖੁ ਫਲੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਚਾਰਿ ਦਿਨ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: bikh fal meetthaa chaar din fir hovai taataa raam |
English: The fruit of sin is sweet for only a few days, and then it grows hot and bitter.

Gurbani: ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਤਾਤਾ ਖਰਾ ਮਾਤਾ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਰਤਾਪਏ ॥
Transliteration: fir hoe taataa kharaa maataa naam bin parataape |
English: That fruit which intoxicated you has now become bitter and painful, without the Naam.

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਜੇਵ ਸਾਇਰ ਦੇਇ ਲਹਰੀ ਬਿਜੁਲ ਜਿਵੈ ਚਮਕਏ ॥
Transliteration: ohu jev saaeir dee laharee bijul jivai chamake |
English: It is temporary, like the waves on the sea, and the flash of lightning.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਬਾਝੁ ਰਾਖਾ ਕੋਇ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੋਇ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: har baajh raakhaa koe naahee soe tujheh bisaariaa |
English: Without the Lord, there is no other protector, but you have forgotten Him.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਚੇਤਿ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮਰਹਿ ਹਰਣਾ ਕਾਲਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sach kahai naanak chet re man mareh haranaa kaaliaa |1|
English: Nanak speaks the Truth. Reflect upon it, O mind; you shall die, O black deer. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਵਰਾ ਫੂਲਿ ਭਵੰਤਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: bhavaraa fool bhavantiaa dukh at bhaaree raam |
English: O bumble bee, you wander among the flowers, but terrible pain awaits you.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਛਿਆ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: mai gur poochhiaa aapanaa saachaa beechaaree raam |
English: I have asked my Guru for true understanding.

Gurbani: ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੁਝੈ ਪੂਛਿਆ ਭਵਰੁ ਬੇਲੀ ਰਾਤਓ ॥
Transliteration: beechaar satigur mujhai poochhiaa bhavar belee raato |
English: I have asked my True Guru for understanding about the bumble bee, who is so involved with the flowers of the garden.

Gurbani: ਸੂਰਜੁ ਚੜਿਆ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪੜਿਆ ਤੇਲੁ ਤਾਵਣਿ ਤਾਤਓ ॥
Transliteration: sooraj charriaa pindd parriaa tel taavan taato |
English: When the sun rises, the body will fall, and it will be cooked in hot oil.

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਮਗਿ ਬਾਧਾ ਖਾਹਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਸਬਦ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੇਤਾਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jam mag baadhaa khaeh chottaa sabad bin betaaliaa |
English: You shall be bound and beaten on the road of Death, without the Word of the Shabad, O madman.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਚੇਤਿ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮਰਹਿ ਭਵਰਾ ਕਾਲਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sach kahai naanak chet re man mareh bhavaraa kaaliaa |2|
English: Nanak speaks the Truth. Reflect upon it, O mind; you shall die, O bumble bee. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਅੜਿਆ ਪਰਦੇਸੀਆ ਕਿਤੁ ਪਵਹਿ ਜੰਜਾਲੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: mere jeearriaa paradeseea kit paveh janjaale raam |
English: O my stranger soul, why do you fall into entanglements?

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਹਿ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: saachaa saahib man vasai kee faaseh jam jaale raam |
English: The True Lord abides within your mind; why are you trapped by the noose of Death?

Gurbani: ਮਛੁਲੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੀ ਨੈਣ ਰੁੰਨੀ ਜਾਲੁ ਬਧਿਕਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: machhulee vichhunee nain runee jaal badhik paaeaa |
English: The fish leaves the water with tearful eyes, when the fisherman casts his net.

Gurbani: ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਅੰਤਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sansaar maaeaa mohu meetthaa ant bharam chukaaeaa |
English: The love of Maya is sweet to the world, but in the end, this delusion is dispelled.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਛੋਡਿ ਮਨਹੁ ਅੰਦੇਸਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat kar chit laae har siau chhodd manahu andesiaa |
English: So perform devotional worship, link your consciousness to the Lord, and dispel anxiety from your mind.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਚੇਤਿ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਜੀਅੜਿਆ ਪਰਦੇਸੀਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sach kahai naanak chet re man jeearriaa paradeseea |3|
English: Nanak speaks the Truth; focus your consciousness on the Lord, O my stranger soul. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਦੀਆ ਵਾਹ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ਮੇਲਾ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: nadeea vaah vichhuniaa melaa sanjogee raam |
English: The rivers and streams which separate may sometime be united again.

Gurbani: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਵਿਸੁ ਭਰੇ ਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੋਗੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: jug jug meetthaa vis bhare ko jaanai jogee raam |
English: In age after age, that which is sweet, is full of poison; how rare is the Yogi who understands this.

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਸਹਜਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਜਿਨਿ ਚੇਤਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: koee sehaj jaanai har pachhaanai satiguroo jin chetiaa |
English: That rare person who centers his consciousness on the True Guru, knows intuitively and realizes the Lord.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਪਚਹਿ ਮੁਗਧ ਅਚੇਤਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: bin naam har ke bharam bhoole pacheh mugadh achetiaa |
English: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the thoughtless fools wander in doubt, and are ruined.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੇ ਅੰਤਿ ਧਾਹੀ ਰੁੰਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: har naam bhagat na ridai saachaa se ant dhaahee runiaa |
English: Those whose hearts are not touched by devotional worship and the Name of the True Lord, shall weep and wail loudly in the end.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਮੇਲਿ ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੫॥
Transliteration: sach kahai naanak sabad saachai mel chiree vichhuniaa |4|1|5|
English: Nanak speaks the Truth; through the True Word of the Shabad, those long separated from the Lord, are united once again. ||4||1||5||

[Ang 439 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 chhant ghar 1 |
English: Aasaa, Third Mehl, Chhant, First House:

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਘਰੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: ham ghare saachaa sohilaa saachai sabad suhaaeaa raam |
English: Within my home, the true wedding songs of rejoicing are sung; my home is adorned with the True Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਧਨ ਪਿਰ ਮੇਲੁ ਭਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: dhan pir mel bheaa prabh aap milaaeaa raam |
English: The soul-bride has met her Husband Lord; God Himself has consummated this union.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਸਚੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: prabh aap milaaeaa sach man vasaaeaa kaaman sahaje maatee |
English: God Himself has consummated this union; the soul-bride enshrines Truth within her mind, intoxicated with peaceful poise.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੀ ਸਚਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ਸਦਾ ਰਾਵੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur sabad seegaaree sach savaaree sadaa raave rang raatee |
English: Embellished with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and beautified with Truth, she enjoys her Beloved forever, imbued with His Love.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਏ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aap gavaae har var paae taa har ras man vasaaeaa |
English: Eradicating her ego, she obtains her Husband Lord, and then, the sublime essence of the Lord dwells within her mind.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ਸਫਲਿਉ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak gur sabad savaaree safaliau janam sabaaeaa |1|
English: Says Nanak, fruitful and prosperous is her entire life; she is embellished with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੜੈ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੀ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: doojarrai kaaman bharam bhulee har var na paae raam |
English: The soul-bride who has been led astray by duality and doubt, does not attain her Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: kaaman gun naahee birathaa janam gavaae raam |
English: That soul-bride has no virtue, and she wastes her life in vain.

Gurbani: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਇਆਣੀ ਅਉਗਣਵੰਤੀ ਝੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: birathaa janam gavaae manamukh eaanee aauganavantee jhoore |
English: The self-willed, ignorant and disgraceful manmukh wastes her life in vain, and in the end, she comes to grief.

Gurbani: ਆਪਣਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਦੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aapanaa satigur sev sadaa sukh paaeaa taa pir miliaa hadoore |
English: But when she serves her True Guru, she obtains peace, and then she meets her Husband Lord, face to face.

Gurbani: ਦੇਖਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਵਿਗਸੀ ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਸਰਸੀ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: dekh pir vigasee andarahu sarasee sachai sabad subhaae |
English: Beholding her Husband Lord, she blossoms forth; her heart is delighted, and she is beautified by the True Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak vin naavai kaaman bharam bhulaanee mil preetam sukh paae |2|
English: O Nanak, without the Name, the soul-bride wanders around, deluded by doubt. Meeting her Beloved, she obtains peace. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪਿਰੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: pir sang kaaman jaaniaa gur mel milaaee raam |
English: The soul-bride knows that her Husband Lord is with her; the Guru unites her in this union.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਤਪਤਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: antar sabad milee sahaje tapat bujhaaee raam |
English: Within her heart, she is merged with the Shabad, and the fire of her desire is easily extinguished.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਤਪਤਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਆਈ ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabad tapat bujhaaee antar saant aaee sahaje har ras chaakhiaa |
English: The Shabad has quenched the fire of desire, and within her heart, peace and tranquility have come; she tastes the Lord's essence with intuitive ease.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਅਪਣੇ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੇ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਖਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: mil preetam apane sadaa rang maane sachai sabad subhaakhiaa |
English: Meeting her Beloved, she enjoys His Love continually, and her speech rings with the True Shabad.

Gurbani: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮੋਨੀ ਥਾਕੇ ਭੇਖੀ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: parr parr panddit monee thaake bhekhee mukat na paaee |
English: Reading and studying continually, the Pandits, the religious scholars, and the silent sages have grown weary; wearing religious robes, liberation is not obtained.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਜਗੁ ਬਉਰਾਨਾ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak bin bhagatee jag bauraanaa sachai sabad milaaee |3|
English: O Nanak, without devotional worship, the world has gone insane; through the True Word of the Shabad, one meets the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮੇਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: saa dhan man anad bheaa har jeeo mel piaare raam |
English: Bliss permeates the mind of the soul-bride, who meets her Beloved Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰਸਿ ਰਸੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਪਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: saa dhan har kai ras rasee gur kai sabad apaare raam |
English: The soul-bride is enraptured with the sublime essence of the Lord, through the incomparable Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਅਪਾਰੇ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੇ ॥
Transliteration: sabad apaare mile piaare sadaa gun saare man vase |
English: Through the incomparable Word of the Guru's Shabad, she meets her Beloved; she continually contemplates and enshrines His Glorious Virtues in her mind.

Gurbani: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਜਾ ਪਿਰਿ ਰਾਵੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਅਵਗਣ ਨਸੇ ॥
Transliteration: sej suhaavee jaa pir raavee mil preetam avagan nase |
English: Her bed was adorned when she enjoyed her Husband Lord; meeting with her Beloved, her demerits were erased.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸੋਹਿਲੜਾ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jit ghar naam har sadaa dhiaaeeai sohilarraa jug chaare |
English: That house, within which the Lord's Name is continually meditated upon, resounds with the wedding songs of rejoicing, throughout the four ages.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਅਨਦੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥੬॥
Transliteration: naanak naam rate sadaa anad hai har miliaa kaaraj saare |4|1|6|
English: O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, we are in bliss forever; meeting the Lord, our affairs are resolved. ||4||1||6||

[Ang 440 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 chhant ghar 3 |
English: Aasaa, Third Mehl, Chhant, Third House:

Gurbani: ਸਾਜਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਸਹ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇਹੋ ॥
Transliteration: saajan mere preetamahu tum seh kee bhagat kareho |
English: O my beloved friend, dedicate yourself to the devotional worship of your Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਲੇਹੋ ॥
Transliteration: gur sevahu sadaa aapanaa naam padaarath leho |
English: Serve your Guru constantly, and obtain the wealth of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਸਹੈ ਕੇਰੀ ਜੋ ਸਹ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat karahu tum sahai keree jo seh piaare bhaave |
English: Dedicate yourself to the worship of your Husband Lord; this is pleasing to your Beloved Husband.

Gurbani: ਆਪਣਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਤੁਮ ਕਰਹੁ ਤਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਸਹ ਖੁਸੀ ਨ ਆਵਏ ॥
Transliteration: aapanaa bhaanaa tum karahu taa fir seh khusee na aave |
English: If you walk in accordance with your own will, then your Husband Lord will not be pleased with you.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਵ ਇਹੁ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਬਿਖੜਾ ਗੁਰ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਕੋ ਪਾਵਏ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat bhaav ihu maarag bikharraa gur duaarai ko paave |
English: This path of loving devotional worship is very difficult; how rare are those who find it, through the Gurdwara, the Guru's Gate.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kahai naanak jis kare kirapaa so har bhagatee chit laave |1|
English: Says Nanak, that one, upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, links his consciousness to the worship of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਬੈਰਾਗੀਆ ਤੂੰ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: mere man bairaageea toon bairaag kar kis dikhaaveh |
English: O my detached mind, unto whom do you show your detachment?

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਤਿਨੑ ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: har sohilaa tina sad sadaa jo har gun gaaveh |
English: Those who sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord live in the joy of the Lord, forever and ever.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਤੂੰ ਛੋਡਿ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣਏ ॥
Transliteration: kar bairaag toon chhodd paakhandd so sahu sabh kichh jaane |
English: So become detached, and renounce hypocrisy; Your Husband Lord knows everything.

Gurbani: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਏ ॥
Transliteration: jal thal maheeal eko soee guramukh hukam pachhaane |
English: The One Lord is pervading the water, the land and the sky; the Gurmukh realizes the Command of His Will.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹਰੀ ਕੇਰਾ ਸੋਈ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਏ ॥
Transliteration: jin hukam pachhaataa haree keraa soee sarab sukh paave |
English: One who realizes the Lord's Command, obtains all peace and comforts.

Gurbani: ਇਵ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੋ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: eiv kahai naanak so bairaagee anadin har liv laave |2|
English: Thus says Nanak: such a detached soul remains absorbed in the Lord's Love, day and night. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਮਨ ਤੂੰ ਧਾਵਦਾ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: jeh jeh man toon dhaavadaa teh teh har terai naale |
English: Wherever you wander, O my mind, the Lord is there with you.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਛੋਡੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: man siaanap chhoddeeai gur kaa sabad samaale |
English: Renounce your cleverness, O my mind, and reflect upon the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਾਥਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: saath terai so sahu sadaa hai ik khin har naam samaalahe |
English: Your Husband Lord is always with you, if you remember the Lord's Name, even for an instant.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਪਾਪ ਕਟੇ ਅੰਤਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਵਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: janam janam ke tere paap katte ant param pad paavahe |
English: The sins of countless incarnations shall be washed away, and in the end, you shall obtain the supreme status.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਗੰਢੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: saache naal teraa gandt laagai guramukh sadaa samaale |
English: You shall be linked to the True Lord, and as Gurmukh, remember Him forever.

Gurbani: ਇਉ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਹ ਮਨ ਤੂੰ ਧਾਵਦਾ ਤਹ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਲੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: eiau kahai naanak jeh man toon dhaavadaa teh har terai sadaa naale |3|
English: Thus says Nanak: wherever you go, O my mind, the Lord is there with you. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਥੰਮਿੑਆ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: satigur miliai dhaavat thamaa nij ghar vasiaa aae |
English: Meeting the True Guru, the wandering mind is held steady; it comes to abide in its own home.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਹਾਝੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਏ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: naam vihaajhe naam le naam rahe samaae |
English: It purchases the Naam, chants the Naam, and remains absorbed in the Naam.

Gurbani: ਧਾਵਤੁ ਥੰਮਿੑਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਦਸਵਾ ਦੁਆਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: dhaavat thamaa satigur miliai dasavaa duaar paaeaa |
English: The outgoing, wandering soul, upon meeting the True Guru, opens the Tenth Gate.

Gurbani: ਤਿਥੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਥੰਮਿੑ ਰਹਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tithai amrit bhojan sehaj dhun upajai jit sabad jagat thama rahaaeaa |
English: There, Ambrosial Nectar is food and the celestial music resounds; the world is held spell-bound by the music of the Word.

Gurbani: ਤਹ ਅਨੇਕ ਵਾਜੇ ਸਦਾ ਅਨਦੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: teh anek vaaje sadaa anad hai sache rahiaa samaae |
English: The many strains of the unstruck melody resound there, as one merges in Truth.

Gurbani: ਇਉ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਥੰਮਿੑਆ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਆਏ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: eiau kahai naanak satigur miliai dhaavat thamaa nij ghar vasiaa aae |4|
English: Thus says Nanak: by meeting the True Guru, the wandering soul becomes steady, and comes to dwell in the home of its own self. ||4||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਤੂੰ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਹੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: man toon jot saroop hai aapanaa mool pachhaan |
English: O my mind, you are the embodiment of the Divine Light - recognize your own origin.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: man har jee terai naal hai guramatee rang maan |
English: O my mind, the Dear Lord is with you; through the Guru's Teachings, enjoy His Love.

Gurbani: ਮੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਤਾਂ ਸਹੁ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਮਰਣ ਜੀਵਣ ਕੀ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: mool pachhaaneh taan sahu jaaneh maran jeevan kee sojhee hoee |
English: Acknowledge your origin, and then you shall know your Husband Lord, and so understand death and birth.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਤਾਂ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee eko jaaneh taan doojaa bhaau na hoee |
English: By Guru's Grace, know the One; then, you shall not love any other.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਆਈ ਵਜੀ ਵਧਾਈ ਤਾ ਹੋਆ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: man saant aaee vajee vadhaaee taa hoaa paravaan |
English: Peace comes to the mind, and gladness resounds; then, you shall be acclaimed.

Gurbani: ਇਉ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਨ ਤੂੰ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਹੈ ਅਪਣਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: eiau kahai naanak man toon jot saroop hai apanaa mool pachhaan |5|
English: Thus says Nanak: O my mind, you are the very image of the Luminous Lord; recognize the true origin of your self. ||5||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਤੂੰ ਗਾਰਬਿ ਅਟਿਆ ਗਾਰਬਿ ਲਦਿਆ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: man toon gaarab attiaa gaarab ladiaa jaeh |
English: O mind, you are so full of pride; loaded with pride, you shall depart.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਭਵਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohanee mohiaa fir fir joonee bhavaeh |
English: The fascinating Maya has fascinated you, over and over again, and lured you into reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਗਾਰਬਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਜਾਹਿ ਮੁਗਧ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: gaarab laagaa jaeh mugadh man ant geaa pachhutaavahe |
English: Clinging to pride, you shall depart, O foolish mind, and in the end, you shall regret and repent.

Gurbani: ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਲਗਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: ahankaar tisanaa rog lagaa birathaa janam gavaavahe |
English: You are afflicted with the diseases of ego and desire, and you are wasting your life away in vain.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਗੈ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh mugadh cheteh naahee agai geaa pachhutaavahe |
English: The foolish self-willed manmukh does not remember the Lord, and shall regret and repent hereafter.

Gurbani: ਇਉ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਨ ਤੂੰ ਗਾਰਬਿ ਅਟਿਆ ਗਾਰਬਿ ਲਦਿਆ ਜਾਵਹੇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: eiau kahai naanak man toon gaarab attiaa gaarab ladiaa jaavahe |6|
English: Thus says Nanak: O mind, you are full of pride; loaded with pride, you shall depart. ||6||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਤੂੰ ਮਤ ਮਾਣੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਿ ਹਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਮਾਣਾ ਹੋਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: man toon mat maan kareh ji hau kichh jaanadaa guramukh nimaanaa hohu |
English: O mind, don't be so proud of yourself, as if you know it all; the Gurmukh is humble and modest.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਹਉ ਬੁਧਿ ਹੈ ਸਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਲੁ ਖੋਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: antar agiaan hau budh hai sach sabad mal khohu |
English: Within the intellect are ignorance and ego; through the True Word of the Shabad, this filth is washed off.

Gurbani: ਹੋਹੁ ਨਿਮਾਣਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਅਗੈ ਮਤ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੁ ਲਖਾਵਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: hohu nimaanaa satiguroo agai mat kichh aap lakhaavahe |
English: So be humble, and surrender to the True Guru; do not attach your identity to your ego.

Gurbani: ਆਪਣੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਜਲਿਆ ਮਤ ਤੂੰ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਵਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: aapanai ahankaar jagat jaliaa mat toon aapanaa aap gavaavahe |
English: The world is consumed by ego and self-identity; see this, lest you lose your own self as well.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਾਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: satigur kai bhaanai kareh kaar satigur kai bhaanai laag rahu |
English: Make yourself follow the Sweet Will of the True Guru; remain attached to His Sweet Will.

Gurbani: ਇਉ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਪੁ ਛਡਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਨ ਨਿਮਾਣਾ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੁ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: eiau kahai naanak aap chhadd sukh paaveh man nimaanaa hoe rahu |7|
English: Thus says Nanak: renounce your ego and self-conceit, and obtain peace; let your mind abide in humility. ||7||

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: dhan su velaa jit mai satigur miliaa so sahu chit aaeaa |
English: Blessed is that time, when I met the True Guru, and my Husband Lord came into my consciousness.

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਭਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: mahaa anand sehaj bheaa man tan sukh paaeaa |
English: I became so very blissful, and my mind and body found such a natural peace.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਇਆ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ਅਵਗਣ ਸਭਿ ਵਿਸਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: so sahu chit aaeaa man vasaaeaa avagan sabh visaare |
English: My Husband Lord came into my consciousness; I enshrined Him within my mind, and I renounced all vice.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਟ ਹੋਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jaa tis bhaanaa gun paragatt hoe satigur aap savaare |
English: When it pleased Him, virtues appeared in me, and the True Guru Himself adorned me.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੋਏ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜਿਆ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਭਾਉ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: se jan paravaan hoe jinaee ik naam dirriaa duteea bhaau chukaaeaa |
English: Those humble beings become acceptable, who cling to the One Name and renounce the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਇਉ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: eiau kahai naanak dhan su velaa jit mai satigur miliaa so sahu chit aaeaa |8|
English: Thus says Nanak: blessed is the time when I met the True Guru, and my Husband Lord came into my consciousness. ||8||

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਜੰਤ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੇ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: eik jant bharam bhule tin seh aap bhulaae |
English: Some people wander around, deluded by doubt; their Husband Lord Himself has misled them.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: doojai bhaae fireh haumai karam kamaae |
English: They wander around in the love of duality, and they do their deeds in ego.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨਿ ਸਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਕੁਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: tin seh aap bhulaae kumaarag paae tin kaa kichh na vasaaee |
English: Their Husband Lord Himself has misled them, and put them on the path of evil. Nothing lies in their power.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਅਵਗਤਿ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹ ਰਚਨ ਰਚਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: tin kee gat avagat toonhai jaaneh jin ih rachan rachaaee |
English: You alone know their ups and downs, You, who created the creation.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਖਰਾ ਭਾਰਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: hukam teraa kharaa bhaaraa guramukh kisai bujhaae |
English: The Command of Your Will is very strict; how rare is the Gurmukh who understands.

Gurbani: ਇਉ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਿਆ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: eiau kahai naanak kiaa jant vichaare jaa tudh bharam bhulaae |9|
English: Thus says Nanak: what can the poor creatures do, when You mislead them into doubt? ||9||

Gurbani: ਸਚੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਸਚੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: sache mere saahibaa sachee teree vaddiaaee |
English: O My True Lord Master, True is Your glorious greatness.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: toon paarabraham beant suaamee teree kudarat kehan na jaaee |
English: You are the Supreme Lord God, the Infinite Lord and Master. Your creative power cannot be described.

Gurbani: ਸਚੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: sachee teree vaddiaaee jaa kau tudh man vasaaee sadaa tere gun gaavahe |
English: True is Your glorious greatness; when You enshrine it within the mind, one sings Your Glorious Praises forever.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: tere gun gaaveh jaa tudh bhaaveh sache siau chit laavahe |
English: He sings Your Glorious Praises, when it is pleasing to You, O True Lord; he centers his consciousness on You.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਸੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jis no toon aape meleh su guramukh rahai samaaee |
English: One whom You unite with Yourself, as Gurmukh, remains absorbed in You.

Gurbani: ਇਉ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਚੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਸਚੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧੦॥੨॥੭॥੫॥੨॥੭॥
Transliteration: eiau kahai naanak sache mere saahibaa sachee teree vaddiaaee |10|2|7|5|2|7|
English: Thus says Nanak: O my True Lord Master, True is Your Glorious Greatness. ||10||2||7||5||2||7||

[Ang 442 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raag aasaa chhant mahalaa 4 ghar 1 |
English: Raag Aasaa, Chhant, Fourth Mehl, First House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਨੋ ਮੈ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: jeevano mai jeevan paaeaa guramukh bhaae raam |
English: Life - I have found real life, as Gurmukh, through His Love.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: har naamo har naam devai merai praan vasaae raam |
English: The Lord's Name - He has given me the Lord's Name, and enshrined it within my breath of life.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam merai praan vasaae sabh sansaa dookh gavaaeaa |
English: He has enshrined the Name of the Lord, Har, Har within my breath of lfe, and all my doubts and sorrows have departed.

Gurbani: ਅਦਿਸਟੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: adisatt agochar gur bachan dhiaaeaa pavitr param pad paaeaa |
English: I have meditated on the invisible and unapproachable Lord, through the Guru's Word, and I have obtained the pure, supreme status.

Gurbani: ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਵਾਜਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਵਾਜੇ ਗਾਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: anahad dhun vaajeh nit vaaje gaaee satigur baanee |
English: The unstruck melody resounds, and the instruments ever vibrate, singing the Bani of the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦਾਤੈ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak daat karee prabh daatai jotee jot samaanee |1|
English: O Nanak, God the Great Giver has given me a gift; He has blended my light into the Light. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਏ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: manamukhaa manamukh mue meree kar maaeaa raam |
English: The self-willed manmukhs die in their self-willed stubbornness, declaring that the wealth of Maya is theirs.

Gurbani: ਖਿਨੁ ਆਵੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਜਾਵੈ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਮੜੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: khin aavai khin jaavai duragandh marrai chit laaeaa raam |
English: They attach their consciousness to the foul-smelling pile of filth, which comes for a moment, and departs in an instant.

Gurbani: ਲਾਇਆ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਮੜੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਜਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: laaeaa duragandh marrai chit laagaa jiau rang kasunbh dikhaaeaa |
English: They attach their consciousness to the foul-smelling pile of filth, which is transitory, like the fading color of the safflower.

Gurbani: ਖਿਨੁ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਛਮਿ ਛਾਏ ਜਿਉ ਚਕੁ ਕੁਮਿੑਆਰਿ ਭਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: khin poorab khin pachham chhaae jiau chak kumaaar bhavaaeaa |
English: One moment, they are facing east, and the next instant, they are facing west; they continue spinning around, like the potter's wheel.

Gurbani: ਦੁਖੁ ਖਾਵਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੰਚਹਿ ਭੋਗਹਿ ਦੁਖ ਕੀ ਬਿਰਧਿ ਵਧਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: dukh khaaveh dukh sancheh bhogeh dukh kee biradh vadhaaee |
English: In sorrow, they eat, and in sorrow, they gather things and try to enjoy them, but they only increase their stores of sorrow.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਤਰੀਐ ਜਾ ਆਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak bikham suhelaa tareeai jaa aavai gur saranaaee |2|
English: O Nanak, one easily crosses over the terrifying world-ocean, when he comes to the Sanctuary of the Guru. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਨੀਕਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: meraa tthaakuro tthaakur neekaa agam athaahaa raam |
English: My Lord, my Lord Master is sublime, unapproachable and unfathomable.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪੂਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਜੀ ਚਾਹੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: har poojee har poojee chaahee mere satigur saahaa raam |
English: The wealth of the Lord - I seek the wealth of the Lord, from my True Guru, the Divine Banker.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪੂਜੀ ਚਾਹੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਹੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: har poojee chaahee naam bisaahee gun gaavai gun bhaavai |
English: I seek the wealth of the Lord, to purchase the Naam; I sing and love the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨੀਦ ਭੂਖ ਸਭ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਸੁੰਨੇ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: need bhookh sabh parahar tiaagee sune sun samaavai |
English: I have totally renounced sleep and hunger, and through deep meditation, I am absorbed into the Absolute Lord.

Gurbani: ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ਇਕ ਭਾਤੀ ਆਵਹਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈ ਜਾਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: vanajaare ik bhaatee aaveh laahaa har naam lai jaahe |
English: The traders of one kind come and take away the Name of the Lord as their profit.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak man tan arap gur aagai jis praapat so paae |3|
English: O Nanak, dedicate your mind and body to the Guru; one who is so destined, attains it. ||3||

Gurbani: ਰਤਨਾ ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਬਹੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਭਰਿਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: ratanaa ratan padaarath bahu saagar bhariaa raam |
English: The great ocean is full of the treasures of jewels upon jewels.

Gurbani: ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਲਾਗੇ ਤਿਨੑ ਹਥਿ ਚੜਿਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: baanee gurabaanee laage tina hath charriaa raam |
English: Those who are committed to the Word of the Guru's Bani, see them come into their hands.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਲਾਗੇ ਤਿਨੑ ਹਥਿ ਚੜਿਆ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: gurabaanee laage tina hath charriaa niramolak ratan apaaraa |
English: This priceless, incomparable jewel comes into the hands of those who are committed to the Word of the Guru's Bani.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਤੋਲਕੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam atolak paaeaa teree bhagat bhare bhanddaaraa |
English: They obtain the immeasurable Name of the Lord, Har, Har; their treasure is overflowing with devotional worship.

Gurbani: ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਵਿਰੋਲਿ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹਮ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਇਕ ਵਸਤੁ ਅਨੂਪ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: samund virol sareer ham dekhiaa ik vasat anoop dikhaaee |
English: I have churned the ocean of the body, and I have seen the incomparable thing come into view.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਗੋੁਵਿੰਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੮॥
Transliteration: gur govind guovind guroo hai naanak bhed na bhaaee |4|1|8|
English: The Guru is God, and God is the Guru, O Nanak; there is no difference between the two, O Siblings of Destiny. ||4||1||8||

[Ang 442 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 |
English: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਝਿਮਿ ਝਿਮੇ ਝਿਮਿ ਝਿਮਿ ਵਰਸੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: jhim jhime jhim jhim varasai amrit dhaaraa raam |
English: Slowly, slowly, slowly, very slowly, the drops of Ambrosial Nectar trickle down.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਦਰੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: guramukhe guramukh nadaree raam piaaraa raam |
English: As Gurmukh, the Gurmukh beholds the Lord, the Beloved Lord.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਜਗਤ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam piaaraa jagat nisataaraa raam naam vaddiaaee |
English: The Name of the Lord, the Emancipator of the world, is dear to him; the Name of the Lord is his glory.

Gurbani: ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਲਘਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kalijug raam naam bohithaa guramukh paar laghaaee |
English: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Lord's Name is the boat, which carries the Gurmukh across.

Gurbani: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: halat palat raam naam suhele guramukh karanee saaree |
English: This world, and the world hereafter, are adorned with the Lord's Name; the Gurmukh's lifestyle is the most excellent.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਤਿ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak daat deaa kar devai raam naam nisataaree |1|
English: O Nanak, bestowing His kindness, the Lord gives the gift of His emancipating Name. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮੋ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿਆ ਦੁਖ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਨਾਸ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: raamo raam naam japiaa dukh kilavikh naas gavaaeaa raam |
English: I chant the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, which destroys my sorrows and erases my sins.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਚੈ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਚੈ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਮੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: gur parachai gur parachai dhiaaeaa mai hiradai raam ravaaeaa raam |
English: Associating with the Guru, associating with the Guru, I practice meditation; I have enshrined the Lord within my heart.

Gurbani: ਰਵਿਆ ਰਾਮੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਜਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: raviaa raam hiradai param gat paaee jaa gur saranaaee aae |
English: I enshrined the Lord within my heart, and obtained the supreme status, when I came to the Sanctuary of the Guru.

Gurbani: ਲੋਭ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਨਾਵ ਡੁਬਦੀ ਨਿਕਲੀ ਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: lobh vikaar naav ddubadee nikalee jaa satigur naam dirraae |
English: My boat was sinking under the weight of greed and corruption, but it was uplifted when the True Guru implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਦਾਨੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੀਆ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jeea daan gur poorai deea raam naam chit laae |
English: The Perfect Guru has given me the gift of spiritual life, and I center my consciousness on the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aap kripaal kripaa kar devai naanak gur saranaae |2|
English: The Merciful Lord Himself has mercifully given this gift to me; O Nanak, I take to the Sanctuary of the Guru. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬਾਣੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੁਣੀ ਸਿਧਿ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਹਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: baanee raam naam sunee sidh kaaraj sabh suhaae raam |
English: Hearing the Bani of the Lord's Name, all my affairs were brought to perfection and embellished.

Gurbani: ਰੋਮੇ ਰੋਮਿ ਰੋਮਿ ਰੋਮੇ ਮੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: rome rom rom rome mai guramukh raam dhiaae raam |
English: With each and every hair, with each and every hair, as Gurmukh, I meditate on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹੋਇ ਆਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਕਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam dhiaae pavit hoe aae tis roop na rekhiaa kaaee |
English: I meditate on the Lord's Name, and become pure; He has no form or shape.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮੋ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਭ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੂਖ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: raamo raam raviaa ghatt antar sabh trisanaa bhookh gavaaee |
English: The Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, is permeating my heart deep within, and all of my desire and hunger has disappeared.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਹੋਆ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: man tan seetal seegaar sabh hoaa guramat raam pragaasaa |
English: My mind and body are totally adorned with peace and tranquility; through the Guru's Teachings, the Lord has been revealed to me.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਕੀਆ ਹਮ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak aap anugrahu keea ham daasan daasan daasaa |3|
English: The Lord Himself has shown His kind mercy to Nanak; He has made me the slave of the slaves of His slaves. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਰਾਮੋ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਸੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂੜ ਅਭਾਗੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: jinee raamo raam naam visaariaa se manamukh moorr abhaagee raam |
English: Those who forget the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, are foolish, unfortunate, self-willed manmukhs.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਅੰਤਰੇ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਲਾਗੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: tin antare mohu viaapai khin khin maaeaa laagee raam |
English: Within, they are engrossed in emotional attachment; each and every moment, Maya clings to them.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ ਮੂੜ ਭਏ ਅਭਾਗੀ ਜਿਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਹ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mal laagee moorr bhe abhaagee jin raam naam neh bhaaeaa |
English: The filth of Maya clings to them, and they become unfortunate fools - they do not love the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਅਨੇਕ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੋਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: anek karam kareh abhimaanee har raamo naam choraaeaa |
English: The egotistical and proud perform all sorts of rituals, but they shy away from the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਜਮ ਪੰਥੁ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ਕਾਲੂਖਤ ਮੋਹ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: mahaa bikham jam panth duhelaa kaalookhat moh andhiaaraa |
English: The path of Death is very arduous and painful; it is stained with the darkness of emotional attachment.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਾ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh naam dhiaaeaa taa paae mokh duaaraa |4|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh meditates on the Naam, and finds the gate of salvation. ||4||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮੋ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਰਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: raamo raam naam guroo raam guramukhe jaanai raam |
English: The Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, and the Lord Guru, are known by the Gurmukh.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਖਿਨੁ ਊਭ ਪਇਆਲੀ ਭਰਮਦਾ ਇਕਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਣੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: eihu manooaa khin aoobh peaalee bharamadaa ikat ghar aanai raam |
English: One moment, this mind is in the heavens, and the next, it is in the nether regions; the Guru brings the wandering mind back to one-pointedness.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਇਕਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਣੈ ਸਭ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: man ikat ghar aanai sabh gat mit jaanai har raamo naam rasaae |
English: When the mind returns to one-pointedness, one totally understands the value of salvation, and enjoys the subtle essence of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦ ਉਧਾਰਿ ਤਰਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jan kee paij rakhai raam naamaa prahilaad udhaar taraae |
English: The Lord's Name preserves the honor of His servant, as He preserved and emancipated Prahlaad.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮੋ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਮੋ ਰਮੁ ਊਚਾ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਤਿਆ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: raamo raam ramo ram aoochaa gun kahatiaa ant na paaeaa |
English: So repeat continually the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam; chanting His Glorious Virtues, His limit cannot be found.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਭੀਨੇ ਰਾਮੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak raam naam sun bheene raamai naam samaaeaa |5|
English: Nanak is drenched in happiness, hearing the Name of the Lord; he is merged in the Name of the Lord. ||5||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਅੰਤਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਤਿਨ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਸਭ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: jin antare raam naam vasai tin chintaa sabh gavaaeaa raam |
English: Those beings, whose minds are filled with the Lord's Name, forsake all anxiety.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਅਰਥਾ ਸਭਿ ਧਰਮ ਮਿਲੇ ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sabh arathaa sabh dharam mile man chindiaa so fal paaeaa raam |
English: They obtain all wealth, and all Dharmic faith, and the fruits of their minds' desires.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: man chindiaa fal paaeaa raam naam dhiaaeaa raam naam gun gaae |
English: They obtain the fruits of their hearts' desires, meditating on the Lord's Name, and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਬੁਧਿ ਗਈ ਸੁਧਿ ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: duramat kabudh gee sudh hoee raam naam man laae |
English: Evil-mindedness and duality depart, and their understanding is enlightened. They attach their minds to the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਹੋਆ ਜਿਤੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: safal janam sareer sabh hoaa jit raam naam paragaasiaa |
English: Their lives and bodies become totally blessed and fruitful; the Lord's Name illumines them.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਿਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: naanak har bhaj sadaa din raatee guramukh nij ghar vaasiaa |6|
English: O Nanak, by continually vibrating upon the Lord, day and night, the Gurmukhs abide in the home of the inner self. ||6||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਸਰਧਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗੀ ਤਿਨੑ ਦੂਜੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: jin saradhaa raam naam lagee tina doojai chit na laaeaa raam |
English: Those who place their faith in the Lord's Name, do not attach their consciousness to another.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਭ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: je dharatee sabh kanchan kar deejai bin naavai avar na bhaaeaa raam |
English: Even if the entire earth were to be transformed into gold, and given to them, without the Naam, they love nothing else.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅੰਤਿ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam man bhaaeaa param sukh paaeaa ant chaladiaa naal sakhaaee |
English: The Lord's Name is pleasing to their minds, and they obtain supreme peace; when they depart in the end, it shall go with them as their support.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸੰਚੀ ਨਾ ਡੂਬੈ ਨਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam dhan poonjee sanchee naa ddoobai naa jaaee |
English: I have gathered the capital, the wealth of the Lord's Name; it does not sink, and does not depart.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਤੁਲਹਾ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam is jug meh tulahaa jamakaal nerr na aavai |
English: The Lord's Name is the only true support in this age; the Messenger of Death does not draw near it.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh raam pachhaataa kar kirapaa aap milaavai |7|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs recognize the Lord; in His Mercy, He unites them with Himself. ||7||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮੋ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਤੇ ਸਤਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: raamo raam naam sate sat guramukh jaaniaa raam |
English: True, True is the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam; the Gurmukh knows the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਕੋ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਚੜਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sevako gur sevaa laagaa jin man tan arap charraaeaa raam |
English: The Lord's servant is the one who commits himself to the Guru's service, and dedicates his mind and body as an offering to Him.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿਆ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮਨਿ ਸਰਧਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਕ ਭਾਇ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: man tan arapiaa bahut man saradhiaa gur sevak bhaae milaae |
English: He dedicates his mind and body to Him, placing great faith in Him; the Guru lovingly unites His servant with Himself.

Gurbani: ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥੁ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: deenaa naath jeea kaa daataa poore gur te paae |
English: The Master of the meek, the Giver of souls, is obtained through the Perfect Guru.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੂ ਸਿਖੁ ਸਿਖੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਏਕੋ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਚਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: guroo sikh sikh guroo hai eko gur upades chalaae |
English: The Guru's Sikh, and the Sikh's Guru, are one and the same; both spread the Guru's Teachings.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਮੰਤੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦੇਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲਣੁ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥੮॥੨॥੯॥
Transliteration: raam naam mant hiradai devai naanak milan subhaae |8|2|9|
English: The Mantra of the Lord's Name is enshrined within the heart, O Nanak, and we merge with the Lord so easily. ||8||2||9||

[Ang 444 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa chhant mahalaa 4 ghar 2 |
English: Aasaa, Chhant, Fourth Mehl, Second House:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਨਾਸਨੁ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har har karataa dookh binaasan patit paavan har naam jeeo |
English: The Creator Lord, Har, Har, is the Destroyer of distress; the Name of the Lord is the Purifier of sinners.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਭਾਈ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਊਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har sevaa bhaaee param gat paaee har aootam har har kaam jeeo |
English: One who lovingly serves the Lord, obtains the supreme status. Service to the Lord, Har, Har, is more exalted than anything.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਊਤਮੁ ਕਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: har aootam kaam japeeai har naam har japeeai asathir hovai |
English: Chanting the Name of the Lord is the most exalted occupation; chanting the Name of the Lord, one becomes immortal.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੋਵੈ ਦੁਖ ਮੇਟੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: janam maran dovai dukh mette sahaje hee sukh sovai |
English: The pains of both birth and death are eradicated, and one comes to sleep in peaceful ease.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har har kirapaa dhaarahu tthaakur har japeeai aatam raam jeeo |
English: O Lord, O Lord and Master, shower Your Mercy upon me; within my mind, I chant the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਨਾਸਨੁ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har har karataa dookh binaasan patit paavan har naam jeeo |1|
English: The Creator Lord, Har, Har, is the Destroyer of distress; the Name of the Lord is the Purifier of sinners. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਊਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har naam padaarath kalijug aootam har japeeai satigur bhaae jeeo |
English: The wealth of the Lord's Name is the most exalted in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga; chant the Lord's Name according to the Way of the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਪੜੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤ ਸੁਣਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh har parreeai guramukh har suneeai har japat sunat dukh jaae jeeo |
English: As Gurmukh, read of the Lord; as Gurmukh, hear of the Lord. Chanting and listening to the Lord's Name, pain departs.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਬਿਨਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam japiaa dukh binasiaa har naam param sukh paaeaa |
English: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, pains are removed. Through the Name of the Lord, supreme peace is obtained.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬਲਿਆ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: satigur giaan baliaa ghatt chaanan agiaan andher gavaaeaa |
English: The spiritual wisdom of the True Guru illumines the heart; this Light dispels the darkness of spiritual ignorance.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨੀ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam tinee aaraadhiaa jin masatak dhur likh paae jeeo |
English: They alone meditate on the Lord's Name, Har, Har, upon whose foreheads such destiny is written.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਊਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har naam padaarath kalijug aootam har japeeai satigur bhaae jeeo |2|
English: The wealth of the Lord's Name is the most exalted in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga; chant the Lord's Name according to the Way of the True Guru. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har har man bhaaeaa param sukh paaeaa har laahaa pad nirabaan jeeo |
English: One whose mind loves the Lord, Har, Har, obtains supreme peace. He reaps the profit of the Lord's Name, the state of Nirvaanaa.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਚੂਕਾ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har preet lagaaee har naam sakhaaee bhram chookaa aavan jaan jeeo |
English: He embraces love for the Lord, and the Lord's Name becomes his companion. His doubts, and his comings and goings are ended.

Gurbani: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aavan jaanaa bhram bhau bhaagaa har har har gun gaaeaa |
English: His comings and goings, doubts and fears come to an end, and he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਦੁਖ ਉਤਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: janam janam ke kilavikh dukh utare har har naam samaaeaa |
English: The sins and pains of countless incarnations are washed away, and he merges into the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਭਾਗ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: jin har dhiaaeaa dhur bhaag likh paaeaa tin safal janam paravaan jeeo |
English: Those who are blessed by such pre-ordained destiny, meditate on the Lord, and their lives become fruitful and approved.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har har man bhaaeaa param sukh paaeaa har laahaa pad nirabaan jeeo |3|
English: One whose mind loves the Lord, Har, Har, obtains supreme peace. He reaps the profit of the Lord's Name, the state of Nirvaanaa. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨਾ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਧਾਨਾ ਤੇ ਊਤਮ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲੋਗ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: jina har meetth lagaanaa te jan paradhaanaa te aootam har har log jeeo |
English: Celebrated are those people, unto whom the Lord seems sweet; how exalted are those people of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har naam vaddaaee har naam sakhaaee gurasabadee har ras bhog jeeo |
English: The Lord's Name is their glorious greatness; the Lord's Name is their companion and helper. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they enjoy the sublime essence of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਮਹਾ ਨਿਰਜੋਗ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: har ras bhog mahaa nirajog vaddabhaagee har ras paaeaa |
English: They enjoy the sublime essence of the Lord, and remain totally detached. By great good fortune, they obtain the sublime essence of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਧੰਨੁ ਵਡੇ ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖਾ ਪੂਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: se dhan vadde sat purakhaa poore jin guramat naam dhiaaeaa |
English: So very blessed and truly perfect are those, who through Guru's Instruction meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਰੇਣੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਪਗ ਸਾਧੂ ਮਨਿ ਚੂਕਾ ਸੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: jan naanak ren mangai pag saadhoo man chookaa sog vijog jeeo |
English: Servant Nanak begs for the dust of the feet of the Holy; his mind is rid of sorrow and separation.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨਾ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਧਾਨਾ ਤੇ ਊਤਮ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲੋਗ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: jina har meetth lagaanaa te jan paradhaanaa te aootam har har log jeeo |4|3|10|
English: Celebrated are those people, unto whom the Lord seems sweet; how exalted are those people of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||3||10||

[Ang 445 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 |
English: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਜੁਗਿ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਸਰੀਰਾ ਪਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਧਰਮੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: satajug sabh santokh sareeraa pag chaare dharam dhiaan jeeo |
English: In the Golden Age of Sat Yuga, everyone embodied contentment and meditation; religion stood upon four feet.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: man tan har gaaveh param sukh paaveh har hiradai har gun giaan jeeo |
English: With mind and body, they sang of the Lord, and attained supreme peace. In their hearts was the spiritual wisdom of the Lord's Glorious Virtues.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਤਾਰਥੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: gun giaan padaarath har har kirataarath sobhaa guramukh hoee |
English: Their wealth was the spiritual wisdom of the Lord's Glorious Virtues; the Lord was their success, and to live as Gurmukh was their glory.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: antar baahar har prabh eko doojaa avar na koee |
English: Inwardly and outwardly, they saw only the One Lord God; for them there was no other second.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਨੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har har liv laaee har naam sakhaaee har daragah paavai maan jeeo |
English: They centered their consciousness lovingly on the Lord, Har, Har. The Lord's Name was their companion, and in the Court of the Lord, they obtained honor.

Gurbani: ਸਤਜੁਗਿ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਸਰੀਰਾ ਪਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਧਰਮੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: satajug sabh santokh sareeraa pag chaare dharam dhiaan jeeo |1|
English: In the Golden Age of Sat Yuga, everyone embodied contentment and meditation; religion stood upon four feet. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੇਤਾ ਜੁਗੁ ਆਇਆ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਤੁ ਸੰਜਮ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: tetaa jug aaeaa antar jor paaeaa jat sanjam karam kamaae jeeo |
English: Then came the Silver Age of Trayta Yuga; men's minds were ruled by power, and they practiced celibacy and self-discipline.

Gurbani: ਪਗੁ ਚਉਥਾ ਖਿਸਿਆ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਪਗ ਟਿਕਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਜਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: pag chauthaa khisiaa trai pag ttikiaa man hiradai krodh jalaae jeeo |
English: The fourth foot of religion dropped off, and three remained. Their hearts and minds were inflamed with anger.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਸਲੋਧੁ ਨਿਰਪ ਧਾਵਹਿ ਲੜਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: man hiradai krodh mahaa bisalodh nirap dhaaveh larr dukh paaeaa |
English: Their hearts and minds were filled with the horribly poisonous essence of anger. The kings fought their wars and obtained only pain.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਮਤਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਲਗਾਨਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: antar mamataa rog lagaanaa haumai ahankaar vadhaaeaa |
English: Their minds were afflicted with the illness of egotism, and their self-conceit and arrogance increased.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har har kripaa dhaaree merai tthaakur bikh guramat har naam leh jaae jeeo |
English: If my Lord, Har, Har, shows His Mercy, my Lord and Master eradicates the poison by the Guru's Teachings and the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਤੇਤਾ ਜੁਗੁ ਆਇਆ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਤੁ ਸੰਜਮ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tetaa jug aaeaa antar jor paaeaa jat sanjam karam kamaae jeeo |2|
English: Then came the Silver Age of Trayta Yuga; men's minds were ruled by power, and they practiced celibacy and self-discipline. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੁਗੁ ਦੁਆਪੁਰੁ ਆਇਆ ਭਰਮਿ ਭਰਮਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਪੀ ਕਾਨੑੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: jug duaapur aaeaa bharam bharamaaeaa har gopee kaanau upaae jeeo |
English: The Brass Age of Dwaapar Yuga came, and people wandered in doubt. The Lord created the Gopis and Krishna.

Gurbani: ਤਪੁ ਤਾਪਨ ਤਾਪਹਿ ਜਗ ਪੁੰਨ ਆਰੰਭਹਿ ਅਤਿ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: tap taapan taapeh jag pun aaranbheh at kiriaa karam kamaae jeeo |
English: The penitents practiced penance, they offered sacred feasts and charity, and performed many rituals and religious rites.

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਿਆ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਆ ਪਗ ਦੁਇ ਖਿਸਕਾਇਆ ਦੁਇ ਪਗ ਟਿਕੈ ਟਿਕਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: kiriaa karam kamaaeaa pag due khisakaaeaa due pag ttikai ttikaae jeeo |
English: They performed many rituals and religious rites; two legs of religion dropped away, and only two legs remained.

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਜੁਧ ਜੋਧ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਨੑੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਪਚੈ ਪਚਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: mahaa judh jodh bahu keenae vich haumai pachai pachaae jeeo |
English: So many heroes waged great wars; in their egos they were ruined, and they ruined others as well.

Gurbani: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਲੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: deen deaal gur saadh milaaeaa mil satigur mal leh jaae jeeo |
English: The Lord, Compassionate to the poor, led them to meet the Holy Guru. Meeting the True Guru, their filth is washed away.

Gurbani: ਜੁਗੁ ਦੁਆਪੁਰੁ ਆਇਆ ਭਰਮਿ ਭਰਮਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਪੀ ਕਾਨੑੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jug duaapur aaeaa bharam bharamaaeaa har gopee kaanau upaae jeeo |3|
English: The Brass Age of Dwaapar Yuga came, and the people wandered in doubt. The Lord created the Gopis and Krishna. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਲਿਜੁਗੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਪਗ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਖਿਸਕੀਆ ਪਗੁ ਚਉਥਾ ਟਿਕੈ ਟਿਕਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: kalijug har keea pag trai khisakeea pag chauthaa ttikai ttikaae jeeo |
English: The Lord ushered in the Dark Age, the Iron Age of Kali Yuga; three legs of religion were lost, and only the fourth leg remained intact.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਪਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: gurasabad kamaaeaa aaukhadh har paaeaa har keerat har saant paae jeeo |
English: Acting in accordance with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the medicine of the Lord's Name is obtained. Singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, divine peace is obtained.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਰੁਤਿ ਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਖੇਤੁ ਜਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: har keerat rut aaee har naam vaddaaee har har naam khet jamaaeaa |
English: The season of singing the Lord's Praise has arrived; the Lord's Name is glorified, and the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, grows in the field of the body.

Gurbani: ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਬੀਜੁ ਬੀਜੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kalijug beej beeje bin naavai sabh laahaa mool gavaaeaa |
English: In the Dark Age of Kali Yuga, if one plants any other seed than the Name, all profit and capital is lost.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਖਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: jan naanak gur pooraa paaeaa man hiradai naam lakhaae jeeo |
English: Servant Nanak has found the Perfect Guru, who has revealed to him the Naam within his heart and mind.

Gurbani: ਕਲਜੁਗੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਪਗ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਖਿਸਕੀਆ ਪਗੁ ਚਉਥਾ ਟਿਕੈ ਟਿਕਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: kalajug har keea pag trai khisakeea pag chauthaa ttikai ttikaae jeeo |4|4|11|
English: The Lord ushered in the Dark Age, the Iron Age of Kali Yuga; three legs of religion were lost, and only the fourth leg remained intact. ||4||4||11||

[Ang 446 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 |
English: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har keerat man bhaaee param gat paaee har man tan meetth lagaan jeeo |
English: One whose mind is pleased with the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, attains the supreme status; the Lord seems so sweet to her mind and body.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har har ras paaeaa guramat har dhiaaeaa dhur masatak bhaag puraan jeeo |
English: She obtains the sublime essence of the Lord, Har, Har; through the Guru's Teachings, she meditates on the Lord, and the destiny written on her forehead is fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਗੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: dhur masatak bhaag har naam suhaag har naamai har gun gaaeaa |
English: By that high destiny written on her forehead, she chants the Name of the Lord, her Husband, and through the Name of the Lord, she sings the Lord's Glorious Praises.

Gurbani: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਮਣੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਹਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: masatak manee preet bahu pragattee har naamai har sohaaeaa |
English: The jewel of immense love sparkles on her forehead, and she is adorned with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਨੂਆ ਮਾਨ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: jotee jot milee prabh paaeaa mil satigur manooaa maan jeeo |
English: Her light blends with the Supreme Light, and she obtains God; meeting the True Guru, her mind is satisfied.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har keerat man bhaaee param gat paaee har man tan meetth lagaan jeeo |1|
English: One whose mind is pleased with the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, attains the supreme status; the Lord seems sweet to her mind and body. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਆ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਊਤਮ ਜਨ ਪਰਧਾਨ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har har jas gaaeaa param pad paaeaa te aootam jan paradhaan jeeo |
English: Those who sing the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, obtain the supreme status; they are the most exalted and acclaimed people.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨੑ ਹਮ ਚਰਣ ਸਰੇਵਹ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਗ ਧੋਵਹ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: tina ham charan sarevah khin khin pag dhovah jin har meetth lagaan jeeo |
English: I bow at their feet; each and every moment, I wash the feet of those, unto whom the Lord seems sweet.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਇਆ ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੁਖਿ ਭਾਗਾ ਰਤੀ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har meetthaa laaeaa param sukh paaeaa mukh bhaagaa ratee chaare |
English: The Lord seems sweet to them, and they obtain the supreme status; their faces are radiant and beautiful with good fortune.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਾਰੁ ਉਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਕੰਠਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: guramat har gaaeaa har haar ur paaeaa har naamaa kantth dhaare |
English: Under Guru's Instruction, they sing the Lord's Name, and wear the garland of the Lord's Name around their necks; they keep the Lord's Name in their throats.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਏਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਮਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਸਭੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਨ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: sabh ek drisatt samat kar dekhai sabh aatam raam pachhaan jeeo |
English: They look upon all with equality, and recognize the Supreme Soul, the Lord, pervading among all.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਆ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਊਤਮ ਜਨ ਪਰਧਾਨ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har har jas gaaeaa param pad paaeaa te aootam jan paradhaan jeeo |2|
English: Those who sing the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, obtain the supreme status; they are the most exalted and acclaimed people. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: satasangat man bhaaee har rasan rasaaee vich sangat har ras hoe jeeo |
English: One whose mind is pleased with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, savors the sublime essence of the Lord; in the Sangat, is this essence of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਿਗਾਸਿਆ ਬੀਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har har aaraadhiaa gur sabad vigaasiaa beejaa avar na koe jeeo |
English: He meditates in adoration upon the Lord, Har, Har, and through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he blossoms forth. He plants no other seed.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸੋਇ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੀਆ ਸੋ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: avar na koe har amrit soe jin peea so bidh jaanai |
English: There is no Nectar, other than the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar. One who drinks it in, knows the way.

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਪੂਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਲਗਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan guroo pooraa prabh paaeaa lag sangat naam pachhaanai |
English: Hail, hail to the Perfect Guru; through Him, God is found. Joining the Sangat, the Naam is understood.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੋ ਸੇਵਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਆਰਾਧੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: naamo sev naamo aaraadhai bin naamai avar na koe jeeo |
English: I serve the Naam, and I meditate on the Naam. Without the Naam, there is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: satasangat man bhaaee har rasan rasaaee vich sangat har ras hoe jeeo |3|
English: One whose mind is pleased with the Sat Sangat, savors the sublime essence of the Lord; in the Sangat, is this essence of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਪਾਖਣ ਹਮ ਤਾਰਹੁ ਕਢਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har deaa prabh dhaarahu paakhan ham taarahu kadt levahu sabad subhaae jeeo |
English: O Lord God, shower Your Mercy upon me; I am just a stone. Please, carry me across, and lift me up with ease, through the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹ ਚੀਕੜਿ ਫਾਥੇ ਨਿਘਰਤ ਹਮ ਜਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਂਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਪਕਰਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: moh cheekarr faathe nigharat ham jaate har baanh prabhoo pakaraae jeeo |
English: I am stuck in the swamp of emotional attachment, and I am sinking. O Lord God, please, take me by the arm.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਬਾਂਹ ਪਕਰਾਈ ਊਤਮ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਜਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: prabh baanh pakaraaee aootam mat paaee gur charanee jan laagaa |
English: God took me by the arm, and I obtained the highest understanding; as His slave, I grasped the Guru's feet.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿਆ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਸਭਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam japiaa aaraadhiaa mukh masatak bhaag sabhaagaa |
English: I chant and meditate in adoration upon the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, according to the good destiny written upon my forehead.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: jan naanak har kirapaa dhaaree man har har meetthaa laae jeeo |
English: The Lord has showered His Mercy upon servant Nanak, and the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, seems so sweet to his mind.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਪਾਖਣ ਹਮ ਤਾਰਹੁ ਕਢਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: har deaa prabh dhaarahu paakhan ham taarahu kadt levahu sabad subhaae jeeo |4|5|12|
English: O Lord God, shower Your Mercy upon me; I am just a stone. Please, carry me across, and lift me up with ease, through the Word of the Shabad. ||4||5||12||

[Ang 447 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 |
English: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: man naam japaanaa har har man bhaanaa har bhagat janaa man chaau jeeo |
English: One who chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har in his mind - the Lord is pleasing to his mind. In the mind of the devotees there is a great yearning for the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵੇ ਤਿਨੑ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੇ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo jan mar jeeve tina amrit peeve man laagaa guramat bhaau jeeo |
English: Those humble beings who remain dead while yet alive, drink in the Ambrosial Nectar; through the Guru's Teachings, their minds embrace love for the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਪਸਾਉ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: man har har bhaau gur kare pasaau jeevan mukat sukh hoee |
English: Their minds love the Lord, Har, Har, and the Guru is Merciful to them. They are Jivan Mukta - liberated while yet alive, and they are at peace.

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਣਿ ਮਰਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jeevan maran har naam suhele man har har hiradai soee |
English: Their birth and death, through the Name of the Lord, are illustrious, and in their hearts and minds, the Lord, Har, Har, abides.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਗਟਾਕ ਪੀਆਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: man har har vasiaa guramat har rasiaa har har ras gattaak peeaau jeeo |
English: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, abides in their minds, and through the Guru's Teachings, they savor the Lord, Har, Har; they drink in the sublime essence of the Lord with abandon.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: man naam japaanaa har har man bhaanaa har bhagat janaa man chaau jeeo |1|
English: One who chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in his mind - the Lord is pleasing to his mind. In the mind of the devotees there is such a great yearning for the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਗਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ਨਿਤ ਆਪੁ ਲੁਕਾਇਆ ਮਤ ਜਮੁ ਪਕਰੈ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: jag maran na bhaaeaa nit aap lukaaeaa mat jam pakarai lai jaae jeeo |
English: The people of the world do not like death; they try to hide from it. They are afraid that the Messenger of Death may catch them and take them away.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਰਖਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har antar baahar har prabh eko ihu jeearraa rakhiaa na jaae jeeo |
English: Inwardly and outwardly, the Lord God is the One and Only; this soul cannot be concealed from Him.

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਜੀਉ ਰਖੀਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਲੋੜੀਜੈ ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਵਸਤੁ ਸੋ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: kiau jeeo rakheejai har vasat lorreejai jis kee vasat so lai jaae jeeo |
English: How can one keep one's soul, when the Lord wishes to have it? All things belong to Him, and He shall take them away.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਵ ਕਰਿ ਭਰਮੇ ਸਭਿ ਅਉਖਧ ਦਾਰੂ ਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh karan palaav kar bharame sabh aaukhadh daaroo laae jeeo |
English: The self-willed manmukhs wander around in pathetic lamentation, trying all medicines and remedies.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਵਸਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਏ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਨ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: jis kee vasat prabh le suaamee jan ubare sabad kamaae jeeo |
English: God, the Master, unto whom all things belong, shall take them away; the Lord's servant is redeemed by living the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਜਗਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ਨਿਤ ਆਪੁ ਲੁਕਾਇਆ ਮਤ ਜਮੁ ਪਕਰੈ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jag maran na bhaaeaa nit aap lukaaeaa mat jam pakarai lai jaae jeeo |2|
English: The people of the world do not like death; they try to hide from it. They are afraid that the Messenger of Death may catch them and take them away. ||2||

Gurbani: ਧੁਰਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਲਿਖਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਹਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਉਬਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਨਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: dhur maran likhaaeaa guramukh sohaaeaa jan ubare har har dhiaan jeeo |
English: Death is pre-ordained; the Gurmukhs look beauteous, and the humble beings are saved, meditating on the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧੇ ਜਾਨਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har sobhaa paaee har naam vaddiaaee har daragah paidhe jaan jeeo |
English: Through the Lord they obtain honor, and through the Lord's Name, glorious greatness. In the Court of the Lord, they are robed in honor.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਸੀਧੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: har daragah paidhe har naamai seedhe har naamai te sukh paaeaa |
English: Robed in honor in the Court of the Lord, in the perfection of the Lord's Name, they obtain peace through the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੋਵੈ ਦੁਖ ਮੇਟੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: janam maran dovai dukh mette har raamai naam samaaeaa |
English: The pains of both birth and death are eliminated, and they merge into the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਲਿ ਏਕੋ ਹੋਏ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har jan prabh ral eko hoe har jan prabh ek samaan jeeo |
English: The Lord's servants meet with God and merge into Oneness. The Lord's servant and God are one and the same.

Gurbani: ਧੁਰਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਲਿਖਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਹਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਉਬਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਨਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: dhur maran likhaaeaa guramukh sohaaeaa jan ubare har har dhiaan jeeo |3|
English: Death is pre-ordained; the Gurmukhs look beauteous, and the humble beings are saved, meditating on the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਗੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ ਲਗਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: jag upajai binasai binas binaasai lag guramukh asathir hoe jeeo |
English: The people of the world are born, only to perish, and perish, and perish again. Only by attaching oneself to the Lord as Gurmukh, does one become permanent.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਚੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur mantru drirraae har rasak rasaae har amrit har mukh choe jeeo |
English: The Guru implants His Mantra within the heart, and one savors the sublime essence of the Lord; the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord trickles into his mouth.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੁਆ ਜੀਵਾਇਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: har amrit ras paaeaa muaa jeevaaeaa fir baahurr maran na hoee |
English: Obtaining the Ambrosial Essence of the Lord, the dead are restored to life, and do not die again.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮਰ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam amar pad paaeaa har naam samaavai soee |
English: Through the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, one obtains the immortal status, and merges into the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: jan naanak naam adhaar ttek hai bin naavai avar na koe jeeo |
English: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the only Support and Anchor of servant Nanak; without the Naam, there is nothing else at all.

Gurbani: ਜਗੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ ਲਗਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: jag upajai binasai binas binaasai lag guramukh asathir hoe jeeo |4|6|13|
English: The people of the world are born, only to perish, and perish, and perish again. Only by attaching oneself to the Lord as Gurmukh, does one become permanent. ||4||6||13||

[Ang 448 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਛੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 chhant |
English: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl, Chhant:

Gurbani: ਵਡਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਆਦਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: vaddaa meraa govind agam agochar aad niranjan nirankaar jeeo |
English: My Lord of the Universe is great, unapproachable, unfathomable, primal, immaculate and formless.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਅਮਿਤਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: taa kee gat kahee na jaaee amit vaddiaaee meraa govind alakh apaar jeeo |
English: His condition cannot be described; His Glorious Greatness is immeasurable. My Lord of the Universe is invisible and infinite.

Gurbani: ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਆਪੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: govind alakh apaar aparanpar aap aapanaa jaanai |
English: The Lord of the Universe is invisible, infinite and unlimited. He Himself knows Himself.

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਇਹ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa ih jant vichaare kaheeeh jo tudh aakh vakhaanai |
English: What should these poor creatures say? How can they speak of and describe You?

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਅਪਣੀ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: jis no nadar kareh toon apanee so guramukh kare veechaar jeeo |
English: That Gurmukh who is blessed by Your Glance of Grace contemplates You.

Gurbani: ਵਡਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਆਦਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: vaddaa meraa govind agam agochar aad niranjan nirankaar jeeo |1|
English: My Lord of the Universe is great, unapproachable, unfathomable, primal, immaculate and formless. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਪਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: toon aad purakh aparanpar karataa teraa paar na paaeaa jaae jeeo |
English: You, O Lord, O Primal Being, are the Limitless Creator; Your limits cannot be found.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: toon ghatt ghatt antar sarab nirantar sabh meh rahiaa samaae jeeo |
English: You are pervading and permeating each and every heart, everywhere, You are contained in all.

Gurbani: ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt antar paarabraham paramesar taa kaa ant na paaeaa |
English: Within the heart is the Transcendent, Supreme Lord God, whose limits cannot be found.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖ ਅਦਿਸਟੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tis roop na rekh adisatt agochar guramukh alakh lakhaaeaa |
English: He has no form or shape; He is unseen and unknown. The Gurmukh sees the unseen Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa anand rahai din raatee sahaje naam samaae jeeo |
English: He remains in continual ecstasy, day and night, and is spontaneously absorbed into the Naam.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਪਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: toon aad purakh aparanpar karataa teraa paar na paaeaa jaae jeeo |2|
English: You, O Lord, O Primal Being, are the Limitless Creator; Your limits cannot be found. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਸਤਿ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: toon sat paramesar sadaa abinaasee har har gunee nidhaan jeeo |
English: You are the True, Transcendent Lord, forever imperishable. The Lord, Har, Har, is the treasure of virtue.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har har prabh eko avar na koee toon aape purakh sujaan jeeo |
English: The Lord God, Har, Har, is the One and only; there is no other at all. You Yourself are the all-knowing Lord.

Gurbani: ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ਤੂੰ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: purakh sujaan toon paradhaan tudh jevadd avar na koee |
English: You are the all-knowing Lord, the most exalted and auspicious; there is no other as great as You.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਵਰਤਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: teraa sabad sabh toonhai varateh toon aape kareh su hoee |
English: The Word of Your Shabad is pervading in all; whatever You do, comes to pass.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਖਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har sabh meh raviaa eko soee guramukh lakhiaa har naam jeeo |
English: The One Lord God is permeating all; the Gurmukh comes to understand the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਸਤਿ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: toon sat paramesar sadaa abinaasee har har gunee nidhaan jeeo |3|
English: You are the True, Transcendent Lord, forever imperishable. The Lord, Har, Har, is the treasure of virtue. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: sabh toonhai karataa sabh teree vaddiaaee jiau bhaavai tivai chalaae jeeo |
