English: You are the Creator of all, and all greatness is Yours. As it pleases Your Will, so do we act.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਵਹਿ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: tudh aape bhaavai tivai chalaaveh sabh terai sabad samaae jeeo |
English: As it pleases Your Will, so do we act. All are merged into Your Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਜਾਂ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: sabh sabad samaavai jaan tudh bhaavai terai sabad vaddiaaee |
English: When it pleases Your Will, we obtain greatness through Your Shabad.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ਸਬਦੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh budh paaeeai aap gavaaeeai sabade rahiaa samaaee |
English: The Gurmukh obtains wisdom, and eliminates his self-conceit, and remains absorbed in the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: teraa sabad agochar guramukh paaeeai naanak naam samaae jeeo |
English: The Gurmukh obtains Your incomprehensible Shabad; O Nanak, he remains merged in the Naam.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: sabh toonhai karataa sabh teree vaddiaaee jiau bhaavai tivai chalaae jeeo |4|7|14|
English: You are the Creator of all, and all greatness is Yours. As it pleases Your Will, so do we act. ||4||7||14||

[Ang 448 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 chhant ghar 4 |
English: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl, Chhant, Fourth House:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਿੰਨੇ ਲੋਇਣਾ ਮਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਰਤੰਨਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: har amrit bhine loeinaa man prem ratanaa raam raaje |
English: My eyes are wet with the Nectar of the Lord, and my mind is imbued with His Love, O Lord King.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮਿ ਕਸਵਟੀ ਲਾਇਆ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਸੋਵਿੰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: man raam kasavattee laaeaa kanchan sovinaa |
English: The Lord applied His touch-stone to my mind, and found it one hundred per cent gold.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੋ ਭਿੰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh rang chalooliaa meraa man tano bhinaa |
English: As Gurmukh, I am dyed in the deep red of the poppy, and my mind and body are drenched with His Love.

Gurbani: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੁਸਕਿ ਝਕੋਲਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak musak jhakoliaa sabh janam dhan dhanaa |1|
English: Servant Nanak is drenched with His Fragrance; blessed, blessed is his entire life. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਾਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਅਣੀਆਲੇ ਅਣੀਆ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: har prem baanee man maariaa aneeaale aneea raam raaje |
English: The Bani of the Lord's Love is the pointed arrow, which has pierced my mind, O Lord King.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਲਾਗੀ ਪੀਰ ਪਿਰੰਮ ਕੀ ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: jis laagee peer piram kee so jaanai jareea |
English: Only those who feel the pain of this love, know how to endure it.

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਸੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਮਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: jeevan mukat so aakheeai mar jeevai mareea |
English: Those who die, and remain dead while yet alive, are said to be Jivan Mukta, liberated while yet alive.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਗੁ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰੀਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jan naanak satigur mel har jag dutar tareea |2|
English: O Lord, unite servant Nanak with the True Guru, that he may cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਮਿਲੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਰੰਗਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: ham moorakh mugadh saranaagatee mil govind rangaa raam raaje |
English: I am foolish and ignorant, but I have taken to His Sanctuary; may I merge in the Love of the Lord of the Universe, O Lord King.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਇਕ ਮੰਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur poorai har paaeaa har bhagat ik mangaa |
English: Through the Perfect Guru, I have obtained the Lord, and I beg for the one blessing of devotion to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਿਗਾਸਿਆ ਜਪਿ ਅਨਤ ਤਰੰਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: meraa man tan sabad vigaasiaa jap anat tarangaa |
English: My mind and body blossom forth through the Word of the Shabad; I meditate on the Lord of infinite waves.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਸੰਗਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: mil sant janaa har paaeaa naanak satasangaa |3|
English: Meeting with the humble Saints, Nanak finds the Lord, in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੁਣਿ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: deen deaal sun benatee har prabh har raaeaa raam raaje |
English: O Merciful to the meek, hear my prayer, O Lord God; You are my Master, O Lord King.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਮਾਗਉ ਸਰਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau maagau saran har naam kee har har mukh paaeaa |
English: I beg for the Sanctuary of the Lord's Name, Har, Har; please, place it in my mouth.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਜ ਰਖਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat vachhal har birad hai har laaj rakhaaeaa |
English: It is the Lord's natural way to love His devotees; O Lord, please preserve my honor!

Gurbani: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੮॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: jan naanak saranaagatee har naam taraaeaa |4|8|15|
English: Servant Nanak has entered His Sanctuary, and has been saved by the Name of the Lord. ||4||8||15||

[Ang 449 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 |
English: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਢੂੰਢਿ ਢੂਢੇਦਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਲਧਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh dtoondt dtoodtediaa har sajan ladhaa raam raaje |
English: As Gurmukh, I searched and searched, and found the Lord, my Friend, my Sovereign Lord King.

Gurbani: ਕੰਚਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋਟ ਗੜ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਧਾ ॥
Transliteration: kanchan kaaeaa kott garr vich har har sidhaa |
English: Within the walled fortress of my golden body, the Lord, Har, Har, is revealed.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹੀਰਾ ਰਤਨੁ ਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਵਿਧਾ ॥
Transliteration: har har heeraa ratan hai meraa man tan vidhaa |
English: The Lord, Har, Har, is a jewel, a diamond; my mind and body are pierced through.

Gurbani: ਧੁਰਿ ਭਾਗ ਵਡੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਸਿ ਗੁਧਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dhur bhaag vadde har paaeaa naanak ras gudhaa |1|
English: By the great good fortune of pre-ordained destiny, I have found the Lord. Nanak is permeated with His sublime essence. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪੰਥੁ ਦਸਾਵਾ ਨਿਤ ਖੜੀ ਮੁੰਧ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਬਾਲੀ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: panth dasaavaa nit kharree mundh joban baalee raam raaje |
English: I stand by the roadside, and ask the way; I am just a youthful bride of the Lord King.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੇਤਾਇ ਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam chetaae gur har maarag chaalee |
English: The Guru has caused me to remember the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; I follow the Path to Him.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਜਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: merai man tan naam aadhaar hai haumai bikh jaalee |
English: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the Support of my mind and body; I have burnt away the poison of ego.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਬਨਵਾਲੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jan naanak satigur mel har har miliaa banavaalee |2|
English: O True Guru, unite me with the Lord, unite me with the Lord, adorned with garlands of flowers. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੁ ਮੈ ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh piaare aae mil mai chiree vichhune raam raaje |
English: O my Love, come and meet me as Gurmukh; I have been separated from You for so long, Lord King.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬੈਰਾਗਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨੈਣ ਰਸਿ ਭਿੰਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: meraa man tan bahut bairaagiaa har nain ras bhine |
English: My mind and body are sad; my eyes are wet with the Lord's sublime essence.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਦਸਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਮੰਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: mai har prabh piaaraa das gur mil har man mane |
English: Show me my Lord God, my Love, O Guru; meeting the Lord, my mind is pleased.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਈਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਮੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: hau moorakh kaarai laaeea naanak har kame |3|
English: I am just a fool, O Nanak, but the Lord has appointed me to perform His service. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਿੰਨੀ ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬੁਰਕੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur amrit bhinee dehuree amrit burake raam raaje |
English: The Guru's body is drenched with Ambrosial Nectar; He sprinkles it upon me, O Lord King.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਛਕਿ ਛਕੇ ॥
Transliteration: jinaa gurabaanee man bhaaeea amrit chhak chhake |
English: Those whose minds are pleased with the Word of the Guru's Bani, drink in the Ambrosial Nectar again and again.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਤੁਠੈ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਚੂਕੇ ਧਕ ਧਕੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur tutthai har paaeaa chooke dhak dhake |
English: As the Guru is pleased, the Lord is obtained, and you shall not be pushed around any more.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਇਆ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਇਕੇ ॥੪॥੯॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: har jan har har hoeaa naanak har ike |4|9|16|
English: The Lord's humble servant becomes the Lord, Har, Har; O Nanak, the Lord and His servant are one and the same. ||4||9||16||

[Ang 449 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 |
English: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: har amrit bhagat bhanddaar hai gur satigur paase raam raaje |
English: The treasure of Ambrosial Nectar, the Lord's devotional service, is found through the Guru, the True Guru, O Lord King.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਹੈ ਸਿਖ ਦੇਇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਸੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur satigur sachaa saahu hai sikh dee har raase |
English: The Guru, the True Guru, is the True Banker, who gives to His Sikh the capital of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ਵਣਜੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਾਬਾਸੇ ॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan vanajaaraa vanaj hai gur saahu saabaase |
English: Blessed, blessed is the trader and the trade; how wonderful is the Banker, the Guru!

Gurbani: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਲਿਲਾਟਿ ਲਿਖਾਸੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak gur tinaee paaeaa jin dhur likhat lilaatt likhaase |1|
English: O servant Nanak, they alone obtain the Guru, who have such pre-ordained destiny written upon their foreheads. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਧਣੀ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: sach saahu hamaaraa toon dhanee sabh jagat vanajaaraa raam raaje |
English: You are my True Banker, O Lord; the whole world is Your trader, O Lord King.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਭਾਂਡੇ ਤੁਧੈ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਥਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabh bhaandde tudhai saajiaa vich vasat har thaaraa |
English: You fashioned all vessels, O Lord, and that which dwells within is also Yours.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਭਾਂਡੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਸਾ ਨਿਕਲੈ ਕਿਆ ਕੋਈ ਕਰੇ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo paaveh bhaandde vich vasat saa nikalai kiaa koee kare vechaaraa |
English: Whatever You place in that vessel, that alone comes out again. What can the poor creatures do?

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਖਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jan naanak kau har bakhasiaa har bhagat bhanddaaraa |2|
English: The Lord has given the treasure of His devotional worship to servant Nanak. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਵਿਥਰਹ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੂੰ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰੋ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: ham kiaa gun tere vitharah suaamee toon apar apaaro raam raaje |
English: What Glorious Virtues of Yours can I describe, O Lord and Master? You are the most infinite of the infinite, O Lord King.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਹ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਏਹਾ ਆਸ ਆਧਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: har naam saalaahah din raat ehaa aas aadhaaro |
English: I praise the Lord's Name, day and night; this alone is my hope and support.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਕਿਛੂਅ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਾ ਕਿਵ ਪਾਵਹ ਪਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: ham moorakh kichhooa na jaanahaa kiv paavah paaro |
English: I am a fool, and I know nothing. How can I find Your limits?

Gurbani: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸ ਪਨਿਹਾਰੋ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jan naanak har kaa daas hai har daas panihaaro |3|
English: Servant Nanak is the slave of the Lord, the water-carrier of the slaves of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੈ ਹਮ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਏ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: jiau bhaavai tiau raakh lai ham saran prabh aae raam raaje |
English: As it pleases You, You save me; I have come seeking Your Sanctuary, O God, O Lord King.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਭੂਲਿ ਵਿਗਾੜਹ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਜ ਰਖਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: ham bhool vigaarrah dinas raat har laaj rakhaae |
English: I am wandering around, ruining myself day and night; O Lord, please save my honor!

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤੂੰ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਹੈ ਦੇ ਮਤਿ ਸਮਝਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: ham baarik toon gur pitaa hai de mat samajhaae |
English: I am just a child; You, O Guru, are my father. Please give me understanding and instruction.

Gurbani: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਂਢਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਏ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: jan naanak daas har kaandtiaa har paij rakhaae |4|10|17|
English: Servant Nanak is known as the Lord's slave; O Lord, please preserve his honor! ||4||10||17||

[Ang 450 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 |
English: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: jin masatak dhur har likhiaa tinaa satigur miliaa raam raaje |
English: Those who have the blessed pre-ordained destiny of the Lord written on their foreheads, meet the True Guru, the Lord King.

Gurbani: ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਕਟਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਘਟਿ ਬਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: agiaan andheraa kattiaa gur giaan ghatt baliaa |
English: The Guru removes the darkness of ignorance, and spiritual wisdom illuminates their hearts.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਲਧਾ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੋ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਚਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: har ladhaa ratan padaaratho fir bahurr na chaliaa |
English: They find the wealth of the jewel of the Lord, and then, they do not wander any longer.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਆਰਾਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak naam aaraadhiaa aaraadh har miliaa |1|
English: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and in meditation, he meets the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਸੇ ਕਾਹੇ ਜਗਿ ਆਏ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: jinee aisaa har naam na chetio se kaahe jag aae raam raaje |
English: Those who have not kept the Lord's Name in their consciousness - why did they bother to come into the world, O Lord King?

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਦੁਲੰਭੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: eihu maanas janam dulanbh hai naam binaa birathaa sabh jaae |
English: It is so difficult to obtain this human incarnation, and without the Naam, it is all futile and useless.

Gurbani: ਹੁਣਿ ਵਤੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਬੀਜਿਓ ਅਗੈ ਭੁਖਾ ਕਿਆ ਖਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: hun vatai har naam na beejio agai bhukhaa kiaa khaae |
English: Now, in this most fortunate season, he does not plant the seed of the Lord's Name; what will the hungry soul eat, in the world hereafter?

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: manamukhaa no fir janam hai naanak har bhaae |2|
English: The self-willed manmukhs are born again and again. O Nanak, such is the Lord's Will. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਉਪਾਏ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: toon har teraa sabh ko sabh tudh upaae raam raaje |
English: You, O Lord, belong to all, and all belong to You. You created all, O Lord King.

Gurbani: ਕਿਛੁ ਹਾਥਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਭਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਚਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: kichh haath kisai dai kichh naahee sabh chaleh chalaae |
English: Nothing is in anyone's hands; all walk as You cause them to walk.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jina toon meleh piaare se tudh mileh jo har man bhaae |
English: They alone are united with You, O Beloved, whom You cause to be so united; they alone are pleasing to Your Mind.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਰਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jan naanak satigur bhettiaa har naam taraae |3|
English: Servant Nanak has met the True Guru, and through the Lord's Name, he has been carried across. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਗਾਵੈ ਰਾਗੀ ਨਾਦੀ ਬੇਦੀ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭੀਜੈ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: koee gaavai raagee naadee bedee bahu bhaat kar nahee har har bheejai raam raaje |
English: Some sing of the Lord, through musical Ragas and the sound current of the Naad, through the Vedas, and in so many ways. But the Lord, Har, Har, is not pleased by these, O Lord King.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਨਾ ਰੋਇ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: jinaa antar kapatt vikaar hai tinaa roe kiaa keejai |
English: Those who are filled with fraud and corruption within - what good does it do for them to cry out?

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਰੋਗ ਹਥੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: har karataa sabh kichh jaanadaa sir rog hath deejai |
English: The Creator Lord knows everything, although they may try to hide their sins and the causes of their diseases.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਿਰਦਾ ਸੁਧੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: jinaa naanak guramukh hiradaa sudh hai har bhagat har leejai |4|11|18|
English: O Nanak, those Gurmukhs whose hearts are pure, obtain the Lord, Har, Har, by devotional worship. ||4||11||18||

[Ang 450 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 |
English: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹੈ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਸੁਘੜ ਸਿਆਣੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: jin antar har har preet hai te jan sugharr siaane raam raaje |
English: Those whose hearts are filled with the love of the Lord, Har, Har, are the wisest and most clever people, O Lord King.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਭੁਲਿ ਚੁਕਿ ਬੋਲਦੇ ਭੀ ਖਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: je baaharahu bhul chuk bolade bhee khare har bhaane |
English: Even if they misspeak outwardly, they are still very pleasing to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਾ ਨੋ ਹੋਰੁ ਥਾਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: har santaa no hor thaau naahee har maan nimaane |
English: The Lord's Saints have no other place. The Lord is the honor of the dishonored.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਤਾਣੁ ਸਤਾਣੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak naam deebaan hai har taan sataane |1|
English: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the Royal Court for servant Nanak; the Lord's power is his only power. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਿਥੈ ਜਾਇ ਬਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: jithai jaae bahai meraa satiguroo so thaan suhaavaa raam raaje |
English: Wherever my True Guru goes and sits, that place is beautiful, O Lord King.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਂੀ ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਭਾਲਿਆ ਲੈ ਧੂਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: gurasikhanee so thaan bhaaliaa lai dhoor mukh laavaa |
English: The Guru's Sikhs seek out that place; they take the dust and apply it to their faces.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਕੀ ਘਾਲ ਥਾਇ ਪਈ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: gurasikhaa kee ghaal thaae pee jin har naam dhiaavaa |
English: The works of the Guru's Sikhs, who meditate on the Lord's Name, are approved.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਜਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਵਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jina naanak satigur poojiaa tin har pooj karaavaa |2|
English: Those who worship the True Guru, O Nanak - the Lord causes them to be worshipped in turn. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: gurasikhaa man har preet hai har naam har teree raam raaje |
English: The Guru's Sikh keeps the Love of the Lord, and the Name of the Lord, in his mind. He loves You, O Lord, O Lord King.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਭੁਖ ਜਾਇ ਲਹਿ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kar seveh pooraa satiguroo bhukh jaae leh meree |
English: He serves the Perfect True Guru, and his hunger and self-conceit are eliminated.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਕੀ ਭੁਖ ਸਭ ਗਈ ਤਿਨ ਪਿਛੈ ਹੋਰ ਖਾਇ ਘਨੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: gurasikhaa kee bhukh sabh gee tin pichhai hor khaae ghaneree |
English: The hunger of the Gursikh is totally eliminated; indeed, many others are satisfied through them.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਬੀਜਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਪੁੰਨ ਕੇਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jan naanak har pun beejiaa fir tott na aavai har pun keree |3|
English: Servant Nanak has planted the Seed of the Lord's Goodness; this Goodness of the Lord shall never be exhausted. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਾਧਾਈਆ ਜਿਨ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਡਿਠਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: gurasikhaa man vaadhaaeea jin meraa satiguroo dditthaa raam raaje |
English: The minds of the Gursikhs rejoice, because they have seen my True Guru, O Lord King.

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਕਰਿ ਗਲ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਸੋ ਲਗੈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਮਨਿ ਮਿਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: koee kar gal sunaavai har naam kee so lagai gurasikhaa man mitthaa |
English: If someone recites to them the story of the Lord's Name, it seems so sweet to the mind of those Gursikhs.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪੈਨਾਈਅਹਿ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: har daragah gurasikh painaaeeeh jinaa meraa satigur tutthaa |
English: The Gursikhs are robed in honor in the Court of the Lord; my True Guru is very pleased with them.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: jan naanak har har hoeaa har har man vutthaa |4|12|19|
English: Servant Nanak has become the Lord, Har, Har; the Lord, Har, Har, abides within his mind. ||4||12||19||

[Ang 451 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 |
English: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵੈ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: jinaa bhettiaa meraa pooraa satiguroo tin har naam drirraavai raam raaje |
English: Those who meet my Perfect True Guru - He implants within them the Name of the Lord, the Lord King.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਸਭ ਉਤਰੈ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: tis kee trisanaa bhukh sabh utarai jo har naam dhiaavai |
English: Those who meditate on the Lord's Name have all of their desire and hunger removed.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਤਿਨੑ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jo har har naam dhiaaeide tina jam nerr na aavai |
English: Those who meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har - the Messenger of Death cannot even approach them.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਤ ਜਪੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਰਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak kau har kripaa kar nit japai har naam har naam taraavai |1|
English: O Lord, shower Your Mercy upon servant Nanak, that he may ever chant the Name of the Lord; through the Name of the Lord, he is saved. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: jinee guramukh naam dhiaaeaa tinaa fir bighan na hoee raam raaje |
English: Those who, as Gurmukh, meditate on the Naam, meet no obstacles in their path, O Lord King.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਨਾਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਪੂਜੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jinee satigur purakh manaaeaa tin pooje sabh koee |
English: Those who are pleasing to the almighty True Guru are worshipped by everyone.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਦ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jinaee satigur piaaraa seviaa tinaa sukh sad hoee |
English: Those who serve their Beloved True Guru obtain eternal peace.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jinaa naanak satigur bhettiaa tinaa miliaa har soee |2|
English: Those who meet the True Guru, O Nanak - the Lord Himself meets them. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹੈ ਤਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਰਖਣਹਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: jinaa antar guramukh preet hai tina har rakhanahaaraa raam raaje |
English: Those Gurmukhs, who are filled with His Love, have the Lord as their Saving Grace, O Lord King.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕੋਈ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: tina kee nindaa koee kiaa kare jina har naam piaaraa |
English: How can anyone slander them? The Lord's Name is dear to them.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਸਭ ਦੁਸਟ ਝਖ ਮਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jin har setee man maaniaa sabh dusatt jhakh maaraa |
English: Those whose minds are in harmony with the Lord - all their enemies attack them in vain.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਖਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jan naanak naam dhiaaeaa har rakhanahaaraa |3|
English: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the Lord Protector. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਭਗਤ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਦਾ ਆਇਆ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: har jug jug bhagat upaaeaa paij rakhadaa aaeaa raam raaje |
English: In each and every age, He creates His devotees and preserves their honor, O Lord King.

Gurbani: ਹਰਣਾਖਸੁ ਦੁਸਟੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦੁ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: haranaakhas dusatt har maariaa prahalaad taraaeaa |
English: The Lord killed the wicked Harnaakhash, and saved Prahlaad.

Gurbani: ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀਆ ਨਿੰਦਕਾ ਪਿਠਿ ਦੇਇ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: ahankaareea nindakaa pitth dee naamadeo mukh laaeaa |
English: He turned his back on the egotists and slanderers, and showed His Face to Naam Dayv.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਅੰਤਿ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: jan naanak aisaa har seviaa ant le chhaddaaeaa |4|13|20|
English: Servant Nanak has so served the Lord, that He will deliver him in the end. ||4||13||20||

[Ang 451 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 chhant ghar 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl, Chhant, Fifth House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਪਰਦੇਸੀ ਵੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਆਉ ਘਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: mere man paradesee ve piaare aau ghare |
English: O my dear beloved stranger mind, please come home!

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਘਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har guroo milaavahu mere piaare ghar vasai hare |
English: Meet with the Lord-Guru, O my dear beloved, and He will dwell in the home of your self.

Gurbani: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਣਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: rang raleea maanahu mere piaare har kirapaa kare |
English: Revel in His Love, O my dear beloved, as the Lord bestows His Mercy.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur naanak tutthaa mere piaare mele hare |1|
English: As Guru Nanak is pleased, O my dear beloved, we are united with the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਨ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਭਾਉ ਕਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: mai prem na chaakhiaa mere piaare bhaau kare |
English: I have not tasted divine love, O my dear beloved, within my heart.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਨ ਬੁਝੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਆਸ ਕਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: man trisanaa na bujhee mere piaare nit aas kare |
English: The mind's desires are not quenched, O my dear beloved, but I still hold out hope.

Gurbani: ਨਿਤ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਜਾਵੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਮੁ ਸਾਸ ਹਿਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: nit joban jaavai mere piaare jam saas hire |
English: Youth is passing away, O my dear beloved, and death is stealing away the breath of life.

Gurbani: ਭਾਗ ਮਣੀ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bhaag manee sohaagan mere piaare naanak har ur dhaare |2|
English: The virtuous bride realizes the good fortune of her destiny, O my dear beloved; O Nanak, she enshrines the Lord within her heart. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪਿਰ ਰਤਿਅੜੇ ਮੈਡੇ ਲੋਇਣ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਬੂੰਦ ਜਿਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: pir ratiarre maidde loein mere piaare chaatrik boond jivai |
English: My eyes are drenched with the Love of my Husband Lord, O my dear beloved, like the song-bird with the rain drop.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਬੂੰਦ ਪੀਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: man seetal hoaa mere piaare har boond peevai |
English: My mind is cooled and soothed, O my dear beloved, by drinking in the rain drops of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਨਿ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਜਗਾਵੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਪਵੈ ਕਿਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: tan birahu jagaavai mere piaare need na pavai kivai |
English: Separation from my Lord keeps my body awake, O my dear beloved; I cannot sleep at all.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਲਧਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੂ ਲਿਵੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har sajan ladhaa mere piaare naanak guroo livai |3|
English: Nanak has found the Lord, the True Friend, O my dear beloved, by loving the Guru. ||3||

Gurbani: ਚੜਿ ਚੇਤੁ ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਭਲੀਅ ਰੁਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: charr chet basant mere piaare bhaleea rute |
English: In the month of Chayt, O my dear beloved, the pleasant season of spring begins.

Gurbani: ਪਿਰ ਬਾਝੜਿਅਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਆਂਗਣਿ ਧੂੜਿ ਲੁਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: pir baajharriahu mere piaare aangan dhoorr lute |
English: But without my Husband Lord, O my dear beloved, my courtyard is filled with dust.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਆਸ ਉਡੀਣੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਦੁਇ ਨੈਨ ਜੁਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: man aas uddeenee mere piaare due nain jute |
English: But my sad mind is still hopeful, O my dear beloved; my eyes are both fixed upon Him.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਿਉ ਮਾਤ ਸੁਤੇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: gur naanak dekh vigasee mere piaare jiau maat sute |4|
English: Beholding the Guru, Nanak is filled with wondrous joy, like a child, gazing upon his mother. ||4||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਕਥਾ ਕਹਾਣੀਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸੁਣਾਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: har keea kathaa kahaaneea mere piaare satiguroo sunaaeea |
English: The True Guru has preached the sermon of the Lord, O my dear beloved.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਵਿਟੜਿਅਹੁ ਹਉ ਘੋਲੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਾਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur vittarriahu hau gholee mere piaare jin har melaaeea |
English: I am a sacrifice to the Guru, O my dear beloved, who has united me with the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਆਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦਿਅੜਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabh aasaa har pooreea mere piaare man chindiarraa fal paaeaa |
English: The Lord has fulfilled all my hopes, O my dear beloved; I have obtained the fruits of my heart's desires.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਤੁਠੜਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: har tuttharraa mere piaare jan naanak naam samaaeaa |5|
English: When the Lord is pleased, O my dear beloved, servant Nanak is absorbed into the Naam. ||5||

Gurbani: ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਨ ਖੇਲਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: piaare har bin prem na khelasaa |
English: Without the Beloved Lord, there is no play of love.

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈ ਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਗਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਦੇਖਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: kiau paaee gur jit lag piaaraa dekhasaa |
English: How can I find the Guru? Grasping hold of Him, I behold my Beloved.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦਾਤੜੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: har daatarre mel guroo mukh guramukh melasaa |
English: O Lord, O Great Giver, let me meet the Guru; as Gurmukh, may I merge with You.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਸਾ ॥੬॥੧੪॥੨੧॥
Transliteration: gur naanak paaeaa mere piaare dhur masatak lekh saa |6|14|21|
English: Nanak has found the Guru, O my dear beloved; such was the destiny inscribed upon his forehead. ||6||14||21||

[Ang 452 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raag aasaa mahalaa 5 chhant ghar 1 |
English: Raag Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Chhant, First House:

Gurbani: ਅਨਦੋ ਅਨਦੁ ਘਣਾ ਮੈ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਡੀਠਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: anado anad ghanaa mai so prabh ddeetthaa raam |
English: Joy - great joy! I have seen the Lord God!

Gurbani: ਚਾਖਿਅੜਾ ਚਾਖਿਅੜਾ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: chaakhiarraa chaakhiarraa mai har ras meetthaa raam |
English: Tasted - I have tasted the sweet essence of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਵੂਠਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤੂਠਾ ਸਹਜੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: har ras meetthaa man meh vootthaa satigur tootthaa sehaj bheaa |
English: The sweet essence of the Lord has rained down in my mind; by the pleasure of the True Guru, I have attained peaceful ease.

Gurbani: ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਵਸਿ ਆਇਆ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਆ ਪੰਚ ਦੁਸਟ ਓਇ ਭਾਗਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: grihu vas aaeaa mangal gaaeaa panch dusatt oe bhaag geaa |
English: I have come to dwell in the home of my own self, and I sing the songs of joy; the five villains have fled.

Gurbani: ਸੀਤਲ ਆਘਾਣੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੇ ਸਾਜਨ ਸੰਤ ਬਸੀਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: seetal aaghaane amrit baane saajan sant baseetthaa |
English: I am soothed and satisfied with the Ambrosial Bani of His Word; the friendly Saint is my advocate.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨੈਣੀ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak har siau man maaniaa so prabh nainee ddeetthaa |1|
English: Says Nanak, my mind is in harmony with the Lord; I have seen God with my eyes. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੋਹਿਅੜੇ ਸੋਹਿਅੜੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਬੰਕ ਦੁਆਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sohiarre sohiarre mere bank duaare raam |
English: Adorned - adorned are my beauteous gates, O Lord.

Gurbani: ਪਾਹੁਨੜੇ ਪਾਹੁਨੜੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: paahunarre paahunarre mere sant piaare raam |
English: Guests - my guests are the Beloved Saints, O Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਾਰੇ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਕਰਿ ਲਗੇ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: sant piaare kaaraj saare namasakaar kar lage sevaa |
English: The Beloved Saints have resolved my affairs; I humbly bowed to them, and committed myself to their service.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਞੀ ਆਪੇ ਮਾਞੀ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਪਿ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape jaayee aape maayee aap suaamee aap devaa |
English: He Himself is the groom's party, and He Himself the bride's party; He Himself is the Lord and Master; He Himself is the Divine Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਪਣਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਧਾਰਨ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: apanaa kaaraj aap savaare aape dhaaran dhaare |
English: He Himself resolves His own affairs; He Himself sustains the Universe.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹੁ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਬੈਠਾ ਸੋਹੇ ਬੰਕ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak sahu ghar meh baitthaa sohe bank duaare |2|
English: Says Nanak, my Bridegroom is sitting in my home; the gates of my body are beautifully adorned. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਵ ਨਿਧੇ ਨਉ ਨਿਧੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: nav nidhe nau nidhe mere ghar meh aaee raam |
English: The nine treasures - the nine treasures come into my home, Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh mai sabh kichh paaeaa naam dhiaaee raam |
English: Everything - I obtain everything, meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਸਦਾ ਸਖਾਈ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਈ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: naam dhiaaee sadaa sakhaaee sehaj subhaaee govindaa |
English: Meditating on the Naam, the Lord of the Universe becomes one's eternal companion, and he dwells in peaceful ease.

Gurbani: ਗਣਤ ਮਿਟਾਈ ਚੂਕੀ ਧਾਈ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: ganat mittaaee chookee dhaaee kade na viaapai man chindaa |
English: His calculations are ended, his wanderings cease, and his mind is no longer afflicted with anxiety.

Gurbani: ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਵਾਜੇ ਅਚਰਜ ਸੋਭ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: govind gaaje anahad vaaje acharaj sobh banaaee |
English: When the Lord of the Universe reveals Himself, and the unstruck melody of the sound current vibrates, the drama of wondrous splendor is enacted.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਰੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਸੰਗੇ ਤਾ ਮੈ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak pir merai sange taa mai nav nidh paaee |3|
English: Says Nanak, when my Husband Lord is with me, I obtain the nine treasures. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਰਸਿਅੜੇ ਸਰਸਿਅੜੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਸਭ ਮੀਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sarasiarre sarasiarre mere bhaaee sabh meetaa raam |
English: Over-joyed - over-joyed are all my brothers and friends.

Gurbani: ਬਿਖਮੋ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਅਖਾੜਾ ਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੀਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: bikhamo bikham akhaarraa mai gur mil jeetaa raam |
English: Meeting the Guru, I have won the most arduous battle in the arena of life.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੀਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਤੂਟੀ ਭੀਤਾ ਭਰਮ ਗੜਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur mil jeetaa har har keetaa toottee bheetaa bharam garraa |
English: Meeting the Guru, I am victorious; praising the Lord, Har, Har, the walls of the fortress of doubt have been destroyed.

Gurbani: ਪਾਇਆ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ਸਾਣਥ ਮੇਰੀ ਆਪਿ ਖੜਾ ॥
Transliteration: paaeaa khajaanaa bahut nidhaanaa saanath meree aap kharraa |
English: I have obtained the wealth of so many treasures; the Lord Himself has stood by my side.

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਸੁਗਿਆਨਾ ਸੋ ਪਰਧਾਨਾ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨਾ ਕੀਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: soee sugiaanaa so paradhaanaa jo prabh apanaa keetaa |
English: He is the man of spiritual wisdom, and he is the leader, whom God has made His own.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਂ ਵਲਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਾ ਸਰਸੇ ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak jaan val suaamee taa sarase bhaaee meetaa |4|1|
English: Says Nanak, when the Lord and Master is on my side, then my brothers and friends rejoice. ||4||1||

[Ang 453 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਕਥਾ ਹਰਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: akathaa har akath kathaa kichh jaae na jaanee raam |
English: Inexpressible is the sermon of the inexpressible Lord; it cannot be known at all.

Gurbani: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸਹਜਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sur nar sur nar mun jan sehaj vakhaanee raam |
English: The demi-gods, mortal beings, angels and silent sages express it in their peaceful poise.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਵਖਾਣੀ ਅਮਿਉ ਬਾਣੀ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sahaje vakhaanee amiau baanee charan kamal rang laaeaa |
English: In their poise, they recite the Ambrosial Bani of the Lord's Word; they embrace love for the Lord's Lotus Feet.

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਏਕੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jap ek alakh prabh niranjan man chindiaa fal paaeaa |
English: Meditating on the One incomprehensible and immaculate Lord, they obtain the fruits of their heart's desires.

Gurbani: ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: taj maan mohu vikaar doojaa jotee jot samaanee |
English: Renouncing self-conceit, emotional attachment, corruption and duality, their light merges into the Light.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak gur prasaadee sadaa har rang maanee |1|
English: Prays Nanak, by Guru's Grace, one enjoys the Lord's Love forever. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਸਜਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ਸਹਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: har santaa har sant sajan mere meet sahaaee raam |
English: The Lord's Saints - the Lord's Saints are my friends, my best friends and helpers.

Gurbani: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: vaddabhaagee vaddabhaagee satasangat paaee raam |
English: By great good fortune, by great good fortune, I have obtained the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

Gurbani: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਲਾਥੇ ਦੂਖ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: vaddabhaagee paae naam dhiaae laathe dookh santaapai |
English: By great good fortune, I obtained it, and I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; my pains and sufferings have been taken away.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੇ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ਆਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur charanee laage bhram bhau bhaage aap mittaaeaa aapai |
English: I have grasped the Guru's Feet, and my doubts and fears are gone. He Himself has erased my self-conceit.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa mele prabh apunai vichhurr kateh na jaaee |
English: Granting His Grace, God has united me with Himself; no longer do I suffer the pains of separation, and I shall not have to go anywhere.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak daas teraa sadaa har saranaaee |2|
English: Prays Nanak, I am forever Your slave, Lord; I seek Your Sanctuary. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: har dare har dar sohan tere bhagat piaare raam |
English: The Lord's Gate - at the Lord's Gate, Your beloved devotees look beautiful.

Gurbani: ਵਾਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਵਾਰੀ ਜਾਵਾ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: vaaree tin vaaree jaavaa sad balihaare raam |
English: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, again and again a sacrifice to them.

Gurbani: ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਭੇਟਤ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: sad balihaare kar namasakaare jin bhettat prabh jaataa |
English: I am forever a sacrifice, and I humbly bow to them; meeting them, I know God.

Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt rav rahiaa sabh thaaee pooran purakh bidhaataa |
English: The Perfect and All-powerful Lord, the Architect of Destiny, is contained in each and every heart, everywhere.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜੂਐ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur pooraa paaeaa naam dhiaaeaa jooai janam na haare |
English: Meeting the Perfect Guru, we meditate on the Naam, and do not lose this life in the gamble.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਾਖੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak saran teree raakh kirapaa dhaare |3|
English: Prays Nanak, I seek Your Sanctuary; please, shower Your Mercy upon me, and protect me. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬੇਅੰਤਾ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੇਤਕ ਗਾਵਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: beantaa beant gun tere ketak gaavaa raam |
English: Innumerable - innumerable are Your Glorious Virtues; how many of them can I sing?

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੇ ਚਰਣਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਚਰਣ ਧੂੜਿ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਵਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: tere charanaa tere charan dhoorr vaddabhaagee paavaa raam |
English: The dust of Your feet, of Your feet, I have obtained, by great good fortune.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਧੂੜੀ ਨੑਾਈਐ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖ ਲਾਥੇ ॥
Transliteration: har dhoorree naaeeai mail gavaaeeai janam maran dukh laathe |
English: Bathing in the Lord's dust, my filth has been washed away, and the pains of birth and death have departed.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਦੂਰੇ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਥੇ ॥
Transliteration: antar baahar sadaa hadoore paramesar prabh saathe |
English: Inwardly and outwardly, the Transcendent Lord God is ever-present, always with us.

Gurbani: ਮਿਟੇ ਦੂਖ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: mitte dookh kaliaan keeratan bahurr jon na paavaa |
English: Suffering departs, and there is peace; singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, one is not consigned to reincarnation again.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਤਰੀਐ ਆਪਣੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak gur saran tareeai aapane prabh bhaavaa |4|2|
English: Prays Nanak, in the Guru's Sanctuary, one swims across, and is pleasing to God. ||4||2||

[Ang 453 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa chhant mahalaa 5 ghar 4 |
English: Aasaa, Chhant, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਨ ਨ ਮੀਠਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: har charan kamal man bedhiaa kichh aan na meetthaa raam raaje |
English: My mind is pierced by the Lord's Lotus Feet; He alone is sweet to my mind, the Lord King.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟੇ ਡੀਠਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: mil santasangat aaraadhiaa har ghatt ghatte ddeetthaa raam raaje |
English: Joining the Society of the Saints, I meditate on the Lord in adoration; I behold the Lord King in each and every heart.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟੇ ਡੀਠਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੋੁ ਵੂਠਾ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖ ਨਾਠੇ ॥
Transliteration: har ghatt ghatte ddeetthaa amrituo vootthaa janam maran dukh naatthe |
English: I behold the Lord in each and every heart, and the Ambrosial Nectar rains down upon me; the pains of birth and death are gone.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਗਾਇਆ ਸਭ ਦੂਖ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਗਾਠੇ ॥
Transliteration: gun nidh gaaeaa sabh dookh mittaaeaa haumai binasee gaatthe |
English: Singing the Praises of the Lord, the treasure of virtue, all my pains are erased, and the knot of ego has been untied.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਈ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਜੀਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: priau sehaj subhaaee chhodd na jaaee man laagaa rang majeetthaa |
English: My Beloved shall not leave me to go anywhere - this is His natural way; my mind is imbued with the lasting color of the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬੇਧੇ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਨ ਨ ਮੀਠਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har naanak bedhe charan kamal kichh aan na meetthaa |1|
English: The Lotus Feet of the Lord have pierced Nanak's mind, and now, nothing else seems sweet to him. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਰਾਤੀ ਜਲਿ ਮਾਛੁਲੀ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਿ ਮਾਤੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: jiau raatee jal maachhulee tiau raam ras maate raam raaje |
English: Just like the fish which revels in water, I am intoxicated with the sublime essence of the Lord, my Lord King.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਜੀਵਨ ਗਤਿ ਭਾਤੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur poorai upadesiaa jeevan gat bhaate raam raaje |
English: The Perfect Guru has instructed me, and blessed me with salvation in my life; I love the Lord, my King.

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਨ ਗਤਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਆਪਿ ਲੀਏ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jeevan gat suaamee antarajaamee aap lee larr laae |
English: The Lord Master, the Searcher of hearts, blesses me with salvation in my life; He Himself attaches me to His Love.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥੋ ਪਰਗਟੋ ਪੂਰਨੋ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: har ratan padaaratho paragatto poorano chhodd na katahoo jaae |
English: The Lord is the treasure of jewels, the perfect manifestation; He shall not forsake us to go anywhere else.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੁਘਰੁ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਮਿਟੈ ਨ ਦਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: prabh sughar saroop sujaan suaamee taa kee mittai na daate |
English: God, the Lord Master, is so accomplished, beauteous, and all-knowing; His gifts are never exhausted.

Gurbani: ਜਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਾਛੁਲੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਤੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jal sang raatee maachhulee naanak har maate |2|
English: As the fish is enraptured by the water, so is Nanak intoxicated by the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਬੂੰਦ ਜਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: chaatrik jaachai boond jiau har praan adhaaraa raam raaje |
English: As the song-bird yearns for the rain-drop, the Lord, the Lord my King, is the Support of my breath of life.

Gurbani: ਮਾਲੁ ਖਜੀਨਾ ਸੁਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਮੀਤ ਸਭਹੂੰ ਤੇ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: maal khajeenaa sut bhraat meet sabhahoon te piaaraa raam raaje |
English: My Lord King is more beloved than all wealth, treasure, children, siblings and friends.

Gurbani: ਸਭਹੂੰ ਤੇ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਾਰਾ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: sabhahoon te piaaraa purakh niraaraa taa kee gat nahee jaaneeai |
English: The absolute Lord, the Primal Being, is more beloved than all; His condition cannot be known.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਨ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: har saas giraas na bisarai kabahoon gurasabadee rang maaneeai |
English: I shall never forget the Lord, for an instant, for a single breath; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I enjoy His Love.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੋ ਸੰਤ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਨੋ ਜਪਿ ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਦੁਖ ਡਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: prabh purakh jagajeevano sant ras peevano jap bharam moh dukh ddaaraa |
English: The Primal Lord God is the Life of the Universe; His Saints drink in the Lord's sublime essence. Meditating on Him, doubts, attachments and pains are shaken off.

Gurbani: ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਬੂੰਦ ਜਿਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: chaatrik jaachai boond jiau naanak har piaaraa |3|
English: As the song-bird yearns for the rain-drop, so does Nanak love the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਿਲੇ ਨਰਾਇਣ ਆਪਣੇ ਮਾਨੋਰਥੋ ਪੂਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: mile naraaein aapane maanoratho pooraa raam raaje |
English: Meeting the Lord, my Lord King, my desires are fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਢਾਠੀ ਭੀਤਿ ਭਰੰਮ ਕੀ ਭੇਟਤ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੂਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: dtaatthee bheet bharam kee bhettat gur sooraa raam raaje |
English: The walls of doubt have been torn down, meeting the Brave Guru, O Lord King.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਏ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਾਏ ਸਭ ਨਿਧਿ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: pooran gur paae purab likhaae sabh nidh deen deaalaa |
English: The Perfect Guru is obtained by perfect pre-ordained destiny; God is the Giver of all treasures - He is merciful to the meek.

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: aad madh ant prabh soee sundar gur gopaalaa |
English: In the beginning, in the middle, and in the end, is God, the most beautiful Guru, the Sustainer of the World.

Gurbani: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sookh sehaj aanand ghanere patit paavan saadhoo dhooraa |
English: The dust of the feet of the Holy purifies sinners, and brings great joy, bliss and ecstasy.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਨਰਾਇਣ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਮਾਨੋਰਥੋੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
Transliteration: har mile naraaein naanakaa maanorathuo pooraa |4|1|3|
English: The Lord, the Infinite Lord, has met with Nanak, and his desires are fulfilled. ||4||1||3||

[Ang 454 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੬ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 chhant ghar 6 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Chhant, Sixth House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਈ ਜਪਾਤ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kau bhe kripaal prabh har har seee japaat |
English: Those beings, unto whom the Lord God shows His Mercy, meditate on the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਤਿਨੑ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਭੇਟਤ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਾਤ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak preet lagee tina raam siau bhettat saadh sangaat |1|
English: O Nanak, they embrace love for the Lord, meeting the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||

[Ang 454 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: chhant |
English: Chhant:

Gurbani: ਜਲ ਦੁਧ ਨਿਆਈ ਰੀਤਿ ਅਬ ਦੁਧ ਆਚ ਨਹੀ ਮਨ ਐਸੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jal dudh niaaee reet ab dudh aach nahee man aisee preet hare |
English: Just like water, which loves milk so much that it will not let it burn - O my mind, so love the Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਉਰਝਿਓ ਅਲਿ ਕਮਲੇਹ ਬਾਸਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਮਗਨ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਭੀ ਨਾਹਿ ਟਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: ab urajhio al kamaleh baasan maeh magan ik khin bhee naeh ttarai |
English: The bumble bee becomes enticed by the lotus, intoxicated by its fragrance, and does not leave it, even for a moment.

Gurbani: ਖਿਨੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਟਰੀਐ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹਰੀਐ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਹਭਿ ਰਸ ਅਰਪੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: khin naeh ttareeai preet hareeai seegaar habh ras arapeeai |
English: Do not let up your love for the Lord, even for an instant; dedicate all your decorations and pleasures to Him.

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਦੂਖੁ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਜਮ ਪੰਥੁ ਭਣੀਐ ਤਹ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਡਰਪੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: jeh dookh suneeai jam panth bhaneeai teh saadhasang na ddarapeeai |
English: Where painful cries are heard, and the Way of Death is shown, there, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall not be afraid.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਣੀਐ ਸਗਲ ਪ੍ਰਾਛਤ ਦੁਖ ਹਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kar keerat govind guneeai sagal praachhat dukh hare |
English: Sing the Kirtan, the Praises of the Lord of the Universe, and all sins and sorrows shall depart.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਛੰਤ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਕਰੇਹੁ ਐਸੀ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak chhant govind har ke man har siau nehu karehu aisee man preet hare |1|
English: Says Nanak, chant the Hymns of the Lord, the Lord of the Universe, O mind, and enshrine love for the Lord; love the Lord this way in your mind. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੀ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਨੀਰ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਭੀ ਨਾ ਧੀਰੇ ਮਨ ਐਸਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਕਰੇਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: jaisee machhulee neer ik khin bhee naa dheere man aisaa nehu karehu |
English: As the fish loves the water, and is not content even for an instant outside it, O my mind, love the Lord in this way.

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੀ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਪਿਆਸ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਬੂੰਦ ਚਵੈ ਬਰਸੁ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ ਮੇਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: jaisee chaatrik piaas khin khin boond chavai baras suhaave mehu |
English: Like the song-bird, thirsting for the rain-drops, chirping each and every moment to the beautiful rain clouds.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰੀਜੈ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਅਤਿ ਲਾਈਐ ਚਿਤੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: har preet kareejai ihu man deejai at laaeeai chit muraaree |
English: So love the Lord, and give to Him this mind of yours; totally focus your consciousness on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੀਜੈ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: maan na keejai saran pareejai darasan kau balihaaree |
English: Do not take pride in yourself, but seek the Sanctuary of the Lord, and make yourself a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨੇ ਮਿਲੁ ਨਾਹ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੇ ਧਨ ਦੇਦੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਨੇਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur suprasane mil naah vichhune dhan dedee saach sanehaa |
English: When the Guru is totally pleased, the separated soul-bride is re-united with her Husband Lord; she sends the message of her true love.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਛੰਤ ਅਨੰਤ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਕੀਜੈ ਨੇਹਾ ਮਨ ਐਸਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਕਰੇਹੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak chhant anant tthaakur ke har siau keejai nehaa man aisaa nehu karehu |2|
English: Says Nanak, chant the Hymns of the Infinite Lord Master; O my mind, love Him and enshrine such love for Him. ||2||

Gurbani: ਚਕਵੀ ਸੂਰ ਸਨੇਹੁ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਆਸ ਘਣੀ ਕਦਿ ਦਿਨੀਅਰੁ ਦੇਖੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: chakavee soor sanehu chitavai aas ghanee kad dineear dekheeai |
English: The chakvi bird is in love with the sun, and thinks of it constantly; her greatest longing is to behold the dawn.

Gurbani: ਕੋਕਿਲ ਅੰਬ ਪਰੀਤਿ ਚਵੈ ਸੁਹਾਵੀਆ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਕੀਜੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: kokil anb pareet chavai suhaaveea man har rang keejeeai |
English: The cuckoo is in love with the mango tree, and sings so sweetly. O my mind, love the Lord in this way.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰੀਜੈ ਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਇਕ ਰਾਤੀ ਕੇ ਹਭਿ ਪਾਹੁਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: har preet kareejai maan na keejai ik raatee ke habh paahuniaa |
English: Love the Lord, and do not take pride in yourself; everyone is a guest for a single night.

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਕਿਆ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇਓ ਮੋਹੁ ਰਚਾਇਓ ਨਾਗੇ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: ab kiaa rang laaeo mohu rachaaeo naage aavan jaavaniaa |
English: Now, why are you entangled in pleasures, and engrossed in emotional attachment? Naked we come, and naked we go.

Gurbani: ਥਿਰੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਣੀ ਪੜੀਐ ਚਰਣੀ ਅਬ ਟੂਟਸਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਜੁ ਕਿਤੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: thir saadhoo saranee parreeai charanee ab ttoottas mohu ju kiteeai |
English: Seek the eternal Sanctuary of the Holy and fall at their feet, and the attachments which you feel shall depart.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਛੰਤ ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਕੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਇ ਪਰੀਤਿ ਕਬ ਦਿਨੀਅਰੁ ਦੇਖੀਐ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak chhant deaal purakh ke man har laae pareet kab dineear dekheeai |3|
English: Says Nanak, chant the Hymns of the Merciful Lord God, and enshrine love for the Lord, O my mind; otherwise, how will you come to behold the dawn? ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਿਸਿ ਕੁਰੰਕ ਜੈਸੇ ਨਾਦ ਸੁਣਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਹੀਉ ਡਿਵੈ ਮਨ ਐਸੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: nis kurank jaise naad sun sravanee heeo ddivai man aisee preet keejai |
English: Like the deer in the night, who hears the sound of the bell and gives his heart - O my mind, love the Lord in this way.

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੀ ਤਰੁਣਿ ਭਤਾਰ ਉਰਝੀ ਪਿਰਹਿ ਸਿਵੈ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਲ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: jaisee tarun bhataar urajhee pireh sivai ihu man laal deejai |
English: Like the wife, who is bound by love to her husband, and serves her beloved - like this, give your heart to the Beloved Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਲਾਲਹਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਭੋਗ ਕਰੀਜੈ ਹਭਿ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: man laaleh deejai bhog kareejai habh khuseea rang maane |
English: Give your heart to your Beloved Lord, and enjoy His bed, and enjoy all pleasure and bliss.

Gurbani: ਪਿਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਅਤਿ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਚਿਰਾਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: pir apanaa paaeaa rang laal banaaeaa at milio mitr chiraane |
English: I have obtained my Husband Lord, and I am dyed in the deep crimson color of His Love; after such a long time, I have met my Friend.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਥੀਆ ਸਾਖੀ ਤਾ ਡਿਠਮੁ ਆਖੀ ਪਿਰ ਜੇਹਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur theea saakhee taa ddittham aakhee pir jehaa avar na deesai |
English: When the Guru became my advocate, then I saw the Lord with my eyes. No one else looks like my Beloved Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਛੰਤ ਦਇਆਲ ਮੋਹਨ ਕੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਗਹੀਜੈ ਐਸੀ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੪॥੧॥੪॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak chhant deaal mohan ke man har charan gaheejai aisee man preet keejai |4|1|4|
English: Says Nanak, chant the Hymns of the merciful and fascinating Lord, O mind. Grasp the lotus feet of the Lord, and enshrine such love for Him in your mind. ||4||1||4||

[Ang 455 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl||

Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਬਨੁ ਬਨੁ ਫਿਰਤੀ ਖੋਜਤੀ ਹਾਰੀ ਬਹੁ ਅਵਗਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: ban ban firatee khojatee haaree bahu avagaeh |
English: From forest to forest, I wandered searching; I am so tired of taking baths at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਭੇਟੇ ਸਾਧ ਜਬ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak bhette saadh jab har paaeaa man maeh |1|
English: O Nanak, when I met the Holy Saint, I found the Lord within my mind. ||1||

[Ang 455 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਛੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: chhant |
English: Chhant:

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਖੋਜਹਿ ਅਸੰਖ ਮੁਨੀ ਅਨੇਕ ਤਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kau khojeh asankh munee anek tape |
English: Countless silent sages and innumerable ascetics seek Him;

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਾਪ ਜਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: brahame kott araadheh giaanee jaap jape |
English: millions of Brahmas meditate and adore Him; the spiritual teachers meditate and chant His Name.

Gurbani: ਜਪ ਤਾਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਪੂਜਾ ਅਨਿਕ ਸੋਧਨ ਬੰਦਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jap taap sanjam kiriaa poojaa anik sodhan bandanaa |
English: Through chanting, deep meditation, strict and austere self-discipline, religious rituals, sincere worship, endless purifications and humble salutations,

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਗਵਨੁ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਤੀਰਥਹ ਮਜਨੁ ਮਿਲਨ ਕਉ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: kar gavan basudhaa teerathah majan milan kau niranjanaa |
English: wandering all over the earth and bathing at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, people seek to meet the Pure Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਾਨੁਖ ਬਨੁ ਤਿਨੁ ਪਸੂ ਪੰਖੀ ਸਗਲ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਅਰਾਧਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: maanukh ban tin pasoo pankhee sagal tujheh araadhate |
English: Mortals, forests, blades of grass, animals and birds all meditate on You.

Gurbani: ਦਇਆਲ ਲਾਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਗਤੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: deaal laal gobind naanak mil saadhasangat hoe gate |1|
English: The Merciful Beloved Lord, the Lord of the Universe is found; O Nanak, joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, salvation is attained. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਬਿਸਨ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਸੰਕਰ ਜਟਾਧਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: kott bisan avataar sankar jattaadhaar |
English: Millions of incarnations of Vishnu and Shiva, with matted hair

Gurbani: ਚਾਹਹਿ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਦਇਆਰ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰੁਚ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: chaaheh tujheh deaar man tan ruch apaar |
English: yearn for You, O Merciful Lord; their minds and bodies are filled with infinite longing.

Gurbani: ਅਪਾਰ ਅਗਮ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਗਲ ਪੂਰਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: apaar agam gobind tthaakur sagal poorak prabh dhanee |
English: The Lord Master, the Lord of the Universe, is infinite and unapproachable; God is the all-pervading Lord of all.

Gurbani: ਸੁਰ ਸਿਧ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਜਖ ਕਿੰਨਰ ਗੁਣ ਭਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: sur sidh gan gandharab dhiaaveh jakh kinar gun bhanee |
English: The angels,the Siddhas,the beings of spiritual perfection,the heavenly heralds and celestial singers meditate on You. The Yakhsha demons,the guards of the divine treasures,and the Kinnars, the dancers of the god of wealth chant Your Glorious Praises.

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਅਨੇਕ ਦੇਵਾ ਜਪਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: kott indr anek devaa japat suaamee jai jai kaar |
English: Millions of Indras and countless gods and super-human beings meditate on the Lord Master and celebrate His Praises.

Gurbani: ਅਨਾਥ ਨਾਥ ਦਇਆਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਉਧਾਰ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: anaath naath deaal naanak saadhasangat mil udhaar |2|
English: The Merciful Lord is the Master of the masterless, O Nanak; joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one is saved. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਦੇਵੀ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਲਖਿਮੀ ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: kott devee jaa kau seveh lakhimee anik bhaat |
English: Millions of gods and goddesses of wealth serve Him in so many ways.

Gurbani: ਗੁਪਤ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ ਪਉਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: gupat pragatt jaa kau araadheh paun paanee dinas raat |
English: The invisible and visible beings worship Him in adoration, along with wind and water, day and night.

Gurbani: ਨਖਿਅਤ੍ਰ ਸਸੀਅਰ ਸੂਰ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਬਸੁਧ ਗਗਨਾ ਗਾਵਏ ॥
Transliteration: nakhiatr saseear soor dhiaaveh basudh gaganaa gaave |
English: The stars, the moon and the sun meditate on Him; the earth and the sky sing to Him.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਖਾਣੀ ਸਗਲ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਵਏ ॥
Transliteration: sagal khaanee sagal baanee sadaa sadaa dhiaave |
English: All the sources of creation, and all languages meditate on Him, forever and ever.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਚਤੁਰ ਬੇਦਹ ਖਟੁ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਜਪਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: simrit puraan chatur bedah khatt saasatr jaa kau japaat |
English: The Simritees, the Puraanas, the four Vedas and the six Shaastras meditate on Him.

Gurbani: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਤਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: patit paavan bhagat vachhal naanak mileeai sang saat |3|
English: He is the Purifier of sinners, the Lover of His Saints; O Nanak, He is met in the Society of the Saints. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੇਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਜਨਾਈ ਰਸਨਾ ਤੇਤ ਭਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: jetee prabhoo janaaee rasanaa tet bhanee |
English: As much as God has revealed to us, that much we can speak with our tongues.

Gurbani: ਅਨਜਾਨਤ ਜੋ ਸੇਵੈ ਤੇਤੀ ਨਹ ਜਾਇ ਗਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: anajaanat jo sevai tetee neh jaae ganee |
English: Those unknown ones who serve You cannot be counted.

Gurbani: ਅਵਿਗਤ ਅਗਨਤ ਅਥਾਹ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਗਲ ਮੰਝੇ ਬਾਹਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: avigat aganat athaah tthaakur sagal manjhe baaharaa |
English: Imperishable, incalculable, and unfathomable is the Lord and Master; He is everywhere, inside and out.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਏਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਨਹ ਦੂਰਿ ਸੰਗੀ ਜਾਹਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sarab jaachik ek daataa neh door sangee jaaharaa |
English: We are all beggars, He is the One and only Giver; He is not far away, but is with us, ever-present.

Gurbani: ਵਸਿ ਭਗਤ ਥੀਆ ਮਿਲੇ ਜੀਆ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਕਿਤ ਗਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: vas bhagat theea mile jeea taa kee upamaa kit ganee |
English: He is in the power of His devotees; those whose souls are united with Him - how can their praises be sung?

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਾਏ ਸੀਸੁ ਸਾਧਹ ਧਰਿ ਚਰਨੀ ॥੪॥੨॥੫॥
Transliteration: eihu daan maan naanak paae sees saadhah dhar charanee |4|2|5|
English: May Nanak receive this gift and honor, of placing his head on the feet of the Holy Saints. ||4||2||5||

[Ang 456 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl,

Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਹੋ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: audam karahu vaddabhaageeho simarahu har har raae |
English: Make the effort, O very fortunate ones, and meditate on the Lord, the Lord King.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak jis simarat sabh sukh hoveh dookh darad bhram jaae |1|
English: O Nanak, remembering Him in meditation, you shall obtain total peace, and your pains and troubles and doubts shall depart. ||1||

[Ang 456 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: chhant |
English: Chhant:

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਹ ਅਲਸਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: naam japat gobind neh alasaaeeai |
English: Chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord of the Universe; don't be lazy.

Gurbani: ਭੇਟਤ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਨਹ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: bhettat saadhoo sang jam pur neh jaaeeai |
English: Meeting with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall not have to go to the City of Death.

Gurbani: ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਨ ਭਉ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਦ ਸੁਖੀ ॥
Transliteration: dookh darad na bhau biaapai naam simarat sad sukhee |
English: Pain, trouble and fear will not afflict you; meditating on the Naam, a lasting peace is found.

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖੀ ॥
Transliteration: saas saas araadh har har dhiaae so prabh man mukhee |
English: With each and every breath, worship the Lord in adoration; meditate on the Lord God in your mind and with your mouth.

Gurbani: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਰਸਾਲ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: kripaal deaal rasaal gun nidh kar deaa sevaa laaeeai |
English: O kind and compassionate Lord, O treasure of sublime essence, treasure of excellence, please link me to Your service.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਚਰਣ ਜੰਪੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਹ ਅਲਸਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak peianpai charan janpai naam japat gobind neh alasaaeeai |1|
English: Prays Nanak: may I meditate on the Lord's lotus feet, and not be lazy in chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord of the Universe. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪਾਵਨ ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: paavan patit puneet naam niranjanaa |
English: The Purifier of sinners is the Naam, the Pure Name of the Immaculate Lord.

Gurbani: ਭਰਮ ਅੰਧੇਰ ਬਿਨਾਸ ਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਜਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: bharam andher binaas giaan gur anjanaa |
English: The darkness of doubt is removed by the healing ointment of the Guru's spiritual wisdom.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur giaan anjan prabh niranjan jal thal maheeal pooriaa |
English: By the healing ointment of the Guru's spiritual wisdom, one meets the Immaculate Lord God, who is totally pervading the water, the land and the sky.

Gurbani: ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਿਟੇ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਵਿਸੂਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: eik nimakh jaa kai ridai vasiaa mitte tiseh visooriaa |
English: If He dwells within the heart, for even an instant, sorrows are forgotten.

Gurbani: ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧ ਸਮਰਥ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਰਬ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: agaadh bodh samarath suaamee sarab kaa bhau bhanjanaa |
English: The wisdom of the all-powerful Lord and Master is incomprehensible; He is the Destroyer of the fears of all.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਚਰਣ ਜੰਪੈ ਪਾਵਨ ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak peianpai charan janpai paavan patit puneet naam niranjanaa |2|
English: Prays Nanak, I meditate on the Lord's lotus feet. The Purifier of sinners is the Naam, the Pure Name of the Immaculate Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧੇ ॥
Transliteration: ott gahee gopaal deaal kripaa nidhe |
English: I have grasped the protection of the merciful Lord, the Sustainer of the Universe, the treasure of grace.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਆਸਰ ਤੁਅ ਚਰਨ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਿਧੇ ॥
Transliteration: mohi aasar tua charan tumaaree saran sidhe |
English: I take the support of Your lotus feet, and in the protection of Your Sanctuary, I attain perfection.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਰਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har charan kaaran karan suaamee patit udharan har hare |
English: The Lord's lotus feet are the cause of causes; the Lord Master saves even the sinners.

Gurbani: ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਭਵ ਉਤਾਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਬਹੁ ਤਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: saagar sansaar bhav utaar naam simarat bahu tare |
English: So many are saved; they cross over the terrifying world-ocean, contemplating the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਖੋਜਹਿ ਸੁਨੀ ਉਧਰਨ ਸੰਤਸੰਗ ਬਿਧੇ ॥
Transliteration: aad ant beant khojeh sunee udharan santasang bidhe |
English: In the beginning and in the end, countless are those who seek the Lord. I have heard that the Society of the Saints is the way to salvation.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਚਰਨ ਜੰਪੈ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak peianpai charan janpai ott gahee gopaal deaal kripaa nidhe |3|
English: Prays Nanak, I meditate on the Lord's lotus feet, and grasp the protection of the Lord of the Universe, the merciful, the ocean of kindness. ||3||

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਆਪਿ ਬਨਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat vachhal har birad aap banaaeaa |
English: The Lord is the Lover of His devotees; this is His natural way.

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਸੰਤ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jeh jeh sant araadheh teh teh pragattaaeaa |
English: Wherever the Saints worship the Lord in adoration, there He is revealed.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਲੀਏ ਸਮਾਇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਭਗਤ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: prabh aap lee samaae sehaj subhaae bhagat kaaraj saariaa |
English: God blends Himself with His devotees in His natural way, and resolves their affairs.

Gurbani: ਆਨੰਦ ਹਰਿ ਜਸ ਮਹਾ ਮੰਗਲ ਸਰਬ ਦੂਖ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: aanand har jas mahaa mangal sarab dookh visaariaa |
English: In the ecstasy of the Lord's Praises, they obtain supreme joy, and forget all their sorrows.

Gurbani: ਚਮਤਕਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਏਕੁ ਤਹ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: chamatakaar pragaas deh dis ek teh drisattaaeaa |
English: The brilliant flash of the One Lord is revealed to them - they behold Him in the ten directions.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਚਰਣ ਜੰਪੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਆਪਿ ਬਨਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੩॥੬॥
Transliteration: naanak peianpai charan janpai bhagat vachhal har birad aap banaaeaa |4|3|6|
English: Prays Nanak, I meditate on the Lord's lotus feet; the Lord is the Lover of His devotees; this is His natural way. ||4||3||6||

[Ang 457 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਥਿਰੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਵਏ ॥
Transliteration: thir santan sohaag marai na jaave |
English: The Husband Lord of the Saints is eternal; He does not die or go away.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਹੁ ਸੁ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਰਾਵਏ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai grihi har naahu su sad hee raave |
English: She, whose home is blessed by her Husband Lord, enjoys Him forever.

Gurbani: ਅਵਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਵਿਗਤੁ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਨਵਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: avinaasee avigat so prabh sadaa navatan niramalaa |
English: God is eternal and immortal, forever young and immaculately pure.

Gurbani: ਨਹ ਦੂਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: neh door sadaa hadoor tthaakur deh dis pooran sad sadaa |
English: He is not far away, He is ever-present; the Lord and Master fills the ten directions, forever and ever.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
Transliteration: praanapat gat mat jaa te pria preet preetam bhaave |
English: He is the Lord of souls, the source of salvation and wisdom. The Love of my Dear Beloved is pleasing to me.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਥਿਰੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਵਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak vakhaanai gur bachan jaanai thir santan sohaag marai na jaave |1|
English: Nanak speaks what the Guru's Teachings have led him to know. The Husband Lord of the Saints is eternal; He does not die or go away. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਰਾਮ ਭਤਾਰੁ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਅਨਦੁ ਘਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kau raam bhataar taa kai anad ghanaa |
English: One who has the Lord as her Husband enjoys great bliss.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖਵੰਤੀ ਸਾ ਨਾਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪੂਰਿ ਬਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: sukhavantee saa naar sobhaa poor banaa |
English: That soul-bride is happy, and her glory is perfect.

Gurbani: ਮਾਣੁ ਮਹਤੁ ਕਲਿਆਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਰਜਨੁ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ॥
Transliteration: maan mehat kaliaan har jas sang surajan so prabhoo |
English: She obtains honor, greatness and happiness, singing the Praise of the Lord. God, the Great Being, is always with her.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਨਹੀ ਊਨਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਛੂ ॥
Transliteration: sarab sidh nav nidh tith grihi nahee aoonaa sabh kachhoo |
English: She attains total perfection and the nine treasures; her home lacks nothing. - everything is there.

Gurbani: ਮਧੁਰ ਬਾਨੀ ਪਿਰਹਿ ਮਾਨੀ ਥਿਰੁ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਬਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: madhur baanee pireh maanee thir sohaag taa kaa banaa |
English: Her speech is so sweet; she obeys her Beloved Lord; her marriage is permanent and everlasting.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਰਾਮੁ ਭਤਾਰੁ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਅਨਦੁ ਘਣਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak vakhaanai gur bachan jaanai jaa ko raam bhataar taa kai anad ghanaa |2|
English: Nanak chants what he knows through the Guru's Teachings: One who has the Lord as her Husband enjoys great bliss. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਉ ਸਖੀ ਸੰਤ ਪਾਸਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: aau sakhee sant paas sevaa laageeai |
English: Come, O my companions, let us dedicate ourselves to serving the Saints.

Gurbani: ਪੀਸਉ ਚਰਣ ਪਖਾਰਿ ਆਪੁ ਤਿਆਗੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: peesau charan pakhaar aap tiaageeai |
English: Let us grind their corn, wash their feet and so renounce our self-conceit.

Gurbani: ਤਜਿ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ਆਪੁ ਨਹ ਜਾਣਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: taj aap mittai santaap aap neh jaanaaeeai |
English: Let us shed our egos, and our troubles shall be removed; let us not display ourselves.

Gurbani: ਸਰਣਿ ਗਹੀਜੈ ਮਾਨਿ ਲੀਜੈ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: saran gaheejai maan leejai kare so sukh paaeeai |
English: Let us take to His Sanctuary and obey Him, and be happy with whatever He does.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸੀ ਤਜਿ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਜਾਗੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: kar daas daasee taj udaasee kar jorr din rain jaageeai |
English: Let us become the slaves of His slaves, and shed our sadness, and with our palms pressed together, remain wakeful day and night.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਉ ਸਖੀ ਸੰਤ ਪਾਸਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੀਐ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak vakhaanai gur bachan jaanai aau sakhee sant paas sevaa laageeai |3|
English: Nanak chants what he knows through the Guru's Teachings; come, O my companions, let us dedicate ourselves to serving the Saints. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗ ਸਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai masatak bhaag si sevaa laaeaa |
English: One who has such good destiny written upon his forehead, dedicates himself to His service.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸ ਜਿਨੑ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: taa kee pooran aas jina saadhasang paaeaa |
English: One who attains the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, has his desires fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਲਾਗਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang har kai rang gobind simaran laagiaa |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, immerse yourself in the Love of the Lord; remember the Lord of the Universe in meditation.

Gurbani: ਭਰਮੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਸਗਲ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਤਿਆਗਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: bharam mohu vikaar doojaa sagal tineh tiaagiaa |
English: Doubt, emotional attachment, sin and duality - he renounces them all.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜੁ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਵੂਠਾ ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: man saant sehaj subhaau vootthaa anad mangal gun gaaeaa |
English: Peace, poise and tranquility fill his mind, and he sings the Lord's Glorious Praises with joy and delight.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗ ਸਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੪॥੭॥
Transliteration: naanak vakhaanai gur bachan jaanai jaa kai masatak bhaag si sevaa laaeaa |4|4|7|
English: Nanak chants what he knows through the Guru's Teachings: one who has such good destiny written upon his forehead, dedicates himself to His service. ||4||4||7||

[Ang 457 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl,

Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੰਤਿਆ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਕਹੈ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam japantiaa kachh na kahai jamakaal |
English: If you chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the Messenger of Death will have nothing to say to you.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੁਖੀ ਹੋਇ ਅੰਤੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੋਪਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak man tan sukhee hoe ante milai gopaal |1|
English: O Nanak, the mind and body will be at peace, and in the end, you shall merge with the Lord of the world. ||1||

[Ang 457 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਛੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: chhant |
English: Chhant:

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਉ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਉਧਾਰਿ ਲੇਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: milau santan kai sang mohi udhaar lehu |
English: Let me join the Society of the Saints - save me, Lord!

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰਉ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: binau krau kar jorr har har naam dehu |
English: With my palms pressed together, I offer my prayer: give me Your Name, O Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਾਗਉ ਚਰਣ ਲਾਗਉ ਮਾਨੁ ਤਿਆਗਉ ਤੁਮੑ ਦਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: har naam maagau charan laagau maan tiaagau tuma deaa |
English: I beg for the Lord's Name, and fall at His feet; I renounce my self-conceit, by Your kindness.

Gurbani: ਕਤਹੂੰ ਨ ਧਾਵਉ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਾਵਉ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਿ ਮਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: katahoon na dhaavau saran paavau karunaa mai prabh kar meaa |
English: I shall not wander anywhere else, but take to Your Sanctuary. O God, embodiment of mercy, have mercy on me.

Gurbani: ਸਮਰਥ ਅਗਥ ਅਪਾਰ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਬਿਨਉ ਏਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: samarath agath apaar niramal sunahu suaamee binau ehu |
English: O all-powerful, indescribable, infinite and immaculate Lord Master, listen to this, my prayer.

Gurbani: ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਨੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਲੇਹੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kar jorr naanak daan maagai janam maran nivaar lehu |1|
English: With palms pressed together, Nanak begs for this blessing: O Lord, let my cycle of birth and death come to an end. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਮਤਿਹੀਨੁ ਨਿਰਗੁਨੁ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਨੀਚੁ ॥
Transliteration: aparaadhee matiheen niragun anaath neech |
English: I am a sinner, devoid of wisdom, worthless, destitute and vile.

Gurbani: ਸਠ ਕਠੋਰੁ ਕੁਲਹੀਨੁ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਮੋਹ ਕੀਚੁ ॥
Transliteration: satth katthor kulaheen biaapat moh keech |
English: I am deceitful, hard-hearted, lowly and entangled in the mud of emotional attachment.

Gurbani: ਮਲ ਭਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਅਹੰ ਮਮਤਾ ਮਰਣੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਏ ॥
Transliteration: mal bharam karam ahan mamataa maran cheet na aave |
English: I am stuck in the filth of doubt and egotistical actions, and I try not to think of death.

Gurbani: ਬਨਿਤਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਅਨੰਦ ਮਾਇਆ ਅਗਿਆਨਤਾ ਲਪਟਾਵਏ ॥
Transliteration: banitaa binod anand maaeaa agiaanataa lapattaave |
English: In ignorance, I cling to the pleasures of woman and the joys of Maya.

Gurbani: ਖਿਸੈ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਬਧੈ ਜਰੂਆ ਦਿਨ ਨਿਹਾਰੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੀਚੁ ॥
Transliteration: khisai joban badhai jarooaa din nihaare sang meech |
English: My youth is wasting away, old age is approaching, and Death, my companion, is counting my days.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਸ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਰਾਖੁ ਨੀਚੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak aas teree saran saadhoo raakh neech |2|
English: Prays Nanak, my hope is in You, Lord; please preserve me, the lowly one, in the Sanctuary of the Holy. ||2||

Gurbani: ਭਰਮੇ ਜਨਮ ਅਨੇਕ ਸੰਕਟ ਮਹਾ ਜੋਨ ॥
Transliteration: bharame janam anek sankatt mahaa jon |
English: I have wandered through countless incarnations, suffering terrible pain in these lives.

Gurbani: ਲਪਟਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਤਿਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੀਠੇ ਭੋਗ ਸੋਨ ॥
Transliteration: lapatt rahio tih sang meetthe bhog son |
English: I am entangled in sweet pleasures and gold.

Gurbani: ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਭਾਰ ਅਗਨਤ ਆਇਓ ਬਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਦੇਸਹ ਧਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: bhramat bhaar aganat aaeo bahu pradesah dhaaeo |
English: After wandering around with such great loads of sin, I have come, after wandering through so many foreign lands.

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਓਟ ਧਾਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: ab ott dhaaree prabh muraaree sarab sukh har naaeo |
English: Now, I have taken the protection of God, and I have found total peace in the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮੁਝ ਤੇ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਆ ਹੋਨ ॥
Transliteration: raakhanahaare prabh piaare mujh te kachhoo na hoaa hon |
English: God, my Beloved, is my protector; nothing was done, or will ever be done, by myself alone.

Gurbani: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਨਾਨਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਤਰੈ ਭਉਨ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sookh sehaj aanand naanak kripaa teree tarai bhaun |3|
English: I have found peace, poise and bliss, O Nanak; by Your mercy, I swim across the world-ocean. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਧਾਰੀਕ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਭਗਤਹ ਸੰਸਾ ਕਉਨ ॥
Transliteration: naam dhaareek udhaare bhagatah sansaa kaun |
English: You saved those who only pretended to believe, so what doubts should Your true devotees have?

Gurbani: ਜੇਨ ਕੇਨ ਪਰਕਾਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ॥
Transliteration: jen ken parakaare har har jas sunahu sravan |
English: By every means possible, listen to the Praises of the Lord with your ears.

Gurbani: ਸੁਨਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਬਾਨੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਮਨਿ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ਪਾਵਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: sun sravan baanee purakh giaanee man nidhaanaa paavahe |
English: Listen with your ears to the Word of the Lord's Bani, the hymns of spiritual wisdom; thus you shall obtain the treasure in your mind.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ਰਾਮ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: har rang raate prabh bidhaate raam ke gun gaavahe |
English: Attuned to the Love of the Lord God, the Architect of Destiny, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਬਸੁਧ ਕਾਗਦ ਬਨਰਾਜ ਕਲਮਾ ਲਿਖਣ ਕਉ ਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਪਵਨ ॥
Transliteration: basudh kaagad banaraaj kalamaa likhan kau je hoe pavan |
English: The earth is the paper, the forest is the pen and the wind is the writer,

Gurbani: ਬੇਅੰਤ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਪਾਇਆ ਗਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਚਰਣ ਸਰਨ ॥੪॥੫॥੮॥
Transliteration: beant ant na jaae paaeaa gahee naanak charan saran |4|5|8|
English: but still, the end of the endless Lord cannot be found. O Nanak, I have taken to the Sanctuary of His lotus feet. ||4||5||8||

[Ang 458 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪੁਰਖ ਪਤੇ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਗਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: purakh pate bhagavaan taa kee saran gahee |
English: The Primal Lord is the Lord God of all beings. I have taken to His Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਪਰਾਨ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਸਗਲ ਲਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: nirbhau bhe paraan chintaa sagal lahee |
