English: My life has become fearless, and all my anxieties have been removed.

Gurbani: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਮੀਤ ਸੁਰਿਜਨ ਇਸਟ ਬੰਧਪ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: maat pitaa sut meet surijan isatt bandhap jaaniaa |
English: I know the Lord as my mother, father, son, friend, well-wisher and close relative.

Gurbani: ਗਹਿ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਜਸੁ ਬਿਮਲ ਸੰਤ ਵਖਾਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: geh kantth laaeaa gur milaaeaa jas bimal sant vakhaaniaa |
English: The Guru has led me to embrace Him; the Saints chant His Pure Praises.

Gurbani: ਬੇਅੰਤ ਗੁਣ ਅਨੇਕ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਕਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: beant gun anek mahimaa keemat kachhoo na jaae kahee |
English: His Glorious Virtues are infinite, and His greatness is unlimited. His value cannot be described at all.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਅਲਖ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਓਟ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਗਹੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: prabh ek anik alakh tthaakur ott naanak tis gahee |1|
English: God is the One and only, the Unseen Lord and Master; O Nanak, I have grasped His protection. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਨੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਹਾਈ ਆਪਿ ਭਏ ॥
Transliteration: amrit ban sansaar sahaaee aap bhe |
English: The world is a pool of nectar, when the Lord becomes our helper.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰ ਹਾਰੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਕੇ ਦਿਵਸ ਗਏ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam ur haar bikh ke divas ge |
English: One who wears the necklace of the Lord's Name - his days of suffering are ended.

Gurbani: ਗਤੁ ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਜੋਨਿ ਆਵਣ ਸਭ ਰਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: gat bharam moh bikaar binase jon aavan sabh rahe |
English: His state of doubt, attachment and sin is erased, and the cycle of reincarnation into the womb is totally ended.

Gurbani: ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਭਏ ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਧ ਅੰਚਲ ਗਹਿ ਰਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: agan saagar bhe seetal saadh anchal geh rahe |
English: The ocean of fire becomes cool, when one grasps the hem of the robe of the Holy Saint.

Gurbani: ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਿਥ ਬੋਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਹਰਿ ਜੈ ਜਏ ॥
Transliteration: govind gupaal deaal samrith bol saadhoo har jai je |
English: The Lord of the Universe, the Sustainer of the World, the merciful all-powerful Lord - the Holy Saints proclaim the victory of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਈ ਪਰਮ ਗਤੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naam dhiaae pooran saadhasang paaee param gate |2|
English: O Nanak, meditating on the Naam, in the perfect Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I have obtained the supreme status. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jeh dekhau teh sang eko rav rahiaa |
English: Wherever I look, there I find the One Lord permeating and pervading all.

Gurbani: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਵਾਸੀ ਆਪਿ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਲਹਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt vaasee aap viralai kinai lahiaa |
English: In each and every heart, He Himself dwells, but how rare is that person who realizes this.

Gurbani: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਕੀਟ ਹਸਤਿ ਸਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jal thal maheeal poor pooran keett hasat samaaniaa |
English: The Lord is permeating and pervading the water, the land and the sky; He is contained in the ant and the elephant.

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤੇ ਮਧਿ ਸੋਈ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: aad ante madh soee gur prasaadee jaaniaa |
English: In the beginning, in the middle and in the end, He exists. By Guru's Grace, He is known.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਲੀਲਾ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਜਨਿ ਕਹਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: braham pasariaa braham leelaa govind gun nidh jan kahiaa |
English: God created the expanse of the universe, God created the play of the world. His humble servants call Him the Lord of the Universe, the treasure of virtue.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: simar suaamee antarajaamee har ek naanak rav rahiaa |3|
English: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord Master, the Searcher of hearts; O Nanak, He is the One, pervading and permeating all. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੜੀ ਆਈ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: din rain suhaavarree aaee simarat naam hare |
English: Day and night, become beauteous by remembering the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਲਮਲ ਪਾਪ ਟਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal sang preet kalamal paap ttare |
English: In love with the Lord's Lotus Feet, corruption and sin depart.

Gurbani: ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਦਾਰਿਦ੍ਰ ਨਾਠੇ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਮਗੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: dookh bhookh daaridr naatthe pragatt mag dikhaaeaa |
English: Pain, hunger and poverty run away, and the path is clearly revealed.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗੇ ਮਨਿ ਲੋੜੀਦਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: mil saadhasange naam range man lorreedaa paaeaa |
English: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one is attuned to the Naam, and obtains the desires of the mind.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਕੁਲ ਸੰਬੂਹਾ ਸਭਿ ਤਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har dekh darasan ichh punee kul sanboohaa sabh tare |
English: Beholding the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, desires are fulfilled; all one's family and relatives are saved.

Gurbani: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਅਨੰਦ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰੰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੪॥੬॥੯॥
Transliteration: dinas rain anand anadin simarant naanak har hare |4|6|9|
English: Day and night, he is in bliss, night and day, remembering the Lord in meditation, O Nanak. ||4||6||9||

[Ang 459 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੭ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 chhant ghar 7 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Chhant, Seventh House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਸੁਭ ਚਿੰਤਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਰਮਣ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗ ॥
Transliteration: subh chintan gobind raman niramal saadhoo sang |
English: It is the most sublime contemplation, to speak of the Lord of the Universe in the pure Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਰਉ ਇਕ ਘੜੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak naam na visrau ik gharree kar kirapaa bhagavant |1|
English: O Nanak, never forget the Naam, even for a moment; bless me with Your Grace, Lord God! ||1||

[Ang 459 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਛੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: chhant |
English: Chhant:

Gurbani: ਭਿੰਨੀ ਰੈਨੜੀਐ ਚਾਮਕਨਿ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: bhinee rainarreeai chaamakan taare |
English: The night is wet with dew, and the stars twinkle in the heavens.

Gurbani: ਜਾਗਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jaageh sant janaa mere raam piaare |
English: The Saints remain wakeful; they are the Beloveds of my Lord.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਗਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੋ ॥
Transliteration: raam piaare sadaa jaageh naam simareh anadino |
English: The Beloveds of the Lord remain ever wakeful, remembering the Naam, the Name of the Lord, day and night.

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੋ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal dhiaan hiradai prabh bisar naahee ik khino |
English: In their hearts, they meditate on the lotus feet of God; they do not forget Him, even for an instant.

Gurbani: ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਿਕਾਰੁ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਕਲਮਲਾ ਦੁਖ ਜਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: taj maan mohu bikaar man kaa kalamalaa dukh jaare |
English: They renounce their pride, emotional attachment and mental corruption, and burn away the pain of wickedness.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਗਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak sadaa jaageh har daas sant piaare |1|
English: Prays Nanak, the Saints, the beloved servants of the Lord, remain ever wakeful. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੀ ਸੇਜੜੀਐ ਆਡੰਬਰੁ ਬਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: meree sejarreeai aaddanbar baniaa |
English: My bed is adorned in splendor.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਵਤ ਸੁਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: man anad bheaa prabh aavat suniaa |
English: My mind is filled with bliss, since I heard that God is coming.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਖਹ ਗਾਮੀ ਚਾਵ ਮੰਗਲ ਰਸ ਭਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: prabh mile suaamee sukhah gaamee chaav mangal ras bhare |
English: Meeting God, the Lord and Master, I have entered the realm of peace; I am filled with joy and delight.

Gurbani: ਅੰਗ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਦੂਖ ਭਾਗੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਸਭਿ ਹਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: ang sang laage dookh bhaage praan man tan sabh hare |
English: He is joined to me, in my very fiber; my sorrows have departed, and my body, mind and soul are all rejuvenated.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਇਛ ਪਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਿਆਈ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਸਾਹਾ ਸੁਭ ਗਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: man ichh paaee prabh dhiaaee sanjog saahaa subh ganiaa |
English: I have obtained the fruits of my mind's desires, meditating on God; the day of my wedding is auspicious.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲੇ ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਸਗਲ ਆਨੰਦ ਰਸੁ ਬਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak mile sreedhar sagal aanand ras baniaa |2|
English: Prays Nanak, when I meet the Lord of excellence, I came to experience all pleasure and bliss. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਖੀਆ ਪੁਛਹਿ ਕਹੁ ਕੰਤ ਨੀਸਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: mil sakheea puchheh kahu kant neesaanee |
English: I meet with my companions and say, "Show me the insignia of my Husband Lord."

Gurbani: ਰਸਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਰੀ ਕਛੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: ras prem bharee kachh bol na jaanee |
English: I am filled with the sublime essence of His Love, and I do not know how to say anything.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗੂੜ ਗੁਪਤ ਅਪਾਰ ਕਰਤੇ ਨਿਗਮ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: gun goorr gupat apaar karate nigam ant na paavahe |
English: The Glorious Virtues of the Creator are profound, mysterious and infinite; even the Vedas cannot find His limits.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਧਿਆਇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat bhaae dhiaae suaamee sadaa har gun gaavahe |
English: With loving devotion, I meditate on the Lord Master, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord forever.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਗੁਣ ਸੁਗਿਆਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਪਣੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: sagal gun sugiaan pooran aapane prabh bhaanee |
English: Filled with all virtues and spiritual wisdom, I have become pleasing to my God.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak rang raatee prem sehaj samaanee |3|
English: Prays Nanak, imbued with the color of the Lord's Love, I am imperceptibly absorbed into Him. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਸੋਹਿਲੜੇ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਵਣ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: sukh sohilarre har gaavan laage |
English: When I began to sing the songs of rejoicing to the Lord,

Gurbani: ਸਾਜਨ ਸਰਸਿਅੜੇ ਦੁਖ ਦੁਸਮਨ ਭਾਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: saajan sarasiarre dukh dusaman bhaage |
English: My friends became glad, and my troubles and enemies departed.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਸਰਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: sukh sehaj sarase har naam rahase prabh aap kirapaa dhaareea |
English: My peace and happiness increased; I rejoiced in the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and God Himself blessed me with His mercy.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਲਾਗੇ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਗੇ ਮਿਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਨਵਾਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: har charan laage sadaa jaage mile prabh banavaareea |
English: I have grasped the Lord's feet, and remaining ever wakeful, I have met the Lord, the Creator.

Gurbani: ਸੁਭ ਦਿਵਸ ਆਏ ਸਹਜਿ ਪਾਏ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: subh divas aae sehaj paae sagal nidh prabh paage |
English: The appointed day came, and I attained peace and poise; all treasures are in the feet of God.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਤਾਗੇ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak saran suaamee sadaa har jan taage |4|1|10|
English: Prays Nanak, the Lord's humble servants always seek the Sanctuary of the Lord and Master. ||4||1||10||

[Ang 459 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਉਠਿ ਵੰਞੁ ਵਟਾਊੜਿਆ ਤੈ ਕਿਆ ਚਿਰੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: autth vany vattaaoorriaa tai kiaa chir laaeaa |
English: Rise up and go forth, O traveller; why do you delay?

Gurbani: ਮੁਹਲਤਿ ਪੁੰਨੜੀਆ ਕਿਤੁ ਕੂੜਿ ਲੋਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: muhalat punarreea kit koorr lobhaaeaa |
English: Your allotted time is now complete - why are you engrossed in falsehood?

Gurbani: ਕੂੜੇ ਲੁਭਾਇਆ ਧੋਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਾਪ ਅਮਿਤਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: koorre lubhaaeaa dhohu maaeaa kareh paap amitiaa |
English: You desire that which is false; deceived by Maya, you commit innumerable sins.

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਭਸਮ ਢੇਰੀ ਜਮਹਿ ਹੇਰੀ ਕਾਲਿ ਬਪੁੜੈ ਜਿਤਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: tan bhasam dteree jameh heree kaal bapurrai jitiaa |
English: Your body shall become a pile of dust; the Messenger of Death has spotted you, and will conquer you.

Gurbani: ਮਾਲੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਵੈਸੀ ਰਹਿਓ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: maal joban chhodd vaisee rahio painan khaaeaa |
English: Abandoning your wealth and youth, you will have to leave, without any food or clothing.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਮਾਣਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਜੁਲਿਆ ਨਹ ਜਾਇ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak kamaanaa sang juliaa neh jaae kirat mittaaeaa |1|
English: O Nanak, only your actions shall go with you; the consequences of your actions cannot be erased. ||1||

Gurbani: ਫਾਥੋਹੁ ਮਿਰਗ ਜਿਵੈ ਪੇਖਿ ਰੈਣਿ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਾਇਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: faathohu mirag jivai pekh rain chandraaein |
English: Like the deer, captured on a moon-lit night,

Gurbani: ਸੂਖਹੁ ਦੂਖ ਭਏ ਨਿਤ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਇਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: sookhahu dookh bhe nit paap kamaaein |
English: so does the constant commission of sins turn pleasure into pain.

Gurbani: ਪਾਪਾ ਕਮਾਣੇ ਛਡਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਲੈ ਚਲੇ ਘਤਿ ਗਲਾਵਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: paapaa kamaane chhaddeh naahee lai chale ghat galaaviaa |
English: The sins you have committed shall not leave you; placing the noose around your neck, they shall lead you away.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿਚੰਦਉਰੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਮੂਠਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਸੇਜਾ ਰਾਵਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: harichandauree dekh mootthaa koorr sejaa raaviaa |
English: Beholding an illusion, you are deceived, and on your bed, you enjoy a false lover.

Gurbani: ਲਬਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਮਾਤਾ ਗਰਬਿ ਭਇਆ ਸਮਾਇਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: lab lobh ahankaar maataa garab bheaa samaaein |
English: You are intoxicated with greed, avarice and egotism; you are engrossed in self-conceit.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਅਗਿਆਨਿ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਨਹ ਮਿਟੈ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਇਣੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak mrig agiaan binase neh mittai aavan jaaein |2|
English: O Nanak, like the deer, you are being destroyed by your ignorance; your comings and goings shall never end. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਿਠੈ ਮਖੁ ਮੁਆ ਕਿਉ ਲਏ ਓਡਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: mitthai makh muaa kiau le oddaaree |
English: The fly is caught in the sweet candy - how can it fly away?

Gurbani: ਹਸਤੀ ਗਰਤਿ ਪਇਆ ਕਿਉ ਤਰੀਐ ਤਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: hasatee garat peaa kiau tareeai taaree |
English: The elephant has fallen into the pit - how can it escape?

Gurbani: ਤਰਣੁ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ਭਇਆ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: taran duhelaa bheaa khin meh khasam chit na aaeo |
English: It shall be so difficult to swim across, for one who does not remember the Lord and Master, even for an instant.

Gurbani: ਦੂਖਾ ਸਜਾਈ ਗਣਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੀਆ ਅਪਣਾ ਪਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: dookhaa sajaaee ganat naahee keea apanaa paaeo |
English: His sufferings and punishments are beyond reckoning; he receives the consequences of his own actions.

Gurbani: ਗੁਝਾ ਕਮਾਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਆ ਈਤ ਉਤਹਿ ਖੁਆਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: gujhaa kamaanaa pragatt hoaa eet uteh khuaaree |
English: His secret deeds are exposed, and he is ruined here and hereafter.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝੁ ਮੂਠਾ ਮਨਮੁਖੋ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak satigur baajh mootthaa manamukho ahankaaree |3|
English: O Nanak, without the True Guru, the self-willed egotistical manmukh is defrauded. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਜੀਵੇ ਲਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: har ke daas jeeve lag prabh kee charanee |
English: The Lord's slaves live by holding on to God's feet.

Gurbani: ਕੰਠਿ ਲਗਾਇ ਲੀਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਰਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: kantth lagaae lee tis tthaakur saranee |
English: The Lord and Master embraces those who seek His Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਬਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਆਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bal budh giaan dhiaan apanaa aap naam japaaeaa |
English: He blesses them with power, wisdom, knowledge and meditation; He Himself inspires them to chant His Name.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਆਪਿ ਹੋਆ ਆਪਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasangat aap hoaa aap jagat taraaeaa |
English: He Himself is the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and He Himself saves the world.

Gurbani: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਰਖਣਹਾਰੈ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: raakh lee rakhanahaarai sadaa niramal karanee |
English: The Preserver preserves those whose actions are always pure.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਰਕਿ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: naanak narak na jaeh kabahoon har sant har kee saranee |4|2|11|
English: O Nanak, they never have to go to hell; the Lord's Saints are under the Lord's Protection. ||4||2||11||

[Ang 460 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਵੰਞੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਆਲਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਸਿ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: vany mere aalasaa har paas benantee |
English: Be gone, O my laziness, that I may pray to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਰਾਵਉ ਸਹੁ ਆਪਨੜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੋਹੰਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: raavau sahu aapanarraa prabh sang sohantee |
English: I enjoy my Husband Lord, and look beautiful with my God.

Gurbani: ਸੰਗੇ ਸੋਹੰਤੀ ਕੰਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣੀ ਰਾਵੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: sange sohantee kant suaamee dinas rainee raaveeai |
English: I look beautiful in the Company of my Husband Lord; I enjoy my Lord Master day and night.

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਚਿਤਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੇਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: saas saas chitaar jeevaa prabh pekh har gun gaaveeai |
English: I live by remembering God with each and every breath, beholding the Lord, and singing His Glorious Praises.

Gurbani: ਬਿਰਹਾ ਲਜਾਇਆ ਦਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਮਿਉ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਿੰਚੰਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: birahaa lajaaeaa daras paaeaa amiau drisatt sinchantee |
English: The pain of separation has grown shy, for I have obtained the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; His Ambrosial Glance of Grace has filled me with bliss.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਮਿਲੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਖੋਜੰਤੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak meree ichh punee mile jis khojantee |1|
English: Prays Nanak, my desires are fulfilled; I have met the One I was seeking. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਸਿ ਵੰਞਹੁ ਕਿਲਵਿਖਹੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: nas vanyahu kilavikhahu karataa ghar aaeaa |
English: Run away, O sins; the Creator has entered my home.

Gurbani: ਦੂਤਹ ਦਹਨੁ ਭਇਆ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: dootah dehan bheaa govind pragattaaeaa |
English: The demons within me have been burnt; the Lord of the Universe has revealed Himself to me.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਲਾਲਨ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਵਖਾਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: pragatte gupaal gobind laalan saadhasang vakhaaniaa |
English: The Beloved Lord of the Universe, the Lord of the World has revealed Himself; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I chant His Name.

Gurbani: ਆਚਰਜੁ ਡੀਠਾ ਅਮਿਉ ਵੂਠਾ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: aacharaj ddeetthaa amiau vootthaa gur prasaadee jaaniaa |
English: I have seen the Wondrous Lord; He showers His Ambrosial Nectar upon me, and by Guru's Grace, I know Him.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਆਈ ਵਜੀ ਵਧਾਈ ਨਹ ਅੰਤੁ ਜਾਈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: man saant aaee vajee vadhaaee neh ant jaaee paaeaa |
English: My mind is at peace, resounding with the music of bliss; the Lord's limits cannot be found.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜਿ ਮੇਲਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਆਪਿ ਬਣਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak sukh sehaj melaa prabhoo aap banaaeaa |2|
English: Prays Nanak, God brings us to union with Himself, in the poise of celestial peace. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਰਕ ਨ ਡੀਠੜਿਆ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ॥
Transliteration: narak na ddeettharriaa simarat naaraaein |
English: They do not have to see hell, if they remember the Lord in meditation.

Gurbani: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਦੂਤ ਭਏ ਪਲਾਇਣ ॥
Transliteration: jai jai dharam kare doot bhe palaaein |
English: The Righteous Judge of Dharma applauds them, and the Messenger of Death runs away from them.

Gurbani: ਧਰਮ ਧੀਰਜ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: dharam dheeraj sehaj sukhee saadhasangat har bhaje |
English: Dharmic faith, patience, peace and poise are obtained by vibrating upon the Lord in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਮੋਹ ਮਮਤਾ ਸਭ ਤਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: kar anugrahu raakh leene moh mamataa sabh taje |
English: Showering His Blessings, He saves those who renounce all attachments and egotism.

Gurbani: ਗਹਿ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਏ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਜਪਤ ਅਘਾਇਣ ॥
Transliteration: geh kantth laae gur milaae govind japat aghaaein |
English: The Lord embraces us; the Guru unites us with Him. Meditating on the Lord of the Universe, we are satisfied.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਗਲ ਆਸ ਪੁਜਾਇਣ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak simar suaamee sagal aas pujaaein |3|
English: Prays Nanak, remembering the Lord and Master in meditation, all hopes are fulfilled. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਚਰਣ ਗਹੇ ਤਾ ਕੇਹਾ ਕਾੜਾ ॥
Transliteration: nidh sidh charan gahe taa kehaa kaarraa |
English: Grasping the Lord's Feet, the treasure of the Siddhas, what suffering can I feel?

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਵਸਿ ਜਿਸੈ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਅਸਾੜਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh vas jisai so prabhoo asaarraa |
English: Everything is in His Power - He is my God.

Gurbani: ਗਹਿ ਭੁਜਾ ਲੀਨੇ ਨਾਮ ਦੀਨੇ ਕਰੁ ਧਾਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: geh bhujaa leene naam deene kar dhaar masatak raakhiaa |
English: Holding me by the arm, He blesses me with His Name; placing His Hand upon my forehead, He saves me.

Gurbani: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਨਹ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਅਮਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sansaar saagar neh viaapai amiau har ras chaakhiaa |
English: The world-ocean does not trouble me, for I have drunk the sublime elixir of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗੇ ਰਣੁ ਜੀਤਿ ਵਡਾ ਅਖਾੜਾ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasange naam range ran jeet vaddaa akhaarraa |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, I am victorious on the great battlefield of life.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਜਮਿ ਨ ਉਪਾੜਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak saran suaamee bahurr jam na upaarraa |4|3|12|
English: Prays Nanak, I have entered the Sanctuary of the Lord and Master; the Messenger of Death shall not destroy me again. ||4||3||12||

[Ang 461 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਕਮਾਇਅੜੋ ਸੋ ਆਇਓ ਮਾਥੈ ॥
Transliteration: din raat kamaaeiarro so aaeo maathai |
English: Those actions you perform, day and night, are recorded upon your forehead.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਾਸਿ ਲੁਕਾਇਦੜੋ ਸੋ ਵੇਖੀ ਸਾਥੈ ॥
Transliteration: jis paas lukaaeidarro so vekhee saathai |
English: And the One, from whom you hide these actions - He sees them, and is always with you.

Gurbani: ਸੰਗਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਕਰਣਹਾਰਾ ਕਾਇ ਪਾਪੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: sang dekhai karanahaaraa kaae paap kamaaeeai |
English: The Creator Lord is with you; He sees you, so why commit sins?

Gurbani: ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੀਜੈ ਨਰਕਿ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: sukrit keejai naam leejai narak mool na jaaeeai |
English: So perform good deeds, and chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord; you shall never have to go to hell.

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਚਲੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਾਥੇ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar har naam simarahu chalai terai saathe |
English: Twenty-four hours a day, dwell upon the Lord's Name in meditation; it alone shall go along with you.

Gurbani: ਭਜੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਦੋਖ ਕਮਾਤੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bhaj saadhasangat sadaa naanak mitteh dokh kamaate |1|
English: So vibrate continually in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, and the sins you committed shall be erased. ||1||

Gurbani: ਵਲਵੰਚ ਕਰਿ ਉਦਰੁ ਭਰਹਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਗਾਵਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: valavanch kar udar bhareh moorakh gaavaaraa |
English: Practicing deceit, you fill your belly, you ignorant fool!

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh de rahiaa har devanahaaraa |
English: The Lord, the Great Giver, continues to give you everything.

Gurbani: ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਾਇ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: daataar sadaa deaal suaamee kaae manahu visaareeai |
English: The Great Giver is always merciful. Why should we forget the Lord Master from our minds?

Gurbani: ਮਿਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇ ਭਜੁ ਨਿਸੰਗੇ ਕੁਲ ਸਮੂਹਾ ਤਾਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: mil saadhasange bhaj nisange kul samoohaa taareeai |
English: Join the Saadh Sangat, and vibrate fearlessly; all your relations shall be saved.

Gurbani: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਦੇਵ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਭਗਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sidh saadhik dev mun jan bhagat naam adhaaraa |
English: The Siddhas, the seekers, the demi-gods, the silent sages and the devotees, all take the Naam as their support.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਭਜੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak sadaa bhajeeai prabh ek karanaihaaraa |2|
English: Prays Nanak, vibrate continually upon God, the One Creator Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਖੋਟੁ ਨ ਕੀਚਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਰਖਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: khott na keechee prabh parakhanahaaraa |
English: Do not practice deception - God is the Assayer of all.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਵਦੜੇ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: koorr kapatt kamaavadarre janameh sansaaraa |
English: Those who practice falsehood and deceit are reincarnated in the world.

Gurbani: ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਤਰਿਆ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sansaar saagar tinaee tariaa jinaee ek dhiaaeaa |
English: Those who meditate on the One Lord, cross over the world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਤਜਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਨਿੰਦ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: taj kaam krodh anind nindaa prabh saranaaee aaeaa |
English: Renouncing sexual desire, anger, flattery and slander, they enter the Sanctuary of God.

Gurbani: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਊਚ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jal thal maheeal raviaa suaamee aooch agam apaaraa |
English: The lofty, inaccessible and infinite Lord and Master is pervading the water, the land and the sky.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਟੇਕ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak ttek jan kee charan kamal adhaaraa |3|
English: Prays Nanak, He is the support of His servants; His Lotus Feet are their only sustenance. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪੇਖੁ ਹਰਿਚੰਦਉਰੜੀ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: pekh harichandaurarree asathir kichh naahee |
English: Behold - the world is a mirage; nothing here is permanent.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ਜੇਤੇ ਸੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa rang jete se sang na jaahee |
English: The pleasures of Maya which are here, shall not go with you.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਥੀ ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰੈ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: har sang saathee sadaa terai dinas rain samaaleeai |
English: The Lord, your companion, is always with you; remember Him day and night.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਏਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਛੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਭਾਉ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਜਾਲੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: har ek bin kachh avar naahee bhaau duteea jaaleeai |
English: Without the One Lord, there is no other; burn away the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਮੀਤੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: meet joban maal sarabas prabh ek kar man maahee |
English: Know in your mind, that the One God is your friend, youth, wealth and everything.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸੂਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak vaddabhaag paaeeai sookh sehaj samaahee |4|4|13|
English: Prays Nanak, by great good fortune, we find the Lord, and merge in peace and celestial poise. ||4||4||13||

[Ang 461 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੮ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 chhant ghar 8 |
English: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Chhant, Eighth House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਕਮਲਾ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੀਤਿ ਕਮਲਾ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੀਤਿ ਹੇ ਤੀਖਣ ਮਦ ਬਿਪਰੀਤਿ ਹੇ ਅਵਧ ਅਕਾਰਥ ਜਾਤ ॥
Transliteration: kamalaa bhram bheet kamalaa bhram bheet he teekhan mad bipareet he avadh akaarath jaat |
English: Maya is the wall of doubt - Maya is the wall of doubt. It is such a powerful and destructive intoxicant; it corrupts and wastes away one's life.

Gurbani: ਗਹਬਰ ਬਨ ਘੋਰ ਗਹਬਰ ਬਨ ਘੋਰ ਹੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮੂਸਤ ਮਨ ਚੋਰ ਹੇ ਦਿਨਕਰੋ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਖਾਤ ॥
Transliteration: gahabar ban ghor gahabar ban ghor he grih moosat man chor he dinakaro anadin khaat |
English: In the terrible, impenetrable world-forest - in the terrible, impenetrable world-forest, the thieves are plundering man's house in broad daylight; night and day, this life is being consumed.

Gurbani: ਦਿਨ ਖਾਤ ਜਾਤ ਬਿਹਾਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਪਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: din khaat jaat bihaat prabh bin milahu prabh karunaa pate |
English: The days of your life are being consumed; they are passing away without God. So meet God, the Merciful Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਅਨੇਕ ਬੀਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੰਗ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਛੁ ਨਹ ਗਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: janam maran anek beete pria sang bin kachh neh gate |
English: I passed through so many births and deaths; without Union with the Beloved, I did not obtain salvation.

Gurbani: ਕੁਲ ਰੂਪ ਧੂਪ ਗਿਆਨਹੀਨੀ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਵਨ ਮਾਤ ॥
Transliteration: kul roop dhoop giaanaheenee tujh binaa mohi kavan maat |
English: I am without the status of high birth, beauty, glory or spiritual wisdom; without You, who is mine, O Mother?

Gurbani: ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਆਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਨਾਥ ਨਰਹਰ ਕਰਹੁ ਗਾਤ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kar jorr naanak saran aaeo pria naath narahar karahu gaat |1|
English: With my palms pressed together, O Nanak, I enter the Lord's Sanctuary; O beloved almighty Lord and Master, please, save me! ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੀਨਾ ਜਲਹੀਨ ਮੀਨਾ ਜਲਹੀਨ ਹੇ ਓਹੁ ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਖੀਨ ਹੇ ਕਤ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਬਿਨੁ ਹੋਤ ॥
Transliteration: meenaa jalaheen meenaa jalaheen he ohu bichhurat man tan kheen he kat jeevan pria bin hot |
English: Like a fish out of water - like a fish out of water, separated from the Lord, the mind and body perish; how can I live, without my Beloved?

Gurbani: ਸਨਮੁਖ ਸਹਿ ਬਾਨ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਸਹਿ ਬਾਨ ਹੇ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਅਰਪੇ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਹੇ ਓਹੁ ਬੇਧਿਓ ਸਹਜ ਸਰੋਤ ॥
Transliteration: sanamukh seh baan sanamukh seh baan he mrig arape man tan praan he ohu bedhio sehaj sarot |
English: Facing the arrow head-on - facing the arrow head-on, the deer surrenders his mind, body and breath of life; he is struck by the hunter's soothing music.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਮਿਲੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਖਿਨੁ ਰਹਨੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਤਨੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: pria preet laagee mil bairaagee khin rehan dhrig tan tis binaa |
English: I have enshrined love for my Beloved. In order to meet Him, I have become a renunciate. Cursed is that body which remains without Him, even for an instant.

Gurbani: ਪਲਕਾ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਾਗੈ ਚਿਤਵੰਤਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: palakaa na laagai pria prem paagai chitavant anadin prabh manaa |
English: My eyelids do not close, for I am absorbed in the love of my Beloved. Day and night, my mind thinks only of God.

Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰੀਰੰਗ ਰਾਤੇ ਨਾਮ ਮਾਤੇ ਭੈ ਭਰਮ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਸਗਲ ਖੋਤ ॥
Transliteration: sreerang raate naam maate bhai bharam duteea sagal khot |
English: Attuned to the Lord, intoxicated with the Naam, fear, doubt and duality have all left me.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਮਇਆ ਦਇਆ ਦਇਆਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਗਨ ਹੋਤ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kar meaa deaa deaal pooran har prem naanak magan hot |2|
English: Bestow Your mercy and compassion, O merciful and perfect Lord, that Nanak may be intoxicated with Your Love. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਲੀਅਲ ਗੁੰਜਾਤ ਅਲੀਅਲ ਗੁੰਜਾਤ ਹੇ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰਸ ਬਾਸਨ ਮਾਤ ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਮਲ ਬੰਧਾਵਤ ਆਪ ॥
Transliteration: aleeal gunjaat aleeal gunjaat he makarand ras baasan maat he preet kamal bandhaavat aap |
English: The bumble-bee is buzzing - the bumble-bee is buzzing, intoxicated with the honey, the flavor and the fragrance; because of its love for the lotus, it entangles itself.

Gurbani: ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਚਿਤ ਪਿਆਸ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਚਿਤ ਪਿਆਸ ਹੇ ਘਨ ਬੂੰਦ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਆਸ ਹੇ ਅਲ ਪੀਵਤ ਬਿਨਸਤ ਤਾਪ ॥
Transliteration: chaatrik chit piaas chaatrik chit piaas he ghan boond bachitr man aas he al peevat binasat taap |
English: The mind of the rainbird thirsts - the mind of the rainbird thirsts; its mind longs for the beautiful rain-drops from the clouds. Drinking them in, its fever departs.

Gurbani: ਤਾਪਾ ਬਿਨਾਸਨ ਦੂਖ ਨਾਸਨ ਮਿਲੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਅਤਿ ਘਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: taapaa binaasan dookh naasan mil prem man tan at ghanaa |
English: O Destroyer of fever, Remover of pain, please unite me with You. My mind and body have such great love for You.

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਸੁਜਾਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਵਨ ਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਣ ਭਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: sundar chatur sujaan suaamee kavan rasanaa gun bhanaa |
English: O my beautiful, wise and all-knowing Lord and Master, with what tongue should I chant Your Praises?

Gurbani: ਗਹਿ ਭੁਜਾ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਾਰਤ ਮਿਟਤ ਪਾਪ ॥
Transliteration: geh bhujaa levahu naam devahu drisatt dhaarat mittat paap |
English: Take me by the arm, and grant me Your Name. One who is blessed with Your Glance of Grace, has his sins erased.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜੰਪੈ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਪੇਖਤ ਨਹ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak janpai patit paavan har daras pekhat neh santaap |3|
English: Nanak meditates on the Lord, the Purifier of sinners; beholding His Vision, he suffers no more. ||3||

Gurbani: ਚਿਤਵਉ ਚਿਤ ਨਾਥ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਚਿਤ ਨਾਥ ਹੇ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਅਨਾਥ ਹੇ ਮਿਲੁ ਚਾਉ ਚਾਈਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: chitvau chit naath chitvau chit naath he rakh levahu saran anaath he mil chaau chaaeele praan |
English: I focus my consciousness on the Lord - I focus my consciousness upon the Lord; I am helpless - please, keep me under Your Protection. I yearn to meet You, my soul hungers for You.

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਤਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਤਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਹੇ ਮਨੁ ਲੁਬਧ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗਿਆਨ ਹੇ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਜਨ ਰਾਖਤ ਮਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: sundar tan dhiaan sundar tan dhiaan he man lubadh gopaal giaan he jaachik jan raakhat maan |
English: I meditate on Your beautiful body - I meditate on Your beautiful body; my mind is fascinated by Your spiritual wisdom, O Lord of the world. Please, preserve the honor of Your humble servants and beggars.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਦੁਖ ਬਿਦੀਰਨ ਸਗਲ ਇਛ ਪੁਜੰਤੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: prabh maan pooran dukh bideeran sagal ichh pujanteea |
English: God bestows perfect honor and destroys pain; He has fulfilled all my desires.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਦਿਨ ਸਭਾਗੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਹ ਸੇਜ ਸੋਹੰਤੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: har kantth laage din sabhaage mil naah sej sohanteea |
English: How very blessed was that day when the Lord embraced me; meeting my Husband Lord, my bed was beautified.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਮਿਲੇ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ਸਗਲ ਕਲਮਲ ਭਏ ਹਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: prabh drisatt dhaaree mile muraaree sagal kalamal bhe haan |
English: When God granted His Grace and met me, all my sins were erased.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰੀ ਆਸ ਪੂਰਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak meree aas pooran mile sreedhar gun nidhaan |4|1|14|
English: Prays Nanak, my hopes are fulfilled; I have met the Lord, the Lord of Lakshmi, the treasure of excellence. ||4||1||14||

[Ang 462 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirbhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibhan gur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 |
English: Aasaa, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਵਾਰ ਸਲੋਕਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਸਲੋਕ ਭੀ ਮਹਲੇ ਪਹਿਲੇ ਕੇ ਲਿਖੇ ਟੁੰਡੇ ਅਸ ਰਾਜੈ ਕੀ ਧੁਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: vaar salokaa naal salok bhee mahale pahile ke likhe ttundde as raajai kee dhunee |
English: Vaar With Saloks, And Saloks Written By The First Mehl. To Be Sung To The Tune Of 'Tunda-Asraajaa':

Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਦਿਉਹਾੜੀ ਸਦ ਵਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: balihaaree gur aapane diauhaarree sad vaar |
English: A hundred times a day, I am a sacrifice to my Guru;

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਮਾਣਸ ਤੇ ਦੇਵਤੇ ਕੀਏ ਕਰਤ ਨ ਲਾਗੀ ਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jin maanas te devate kee karat na laagee vaar |1|
English: He made angels out of men, without delay. ||1||

[Ang 463 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 2 |
English: Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਚੰਦਾ ਉਗਵਹਿ ਸੂਰਜ ਚੜਹਿ ਹਜਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: je sau chandaa ugaveh sooraj charreh hajaar |
English: If a hundred moons were to rise, and a thousand suns appeared,

Gurbani: ਏਤੇ ਚਾਨਣ ਹੋਦਿਆਂ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ete chaanan hodiaan gur bin ghor andhaar |2|
English: even with such light, there would still be pitch darkness without the Guru. ||2||

[Ang 463 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੂ ਨ ਚੇਤਨੀ ਮਨਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਸੁਚੇਤ ॥
Transliteration: naanak guroo na chetanee man aapanai suchet |
English: O Nanak, those who do not think of the Guru, and who think of themselves as clever,

Gurbani: ਛੁਟੇ ਤਿਲ ਬੂਆੜ ਜਿਉ ਸੁੰਞੇ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਖੇਤ ॥
Transliteration: chhutte til booaarr jiau sunye andar khet |
English: shall be left abandoned in the field, like the scattered sesame.

Gurbani: ਖੇਤੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਛੁਟਿਆ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਉ ਨਾਹ ॥
Transliteration: khetai andar chhuttiaa kahu naanak sau naah |
English: They are abandoned in the field, says Nanak, and they have a hundred masters to please.

Gurbani: ਫਲੀਅਹਿ ਫੁਲੀਅਹਿ ਬਪੁੜੇ ਭੀ ਤਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੁਆਹ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: faleeeh fuleeeh bapurre bhee tan vich suaah |3|
English: The wretches bear fruit and flower, but within their bodies, they are filled with ashes. ||3||

[Ang 463 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਆਪੀਨੑੈ ਆਪੁ ਸਾਜਿਓ ਆਪੀਨੑੈ ਰਚਿਓ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aapeenai aap saajio aapeenai rachio naau |
English: He Himself created Himself; He Himself assumed His Name.

Gurbani: ਦੁਯੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸਾਜੀਐ ਕਰਿ ਆਸਣੁ ਡਿਠੋ ਚਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: duyee kudarat saajeeai kar aasan ddittho chaau |
English: Secondly, He fashioned the creation; seated within the creation, He beholds it with delight.

Gurbani: ਦਾਤਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਤੂੰ ਤੁਸਿ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਸਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: daataa karataa aap toon tus deveh kareh pasaau |
English: You Yourself are the Giver and the Creator; by Your Pleasure, You bestow Your Mercy.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਜਾਣੋਈ ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇ ਲੈਸਹਿ ਜਿੰਦੁ ਕਵਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: toon jaanoee sabhasai de laiseh jind kavaau |
English: You are the Knower of all; You give life, and take it away again with a word.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਆਸਣੁ ਡਿਠੋ ਚਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kar aasan ddittho chaau |1|
English: Seated within the creation, You behold it with delight. ||1||

[Ang 463 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਚੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਖੰਡ ਸਚੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ॥
Transliteration: sache tere khandd sache brahamandd |
English: True are Your worlds, True are Your solar Systems.

Gurbani: ਸਚੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਲੋਅ ਸਚੇ ਆਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: sache tere loa sache aakaar |
English: True are Your realms, True is Your creation.

Gurbani: ਸਚੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਰਣੇ ਸਰਬ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: sache tere karane sarab beechaar |
English: True are Your actions, and all Your deliberations.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਅਮਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa teraa amar sachaa deebaan |
English: True is Your Command, and True is Your Court.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਫੁਰਮਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa teraa hukam sachaa furamaan |
English: True is the Command of Your Will, True is Your Order.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਰਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa teraa karam sachaa neesaan |
English: True is Your Mercy, True is Your Insignia.

Gurbani: ਸਚੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਖਹਿ ਲਖ ਕਰੋੜਿ ॥
Transliteration: sache tudh aakheh lakh karorr |
English: Hundreds of thousands and millions call You True.

Gurbani: ਸਚੈ ਸਭਿ ਤਾਣਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਭਿ ਜੋਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: sachai sabh taan sachai sabh jor |
English: In the True Lord is all power, in the True Lord is all might.

Gurbani: ਸਚੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਚੀ ਸਾਲਾਹ ॥
Transliteration: sachee teree sifat sachee saalaah |
English: True is Your Praise, True is Your Adoration.

Gurbani: ਸਚੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸਚੇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ॥
Transliteration: sachee teree kudarat sache paatisaah |
English: True is Your almighty creative power, True King.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਸਚੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak sach dhiaaein sach |
English: O Nanak, true are those who meditate on the True One.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੇ ਸੁ ਕਚੁ ਨਿਕਚੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jo mar jame su kach nikach |1|
English: Those who are subject to birth and death are totally false. ||1||

[Ang 463 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਾ ਵਡਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: vaddee vaddiaaee jaa vaddaa naau |
English: Great is His greatness, as great as His Name.

Gurbani: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਆਉ ॥
Transliteration: vaddee vaddiaaee jaa sach niaau |
English: Great is His greatness, as True is His justice.

Gurbani: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਾ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਥਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: vaddee vaddiaaee jaa nihachal thaau |
English: Great is His greatness, as permanent as His Throne.

Gurbani: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਲਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: vaddee vaddiaaee jaanai aalaau |
English: Great is His greatness, as He knows our utterances.

Gurbani: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਬੁਝੈ ਸਭਿ ਭਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: vaddee vaddiaaee bujhai sabh bhaau |
English: Great is His greatness, as He understands all our affections.

Gurbani: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਾ ਪੁਛਿ ਨ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: vaddee vaddiaaee jaa puchh na daat |
English: Great is His greatness, as He gives without being asked.

Gurbani: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: vaddee vaddiaaee jaa aape aap |
English: Great is His greatness, as He Himself is all-in-all.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਰ ਨ ਕਥਨੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak kaar na kathanee jaae |
English: O Nanak, His actions cannot be described.

Gurbani: ਕੀਤਾ ਕਰਣਾ ਸਰਬ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: keetaa karanaa sarab rajaae |2|
English: Whatever He has done, or will do, is all by His Own Will. ||2||

[Ang 463 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 2 |
English: Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਸਚੈ ਕੀ ਹੈ ਕੋਠੜੀ ਸਚੇ ਕਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: eihu jag sachai kee hai kottharree sache kaa vich vaas |
English: This world is the room of the True Lord; within it is the dwelling of the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਇਕਨੑਾ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਲਏ ਇਕਨੑਾ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਕਰੇ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: eikanaa hukam samaae le ikanaa hukame kare vinaas |
English: By His Command, some are merged into Him, and some, by His Command, are destroyed.

Gurbani: ਇਕਨੑਾ ਭਾਣੈ ਕਢਿ ਲਏ ਇਕਨੑਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: eikanaa bhaanai kadt le ikanaa maaeaa vich nivaas |
English: Some, by the Pleasure of His Will, are lifted up out of Maya, while others are made to dwell within it.

Gurbani: ਏਵ ਭਿ ਆਖਿ ਨ ਜਾਪਈ ਜਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਆਣੇ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: ev bhi aakh na jaapee ji kisai aane raas |
English: No one can say who will be rescued.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh jaaneeai jaa kau aap kare paragaas |3|
English: O Nanak, he alone is known as Gurmukh, unto whom the Lord reveals Himself. ||3||

[Ang 463 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਅ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਲਿਖਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਧਰਮੁ ਬਹਾਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: naanak jeea upaae kai likh naavai dharam bahaaliaa |
English: O Nanak, having created the souls, the Lord installed the Righteous Judge of Dharma to read and record their accounts.

Gurbani: ਓਥੈ ਸਚੇ ਹੀ ਸਚਿ ਨਿਬੜੈ ਚੁਣਿ ਵਖਿ ਕਢੇ ਜਜਮਾਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: othai sache hee sach nibarrai chun vakh kadte jajamaaliaa |
English: There, only the Truth is judged true; the sinners are picked out and separated.

Gurbani: ਥਾਉ ਨ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਮੁਹ ਕਾਲੑੈ ਦੋਜਕਿ ਚਾਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: thaau na paaein koorriaar muh kaalai dojak chaaliaa |
English: The false find no place there, and they go to hell with their faces blackened.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਇ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਜਿਣਿ ਗਏ ਹਾਰਿ ਗਏ ਸਿ ਠਗਣ ਵਾਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: terai naae rate se jin ge haar ge si tthagan vaaliaa |
English: Those who are imbued with Your Name win, while the cheaters lose.

Gurbani: ਲਿਖਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਧਰਮੁ ਬਹਾਲਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: likh naavai dharam bahaaliaa |2|
English: The Lord installed the Righteous Judge of Dharma to read and record the accounts. ||2||

[Ang 463 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਨਾਦ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਵੇਦ ॥
Transliteration: visamaad naad visamaad ved |
English: Wonderful is the sound current of the Naad, wonderful is the knowledge of the Vedas.

Gurbani: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਜੀਅ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਭੇਦ ॥
Transliteration: visamaad jeea visamaad bhed |
English: Wonderful are the beings, wonderful are the species.

Gurbani: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਰੂਪ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਰੰਗ ॥
Transliteration: visamaad roop visamaad rang |
English: Wonderful are the forms, wonderful are the colors.

Gurbani: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਨਾਗੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਜੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: visamaad naage fireh jant |
English: Wonderful are the beings who wander around naked.

Gurbani: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਪਉਣੁ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: visamaad paun visamaad paanee |
English: Wonderful is the wind, wonderful is the water.

Gurbani: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਅਗਨੀ ਖੇਡਹਿ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: visamaad aganee kheddeh viddaanee |
English: Wonderful is fire, which works wonders.

Gurbani: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਧਰਤੀ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਖਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: visamaad dharatee visamaad khaanee |
English: Wonderful is the earth, wonderful the sources of creation.

Gurbani: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਸਾਦਿ ਲਗਹਿ ਪਰਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: visamaad saad lageh paraanee |
English: Wonderful are the tastes to which mortals are attached.

Gurbani: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: visamaad sanjog visamaad vijog |
English: Wonderful is union, and wonderful is separation.

Gurbani: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਭੁਖ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਭੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: visamaad bhukh visamaad bhog |
English: Wonderful is hunger, wonderful is satisfaction.

Gurbani: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਸਾਲਾਹ ॥
Transliteration: visamaad sifat visamaad saalaah |
English: Wonderful is His Praise, wonderful is His adoration.

Gurbani: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਉਝੜ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਰਾਹ ॥
Transliteration: visamaad ujharr visamaad raah |
English: Wonderful is the wilderness, wonderful is the path.

Gurbani: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: visamaad nerrai visamaad door |
English: Wonderful is closeness, wonderful is distance.

Gurbani: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਹਾਜਰਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: visamaad dekhai haajaraa hajoor |
English: How wonderful to behold the Lord, ever-present here.

Gurbani: ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਡਾਣੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: vekh viddaan rahiaa visamaad |
English: Beholding His wonders, I am wonder-struck.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬੁਝਣੁ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak bujhan poorai bhaag |1|
English: O Nanak, those who understand this are blessed with perfect destiny. ||1||

[Ang 464 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਦਿਸੈ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਭਉ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: kudarat disai kudarat suneeai kudarat bhau sukh saar |
English: By His Power we see, by His Power we hear; by His Power we have fear, and the essence of happiness.

Gurbani: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਪਾਤਾਲੀ ਆਕਾਸੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸਰਬ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: kudarat paataalee aakaasee kudarat sarab aakaar |
English: By His Power the nether worlds exist, and the Akaashic ethers; by His Power the entire creation exists.

Gurbani: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਵੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਕਤੇਬਾ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸਰਬ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: kudarat ved puraan katebaa kudarat sarab veechaar |
English: By His Power the Vedas and the Puraanas exist, and the Holy Scriptures of the Jewish, Christian and Islamic religions. By His Power all deliberations exist.

Gurbani: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਖਾਣਾ ਪੀਣਾ ਪੈਨੑਣੁ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸਰਬ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: kudarat khaanaa peenaa painan kudarat sarab piaar |
English: By His Power we eat, drink and dress; by His Power all love exists.

Gurbani: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਜਾਤੀ ਜਿਨਸੀ ਰੰਗੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਜੀਅ ਜਹਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: kudarat jaatee jinasee rangee kudarat jeea jahaan |
English: - By His Power come the species of all kinds and colors; by His Power the living beings of the world exist.

Gurbani: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਨੇਕੀਆ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਬਦੀਆ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: kudarat nekeea kudarat badeea kudarat maan abhimaan |
English: By His Power virtues exist, and by His Power vices exist. By His Power come honor and dishonor.

Gurbani: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਖਾਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: kudarat paun paanee baisantar kudarat dharatee khaak |
English: By His Power wind, water and fire exist; by His Power earth and dust exist.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਤੂੰ ਕਾਦਿਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪਾਕੀ ਨਾਈ ਪਾਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: sabh teree kudarat toon kaadir karataa paakee naaee paak |
English: Everything is in Your Power, Lord; You are the all-powerful Creator. Your Name is the Holiest of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਵਰਤੈ ਤਾਕੋ ਤਾਕੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak hukamai andar vekhai varatai taako taak |2|
English: O Nanak, through the Command of His Will, He beholds and pervades the creation; He is absolutely unrivalled. ||2||

[Ang 464 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਆਪੀਨੑੈ ਭੋਗ ਭੋਗਿ ਕੈ ਹੋਇ ਭਸਮੜਿ ਭਉਰੁ ਸਿਧਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aapeenai bhog bhog kai hoe bhasamarr bhaur sidhaaeaa |
English: Enjoying his pleasures, one is reduced to a pile of ashes, and the soul passes away.

Gurbani: ਵਡਾ ਹੋਆ ਦੁਨੀਦਾਰੁ ਗਲਿ ਸੰਗਲੁ ਘਤਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: vaddaa hoaa duneedaar gal sangal ghat chalaaeaa |
English: He may be great, but when he dies, the chain is thrown around his neck, and he is led away.

Gurbani: ਅਗੈ ਕਰਣੀ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਵਾਚੀਐ ਬਹਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: agai karanee keerat vaacheeai beh lekhaa kar samajhaaeaa |
English: There, his good and bad deeds are added up; sitting there, his account is read.

Gurbani: ਥਾਉ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਪਉਦੀਈ ਹੁਣਿ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਕਿਆ ਰੂਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: thaau na hovee paudeeee hun suneeai kiaa rooaaeaa |
English: He is whipped, but finds no place of rest, and no one hears his cries of pain.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਅੰਧੈ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: man andhai janam gavaaeaa |3|
English: The blind man has wasted his life away. ||3||

[Ang 464 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਵਣੁ ਵਹੈ ਸਦਵਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhai vich pavan vahai sadavaau |
English: In the Fear of God, the wind and breezes ever blow.

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਲਖ ਦਰੀਆਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhai vich chaleh lakh dareeaau |
English: In the Fear of God, thousands of rivers flow.

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਕਢੈ ਵੇਗਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: bhai vich agan kadtai vegaar |
English: In the Fear of God, fire is forced to labor.

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਦਬੀ ਭਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: bhai vich dharatee dabee bhaar |
English: In the Fear of God, the earth is crushed under its burden.

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਇੰਦੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਸਿਰ ਭਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: bhai vich ind firai sir bhaar |
English: In the Fear of God, the clouds move across the sky.

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਾਜਾ ਧਰਮ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: bhai vich raajaa dharam duaar |
English: In the Fear of God, the Righteous Judge of Dharma stands at His Door.

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਚੰਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: bhai vich sooraj bhai vich chand |
English: In the Fear of God, the sun shines, and in the Fear of God, the moon reflects.

Gurbani: ਕੋਹ ਕਰੋੜੀ ਚਲਤ ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: koh karorree chalat na ant |
English: They travel millions of miles, endlessly.

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਿਧ ਬੁਧ ਸੁਰ ਨਾਥ ॥
Transliteration: bhai vich sidh budh sur naath |
English: In the Fear of God, the Siddhas exist, as do the Buddhas, the demi-gods and Yogis.

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਡਾਣੇ ਆਕਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: bhai vich aaddaane aakaas |
English: In the Fear of God, the Akaashic ethers are stretched across the sky.

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੋਧ ਮਹਾਬਲ ਸੂਰ ॥
Transliteration: bhai vich jodh mahaabal soor |
English: In the Fear of God, the warriors and the most powerful heroes exist.

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਪੂਰ ॥
Transliteration: bhai vich aaveh jaaveh poor |
English: In the Fear of God, multitudes come and go.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲਿਆ ਭਉ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਲੇਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: sagaliaa bhau likhiaa sir lekh |
English: God has inscribed the Inscription of His Fear upon the heads of all.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਏਕੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak nirbhau nirankaar sach ek |1|
English: O Nanak, the Fearless Lord, the Formless Lord, the True Lord, is One. ||1||

[Ang 464 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਹੋਰਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਵਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: naanak nirbhau nirankaar hor kete raam ravaal |
English: O Nanak, the Lord is fearless and formless; myriads of others, like Rama, are mere dust before Him.

Gurbani: ਕੇਤੀਆ ਕੰਨੑ ਕਹਾਣੀਆ ਕੇਤੇ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: keteea kana kahaaneea kete bed beechaar |
English: There are so many stories of Krishna, so many who reflect over the Vedas.

Gurbani: ਕੇਤੇ ਨਚਹਿ ਮੰਗਤੇ ਗਿੜਿ ਮੁੜਿ ਪੂਰਹਿ ਤਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: kete nacheh mangate girr murr pooreh taal |
English: So many beggars dance, spinning around to the beat.

Gurbani: ਬਾਜਾਰੀ ਬਾਜਾਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਇ ਕਢਹਿ ਬਾਜਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: baajaaree baajaar meh aae kadteh baajaar |
English: The magicians perform their magic in the market place, creating a false illusion.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਰਾਣੀਆ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਆਲ ਪਤਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: gaaveh raaje raaneea boleh aal pataal |
English: They sing as kings and queens, and speak of this and that.

Gurbani: ਲਖ ਟਕਿਆ ਕੇ ਮੁੰਦੜੇ ਲਖ ਟਕਿਆ ਕੇ ਹਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: lakh ttakiaa ke mundarre lakh ttakiaa ke haar |
English: They wear earrings, and necklaces worth thousands of dollars.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸੇ ਤਨ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਛਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: jit tan paaeeeh naanakaa se tan hoveh chhaar |
English: Those bodies on which they are worn, O Nanak, those bodies turn to ashes.

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਗਲੀਈ ਢੂਢੀਐ ਕਥਨਾ ਕਰੜਾ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: giaan na galeeee dtoodteeai kathanaa kararraa saar |
English: Wisdom cannot be found through mere words. To explain it is as hard as iron.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਹੋਰ ਹਿਕਮਤਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: karam milai taa paaeeai hor hikamat hukam khuaar |2|
English: When the Lord bestows His Grace, then alone it is received; other tricks and orders are useless. ||2||

[Ang 465 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਤਾ ਨਦਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: nadar kareh je aapanee taa nadaree satigur paaeaa |
English: If the Merciful Lord shows His Mercy, then the True Guru is found.

Gurbani: ਏਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਬਹੁਤੇ ਜਨਮ ਭਰੰਮਿਆ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: ehu jeeo bahute janam bharamiaa taa satigur sabad sunaaeaa |
English: This soul wandered through countless incarnations, until the True Guru instructed it in the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਣਿਅਹੁ ਲੋਕ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: satigur jevadd daataa ko nahee sabh suniahu lok sabaaeaa |
English: There is no giver as great as the True Guru; hear this, all you people.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: satigur miliai sach paaeaa jinaee vichahu aap gavaaeaa |
English: Meeting the True Guru, the True Lord is found; He removes self-conceit from within,

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jin sacho sach bujhaaeaa |4|
English: and instructs us in the Truth of Truths. ||4||

[Ang 465 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਘੜੀਆ ਸਭੇ ਗੋਪੀਆ ਪਹਰ ਕੰਨੑ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: gharreea sabhe gopeea pehar kana gopaal |
English: All the hours are the milk-maids, and the quarters of the day are the Krishnas.

Gurbani: ਗਹਣੇ ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: gahane paun paanee baisantar chand sooraj avataar |
English: The wind, water and fire are the ornaments; the sun and moon are the incarnations.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲੀ ਧਰਤੀ ਮਾਲੁ ਧਨੁ ਵਰਤਣਿ ਸਰਬ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: sagalee dharatee maal dhan varatan sarab janjaal |
English: All of the earth, property, wealth and articles are all entanglements.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੁਸੈ ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਹੂਣੀ ਖਾਇ ਗਇਆ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak musai giaan vihoonee khaae geaa jamakaal |1|
English: O Nanak, without divine knowledge, one is plundered, and devoured by the Messenger of Death. ||1||

[Ang 465 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਵਾਇਨਿ ਚੇਲੇ ਨਚਨਿ ਗੁਰ ॥
Transliteration: vaaein chele nachan gur |
English: The disciples play the music, and the gurus dance.

Gurbani: ਪੈਰ ਹਲਾਇਨਿ ਫੇਰਨਿੑ ਸਿਰ ॥
Transliteration: pair halaaein ferana sir |
English: They move their feet and roll their heads.

Gurbani: ਉਡਿ ਉਡਿ ਰਾਵਾ ਝਾਟੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: audd udd raavaa jhaattai paae |
English: The dust flies and falls upon their hair.

Gurbani: ਵੇਖੈ ਲੋਕੁ ਹਸੈ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: vekhai lok hasai ghar jaae |
English: Beholding them, the people laugh, and then go home.

Gurbani: ਰੋਟੀਆ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਪੂਰਹਿ ਤਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: rotteea kaaran pooreh taal |
English: They beat the drums for the sake of bread.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾੜਹਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: aap pachhaarreh dharatee naal |
English: They throw themselves upon the ground.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਗੋਪੀਆ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਕਾਨੑ ॥
Transliteration: gaavan gopeea gaavan kaana |
English: They sing of the milk-maids, they sing of the Krishnas.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਸੀਤਾ ਰਾਜੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: gaavan seetaa raaje raam |
English: They sing of Sitas, and Ramas and kings.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: nirbhau nirankaar sach naam |
English: The Lord is fearless and formless; His Name is True.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਗਲ ਜਹਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kaa keea sagal jahaan |
English: The entire universe is His Creation.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਕਰਮਿ ਚੜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sevak seveh karam charraau |
English: Those servants, whose destiny is awakened, serve the Lord.

Gurbani: ਭਿੰਨੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhinee rain jinaa man chaau |
English: The night of their lives is cool with dew; their minds are filled with love for the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਿਖੀ ਸਿਖਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: sikhee sikhiaa gur veechaar |
English: Contemplating the Guru, I have been taught these teachings;

Gurbani: ਨਦਰੀ ਕਰਮਿ ਲਘਾਏ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: nadaree karam laghaae paar |
English: granting His Grace, He carries His servants across.

Gurbani: ਕੋਲੂ ਚਰਖਾ ਚਕੀ ਚਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: koloo charakhaa chakee chak |
English: The oil-press, the spinning wheel, the grinding stones, the potter's wheel,

Gurbani: ਥਲ ਵਾਰੋਲੇ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਨੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: thal vaarole bahut anant |
English: the numerous, countless whirlwinds in the desert,

Gurbani: ਲਾਟੂ ਮਾਧਾਣੀਆ ਅਨਗਾਹ ॥
Transliteration: laattoo maadhaaneea anagaah |
English: the spinning tops, the churning sticks, the threshers,

Gurbani: ਪੰਖੀ ਭਉਦੀਆ ਲੈਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਹ ॥
Transliteration: pankhee bhaudeea lain na saah |
English: the breathless tumblings of the birds,

Gurbani: ਸੂਐ ਚਾੜਿ ਭਵਾਈਅਹਿ ਜੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: sooai chaarr bhavaaeeeh jant |
English: and the men moving round and round on spindles

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਉਦਿਆ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਅੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: naanak bhaudiaa ganat na ant |
English: O Nanak, the tumblers are countless and endless.

Gurbani: ਬੰਧਨ ਬੰਧਿ ਭਵਾਏ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bandhan bandh bhavaae soe |
English: The Lord binds us in bondage - so do we spin around.

Gurbani: ਪਇਐ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਨਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: peiai kirat nachai sabh koe |
English: According to their actions, so do all people dance.

Gurbani: ਨਚਿ ਨਚਿ ਹਸਹਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਸੇ ਰੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: nach nach haseh chaleh se roe |
English: Those who dance and dance and laugh, shall weep on their ultimate departure.

Gurbani: ਉਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ਸਿਧ ਨ ਹੋਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: audd na jaahee sidh na hohi |
English: They do not fly to the heavens, nor do they become Siddhas.

Gurbani: ਨਚਣੁ ਕੁਦਣੁ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਚਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: nachan kudan man kaa chaau |
English: They dance and jump around on the urgings of their minds.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨੑ ਮਨਿ ਭਉ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak jina man bhau tinaa man bhaau |2|
English: O Nanak, those whose minds are filled with the Fear of God, have the love of God in their minds as well. ||2||

[Ang 465 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਨਾਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਇ ਲਇਐ ਨਰਕਿ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: naau teraa nirankaar hai naae leiai narak na jaaeeai |
English: Your Name is the Fearless Lord; chanting Your Name, one does not have to go to hell.

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਦੇ ਖਾਜੈ ਆਖਿ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: jeeo pindd sabh tis daa de khaajai aakh gavaaeeai |
English: Soul and body all belong to Him; asking Him to give us sustenance is a waste.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਚੰਗਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਕਰਿ ਪੁੰਨਹੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਸਦਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: je lorreh changaa aapanaa kar punahu neech sadaaeeai |
English: If you yearn for goodness, then perform good deeds and feel humble.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਜਰਵਾਣਾ ਪਰਹਰੈ ਜਰੁ ਵੇਸ ਕਰੇਦੀ ਆਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: je jaravaanaa paraharai jar ves karedee aaeeai |
English: Even if you remove the signs of old age, old age shall still come in the guise of death.

Gurbani: ਕੋ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਭਰੀਐ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: ko rahai na bhareeai paaeeai |5|
English: No one remains here when the count of the breaths is full. ||5||

[Ang 465 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੁਸਲਮਾਨਾ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਰੀਅਤਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: musalamaanaa sifat sareeat parr parr kareh beechaar |
English: The Muslims praise the Islamic law; they read and reflect upon it.

Gurbani: ਬੰਦੇ ਸੇ ਜਿ ਪਵਹਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਬੰਦੀ ਵੇਖਣ ਕਉ ਦੀਦਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: bande se ji paveh vich bandee vekhan kau deedaar |
English: The Lord's bound servants are those who bind themselves to see the Lord's Vision.

Gurbani: ਹਿੰਦੂ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਨਿ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਰੂਪਿ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: hindoo saalaahee saalaahan darasan roop apaar |
English: The Hindus praise the Praiseworthy Lord; the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, His form is incomparable.

Gurbani: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵਹਿ ਅਰਚਾ ਪੂਜਾ ਅਗਰ ਵਾਸੁ ਬਹਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: teerath naaveh arachaa poojaa agar vaas bahakaar |
English: They bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, making offerings of flowers, and burning incense before idols.

Gurbani: ਜੋਗੀ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਧਿਆਵਨਿੑ ਜੇਤੇ ਅਲਖ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jogee sun dhiaavana jete alakh naam karataar |
English: The Yogis meditate on the absolute Lord there; they call the Creator the Unseen Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੂਖਮ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sookham moorat naam niranjan kaaeaa kaa aakaar |
English: But to the subtle image of the Immaculate Name, they apply the form of a body.

Gurbani: ਸਤੀਆ ਮਨਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਦੇਣੈ ਕੈ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: sateea man santokh upajai denai kai veechaar |
English: In the minds of the virtuous, contentment is produced, thinking about their giving.

Gurbani: ਦੇ ਦੇ ਮੰਗਹਿ ਸਹਸਾ ਗੂਣਾ ਸੋਭ ਕਰੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: de de mangeh sahasaa goonaa sobh kare sansaar |
English: They give and give, but ask a thousand-fold more, and hope that the world will honor them.

Gurbani: ਚੋਰਾ ਜਾਰਾ ਤੈ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਾ ਖਾਰਾਬਾ ਵੇਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: choraa jaaraa tai koorriaaraa khaaraabaa vekaar |
English: The thieves, adulterers, perjurers, evil-doers and sinners

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਹੋਦਾ ਖਾਇ ਚਲਹਿ ਐਥਾਊ ਤਿਨਾ ਭਿ ਕਾਈ ਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: eik hodaa khaae chaleh aithaaoo tinaa bhi kaaee kaar |
English: - after using up what good karma they had, they depart; have they done any good deeds here at all?

Gurbani: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਜੀਆ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਲੋਆ ਆਕਾਰਾ ਆਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: jal thal jeea pureea loaa aakaaraa aakaar |
English: There are beings and creatures in the water and on the land, in the worlds and universes, form upon form.

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਜਿ ਆਖਹਿ ਸੁ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਭਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: oe ji aakheh su toonhai jaaneh tinaa bhi teree saar |
English: Whatever they say, You know; You care for them all.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਾ ਭੁਖ ਸਾਲਾਹਣੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak bhagataa bhukh saalaahan sach naam aadhaar |
English: O Nanak, the hunger of the devotees is to praise You; the True Name is their only support.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਣਵੰਤਿਆ ਪਾ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sadaa anand raheh din raatee gunavantiaa paa chhaar |1|
English: They live in eternal bliss, day and night; they are the dust of the feet of the virtuous. ||1||

[Ang 466 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਿਟੀ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਨ ਕੀ ਪੇੜੈ ਪਈ ਕੁਮਿੑਆਰ ॥
Transliteration: mittee musalamaan kee perrai pee kumaaar |
English: The clay of the Muslim's grave becomes clay for the potter's wheel.

Gurbani: ਘੜਿ ਭਾਂਡੇ ਇਟਾ ਕੀਆ ਜਲਦੀ ਕਰੇ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: gharr bhaandde ittaa keea jaladee kare pukaar |
English: Pots and bricks are fashioned from it, and it cries out as it burns.

Gurbani: ਜਲਿ ਜਲਿ ਰੋਵੈ ਬਪੁੜੀ ਝੜਿ ਝੜਿ ਪਵਹਿ ਅੰਗਿਆਰ ॥
Transliteration: jal jal rovai bapurree jharr jharr paveh angiaar |
English: The poor clay burns, burns and weeps, as the fiery coals fall upon it.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak jin karatai kaaran keea so jaanai karataar |2|
English: O Nanak, the Creator created the creation; the Creator Lord alone knows. ||2||

[Ang 466 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bin satigur kinai na paaeo bin satigur kinai na paaeaa |
English: Without the True Guru, no one has obtained the Lord; without the True Guru, no one has obtained the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਪੁ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: satigur vich aap rakhion kar paragatt aakh sunaaeaa |
English: He has placed Himself within the True Guru; revealing Himself, He declares this openly.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: satigur miliai sadaa mukat hai jin vichahu mohu chukaaeaa |
English: Meeting the True Guru, eternal liberation is obtained; He has banished attachment from within.

Gurbani: ਉਤਮੁ ਏਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: autam ehu beechaar hai jin sache siau chit laaeaa |
English: This is the highest thought, that one's consciousness is attached to the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: jagajeevan daataa paaeaa |6|
English: Thus the Lord of the World, the Great Giver is obtained. ||6||

[Ang 466 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਇਆ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau vich aaeaa hau vich geaa |
English: In ego they come, and in ego they go.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੰਮਿਆ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਮੁਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau vich jamiaa hau vich muaa |
English: In ego they are born, and in ego they die.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਦਿਤਾ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau vich ditaa hau vich leaa |
English: In ego they give, and in ego they take.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਖਟਿਆ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau vich khattiaa hau vich geaa |
English: In ego they earn, and in ego they lose.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: hau vich sachiaar koorriaar |
English: In ego they become truthful or false.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: hau vich paap pun veechaar |
English: In ego they reflect on virtue and sin.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਰਕਿ ਸੁਰਗਿ ਅਵਤਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: hau vich narak surag avataar |
English: In ego they go to heaven or hell.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਸੈ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਰੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: hau vich hasai hau vich rovai |
English: In ego they laugh, and in ego they weep.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਭਰੀਐ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: hau vich bhareeai hau vich dhovai |
English: In ego they become dirty, and in ego they are washed clean.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਾਤੀ ਜਿਨਸੀ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: hau vich jaatee jinasee khovai |
English: In ego they lose social status and class.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਿਆਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: hau vich moorakh hau vich siaanaa |
English: In ego they are ignorant, and in ego they are wise.

Gurbani: ਮੋਖ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: mokh mukat kee saar na jaanaa |
English: They do not know the value of salvation and liberation.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਹਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau vich maaeaa hau vich chhaaeaa |
English: In ego they love Maya, and in ego they are kept in darkness by it.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: haumai kar kar jant upaaeaa |
English: Living in ego, mortal beings are created.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਤਾ ਦਰੁ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
Transliteration: haumai boojhai taa dar soojhai |
English: When one understands ego, then the Lord's gate is known.

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਹੂਣਾ ਕਥਿ ਕਥਿ ਲੂਝੈ ॥
Transliteration: giaan vihoonaa kath kath loojhai |
English: Without spiritual wisdom, they babble and argue.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਲਿਖੀਐ ਲੇਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak hukamee likheeai lekh |
English: O Nanak, by the Lord's Command, destiny is recorded.

Gurbani: ਜੇਹਾ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਤੇਹਾ ਵੇਖੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jehaa vekheh tehaa vekh |1|
English: As the Lord sees us, so are we seen. ||1||

[Ang 466 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 2 |
English: Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਏਹਾ ਜਾਤਿ ਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: haumai ehaa jaat hai haumai karam kamaeh |
English: This is the nature of ego, that people perform their actions in ego.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਏਈ ਬੰਧਨਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: haumai eee bandhanaa fir fir jonee paeh |
English: This is the bondage of ego, that time and time again, they are reborn.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਿਥਹੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਕਿਤੁ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਇਹ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: haumai kithahu aoopajai kit sanjam ih jaae |
English: Where does ego come from? How can it be removed?

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਏਹੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੈ ਪਇਐ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਫਿਰਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: haumai eho hukam hai peiai kirat firaeh |
English: This ego exists by the Lord's Order; people wander according to their past actions.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਦੀਰਘ ਰੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਦਾਰੂ ਭੀ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: haumai deeragh rog hai daaroo bhee is maeh |
English: Ego is a chronic disease, but it contains its own cure as well.

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: kirapaa kare je aapanee taa gur kaa sabad kamaeh |
English: If the Lord grants His Grace, one acts according to the Teachings of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਜਨਹੁ ਇਤੁ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਦੁਖ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak kahai sunahu janahu it sanjam dukh jaeh |2|
English: Nanak says, listen, people: in this way, troubles depart. ||2||

[Ang 466 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸੇਵ ਕੀਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀੲਂੀ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sev keetee santokheenee jinaee sacho sach dhiaaeaa |
English: Those who serve are content. They meditate on the Truest of the True.

Gurbani: ਓਨੑੀ ਮੰਦੈ ਪੈਰੁ ਨ ਰਖਿਓ ਕਰਿ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: onaee mandai pair na rakhio kar sukrit dharam kamaaeaa |
English: They do not place their feet in sin, but do good deeds and live righteously in Dharma.

Gurbani: ਓਨੑੀ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਤੋੜੇ ਬੰਧਨਾ ਅੰਨੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਥੋੜਾ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: onaee duneea torre bandhanaa an paanee thorraa khaaeaa |
English: They burn away the bonds of the world, and eat a simple diet of grain and water.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਬਖਸੀਸੀ ਅਗਲਾ ਨਿਤ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਚੜਹਿ ਸਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: toon bakhaseesee agalaa nit deveh charreh savaaeaa |
English: You are the Great Forgiver; You give continually, more and more each day.

Gurbani: ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: vaddiaaee vaddaa paaeaa |7|
English: By His greatness, the Great Lord is obtained. ||7||

[Ang 467 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪੁਰਖਾਂ ਬਿਰਖਾਂ ਤੀਰਥਾਂ ਤਟਾਂ ਮੇਘਾਂ ਖੇਤਾਂਹ ॥
Transliteration: purakhaan birakhaan teerathaan tattaan meghaan khetaanh |
English: Men, trees, sacred shrines of pilgrimage, banks of sacred rivers, clouds, fields,

Gurbani: ਦੀਪਾਂ ਲੋਆਂ ਮੰਡਲਾਂ ਖੰਡਾਂ ਵਰਭੰਡਾਂਹ ॥
Transliteration: deepaan loaan manddalaan khanddaan varabhanddaanh |
English: islands, continents, worlds, solar systems, and universes;

Gurbani: ਅੰਡਜ ਜੇਰਜ ਉਤਭੁਜਾਂ ਖਾਣੀ ਸੇਤਜਾਂਹ ॥
Transliteration: anddaj jeraj utabhujaan khaanee setajaanh |
English: the four sources of creation - born of eggs, born of the womb, born of the earth and born of sweat;

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਮਿਤਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਰਾਂ ਮੇਰਾਂ ਜੰਤਾਹ ॥
Transliteration: so mit jaanai naanakaa saraan meraan jantaah |
English: oceans, mountains, and all beings - O Nanak, He alone knows their condition.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਸੰਮਾਲੇ ਸਭਨਾਹ ॥
Transliteration: naanak jant upaae kai samaale sabhanaah |
English: O Nanak, having created the living beings, He cherishes them all.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਕਰਣਾ ਕੀਆ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਭਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਤਾਹ ॥
Transliteration: jin karatai karanaa keea chintaa bhi karanee taah |
English: The Creator who created the creation, takes care of it as well.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਜਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: so karataa chintaa kare jin upaaeaa jag |
English: He, the Creator who formed the world, cares for it.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਜੋਹਾਰੀ ਸੁਅਸਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਅਭਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: tis johaaree suasat tis tis deebaan abhag |
English: Unto Him I bow and offer my reverence; His Royal Court is eternal.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਆ ਟਿਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਤਗੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak sache naam bin kiaa ttikaa kiaa tag |1|
English: O Nanak, without the True Name, of what use is the frontal mark of the Hindus, or their sacred thread? ||1||

[Ang 467 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਲਖ ਨੇਕੀਆ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਲਖ ਪੁੰਨਾ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: lakh nekeea changiaaeea lakh punaa paravaan |
English: Hundreds of thousands of virtues and good actions, and hundreds of thousands of blessed charities,

Gurbani: ਲਖ ਤਪ ਉਪਰਿ ਤੀਰਥਾਂ ਸਹਜ ਜੋਗ ਬੇਬਾਣ ॥
Transliteration: lakh tap upar teerathaan sehaj jog bebaan |
English: hundreds of thousands of penances at sacred shrines, and the practice of Sehj Yoga in the wilderness,

Gurbani: ਲਖ ਸੂਰਤਣ ਸੰਗਰਾਮ ਰਣ ਮਹਿ ਛੁਟਹਿ ਪਰਾਣ ॥
Transliteration: lakh sooratan sangaraam ran meh chhutteh paraan |
English: hundreds of thousands of courageous actions and giving up the breath of life on the field of battle,

Gurbani: ਲਖ ਸੁਰਤੀ ਲਖ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਪੜੀਅਹਿ ਪਾਠ ਪੁਰਾਣ ॥
Transliteration: lakh suratee lakh giaan dhiaan parreeeh paatth puraan |
English: hundreds of thousands of divine understandings, hundreds of thousands of divine wisdoms and meditations and readings of the Vedas and the Puraanas

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਕਰਣਾ ਕੀਆ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: jin karatai karanaa keea likhiaa aavan jaan |
English: - before the Creator who created the creation, and who ordained coming and going,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਤੀ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਕਰਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak matee mithiaa karam sachaa neesaan |2|
English: O Nanak, all these things are false. True is the Insignia of His Grace. ||2||

[Ang 467 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਏਕੁ ਤੂੰ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa saahib ek toon jin sacho sach varataaeaa |
English: You alone are the True Lord. The Truth of Truths is pervading everywhere.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jis toon dehi tis milai sach taa tinaee sach kamaaeaa |
English: He alone receives the Truth, unto whom You give it; then, he practices Truth.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨੑ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਚੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: satigur miliai sach paaeaa jina kai hiradai sach vasaaeaa |
English: Meeting the True Guru, Truth is found. In His Heart, Truth is abiding.

Gurbani: ਮੂਰਖ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੑੀ ਮਨਮੁਖੀ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: moorakh sach na jaananaee manamukhee janam gavaaeaa |
English: The fools do not know the Truth. The self-willed manmukhs waste their lives away in vain.

Gurbani: ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕਾਹੇ ਆਇਆ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: vich duneea kaahe aaeaa |8|
English: Why have they even come into the world? ||8||

[Ang 467 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਗਡੀ ਲਦੀਅਹਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਭਰੀਅਹਿ ਸਾਥ ॥
Transliteration: parr parr gaddee ladeeeh parr parr bhareeeh saath |
English: You may read and read loads of books; you may read and study vast multitudes of books.

Gurbani: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਬੇੜੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਗਡੀਅਹਿ ਖਾਤ ॥
Transliteration: parr parr berree paaeeai parr parr gaddeeeh khaat |
English: You may read and read boat-loads of books; you may read and read and fill pits with them.

Gurbani: ਪੜੀਅਹਿ ਜੇਤੇ ਬਰਸ ਬਰਸ ਪੜੀਅਹਿ ਜੇਤੇ ਮਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: parreeeh jete baras baras parreeeh jete maas |
English: You may read them year after year; you may read them as many months are there are.

Gurbani: ਪੜੀਐ ਜੇਤੀ ਆਰਜਾ ਪੜੀਅਹਿ ਜੇਤੇ ਸਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: parreeai jetee aarajaa parreeeh jete saas |
English: You may read them all your life; you may read them with every breath.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਲੇਖੈ ਇਕ ਗਲ ਹੋਰੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਝਖਣਾ ਝਾਖ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak lekhai ik gal hor haumai jhakhanaa jhaakh |1|
English: O Nanak, only one thing is of any account: everything else is useless babbling and idle talk in ego. ||1||

[Ang 467 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਲਿਖਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪੜਿਆ ॥ ਤੇਤਾ ਕੜਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: likh likh parriaa | tetaa karriaa |
English: The more one write and reads, the more one burns.

Gurbani: ਬਹੁ ਤੀਰਥ ਭਵਿਆ ॥ ਤੇਤੋ ਲਵਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: bahu teerath bhaviaa | teto laviaa |
English: The more one wanders at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, the more one talks uselessly.

Gurbani: ਬਹੁ ਭੇਖ ਕੀਆ ਦੇਹੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: bahu bhekh keea dehee dukh deea |
English: The more one wears religious robes, the more pain he causes his body.

Gurbani: ਸਹੁ ਵੇ ਜੀਆ ਅਪਣਾ ਕੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: sahu ve jeea apanaa keea |
English: O my soul, you must endure the consequences of your own actions.

Gurbani: ਅੰਨੁ ਨ ਖਾਇਆ ਸਾਦੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: an na khaaeaa saad gavaaeaa |
English: One who does not eat the corn, misses out on the taste.

Gurbani: ਬਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bahu dukh paaeaa doojaa bhaaeaa |
English: One obtains great pain, in the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਨ ਪਹਿਰੈ ॥ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਕਹਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: basatr na pahirai | ahinis kaharai |
English: One who does not wear any clothes, suffers night and day.

Gurbani: ਮੋਨਿ ਵਿਗੂਤਾ ॥ ਕਿਉ ਜਾਗੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੂਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: mon vigootaa | kiau jaagai gur bin sootaa |
English: Through silence, he is ruined. How can the sleeping one be awakened without the Guru?

Gurbani: ਪਗ ਉਪੇਤਾਣਾ ॥ ਅਪਣਾ ਕੀਆ ਕਮਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: pag upetaanaa | apanaa keea kamaanaa |
English: One who goes barefoot suffers by his own actions.

Gurbani: ਅਲੁ ਮਲੁ ਖਾਈ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਾਈ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: al mal khaaee sir chhaaee paaee |
English: One who eats filth and throws ashes on his head

Gurbani: ਮੂਰਖਿ ਅੰਧੈ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: moorakh andhai pat gavaaee |
English: the blind fool loses his honor.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: vin naavai kichh thaae na paaee |
English: Without the Name, nothing is of any use.

Gurbani: ਰਹੈ ਬੇਬਾਣੀ ਮੜੀ ਮਸਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: rahai bebaanee marree masaanee |
English: One who lives in the wilderness, in cemetaries and cremation grounds

Gurbani: ਅੰਧੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: andh na jaanai fir pachhutaanee |
English: - that blind man does not know the Lord; he regrets and repents in the end.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: satigur bhette so sukh paae |
English: One who meets the True Guru finds peace.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam man vasaae |
English: He enshrines the Name of the Lord in his mind.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: naanak nadar kare so paae |
English: O Nanak, when the Lord grants His Grace, He is obtained.

Gurbani: ਆਸ ਅੰਦੇਸੇ ਤੇ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aas andese te nihakeval haumai sabad jalaae |2|
English: He becomes free of hope and fear, and burns away his ego with the Word of the Shabad. ||2||

[Ang 468 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਦੇ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗਾਵਦੇ ॥
