Transliteration: bhagat terai man bhaavade dar sohan keerat gaavade |
English: Your devotees are pleasing to Your Mind, Lord. They look beautiful at Your door, singing Your Praises.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਮਾ ਬਾਹਰੇ ਦਰਿ ਢੋਅ ਨ ਲਹਨੑੀ ਧਾਵਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak karamaa baahare dar dtoa na lehanaee dhaavade |
English: O Nanak, those who are denied Your Grace, find no shelter at Your Door; they continue wandering.

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਮੂਲੁ ਨ ਬੁਝਨਿੑ ਆਪਣਾ ਅਣਹੋਦਾ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: eik mool na bujhana aapanaa anahodaa aap ganaaeide |
English: Some do not understand their origins, and without cause, they display their self-conceit.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਢਾਢੀ ਕਾ ਨੀਚ ਜਾਤਿ ਹੋਰਿ ਉਤਮ ਜਾਤਿ ਸਦਾਇਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: hau dtaadtee kaa neech jaat hor utam jaat sadaaeide |
English: I am the Lord's minstrel, of low social status; others call themselves high caste.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨੑ ਮੰਗਾ ਜਿ ਤੁਝੈ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: tina mangaa ji tujhai dhiaaeide |9|
English: I seek those who meditate on You. ||9||

[Ang 468 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕੂੜੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਪਰਜਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: koorr raajaa koorr parajaa koorr sabh sansaar |
English: False is the king, false are the subjects; false is the whole world.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜੁ ਮੰਡਪ ਕੂੜੁ ਮਾੜੀ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੈਸਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: koorr manddap koorr maarree koorr baisanahaar |
English: False is the mansion, false are the skyscrapers; false are those who live in them.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜੁ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਰੁਪਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਪੈਨੑਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: koorr sueinaa koorr rupaa koorr painanahaar |
English: False is gold, and false is silver; false are those who wear them.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਪੜੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: koorr kaaeaa koorr kaparr koorr roop apaar |
English: False is the body, false are the clothes; false is incomparable beauty.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜੁ ਮੀਆ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੀਬੀ ਖਪਿ ਹੋਏ ਖਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: koorr meea koorr beebee khap hoe khaar |
English: False is the husband, false is the wife; they mourn and waste away.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜਿ ਕੂੜੈ ਨੇਹੁ ਲਗਾ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: koorr koorrai nehu lagaa visariaa karataar |
English: The false ones love falsehood, and forget their Creator.

Gurbani: ਕਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਕੀਚੈ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਚਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: kis naal keechai dosatee sabh jag chalanahaar |
English: With whom should I become friends, if all the world shall pass away?

Gurbani: ਕੂੜੁ ਮਿਠਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਮਾਖਿਉ ਕੂੜੁ ਡੋਬੇ ਪੂਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: koorr mitthaa koorr maakhiau koorr ddobe poor |
English: False is sweetness, false is honey; through falsehood, boat-loads of men have drowned.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਾਝੁ ਕੂੜੋ ਕੂੜੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak vakhaanai benatee tudh baajh koorro koorr |1|
English: Nanak speaks this prayer: without You, Lord, everything is totally false. ||1||

[Ang 468 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sach taa par jaaneeai jaa ridai sachaa hoe |
English: One knows the Truth only when the Truth is in his heart.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਤਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਹਛਾ ਧੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: koorr kee mal utarai tan kare hachhaa dhoe |
English: The filth of falsehood departs, and the body is washed clean.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਸਚਿ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sach taa par jaaneeai jaa sach dhare piaar |
English: One knows the Truth only when he bears love to the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਉ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਹਸੀਐ ਤਾ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: naau sun man rahaseeai taa paae mokh duaar |
English: Hearing the Name, the mind is enraptured; then, he attains the gate of salvation.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: sach taa par jaaneeai jaa jugat jaanai jeeo |
English: One knows the Truth only when he knows the true way of life.

Gurbani: ਧਰਤਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਸਾਧਿ ਕੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੇਇ ਕਰਤਾ ਬੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: dharat kaaeaa saadh kai vich dee karataa beeo |
English: Preparing the field of the body, he plants the Seed of the Creator.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਸਿਖ ਸਚੀ ਲੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: sach taa par jaaneeai jaa sikh sachee lee |
English: One knows the Truth only when he receives true instruction.

Gurbani: ਦਇਆ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: deaa jaanai jeea kee kichh pun daan karee |
English: Showing mercy to other beings, he makes donations to charities.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਤਾਂ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਆਤਮ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: sach taan par jaaneeai jaa aatam teerath kare nivaas |
English: One knows the Truth only when he dwells in the sacred shrine of pilgrimage of his own soul.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਨੋ ਪੁਛਿ ਕੈ ਬਹਿ ਰਹੈ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: satiguroo no puchh kai beh rahai kare nivaas |
English: He sits and receives instruction from the True Guru, and lives in accordance with His Will.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਹੋਇ ਦਾਰੂ ਪਾਪ ਕਢੈ ਧੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sach sabhanaa hoe daaroo paap kadtai dhoe |
English: Truth is the medicine for all; it removes and washes away our sins.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਜਿਨ ਸਚੁ ਪਲੈ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak vakhaanai benatee jin sach palai hoe |2|
English: Nanak speaks this prayer to those who have Truth in their laps. ||2||

[Ang 468 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਦਾਨੁ ਮਹਿੰਡਾ ਤਲੀ ਖਾਕੁ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: daan mahinddaa talee khaak je milai ta masatak laaeeai |
English: The gift I seek is the dust of the feet of the Saints; if I were to obtain it, I would apply it to my forehead.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜਾ ਲਾਲਚੁ ਛਡੀਐ ਹੋਇ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: koorraa laalach chhaddeeai hoe ik man alakh dhiaaeeai |
English: Renounce false greed, and meditate single-mindedly on the unseen Lord.

Gurbani: ਫਲੁ ਤੇਵੇਹੋ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੇਵੇਹੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: fal teveho paaeeai jevehee kaar kamaaeeai |
English: As are the actions we commit, so are the rewards we receive.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਾ ਧੂੜਿ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਦੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: je hovai poorab likhiaa taa dhoorr tinaa dee paaeeai |
English: If it is so pre-ordained, then one obtains the dust of the feet of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਮਤਿ ਥੋੜੀ ਸੇਵ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: mat thorree sev gavaaeeai |10|
English: But through small-mindedness, we forfeit the merits of selfless service. ||10||

[Ang 468 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਚਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਕਲਿ ਕਾਲਖ ਬੇਤਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: sach kaal koorr varatiaa kal kaalakh betaal |
English: There is a famine of Truth; falsehood prevails, and the blackness of the Dark Age of Kali Yuga has turned men into demons.

Gurbani: ਬੀਉ ਬੀਜਿ ਪਤਿ ਲੈ ਗਏ ਅਬ ਕਿਉ ਉਗਵੈ ਦਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: beeo beej pat lai ge ab kiau ugavai daal |
English: Those who planted their seed have departed with honor; now, how can the shattered seed sprout?

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਇਕੁ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਉਗਵੈ ਰੁਤੀ ਹੂ ਰੁਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: je ik hoe ta ugavai rutee hoo rut hoe |
English: If the seed is whole, and it is the proper season, then the seed will sprout.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਹੈ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਕੋਰੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak paahai baaharaa korai rang na soe |
English: O Nanak, without treatment, the raw fabric cannot be dyed.

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਖੁੰਬਿ ਚੜਾਈਐ ਸਰਮੁ ਪਾਹੁ ਤਨਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhai vich khunb charraaeeai saram paahu tan hoe |
English: In the Fear of God it is bleached white, if the treatment of modesty is applied to the cloth of the body.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤੀ ਜੇ ਰਪੈ ਕੂੜੈ ਸੋਇ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak bhagatee je rapai koorrai soe na koe |1|
English: O Nanak, if one is imbued with devotional worship, his reputation is not false. ||1||

[Ang 468 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਲਬੁ ਪਾਪੁ ਦੁਇ ਰਾਜਾ ਮਹਤਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਿਕਦਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: lab paap due raajaa mahataa koorr hoaa sikadaar |
English: Greed and sin are the king and prime minister; falsehood is the treasurer.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮੁ ਨੇਬੁ ਸਦਿ ਪੁਛੀਐ ਬਹਿ ਬਹਿ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: kaam neb sad puchheeai beh beh kare beechaar |
English: Sexual desire, the chief advisor, is summoned and consulted; they all sit together and contemplate their plans.

Gurbani: ਅੰਧੀ ਰਯਤਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਹੂਣੀ ਭਾਹਿ ਭਰੇ ਮੁਰਦਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: andhee rayat giaan vihoonee bhaeh bhare muradaar |
English: Their subjects are blind, and without wisdom, they try to please the will of the dead.

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਨਚਹਿ ਵਾਜੇ ਵਾਵਹਿ ਰੂਪ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: giaanee nacheh vaaje vaaveh roop kareh seegaar |
English: The spiritually wise dance and play their musical instruments, adorning themselves with beautiful decorations.

Gurbani: ਊਚੇ ਕੂਕਹਿ ਵਾਦਾ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਜੋਧਾ ਕਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: aooche kookeh vaadaa gaaveh jodhaa kaa veechaar |
English: They shout out loud, and sing epic poems and heroic stories.

Gurbani: ਮੂਰਖ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਹਿਕਮਤਿ ਹੁਜਤਿ ਸੰਜੈ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: moorakh panddit hikamat hujat sanjai kareh piaar |
English: The fools call themselves spiritual scholars, and by their clever tricks, they love to gather wealth.

Gurbani: ਧਰਮੀ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਗਾਵਾਵਹਿ ਮੰਗਹਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: dharamee dharam kareh gaavaaveh mangeh mokh duaar |
English: The righteous waste their righteousness, by asking for the door of salvation.

Gurbani: ਜਤੀ ਸਦਾਵਹਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਛਡਿ ਬਹਹਿ ਘਰ ਬਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jatee sadaaveh jugat na jaaneh chhadd baheh ghar baar |
English: They call themselves celibate, and abandon their homes, but they do not know the true way of life.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਪੂਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਘਟਿ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਆਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: sabh ko pooraa aape hovai ghatt na koee aakhai |
English: Everyone calls himself perfect; none call themselves imperfect.

Gurbani: ਪਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ ਪਿਛੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੋਲਿਆ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: pat paravaanaa pichhai paaeeai taa naanak toliaa jaapai |2|
English: If the weight of honor is placed on the scale, then, O Nanak, one sees his true weight. ||2||

[Ang 469 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਵਦੀ ਸੁ ਵਜਗਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਚਾ ਵੇਖੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: vadee su vajag naanakaa sachaa vekhai soe |
English: Evil actions become publicly known; O Nanak, the True Lord sees everything.

Gurbani: ਸਭਨੀ ਛਾਲਾ ਮਾਰੀਆ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabhanee chhaalaa maareea karataa kare su hoe |
English: Everyone makes the attempt, but that alone happens which the Creator Lord does.

Gurbani: ਅਗੈ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਜੋਰੁ ਹੈ ਅਗੈ ਜੀਉ ਨਵੇ ॥
Transliteration: agai jaat na jor hai agai jeeo nave |
English: In the world hereafter, social status and power mean nothing; hereafter, the soul is new.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕੀ ਲੇਖੈ ਪਤਿ ਪਵੈ ਚੰਗੇ ਸੇਈ ਕੇਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jin kee lekhai pat pavai change seee kee |3|
English: Those few, whose honor is confirmed, are good. ||3||

[Ang 469 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਜਿਨਾ ਕਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਾ ਤਿਨੀ ਖਸਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: dhur karam jinaa kau tudh paaeaa taa tinee khasam dhiaaeaa |
English: Only those whose karma You have pre-ordained from the very beginning, O Lord, meditate on You.

Gurbani: ਏਨਾ ਜੰਤਾ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਵੇਕੀ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: enaa jantaa kai vas kichh naahee tudh vekee jagat upaaeaa |
English: Nothing is in the power of these beings; You created the various worlds.

Gurbani: ਇਕਨਾ ਨੋ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਆਪਹੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਖੁਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: eikanaa no toon mel laihi ik aapahu tudh khuaaeaa |
English: Some, You unite with Yourself, and some, You lead astray.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਜਿਥੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur kirapaa te jaaniaa jithai tudh aap bujhaaeaa |
English: By Guru's Grace You are known; through Him, You reveal Yourself.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: sahaje hee sach samaaeaa |11|
English: We are easily absorbed in You. ||11||

[Ang 469 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦੁਖੁ ਦਾਰੂ ਸੁਖੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਭਇਆ ਜਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਤਾਮਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: dukh daaroo sukh rog bheaa jaa sukh taam na hoee |
English: Suffering is the medicine, and pleasure the disease, because where there is pleasure, there is no desire for God.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰਣਾ ਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾ ਹਉ ਕਰੀ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: toon karataa karanaa mai naahee jaa hau karee na hoee |1|
English: You are the Creator Lord; I can do nothing. Even if I try, nothing happens. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਵਸਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: balihaaree kudarat vasiaa |
English: I am a sacrifice to Your almighty creative power which is pervading everywhere.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਲਖਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: teraa ant na jaaee lakhiaa |1| rahaau |
English: Your limits cannot be known. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਾਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਅਕਲ ਕਲਾ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jaat meh jot jot meh jaataa akal kalaa bharapoor rahiaa |
English: Your Light is in Your creatures, and Your creatures are in Your Light; Your almighty power is pervading everywhere.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸੁਆਲਿੑਉ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤੀ ਸੋ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: toon sachaa saahib sifat suaalau jin keetee so paar peaa |
English: You are the True Lord and Master; Your Praise is so beautiful. One who sings it, is carried across.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀਆ ਬਾਤਾ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak karate keea baataa jo kichh karanaa su kar rahiaa |2|
English: Nanak speaks the stories of the Creator Lord; whatever He is to do, He does. ||2||

[Ang 469 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 2 |
English: Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੋਗ ਸਬਦੰ ਗਿਆਨ ਸਬਦੰ ਬੇਦ ਸਬਦੰ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣਹ ॥
Transliteration: jog sabadan giaan sabadan bed sabadan braahamanah |
English: The Way of Yoga is the Way of spiritual wisdom; the Vedas are the Way of the Brahmins.

Gurbani: ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਸਬਦੰ ਸੂਰ ਸਬਦੰ ਸੂਦ੍ਰ ਸਬਦੰ ਪਰਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਤਹ ॥
Transliteration: khatree sabadan soor sabadan soodr sabadan paraa kritah |
English: The Way of the Khshatriya is the Way of bravery; the Way of the Shudras is service to others.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਸਬਦੰ ਏਕ ਸਬਦੰ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਭੇਉ ॥
Transliteration: sarab sabadan ek sabadan je ko jaanai bheo |
English: The Way of all is the Way of the One; Nanak is a slave to one who knows this secret;

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਦੇਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak taa kaa daas hai soee niranjan deo |3|
English: He himself is the Immaculate Divine Lord. ||3||

[Ang 469 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 2 |
English: Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨੰ ਸਰਬ ਦੇਵਾ ਦੇਵ ਦੇਵਾ ਤ ਆਤਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: ek krisanan sarab devaa dev devaa ta aatamaa |
English: The One Lord Krishna is the Divine Lord of all; He is the Divinity of the individual soul.

Gurbani: ਆਤਮਾ ਬਾਸੁਦੇਵਸੵਿ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਭੇਉ ॥
Transliteration: aatamaa baasudevasay je ko jaanai bheo |
English: Nanak is a slave to anyone who understands this mystery of the all-pervading Lord;

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਦੇਉ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak taa kaa daas hai soee niranjan deo |4|
English: He himself is the Immaculate Divine Lord. ||4||

[Ang 469 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕੁੰਭੇ ਬਧਾ ਜਲੁ ਰਹੈ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੁੰਭੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: kunbhe badhaa jal rahai jal bin kunbh na hoe |
English: Water remains confined within the pitcher, but without water, the pitcher could not have been formed;

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨ ਕਾ ਬਧਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: giaan kaa badhaa man rahai gur bin giaan na hoe |5|
English: just so, the mind is restrained by spiritual wisdom, but without the Guru, there is no spiritual wisdom. ||5||

[Ang 469 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਪੜਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਨਹਗਾਰੁ ਤਾ ਓਮੀ ਸਾਧੁ ਨ ਮਾਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: parriaa hovai gunahagaar taa omee saadh na maareeai |
English: If an educated person is a sinner, then the illiterate holy man is not to be punished.

Gurbani: ਜੇਹਾ ਘਾਲੇ ਘਾਲਣਾ ਤੇਵੇਹੋ ਨਾਉ ਪਚਾਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: jehaa ghaale ghaalanaa teveho naau pachaareeai |
English: As are the deeds done, so is the reputation one acquires.

Gurbani: ਐਸੀ ਕਲਾ ਨ ਖੇਡੀਐ ਜਿਤੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਗਇਆ ਹਾਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: aisee kalaa na kheddeeai jit daragah geaa haareeai |
English: So do not play such a game, which will bring you to ruin at the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਪੜਿਆ ਅਤੈ ਓਮੀਆ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਅਗੈ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: parriaa atai omeea veechaar agai veechaareeai |
English: The accounts of the educated and the illiterate shall be judged in the world hereafter.

Gurbani: ਮੁਹਿ ਚਲੈ ਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਮਾਰੀਐ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: muhi chalai su agai maareeai |12|
English: One who stubbornly follows his own mind shall suffer in the world hereafter. ||12||

[Ang 470 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰੁ ਸਰੀਰ ਕਾ ਇਕੁ ਰਥੁ ਇਕੁ ਰਥਵਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak mer sareer kaa ik rath ik rathavaahu |
English: O Nanak, the soul of the body has one chariot and one charioteer.

Gurbani: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਫੇਰਿ ਵਟਾਈਅਹਿ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਬੁਝਹਿ ਤਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jug jug fer vattaaeeeh giaanee bujheh taeh |
English: In age after age they change; the spiritually wise understand this.

Gurbani: ਸਤਜੁਗਿ ਰਥੁ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਕਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਅਗੈ ਰਥਵਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: satajug rath santokh kaa dharam agai rathavaahu |
English: In the Golden Age of Sat Yuga, contentment was the chariot and righteousness the charioteer.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰੇਤੈ ਰਥੁ ਜਤੈ ਕਾ ਜੋਰੁ ਅਗੈ ਰਥਵਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: tretai rath jatai kaa jor agai rathavaahu |
English: In the Silver Age of Traytaa Yuga, celibacy was the chariot and power the charioteer.

Gurbani: ਦੁਆਪੁਰਿ ਰਥੁ ਤਪੈ ਕਾ ਸਤੁ ਅਗੈ ਰਥਵਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: duaapur rath tapai kaa sat agai rathavaahu |
English: In the Brass Age of Dwaapar Yuga, penance was the chariot and truth the charioteer.

Gurbani: ਕਲਜੁਗਿ ਰਥੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਕਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਅਗੈ ਰਥਵਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kalajug rath agan kaa koorr agai rathavaahu |1|
English: In the Iron Age of Kali Yuga, fire is the chariot and falsehood the charioteer. ||1||

[Ang 470 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਾਮ ਕਹੈ ਸੇਤੰਬਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਚ ਮਹਿ ਆਛੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਰਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: saam kahai setanbar suaamee sach meh aachhai saach rahe |
English: The Sama Veda says that the Lord Master is robed in white; in the Age of Truth,

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: sabh ko sach samaavai |
English: Everyone desired Truth, abided in Truth, and was merged in the Truth.

Gurbani: ਰਿਗੁ ਕਹੈ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: rig kahai rahiaa bharapoor |
English: The Rig Veda says that God is permeating and pervading everywhere;

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵਾ ਮਹਿ ਸੂਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam devaa meh soor |
English: among the deities, the Lord's Name is the most exalted.

Gurbani: ਨਾਇ ਲਇਐ ਪਰਾਛਤ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: naae leiai paraachhat jaeh |
English: Chanting the Name, sins depart;

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਉ ਮੋਖੰਤਰੁ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: naanak tau mokhantar paeh |
English: O Nanak, then, one obtains salvation.

Gurbani: ਜੁਜ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਰਿ ਛਲੀ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਾਵਲਿ ਕਾਨੑ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨੁ ਜਾਦਮੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: juj meh jor chhalee chandraaval kaana krisan jaadam bheaa |
English: In the Jujar Veda, Kaan Krishna of the Yaadva tribe seduced Chandraavali by force.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਜਾਤੁ ਗੋਪੀ ਲੈ ਆਇਆ ਬਿੰਦ੍ਰਾਬਨ ਮਹਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: paarajaat gopee lai aaeaa bindraaban meh rang keea |
English: He brought the Elysian Tree for his milk-maid, and revelled in Brindaaban.

Gurbani: ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਬੇਦੁ ਅਥਰਬਣੁ ਹੂਆ ਨਾਉ ਖੁਦਾਈ ਅਲਹੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kal meh bed atharaban hooaa naau khudaaee alahu bheaa |
English: In the Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Atharva Veda became prominent; Allah became the Name of God.

Gurbani: ਨੀਲ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਲੇ ਕਪੜੇ ਪਹਿਰੇ ਤੁਰਕ ਪਠਾਣੀ ਅਮਲੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: neel basatr le kaparre pahire turak patthaanee amal keea |
English: Men began to wear blue robes and garments; Turks and Pat'haans assumed power.

Gurbani: ਚਾਰੇ ਵੇਦ ਹੋਏ ਸਚਿਆਰ ॥
Transliteration: chaare ved hoe sachiaar |
English: The four Vedas each claim to be true.

Gurbani: ਪੜਹਿ ਗੁਣਹਿ ਤਿਨੑ ਚਾਰ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: parreh guneh tina chaar veechaar |
English: Reading and studying them, four doctrines are found.

Gurbani: ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਨੀਚੁ ਸਦਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: bhaau bhagat kar neech sadaae |
English: With loving devotional worship, abiding in humility,

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੋਖੰਤਰੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tau naanak mokhantar paae |2|
English: O Nanak, salvation is attained. ||2||

[Ang 470 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਖਸਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: satigur vittahu vaariaa jit miliai khasam samaaliaa |
English: I am a sacrifice to the True Guru; meeting Him, I have come to cherish the Lord Master.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਇਨੑੀ ਨੇਤ੍ਰੀ ਜਗਤੁ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jin kar upades giaan anjan deea inaee netree jagat nihaaliaa |
English: He has taught me and given me the healing ointment of spiritual wisdom, and with these eyes, I behold the world.

Gurbani: ਖਸਮੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗੇ ਡੁਬੇ ਸੇ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: khasam chhodd doojai lage ddube se vanajaariaa |
English: Those dealers who abandon their Lord and Master and attach themselves to another, are drowned.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਵੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: satiguroo hai bohithaa viralai kinai veechaariaa |
English: The True Guru is the boat, but few are those who realize this.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਿਆ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa paar utaariaa |13|
English: Granting His Grace, He carries them across. ||13||

[Ang 470 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਿੰਮਲ ਰੁਖੁ ਸਰਾਇਰਾ ਅਤਿ ਦੀਰਘ ਅਤਿ ਮੁਚੁ ॥
Transliteration: sinmal rukh saraaeiraa at deeragh at much |
English: The simmal tree is straight as an arrow; it is very tall, and very thick.

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਜਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਆਸ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਸੇ ਕਿਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: oe ji aaveh aas kar jaeh niraase kit |
English: But those birds which visit it hopefully, depart disappointed.

Gurbani: ਫਲ ਫਿਕੇ ਫੁਲ ਬਕਬਕੇ ਕੰਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਪਤ ॥
Transliteration: fal fike ful bakabake kam na aaveh pat |
English: Its fruits are tasteless, its flowers are nauseating, and its leaves are useless.

Gurbani: ਮਿਠਤੁ ਨੀਵੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਗੁਣ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਤਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: mitthat neevee naanakaa gun changiaaeea tat |
English: Sweetness and humility, O Nanak, are the essence of virtue and goodness.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਨਿਵੈ ਆਪ ਕਉ ਪਰ ਕਉ ਨਿਵੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabh ko nivai aap kau par kau nivai na koe |
English: Everyone bows down to himself; no one bows down to another.

Gurbani: ਧਰਿ ਤਾਰਾਜੂ ਤੋਲੀਐ ਨਿਵੈ ਸੁ ਗਉਰਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: dhar taaraajoo toleeai nivai su gauraa hoe |
English: When something is placed on the balancing scale and weighed, the side which descends is heavier.

Gurbani: ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਦੂਣਾ ਨਿਵੈ ਜੋ ਹੰਤਾ ਮਿਰਗਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: aparaadhee doonaa nivai jo hantaa miragaeh |
English: The sinner, like the deer hunter, bows down twice as much.

Gurbani: ਸੀਸਿ ਨਿਵਾਇਐ ਕਿਆ ਥੀਐ ਜਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਕੁਸੁਧੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sees nivaaeiai kiaa theeai jaa ridai kusudhe jaeh |1|
English: But what can be achieved by bowing the head, when the heart is impure? ||1||

[Ang 470 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪੜਿ ਪੁਸਤਕ ਸੰਧਿਆ ਬਾਦੰ ॥
Transliteration: parr pusatak sandhiaa baadan |
English: You read your books and say your prayers, and then engage in debate;

Gurbani: ਸਿਲ ਪੂਜਸਿ ਬਗੁਲ ਸਮਾਧੰ ॥
Transliteration: sil poojas bagul samaadhan |
English: you worship stones and sit like a stork, pretending to be in Samaadhi.

Gurbani: ਮੁਖਿ ਝੂਠ ਬਿਭੂਖਣ ਸਾਰੰ ॥
Transliteration: mukh jhootth bibhookhan saaran |
English: With your mouth you utter falsehood, and you adorn yourself with precious decorations;

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰੈਪਾਲ ਤਿਹਾਲ ਬਿਚਾਰੰ ॥
Transliteration: traipaal tihaal bichaaran |
English: you recite the three lines of the Gayatri three times a day.

Gurbani: ਗਲਿ ਮਾਲਾ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਲਿਲਾਟੰ ॥
Transliteration: gal maalaa tilak lilaattan |
English: Around your neck is a rosary, and on your forehead is a sacred mark;

Gurbani: ਦੁਇ ਧੋਤੀ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਕਪਾਟੰ ॥
Transliteration: due dhotee basatr kapaattan |
English: upon your head is a turban, and you wear two loin cloths.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਜਾਣਸਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰ ਕਰਮੰ ॥
Transliteration: je jaanas brahaman karaman |
English: If you knew the nature of God,

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਫੋਕਟ ਨਿਸਚਉ ਕਰਮੰ ॥
Transliteration: sabh fokatt nischau karaman |
English: you would know that all of these beliefs and rituals are in vain.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਹਚਉ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak nihchau dhiaavai |
English: Says Nanak, meditate with deep faith;

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਾਟ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: vin satigur vaatt na paavai |2|
English: without the True Guru, no one finds the Way. ||2||

[Ang 470 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਕਪੜੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਾ ਛਡਿ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜਾਵਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaparr roop suhaavanaa chhadd duneea andar jaavanaa |
English: Abandoning the world of beauty, and beautiful clothes, one must depart.

Gurbani: ਮੰਦਾ ਚੰਗਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਕੀਤਾ ਪਾਵਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: mandaa changaa aapanaa aape hee keetaa paavanaa |
English: He obtains the rewards of his good and bad deeds.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮ ਕੀਏ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਦੇ ਰਾਹਿ ਭੀੜੈ ਅਗੈ ਜਾਵਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: hukam kee man bhaavade raeh bheerrai agai jaavanaa |
English: He may issue whatever commands he wishes, but he shall have to take to the narrow path hereafter.

Gurbani: ਨੰਗਾ ਦੋਜਕਿ ਚਾਲਿਆ ਤਾ ਦਿਸੈ ਖਰਾ ਡਰਾਵਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: nangaa dojak chaaliaa taa disai kharaa ddaraavanaa |
English: He goes to hell naked, and he looks hideous then.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਅਉਗਣ ਪਛੋਤਾਵਣਾ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: kar aaugan pachhotaavanaa |14|
English: He regrets the sins he committed. ||14||

[Ang 471 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦਇਆ ਕਪਾਹ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸੂਤੁ ਜਤੁ ਗੰਢੀ ਸਤੁ ਵਟੁ ॥
Transliteration: deaa kapaah santokh soot jat gandtee sat vatt |
English: Make compassion the cotton, contentment the thread, modesty the knot and truth the twist.

Gurbani: ਏਹੁ ਜਨੇਊ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਹਈ ਤ ਪਾਡੇ ਘਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: ehu janeaoo jeea kaa hee ta paadde ghat |
English: This is the sacred thread of the soul; if you have it, then go ahead and put it on me.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਏਹੁ ਤੁਟੈ ਨ ਮਲੁ ਲਗੈ ਨਾ ਏਹੁ ਜਲੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: naa ehu tuttai na mal lagai naa ehu jalai na jaae |
English: It does not break, it cannot be soiled by filth, it cannot be burnt, or lost.

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਮਾਣਸ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜੋ ਗਲਿ ਚਲੇ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: dhan su maanas naanakaa jo gal chale paae |
English: Blessed are those mortal beings, O Nanak, who wear such a thread around their necks.

Gurbani: ਚਉਕੜਿ ਮੁਲਿ ਅਣਾਇਆ ਬਹਿ ਚਉਕੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: chaukarr mul anaaeaa beh chaukai paaeaa |
English: You buy the thread for a few shells, and seated in your enclosure, you put it on.

Gurbani: ਸਿਖਾ ਕੰਨਿ ਚੜਾਈਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਥਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sikhaa kan charraaeea gur braahaman thiaa |
English: Whispering instructions into others' ears, the Brahmin becomes a guru.

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਮੁਆ ਓਹੁ ਝੜਿ ਪਇਆ ਵੇਤਗਾ ਗਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ohu muaa ohu jharr peaa vetagaa geaa |1|
English: But he dies, and the sacred thread falls away, and the soul departs without it. ||1||

[Ang 471 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਲਖ ਚੋਰੀਆ ਲਖ ਜਾਰੀਆ ਲਖ ਕੂੜੀਆ ਲਖ ਗਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: lakh choreea lakh jaareea lakh koorreea lakh gaal |
English: He commits thousands of robberies, thousands of acts of adultery, thousands of falsehoods and thousands of abuses.

Gurbani: ਲਖ ਠਗੀਆ ਪਹਿਨਾਮੀਆ ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਜੀਅ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: lakh tthageea pahinaameea raat dinas jeea naal |
English: He practices thousands of deceptions and secret deeds, night and day, against his fellow beings.

Gurbani: ਤਗੁ ਕਪਾਹਹੁ ਕਤੀਐ ਬਾਮੑਣੁ ਵਟੇ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: tag kapaahahu kateeai baaman vatte aae |
English: The thread is spun from cotton, and the Brahmin comes and twists it.

Gurbani: ਕੁਹਿ ਬਕਰਾ ਰਿੰਨਿੑ ਖਾਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਆਖੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kuhi bakaraa rina khaaeaa sabh ko aakhai paae |
English: The goat is killed, cooked and eaten, and everyone then says, "Put on the sacred thread."

Gurbani: ਹੋਇ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ ਸੁਟੀਐ ਭੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹੋਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: hoe puraanaa sutteeai bhee fir paaeeai hor |
English: When it wears out, it is thrown away, and another one is put on.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਗੁ ਨ ਤੁਟਈ ਜੇ ਤਗਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੋਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak tag na tuttee je tag hovai jor |2|
English: O Nanak, the thread would not break, if it had any real strength. ||2||

[Ang 471 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਪਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੂਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: naae maniai pat aoopajai saalaahee sach soot |
English: Believing in the Name, honor is obtained. The Lord's Praise is the true sacred thread.

Gurbani: ਦਰਗਹ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਤਗੁ ਨ ਤੂਟਸਿ ਪੂਤ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: daragah andar paaeeai tag na toottas poot |3|
English: Such a sacred thread is worn in the Court of the Lord; it shall never break. ||3||

[Ang 471 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤਗੁ ਨ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਤਗੁ ਨ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: tag na indree tag na naaree |
English: There is no sacred thread for the sexual organ, and no thread for woman.

Gurbani: ਭਲਕੇ ਥੁਕ ਪਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਦਾੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: bhalake thuk pavai nit daarree |
English: The man's beard is spat upon daily.

Gurbani: ਤਗੁ ਨ ਪੈਰੀ ਤਗੁ ਨ ਹਥੀ ॥
Transliteration: tag na pairee tag na hathee |
English: There is no sacred thread for the feet, and no thread for the hands;

Gurbani: ਤਗੁ ਨ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਤਗੁ ਨ ਅਖੀ ॥
Transliteration: tag na jihavaa tag na akhee |
English: no thread for the tongue, and no thread for the eyes.

Gurbani: ਵੇਤਗਾ ਆਪੇ ਵਤੈ ॥
Transliteration: vetagaa aape vatai |
English: The Brahmin himself goes to the world hereafter without a sacred thread.

Gurbani: ਵਟਿ ਧਾਗੇ ਅਵਰਾ ਘਤੈ ॥
Transliteration: vatt dhaage avaraa ghatai |
English: Twisting the threads, he puts them on others.

Gurbani: ਲੈ ਭਾੜਿ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਆਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: lai bhaarr kare veeaahu |
English: He takes payment for performing marriages;

Gurbani: ਕਢਿ ਕਾਗਲੁ ਦਸੇ ਰਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: kadt kaagal dase raahu |
English: reading their horoscopes, he shows them the way.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਲੋਕਾ ਏਹੁ ਵਿਡਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: sun vekhahu lokaa ehu viddaan |
English: Hear, and see, O people, this wondrous thing.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਅੰਧਾ ਨਾਉ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: man andhaa naau sujaan |4|
English: He is mentally blind, and yet his name is wisdom. ||4||

[Ang 471 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਸਾਈ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਇਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: saahib hoe deaal kirapaa kare taa saaee kaar karaaeisee |
English: One, upon whom the Merciful Lord bestows His Grace, performs His service.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਇਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: so sevak sevaa kare jis no hukam manaaeisee |
English: That servant, whom the Lord causes to obey the Order of His Will, serves Him.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਤਾ ਖਸਮੈ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: hukam maniai hovai paravaan taa khasamai kaa mehal paaeisee |
English: Obeying the Order of His Will, he becomes acceptable, and then, he obtains the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

Gurbani: ਖਸਮੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਮਨਹੁ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: khasamai bhaavai so kare manahu chindiaa so fal paaeisee |
English: One who acts to please His Lord and Master, obtains the fruits of his mind's desires.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਇਸੀ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: taa daragah paidhaa jaaeisee |15|
English: Then, he goes to the Court of the Lord, wearing robes of honor. ||15||

[Ang 471 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗਊ ਬਿਰਾਹਮਣ ਕਉ ਕਰੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਗੋਬਰਿ ਤਰਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: gaoo biraahaman kau kar laavahu gobar taran na jaaee |
English: They tax the cows and the Brahmins, but the cow-dung they apply to their kitchen will not save them.

Gurbani: ਧੋਤੀ ਟਿਕਾ ਤੈ ਜਪਮਾਲੀ ਧਾਨੁ ਮਲੇਛਾਂ ਖਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: dhotee ttikaa tai japamaalee dhaan malechhaan khaaee |
English: They wear their loin cloths, apply ritual frontal marks to their foreheads, and carry their rosaries, but they eat food with the Muslims.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਪੜਹਿ ਕਤੇਬਾ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਤੁਰਕਾ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: antar poojaa parreh katebaa sanjam turakaa bhaaee |
English: O Siblings of Destiny, you perform devotional worship indoors, but read the Islamic sacred texts, and adopt the Muslim way of life.

Gurbani: ਛੋਡੀਲੇ ਪਾਖੰਡਾ ॥
Transliteration: chhoddeele paakhanddaa |
English: Renounce your hypocrisy!

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਿ ਲਇਐ ਜਾਹਿ ਤਰੰਦਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naam leiai jaeh tarandaa |1|
English: Taking the Naam, the Name of the Lord, you shall swim across. ||1||

[Ang 471 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਾਣਸ ਖਾਣੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਿਵਾਜ ॥
Transliteration: maanas khaane kareh nivaaj |
English: The man-eaters say their prayers.

Gurbani: ਛੁਰੀ ਵਗਾਇਨਿ ਤਿਨ ਗਲਿ ਤਾਗ ॥
Transliteration: chhuree vagaaein tin gal taag |
English: Those who wield the knife wear the sacred thread around their necks.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਘਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣ ਪੂਰਹਿ ਨਾਦ ॥
Transliteration: tin ghar brahaman pooreh naad |
English: In their homes, the Brahmins sound the conch.

Gurbani: ਉਨੑਾ ਭਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਓਈ ਸਾਦ ॥
Transliteration: aunaa bhi aaveh oee saad |
English: They too have the same taste.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜੀ ਰਾਸਿ ਕੂੜਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: koorree raas koorraa vaapaar |
English: False is their capital, and false is their trade.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਆਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: koorr bol kareh aahaar |
English: Speaking falsehood, they take their food.

Gurbani: ਸਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਕਾ ਡੇਰਾ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: saram dharam kaa dderaa door |
English: The home of modesty and Dharma is far from them.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੂੜੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: naanak koorr rahiaa bharapoor |
English: O Nanak, they are totally permeated with falsehood.

Gurbani: ਮਥੈ ਟਿਕਾ ਤੇੜਿ ਧੋਤੀ ਕਖਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: mathai ttikaa terr dhotee kakhaaee |
English: The sacred marks are on their foreheads, and the saffron loin-cloths are around their waists;

Gurbani: ਹਥਿ ਛੁਰੀ ਜਗਤ ਕਾਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: hath chhuree jagat kaasaaee |
English: in their hands they hold the knives - they are the butchers of the world!

Gurbani: ਨੀਲ ਵਸਤ੍ਰ ਪਹਿਰਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: neel vasatr pahir hoveh paravaan |
English: Wearing blue robes, they seek the approval of the Muslim rulers.

Gurbani: ਮਲੇਛ ਧਾਨੁ ਲੇ ਪੂਜਹਿ ਪੁਰਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: malechh dhaan le poojeh puraan |
English: Accepting bread from the Muslim rulers, they still worship the Puraanas.

Gurbani: ਅਭਾਖਿਆ ਕਾ ਕੁਠਾ ਬਕਰਾ ਖਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: abhaakhiaa kaa kutthaa bakaraa khaanaa |
English: They eat the meat of the goats, killed after the Muslim prayers are read over them,

Gurbani: ਚਉਕੇ ਉਪਰਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: chauke upar kisai na jaanaa |
English: but they do not allow anyone else to enter their kitchen areas.

Gurbani: ਦੇ ਕੈ ਚਉਕਾ ਕਢੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: de kai chaukaa kadtee kaar |
English: They draw lines around them, plastering the ground with cow-dung.

Gurbani: ਉਪਰਿ ਆਇ ਬੈਠੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ॥
Transliteration: aupar aae baitthe koorriaar |
English: The false come and sit within them.

Gurbani: ਮਤੁ ਭਿਟੈ ਵੇ ਮਤੁ ਭਿਟੈ ॥
Transliteration: mat bhittai ve mat bhittai |
English: They cry out, "Do not touch our food,

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਅੰਨੁ ਅਸਾਡਾ ਫਿਟੈ ॥
Transliteration: eihu an asaaddaa fittai |
English: Or it will be polluted!"

Gurbani: ਤਨਿ ਫਿਟੈ ਫੇੜ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: tan fittai ferr karen |
English: But with their polluted bodies, they commit evil deeds.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਜੂਠੈ ਚੁਲੀ ਭਰੇਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: man jootthai chulee bharen |
English: With filthy minds, they try to cleanse their mouths.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak sach dhiaaeeai |
English: Says Nanak, meditate on the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੁਚਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: such hovai taa sach paaeeai |2|
English: If you are pure, you will obtain the True Lord. ||2||

[Ang 472 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਚਿਤੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਵੇਖਿ ਨਦਰੀ ਹੇਠਿ ਚਲਾਇਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: chitai andar sabh ko vekh nadaree hetth chalaaeidaa |
English: All are within Your mind; You see and move them under Your Glance of Grace, O Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape de vaddiaaeea aape hee karam karaaeidaa |
English: You Yourself grant them glory, and You Yourself cause them to act.

Gurbani: ਵਡਹੁ ਵਡਾ ਵਡ ਮੇਦਨੀ ਸਿਰੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahu vaddaa vadd medanee sire sir dhandhai laaeidaa |
English: The Lord is the greatest of the great; great is His world. He enjoins all to their tasks.

Gurbani: ਨਦਰਿ ਉਪਠੀ ਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਲਤਾਨਾ ਘਾਹੁ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: nadar upatthee je kare sulataanaa ghaahu karaaeidaa |
English: If he should cast an angry glance, He can transform kings into blades of grass.

Gurbani: ਦਰਿ ਮੰਗਨਿ ਭਿਖ ਨ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: dar mangan bhikh na paaeidaa |16|
English: Even though they may beg from door to door, no one will give them charity. ||16||

[Ang 472 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਮੋਹਾਕਾ ਘਰੁ ਮੁਹੈ ਘਰੁ ਮੁਹਿ ਪਿਤਰੀ ਦੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: je mohaakaa ghar muhai ghar muhi pitaree dee |
English: The thief robs a house, and offers the stolen goods to his ancestors.

Gurbani: ਅਗੈ ਵਸਤੁ ਸਿਞਾਣੀਐ ਪਿਤਰੀ ਚੋਰ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: agai vasat siyaaneeai pitaree chor karee |
English: In the world hereafter, this is recognized, and his ancestors are considered thieves as well.

Gurbani: ਵਢੀਅਹਿ ਹਥ ਦਲਾਲ ਕੇ ਮੁਸਫੀ ਏਹ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: vadteeeh hath dalaal ke musafee eeh karee |
English: The hands of the go-between are cut off; this is the Lord's justice.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਗੈ ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਿ ਖਟੇ ਘਾਲੇ ਦੇਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak agai so milai ji khatte ghaale dee |1|
English: O Nanak, in the world hereafter, that alone is received, which one gives to the needy from his own earnings and labor. ||1||

[Ang 472 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਜੋਰੂ ਸਿਰਨਾਵਣੀ ਆਵੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: jiau joroo siranaavanee aavai vaaro vaar |
English: As a woman has her periods, month after month,

Gurbani: ਜੂਠੇ ਜੂਠਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jootthe jootthaa mukh vasai nit nit hoe khuaar |
English: so does falsehood dwell in the mouth of the false; they suffer forever, again and again.

Gurbani: ਸੂਚੇ ਏਹਿ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਬਹਨਿ ਜਿ ਪਿੰਡਾ ਧੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sooche ehi na aakheeeh behan ji pinddaa dhoe |
English: They are not called pure, who sit down after merely washing their bodies.

Gurbani: ਸੂਚੇ ਸੇਈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sooche seee naanakaa jin man vasiaa soe |2|
English: Only they are pure, O Nanak, within whose minds the Lord abides. ||2||

[Ang 472 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਤੁਰੇ ਪਲਾਣੇ ਪਉਣ ਵੇਗ ਹਰ ਰੰਗੀ ਹਰਮ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: ture palaane paun veg har rangee haram savaariaa |
English: With saddled horses, as fast as the wind, and harems decorated in every way;

Gurbani: ਕੋਠੇ ਮੰਡਪ ਮਾੜੀਆ ਲਾਇ ਬੈਠੇ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: kotthe manddap maarreea laae baitthe kar paasaariaa |
English: in houses and pavilions and lofty mansions, they dwell, making ostentatious shows.

Gurbani: ਚੀਜ ਕਰਨਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਬੁਝਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: cheej karan man bhaavade har bujhan naahee haariaa |
English: They act out their minds' desires, but they do not understand the Lord, and so they are ruined.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਸਿ ਖਾਇਆ ਵੇਖਿ ਮਹਲਤਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: kar furamaaeis khaaeaa vekh mahalat maran visaariaa |
English: Asserting their authority, they eat, and beholding their mansions, they forget about death.

Gurbani: ਜਰੁ ਆਈ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਹਾਰਿਆ ॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: jar aaee joban haariaa |17|
English: But old age comes, and youth is lost. ||17||

[Ang 472 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਕਰਿ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਸਭ ਤੈ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: je kar sootak maneeai sabh tai sootak hoe |
English: If one accepts the concept of impurity, then there is impurity everywhere.

Gurbani: ਗੋਹੇ ਅਤੈ ਲਕੜੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕੀੜਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: gohe atai lakarree andar keerraa hoe |
English: In cow-dung and wood there are worms.

Gurbani: ਜੇਤੇ ਦਾਣੇ ਅੰਨ ਕੇ ਜੀਆ ਬਾਝੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jete daane an ke jeea baajh na koe |
English: As many as are the grains of corn, none is without life.

Gurbani: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਜੀਉ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: pahilaa paanee jeeo hai jit hariaa sabh koe |
English: First, there is life in the water, by which everything else is made green.

Gurbani: ਸੂਤਕੁ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਰਖੀਐ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਪਵੈ ਰਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sootak kiau kar rakheeai sootak pavai rasoe |
English: How can it be protected from impurity? It touches our own kitchen.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਏਵ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਉਤਾਰੇ ਧੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak sootak ev na utarai giaan utaare dhoe |1|
English: O Nanak, impurity cannot be removed in this way; it is washed away only by spiritual wisdom. ||1||

[Ang 472 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਕੂੜੁ ॥
Transliteration: man kaa sootak lobh hai jihavaa sootak koorr |
English: The impurity of the mind is greed, and the impurity of the tongue is falsehood.

Gurbani: ਅਖੀ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਵੇਖਣਾ ਪਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਅ ਪਰ ਧਨ ਰੂਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: akhee sootak vekhanaa par tria par dhan roop |
English: The impurity of the eyes is to gaze upon the beauty of another man's wife, and his wealth.

Gurbani: ਕੰਨੀ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਕੰਨਿ ਪੈ ਲਾਇਤਬਾਰੀ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: kanee sootak kan pai laaeitabaaree khaeh |
English: The impurity of the ears is to listen to the slander of others.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੰਸਾ ਆਦਮੀ ਬਧੇ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak hansaa aadamee badhe jam pur jaeh |2|
English: O Nanak, the mortal's soul goes, bound and gagged to the city of Death. ||2||

[Ang 472 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਭੋ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabho sootak bharam hai doojai lagai jaae |
English: All impurity comes from doubt and attachment to duality.

Gurbani: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jaman maranaa hukam hai bhaanai aavai jaae |
English: Birth and death are subject to the Command of the Lord's Will; through His Will we come and go.

Gurbani: ਖਾਣਾ ਪੀਣਾ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਹੈ ਦਿਤੋਨੁ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: khaanaa peenaa pavitru hai diton rijak sanbaeh |
English: Eating and drinking are pure, since the Lord gives nourishment to all.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak jinaee guramukh bujhiaa tinaa sootak naeh |3|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs, who understand the Lord, are not stained by impurity. ||3||

[Ang 473 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਵਡਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਡੀਆ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: satigur vaddaa kar saalaaheeai jis vich vaddeea vaddiaaeea |
English: Praise the Great True Guru; within Him is the greatest greatness.

Gurbani: ਸਹਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਤਾ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: seh mele taa nadaree aaeea |
English: When the Lord causes us to meet the Guru, then we come to see them.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਾਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: jaa tis bhaanaa taa man vasaaeea |
English: When it pleases Him, they come to dwell in our minds.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹਥੁ ਧਰਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਢੀਆ ਬੁਰਿਆਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: kar hukam masatak hath dhar vichahu maar kadteea buriaaeea |
English: By His Command, when He places His hand on our foreheads, wickedness departs from within.

Gurbani: ਸਹਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਆ ॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: seh tutthai nau nidh paaeea |18|
English: When the Lord is thoroughly pleased, the nine treasures are obtained. ||18||

[Ang 473 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਸੁਚਾ ਆਪਿ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਚੈ ਬੈਠਾ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: pahilaa suchaa aap hoe suchai baitthaa aae |
English: First, purifying himself, the Brahmin comes and sits in his purified enclosure.

Gurbani: ਸੁਚੇ ਅਗੈ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਭਿਟਿਓ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: suche agai rakhion koe na bhittio jaae |
English: The pure foods, which no one else has touched, are placed before him.

Gurbani: ਸੁਚਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਜੇਵਿਆ ਲਗਾ ਪੜਣਿ ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: suchaa hoe kai jeviaa lagaa parran salok |
English: Being purified, he takes his food, and begins to read his sacred verses.

Gurbani: ਕੁਹਥੀ ਜਾਈ ਸਟਿਆ ਕਿਸੁ ਏਹੁ ਲਗਾ ਦੋਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: kuhathee jaaee sattiaa kis ehu lagaa dokh |
English: But it is then thrown into a filthy place - whose fault is this?

Gurbani: ਅੰਨੁ ਦੇਵਤਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਦੇਵਤਾ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਦੇਵਤਾ ਲੂਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: an devataa paanee devataa baisantar devataa loon |
English: The corn is sacred, the water is sacred; the fire and salt are sacred as well;

Gurbani: ਪੰਜਵਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਘਿਰਤੁ ॥ ਤਾ ਹੋਆ ਪਾਕੁ ਪਵਿਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: panjavaa paaeaa ghirat | taa hoaa paak pavit |
English: When the fifth thing, the ghee, is added, then the food becomes pure and sanctified.

Gurbani: ਪਾਪੀ ਸਿਉ ਤਨੁ ਗਡਿਆ ਥੁਕਾ ਪਈਆ ਤਿਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: paapee siau tan gaddiaa thukaa peea tith |
English: Coming into contact with the sinful human body, the food becomes so impure that is is spat upon.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਊਚਰਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਰਸ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jit mukh naam na aoochareh bin naavai ras khaeh |
English: That mouth which does not chant the Naam, and without the Name eats tasty foods

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਵੈ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਤਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਥੁਕਾ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak evai jaaneeai tith mukh thukaa paeh |1|
English: - O Nanak, know this: such a mouth is to be spat upon. ||1||

[Ang 473 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਭੰਡਿ ਜੰਮੀਐ ਭੰਡਿ ਨਿੰਮੀਐ ਭੰਡਿ ਮੰਗਣੁ ਵੀਆਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: bhandd jameeai bhandd ninmeeai bhandd mangan veeaahu |
English: From woman, man is born; within woman, man is conceived; to woman he is engaged and married.

Gurbani: ਭੰਡਹੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਭੰਡਹੁ ਚਲੈ ਰਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: bhanddahu hovai dosatee bhanddahu chalai raahu |
English: Woman becomes his friend; through woman, the future generations come.

Gurbani: ਭੰਡੁ ਮੁਆ ਭੰਡੁ ਭਾਲੀਐ ਭੰਡਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਬੰਧਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: bhandd muaa bhandd bhaaleeai bhandd hovai bandhaan |
English: When his woman dies, he seeks another woman; to woman he is bound.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਮੰਦਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿਤੁ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਰਾਜਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: so kiau mandaa aakheeai jit jameh raajaan |
English: So why call her bad? From her, kings are born.

Gurbani: ਭੰਡਹੁ ਹੀ ਭੰਡੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਭੰਡੈ ਬਾਝੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhanddahu hee bhandd aoopajai bhanddai baajh na koe |
English: From woman, woman is born; without woman, there would be no one at all.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਭੰਡੈ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਏਕੋ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak bhanddai baaharaa eko sachaa soe |
English: O Nanak, only the True Lord is without a woman.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਭਾਗਾ ਰਤੀ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jit mukh sadaa saalaaheeai bhaagaa ratee chaar |
English: That mouth which praises the Lord continually is blessed and beautiful.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak te mukh aoojale tith sachai darabaar |2|
English: O Nanak, those faces shall be radiant in the Court of the True Lord. ||2||

[Ang 473 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਆਖੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੋ ਚੁਣਿ ਕਢੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: sabh ko aakhai aapanaa jis naahee so chun kadteeai |
English: All call You their own, Lord; one who does not own You, is picked up and thrown away.

Gurbani: ਕੀਤਾ ਆਪੋ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਲੇਖਾ ਸੰਢੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: keetaa aapo aapanaa aape hee lekhaa sandteeai |
English: Everyone receives the rewards of his own actions; his account is adjusted accordingly.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਰਹਣਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਐਤੁ ਜਗਿ ਤਾ ਕਾਇਤੁ ਗਾਰਬਿ ਹੰਢੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: jaa rahanaa naahee ait jag taa kaaeit gaarab handteeai |
English: Since one is not destined to remain in this world anyway, why should he ruin himself in pride?

Gurbani: ਮੰਦਾ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਆਖੀਐ ਪੜਿ ਅਖਰੁ ਏਹੋ ਬੁਝੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: mandaa kisai na aakheeai parr akhar eho bujheeai |
English: Do not call anyone bad; read these words, and understand.

Gurbani: ਮੂਰਖੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਲੁਝੀਐ ॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: moorakhai naal na lujheeai |19|
English: Don't argue with fools. ||19||

[Ang 473 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਫਿਕੈ ਬੋਲਿਐ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਫਿਕਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak fikai boliai tan man fikaa hoe |
English: O Nanak, speaking insipid words, the body and mind become insipid.

Gurbani: ਫਿਕੋ ਫਿਕਾ ਸਦੀਐ ਫਿਕੇ ਫਿਕੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: fiko fikaa sadeeai fike fikee soe |
English: He is called the most insipid of the insipid; the most insipid of the insipid is his reputation.

Gurbani: ਫਿਕਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਟੀਐ ਮੁਹਿ ਥੁਕਾ ਫਿਕੇ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: fikaa daragah satteeai muhi thukaa fike paae |
English: The insipid person is discarded in the Court of the Lord, and the insipid one's face is spat upon.

Gurbani: ਫਿਕਾ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਪਾਣਾ ਲਹੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: fikaa moorakh aakheeai paanaa lahai sajaae |1|
English: The insipid one is called a fool; he is beaten with shoes in punishment. ||1||

[Ang 473 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਝੂਠੇ ਪੈਜ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਫੈਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: andarahu jhootthe paij baahar duneea andar fail |
English: Those who are false within, and honorable on the outside, are very common in this world.

Gurbani: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਜੇ ਨਾਵਹਿ ਉਤਰੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੈਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: atthasatth teerath je naaveh utarai naahee mail |
English: Even though they may bathe at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, still, their filth does not depart.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑ ਪਟੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਗੁਦੜੁ ਤੇ ਭਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jina patt andar baahar gudarr te bhale sansaar |
English: Those who have silk on the inside and rags on the outside, are the good ones in this world.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨੑ ਨੇਹੁ ਲਗਾ ਰਬ ਸੇਤੀ ਦੇਖਨੑੇ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: tina nehu lagaa rab setee dekhanae veechaar |
English: They embrace love for the Lord, and contemplate beholding Him.

Gurbani: ਰੰਗਿ ਹਸਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਚੁਪ ਭੀ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: rang haseh rang roveh chup bhee kar jaeh |
English: In the Lord's Love, they laugh, and in the Lord's Love, they weep, and also keep silent.

Gurbani: ਪਰਵਾਹ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਕੇਰੀ ਬਾਝੁ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਹ ॥
Transliteration: paravaah naahee kisai keree baajh sache naah |
English: They do not care for anything else, except their True Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਦਰਿ ਵਾਟ ਉਪਰਿ ਖਰਚੁ ਮੰਗਾ ਜਬੈ ਦੇਇ ਤ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: dar vaatt upar kharach mangaa jabai dee ta khaeh |
English: Sitting, waiting at the Lord's Door, they beg for food, and when He gives to them, they eat.

Gurbani: ਦੀਬਾਨੁ ਏਕੋ ਕਲਮ ਏਕਾ ਹਮਾ ਤੁਮੑਾ ਮੇਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: deebaan eko kalam ekaa hamaa tumaa mel |
English: There is only One Court of the Lord, and He has only one pen; there, you and I shall meet.

Gurbani: ਦਰਿ ਲਏ ਲੇਖਾ ਪੀੜਿ ਛੁਟੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਉ ਤੇਲੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: dar le lekhaa peerr chhuttai naanakaa jiau tel |2|
English: In the Court of the Lord, the accounts are examined; O Nanak, the sinners are crushed, like oil seeds in the press. ||2||

[Ang 474 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਕਰਣਾ ਕੀਓ ਕਲ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਤੈ ਧਾਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: aape hee karanaa keeo kal aape hee tai dhaareeai |
English: You Yourself created the creation; You Yourself infused Your power into it.

Gurbani: ਦੇਖਹਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਧਰਿ ਕਚੀ ਪਕੀ ਸਾਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: dekheh keetaa aapanaa dhar kachee pakee saareeai |
English: You behold Your creation, like the losing and winning dice of the earth.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਆਇਆ ਸੋ ਚਲਸੀ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਆਈ ਵਾਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: jo aaeaa so chalasee sabh koee aaee vaareeai |
English: Whoever has come, shall depart; all shall have their turn.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਪਰਾਣ ਹਹਿ ਕਿਉ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: jis ke jeea paraan heh kiau saahib manahu visaareeai |
English: He who owns our soul, and our very breath of life - why should we forget that Lord and Master from our minds?

Gurbani: ਆਪਣ ਹਥੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਕਾਜੁ ਸਵਾਰੀਐ ॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: aapan hathee aapanaa aape hee kaaj savaareeai |20|
English: With our own hands, let us resolve our own affairs. ||20||

[Ang 474 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 2 |
English: Salok, Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਏਹ ਕਿਨੇਹੀ ਆਸਕੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: eeh kinehee aasakee doojai lagai jaae |
English: What sort of love is this, which clings to duality?

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਸਕੁ ਕਾਂਢੀਐ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak aasak kaandteeai sad hee rahai samaae |
English: O Nanak, he alone is called a lover, who remains forever immersed in absorption.

Gurbani: ਚੰਗੈ ਚੰਗਾ ਕਰਿ ਮੰਨੇ ਮੰਦੈ ਮੰਦਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: changai changaa kar mane mandai mandaa hoe |
English: But one who feels good only when good is done for him, and feels bad when things go badly

Gurbani: ਆਸਕੁ ਏਹੁ ਨ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਵਰਤੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aasak ehu na aakheeai ji lekhai varatai soe |1|
English: - do not call him a lover. He trades only for his own account. ||1||

[Ang 474 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 2 |
English: Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਲਾਮੁ ਜਬਾਬੁ ਦੋਵੈ ਕਰੇ ਮੁੰਢਹੁ ਘੁਥਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: salaam jabaab dovai kare mundtahu ghuthaa jaae |
English: One who offers both respectful greetings and rude refusal to his master, has gone wrong from the very beginning.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੋਵੈ ਕੂੜੀਆ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak dovai koorreea thaae na kaaee paae |2|
English: O Nanak, both of his actions are false; he obtains no place in the Court of the Lord. ||2||

[Ang 474 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਮੑਾਲੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: jit seviai sukh paaeeai so saahib sadaa samaaleeai |
English: Serving Him, peace is obtained; meditate and dwell upon that Lord and Master forever.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਾ ਘਾਲ ਬੁਰੀ ਕਿਉ ਘਾਲੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: jit keetaa paaeeai aapanaa saa ghaal buree kiau ghaaleeai |
English: Why do you do such evil deeds, that you shall have to suffer so?

Gurbani: ਮੰਦਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਕੀਚਈ ਦੇ ਲੰਮੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: mandaa mool na keechee de lamee nadar nihaaleeai |
English: Do not do any evil at all; look ahead to the future with foresight.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਹਾਰੀਐ ਤੇਵੇਹਾ ਪਾਸਾ ਢਾਲੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: jiau saahib naal na haareeai tevehaa paasaa dtaaleeai |
English: So throw the dice in such a way, that you shall not lose with your Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਕਿਛੁ ਲਾਹੇ ਉਪਰਿ ਘਾਲੀਐ ॥੨੧॥
Transliteration: kichh laahe upar ghaaleeai |21|
English: Do those deeds which shall bring you profit. ||21||

[Ang 474 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 2 |
English: Salok, Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਚਾਕਰੁ ਲਗੈ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਨਾਲੇ ਗਾਰਬੁ ਵਾਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: chaakar lagai chaakaree naale gaarab vaad |
English: If a servant performs service, while being vain and argumentative,

Gurbani: ਗਲਾ ਕਰੇ ਘਣੇਰੀਆ ਖਸਮ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਸਾਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: galaa kare ghanereea khasam na paae saad |
English: he may talk as much as he wants, but he shall not be pleasing to his Master.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਏ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: aap gavaae sevaa kare taa kichh paae maan |
English: But if he eliminates his self-conceit and then performs service, he shall be honored.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਗਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਲਗਾ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak jis no lagaa tis milai lagaa so paravaan |1|
English: O Nanak, if he merges with the one with whom he is attached, his attachment becomes acceptable. ||1||

[Ang 474 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 2 |
English: Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੀਇ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਉਗਵੈ ਮੁਹ ਕਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਵਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo jee hoe su ugavai muh kaa kahiaa vaau |
English: Whatever is in the mind, comes forth; spoken words by themselves are just wind.

Gurbani: ਬੀਜੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਏਹੁ ਨਿਆਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: beeje bikh mangai amrit vekhahu ehu niaau |2|
English: He sows seeds of poison, and demands Ambrosial Nectar. Behold - what justice is this? ||2||

[Ang 474 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 2 |
English: Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਲਿ ਇਆਣੇ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: naal eaane dosatee kade na aavai raas |
English: Friendship with a fool never works out right.

Gurbani: ਜੇਹਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਤੇਹੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕੋ ਨਿਰਜਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: jehaa jaanai teho varatai vekhahu ko nirajaas |
English: As he knows, he acts; behold, and see that it is so.

Gurbani: ਵਸਤੂ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਦੂਜੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: vasatoo andar vasat samaavai doojee hovai paas |
English: One thing can be absorbed into another thing, but duality keeps them apart.

Gurbani: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸੇਤੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਕਹੀ ਬਣੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: saahib setee hukam na chalai kahee banai aradaas |
English: No one can issue commands to the Lord Master; offer instead humble prayers.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜਿ ਕਮਾਣੈ ਕੂੜੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਵਿਗਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: koorr kamaanai koorro hovai naanak sifat vigaas |3|
English: Practicing falsehood, only falsehood is obtained. O Nanak, through the Lord's Praise, one blossoms forth. ||3||

[Ang 474 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 2 |
English: Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਲਿ ਇਆਣੇ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਵਡਾਰੂ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: naal eaane dosatee vaddaaroo siau nehu |
English: Friendship with a fool, and love with a pompous person,

Gurbani: ਪਾਣੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਲੀਕ ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਥਾਉ ਨ ਥੇਹੁ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: paanee andar leek jiau tis daa thaau na thehu |4|
English: are like lines drawn in water, leaving no trace or mark. ||4||

[Ang 474 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 2 |
English: Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹੋਇ ਇਆਣਾ ਕਰੇ ਕੰਮੁ ਆਣਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: hoe eaanaa kare kam aan na sakai raas |
English: If a fool does a job, he cannot do it right.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਇਕ ਅਧ ਚੰਗੀ ਕਰੇ ਦੂਜੀ ਭੀ ਵੇਰਾਸਿ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: je ik adh changee kare doojee bhee veraas |5|
English: Even if he does something right, he does the next thing wrong. ||5||

[Ang 474 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਚਾਕਰੁ ਲਗੈ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਜੇ ਚਲੈ ਖਸਮੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: chaakar lagai chaakaree je chalai khasamai bhaae |
English: If a servant, performing service, obeys the Will of his Master,

Gurbani: ਹੁਰਮਤਿ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਅਗਲੀ ਓਹੁ ਵਜਹੁ ਭਿ ਦੂਣਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: huramat tis no agalee ohu vajahu bhi doonaa khaae |
English: his honor increases, and he receives double his wages.

Gurbani: ਖਸਮੈ ਕਰੇ ਬਰਾਬਰੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਗੈਰਤਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: khasamai kare baraabaree fir gairat andar paae |
English: But if he claims to be equal to his Master, he earns his Master's displeasure.

Gurbani: ਵਜਹੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਅਗਲਾ ਮੁਹੇ ਮੁਹਿ ਪਾਣਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: vajahu gavaae agalaa muhe muhi paanaa khaae |
English: He loses his entire salary, and is also beaten on his face with shoes.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਦਿਤਾ ਖਾਵਣਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: jis daa ditaa khaavanaa tis kaheeai saabaas |
English: Let us all celebrate Him, from whom we receive our nourishment.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਨਾਲਿ ਖਸਮ ਚਲੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੨੨॥
Transliteration: naanak hukam na chalee naal khasam chalai aradaas |22|
English: O Nanak, no one can issue commands to the Lord Master; let us offer prayers instead. ||22||

[Ang 474 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 2 |
English: Salok, Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਏਹ ਕਿਨੇਹੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਆਪਸ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: eeh kinehee daat aapas te jo paaeeai |
English: What sort of gift is this, which we receive only by our own asking?

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾ ਕਰਮਾਤਿ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੁਠੈ ਜੋ ਮਿਲੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak saa karamaat saahib tutthai jo milai |1|
English: O Nanak, that is the most wonderful gift, which is received from the Lord, when He is totally pleased. ||1||

[Ang 475 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 2 |
English: Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਏਹ ਕਿਨੇਹੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਭਉ ਖਸਮ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: eeh kinehee chaakaree jit bhau khasam na jaae |
English: What sort of service is this, by which the fear of the Lord Master does not depart?

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਕਾਢੀਐ ਜਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਖਸਮ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak sevak kaadteeai ji setee khasam samaae |2|
English: O Nanak, he alone is called a servant, who merges with the Lord Master. ||2||

[Ang 475 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਤ ਨ ਜਾਪਨੑੀ ਹਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: naanak ant na jaapanaee har taa ke paaraavaar |
English: O Nanak, the Lord's limits cannot be known; He has no end or limitation.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਸਾਖਤੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਮਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: aap karaae saakhatee fir aap karaae maar |
English: He Himself creates, and then He Himself destroys.

Gurbani: ਇਕਨੑਾ ਗਲੀ ਜੰਜੀਰੀਆ ਇਕਿ ਤੁਰੀ ਚੜਹਿ ਬਿਸੀਆਰ ॥
Transliteration: eikanaa galee janjeereea ik turee charreh biseeaar |
English: Some have chains around their necks, while some ride on many horses.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਹਉ ਕੈ ਸਿਉ ਕਰੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: aap karaae kare aap hau kai siau karee pukaar |
English: He Himself acts, and He Himself causes us to act. Unto whom should I complain?

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰ ॥੨੩॥
Transliteration: naanak karanaa jin keea fir tis hee karanee saar |23|
English: O Nanak, the One who created the creation - He Himself takes care of it. ||23||

[Ang 475 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਭਾਂਡੇ ਸਾਜਿਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਪੂਰਣੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: aape bhaandde saajian aape pooran dee |
English: He Himself fashioned the vessel of the body, and He Himself fills it.

Gurbani: ਇਕਨੑੀ ਦੁਧੁ ਸਮਾਈਐ ਇਕਿ ਚੁਲੑੈ ਰਹਨਿੑ ਚੜੇ ॥
Transliteration: eikanaee dudh samaaeeai ik chulai rehana charre |
English: Into some, milk is poured, while others remain on the fire.

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀ ਪੈ ਸਵਨਿੑ ਇਕਿ ਉਪਰਿ ਰਹਨਿ ਖੜੇ ॥
Transliteration: eik nihaalee pai savana ik upar rehan kharre |
English: Some lie down and sleep on soft beds, while others remain watchful.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨੑਾ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tinaa savaare naanakaa jina kau nadar kare |1|
English: He adorns those, O Nanak, upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace. ||1||

[Ang 475 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 2 |
English: Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਜਾਈ ਭਿ ਰਖੈ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: aape saaje kare aap jaaee bhi rakhai aap |
English: He Himself creates and fashions the world, and He Himself keeps it in order.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਦੇਖੈ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: tis vich jant upaae kai dekhai thaap uthaap |
English: Having created the beings within it, He oversees their birth and death.

Gurbani: ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kis no kaheeai naanakaa sabh kichh aape aap |2|
English: Unto whom should we speak, O Nanak, when He Himself is all-in-all? ||2||

[Ang 475 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਵਡੇ ਕੀਆ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: vadde keea vaddiaaeea kichh kahanaa kehan na jaae |
English: The description of the greatness of the Great Lord cannot be described.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਾਦਰ ਕਰੀਮੁ ਦੇ ਜੀਆ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: so karataa kaadar kareem de jeea rijak sanbaeh |
English: He is the Creator, all-powerful and benevolent; He gives sustenance to all beings.

Gurbani: ਸਾਈ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਧੁਰਿ ਛੋਡੀ ਤਿੰਨੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: saaee kaar kamaavanee dhur chhoddee tinai paae |
English: The mortal does that work, which has been pre-destined from the very beginning.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੀ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਹੋਰ ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak ekee baaharee hor doojee naahee jaae |
English: O Nanak, except for the One Lord, there is no other place at all.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੨੪॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ
Transliteration: so kare ji tisai rajaae |24|1| sudh
English: He does whatever He wills. ||24||1|| Sudh||

[Ang 475 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirbhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibhan gur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: raag aasaa baanee bhagataa kee |
English: Raag Aasaa, The Word Of The Devotees:

Gurbani: ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀਉ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: kabeer jeeo naamadeo jeeo ravidaas jeeo |
English: Kabeer, Naam Dayv And Ravi Daas.

Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa sree kabeer jeeo |
English: Aasaa, Kabeer Jee:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਲਾਗਿ ਹਮ ਬਿਨਵਤਾ ਪੂਛਤ ਕਹ ਜੀਉ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur charan laag ham binavataa poochhat keh jeeo paaeaa |
English: Falling at the Feet of the Guru, I pray, and ask Him, "Why was man created?

Gurbani: ਕਵਨ ਕਾਜਿ ਜਗੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਕਹਹੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kavan kaaj jag upajai binasai kahahu mohi samajhaaeaa |1|
English: What deeds cause the world to come into being, and be destroyed? Tell me, that I may understand." ||1||

Gurbani: ਦੇਵ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਭੈ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੂਟੈ ॥
Transliteration: dev karahu deaa mohi maarag laavahu jit bhai bandhan toottai |
English: O Divine Guru, please, show Mercy to me, and place me on the right path, by which the bonds of fear may be cut away.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖ ਫੇੜ ਕਰਮ ਸੁਖ ਜੀਅ ਜਨਮ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: janam maran dukh ferr karam sukh jeea janam te chhoottai |1| rahaau |
English: The pains of birth and death come from past actions and karma; peace comes when the soul finds release from reincarnation. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਫਾਸ ਬੰਧ ਨਹੀ ਫਾਰੈ ਅਰੁ ਮਨ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਨ ਲੂਕੇ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa faas bandh nahee faarai ar man sun na looke |
English: The mortal does not break free from the bonds of the noose of Maya, and he does not seek the shelter of the profound, absolute Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਪਾ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ਨ ਚੀਨਿੑਆ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਅਭਿਉ ਨ ਚੂਕੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aapaa pad nirabaan na cheenaa in bidh abhiau na chooke |2|
English: He does not realize the dignity of the self, and Nirvaanaa; because of this, his doubt does not depart. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਹੀ ਨ ਉਪਜੈ ਉਪਜੀ ਜਾਣੈ ਭਾਵ ਅਭਾਵ ਬਿਹੂਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: kahee na upajai upajee jaanai bhaav abhaav bihoonaa |
English: The soul is not born, even though he thinks it is born; it is free from birth and death.

Gurbani: ਉਦੈ ਅਸਤ ਕੀ ਮਨ ਬੁਧਿ ਨਾਸੀ ਤਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਲਿਵ ਲੀਣਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: audai asat kee man budh naasee tau sadaa sehaj liv leenaa |3|
English: When the mortal gives up his ideas of birth and death, he remains constantly absorbed in the Lord's Love. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਬਿੰਬੁ ਬਿੰਬ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੀ ਹੈ ਉਦਕ ਕੁੰਭੁ ਬਿਗਰਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jiau pratibinb binb kau milee hai udak kunbh bigaraanaa |
English: As the reflection of an object blends in the water when the pitcher is broken,

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਐਸਾ ਗੁਣ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਤਉ ਮਨੁ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਮਾਨਾਂ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer aisaa gun bhram bhaagaa tau man sun samaanaan |4|1|
English: says Kabeer, just so virtue dispels doubt, and then the soul is absorbed in the profound, absolute Lord. ||4||1||

[Ang 476 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa |
English: Aasaa:

Gurbani: ਗਜ ਸਾਢੇ ਤੈ ਤੈ ਧੋਤੀਆ ਤਿਹਰੇ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਤਗ ॥
Transliteration: gaj saadte tai tai dhoteea tihare paaein tag |
English: They wear loin cloths, three and a half yards long, and triple-wound sacred threads.

Gurbani: ਗਲੀ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਜਪਮਾਲੀਆ ਲੋਟੇ ਹਥਿ ਨਿਬਗ ॥
Transliteration: galee jinaa japamaaleea lotte hath nibag |
English: They have rosaries around their necks, and they carry glittering jugs in their hands.

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਬਾਨਾਰਸਿ ਕੇ ਠਗ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: oe har ke sant na aakheeeh baanaaras ke tthag |1|
English: They are not called Saints of the Lord - they are thugs of Benares. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸੇ ਸੰਤ ਨ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਭਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: aise sant na mo kau bhaaveh |
English: Such 'saints' are not pleasing to me;

Gurbani: ਡਾਲਾ ਸਿਉ ਪੇਡਾ ਗਟਕਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ddaalaa siau peddaa gattakaaveh |1| rahaau |
English: they eat the trees along with the branches. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਾਸਨ ਮਾਂਜਿ ਚਰਾਵਹਿ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਾਠੀ ਧੋਇ ਜਲਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: baasan maanj charaaveh aoopar kaatthee dhoe jalaaveh |
English: They wash their pots and pans before putting them on the stove, and they wash the wood before lighting it.

Gurbani: ਬਸੁਧਾ ਖੋਦਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦੁਇ ਚੂਲੇੑ ਸਾਰੇ ਮਾਣਸ ਖਾਵਹਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: basudhaa khod kareh due choole saare maanas khaaveh |2|
English: They dig up the earth and make two fireplaces, but they eat the whole person! ||2||

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਪਾਪੀ ਸਦਾ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਅਪਰਸ ਕਹਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: oe paapee sadaa fireh aparaadhee mukhahu aparas kahaaveh |
English: Those sinners continually wander in evil deeds, while they call themselves touch-nothing saints.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਸਗਲ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਡੁਬਾਵਹਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa fireh abhimaanee sagal kuttanb ddubaaveh |3|
English: They wander around forever and ever in their self-conceit, and all their families are drowned. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਲਾਗਾ ਤੈਸੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jit ko laaeaa tith hee laagaa taise karam kamaavai |
English: He is attached to that, to which the Lord has attached him, and he acts accordingly.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਪੁਨਰਪਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer jis satigur bhettai punarap janam na aavai |4|2|
English: Says Kabeer, one who meets the True Guru, is not reincarnated again. ||4||2||

[Ang 476 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa |
English: Aasaa:

Gurbani: ਬਾਪਿ ਦਿਲਾਸਾ ਮੇਰੋ ਕੀਨੑਾ ॥
Transliteration: baap dilaasaa mero keenaa |
English: My Father has comforted me. He has given me a cozy bed,

Gurbani: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਦੀਨੑਾ ॥
Transliteration: sej sukhaalee mukh amrit deenaa |
English: And placed His Ambrosial Nectar in my mouth.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਾਪ ਕਉ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: tis baap kau kiau manahu visaaree |
English: How could I forget that Father from my mind?

Gurbani: ਆਗੈ ਗਇਆ ਨ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aagai geaa na baajee haaree |1|
English: When I go to the world hereafter, I shall not lose the game. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੁਈ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ਹਉ ਖਰਾ ਸੁਖਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: muee meree maaee hau kharaa sukhaalaa |
English: Maya is dead, O mother, and I am very happy.

Gurbani: ਪਹਿਰਉ ਨਹੀ ਦਗਲੀ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: pahirau nahee dagalee lagai na paalaa |1| rahaau |
English: I do not wear the patched coat, nor do I feel the chill. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਲਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਾਪੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਉ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bal tis baapai jin hau jaaeaa |
English: I am a sacrifice to my Father, who gave me life.

Gurbani: ਪੰਚਾ ਤੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: panchaa te meraa sang chukaaeaa |
English: He put an end to my association with the five deadly sins.

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਾਵਾ ਤਲਿ ਦੀਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: panch maar paavaa tal deene |
English: I have conquered those five demons, and trampled them underfoot.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਭੀਨੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har simaran meraa man tan bheene |2|
English: Remembering the Lord in meditation, my mind and body are drenched with His Love. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪਿਤਾ ਹਮਾਰੋ ਵਡ ਗੋਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: pitaa hamaaro vadd gosaaee |
English: My Father is the Great Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਪਹਿ ਹਉ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: tis pitaa peh hau kiau kar jaaee |
English: How shall I go to that Father?

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੇ ਤ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: satigur mile ta maarag dikhaaeaa |
English: When I met the True Guru, He showed me the Way.

Gurbani: ਜਗਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jagat pitaa merai man bhaaeaa |3|
English: The Father of the Universe is pleasing to my mind. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਪੂਤੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਬਾਪੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: hau poot teraa toon baap meraa |
English: I am Your son, and You are my Father.

Gurbani: ਏਕੈ ਠਾਹਰ ਦੁਹਾ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: ekai tthaahar duhaa baseraa |
English: We both dwell in the same place.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਨਿ ਏਕੋ ਬੂਝਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer jan eko boojhiaa |
English: Says Kabeer, the Lord's humble servant knows only the One.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝਿਆ ॥੪॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad mai sabh kichh soojhiaa |4|3|
English: By Guru's Grace, I have come to know everything. ||4||3||

[Ang 476 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa |
English: Aasaa:

Gurbani: ਇਕਤੁ ਪਤਰਿ ਭਰਿ ਉਰਕਟ ਕੁਰਕਟ ਇਕਤੁ ਪਤਰਿ ਭਰਿ ਪਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: eikat patar bhar urakatt kurakatt ikat patar bhar paanee |
English: In one pot, they put a boiled chicken, and in the other pot, they put wine.

Gurbani: ਆਸਿ ਪਾਸਿ ਪੰਚ ਜੋਗੀਆ ਬੈਠੇ ਬੀਚਿ ਨਕਟ ਦੇ ਰਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aas paas panch jogeea baitthe beech nakatt de raanee |1|
English: The five Yogis of the Tantric ritual sit there, and in their midst sits the noseless one, the shameless queen. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਕਟੀ ਕੋ ਠਨਗਨੁ ਬਾਡਾ ਡੂੰ ॥
Transliteration: nakattee ko tthanagan baaddaa ddoon |
English: The bell of the shameless queen, Maya, rings in both worlds.

Gurbani: ਕਿਨਹਿ ਬਿਬੇਕੀ ਕਾਟੀ ਤੂੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kineh bibekee kaattee toon |1| rahaau |
English: Some rare person of discriminating wisdom has cut off your nose. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਕਟੀ ਕਾ ਵਾਸਾ ਸਗਲ ਮਾਰਿ ਅਉਹੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: sagal maeh nakattee kaa vaasaa sagal maar aauheree |
English: Within all dwells the noseless Maya, who kills all, and destroys them.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲਿਆ ਕੀ ਹਉ ਬਹਿਨ ਭਾਨਜੀ ਜਿਨਹਿ ਬਰੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਚੇਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sagaliaa kee hau bahin bhaanajee jineh baree tis cheree |2|
English: She says, "I am the sister, and the daughter of the sister of everyone; I am the hand-maiden of one who marries me." ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਮਰੋ ਭਰਤਾ ਬਡੋ ਬਿਬੇਕੀ ਆਪੇ ਸੰਤੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: hamaro bharataa baddo bibekee aape sant kahaavai |
English: My Husband is the Great One of discriminating wisdom; He alone is called a Saint.

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਮਾਥੈ ਕਾਇਮੁ ਅਉਰੁ ਹਮਰੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ohu hamaarai maathai kaaeim aaur hamarai nikatt na aavai |3|
English: He stands by me, and no one else comes near me. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਕਹੁ ਕਾਟੀ ਕਾਨਹੁ ਕਾਟੀ ਕਾਟਿ ਕੂਟਿ ਕੈ ਡਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: naakahu kaattee kaanahu kaattee kaatt koott kai ddaaree |
English: I have cut off her nose, and cut off her ears, and cutting her into bits, I have expelled her.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਬੈਰਨਿ ਤੀਨਿ ਲੋਕ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੪॥੪॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer santan kee bairan teen lok kee piaaree |4|4|
English: Says Kabeer, she is the darling of the three worlds, but the enemy of the Saints. ||4||4||

[Ang 476 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa |
English: Aasaa:

Gurbani: ਜੋਗੀ ਜਤੀ ਤਪੀ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਬਹੁ ਤੀਰਥ ਭ੍ਰਮਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jogee jatee tapee saniaasee bahu teerath bhramanaa |
English: The Yogis, celibates, penitents and Sannyaasees make pilgrimages to all the sacred places.

Gurbani: ਲੁੰਜਿਤ ਮੁੰਜਿਤ ਮੋਨਿ ਜਟਾਧਰ ਅੰਤਿ ਤਊ ਮਰਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: lunjit munjit mon jattaadhar ant taoo maranaa |1|
English: The Jains with shaven heads, the silent ones, the beggars with matted hair - in the end, they all shall die. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਸੇਵੀਅਲੇ ਰਾਮਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: taa te seveeale raamanaa |
English: Meditate, therefore, on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਹਿਤੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੈ ਜਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: rasanaa raam naam hit jaa kai kahaa karai jamanaa |1| rahaau |
English: What can the Messenger of Death do to one whose tongue loves the Name of the Lord? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਗਮ ਨਿਰਗਮ ਜੋਤਿਕ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਆਕਰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: aagam niragam jotik jaaneh bahu bahu biaakaranaa |
English: Those who know the Shaastras and the Vedas, astrology and the rules of grammar of many languages;

Gurbani: ਤੰਤ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਸਭ ਅਉਖਧ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਤਊ ਮਰਨਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tant mantr sabh aaukhadh jaaneh ant taoo maranaa |2|
English: those who know Tantras and mantras and all medicines - even they shall die in the end. ||2||

Gurbani: ਰਾਜ ਭੋਗ ਅਰੁ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਨ ਬਹੁ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਰਮਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: raaj bhog ar chhatr singhaasan bahu sundar ramanaa |
English: Those who enjoy regal power and rule, royal canopies and thrones, many beautiful women,

Gurbani: ਪਾਨ ਕਪੂਰ ਸੁਬਾਸਕ ਚੰਦਨ ਅੰਤਿ ਤਊ ਮਰਨਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: paan kapoor subaasak chandan ant taoo maranaa |3|
English: betel nuts, camphor and fragrant sandalwood oil - in the end, they too shall die. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਭ ਖੋਜੇ ਕਹੂ ਨ ਊਬਰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: bed puraan sinmrit sabh khoje kahoo na aoobaranaa |
English: I have searched all the Vedas, Puraanas and Simritees, but none of these can save anyone.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਇਉ ਰਾਮਹਿ ਜੰਪਉ ਮੇਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨਾ ॥੪॥੫॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer iau raameh janpau mett janam maranaa |4|5|
English: Says Kabeer, meditate on the Lord, and eliminate birth and death. ||4||5||

[Ang 477 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa |
English: Aasaa:

Gurbani: ਫੀਲੁ ਰਬਾਬੀ ਬਲਦੁ ਪਖਾਵਜ ਕਊਆ ਤਾਲ ਬਜਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: feel rabaabee balad pakhaavaj kaooaa taal bajaavai |
English: The elephant is the guitar player, the ox is the drummer, and the crow plays the cymbals.

Gurbani: ਪਹਿਰਿ ਚੋਲਨਾ ਗਦਹਾ ਨਾਚੈ ਭੈਸਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: pahir cholanaa gadahaa naachai bhaisaa bhagat karaavai |1|
English: Putting on the skirt, the donkey dances around, and the water buffalo performs devotional worship. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਕਕਰੀਆ ਬਰੇ ਪਕਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: raajaa raam kakareea bare pakaae |
English: The Lord, the King, has cooked the cakes of ice,

Gurbani: ਕਿਨੈ ਬੂਝਨਹਾਰੈ ਖਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
