Transliteration: kinai boojhanahaarai khaae |1| rahaau |
English: but only the rare man of understanding eats them. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬੈਠਿ ਸਿੰਘੁ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਨ ਲਗਾਵੈ ਘੀਸ ਗਲਉਰੇ ਲਿਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: baitth singh ghar paan lagaavai ghees glaure liaavai |
English: Sitting in his den, the lion prepares the betel leaves, and the muskrat brings the betel nuts.

Gurbani: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮੁਸਰੀ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਕਛੂਆ ਸੰਖੁ ਬਜਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ghar ghar musaree mangal gaaveh kachhooaa sankh bajaavai |2|
English: Going from house to house, the mouse sings the songs of joy, and the turtle blows on the conch-shell. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬੰਸ ਕੋ ਪੂਤੁ ਬੀਆਹਨ ਚਲਿਆ ਸੁਇਨੇ ਮੰਡਪ ਛਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: bans ko poot beeaahan chaliaa sueine manddap chhaae |
English: The son of the sterile woman goes to get married, and the golden canopy is spread out for him.

Gurbani: ਰੂਪ ਕੰਨਿਆ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਬੇਧੀ ਸਸੈ ਸਿੰਘ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: roop kaniaa sundar bedhee sasai singh gun gaae |3|
English: He marries a beautiful and enticing young woman; the rabbit and the lion sing their praises. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਕੀਟੀ ਪਰਬਤੁ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kehat kabeer sunahu re santahu keettee parabat khaaeaa |
English: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints - the ant has eaten the mountain.

Gurbani: ਕਛੂਆ ਕਹੈ ਅੰਗਾਰ ਭਿ ਲੋਰਉ ਲੂਕੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਨਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੬॥
Transliteration: kachhooaa kahai angaar bhi lorau lookee sabad sunaaeaa |4|6|
English: The turtle says, "I need a burning coal, also." Listen to this mystery of the Shabad. ||4||6||

[Ang 477 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa |
English: Aasaa:

Gurbani: ਬਟੂਆ ਏਕੁ ਬਹਤਰਿ ਆਧਾਰੀ ਏਕੋ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: battooaa ek bahatar aadhaaree eko jiseh duaaraa |
English: The body is a bag with seventy-two chambers, and one opening, the Tenth Gate.

Gurbani: ਨਵੈ ਖੰਡ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੀ ਮਾਗੈ ਸੋ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਗਿ ਸਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: navai khandd kee prithamee maagai so jogee jag saaraa |1|
English: He alone is a real Yogi on this earth, who asks for the primal world of the nine regions. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਜੋਗੀ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa jogee nau nidh paavai |
English: Such a Yogi obtains the nine treasures.

Gurbani: ਤਲ ਕਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਲੇ ਗਗਨਿ ਚਰਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tal kaa braham le gagan charaavai |1| rahaau |
English: He lifts his soul up from below, to the skies of the Tenth Gate. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਖਿੰਥਾ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਕਰਿ ਸੂਈ ਸਬਦੁ ਤਾਗਾ ਮਥਿ ਘਾਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: khinthaa giaan dhiaan kar sooee sabad taagaa math ghaalai |
English: He makes spiritual wisdom his patched coat, and meditation his needle. He twists the thread of the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਰਗਾਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਾਲੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: panch tat kee kar miragaanee gur kai maarag chaalai |2|
English: Making the five elements his deer skin to sit on, he walks on the Guru's Path. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦਇਆ ਫਾਹੁਰੀ ਕਾਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਧੂਈ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਲਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: deaa faahuree kaaeaa kar dhooee drisatt kee agan jalaavai |
English: He makes compassion his shovel, his body the firewood, and he kindles the fire of divine vision.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਭਾਉ ਲਏ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tis kaa bhaau le rid antar chahu jug taarree laavai |3|
English: He places love within his heart, and he remains in deep meditation throughout the four ages. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਜੋਗਤਣ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪਰਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabh jogatan raam naam hai jis kaa pindd paraanaa |
English: All Yoga is in the Name of the Lord; the body and the breath of life belong to Him.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੈ ਦੇਇ ਸਚਾ ਨੀਸਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੭॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer je kirapaa dhaarai dee sachaa neesaanaa |4|7|
English: Says Kabeer, if God grants His Grace, He bestows the insignia of Truth. ||4||7||

[Ang 477 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa |
English: Aasaa:

Gurbani: ਹਿੰਦੂ ਤੁਰਕ ਕਹਾ ਤੇ ਆਏ ਕਿਨਿ ਏਹ ਰਾਹ ਚਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: hindoo turak kahaa te aae kin eeh raah chalaaee |
English: Where have the Hindus and Muslims come from? Who put them on their different paths?

Gurbani: ਦਿਲ ਮਹਿ ਸੋਚਿ ਬਿਚਾਰਿ ਕਵਾਦੇ ਭਿਸਤ ਦੋਜਕ ਕਿਨਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dil meh soch bichaar kavaade bhisat dojak kin paaee |1|
English: Think of this, and contemplate it within your mind, O men of evil intentions. Who will go to heaven and hell? ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਾਜੀ ਤੈ ਕਵਨ ਕਤੇਬ ਬਖਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: kaajee tai kavan kateb bakhaanee |
English: O Qazi, which book have you read?

Gurbani: ਪੜ੍ਹਤ ਗੁਨਤ ਐਸੇ ਸਭ ਮਾਰੇ ਕਿਨਹੂੰ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: parrhat gunat aise sabh maare kinahoon khabar na jaanee |1| rahaau |
English: Such scholars and students have all died, and none of them have discovered the inner meaning. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਕਤਿ ਸਨੇਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਸੁੰਨਤਿ ਕਰੀਐ ਮੈ ਨ ਬਦਉਗਾ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sakat sanehu kar sunat kareeai mai na bdaugaa bhaaee |
English: Because of the love of woman, circumcision is done; I don't believe in it, O Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਰੇ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਮੋਹਿ ਤੁਰਕੁ ਕਰੈਗਾ ਆਪਨ ਹੀ ਕਟਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jau re khudaae mohi turak karaigaa aapan hee katt jaaee |2|
English: If God wished me to be a Muslim, it would be cut off by itself. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਨਤਿ ਕੀਏ ਤੁਰਕੁ ਜੇ ਹੋਇਗਾ ਅਉਰਤ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: sunat kee turak je hoeigaa aaurat kaa kiaa kareeai |
English: If circumcision makes one a Muslim, then what about a woman?

Gurbani: ਅਰਧ ਸਰੀਰੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਹੀ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aradh sareeree naar na chhoddai taa te hindoo hee raheeai |3|
English: She is the other half of a man's body, and she does not leave him, so he remains a Hindu. ||3||

Gurbani: ਛਾਡਿ ਕਤੇਬ ਰਾਮੁ ਭਜੁ ਬਉਰੇ ਜੁਲਮ ਕਰਤ ਹੈ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: chhaadd kateb raam bhaj baure julam karat hai bhaaree |
English: Give up your holy books, and remember the Lord, you fool, and stop oppressing others so badly.

Gurbani: ਕਬੀਰੈ ਪਕਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਤੁਰਕ ਰਹੇ ਪਚਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੮॥
Transliteration: kabeerai pakaree ttek raam kee turak rahe pachihaaree |4|8|
English: Kabeer has grasped hold of the Lord's Support, and the Muslims have utterly failed. ||4||8||

[Ang 477 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa |
English: Aasaa:

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਤੇਲੁ ਦੀਵੇ ਮੁਖਿ ਬਾਤੀ ਤਬ ਸੂਝੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jab lag tel deeve mukh baatee tab soojhai sabh koee |
English: As long as the oil and the wick are in the lamp, everything is illuminated.

Gurbani: ਤੇਲ ਜਲੇ ਬਾਤੀ ਠਹਰਾਨੀ ਸੂੰਨਾ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tel jale baatee tthaharaanee soonaa mandar hoee |1|
English: But when the oil is burnt, the wick goes out, and the mansion becomes desolate. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰੇ ਬਉਰੇ ਤੁਹਿ ਘਰੀ ਨ ਰਾਖੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: re baure tuhi gharee na raakhai koee |
English: O mad-man, no one will keep you, for even a moment.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: toon raam naam jap soee |1| rahaau |
English: Meditate on the Name of that Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਾ ਕੀ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਕਹੁ ਕਾ ਕੋ ਕਵਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਕੀ ਜੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: kaa kee maat pitaa kahu kaa ko kavan purakh kee joee |
English: Tell me, whose mother is that, whose father is that, and which man has a wife?

Gurbani: ਘਟ ਫੂਟੇ ਕੋਊ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਪੂਛੈ ਕਾਢਹੁ ਕਾਢਹੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ghatt footte koaoo baat na poochhai kaadtahu kaadtahu hoee |2|
English: When the pitcher of the body breaks, no one cares for you at all. Everyone says, "Take him away, take him away!" ||2||

Gurbani: ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਬੈਠੀ ਮਾਤਾ ਰੋਵੈ ਖਟੀਆ ਲੇ ਗਏ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: dehuree baitthee maataa rovai khatteea le ge bhaaee |
English: Sitting on the threshold, his mother cries, and his brothers take away the coffin.

Gurbani: ਲਟ ਛਿਟਕਾਏ ਤਿਰੀਆ ਰੋਵੈ ਹੰਸੁ ਇਕੇਲਾ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: latt chhittakaae tireea rovai hans ikelaa jaaee |3|
English: Taking down her hair, his wife cries out in sorrow, and the swan-soul departs all alone. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kehat kabeer sunahu re santahu bhai saagar kai taaee |
English: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints, about the terrifying world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਬੰਦੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਜੁਲਮੁ ਹੋਤ ਹੈ ਜਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਹਟੈ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥੪॥੯॥ ਦੁਤੁਕੇ
Transliteration: eis bande sir julam hot hai jam nahee hattai gusaaee |4|9| dutuke
English: This human suffers torture and the Messenger of Death will not leave him alone, O Lord of the World. ||4||9|| Dho-Thukay

[Ang 478 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਇਕਤੁਕੇ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa sree kabeer jeeo ke chaupade ikatuke |
English: Aasaa Of Kabeer Jee, Chau-Padhay, Ek-Thukay:

Gurbani: ਸਨਕ ਸਨੰਦ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sanak sanand ant nahee paaeaa |
English: Sanak and Sanand, the sons of Brahma, could not find the Lord's limits.

Gurbani: ਬੇਦ ਪੜੇ ਪੜਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bed parre parr brahame janam gavaaeaa |1|
English: Brahma wasted his life away, continually reading the Vedas. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਬਿਲੋਵਨਾ ਬਿਲੋਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa bilovanaa bilovahu mere bhaaee |
English: Churn the churn of the Lord, O my Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜਿ ਬਿਲੋਵਹੁ ਜੈਸੇ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj bilovahu jaise tat na jaaee |1| rahaau |
English: Churn it steadily, so that the essence, the butter, may not be lost. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਟੁਕੀ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਬਿਲੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: tan kar mattukee man maeh biloee |
English: Make your body the churning jar, and use the stick of your mind to churn it.

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਮਟੁਕੀ ਮਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੰਜੋਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: eis mattukee meh sabad sanjoee |2|
English: Gather the curds of the Word of the Shabad. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਬਿਲੋਵਨਾ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa bilovanaa man kaa beechaaraa |
English: The churning of the Lord is to reflect upon Him within your mind.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad paavai amrit dhaaraa |3|
English: By Guru's Grace, the Ambrosial Nectar flows into us. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਮਂੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer nadar kare je maneeraa |
English: Says Kabeer, if the Lord, our King casts His Glance of Grace,

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਗਿ ਉਤਰੇ ਤੀਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: raam naam lag utare teeraa |4|1|10|
English: one is carried across to the other side, holding fast to the Lord's Name. ||4||1||10||

[Ang 478 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa |
English: Aasaa:

Gurbani: ਬਾਤੀ ਸੂਕੀ ਤੇਲੁ ਨਿਖੂਟਾ ॥
Transliteration: baatee sookee tel nikhoottaa |
English: The wick has dried up, and the oil is exhausted.

Gurbani: ਮੰਦਲੁ ਨ ਬਾਜੈ ਨਟੁ ਪੈ ਸੂਤਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mandal na baajai natt pai sootaa |1|
English: The drum does not sound, and the actor has gone to sleep. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬੁਝਿ ਗਈ ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਨਿਕਸਿਓ ਧੂੰਆ ॥
Transliteration: bujh gee agan na nikasio dhoonaa |
English: The fire has gone out, and no smoke is produced.

Gurbani: ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਏਕੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: rav rahiaa ek avar nahee dooaa |1| rahaau |
English: The One Lord is pervading and permeating everywhere; there is no other second. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਟੂਟੀ ਤੰਤੁ ਨ ਬਜੈ ਰਬਾਬੁ ॥
Transliteration: ttoottee tant na bajai rabaab |
English: The string has broken, and the guitar makes no sound.

Gurbani: ਭੂਲਿ ਬਿਗਾਰਿਓ ਅਪਨਾ ਕਾਜੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bhool bigaario apanaa kaaj |2|
English: He mistakenly ruins his own affairs. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਨੀ ਕਹਨੁ ਕਹਾਵਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: kathanee badanee kehan kahaavan |
English: When one comes to understand,

Gurbani: ਸਮਝਿ ਪਰੀ ਤਉ ਬਿਸਰਿਓ ਗਾਵਨੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: samajh paree tau bisario gaavan |3|
English: He forgets his preaching, ranting and raving, and arguing. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਪੰਚ ਜੋ ਚੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kehat kabeer panch jo choore |
English: Says Kabeer, the state of supreme dignity is never far

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਤੇ ਨਾਹਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਦੂਰੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: tin te naeh param pad doore |4|2|11|
English: From those who conquer the five demons of the body passions. ||4||2||11||

[Ang 478 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa |
English: Aasaa:

Gurbani: ਸੁਤੁ ਅਪਰਾਧ ਕਰਤ ਹੈ ਜੇਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: sut aparaadh karat hai jete |
English: As many mistakes as the son commits,

Gurbani: ਜਨਨੀ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਰਾਖਸਿ ਤੇਤੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jananee cheet na raakhas tete |1|
English: his mother does not hold them against him in her mind. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮਈਆ ਹਉ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: raameea hau baarik teraa |
English: O Lord, I am Your child.

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੇ ਨ ਖੰਡਸਿ ਅਵਗਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kaahe na khanddas avagan meraa |1| rahaau |
English: Why not destroy my sins? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਅਤਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਪ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਧਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: je at krop kare kar dhaaeaa |
English: If the son, in anger, runs away,

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਭੀ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਰਾਖਸਿ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: taa bhee cheet na raakhas maaeaa |2|
English: even then, his mother does not hold it against him in her mind. ||2||

Gurbani: ਚਿੰਤ ਭਵਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਪਰਿਓ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: chint bhavan man pario hamaaraa |
English: My mind has fallen into the whirlpool of anxiety.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਪਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naam binaa kaise utaras paaraa |3|
English: Without the Naam, how can I cross over to the other side? ||3||

Gurbani: ਦੇਹਿ ਬਿਮਲ ਮਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: dehi bimal mat sadaa sareeraa |
English: Please, bless my body with pure and lasting understanding, Lord;

Gurbani: ਸਹਜਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਗੁਨ ਰਵੈ ਕਬੀਰਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: sehaj sehaj gun ravai kabeeraa |4|3|12|
English: in peace and poise, Kabeer chants the Praises of the Lord. ||4||3||12||

[Ang 478 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa |
English: Aasaa:

Gurbani: ਹਜ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਗੋਮਤੀ ਤੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: haj hamaaree gomatee teer |
English: My pilgrimage to Mecca is on the banks of the Gomati River;

Gurbani: ਜਹਾ ਬਸਹਿ ਪੀਤੰਬਰ ਪੀਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jahaa baseh peetanbar peer |1|
English: the spiritual teacher in his yellow robes dwells there. ||1||

Gurbani: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਖੂਬੁ ਗਾਵਤਾ ਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: vaahu vaahu kiaa khoob gaavataa hai |
English: Waaho! Waaho! Hail! Hail! How wondrously he sings.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਤਾ ਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam merai man bhaavataa hai |1| rahaau |
English: The Name of the Lord is pleasing to my mind. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾਰਦ ਸਾਰਦ ਕਰਹਿ ਖਵਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: naarad saarad kareh khavaasee |
English: Naarada the sage, and Shaarada the goddess of knowledge, serve the Lord.

Gurbani: ਪਾਸਿ ਬੈਠੀ ਬੀਬੀ ਕਵਲਾ ਦਾਸੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: paas baitthee beebee kavalaa daasee |2|
English: The goddess Lakhshmi sits by Him as His slave. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕੰਠੇ ਮਾਲਾ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਰਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: kantthe maalaa jihavaa raam |
English: The mala is around my neck, and the Lord's Name is upon my tongue.

Gurbani: ਸਹੰਸ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈ ਲੈ ਕਰਉ ਸਲਾਮੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sahans naam lai lai krau salaam |3|
English: I repeat the Naam, the Name of the Lord, a thousand times, and bow in reverence to Him. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: kehat kabeer raam gun gaavau |
English: Says Kabeer, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord;

Gurbani: ਹਿੰਦੂ ਤੁਰਕ ਦੋਊ ਸਮਝਾਵਉ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: hindoo turak doaoo samajhaavau |4|4|13|
English: I teach both Hindus and Muslims. ||4||4||13||

[Ang 479 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ ਪੰਚਪਦੇ ੯ ਦੁਤੁਕੇ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa sree kabeer jeeo ke panchapade 9 dutuke 5 |
English: Aasaa, Kabeer Jee, 9 Panch-Padhay, 5 Dho-Thukay:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਪਾਤੀ ਤੋਰੈ ਮਾਲਿਨੀ ਪਾਤੀ ਪਾਤੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: paatee torai maalinee paatee paatee jeeo |
English: You tear off the leaves, O gardener, but in each and every leaf, there is life.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਾਹਨ ਕਉ ਪਾਤੀ ਤੋਰੈ ਸੋ ਪਾਹਨ ਨਿਰਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jis paahan kau paatee torai so paahan nirajeeo |1|
English: That stone idol, for which you tear off those leaves - that stone idol is lifeless. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭੂਲੀ ਮਾਲਨੀ ਹੈ ਏਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhoolee maalanee hai eo |
English: In this, you are mistaken, O gardener.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਾਗਤਾ ਹੈ ਦੇਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur jaagataa hai deo |1| rahaau |
English: The True Guru is the Living Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਾਤੀ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਡਾਰੀ ਫੂਲ ਸੰਕਰਦੇਉ ॥
Transliteration: braham paatee bisan ddaaree fool sankaradeo |
English: Brahma is in the leaves, Vishnu is in the branches, and Shiva is in the flowers.

Gurbani: ਤੀਨਿ ਦੇਵ ਪ੍ਰਤਖਿ ਤੋਰਹਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੇਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: teen dev pratakh toreh kareh kis kee seo |2|
English: When you break these three gods, whose service are you performing? ||2||

Gurbani: ਪਾਖਾਨ ਗਢਿ ਕੈ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਕੀਨੑੀ ਦੇ ਕੈ ਛਾਤੀ ਪਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: paakhaan gadt kai moorat keenaee de kai chhaatee paau |
English: The sculptor carves the stone and fashions it into an idol, placing his feet upon its chest.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਏਹ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਹੈ ਤਉ ਗੜ੍ਹਣਹਾਰੇ ਖਾਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: je eeh moorat saachee hai tau garrhanahaare khaau |3|
English: If this stone god was true, it would devour the sculptor for this! ||3||

Gurbani: ਭਾਤੁ ਪਹਿਤਿ ਅਰੁ ਲਾਪਸੀ ਕਰਕਰਾ ਕਾਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: bhaat pahit ar laapasee karakaraa kaasaar |
English: Rice and beans, candies, cakes and cookies

Gurbani: ਭੋਗਨਹਾਰੇ ਭੋਗਿਆ ਇਸੁ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: bhoganahaare bhogiaa is moorat ke mukh chhaar |4|
English: - the priest enjoys these, while he puts ashes into the mouth of the idol. ||4||

Gurbani: ਮਾਲਿਨਿ ਭੂਲੀ ਜਗੁ ਭੁਲਾਨਾ ਹਮ ਭੁਲਾਨੇ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: maalin bhoolee jag bhulaanaa ham bhulaane naeh |
English: The gardener is mistaken, and the world is mistaken, but I am not mistaken.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਹਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਖੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥੫॥੧॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer ham raam raakhe kripaa kar har raae |5|1|14|
English: Says Kabeer, the Lord preserves me; the Lord, my King, has showered His Blessings upon me. ||5||1||14||

[Ang 479 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa |
English: Aasaa:

Gurbani: ਬਾਰਹ ਬਰਸ ਬਾਲਪਨ ਬੀਤੇ ਬੀਸ ਬਰਸ ਕਛੁ ਤਪੁ ਨ ਕੀਓ ॥
Transliteration: baarah baras baalapan beete bees baras kachh tap na keeo |
English: Twelve years pass in childhood, and for another twenty years, he does not practice self-discipline and austerity.

Gurbani: ਤੀਸ ਬਰਸ ਕਛੁ ਦੇਵ ਨ ਪੂਜਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਨਾ ਬਿਰਧਿ ਭਇਓ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tees baras kachh dev na poojaa fir pachhutaanaa biradh bheo |1|
English: For another thirty years, he does not worship God in any way, and then, when he is old, he repents and regrets. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਤੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: meree meree karate janam geo |
English: His life wastes away as he cries out, "Mine, mine!"

Gurbani: ਸਾਇਰੁ ਸੋਖਿ ਭੁਜੰ ਬਲਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saaeir sokh bhujan baleo |1| rahaau |
English: The pool of his power has dried up. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੂਕੇ ਸਰਵਰਿ ਪਾਲਿ ਬੰਧਾਵੈ ਲੂਣੈ ਖੇਤਿ ਹਥ ਵਾਰਿ ਕਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: sooke saravar paal bandhaavai loonai khet hath vaar karai |
English: He makes a dam around the dried-up pool, and with his hands, he makes a fence around the harvested field.

Gurbani: ਆਇਓ ਚੋਰੁ ਤੁਰੰਤਹ ਲੇ ਗਇਓ ਮੇਰੀ ਰਾਖਤ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਫਿਰੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aaeo chor turantah le geo meree raakhat mugadh firai |2|
English: When the thief of Death comes, he quickly carries away what the fool had tried to preserve as his own. ||2||

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਸੀਸੁ ਕਰ ਕੰਪਨ ਲਾਗੇ ਨੈਨੀ ਨੀਰੁ ਅਸਾਰ ਬਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: charan sees kar kanpan laage nainee neer asaar bahai |
English: His feet and head and hands begin to tremble, and the tears flow copiously from his eyes.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਸੁਧੁ ਨਹੀ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਤਬ ਰੇ ਧਰਮ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਕਰੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jihavaa bachan sudh nahee nikasai tab re dharam kee aas karai |3|
English: His tongue has not spoken the correct words, but now, he hopes to practice religion! ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੀਓ ॥
Transliteration: har jeeo kripaa karai liv laavai laahaa har har naam leeo |
English: If the Dear Lord shows His Mercy, one enshrines love for Him, and obtains the Profit of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਅੰਤੇ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਚਲਿਓ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee har dhan paaeo ante chaladiaa naal chalio |4|
English: By Guru's Grace, he receives the wealth of the Lord's Name, which alone shall go with him, when he departs in the end. ||4||

Gurbani: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਅਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਕਛੂਐ ਲੈ ਨ ਗਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: kehat kabeer sunahu re santahu an dhan kachhooai lai na geo |
English: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints - he shall not take any other wealth with him.

Gurbani: ਆਈ ਤਲਬ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਰਾਇ ਕੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੰਦਰ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਲਿਓ ॥੫॥੨॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: aaee talab gopaal raae kee maaeaa mandar chhodd chalio |5|2|15|
English: When the summons comes from the King, the Lord of the Universe, the mortal departs, leaving behind his wealth and mansions. ||5||2||15||

[Ang 479 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa |
English: Aasaa:

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੂ ਦੀਨੑੇ ਪਾਟ ਪਟੰਬਰ ਕਾਹੂ ਪਲਘ ਨਿਵਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaahoo deenae paatt pattanbar kaahoo palagh nivaaraa |
English: To some, the Lord has given silks and satins, and to some, beds decorated with cotton ribbons.

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੂ ਗਰੀ ਗੋਦਰੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਾਹੂ ਖਾਨ ਪਰਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kaahoo garee godaree naahee kaahoo khaan paraaraa |1|
English: Some do not even have a poor patched coat, and some live in thatched huts. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਹਿਰਖ ਵਾਦੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਰੇ ਮਨ ॥
Transliteration: ahirakh vaad na keejai re man |
English: Do not indulge in envy and bickering, O my mind.

Gurbani: ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਜੈ ਰੇ ਮਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sukrit kar kar leejai re man |1| rahaau |
English: By continually doing good deeds, these are obtained, O my mind. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕੁਮੑਾਰੈ ਏਕ ਜੁ ਮਾਟੀ ਗੂੰਧੀ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਾਨੀ ਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kumaarai ek ju maattee goondhee bahu bidh baanee laaee |
English: The potter works the same clay, and colors the pots in different ways.

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੂ ਮਹਿ ਮੋਤੀ ਮੁਕਤਾਹਲ ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਲਗਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kaahoo meh motee mukataahal kaahoo biaadh lagaaee |2|
English: Into some, he sets pearls, while to others, he attaches filth. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੂਮਹਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਖਨ ਕਉ ਦੀਆ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਕਹੈ ਧਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: soomeh dhan raakhan kau deea mugadh kahai dhan meraa |
English: God gave wealth to the miser for him to preserve, but the fool calls it his own.

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਕਾ ਡੰਡੁ ਮੂੰਡ ਮਹਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਰੈ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jam kaa ddandd moondd meh laagai khin meh karai niberaa |3|
English: When the Messenger of Death strikes him with his club, in an instant, everything is settled. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਊਤਮੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਸਦਾਵੈ ਆਗਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har jan aootam bhagat sadaavai aagiaa man sukh paaee |
English: The Lord's humble servant is called the most exalted Saint; he obeys the Command of the Lord's Order, and obtains peace.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੈ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jo tis bhaavai sat kar maanai bhaanaa man vasaaee |4|
English: Whatever is pleasing to the Lord, he accepts as True; he enshrines the Lord's Will within his mind. ||4||

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਝੂਠੀ ॥
Transliteration: kahai kabeer sunahu re santahu meree meree jhootthee |
English: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints - it is false to call out, "Mine, mine."

Gurbani: ਚਿਰਗਟ ਫਾਰਿ ਚਟਾਰਾ ਲੈ ਗਇਓ ਤਰੀ ਤਾਗਰੀ ਛੂਟੀ ॥੫॥੩॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: chiragatt faar chattaaraa lai geo taree taagaree chhoottee |5|3|16|
English: Breaking the bird cage, death takes the bird away, and only the torn threads remain. ||5||3||16||

[Ang 480 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa |
English: Aasaa:

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਮਸਕੀਨ ਖੁਦਾਈ ਬੰਦੇ ਤੁਮ ਰਾਜਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: ham masakeen khudaaee bande tum raajas man bhaavai |
English: I am Your humble servant, Lord; Your Praises are pleasing to my mind.

Gurbani: ਅਲਹ ਅਵਲਿ ਦੀਨ ਕੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਜੋਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਫੁਰਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: alah aval deen ko saahib jor nahee furamaavai |1|
English: The Lord, the Primal Being, the Master of the poor, does not ordain that they should be oppressed. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਾਜੀ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਬਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kaajee boliaa ban nahee aavai |1| rahaau |
English: O Qazi, it is not right to speak before Him. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਰੋਜਾ ਧਰੈ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਗੁਜਾਰੈ ਕਲਮਾ ਭਿਸਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: rojaa dharai nivaaj gujaarai kalamaa bhisat na hoee |
English: Keeping your fasts, reciting your prayers, and reading the Kalma, the Islamic creed, shall not take you to paradise.

Gurbani: ਸਤਰਿ ਕਾਬਾ ਘਟ ਹੀ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਜੇ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: satar kaabaa ghatt hee bheetar je kar jaanai koee |2|
English: The Temple of Mecca is hidden within your mind, if you only knew it. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਿਵਾਜ ਸੋਈ ਜੋ ਨਿਆਉ ਬਿਚਾਰੈ ਕਲਮਾ ਅਕਲਹਿ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: nivaaj soee jo niaau bichaarai kalamaa akaleh jaanai |
English: That should be your prayer, to administer justice. Let your Kalma be the knowledge of the unknowable Lord.

Gurbani: ਪਾਚਹੁ ਮੁਸਿ ਮੁਸਲਾ ਬਿਛਾਵੈ ਤਬ ਤਉ ਦੀਨੁ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: paachahu mus musalaa bichhaavai tab tau deen pachhaanai |3|
English: Spread your prayer mat by conquering your five desires, and you shall recognize the true religion. ||3||

Gurbani: ਖਸਮੁ ਪਛਾਨਿ ਤਰਸ ਕਰਿ ਜੀਅ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਣੀ ਕਰਿ ਫੀਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: khasam pachhaan taras kar jeea meh maar manee kar feekee |
English: Recognize Your Lord and Master, and fear Him within your heart; conquer your egotism, and make it worthless.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਜਨਾਇ ਅਵਰ ਕਉ ਜਾਨੈ ਤਬ ਹੋਇ ਭਿਸਤ ਸਰੀਕੀ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: aap janaae avar kau jaanai tab hoe bhisat sareekee |4|
English: As you see yourself, see others as well; only then will you become a partner in heaven. ||4||

Gurbani: ਮਾਟੀ ਏਕ ਭੇਖ ਧਰਿ ਨਾਨਾ ਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: maattee ek bhekh dhar naanaa taa meh braham pachhaanaa |
English: The clay is one, but it has taken many forms; I recognize the One Lord within them all.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਭਿਸਤ ਛੋਡਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੋਜਕ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਾ ॥੫॥੪॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: kahai kabeeraa bhisat chhodd kar dojak siau man maanaa |5|4|17|
English: Says Kabeer, I have abandoned paradise, and reconciled my mind to hell. ||5||4||17||

[Ang 480 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa |
English: Aasaa:

Gurbani: ਗਗਨ ਨਗਰਿ ਇਕ ਬੂੰਦ ਨ ਬਰਖੈ ਨਾਦੁ ਕਹਾ ਜੁ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: gagan nagar ik boond na barakhai naad kahaa ju samaanaa |
English: From the city of the Tenth Gate, the sky of the mind, not even a drop rains down. Where is the music of the sound current of the Naad, which was contained in it?

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਮਾਧੋ ਪਰਮ ਹੰਸੁ ਲੇ ਸਿਧਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: paarabraham paramesur maadho param hans le sidhaanaa |1|
English: The Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, the Master of wealth has taken away the Supreme Soul. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਾਬਾ ਬੋਲਤੇ ਤੇ ਕਹਾ ਗਏ ਦੇਹੀ ਕੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਹਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: baabaa bolate te kahaa ge dehee ke sang rahate |
English: O Father, tell me: where has it gone? It used to dwell within the body,

Gurbani: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਾਹਿ ਜੋ ਨਿਰਤੇ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਥਾ ਬਾਰਤਾ ਕਹਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: surat maeh jo nirate karate kathaa baarataa kahate |1| rahaau |
English: and dance in the mind, teaching and speaking. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਜਾਵਨਹਾਰੋ ਕਹਾ ਗਇਓ ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਕੀਨੑਾ ॥
Transliteration: bajaavanahaaro kahaa geo jin ihu mandar keenaa |
English: Where has the player gone - he who made this temple his own?

Gurbani: ਸਾਖੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਉਪਜੈ ਖਿੰਚਿ ਤੇਜੁ ਸਭੁ ਲੀਨੑਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saakhee sabad surat nahee upajai khinch tej sabh leenaa |2|
English: No story, word or understanding is produced; the Lord has drained off all the power. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰਵਨਨ ਬਿਕਲ ਭਏ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਕਾ ਬਲੁ ਥਾਕਾ ॥
Transliteration: sravanan bikal bhe sang tere indree kaa bal thaakaa |
English: The ears, your companions, have gone deaf, and the power of your organs is exhausted.

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਰਹੇ ਕਰ ਢਰਕਿ ਪਰੇ ਹੈ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਨ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਬਾਤਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: charan rahe kar dtarak pare hai mukhahu na nikasai baataa |3|
English: Your feet have failed, your hands have gone limp, and no words issue forth from your mouth. ||3||

Gurbani: ਥਾਕੇ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਸਭ ਤਸਕਰ ਆਪ ਆਪਣੈ ਭ੍ਰਮਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: thaake panch doot sabh tasakar aap aapanai bhramate |
English: Having grown weary, the five enemies and all the thieves have wandered away according to their own will.

Gurbani: ਥਾਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਕੁੰਚਰ ਉਰੁ ਥਾਕਾ ਤੇਜੁ ਸੂਤੁ ਧਰਿ ਰਮਤੇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: thaakaa man kunchar ur thaakaa tej soot dhar ramate |4|
English: The elephant of the mind has grown weary, and the heart has grown weary as well; through its power, it used to pull the strings. ||4||

Gurbani: ਮਿਰਤਕ ਭਏ ਦਸੈ ਬੰਦ ਛੂਟੇ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਭਾਈ ਸਭ ਛੋਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: miratak bhe dasai band chhootte mitr bhaaee sabh chhore |
English: He is dead, and the bonds of the ten gates are opened; he has left all his friends and brothers.

Gurbani: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਜੀਵਤ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋਰੇ ॥੫॥੫॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: kehat kabeeraa jo har dhiaavai jeevat bandhan tore |5|5|18|
English: Says Kabeer, one who meditates on the Lord, breaks his bonds, even while yet alive. ||5||5||18||

[Ang 480 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਇਕਤੁਕੇ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa ikatuke 4 |
English: Aasaa, 4 Ek-Thukay:

Gurbani: ਸਰਪਨੀ ਤੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਬਲੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: sarapanee te aoopar nahee baleea |
English: No one is more powerful than the she-serpent Maya,

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹਾਦੇਉ ਛਲੀਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jin brahamaa bisan mahaadeo chhaleea |1|
English: who deceived even Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਾਰੁ ਮਾਰੁ ਸ੍ਰਪਨੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਲਿ ਪੈਠੀ ॥
Transliteration: maar maar srapanee niramal jal paitthee |
English: Having bitten and struck them down, she now sits in the immaculate waters.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਡਸੀਅਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਡੀਠੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jin tribhavan ddaseeale gur prasaad ddeetthee |1| rahaau |
English: By Guru's Grace, I have seen her, who has bitten the three worlds. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰਪਨੀ ਸ੍ਰਪਨੀ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: srapanee srapanee kiaa kahahu bhaaee |
English: O Siblings of Destiny, why is she called a she-serpent?

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸ੍ਰਪਨੀ ਖਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jin saach pachhaaniaa tin srapanee khaaee |2|
English: One who realizes the True Lord, devours the she-serpent. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰਪਨੀ ਤੇ ਆਨ ਛੂਛ ਨਹੀ ਅਵਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: srapanee te aan chhoochh nahee avaraa |
English: No one else is more frivolous than this she-serpent.

Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰਪਨੀ ਜੀਤੀ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੈ ਜਮਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: srapanee jeetee kahaa karai jamaraa |3|
English: When the she-serpent is overcome, what can the Messengers of the King of Death do? ||3||

Gurbani: ਇਹ ਸ੍ਰਪਨੀ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਤੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: eih srapanee taa kee keetee hoee |
English: This she-serpent is created by Him.

Gurbani: ਬਲੁ ਅਬਲੁ ਕਿਆ ਇਸ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: bal abal kiaa is te hoee |4|
English: What power or weakness does she have by herself? ||4||

Gurbani: ਇਹ ਬਸਤੀ ਤਾ ਬਸਤ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: eih basatee taa basat sareeraa |
English: If she abides with the mortal, then his soul abides in his body.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਤਰੇ ਕਬੀਰਾ ॥੫॥੬॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad sehaj tare kabeeraa |5|6|19|
English: By Guru's Grace, Kabeer has easily crossed over. ||5||6||19||

[Ang 481 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa |
English: Aasaa:

Gurbani: ਕਹਾ ਸੁਆਨ ਕਉ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸੁਨਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: kahaa suaan kau simrit sunaae |
English: Why bother to read the Simritees to a dog?

Gurbani: ਕਹਾ ਸਾਕਤ ਪਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kahaa saakat peh har gun gaae |1|
English: Why bother to sing the Lord's Praises to the faithless cynic? ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਮੇ ਰਮਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: raam raam raam rame ram raheeai |
English: Remain absorbed in the Lord's Name, Raam, Raam, Raam.

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤ ਸਿਉ ਭੂਲਿ ਨਹੀ ਕਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saakat siau bhool nahee kaheeai |1| rahaau |
English: Do not bother to speak of it to the faithless cynic, even by mistake. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਊਆ ਕਹਾ ਕਪੂਰ ਚਰਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: kaooaa kahaa kapoor charaae |
English: Why offer camphor to a crow?

Gurbani: ਕਹ ਬਿਸੀਅਰ ਕਉ ਦੂਧੁ ਪੀਆਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: keh biseear kau doodh peeae |2|
English: Why give the snake milk to drink? ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੁਧਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: satasangat mil bibek budh hoee |
English: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, discriminating understanding is attained.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਰਸਿ ਲੋਹਾ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: paaras paras lohaa kanchan soee |3|
English: That iron which touches the Philosopher's Stone becomes gold. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤੁ ਸੁਆਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: saakat suaan sabh kare karaaeaa |
English: The dog, the faithless cynic, does everything as the Lord causes him to do.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jo dhur likhiaa su karam kamaaeaa |4|
English: He does the deeds pre-ordained from the very beginning. ||4||

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਲੈ ਲੈ ਨੀਮੁ ਸਿੰਚਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: amrit lai lai neem sinchaaee |
English: If you take Ambrosial Nectar and irrigate the neem tree with it,

Gurbani: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਉਆ ਕੋ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੫॥੭॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: kehat kabeer uaa ko sehaj na jaaee |5|7|20|
English: still, says Kabeer, its natural qualities are not changed. ||5||7||20||

[Ang 481 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa |
English: Aasaa:

Gurbani: ਲੰਕਾ ਸਾ ਕੋਟੁ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਸੀ ਖਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: lankaa saa kott samund see khaaee |
English: A fortress like that of Sri Lanka, with the ocean as a moat around it

Gurbani: ਤਿਹ ਰਾਵਨ ਘਰ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tih raavan ghar khabar na paaee |1|
English: - there is no news about that house of Raavan. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਮਾਗਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa maagau kichh thir na rahaaee |
English: What shall I ask for? Nothing is permanent.

Gurbani: ਦੇਖਤ ਨੈਨ ਚਲਿਓ ਜਗੁ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dekhat nain chalio jag jaaee |1| rahaau |
English: I see with my eyes that the world is passing away. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਇਕੁ ਲਖੁ ਪੂਤ ਸਵਾ ਲਖੁ ਨਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: eik lakh poot savaa lakh naatee |
English: Thousands of sons and thousands of grandsons

Gurbani: ਤਿਹ ਰਾਵਨ ਘਰ ਦੀਆ ਨ ਬਾਤੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tih raavan ghar deea na baatee |2|
English: - but in that house of Raavan, the lamps and wicks have gone out. ||2||

Gurbani: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਤਪਤ ਰਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: chand sooraj jaa ke tapat rasoee |
English: The moon and the sun cooked his food.

Gurbani: ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਕਪਰੇ ਧੋਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: baisantar jaa ke kapare dhoee |3|
English: The fire washed his clothes. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਬਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramat raamai naam basaaee |
English: Under Guru's Instructions, one whose mind is filled with the Lord's Name,

Gurbani: ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਜਾਈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: asathir rahai na katahoon jaaee |4|
English: becomes permanent, and does not go anywhere. ||4||

Gurbani: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਲੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: kehat kabeer sunahu re loee |
English: Says Kabeer, listen, people:

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੫॥੮॥੨੧॥
Transliteration: raam naam bin mukat na hoee |5|8|21|
English: without the Lord's Name, no one is liberated. ||5||8||21||

[Ang 481 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa |
English: Aasaa:

Gurbani: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਪੂਤੁ ਪਿਛੈਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: pahilaa poot pichhairee maaee |
English: First, the son was born, and then, his mother.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਲਾਗੋ ਚੇਲੇ ਕੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur laago chele kee paaee |1|
English: The guru falls at the feet of the disciple. ||1||

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਅਚੰਭਉ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਤੁਮੑ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ek achanbhau sunahu tuma bhaaee |
English: Listen to this wonderful thing, O Siblings of Destiny!

Gurbani: ਦੇਖਤ ਸਿੰਘੁ ਚਰਾਵਤ ਗਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dekhat singh charaavat gaaee |1| rahaau |
English: I saw the lion herding the cows. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਲ ਕੀ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਤਰਵਰਿ ਬਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: jal kee machhulee taravar biaaee |
English: The fish of the water gives birth upon a tree.

Gurbani: ਦੇਖਤ ਕੁਤਰਾ ਲੈ ਗਈ ਬਿਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: dekhat kutaraa lai gee bilaaee |2|
English: I saw a cat carrying away a dog. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤਲੈ ਰੇ ਬੈਸਾ ਊਪਰਿ ਸੂਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: talai re baisaa aoopar soolaa |
English: The branches are below, and the roots are above.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਪੇਡਿ ਲਗੇ ਫਲ ਫੂਲਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tis kai pedd lage fal foolaa |3|
English: The trunk of that tree bears fruits and flowers. ||3||

Gurbani: ਘੋਰੈ ਚਰਿ ਭੈਸ ਚਰਾਵਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ghorai char bhais charaavan jaaee |
English: Riding a horse, the buffalo takes him out to graze.

Gurbani: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਬੈਲੁ ਗੋਨਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: baahar bail gon ghar aaee |4|
English: The bull is away, while his load has come home. ||4||

Gurbani: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੁ ਇਸ ਪਦ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
Transliteration: kehat kabeer ju is pad boojhai |
English: Says Kabeer, one who understands this hymn,

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਰਮਤ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ॥੫॥੯॥੨੨॥
Transliteration: raam ramat tis sabh kichh soojhai |5|9|22|
English: and chants the Lord's Name, comes to understand everything. ||5||9||22||

Gurbani: ਬਾਈਸ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਤਥਾ ਪੰਚਪਦੇ
Transliteration: baaees chaupade tathaa panchapade
English: 22 Chau-Padhay And Panch-Padhay

[Ang 481 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ ਤਿਪਦੇ ੮ ਦੁਤੁਕੇ ੭ ਇਕਤੁਕਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa sree kabeer jeeo ke tipade 8 dutuke 7 ikatukaa 1 |
English: Aasaa Of Kabeer Jee, 8 Thri-Padhay, 7 Dho-Thukay, 1 Ik-Tuka:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਬਿੰਦੁ ਤੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਕੀਆ ਅਗਨਿ ਕੁੰਡ ਰਹਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bind te jin pindd keea agan kundd rahaaeaa |
English: The Lord created the body from sperm, and protected it in the fire pit.

Gurbani: ਦਸ ਮਾਸ ਮਾਤਾ ਉਦਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: das maas maataa udar raakhiaa bahur laagee maaeaa |1|
English: For ten months He preserved you in your mother's womb, and then, after you were born, you became attached to Maya. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਲੋਭਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਖੋਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: praanee kaahe kau lobh laage ratan janam khoeaa |
English: O mortal, why have you attached yourself to greed, and lost the jewel of life?

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਬ ਜਨਮਿ ਕਰਮ ਭੂਮਿ ਬੀਜੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਬੋਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: poorab janam karam bhoom beej naahee boeaa |1| rahaau |
English: You did not plant the seeds of good actions in the earth of your past lives. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤੇ ਬਿਰਧਿ ਭਇਆ ਹੋਨਾ ਸੋ ਹੋਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: baarik te biradh bheaa honaa so hoeaa |
English: From an infant, you have grown old. That which was to happen, has happened.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਜਮੁ ਆਇ ਝੋਟ ਪਕਰੈ ਤਬਹਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਰੋਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jaa jam aae jhott pakarai tabeh kaahe roeaa |2|
English: When the Messenger of Death comes and grabs you by your hair, why do you cry out then? ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਨੈ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਮੁ ਨਿਹਾਰੈ ਸਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeevanai kee aas kareh jam nihaarai saasaa |
English: You hope for long life, while Death counts your breaths.

Gurbani: ਬਾਜੀਗਰੀ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਚੇਤਿ ਢਾਲਿ ਪਾਸਾ ॥੩॥੧॥੨੩॥
Transliteration: baajeegaree sansaar kabeeraa chet dtaal paasaa |3|1|23|
English: The world is a game, O Kabeer, so throw the dice consciously. ||3||1||23||

[Ang 482 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa |
English: Aasaa:

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਰੈਨੀ ਮਨੁ ਪੁਨ ਰਪਿ ਕਰਿ ਹਉ ਪਾਚਉ ਤਤ ਬਰਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: tan rainee man pun rap kar hau paachau tat baraatee |
English: I make my body the dying vat, and within it, I dye my mind. I make the five elements my marriage guests.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਸਿਉ ਭਾਵਰਿ ਲੈਹਉ ਆਤਮ ਤਿਹ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: raam raae siau bhaavar laihau aatam tih rang raatee |1|
English: I take my marriage vows with the Lord, my King; my soul is imbued with His Love. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗਾਉ ਗਾਉ ਰੀ ਦੁਲਹਨੀ ਮੰਗਲਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: gaau gaau ree dulahanee mangalachaaraa |
English: Sing, sing, O brides of the Lord, the marriage songs of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਆਏ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਭਤਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mere grih aae raajaa raam bhataaraa |1| rahaau |
English: The Lord, my King, has come to my house as my Husband. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾਭਿ ਕਮਲ ਮਹਿ ਬੇਦੀ ਰਚਿ ਲੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਉਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: naabh kamal meh bedee rach le braham giaan uchaaraa |
English: Within the lotus of my heart, I have made my bridal pavilion, and I have spoken the wisdom of God.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਸੋ ਦੂਲਹੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਅਸ ਬਡਭਾਗ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: raam raae so doolahu paaeo as baddabhaag hamaaraa |2|
English: I have obtained the Lord King as my Husband - such is my great good fortune. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਕਉਤਕ ਆਏ ਕੋਟਿ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਉਜਾਨਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: sur nar mun jan kautak aae kott tetees ujaanaan |
English: The angles, holy men, silent sages, and the 330,000,000 deities have come in their heavenly chariots to see this spectacle.

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਿਆਹਿ ਚਲੇ ਹੈ ਪੁਰਖ ਏਕ ਭਗਵਾਨਾ ॥੩॥੨॥੨੪॥
Transliteration: keh kabeer mohi biaaeh chale hai purakh ek bhagavaanaa |3|2|24|
English: Says Kabeer, I have been taken in marriage by the One Supreme Being, the Lord God. ||3||2||24||

[Ang 482 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa |
English: Aasaa:

Gurbani: ਸਾਸੁ ਕੀ ਦੁਖੀ ਸਸੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਜੇਠ ਕੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਡਰਉ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: saas kee dukhee sasur kee piaaree jetth ke naam ddrau re |
English: I am bothered by my mother-in-law, Maya, and loved by my father-in-law, the Lord. I fear even the name of my husband's elder brother, Death.

Gurbani: ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਨਨਦ ਗਹੇਲੀ ਦੇਵਰ ਕੈ ਬਿਰਹਿ ਜਰਉ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sakhee sahelee nanad gahelee devar kai bireh jrau re |1|
English: O my mates and companions, my husband's sister, misunderstanding has seized me, and I am burning with the pain of separation from my husband's younger brother, divine knowledge. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਬਉਰੀ ਮੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਓ ਕਿਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਰਹਨਿ ਰਹਉ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: meree mat bauree mai raam bisaario kin bidh rehan rhau re |
English: My mind has gone insane, since I forgot the Lord. How can I lead a virtuous lifestyle?

Gurbani: ਸੇਜੈ ਰਮਤੁ ਨੈਨ ਨਹੀ ਪੇਖਉ ਇਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾ ਸਉ ਕਹਉ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sejai ramat nain nahee pekhau ihu dukh kaa sau khau re |1| rahaau |
English: He rests in the bed of my mind, but I cannot see Him with my eyes. Unto whom should I tell my sufferings? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਾਪੁ ਸਾਵਕਾ ਕਰੈ ਲਰਾਈ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਦ ਮਤਵਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: baap saavakaa karai laraaee maaeaa sad matavaaree |
English: My step-father, egotism, fights with me, and my mother, desire, is always intoxicated.

Gurbani: ਬਡੇ ਭਾਈ ਕੈ ਜਬ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੋਤੀ ਤਬ ਹਉ ਨਾਹ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: badde bhaaee kai jab sang hotee tab hau naah piaaree |2|
English: When I stayed with my elder brother, meditation, then I was loved by my Husband Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਪੰਚ ਕੋ ਝਗਰਾ ਝਗਰਤ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kehat kabeer panch ko jhagaraa jhagarat janam gavaaeaa |
English: Says Kabeer, the five passions argue with me, and in these arguments, my life is wasting away.

Gurbani: ਝੂਠੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਬਾਧਿਆ ਮੈ ਰਾਮ ਰਮਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥੩॥੨੫॥
Transliteration: jhootthee maaeaa sabh jag baadhiaa mai raam ramat sukh paaeaa |3|3|25|
English: The false Maya has bound the whole world, but I have obtained peace, chanting the Name of the Lord. ||3||3||25||

[Ang 482 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa |
English: Aasaa:

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਘਰਿ ਸੂਤੁ ਤਨਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਤਾਨਾ ਕੰਠਿ ਜਨੇਊ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: ham ghar soot taneh nit taanaa kantth janeaoo tumaare |
English: In my house, I constantly weave the thread, while you wear the thread around your neck, O Brahmin.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮੑ ਤਉ ਬੇਦ ਪੜਹੁ ਗਾਇਤ੍ਰੀ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tuma tau bed parrahu gaaeitree gobind ridai hamaare |1|
English: You read the Vedas and sacred hymns, while I have enshrined the Lord of the Universe in my heart. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਨੈਨ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਸਹਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: meree jihabaa bisan nain naaraaein hiradai baseh gobindaa |
English: Upon my tongue, within my eyes, and within my heart, abides the Lord, the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਦੁਆਰ ਜਬ ਪੂਛਸਿ ਬਵਰੇ ਤਬ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਸਿ ਮੁਕੰਦਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jam duaar jab poochhas bavare tab kiaa kehas mukandaa |1| rahaau |
English: When you are interrogated at Death's door, O mad-man, what will you say then? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਗੋਰੂ ਤੁਮ ਗੁਆਰ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਰਖਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: ham goroo tum guaar gusaaee janam janam rakhavaare |
English: I am a cow, and You are the herdsman, the Sustainer of the World. You are my Saving Grace, lifetime after lifetime.

Gurbani: ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਿ ਚਰਾਇਹੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਖਸਮ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kabahoon na paar utaar charaaeihu kaise khasam hamaare |2|
English: You have never taken me across to graze there - what sort of a herdsman are You? ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਬਾਮੑਨੁ ਮੈ ਕਾਸੀਕ ਜੁਲਹਾ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਮੋਰ ਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: toon baaman mai kaaseek julahaa boojhahu mor giaanaa |
English: You are a Brahmin, and I am a weaver of Benares; can You understand my wisdom?

Gurbani: ਤੁਮੑ ਤਉ ਜਾਚੇ ਭੂਪਤਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਉ ਮੋਰ ਧਿਆਨਾ ॥੩॥੪॥੨੬॥
Transliteration: tuma tau jaache bhoopat raaje har sau mor dhiaanaa |3|4|26|
English: You beg from emperors and kings, while I meditate on the Lord. ||3||4||26||

[Ang 482 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa |
English: Aasaa:

Gurbani: ਜਗਿ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਐਸਾ ਸੁਪਨੇ ਜੈਸਾ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਸੁਪਨ ਸਮਾਨੰ ॥
Transliteration: jag jeevan aisaa supane jaisaa jeevan supan samaanan |
English: The life of the world is only a dream; life is just a dream.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੁ ਕਰਿ ਹਮ ਗਾਠਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਛੋਡਿ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨੰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saach kar ham gaatth deenee chhodd param nidhaanan |1|
English: Believing it to be true, I grasped at it, and abandoned the supreme treasure. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਾਬਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਹਿਤੁ ਕੀਨੑ ॥
Transliteration: baabaa maaeaa moh hit keena |
English: O Father, I have enshrined love and affection for Maya,

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਹਿਰਿ ਲੀਨੑ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jin giaan ratan hir leena |1| rahaau |
English: which has taken the jewel of spiritual wisdom away from me. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨੈਨ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਤੰਗੁ ਉਰਝੈ ਪਸੁ ਨ ਦੇਖੈ ਆਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: nain dekh patang urajhai pas na dekhai aag |
English: The moth sees with its eyes, but it still becomes entangled; the insect does not see the fire.

Gurbani: ਕਾਲ ਫਾਸ ਨ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਚੇਤੈ ਕਨਿਕ ਕਾਮਿਨਿ ਲਾਗਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kaal faas na mugadh chetai kanik kaamin laag |2|
English: Attached to gold and woman, the fool does not think of the noose of Death. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਬਿਚਾਰੁ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਤਰਨ ਤਾਰਨ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: kar bichaar bikaar parahar taran taaran soe |
English: Reflect upon this, and abandon sin; the Lord is a boat to carry you across.

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਐਸਾ ਦੁਤੀਅ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥੫॥੨੭॥
Transliteration: keh kabeer jagajeevan aisaa duteea naahee koe |3|5|27|
English: Says Kabeer, such is the Lord, the Life of the World; there is no one equal to Him. ||3||5||27||

[Ang 482 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa |
English: Aasaa:

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਮੈ ਰੂਪ ਕੀਏ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਅਬ ਫੁਨਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jau mai roop kee bahutere ab fun roop na hoee |
English: In the past, I have taken many forms, but I shall not take form again.

Gurbani: ਤਾਗਾ ਤੰਤੁ ਸਾਜੁ ਸਭੁ ਥਾਕਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਸਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: taagaa tant saaj sabh thaakaa raam naam bas hoee |1|
English: The strings and wires of the musical instrument are worn out, and I am in the power of the Lord's Name. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਾਚਨੋ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: ab mohi naachano na aavai |
English: Now, I no longer dance to the tune.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੰਦਰੀਆ ਨ ਬਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: meraa man mandareea na bajaavai |1| rahaau |
English: My mind no longer beats the drum. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਲੈ ਜਾਰੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਗਾਗਰਿ ਫੂਟੀ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh maaeaa lai jaaree trisanaa gaagar foottee |
English: I have burnt away sexual desire, anger and attachment to Maya, and the pitcher of my desires has burst.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮ ਚੋਲਨਾ ਭਇਆ ਹੈ ਪੁਰਾਨਾ ਗਇਆ ਭਰਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਛੂਟੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kaam cholanaa bheaa hai puraanaa geaa bharam sabh chhoottee |2|
English: The gown of sensuous pleasures is worn out, and all my doubts have been dispelled. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਭੂਤ ਏਕੈ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਚੂਕੇ ਬਾਦ ਬਿਬਾਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: sarab bhoot ekai kar jaaniaa chooke baad bibaadaa |
English: I look upon all beings alike, and my conflict and strife are ended.

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਮੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਭਏ ਰਾਮ ਪਰਸਾਦਾ ॥੩॥੬॥੨੮॥
Transliteration: keh kabeer mai pooraa paaeaa bhe raam parasaadaa |3|6|28|
English: Says Kabeer, when the Lord showed His Favor, I obtained Him, the Perfect One. ||3||6||28||

[Ang 483 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa |
English: Aasaa:

Gurbani: ਰੋਜਾ ਧਰੈ ਮਨਾਵੈ ਅਲਹੁ ਸੁਆਦਤਿ ਜੀਅ ਸੰਘਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: rojaa dharai manaavai alahu suaadat jeea sanghaarai |
English: You keep your fasts to please Allah, while you murder other beings for pleasure.

Gurbani: ਆਪਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਅਵਰ ਨਹੀ ਦੇਖੈ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਝਖ ਮਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aapaa dekh avar nahee dekhai kaahe kau jhakh maarai |1|
English: You look after your own interests, and so not see the interests of others. What good is your word? ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਾਜੀ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਏਕੁ ਤੋਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੋਚਿ ਬਿਚਾਰਿ ਨ ਦੇਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: kaajee saahib ek tohee meh teraa soch bichaar na dekhai |
English: O Qazi, the One Lord is within you, but you do not behold Him by thought or contemplation.

Gurbani: ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਕਰਹਿ ਦੀਨ ਕੇ ਬਉਰੇ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਲੇਖੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: khabar na kareh deen ke baure taa te janam alekhai |1| rahaau |
English: You do not care for others, you are a religious fanatic, and your life is of no account at all. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੁ ਕਤੇਬ ਬਖਾਨੈ ਅਲਹੁ ਨਾਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: saach kateb bakhaanai alahu naar purakh nahee koee |
English: Your holy scriptures say that Allah is True, and that he is neither male nor female.

Gurbani: ਪਢੇ ਗੁਨੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਬਉਰੇ ਜਉ ਦਿਲ ਮਹਿ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: padte gune naahee kachh baure jau dil meh khabar na hoee |2|
English: But you gain nothing by reading and studying, O mad-man, if you do not gain the understanding in your heart. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਲਹੁ ਗੈਬੁ ਸਗਲ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਲੇਹੁ ਬਿਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: alahu gaib sagal ghatt bheetar hiradai lehu bichaaree |
English: Allah is hidden in every heart; reflect upon this in your mind.

Gurbani: ਹਿੰਦੂ ਤੁਰਕ ਦੁਹੂੰ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੈ ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰ ਪੁਕਾਰੀ ॥੩॥੭॥੨੯॥
Transliteration: hindoo turak duhoon meh ekai kahai kabeer pukaaree |3|7|29|
English: The One Lord is within both Hindu and Muslim; Kabeer proclaims this out loud. ||3||7||29||

[Ang 483 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ॥ ਤਿਪਦਾ ॥ ਇਕਤੁਕਾ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa | tipadaa | ikatukaa |
English: Aasaa, Ti-Pada, Ik-Tuka:

Gurbani: ਕੀਓ ਸਿੰਗਾਰੁ ਮਿਲਨ ਕੇ ਤਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: keeo singaar milan ke taaee |
English: I have decorated myself to meet my Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har na mile jagajeevan gusaaee |1|
English: But the Lord, the Life of the Word, the Sustainer of the Universe, has not come to meet me. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਬਹੁਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: har mero pir hau har kee bahureea |
English: The Lord is my Husband, and I am the Lord's bride.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਬਡੇ ਮੈ ਤਨਕ ਲਹੁਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raam badde mai tanak lahureea |1| rahaau |
English: The Lord is so great, and I am infinitesimally small. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਧਨ ਪਿਰ ਏਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: dhan pir ekai sang baseraa |
English: The bride and the Groom dwell together.

Gurbani: ਸੇਜ ਏਕ ਪੈ ਮਿਲਨੁ ਦੁਹੇਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sej ek pai milan duheraa |2|
English: They lie upon the one bed, but their union is difficult. ||2||

Gurbani: ਧੰਨਿ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਜੋ ਪੀਅ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: dhan suhaagan jo peea bhaavai |
English: Blessed is the soul-bride, who is pleasing to her Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੩॥੮॥੩੦॥
Transliteration: keh kabeer fir janam na aavai |3|8|30|
English: Says Kabeer, she shall not have to be reincarnated again. ||3||8||30||

[Ang 483 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa sree kabeer jeeo ke dupade |
English: Aasaa Of Kabeer Jee, Dho-Padhay:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਹੀਰੈ ਹੀਰਾ ਬੇਧਿ ਪਵਨ ਮਨੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: heerai heeraa bedh pavan man sahaje rahiaa samaaee |
English: When the Diamond of the Lord pierces the diamond of my mind, the fickle mind waving in the wind is easily absorbed into Him.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਇਨਿ ਹੀਰੈ ਬੇਧੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਮੈ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sagal jot in heerai bedhee satigur bachanee mai paaee |1|
English: This Diamond fills all with Divine Light; through the True Guru's Teachings, I have found Him. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਅਨਾਹਦ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: har kee kathaa anaahad baanee |
English: The sermon of the Lord is the unstruck, endless song.

Gurbani: ਹੰਸੁ ਹੁਇ ਹੀਰਾ ਲੇਇ ਪਛਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hans hue heeraa lee pachhaanee |1| rahaau |
English: Becoming a swan, one recognizes the Diamond of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਹੀਰਾ ਅਸ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਜਗ ਮਹ ਰਹਾ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: keh kabeer heeraa as dekhio jag meh rahaa samaaee |
English: Says Kabeer, I have seen such a Diamond, permeating and pervading the world.

Gurbani: ਗੁਪਤਾ ਹੀਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਇਓ ਜਬ ਗੁਰ ਗਮ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥੨॥੧॥੩੧॥
Transliteration: gupataa heeraa pragatt bheo jab gur gam deea dikhaaee |2|1|31|
English: The hidden diamond became visible, when the Guru revealed it to me. ||2||1||31||

[Ang 483 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa |
English: Aasaa:

Gurbani: ਪਹਿਲੀ ਕਰੂਪਿ ਕੁਜਾਤਿ ਕੁਲਖਨੀ ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਪੇਈਐ ਬੁਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: pahilee karoop kujaat kulakhanee saahurai peeeai buree |
English: My first wife, ignorance, was ugly, of low social status and bad character; she was evil in my home, and in her parents' home.

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਕੀ ਸਰੂਪਿ ਸੁਜਾਨਿ ਸੁਲਖਨੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਉਦਰਿ ਧਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ab kee saroop sujaan sulakhanee sahaje udar dharee |1|
English: My present bride, divine understanding, is beautiful, wise and well-behaved; I have taken her to my heart. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਲੀ ਸਰੀ ਮੁਈ ਮੇਰੀ ਪਹਿਲੀ ਬਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: bhalee saree muee meree pahilee baree |
English: It has turned out so well, that my first wife has died.

Gurbani: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੀਵਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਅਬ ਕੀ ਧਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jug jug jeevau meree ab kee dharee |1| rahaau |
English: May she, whom I have now married, live throughout the ages. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਬ ਲਹੁਰੀ ਆਈ ਬਡੀ ਕਾ ਸੁਹਾਗੁ ਟਰਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer jab lahuree aaee baddee kaa suhaag ttario |
English: Says Kabeer, when the younger bride came, the elder one lost her husband.

Gurbani: ਲਹੁਰੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਭਈ ਅਬ ਮੇਰੈ ਜੇਠੀ ਅਉਰੁ ਧਰਿਓ ॥੨॥੨॥੩੨॥
Transliteration: lahuree sang bhee ab merai jetthee aaur dhario |2|2|32|
English: The younger bride is with me now, and the elder one has taken another husband. ||2||2||32||

[Ang 484 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa |
English: Aasaa:

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੀ ਬਹੁਰੀਆ ਕੋ ਧਨੀਆ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: meree bahureea ko dhaneea naau |
English: My daughter-in-law was first called Dhannia, the woman of wealth,

Gurbani: ਲੇ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਰਾਮ ਜਨੀਆ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: le raakhio raam janeea naau |1|
English: but now she is called Raam-jannia, the servant of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਇਨੑ ਮੁੰਡੀਅਨ ਮੇਰਾ ਘਰੁ ਧੁੰਧਰਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: eina munddeean meraa ghar dhundharaavaa |
English: These shaven-headed saints have ruined my house.

Gurbani: ਬਿਟਵਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਮਊਆ ਲਾਵਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bittaveh raam rmaooaa laavaa |1| rahaau |
English: They have caused my son to start chanting the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kehat kabeer sunahu meree maaee |
English: Says Kabeer, listen, O mother:

Gurbani: ਇਨੑ ਮੁੰਡੀਅਨ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੨॥੩॥੩੩॥
Transliteration: eina munddeean meree jaat gavaaee |2|3|33|
English: these shaven-headed saints have done away with my low social status. ||2||3||33||

[Ang 484 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa |
English: Aasaa:

Gurbani: ਰਹੁ ਰਹੁ ਰੀ ਬਹੁਰੀਆ ਘੂੰਘਟੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਾਢੈ ॥
Transliteration: rahu rahu ree bahureea ghoonghatt jin kaadtai |
English: Stay, stay, O daughter-in-law - do not cover your face with a veil.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਬਾਰ ਲਹੈਗੀ ਨ ਆਢੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ant kee baar lahaigee na aadtai |1| rahaau |
English: In the end, this shall not bring you even half a shell. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਘੂੰਘਟੁ ਕਾਢਿ ਗਈ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: ghoonghatt kaadt gee teree aagai |
English: The one before you used to veil her face;

Gurbani: ਉਨ ਕੀ ਗੈਲਿ ਤੋਹਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aun kee gail tohi jin laagai |1|
English: do not follow in her footsteps. ||1||

Gurbani: ਘੂੰਘਟ ਕਾਢੇ ਕੀ ਇਹੈ ਬਡਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ghoonghatt kaadte kee ihai baddaaee |
English: The only merit in veiling your face is

Gurbani: ਦਿਨ ਦਸ ਪਾਂਚ ਬਹੂ ਭਲੇ ਆਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: din das paanch bahoo bhale aaee |2|
English: that for a few days, people will say, "What a noble bride has come". ||2||

Gurbani: ਘੂੰਘਟੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਤਉ ਪਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ॥
Transliteration: ghoonghatt tero tau par saachai |
English: Your veil shall be true only if

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਕੂਦਹਿ ਅਰੁ ਨਾਚੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har gun gaae koodeh ar naachai |3|
English: you skip, dance and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਬਹੂ ਤਬ ਜੀਤੈ ॥
Transliteration: kehat kabeer bahoo tab jeetai |
English: Says Kabeer, the soul-bride shall win,

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਜਨਮੁ ਬਿਤੀਤੈ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੪॥
Transliteration: har gun gaavat janam biteetai |4|1|34|
English: only if she passes her life singing the Lord's Praises. ||4||1||34||

[Ang 484 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa |
English: Aasaa:

Gurbani: ਕਰਵਤੁ ਭਲਾ ਨ ਕਰਵਟ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: karavat bhalaa na karavatt teree |
English: I would rather be cut apart by a saw, than have You turn Your back on me.

Gurbani: ਲਾਗੁ ਗਲੇ ਸੁਨੁ ਬਿਨਤੀ ਮੇਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: laag gale sun binatee meree |1|
English: Hug me close, and listen to my prayer. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਮੁਖੁ ਫੇਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: hau vaaree mukh fer piaare |
English: I am a sacrifice to You - please, turn Your face to me, O Beloved Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਰਵਟੁ ਦੇ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: karavatt de mo kau kaahe kau maare |1| rahaau |
English: Why have You turned Your back to me? Why have You killed me? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਤਨੁ ਚੀਰਹਿ ਅੰਗੁ ਨ ਮੋਰਉ ॥
Transliteration: jau tan cheereh ang na morau |
English: Even if You cut my body apart, I shall not pull my limbs away from You.

Gurbani: ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪਰੈ ਤਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਤੋਰਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: pindd parai tau preet na torau |2|
English: Even if my body falls, I shall not break my bonds of love with You. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਬੀਚੁ ਭਇਓ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: ham tum beech bheo nahee koee |
English: Between You and I, there is no other.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮਹਿ ਸੁ ਕੰਤ ਨਾਰਿ ਹਮ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tumeh su kant naar ham soee |3|
English: You are the Husband Lord, and I am the soul-bride. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਲੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: kehat kabeer sunahu re loee |
English: Says Kabeer, listen, O people:

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੨॥੩੫॥
Transliteration: ab tumaree parateet na hoee |4|2|35|
English: now, I place no reliance in you. ||4||2||35||

[Ang 484 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa |
English: Aasaa:

Gurbani: ਕੋਰੀ ਕੋ ਕਾਹੂ ਮਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: koree ko kaahoo maram na jaanaan |
English: No one knows the secret of God, the Cosmic Weaver.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਆਨਿ ਤਨਾਇਓ ਤਾਨਾਂ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sabh jag aan tanaaeo taanaan |1| rahaau |
English: He has stretched out the fabric of the whole world. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਤੁਮ ਸੁਨਿ ਲੇ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: jab tum sun le bed puraanaan |
English: When you listen to the Vedas and the Puraanas,

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਹਮ ਇਤਨਕੁ ਪਸਰਿਓ ਤਾਨਾਂ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tab ham itanak pasario taanaan |1|
English: you shall know that the whole world is only a small piece of His woven fabric. ||1||

Gurbani: ਧਰਨਿ ਅਕਾਸ ਕੀ ਕਰਗਹ ਬਨਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: dharan akaas kee karagah banaaee |
English: He has made the earth and sky His loom.

Gurbani: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਸਾਥ ਚਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: chand sooraj due saath chalaaee |2|
English: Upon it, He moves the two bobbins of the sun and the moon. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪਾਈ ਜੋਰਿ ਬਾਤ ਇਕ ਕੀਨੀ ਤਹ ਤਾਂਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: paaee jor baat ik keenee teh taantee man maanaan |
English: Placing my feet together, I have accomplished one thing - my mind is pleased with that Weaver.

Gurbani: ਜੋਲਾਹੇ ਘਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਚੀਨੑਾਂ ਘਟ ਹੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਨਾਂ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jolaahe ghar apanaa cheenaan ghatt hee raam pachhaanaan |3|
English: I have come to understand my own home, and recognize the Lord within my heart. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਕਾਰਗਹ ਤੋਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kehat kabeer kaaragah toree |
English: Says Kabeer, when my body workshop breaks,

Gurbani: ਸੂਤੈ ਸੂਤ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਕੋਰੀ ॥੪॥੩॥੩੬॥
Transliteration: sootai soot milaae koree |4|3|36|
English: the Weaver shall blend my thread with His thread. ||4||3||36||

[Ang 484 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa |
English: Aasaa:

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਜੇ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਨ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: antar mail je teerath naavai tis baikuntth na jaanaan |
English: With filth within the heart, even if one bathes at sacred places of pilgrimage, still, he shall not go to heaven.

Gurbani: ਲੋਕ ਪਤੀਣੇ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਅਯਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: lok pateene kachhoo na hovai naahee raam ayaanaa |1|
English: Nothing is gained by trying to please others - the Lord cannot be fooled. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪੂਜਹੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੀ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: poojahu raam ek hee devaa |
English: Worship the One Divine Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਵਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saachaa naavan gur kee sevaa |1| rahaau |
English: The true cleansing bath is service to the Guru. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਲ ਕੈ ਮਜਨਿ ਜੇ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਮੇਂਡੁਕ ਨਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jal kai majan je gat hovai nit nit mendduk naaveh |
English: If salvation can be obtained by bathing in water, then what about the frog, which is always bathing in water?

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੇ ਮੇਂਡੁਕ ਤੈਸੇ ਓਇ ਨਰ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਆਵਹਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jaise mendduk taise oe nar fir fir jonee aaveh |2|
English: As is the frog, so is that mortal; he is reincarnated, over and over again. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨਹੁ ਕਠੋਰੁ ਮਰੈ ਬਾਨਾਰਸਿ ਨਰਕੁ ਨ ਬਾਂਚਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: manahu katthor marai baanaaras narak na baanchiaa jaaee |
English: If the hard-hearted sinner dies in Benaares, he cannot escape hell.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਹਾੜੰਬੈ ਤ ਸਗਲੀ ਸੈਨ ਤਰਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har kaa sant marai haarranbai ta sagalee sain taraaee |3|
English: And even if the Lord's Saint dies in the cursed land of Haramba, still, he saves all his family. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਨ ਰੈਨਿ ਬੇਦੁ ਨਹੀ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਤਹਾ ਬਸੈ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: dinas na rain bed nahee saasatr tahaa basai nirankaaraa |
English: Where there is neither day nor night, and neither Vedas nor Shaastras, there, the Formless Lord abides.

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਨਰ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਬਾਵਰਿਆ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੪॥੩੭॥
Transliteration: keh kabeer nar tiseh dhiaavahu baavariaa sansaaraa |4|4|37|
English: Says Kabeer, meditate on Him, O mad-men of the world. ||4||4||37||

[Ang 485 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Namdev Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਬਾਣੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa baanee sree naamadeo jee kee |
English: Aasaa, The Word Of The Reverend Naam Dayv Jee:

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਅਨੇਕ ਬਿਆਪਕ ਪੂਰਕ ਜਤ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਤ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: ek anek biaapak poorak jat dekhau tat soee |
English: In the one and in the many, He is pervading and permeating; wherever I look, there He is.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਬਿਮੋਹਿਤ ਬਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: maaeaa chitr bachitr bimohit biralaa boojhai koee |1|
English: The marvellous image of Maya is so fascinating; how few understand this. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: sabh gobind hai sabh gobind hai gobind bin nahee koee |
English: God is everything, God is everything. Without God, there is nothing at all.

Gurbani: ਸੂਤੁ ਏਕੁ ਮਣਿ ਸਤ ਸਹੰਸ ਜੈਸੇ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: soot ek man sat sahans jaise ot pot prabh soee |1| rahaau |
English: As one thread holds hundreds and thousands of beads, He is woven into His creation. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਲ ਤਰੰਗ ਅਰੁ ਫੇਨ ਬੁਦਬੁਦਾ ਜਲ ਤੇ ਭਿੰਨ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jal tarang ar fen budabudaa jal te bhin na hoee |
English: The waves of the water, the foam and bubbles, are not distinct from the water.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਲੀਲਾ ਬਿਚਰਤ ਆਨ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: eihu parapanch paarabraham kee leelaa bicharat aan na hoee |2|
English: This manifested world is the playful game of the Supreme Lord God; reflecting upon it, we find that it is not different from Him. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਭਰਮੁ ਅਰੁ ਸੁਪਨ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਸਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: mithiaa bharam ar supan manorath sat padaarath jaaniaa |
English: False doubts and dream objects - man believes them to be true.

Gurbani: ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਮਨਸਾ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੀ ਜਾਗਤ ਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sukrit manasaa gur upadesee jaagat hee man maaniaa |3|
English: The Guru has instructed me to try to do good deeds, and my awakened mind has accepted this. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kehat naamadeo har kee rachanaa dekhahu ridai beechaaree |
English: Says Naam Dayv, see the Creation of the Lord, and reflect upon it in your heart.

Gurbani: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਕੇਵਲ ਏਕ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt antar sarab nirantar keval ek muraaree |4|1|
English: In each and every heart, and deep within the very nucleus of all, is the One Lord. ||4||1||

[Ang 485 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Namdev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa |
English: Aasaa:

Gurbani: ਆਨੀਲੇ ਕੁੰਭ ਭਰਾਈਲੇ ਊਦਕ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਉ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰਉ ॥
Transliteration: aaneele kunbh bharaaeele aoodak tthaakur kau isanaan krau |
English: Bringing the pitcher, I fill it with water, to bathe the Lord.

Gurbani: ਬਇਆਲੀਸ ਲਖ ਜੀ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਤੇ ਬੀਠਲੁ ਭੈਲਾ ਕਾਇ ਕਰਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: beaalees lakh jee jal meh hote beetthal bhailaa kaae krau |1|
English: But 4.2 million species of beings are in the water - how can I use it for the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny? ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਤ੍ਰ ਜਾਉ ਤਤ ਬੀਠਲੁ ਭੈਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: jatr jaau tat beetthal bhailaa |
English: Wherever I go, the Lord is there.

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਕਰੇ ਸਦ ਕੇਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mahaa anand kare sad kelaa |1| rahaau |
English: He continually plays in supreme bliss. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਨੀਲੇ ਫੂਲ ਪਰੋਈਲੇ ਮਾਲਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੀ ਹਉ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਉ ॥
Transliteration: aaneele fool paroeele maalaa tthaakur kee hau pooj krau |
English: I bring flowers to weave a garland, in worshipful adoration of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਪਹਿਲੇ ਬਾਸੁ ਲਈ ਹੈ ਭਵਰਹ ਬੀਠਲ ਭੈਲਾ ਕਾਇ ਕਰਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: pahile baas lee hai bhavarah beetthal bhailaa kaae krau |2|
English: But the bumble bee has already sucked out the fragrance - how can I use it for the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny? ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਨੀਲੇ ਦੂਧੁ ਰੀਧਾਈਲੇ ਖੀਰੰ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਉ ਨੈਵੇਦੁ ਕਰਉ ॥
Transliteration: aaneele doodh reedhaaeele kheeran tthaakur kau naived krau |
English: I carry milk and cook it to make pudding, with which to feed the Lord.

Gurbani: ਪਹਿਲੇ ਦੂਧੁ ਬਿਟਾਰਿਓ ਬਛਰੈ ਬੀਠਲੁ ਭੈਲਾ ਕਾਇ ਕਰਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: pahile doodh bittaario bachharai beetthal bhailaa kaae krau |3|
English: But the calf has already tasted the milk - how can I use it for the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny? ||3||

Gurbani: ਈਭੈ ਬੀਠਲੁ ਊਭੈ ਬੀਠਲੁ ਬੀਠਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਨਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: eebhai beetthal aoobhai beetthal beetthal bin sansaar nahee |
English: The Lord is here, the Lord is there; without the Lord, there is no world at all.

Gurbani: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਤੂੰ ਸਰਬ ਮਹੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: thaan thanantar naamaa pranavai poor rahio toon sarab mahee |4|2|
English: Prays Naam Dayv, O Lord, You are totally permeating and pervading all places and interspaces. ||4||2||

[Ang 485 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Namdev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa |
English: Aasaa:

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰੋ ਗਜੁ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: man mero gaj jihabaa meree kaatee |
English: My mind is the yardstick, and my tongue is the scissors.

Gurbani: ਮਪਿ ਮਪਿ ਕਾਟਉ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: map map kaattau jam kee faasee |1|
English: I measure it out and cut off the noose of death. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਹਾ ਕਰਉ ਜਾਤੀ ਕਹ ਕਰਉ ਪਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: kahaa krau jaatee keh krau paatee |
English: What do I have to do with social status? What do I have to with ancestry?

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਉ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raam ko naam jpau din raatee |1| rahaau |
English: I meditate on the Name of the Lord, day and night. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਰਾਂਗਨਿ ਰਾਂਗਉ ਸੀਵਨਿ ਸੀਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: raangan raangau seevan seevau |
English: I dye myself in the color of the Lord, and sew what has to be sewn.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਘਰੀਅ ਨ ਜੀਵਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: raam naam bin ghareea na jeevau |2|
English: Without the Lord's Name, I cannot live, even for a moment. ||2||

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਉ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat krau har ke gun gaavau |
English: I perform devotional worship, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਅਪਨਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar apanaa khasam dhiaavau |3|
English: Twenty-four hours a day, I meditate on my Lord and Master. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੁਇਨੇ ਕੀ ਸੂਈ ਰੁਪੇ ਕਾ ਧਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: sueine kee sooee rupe kaa dhaagaa |
English: My needle is gold, and my thread is silver.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੇ ਕਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਉ ਲਾਗਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
Transliteration: naame kaa chit har sau laagaa |4|3|
English: Naam Dayv's mind is attached to the Lord. ||4||3||

[Ang 485 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Namdev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa |
English: Aasaa:

Gurbani: ਸਾਪੁ ਕੁੰਚ ਛੋਡੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਛਾਡੈ ॥
Transliteration: saap kunch chhoddai bikh nahee chhaaddai |
English: The snake sheds its skin, but does not lose its venom.

Gurbani: ਉਦਕ ਮਾਹਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਗੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਮਾਡੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: audak maeh jaise bag dhiaan maaddai |1|
English: The heron appears to be meditating, but it is concentrating on the water. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਕੀਜੈ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਜਪੰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaahe kau keejai dhiaan japanaa |
English: Why do you practice meditation and chanting,

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਸੁਧੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jab te sudh naahee man apanaa |1| rahaau |
English: when your mind is not pure? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਿੰਘਚ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: singhach bhojan jo nar jaanai |
English: That man who feeds like a lion,

Gurbani: ਐਸੇ ਹੀ ਠਗਦੇਉ ਬਖਾਨੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aise hee tthagadeo bakhaanai |2|
English: is called the god of thieves. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੇ ਕੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਲਾਹਿ ਲੇ ਝਗਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: naame ke suaamee laeh le jhagaraa |
English: Naam Dayv's Lord and Master has settled my inner conflicts.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਨ ਪੀਓ ਰੇ ਦਗਰਾ ॥੩॥੪॥
Transliteration: raam rasaaein peeo re dagaraa |3|4|
English: Drink in the sublime elixir of the Lord, O deceitful one. ||3||4||

[Ang 486 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Namdev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa |
English: Aasaa:

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਿ ਚੀਨੑਸੀ ਆਸਾ ਤੇ ਨ ਭਾਵਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham ji cheenasee aasaa te na bhaavasee |
English: One who recognizes the Supreme Lord God, dislikes other desires.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮਾ ਭਗਤਹ ਚੇਤੀਅਲੇ ਅਚਿੰਤ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖਸੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: raamaa bhagatah cheteeale achint man raakhasee |1|
English: He focuses his consciousness on the Lord's devotional worship, and keeps his mind free of anxiety. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕੈਸੇ ਮਨ ਤਰਹਿਗਾ ਰੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਬਿਖੈ ਕੋ ਬਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaise man tarahigaa re sansaar saagar bikhai ko banaa |
English: O my mind, how will you cross over the world-ocean, if you are filled with the water of corruption?

Gurbani: ਝੂਠੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ ਭੂਲਾ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jhootthee maaeaa dekh kai bhoolaa re manaa |1| rahaau |
English: Gazing upon the falseness of Maya, you have gone astray, O my mind. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਛੀਪੇ ਕੇ ਘਰਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਦੈਲਾ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਭੈਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: chheepe ke ghar janam dailaa gur upades bhailaa |
English: You have given me birth in the house of a calico-printer, but I have found the Teachings of the Guru.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਹ ਕੈ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟੁਲਾ ॥੨॥੫॥
Transliteration: santah kai parasaad naamaa har bhettulaa |2|5|
English: By the Grace of the Saint, Naam Dayv has met the Lord. ||2||5||

[Ang 486 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Ravidas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਬਾਣੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa baanee sree ravidaas jeeo kee |
English: Aasaa, The Word Of The Reverend Ravi Daas Jee:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਮੀਨ ਭ੍ਰਿੰਗ ਪਤੰਗ ਕੁੰਚਰ ਏਕ ਦੋਖ ਬਿਨਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: mrig meen bhring patang kunchar ek dokh binaas |
English: The deer, the fish, the bumble bee, the moth and the elephant are destroyed, each for a single defect.

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਦੋਖ ਅਸਾਧ ਜਾ ਮਹਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੇਤਕ ਆਸ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: panch dokh asaadh jaa meh taa kee ketak aas |1|
English: So the one who is filled with the five incurable vices - what hope is there for him? ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਾਧੋ ਅਬਿਦਿਆ ਹਿਤ ਕੀਨ ॥
Transliteration: maadho abidiaa hit keen |
English: O Lord, he is in love with ignorance.

Gurbani: ਬਿਬੇਕ ਦੀਪ ਮਲੀਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bibek deep maleen |1| rahaau |
English: His lamp of clear wisdom has grown dim. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਗਦ ਜੋਨਿ ਅਚੇਤ ਸੰਭਵ ਪੁੰਨ ਪਾਪ ਅਸੋਚ ॥
Transliteration: trigad jon achet sanbhav pun paap asoch |
English: The creeping creatures live thoughtless lives, and cannot discriminate between good and evil.

Gurbani: ਮਾਨੁਖਾ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਦੁਲਭ ਤਿਹੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪੋਚ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: maanukhaa avataar dulabh tihee sangat poch |2|
English: It is so difficult to obtain this human incarnation, and yet, they keep company with the low. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਜਹਾ ਜਹਾ ਲਗੁ ਕਰਮ ਕੇ ਬਸਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jant jahaa jahaa lag karam ke bas jaae |
English: Wherever the beings and creatures are, they are born according to the karma of their past actions.

Gurbani: ਕਾਲ ਫਾਸ ਅਬਧ ਲਾਗੇ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਉਪਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kaal faas abadh laage kachh na chalai upaae |3|
English: The noose of death is unforgiving, and it shall catch them; it cannot be warded off. ||3||

Gurbani: ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਦਾਸ ਉਦਾਸ ਤਜੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਤਪਨ ਤਪੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ॥
Transliteration: ravidaas daas udaas taj bhram tapan tap gur giaan |
English: O servant Ravi Daas, dispel your sorrow and doubt, and know that Guru-given spiritual wisdom is the penance of penances.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤ ਜਨ ਭੈ ਹਰਨ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ ਕਰਹੁ ਨਿਦਾਨ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: bhagat jan bhai haran paramaanand karahu nidaan |4|1|
English: O Lord, Destroyer of the fears of Your humble devotees, make me supremely blissful in the end. ||4||1||

[Ang 486 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Ravidas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa |
English: Aasaa:

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਤੁਝੀ ਤਨੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: sant tujhee tan sangat praan |
English: Your Saints are Your body, and their company is Your breath of life.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਸੰਤ ਦੇਵਾ ਦੇਵ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: satigur giaan jaanai sant devaa dev |1|
English: By the True Guru-given spiritual wisdom, I know the Saints as the gods of gods. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਚੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੰਤ ਕਥਾ ਰਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: sant chee sangat sant kathaa ras |
English: O Lord, God of gods, grant me the Society of the Saints,

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਮਾਝੈ ਦੀਜੈ ਦੇਵਾ ਦੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sant prem maajhai deejai devaa dev |1| rahaau |
English: The sublime essence of the Saints' conversation, and the Love of the Saints. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਆਚਰਣ ਸੰਤ ਚੋ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਸੰਤ ਚ ਓਲ੍ਹਗ ਓਲ੍ਹਗਣੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sant aacharan sant cho maarag sant ch olhag olhaganee |2|
English: The Character of the Saints, the lifestyle of the Saints, and the service of the servant of the Saints. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਉਰ ਇਕ ਮਾਗਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਣਿ ॥
Transliteration: aaur ik maagau bhagat chintaaman |
English: I ask for these, and for one thing more - devotional worship, which shall fulfill my desires.

Gurbani: ਜਣੀ ਲਖਾਵਹੁ ਅਸੰਤ ਪਾਪੀ ਸਣਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: janee lakhaavahu asant paapee san |3|
English: Do not show me the wicked sinners. ||3||

Gurbani: ਰਵਿਦਾਸੁ ਭਣੈ ਜੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: ravidaas bhanai jo jaanai so jaan |
English: Says Ravi Daas, he alone is wise, who knows this:

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਅਨੰਤਹਿ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: sant ananteh antar naahee |4|2|
English: there is no difference between the Saints and the Infinite Lord. ||4||2||

[Ang 486 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Ravidas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa |
English: Aasaa:

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਚੰਦਨ ਹਮ ਇਰੰਡ ਬਾਪੁਰੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਬਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: tum chandan ham irandd baapure sang tumaare baasaa |
English: You are sandalwood, and I am the poor castor oil plant, dwelling close to you.

Gurbani: ਨੀਚ ਰੂਖ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਗੰਧ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: neech rookh te aooch bhe hai gandh sugandh nivaasaa |1|
English: From a lowly tree, I have become exalted; Your fragrance, Your exquisite fragrance now permeates me. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਾਧਉ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: maadhau satasangat saran tumaaree |
English: O Lord, I seek the Sanctuary of the company of Your Saints;

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਅਉਗਨ ਤੁਮੑ ਉਪਕਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ham aaugan tuma upakaaree |1| rahaau |
English: I am worthless, and You are so benevolent. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਮਖਤੂਲ ਸੁਪੇਦ ਸਪੀਅਲ ਹਮ ਬਪੁਰੇ ਜਸ ਕੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: tum makhatool suped sapeeal ham bapure jas keeraa |
English: You are the white and yellow threads of silk, and I am like a poor worm.

Gurbani: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਮਾਧਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਮਧੁਪ ਮਖੀਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: satasangat mil raheeai maadhau jaise madhup makheeraa |2|
English: O Lord, I seek to live in the Company of the Saints, like the bee with its honey. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਾਤੀ ਓਛਾ ਪਾਤੀ ਓਛਾ ਓਛਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaatee ochhaa paatee ochhaa ochhaa janam hamaaraa |
English: My social status is low, my ancestry is low, and my birth is low as well.

Gurbani: ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਕੀਨੀ ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਚਮਾਰਾ ॥੩॥੩॥
Transliteration: raajaa raam kee sev na keenee keh ravidaas chamaaraa |3|3|
English: I have not performed the service of the Lord, the Lord, says Ravi Daas the cobbler. ||3||3||

[Ang 486 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Ravidas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa |
English: Aasaa:

Gurbani: ਕਹਾ ਭਇਓ ਜਉ ਤਨੁ ਭਇਓ ਛਿਨੁ ਛਿਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: kahaa bheo jau tan bheo chhin chhin |
English: What would it matter, if my body were cut into pieces?

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਜਾਇ ਤਉ ਡਰਪੈ ਤੇਰੋ ਜਨੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: prem jaae tau ddarapai tero jan |1|
English: If I were to lose Your Love, Lord, then Your humble servant would be afraid. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੁਝਹਿ ਚਰਨ ਅਰਬਿੰਦ ਭਵਨ ਮਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: tujheh charan arabind bhavan man |
English: Your lotus feet are the home of my mind.

Gurbani: ਪਾਨ ਕਰਤ ਪਾਇਓ ਪਾਇਓ ਰਾਮਈਆ ਧਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: paan karat paaeo paaeo raameea dhan |1| rahaau |
