English: Drinking in Your Nectar, I have obtained the wealth of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੰਪਤਿ ਬਿਪਤਿ ਪਟਲ ਮਾਇਆ ਧਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: sanpat bipat pattal maaeaa dhan |
English: Prosperity, adversity, property and wealth are just Maya.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਮਗਨ ਹੋਤ ਨ ਤੇਰੋ ਜਨੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: taa meh magan hot na tero jan |2|
English: Your humble servant is not engrossed in them. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੀ ਜੇਵਰੀ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਤੇਰੋ ਜਨ ॥
Transliteration: prem kee jevaree baadhio tero jan |
English: Your humble servant is tied by the rope of Your Love.

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਛੂਟਿਬੋ ਕਵਨ ਗੁਨ ॥੩॥੪॥
Transliteration: keh ravidaas chhoottibo kavan gun |3|4|
English: Says Ravi Daas, what benefit would I get by escaping from it? ||3||4||

[Ang 487 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Ravidas Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa |
English: Aasaa:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har har har har har har hare |
English: The Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har, Har, Har, Haray.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਜਨ ਗਏ ਨਿਸਤਰਿ ਤਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har simarat jan ge nisatar tare |1| rahaau |
English: Meditating on the Lord, the humble are carried across to salvation. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕਬੀਰ ਉਜਾਗਰ ॥
Transliteration: har ke naam kabeer ujaagar |
English: Through the Lord's Name, Kabeer became famous and respected.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਾਟੇ ਕਾਗਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: janam janam ke kaatte kaagar |1|
English: The accounts of his past incarnations were torn up. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਿਮਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਦੂਧੁ ਪੀਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: nimat naamadeo doodh peeaeaa |
English: Because of Naam Dayv's devotion, the Lord drank the milk he offered.

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਜਗ ਜਨਮ ਸੰਕਟ ਨਹੀ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tau jag janam sankatt nahee aaeaa |2|
English: He shall not have to suffer the pains of reincarnation into the world again. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: jan ravidaas raam rang raataa |
English: Servant Ravi Daas is imbued with the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਇਉ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਰਕ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੩॥੫॥
Transliteration: eiau gur parasaad narak nahee jaataa |3|5|
English: By Guru's Grace, he shall not have to go to hell. ||3||5||

Gurbani: ਮਾਟੀ ਕੋ ਪੁਤਰਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਨਚਤੁ ਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: maattee ko putaraa kaise nachat hai |
English: How does the puppet of clay dance?

Gurbani: ਦੇਖੈ ਦੇਖੈ ਸੁਨੈ ਬੋਲੈ ਦਉਰਿਓ ਫਿਰਤੁ ਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dekhai dekhai sunai bolai daurio firat hai |1| rahaau |
English: He looks and listens, hears and speaks, and runs around. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਕਛੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਤਬ ਗਰਬੁ ਕਰਤੁ ਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: jab kachh paavai tab garab karat hai |
English: When he acquires something, he is inflated with ego.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਗਈ ਤਬ ਰੋਵਨੁ ਲਗਤੁ ਹੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: maaeaa gee tab rovan lagat hai |1|
English: But when his wealth is gone, then he cries and bewails. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਰਸ ਕਸਹਿ ਲੁਭਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: man bach kram ras kaseh lubhaanaa |
English: In thought, word and deed, he is attached to the sweet and tangy flavors.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਸਿ ਗਇਆ ਜਾਇ ਕਹੂੰ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: binas geaa jaae kahoon samaanaa |2|
English: When he dies, no one knows where he has gone. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਬਾਜੀ ਜਗੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: keh ravidaas baajee jag bhaaee |
English: Says Ravi Daas, the world is just a dramatic play, O Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਬਾਜੀਗਰ ਸਉ ਮੋੁਹਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥੩॥੬॥
Transliteration: baajeegar sau muohi preet ban aaee |3|6|
English: I have enshrined love for the Lord, the star of the show. ||3||6||

[Ang 487 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Dhanna Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਧੰਨੇ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa baanee bhagat dhane jee kee |
English: Aasaa, The Word Of Devotee Dhanna Jee:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਬਹੁ ਜਨਮ ਬਿਲਾਨੇ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਧੀਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: bhramat firat bahu janam bilaane tan man dhan nahee dheere |
English: I wandered through countless incarnations, but mind, body and wealth never remain stable.

Gurbani: ਲਾਲਚ ਬਿਖੁ ਕਾਮ ਲੁਬਧ ਰਾਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਬਿਸਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹੀਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: laalach bikh kaam lubadh raataa man bisare prabh heere |1| rahaau |
English: Attached to, and stained by the poisons of sexual desire and greed, the mind has forgotten the jewel of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਿਖੁ ਫਲ ਮੀਠ ਲਗੇ ਮਨ ਬਉਰੇ ਚਾਰ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: bikh fal meetth lage man baure chaar bichaar na jaaniaa |
English: The poisonous fruit seems sweet to the demented mind, which does not know the difference between good and evil.

Gurbani: ਗੁਨ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਢੀ ਅਨ ਭਾਂਤੀ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਫਿਰਿ ਤਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gun te preet badtee an bhaantee janam maran fir taaniaa |1|
English: Turning away from virtue, his love for other things increases, and he weaves again the web of birth and death. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜਾਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਜਲਤ ਜਾਲ ਜਮ ਫੰਧ ਪਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jugat jaan nahee ridai nivaasee jalat jaal jam fandh pare |
English: He does not know the way to the Lord, who dwells within his heart; burning in the trap, he is caught by the noose of death.

Gurbani: ਬਿਖੁ ਫਲ ਸੰਚਿ ਭਰੇ ਮਨ ਐਸੇ ਪਰਮ ਪੁਰਖ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਨ ਬਿਸਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bikh fal sanch bhare man aise param purakh prabh man bisare |2|
English: Gathering the poisonous fruits, he fills his mind with them, and he forgets God, the Supreme Being, from his mind. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸੁ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਧਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਮਨ ਏਕ ਮਏ ॥
Transliteration: giaan praves gureh dhan deea dhiaan maan man ek me |
English: The Guru has given the wealth of spiritual wisdom; practicing meditation, the mind becomes one with Him.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਮਾਨੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਨੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: prem bhagat maanee sukh jaaniaa tripat aghaane mukat bhe |3|
English: Embracing loving devotional worship for the Lord, I have come to know peace; satisfied and satiated, I have been liberated. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਸਮਾਨੀ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅਛਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਹਿਚਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jot samaae samaanee jaa kai achhalee prabh pahichaaniaa |
English: One who is filled with the Divine Light, recognizes the undeceivable Lord God.

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੈ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਧਰਣੀਧਰੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਨ ਸੰਤ ਸਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: dhanai dhan paaeaa dharaneedhar mil jan sant samaaniaa |4|1|
English: Dhanna has obtained the Lord, the Sustainer of the World, as his wealth; meeting the humble Saints, he merges in the Lord. ||4||1||

[Ang 487 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: gobind gobind gobind sang naamadeo man leenaa |
English: Naam Dayv's mind was absorbed into God, Gobind, Gobind, Gobind.

Gurbani: ਆਢ ਦਾਮ ਕੋ ਛੀਪਰੋ ਹੋਇਓ ਲਾਖੀਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aadt daam ko chheeparo hoeo laakheenaa |1| rahaau |
English: The calico-printer, worth half a shell, became worth millions. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬੁਨਨਾ ਤਨਨਾ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਚਰਨ ਕਬੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: bunanaa tananaa tiaag kai preet charan kabeeraa |
English: Abandoning weaving and stretching thread, Kabeer enshrined love for the Lord's lotus feet.

Gurbani: ਨੀਚ ਕੁਲਾ ਜੋਲਾਹਰਾ ਭਇਓ ਗੁਨੀਯ ਗਹੀਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: neech kulaa jolaaharaa bheo guneey gaheeraa |1|
English: A weaver from a lowly family, he became an ocean of excellence. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਵਿਦਾਸੁ ਢੁਵੰਤਾ ਢੋਰ ਨੀਤਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: ravidaas dtuvantaa dtor neet tin tiaagee maaeaa |
English: Ravi Daas, who used to carry dead cows every day, renounced the world of Maya.

Gurbani: ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: paragatt hoaa saadhasang har darasan paaeaa |2|
English: He became famous in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and obtained the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੈਨੁ ਨਾਈ ਬੁਤਕਾਰੀਆ ਓਹੁ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਸੁਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sain naaee butakaareea ohu ghar ghar suniaa |
English: Sain, the barber, the village drudge, became famous in each and every house.

Gurbani: ਹਿਰਦੇ ਵਸਿਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਭਗਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਗਨਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: hirade vasiaa paarabraham bhagataa meh ganiaa |3|
English: The Supreme Lord God dwelled in his heart, and he was counted among the devotees. ||3||

Gurbani: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਕੈ ਜਾਟਰੋ ਉਠਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: eih bidh sun kai jaattaro utth bhagatee laagaa |
English: Hearing this, Dhanna the Jaat applied himself to devotional worship.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਖਿ ਗੁਸਾਈਆ ਧੰਨਾ ਵਡਭਾਗਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: mile pratakh gusaaeea dhanaa vaddabhaagaa |4|2|
English: The Lord of the Universe met him personally; Dhanna was so very blessed. ||4||2||

[Ang 488 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Bhagat Dhanna Ji]
Gurbani: ਰੇ ਚਿਤ ਚੇਤਸਿ ਕੀ ਨ ਦਯਾਲ ਦਮੋਦਰ ਬਿਬਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਨਸਿ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: re chit chetas kee na dayaal damodar bibeh na jaanas koee |
English: O my consciousness, why don't you remain conscious of the Merciful Lord? How can you recognize any other?

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਧਾਵਹਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਕਉ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: je dhaaveh brahamandd khandd kau karataa karai su hoee |1| rahaau |
English: You may run around the whole universe, but that alone happens which the Creator Lord does. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਨਨੀ ਕੇਰੇ ਉਦਰ ਉਦਕ ਮਹਿ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਕੀਆ ਦਸ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jananee kere udar udak meh pindd keea das duaaraa |
English: In the water of the mother's womb, He fashioned the body with ten gates.

Gurbani: ਦੇਇ ਅਹਾਰੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਐਸਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dee ahaar agan meh raakhai aisaa khasam hamaaraa |1|
English: He gives it sustenance, and preserves it in fire - such is my Lord and Master. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕੁੰਮੀ ਜਲ ਮਾਹਿ ਤਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਪੰਖ ਖੀਰੁ ਤਿਨ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: kunmee jal maeh tan tis baahar pankh kheer tin naahee |
English: The mother turtle is in the water, and her babies are out of the water. She has no wings to protect them, and no milk to feed them.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ ਮਨੋਹਰ ਸਮਝਿ ਦੇਖੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: pooran paramaanand manohar samajh dekh man maahee |2|
English: The Perfect Lord, the embodiment of supreme bliss, the Fascinating Lord takes care of them. See this, and understand it in your mind||2||

Gurbani: ਪਾਖਣਿ ਕੀਟੁ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਹੋਇ ਰਹਤਾ ਤਾ ਚੋ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: paakhan keett gupat hoe rahataa taa cho maarag naahee |
English: The worm lies hidden under the stone - there is no way for him to escape.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਧੰਨਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਤਾਹੂ ਕੋ ਮਤ ਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਡਰਾਂਹੀ ॥੩॥੩॥
Transliteration: kahai dhanaa pooran taahoo ko mat re jeea ddaraanhee |3|3|
English: Says Dhanna, the Perfect Lord takes care of him. Fear not, O my soul. ||3||3||

[Ang 488 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Sheikh Farid Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa sekh fareed jeeo kee baanee |
English: Aasaa, The Word Of Shaykh Fareed Jee:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਦਿਲਹੁ ਮੁਹਬਤਿ ਜਿੰਨੑ ਸੇਈ ਸਚਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: dilahu muhabat jina seee sachiaa |
English: They alone are true, whose love for God is deep and heart-felt.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਰੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਰੁ ਸਿ ਕਾਂਢੇ ਕਚਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jina man hor mukh hor si kaandte kachiaa |1|
English: Those who have one thing in their heart, and something else in their mouth, are judged to be false. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਤੇ ਇਸਕ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਰੰਗਿ ਦੀਦਾਰ ਕੇ ॥
Transliteration: rate isak khudaae rang deedaar ke |
English: Those who are imbued with love for the Lord, are delighted by His Vision.

Gurbani: ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਜਿਨੑ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇ ਭੁਇ ਭਾਰੁ ਥੀਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: visariaa jina naam te bhue bhaar thee |1| rahaau |
English: Those who forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are a burden on the earth. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਲੀਏ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ਦਰਿ ਦਰਵੇਸ ਸੇ ॥
Transliteration: aap lee larr laae dar daraves se |
English: Those whom the Lord attaches to the hem of His robe, are the true dervishes at His Door.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਣੇਦੀ ਮਾਉ ਆਏ ਸਫਲੁ ਸੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tin dhan janedee maau aae safal se |2|
English: Blessed are the mothers who gave birth to them, and fruitful is their coming into the world. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪਰਵਦਗਾਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਗਮ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਤੂ ॥
Transliteration: paravadagaar apaar agam beant too |
English: O Lord, Sustainer and Cherisher, You are infinite, unfathomable and endless.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਾ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਚੁੰਮਾ ਪੈਰ ਮੂੰ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jinaa pachhaataa sach chunmaa pair moon |3|
English: Those who recognize the True Lord - I kiss their feet. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੀ ਪਨਹ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਤੂ ਬਖਸੰਦਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: teree panah khudaae too bakhasandagee |
English: I seek Your Protection - You are the Forgiving Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦੈ ਖੈਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਬੰਦਗੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: sekh fareedai khair deejai bandagee |4|1|
English: Please, bless Shaykh Fareed with the bounty of Your meditative worship. ||4||1||

[Ang 488 | Raag: Raag Aasaa | Author: Sheikh Farid Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa |
English: Aasaa:

Gurbani: ਬੋਲੈ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਅਲਹ ਲਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: bolai sekh fareed piaare alah lage |
English: Says Shaykh Fareed, O my dear friend, attach yourself to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਸੀ ਖਾਕ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਗੋਰ ਘਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: eihu tan hosee khaak nimaanee gor ghare |1|
English: This body shall turn to dust, and its home shall be a neglected graveyard. ||1||

Gurbani: ਆਜੁ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਟਾਕਿਮ ਕੂੰਜੜੀਆ ਮਨਹੁ ਮਚਿੰਦੜੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aaj milaavaa sekh fareed ttaakim koonjarreea manahu machindarreea |1| rahaau |
English: You can meet the Lord today, O Shaykh Fareed, if you restrain your bird-like desires which keep your mind in turmoil. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਜਾਣਾ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਘੁਮਿ ਨ ਆਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: je jaanaa mar jaaeeai ghum na aaeeai |
English: If I had known that I was to die, and not return again,

Gurbani: ਝੂਠੀ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਲਗਿ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਵਞਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jhootthee duneea lag na aap vayaaeeai |2|
English: I would not have ruined myself by clinging to the world of falsehood. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬੋਲੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਨ ਬੋਲੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: boleeai sach dharam jhootth na boleeai |
English: So speak the Truth, in righteousness, and do not speak falsehood.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਸੈ ਵਾਟ ਮੁਰੀਦਾ ਜੋਲੀਐ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jo gur dasai vaatt mureedaa joleeai |3|
English: The disciple ought to travel the route, pointed out by the Guru. ||3||

Gurbani: ਛੈਲ ਲੰਘੰਦੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਗੋਰੀ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: chhail langhande paar goree man dheeriaa |
English: Seeing the youths being carried across, the hearts of the beautiful young soul-brides are encouraged.

Gurbani: ਕੰਚਨ ਵੰਨੇ ਪਾਸੇ ਕਲਵਤਿ ਚੀਰਿਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: kanchan vane paase kalavat cheeriaa |4|
English: Those who side with the glitter of gold, are cut down with a saw. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸੇਖ ਹੈਯਾਤੀ ਜਗਿ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਥਿਰੁ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sekh haiyaatee jag na koee thir rahiaa |
English: O Shaykh, no one's life is permanent in this world.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਸਣਿ ਹਮ ਬੈਠੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਬੈਸਿ ਗਇਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: jis aasan ham baitthe kete bais geaa |5|
English: That seat, upon which we now sit - many others sat on it and have since departed. ||5||

Gurbani: ਕਤਿਕ ਕੂੰਜਾਂ ਚੇਤਿ ਡਉ ਸਾਵਣਿ ਬਿਜੁਲੀਆਂ ॥
Transliteration: katik koonjaan chet ddau saavan bijuleean |
English: As the swallows appear in the month of Katik, forest fires in the month of Chayt, and lightning in Saawan,

Gurbani: ਸੀਆਲੇ ਸੋਹੰਦੀਆਂ ਪਿਰ ਗਲਿ ਬਾਹੜੀਆਂ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: seeaale sohandeean pir gal baaharreean |6|
English: and as the bride's arms adorn her husband's neck in winter;||6||

Gurbani: ਚਲੇ ਚਲਣਹਾਰ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ਲੇਇ ਮਨੋ ॥
Transliteration: chale chalanahaar vichaaraa lee mano |
English: Just so, the transitory human bodies pass away. Reflect upon this in your mind.

Gurbani: ਗੰਢੇਦਿਆਂ ਛਿਅ ਮਾਹ ਤੁੜੰਦਿਆ ਹਿਕੁ ਖਿਨੋ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: gandtediaan chhia maah turrandiaa hik khino |7|
English: It takes six months to form the body, but it breaks in an instant. ||7||

Gurbani: ਜਿਮੀ ਪੁਛੈ ਅਸਮਾਨ ਫਰੀਦਾ ਖੇਵਟ ਕਿੰਨਿ ਗਏ ॥
Transliteration: jimee puchhai asamaan fareedaa khevatt kin ge |
English: O Fareed, the earth asks the sky, "Where have the boatmen gone?"

Gurbani: ਜਾਲਣ ਗੋਰਾਂ ਨਾਲਿ ਉਲਾਮੇ ਜੀਅ ਸਹੇ ॥੮॥੨॥
Transliteration: jaalan goraan naal ulaame jeea sahe |8|2|
English: Some have been cremated, and some lie in their graves; their souls are suffering rebukes. ||8||2||

[Ang 489 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirbhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibhan gur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raag goojaree mahalaa 1 chaupade ghar 1 |
English: Raag Goojaree, First Mehl, Chau-Padhay, First House:

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰੀ ਚਨਣਾਠੀਆ ਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਉਰਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: teraa naam karee chananaattheea je man urasaa hoe |
English: I would make Your Name the sandalwood, and my mind the stone to rub it on;

Gurbani: ਕਰਣੀ ਕੁੰਗੂ ਜੇ ਰਲੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: karanee kungoo je ralai ghatt antar poojaa hoe |1|
English: for saffron, I would offer good deeds; thus, I perform worship and adoration within my heart. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪੂਜਾ ਕੀਚੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪੂਜ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: poojaa keechai naam dhiaaeeai bin naavai pooj na hoe |1| rahaau |
English: Perform worship and adoration by meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; without the Name, there is no worship and adoration. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਦੇਵ ਪਖਾਲੀਅਹਿ ਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਧੋਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: baahar dev pakhaaleeeh je man dhovai koe |
English: If one were to wash his heart inwardly, like the stone idol which is washed on the outside,

Gurbani: ਜੂਠਿ ਲਹੈ ਜੀਉ ਮਾਜੀਐ ਮੋਖ ਪਇਆਣਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jootth lahai jeeo maajeeai mokh peaanaa hoe |2|
English: his filth would be removed, his soul would be cleansed, and he would be liberated when he departs. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪਸੂ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਖੜੁ ਖਾਵਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਦੇਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: pasoo mileh changiaaeea kharr khaaveh amrit dehi |
English: Even beasts have value, as they eat grass and give milk.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੇ ਆਦਮੀ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇਹਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naam vihoone aadamee dhrig jeevan karam karehi |3|
English: Without the Naam, the mortal's life is cursed, as are the actions he performs. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨੇੜਾ ਹੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਅਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਰੇ ਸੰਮੑਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: nerraa hai door na jaaniahu nit saare samaale |
English: The Lord is hear at hand - do not think that He is far away. He always cherishes us, and remembers us.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਖਾਵਣਾ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: jo devai so khaavanaa kahu naanak saachaa he |4|1|
English: Whatever He gives us, we eat; says Nanak, He is the True Lord. ||4||1||

[Ang 489 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 1 |
English: Goojaree, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਭਿ ਕਮਲ ਤੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਉਪਜੇ ਬੇਦ ਪੜਹਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਕੰਠਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: naabh kamal te brahamaa upaje bed parreh mukh kantth savaar |
English: From the lotus of Vishnu's navel, Brahma was born; He chanted the Vedas with a melodious voice.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੋ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਲਖਣਾ ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਰਹੈ ਗੁਬਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: taa ko ant na jaaee lakhanaa aavat jaat rahai gubaar |1|
English: He could not find the Lord's limits, and he remained in the darkness of coming and going. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: preetam kiau bisareh mere praan adhaar |
English: Why should I forget my Beloved? He is the support of my very breath of life.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਨ ਪੂਰੇ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kee bhagat kareh jan poore mun jan seveh gur veechaar |1| rahaau |
English: The perfect beings perform devotional worship to Him. The silent sages serve Him through the Guru's Teachings. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਦੀਪਕ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਏਕਾ ਜੋਤਿ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: rav sas deepak jaa ke tribhavan ekaa jot muraar |
English: His lamps are the sun and the moon; the One Light of the Destroyer of ego fills the three worlds.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਰੈਣਿ ਅੰਧਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: guramukh hoe su ahinis niramal manamukh rain andhaar |2|
English: One who becomes Gurmukh remains immaculately pure, day and night, while the self-willed manmukh is enveloped by the darkness of night. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਝਗਰਾ ਦੁਹੁ ਲੋਚਨ ਕਿਆ ਹੇਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: sidh samaadh kareh nit jhagaraa duhu lochan kiaa herai |
English: The Siddhas in Samaadhi are continually in conflict; what can they see with their two eyes?

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਧੁਨਿ ਜਾਗੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਝਗਰੁ ਨਿਬੇਰੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: antar jot sabad dhun jaagai satigur jhagar niberai |3|
English: One who has the Divine Light within his heart, and is awakened to the melody of the Word of the Shabad - the True Guru settles his conflicts. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਨਾਥ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਸਾਚੈ ਮਹਲਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sur nar naath beant ajonee saachai mehal apaaraa |
English: O Lord of angels and men, infinite and unborn, Your True Mansion is incomparable.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak sehaj mile jagajeevan nadar karahu nisataaraa |4|2|
English: Nanak merges imperceptibly into the Life of the world; shower Your mercy upon him, and save him. ||4||2||

[Ang 490 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raag goojaree mahalaa 3 ghar 1 |
English: Raag Goojaree, Third Mehl, First House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਇਵੇਹਾ ਜੀਵਣਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: dhrig ivehaa jeevanaa jit har preet na paae |
English: Cursed is that life, in which the Lord's Love is not obtained.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਕੰਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jit kam har veesarai doojai lagai jaae |1|
English: Cursed is that occupation, in which the Lord is forgotten, and one becomes attached to duality. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਮਨਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਗੋਵਿਦ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਅਵਰ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਸਭ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa satigur seveeai manaa jit seviai govid preet aoopajai avar visar sabh jaae |
English: Serve such a True Guru, O my mind, that by serving Him, God's Love may be produced, and all others may be forgotten.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਗਹਿ ਰਹੈ ਜਰਾ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har setee chit geh rahai jaraa kaa bhau na hovee jeevan padavee paae |1| rahaau |
English: Your consciousness shall remain attached to the Lord; there shall be no fear of old age, and the supreme status shall be obtained. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਇਕੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਵੇਖੁ ਜੈਸੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: gobind preet siau ik sehaj upajiaa vekh jaisee bhagat banee |
English: A divine peace wells up from God's Love; behold, it comes from devotional worship.

Gurbani: ਆਪ ਸੇਤੀ ਆਪੁ ਖਾਇਆ ਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aap setee aap khaaeaa taa man niramal hoaa jotee jot samee |2|
English: When my identity consumed my identical identity, then my mind became immaculately pure, and my light was blended with the Divine Light. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਐਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin bhaagaa aisaa satigur na paaeeai je lochai sabh koe |
English: Without good fortune, such a True Guru cannot be found, no matter how much all may yearn for Him.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜੈ ਕੀ ਪਾਲਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਨਿਕਲੈ ਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: koorrai kee paal vichahu nikalai taa sadaa sukh hoe |3|
English: If the veil of falsehood is removed from within, then lasting peace is obtained. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਐਸੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਿਆ ਓਹੁ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਜੀਉ ਧਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak aise satigur kee kiaa ohu sevak sevaa kare gur aagai jeeo dharee |
English: O Nanak, what service can the servant perform for such a True Guru? He should offer his life, his very soul, to the Guru.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
Transliteration: satigur kaa bhaanaa chit kare satigur aape kripaa karee |4|1|3|
English: If he focuses his consciousness on the Will of the True Guru, then the True Guru Himself will bless him. ||4||1||3||

[Ang 490 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 3 |
English: Goojaree, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਤੁਮ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਦੂਜੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: har kee tum sevaa karahu doojee sevaa karahu na koe jee |
English: Serve the Lord; do not serve anyone else.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਮਨਹੁ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਦੂਜੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਇ ਜੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har kee sevaa te manahu chindiaa fal paaeeai doojee sevaa janam birathaa jaae jee |1|
English: Serving the Lord, you shall obtain the fruits of your heart's desires; serving another, your life shall pass away in vain. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰੀਤਿ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਥਾ ਕਹਾਨੀ ਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: har meree preet reet hai har meree har meree kathaa kahaanee jee |
English: The Lord is my Love, the Lord is my way of life, the Lord is my speech and conversation.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਏਹਾ ਸੇਵ ਬਨੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad meraa man bheejai ehaa sev banee jeeo |1| rahaau |
English: By Guru's Grace, my mind is saturated with the Lord's Love; this is what makes up my service. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਬੰਧਪੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har meraa simrit har meraa saasatr har meraa bandhap har meraa bhaaee |
English: The Lord is my Simritees, the Lord is my Shaastras; the Lord is my relative and the Lord is my brother.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਮੈ ਭੂਖ ਲਾਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੈ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਕੁ ਅੰਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har kee mai bhookh laagai har naam meraa man tripatai har meraa saak ant hoe sakhaaee |2|
English: I am hungry for the Lord; my mind is satisfied with the Name of the Lord. The Lord is my relation, my helper in the end. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਹੋਰ ਰਾਸਿ ਕੂੜੀ ਹੈ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har bin hor raas koorree hai chaladiaa naal na jaaee |
English: Without the Lord, other assets are false. They do not go with the mortal when he departs.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਧਨੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਸਾਥਿ ਚਾਲੈ ਜਹਾ ਹਉ ਜਾਉ ਤਹ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har meraa dhan merai saath chaalai jahaa hau jaau teh jaaee |3|
English: The Lord is my wealth, which shall go with me; wherever I go, it will go. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਝੂਠਾ ਜੋ ਝੂਠੇ ਲਾਗੈ ਝੂਠੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: so jhootthaa jo jhootthe laagai jhootthe karam kamaaee |
English: One who is attached to falsehood is false; false are the deeds he does.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਹੋਆ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੪॥੨॥੪॥
Transliteration: kahai naanak har kaa bhaanaa hoaa kahanaa kachhoo na jaaee |4|2|4|
English: Says Nanak, everything happens according to the Will of the Lord; no one has any say in this at all. ||4||2||4||

[Ang 490 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 3 |
English: Goojaree, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੁਗ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੁਲੰਭੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jug maeh naam dulanbh hai guramukh paaeaa jaae |
English: It is so difficult to obtain the Naam, the Name of the Lord, in this age; only the Gurmukh obtains it.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕੋ ਵਿਉਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bin naavai mukat na hovee vekhahu ko viaupaae |1|
English: Without the Name, no one is liberated; let anyone make other efforts, and see. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: balihaaree gur aapane sad balihaarai jaau |
English: I am a sacrifice to my Guru; I am forever a sacrifice to Him.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur miliai har man vasai sahaje rahai samaae |1| rahaau |
English: Meeting the True Guru, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind, and one remains absorbed in Him. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਾਂ ਭਉ ਪਾਏ ਆਪਣਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: jaan bhau paae aapanaa bairaag upajai man aae |
English: When God instills His fear, a balanced detachment springs up in the mind.

Gurbani: ਬੈਰਾਗੈ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bairaagai te har paaeeai har siau rahai samaae |2|
English: Through this detachment, the Lord is obtained, and one remains absorbed in the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੇਇ ਮੁਕਤ ਜਿ ਮਨੁ ਜਿਣਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਧਾਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: see mukat ji man jineh fir dhaat na laagai aae |
English: He alone is liberated, who conquers his mind; Maya does not stick to him again.

Gurbani: ਦਸਵੈ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਰਹਤ ਕਰੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: dasavai duaar rehat kare tribhavan sojhee paae |3|
English: He dwells in the Tenth Gate, and obtains the understanding of the three worlds. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇਆ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak gur te gur hoeaa vekhahu tis kee rajaae |
English: O Nanak, through the Guru, one becomes the Guru; behold, His Wondrous Will.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੩॥੫॥
Transliteration: eihu kaaran karataa kare jotee jot samaae |4|3|5|
English: This deed was done by the Creator Lord; one's light merges into the Light. ||4||3||5||

[Ang 491 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 3 |
English: Goojaree, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਿਐ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: raam raam sabh ko kahai kahiai raam na hoe |
English: Everyone chants the Lord's Name, Raam, Raam; but by such chanting, the Lord is not obtained.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee raam man vasai taa fal paavai koe |1|
English: By Guru's Grace, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind, and then, the fruits are obtained. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: antar govind jis laagai preet |
English: One who enshrines love for God within his mind,

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਚੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har tis kade na veesarai har har kareh sadaa man cheet |1| rahaau |
English: never forgets the Lord; he continually chants the Lord's Name, Har, Har, in his conscious mind. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਿਨੑ ਕੈ ਕਪਟੁ ਵਸੈ ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਕਹਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: hiradai jina kai kapatt vasai baaharahu sant kahaeh |
English: Those whose hearts are filled with hypocrisy, who are called saints only for their outward show

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਏ ਪਛੁਤਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: trisanaa mool na chukee ant ge pachhutaeh |2|
English: - their desires are never satisfied, and they depart grieving in the end. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਨੇਕ ਤੀਰਥ ਜੇ ਜਤਨ ਕਰੈ ਤਾ ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: anek teerath je jatan karai taa antar kee haumai kade na jaae |
English: Although one may bathe at many places of pilgrimage, still, his ego never departs.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਰ ਕੀ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jis nar kee dubidhaa na jaae dharam raae tis dee sajaae |3|
English: That man, whose sense of duality does not depart - the Righteous Judge of Dharma shall punish him. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: karam hovai soee jan paae guramukh boojhai koee |
English: That humble being, unto whom God showers His Mercy, obtains Him; how few are the Gurmukhs who understand Him.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਾਂ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੪॥੪॥੬॥
Transliteration: naanak vichahu haumai maare taan har bhettai soee |4|4|6|
English: O Nanak, if one conquers his ego within, then he comes to meet the Lord. ||4||4||6||

[Ang 491 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 3 |
English: Goojaree, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਤਿ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: tis jan saant sadaa mat nihachal jis kaa abhimaan gavaae |
English: That humble being who eliminates his ego is at peace; he is blessed with an ever-stable intellect.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: so jan niramal ji guramukh boojhai har charanee chit laae |1|
English: That humble being is immaculately pure, who, as Gurmukh, understands the Lord, and focuses his consciousness on the Lord's Feet. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿ ਅਚੇਤ ਮਨਾ ਜੋ ਇਛਹਿ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: har chet achet manaa jo ichheh so fal hoee |
English: O my unconscious mind, remain conscious of the Lord, and you shall obtain the fruits of your desires.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਪੀਵਤ ਰਹਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee har ras paaveh peevat raheh sadaa sukh hoee |1| rahaau |
English: By Guru's Grace, you shall obtain the sublime elixir of the Lord; by continually drinking it in, you shall have eternal peace. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਤਾ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: satigur bhette taa paaras hovai paaras hoe ta pooj karaae |
English: When one meets the True Guru, he becomes the philosopher's stone, with the ability to transform others, inspiring them to worship the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਉਸੁ ਪੂਜੇ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਦੇਵੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jo us pooje so fal paae deekhiaa devai saach bujhaae |2|
English: One who worships the Lord in adoration, obtains his rewards; instructing others, he reveals the Truth. ||2||

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਪਾਰਸੈ ਪੂਜ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਵਿਣੁ ਮਨ ਪਰਚੇ ਅਵਰਾ ਸਮਝਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: vin paarasai pooj na hovee vin man parache avaraa samajhaae |
English: Without becoming the philosopher's stone, he does not inspire others to worship the Lord; without instructing his own mind, how can he instruct others?

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੂ ਸਦਾਏ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧਾ ਕਿਸੁ ਓਹੁ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: guroo sadaae agiaanee andhaa kis ohu maarag paae |3|
English: The ignorant, blind man calls himself the guru, but to whom can he show the way? ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: naanak vin nadaree kichhoo na paaeeai jis nadar kare so paae |
English: O Nanak, without His Mercy, nothing can be obtained. One upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace, obtains Him.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਅਪਣਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਰਤਾਏ ॥੪॥੫॥੭॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee de vaddiaaee apanaa sabad varataae |4|5|7|
English: By Guru's Grace, God bestows greatness, and projects the Word of His Shabad. ||4||5||7||

[Ang 491 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਪੰਚਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 3 panchapade |
English: Goojaree, Third Mehl, Panch-Padhay:

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਕਾਸੀ ਮਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਨਾ ਕਾਸੀ ਮਤਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: naa kaasee mat aoopajai naa kaasee mat jaae |
English: Wisdom is not produced in Benares, nor is wisdom lost in Benares.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਮਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਤਾ ਇਹ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: satigur miliai mat aoopajai taa ih sojhee paae |1|
English: Meeting the True Guru, wisdom is produced, and then, one obtains this understanding. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਤੂੰ ਸੁਣਿ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: har kathaa toon sun re man sabad man vasaae |
English: Listen to the sermon of the Lord, O mind, and enshrine the Shabad of His Word within your mind.

Gurbani: ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਥਿਰੁ ਰਹੈ ਤਾਂ ਭਰਮੁ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: eih mat teree thir rahai taan bharam vichahu jaae |1| rahaau |
English: If your intellect remains stable and steady, then doubt shall depart from within you. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਇ ਤੂ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਨਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: har charan ridai vasaae too kilavikh hoveh naas |
English: Enshrine the Lord's lotus feet within your heart, and your sins shall be erased.

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਭੂ ਆਤਮਾ ਵਸਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਤਾ ਤੀਰਥ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: panch bhoo aatamaa vas kareh taa teerath kareh nivaas |2|
English: If your soul overcomes the five elements, then you shall come to have a home at the true place of pilgrimage. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਝੀ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh ihu man mugadh hai sojhee kichhoo na paae |
English: This mind of the self-centered manmukh is so stupid; it does not obtain any understanding at all.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਬੁਝਈ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam na bujhee ant geaa pachhutaae |3|
English: It does not understand the Name of the Lord; it departs repenting in the end. ||3||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਕਾਸੀ ਸਭਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੀਆ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: eihu man kaasee sabh teerath simrit satigur deea bujhaae |
English: In this mind are found Benares, all sacred shrines of pilgrimage and the Shaastras; the True Guru has explained this.

Gurbani: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: atthasatth teerath tis sang raheh jin har hiradai rahiaa samaae |4|
English: The sixty-eight places of pilgrimage remain with one, whose heart is filled with the Lord. ||4||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਏਕੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak satigur miliai hukam bujhiaa ek vasiaa man aae |
English: O Nanak, upon meeting the True Guru, the Order of the Lord's Will is understood, and the One Lord comes to dwell in the mind.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੫॥੬॥੮॥
Transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai sabh sach hai sache rahai samaae |5|6|8|
English: Those who are pleasing to You, O True Lord, are true. They remain absorbed in You. ||5||6||8||

[Ang 492 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਤੀਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 3 teejaa |
English: Goojaree, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਿਖੁ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: eko naam nidhaan panddit sun sikh sach soee |
English: The One Name is the treasure, O Pandit. Listen to these True Teachings.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਜੇਤਾ ਪੜਹਿ ਪੜਤ ਗੁਣਤ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: doojai bhaae jetaa parreh parrat gunat sadaa dukh hoee |1|
English: No matter what you read in duality, reading and contemplating it, you shall only continue to suffer. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਤੂੰ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: har charanee toon laag rahu gur sabad sojhee hoee |
English: So grasp the Lord's lotus feet; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, you shall come to understand.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਚਾਖੁ ਤੂੰ ਤਾਂ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har ras rasanaa chaakh toon taan man niramal hoee |1| rahaau |
English: With your tongue, taste the sublime elixir of the Lord, and your mind shall be rendered immaculately pure. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਮਨੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਐ ਤਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur miliai man santokheeai taa fir trisanaa bhookh na hoe |
English: Meeting the True Guru, the mind becomes content, and then, hunger and desire will not trouble you any longer.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪਰ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naam nidhaan paaeaa par ghar jaae na koe |2|
English: Obtaining the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one does not go knocking at other doors. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਨੀ ਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: kathanee badanee je kare manamukh boojh na hoe |
English: The self-willed manmukh babbles on and on, but he does not understand.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: guramatee ghatt chaananaa har naam paavai soe |3|
English: One whose heart is illumined, by Guru's Teachings, obtains the Name of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਤੂੰ ਨ ਬੁਝਹੀ ਤਾ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਬਾਰੋ ਬਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: sun saasatr toon na bujhahee taa fireh baaro baar |
English: You may listen to the Shaastras, but you do not understand, and so you wander from door to door.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਜੋ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਈ ਸਚਿ ਨ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: so moorakh jo aap na pachhaanee sach na dhare piaar |4|
English: He is a fool, who does not understand his own self, and who does not enshrine love for the True Lord. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਚੈ ਜਗਤੁ ਡਹਕਾਇਆ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sachai jagat ddahakaaeaa kahanaa kachhoo na jaae |
English: The True Lord has fooled the world - no one has any say in this at all.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੫॥੭॥੯॥
Transliteration: naanak jo tis bhaavai so kare jiau tis kee rajaae |5|7|9|
English: O Nanak, He does whatever He pleases, according to His Will. ||5||7||9||

[Ang 492 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raag goojaree mahalaa 4 chaupade ghar 1 |
English: Raag Goojaree, Fourth Mehl, Chau-Padhay, First House:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖਾ ਹਉ ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰਉ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: har ke jan satigur sat purakhaa hau binau krau gur paas |
English: O Servant of the Lord, O True Guru, O True Primal Being, I offer my prayers to You, O Guru.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਕੀਰੇ ਕਿਰਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ham keere kiram satigur saranaaee kar deaa naam paragaas |1|
English: I am an insect and a worm; O True Guru, I seek Your Sanctuary; please, be merciful and bestow upon me the Light of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: mere meet guradev mo kau raam naam paragaas |
English: O my Best Friend, O Divine Guru, please illuminate me with the Light of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸਖਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹਮਰੀ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: guramat naam meraa praan sakhaaee har keerat hamaree raharaas |1| rahaau |
English: By Guru's Instructions, the Naam is my breath of life, and the Praise of the Lord is my occupation. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਵਡਭਾਗ ਵਡੇਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਧਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
Transliteration: har jan ke vaddabhaag vaddere jin har har saradhaa har piaas |
English: The Lord's servants have the greatest good fortune; they have faith in the Lord, Har, Har, and a thirst for the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸਹਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har har naam milai tripataaseh mil sangat gun paragaas |2|
English: Obtaining the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, they are satisfied; joining the Company of the Holy, their virtues shine forth. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਜਮ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: jina har har har ras naam na paaeaa te bhaagaheen jam paas |
English: Those who have not obtained the essence of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, are most unfortunate; they are taken away by the Messenger of Death.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਏ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵੇ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jo satigur saran sangat nahee aae dhrig jeeve dhrig jeevaas |3|
English: Those who have not sought the Sanctuary of the True Guru and the Company of the Holy - cursed are their lives, and cursed are their hopes of life. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਤਿਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲਿਖਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: jin har jan satigur sangat paaee tin dhur masatak likhiaa likhaas |
English: Those humble servants of the Lord, who have obtained the Company of the True Guru, have such pre-ordained destiny written on their foreheads.

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan satasangat jit har ras paaeaa mil naanak naam paragaas |4|1|
English: Blessed, blessed is the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, where the sublime essence of the Lord is obtained. Meeting with His humble servant, O Nanak, the Naam shines forth. ||4||1||

[Ang 492 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 4 |
English: Goojaree, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: govind govind preetam man preetam mil satasangat sabad man mohai |
English: The Lord, the Lord of the Universe is the Beloved of the minds of those who join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. The Shabad of His Word fascinates their minds.

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਭ ਕਉ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਓਹੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jap govind govind dhiaaeeai sabh kau daan dee prabh ohai |1|
English: Chant, and meditate on the Lord, the Lord of the Universe; God is the One who gives gifts to all. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਜਨਾ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: mere bhaaee janaa mo kau govind govind govind man mohai |
English: O my Siblings of Destiny, the Lord of the Universe, Govind, Govind, Govind, has enticed and fascinated my mind.

Gurbani: ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: govind govind govind gun gaavaa mil gur saadhasangat jan sohai |1| rahaau |
English: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, Govind, Govind, Govind; joining the Holy Society of the Guru, Your humble servant is beautified. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਉਲਾ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਪਗਿ ਓਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: sukh saagar har bhagat hai guramat kaulaa ridh sidh laagai pag ohai |
English: Devotional worship to the Lord is an ocean of peace; through the Guru's Teachings, wealth, prosperity and the spiritual powers of the Siddhas fall at our feet.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਕਉ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਸੋਹੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jan kau raam naam aadhaaraa har naam japat har naame sohai |2|
English: The Lord's Name is the Support of His humble servant; he chants the Lord's Name, and with the Lord's Name he is adorned. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਾਗਹੀਨ ਮਤਿ ਫੀਕੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਤ ਆਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਰੋਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: duramat bhaagaheen mat feeke naam sunat aavai man rohai |
English: Evil-minded, unfortunate and shallow-minded are those who feel anger in their minds, when they hear the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਊਆ ਕਾਗ ਕਉ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੈ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਖਾਇ ਮੁਖਿ ਗੋਹੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kaooaa kaag kau amrit ras paaeeai tripatai visattaa khaae mukh gohai |3|
English: You may place ambrosial nectar before crows and ravens, but they will be satisfied only by eating manure and dung with their mouths. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਵਾਦੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਨਾਤੈ ਕਊਆ ਹੰਸੁ ਹੋਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: amrit sar satigur sativaadee jit naatai kaooaa hans hohai |
English: The True Guru, the Speaker of Truth, is the pool of Ambrosial Nectar; bathing within it, the crow becomes a swan.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਵਡੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿਨੑ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਹੈ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak dhan dhan vadde vaddabhaagee jina guramat naam ridai mal dhohai |4|2|
English: O Nanak, blessed, blessed and very fortunate are those who, through the Guru's Teachings, with the Naam, wash away the filth of their hearts. ||4||2||

[Ang 493 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 4 |
English: Goojaree, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਊਤਮ ਊਤਮ ਬਾਣੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har jan aootam aootam baanee mukh boleh praupakaare |
English: The humble servants of the Lord are exalted, and exalted is their speech. With their mouths, they speak for the benefit of others.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਸੁਣੈ ਸਰਧਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jo jan sunai saradhaa bhagat setee kar kirapaa har nisataare |1|
English: Those who listen to them with faith and devotion, are blessed by the Lord; showering His Mercy, He saves them. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮੇਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: raam mo kau har jan mel piaare |
English: Lord, please, let me meet the beloved servants of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mere preetam praan satigur gur pooraa ham paapee gur nisataare |1| rahaau |
English: The True Guru, the Perfect Guru, is my Beloved, my very breath of life; the Guru has saved me, the sinner. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਵਡਭਾਗੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh vaddabhaagee vaddabhaage jin har har naam adhaare |
English: The Gurmukhs are fortunate, so very fortunate; their Support is the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har har amrit har ras paaveh guramat bhagat bhanddaare |2|
English: They obtain the Ambrosial Nectar of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; through the Guru's Teachings, they obtain this treasure-house of devotional worship. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਜਮਿ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jin darasan satigur sat purakh na paaeaa te bhaagaheen jam maare |
English: Those who do not obtain the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the True Guru, the True Primal Being, are most unfortunate; they are destroyed by the Messenger of Death.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਕੂਕਰ ਸੂਕਰ ਗਰਧਭ ਪਵਹਿ ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨੀ ਦਯਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਮਹਾ ਹਤਿਆਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: se kookar sookar garadhabh paveh garabh jonee day maare mahaa hatiaare |3|
English: They are like dogs, pigs and jackasses; they are cast into the womb of reincarnation, and the Lord strikes them down as the worst of murderers. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਹੋਹੁ ਜਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: deen deaal hohu jan aoopar kar kirapaa lehu ubaare |
English: O Lord, Kind to the poor, please shower Your mercy upon Your humble servant, and save him.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak jan har kee saranaaee har bhaavai har nisataare |4|3|
English: Servant Nanak has entered the Lord's Sanctuary; if it pleases You, Lord, please save him. ||4||3||

[Ang 493 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 4 |
English: Goojaree, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਹਉ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: hohu deaal meraa man laavahu hau anadin raam naam nit dhiaaee |
English: Be Merciful and attune my mind, so that I might meditate continually on the Lord's Name, night and day.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਭਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਜਪਿਐ ਦੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਸਭ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sabh sukh sabh gun sabh nidhaan har jit japiai dukh bhukh sabh leh jaaee |1|
English: The Lord is all peace, all virtue and all wealth; remembering Him, all misery and hunger depart. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: man mere meraa raam naam sakhaa har bhaaee |
English: O my mind, the Lord's Name is my companion and brother.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਾ ਅੰਤਿ ਬੇਲੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: guramat raam naam jas gaavaa ant belee daragah le chhaddaaee |1| rahaau |
English: Under Guru's Instruction, I sing the Praises of the Lord's Name; it shall be my help and support in the end, and it shall deliver me in the Court of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਦਾਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੋਚ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: toon aape daataa prabh antarajaamee kar kirapaa loch merai man laaee |
English: You Yourself are the Giver, O God, Inner-knower, Searcher of hearts; by Your Grace, You have infused longing for You in my mind.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਲੋਚ ਲਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਲੋਚ ਪੂਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mai man tan loch lagee har setee prabh loch pooree satigur saranaaee |2|
English: My mind and body long for the Lord; God has fulfilled my longing. I have entered the Sanctuary of the True Guru. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਪੁੰਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: maanas janam pun kar paaeaa bin naavai dhrig dhrig birathaa jaaee |
English: Human birth is obtained through good actions; without the Name, it is cursed, totally cursed, and it passes away in vain.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਦੁਖੁ ਖਾਵੈ ਮੁਖੁ ਫੀਕਾ ਥੁਕ ਥੂਕ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naam binaa ras kas dukh khaavai mukh feekaa thuk thook mukh paaee |3|
English: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one obtains only suffering for his delicacies to eat. His mouth is insipid, and his face is spat upon, again and again. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾ ਤਿਨ ਦਰਗਹ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: jo jan har prabh har har saranaa tin daragah har har de vaddiaaee |
English: Those humble beings, who have entered the Sanctuary of the Lord God, Har, Har, are blessed with glory in the Court of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਕਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਈ ॥੪॥੪॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan saabaas kahai prabh jan kau jan naanak mel le gal laaee |4|4|
English: Blessed, blessed and congratulations, says God to His humble servant. O servant Nanak, He embraces him, and blends him with Himself. ||4||4||

[Ang 493 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 4 |
English: Goojaree, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਜੀਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh sakhee sahelee meree mo kau devahu daan har praan jeevaaeaa |
English: O Gurmukhs, O my friends and companions, give me the gift of the Lord's Name, the life of my very life.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਹੋਵਹ ਲਾਲੇ ਗੋਲੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਕੇ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ham hovah laale gole gurasikhaa ke jinaa anadin har prabh purakh dhiaaeaa |1|
English: I am the slave, the servant of the Guru's Sikhs, who meditate on the Lord God, the Primal Being, night and day. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪਗ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: merai man tan birahu gurasikh pag laaeaa |
English: Within my mind and body, I have enshrined love for the feet of the Guru's Sikhs.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸਖਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਸਿਖ ਭਾਈ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mere praan sakhaa gur ke sikh bhaaee mo kau karahu upades har milai milaaeaa |1| rahaau |
English: O my life-mates, O Sikhs of the Guru, O Siblings of Destiny, instruct me in the Teachings, that I might merge in the Lord's Merger. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਜਿਨੑ ਵਚਨ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jaa har prabh bhaavai taa guramukh mele jina vachan guroo satigur man bhaaeaa |
English: When it pleases the Lord God, he causes us to meet the Gurmukhs; the Hymns of the Guru, the True Guru, are very sweet to their minds.

Gurbani: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਸਿਖ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ਨਿਰਬਾਣ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: vaddabhaagee gur ke sikh piaare har nirabaanee nirabaan pad paaeaa |2|
English: Very fortunate are the beloved Sikhs of the Guru; through the Lord, they attain the supreme state of Nirvaanaa. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: satasangat gur kee har piaaree jin har har naam meetthaa man bhaaeaa |
English: The Sat Sangat, the True Congregation of the Guru, is loved by the Lord. The Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is sweet and pleasing to their minds.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੇ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਪਾਪੀ ਜਮਿ ਖਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jin satigur sangat sang na paaeaa se bhaagaheen paapee jam khaaeaa |3|
English: One who does not obtain the Association of the True Guru, is a most unfortunate sinner; he is consumed by the Messenger of Death. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਾਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aap kripaal kripaa prabh dhaare har aape guramukh milai milaaeaa |
English: If God, the Kind Master, Himself shows His kindness, then the Lord causes the Gurmukh to merge into Himself.

Gurbani: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੇ ਗੁਣ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੫॥
Transliteration: jan naanak bole gun baanee gurabaanee har naam samaaeaa |4|5|
English: Servant Nanak chants the Glorious Words of the Guru's Bani; through them, one is absorbed into the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||5||

[Ang 494 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 4 |
English: Goojaree, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jin satigur purakh jin har prabh paaeaa mo kau kar upades har meetth lagaavai |
English: One who has found the Lord God through the True Guru, has made the Lord seem so sweet to me, through the His Teachings.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਭ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: man tan seetal sabh hariaa hoaa vaddabhaagee har naam dhiaavai |1|
English: My mind and body have been cooled and soothed, and totally rejuvenated; by great good fortune, I meditate on the Name of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕੋਈ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: bhaaee re mo kau koee aae milai har naam drirraavai |
English: O Siblings of Destiny, let anyone who can implant the Lord's Name within me, come and meet with me.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਦੇਵਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mere preetam praan man tan sabh devaa mere har prabh kee har kathaa sunaavai |1| rahaau |
English: Unto my Beloved, I give my mind and body, and my very breath of life. He speaks to me of the sermon of my Lord God. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਧੀਰਜੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: dheeraj dharam guramat har paaeaa nit har naamai har siau chit laavai |
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, I have obtained courage, faith and the Lord. He keeps my mind focused continually on the Lord, and the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਚਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਜੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਸੋ ਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: amrit bachan satigur kee baanee jo bolai so mukh amrit paavai |2|
English: The Words of the True Guru's Teachings are Ambrosial Nectar; this Amrit trickles into the mouth of the one who chants them. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: niramal naam jit mail na laagai guramat naam japai liv laavai |
English: Immaculate is the Naam, which cannot be stained by filth. Through the Guru's Teachings, chant the Naam with love.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜਿਨ ਨਰ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੇ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਮੁਏ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naam padaarath jin nar nahee paaeaa se bhaagaheen mue mar jaavai |3|
English: That man who has not found the wealth of the Naam is most unfortunate; he dies over and over again. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਨਦ ਮੂਲੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਅਨਦੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: aanad mool jagajeevan daataa sabh jan kau anad karahu har dhiaavai |
English: The source of bliss, the Life of the world, the Great Giver brings bliss to all who meditate on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੀਅ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੬॥
Transliteration: toon daataa jeea sabh tere jan naanak guramukh bakhas milaavai |4|6|
English: You are the Great Giver, all beings belong to You. O servant Nanak, You forgive the Gurmukhs, and merge them into Yourself. ||4||6||

[Ang 494 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 4 ghar 3 |
English: Goojaree, Fourth Mehl, Third House:

Gurbani: ਮਾਈ ਬਾਪ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਸਭਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਕੀਏ ॥
Transliteration: maaee baap putr sabh har ke kee |
English: Mother, father and sons are all made by the Lord;

Gurbani: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਉ ਸਨਬੰਧੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sabhanaa kau sanabandh har kar dee |1|
English: the relationships of all are established by the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਮਰਾ ਜੋਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਰਹਿਓ ਮੇਰੇ ਬੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: hamaraa jor sabh rahio mere beer |
English: I have given up all my strength, O my brother.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਸਰੀਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa tan man sabh har kai vas hai sareer |1| rahaau |
English: The mind and body belong to the Lord, and the human body is entirely under His control. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਸਰਧਾ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat janaa kau saradhaa aap har laaee |
English: The Lord Himself infuses devotion into His humble devotees.

Gurbani: ਵਿਚੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਸਤ ਉਦਾਸ ਰਹਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: viche grisat udaas rahaaee |2|
English: In the midst of family life, they remain unattached. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: jab antar preet har siau ban aaee |
English: When inner love is established with the Lord,

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tab jo kichh kare su mere har prabh bhaaee |3|
English: then whatever one does, is pleasing to my Lord God. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਕਾਰੈ ਕੰਮਿ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jit kaarai kam ham har laae |
English: I do those deeds and tasks which the Lord has set me to;

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਹਮ ਕਰਹ ਜੁ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: so ham karah ju aap karaae |4|
English: I do that which He makes me to do. ||4||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jin kee bhagat mere prabh bhaaee |
English: Those whose devotional worship is pleasing to my God

Gurbani: ਤੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੫॥੧॥੭॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: te jan naanak raam naam liv laaee |5|1|7|16|
English: - O Nanak, those humble beings center their minds lovingly on the Lord's Name. ||5||1||7||16||

[Ang 495 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 chaupade ghar 1 |
English: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl, Chau-Padhay, First House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੇ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਚਿਤਵਹਿ ਉਦਮੁ ਜਾ ਆਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਪਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: kaahe re man chitaveh udam jaa aahar har jeeo pariaa |
English: Why, O mind, do you contrive your schemes, when the Dear Lord Himself provides for your care?

Gurbani: ਸੈਲ ਪਥਰ ਮਹਿ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਏ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਆਗੈ ਕਰਿ ਧਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sail pathar meh jant upaae taa kaa rijak aagai kar dhariaa |1|
English: From rocks and stones, He created the living beings, and He places before them their sustenance. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਾਧਉ ਜੀ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਿ ਤਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: mere maadhau jee satasangat mile si tariaa |
English: O my Dear Lord of Souls, one who meets with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, is saved.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੂਕੇ ਕਾਸਟ ਹਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaad param pad paaeaa sooke kaasatt hariaa |1| rahaau |
English: By Guru's Grace, he obtains the supreme status, and the dry branch blossoms forth in greenery. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਨਨਿ ਪਿਤਾ ਲੋਕ ਸੁਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸ ਕੀ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: janan pitaa lok sut banitaa koe na kis kee dhariaa |
English: Mother, father, friends, children, and spouse - no one is the support of any other.

Gurbani: ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕਾਹੇ ਮਨ ਭਉ ਕਰਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sir sir rijak sanbaahe tthaakur kaahe man bhau kariaa |2|
English: For each and every individual, the Lord and Master provides sustenance; why do you fear, O my mind? ||2||

Gurbani: ਊਡੈ ਊਡਿ ਆਵੈ ਸੈ ਕੋਸਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਾਛੈ ਬਚਰੇ ਛਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: aooddai aoodd aavai sai kosaa tis paachhai bachare chhariaa |
English: The flamingoes fly hundreds of miles, leaving their young ones behind.

Gurbani: ਉਨ ਕਵਨੁ ਖਲਾਵੈ ਕਵਨੁ ਚੁਗਾਵੈ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਕਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aun kavan khalaavai kavan chugaavai man meh simaran kariaa |3|
English: Who feeds them, and who teaches them to feed themselves? Have you ever thought of this in your mind? ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਦਸ ਅਸਟ ਸਿਧਾਨ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਰ ਤਲ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabh nidhaan das asatt sidhaan tthaakur kar tal dhariaa |
English: All treasures and the eighteen supernatural spiritual powers of the Siddhas are held by the Lord and Master in the palm of His hand.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਰਿਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak bal bal sad bal jaaeeai teraa ant na paaraavariaa |4|1|
English: Servant Nanak is devoted, dedicated, and forever a sacrifice to You - Your vast expanse has no limit. ||4||1||

[Ang 495 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 chaupade ghar 2 |
English: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl, Chau-Padhay, Second House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਿਆਚਾਰ ਕਰਹਿ ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਇਤੁ ਰਾਤੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kiriaachaar kareh khatt karamaa it raate sansaaree |
English: They perform the four rituals and six religious rites; the world is engrossed in these.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: antar mail na utarai haumai bin gur baajee haaree |1|
English: They are not cleansed of the filth of their ego within; without the Guru, they lose the game of life. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: mere tthaakur rakh levahu kirapaa dhaaree |
English: O my Lord and Master, please, grant Your Grace and preserve me.

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਹੋਰਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kott madhe ko viralaa sevak hor sagale biauhaaree |1| rahaau |
English: Out of millions, hardly anyone is a servant of the Lord. All the others are mere traders. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਤ ਬੇਦ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਭਿ ਸੋਧੇ ਸਭ ਏਕਾ ਬਾਤ ਪੁਕਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: saasat bed simrit sabh sodhe sabh ekaa baat pukaaree |
English: I have searched all the Shaastras, the Vedas and the Simritees, and they all affirm one thing:

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bin gur mukat na koaoo paavai man vekhahu kar beechaaree |2|
English: without the Guru, no one obtains liberation; see, and reflect upon this in your mind. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਮਜਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਇਸਨਾਨਾ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਏ ਧਰ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: atthasatth majan kar isanaanaa bhram aae dhar saaree |
English: Even if one takes cleansing baths at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, and wanders over the whole planet,

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਸੋਚ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: anik soch kareh din raatee bin satigur andhiaaree |3|
English: and performs all the rituals of purification day and night, still, without the True Guru, there is only darkness. ||3||

Gurbani: ਧਾਵਤ ਧਾਵਤ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਧਾਇਓ ਅਬ ਆਏ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: dhaavat dhaavat sabh jag dhaaeo ab aae har duaaree |
English: Roaming and wandering around, I have travelled over the whole world, and now, I have arrived at the Lord's Door.

Gurbani: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੇਟਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੨॥
Transliteration: duramat mett budh paragaasee jan naanak guramukh taaree |4|1|2|
English: The Lord has eliminated my evil-mindedness, and enlightened my intellect; O servant Nanak, the Gurmukhs are saved. ||4||1||2||

[Ang 495 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਜਾਪ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਤਾਪ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: har dhan jaap har dhan taap har dhan bhojan bhaaeaa |
English: The wealth of the Lord is my chanting, the wealth of the Lord is my deep meditation; the wealth of the Lord is the food I enjoy.

Gurbani: ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਬਿਸਰਉ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: nimakh na bisrau man te har har saadhasangat meh paaeaa |1|
English: I do not forget the Lord, Har, Har, from my mind, even for an instant; I have found Him in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਾਈ ਖਾਟਿ ਆਇਓ ਘਰਿ ਪੂਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: maaee khaatt aaeo ghar pootaa |
English: O mother, your son has returned home with a profit:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਚਲਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਬੈਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਜਾਗਤ ਸੂਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har dhan chalate har dhan baise har dhan jaagat sootaa |1| rahaau |
English: the wealth of the Lord while walking, the wealth of the Lord while sitting, and the wealth of the Lord while waking and sleeping. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਾਇ ਧਿਆਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: har dhan isanaan har dhan giaan har sang laae dhiaanaa |
English: The wealth of the Lord is my cleansing bath, the wealth of the Lord is my wisdom; I center my meditation on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਤੁਲਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਬੇੜੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har dhan tulahaa har dhan berree har har taar paraanaa |2|
English: The wealth of the Lord is my raft, the wealth of the Lord is my boat; the Lord, Har, Har, is the ship to carry me across. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਧਨ ਮੇਰੀ ਚਿੰਤ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਨਿ ਲਾਹਿਆ ਧੋਖਾ ॥
Transliteration: har dhan meree chint visaaree har dhan laahiaa dhokhaa |
English: Through the wealth of the Lord, I have forgotten my anxiety; through the wealth of the Lord, my doubt has been dispelled.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਧਨ ਤੇ ਮੈ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ਹਾਥਿ ਚਰਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਥੋਕਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har dhan te mai nav nidh paaee haath chario har thokaa |3|
English: From the wealth of the Lord, I have obtained the nine treasures; the true essence of the Lord has come into my hands. ||3||

Gurbani: ਖਾਵਹੁ ਖਰਚਹੁ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਲਤ ਪਲਤ ਕੈ ਸੰਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: khaavahu kharachahu tott na aavai halat palat kai sange |
English: No matter how much I eat and expend this wealth, it is not exhausted; here and hereafter, it remains with me.

Gurbani: ਲਾਦਿ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਦੀਆ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੩॥
Transliteration: laad khajaanaa gur naanak kau deea ihu man har rang range |4|2|3|
English: Loading the treasure, Guru Nanak has given it, and this mind is imbued with the Lord's Love. ||4||2||3||

[Ang 496 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਨਾਸਹਿ ਪਿਤਰੀ ਹੋਇ ਉਧਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: jis simarat sabh kilavikh naaseh pitaree hoe udhaaro |
English: Remembering Him, all sins are erased, and ones generations are saved.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤੁਮੑ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਜਾਪਹੁ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: so har har tuma sad hee jaapahu jaa kaa ant na paaro |1|
English: So meditate continually on the Lord, Har, Har; He has no end or limitation. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪੂਤਾ ਮਾਤਾ ਕੀ ਆਸੀਸ ॥
Transliteration: pootaa maataa kee aasees |
English: O son, this is your mother's hope and prayer,

Gurbani: ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਬਿਸਰਉ ਤੁਮੑ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਭਜਹੁ ਜਗਦੀਸ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: nimakh na bisrau tuma kau har har sadaa bhajahu jagadees |1| rahaau |
English: that you may never forget the Lord, Har, Har, even for an instant. May you ever vibrate upon the Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਮੑ ਕਉ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: satigur tuma kau hoe deaalaa santasang teree preet |
English: May the True Guru be kind to you, and may you love the Society of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਕਾਪੜੁ ਪਤਿ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਰਾਖੀ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਨੀਤਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kaaparr pat paramesar raakhee bhojan keeratan neet |2|
English: May the preservation of your honor by the Transcendent Lord be your clothes, and may the singing of His Praises be your food. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਚਿਰੁ ਜੀਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਅਨਦ ਅਨੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: amrit peevahu sadaa chir jeevahu har simarat anad anantaa |
English: So drink in forever the Ambrosial Nectar; may you live long, and may the meditative remembrance of the Lord give you infinite delight.

Gurbani: ਰੰਗ ਤਮਾਸਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਚਿੰਤਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: rang tamaasaa pooran aasaa kabeh na biaapai chintaa |3|
English: May joy and pleasure be yours; may your hopes be fulfilled, and may you never be troubled by worries. ||3||

Gurbani: ਭਵਰੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਵਉ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣਾ ਹੋਹੁ ਕਉਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: bhavar tumaaraa ihu man hovau har charanaa hohu kaulaa |
English: Let this mind of yours be the bumble bee, and let the Lord's feet be the lotus flower.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਉਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਪਟਾਇਓ ਜਿਉ ਬੂੰਦਹਿ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕੁ ਮਉਲਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak daas un sang lapattaaeo jiau boondeh chaatrik maulaa |4|3|4|
English: Says servant Nanak, attach your mind to them, and blossom forth like the song-bird, upon finding the rain-drop. ||4||3||4||

[Ang 496 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਤਾ ਕਰੈ ਪਛਮ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ਪੂਰਬ ਹੀ ਲੈ ਜਾਤ ॥
Transliteration: mataa karai pachham kai taaee poorab hee lai jaat |
English: He decides to go to the west, but the Lord leads him away to the east.

Gurbani: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਨਹਾਰਾ ਆਪਨ ਹਾਥਿ ਮਤਾਤ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: khin meh thaap uthaapanahaaraa aapan haath mataat |1|
English: In an instant, He establishes and disestablishes; He holds all matters in His hands. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਿਆਨਪ ਕਾਹੂ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਤ ॥
Transliteration: siaanap kaahoo kaam na aat |
English: Cleverness is of no use at all.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਅਨਰੂਪਿਓ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੀ ਉਹ ਬਾਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo anaroopio tthaakur merai hoe rahee uh baat |1| rahaau |
English: Whatever my Lord and Master deems to be right - that alone comes to pass. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦੇਸੁ ਕਮਾਵਨ ਧਨ ਜੋਰਨ ਕੀ ਮਨਸਾ ਬੀਚੇ ਨਿਕਸੇ ਸਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: des kamaavan dhan joran kee manasaa beeche nikase saas |
English: In his desire to acquire land and accumulate wealth, one's breath escapes him.

Gurbani: ਲਸਕਰ ਨੇਬ ਖਵਾਸ ਸਭ ਤਿਆਗੇ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਊਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਸ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: lasakar neb khavaas sabh tiaage jam pur aootth sidhaas |2|
English: He must leave all his armies, assistants and servants; rising up, he departs to the City of Death. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਨਿ ਮਨਹਠ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਤਾ ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਜਾਨਾਤ ॥
Transliteration: hoe anan manahatth kee drirrataa aapas kau jaanaat |
English: Believing himself to be unique, he clings to his stubborn mind, and shows himself off.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਅਨਿੰਦੁ ਨਿੰਦੁ ਕਰਿ ਛੋਡਿਓ ਸੋਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਖਾਤ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jo anind nind kar chhoddio soee fir fir khaat |3|
English: That food, which the blameless people have condemned and discarded, he eats again and again. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਭਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਕਾਟੀ ਫਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj subhaae bhe kirapaalaa tis jan kee kaattee faas |
English: One, unto whom the Lord shows His natural mercy, has the noose of Death cut away from him.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਗਿਰਸਤ ਉਦਾਸ ॥੪॥੪॥੫॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak gur pooraa bhettiaa paravaan girasat udaas |4|4|5|
English: Says Nanak, one who meets the Perfect Guru, is celebrated as a householder as well as a renunciate. ||4||4||5||

[Ang 496 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੇ ॥
Transliteration: naam nidhaan jin jan japio tin ke bandhan kaatte |
English: Those humble beings who chant the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, have their bonds broken.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮਾਇਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਮਤਾ ਇਹ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਤੇ ਹਾਟੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh maaeaa bikh mamataa ih biaadh te haatte |1|
English: Sexual desirer, anger, the poison of Maya and egotism - they are rid of these afflictions. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਗਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: har jas saadhasang mil gaaeo |
English: One who joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and chants the Praises of the Lord,

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਭਇਓ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਅਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaad bheo man niramal sarab sukhaa sukh paaeaau |1| rahaau |
English: has his mind purified, by Guru's Grace, and he obtains the joy of all joys. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਓ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨੈ ਐਸੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਮਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: jo kichh keeo soee bhal maanai aisee bhagat kamaanee |
English: Whatever the Lord does, he sees that as good; such is the devotional service he performs.

Gurbani: ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਭ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨੇ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨੀਸਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mitr satru sabh ek samaane jog jugat neesaanee |2|
English: He sees friends and enemies as all the same; this is the sign of the Way of Yoga. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਥਾਈ ਆਨ ਨ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: pooran poor rahio srab thaaee aan na katahoon jaataa |
English: The all-pervading Lord is fully filling all places; why should I go anywhere else?

Gurbani: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਵਿਓ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt antar sarab nirantar rang ravio rang raataa |3|
English: He is permeating and pervading within each and every heart; I am immersed in His Love, dyed in the color of His Love. ||3||

Gurbani: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੁਪਾਲਾ ਤਾ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bhe kripaal deaal gupaalaa taa nirabhai kai ghar aaeaa |
English: When the Lord of the Universe becomes kind and compassionate, then one enters the home of the Fearless Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਿਟੇ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੫॥੬॥
Transliteration: kal kales mitte khin bheetar naanak sehaj samaaeaa |4|5|6|
English: His troubles and worries are ended in an instant; O Nanak, he merges in celestial peace. ||4||5||6||

[Ang 497 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਸੋ ਅਪਨੈ ਦੁਖਿ ਭਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jis maanukh peh krau benatee so apanai dukh bhariaa |
English: Whoever I approach to ask for help, I find him full of his own troubles.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਭਉ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: paarabraham jin ridai araadhiaa tin bhau saagar tariaa |1|
English: One who worships in his heart the Supreme Lord God, crosses over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋ ਨ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur har bin ko na brithaa dukh kaattai |
English: No one, except the Guru-Lord, can dispel our pain and sorrow.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਜਿ ਅਵਰ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜੇ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਮਹਤੁ ਜਸੁ ਘਾਟੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: prabh taj avar sevak je hoee hai tith maan mehat jas ghaattai |1| rahaau |
English: Forsaking God, and serving another, one's honor, dignity and reputation are decreased. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਸਨਬੰਧ ਸੈਨ ਸਾਕ ਕਿਤ ਹੀ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa ke sanabandh sain saak kit hee kaam na aaeaa |
English: Relatives, relations and family bound through Maya are of no avail.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਨੀਚ ਕੁਲੁ ਊਚਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਨ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har kaa daas neech kul aoochaa tis sang man baanchhat fal paaeaa |2|
English: The Lord's servant, although of lowly birth, is exalted. Associating with him, one obtains the fruits of his mind's desires. ||2||

Gurbani: ਲਾਖ ਕੋਟਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕੇ ਬਿੰਜਨ ਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਨ ਬੂਝੀ ॥
Transliteration: laakh kott bikhiaa ke binjan taa meh trisan na boojhee |
English: Through corruption, one may obtain thousands and millions of enjoyments, but even so, his desires are not satisfied through them.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੋਟਿ ਉਜੀਆਰਾ ਬਸਤੁ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਸੂਝੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: simarat naam kott ujeeaaraa basat agochar soojhee |3|
English: Remembering the Naam, the Name of the Lord, millions of lights appear, and the incomprehensible is understood. ||3||

Gurbani: ਫਿਰਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਤੁਮੑਰੈ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: firat firat tumarai duaar aaeaa bhai bhanjan har raaeaa |
English: Wandering and roaming around, I have come to Your Door, Destroyer of fear, O Lord King.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਧੂਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਬਾਛੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੬॥੭॥
Transliteration: saadh ke charan dhoor jan baachhai sukh naanak ihu paaeaa |4|6|7|
English: Servant Nanak yearns for the dust of the feet of the Holy; in it, he finds peace. ||4||6||7||

[Ang 497 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਪੰਚਪਦਾ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 panchapadaa ghar 2 |
English: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl, Panch-Pada, Second House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਥਮੇ ਗਰਭ ਮਾਤਾ ਕੈ ਵਾਸਾ ਊਹਾ ਛੋਡਿ ਧਰਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: prathame garabh maataa kai vaasaa aoohaa chhodd dharan meh aaeaa |
English: First, he came to dwell in his mother's womb; leaving it, he came into the world.

Gurbani: ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਾਲ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਬਾਗ ਮੰਦਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਕਛਹੂ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: chitr saal sundar baag mandar sang na kachhahoo jaaeaa |1|
English: Splendid mansions, beautiful gardens and palaces - none of these shall go with him. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਵਰ ਸਭ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਲੋਭ ਲਬੀ ॥
Transliteration: avar sabh mithiaa lobh labee |
English: All other greeds of the greedy are false.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੀਓ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਜੀਅ ਕਉ ਏਹਾ ਵਸਤੁ ਫਬੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur poorai deeo har naamaa jeea kau ehaa vasat fabee |1| rahaau |
