English: The Perfect Guru has given me the Name of the Lord, which my soul has come to treasure. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਇਸਟ ਮੀਤ ਬੰਧਪ ਸੁਤ ਭਾਈ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਰਚਿ ਹਸਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: eisatt meet bandhap sut bhaaee sang banitaa rach hasiaa |
English: Surrounded by dear friends, relatives, children, siblings and spouse, he laughs playfully.

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਅੰਤੀ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਆਇ ਬਨਿਓ ਹੈ ਉਨੑ ਪੇਖਤ ਹੀ ਕਾਲਿ ਗ੍ਰਸਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jab antee aausar aae banio hai una pekhat hee kaal grasiaa |2|
English: But when the very last moment arrives, Death seizes him, while they merely look on. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਅਨਰਥ ਬਿਹਾਝੀ ਸੰਪੈ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੂਪਾ ਦਾਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: kar kar anarath bihaajhee sanpai sueinaa roopaa daamaa |
English: By continual oppression and exploitation, he accumulates wealth, gold, silver and money,

Gurbani: ਭਾੜੀ ਕਉ ਓਹੁ ਭਾੜਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹੋਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਭਇਓ ਬਿਰਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bhaarree kau ohu bhaarraa miliaa hor sagal bheo biraanaa |3|
English: but the load-bearer gets only paltry wages, while the rest of the money passes on to others. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹੈਵਰ ਗੈਵਰ ਰਥ ਸੰਬਾਹੇ ਗਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਕੀਨੇ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: haivar gaivar rath sanbaahe gahu kar keene mere |
English: He grabs and collects horses, elephants and chariots, and claims them as his own.

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ਲਾਂਮੀ ਧਾਈ ਚਲਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਇਕ ਪੈਰੇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jab te hoee laamee dhaaee chaleh naahee ik paire |4|
English: But when he sets out on the long journey, they will not go even one step with him. ||4||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਖ ਰਾਜਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: naam dhan naam sukh raajaa naam kuttanb sahaaee |
English: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is my wealth; the Naam is my princely pleasure; the Naam is my family and helper.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਦੀਈ ਓਹ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਈ ॥੫॥੧॥੮॥
Transliteration: naam sanpat gur naanak kau deeee oeh marai na aavai jaaee |5|1|8|
English: The Guru has given Nanak the wealth of the Naam; it neither perishes, nor comes or goes. ||5||1||8||

[Ang 497 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਤਿਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 tipade ghar 2 |
English: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl, Thi-Padhay, Second House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਦੁਖ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸੁਖ ਕੀਆ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਲਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: dukh binase sukh keea nivaasaa trisanaa jalan bujhaaee |
English: My sorrows are ended, and I am filled with peace. The fire of desire within me has been quenched.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naam nidhaan satiguroo drirraaeaa binas na aavai jaaee |1|
English: The True Guru has implanted the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me; it neither dies, nor goes anywhere. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੂਟੇ ॥
Transliteration: har jap maaeaa bandhan tootte |
English: Meditating on the Lord, the bonds of Maya are cut away.

Gurbani: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਛੂਟੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhe kripaal deaal prabh mere saadhasangat mil chhootte |1| rahaau |
English: When my God becomes kind and compassionate, one joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and is emancipated. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸਿ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar har ke gun gaavai bhagat prem ras maataa |
English: Twenty-four hours a day, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, absorbed in loving devotional worship.

Gurbani: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਦੁਹੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: harakh sog duhu maeh niraalaa karanaihaar pachhaataa |2|
English: He remains unaffected by both fortune and misfortune, and he recognizes the Creator Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਰਖਿ ਲੀਆ ਸਗਲ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: jis kaa saa tin hee rakh leea sagal jugat ban aaee |
English: The Lord saves those who belong to Him, and all pathways are opened to them.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੁਰਖ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥੧॥੯॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak prabh purakh deaalaa keemat kehan na jaaee |3|1|9|
English: Says Nanak, the value of the Merciful Lord God cannot be described. ||3||1||9||

[Ang 498 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 dupade ghar 2 |
English: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl, Dho-Padhay, Second House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਲੀਏ ਕਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਗਲ ਕਰਤ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: patit pavitr lee kar apune sagal karat namasakaaro |
English: The Lord has sanctified the sinners and made them His own; all bow in reverence to Him.

Gurbani: ਬਰਨੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਕੋਊ ਪੂਛੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਾਛਹਿ ਚਰਨ ਰਵਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: baran jaat koaoo poochhai naahee baachheh charan ravaaro |1|
English: No one asks about their ancestry and social status; instead, they yearn for the dust of their feet. ||1||

Gurbani: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਐਸੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: tthaakur aiso naam tumaaro |
English: O Lord Master, such is Your Name.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕੋ ਧਣੀ ਕਹੀਜੈ ਜਨ ਕੋ ਅੰਗੁ ਨਿਰਾਰੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sagal srisatt ko dhanee kaheejai jan ko ang niraaro |1| rahaau |
English: You are called the Lord of all creation; You give Your unique support to Your servant. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਆਧਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang naanak budh paaee har keeratan aadhaaro |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak has obtained understanding; singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises is his only support.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਦਾਸਰੋ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਇਓ ਚੰਮਿਆਰੋ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: naamadeo trilochan kabeer daasaro mukat bheo chamiaaro |2|1|10|
English: The Lord's servants, Naam Dayv, Trilochan, Kabeer and Ravi Daas the shoe-maker have been liberated. ||2||1||10||

[Ang 498 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਊ ਬੂਝਨਹਾਰੋ ਜਾਨੈ ਕਵਨੁ ਭਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: hai naahee koaoo boojhanahaaro jaanai kavan bhataa |
English: No one understands the Lord; who can understand His plans?

Gurbani: ਸਿਵ ਬਿਰੰਚਿ ਅਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਮੋਨਿ ਜਨ ਗਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਾਹਿ ਗਤਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: siv biranch ar sagal mon jan geh na sakaeh gataa |1|
English: Shiva, Brahma and all the silent sages cannot understand the state of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਕਥਾ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kee agam agaadh kathaa |
English: God's sermon is profound and unfathomable.

Gurbani: ਸੁਨੀਐ ਅਵਰ ਅਵਰ ਬਿਧਿ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਬਕਨ ਕਥਨ ਰਹਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: suneeai avar avar bidh bujheeai bakan kathan rahataa |1| rahaau |
English: He is heard to be one thing, but He is understood to be something else again; He is beyond description and explanation. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਪਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape bhagataa aap suaamee aapan sang rataa |
English: He Himself is the devotee, and He Himself is the Lord and Master; He is imbued with Himself.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਹੈ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਜਤ੍ਰ ਕਤਾ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: naanak ko prabh poor rahio hai pekhio jatr kataa |2|2|11|
English: Nanak's God is pervading and permeating everywhere; wherever he looks, He is there. ||2||2||11||

[Ang 498 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਤਾ ਮਸੂਰਤਿ ਅਵਰ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਆਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: mataa masoorat avar siaanap jan kau kachhoo na aaeo |
English: The humble servant of the Lord has no plans, politics or other clever tricks.

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਆਇ ਬਨਿਓ ਹੈ ਤਹਾ ਤਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਓ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jeh jeh aausar aae banio hai tahaa tahaa har dhiaaeo |1|
English: Whenever the occasion arises, there, he meditates on the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੋ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਬਿਰਦਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: prabh ko bhagat vachhal biradaaeo |
English: It is the very nature of God to love His devotees;

Gurbani: ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਲਾਡ ਲਡਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kare pratipaal baarik kee niaaee jan kau laadd laddaaeo |1| rahaau |
English: He cherishes His servant, and caresses him as His own child. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਜਨਿ ਗਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: jap tap sanjam karam dharam har keeratan jan gaaeo |
English: The Lord's servant sings the Kirtan of His Praises as his worship, deep meditation, self-discipline and religious observances.

Gurbani: ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੀ ਅਭੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੨॥੩॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: saran pario naanak tthaakur kee abhai daan sukh paaeo |2|3|12|
English: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of his Lord and Master, and has received the blessings of fearlessness and peace. ||2||3||12||

[Ang 498 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਆਰਾਧਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੋ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਢੀਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: din raatee aaraadhahu piaaro nimakh na keejai dteelaa |
English: Worship the Lord in adoration, day and night, O my dear - do not delay for a moment.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਲਾਈਐ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਹਾਠੀਲਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sant sevaa kar bhaavanee laaeeai tiaag maan haattheelaa |1|
English: Serve the Saints with loving faith, and set aside your pride and stubbornness. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮਾਨ ਰਾਗੀਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: mohan praan maan raageelaa |
English: The fascinating, playful Lord is my very breath of life and honor.

Gurbani: ਬਾਸਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਹੀਅਰੇ ਕੈ ਸੰਗੇ ਪੇਖਿ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: baas rahio heeare kai sange pekh mohio man leelaa |1| rahaau |
English: He abides in my heart; beholding His playful games, my mind is fascinated. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਤ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਉਤਰੈ ਮਨਹੁ ਜੰਗੀਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: jis simarat man hot anandaa utarai manahu jangeelaa |
English: Remembering Him, my mind is in bliss, and the rust of my mind is removed.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਬੇ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰੈ ਪਰੀਲਾ ॥੨॥੪॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: milabe kee mahimaa baran na saakau naanak parai pareelaa |2|4|13|
English: The great honor of meeting the Lord cannot be described; O Nanak, it is infinite, beyond measure. ||2||4||13||

[Ang 498 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੁਨਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰਗਿ ਕਹਾਵਤ ਸਭ ਕੀਨੑੇ ਬਸਿ ਅਪਨਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: mun jogee saasatrag kahaavat sabh keenae bas apanahee |
English: They call themselves silent sages, Yogis and scholars of the Shaastras, but Maya has has them all under her control.

Gurbani: ਤੀਨਿ ਦੇਵ ਅਰੁ ਕੋੜਿ ਤੇਤੀਸਾ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਹੈਰਤਿ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਰਹੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: teen dev ar korr teteesaa tin kee hairat kachh na rahee |1|
English: The three gods, and the 330,000,000 demi-gods, were astonished. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਲਵੰਤਿ ਬਿਆਪਿ ਰਹੀ ਸਭ ਮਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: balavant biaap rahee sabh mahee |
English: The power of Maya is pervading everywhere.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਸਿ ਕੋਊ ਮਰਮਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਲਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: avar na jaanas koaoo maramaa gur kirapaa te lahee |1| rahaau |
English: Her secret is known only by Guru's Grace - no one else knows it. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੀਤਿ ਜੀਤਿ ਜੀਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਥਾਨਾ ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਲਪਟਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jeet jeet jeete sabh thaanaa sagal bhavan lapattahee |
English: Conquering and conquering, she has conquered everywhere, and she clings to the whole world.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਤੇ ਭਾਗੀ ਹੋਇ ਚੇਰੀ ਚਰਨ ਗਹੀ ॥੨॥੫॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak saadh te bhaagee hoe cheree charan gahee |2|5|14|
English: Says Nanak, she surrenders to the Holy Saint; becoming his servant, she falls at his feet. ||2||5||14||

[Ang 499 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਕਰੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: due kar jorr karee benantee tthaakur apanaa dhiaaeaa |
English: With my palms pressed together, I offer my prayer, meditating on my Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਰਾਖੇ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਸਗਲਾ ਦੁਰਤੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: haath dee raakhe paramesar sagalaa durat mittaaeaa |1|
English: Giving me His hand, the Transcendent Lord has saved me, and erased all my sins. ||1||

Gurbani: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹੋਏ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
Transliteration: tthaakur hoe aap deaal |
English: The Lord and Master Himself has become merciful.

Gurbani: ਭਈ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਆਨੰਦ ਰੂਪ ਹੁਈ ਹੈ ਉਬਰੇ ਬਾਲ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhee kaliaan aanand roop huee hai ubare baal gupaal |1| rahaau |
English: I have been emancipated, the embodiment of bliss; I am the child of the Lord of the Universe - He has carried me across. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਵਰ ਨਾਰੀ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਆ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਾ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: mil var naaree mangal gaaeaa tthaakur kaa jaikaar |
English: Meeting her Husband, the soul-bride sings the songs of joy, and celebrates her Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਭ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥੬॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak tis gur balihaaree jin sabh kaa keea udhaar |2|6|15|
English: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Guru, who has emancipated everyone. ||2||6||15||

[Ang 499 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਬਲੁ ਹੈ ਥੋਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: maat pitaa bhaaee sut bandhap tin kaa bal hai thoraa |
English: Mother, father, siblings, children and relatives - their power is insignificant.

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਪੇਖੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਭੋਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: anik rang maaeaa ke pekhe kichh saath na chaalai bhoraa |1|
English: I have seen the many pleasures of Maya, but none goes with them in the end. ||1||

Gurbani: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਆਹਿ ਨ ਮੋਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: tthaakur tujh bin aaeh na moraa |
English: O Lord Master, other than You, no one is mine.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਅਨਾਥ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੈ ਆਹਿਓ ਤੁਮੑਰਾ ਧੋਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mohi anaath niragun gun naahee mai aahio tumaraa dhoraa |1| rahaau |
English: I am a worthless orphan, devoid of merit; I long for Your Support. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਚਰਣ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ਜੋਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: bal bal bal bal charan tumaare eehaa aoohaa tumaaraa joraa |
English: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice to Your lotus feet; here and hereafter, Yours is the only power.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਹੋਰਾ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: saadhasang naanak daras paaeo binasio sagal nihoraa |2|7|16|
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak has obtained the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; my obligations to all others are annulled. ||2||7||16||

[Ang 499 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਲ ਜਾਲ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਤਜਾਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੇਤੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aal jaal bhram moh tajaavai prabh setee rang laaee |
English: He rids us of entanglements, doubt and emotional attachment, and leads us to love God.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕਉ ਇਹ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: man kau ih upades drirraavai sehaj sehaj gun gaaee |1|
English: He implants this instruction in our minds, for us to sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, in peace and poise. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਾਜਨ ਐਸੋ ਸੰਤੁ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: saajan aiso sant sahaaee |
English: O friend, the Saintly Guru is such a helper.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਤੂਟਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਬੰਧ ਬਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jis bhette tootteh maaeaa bandh bisar na kabahoon jaaee |1| rahaau |
English: Meeting Him, the bonds of Maya are released, and one never forgets the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਰਤ ਕਰਤ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤੀ ਨੀਕੀ ਇਹ ਠਹਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: karat karat anik bahu bhaatee neekee ih tthaharaaee |
English: Practicing, practicing various actions in so many ways, I came to recognize this as the best way.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਈ ॥੨॥੮॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: mil saadhoo har jas gaavai naanak bhavajal paar paraaee |2|8|17|
English: Joining the Company of the Holy, Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and crosses over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||8||17||

[Ang 499 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਨਹਾਰਾ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਕਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: khin meh thaap uthaapanahaaraa keemat jaae na karee |
English: In an instant, He establishes and disestablishes; His value cannot be described.

Gurbani: ਰਾਜਾ ਰੰਕੁ ਕਰੈ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਨੀਚਹ ਜੋਤਿ ਧਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: raajaa rank karai khin bheetar neechah jot dharee |1|
English: He turns the king into a beggar in an instant, and He infuses splendor into the lowly. ||1||

Gurbani: ਧਿਆਈਐ ਅਪਨੋ ਸਦਾ ਹਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: dhiaaeeai apano sadaa haree |
English: Meditate forever on Your Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੋਚ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੀਐ ਜਾ ਮਹਿ ਏਕ ਘਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: soch andesaa taa kaa kahaa kareeai jaa meh ek gharee |1| rahaau |
English: Why should I feel worry or anxiety, when I am here for only a short time. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਪੂਰੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੈ ਪਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: tumaree ttek poore mere satigur man saran tumaarai paree |
English: You are my support, O my Perfect True Guru; my mind has taken to the protection of Your Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਅਚੇਤ ਇਆਨੇ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਧਾਰਿ ਕਰੀ ॥੨॥੯॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: achet eaane baarik naanak ham tum raakhahu dhaar karee |2|9|18|
English: Nanak, I am a foolish and ignorant child; reach out to me with Your hand, Lord, and save me. ||2||9||18||

[Ang 499 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੀਆ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਬਸਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: toon daataa jeea sabhanaa kaa basahu mere man maahee |
English: You are the Giver of all beings; please, come to dwell within my mind.

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਰਿਦ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਤਹ ਭਰਮੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: charan kamal rid maeh samaae teh bharam andheraa naahee |1|
English: That heart, within which Your lotus feet are enshrined, suffers no darkness or doubt. ||1||

Gurbani: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਜਾ ਸਿਮਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਤਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: tthaakur jaa simaraa toon taahee |
English: O Lord Master, wherever I remember You, there I find You.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਰਬ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa sarab pratipaalak prabh kau sadaa salaahee |1| rahaau |
English: Show Mercy to me, O God, Cherisher of all, that I may sing Your Praises forever. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਰਉ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: saas saas teraa naam samaarau tum hee kau prabh aahee |
English: With each and every breath, I contemplate Your Name; O God, I long for You alone.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਟੇਕ ਭਈ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀ ਹੋਰ ਆਸ ਬਿਡਾਣੀ ਲਾਹੀ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: naanak ttek bhee karate kee hor aas biddaanee laahee |2|10|19|
English: O Nanak, my support is the Creator Lord; I have renounced all other hopes. ||2||10||19||

[Ang 500 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪਨਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਉ ਨਿਸਿ ਅਰੁ ਭੋਰ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa apanaa daras deejai jas gaavau nis ar bhor |
English: Show Mercy to me, and grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. I sing Your Praises night and day.

Gurbani: ਕੇਸ ਸੰਗਿ ਦਾਸ ਪਗ ਝਾਰਉ ਇਹੈ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਮੋਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kes sang daas pag jhaarau ihai manorath mor |1|
English: With my hair, I wash the feet of Your slave; this is my life's purpose. ||1||

Gurbani: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੀਆ ਨ ਹੋਰ ॥
Transliteration: tthaakur tujh bin beea na hor |
English: O Lord and Master, without You, there is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਚਿਤਿ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨ ਅਰਾਧਉ ਨਿਰਖਉ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਓਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: chit chitvau har rasan araadhau nirkhau tumaree or |1| rahaau |
English: O Lord, in my mind I remain conscious of You; with my tongue I worship You, and with my eyes, I gaze upon You. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਸਰਬ ਕੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰਉ ਕਰ ਜੋਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: deaal purakh sarab ke tthaakur binau krau kar jor |
English: O Merciful Lord, O Lord and Master of all, with my palms pressed together I pray to You.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੁਮਰੋ ਉਧਰਸਿ ਆਖੀ ਫੋਰ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: naam japai naanak daas tumaro udharas aakhee for |2|11|20|
English: Nanak, Your slave, chants Your Name, and is redeemed in the twinkling of an eye. ||2||11||20||

[Ang 500 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਲੋਕ ਅਰੁ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਲੋਕ ਆਈ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਲੋਕ ਤੇ ਧਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: braham lok ar rudr lok aaee indr lok te dhaae |
English: Overwhelming the realm of Brahma, the realm of Shiva and the realm of Indra, Maya has come running here.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਉ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਧੋਵੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saadhasangat kau johi na saakai mal mal dhovai paae |1|
English: But she cannot touch the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; she washes and massages their feet. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਆਇ ਪਰਿਓ ਸਰਨਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: ab mohi aae pario saranaae |
English: Now, I have come and entered the Lord's Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਗੁਹਜ ਪਾਵਕੋ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਜਾਰੈ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਓ ਹੈ ਬਤਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: guhaj paavako bahut prajaarai mo kau satigur deeo hai bataae |1| rahaau |
English: This awful fire has burned so many; the True Guru has cautioned me about it. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਅਰੁ ਜਖੵ ਕਿੰਨਰ ਨਰ ਰਹੀ ਕੰਠਿ ਉਰਝਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sidh saadhik ar jakhay kinar nar rahee kantth urajhaae |
English: It clings to the necks of the Siddhas, and the seekers, the demi-gods, angels and mortals.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਗੁ ਕੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕੋਟਿ ਐਸੀ ਦਾਸਾਇ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੨੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak ang keea prabh karatai jaa kai kott aisee daasaae |2|12|21|
English: Servant Nanak has the support of God the Creator, who has millions of slaves like her. ||2||12||21||

[Ang 500 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਪਜਸੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਗਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਬੈਸਣੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: apajas mittai hovai jag keerat daragah baisan paaeeai |
English: His bad reputation is erased, he is acclaimed all over the world, and he obtains a seat in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਨਾਸ ਹੋਇ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਸੁਖ ਅਨਦ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jam kee traas naas hoe khin meh sukh anad setee ghar jaaeeai |1|
English: The fear of death is removed in an instant, and he goes to the Lord's House in peace and bliss. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਘਾਲ ਨ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: jaa te ghaal na birathee jaaeeai |
English: His works do not go in vain.

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar simarahu prabh apanaa man tan sadaa dhiaaeeai |1| rahaau |
English: Twenty-four hours a day, remember your God in meditation; meditate on Him continually in your mind and body. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: mohi saran deen dukh bhanjan toon dehi soee prabh paaeeai |
English: I seek Your Sanctuary, O Destroyer of the pains of the poor; whatever You give me, God, that is what I receive.

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਹ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈਐ ॥੨॥੧੩॥੨੨॥
Transliteration: charan kamal naanak rang raate har daasah paij rakhaaeeai |2|13|22|
English: Nanak is imbued with the love of Your lotus feet; O Lord, please preserve the honor of Your slave. ||2||13||22||

[Ang 500 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬਿਸ੍ਵੰਭਰ ਜੀਅਨ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: bisvanbhar jeean ko daataa bhagat bhare bhanddaar |
English: The all-sustaining Lord is the Giver of all beings; His devotional worship is an overflowing treasure.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਿਫਲ ਨ ਹੋਵਤ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਰੇ ਉਧਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jaa kee sevaa nifal na hovat khin meh kare udhaar |1|
English: Service to Him is not wasted; in an instant, He emancipates. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਚੁ ॥
Transliteration: man mere charan kamal sang raach |
English: O my mind, immerse yourself in the Lord's lotus feet.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਜੀਅ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਆਰਾਧਹਿ ਤਾਹੂ ਕਉ ਤੂੰ ਜਾਚੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sagal jeea jaa kau aaraadheh taahoo kau toon jaach |1| rahaau |
English: Seek from Him, who is worshipped by all beings. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ਕਰਤੇ ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: naanak saran tumaaree karate toon prabh praan adhaar |
English: Nanak has entered Your Sanctuary, O Creator Lord; You, O God, are the support of my breath of life.

Gurbani: ਹੋਇ ਸਹਾਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੨॥੧੪॥੨੩॥
Transliteration: hoe sahaaee jis toon raakheh tis kahaa kare sansaar |2|14|23|
English: He who is protected by You, O Helper Lord - what can the world do to him? ||2||14||23||

[Ang 500 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੀ ਆਪ ॥
Transliteration: jan kee paij savaaree aap |
English: The Lord Himself has protected the honor of His humble servant.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਅਵਖਧੁ ਉਤਰਿ ਗਇਓ ਸਭੁ ਤਾਪ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam deeo gur avakhadh utar geo sabh taap |1| rahaau |
English: The Guru has given the medicine of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, and all afflictions are gone. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਰਖਿਓ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: harigobind rakhio paramesar apunee kirapaa dhaar |
English: The Transcendent Lord, in His Mercy, has preserved Har Gobind.

Gurbani: ਮਿਟੀ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਹੋਏ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਦਾ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mittee biaadh sarab sukh hoe har gun sadaa beechaar |1|
English: The disease is over, and there is joy all around; we ever contemplate the Glories of God. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਓ ਮੇਰੈ ਕਰਤੈ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: angeekaar keeo merai karatai gur poore kee vaddiaaee |
English: My Creator Lord has made me His own; such is the glorious greatness of the Perfect Guru.

Gurbani: ਅਬਿਚਲ ਨੀਵ ਧਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਈ ॥੨॥੧੫॥੨੪॥
Transliteration: abichal neev dharee gur naanak nit nit charrai savaaee |2|15|24|
English: Guru Nanak laid the immovable foundation, which grows higher and higher each day. ||2||15||24||

[Ang 500 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਬਹੂ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚੀਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: kabahoo har siau cheet na laaeo |
English: You never focused your consciousness on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਧੰਧਾ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਹਾਨੀ ਅਉਧਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਗਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dhandhaa karat bihaanee aaudheh gun nidh naam na gaaeo |1| rahaau |
English: You have spent your life engaged in worldly pursuits; you have not sung the Glorious Praises of the treasure of the Naam. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਉਡੀ ਕਉਡੀ ਜੋਰਤ ਕਪਟੇ ਅਨਿਕ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਧਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: kauddee kauddee jorat kapatte anik jugat kar dhaaeo |
English: Shell by shell, you accumulate money; in various ways, you work for this.

Gurbani: ਬਿਸਰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਤੇ ਦੁਖ ਗਨੀਅਹਿ ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਖਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bisarat prabh kete dukh ganeeeh mahaa mohanee khaaeo |1|
English: Forgetting God, you suffer awful pain beyond measure, and you are consumed by the Great Enticer, Maya. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਰਹੁ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਗਨਹੁ ਨ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਮਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: karahu anugrahu suaamee mere ganahu na mohi kamaaeo |
English: Show Mercy to me, O my Lord and Master, and do not hold me to account for my actions.

Gurbani: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਇਓ ॥੨॥੧੬॥੨੫॥
Transliteration: gobind deaal kripaal sukh saagar naanak har saranaaeo |2|16|25|
English: O merciful and compassionate Lord God, ocean of peace, Nanak has taken to Your Sanctuary, Lord. ||2||16||25||

[Ang 501 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਵੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: rasanaa raam raam ravant |
English: With your tongue, chant the Lord's Name, Raam, Raam.

Gurbani: ਛੋਡਿ ਆਨ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਭਜੁ ਸਦਾ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: chhodd aan biauhaar mithiaa bhaj sadaa bhagavant |1| rahaau |
English: Renounce other false occupations, and vibrate forever on the Lord God. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਏਕੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਭਗਤਾ ਈਤ ਆਗੈ ਟੇਕ ॥
Transliteration: naam ek adhaar bhagataa eet aagai ttek |
English: The One Name is the support of His devotees; in this world, and in the world hereafter, it is their anchor and support.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਦੀਆ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kar kripaa gobind deea gur giaan budh bibek |1|
English: In His mercy and kindness, the Guru has given me the divine wisdom of God, and a discriminating intellect. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥ ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: karan kaaran samrath sreedhar saran taa kee gahee |
English: The all-powerful Lord is the Creator, the Cause of causes; He is the Master of wealth - I seek His Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਰਵਾਲ ਸਾਧੂ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਲਹੀ ॥੨॥੧੭॥੨੬॥
Transliteration: mukat jugat ravaal saadhoo naanak har nidh lahee |2|17|26|
English: Liberation and worldly success come from the dust of the feet of the Holy Saints; Nanak has obtained the Lord's treasure. ||2||17||26||

[Ang 501 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ghar 4 chaupade |
English: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House, Chau-Padhay:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਛਾਡਿ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਸਾਧ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਉ ॥
Transliteration: chhaadd sagal siaanapaa saadh saranee aau |
English: Give up all your clever tricks, and seek the Sanctuary of the Holy Saint.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: paarabraham paramesaro prabhoo ke gun gaau |1|
English: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰੇ ਚਿਤ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਅਰਾਧਿ ॥
Transliteration: re chit charan kamal araadh |
English: O my consciousness, contemplate and adore the Lotus Feet of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਿਟੈ ਸਗਲ ਉਪਾਧਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sarab sookh kaliaan paaveh mittai sagal upaadh |1| rahaau |
English: You shall obtain total peace and salvation, and all troubles shall depart. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਮੀਤ ਭਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: maat pitaa sut meet bhaaee tis binaa nahee koe |
English: Mother, father, children, friends and siblings - without the Lord, none of them are real.

Gurbani: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਜੀਅ ਨਾਲਿ ਸੰਗੀ ਸਰਬ ਰਵਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: eet aoot jeea naal sangee sarab raviaa soe |2|
English: Here and hereafter, He is the companion of the soul; He is pervading everywhere. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਤਨ ਉਪਾਵ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕਾਮਿ ॥
Transliteration: kott jatan upaav mithiaa kachh na aavai kaam |
English: Millions of plans, tricks, and efforts are of no use, and serve no purpose.

Gurbani: ਸਰਣਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: saran saadhoo niramalaa gat hoe prabh kai naam |3|
English: In the Sanctuary of the Holy, one becomes immaculate and pure, and obtains salvation, through the Name of God. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅਗਮ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਊਚਾ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: agam deaal prabhoo aoochaa saran saadhoo jog |
English: God is profound and merciful, lofty and exalted; He gives Sanctuary to the Holy.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੨੭॥
Transliteration: tis paraapat naanakaa jis likhiaa dhur sanjog |4|1|27|
English: He alone obtains the Lord, O Nanak, who is blessed with such pre-ordained destiny to meet Him. ||4||1||27||

[Ang 501 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਪਨਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਰਮਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: aapanaa gur sev sad hee ramahu gun gobind |
English: Serve your Guru forever, and chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਦ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saas saas araadh har har leh jaae man kee chind |1|
English: With each and every breath, worship the Lord, Har, Har, in adoration, and the anxiety of your mind will be dispelled. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਾਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mere man jaap prabh kaa naau |
English: O my mind, chant the Name of God.

Gurbani: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sookh sehaj anand paaveh milee niramal thaau |1| rahaau |
English: You shall be blessed with peace, poise and pleasure, and you shall find the immaculate place. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਾਰਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਆਰਾਧਿ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang udhaar ihu man aatth pehar aaraadh |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, redeem your mind, and adore the Lord, twenty-four hours a day.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਮਿਟੈ ਸਗਲ ਉਪਾਧਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh ahankaar binasai mittai sagal upaadh |2|
English: Sexual desire, anger and egotism will be dispelled, and all troubles shall end. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਟਲ ਅਛੇਦ ਅਭੇਦ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਆਉ ॥
Transliteration: attal achhed abhed suaamee saran taa kee aau |
English: The Lord Master is immovable, immortal and inscrutable; seek His Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਏਕ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: charan kamal araadh hiradai ek siau liv laau |3|
English: Worship in adoration the lotus feet of the Lord in your heart, and center your consciousness lovingly on Him alone. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰੀ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੀਨੑੇ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham prabh deaa dhaaree bakhas leenae aap |
English: The Supreme Lord God has shown mercy to me, and He Himself has forgiven me.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੪॥੨॥੨੮॥
Transliteration: sarab sukh har naam deea naanak so prabh jaap |4|2|28|
English: The Lord has given me His Name, the treasure of peace; O Nanak, meditate on that God. ||4||2||28||

[Ang 501 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗਈ ਸੰਕਾ ਤੂਟਿ ॥
Transliteration: gur prasaadee prabh dhiaaeaa gee sankaa toott |
English: By Guru's Grace, I meditate on God, and my doubts are gone.

Gurbani: ਦੁਖ ਅਨੇਰਾ ਭੈ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਪਾਪ ਗਏ ਨਿਖੂਟਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dukh aneraa bhai binaase paap ge nikhoott |1|
English: Pain, ignorance and fear have left me, and my sins have been dispelled. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam kee man preet |
English: My mind is filled with love for the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧ ਬਚਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਧਿਆਏ ਮਹਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mil saadh bachan gobind dhiaae mahaa niramal reet |1| rahaau |
English: Meeting the Holy Saint, under His Instruction, I meditate on the Lord of the Universe, in the most immaculate way. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਅਨੇਕ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਫਲ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: jaap taap anek karanee safal simarat naam |
English: Chanting, deep meditation and various rituals are contained in the fruitful meditative remembrance of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਭਏ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kar anugrahu aap raakhe bhe pooran kaam |2|
English: Showing His Mercy, the Lord Himself has protected me, and all my works have been brought to fruition. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਨ ਬਿਸਰੁ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਮਰਥ ॥
Transliteration: saas saas na bisar kabahoon braham prabh samarath |
English: With each and every breath, may I never forget You, O God, Almighty Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਅਨਿਕ ਰਸਨਾ ਕਿਆ ਬਖਾਨੈ ਅਗਨਤ ਸਦਾ ਅਕਥ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gun anik rasanaa kiaa bakhaanai aganat sadaa akath |3|
English: How can my tongue describe Your countless virtues? They are uncountable, and forever indescribable. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦੀਨ ਦਰਦ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਤਾਰਣ ਦਇਆਲ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਣ ॥
Transliteration: deen darad nivaar taaran deaal kirapaa karan |
English: You are the Remover of the pains of the poor, the Savior, the Compassionate Lord, the Bestower of Mercy.

Gurbani: ਅਟਲ ਪਦਵੀ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣ ॥੪॥੩॥੨੯॥
Transliteration: attal padavee naam simaran drirr naanak har har saran |4|3|29|
English: Remembering the Naam in meditation, the state of eternal dignity is obtained; Nanak has grasped the protection of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||3||29||

[Ang 502 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਬਹੁ ਸਘਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਾ ਦੀਰਘ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: ahanbudh bahu saghan maaeaa mahaa deeragh rog |
English: Intellectual egotism and great love for Maya are the most serious chronic diseases.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਨੋ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har naam aaukhadh gur naam deeno karan kaaran jog |1|
English: The Lord's Name is the medicine, which is potent to cure everything. The Guru has given me the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਾਛੀਐ ਜਨ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: man tan baachheeai jan dhoor |
English: My mind and body yearn for the dust of the Lord's humble servants.

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਲਹਹਿ ਪਾਤਿਕ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਲੋਚਾ ਪੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kott janam ke laheh paatik gobind lochaa poor |1| rahaau |
English: With it, the sins of millions of incarnations are obliterated. O Lord of the Universe, please fulfill my desire. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤੇ ਮਧਿ ਆਸਾ ਕੂਕਰੀ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: aad ante madh aasaa kookaree bikaraal |
English: In the beginning, in the middle, and in the end, one is hounded by dreadful desires.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਰਮਣੰ ਕਾਟੀਐ ਜਮ ਜਾਲ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur giaan keeratan gobind ramanan kaatteeai jam jaal |2|
English: Through the Guru's spiritual wisdom, we sing the Kirtan of the Praises of the Lord of the Universe, and the noose of death is cut away. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਮੂਠੇ ਸਦਾ ਆਵਾ ਗਵਣ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh lobh moh mootthe sadaa aavaa gavan |
English: Those who are cheated by sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment suffer reincarnation forever.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਮਿਟਤ ਜੋਨੀ ਭਵਣ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: prabh prem bhagat gupaal simaran mittat jonee bhavan |3|
English: By loving devotional worship to God, and meditative remembrance of the Lord of the World, one's wandering in reincarnation is ended. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਰ ਰਿਦ ਤੀਨਿ ਤਾਪ ਜਲੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: mitr putr kalatr sur rid teen taap jalant |
English: Friends, children, spouses and well-wishers are burnt by the three fevers.

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮਾ ਦੁਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸੰਤ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jap raam raamaa dukh nivaare milai har jan sant |4|
English: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, one's miseries are ended, as one meets the Saintly servants of the Lord. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਬਿਧਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਤੇ ਪੁਕਾਰਹਿ ਕਤਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਛੋਟਿ ॥
Transliteration: sarab bidh bhramate pukaareh kateh naahee chhott |
English: Wandering around in all directions, they cry out, "Nothing can save us!"

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਅਪਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਗਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਓਟ ॥੫॥੪॥੩੦॥
Transliteration: har charan saran apaar prabh ke drirr gahee naanak ott |5|4|30|
English: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Lotus Feet of the Infinite Lord; he holds fast to their Support. ||5||4||30||

[Ang 502 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ghar 4 dupade |
English: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House, Dho-Padhay:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਆਰਾਧਿ ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: aaraadh sreedhar safal moorat karan kaaran jog |
English: Worship and adore the Lord of wealth, the fulfilling vision, the Almighty Cause of causes.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਰਮਣ ਸ੍ਰਵਣ ਅਪਾਰ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਤ ਬਿਓਗੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gun raman sravan apaar mahimaa fir na hot biog |1|
English: Uttering His Praises, and hearing of His infinite glory, you shall never suffer separation from Him again. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਚਰਣਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਉਪਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: man charanaarabind upaas |
English: O my mind, worship the Lord's Lotus Feet.

Gurbani: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਿਟੰਤ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ ਕਾਟਿ ਜਮਦੂਤ ਫਾਸ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kal kales mittant simaran kaatt jamadoot faas |1| rahaau |
English: Meditating in remembrance, strife and sorrow are ended, and the noose of the Messenger of Death is snapped. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਦਹਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕਹਨ ਅਵਰ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਉਪਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: satru dehan har naam kehan avar kachh na upaau |
English: Chant the Name of the Lord, and your enemies shall be consumed; there is no other way.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੨॥੧॥੩੧॥
Transliteration: kar anugrahu prabhoo mere naanak naam suaau |2|1|31|
English: Show Mercy, O my God, and bestow upon Nanak the taste of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||1||31||

[Ang 502 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਸੁਖ ਰਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: toon samarath saran ko daataa dukh bhanjan sukh raae |
English: You are the Almighty Lord, the Giver of Sanctuary, the Destroyer of pain, the King of happiness.

Gurbani: ਜਾਹਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਿਟੇ ਭੈ ਭਰਮਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗੁਣ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jaeh kales mitte bhai bharamaa niramal gun prabh gaae |1|
English: Troubles depart, and fear and doubt are dispelled, singing the Glorious Praises of the Immaculate Lord God. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਠਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: govind tujh bin avar na tthaau |
English: O Lord of the Universe, without You, there is no other place.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਪੀ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਨਾਉ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa paarabraham suaamee japee tumaaraa naau | rahaau |
English: Show Mercy to me, O Supreme Lord Master, that I may chant Your Name. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਿ ਲਗੇ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨੀ ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sev lage har charanee vaddai bhaag liv laagee |
English: Serving the True Guru, I am attached to the Lord's Lotus Feet; by great good fortune, I have embraced love for Him.

Gurbani: ਕਵਲ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਭਏ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kaval pragaas bhe saadhasange duramat budh tiaagee |2|
English: My heart lotus blossoms forth in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; I have renounced evil-mindedness and intellectualism. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਦੀਨ ਦੈਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar har ke gun gaavai simarai deen daiaalaa |
English: One who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, twenty-four hours a day, and remembers the Lord in meditation, who is Kind to the poor,

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਭ ਉਧਰੈ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਗਲ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aap tarai sangat sabh udharai binase sagal janjaalaa |3|
English: saves himself, and redeems all his generations; all of his bonds are released. ||3||

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
Transliteration: charan adhaar teraa prabh suaamee ot pot prabh saath |
English: I take the Support of Your Feet, O God, O Lord and Master; you are with me through and through, God.

Gurbani: ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਦੇ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਹਾਥ ॥੪॥੨॥੩੨॥
Transliteration: saran pario naanak prabh tumaree de raakhio har haath |4|2|32|
English: Nanak has entered Your Sanctuary, God; giving him His hand, the Lord has protected him. ||4||2||32||

[Ang 503 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree asattapadeea mahalaa 1 ghar 1 |
English: Goojaree, Ashtpadheeyaa, First Mehl, First House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਨਗਰੀ ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਬਸੀਅਲੇ ਬਰਜਤ ਚੋਰੀ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: ek nagaree panch chor baseeale barajat choree dhaavai |
English: In the one village of the body, live the five thieves; they have been warned, but they still go out stealing.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਹਦਸ ਮਾਲ ਰਖੈ ਜੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੋਖ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: trihadas maal rakhai jo naanak mokh mukat so paavai |1|
English: One who keeps his assets safe from the three modes and the ten passions, O Nanak, attains liberation and emancipation. ||1||

Gurbani: ਚੇਤਹੁ ਬਾਸੁਦੇਉ ਬਨਵਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: chetahu baasudeo banavaalee |
English: Center your mind on the all-pervading Lord, the Wearer of garlands of the jungles.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਜਪਮਾਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raam ridai japamaalee |1| rahaau |
English: Let your rosary be the chanting of the Lord's Name in your heart. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਉਰਧ ਮੂਲ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਾਖ ਤਲਾਹਾ ਚਾਰਿ ਬੇਦ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: auradh mool jis saakh talaahaa chaar bed jit laage |
English: Its roots extend upwards, and its branches reach down; the four Vedas are attached to it.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜ ਭਾਇ ਜਾਇ ਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਲਿਵ ਜਾਗੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sehaj bhaae jaae te naanak paarabraham liv jaage |2|
English: He alone reaches this tree with ease, O Nanak, who remains wakeful in the Love of the Supreme Lord God. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਜਾਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਗਨਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਪੁਹਪ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਤਤੁ ਡਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: paarajaat ghar aagan merai puhap patr tat ddaalaa |
English: The Elysian Tree is the courtyard of my house; in it are the flowers, leaves and stems of reality.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਸੰਭੂ ਛੋਡਹੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sarab jot niranjan sanbhoo chhoddahu bahut janjaalaa |3|
English: Meditate on the self-existent, immaculate Lord, whose Light is pervading everywhere; renounce all your worldly entanglements. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਿਖਵੰਤੇ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬਿਨਵੈ ਛੋਡਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: sun sikhavante naanak binavai chhoddahu maaeaa jaalaa |
English: Listen, O seekers of Truth - Nanak begs you to renounce the traps of Maya.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਪੁਨਰਪਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਕਾਲਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: man beechaar ek liv laagee punarap janam na kaalaa |4|
English: Reflect within your mind, that by enshrining love for the One Lord, you shall not be subject to birth and death again. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਗੁਰੂ ਸੋ ਸਿਖੁ ਕਥੀਅਲੇ ਸੋ ਵੈਦੁ ਜਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਰੋਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: so guroo so sikh katheeale so vaid ji jaanai rogee |
English: He alone is said to be a Guru, he alone is said to be a Sikh, and he alone is said to be a physician, who knows the patient's illness.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਕੰਮੁ ਨ ਧੰਧਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਧੰਧੈ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਜੋਗੀ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: tis kaaran kam na dhandhaa naahee dhandhai girahee jogee |5|
English: He is not affected by actions, responsibilities and entanglements; in the entanglements of his household, he maintains the detachment of Yoga. ||5||

Gurbani: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਤਜੀਅਲੇ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh ahankaar tajeeale lobh mohu tis maaeaa |
English: He renounces sexual desire, anger, egotism, greed, attachment and Maya.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਤਤੁ ਅਵਿਗਤੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: man tat avigat dhiaaeaa gur parasaadee paaeaa |6|
English: Within his mind, he meditates on the reality of the Imperishable Lord; by Guru's Grace he finds Him. ||6||

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਸਭ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਥੀਅਲੇ ਸੇਤ ਬਰਨ ਸਭਿ ਦੂਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: giaan dhiaan sabh daat katheeale set baran sabh dootaa |
English: Spiritual wisdom and meditation are all said to be God's gifts; all of the demons are turned white before him.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਮਲ ਮਧੁ ਤਾਸੁ ਰਸਾਦੰ ਜਾਗਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੂਤਾ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: braham kamal madh taas rasaadan jaagat naahee sootaa |7|
English: He enjoys the taste of the honey of God's lotus; he remains awake, and does not fall asleep. ||7||

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਪਾਤਾਲਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਬ ਜੁਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: mahaa ganbheer patr paataalaa naanak sarab juaaeaa |
English: This lotus is very deep; its leaves are the nether regions, and it is connected to the whole universe.

Gurbani: ਉਪਦੇਸ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਮ ਪੁਨਹਿ ਨ ਗਰਭੰ ਬਿਖੁ ਤਜਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਇਆ ॥੮॥੧॥
Transliteration: aupades guroo mam puneh na garabhan bikh taj amrit peeaeaa |8|1|
English: Under Guru's Instruction, I shall not have to enter the womb again; I have renounced the poison of corruption, and I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||8||1||

[Ang 503 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 1 |
English: Goojaree, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਵਨ ਕਵਨ ਜਾਚਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤੇ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਅੰਤ ਨ ਪਰਹਿ ਸੁਮਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: kavan kavan jaacheh prabh daate taa ke ant na pareh sumaar |
English: Those who beg of God the Great Giver - their numbers cannot be counted.

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੀ ਭੂਖ ਹੋਇ ਅਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੂੰ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸਚੁ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jaisee bhookh hoe abh antar toon samarath sach devanahaar |1|
English: You, Almighty True Lord, fulfill the desires within their hearts. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐ ਜੀ ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਚੁ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: ai jee jap tap sanjam sach adhaar |
English: O Dear Lord, chanting, deep meditation, self-discipline and truth are my foundations.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam dehi sukh paaeeai teree bhagat bhare bhanddaar |1| rahaau |
English: Bless me with Your Name, Lord, that I may find peace. Your devotional worship is a treasure over-flowing. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ਏਕਾ ਏਕੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: sun samaadh raheh liv laage ekaa ekee sabad beechaar |
English: Some remain absorbed in Samaadhi, their minds fixed lovingly on the One Lord; they reflect only on the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਜਲੁ ਥਲੁ ਧਰਣਿ ਗਗਨੁ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੁ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jal thal dharan gagan teh naahee aape aap keea karataar |2|
English: In that state, there is no water, land, earth or sky; only the Creator Lord Himself exists. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਤਦਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਗਨੁ ਨ ਛਾਇਆ ਨਾ ਸੂਰਜ ਚੰਦ ਨ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: naa tad maaeaa magan na chhaaeaa naa sooraj chand na jot apaar |
English: There is no intoxication of Maya there, and no shadow, nor the infinite light of the sun or the moon.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਲੋਚਨ ਅਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਏਕਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਸੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸਾਰ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sarab drisatt lochan abh antar ekaa nadar su tribhavan saar |3|
English: The eyes within the mind which see everything - with one glance, they see the three worlds. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪਵਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸ ਅਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: pavan paanee agan tin keea brahamaa bisan mahes akaar |
English: He created air, water and fire, Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva - the whole creation.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬੇ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: sarabe jaachik toon prabh daataa daat kare apunai beechaar |4|
English: All are beggars; You alone are the Great Giver, God. You give Your gifts according to Your own considerations. ||4||

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਜਾਚਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਇਕ ਦੇਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: kott tetees jaacheh prabh naaeik dede tott naahee bhanddaar |
English: Three hundred thirty million gods beg of God the Master; even as He gives, His treasures are never exhausted.

Gurbani: ਊਂਧੈ ਭਾਂਡੈ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਸੀਧੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਰੈ ਨਿਹਾਰ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: aoondhai bhaanddai kachh na samaavai seedhai amrit parai nihaar |5|
English: Nothing can be contained in a vessel turned upside-down; Ambrosial Nectar pours into the upright one. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਚਹਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਜਾਚਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਜੈਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: sidh samaadhee antar jaacheh ridh sidh jaach kareh jaikaar |
English: The Siddhas in Samaadhi beg for wealth and miracles, and proclaim His victory.

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਹੋਇ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੈਸੋ ਜਲੁ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਪਰਕਾਰ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: jaisee piaas hoe man antar taiso jal deveh parakaar |6|
English: As is the thirst within their minds, so is the water which You give to them. ||6||

Gurbani: ਬਡੇ ਭਾਗ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਭੇਦੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਮੁਰਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: badde bhaag gur seveh apunaa bhed naahee guradev muraar |
English: The most fortunate ones serve their Guru; there is no difference between the Divine Guru and the Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕਾਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹੈ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: taa kau kaal naahee jam johai boojheh antar sabad beechaar |7|
English: The Messenger of Death cannot see those who come to realize within their minds the contemplative meditation of the Word of the Shabad. ||7||

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਤਬ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਮਾਗਉ ਹਰਿ ਪਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਦੀਜੈ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: ab tab avar na maagau har peh naam niranjan deejai piaar |
English: I shall never ask anything else of the Lord; please, bless me with the Love of Your Immaculate Name.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਲੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੮॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak chaatrik amrit jal maagai har jas deejai kirapaa dhaar |8|2|
English: Nanak, the song-bird, begs for the Ambrosial Water; O Lord, shower Your Mercy upon him, and bless him with Your Praise. ||8||2||

[Ang 504 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 1 |
English: Goojaree, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਐ ਜੀ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਆਵੈ ਫੁਨਿ ਜਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ai jee janam marai aavai fun jaavai bin gur gat nahee kaaee |
English: O Dear One, he is born, and then dies; he continues coming and going; without the Guru, he is not emancipated.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਾਤੇ ਨਾਮੇ ਗਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: guramukh praanee naame raate naame gat pat paaee |1|
English: Those mortals who become Gurmukhs are attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord; through the Name, they obtain salvation and honor. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: bhaaee re raam naam chit laaee |
English: O Siblings of Destiny, focus your consciousness lovingly on the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਚੇ ਐਸੀ ਨਾਮ ਬਡਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee har prabh jaache aisee naam baddaaee |1| rahaau |
English: By Guru's Grace, one begs of the Lord God; such is the glorious greatness of the Naam. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਐ ਜੀ ਬਹੁਤੇ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਹਿ ਭਿਖਿਆ ਕਉ ਕੇਤੇ ਉਦਰੁ ਭਰਨ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ai jee bahute bhekh kareh bhikhiaa kau kete udar bharan kai taaee |
English: O Dear One, so many wear various religious robes, for begging and filling their bellies.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਰਬੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bin har bhagat naahee sukh praanee bin gur garab na jaaee |2|
English: Without devotional worship to the Lord, O mortal, there can be no peace. Without the Guru, pride does not depart. ||2||

Gurbani: ਐ ਜੀ ਕਾਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਠਾਢੇ ਜਨਮਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਵੈਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ai jee kaal sadaa sir aoopar tthaadte janam janam vairaaee |
English: O Dear One, death hangs constantly over his head. Incarnation after incarnation, it is his enemy.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਬਾਚੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: saachai sabad rate se baache satigur boojh bujhaaee |3|
English: Those who are attuned to the True Word of the Shabad are saved. The True Guru has imparted this understanding. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਦੂਤੁ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਸੰਤਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur saranaaee johi na saakai doot na sakai santaaee |
English: In the Guru's Sanctuary, the Messenger of Death cannot see the mortal, or torture him.

Gurbani: ਅਵਿਗਤ ਨਾਥ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: avigat naath niranjan raate nirbhau siau liv laaee |4|
English: I am imbued with the Imperishable and Immaculate Lord Master, and lovingly attached to the Fearless Lord. ||4||

Gurbani: ਐ ਜੀਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜਹੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਟੇਕ ਟਿਕਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ai jeeo naam dirrahu naame liv laavahu satigur ttek ttikaaee |
English: O Dear One, implant the Naam within me; lovingly attached to the Naam, I lean on the True Guru's Support.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਸੀ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: jo tis bhaavai soee karasee kirat na mettiaa jaaee |5|
English: Whatever pleases Him, He does; no one can erase His actions. ||5||

Gurbani: ਐ ਜੀ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ਮੈ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਦੂਜੀ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ai jee bhaag pare gur saran tumaaree mai avar na doojee bhaaee |
English: O Dear One, I have hurried to the Sanctuary of the Guru; I have no love for any other except You.

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਤਬ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਪੁਕਾਰਉ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: ab tab eko ek pukaarau aad jugaad sakhaaee |6|
English: I constantly call upon the One Lord; since the very beginning, and throughout the ages, He has been my help and support. ||6||

Gurbani: ਐ ਜੀ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਪੈਜ ਨਾਮ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਸਿਉ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: ai jee raakhahu paij naam apune kee tujh hee siau ban aaee |
English: O Dear One, please preserve the Honor of Your Name; I am hand and glove with You.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਵਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਈ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa gur daras dikhaavahu haumai sabad jalaaee |7|
English: Bless me with Your Mercy, and reveal to me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, O Guru. Through the Word of the Shabad, I have burnt away my ego. ||7||

Gurbani: ਐ ਜੀ ਕਿਆ ਮਾਗਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ai jee kiaa maagau kichh rahai na deesai is jag meh aaeaa jaaee |
English: O Dear One, what should I ask of You? Nothing appears permanent; whoever comes into this world shall depart.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕੰਠਿ ਬਣਾਈ ॥੮॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak naam padaarath deejai hiradai kantth banaaee |8|3|
English: Bless Nanak with the wealth of the Naam, to adorn his heart and neck. ||8||3||

[Ang 504 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 1 |
English: Goojaree, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਐ ਜੀ ਨਾ ਹਮ ਉਤਮ ਨੀਚ ਨ ਮਧਿਮ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: ai jee naa ham utam neech na madhim har saranaagat har ke log |
English: O Dear One, I am not high or low or in the middle. I am the Lord's slave, and I seek the Lord's Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਰਤੇ ਕੇਵਲ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਸੋਗ ਬਿਜੋਗ ਬਿਸਰਜਿਤ ਰੋਗ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naam rate keval bairaagee sog bijog bisarajit rog |1|
English: Imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, I am detached from the world; I have forgotten sorrow, separation and disease. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: bhaaee re gur kirapaa te bhagat tthaakur kee |
English: O Siblings of Destiny, by Guru's Grace, I perform devotional worship to my Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਾਕਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾ ਜਮ ਕਾਣਿ ਨ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਬਾਕੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur vaak hiradai har niramal naa jam kaan na jam kee baakee |1| rahaau |
English: One whose heart is filled with the Hymns of the True Guru, obtains the Pure Lord. He is not under the power of the Messenger of Death, nor does he owe Death anything. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਸਨ ਰਵਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗੇ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਹਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: har gun rasan raveh prabh sange jo tis bhaavai sehaj haree |
English: He chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord with his tongue, and abides with God; he does whatever pleases the Lord.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਜਗਿ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਮੇਕ ਘਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bin har naam brithaa jag jeevan har bin nihafal mek gharee |2|
English: Without the Lord's Name, life passes in vain in the world, and every moment is useless. ||2||

Gurbani: ਐ ਜੀ ਖੋਟੇ ਠਉਰ ਨਾਹੀ ਘਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ai jee khotte tthaur naahee ghar baahar nindak gat nahee kaaee |
English: The false have no place of rest, either inside or outside; the slanderer does not find salvation.

Gurbani: ਰੋਸੁ ਕਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਖਸ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ros karai prabh bakhas na mettai nit nit charrai savaaee |3|
English: Even if one is resentful, God does not withhold His blessings; day by day, they increase. ||3||

Gurbani: ਐ ਜੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਈ ਮੇਰੈ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਦਿਵਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ai jee gur kee daat na mettai koee merai tthaakur aap divaaee |
English: No one can take away the Guru's gifts; my Lord and Master Himself has given them.

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਨਰ ਕਾਲੇ ਮੁਖ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਜਿਨੑ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: nindak nar kaale mukh nindaa jina gur kee daat na bhaaee |4|
English: The black-faced slanderers, with slander in their mouths, do not appreciate the Guru's gifts. ||4||

Gurbani: ਐ ਜੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਬਿਲਮ ਨ ਅਧੂਆ ਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ai jee saran pare prabh bakhas milaavai bilam na adhooaa raaee |
English: God forgives and blends with Himself those who take to His Sanctuary; He does not delay for an instant.

Gurbani: ਆਨਦ ਮੂਲੁ ਨਾਥੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਨਾਥਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: aanad mool naath sir naathaa satigur mel milaaee |5|
English: He is the source of bliss, the Greatest Lord; through the True Guru, we are united in His Union. ||5||

Gurbani: ਐ ਜੀ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਨਿ ਚੁਕਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ai jee sadaa deaal deaa kar raviaa guramat bhraman chukaaee |
English: Through His Kindness, the Kind Lord pervades us; through Guru's Teachings, our wanderings cease.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਸੁ ਭੇਟਿ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੋਈ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: paaras bhett kanchan dhaat hoee satasangat kee vaddiaaee |6|
English: Touching the philosopher's stone, metal is transformed into gold. Such is the glorious greatness of the Society of the Saints. ||6||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੀ ਮਜਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har jal niramal man isanaanee majan satigur bhaaee |
English: The Lord is the immaculate water; the mind is the bather, and the True Guru is the bath attendant, O Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਪੁਨਰਪਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਨ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: punarap janam naahee jan sangat jotee jot milaaee |7|
English: That humble being who joins the Sat Sangat shall not be consigned to reincarnation again; his light merges into the Light. ||7||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਗੰਮ ਤਰੋਵਰੁ ਹਮ ਪੰਖੀ ਤੁਝ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: toon vadd purakh agam tarovar ham pankhee tujh maahee |
English: You are the Great Primal Lord, the infinite tree of life; I am a bird perched on Your branches.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਦੀਜੈ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀ ॥੮॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak naam niranjan deejai jug jug sabad salaahee |8|4|
English: Grant to Nanak the Immaculate Naam; throughout the ages, he sings the Praises of the Shabad. ||8||4||

[Ang 505 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 1 ghar 4 |
English: Goojaree, First Mehl, Fourth House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਆਰਾਧਿਤੰ ਸਚੁ ਪਿਆਸ ਪਰਮ ਹਿਤੰ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat prem aaraadhitan sach piaas param hitan |
English: The devotees worship the Lord in loving adoration. They thirst for the True Lord, with infinite affection.

Gurbani: ਬਿਲਲਾਪ ਬਿਲਲ ਬਿਨੰਤੀਆ ਸੁਖ ਭਾਇ ਚਿਤ ਹਿਤੰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bilalaap bilal binanteea sukh bhaae chit hitan |1|
English: They tearfully beg and implore the Lord; in love and affection, their consciousness is at peace. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: jap man naam har saranee |
English: Chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O my mind, and take to His Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਤਾਰਿ ਤਾਰਣ ਰਮ ਨਾਮ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sansaar saagar taar taaran ram naam kar karanee |1| rahaau |
English: The Lord's Name is the boat to cross over the world-ocean. Practice such a way of life. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਏ ਮਨ ਮਿਰਤ ਸੁਭ ਚਿੰਤੰ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਮਣੰ ॥
Transliteration: e man mirat subh chintan gur sabad har ramanan |
English: O mind, even death wishes you well, when you remember the Lord through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਮਤਿ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੰ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਨਿਧਾਨੰ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਮਨਿ ਰਮਣੰ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mat tat giaanan kaliaan nidhaanan har naam man ramanan |2|
English: The intellect receives the treasure, the knowledge of reality and supreme bliss, by repeating the Lord's Name in the mind. ||2||

Gurbani: ਚਲ ਚਿਤ ਵਿਤ ਭ੍ਰਮਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੰ ਜਗੁ ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਹਿਤੰ ॥
Transliteration: chal chit vit bhramaa bhraman jag moh magan hitan |
English: The fickle consciousness wanders around chasing after wealth; it is intoxicated with worldly love and emotional attachment.

Gurbani: ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਦਿੜੰ ਮਤੀ ਗੁਰ ਵਾਕਿ ਸਬਦ ਰਤੰ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: thir naam bhagat dirran matee gur vaak sabad ratan |3|
English: Devotion to the Naam is permanently implanted within the mind, when it is attuned to the Guru's Teachings and His Shabad. ||3||

Gurbani: ਭਰਮਾਤਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਚੂਕਈ ਜਗੁ ਜਨਮਿ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਖਪੰ ॥
Transliteration: bharamaat bharam na chookee jag janam biaadh khapan |
English: Wandering around, doubt is not dispelled; afflicted by reincarnation, the world is being ruined.

Gurbani: ਅਸਥਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੰ ਸਤਿ ਮਤੀ ਨਾਮ ਤਪੰ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: asathaan har nihakevalan sat matee naam tapan |4|
English: The Lord's eternal throne is free of this affliction; he is truly wise, who takes the Naam as his deep meditation. ||4||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਮੋਹ ਹੇਤ ਬਿਆਪਿਤੰ ਦੁਖੁ ਅਧਿਕ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣੰ ॥
Transliteration: eihu jag moh het biaapitan dukh adhik janam maranan |
English: This world is engrossed in attachment and transitory love; it suffers the terrible pains of birth and death.

Gurbani: ਭਜੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਊਬਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦ ਰਮਣੰ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: bhaj saran satigur aoobareh har naam rid ramanan |5|
English: Run to the Sanctuary of the True Guru, chant the Lord's Name in your heart, and you shall swim across. ||5||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਮਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਨੰ ਸਹਜ ਬੀਚਾਰੰ ॥
Transliteration: guramat nihachal man man manan sehaj beechaaran |
English: Following the Guru's Teaching, the mind becomes stable; the mind accepts it, and reflects upon it in peaceful poise.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ ਸਾਰੰ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: so man niramal jit saach antar giaan ratan saaran |6|
English: That mind is pure, which enshrines Truth within, and the most excellent jewel of spiritual wisdom. ||6||

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਤਰੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਮਨਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: bhai bhaae bhagat tar bhavajal manaa chit laae har charanee |
English: By the Fear of God, and Love of God, and by devotion, man crosses over the terrifying world-ocean, focusing his consciousness on the Lord's Lotus Feet.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਪਾਵਨੁ ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਤਉ ਸਰਣੀ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: har naam hiradai pavitru paavan ihu sareer tau saranee |7|
English: The Name of the Lord, the most pure and sacred, is within my heart; this body is Your Sanctuary, Lord. ||7||

Gurbani: ਲਬ ਲੋਭ ਲਹਰਿ ਨਿਵਾਰਣੰ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਾਸਿ ਮਨੰ ॥
Transliteration: lab lobh lehar nivaaranan har naam raas manan |
English: The waves of greed and avarice are subdued, by treasuring the Lord's Name in the mind.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਤੁਹੀ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਾ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਰਨੰ ॥੮॥੧॥੫॥
Transliteration: man maar tuhee niranjanaa kahu naanakaa saranan |8|1|5|
English: Subdue my mind, O Pure Immaculate Lord; says Nanak, I have entered Your Sanctuary. ||8||1||5||

[Ang 506 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 3 ghar 1 |
English: Goojaree, Third Mehl, First House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਚਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: nirat karee ihu man nachaaee |
English: I dance, and make this mind dance as well.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee aap gavaaee |
English: By Guru's Grace, I eliminate my self-conceit.

Gurbani: ਚਿਤੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੋ ਇਛੀ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: chit thir raakhai so mukat hovai jo ichhee soee fal paaee |1|
English: One who keeps his consciousness focused on the Lord is liberated; he obtains the fruits of his desires. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਾਚੁ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਆਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: naach re man gur kai aagai |
English: So dance, O mind, before your Guru.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਨਾਚਹਿ ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਅੰਤੇ ਜਮ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai bhaanai naacheh taa sukh paaveh ante jam bhau bhaagai | rahaau |
English: If you dance according to the Guru's Will, you shall obtain peace, and in the end, the fear of death shall leave you. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਨਚਾਏ ਸੋ ਭਗਤੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਆਪਣਾ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਆਪਿ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aap nachaae so bhagat kaheeai aapanaa piaar aap laae |
English: One whom the Lord Himself causes to dance, is called a devotee. He Himself links us to His Love.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਗਾਵੈ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਅੰਧੇ ਕਉ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aape gaavai aap sunaavai is man andhe kau maarag paae |2|
English: He Himself sings, He Himself listens, and He puts this blind mind on the right path. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਚੈ ਸਕਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਸਿਵ ਘਰਿ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: anadin naachai sakat nivaarai siv ghar need na hoee |
English: One who dances night and day, and banishes Shakti's Maya, enters the House of the Lord Shiva, where there is no sleep.

Gurbani: ਸਕਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਸੂਤਾ ਨਾਚੈ ਟਾਪੈ ਅਵਰੋ ਗਾਵੈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sakatee ghar jagat sootaa naachai ttaapai avaro gaavai manamukh bhagat na hoee |3|
English: The world is asleep in Maya, the house of Shakti; it dances, jumps and sings in duality. The self-willed manmukh has no devotion. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਵਿਰਤਿ ਪਖਿ ਕਰਮੀ ਨਾਚੇ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: sur nar virat pakh karamee naache mun jan giaan beechaaree |
English: The angels, mortals, renunciates, ritualists, silent sages and beings of spiritual wisdom dance.

Gurbani: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਨਾਚੇ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: sidh saadhik liv laagee naache jin guramukh budh veechaaree |4|
English: The Siddhas and seekers, lovingly focused on the Lord, dance, as do the Gurmukhs, whose minds dwell in reflective meditation. ||4||

Gurbani: ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਚੇ ਜਿਨ ਲਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: khandd brahamandd trai gun naache jin laagee har liv tumaaree |
English: The planets and solar systems dance in the three qualities, as do those who bear love for You, Lord.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭੇ ਹੀ ਨਾਚੇ ਨਾਚਹਿ ਖਾਣੀ ਚਾਰੀ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: jeea jant sabhe hee naache naacheh khaanee chaaree |5|
English: The beings and creatures all dance, and the four sources of creation dance. ||5||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਸੇਈ ਨਾਚਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jo tudh bhaaveh seee naacheh jin guramukh sabad liv laae |
English: They alone dance, who are pleasing to You, and who, as Gurmukhs, embrace love for the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਸੇ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਏ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: se bhagat se tat giaanee jin kau hukam manaae |6|
English: They are devotees, with the essence of spiritual wisdom, who obey the Hukam of His Command. ||6||

Gurbani: ਏਹਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: ehaa bhagat sache siau liv laagai bin sevaa bhagat na hoee |
English: This is devotional worship, that one loves the True Lord; without service, one cannot be a devotee.

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: jeevat marai taa sabad beechaarai taa sach paavai koee |7|
English: If one remains dead while yet alive, he reflects upon the Shabad, and then, he obtains the True Lord. ||7||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਅਰਥਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਲੋਕ ਨਾਚੇ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa kai arath bahut lok naache ko viralaa tat beechaaree |
English: So many people dance for the sake of Maya; how rare are those who contemplate reality.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee soee jan paae jin kau kripaa tumaaree |8|
English: By Guru's Grace, that humble being obtains You, Lord, upon whom You show Mercy. ||8||

Gurbani: ਇਕੁ ਦਮੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਸਾ ਵੇਲਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: eik dam saachaa veesarai saa velaa birathaa jaae |
English: If I forget the True Lord, even for an instant, that time passes in vain.

Gurbani: ਸਾਹਿ ਸਾਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: saeh saeh sadaa samaaleeai aape bakhase kare rajaae |9|
English: With each and every breath, constantly remember the Lord; He Himself shall forgive you, according to His Will. ||9||

Gurbani: ਸੇਈ ਨਾਚਹਿ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: seee naacheh jo tudh bhaaveh ji guramukh sabad veechaaree |
English: They alone dance, who are pleasing to Your Will, and who, as Gurmukhs, contemplate the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੧੦॥੧॥੬॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak se sehaj sukh paaveh jin kau nadar tumaaree |10|1|6|
English: Says Nanak, they alone find celestial peace, whom You bless with Your Grace. ||10||1||6||

[Ang 506 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 4 ghar 2 |
English: Goojaree, Fourth Mehl, Second House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਅਰਾ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਲਕੁ ਖੀਰ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: har bin jeearaa reh na sakai jiau baalak kheer adhaaree |
English: Without the Lord, my soul cannot survive, like an infant without milk.

Gurbani: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: agam agochar prabh guramukh paaeeai apune satigur kai balihaaree |1|
English: The inaccessible and incomprehensible Lord God is obtained by the Gurmukh; I am a sacrifice to my True Guru. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: man re har keerat tar taaree |
English: O my mind, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise is a boat to carry you across.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh naam amrit jal paaeeai jin kau kripaa tumaaree | rahaau |
English: The Gurmukhs obtain the Ambrosial Water of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. You bless them with Your Grace. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਨਕ ਸਨੰਦਨ ਨਾਰਦ ਮੁਨਿ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਪਤ ਰਹਹਿ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: sanak sanandan naarad mun seveh anadin japat raheh banavaaree |
English: Sanak, Sanandan and Naarad the sage serve You; night and day, they continue to chant Your Name, O Lord of the jungle.

Gurbani: ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦ ਜਨ ਆਏ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saranaagat prahalaad jan aae tin kee paij savaaree |2|
English: Slave Prahlaad sought Your Sanctuary, and You saved his honor. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਲਖ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਏਕੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਏਕਾ ਜੋਤਿ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: alakh niranjan eko varatai ekaa jot muraaree |
English: The One unseen immaculate Lord is pervading everywhere, as is the Light of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਤੂ ਏਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਹਾਥ ਪਸਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sabh jaachik too eko daataa maageh haath pasaaree |3|
English: All are beggars, You alone are the Great Giver. Reaching out our hands, we beg from You. ||3||

Gurbani: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਊਤਮ ਬਾਣੀ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਆਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat janaa kee aootam baanee gaaveh akath kathaa nit niaaree |
English: The speech of the humble devotees is sublime; they sing continually the wondrous, Unspoken Speech of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਭਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਕੇਰਾ ਆਪਿ ਤਰੇ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: safal janam bheaa tin keraa aap tare kul taaree |4|
English: Their lives become fruitful; they save themselves, and all their generations. ||4||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਬਿਆਪੇ ਜਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੋਹ ਗੁਬਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh dubidhaa duramat biaape jin antar moh gubaaree |
English: The self-willed manmukhs are engrossed in duality and evil-mindedness; within them is the darkness of attachment.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਓਇ ਡੂਬੇ ਸਣੁ ਪਰਵਾਰੀ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: sant janaa kee kathaa na bhaavai oe ddoobe san paravaaree |5|
English: They do not love the sermon of the humble Saints, and they are drowned along with their families. ||5||

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਵੈ ਓਹੁ ਮਲਭਖੁ ਮਾਇਆਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: nindak nindaa kar mal dhovai ohu malabhakh maaeaadhaaree |
English: By slandering, the slanderer washes the filth off others; he is an eater of filth, and a worshipper of Maya.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: sant janaa kee nindaa viaape naa uravaar na paaree |6|
English: He indulges in the slander of the humble Saints; he is neither on this shore, nor the shore beyond. ||6||

Gurbani: ਏਹੁ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਕਰਤੈ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: ehu parapanch khel keea sabh karatai har karatai sabh kal dhaaree |
English: All this worldly drama is set in motion by the Creator Lord; He has infused His almighty strength into all.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਸੂਤੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਜੁਗ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੂਤੁ ਖਿੰਚੈ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੀ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: har eko soot varatai jug antar soot khinchai ekankaaree |7|
English: The thread of the One Lord runs through the world; when He pulls out this thread, the One Creator alone remains. ||7||

Gurbani: ਰਸਨਿ ਰਸਨਿ ਰਸਿ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: rasan rasan ras gaaveh har gun rasanaa har ras dhaaree |
English: With their tongues, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and savor Them. They place the sublime essence of the Lord upon their tongues, and savor it.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਮਾਗਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੮॥੧॥੭॥
Transliteration: naanak har bin avar na maagau har ras preet piaaree |8|1|7|
English: O Nanak, other than the Lord, I ask for nothing else; I am in love with the Love of the Lord's sublime essence. ||8||1||7||

[Ang 507 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ghar 2 |
English: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl, Second House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਰਾਜਨ ਮਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਜਾ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਭੂਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਭੂਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: raajan meh toon raajaa kaheeeh bhooman meh bhoomaa |
English: Among kings, You are called the King. Among land-lords, You are the Land-lord.

Gurbani: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮਹਿ ਠਕੁਰਾਈ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੋਮਨ ਸਿਰਿ ਕੋਮਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tthaakur meh tthakuraaee teree koman sir komaa |1|
English: Among masters, You are the Master. Among tribes, Yours is the Supreme Tribe. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪਿਤਾ ਮੇਰੋ ਬਡੋ ਧਨੀ ਅਗਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: pitaa mero baddo dhanee agamaa |
English: My Father is wealthy, deep and profound.

Gurbani: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਵਨ ਕਰੀਜੈ ਕਰਤੇ ਪੇਖਿ ਰਹੇ ਬਿਸਮਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ausatat kavan kareejai karate pekh rahe bisamaa |1| rahaau |
English: What praises should I chant, O Creator Lord? Beholding You, I am wonder-struck. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੁਖੀਅਨ ਮਹਿ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਤੂੰ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਦਾਤਨ ਸਿਰਿ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: sukheean meh sukheea toon kaheeeh daatan sir daataa |
English: Among the peaceful, You are called the Peaceful One. Among givers, You are the Greatest Giver.

Gurbani: ਤੇਜਨ ਮਹਿ ਤੇਜਵੰਸੀ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਰਸੀਅਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tejan meh tejavansee kaheeeh raseean meh raataa |2|
English: Among the glorious, You are said to be the Most Glorious. Among revellers, You are the Reveller. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੂਰਨ ਮਹਿ ਸੂਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਭੋਗਨ ਮਹਿ ਭੋਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: sooran meh sooraa toon kaheeeh bhogan meh bhogee |
English: Among warriors, You are called the Warrior. Among indulgers, You are the Indulger.

Gurbani: ਗ੍ਰਸਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਬਡੋ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਸਤੀ ਜੋਗਨ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਗੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: grasatan meh toon baddo grihasatee jogan meh jogee |3|
English: Among householders, You are the Great Householder. Among yogis, You are the Yogi. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਰਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਆਚਾਰਨ ਮਹਿ ਆਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: karatan meh toon karataa kaheeeh aachaaran meh aachaaree |
English: Among creators, You are called the Creator. Among the cultured, You are the Cultured One.

Gurbani: ਸਾਹਨ ਮਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਾ ਵਾਪਾਰਨ ਮਹਿ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
