Transliteration: saahan meh toon saachaa saahaa vaapaaran meh vaapaaree |4|
English: Among bankers, You are the True Banker. Among merchants, You are the Merchant. ||4||

Gurbani: ਦਰਬਾਰਨ ਮਹਿ ਤੇਰੋ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ ਸਰਨ ਪਾਲਨ ਟੀਕਾ ॥
Transliteration: darabaaran meh tero darabaaraa saran paalan tteekaa |
English: Among courts, Yours is the Court. Yours is the Most Sublime of Sanctuaries.

Gurbani: ਲਖਿਮੀ ਕੇਤਕ ਗਨੀ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ਗਨਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਸੀਕਾ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: lakhimee ketak ganee na jaaeeai gan na skau seekaa |5|
English: The extent of Your wealth cannot be determined. Your Coins cannot be counted. ||5||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਤੇਰੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮਾ ਗਿਆਨਨ ਮਹਿ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: naaman meh tero prabh naamaa giaanan meh giaanee |
English: Among names, Your Name, God, is the most respected. Among the wise, You are the Wisest.

Gurbani: ਜੁਗਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੁਗਤਾ ਇਸਨਾਨਨ ਮਹਿ ਇਸਨਾਨੀ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: jugatan meh teree prabh jugataa isanaanan meh isanaanee |6|
English: Among ways, Yours, God, is the Best Way. Among purifying baths, Yours is the Most Purifying. ||6||

Gurbani: ਸਿਧਨ ਮਹਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਧਾ ਕਰਮਨ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: sidhan meh teree prabh sidhaa karaman sir karamaa |
English: Among spiritual powers, Yours, O God, are the Spiritual Powers. Among actions, Yours are the Greatest Actions.

Gurbani: ਆਗਿਆ ਮਹਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਗਿਆ ਹੁਕਮਨ ਸਿਰਿ ਹੁਕਮਾ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: aagiaa meh teree prabh aagiaa hukaman sir hukamaa |7|
English: Among wills, Your Will, God, is the Supreme Will. Of commands, Yours is the Supreme Command. ||7||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਬੋਲਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਬੋਲਹ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਵਨ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jiau bolaaveh tiau bolah suaamee kudarat kavan hamaaree |
English: As You cause me to speak, so do I speak, O Lord Master. What other power do I have?

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਓ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੮॥੧॥੮॥
Transliteration: saadhasang naanak jas gaaeo jo prabh kee at piaaree |8|1|8|
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, sing His Praises; they are so very dear to God. ||8||1||8||

[Ang 508 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ghar 4 |
English: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਨਾਥ ਨਰਹਰ ਦੀਨ ਬੰਧਵ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਦੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: naath narahar deen bandhav patit paavan dev |
English: O Lord, Man-lion Incarnate, Companion to the poor, Divine Purifier of sinners;

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਨਾਸ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਸਫਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bhai traas naas kripaal gun nidh safal suaamee sev |1|
English: O Destroyer of fear and dread, Merciful Lord Master, Treasure of Excellence, fruitful is Your service. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: har gopaal gur gobind |
English: O Lord, Cherisher of the World, Guru-Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਦਇਆਲ ਕੇਸਵ ਤਾਰਿ ਜਗ ਭਵ ਸਿੰਧ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: charan saran deaal kesav taar jag bhav sindh |1| rahaau |
English: I seek the Sanctuary of Your Feet, O Merciful Lord. Carry me across the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਹਰਨ ਮਦ ਮੋਹ ਦਹਨ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ਮਨ ਮਕਰੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh haran mad moh dehan muraar man makarand |
English: O Dispeller of sexual desire and anger, Eliminator of intoxication and attachment, Destroyer of ego, Honey of the mind;

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਧਰਣੀਧਰ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੁ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: janam maran nivaar dharaneedhar pat raakh paramaanand |2|
English: set me free from birth and death, O Sustainer of the earth, and preserve my honor, O Embodiment of supreme bliss. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਲਤ ਅਨਿਕ ਤਰੰਗ ਮਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਿਦ ਮੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: jalat anik tarang maaeaa gur giaan har rid mant |
English: The many waves of desire for Maya are burnt away, when the Guru's spiritual wisdom is enshrined in the heart, through the Guru's Mantra.

Gurbani: ਛੇਦਿ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਚਿੰਤ ਮੇਟਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਨੰਤ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: chhed ahanbudh karunaa mai chint mett purakh anant |3|
English: Destroy my egotism, O Merciful Lord; dispel my anxiety, O Infinite Primal Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਮਰਥ ਪਲ ਮਹੂਰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ॥
Transliteration: simar samarath pal mahoorat prabh dhiaan sehaj samaadh |
English: Remember in meditation the Almighty Lord, every moment and every instant; meditate on God in the celestial peace of Samaadhi.

Gurbani: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਜਾਚੀਐ ਰਜ ਸਾਧ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: deen deaal prasan pooran jaacheeai raj saadh |4|
English: O Merciful to the meek, perfectly blissful Lord, I beg for the dust of the feet of the Holy. ||4||

Gurbani: ਮੋਹ ਮਿਥਨ ਦੁਰੰਤ ਆਸਾ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: moh mithan durant aasaa baasanaa bikaar |
English: Emotional attachment is false, desire is filthy, and longing is corrupt.

Gurbani: ਰਖੁ ਧਰਮ ਭਰਮ ਬਿਦਾਰਿ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਉਧਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: rakh dharam bharam bidaar man te udhar har nirankaar |5|
English: Please, preserve my faith, dispel these doubts from my mind, and save me, O Formless Lord. ||5||

Gurbani: ਧਨਾਢਿ ਆਢਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਹੋਤ ਜਿਨਾ ਨ ਚੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaadt aadt bhanddaar har nidh hot jinaa na cheer |
English: They have become wealthy, loaded with the treasures of the Lord's riches; they were lacking even clothes.

Gurbani: ਖਲ ਮੁਗਧ ਮੂੜ ਕਟਾਖੵ ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਭਏ ਗੁਣ ਮਤਿ ਧੀਰ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: khal mugadh moorr kattaakhay sreedhar bhe gun mat dheer |6|
English: The idiotic, foolish and senseless people have become virtuous and patient, receiving the Gracious Glance of the Lord of wealth. ||6||

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਿਦ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: jeevan mukat jagadees jap man dhaar rid parateet |
English: Become Jivan-Mukta, liberated while yet alive, by meditating on the Lord of the Universe, O mind, and maintaining faith in Him in your heart.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਦਇਆ ਮਇਆ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਰਮਣੰ ਪਰਮ ਹੰਸਹ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: jeea deaa meaa sarabatr ramanan param hansah reet |7|
English: Show kindness and mercy to all beings, and realize that the Lord is pervading everywhere; this is the way of life of the enlightened soul, the supreme swan. ||7||

Gurbani: ਦੇਤ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਰਸਨ ਨਾਮ ਉਚਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: det darasan sravan har jas rasan naam uchaar |
English: He grants the Blessed Vision of His Darshan to those who listen to His Praises, and who, with their tongues, chant His Name.

Gurbani: ਅੰਗ ਸੰਗ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਪਰਸਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰ ॥੮॥੧॥੨॥੫॥੧॥੧॥੨॥੫੭॥
Transliteration: ang sang bhagavaan parasan prabh naanak patit udhaar |8|1|2|5|1|1|2|57|
English: They are part and parcel, life and limb with the Lord God; O Nanak, they feel the Touch of God, the Savior of sinners. ||8||1||2||5||1||1||2||57||

[Ang 508 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਸਿਕੰਦਰ ਬਿਰਾਹਿਮ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਕੀ ਧੁਨੀ ਗਾਉਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree kee vaar mahalaa 3 sikandar biraahim kee vaar kee dhunee gaaunee |
English: Goojaree Ki Vaar, Third Mehl, Sung In The Tune Of The Vaar Of Sikandar & Biraahim:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਮਮਤਾ ਮੁਆ ਜੀਵਣ ਕੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: eihu jagat mamataa muaa jeevan kee bidh naeh |
English: This world perishing in attachment and possessiveness; no one knows the way of life.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਤਾਂ ਜੀਵਣ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai bhaanai jo chalai taan jeevan padavee paeh |
English: One who walks in harmony with the Guru's Will, obtains the supreme status of life.

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਨ ਜੀਵਤੇ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: oe sadaa sadaa jan jeevate jo har charanee chit laeh |
English: Those humble beings who focus their consciousness on the Lord's Feet, live forever and ever.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak nadaree man vasai guramukh sehaj samaeh |1|
English: O Nanak, by His Grace, the Lord abides in the minds of the Gurmukhs, who merge in celestial bliss. ||1||

[Ang 508 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਮਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: andar sahasaa dukh hai aapai sir dhandhai maar |
English: Within the self is the pain of doubt; engrossed in worldly affairs, they are killing themselves.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਤੇ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਗਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਿਆਰ ॥
Transliteration: doojai bhaae sute kabeh na jaageh maaeaa moh piaar |
English: Asleep in the love of duality, they never wake up; they are in love with, and attached to Maya.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਵੀਚਾਰਹਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਾ ਆਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: naam na cheteh sabad na veechaareh ihu manamukh kaa aachaar |
English: They do not think of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and they do not contemplate the Word of the Shabad. This is the conduct of the self-willed manmukhs.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨਮੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਆਰ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har naam na paaeaa janam birathaa gavaaeaa naanak jam maar kare khuaar |2|
English: They do not obtain the Lord's Name, and they waste away their lives in vain; O Nanak, the Messenger of Death punishes and dishonors them. ||2||

[Ang 509 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਤਦਹੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aapanaa aap upaaeon tadahu hor na koee |
English: He created Himself - at that time, there was no other.

Gurbani: ਮਤਾ ਮਸੂਰਤਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: mataa masoorat aap kare jo kare su hoee |
English: He consulted Himself for advice, and what He did came to pass.

Gurbani: ਤਦਹੁ ਆਕਾਸੁ ਨ ਪਾਤਾਲੁ ਹੈ ਨਾ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਲੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: tadahu aakaas na paataal hai naa trai loee |
English: At that time, there were no Akaashic Ethers, no nether regions, nor the three worlds.

Gurbani: ਤਦਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਾ ਓਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: tadahu aape aap nirankaar hai naa opat hoee |
English: At that time, only the Formless Lord Himself existed - there was no creation.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jiau tis bhaavai tivai kare tis bin avar na koee |1|
English: As it pleased Him, so did He act; without Him, there was no other. ||1||

[Ang 509 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਦਿਸੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: saahib meraa sadaa hai disai sabad kamaae |
English: My Master is eternal. He is seen by practicing the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਅਉਹਾਣੀ ਕਦੇ ਨਾਹਿ ਨਾ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: ohu aauhaanee kade naeh naa aavai naa jaae |
English: He never perishes; He does not come or go in reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੋ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਜੋ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa so seveeai jo sabh meh rahai samaae |
English: So serve Him, forever and ever; He is contained in all.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਕਿਉ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਜੰਮੈ ਤੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: avar doojaa kiau seveeai jamai tai mar jaae |
English: Why serve another who is born, and then dies?

Gurbani: ਨਿਹਫਲੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਜਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਅਵਰੀ ਕਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: nihafal tin kaa jeeviaa ji khasam na jaaneh aapanaa avaree kau chit laae |
English: Fruitless is the life of those who do not know their Lord and Master, and who center their consciousness on others.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਵ ਨ ਜਾਪਈ ਕਰਤਾ ਕੇਤੀ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak ev na jaapee karataa ketee dee sajaae |1|
English: O Nanak, it cannot be known, how much punishment the Creator shall inflict on them. ||1||

[Ang 509 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਭੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਚੁ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa naam dhiaaeeai sabho varatai sach |
English: Meditate on the True Name; the True Lord is pervading everywhere.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੁਝਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਤਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਸਚੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak hukam bujh paravaan hoe taa fal paavai sach |
English: O Nanak, by understanding the Hukam of the Lord's Command, one becomes acceptable, and then obtains the fruit of Truth.

Gurbani: ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਨੀ ਕਰਤਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਬੁਝਈ ਅੰਧਾ ਕਚੁ ਨਿਕਚੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kathanee badanee karataa firai hukamai mool na bujhee andhaa kach nikach |2|
English: He wanders around babbling and speaking, but he does not understand the Lord's Command at all. He is blind, the falsest of the false. ||2||

[Ang 509 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਉਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟੀ ਕਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sanjog vijog upaaeon srisattee kaa mool rachaaeaa |
English: Creating union and separation, He laid the foundations of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: hukamee srisatt saajeean jotee jot milaaeaa |
English: By His Command, the Lord of Light fashioned the Universe, and infused His Divine Light into it.

Gurbani: ਜੋਤੀ ਹੂੰ ਸਭੁ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jotee hoon sabh chaananaa satigur sabad sunaaeaa |
English: From the Lord of Light, all light originates. The True Guru proclaims the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: brahamaa bisan mahes trai gun sir dhandhai laaeaa |
English: Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva, under the influence of the three dispositions, were put to their tasks.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਓਨੁ ਤੁਰੀਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: maaeaa kaa mool rachaaeon tureea sukh paaeaa |2|
English: He created the root of Maya, and the peace obtained in the fourth state of consciousness. ||2||

[Ang 509 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਜਪੁ ਸੋ ਤਪੁ ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: so jap so tap ji satigur bhaavai |
English: That alone is chanting, and that alone is deep meditation, which is pleasing to the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur kai bhaanai vaddiaaee paavai |
English: Pleasing the True Guru, glorious greatness is obtained.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਗੁਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak aap chhodd gur maeh samaavai |1|
English: O Nanak, renouncing self-conceit, one merges into the Guru. ||1||

[Ang 509 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਲੇਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur kee sikh ko viralaa levai |
English: How rare are those who receive the Guru's Teachings.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak jis aap vaddiaaee devai |2|
English: O Nanak, he alone receives it, whom the Lord Himself blesses with glorious greatness. ||2||

[Ang 509 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਹੈ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohu agiaan hai bikham at bhaaree |
English: Emotional attachment to Maya is spiritual darkness; it is very difficult and such a heavy load.

Gurbani: ਪਥਰ ਪਾਪ ਬਹੁ ਲਦਿਆ ਕਿਉ ਤਰੀਐ ਤਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: pathar paap bahu ladiaa kiau tareeai taaree |
English: Loaded with so very many stones of sin, how can the boat cross over?

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: anadin bhagatee ratiaa har paar utaaree |
English: Those who are attuned to the Lord's devotional worship night and day are carried across.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਛਡਿ ਵਿਕਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: gurasabadee man niramalaa haumai chhadd vikaaree |
English: Under the Instruction of the Guru's Shabad, one sheds egotism and corruption, and the mind becomes immaculate.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har har naam dhiaaeeai har har nisataaree |3|
English: Meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; the Lord, Har, Har, is our Saving Grace. ||3||

[Ang 509 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਕਬੀਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਸੰਕੁੜਾ ਰਾਈ ਦਸਵੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kabeer mukat duaaraa sankurraa raaee dasavai bhaae |
English: O Kabeer, the gate of liberation is narrow, less than one-tenth of a mustard seed.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਉ ਮੈਗਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਰਹਾ ਨਿਕਸਿਆ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man tau maigal hoe rahaa nikasiaa kiau kar jaae |
English: The mind has become as big as an elephant; how can it pass through this gate?

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਤੁਠਾ ਕਰੇ ਪਸਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa satigur je milai tutthaa kare pasaau |
English: If one meets such a True Guru, by His Pleasure, He shows His Mercy.

Gurbani: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਮੋਕਲਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਆਵਉ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mukat duaaraa mokalaa sahaje aavau jaau |1|
English: Then, the gate of liberation becomes wide open, and the soul easily passes through. ||1||

[Ang 509 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਅਤਿ ਨੀਕਾ ਨਾਨੑਾ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak mukat duaaraa at neekaa naanaa hoe su jaae |
English: O Nanak, the gate of liberation is very narrow; only the very tiny can pass through.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਨੁ ਅਸਥੂਲੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਵਿਚੁ ਦੇ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: haumai man asathool hai kiau kar vich de jaae |
English: Through egotism, the mind has become bloated. How can it pass through?

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਈ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਹੀ ਸਭ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur miliai haumai gee jot rahee sabh aae |
English: Meeting the True Guru, egotism departs, and one is filled with the Divine Light.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: eihu jeeo sadaa mukat hai sahaje rahiaa samaae |2|
English: Then, this soul is liberated forever, and it remains absorbed in celestial bliss. ||2||

[Ang 510 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਕੀਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: prabh sansaar upaae kai vas aapanai keetaa |
English: God created the Universe, and He keeps it under His power.

Gurbani: ਗਣਤੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮੀਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: ganatai prabhoo na paaeeai doojai bharameetaa |
English: God cannot be obtained by counting; the mortal wanders in doubt.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਬੁਝਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮੀਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: satigur miliai jeevat marai bujh sach sameetaa |
English: Meeting the True Guru, one remains dead while yet alive; understanding Him, he is absorbed in the Truth.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਖੋਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲੀਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabade haumai khoeeai har mel mileetaa |
English: Through the Word of the Shabad, egotism is eradicated, and one is united in the Lord's Union.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੇ ਵਿਗਸੀਤਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh jaanai kare aap aape vigaseetaa |4|
English: He knows everything, and Himself does everything; beholding His Creation, He rejoices. ||4||

[Ang 510 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਇਓ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵਸਿਓ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur siau chit na laaeo naam na vasio man aae |
English: One who has not focused his consciousness on the True Guru, and into whose mind the Naam does not come

Gurbani: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਇਵੇਹਾ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਕਿਆ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: dhrig ivehaa jeeviaa kiaa jug meh paaeaa aae |
English: cursed is such a life. What has he gained by coming into the world?

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਖੋਟੀ ਰਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਏਕ ਚਸੇ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਜੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa khottee raas hai ek chase meh paaj leh jaae |
English: Maya is false capital; in an instant, its false covering falls off.

Gurbani: ਹਥਹੁ ਛੁੜਕੀ ਤਨੁ ਸਿਆਹੁ ਹੋਇ ਬਦਨੁ ਜਾਇ ਕੁਮਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: hathahu chhurrakee tan siaahu hoe badan jaae kumalaae |
English: When it slips from his hand, his body turns black, and his face withers away.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: jin satigur siau chit laaeaa tina sukh vasiaa man aae |
English: Those who focus their consciousness on the True Guru - peace comes to abide in their minds.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: har naam dhiaaveh rang siau har naam rahe liv laae |
English: They meditate on the Name of the Lord with love; they are lovingly attuned to the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਸਉਪਿਆ ਜਿ ਜੀਅ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak satigur so dhan saupiaa ji jeea meh rahiaa samaae |
English: O Nanak, the True Guru has bestowed upon them the wealth, which remains contained within their hearts.

Gurbani: ਰੰਗੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਉ ਅਗਲਾ ਵੰਨੀ ਚੜੈ ਚੜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: rang tisai kau agalaa vanee charrai charraae |1|
English: They are imbued with supreme love; its color increases day by day. ||1||

[Ang 510 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਹੋਈ ਨਾਗਨੀ ਜਗਤਿ ਰਹੀ ਲਪਟਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa hoee naaganee jagat rahee lapattaae |
English: Maya is a serpent, clinging to the world.

Gurbani: ਇਸ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਫਿਰਿ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: eis kee sevaa jo kare tis hee kau fir khaae |
English: Whoever serves her, she ultimately devours.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੋਈ ਗਾਰੜੂ ਤਿਨਿ ਮਲਿ ਦਲਿ ਲਾਈ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh koee gaararroo tin mal dal laaee paae |
English: The Gurmukh is a snake-charmer; he has trampled her and thrown her down, and crushed her underfoot.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਈ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਿ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak seee ubare ji sach rahe liv laae |2|
English: O Nanak, they alone are saved, who remain lovingly absorbed in the True Lord. ||2||

[Ang 510 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਢਾਢੀ ਕਰੇ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸੁਣਾਇਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: dtaadtee kare pukaar prabhoo sunaaeisee |
English: The minstrel cries out, and God hears him.

Gurbani: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਧੀਰਕ ਹੋਇ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: andar dheerak hoe pooraa paaeisee |
English: He is comforted within his mind, and he obtains the Perfect Lord.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ ਸੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: jo dhur likhiaa lekh se karam kamaaeisee |
English: Whatever destiny is pre-ordained by the Lord, those are the deeds he does.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਖਸਮੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: jaa hovai khasam deaal taa mehal ghar paaeisee |
English: When the Lord and Master becomes Merciful, then one obtains the Mansion of the Lord's Presence as his home.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਅਤਿ ਵਡਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲਾਇਸੀ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: so prabh meraa at vaddaa guramukh melaaeisee |5|
English: That God of mine is so very great; as Gurmukh, I have met Him. ||5||

[Ang 510 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਸਹੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਰਹੈ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: sabhanaa kaa sahu ek hai sad hee rahai hajoor |
English: There is One Lord God of all; He remains ever-present.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਮੰਨਈ ਤਾ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: naanak hukam na manee taa ghar hee andar door |
English: O Nanak, if one does not obey the Hukam of the Lord's Command, then within one's own home, the Lord seems far away.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਭੀ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਮਨਾਇਸੀ ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: hukam bhee tinaa manaaeisee jina kau nadar karee |
English: They alone obey the Lord's Command, upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: hukam man sukh paaeaa prem suhaagan hoe |1|
English: Obeying His Command, one obtains peace, and becomes the happy, loving soul-bride. ||1||

[Ang 510 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰੈਣਿ ਸਬਾਈ ਜਲਿ ਮੁਈ ਕੰਤ ਨ ਲਾਇਓ ਭਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: rain sabaaee jal muee kant na laaeo bhaau |
English: She who does not love her Husband Lord, burns and wastes away all through the night of her life.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸਨਿ ਸੋੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨੑ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak sukh vasan suohaaganee jina piaaraa purakh har raau |2|
English: O Nanak, the soul-brides dwell in peace; they have the Lord, their King, as their Husband. ||2||

[Ang 510 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਮੈ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabh jag fir mai dekhiaa har iko daataa |
English: Roaming over the entire world, I have seen that the Lord is the only Giver.

Gurbani: ਉਪਾਇ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: aupaae kitai na paaeeai har karam bidhaataa |
English: The Lord cannot be obtained by any device at all; He is the Architect of Karma.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: gurasabadee har man vasai har sahaje jaataa |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind, and the Lord is easily revealed within.

Gurbani: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: andarahu trisanaa agan bujhee har amrit sar naataa |
English: The fire of desire within is quenched, and one bathes in the Lord's Pool of Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੇ ਕੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲਾਤਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: vaddee vaddiaaee vadde kee guramukh bolaataa |6|
English: The great greatness of the great Lord God - the Gurmukh speaks of this. ||6||

[Ang 510 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਹੰਸ ਕਿਆ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹੈ ਜਿ ਪਇਆ ਹੀ ਛਡਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa hans kiaa preet hai ji peaa hee chhadd jaae |
English: What love is this between the body and soul, which ends when the body falls?

Gurbani: ਏਸ ਨੋ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਕਿ ਖਵਾਲੀਐ ਜਿ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: es no koorr bol ki khavaaleeai ji chaladiaa naal na jaae |
English: Why feed it by telling lies? When you leave, it does not go with you.

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਮਿਟੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਪਉਣੈ ਪੁਛਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa mittee andh hai paunai puchhahu jaae |
English: The body is merely blind dust; go, and ask the soul.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: hau taa maaeaa mohiaa fir fir aavaa jaae |
English: The soul answers, "I am enticed by Maya, and so I come and go, again and again."

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਤੋ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਜਿ ਰਹਾ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak hukam na jaato khasam kaa ji rahaa sach samaae |1|
English: O Nanak, I do not know my Lord and Master's Command, by which I would merge in the Truth. ||1||

[Ang 511 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: eko nihachal naam dhan hor dhan aavai jaae |
English: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the only permanent wealth; all other wealth comes and goes.

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਧਨ ਕਉ ਤਸਕਰੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਈ ਨਾ ਓਚਕਾ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: eis dhan kau tasakar johi na sakee naa ochakaa lai jaae |
English: Thieves cannot steal this wealth, nor can robbers take it away.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਜੀਐ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਜੀਐ ਨਾਲੇ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: eihu har dhan jeeai setee rav rahiaa jeeai naale jaae |
English: This wealth of the Lord is embedded in the soul, and with the soul, it shall depart.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪਲੈ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: poore gur te paaeeai manamukh palai na paae |
English: It is obtained from the Perfect Guru; the self-willed manmukhs do not receive it.

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਖਟਿਆ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: dhan vaapaaree naanakaa jinaa naam dhan khattiaa aae |2|
English: Blessed are the traders, O Nanak, who have come to earn the wealth of the Naam. ||2||

[Ang 511 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅਤਿ ਵਡਾ ਸਚੁ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: meraa saahib at vaddaa sach gahir ganbheeraa |
English: My Master is so very great, true, profound and unfathomable.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਚੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabh jag tis kai vas hai sabh tis kaa cheeraa |
English: The whole world is under His power; everything is the projection of Him.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਧਨੁ ਧੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee paaeeai nihachal dhan dheeraa |
English: By Guru's Grace, the eternal wealth is obtained, bringing peace and patience to the mind.

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਭੇਟੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੂਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kirapaa te har man vasai bhettai gur sooraa |
English: By His Grace, the Lord dwells in the mind, and one meets the Brave Guru.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰਾ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: gunavantee saalaahiaa sadaa thir nihachal har pooraa |7|
English: The virtuous praise the ever-stable, permanent, perfect Lord. ||7||

[Ang 511 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਦਾ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਤਿਆਗਦੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: dhrig tinaa daa jeeviaa jo har sukh parahar tiaagade dukh haumai paap kamaae |
English: Cursed is the life of those who forsake and throw away the peace of the Lord's Name, and suffer pain instead by practicing ego and sin.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਤਿਨੑ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh agiaanee maaeaa mohi viaape tina boojh na kaaee paae |
English: The ignorant self-willed manmukhs are engrossed in the love of Maya; they have no understanding at all.

Gurbani: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਓਇ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਏ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: halat palat oe sukh na paaveh ant ge pachhutaae |
English: In this world and in the world beyond, they do not find peace; in the end, they depart regretting and repenting.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee ko naam dhiaae tis haumai vichahu jaae |
English: By Guru's Grace, one may meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and egotism departs from within him.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਆਇ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak jis poorab hovai likhiaa so gur charanee aae paae |1|
English: O Nanak, one who has such pre-ordained destiny, comes and falls at the Guru's Feet. ||1||

[Ang 511 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਊਧਾ ਕਉਲੁ ਹੈ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh aoodhaa kaul hai naa tis bhagat na naau |
English: The self-willed manmukh is like the inverted lotus; he has neither devotional worship, nor the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਸਕਤੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਹੈ ਉਪਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sakatee andar varatadaa koorr tis kaa hai upaau |
English: He remains engrossed in material wealth, and his efforts are false.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਅੰਦਰੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਭਿਜਈ ਮੁਖਿ ਫੀਕਾ ਆਲਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tis kaa andar chit na bhijee mukh feekaa aalaau |
English: His consciousness is not softened within, and the words from his mouth are insipid.

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਧਰਮਿ ਰਲਾਏ ਨਾ ਰਲਨਿੑ ਓਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
Transliteration: oe dharam ralaae naa ralana onaa andar koorr suaau |
English: He does not mingle with the righteous; within him are falsehood and selfishness.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤੈ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬੋਲਿ ਡੁਬੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਰੇ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak karatai banat banaaee manamukh koorr bol bol ddube guramukh tare jap har naau |2|
English: O Nanak, the Creator Lord has arranged things, so that the self-willed manmukhs are drowned by telling lies, while the Gurmukhs are saved by chanting the Lord's Name. ||2||

[Ang 511 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਵਡਾ ਫੇਰੁ ਪਇਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: bin boojhe vaddaa fer peaa fir aavai jaaee |
English: Without understanding, one must wander around the cycle of reincarnation, and continue coming and going.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਨ ਕੀਤੀਆ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur kee sevaa na keeteea ant geaa pachhutaaee |
English: One who has not served the True Guru, shall depart regretting and repenting in the end.

Gurbani: ਆਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aapanee kirapaa kare gur paaeeai vichahu aap gavaaee |
English: But if the Lord shows His Mercy, one finds the Guru, and ego is banished from within.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: trisanaa bhukh vichahu utarai sukh vasai man aaee |
English: Hunger and thirst depart from within, and peace comes to dwell in the mind.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa saalaaheeai hiradai liv laaee |8|
English: Forever and ever, praise Him with love in your heart. ||8||

[Ang 511 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਪੂਜੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: ji satigur seve aapanaa tis no pooje sabh koe |
English: One who serves his True Guru, is worshipped by everyone.

Gurbani: ਸਭਨਾ ਉਪਾਵਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਉਪਾਉ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabhanaa upaavaa sir upaau hai har naam paraapat hoe |
English: Of all efforts, the supreme effort is the attainment of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਤਿ ਵਸੈ ਜਪਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: antar seetal saat vasai jap hiradai sadaa sukh hoe |
English: Peace and tranquility come to dwell within the mind; meditating within the heart, there comes a lasting peace.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੈਨਣਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: amrit khaanaa amrit painanaa naanak naam vaddaaee hoe |1|
English: The Ambrosial Amrit is his food, and the Ambrosial Amrit is his clothes; O Nanak, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, greatness is obtained. ||1||

[Ang 511 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਏ ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: e man gur kee sikh sun har paaveh gunee nidhaan |
English: O mind, listen to the Guru's Teachings, and you shall obtain the treasure of virtue.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: har sukhadaataa man vasai haumai jaae gumaan |
English: The Lord, the Giver of peace, shall dwell in your mind, and your egotism and pride shall depart.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਤਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak nadaree paaeeai taa anadin laagai dhiaan |2|
English: O Nanak, when the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, then, night and day, one centers his meditation on the Lord. ||2||

[Ang 512 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਵਿਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: sat santokh sabh sach hai guramukh pavitaa |
English: The Gurmukh is totally truthful, content and pure.

Gurbani: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ਗਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਜਿਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: andarahu kapatt vikaar geaa man sahaje jitaa |
English: Deception and wickedness have departed from within him, and he easily conquers his mind.

Gurbani: ਤਹ ਜੋਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਅਨੰਦ ਰਸੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਗਵਿਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: teh jot pragaas anand ras agiaan gavitaa |
English: There, the Divine Light and the essence of bliss are manifest, and ignorance is eliminated.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਕਿਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: anadin har ke gun ravai gun paragatt kitaa |
English: Night and day, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and manifests the excellence of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਭਨਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਇਕੋ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਤਾ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: sabhanaa daataa ek hai iko har mitaa |9|
English: The One Lord is the Giver of all; the Lord alone is our friend. ||9||

[Ang 512 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬਿੰਦੇ ਸੋ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਜਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: braham binde so braahaman kaheeai ji anadin har liv laae |
English: One who understands God, who lovingly centers his mind on the Lord night and day, is called a Brahmin.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਛੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: satigur puchhai sach sanjam kamaavai haumai rog tis jaae |
English: Consulting the True Guru, he practices Truth and self-restraint, and he is rid of the disease of ego.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: har gun gaavai gun sangrahai jotee jot milaae |
English: He sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and gathers in His Praises; his light is blended with the Light.

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਟਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: eis jug meh ko viralaa braham giaanee ji haumai mett samaae |
English: In this world, one who knows God is very rare; eradicating ego, he is absorbed in God.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak tis no miliaa sadaa sukh paaeeai ji anadin har naam dhiaae |1|
English: O Nanak, meeting him, peace is obtained; night and day, he meditates on the Lord's Name. ||1||

[Ang 512 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਰਸਨਾ ਝੂਠੁ ਬੋਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: antar kapatt manamukh agiaanee rasanaa jhootth bolaae |
English: Within the ignorant self-willed manmukh is deception; with his tongue, he speaks lies.

Gurbani: ਕਪਟਿ ਕੀਤੈ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਨਿਤ ਵੇਖੈ ਸੁਣੈ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kapatt keetai har purakh na bheejai nit vekhai sunai subhaae |
English: Practicing deception, he does not please the Lord God, who always sees and hears with natural ease.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਜਾਇ ਜਗੁ ਪਰਬੋਧੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਸੁਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: doojai bhaae jaae jag parabodhai bikh maaeaa moh suaae |
English: In the love of duality, he goes to instruct the world, but he is engrossed in the poison of Maya and attachment to pleasure.

Gurbani: ਇਤੁ ਕਮਾਣੈ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਜੰਮੈ ਮਰੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: eit kamaanai sadaa dukh paavai jamai marai fir aavai jaae |
English: By doing so, he suffers in constant pain; he is born and then dies, and comes and goes again and again.

Gurbani: ਸਹਸਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਪਚੈ ਪਚਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sahasaa mool na chukee vich visattaa pachai pachaae |
English: His doubts do not leave him at all, and he rots away in manure.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jis no kripaa kare meraa suaamee tis gur kee sikh sunaae |
English: One, unto whom my Lord Master shows His Mercy, listens to the Guru's Teachings.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਗਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਅੰਤਿ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har naam dhiaavai har naamo gaavai har naamo ant chhaddaae |2|
English: He meditates on the Lord's Name, and sings the Lord's Name; in the end, the Lord's Name will deliver him. ||2||

[Ang 512 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਇਓਨੁ ਤੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jinaa hukam manaaeon te poore sansaar |
English: Those who obey the Hukam of the Lord's Command, are the perfect persons in the world.

Gurbani: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੇਵਨਿੑ ਆਪਣਾ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: saahib sevana aapanaa poorai sabad veechaar |
English: They serve their Lord Master, and reflect upon the Perfect Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: har kee sevaa chaakaree sachai sabad piaar |
English: They serve the Lord, and love the True Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨੑ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa mehal tinaee paaeaa jina haumai vichahu maar |
English: They attain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, as they eradicate egotism from within.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh mil rahe jap har naamaa ur dhaar |10|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs remain united with Him, chanting the Name of the Lord, and enshrining it within their hearts. ||10||

[Ang 512 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh dhiaan sehaj dhun upajai sach naam chit laaeaa |
English: The Gurmukh meditates on the Lord; the celestial sound-current resounds within him, and he focuses his consciousness on the True Name.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh anadin rahai rang raataa har kaa naam man bhaaeaa |
English: The Gurmukh remains imbued with the Lord's Love, night and day; his mind is pleased with the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh har vekheh guramukh har boleh guramukh har sehaj rang laaeaa |
English: The Gurmukh beholds the Lord, the Gurmukh speaks of the Lord, and the Gurmukh naturally loves the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਿਮਰ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅਧੇਰੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh giaan paraapat hovai timar agiaan adher chukaaeaa |
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh attains spiritual wisdom, and the pitch-black darkness of ignorance is dispelled.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jis no karam hovai dhur pooraa tin guramukh har naam dhiaaeaa |1|
English: One who is blessed by the Perfect Lord's Grace - as Gurmukh, he meditates on the Lord's Name. ||1||

[Ang 512 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨਾ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: satigur jinaa na sevio sabad na lago piaar |
English: Those who do not serve the True Guru do not embrace love for the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਕਿਤੁ ਆਇਆ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: sahaje naam na dhiaaeaa kit aaeaa sansaar |
English: They do not meditate on the Celestial Naam, the Name of the Lord - why did they even bother to come into the world?

Gurbani: ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਸਦਾ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: fir fir joonee paaeeai visattaa sadaa khuaar |
English: Time and time again, they are reincarnated, and they rot away forever in manure.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜੈ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਲਗਿਆ ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: koorrai laalach lagiaa naa uravaar na paar |
English: They are attached to false greed; they are not on this shore, nor on the one beyond.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਿ ਆਪਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh ubare ji aap mele karataar |2|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are saved; the Creator Lord unites them with Himself. ||2||

[Ang 513 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਭਗਤ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਹਦੇ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat sachai dar sohade sachai sabad rahaae |
English: The devotees look beauteous in the True Court of the Lord; they abide in the True Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਊਪਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: har kee preet tin aoopajee har prem kasaae |
English: The Lord's Love wells up in them; they are attracted by the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਿਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: har rang raheh sadaa rang raate rasanaa har ras piaae |
English: They abide in the Lord's Love, they remain imbued with the Lord's Love forever, and with their tongues, they drink in the sublime essence of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: safal janam jinaee guramukh jaataa har jeeo ridai vasaae |
English: Fruitful are the lives of those Gurmukhs who recognize the Lord and enshrine Him in their hearts.

Gurbani: ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਫਿਰੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਦੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਏ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: baajh guroo firai bilalaadee doojai bhaae khuaae |11|
English: Without the Guru, they wander around crying out in misery; in the love of duality, they are ruined. ||11||

[Ang 513 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਖਟਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਉਤਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kalijug meh naam nidhaan bhagatee khattiaa har utam pad paaeaa |
English: In the Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the devotees earn the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; they obtain the supreme status of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sev har naam man vasaaeaa anadin naam dhiaaeaa |
English: Serving the True Guru, they enshrine the Lord's Name in their minds, and they meditate on the Naam, night and day.

Gurbani: ਵਿਚੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਜਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: viche grih gur bachan udaasee haumai mohu jalaaeaa |
English: Within the home of their own selves, they remain unattached, through the Guru's Teachings; they burn away egotism and emotional attachment.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਤਰਿਆ ਕੁਲ ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਾਇਆ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਣੇਦੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aap tariaa kul jagat taraaeaa dhan janedee maaeaa |
English: They save themselves, and they save the whole world. Blessed are the mothers who gave birth to them.

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਸੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa satigur soee paae jis dhur masatak har likh paaeaa |
English: He alone finds such a True Guru, upon whose forehead the Lord inscribed such pre-ordained destiny.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak balihaaree gur aapane vittahu jin bhram bhulaa maarag paaeaa |1|
English: Servant Nanak is a sacrifice to his Guru; when he was wandering in doubt, He placed him on the Path. ||1||

[Ang 513 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ ਵੇਖਿ ਭੁਲੇ ਜਿਉ ਦੇਖਿ ਦੀਪਕਿ ਪਤੰਗ ਪਚਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: trai gun maaeaa vekh bhule jiau dekh deepak patang pachaaeaa |
English: Beholding Maya with her three dispositions, he goes astray; he is like the moth, which sees the flame, and is consumed.

Gurbani: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਭੁਲਿ ਭੁਲਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਦਿਖਾ ਕਿਨੈ ਕਿਹੁ ਆਣਿ ਚੜਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: panddit bhul bhul maaeaa vekheh dikhaa kinai kihu aan charraaeaa |
English: The mistaken, deluded Pandits gaze upon Maya, and watch to see whether anyone has offered them something.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪੜਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਦਯਿ ਖੁਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: doojai bhaae parreh nit bikhiaa naavahu day khuaaeaa |
English: In the love of duality, they read continually about sin, while the Lord has withheld His Name from them.

Gurbani: ਜੋਗੀ ਜੰਗਮ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਭੁਲੇ ਓਨੑਾ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਬਹੁ ਗਰਬੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jogee jangam saniaasee bhule onaa ahankaar bahu garab vadhaaeaa |
English: The Yogis, the wandering hermits and the Sannyaasees have gone astray; their egotism and arrogance have increased greatly.

Gurbani: ਛਾਦਨੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਨ ਲੈਹੀ ਸਤ ਭਿਖਿਆ ਮਨਹਠਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: chhaadan bhojan na laihee sat bhikhiaa manahatth janam gavaaeaa |
English: They do not accept the true donations of clothes and food, and their lives are ruined by their stubborn minds.

Gurbani: ਏਤੜਿਆ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸਮਧਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: etarriaa vichahu so jan samadhaa jin guramukh naam dhiaaeaa |
English: Among these, he alone is a man of poise, who, as Gurmukh, meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ਜਾ ਕਰਦੇ ਸਭਿ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jan naanak kis no aakh sunaaeeai jaa karade sabh karaaeaa |2|
English: Unto whom should servant Nanak speak and complain? All act as the Lord causes them to act. ||2||

[Ang 513 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਪਰੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohu paret hai kaam krodh ahankaaraa |
English: Emotional attachment to Maya, sexual desire, anger and egotism are demons.

Gurbani: ਏਹ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਸਿਰਕਾਰ ਹੈ ਏਨੑਾ ਉਪਰਿ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਡੰਡੁ ਕਰਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: eeh jam kee sirakaar hai enaa upar jam kaa ddandd karaaraa |
English: Because of them, mortals are subject to death; above their heads hangs the heavy club of the Messenger of Death.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਜਮ ਮਗਿ ਪਾਈਅਨਿੑ ਜਿਨੑ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh jam mag paaeeana jina doojaa bhaau piaaraa |
English: The self-willed manmukhs, in love with duality, are led onto the path of Death.

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਨਿ ਕੋ ਸੁਣੈ ਨ ਪੂਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jam pur badhe maareean ko sunai na pookaaraa |
English: In the City of Death, they are tied up and beaten, and no one hears their cries.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: jis no kripaa kare tis gur milai guramukh nisataaraa |12|
English: One who is blessed by the Lord's Grace meets the Guru; as Gurmukh, he is emancipated. ||12||

[Ang 513 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਗਈ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: haumai mamataa mohanee manamukhaa no gee khaae |
English: By egotism and pride, the self-willed manmukhs are enticed, and consumed.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਮੋਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਦੇ ਤਿਨਾ ਵਿਆਪਿ ਰਹੀ ਲਪਟਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jo mohi doojai chit laaeide tinaa viaap rahee lapattaae |
English: Those who center their consciousness on duality are caught in it, and remain stuck.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਰਜਾਲੀਐ ਤਾ ਏਹ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad parajaaleeai taa eeh vichahu jaae |
English: But when it is burnt away by the Word of the Guru's Shabad, only then does it depart from within.

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਉਜਲਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: tan man hovai ujalaa naam vasai man aae |
English: The body and mind become radiant and bright, and the Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to dwell within the mind.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak maaeaa kaa maaran har naam hai guramukh paaeaa jaae |1|
English: O Nanak, the Lord's Name is the antidote to Maya; the Gurmukh obtains it. ||1||

[Ang 513 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਕੇਤੜਿਆ ਜੁਗ ਭਰਮਿਆ ਥਿਰੁ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: eihu man ketarriaa jug bharamiaa thir rahai na aavai jaae |
English: This mind has wandered through so many ages; it has not remained stable - it continues coming and going.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਾ ਭਰਮਾਇਅਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਉਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: har bhaanaa taa bharamaaeian kar parapanch khel upaae |
English: When it is pleasing to the Lord's Will, then He causes the soul to wander; He has set the world-drama in motion.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਬਖਸੇ ਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੈ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jaa har bakhase taa gur milai asathir rahai samaae |
English: When the Lord forgives, then one meets the Guru, and becoming stable, he remains absorbed in the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak man hee te man maaniaa naa kichh marai na jaae |2|
English: O Nanak, through the mind, the mind is satisfied, and then, nothing comes or goes. ||2||

[Ang 514 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋਟੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਮਿਲਣਾ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa kott apaar hai milanaa sanjogee |
English: The body is the fortress of the Infinite Lord; it is obtained only by destiny.

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਸਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਆਪੇ ਰਸ ਭੋਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa andar aap vas rahiaa aape ras bhogee |
English: The Lord Himself dwells within the body; He Himself is the Enjoyer of pleasures.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਜੋਗੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੋਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: aap ateet alipat hai nirajog har jogee |
English: He Himself remains detached and unaffected; while unattached, He is still attached.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: jo tis bhaavai so kare har kare su hogee |
English: He does whatever He pleases, and whatever He does, comes to pass.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਵਿਜੋਗੀ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: har guramukh naam dhiaaeeai leh jaeh vijogee |13|
English: The Gurmukh meditates on the Lord's Name, and separation from the Lord is ended. ||13||

[Ang 514 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਅਖਾਇਦਾ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: vaahu vaahu aap akhaaeidaa gurasabadee sach soe |
English: Waaho! Waaho! The Lord Himself causes us to praise Him, through the True Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਲਾਹ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: vaahu vaahu sifat salaah hai guramukh boojhai koe |
English: Waaho! Waaho! is His Eulogy and Praise; how rare are the Gurmukhs who understand this.

Gurbani: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: vaahu vaahu baanee sach hai sach milaavaa hoe |
English: Waaho! Waaho! is the True Word of His Bani, by which we meet our True Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak vaahu vaahu karatiaa prabh paaeaa karam paraapat hoe |1|
English: O Nanak, chanting Waaho! Waaho! God is attained; by His Grace, He is obtained. ||1||

[Ang 514 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਤੀ ਰਸਨਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: vaahu vaahu karatee rasanaa sabad suhaaee |
English: Chanting Waaho! Waaho! the tongue is adorned with the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: poorai sabad prabh miliaa aaee |
English: Through the Perfect Shabad, one comes to meet God.

Gurbani: ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਮੁਹਹੁ ਕਢਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: vaddabhaageea vaahu vaahu muhahu kadtaaee |
English: How very fortunate are those, who with their mouths, chant Waaho! Waaho!

Gurbani: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਪਰਜਾ ਪੂਜਣ ਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: vaahu vaahu kareh seee jan sohane tina kau parajaa poojan aaee |
English: How beautiful are those persons who chant Waaho! Waaho! ; people come to venerate them.

Gurbani: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: vaahu vaahu karam paraapat hovai naanak dar sachai sobhaa paaee |2|
English: Waaho! Waaho! is obtained by His Grace; O Nanak, honor is obtained at the Gate of the True Lord. ||2||

[Ang 514 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਕਾਇਆ ਗੜੑ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਸਤੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: bajar kapaatt kaaeaa garra bheetar koorr kusat abhimaanee |
English: Within the fortress of body, are the hard and rigid doors of falsehood, deception and pride.

Gurbani: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਨੀ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: bharam bhoole nadar na aavanee manamukh andh agiaanee |
English: Deluded by doubt, the blind and ignorant self-willed manmukhs cannot see them.

Gurbani: ਉਪਾਇ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਲਭਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਭੇਖ ਥਕੇ ਭੇਖਵਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: aupaae kitai na labhanee kar bhekh thake bhekhavaanee |
English: They cannot be found by any efforts; wearing their religious robes, the wearers have grown weary of trying.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਖੋਲਾਈਅਨਿੑ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: gurasabadee kholaaeeana har naam japaanee |
English: The doors are opened only by the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and then, one chants the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨ ਪੀਆ ਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨੀ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: har jeeo amrit birakh hai jin peea te tripataanee |14|
English: The Dear Lord is the Tree of Ambrosial Nectar; those who drink in this Nectar are satisfied. ||14||

[Ang 514 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਰੈਣਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: vaahu vaahu karatiaa rain sukh vihaae |
English: Chanting Waaho! Waaho! the night of one's life passes in peace.

Gurbani: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: vaahu vaahu karatiaa sadaa anand hovai meree maae |
English: Chanting Waaho! Waaho! I am in eternal bliss, O my mother!

Gurbani: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: vaahu vaahu karatiaa har siau liv laae |
English: Chanting Waaho! Waaho!, I have fallen in love with the Lord.

Gurbani: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਮੀ ਬੋਲੈ ਬੋਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: vaahu vaahu karamee bolai bolaae |
English: Waaho! Waaho! Through the karma of good deeds, I chant it, and inspire others to chant it as well.

Gurbani: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: vaahu vaahu karatiaa sobhaa paae |
English: Chanting Waaho! Waaho!, one obtains honor.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਤਿ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak vaahu vaahu sat rajaae |1|
English: O Nanak, Waaho! Waaho! is the Will of the True Lord. ||1||

[Ang 514 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਧੀ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: vaahu vaahu baanee sach hai guramukh ladhee bhaal |
English: Waaho! Waaho! is the Bani of the True Word. Searching, the Gurmukhs have found it.

Gurbani: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਉਚਰੈ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: vaahu vaahu sabade ucharai vaahu vaahu hiradai naal |
English: Waaho! Waaho! They chant the Word of the Shabad. Waaho! Waaho! They enshrine it in their hearts.

Gurbani: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: vaahu vaahu karatiaa har paaeaa sahaje guramukh bhaal |
English: Chanting Waaho! Waaho! the Gurmukhs easily obtain the Lord, after searching.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: se vaddabhaagee naanakaa har har ridai samaal |2|
English: O Nanak, very fortunate are those who reflect upon the Lord, Har, Har, within their hearts. ||2||

[Ang 514 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਏ ਮਨਾ ਅਤਿ ਲੋਭੀਆ ਨਿਤ ਲੋਭੇ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: e manaa at lobheea nit lobhe raataa |
English: O my utterly greedy mind, you are constantly engrossed in greed.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਨਸਾ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਫਿਰਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa manasaa mohanee deh dis firaataa |
English: In your desire for the enticing Maya, you wander in the ten directions.

Gurbani: ਅਗੈ ਨਾਉ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਇਸੀ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਖਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: agai naau jaat na jaaeisee manamukh dukh khaataa |
English: Your name and social status shall not go with you hereafter; the self-willed manmukh is consumed by pain.

Gurbani: ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਨ ਚਖਿਓ ਫੀਕਾ ਬੋਲਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: rasanaa har ras na chakhio feekaa bolaataa |
English: Your tongue does not taste the sublime essence of the Lord; it utters only insipid words.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਤਾ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: jinaa guramukh amrit chaakhiaa se jan tripataataa |15|
English: Those Gurmukhs who drink in the Ambrosial Nectar are satisfied. ||15||

[Ang 514 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿ ਸਚਾ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: vaahu vaahu tis no aakheeai ji sachaa gahir ganbheer |
English: Chant Waaho! Waaho! to the Lord, who is True, profound and unfathomable.

Gurbani: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਮਤਿ ਧੀਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: vaahu vaahu tis no aakheeai ji gunadaataa mat dheer |
English: Chant Waaho! Waaho! to the Lord, who is the Giver of virtue, intelligence and patience.

Gurbani: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: vaahu vaahu tis no aakheeai ji sabh meh rahiaa samaae |
English: Chant Waaho! Waaho! to the Lord, who is permeating and pervading in all.

Gurbani: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿ ਦੇਦਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਬਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: vaahu vaahu tis no aakheeai ji dedaa rijak sabaeh |
English: Chant Waaho! Waaho! to the Lord, who is the Giver of sustenance to all.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਇਕੋ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak vaahu vaahu iko kar saalaaheeai ji satigur deea dikhaae |1|
English: O Nanak, Waaho! Waaho! - praise the One Lord, revealed by the True Guru. ||1||

[Ang 515 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਰਹਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: vaahu vaahu guramukh sadaa kareh manamukh mareh bikh khaae |
English: Waaho! Waaho! The Gurmukhs praise the Lord continually, while the self-willed manmukhs eat poison and die.

Gurbani: ਓਨਾ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ਦੁਖੇ ਦੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: onaa vaahu vaahu na bhaavee dukhe dukh vihaae |
English: They have no love for the Lord's Praises, and they pass their lives in misery.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਣਾ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh amrit peevanaa vaahu vaahu kareh liv laae |
English: The Gurmukhs drink in the Ambrosial Nectar, and they center their consciousness on the Lord's Praises.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak vaahu vaahu kareh se jan niramale tribhavan sojhee paae |2|
English: O Nanak, those who chant Waaho! Waaho! are immaculate and pure; they obtain the knowledge of the three worlds. ||2||

[Ang 515 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੇਵਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਨੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: har kai bhaanai gur milai sevaa bhagat baneejai |
English: By the Lord's Will, one meets the Guru, serves Him, and worships the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: har kai bhaanai har man vasai sahaje ras peejai |
English: By the Lord's Will, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind, and one easily drinks in the sublime essence of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਨਿਤ ਲੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: har kai bhaanai sukh paaeeai har laahaa nit leejai |
English: By the Lord's Will, one finds peace, and continually earns the Lord's Profit.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਬਹਾਲੀਐ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਵਸੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: har kai takhat bahaaleeai nij ghar sadaa vaseejai |
English: He is seated on the Lord's throne, and he dwells continually in the home of his own being.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਿਨੀ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲੀਜੈ ॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: har kaa bhaanaa tinee maniaa jinaa guroo mileejai |16|
English: He alone surrenders to the Lord's Will, who meets the Guru. ||16||

[Ang 515 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: vaahu vaahu se jan sadaa kareh jina kau aape dee bujhaae |
English: Waaho! Waaho! Those humble beings ever praise the Lord, unto whom the Lord Himself grants understanding.

Gurbani: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: vaahu vaahu karatiaa man niramal hovai haumai vichahu jaae |
English: Chanting Waaho! Waaho!, the mind is purified, and egotism departs from within.

Gurbani: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਜੋ ਨਿਤ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: vaahu vaahu gurasikh jo nit kare so man chindiaa fal paae |
English: The Gurmukh who continually chants Waaho! Waaho! attains the fruits of his heart's desires.

Gurbani: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: vaahu vaahu kareh se jan sohane har tina kai sang milaae |
English: Beauteous are those humble beings who chant Waaho! Waaho! O Lord, let me join them!

Gurbani: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਉਚਰਾ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਭੀ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰੇਉ ॥
Transliteration: vaahu vaahu hiradai ucharaa mukhahu bhee vaahu vaahu kareo |
English: Within my heart, I chant Waaho! Waaho!, and with my mouth, Waaho! Waaho!

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਜੋ ਕਰਹਿ ਹਉ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਦੇਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak vaahu vaahu jo kareh hau tan man tina kau deo |1|
English: O Nanak, those who chant Waaho! Waaho! - unto them I dedicate my body and mind. ||1||

[Ang 515 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: vaahu vaahu saahib sach hai amrit jaa kaa naau |
English: Waaho! Waaho! is the True Lord Master; His Name is Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jin seviaa tin fal paaeaa hau tin balihaarai jaau |
English: Those who serve the Lord are blessed with the fruit; I am a sacrifice to them.

Gurbani: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਸੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: vaahu vaahu gunee nidhaan hai jis no dee su khaae |
English: Waaho! Waaho! is the treasure of virtue; he alone tastes it, who is so blessed.

Gurbani: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਭਰਪੂਰੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: vaahu vaahu jal thal bharapoor hai guramukh paaeaa jaae |
English: Waaho! Waaho! The Lord is pervading and permeating the oceans and the land; the Gurmukh attains Him.

Gurbani: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਨਿਤ ਸਭ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: vaahu vaahu gurasikh nit sabh karahu gur poore vaahu vaahu bhaavai |
English: Waaho! Waaho! Let all the Gursikhs continually praise Him. Waaho! Waaho! The Perfect Guru is pleased with His Praises.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਜੋ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਮਕੰਕਰੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak vaahu vaahu jo man chit kare tis jamakankar nerr na aavai |2|
English: O Nanak, one who chants Waaho! Waaho! with his heart and mind - the Messenger of Death does not approach him. ||2||

[Ang 515 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੀ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: har jeeo sachaa sach hai sachee gurabaanee |
English: The Dear Lord is the Truest of the True; True is the Word of the Guru's Bani.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਸਚਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: satigur te sach pachhaaneeai sach sehaj samaanee |
English: Through the True Guru, the Truth is realized, and one is easily absorbed in the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਹਿ ਨਾ ਸਵਹਿ ਜਾਗਤ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: anadin jaageh naa saveh jaagat rain vihaanee |
English: Night and day, they remain awake, and do not sleep; in wakefulness, the night of their lives passes.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸੇ ਪੁੰਨ ਪਰਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: guramatee har ras chaakhiaa se pun paraanee |
English: Those who taste the sublime essence of the Lord, through the Guru's Teachings, are the most worthy persons.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਅਜਾਣੀ ॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: bin gur kinai na paaeo pach mue ajaanee |17|
English: Without the Guru, no one has obtained the Lord; the ignorant rot away and die. ||17||

[Ang 515 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: vaahu vaahu baanee nirankaar hai tis jevadd avar na koe |
English: Waaho! Waaho! is the Bani, the Word, of the Formless Lord. There is no other as great as He is.

Gurbani: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਹੈ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: vaahu vaahu agam athaahu hai vaahu vaahu sachaa soe |
English: Waaho! Waaho! The Lord is unfathomable and inaccessible. Waaho! Waaho! He is the True One.

Gurbani: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਹੈ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: vaahu vaahu veparavaahu hai vaahu vaahu kare su hoe |
English: Waaho! Waaho! He is the self-existent Lord. Waaho! Waaho! As He wills, so it comes to pass.

Gurbani: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: vaahu vaahu amrit naam hai guramukh paavai koe |
English: Waaho! Waaho! is the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, obtained by the Gurmukh.

Gurbani: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਮੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: vaahu vaahu karamee paaeeai aap deaa kar dee |
English: Waaho! Waaho! This is realized by His Grace, as He Himself grants His Grace.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਏਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak vaahu vaahu guramukh paaeeai anadin naam lee |1|
English: O Nanak, Waaho! Waaho! This is obtained by the Gurmukhs, who hold tight to the Naam, night and day. ||1||

[Ang 516 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਸਾਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin satigur seve saat na aavee doojee naahee jaae |
English: Without serving the True Guru, peace is not obtained, and the sense of duality does not depart.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰਾ ਲੋਚੀਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: je bahuteraa locheeai vin karamai na paaeaa jaae |
English: No matter how much one may wish, without the Lord's Grace, He is not found.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: jinaa antar lobh vikaar hai doojai bhaae khuaae |
English: Those who are filled with greed and corruption are ruined by the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jaman maran na chukee haumai vich dukh paae |
English: They cannot escape birth and death, and with egotism within them, they suffer in misery.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਸੁ ਖਾਲੀ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jinaa satigur siau chit laaeaa su khaalee koee naeh |
English: Those who center their consciousness on the True Guru, never go empty-handed.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤਲਬ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਾ ਓਇ ਦੁਖ ਸਹਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: tin jam kee talab na hovee naa oe dukh sahaeh |
English: They are not summoned by the Messenger of Death, and they do not suffer in pain.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh ubare sachai sabad samaeh |2|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are saved; they merge in the True Lord. ||2||

[Ang 516 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਢਾਢੀ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿ ਖਸਮੈ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: dtaadtee tis no aakheeai ji khasamai dhare piaar |
English: He alone is called a minstrel, who enshrines love for his Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਦਰਿ ਖੜਾ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: dar kharraa sevaa kare gurasabadee veechaar |
English: Standing at the Lord's Door, he serves the Lord, and reflects upon the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਢਾਢੀ ਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ ਸਚੁ ਰਖੈ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: dtaadtee dar ghar paaeisee sach rakhai ur dhaar |
English: The minstrel attains the Lord's Gate and Mansion, and he keeps the True Lord clasped to his heart.

Gurbani: ਢਾਢੀ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਅਗਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: dtaadtee kaa mehal agalaa har kai naae piaar |
English: The status of the minstrel is exalted; he loves the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਢਾਢੀ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿ ॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: dtaadtee kee sevaa chaakaree har jap har nisataar |18|
English: The service of the minstrel is to meditate on the Lord; he is emancipated by the Lord. ||18||

[Ang 516 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਗਵਾਰਿ ਜਾ ਸਹੁ ਪਾਏ ਆਪਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree jaat gavaar jaa sahu paae aapanaa |
English: The milkmaid's status is very low, but she attains her Husband Lord

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad veechaar anadin har jap jaapanaa |
English: when she reflects upon the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and chants the Lord's Name, night and day.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਉ ਪਵੈ ਸਾ ਕੁਲਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jis satigur milai tis bhau pavai saa kulavantee naar |
English: She who meets the True Guru, lives in the Fear of God; she is a woman of noble birth.

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਕੰਤ ਕਾ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕੀਤੀ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: saa hukam pachhaanai kant kaa jis no kripaa keetee karataar |
English: She alone realizes the Hukam of her Husband Lord's Command, who is blessed by the Creator Lord's Mercy.

Gurbani: ਓਹ ਕੁਚਜੀ ਕੁਲਖਣੀ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਛੋਡੀ ਭਤਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: oeh kuchajee kulakhanee parahar chhoddee bhataar |
English: She who is of little merit and ill-mannered, is discarded and forsaken by her Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਪਇਐ ਮਲੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: bhai peiai mal katteeai niramal hovai sareer |
English: By the Fear of God, filth is washed off, and the body becomes immaculately pure.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: antar paragaas mat aootam hovai har jap gunee gaheer |
English: The soul is enlightened, and the intellect is exalted, meditating on the Lord, the ocean of excellence.

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਬੈਸੈ ਭੈ ਰਹੈ ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: bhai vich baisai bhai rahai bhai vich kamaavai kaar |
English: One who dwells in the Fear of God, lives in the Fear of God, and acts in the Fear of God.

Gurbani: ਐਥੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਦਰਗਹ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
Transliteration: aithai sukh vaddiaaeea daragah mokh duaar |
English: He obtains peace and glorious greatness here, in the Lord's Court, and at the Gate of Salvation.

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: bhai te nirbhau paaeeai mil jotee jot apaar |
English: Through the Fear of God, the Fearless Lord is obtained, and one's light merges in the Infinite Light.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਖਸਮੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾ ਭਲੀ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak khasamai bhaavai saa bhalee jis no aape bakhase karataar |1|
English: O Nanak, that bride alone is good, who is pleasing to her Lord and Master, and whom the Creator Lord Himself forgives. ||1||

[Ang 516 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਸਚੇ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa saalaaheeai sache kau bal jaau |
English: Praise the Lord, forever and ever, and make yourself a sacrifice to the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗੈ ਸਾ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak ek chhodd doojai lagai saa jihavaa jal jaau |2|
English: O Nanak, let that tongue be burnt, which renounces the One Lord, and attaches itself to another. ||2||

[Ang 516 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਅੰਸਾ ਅਉਤਾਰੁ ਉਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਭਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: ansaa aautaar upaaeon bhaau doojaa keea |
English: From a single particle of His greatness, He created His incarnations, but they indulged in the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਰਾਜੇ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਭਿੜੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: jiau raaje raaj kamaavade dukh sukh bhirreea |
English: They ruled like kings, and fought for pleasure and pain.

Gurbani: ਈਸਰੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਅੰਤੁ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਨ ਲਹੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: eesar brahamaa sevade ant tinaee na laheea |
English: Those who serve Shiva and Brahma do not find the limits of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: nirbhau nirankaar alakh hai guramukh pragatteea |
English: The Fearless, Formless Lord is unseen and invisible; He is revealed only to the Gurmukh.

Gurbani: ਤਿਥੈ ਸੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪਈ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਜਗਿ ਥੀਆ ॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: tithai sog vijog na viaapee asathir jag theea |19|
English: There, one does not suffer sorrow or separation; he becomes stable and immortal in the world. ||19||

[Ang 516 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਏਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਜੇਤਾ ਹੈ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: ehu sabh kichh aavan jaan hai jetaa hai aakaar |
English: All these things come and go, all these things of the world.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹੁ ਲੇਖਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਹੋਆ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: jin ehu lekhaa likhiaa so hoaa paravaan |
English: One who knows this written account is acceptable and approved.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਦਾ ਸੋ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਗਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak je ko aap ganaaeidaa so moorakh gaavaar |1|
English: O Nanak, anyone who takes pride in himself is foolish and unwise. ||1||

[Ang 516 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਕੁੰਚਰੁ ਪੀਲਕੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਜਹ ਖਿੰਚੇ ਤਹ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man kunchar peelak guroo giaan kunddaa jeh khinche teh jaae |
English: The mind is the elephant, the Guru is the elephant-driver, and knowledge is the whip. Wherever the Guru drives the mind, it goes.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਸਤੀ ਕੁੰਡੇ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਉਝੜਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak hasatee kundde baaharaa fir fir ujharr paae |2|
English: O Nanak, without the whip, the elephant wanders into the wilderness, again and again. ||2||

[Ang 516 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tis aagai aradaas jin upaaeaa |
English: I offer my prayer to the One, from whom I was created.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਭ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: satigur apanaa sev sabh fal paaeaa |
English: Serving my True Guru, I have obtained all the fruits.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: amrit har kaa naau sadaa dhiaaeaa |
English: I meditate continually on the Ambrosial Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sant janaa kai sang dukh mittaaeaa |
English: In the Society of the Saints, I am rid of my pain and suffering.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਏ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਨਿਹਚਲਾਇਆ ॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: naanak bhe achint har dhan nihachalaaeaa |20|
English: O Nanak, I have become care-free; I have obtained the imperishable wealth of the Lord. ||20||

[Ang 517 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਖੇਤਿ ਮਿਆਲਾ ਉਚੀਆ ਘਰੁ ਉਚਾ ਨਿਰਣਉ ॥
Transliteration: khet miaalaa ucheea ghar uchaa nirnau |
English: Raising the embankments of the mind's field, I gaze at the heavenly mansion.

Gurbani: ਮਹਲ ਭਗਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਸਰੈ ਸਜਣ ਪਾਹੁਣਿਅਉ ॥
Transliteration: mehal bhagatee ghar sarai sajan paahuniaau |
English: When devotion comes to the mind of the soul-bride, she is visited by the friendly guest.

Gurbani: ਬਰਸਨਾ ਤ ਬਰਸੁ ਘਨਾ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਬਰਸਹਿ ਕਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: barasanaa ta baras ghanaa bahurr baraseh kaeh |
English: O clouds, if you are going to rain, then go ahead and rain; why rain after the season has passed?

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨੑ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜਿਨੑ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak tina balihaaranai jina guramukh paaeaa man maeh |1|
English: Nanak is a sacrifice to those Gurmukhs who obtain the Lord in their minds. ||1||

[Ang 517 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਿਠਾ ਸੋ ਜੋ ਭਾਵਦਾ ਸਜਣੁ ਸੋ ਜਿ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: mitthaa so jo bhaavadaa sajan so ji raas |
English: That which is pleasing is sweet, and one who is sincere is a friend.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh jaaneeai jaa kau aap kare paragaas |2|
English: O Nanak, he is known as a Gurmukh, whom the Lord Himself enlightens. ||2||

[Ang 517 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਤੂ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਂਈ ॥
Transliteration: prabh paas jan kee aradaas too sachaa saanee |
English: O God, Your humble servant offers his prayer to You; You are my True Master.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: too rakhavaalaa sadaa sadaa hau tudh dhiaaee |
English: You are my Protector, forever and ever; I meditate on You.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰਿਆ ਤੂ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
