Transliteration: jeea jant sabh teriaa too rahiaa samaaee |
English: All the beings and creatures are Yours; You are pervading and permeating in them.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਚਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jo daas tere kee nindaa kare tis maar pachaaee |
English: One who slanders Your slave is crushed and destroyed.

Gurbani: ਚਿੰਤਾ ਛਡਿ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਰਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਗਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੨੧॥
Transliteration: chintaa chhadd achint rahu naanak lag paaee |21|
English: Falling at Your Feet, Nanak has renounced his cares, and has become care-free. ||21||

[Ang 517 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਗੁ ਮੁਆ ਆਸਾ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa karataa jag muaa aasaa marai na jaae |
English: Building up its hopes, the world dies, but its hopes do not die or depart.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਸਾ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak aasaa pooreea sache siau chit laae |1|
English: O Nanak, hopes are fulfilled only by attaching one's consciousness to the True Lord. ||1||

[Ang 517 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇਸੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤੀ ਸੋ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa manasaa mar jaaeisee jin keetee so lai jaae |
English: Hopes and desires shall die only when He, who created them, takes them away.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak nihachal ko nahee baajhahu har kai naae |2|
English: O Nanak, nothing is permanent, except the Name of the Lord. ||2||

[Ang 517 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਥਾਟੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape jagat upaaeon kar pooraa thaatt |
English: He Himself created the world, with His perfect workmanship.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਾਟੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape saahu aape vanajaaraa aape hee har haatt |
English: He Himself is the true banker, He Himself is the merchant, and He Himself is the store.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਖੇਵਾਟੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape saagar aape bohithaa aape hee khevaatt |
English: He Himself is the ocean, He Himself is the boat, and He Himself is the boatman.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲਾ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਦਸੇ ਘਾਟੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape gur chelaa hai aape aape dase ghaatt |
English: He Himself is the Guru, He Himself is the disciple, and He Himself shows the destination.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਾਟੁ ॥੨੨॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ
Transliteration: jan naanak naam dhiaae too sabh kilavikh kaatt |22|1| sudh
English: O servant Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and all your sins shall be eradicated. ||22||1||Sudh||

[Ang 517 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੂਜਰੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raag goojaree vaar mahalaa 5 |
English: Raag Goojaree, Vaar, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਰਾਧਣਾ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਜਪਿ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: antar gur aaraadhanaa jihavaa jap gur naau |
English: Deep within yourself, worship the Guru in adoration, and with your tongue, chant the Guru's Name.

Gurbani: ਨੇਤ੍ਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੇਖਣਾ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਸੁਨਣਾ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: netree satigur pekhanaa sravanee sunanaa gur naau |
English: Let your eyes behold the True Guru, and let your ears hear the Guru's Name.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਈਐ ਠਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur setee ratiaa daragah paaeeai tthaau |
English: Attuned to the True Guru, you shall receive a place of honor in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਏਹ ਵਥੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak kirapaa kare jis no eeh vath dee |
English: Says Nanak, this treasure is bestowed on those who are blessed with His Mercy.

Gurbani: ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਉਤਮ ਕਾਢੀਅਹਿ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕੇਈ ਕੇਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jag meh utam kaadteeeh virale keee kee |1|
English: In the midst of the world, they are known as the most pious - they are rare indeed. ||1||

[Ang 517 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਖੇ ਰਖਣਹਾਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਉਬਾਰਿਅਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: rakhe rakhanahaar aap ubaarian |
English: O Savior Lord, save us and take us across.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਿਅਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur kee pairee paae kaaj savaarian |
English: Falling at the feet of the Guru, our works are embellished with perfection.

Gurbani: ਹੋਆ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਅਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: hoaa aap deaal manahu na visaarian |
English: You have become kind, merciful and compassionate; we do not forget You from our minds.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਾਰਿਅਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: saadh janaa kai sang bhavajal taarian |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, we are carried across the terrifying world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਦੁਸਟ ਖਿਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਬਿਦਾਰਿਅਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: saakat nindak dusatt khin maeh bidaarian |
English: In an instant, You have destroyed the faithless cynics and slanderous enemies.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੈ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: tis saahib kee ttek naanak manai maeh |
English: That Lord and Master is my Anchor and Support; O Nanak, hold firm in your mind.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jis simarat sukh hoe sagale dookh jaeh |2|
English: Remembering Him in meditation, happiness comes, and all sorrows and pains simply vanish. ||2||

[Ang 518 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਅਕੁਲ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: akul niranjan purakh agam apaareeai |
English: He is without relatives, immaculate, all-powerful, unapproachable and infinite.

Gurbani: ਸਚੋ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਹਾਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: sacho sachaa sach sach nihaareeai |
English: Truly, the True Lord is seen to be the Truest of the True.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਧਾਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: koorr na jaapai kichh teree dhaareeai |
English: Nothing established by You appears to be false.

Gurbani: ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਜੇਤ ਉਪਾਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: sabhasai de daataar jet upaareeai |
English: The Great Giver gives sustenance to all those He has created.

Gurbani: ਇਕਤੁ ਸੂਤਿ ਪਰੋਇ ਜੋਤਿ ਸੰਜਾਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: eikat soot paroe jot sanjaareeai |
English: He has strung all on only one thread; He has infused His Light in them.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਭਵਜਲ ਮੰਝਿ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਤਾਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: hukame bhavajal manjh hukame taareeai |
English: By His Will, some drown in the terrifying world-ocean, and by His Will, some are carried across.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਸੋਇ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਗੁ ਮਥਾਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: prabh jeeo tudh dhiaae soe jis bhaag mathaareeai |
English: O Dear Lord, he alone meditates on You, upon whose forehead such blessed destiny is inscribed.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਲਖੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀਐ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: teree gat mit lakhee na jaae hau tudh balihaareeai |1|
English: Your condition and state cannot be known; I am a sacrifice to You. ||1||

[Ang 518 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਤੁਸਹਿ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਵਸਹਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jaa toon tuseh miharavaan achint vaseh man maeh |
English: When You are pleased, O Merciful Lord, you automatically come to dwell within my mind.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਤੁਸਹਿ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jaa toon tuseh miharavaan nau nidh ghar meh paeh |
English: When You are pleased, O Merciful Lord, I find the nine treasures within the home of my own self.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਤੁਸਹਿ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jaa toon tuseh miharavaan taa gur kaa mantru kamaeh |
English: When You are pleased, O Merciful Lord, I act according to the Guru's Instructions.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਤੁਸਹਿ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jaa toon tuseh miharavaan taa naanak sach samaeh |1|
English: When You are pleased, O Merciful Lord, then Nanak is absorbed in the True One. ||1||

[Ang 518 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਿਤੀ ਬੈਹਨਿੑ ਬੈਹਣੇ ਮੁਚੁ ਵਜਾਇਨਿ ਵਜ ॥
Transliteration: kitee baihana baihane much vajaaein vaj |
English: Many sit on thrones, to the sounds of musical instruments.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਰਹੀਆ ਲਜ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak sache naam vin kisai na raheea laj |2|
English: O Nanak, without the True Name, no one's honor is safe. ||2||

[Ang 518 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿੑ ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬਾ ਸਣੁ ਖੜੇ ॥
Transliteration: tudh dhiaaeina bed katebaa san kharre |
English: The followers of the Vedas, the Bible and the Koran, standing at Your Door, meditate on You.

Gurbani: ਗਣਤੀ ਗਣੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਤੇਰੈ ਦਰਿ ਪੜੇ ॥
Transliteration: ganatee ganee na jaae terai dar parre |
English: Uncounted are those who fall at Your Door.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿੑ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਸਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: brahame tudh dhiaaeina indr indraasanaa |
English: Brahma meditates on You, as does Indra on his throne.

Gurbani: ਸੰਕਰ ਬਿਸਨ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਭਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: sankar bisan avataar har jas mukh bhanaa |
English: Shiva and Vishnu, and their incarnations, chant the Lord's Praise with their mouths,

Gurbani: ਪੀਰ ਪਿਕਾਬਰ ਸੇਖ ਮਸਾਇਕ ਅਉਲੀਏ ॥
Transliteration: peer pikaabar sekh masaaeik aaulee |
English: as do the Pirs, the spiritual teachers, the prophets and the Shaykhs, the silent sages and the seers.

Gurbani: ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਮਉਲੀਏ ॥
Transliteration: ot pot nirankaar ghatt ghatt maulee |
English: Through and through, the Formless Lord is woven into each and every heart.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜਹੁ ਕਰੇ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ਧਰਮੇ ਤਗੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: koorrahu kare vinaas dharame tageeai |
English: One is destroyed through falsehood; through righteousness, one prospers.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗੀਐ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jit jit laaeihi aap tith tit lageeai |2|
English: Whatever the Lord links him to, to that he is linked. ||2||

[Ang 518 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਚੰਗਿਆੲਂੀ ਆਲਕੁ ਕਰੇ ਬੁਰਿਆੲਂੀ ਹੋਇ ਸੇਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: changiaaenee aalak kare buriaaenee hoe ser |
English: He is reluctant to do good, but eager to practice evil.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਜੁ ਕਲਿ ਆਵਸੀ ਗਾਫਲ ਫਾਹੀ ਪੇਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak aj kal aavasee gaafal faahee per |1|
English: O Nanak, today or tomorrow, the feet of the careless fool shall fall into the trap. ||1||

[Ang 518 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਿਤੀਆ ਕੁਢੰਗ ਗੁਝਾ ਥੀਐ ਨ ਹਿਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: kiteea kudtang gujhaa theeai na hit |
English: No matter how evil my ways are, still, Your Love for me is not concealed.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੈ ਸਹਿ ਢਕਿਆ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਚਾ ਮਿਤੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak tai seh dtakiaa man meh sachaa mit |2|
English: Nanak: You, O Lord, conceal my short-comings and dwell within my mind; You are my true friend. ||2||

[Ang 518 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਮਾਗਉ ਤੁਝੈ ਦਇਆਲ ਕਰਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਗੋਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau maagau tujhai deaal kar daasaa goliaa |
English: I beg of You, O Merciful Lord: please, make me the slave of Your slaves.

Gurbani: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੀਵਾ ਬੋਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: nau nidh paaee raaj jeevaa boliaa |
English: I obtain the nine treasures and royalty; chanting Your Name, I live.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਦਾਸਾ ਘਰਿ ਘਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: amrit naam nidhaan daasaa ghar ghanaa |
English: The great ambrosial treasure, the Nectar of the Naam, is in the home of the Lord's slaves.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: tin kai sang nihaal sravanee jas sunaa |
English: In their company, I am in ecstasy, listening to Your Praises with my ears.

Gurbani: ਕਮਾਵਾ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: kamaavaa tin kee kaar sareer pavit hoe |
English: Serving them, my body is purified.

Gurbani: ਪਖਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਪੀਸਿ ਬਿਗਸਾ ਪੈਰ ਧੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: pakhaa paanee pees bigasaa pair dhoe |
English: I wave the fans over them, and carry water for them; I grind the corn for them, and washing their feet, I am over-joyed.

Gurbani: ਆਪਹੁ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: aapahu kachhoo na hoe prabh nadar nihaaleeai |
English: By myself, I can do nothing; O God, bless me with Your Glance of Grace.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਦਿਚੈ ਥਾਉ ਸੰਤ ਧਰਮ ਸਾਲੀਐ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: mohi niragun dichai thaau sant dharam saaleeai |3|
English: I am worthless - please, bless me with a seat in the place of worship of the Saints. ||3||

[Ang 518 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਾਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਚਰਨ ਕੀ ਹੋਇ ਰਹਾ ਸਦ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: saajan tere charan kee hoe rahaa sad dhoor |
English: O Friend, I pray that I may remain forever the dust of Your Feet.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੀਆ ਪੇਖਉ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak saran tuhaareea pekhau sadaa hajoor |1|
English: Nanak has entered Your Sanctuary, and beholds You ever-present. ||1||

[Ang 518 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਅਸੰਖ ਹੋਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗ ॥
Transliteration: patit puneet asankh hohi har charanee man laag |
English: Countless sinners become pure, by fixing their minds on the Feet of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: atthasatth teerath naam prabh jis naanak masatak bhaag |2|
English: The Name of God is the sixty-eight holy places of pilgrimage, O Nanak, for one who has such destiny written upon his forehead. ||2||

[Ang 518 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਨਿਤ ਜਪੀਐ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਨਾਉ ਪਰਵਦਿਗਾਰ ਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: nit japeeai saas giraas naau paravadigaar daa |
English: With every breath and morsel of food, chant the Name of the Lord, the Cherisher.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਰੇ ਰਹੰਮ ਤਿਸੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਾਰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: jis no kare raham tis na visaaradaa |
English: The Lord does not forget one upon whom He has bestowed His Grace.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਵਣਹਾਰ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਮਾਰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: aap upaavanahaar aape hee maaradaa |
English: He Himself is the Creator, and He Himself destroys.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਾਣੁ ਬੁਝਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh jaanai jaan bujh veechaaradaa |
English: The Knower knows everything; He understands and contemplates.

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਰੂਪ ਖਿਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਧਾਰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: anik roop khin maeh kudarat dhaaradaa |
English: By His creative power, He assumes numerous forms in an instant.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਾਇ ਸਚਿ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਉਧਾਰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: jis no laae sach tiseh udhaaradaa |
English: One whom the Lord attaches to the Truth is redeemed.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਦੈ ਹੋਵੈ ਵਲਿ ਸੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹਾਰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: jis dai hovai val su kade na haaradaa |
English: One who has God on his side is never conquered.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਅਭਗੁ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਦਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: sadaa abhag deebaan hai hau tis namasakaaradaa |4|
English: His Court is eternal and imperishable; I humbly bow to Him. ||4||

[Ang 519 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਛੋਡੀਐ ਦੀਜੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh lobh chhoddeeai deejai agan jalaae |
English: Renounce sexual desire, anger and greed, and burn them in the fire.

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਨਿਤ ਜਾਪੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jeevadiaa nit jaapeeai naanak saachaa naau |1|
English: As long as you are alive, O Nanak, meditate continually on the True Name. ||1||

[Ang 519 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਭ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਆਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: simarat simarat prabh aapanaa sabh fal paae aaeh |
English: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on my God, I have obtained all the fruits.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੀਆ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naam araadhiaa gur poorai deea milaae |2|
English: O Nanak, I worship the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the Perfect Guru has united me with the Lord. ||2||

[Ang 519 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: so mukataa sansaar ji gur upadesiaa |
English: One who has been instructed by the Guru is liberated in this world.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਗਈ ਬਲਾਇ ਮਿਟੇ ਅੰਦੇਸਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: tis kee gee balaae mitte andesiaa |
English: He avoids disaster, and his anxiety is dispelled.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: tis kaa darasan dekh jagat nihaal hoe |
English: Beholding the blessed vision of his Darshan, the world is over-joyed.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਪਾਪਾ ਮੈਲੁ ਧੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jan kai sang nihaal paapaa mail dhoe |
English: In the company of the Lord's humble servants, the world is over-joyed, and the filth of sin is washed away.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਉ ਓਥੈ ਜਾਪੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: amrit saachaa naau othai jaapeeai |
English: There, they meditate on the Ambrosial Nectar of the True Name.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕਉ ਹੋਇ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਭੁਖਾ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: man kau hoe santokh bhukhaa dhraapeeai |
English: The mind becomes content, and its hunger is satisfied.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਘਟਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਨਾਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: jis ghatt vasiaa naau tis bandhan kaatteeai |
English: One whose heart is filled with the Name, has his bonds cut away.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਾਟੀਐ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: gur parasaad kinai viralai har dhan khaatteeai |5|
English: By Guru's Grace, some rare person earns the wealth of the Lord's Name. ||5||

[Ang 519 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਚਿਤਵਨੀ ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਉ ਉਠਿ ਨੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: man meh chitvau chitavanee udam krau utth neet |
English: Within my mind, I think thoughts of always rising early, and making the effort.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਕਾ ਆਹਰੋ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har keeratan kaa aaharo har dehu naanak ke meet |1|
English: O Lord, my Friend, please bless Nanak with the habit of singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||1||

[Ang 519 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਮੂਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: drisatt dhaar prabh raakhiaa man tan rataa mool |
English: Casting His Glance of Grace, God has saved me; my mind and body are imbued with the Primal Being.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣੀਆ ਮਰਉ ਵਿਚਾਰੀ ਸੂਲਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak jo prabh bhaaneea mrau vichaaree sool |2|
English: O Nanak, those who are pleasing to God, have their cries of suffering taken away. ||2||

[Ang 519 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਕਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jeea kee birathaa hoe su gur peh aradaas kar |
English: When your soul is feeling sad, offer your prayers to the Guru.

Gurbani: ਛੋਡਿ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਸਗਲ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਧਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: chhodd siaanap sagal man tan arap dhar |
English: Renounce all your cleverness, and dedicate your mind and body to Him.

Gurbani: ਪੂਜਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਪੈਰ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਇ ਜਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: poojahu gur ke pair duramat jaae jar |
English: Worship the Feet of the Guru, and your evil-mindedness shall be burnt away.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਤਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: saadh janaa kai sang bhavajal bikham tar |
English: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall cross over the terrifying and difficult world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੇਵ ਅਗੈ ਨ ਮਰਹੁ ਡਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: sevahu satigur dev agai na marahu ddar |
English: Serve the True Guru, and in the world hereafter, you shall not die of fear.

Gurbani: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਊਣੇ ਸੁਭਰ ਭਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: khin meh kare nihaal aoone subhar bhar |
English: In an instant, he shall make you happy, and the empty vessel shall be filled to overflowing.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕਉ ਹੋਇ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: man kau hoe santokh dhiaaeeai sadaa har |
English: The mind becomes content, meditating forever on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਲਗਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕਰਮੁ ਧੁਰਿ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: so lagaa satigur sev jaa kau karam dhur |6|
English: He alone dedicates himself to the Guru's service, unto whom the Lord has granted His Grace. ||6||

[Ang 519 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਲਗੜੀ ਸੁਥਾਨਿ ਜੋੜਣਹਾਰੈ ਜੋੜੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: lagarree suthaan jorranahaarai jorreea |
English: I am attached to the right place; the Uniter has united me.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਹਰੀ ਲਖ ਸੈ ਆਨ ਡੁਬਣ ਦੇਇ ਨ ਮਾ ਪਿਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak laharee lakh sai aan dduban dee na maa piree |1|
English: O Nanak, there are hundreds and thousands of waves, but my Husband Lord does not let me drown. ||1||

[Ang 519 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬਨਿ ਭੀਹਾਵਲੈ ਹਿਕੁ ਸਾਥੀ ਲਧਮੁ ਦੁਖ ਹਰਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: ban bheehaavalai hik saathee ladham dukh harataa har naamaa |
English: In the dreadful wilderness, I have found the one and only companion; the Name of the Lord is the Destroyer of distress.

Gurbani: ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮਾਂ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bal bal jaaee sant piaare naanak pooran kaamaan |2|
English: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Beloved Saints, O Nanak; through them, my affairs have been brought to fulfillment. ||2||

[Ang 519 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਪਾਈਅਨਿ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਤੇਰੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: paaeean sabh nidhaan terai rang ratiaa |
English: All treasures are obtained, when we are attuned to Your Love.

Gurbani: ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਪਛੋਤਾਉ ਤੁਧ ਨੋ ਜਪਤਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: n hovee pachhotaau tudh no japatiaa |
English: One does not have to suffer regret and repentance, when he meditates on You.

Gurbani: ਪਹੁਚਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਜਨ ॥
Transliteration: pahuch na sakai koe teree ttek jan |
English: No one can equal Your humble servant, who has Your Support.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸੁਖ ਲਹਾ ਚਿਤਾਰਿ ਮਨ ॥
Transliteration: gur poore vaahu vaahu sukh lahaa chitaar man |
English: Waaho! Waaho! How wonderful is the Perfect Guru! Cherishing Him in my mind, I obtain peace.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ਕਰਮੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: gur peh sifat bhanddaar karamee paaeeai |
English: The treasure of the Lord's Praise comes from the Guru; by His Mercy, it is obtained.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਧਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: satigur nadar nihaal bahurr na dhaaeeai |
English: When the True Guru bestows His Glance of Grace, one does not wander any more.

Gurbani: ਰਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਆਪਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: rakhai aap deaal kar daasaa aapane |
English: The Merciful Lord preserves him - He makes him His own slave.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀਵਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣੇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: har har har har naam jeevaa sun sune |7|
English: Listening, hearing the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har, I live. ||7||

[Ang 520 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਟੋਲਾ ਤੈ ਸਹਿ ਦਿਤਾ ਢਕਣ ਕੂ ਪਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: prem pattolaa tai seh ditaa dtakan koo pat meree |
English: O Husband Lord, You have given me the silk gown of Your Love to cover and protect my honor.

Gurbani: ਦਾਨਾ ਬੀਨਾ ਸਾਈ ਮੈਡਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਤੇਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: daanaa beenaa saaee maiddaa naanak saar na jaanaa teree |1|
English: You are all-wise and all-knowing, O my Master; Nanak: I have not appreciated Your value, Lord. ||1||

[Ang 520 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤੈਡੈ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ ਹਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਲਧਮੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਨ ਡਿਠਮੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: taiddai simaran habh kichh ladham bikham na ddittham koee |
English: By Your meditative remembrance, I have found everything; nothing seems difficult to me.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਤਿ ਰਖੈ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jis pat rakhai sachaa saahib naanak mett na sakai koee |2|
English: One whose honor the True Lord Master has preserved - O Nanak, no one can dishonor him. ||2||

[Ang 520 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਘਣਾ ਦਯਿ ਧਿਆਇਐ ॥
Transliteration: hovai sukh ghanaa day dhiaaeiai |
English: Meditating on the Lord, there comes a great peace.

Gurbani: ਵੰਞੈ ਰੋਗਾ ਘਾਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਐ ॥
Transliteration: vanyai rogaa ghaan har gun gaaeiai |
English: Multitudes of illnesses vanish, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਠਾਢਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਇਐ ॥
Transliteration: andar varatai tthaadt prabh chit aaeiai |
English: Utter peace pervades within, when God comes to mind.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਆਸ ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਐ ॥
Transliteration: pooran hovai aas naae man vasaaeiai |
English: One's hopes are fulfilled, when one's mind is filled with the Name.

Gurbani: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਐ ॥
Transliteration: koe na lagai bighan aap gavaaeiai |
English: No obstacles stand in the way, when one eliminates his self-conceit.

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਐ ॥
Transliteration: giaan padaarath mat gur te paaeiai |
English: The intellect attains the blessing of spiritual wisdom from the Guru.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਏ ਸਭੇ ਥੋਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਦਿਵਾਇਐ ॥
Transliteration: tin paae sabhe thok jis aap divaaeiai |
English: He receives everything, unto whom the Lord Himself gives.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਛਾਇਐ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: toon sabhanaa kaa khasam sabh teree chhaaeiai |8|
English: You are the Lord and Master of all; all are under Your Protection. ||8||

[Ang 520 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਦੀ ਤਰੰਦੜੀ ਮੈਡਾ ਖੋਜੁ ਨ ਖੁੰਭੈ ਮੰਝਿ ਮੁਹਬਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: nadee tarandarree maiddaa khoj na khunbhai manjh muhabat teree |
English: Crossing the stream, my foot does not get stuck - I am filled with love for You.

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਸਹ ਚਰਣੀ ਮੈਡਾ ਹੀਅੜਾ ਸੀਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੁਲਹਾ ਬੇੜੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tau seh charanee maiddaa heearraa seetam har naanak tulahaa berree |1|
English: O Lord, my heart is attached to Your Feet; the Lord is Nanak's raft and boat. ||1||

[Ang 520 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਦਿਸੰਦੜਿਆ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਵੰਞੈ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਅਸਾਡੜੇ ਸੇਈ ॥
Transliteration: jinaa disandarriaa duramat vanyai mitr asaaddarre seee |
English: The sight of them banishes my evil-mindedness; they are my only true friends.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਢੂਢੇਦੀ ਜਗੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕੇਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: hau dtoodtedee jag sabaaeaa jan naanak virale keee |2|
English: I have searched the whole world; O servant Nanak, how rare are such persons! ||2||

[Ang 520 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਆਵੈ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਤੇਰਿਆ ਭਗਤਾ ਡਿਠਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: aavai saahib chit teriaa bhagataa dditthiaa |
English: You come to mind, O Lord and Master, when I behold Your devotees.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਕਟੀਐ ਮੈਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਵੁਠਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: man kee katteeai mail saadhasang vutthiaa |
English: The filth of my mind is removed, when I dwell in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭਉ ਕਟੀਐ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਜਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: janam maran bhau katteeai jan kaa sabad jap |
English: The fear of birth and death is dispelled, meditating on the Word of His humble servant.

Gurbani: ਬੰਧਨ ਖੋਲਨਿੑ ਸੰਤ ਦੂਤ ਸਭਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਛਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: bandhan kholana sant doot sabh jaeh chhap |
English: The Saints untie the bonds, and all the demons are dispelled.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਇਨਿੑ ਰੰਗੁ ਜਿਸ ਦੀ ਸਭ ਧਾਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: tis siau laaeina rang jis dee sabh dhaareea |
English: They inspire us to love Him, the One who established the entire universe.

Gurbani: ਊਚੀ ਹੂੰ ਊਚਾ ਥਾਨੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: aoochee hoon aoochaa thaan agam apaareea |
English: The seat of the inaccessible and infinite Lord is the highest of the high.

Gurbani: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: rain dinas kar jorr saas saas dhiaaeeai |
English: Night and day, with your palms pressed together, with each and every breath, meditate on Him.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਾਂ ਭਗਤ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: jaa aape hoe deaal taan bhagat sang paaeeai |9|
English: When the Lord Himself becomes merciful, then we attain the Society of His devotees. ||9||

[Ang 520 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬਾਰਿ ਵਿਡਾਨੜੈ ਹੁੰਮਸ ਧੁੰਮਸ ਕੂਕਾ ਪਈਆ ਰਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: baar viddaanarrai hunmas dhunmas kookaa peea raahee |
English: In this wondrous forest of the world, there is chaos and confusion; shrieks emanate from the highways.

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਸਹ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਗੜੀ ਡੋਰੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਦ ਸੇਤੀ ਬਨੁ ਗਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tau seh setee lagarree ddoree naanak anad setee ban gaahee |1|
English: I am in love with You, O my Husband Lord; O Nanak, I cross the jungle joyfully. ||1||

[Ang 520 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਚੀ ਬੈਸਕ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਿਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sachee baisak tinaa sang jin sang japeeai naau |
English: The true society is the company of those who meditate on the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨੑ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਕੀਚਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tina sang sang na keechee naanak jinaa aapanaa suaau |2|
English: Do not associate with those, O Nanak, who look out only for their own interests. ||2||

[Ang 520 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਵੇਲਾ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: saa velaa paravaan jit satigur bhettiaa |
English: Approved is that time, when one meets the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਹੋਆ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖ ਨ ਤੇਟਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: hoaa saadhoo sang fir dookh na tettiaa |
English: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he does not suffer pain again.

Gurbani: ਪਾਇਆ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਗਰਭਿ ਨ ਲੇਟਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: paaeaa nihachal thaan fir garabh na lettiaa |
English: When he attains the eternal place, he does not have to enter the womb again.

Gurbani: ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ਇਕੁ ਸਗਲ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇਟਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: nadaree aaeaa ik sagal brahamettiaa |
English: He comes to see the One God everywhere.

Gurbani: ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਲਾਇ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਮੇਟਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: tat giaan laae dhiaan drisatt samettiaa |
English: He focuses his meditation on the essence of spiritual wisdom, and withdraws his attention from other sights.

Gurbani: ਸਭੋ ਜਪੀਐ ਜਾਪੁ ਜਿ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਬੋਲੇਟਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabho japeeai jaap ji mukhahu bolettiaa |
English: All chants are chanted by one who chants them with his mouth.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਬੁਝਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੇਟਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: hukame bujh nihaal sukh sukhettiaa |
English: Realizing the Hukam of the Lord's Command, he becomes happy, and he is filled with peace and tranquility.

Gurbani: ਪਰਖਿ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਪਾਏ ਸੇ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਖੋਟਿਆ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: parakh khajaanai paae se bahurr na khottiaa |10|
English: Those who are assayed, and placed in the Lord's treasury, are not declared counterfeit again. ||10||

[Ang 520 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਵਿਛੋਹੇ ਜੰਬੂਰ ਖਵੇ ਨ ਵੰਞਨਿ ਗਾਖੜੇ ॥
Transliteration: vichhohe janboor khave na vanyan gaakharre |
English: The pincers of separation are so painful to endure.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਸੋ ਧਣੀ ਮਿਲੰਨਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਬੂਹ ਸਚੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: je so dhanee milan naanak sukh sanbooh sach |1|
English: If only the Master would come to meet me! O Nanak, I would then obtain all the true comforts. ||1||

[Ang 521 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਮੀ ਵਸੰਦੀ ਪਾਣੀਐ ਈਧਣੁ ਰਖੈ ਭਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jimee vasandee paaneeai eedhan rakhai bhaeh |
English: The earth is in the water, and the fire is contained in the wood.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਆਹਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਆਢਲਿ ਹਭੁ ਕੋ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak so sahu aaeh jaa kai aadtal habh ko |2|
English: O Nanak, yearn for that Lord, who is the Support of all. ||2||

[Ang 521 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀਤੇ ਕੰਮ ਤੁਧੈ ਹੀ ਗੋਚਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: tere keete kam tudhai hee gochare |
English: The works which You have done, O Lord, could only have been performed by You.

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਵਰਤੈ ਜਗਿ ਜਿ ਕੀਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਧੁਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: soee varatai jag ji keea tudh dhure |
English: That alone happens in the world, which You, O Master, have done.

Gurbani: ਬਿਸਮੁ ਭਏ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਤੇਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: bisam bhe bisamaad dekh kudarat tereea |
English: I am wonderstruck beholding the wonder of Your Almighty Creative Power.

Gurbani: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਸ ਕਰਿ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਮੇਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: saran pare teree daas kar gat hoe mereea |
English: I seek Your Sanctuary - I am Your slave; if it is Your Will, I shall be emancipated.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੈ ਹਥਿ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: terai hath nidhaan bhaavai tis dehi |
English: The treasure is in Your Hands; according to Your Will, You bestow it.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੇਇ ਲੇਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jis no hoe deaal har naam see lehi |
English: One, upon whom You have bestowed Your Mercy, is blessed with the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: agam agochar beant ant na paaeeai |
English: You are unapproachable, unfathomable and infinite; Your limits cannot be found.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੋਹਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: jis no hohi kripaal su naam dhiaaeeai |11|
English: One, unto whom You have been compassionate, meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||11||

[Ang 521 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕੜਛੀਆ ਫਿਰੰਨਿੑ ਸੁਆਉ ਨ ਜਾਣਨਿੑ ਸੁਞੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: karrachheea firana suaau na jaanana suyeea |
English: The ladles cruise through the food, but they do not know the taste of it.

Gurbani: ਸੇਈ ਮੁਖ ਦਿਸੰਨਿੑ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਤੇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: seee mukh disana naanak rate prem ras |1|
English: I long to see the faces of those, O Nanak, who are imbued with the essence of the Lord's Love. ||1||

[Ang 521 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਖੋਜੀ ਲਧਮੁ ਖੋਜੁ ਛਡੀਆ ਉਜਾੜਿ ॥
Transliteration: khojee ladham khoj chhaddeea ujaarr |
English: Through the Tracker, I discovered the tracks of those who ruined my crops.

Gurbani: ਤੈ ਸਹਿ ਦਿਤੀ ਵਾੜਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਖੇਤੁ ਨ ਛਿਜਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tai seh ditee vaarr naanak khet na chhijee |2|
English: You, O Lord, have put up the fence; O Nanak, my fields shall not be plundered again. ||2||

[Ang 521 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਆਰਾਧਿਹੁ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: aaraadhihu sachaa soe sabh kichh jis paas |
English: Worship in adoration that True Lord; everything is under His Power.

Gurbani: ਦੁਹਾ ਸਿਰਿਆ ਖਸਮੁ ਆਪਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਰੇ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: duhaa siriaa khasam aap khin meh kare raas |
English: He Himself is the Master of both ends; in an instant, He adjusts our affairs.

Gurbani: ਤਿਆਗਹੁ ਸਗਲ ਉਪਾਵ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਗਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: tiaagahu sagal upaav tis kee ott gahu |
English: Renounce all your efforts, and hold fast to His Support.

Gurbani: ਪਉ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਭਜਿ ਸੁਖੀ ਹੂੰ ਸੁਖ ਲਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: pau saranaaee bhaj sukhee hoon sukh lahu |
English: Run to His Sanctuary, and you shall obtain the comfort of all comforts.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: karam dharam tat giaan santaa sang hoe |
English: The karma of good deeds, the righteousness of Dharma and the essence of spiritual wisdom are obtained in the Society of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਜਪੀਐ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: japeeai amrit naam bighan na lagai koe |
English: Chanting the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, no obstacle shall block your way.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jis no aap deaal tis man vutthiaa |
English: The Lord abides in the mind of one who is blessed by His Kindness.

Gurbani: ਪਾਈਅਨਿੑ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸਾਹਿਬਿ ਤੁਠਿਆ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: paaeeana sabh nidhaan saahib tutthiaa |12|
English: All treasures are obtained, when the Lord and Master is pleased. ||12||

[Ang 521 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਲਧਮੁ ਲਭਣਹਾਰੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਰੰਦੋ ਮਾ ਪਿਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: ladham labhanahaar karam karando maa piree |
English: I have found the object of my search - my Beloved took pity on me.

Gurbani: ਇਕੋ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਆ ਨ ਪਸੀਐ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: eiko sirajanahaar naanak biaa na paseeai |1|
English: There is One Creator; O Nanak, I do not see any other. ||1||

[Ang 521 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪਾਪੜਿਆ ਪਛਾੜਿ ਬਾਣੁ ਸਚਾਵਾ ਸੰਨਿੑ ਕੈ ॥
Transliteration: paaparriaa pachhaarr baan sachaavaa sana kai |
English: Take aim with the arrow of Truth, and shoot down sin.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੜਾ ਚਿਤਾਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਥੀਵਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur mantrarraa chitaar naanak dukh na theevee |2|
English: Cherish the Words of the Guru's Mantra, O Nanak, and you shall not suffer in pain. ||2||

[Ang 521 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰ ਪਾਈਅਨੁ ਠਾਢਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: vaahu vaahu sirajanahaar paaeean tthaadt aap |
English: Waaho! Waaho! The Creator Lord Himself has brought about peace and tranquility.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jant miharavaan tis no sadaa jaap |
English: He is Kind to all beings and creatures; meditate forever on Him.

Gurbani: ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰੀ ਸਮਰਥਿ ਚੁਕੇ ਬਿਲ ਬਿਲਾਪ ॥
Transliteration: deaa dhaaree samarath chuke bil bilaap |
English: The all-powerful Lord has shown Mercy, and my cries of suffering are ended.

Gurbani: ਨਠੇ ਤਾਪ ਦੁਖ ਰੋਗ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: natthe taap dukh rog poore gur prataap |
English: My fevers, pains and diseases are gone, by the Grace of the Perfect Guru.

Gurbani: ਕੀਤੀਅਨੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਰਖ ਗਰੀਬ ਨਿਵਾਜਿ ਥਾਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: keeteean aapanee rakh gareeb nivaaj thaap |
English: The Lord has established me, and protected me; He is the Cherisher of the poor.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਲਇਅਨੁ ਛਡਾਇ ਬੰਧਨ ਸਗਲ ਕਾਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: aape leian chhaddaae bandhan sagal kaap |
English: He Himself has delivered me, breaking all my bonds.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸਨ ਬੁਝੀ ਆਸ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਮਨ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਧ੍ਰਾਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: tisan bujhee aas punee man santokh dhraap |
English: My thirst is quenched, my hopes are fulfilled, and my mind is contented and satisfied.

Gurbani: ਵਡੀ ਹੂੰ ਵਡਾ ਅਪਾਰ ਖਸਮੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਲੇਪੁ ਨ ਪੁੰਨਿ ਪਾਪਿ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: vaddee hoon vaddaa apaar khasam jis lep na pun paap |13|
English: The greatest of the great, the Infinite Lord and Master - He is not affected by virtue and vice. ||13||

[Ang 521 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਈ ਜਪਾਤ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kau bhe kripaal prabh har har seee japaat |
English: They alone meditate on the Lord God, Har, Har, unto whom the Lord is Merciful.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਤਿਨ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਭੇਟਤ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਾਤ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak preet lagee tin raam siau bhettat saadh sangaat |1|
English: O Nanak, they enshrine love for the Lord, meeting the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||

[Ang 521 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਾਮੁ ਰਮਹੁ ਬਡਭਾਗੀਹੋ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: raam ramahu baddabhaageeho jal thal maheeal soe |
English: Contemplate the Lord, O very fortunate ones; He is pervading in the water, the land and the sky.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਅਰਾਧਿਐ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naam araadhiai bighan na laagai koe |2|
English: O Nanak, worshipping the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mortal encounters no misfortune. ||2||

[Ang 521 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਾ ਕਾ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਵੈ ਥਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhagataa kaa boliaa paravaan hai daragah pavai thaae |
English: The speech of the devotees is approved; it is accepted in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਰਤੇ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhagataa teree ttek rate sach naae |
English: Your devotees take to Your Support; they are imbued with the True Name.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jis no hoe kripaal tis kaa dookh jaae |
English: One unto whom You are Merciful, has his sufferings depart.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਇਆਲ ਓਨੑਾ ਮਿਹਰ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat tere deaal onaa mihar paae |
English: O Merciful Lord, You bless Your devotees with Your Grace.

Gurbani: ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਵਡ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਪੋਹੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: dookh darad vadd rog na pohe tis maae |
English: Suffering, pain, terrible disease and Maya do not afflict them.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਾ ਏਹੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhagataa ehu adhaar gun govind gaae |
English: This is the Support of the devotees, that they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਇਕੋ ਇਕੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa din rain iko ik dhiaae |
English: Forever and ever, day and night, they meditate on the One and Only Lord.

Gurbani: ਪੀਵਤਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਹੇ ਅਘਾਇ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: peevat amrit naam jan naame rahe aghaae |14|
English: Drinking in the Ambrosial Amrit of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, His humble servants remain satisfied with the Naam. ||14||

[Ang 522 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਬਿਘਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਾਗਤੇ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kott bighan tis laagate jis no visarai naau |
English: Millions of obstacles stand in the way of one who forgets the Name.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਬਿਲਪਤੇ ਜਿਉ ਸੁੰਞੈ ਘਰਿ ਕਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak anadin bilapate jiau sunyai ghar kaau |1|
English: O Nanak, night and day, he croaks like a raven in a deserted house. ||1||

[Ang 522 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪਿਰੀ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਜਾ ਥੀਐ ਸਾਈ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਰੁਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: piree milaavaa jaa theeai saaee suhaavee rut |
English: Beauteous is that season, when I am united with my Beloved.

Gurbani: ਘੜੀ ਮੁਹਤੁ ਨਹ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਵੀਐ ਨਿਤ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gharree muhat neh veesarai naanak raveeai nit |2|
English: I do not forget Him for a moment or an instant; O Nanak, I contemplate Him constantly. ||2||

[Ang 522 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸੂਰਬੀਰ ਵਰੀਆਮ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਹੋੜੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: soorabeer vareeaam kinai na horreeai |
English: Even brave and mighty men cannot withstand the powerful

Gurbani: ਫਉਜ ਸਤਾਣੀ ਹਾਠ ਪੰਚਾ ਜੋੜੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: fauj sataanee haatth panchaa jorreeai |
English: And overwhelming army which the five passions have gathered.

Gurbani: ਦਸ ਨਾਰੀ ਅਉਧੂਤ ਦੇਨਿ ਚਮੋੜੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: das naaree aaudhoot den chamorreeai |
English: The ten organs of sensation attach even detached renunciates to sensory pleasures.

Gurbani: ਜਿਣਿ ਜਿਣਿ ਲੈਨਿੑ ਰਲਾਇ ਏਹੋ ਏਨਾ ਲੋੜੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: jin jin laina ralaae eho enaa lorreeai |
English: They seek to conquer and overpower them, and so increase their following.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਇਨ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਮੋੜੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: trai gun in kai vas kinai na morreeai |
English: The world of the three dispositions is under their influence; no one can stand against them.

Gurbani: ਭਰਮੁ ਕੋਟੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਖਾਈ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਤੋੜੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: bharam kott maaeaa khaaee kahu kit bidh torreeai |
English: So tell me - how can the fort of doubt and the moat of Maya be overcome?

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਆਰਾਧਿ ਬਿਖਮ ਦਲੁ ਫੋੜੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: gur pooraa aaraadh bikham dal forreeai |
English: Worshipping the Perfect Guru, this awesome force is subdued.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਰਹਾ ਕਰ ਜੋੜੀਐ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: hau tis agai din raat rahaa kar jorreeai |15|
English: I stand before Him, day and night, with my palms pressed together. ||15||

[Ang 522 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਸਭੇ ਉਤਰਨਿ ਨੀਤ ਨੀਤ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kilavikh sabhe utaran neet neet gun gaau |
English: All sins are washed away, by continually singing the Lord's Glories.

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਕਲੇਸਾ ਊਪਜਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kott kalesaa aoopajeh naanak bisarai naau |1|
English: Millions of afflictions are produced, O Nanak, when the Name is forgotten. ||1||

[Ang 522 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਭੇਟਿਐ ਪੂਰੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੁਗਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: naanak satigur bhettiai pooree hovai jugat |
English: O Nanak, meeting the True Guru, one comes to know the Perfect Way.

Gurbani: ਹਸੰਦਿਆ ਖੇਲੰਦਿਆ ਪੈਨੰਦਿਆ ਖਾਵੰਦਿਆ ਵਿਚੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: hasandiaa khelandiaa painandiaa khaavandiaa viche hovai mukat |2|
English: While laughing, playing, dressing and eating, he is liberated. ||2||

[Ang 522 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਭਰਮ ਗੜੁ ਤੋੜਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: so satigur dhan dhan jin bharam garr torriaa |
English: Blessed, blessed is the True Guru, who has demolished the fortress of doubt.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜੋੜਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: so satigur vaahu vaahu jin har siau jorriaa |
English: Waaho! Waaho! - Hail! Hail! to the True Guru, who has united me with the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਇ ਦਾਰੂਓ ॥
Transliteration: naam nidhaan akhutt gur dee daarooo |
English: The Guru has given me the medicine of the inexhaustible treasure of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ਤਿਨੈ ਬਿਦਾਰੂਓ ॥
Transliteration: mahaa rog bikaraal tinai bidaarooo |
English: He has banished the great and terrible disease.

Gurbani: ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਖਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: paaeaa naam nidhaan bahut khajaaniaa |
English: I have obtained the great treasure of the wealth of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jitaa janam apaar aap pachhaaniaa |
English: I have obtained eternal life, recognizing my own self.

Gurbani: ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਗੁਰ ਸਮਰਥ ਦੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: mahimaa kahee na jaae gur samarath dev |
English: The Glory of the all-powerful Divine Guru cannot be described.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵ ॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: gur paarabraham paramesur aparanpar alakh abhev |16|
English: The Guru is the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, infinite, unseen and unknowable. ||16||

[Ang 522 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰੇਦਿਆ ਜੀਉ ਤੂੰ ਕਮਾਵਦਿਆ ਸੁਖ ਭੁੰਚੁ ॥
Transliteration: audam karediaa jeeo toon kamaavadiaa sukh bhunch |
English: Make the effort, and you shall live; practicing it, you shall enjoy peace.

Gurbani: ਧਿਆਇਦਿਆ ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮਿਲੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਉਤਰੀ ਚਿੰਤ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dhiaaeidiaa toon prabhoo mil naanak utaree chint |1|
English: Meditating, you shall meet God, O Nanak, and your anxiety shall vanish. ||1||

[Ang 522 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੁਭ ਚਿੰਤਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਰਮਣ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗ ॥
Transliteration: subh chintan gobind raman niramal saadhoo sang |
English: Bless me with sublime thoughts, O Lord of the Universe, and contemplation in the immaculate Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਰਉ ਇਕ ਘੜੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naam na visrau ik gharree kar kirapaa bhagavant |2|
English: O Nanak, may I never forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord, for even an instant; be merciful to me, Lord God. ||2||

[Ang 522 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਕਾਹੇ ਡਰਪੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: teraa keetaa hoe ta kaahe ddarapeeai |
English: Whatever happens is according to Your Will, so why should I be afraid?

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਨਾਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੀਉ ਅਰਪੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: jis mil japeeai naau tis jeeo arapeeai |
English: Meeting Him, I meditate on the Name - I offer my soul to Him.

Gurbani: ਆਇਐ ਚਿਤਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: aaeiai chit nihaal saahib besumaar |
English: When the Infinite Lord comes to mind, one is enraptured.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਪੋਹੇ ਕਵਣੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਲਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: tis no pohe kavan jis val nirankaar |
English: Who can touch one who has the Formless Lord on his side?

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਬਾਹਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh tis kai vas na koee baaharaa |
English: Everything is under His control; no one is beyond Him.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਭਗਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: so bhagataa man vutthaa sach samaaharaa |
English: He, the True Lord, dwells in the minds of His devotees.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਤੂੰ ਰਖਣ ਵਾਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: tere daas dhiaaein tudh toon rakhan vaaliaa |
English: Your slaves meditate on You; You are the Savior, the Protector Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਿਰਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਆ ॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: sir sabhanaa samarath nadar nihaaliaa |17|
English: You are the Almighty Overlord of all; You bless us with Your Glance of Grace. ||17||

[Ang 523 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮਦ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਦੁਸਟ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh mad lobh moh dusatt baasanaa nivaar |
English: Take away my sexual desire, anger, pride, greed, emotional attachment and evil desires.

Gurbani: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਣੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: raakh lehu prabh aapane naanak sad balihaar |1|
English: Protect me, O my God; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to You. ||1||

[Ang 523 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਖਾਂਦਿਆ ਖਾਂਦਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਘਠਾ ਪੈਨੰਦਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਅੰਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: khaandiaa khaandiaa muhu ghatthaa painandiaa sabh ang |
English: By eating and eating, the mouth is worn out; by wearing clothes, the limbs grow weary.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਦਾ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਸਚਿ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਰੰਗੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak dhrig tinaa daa jeeviaa jin sach na lago rang |2|
English: O Nanak, cursed are the lives of those who are not attuned to the Love of the True Lord. ||2||

[Ang 523 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਤਿਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਹੋਵਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: jiau jiau teraa hukam tivai tiau hovanaa |
English: As is the Hukam of Your Command, so do things happen.

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਰਖਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਤਹ ਜਾਇ ਖੜੋਵਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeh jeh rakheh aap teh jaae kharrovanaa |
English: Wherever You keep me, there I go and stand.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਤੇਰੈ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਧੋਵਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: naam terai kai rang duramat dhovanaa |
English: With the Love of Your Name, I wash away my evil-mindedness.

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਖੋਵਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: jap jap tudh nirankaar bharam bhau khovanaa |
English: By continually meditating on You, O Formless Lord, my doubts and fears are dispelled.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਜੋਵਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo terai rang rate se jon na jovanaa |
English: Those who are attuned to Your Love, shall not be trapped in reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਨੈਣ ਅਲੋਵਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: antar baahar ik nain alovanaa |
English: Inwardly and outwardly, they behold the One Lord with their eyes.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਰੋਵਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: jinaee pachhaataa hukam tina kade na rovanaa |
English: Those who recognize the Lord's Command never weep.

Gurbani: ਨਾਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸੀਸ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਪਰੋਵਣਾ ॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: naau naanak bakhasees man maeh parovanaa |18|
English: O Nanak, they are blessed with the gift of the Name, woven into the fabric of their minds. ||18||

[Ang 523 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਮੁਆ ਰਲੰਦੜੋ ਖਾਕ ॥
Transliteration: jeevadiaa na chetio muaa ralandarro khaak |
English: Those who do not remember the Lord while they are alive, shall mix with the dust when they die.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਗੁਦਾਰਿਆ ਸਾਕਤ ਮੂੜ ਨਪਾਕ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak duneea sang gudaariaa saakat moorr napaak |1|
English: O Nanak, the foolish and filthy faithless cynic passes his life engrossed in the world. ||1||

[Ang 523 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੀਵੰਦਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿਆ ਮਰੰਦਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: jeevandiaa har chetiaa marandiaa har rang |
English: One who remembers the Lord while he is alive, shall be imbued with the Lord's Love when he dies.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਤਾਰਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: janam padaarath taariaa naanak saadhoo sang |2|
English: The precious gift of his life is redeemed, O Nanak, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||

[Ang 523 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਆਪਿ ਰਖਣ ਵਾਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: aad jugaadee aap rakhan vaaliaa |
English: From the beginning, and through the ages, You have been our Protector and Preserver.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਪਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sach naam karataar sach pasaariaa |
English: True is Your Name, O Creator Lord, and True is Your Creation.

Gurbani: ਊਣਾ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਘਟੇ ਘਟਿ ਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: aoonaa kahee na hoe ghatte ghatt saariaa |
English: You do not lack anything; You are filling each and every heart.

Gurbani: ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਸਮਰਥ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਘਾਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: miharavaan samarath aape hee ghaaliaa |
English: You are merciful and all-powerful; You Yourself cause us to serve You.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਆਪਿ ਸੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਾਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jina man vutthaa aap se sadaa sukhaaliaa |
English: Those whose minds in which You dwell are forever at peace.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਇ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਪਾਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: aape rachan rachaae aape hee paaliaa |
English: Having created the creation, You Yourself cherish it.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਅਪਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh aape aap beant apaariaa |
English: You Yourself are everything, O infinite, endless Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਮੑਾਲਿਆ ॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: gur poore kee ttek naanak samaaliaa |19|
English: Nanak seeks the Protection and Support of the Perfect Guru. ||19||

[Ang 523 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਅਰੁ ਅੰਤਿ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਰਖਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: aad madh ar ant paramesar rakhiaa |
English: In the beginning, in the middle and in the end, the Transcendent Lord has saved me.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਚਖਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: satigur ditaa har naam amrit chakhiaa |
English: The True Guru has blessed me with the Lord's Name, and I have tasted the Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: saadhaa sang apaar anadin har gun ravai |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, night and day.

Gurbani: ਪਾਏ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਸਭਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਨਹ ਭਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: paae manorath sabh jonee neh bhavai |
English: I have obtained all my objectives, and I shall not wander in reincarnation again.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਹਥਿ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਜੋ ਕਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh karate hath kaaran jo karai |
English: Everything is in the Hands of the Creator; He does what is done.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਸੰਤਾ ਧੂਰਿ ਤਰੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak mangai daan santaa dhoor tarai |1|
English: Nanak begs for the gift of the dust of the feet of the Holy, which shall deliver him. ||1||

[Ang 523 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tis no man vasaae jin upaaeaa |
English: Enshrine Him in your mind, the One who created you.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਖਸਮੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jin jan dhiaaeaa khasam tin sukh paaeaa |
English: Whoever meditates on the Lord and Master obtains peace.

Gurbani: ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: safal janam paravaan guramukh aaeaa |
English: Fruitful is the birth, and approved is the coming of the Gurmukh.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਬੁਝਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਖਸਮਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: hukamai bujh nihaal khasam furamaaeaa |
English: One who realizes the Hukam of the Lord's Command shall be blessed - so has the Lord and Master ordained.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਆ ਆਪਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਸੁ ਨਹ ਭਰਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jis hoaa aap kripaal su neh bharamaaeaa |
English: One who is blessed with the Lord's Mercy does not wander.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਦਿਤਾ ਖਸਮਿ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jo jo ditaa khasam soee sukh paaeaa |
English: Whatever the Lord and Master gives him, with that he is content.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਿਤ ॥
Transliteration: naanak jiseh deaal bujhaae hukam mit |
English: O Nanak, one who is blessed with the kindness of the Lord, our Friend, realizes the Hukam of His Command.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਮਹਿ ਨਿਤ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jiseh bhulaae aap mar mar jameh nit |2|
English: But those whom the Lord Himself causes to wander, continue to die, and take reincarnation again. ||2||

[Ang 523 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਤਕਾਲਿ ਖਿਨੁ ਟਿਕਣ ਨ ਦਿਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: nindak maare tatakaal khin ttikan na dite |
English: The slanderers are destroyed in an instant; they are not spared for even a moment.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਸ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਖਵਿ ਸਕਹਿ ਫੜਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਜੁਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: prabh daas kaa dukh na khav sakeh farr jonee jute |
English: God will not endure the sufferings of His slaves, but catching the slanderers, He binds them to the cycle of reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਮਥੇ ਵਾਲਿ ਪਛਾੜਿਅਨੁ ਜਮ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਮੁਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: mathe vaal pachhaarrian jam maarag mute |
English: Grabbing them by the hair on their heads, the Lord throws them down, and leaves them on the path of Death.

Gurbani: ਦੁਖਿ ਲਗੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਣਿਆ ਨਰਕਿ ਘੋਰਿ ਸੁਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: dukh lagai bilalaaniaa narak ghor sute |
English: They cry out in pain, in the darkest of hells.

Gurbani: ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਦਾਸ ਰਖਿਅਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਤੇ ॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: kantth laae daas rakhian naanak har sate |20|
English: But hugging His slaves close to His Heart, O Nanak, the True Lord saves them. ||20||

[Ang 524 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਹੋ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: raam japahu vaddabhaageeho jal thal pooran soe |
English: Meditate on the Lord, O fortunate ones; He is pervading the waters and the earth.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਧਿਆਇਐ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak naam dhiaaeiai bighan na laagai koe |1|
English: O Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and no misfortune shall strike you. ||1||

[Ang 524 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਬਿਘਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਾਗਤੇ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kott bighan tis laagate jis no visarai naau |
English: Millions of misfortunes block the way of one who forgets the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਬਿਲਪਤੇ ਜਿਉ ਸੁੰਞੈ ਘਰਿ ਕਾਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak anadin bilapate jiau sunyai ghar kaau |2|
English: O Nanak, like a crow in a deserted house, he cries out, night and day. ||2||

[Ang 524 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: simar simar daataar manorath pooriaa |
English: Meditating, meditating in remembrance of the Great Giver, one's heart's desires are fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਮਨਿ ਆਸ ਗਏ ਵਿਸੂਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: eichh punee man aas ge visooriaa |
English: The hopes and desires of the mind are realized, and sorrows are forgotten.

Gurbani: ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਭਾਲਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: paaeaa naam nidhaan jis no bhaaladaa |
English: The treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is obtained; I have searched for it for so long.

Gurbani: ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਘਾਲਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: jot milee sang jot rahiaa ghaaladaa |
English: My light is merged into the Light, and my labors are over.

Gurbani: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਵੁਠੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: sookh sehaj aanand vutthe tith ghar |
English: I abide in that house of peace, poise and bliss.

Gurbani: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣ ਰਹੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਤਹਾ ਮਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: aavan jaan rahe janam na tahaa mar |
English: My comings and goings have ended - there is no birth or death there.

Gurbani: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਇਕੁ ਇਕੁ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: saahib sevak ik ik drisattaaeaa |
English: The Master and the servant have become one, with no sense of separation.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੨੧॥੧॥੨॥ ਸੁਧੁ
Transliteration: gur prasaad naanak sach samaaeaa |21|1|2| sudh
English: By Guru's Grace, Nanak is absorbed in the True Lord. ||21||1||2||Sudh||

[Ang 524 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੂਜਰੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: raag goojaree bhagataa kee baanee |
English: Raag Goojaree, The Words Of The Devotees:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕਾ ਚਉਪਦਾ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: sree kabeer jeeo kaa chaupadaa ghar 2 doojaa |
English: Chau-Padhay Of Kabeer Jee, Second House:

Gurbani: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਾਵ ਦੁਇ ਸਿੰਗ ਗੁੰਗ ਮੁਖ ਤਬ ਕੈਸੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਈਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: chaar paav due sing gung mukh tab kaise gun geehai |
English: With four feet, two horns and a mute mouth, how could you sing the Praises of the Lord?

Gurbani: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਠੇਗਾ ਪਰਿਹੈ ਤਬ ਕਤ ਮੂਡ ਲੁਕਈਹੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aootthat baitthat tthegaa parihai tab kat moodd lukeehai |1|
English: Standing up and sitting down, the stick shall still fall on you, so where will you hide your head? ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੈਲ ਬਿਰਾਨੇ ਹੁਈਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: har bin bail biraane hueehai |
English: Without the Lord, you are like a stray ox;

Gurbani: ਫਾਟੇ ਨਾਕਨ ਟੂਟੇ ਕਾਧਨ ਕੋਦਉ ਕੋ ਭੁਸੁ ਖਈਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: faatte naakan ttootte kaadhan kodau ko bhus kheehai |1| rahaau |
English: with your nose torn, and your shoulders injured, you shall have only the straw of coarse grain to eat. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਰੋ ਦਿਨੁ ਡੋਲਤ ਬਨ ਮਹੀਆ ਅਜਹੁ ਨ ਪੇਟ ਅਘਈਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: saaro din ddolat ban maheea ajahu na pett agheehai |
English: All day long, you shall wander in the forest, and even then, your belly will not be full.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੋ ਕਹੋ ਨ ਮਾਨੋ ਕੀਓ ਅਪਨੋ ਪਈਹੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jan bhagatan ko kaho na maano keeo apano peehai |2|
English: You did not follow the advice of the humble devotees, and so you shall obtain the fruits of your actions. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਕਰਤ ਮਹਾ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਬੂਡੋ ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਭਰਮਈਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: dukh sukh karat mahaa bhram booddo anik jon bharameehai |
English: Enduring pleasure and pain, drowned in the great ocean of doubt, you shall wander in numerous reincarnations.

Gurbani: ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਖੋਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਿਸਰਿਓ ਇਹੁ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਕਤ ਪਈਹੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ratan janam khoeo prabh bisario ihu aausar kat peehai |3|
English: You have lost the jewel of human birth by forgetting God; when will you have such an opportunity again? ||3||

Gurbani: ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਤੇਲਕ ਕੇ ਕਪਿ ਜਿਉ ਗਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਬਿਹਈਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: bhramat firat telak ke kap jiau gat bin rain biheehai |
English: You turn on the wheel of reincarnation, like an ox at the oil-press; the night of your life passes away without salvation.

Gurbani: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੂੰਡ ਧੁਨੇ ਪਛੁਤਈਹੈ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: kehat kabeer raam naam bin moondd dhune pachhuteehai |4|1|
English: Says Kabeer, without the Name of the Lord, you shall pound your head, and regret and repent. ||4||1||

[Ang 524 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree ghar 3 |
English: Goojaree, Third House:

Gurbani: ਮੁਸਿ ਮੁਸਿ ਰੋਵੈ ਕਬੀਰ ਕੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: mus mus rovai kabeer kee maaee |
English: Kabeer's mother sobs, cries and bewails

Gurbani: ਏ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਕੈਸੇ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਰਘੁਰਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: e baarik kaise jeeveh raghuraaee |1|
English: - O Lord, how will my grandchildren live? ||1||

Gurbani: ਤਨਨਾ ਬੁਨਨਾ ਸਭੁ ਤਜਿਓ ਹੈ ਕਬੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: tananaa bunanaa sabh tajio hai kabeer |
English: Kabeer has given up all his spinning and weaving,

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਿਖਿ ਲੀਓ ਸਰੀਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam likh leeo sareer |1| rahaau |
English: and written the Name of the Lord on his body. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਤਾਗਾ ਬਾਹਉ ਬੇਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jab lag taagaa baahau behee |
English: As long as I pass the thread through the bobbin,

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਨੇਹੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tab lag bisarai raam sanehee |2|
English: I forget the Lord, my Beloved. ||2||

Gurbani: ਓਛੀ ਮਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਜੁਲਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: ochhee mat meree jaat julaahaa |
English: My intellect is lowly - I am a weaver by birth,

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਹਿਓ ਮੈ ਲਾਹਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam lahio mai laahaa |3|
English: but I have earned the profit of the Name of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kehat kabeer sunahu meree maaee |
English: Says Kabeer, listen, O my mother

Gurbani: ਹਮਰਾ ਇਨ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਰਘੁਰਾਈ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: hamaraa in kaa daataa ek raghuraaee |4|2|
English: - the Lord alone is the Provider, for me and my children. ||4||2||

[Ang 525 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Bhagat Namdev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਜੀ ਕੇ ਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree sree naamadev jee ke pade ghar 1 |
English: Goojaree, Padhay Of Naam Dayv Jee, First House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਜੌ ਰਾਜੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਤ ਕਵਨ ਬਡਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jau raaj dehi ta kavan baddaaee |
English: If You gave me an empire, then what glory would be in it for me?

Gurbani: ਜੌ ਭੀਖ ਮੰਗਾਵਹਿ ਤ ਕਿਆ ਘਟਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jau bheekh mangaaveh ta kiaa ghatt jaaee |1|
English: If You made me beg for charity, what would it take away from me? ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: toon har bhaj man mere pad nirabaan |
English: Meditate and vibrate upon the Lord, O my mind, and you shall obtain the state of Nirvaanaa.

Gurbani: ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਵਨ ਜਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bahur na hoe teraa aavan jaan |1| rahaau |
English: You shall not have to come and go in reincarnation any longer. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਤੈ ਉਪਾਈ ਭਰਮ ਭੁਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sabh tai upaaee bharam bhulaaee |
English: You created all, and You lead them astray in doubt.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jis toon deveh tiseh bujhaaee |2|
English: They alone understand, unto whom You give understanding. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਸਹਸਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur milai ta sahasaa jaaee |
English: Meeting the True Guru, doubt is dispelled.

Gurbani: ਕਿਸੁ ਹਉ ਪੂਜਉ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kis hau poojau doojaa nadar na aaee |3|
English: Who else should I worship? I can see no other. ||3||

Gurbani: ਏਕੈ ਪਾਥਰ ਕੀਜੈ ਭਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ekai paathar keejai bhaau |
English: One stone is lovingly decorated,

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਪਾਥਰ ਧਰੀਐ ਪਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: doojai paathar dhareeai paau |
English: while another stone is walked upon.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਓਹੁ ਦੇਉ ਤ ਓਹੁ ਭੀ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: je ohu deo ta ohu bhee devaa |
English: If one is a god, then the other must also be a god.

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: keh naamadeo ham har kee sevaa |4|1|
English: Says Naam Dayv, I serve the Lord. ||4||1||

[Ang 525 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Bhagat Namdev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree ghar 1 |
English: Goojaree, First House:

Gurbani: ਮਲੈ ਨ ਲਾਛੈ ਪਾਰ ਮਲੋ ਪਰਮਲੀਓ ਬੈਠੋ ਰੀ ਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: malai na laachhai paar malo paramaleeo baittho ree aaee |
English: He does not have even a trace of impurity - He is beyond impurity. He is fragrantly scented - He has come to take His Seat in my mind.

Gurbani: ਆਵਤ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਕਵਨੈ ਜਾਣੈ ਰੀ ਬਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aavat kinai na pekhio kavanai jaanai ree baaee |1|
English: No one saw Him come - who can know Him, O Siblings of Destiny? ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਉਣੁ ਕਹੈ ਕਿਣਿ ਬੂਝੀਐ ਰਮਈਆ ਆਕੁਲੁ ਰੀ ਬਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kaun kahai kin boojheeai rameea aakul ree baaee |1| rahaau |
English: Who can describe Him? Who can understand Him? The all-pervading Lord has no ancestors, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਆਕਾਸੈ ਪੰਖੀਅਲੋ ਖੋਜੁ ਨਿਰਖਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jiau aakaasai pankheealo khoj nirakhio na jaaee |
English: As the path of a bird's flight across the sky cannot be seen,

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਮਾਝੈ ਮਾਛਲੋ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪੇਖਣੋ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jiau jal maajhai maachhalo maarag pekhano na jaaee |2|
English: and the path of a fish through the water cannot be seen;||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਆਕਾਸੈ ਘੜੂਅਲੋ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jiau aakaasai gharrooalo mrig trisanaa bhariaa |
English: As the mirage leads one to mistake the sky for a pitcher filled with water

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੇ ਚੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਬੀਠਲੋ ਜਿਨਿ ਤੀਨੈ ਜਰਿਆ ॥੩॥੨॥
Transliteration: naame che suaamee beetthalo jin teenai jariaa |3|2|
English: - so is God, the Lord and Master of Naam Dayv, who fits these three comparisons. ||3||2||

[Ang 525 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Bhagat Ravidas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਕੇ ਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree sree ravidaas jee ke pade ghar 3 |
English: Goojaree, Padhay Of Ravi Daas Jee, Third House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਦੂਧੁ ਤ ਬਛਰੈ ਥਨਹੁ ਬਿਟਾਰਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: doodh ta bachharai thanahu bittaario |
English: The calf has contaminated the milk in the teats.

Gurbani: ਫੂਲੁ ਭਵਰਿ ਜਲੁ ਮੀਨਿ ਬਿਗਾਰਿਓ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: fool bhavar jal meen bigaario |1|
English: The bumble bee has contaminated the flower, and the fish the water. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਾਈ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਪੂਜਾ ਕਹਾ ਲੈ ਚਰਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: maaee gobind poojaa kahaa lai charaavau |
English: O mother, where shall I find any offering for the Lord's worship?

Gurbani: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਫੂਲੁ ਅਨੂਪੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: avar na fool anoop na paavau |1| rahaau |
English: I cannot find any other flowers worthy of the incomparable Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੈਲਾਗਰ ਬੇਰ੍ਹੇ ਹੈ ਭੁਇਅੰਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: mailaagar berhe hai bhueiangaa |
English: The snakes encircle the sandalwood trees.

Gurbani: ਬਿਖੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬਸਹਿ ਇਕ ਸੰਗਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bikh amrit baseh ik sangaa |2|
English: Poison and nectar dwell there together. ||2||

Gurbani: ਧੂਪ ਦੀਪ ਨਈਬੇਦਹਿ ਬਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: dhoop deep neebedeh baasaa |
English: Even with incense, lamps, offerings of food and fragrant flowers,

Gurbani: ਕੈਸੇ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kaise pooj kareh teree daasaa |3|
English: how are Your slaves to worship You? ||3||

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪਉ ਪੂਜ ਚਰਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: tan man arpau pooj charaavau |
English: I dedicate and offer my body and mind to You.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: gur parasaad niranjan paavau |4|
English: By Guru's Grace, I attain the immaculate Lord. ||4||

Gurbani: ਪੂਜਾ ਅਰਚਾ ਆਹਿ ਨ ਤੋਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: poojaa arachaa aaeh na toree |
English: I cannot worship You, nor offer You flowers.

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਕਵਨ ਗਤਿ ਮੋਰੀ ॥੫॥੧॥
Transliteration: keh ravidaas kavan gat moree |5|1|
English: Says Ravi Daas, what shall my condition be hereafter? ||5||1||

[Ang 525 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Bhagat Trilochan Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ ਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree sree trilochan jeeo ke pade ghar 1 |
English: Goojaree, Padhay Of Trilochan Jee, First House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰੁ ਮਲਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੀਨਾ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭੇਖ ਉਦਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: antar mal niramal nahee keenaa baahar bhekh udaasee |
English: You have not cleansed the filth from within yourself, although outwardly, you wear the dress of a renunciate.

Gurbani: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਮਲੁ ਘਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੑਾ ਕਾਹੇ ਭਇਆ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: hiradai kamal ghatt braham na cheenaa kaahe bheaa saniaasee |1|
English: In the heart-lotus of your self, you have not recognized God - why have you become a Sannyaasee? ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲੀ ਰੇ ਜੈ ਚੰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: bharame bhoolee re jai chandaa |
English: Deluded by doubt, O Jai Chand,

Gurbani: ਨਹੀ ਨਹੀ ਚੀਨਿੑਆ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: nahee nahee cheenaa paramaanandaa |1| rahaau |
English: you have not realized the Lord, the embodiment of supreme bliss. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਖਾਇਆ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਬਧਾਇਆ ਖਿੰਥਾ ਮੁੰਦਾ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: ghar ghar khaaeaa pindd badhaaeaa khinthaa mundaa maaeaa |
English: You eat in each and every house, fattening your body; you wear the patched coat and the ear-rings of the beggar, for the sake of wealth.

Gurbani: ਭੂਮਿ ਮਸਾਣ ਕੀ ਭਸਮ ਲਗਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bhoom masaan kee bhasam lagaaee gur bin tat na paaeaa |2|
English: You apply the ashes of cremation to your body, but without a Guru, you have not found the essence of reality. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਾਇ ਜਪਹੁ ਰੇ ਕਾਇ ਤਪਹੁ ਰੇ ਕਾਇ ਬਿਲੋਵਹੁ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: kaae japahu re kaae tapahu re kaae bilovahu paanee |
English: Why bother to chant your spells? Why bother to practice austerities? Why bother to churn water?

Gurbani: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜਿਨਿੑ ਉਪਾਈ ਸੋ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh jina upaaee so simarahu nirabaanee |3|
English: Meditate on the Lord of Nirvaanaa, who has created the 8.4 million species of beings. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਾਇ ਕਮੰਡਲੁ ਕਾਪੜੀਆ ਰੇ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਕਾਇ ਫਿਰਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: kaae kamanddal kaaparreea re atthasatth kaae firaahee |
English: Why bother to carry the water-pot, O saffron-robed Yogi? Why bother to visit the sixty-eight holy places of pilgrimage?

Gurbani: ਬਦਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨੁ ਸੁਨੁ ਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਕਣ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਾਹੁ ਕਿ ਪਾਹੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: badat trilochan sun re praanee kan bin gaahu ki paahee |4|1|
English: Says Trilochan, listen, mortal: you have no corn - what are you trying to thresh? ||4||1||

[Ang 526 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Bhagat Trilochan Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree |
English: Goojaree:

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਜੋ ਲਛਮੀ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਐਸੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: ant kaal jo lachhamee simarai aisee chintaa meh je marai |
English: At the very last moment, one who thinks of wealth, and dies in such thoughts,

Gurbani: ਸਰਪ ਜੋਨਿ ਵਲਿ ਵਲਿ ਅਉਤਰੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sarap jon val val aautarai |1|
English: shall be reincarnated over and over again, in the form of serpents. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਰੀ ਬਾਈ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਤਿ ਬੀਸਰੈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aree baaee gobid naam mat beesarai | rahaau |
English: O sister, do not forget the Name of the Lord of the Universe. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਜੋ ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਐਸੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: ant kaal jo isatree simarai aisee chintaa meh je marai |
English: At the very last moment, he who thinks of women, and dies in such thoughts,

Gurbani: ਬੇਸਵਾ ਜੋਨਿ ਵਲਿ ਵਲਿ ਅਉਤਰੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: besavaa jon val val aautarai |2|
English: shall be reincarnated over and over again as a prostitute. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਜੋ ਲੜਿਕੇ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਐਸੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: ant kaal jo larrike simarai aisee chintaa meh je marai |
English: At the very last moment, one who thinks of his children, and dies in such thoughts,

Gurbani: ਸੂਕਰ ਜੋਨਿ ਵਲਿ ਵਲਿ ਅਉਤਰੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sookar jon val val aautarai |3|
English: shall be reincarnated over and over again as a pig. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਜੋ ਮੰਦਰ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਐਸੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: ant kaal jo mandar simarai aisee chintaa meh je marai |
English: At the very last moment, one who thinks of mansions, and dies in such thoughts,

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਜੋਨਿ ਵਲਿ ਵਲਿ ਅਉਤਰੈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: pret jon val val aautarai |4|
English: shall be reincarnated over and over again as a goblin. ||4||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਐਸੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: ant kaal naaraaein simarai aisee chintaa meh je marai |
English: At the very last moment, one who thinks of the Lord, and dies in such thoughts,

Gurbani: ਬਦਤਿ ਤਿਲੋਚਨੁ ਤੇ ਨਰ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਪੀਤੰਬਰੁ ਵਾ ਕੇ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸੈ ॥੫॥੨॥
Transliteration: badat tilochan te nar mukataa peetanbar vaa ke ridai basai |5|2|
English: says Trilochan, that man shall be liberated; the Lord shall abide in his heart. ||5||2||

[Ang 526 | Raag: Raag Gujri | Author: Bhagat Jaidev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਜੈਦੇਵ ਜੀਉ ਕਾ ਪਦਾ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: goojaree sree jaidev jeeo kaa padaa ghar 4 |
English: Goojaree, Padhay Of Jai Dayv Jee, Fourth House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਪਰਮਾਦਿ ਪੁਰਖਮਨੋਪਿਮੰ ਸਤਿ ਆਦਿ ਭਾਵ ਰਤੰ ॥
Transliteration: paramaad purakhamanopiman sat aad bhaav ratan |
English: In the very beginning, was the Primal Lord, unrivalled, the Lover of Truth and other virtues.

Gurbani: ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤੰ ਪਰਕ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪਰੰ ਜਦਿਚਿੰਤਿ ਸਰਬ ਗਤੰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: paramadabhutan parakrit paran jadichint sarab gatan |1|
English: He is absolutely wonderful, transcending creation; remembering Him, all are emancipated. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕੇਵਲ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਮਨੋਰਮੰ ॥
Transliteration: keval raam naam manoraman |
English: Dwell only upon the beauteous Name of the Lord,

Gurbani: ਬਦਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਤਤ ਮਇਅੰ ॥
Transliteration: bad amrit tat meian |
English: the embodiment of ambrosial nectar and reality.

Gurbani: ਨ ਦਨੋਤਿ ਜਸਮਰਣੇਨ ਜਨਮ ਜਰਾਧਿ ਮਰਣ ਭਇਅੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: n danot jasamaranen janam jaraadh maran bheian |1| rahaau |
English: Remembering Him in meditation, the fear of birth, old age and death will not trouble you. ||1||Pause||
