Gurbani: ਇਛਸਿ ਜਮਾਦਿ ਪਰਾਭਯੰ ਜਸੁ ਸ੍ਵਸਤਿ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਤੰ ॥
Transliteration: eichhas jamaad paraabhayan jas svasat sukrit kritan |
English: If you desire to escape the fear of the Messenger of Death, then praise the Lord joyfully, and do good deeds.

Gurbani: ਭਵ ਭੂਤ ਭਾਵ ਸਮਬੵਿਅੰ ਪਰਮੰ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨਮਿਦੰ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bhav bhoot bhaav samabayian paraman prasanamidan |2|
English: In the past, present and future, He is always the same; He is the embodiment of supreme bliss. ||2||

Gurbani: ਲੋਭਾਦਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਪਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੰ ਜਦਿਬਿਧਿ ਆਚਰਣੰ ॥
Transliteration: lobhaad drisatt par grihan jadibidh aacharanan |
English: If you seek the path of good conduct, forsake greed, and do not look upon other men's property and women.

Gurbani: ਤਜਿ ਸਕਲ ਦੁਹਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਦੁਰਮਤੀ ਭਜੁ ਚਕ੍ਰਧਰ ਸਰਣੰ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: taj sakal duhakrit duramatee bhaj chakradhar saranan |3|
English: Renounce all evil actions and evil inclinations, and hurry to the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਨਿਜ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲਾ ਰਿਦ ਕਰਮਣਾ ਬਚਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: har bhagat nij nihakevalaa rid karamanaa bachasaa |
English: Worship the immaculate Lord, in thought, word and deed.

Gurbani: ਜੋਗੇਨ ਕਿੰ ਜਗੇਨ ਕਿੰ ਦਾਨੇਨ ਕਿੰ ਤਪਸਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jogen kin jagen kin daanen kin tapasaa |4|
English: What is the good of practicing Yoga, giving feasts and charity, and practicing penance? ||4||

Gurbani: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੇਤਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਰ ਸਕਲ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਦੰ ॥
Transliteration: gobind gobindet jap nar sakal sidh padan |
English: Meditate on the Lord of the Universe, the Lord of the Universe, O man; He is the source of all the spiritual powers of the Siddhas.

Gurbani: ਜੈਦੇਵ ਆਇਉ ਤਸ ਸਫੁਟੰ ਭਵ ਭੂਤ ਸਰਬ ਗਤੰ ॥੫॥੧॥
Transliteration: jaidev aaeiau tas safuttan bhav bhoot sarab gatan |5|1|
English: Jai Dayv has openly come to Him; He is the salvation of all, in the past, present and future. ||5||1||

[Ang 527 | Raag: Raag Dayv Gandhaaree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirbhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibhan gur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raag devagandhaaree mahalaa 4 ghar 1 |
English: Raag Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fourth Mehl, First House:

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਕ ਜਨ ਬਨੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: sevak jan bane tthaakur liv laage |
English: Those who become the humble servants of the Lord and Master, lovingly focus their minds on Him.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਜਸੁ ਕਹਤੇ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਮੁਖ ਭਾਗ ਸਭਾਗੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo tumaraa jas kahate guramat tin mukh bhaag sabhaage |1| rahaau |
English: Those who chant Your Praises, through the Guru's Teachings, have great good fortune recorded upon their foreheads. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਟੂਟੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਫਾਹੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: ttootte maaeaa ke bandhan faahe har raam naam liv laage |
English: The bonds and shackles of Maya are shattered, by lovingly focusing their minds on the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਮਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਮੋਹਨਿ ਹਮ ਬਿਸਮ ਭਈ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: hamaraa man mohio gur mohan ham bisam bhee mukh laage |1|
English: My mind is enticed by the Guru, the Enticer; beholding Him, I am wonder-struck. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਗਲੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਸੋਈ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਕਿੰਚਤ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: sagalee rain soee andhiaaree gur kinchat kirapaa jaage |
English: I slept through the entire dark night of my life, but through the tiniest bit of the Guru's Grace, I have been awakened.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਸਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੨॥੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak ke prabh sundar suaamee mohi tum sar avar na laage |2|1|
English: O Beautiful Lord God, Master of servant Nanak, there is none comparable to You. ||2||1||

[Ang 527 | Raag: Raag Dayv Gandhaaree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: devagandhaaree |
English: Dayv-Gandhaaree:

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੋ ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਕਿਤੁ ਗਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: mero sundar kahahu milai kit galee |
English: Tell me - on what path will I find my Beauteous Lord?

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਬਤਾਵਹੁ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਹਮ ਪੀਛੈ ਲਾਗਿ ਚਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har ke sant bataavahu maarag ham peechhai laag chalee |1| rahaau |
English: O Saints of the Lord, show me the Way, and I shall follow. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਕੇ ਬਚਨ ਸੁਖਾਨੇ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਇਹ ਚਾਲ ਬਨੀ ਹੈ ਭਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: pria ke bachan sukhaane heearai ih chaal banee hai bhalee |
English: I cherish in my heart the Words of my Beloved; this is the best way.

Gurbani: ਲਟੁਰੀ ਮਧੁਰੀ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਾਈ ਓਹ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਢੁਲਿ ਮਿਲੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: latturee madhuree tthaakur bhaaee oeh sundar har dtul milee |1|
English: The bride may be hunch-backed and short, but if she is loved by her Lord Master, she becomes beautiful, and she melts in the Lord's embrace. ||1||

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਸਖੀਆ ਸਭ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਕੀ ਜੋ ਭਾਵੈ ਪਿਰ ਸਾ ਭਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: eko priau sakheea sabh pria kee jo bhaavai pir saa bhalee |
English: There is only the One Beloved - we are all soul-brides of our Husband Lord. She who is pleasing to her Husband Lord is good.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗਰੀਬੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਰਾਹਿ ਚਲੀ ॥੨॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak gareeb kiaa karai bichaaraa har bhaavai tith raeh chalee |2|2|
English: What can poor, helpless Nanak do? As it pleases the Lord, so does he walk. ||2||2||

[Ang 527 | Raag: Raag Dayv Gandhaaree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: devagandhaaree |
English: Dayv-Gandhaaree:

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: mere man mukh har har har boleeai |
English: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੈ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭੀਨੀ ਚੋਲੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh rang chaloolai raatee har prem bheenee choleeai |1| rahaau |
English: The Gurmukh is imbued with the deep red color of the poppy. His shawl is saturated with the Lord's Love. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਫਿਰਉ ਦਿਵਾਨੀ ਆਵਲ ਬਾਵਲ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਢੋਲੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: hau firau divaanee aaval baaval tis kaaran har dtoleeai |
English: I wander around here and there, like a madman, bewildered, seeking out my Darling Lord.

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਮੇਲੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਹਮ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਗੁਲ ਗੋਲੀਐ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: koee melai meraa preetam piaaraa ham tis kee gul goleeai |1|
English: I shall be the slave of the slave of whoever unites me with my Darling Beloved. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਨਾਵਹੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀ ਝੋਲੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: satigur purakh manaavahu apunaa har amrit pee jholeeai |
English: So align yourself with the Almighty True Guru; drink in and savor the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਧਾ ਦੇਹ ਟੋਲੀਐ ॥੨॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad jan naanak paaeaa har laadhaa deh ttoleeai |2|3|
English: By Guru's Grace, servant Nanak has obtained the wealth of the Lord within. ||2||3||

[Ang 527 | Raag: Raag Dayv Gandhaaree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: devagandhaaree |
English: Dayv-Gandhaaree:

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਹਮ ਚਲੀ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: ab ham chalee tthaakur peh haar |
English: Now, I have come, exhausted, to my Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਹਮ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕੀ ਆਈ ਰਾਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਭਾਵੈ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jab ham saran prabhoo kee aaee raakh prabhoo bhaavai maar |1| rahaau |
English: Now that I have come seeking Your Sanctuary, God, please, either save me, or kill me. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਲੋਕਨ ਕੀ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਉਪਮਾ ਤੇ ਬੈਸੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: lokan kee chaturaaee upamaa te baisantar jaar |
English: I have burnt in the fire the clever devices and praises of the world.

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਭਲਾ ਕਹਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਬੁਰਾ ਕਹਉ ਹਮ ਤਨੁ ਦੀਓ ਹੈ ਢਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: koee bhalaa khau bhaavai buraa khau ham tan deeo hai dtaar |1|
English: Some speak good of me, and some speak ill of me, but I have surrendered my body to You. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਆਵਤ ਸਰਣਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jo aavat saran tthaakur prabh tumaree tis raakhahu kirapaa dhaar |
English: Whoever comes to Your Sanctuary, O God, Lord and Master, You save by Your Merciful Grace.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਲਾਜ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੪॥
Transliteration: jan naanak saran tumaaree har jeeo raakhahu laaj muraar |2|4|
English: Servant Nanak has entered Your Sanctuary, Dear Lord; O Lord, please, protect his honor! ||2||4||

[Ang 528 | Raag: Raag Dayv Gandhaaree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: devagandhaaree |
English: Dayv-Gandhaaree:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: har gun gaavai hau tis balihaaree |
English: I am a sacrifice to one who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਦੇਖਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਸਾਧ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dekh dekh jeevaa saadh gur darasan jis hiradai naam muraaree |1| rahaau |
English: I live by continuously beholding the Blessed Vision of the Holy Guru's Darshan; within His Mind is the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਾਵਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਲਹ ਜੂਠਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: tum pavitr paavan purakh prabh suaamee ham kiau kar milah jootthaaree |
English: You are pure and immaculate, O God, Almighty Lord and Master; how can I, the impure one, meet You?

Gurbani: ਹਮਰੈ ਜੀਇ ਹੋਰੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਰੁ ਹੋਤ ਹੈ ਹਮ ਕਰਮਹੀਣ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: hamarai jee hor mukh hor hot hai ham karamaheen koorriaaree |1|
English: I have one thing in my mind, and another thing on my lips; I am such a poor, unfortunate liar! ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਮਰੀ ਮੁਦ੍ਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਦੁਸਟ ਦੁਸਟਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: hamaree mudr naam har suaamee rid antar dusatt dusattaaree |
English: I appear to chant the Lord's Name, but within my heart, I am the most wicked of the wicked.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥੨॥੫॥
Transliteration: jiau bhaavai tiau raakhahu suaamee jan naanak saran tumaaree |2|5|
English: As it pleases You, save me, O Lord and Master; servant Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary. ||2||5||

[Ang 528 | Raag: Raag Dayv Gandhaaree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: devagandhaaree |
English: Dayv-Gandhaaree:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਹੈ ਨਕਟੀ ॥
Transliteration: har ke naam binaa sundar hai nakattee |
English: Without the Name of the Lord, the beautiful are just like the noseless ones.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਬੇਸੁਆ ਕੇ ਘਰਿ ਪੂਤੁ ਜਮਤੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਿਓ ਹੈ ਧ੍ਰਕਟੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jiau besuaa ke ghar poot jamat hai tis naam pario hai dhrakattee |1| rahaau |
English: Like the son, born into the house of a prostitute, his name is cursed. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੇ ਬਿਗੜ ਰੂਪ ਬੇਰਕਟੀ ॥
Transliteration: jin kai hiradai naeh har suaamee te bigarr roop berakattee |
English: Those who do not have the Name of their Lord and Master within their hearts, are the most wretched, deformed lepers.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਨਿਗੁਰਾ ਬਹੁ ਬਾਤਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਓਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਹੈ ਭ੍ਰਸਟੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jiau niguraa bahu baataa jaanai ohu har daragah hai bhrasattee |1|
English: Like the person who has no Guru, they may know many things, but they are cursed in the Court of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਨਾ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਪਗ ਚਕਟੀ ॥
Transliteration: jin kau deaal hoaa meraa suaamee tinaa saadh janaa pag chakattee |
English: Those, unto whom my Lord Master becomes Merciful, long for the feet of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵਿਤ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਛੈ ਛੁਕਟੀ ॥੨॥੬॥ ਛਕਾ ੧
Transliteration: naanak patit pavit mil sangat gur satigur paachhai chhukattee |2|6| chhakaa 1
English: O Nanak, the sinners become pure, joining the Company of the Holy; following the Guru, the True Guru, they are emancipated. ||2||6|| First Set of Six||

[Ang 528 | Raag: Raag Dayv Gandhaaree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: devagandhaaree mahalaa 5 ghar 2 |
English: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl, Second House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਮਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: maaee gur charanee chit laaeeai |
English: O mother, I focus my consciousness on the Guru's feet.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਕਮਲੁ ਪਰਗਾਸੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: prabh hoe kripaal kamal paragaase sadaa sadaa har dhiaaeeai |1| rahaau |
English: As God shows His Mercy, the lotus of my heart blossoms, and forever and ever, I meditate on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: antar eko baahar eko sabh meh ek samaaeeai |
English: The One Lord is within, and the One Lord is outside; the One Lord is contained in all.

Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਅਵਘਟਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਦਿਖਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ghatt avaghatt raviaa sabh tthaaee har pooran braham dikhaaeeai |1|
English: Within the heart, beyond the heart, and in all places, God, the Perfect One, is seen to be permeating. ||1||

Gurbani: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਮੁਨਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: ausatat kareh sevak mun kete teraa ant na katahoo paaeeai |
English: So many of Your servants and silent sages sing Your Praises, but no one has found Your limits.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੨॥੧॥
Transliteration: sukhadaate dukh bhanjan suaamee jan naanak sad bal jaaeeai |2|1|
English: O Giver of peace, Destroyer of pain, Lord and Master - servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice to You. ||2||1||

[Ang 528 | Raag: Raag Dayv Gandhaaree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: devagandhaaree |
English: Dayv-Gandhaaree:

Gurbani: ਮਾਈ ਹੋਨਹਾਰ ਸੋ ਹੋਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: maaee honahaar so hoeeai |
English: O mother, whatever is to be, shall be.

Gurbani: ਰਾਚਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਰਚਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਕਹਾ ਲਾਭੁ ਕਹਾ ਖੋਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raach rahio rachanaa prabh apanee kahaa laabh kahaa khoeeai |1| rahaau |
English: God pervades His pervading creation; one gains, while another loses. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਹ ਫੂਲਹਿ ਆਨੰਦ ਬਿਖੈ ਸੋਗ ਕਬ ਹਸਨੋ ਕਬ ਰੋਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: keh fooleh aanand bikhai sog kab hasano kab roeeai |
English: Sometimes he blossoms in bliss, while at other times, he suffers in mourning. Sometimes he laughs, and sometimes he weeps.

Gurbani: ਕਬਹੂ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੇ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਕਬ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਧੋਈਐ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kabahoo mail bhare abhimaanee kab saadhoo sang dhoeeai |1|
English: Sometimes he is filled with the filth of ego, while at other times, he washes it off in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਦੂਸਰ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਲੋਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: koe na mettai prabh kaa keea doosar naahee aloeeai |
English: No one can erase the actions of God; I cannot see any other like Him.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੋਈਐ ॥੨॥੨॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak tis gur balihaaree jih prasaad sukh soeeai |2|2|
English: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Guru; by His Grace, I sleep in peace. ||2||2||

[Ang 529 | Raag: Raag Dayv Gandhaaree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: devagandhaaree |
English: Dayv-Gandhaaree:

Gurbani: ਮਾਈ ਸੁਨਤ ਸੋਚ ਭੈ ਡਰਤ ॥
Transliteration: maaee sunat soch bhai ddarat |
English: O mother, I hear of death, and think of it, and I am filled with fear.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰ ਤੇਰ ਤਜਉ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ਸਰਨਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੀ ਪਰਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mer ter tjau abhimaanaa saran suaamee kee parat |1| rahaau |
English: Renouncing 'mine and yours' and egotism, I have sought the Sanctuary of the Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨਉ ਨਾਹਿ ਨ ਕਾ ਬੋਲ ਕਰਤ ॥
Transliteration: jo jo kahai soee bhal maanau naeh na kaa bol karat |
English: Whatever He says, I accept that as good. I do not say "No" to what He says.

Gurbani: ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਬਿਸਰਉ ਹੀਏ ਮੋਰੇ ਤੇ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਜਾਈ ਹਉ ਮਰਤ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: nimakh na bisrau hee more te bisarat jaaee hau marat |1|
English: Let me not forget Him, even for an instant; forgetting Him, I die. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਇਆਨਪ ਜਰਤ ॥
Transliteration: sukhadaaee pooran prabh karataa meree bahut eaanap jarat |
English: The Giver of peace, God, the Perfect Creator, endures my great ignorance.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਗੁਨਿ ਕਰੂਪਿ ਕੁਲਹੀਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉ ਅਨਦ ਰੂਪ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਭਰਤ ॥੨॥੩॥
Transliteration: niragun karoop kulaheen naanak hau anad roop suaamee bharat |2|3|
English: I am worthless, ugly and of low birth, O Nanak, but my Husband Lord is the embodiment of bliss. ||2||3||

[Ang 529 | Raag: Raag Dayv Gandhaaree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: devagandhaaree |
English: Dayv-Gandhaaree:

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਦਹੂੰ ॥
Transliteration: man har keerat kar sadahoon |
English: O my mind, chant forever the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਜਪਤ ਉਧਾਰੈ ਬਰਨ ਅਬਰਨਾ ਸਭਹੂੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gaavat sunat japat udhaarai baran abaranaa sabhahoon |1| rahaau |
English: By singing, hearing and meditating on Him, all, whether of high or low status, are saved. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਤਹੀ ਸਮਾਇਓ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਨੀ ਤਬਹੂੰ ॥
Transliteration: jeh te upajio tahee samaaeo ih bidh jaanee tabahoon |
English: He is absorbed into the One from which he originated, when he understands the Way.

Gurbani: ਜਹਾ ਜਹਾ ਇਹ ਦੇਹੀ ਧਾਰੀ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਕਬਹੂੰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jahaa jahaa ih dehee dhaaree rehan na paaeo kabahoon |1|
English: Wherever this body was fashioned, it was not allowed to remain there. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁਖੁ ਆਇਓ ਭੈ ਭਰਮ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਹੂਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਬਹੂ ॥
Transliteration: sukh aaeo bhai bharam binaase kripaal hooe prabh jabahoo |
English: Peace comes, and fear and doubt are dispelled, when God becomes Merciful.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਤਜਿ ਲਬਹੂੰ ॥੨॥੪॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak mere poore manorath saadhasang taj labahoon |2|4|
English: Says Nanak, my hopes have been fulfilled, renouncing my greed in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||4||

[Ang 529 | Raag: Raag Dayv Gandhaaree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: devagandhaaree |
English: Dayv-Gandhaaree:

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਜਿਉ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: man jiau apune prabh bhaavau |
English: O my mind, act as it pleases God.

Gurbani: ਨੀਚਹੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਅਤਿ ਨਾਨੑਾ ਹੋਇ ਗਰੀਬੁ ਬੁਲਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: neechahu neech neech at naanaa hoe gareeb bulaavau |1| rahaau |
English: Become the lowest of the low, the very least of the tiny, and speak in utmost humility. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਅਡੰਬਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਬਿਰਥੇ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਘਟਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: anik addanbar maaeaa ke birathe taa siau preet ghattaavau |
English: The many ostentatious shows of Maya are useless; I withhold my love from these.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jiau apuno suaamee sukh maanai taa meh sobhaa paavau |1|
English: As something pleases my Lord and Master, in that I find my glory. ||1||

Gurbani: ਦਾਸਨ ਦਾਸ ਰੇਣੁ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੀ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਕਮਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: daasan daas ren daasan kee jan kee ttehal kamaavau |
English: I am the slave of His slaves; becoming the dust of the feet of his slaves, I serve His humble servants.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਬਡਿਆਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵਉ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਬੁਲਾਵਉ ॥੨॥੫॥
Transliteration: sarab sookh baddiaaee naanak jeevau mukhahu bulaavau |2|5|
English: I obtain all peace and greatness, O Nanak, living to chant His Name with my mouth. ||2||5||

[Ang 529 | Raag: Raag Dayv Gandhaaree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: devagandhaaree |
English: Dayv-Gandhaaree:

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਤਉ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਡਾਰਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: prabh jee tau prasaad bhram ddaario |
English: Dear God, by Your Grace, my doubts have been dispelled.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਅਪਨਾ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਇਹੈ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tumaree kripaa te sabh ko apanaa man meh ihai beechaario |1| rahaau |
English: By Your Mercy, all are mine; I reflect upon this in my mind. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰਾਧ ਮਿਟੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਉਤਾਰਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: kott paraadh mitte teree sevaa darasan dookh utaario |
English: Millions of sins are erased, by serving You; the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan drives away sorrow.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਬਿਦਾਰਿਓ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naam japat mahaa sukh paaeo chintaa rog bidaario |1|
English: Chanting Your Name, I have obtained supreme peace, and my anxieties and diseases have been cast out. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh lobh jhootth nindaa saadhoo sang bisaario |
English: Sexual desire, anger, greed, falsehood and slander are forgotten, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਬੰਧ ਕਾਟੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਉਧਾਰਿਓ ॥੨॥੬॥
Transliteration: maaeaa bandh kaatte kirapaa nidh naanak aap udhaario |2|6|
English: The ocean of mercy has cut away the bonds of Maya; O Nanak, He has saved me. ||2||6||

[Ang 529 | Raag: Raag Dayv Gandhaaree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: devagandhaaree |
English: Dayv-Gandhaaree:

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਰਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: man sagal siaanap rahee |
English: All the cleverness of my mind is gone.

Gurbani: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨਹਾਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: karan karaavanahaar suaamee naanak ott gahee |1| rahaau |
English: The Lord and Master is the Doer, the Cause of causes; Nanak holds tight to His Support. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਮੇਟਿ ਪਏ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਕਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: aap mett pe saranaaee ih mat saadhoo kahee |
English: Erasing my self-conceit, I have entered His Sanctuary; these are the Teachings spoken by the Holy Guru.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਮਾਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਭਰਮੁ ਅਧੇਰਾ ਲਹੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: prabh kee aagiaa maan sukh paaeaa bharam adheraa lahee |1|
English: Surrendering to the Will of God, I attain peace, and the darkness of doubt is dispelled. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਅਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jaan prabeen suaamee prabh mere saran tumaaree ahee |
English: I know that You are all-wise, O God, my Lord and Master; I seek Your Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਨਹਾਰੇ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਹੀ ॥੨॥੭॥
Transliteration: khin meh thaap uthaapanahaare kudarat keem na pahee |2|7|
English: In an instant, You establish and disestablish; the value of Your Almighty Creative Power cannot be estimated. ||2||7||

[Ang 529 | Raag: Raag Dayv Gandhaaree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: devagandhaaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: har praan prabhoo sukhadaate |
English: The Lord God is my praanaa, my breath of life; He is the Giver of peace.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਾਹੂ ਜਾਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad kaahoo jaate |1| rahaau |
English: By Guru's Grace, only a few know Him. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਕਾਲ ਨ ਖਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: sant tumaare tumare preetam tin kau kaal na khaate |
English: Your Saints are Your Beloveds; death does not consume them.

Gurbani: ਰੰਗਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੈ ਲਾਲ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਸਿ ਮਾਤੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: rang tumaarai laal bhe hai raam naam ras maate |1|
English: They are dyed in the deep crimson color of Your Love, and they are intoxicated with the sublime essence of the Lord's Name. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕੋਟਿ ਦੋਖ ਰੋਗਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ ਹਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: mahaa kilabikh kott dokh rogaa prabh drisatt tuhaaree haate |
English: The greatest sins, and millions of pains and diseases are destroyed by Your Gracious Glance, O God.

Gurbani: ਸੋਵਤ ਜਾਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਪਰਾਤੇ ॥੨॥੮॥
Transliteration: sovat jaag har har har gaaeaa naanak gur charan paraate |2|8|
English: While sleeping and waking, Nanak sings the Lord's Name, Har, Har, Har; he falls at the Guru's feet. ||2||8||

[Ang 530 | Raag: Raag Dayv Gandhaaree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: devagandhaaree 5 |
English: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਨੈਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: so prabh jat kat pekhio nainee |
English: I have seen that God with my eyes everywhere.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਜੀਅਨ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬੈਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sukhadaaee jeean ko daataa amrit jaa kee bainee |1| rahaau |
English: The Giver of peace, the Giver of souls, His Speech is Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅਧੇਰਾ ਸੰਤੀ ਕਾਟਿਆ ਜੀਅ ਦਾਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਦੈਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: agiaan adheraa santee kaattiaa jeea daan gur dainee |
English: The Saints dispel the darkness of ignorance; the Guru is the Giver of the gift of life.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਨੋ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਜਲਤੇ ਸੀਤਲ ਹੋਣੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa kar leeno apunaa jalate seetal honee |1|
English: Granting His Grace, the Lord has made me His own; I was on fire, but now I am cooled. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਰਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਉਪਜਿ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਨਹ ਉਪਜੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: karam dharam kichh upaj na aaeo neh upajee niramal karanee |
English: The karma of good deeds, and the Dharma of righteous faith, have not been produced in me, in the least; nor has pure conduct welled up in me.

Gurbani: ਛਾਡਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਾਗੋ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ॥੨॥੯॥
Transliteration: chhaadd siaanap sanjam naanak laago gur kee charanee |2|9|
English: Renouncing cleverness and self-mortification, O Nanak, I fall at the Guru's feet. ||2||9||

[Ang 530 | Raag: Raag Dayv Gandhaaree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: devagandhaaree 5 |
English: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: har raam naam jap laahaa |
English: Chant the Lord's Name, and earn the profit.

Gurbani: ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਕਾਟੇ ਜਮ ਕੇ ਫਾਹਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gat paaveh sukh sehaj anandaa kaatte jam ke faahaa |1| rahaau |
English: You shall attain salvation, peace, poise and bliss, and the noose of Death shall be cut away. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਪਹਿ ਆਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: khojat khojat khoj beechaario har sant janaa peh aahaa |
English: Searching, searching, searching and reflecting, I have found that the Lord's Name is with the Saints.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨੑਾ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਏਹੁ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ਜਿਨੑ ਕੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਲਿਖਾਹਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tinaa paraapat ehu nidhaanaa jina kai karam likhaahaa |1|
English: They alone obtain this treasure, who have such pre-ordained destiny. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ਸੇ ਪਤਿਵੰਤੇ ਸੇਈ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: se baddabhaagee se pativante seee poore saahaa |
English: They are very fortunate and honorable; they are the perfect bankers.

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸੁਘੜ ਸਰੂਪ ਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਹਾ ॥੨॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: sundar sugharr saroop te naanak jina har har naam visaahaa |2|10|
English: They are beautiful, so very wise and handsome; O Nanak, purchase the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||2||10||

[Ang 530 | Raag: Raag Dayv Gandhaaree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: devagandhaaree 5 |
English: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕਹ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਅਫਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: man keh ahankaar afaaraa |
English: O mind, why are you so puffed up with egotism?

Gurbani: ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਅਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਅਪਾਵਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਛਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: duragandh apavitr apaavan bheetar jo deesai so chhaaraa |1| rahaau |
English: Whatever is seen in this foul, impure and filthy world, is only ashes. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪਰਾਨੀ ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਜਿਨਿ ਧਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jin keea tis simar paraanee jeeo praan jin dhaaraa |
English: Remember the One who created you, O mortal; He is the Support of your soul, and the breath of life.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਅਵਰ ਲਪਟਾਵਹਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਮੁਗਧ ਗਵਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tiseh tiaag avar lapattaaveh mar janameh mugadh gavaaraa |1|
English: One who forsakes Him, and attaches himself to another, dies to be reborn; he is such an ignorant fool! ||1||

Gurbani: ਅੰਧ ਗੁੰਗ ਪਿੰਗੁਲ ਮਤਿ ਹੀਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: andh gung pingul mat heenaa prabh raakhahu raakhanahaaraa |
English: I am blind, mute, crippled and totally lacking in understanding; O God, Preserver of all, please preserve me!

Gurbani: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨਹਾਰ ਸਮਰਥਾ ਕਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੰਤ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੨॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: karan karaavanahaar samarathaa kiaa naanak jant bichaaraa |2|11|
English: The Creator, the Cause of causes is all-powerful; O Nanak, how helpless are His beings! ||2||11||

[Ang 530 | Raag: Raag Dayv Gandhaaree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: devagandhaaree 5 |
English: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨੇਰੈ ਹੂ ਤੇ ਨੇਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: so prabh nerai hoo te nerai |
English: God is the nearest of the near.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਗਾਇ ਗੁਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਸਾਝ ਸਵੇਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: simar dhiaae gaae gun gobind din rain saajh saverai |1| rahaau |
English: Remember Him, meditate on Him, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, day and night, evening and morning. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਉਧਰੁ ਦੇਹ ਦੁਲਭ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: audhar deh dulabh saadhoo sang har har naam japerai |
English: Redeem your body in the invaluable Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਘਰੀ ਨ ਮੁਹਤੁ ਨ ਚਸਾ ਬਿਲੰਬਹੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਨਿਤਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਹੇਰੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gharee na muhat na chasaa bilanbahu kaal niteh nit herai |1|
English: Do not delay for an instant, even for a moment. Death is keeping you constantly in his vision. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅੰਧ ਬਿਲਾ ਤੇ ਕਾਢਹੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਿਆ ਨਾਹੀ ਘਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: andh bilaa te kaadtahu karate kiaa naahee ghar terai |
English: Lift me up out of the dark dungeon, O Creator Lord; what is there which is not in Your home?

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਆਨਦ ਸੂਖ ਘਨੇਰੈ ॥੨॥੧੨॥ ਛਕੇ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: naam adhaar deejai naanak kau aanad sookh ghanerai |2|12| chhake 2 |
English: Bless Nanak with the Support of Your Name, that he may find great happiness and peace. ||2||12|| Second Set of Six||

[Ang 530 | Raag: Raag Dayv Gandhaaree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: devagandhaaree 5 |
English: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: man gur mil naam araadhio |
English: O mind, meet with the Guru, and worship the Naam in adoration.

Gurbani: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਰਸ ਜੀਵਨ ਕਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਬਾਧਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sookh sehaj aanand mangal ras jeevan kaa mool baadhio |1| rahaau |
English: You shall obtain peace, poise, bliss, joy and pleasure, and lay the foundation of eternal life. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਕਾਟੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਫਾਧਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa apunaa daas keeno kaatte maaeaa faadhio |
English: Showing His Mercy, the Lord has made me His slave, and shattered the bonds of Maya.

Gurbani: ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਗਾਇ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਸਾਧਿਓ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bhaau bhagat gaae gun gobid jam kaa maarag saadhio |1|
English: Through loving devotion, and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, I have escaped the Path of Death. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਇਓ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਮਿਟਿਓ ਮੋਰਚਾ ਅਮੋਲ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਲਾਧਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: bheo anugrahu mittio morachaa amol padaarath laadhio |
English: When he became Merciful, the rust was removed, and I found the priceless treasure.

Gurbani: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਖ ਬੇਰਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿਓ ॥੨॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: balihaarai naanak lakh beraa mere tthaakur agam agaadhio |2|13|
English: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice, a hundred thousand times, to my unapproachable, unfathomable Lord and Master. ||2||13||

[Ang 531 | Raag: Raag Dayv Gandhaaree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: devagandhaaree 5 |
English: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਾਈ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: maaee jo prabh ke gun gaavai |
English: O mother, how fruitful is the birth of one who sings the Glories of God,

Gurbani: ਸਫਲ ਆਇਆ ਜੀਵਨ ਫਲੁ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: safal aaeaa jeevan fal taa ko paarabraham liv laavai |1| rahaau |
English: and enshrines love for the Supreme Lord God. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੂਰੁ ਸੋ ਬੇਤਾ ਜੋ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: sundar sugharr soor so betaa jo saadhoo sang paavai |
English: Beautiful, wise, brave and divine is one who obtains the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਉਚਾਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਜੋਨੀ ਧਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naam uchaar kare har rasanaa bahurr na jonee dhaavai |1|
English: He chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, with his tongue, and does not have to wander in reincarnation again. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਆਨ ਨ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੀ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: pooran braham raviaa man tan meh aan na drisattee aavai |
English: The Perfect Lord God pervades his mind and body; he does not look upon any other.

Gurbani: ਨਰਕ ਰੋਗ ਨਹੀ ਹੋਵਤ ਜਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: narak rog nahee hovat jan sang naanak jis larr laavai |2|14|
English: Hell and disease do not afflict one who joins the Company of the Lord's humble servants, O Nanak; the Lord attaches him to the hem of His robe. ||2||14||

[Ang 531 | Raag: Raag Dayv Gandhaaree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: devagandhaaree 5 |
English: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਚੰਚਲੁ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਹੀ ਉਰਝਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: chanchal supanai hee urajhaaeo |
English: His fickle mind is entangled in a dream.

Gurbani: ਇਤਨੀ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਕਬਹੂ ਚਲਨਾ ਬਿਕਲ ਭਇਓ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: eitanee na boojhai kabahoo chalanaa bikal bheo sang maaeo |1| rahaau |
English: He does not even understand this much, that someday he shall have to depart; he has gone crazy with Maya. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕੁਸਮ ਰੰਗ ਸੰਗ ਰਸਿ ਰਚਿਆ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਏਕ ਉਪਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: kusam rang sang ras rachiaa bikhiaa ek upaaeo |
English: He is engrossed in the delight of the flower's color; he strives only to indulge in corruption.

Gurbani: ਲੋਭ ਸੁਨੈ ਮਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੈ ਬੇਗਿ ਤਹਾ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: lobh sunai man sukh kar maanai beg tahaa utth dhaaeo |1|
English: Hearing about greed, he feels happy in his mind, and he runs after it. ||1||

Gurbani: ਫਿਰਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਸੰਤ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਆਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: firat firat bahut sram paaeo sant duaarai aaeo |
English: Wandering and roaming all around, I have endured great pain, but now, I have come to the door of the Saint.

Gurbani: ਕਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੀਓ ਸਮਾਇਓ ॥੨॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: karee kripaa paarabraham suaamee naanak leeo samaaeo |2|15|
English: Granting His Grace, the Supreme Lord Master has blended Nanak with Himself. ||2||15||

[Ang 531 | Raag: Raag Dayv Gandhaaree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: devagandhaaree 5 |
English: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: sarab sukhaa gur charanaa |
English: All peace is found in the Guru's feet.

Gurbani: ਕਲਿਮਲ ਡਾਰਨ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਧਾਰਨ ਇਹ ਆਸਰ ਮੋਹਿ ਤਰਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kalimal ddaaran maneh sadhaaran ih aasar mohi taranaa |1| rahaau |
English: They drive away my sins and purify my mind; their Support carries me across. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪੂਜਾ ਅਰਚਾ ਸੇਵਾ ਬੰਦਨ ਇਹੈ ਟਹਲ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: poojaa arachaa sevaa bandan ihai ttehal mohi karanaa |
English: This is the labor which I perform: worship, flower-offerings, service and devotion.

Gurbani: ਬਿਗਸੈ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਗਰਭੈ ਪਰਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bigasai man hovai paragaasaa bahur na garabhai paranaa |1|
English: My mind blossoms forth and is enlightened, and I am not cast into the womb again. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਪਰਸਉ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਇਹੈ ਧਿਆਨਾ ਧਰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: safal moorat parsau santan kee ihai dhiaanaa dharanaa |
English: I behold the fruitful vision of the Saint; this is the meditation I have taken.

Gurbani: ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪਰਿਓ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾ ॥੨॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: bheo kripaal tthaakur naanak kau pario saadh kee saranaa |2|16|
English: The Lord Master has become Merciful to Nanak, and he has entered the Sanctuary of the Holy. ||2||16||

[Ang 531 | Raag: Raag Dayv Gandhaaree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: devagandhaaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਹਿ ਬਿਨਤੀ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: apune har peh binatee kaheeai |
English: Offer your prayer to your Lord.

Gurbani: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਨਿਧਿ ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਸਿਧਿ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: chaar padaarath anad mangal nidh sookh sehaj sidh laheeai |1| rahaau |
English: You shall obtain the four blessings, and the treasures of bliss, pleasure, peace, poise and the spiritual powers of the Siddhas. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਾਨੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨੀ ਲਾਗਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਚਲੁ ਗਹੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: maan tiaag har charanee laagau tis prabh anchal gaheeai |
English: Renounce your self-conceit, and grasp hold of the Guru's feet; hold tight to the hem of God's robe.

Gurbani: ਆਂਚ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਤੇ ਸਰਨਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੀ ਅਹੀਐ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aanch na laagai agan saagar te saran suaamee kee aheeai |1|
English: The heat of the ocean of fire does not affect one who longs for the Lord and Master's Sanctuary. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰਾਧ ਮਹਾ ਅਕ੍ਰਿਤਘਨ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਹੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: kott paraadh mahaa akritaghan bahur bahur prabh saheeai |
English: Again and again, God puts up with the millions of sins of the supremely ungrateful ones.

Gurbani: ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਨਹੀਐ ॥੨॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: karunaa mai pooran paramesur naanak tis saranaheeai |2|17|
English: The embodiment of mercy, the Perfect Transcendent Lord - Nanak longs for His Sanctuary. ||2||17||

[Ang 531 | Raag: Raag Dayv Gandhaaree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: devagandhaaree 5 |
English: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਰਿਦੈ ਪਰਵੇਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur ke charan ridai paravesaa |
English: Place the Guru's feet within your heart,

Gurbani: ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਸਭਿ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਉਤਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਕਲੇਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: rog sog sabh dookh binaase utare sagal kalesaa |1| rahaau |
English: and all illness, sorrow and pain shall be dispelled; all suffering shall come to an end. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਨਾਸਹਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਮਜਨ ਇਸਨਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: janam janam ke kilabikh naaseh kott majan isanaanaa |
English: The sins of countless incarnations are erased, as if one has taken purifying baths at millions of sacred shrines.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਗਾਵਤ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਲਾਗੋ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naam nidhaan gaavat gun gobind laago sehaj dhiaanaa |1|
English: The treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is obtained by singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, and centering one's mind in meditation on Him. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋਰਿ ਨਿਰਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa apunaa daas keeno bandhan tor niraare |
English: Showing His Mercy, the Lord has made me His slave; breaking my bonds, He has saved me.

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀਵਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੧੮॥ ਛਕੇ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: jap jap naam jeevaa teree baanee naanak daas balihaare |2|18| chhake 3 |
English: I live by chanting and meditating on the Naam, and the Bani of Your Word; slave Nanak is a sacrifice to You. ||2||18|| Third Set of Six||

[Ang 531 | Raag: Raag Dayv Gandhaaree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: devagandhaaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਨਿਹਾਰਉ ॥
Transliteration: maaee prabh ke charan nihaarau |
English: O mother, I long to see the Feet of God.

Gurbani: ਕਰਹੁ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਡਾਰਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: karahu anugrahu suaamee mere man te kabahu na ddaarau |1| rahaau |
English: Be Merciful to me, O my Lord and Master, that I might never forsake them from my mind. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰਿ ਲਾਈ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਬਿਖੁ ਜਾਰਉ ॥
Transliteration: saadhoo dhoor laaee mukh masatak kaam krodh bikh jaarau |
English: Applying the dust of the feet of the Holy to my face and forehead, I burn away the poison of sexual desire and anger.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਨੀਚੁ ਆਤਮ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਉ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਇਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਧਾਰਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sabh te neech aatam kar maanau man meh ihu sukh dhaarau |1|
English: I judge myself to be the lowest of all; in this way, I instill peace within my mind. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਕਲਮਲ ਸਗਲੇ ਝਾਰਉ ॥
Transliteration: gun gaavah tthaakur abinaasee kalamal sagale jhaarau |
English: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Imperishable Lord and Master, and I shake off all my sins.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਨੁ ਪਾਵਉ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਉ ॥੨॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: naam nidhaan naanak daan paavau kantth laae ur dhaarau |2|19|
English: I have found the gift of the treasure of the Naam, O Nanak; I hug it close, and enshrine it in my heart. ||2||19||

[Ang 532 | Raag: Raag Dayv Gandhaaree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: devagandhaaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਪੇਖਉ ਦਰਸੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: prabh jeeo pekhau daras tumaaraa |
English: Dear God, I long to behold the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਾਰੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨੀ ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਤੇ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sundar dhiaan dhaar din rainee jeea praan te piaaraa |1| rahaau |
English: I cherish this beautiful meditation day and night; You are dearer to me than my soul, dearer than life itself. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਅਵਿਲੋਕੇ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: saasatr bed puraan aviloke simrit tat beechaaraa |
English: I have studied and contemplated the essence of the Shaastras, the Vedas and the Puraanas.

Gurbani: ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਵਜਲ ਉਧਰਨਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: deenaa naath praanapat pooran bhavajal udharanahaaraa |1|
English: Protector of the meek, Lord of the breath of life, O Perfect One, carry us across the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਭਗਤ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਕ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਬਿਖੈ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aad jugaad bhagat jan sevak taa kee bikhai adhaaraa |
English: Since the very beginning, and throughout the ages, the humble devotees have been Your servants; in the midst of the world of corruption, You are their Support.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਬਾਛੈ ਨਿਤ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰਾ ॥੨॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: tin jan kee dhoor baachhai nit naanak paramesar devanahaaraa |2|20|
English: Nanak longs for the dust of the feet of such humble beings; the Transcendent Lord is the Giver of all. ||2||20||

[Ang 532 | Raag: Raag Dayv Gandhaaree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: devagandhaaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਜਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣਿ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: teraa jan raam rasaaein maataa |
English: Your humble servant, O Lord, is intoxicated with Your sublime essence.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਉਪਜੀ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: prem rasaa nidh jaa kau upajee chhodd na katahoo jaataa |1| rahaau |
English: One who obtains the treasure of the Nectar of Your Love, does not renounce it to go somewhere else. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬੈਠਤ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਵਤ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਖਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: baitthat har har sovat har har har ras bhojan khaataa |
English: While sitting, he repeats the Lord's Name, Har, Har; while sleeping, he repeats the Lord's Name, Har, Har; he eats the Nectar of the Lord's Name as his food.

Gurbani: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਮਜਨੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰੀ ਨਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: atthasatth teerath majan keeno saadhoo dhooree naataa |1|
English: Bathing in the dust of the feet of the Holy is equal to taking cleansing baths at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਨੋ ਸਉਤੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: safal janam har jan kaa upajiaa jin keeno saut bidhaataa |
English: How fruitful is the birth of the Lord's humble servant; the Creator is his Father.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਸਮੂਹ ਲੈ ਉਧਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥੨॥੨੧॥
Transliteration: sagal samooh lai udhare naanak pooran braham pachhaataa |2|21|
English: O Nanak, one who recognizes the Perfect Lord God, takes all with him, and saves everyone. ||2||21||

[Ang 532 | Raag: Raag Dayv Gandhaaree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: devagandhaaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: maaee gur bin giaan na paaeeai |
English: O mother, without the Guru, spiritual wisdom is not obtained.

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਫਿਰਤ ਬਿਲਲਾਤੇ ਮਿਲਤ ਨਹੀ ਗੋਸਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: anik prakaar firat bilalaate milat nahee gosaaeeai |1| rahaau |
English: They wander around, weeping and crying out in various ways, but the Lord of the World does not meet them. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੋਹ ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਤਨੁ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਭਰਮਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: moh rog sog tan baadhio bahu jonee bharamaaeeai |
English: The body is tied up with emotional attachment, disease and sorrow, and so it is lured into countless reincarnations.

Gurbani: ਟਿਕਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਜਾਇ ਰੂਆਈਐ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ttikan na paavai bin satasangat kis aagai jaae rooaaeeai |1|
English: He finds no place of rest without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; to whom should he go and cry? ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਰੈ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਧ ਚਰਨ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: karai anugrahu suaamee meraa saadh charan chit laaeeai |
English: When my Lord and Master shows His Mercy, we lovingly focus our consciousness on the feet of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਸੰਕਟ ਘੋਰ ਕਟੇ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥੨॥੨੨॥
Transliteration: sankatt ghor katte khin bheetar naanak har daras samaaeeai |2|22|
English: The most horrible agonies are dispelled in an instant, O Nanak, and we merge in the Blessed Vision of the Lord. ||2||22||

[Ang 532 | Raag: Raag Dayv Gandhaaree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: devagandhaaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹੋਏ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
Transliteration: tthaakur hoe aap deaal |
English: The Lord and Master Himself has become Merciful.

Gurbani: ਭਈ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਅਨੰਦ ਰੂਪ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਉਬਰੇ ਬਾਲ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhee kaliaan anand roop hoee hai ubare baal gupaal | rahaau |
English: I have been emancipated, and I have become the embodiment of bliss; I am the Lord's child - He has saved me. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਕਰੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: due kar jorr karee benantee paarabraham man dhiaaeaa |
English: With my palms pressed together, I offer my prayer; within my mind, I meditate on the Supreme Lord God.

Gurbani: ਹਾਥੁ ਦੇਇ ਰਾਖੇ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰਿ ਸਗਲਾ ਦੁਰਤੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: haath dee raakhe paramesur sagalaa durat mittaaeaa |1|
English: Giving me His hand, the Transcendent Lord has eradicated all my sins. ||1||

Gurbani: ਵਰ ਨਾਰੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਆ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਾ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: var naaree mil mangal gaaeaa tthaakur kaa jaikaar |
English: Husband and wife join together in rejoicing, celebrating the Victory of the Lord Master.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਜੋ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਰੇ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥੨੩॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak jan kau bal jaaeeai jo sabhanaa kare udhaar |2|23|
English: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the humble servant of the Lord, who emancipates everyone. ||2||23||

[Ang 533 | Raag: Raag Dayv Gandhaaree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: devagandhaaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਬਿਨਉ ਕਹਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: apune satigur peh binau kahiaa |
English: I offer my prayer to my True Guru.

Gurbani: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਗਲ ਅੰਦੇਸਰਾ ਗਇਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhe kripaal deaal dukh bhanjan meraa sagal andesaraa geaa | rahaau |
English: The Destroyer of distress has become kind and merciful, and all my anxiety is over. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਪਾਖੰਡੀ ਲੋਭੀ ਹਮਰਾ ਗੁਨੁ ਅਵਗੁਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਹਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: ham paapee paakhanddee lobhee hamaraa gun avagun sabh sahiaa |
English: I am a sinner, hypocritical and greedy, but still, He puts up with all of my merits and demerits.

Gurbani: ਕਰੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਸਾਜਿ ਨਿਵਾਜੇ ਮੁਏ ਦੁਸਟ ਜੋ ਖਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kar masatak dhaar saaj nivaaje mue dusatt jo kheaa |1|
English: Placing His hand on my forehead, He has exalted me. The wicked ones who wanted to destroy me have been killed. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ ਸਰਬ ਸਧਾਰੀ ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸਨ ਸਹਜਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: praupakaaree sarab sadhaaree safal darasan sahajeaa |
English: He is generous and benevolent, the beautifier of all, the embodiment of peace; the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is so fruitful!

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਕਉ ਦਾਤਾ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਉਰ ਧਰਿਆ ॥੨॥੨੪॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak niragun kau daataa charan kamal ur dhariaa |2|24|
English: Says Nanak, He is the Giver to the unworthy; I enshrine His Lotus Feet within my heart. ||2||24||

[Ang 533 | Raag: Raag Dayv Gandhaaree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: devagandhaaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਨਾਥ ਨਾਥ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: anaath naath prabh hamaare |
English: My God is the Master of the masterless.

Gurbani: ਸਰਨਿ ਆਇਓ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saran aaeo raakhanahaare | rahaau |
English: I have come to the Sanctuary of the Savior Lord. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਪਾਖ ਰਾਖੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sarab paakh raakh muraare |
English: Protect me on all sides, O Lord;

Gurbani: ਆਗੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਅੰਤੀ ਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aagai paachhai antee vaare |1|
English: protect me in the future, in the past, and at the very last moment. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਤਬ ਤੁਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jab chitvau tab tuhaare |
English: Whenever something comes to mind, it is You.

Gurbani: ਉਨ ਸਮੑਾਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਧਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aun samaar meraa man sadhaare |2|
English: Contemplating Your virtues, my mind is sanctified. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੁਨਿ ਗਾਵਉ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sun gaavau gur bachanaare |
English: I hear and sing the Hymns of the Guru's Word.

Gurbani: ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ਸਾਧ ਦਰਸਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bal bal jaau saadh darasaare |3|
English: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the Holy. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖਉ ਏਕ ਅਸਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: man meh raakhau ek asaare |
English: Within my mind, I have the Support of the One Lord alone.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੨੫॥
Transliteration: naanak prabh mere karanaihaare |4|25|
English: O Nanak, my God is the Creator of all. ||4||25||

[Ang 533 | Raag: Raag Dayv Gandhaaree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: devagandhaaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਇਹੈ ਮਨੋਰਥੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: prabh ihai manorath meraa |
English: God, this is my heart's desire:

Gurbani: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਮੋਹਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ ਚੇਰਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kripaa nidhaan deaal mohi deejai kar santan kaa cheraa | rahaau |
English: O treasure of kindness, O Merciful Lord, please make me the slave of your Saints. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਾਤਹਕਾਲ ਲਾਗਉ ਜਨ ਚਰਨੀ ਨਿਸ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਦਰਸੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: praatahakaal laagau jan charanee nis baasur daras paavau |
English: In the early hours of the morning, I fall at the feet of Your humble servants; night and day, I obtain the Blessed Vision of their Darshan.

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਕਰਉ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਾ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tan man arap krau jan sevaa rasanaa har gun gaavau |1|
English: Dedicating my body and mind, I serve the humble servant of the Lord; with my tongue, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਿਮਰਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਤ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: saas saas simrau prabh apunaa santasang nit raheeai |
English: With each and every breath, I meditate in remembrance on my God; I live continually in the Society of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਮੋਰਾ ਅਨਦੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੨॥੨੬॥
Transliteration: ek adhaar naam dhan moraa anad naanak ihu laheeai |2|26|
English: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is my only support and wealth; O Nanak, from this, I obtain bliss. ||2||26||

[Ang 533 | Raag: Raag Dayv Gandhaaree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: raag devagandhaaree mahalaa 5 ghar 3 |
English: Raag Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl, Third House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਮੀਤਾ ਐਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: meetaa aise har jeeo paae |
English: O friend, such is the Dear Lord whom I have obtained.

Gurbani: ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੰਗੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਗਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: chhodd na jaaee sad hee sange anadin gur mil gaae |1| rahaau |
English: He does not leave me, and He always keeps me company. Meeting the Guru, night and day, I sing His Praises. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿਓ ਮਨੋਹਰੁ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖੈਨਾ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: milio manohar sarab sukhainaa tiaag na katahoo jaae |
English: I met the Fascinating Lord, who has blessed me with all comforts; He does not leave me to go anywhere else.

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਪੇਖੇ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਰੋਮ ਨ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਲਾਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: anik anik bhaat bahu pekhe pria rom na samasar laae |1|
English: I have seen the mortals of many and various types, but they are not equal to even a hair of my Beloved. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੰਦਰਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਸੋਭ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਅਨਹਤ ਰੁਣੁ ਝੁਣੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: mandar bhaag sobh duaarai anahat run jhun laae |
English: His palace is so beautiful! His gate is so wonderful! The celestial melody of the sound current resounds there.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਥੀਤੇ ਸਦ ਥਾਏ ॥੨॥੧॥੨੭॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak sadaa rang maane grih pria theete sad thaae |2|1|27|
English: Says Nanak, I enjoy eternal bliss; I have obtained a permanent place in the home of my Beloved. ||2||1||27||

[Ang 533 | Raag: Raag Dayv Gandhaaree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: devagandhaaree 5 |
English: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦਰਸਨ ਨਾਮ ਕਉ ਮਨੁ ਆਛੈ ॥
Transliteration: darasan naam kau man aachhai |
English: My mind longs for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, and His Name.

Gurbani: ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਇਓ ਹੈ ਸਗਲ ਥਾਨ ਰੇ ਆਹਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਸੰਤ ਪਾਛੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhram aaeo hai sagal thaan re aaeh pario sant paachhai |1| rahaau |
English: I have wandered everywhere, and now I have come to follow the Saint. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਿਸੁ ਹਉ ਸੇਵੀ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਰਾਧੀ ਜੋ ਦਿਸਟੈ ਸੋ ਗਾਛੈ ॥
Transliteration: kis hau sevee kis aaraadhee jo disattai so gaachhai |
English: Whom should I serve? Whom should I worship in adoration? Whoever I see shall pass away.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਨੀ ਪਰੀਐ ਚਰਣ ਰੇਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਬਾਛੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saadhasangat kee saranee pareeai charan ren man baachhai |1|
English: I have sought the Sanctuary of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; my mind longs for the dust of their Feet. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ਗੁਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਮਾਇ ਆਛੈ ॥
Transliteration: jugat na jaanaa gun nahee koee mahaa dutar maae aachhai |
English: I do not know the way, and I have no virtue. It is so difficult to escape from Maya!

Gurbani: ਆਇ ਪਇਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ ਤਉ ਉਤਰੀ ਸਗਲ ਦੁਰਾਛੈ ॥੨॥੨॥੨੮॥
Transliteration: aae peo naanak gur charanee tau utaree sagal duraachhai |2|2|28|
English: Nanak has come and fallen at the Guru's feet; all of his evil inclinations have vanished. ||2||2||28||

[Ang 534 | Raag: Raag Dayv Gandhaaree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: devagandhaaree 5 |
English: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਬਚਨ ਤੁਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: amritaa pria bachan tuhaare |
English: O Beloved, Your Words are Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਅਤਿ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਮਨਮੋਹਨ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਭਹੂ ਮਧਿ ਨਿਰਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: at sundar manamohan piaare sabhahoo madh niraare |1| rahaau |
English: O supremely beautiful Enticer, O Beloved, You are among all, and yet distinct from all. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਰਾਜੁ ਨ ਚਾਹਉ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਚਾਹਉ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: raaj na chaahau mukat na chaahau man preet charan kamalaare |
English: I do not seek power, and I do not seek liberation. My mind is in love with Your Lotus Feet.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮਹੇਸ ਸਿਧ ਮੁਨਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹੀ ਦਰਸਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: braham mahes sidh mun indraa mohi tthaakur hee darasaare |1|
English: Brahma, Shiva, the Siddhas, the silent sages and Indra - I seek only the Blessed Vision of my Lord and Master's Darshan. ||1||

Gurbani: ਦੀਨੁ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਆਇਓ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਸੰਤ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: deen duaarai aaeo tthaakur saran pario sant haare |
English: I have come, helpless, to Your Door, O Lord Master; I am exhausted - I seek the Sanctuary of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲੇ ਮਨੋਹਰ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲ ਬਿਗਸਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੩॥੨੯॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak prabh mile manohar man seetal bigasaare |2|3|29|
English: Says Nanak, I have met my Enticing Lord God; my mind is cooled and soothed - it blossoms forth in joy. ||2||3||29||

[Ang 534 | Raag: Raag Dayv Gandhaaree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: devagandhaaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: har jap sevak paar utaario |
English: Meditating on the Lord, His servant swims across to salvation.

Gurbani: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਭਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨਹੀ ਮਾਰਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: deen deaal bhe prabh apane bahurr janam nahee maario |1| rahaau |
English: When God becomes merciful to the meek, then one does not have to suffer reincarnation, only to die again. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਮਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਹਾਰਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasangam gun gaavah har ke ratan janam nahee haario |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and he does not lose the jewel of this human life.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਨੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਕੁਲਹ ਸਮੂਹ ਉਧਾਰਿਓ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: prabh gun gaae bikhai ban tariaa kulah samooh udhaario |1|
English: Singing the Glories of God, he crosses over the ocean of poison, and saves all his generations as well. ||1||

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਬਸਿਆ ਰਿਦ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਉਚਾਰਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal basiaa rid bheetar saas giraas uchaario |
English: The Lotus Feet of the Lord abide within his heart, and with every breath and morsel of food, he chants the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰ ਪੁਨਹ ਪੁਨਹ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿਓ ॥੨॥੪॥੩੦॥
Transliteration: naanak ott gahee jagadeesur punah punah balihaario |2|4|30|
English: Nanak has grasped the Support of the Lord of the Universe; again and again, he is a sacrifice to Him. ||2||4||30||

[Ang 534 | Raag: Raag Dayv Gandhaaree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: raag devagandhaaree mahalaa 5 ghar 4 |
English: Raag Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਕਰਤ ਫਿਰੇ ਬਨ ਭੇਖ ਮੋਹਨ ਰਹਤ ਨਿਰਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: karat fire ban bhekh mohan rehat niraar |1| rahaau |
English: Some wander around the forests, wearing religious robes, but the Fascinating Lord remains distant from them. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਥਨ ਸੁਨਾਵਨ ਗੀਤ ਨੀਕੇ ਗਾਵਨ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਧਰਤੇ ਗਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kathan sunaavan geet neeke gaavan man meh dharate gaar |1|
English: They talk, preach, and sing their lovely songs, but within their minds, the filth of their sins remains. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਤਿ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਬਹੁ ਚਤੁਰ ਸਿਆਨੇ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਰਸਨਾ ਚਾਰ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: at sundar bahu chatur siaane bidiaa rasanaa chaar |2|
English: They may be very beautiful, extremely clever, wise and educated, and they may speak very sweetly. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹ ਮੇਰ ਤੇਰ ਬਿਬਰਜਿਤ ਏਹੁ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਖੰਡੇ ਧਾਰ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: maan moh mer ter bibarajit ehu maarag khandde dhaar |3|
English: To forsake pride, emotional attachment, and the sense of 'mine and yours', is the path of the double-edged sword. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨਿ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰੀਅਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗਾਰ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੧॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak tin bhavajal tareeale prabh kirapaa sant sangaar |4|1|31|
English: Says Nanak, they alone swim across the terrifying world-ocean, who, by God's Grace, join the Society of the Saints. ||4||1||31||

[Ang 534 | Raag: Raag Dayv Gandhaaree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raag devagandhaaree mahalaa 5 ghar 5 |
English: Raag Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl, Fifth House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਰੀ ਊਚਾ ਮੋਹਨੁ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ॥
Transliteration: mai pekhio ree aoochaa mohan sabh te aoochaa |
English: I have seen the Lord to be on high; the Fascinating Lord is the highest of all.

Gurbani: ਆਨ ਨ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਕੋਊ ਲਾਗੈ ਢੂਢਿ ਰਹੇ ਹਮ ਮੂਚਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aan na samasar koaoo laagai dtoodt rahe ham moochaa |1| rahaau |
English: No one else is equal to Him - I have made the most extensive search on this. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਹੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਅਤਿ ਬਡੋ ਗਾਹਰੋ ਥਾਹ ਨਹੀ ਅਗਹੂਚਾ ॥
Transliteration: bahu beant at baddo gaaharo thaah nahee agahoochaa |
English: Utterly infinite, exceedingly great, deep and unfathomable - He is lofty, beyond reach.

Gurbani: ਤੋਲਿ ਨ ਤੁਲੀਐ ਮੋਲਿ ਨ ਮੁਲੀਐ ਕਤ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਨ ਰੂਚਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tol na tuleeai mol na muleeai kat paaeeai man roochaa |1|
English: His weight cannot be weighed, His value cannot be estimated. How can the Enticer of the mind be obtained? ||1||

Gurbani: ਖੋਜ ਅਸੰਖਾ ਅਨਿਕ ਤਪੰਥਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਨਹੀ ਪਹੂਚਾ ॥
Transliteration: khoj asankhaa anik tapanthaa bin gur nahee pahoochaa |
English: Millions search for Him, on various paths, but without the Guru, none find Him.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਰਸ ਭੂੰਚਾ ॥੨॥੧॥੩੨॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak kirapaa karee tthaakur mil saadhoo ras bhoonchaa |2|1|32|
English: Says Nanak, the Lord Master has become Merciful. Meeting the Holy Saint, I drink in the sublime essence. ||2||1||32||

[Ang 535 | Raag: Raag Dayv Gandhaaree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: devagandhaaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਰੀ ਕੋਊ ॥
Transliteration: mai bahu bidh pekhio doojaa naahee ree koaoo |
English: I have looked in so many ways, but there is no other like the Lord.

Gurbani: ਖੰਡ ਦੀਪ ਸਭ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਭ ਲੋਊ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: khandd deep sabh bheetar raviaa poor rahio sabh loaoo |1| rahaau |
English: On all the continents and islands, He is permeating and fully pervading; He is in all worlds. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੰਮਾ ਕਵਨ ਮਹਿੰਮਾ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਸੁਨਿ ਸੋਊ ॥
Transliteration: agam agamaa kavan mahinmaa man jeevai sun soaoo |
English: He is the most unfathomable of the unfathomable; who can chant His Praises? My mind lives by hearing news of Him.

Gurbani: ਚਾਰਿ ਆਸਰਮ ਚਾਰਿ ਬਰੰਨਾ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਏ ਸੇਵਤੋਊ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: chaar aasaram chaar baranaa mukat bhe sevatoaoo |1|
English: People in the four stages of life, and in the four social classes are liberated, by serving You, Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੁਤੀਅ ਗਏ ਸੁਖ ਹੋਊ ॥
Transliteration: gur sabad drirraaeaa param pad paaeaa duteea ge sukh hoaoo |
English: The Guru has implanted the Word of His Shabad within me; I have attained the supreme status. My sense of duality has been dispelled, and now, I am at peace.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ਸਹਜੋਊ ॥੨॥੨॥੩੩॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak bhav saagar tariaa har nidh paaee sahajoaoo |2|2|33|
English: Says Nanak, I have easily crossed over the terrifying world-ocean, obtaining the treasure of the Lord's Name. ||2||2||33||

[Ang 535 | Raag: Raag Dayv Gandhaaree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੬ ॥
Transliteration: raag devagandhaaree mahalaa 5 ghar 6 |
English: Raag Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl, Sixth House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਏਕੈ ਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੈ ਜਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: ekai re har ekai jaan |
English: Know that there is One and only One Lord.

Gurbani: ਏਕੈ ਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ekai re guramukh jaan |1| rahaau |
English: O Gurmukh, know that He is One. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਹਉ ਤੁਮ ਭ੍ਰਮਹੁ ਨ ਭਾਈ ਰਵਿਆ ਰੇ ਰਵਿਆ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਥਾਨ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kaahe bhramat hau tum bhramahu na bhaaee raviaa re raviaa srab thaan |1|
English: Why are you wandering around? O Siblings of Destiny, don't wander around; He is permeating and pervading everywhere. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਕਾਸਟ ਮਝਾਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਜਮ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jiau baisantar kaasatt majhaar bin sanjam nahee kaaraj saar |
English: As the fire in the forest, without control, cannot serve any purpose

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਨ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਕੋ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
Transliteration: bin gur na paavaigo har jee ko duaar |
English: just so, without the Guru, one cannot attain the Gate of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਤਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਏ ਹੈ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥੨॥੧॥੩੪॥
Transliteration: mil sangat taj abhimaan kahu naanak paae hai param nidhaan |2|1|34|
English: Joining the Society of the Saints, renounce your ego; says Nanak, in this way, the supreme treasure is obtained. ||2||1||34||

[Ang 535 | Raag: Raag Dayv Gandhaaree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: devagandhaaree 5 |
English: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਾਨੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਾਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaanee na jaaee taa kee gaat |1| rahaau |
English: His state cannot be known. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਹ ਪੇਖਾਰਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਿ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਬਿਸਮਨ ਬਿਸਮੇ ਕਹਨ ਕਹਾਤਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: keh pekhaarau hau kar chaturaaee bisaman bisame kehan kahaat |1|
English: How can I behold Him through clever tricks? Those who tell this story are wonder-struck and amazed. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਸਿਧ ਅਰੁ ਸਾਧਿਕ ॥
Transliteration: gan gandharab sidh ar saadhik |
English: The servants of God, the celestial singers, the Siddhas and the seekers,

Gurbani: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਦੇਵ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿਕ ॥
Transliteration: sur nar dev braham brahamaadik |
English: the angelic and divine beings, Brahma and those like Brahma,

Gurbani: ਚਤੁਰ ਬੇਦ ਉਚਰਤ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: chatur bed ucharat din raat |
English: and the four Vedas proclaim, day and night,

Gurbani: ਅਗਮ ਅਗਮ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਆਗਾਧਿ ॥
Transliteration: agam agam tthaakur aagaadh |
English: that the Lord and Master is inaccessible, unapproachable and unfathomable.

Gurbani: ਗੁਨ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਭਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਪਰੈ ਪਰਾਤਿ ॥੨॥੨॥੩੫॥
Transliteration: gun beant beant bhan naanak kehan na jaaee parai paraat |2|2|35|
English: Endless, endless are His Glories, says Nanak; they cannot be described - they are beyond our reach. ||2||2||35||

[Ang 535 | Raag: Raag Dayv Gandhaaree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: devagandhaaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਧਿਆਏ ਗਾਏ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: dhiaae gaae karanaihaar |
English: I meditate, and sing of the Creator Lord.

Gurbani: ਭਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਅਨਿਕ ਓਹੀ ਰੇ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhau naahee sukh sehaj anandaa anik ohee re ek samaar |1| rahaau |
English: I have become fearless, and I have found peace, poise and bliss, remembering the infinite Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਾਥੈ ॥
Transliteration: safal moorat gur merai maathai |
English: The Guru, of the most fruitful image, has placed His hand upon my forehead.

Gurbani: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਤਤ ਤਤ ਸਾਥੈ ॥
Transliteration: jat kat pekhau tat tat saathai |
English: Wherever I look, there, I find Him with me.

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: charan kamal mere praan adhaar |1|
English: The Lotus Feet of the Lord are the Support of my very breath of life. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਮਰਥ ਅਥਾਹ ਬਡਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: samarath athaah baddaa prabh meraa |
English: My God is all-powerful, unfathomable and utterly vast.

Gurbani: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਨੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt antar saahib neraa |
English: The Lord and Master is close at hand - He dwells in each and every heart.

Gurbani: ਤਾਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਆਸਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ ॥੨॥੩॥੩੬॥
Transliteration: taakee saran aasar prabh naanak jaa kaa ant na paaraavaar |2|3|36|
English: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary and the Support of God, who has no end or limitation. ||2||3||36||

[Ang 535 | Raag: Raag Dayv Gandhaaree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: devagandhaaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਉਲਟੀ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਉਲਟੀ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aulattee re man ulattee re |
English: Turn away, O my mind, turn away.

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤ ਸਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਉਲਟੀ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: saakat siau kar ulattee re |
English: Turn away from the faithless cynic.

Gurbani: ਝੂਠੈ ਕੀ ਰੇ ਝੂਠੁ ਪਰੀਤਿ ਛੁਟਕੀ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਛੁਟਕੀ ਰੇ ਸਾਕਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਛੁਟਕੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jhootthai kee re jhootth pareet chhuttakee re man chhuttakee re saakat sang na chhuttakee re |1| rahaau |
English: False is the love of the false one; break the ties, O my mind, and your ties shall be broken. Break your ties with the faithless cynic. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਕਾਜਰ ਭਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਜੋ ਪੈਸੈ ਕਾਲੂਖੀ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jiau kaajar bhar mandar raakhio jo paisai kaalookhee re |
English: One who enters a house filled with soot is blackened.

Gurbani: ਦੂਰਹੁ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਭਾਗਿ ਗਇਓ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਛੁਟਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: doorahu hee te bhaag geo hai jis gur mil chhuttakee trikuttee re |1|
English: Run far away from such people! One who meets the Guru escapes from the bondage of the three dispositions. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਾਗਉ ਦਾਨੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੁਖੁ ਸਾਕਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਜੁਟਸੀ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: maagau daan kripaal kripaa nidh meraa mukh saakat sang na juttasee re |
English: I beg this blessing of You, O Merciful Lord, ocean of mercy - please, don't bring me face to face with the faithless cyincs.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸ ਕੋ ਕਰੀਅਹੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੂੰਡੁ ਸਾਧ ਪਗਾ ਹੇਠਿ ਰੁਲਸੀ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੪॥੩੭॥
Transliteration: jan naanak daas daas ko kareeahu meraa moondd saadh pagaa hetth rulasee re |2|4|37|
English: Make servant Nanak the slave of Your slave; let his head roll in the dust under the feet of the Holy. ||2||4||37||

[Ang 536 | Raag: Raag Dayv Gandhaaree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੭ ॥
Transliteration: raag devagandhaaree mahalaa 5 ghar 7 |
English: Raag Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl, Seventh House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਦਿਨ ਕੇ ਸਮਰਥ ਪੰਥ ਬਿਠੁਲੇ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sabh din ke samarath panth bitthule hau bal bal jaau |
English: You are all-powerful, at all times; You show me the Way; I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to You.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਨ ਭਾਵਨ ਸੰਤਨ ਤੋਰੈ ਚਰਨ ਉਵਾ ਕੈ ਪਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gaavan bhaavan santan torai charan uvaa kai paau |1| rahaau |
English: Your Saints sing to You with love; I fall at their feet. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਾਸਨ ਬਾਸਨ ਸਹਜ ਕੇਲ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਏਕ ਅਨੰਤ ਅਨੂਪੈ ਠਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jaasan baasan sehaj kel karunaa mai ek anant anoopai tthaau |1|
English: O Praiseworthy Lord, Enjoyer of celestial peace, Embodiment of mercy, One Infinite Lord, Your place is so beautiful. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਕਰ ਤਲ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਨਾਥ ਅਨੇਕੈ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ridh sidh nidh kar tal jagajeevan srab naath anekai naau |
English: Riches, supernatural spiritual powers and wealth are in the palm of Your hand. O Lord, Life of the World, Master of all, infinite is Your Name.

Gurbani: ਦਇਆ ਮਇਆ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਜਸੁ ਜੀਵਾਉ ॥੨॥੧॥੩੮॥੬॥੪੪॥
Transliteration: deaa meaa kirapaa naanak kau sun sun jas jeevaau |2|1|38|6|44|
English: Show Kindness, Mercy and Compassion to Nanak; hearing Your Praises, I live. ||2||1||38||6||44||

[Ang 536 | Raag: Raag Dayv Gandhaaree | Author: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: raag devagandhaaree mahalaa 9 |
English: Raag Dayv-Gandhaaree, Ninth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਯਹ ਮਨੁ ਨੈਕ ਨ ਕਹਿਓ ਕਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: yeh man naik na kahio karai |
English: This mind does not follow my advice one tiny bit.

Gurbani: ਸੀਖ ਸਿਖਾਇ ਰਹਿਓ ਅਪਨੀ ਸੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਤੇ ਨ ਟਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: seekh sikhaae rahio apanee see duramat te na ttarai |1| rahaau |
English: I am so tired of giving it instructions - it will not refrain from its evil-mindedness. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਦਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਭਇਓ ਬਾਵਰੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਨਹਿ ਉਚਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: mad maaeaa kai bheo baavaro har jas neh ucharai |
English: It has gone insane with the intoxication of Maya; it does not chant the Lord's Praise.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਜਗਤ ਕਉ ਡਹਕੈ ਅਪਨੋ ਉਦਰੁ ਭਰੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kar parapanch jagat kau ddahakai apano udar bharai |1|
English: Practicing deception, it tries to cheat the world, and so it fills its belly. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁਆਨ ਪੂਛ ਜਿਉ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਸੂਧੋ ਕਹਿਓ ਨ ਕਾਨ ਧਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: suaan poochh jiau hoe na soodho kahio na kaan dharai |
English: Like a dog's tail, it cannot be straightened; it will not listen to what I tell it.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਜੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਤ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਕਾਜੁ ਸਰੈ ॥੨॥੧॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak bhaj raam naam nit jaa te kaaj sarai |2|1|
English: Says Nanak, vibrate forever the Name of the Lord, and all your affairs shall be adjusted. ||2||1||

[Ang 536 | Raag: Raag Dayv Gandhaaree | Author: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji]
Gurbani: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: devagandhaaree mahalaa 9 |
English: Raag Dayv-Gandhaaree, Ninth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਜੀਵਤ ਕੋ ਬਿਵਹਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh jeevat ko bivahaar |
English: All things are mere diversions of life:

Gurbani: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪ ਅਰੁ ਫੁਨਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਕੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: maat pitaa bhaaee sut bandhap ar fun grih kee naar |1| rahaau |
English: mother, father, siblings, children, relatives and the wife of your home. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤਨ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਹੋਤ ਜਬ ਨਿਆਰੇ ਟੇਰਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਤਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: tan te praan hot jab niaare tterat pret pukaar |
English: When the soul is separated from the body, then they will cry out, calling you a ghost.

Gurbani: ਆਧ ਘਰੀ ਕੋਊ ਨਹਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਘਰ ਤੇ ਦੇਤ ਨਿਕਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aadh gharee koaoo neh raakhai ghar te det nikaar |1|
English: No one will let you stay, for even half an hour; they drive you out of the house. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਿਉ ਜਗ ਰਚਨਾ ਯਹ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਿਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: mrig trisanaa jiau jag rachanaa yeh dekhahu ridai bichaar |
English: The created world is like an illusion, a mirage - see this, and reflect upon it in your mind.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਜੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਤ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਹੋਤ ਉਧਾਰ ॥੨॥੨॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak bhaj raam naam nit jaa te hot udhaar |2|2|
English: Says Nanak, vibrate forever the Name of the Lord, which shall deliver you. ||2||2||

[Ang 536 | Raag: Raag Dayv Gandhaaree | Author: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji]
Gurbani: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: devagandhaaree mahalaa 9 |
English: Raag Dayv-Gandhaaree, Ninth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਗਤ ਮੈ ਝੂਠੀ ਦੇਖੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: jagat mai jhootthee dekhee preet |
English: In this world, I have seen love to be false.

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖ ਸਿਉ ਸਭ ਲਾਗੇ ਕਿਆ ਦਾਰਾ ਕਿਆ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: apane hee sukh siau sabh laage kiaa daaraa kiaa meet |1| rahaau |
English: Whether they are spouses or friends, all are concerned only with their own happiness. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਉ ਮੇਰਉ ਸਭੈ ਕਹਤ ਹੈ ਹਿਤ ਸਿਉ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਚੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: merau merau sabhai kehat hai hit siau baadhio cheet |
English: All say, "Mine, mine", and attach their consciousness to you with love.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਸੰਗੀ ਨਹ ਕੋਊ ਇਹ ਅਚਰਜ ਹੈ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ant kaal sangee neh koaoo ih acharaj hai reet |1|
English: But at the very last moment, none shall go along with you. How strange are the ways of the world! ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮੂਰਖ ਅਜਹੂ ਨਹ ਸਮਝਤ ਸਿਖ ਦੈ ਹਾਰਿਓ ਨੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: man moorakh ajahoo neh samajhat sikh dai haario neet |
English: The foolish mind has not yet reformed itself, although I have grown weary of continually instructing it.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰੈ ਜਉ ਗਾਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਗੀਤ ॥੨॥੩॥੬॥੩੮॥੪੭॥
Transliteration: naanak bhaujal paar parai jau gaavai prabh ke geet |2|3|6|38|47|
English: O Nanak, one crosses over the terrifying world-ocean, singing the Songs of God. ||2||3||6||38||47||

[Ang 537 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirbhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibhan gur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਹਾਗੜਾ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: raag bihaagarraa chaupade mahalaa 5 ghar 2 |
English: Raag Bihaagraa, Chau-Padhay, Fifth Mehl, Second House:

Gurbani: ਦੂਤਨ ਸੰਗਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: dootan sangareea |
English: To associate with your arch enemies,

Gurbani: ਭੁਇਅੰਗਨਿ ਬਸਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: bhueiangan basareea |
English: is to live with poisonous snakes;

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਉਪਰੀਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: anik upareea |1|
English: I have made the effort to shake them off. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: tau mai har har kareea |
English: Then, I repeated the Name of the Lord, Har, Har,

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tau sukh sahajareea |1| rahaau |
English: and I obtained celestial peace. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਿਥਨ ਮੋਹਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: mithan mohareea |
English: False is the love

Gurbani: ਅਨ ਕਉ ਮੇਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: an kau mereea |
English: Of the many emotional attachments,

Gurbani: ਵਿਚਿ ਘੂਮਨ ਘਿਰੀਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: vich ghooman ghireea |2|
English: which suck the mortal into the whirlpool of reincarnation. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਬਟਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: sagal battareea |
English: All are travellers,

Gurbani: ਬਿਰਖ ਇਕ ਤਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: birakh ik tareea |
English: who have gathered under the world-tree,

Gurbani: ਬਹੁ ਬੰਧਹਿ ਪਰੀਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bahu bandheh pareea |3|
English: and are bound by their many bonds. ||3||

Gurbani: ਥਿਰੁ ਸਾਧ ਸਫਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: thir saadh safareea |
English: Eternal is the Company of the Holy,

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: jeh keeratan hareea |
English: where the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises are sung.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਰੀਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak saranareea |4|1|
English: Nanak seeks this Sanctuary. ||4||1||

[Ang 537 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਹਾਗੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: raag bihaagarraa mahalaa 9 |
English: Raag Bihaagraa, Ninth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਨਹਿ ਕੋਊ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: har kee gat neh koaoo jaanai |
English: No one knows the state of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜੋਗੀ ਜਤੀ ਤਪੀ ਪਚਿ ਹਾਰੇ ਅਰੁ ਬਹੁ ਲੋਗ ਸਿਆਨੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jogee jatee tapee pach haare ar bahu log siaane |1| rahaau |
English: The Yogis, the celibates, the penitents, and all sorts of clever people have failed. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਛਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਉ ਰੰਕ ਕਉ ਕਰਈ ਰਾਉ ਰੰਕ ਕਰਿ ਡਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: chhin meh raau rank kau karee raau rank kar ddaare |
English: In an instant, He changes the beggar into a king, and the king into a beggar.

Gurbani: ਰੀਤੇ ਭਰੇ ਭਰੇ ਸਖਨਾਵੈ ਯਹ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਬਿਵਹਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: reete bhare bhare sakhanaavai yeh taa ko bivahaare |1|
English: He fills what is empty, and empties what is full - such are His ways. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਆਪਿ ਪਸਾਰੀ ਆਪਹਿ ਦੇਖਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: apanee maaeaa aap pasaaree aapeh dekhanahaaraa |
English: He Himself spread out the expanse of His Maya, and He Himself beholds it.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਧਰੇ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਆਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanaa roop dhare bahu rangee sabh te rahai niaaraa |2|
