English: Prays Nanak, without the Name of the Lord, so many have departed with regret. ||3||

Gurbani: ਧਾਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੋ ਅਪਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: dhaar anugraho apanaa kar leenaa raam |
English: Showering His blessings, the Lord has made me His own.

Gurbani: ਭੁਜਾ ਗਹਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੀਓ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਦੀਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: bhujaa geh kaadt leeo saadhoo sang deenaa raam |
English: Grasping me by the arm, He has pulled me out of the mud, and He has blessed me with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਰਾਧੇ ਸਗਲ ਕਲਮਲ ਦੁਖ ਜਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasangam har araadhe sagal kalamal dukh jale |
English: Worshipping the Lord in the Saadh Sangat, all my sins and sufferings are burnt away.

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਧਰਮ ਸੁਦਾਨ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਸੇ ਚਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: mahaa dharam sudaan kiriaa sang terai se chale |
English: This is the greatest religion, and the best act of charity; this alone shall go along with you.

Gurbani: ਰਸਨਾ ਅਰਾਧੈ ਏਕੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਭੀਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: rasanaa araadhai ek suaamee har naam man tan bheenaa |
English: My tongue chants in adoration the Name of the One Lord and Master; my mind and body are drenched in the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਸੋ ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਬੀਨਾ ॥੪॥੬॥੯॥
Transliteration: naanak jis no har milaae so sarab gun parabeenaa |4|6|9|
English: O Nanak, whoever the Lord unites with Himself, is filled with all virtues. ||4||6||9||

[Ang 548 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਹਾਗੜੇ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: bihaagarre kee vaar mahalaa 4 |
English: Vaar Of Bihaagraa, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਹੋਰ ਥੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: gur sevaa te sukh paaeeai hor thai sukh na bhaal |
English: Serving the Guru, peace is obtained; do not search for peace anywhere else.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਭੇਦੀਐ ਸਦਾ ਵਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad man bhedeeai sadaa vasai har naal |
English: The soul is pierced by the Word of the Guru's Shabad. The Lord dwells ever with the soul.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak naam tinaa kau milai jin har vekhai nadar nihaal |1|
English: O Nanak, they alone obtain the Naam, the Name of the Lord, who are blessed by the Lord with His Glance of Grace. ||1||

[Ang 548 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਿਫਤਿ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਬਖਸ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੈ ਸੋ ਖਰਚੈ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sifat khajaanaa bakhas hai jis bakhasai so kharachai khaae |
English: The treasure of the Lord's Praise is such a blessed gift; he alone obtains it to spend, unto whom the Lord bestows it.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਸਭ ਥਕੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur bin hath na aavee sabh thake karam kamaae |
English: Without the True Guru, it does not come to hand; all have grown weary of performing religious rituals.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਧਨਹੀਣੁ ਹੈ ਅਗੈ ਭੁਖਾ ਕਿ ਖਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak manamukh jagat dhanaheen hai agai bhukhaa ki khaae |2|
English: O Nanak, the self-willed manmukhs of the world lack this wealth; when they are hungry in the next world, what will they have to eat there? ||2||

[Ang 548 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਸਭਸ ਦਾ ਸਭ ਤੁਧੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabh teree too sabhas daa sabh tudh upaaeaa |
English: All are Yours, and You belong to all. You created all.

Gurbani: ਸਭਨਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਤੂ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਤੂ ਸਭਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabhanaa vich too varatadaa too sabhanee dhiaaeaa |
English: You are pervading within all - all meditate on You.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਤੂ ਭਗਤਿ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਇਹਿ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tis dee too bhagat thaae paaeihi jo tudh man bhaaeaa |
English: You accept the devotional worship of those who are pleasing to Your Mind.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਸਭਿ ਕਰਨਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jo har prabh bhaavai so theeai sabh karan teraa karaaeaa |
English: Whatever pleases the Lord God happens; all act as You cause them to act.

Gurbani: ਸਲਾਹਿਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਤੇ ਵਡਾ ਜੋ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾਂ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਦਾ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: salaahihu har sabhanaa te vaddaa jo sant janaan kee paij rakhadaa aaeaa |1|
English: Praise the Lord, the greatest of all; He preserves the honor of the Saints. ||1||

[Ang 548 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਗੁ ਜੀਤਾ ਜਗਿ ਜੀਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak giaanee jag jeetaa jag jeetaa sabh koe |
English: O Nanak, the spiritually wise one has conquered all others.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਿਧਿ ਹੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: naame kaaraj sidh hai sahaje hoe su hoe |
English: Through the Name, his affairs are brought to perfection; whatever happens is by His Will.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਅਚਲੁ ਹੈ ਚਲਾਇ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramat mat achal hai chalaae na sakai koe |
English: Under Guru's Instruction, his mind is held steady; no one can make him waver.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਾ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhagataa kaa har angeekaar kare kaaraj suhaavaa hoe |
English: The Lord makes His devotee His own, and his affairs are adjusted.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂਲਹੁ ਭੁਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh moolahu bhulaaeian vich lab lobh ahankaar |
English: The self-willed manmukhs have been led astray from the very beginning; within them lurks greed, avarice and ego.

Gurbani: ਝਗੜਾ ਕਰਦਿਆ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਦਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਕਰੈ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jhagarraa karadiaa anadin gudarai sabad na karai veechaar |
English: Their nights and days pass in argument, and they do not reflect upon the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸੁਧਿ ਮਤਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਹਿਰਿ ਲਈ ਬੋਲਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sudh mat karatai hir lee bolan sabh vikaar |
English: The Creator has taken away their subtle intellect, and all their speech is corrupt.

Gurbani: ਦਿਤੈ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਅਨਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਗੵਾਨੁ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: ditai kitai na santokheean antar trisanaa bahut agayaan andhaar |
English: No matter what they are given, they are not satisfied; within them is desire, and the great darkness of ignorance.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਨਾਲਹੁ ਤੁਟੀਆ ਭਲੀ ਜਿਨਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak manamukhaa naalahu tutteea bhalee jinaa maaeaa mohi piaar |1|
English: O Nanak, it is right to break with the self-willed manmukhs; to them, the love of Maya is sweet. ||1||

[Ang 549 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤਿਨੑ ਭਉ ਸੰਸਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: tina bhau sansaa kiaa kare jin satigur sir karataar |
English: What can fear and doubt do to those, who have given their heads to the Creator, and to the True Guru?

Gurbani: ਧੁਰਿ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਰਖਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: dhur tin kee paij rakhadaa aape rakhanahaar |
English: He who has preserved honor from the beginning of time, He shall preserve their honor as well.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: mil preetam sukh paaeaa sachai sabad veechaar |
English: Meeting their Beloved, they find peace; they reflect upon the True Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਆਪੇ ਪਰਖਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak sukhadaataa seviaa aape parakhanahaar |2|
English: O Nanak, I serve the Giver of Peace; He Himself is the Assessor. ||2||

[Ang 549 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰਿਆ ਤੂ ਸਭਨਾ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jant sabh teriaa too sabhanaa raas |
English: All beings are Yours; You are the wealth of all.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਕੋਈ ਹੋਰੁ ਸਰੀਕੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: jis no too dehi tis sabh kichh milai koee hor sareek naahee tudh paas |
English: One unto whom You give, obtains everything; there is no one else to rival You.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਇਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭਸ ਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਹਿ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: too iko daataa sabhas daa har peh aradaas |
English: You alone are the Great Giver of all; I offer my prayer unto You, Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਦੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਤੂ ਮੰਨਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: jis dee tudh bhaavai tis dee too man laihi so jan saabaas |
English: One with whom You are pleased, is accepted by You; how blessed is such a person!

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਚੋਜੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sabh teraa choj varatadaa dukh sukh tudh paas |2|
English: Your wondrous play is pervading everywhere. I place my pain and pleasure before You. ||2||

[Ang 549 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੈ ਭਾਵਦੇ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh sachai bhaavade dar sachai sachiaar |
English: The Gurmukhs are pleasing to the True Lord; they are judged to be true in the True Court.

Gurbani: ਸਾਜਨ ਮਨਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: saajan man aanand hai gur kaa sabad veechaar |
English: The minds of such friends are filled with bliss, as they reflect upon the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਟਿਆ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: antar sabad vasaaeaa dukh kattiaa chaanan keea karataar |
English: They enshrine the Shabad within their hearts; their pain is dispelled, and the Creator blesses them with the Divine Light.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਖਣਹਾਰਾ ਰਖਸੀ ਆਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak rakhanahaaraa rakhasee aapanee kirapaa dhaar |1|
English: O Nanak, the Savior Lord shall save them, and shower them with His Mercy. ||1||

[Ang 549 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਭੈ ਰਚਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur kee sevaa chaakaree bhai rach kaar kamaae |
English: Serve the Guru, and wait upon Him; as you work, maintain the Fear of God.

Gurbani: ਜੇਹਾ ਸੇਵੈ ਤੇਹੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੇ ਚਲੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jehaa sevai teho hovai je chalai tisai rajaae |
English: As you serve Him, you will become like Him, as you walk according to His Will.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜੀ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak sabh kichh aap hai avar na doojee jaae |2|
English: O Nanak, He Himself is everything; there is no other place to go. ||2||

[Ang 549 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਤੂਹੈ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: teree vaddiaaee toohai jaanadaa tudh jevadd avar na koee |
English: You alone know Your greatness - no one else is as great as You.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਸਰੀਕੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: tudh jevadd hor sareek hovai taa aakheeai tudh jevadd toohai hoee |
English: If there were some other rival as great as You, then I would speak of him. You alone are as great as You are.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹੋਰੁ ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਰੀਸ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jin too seviaa tin sukh paaeaa hor tis dee rees kare kiaa koee |
English: One who serves You obtains peace; who else can compare to You?

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਭੰਨਣ ਘੜਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਹਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਅਗੈ ਮੰਗਣ ਨੋ ਹਥ ਜੋੜਿ ਖਲੀ ਸਭ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: too bhanan gharran samarath daataar heh tudh agai mangan no hath jorr khalee sabh hoee |
English: You are all-powerful to destroy and create, O Great Giver; with palms pressed together, all stand begging before You.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਮੈ ਕੋਈ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਭਸੈ ਨੋ ਦਾਨੁ ਦਿਤਾ ਖੰਡੀ ਵਰਭੰਡੀ ਪਾਤਾਲੀ ਪੁਰਈ ਸਭ ਲੋਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tudh jevadd daataar mai koee nadar na aavee tudh sabhasai no daan ditaa khanddee varabhanddee paataalee puree sabh loee |3|
English: I see none as great as You, O Great Giver; You give in charity to the beings of all the continents, worlds, solar systems, nether regions and universes. ||3||

[Ang 549 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਈਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਭਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: man parateet na aaeea sehaj na lago bhaau |
English: O mind, you have no faith, and you have not embraced love for the Celestial Lord;

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੈ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabadai saad na paaeo manahatth kiaa gun gaae |
English: you do not enjoy the sublime taste of the Word of the Shabad - what Praises of the Lord will you stubborn-mindedly sing?

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਇਆ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak aaeaa so paravaan hai ji guramukh sach samaae |1|
English: O Nanak, his coming alone is approved, who, as Gurmukh, merges into the True Lord. ||1||

[Ang 549 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਮੂੜਾ ਅਵਰਾ ਆਖਿ ਦੁਖਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aapanaa aap na pachhaanai moorraa avaraa aakh dukhaae |
English: The fool does not understand his own self; he annoys others with his speech.

Gurbani: ਮੁੰਢੈ ਦੀ ਖਸਲਤਿ ਨ ਗਈਆ ਅੰਧੇ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: mundtai dee khasalat na geea andhe vichhurr chottaa khaae |
English: His underlying nature does not leave him; separated from the Lord, he suffers cruel blows.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭੈ ਭੰਨਿ ਨ ਘੜਿਓ ਰਹੈ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: satigur kai bhai bhan na gharrio rahai ank samaae |
English: Through the fear of the True Guru, he has not changed and reformed himself, so that he might merge in the lap of God.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਹਸਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: anadin sahasaa kade na chookai bin sabadai dukh paae |
English: Night and day, his doubts never stop; without the Word of the Shabad, he suffers in pain.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਲਾ ਨਿਤ ਧੰਧਾ ਕਰਤ ਵਿਹਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh lobh antar sabalaa nit dhandhaa karat vihaae |
English: Sexual desire, anger and greed are so powerful within him; he passes his life constantly entangled in worldly affairs.

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਕਰ ਦੇਖਤ ਸੁਣਿ ਥਕੇ ਦਿਹ ਮੁਕੇ ਨੇੜੈ ਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: charan kar dekhat sun thake dih muke nerrai aae |
English: His feet, hands, eyes and ears are exhausted; his days are numbered, and his death is immanent.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਮੀਠਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa naam na lago meetthaa jit naam nav nidh paae |
English: The True Name does not seem sweet to him - the Name by which the nine treasures are obtained.

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਮਰੈ ਫੁਨਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਮੋਖੰਤਰੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jeevat marai marai fun jeevai taan mokhantar paae |
English: But if he remains dead while yet alive, then by so dying, he truly lives; thus, he attains liberation.

Gurbani: ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਪਰਾਣੀ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕਿਆ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: dhur karam na paaeo paraanee vin karamaa kiaa paae |
English: But if he is not blessed with such pre-ordained karma, then without this karma, what can he obtain?

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਤੂ ਮੂੜੇ ਗਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਸਬਦੇ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa sabad samaal too moorre gat mat sabade paae |
English: Meditate in remembrance on the Word of the Guru's Shabad, you fool; through the Shabad, you shall obtain salvation and wisdom.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਦ ਹੀ ਪਾਏ ਜਾਂ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak satigur tad hee paae jaan vichahu aap gavaae |2|
English: O Nanak, he alone finds the True Guru, who eliminates self-conceit from within. ||2||

[Ang 550 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਦੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਉ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਕਿਸੈ ਗਲੈ ਦਾ ਲੋੜੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: jis dai chit vasiaa meraa suaamee tis no kiau andesaa kisai galai daa lorreeai |
English: One whose consciousness is filled with my Lord Master - why should he feel anxious about anything?

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸਭਨਾ ਗਲਾ ਕਾ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਧਿਆਇਦਿਆ ਕਿਵ ਨਿਮਖ ਘੜੀ ਮੁਹੁ ਮੋੜੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: har sukhadaataa sabhanaa galaa kaa tis no dhiaaeidiaa kiv nimakh gharree muhu morreeai |
English: The Lord is the Giver of Peace, the Lord of all things; why would we turn our faces away from His meditation, even for a moment, or an instant?

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਹੋਏ ਨਿਤ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਾਇ ਬਹੀਐ ਮੁਹੁ ਜੋੜੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: jin har dhiaaeaa tis no sarab kaliaan hoe nit sant janaa kee sangat jaae baheeai muhu jorreeai |
English: One who meditates on the Lord obtains all pleasures and comforts; let us go each and every day, to sit in the Saints' Society.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਰੋਗ ਗਏ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋੜੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: sabh dukh bhukh rog ge har sevak ke sabh jan ke bandhan torreeai |
English: All the pain, hunger, and disease of the Lord's servant are eradicated; the bonds of the humble beings are torn away.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹੋਆ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਡਿਠੈ ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਲੋੜੀਐ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: har kirapaa te hoaa har bhagat har bhagat janaa kai muhi dditthai jagat tariaa sabh lorreeai |4|
English: By the Lord's Grace, one becomes the Lord's devotee; beholding the face of the Lord's humble devotee, the whole world is saved and carried across. ||4||

[Ang 550 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਰਸਨਾ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਉ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸੁਆਉ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: saa rasanaa jal jaau jin har kaa suaau na paaeaa |
English: Let that tongue, which has not tasted the Name of the Lord, be burnt.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਸਨਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਸਾਇ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak rasanaa sabad rasaae jin har har man vasaaeaa |1|
English: O Nanak, one whose mind is filled with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har - his tongue savors the Word of the Shabad. ||1||

[Ang 550 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਰਸਨਾ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਉ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: saa rasanaa jal jaau jin har kaa naau visaariaa |
English: Let that tongue, which has forgotten the Name of the Lord, be burnt.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh rasanaa har japai har kai naae piaariaa |2|
English: O Nanak, the tongue of the Gurmukh chants the Lord's Name, and loves the Name of the Lord. ||2||

[Ang 550 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: har aape tthaakur sevak bhagat har aape kare karaae |
English: The Lord Himself is the Master, the servant and the devotee; the Lord Himself is the Cause of causes.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਆਪੇ ਜਿਤੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: har aape vekhai vigasai aape jit bhaavai tith laae |
English: The Lord Himself beholds, and He Himself rejoices. As He wills, so does He enjoin us.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਇਕਨਾ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਇਕਨਾ ਉਝੜਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: har ikanaa maarag paae aape har ikanaa ujharr paae |
English: The Lord places some on the Path, and the Lord leads others into the wilderness.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਤਪਾਵਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਚਲਤ ਸਬਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: har sachaa saahib sach tapaavas kar vekhai chalat sabaae |
English: The Lord is the True Master; True is His justice. He arranges and beholds all His plays.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਹੈ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: gur parasaad kahai jan naanak har sache ke gun gaae |5|
English: By Guru's Grace, servant Nanak speaks and sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord. ||5||

[Ang 550 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦਰਵੇਸੀ ਕੋ ਜਾਣਸੀ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋ ਦਰਵੇਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: daravesee ko jaanasee viralaa ko daraves |
English: How rare is the dervish, the Saintly renunciate, who understands renunciation.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਹੰਢੈ ਮੰਗਦਾ ਧਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਧਿਗੁ ਵੇਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: je ghar ghar handtai mangadaa dhig jeevan dhig ves |
English: Cursed is the life, and cursed are the clothes, of one who wanders around, begging from door to door.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਆਸਾ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਤਜਿ ਰਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਿਖਿਆ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: je aasaa andesaa taj rahai guramukh bhikhiaa naau |
English: But, if he abandons hope and anxiety, and as Gurmukh receives the Name as his charity,

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਲੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tis ke charan pakhaaleeeh naanak hau balihaarai jaau |1|
English: then Nanak washes his feet, and is a sacrifice to him. ||1||

[Ang 550 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਰਵਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਫਲੁ ਦੁਇ ਪੰਖੇਰੂ ਆਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: naanak taravar ek fal due pankheroo aaeh |
English: O Nanak, the tree has one fruit, but two birds are perched upon it.

Gurbani: ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਨ ਦੀਸਹੀ ਨਾ ਪਰ ਪੰਖੀ ਤਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: aavat jaat na deesahee naa par pankhee taeh |
English: They are not seen coming or going; these birds have no wings.

Gurbani: ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਿਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: bahu rangee ras bhogiaa sabad rahai nirabaan |
English: One enjoys so many pleasures, while the other, through the Word of the Shabad, remains in Nirvaanaa.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਫਲਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਕਰਮਿ ਸਚਾ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har ras fal raate naanakaa karam sachaa neesaan |2|
English: Imbued with the subtle essence of the fruit of the Lord's Name, O Nanak, the soul bears the True Insignia of God's Grace. ||2||

[Ang 550 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਆਪੇ ਹੈ ਰਾਹਕੁ ਆਪਿ ਜੰਮਾਇ ਪੀਸਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: aape dharatee aape hai raahak aap jamaae peesaavai |
English: He Himself is the field, and He Himself is the farmer. He Himself grows and grinds the corn.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਪਕਾਵੈ ਆਪਿ ਭਾਂਡੇ ਦੇਇ ਪਰੋਸੈ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਬਹਿ ਖਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: aap pakaavai aap bhaandde dee parosai aape hee beh khaavai |
English: He Himself cooks it, He Himself puts the food in the dishes, and He Himself sits down to eat.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਜਲੁ ਆਪੇ ਦੇ ਛਿੰਗਾ ਆਪੇ ਚੁਲੀ ਭਰਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: aape jal aape de chhingaa aape chulee bharaavai |
English: He Himself is the water, He Himself gives the tooth-pick, and He Himself offers the mouthwash.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਦਿ ਬਹਾਲੈ ਆਪੇ ਵਿਦਾ ਕਰਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: aape sangat sad bahaalai aape vidaa karaavai |
English: He Himself calls and seats the congregation, and He Himself bids them goodbye.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਵੈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: jis no kirapaal hovai har aape tis no hukam manaavai |6|
English: One whom the Lord Himself blesses with His Mercy - the Lord causes him to walk according to His Will. ||6||

[Ang 551 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਸਭਿ ਬੰਧਨਾ ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਸਨਬੰਧੁ ॥
Transliteration: karam dharam sabh bandhanaa paap pun sanabandh |
English: Rituals and religions are all just entanglements; bad and good are bound up with them.

Gurbani: ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਸੁ ਬੰਧਨਾ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਸੁ ਧੰਧੁ ॥
Transliteration: mamataa mohu su bandhanaa putr kalatr su dhandh |
English: Those things done for the sake of children and spouse, in ego and attachment, are just more bonds.

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਜੇਵਰੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਸਨਬੰਧੁ ॥
Transliteration: jeh dekhaa teh jevaree maaeaa kaa sanabandh |
English: Wherever I look, there I see the noose of attachment to Maya.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਵਰਤਣਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਅੰਧੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak sache naam bin varatan varatai andh |1|
English: O Nanak, without the True Name, the world is engrossed in blind entanglements. ||1||

[Ang 551 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 4 |
English: Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅੰਧੇ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਤਾ ਥੀਐ ਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: andhe chaanan taa theeai jaa satigur milai rajaae |
English: The blind receive the Divine Light, when they merge with the Will of the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋੜੈ ਸਚਿ ਵਸੈ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅਧੇਰਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bandhan torrai sach vasai agiaan adheraa jaae |
English: They break their bonds, and dwell in Truth, and the darkness of ignorance is dispelled.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਜਿ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh dekhai tisai kaa jin keea tan saaj |
English: They see that everything belongs to the One who created and fashioned the body.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਕਰਤਾਰ ਕੀ ਕਰਤਾ ਰਾਖੈ ਲਾਜ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak saran karataar kee karataa raakhai laaj |2|
English: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Creator - the Creator preserves his honor. ||2||

[Ang 551 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਜਦਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਥਾਟੁ ਕੀਆ ਬਹਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਤਦਹੁ ਪੁਛਿ ਨ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਬੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: jadahu aape thaatt keea beh karatai tadahu puchh na sevak beea |
English: When the Creator, sitting all by Himself, created the Universe, he did not consult with any of His servants;

Gurbani: ਤਦਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਲੇਵੈ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਜਾਂ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: tadahu kiaa ko levai kiaa ko devai jaan avar na doojaa keea |
English: so what can anyone take, and what can anyone give, when He did not create any other like Himself?

Gurbani: ਫਿਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਕਰਤੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਉ ਦੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: fir aape jagat upaaeaa karatai daan sabhanaa kau deea |
English: Then, after fashioning the world, the Creator blessed all with His blessings.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵ ਬਣਾਈਅਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: aape sev banaaeean guramukh aape amrit peea |
English: He Himself instructs us in His service, and as Gurmukh, we drink in His Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਥੀਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: aap nirankaar aakaar hai aape aape karai su theea |7|
English: He Himself is formless, and He Himself is formed; whatever He Himself does, comes to pass. ||7||

[Ang 551 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਦ ਸਾਚਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh prabh seveh sad saachaa anadin sehaj piaar |
English: The Gurmukhs serve God forever; night and day, they are steeped in the Love of the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਚੇ ਅਰਧਿ ਉਰਧਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa anand gaaveh gun saache aradh uradh ur dhaar |
English: They are in bliss forever, singing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord; in this world and in the next, they keep Him clasped to their hearts.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: antar preetam vasiaa dhur karam likhiaa karataar |
English: Their Beloved dwells deep within; the Creator pre-ordained this destiny.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak aap milaaeian aape kirapaa dhaar |1|
English: O Nanak, He blends them into Himself; He Himself showers His Mercy upon them. ||1||

[Ang 551 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਹਿਐ ਕਥਿਐ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kahiai kathiai na paaeeai anadin rahai sadaa gun gaae |
English: By merely talking and speaking, He is not found. Night and day, sing His Glorious Praises continually.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਭਉਕਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: vin karamai kinai na paaeo bhauk mue bilalaae |
English: Without His Merciful Grace, no one finds Him; many have died barking and bewailing.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਭਿਜੈ ਆਪਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad man tan bhijai aap vasai man aae |
English: When the mind and body are saturated with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord Himself comes to dwell in his mind.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak nadaree paaeeai aape le milaae |2|
English: O Nanak, by His Grace, He is found; He unites us in His Union. ||2||

[Ang 551 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਸਭਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਆਪਿ ਕਥੈ ਆਪਿ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: aape ved puraan sabh saasat aap kathai aap bheejai |
English: He Himself is the Vedas, the Puraanas and all the Shaastras; He Himself chants them, and He Himself is pleased.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਬਹਿ ਪੂਜੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: aape hee beh pooje karataa aap parapanch kareejai |
English: He Himself sits down to worship, and He Himself creates the world.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਪਰਵਿਰਤਿ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰਵਿਰਤੀ ਆਪੇ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: aap paravirat aap niraviratee aape akath katheejai |
English: He Himself is a householder, and He Himself is a renunciate; He Himself utters the Unutterable.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਵਰਤੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: aape pun sabh aap karaae aap alipat varateejai |
English: He Himself is all goodness, and He Himself causes us to act; He Himself remains detached.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: aape sukh dukh devai karataa aape bakhas kareejai |8|
English: He Himself grants pleasure and pain; the Creator Himself bestows His gifts. ||8||

[Ang 551 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੇਖਾ ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਜੋਰੁ ਛਡਿ ਤੂ ਭਉ ਕਰਿ ਝਲੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sekhaa andarahu jor chhadd too bhau kar jhal gavaae |
English: O Shaykh, abandon your cruel nature; live in the Fear of God and give up your madness.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭੈ ਕੇਤੇ ਨਿਸਤਰੇ ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai bhai kete nisatare bhai vich nirbhau paae |
English: Through the Fear of the Guru, many have been saved; in this fear, find the Fearless Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਕਠੋਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਭੇਦਿ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: man katthor sabad bhed toon saant vasai man aae |
English: Pierce your stone heart with the Word of the Shabad; let peace and tranquility come to abide in your mind.

Gurbani: ਸਾਂਤੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਸਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਪਾਏ ਥਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: saantee vich kaar kamaavanee saa khasam paae thaae |
English: If good deeds are done in this state of peace, they are approved by the Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਪੁਛਹੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak kaam krodh kinai na paaeo puchhahu giaanee jaae |1|
English: O Nanak, through sexual desire and anger, no one has ever found God - go, and ask any wise man. ||1||

[Ang 551 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh maaeaa mohu hai naam na lago piaar |
English: The self-willed manmukh is emotionally attached to Maya - he has no love for the Naam.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਕੂੜੁ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਰੇ ਆਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: koorr kamaavai koorr sangrahai koorr kare aahaar |
English: He practices falsehood, gathers in falsehood, and makes falsehood his sustenance.

Gurbani: ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਅੰਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਸਭੁ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: bikh maaeaa dhan sanch mareh ante hoe sabh chhaar |
English: He collects the poisonous wealth of Maya, and then dies; in the end, it is all reduced to ashes.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਸੁਚ ਸੰਜਮ ਕਰਹਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: karam dharam such sanjam kareh antar lobh vikaar |
English: He practices religious rituals, purity and austere self-discipline, but within, there is greed and corruption.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਥਾਇ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak ji manamukh kamaavai su thaae naa pavai darageh hoe khuaar |2|
English: O Nanak, whatever the self-willed manmukh does, is not acceptable; in the Court of the Lord, he is dishonored. ||2||

[Ang 552 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਖਾਣੀ ਆਪੇ ਬਾਣੀ ਆਪੇ ਖੰਡ ਵਰਭੰਡ ਕਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aape khaanee aape baanee aape khandd varabhandd kare |
English: He Himself created the four sources of creation, and He Himself fashioned speech; He Himself formed the worlds and solar systems.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਤਨ ਧਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aap samund aap hai saagar aape hee vich ratan dhare |
English: He Himself is the ocean, and He Himself is the sea; He Himself puts the pearls in it.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਲਹਾਏ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰੇ ਹਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aap lahaae kare jis kirapaa jis no guramukh kare hare |
English: By His Grace, the Lord enables the Gurmukh to find these pearls.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਆਪੇ ਖੇਵਟੁ ਆਪਿ ਤਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aape bhaujal aap hai bohithaa aape khevatt aap tare |
English: He Himself is the terrifying world-ocean, and He Himself is the boat; He Himself is the boatman, and He Himself ferries us across.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਤੁਝੈ ਸਰੇ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: aape kare karaae karataa avar na doojaa tujhai sare |9|
English: The Creator Himself acts, and causes us to act; no one else can equal You, Lord. ||9||

[Ang 552 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਫਲ ਹੈ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur kee sevaa safal hai je ko kare chit laae |
English: Fruitful is service to the True Guru, if one does so with a sincere mind.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: naam padaarath paaeeai achint vasai man aae |
English: The treasure of the Naam, is obtained, and the mind comes to be free of anxiety.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: janam maran dukh katteeai haumai mamataa jaae |
English: The pains of birth and death are eradicated, and the mind is rid of egotism and self-conceit.

Gurbani: ਉਤਮ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: autam padavee paaeeai sache rahai samaae |
English: One achieves the ultimate state, and remains absorbed in the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak poorab jin kau likhiaa tinaa satigur miliaa aae |1|
English: O Nanak, the True Guru comes and meets those who have such pre-ordained destiny. ||1||

[Ang 552 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: naam rataa satiguroo hai kalijug bohith hoe |
English: The True Guru is imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord; He is the boat in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਵੈ ਜਿਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh hovai su paar pavai jinaa andar sachaa soe |
English: One who becomes Gurmukh crosses over; the True Lord dwells within him.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: naam samaale naam sangrahai naame hee pat hoe |
English: He remembers the Naam, he gathers in the Naam, and he obtains honor through the Naam.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak satigur paaeaa karam paraapat hoe |2|
English: Nanak has found the True Guru; by His Grace, the Name is obtained. ||2||

[Ang 552 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਆਪਿ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਕੰਚਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape paaras aap dhaat hai aap keeton kanchan |
English: He Himself is the Philosopher's Stone, He Himself is the metal, and He Himself is transformed into gold.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਪਾਪ ਖੰਡਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape tthaakur sevak aape aape hee paap khanddan |
English: He Himself is the Lord and Master, He Himself is the servant, and He Himself is the Destroyer of sins.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਭਿ ਘਟ ਭੋਗਵੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਸਭੁ ਅੰਜਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape sabh ghatt bhogavai suaamee aape hee sabh anjan |
English: He Himself enjoys every heart; the Lord Master Himself is the basis of all illusion.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਬਿਬੇਕੁ ਆਪਿ ਸਭੁ ਬੇਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭੰਜਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: aap bibek aap sabh betaa aape guramukh bhanjan |
English: He Himself is the discerning one, and He Himself is the Knower of all; He Himself breaks the bonds of the Gurmukhs.

Gurbani: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਨ ਰਜੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਵਡਨੁ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: jan naanak saalaeh na rajai tudh karate too har sukhadaataa vaddan |10|
English: Servant Nanak is not satisfied by merely praising You, O Creator Lord; You are the Great Giver of peace. ||10||

[Ang 552 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 4 |
English: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਜੀਅ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨਾ ਜੇਤੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: bin satigur seve jeea ke bandhanaa jete karam kamaeh |
English: Without serving the True Guru, the deeds which are done are only chains binding the soul.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਠਵਰ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੀ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: bin satigur seve tthavar na paavahee mar jameh aaveh jaeh |
English: Without serving the True Guru, they find no place of rest. They die, only to be born again - they continue coming and going.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਫਿਕਾ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin satigur seve fikaa bolanaa naam na vasai man aae |
English: Without serving the True Guru, their speech is insipid. They do not enshrine the Naam, the Name of the Lord, in the mind.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਮੁਹਿ ਕਾਲੈ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak bin satigur seve jam pur badhe maareeeh muhi kaalai utth jaeh |1|
English: O Nanak, without serving the True Guru, they are bound and gagged, and beaten in the City of Death; they depart with blackened faces. ||1||

[Ang 552 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: eik satigur kee sevaa kareh chaakaree har naame lagai piaar |
English: Some wait upon and serve the True Guru; they embrace love for the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਕੁਲ ਕਾ ਕਰਨਿ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak janam savaaran aapanaa kul kaa karan udhaar |2|
English: O Nanak, they reform their lives, and redeem their generations as well. ||2||

[Ang 552 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਚਾਟਸਾਲ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਪਾਧਾ ਆਪੇ ਚਾਟੜੇ ਪੜਣ ਕਉ ਆਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: aape chaattasaal aap hai paadhaa aape chaattarre parran kau aane |
English: He Himself is the school, He Himself is the teacher, and He Himself brings the students to be taught.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਤਾ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਬਾਲਕ ਕਰੇ ਸਿਆਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: aape pitaa maataa hai aape aape baalak kare siaane |
English: He Himself is the father, He Himself is the mother, and He Himself makes the children wise.

Gurbani: ਇਕ ਥੈ ਪੜਿ ਬੁਝੈ ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਇਕ ਥੈ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਇਆਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: eik thai parr bujhai sabh aape ik thai aape kare eaane |
English: In one place, He teaches them to read and understand everything, while in another place, He Himself makes them ignorant.

Gurbani: ਇਕਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਏ ਜਾ ਆਪਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਸਚੇ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: eikanaa andar mehal bulaae jaa aap terai man sache bhaane |
English: Some, You summon to the Mansion of Your Presence within, when they are pleasing to Your Mind, O True Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਾ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਚੀ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਜਾਣੇ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: jinaa aape guramukh de vaddiaaee se jan sachee darageh jaane |11|
English: That Gurmukh, whom You have blessed with greatness - that humble being is known in Your True Court. ||11||

[Ang 553 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਰਦਾਨਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok maradaanaa 1 |
English: Salok, Mardaanaa:

Gurbani: ਕਲਿ ਕਲਵਾਲੀ ਕਾਮੁ ਮਦੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਪੀਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: kal kalavaalee kaam mad manooaa peevanahaar |
English: The Dark Age of Kali Yuga is the vessel, filled with the wine of sexual desire; the mind is the drunkard.

Gurbani: ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਕਟੋਰੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਭਰੀ ਪੀਲਾਵਾ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: krodh kattoree mohi bharee peelaavaa ahankaar |
English: Anger is the cup, filled with emotional attachment, and egotism is the server.

Gurbani: ਮਜਲਸ ਕੂੜੇ ਲਬ ਕੀ ਪੀ ਪੀ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: majalas koorre lab kee pee pee hoe khuaar |
English: Drinking too much in the company of falsehood and greed, one is ruined.

Gurbani: ਕਰਣੀ ਲਾਹਣਿ ਸਤੁ ਗੁੜੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: karanee laahan sat gurr sach saraa kar saar |
English: So let good deeds be your distillery, and Truth your molasses; in this way, make the most excellent wine of Truth.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਮੰਡੇ ਕਰਿ ਸੀਲੁ ਘਿਉ ਸਰਮੁ ਮਾਸੁ ਆਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: gun mandde kar seel ghiau saram maas aahaar |
English: Make virtue your bread, good conduct the ghee, and modesty the meat to eat.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਖਾਧੈ ਜਾਹਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: guramukh paaeeai naanakaa khaadhai jaeh bikaar |1|
English: As Gurmukh, these are obtained, O Nanak; partaking of them, one's sins depart. ||1||

[Ang 553 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਰਦਾਨਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: maradaanaa 1 |
English: Mardaanaa:

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਲਾਹਣਿ ਆਪੁ ਮਦੁ ਮਜਲਸ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਧਾਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa laahan aap mad majalas trisanaa dhaat |
English: The human body is the vat, self-conceit is the wine, and desire is the company of drinking buddies.

Gurbani: ਮਨਸਾ ਕਟੋਰੀ ਕੂੜਿ ਭਰੀ ਪੀਲਾਏ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: manasaa kattoree koorr bharee peelaae jamakaal |
English: The cup of the mind's longing is overflowing with falsehood, and the Messenger of Death is the cup-bearer.

Gurbani: ਇਤੁ ਮਦਿ ਪੀਤੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਬਹੁਤੇ ਖਟੀਅਹਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: eit mad peetai naanakaa bahute khatteeeh bikaar |
English: Drinking in this wine, O Nanak, one takes on countless sins and corruptions.

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਗੁੜੁ ਸਾਲਾਹ ਮੰਡੇ ਭਉ ਮਾਸੁ ਆਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: giaan gurr saalaah mandde bhau maas aahaar |
English: So make spiritual wisdom your molasses, the Praise of God your bread, and the Fear of God the meat you eat.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak ihu bhojan sach hai sach naam aadhaar |2|
English: O Nanak, this is the true food; let the True Name be your only Support. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਾਂਯਾਂ ਲਾਹਣਿ ਆਪੁ ਮਦੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਧਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: kaanyaan laahan aap mad amrit tis kee dhaar |
English: If the human body is the vat, and self-realization is the wine, then a stream of Ambrosial Nectar is produced.

Gurbani: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਲਾਪੁ ਹੋਇ ਲਿਵ ਕਟੋਰੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਰੀ ਪੀ ਪੀ ਕਟਹਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: satasangat siau melaap hoe liv kattoree amrit bharee pee pee katteh bikaar |3|
English: Meeting with the Society of the Saints, the cup of the Lord's Love is filled with this Ambrosial Nectar; drinking it in, one's corruptions and sins are wiped away. ||3||

[Ang 553 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬਾ ਆਪੇ ਖਟ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: aape sur nar gan gandharabaa aape khatt darasan kee baanee |
English: He Himself is the angelic being, the heavenly herald, and the celestial singer. He Himself is the one who explains the six schools of philosophy.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਿਵ ਸੰਕਰ ਮਹੇਸਾ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: aape siv sankar mahesaa aape guramukh akath kahaanee |
English: He Himself is Shiva, Shankara and Mahaysh; He Himself is the Gurmukh, who speaks the Unspoken Speech.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਜੋਗੀ ਆਪੇ ਭੋਗੀ ਆਪੇ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਫਿਰੈ ਬਿਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: aape jogee aape bhogee aape saniaasee firai bibaanee |
English: He Himself is the Yogi, He Himself is the Sensual Enjoyer, and He Himself is the Sannyaasee, wandering through the wilderness.

Gurbani: ਆਪੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਗੋਸਟਿ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੈ ਆਪੇ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਸਿਆਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: aapai naal gosatt aap upadesai aape sugharr saroop siaanee |
English: He discusses with Himself, and He teaches Himself; He Himself is discrete, graceful and wise.

Gurbani: ਆਪਣਾ ਚੋਜੁ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਹੈ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: aapanaa choj kar vekhai aape aape sabhanaa jeea kaa hai jaanee |12|
English: Staging His own play, He Himself watches it; He Himself is the Knower of all beings. ||12||

[Ang 553 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਏਹਾ ਸੰਧਿਆ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: ehaa sandhiaa paravaan hai jit har prabh meraa chit aavai |
English: That evening prayer alone is acceptable, which brings the Lord God to my consciousness.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਜਲਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: har siau preet aoopajai maaeaa mohu jalaavai |
English: Love for the Lord wells up within me, and my attachment to Maya is burnt away.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਰੈ ਮਨੂਆ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਸੰਧਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee dubidhaa marai manooaa asathir sandhiaa kare veechaar |
English: By Guru's Grace, duality is conquered, and the mind becomes stable; I have made contemplative meditation my evening prayer.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਧਿਆ ਕਰੈ ਮਨਮੁਖੀ ਜੀਉ ਨ ਟਿਕੈ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak sandhiaa karai manamukhee jeeo na ttikai mar jamai hoe khuaar |1|
English: O Nanak, the self-willed manmukh may recite his evening prayers, but his mind is not centered on it; through birth and death, he is ruined. ||1||

[Ang 553 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਕਰਤੀ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਫਿਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: priau priau karatee sabh jag firee meree piaas na jaae |
English: I wandered over the whole world, crying out, "Love, O Love!", but my thirst was not quenched.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਮੇਰੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਗਈ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਘਰਿ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak satigur miliai meree piaas gee pir paaeaa ghar aae |2|
English: O Nanak, meeting the True Guru, my desires are satisfied; I found my Beloved, when I returned to my own home. ||2||

[Ang 553 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਤੰਤੁ ਪਰਮ ਤੰਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aape tant param tant sabh aape aape tthaakur daas bheaa |
English: He Himself is the supreme essence, He Himself is the essence of all. He Himself is the Lord and Master, and He Himself is the servant.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਦਸ ਅਠ ਵਰਨ ਉਪਾਇਅਨੁ ਆਪਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਆਪਿ ਰਾਜੁ ਲਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aape das atth varan upaaeian aap braham aap raaj leaa |
English: He Himself created the people of the eighteen castes; God Himself acquired His domain.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਛੋਡੈ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਕਰੇ ਦਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aape maare aape chhoddai aape bakhase kare deaa |
English: He Himself kills, and He Himself redeems; He Himself, in His Kindness, forgives us. He is infallible

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਅਭੁਲੁ ਨ ਭੁਲੈ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਤਪਾਵਸੁ ਸਚੁ ਥਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: aap abhul na bhulai kab hee sabh sach tapaavas sach thiaa |
English: - He never errs; the justice of the True Lord is totally True.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਜਿਨਾ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਿਨ ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: aape jinaa bujhaae guramukh tin andarahu doojaa bharam geaa |13|
English: Those whom the Lord Himself instructs as Gurmukh - duality and doubt depart from within them. ||13||

[Ang 553 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਤੈ ਤਨਿ ਉਡੈ ਖੇਹ ॥
Transliteration: har naam na simareh saadhasang tai tan uddai kheh |
English: That body, which does not remember the Lord's Name in meditation in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, shall be reduced to dust.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤੀ ਤਿਸੈ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਫਿਟੁ ਅਲੂਣੀ ਦੇਹ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jin keetee tisai na jaanee naanak fitt aloonee deh |1|
English: Cursed and insipid is that body, O Nanak, which does not know the One who created it. ||1||

[Ang 554 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਚਰਣਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਰਸਨਾ ਜਪੈ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt vaseh charanaarabind rasanaa japai gupaal |
English: Let the Lotus Feet of the Lord abide within your heart, and with your tongue, chant God's Name.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਕਉ ਪਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak so prabh simareeai tis dehee kau paal |2|
English: O Nanak, meditate in remembrance on God, and nurture this body. ||2||

[Ang 554 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape atthasatth teerath karataa aap kare isanaan |
English: The Creator Himself is the sixty-eight sacred places of pilgrimage; He Himself takes the cleansing bath in them.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਸ੍ਵਾਮੀ ਆਪਿ ਜਪਾਇਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape sanjam varatai svaamee aap japaaeihi naam |
English: He Himself practices austere self-discipline; the Lord Master Himself causes us to chant His Name.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਭਉ ਖੰਡਨੁ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: aap deaal hoe bhau khanddan aap karai sabh daan |
English: He Himself becomes merciful to us; the Destroyer of fear Himself gives in charity to all.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਪਾਏ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: jis no guramukh aap bujhaae so sad hee darageh paae maan |
English: One whom He has enlightened and made Gurmukh, ever obtains honor in His Court.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਦੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੋ ਸਚਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਨੁ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: jis dee paij rakhai har suaamee so sachaa har jaan |14|
English: One whose honor the Lord Master has preserved, comes to know the True Lord. ||14||

[Ang 554 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਜਗੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਧੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak bin satigur bhette jag andh hai andhe karam kamaae |
English: O Nanak, without meeting the True Guru, the world is blind, and it does blind deeds.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੈ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਵਈ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabadai siau chit na laavee jit sukh vasai man aae |
English: It does not focus its consciousness on the Word of the Shabad, which would bring peace to abide in the mind.

Gurbani: ਤਾਮਸਿ ਲਗਾ ਸਦਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਜਲਤੁ ਬਿਹਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: taamas lagaa sadaa firai ahinis jalat bihaae |
English: Always afflicted with the dark passions of low energy, it wanders around, passing its days and nights burning.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jo tis bhaavai so theeai kahanaa kichhoo na jaae |1|
English: Whatever pleases Him, comes to pass; no one has any say in this. ||1||

[Ang 554 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰੀ ਏਹ ਕਰੇਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: satiguroo furamaaeaa kaaree eeh karehu |
English: The True Guru has commanded us to do this:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੰਮਾਲੇਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: guroo duaarai hoe kai saahib samaalehu |
English: through the Guru's Gate, meditate on the Lord Master.

Gurbani: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ਹੈ ਭਰਮੈ ਕੇ ਛਉੜ ਕਟਿ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਧਰੇਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: saahib sadaa hajoor hai bharamai ke chhaurr katt kai antar jot dharehu |
English: The Lord Master is ever-present. He tears away the veil of doubt, and installs His Light within the mind.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਦਾਰੂ ਏਹੁ ਲਾਏਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam amrit hai daaroo ehu laaehu |
English: The Name of the Lord is Ambrosial Nectar - take this healing medicine!

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਰਖਹੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: satigur kaa bhaanaa chit rakhahu sanjam sachaa nehu |
English: Enshrine the Will of the True Guru in your consciousness, and make the True Lord's Love your self-discipline.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਐਥੈ ਸੁਖੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਖਸੀ ਅਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਕੇਲ ਕਰੇਹੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak aithai sukhai andar rakhasee agai har siau kel karehu |2|
English: O Nanak, you shall be kept in peace here, and hereafter, you shall celebrate with the Lord. ||2||

[Ang 554 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਭਾਰ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਬਣਸਪਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਫਲ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aape bhaar atthaarah banasapat aape hee fal laae |
English: He Himself is the vast variety of Nature, and He Himself makes it bear fruit.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮਾਲੀ ਆਪਿ ਸਭੁ ਸਿੰਚੈ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਮੁਹਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aape maalee aap sabh sinchai aape hee muhi paae |
English: He Himself is the Gardener, He Himself irrigates all the plants, and He Himself puts them in His mouth.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਦਿਵਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aape karataa aape bhugataa aape dee divaae |
English: He Himself is the Creator, and He Himself is the Enjoyer; He Himself gives, and causes others to give.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੈ ਰਾਖਾ ਆਪੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aape saahib aape hai raakhaa aape rahiaa samaae |
English: He Himself is the Lord and Master, and He Himself is the Protector; He Himself is permeating and pervading everywhere.

Gurbani: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਆਖੈ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਏ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: jan naanak vaddiaaee aakhai har karate kee jis no til na tamaae |15|
English: Servant Nanak speaks of the greatness of the Lord, the Creator, who has no greed at all. ||15||

[Ang 554 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਾਣਸੁ ਭਰਿਆ ਆਣਿਆ ਮਾਣਸੁ ਭਰਿਆ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: maanas bhariaa aaniaa maanas bhariaa aae |
English: One person brings a full bottle, and another fills his cup.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਪੀਤੈ ਮਤਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਬਰਲੁ ਪਵੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: jit peetai mat door hoe baral pavai vich aae |
English: Drinking the wine, his intelligence departs, and madness enters his mind;

Gurbani: ਆਪਣਾ ਪਰਾਇਆ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਈ ਖਸਮਹੁ ਧਕੇ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aapanaa paraaeaa na pachhaanee khasamahu dhake khaae |
English: he cannot distinguish between his own and others, and he is struck down by his Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਪੀਤੈ ਖਸਮੁ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jit peetai khasam visarai daragah milai sajaae |
English: Drinking it, he forgets his Lord and Master, and he is punished in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਝੂਠਾ ਮਦੁ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਪੀਚਈ ਜੇ ਕਾ ਪਾਰਿ ਵਸਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jhootthaa mad mool na peechee je kaa paar vasaae |
English: Do not drink the false wine at all, if it is in your power.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਸਚੁ ਮਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak nadaree sach mad paaeeai satigur milai jis aae |
English: O Nanak, the True Guru comes and meets the mortal; by His Grace, one obtains the True Wine.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਹੈ ਮਹਲੀ ਪਾਵੈ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sadaa saahib kai rang rahai mahalee paavai thaau |1|
English: He shall dwell forever in the Love of the Lord Master, and obtain a seat in the Mansion of His Presence. ||1||

[Ang 554 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਜਾ ਇਸ ਨੋ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: eihu jagat jeevat marai jaa is no sojhee hoe |
English: When this world comes to understand, it remains dead while yet alive.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤਿਨਿੑ ਸਵਾਲਿਆ ਤਾਂ ਸਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਜਗਾਏ ਤਾਂ ਸੁਧਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jaa tina savaaliaa taan sav rahiaa jagaae taan sudh hoe |
English: When the Lord puts him to sleep, he remains asleep; when He wakes him up, he regains consciousness.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak nadar kare je aapanee satigur melai soe |
English: O Nanak, when the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, He causes him to meet the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad jeevat marai taa fir maran na hoe |2|
English: By Guru's Grace, remain dead while yet alive, and you shall not have to die again. ||2||

[Ang 554 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਪਰਵਾਹ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਕੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jis daa keetaa sabh kichh hovai tis no paravaah naahee kisai keree |
English: By His doing, everything happens; what does He care for anyone else?

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਿਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਖਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਮੁਹਤਾਜੀ ਕਢੈ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: har jeeo teraa ditaa sabh ko khaavai sabh muhataajee kadtai teree |
English: O Dear Lord, everyone eats whatever You give - all are subservient to You.

Gurbani: ਜਿ ਤੁਧ ਨੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਕੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: ji tudh no saalaahe su sabh kichh paavai jis no kirapaa niranjan keree |
English: One who praises You obtains everything; You bestow Your Mercy upon him, O Immaculate Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਚਾ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਵਖਰੁ ਲਦਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: soee saahu sachaa vanajaaraa jin vakhar ladiaa har naam dhan teree |
English: He alone is a true banker and trader, who loads the merchandise of the wealth of the Your Name, O Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਨੋ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਦੂਜੇ ਭਾਵ ਕੀ ਮਾਰਿ ਵਿਡਾਰੀ ਢੇਰੀ ॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: sabh tisai no saalaahihu santahu jin dooje bhaav kee maar viddaaree dteree |16|
English: O Saints, let everyone praise the Lord, who has destroyed the pile of the love of duality. ||16||

[Ang 555 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਕਬੀਰਾ ਮਰਤਾ ਮਰਤਾ ਜਗੁ ਮੁਆ ਮਰਿ ਭਿ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: kabeeraa marataa marataa jag muaa mar bhi na jaanai koe |
English: Kabeer, the world is dying - dying to death, but no one knows how to truly die.

Gurbani: ਐਸੀ ਮਰਨੀ ਜੋ ਮਰੈ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਮਰਨਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aisee maranee jo marai bahur na maranaa hoe |1|
English: Whoever dies, let him die such a death, that he does not have to die again. ||1||

[Ang 555 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਜਾਣਾ ਕਿਵ ਮਰਹਗੇ ਕੈਸਾ ਮਰਣਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa jaanaa kiv marahage kaisaa maranaa hoe |
English: What do I know? How will I die? What sort of death will it be?

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਤਾ ਸਹਿਲਾ ਮਰਣਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: je kar saahib manahu na veesarai taa sahilaa maranaa hoe |
English: If I do not forget the Lord Master from my mind, then my death will be easy.

Gurbani: ਮਰਣੈ ਤੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਡਰੈ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਲੋੜੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: maranai te jagat ddarai jeeviaa lorrai sabh koe |
English: The world is terrified of death; everyone longs to live.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee jeevat marai hukamai boojhai soe |
English: By Guru's Grace, one who dies while yet alive, understands the Lord's Will.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਐਸੀ ਮਰਨੀ ਜੋ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਸਦ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak aisee maranee jo marai taa sad jeevan hoe |2|
English: O Nanak, one who dies such a death, lives forever. ||2||

[Ang 555 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਆਪਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਾ ਆਪਣਾਂ ਨਾਉ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਜਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jaa aap kripaal hovai har suaamee taa aapanaan naau har aap japaavai |
English: When the Lord Master Himself becomes merciful, the Lord Himself causes His Name to be chanted.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਆਪਣਾਂ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: aape satigur mel sukh devai aapanaan sevak aap har bhaavai |
English: He Himself causes us to meet the True Guru, and blesses us with peace. His servant is pleasing to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਪਣਿਆ ਸੇਵਕਾ ਕੀ ਆਪਿ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੈ ਆਪਣਿਆ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: aapaniaa sevakaa kee aap paij rakhai aapaniaa bhagataa kee pairee paavai |
English: He Himself preserves the honor of His servants; He causes others to fall at the feet of His devotees.

Gurbani: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਕ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: dharam raae hai har kaa keea har jan sevak nerr na aavai |
English: The Righteous Judge of Dharma is a creation of the Lord; he does not approach the humble servant of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸੋ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਹੋਰ ਕੇਤੀ ਝਖਿ ਝਖਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: jo har kaa piaaraa so sabhanaa kaa piaaraa hor ketee jhakh jhakh aavai jaavai |17|
English: One who is dear to the Lord, is dear to all; so many others come and go in vain. ||17||

[Ang 555 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਾਮੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: raam raam karataa sabh jag firai raam na paaeaa jaae |
English: The entire world roams around, chanting, "Raam, Raam, Lord, Lord", but the Lord cannot be obtained like this.

Gurbani: ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਤਿ ਵਡਾ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਨ ਤੁਲਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: agam agochar at vaddaa atul na tuliaa jaae |
English: He is inaccessible, unfathomable and so very great; He is unweighable, and cannot be weighed.

Gurbani: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਲਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: keemat kinai na paaeea kitai na leaa jaae |
English: No one can evaluate Him; He cannot be purchased at any price.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਭੇਦਿਆ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad bhediaa in bidh vasiaa man aae |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, His mystery is known; in this way, He comes to dwell in the mind.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਅਮੇਉ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak aap ameo hai gur kirapaa te rahiaa samaae |
English: O Nanak, He Himself is infinite; by Guru's Grace, He is known to be permeating and pervading everywhere.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਆਪੇ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aape miliaa mil rahiaa aape miliaa aae |1|
English: He Himself comes to blend, and having blended, remains blended. ||1||

[Ang 555 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਏ ਮਨ ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: e man ihu dhan naam hai jit sadaa sadaa sukh hoe |
English: O my soul, this is the wealth of the Naam; through it, comes peace, forever and ever.

Gurbani: ਤੋਟਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਲਾਹਾ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: tottaa mool na aavee laahaa sad hee hoe |
English: It never brings any loss; through it, one earns profits forever.

Gurbani: ਖਾਧੈ ਖਰਚਿਐ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਓਹੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: khaadhai kharachiai tott na aavee sadaa sadaa ohu dee |
English: Eating and spending it, it never decreases; He continues to give, forever and ever.

Gurbani: ਸਹਸਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਹਾਣਤ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sahasaa mool na hovee haanat kade na hoe |
English: One who has no skepticism at all never suffers humiliation.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh paaeeai jaa kau nadar karee |2|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh obtains the Name of the Lord, when the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace. ||2||

[Ang 555 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਭ ਘਟ ਅੰਦਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਬਾਹਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: aape sabh ghatt andare aape hee baahar |
English: He Himself is deep within all hearts, and He Himself is outside them.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਜਾਹਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: aape gupat varatadaa aape hee jaahar |
English: He Himself is prevailing unmanifest, and He Himself is manifest.

Gurbani: ਜੁਗ ਛਤੀਹ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਸੁੰਨਾਹਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jug chhateeh gubaar kar varatiaa sunaahar |
English: For thirty-six ages, He created the darkness, abiding in the void.

Gurbani: ਓਥੈ ਵੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਨ ਸਾਸਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਰਹਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: othai ved puraan na saasataa aape har narahar |
English: There were no Vedas, Puraanas or Shaastras there; only the Lord Himself existed.

Gurbani: ਬੈਠਾ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਇ ਆਪਿ ਸਭ ਦੂ ਹੀ ਬਾਹਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: baitthaa taarree laae aap sabh doo hee baahar |
English: He Himself sat in the absolute trance, withdrawn from everything.

Gurbani: ਆਪਣੀ ਮਿਤਿ ਆਪਿ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਗਉਹਰੁ ॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: aapanee mit aap jaanadaa aape hee gauhar |18|
English: Only He Himself knows His state; He Himself is the unfathomable ocean. ||18||

[Ang 555 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਮੁਆ ਮਰਦੋ ਮਰਦਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: haumai vich jagat muaa marado maradaa jaae |
English: In egotism, the world is dead; it dies and dies, again and again.

Gurbani: ਜਿਚਰੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਚਰੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਈ ਕਿ ਕਰੇਗੁ ਅਗੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jichar vich dam hai tichar na chetee ki kareg agai jaae |
English: As long as there is breath in the body, he does not remember the Lord; what will he do in the world hereafter?

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਚੇਤੰਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: giaanee hoe su chetan hoe agiaanee andh kamaae |
English: One who remembers the Lord is a spiritual teacher; the ignorant one acts blindly.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਥੈ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਅਗੈ ਪਾਏ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak ethai kamaavai so milai agai paae jaae |1|
English: O Nanak, whatever one does in this world, determines what he shall receive in the world hereafter. ||1||

[Ang 556 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਧੁਰਿ ਖਸਮੈ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਇਆ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚੇਤਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: dhur khasamai kaa hukam peaa vin satigur chetiaa na jaae |
English: From the very beginning, it has been the Will of the Lord Master, that He cannot be remembered without the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਿਆ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur miliai antar rav rahiaa sadaa rahiaa liv laae |
English: Meeting the True Guru, he realizes that the Lord is permeating and pervading deep within him; he remains forever absorbed in the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਦਮਿ ਦਮਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲਦਾ ਦੰਮੁ ਨ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: dam dam sadaa samaaladaa dam na birathaa jaae |
English: With each and every breath, he constantly remembers the Lord in meditation; not a single breath passes in vain.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਗਇਆ ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: janam maran kaa bhau geaa jeevan padavee paae |
English: His fears of birth and death depart, and he obtains the honored state of eternal life.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਮਰਤਬਾ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak ihu maratabaa tis no dee jis no kirapaa kare rajaae |2|
English: O Nanak, He bestows this rank upon that mortal, upon whom He showers His Mercy. ||2||

[Ang 556 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਦਾਨਾਂ ਬੀਨਿਆ ਆਪੇ ਪਰਧਾਨਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: aape daanaan beeniaa aape paradhaanaan |
English: He Himself is all-wise and all-knowing; He Himself is supreme.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਰੂਪ ਦਿਖਾਲਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਲਾਇ ਧਿਆਨਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: aape roop dikhaaladaa aape laae dhiaanaan |
English: He Himself reveals His form, and He Himself enjoins us to His meditation.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮੋਨੀ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਕਥੈ ਗਿਆਨਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: aape monee varatadaa aape kathai giaanaan |
English: He Himself poses as a silent sage, and He Himself speaks spiritual wisdom.

Gurbani: ਕਉੜਾ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਸਭਨਾ ਹੀ ਭਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaurraa kisai na lagee sabhanaa hee bhaanaa |
English: He does not seem bitter to anyone; He is pleasing to all.

Gurbani: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਕੀਐ ਸਦ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾ ॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: ausatat baran na sakeeai sad sad kurabaanaa |19|
English: His Praises cannot be described; forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to Him. ||19||

[Ang 556 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਲੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿੰਨਾਂ ਦਾ ਅਉਤਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: kalee andar naanakaa jinaan daa aautaar |
English: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, O Nanak, the demons have taken birth.

Gurbani: ਪੁਤੁ ਜਿਨੂਰਾ ਧੀਅ ਜਿੰਨੂਰੀ ਜੋਰੂ ਜਿੰਨਾ ਦਾ ਸਿਕਦਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: put jinooraa dheea jinooree joroo jinaa daa sikadaar |1|
English: The son is a demon, and the daughter is a demon; the wife is the chief of the demons. ||1||

[Ang 556 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਿੰਦੂ ਮੂਲੇ ਭੂਲੇ ਅਖੁਟੀ ਜਾਂਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: hindoo moole bhoole akhuttee jaanhee |
English: The Hindus have forgotten the Primal Lord; they are going the wrong way.

Gurbani: ਨਾਰਦਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਸਿ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਂਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: naarad kahiaa si pooj karaanhee |
English: As Naarad instructed them, they are worshipping idols.

Gurbani: ਅੰਧੇ ਗੁੰਗੇ ਅੰਧ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: andhe gunge andh andhaar |
English: They are blind and mute, the blindest of the blind.

Gurbani: ਪਾਥਰੁ ਲੇ ਪੂਜਹਿ ਮੁਗਧ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: paathar le poojeh mugadh gavaar |
English: The ignorant fools pick up stones and worship them.

Gurbani: ਓਹਿ ਜਾ ਆਪਿ ਡੁਬੇ ਤੁਮ ਕਹਾ ਤਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ohi jaa aap ddube tum kahaa taranahaar |2|
English: But when those stones themselves sink, who will carry you across? ||2||

[Ang 556 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਹੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਤੂ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kihu terai vas hai too sachaa saahu |
English: Everything is in Your power; You are the True King.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਏਕ ਕੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat rate rang ek kai pooraa vesaahu |
English: The devotees are imbued with the Love of the One Lord; they have perfect faith in Him.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਜਿ ਰਜਿ ਜਨ ਖਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: amrit bhojan naam har raj raj jan khaahu |
English: The Name of the Lord is the ambrosial food; His humble servants eat their fill.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਪਾਈਅਨਿ ਸਿਮਰਣੁ ਸਚੁ ਲਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: sabh padaarath paaeean simaran sach laahu |
English: All treasures are obtained - meditative remembrance on the Lord is the true profit.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਹੁ ॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: sant piaare paarabraham naanak har agam agaahu |20|
English: The Saints are very dear to the Supreme Lord God, O Nanak; the Lord is unapproachable and unfathomable. ||20||

[Ang 556 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਆਵਦਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh hukame aavadaa sabh kichh hukame jaae |
English: Everything comes by the Lord's Will, and everything goes by the Lord's Will.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਆਪਹੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਅੰਧਾ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: je ko moorakh aapahu jaanai andhaa andh kamaae |
English: If some fool believes that he is the creator, he is blind, and acts in blindness.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੁਝੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak hukam ko guramukh bujhai jis no kirapaa kare rajaae |1|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh understands the Hukam of the Lord's Command; the Lord showers His Mercy upon him. ||1||

[Ang 556 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਜੋਗੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: so jogee jugat so paae jis no guramukh naam paraapat hoe |
English: He alone is a Yogi, and he alone finds the Way, who, as Gurmukh, obtains the Naam.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਕੀ ਨਗਰੀ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਵਸੈ ਭੇਖੀ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: tis jogee kee nagaree sabh ko vasai bhekhee jog na hoe |
English: In the body-village of that Yogi are all blessings; this Yoga is not obtained by outward show.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਐਸਾ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਘਟਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak aisaa viralaa ko jogee jis ghatt paragatt hoe |2|
English: O Nanak, such a Yogi is very rare; the Lord is manifest in his heart. ||2||

[Ang 556 | Raag: Raag Bihaagraa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape jant upaaeian aape aadhaar |
English: He Himself created the creatures, and He Himself supports them.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸੂਖਮੁ ਭਾਲੀਐ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape sookham bhaaleeai aape paasaar |
English: He Himself is seen to be subtle, and He Himself is obvious.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਇਕਾਤੀ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਵਡ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: aap ikaatee hoe rahai aape vadd paravaar |
English: He Himself remains a solitary recluse, and He Himself has a huge family.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਾ ਰੇਨਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak mangai daan har santaa renaar |
English: Nanak asks for the gift of the dust of the feet of the Saints of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹੋਰੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਤੂ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨੧॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ ॥
Transliteration: hor daataar na sujhee too devanahaar |21|1| sudh |
English: I cannot see any other Giver; You alone are the Giver, O Lord. ||21||1|| Sudh||

[Ang 557 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirbhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibhan gur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raag vaddahans mahalaa 1 ghar 1 |
English: Raag Wadahans, First Mehl, First House:

Gurbani: ਅਮਲੀ ਅਮਲੁ ਨ ਅੰਬੜੈ ਮਛੀ ਨੀਰੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: amalee amal na anbarrai machhee neer na hoe |
English: To the addict, there is nothing like the drug; to the fish, there is nothing else like water.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਸਹਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਤਿਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jo rate seh aapanai tin bhaavai sabh koe |1|
English: Those who are attuned to their Lord - everyone is pleasing to them. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਵੰਞਾ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਵੰਞਾ ਤਉ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੇ ਨਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hau vaaree vanyaa khaneeai vanyaa tau saahib ke naavai |1| rahaau |
English: I am a sacrifice, cut apart into pieces, a sacrifice to Your Name, O Lord Master. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਫਲਿਓ ਰੁਖੜਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saahib safalio rukharraa amrit jaa kaa naau |
English: The Lord is the fruitful tree; His Name is ambrosial nectar.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਪੀਆ ਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤ ਭਏ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jin peea te tripat bhe hau tin balihaarai jaau |2|
English: Those who drink it in are satisfied; I am a sacrifice to them. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਕੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਹੀ ਵਸਹਿ ਹਭੀਆਂ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: mai kee nadar na aavahee vaseh habheean naal |
English: You are not visible to me, although You dwell with everyone.

Gurbani: ਤਿਖਾ ਤਿਹਾਇਆ ਕਿਉ ਲਹੈ ਜਾ ਸਰ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਪਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tikhaa tihaaeaa kiau lahai jaa sar bheetar paal |3|
English: How can the thirst of the thirsty be quenched, with that wall between me and the pond? ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਬਾਣੀਆ ਤੂ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: naanak teraa baaneea too saahib mai raas |
English: Nanak is Your merchant; You, O Lord Master, are my merchandise.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਤੇ ਧੋਖਾ ਤਾ ਲਹੈ ਜਾ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: man te dhokhaa taa lahai jaa sifat karee aradaas |4|1|
English: My mind is cleansed of doubt, only when I praise You, and pray to You. ||4||1||

[Ang 557 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 1 |
English: Wadahans, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਨਿਰਗੁਣਿ ਕੂਕੇ ਕਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gunavantee sahu raaviaa niragun kooke kaae |
English: The virtuous bride enjoys her Husband Lord; why does the unworthy one cry out?

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਥੀ ਰਹੈ ਤਾ ਭੀ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਵਣ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: je gunavantee thee rahai taa bhee sahu raavan jaae |1|
English: If she were to become virtuous, then she too could enjoy her Husband Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਕੰਤੁ ਰੀਸਾਲੂ ਕੀ ਧਨ ਅਵਰਾ ਰਾਵੇ ਜੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: meraa kant reesaaloo kee dhan avaraa raave jee |1| rahaau |
English: My Husband Lord is loving and playful; why should the soul-bride enjoy anyone else? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਮਣ ਜੇ ਥੀਐ ਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਧਾਗਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: karanee kaaman je theeai je man dhaagaa hoe |
English: If the soul-bride does good deeds, and strings them on the thread of her mind,

Gurbani: ਮਾਣਕੁ ਮੁਲਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਲੀਜੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਪਰੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: maanak mul na paaeeai leejai chit paroe |2|
English: she obtains the jewel, which cannot be purchased for any price, strung upon the thread of her consciousness. ||2||

Gurbani: ਰਾਹੁ ਦਸਾਈ ਨ ਜੁਲਾਂ ਆਖਾਂ ਅੰਮੜੀਆਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: raahu dasaaee na julaan aakhaan amarreeaas |
English: I ask, but do not follow the way shown to me; still, I claim to have reached my destination.

Gurbani: ਤੈ ਸਹ ਨਾਲਿ ਅਕੂਅਣਾ ਕਿਉ ਥੀਵੈ ਘਰ ਵਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tai seh naal akooanaa kiau theevai ghar vaas |3|
English: I do not speak with You, O my Husband Lord; how then can I come to have a place in Your home? ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੀ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak ekee baaharaa doojaa naahee koe |
English: O Nanak, without the One Lord, there is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਤੈ ਸਹ ਲਗੀ ਜੇ ਰਹੈ ਭੀ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: tai seh lagee je rahai bhee sahu raavai soe |4|2|
English: If the soul-bride remains attached to You, then she shall enjoy her Husband Lord. ||4||2||

[Ang 557 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 1 ghar 2 |
English: Wadahans, First Mehl, Second House:

Gurbani: ਮੋਰੀ ਰੁਣ ਝੁਣ ਲਾਇਆ ਭੈਣੇ ਸਾਵਣੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: moree run jhun laaeaa bhaine saavan aaeaa |
English: The peacocks are singing so sweetly, O sister; the rainy season of Saawan has come.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੇ ਮੁੰਧ ਕਟਾਰੇ ਜੇਵਡਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਲੋਭੀ ਲੋਭ ਲੁਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tere mundh kattaare jevaddaa tin lobhee lobh lubhaaeaa |
English: Your beauteous eyes are like a string of charms, fascinating and enticing the soul-bride.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਵੰਞਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੋ ॥
Transliteration: tere darasan vittahu khaneeai vanyaa tere naam vittahu kurabaano |
English: I would cut myself into pieces for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; I am a sacrifice to Your Name.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤੂ ਤਾ ਮੈ ਮਾਣੁ ਕੀਆ ਹੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਣੋ ॥
Transliteration: jaa too taa mai maan keea hai tudh bin kehaa meraa maano |
English: I take pride in You; without You, what could I be proud of?

Gurbani: ਚੂੜਾ ਭੰਨੁ ਪਲੰਘ ਸਿਉ ਮੁੰਧੇ ਸਣੁ ਬਾਹੀ ਸਣੁ ਬਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: choorraa bhan palangh siau mundhe san baahee san baahaa |
English: So smash your bracelets along with your bed, O soul-bride, and break your arms, along with the arms of your couch.

Gurbani: ਏਤੇ ਵੇਸ ਕਰੇਦੀਏ ਮੁੰਧੇ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਤੋ ਅਵਰਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: ete ves karedee mundhe sahu raato avaraahaa |
English: In spite of all the decorations which you have made, O soul-bride, your Husband Lord is enjoying someone else.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਮਨੀਆਰੁ ਨ ਚੂੜੀਆ ਨਾ ਸੇ ਵੰਗੁੜੀਆਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: naa maneeaar na choorreea naa se vangurreeaahaa |
English: You don't have the bracelets of gold, nor the good crystal jewelry; you haven't dealt with the true jeweller.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਸਹ ਕੰਠਿ ਨ ਲਗੀਆ ਜਲਨੁ ਸਿ ਬਾਹੜੀਆਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo seh kantth na lageea jalan si baaharreeaahaa |
English: Those arms, which do not embrace the neck of the Husband Lord, burn in anguish.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਸਹੀਆ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਵਣਿ ਗਈਆ ਹਉ ਦਾਧੀ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਜਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabh saheea sahu raavan geea hau daadhee kai dar jaavaa |
