English: All my companions have gone to enjoy their Husband Lord; which door should I, the wretched one, go to?

Gurbani: ਅੰਮਾਲੀ ਹਉ ਖਰੀ ਸੁਚਜੀ ਤੈ ਸਹ ਏਕਿ ਨ ਭਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: amaalee hau kharee suchajee tai seh ek na bhaavaa |
English: O friend, I may look very attractive, but I am not pleasing to my Husband Lord at all.

Gurbani: ਮਾਠਿ ਗੁੰਦਾੲਂੀ ਪਟੀਆ ਭਰੀਐ ਮਾਗ ਸੰਧੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: maatth gundaaenee patteea bhareeai maag sandhoore |
English: I have woven my hair into lovely braids, and saturated their partings with vermillion;

Gurbani: ਅਗੈ ਗਈ ਨ ਮੰਨੀਆ ਮਰਉ ਵਿਸੂਰਿ ਵਿਸੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: agai gee na maneea mrau visoor visoore |
English: but when I go before Him, I am not accepted, and I die, suffering in anguish.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਰੋਵੰਦੀ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਰੁਨਾ ਰੁੰਨੜੇ ਵਣਹੁ ਪੰਖੇਰੂ ॥
Transliteration: mai rovandee sabh jag runaa runarre vanahu pankheroo |
English: I weep; the whole world weeps; even the birds of the forest weep with me.

Gurbani: ਇਕੁ ਨ ਰੁਨਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਤਨ ਕਾ ਬਿਰਹਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਉ ਪਿਰਹੁ ਵਿਛੋੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: eik na runaa mere tan kaa birahaa jin hau pirahu vichhorree |
English: The only thing which doesn't weep is my body's sense of separateness, which has separated me from my Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੁਪਨੈ ਆਇਆ ਭੀ ਗਇਆ ਮੈ ਜਲੁ ਭਰਿਆ ਰੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: supanai aaeaa bhee geaa mai jal bhariaa roe |
English: In a dream, He came, and went away again; I cried so many tears.

Gurbani: ਆਇ ਨ ਸਕਾ ਤੁਝ ਕਨਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਭੇਜਿ ਨ ਸਕਾ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aae na sakaa tujh kan piaare bhej na sakaa koe |
English: I can't come to You, O my Beloved, and I can't send anyone to You.

Gurbani: ਆਉ ਸਭਾਗੀ ਨੀਦੜੀਏ ਮਤੁ ਸਹੁ ਦੇਖਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aau sabhaagee needarree mat sahu dekhaa soe |
English: Come to me, O blessed sleep - perhaps I will see my Husband Lord again.

Gurbani: ਤੈ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ਜਿ ਆਖੈ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਆ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: tai saahib kee baat ji aakhai kahu naanak kiaa deejai |
English: One who brings me a message from my Lord and Master - says Nanak, what shall I give to Him?

Gurbani: ਸੀਸੁ ਵਢੇ ਕਰਿ ਬੈਸਣੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਿਰ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: sees vadte kar baisan deejai vin sir sev kareejai |
English: Cutting off my head, I give it to Him to sit upon; without my head, I shall still serve Him.

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਨ ਮਰੀਜੈ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਨ ਦੀਜੈ ਜਾ ਸਹੁ ਭਇਆ ਵਿਡਾਣਾ ॥੧॥੩॥
Transliteration: kiau na mareejai jeearraa na deejai jaa sahu bheaa viddaanaa |1|3|
English: Why haven't I died? Why hasn't my life just ended? My Husband Lord has become a stranger to me. ||1||3||

[Ang 558 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 3 ghar 1 |
English: Wadahans, Third Mehl, First House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਮੈਲੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਤਨਿ ਧੋਤੈ ਮਨੁ ਹਛਾ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: man mailai sabh kichh mailaa tan dhotai man hachhaa na hoe |
English: When the mind is filthy, everything is filthy; by washing the body, the mind is not cleaned.

Gurbani: ਇਹ ਜਗਤੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: eih jagat bharam bhulaaeaa viralaa boojhai koe |1|
English: This world is deluded by doubt; how rare are those who understand this. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: jap man mere too eko naam |
English: O my mind, chant the One Name.

Gurbani: ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਏਹੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: satagur deea mo kau ehu nidhaan |1| rahaau |
English: The True Guru has given me this treasure. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਿਧਾ ਕੇ ਆਸਣ ਜੇ ਸਿਖੈ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਵਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sidhaa ke aasan je sikhai indree vas kar kamaae |
English: Even if one learns the Yogic postures of the Siddhas, and holds his sexual energy in check,

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: man kee mail na utarai haumai mail na jaae |2|
English: still, the filth of the mind is not removed, and the filth of egotism is not eliminated. ||2||

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਹੋਰੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: eis man kau hor sanjam ko naahee vin satigur kee saranaae |
English: This mind is not controlled by any other discipline, except the Sanctuary of the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਉਲਟੀ ਭਈ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: satagur miliai ulattee bhee kahanaa kichhoo na jaae |3|
English: Meeting the True Guru, one is transformed beyond description. ||3||

Gurbani: ਭਣਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਦੋ ਮਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhanat naanak satigur kau milado marai gur kai sabad fir jeevai koe |
English: Prays Nanak, one who dies upon meeting the True Guru, shall be rejuvenated through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਮਮਤਾ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਛਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: mamataa kee mal utarai ihu man hachhaa hoe |4|1|
English: The filth of his attachment and possessiveness shall depart, and his mind shall become pure. ||4||1||

[Ang 558 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 3 |
English: Wadahans, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਦਰੀ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਨਦਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: nadaree satagur seveeai nadaree sevaa hoe |
English: By His Grace, one serves the True Guru; by His Grace, service is performed.

Gurbani: ਨਦਰੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਵਸਿ ਆਵੈ ਨਦਰੀ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: nadaree ihu man vas aavai nadaree man niramal hoe |1|
English: By His grace, this mind is controlled, and by His Grace, it becomes pure. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਚੇਤਿ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: mere man chet sachaa soe |
English: O my mind, think of the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਮੂਲੇ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: eko cheteh taa sukh paaveh fir dookh na moole hoe |1| rahaau |
English: Think of the One Lord, and you shall obtain peace; you shall never suffer in sorrow again. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਦਰੀ ਮਰਿ ਕੈ ਜੀਵੀਐ ਨਦਰੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: nadaree mar kai jeeveeai nadaree sabad vasai man aae |
English: By His Grace, one dies while yet alive, and by His Grace, the Word of the Shabad is enshrined in the mind.

Gurbani: ਨਦਰੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: nadaree hukam bujheeai hukame rahai samaae |2|
English: By His Grace, one understands the Hukam of the Lord's Command, and by His Command, one merges into the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਨ ਚਖਿਓ ਸਾ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jin jihavaa har ras na chakhio saa jihavaa jal jaau |
English: That tongue, which does not savor the sublime essence of the Lord - may that tongue be burned off!

Gurbani: ਅਨ ਰਸ ਸਾਦੇ ਲਗਿ ਰਹੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: an ras saade lag rahee dukh paaeaa doojai bhaae |3|
English: It remains attached to other pleasures, and through the love of duality, it suffers in pain. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਭਨਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਏਕ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਫਰਕੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabhanaa nadar ek hai aape farak karee |
English: The One Lord grants His Grace to all; He Himself makes distinctions.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਦੇਇ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak satagur miliai fal paaeaa naam vaddaaee dee |4|2|
English: O Nanak, meeting the True Guru, the fruits are obtained, and one is blessed with the Glorious Greatness of the Naam. ||4||2||

[Ang 559 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 3 |
English: Wadahans, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohu gubaar hai gur bin giaan na hoee |
English: Emotional attachment to Maya is darkness; without the Guru, there is no wisdom.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਲਗੇ ਤਿਨ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਪਰਜ ਵਿਗੋਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sabad lage tin bujhiaa doojai paraj vigoee |1|
English: Those who are attached to the Word of the Shabad understand; duality has ruined the people. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: man mere guramat karanee saar |
English: O my mind, under Guru's Instruction, do good deeds.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa har prabh raveh taa paaveh mokh duaar |1| rahaau |
English: Dwell forever and ever upon the Lord God, and you shall find the gate of salvation. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਣਾ ਕਾ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gunaa kaa nidhaan ek hai aape dee taa ko paae |
English: The Lord alone is the treasure of virtue; He Himself gives, and then one receives.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਵਿਛੁੜੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bin naavai sabh vichhurree gur kai sabad milaae |2|
English: Without the Name, all are separated from the Lord; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one meets the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਦੇ ਘਟਿ ਗਏ ਤਿਨਾ ਹਥਿ ਕਿਹੁ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: meree meree karade ghatt ge tinaa hath kihu na aaeaa |
English: Acting in ego, they lose, and nothing comes into their hands.

Gurbani: ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: satagur miliai sach mile sach naam samaaeaa |3|
English: Meeting the True Guru, they find Truth, and merge into the True Name. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਏਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa manasaa ehu sareer hai antar jot jagaae |
English: Hope and desire abide in this body, but the Lord's Light shines within as well.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥੪॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak manamukh bandh hai guramukh mukat karaae |4|3|
English: O Nanak, the self-willed manmukhs remain in bondage; the Gurmukhs are liberated. ||4||3||

[Ang 559 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 3 |
English: Wadahans, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਸਦਾ ਮੁਖੁ ਉਜਲਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sohaaganee sadaa mukh ujalaa gur kai sehaj subhaae |
English: The faces of the happy soul-brides are radiant forever; through the Guru, they are peacefully poised.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sadaa pir raaveh aapanaa vichahu aap gavaae |1|
English: They enjoy their Husband Lord constantly, eradicating their ego from within. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: mere man too har har naam dhiaae |
English: O my mind, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: satagur mo kau har deea bujhaae |1| rahaau |
English: The True Guru has led me to understand the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਖਰੀਆ ਬਿਲਲਾਦੀਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: dohaaganee khareea bilalaadeea tinaa mehal na paae |
English: The abandoned brides cry out in their suffering; they do not attain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਕਰੂਪੀ ਦੂਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਆਗੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: doojai bhaae karoopee dookh paaveh aagai jaae |2|
English: In the love of duality, they appear so ugly; they suffer in pain as they go to the world beyond. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਨਿਤ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gunavantee nit gun ravai hiradai naam vasaae |
English: The virtuous soul-bride constantly chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord; she enshrines the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within her heart.

Gurbani: ਅਉਗਣਵੰਤੀ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aauganavantee kaamanee dukh laagai bilalaae |3|
English: The unvirtuous woman suffers, and cries out in pain. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਭਤਾਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabhanaa kaa bhataar ek hai suaamee kahanaa kichhoo na jaae |
English: The One Lord and Master is the Husband Lord of all; His Praises cannot be expressed.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਕ ਕੀਤਿਅਨੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਇਅਨੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak aape vek keetian naame leian laae |4|4|
English: O Nanak, He has separated some from Himself, while others are to His Name. ||4||4||

[Ang 559 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 3 |
English: Wadahans, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਗਾ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: amrit naam sad meetthaa laagaa gurasabadee saad aaeaa |
English: The Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam is always sweet to me; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I come to taste it.

Gurbani: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sachee baanee sehaj samaanee har jeeo man vasaaeaa |1|
English: Through the True Word of the Guru's Bani, I am merged in peace and poise; the Dear Lord is enshrined in the mind. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: har kar kirapaa sataguroo milaaeaa |
English: The Lord, showing His Mercy, has caused me to meet the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: poorai satagur har naam dhiaaeaa |1| rahaau |
English: Through the Perfect True Guru, I meditate on the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੈ ਬੇਦ ਬਾਣੀ ਪਰਗਾਸੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: brahamai bed baanee paragaasee maaeaa moh pasaaraa |
English: Through Brahma, the hymns of the Vedas were revealed, but the love of Maya spread.

Gurbani: ਮਹਾਦੇਉ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਵਰਤੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਤਾਮਸੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mahaadeo giaanee varatai ghar aapanai taamas bahut ahankaaraa |2|
English: The wise one, Shiva, remains absorbed in himself, but he is engrossed in dark passions and excessive egotism. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਿਸਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਅਵਤਾਰੀ ਰੂਧਾ ਕਿਤੁ ਲਗਿ ਤਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kisan sadaa avataaree roodhaa kit lag tarai sansaaraa |
English: Vishnu is always busy reincarnating himself - who will save the world?

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਰਤੇ ਜੁਗ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚੂਕੈ ਮੋਹ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: guramukh giaan rate jug antar chookai moh gubaaraa |3|
English: The Gurmukhs are imbued with spiritual wisdom in this age; they are rid of the darkness of emotional attachment. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: satagur sevaa te nisataaraa guramukh tarai sansaaraa |
English: Serving the True Guru, one is emancipated; the Gurmukh crosses over the world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: saachai naae rate bairaagee paaein mokh duaaraa |4|
English: The detached renunciates are imbued with the True Name; they attain the gate of salvation. ||4||

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: eko sach varatai sabh antar sabhanaa kare pratipaalaa |
English: The One True Lord is pervading and permeating everywhere; He cherishes everyone.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਕਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਸਭਨਾ ਦੀਵਾਨੁ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥੫॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak ikas bin mai avar na jaanaa sabhanaa deevaan deaalaa |5|5|
English: O Nanak, without the One Lord, I do not know any other; He is the Merciful Master of all. ||5||5||

[Ang 559 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 3 |
English: Wadahans, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh sach sanjam tat giaan |
English: The Gurmukh practices true self-discipline, and attains the essence of wisdom.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਲਗੈ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: guramukh saache lagai dhiaan |1|
English: The Gurmukh meditates on the True Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh man mere naam samaal |
English: As Gurmukh, O my mind, remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਚਲੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa nibahai chalai terai naal | rahaau |
English: It shall stand by you always, and go with you. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh jaat pat sach soe |
English: The True Lord is the social status and honor of the Gurmukh.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਖਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: guramukh antar sakhaaee prabh hoe |2|
English: Within the Gurmukh, is God, his friend and helper. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh jis no aap kare so hoe |
English: He alone becomes Gurmukh, whom the Lord so blesses.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: guramukh aap vaddaaee devai soe |3|
English: He Himself blesses the Gurmukh with greatness. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh sabad sach karanee saar |
English: The Gurmukh lives the True Word of the Shabad, and practices good deeds.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰਵਾਰੈ ਸਾਧਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੬॥
Transliteration: guramukh naanak paravaarai saadhaar |4|6|
English: The Gurmukh, O Nanak, emancipates his family and relations. ||4||6||

[Ang 560 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 3 |
English: Wadahans, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਦਿ ਲਗੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: rasanaa har saad lagee sehaj subhaae |
English: My tongue is intuitively attracted to the taste of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: man tripatiaa har naam dhiaae |1|
English: My mind is satisfied, meditating on the Name of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sukh saachai sabad veechaaree |
English: Lasting peace is obtained, contemplating the Shabad, the True Word of God.

Gurbani: ਆਪਣੇ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aapane satagur vittahu sadaa balihaaree |1| rahaau |
English: I am forever a sacrifice to my True Guru. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਖੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: akhee santokheea ek liv laae |
English: My eyes are content, lovingly focused on the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਸੰਤੋਖਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: man santokhiaa doojaa bhaau gavaae |2|
English: My mind is content, having forsaken the love of duality. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦੇਹ ਸਰੀਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: deh sareer sukh hovai sabad har naae |
English: The frame of my body is at peace, through the Shabad, and the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਮਲੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naam paramal hiradai rahiaa samaae |3|
English: The fragrance of the Naam permeates my heart. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak masatak jis vaddabhaag |
English: O Nanak, one who has such great destiny written upon his forehead,

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਹਜ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ॥੪॥੭॥
Transliteration: gur kee baanee sehaj bairaag |4|7|
English: through the Bani of the Guru's Word, easily and intuitively becomes free of desire. ||4||7||

[Ang 560 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 3 |
English: Wadahans, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: poore gur te naam paaeaa jaae |
English: From the Perfect Guru, the Naam is obtained.

Gurbani: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sachai sabad sach samaae |1|
English: Through the Shabad, the True Word of God, one merges in the True Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਏ ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਤੂ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: e man naam nidhaan too paae |
English: O my soul, obtain the treasure of the Naam,

Gurbani: ਆਪਣੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਲੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aapane gur kee man lai rajaae |1| rahaau |
English: by submitting to the Will of your Guru. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad vichahu mail gavaae |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, filth is washed away from within.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: niramal naam vasai man aae |2|
English: The Immaculate Naam comes to abide within the mind. ||2||

Gurbani: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: bharame bhoolaa firai sansaar |
English: Deluded by doubt, the world wanders around.

Gurbani: ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਜਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: mar janamai jam kare khuaar |3|
English: It dies, and is born again, and is ruined by the Messenger of Death. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: naanak se vaddabhaagee jin har naam dhiaaeaa |
English: O Nanak, very fortunate are those who meditate on the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੮॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee man vasaaeaa |4|8|
English: By Guru's Grace, they enshrine the Name within their minds. ||4||8||

[Ang 560 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 3 |
English: Wadahans, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਵਿਰੋਧੁ ਹੈ ਦੁਇ ਨ ਵਸਹਿ ਇਕ ਠਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: haumai naavai naal virodh hai due na vaseh ik tthaae |
English: Ego is opposed to the Name of the Lord; the two do not dwell in the same place.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: haumai vich sevaa na hovee taa man birathaa jaae |1|
English: In egotism, selfless service cannot be performed, and so the soul goes unfulfilled. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: har chet man mere too gur kaa sabad kamaae |
English: O my mind, think of the Lord, and practice the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨਹਿ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hukam maneh taa har milai taa vichahu haumai jaae | rahaau |
English: If you submit to the Hukam of the Lord's Command, then you shall meet with the Lord; only then will your ego depart from within. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਸਭੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਓਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: haumai sabh sareer hai haumai opat hoe |
English: Egotism is within all bodies; through egotism, we come to be born.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਡਾ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਬੁਝਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: haumai vaddaa gubaar hai haumai vich bujh na sakai koe |2|
English: Egotism is total darkness; in egotism, no one can understand anything. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: haumai vich bhagat na hovee hukam na bujhiaa jaae |
English: In egotism, devotional worship cannot be performed, and the Hukam of the Lord's Command cannot be understood.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੀਉ ਬੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: haumai vich jeeo bandh hai naam na vasai man aae |3|
English: In egotism, the soul is in bondage, and the Naam, the Name of the Lord, does not come to abide in the mind. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਈ ਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak satagur miliai haumai gee taa sach vasiaa man aae |
English: O Nanak, meeting with the True Guru, egotism is eliminated, and then, the True Lord comes to dwell in the mind||

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਸਚੇ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੯॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: sach kamaavai sach rahai sache sev samaae |4|9|12|
English: One starts practicing truth, abides in truth and by serving the True One gets absorbed in Him. ||4||9||12||

[Ang 560 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 4 ghar 1 |
English: Wadahans, Fourth Mehl, First House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸੇਜ ਏਕ ਏਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sej ek eko prabh tthaakur |
English: There is one bed, and One Lord God.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਵੇ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: guramukh har raave sukh saagar |1|
English: The Gurmukh enjoys the Lord, the ocean of peace. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਣ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਮਨਿ ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: mai prabh milan prem man aasaa |
English: My mind longs to meet my Beloved Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮੇਲਾਵੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਹਉ ਵਾਰਿ ਵਾਰਿ ਆਪਣੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਉ ਜਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur pooraa melaavai meraa preetam hau vaar vaar aapane guroo kau jaasaa |1| rahaau |
English: The Perfect Guru leads me to meet my Beloved; I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to my Guru. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਅਵਗਣ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਸਰੀਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: mai avagan bharapoor sareere |
English: My body is over-flowing with corruption;

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਲਾ ਅਪਣੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪੂਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: hau kiau kar milaa apane preetam poore |2|
English: how can I meet my Perfect Beloved? ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jin gunavantee meraa preetam paaeaa |
English: The virtuous ones obtain my Beloved;

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਮੈ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਉ ਕਿਉ ਮਿਲਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: se mai gun naahee hau kiau milaa meree maaeaa |3|
English: I do not have these virtues. How can I meet Him, O my mother? ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਕਾ ਉਪਾਵ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: hau kar kar thaakaa upaav bahutere |
English: I am so tired of making all these efforts.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਰੀਬ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak gareeb raakhahu har mere |4|1|
English: Please protect Nanak, the meek one, O my Lord. ||4||1||

[Ang 561 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 4 |
English: Wadahans, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਮੈ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: meraa har prabh sundar mai saar na jaanee |
English: My Lord God is so beautiful. I do not know His worth.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਛੋਡਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਲੋਭਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: hau har prabh chhodd doojai lobhaanee |1|
English: Abandoning my Lord God, I have become entangled in duality. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਪਿਰ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਉ ਇਆਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: hau kiau kar pir kau milau eaanee |
English: How can I meet with my Husband? I don't know.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਪਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਾਈ ਪਿਰ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਿਆਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo pir bhaavai saa sohaagan saaee pir kau milai siaanee |1| rahaau |
English: She who pleases her Husband Lord is a happy soul-bride. She meets with her Husband Lord - she is so wise. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੋਸ ਹਉ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: mai vich dos hau kiau kar pir paavaa |
English: I am filled with faults; how can I attain my Husband Lord?

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਉ ਪਿਰ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tere anek piaare hau pir chit na aavaa |2|
English: You have many loves, but I am not in Your thoughts, O my Husband Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਸਾ ਭਲੀ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ॥
Transliteration: jin pir raaviaa saa bhalee suhaagan |
English: She who enjoys her Husband Lord, is the good soul-bride.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਮੈ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੀ ਦੁਹਾਗਣਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: se mai gun naahee hau kiaa karee duhaagan |3|
English: I don't have these virtues; what can I, the discarded bride, do? ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਿਤ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: nit suhaagan sadaa pir raavai |
English: The soul-bride continually, constantly enjoys her Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਕਰਮਹੀਣ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: mai karamaheen kab hee gal laavai |4|
English: I have no good fortune; will He ever hold me close in His embrace? ||4||

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਪਿਰੁ ਗੁਣਵੰਤਾ ਹਉ ਅਉਗੁਣਿਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: too pir gunavantaa hau aauguniaaraa |
English: You, O Husband Lord, are meritorious, while I am without merit.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਬਖਸਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ॥੫॥੨॥
Transliteration: mai niragun bakhas naanak vechaaraa |5|2|
English: I am worthless; please forgive Nanak, the meek. ||5||2||

[Ang 561 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 4 ghar 2 |
English: Wadahans, Fourth Mehl, Second House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਡੀ ਆਸ ਹਰੇ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: mai man vaddee aas hare kiau kar har darasan paavaa |
English: Within my mind there is such a great yearning; how will I attain the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan?

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਜਾਇ ਪੁਛਾ ਅਪਨੇ ਸਤਗੁਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਪੁਛਿ ਮਨੁ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਸਮਝਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: hau jaae puchhaa apane satagurai gur puchh man mugadh samajhaavaa |
English: I go and ask my True Guru; with the Guru's advice, I shall teach my foolish mind.

Gurbani: ਭੂਲਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: bhoolaa man samajhai gurasabadee har har sadaa dhiaae |
English: The foolish mind is instructed in the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and meditates forever on the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak jis nadar kare meraa piaaraa so har charanee chit laae |1|
English: O Nanak, one who is blessed with the Mercy of my Beloved, focuses his consciousness on the Lord's Feet. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਸਭਿ ਵੇਸ ਕਰੀ ਪਿਰ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: hau sabh ves karee pir kaaran je har prabh saache bhaavaa |
English: I dress myself in all sorts of robes for my Husband, so that my True Lord God will be pleased.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਮੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਦੇਖੈ ਹਉ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: so pir piaaraa mai nadar na dekhai hau kiau kar dheeraj paavaa |
English: But my Beloved Husband Lord does not even cast a glance in my direction; how can I be consoled?

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਹਉ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੀ ਸੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਤਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਅਵਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jis kaaran hau seegaar seegaaree so pir rataa meraa avaraa |
English: For His sake, I adorn myself with adornments, but my Husband is imbued with the love of another.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵਿਅੜਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਵਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak dhan dhan dhan sohaagan jin pir raaviarraa sach savaraa |2|
English: O Nanak, blessed, blessed, blessed is that soul-bride, who enjoys her True, Sublime Husband Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਜਾਇ ਪੁਛਾ ਸੋਹਾਗ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਤੁਸੀ ਕਿਉ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਅੜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: hau jaae puchhaa sohaag suhaagan tusee kiau pir paaeiarraa prabh meraa |
English: I go and ask the fortunate, happy soul-bride, "How did you attain Him - your Husband Lord, my God?"

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਊਪਰਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੀ ਪਿਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਮੈ ਛੋਡਿਅੜਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: mai aoopar nadar karee pir saachai mai chhoddiarraa meraa teraa |
English: She answers, "My True Husband blessed me with His Mercy; I abandoned the distinction between mine and yours.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਜੀਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਇਤੁ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਭੈਣੇ ਮਿਲੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: sabh man tan jeeo karahu har prabh kaa it maarag bhaine mileeai |
English: Dedicate everything, mind, body and soul, to the Lord God; this is the Path to meet Him, O sister."

Gurbani: ਆਪਨੜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋਤਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਰਲੀਐ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aapanarraa prabh nadar kar dekhai naanak jot jotee raleeai |3|
English: If her God gazes upon her with favor, O Nanak, her light merges into the Light. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਮੈ ਦੇਇ ਸਨੇਹਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo har prabh kaa mai dee sanehaa tis man tan apanaa devaa |
English: I dedicate my mind and body to the one who brings me a message from my Lord God.

Gurbani: ਨਿਤ ਪਖਾ ਫੇਰੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਵਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਪਾਣੀ ਢੋਵਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: nit pakhaa feree sev kamaavaa tis aagai paanee dtovaan |
English: I wave the fan over him every day, serve him and carry water for him.

Gurbani: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: nit nit sev karee har jan kee jo har har kathaa sunaae |
English: Constantly and continuously, I serve the Lord's humble servant, who recites to me the sermon of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਆਸ ਪੁਜਾਏ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan guroo gur satigur pooraa naanak man aas pujaae |4|
English: Hail, hail unto the Guru, the Guru, the Perfect True Guru, who fulfills Nanak's heart's desires. ||4||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੇਲਿ ਹਰੇ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur sajan meraa mel hare jit mil har naam dhiaavaa |
English: O Lord, let me meet the Guru, my best friend; meeting Him, I meditate on the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਸਟਿ ਪੂਛਾਂ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਂਝੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: gur satigur paasahu har gosatt poochhaan kar saanjhee har gun gaavaan |
English: I seek the Lord's sermon from the Guru, the True Guru; joining with Him, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਸਦ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: gun gaavaa nit nit sad har ke man jeevai naam sun teraa |
English: Each and every day, forever, I sing the Lord's Praises; my mind lives by hearing Your Name.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਤੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਤੁ ਵੇਲੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak jit velaa visarai meraa suaamee tith velai mar jaae jeeo meraa |5|
English: O Nanak, that moment when I forget my Lord and Master - at that moment, my soul dies. ||5||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਵੇਖਣ ਕਉ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਲੋਚੈ ਸੋ ਵੇਖੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਵਿਖਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: har vekhan kau sabh koee lochai so vekhai jis aap vikhaale |
English: Everyone longs to see the Lord, but he alone sees Him, whom the Lord causes to see Him.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: jis no nadar kare meraa piaaraa so har har sadaa samaale |
English: One upon whom my Beloved bestows His Glance of Grace, cherishes the Lord, Har, Har forever.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: so har har naam sadaa sadaa samaale jis satagur pooraa meraa miliaa |
English: He alone cherishes the Lord, Har, Har, forever and ever, who meets my Perfect True Guru.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਇਕੇ ਹੋਏ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਲਿਆ ॥੬॥੧॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak har jan har ike hoe har jap har setee raliaa |6|1|3|
English: O Nanak, the Lord's humble servant and the Lord become One; meditating on the Lord, he blends with the Lord. ||6||1||3||

[Ang 562 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 5 ghar 1 |
English: Wadahans, Fifth Mehl, First House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਅਤਿ ਊਚਾ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: at aoochaa taa kaa darabaaraa |
English: His Darbaar, His Court, is the most lofty and exalted.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: ant naahee kichh paaraavaaraa |
English: It has no end or limitations.

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਲਖ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: kott kott kott lakh dhaavai |
English: Millions, millions, tens of millions seek,

Gurbani: ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: eik til taa kaa mehal na paavai |1|
English: but they cannot find even a tiny bit of His Mansion. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: suhaavee kaun su velaa jit prabh melaa |1| rahaau |
English: What is that auspicious moment, when God is met? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਲਾਖ ਭਗਤ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਆਰਾਧਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: laakh bhagat jaa kau aaraadheh |
English: Tens of thousands of devotees worship Him in adoration.

Gurbani: ਲਾਖ ਤਪੀਸਰ ਤਪੁ ਹੀ ਸਾਧਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: laakh tapeesar tap hee saadheh |
English: Tens of thousands of ascetics practice austere discipline.

Gurbani: ਲਾਖ ਜੋਗੀਸਰ ਕਰਤੇ ਜੋਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: laakh jogeesar karate jogaa |
English: Tens of thousands of Yogis practice Yoga.

Gurbani: ਲਾਖ ਭੋਗੀਸਰ ਭੋਗਹਿ ਭੋਗਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: laakh bhogeesar bhogeh bhogaa |2|
English: Tens of thousands of pleasure seekers seek pleasure. ||2||

Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਥੋਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt vaseh jaaneh thoraa |
English: He dwells in each and every heart, but only a few know this.

Gurbani: ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਸਾਜਣੁ ਪਰਦਾ ਤੋਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: hai koee saajan paradaa toraa |
English: Is there any friend who can rip apart the screen of separation?

Gurbani: ਕਰਉ ਜਤਨ ਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: krau jatan je hoe miharavaanaa |
English: I can only make the effort, if the Lord is merciful to me.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਦੇਈ ਜੀਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: taa kau deee jeeo kurabaanaa |3|
English: I sacrifice my body and soul to Him. ||3||

Gurbani: ਫਿਰਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਸੰਤਨ ਪਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: firat firat santan peh aaeaa |
English: After wandering around for so long, I have finally come to the Saints;

Gurbani: ਦੂਖ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਸਗਲ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: dookh bhram hamaaraa sagal mittaaeaa |
English: all of my pains and doubts have been eradicated.

Gurbani: ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਭੂੰਚਾ ॥
Transliteration: mehal bulaaeaa prabh amrit bhoonchaa |
English: God summoned me to the Mansion of His Presence, and blessed me with the Ambrosial Nectar of His Name.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਊਚਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak prabh meraa aoochaa |4|1|
English: Says Nanak, my God is lofty and exalted. ||4||1||

[Ang 562 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 5 |
English: Wadahans, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: dhan su velaa jit darasan karanaa |
English: Blessed is that time, when the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is given;

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: hau balihaaree satigur charanaa |1|
English: I am a sacrifice to the feet of the True Guru. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jeea ke daate preetam prabh mere |
English: You are the Giver of souls, O my Beloved God.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਿਤੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: man jeevai prabh naam chitere |1| rahaau |
English: My soul lives by reflecting upon the Name of God. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: sach mantru tumaaraa amrit baanee |
English: True is Your Mantra, Ambrosial is the Bani of Your Word.

Gurbani: ਸੀਤਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸੁਜਾਣੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: seetal purakh drisatt sujaanee |2|
English: Cooling and soothing is Your Presence, all-knowing is Your gaze. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਤਖਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: sach hukam tumaaraa takhat nivaasee |
English: True is Your Command; You sit upon the eternal throne.

Gurbani: ਆਇ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aae na jaavai meraa prabh abinaasee |3|
English: My eternal God does not come or go. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਦਾਸ ਹਮ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: tum miharavaan daas ham deenaa |
English: You are the Merciful Master; I am Your humble servant.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਭਰਪੁਰਿ ਲੀਣਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak saahib bharapur leenaa |4|2|
English: O Nanak, the Lord and Master is totally permeating and pervading everywhere. ||4||2||

[Ang 562 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 5 |
English: Wadahans, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: too beant ko viralaa jaanai |
English: You are infinite - only a few know this.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਕੋ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad ko sabad pachhaanai |1|
English: By Guru's Grace, some come to understand You through the Word of the Shabad. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sevak kee aradaas piaare |
English: Your servant offers this prayer, O Beloved:

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਰਣ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jap jeevaa prabh charan tumaare |1| rahaau |
English: I live by meditating on Your Feet, God. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: deaal purakh mere prabh daate |
English: O my Merciful and Almighty God, O Great Giver,

Gurbani: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਜਨਾਵਹੁ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਜਾਤੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jiseh janaavahu tineh tum jaate |2|
English: he alone knows You, whom You so bless. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa jaaee balihaaree |
English: Forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to You.

Gurbani: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਦੇਖਉ ਓਟ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: eit ut dekhau ott tumaaree |3|
English: Here and hereafter, I seek Your Protection. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਗੁਣੁ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: mohi niragun gun kichhoo na jaataa |
English: I am without virtue; I know none of Your Glorious Virtues.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧੂ ਦੇਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak saadhoo dekh man raataa |4|3|
English: O Nanak, seeing the Holy Saint, my mind is imbued with You. ||4||3||

[Ang 563 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 5 |
English: Wadahans, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: antarajaamee so prabh pooraa |
English: God is perfect - He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

Gurbani: ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: daan dee saadhoo kee dhooraa |1|
English: He blesses us with the gift of the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh deen deaalaa |
English: Bless me with Your Grace, God, O Merciful to the meek.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੀ ਓਟ ਪੂਰਨ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: teree ott pooran gopaalaa |1| rahaau |
English: I seek Your Protection, O Perfect Lord, Sustainer of the World. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jal thal maheeal rahiaa bharapoore |
English: He is totally pervading and permeating the water, the land and the sky.

Gurbani: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੂਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: nikatt vasai naahee prabh doore |2|
English: God is near at hand, not far away. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: jis no nadar kare so dhiaae |
English: One whom He blesses with His Grace, meditates on Him.

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar har ke gun gaae |3|
English: Twenty-four hours a day, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਗਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jant sagale pratipaare |
English: He cherishes and sustains all beings and creatures.

Gurbani: ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੪॥੪॥
Transliteration: saran pario naanak har duaare |4|4|
English: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord's Door. ||4||4||

[Ang 563 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 5 |
English: Wadahans, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਵਡ ਦਾਤਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: too vadd daataa antarajaamee |
English: You are the Great Giver, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sabh meh raviaa pooran prabh suaamee |1|
English: God, the Perfect Lord and Master, is permeating and pervading in all. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: mere prabh preetam naam adhaaraa |
English: The Name of my Beloved God is my only support.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hau sun sun jeevaa naam tumaaraa |1| rahaau |
English: I live by hearing, continually hearing Your Name. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: teree saran satigur mere poore |
English: I seek Your Sanctuary, O my Perfect True Guru.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੰਤਾ ਧੂਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: man niramal hoe santaa dhoore |2|
English: My mind is purified by the dust of the Saints. ||2||

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal hiradai ur dhaare |
English: I have enshrined His Lotus Feet within my heart.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਜਾਈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tere darasan kau jaaee balihaare |3|
English: I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa tere gun gaavaa |
English: Show mercy unto me, that I may sing Your Glorious Praises.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਾ ॥੪॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak naam japat sukh paavaa |4|5|
English: O Nanak, chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, I obtain peace. ||4||5||

[Ang 563 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 5 |
English: Wadahans, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang har amrit peejai |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਜੀਉ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਛੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naa jeeo marai na kabahoo chheejai |1|
English: The soul does not die, nor does it ever waste away. ||1||

Gurbani: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: vaddabhaagee gur pooraa paaeeai |
English: By great good fortune, one meets the Perfect Guru.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur kirapaa te prabhoo dhiaaeeai |1| rahaau |
English: By Guru's Grace, one meditates on God. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਰਤਨ ਜਵਾਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਣਕ ਲਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: ratan javaahar har maanak laalaa |
English: The Lord is the jewel, the pearl, the gem, the diamond.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: simar simar prabh bhe nihaalaa |2|
English: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on God, I am in ecstasy. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: jat kat pekhau saadhoo saranaa |
English: Wherever I look, I see the Sanctuary of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮਨੁ ਕਰਣਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har gun gaae niramal man karanaa |3|
English: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, my soul becomes immaculately pure. ||3||

Gurbani: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਵੂਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt antar meraa suaamee vootthaa |
English: Within each and every heart, dwells my Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤੂਠਾ ॥੪॥੬॥
Transliteration: naanak naam paaeaa prabh tootthaa |4|6|
English: O Nanak, one obtains the Naam, the Name of the Lord, when God bestows His Mercy. ||4||6||

[Ang 563 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 5 |
English: Wadahans, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਵਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: visar naahee prabh deen deaalaa |
English: Do not forget me, O God, Merciful to the meek.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: teree saran pooran kirapaalaa |1| rahaau |
English: I seek Your Sanctuary, O Perfect, Compassionate Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeh chit aaveh so thaan suhaavaa |
English: Wherever You come to mind, that place is blessed.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਤਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਹਾਵਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jit velaa visareh taa laagai haavaa |1|
English: The moment I forget You, I am stricken with regret. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਤੂ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਥੀ ॥
Transliteration: tere jeea too sad hee saathee |
English: All beings are Yours; You are their constant companion.

Gurbani: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਤੇ ਕਢੁ ਦੇ ਹਾਥੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sansaar saagar te kadt de haathee |2|
English: Please, give me Your hand, and pull me up out of this world-ocean. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣਾ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਕੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: aavan jaanaa tum hee keea |
English: Coming and going are by Your Will.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਥੀਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jis too raakheh tis dookh na theea |3|
English: One whom You save is not afflicted by suffering. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਏਕੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਹੋਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: too eko saahib avar na hor |
English: You are the One and only Lord and Master; there is no other.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਰ ਜੋਰਿ ॥੪॥੭॥
Transliteration: binau karai naanak kar jor |4|7|
English: Nanak offers this prayer with his palms pressed together. ||4||7||

[Ang 563 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 5 |
English: Wadahans, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਜਾਣਾਇਹਿ ਤਾ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: too jaanaaeihi taa koee jaanai |
English: When You allow Yourself to be known, then we know You.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਦੀਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: teraa deea naam vakhaanai |1|
English: We chant Your Name, which You have given to us. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਿਸਮਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: too acharaj kudarat teree bisamaa |1| rahaau |
English: You are wonderful! Your creative potency is amazing! ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: tudh aape kaaran aape karanaa |
English: You Yourself are the Cause of causes, You Yourself are the Creator.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਜੰਮਣੁ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਮਰਣਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: hukame jaman hukame maranaa |2|
English: By Your Will, we are born, and by Your Will, we die. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਆਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: naam teraa man tan aadhaaree |
English: Your Name is the Support of our mind and body.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਬਖਸੀਸ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੩॥੮॥
Transliteration: naanak daas bakhasees tumaaree |3|8|
English: This is Your blessing to Nanak, Your slave. ||3||8||

[Ang 564 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 5 ghar 2 |
English: Wadahans, Fifth Mehl, Second House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਚਾ ਮਿਲਣ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਉ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: merai antar lochaa milan kee piaare hau kiau paaee gur poore |
English: Deep within me, there is a longing to meet my Beloved; how can I attain my Perfect Guru?

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਖੇਲ ਖੇਲਾਈਐ ਬਾਲਕੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਖੀਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: je sau khel khelaaeeai baalak reh na sakai bin kheere |
English: Even though a baby may play hundreds of games, he cannot survive without milk.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਅੰਮਾਲੀ ਜੇ ਸਉ ਭੋਜਨ ਮੈ ਨੀਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: merai antar bhukh na utarai amaalee je sau bhojan mai neere |
English: The hunger within me is not satisfied, O my friend, even though I am served hundreds of dishes.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਪਿਰੰਮ ਕਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: merai man tan prem piram kaa bin darasan kiau man dheere |1|
English: My mind and body are filled with love for my Beloved; how can my soul find relief, without the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan? ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਜਣ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਭਾਈ ਮੈ ਮੇਲਿਹੁ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: sun sajan mere preetam bhaaee mai melihu mitru sukhadaataa |
English: Listen, O my dear friends and siblings - lead me to my True Friend, the Giver of peace.

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਸਭ ਬੇਦਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਬਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: ohu jeea kee meree sabh bedan jaanai nit sunaavai har keea baataa |
English: He knows all the troubles of my soul; every day, he tells me stories of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਾ ਜਿਉ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕੁ ਜਲ ਕਉ ਬਿਲਲਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: hau ik khin tis bin reh na sakaa jiau chaatrik jal kau bilalaataa |
English: I cannot live without Him, even for an instant. I cry out for Him, just as the song-bird cries for the drop of water.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਲੀ ਮੈ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਕਉ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਤਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: hau kiaa gun tere saar samaalee mai niragun kau rakh letaa |2|
English: Which of Your Glorious Virtues should I sing? You save even worthless beings like me. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਭਈ ਉਡੀਣੀ ਕੰਤ ਕਉ ਅੰਮਾਲੀ ਸੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਕਦਿ ਨੈਣੀ ਦੇਖਾ ॥
Transliteration: hau bhee uddeenee kant kau amaalee so pir kad nainee dekhaa |
English: I have become depressed, waiting for my Husband Lord, O my friend; when shall my eyes behold my Husband?

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣ ਵਿਸਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਲੇਖਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabh ras bhogan visare bin pir kitai na lekhaa |
English: I have forgotten how to enjoy all pleasures; without my Husband Lord, they are of no use at all.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਕਾਪੜੁ ਤਨਿ ਨ ਸੁਖਾਵਈ ਕਰਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਹਉ ਵੇਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: eihu kaaparr tan na sukhaavee kar na skau hau vesaa |
English: These clothes do not please my body; I cannot dress myself.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਖੀ ਲਾਲੁ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਤਿਨ ਆਗੈ ਹਮ ਆਦੇਸਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jinee sakhee laal raaviaa piaaraa tin aagai ham aadesaa |3|
English: I bow to those friends of mine, who have enjoyed their Beloved Husband Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਸਭਿ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਅੰਮਾਲੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: mai sabh seegaar banaaeaa amaalee bin pir kaam na aae |
English: I have adorned myself with all sorts of decorations, O my friend, but without my Husband Lord, they are of no use at all.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਸਹਿ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਪੁਛੀਆ ਅੰਮਾਲੀ ਤਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jaa seh baat na puchheea amaalee taa birathaa joban sabh jaae |
English: When my Husband does not care for me, O my friend, then my youth passes, totally useless.

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਤੇ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਅੰਮਾਲੀ ਜਿਨ ਸਹੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan te sohaaganee amaalee jin sahu rahiaa samaae |
English: Blessed, blessed are the happy soul-brides, O my friend, who are blended with their Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਅੰਮਾਲੀ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਧੋਵਾ ਸਦ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: hau vaariaa tin sohaaganee amaalee tin ke dhovaa sad paae |4|
English: I am a sacrifice to those happy soul-brides; I wash their feet again and again. ||4||

Gurbani: ਜਿਚਰੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਸਾ ਅੰਮਾਲੀ ਤਿਚਰੁ ਮੈ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jichar doojaa bharam saa amaalee tichar mai jaaniaa prabh doore |
English: As long as I suffered from duality and doubt, O my friend, I thought God was far away.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਅੰਮਾਲੀ ਤਾ ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਸਭ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jaa miliaa pooraa satiguroo amaalee taa aasaa manasaa sabh poore |
English: But when I met the Perfect True Guru, O my friend, then all my hopes and desires were fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਆ ਅੰਮਾਲੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਸਰਬ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: mai sarab sukhaa sukh paaeaa amaalee pir sarab rahiaa bharapoore |
English: I have obtained all pleasures and comforts, O my friend; my Husband Lord is all-pervading everywhere.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਿਆ ਅੰਮਾਲੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਲਗਿ ਪੈਰੇ ॥੫॥੧॥੯॥
Transliteration: jan naanak har rang maaniaa amaalee gur satigur kai lag paire |5|1|9|
English: Servant Nanak enjoys the Lord's Love, O my friend; I fall at the feet of the Guru, the True Guru. ||5||1||9||

[Ang 564 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 3 asattapadeea |
English: Wadahans, Third Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਧੁਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sachee baanee sach dhun sach sabad veechaaraa |
English: True is the Bani of His Word, and True is the melody; True is contemplative meditation on the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਣਾ ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਵਡਭਾਗ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: anadin sach salaahanaa dhan dhan vaddabhaag hamaaraa |1|
English: Night and day, I praise the True Lord. Blessed, blessed is my great good fortune. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: man mere saache naam vittahu bal jaau |
English: O my mind, let yourself be a sacrifice to the True Name.

Gurbani: ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ਰਹਹਿ ਤਾ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: daasan daasaa hoe raheh taa paaveh sachaa naau |1| rahaau |
English: If you become the slave of the Lord's slaves, you shall obtain the True Name. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਸਚੀ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੀ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jihavaa sachee sach ratee tan man sachaa hoe |
English: True is the tongue which is imbued with Truth, and true are the mind and body.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਹੋਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਜਾਸਹਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਖੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bin saache hor saalaahanaa jaaseh janam sabh khoe |2|
English: By praising any other than the True Lord, one's whole life is wasted. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਖੇਤੀ ਸਚੁ ਬੀਜਣਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sach khetee sach beejanaa saachaa vaapaaraa |
English: Let Truth be the farm, Truth the seed, and Truth the merchandise you trade.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: anadin laahaa sach naam dhan bhagat bhare bhanddaaraa |3|
English: Night and day, you shall earn the profit of the Lord's Name; you shall have the treasure overflowing with the wealth of devotional worship. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਪੈਨਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਟੇਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sach khaanaa sach painanaa sach ttek har naau |
English: Let Truth be your food, and let Truth be your clothes; let your True Support be the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਖਸੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਹਲੀ ਪਾਏ ਥਾਉ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jis no bakhase tis milai mahalee paae thaau |4|
English: One who is so blessed by the Lord, obtains a seat in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||4||

Gurbani: ਆਵਹਿ ਸਚੇ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: aaveh sache jaaveh sache fir joonee mool na paeh |
English: In Truth we come, and in Truth we go, and then, we are not consigned to reincarnation again.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰ ਹਹਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: guramukh dar saachai sachiaar heh saache maeh samaeh |5|
English: The Gurmukhs are hailed as True in the True Court; they merge in the True Lord. ||5||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਨਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: antar sachaa man sachaa sachee sifat sanaae |
English: Deep within they are True, and their minds are True; they sing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਚੈ ਥਾਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: sachai thaan sach saalaahanaa satigur balihaarai jaau |6|
English: In the true place, they praise the True Lord; I am a sacrifice to the True Guru. ||6||

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਮੂਰਤੁ ਸਚੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sach velaa moorat sach jit sache naal piaar |
English: True is the time, and true is the moment, when one falls in love with the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਵੇਖਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਸਚਾ ਸਭੁ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: sach vekhanaa sach bolanaa sachaa sabh aakaar |7|
English: Then, he sees Truth, and speaks the Truth; he realizes the True Lord pervading the entire Universe. ||7||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਤਾ ਮਿਲੇ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak sachai mele taa mile aape le milaae |
English: O Nanak, one merges with the True Lord, when He merges with Himself.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਖਸੀ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੮॥੧॥
Transliteration: jiau bhaavai tiau rakhasee aape kare rajaae |8|1|
English: As it pleases Him, He preserves us; He Himself ordains His Will. ||8||1||

[Ang 565 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 3 |
English: Wadahans, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨੂਆ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਵਦਾ ਓਹੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: manooaa deh dis dhaavadaa ohu kaise har gun gaavai |
English: His mind wanders in the ten directions - how can he sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord?

Gurbani: ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਵਿਆਪਿ ਰਹੀ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਨਿਤ ਸੰਤਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: eindree viaap rahee adhikaaee kaam krodh nit santaavai |1|
English: The sensory organs are totally engrossed in sensuality; sexual desire and anger constantly afflict him. ||1||

Gurbani: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: vaahu vaahu sahaje gun raveejai |
English: Waaho! Waaho! Hail! Hail! Chant His Glorious Praises.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਦੁਲਭੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam is jug meh dulabh hai guramat har ras peejai |1| rahaau |
English: The Lord's Name is so difficult to obtain in this age; under Guru's Instruction, drink in the subtle essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੁ ਚੀਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: sabad cheen man niramal hovai taa har ke gun gaavai |
English: Remembering the Word of the Shabad, the mind becomes immaculately pure, and then, one sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਤਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: guramatee aapai aap pachhaanai taa nij ghar vaasaa paavai |2|
English: Under Guru's Instruction, one comes to understand his own self, and then, he comes to dwell in the home of his inner self. ||2||

Gurbani: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: e man mere sadaa rang raate sadaa har ke gun gaau |
English: O my mind, be imbued forever with the Lord's Love, and sing forever the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har niramal sadaa sukhadaataa man chindiaa fal paau |3|
English: The Immaculate Lord is forever the Giver of peace; from Him, one receives the fruits of his heart's desires. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਨੀਚ ਸੇ ਊਤਮ ਭਏ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ham neech se aootam bhe har kee saranaaee |
English: I am lowly, but I have been exalted, entering the Sanctuary of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਪਾਥਰੁ ਡੁਬਦਾ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੀਆ ਸਾਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: paathar ddubadaa kaadt leea saachee vaddiaaee |4|
English: He has lifted up the sinking stone; True is His glorious greatness. ||4||

Gurbani: ਬਿਖੁ ਸੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਏ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: bikh se amrit bhe guramat budh paaee |
English: From poison, I have been transformed into Ambrosial Nectar; under Guru's Instruction, I have obtained wisdom.

Gurbani: ਅਕਹੁ ਪਰਮਲ ਭਏ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਾਸਨਾ ਵਸਾਈ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: akahu paramal bhe antar vaasanaa vasaaee |5|
English: From bitter herbs, I have been transformed into sandalwood; this fragrance permeates me deep within. ||5||

Gurbani: ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਦੁਲੰਭੁ ਹੈ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਖਟਿਆ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: maanas janam dulanbh hai jag meh khattiaa aae |
English: This human birth is so precious; one must earn the right to come into the world.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: poorai bhaag satigur milai har naam dhiaae |6|
English: By perfect destiny, I met the True Guru, and I meditate on the Lord's Name. ||6||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭੂਲੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਲਗੇ ਅਹਿਲਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh bhoole bikh lage ahilaa janam gavaaeaa |
English: The self-willed manmukhs are deluded; attached to corruption, they waste away their lives in vain.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam sadaa sukh saagar saachaa sabad na bhaaeaa |7|
English: The Name of the Lord is forever an ocean of peace, but the manmukhs do not love the Word of the Shabad. ||7||

Gurbani: ਮੁਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਕਰੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: mukhahu har har sabh ko karai viralai hiradai vasaaeaa |
English: Everyone can chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har with their mouths, but only a few enshrine it within their hearts.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਿਆ ਮੋਖ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਤਿਨੑ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੮॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak jin kai hiradai vasiaa mokh mukat tina paaeaa |8|2|
English: O Nanak, those who enshrine the Lord within their hearts, attain liberation and emancipation. ||8||2||

[Ang 565 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਛੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 1 chhant |
English: Wadahans, First Mehl, Chhant:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੂੜਿ ਵਿਗਾੜਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਨਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa koorr vigaarr kaahe naaeeai |
English: Why bother to wash the body, polluted by falsehood?

Gurbani: ਨਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: naataa so paravaan sach kamaaeeai |
English: One's cleansing bath is only approved, if he practices Truth.

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਸਾਚ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਾਚਾ ਤਾਮਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: jab saach andar hoe saachaa taam saachaa paaeeai |
English: When there is Truth within the heart, then one becomes True, and obtains the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਲਿਖੇ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਬੋਲਿ ਬੋਲਿ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: likhe baajhahu surat naahee bol bol gavaaeeai |
English: Without pre-ordained destiny, understanding is not attained; talking and babbling, one wastes his life away.

Gurbani: ਜਿਥੈ ਜਾਇ ਬਹੀਐ ਭਲਾ ਕਹੀਐ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਲਿਖਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: jithai jaae baheeai bhalaa kaheeai surat sabad likhaaeeai |
English: Wherever you go and sit, speak well, and write the Word of the Shabad in your consciousness.

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੂੜਿ ਵਿਗਾੜਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਨਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa koorr vigaarr kaahe naaeeai |1|
English: Why bother to wash the body which is polluted by falsehood? ||1||

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਮੈ ਕਹਿਆ ਕਹਣੁ ਜਾ ਤੁਝੈ ਕਹਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: taa mai kahiaa kehan jaa tujhai kahaaeaa |
English: When I have spoken, I spoke as You made me speak.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: amrit har kaa naam merai man bhaaeaa |
English: The Ambrosial Name of the Lord is pleasing to my mind.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਦੂਖਿ ਡੇਰਾ ਢਾਹਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: naam meetthaa maneh laagaa dookh dderaa dtaahiaa |
English: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, seems so sweet to my mind; it has destroyed the dwelling of pain.

Gurbani: ਸੂਖੁ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਆਇ ਵਸਿਆ ਜਾਮਿ ਤੈ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sookh man meh aae vasiaa jaam tai furamaaeaa |
English: Peace came to dwell in my mind, when You gave the Order.

Gurbani: ਨਦਰਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਨਿ ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: nadar tudh aradaas meree jin aap upaaeaa |
English: It is Yours to bestow Your Grace, and it is mine to speak this prayer; You created Yourself.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਮੈ ਕਹਿਆ ਕਹਣੁ ਜਾ ਤੁਝੈ ਕਹਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: taa mai kahiaa kehan jaa tujhai kahaaeaa |2|
English: When I have spoken, I spoke as You made me speak. ||2||

Gurbani: ਵਾਰੀ ਖਸਮੁ ਕਢਾਏ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: vaaree khasam kadtaae kirat kamaavanaa |
English: The Lord and Master gives them their turn, according to the deeds they have done.

Gurbani: ਮੰਦਾ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਆਖਿ ਝਗੜਾ ਪਾਵਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: mandaa kisai na aakh jhagarraa paavanaa |
English: Do not speak ill of others, or get involved in arguments.

Gurbani: ਨਹ ਪਾਇ ਝਗੜਾ ਸੁਆਮਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੁ ਵਞਾਵਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: neh paae jhagarraa suaam setee aap aap vayaavanaa |
English: Do not get into arguments with the Lord, or you shall ruin yourself.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਰੀਕੀ ਜਾਇ ਕਿਆ ਰੂਆਵਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: jis naal sangat kar sareekee jaae kiaa rooaavanaa |
English: If you challenge the One, with whom you must abide, you will cry in the end.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਦੇਇ ਸਹਣਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਕਹਣਾ ਆਖਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਵਾਵਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo dee sahanaa maneh kahanaa aakh naahee vaavanaa |
English: Be satisfied with what God gives you; tell your mind not to complain uselessly.

Gurbani: ਵਾਰੀ ਖਸਮੁ ਕਢਾਏ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: vaaree khasam kadtaae kirat kamaavanaa |3|
English: The Lord and Master gives them their turn, according to the deeds they have done. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਉਪਾਈਅਨੁ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sabh upaaeean aap aape nadar kare |
English: He Himself created all, and He blesses then with His Glance of Grace.

Gurbani: ਕਉੜਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮਾਗੈ ਮੀਠਾ ਸਭ ਮਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: kaurraa koe na maagai meetthaa sabh maagai |
English: No one asks for that which is bitter; everyone asks for sweets.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ਮੀਠਾ ਮੰਗਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਖਸਮ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sabh koe meetthaa mang dekhai khasam bhaavai so kare |
English: Let everyone ask for sweets, and behold, it is as the Lord wills.

Gurbani: ਕਿਛੁ ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਅਨੇਕ ਕਰਣੀ ਨਾਮ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਸਮਸਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kichh pun daan anek karanee naam tul na samasare |
English: Giving donations to charity, and performing various religious rituals are not equal to the contemplation of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: naanakaa jin naam miliaa karam hoaa dhur kade |
English: O Nanak, those who are blessed with the Naam have had such good karma pre-ordained.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਉਪਾਈਅਨੁ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: sabh upaaeean aap aape nadar kare |4|1|
English: He Himself created all, and He blesses them with His Glance of Grace. ||4||1||

[Ang 566 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 1 |
English: Wadahans, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਰਹੁ ਦਇਆ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: karahu deaa teraa naam vakhaanaa |
English: Show mercy to me, that I may chant Your Name.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਉਪਾਈਐ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੇ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabh upaaeeai aap aape sarab samaanaa |
English: You Yourself created all, and You are pervading among all.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬੇ ਸਮਾਣਾ ਆਪਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਉਪਾਇ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: sarabe samaanaa aap toohai upaae dhandhai laaeea |
English: You Yourself are pervading among all, and You link them to their tasks.

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਕੀਏ ਰਾਜੇ ਇਕਨਾ ਭਿਖ ਭਵਾਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: eik tujh hee kee raaje ikanaa bhikh bhavaaeea |
English: Some, You have made kings, while others go about begging.

Gurbani: ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਤੁਝੁ ਕੀਆ ਮੀਠਾ ਏਤੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: lobh mohu tujh keea meetthaa et bharam bhulaanaa |
English: You have made greed and emotional attachment seem sweet; they are deluded by this delusion.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਅਪਣੀ ਤਾਮਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sadaa deaa karahu apanee taam naam vakhaanaa |1|
English: Be ever merciful to me; only then can I chant Your Name. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਦਾ ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: naam teraa hai saachaa sadaa mai man bhaanaa |
English: Your Name is True, and ever pleasing to my mind.

Gurbani: ਦੂਖੁ ਗਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਆਇ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: dookh geaa sukh aae samaanaa |
English: My pains are dispelled, and I am permeated with peace.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਸੁਘੜ ਸੁਜਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: gaavan sur nar sugharr sujaanaa |
English: The angels, the mortals and the silent sages sing of You.

Gurbani: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਸੁਘੜ ਸੁਜਾਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਜੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: sur nar sugharr sujaan gaaveh jo terai man bhaavahe |
English: The angels, the mortals and the silent sages sing of You; they are pleasing to Your Mind.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੇ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਹਿਲਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohe cheteh naahee ahilaa janam gavaavahe |
English: Enticed by Maya, they do not remember the Lord, and they waste away their lives in vain.

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਮੂਲੇ ਜੋ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: eik moorr mugadh na cheteh moole jo aaeaa tis jaanaa |
English: Some fools and idiots never think of the Lord; whoever has come, shall have to go.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naam teraa sadaa saachaa soe mai man bhaanaa |2|
English: Your Name is True, and ever pleasing to my mind. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਵਖਤੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: teraa vakhat suhaavaa amrit teree baanee |
English: Beauteous is Your time, O Lord; the Bani of Your Word is Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਸਾਉ ਪਰਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: sevak seveh bhaau kar laagaa saau paraanee |
English: Your servants serve You with love; these mortals are attached to Your essence.

Gurbani: ਸਾਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਤਿਨਾ ਲਾਗਾ ਜਿਨੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: saau praanee tinaa laagaa jinee amrit paaeaa |
English: Those mortals are attached to Your essence, who are blessed with the Ambrosial Name.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਜੋਇ ਰਾਤੇ ਨਿਤ ਚੜਹਿ ਸਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: naam terai joe raate nit charreh savaaeaa |
English: Those who are imbued with Your Name, prosper more and more, day by day.

Gurbani: ਇਕੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਜਾਮਿ ਨ ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: eik karam dharam na hoe sanjam jaam na ek pachhaanee |
English: Some do not practice good deeds, or live righteously; nor do they practice self-restraint. They do not realize the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਵਖਤੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: vakhat suhaavaa sadaa teraa amrit teree baanee |3|
English: Ever beauteous is Your time, O Lord; the Bani of Your Word is Ambrosial Nectar. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: hau balihaaree saache naavai |
English: I am a sacrifice to the True Name.

Gurbani: ਰਾਜੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: raaj teraa kabahu na jaavai |
English: Your rule shall never end.

Gurbani: ਰਾਜੋ ਤ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਏਹੁ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਵਏ ॥
Transliteration: raajo ta teraa sadaa nihachal ehu kabahu na jaave |
English: Your rule is eternal and unchanging; it shall never come to an end.

Gurbani: ਚਾਕਰੁ ਤ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੋਇ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੋਇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਏ ॥
Transliteration: chaakar ta teraa soe hovai joe sehaj samaave |
English: He alone becomes Your servant, who contemplates You in peaceful ease.

Gurbani: ਦੁਸਮਨੁ ਤ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਮੂਲੇ ਪਾਪੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਏ ॥
Transliteration: dusaman ta dookh na lagai moole paap nerr na aave |
English: Enemies and pains shall never touch him, and sin shall never draw near him.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਦਾ ਹੋਵਾ ਏਕ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਵਏ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: hau balihaaree sadaa hovaa ek tere naave |4|
English: I am forever a sacrifice to the One Lord, and Your Name. ||4||

Gurbani: ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗੰਤਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jugah jugantar bhagat tumaare |
English: Throughout the ages, Your devotees sing the Kirtan of Your Praises,

Gurbani: ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੇਰੈ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: keerat kareh suaamee terai duaare |
English: O Lord Master, at Your Door.

Gurbani: ਜਪਹਿ ਤ ਸਾਚਾ ਏਕੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: japeh ta saachaa ek muraare |
English: They meditate on the One True Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਾ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ਤਾਮਿ ਜਾਪਹਿ ਜਾਮਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: saachaa muraare taam jaapeh jaam man vasaavahe |
English: Only then do they meditate on the True Lord, when they enshrine Him in their minds.

Gurbani: ਭਰਮੋ ਭੁਲਾਵਾ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਕੀਆ ਜਾਮਿ ਏਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: bharamo bhulaavaa tujheh keea jaam ehu chukaavahe |
English: Doubt and delusion are Your making; when these are dispelled,

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੇਹੁ ਜਮਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee karahu kirapaa lehu jamahu ubaare |
English: then, by Guru's Grace, You grant Your Grace, and save them from the noose of Death.

Gurbani: ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗੰਤਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: jugah jugantar bhagat tumaare |5|
English: Throughout the ages, they are Your devotees. ||5||

Gurbani: ਵਡੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: vadde mere saahibaa alakh apaaraa |
English: O my Great Lord and Master, You are unfathomable and infinite.

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਹਉ ਆਖਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: kiau kar krau benantee hau aakh na jaanaa |
English: How should I make and offer my prayer? I do not know what to say.

Gurbani: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਤਾ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: nadar kareh taa saach pachhaanaa |
English: If You bless me with Your Glance of Grace, I realize the Truth.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੋ ਪਛਾਣਾ ਤਾਮਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਾਮਿ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਵਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: saacho pachhaanaa taam teraa jaam aap bujhaavahe |
English: Only then do I come to realize the Truth, when You Yourself instruct me.

Gurbani: ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਸਹਸਾ ਏਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: dookh bhookh sansaar kee sahasaa ehu chukaavahe |
English: The pain and hunger of the world are Your making; dispel this doubt.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਾਇ ਸਹਸਾ ਬੁਝੈ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak jaae sahasaa bujhai gur beechaaraa |
English: Prays Nanak, ones skepticism is taken away, when he understands the Guru's wisdom.

Gurbani: ਵਡਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਹੈ ਆਪਿ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: vaddaa saahib hai aap alakh apaaraa |6|
English: The Great Lord Master is unfathomable and infinite. ||6||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੇ ਬੰਕੇ ਲੋਇਣ ਦੰਤ ਰੀਸਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: tere banke loein dant reesaalaa |
English: Your eyes are so beautiful, and Your teeth are delightful.

Gurbani: ਸੋਹਣੇ ਨਕ ਜਿਨ ਲੰਮੜੇ ਵਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: sohane nak jin lamarre vaalaa |
English: Your nose is so graceful, and Your hair is so long.

Gurbani: ਕੰਚਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਸੁਇਨੇ ਕੀ ਢਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: kanchan kaaeaa sueine kee dtaalaa |
English: Your body is so precious, cast in gold.

Gurbani: ਸੋਵੰਨ ਢਾਲਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਮਾਲਾ ਜਪਹੁ ਤੁਸੀ ਸਹੇਲੀਹੋ ॥
Transliteration: sovan dtaalaa krisan maalaa japahu tusee saheleeho |
English: His body is cast in gold, and He wears Krishna's mala; meditate on Him, O sisters.

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਹੁ ਖੜੀਆ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਮਹੇਲੀਹੋ ॥
Transliteration: jam duaar na hohu kharreea sikh sunahu maheleeho |
English: You shall not have to stand at Death's door, O sisters, if you listen to these teachings.

Gurbani: ਹੰਸ ਹੰਸਾ ਬਗ ਬਗਾ ਲਹੈ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਜਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: hans hansaa bag bagaa lahai man kee jaalaa |
English: From a crane, you shall be transformed into a swan, and the filth of your mind shall be removed.

Gurbani: ਬੰਕੇ ਲੋਇਣ ਦੰਤ ਰੀਸਾਲਾ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: banke loein dant reesaalaa |7|
English: Your eyes are so beautiful, and Your teeth are delightful. ||7||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੀ ਚਾਲ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਮਧੁਰਾੜੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: teree chaal suhaavee madhuraarree baanee |
English: Your walk is so graceful, and Your speech is so sweet.

Gurbani: ਕੁਹਕਨਿ ਕੋਕਿਲਾ ਤਰਲ ਜੁਆਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: kuhakan kokilaa taral juaanee |
English: You coo like a songbird, and your youthful beauty is alluring.

Gurbani: ਤਰਲਾ ਜੁਆਣੀ ਆਪਿ ਭਾਣੀ ਇਛ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪੂਰੀਏ ॥
Transliteration: taralaa juaanee aap bhaanee ichh man kee pooree |
English: Your youthful beauty is so alluring; it pleases You, and it fulfills the heart's desires.

Gurbani: ਸਾਰੰਗ ਜਿਉ ਪਗੁ ਧਰੈ ਠਿਮਿ ਠਿਮਿ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੁ ਸੰਧੂਰਏ ॥
Transliteration: saarang jiau pag dharai tthim tthim aap aap sandhoore |
English: Like an elephant, You step with Your Feet so carefully; You are satisfied with Yourself.

Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰੀਰੰਗ ਰਾਤੀ ਫਿਰੈ ਮਾਤੀ ਉਦਕੁ ਗੰਗਾ ਵਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: sreerang raatee firai maatee udak gangaa vaanee |
English: She who is imbued with the Love of such a Great Lord, flows intoxicated, like the waters of the Ganges.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਚਾਲ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਮਧੁਰਾੜੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੮॥੨॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak daas har kaa teree chaal suhaavee madhuraarree baanee |8|2|
English: Prays Nanak, I am Your slave, O Lord; Your walk is so graceful, and Your speech is so sweet. ||8||2||

[Ang 567 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਛੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 3 chhant |
English: Wadahans, Third Mehl, Chhant:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਆਪਣੇ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੀ ਮੁਈਏ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aapane pir kai rang ratee mueee sobhaavantee naare |
English: Let yourself be imbued with the Love of your Husband Lord, O beautiful, mortal bride.

Gurbani: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀ ਮੁਈਏ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sachai sabad mil rahee mueee pir raave bhaae piaare |
English: Let yourself remain merged in the True Word of the Shabad, O mortal bride; savor and enjoy the Love of your Beloved Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਚੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਕੰਤਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sachai bhaae piaaree kant savaaree har har siau nehu rachaaeaa |
English: The Husband Lord embellishes His beloved bride with His True Love; she is in love with the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਤਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aap gavaaeaa taa pir paaeaa gur kai sabad samaaeaa |
English: Renouncing her self-centeredness, she attains her Husband Lord, and remains merged in the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕਸਾਈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: saa dhan sabad suhaaee prem kasaaee antar preet piaaree |
English: That soul bride is adorned, who is attracted by His Love, and who treasures the Love of her Beloved within her heart.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਈ ਪਿਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਹਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak saa dhan mel lee pir aape saachai saeh savaaree |1|
English: O Nanak, the Lord blends that soul bride with Himself; the True King adorns her. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਗੁਣਵੰਤੜੀਏ ਪਿਰੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਹਦੂਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: niragunavantarree pir dekh hadoore raam |
English: O worthless bride, see your Husband Lord ever-present.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਮੁਈਏ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh jinee raaviaa mueee pir rav rahiaa bharapoore raam |
English: One who, as Gurmukh, enjoys her Husband Lord, O mortal bride, knows Him to be all-pervading everywhere.

Gurbani: ਪਿਰੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ਵੇਖੁ ਹਜੂਰੇ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: pir rav rahiaa bharapoore vekh hajoore jug jug eko jaataa |
English: The Lord is all-pervading everywhere; behold Him ever-present. Throughout the ages, know Him as the One.

Gurbani: ਧਨ ਬਾਲੀ ਭੋਲੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਰਾਵੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: dhan baalee bholee pir sehaj raavai miliaa karam bidhaataa |
English: The young, innocent bride enjoys her Husband Lord; she meets Him, the Architect of karma.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਖਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਿ ਰਹੀ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jin har ras chaakhiaa sabad subhaakhiaa har sar rahee bharapoore |
English: One who tastes the sublime essence of the Lord, and utters the sublime Word of the Shabad, remains immersed in the Lord's Ambrosial Pool.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਸਾ ਪਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਰਹੈ ਹਦੂਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak kaaman saa pir bhaavai sabade rahai hadoore |2|
English: O Nanak, that soul bride is pleasing to her Husband Lord, who, through the Shabad, remains in His Presence. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਾਇ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਮੁਈਏ ਜਿਨੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sohaaganee jaae poochhahu mueee jinee vichahu aap gavaaeaa |
English: Go and ask the happy soul-brides, O mortal bride, who have eradicated their self-conceit from within.

Gurbani: ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਮੁਈਏ ਜਿਨੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: pir kaa hukam na paaeo mueee jinee vichahu aap na gavaaeaa |
