English: Those who have not eradicated their self-conceit, O mortal bride, do not realize the Hukam of their Husband Lord's Command.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਤਿਨੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: jinee aap gavaaeaa tinee pir paaeaa rang siau raleea maanai |
English: Those who eradicate their self-conceit, obtain their Husband Lord; they delight in His Love.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa rang raatee sahaje maatee anadin naam vakhaanai |
English: Ever imbued with His Love, in perfect poise and grace, she repeats His Name, night and day.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਸੁਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kaaman vaddabhaagee antar liv laagee har kaa prem subhaaeaa |
English: Very fortunate is that bride, who focuses her consciousness on Him; her Lord's Love is so sweet to her.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਾਤੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak kaaman sahaje raatee jin sach seegaar banaaeaa |3|
English: O Nanak, that soul-bride who is adorned with Truth, is imbued with her Lord's Love, in the state of perfect poise. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮੁਈਏ ਤੂ ਚਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: haumai maar mueee too chal gur kai bhaae |
English: Overcome your egotism, O mortal bride, and walk in the Guru's Way.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਰਾਵਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਮੁਈਏ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: har var raaveh sadaa mueee nij ghar vaasaa paae |
English: Thus you shall ever enjoy your Husband Lord, O mortal bride, and obtain an abode in the home of your own inner being.

Gurbani: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਏ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਏ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: nij ghar vaasaa paae sabad vajaae sadaa suhaagan naaree |
English: Obtaining an abode in the home of her inner being, she vibrates the Word of the Shabad, and is a happy soul-bride forever.

Gurbani: ਪਿਰੁ ਰਲੀਆਲਾ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਬਾਲਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਕੰਤਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: pir raleeaalaa joban baalaa anadin kant savaaree |
English: The Husband Lord is delightful, and forever young; night and day, He embellishes His bride.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਸੋਹਾਗੋ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੋ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: har var sohaago masatak bhaago sachai sabad suhaae |
English: Her Husband Lord activates the destiny written on her forehead, and she is adorned with the True Shabad.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਜਾ ਚਲੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਏ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak kaaman har rang raatee jaa chalai satigur bhaae |4|1|
English: O Nanak, the soul-bride is imbued with the Love of the Lord, when she walks according to the Will of the True Guru. ||4||1||

[Ang 568 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 3 |
English: Wadahans, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਭੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ਭਲਾ ਜੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਕੀਜੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh sabh vaapaar bhalaa je sahaje keejai raam |
English: All dealings of the Gurmukh are good, if they are accomplished with poise and grace.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: anadin naam vakhaaneeai laahaa har ras peejai raam |
English: Night and day, he repeats the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and he earns his profits, drinking in the subtle essence of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਲੀਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਵੀਜੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: laahaa har ras leejai har raaveejai anadin naam vakhaanai |
English: He earns the profit of the subtle essence of the Lord, meditating on the Lord, and repeating the Naam, night and day.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਵਿਕਣਹਿ ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: gun sangreh avagan vikaneh aapai aap pachhaanai |
English: He gathers in merits, and eliminates demerits, and realizes his own self.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: guramat paaee vaddee vaddiaaee sachai sabad ras peejai |
English: Under Guru's Instruction, he is blessed with glorious greatness; he drinks in the essence of the True Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak har kee bhagat niraalee guramukh viralai keejai |1|
English: O Nanak, devotional worship of the Lord is wonderful, but only a few Gurmukhs perform it. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੇਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬੀਜੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਲੀਜੈ ਸਰੀਰਿ ਜਮਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh khetee har antar beejeeai har leejai sareer jamaae raam |
English: As Gurmukh, plant the crop of the Lord within the field of your body, and let it grow.

Gurbani: ਆਪਣੇ ਘਰ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਭੁੰਚੁ ਤੂ ਲਾਹਾ ਲੈ ਪਰਥਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: aapane ghar andar ras bhunch too laahaa lai parathaae raam |
English: Within the home of your own being, enjoy the Lord's subtle essence, and earn profits in the world hereafter.

Gurbani: ਲਾਹਾ ਪਰਥਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ਧਨੁ ਖੇਤੀ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: laahaa parathaae har man vasaae dhan khetee vaapaaraa |
English: This profit is earned by enshrining the Lord within your mind; blessed is this farming and trade.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har naam dhiaae man vasaae boojhai gur beechaaraa |
English: Meditating on the Lord's Name, and enshrining Him within your mind, you shall come to understand the Guru's Teachings.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਖੇਤੀ ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh khetee vanaj kar thaake trisanaa bhukh na jaae |
English: The self-willed manmukhs have grown weary of this farming and trade; their hunger and thirst will not go away.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੀਜਿ ਮਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naam beej man andar sachai sabad subhaae |2|
English: O Nanak, plant the seed of the Name within your mind, and adorn yourself with the True Word of the Shabad. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਵਾਪਾਰਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਲਾਗੇ ਜਿਨਾ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਮਣੀ ਵਡਭਾਗੋ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: har vaapaar se jan laage jinaa masatak manee vaddabhaago raam |
English: Those humble beings engage in the Lord's Trade, who have the jewel of such pre-ordained destiny upon their foreheads.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੋ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: guramatee man nij ghar vasiaa sachai sabad bairaago raam |
English: Under Guru's Instruction, the soul dwells in the home of the self; through the True Word of the Shabad, she becomes unattached.

Gurbani: ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੋ ਸਚਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੋ ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: mukh masatak bhaago sach bairaago saach rate veechaaree |
English: By the destiny written upon their foreheads, they become truly unattached, and by reflective meditation, they are imbued with Truth.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਬਉਰਾਨਾ ਸਬਦੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: naam binaa sabh jag bauraanaa sabade haumai maaree |
English: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the whole world is insane; through the Shabad, the ego is conquered.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਮਤਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੋਹਾਗੋ ॥
Transliteration: saachai sabad laag mat upajai guramukh naam sohaago |
English: Attached to the True Word of the Shabad, wisdom comes forth. The Gurmukh obtains the Naam, the Name of the Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਵੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੋ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak sabad milai bhau bhanjan har raavai masatak bhaago |3|
English: O Nanak, through the Shabad, one meets the Lord, the Destroyer of fear, and by the destiny written on her forehead, she enjoys Him. ||3||

Gurbani: ਖੇਤੀ ਵਣਜੁ ਸਭੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: khetee vanaj sabh hukam hai hukame man vaddiaaee raam |
English: All farming and trading is by Hukam of His Will; surrendering to the Lord's Will, glorious greatness is obtained.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੂਝੀਐ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: guramatee hukam boojheeai hukame mel milaaee raam |
English: Under Guru's Instruction, one comes to understand the Lord's Will, and by His Will, he is united in His Union.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: hukam milaaee sehaj samaaee gur kaa sabad apaaraa |
English: By His Will, one merges and easily blends with Him. The Shabads of the Guru are incomparable.

Gurbani: ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ਸਚੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sachee vaddiaaee gur te paaee sach savaaranahaaraa |
English: Through the Guru, true greatness is obtained, and one is embellished with Truth.

Gurbani: ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: bhau bhanjan paaeaa aap gavaaeaa guramukh mel milaaee |
English: He finds the Destroyer of fear, and eradicates his self-conceit; as Gurmukh, he is united in His Union.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak naam niranjan agam agochar hukame rahiaa samaaee |4|2|
English: Says Nanak, the Name of the immaculate, inaccessible, unfathomable Commander is permeating and pervading everywhere. ||4||2||

[Ang 569 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 3 |
English: Wadahans, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਤੂ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: man meriaa too sadaa sach samaal jeeo |
English: O my mind, contemplate the True Lord forever.

Gurbani: ਆਪਣੈ ਘਰਿ ਤੂ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਪੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: aapanai ghar too sukh vaseh pohi na sakai jamakaal jeeo |
English: Dwell in peace in the home of your own self, and the Messenger of Death shall not touch you.

Gurbani: ਕਾਲੁ ਜਾਲੁ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: kaal jaal jam johi na saakai saachai sabad liv laae |
English: The noose of the Messenger of Death shall not touch you, when you embrace love for the True Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਚਿ ਰਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sach rataa man niramal aavan jaan rahaae |
English: Ever imbued with the True Lord, the mind becomes immaculate, and its coming and going is ended.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਰਮਿ ਵਿਗੁਤੀ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮੋਹੀ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: doojai bhaae bharam vigutee manamukh mohee jamakaal |
English: The love of duality and doubt have ruined the self-willed manmukh, who is lured away by the Messenger of Death.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kahai naanak sun man mere too sadaa sach samaal |1|
English: Says Nanak, listen, O my mind: contemplate the True Lord forever. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਨ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: man meriaa antar terai nidhaan hai baahar vasat na bhaal |
English: O my mind, the treasure is within you; do not search for it on the outside.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਭੁੰਚਿ ਤੂ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: jo bhaavai so bhunch too guramukh nadar nihaal |
English: Eat only that which is pleasing to the Lord, and as Gurmukh, receive the blessing of His Glance of Grace.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh nadar nihaal man mere antar har naam sakhaaee |
English: As Gurmukh, receive the blessing of His Glance of Grace, O my mind; the Name of the Lord, your help and support, is within you.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਹੂਣੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh andhule giaan vihoone doojai bhaae khuaaee |
English: The self-willed manmukhs are blind, and devoid of wisdom; they are ruined by the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਛੂਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਭ ਬਾਧੀ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: bin naavai ko chhoottai naahee sabh baadhee jamakaal |
English: Without the Name, no one is emancipated. All are bound by the Messenger of Death.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਤੂ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਨ ਭਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak antar terai nidhaan hai too baahar vasat na bhaal |2|
English: O Nanak, the treasure is within you; do not search for it on the outside. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਇਕਿ ਸਚਿ ਲਗੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: man meriaa janam padaarath paae kai ik sach lage vaapaaraa |
English: O my mind, obtaining the blessing of this human birth, some are engaged in the trade of Truth.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sevan aapanaa antar sabad apaaraa |
English: They serve their True Guru, and the Infinite Word of the Shabad resounds within them.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: antar sabad apaaraa har naam piaaraa naame nau nidh paaee |
English: Within them is the Infinite Shabad, and the Beloved Naam, the Name of the Lord; through the Naam, the nine treasures are obtained.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਦੂਖਿ ਸੰਤਾਪੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh maaeaa moh viaape dookh santaape doojai pat gavaaee |
English: The self-willed manmukhs are engrossed in emotional attachment to Maya; they suffer in pain, and through duality, they lose their honor.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: haumai maar sach sabad samaane sach rate adhikaaee |
English: But those who conquer their ego, and merge in the True Shabad, are totally imbued with Truth.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਦੁਲੰਭੁ ਹੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak maanas janam dulanbh hai satigur boojh bujhaaee |3|
English: O Nanak, it is so difficult to obtain this human life; the True Guru imparts this understanding. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: man mere satigur sevan aapanaa se jan vaddabhaagee raam |
English: O my mind, those who serve their True Guru are the most fortunate beings.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੇ ਪੁਰਖ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: jo man maareh aapanaa se purakh bairaagee raam |
English: Those who conquer their minds are beings of renunciation and detachment.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਸਚਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: se jan bairaagee sach liv laagee aapanaa aap pachhaaniaa |
English: They are beings of renunciation and detachment, who lovingly focus their consciousness on the True Lord; they realize and understand their own selves.

Gurbani: ਮਤਿ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਅਤਿ ਗੂੜੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: mat nihachal at goorree guramukh sahaje naam vakhaaniaa |
English: Their intellect is steady, deep and profound; as Gurmukh, they naturally chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਇਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਹਿਤਕਾਰੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸੋਇ ਰਹੇ ਅਭਾਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: eik kaaman hitakaaree maaeaa mohi piaaree manamukh soe rahe abhaage |
English: Some are lovers of beautiful young women; emotional attachment to Maya is very dear to them. The unfortunate self-willed manmukhs remain asleep.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੇ ॥੪॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak sahaje seveh gur apanaa se poore vaddabhaage |4|3|
English: O Nanak, those who intuitively serve their Guru, have perfect destiny. ||4||3||

[Ang 569 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 3 |
English: Wadahans, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਵਣਜੀਅਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: ratan padaarath vanajeeeh satigur deea bujhaaee raam |
English: Purchase the jewel, the invaluable treasure; the True Guru has given this understanding.

Gurbani: ਲਾਹਾ ਲਾਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: laahaa laabh har bhagat hai gun meh gunee samaaee raam |
English: The profit of profits is the devotional worship of the Lord; one's virtues merge into the virtues of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਏ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਲਾਹਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੈਸਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gun meh gunee samaae jis aap bujhaae laahaa bhagat saisaare |
English: One's virtues merge into the virtues of the Lord; he comes to understand his own self. He earns the profit of devotional worship in this world.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਦੂਜੈ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: bin bhagatee sukh na hoee doojai pat khoee guramat naam adhaare |
English: Without devotion, there is no peace; through duality, one's honor is lost, but under Guru's Instruction, he is blessed with the Support of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਵਖਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਲਾਭੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਏਤੁ ਵਾਪਾਰਿ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: vakhar naam sadaa laabh hai jis no et vaapaar laae |
English: He ever earns the profit of the merchandise of the Naam, whom the Lord employs in this Trade.

Gurbani: ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਵਣਜੀਅਹਿ ਜਾਂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ratan padaarath vanajeeeh jaan satigur dee bujhaae |1|
English: He purchases the jewel, the invaluable treasure, unto whom the True Guru has given this understanding. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਖੋਟਾ ਇਹੁ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohu sabh dukh hai khottaa ihu vaapaaraa raam |
English: The love of Maya is totally painful; this is a bad deal.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਵਣੀ ਬਹੁ ਵਧਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: koorr bol bikh khaavanee bahu vadheh vikaaraa raam |
English: Speaking falsehood, one eats poison, and the evil within increases greatly.

Gurbani: ਬਹੁ ਵਧਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ਸਹਸਾ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: bahu vadheh vikaaraa sahasaa ihu sansaaraa bin naavai pat khoee |
English: The evil within increases greatly, in this world of doubt; without the Name, one's honor is lost.

Gurbani: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਵਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: parr parr panddit vaad vakhaaneh bin boojhe sukh na hoee |
English: Reading and studying, the religious scholars argue and debate; but without understanding, there is no peace.

Gurbani: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aavan jaanaa kade na chookai maaeaa moh piaaraa |
English: Their comings and goings never end; emotional attachment to Maya is dear to them.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਖੋਟਾ ਇਹੁ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohu sabh dukh hai khottaa ihu vaapaaraa |2|
English: The love of Maya is totally painful; this is a bad deal. ||2||

Gurbani: ਖੋਟੇ ਖਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਪਰਖੀਅਨਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਚੇ ਕੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: khotte khare sabh parakheean tith sache kai darabaaraa raam |
English: The counterfeit and the genuine are all assayed in the Court of the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਖੋਟੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੁਟੀਅਨਿ ਊਭੇ ਕਰਨਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: khotte daragah sutteean aoobhe karan pukaaraa raam |
English: The counterfeit are cast out of the Court, and they stand there, crying out in misery.

Gurbani: ਊਭੇ ਕਰਨਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ਮੁਗਧ ਗਵਾਰਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aoobhe karan pukaaraa mugadh gavaaraa manamukh janam gavaaeaa |
English: They stand there, crying out in misery; the foolish, idiotic, self-willed manmukhs have wasted their lives.

Gurbani: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bikhiaa maaeaa jin jagat bhulaaeaa saachaa naam na bhaaeaa |
English: Maya is the poison which has deluded the world; it does not love the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸੰਤਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਵੈਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਖਟੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh santaa naal vair kar dukh khatte sansaaraa |
English: The self-willed manmukhs are resentful toward the Saints; they harvest only pain in this world.

Gurbani: ਖੋਟੇ ਖਰੇ ਪਰਖੀਅਨਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਵਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: khotte khare parakheean tith sachai daravaaraa raam |3|
English: The counterfeit and the genuine are assayed in that True Court of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਹੋਰੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: aap kare kis aakheeai hor karanaa kichhoo na jaaee raam |
English: He Himself acts; who else should I ask? No one else can do anything.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਸੀ ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: jit bhaavai tith laaeisee jiau tis dee vaddiaaee raam |
English: As He pleases, He engages us; such is His glorious greatness.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਈ ਵਰੀਆਮੁ ਨ ਫੁਸੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jiau tis dee vaddiaaee aap karaaee vareeaam na fusee koee |
English: Such is His glorious greatness - He Himself causes all to act; no one is a warrior or a coward.

Gurbani: ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਕਰਮਿ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jagajeevan daataa karam bidhaataa aape bakhase soee |
English: The Life of the World, the Great Giver, the Architect of karma - He Himself grants forgiveness.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee aap gavaaeeai naanak naam pat paaee |
English: By Guru's Grace, self-conceit is eradicated, O Nanak, and through the Naam, honor is obtained.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਹੋਰੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੪॥੪॥
Transliteration: aap kare kis aakheeai hor karanaa kichhoo na jaaee |4|4|
English: He Himself acts; who else should I ask? No one else can do anything. ||4||4||

[Ang 570 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 3 |
English: Wadahans, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਸਉਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਸਚਾ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa saudaa har naam hai sachaa vaapaaraa raam |
English: The True merchandise is the Lord's Name. This is the true trade.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਣਜੀਐ ਅਤਿ ਮੋਲੁ ਅਫਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: guramatee har naam vanajeeai at mol afaaraa raam |
English: Under Guru's Instruction, we trade in the Lord's Name; its value is very great.

Gurbani: ਅਤਿ ਮੋਲੁ ਅਫਾਰਾ ਸਚ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ਸਚਿ ਵਾਪਾਰਿ ਲਗੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: at mol afaaraa sach vaapaaraa sach vaapaar lage vaddabhaagee |
English: The value of this true trade is very great; those who are engaged in the true trade are very fortunate.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: antar baahar bhagatee raate sach naam liv laagee |
English: Inwardly and outwardly, they are imbued with devotion, and they enshrine love for the True Name.

Gurbani: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: nadar kare soee sach paae gur kai sabad veechaaraa |
English: One who is blessed with the Lord's Favor, obtains Truth, and reflects upon the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਚੈ ਕੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak naam rate tin hee sukh paaeaa saachai ke vaapaaraa |1|
English: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Name find peace; they deal only in the True Name. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹੰਉਮੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੈਲੁ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੀਜੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: hnaumai maaeaa mail hai maaeaa mail bhareejai raam |
English: Egotistical involvement in Maya is filth; Maya is overflowing with filth.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: guramatee man niramalaa rasanaa har ras peejai raam |
English: Under Guru's Instruction, the mind is made pure and the tongue tastes the subtle essence of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: rasanaa har ras peejai antar bheejai saach sabad beechaaree |
English: The tongue tastes the subtle essence of the Lord, and deep within, the heart is drenched with His Love, contemplating the True Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਖੂਹਟਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਭਰਿਆ ਸਬਦੇ ਕਾਢਿ ਪੀਐ ਪਨਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: antar khoohattaa amrit bhariaa sabade kaadt peeai panihaaree |
English: Deep within, the well of the heart is overflowing with the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar; the water-carrier draws and drinks in the water of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਸਚਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: jis nadar kare soee sach laagai rasanaa raam raveejai |
English: One who is blessed with the Lord's favor is attuned to the Truth; with his tongue, he chants the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਰ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naam rate se niramal hor haumai mail bhareejai |2|
English: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are immaculate. The others are full of the filth of egotism. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਜੋਤਕੀ ਸਭਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਕੂਕਦੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: panddit jotakee sabh parr parr kookade kis peh kareh pukaaraa raam |
English: All the religious scholars and astrologers read and study, and argue and shout. Who are they trying to teach?

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohu antar mal laagai maaeaa ke vaapaaraa raam |
English: The filth of attachment to Maya clings to their hearts; they deal in Maya alone.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ਜਗਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਵਣਿ ਜਾਣਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa ke vaapaaraa jagat piaaraa aavan jaan dukh paaee |
English: They love to deal in Maya in this world; coming and going, they suffer in pain.

Gurbani: ਬਿਖੁ ਕਾ ਕੀੜਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗਾ ਬਿਸ੍ਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: bikh kaa keerraa bikh siau laagaa bisattaa maeh samaaee |
English: The worm of poison is addicted to poison; it is immersed in manure.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋਇ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo dhur likhiaa soe kamaavai koe na mettanahaaraa |
English: He does what is pre-ordained for him; no one can erase his destiny.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹੋਰਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਕੂਕਿ ਮੁਏ ਗਾਵਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak naam rate tin sadaa sukh paaeaa hor moorakh kook mue gaavaaraa |3|
English: O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, lasting peace is found; the ignorant fools die screaming. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗਿਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਸੁਧਿ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohi man rangiaa mohi sudh na kaaee raam |
English: Their minds are colored by emotional attachment to Maya; because of this emotional attachment, they do not understand.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗੀਐ ਦੂਜਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਜਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh ihu man rangeeai doojaa rang jaaee raam |
English: The soul of the Gurmukh is imbued with the Lord's Love; the love of duality departs.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਜਾਈ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਸਚਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: doojaa rang jaaee saach samaaee sach bhare bhanddaaraa |
English: The love of duality departs, and the soul merges in Truth; the warehouse is overflowing with Truth.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਚਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh hovai soee boojhai sach savaaranahaaraa |
English: One who becomes Gurmukh, comes to understand; the Lord embellishes him with Truth.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aape mele so har milai hor kahanaa kichhoo na jaae |
English: He alone merges with the Lord, whom the Lord causes to merge; nothing else can be said or done.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਇਕਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਏ ॥੪॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak vin naavai bharam bhulaaeaa ik naam rate rang laae |4|5|
English: O Nanak, without the Name, one is deluded by doubt; but some, imbued with the Name, enshrine love for the Lord. ||4||5||

[Ang 571 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 3 |
English: Wadahans, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਚਿ ਨਿਬੇੜਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: e man meriaa aavaa gaun sansaar hai ant sach niberraa raam |
English: O my mind, the world comes and goes in birth and death; only the True Name shall emancipate you in the end.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਚਾ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਫੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: aape sachaa bakhas le fir hoe na feraa raam |
English: When the True Lord Himself grants forgiveness, then one does not have to enter the cycle of reincarnation again.

Gurbani: ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਫੇਰਾ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਚਿ ਨਿਬੇੜਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: fir hoe na feraa ant sach niberraa guramukh milai vaddiaaee |
English: He does not have to enter the cycle of reincarnation again, and he is emancipated in the end; as Gurmukh, he obtains glorious greatness.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: saachai rang raate sahaje maate sahaje rahe samaaee |
English: Imbued with love for the True Lord, he is intoxicated with celestial bliss, and he remains absorbed in the Celestial Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ਸਚੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਅੰਤਿ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa man bhaaeaa sach vasaaeaa sabad rate ant niberaa |
English: The True Lord is pleasing to his mind; he enshrines the True Lord in his mind; attuned to the Word of the Shabad, he is emancipated in the end.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਭਵਜਲਿ ਫੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak naam rate se sach samaane bahur na bhavajal feraa |1|
English: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Naam, merge in the True Lord; they are not cast into the terrifying world-ocean again. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਬਰਲੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohu sabh baral hai doojai bhaae khuaaee raam |
English: Emotional attachment to Maya is total madness; through the love of duality, one is ruined.

Gurbani: ਮਾਤਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਹੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਹੇਤੇ ਪਲਚਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: maataa pitaa sabh het hai hete palachaaee raam |
English: Mother and father - all are subject to this love; in this love, they are entangled.

Gurbani: ਹੇਤੇ ਪਲਚਾਈ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਕਮਾਈ ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: hete palachaaee purab kamaaee mett na sakai koee |
English: They are entangled in this love, on account of their past actions, which no one can erase.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਾਜੀ ਸੋ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jin srisatt saajee so kar vekhai tis jevadd avar na koee |
English: The One who created the Universe, beholds it; no other is as great as He.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧਾ ਤਪਿ ਤਪਿ ਖਪੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh andhaa tap tap khapai bin sabadai saant na aaee |
English: The blind, self-willed manmukh is consumed by his burning rage; without the Word of the Shabad, peace is not obtained.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਭੁਲਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਖੁਆਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak bin naavai sabh koee bhulaa maaeaa mohi khuaaee |2|
English: O Nanak, without the Name, everyone is deluded, ruined by emotional attachment to Maya. ||2||

Gurbani: ਏਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਜਲਤਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ ਭਜਿ ਪਏ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: ehu jag jalataa dekh kai bhaj pe har saranaaee raam |
English: Seeing that this world on fire, I have hurried to the Sanctuary of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਕਰਂੀ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਆਗੈ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: aradaas karanee gur poore aagai rakh levahu dehu vaddaaee raam |
English: I offer my prayer to the Perfect Guru: please save me, and bless me with Your glorious greatness.

Gurbani: ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: rakh levahu saranaaee har naam vaddaaee tudh jevadd avar na daataa |
English: Preserve me in Your Sanctuary, and bless me with the glorious greatness of the Name of the Lord; there is no other Giver as great as You.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੇ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੇ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: sevaa laage se vaddabhaage jug jug eko jaataa |
English: Those who are engaged in serving You are very fortunate; throughout the ages, they know the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jat sat sanjam karam kamaavai bin gur gat nahee paaee |
English: You may practice celibacy, truth, austere self-discipline and rituals, but without the Guru, you shall not be emancipated.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਜੋ ਜਾਇ ਪਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak tis no sabad bujhaae jo jaae pavai har saranaaee |3|
English: O Nanak, he alone understands the Word of the Shabad, who goes and seeks the Lord's Sanctuary. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਇ ਸਾ ਊਪਜੈ ਹੋਰ ਮਤਿ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: jo har mat dee saa aoopajai hor mat na kaaee raam |
English: That understanding, imparted by the Lord, wells up; there is no other understanding.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: antar baahar ek too aape dehi bujhaaee raam |
English: Deep within, and beyond as well, You alone are, O Lord; You Yourself impart this understanding.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: aape dehi bujhaaee avar na bhaaee guramukh har ras chaakhiaa |
English: One whom He Himself blesses with this understanding, does not love any other. As Gurmukh, he tastes the subtle essence of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਖਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: dar saachai sadaa hai saachaa saachai sabad subhaakhiaa |
English: In the True Court, he is forever True; with love, he chants the True Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ghar meh nij ghar paaeaa satigur dee vaddaaee |
English: Within his home, he finds the home of his own being; the True Guru blesses him with glorious greatness.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇਈ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਮਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਈ ॥੪॥੬॥
Transliteration: naanak jo naam rate seee mehal paaein mat paravaan sach saaee |4|6|
English: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence; their understanding is true, and approved. ||4||6||

[Ang 572 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਛੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 4 chhant |
English: Wadahans, Fourth Mehl, Chhant:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: merai man merai man satigur preet lagaaee raam |
English: My mind, my mind - the True Guru has blessed it with the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: har har har har naam merai man vasaaee raam |
English: He has enshrined the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har, within my mind.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ਸਭਿ ਦੂਖ ਵਿਸਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam merai man vasaaee sabh dookh visaaranahaaraa |
English: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, dwells within my mind; He is the Destroyer of all pain.

Gurbani: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: vaddabhaagee gur darasan paaeaa dhan dhan satiguroo hamaaraa |
English: By great good fortune, I have obtained the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan; blessed, blessed is my True Guru.

Gurbani: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aootthat baitthat satigur sevah jit seviai saant paaee |
English: While standing up and sitting down, I serve the True Guru; serving Him, I have found peace.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: merai man merai man satigur preet lagaaee |1|
English: My mind, my mind - the True Guru has blessed it with the Lord's Love. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਰਸੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: hau jeevaa hau jeevaa satigur dekh sarase raam |
English: I live, I live, and I blossom forth, beholding the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਗਸੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: har naamo har naam drirraae jap har har naam vigase raam |
English: The Name of the Lord, the Name of the Lord, He has implanted within me; chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I blossom forth.

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਮਲ ਪਰਗਾਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਵੰ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jap har har naam kamal paragaase har naam navan nidh paaee |
English: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the heart-lotus blossoms forth, and through the Name of the Lord, I have obtained the nine treasures.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਥਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: haumai rog geaa dukh laathaa har sehaj samaadh lagaaee |
English: The disease of egotism has been eradicated, suffering has been eliminated, and I have entered the Lord's state of celestial Samaadhi.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੇਵ ਮਨੁ ਪਰਸੇ ॥
Transliteration: har naam vaddaaee satigur te paaee sukh satigur dev man parase |
English: I have obtained the glorious greatness of Name of the Lord from the True Guru; beholding the Divine True Guru, my mind is at peace.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਰਸੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: hau jeevaa hau jeevaa satigur dekh sarase |2|
English: I live, I live, and I blossom forth, beholding the True Guru. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਆਣਿ ਕੋਈ ਆਣਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: koee aan koee aan milaavai meraa satigur pooraa raam |
English: If only someone would come, if only someone would come, and lead me to meet my Perfect True Guru.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਦੇਵਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਟਿ ਸਰੀਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: hau man tan hau man tan devaa tis kaatt sareeraa raam |
English: My mind and body, my mind and body - I cut my body into pieces, and I dedicate these to Him.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਕਾਟਿ ਕਾਟਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਈ ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: hau man tan kaatt kaatt tis deee jo satigur bachan sunaae |
English: Cutting my mind and body apart, cutting them into pieces, I offer these to the one, who recites to me the Words of the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਭਇਆ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: merai man bairaag bheaa bairaagee mil gur darasan sukh paae |
English: My unattached mind has renounced the world; obtaining the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan, it has found peace.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਦੇਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਹਮ ਧੂਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har har kripaa karahu sukhadaate dehu satigur charan ham dhooraa |
English: O Lord, Har, Har, O Giver of Peace, please, grant Your Grace, and bless me with the dust of the feet of the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਆਣਿ ਕੋਈ ਆਣਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: koee aan koee aan milaavai meraa satigur pooraa |3|
English: If only someone would come, if only someone would come, and lead me to meet my Perfect True Guru. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: gur jevadd gur jevadd daataa mai avar na koee raam |
English: A Giver as great as the Guru, as great as the Guru - I cannot see any other.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦਾਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: har daano har daan devai har purakh niranjan soee raam |
English: He blesses me with the gift of the Lord's Name, the gift of the Lord's Name; He is the Immaculate Lord God.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam jinee aaraadhiaa tin kaa dukh bharam bhau bhaagaa |
English: Those who worship in adoration the Name of the Lord, Har, Har - their pain, doubts and fears are dispelled.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਕ ਭਾਇ ਮਿਲੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: sevak bhaae mile vaddabhaagee jin gur charanee man laagaa |
English: Through their loving service, those very fortunate ones, whose minds are attached to the Guru's Feet, meet Him.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak har aap milaae mil satigur purakh sukh hoee |
English: Says Nanak, the Lord Himself causes us to meet the Guru; meeting the Almighty True Guru, peace is obtained.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur jevadd gur jevadd daataa mai avar na koee |4|1|
English: A Giver as great as the Guru, as great as the Guru - I cannot see any other. ||4||1||

[Ang 572 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 4 |
English: Wadahans, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹੰਉ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਹੰਉ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਖਰੀ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: hnau gur bin hnau gur bin kharee nimaanee raam |
English: Without the Guru, I am - without the Guru, I am totally dishonored.

Gurbani: ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: jagajeevan jagajeevan daataa gur mel samaanee raam |
English: The Life of the World, the Life of the World, the Great Giver has led me to meet and merge with the Guru.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: satigur mel har naam samaanee jap har har naam dhiaaeaa |
English: Meeting with the True Guru, I have merged into the Naam, the Name of the Lord. I chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and meditate on it.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਹੰਉ ਢੂੰਢਿ ਢੂਢੇਦੀ ਸੋ ਸਜਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jis kaaran hnau dtoondt dtoodtedee so sajan har ghar paaeaa |
English: I was seeking and searching for Him, the Lord, my best friend, and I have found Him within the home of my own being.

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸ੍ਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: ek drisatt har eko jaataa har aatam raam pachhaanee |
English: I see the One Lord, and I know the One Lord; I realize Him within my soul.

Gurbani: ਹੰਉ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਹੰਉ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਖਰੀ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: hnau gur bin hnau gur bin kharee nimaanee |1|
English: Without the Guru, I am - without the Guru, I am totally dishonored. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: jinaa satigur jin satigur paaeaa tin har prabh mel milaae raam |
English: Those who have found the True Guru, the True Guru, the Lord God unites them in His Union.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਚਰਣ ਤਿਨ ਚਰਣ ਸਰੇਵਹ ਹਮ ਲਾਗਹ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਪਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: tin charan tin charan sarevah ham laagah tin kai paae raam |
English: Their feet, their feet, I adore; I fall at their feet.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਸਰੇਵਹ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧੵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: har har charan sarevah tin ke jin satigur purakh prabh dhayaaeaa |
English: O Lord, Har, Har, I adore the feet of those who meditate on the True Guru, and the Almighty Lord God.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਵਡਦਾਤਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਸਰਧਾ ਪੂਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: too vaddadaataa antarajaamee meree saradhaa poor har raaeaa |
English: You are the Greatest Giver, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts; please, reward my faith, O Lord King.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮੇਲਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਸਰਧਾ ਪੂਰੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gurasikh mel meree saradhaa pooree anadin raam gun gaae |
English: Meeting the Gursikh, my faith is rewarded; night and day, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jin satigur jin satigur paaeaa tin har prabh mel milaae |2|
English: Those who have found the True Guru, the True Guru, the Lord God unites them in His Union. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹੰਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਹੰਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮੀਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: hnau vaaree hnau vaaree gurasikh meet piaare raam |
English: I am a sacrifice, I am a sacrifice to the Gursikhs, my dear friends.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਾਏ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: har naamo har naam sunaae meraa preetam naam adhaare raam |
English: They chant the Lord's Name, the Lord's Name; the Beloved Naam, the Name of the Lord, is my only Support.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸਖਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੜੀ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਹੀ ਜੀਵਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam meraa praan sakhaaee tis bin gharree nimakh nahee jeevaan |
English: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is the companion of my breath of life; without it, I cannot live for an instant or a moment.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: har har kripaa kare sukhadaataa guramukh amrit peevaan |
English: The Lord, Har, Har, the Giver of peace, shows His Mercy, and the Gurmukh drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸਰਧਾ ਲਾਇ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har aape saradhaa laae milaae har aape aap savaare |
English: The Lord blesses him with faith, and unites him in His Union; He Himself adorns him.

Gurbani: ਹੰਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਹੰਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮੀਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: hnau vaaree hnau vaaree gurasikh meet piaare |3|
English: I am a sacrifice, I am a sacrifice to the Gursikhs, my dear friends. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: har aape har aape purakh niranjan soee raam |
English: The Lord Himself, the Lord Himself, is the Immaculate Almighty Lord God.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੈ ਕਰੈ ਸੋ ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: har aape har aape melai karai so hoee raam |
English: The Lord Himself, the Lord Himself, unites us with Himself; that which He does, comes to pass.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jo har prabh bhaavai soee hovai avar na karanaa jaaee |
English: Whatever is pleasing to the Lord God, that alone comes to pass; nothing else can be done.

Gurbani: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਲਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: bahut siaanap leaa na jaaee kar thaake sabh chaturaaee |
English: Even by very clever tricks, He cannot be obtained; all have grown weary of practicing cleverness.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad jan naanak dekhiaa mai har bin avar na koee |
English: By Guru's Grace, servant Nanak beholds the Lord; without the Lord, I have no other at all.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: har aape har aape purakh niranjan soee |4|2|
English: The Lord Himself, the Lord Himself, is the Immaculate Almighty Lord God. ||4||2||

[Ang 573 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 4 |
English: Wadahans, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਹਮ ਭਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: har satigur har satigur mel har satigur charan ham bhaaeaa raam |
English: The Lord, the True Guru, the Lord, the True Guru - if only I could meet the Lord, the True Guru; His Lotus Feet are so pleasing to me.

Gurbani: ਤਿਮਰ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: timar agiaan gavaaeaa gur giaan anjan gur paaeaa raam |
English: The darkness of my ignorance was dispelled, when the Guru applied the healing ointment of spiritual wisdom to my eyes.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧੇਰ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur giaan anjan satiguroo paaeaa agiaan andher binaase |
English: The True Guru has applied the healing ointment of spiritual wisdom to my eyes, and the darkness of ignorance has been dispelled.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸੇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sev param pad paaeaa har japiaa saas giraase |
English: Serving the Guru, I have obtained the supreme status; I meditate on the Lord with every breath, and every morsel of food.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕੰਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਤੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jin knau har prabh kirapaa dhaaree te satigur sevaa laaeaa |
English: Those, upon whom the Lord God has bestowed His Grace, are committed to the service of the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਹਮ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har satigur har satigur mel har satigur charan ham bhaaeaa |1|
English: The Lord, the True Guru, the Lord, the True Guru - if only I could meet the Lord, the True Guru; His Lotus Feet are so pleasing to me. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: meraa satigur meraa satigur piaaraa mai gur bin rehan na jaaee raam |
English: My True Guru, my True Guru is my Beloved; without the Guru, I cannot live.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: har naamo har naam devai meraa ant sakhaaee raam |
English: He gives me the Name of the Lord, the Name of the Lord, my only companion in the end.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam meraa ant sakhaaee gur satigur naam drirraaeaa |
English: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is my only companion in the end; the Guru, the True Guru, has implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me.

Gurbani: ਜਿਥੈ ਪੁਤੁ ਕਲਤ੍ਰੁ ਕੋਈ ਬੇਲੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਿਥੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਛਡਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jithai put kalatru koee belee naahee tithai har har naam chhaddaaeaa |
English: There, where neither child nor spouse shall accompany you, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har shall emancipate you.

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan satigur purakh niranjan jit mil har naam dhiaaee |
English: Blessed, blessed is the True Guru, the Immaculate, Almighty Lord God; meeting Him, I meditate on the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: meraa satigur meraa satigur piaaraa mai gur bin rehan na jaaee |2|
English: My True Guru, my True Guru is my Beloved; without the Guru, I cannot live. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: jinee darasan jinee darasan satigur purakh na paaeaa raam |
English: Those who have not obtained the Blessed Vision, the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the True Guru, the Almighty Lord God,

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਨਿਹਫਲੁ ਤਿਨ ਨਿਹਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: tin nihafal tin nihafal janam sabh brithaa gavaaeaa raam |
English: they have fruitlessly, fruitlessly wasted their whole lives in vain.

Gurbani: ਨਿਹਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਿਨ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਸਾਕਤ ਮੁਏ ਮਰਿ ਝੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: nihafal janam tin brithaa gavaaeaa te saakat mue mar jhoore |
English: They have wasted away their whole lives in vain; those faithless cynics die a regretful death.

Gurbani: ਘਰਿ ਹੋਦੈ ਰਤਨਿ ਪਦਾਰਥਿ ਭੂਖੇ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਹਰਿ ਦੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: ghar hodai ratan padaarath bhookhe bhaagaheen har doore |
English: They have the jewel-treasure in their own homes, but still, they are hungry; those unlucky wretches are far away from the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਨ ਕਰੀਅਹੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: har har tin kaa daras na kareeahu jinee har har naam na dhiaaeaa |
English: O Lord, please, let me not see those who do not meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har,

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jinee darasan jinee darasan satigur purakh na paaeaa |3|
English: and who have not obtained the Blessed Vision, the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the True Guru, the Almighty Lord God. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਹਮ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਦੀਨ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਸਿ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: ham chaatrik ham chaatrik deen har paas benantee raam |
English: I am a song-bird, I am a meek song-bird; I offer my prayer to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਹਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਰਹ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: gur mil gur mel meraa piaaraa ham satigur karah bhagatee raam |
English: If only I could meet the Guru, meet the Guru, O my Beloved; I dedicate myself to the devotional worship of the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਰਹ ਭਗਤੀ ਜਾਂ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har har satigur karah bhagatee jaan har prabh kirapaa dhaare |
English: I worship the Lord, Har, Har, and the True Guru; the Lord God has granted His Grace.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਬੇਲੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਹਮੑਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: mai gur bin avar na koee belee gur satigur praan hamaare |
English: Without the Guru, I have no other friend. The Guru, the True Guru, is my very breath of life.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜ੍ਹਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak gur naam drirrhaaeaa har har naam har satee |
English: Says Nanak, the Guru has implanted the Naam within me; the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the True Name.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਹਮ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਦੀਨ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਸਿ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ॥੪॥੩॥
Transliteration: ham chaatrik ham chaatrik deen har paas benantee |4|3|
English: I am a song-bird, I am a meek song-bird; I offer my prayer to the Lord. ||4||3||

[Ang 574 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 4 |
English: Wadahans, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: har kirapaa har kirapaa kar satigur mel sukhadaataa raam |
English: O Lord, show Your Mercy, show Your Mercy, and let me meet the True Guru, the Giver of peace.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਪੂਛਹ ਹਮ ਪੂਛਹ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: ham poochhah ham poochhah satigur paas har baataa raam |
English: I go and ask, I go and ask from the True Guru, about the sermon of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਤ ਪੂਛਹ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: satigur paas har baat poochhah jin naam padaarath paaeaa |
English: I ask about the sermon of the Lord from the True Guru, who has obtained the treasure of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਪਾਇ ਲਗਹ ਨਿਤ ਕਰਹ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਬਤਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: paae lagah nit karah binantee gur satigur panth bataaeaa |
English: I bow at His Feet constantly, and pray to Him; the Guru, the True Guru, has shown me the Way.

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਭਗਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: soee bhagat dukh sukh samat kar jaanai har har naam har raataa |
English: He alone is a devotee, who looks alike upon pleasure and pain; he is imbued with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har kirapaa har kirapaa kar gur satigur mel sukhadaataa |1|
English: O Lord, show Your Mercy, show Your Mercy, and let me meet the True Guru, the Giver of peace. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਭਿ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਹੰਉਮੈ ਪਾਪਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sun guramukh sun guramukh naam sabh binase hnaumai paapaa raam |
English: Listen as Gurmukh, listen as Gurmukh, to the Naam, the Name of the Lord; all egotism and sins are eradicated.

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਥਿਅੜੇ ਜਗਿ ਤਾਪਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: jap har har jap har har naam lathiarre jag taapaa raam |
English: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the troubles of the world vanish.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਪ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam jinee aaraadhiaa tin ke dukh paap nivaare |
English: Those who contemplate the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, are rid of their suffering and sins.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਖੜਗੁ ਹਥਿ ਦੀਨਾ ਜਮਕੰਕਰ ਮਾਰਿ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur giaan kharrag hath deenaa jamakankar maar bidaare |
English: The True Guru has placed the sword of spiritual wisdom in my hands; I have overcome and slain the Messenger of Death.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਦੁਖ ਲਾਥੇ ਪਾਪ ਸੰਤਾਪਾ ॥
Transliteration: har prabh kripaa dhaaree sukhadaate dukh laathe paap santaapaa |
English: The Lord God, the Giver of peace, has granted His Grace, and I am rid of pain, sin and disease.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਭਿ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਹੰਉਮੈ ਪਾਪਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sun guramukh sun guramukh naam sabh binase hnaumai paapaa |2|
English: Listen as Gurmukh, listen as Gurmukh, to the Naam, the Name of the Lord; all egotism and sins are eradicated. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: jap har har jap har har naam merai man bhaaeaa raam |
English: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is so pleasing to my mind.

Gurbani: ਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਪਿ ਸਭਿ ਰੋਗ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: mukh guramukh mukh guramukh jap sabh rog gavaaeaa raam |
English: Speaking as Gurmukh, speaking as Gurmukh, chanting the Naam, all disease is eradicated.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਪਿ ਸਭਿ ਰੋਗ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਅਰੋਗਤ ਭਏ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh jap sabh rog gavaaeaa arogat bhe sareeraa |
English: As Gurmukh, chanting the Naam, all disease is eradicated, and the body becomes free of disease.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: anadin sehaj samaadh har laagee har japiaa gahir ganbheeraa |
English: Night and day, one remains absorbed in the Perfect Poise of Samaadhi; meditate on the Name of the Lord, the inaccessible and unfathomable Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਾਤਿ ਅਜਾਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਨ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਪਰਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jaat ajaat naam jin dhiaaeaa tin param padaarath paaeaa |
English: Whether of high or low social status, one who meditates on the Naam obtains the supreme treasure.

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jap har har jap har har naam merai man bhaaeaa |3|
English: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is pleasing to my mind. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: har dhaarahu har dhaarahu kirapaa kar kirapaa lehu ubaare raam |
English: Grant Your Grace, grant Your Grace, O Lord, and save me.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਦੀਨ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: ham paapee ham paapee niragun deen tumaare raam |
English: I am a sinner, I am a worthless sinner, I am meek, but I am Yours, O Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਦੀਨ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਦੈਆਲ ਸਰਣਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: ham paapee niragun deen tumaare har daiaal saranaaeaa |
English: I am a worthless sinner, and I am meek, but I am Yours; I seek Your Sanctuary, O Merciful Lord.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਹਮ ਪਾਥਰ ਤਰੇ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: too dukh bhanjan sarab sukhadaataa ham paathar tare taraaeaa |
English: You are the Destroyer of pain, the Giver of absolute peace; I am a stone - carry me across and save me.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur bhett raam ras paaeaa jan naanak naam udhaare |
English: Meeting the True Guru, servant Nanak has obtained the subtle essence of the Lord; through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he is saved.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੪॥
Transliteration: har dhaarahu har dhaarahu kirapaa kar kirapaa lehu ubaare raam |4|4|
English: Grant Your Grace, grant Your Grace, Lord, and save me. ||4||4||

[Ang 575 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘੋੜੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 4 ghorreea |
English: Wadahans, Fourth Mehl, Ghorees ~ The Wedding Procession Songs:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਦੇਹ ਤੇਜਣਿ ਜੀ ਰਾਮਿ ਉਪਾਈਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: deh tejan jee raam upaaeea raam |
English: This body-horse was created by the Lord.

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਪੁੰਨਿ ਪਾਈਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: dhan maanas janam pun paaeea raam |
English: Blessed is human life, which is obtained by virtuous actions.

Gurbani: ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਵਡ ਪੁੰਨੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੇਹ ਸੁ ਕੰਚਨ ਚੰਗੜੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: maanas janam vadd pune paaeaa deh su kanchan changarreea |
English: Human life is obtained only by the most virtuous actions; this body is radiant and golden.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਚਲੂਲਾ ਪਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਵ ਰੰਗੜੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh rang chaloolaa paavai har har har nav rangarreea |
English: The Gurmukh is imbued with the deep red color of the poppy; he is imbued with the new color of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਏਹ ਦੇਹ ਸੁ ਬਾਂਕੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: eeh deh su baankee jit har jaapee har har naam suhaaveea |
English: This body is so very beautiful; it chants the Name of the Lord, and it is adorned with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮਿ ਉਪਾਈਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: vaddabhaagee paaee naam sakhaaee jan naanak raam upaaeea |1|
English: By great good fortune, the body is obtained; the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is its companion; O servant Nanak, the Lord has created it. ||1||

Gurbani: ਦੇਹ ਪਾਵਉ ਜੀਨੁ ਬੁਝਿ ਚੰਗਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: deh paavau jeen bujh changaa raam |
English: I place the saddle on the body-horse, the saddle of realization of the Good Lord.

Gurbani: ਚੜਿ ਲੰਘਾ ਜੀ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਭੁਇਅੰਗਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: charr langhaa jee bikham bhueiangaa raam |
English: Riding this horse, I cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਬਿਖਮੁ ਭੁਇਅੰਗਾ ਅਨਤ ਤਰੰਗਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: bikham bhueiangaa anat tarangaa guramukh paar langhaae |
English: The terrifying world-ocean is rocked by countless waves, but the Gurmukh is carried across.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਬੋਹਿਥਿ ਚੜਿ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਲੰਘੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਖੇਵਟੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਰਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: har bohith charr vaddabhaagee langhai gur khevatt sabad taraae |
English: Embarking upon the boat of the Lord, the very fortunate ones cross over; the Guru, the Boatman, carries them across through the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: anadin har rang har gun gaavai har rangee har rangaa |
English: Night and day, imbued with the Lord's Love, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the Lord's lover loves the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਬਾਣ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਉਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਦੁ ਚੰਗਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jan naanak nirabaan pad paaeaa har utam har pad changaa |2|
English: Servant Nanak has obtained the state of Nirvaanaa, the state of ultimate goodness, the state of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕੜੀਆਲੁ ਮੁਖੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: karreeaal mukhe gur giaan drirraaeaa raam |
English: For a bridle in my mouth, the Guru has implanted spiritual wisdom within me.

Gurbani: ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਚਾਬਕੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: tan prem har chaabak laaeaa raam |
English: He has applied the whip of the Lord's Love to my body.

Gurbani: ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਇ ਚਾਬਕੁ ਮਨੁ ਜਿਣੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੀਤਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: tan prem har har laae chaabak man jinai guramukh jeetiaa |
English: Applying the whip of the Lord's Love to his body, the Gurmukh conquers his mind, and wins the battle of life.

Gurbani: ਅਘੜੋ ਘੜਾਵੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਅਪਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਤਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: agharro gharraavai sabad paavai apiau har ras peetiaa |
English: He trains his untrained mind with the Word of the Shabad, and drinks in the rejuvenating essence of the Lord's Nectar.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਣ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਤੁਰੀ ਚੜਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sun sravan baanee gur vakhaanee har rang turee charraaeaa |
English: Listen with your ears to the Word, uttered by the Guru, and attune your body-horse to the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪੰਥੁ ਬਿਖੜਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: mahaa maarag panth bikharraa jan naanak paar langhaaeaa |3|
English: Servant Nanak has crossed over the long and treacherous path. ||3||

Gurbani: ਘੋੜੀ ਤੇਜਣਿ ਦੇਹ ਰਾਮਿ ਉਪਾਈਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: ghorree tejan deh raam upaaeea raam |
English: The transitory body-horse was created by the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਪੈ ਸਾ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਤੁਖਾਈਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: jit har prabh jaapai saa dhan dhan tukhaaeea raam |
English: Blessed, blessed is that body-horse which meditates on the Lord God.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਪੈ ਸਾ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਾਬਾਸੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਜੁੜੰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: jit har prabh jaapai saa dhan saabaasai dhur paaeaa kirat jurrandaa |
English: Blessed and acclaimed is that body-horse which meditates on the Lord God; it is obtained by the merits of past actions.

Gurbani: ਚੜਿ ਦੇਹੜਿ ਘੋੜੀ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਲਘਾਏ ਮਿਲੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: charr deharr ghorree bikham laghaae mil guramukh paramaanandaa |
English: Riding the body-horse, one crosses over the terrifying world ocean; the Gurmukh meets the Lord, the embodiment of supreme bliss.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਜੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ਪੂਰੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਜੰਞ ਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: har har kaaj rachaaeaa poorai mil sant janaa jany aaee |
English: The Lord, Har, Har, has perfectly arranged this wedding; the Saints have come together as a marriage party.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਵਾਧਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੫॥
Transliteration: jan naanak har var paaeaa mangal mil sant janaa vaadhaaee |4|1|5|
English: Servant Nanak has obtained the Lord as his Spouse; joining together, the Saints sing the songs of joy and congratulations. ||4||1||5||

[Ang 575 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 4 |
English: Wadahans, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦੇਹ ਤੇਜਨੜੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਵ ਰੰਗੀਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: deh tejanarree har nav rangeea raam |
English: The body is the Lord's horse; the Lord imbues it with the fresh and new color.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਗੀਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: gur giaan guroo har mangeea raam |
English: From the Guru, I ask for the Lord's spiritual wisdom.

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨ ਮੰਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਚੰਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਜਾਣੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: giaan mangee har kathaa changee har naam gat mit jaaneea |
English: I ask for the Lord's spiritual wisdom, and the Lord's sublime sermon; through the Name of the Lord, I have come to know His value and His state.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਫਲਿਉ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਤੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਖਾਣੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabh janam safaliau keea karatai har raam naam vakhaaneea |
English: The Creator has made my life totally fruitful; I chant the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮੰਗੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: har raam naam salaeh har prabh har bhagat har jan mangeea |
English: The Lord's humble servant begs for the Lord's Name, for the Lord's Praises, and for devotional worship of the Lord God.

Gurbani: ਜਨੁ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਚੰਗੀਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jan kahai naanak sunahu santahu har bhagat govind changeea |1|
English: Says servant Nanak, listen, O Saints: devotional worship of the Lord, the Lord of the Universe, is sublime and good. ||1||

Gurbani: ਦੇਹ ਕੰਚਨ ਜੀਨੁ ਸੁਵਿਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: deh kanchan jeen suvinaa raam |
English: The golden body is saddled with the saddle of gold.

Gurbani: ਜੜਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤੰਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: jarr har har naam ratanaa raam |
English: It is adorned with the jewel of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਜੜਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸੁਖ ਘਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: jarr naam ratan govind paaeaa har mile har gun sukh ghane |
English: Adorned with the jewel of the Naam, one obtains the Lord of the Universe; he meets the Lord, sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and obtains all sorts of comforts.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਹਰਿ ਬਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: gurasabad paaeaa har naam dhiaaeaa vaddabhaagee har rang har bane |
English: He obtains the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and he meditates on the Name of the Lord; by great good fortune, he assumes the color of the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਵਤਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਵ ਰੰਗੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: har mile suaamee antarajaamee har navatan har nav rangeea |
English: He meets his Lord and Master, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts; His body is ever-new, and His color is ever-fresh.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੰਗੀਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak vakhaanai naam jaanai har naam har prabh mangeea |2|
English: Nanak chants and realizes the Naam; he begs for the Name of the Lord, the Lord God. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕੜੀਆਲੁ ਮੁਖੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਅੰਕਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: karreeaal mukhe gur ankas paaeaa raam |
English: The Guru has placed the reins in the mouth of the body-horse.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਮੈਗਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਸਿ ਆਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: man maigal gur sabad vas aaeaa raam |
English: The mind-elephant is overpowered by the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਆਇਆ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਕੰਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: man vasagat aaeaa param pad paaeaa saa dhan kant piaaree |
English: The bride obtains the supreme status, as her mind is brought under control; she is the beloved of her Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਲਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਸੋਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: antar prem lagaa har setee ghar sohai har prabh naaree |
English: Deep within her inner self, she is in love with her Lord; in His home, she is beautiful - she is the bride of her Lord God.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: har rang raatee sahaje maatee har prabh har har paaeaa |
English: Imbued with the Lord's Love, she is intuitively absorbed in bliss; she obtains the Lord God, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹਤੁ ਹੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak jan har daas kehat hai vaddabhaagee har har dhiaaeaa |3|
English: Servant Nanak, the Lord's slave, says that only the very fortunate meditate on the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦੇਹ ਘੋੜੀ ਜੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: deh ghorree jee jit har paaeaa raam |
English: The body is the horse, upon which one rides to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਜੀ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: mil satigur jee mangal gaaeaa raam |
English: Meeting with the True Guru, one sings the songs of joy.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗਾਇ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਵਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: har gaae mangal raam naamaa har sev sevak sevakee |
English: Sing the songs of joy to the Lord, serve the Name of the Lord, and become the servant of His servants.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਇ ਪਾਵੈ ਰੰਗ ਮਹਲੀ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੈ ਰੰਗ ਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: prabh jaae paavai rang mahalee har rang maanai rang kee |
English: You shall go and enter the Mansion of the Beloved Lord's Presence, and lovingly enjoy His Love.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਰਾਮ ਗਾਏ ਮਨਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gun raam gaae man subhaae har guramatee man dhiaaeaa |
English: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, so pleasing to my mind; following the Guru's Teachings, I meditate on the Lord within my mind.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਦੇਹ ਘੋੜੀ ਚੜਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੨॥੬॥
Transliteration: jan naanak har kirapaa dhaaree deh ghorree charr har paaeaa |4|2|6|
English: The Lord has showered His Mercy upon servant Nanak; mounting the body-horse, he has found the Lord. ||4||2||6||

[Ang 576 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: raag vaddahans mahalaa 5 chhant ghar 4 |
English: Raag Wadahans, Fifth Mehl, Chhant, Fourth House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਲਧਾ ਜੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: gur mil ladhaa jee raam piaaraa raam |
English: Meeting with the Guru, I have found my Beloved Lord God.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਦਿਤੜਾ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: eihu tan man ditarraa vaaro vaaraa raam |
English: I have made this body and mind a sacrifice, a sacrificial offering to my Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਦਿਤਾ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਜਿਤਾ ਚੂਕੀ ਕਾਂਣਿ ਜਮਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: tan man ditaa bhavajal jitaa chookee kaan jamaanee |
English: Dedicating my body and mind, I have crossed over the terrifying world-ocean, and shaken off the fear of death.

Gurbani: ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਥੀਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ਰਹਿਆ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: asathir theea amrit peea rahiaa aavan jaanee |
English: Drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar, I have become immortal; my comings and goings have ceased.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਲਧਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਧਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: so ghar ladhaa sehaj samadhaa har kaa naam adhaaraa |
English: I have found that home, of celestial Samaadhi; the Name of the Lord is my only Support.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਿ ਮਾਣੇ ਰਲੀਆਂ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੰਉ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak sukh maane raleean gur poore knau namasakaaraa |1|
English: Says Nanak, I enjoy peace and pleasure; I bow in reverence to the Perfect Guru. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਜਣ ਜੀ ਮੈਡੜੇ ਮੀਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sun sajan jee maiddarre meetaa raam |
English: Listen, O my friend and companion

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚੁ ਦੀਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: gur mantru sabad sach deetaa raam |
English: - the Guru has given the Mantra of the Shabad, the True Word of God.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਆ ਚੂਕੇ ਮਨਹੁ ਅਦੇਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: sach sabad dhiaaeaa mangal gaaeaa chooke manahu adesaa |
English: Meditating on this True Shabad, I sing the songs of joy, and my mind is rid of anxiety.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਇਆ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਬੈਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: so prabh paaeaa kateh na jaaeaa sadaa sadaa sang baisaa |
English: I have found God, who never leaves; forever and ever, He sits with me.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਭਾਣਾ ਸਚਾ ਮਾਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਦੀਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: prabh jee bhaanaa sachaa maanaa prabh har dhan sahaje deetaa |
English: One who is pleasing to God receives true honor. The Lord God blesses him with wealth.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਾਨੁ ਸਭਨੀ ਹੈ ਲੀਤਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak tis jan balihaaree teraa daan sabhanee hai leetaa |2|
English: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to such a humble being. O Lord, You bless all with Your bountiful blessings. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਾਂ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: tau bhaanaa taan tripat aghaae raam |
English: When it pleases You, then I am satisfied and satiated.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਥੀਆ ਠੰਢਾ ਸਭ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: man theea tthandtaa sabh trisan bujhaae raam |
English: My mind is soothed and calmed, and all my thirst is quenched.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਥੀਆ ਠੰਢਾ ਚੂਕੀ ਡੰਝਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਖਜਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: man theea tthandtaa chookee ddanjhaa paaeaa bahut khajaanaa |
English: My mind is soothed and calmed, the burning has ceased, and I have found so many treasures.

Gurbani: ਸਿਖ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਭਿ ਭੁੰਚਣ ਲਗੇ ਹੰਉ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: sikh sevak sabh bhunchan lage hnau satagur kai kurabaanaa |
English: All the Sikhs and servants partake of them; I am a sacrifice to my True Guru.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਖਸਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: nirbhau bhe khasam rang raate jam kee traas bujhaae |
English: I have become fearless, imbued with the Love of my Lord Master, and I have shaken off the fear of death.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੰਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak daas sadaa sang sevak teree bhagat karnau liv laae |3|
English: Slave Nanak, Your humble servant, lovingly embraces Your meditation; O Lord, be with me always. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੀ ਆਸਾ ਜੀ ਮਨਸਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: pooree aasaa jee manasaa mere raam |
English: My hopes and desires have been fulfilled, O my Lord.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਜੀਉ ਸਭਿ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: mohi niragun jeeo sabh gun tere raam |
English: I am worthless, without virtue; all virtues are Yours, O Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: sabh gun tere tthaakur mere kit mukh tudh saalaahee |
English: All virtues are Yours, O my Lord and Master; with what mouth should I praise You?

Gurbani: ਗੁਣੁ ਅਵਗੁਣੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੀਆ ਖਿਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: gun avagun meraa kichh na beechaariaa bakhas leea khin maahee |
English: You did not consider my merits and demerits; you forgave me in an instant.

Gurbani: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ਵਜੀ ਵਾਧਾਈ ਵਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਤੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: nau nidh paaee vajee vaadhaaee vaaje anahad toore |
English: I have obtained the nine treasures, congratulations are pouring in, and the unstruck melody resounds.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈ ਵਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਥੇ ਜੀ ਸਗਲ ਵਿਸੂਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak mai var ghar paaeaa mere laathe jee sagal visoore |4|1|
English: Says Nanak, I have found my Husband Lord within my own home, and all my anxiety is forgotten. ||4||1||

[Ang 577 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਸੁਣੇਦੋ ਕੂੜੁ ਵੰਞਨਿ ਪਵਣ ਝੁਲਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa sunedo koorr vanyan pavan jhulaariaa |
English: Why do you listen to falsehood? It shall vanish like a gust of wind.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਣੀਅਰ ਤੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਜੋ ਸੁਣੇਦੇ ਸਚੁ ਧਣੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak suneear te paravaan jo sunede sach dhanee |1|
English: O Nanak, those ears are acceptable, which listen to the True Master. ||1||

[Ang 577 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: chhant |
English: Chhant:

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੁਮਾਈ ਜਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: tin ghol ghumaaee jin prabh sravanee suniaa raam |
English: I am a sacrifice to those who listen with their ears to the Lord God.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਭਣਿਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: se sehaj suhele jin har har rasanaa bhaniaa raam |
English: Blissful and comfortable are those, who with their tongues chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਗੁਣਹ ਅਮੋਲੇ ਜਗਤ ਉਧਾਰਣ ਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: se sehaj suhele gunah amole jagat udhaaran aae |
English: They are naturally embellished, with priceless virtues; they have come to save the world.

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਸਾਗਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਰਣਾ ਕੇਤੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਲਘਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: bhai bohith saagar prabh charanaa kete paar laghaae |
English: God's Feet are the boat, which carries so many across the terrifying world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕੰਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਲੇਖਾ ਨ ਗਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jin knau kripaa karee merai tthaakur tin kaa lekhaa na ganiaa |
English: Those who are blessed with the favor of my Lord and Master, are not asked to render their account.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੁਮਾਈ ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਸੁਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak tis ghol ghumaaee jin prabh sravanee suniaa |1|
English: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those who listen to God with their ears. ||1||

[Ang 577 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਲੋਇਣ ਲੋਈ ਡਿਠ ਪਿਆਸ ਨ ਬੁਝੈ ਮੂ ਘਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: loein loee dditth piaas na bujhai moo ghanee |
English: With my eyes, I have seen the Light of the Lord, but my great thirst is not quenched.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਅਖੜੀਆਂ ਬਿਅੰਨਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਡਿਸੰਦੋ ਮਾ ਪਿਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak se akharreean bian jinee ddisando maa piree |1|
English: O Nanak, those eyes are different, which behold my Husband Lord. ||1||

[Ang 577 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: chhant |
English: Chhant:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਡਿਠਾ ਤਿਨ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: jinee har prabh dditthaa tin kurabaane raam |
English: I am a sacrifice to those who have seen the Lord God.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਭਾਣੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: se saachee daragah bhaane raam |
English: In the True Court of the Lord, they are approved.

Gurbani: ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਮਾਨੇ ਸੇ ਪਰਧਾਨੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: tthaakur maane se paradhaane har setee rang raate |
English: They are approved by their Lord and Master, and acclaimed as supreme; they are imbued with the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਸਹਿ ਅਘਾਏ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਮਈਆ ਜਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: har raseh aghaae sehaj samaae ghatt ghatt rameea jaate |
English: They are satiated with the sublime essence of the Lord, and they merge in celestial peace; in each and every heart, they see the all-pervading Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੇਈ ਸਜਣ ਸੰਤ ਸੇ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਪਣੇ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: seee sajan sant se sukhee tthaakur apane bhaane |
English: They alone are the friendly Saints, and they alone are happy, who are pleasing to their Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਡਿਠਾ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak jin har prabh dditthaa tin kai sad kurabaane |2|
English: Says Nanak, I am forever a sacrifice to those who have seen the Lord God. ||2||

[Ang 577 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਦੇਹ ਅੰਧਾਰੀ ਅੰਧ ਸੁੰਞੀ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: deh andhaaree andh sunyee naam vihooneea |
English: The body is blind, totally blind and desolate, without the Naam.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਫਲ ਜਨੰਮੁ ਜੈ ਘਟਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਸਚੁ ਧਣੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak safal janam jai ghatt vutthaa sach dhanee |1|
English: O Nanak, fruitful is the life of that being, within whose heart the True Lord and Master abides. ||1||

[Ang 577 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: chhant |
English: Chhant:

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਵੰਞਾਂ ਜਿਨ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਡੀਠਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: tin khaneeai vanyaan jin meraa har prabh ddeetthaa raam |
English: I am cut into pieces as a sacrifice, to those who have seen my Lord God.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਚਾਖਿ ਅਘਾਣੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: jan chaakh aghaane har har amrit meetthaa raam |
English: His humble servants partake of the Sweet Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord, Har, Har, and are satiated.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਮਨਹਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤੂਠਾ ਅਮਿਉ ਵੂਠਾ ਸੁਖ ਭਏ ॥
Transliteration: har maneh meetthaa prabhoo tootthaa amiau vootthaa sukh bhe |
English: The Lord seems sweet to their minds; God is merciful to them, His Ambrosial Nectar rains down upon them, and they are at peace.

Gurbani: ਦੁਖ ਨਾਸ ਭਰਮ ਬਿਨਾਸ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਜਪਿ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਈਸਹ ਜੈ ਜਏ ॥
Transliteration: dukh naas bharam binaas tan te jap jagadees eesah jai je |
English: Pain is eliminated and doubt is dispelled from the body; chanting the Name of the Lord of the World, their victory is celebrated.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹ ਰਹਤ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਥਾਕੇ ਪੰਚ ਤੇ ਸੰਗੁ ਤੂਟਾ ॥
Transliteration: moh rehat bikaar thaake panch te sang toottaa |
English: They are rid of emotional attachment, their sins are erased, and their association with the five passions is broken off.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਵੰਞਾ ਜਿਨ ਘਟਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਵੂਠਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak tin khaneeai vanyaa jin ghatt meraa har prabh vootthaa |3|
English: Says Nanak, I am every bit a sacrifice to those, within whose hearts my Lord God abides. ||3||

[Ang 578 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਲੋੜੀਦੇ ਰਾਮ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਈ ਕਾਂਢਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jo lorreede raam sevak seee kaandtiaa |
English: Those who long for the Lord, are said to be His servants.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਣੇ ਸਤਿ ਸਾਂਈ ਸੰਤ ਨ ਬਾਹਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak jaane sat saanee sant na baaharaa |1|
English: Nanak knows this Truth, that the Lord is not different from His Saint. ||1||

[Ang 578 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: chhant |
English: Chhant:

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਜਲੁ ਜਲਹਿ ਖਟਾਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: mil jal jaleh khattaanaa raam |
English: As water mixes and blends with water,
