Gurbani: ਸੰਗਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sang jotee jot milaanaa raam |
English: so does one's light mix and blend with the Lord's Light.

Gurbani: ਸੰਮਾਇ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਰਤੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਹਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: samaae pooran purakh karate aap aapeh jaaneeai |
English: Merging with the perfect, all-powerful Creator, one comes to know his own self.

Gurbani: ਤਹ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਏਕੁ ਏਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: teh sun sehaj samaadh laagee ek ek vakhaaneeai |
English: Then, he enters the celestial state of absolute Samaadhi, and speaks of the One and Only Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਗੁਪਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੁ ਵਖਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: aap gupataa aap mukataa aap aap vakhaanaa |
English: He Himself is unmanifest, and He Himself is liberated; He Himself speaks of Himself.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੈ ਗੁਣ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਲੁ ਜਲਹਿ ਖਟਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak bhram bhai gun binaase mil jal jaleh khattaanaa |4|2|
English: O Nanak, doubt, fear and the limitations of the three qualities are dispelled, as one merges into the Lord, like water blending with water. ||4||2||

[Ang 578 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 5 |
English: Wadahans, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: prabh karan kaaran samarathaa raam |
English: God is the all-powerful Creator, the Cause of causes.

Gurbani: ਰਖੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਗਲ ਦੇ ਹਥਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: rakh jagat sagal de hathaa raam |
English: He preserves the whole world, reaching out with His hand.

Gurbani: ਸਮਰਥ ਸਰਣਾ ਜੋਗੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: samarath saranaa jog suaamee kripaa nidh sukhadaataa |
English: He is the all-powerful, safe Sanctuary, Lord and Master, Treasure of mercy, Giver of peace.

Gurbani: ਹੰਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਿਨੀ ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: hnau kurabaanee daas tere jinee ek pachhaataa |
English: I am a sacrifice to Your slaves, who recognize only the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਵਰਨੁ ਚਿਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਲਖਿਆ ਕਥਨ ਤੇ ਅਕਥਾ ॥
Transliteration: varan chihan na jaae lakhiaa kathan te akathaa |
English: His color and shape cannot be seen; His description is indescribable.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਬਿਨਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak sunahu binatee prabh karan kaaran samarathaa |1|
English: Prays Nanak, hear my prayer, O God, Almighty Creator, Cause of causes. ||1||

Gurbani: ਏਹਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: ehi jeea tere too karataa raam |
English: These beings are Yours; You are their Creator.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਹਰਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: prabh dookh darad bhram harataa raam |
English: God is the Destroyer of pain, suffering and doubt.

Gurbani: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਦੀਨ ਦੈਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: bhram dookh darad nivaar khin meh rakh lehu deen daiaalaa |
English: Eliminate my doubt, pain and suffering in an instant, and preserve me, O Lord, Merciful to the meek.

Gurbani: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਆਮਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਬਾਲ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: maat pitaa suaam sajan sabh jagat baal gopaalaa |
English: You are mother, father and friend, O Lord and Master; the whole world is Your child, O Lord of the World.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਸਰਣਿ ਆਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਮਰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo saran aavai gun nidhaan paavai so bahurr janam na marataa |
English: One who comes seeking Your Sanctuary, obtains the treasure of virtue, and does not have to enter the cycle of birth and death again.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak daas teraa sabh jeea tere too karataa |2|
English: Prays Nanak, I am Your slave. All beings are Yours; You are their Creator. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar har dhiaaeeai raam |
English: Meditating on the Lord, twenty-four hours a day,

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਇਛਿਅੜਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: man ichhiarraa fal paaeeai raam |
English: the fruits of the heart's desires are obtained.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਇਛ ਪਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਜਮ ਕੇ ਤ੍ਰਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: man ichh paaeeai prabh dhiaaeeai mitteh jam ke traasaa |
English: Your heart's desires are obtained, meditating on God, and the fear of death is dispelled.

Gurbani: ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਗਾਇਆ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਾਇਆ ਭਈ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: gobid gaaeaa saadh sangaaeaa bhee pooran aasaa |
English: I sing of the Lord of the Universe in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and my hopes are fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਸਗਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: taj maan mohu vikaar sagale prabhoo kai man bhaaeeai |
English: Renouncing egotism, emotional attachment and all corruption, we become pleasing to the Mind of God.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣੀ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak dinas rainee sadaa har har dhiaaeeai |3|
English: Prays Nanak, day and night, meditate forever on the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦਰਿ ਵਾਜਹਿ ਅਨਹਤ ਵਾਜੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: dar vaajeh anahat vaaje raam |
English: At the Lord's Door, the unstruck melody resounds.

Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਗਾਜੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt har gobind gaaje raam |
English: In each and every heart, the Lord, the Lord of the Universe, sings.

Gurbani: ਗੋਵਿਦ ਗਾਜੇ ਸਦਾ ਬਿਰਾਜੇ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਊਚਾ ॥
Transliteration: govid gaaje sadaa biraaje agam agochar aoochaa |
English: The Lord of the Universe sings, and abides forever; He is unfathomable, profoundly deep, lofty and exalted.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਪਹੂਚਾ ॥
Transliteration: gun beant kichh kehan na jaaee koe na sakai pahoochaa |
English: His virtues are infinite - none of them can be described. No one can reach Him.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਸਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: aap upaae aap pratipaale jeea jant sabh saaje |
English: He Himself creates, and He Himself sustains; all beings and creatures are fashioned by Him.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਦਰਿ ਵਜਹਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਵਾਜੇ ॥੪॥੩॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak sukh naam bhagatee dar vajeh anahad vaaje |4|3|
English: Prays Nanak, happiness comes from devotional worship of the Naam; at His Door, the unstruck melody resounds. ||4||3||

[Ang 578 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੫ ਅਲਾਹਣੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: raag vaddahans mahalaa 1 ghar 5 alaahaneea |
English: Raag Wadahans, First Mehl, Fifth House, Alaahanees ~ Songs Of Mourning:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਸਿਰੰਦਾ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: dhan sirandaa sachaa paatisaahu jin jag dhandhai laaeaa |
English: Blessed is the Creator, the True King, who has linked the whole world to its tasks.

Gurbani: ਮੁਹਲਤਿ ਪੁਨੀ ਪਾਈ ਭਰੀ ਜਾਨੀਅੜਾ ਘਤਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: muhalat punee paaee bharee jaaneearraa ghat chalaaeaa |
English: When one's time is up, and the measure is full, this dear soul is caught, and driven off.

Gurbani: ਜਾਨੀ ਘਤਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਆਇਆ ਰੁੰਨੇ ਵੀਰ ਸਬਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jaanee ghat chalaaeaa likhiaa aaeaa rune veer sabaae |
English: This dear soul is driven off, when the pre-ordained Order is received, and all the relatives cry out in mourning.

Gurbani: ਕਾਂਇਆ ਹੰਸ ਥੀਆ ਵੇਛੋੜਾ ਜਾਂ ਦਿਨ ਪੁੰਨੇ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: kaaneaa hans theea vechhorraa jaan din pune meree maae |
English: The body and the swan-soul are separated, when one's days are past and done, O my mother.

Gurbani: ਜੇਹਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤੇਹਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੇਹਾ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jehaa likhiaa tehaa paaeaa jehaa purab kamaaeaa |
English: As is one's pre-ordained Destiny, so does one receive, according to one's past actions.

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਸਿਰੰਦਾ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dhan sirandaa sachaa paatisaahu jin jag dhandhai laaeaa |1|
English: Blessed is the Creator, the True King, who has linked the whole world to its tasks. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈਹੋ ਸਭਨਾ ਏਹੁ ਪਇਆਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: saahib simarahu mere bhaaeeho sabhanaa ehu peaanaa |
English: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord and Master, O my Siblings of Destiny; everyone has to pass this way.

Gurbani: ਏਥੈ ਧੰਧਾ ਕੂੜਾ ਚਾਰਿ ਦਿਹਾ ਆਗੈ ਸਰਪਰ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: ethai dhandhaa koorraa chaar dihaa aagai sarapar jaanaa |
English: These false entanglements last for only a few days; then, one must surely move on to the world hereafter.

Gurbani: ਆਗੈ ਸਰਪਰ ਜਾਣਾ ਜਿਉ ਮਿਹਮਾਣਾ ਕਾਹੇ ਗਾਰਬੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: aagai sarapar jaanaa jiau mihamaanaa kaahe gaarab keejai |
English: He must surely move on to the world hereafter, like a guest; so why does he indulge in ego?

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਲੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: jit seviai daragah sukh paaeeai naam tisai kaa leejai |
English: Chant the Name of the Lord; serving Him, you shall obtain peace in His Court.

Gurbani: ਆਗੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਮੂਲੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਿਆ ਵਿਹਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: aagai hukam na chalai moole sir sir kiaa vihaanaa |
English: In the world hereafter, no one's commands will be obeyed. According to their actions, each and every person proceeds.

Gurbani: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਿਮਰਿਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈਹੋ ਸਭਨਾ ਏਹੁ ਪਇਆਣਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saahib simarihu mere bhaaeeho sabhanaa ehu peaanaa |2|
English: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord and Master, O my Siblings of Destiny; everyone has to pass this way. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਹੀਲੜਾ ਏਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: jo tis bhaavai samrath so theeai heelarraa ehu sansaaro |
English: Whatever pleases the Almighty Lord, that alone comes to pass; this world is an opportunity to please Him.

Gurbani: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਾਚੜਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: jal thal maheeal rav rahiaa saacharraa sirajanahaaro |
English: The True Creator Lord is pervading and permeating the water, the land and the air.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੋ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: saachaa sirajanahaaro alakh apaaro taa kaa ant na paaeaa |
English: The True Creator Lord is invisible and infinite; His limits cannot be found.

Gurbani: ਆਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਸਫਲੁ ਭਇਆ ਹੈ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aaeaa tin kaa safal bheaa hai ik man jinee dhiaaeaa |
English: Fruitful is the coming of those, who meditate single-mindedly on Him.

Gurbani: ਢਾਹੇ ਢਾਹਿ ਉਸਾਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: dtaahe dtaeh usaare aape hukam savaaranahaaro |
English: He destroys, and having destroyed, He creates; by His Order, He adorns us.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਹੀਲੜਾ ਏਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jo tis bhaavai samrath so theeai heelarraa ehu sansaaro |3|
English: Whatever pleases the Almighty Lord, that alone comes to pass; this world is an opportunity to please Him. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੁੰਨਾ ਬਾਬਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜੇ ਰੋਵੈ ਲਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: naanak runaa baabaa jaaneeai je rovai laae piaaro |
English: Nanak: he alone truly weeps, O Baba, who weeps in the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਵਾਲੇਵੇ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਬਾਬਾ ਰੋਈਐ ਰੋਵਣੁ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਕਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: vaaleve kaaran baabaa roeeai rovan sagal bikaaro |
English: One who weeps for the sake of worldly objects, O Baba, weeps totally in vain.

Gurbani: ਰੋਵਣੁ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਕਾਰੋ ਗਾਫਲੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਰੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: rovan sagal bikaaro gaafal sansaaro maaeaa kaaran rovai |
English: This weeping is all in vain; the world forgets the Lord, and weeps for the sake of Maya.

Gurbani: ਚੰਗਾ ਮੰਦਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਏਵੈ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: changaa mandaa kichh soojhai naahee ihu tan evai khovai |
English: He does not distinguish between good and evil, and wastes away this life in vain.

Gurbani: ਐਥੈ ਆਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਜਾਸੀ ਕੂੜਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: aithai aaeaa sabh ko jaasee koorr karahu ahankaaro |
English: Everyone who comes here, shall have to leave; to act in ego is false.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੁੰਨਾ ਬਾਬਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜੇ ਰੋਵੈ ਲਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak runaa baabaa jaaneeai je rovai laae piaaro |4|1|
English: Nanak: he alone truly weeps, O Baba, who weeps in the Lord's Love. ||4||1||

[Ang 579 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 1 |
English: Wadahans, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਵਹੁ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਸਹੇਲੀਹੋ ਸਚੜਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਏਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: aavahu milahu saheleeho sacharraa naam lehaan |
English: Come, O my companions - let us meet together and dwell upon the True Name.

Gurbani: ਰੋਵਹ ਬਿਰਹਾ ਤਨ ਕਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੰਮੑਾਲੇਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: rovah birahaa tan kaa aapanaa saahib samaalehaan |
English: Let us weep over the body's separation from the Lord and Master; let us remember Him in contemplation.

Gurbani: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਿਹ ਪੰਥੁ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਹ ਅਸਾ ਭਿ ਓਥੈ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: saahib samaalih panth nihaalih asaa bhi othai jaanaa |
English: Let us remember the Lord and Master in contemplation, and keep a watchful eye on the Path. We shall have to go there as well.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਲੀਆ ਹੋਆ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: jis kaa keea tin hee leea hoaa tisai kaa bhaanaa |
English: He who has created, also destroys; whatever happens is by His Will.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤਿਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਆਇਆ ਅਸੀ ਕਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਰੇਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo tin kar paaeaa su aagai aaeaa asee ki hukam karehaa |
English: Whatever He has done, has come to pass; how can we command Him?

Gurbani: ਆਵਹੁ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਸਹੇਲੀਹੋ ਸਚੜਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਏਹਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aavahu milahu saheleeho sacharraa naam lehaa |1|
English: Come, O my companions - let us meet together and dwell upon the True Name. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਮੰਦਾ ਲੋਕਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਜੇ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਐਸਾ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: maran na mandaa lokaa aakheeai je mar jaanai aisaa koe |
English: Death would not be called bad, O people, if one knew how to truly die.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਪੰਥੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਆਗੈ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sevihu saahib samrath aapanaa panth suhelaa aagai hoe |
English: Serve your Almighty Lord and Master, and your path in the world hereafter will be easy.

Gurbani: ਪੰਥਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੈ ਜਾਵਹੁ ਤਾਂ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਆਗੈ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: panth suhelai jaavahu taan fal paavahu aagai milai vaddaaee |
English: Take this easy path, and you shall obtain the fruits of your rewards, and receive honor in the world hereafter.

Gurbani: ਭੇਟੈ ਸਿਉ ਜਾਵਹੁ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਹੁ ਤਾਂ ਪਤਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: bhettai siau jaavahu sach samaavahu taan pat lekhai paaee |
English: Go there with your offering, and you shall merge in the True Lord; your honor shall be confirmed.

Gurbani: ਮਹਲੀ ਜਾਇ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਖਸਮੈ ਭਾਵਹੁ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: mahalee jaae paavahu khasamai bhaavahu rang siau raleea maanai |
English: You shall obtain a place in the Mansion of the Lord Master's Presence; being pleasing to Him, you shall enjoy the pleasures of His Love.

Gurbani: ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਮੰਦਾ ਲੋਕਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: maran na mandaa lokaa aakheeai je koee mar jaanai |2|
English: Death would not be called bad, O people, if one knew how to truly die. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਰਣੁ ਮੁਣਸਾ ਸੂਰਿਆ ਹਕੁ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਹੋਇ ਮਰਨਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੋ ॥
Transliteration: maran munasaa sooriaa hak hai jo hoe maran paravaano |
English: The death of brave heroes is blessed, if it is approved by God.

Gurbani: ਸੂਰੇ ਸੇਈ ਆਗੈ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਮਾਣੋ ॥
Transliteration: soore seee aagai aakheeeh daragah paaveh saachee maano |
English: They alone are acclaimed as brave warriors in the world hereafter, who receive true honor in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਣੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਆਗੈ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: daragah maan paaveh pat siau jaaveh aagai dookh na laagai |
English: They are honored in the Court of the Lord; they depart with honor, and they do not suffer pain in the world hereafter.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਤਾਂ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: kar ek dhiaaveh taan fal paaveh jit seviai bhau bhaagai |
English: They meditate on the One Lord, and obtain the fruits of their rewards. Serving the Lord, their fear is dispelled.

Gurbani: ਊਚਾ ਨਹੀ ਕਹਣਾ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਣਾ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਾਣੋ ॥
Transliteration: aoochaa nahee kahanaa man meh rahanaa aape jaanai jaano |
English: Do not indulge in egotism, and dwell within your own mind; the Knower Himself knows everything.

Gurbani: ਮਰਣੁ ਮੁਣਸਾਂ ਸੂਰਿਆ ਹਕੁ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਹੋਇ ਮਰਹਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੋ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: maran munasaan sooriaa hak hai jo hoe mareh paravaano |3|
English: The death of brave heroes is blessed, if it is approved by God. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਾਬਾ ਰੋਈਐ ਬਾਜੀ ਹੈ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: naanak kis no baabaa roeeai baajee hai ihu sansaaro |
English: Nanak: for whom should we mourn, O Baba? This world is merely a play.

Gurbani: ਕੀਤਾ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: keetaa vekhai saahib aapanaa kudarat kare beechaaro |
English: The Lord Master beholds His work, and contemplates His creative potency.

Gurbani: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ਧਾਰਣ ਧਾਰੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: kudarat beechaare dhaaran dhaare jin keea so jaanai |
English: He contemplates His creative potency, having established the Universe. He who created it, He alone knows.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਆਪੇ ਬੂਝੈ ਆਪੇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: aape vekhai aape boojhai aape hukam pachhaanai |
English: He Himself beholds it, and He Himself understands it. He Himself realizes the Hukam of His Command.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਆ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਪਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: jin kichh keea soee jaanai taa kaa roop apaaro |
English: He who created these things, He alone knows. His subtle form is infinite.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਾਬਾ ਰੋਈਐ ਬਾਜੀ ਹੈ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak kis no baabaa roeeai baajee hai ihu sansaaro |4|2|
English: Nanak: for whom should we mourn, O Baba? This world is merely a play. ||4||2||

[Ang 580 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਦਖਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 1 dakhanee |
English: Wadahans, First Mehl, Dakhanee:

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸਿਰੰਦਾ ਸਚਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਸਚੜਾ ਪਰਵਦਗਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: sach sirandaa sachaa jaaneeai sacharraa paravadagaaro |
English: The True Creator Lord is True - know this well; He is the True Sustainer.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੀਨੈ ਆਪੁ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਸਚੜਾ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: jin aapeenai aap saajiaa sacharraa alakh apaaro |
English: He Himself fashioned His Own Self; the True Lord is invisible and infinite.

Gurbani: ਦੁਇ ਪੁੜ ਜੋੜਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਿਅਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੋਰੁ ਅੰਧਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: due purr jorr vichhorrian gur bin ghor andhaaro |
English: He brought together, and then separated, the two grinding stones of the earth and the sky; without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness.

Gurbani: ਸੂਰਜੁ ਚੰਦੁ ਸਿਰਜਿਅਨੁ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਚਲਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sooraj chand sirajian ahinis chalat veechaaro |1|
English: He created the sun and the moon; night and day, they move according to His Thought. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਚੜਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਤੂ ਸਚੜਾ ਦੇਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sacharraa saahib sach too sacharraa dehi piaaro | rahaau |
English: O True Lord and Master, You are True. O True Lord, bless me with Your Love. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਸਿਰਜੀ ਮੇਦਨੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: tudh sirajee medanee dukh sukh devanahaaro |
English: You created the Universe; You are the Giver of pain and pleasure.

Gurbani: ਨਾਰੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਸਿਰਜਿਐ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: naaree purakh sirajiai bikh maaeaa mohu piaaro |
English: You created woman and man, the love of poison, and emotional attachment to Maya.

Gurbani: ਖਾਣੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਤੇਰੀਆ ਦੇਹਿ ਜੀਆ ਆਧਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: khaanee baanee tereea dehi jeea aadhaaro |
English: The four sources of creation, and the power of the Word, are also of Your making. You give Support to all beings.

Gurbani: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਤਖਤੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ਸਚਿ ਨਿਬੇੜਣਹਾਰੋ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kudarat takhat rachaaeaa sach niberranahaaro |2|
English: You have made the Creation as Your Throne; You are the True Judge. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਵਾ ਗਵਣੁ ਸਿਰਜਿਆ ਤੂ ਥਿਰੁ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: aavaa gavan sirajiaa too thir karanaihaaro |
English: You created comings and goings, but You are ever-stable, O Creator Lord.

Gurbani: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਆਇ ਗਇਆ ਬਧਿਕੁ ਜੀਉ ਬਿਕਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: jaman maranaa aae geaa badhik jeeo bikaaro |
English: In birth and death, in coming and going, this soul is held in bondage by corruption.

Gurbani: ਭੂਡੜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਬੂਡੜੈ ਕਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਚਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: bhooddarrai naam visaariaa booddarrai kiaa tis chaaro |
English: The evil person has forgotten the Naam; he has drowned - what can he do now?

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਛੋਡਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਲਦਿਆ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਕਾ ਵਣਜਾਰੋ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gun chhodd bikh ladiaa avagun kaa vanajaaro |3|
English: Forsaking merit, he has loaded the poisonous cargo of demerits; he is a trader of sins. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਦੜੇ ਆਏ ਤਿਨਾ ਜਾਨੀਆ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਚੇ ਕਰਤਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: sadarre aae tinaa jaaneea hukam sache karataaro |
English: The beloved soul has received the Call, the Command of the True Creator Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਰੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: naaree purakh vichhuniaa vichhurriaa melanahaaro |
English: The soul, the husband, has become separated from the body, the bride. The Lord is the Re-uniter of the separated ones.

Gurbani: ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਹਣੀਐ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਬਧੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: roop na jaanai sohaneeai hukam badhee sir kaaro |
English: No one cares for your beauty, O beautiful bride.; the Messenger of Death is bound only by the Lord Commander's Command.

Gurbani: ਬਾਲਕ ਬਿਰਧਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਤੋੜਨਿ ਹੇਤੁ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: baalak biradh na jaananee torran het piaaro |4|
English: He does not distinguish between young children and old people; he tears apart love and affection. ||4||

Gurbani: ਨਉ ਦਰ ਠਾਕੇ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਚੈ ਹੰਸੁ ਗਇਆ ਗੈਣਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: nau dar tthaake hukam sachai hans geaa gainaare |
English: The nine doors are closed by the True Lord's Command, and the swan-soul takes flight into the skies.

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਛੁਟੀ ਮੁਠੀ ਝੂਠਿ ਵਿਧਣੀਆ ਮਿਰਤਕੜਾ ਅੰਙਨੜੇ ਬਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: saa dhan chhuttee mutthee jhootth vidhaneea miratakarraa anganarre baare |
English: The body-bride is separated, and defrauded by falsehood; she is now a widow - her husband's body lies dead in the courtyard.

Gurbani: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮੁਈ ਮਰੁ ਮਾਈਏ ਮਹਲ ਰੁੰਨੀ ਦਰ ਬਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: surat muee mar maaeee mehal runee dar baare |
English: The widow cries out at the door, "The light of my mind has gone out, O my mother, with his death."

Gurbani: ਰੋਵਹੁ ਕੰਤ ਮਹੇਲੀਹੋ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: rovahu kant maheleeho sache ke gun saare |5|
English: So cry out, O soul-brides of the Husband Lord, and dwell on the Glorious Praises of the True Lord. ||5||

Gurbani: ਜਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਜਾਨੀ ਨਾਵਾਲਿਆ ਕਪੜਿ ਪਟਿ ਅੰਬਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jal mal jaanee naavaaliaa kaparr patt anbaare |
English: Her loved one is cleansed, bathed in water, and dressed in silken robes.

Gurbani: ਵਾਜੇ ਵਜੇ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀਆ ਪੰਚ ਮੁਏ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: vaaje vaje sachee baaneea panch mue man maare |
English: The musicians play, and the Bani of the True Lord's Words are sung; the five relatives feel as if they too are dead, so deadened are their minds.

Gurbani: ਜਾਨੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੜੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਰਣੁ ਭਇਆ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jaanee vichhunarre meraa maran bheaa dhrig jeevan sansaare |
English: "Separation from my beloved is like death to me!" cries the widow. "My life in this world is cursed and worthless!"

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਸੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਪਿਰ ਸਚੜੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: jeevat marai su jaaneeai pir sacharrai het piaare |6|
English: But she alone is approved, who dies, while yet still alive; she lives for the sake of the Love of her Beloved. ||6||

Gurbani: ਤੁਸੀ ਰੋਵਹੁ ਰੋਵਣ ਆਈਹੋ ਝੂਠਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: tusee rovahu rovan aaeeho jhootth mutthee sansaare |
English: So cry out in mourning, you who have come to mourn; this world is false and fraudulent.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਮੁਠੜੀ ਧੰਧੈ ਧਾਵਣੀਆ ਪਿਰਿ ਛੋਡਿਅੜੀ ਵਿਧਣਕਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: hau muttharree dhandhai dhaavaneea pir chhoddiarree vidhanakaare |
English: I too have been defrauded, chasing after worldly entanglements; my Husband Lord has forsaken me - I practice the evil deeds of a wife without a spouse.

Gurbani: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਕੰਤੁ ਮਹੇਲੀਆ ਰੂੜੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: ghar ghar kant maheleea roorrai het piaare |
English: In each and every home, are the brides of the Husband Lord; they gaze upon their Handsome Lord with love and affection.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਹਉ ਰਹਸਿਅੜੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਭਤਾਰੇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: mai pir sach saalaahanaa hau rahasiarree naam bhataare |7|
English: I sing the Praises of my True Husband Lord, and through the Naam, the Name of my Husband Lord, I blossom forth. ||7||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਵੇਸੁ ਪਲਟਿਆ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਸਚੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: gur miliai ves palattiaa saa dhan sach seegaaro |
English: Meeting with the Guru, the soul-bride's dress is transformed, and she is adorned with Truth.

Gurbani: ਆਵਹੁ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਸਹੇਲੀਹੋ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: aavahu milahu saheleeho simarahu sirajanahaaro |
English: Come and meet with me, O brides of the Lord; let's meditate in remembrance on the Creator Lord.

Gurbani: ਬਈਅਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੋੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: beear naam suohaaganee sach savaaranahaaro |
English: Through the Naam, the soul-bride becomes the Lord's favorite; she is adorned with Truth.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਹੁ ਗੀਤੁ ਨ ਬਿਰਹੜਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥੮॥੩॥
Transliteration: gaavahu geet na biraharraa naanak braham beechaaro |8|3|
English: Do not sing the songs of separation, O Nanak; reflect upon God. ||8||3||

[Ang 581 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 1 |
English: Wadahans, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗੁ ਸਿਰਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ਸੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਜਾਣੋਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: jin jag siraj samaaeaa so saahib kudarat jaanovaa |
English: The One who creates and dissolves the world - that Lord and Master alone knows His creative power.

Gurbani: ਸਚੜਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਭਾਲੀਐ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੋਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: sacharraa door na bhaaleeai ghatt ghatt sabad pachhaanovaa |
English: Do not search for the True Lord far away; recognize the Word of the Shabad in each and every heart.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣਹੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹ ਰਚਨਾ ਰਾਚੀ ॥
Transliteration: sach sabad pachhaanahu door na jaanahu jin eeh rachanaa raachee |
English: Recognize the Shabad, and do not think that the Lord is far away; He created this creation.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪਿੜ ਕਾਚੀ ॥
Transliteration: naam dhiaae taa sukh paae bin naavai pirr kaachee |
English: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one obtains peace; without the Naam, he plays a losing game.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਥਾਪੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਵਖਾਣੋ ॥
Transliteration: jin thaapee bidh jaanai soee kiaa ko kahai vakhaano |
English: The One who established the Universe, He alone knows the Way; what can anyone say?

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗੁ ਥਾਪਿ ਵਤਾਇਆ ਜਾਲੋੁ ਸੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੋ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jin jag thaap vataaeaa jaaluo so saahib paravaano |1|
English: The One who established the world cast the net of Maya over it; accept Him as your Lord and Master. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਾਬਾ ਆਇਆ ਹੈ ਉਠਿ ਚਲਣਾ ਅਧ ਪੰਧੈ ਹੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੋਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: baabaa aaeaa hai utth chalanaa adh pandhai hai sansaarovaa |
English: O Baba, he has come, and now he must get up and depart; this world is only a way-station.

Gurbani: ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਚੜੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੋਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: sir sir sacharrai likhiaa dukh sukh purab veechaarovaa |
English: Upon each and every head, the True Lord writes their destiny of pain and pleasure, according to their past actions.

Gurbani: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੀਆ ਜੇਹਾ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਜੀਅ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: dukh sukh deea jehaa keea so nibahai jeea naale |
English: He bestows pain and pleasure, according to the deeds done; the record of these deeds stays with the soul.

Gurbani: ਜੇਹੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਦੂਜੀ ਕਾਰ ਨ ਭਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: jehe karam karaae karataa doojee kaar na bhaale |
English: He does those deeds which the Creator Lord causes him to do; he attempts no other actions.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਬਾਧੀ ਕਰਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਛਡਾਵਣਹਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: aap niraalam dhandhai baadhee kar hukam chhaddaavanahaaro |
English: The Lord Himself is detached, while the world is entangled in conflict; by His Command, He emancipates it.

Gurbani: ਅਜੁ ਕਲਿ ਕਰਦਿਆ ਕਾਲੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਵਿਕਾਰੋ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aj kal karadiaa kaal biaapai doojai bhaae vikaaro |2|
English: He may put this off today, but tomorrow he is seized by death; in love with duality, he practices corruption. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਮਾਰਗ ਪੰਥੁ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਉਝੜੁ ਅੰਧ ਗੁਬਾਰੋਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: jam maarag panth na sujhee ujharr andh gubaarovaa |
English: The path of death is dark and dismal; the way cannot be seen.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਜਲੁ ਲੇਫ ਤੁਲਾਈਆ ਨਾ ਭੋਜਨ ਪਰਕਾਰੋਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: naa jal lef tulaaeea naa bhojan parakaarovaa |
English: There is no water, no quilt or mattress, and no food there.

Gurbani: ਭੋਜਨ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਠੰਢਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਨਾ ਕਾਪੜੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: bhojan bhaau na tthandtaa paanee naa kaaparr seegaaro |
English: He receives no food there, no honor or water, no clothes or decorations.

Gurbani: ਗਲਿ ਸੰਗਲੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਊਭੌ ਨਾ ਦੀਸੈ ਘਰ ਬਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: gal sangal sir maare aoobhau naa deesai ghar baaro |
English: The chain is put around his neck, and the Messenger of Death standing over his head strikes him; he cannot see the door of his home.

Gurbani: ਇਬ ਕੇ ਰਾਹੇ ਜੰਮਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: eib ke raahe jaman naahee pachhutaane sir bhaaro |
English: The seeds planted on this path do not sprout; bearing the weight of his sins upon his head, he regrets and repents.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੋ ਬੇਲੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਏਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bin saache ko belee naahee saachaa ehu beechaaro |3|
English: Without the True Lord, no one is his friend; reflect upon this as true. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬਾਬਾ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਰਵਹਿ ਸੁ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰੋਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੇਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: baabaa roveh raveh su jaaneeeh mil rovai gun saarevaa |
English: O Baba, they alone are known to truly weep and wail, who meet together and weep, chanting the Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਰੋਵੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੁਠੜੀ ਧੰਧੜਾ ਰੋਵਣਹਾਰੇਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: rovai maaeaa muttharree dhandharraa rovanahaarevaa |
English: Defrauded by Maya and worldly affairs, the weepers weep.

Gurbani: ਧੰਧਾ ਰੋਵੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਧੋਵੈ ਸੁਪਨੰਤਰੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: dhandhaa rovai mail na dhovai supanantar sansaaro |
English: They weep for the sake of worldly affairs, and they do not wash off their own filth; the world is merely a dream.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਬਾਜੀਗਰੁ ਭਰਮੈ ਭੂਲੈ ਝੂਠਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: jiau baajeegar bharamai bhoolai jhootth mutthee ahankaaro |
English: Like the juggler, deceiving by his tricks, one is deluded by egotism, falsehood and illusion.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aape maarag paavanahaaraa aape karam kamaae |
English: The Lord Himself reveals the Path; He Himself is the Doer of deeds.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਰਾਖੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥੪॥੪॥
Transliteration: naam rate gur poorai raakhe naanak sehaj subhaae |4|4|
English: Those who are imbued with the Naam, are protected by the Perfect Guru, O Nanak; they merge in celestial bliss. ||4||4||

[Ang 581 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 1 |
English: Wadahans, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬਾਬਾ ਆਇਆ ਹੈ ਉਠਿ ਚਲਣਾ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਪਸਾਰੋਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: baabaa aaeaa hai utth chalanaa ihu jag jhootth pasaarovaa |
English: O Baba, whoever has come, will rise up and leave; this world is merely a false show.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਘਰੁ ਸਚੜੈ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਖਰਾ ਸਚਿਆਰੋਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa ghar sacharrai seveeai sach kharaa sachiaarovaa |
English: One's true home is obtained by serving the True Lord; real Truth is obtained by being truthful.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜਿ ਲਬਿ ਜਾਂ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਸੀ ਅਗੈ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਠਾਓ ॥
Transliteration: koorr lab jaan thaae na paasee agai lahai na tthaao |
English: By falsehood and greed, no place of rest is found, and no place in the world hereafter is obtained.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਆਉ ਨ ਬੈਸਹੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਜਿਉ ਸੁੰਞੈ ਘਰਿ ਕਾਓ ॥
Transliteration: antar aau na baisahu kaheeai jiau sunyai ghar kaao |
English: No one invites him to come in and sit down. He is like a crow in a deserted home.

Gurbani: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਵਡਾ ਵੇਛੋੜਾ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਜਗੁ ਸਬਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jaman maran vaddaa vechhorraa binasai jag sabaae |
English: Trapped by birth and death, he is separated from the Lord for such a long time; the whole world is wasting away.

Gurbani: ਲਬਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਗਤੁ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਕਾਲੁ ਖੜਾ ਰੂਆਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: lab dhandhai maaeaa jagat bhulaaeaa kaal kharraa rooaae |1|
English: Greed, worldly entanglements and Maya deceive the world. Death hovers over its head, and causes it to weep. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਾਬਾ ਆਵਹੁ ਭਾਈਹੋ ਗਲਿ ਮਿਲਹ ਮਿਲਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਦੇਹ ਆਸੀਸਾ ਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: baabaa aavahu bhaaeeho gal milah mil mil deh aaseesaa he |
English: Come, O Baba, and Siblings of Destiny - let's join together; take me in your arms, and bless me with your prayers.

Gurbani: ਬਾਬਾ ਸਚੜਾ ਮੇਲੁ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕੀਆ ਦੇਹ ਅਸੀਸਾ ਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: baabaa sacharraa mel na chukee preetam keea deh aseesaa he |
English: O Baba, union with the True Lord cannot be broken; bless me with your prayers for union with my Beloved.

Gurbani: ਆਸੀਸਾ ਦੇਵਹੋ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇਵਹੋ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਮੇਲੋ ॥
Transliteration: aaseesaa devaho bhagat karevaho miliaa kaa kiaa melo |
English: Bless me with your prayers, that I may perform devotional worship service to my Lord; for those already united with Him, what is there to unite?

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਥੇਹਹੁ ਥਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਖੇਲੋ ॥
Transliteration: eik bhoole naavahu thehahu thaavahu gurasabadee sach khelo |
English: Some have wandered away from the Name of the Lord, and lost the Path. The Word of the Guru's Shabad is the true game.

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਵੇਸੇ ॥
Transliteration: jam maarag nahee jaanaa sabad samaanaa jug jug saachai vese |
English: Do not go on Death's path; remain merged in the Word of the Shabad, the true form throughout the ages.

Gurbani: ਸਾਜਨ ਸੈਣ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਖੋਲੇ ਫਾਸੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saajan sain milahu sanjogee gur mil khole faase |2|
English: Through good fortune, we meet such friends and relatives, who meet with the Guru, and escape the noose of Death. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬਾਬਾ ਨਾਂਗੜਾ ਆਇਆ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: baabaa naangarraa aaeaa jag meh dukh sukh lekh likhaaeaa |
English: O Baba, we come into the world naked, into pain and pleasure, according to the record of our account.

Gurbani: ਲਿਖਿਅੜਾ ਸਾਹਾ ਨਾ ਟਲੈ ਜੇਹੜਾ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: likhiarraa saahaa naa ttalai jeharraa purab kamaaeaa |
English: The call of our pre-ordained destiny cannot be altered; it follows from our past actions.

Gurbani: ਬਹਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: beh saachai likhiaa amrit bikhiaa jit laaeaa tith laagaa |
English: The True Lord sits and writes of ambrosial nectar, and bitter poison; as the Lord attaches us, so are we attached.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮਣਿਆਰੀ ਕਾਮਣ ਪਾਏ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ਗਲਿ ਤਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaamaniaaree kaaman paae bahu rangee gal taagaa |
English: The Charmer, Maya, has worked her charms, and the multi-colored thread is around everyone's neck.

Gurbani: ਹੋਛੀ ਮਤਿ ਭਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਛਾ ਗੁੜੁ ਸਾ ਮਖੀ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: hochhee mat bheaa man hochhaa gurr saa makhee khaaeaa |
English: Through shallow intellect, the mind becomes shallow, and one eats the fly, along with the sweets.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਮਰਜਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ ਕਲਿ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਨਾਂਗੋ ਬੰਧਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naa marajaad aaeaa kal bheetar naango bandh chalaaeaa |3|
English: Contrary to custom, he comes into the Dark Age of Kali Yuga naked, and naked he is bound down and sent away again. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬਾਬਾ ਰੋਵਹੁ ਜੇ ਕਿਸੈ ਰੋਵਣਾ ਜਾਨੀਅੜਾ ਬੰਧਿ ਪਠਾਇਆ ਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: baabaa rovahu je kisai rovanaa jaaneearraa bandh patthaaeaa hai |
English: O Baba, weep and mourn if you must; the beloved soul is bound and driven off.

Gurbani: ਲਿਖਿਅੜਾ ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਮੇਟੀਐ ਦਰਿ ਹਾਕਾਰੜਾ ਆਇਆ ਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: likhiarraa lekh na metteeai dar haakaararraa aaeaa hai |
English: The pre-ordained record of destiny cannot be erased; the summons has come from the Lord's Court.

Gurbani: ਹਾਕਾਰਾ ਆਇਆ ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਇਆ ਰੁੰਨੇ ਰੋਵਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: haakaaraa aaeaa jaa tis bhaaeaa rune rovanahaare |
English: The messenger comes, when it pleases the Lord, and the mourners begin to mourn.

Gurbani: ਪੁਤ ਭਾਈ ਭਾਤੀਜੇ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: put bhaaee bhaateeje roveh preetam at piaare |
English: Sons, brothers, nephews and very dear friends weep and wail.

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਰੋਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਕੋ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਮੁਇਆ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: bhai rovai gun saar samaale ko marai na mueaa naale |
English: Let him weep, who weeps in the Fear of God, cherishing the virtues of God. No one dies with the dead.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਜਾਣ ਸਿਜਾਣਾ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥੪॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak jug jug jaan sijaanaa roveh sach samaale |4|5|
English: O Nanak, throughout the ages, they are known as wise, who weep, remembering the True Lord. ||4||5||

[Ang 582 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਮਹਲਾ ਤੀਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 3 mahalaa teejaa |
English: Wadahans, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਚੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: prabh sacharraa har saalaaheeai kaaraj sabh kichh karanai jog |
English: Praise God, the True Lord; He is all-powerful to do all things.

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਰੰਡ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਬੈਸਈ ਨਾ ਕਦੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: saa dhan randd na kabahoo baisee naa kade hovai sog |
English: The soul-bride shall never be a widow, and she shall never have to endure suffering.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਕਦੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਗੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਮਹਲਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: naa kade hovai sog anadin ras bhog saa dhan mehal samaanee |
English: She shall never suffer - night and day, she enjoys pleasures; that soul-bride merges in the Mansion of her Lord's Presence.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਜਾਤਾ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਬੋਲੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: jin priau jaataa karam bidhaataa bole amrit baanee |
English: She knows her Beloved, the Architect of karma, and she speaks words of ambrosial sweetness.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀਆ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਹਿ ਅਪਣੇ ਕੰਤ ਸਮਾਲਹਿ ਨਾ ਕਦੇ ਲਗੈ ਵਿਜੋਗੋ ॥
Transliteration: gunavanteea gun saareh apane kant samaaleh naa kade lagai vijogo |
English: The virtuous soul-brides dwell on the Lord's virtues; they keep their Husband Lord in their remembrance, and so they never suffer separation from Him.

Gurbani: ਸਚੜਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣੈ ਜੋਗੋ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sacharraa pir saalaaheeai sabh kichh karanai jogo |1|
English: So praise your True Husband Lord, who is all-powerful to do all things. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਚੜਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sacharraa saahib sabad pachhaaneeai aape le milaae |
English: The True Lord and Master is realized through the Word of His Shabad; He blends all with Himself.

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: saa dhan pria kai rang ratee vichahu aap gavaae |
English: That soul-bride is imbued with the Love of her Husband Lord, who banishes her self-conceit from within.

Gurbani: ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਫਿਰਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਖਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: vichahu aap gavaae fir kaal na khaae guramukh eko jaataa |
English: Eradicating her ego from within herself, death shall not consume her again; as Gurmukh, she knows the One Lord God.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਭਿੰਨੀ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaaman ichh punee antar bhinee miliaa jagajeevan daataa |
English: The desire of the soul-bride is fulfilled; deep within herself, she is drenched in His Love. She meets the Great Giver, the Life of the World.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਮਾਤੀ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sabad rang raatee joban maatee pir kai ank samaae |
English: Imbued with love for the Shabad, she is like a youth intoxicated; she merges into the very being of her Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਚੜਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sacharraa saahib sabad pachhaaneeai aape le milaae |2|
English: The True Lord Master is realized through the Word of His Shabad. He blends all with Himself. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਕੰਤੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਪੂਛਉ ਸੰਤਾ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jinee aapanaa kant pachhaaniaa hau tin poochhau santaa jaae |
English: Those who have realized their Husband Lord - I go and ask those Saints about Him.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਸਚੜਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aap chhodd sevaa karee pir sacharraa milai sehaj subhaae |
English: Renouncing ego, I serve them; thus I meet my True Husband Lord, with intuitive ease.

Gurbani: ਪਿਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਆਏ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਮਾਏ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਧਨ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: pir sachaa milai aae saach kamaae saach sabad dhan raatee |
English: The True Husband Lord comes to meet the soul-bride who practices Truth, and is imbued with the True Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਕਦੇ ਨ ਰਾਂਡ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧੀ ॥
Transliteration: kade na raandd sadaa sohaagan antar sehaj samaadhee |
English: She shall never become a widow; she shall always be a happy bride. Deep within herself, she dwells in the celestial bliss of Samaadhi.

Gurbani: ਪਿਰੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ਵੇਖੁ ਹਦੂਰੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: pir rahiaa bharapoore vekh hadoore rang maane sehaj subhaae |
English: Her Husband Lord is fully pervading everywhere; beholding Him ever-present, she enjoys His Love, with intuitive ease.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਕੰਤੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਪੂਛਉ ਸੰਤਾ ਜਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jinee aapanaa kant pachhaaniaa hau tin poochhau santaa jaae |3|
English: Those who have realized their Husband Lord - I go and ask those Saints about Him. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪਿਰਹੁ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੀਆ ਭੀ ਮਿਲਹ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਲਾਗਹ ਸਾਚੇ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: pirahu vichhuneea bhee milah je satigur laagah saache paae |
English: The separated ones also meet with their Husband Lord, if they fall at the Feet of the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sadaa deaal hai avagun sabad jalaae |
English: The True Guru is forever merciful; through the Word of His Shabad, demerits are burnt away.

Gurbani: ਅਉਗੁਣ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਗਵਾਏ ਸਚੇ ਹੀ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: aaugun sabad jalaae doojaa bhaau gavaae sache hee sach raatee |
English: Burning away her demerits through the Shabad, the soul-bride eradicates her love of duality, and remains absorbed in the True, True Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਈ ਭਰਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: sachai sabad sadaa sukh paaeaa haumai gee bharaatee |
English: Through the True Shabad, everlasting peace is obtained, and egotism and doubt are dispelled.

Gurbani: ਪਿਰੁ ਨਿਰਮਾਇਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: pir niramaaeil sadaa sukhadaataa naanak sabad milaae |
English: The Immaculate Husband Lord is forever the Giver of peace; O Nanak, through the Word of His Shabad, He is met.

Gurbani: ਪਿਰਹੁ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੀਆ ਭੀ ਮਿਲਹ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਲਾਗਹ ਸਾਚੇ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: pirahu vichhuneea bhee milah je satigur laagah saache paae |4|1|
English: The separated ones also meet with their Husband Lord, if they fall at the feet of the True Guru. ||4||1||

[Ang 583 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 3 |
English: Wadahans, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿਅਹੁ ਕੰਤ ਮਹੇਲੀਹੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: suniahu kant maheleeho pir sevihu sabad veechaar |
English: Listen, O brides of the Lord: serve your Beloved Husband Lord, and contemplate the Word of His Shabad.

Gurbani: ਅਵਗਣਵੰਤੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਮੁਠੀ ਰੋਵੈ ਕੰਤ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: avaganavantee pir na jaanee mutthee rovai kant visaar |
English: The worthless bride does not know her Husband Lord - she is deluded; forgetting her Husband Lord, she weeps and wails.

Gurbani: ਰੋਵੈ ਕੰਤ ਸੰਮਾਲਿ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ਨਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: rovai kant samaal sadaa gun saar naa pir marai na jaae |
English: She weeps, thinking of her Husband Lord, and she cherishes His virtues; her Husband Lord does not die, and does not leave.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਸਾਚੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh jaataa sabad pachhaataa saachai prem samaae |
English: As Gurmukh, she knows the Lord; through the Word of His Shabad, He is realized; through True Love, she merges with Him.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਅਪਣਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤਾ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਕੂੜਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jin apanaa pir nahee jaataa karam bidhaataa koorr mutthee koorriaare |
English: She who does not know her Husband Lord, the Architect of karma, is deluded by falsehood - she herself is false.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿਅਹੁ ਕੰਤ ਮਹੇਲੀਹੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: suniahu kant maheleeho pir sevihu sabad veechaare |1|
English: Listen, O brides of the Lord: serve your Beloved Husband Lord, and contemplate the Word of His Shabad. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabh jag aap upaaeon aavan jaan sansaaraa |
English: He Himself created the whole world; the world comes and goes.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਖੁਆਇਅਨੁ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohu khuaaeian mar jamai vaaro vaaraa |
English: The love of Maya has ruined the world; people die, to be re-born, over and over again.

Gurbani: ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰਾ ਵਧਹਿ ਬਿਕਾਰਾ ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਹੂਣੀ ਮੂਠੀ ॥
Transliteration: mar jamai vaaro vaaraa vadheh bikaaraa giaan vihoonee mootthee |
English: People die to be re-born, over and over again, while their sins increase; without spiritual wisdom, they are deluded.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਓ ਰੋਵੈ ਅਵਗੁਣਿਆਰੀ ਝੂਠੀ ॥
Transliteration: bin sabadai pir na paaeo janam gavaaeo rovai avaguniaaree jhootthee |
English: Without the Word of the Shabad, the Husband Lord is not found; the worthless, false bride wastes her life away, weeping and wailing.

Gurbani: ਪਿਰੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਰੋਈਐ ਰੋਵੈ ਕੰਤੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: pir jagajeevan kis no roeeai rovai kant visaare |
English: He is my Beloved Husband Lord, the Life of the World - for whom should I weep? They alone weep, who forget their Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sabh jag aap upaaeon aavan jaan sansaare |2|
English: He Himself created the whole world; the world comes and goes. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਹੈ ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: so pir sachaa sad hee saachaa hai naa ohu marai na jaae |
English: That Husband Lord is True, forever True; He does not die, and He does not leave.

Gurbani: ਭੂਲੀ ਫਿਰੈ ਧਨ ਇਆਣੀਆ ਰੰਡ ਬੈਠੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: bhoolee firai dhan eaaneea randd baitthee doojai bhaae |
English: The ignorant soul-bride wanders in delusion; in the love of duality, she sits like a widow.

Gurbani: ਰੰਡ ਬੈਠੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਏ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਆਵ ਘਟੈ ਤਨੁ ਛੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: randd baitthee doojai bhaae maaeaa mohi dukh paae aav ghattai tan chheejai |
English: She sits like a widow, in the love of duality; through emotional attachment to Maya, she suffers in pain. She is growing old, and her body is withering away.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਸੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਭਾਇ ਦੂਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: jo kichh aaeaa sabh kichh jaasee dukh laagaa bhaae doojai |
English: Whatever has come, all that shall pass away; through the love of duality, they suffer in pain.

Gurbani: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਗੁ ਲੂਝੈ ਲਬਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jamakaal na soojhai maaeaa jag loojhai lab lobh chit laae |
English: They do not see the Messenger of Death; they long for Maya, and their consciousness is attached to greed.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: so pir saachaa sad hee saachaa naa ohu marai na jaae |3|
English: That Husband Lord is True, forever True; He does not die, and He does not leave. ||3||

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਪਿਰਹਿ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੀਆ ਅੰਧੀ ਨਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: eik roveh pireh vichhuneea andhee naa jaanai pir naale |
English: Some weep and wail, separated from their Husband Lord; the blind ones do not know that their Husband is with them.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee saachaa pir milai antar sadaa samaale |
English: By Guru's Grace, they may meet with their True Husband, and cherish Him always deep within.

Gurbani: ਪਿਰੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਨਾਲੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਦੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: pir antar samaale sadaa hai naale manamukh jaataa doore |
English: She cherishes her Husband deep within herself - He is always with her; the self-willed manmukhs think that He is far away.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਰੁਲੈ ਰੁਲਾਇਆ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਤਾ ਹਦੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: eihu tan rulai rulaaeaa kaam na aaeaa jin khasam na jaataa hadoore |
English: This body rolls in the dust, and is totally useless; it does not realize the Presence of the Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਪਿਰੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak saa dhan milai milaaee pir antar sadaa samaale |
English: O Nanak, that soul-bride is united in Union; she cherishes her Beloved Husband forever, deep within herself.

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਪਿਰਹਿ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੀਆ ਅੰਧੀ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: eik roveh pireh vichhuneea andhee na jaanai pir hai naale |4|2|
English: Some weep and wail, separated from their Husband Lord; the blind ones do not know that their Husband is with them. ||4||2||

[Ang 584 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 3 |
English: Wadahans, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰੋਵਹਿ ਪਿਰਹਿ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੀਆ ਮੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਸਚੜਾ ਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: roveh pireh vichhuneea mai pir sacharraa hai sadaa naale |
English: Those who are separated from their Beloved Husband Lord weep and wail, but my True Husband Lord is always with me.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਚਲਣੁ ਸਹੀ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: jinee chalan sahee jaaniaa satigur seveh naam samaale |
English: Those who know that they must depart, serve the True Guru, and dwell upon the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਲੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa naam samaale satigur hai naale satigur sev sukh paaeaa |
English: They dwell constantly upon the Naam, and the True Guru is with them; they serve the True Guru, and so obtain peace.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੇ ਕਾਲੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਨ ਹੋਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabade kaal maar sach ur dhaar fir aavan jaan na hoeaa |
English: Through the Shabad, they kill death, and enshrine the True Lord within their hearts; they shall not have to come and go again.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੀ ਨਾਈ ਵੇਖੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa saahib sachee naaee vekhai nadar nihaale |
English: True is the Lord and Master, and True is His Name; bestowing His Gracious Glance, one is enraptured.

Gurbani: ਰੋਵਹਿ ਪਿਰਹੁ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੀਆ ਮੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਸਚੜਾ ਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਲੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: roveh pirahu vichhuneea mai pir sacharraa hai sadaa naale |1|
English: Those who are separated from their Beloved Husband Lord weep and wail, but my True Husband Lord is always with me. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਭ ਦੂ ਊਚਾ ਹੈ ਕਿਵ ਮਿਲਾਂ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: prabh meraa saahib sabh doo aoochaa hai kiv milaan preetam piaare |
English: God, my Lord and Master, is the highest of all; how can I meet my Dear Beloved?

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਤਾਂ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur melee taan sehaj milee pir raakhiaa ur dhaare |
English: When the True Guru united me, then I was naturally united with my Husband Lord, and now, I keep Him clasped to my heart.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ਨੇਹੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਿਰੁ ਦਿਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa ur dhaare nehu naal piaare satigur te pir disai |
English: I constantly, lovingly cherish my Beloved within my heart; through the True Guru, I see my Beloved.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਕਾ ਕਚਾ ਚੋਲਾ ਤਿਤੁ ਪੈਧੈ ਪਗੁ ਖਿਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa moh kaa kachaa cholaa tith paidhai pag khisai |
English: The cloak of Maya's love is false; wearing it, one slips and loses his footing.

Gurbani: ਪਿਰ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਸਚਾ ਚੋਲਾ ਤਿਤੁ ਪੈਧੈ ਤਿਖਾ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: pir rang raataa so sachaa cholaa tith paidhai tikhaa nivaare |
English: That cloak is true, which is dyed in the color of the Love of my Beloved; wearing it, my inner thirst is quenched.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਭ ਦੂ ਊਚਾ ਹੈ ਕਿਉ ਮਿਲਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: prabh meraa saahib sabh doo aoochaa hai kiau milaa preetam piaare |2|
English: God, my Lord and Master, is the highest of all; how can I meet my Dear Beloved? ||2||

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਹੋਰ ਭੂਲੀ ਅਵਗਣਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: mai prabh sach pachhaaniaa hor bhoolee avaganiaare |
English: I have realized my True Lord God, while the other worthless ones have gone astray.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਸਦਾ ਰਾਵੇ ਪਿਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਚੜੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: mai sadaa raave pir aapanaa sacharrai sabad veechaare |
English: I dwell constantly upon my Beloved Husband Lord, and reflect upon the True Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਨਾਰੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sachai sabad veechaare rang raatee naare mil satigur preetam paaeaa |
English: The bride reflects upon the True Shabad, and is imbued with His Love; she meets with the True Guru, and finds her Beloved.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੀ ਗਇਆ ਦੁਸਮਨੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: antar rang raatee sahaje maatee geaa dusaman dookh sabaaeaa |
English: Deep within, she is imbued with His Love, and intoxicated with delight; her enemies and sufferings are all taken away.

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੰਉ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਤਾਂ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: apane gur knau tan man deejai taan man bheejai trisanaa dookh nivaare |
English: Surrender body and soul to your Guru, and then you shall become happy; your thirst and pain shall be taken away.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਹੋਰ ਭੂਲੀ ਅਵਗਣਿਆਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: mai pir sach pachhaaniaa hor bhoolee avaganiaare |3|
English: I have realized my True Lord God, while the other worthless ones have gone astray. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਚੜੈ ਆਪਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: sacharrai aap jagat upaaeaa gur bin ghor andhaaro |
English: The True Lord Himself created the world; without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: aap milaae aap milai aape dee piaaro |
English: He Himself unites, and causes us to unite with Him; He Himself blesses us with His Love.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਪਿਆਰੋ ਸਹਜਿ ਵਾਪਾਰੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aape dee piaaro sehaj vaapaaro guramukh janam savaare |
English: He Himself blesses us with His Love, and deals in celestial peace; the life of the Gurmukh is reformed.

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: dhan jag meh aaeaa aap gavaaeaa dar saachai sachiaaro |
English: Blessed is his coming into the world; he banishes his self-conceit, and is acclaimed as true in the Court of the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨਿ ਰਤਨਿ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਹੋਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: giaan ratan ghatt chaanan hoaa naanak naam piaaro |
English: The light of the jewel of spiritual wisdom shines within his heart, O Nanak, and he loves the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਚੜੈ ਆਪਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰੋ ॥੪॥੩॥
Transliteration: sacharrai aap jagat upaaeaa gur bin ghor andhaaro |4|3|
English: The True Lord Himself created the world; without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness. ||4||3||

[Ang 584 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans mahalaa 3 |
English: Wadahans, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਜਜਰੀ ਹੈ ਇਸ ਨੋ ਜਰੁ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: eihu sareer jajaree hai is no jar pahuchai aae |
English: This body is frail; old age is overtaking it.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਹੋਰੁ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur raakhe se ubare hor mar jamai aavai jaae |
English: Those who are protected by the Guru are saved, while others die, to be reincarnated; they continue coming and going.

Gurbani: ਹੋਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਏ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: hor mar jameh aaveh jaaveh ant ge pachhutaaveh bin naavai sukh na hoee |
English: Others die, to be reincarnated; they continue coming and going, and in the end, they depart regretfully. Without the Name, there is no peace.

Gurbani: ਐਥੈ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਹੈ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aithai kamaavai so fal paavai manamukh hai pat khoee |
English: As one acts here, so does he obtain his rewards; the self-willed manmukh loses his honor.

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ਮਹਾ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਨਾ ਤਿਥੈ ਭੈਣ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jam pur ghor andhaar mahaa gubaar naa tithai bhain na bhaaee |
English: In the City of Death, there is pitch darkness, and huge clouds of dust; neither sister nor brother is there.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਜਜਰੀ ਹੈ ਇਸ ਨੋ ਜਰੁ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਆਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: eihu sareer jajaree hai is no jar pahuchai aaee |1|
English: This body is frail; old age is overtaking it. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਤਾਂ ਥੀਐ ਜਾਂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa kanchan taan theeai jaan satigur le milaae |
English: The body becomes like gold, when the True Guru unites one with Himself.

Gurbani: ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਸਚੜੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: bhram maaeaa vichahu katteeai sacharrai naam samaae |
English: Doubt and Maya have been removed from within me, and I am merged in the Naam, the True Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sachai naam samaae har gun gaae mil preetam sukh paae |
English: Merged in the True Name of the Lord, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; meeting my Beloved, I have found peace.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹੰਉਮੈ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa anand rahai din raatee vichahu hnaumai jaae |
English: I am in constant bliss, day and night; egotism has been dispelled from within me.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਪੁਰਖੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਹੰਉ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jinee purakhee har naam chit laaeaa tin kai hnau laagau paae |
English: I fall at the feet of those who enshrine the Naam within their consciousness.

Gurbani: ਕਾਂਇਆ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਤਾਂ ਥੀਐ ਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kaaneaa kanchan taan theeai jaa satigur le milaae |2|
English: The body becomes like gold, when the True Guru unites one with Himself. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: so sachaa sach salaaheeai je satigur dee bujhaae |
English: We truly praise the True Lord, when the True Guru imparts understanding.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੀਆ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਦੇਸਨਿ ਆਗੈ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: bin satigur bharam bhulaaneea kiaa muhu desan aagai jaae |
English: Without the True Guru, they are deluded by doubt; going to the world hereafter, what face will they display?

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਦੇਨਿ ਮੁਹੁ ਜਾਏ ਅਵਗੁਣਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਏ ਦੁਖੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa den muhu jaae avagun pachhutaae dukho dukh kamaae |
English: What face will they show, when they go there? They will regret and repent for their sins; their actions will bring them only pain and suffering.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੀਆ ਸੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲਾ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: naam rateea se rang chaloolaa pir kai ank samaae |
English: Those who are imbued with the Naam are dyed in the deep crimson color of the Lord's Love; they merge into the Being of their Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਸੂਝਈ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਕਹੀਐ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: tis jevadd avar na soojhee kis aagai kaheeai jaae |
English: I can conceive of no other as great as the Lord; unto whom should I go and speak?

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: so sachaa sach salaaheeai je satigur dee bujhaae |3|
English: We truly praise the True Lord, when the True Guru imparts understanding. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੜਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਿਆ ਹੰਉ ਤਿਨ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jinee sacharraa sach salaahiaa hnau tin laagau paae |
English: I fall at the feet of those who praise the Truest of the True.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਚੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਤਿਨ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮਲੁ ਸਭ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: se jan sache niramale tin miliaa mal sabh jaae |
English: Those humble beings are true, and immaculately pure; meeting them, all filth is washed off.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮਲੁ ਸਭ ਜਾਏ ਸਚੈ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਏ ਸਚੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: tin miliaa mal sabh jaae sachai sar naae sachai sehaj subhaae |
English: Meeting them, all filth is washed off; bathing in the Pool of Truth, one becomes truthful, with intuitive ease.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: naam niranjan agam agochar satigur deea bujhaae |
English: The True Guru has given me the realization of the Naam, the Immaculate Name of the Lord, the unfathomable, the imperceptible.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: anadin bhagat kareh rang raate naanak sach samaae |
English: Those who perform devotional worship to the Lord night and day, are imbued with His Love; O Nanak, they are absorbed in the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੜਾ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਹੰਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੪॥
Transliteration: jinee sacharraa sach dhiaaeaa hnau tin kai laagau paae |4|4|
English: I fall at the feet of those who meditate on the Truest of the True. ||4||4||

[Ang 585 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਵਡਹੰਸ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਲਲਾਂ ਬਹਲੀਮਾ ਕੀ ਧੁਨਿ ਗਾਵਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: vaddahans kee vaar mahalaa 4 lalaan bahaleemaa kee dhun gaavanee |
English: Vaar Of Wadahans, Fourth Mehl: To Be Sung In The Tune Of Lalaa-Behleemaa:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਵਡ ਹੰਸ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: sabad rate vadd hans hai sach naam ur dhaar |
English: The great swans are imbued with the Word of the Shabad; they enshrine the True Name within their hearts.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਹਿ ਸਦ ਸਚਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: sach sangraheh sad sach raheh sachai naam piaar |
English: They gather Truth, remain always in Truth, and love the True Name.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਨਦਰਿ ਕੀਤੀ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa niramal mail na lagee nadar keetee karataar |
English: They are always pure and immaculate - filth does not touch them; they are blessed with the Grace of the Creator Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜੋ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਪਹਿ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak hau tin kai balihaaranai jo anadin japeh muraar |1|
English: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those who, night and day, meditate on the Lord. ||1||

[Ang 585 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਵਡ ਹੰਸੁ ਹੈ ਤਾ ਮੈ ਕੀਆ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: mai jaaniaa vadd hans hai taa mai keea sang |
English: I thought that he was a great swan, so I associated with him.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਜਾਣਾ ਬਗੁ ਬਪੁੜਾ ਤ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਦੇਦੀ ਅੰਗੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: je jaanaa bag bapurraa ta janam na dedee ang |2|
English: If I had known that he was only a wretched heron from birth, I would not have touched him. ||2||

[Ang 585 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹੰਸਾ ਵੇਖਿ ਤਰੰਦਿਆ ਬਗਾਂ ਭਿ ਆਯਾ ਚਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hansaa vekh tarandiaa bagaan bhi aayaa chaau |
English: Seeing the swans swimming, the herons became envious.

Gurbani: ਡੁਬਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਗ ਬਪੁੜੇ ਸਿਰੁ ਤਲਿ ਉਪਰਿ ਪਾਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ddub mue bag bapurre sir tal upar paau |3|
English: But the poor herons drowned and died, and floated with their heads down, and their feet above. ||3||

[Ang 585 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਆਪਿ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: too aape hee aap aap hai aap kaaran keea |
English: You Yourself are Yourself, all by Yourself; You Yourself created the creation.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਕੋ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਬੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: too aape aap nirankaar hai ko avar na beea |
English: You Yourself are Yourself the Formless Lord; there is no other than You.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਹੈ ਤੂ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੁ ਥੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: too karan kaaran samarath hai too kareh su theea |
English: You are the all-powerful Cause of causes; what You do, comes to be.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਅਣਮੰਗਿਆ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵਣਾ ਸਭਨਾਹਾ ਜੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: too anamangiaa daan devanaa sabhanaahaa jeea |
English: You give gifts to all beings, without their asking.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਆਖਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੀਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sabh aakhahu satigur vaahu vaahu jin daan har naam mukh deea |1|
English: Everyone proclaims, "Waaho! Waaho!" Blessed, blessed is the True Guru, who has given the supreme gift of the Name of the Lord. ||1||

[Ang 586 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਭੁ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhai vich sabh aakaar hai nirbhau har jeeo soe |
English: The entire universe is in fear; only the Dear Lord is fearless.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਿਥੈ ਭਉ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur seviai har man vasai tithai bhau kade na hoe |
English: Serving the True Guru, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind, and then, fear cannot stay there.

Gurbani: ਦੁਸਮਨੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਪੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: dusaman dukh tis no nerr na aavai pohi na sakai koe |
English: Enemies and pain cannot come close, and no one can touch him.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿਆ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh man veechaariaa jo tis bhaavai su hoe |
English: The Gurmukh reflects upon the Lord in his mind; whatever pleases the Lord - that alone comes to pass.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਪਤਿ ਰਖਸੀ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak aape hee pat rakhasee kaaraj savaare soe |1|
English: O Nanak, He Himself preserves one's honor; He alone resolves our affairs. ||1||

[Ang 586 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਸਜਣ ਚਲੇ ਇਕਿ ਚਲਿ ਗਏ ਰਹਦੇ ਭੀ ਫੁਨਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: eik sajan chale ik chal ge rahade bhee fun jaeh |
English: Some friends are leaving, some have already left, and those remaining will eventually leave.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਸੇ ਆਇ ਗਏ ਪਛੁਤਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jinee satigur na sevio se aae ge pachhutaeh |
English: Those who do not serve the True Guru, come and go regretting.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak sach rate se na vichhurreh satigur sev samaeh |2|
English: O Nanak, those who are attuned to Truth are not separated; serving the True Guru, they merge into the Lord. ||2||

[Ang 586 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਜਣੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: tis mileeai satigur sajanai jis antar har gunakaaree |
English: Meet with that True Guru, the True Friend, within whose mind the Lord, the virtuous One, abides.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਹੰਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: tis mileeai satigur preetamai jin hnaumai vichahu maaree |
English: Meet with that Beloved True Guru, who has subdued ego from within himself.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਦੇ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸ੍ਟਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: so satigur pooraa dhan dhan hai jin har upades de sabh srisatt savaaree |
English: Blessed, blessed is the Perfect True Guru, who has given the Lord's Teachings to reform the whole world.

Gurbani: ਨਿਤ ਜਪਿਅਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਉਜਲ ਬਿਖੁ ਤਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: nit japiahu santahu raam naam bhaujal bikh taaree |
English: O Saints, meditate constantly on the Lord's Name, and cross over the terrifying, poisonous world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਵਿਟੜਿਅਹੁ ਹੰਉ ਸਦ ਵਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur poorai har upadesiaa gur vittarriahu hnau sad vaaree |2|
English: The Perfect Guru has taught me about the Lord; I am forever a sacrifice to the Guru. ||2||

[Ang 586 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਸੁਖੀ ਹੂੰ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: satigur kee sevaa chaakaree sukhee hoon sukh saar |
English: Service to, and obedience to the True Guru, is the essence of comfort and peace.

Gurbani: ਐਥੈ ਮਿਲਨਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਦਰਗਹ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: aithai milan vaddiaaeea daragah mokh duaar |
English: Doing so, one obtains honor here, and the door of salvation in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sachee kaar kamaavanee sach painan sach naam adhaar |
English: In this way, perform the tasks of Truth, wear Truth, and take the Support of the True Name.

Gurbani: ਸਚੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sachee sangat sach milai sachai naae piaar |
English: Associating with Truth, obtain Truth, and love the True Name.

Gurbani: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਖੁ ਸਦਾ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sachai sabad harakh sadaa dar sachai sachiaar |
English: Through the True Word of the Shabad, be always happy, and you shall be acclaimed as True in the True Court.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਕਰੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੈ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak satigur kee sevaa so karai jis no nadar karai karataar |1|
English: O Nanak, he alone serves the True Guru, whom the Creator has blessed with His Glance of Grace. ||1||

[Ang 586 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹੋਰ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: hor viddaanee chaakaree dhrig jeevan dhrig vaas |
English: Cursed is the life, and cursed is the dwelling, of those who serve another.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਲਗੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਟਣਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: amrit chhodd bikh lage bikh khattanaa bikh raas |
English: Abandoning the Ambrosial Nectar, they turn to poison; they earn poison, and poison is their only wealth.

Gurbani: ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਪੈਨਣਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਕੇ ਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਰਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: bikh khaanaa bikh painanaa bikh ke mukh giraas |
English: Poison is their food, and poison is their dress; they fill their mouths with morsels of poison.

Gurbani: ਐਥੈ ਦੁਖੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਮੁਇਆ ਨਰਕਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: aithai dukho dukh kamaavanaa mueaa narak nivaas |
English: In this world, they earn only pain and suffering, and dying, they go to abide in hell.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਹਿ ਮੈਲੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਕਾਮ ਕਰੋਧਿ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh muhi mailai sabad na jaananee kaam karodh vinaas |
English: The self-willed manmukhs have filthy faces; they do not know the Word of the Shabad; in sexual desire and anger they waste away.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕੰਮੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: satigur kaa bhau chhoddiaa manahatth kam na aavai raas |
English: They forsake the Fear of the True Guru, and because of their stubborn ego, their efforts do not come to fruition.

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਕੋ ਨ ਸੁਣੇ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: jam pur badhe maareeeh ko na sune aradaas |
English: In the City of Death, they are bound and beaten, and no one hears their prayers.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak poorab likhiaa kamaavanaa guramukh naam nivaas |2|
English: O Nanak, they act according to their pre-ordained destiny; the Gurmukh abides in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

[Ang 586 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਸਾਧ ਜਨੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: so satigur sevihu saadh jan jin har har naam drirraaeaa |
English: Serve the True Guru, O Holy people; He implants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in our minds.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਜਹੁ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗੰਨਾਥੁ ਜਗਦੀਸੁ ਜਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: so satigur poojahu dinas raat jin jaganaath jagadees japaaeaa |
English: Worship the True Guru day and night; He leads us the meditate on the Lord of the Universe, the Master of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਬਤਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: so satigur dekhahu ik nimakh nimakh jin har kaa har panth bataaeaa |
English: Behold the True Guru, each and every moment; He shows us the Divine Path of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਪਗੀ ਪਵਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਮੋਹ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tis satigur kee sabh pagee pavahu jin moh andher chukaaeaa |
English: Let everyone fall at the feet of the True Guru; He has dispelled the darkness of emotional attachment.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਸਭਿ ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਲਹਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: so satagur kahahu sabh dhan dhan jin har bhagat bhanddaar lahaaeaa |3|
English: Let everyone hail and praise the True Guru, who has led us to find the treasure of the Lord's devotional worship. ||3||

[Ang 586 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਭੁਖ ਗਈ ਭੇਖੀ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur miliai bhukh gee bhekhee bhukh na jaae |
English: Meeting with the True Guru, hunger departs; by wearing the robes of a beggar, hunger does not depart.

Gurbani: ਦੁਖਿ ਲਗੈ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਅਗੈ ਦੂਣੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: dukh lagai ghar ghar firai agai doonee milai sajaae |
English: Afflicted with pain, he wanders from house to house, and in the world hereafter, he receives double punishment.

Gurbani: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਲੈ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: andar sehaj na aaeo sahaje hee lai khaae |
English: Peace does not come to his heart - he is not content to eat what comes his way.

Gurbani: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਮੰਗਣਾ ਲੈਣਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਮਨਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: manahatth jis te manganaa lainaa dukh manaae |
English: With his stubborn mind, he begs, and grabs, and annoys those who give.

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਭੇਖੈ ਥਾਵਹੁ ਗਿਰਹੋ ਭਲਾ ਜਿਥਹੁ ਕੋ ਵਰਸਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: eis bhekhai thaavahu giraho bhalaa jithahu ko varasaae |
English: Instead of wearing these beggar's robes, it is better to be a householder, and give to others.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਤਿਨਾ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabad rate tinaa sojhee pee doojai bharam bhulaae |
English: Those who are attuned to the Word of the Shabad, acquire understanding; the others wander, deluded by doubt.

Gurbani: ਪਇਐ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: peiai kirat kamaavanaa kahanaa kachhoo na jaae |
English: They act according to their past actions; it is useless to talk to them.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਭਲੇ ਜਿਨ ਕੀ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਥਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak jo tis bhaaveh se bhale jin kee pat paaveh thaae |1|
English: O Nanak, those who are pleasing unto the Lord are good; He upholds their honor. ||1||

[Ang 587 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur seviai sadaa sukh janam maran dukh jaae |
English: Serving the True Guru, one finds a lasting peace; the pains of birth and death are removed.

Gurbani: ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: chintaa mool na hovee achint vasai man aae |
English: He is not troubled by anxiety, and the carefree Lord comes to dwell in the mind.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਹੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: antar teerath giaan hai satigur deea bujhaae |
English: Deep within himself, is the sacred shrine of spiritual wisdom, revealed by the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਮੈਲੁ ਗਈ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: mail gee man niramal hoaa amrit sar teerath naae |
English: His filth is removed, and his soul becomes immaculately pure, bathing in the sacred shrine, the pool of Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਸਜਣ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਜਣਾ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sajan mile sajanaa sachai sabad subhaae |
English: The friend meets with the True Friend, the Lord, through the love of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਪਰਚਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: ghar hee parachaa paaeaa jotee jot milaae |
English: Within the home of his own being, he finds the Divine Self, and his light blends with the Light.

Gurbani: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਈ ਲੈ ਜਾਸੀ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: paakhandd jamakaal na chhoddee lai jaasee pat gavaae |
English: The Messenger of Death does not leave the hypocrite; he is led away in dishonor.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naam rate se ubare sache siau liv laae |2|
English: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Naam are saved; they are in love with the True Lord. ||2||

[Ang 587 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਤਿਤੁ ਜਾਇ ਬਹਹੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤੀ ਜਿਥੈ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਲੋਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: tit jaae bahahu satasangatee jithai har kaa har naam biloeeai |
English: Go, and sit in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, where the Name of the Lord is churned.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਖੋਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: sahaje hee har naam lehu har tat na khoeeai |
English: In peace and poise, contemplate the Lord's Name - don't lose the essence of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਿਤ ਜਪਿਅਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਢੋਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: nit japiahu har har dinas raat har daragah dtoeeai |
English: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, constantly, day and night, and you shall be accepted in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੂ ਜਿਸੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਲਾਟਿ ਲਿਖੋਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: so paae pooraa sataguroo jis dhur masatak lilaatt likhoeeai |
English: He alone finds the Perfect True Guru, on whose forehead such a pre-ordained destiny is written.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੰਉ ਸਭਿ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਲ ਗਲੋਈਐ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: tis gur knau sabh namasakaar karahu jin har kee har gaal galoeeai |4|
English: Let everyone bow in worship to the Guru, who utters the sermon of the Lord. ||4||

[Ang 587 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਜਣ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਜਣਾ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sajan mile sajanaa jin satagur naal piaar |
English: The friends who love the True Guru, meet with the Lord, the True Friend.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਤਿਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਸਚੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: mil preetam tinee dhiaaeaa sachai prem piaar |
English: Meeting their Beloved, they meditate on the True Lord with love and affection.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: man hee te man maaniaa gur kai sabad apaar |
English: Their minds are appeased by their own minds, through the incomparable Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਏਹਿ ਸਜਣ ਮਿਲੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਜਿ ਆਪਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: ehi sajan mile na vichhurreh ji aap mele karataar |
English: These friends are united, and will not be separated again; they have been united by the Creator Lord Himself.

Gurbani: ਇਕਨਾ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਈਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਕਰਹਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: eikanaa darasan kee parateet na aaeea sabad na kareh veechaar |
English: Some do not believe in the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan; they do not contemplate the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਵਿਛੁੜੈ ਜਿਨਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: vichhurriaa kaa kiaa vichhurrai jinaa doojai bhaae piaar |
English: The separated ones are in love with duality - what more separation can they suffer?

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸੇਤੀ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਥੋੜੜਿਆ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh setee dosatee thorrarriaa din chaar |
English: Friendship with the self-willed manmukhs lasts for only a few short days.

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਪਰੀਤੀ ਤੁਟਦੀ ਵਿਲਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਇਤੁ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਚਲਨਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: eis pareetee tuttadee vilam na hovee it dosatee chalan vikaar |
English: This friendship is broken in an instant; this friendship leads to corruption.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jinaa andar sache kaa bhau naahee naam na kareh piaar |
English: They do not fear the True Lord within their hearts, and they do not love the Naam.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਸਿਉ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਚੈ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਜਿ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak tin siau kiaa keechai dosatee ji aap bhulaae karataar |1|
English: O Nanak, why become friends with those whom the Creator Lord Himself has misled? ||1||

[Ang 587 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
