Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਸਦਾ ਇਕਤੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: eik sadaa ikatai rang raheh tin kai hau sad balihaarai jaau |
English: Some remain constantly imbued with the Lord's Love; I am forever a sacrifice to them.

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਅਰਪੀ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: tan man dhan arapee tin kau niv niv laagau paae |
English: I dedicate my mind, soul and wealth to them; bowing low, I fall at their feet.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਐ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਸਭ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: tin miliaa man santokheeai trisanaa bhukh sabh jaae |
English: Meeting them, the soul is satisfied, and one's hunger and thirst all depart.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naam rate sukhee sadaa sache siau liv laae |2|
English: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam are happy forever; they lovingly focus their minds on the True Lord. ||2||

[Ang 587 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: tis gur kau hau vaariaa jin har kee har kathaa sunaaee |
English: I am a sacrifice to the Guru, who recites the sermon of the Lord's Teachings.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: tis gur kau sad balihaaranai jin har sevaa banat banaaee |
English: I am forever a sacrifice to that Guru, who has led me to serve the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਮੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਹੈ ਜਿਥੈ ਕਿਥੈ ਮੈਨੋ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: so satigur piaaraa merai naal hai jithai kithai maino le chhaddaaee |
English: That Beloved True Guru is always with me; wherever I may be, He will save me.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: tis gur kau saabaas hai jin har sojhee paaee |
English: Most blessed is that Guru, who imparts understanding of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਪੁਰਾਈ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak gur vittahu vaariaa jin har naam deea mere man kee aas puraaee |5|
English: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Guru, who has given me the Lord's Name, and fulfilled the desires of my mind. ||5||

[Ang 588 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਦਾਧੀ ਜਲਿ ਮੁਈ ਜਲਿ ਜਲਿ ਕਰੇ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: trisanaa daadhee jal muee jal jal kare pukaar |
English: Consumed by desires, the world is burning and dying; burning and burning, it cries out.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੀਤਲ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਲੈ ਨ ਦੂਜੀ ਵਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: satigur seetal je milai fir jalai na doojee vaar |
English: But if it meets with the cooling and soothing True Guru, it does not burn any longer.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak vin naavai nirbhau ko nahee jichar sabad na kare veechaar |1|
English: O Nanak, without the Name, and without contemplating the Word of the Shabad, no one becomes fearless. ||1||

[Ang 588 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਭੇਖੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਬੁਝਈ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਹੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: bhekhee agan na bujhee chintaa hai man maeh |
English: Wearing ceremonial robes, the fire is not quenched, and the mind is filled with anxiety.

Gurbani: ਵਰਮੀ ਮਾਰੀ ਸਾਪੁ ਨਾ ਮਰੈ ਤਿਉ ਨਿਗੁਰੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: varamee maaree saap naa marai tiau nigure karam kamaeh |
English: Destroying the snake's hole, the snake is not killed; it is just like doing deeds without a Guru.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur daataa seveeai sabad vasai man aae |
English: Serving the Giver, the True Guru, the Shabad comes to abide in the mind.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man tan seetal saant hoe trisanaa agan bujhaae |
English: The mind and body are cooled and soothed; peace ensues, and the fire of desire is quenched.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਾ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sukhaa sir sadaa sukh hoe jaa vichahu aap gavaae |
English: The supreme comforts and lasting peace are obtained, when one eradicates ego from within.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਿ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh udaasee so kare ji sach rahai liv laae |
English: He alone becomes a detached Gurmukh, who lovingly focuses his consciousness on the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਜਾ ਆਘਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: chintaa mool na hovee har naam rajaa aaghaae |
English: Anxiety does not affect him at all; he is satisfied and satiated with the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਹ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਪਚਹਿ ਪਚਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naam binaa neh chhootteeai haumai pacheh pachaae |2|
English: O Nanak, without the Naam, no one is saved; they are utterly ruined by egotism. ||2||

[Ang 588 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨੀ ਪਾਇਅੜੇ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ॥
Transliteration: jinee har har naam dhiaaeaa tinee paaeiarre sarab sukhaa |
English: Those who meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, obtain all peace and comforts.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਕਾ ਸਫਲੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਭੁਖਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabh janam tinaa kaa safal hai jin har ke naam kee man laagee bhukhaa |
English: Fruitful is the entire life of those, who hunger for the Name of the Lord in their minds.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਗਏ ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖਾ ॥
Transliteration: jinee gur kai bachan aaraadhiaa tin visar ge sabh dukhaa |
English: Those who worship the Lord in adoration, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, forget all their pains and suffering.

Gurbani: ਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਭਲੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਹੈ ਜਿਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਚਿੰਤ ਪਰਾਈ ਚੁਖਾ ॥
Transliteration: te sant bhale gurasikh hai jin naahee chint paraaee chukhaa |
English: Those Gursikhs are good Saints, who care for nothing other than the Lord.

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਕਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਮੁਖਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan tinaa kaa guroo hai jis amrit fal har laage mukhaa |6|
English: Blessed, blessed is their Guru, whose mouth tastes the Ambrosial Fruit of the Lord's Name. ||6||

[Ang 588 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਜਮੁ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kal meh jam jandaar hai hukame kaar kamaae |
English: In the Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Messenger of Death is the enemy of life, but he acts according to the Lord's Command.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur raakhe se ubare manamukhaa dee sajaae |
English: Those who are protected by the Guru are saved, while the self-willed manmukhs receive their punishment.

Gurbani: ਜਮਕਾਲੈ ਵਸਿ ਜਗੁ ਬਾਂਧਿਆ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਫਰੂ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jamakaalai vas jag baandhiaa tis daa faroo na koe |
English: The world is under the control, and in the bondage of the Messenger of Death; no one can hold him back.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਮੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਸੋ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jin jam keetaa so seveeai guramukh dukh na hoe |
English: So serve the One who created Death; as Gurmukh, no pain shall touch you.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਮੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਸਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh jam sevaa kare jin man sachaa hoe |1|
English: O Nanak, Death serves the Gurmukhs; the True Lord abides in their minds. ||1||

[Ang 588 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਏਹਾ ਕਾਇਆ ਰੋਗਿ ਭਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: ehaa kaaeaa rog bharee bin sabadai dukh haumai rog na jaae |
English: This body is filled with disease; without the Word of the Shabad, the pain of the disease of ego does not depart.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur milai taa niramal hovai har naamo man vasaae |
English: When one meets the True Guru, then he becomes immaculately pure, and he enshrines the Lord's Name within his mind.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naam dhiaaeaa sukhadaataa dukh visariaa sehaj subhaae |2|
English: O Nanak, meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Peace-Giving Lord, his pains are automatically forgotten. ||2||

[Ang 588 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਸਦਾ ਘੁਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jin jagajeevan upadesiaa tis gur kau hau sadaa ghumaaeaa |
English: I am forever a sacrifice to the Guru, who has taught me about the Lord, the Life of the World.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tis gur kau hau khaneeai jin madhusoodan har naam sunaaeaa |
English: I am every bit a sacrifice to the Guru, the Lover of Nectar, who has revealed the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਵਾਰਣੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਸਭੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tis gur kau hau vaaranai jin haumai bikh sabh rog gavaaeaa |
English: I am a sacrifice to the Guru, who has totally cured me of the fatal disease of egotism.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਵਡ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਕਟਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tis satigur kau vadd pun hai jin avagan katt gunee samajhaaeaa |
English: Glorious and great are the virtues of the Guru, who has eradicated evil, and instructed me in virtue.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: so satigur tin kau bhettiaa jin kai mukh masatak bhaag likh paaeaa |7|
English: The True Guru meets with those upon whose foreheads such blessed destiny is recorded. ||7||

[Ang 589 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਮਰਜੀਵੜੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat kareh marajeevarre guramukh bhagat sadaa hoe |
English: They alone worship the Lord, who remain dead while yet alive; the Gurmukhs worship the Lord continually.

Gurbani: ਓਨਾ ਕਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਬਖਸਿਆ ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: onaa kau dhur bhagat khajaanaa bakhasiaa mett na sakai koe |
English: The Lord blesses them with the treasure of devotional worship, which no one can destroy.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਏਕੋ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: gun nidhaan man paaeaa eko sachaa soe |
English: They obtain the treasure of virtue, the One True Lord, within their minds.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh mil rahe fir vichhorraa kade na hoe |1|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs remain united with the Lord; they shall never be separated again. ||1||

[Ang 589 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਕੀਨੀਆ ਕਿਆ ਓਹੁ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: satigur kee sev na keeneea kiaa ohu kare veechaar |
English: He does not serve the True Guru; how can he reflect upon the Lord?

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੈ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਬਿਖੁ ਭੂਲਾ ਗਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sabadai saar na jaanee bikh bhoolaa gaavaar |
English: He does not appreciate the value of the Shabad; the fool wanders in corruption and sin.

Gurbani: ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: agiaanee andh bahu karam kamaavai doojai bhaae piaar |
English: The blind and ignorant perform all sorts of ritualistic actions; they are in love with duality.

Gurbani: ਅਣਹੋਦਾ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਦੇ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: anahodaa aap ganaaeide jam maar kare tin khuaar |
English: Those who take unjustified pride in themselves, are punished and humiliated by the Messenger of Death.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak kis no aakheeai jaa aape bakhasanahaar |2|
English: O Nanak, who else is there to ask? The Lord Himself is the Forgiver. ||2||

[Ang 589 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: too karataa sabh kichh jaanadaa sabh jeea tumaare |
English: You, O Creator, know all things; all beings belong to You.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jis too bhaavai tis too mel laihi kiaa jant vichaare |
English: Those who are pleasing to You, You unite with Yourself; what can the poor creatures do?

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: too karan kaaran samarath hai sach sirajanahaare |
English: You are all-powerful, the Cause of causes, the True Creator Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਸੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jis too meleh piaariaa so tudh milai guramukh veechaare |
English: Only those unite with you, Beloved Lord, whom you approve and who meditate on Guru's Word.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਰੇ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: hau balihaaree satigur aapane jin meraa har alakh lakhaare |8|
English: I am a sacrifice to my True Guru, who has allowed me to see my unseen Lord. ||8||

[Ang 589 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਤਨਾ ਪਾਰਖੁ ਜੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਰਤਨਾ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: ratanaa paarakh jo hovai su ratanaa kare veechaar |
English: He is the Assayer of jewels; He contemplates the jewel.

Gurbani: ਰਤਨਾ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: ratanaa saar na jaanee agiaanee andh andhaar |
English: He is ignorant and totally blind - he does not appreciate the value of the jewel.

Gurbani: ਰਤਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਬੂਝਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: ratan guroo kaa sabad hai boojhai boojhanahaar |
English: The Jewel is the Word of the Guru's Shabad; the Knower alone knows it.

Gurbani: ਮੂਰਖ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਦੇ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: moorakh aap ganaaeide mar jameh hoe khuaar |
English: The fools take pride in themselves, and are ruined in birth and death.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਤਨਾ ਸੋ ਲਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak ratanaa so lahai jis guramukh lagai piaar |
English: O Nanak, he alone obtains the jewel, who, as Gurmukh, enshrines love for it.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਚਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਨਿਤ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa naam ucharai har naamo nit biauhaar |
English: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, forever and ever, make the Name of the Lord your daily occupation.

Gurbani: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਖਾ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kripaa kare je aapanee taa har rakhaa ur dhaar |1|
English: If the Lord shows His Mercy, then I keep Him enshrined within my heart. ||1||

[Ang 589 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਕੀਨੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: satigur kee sev na keeneea har naam na lago piaar |
English: They do not serve the True Guru, and they do not embrace love for the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਮਤ ਤੁਮ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਓਇ ਜੀਵਦੇ ਓਇ ਆਪਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: mat tum jaanahu oe jeevade oe aap maare karataar |
English: Do not even think that they are alive - the Creator Lord Himself has killed them.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਡਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੂਜੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: haumai vaddaa rog hai bhaae doojai karam kamaae |
English: Egotism is such a terrible disease; in the love of duality, they do their deeds.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਮੁਏ ਹਰਿ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak manamukh jeevadiaa mue har visariaa dukh paae |2|
English: O Nanak, the self-willed manmukhs are in a living death; forgetting the Lord, they suffer in pain. ||2||

[Ang 589 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਹਿਰਦਾ ਸੁਧੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਸਭਿ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jis antar hiradaa sudh hai tis jan kau sabh namasakaaree |
English: Let all bow in reverence, to that humble being whose heart is pure within.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jis andar naam nidhaan hai tis jan kau hau balihaaree |
English: I am a sacrifice to that humble being whose mind is filled with the treasure of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਬੇਕੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jis andar budh bibek hai har naam muraaree |
English: He has a discriminating intellect; he meditates on the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਮਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: so satigur sabhanaa kaa mit hai sabh tiseh piaaree |
English: That True Guru is a friend to all; everyone is dear to Him.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਸਾਰਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਬੁਧਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: sabh aatam raam pasaariaa gur budh beechaaree |9|
English: The Lord, the Supreme Soul, is pervading everywhere; reflect upon the wisdom of the Guru's Teachings. ||9||

[Ang 589 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਜੀਅ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: bin satigur seve jeea ke bandhanaa vich haumai karam kamaeh |
English: Without serving the True Guru, the soul is in the bondage of deeds done in ego.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੀ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: bin satigur seve tthaur na paavahee mar jameh aaveh jaeh |
English: Without serving the True Guru, one finds no place of rest; he dies, and is reincarnated, and continues coming and going.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਫਿਕਾ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: bin satigur seve fikaa bolanaa naam na vasai man maeh |
English: Without serving the True Guru, one's speech is vapid and insipid; the Naam, the Name of the Lord, does not abide in his mind.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਨਿ ਮੁਹਿ ਕਾਲੈ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak bin satigur seve jam pur badhe maareean muhi kaalai utth jaeh |1|
English: O Nanak, without serving the True Guru, they are bound and beaten in the City of Death; they arise and depart with blackened faces. ||1||

[Ang 590 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਾਲਉ ਐਸੀ ਰੀਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਮੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: jaalau aisee reet jit mai piaaraa veesarai |
English: Burn away those rituals which lead you to forget the Beloved Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਈ ਭਲੀ ਪਰੀਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸੇਤੀ ਪਤਿ ਰਹੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak saaee bhalee pareet jit saahib setee pat rahai |2|
English: O Nanak, sublime is that love, which preserves my honor with my Lord Master. ||2||

[Ang 590 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: har iko daataa seveeai har ik dhiaaeeai |
English: Serve the One Lord, the Great Giver; meditate on the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: har iko daataa mangeeai man chindiaa paaeeai |
English: Beg from the One Lord, the Great Giver, and you shall obtain your heart's desires.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਦੂਜੇ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਤਾ ਲਾਜ ਮਰਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: je dooje paasahu mangeeai taa laaj maraaeeai |
English: But if you beg from another, then you shall be shamed and destroyed.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਭੁਖ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: jin seviaa tin fal paaeaa tis jan kee sabh bhukh gavaaeeai |
English: One who serves the Lord obtains the fruits of his rewards; all of his hunger is satisfied.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: naanak tin vittahu vaariaa jin anadin hiradai har naam dhiaaeeai |10|
English: Nanak is a sacrifice to those, who night and day, meditate within their hearts on the Name of the Lord. ||10||

[Ang 590 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੰਉ ਆਪਿ ਤੁਠਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਲਇਅਨੁ ਜਨ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat janaa knau aap tutthaa meraa piaaraa aape leian jan laae |
English: He Himself is pleased with His humble devotees; my Beloved Lord attaches them to Himself.

Gurbani: ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਦਿਤੀਅਨੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਤੁ ਸਚਾ ਹਰਿ ਬਣਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: paatisaahee bhagat janaa kau diteean sir chhat sachaa har banaae |
English: The Lord blesses His humble devotees with royalty; He fashions the true crown upon their heads.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sukhee niramale satigur kee kaar kamaae |
English: They are always at peace, and immaculately pure; they perform service for the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਰਾਜੇ ਓਇ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਭਿੜਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: raaje oe na aakheeeh bhirr mareh fir joonee paeh |
English: They are not said to be kings, who die in conflict, and then enter again the cycle of reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਕਂੀ ਵਢਂੀ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak vin naavai nakanee vadtanee fireh sobhaa mool na paeh |1|
English: O Nanak, without the Name of the Lord, they wander about with their noses cut off in disgrace; they get no respect at all. ||1||

[Ang 590 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਿਖਿਐ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: sun sikhiai saad na aaeo jichar guramukh sabad na laagai |
English: Hearing the teachings, he does not appreciate them, as long as he is not Gurmukh, attached to the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur seviai naam man vasai vichahu bhram bhau bhaagai |
English: Serving the True Guru, the Naam comes to abide in the mind, and doubts and fears run away.

Gurbani: ਜੇਹਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਤੇਹੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: jehaa satigur no jaanai teho hovai taa sach naam liv laagai |
English: As he knows the True Guru, so he is transformed, and then, he lovingly focuses his consciousness on the Naam.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਆਗੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naam milai vaddiaaee har dar sohan aagai |2|
English: O Nanak, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, greatness is obtained; he shall be resplendent in the Court of the Lord hereafter. ||2||

[Ang 590 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾਂ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਜਣ ਆਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: gurasikhaan man har preet hai gur poojan aaveh |
English: The minds of the Gursikhs are filled with the love of the Lord; they come and worship the Guru.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਣੰਜਹਿ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈ ਜਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: har naam vananjeh rang siau laahaa har naam lai jaaveh |
English: They trade lovingly in the Lord's Name, and depart after earning the profit of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਭਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: gurasikhaa ke mukh ujale har daragah bhaaveh |
English: The faces of the Gursikhs are radiant; in the Court of the Lord, they are approved.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸਿਖ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਂਝ ਕਰਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: gur satigur bohal har naam kaa vaddabhaagee sikh gun saanjh karaaveh |
English: The Guru, the True Guru, is the treasure of the Lord's Name; how very fortunate are the Sikhs who share in this treasure of virtue.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਕੰਉ ਹਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜੋ ਬਹਦਿਆ ਉਠਦਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: tinaa gurasikhaa knau hau vaariaa jo bahadiaa utthadiaa har naam dhiaaveh |11|
English: I am a sacrifice to those Gursikhs who, sitting and standing, meditate on the Lord's Name. ||11||

[Ang 590 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak naam nidhaan hai guramukh paaeaa jaae |
English: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the treasure, which the Gurmukhs obtain.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਘਰਿ ਹੋਦੀ ਵਥੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਅੰਧੇ ਭਉਕਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: manamukh ghar hodee vath na jaananee andhe bhauk mue bilalaae |1|
English: The self-willed manmukhs are blind; they do not realize that it is within their own home. They die barking and crying. ||1||

[Ang 590 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕੰਚਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਨਿਰਮਲੀ ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਚਿ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: kanchan kaaeaa niramalee jo sach naam sach laagee |
English: That body is golden and immaculate, which is attached to the True Name of the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: niramal jot niranjan paaeaa guramukh bhram bhau bhaagee |
English: The Gurmukh obtains the Pure Light of the Luminous Lord, and his doubts and fears run away.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh sadaa sukh paaveh anadin har bairaagee |2|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs find lasting peace; night and day, they remain detached, while in the Love of the Lord. ||2||

[Ang 590 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: se gurasikh dhan dhan hai jinee gur upades suniaa har kanee |
English: Blessed, blessed are those Gursikhs, who, with their ears, listen to the Guru's Teachings about the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਹੰਉਮੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਭੰਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur satigur naam drirraaeaa tin hnaumai dubidhaa bhanee |
English: The Guru, the True Guru, implants the Naam within them, and their egotism and duality are silenced.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਡਿਠਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੰਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: bin har naavai ko mitru naahee veechaar dditthaa har janee |
English: There is no friend, other than the Name of the Lord; the Lord's humble servants reflect upon this and see.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤੁਸਟੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਗਲ ਮੰਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: jinaa gurasikhaa kau har santusatt hai tinee satigur kee gal manee |
English: Those Gursikhs, with whom the Lord is pleased, accept the Word of the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਤਿਨੀ ਚੜੀ ਚਵਗਣਿ ਵੰਨੀ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: jo guramukh naam dhiaaeide tinee charree chavagan vanee |12|
English: Those Gurmukhs who meditate on the Naam are imbued with the four-fold color of the Lord's Love. ||12||

[Ang 591 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਕਾਇਰੁ ਕਰੂਪੁ ਹੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਕੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh kaaeir karoop hai bin naavai nak naeh |
English: The self-willed manmukh is cowardly and ugly; lacking the Name of the Lord, his nose is cut off in disgrace.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਭੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: anadin dhandhai viaapiaa supanai bhee sukh naeh |
English: Night and day, he is engrossed in worldly affairs, and even in his dreams, he finds no peace.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਉਬਰਹਿ ਨਾਹਿ ਤ ਬਧੇ ਦੁਖ ਸਹਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh hoveh taa ubareh naeh ta badhe dukh sahaeh |1|
English: O Nanak, if he becomes Gurmukh, then he shall be saved; otherwise, he is held in bondage, and suffers in pain. ||1||

[Ang 591 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh sadaa dar sohane gur kaa sabad kamaeh |
English: The Gurmukhs always look beautiful in the Court of the Lord; they practice the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: antar saant sadaa sukh dar sachai sobhaa paeh |
English: There is a lasting peace and happiness deep within them; at the Court of the True Lord, they receive honor.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh har naam paaeaa sahaje sach samaeh |2|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are blessed with the Name of the Lord; they merge imperceptibly into the True Lord. ||2||

[Ang 591 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh prahilaad jap har gat paaee |
English: As Gurmukh, Prahlaad meditated on the Lord, and was saved.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh janak har naam liv laaee |
English: As Gurmukh, Janak lovingly centered his consciousness on the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਸਿਸਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸੁਣਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh basisatt har upades sunaaee |
English: As Gurmukh, Vashisht taught the Teachings of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਿਨੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: bin gur har naam na kinai paaeaa mere bhaaee |
English: Without the Guru, no one has found the Lord's Name, O my Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਲਹਾਈ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: guramukh har bhagat har aap lahaaee |13|
English: The Lord blesses the Gurmukh with devotion. ||13||

[Ang 591 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਈਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੋ ਭਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur kee parateet na aaeea sabad na laago bhaau |
English: One who has no faith in the True Guru, and who does not love the Word of the Shabad,

Gurbani: ਓਸ ਨੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਉਪਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਉ ਗੇੜਾ ਆਵਉ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: os no sukh na upajai bhaavai sau gerraa aavau jaau |
English: shall find no peace, even though he may come and go hundreds of times.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh sehaj milai sache siau liv laau |1|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh meets the True Lord with natural ease; he is in love with the Lord. ||1||

[Ang 591 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਏ ਮਨ ਐਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: e man aisaa satigur khoj lahu jit seviai janam maran dukh jaae |
English: O mind, search for such a True Guru, by serving whom the pains of birth and death are dispelled.

Gurbani: ਸਹਸਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sahasaa mool na hovee haumai sabad jalaae |
English: Doubt shall never afflict you, and your ego shall be burnt away through the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜੈ ਕੀ ਪਾਲਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਨਿਕਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: koorrai kee paal vichahu nikalai sach vasai man aae |
English: The veil of falsehood shall be torn down from within you, and Truth shall come to dwell in the mind.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਚ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: antar saant man sukh hoe sach sanjam kaar kamaae |
English: Peace and happiness shall fill your mind deep within, if you act according to truth and self-discipline.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak poorai karam satigur milai har jeeo kirapaa kare rajaae |2|
English: O Nanak, by perfect good karma, you shall meet the True Guru, and then the Dear Lord, by His Sweet Will, shall bless you with His Mercy. ||2||

[Ang 591 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਦੀਬਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਮੁਠੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jis kai ghar deebaan har hovai tis kee mutthee vich jagat sabh aaeaa |
English: The whole world comes under the control of one whose home is filled with the Lord, the King.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਤਲਕੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਬਾਨਿ ਸਭਿ ਆਣਿ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tis kau talakee kisai dee naahee har deebaan sabh aan pairee paaeaa |
English: He is subject to no one else's rule, and the Lord, the King, causes everyone to fall at his feet.

Gurbani: ਮਾਣਸਾ ਕਿਅਹੁ ਦੀਬਾਣਹੁ ਕੋਈ ਨਸਿ ਭਜਿ ਨਿਕਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਬਾਣਹੁ ਕੋਈ ਕਿਥੈ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: maanasaa kiahu deebaanahu koee nas bhaj nikalai har deebaanahu koee kithai jaaeaa |
English: One may run away from the courts of other men, but where can one go to escape the Lord's Kingdom?

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਬਾਨੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਤਿਨਿ ਰਹਦੇ ਖੁਹਦੇ ਆਣਿ ਸਭਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਅਗੈ ਖਲਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: so aisaa har deebaan vasiaa bhagataa kai hiradai tin rahade khuhade aan sabh bhagataa agai khalavaaeaa |
English: The Lord is such a King, who abides in the hearts of His devotees; He brings the others, and makes them stand before His devotees.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: har naavai kee vaddiaaee karam paraapat hovai guramukh viralai kinai dhiaaeaa |14|
English: The glorious greatness of the Lord's Name is obtained only by His Grace; how few are the Gurmukhs who meditate on Him. ||14||

[Ang 591 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਮੁਆ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin satigur seve jagat muaa birathaa janam gavaae |
English: Without serving the True Guru, the people of the world are dead; they waste their lives away in vain.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਅਤਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਗਾ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: doojai bhaae at dukh lagaa mar jamai aavai jaae |
English: In love with duality, they suffer terrible pain; they die, and are reincarnated, and continue coming and going.

Gurbani: ਵਿਸਟਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: visattaa andar vaas hai fir fir joonee paae |
English: They live in manure, and are reincarnated again and again.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰਸੀ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak bin naavai jam maarasee ant geaa pachhutaae |1|
English: O Nanak, without the Name, the Messenger of Death punishes them; in the end, they depart regretting and repenting. ||1||

[Ang 591 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਹੋਰ ਸਗਲੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਸਬਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: eis jag meh purakh ek hai hor sagalee naar sabaaee |
English: In this world, there is one Husband Lord; all other beings are His brides.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਘਟ ਭੋਗਵੈ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sabh ghatt bhogavai alipat rahai alakh na lakhanaa jaaee |
English: He enjoys the hearts of all, and yet He remains detached; He is unseen; He cannot be described.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਵੇਖਾਲਿਆ ਸਬਦੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: poorai gur vekhaaliaa sabade sojhee paaee |
English: The Perfect Guru reveals Him, and through the Word of His Shabad, we come to understand Him.

Gurbani: ਪੁਰਖੈ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਪੁਰਖ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: purakhai seveh se purakh hoveh jinee haumai sabad jalaaee |
English: Those who serve their Husband Lord, become like Him; their egos are burnt away by His Shabad.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਰੀਕੁ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਕੰਟਕੁ ਵੈਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: tis kaa sareek ko nahee naa ko kanttak vairaaee |
English: He has no rival, no attacker, no enemy.

Gurbani: ਨਿਹਚਲ ਰਾਜੁ ਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੇਰਾ ਨਾ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: nihachal raaj hai sadaa tis keraa naa aavai naa jaaee |
English: His rule is unchanging and eternal; He does not come or go.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: anadin sevak sevaa kare har sache ke gun gaaee |
English: Night and day, His servant serves Him, singing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak vekh vigasiaa har sache kee vaddiaaee |2|
English: Beholding the Glorious Greatness of the True Lord, Nanak blossoms forth. ||2||

[Ang 592 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਦ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਤਿਨ ਕੰਉ ਰਖਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jin kai har naam vasiaa sad hiradai har naamo tin knau rakhanahaaraa |
English: Those whose hearts are forever filled with the Name of the Lord, have the Name of the Lord as their Protector.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਮਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har naam pitaa har naamo maataa har naam sakhaaee mitru hamaaraa |
English: The Lord's Name is my father, the Lord's Name is my mother; the Lord's Name is my helper and friend.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਗਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਮਸਲਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਕਰਦਾ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har naavai naal galaa har naavai naal masalat har naam hamaaree karadaa nit saaraa |
English: My conversation is with the Lord's Name, and my counseling is with the Lord's Name; the Lord's Name always takes care of me.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੁਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਵਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har naam hamaaree sangat at piaaree har naam kul har naam paravaaraa |
English: The Lord's Name is my most beloved society, the Lord's Name is my ancestry, and the Lord's Name is my family.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੰਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: jan naanak knau har naam har gur deea har halat palat sadaa kare nisataaraa |15|
English: The Guru, the Lord Incarnate, has bestowed upon servant Nanak the Name of the Lord; in this world, and in the next, the Lord ever saves me. ||15||

[Ang 592 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕੰਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jin knau satigur bhettiaa se har keerat sadaa kamaeh |
English: Those who meet the True Guru, ever sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

Gurbani: ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: achint har naam tin kai man vasiaa sachai sabad samaeh |
English: The Lord's Name naturally fills their minds, and they are absorbed in the Shabad, the Word of the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਕੁਲੁ ਉਧਾਰਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਮੋਖ ਪਦਵੀ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: kul udhaareh aapanaa mokh padavee aape paeh |
English: They redeem their generations, and they themselves obtain the state of liberation.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੰਉ ਸੰਤੁਸਟੁ ਭਇਆ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ ਜਨ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham tin knau santusatt bheaa jo gur charanee jan paeh |
English: The Supreme Lord God is pleased with those who fall at the Guru's Feet.

Gurbani: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਜ ਰਖਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak har kaa daas hai kar kirapaa har laaj rakhaeh |1|
English: Servant Nanak is the Lord's slave; by His Grace, the Lord preserves his honor. ||1||

[Ang 592 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹੰਉਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਖੜਕੁ ਹੈ ਖੜਕੇ ਖੜਕਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: hnaumai andar kharrak hai kharrake kharrak vihaae |
English: In egotism, one is assailed by fear; he passes his life totally troubled by fear.

Gurbani: ਹੰਉਮੈ ਵਡਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: hnaumai vaddaa rog hai mar jamai aavai jaae |
English: Egotism is such a terrible disease; he dies, to be reincarnated - he continues coming and going.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: jin kau poorab likhiaa tinaa satagur miliaa prabh aae |
English: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny meet with the True Guru, God Incarnate.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਉਬਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak gur parasaadee ubare haumai sabad jalaae |2|
English: O Nanak, by Guru's Grace, they are redeemed; their egos are burnt away through the Word of the Shabad. ||2||

[Ang 592 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਬਿਗਤੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: har naam hamaaraa prabh abigat agochar abinaasee purakh bidhaataa |
English: The Lord's Name is my immortal, unfathomable, imperishable Creator Lord, the Architect of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮ ਸ੍ਰੇਵਹ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮ ਪੂਜਹ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: har naam ham srevah har naam ham poojah har naame hee man raataa |
English: I serve the Lord's Name, I worship the Lord's Name, and my soul is imbued with the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਕੋਈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਅੰਤਿ ਛਡਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: har naamai jevadd koee avar na soojhai har naamo ant chhaddaataa |
English: I know of no other as great as the Lord's Name; the Lord's Name shall deliver me in the end.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: har naam deea gur praupakaaree dhan dhan guroo kaa pitaa maataa |
English: The Generous Guru has given me the Lord's Name; blessed, blessed are the Guru's mother and father.

Gurbani: ਹੰਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਣੇ ਕੰਉ ਸਦਾ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੈ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: hnau satigur apune knau sadaa namasakaaree jit miliai har naam mai jaataa |16|
English: I ever bow in humble reverence to my True Guru; meeting Him, I have come to know the Lord's Name. ||16||

[Ang 592 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਕੀਨੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh sev na keeneea har naam na lago piaar |
English: One who does not serve the Guru as Gurmukh, who does not love the Lord's Name,

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੈ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: sabadai saad na aaeo mar janamai vaaro vaar |
English: and who does not savor the taste of the Shabad, shall die, and be reborn, over and over again.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਈ ਕਿਤੁ ਆਇਆ ਸੈਸਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh andh na chetee kit aaeaa saisaar |
English: The blind, self-willed manmukh does not think of the Lord; why did he even come into the world?

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲੰਘੇ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak jin kau nadar kare se guramukh langhe paar |1|
English: O Nanak, that Gurmukh, upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, crosses over the world-ocean. ||1||

[Ang 592 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਇਕੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਾਗਤਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਜਗੁ ਸੂਤਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਪਿਆਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: eiko satigur jaagataa hor jag sootaa mohi piaas |
English: Only the Guru is awake; the rest of the world is asleep in emotional attachment and desire.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਜਾਗੰਨਿ ਸੇ ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sevan jaagan se jo rate sach naam gunataas |
English: Those who serve the True Guru and remain wakeful, are imbued with the True Name, the treasure of virtue.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧ ਨ ਚੇਤਨੀ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰਿ ਹੋਹਿ ਬਿਨਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh andh na chetanee janam mar hohi binaas |
English: The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not think of the Lord; they are ruined through birth and death.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜਿਨ ਕੰਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆਸਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh tinee naam dhiaaeaa jin knau dhur poorab likhiaas |2|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; this is their destiny, pre-ordained by the Primal Lord God. ||2||

[Ang 593 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਛਤੀਹ ਪਰਕਾਰ ਜਿਤੁ ਖਾਇਐ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਭਈ ॥
Transliteration: har naam hamaaraa bhojan chhateeh parakaar jit khaaeiai ham kau tripat bhee |
English: The Lord's Name is my food; eating the thirty-six varieties of it, I am satisfied and satiated.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਨੰਗੇ ਨ ਹੋਵਹ ਹੋਰ ਪੈਨਣ ਕੀ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਸਰਧ ਗਈ ॥
Transliteration: har naam hamaaraa painan jit fir nange na hovah hor painan kee hamaaree saradh gee |
English: The Lord's Name is my clothing; wearing it, I shall never be naked again, and my desire to wear other clothing is gone.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਵਣਜੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਕੀ ਹਮ ਕੰਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਰਕੁਨੀ ਦੀਈ ॥
Transliteration: har naam hamaaraa vanaj har naam vaapaar har naamai kee ham knau satigur kaarakunee deeee |
English: The Lord's Name is my business, the Lord's Name is my commerce; the True Guru has blessed me with its use.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਕਾ ਹਮ ਲੇਖਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸਭ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਅਗਲੀ ਕਾਣਿ ਗਈ ॥
Transliteration: har naamai kaa ham lekhaa likhiaa sabh jam kee agalee kaan gee |
English: I record the account of the Lord's Name, and I shall not be subject to death again.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜਿਨ ਕੰਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਪਈ ॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam guramukh kinai viralai dhiaaeaa jin knau dhur karam paraapat likhat pee |17|
English: Only a few, as Gurmukh, meditate on the Lord's Name; they are blessed by the Lord, and receive their pre-ordained destiny. ||17||

[Ang 593 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਗਤੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jagat agiaanee andh hai doojai bhaae karam kamaae |
English: The world is blind and ignorant; in the love of duality, it engages in actions.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਜੇਤੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਗੈ ਤਨਿ ਧਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: doojai bhaae jete karam kare dukh lagai tan dhaae |
English: But those actions which are performed in the love of duality, cause only pain to the body.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਜਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee sukh aoopajai jaa gur kaa sabad kamaae |
English: By Guru's Grace, peace wells up, when one acts according to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: sachee baanee karam kare anadin naam dhiaae |
English: He acts according to the True Word of the Guru's Bani; night and day, he meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਤੁ ਆਪੇ ਲਾਏ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗੇ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak jit aape laae tith lage kahanaa kichhoo na jaae |1|
English: O Nanak, as the Lord Himself engages him, so is he engaged; no one has any say in this matter. ||1||

[Ang 593 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਘਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: ham ghar naam khajaanaa sadaa hai bhagat bhare bhanddaaraa |
English: Within the home of my own being, is the everlasting treasure of the Naam; it is a treasure house, overflowing with devotion.

Gurbani: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਸਦ ਜੀਵੈ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: satagur daataa jeea kaa sad jeevai devanahaaraa |
English: The True Guru is the Giver of the life of the soul; the Great Giver lives forever.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: anadin keeratan sadaa kareh gur kai sabad apaaraa |
English: Night and day, I continually sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise, through the Infinite Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਾ ਸਦ ਉਚਰਹਿ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਵਰਤਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabad guroo kaa sad uchareh jug jug varataavanahaaraa |
English: I recite continually the Guru's Shabads, which have been effective throughout the ages.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: eihu manooaa sadaa sukh vasai sahaje kare vaapaaraa |
English: This mind ever abides in peace, dealing in peace and poise.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਹੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: antar gur giaan har ratan hai mukat karaavanahaaraa |
English: Deep within me is the Guru's Wisdom, the Lord's jewel, the Bringer of liberation.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਸੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਰਿ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak jis no nadar kare so paae so hovai dar sachiaaraa |2|
English: O Nanak, one who is blessed by the Lord's Glance of Grace obtains this, and is judged to be True in the Court of the Lord. ||2||

[Ang 593 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਜਾਇ ਪਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan so gurasikh kaheeai jo satigur charanee jaae peaa |
English: Blessed, blessed is that Sikh of the Guru, who goes and falls at the Feet of the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਕਹਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan so gurasikh kaheeai jin har naamaa mukh raam kahiaa |
English: Blessed, blessed is that Sikh of the Guru, who with his mouth, utters the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan so gurasikh kaheeai jis har naam suniai man anad bheaa |
English: Blessed, blessed is that Sikh of the Guru, whose mind, upon hearing the Lord's Name, becomes blissful.

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan so gurasikh kaheeai jin satigur sevaa kar har naam leaa |
English: Blessed, blessed is that Sikh of the Guru, who serves the True Guru, and so obtains the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਕੰਉ ਹੰਉ ਸਦਾ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੀ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਚਲਿਆ ॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: tis gurasikh knau hnau sadaa namasakaaree jo gur kai bhaanai gurasikh chaliaa |18|
English: I bow forever in deepest respect to that Sikh of the Guru, who walks in the Way of the Guru. ||18||

[Ang 593 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਭ ਥਕੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: manahatth kinai na paaeo sabh thake karam kamaae |
English: No one has ever found the Lord through stubborn-mindedness. All have grown weary of performing such actions.

Gurbani: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਿ ਭਰਮਦੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: manahatth bhekh kar bharamade dukh paaeaa doojai bhaae |
English: Through their stubborn-mindedness, and by wearing their disguises, they are deluded; they suffer in pain from the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਸਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: ridh sidh sabh mohu hai naam na vasai man aae |
English: Riches and the supernatural spiritual powers of the Siddhas are all emotional attachments; through them, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, does not come to dwell in the mind.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur sevaa te man niramal hovai agiaan andheraa jaae |
English: Serving the Guru, the mind becomes immaculately pure, and the darkness of spiritual ignorance is dispelled.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਘਰਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naam ratan ghar paragatt hoaa naanak sehaj samaae |1|
English: The jewel of the Naam is revealed in the home of one's own being; O Nanak, one merges in celestial bliss. ||1||

[Ang 593 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੈ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sabadai saad na aaeo naam na lago piaar |
English: One who does not savor the taste of the Shabad, who does not love the Naam, the Name of the Lord,

Gurbani: ਰਸਨਾ ਫਿਕਾ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: rasanaa fikaa bolanaa nit nit hoe khuaar |
English: and who speaks insipid words with his tongue, is ruined, again and again.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਪਇਐ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak kirat peiai kamaavanaa koe na mettanahaar |2|
English: O Nanak, he acts according to the karma of his past actions, which no one can erase. ||2||

[Ang 594 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan sat purakh satiguroo hamaaraa jit miliai ham kau saant aaee |
English: Blessed, blessed is the True Being, my True Guru; meeting Him, I have found peace.

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan sat purakh satiguroo hamaaraa jit miliai ham har bhagat paaee |
English: Blessed, blessed is the True Being, my True Guru; meeting Him, I have attained the Lord's devotional worship.

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan har bhagat satiguroo hamaaraa jis kee sevaa te ham har naam liv laaee |
English: Blessed, blessed is the Lord's devotee, my True Guru; serving Him, I have come to enshrine love for the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਵੈਰੀ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਸਭ ਸਮ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan har giaanee satiguroo hamaaraa jin vairee mitru ham kau sabh sam drisatt dikhaaee |
English: Blessed, blessed is the Knower of the Lord, my True Guru; He has taught me to look upon friend and foe alike.

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਣਾਈ ॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan satiguroo mitru hamaaraa jin har naam siau hamaaree preet banaaee |19|
English: Blessed, blessed is the True Guru, my best friend; He has led me to embrace love for the Name of the Lord. ||19||

[Ang 594 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮੁੰਧਿ ਵਿਦੇਸਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਨਿਤ ਝੂਰੇ ਸੰਮ੍ਹਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: ghar hee mundh vides pir nit jhoore samhaale |
English: The soul-bride is at home, while the Husband Lord is away; she cherishes His memory, and mourns His absence.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਦਿਆ ਢਿਲ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜੇ ਨੀਅਤਿ ਰਾਸਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: miladiaa dtil na hovee je neeat raas kare |1|
English: She shall meet Him without delay, if she rids herself of duality. ||1||

[Ang 594 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਾਲੀ ਕੂੜੀਆ ਬਾਝੁ ਪਰੀਤਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak gaalee koorreea baajh pareet karee |
English: O Nanak, false is the speech of one who acts without loving the Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਿਚਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਭਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਲੇਵੈ ਦੇਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tichar jaanai bhalaa kar jichar levai dee |2|
English: He judges things to be good, only as long as the Lord gives and he receives. ||2||

[Ang 594 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਜੀਅ ਤਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jin upaae jeea tin har raakhiaa |
English: The Lord, who created the creatures, also protects them.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: amrit sachaa naau bhojan chaakhiaa |
English: I have tasted the food of Ambrosial Nectar, the True Name.

Gurbani: ਤਿਪਤਿ ਰਹੇ ਆਘਾਇ ਮਿਟੀ ਭਭਾਖਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: tipat rahe aaghaae mittee bhabhaakhiaa |
English: I am satisfied and satiated, and my hunger is appeased.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਲਾਖਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabh andar ik varatai kinai viralai laakhiaa |
English: The One Lord is pervading in all, but rare are those who realize this.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪਾਖਿਆ ॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: jan naanak bhe nihaal prabh kee paakhiaa |20|
English: Servant Nanak is enraptured, in the Protection of God. ||20||

[Ang 594 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨੋ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਵੇਖਦਾ ਜੇਤਾ ਜਗਤੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: satigur no sabh ko vekhadaa jetaa jagat sansaar |
English: All the living beings of the world behold the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਡਿਠੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: dditthai mukat na hovee jichar sabad na kare veechaar |
English: One is not liberated by merely seeing Him, unless one contemplates the Word of His Shabad.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: haumai mail na chukee naam na lagai piaar |
English: The filth of ego is not removed, and he does not enshrine love for the Naam.

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: eik aape bakhas milaaeian dubidhaa taj vikaar |
English: The Lord forgives some, and unites them with Himself; they forsake their duality and sinful ways.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਕਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਮਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak ik darasan dekh mar mile satigur het piaar |1|
English: O Nanak, some behold the Blessed Vision of the True Guru's Darshan, with love and affection; conquering their ego, they meet with the Lord. ||1||

[Ang 594 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਮੂਰਖ ਅੰਧ ਗਵਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: satiguroo na sevio moorakh andh gavaar |
English: The foolish, blind clown does not serve the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਜਲਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: doojai bhaae bahut dukh laagaa jalataa kare pukaar |
English: In love with duality, he endures terrible suffering, and burning, he cries out in pain.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਸੇ ਨ ਉਪਕਰੇ ਅੰਤੀ ਵਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: jin kaaran guroo visaariaa se na upakare antee vaar |
English: He forgets the Guru, for the sake of mere objects, but they will not come to his rescue in the end.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਖਸੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak guramatee sukh paaeaa bakhase bakhasanahaar |2|
English: Through the Guru's Instructions, Nanak has found peace; the Forgiving Lord has forgiven him. ||2||

[Ang 594 | Raag: Raag Vadhans | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਕੋਈ ਦੂਜਾ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਅਵਰੋ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: too aape aap aap sabh karataa koee doojaa hoe su avaro kaheeai |
English: You Yourself, all by Yourself, are the Creator of all. If there were any other, then I would speak of another.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਬੋਲੈ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਲਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: har aape bolai aap bulaavai har aape jal thal rav raheeai |
English: The Lord Himself speaks, and causes us to speak; He Himself is pervading the water and the land.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਛੋਡੈ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣੀ ਪੜਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: har aape maarai har aape chhoddai man har saranee parr raheeai |
English: The Lord Himself destroys, and the Lord Himself saves. O mind, seek and remain in the Lord's Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋਈ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਮਨ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਚਿੰਦ ਨਿਸਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: har bin koee maar jeevaal na sakai man hoe nichind nisal hoe raheeai |
English: Other than the Lord, no one can kill or rejuvenate. O mind, do not be anxious - remain fearless.

Gurbani: ਉਠਦਿਆ ਬਹਦਿਆ ਸੁਤਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੨੧॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ
Transliteration: autthadiaa bahadiaa sutiaa sadaa sadaa har naam dhiaaeeai jan naanak guramukh har laheeai |21|1| sudh
English: While standing, sitting, and sleeping, forever and ever, meditate on the Lord's Name; O servant Nanak, as Gurmukh, you shall attain the Lord. ||21||1||Sudh||

[Ang 595 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirbhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibhan gur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 1 ghar 1 chaupade |
English: Sorat'h, First Mehl, First House, Chau-Padhay:

Gurbani: ਸਭਨਾ ਮਰਣਾ ਆਇਆ ਵੇਛੋੜਾ ਸਭਨਾਹ ॥
Transliteration: sabhanaa maranaa aaeaa vechhorraa sabhanaah |
English: Death comes to all, and all must suffer separation.

Gurbani: ਪੁਛਹੁ ਜਾਇ ਸਿਆਣਿਆ ਆਗੈ ਮਿਲਣੁ ਕਿਨਾਹ ॥
Transliteration: puchhahu jaae siaaniaa aagai milan kinaah |
English: Go and ask the clever people, whether they shall meet in the world hereafter.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਵਡੜੀ ਵੇਦਨ ਤਿਨਾਹ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jin meraa saahib veesarai vaddarree vedan tinaah |1|
English: Those who forget my Lord and Master shall suffer in terrible pain. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਹੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhee saalaahihu saachaa soe |
English: So praise the True Lord,

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kee nadar sadaa sukh hoe | rahaau |
English: by whose Grace peace ever prevails. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਵਡਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: vaddaa kar saalaahanaa hai bhee hosee soe |
English: Praise Him as great; He is, and He shall ever be.

Gurbani: ਸਭਨਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਤੂ ਮਾਣਸ ਦਾਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabhanaa daataa ek too maanas daat na hoe |
English: You alone are the Great Giver; mankind cannot give anything.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਰੰਨ ਕਿ ਰੁੰਨੈ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jo tis bhaavai so theeai ran ki runai hoe |2|
English: Whatever pleases Him, comes to pass; what good does it do to cry out in protest? ||2||

Gurbani: ਧਰਤੀ ਉਪਰਿ ਕੋਟ ਗੜ ਕੇਤੀ ਗਈ ਵਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: dharatee upar kott garr ketee gee vajaae |
English: Many have proclaimed their sovereignty over millions of fortresses on the earth, but they have now departed.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਅਸਮਾਨਿ ਨ ਮਾਵਨੀ ਤਿਨ ਨਕਿ ਨਥਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jo asamaan na maavanee tin nak nathaa paae |
English: And those, whom even the sky could not contain, had ropes put through their noses.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਮਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸੂਲੀਆ ਕਾਹੇ ਮਿਠਾ ਖਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: je man jaaneh sooleea kaahe mitthaa khaeh |3|
English: O mind, if you only knew the torment in your future, you would not relish the sweet pleasures of the present. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਉਗੁਣ ਜੇਤੜੇ ਤੇਤੇ ਗਲੀ ਜੰਜੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: naanak aaugun jetarre tete galee janjeer |
English: O Nanak, as many as are the sins one commits, so many are the chains around his neck.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਹੋਨਿ ਤ ਕਟੀਅਨਿ ਸੇ ਭਾਈ ਸੇ ਵੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: je gun hon ta katteean se bhaaee se veer |
English: If he possesses virtues, then the chains are cut away; these virtues are his brothers, his true brothers.

Gurbani: ਅਗੈ ਗਏ ਨ ਮੰਨੀਅਨਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਢਹੁ ਵੇਪੀਰ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: agai ge na maneean maar kadtahu vepeer |4|1|
English: Going to the world hereafter, those who have no Guru are not accepted; they are beaten, and expelled. ||4||1||

[Ang 595 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 1 ghar 1 |
English: Sorat'h, First Mehl, First House:

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਹਾਲੀ ਕਿਰਸਾਣੀ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਰਮੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਤਨੁ ਖੇਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: man haalee kirasaanee karanee saram paanee tan khet |
English: Make your mind the farmer, good deeds the farm, modesty the water, and your body the field.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਬੀਜੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸੁਹਾਗਾ ਰਖੁ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਵੇਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: naam beej santokh suhaagaa rakh gareebee ves |
English: Let the Lord's Name be the seed, contentment the plow, and your humble dress the fence.

Gurbani: ਭਾਉ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਜੰਮਸੀ ਸੇ ਘਰ ਭਾਗਠ ਦੇਖੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bhaau karam kar jamasee se ghar bhaagatth dekh |1|
English: Doing deeds of love, the seed shall sprout, and you shall see your home flourish. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਾਬਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: baabaa maaeaa saath na hoe |
English: O Baba, the wealth of Maya does not go with anyone.

Gurbani: ਇਨਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਗੁ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ein maaeaa jag mohiaa viralaa boojhai koe | rahaau |
English: This Maya has bewitched the world, but only a rare few understand this. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਾਣੁ ਹਟੁ ਕਰਿ ਆਰਜਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਵਥੁ ॥
Transliteration: haan hatt kar aarajaa sach naam kar vath |
English: Make your ever-decreasing life your shop, and make the Lord's Name your merchandise.

Gurbani: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੋਚ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਂਡਸਾਲ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਰਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: surat soch kar bhaanddasaal tis vich tis no rakh |
English: Make understanding and contemplation your warehouse, and in that warehouse, store the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਸਿਉ ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਿ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ਮਨ ਹਸੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: vanajaariaa siau vanaj kar lai laahaa man has |2|
English: Deal with the Lord's dealers, earn your profits, and rejoice in your mind. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਸਉਦਾਗਰੀ ਸਤੁ ਘੋੜੇ ਲੈ ਚਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: sun saasat saudaagaree sat ghorre lai chal |
English: Let your trade be listening to scripture, and let Truth be the horses you take to sell.

Gurbani: ਖਰਚੁ ਬੰਨੁ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਮਤੁ ਮਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਕਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: kharach ban changiaaeea mat man jaaneh kal |
English: Gather up merits for your travelling expenses, and do not think of tomorrow in your mind.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਕੈ ਦੇਸਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਤਾ ਸੁਖਿ ਲਹਹਿ ਮਹਲੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: nirankaar kai des jaeh taa sukh laheh mehal |3|
English: When you arrive in the land of the Formless Lord, you shall find peace in the Mansion of His Presence. ||3||

Gurbani: ਲਾਇ ਚਿਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਕੰਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: laae chit kar chaakaree man naam kar kam |
English: Let your service be the focusing of your consciousness, and let your occupation be the placing of faith in the Naam.

Gurbani: ਬੰਨੁ ਬਦੀਆ ਕਰਿ ਧਾਵਣੀ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਆਖੈ ਧੰਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: ban badeea kar dhaavanee taa ko aakhai dhan |
English: Let your work be restraint from sin; only then will people call you blessed.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਵੇਖੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਚੜੈ ਚਵਗਣ ਵੰਨੁ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak vekhai nadar kar charrai chavagan van |4|2|
English: O Nanak, the Lord shall look upon you with His Glance of Grace, and you shall be blessed with honor four times over. ||4||2||

[Ang 596 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਃ ੧ ਚਉਤੁਕੇ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 1 chautuke |
English: Sorat'h, First Mehl, Chau-Thukay:

Gurbani: ਮਾਇ ਬਾਪ ਕੋ ਬੇਟਾ ਨੀਕਾ ਸਸੁਰੈ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਜਵਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: maae baap ko bettaa neekaa sasurai chatur javaaee |
English: The son is dear to his mother and father; he is the wise son-in-law to his father-in-law.

Gurbani: ਬਾਲ ਕੰਨਿਆ ਕੌ ਬਾਪੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਭਾਈ ਕੌ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: baal kaniaa kau baap piaaraa bhaaee kau at bhaaee |
English: The father is dear to his son and daughter, and the brother is very dear to his brother.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਭਇਆ ਬਾਹਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਭਈ ਪਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: hukam bheaa baahar ghar chhoddiaa khin meh bhee paraaee |
English: By the Order of the Lord's Command, he leaves his house and goes outside, and in an instant, everything becomes alien to him.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਨ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਧੂੜਿ ਧੁਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naam daan isanaan na manamukh tith tan dhoorr dhumaaee |1|
English: The self-willed manmukh does not remember the Name of the Lord, does not give in charity, and does not cleanse his consciousness; his body rolls in the dust. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: man maaniaa naam sakhaaee |
English: The mind is comforted by the Comforter of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਪਾਇ ਪਰਉ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: paae prau gur kai balihaarai jin saachee boojh bujhaaee | rahaau |
English: I fall at the Guru's feet - I am a sacrifice to Him; He has given me to understand the true understanding. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਗ ਸਿਉ ਝੂਠ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਜਨ ਸਿਉ ਵਾਦੁ ਰਚਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jag siau jhootth preet man bedhiaa jan siau vaad rachaaee |
English: The mind is impressed with the false love of the world; he quarrels with the Lord's humble servant.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਗਨੁ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਮਗੁ ਜੋਹੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਲੇਵੈ ਮਰੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa magan ahinis mag johai naam na levai marai bikh khaaee |
English: Infatuated with Maya, night and day, he sees only the worldly path; he does not chant the Naam, and drinking poison, he dies.

Gurbani: ਗੰਧਣ ਵੈਣਿ ਰਤਾ ਹਿਤਕਾਰੀ ਸਬਦੈ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨ ਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: gandhan vain rataa hitakaaree sabadai surat na aaee |
English: He is imbued and infatuated with vicious talk; the Word of the Shabad does not come into his consciousness.

Gurbani: ਰੰਗਿ ਨ ਰਾਤਾ ਰਸਿ ਨਹੀ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: rang na raataa ras nahee bedhiaa manamukh pat gavaaee |2|
English: He is not imbued with the Lord's Love, and he is not impressed by the taste of the Name; the self-willed manmukh loses his honor. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਸਭਾ ਮਹਿ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਰਸੁ ਨਹੀ ਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: saadh sabhaa meh sehaj na chaakhiaa jihabaa ras nahee raaee |
English: He does not enjoy celestial peace in the Company of the Holy, and there is not even a bit of sweetness on his tongue.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਦਰ ਕੀ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: man tan dhan apunaa kar jaaniaa dar kee khabar na paaee |
English: He calls his mind, body and wealth his own; he has no knowledge of the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਖੀ ਮੀਟਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਦਿਸੈ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: akhee meett chaliaa andhiaaraa ghar dar disai na bhaaee |
English: Closing his eyes, he walks in darkness; he cannot see the home of his own being, O Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਾਧਾ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕੀਆ ਕਮਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jam dar baadhaa tthaur na paavai apunaa keea kamaaee |3|
English: Tied up at Death's door, he finds no place of rest; he receives the rewards of his own actions. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਅਖੀ ਵੇਖਾ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: nadar kare taa akhee vekhaa kahanaa kathan na jaaee |
English: When the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, then I see Him with my own eyes; He is indescribable, and cannot be described.

Gurbani: ਕੰਨੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kanee sun sun sabad salaahee amrit ridai vasaaee |
English: With my ears, I continually listen to the Word of the Shabad, and I praise Him; His Ambrosial Name abides within my heart.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: nirbhau nirankaar niravair pooran jot samaaee |
English: He is Fearless, Formless and absolutely without vengeance; I am absorbed in His Perfect Light.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਵਿਣੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਭਾਗੈ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੪॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak gur vin bharam na bhaagai sach naam vaddiaaee |4|3|
English: O Nanak, without the Guru, doubt is not dispelled; through the True Name, glorious greatness is obtained. ||4||3||

[Ang 596 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਦੁਤੁਕੇ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 1 dutuke |
English: Sorat'h, First Mehl, Dho-Thukay:

Gurbani: ਪੁੜੁ ਧਰਤੀ ਪੁੜੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਆਸਣੁ ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਚਉਬਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: purr dharatee purr paanee aasan chaar kuntt chaubaaraa |
English: In the realm of land, and in the realm of water, Your seat is the chamber of the four directions.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਭਵਣ ਕੀ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਏਕਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਟਕਸਾਲਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sagal bhavan kee moorat ekaa mukh terai ttakasaalaa |1|
English: Yours is the one and only form of the entire universe; Your mouth is the mint to fashion all. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: mere saahibaa tere choj viddaanaa |
English: O my Lord Master, Your play is so wonderful!

Gurbani: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਲੀਣਾ ਆਪੇ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jal thal maheeal bharipur leenaa aape sarab samaanaa | rahaau |
English: You are pervading and permeating the water, the land and the sky; You Yourself are contained in all. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਕਿਨੇਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeh jeh dekhaa teh jot tumaaree teraa roop kinehaa |
English: Wherever I look, there I see Your Light, but what is Your form?

Gurbani: ਇਕਤੁ ਰੂਪਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਪਰਛੰਨਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਜੇਹਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: eikat roop fireh parachhanaa koe na kis hee jehaa |2|
English: You have one form, but it is unseen; there is none like any other. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅੰਡਜ ਜੇਰਜ ਉਤਭੁਜ ਸੇਤਜ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀਤੇ ਜੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: anddaj jeraj utabhuj setaj tere keete jantaa |
English: The beings born of eggs, born of the womb, born of the earth and born of sweat, all are created by You.

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਪੁਰਬੁ ਮੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਤੂ ਸਭਨਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਰਵੰਤਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ek purab mai teraa dekhiaa too sabhanaa maeh ravantaa |3|
English: I have seen one glory of Yours, that You are pervading and permeating in all. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਬਹੁਤੇ ਮੈ ਏਕੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: tere gun bahute mai ek na jaaniaa mai moorakh kichh deejai |
English: Your Glories are so numerous, and I do not know even one of them; I am such a fool - please, give me some of them!

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਡੁਬਦਾ ਪਥਰੁ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੪॥੪॥
Transliteration: pranavat naanak sun mere saahibaa ddubadaa pathar leejai |4|4|
English: Prays Nanak, listen, O my Lord Master: I am sinking like a stone - please, save me! ||4||4||

[Ang 596 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 1 |
English: Sorat'h, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਪਾਪੀ ਪਤਿਤੁ ਪਰਮ ਪਾਖੰਡੀ ਤੂ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: hau paapee patit param paakhanddee too niramal nirankaaree |
English: I am a wicked sinner and a great hypocrite; You are the Immaculate and Formless Lord.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਚਾਖਿ ਪਰਮ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: amrit chaakh param ras raate tthaakur saran tumaaree |1|
English: Tasting the Ambrosial Nectar, I am imbued with supreme bliss; O Lord and Master, I seek Your Sanctuary. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਰਤਾ ਤੂ ਮੈ ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: karataa too mai maan nimaane |
English: O Creator Lord, You are the honor of the dishonored.

Gurbani: ਮਾਣੁ ਮਹਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: maan mehat naam dhan palai saachai sabad samaane | rahaau |
English: In my lap is the honor and glory of the wealth of the Name; I merge into the True Word of the Shabad. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਪੂਰਾ ਹਮ ਊਰੇ ਹੋਛੇ ਤੂ ਗਉਰਾ ਹਮ ਹਉਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: too pooraa ham aoore hochhe too gauraa ham haure |
English: You are perfect, while I am worthless and imperfect. You are profound, while I am trivial.

Gurbani: ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਮਨ ਰਾਤੇ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਪਰਭਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tujh hee man raate ahinis parabhaate har rasanaa jap man re |2|
English: My mind is imbued with You, day and night and morning, O Lord; my tongue chants Your Name, and my mind meditates on You. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਸਾਚੇ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਰਾਚੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਭੇਦਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਸਾਚੇ ॥
Transliteration: tum saache ham tum hee raache sabad bhed fun saache |
English: You are True, and I am absorbed into You; through the mystery of the Shabad, I shall ultimately become True as well.

Gurbani: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਸੂਚੇ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੇ ਸੇ ਕਾਚੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ahinis naam rate se sooche mar janame se kaache |3|
English: Those who are imbued with the Naam day and night are pure, while those who die to be reborn are impure. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਕਿਸੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਸਰੀਕੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: avar na deesai kis saalaahee tiseh sareek na koee |
English: I do not see any other like the Lord; who else should I praise? No one is equal to Him.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਸੋਈ ॥੪॥੫॥
Transliteration: pranavat naanak daasan daasaa guramat jaaniaa soee |4|5|
English: Prays Nanak, I am the slave of His slaves; by Guru's Instruction, I know Him. ||4||5||

[Ang 597 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 1 |
English: Sorat'h, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਗੰਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਕਰਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: alakh apaar agam agochar naa tis kaal na karamaa |
English: He is unknowable, infinite, unapproachable and imperceptible. He is not subject to death or karma.

Gurbani: ਜਾਤਿ ਅਜਾਤਿ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਸੰਭਉ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਭਰਮਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jaat ajaat ajonee sanbhau naa tis bhaau na bharamaa |1|
English: His caste is casteless; He is unborn, self-illumined, and free of doubt and desire. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਚਿਆਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: saache sachiaar vittahu kurabaan |
English: I am a sacrifice to the Truest of the True.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪ ਵਰਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: naa tis roop varan nahee rekhiaa saachai sabad neesaan | rahaau |
English: He has no form, no color and no features; through the True Word of the Shabad, He reveals Himself. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਮੁ ਨ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: naa tis maat pitaa sut bandhap naa tis kaam na naaree |
English: He has no mother, father, sons or relatives; He is free of sexual desire; He has no wife.

Gurbani: ਅਕੁਲ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਅਪਰ ਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਸਗਲੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: akul niranjan apar paranpar sagalee jot tumaaree |2|
English: He has no ancestry; He is immaculate. He is infinite and endless; O Lord, Your Light is pervading all. ||2||

Gurbani: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਲੁਕਾਇਆ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt antar braham lukaaeaa ghatt ghatt jot sabaaee |
English: Deep within each and every heart, God is hidden; His Light is in each and every heart.

Gurbani: ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bajar kapaatt mukate guramatee nirabhai taarree laaee |3|
English: The heavy doors are opened by Guru's Instructions; one becomes fearless, in the trance of deep meditation. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇ ਕਾਲੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਜੰਤਾ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਬਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jant upaae kaal sir jantaa vasagat jugat sabaaee |
English: The Lord created all beings, and placed death over the heads of all; all the world is under His Power.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਛੂਟਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: satigur sev padaarath paaveh chhootteh sabad kamaaee |4|
English: Serving the True Guru, the treasure is obtained; living the Word of the Shabad, one is emancipated. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸੂਚੈ ਭਾਡੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੂਚਾਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: soochai bhaaddai saach samaavai virale soochaachaaree |
English: In the pure vessel, the True Name is contained; how few are those who practice true conduct.

Gurbani: ਤੰਤੈ ਕਉ ਪਰਮ ਤੰਤੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੫॥੬॥
Transliteration: tantai kau param tant milaaeaa naanak saran tumaaree |5|6|
English: The individual soul is united with the Supreme Soul; Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary, Lord. ||5||6||

[Ang 597 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 1 |
English: Sorat'h, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਮੀਨਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਾਣੀਐ ਤਿਉ ਸਾਕਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
Transliteration: jiau meenaa bin paaneeai tiau saakat marai piaas |
English: Like a fish without water is the faithless cynic, who dies of thirst.

Gurbani: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਰੀਐ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਜੋ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਵੈ ਸਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tiau har bin mareeai re manaa jo birathaa jaavai saas |1|
English: So shall you die, O mind, without the Lord, as your breath goes in vain. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਜਸੁ ਲੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: man re raam naam jas lee |
English: O mind, chant the Lord's Name, and praise Him.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਇਹੁ ਰਸੁ ਕਿਉ ਲਹਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bin gur ihu ras kiau lhau gur melai har dee | rahaau |
English: Without the Guru, how will you obtain this juice? The Guru shall unite you with the Lord. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲੁ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sant janaa mil sangatee guramukh teerath hoe |
English: For the Gurmukh, meeting with the Society of the Saints is like making a pilgrimage to a sacred shrine.

Gurbani: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਮਜਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: atthasatth teerath majanaa gur daras paraapat hoe |2|
English: The benefit of bathing at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage is obtained by the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਤ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਤਪੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: jiau jogee jat baaharaa tap naahee sat santokh |
English: Like the Yogi without abstinence, and like penance without truth and contentment,

Gurbani: ਤਿਉ ਨਾਮੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਦੋਖੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tiau naamai bin dehuree jam maarai antar dokh |3|
English: so is the body without the Lord's Name; death will slay it, because of the sin within. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: saakat prem na paaeeai har paaeeai satigur bhaae |
English: The faithless cynic does not obtain the Lord's Love; the Lord's Love is obtained only through the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੭॥
Transliteration: sukh dukh daataa gur milai kahu naanak sifat samaae |4|7|
