English: One who meets with the Guru, the Giver of pleasure and pain, says Nanak, is absorbed in the Lord's Praise. ||4||7||

[Ang 597 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 1 |
English: Sorat'h, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਨਿ ਮਤਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਹਮ ਥਾਰੇ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: too prabh daataa daan mat pooraa ham thaare bhekhaaree jeeo |
English: You, God, are the Giver of gifts, the Lord of perfect understanding; I am a mere beggar at Your Door.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਕਿਆ ਮਾਗਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mai kiaa maagau kichh thir na rahaaee har deejai naam piaaree jeeo |1|
English: What should I beg for? Nothing remains permanent; O Lord, please, bless me with Your Beloved Name. ||1||

Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt rav rahiaa banavaaree |
English: In each and every heart, the Lord, the Lord of the forest, is permeating and pervading.

Gurbani: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਗੁਪਤੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਹਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jal thal maheeal gupato varatai gurasabadee dekh nihaaree jeeo | rahaau |
English: In the water, on the land, and in the sky, He is pervading but hidden; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is revealed. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਰਤ ਪਇਆਲ ਅਕਾਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: marat peaal akaas dikhaaeo gur satigur kirapaa dhaaree jeeo |
English: In this world, in the nether regions of the underworld, and in the Akaashic Ethers, the Guru, the True Guru, has shown me the Lord; He has showered me with His Mercy.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਨੀ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਦੇਖੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: so braham ajonee hai bhee honee ghatt bheetar dekh muraaree jeeo |2|
English: He is the unborn Lord God; He is, and shall ever be. Deep within your heart, behold Him, the Destroyer of ego. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕਉ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਬਪੁੜੋ ਇਨਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: janam maran kau ihu jag bapurro in doojai bhagat visaaree jeeo |
English: This wretched world is caught in birth and death; in the love of duality, it has forgotten devotional worship of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਾਕਤ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: satigur milai ta guramat paaeeai saakat baajee haaree jeeo |3|
English: Meeting the True Guru, the Guru's Teachings are obtained; the faithless cynic loses the game of life. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋੜਿ ਨਿਰਾਰੇ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਗਰਭ ਮਝਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur bandhan torr niraare bahurr na garabh majhaaree jeeo |
English: Breaking my bonds, the True Guru has set me free, and I shall not be cast into the womb of reincarnation again.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੮॥
Transliteration: naanak giaan ratan paragaasiaa har man vasiaa nirankaaree jeeo |4|8|
English: O Nanak, the jewel of spiritual wisdom shines forth, and the Lord, the Formless Lord, dwells within my mind. ||4||8||

[Ang 598 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 1 |
English: Sorat'h, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਜਲ ਨਿਧਿ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਤੁਮ ਜਗਿ ਆਏ ਸੋ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: jis jal nidh kaaran tum jag aae so amrit gur paahee jeeo |
English: The treasure of the Name, for which you have come into the world - that Ambrosial Nectar is with the Guru.

Gurbani: ਛੋਡਹੁ ਵੇਸੁ ਭੇਖ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਇਹੁ ਫਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: chhoddahu ves bhekh chaturaaee dubidhaa ihu fal naahee jeeo |1|
English: Renounce costumes, disguises and clever tricks; this fruit is not obtained by duplicity. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਥਿਰੁ ਰਹੁ ਮਤੁ ਕਤ ਜਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: man re thir rahu mat kat jaahee jeeo |
English: O my mind, remain steady, and do not wander away.

Gurbani: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਢੂਢਤ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਘਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਘਟ ਮਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: baahar dtoodtat bahut dukh paaveh ghar amrit ghatt maahee jeeo | rahaau |
English: By searching around on the outside, you shall only suffer great pain; the Ambrosial Nectar is found within the home of your own being. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਵਗੁਣ ਛੋਡਿ ਗੁਣਾ ਕਉ ਧਾਵਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਪਛੁਤਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: avagun chhodd gunaa kau dhaavahu kar avagun pachhutaahee jeeo |
English: Renounce corruption, and seek virtue; committing sins, you shall only come to regret and repent.

Gurbani: ਸਰ ਅਪਸਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਕੀਚ ਬੁਡਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sar apasar kee saar na jaaneh fir fir keech buddaahee jeeo |2|
English: You do not know the difference between good and evil; again and again, you sink into the mud. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਲੋਭ ਬਹੁ ਝੂਠੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਕਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: antar mail lobh bahu jhootthe baahar naavahu kaahee jeeo |
English: Within you is the great filth of greed and falsehood; why do you bother to wash your body on the outside?

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਸਦ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਤਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: niramal naam japahu sad guramukh antar kee gat taahee jeeo |3|
English: Chant the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord always, under Guru's Instruction; only then will your innermost being be emancipated. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪਰਹਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਤਿਆਗਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: parahar lobh nindaa koorr tiaagahu sach gur bachanee fal paahee jeeo |
English: Let greed and slander be far away from you, and renounce falsehood; through the True Word of the Guru's Shabad, you shall obtain the true fruit.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੯॥
Transliteration: jiau bhaavai tiau raakhahu har jeeo jan naanak sabad salaahee jeeo |4|9|
English: As it pleases You, You preserve me, Dear Lord; servant Nanak sings the Praises of Your Shabad. ||4||9||

[Ang 598 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਪੰਚਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 1 panchapade |
English: Sorat'h, First Mehl, Panch-Padhay:

Gurbani: ਅਪਨਾ ਘਰੁ ਮੂਸਤ ਰਾਖਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਹਿ ਕੀ ਪਰ ਘਰੁ ਜੋਹਨ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: apanaa ghar moosat raakh na saakeh kee par ghar johan laagaa |
English: You cannot save your own home from being plundered; why do you spy on the houses of others?

Gurbani: ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਜੇ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਹਿ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ghar dar raakheh je ras chaakheh jo guramukh sevak laagaa |1|
English: That Gurmukh who joins himself to the Guru's service, saves his own home, and tastes the Lord's Nectar. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਮਝੁ ਕਵਨ ਮਤਿ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: man re samajh kavan mat laagaa |
English: O mind, you must realize what your intellect is focused on.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਲੋਭਾਨੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਹਿ ਅਭਾਗਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: naam visaar an ras lobhaane fir pachhutaeh abhaagaa | rahaau |
English: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one is involved with other tastes; the unfortunate wretch shall come to regret it in the end. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਵਤ ਕਉ ਹਰਖ ਜਾਤ ਕਉ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਇਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਲੇ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: aavat kau harakh jaat kau roveh ihu dukh sukh naale laagaa |
English: When things come, he is pleased, but when they go, he weeps and wails; this pain and pleasure remains attached to him.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਭੋਗਿ ਭੋਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋ ਅਨਰਾਗਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aape dukh sukh bhog bhogaavai guramukh so anaraagaa |2|
English: The Lord Himself causes him to enjoy pleasure and endure pain; the Gurmukh, however, remains unaffected. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਊਪਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੀਆ ਸੋ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: har ras aoopar avar kiaa kaheeai jin peea so tripataagaa |
English: What else can be said to be above the subtle essence of the Lord? One who drinks it in is satisfied and satiated.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿਤ ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਰਸੁ ਖੋਇਆ ਜਾ ਸਾਕਤ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਲਾਗਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohit jin ihu ras khoeaa jaa saakat duramat laagaa |3|
English: One who is lured by Maya loses this juice; that faithless cynic is tied to his evil-mindedness. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਜੀਉ ਪਵਨਪਤਿ ਦੇਹੀ ਦੇਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਦੇਉ ਸਮਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: man kaa jeeo pavanapat dehee dehee meh deo samaagaa |
English: The Lord is the life of the mind, the Master of the breath of life; the Divine Lord is contained in the body.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ ਤ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਗਾਈ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੈ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: je too dehi ta har ras gaaee man tripatai har liv laagaa |4|
English: If You so bless us, Lord, then we sing Your Praises; the mind is satisfied and fulfilled, lovingly attached to the Lord. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਜਮ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasangat meh har ras paaeeai gur miliai jam bhau bhaagaa |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the subtle essence of the Lord is obtained; meeting the Guru, the fear of death departs.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੫॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: naanak raam naam jap guramukh har paae masatak bhaagaa |5|10|
English: O Nanak, chant the Name of the Lord, as Gurmukh; you shall obtain the Lord, and realize your pre-ordained destiny. ||5||10||

[Ang 598 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 1 |
English: Sorat'h, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਧੁਰਾਹੂ ਬਿਨੁ ਲੇਖੈ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: sarab jeea sir lekh dhuraahoo bin lekhai nahee koee jeeo |
English: Destiny, pre-ordained by the Lord, looms over the heads of all beings; no one is without this pre-ordained destiny.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਅਲੇਖੁ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਚਲਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aap alekh kudarat kar dekhai hukam chalaae soee jeeo |1|
English: Only He Himself is beyond destiny; creating the creation by His creative power, He beholds it, and causes His Command to be followed. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਜਪਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: man re raam japahu sukh hoee |
English: O mind, chant the Name of the Lord, and be at peace.

Gurbani: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਸਰੇਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਸੋਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ahinis gur ke charan sarevahu har daataa bhugataa soee | rahaau |
English: Day and night, serve at the Guru's feet; the Lord is the Giver, and the Enjoyer. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੋ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo antar so baahar dekhahu avar na doojaa koee jeeo |
English: He is within - see Him outside as well; there is no one, other than Him.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮੋਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: guramukh ek drisatt kar dekhahu ghatt ghatt jot samoee jeeo |2|
English: As Gurmukh, look upon all with the single eye of equality; in each and every heart, the Divine Light is contained. ||2||

Gurbani: ਚਲਤੌ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਖਹੁ ਘਰਿ ਅਪਨੈ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: chalatau tthaak rakhahu ghar apanai gur miliai ih mat hoee jeeo |
English: Restrain your fickle mind, and keep it steady within its own home; meeting the Guru, this understanding is obtained.

Gurbani: ਦੇਖਿ ਅਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੁ ਰਹਉ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: dekh adrisatt rhau bisamaadee dukh bisarai sukh hoee jeeo |3|
English: Seeing the unseen Lord, you shall be amazed and delighted; forgetting your pain, you shall be at peace. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪੀਵਹੁ ਅਪਿਉ ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਹੋਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: peevahu apiau param sukh paaeeai nij ghar vaasaa hoee jeeo |
English: Drinking in the ambrosial nectar, you shall attain the highest bliss, and dwell within the home of your own self.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭਵ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਗਾਈਐ ਪੁਨਰਪਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: janam maran bhav bhanjan gaaeeai punarap janam na hoee jeeo |4|
English: So sing the Praises of the Lord, the Destroyer of the fear of birth and death, and you shall not be reincarnated again. ||4||

Gurbani: ਤਤੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਾਈ ਸੋਹੰ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: tat niranjan jot sabaaee sohan bhed na koee jeeo |
English: The essence, the immaculate Lord, the Light of all - I am He and He is me - there is no difference between us.

Gurbani: ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੋਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: aparanpar paarabraham paramesar naanak gur miliaa soee jeeo |5|11|
English: The Infinite Transcendent Lord, the Supreme Lord God - Nanak has met with Him, the Guru. ||5||11||

[Ang 599 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 1 ghar 3 |
English: Sorat'h, First Mehl, Third House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵਾ ਤਦ ਹੀ ਗਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaa tis bhaavaa tad hee gaavaa |
English: When I am pleasing to Him, then I sing His Praises.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਗਾਵੇ ਕਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: taa gaave kaa fal paavaa |
English: Singing His Praises, I receive the fruits of my rewards.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵੇ ਕਾ ਫਲੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: gaave kaa fal hoee |
English: The rewards of singing His Praises

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jaa aape devai soee |1|
English: Are obtained when He Himself gives them. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: man mere gur bachanee nidh paaee |
English: O my mind, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the treasure is obtained;

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਸਚ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: taa te sach meh rahiaa samaaee | rahaau |
English: this is why I remain immersed in the True Name. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸਾਖੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur saakhee antar jaagee |
English: When I awoke within myself to the Guru's Teachings,

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਚੰਚਲ ਮਤਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: taa chanchal mat tiaagee |
English: then I renounced my fickle intellect.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸਾਖੀ ਕਾ ਉਜੀਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur saakhee kaa ujeeaaraa |
English: When the Light of the Guru's Teachings dawned,

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਅੰਧੵਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: taa mittiaa sagal andhayaaraa |2|
English: and then all darkness was dispelled. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur charanee man laagaa |
English: When the mind is attached to the Guru's Feet,

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਭਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: taa jam kaa maarag bhaagaa |
English: then the Path of Death recedes.

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bhai vich nirbhau paaeaa |
English: Through the Fear of God, one attains the Fearless Lord;

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਸਹਜੈ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: taa sahajai kai ghar aaeaa |3|
English: then, one enters the home of celestial bliss. ||3||

Gurbani: ਭਣਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: bhanat naanak boojhai ko beechaaree |
English: Prays Nanak, how rare are those who reflect and understand,

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: eis jag meh karanee saaree |
English: the most sublime action in this world.

Gurbani: ਕਰਣੀ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: karanee keerat hoee |
English: The noblest deed is to sing the Lord's Praises,

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੋਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: jaa aape miliaa soee |4|1|12|
English: and so meet the Lord Himself. ||4||1||12||

[Ang 599 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 3 ghar 1 |
English: Sorat'h, Third Mehl, First House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਜਿਨ ਸਬਦੈ ਸਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sevak sev kareh sabh teree jin sabadai saad aaeaa |
English: All of Your servants, who relish the Word of Your Shabad, serve You.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur kirapaa te niramal hoaa jin vichahu aap gavaaeaa |
English: By Guru's Grace, they become pure, eradicating self-conceit from within.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: anadin gun gaaveh nit saache gur kai sabad suhaaeaa |1|
English: Night and day, they continually sing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord; they are adorned with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: mere tthaakur ham baarik saran tumaaree |
English: O my Lord and Master, I am Your child; I seek Your Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਤੂ ਕੇਵਲੁ ਆਪਿ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: eko sachaa sach too keval aap muraaree | rahaau |
English: You are the One and Only Lord, the Truest of the True; You Yourself are the Destroyer of ego. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਾਗਤ ਰਹੇ ਤਿਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਬਦੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jaagat rahe tinee prabh paaeaa sabade haumai maaree |
English: Those who remain wakeful obtain God; through the Word of the Shabad, they conquer their ego.

Gurbani: ਗਿਰਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਗਿਆਨ ਤਤ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: girahee meh sadaa har jan udaasee giaan tat beechaaree |
English: Immersed in family life, the Lord's humble servant ever remains detached; he reflects upon the essence of spiritual wisdom.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: satigur sev sadaa sukh paaeaa har raakhiaa ur dhaaree |2|
English: Serving the True Guru, he finds eternal peace, and he keeps the Lord enshrined in his heart. ||2||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਧਾਵਦਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: eihu manooaa deh dis dhaavadaa doojai bhaae khuaaeaa |
English: This mind wanders in the ten directions; it is consumed by the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh mugadh har naam na chetai birathaa janam gavaaeaa |
English: The foolish self-willed manmukh does not remember the Lord's Name; he wastes away his life in vain.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਤਾ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਏ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: satigur bhette taa naau paae haumai mohu chukaaeaa |3|
English: But when he meets the True Guru, then he obtains the Name; he sheds egotism and emotional attachment. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: har jan saache saach kamaaveh gur kai sabad veechaaree |
English: The Lord's humble servants are True - they practice Truth, and reflect upon the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: aape mel le prabh saachai saach rakhiaa ur dhaaree |
English: The True Lord God unites them with Himself, and they keep the True Lord enshrined in their hearts.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਗਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਏਹਾ ਰਾਸਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak naavahu gat mat paaee ehaa raas hamaaree |4|1|
English: O Nanak, through the Name, I have obtained salvation and understanding; this alone is my wealth. ||4||1||

[Ang 600 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 3 |
English: Sorat'h, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਉ ਦੀਆ ਨਾਉ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat khajaanaa bhagatan kau deea naau har dhan sach soe |
English: The True Lord has blessed His devotees with the treasure of devotional worship, and the wealth of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਅਖੁਟੁ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਕਦੇ ਨਿਖੁਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: akhutt naam dhan kade nikhuttai naahee kinai na keemat hoe |
English: The wealth of the Naam, shall never be exhausted; no one can estimate its worth.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਧਨਿ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਹੋਏ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naam dhan mukh ujale hoe har paaeaa sach soe |1|
English: With the wealth of the Naam, their faces are radiant, and they attain the True Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man mere gurasabadee har paaeaa jaae |
English: O my mind, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord is found.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਜਗੁ ਭੁਲਦਾ ਫਿਰਦਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bin sabadai jag bhuladaa firadaa daragah milai sajaae | rahaau |
English: Without the Shabad, the world wanders around, and receives its punishment in the Court of the Lord. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਵਸਹਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: eis dehee andar panch chor vaseh kaam krodh lobh mohu ahankaaraa |
English: Within this body dwell the five thieves: sexual desire, anger, greed, emotional attachment and egotism.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਲੂਟਹਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸੁਣੈ ਪੂਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: amrit lootteh manamukh nahee boojheh koe na sunai pookaaraa |
English: They plunder the Nectar, but the self-willed manmukh does not realize it; no one hears his complaint.

Gurbani: ਅੰਧਾ ਜਗਤੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: andhaa jagat andh varataaraa baajh guroo gubaaraa |2|
English: The world is blind, and its dealings are blind as well; without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵਿਗੁਤੇ ਕਿਹੁ ਚਲੈ ਨ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: haumai meraa kar kar vigute kihu chalai na chaladiaa naal |
English: Indulging in egotism and possessiveness, they are ruined; when they depart, nothing goes along with them.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh hovai su naam dhiaavai sadaa har naam samaal |
English: But one who becomes Gurmukh meditates on the Naam, and ever contemplates the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਦਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sachee baanee har gun gaavai nadaree nadar nihaal |3|
English: Through the True Word of Gurbani, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord; blessed with the Lord's Glance of Grace, he is enraptured. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਅਮਰੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਬਾਦਿਸਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: satigur giaan sadaa ghatt chaanan amar sir baadisaahaa |
English: The spiritual wisdom of the True Guru is a steady light within the heart. The Lord's decree is over the heads of even kings.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚੁ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: anadin bhagat kareh din raatee raam naam sach laahaa |
English: Night and day, the Lord's devotees worship Him; night and day, they gather in the true profit of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਹਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak raam naam nisataaraa sabad rate har paahaa |4|2|
English: O Nanak, through the Lord's Name, one is emancipated; attuned to the Shabad, he finds the Lord. ||4||2||

[Ang 600 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 3 |
English: Sorat'h, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: daasan daas hovai taa har paae vichahu aap gavaaee |
English: If one becomes the slave of the Lord's slaves, then he finds the Lord, and eradicates ego from within.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਾ ਕਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਹਰਿ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: bhagataa kaa kaaraj har anand hai anadin har gun gaaee |
English: The Lord of bliss is his object of devotion; night and day, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਇਕ ਰੰਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sabad rate sadaa ik rangee har siau rahe samaaee |1|
English: Attuned to the Word of the Shabad, the Lord's devotees remain ever as one, absorbed in the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਾਚੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: har jeeo saachee nadar tumaaree |
English: O Dear Lord, Your Glance of Grace is True.

Gurbani: ਆਪਣਿਆ ਦਾਸਾ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਪੈਜ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aapaniaa daasaa no kripaa kar piaare raakhahu paij hamaaree | rahaau |
English: Show mercy to Your slave, O Beloved Lord, and preserve my honor. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਸਦਾ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabad salaahee sadaa hau jeevaa guramatee bhau bhaagaa |
English: Continually praising the Word of the Shabad, I live; under Guru's Instruction, my fear has been dispelled.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਅਤਿ ਸੁਆਲਿਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: meraa prabh saachaa at suaaliau gur seviaa chit laagaa |
English: My True Lord God is so beautiful! Serving the Guru, my consciousness is focused on Him.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚੀ ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saachaa sabad sachee sach baanee so jan anadin jaagaa |2|
English: One who chants the True Word of the Shabad, and the Truest of the True, the Word of His Bani, remains wakeful, day and night. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: mahaa ganbheer sadaa sukhadaataa tis kaa ant na paaeaa |
English: He is so very deep and profound, the Giver of eternal peace; no one can find His limit.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕੀਨੀ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: poore gur kee sevaa keenee achint har man vasaaeaa |
English: Serving the Perfect Guru, one becomes carefree, enshrining the Lord within the mind.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: man tan niramal sadaa sukh antar vichahu bharam chukaaeaa |3|
English: The mind and body become immaculately pure, and a lasting peace fills the heart; doubt is eradicated from within. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਸਦਾ ਪੰਥੁ ਵਿਖੜਾ ਕੋ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa maarag sadaa panth vikharraa ko paae gur veechaaraa |
English: The Way of the Lord is always such a difficult path; only a few find it, contemplating the Guru.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਬਦੇ ਮਾਤਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜੇ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har kai rang raataa sabade maataa haumai taje vikaaraa |
English: Imbued with the Lord's Love, and intoxicated with the Shabad, he renounces ego and corruption.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤਾ ਇਕ ਰੰਗੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak naam rataa ik rangee sabad savaaranahaaraa |4|3|
English: O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, and the Love of the One Lord, he is embellished with the Word of the Shabad. ||4||3||

[Ang 601 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 3 |
English: Sorat'h, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਨੋ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹੈ ਸਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: har jeeo tudh no sadaa saalaahee piaare jichar ghatt antar hai saasaa |
English: Dear Beloved Lord, I praise You continually, as long as there is the breath within my body.

Gurbani: ਇਕੁ ਪਲੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਤੂ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਾਣਉ ਬਰਸ ਪਚਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: eik pal khin visareh too suaamee jaanau baras pachaasaa |
English: If I were to forget You, for a moment, even for an instant, O Lord Master, it would be like fifty years for me.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ ਸਦਾ ਸੇ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ham moorr mugadh sadaa se bhaaee gur kai sabad pragaasaa |1|
English: I was always such a fool and an idiot, O Siblings of Destiny, but now, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, my mind is enlightened. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੁਮ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਹੁ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har jeeo tum aape dehu bujhaaee |
English: Dear Lord, You Yourself bestow understanding.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har jeeo tudh vittahu vaariaa sad hee tere naam vittahu bal jaaee | rahaau |
English: Dear Lord, I am forever a sacrifice to You; I am dedicated and devoted to Your Name. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਸਬਦਿ ਮੁਏ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲੇ ਭਾਈ ਸਬਦੇ ਹੀ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ham sabad mue sabad maar jeevaale bhaaee sabade hee mukat paaee |
English: I have died in the Word of the Shabad, and through the Shabad, I am dead while yet alive, O Siblings of Destiny; through the Shabad, I have been liberated.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੇ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਹਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: sabade man tan niramal hoaa har vasiaa man aaee |
English: Through the Shabad, my mind and body have been purified, and the Lord has come to dwell within my mind.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰ ਦਾਤਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sabad gur daataa jit man raataa har siau rahiaa samaaee |2|
English: The Guru is the Giver of the Shabad; my mind is imbued with it, and I remain absorbed in the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸੇ ਅੰਨੇ ਬੋਲੇ ਸੇ ਕਿਤੁ ਆਏ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabad na jaaneh se ane bole se kit aae sansaaraa |
English: Those who do not know the Shabad are blind and deaf; why did they even bother to come into the world?

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har ras na paaeaa birathaa janam gavaaeaa jameh vaaro vaaraa |
English: They do not obtain the subtle essence of the Lord's elixir; they waste away their lives, and are reincarnated over and over again.

Gurbani: ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕੇ ਕੀੜੇ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bisattaa ke keerre bisattaa maeh samaane manamukh mugadh gubaaraa |3|
English: The blind, idiotic, self-willed manmukhs are like maggots in manure, and in manure they rot away. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਲਾਏ ਭਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aape kar vekhai maarag laae bhaaee tis bin avar na koee |
English: The Lord Himself creates us, watches over us, and places us on the Path, O Siblings of Destiny; there is no one other than Him.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਭਾਈ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jo dhur likhiaa su koe na mettai bhaaee karataa kare su hoee |
English: No one can erase that which is pre-ordained, O Siblings of Destiny; whatever the Creator wills, comes to pass.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਭਾਈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ ॥੪॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak naam vasiaa man antar bhaaee avar na doojaa koee |4|4|
English: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within the mind; O Siblings of Destiny, there is no other at all. ||4||4||

[Ang 601 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 3 |
English: Sorat'h, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh bhagat kareh prabh bhaaveh anadin naam vakhaane |
English: The Gurmukhs practice devotional worship, and become pleasing to God; night and day, they chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਕਰਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਜੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: bhagataa kee saar kareh aap raakheh jo terai man bhaane |
English: You Yourself protect and take care of Your devotees, who are pleasing to Your Mind.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਣੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: too gunadaataa sabad pachhaataa gun keh gunee samaane |1|
English: You are the Giver of virtue, realized through the Word of Your Shabad. Uttering Your Glories, we merge with You, O Glorious Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: man mere har jeeo sadaa samaal |
English: O my mind, remember always the Dear Lord.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਬੇਲੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ant kaal teraa belee hovai sadaa nibahai terai naal | rahaau |
English: At the very last moment, He alone shall be your best friend; He shall always stand by you. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦੁਸਟ ਚਉਕੜੀ ਸਦਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਨਾ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: dusatt chaukarree sadaa koorr kamaaveh naa boojheh veechaare |
English: The gathering of the wicked enemies shall always practice falsehood; they do not contemplate understanding.

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਦੁਸਟੀ ਤੇ ਕਿਨਿ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਣਾਖਸ ਨਖਹਿ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: nindaa dusattee te kin fal paaeaa haranaakhas nakheh bidaare |
English: Who can obtain fruit from the slander of evil enemies? Remember that Harnaakhash was torn apart by the Lord's claws.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦੁ ਜਨੁ ਸਦ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਲਏ ਉਬਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: prahilaad jan sad har gun gaavai har jeeo le ubaare |2|
English: Prahlaad, the Lord's humble servant, constantly sang the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and the Dear Lord saved him. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਬਹੁ ਭਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮਤਿ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aapas kau bahu bhalaa kar jaaneh manamukh mat na kaaee |
English: The self-willed manmukhs see themselves as being very virtuous; they have absolutely no understanding at all.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਜਾਸਨਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: saadhoo jan kee nindaa viaape jaasan janam gavaaee |
English: They indulge in slander of the humble spiritual people; they waste their lives away, and then they have to depart.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਦੇ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਏ ਪਛੁਤਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: raam naam kade cheteh naahee ant ge pachhutaaee |3|
English: They never think of the Lord's Name, and in the end, they depart, regretting and repenting. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਭਗਤਾ ਕਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਆਪਿ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: safal janam bhagataa kaa keetaa gur sevaa aap laae |
English: The Lord makes the lives of His devotees fruitful; He Himself links them to the Guru's service.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੇ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sabade raate sahaje maate anadin har gun gaae |
English: Imbued with the Word of the Shabad, and intoxicated with celestial bliss, night and day, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਹਉ ਲਾਗਾ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak daas kahai benantee hau laagaa tin kai paae |4|5|
English: Slave Nanak utters this prayer: O Lord, please, let me fall at their feet. ||4||5||

[Ang 601 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 3 |
English: Sorat'h, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਿਖੁ ਸਖਾ ਬੰਧਪੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਜਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਭਾਣੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: so sikh sakhaa bandhap hai bhaaee ji gur ke bhaane vich aavai |
English: He alone is a Sikh, a friend, a relative and a sibling, who walks in the Way of the Guru's Will.

Gurbani: ਆਪਣੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਭਾਈ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: aapanai bhaanai jo chalai bhaaee vichhurr chottaa khaavai |
English: One who walks according to his own will, O Siblings of Destiny, suffers separation from the Lord, and shall be punished.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੁਖੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਭਾਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੋਤਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bin satigur sukh kade na paavai bhaaee fir fir pachhotaavai |1|
English: Without the True Guru, peace is never obtained, O Siblings of Destiny; again and again, he regrets and repents. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har ke daas suhele bhaaee |
English: The Lord's slaves are happy, O Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਟੇ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: janam janam ke kilabikh dukh kaatte aape mel milaaee | rahaau |
English: The sins and sorrows of countless lifetimes are eradicated; the Lord Himself unites them in His Union. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਸਭੁ ਜੀਅ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਭਾਈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾ ਸੈਂਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: eihu kuttanb sabh jeea ke bandhan bhaaee bharam bhulaa sainsaaraa |
English: All of these relatives are like chains upon the soul, O Siblings of Destiny; the world is deluded by doubt.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬੰਧਨ ਟੂਟਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: bin gur bandhan ttootteh naahee guramukh mokh duaaraa |
English: Without the Guru, the chains cannot be broken; the Gurmukhs find the door of salvation.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮ ਕਰਹਿ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: karam kareh gurasabad na pachhaaneh mar janameh vaaro vaaraa |2|
English: One who performs rituals without realizing the Word of the Guru's Shabad, shall die and be reborn, again and again. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਮੇਰਾ ਜਗੁ ਪਲਚਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: hau meraa jag palach rahiaa bhaaee koe na kis hee keraa |
English: The world is entangled in egotism and possessiveness, O Siblings of Destiny, but no one belongs to anyone else.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh mehal paaein gun gaavan nij ghar hoe baseraa |
English: The Gurmukhs attain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, singing the Glories of the Lord; they dwell in the home of their own inner being.

Gurbani: ਐਥੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੁ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aithai boojhai su aap pachhaanai har prabh hai tis keraa |3|
English: One who understands here, realizes himself; the Lord God belongs to him. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਵਿਣੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਕਿਆ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: satiguroo sadaa deaal hai bhaaee vin bhaagaa kiaa paaeeai |
English: The True Guru is forever merciful, O Siblings of Destiny; without good destiny, what can anyone obtain?

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਜੇਹਾ ਭਾਉ ਤੇਹਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: ek nadar kar vekhai sabh aoopar jehaa bhaau tehaa fal paaeeai |
English: He looks alike upon all with His Glance of Grace, but people receive the fruits of their rewards according to their love for the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥੪॥੬॥
Transliteration: naanak naam vasai man antar vichahu aap gavaaeeai |4|6|
English: O Nanak, when the Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to dwell within the mind, then self-conceit is eradicated from within. ||4||6||

[Ang 602 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਚੌਤੁਕੇ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 3 chauatuke |
English: Sorat'h, Third Mehl, Chau-Thukay:

Gurbani: ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਚੀ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: sachee bhagat satigur te hovai sachee hiradai baanee |
English: True devotional worship is obtained only through the True Guru, when the True Word of His Bani is in the heart.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: satigur seve sadaa sukh paae haumai sabad samaanee |
English: Serving the True Guru, eternal peace is obtained; egotism is obliterated through the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਹੋਰ ਭੂਲੀ ਫਿਰੈ ਇਆਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: bin gur saache bhagat na hovee hor bhoolee firai eaanee |
English: Without the Guru, there is no true devotion; otherwise, people wander around, deluded by ignorance.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਡੂਬਿ ਮੁਏ ਵਿਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: manamukh fireh sadaa dukh paaveh ddoob mue vin paanee |1|
English: The self-willed manmukhs wander around, suffering in constant pain; they drown and die, even without water. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਹੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: bhaaee re sadaa rahahu saranaaee |
English: O Siblings of Destiny, remain forever in the Lord's Sanctuary, under His Protection.

Gurbani: ਆਪਣੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aapanee nadar kare pat raakhai har naamo de vaddiaaee | rahaau |
English: Bestowing His Glance of Grace, He preserves our honor, and blesses us with the glory of the Lord's Name. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: poore gur te aap pachhaataa sabad sachai veechaaraa |
English: Through the Perfect Guru, one comes to understand himself, contemplating the True Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਸਦ ਵਸਿਆ ਤਜਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: hiradai jagajeevan sad vasiaa taj kaam krodh ahankaaraa |
English: The Lord, the Life of the world, ever abides in his heart, and he renounces sexual desire, anger and egotism.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa hajoor raviaa sabh tthaaee hiradai naam apaaraa |
English: The Lord is ever-present, permeating and pervading all places; the Name of the Infinite Lord is enshrined within the heart.

Gurbani: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੀ ਨਾਉ ਮੀਠਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jug jug baanee sabad pachhaanee naau meetthaa maneh piaaraa |2|
English: Throughout the ages, through the Word of His Bani, His Shabad is realized, and the Name becomes so sweet and beloved to the mind. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਜਗਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sev jin naam pachhaataa safal janam jag aaeaa |
English: Serving the Guru, one realizes the Naam, the Name of the Lord; fruitful is his life, and his coming into the world.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਣੀ ਅਘਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: har ras chaakh sadaa man tripatiaa gun gaavai gunee aghaaeaa |
English: Tasting the sublime elixir of the Lord, his mind is satisfied and satiated forever; singing the Glories of the Glorious Lord, he is fulfilled and satisfied.

Gurbani: ਕਮਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kamal pragaas sadaa rang raataa anahad sabad vajaaeaa |
English: The lotus of his heart blossoms forth, he is ever imbued with the Lord's Love, and the unstruck melody of the Shabad resounds within him.

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tan man niramal niramal baanee sache sach samaaeaa |3|
English: His body and mind become immaculately pure; his speech becomes immaculate as well, and he merges in the Truest of the True. ||3||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam kee gat koe na boojhai guramat ridai samaaee |
English: No one knows the state of the Lord's Name; through the Guru's Teachings, it comes to abide in the heart.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਮਗੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh hovai su mag pachhaanai har ras rasan rasaaee |
English: One who becomes Gurmukh, understands the Path; his tongue savors the sublime essence of the Lord's Nectar.

Gurbani: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jap tap sanjam sabh gur te hovai hiradai naam vasaaee |
English: Meditation, austere self-discipline and self-restraint are all obtained from the Guru; the Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to abide within the heart.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੭॥
Transliteration: naanak naam samaaleh se jan sohan dar saachai pat paaee |4|7|
English: O Nanak, those humble beings who praise the Naam are beautiful; they are honored in the Court of the True Lord. ||4||7||

[Ang 602 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਃ ੩ ਦੁਤੁਕੇ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 3 dutuke |
English: Sorat'h, Third Mehl, Dho-Thukay:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਉਲਟੀ ਭਈ ਭਾਈ ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਬੂਝ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur miliai ulattee bhee bhaaee jeevat marai taa boojh paae |
English: Meeting the True Guru, one turns away from the world, O Siblings of Destiny; when he remains dead while yet alive, he obtains true understanding.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਗੁਰੂ ਸੋ ਸਿਖੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: so guroo so sikh hai bhaaee jis jotee jot milaae |1|
English: He alone is the Guru, and he alone is a Sikh, O Siblings of Destiny, whose light merges in the Light. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man re har har setee liv laae |
English: O my mind, be lovingly attuned to the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਥਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: man har jap meetthaa laagai bhaaee guramukh paae har thaae | rahaau |
English: Chanting the Name of the Lord, it seems so sweet to the mind, O Siblings of Destiny; the Gurmukhs obtain a place in the Court of the Lord. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਭਾਈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin gur preet na aoopajai bhaaee manamukh doojai bhaae |
English: Without the Guru, love for the Lord does not well up, O Siblings of Destiny; the self-willed manmukhs are engrossed in the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਤੁਹ ਕੁਟਹਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਹਿ ਭਾਈ ਪਲੈ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tuh kutteh manamukh karam kareh bhaaee palai kichhoo na paae |2|
English: Actions performed by the manmukh are like the threshing of the chaff - they obtain nothing for their efforts. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਸਾਚੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: gur miliai naam man raviaa bhaaee saachee preet piaar |
English: Meeting the Guru, the Naam comes to permeate the mind, O Siblings of Destiny, with true love and affection.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sadaa har ke gun ravai bhaaee gur kai het apaar |3|
English: He always sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny, with infinite love for the Guru. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਇਆ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਜਿ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aaeaa so paravaan hai bhaaee ji gur sevaa chit laae |
English: How blessed and approved is his coming into the world, O Siblings of Destiny, who focuses his mind on serving the Guru.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮੇਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੮॥
Transliteration: naanak naam har paaeeai bhaaee gurasabadee melaae |4|8|
English: O Nanak, the Name of the Lord is obtained, O Siblings of Destiny, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and we merge with the Lord. ||4||8||

[Ang 603 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 3 ghar 1 |
English: Sorat'h, Third Mehl, First House:

Gurbani: ਤਿਹੀ ਗੁਣੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: tihee gunee tribhavan viaapiaa bhaaee guramukh boojh bujhaae |
English: The three worlds are entangled in the three qualities, O Siblings of Destiny; the Guru imparts understanding.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗਿ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਗਿਆਨੀਆ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: raam naam lag chhootteeai bhaaee poochhahu giaaneea jaae |1|
English: Attached to the Lord's Name, one is emancipated, O Siblings of Destiny; go and ask the wise ones about this. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਉਥੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man re trai gun chhodd chauthai chit laae |
English: O mind, renounce the three qualities, and focus your consciousness on the fourth state.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਭਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har jeeo terai man vasai bhaaee sadaa har ke gun gaae | rahaau |
English: The Dear Lord abides in the mind, O Siblings of Destiny; ever sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੈ ਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਊਪਜੇ ਭਾਈ ਨਾਇ ਵਿਸਰਿਐ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: naamai te sabh aoopaje bhaaee naae visariai mar jaae |
English: From the Naam, everyone originated, O Siblings of Destiny; forgetting the Naam, they die away.

Gurbani: ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਗਤੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਸੂਤੇ ਗਏ ਮੁਹਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: agiaanee jagat andh hai bhaaee soote ge muhaae |2|
English: The ignorant world is blind, O Siblings of Destiny; those who sleep are plundered. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਗੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh jaage se ubare bhaaee bhavajal paar utaar |
English: Those Gurmukhs who remain awake are saved, O Siblings of Destiny; they cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jag meh laahaa har naam hai bhaaee hiradai rakhiaa ur dhaar |3|
English: In this world, the Name of the Lord is the true profit, O Siblings of Destiny; keep it enshrined within your heart. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਉਬਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur saranaaee ubare bhaaee raam naam liv laae |
English: In the Guru's Sanctuary, O Siblings of Destiny, you shall be saved; be lovingly attuned to the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਉ ਬੇੜਾ ਨਾਉ ਤੁਲਹੜਾ ਭਾਈ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਗਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਜਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥੯॥
Transliteration: naanak naau berraa naau tulaharraa bhaaee jit lag paar jan paae |4|9|
English: O Nanak, the Name of the Lord is the boat, and the Name is the raft, O Siblings of Destiny; setting out on it, the Lord's humble servant crosses over the world-ocean. ||4||9||

[Ang 603 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 3 ghar 1 |
English: Sorat'h, Third Mehl, First House:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਜਗ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹੋਰ ਥੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sukh saagar jag antar hor thai sukh naahee |
English: The True Guru is the ocean of peace in the world; there is no other place of rest and peace.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਜਗਤੁ ਦੁਖਿ ਰੋਗਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਰੋਵੈ ਧਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: haumai jagat dukh rog viaapiaa mar janamai rovai dhaahee |1|
English: The world is afflicted with the painful disease of egotism; dying, only to be reborn, it cries out in pain. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: praanee satigur sev sukh paae |
English: O mind, serve the True Guru, and obtain peace.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਨਾਹਿ ਤ ਜਾਹਿਗਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur seveh taa sukh paaveh naeh ta jaahigaa janam gavaae | rahaau |
English: If you serve the True Guru, you shall find peace; otherwise, you shall depart, after wasting away your life in vain. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਧਾਤੁ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: trai gun dhaat bahu karam kamaaveh har ras saad na aaeaa |
English: Led around by the three qualities, he does many deeds, but he does not come to taste and savor the subtle essence of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੰਧਿਆ ਤਰਪਣੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਗਾਇਤ੍ਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sandhiaa tarapan kareh gaaeitree bin boojhe dukh paaeaa |2|
English: He says his evening prayers, and makes offerings of water, and recites his morning prayers, but without true understanding, he still suffers in pain. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: satigur seve so vaddabhaagee jis no aap milaae |
English: One who serves the True Guru is very fortunate; as the Lord so wills, he meets with the Guru.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀ ਜਨ ਸਦਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੇ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har ras pee jan sadaa tripataase vichahu aap gavaae |3|
English: Drinking in the sublime essence of the Lord, His humble servants remain ever satisfied; they eradicate self-conceit from within themselves. ||3||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਅੰਧਾ ਸਭੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: eihu jag andhaa sabh andh kamaavai bin gur mag na paae |
English: This world is blind, and all act blindly; without the Guru, no one finds the Path.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਅਖੀ ਵੇਖੈ ਘਰੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: naanak satigur milai ta akhee vekhai gharai andar sach paae |4|10|
English: O Nanak, meeting with the True Guru, one sees with his eyes, and finds the True Lord within the home of his own being. ||4||10||

[Ang 603 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 3 |
English: Sorat'h, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਭਰਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: bin satigur seve bahutaa dukh laagaa jug chaare bharamaaee |
English: Without serving the True Guru, he suffers in terrible pain, and throughout the four ages, he wanders aimlessly.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਦੀਨ ਤੁਮ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਦਾਤੇ ਸਬਦੇ ਦੇਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ham deen tum jug jug daate sabade dehi bujhaaee |1|
English: I am poor and meek, and throughout the ages, You are the Great Giver - please, grant me the understanding of the Shabad. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har jeeo kripaa karahu tum piaare |
English: O Dear Beloved Lord, please show mercy to me.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਆਧਾਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur daataa mel milaavahu har naam devahu aadhaare | rahaau |
English: Unite me in the Union of the True Guru, the Great Giver, and give me the support of the Lord's Name. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: manasaa maar dubidhaa sehaj samaanee paaeaa naam apaaraa |
English: Conquering my desires and duality, I have merged in celestial peace, and I have found the Naam, the Name of the Infinite Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har ras chaakh man niramal hoaa kilabikh kaattanahaaraa |2|
English: I have tasted the sublime essence of the Lord, and my soul has become immaculately pure; the Lord is the Destroyer of sins. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰਹੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੀਵਹੁ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਤਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: sabad marahu fir jeevahu sad hee taa fir maran na hoee |
English: Dying in the Word of the Shabad, you shall live forever, and you shall never die again.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਸਬਦੇ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: amrit naam sadaa man meetthaa sabade paavai koee |3|
English: The Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam is ever-sweet to the mind; but how few are those who obtain the Shabad. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦਾਤੈ ਦਾਤਿ ਰਖੀ ਹਥਿ ਅਪਣੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਈ ॥
Transliteration: daatai daat rakhee hath apanai jis bhaavai tis deee |
English: The Great Giver keeps His Gifts in His Hand; He gives them to those with whom He is pleased.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਦਰਗਹ ਜਾਪਹਿ ਸੇਈ ॥੪॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: naanak naam rate sukh paaeaa daragah jaapeh seee |4|11|
English: O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, they find peace, and in the Court of the Lord, they are exalted. ||4||11||

[Ang 604 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 3 |
English: Sorat'h, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਾ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਗਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਤਦ ਹੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: satigur seve taa sehaj dhun upajai gat mat tad hee paae |
English: Serving the True Guru, the divine melody wells up within, and one is blessed with wisdom and salvation.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam sachaa man vasiaa naame naam samaae |1|
English: The True Name of the Lord comes to abide in the mind, and through the Name, one merges in the Name. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਬਉਰਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: bin satigur sabh jag bauraanaa |
English: Without the True Guru, the whole world is insane.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਝੂਠੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਨਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh andhaa sabad na jaanai jhootthai bharam bhulaanaa | rahaau |
English: The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not realize the Word of the Shabad; they are deluded by false doubts. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: trai gun maaeaa bharam bhulaaeaa haumai bandhan kamaae |
English: The three-faced Maya had led them astray in doubt, and they are snared by the noose of egotism.

Gurbani: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਊਭਉ ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jaman maran sir aoopar aoobhau garabh jon dukh paae |2|
English: Birth and death hang over their heads, and being reborn from the womb, they suffer in pain. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਵਰਤਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: trai gun varateh sagal sansaaraa haumai vich pat khoee |
English: The three qualities permeate the whole world; acting in ego, it loses its honor.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਚਉਥਾ ਪਦੁ ਚੀਨੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: guramukh hovai chauthaa pad cheenai raam naam sukh hoee |3|
English: But one who becomes Gurmukh comes to realize the fourth state of celestial bliss; he finds peace through the Name of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਜੋ ਤੂ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: trai gun sabh tere too aape karataa jo too kareh su hoee |
English: The three qualities are all Yours, O Lord; You Yourself created them. Whatever You do, comes to pass.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਸਬਦੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਖੋਈ ॥੪॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: naanak raam naam nisataaraa sabade haumai khoee |4|12|
English: O Nanak, through the Lord's Name, one is emancipated; through the Shabad, he is rid of egotism. ||4||12||

[Ang 604 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 4 ghar 1 |
English: Sorat'h, Fourth Mehl, First House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਅਪਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape aap varatadaa piaaraa aape aap apaahu |
English: My Beloved Lord Himself pervades and permeates all; He Himself is, all by Himself.

Gurbani: ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ਜਗੁ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: vanajaaraa jag aap hai piaaraa aape saachaa saahu |
English: My Beloved Himself is the trader in this world; He Himself is the true banker.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਵਣਜੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੀਆ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਸਚੁ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aape vanaj vaapaareea piaaraa aape sach vesaahu |1|
English: My Beloved Himself is the trade and the trader; He Himself is the true credit. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹ ॥
Transliteration: jap man har har naam salaah |
English: O mind, meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, and praise His Name.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur kirapaa te paaeeai piaaraa amrit agam athaah | rahaau |
English: By Guru's Grace, the Beloved, Ambrosial, unapproachable and unfathomable Lord is obtained. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਭ ਵੇਖਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੇ ਆਪਿ ਮੁਹਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape sun sabh vekhadaa piaaraa mukh bole aap muhaahu |
English: The Beloved Himself sees and hears everything; He Himself speaks through the mouths of all beings.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਉਝੜਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪਿ ਵਿਖਾਲੇ ਰਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape ujharr paaeidaa piaaraa aap vikhaale raahu |
English: The Beloved Himself leads us into the wilderness, and He Himself shows us the Way.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਸਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aape hee sabh aap hai piaaraa aape veparavaahu |2|
English: The Beloved Himself is Himself all-in-all; He Himself is carefree. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਧੰਧੜੈ ਲਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape aap upaaeidaa piaaraa sir aape dhandharrai laahu |
English: The Beloved Himself, all by Himself, created everything; He Himself links all to their tasks.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਸਾਖਤੀ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: aap karaae saakhatee piaaraa aap maare mar jaahu |
English: The Beloved Himself creates the Creation, and He Himself destroys it.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਪਤਣੁ ਪਾਤਣੀ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਹੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aape patan paatanee piaaraa aape paar langhaahu |3|
English: He Himself is the wharf, and He Himself is the ferryman, who ferries us across. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਖੇਵਟੁ ਆਪਿ ਚਲਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape saagar bohithaa piaaraa gur khevatt aap chalaahu |
English: The Beloved Himself is the ocean, and the boat; He Himself is the Guru, the boatman who steers it

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਚੜਿ ਲੰਘਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਚੋਜ ਵੇਖੈ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape hee charr langhadaa piaaraa kar choj vekhai paatisaahu |
English: . The Beloved Himself sets sail and crosses over; He, the King, beholds His wondrous play.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਹੁ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: aape aap deaal hai piaaraa jan naanak bakhas milaahu |4|1|
English: The Beloved Himself is the Merciful Master; O servant Nanak, He forgives and blends with Himself. ||4||1||

[Ang 604 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਚਉਥਾ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 4 chauthaa |
English: Sorat'h, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਅੰਡਜ ਜੇਰਜ ਸੇਤਜ ਉਤਭੁਜ ਆਪੇ ਖੰਡ ਆਪੇ ਸਭ ਲੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aape anddaj jeraj setaj utabhuj aape khandd aape sabh loe |
English: He Himself is born of the egg, from the womb, from sweat and from the earth; He Himself is the continents and all the worlds.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸੂਤੁ ਆਪੇ ਬਹੁ ਮਣੀਆ ਕਰਿ ਸਕਤੀ ਜਗਤੁ ਪਰੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aape soot aape bahu maneea kar sakatee jagat paroe |
English: He Himself is the thread, and He Himself is the many beads; through His Almighty Power, He has strung the worlds.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਸੂਤਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸੂਤੁ ਖਿੰਚੇ ਢਹਿ ਢੇਰੀ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aape hee sootadhaar hai piaaraa soot khinche dteh dteree hoe |1|
English: He holds the thread, and when He withdraws the thread, the beads scatter into heaps. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: mere man mai har bin avar na koe |
English: O my mind, there is no other than the Lord for me.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਚੋਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur vich naam nidhaan hai piaaraa kar deaa amrit mukh choe | rahaau |
English: The treasure of the Beloved Naam is within the True Guru; in His Mercy, he pours the Ambrosial Nectar into my mouth. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਜਲ ਥਲਿ ਸਭਤੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aape jal thal sabhat hai piaaraa prabh aape kare su hoe |
English: The Beloved Himself is in all the oceans and lands; whatever God does, comes to pass.

Gurbani: ਸਭਨਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਮਾਹਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabhanaa rijak samaahadaa piaaraa doojaa avar na koe |
English: The Beloved brings nourishment to all; there is no other than Him.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲ ਖੇਲਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aape khel khelaaeidaa piaaraa aape kare su hoe |2|
English: The Beloved Himself plays, and whatever He Himself does, comes to pass. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aape hee aap niramalaa piaaraa aape niramal soe |
English: The Beloved Himself, all by Himself, is immaculate and pure; He Himself is immaculate and pure.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aape keemat paaeidaa piaaraa aape kare su hoe |
English: The Beloved Himself determines the value of all; whatever He does comes to pass.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪਿ ਲਖਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aape alakh na lakheeai piaaraa aap lakhaavai soe |3|
English: The Beloved Himself is unseen - He cannot be seen; He Himself causes us to see. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aape gahir ganbheer hai piaaraa tis jevadd avar na koe |
English: The Beloved Himself is deep and profound and unfathomable; there is no other as great as He.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਘਟ ਆਪੇ ਭੋਗਵੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਾਰੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਸਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabh ghatt aape bhogavai piaaraa vich naaree purakh sabh soe |
English: The Beloved Himself enjoys every heart; He is contained within every woman and man.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak gupat varatadaa piaaraa guramukh paragatt hoe |4|2|
English: O Nanak, the Beloved is pervading everywhere, but He is hidden; through the Guru, He is revealed. ||4||2||

[Ang 605 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 4 |
English: Sorat'h, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਸਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: aape hee sabh aap hai piaaraa aape thaap uthaapai |
English: He Himself, the Beloved, is Himself all-in-all; He Himself establishes and disestablishes.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਚੋਜ ਵੇਖੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: aape vekh vigasadaa piaaraa kar choj vekhai prabh aapai |
English: The Beloved Himself beholds, and rejoices; God Himself works wonders, and beholds them.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਵਣਿ ਤਿਣਿ ਸਭਤੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aape van tin sabhat hai piaaraa aape guramukh jaapai |1|
English: The Beloved Himself is contained in all the woods and meadows; as Gurmukh, He reveals Himself. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਸਿ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: jap man har har naam ras dhraapai |
English: Meditate, O mind, on the Lord, Har, Har; through the sublime essence of Lord's Name, you shall be satisfied.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਚਖਿ ਜਾਪੈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: amrit naam mahaa ras meetthaa gurasabadee chakh jaapai | rahaau |
English: The Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, is the sweetest juice; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, its taste is revealed. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਤੁਲਹੜਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: aape teerath tulaharraa piaaraa aap tarai prabh aapai |
English: The Beloved is Himself the place of pilgrimage and the raft; God Himself ferries Himself across.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਲੁ ਵਤਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: aape jaal vataaeidaa piaaraa sabh jag machhulee har aapai |
English: The Beloved Himself casts the net over all the world; the Lord Himself is the fish.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਅਭੁਲੁ ਨ ਭੁਲਈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aap abhul na bhulee piaaraa avar na doojaa jaapai |2|
English: The Beloved Himself is infallible; He makes no mistakes. There is no other like Him to be seen. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਿੰਙੀ ਨਾਦੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਧੁਨਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਜਾਏ ਆਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: aape singee naad hai piaaraa dhun aap vajaae aapai |
English: The Beloved Himself is the Yogi's horn, and the sound current of the Naad; He Himself plays the tune.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਜੋਗੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਤਪੁ ਤਾਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: aape jogee purakh hai piaaraa aape hee tap taapai |
English: The Beloved Himself is the Yogi, the Primal Being; He Himself practices intense meditation.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਚੇਲਾ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aape satigur aap hai chelaa upades karai prabh aapai |3|
English: He Himself is the True Guru, and He Himself is the disciple; God Himself imparts the Teachings. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਨਾਉ ਜਪਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: aape naau japaaeidaa piaaraa aape hee jap jaapai |
English: The Beloved Himself inspires us to chant His Name, and He Himself practices meditation.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਰਸੁ ਆਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: aape amrit aap hai piaaraa aape hee ras aapai |
English: The Beloved Himself is the Ambrosial Nectar; He Himself is the juice of it.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਸਲਾਹਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੈ ॥੪॥੩॥
Transliteration: aape aap salaahadaa piaaraa jan naanak har ras dhraapai |4|3|
English: The Beloved Himself praises Himself; servant Nanak is satisfied, with the sublime essence of the Lord. ||4||3||

[Ang 605 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 4 |
English: Sorat'h, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕੰਡਾ ਆਪਿ ਤਰਾਜੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ਤੋਲਿ ਤੋਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aape kanddaa aap taraajee prabh aape tol tolaaeaa |
English: God Himself is the balance scale, He Himself is the weigher, and He Himself weighs with the weights.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aape saahu aape vanajaaraa aape vanaj karaaeaa |
English: He Himself is the banker, He Himself is the trader, and He Himself makes the trades.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਪਿਆਰੈ ਪਿਛੈ ਟੰਕੁ ਚੜਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aape dharatee saajeean piaarai pichhai ttank charraaeaa |1|
English: The Beloved Himself fashioned the world, and He Himself counter-balances it with a gram. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: mere man har har dhiaae sukh paaeaa |
English: My mind meditates on the Lord, Har, Har, and finds peace.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam nidhaan hai piaaraa gur poorai meetthaa laaeaa | rahaau |
English: The Name of the Beloved Lord, Har, Har, is a treasure; the Perfect Guru has made it seem sweet to me. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਆਪਿ ਜਲੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aape dharatee aap jal piaaraa aape kare karaaeaa |
English: The Beloved Himself is the earth, and He Himself is the water; He Himself acts, and causes others to act.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਜਲੁ ਮਾਟੀ ਬੰਧਿ ਰਖਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aape hukam varatadaa piaaraa jal maattee bandh rakhaaeaa |
English: The Beloved Himself issues His Commands, and keeps the water and the land bound down.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਭਉ ਪਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਬੰਨਿ ਬਕਰੀ ਸੀਹੁ ਹਢਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aape hee bhau paaeidaa piaaraa ban bakaree seehu hadtaaeaa |2|
English: The Beloved Himself instills the Fear of God; He binds the tiger and the goat together. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਾਸਟ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਾਸਟ ਅਗਨਿ ਰਖਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aape kaasatt aap har piaaraa vich kaasatt agan rakhaaeaa |
English: The Beloved Lord Himself is the firewood, and He Himself keeps the fire within the wood.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਭੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਜਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aape hee aap varatadaa piaaraa bhai agan na sakai jalaaeaa |
English: The Beloved Lord Himself, all by Himself, permeates them, and because of the Fear of God, the fire cannot burn the wood.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸਾਹ ਲੈਦੇ ਸਭਿ ਲਵਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aape maar jeevaaeidaa piaaraa saah laide sabh lavaaeaa |3|
English: The Beloved Himself kills and revives; all draw the breath of life, given by Him. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਤਾਣੁ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aape taan deebaan hai piaaraa aape kaarai laaeaa |
English: The Beloved Himself is power and presence; He Himself engages us in our work.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਆਪਿ ਚਲਾਏ ਤਿਉ ਚਲੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jiau aap chalaae tiau chaleeai piaare jiau har prabh mere bhaaeaa |
English: As the Beloved makes me walk, I walk, as it pleases my Lord God.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਜੰਤੀ ਜੰਤੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਜਹਿ ਵਜਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੪॥
Transliteration: aape jantee jant hai piaaraa jan naanak vajeh vajaaeaa |4|4|
English: The Beloved Himself is the musician, and the musical instrument; servant Nanak vibrates His vibration. ||4||4||

[Ang 606 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 4 |
English: Sorat'h, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਚੰਦੁ ਚਾਨਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape srisatt upaaeidaa piaaraa kar sooraj chand chaanaan |
English: The Beloved Himself created the Universe; He made the light of the sun and the moon.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਨਿਤਾਣਿਆ ਤਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਮਾਣਿਆ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: aap nitaaniaa taan hai piaaraa aap nimaaniaa maan |
English: The Beloved Himself is the power of the powerless; He Himself is the honor of the dishonored.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਰਖਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aap deaa kar rakhadaa piaaraa aape sugharr sujaan |1|
English: The Beloved Himself grants His Grace and protects us; He Himself is wise and all-knowing. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: mere man jap raam naam neesaan |
English: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, and receive His Insignia.

Gurbani: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: satasangat mil dhiaae too har har bahurr na aavan jaan | rahaau |
English: Join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and meditate on the Lord, Har, Har; you shall not have to come and go in reincarnation again. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਗੁਣ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape hee gun varatadaa piaaraa aape hee paravaan |
English: The Beloved Himself pervades His Glorious Praises, and He Himself approves them.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਸਚੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape bakhas karaaeidaa piaaraa aape sach neesaan |
English: The Beloved Himself grants His forgiveness, and He Himself bestows the Insignia of Truth.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਫੁਰਮਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aape hukam varatadaa piaaraa aape hee furamaan |2|
English: The Beloved Himself obeys His Will, and He Himself issues His Command. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਦਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape bhagat bhanddaar hai piaaraa aape devai daan |
English: The Beloved Himself is the treasure of devotion; He Himself gives His gifts.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪਿ ਦਿਵਾਵੈ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape sev karaaeidaa piaaraa aap divaavai maan |
English: The Beloved Himself commits some to His service, and He Himself blesses them with honor.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aape taarree laaeidaa piaaraa aape gunee nidhaan |3|
English: The Beloved Himself is absorbed in Samaadhi; He Himself is the treasure of excellence. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਵਡਾ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਪਰਧਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape vaddaa aap hai piaaraa aape hee paradhaan |
English: The Beloved Himself is the greatest; He Himself is supreme.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਤੁਲੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape keemat paaeidaa piaaraa aape tul paravaan |
English: The Beloved Himself appraises the value; He Himself is the scale, and the weights.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਤੁਲਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੫॥
Transliteration: aape atul tulaaeidaa piaaraa jan naanak sad kurabaan |4|5|
English: The Beloved Himself is unweighable - He weighs Himself; servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||4||5||

[Ang 606 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 4 |
English: Sorat'h, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਉਮਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape sevaa laaeidaa piaaraa aape bhagat umaahaa |
English: The Beloved Himself commits some to His service; He Himself blesses them with the joy of devotional worship.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape gun gaavaaeidaa piaaraa aape sabad samaahaa |
English: The Beloved Himself causes us to sing His Glorious Praises; He Himself is absorbed in the Word of His Shabad.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਲੇਖਣਿ ਆਪਿ ਲਿਖਾਰੀ ਆਪੇ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਹਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aape lekhan aap likhaaree aape lekh likhaahaa |1|
English: He Himself is the pen, and He Himself is the scribe; He Himself inscribes His inscription. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਓਮਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: mere man jap raam naam omaahaa |
English: O my mind, joyfully chant the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਅਨਦੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਲੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਹਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: anadin anad hovai vaddabhaagee lai gur poorai har laahaa | rahaau |
English: Those very fortunate ones are in ecstasy night and day; through the Perfect Guru, they obtain the profit of the Lord's Name. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਗੋਪੀ ਕਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਬਨਿ ਆਪੇ ਗਊ ਚਰਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape gopee kaan hai piaaraa ban aape gaoo charaahaa |
English: The Beloved Himself is the milk-maid and Krishna; He Himself herds the cows in the woods.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਵਲ ਸੁੰਦਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਵੰਸੁ ਵਜਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape saaval sundaraa piaaraa aape vans vajaahaa |
English: The Beloved Himself is the blue-skinned, handsome one; He Himself plays on His flute.

Gurbani: ਕੁਵਲੀਆਪੀੜੁ ਆਪਿ ਮਰਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਬਾਲਕ ਰੂਪਿ ਪਚਾਹਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kuvaleeaapeerr aap maraaeidaa piaaraa kar baalak roop pachaahaa |2|
English: The Beloved Himself took the form of a child, and destroyed Kuwalia-peer, the mad elephant. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਅਖਾੜਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਚੋਜਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: aap akhaarraa paaeidaa piaaraa kar vekhai aap chojaahaa |
English: The Beloved Himself sets the stage; He performs the plays, and He Himself watches them.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਬਾਲਕ ਰੂਪ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਚੰਡੂਰੁ ਕੰਸੁ ਕੇਸੁ ਮਾਰਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: kar baalak roop upaaeidaa piaaraa chanddoor kans kes maaraahaa |
English: The Beloved Himself assumed the form of the child, and killed the demons Chandoor, Kansa and Kaysee.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਬਲੁ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਬਲੁ ਭੰਨੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧਾਹਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aape hee bal aap hai piaaraa bal bhanai moorakh mugadhaahaa |3|
English: The Beloved Himself, by Himself, is the embodiment of power; He shatters the power of the fools and idiots. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਵਸਿ ਆਪੇ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਹਥਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabh aape jagat upaaeidaa piaaraa vas aape jugat hathaahaa |
English: The Beloved Himself created the whole world. In His hands He holds the power of the ages.

Gurbani: ਗਲਿ ਜੇਵੜੀ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਖਿੰਚੈ ਤਿਉ ਜਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: gal jevarree aape paaeidaa piaaraa jiau prabh khinchai tiau jaahaa |
English: The Beloved Himself puts the chains around their necks; as God pulls them, must they go.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਗਰਬੈ ਸੋ ਪਚਸੀ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ॥੪॥੬॥
Transliteration: jo garabai so pachasee piaare jap naanak bhagat samaahaa |4|6|
English: Whoever harbors pride shall be destroyed, O Beloved; meditating on the Lord, Nanak is absorbed in devotional worship. ||4||6||

[Ang 607 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਃ ੪ ਦੁਤੁਕੇ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 4 dutuke |
English: Sorat'h, Fourth Mehl, Dho-Thukay:

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਨਮ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: anik janam vichhurre dukh paaeaa manamukh karam karai ahankaaree |
English: Separated from the Lord for countless lifetimes, the self-willed manmukh suffers in pain, engaged in acts of egotism.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਪਰਸਤ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saadhoo parasat hee prabh paaeaa gobid saran tumaaree |1|
English: Beholding the Holy Saint, I found God; O Lord of the Universe, I seek Your Sanctuary. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੋਬਿਦ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: gobid preet lagee at piaaree |
English: The Love of God is very dear to me.

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਸਤਸੰਗ ਭਏ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jab satasang bhe saadhoo jan hiradai miliaa saant muraaree | rahaau |
English: When I joined the Sat Sangat, the Company of the Holy People, the Lord, the embodiment of peace, came into my heart. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਵਸਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਬੁਝਹਿ ਗਵਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: too hiradai gupat vaseh din raatee teraa bhaau na bujheh gavaaree |
English: You dwell, hidden, within my heart day and night, Lord; but the poor fools do not understand Your Love.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: satigur purakh miliaa prabh pragattiaa gun gaavai gun veechaaree |2|
English: Meeting with the Almighty True Guru, God was revealed to me; I sing His Glorious Praises, and reflect upon His Glories. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਭਇਆ ਸਾਤਿ ਆਈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh pragaas bheaa saat aaee duramat budh nivaaree |
English: As Gurmukh, I have become enlightened; peace has come, and evil-mindedness has been dispelled from my mind.

Gurbani: ਆਤਮ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਚੀਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aatam braham cheen sukh paaeaa satasangat purakh tumaaree |3|
English: Understanding the relationship of the individual soul with God, I have found peace, in Your Sat Sangat, Your True Congregation, O Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪੁਰਖੈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਈ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: purakhai purakh miliaa gur paaeaa jin kau kirapaa bhee tumaaree |
English: Those who are blessed by Your Kind Mercy, meet the Almighty Lord, and find the Guru.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੭॥
Transliteration: naanak atul sehaj sukh paaeaa anadin jaagat rahai banavaaree |4|7|
English: Nanak has found the immeasurable, celestial peace; night and day, he remains awake to the Lord, the Master of the Forest of the Universe. ||4||7||

[Ang 607 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 4 |
English: Sorat'h, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har siau preet antar man bedhiaa har bin rehan na jaaee |
English: The inner depths of my mind are pierced by love for the Lord; I cannot live without the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਨੀਰੈ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਤਿਉ ਨਾਮੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jiau machhulee bin neerai binasai tiau naamai bin mar jaaee |1|
English: Just as the fish dies without water, I die without the Lord's Name. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਲੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: mere prabh kirapaa jal devahu har naaee |
English: O my God, please bless me with the water of Your Name.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਗਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hau antar naam mangaa din raatee naame hee saant paaee | rahaau |
English: I beg for Your Name, deep within myself, day and night; through the Name, I find peace. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕੁ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਿਲਲਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਪਿਆਸ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jiau chaatrik jal bin bilalaavai bin jal piaas na jaaee |
English: The song-bird cries out for lack of water - without water, its thirst cannot be quenched.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿਆ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: guramukh jal paavai sukh sahaje hariaa bhaae subhaaee |2|
English: The Gurmukh obtains the water of celestial bliss, and is rejuvenated, blossoming forth through the blessed Love of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭੂਖੇ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਡੋਲਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh bhookhe deh dis ddoleh bin naavai dukh paaee |
English: The self-willed manmukhs are hungry, wandering around in the ten directions; without the Name, they suffer in pain.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਆਵੈ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: janam marai fir jonee aavai darageh milai sajaaee |3|
English: They are born, only to die, and enter into reincarnation again; in the Court of the Lord, they are punished. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kripaa kareh taa har gun gaavah har ras antar paaee |
English: But if the Lord shows His Mercy, then one comes to sing His Glorious Praises; deep within the nucleus of his own self, he finds the sublime essence of the Lord's elixir.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੪॥੮॥
Transliteration: naanak deen deaal bhe hai trisanaa sabad bujhaaee |4|8|
English: The Lord has become Merciful to meek Nanak, and through the Word of the Shabad, his desires are quenched. ||4||8||

[Ang 607 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਪੰਚਪਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 4 panchapadaa |
English: Sorat'h, Fourth Mehl, Panch-Padhay:
