Gurbani: ਅਚਰੁ ਚਰੈ ਤਾ ਸਿਧਿ ਹੋਈ ਸਿਧੀ ਤੇ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: achar charai taa sidh hoee sidhee te budh paaee |
English: If one eats the uneatable, then he becomes a Siddha, a being of perfect spirituality; through this perfection, he obtains wisdom.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੇ ਸਰ ਲਾਗੇ ਤਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਤਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਾਟਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: prem ke sar laage tan bheetar taa bhram kaattiaa jaaee |1|
English: When the arrow of the Lord's Love pierces his body, then his doubt is eradicated. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਦੇਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: mere gobid apune jan kau dehi vaddiaaee |
English: O my Lord of the Universe, please bless Your humble servant with glory.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਹੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: guramat raam naam paragaasahu sadaa rahahu saranaaee | rahaau |
English: Under Guru's Instructions, enlighten me with the Lord's Name, that I may dwell forever in Your Sanctuary. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਮਨ ਮੂਰਖ ਚੇਤਿ ਅਜਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: eihu sansaar sabh aavan jaanaa man moorakh chet ajaanaa |
English: This whole world is engrossed in coming and going; O my foolish and ignorant mind, be mindful of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har jeeo kripaa karahu gur melahu taa har naam samaanaa |2|
English: O Dear Lord, please, take pity upon me, and unite me with the Guru, that I may merge in the Lord's Name. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਵਥੁ ਸੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਸੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jis kee vath soee prabh jaanai jis no dee su paae |
English: Only one who has it knows God; he alone has it, to whom God has given it

Gurbani: ਵਸਤੁ ਅਨੂਪ ਅਤਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: vasat anoop at agam agochar gur pooraa alakh lakhaae |3|
English: - so very beautiful, unapproachable and unfathomable. Through the Perfect Guru, the unknowable is known. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹ ਚਾਖੀ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੂੰਗੇ ਕੀ ਮਿਠਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: jin ih chaakhee soee jaanai goonge kee mitthiaaee |
English: Only one who tastes it knows it, like the mute, who tastes the sweet candy, but cannot speak of it.

Gurbani: ਰਤਨੁ ਲੁਕਾਇਆ ਲੂਕੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਰਖੈ ਲੁਕਾਈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: ratan lukaaeaa lookai naahee je ko rakhai lukaaee |4|
English: The jewel is concealed, but it is not concealed, even though one may try to conceal it. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਤੂ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh teraa too antarajaamee too sabhanaa kaa prabh soee |
English: Everything is Yours, O Inner-knower, Searcher of hearts; You are the Lord God of all.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੫॥੯॥
Transliteration: jis no daat kareh so paae jan naanak avar na koee |5|9|
English: He alone receives the gift, unto whom You give it; O servant Nanak, there is no one else. ||5||9||

[Ang 608 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਤਿਤੁਕੇ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 ghar 1 tituke |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl, First House, Thi-Thukay:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਕਿਸੁ ਹਉ ਜਾਚੀ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਰਾਧੀ ਜਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੋਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: kis hau jaachee kis aaraadhee jaa sabh ko keetaa hosee |
English: Who should I ask? Who should I worship? All were created by Him.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਵਡਾ ਵਡੇਰਾ ਸੋ ਸੋ ਖਾਕੂ ਰਲਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: jo jo deesai vaddaa vadderaa so so khaakoo ralasee |
English: Whoever appears to be the greatest of the great, shall ultimately be mixed with the dust.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਭਵ ਖੰਡਨੁ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਦੇਸੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: nirbhau nirankaar bhav khanddan sabh sukh nav nidh desee |1|
English: The Fearless, Formless Lord, the Destroyer of Fear bestows all comforts, and the nine treasures. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਤੀ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: har jeeo teree daatee raajaa |
English: O Dear Lord, Your gifts alone satisfy me.

Gurbani: ਮਾਣਸੁ ਬਪੁੜਾ ਕਿਆ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਕਿਆ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਮੁਹਤਾਜਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: maanas bapurraa kiaa saalaahee kiaa tis kaa muhataajaa | rahaau |
English: Why should I praise the poor helpless man? Why should I feel subservient to him? ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਭੂਖ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jin har dhiaaeaa sabh kichh tis kaa tis kee bhookh gavaaee |
English: All things come to one who meditates on the Lord; the Lord satisfies his hunger.

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਧਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੈ ਨਿਖੁਟਿ ਨ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa dhan deea sukhadaatai nikhutt na kab hee jaaee |
English: The Lord, the Giver of peace, bestows such wealth, that it can never be exhausted.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: anad bheaa sukh sehaj samaane satigur mel milaaee |2|
English: I am in ecstasy, absorbed in celestial peace; the True Guru has united me in His Union. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਰਾਧਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: man naam jap naam aaraadh anadin naam vakhaanee |
English: O mind, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord; worship the Naam, night and day, and recite the Naam.

Gurbani: ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ ਸਭ ਚੂਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ਜਮਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: aupades sun saadh santan kaa sabh chookee kaan jamaanee |
English: Listen to the Teachings of the Holy Saints, and all fear of death will be dispelled.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੇ ਲਾਗੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jin kau kripaal hoaa prabh meraa se laage gur kee baanee |3|
English: Those blessed by God's Grace are attached to the Word of the Guru's Bani. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਉਣੁ ਕਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: keemat kaun karai prabh teree too sarab jeea deaalaa |
English: Who can estimate Your worth, God? You are kind and compassionate to all beings.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਵਰਤੈ ਕਿਆ ਹਮ ਬਾਲ ਗੁਪਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh keetaa teraa varatai kiaa ham baal gupaalaa |
English: Everything which You do, prevails; I am just a poor child - what can I do?

Gurbani: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਨੁ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਜਿਉ ਪਿਤਾ ਪੂਤ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: raakh lehu naanak jan tumaraa jiau pitaa poot kirapaalaa |4|1|
English: Protect and preserve Your servant Nanak; be kind to him, like a father to his son. ||4||1||

[Ang 608 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚੌਤੁਕੇ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 ghar 1 chauatuke |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl, First House, Chau-Thukay:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਧਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: gur govind salaaheeai bhaaee man tan hiradai dhaar |
English: Praise the Guru, and the Lord of the Universe, O Siblings of Destiny; enshrine Him in your mind, body and heart.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਭਾਈ ਏਹਾ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: saachaa saahib man vasai bhaaee ehaa karanee saar |
English: Let the True Lord and Master abide in your mind, O Siblings of Destiny; this is the most excellent way of life.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਭਾਈ ਸੇ ਤਨ ਹੋਏ ਛਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: jit tan naam na aoopajai bhaaee se tan hoe chhaar |
English: Those bodies, in which the Name of the Lord does not well up, O Siblings of Destiny - those bodies are reduced to ashes.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਜਿਨ ਏਕੰਕਾਰ ਅਧਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saadhasangat kau vaariaa bhaaee jin ekankaar adhaar |1|
English: I am a sacrifice to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Siblings of Destiny; they take the Support of the One and Only Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਸਚੁ ਅਰਾਧਣਾ ਭਾਈ ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: soee sach araadhanaa bhaaee jis te sabh kichh hoe |
English: So worship and adore that True Lord, O Siblings of Destiny; He alone does everything.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਜਾਣਾਇਆ ਭਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur poorai jaanaaeaa bhaaee tis bin avar na koe | rahaau |
English: The Perfect Guru has taught me, O Siblings of Destiny, that without Him, there is no other at all. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੇ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਭਾਈ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਗਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: naam vihoone pach mue bhaaee ganat na jaae ganee |
English: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, they putrefy and die, O Siblings of Destiny; their numbers cannot be counted.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਚ ਸੋਚ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਭਾਈ ਸਾਚਾ ਅਗਮ ਧਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: vin sach soch na paaeeai bhaaee saachaa agam dhanee |
English: Without Truth, purity cannot be achieved, O Siblings of Destiny; the Lord is true and unfathomable.

Gurbani: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਭਾਈ ਝੂਠੀ ਦੁਨੀ ਮਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: aavan jaan na chukee bhaaee jhootthee dunee manee |
English: Coming and going do not end, O Siblings of Destiny; pride in worldly valuables is false.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਉਧਾਰਦਾ ਭਾਈ ਦੇ ਨਾਵੈ ਏਕ ਕਣੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: guramukh kott udhaaradaa bhaaee de naavai ek kanee |2|
English: The Gurmukh saves millions of people, O Siblings of Destiny, blessing them with even a particle of the Name. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਸੋਧਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sinmrit saasat sodhiaa bhaaee vin satigur bharam na jaae |
English: I have searched through the Simritees and the Shaastras, O Siblings of Destiny - without the True Guru, doubt does not depart.

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਕਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: anik karam kar thaakiaa bhaaee fir fir bandhan paae |
English: They are so tired of performing their many deeds, O Siblings of Destiny, but they fall into bondage again and again.

Gurbani: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਸੋਧੀਆ ਭਾਈ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: chaare kunddaa sodheea bhaaee vin satigur naahee jaae |
English: I have searched in the four directions, O Siblings of Destiny, but without the True Guru, there is no place at all.

Gurbani: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਭਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: vaddabhaagee gur paaeaa bhaaee har har naam dhiaae |3|
English: By great good fortune, I found the Guru, O Siblings of Destiny, and I meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਭਾਈ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਾਚੇ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sach sadaa hai niramalaa bhaaee niramal saache soe |
English: The Truth is forever pure, O Siblings of Destiny; those who are true are pure.

Gurbani: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਭਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: nadar kare jis aapanee bhaaee tis paraapat hoe |
English: When the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, O Siblings of Destiny, then one obtains Him.

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਭਾਈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: kott madhe jan paaeeai bhaaee viralaa koee koe |
English: Among millions, O Siblings of Destiny, hardly one humble servant of the Lord is found.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਤਾ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak rataa sach naam bhaaee sun man tan niramal hoe |4|2|
English: Nanak is imbued with the True Name, O Siblings of Destiny; hearing it, the mind and body become immaculately pure. ||4||2||

[Ang 609 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਤੁਕੇ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 dutuke |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl, Dho-Thukay:

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਲਉ ਭਾਉ ਅਭਾਉ ਇਹੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਤਉ ਲਉ ਮਿਲਣੁ ਦੂਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jau lau bhaau abhaau ihu maanai tau lau milan dooraaee |
English: As long as this person believes in love and hate, it is difficult for him to meet the Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਨ ਆਪਨਾ ਕਰਤ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ਤਉ ਲਉ ਬੀਚੁ ਬਿਖਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aan aapanaa karat beechaaraa tau lau beech bikhaaee |1|
English: As long as he discriminates between himself and others, he will distance himself from the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਾਧਵੇ ਐਸੀ ਦੇਹੁ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: maadhave aisee dehu bujhaaee |
English: O Lord, grant me such understanding,

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਉ ਸਾਧ ਗਹਉ ਓਟ ਚਰਨਾ ਨਹ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਮੁਹਤੁ ਚਸਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sevau saadh ghau ott charanaa neh bisarai muhat chasaaee | rahaau |
English: that I might serve the Holy Saints, and seek the protection of their feet, and not forget them, for a moment, even an instant. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੁਗਧ ਅਚੇਤ ਚੰਚਲ ਚਿਤ ਤੁਮ ਐਸੀ ਰਿਦੈ ਨ ਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: re man mugadh achet chanchal chit tum aisee ridai na aaee |
English: O foolish, thoughtless and fickle mind, such understanding did not come into your heart.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਆਨ ਤੂ ਰਚਿਆ ਉਰਝਿਓ ਸੰਗਿ ਬੈਰਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: praanapat tiaag aan too rachiaa urajhio sang bairaaee |2|
English: Renouncing the Lord of Life, you have become engrossed in other things, and you are involved with your enemies. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੋਗੁ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਥਾਪੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sog na biaapai aap na thaapai saadhasangat budh paaee |
English: Sorrow does not afflict one who does not harbor self-conceit; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I have attained this understanding.

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤ ਕਾ ਬਕਨਾ ਇਉ ਜਾਨਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਪਵਨੁ ਝੁਲਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: saakat kaa bakanaa iau jaanau jaise pavan jhulaaee |3|
English: Know that the babbling of the faithless cynic is like wind passing by. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰਾਧ ਅਛਾਦਿਓ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kott paraadh achhaadio ihu man kahanaa kachhoo na jaaee |
English: This mind is inundated by millions of sins - what can I say?

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਆਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਭੁ ਲੇਖਾ ਰਖਹੁ ਉਠਾਈ ॥੪॥੩॥
Transliteration: jan naanak deen saran aaeo prabh sabh lekhaa rakhahu utthaaee |4|3|
English: Nanak, Your humble servant has come to Your Sanctuary, God; please, erase all his accounts. ||4||3||

[Ang 609 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਲੋਕ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਨਬੰਧੇਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: putr kalatr lok grih banitaa maaeaa sanabandhehee |
English: Children, spouses, men and women in one's household, are all bound by Maya.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਬਾਰ ਕੋ ਖਰਾ ਨ ਹੋਸੀ ਸਭ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਅਸਨੇਹੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ant kee baar ko kharaa na hosee sabh mithiaa asanehee |1|
English: At the very last moment, none of them shall stand by you; their love is totally false. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰੇ ਨਰ ਕਾਹੇ ਪਪੋਰਹੁ ਦੇਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: re nar kaahe paporahu dehee |
English: O man, why do you pamper your body so?

Gurbani: ਊਡਿ ਜਾਇਗੋ ਧੂਮੁ ਬਾਦਰੋ ਇਕੁ ਭਾਜਹੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਨੇਹੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aoodd jaaeigo dhoom baadaro ik bhaajahu raam sanehee | rahaau |
English: It shall disperse like a cloud of smoke; vibrate upon the One, the Beloved Lord. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੀਨਿ ਸੰਙਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਹੀ ਕੀਨੀ ਜਲ ਕੂਕਰ ਭਸਮੇਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: teen sangiaa kar dehee keenee jal kookar bhasamehee |
English: There are three ways in which the body can be consumed - it can be thrown into water, given to the dogs, or cremated to ashes.

Gurbani: ਹੋਇ ਆਮਰੋ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ ਬੈਠਾ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਬਿਸਰੋਹੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: hoe aamaro grih meh baitthaa karan kaaran bisarohee |2|
English: He considers himself to be immortal; he sits in his home, and forgets the Lord, the Cause of causes. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਣੀਏ ਸਾਜੇ ਕਾਚੈ ਤਾਗਿ ਪਰੋਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: anik bhaat kar manee saaje kaachai taag parohee |
English: In various ways, the Lord has fashioned the beads, and strung them on a slender thread.

Gurbani: ਤੂਟਿ ਜਾਇਗੋ ਸੂਤੁ ਬਾਪੁਰੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਛੁਤੋਹੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: toott jaaeigo soot baapure fir paachhai pachhutohee |3|
English: The thread shall break, O wretched man, and then, you shall repent and regret. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਤੁਮ ਸਿਰਜੇ ਸਿਰਜਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨੇਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jin tum siraje siraj savaare tis dhiaavahu din rainehee |
English: He created you, and after creating you, He adorned you - meditate on Him day and night.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਓਟ ਗਹੇਹੀ ॥੪॥੪॥
Transliteration: jan naanak prabh kirapaa dhaaree mai satigur ott gahehee |4|4|
English: God has showered His Mercy upon servant Nanak; I hold tight to the Support of the True Guru. ||4||4||

[Ang 609 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮਨਹਿ ਭਇਆ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur pooraa bhettio vaddabhaagee maneh bheaa paragaasaa |
English: I met the True Guru, by great good fortune, and my mind has been enlightened.

Gurbani: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਹੁਚਨਹਾਰਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕਾ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: koe na pahuchanahaaraa doojaa apune saahib kaa bharavaasaa |1|
English: No one else can equal me, because I have the loving support of my Lord and Master. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: apune satigur kai balihaarai |
English: I am a sacrifice to my True Guru.

Gurbani: ਆਗੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਛੈ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aagai sukh paachhai sukh sahajaa ghar aanand hamaarai | rahaau |
English: I am at peace in this world, and I shall be in celestial peace in the next; my home is filled with bliss. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਾ ਸੋਈ ਖਸਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: antarajaamee karanaihaaraa soee khasam hamaaraa |
English: He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, the Creator, my Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੇ ਇਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਆਧਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: nirbhau bhe gur charanee laage ik raam naam aadhaaraa |2|
English: I have become fearless, attached to the Guru's feet; I take the Support of the Name of the One Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਵਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: safal darasan akaal moorat prabh hai bhee hovanahaaraa |
English: Fruitful is the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; the Form of God is deathless; He is and shall always be.

Gurbani: ਕੰਠਿ ਲਗਾਇ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਜਨ ਰਾਖੇ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kantth lagaae apune jan raakhe apunee preet piaaraa |3|
English: He hugs His humble servants close, and protects and preserves them; their love for Him is sweet to Him. ||3||

Gurbani: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਅਚਰਜ ਸੋਭਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਆਇਆ ਰਾਸੇ ॥
Transliteration: vaddee vaddiaaee acharaj sobhaa kaaraj aaeaa raase |
English: Great is His glorious greatness, and wondrous is His magnificence; through Him, all affairs are resolved.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ॥੪॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak kau gur pooraa bhettio sagale dookh binaase |4|5|
English: Nanak has met with the Perfect Guru; all his sorrows have been dispelled. ||4||5||

[Ang 610 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੁਖੀਏ ਕਉ ਪੇਖੈ ਸਭ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਰੋਗੀ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸਭ ਰੋਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: sukhee kau pekhai sabh sukheea rogee kai bhaanai sabh rogee |
English: To the happy person, everyone seems happy; to the sick person, everyone seems sick.

Gurbani: ਕਰਣ ਕਰਾਵਨਹਾਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਪਨ ਹਾਥਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: karan karaavanahaar suaamee aapan haath sanjogee |1|
English: The Lord and Master acts, and causes us to act; union is in His Hands. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: man mere jin apunaa bharam gavaataa |
English: O my mind, no one appears to be mistaken, to one who has dispelled his own doubts;

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਭੂਲਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਗਲੋ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tis kai bhaanai koe na bhoolaa jin sagalo braham pachhaataa | rahaau |
English: He realizes that everyone is God. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਓਹੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਗਲੀ ਠਾਂਢੀ ॥
Transliteration: sant sang jaa kaa man seetal ohu jaanai sagalee tthaandtee |
English: One whose mind is comforted in the Society of the Saints, believes that all are joyful.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗਿ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਆਪਿਤ ਓਹੁ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਤੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: haumai rog jaa kaa man biaapit ohu janam marai bilalaatee |2|
English: One whose mind is afflicted by the disease of egotism, cries out in birth and death. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਨੇਤ੍ਰੀ ਪੜਿਆ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਸਰਬ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: giaan anjan jaa kee netree parriaa taa kau sarab pragaasaa |
English: Everything is clear to one whose eyes are blessed with the ointment of spiritual wisdom.

Gurbani: ਅਗਿਆਨਿ ਅੰਧੇਰੈ ਸੂਝਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਭਰਮਾਤਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: agiaan andherai soojhas naahee bahurr bahurr bharamaataa |3|
English: In the darkness of spiritual ignorance, he sees nothing at all; he wanders around in reincarnation, over and over again. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਇਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: sun benantee suaamee apune naanak ihu sukh maagai |
English: Hear my prayer, O Lord and Master; Nanak begs for this happiness:

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਾਧੂ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਤਹ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੪॥੬॥
Transliteration: jeh keeratan teraa saadhoo gaaveh teh meraa man laagai |4|6|
English: whereever Your Holy Saints sing the Kirtan of Your Praises, let my mind be attached to that place. ||4||6||

[Ang 610 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: tan santan kaa dhan santan kaa man santan kaa keea |
English: My body belongs to the Saints, my wealth belongs to the Saints, and my mind belongs to the Saints.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਸਰਬ ਕੁਸਲ ਤਬ ਥੀਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sant prasaad har naam dhiaaeaa sarab kusal tab theea |1|
English: By the Grace of the Saints, I meditate on the Lord's Name, and then, all comforts come to me. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦਾਤਾ ਬੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: santan bin avar na daataa beea |
English: Without the Saints, there are no other givers.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਸੋ ਪਾਰਗਰਾਮੀ ਕੀਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo jo saran parai saadhoo kee so paaragaraamee keea | rahaau |
English: Whoever takes to the Sanctuary of the Holy Saints, is carried across. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰਾਧ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਰਸਿ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: kott paraadh mitteh jan sevaa har keeratan ras gaaeeai |
English: Millions of sins are erased by serving the humble Saints, and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord with love.

Gurbani: ਈਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਆਗੈ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: eehaa sukh aagai mukh aoojal jan kaa sang vaddabhaagee paaeeai |2|
English: One finds peace in this world, and one's face is radiant in the next world, by associating with the humble Saints, through great good fortune. ||2||

Gurbani: ਰਸਨਾ ਏਕ ਅਨੇਕ ਗੁਣ ਪੂਰਨ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਕੇਤਕ ਉਪਮਾ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: rasanaa ek anek gun pooran jan kee ketak upamaa kaheeai |
English: I have only one tongue, and the Lord's humble servant is filled with countless virtues; how can I sing his praises?

Gurbani: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਸਦ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: agam agochar sad abinaasee saran santan kee laheeai |3|
English: The inaccessible, unapproachable and eternally unchanging Lord is obtained in the Sanctuary of the Saints. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਨੀਚ ਅਨਾਥ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਓਟ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਆਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: niragun neech anaath aparaadhee ott santan kee aahee |
English: I am worthless, lowly, without friends or support, and full of sins; I long for the Shelter of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਬੂਡਤ ਮੋਹ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੇਹੁ ਨਿਬਾਹੀ ॥੪॥੭॥
Transliteration: booddat moh grih andh koop meh naanak lehu nibaahee |4|7|
English: I am drowning in the deep, dark pit of household attachments - please save me, Lord! ||4||7||

[Ang 610 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 ghar 1 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl, First House:

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਿਆ ਤੂ ਕਰਤੇ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਤੈਂ ਆਸ ਪੁਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai hiradai vasiaa too karate taa kee tain aas pujaaee |
English: O Creator Lord, You fulfill the desires of those, within whose heart You abide.

Gurbani: ਦਾਸ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਉ ਤੂ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਚਰਣ ਧੂਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: daas apune kau too visareh naahee charan dhoor man bhaaee |1|
English: Your slaves do not forget You; the dust of Your feet is pleasing to their minds. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੀ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: teree akath kathaa kathan na jaaee |
English: Your Unspoken Speech cannot be spoken.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਬਡਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gun nidhaan sukhadaate suaamee sabh te aooch baddaaee | rahaau |
English: O treasure of excellence, Giver of peace, Lord and Master, Your greatness is the highest of all. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸੋ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਤ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਜੈਸੀ ਤੁਮ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: so so karam karat hai praanee jaisee tum likh paaee |
English: The mortal does those deeds, and those alone, which You ordained by destiny.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਸੇਵਾ ਦੀਨੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਅਘਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sevak kau tum sevaa deenee darasan dekh aghaaee |2|
English: Your servant, whom You bless with Your service, is satisfied and fulfilled, beholding the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਸਮਾਨੇ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sarab nirantar tumeh samaane jaa kau tudh aap bujhaaee |
English: You are contained in all, but he alone realizes this, whom You bless with understanding.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਮਿਟਿਓ ਅਗਿਆਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਏ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur parasaad mittio agiaanaa pragatt bhe sabh tthaaee |3|
English: By Guru's Grace, his spiritual ignorance is dispelled, and he is respected everywhere. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸੋਈ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਸੋਈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: soee giaanee soee dhiaanee soee purakh subhaaee |
English: He alone is spiritually enlightened, he alone is a meditator, and he alone is a man of good nature.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਬਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੪॥੮॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak jis bhe deaalaa taa kau man te bisar na jaaee |4|8|
English: Says Nanak, one unto whom the Lord becomes Merciful, does not forget the Lord from his mind. ||4||8||

[Ang 610 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪੀ ਕਬ ਊਚੇ ਕਬ ਨੀਚੇ ॥
Transliteration: sagal samagree mohi viaapee kab aooche kab neeche |
English: The whole creation is engrossed in emotional attachment; sometimes, one is high, and at other times, low.

Gurbani: ਸੁਧੁ ਨ ਹੋਈਐ ਕਾਹੂ ਜਤਨਾ ਓੜਕਿ ਕੋ ਨ ਪਹੂਚੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sudh na hoeeai kaahoo jatanaa orrak ko na pahooche |1|
English: No one can be purified by any rituals or devices; they cannot reach their goal. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸਾਧ ਸਰਣਿ ਛੁਟਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: mere man saadh saran chhuttakaaraa |
English: O my mind, emancipation is attained in the Sanctuary of the Holy Saints.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਰਹਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਤ ਬਾਰੋ ਬਾਰਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bin gur poore janam maran na rahee fir aavat baaro baaraa | rahaau |
English: Without the Perfect Guru, births and deaths do not cease, and one comes and goes, over and over again. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਜੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਭੁਲਾਵਾ ਕਹੀਅਤ ਤਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਉਰਝਿਓ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: ohu ju bharam bhulaavaa kaheeat tin meh urajhio sagal sansaaraa |
English: The whole world is entangled in what is called the delusion of doubt.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਭਗਤੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਾ ਸਰਬ ਥੋਕ ਤੇ ਨਿਆਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: pooran bhagat purakh suaamee kaa sarab thok te niaaraa |2|
English: The perfect devotee of the Primal Lord God remains detached from everything. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਾਹੂ ਬਾਤੈ ਏਹੁ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: nindau naahee kaahoo baatai ehu khasam kaa keea |
English: Don't indulge in slander for any reason, for everything is the creation of the Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਾਉ ਲੀਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jaa kau kripaa karee prabh merai mil saadhasangat naau leea |3|
English: One who is blessed with the Mercy of my God, dwells on the Name in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਰਤ ਉਧਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham paramesur satigur sabhanaa karat udhaaraa |
English: The Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, the True Guru, saves all.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਤਰੀਐ ਇਹੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੯॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak gur bin nahee tareeai ihu pooran tat beechaaraa |4|9|
English: Says Nanak, without the Guru, no one crosses over; this is the perfect essence of all contemplation. ||4||9||

[Ang 611 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਤੁ ਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: khojat khojat khoj beechaario raam naam tat saaraa |
English: I have searched and searched and searched, and found that the Lord's Name is the most sublime reality.

Gurbani: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟੇ ਨਿਮਖ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kilabikh kaatte nimakh araadhiaa guramukh paar utaaraa |1|
English: Contemplating it for even an instant, sins are erased; the Gurmukh is carried across and saved. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਹੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: har ras peevahu purakh giaanee |
English: Drink in the sublime essence of the Lord's Name, O man of spiritual wisdom.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਹਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਨੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sun sun mahaa tripat man paavai saadhoo amrit baanee | rahaau |
English: Listening to the Ambrosial Words of the Holy Saints, the mind finds absolute fulfillment and satisfaction. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: mukat bhugat jugat sach paaeeai sarab sukhaa kaa daataa |
English: Liberation, pleasures, and the true way of life are obtained from the Lord, the Giver of all peace.

Gurbani: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: apune daas kau bhagat daan devai pooran purakh bidhaataa |2|
English: The Perfect Lord, the Architect of Destiny, blesses His slave with the gift of devotional worship. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਰਸਨਾ ਗਾਈਐ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: sravanee suneeai rasanaa gaaeeai hiradai dhiaaeeai soee |
English: Hear with your ears, and sing with your tongue, and meditate within your heart on Him.

Gurbani: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: karan kaaran samarath suaamee jaa te brithaa na koee |3|
English: The Lord and Master is all-powerful, the Cause of causes; without Him, there is nothing at all. ||3||

Gurbani: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: vaddai bhaag ratan janam paaeaa karahu kripaa kirapaalaa |
English: By great good fortune, I have obtained the jewel of human life; have mercy on me, O Merciful Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਸਦਾ ਗੋੁਪਾਲਾ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: saadhasang naanak gun gaavai simarai sadaa guopaalaa |4|10|
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and contemplates Him forever in meditation. ||4||10||

[Ang 611 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਭਏ ਅਰੋਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: kar isanaan simar prabh apanaa man tan bhe arogaa |
English: After taking your cleansing bath, remember your God in meditation, and your mind and body shall be free of disease.

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਬਿਘਨ ਲਾਥੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਭਲੇ ਸੰਜੋਗਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kott bighan laathe prabh saranaa pragatte bhale sanjogaa |1|
English: Millions of obstacles are removed, in the Sanctuary of God, and good fortune dawns. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਭਾਖਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: prabh baanee sabad subhaakhiaa |
English: The Word of God's Bani, and His Shabad, are the best utterances.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਹੁ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਪੜਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gaavahu sunahu parrahu nit bhaaee gur poorai too raakhiaa | rahaau |
English: So constantly sing them, listen to them, and read them, O Siblings of Destiny, and the Perfect Guru shall save you. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅਮਿਤਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: saachaa saahib amit vaddaaee bhagat vachhal deaalaa |
English: The glorious greatness of the True Lord is immeasurable; the Merciful Lord is the Lover of His devotees.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਦਾ ਆਇਆ ਆਦਿ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: santaa kee paij rakhadaa aaeaa aad birad pratipaalaa |2|
English: He has preserved the honor of His Saints; from the very beginning of time, His Nature is to cherish them. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਨਿਤ ਭੁੰਚਹੁ ਸਰਬ ਵੇਲਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: har amrit naam bhojan nit bhunchahu sarab velaa mukh paavahu |
English: So eat the Ambrosial Name of the Lord as your food; put it into your mouth at all times.

Gurbani: ਜਰਾ ਮਰਾ ਤਾਪੁ ਸਭੁ ਨਾਠਾ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਵਹੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jaraa maraa taap sabh naatthaa gun gobind nit gaavahu |3|
English: The pains of old age and death shall all depart, when you constantly sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: sunee aradaas suaamee merai sarab kalaa ban aaee |
English: My Lord and Master has heard my prayer, and all my affairs have been resolved.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਈ ਸਗਲੇ ਜੁਗ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੪॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: pragatt bhee sagale jug antar gur naanak kee vaddiaaee |4|11|
English: The glorious greatness of Guru Nanak is manifest, throughout all the ages. ||4||11||

[Ang 611 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 ghar 2 chaupade |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl, Second House, Chau-Padhay:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਏਕਸ ਕੇ ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਰ ਹਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ek pitaa ekas ke ham baarik too meraa gur haaee |
English: The One God is our father; we are the children of the One God. You are our Guru.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਮੀਤਾ ਜੀਉ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sun meetaa jeeo hamaaraa bal bal jaasee har darasan dehu dikhaaee |1|
English: Listen, friends: my soul is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to You; O Lord, reveal to me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਮੀਤਾ ਧੂਰੀ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sun meetaa dhooree kau bal jaaee |
English: Listen, friends: I am a sacrifice to the dust of Your feet.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: eihu man teraa bhaaee | rahaau |
English: This mind is yours, O Siblings of Destiny. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪਾਵ ਮਲੋਵਾ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਧੋਵਾ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤੈ ਕੂ ਦੇਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: paav malovaa mal mal dhovaa ihu man tai koo desaa |
English: I wash your feet, I massage and clean them; I give this mind to you.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਮੀਤਾ ਹਉ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਆਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਉ ਦੇਹੁ ਉਪਦੇਸਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sun meetaa hau teree saranaaee aaeaa prabh milau dehu upadesaa |2|
English: Listen, friends: I have come to Your Sanctuary; teach me, that I might unite with God. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੀਜੈ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਭਲਾ ਮਨਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: maan na keejai saran pareejai karai su bhalaa manaaeeai |
English: Do not be proud; seek His Sanctuary, and accept as good all that He does.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਮੀਤਾ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪੀਜੈ ਇਉ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sun meetaa jeeo pindd sabh tan arapeejai iau darasan har jeeo paaeeai |3|
English: Listen, friends: dedicate your soul, body and your whole being to Him; thus you shall receive the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||3||

Gurbani: ਭਇਓ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹੈ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: bheo anugrahu prasaad santan kai har naamaa hai meetthaa |
English: He has shown mercy to me, by the Grace of the Saints; the Lord's Name is sweet to me.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਸਭੁ ਅਕੁਲ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: jan naanak kau gur kirapaa dhaaree sabh akul niranjan ddeetthaa |4|1|12|
English: The Guru has shown mercy to servant Nanak; I see the casteless, immaculate Lord everywhere. ||4||1||12||

[Ang 612 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kott brahamandd ko tthaakur suaamee sarab jeea kaa daataa re |
English: God is the Lord and Master of millions of universes; He is the Giver of all beings.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੈ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਲੈ ਇਕੁ ਗੁਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਮੂਰਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: pratipaalai nit saar samaalai ik gun nahee moorakh jaataa re |1|
English: He ever cherishes and cares for all beings, but the fool does not appreciate any of His virtues. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਿ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har aaraadh na jaanaa re |
English: I do not know how to worship the Lord in adoration.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har har gur gur karataa re |
English: I can only repeat, "Lord, Lord, Guru, Guru."

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਿਓ ਰਾਮਦਾਸੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har jeeo naam pario raamadaas | rahaau |
English: O Dear Lord, I go by the name of the Lord's slave. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਸਰਬ ਘਟਾ ਭਰਪੂਰੀ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: deen deaal kripaal sukh saagar sarab ghattaa bharapooree re |
English: The Compassionate Lord is Merciful to the meek, the ocean of peace; He fills all hearts.

Gurbani: ਪੇਖਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਸੰਗੇ ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਦੂਰੀ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: pekhat sunat sadaa hai sange mai moorakh jaaniaa dooree re |2|
English: He sees, hears, and is always with me; but I am a fool, and I think that He is far away. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਅੰਤੁ ਹਉ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਵਰਨਉ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਨਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈਸੋ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har biant hau mit kar varnau kiaa jaanaa hoe kaiso re |
English: The Lord is limitless, but I can only describe Him within my limitations; what do I know, about what He is like?

Gurbani: ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਦੇਹੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੋ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: krau benatee satigur apune mai moorakh dehu upadeso re |3|
English: I offer my prayer to my True Guru; I am so foolish - please, teach me! ||3||

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਕੀ ਕੇਤਕ ਬਾਤ ਹੈ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰਾਧੀ ਤਰਿਆ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: mai moorakh kee ketak baat hai kott paraadhee tariaa re |
English: I am just a fool, but millions of sinners just like me have been saved.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਿਨ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਪੇਖਿਆ ਸੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਗਰਭਾਸਿ ਨ ਪਰਿਆ ਰੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: gur naanak jin suniaa pekhiaa se fir garabhaas na pariaa re |4|2|13|
English: Those who have heard, and seen Guru Nanak, do not descend into the womb of reincarnation again. ||4||2||13||

[Ang 612 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਾ ਬਾਤ ਕੋ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅੰਦੇਸਰੋ ਤੇ ਮਿਟੇ ਸਭਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jinaa baat ko bahut andesaro te mitte sabh geaa |
English: Those things, which caused me such anxiety, have all vanished.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜ ਸੈਨ ਅਰੁ ਸੁਖਮਨ ਨਾਰੀ ਊਧ ਕਮਲ ਬਿਗਸਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sehaj sain ar sukhaman naaree aoodh kamal bigaseaa |1|
English: Now, I sleep in peace and tranquility, and my mind is in a state of deep and profound peace; the inverted lotus of my heart has blossomed forth. ||1||

Gurbani: ਦੇਖਹੁ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: dekhahu acharaj bheaa |
English: Behold, a wondrous miracle has happened!

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਉ ਸੁਨਤ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ ਸੋ ਰਿਦੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਦਇਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jih tthaakur kau sunat agaadh bodh so ridai gur deaa | rahaau |
English: That Lord and Master, whose wisdom is said to be unfathomable, has been enshrined within my heart, by the Guru. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੋਇ ਦੂਤ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸੰਤਾਵਤ ਤੇ ਭਇਆਨਕ ਭਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: joe doot mohi bahut santaavat te bheaanak bheaa |
English: The demons which tormented me so much, have themselves become terrified.

Gurbani: ਕਰਹਿ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਰਾਖੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੇ ਹਮ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਨਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kareh benatee raakh tthaakur te ham teree saraneaa |2|
English: They pray: please, save us from your Lord Master; we seek your protection. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕਾ ਖੁਲਿਆ ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤਿ ਤਿਹ ਲਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jeh bhanddaar gobind kaa khuliaa jih praapat tih leaa |
English: When the treasure of the Lord of the Universe is opened, those who are pre-destined, receive it.

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਥਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ek ratan mo kau gur deenaa meraa man tan seetal thiaa |3|
English: The Guru has given me the one jewel, and my mind and body have become peaceful and tranquil. ||3||

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਬੂੰਦ ਗੁਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਦੀਨੋ ਤਾ ਅਟਲੁ ਅਮਰੁ ਨ ਮੁਆ ॥
Transliteration: ek boond gur amrit deeno taa attal amar na muaa |
English: The Guru has blessed me with the one drop of Ambrosial Nectar, and so I have become stable, unmoving and immortal - I shall not die.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਸਉਪੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਲਇਆ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: bhagat bhanddaar gur naanak kau saupe fir lekhaa mool na leaa |4|3|14|
English: The Lord blessed Guru Nanak with the treasure of devotional worship, and did not call him to account again. ||4||3||14||

[Ang 612 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal siau jaa kaa man leenaa se jan tripat aghaaee |
English: Those whose minds are attached to the lotus feet of the Lord - those humble beings are satisfied and fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਅਮੋਲ ਜਿਸੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਨ ਵਸਿਆ ਤੇ ਨਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gun amol jis ridai na vasiaa te nar trisan trikhaaee |1|
English: But those, within whose hearts the priceless virtue does not abide - those men remain thirsty and unsatisfied. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਅਰੋਗ ਅਨਦਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har aaraadhe arog anadaaee |
English: Worshipping the Lord in adoration, one becomes happy, and free of disease.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਸਨੇਹੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਾਖ ਬੇਦਨ ਜਣੁ ਆਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jis no visarai meraa raam sanehee tis laakh bedan jan aaee | rahaau |
English: But one who forgets my Dear Lord - know him to be afflicted with tens of thousands of illnesses. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਜਨ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: jih jan ott gahee prabh teree se sukhee prabh sarane |
English: Those who hold tightly to Your Support, God, are happy in Your Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਨਰ ਬਿਸਰਿਆ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਤੇ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਮਹਿ ਗਨਣੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jih nar bisariaa purakh bidhaataa te dukheea meh ganane |2|
English: But those humble beings who forget the Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny, are counted among the most miserable beings. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਗੁਰ ਮਾਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਤਿਹ ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਰਸੁ ਕਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jih gur maan prabhoo liv laaee tih mahaa anand ras kariaa |
English: One who has faith in the Guru, and who is lovingly attached to God, enjoys the delights of supreme ecstasy.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਬੇਮੁਖਾਈ ਤੇ ਨਰਕ ਘੋਰ ਮਹਿ ਪਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jih prabhoo bisaar gur te bemukhaaee te narak ghor meh pariaa |3|
English: One who forgets God and forsakes the Guru, falls into the most horrible hell. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਲਾਗਾ ਤੈਸੋ ਹੀ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jit ko laaeaa tith hee laagaa taiso hee varataaraa |
English: As the Lord engages someone, so he is engaged, and so does he perform.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹ ਪਕਰੀ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਰਿਦੈ ਭਏ ਮਗਨ ਚਰਨਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: naanak seh pakaree santan kee ridai bhe magan charanaaraa |4|4|15|
English: Nanak has taken to the Shelter of the Saints; his heart is absorbed in the Lord's feet. ||4||4||15||

[Ang 613 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਾਜਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਜਾ ਉਰਝਾਇਓ ਮਾਨਨ ਮਹਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: raajan meh raajaa urajhaaeo maanan meh abhimaanee |
English: As the king is entangled in kingly affairs, and the egotist in his own egotism,

Gurbani: ਲੋਭਨ ਮਹਿ ਲੋਭੀ ਲੋਭਾਇਓ ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਚੇ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: lobhan meh lobhee lobhaaeo tiau har rang rache giaanee |1|
English: and the greedy man is enticed by greed, so is the spiritually enlightened being absorbed in the Love of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਇਹੀ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: har jan kau ihee suhaavai |
English: This is what befits the Lord's servant.

Gurbani: ਪੇਖਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨਿ ਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵੈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: pekh nikatt kar sevaa satigur har keeratan hee tripataavai | rahaau |
English: Beholding the Lord near at hand, he serves the True Guru, and he is satisfied through the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਮਲਨ ਸਿਉ ਅਮਲੀ ਲਪਟਾਇਓ ਭੂਮਨ ਭੂਮਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: amalan siau amalee lapattaaeo bhooman bhoom piaaree |
English: The addict is addicted to his drug, and the landlord is in love with his land.

Gurbani: ਖੀਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਹੈ ਲੀਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਤ ਐਸੇ ਹਿਤਕਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kheer sang baarik hai leenaa prabh sant aise hitakaaree |2|
English: As the baby is attached to his milk, so the Saint is in love with God. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬਿਦਿਆ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਦੁਅੰਸੀ ਰਚਿਆ ਨੈਨ ਦੇਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: bidiaa meh biduansee rachiaa nain dekh sukh paaveh |
English: The scholar is absorbed in scholarship, and the eyes are happy to see.

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੇ ਰਸਨਾ ਸਾਦਿ ਲੁਭਾਨੀ ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jaise rasanaa saad lubhaanee tiau har jan har gun gaaveh |3|
English: As the tongue savors the tastes, so does the humble servant of the Lord sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੀ ਭੂਖ ਤੈਸੀ ਕਾ ਪੂਰਕੁ ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਕਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: jaisee bhookh taisee kaa poorak sagal ghattaa kaa suaamee |
English: As is the hunger, so is the fulfiller; He is the Lord and Master of all hearts.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਆਸ ਲਗੀ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: naanak piaas lagee darasan kee prabh miliaa antarajaamee |4|5|16|
English: Nanak thirsts for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan; he has met God, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||4||5||16||

[Ang 613 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਮੈਲੇ ਤੁਮ ਊਜਲ ਕਰਤੇ ਹਮ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: ham maile tum aoojal karate ham niragun too daataa |
English: We are filthy, and You are immaculate, O Creator Lord; we are worthless, and You are the Great Giver.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਤੁਮ ਚਤੁਰ ਸਿਆਣੇ ਤੂ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਕਾ ਗਿਆਤਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ham moorakh tum chatur siaane too sarab kalaa kaa giaataa |1|
English: We are fools, and You are wise and all-knowing. You are the knower of all things. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਾਧੋ ਹਮ ਐਸੇ ਤੂ ਐਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: maadho ham aise too aisaa |
English: O Lord, this is what we are, and this is what You are.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਤੁਮ ਪਾਪ ਖੰਡਨ ਨੀਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਦੇਸਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ham paapee tum paap khanddan neeko tthaakur desaa | rahaau |
English: We are sinners, and You are the Destroyer of sins. Your abode is so beautiful, O Lord and Master. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਸਭ ਸਾਜੇ ਸਾਜਿ ਨਿਵਾਜੇ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਦੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: tum sabh saaje saaj nivaaje jeeo pindd de praanaa |
English: You fashion all, and having fashioned them, You bless them. You bestow upon them soul, body and the breath of life.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਗੁਨੀਆਰੇ ਗੁਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਤੁਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: niraguneeaare gun nahee koee tum daan dehu miharavaanaa |2|
English: We are worthless - we have no virtue at all; please, bless us with Your gift, O Merciful Lordand Master. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਕਰਹੁ ਭਲਾ ਹਮ ਭਲੋ ਨ ਜਾਨਹ ਤੁਮ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: tum karahu bhalaa ham bhalo na jaanah tum sadaa sadaa deaalaa |
English: You do good for us, but we do not see it as good; You are kind and compassionate, forever and ever.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ਤੁਮ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਬਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tum sukhadaaee purakh bidhaate tum raakhahu apune baalaa |3|
English: You are the Giver of peace, the Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny; please, save us, Your children! ||3||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਅਟਲ ਸੁਲਿਤਾਨ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਜਾਚੈ ॥
Transliteration: tum nidhaan attal sulitaan jeea jant sabh jaachai |
English: You are the treasure, eternal Lord King; all beings and creatures beg of You.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਮ ਇਹੈ ਹਵਾਲਾ ਰਾਖੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਪਾਛੈ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak ham ihai havaalaa raakh santan kai paachhai |4|6|17|
English: Says Nanak, such is our condition; please, Lord, keep us on the Path of the Saints. ||4||6||17||

[Ang 613 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 ghar 2 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl, Second House:

Gurbani: ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਮਹਿ ਆਪਨ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਦੇ ਤਹ ਤੁਮ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: maat garabh meh aapan simaran de teh tum raakhanahaare |
English: In our mother's womb, You blessed us with Your meditative remembrance, and You preserved us there.

Gurbani: ਪਾਵਕ ਸਾਗਰ ਅਥਾਹ ਲਹਰਿ ਮਹਿ ਤਾਰਹੁ ਤਾਰਨਹਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: paavak saagar athaah lehar meh taarahu taaranahaare |1|
English: Through the countless waves of the ocean of fire, please, carry us across and save us, O Savior Lord! ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਾਧੌ ਤੂ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਮੋਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: maadhau too tthaakur sir moraa |
English: O Lord, You are the Master above my head.

Gurbani: ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਤੁਹਾਰੋ ਧੋਰਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: eehaa aoohaa tuhaaro dhoraa | rahaau |
English: Here and hereafter, You alone are my Support. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕੀਤੇ ਕਉ ਮੇਰੈ ਸੰਮਾਨੈ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: keete kau merai samaanai karanahaar trin jaanai |
English: He looks upon the creation like a mountain of gold, and sees the Creator as a blade of grass.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ ਮਾਗਨ ਕਉ ਸਗਲੀ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਨੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: too daataa maagan kau sagalee daan dehi prabh bhaanai |2|
English: You are the Great Giver, and we are all mere beggars; O God, You give gifts according to Your Will. ||2||

Gurbani: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਖਿਨੈ ਮਹਿ ਅਵਰਾ ਅਚਰਜ ਚਲਤ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: khin meh avar khinai meh avaraa acharaj chalat tumaare |
English: In an instant, You are one thing, and in another instant, You are another. Wondrous are Your ways!

Gurbani: ਰੂੜੋ ਗੂੜੋ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੋ ਊਚੌ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: roorro goorro gahir ganbheero aoochau agam apaare |3|
English: You are beautiful, mysterious, profound, unfathomable, lofty, inaccessible and infinite. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਉ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਓ ਤਉ ਸੁਨੀ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang jau tumeh milaaeo tau sunee tumaaree baanee |
English: When You brought me to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, then I heard the Bani of Your Word.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਪੇਖਤ ਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਪੁਰਖ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: anad bheaa pekhat hee naanak prataap purakh nirabaanee |4|7|18|
English: Nanak is in ecstasy, beholding the Glory of the Primal Lord of Nirvaanaa. ||4||7||18||

[Ang 614 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਰੇਨੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਮ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: ham santan kee ren piaare ham santan kee saranaa |
English: I am the dust of the feet of the Beloved Saints; I seek the Protection of their Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਓਟ ਸਤਾਣੀ ਸੰਤ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਗਹਣਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sant hamaaree ott sataanee sant hamaaraa gahanaa |1|
English: The Saints are my all-powerful Support; the Saints are my ornament and decoration. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਸੰਤਨ ਸਿਉ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: ham santan siau ban aaee |
English: I am hand and glove with the Saints.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: poorab likhiaa paaee |
English: I have realized my pre-ordained destiny.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: eihu man teraa bhaaee | rahaau |
English: This mind is yours, O Siblings of Destiny. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਨ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਲੇਵਾ ਦੇਵੀ ਸੰਤਨ ਸਿਉ ਬਿਉਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: santan siau meree levaa devee santan siau biauhaaraa |
English: My dealings are with the Saints, and my business is with the Saints.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਨ ਸਿਉ ਹਮ ਲਾਹਾ ਖਾਟਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: santan siau ham laahaa khaattiaa har bhagat bhare bhanddaaraa |2|
English: I have earned the profit with the Saints, and the treasure filled to over-flowing with devotion to the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਨ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਉਪੀ ਤਉ ਉਤਰਿਆ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਧੋਖਾ ॥
Transliteration: santan mo kau poonjee saupee tau utariaa man kaa dhokhaa |
English: The Saints entrusted to me the capital, and my mind's delusion was dispelled.

Gurbani: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਅਬ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੈਗੋ ਜਉ ਫਾਟਿਓ ਸਗਲੋ ਲੇਖਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: dharam raae ab kahaa karaigo jau faattio sagalo lekhaa |3|
English: What can the Righteous Judge of Dharma do now? All my accounts have been torn up. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਭਏ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਪਰਸਾਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: mahaa anand bhe sukh paaeaa santan kai parasaade |
English: I have found the greatest bliss, and I am at peace, by the Grace of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੇ ॥੪॥੮॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak har siau man maaniaa rang rate bisamaade |4|8|19|
English: Says Nanak, my mind is reconciled with the Lord; it is imbued with the wondrous Love of the Lord. ||4||8||19||

[Ang 614 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੇਤੀ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਰੇ ਨਰ ਤੇਤੀ ਹੀ ਛਡਿ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: jetee samagree dekhahu re nar tetee hee chhadd jaanee |
English: All the things that you see, O man, you shall have to leave behind.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਉਹਾਰਾ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: raam naam sang kar biauhaaraa paaveh pad nirabaanee |1|
English: Let your dealings be with the Lord's Name, and you shall attain the state of Nirvaanaa. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੋ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: piaare too mero sukhadaataa |
English: O my Beloved, You are the Giver of peace.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੀਆ ਉਪਦੇਸਾ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਰਾਤਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur poorai deea upadesaa tum hee sang paraataa | rahaau |
English: The Perfect Guru has given me these Teachings, and I am attuned to You. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh lobh moh abhimaanaa taa meh sukh nahee paaeeai |
English: In sexual desire, anger, greed, emotional attachment and self-conceit, peace is not to be found.

Gurbani: ਹੋਹੁ ਰੇਨ ਤੂ ਸਗਲ ਕੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਤਉ ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: hohu ren too sagal kee mere man tau anad mangal sukh paaeeai |2|
English: So be the dust of the feet of all, O my mind, and then you shall find bliss, joy and peace. ||2||

Gurbani: ਘਾਲ ਨ ਭਾਨੈ ਅੰਤਰ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਮਨ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: ghaal na bhaanai antar bidh jaanai taa kee kar man sevaa |
English: He knows the condition of your inner self, and He will not let your work go in vain - serve Him, O mind.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਹੋਮਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਗੁਰਦੇਵਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kar poojaa hom ihu manooaa akaal moorat guradevaa |3|
English: Worship Him, and dedicate this mind unto Him, the Image of the Undying Lord, the Divine Guru. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੋਬਿਦ ਦਾਮੋਦਰ ਦਇਆਲ ਮਾਧਵੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: gobid daamodar deaal maadhave paarabraham nirankaaraa |
English: He is the Lord of the Universe, the Compassionate Lord, the Supreme Lord God, the Formless Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਰਤਣਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਵਾਲੇਵਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੯॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: naam varatan naamo vaalevaa naam naanak praan adhaaraa |4|9|20|
English: The Naam is my merchandise, the Naam is my nourishment; the Naam, O Nanak, is the Support of my breath of life. ||4||9||20||

[Ang 614 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਿਰਤਕ ਕਉ ਪਾਇਓ ਤਨਿ ਸਾਸਾ ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਆਨਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: miratak kau paaeo tan saasaa bichhurat aan milaaeaa |
English: He infuses the breath into the dead bodies, and he reunited the separated ones.

Gurbani: ਪਸੂ ਪਰੇਤ ਮੁਗਧ ਭਏ ਸ੍ਰੋਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: pasoo paret mugadh bhe srote har naamaa mukh gaaeaa |1|
English: Even beasts, demons and fools become attentive listeners, when He sings the Praises of the Lord's Name. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਦੇਖੁ ਵਡਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: poore gur kee dekh vaddaaee |
English: Behold the glorious greatness of the Perfect Guru.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: taa kee keemat kehan na jaaee | rahaau |
English: His worth cannot be described. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦੂਖ ਸੋਗ ਕਾ ਢਾਹਿਓ ਡੇਰਾ ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਬਿਸਰਾਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: dookh sog kaa dtaahio dderaa anad mangal bisaraamaa |
English: He has demolished the abode of sorrow and disease, and brought bliss, joy and happiness.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਫਲ ਮਿਲੇ ਅਚਿੰਤਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਏ ਕਾਮਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: man baanchhat fal mile achintaa pooran hoe kaamaa |2|
English: He effortlessly awards the fruits of the mind's desire, and all works are brought to perfection. ||2||

Gurbani: ਈਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਆਗੈ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: eehaa sukh aagai mukh aoojal mitt ge aavan jaane |
English: He finds peace in this world, and his face is radiant in the world hereafter; his comings and goings are finished.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: nirbhau bhe hiradai naam vasiaa apune satigur kai man bhaane |3|
English: He becomes fearless, and his heart is filled with the Naam, the Name of the Lord; his mind is pleasing to the True Guru. ||3||

Gurbani: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: aootthat baitthat har gun gaavai dookh darad bhram bhaagaa |
English: Standing up and sitting down, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord; his pain, sorrow and doubt are dispelled.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰ ਕਰੰਮਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੨੧॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak taa ke poor karamaa jaa kaa gur charanee man laagaa |4|10|21|
English: Says Nanak, his karma is perfect; his mind is attached to the Guru's feet. ||4||10||21||

[Ang 614 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਤਨੁ ਛਾਡਿ ਕਉਡੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: ratan chhaadd kauddee sang laage jaa te kachhoo na paaeeai |
English: Forsaking the jewel, he is attached to the shell; nothing will come of it.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: pooran paarabraham paramesur mere man sadaa dhiaaeeai |1|
English: O my mind, meditate forever on the Perfect, Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: simarahu har har naam paraanee |
English: Meditate in remembrance on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O mortal.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਸੈ ਕਾਚੀ ਦੇਹ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: binasai kaachee deh agiaanee | rahaau |
English: Your frail body shall perish, you ignorant fool. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਰੁ ਸੁਪਨ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਵਡਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: mrig trisanaa ar supan manorath taa kee kachh na vaddaaee |
English: Illusions and dream-objects possess nothing of greatness.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਸਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: raam bhajan bin kaam na aavas sang na kaahoo jaaee |2|
English: Without meditating on the Lord, nothing succeeds, and nothing will go along with you. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਹਾਇ ਅਵਰਦਾ ਜੀਅ ਕੋ ਕਾਮੁ ਨ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: hau hau karat bihaae avaradaa jeea ko kaam na keenaa |
English: Acting in egotism and pride, his life passes away, and he does nothing for his soul.

Gurbani: ਧਾਵਤ ਧਾਵਤ ਨਹ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸਿਆ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਚੀਨਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: dhaavat dhaavat neh tripataasiaa raam naam nahee cheenaa |3|
English: Wandering and wandering all around, he is never satisfied; he does not remember the Name of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਾਦ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਰਸ ਮਾਤੋ ਅਸੰਖ ਖਤੇ ਕਰਿ ਫੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: saad bikaar bikhai ras maato asankh khate kar fere |
English: Intoxicated with the taste of corruption, cruel pleasures and countless sins, he is consigned to the cycle of reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਹਿ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਕਾਟਹੁ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਮੇਰੇ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੨੨॥
Transliteration: naanak kee prabh paeh binantee kaattahu avagun mere |4|11|22|
English: Nanak offers his prayer to God, to eradicate his demerits. ||4||11||22||

[Ang 615 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਬਿਖੁ ਜਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gun gaavahu pooran abinaasee kaam krodh bikh jaare |
English: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Perfect, Imperishable Lord, and the poison of sexual desire and anger shall be burnt away.

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਕੋ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mahaa bikham agan ko saagar saadhoo sang udhaare |1|
English: You shall cross over the awesome, arduous ocean of fire, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਟਿਓ ਭਰਮੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: poorai gur mettio bharam andheraa |
English: The Perfect Guru has dispelled the darkness of doubt.

Gurbani: ਭਜੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨੇਰਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhaj prem bhagat prabh neraa | rahaau |
English: Remember God with love and devotion; He is near at hand. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਰਹੇ ਅਘਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam nidhaan ras peea man tan rahe aghaaee |
English: Drink in the sublime essence, the treasure of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and your mind and body shall remain satisfied.

Gurbani: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਕਤ ਆਵੈ ਕਤ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jat kat poor rahio paramesar kat aavai kat jaaee |2|
English: The Transcendent Lord is totally permeating and pervading everywhere; where would He come from, and where would He go? ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਤਤ ਬੇਤਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਗੋੁਪਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: jap tap sanjam giaan tat betaa jis man vasai guopaalaa |
English: One whose mind is filled with the Lord, is a person of meditation, penance, self-restraint and spiritual wisdom, and a knower of reality.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਘਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naam ratan jin guramukh paaeaa taa kee pooran ghaalaa |3|
English: The Gurmukh obtains the jewel of the Naam; his efforts come to perfect fruition. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਿਟੇ ਦੁਖ ਸਗਲੇ ਕਾਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: kal kales mitte dukh sagale kaattee jam kee faasaa |
English: All his struggles, sufferings and pains are dispelled, and the noose of death is cut away from him.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਭਏ ਬਿਗਾਸਾ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੨੩॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak prabh kirapaa dhaaree man tan bhe bigaasaa |4|12|23|
English: Says Nanak, God has extended His Mercy, and so his mind and body blossom forth. ||4||12||23||

[Ang 615 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਰਣ ਕਰਾਵਣਹਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: karan karaavanahaar prabh daataa paarabraham prabh suaamee |
English: God is the Doer, the Cause of causes, the Great Giver; God is the Supreme Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲੇ ਜੀਅ ਕੀਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sagale jeea kee deaalaa so prabh antarajaamee |1|
English: The Merciful Lord created all beings; God is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਆ ਆਪਿ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: meraa gur hoaa aap sahaaee |
English: My Guru is Himself my friend and support.

Gurbani: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਰਸ ਅਚਰਜ ਭਈ ਬਡਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sookh sehaj aanand mangal ras acharaj bhee baddaaee | rahaau |
English: I am in celestial peace, bliss, joy, pleasure and wondrous glory. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਏ ਭੈ ਨਾਸੇ ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur kee saran pe bhai naase saachee daragah maane |
English: Seeking the Sanctuary of the Guru, my fears have been dispelled, and I am accepted in the Court of the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ ਆਰਾਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਏ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਥਾਨੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gun gaavat aaraadh naam har aae apunai thaane |2|
English: Singing His Glorious Praises, and worshipping in adoration the Name of the Lord, I have reached my destination. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਕਰੈ ਸਭ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jai jai kaar karai sabh usatat sangat saadh piaaree |
English: Everyone applauds and congratulates me; the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is dear to me.

Gurbani: ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿ ਜਾਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sad balihaar jaau prabh apune jin pooran paij savaaree |3|
English: I am forever a sacrifice to my God, who has totally protected and preserved my honor. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੋਸਟਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਉਧਰੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gosatt giaan naam sun udhare jin jin darasan paaeaa |
English: They are saved, who receive the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; they listen to the spiritual dialogue of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਅਨਦ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੨੪॥
Transliteration: bheo kripaal naanak prabh apunaa anad setee ghar aaeaa |4|13|24|
English: Nanak's God has become Merciful to him; he has arrived home in ecstasy. ||4||13||24||

[Ang 615 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਗਲ ਭੈ ਲਾਥੇ ਦੁਖ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kee saran sagal bhai laathe dukh binase sukh paaeaa |
English: In God's Sanctuary, all fears depart, suffering disappears, and peace is obtained.

Gurbani: ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: deaal hoaa paarabraham suaamee pooraa satigur dhiaaeaa |1|
English: When the Supreme Lord God and Master becomes merciful, we meditate on the Perfect True Guru. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: prabh jeeo too mero saahib daataa |
English: O Dear God, You are my Lord Master and Great Giver.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਉ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh deen deaalaa gun gaavau rang raataa | rahaau |
English: By Your Mercy, O God, Merciful to the meek, imbue me with Your Love, that I might sing Your Glorious Praises. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: satigur naam nidhaan drirraaeaa chintaa sagal binaasee |
English: The True Guru has implanted the treasure of the Naam within me, and all my anxieties have been dispelled.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa apuno kar leenaa man vasiaa abinaasee |2|
English: By His Mercy, He has made me His own, and the imperishable Lord has come to dwell within my mind. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਲਾਗੈ ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
Transliteration: taa kau bighan na koaoo laagai jo satigur apunai raakhe |
English: No misfortune afflicts one who is protected by the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਬਸੇ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: charan kamal base rid antar amrit har ras chaakhe |3|
English: The Lotus Feet of God come to abide within his heart, and he savors the sublime essence of the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੇਵਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kar sevaa sevak prabh apune jin man kee ichh pujaaee |
English: So, as a servant, serve your God, who fulfills your mind's desires.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੨੫॥
Transliteration: naanak daas taa kai balihaarai jin pooran paij rakhaaee |4|14|25|
English: Slave Nanak is a sacrifice to the Perfect Lord, who has protected and preserved his honor. ||4||14||25||

[Ang 616 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨੁ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੈ ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa moh magan andhiaarai devanahaar na jaanai |
English: Infatuated with the darkness of emotional attachment to Maya, he does not know the Lord, the Great Giver.

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਾਜਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਿਆ ਬਲੁ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jeeo pindd saaj jin rachiaa bal apuno kar maanai |1|
English: The Lord created his body and fashioned his soul, but he claims that his power is his own. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮੂੜੇ ਦੇਖਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: man moorre dekh rahio prabh suaamee |
English: O foolish mind, God, your Lord and Master is watching over you.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਕਛੂਐ ਛਾਨੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo kichh kareh soee soee jaanai rahai na kachhooai chhaanee | rahaau |
English: Whatever you do, He knows; nothing can remain concealed from Him. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਸੁਆਦ ਲੋਭ ਮਦਿ ਮਾਤੋ ਉਪਜੇ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਿਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jihavaa suaad lobh mad maato upaje anik bikaaraa |
English: You are intoxicated with the tastes of the tongue, with greed and pride; countless sins spring from these.

Gurbani: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਜੋਨਿ ਭਰਮਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਬੰਧਨ ਕੇ ਭਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bahut jon bharamat dukh paaeaa haumai bandhan ke bhaaraa |2|
English: You wandered in pain through countless incarnations, weighed down by the chains of egotism. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦੇਇ ਕਿਵਾੜ ਅਨਿਕ ਪੜਦੇ ਮਹਿ ਪਰ ਦਾਰਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਫਾਕੈ ॥
Transliteration: dee kivaarr anik parrade meh par daaraa sang faakai |
English: Behind closed doors, hidden by many screens, the man takes his pleasure with another man's wife.

Gurbani: ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਜਬ ਲੇਖਾ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਤਬ ਕਉਣੁ ਪੜਦਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਢਾਕੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: chitr gupat jab lekhaa maageh tab kaun parradaa teraa dtaakai |3|
English: When Chitr and Gupt, the celestial accountants of the conscious and subconscious, call for your account, who will screen you then? ||3||

Gurbani: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਤੁਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਓਟ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: deen deaal pooran dukh bhanjan tum bin ott na kaaee |
English: O Perfect Lord, Merciful to the meek, Destroyer of pain, without You, I have no shelter at all.

Gurbani: ਕਾਢਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੨੬॥
Transliteration: kaadt lehu sansaar saagar meh naanak prabh saranaaee |4|15|26|
English: Please, lift me up out of the world-ocean; O God, I have come to Your Sanctuary. ||4||15||26||

[Ang 616 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਹਾਈ ਕਥਾ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham hoaa sahaaee kathaa keeratan sukhadaaee |
English: The Supreme Lord God has become my helper and friend; His sermon and the Kirtan of His Praises have brought me peace.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਜਪਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur poore kee baanee jap anad karahu nit praanee |1|
English: Chant the Word of the Perfect Guru's Bani, and be ever in bliss, O mortal. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har saachaa simarahu bhaaee |
English: Remember the True Lord in meditation, O Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਜਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang sadaa sukh paaeeai har bisar na kabahoo jaaee | rahaau |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, eternal peace is obtained, and the Lord is never forgotten. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਜੋ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਸੋ ਜੀਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: amrit naam paramesar teraa jo simarai so jeevai |
English: Your Name, O Transcendent Lord, is Ambrosial Nectar; whoever meditates on it, lives.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਥੀਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jis no karam paraapat hovai so jan niramal theevai |2|
English: One who is blessed with God's Grace - that humble servant becomes immaculate and pure. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬਿਘਨ ਬਿਨਾਸਨ ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖ ਨਾਸਨ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: bighan binaasan sabh dukh naasan gur charanee man laagaa |
English: Obstacles are removed, and all pains are eliminated; my mind is attached to the Guru's feet.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ ਅਚੁਤ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਜਾਗਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gun gaavat achut abinaasee anadin har rang jaagaa |3|
English: Singing the Glorious Praises of the immovable and imperishable Lord, one remains awake to the Lord's Love, day and night. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਸੇਈ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: man ichhe seee fal paae har kee kathaa suhelee |
English: He obtains the fruits of his mind's desires, listening to the comforting sermon of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਮਧਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੋਆ ਬੇਲੀ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੨੭॥
Transliteration: aad ant madh naanak kau so prabh hoaa belee |4|16|27|
English: In the beginning, in the middle, and in the end, God is Nanak's best friend. ||4||16||27||

[Ang 616 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਪੰਚਪਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 panchapadaa |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl, Panch-Padhay:

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਸੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਅਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਅਪਨੀ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: binasai mohu meraa ar teraa binasai apanee dhaaree |1|
English: May my emotional attachment, my sense of mine and yours, and my self-conceit be dispelled. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਇਹਾ ਬਤਾਵਹੁ ਕਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: santahu ihaa bataavahu kaaree |
English: O Saints, show me such a way,

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jit haumai garab nivaaree |1| rahaau |
English: by which my egotism and pride might be eliminated. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਭੂਤ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਹੋਵਾਂ ਸਗਲ ਰੇਨਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sarab bhoot paarabraham kar maaniaa hovaan sagal renaaree |2|
English: I see the Supreme Lord God in all beings, and I am the dust of all. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪੇਖਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਸੰਗੇ ਚੂਕੈ ਭੀਤਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: pekhio prabh jeeo apunai sange chookai bheet bhramaaree |3|
English: I see God always with me, and the wall of doubt has been shattered. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅਉਖਧੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਲੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੀ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: aaukhadh naam niramal jal amrit paaeeai guroo duaaree |4|
English: The medicine of the Naam, and the Immaculate Water of Ambrosial Nectar, are obtained through the Guru's Gate. ||4||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਰੋਗ ਬਿਦਾਰੀ ॥੫॥੧੭॥੨੮॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak jis masatak likhiaa tis gur mil rog bidaaree |5|17|28|
English: Says Nanak, one who has such pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon his forehead, meets with the Guru, and his diseases are cured. ||5||17||28||

[Ang 617 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 ghar 2 dupade |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl, Second House, Dho-Padhay:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਬਨਸਪਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਦੂਧ ਮਹਿ ਘੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: sagal banasapat meh baisantar sagal doodh meh gheea |
English: Fire is contained in all firewood, and butter is contained in all milk.

Gurbani: ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਮਾਧਉ ਜੀਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aooch neech meh jot samaanee ghatt ghatt maadhau jeea |1|
English: God's Light is contained in the high and the low; the Lord is in the hearts of all beings. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਹਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: santahu ghatt ghatt rahiaa samaahio |
English: O Saints, He is pervading and permeating each and every heart.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਰਬ ਮਹਿ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਰਮਈਆ ਆਹਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: pooran poor rahio sarab meh jal thal rameea aahio |1| rahaau |
English: The Perfect Lord is completely permeating everyone, everywhere; He is diffused in the water and the land. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: gun nidhaan naanak jas gaavai satigur bharam chukaaeo |
English: Nanak sings the Praises of the Lord, the treasure of excellence; the True Guru has dispelled his doubt.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਸਦਾ ਅਲੇਪਾ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇਓ ॥੨॥੧॥੨੯॥
Transliteration: sarab nivaasee sadaa alepaa sabh meh rahiaa samaaeo |2|1|29|
English: The Lord is pervading everywhere, permeating all, and yet, He is unattached from all. ||2||1||29||

[Ang 617 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭੈ ਦੁਖੀ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai simaran hoe anandaa binasai janam maran bhai dukhee |
English: Meditating on Him, one is in ecstasy; the pains of birth and death and fear are removed.

Gurbani: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: chaar padaarath nav nidh paaveh bahur na trisanaa bhukhee |1|
English: The four cardinal blessings, and the nine treasures are received; you shall never feel hunger or thirst again. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਤੂ ਸੁਖੀ ॥
Transliteration: jaa ko naam lait too sukhee |
English: Chanting His Name, you shall be at peace.

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਉ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਜੀਅਰੇ ਮੁਖੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saas saas dhiaavahu tthaakur kau man tan jeeare mukhee |1| rahaau |
English: With each and every breath, meditate on the Lord and Master, O my soul, with mind, body and mouth. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਮਨ ਸੀਤਲ ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਧੁਖੀ ॥
Transliteration: saant paaveh hoveh man seetal agan na antar dhukhee |
English: You shall find peace, and your mind shall be soothed and cooled; the fire of desire shall not burn within you.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਰੁਖੀ ॥੨॥੨॥੩੦॥
Transliteration: gur naanak kau prabhoo dikhaaeaa jal thal tribhavan rukhee |2|2|30|
English: The Guru has revealed God to Nanak, in the three worlds, in the water, the earth and the woods. ||2||2||30||

[Ang 617 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਝੂਠ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਇਨ ਤੇ ਆਪਿ ਛਡਾਵਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh lobh jhootth nindaa in te aap chhaddaavahu |
English: Sexual desire, anger, greed, falsehood and slander - please, save me from these, O Lord.

Gurbani: ਇਹ ਭੀਤਰ ਤੇ ਇਨ ਕਉ ਡਾਰਹੁ ਆਪਨ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਬੁਲਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: eih bheetar te in kau ddaarahu aapan nikatt bulaavahu |1|
English: Please eradicate these from within me, and call me to come close to You. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਪੁਨੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਆਪਿ ਜਨਾਵਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: apunee bidh aap janaavahu |
English: You alone teach me Your Ways.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮੰਗਲ ਗਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har jan mangal gaavahu |1| rahaau |
English: With the Lord's humble servants, I sing His Praises. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਬਹੂ ਹੀਏ ਤੇ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: bisar naahee kabahoo hee te ih bidh man meh paavahu |
English: May I never forget the Lord within my heart; please, instill such understanding within my mind.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਧਾਵਹੁ ॥੨॥੩॥੩੧॥
Transliteration: gur pooraa bhettio vaddabhaagee jan naanak kateh na dhaavahu |2|3|31|
English: By great good fortune, servant Nanak has met with the Perfect Guru, and now, he will not go anywhere else. ||2||3||31||

[Ang 617 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਘਾਲ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai simaran sabh kachh paaeeai birathee ghaal na jaaee |
English: Meditating in remembrance on Him, all things are obtained, and one's efforts shall not be in vain.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਅਵਰ ਕਤ ਰਾਚਹੁ ਜੋ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tis prabh tiaag avar kat raachahu jo sabh meh rahiaa samaaee |1|
English: Forsaking God, why do you attach yourself to another? He is contained in everything. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: har har simarahu sant gopaalaa |
English: O Saints, meditate in remembrance on the World-Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਘਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang mil naam dhiaavahu pooran hovai ghaalaa |1| rahaau |
English: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; your efforts shall be rewarded. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਲੈ ਨਿਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਸਹਿਤ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: saar samaalai nit pratipaalai prem sahit gal laavai |
English: He ever preserves and cherishes His servant; with Love, He hugs him close.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਜਗਤ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੪॥੩੨॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak prabh tumare bisarat jagat jeevan kaise paavai |2|4|32|
