English: Says Nanak, forgetting You, O God, how can the world find life? ||2||4||32||

[Ang 617 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਜੀਅਨ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਭ ਮਲੁ ਖੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: abinaasee jeean ko daataa simarat sabh mal khoee |
English: He is imperishable, the Giver of all beings; meditating on Him, all filth is removed.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਉ ਬਰਤਨਿ ਬਿਰਲਾ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gun nidhaan bhagatan kau baratan biralaa paavai koee |1|
English: He is the treasure of excellence, the object of His devotees, but rare are those who find Him. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: mere man jap gur gopaal prabh soee |
English: O my mind, meditate on the Guru, and God, the Cherisher of the world.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆਂ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kee saran peaan sukh paaeeai baahurr dookh na hoee |1| rahaau |
English: Seeking His Sanctuary, one finds peace, and he shall not suffer in pain again. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਭੇਟਤ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: vaddabhaagee saadhasang paraapat tin bhettat duramat khoee |
English: By great good fortune, one obtains the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. Meeting them, evil-mindedness is eliminated.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਬਾਛੈ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਪਰੋਈ ॥੨॥੫॥੩੩॥
Transliteration: tin kee dhoor naanak daas baachhai jin har naam ridai paroee |2|5|33|
English: Slave Nanak yearns for the dust of the feet of those, who have woven the Lord's Name into their hearts. ||2||5||33||

[Ang 618 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਸੂਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਧਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: janam janam ke dookh nivaarai sookaa man saadhaarai |
English: He dispels the pains of countless incarnations, and lends support to the dry and shrivelled mind.

Gurbani: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਹੋਤ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: darasan bhettat hot nihaalaa har kaa naam beechaarai |1|
English: Beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, one is enraptured, contemplating the Name of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਬੈਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: meraa baid guroo govindaa |
English: My physician is the Guru, the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਕਾਟੈ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫੰਧਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam aaukhadh mukh devai kaattai jam kee fandhaa |1| rahaau |
English: He places the medicine of the Naam into my mouth, and cuts away the noose of Death. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਮਰਥ ਪੁਰਖ ਪੂਰਨ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: samarath purakh pooran bidhaate aape karanaihaaraa |
English: He is the all-powerful, Perfect Lord, the Architect of Destiny; He Himself is the Doer of deeds.

Gurbani: ਅਪੁਨਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਉਬਾਰਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੨॥੬॥੩੪॥
Transliteration: apunaa daas har aap ubaariaa naanak naam adhaaraa |2|6|34|
English: The Lord Himself saves His slave; Nanak takes the Support of the Naam. ||2||6||34||

[Ang 618 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਪਾਹਿ ਨਿਬੇਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: antar kee gat tum hee jaanee tujh hee paeh nibero |
English: Only You know the state of my innermost self; You alone can judge me.

Gurbani: ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ ਲਾਖ ਖਤੇ ਕਰਿ ਫੇਰੋ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bakhas laihu saahib prabh apane laakh khate kar fero |1|
English: Please forgive me, O Lord God Master; I have committed thousands of sins and mistakes. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਨੇਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: prabh jee too mero tthaakur nero |
English: O my Dear Lord God Master, You are always near me.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਮੋਹਿ ਚੇਰੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har charan saran mohi chero |1| rahaau |
English: O Lord, please bless Your disciple with the shelter of Your feet. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਊਚੋ ਗੁਨੀ ਗਹੇਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: besumaar beant suaamee aoocho gunee gahero |
English: Infinite and endless is my Lord and Master; He is lofty, virtuous and profoundly deep.

Gurbani: ਕਾਟਿ ਸਿਲਕ ਕੀਨੋ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਦਾਸਰੋ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਾ ਨਿਹੋਰੋ ॥੨॥੭॥੩੫॥
Transliteration: kaatt silak keeno apuno daasaro tau naanak kahaa nihoro |2|7|35|
English: Cutting away the noose of death, the Lord has made Nanak His slave, and now, what does he owe to anyone else? ||2||7||35||

[Ang 618 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: bhe kripaal guroo govindaa sagal manorath paae |
English: The Guru, the Lord of the Universe, became merciful to me, and I obtained all of my mind's desires.

Gurbani: ਅਸਥਿਰ ਭਏ ਲਾਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: asathir bhe laag har charanee govind ke gun gaae |1|
English: I have become stable and steady, touching the Lord's Feet, and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਲੋ ਸਮੂਰਤੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: bhalo samoorat pooraa |
English: It is a good time, a perfectly auspicious time.

Gurbani: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਵਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਤੂਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saant sehaj aanand naam jap vaaje anahad tooraa |1| rahaau |
English: I am in celestial peace, tranquility and ecstasy, chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the unstruck melody of the sound current vibrates and resounds. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: mile suaamee preetam apune ghar mandar sukhadaaee |
English: Meeting with my Beloved Lord and Master, my home has become a mansion filled with happiness.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਗਲੀ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਈ ॥੨॥੮॥੩੬॥
Transliteration: har naam nidhaan naanak jan paaeaa sagalee ichh pujaaee |2|8|36|
English: Servant Nanak has attained the treasure of the Lord's Name; all his desires have been fulfilled. ||2||8||36||

[Ang 618 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਬਸੇ ਰਿਦ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸੁਭ ਲਖਣ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur ke charan base rid bheetar subh lakhan prabh keene |
English: The Guru's feet abide within my heart; God has blessed me with good fortune.

Gurbani: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਮਨਿ ਚੀਨੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bhe kripaal pooran paramesar naam nidhaan man cheene |1|
English: The Perfect Transcendent Lord became merciful to me, and I found the treasure of the Naam within my mind. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਰਖਵਾਰੋ ਮੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: mero gur rakhavaaro meet |
English: My Guru is my Saving Grace, my only best friend.

Gurbani: ਦੂਣ ਚਊਣੀ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸੋਭਾ ਨੀਤਾ ਨੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: doon chaoonee de vaddiaaee sobhaa neetaa neet |1| rahaau |
English: Over and over again, He blesses me with double, even four-fold, greatness. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸਗਲ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jant prabh sagal udhaare darasan dekhanahaare |
English: God saves all beings and creatures, giving them the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਅਚਰਜ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੯॥੩੭॥
Transliteration: gur poore kee acharaj vaddiaaee naanak sad balihaare |2|9|37|
English: Wondrous is the glorious greatness of the Perfect Guru; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||9||37||

[Ang 618 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੰਚਨਿ ਕਰਉ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਥਾਤੀ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: sanchan krau naam dhan niramal thaatee agam apaar |
English: I gather in and collect the immaculate wealth of the Naam; this commodity is inaccessible and incomparable.

Gurbani: ਬਿਲਛਿ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਆਨੰਦ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਣਹੁ ਖਾਇ ਜੀਵਹੁ ਸਿਖ ਪਰਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bilachh binod aanand sukh maanahu khaae jeevahu sikh paravaar |1|
English: Revel in it, delight in it, be happy and enjoy peace, and live long, O Sikhs and brethren. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਆਧਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: har ke charan kamal aadhaar |
English: I have the support of the Lotus Feet of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਚ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਚੜਿ ਲੰਘਉ ਬਿਖੁ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sant prasaad paaeo sach bohith charr langhau bikh sansaar |1| rahaau |
English: By the Grace of the Saints, I have found the boat of Truth; embarking on it, I sail across the ocean of poison. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਆਪਹਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਸਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: bhe kripaal pooran abinaasee aapeh keenee saar |
English: The perfect, imperishable Lord has become merciful; He Himself has taken care of me.

Gurbani: ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਗਸਾਨੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੁਮਾਰ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੩੮॥
Transliteration: pekh pekh naanak bigasaano naanak naahee sumaar |2|10|38|
English: Beholding, beholding His Vision, Nanak has blossomed forth in ecstasy. O Nanak, He is beyond estimation. ||2||10||38||

[Ang 618 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਅਪਨੀ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ ਸਭ ਘਟ ਉਪਜੀ ਦਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur poorai apanee kal dhaaree sabh ghatt upajee deaa |
English: The Perfect Guru has revealed His power, and compassion has welled up in every heart.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਕੀਨੀ ਕੁਸਲ ਖੇਮ ਸਭ ਭਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aape mel vaddaaee keenee kusal khem sabh bheaa |1|
English: Blending me with Himself, He has blessed me with glorious greatness, and I have found pleasure and happiness. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: satigur pooraa merai naal |
English: The Perfect True Guru is always with me.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham jap sadaa nihaal | rahaau |
English: Meditating on the Supreme Lord God, I am forever in ecstasy. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: antar baahar thaan thanantar jat kat pekhau soee |
English: Inwardly and outwardly, in all places and interspaces, wherever I look, He is there.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੩੯॥
Transliteration: naanak gur paaeo vaddabhaagee tis jevadd avar na koee |2|11|39|
English: Nanak has found the Guru, by great good fortune; no one else is as great as He. ||2||11||39||

[Ang 619 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੂਖ ਮੰਗਲ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਨਿਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sookh mangal kaliaan sehaj dhun prabh ke charan nihaariaa |
English: I have been blessed with peace, pleasure, bliss, and the celestial sound current, gazing upon the feet of God.

Gurbani: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੈ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਤਾਪੁ ਉਤਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: raakhanahaarai raakhio baarik satigur taap utaariaa |1|
English: The Savior has saved His child, and the True Guru has cured his fever. ||1||

Gurbani: ਉਬਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aubare satigur kee saranaaee |
English: I have been saved, in the True Guru's Sanctuary;

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਜਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kee sev na birathee jaaee | rahaau |
English: service to Him does not go in vain. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਸੂਖ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਸੂਖਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: ghar meh sookh baahar fun sookhaa prabh apune bhe deaalaa |
English: There is peace within the home of one's heart, and there is peace outside as well, when God becomes kind and compassionate.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕੋਊ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੋਆ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੪੦॥
Transliteration: naanak bighan na laagai koaoo meraa prabh hoaa kirapaalaa |2|12|40|
English: O Nanak, no obstacles block my way; my God has become gracious and merciful to me. ||2||12||40||

[Ang 619 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਭਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਉਦਮੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: saadhoo sang bheaa man udam naam ratan jas gaaee |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, my mind became excited, and I sang the Praises of the jewel of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਮਿਟਿ ਗਈ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਅਨੰਤਾ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mitt gee chintaa simar anantaa saagar tariaa bhaaee |1|
English: My anxiety was dispelled, meditating in remembrance on the Infinite Lord; I have crossed over the world ocean, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: hiradai har ke charan vasaaee |
English: I enshrine the Lord's Feet within my heart.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੀ ਰੋਗਾ ਘਾਣਿ ਮਿਟਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sukh paaeaa sehaj dhun upajee rogaa ghaan mittaaee | rahaau |
English: I have found peace, and the celestial sound current resounds within me; countless diseases have been eradicated. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣਾ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa gun tere aakh vakhaanaa keemat kehan na jaaee |
English: Which of Your Glorious Virtues can I speak and describe? Your worth cannot be estimated.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤ ਭਏ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭਇਆ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੨॥੧੩॥੪੧॥
Transliteration: naanak bhagat bhe abinaasee apunaa prabh bheaa sahaaee |2|13|41|
English: O Nanak, the Lord's devotees become imperishable and immortal; their God becomes their friend and support. ||2||13||41||

[Ang 619 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗਏ ਕਲੇਸ ਰੋਗ ਸਭਿ ਨਾਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: ge kales rog sabh naase prabh apunai kirapaa dhaaree |
English: My sufferings have come to an end, and all diseases have been eradicated.

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਆਰਾਧਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਘਾਲ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar aaraadhahu suaamee pooran ghaal hamaaree |1|
English: God has showered me with His Grace. Twenty-four hours a day, I worship and adore my Lord and Master; my efforts have come to fruition. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੂ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: har jeeo too sukh sanpat raas |
English: O Dear Lord, You are my peace, wealth and capital.

Gurbani: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਭਾਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਗੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raakh laihu bhaaee mere kau prabh aagai aradaas | rahaau |
English: Please, save me, O my Beloved! I offer this prayer to my God. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਮਾਗਉ ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਵਉ ਅਪਨੇ ਖਸਮ ਭਰੋਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo maagau soee soee paavau apane khasam bharosaa |
English: Whatever I ask for, I receive; I have total faith in my Master.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਮਿਟਿਓ ਸਗਲ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ॥੨॥੧੪॥੪੨॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak gur pooraa bhettio mittio sagal andesaa |2|14|42|
English: Says Nanak, I have met with the Perfect Guru, and all my fears have been dispelled. ||2||14||42||

[Ang 619 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਸਗਲਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: simar simar gur satigur apanaa sagalaa dookh mittaaeaa |
English: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on my Guru, the True Guru, all pains have been eradicated.

Gurbani: ਤਾਪ ਰੋਗ ਗਏ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: taap rog ge gur bachanee man ichhe fal paaeaa |1|
English: The fever and the disease are gone, through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, and I have obtained the fruits of my mind's desires. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: meraa gur pooraa sukhadaataa |
English: My Perfect Guru is the Giver of peace.

Gurbani: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: karan kaaran samarath suaamee pooran purakh bidhaataa | rahaau |
English: He is the Doer, the Cause of causes, the Almighty Lord and Master, the Perfect Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਨੰਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: anand binod mangal gun gaavahu gur naanak bhe deaalaa |
English: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord in bliss, joy and ecstasy; Guru Nanak has become kind and compassionate.

Gurbani: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰ ਭਏ ਜਗ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਹੋਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥੨॥੧੫॥੪੩॥
Transliteration: jai jai kaar bhe jag bheetar hoaa paarabraham rakhavaalaa |2|15|43|
English: Shouts of cheers and congratulations ring out all over the world; the Supreme Lord God has become my Savior and Protector. ||2||15||43||

[Ang 619 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਮਰੀ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਗਣੀਆ ਕਾਈ ਅਪਣਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਪਛਾਣਿ ॥
Transliteration: hamaree ganat na ganeea kaaee apanaa birad pachhaan |
English: He did not take my accounts into account; such is His forgiving nature.

Gurbani: ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਰਾਖੇ ਕਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: haath dee raakhe kar apune sadaa sadaa rang maan |1|
English: He gave me His hand, and saved me and made me His own; forever and ever, I enjoy His Love. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਦ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਣ ॥
Transliteration: saachaa saahib sad miharavaan |
English: The True Lord and Master is forever merciful and forgiving.

Gurbani: ਬੰਧੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹੋਈ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਿਆਣ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bandh paaeaa merai satigur poorai hoee sarab kaliaan | rahaau |
English: My Perfect Guru has bound me to Him, and now, I am in absolute ecstasy. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਪਾਇ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਦਿਤਾ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਖਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: jeeo paae pindd jin saajiaa ditaa painan khaan |
English: The One who fashioned the body and placed the soul within, who gives you clothing and nourishment

Gurbani: ਅਪਣੇ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਆਪਿ ਪੈਜ ਰਾਖੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥੨॥੧੬॥੪੪॥
Transliteration: apane daas kee aap paij raakhee naanak sad kurabaan |2|16|44|
English: - He Himself preserves the honor of His slaves. Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||16||44||

[Ang 620 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦੁਰਤੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਉਬਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: durat gavaaeaa har prabh aape sabh sansaar ubaariaa |
English: The Lord God Himself has rid the whole world of its sins, and saved it.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਅਪਣਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸਮਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: paarabraham prabh kirapaa dhaaree apanaa birad samaariaa |1|
English: The Supreme Lord God extended His mercy, and confirmed His innate nature. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹੋਈ ਰਾਜੇ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਰਖਵਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: hoee raaje raam kee rakhavaalee |
English: I have attained the Protective Sanctuary of the Lord, my King.

Gurbani: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਦੇਹ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sookh sehaj aanad gun gaavahu man tan deh sukhaalee | rahaau |
English: In celestial peace and ecstasy, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and my mind, body and being are at peace. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: patit udhaaran satigur meraa mohi tis kaa bharavaasaa |
English: My True Guru is the Savior of sinners; I have placed my trust and faith in Him.

Gurbani: ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਸਭਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਾਹਿਬਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਾ ॥੨॥੧੭॥੪੫॥
Transliteration: bakhas le sabh sachai saahib sun naanak kee aradaasaa |2|17|45|
English: The True Lord has heard Nanak's prayer, and He has forgiven everything. ||2||17||45||

[Ang 620 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬਖਸਿਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਰੋਗ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: bakhasiaa paarabraham paramesar sagale rog bidaare |
English: The Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, has forgiven me, and all diseases have been cured.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ ਉਬਰੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur poore kee saranee ubare kaaraj sagal savaare |1|
English: Those who come to the Sanctuary of the True Guru are saved, and all their affairs are resolved. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਨਿ ਸਿਮਰਿਆ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: har jan simariaa naam adhaar |
English: The Lord's humble servant meditates in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; this is his only support.

Gurbani: ਤਾਪੁ ਉਤਾਰਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਅਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: taap utaariaa satigur poorai apanee kirapaa dhaar | rahaau |
English: The Perfect True Guru extended His Mercy, and the fever has been dispelled. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਕਰਹ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa anand karah mere piaare har govid gur raakhiaa |
English: So celebrate and be happy, my beloveds - the Guru has saved Hargobind.

Gurbani: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਤਿ ਭਾਖਿਆ ॥੨॥੧੮॥੪੬॥
Transliteration: vaddee vaddiaaee naanak karate kee saach sabad sat bhaakhiaa |2|18|46|
English: Great is the glorious greatness of the Creator, O Nanak; True is the Word of His Shabad, and True is the sermon of His Teachings. ||2||18||46||

[Ang 620 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: bhe kripaal suaamee mere tith saachai darabaar |
English: My Lord and Master has become Merciful, in His True Court.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਤਾਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਭਾਈ ਠਾਂਢਿ ਪਈ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: satigur taap gavaaeaa bhaaee tthaandt pee sansaar |
English: The True Guru has taken away the fever, and the whole world is at peace, O Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਅਪਣੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਆਪੇ ਰਾਖੇ ਜਮਹਿ ਕੀਓ ਹਟਤਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: apane jeea jant aape raakhe jameh keeo hattataar |1|
English: The Lord Himself protects His beings and creatures, and the Messenger of Death is out of work. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਰਿਦੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: har ke charan ridai ur dhaar |
English: Enshrine the Lord's feet within your heart.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਦੁਖ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa prabh simareeai bhaaee dukh kilabikh kaattanahaar |1| rahaau |
English: Forever and ever, meditate in remembrance on God, O Siblings of Destiny. He is the Eradicator of suffering and sins. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ ਊਬਰੈ ਭਾਈ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: tis kee saranee aoobarai bhaaee jin rachiaa sabh koe |
English: He fashioned all beings, O Siblings of Destiny, and His Sanctuary saves them.

Gurbani: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸੋ ਭਾਈ ਸਚੈ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: karan kaaran samarath so bhaaee sachai sachee soe |
English: He is the Almighty Creator, the Cause of causes, O Siblings of Destiny; He, the True Lord, is True.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਭਾਈ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥੧੯॥੪੭॥
Transliteration: naanak prabhoo dhiaaeeai bhaaee man tan seetal hoe |2|19|47|
English: Nanak: meditate on God, O Siblings of Destiny, and your mind and body shall be cool and calm. ||2||19||47||

[Ang 620 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: santahu har har naam dhiaaee |
English: O Saints, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਵਿਸਰਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਅੜਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sukh saagar prabh visrau naahee man chindiarraa fal paaee |1| rahaau |
English: Never forget God, the ocean of peace; thus you shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਤਾਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਅਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: satigur poorai taap gavaaeaa apanee kirapaa dhaaree |
English: Extending His Mercy, the Perfect True Guru has dispelled the fever.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਸਭ ਪਰਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: paarabraham prabh bhe deaalaa dukh mittiaa sabh paravaaree |1|
English: The Supreme Lord God has become kind and compassionate, and my whole family is now free of pain and suffering. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਮੰਗਲ ਰਸ ਰੂਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: sarab nidhaan mangal ras roopaa har kaa naam adhaaro |
English: The Treasure of absolute joy, sublime elixir and beauty, the Name of the Lord is my only Support.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਉਧਰਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ॥੨॥੨੦॥੪੮॥
Transliteration: naanak pat raakhee paramesar udhariaa sabh sansaaro |2|20|48|
English: O Nanak, the Transcendent Lord has preserved my honor, and saved the whole world. ||2||20||48||

[Ang 620 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ਹੋਆ ॥
Transliteration: meraa satigur rakhavaalaa hoaa |
English: My True Guru is my Savior and Protector.

Gurbani: ਧਾਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਾਥ ਦੇ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਨਵਾ ਨਿਰੋਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dhaar kripaa prabh haath de raakhiaa har govid navaa niroaa |1| rahaau |
English: Showering us with His Mercy and Grace, God extended His Hand, and saved Hargobind, who is now safe and secure. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤਾਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਲਾਜ ਰਖਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: taap geaa prabh aap mittaaeaa jan kee laaj rakhaaee |
English: The fever is gone - God Himself eradicated it, and preserved the honor of His servant.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਂਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saadhasangat te sabh fal paae satigur kai bal jaanee |1|
English: I have obtained all blessings from the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; I am a sacrifice to the True Guru. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੋਵੈ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਹਮਰਾ ਗੁਣੁ ਅਵਗੁਣੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: halat palat prabh dovai savaare hamaraa gun avagun na beechaariaa |
English: God has saved me, both here and hereafter. He has not taken my merits and demerits into account.

Gurbani: ਅਟਲ ਬਚਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਫਲ ਕਰੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥੨॥੨੧॥੪੯॥
Transliteration: attal bachan naanak gur teraa safal kar masatak dhaariaa |2|21|49|
English: Your Word is eternal, O Guru Nanak; You placed Your Hand of blessing upon my forehead. ||2||21||49||

[Ang 621 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਸਭਿ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਕੀਏ ਸੋਈ ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jantr sabh tis ke kee soee sant sahaaee |
English: All beings and creatures were created by Him; He alone is the support and friend of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਆਪੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਈ ਬਡਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: apune sevak kee aape raakhai pooran bhee baddaaee |1|
English: He Himself preserves the honor of His servants; their glorious greatness becomes perfect. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham pooraa merai naal |
English: The Perfect Supreme Lord God is always with me.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪੂਰੀ ਸਭ ਰਾਖੀ ਹੋਏ ਸਰਬ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur poorai pooree sabh raakhee hoe sarab deaal |1| rahaau |
English: The Perfect Guru has perfectly and totally protected me, and now everyone is kind and compassionate to me. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: anadin naanak naam dhiaae jeea praan kaa daataa |
English: Night and day, Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; He is the Giver of the soul, and the breath of life itself.

Gurbani: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਰਾਖੈ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਪਿਤ ਮਾਤਾ ॥੨॥੨੨॥੫੦॥
Transliteration: apune daas kau kantth laae raakhai jiau baarik pit maataa |2|22|50|
English: He hugs His slave close in His loving embrace, like the mother and father hug their child. ||2||22||50||

[Ang 621 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 ghar 3 chaupade |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl, Third House, Chau-Padhay:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਪੰਚਹੁ ਨਹੀ ਸਹਸਾ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: mil panchahu nahee sahasaa chukaaeaa |
English: Meeting with the council, my doubts were not dispelled.

Gurbani: ਸਿਕਦਾਰਹੁ ਨਹ ਪਤੀਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sikadaarahu neh pateeaeaa |
English: The chiefs did not give me satisfaction.

Gurbani: ਉਮਰਾਵਹੁ ਆਗੈ ਝੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aumaraavahu aagai jheraa |
English: I presented my dispute to the noblemen as well.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਰਾਜਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mil raajan raam niberaa |1|
English: But it was only settled by meeting with the King, my Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਢੂਢਨ ਕਤਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ab dtoodtan katahu na jaaee |
English: Now, I do not go searching anywhere else,

Gurbani: ਗੋਬਿਦ ਭੇਟੇ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਸਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gobid bhette gur gosaaee | rahaau |
English: because I have met the Guru, the Lord of the Universe. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aaeaa prabh darabaaraa |
English: When I came to God's Darbaar, His Holy Court,

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਸਗਲੀ ਮਿਟੀ ਪੂਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: taa sagalee mittee pookaaraa |
English: then all of my cries and complaints were settled.

Gurbani: ਲਬਧਿ ਆਪਣੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: labadh aapanee paaee |
English: Now that I have attained what I had sought,

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕਤ ਆਵੈ ਕਤ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: taa kat aavai kat jaaee |2|
English: where should I come and where should I go? ||2||

Gurbani: ਤਹ ਸਾਚ ਨਿਆਇ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: teh saach niaae niberaa |
English: There, true justice is administered.

Gurbani: ਊਹਾ ਸਮ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਮ ਚੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aoohaa sam tthaakur sam cheraa |
English: There, the Lord Master and His disciple are one and the same.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: antarajaamee jaanai |
English: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, knows.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੋਲਤ ਆਪਿ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bin bolat aap pachhaanai |3|
English: Without our speaking, He understands. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਥਾਨ ਕੋ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: sarab thaan ko raajaa |
English: He is the King of all places.

Gurbani: ਤਹ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਅਗਾਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: teh anahad sabad agaajaa |
English: There, the unstruck melody of the Shabad resounds.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: tis peh kiaa chaturaaee |
English: Of what use is cleverness when dealing with Him?

Gurbani: ਮਿਲੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੫੧॥
Transliteration: mil naanak aap gavaaee |4|1|51|
English: Meeting with Him, O Nanak, one loses his self-conceit. ||4||1||51||

[Ang 621 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਇਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: hiradai naam vasaaeihu |
English: Enshrine the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within your heart;

Gurbani: ਘਰਿ ਬੈਠੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਧਿਆਇਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: ghar baitthe guroo dhiaaeihu |
English: sitting within your own home, meditate on the Guru.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਚੁ ਕਹਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur poorai sach kahiaa |
English: The Perfect Guru has spoken the Truth;

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਲਹਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: so sukh saachaa lahiaa |1|
English: the True Peace is obtained only from the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਪੁਨਾ ਹੋਇਓ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: apunaa hoeo gur miharavaanaa |
English: My Guru has become merciful.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦ ਸੂਖ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਮੰਗਲ ਸਿਉ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ਕਰਿ ਇਸਨਾਨਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: anad sookh kaliaan mangal siau ghar aae kar isanaanaa | rahaau |
English: In bliss, peace, pleasure and joy, I have returned to my own home, after my purifying bath. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੀ ਗੁਰ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: saachee gur vaddiaaee |
English: True is the glorious greatness of the Guru;

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: taa kee keemat kehan na jaaee |
English: His worth cannot be described.

Gurbani: ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: sir saahaa paatisaahaa |
English: He is the Supreme Overlord of kings.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟਤ ਮਨਿ ਓਮਾਹਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur bhettat man omaahaa |2|
English: Meeting with the Guru, the mind is enraptured. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਪਰਾਛਤ ਲਾਥੇ ॥
Transliteration: sagal paraachhat laathe |
English: All sins are washed away,

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਸਾਥੇ ॥
Transliteration: mil saadhasangat kai saathe |
English: meeting with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: gun nidhaan har naamaa |
English: The Lord's Name is the treasure of excellence;

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਏ ਕਾਮਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jap pooran hoe kaamaa |3|
English: chanting it, one's affairs are perfectly resolved. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੋ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur keeno mukat duaaraa |
English: The Guru has opened the door of liberation,

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਰੈ ਜੈਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabh srisatt karai jaikaaraa |
English: and the entire world applauds Him with cheers of victory.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਸਾਥੇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak prabh merai saathe |
English: O Nanak, God is always with me;

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭੈ ਲਾਥੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੫੨॥
Transliteration: janam maran bhai laathe |4|2|52|
English: my fears of birth and death are gone. ||4||2||52||

[Ang 621 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur poorai kirapaa dhaaree |
English: The Perfect Guru has granted His Grace,

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਲੋਚ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: prabh pooree loch hamaaree |
English: and God has fulfilled my desire.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: kar isanaan grihi aae |
English: After taking my bath of purification, I returned to my home,

Gurbani: ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: anad mangal sukh paae |1|
English: and I found bliss, happiness and peace. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: santahu raam naam nisatareeai |
English: O Saints, salvation comes from the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਕਰੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aootthat baitthat har har dhiaaeeai anadin sukrit kareeai |1| rahaau |
English: While standing up and sitting down, meditate on the Lord's Name. Night and day, do good deeds. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਧਰਮ ਕੀ ਪਉੜੀ ਕੋ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sant kaa maarag dharam kee paurree ko vaddabhaagee paae |
English: The way of the Saints is the ladder of righteous living, found only by great good fortune.

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਨਾਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kott janam ke kilabikh naase har charanee chit laae |2|
English: The sins of millions of incarnations are washed away, by focusing your consciousness on the Lord's feet. ||2||

Gurbani: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਕਲ ਰਾਖੀ ॥
Transliteration: ausatat karahu sadaa prabh apane jin pooree kal raakhee |
English: So sing the Praises of your God forever; His almighty power is perfect.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਭਏ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਖੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jeea jant sabh bhe pavitraa satigur kee sach saakhee |3|
English: All beings and creatures are purified, listening to the True Teachings of the True Guru. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬਿਘਨ ਬਿਨਾਸਨ ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖ ਨਾਸਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bighan binaasan sabh dukh naasan satigur naam drirraaeaa |
English: The True Guru has implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me; it is the Eliminator of obstructions, the Destroyer of all pains.

Gurbani: ਖੋਏ ਪਾਪ ਭਏ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਵਨ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੩॥੫੩॥
Transliteration: khoe paap bhe sabh paavan jan naanak sukh ghar aaeaa |4|3|53|
English: All of my sins were erased, and I have been purified; servant Nanak has returned to his home of peace. ||4||3||53||

[Ang 622 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਗੁਨੀ ਗਹੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: saahib gunee gaheraa |
English: O Lord Master, You are the ocean of excellence.

Gurbani: ਘਰੁ ਲਸਕਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: ghar lasakar sabh teraa |
English: My home and all my possessions are Yours.

Gurbani: ਰਖਵਾਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: rakhavaale gur gopaalaa |
English: The Guru, the Lord of the world, is my Savior.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sabh jeea bhe deaalaa |1|
English: All beings have become kind and compassionate to me. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਅਨਦਿ ਰਹਉ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: jap anad rhau gur charanaa |
English: Meditating on the Guru's feet, I am in bliss.

Gurbani: ਭਉ ਕਤਹਿ ਨਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhau kateh nahee prabh saranaa | rahaau |
English: There is no fear at all, in God's Sanctuary. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਿਆ ਦਾਸਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: teriaa daasaa ridai muraaree |
English: You dwell in the hearts of Your slaves, Lord.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਬਿਚਲ ਨੀਵ ਉਸਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: prabh abichal neev usaaree |
English: God has laid the eternal foundation.

Gurbani: ਬਲੁ ਧਨੁ ਤਕੀਆ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: bal dhan takeea teraa |
English: You are my strength, wealth and support.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਭਾਰੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: too bhaaro tthaakur meraa |2|
English: You are my Almighty Lord and Master. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jin jin saadhasang paaeaa |
English: Whoever finds the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy,

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: so prabh aap taraaeaa |
English: is saved by God Himself.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਦੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa naam ras deea |
English: By His Grace, He has blessed me with the sublime essence of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਕੁਸਲ ਖੇਮ ਸਭ ਥੀਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kusal khem sabh theea |3|
English: All joy and pleasure then came to me. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹੋਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: hoe prabhoo sahaaee |
English: God became my helper and my best friend;

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਉਠਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sabh utth laagee paaee |
English: everyone rises up and bows down at my feet.

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: saas saas prabh dhiaaeeai |
English: With each and every breath, meditate on God;

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੪॥੪॥੫੪॥
Transliteration: har mangal naanak gaaeeai |4|4|54|
English: O Nanak, sing the songs of joy to the Lord. ||4||4||54||

[Ang 622 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: sookh sehaj aanandaa |
English: Celestial peace and bliss have come,

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: prabh milio man bhaavandaa |
English: meeting God, who is so pleasing to my mind.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: poorai gur kirapaa dhaaree |
English: The Perfect Guru showered me with His Mercy,

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਗਤਿ ਭਈ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: taa gat bhee hamaaree |1|
English: and I attained salvation. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: har kee prem bhagat man leenaa |
English: My mind is absorbed in loving devotional worship of the Lord,

Gurbani: ਨਿਤ ਬਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਤ ਬੀਨਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: nit baaje anahat beenaa | rahaau |
English: and the unstruck melody of the celestial sound current ever resounds within me. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਸਤਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: har charan kee ott sataanee |
English: The Lord's feet are my all-powerful shelter and support;

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਚੂਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ਲੋਕਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: sabh chookee kaan lokaanee |
English: my dependence on other people is totally finished.

Gurbani: ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jagajeevan daataa paaeaa |
English: I have found the Life of the world, the Great Giver;

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har rasak rasak gun gaaeaa |2|
English: in joyful rapture, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾਟਿਆ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਫਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kaattiaa jam kaa faasaa |
English: God has cut away the noose of death.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: man pooran hoee aasaa |
English: My mind's desires have been fulfilled;

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਪੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jeh pekhaa teh soee |
English: wherever I look, He is there.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har prabh bin avar na koee |3|
English: Without the Lord God, there is no other at all. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh raakhe |
English: In His Mercy, God has protected and preserved me.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਦੁਖ ਲਾਥੇ ॥
Transliteration: sabh janam janam dukh laathe |
English: I am rid of all the pains of countless incarnations.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: nirbhau naam dhiaaeaa |
English: I have meditated on the Naam, the Name of the Fearless Lord;

Gurbani: ਅਟਲ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੫॥੫੫॥
Transliteration: attal sukh naanak paaeaa |4|5|55|
English: O Nanak, I have found eternal peace. ||4||5||55||

[Ang 622 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਠਾਢਿ ਪਾਈ ਕਰਤਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: tthaadt paaee karataare |
English: The Creator has brought utter peace to my home;

Gurbani: ਤਾਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਰਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: taap chhodd geaa paravaare |
English: the fever has left my family.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹੈ ਰਾਖੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur poorai hai raakhee |
English: The Perfect Guru has saved us.

Gurbani: ਸਰਣਿ ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਤਾਕੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saran sache kee taakee |1|
English: I sought the Sanctuary of the True Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਆਪਿ ਹੋਆ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: paramesar aap hoaa rakhavaalaa |
English: The Transcendent Lord Himself has become my Protector.

Gurbani: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਉਪਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਾਲਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saant sehaj sukh khin meh upaje man hoaa sadaa sukhaalaa | rahaau |
English: Tranquility, intuitive peace and poise welled up in an instant, and my mind was comforted forever. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਓ ਦਾਰੂ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam deeo daaroo |
English: The Lord, Har, Har, gave me the medicine of His Name,

Gurbani: ਤਿਨਿ ਸਗਲਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਬਿਦਾਰੂ ॥
Transliteration: tin sagalaa rog bidaaroo |
English: which has cured all disease.

Gurbani: ਅਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: apanee kirapaa dhaaree |
English: He extended His Mercy to me,

Gurbani: ਤਿਨਿ ਸਗਲੀ ਬਾਤ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tin sagalee baat savaaree |2|
English: and resolved all these affairs. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸਮਾਰਿਆ ॥

English: God confirmed His loving nature;

Gurbani: ਬੋਲਾਇਆ ਬੋਲੀ ਤੇਰਾ ॥

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਖੀ ॥

English: God preserves the honor of His slaves. ||4||6||56||

[Ang 623 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]

Gurbani: ਵਾਲੁ ਨ ਵਿੰਗਾ ਹੋਆ ॥

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਨਾਸੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jap har har kilavikh naase |1|
English: meditating on the Lord, Har, Har, my sins were erased. ||1||

Transliteration: jo naavai so kul taraavai udhaar hoaa hai jee kaa |1| rahaau |
English: Whoever bathes in it, his family and ancestry are saved, and his soul is saved as well. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਹੀ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਨਾਇ ਆਏ ॥

English: Whoever comes and bathes here,

Transliteration: apanaa prabhoo dhiaae |2|

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਨਾਵੈ ॥

Gurbani: ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਈ ॥

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har har naam dhiaaee |3|
English: he meditates on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਚਾਰੁ ਸੁ ਜਾਨੈ ॥

English: He alone knows this about God,

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਭਗਵਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: jis deaal hoe bhagavaanai |
English: whom God blesses with His kindness.

Gurbani: ਬਾਬਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥

English: Baba Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God;

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਗਣਤ ਮਿਟਾਈ ॥੪॥੭॥੫੭॥

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥

English: My consciousness is focused on loving, devotional worship of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗਾ ॥੨॥

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਗਾਵੈ ॥

Transliteration: saadhaa kee dhooree naavai |
English: and bathes in the dust of the feet of the Holy.

Transliteration: prabh karanahaar rakh leea |3|

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਬਿਮਲ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥

Gurbani: ਦਾਸ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੪॥੮॥੫੮॥

English: slave Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of his Lord and Master. ||4||8||58||

Gurbani: ਜਮਕੰਕਰੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jamakankar nerr na aaeaa |

Gurbani: ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੯॥੫੯॥

Gurbani: ਰਾਮਦਾਸਿ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਨਾਤੇ ॥

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ॥

Transliteration: jan naanak naam dhiaaeaa |

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਰਖਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੬੦॥

Transliteration: mandar char kai panth nihaarau nain neer bhar aaeo |2|
English: Ascending to His Mansion, I gaze upon His path, and my eyes are filled with tears. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਭੀਤਿ ਭਇਓ ਹੈ ਬੀਚੋ ਸੁਨਤ ਦੇਸਿ ਨਿਕਟਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: hau hau bheet bheo hai beecho sunat des nikattaaeo |
English: The wall of egotism and pride separates us, but I can hear Him nearby.

Gurbani: ਭਾਂਭੀਰੀ ਕੇ ਪਾਤ ਪਰਦੋ ਬਿਨੁ ਪੇਖੇ ਦੂਰਾਇਓ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bhaanbheeree ke paat parado bin pekhe dooraaeo |3|
English: There is a veil between us, like the wings of a butterfly; without being able to see Him, He seems so far away. ||3||

Gurbani: ਭਇਓ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਸਰਬ ਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਗਰੋ ਦੂਖੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: bheo kirapaal sarab ko tthaakur sagaro dookh mittaaeo |
English: The Lord and Master of all has become merciful; He has dispelled all my sufferings.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉਮੈ ਭੀਤਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਈ ਤਉ ਦਇਆਰੁ ਬੀਠਲੋ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak haumai bheet gur khoee tau deaar beetthalo paaeo |4|
English: Says Nanak, when the Guru tore down the wall of egotism, then, I found my Merciful Lord and Master. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਰਹਿਓ ਅੰਦੇਸਰੋ ਮਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: sabh rahio andesaro maaeo |
English: All my fears have been dispelled, O mother!

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਚਾਹਤ ਸੋ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: jo chaahat so guroo milaaeo |
English: Whoever I seek, the Guru leads me to find.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਗੁਨਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਰਾਇਓ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧੧॥੬੧॥
Transliteration: sarab gunaa nidh raaeo | rahaau doojaa |11|61|
English: The Lord, our King, is the treasure of all virtue. ||Second Pause||11||61||

[Ang 624 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗਈ ਬਹੋੜੁ ਬੰਦੀ ਛੋੜੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਦੁਖਦਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: gee bahorr bandee chhorr nirankaar dukhadaaree |
English: The Restorer of what was taken away, the Liberator from captivity; the Formless Lord, the Destroyer of pain.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਲੋਭੀ ਮਾਇਆਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: karam na jaanaa dharam na jaanaa lobhee maaeaadhaaree |
English: I do not know about karma and good deeds; I do not know about Dharma and righteous living. I am so greedy, chasing after Maya.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਿਓ ਭਗਤੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕਾ ਇਹ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਪੈਜ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naam pario bhagat govind kaa ih raakhahu paij tumaaree |1|
English: I go by the name of God's devotee; please, save this honor of Yours. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਨਿਮਾਣਿਆ ਤੂ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: har jeeo nimaaniaa too maan |
English: O Dear Lord, You are the honor of the dishonored.

Gurbani: ਨਿਚੀਜਿਆ ਚੀਜ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: nicheejiaa cheej kare meraa govind teree kudarat kau kurabaan | rahaau |
English: You make the unworthy ones worthy, O my Lord of the Universe; I am a sacrifice to Your almighty creative power. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੈਸਾ ਬਾਲਕੁ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਭਾਈ ਲਖ ਅਪਰਾਧ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jaisaa baalak bhaae subhaaee lakh aparaadh kamaavai |
English: Like the child, innocently making thousands of mistakes

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਝਿੜਕੇ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤੀ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਪਿਤਾ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: kar upades jhirrake bahu bhaatee bahurr pitaa gal laavai |
English: his father teaches him, and scolds him so many times, but still, he hugs him close in his embrace.

Gurbani: ਪਿਛਲੇ ਅਉਗੁਣ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਗੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: pichhale aaugun bakhas le prabh aagai maarag paavai |2|
English: Please forgive my past actions, God, and place me on Your path for the future. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਤਾ ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: har antarajaamee sabh bidh jaanai taa kis peh aakh sunaaeeai |
English: The Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, knows all about my state of mind; so who else should I go to and speak to?

Gurbani: ਕਹਣੈ ਕਥਨਿ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: kahanai kathan na bheejai gobind har bhaavai paij rakhaaeeai |
English: The Lord, the Lord of the Universe, is not pleased by mere recitation of words; if it is pleasing to His Will, He preserves our honor.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰ ਓਟ ਮੈ ਸਗਲੀ ਦੇਖੀ ਇਕ ਤੇਰੀ ਓਟ ਰਹਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: avar ott mai sagalee dekhee ik teree ott rahaaeeai |3|
English: I have seen all other shelters, but Yours alone remains for me. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਸੁਣੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: hoe deaal kirapaal prabh tthaakur aape sunai benantee |
English: Becoming kind and compassionate, God the Lord and Master Himself listens to my prayer.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਚੂਕੈ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: pooraa satagur mel milaavai sabh chookai man kee chintee |
English: He unites me in Union with the Perfect True Guru, and all the cares and anxieties of my mind are dispelled.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਵਖਦੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸੰਤੀ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੬੨॥
Transliteration: har har naam avakhad mukh paaeaa jan naanak sukh vasantee |4|12|62|
English: The Lord, Har, Har, has placed the medicine of the Naam into my mouth; servant Nanak abides in peace. ||4||12||62||

[Ang 625 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਦੁਖ ਕਲੇਸ ਸਭਿ ਨਾਠੇ ॥
Transliteration: simar simar prabh bhe anandaa dukh kales sabh naatthe |
English: Remembering, remembering God in meditation, bliss ensues, and one is rid of all suffering and pain.

Gurbani: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਧਿਆਵਤ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲੇ ਸਾਂਠੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gun gaavat dhiaavat prabh apanaa kaaraj sagale saantthe |1|
English: Singing the Glorious Praises of God, and meditating on Him, all my affairs are brought into harmony. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jagajeevan naam tumaaraa |
English: Your Name is the Life of the world.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਦੀਓ ਉਪਦੇਸਾ ਜਪਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur poore deeo upadesaa jap bhaujal paar utaaraa | rahaau |
English: The Perfect Guru has taught me, that by meditating, I cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੂਹੈ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਸੁਨਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੂਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: toohai mantree suneh prabh toohai sabh kichh karanaihaaraa |
English: You are Your own advisor; You hear everything, God, and You do everything.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਦਾਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਇਹੁ ਜੰਤੁ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: too aape daataa aape bhugataa kiaa ihu jant vichaaraa |2|
English: You Yourself are the Giver, and You Yourself are the Enjoyer. What can this poor creature do? ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa gun tere aakh vakhaanee keemat kehan na jaaee |
English: Which of Your Glorious Virtues should I describe and speak of? Your value cannot be described.

Gurbani: ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਵਡਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: pekh pekh jeevai prabh apanaa acharaj tumeh vaddaaee |3|
English: I live by beholding, beholding You, O God. Your glorious greatness is wonderful and amazing! ||3||

Gurbani: ਧਾਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸ੍ਵਾਮੀ ਪਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਪੂਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: dhaar anugrahu aap prabh svaamee pat mat keenee pooree |
English: Granting His Grace, God my Lord and Master Himself saved my honor, and my intellect has been made perfect.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਬਾਛਉ ਸੰਤਾ ਧੂਰੀ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੬੩॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa naanak balihaaree baachhau santaa dhooree |4|13|63|
English: Forever and ever, Nanak is a sacrifice, longing for the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||4||13||63||

[Ang 625 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur pooraa namasakaare |
English: I bow in reverence to the Perfect Guru.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸਭੇ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: prabh sabhe kaaj savaare |
English: God has resolved all my affairs.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਅਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: har apanee kirapaa dhaaree |
English: The Lord has showered me with His Mercy.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: prabh pooran paij savaaree |1|
English: God has perfectly preserved my honor. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਕੋ ਭਇਓ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: apane daas ko bheo sahaaee |
English: He has become the help and support of His slave.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਕੀਨੇ ਕਰਤੈ ਊਣੀ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sagal manorath keene karatai aoonee baat na kaaee | rahaau |
English: The Creator has achieved all my goals, and now, nothing is lacking. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਰਤੈ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਤਾਲੁ ਦਿਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: karatai purakh taal divaaeaa |
English: The Creator Lord has caused the pool of nectar to be constructed.

Gurbani: ਪਿਛੈ ਲਗਿ ਚਲੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: pichhai lag chalee maaeaa |
English: The wealth of Maya follows in my footsteps,

Gurbani: ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: tott na katahoo aavai |
English: and now, nothing is lacking at all.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mere poore satagur bhaavai |2|
English: This is pleasing to my Perfect True Guru. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: simar simar deaalaa |
English: Remembering, remembering the Merciful Lord in meditation,

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਭਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabh jeea bhe kirapaalaa |
English: all beings have become kind and compassionate to me.

Gurbani: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jai jai kaar gusaaee |
English: Hail! Hail to the Lord of the world,

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jin pooree banat banaaee |3|
English: who created the perfect creation. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਭਾਰੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੋਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: too bhaaro suaamee moraa |
English: You are my Great Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: eihu pun padaarath teraa |
English: These blessings and wealth are Yours.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jan naanak ek dhiaaeaa |
English: Servant Nanak has meditated on the One Lord;

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਫਲਾ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੬੪॥
Transliteration: sarab falaa pun paaeaa |4|14|64|
English: he has obtained the fruitful rewards for all good deeds. ||4||14||64||

[Ang 625 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 ghar 3 dupade |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl, Third House, Dho-Padhay:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਸਰੋਵਰਿ ਨਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: raamadaas sarovar naate |
English: Bathing in the nectar tank of Ram Das,

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਉਤਰੇ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: sabh utare paap kamaate |
English: all sins are erased.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਏ ਕਰਿ ਇਸਨਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: niramal hoe kar isanaanaa |
English: One becomes immaculately pure, taking this cleansing bath.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਕੀਨੇ ਦਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur poorai keene daanaa |1|
English: The Perfect Guru has bestowed this gift. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਕੁਸਲ ਖੇਮ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kusal khem prabh dhaare |
English: God has blessed all with peace and pleasure.

Gurbani: ਸਹੀ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਸਭਿ ਥੋਕ ਉਬਾਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sahee salaamat sabh thok ubaare gur kaa sabad veechaare | rahaau |
English: Everything is safe and sound, as we contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਥੀ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang mal laathee |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, filth is washed off.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਭਇਓ ਸਾਥੀ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham bheo saathee |
English: The Supreme Lord God has become our friend and helper.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: naanak naam dhiaaeaa |
English: Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥੧॥੬੫॥
Transliteration: aad purakh prabh paaeaa |2|1|65|
English: He has found God, the Primal Being. ||2||1||65||

[Ang 625 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jit paarabraham chit aaeaa |
English: The Supreme Lord God has established that home,

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਦਯਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: so ghar day vasaaeaa |
English: In which He comes to mind.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sukh saagar gur paaeaa |
English: I found the Guru, the ocean of peace,

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਸਹਸਾ ਸਗਲ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: taa sahasaa sagal mittaaeaa |1|
English: And all my doubts were dispelled. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: har ke naam kee vaddiaaee |
English: This is the glorious greatness of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar gun gaaee |
English: Twenty-four hours a day, I sing His Glorious Praises.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur poore te paaee | rahaau |
English: I obtained this from the Perfect Guru. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kee akath kahaanee |
English: God's sermon is inexpressible.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: jan boleh amrit baanee |
English: His humble servants speak words of Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: naanak daas vakhaanee |
English: Slave Nanak has spoken.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੨॥੨॥੬੬॥
Transliteration: gur poore te jaanee |2|2|66|
English: Through the Perfect Guru, it is known. ||2||2||66||

[Ang 626 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਗੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: aagai sukh gur deea |
English: The Guru has blessed me with peace here,

Gurbani: ਪਾਛੈ ਕੁਸਲ ਖੇਮ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: paachhai kusal khem gur keea |
English: and the Guru has arranged peace and pleasure for me hereafter.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sarab nidhaan sukh paaeaa |
English: I have all treasures and comforts,

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur apunaa ridai dhiaaeaa |1|
English: meditating on the Guru in my heart. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: apane satigur kee vaddiaaee |
English: This is the glorious greatness of my True Guru;

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: man ichhe fal paaee |
English: I have obtained the fruits of my mind's desires.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: santahu din din charrai savaaee | rahaau |
English: O Saints, His Glory increases day by day. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jant sabh bhe deaalaa prabh apane kar deene |
English: All beings and creatures have become kind and compassionate to me; my God has made them so.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਤੀਨੇ ॥੨॥੩॥੬੭॥
Transliteration: sehaj subhaae mile gopaalaa naanak saach pateene |2|3|67|
English: Nanak has met with the Lord of the world with intuitive ease, and with Truth, he is pleased. ||2||3||67||

[Ang 626 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਖਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa sabad rakhavaare |
English: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is my Saving Grace.

Gurbani: ਚਉਕੀ ਚਉਗਿਰਦ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: chaukee chaugirad hamaare |
English: It is a guardian posted on all four sides around me.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam man laagaa |
English: My mind is attached to the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਜਮੁ ਲਜਾਇ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jam lajaae kar bhaagaa |1|
English: The Messenger of Death has run away in shame. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੋ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: prabh jee too mero sukhadaataa |
English: O Dear Lord, You are my Giver of peace.

Gurbani: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਕਰੇ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bandhan kaatt kare man niramal pooran purakh bidhaataa | rahaau |
English: The Perfect Lord, the Architect of Destiny, has shattered my bonds, and made my mind immaculately pure. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: naanak prabh abinaasee |
English: O Nanak, God is eternal and imperishable.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਜਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: taa kee sev na birathee jaasee |
English: Service to Him shall never go unrewarded.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: anad kareh tere daasaa |
English: Your slaves are in bliss;

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਆਸਾ ॥੨॥੪॥੬੮॥
Transliteration: jap pooran hoee aasaa |2|4|68|
English: chanting and meditating, their desires are fulfilled. ||2||4||68||

[Ang 626 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur apune balihaaree |
English: I am a sacrifice to my Guru.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jin pooran paij savaaree |
English: He has totally preserved my honor.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: man chindiaa fal paaeaa |
English: I have obtained the fruits of my mind's desires.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: prabh apunaa sadaa dhiaaeaa |1|
English: I meditate forever on my God. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: santahu tis bin avar na koee |
English: O Saints, without Him, there is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: karan kaaran prabh soee | rahaau |
English: He is God, the Cause of causes. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨੈ ਵਰ ਦੀਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: prabh apanai var deene |
English: My God has given me His Blessing.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਜੀਅ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: sagal jeea vas keene |
English: He has made all creatures subject to me.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jan naanak naam dhiaaeaa |
English: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord,

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥੨॥੫॥੬੯॥
Transliteration: taa sagale dookh mittaaeaa |2|5|69|
English: and all his sorrows depart. ||2||5||69||

[Ang 626 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤਾਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: taap gavaaeaa gur poore |
English: The Perfect Guru has dispelled the fever.

Gurbani: ਵਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਤੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: vaaje anahad toore |
English: The unstruck melody of the sound current resounds.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: sarab kaliaan prabh keene |
English: God has bestowed all comforts.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਦੀਨੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa aap deene |1|
English: In His Mercy, He Himself has given them. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬੇਦਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: bedan satigur aap gavaaee |
English: The True Guru Himself has eradicated the disease.

Gurbani: ਸਿਖ ਸੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਸਰਸੇ ਹੋਏ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sikh sant sabh sarase hoe har har naam dhiaaee | rahaau |
English: All the Sikhs and Saints are filled with joy, meditating on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਮੰਗਹਿ ਸੋ ਲੇਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jo mangeh so leveh |
English: They obtain that which they ask for.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਣਿਆ ਸੰਤਾ ਦੇਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: prabh apaniaa santaa deveh |
English: God gives to His Saints.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: har govid prabh raakhiaa |
English: God saved Hargobind.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੁ ਸੁਭਾਖਿਆ ॥੨॥੬॥੭੦॥
Transliteration: jan naanak saach subhaakhiaa |2|6|70|
English: Servant Nanak speaks the Truth. ||2||6||70||

[Ang 626 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਕਰਾਇ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: soee karaae jo tudh bhaavai |
English: You make me do what pleases You.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: mohi siaanap kachhoo na aavai |
English: I have no cleverness at all.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤਉ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ham baarik tau saranaaee |
English: I am just a child - I seek Your Protection.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: prabh aape paij rakhaaee |1|
English: God Himself preserves my honor. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: meraa maat pitaa har raaeaa |
English: The Lord is my King; He is my mother and father.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਣ ਲਾਗਾ ਕਰਂੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa pratipaalan laagaa karanee teraa karaaeaa | rahaau |
English: In Your Mercy, You cherish me; I do whatever You make me do. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jant tere dhaare |
English: The beings and creatures are Your creation.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਡੋਰੀ ਹਾਥਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: prabh ddoree haath tumaare |
English: O God, their reins are in Your hands.

Gurbani: ਜਿ ਕਰਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: ji karaavai so karanaa |
English: Whatever You cause us to do, we do.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾ ॥੨॥੭॥੭੧॥
Transliteration: naanak daas teree saranaa |2|7|71|
English: Nanak, Your slave, seeks Your Protection. ||2||7||71||

[Ang 627 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਪਰੋਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: har naam ridai paroeaa |
English: I have woven the Lord's Name into the fabric of my heart.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਾਜੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਹੋਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kaaj hamaaraa hoeaa |
English: All my affairs are resolved.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: prabh charanee man laagaa |
English: His mind is attached to God's feet,

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: pooran jaa ke bhaagaa |1|
English: whose destiny is perfect. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: mil saadhasang har dhiaaeaa |
English: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I meditate on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਅਰਾਧਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar araadhio har har man chindiaa fal paaeaa | rahaau |
English: Twenty-four hours a day, I worship and adore the Lord, Har, Har; I have obtained the fruits of my mind's desires. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪਰਾ ਪੂਰਬਲਾ ਅੰਕੁਰੁ ਜਾਗਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: paraa poorabalaa ankur jaagiaa |
English: The seeds of my past actions have sprouted.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam man laagiaa |
English: My mind is attached to the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: man tan har daras samaavai |
English: My mind and body are absorbed into the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੮॥੭੨॥
Transliteration: naanak daas sache gun gaavai |2|8|72|
English: Slave Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord. ||2||8||72||

[Ang 627 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਚਿਤਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur mil prabhoo chitaariaa |
English: Meeting with the Guru, I contemplate God.

Gurbani: ਕਾਰਜ ਸਭਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: kaaraj sabh savaariaa |
English: All of my affairs have been resolved.

Gurbani: ਮੰਦਾ ਕੋ ਨ ਅਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: mandaa ko na alaae |
English: No one speaks ill of me.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sabh jai jai kaar sunaae |1|
English: Everyone congratulates me on my victory. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਸਾਚੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: santahu saachee saran suaamee |
English: O Saints, I seek the True Sanctuary of the Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਹਾਥਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਕੈ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jant sabh haath tisai kai so prabh antarajaamee | rahaau |
English: All beings and creatures are in His hands; He is God, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਰਤਬ ਸਭਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: karatab sabh savaare |
English: He has resolved all of my affairs.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸਮਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: prabh apunaa birad samaare |
English: God has confirmed His innate nature.

Gurbani: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: patit paavan prabh naamaa |
English: God's Name is the Purifier of sinners.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾ ॥੨॥੯॥੭੩॥
Transliteration: jan naanak sad kurabaanaa |2|9|73|
English: Servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||9||73||

[Ang 627 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham saaj savaariaa |
English: The Supreme Lord God created and embellished him.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਲਹੁੜਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਉਬਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: eihu lahurraa guroo ubaariaa |
English: The Guru has saved this small child.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦ ਕਰਹੁ ਪਿਤ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: anad karahu pit maataa |
English: So celebrate and be happy, father and mother.

Gurbani: ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: paramesar jeea kaa daataa |1|
English: The Transcendent Lord is the Giver of souls. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁਭ ਚਿਤਵਨਿ ਦਾਸ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: subh chitavan daas tumaare |
English: Your slaves, O Lord, focus on pure thoughts.

Gurbani: ਰਾਖਹਿ ਪੈਜ ਦਾਸ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਕਾਰਜ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raakheh paij daas apune kee kaaraj aap savaare | rahaau |
English: You preserve the honor of Your slaves, and You Yourself arrange their affairs. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: meraa prabh praupakaaree |
English: My God is so benevolent.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਕਲ ਜਿਨਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: pooran kal jin dhaaree |
English: His Almighty Power is manifest.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: naanak saranee aaeaa |
English: Nanak has come to His Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੭੪॥
Transliteration: man chindiaa fal paaeaa |2|10|74|
English: He has obtained the fruits of his mind's desires. ||2||10||74||

[Ang 627 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa har jaape |
English: Forever and ever, I chant the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਾਲਕ ਰਾਖੇ ਆਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: prabh baalak raakhe aape |
English: God Himself has saved my child.

Gurbani: ਸੀਤਲਾ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: seetalaa tthaak rahaaee |
English: He healed him from the smallpox.

Gurbani: ਬਿਘਨ ਗਏ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bighan ge har naaee |1|
English: My troubles have been removed through the Lord's Name. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: meraa prabh hoaa sadaa deaalaa |
English: My God is forever Merciful.

Gurbani: ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਜੀਅ ਭਇਆ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aradaas sunee bhagat apune kee sabh jeea bheaa kirapaalaa | rahaau |
English: He heard the prayer of His devotee, and now all beings are kind and compassionate to him. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਾਥਾ ॥
Transliteration: prabh karan kaaran samaraathaa |
English: God is Almighty, the Cause of causes.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਥਾ ॥
Transliteration: har simarat sabh dukh laathaa |
English: Remembering the Lord in meditation, all pains and sorrows vanish.

Gurbani: ਅਪਣੇ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਸੁਣੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: apane daas kee sunee benantee |
English: He has heard the prayer of His slave.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਵੰਤੀ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੭੫॥
Transliteration: sabh naanak sukh savantee |2|11|75|
English: O Nanak, now everyone sleeps in peace. ||2||11||75||

[Ang 627 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਪਨਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: apanaa guroo dhiaae |
English: I meditated on my Guru.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਕੁਸਲ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: mil kusal setee ghar aae |
English: I met with Him, and returned home in joy.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੈ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: naamai kee vaddiaaee |
English: This is the glorious greatness of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tis keemat kehan na jaaee |1|
English: Its value cannot be estimated. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: santahu har har har aaraadhahu |
English: O Saints, worship and adore the Lord, Har, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਿ ਸਭੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲੇ ਸਾਧਹੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har aaraadh sabho kichh paaeeai kaaraj sagale saadhahu | rahaau |
English: Worship the Lord in adoration, and you shall obtain everything; your affairs shall all be resolved. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: prem bhagat prabh laagee |
English: He alone is attached in loving devotion to God,

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: so paae jis vaddabhaagee |
English: who realizes his great destiny.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jan naanak naam dhiaaeaa |
English: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨਿ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੭੬॥
Transliteration: tin sarab sukhaa fal paaeaa |2|12|76|
English: He obtains the rewards of all joys and peace. ||2||12||76||

[Ang 627 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਦਿਤਾ ਬੰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: paramesar ditaa banaa |
English: The Transcendent Lord has given me His support.

Gurbani: ਦੁਖ ਰੋਗ ਕਾ ਡੇਰਾ ਭੰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: dukh rog kaa dderaa bhanaa |
English: The house of pain and disease has been demolished.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਰ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: anad kareh nar naaree |
English: The men and women celebrate.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har har prabh kirapaa dhaaree |1|
English: The Lord God, Har, Har, has extended His Mercy. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: santahu sukh hoaa sabh thaaee |
English: O Saints, there is peace everywhere.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭਨੀ ਜਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham pooran paramesar rav rahiaa sabhanee jaaee | rahaau |
English: The Supreme Lord God, the Perfect Transcendent Lord, is pervading everywhere. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਧੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: dhur kee baanee aaee |
English: The Bani of His Word emanated from the Primal Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨਿ ਸਗਲੀ ਚਿੰਤ ਮਿਟਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: tin sagalee chint mittaaee |
English: It eradicates all anxiety.

Gurbani: ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: deaal purakh miharavaanaa |
English: The Lord is merciful, kind and compassionate.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੁ ਵਖਾਨਾ ॥੨॥੧੩॥੭੭॥
Transliteration: har naanak saach vakhaanaa |2|13|77|
English: Nanak chants the Naam, the Name of the True Lord. ||2||13||77||

[Ang 628 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: aithai othai rakhavaalaa |
English: Here and hereafter, He is our Savior.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: prabh satigur deen deaalaa |
English: God, the True Guru, is Merciful to the meek.

Gurbani: ਦਾਸ ਅਪਨੇ ਆਪਿ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
Transliteration: daas apane aap raakhe |
English: He Himself protects His slaves.

Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਭਾਖੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt sabad subhaakhe |1|
English: In each and every heart, the Beautiful Word of His Shabad resounds. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਊਪਰਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur ke charan aoopar bal jaaee |
English: I am a sacrifice to the Guru's Feet.

Gurbani: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਮਾਲੀ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dinas rain saas saas samaalee pooran sabhanee thaaee | rahaau |
English: Day and night, with each and every breath, I remember Him; He is totally pervading and permeating all places. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਹੋਆ ॥
Transliteration: aap sahaaee hoaa |
English: He Himself has become my help and support.

Gurbani: ਸਚੇ ਦਾ ਸਚਾ ਢੋਆ ॥
Transliteration: sache daa sachaa dtoaa |
English: True is the support of the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: teree bhagat vaddiaaee |
English: Glorious and great is devotional worship to You.

Gurbani: ਪਾਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੨॥੧੪॥੭੮॥
Transliteration: paaee naanak prabh saranaaee |2|14|78|
English: Nanak has found God's Sanctuary. ||2||14||78||

[Ang 628 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: satigur poore bhaanaa |
English: When it was pleasing to the Perfect True Guru,

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਜਪਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਮਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: taa japiaa naam ramaanaa |
English: then I chanted the Naam, the Name of the Pervading Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: gobind kirapaa dhaaree |
English: The Lord of the Universe extended His Mercy to me,

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਪੈਜ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: prabh raakhee paij hamaaree |1|
English: and God saved my honor. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har ke charan sadaa sukhadaaee |
English: The Lord's feet are forever peace-giving.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਇਛਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਆਸ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo ichheh soee fal paaveh birathee aas na jaaee |1| rahaau |
English: Whatever fruit one desires, he receives; his hopes shall not go in vain. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੋਈ ਸੰਤੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: kripaa kare jis praanapat daataa soee sant gun gaavai |
English: That Saint, unto whom the Lord of Life, the Great Giver, extends His Mercy - he alone sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਣਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: prem bhagat taa kaa man leenaa paarabraham man bhaavai |2|
English: His soul is absorbed in loving devotional worship; his mind is pleasing to the Supreme Lord God. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਜਸੁ ਰਵਣਾ ਬਿਖੈ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਲਾਥੀ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar har kaa jas ravanaa bikhai tthgauree laathee |
English: Twenty-four hours a day, he chants the Praises of the Lord, and the bitter poison does not affect him.

Gurbani: ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਲੀਆ ਮੇਰੈ ਕਰਤੈ ਸੰਤ ਸਾਧ ਭਏ ਸਾਥੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sang milaae leea merai karatai sant saadh bhe saathee |3|
English: My Creator Lord has united me with Himself, and the Holy Saints have become my companions. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਦੀਨੇ ਆਪਹਿ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kar geh leene sarabas deene aapeh aap milaaeaa |
English: Taking me by the hand, He has given me everything, and blended me with Himself.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਬ ਥੋਕ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੭੯॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak sarab thok pooran pooraa satigur paaeaa |4|15|79|
English: Says Nanak, everything has been perfectly resolved; I have found the Perfect True Guru. ||4||15||79||

[Ang 628 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗਰੀਬੀ ਗਦਾ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: gareebee gadaa hamaaree |
English: Humility is my spiked club.

Gurbani: ਖੰਨਾ ਸਗਲ ਰੇਨੁ ਛਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: khanaa sagal ren chhaaree |
English: My dagger is to be the dust of all men's feet.

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਕੋ ਨ ਟਿਕੈ ਵੇਕਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: eis aagai ko na ttikai vekaaree |
English: No evil-doer can withstand these weapons.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਏਹ ਗਲ ਸਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur poore eeh gal saaree |1|
English: The Perfect Guru has given me this understanding. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਓਟਾ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam santan kee ottaa |
English: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is the support and shelter of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਉਧਰਹਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੋਟਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo simarai tis kee gat hovai udhareh sagale kottaa |1| rahaau |
