English: One who remembers the Lord in meditation, is emancipated; millions have been saved in this way. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sant sang jas gaaeaa |
English: In the Society of the Saints, I sing His Praises.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: eihu pooran har dhan paaeaa |
English: I have found this, the perfect wealth of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak aap mittaaeaa |
English: Says Nanak, I have eradicated my self-conceit.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥੧੬॥੮੦॥
Transliteration: sabh paarabraham nadaree aaeaa |2|16|80|
English: I see the Supreme Lord God everywhere. ||2||16||80||

[Ang 628 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪੂਰੀ ਕੀਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur poorai pooree keenee |
English: The Perfect Guru has done it perfectly.

Gurbani: ਬਖਸ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: bakhas apunee kar deenee |
English: He blessed me with forgiveness.

Gurbani: ਨਿਤ ਅਨੰਦ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: nit anand sukh paaeaa |
English: I have found lasting peace and bliss.

Gurbani: ਥਾਵ ਸਗਲੇ ਸੁਖੀ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: thaav sagale sukhee vasaaeaa |1|
English: Everywhere, the people dwell in peace. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਫਲ ਦਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: har kee bhagat fal daatee |
English: Devotional worship to the Lord is what gives rewards.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਜਾਤੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur poorai kirapaa kar deenee viralai kin hee jaatee | rahaau |
English: The Perfect Guru, by His Grace, gave it to me; how rare are those who know this. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਗਾਵਹ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: gurabaanee gaavah bhaaee |
English: Sing the Word of the Guru's Bani, O Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਓਹ ਸਫਲ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: oeh safal sadaa sukhadaaee |
English: That is always rewarding and peace-giving.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: naanak naam dhiaaeaa |
English: Nanak has meditated on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥੧੭॥੮੧॥
Transliteration: poorab likhiaa paaeaa |2|17|81|
English: He has realized his pre-ordained destiny. ||2||17||81||

[Ang 628 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਆਰਾਧੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur pooraa aaraadhe |
English: I worship and adore the Perfect Guru.

Gurbani: ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲੇ ਸਾਧੇ ॥
Transliteration: kaaraj sagale saadhe |
English: All my affairs have been resolved.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sagal manorath poore |
English: All desires have been fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਬਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਤੂਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: baaje anahad toore |1|
English: The unstruck melody of the sound current resounds. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: santahu raam japat sukh paaeaa |
English: O Saints, meditating on the Lord, we obtain peace.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਅਸਥਾਨਿ ਬਸੇ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sant asathaan base sukh sahaje sagale dookh mittaaeaa |1| rahaau |
English: In the home of the Saints, celestial peace is pervading; all pain and suffering is dispelled. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur poore kee baanee |
English: The Word of the Perfect Guru's Bani

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham man bhaanee |
English: is pleasing to the Mind of the Supreme Lord God.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: naanak daas vakhaanee |
English: Slave Nanak speaks

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥੨॥੧੮॥੮੨॥
Transliteration: niramal akath kahaanee |2|18|82|
English: the Unspoken, immaculate sermon of the Lord. ||2||18||82||

[Ang 629 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਭੂਖੇ ਖਾਵਤ ਲਾਜ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: bhookhe khaavat laaj na aavai |
English: The hungry man is not ashamed to eat.

Gurbani: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tiau har jan har gun gaavai |1|
English: Just so, the humble servant of the Lord sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੇ ਕਾਜ ਕਉ ਕਿਉ ਅਲਕਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: apane kaaj kau kiau alakaaeeai |
English: Why are you so lazy in your own affairs?

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jit simaran daragah mukh aoojal sadaa sadaa sukh paaeeai |1| rahaau |
English: Remembering Him in meditation, your face shall be radiant in the Court of the Lord; you shall find peace, forever and ever. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਕਾਮੀ ਕਾਮਿ ਲੁਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jiau kaamee kaam lubhaavai |
English: Just as the lustful man is enticed by lust,

Gurbani: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tiau har daas har jas bhaavai |2|
English: so is the Lord's slave pleased with the Lord's Praise. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਮਾਤਾ ਬਾਲਿ ਲਪਟਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jiau maataa baal lapattaavai |
English: Just as the mother holds her baby close,

Gurbani: ਤਿਉ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tiau giaanee naam kamaavai |3|
English: so does the spiritual person cherish the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur poore te paavai |
English: This is obtained from the Perfect Guru.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥੪॥੧੯॥੮੩॥
Transliteration: jan naanak naam dhiaavai |4|19|83|
English: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||19||83||

[Ang 629 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਂਦਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sukh saand ghar aaeaa |
English: Safe and sound, I have returned home.

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: nindak kai mukh chhaaeaa |
English: The slanderer's face is blackened with ashes.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਹਿਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: poorai gur pahiraaeaa |
English: The Perfect Guru has dressed in robes of honor.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਸੇ ਦੁਖ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: binase dukh sabaaeaa |1|
English: All my pains and sufferings are over. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: santahu saache kee vaddiaaee |
English: O Saints, this is the glorious greatness of the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਅਚਰਜ ਸੋਭ ਬਣਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jin acharaj sobh banaaee |1| rahaau |
English: He has created such wonder and glory! ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬੋਲੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: bole saahib kai bhaanai |
English: I speak according to the Will of my Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਦਾਸੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: daas baanee braham vakhaanai |
English: God's slave chants the Word of His Bani.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: naanak prabh sukhadaaee |
English: O Nanak, God is the Giver of peace.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥੨॥੨੦॥੮੪॥
Transliteration: jin pooree banat banaaee |2|20|84|
English: He has created the perfect creation. ||2||20||84||

[Ang 629 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: prabh apunaa ridai dhiaae |
English: Within my heart, I meditate on God.

Gurbani: ਘਰਿ ਸਹੀ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: ghar sahee salaamat aae |
English: I have returned home safe and sound.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਭਇਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: santokh bheaa sansaare |
English: The world has become contented.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਲੈ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur poorai lai taare |1|
English: The Perfect Guru has saved me. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: santahu prabh meraa sadaa deaalaa |
English: O Saints, my God is forever merciful.

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੇ ਭਗਤ ਕੀ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਗਣਈ ਰਾਖੈ ਬਾਲ ਗੁਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: apane bhagat kee ganat na ganee raakhai baal gupaalaa |1| rahaau |
English: The Lord of the world does not call His devotee to account; He protects His children. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har naam ridai ur dhaare |
English: I have enshrined the Lord's Name within my heart.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨਿ ਸਭੇ ਥੋਕ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: tin sabhe thok savaare |
English: He has resolved all my affairs.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਤੁਸਿ ਦੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur poorai tus deea |
English: The Perfect Guru was pleased, and blessed me,

Gurbani: ਫਿਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਥੀਆ ॥੨॥੨੧॥੮੫॥
Transliteration: fir naanak dookh na theea |2|21|85|
English: and now, Nanak shall never again suffer pain. ||2||21||85||

[Ang 629 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: har man tan vasiaa soee |
English: The Lord abides in my mind and body.

Gurbani: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jai jai kaar kare sabh koee |
English: Everyone congratulates me on my victory.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur poore kee vaddiaaee |
English: This is the glorious greatness of the Perfect Guru.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: taa kee keemat kahee na jaaee |1|
English: His value cannot be described. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ਜਾਈ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: hau kurabaan jaaee tere naavai |
English: I am a sacrifice to Your Name.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸੋ ਜਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jis no bakhas laihi mere piaare so jas teraa gaavai |1| rahaau |
English: He alone, whom You have forgiven, O my Beloved, sings Your Praises. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਭਾਰੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: toon bhaaro suaamee meraa |
English: You are my Great Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਾਂ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: santaan bharavaasaa teraa |
English: You are the support of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: naanak prabh saranaaee |
English: Nanak has entered God's Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਮੁਖਿ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕੈ ਛਾਈ ॥੨॥੨੨॥੮੬॥
Transliteration: mukh nindak kai chhaaee |2|22|86|
English: The faces of the slanderers are blackened with ashes. ||2||22||86||

[Ang 629 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਗੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: aagai sukh mere meetaa |
English: Peace in this world, O my friends,

Gurbani: ਪਾਛੇ ਆਨਦੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: paachhe aanad prabh keetaa |
English: and bliss in the world hereafter - God has given me this.

Gurbani: ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰਿ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: paramesur banat banaaee |
English: The Transcendent Lord has arranged these arrangements;

Gurbani: ਫਿਰਿ ਡੋਲਤ ਕਤਹੂ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: fir ddolat katahoo naahee |1|
English: I shall never waver again. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: saache saahib siau man maaniaa |
English: My mind is pleased with the True Lord Master.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har sarab nirantar jaaniaa |1| rahaau |
English: I know the Lord to be pervading all. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabh jeea tere deaalaa |
English: All beings are Yours, O Merciful Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੇ ਭਗਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: apane bhagat kareh pratipaalaa |
English: You cherish Your devotees.

Gurbani: ਅਚਰਜੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: acharaj teree vaddiaaee |
English: Your glorious greatness is wonderful and marvellous.

Gurbani: ਨਿਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੨॥੨੩॥੮੭॥
Transliteration: nit naanak naam dhiaaee |2|23|87|
English: Nanak ever meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||23||87||

[Ang 630 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਲਿ ਨਰਾਇਣੁ ਮੇਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: naal naraaein merai |
English: The Lord is always with me.

Gurbani: ਜਮਦੂਤੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨੇਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: jamadoot na aavai nerai |
English: The Messenger of Death does not approach me.

Gurbani: ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: kantth laae prabh raakhai |
English: God holds me close in His embrace, and protects me.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਖੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: satigur kee sach saakhai |1|
English: True are the Teachings of the True Guru. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪੂਰੀ ਕੀਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur poorai pooree keetee |
English: The Perfect Guru has done it perfectly.

Gurbani: ਦੁਸਮਨ ਮਾਰਿ ਵਿਡਾਰੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਦੀਤੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dusaman maar viddaare sagale daas kau sumat deetee |1| rahaau |
English: He has beaten and driven off my enemies, and given me, His slave, the sublime understanding of the neutral mind. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਥਾਨ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: prabh sagale thaan vasaae |
English: God has blessed all places with prosperity.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖਿ ਸਾਂਦਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: sukh saand fir aae |
English: I have returned again safe and sound.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: naanak prabh saranaae |
English: Nanak has entered God's Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਰੋਗ ਮਿਟਾਏ ॥੨॥੨੪॥੮੮॥
Transliteration: jin sagale rog mittaae |2|24|88|
English: It has eradicated all disease. ||2||24||88||

[Ang 630 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਨੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: sarab sukhaa kaa daataa satigur taa kee saranee paaeeai |
English: The True Guru is the Giver of all peace and comfort - seek His Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਹੋਤ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਗਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: darasan bhettat hot anandaa dookh geaa har gaaeeai |1|
English: Beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, bliss ensues, pain is dispelled, and one sings the Lord's Praises. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har ras peevahu bhaaee |
English: Drink in the sublime essence of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਨਾਮੋ ਆਰਾਧਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: naam japahu naamo aaraadhahu gur poore kee saranaaee | rahaau |
English: Chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord; worship the Naam in adoration, and enter the Sanctuary of the Perfect Guru. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋਈ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: tiseh paraapat jis dhur likhiaa soee pooran bhaaee |
English: Only one who has such pre-ordained destiny receives it; he alone becomes perfect, O Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹਾ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੨॥੨੫॥੮੯॥
Transliteration: naanak kee benantee prabh jee naam rahaa liv laaee |2|25|89|
English: Nanak's prayer, O Dear God, is to remain lovingly absorbed in the Naam. ||2||25||89||

[Ang 630 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: karan karaavan har antarajaamee jan apune kee raakhai |
English: The Lord is the Cause of Causes, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts; He preserves the honor of His servant.

Gurbani: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਹੋਤੁ ਜਗ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jai jai kaar hot jag bheetar sabad guroo ras chaakhai |1|
English: He is hailed and congratulated throughout the world, and he tastes the sublime essence of the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਓਟ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: prabh jee teree ott gusaaee |
English: Dear God, Lord of the world, You are my only support.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤੁਮੑ ਧਿਆਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: too samarath saran kaa daataa aatth pehar tuma dhiaaee | rahaau |
English: You are all-powerful, the Giver of Sanctuary; twenty-four hours a day, I meditate on You. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਭਜਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਾ ਤਿਸੈ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jo jan bhajan kare prabh teraa tisai andesaa naahee |
English: That humble being, who vibrates upon You, O God, is not afflicted by anxiety.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਲਗੇ ਭਉ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: satigur charan lage bhau mittiaa har gun gaae man maahee |2|
English: Attached to the Feet of the True Guru, his fear is dispelled, and within his mind, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਲਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: sookh sehaj aanand ghanere satigur deea dilaasaa |
English: He abides in celestial peace and utter ecstasy; the True Guru has comforted him.

Gurbani: ਜਿਣਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ਸੋਭਾ ਸੇਤੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਆਸਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jin ghar aae sobhaa setee pooran hoee aasaa |3|
English: He has returned home victorious, with honor, and his hopes have been fulfilled. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਕਾਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: pooraa gur pooree mat jaa kee pooran prabh ke kaamaa |
English: Perfect are the Teachings of the Perfect Guru; Perfect are the actions of God.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ ਲਾਗਿ ਤਰਿਓ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੪॥੨੬॥੯੦॥
Transliteration: gur charanee laag tario bhav saagar jap naanak har har naamaa |4|26|90|
English: Grasping hold of the Guru's feet, Nanak has crossed over the terrifying world-ocean, chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||26||90||

[Ang 630 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਭਇਓ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਥਾਟੀ ॥
Transliteration: bheo kirapaal deen dukh bhanjan aape sabh bidh thaattee |
English: Becoming merciful, the Destroyer of the pains of the poor has Himself devised all devices.

Gurbani: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਓ ਜਨੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਬੇੜੀ ਕਾਟੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: khin meh raakh leeo jan apunaa gur poorai berree kaattee |1|
English: In an instant, He has saved His humble servant; the Perfect Guru has cut away his bonds. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਸਦ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: mere man gur govind sad dhiaaeeai |
English: O my mind, meditate forever on the Guru, the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sagal kales mitteh is tan te man chindiaa fal paaeeai | rahaau |
English: All illness shall depart from this body, and you shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਕੀਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਊਚਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jant jaa ke sabh keene prabh aoochaa agam apaaraa |
English: God created all beings and creatures; He is lofty, inaccessible and infinite.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਭਏ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ ॥੨॥੨੭॥੯੧॥
Transliteration: saadhasang naanak naam dhiaaeaa mukh aoojal bhe darabaaraa |2|27|91|
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; his face is radiant in the Court of the Lord. ||2||27||91||

[Ang 630 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਉ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਸਾਂਈ ॥
Transliteration: simrau apunaa saanee |
English: I meditate in remembrance on my Lord.

Gurbani: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਸਦ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: dinas rain sad dhiaaee |
English: Day and night, I ever meditate on Him.

Gurbani: ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
Transliteration: haath dee jin raakhe |
English: He gave me His hand, and protected me.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਮਹਾ ਰਸ ਚਾਖੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har naam mahaa ras chaakhe |1|
English: I drink in the most sublime essence of the Lord's Name. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: apane gur aoopar kurabaan |
English: I am a sacrifice to my Guru.

Gurbani: ਭਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਹੋਏ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhe kirapaal pooran prabh daate jeea hoe miharavaan | rahaau |
English: God, the Great Giver, the Perfect One, has become merciful to me, and now, all are kind to me. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: naanak jan saranaaee |
English: Servant Nanak has entered His Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jin pooran paij rakhaaee |
English: He has perfectly preserved his honor.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਮਿਟਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sagale dookh mittaaee |
English: All suffering has been dispelled.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖੁ ਭੁੰਚਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥੨॥੨੮॥੯੨॥
Transliteration: sukh bhunchahu mere bhaaee |2|28|92|
English: So enjoy peace, O my Siblings of Destiny! ||2||28||92||

[Ang 631 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sunahu binantee tthaakur mere jeea jant tere dhaare |
English: Hear my prayer, O my Lord and Master; all beings and creatures were created by You.

Gurbani: ਰਾਖੁ ਪੈਜ ਨਾਮ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨਹਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: raakh paij naam apune kee karan karaavanahaare |1|
English: You preserve the honor of Your Name, O Lord, Cause of causes. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਖਸਮਾਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: prabh jeeo khasamaanaa kar piaare |
English: O Dear God, Beloved, please, make me Your own.

Gurbani: ਬੁਰੇ ਭਲੇ ਹਮ ਥਾਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bure bhale ham thaare | rahaau |
English: Whether good or bad, I am Yours. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਸਮਰਥ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sunee pukaar samarath suaamee bandhan kaatt savaare |
English: The Almighty Lord and Master heard my prayer; cutting away my bonds, He has adorned me.

Gurbani: ਪਹਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਪਾਉ ਸੇਵਕ ਜਨ ਮੇਲੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪਹਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੨੯॥੯੩॥
Transliteration: pahir sirapaau sevak jan mele naanak pragatt pahaare |2|29|93|
English: He dressed me in robes of honor, and blended His servant with Himself; Nanak is revealed in glory throughout the world. ||2||29||93||

[Ang 631 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਵਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਭਿ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jant sabh vas kar deene sevak sabh darabaare |
English: All beings and creatures are subservient to all those who serve in the Lord's Court.

Gurbani: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਭਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: angeekaar keeo prabh apune bhav nidh paar utaare |1|
English: Their God made them His own, and carried them across the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: santan ke kaaraj sagal savaare |
English: He resolves all the affairs of His Saints.

Gurbani: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਖਸਮ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: deen deaal kripaal kripaa nidh pooran khasam hamaare | rahaau |
English: He is merciful to the meek, kind and compassionate, the ocean of kindness, my Perfect Lord and Master. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਉ ਬੈਠੁ ਆਦਰੁ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ਊਨ ਨ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਬਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: aau baitth aadar sabh thaaee aoon na katahoon baataa |
English: I am asked to come and be seated, everywhere I go, and I lack nothing.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਸਿਰਪਾਉ ਦੀਓ ਜਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੨॥੩੦॥੯੪॥
Transliteration: bhagat sirapaau deeo jan apune prataap naanak prabh jaataa |2|30|94|
English: The Lord blesses His humble devotee with robes of honor; O Nanak, the Glory of God is manifest. ||2||30||94||

[Ang 631 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 9 |
English: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: re man raam siau kar preet |
English: O mind, love the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਨੁ ਸੁਨਉ ਅਰੁ ਗਾਉ ਰਸਨਾ ਗੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sravan gobind gun sunau ar gaau rasanaa geet |1| rahaau |
English: With your ears, hear the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, and with your tongue, sing His song. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਿਮਰੁ ਮਾਧੋ ਹੋਹਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: kar saadhasangat simar maadho hohi patit puneet |
English: Join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and meditate in remembrance on the Lord; even a sinner like yourself will become pure.

Gurbani: ਕਾਲੁ ਬਿਆਲੁ ਜਿਉ ਪਰਿਓ ਡੋਲੈ ਮੁਖੁ ਪਸਾਰੇ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kaal biaal jiau pario ddolai mukh pasaare meet |1|
English: Death is on the prowl, with its mouth wide open, friend. ||1||

Gurbani: ਆਜੁ ਕਾਲਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਤੋਹਿ ਗ੍ਰਸਿ ਹੈ ਸਮਝਿ ਰਾਖਉ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: aaj kaal fun tohi gras hai samajh raakhau cheet |
English: Today or tomorrow, eventually it will seize you; understand this in your consciousness.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਭਜਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਤੁ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਬੀਤ ॥੨॥੧॥
Transliteration: kahai naanak raam bhaj lai jaat aausar beet |2|1|
English: Says Nanak, meditate, and vibrate upon the Lord; this opportunity is slipping away! ||2||1||

[Ang 631 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 9 |
English: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਰਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: man kee man hee maeh rahee |
English: The mind remains in the mind.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੇ ਨ ਤੀਰਥ ਸੇਵੇ ਚੋਟੀ ਕਾਲਿ ਗਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: naa har bhaje na teerath seve chottee kaal gahee |1| rahaau |
English: He does not meditate on the Lord, nor does he perform service at sacred shrines, and so death seizes him by the hair. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦਾਰਾ ਮੀਤ ਪੂਤ ਰਥ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਧਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭ ਮਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: daaraa meet poot rath sanpat dhan pooran sabh mahee |
English: Wife, friends, children, carriages, property, total wealth, the entire world

Gurbani: ਅਵਰ ਸਗਲ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਏ ਜਾਨਉ ਭਜਨੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਕੋ ਸਹੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: avar sagal mithiaa e jaanau bhajan raam ko sahee |1|
English: - know that all of these things are false. The Lord's meditation alone is true. ||1||

Gurbani: ਫਿਰਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਬਹੁਤੇ ਜੁਗ ਹਾਰਿਓ ਮਾਨਸ ਦੇਹ ਲਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: firat firat bahute jug haario maanas deh lahee |
English: Wandering, wandering around for so many ages, he has grown weary, and finally, he obtained this human body.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਤ ਮਿਲਨ ਕੀ ਬਰੀਆ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਕਹਾ ਨਹੀ ॥੨॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak kehat milan kee bareea simarat kahaa nahee |2|2|
English: Says Nanak, this is the opportunity to meet the Lord; why don't you remember Him in meditation? ||2||2||

[Ang 631 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 9 |
English: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਕਉਨੁ ਕੁਮਤਿ ਤੈ ਲੀਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: man re kaun kumat tai leenee |
English: O mind, what evil-mindedness have you developed?

Gurbani: ਪਰ ਦਾਰਾ ਨਿੰਦਿਆ ਰਸ ਰਚਿਓ ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਹਿ ਕੀਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: par daaraa nindiaa ras rachio raam bhagat neh keenee |1| rahaau |
English: You are engrossed in the pleasures of other men's wives, and slander; you have not worshipped the Lord at all. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਤੈ ਨਾਹਨਿ ਧਨ ਜੋਰਨ ਕਉ ਧਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: mukat panth jaanio tai naahan dhan joran kau dhaaeaa |
English: You do not know the way to liberation, but you run all around chasing wealth.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਿ ਸੰਗ ਕਾਹੂ ਨਹੀ ਦੀਨਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਆਪੁ ਬੰਧਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ant sang kaahoo nahee deenaa birathaa aap bandhaaeaa |1|
English: In the end, nothing shall go along with you; you have entrapped yourself in vain. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਿਓ ਨ ਗੁਰ ਜਨੁ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਨਹ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਕਛੁ ਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: naa har bhajio na gur jan sevio neh upajio kachh giaanaa |
English: You have not meditated or vibrated upon the Lord; you have not served the Guru, or His humble servants; spiritual wisdom has not welled up within you.

Gurbani: ਘਟ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਤੈ ਖੋਜਤ ਉਦਿਆਨਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ghatt hee maeh niranjan terai tai khojat udiaanaa |2|
English: The Immaculate Lord is within your heart, and yet you search for Him in the wilderness. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਜਨਮ ਭਰਮਤ ਤੈ ਹਾਰਿਓ ਅਸਥਿਰ ਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: bahut janam bharamat tai haario asathir mat nahee paaee |
English: You have wandered through many many births; you are exhausted but have still not found a way out of this endless cycle.

Gurbani: ਮਾਨਸ ਦੇਹ ਪਾਇ ਪਦ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਤ ਬਤਾਈ ॥੩॥੩॥
Transliteration: maanas deh paae pad har bhaj naanak baat bataaee |3|3|
English: Now that you have obtained this human body, meditate on the Lord's Feet; Nanak advises with this advice. ||3||3||

[Ang 632 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 9 |
English: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਬਿਚਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: man re prabh kee saran bichaaro |
English: O mind, contemplate the Sanctuary of God.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਗਨਕਾ ਸੀ ਉਧਰੀ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਜਸੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jih simarat ganakaa see udharee taa ko jas ur dhaaro |1| rahaau |
English: Meditating on Him in remembrance, Ganika the prostitute was saved; enshrine His Praises within your heart. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਟਲ ਭਇਓ ਧ੍ਰੂਅ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਅਰੁ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: attal bheo dhraooa jaa kai simaran ar nirabhai pad paaeaa |
English: Meditating on Him in remembrance, Dhroo became immortal, and obtained the state of fearlessness.

Gurbani: ਦੁਖ ਹਰਤਾ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੈ ਕਾਹੇ ਬਿਸਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dukh harataa ih bidh ko suaamee tai kaahe bisaraaeaa |1|
English: The Lord and Master removes suffering in this way - why have you forgotten Him? ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਗਜ ਗਰਾਹ ਤੇ ਛੂਟਾ ॥
Transliteration: jab hee saran gahee kirapaa nidh gaj garaah te chhoottaa |
English: As soon as the elephant took to the protective Sanctuary of the Lord, the ocean of mercy, he escaped from the crocodile.

Gurbani: ਮਹਮਾ ਨਾਮ ਕਹਾ ਲਉ ਬਰਨਉ ਰਾਮ ਕਹਤ ਬੰਧਨ ਤਿਹ ਤੂਟਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mahamaa naam kahaa lau barnau raam kehat bandhan tih toottaa |2|
English: How much can I describe the Glorious Praises of the Naam? Whoever chants the Lord's Name, his bonds are broken. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਜਾਮਲੁ ਪਾਪੀ ਜਗੁ ਜਾਨੇ ਨਿਮਖ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: ajaamal paapee jag jaane nimakh maeh nisataaraa |
English: Ajaamal, known throughout the world as a sinner, was redeemed in an instant.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਤ ਚੇਤ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਨਿ ਤੈ ਭੀ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਪਾਰਾ ॥੩॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak kehat chet chintaaman tai bhee utareh paaraa |3|4|
English: Says Nanak, remember the Chintaamani, the jewel which fulfills all desires, and you too shall be carried across and saved. ||3||4||

[Ang 632 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 9 |
English: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਕਉਨੁ ਉਪਾਉ ਕਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: praanee kaun upaau karai |
English: What efforts should the mortal make,

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਮ ਕੋ ਤ੍ਰਾਸੁ ਹਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaa te bhagat raam kee paavai jam ko traas harai |1| rahaau |
English: to attain devotional worship of the Lord, and eradicate the fear of death? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਉਨੁ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਕਹੁ ਕੈਸੀ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਫੁਨਿ ਕਰਈ ॥
Transliteration: kaun karam bidiaa kahu kaisee dharam kaun fun karee |
English: Which actions, what sort of knowledge, and what religion - what Dharma should one practice?

Gurbani: ਕਉਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰ ਕਉ ਤਰਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kaun naam gur jaa kai simarai bhav saagar kau taree |1|
English: What Name of the Guru should one remember in meditation, to cross over the terrifying world-ocean? ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਲ ਮੈ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਜਪੈ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: kal mai ek naam kirapaa nidh jaeh japai gat paavai |
English: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Name of the One Lord is the treasure of mercy; chanting it, one obtains salvation.

Gurbani: ਅਉਰ ਧਰਮ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸਮ ਨਾਹਨਿ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਬੇਦੁ ਬਤਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aaur dharam taa kai sam naahan ih bidh bed bataavai |2|
English: No other religion is comparable to this; so speak the Vedas. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਰਹਤ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਲੇਪੀ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕਹਤ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sukh dukh rehat sadaa niralepee jaa kau kehat gusaaee |
English: He is beyond pain and pleasure, forever unattached; He is called the Lord of the world.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਬਸੈ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਪਨਿ ਨਿਆਈ ॥੩॥੫॥
Transliteration: so tum hee meh basai nirantar naanak darapan niaaee |3|5|
English: He dwells deep within your inner self, O Nanak, like the image in a mirror. ||3||5||

[Ang 632 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 9 |
English: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਾਈ ਮੈ ਕਿਹਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਲਖਉ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: maaee mai kihi bidh lkhau gusaaee |
English: O mother, how can I see the Lord of the world?

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹ ਅਗਿਆਨਿ ਤਿਮਰਿ ਮੋ ਮਨੁ ਰਹਿਓ ਉਰਝਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mahaa moh agiaan timar mo man rahio urajhaaee |1| rahaau |
English: In the utter darkness of emotional attachment and spiritual ignorance, my mind remains entangled. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਜਨਮ ਭਰਮ ਹੀ ਭਰਮ ਖੋਇਓ ਨਹ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sagal janam bharam hee bharam khoeo neh asathir mat paaee |
English: Deluded by doubt, I have wasted my whole life; I have not obtained a stable intellect.

Gurbani: ਬਿਖਿਆਸਕਤ ਰਹਿਓ ਨਿਸ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਨਹ ਛੂਟੀ ਅਧਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bikhiaasakat rahio nis baasur neh chhoottee adhamaaee |1|
English: I remain under the influence of corrupting sins, night and day, and I have not renounced wickedness. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਕਬਹੂ ਨਹੀ ਕੀਨਾ ਨਹ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang kabahoo nahee keenaa neh keerat prabh gaaee |
English: I never joined the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and I did not sing the Kirtan of God's Praises.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋਊ ਗੁਨੁ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥੨॥੬॥
Transliteration: jan naanak mai naeh koaoo gun raakh lehu saranaaee |2|6|
English: O servant Nanak, I have no virtues at all; keep me in Your Sanctuary, Lord. ||2||6||

[Ang 632 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 9 |
English: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਾਈ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰੋ ਬਸਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: maaee man mero bas naeh |
English: O mother, my mind is out of control.

Gurbani: ਨਿਸ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਬਿਖਿਅਨ ਕਉ ਧਾਵਤ ਕਿਹਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਰੋਕਉ ਤਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: nis baasur bikhian kau dhaavat kihi bidh rokau taeh |1| rahaau |
English: Night and day, it runs after sin and corruption. How can I restrain it? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਕੇ ਮਤ ਸੁਨਿ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਹੀਏ ਬਸਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: bed puraan simrit ke mat sun nimakh na hee basaavai |
English: He listens to the teachings of the Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees, but he does not enshrine them in his heart, even for an instant.

Gurbani: ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰ ਦਾਰਾ ਸਿਉ ਰਚਿਓ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਿਰਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: par dhan par daaraa siau rachio birathaa janam siraavai |1|
English: Engrossed in the wealth and women of others, his life passes away uselessly. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਦਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਭਇਓ ਬਾਵਰੋ ਸੂਝਤ ਨਹ ਕਛੁ ਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: mad maaeaa kai bheo baavaro soojhat neh kachh giaanaa |
English: He has gone insane with the wine of Maya, and does not understand even a bit of spiritual wisdom.

Gurbani: ਘਟ ਹੀ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਬਸਤ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਮਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ghatt hee bheetar basat niranjan taa ko maram na jaanaa |2|
English: Deep within his heart, the Immaculate Lord dwells, but he does not know this secret. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਆਇਓ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: jab hee saran saadh kee aaeo duramat sagal binaasee |
English: When I came to the Sanctuary of the Holy Saints, all my evil-mindedness was dispelled.

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਨਾਨਕ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਨਿ ਕਾਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ॥੩॥੭॥
Transliteration: tab naanak chetio chintaaman kaattee jam kee faasee |3|7|
English: Then, O Nanak, I remembered the Chintaamani, the jewel which fulfills all desires, and the noose of Death was snapped. ||3||7||

[Ang 633 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 9 |
English: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰੇ ਨਰ ਇਹ ਸਾਚੀ ਜੀਅ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: re nar ih saachee jeea dhaar |
English: O man, grasp this Truth firmly in your soul.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਜਗਤੁ ਹੈ ਜੈਸੇ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਬਿਨਸਤ ਲਗਤ ਨ ਬਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sagal jagat hai jaise supanaa binasat lagat na baar |1| rahaau |
English: The whole world is just like a dream; it will pass away in an instant. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਾਰੂ ਭੀਤਿ ਬਨਾਈ ਰਚਿ ਪਚਿ ਰਹਤ ਨਹੀ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: baaroo bheet banaaee rach pach rehat nahee din chaar |
English: Like a wall of sand, built up and plastered with great care, which does not last even a few days,

Gurbani: ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਇਹ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਉਰਝਿਓ ਕਹਾ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: taise hee ih sukh maaeaa ke urajhio kahaa gavaar |1|
English: just so are the pleasures of Maya. Why are you entangled in them, you ignorant fool? ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਜਹੂ ਸਮਝਿ ਕਛੁ ਬਿਗਰਿਓ ਨਾਹਿਨਿ ਭਜਿ ਲੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: ajahoo samajh kachh bigario naahin bhaj le naam muraar |
English: Understand this today - it is not yet too late! Chant and vibrate the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਜ ਮਤੁ ਸਾਧਨ ਕਉ ਭਾਖਿਓ ਤੋਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੮॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak nij mat saadhan kau bhaakhio tohi pukaar |2|8|
English: Says Nanak, this is the subtle wisdom of the Holy Saints, which I proclaim out loud to you. ||2||8||

[Ang 633 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 9 |
English: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਇਹ ਜਗਿ ਮੀਤੁ ਨ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: eih jag meet na dekhio koee |
English: In this world, I have not found any true friend.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਜਗਤੁ ਅਪਨੈ ਸੁਖਿ ਲਾਗਿਓ ਦੁਖ ਮੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sagal jagat apanai sukh laagio dukh mai sang na hoee |1| rahaau |
English: The whole world is attached to its own pleasures, and when trouble comes, no one is with you. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦਾਰਾ ਮੀਤ ਪੂਤ ਸਨਬੰਧੀ ਸਗਰੇ ਧਨ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: daaraa meet poot sanabandhee sagare dhan siau laage |
English: Wives, friends, children and relatives - all are attached to wealth.

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਨਿਰਧਨ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਨਰ ਕਉ ਸੰਗੁ ਛਾਡਿ ਸਭ ਭਾਗੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jab hee niradhan dekhio nar kau sang chhaadd sabh bhaage |1|
English: When they see a poor man, they all forsake his company and run away. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਹਂਉ ਕਹਾ ਯਿਆ ਮਨ ਬਉਰੇ ਕਉ ਇਨ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਲਗਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: kahnau kahaa yiaa man baure kau in siau nehu lagaaeo |
English: So what should I say to this crazy mind, which is affectionately attached to them?

Gurbani: ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਸਕਲ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ ਜਸੁ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਬਿਸਰਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: deenaa naath sakal bhai bhanjan jas taa ko bisaraaeo |2|
English: The Lord is the Master of the meek, the Destroyer of all fears, and I have forgotten to praise Him. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੁਆਨ ਪੂਛ ਜਿਉ ਭਇਓ ਨ ਸੂਧਉ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਜਤਨੁ ਮੈ ਕੀਨਉ ॥
Transliteration: suaan poochh jiau bheo na soodhau bahut jatan mai keenau |
English: Like a dog's tail, which will never straighten out, the mind will not change, no matter how many things are tried.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਾਜ ਬਿਰਦ ਕੀ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਹਾਰਉ ਲੀਨਉ ॥੩॥੯॥
Transliteration: naanak laaj birad kee raakhahu naam tuhaarau leenau |3|9|
English: Says Nanak, please, Lord, uphold the honor of Your innate nature; I chant Your Name. ||3||9||

[Ang 633 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 9 |
English: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਗਹਿਓ ਨ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: man re gahio na gur upades |
English: O mind, you have not accepted the Guru's Teachings.

Gurbani: ਕਹਾ ਭਇਓ ਜਉ ਮੂਡੁ ਮੁਡਾਇਓ ਭਗਵਉ ਕੀਨੋ ਭੇਸੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kahaa bheo jau moodd muddaaeo bhagvau keeno bhes |1| rahaau |
English: What is the use of shaving your head, and wearing saffron robes? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚ ਛਾਡਿ ਕੈ ਝੂਠਹ ਲਾਗਿਓ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਕਾਰਥੁ ਖੋਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: saach chhaadd kai jhootthah laagio janam akaarath khoeo |
English: Abandoning Truth, you cling to falsehood; your life is uselessly wasting away.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਪਰਪੰਚ ਉਦਰ ਨਿਜ ਪੋਖਿਓ ਪਸੁ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ ਸੋਇਓ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kar parapanch udar nij pokhio pas kee niaaee soeo |1|
English: Practicing hypocrisy, you fill your belly, and then sleep like an animal. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਭਜਨ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਹਾਥਿ ਬਿਕਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: raam bhajan kee gat nahee jaanee maaeaa haath bikaanaa |
English: You do not know the Way of the Lord's meditation; you have sold yourself into Maya's hands.

Gurbani: ਉਰਝਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਬਿਖਿਅਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਉਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਬਿਸਰਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aurajh rahio bikhian sang bauraa naam ratan bisaraanaa |2|
English: The madman remains entangled in vice and corruption; he has forgotten the jewel of the Naam. ||2||

Gurbani: ਰਹਿਓ ਅਚੇਤੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਅਉਧ ਸਿਰਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: rahio achet na chetio gobind birathaa aaudh siraanee |
English: He remains thoughtless, not thinking of the Lord of the Universe; his life is uselessly passing away.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਪਛਾਨਉ ਭੂਲੇ ਸਦਾ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥੩॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak har birad pachhaanau bhoole sadaa paraanee |3|10|
English: Says Nanak, O Lord, please, confirm your innate nature; this mortal is continually making mistakes. ||3||10||

[Ang 633 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 9 |
English: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਦੁਖ ਮੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: jo nar dukh mai dukh nahee maanai |
English: That man, who in the midst of pain, does not feel pain,

Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਸਨੇਹੁ ਅਰੁ ਭੈ ਨਹੀ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕੰਚਨ ਮਾਟੀ ਮਾਨੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sukh sanehu ar bhai nahee jaa kai kanchan maattee maanai |1| rahaau |
English: who is not affected by pleasure, affection or fear, and who looks alike upon gold and dust;||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਹ ਨਿੰਦਿਆ ਨਹ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: neh nindiaa neh usatat jaa kai lobh mohu abhimaanaa |
English: Who is not swayed by either slander or praise, nor affected by greed, attachment or pride;

Gurbani: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਤੇ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਆਰਉ ਨਾਹਿ ਮਾਨ ਅਪਮਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: harakh sog te rahai niaarau naeh maan apamaanaa |1|
English: who remains unaffected by joy and sorrow, honor and dishonor;||1||

Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗੈ ਜਗ ਤੇ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa manasaa sagal tiaagai jag te rahai niraasaa |
English: who renounces all hopes and desires and remains desireless in the world;

Gurbani: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਜਿਹ ਪਰਸੈ ਨਾਹਨਿ ਤਿਹ ਘਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh jih parasai naahan tih ghatt braham nivaasaa |2|
English: who is not touched by sexual desire or anger - within his heart, God dwells. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਹ ਨਰ ਕਉ ਕੀਨੀ ਤਿਹ ਇਹ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਪਛਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur kirapaa jih nar kau keenee tih ih jugat pachhaanee |
English: That man, blessed by Guru's Grace, understands this way.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਲੀਨ ਭਇਓ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਪਾਨੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਨੀ ॥੩॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: naanak leen bheo gobind siau jiau paanee sang paanee |3|11|
English: O Nanak, he merges with the Lord of the Universe, like water with water. ||3||11||

[Ang 634 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 9 |
English: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਜਾਨਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: preetam jaan lehu man maahee |
English: O dear friend, know this in your mind.

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੇ ਸੁਖ ਸਿਉ ਹੀ ਜਗੁ ਫਾਂਧਿਓ ਕੋ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: apane sukh siau hee jag faandhio ko kaahoo ko naahee |1| rahaau |
English: The world is entangled in its own pleasures; no one is for anyone else. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਮੈ ਆਨਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਬੈਠਤ ਰਹਤ ਚਹੂ ਦਿਸਿ ਘੇਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: sukh mai aan bahut mil baitthat rehat chahoo dis gherai |
English: In good times, many come and sit together, surrounding you on all four sides.

Gurbani: ਬਿਪਤਿ ਪਰੀ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਸੰਗੁ ਛਾਡਿਤ ਕੋਊ ਨ ਆਵਤ ਨੇਰੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bipat paree sabh hee sang chhaaddit koaoo na aavat nerai |1|
English: But when hard times come, they all leave, and no one comes near you. ||1||

Gurbani: ਘਰ ਕੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਹਿਤੁ ਜਾ ਸਿਉ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਤ ਸੰਗ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: ghar kee naar bahut hit jaa siau sadaa rehat sang laagee |
English: Your wife, whom you love so much, and who has remained ever attached to you,

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਹੰਸ ਤਜੀ ਇਹ ਕਾਂਇਆ ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਗੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jab hee hans tajee ih kaaneaa pret pret kar bhaagee |2|
English: runs away crying, "Ghost! Ghost!", as soon as the swan-soul leaves this body. ||2||

Gurbani: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੋ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੁ ਬਨਿਓ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਲਗਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: eih bidh ko biauhaar banio hai jaa siau nehu lagaaeo |
English: This is the way they act - those whom we love so much.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤ ਬਾਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਕੋਊ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਇਓ ॥੩॥੧੨॥੧੩੯॥
Transliteration: ant baar naanak bin har jee koaoo kaam na aaeo |3|12|139|
English: At the very last moment, O Nanak, no one is any use at all, except the Dear Lord. ||3||12||139||

[Ang 634 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਚਉਤੁਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 1 ghar 1 asattapadeea chautukee |
English: Sorat'h, First Mehl, First House, Ashtpadheeyaa, Chau-Thukay:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਨ ਪੜਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਪੂਜਉ ਮੜੈ ਮਸਾਣਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: dubidhaa na prrau har bin hor na poojau marrai masaan na jaaee |
English: I am not torn by duality, because I do not worship any other than the Lord; I do not visit tombs or crematoriums.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਰਾਚਿ ਨ ਪਰ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਵਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਨਾਮਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: trisanaa raach na par ghar jaavaa trisanaa naam bujhaaee |
English: I do not enter the houses of strangers, engrossed in desire. The Naam, the Name of the Lord, has satisfied my desires.

Gurbani: ਘਰ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਘਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਰਤੇ ਮਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ghar bheetar ghar guroo dikhaaeaa sehaj rate man bhaaee |
English: Deep within my heart, the Guru has shown me the home of my being, and my mind is imbued with peace and poise, O Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਦਾਨਾ ਆਪੇ ਬੀਨਾ ਤੂ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਮਤਿ ਸਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: too aape daanaa aape beenaa too deveh mat saaee |1|
English: You Yourself are all-knowing, and You Yourself are all-seeing; You alone bestow intelligence, O Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗਿ ਰਤਉ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: man bairaag rtau bairaagee sabad man bedhiaa meree maaee |
English: My mind is detached, imbued with detachment; the Word of the Shabad has pierced my mind, O my mother.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: antar jot nirantar baanee saache saahib siau liv laaee | rahaau |
English: God's Light shines continually within the nucleus of my deepest self; I am lovingly attached to the Bani, the Word of the True Lord Master. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਸੰਖ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਕਹਹਿ ਬੈਰਾਗ ਸੋ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਜਿ ਖਸਮੈ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: asankh bairaagee kaheh bairaag so bairaagee ji khasamai bhaavai |
English: Countless detached renunciates talk of detachment and renunciation, but he alone is a true renunciate, who is pleasing to the Lord Master.

Gurbani: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਭੈ ਰਚਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: hiradai sabad sadaa bhai rachiaa gur kee kaar kamaavai |
English: The Word of the Shabad is ever in his heart; he is absorbed in the Fear of God, and he works to serve the Guru.

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਚੇਤੈ ਮਨੂਆ ਨ ਡੋਲੈ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਵਰਜਿ ਰਹਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: eko chetai manooaa na ddolai dhaavat varaj rahaavai |
English: He remembers the One Lord, his mind does not waver, and he restrains its wanderings.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sahaje maataa sadaa rang raataa saache ke gun gaavai |2|
English: He is intoxicated with celestial bliss, and is ever imbued with the Lord's Love; he sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨੂਆ ਪਉਣੁ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਸੁਖਵਾਸੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਸੈ ਸੁਖ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: manooaa paun bind sukhavaasee naam vasai sukh bhaaee |
English: The mind is like the wind, but if it comes to rest in peace, even for an instant, then he shall abide in the peace of the Name, O Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹਬਾ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਸੋਤ੍ਰ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਜਲਿ ਬੂਝੀ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jihabaa netr sotr sach raate jal boojhee tujheh bujhaaee |
English: His tongue, eyes and ears are imbued with Truth; O Lord, You quench the fires of desire.

Gurbani: ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਰਹੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aas niraas rahai bairaagee nij ghar taarree laaee |
English: In hope, the renunciate remains free of hopes; in the home of his own inner self, he is absorbed in the trance of deep meditation.

Gurbani: ਭਿਖਿਆ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਜੇ ਸੰਤੋਖੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਪੀਆਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bhikhiaa naam raje santokhee amrit sehaj peeaee |3|
English: He remains content, satisfied with the charity of the Naam; he drinks in the Ambrosial Amrit with ease. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਦੂਜੀ ਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: dubidhaa vich bairaag na hovee jab lag doojee raaee |
English: There is no renunciation in duality, as long as there is even a particle of duality.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਏਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sabh jag teraa too eko daataa avar na doojaa bhaaee |
English: The whole world is Yours, Lord; You alone are the Giver. There is not any other, O Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜੰਤ ਦੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh jant dukh sadaa nivaasee guramukh de vaddiaaee |
English: The self-willed manmukh dwells in misery forever, while the Lord bestows greatness upon the Gurmukh.

Gurbani: ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਗੰਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਕਹਣੈ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: apar apaar agam agochar kahanai keem na paaee |4|
English: God is infinite, endless, inaccessible and unfathomable; His worth cannot be described. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਮਹਾ ਪਰਮਾਰਥੁ ਤੀਨਿ ਭਵਣ ਪਤਿ ਨਾਮੰ ॥
Transliteration: sun samaadh mahaa paramaarath teen bhavan pat naaman |
English: The consciousness in deep Samaadhi, the Supreme Being, the Lord of the three worlds - these are Your Names, Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਜੀਆ ਜਗਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਸਹਾਮੰ ॥
Transliteration: masatak lekh jeea jag jonee sir sir lekh sahaaman |
English: The creatures born into this world have their destiny inscribed upon their foreheads; they experience according to their destinies.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮ ਸੁਕਰਮ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਮੰ ॥
Transliteration: karam sukaram karaae aape aape bhagat drirraaman |
English: The Lord Himself causes them to do good and bad deeds; He Himself makes them steadfast in devotional worship.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਜੂਠਿ ਲਹੈ ਭੈ ਮਾਨੰ ਆਪੇ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਅਗਾਮੰ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: man mukh jootth lahai bhai maanan aape giaan agaaman |5|
English: The filth of their mind and mouth is washed off when they live in the Fear of God; the inaccessible Lord Himself blesses them with spiritual wisdom. ||5||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸੇਈ ਸਾਦੁ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਜਿਉ ਗੁੰਗੇ ਮਿਠਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: jin chaakhiaa seee saad jaanan jiau gunge mitthiaaee |
English: Only those who taste it know its sweet taste, like the mute, who eats the candy, and only smiles.

Gurbani: ਅਕਥੈ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਥੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਚਾਲਉ ਸਦਾ ਰਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: akathai kaa kiaa katheeai bhaaee chaalau sadaa rajaaee |
English: How can I describe the indescribable, O Siblings of Destiny? I shall follow His Will forever.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਮੇਲੇ ਤਾ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਿਗੁਰੇ ਮਤਿ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur daataa mele taa mat hovai nigure mat na kaaee |
English: If one meets with the Guru, the Generous Giver, then he understands; those who have no Guru cannot understand this.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਚਲਾਏ ਤਿਉ ਚਾਲਹ ਭਾਈ ਹੋਰ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: jiau chalaae tiau chaalah bhaaee hor kiaa ko kare chaturaaee |6|
English: As the Lord causes us to act, so do we act, O Siblings of Destiny. What other clever tricks can anyone try? ||6||

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਇਕਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਾਤੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: eik bharam bhulaae ik bhagatee raate teraa khel apaaraa |
English: Some are deluded by doubt, while others are imbued with devotional worship; Your play is infinite and endless.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਲਾਏ ਤੇਹਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੂ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਚਲਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jit tudh laae tehaa fal paaeaa too hukam chalaavanahaaraa |
English: As You engage them, they receive the fruits of their rewards; You alone are the One who issues Your Commands.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੀ ਜੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਪਣਾ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sevaa karee je kichh hovai apanaa jeeo pindd tumaaraa |
English: I would serve You, if anything were my own; my soul and body are Yours.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਨੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: satigur miliai kirapaa keenee amrit naam adhaaraa |7|
English: One who meets with the True Guru, by His Grace, takes the Support of the Ambrosial Naam. ||7||

Gurbani: ਗਗਨੰਤਰਿ ਵਾਸਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨੰ ॥
Transliteration: gaganantar vaasiaa gun paragaasiaa gun meh giaan dhiaanan |
English: He dwells in the heavenly realms, and his virtues radiantly shine forth; meditation and spiritual wisdom are found in virtue.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਤਤੋ ਤਤੁ ਵਖਾਨੰ ॥
Transliteration: naam man bhaavai kahai kahaavai tato tat vakhaanan |
English: The Naam is pleasing to his mind; he speaks it, and causes others to speak it as well. He speaks the essential essence of wisdom.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੀਰਾ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਜਗੁ ਬਉਰਾਨੰ ॥
Transliteration: sabad gur peeraa gahir ganbheeraa bin sabadai jag bauraanan |
English: The Word of the Shabad is his Guru and spiritual teacher, profound and unfathomable; without the Shabad, the world is insane.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਗੀ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੰ ॥੮॥੧॥
Transliteration: pooraa bairaagee sehaj subhaagee sach naanak man maanan |8|1|
English: He is a perfect renunciate, naturally at ease, O Nanak, whose mind is pleased with the True Lord. ||8||1||

[Ang 635 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਤਿਤੁਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 1 titukee |
English: Sorat'h, First Mehl, Thi-Thukay:

Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਬੰਧਨੀ ਭਾਈ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਬੰਧਕਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa manasaa bandhanee bhaaee karam dharam bandhakaaree |
English: Hope and desire are entrapments, O Siblings of Destiny. Religious rituals and ceremonies are traps.

Gurbani: ਪਾਪਿ ਪੁੰਨਿ ਜਗੁ ਜਾਇਆ ਭਾਈ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: paap pun jag jaaeaa bhaaee binasai naam visaaree |
English: Because of good and bad deeds, one is born into the world, O Siblings of Destiny; forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he is ruined.

Gurbani: ਇਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਗਿ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਭਾਈ ਕਰਮ ਸਭੇ ਵੇਕਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: eih maaeaa jag mohanee bhaaee karam sabhe vekaaree |1|
English: This Maya is the enticer of the world, O Siblings of Destiny; all such actions are corrupt. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਕਰਮਾ ਕਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: sun panddit karamaa kaaree |
English: Listen, O ritualistic Pandit:

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਕਰਮਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਭਾਈ ਸੁ ਆਤਮ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jit karam sukh aoopajai bhaaee su aatam tat beechaaree | rahaau |
English: that religious ritual which produces happiness, O Siblings of Destiny, is contemplation of the essence of the soul. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਤੁ ਬੇਦੁ ਬਕੈ ਖੜੋ ਭਾਈ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: saasat bed bakai kharro bhaaee karam karahu sansaaree |
English: You may stand and recite the Shaastras and the Vedas, O Siblings of Destiny, but these are just worldly actions.

Gurbani: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਚੂਕਈ ਭਾਈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: paakhandd mail na chookee bhaaee antar mail vikaaree |
English: Filth cannot be washed away by hypocrisy, O Siblings of Destiny; the filth of corruption and sin is within you.

Gurbani: ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਡੂਬੀ ਮਾਕੁਰੀ ਭਾਈ ਊਂਡੀ ਸਿਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ein bidh ddoobee maakuree bhaaee aoonddee sir kai bhaaree |2|
English: This is how the spider is destroyed, O Siblings of Destiny, by falling head-long in its own web. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਘਣੀ ਵਿਗੂਤੀ ਭਾਈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: duramat ghanee vigootee bhaaee doojai bhaae khuaaee |
English: So many are destroyed by their own evil-mindedness, O Siblings of Destiny; in the love of duality, they are ruined.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਭਾਈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੈ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: bin satigur naam na paaeeai bhaaee bin naamai bharam na jaaee |
English: Without the True Guru, the Name is not obtained, O Siblings of Destiny; without the Name, doubt does not depart.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਭਾਈ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਰਹਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: satigur seve taa sukh paae bhaaee aavan jaan rahaaee |3|
English: If one serves the True Guru, then he obtains peace, O Siblings of Destiny; his comings and goings are ended. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਊਪਜੈ ਭਾਈ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: saach sehaj gur te aoopajai bhaaee man niramal saach samaaee |
English: True celestial peace comes from the Guru, O Siblings of Destiny; the immaculate mind is absorbed into the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur seve so boojhai bhaaee gur bin mag na paaee |
English: One who serves the Guru, understands, O Siblings of Destiny; without the Guru, the way is not found.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਕਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਭਾਈ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jis antar lobh ki karam kamaavai bhaaee koorr bol bikh khaaee |4|
English: What can anyone do, with greed within? O Siblings of Destiny, by telling lies, they eat poison. ||4||

Gurbani: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਦਹੀ ਵਿਲੋਈਐ ਭਾਈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਨਿਕਲੈ ਤਥੁ ॥
Transliteration: panddit dahee viloeeai bhaaee vichahu nikalai tath |
English: O Pandit, by churning cream, butter is produced.

Gurbani: ਜਲੁ ਮਥੀਐ ਜਲੁ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਏਹਾ ਵਥੁ ॥
Transliteration: jal matheeai jal dekheeai bhaaee ihu jag ehaa vath |
English: By churning water, you shall only see water, O Siblings of Destiny; this world is like that.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਵਿਗੂਚੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਦੇਉ ਅਲਖੁ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: gur bin bharam vigoocheeai bhaaee ghatt ghatt deo alakh |5|
English: Without the Guru, he is ruined by doubt, O Siblings of Destiny; the unseen Divine Lord is in each and every heart. ||5||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਤਾਗੋ ਸੂਤ ਕੋ ਭਾਈ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਬਾਧੋ ਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: eihu jag taago soot ko bhaaee deh dis baadho maae |
English: This world is like a thread of cotton, O Siblings of Destiny, which Maya has tied on all ten sides.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਾਠਿ ਨ ਛੂਟਈ ਭਾਈ ਥਾਕੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin gur gaatth na chhoottee bhaaee thaake karam kamaae |
English: Without the Guru, the knots cannot be untied, O Siblings of Destiny; I am so tired of religious rituals.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਭਾਈ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: eihu jag bharam bhulaaeaa bhaaee kahanaa kichhoo na jaae |6|
English: This world is deluded by doubt, O Siblings of Destiny; no one can say anything about it. ||6||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਭਉ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਭਾਈ ਭੈ ਮਰਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਲੇਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur miliai bhau man vasai bhaaee bhai maranaa sach lekh |
English: Meeting with the Guru, the Fear of God comes to abide in the mind; to die in the Fear of God is one's true destiny.

Gurbani: ਮਜਨੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਭਾਈ ਦਰਗਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸੇਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: majan daan changiaaeea bhaaee daragah naam visekh |
English: In the Court of the Lord, the Naam is far superior to ritualistic cleansing baths, charity and good deeds, O Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਅੰਕਸੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਭਾਈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਚੂਕਾ ਭੇਖੁ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: gur ankas jin naam drirraaeaa bhaaee man vasiaa chookaa bhekh |7|
English: One who implants the Naam within himself, through the Guru's halter - O Siblings of Destiny, the Lord dwells in his mind, and he is free of hypocrisy. ||7||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਾਟੁ ਸਰਾਫ ਕੋ ਭਾਈ ਵਖਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: eihu tan haatt saraaf ko bhaaee vakhar naam apaar |
English: This body is the jeweller's shop, O Siblings of Destiny; the incomparable Naam is the merchandise.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਸੋ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੈ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: eihu vakhar vaapaaree so drirrai bhaaee gur sabad kare veechaar |
English: The merchant secures this merchandise, O Siblings of Destiny, by contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਭਾਈ ਮੇਲਿ ਕਰੇ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥੮॥੨॥
Transliteration: dhan vaapaaree naanakaa bhaaee mel kare vaapaar |8|2|
English: Blessed is the merchant, O Nanak, who meets the Guru, and engages in this trade. ||8||2||

[Ang 636 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 1 |
English: Sorat'h, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤਿਨੑ ਕੇ ਸਾਥ ਤਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jinaee satigur seviaa piaare tina ke saath tare |
English: Those who serve the True Guru, O Beloved, their companions are saved as well.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨੑਾ ਠਾਕ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸਨ ਹਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: tinaa tthaak na paaeeai piaare amrit rasan hare |
English: No one blocks their way, O Beloved, and the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar is on their tongue.

Gurbani: ਬੂਡੇ ਭਾਰੇ ਭੈ ਬਿਨਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤਾਰੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: boodde bhaare bhai binaa piaare taare nadar kare |1|
English: Without the Fear of God, they are so heavy that they sink and drown, O Beloved; but the Lord, casting His Glance of Grace, carries them across. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭੀ ਤੂਹੈ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਭੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਾਲਾਹ ॥
Transliteration: bhee toohai saalaahanaa piaare bhee teree saalaah |
English: I ever praise You, O Beloved, I ever sing Your Praises.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਭੈ ਡੁਬੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕੰਧੀ ਪਾਇ ਕਹਾਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: vin bohith bhai ddubeeai piaare kandhee paae kahaah |1| rahaau |
English: Without the boat, one is drowned in the sea of fear, O Beloved; how can I reach the distant shore? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: saalaahee saalaahanaa piaare doojaa avar na koe |
English: I praise the Praiseworthy Lord, O Beloved; there is no other one to praise.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਲਾਹਨਿ ਸੇ ਭਲੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: mere prabh saalaahan se bhale piaare sabad rate rang hoe |
English: Those who praise my God are good, O Beloved; they are imbued with the Word of the Shabad, and His Love.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਸੁ ਲੈ ਤਤੁ ਵਿਲੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tis kee sangat je milai piaare ras lai tat viloe |2|
English: If I join them, O Beloved, I can churn the essence and so find joy. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ਸਾਚ ਕਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: pat paravaanaa saach kaa piaare naam sachaa neesaan |
English: The gateway to honor is Truth, O Beloved; it bears the Insignia of the True Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਇਆ ਲਿਖਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਵਣਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: aaeaa likh lai jaavanaa piaare hukamee hukam pachhaan |
English: We come into the world, and we depart, with our destiny written and pre-ordained, O Beloved; realize the Command of the Commander.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur bin hukam na boojheeai piaare saache saachaa taan |3|
English: Without the Guru, this Command is not understood, O Beloved; True is the Power of the True Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਿੰਮਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਉਦਰ ਮਝਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: hukamai andar ninmiaa piaare hukamai udar majhaar |
English: By His Command, we are conceived, O Beloved, and by His Command, we grow in the womb.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜੰਮਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਊਧਉ ਸਿਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: hukamai andar jamiaa piaare aoodhau sir kai bhaar |
English: By His Command, we are born, O Beloved, head-first, and upside-down.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਚਲੈ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: guramukh daragah jaaneeai piaare chalai kaaraj saar |4|
English: The Gurmukh is honored in the Court of the Lord, O Beloved; he departs after resolving his affairs. ||4||

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਜਾਦੋ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: hukamai andar aaeaa piaare hukame jaado jaae |
English: By His Command, one comes into the world, O Beloved, and by His Will, he goes.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਬੰਨਿੑ ਚਲਾਈਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਲਹੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: hukame bana chalaaeeai piaare manamukh lahai sajaae |
English: By His Will, some are bound and gagged and driven away, O Beloved; the self-willed manmukhs suffer their punishment.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: hukame sabad pachhaaneeai piaare daragah paidhaa jaae |5|
English: By His Command, the Word of the Shabad, is realized, O Beloved, and one goes to the Court of the Lord robed in honor. ||5||

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਗਣਤ ਗਣਾਈਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: hukame ganat ganaaeeai piaare hukame haumai doe |
English: By His Command, some accounts are accounted for, O Beloved; by His Command, some suffer in egotism and duality.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਭਵੈ ਭਵਾਈਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਅਵਗਣਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਰੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: hukame bhavai bhavaaeeai piaare avagan mutthee roe |
English: By His Command, one wanders in reincarnation, O Beloved; deceived by sins and demerits, he cries out in his suffering.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਿਞਾਪੈ ਸਾਹ ਕਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹੋਇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: hukam siyaapai saah kaa piaare sach milai vaddiaaee hoe |6|
English: If he comes to realize the Command of the Lord's Will, O Beloved, then he is blessed with Truth and Honor. ||6||

Gurbani: ਆਖਣਿ ਅਉਖਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aakhan aaukhaa aakheeai piaare kiau suneeai sach naau |
English: It is so difficult to speak it, O Beloved; how can we speak, and hear, the True Name?

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਉ ਤਿਨੑ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jinaee so saalaahiaa piaare hau tina balihaarai jaau |
English: I am a sacrifice to those who praise the Lord, O Beloved.

Gurbani: ਨਾਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆਂ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਦਰੀ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: naau milai santokheean piaare nadaree mel milaau |7|
English: I have obtained the Name, and I am satisfied, O Beloved; by His Grace, I am united in His Union. ||7||

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਜੇ ਥੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਸਵਾਣੀ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa kaagad je theeai piaare man masavaanee dhaar |
English: If my body were to become the paper, O Beloved, and my mind the inkpot;

Gurbani: ਲਲਤਾ ਲੇਖਣਿ ਸਚ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਲਿਖਹੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: lalataa lekhan sach kee piaare har gun likhahu veechaar |
English: and if my tongue became the pen, O Beloved, I would write, and contemplate, the Glorious Praises of the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਲੇਖਾਰੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਲਿਖੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੮॥੩॥
Transliteration: dhan lekhaaree naanakaa piaare saach likhai ur dhaar |8|3|
English: Blessed is that scribe, O Nanak, who writes the True Name, and enshrines it within his heart. ||8||3||

[Ang 636 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਪਹਿਲਾ ਦੁਤੁਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 1 pahilaa dutukee |
English: Sorat'h, First Mehl, Dho-Thukay:

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਗੁਣਦਾਤੌ ਨਿਰਮਲੋ ਭਾਈ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: too gunadaatau niramalo bhaaee niramal naa man hoe |
English: You are the Giver of virtue, O Immaculate Lord, but my mind is not immaculate, O Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਨਿਰਗੁਣੇ ਭਾਈ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਗੁਣੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ham aparaadhee niragune bhaaee tujh hee te gun soe |1|
English: I am a worthless sinner, O Siblings of Destiny; virtue is obtained from You alone, Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਾ ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: mere preetamaa too karataa kar vekh |
English: O my Beloved Creator Lord, You create, and You behold.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਪਾਪੀ ਪਾਖੰਡੀਆ ਭਾਈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਸੇਖੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hau paapee paakhanddeea bhaaee man tan naam visekh | rahaau |
English: I am a hypocritical sinner, O Siblings of Destiny. Bless my mind and body with Your Name, O Lord. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਚਿਤੁ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bikh maaeaa chit mohiaa bhaaee chaturaaee pat khoe |
English: The poisonous Maya has enticed the consciousness, O Siblings of Destiny; through clever tricks, one loses his honor.

Gurbani: ਚਿਤ ਮਹਿ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਚਿ ਵਸੈ ਭਾਈ ਜੇ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਮੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: chit meh tthaakur sach vasai bhaaee je gur giaan samoe |2|
English: The True Lord and Master abides in the consciousness, O Siblings of Destiny, if the Guru's spiritual wisdom permeates it. ||2||

Gurbani: ਰੂੜੌ ਰੂੜੌ ਆਖੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਰੂੜੌ ਲਾਲ ਚਲੂਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: roorrau roorrau aakheeai bhaaee roorrau laal chalool |
English: Beautiful, beautiful, the Lord is called, O Siblings of Destiny; beautiful, like the deep crimson color of the poppy.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਬੈਰਾਗੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਅਭੂਲੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: je man har siau bairaageeai bhaaee dar ghar saach abhool |3|
English: If man loves the Lord with detachment, O Siblings of Destiny, he is judged to be true and infallible in the Lord's court and home. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪਾਤਾਲੀ ਆਕਾਸਿ ਤੂ ਭਾਈ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਤੂ ਗੁਣ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: paataalee aakaas too bhaaee ghar ghar too gun giaan |
English: You are pervading the realms of the underworld and the heavenly skies; Your wisdom and glories are in each and every heart.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਭਾਈ ਚੂਕਾ ਮਨਹੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: gur miliai sukh paaeaa bhaaee chookaa manahu gumaan |4|
English: Meeting with the Guru, one finds peace, O Siblings of Destiny, and pride is dispelled from the mind. ||4||

Gurbani: ਜਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਮਾਜੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਭੀ ਮੈਲਾ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jal mal kaaeaa maajeeai bhaaee bhee mailaa tan hoe |
English: Scrubbing with water, the body can be cleaned, O Siblings of Destiny, but the body becomes dirty again.

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨਿ ਮਹਾ ਰਸਿ ਨਾਈਐ ਭਾਈ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: giaan mahaa ras naaeeai bhaaee man tan niramal hoe |5|
English: Bathing in the supreme essence of spiritual wisdom, O Siblings of Destiny, the mind and body become pure. ||5||

Gurbani: ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵਾ ਪੂਜੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਕਿਆ ਮਾਗਉ ਕਿਆ ਦੇਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: devee devaa poojeeai bhaaee kiaa maagau kiaa dehi |
English: Why worship gods and goddesses, O Siblings of Destiny? What can we ask of them? What can they give us?

Gurbani: ਪਾਹਣੁ ਨੀਰਿ ਪਖਾਲੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਬੂਡਹਿ ਤੇਹਿ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: paahan neer pakhaaleeai bhaaee jal meh booddeh tehi |6|
English: The stone gods are washed with water, O Siblings of Destiny, but they just sink in the water. ||6||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਜਗੁ ਬੂਡੈ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur bin alakh na lakheeai bhaaee jag booddai pat khoe |
English: Without the Guru, the unseen Lord cannot be seen, O Siblings of Destiny; the world is drowning, having lost its honor.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਾਥਿ ਵਡਾਈਆ ਭਾਈ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: mere tthaakur haath vaddaaeea bhaaee jai bhaavai tai dee |7|
English: Greatness is in the hands of my Lord and Master, O Siblings of Destiny; as He is pleased, He gives. ||7||

Gurbani: ਬਈਅਰਿ ਬੋਲੈ ਮੀਠੁਲੀ ਭਾਈ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਪਿਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: beear bolai meetthulee bhaaee saach kahai pir bhaae |
English: That soul-bride, who talks sweetly and speaks the Truth, O Siblings of Destiny, becomes pleasing to her Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਬਿਰਹੈ ਬੇਧੀ ਸਚਿ ਵਸੀ ਭਾਈ ਅਧਿਕ ਰਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: birahai bedhee sach vasee bhaaee adhik rahee har naae |8|
English: Pierced by His Love, she abides in Truth, O Siblings of Destiny, deeply imbued with the Lord's Name. ||8||

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਆਖੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਬੁਝੈ ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: sabh ko aakhai aapanaa bhaaee gur te bujhai sujaan |
English: Everyone calls God his own, O Siblings of Destiny, but the all-knowing Lord is known only through the Guru.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਬੀਧੇ ਸੇ ਊਬਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚਾ ਨੀਸਾਨੁ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: jo beedhe se aoobare bhaaee sabad sachaa neesaan |9|
English: Those who are pierced by His Love are saved, O Siblings of Destiny; they bear the Insignia of the True Word of the Shabad. ||9||

Gurbani: ਈਧਨੁ ਅਧਿਕ ਸਕੇਲੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਰੰਚਕ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: eedhan adhik sakeleeai bhaaee paavak ranchak paae |
English: A large pile of firewood, O Siblings of Destiny, will burn if a small fire is applied.

Gurbani: ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸੈ ਭਾਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲਣੁ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੧੦॥੪॥
Transliteration: khin pal naam ridai vasai bhaaee naanak milan subhaae |10|4|
English: In the same way, if the Naam, the Name of the Lord, dwells in the heart for a moment, even for an instant, O Siblings of Destiny, then one meets the Lord with ease, O Nanak. ||10||4||

[Ang 637 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਤਿਤੁਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 3 ghar 1 titukee |
English: Sorat'h, Third Mehl, First House, Thi-Thukay:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਾ ਦੀ ਸਦਾ ਤੂ ਰਖਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਤੂ ਰਖਦਾ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bhagataa dee sadaa too rakhadaa har jeeo dhur too rakhadaa aaeaa |
English: You always preserve the honor of Your devotees, O Dear Lord; You have protected them from the very beginning of time.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦ ਜਨ ਤੁਧੁ ਰਾਖਿ ਲਏ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਹਰਣਾਖਸੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਚਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: prahilaad jan tudh raakh le har jeeo haranaakhas maar pachaaeaa |
English: You protected Your servant Prahlaad, O Dear Lord, and annihilated Harnaakhash.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: guramukhaa no parateet hai har jeeo manamukh bharam bhulaaeaa |1|
English: The Gurmukhs place their faith in the Dear Lord, but the self-willed manmukhs are deluded by doubt. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਏਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: har jee eeh teree vaddiaaee |
English: O Dear Lord, this is Your Glory.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੁ ਤੂ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhagataa kee paij rakh too suaamee bhagat teree saranaaee | rahaau |
English: You preserve the honor of Your devotees, O Lord Master; Your devotees seek Your Sanctuary. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਾ ਨੋ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਨੇੜੈ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: bhagataa no jam johi na saakai kaal na nerrai jaaee |
English: The Messenger of Death cannot touch Your devotees; death cannot even approach them.

Gurbani: ਕੇਵਲ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: keval raam naam man vasiaa naame hee mukat paaee |
English: The Name of the Lord alone abides in their minds; through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, they find liberation.

Gurbani: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਸਭ ਭਗਤਾ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ridh sidh sabh bhagataa charanee laagee gur kai sehaj subhaaee |2|
English: Wealth and all the spiritual powers of the Siddhis fall at the feet of the Lord's devotees; they obtain peace and poise from the Guru. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
Transliteration: manamukhaa no parateet na aavee antar lobh suaau |
English: The self-willed manmukhs have no faith; they are filled with greed and self-interest.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਭੇਦਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਾਗਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh hiradai sabad na bhedio har naam na laagaa bhaau |
English: They are not Gurmukh - they do not understand the Word of the Shabad in their hearts; they do not love the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜ ਕਪਟ ਪਾਜੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਸੀ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਫੀਕਾ ਅਲਾਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: koorr kapatt paaj leh jaasee manamukh feekaa alaau |3|
English: Their masks of falsehood and hypocrisy shall fall off; the self-willed manmukhs speak with insipid words. ||3||

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਭਗਤੀ ਹੂ ਤੂ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: bhagataa vich aap varatadaa prabh jee bhagatee hoo too jaataa |
English: You are pervading through Your devotees, O Dear God; through Your devotees, You are known.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਸਭ ਲੋਕ ਹੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਏਕੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa moh sabh lok hai teree too eko purakh bidhaataa |
English: All the people are enticed by Maya; they are Yours, Lord - You alone are the Architect of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: haumai maar manasaa maneh samaanee gur kai sabad pachhaataa |4|
English: Overcoming my egotism and quieting the desires within my mind, I have come to realize the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||4||

Gurbani: ਅਚਿੰਤ ਕੰਮ ਕਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: achint kam kareh prabh tin ke jin har kaa naam piaaraa |
English: God automatically does the work of those who love the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaad sadaa man vasiaa sabh kaaj savaaranahaaraa |
English: By Guru's Grace, he ever dwells in their minds, and He resolves all their affairs.

Gurbani: ਓਨਾ ਕੀ ਰੀਸ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਵਿਗੁਚੈ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੈ ਰਖਵਾਰਾ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: onaa kee rees kare su viguchai jin har prabh hai rakhavaaraa |5|
English: Whoever challenges them is destroyed; they have the Lord God as their Savior. ||5||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਭਉਕਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਲਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: bin satigur seve kinai na paaeaa manamukh bhauk mue bilalaaee |
English: Without serving the True Guru, no one finds the Lord; the self-willed manmukhs die crying out in pain.

Gurbani: ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਦੁਖ ਮਹਿ ਦੁਖਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aaveh jaaveh tthaur na paaveh dukh meh dukh samaaee |
English: They come and go, and find no place of rest; in pain and suffering, they perish.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: guramukh hovai su amrit peevai sahaje saach samaaee |6|
English: But one who becomes Gurmukh drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar, and is easily absorbed in the True Name. ||6||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਜੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: bin satigur seve janam na chhoddai je anek karam karai adhikaaee |
English: Without serving the True Guru, one cannot escape reincarnation, even by performing numerous rituals.

Gurbani: ਵੇਦ ਪੜਹਿ ਤੈ ਵਾਦ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ved parreh tai vaad vakhaaneh bin har pat gavaaee |
English: Those who read the Vedas, and argue and debate without the Lord, lose their honor.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਚੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਜਿ ਛੂਟਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: sachaa satigur saachee jis baanee bhaj chhootteh gur saranaaee |7|
English: True is the True Guru, and True is the Word of His Bani; in the Guru's Sanctuary, one is saved. ||7||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੇ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jin har man vasiaa se dar saache dar saachai sachiaaraa |
English: Those whose minds are filled with the Lord are judged as true in the Court of the Lord; they are hailed as true in the True Court.

Gurbani: ਓਨਾ ਦੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਹੋਈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: onaa dee sobhaa jug jug hoee koe na mettanahaaraa |
English: Their praises echo throughout the ages, and no one can erase them.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਾ ॥੮॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak tin kai sad balihaarai jin har raakhiaa ur dhaaraa |8|1|
English: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to those who enshrine the Lord within their hearts. ||8||1||

[Ang 638 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਦੁਤੁਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 3 dutukee |
English: Sorat'h, Third Mehl, Dho-Thukay:

Gurbani: ਨਿਗੁਣਿਆ ਨੋ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਭਾਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: niguniaa no aape bakhas le bhaaee satigur kee sevaa laae |
English: He Himself forgives the worthless, O Siblings of Destiny; He commits them to the service of the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਊਤਮ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: satigur kee sevaa aootam hai bhaaee raam naam chit laae |1|
English: Service to the True Guru is sublime, O Siblings of Destiny; through it, one's consciousness is attached to the Lord's Name. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: har jeeo aape bakhas milaae |
English: The Dear Lord forgives, and unites with Himself.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣਹੀਣ ਹਮ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਭਾਈ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਲਏ ਰਲਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gunaheen ham aparaadhee bhaaee poorai satigur le ralaae | rahaau |
English: I am a sinner, totally without virtue, O Siblings of Destiny; the Perfect True Guru has blended me. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਉਣ ਕਉਣ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਬਖਸਿਅਨੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: kaun kaun aparaadhee bakhasian piaare saachai sabad veechaar |
English: So many, so many sinners have been forgiven, O beloved one, by contemplating the True Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਿਅਨੁ ਭਾਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੇੜੈ ਚਾੜਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bhaujal paar utaarian bhaaee satigur berrai chaarr |2|
English: They got on board the boat of the True Guru, who carried them across the terrifying world-ocean, O Siblings of Destiny. ||2||
