Gurbani: ਮਨੂਰੈ ਤੇ ਕੰਚਨ ਭਏ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: manoorai te kanchan bhe bhaaee gur paaras mel milaae |
English: I have been transformed from rusty iron into gold, O Siblings of Destiny, united in Union with the Guru, the Philosopher's Stone.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਨਾਉ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aap chhodd naau man vasiaa bhaaee jotee jot milaae |3|
English: Eliminating my self-conceit, the Name has come to dwell within my mind, O Siblings of Destiny; my light has merged in the Light. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਹਉ ਵਾਰਣੈ ਭਾਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hau vaaree hau vaaranai bhaaee satigur kau sad balihaarai jaau |
English: I am a sacrifice, I am a sacrifice, O Siblings of Destiny, I am forever a sacrifice to my True Guru.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਦਿਤਾ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: naam nidhaan jin ditaa bhaaee guramat sehaj samaau |4|
English: He has given me the treasure of the Naam; O Siblings of Destiny, through the Guru's Teachings, I am absorbed in celestial bliss. ||4||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਭਾਈ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਗਿਆਨੀਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur bin sehaj na aoopajai bhaaee poochhahu giaaneea jaae |
English: Without the Guru, celestial peace is not produced, O Siblings of Destiny; go and ask the spiritual teachers about this.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: satigur kee sevaa sadaa kar bhaaee vichahu aap gavaae |5|
English: Serve the True Guru forever, O Siblings of Destiny, and eradicate self-conceit from within. ||5||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਭਉ ਊਪਜੈ ਭਾਈ ਭਉ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramatee bhau aoopajai bhaaee bhau karanee sach saar |
English: Under Guru's Instruction, the Fear of God is produced, O Siblings of Destiny; true and excellent are the deeds done in the Fear of God.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਭਾਈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: prem padaarath paaeeai bhaaee sach naam aadhaar |6|
English: Then, one is blessed with the treasure of the Lord's Love, O Siblings of Destiny, and the Support of the True Name. ||6||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਭਾਈ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jo satigur seveh aapanaa bhaaee tin kai hau laagau paae |
English: I fall at the feet of those who serve their True Guru, O Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਭਾਈ ਕੁਲੁ ਭੀ ਲਈ ਬਖਸਾਇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: janam savaaree aapanaa bhaaee kul bhee lee bakhasaae |7|
English: I have fulfilled my life, O Siblings of Destiny, and my family has been saved as well. ||7||

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sach baanee sach sabad hai bhaaee gur kirapaa te hoe |
English: The True Word of the Guru's Bani, and the True Word of the Shabad, O Siblings of Destiny, are obtained only by Guru's Grace.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਭਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੮॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naam har man vasai bhaaee tis bighan na laagai koe |8|2|
English: O Nanak, with the Name of the Lord abiding in one's mind, no obstacles stand in one's way, O Siblings of Destiny. ||8||2||

[Ang 639 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 3 |
English: Sorat'h, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਬਦੇ ਜਾਪਦਾ ਭਾਈ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: har jeeo sabade jaapadaa bhaaee poorai bhaag milaae |
English: The Dear Lord is realized through the Word of His Shabad, O Siblings of Destiny, which is found only by perfect destiny.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਭਾਈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਤੀਆ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sadaa sukh sohaaganee bhaaee anadin rateea rang laae |1|
English: The happy soul-brides are forever in peace, O Siblings of Destiny; night and day, they are attuned to the Lord's Love. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: har jee too aape rang charraae |
English: O Dear Lord, You Yourself color us in Your Love.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਹੁ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਿਹੋ ਭਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gaavahu gaavahu rang raatiho bhaaee har setee rang laae | rahaau |
English: Sing, continually sing His Praises, imbued with His Love, O Siblings of Destiny; be in love with the Lord. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਭਾਈ ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur kee kaar kamaavanee bhaaee aap chhodd chit laae |
English: Work to serve the Guru, O Siblings of Destiny; abandon self-conceit, and focus your consciousness.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਹਜੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਭਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sadaa sehaj fir dukh na lagee bhaaee har aap vasai man aae |2|
English: You shall be in peace forever, and you shall not suffer in pain any longer, O Siblings of Destiny; the Lord Himself shall come and abide in your mind. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਭਾਈ ਸਾ ਕੁਲਖਣੀ ਕੁਨਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: pir kaa hukam na jaanee bhaaee saa kulakhanee kunaar |
English: She who does not know the Will of her Husband Lord, O Siblings of Destiny, is an ill-mannered and bitter bride.

Gurbani: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਭਾਈ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: manahatth kaar kamaavanee bhaaee vin naavai koorriaar |3|
English: She does things with a stubborn mind, O Siblings of Destiny; without the Name, she is false. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਭਾਇ ਸਚੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: se gaaveh jin masatak bhaag hai bhaaee bhaae sachai bairaag |
English: They alone sing the Lord's Praises, who have such pre-ordained destiny written upon their foreheads, O Siblings of Destiny; through the Love of the True Lord, they find detachment.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਹਿ ਭਾਈ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਗੁਰ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੁ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: anadin raate gun raveh bhaaee nirbhau gur liv laag |4|
English: Night and day, they are imbued with His Love; they utter His Glorious Praises, O Siblings of Destiny, and they lovingly focus their consciousness on the Fearless Guru. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਭਨਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲਦਾ ਭਾਈ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: sabhanaa maar jeevaaladaa bhaaee so sevahu din raat |
English: He kills and revives all, O Siblings of Destiny; serve Him, day and night.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਜਿਸ ਦੀ ਵਡੀ ਹੈ ਦਾਤਿ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: so kiau manahu visaareeai bhaaee jis dee vaddee hai daat |5|
English: How can we forget Him from our minds, O Siblings of Destiny? His gifts are glorious and great. ||5||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮੈਲੀ ਡੁੰਮਣੀ ਭਾਈ ਦਰਗਹ ਨਾਹੀ ਥਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh mailee ddunmanee bhaaee daragah naahee thaau |
English: The self-willed manmukh is filthy and double-minded, O Siblings of Destiny; the finds no place of rest in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਤ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਭਾਈ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: guramukh hovai ta gun ravai bhaaee mil preetam saach samaau |6|
English: But if she becomes Gurmukh, then she chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny; the meets her True Beloved, and merges in Him. ||6||

Gurbani: ਏਤੁ ਜਨਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਭਾਈ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਦੇਸੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: et janam har na chetio bhaaee kiaa muhu desee jaae |
English: In this life, she has not focused her consciousness on the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny; how can she show her face when she leaves?

Gurbani: ਕਿੜੀ ਪਵੰਦੀ ਮੁਹਾਇਓਨੁ ਭਾਈ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਨੋ ਲੋਭਾਇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: kirree pavandee muhaaeon bhaaee bikhiaa no lobhaae |7|
English: In spite of the warning calls which were sounded, she has been plundered, O Siblings of Destiny; she yearned only for corruption. ||7||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਹਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਭਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: naam samaaleh sukh vaseh bhaaee sadaa sukh saant sareer |
English: Those who dwell upon the Naam, O Siblings of Destiny, their bodies are ever peaceful and tranquil.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਤੂ ਭਾਈ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰ ॥੮॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak naam samaal too bhaaee aparanpar gunee gaheer |8|3|
English: O Nanak, dwell upon the Naam; the Lord is infinite, virtuous and unfathomable, O Siblings of Destiny. ||8||3||

[Ang 639 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 ghar 1 asattapadeea |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl, First House, Ashtpadheeyaa:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਜਿਨਹਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਭਾਈ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥
Transliteration: sabh jag jineh upaaeaa bhaaee karan kaaran samarath |
English: The One who created the whole world, O Siblings of Destiny, is the Almighty Lord, the Cause of causes.

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਅਪਣੀ ਵਥੁ ॥
Transliteration: jeeo pindd jin saajiaa bhaaee de kar apanee vath |
English: He fashioned the soul and the body, O Siblings of Destiny, by His own power.

Gurbani: ਕਿਨਿ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਉ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਕਰਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਅਕਥੁ ॥
Transliteration: kin kaheeai kiau dekheeai bhaaee karataa ek akath |
English: How can He be described? How can He be seen, O Siblings of Destiny? The Creator is One; He is indescribable.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਜਾਪੈ ਤਥੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur govind salaaheeai bhaaee jis te jaapai tath |1|
English: Praise the Guru, the Lord of the Universe, O Siblings of Destiny; through Him, the essence is known. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: mere man japeeai har bhagavantaa |
English: O my mind, meditate on the Lord, the Lord God.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਜਨ ਅਪਨੇ ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਕਾ ਹੰਤਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: naam daan dee jan apane dookh darad kaa hantaa | rahaau |
English: He blesses His servant with the gift of the Naam; He is the Destroyer of pain and suffering. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai ghar sabh kichh hai bhaaee nau nidh bhare bhanddaar |
English: Everything is in His home, O Siblings of Destiny; His warehouse is overflowing with the nine treasures.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਭਾਈ ਊਚਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: tis kee keemat naa pavai bhaaee aoochaa agam apaar |
English: His worth cannot be estimated, O Siblings of Destiny; He is lofty, inaccessible and infinite.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਦਾ ਭਾਈ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਕਰਦਾ ਸਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jant pratipaaladaa bhaaee nit nit karadaa saar |
English: He cherishes all beings and creatures, O Siblings of Destiny; he continually takes care of them.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਹਾਰ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: satigur pooraa bhetteeai bhaaee sabad milaavanahaar |2|
English: So meet with the Perfect True Guru, O Siblings of Destiny, and merge in the Word of the Shabad. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਚੇ ਚਰਣ ਸਰੇਵੀਅਹਿ ਭਾਈ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: sache charan sareveeeh bhaaee bhram bhau hovai naas |
English: Adoring the feet of the True Guru, O Siblings of Destiny, doubt and fear are dispelled.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਂਜੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: mil sant sabhaa man maanjeeai bhaaee har kai naam nivaas |
English: Joining the Society of the Saints, cleanse your mind, O Siblings of Destiny, and dwell in the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਿਟੈ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਅਗਿਆਨਤਾ ਭਾਈ ਕਮਲ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: mittai andheraa agiaanataa bhaaee kamal hovai paragaas |
English: The darkness of ignorance shall be dispelled, O Siblings of Destiny, and the lotus of your heart shall blossom forth.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਭਾਈ ਸਭਿ ਫਲ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur bachanee sukh aoopajai bhaaee sabh fal satigur paas |3|
English: By the Guru's Word, peace wells up, O Siblings of Destiny; all fruits are with the True Guru. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਛੋਡੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਹੋਈਐ ਸਭ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: meraa teraa chhoddeeai bhaaee hoeeai sabh kee dhoor |
English: Give up your sense of mine and yours, O Siblings of Destiny, and become the dust of the feet of all.

Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਸਾਰਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਪੇਖੈ ਸੁਣੈ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt braham pasaariaa bhaaee pekhai sunai hajoor |
English: In each and every heart, God is contained, O Siblings of Destiny; He sees, and hears, and is ever-present with us.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਦਿਨਿ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਭਾਈ ਤਿਤੁ ਦਿਨਿ ਮਰੀਐ ਝੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jit din visarai paarabraham bhaaee tith din mareeai jhoor |
English: On that day when one forgets the Supreme Lord God, O Siblings of Destiny, on that day, one ought to die crying out in pain.

Gurbani: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਸਮਰਥੋ ਭਾਈ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: karan karaavan samaratho bhaaee sarab kalaa bharapoor |4|
English: He is the all-powerful Cause of Causes, O Siblings of Destiny; he is totally filled with all powers. ||4||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: prem padaarath naam hai bhaaee maaeaa moh binaas |
English: The Love of the Name is the greatest treasure, O Siblings of Destiny; through it, emotional attachment to Maya is dispelled.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਭਾਈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: tis bhaavai taa mel le bhaaee hiradai naam nivaas |
English: If it is pleasing to His Will, then He unites us in His Union, O Siblings of Destiny; the Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to abide in the mind.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਰਿਦੈ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh kamal pragaaseeai bhaaee ridai hovai paragaas |
English: The heart-lotus of the Gurmukh blossoms forth, O Siblings of Destiny, and the heart is illumined.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਭਇਆ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਈ ਮਉਲਿਆ ਧਰਤਿ ਅਕਾਸੁ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: pragatt bheaa parataap prabh bhaaee mauliaa dharat akaas |5|
English: The Glory of God has been revealed, O Siblings of Destiny, and the earth and sky have blossomed forth. ||5||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਸੰਤੋਖਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur poorai santokhiaa bhaaee ahinis laagaa bhaau |
English: The Perfect Guru has blessed me with contentment, O Siblings of Destiny; day and night, I remain attached to the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਭਾਈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਦੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
Transliteration: rasanaa raam ravai sadaa bhaaee saachaa saad suaau |
English: My tongue continually chants the Lord's Name, O Siblings of Destiny; this is the true taste, and the object of human life.

Gurbani: ਕਰਨੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਥਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: karanee sun sun jeeviaa bhaaee nihachal paaeaa thaau |
English: Listening with my ears, I hear and so I live, O Siblings of Destiny; I have obtained the unchanging, unmoving state.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਭਾਈ ਸੋ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: jis parateet na aavee bhaaee so jeearraa jal jaau |6|
English: That soul,which does not place its faith in the Lord shall burn, O Siblings of Destiny. ||6||

Gurbani: ਬਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬੈ ਭਾਈ ਹਉ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bahu gun mere saahibai bhaaee hau tis kai bal jaau |
English: My Lord and Master has so many virtues, O Siblings of Destiny; I am a sacrifice to Him.

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਨਿਰਗੁਣੀਆਰੇ ਪਾਲਦਾ ਭਾਈ ਦੇਇ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਥਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ohu niraguneeaare paaladaa bhaaee dee nithaave thaau |
English: He nurtures even the most worthless, O Siblings of Destiny, and gives home to the homeless.

Gurbani: ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹੇ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਭਾਈ ਗੂੜਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: rijak sanbaahe saas saas bhaaee goorraa jaa kaa naau |
English: He gives us nourishment with each and every breath, O Siblings of Destiny; His Name is everlasting.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਪੂਰਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਰਮਾਉ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: jis gur saachaa bhetteeai bhaaee pooraa tis karamaau |7|
English: One who meets with the True Guru, O Siblings of Destiny, does so only by perfect destiny. ||7||

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਜੀਵੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: tis bin gharree na jeeveeai bhaaee sarab kalaa bharapoor |
English: Without Him, I cannot live, even for an instant, O Siblings of Destiny; He is totally filled with all powers.

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਭਾਈ ਪੇਖਉ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: saas giraas na visarai bhaaee pekhau sadaa hajoor |
English: With every breath and morsel of food, I will not forget Him, O Siblings of Destiny; I behold Him ever-present.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਭਾਈ ਸਰਬ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: saadhoo sang milaaeaa bhaaee sarab rahiaa bharapoor |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I meet Him, O Siblings of Destiny; He is totally pervading and permeating everywhere.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਲਗੀਆ ਭਾਈ ਸੇ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਮਰਦੇ ਝੂਰਿ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: jinaa preet na lageea bhaaee se nit nit marade jhoor |8|
English: Those who do not embrace love for the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny, always die crying out in pain. ||8||

Gurbani: ਅੰਚਲਿ ਲਾਇ ਤਰਾਇਆ ਭਾਈ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: anchal laae taraaeaa bhaaee bhaujal dukh sansaar |
English: Grasping hold of the hem of His robe, O Siblings of Destiny, we are carried across the world-ocean of fear and pain.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਅੰਗੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa nadar nihaaliaa bhaaee keeton ang apaar |
English: By His Glance of Grace, He has blessed us, O Siblings of Destiny; He shall be with us until the very end.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇਆ ਭਾਈ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: man tan seetal hoeaa bhaaee bhojan naam adhaar |
English: My mind and body are soothed and calmed, O Siblings of Destiny, nourished by the food of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਭਾਈ ਜਿ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੯॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak tis saranaagatee bhaaee ji kilabikh kaattanahaar |9|1|
English: Nanak has entered His Sanctuary, O Siblings of Destiny; the Lord is the Destroyer of sins. ||9||1||

[Ang 640 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਦੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੋ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤਹ ਅਪਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: maat garabh dukh saagaro piaare teh apanaa naam japaaeaa |
English: The womb of the mother is an ocean of pain, O Beloved; even there, the Lord causes His Name to be chanted.

Gurbani: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਪਸਰੀਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: baahar kaadt bikh pasareea piaare maaeaa mohu vadhaaeaa |
English: When he emerges, he finds corruption pervading everywhere, O Beloved, and he becomes increasingly attached to Maya.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕੀਤੋ ਕਰਮੁ ਆਪਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jis no keeto karam aap piaare tis pooraa guroo milaaeaa |
English: One whom the Lord blesses with His kind favor, O Beloved, meets the Perfect Guru.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: so aaraadhe saas saas piaare raam naam liv laaeaa |1|
English: He worships the Lord in adoration with each and every breath, O Beloved; he is lovingly attached to the Lord's Name. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ॥
Transliteration: man tan teree ttek hai piaare man tan teree ttek |
English: You are the support of my mind and body, O Beloved; You are the support of my mind and body.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਨਹਾਰੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਏਕ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tudh bin avar na karanahaar piaare antarajaamee ek | rahaau |
English: There is no other Creator except for You, O Beloved; You alone are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਇਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kott janam bhram aaeaa piaare anik jon dukh paae |
English: After wandering in doubt for millions of incarnations, he comes into the world, O Beloved; for uncounted lifetimes, he has suffered in pain.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: saachaa saahib visariaa piaare bahutee milai sajaae |
English: He has forgotten his True Lord and Master, O Beloved, and so he suffers terrible punishment.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਭੇਟੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸੇ ਲਾਗੇ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jin bhettai pooraa satiguroo piaare se laage saachai naae |
English: Those who meet with the Perfect True Guru, O Beloved, are attached to the True Name.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨਾ ਪਿਛੈ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜੋ ਸਾਚੀ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tinaa pichhai chhutteeai piaare jo saachee saranaae |2|
English: We are saved by following those, O Beloved, who seek the Sanctuary of the True Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਿਠਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਖਾਇਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤਿਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: mitthaa kar kai khaaeaa piaare tin tan keetaa rog |
English: He thinks that his food is so sweet, O Beloved, but it makes his body ill.

Gurbani: ਕਉੜਾ ਹੋਇ ਪਤਿਸਟਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: kaurraa hoe patisattiaa piaare tis te upajiaa sog |
English: It turns out to be bitter, O Beloved, and it produces only sadness.

Gurbani: ਭੋਗ ਭੁੰਚਾਇ ਭੁਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਉਤਰੈ ਨਹੀ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: bhog bhunchaae bhulaaeian piaare utarai nahee vijog |
English: The Lord leads him astray in the enjoyment of pleasures, O Beloved, and so his sense of separation does not depart.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਿ ਉਧਾਰਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਧੁਰੇ ਪਇਆ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jo gur mel udhaariaa piaare tin dhure peaa sanjog |3|
English: Those who meet the Guru are saved, O Beloved; this is their pre-ordained destiny. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਅਟਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਮੂਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa laalach attiaa piaare chit na aaveh mool |
English: He is filled with longing for Maya, O Beloved, and so the Lord does not ever come into his mind.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਤੂ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੇ ਤਨ ਹੋਏ ਧੂੜਿ ॥
Transliteration: jin too visareh paarabraham suaamee se tan hoe dhoorr |
English: Those who forget You, O Supreme Lord Master, their bodies turn to dust.

Gurbani: ਬਿਲਲਾਟ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੇਰਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਉਤਰੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੂਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: bilalaatt kareh bahuteriaa piaare utarai naahee sool |
English: They cry out and scream horribly, O Beloved, but their torment does not end.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਰਹਿਆ ਮੂਲੁ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jo gur mel savaariaa piaare tin kaa rahiaa mool |4|
English: Those who meet the Guru, and reform themselves, O Beloved, their capital remains intact. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤ ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਕੀਜਈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜੇ ਕਾ ਪਾਰਿ ਵਸਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: saakat sang na keejee piaare je kaa paar vasaae |
English: As far as possible, do not associate with the faithless cynics, O Beloved.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸੋੁ ਮੁਹਿ ਕਾਲੈ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jis miliai har visarai piaare suo muhi kaalai utth jaae |
English: Meeting with them, the Lord is forgotten, O Beloved, and you rise and depart with a blackened face.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਢੋਈ ਨਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh dtoee neh milai piaare daragah milai sajaae |
English: The self-willed manmukh finds no rest or shelter, O Beloved; in the Court of the Lord, they are punished.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤਿਨਾ ਪੂਰੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: jo gur mel savaariaa piaare tinaa pooree paae |5|
English: Those who meet with the Guru, and reform themselves, O Beloved, their affairs are resolved. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸੰਜਮ ਸਹਸ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਇਕ ਨ ਚਲੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: sanjam sehas siaanapaa piaare ik na chalee naal |
English: One may have thousands of clever tricks and techniques of austere self-discipline, O Beloved, but not even one of them will go with him.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਬੇਮੁਖ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਤੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੁਲਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਗਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: jo bemukh gobind te piaare tin kul laagai gaal |
English: Those who turn their backs on the Lord of the Universe, O Beloved, their families are stained with disgrace.

Gurbani: ਹੋਦੀ ਵਸਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਤੀਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕੂੜੁ ਨ ਚਲੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: hodee vasat na jaateea piaare koorr na chalee naal |
English: They do not realize that they do have Him , O Beloved; falsehood will not go with them.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨਾ ਮਿਲਾਇਓਨੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: satigur jinaa milaaeon piaare saachaa naam samaal |6|
English: Those who meet with the True Guru, O Beloved, dwell upon the True Name. ||6||

Gurbani: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sat santokh giaan dhiaan piaare jis no nadar kare |
English: When the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, O Beloved, one is blessed with Truth, contentment, wisdom and meditation.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪੂਰ ਭਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: anadin keeratan gun ravai piaare amrit poor bhare |
English: Night and day, he sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, O Beloved, totally filled with Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਦੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਿਨ ਲੰਘਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: dukh saagar tin langhiaa piaare bhavajal paar pare |
English: He crosses over the sea of pain, O Beloved, and swims across the terrifying world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸੇਈ ਸਦਾ ਖਰੇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: jis bhaavai tis mel laihi piaare seee sadaa khare |7|
English: One who is pleasing to His Will, He unites with Himself, O Beloved; he is forever true. ||7||

Gurbani: ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਦੇਉ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਭਗਤਾ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: samrath purakh deaal deo piaare bhagataa tis kaa taan |
English: The all-powerful Divine Lord is compassionate, O Beloved; He is the Support of His devotees.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਢਹਿ ਪਏ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਿ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: tis saranaaee dteh pe piaare ji antarajaamee jaan |
English: I seek His Sanctuary, O Beloved; He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

Gurbani: ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਸਚੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: halat palat savaariaa piaare masatak sach neesaan |
English: He has adorned me in this world and the next, O Beloved; He has placed the Emblem of Truth upon my forehead.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥੮॥੨॥
Transliteration: so prabh kade na veesarai piaare naanak sad kurabaan |8|2|
English: I shall never forget that God, O Beloved; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||8||2||

[Ang 641 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: soratth mahalaa 5 ghar 2 asattapadeea |
English: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl, Second House, Ashtpadheeyaa:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਪਾਠੁ ਪੜਿਓ ਅਰੁ ਬੇਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਨਿਵਲਿ ਭੁਅੰਗਮ ਸਾਧੇ ॥
Transliteration: paatth parrio ar bed beechaario nival bhuangam saadhe |
English: They read scriptures, and contemplate the Vedas; they practice the inner cleansing techniques of Yoga, and control of the breath.

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਜਨਾ ਸਿਉ ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਛੁਟਕਿਓ ਅਧਿਕ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਬਾਧੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: panch janaa siau sang na chhuttakio adhik ahanbudh baadhe |1|
English: But they cannot escape from the company of the five passions; they are increasingly bound to egotism. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪਿਆਰੇ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਮੈ ਕੀਏ ਕਰਮ ਅਨੇਕਾ ॥
Transliteration: piaare in bidh milan na jaaee mai kee karam anekaa |
English: O Beloved, this is not the way to meet the Lord; I have performed these rituals so many times.

Gurbani: ਹਾਰਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੈ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਦੀਜੈ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਬੇਕਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: haar pario suaamee kai duaarai deejai budh bibekaa | rahaau |
English: I have collapsed, exhausted, at the Door of my Lord Master; I pray that He may grant me a discerning intellect. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੋਨਿ ਭਇਓ ਕਰਪਾਤੀ ਰਹਿਓ ਨਗਨ ਫਿਰਿਓ ਬਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: mon bheo karapaatee rahio nagan firio ban maahee |
English: One may remain silent and use his hands as begging bowls, and wander naked in the forest.

Gurbani: ਤਟ ਤੀਰਥ ਸਭ ਧਰਤੀ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਓ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਛੁਟਕੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tatt teerath sabh dharatee bhramio dubidhaa chhuttakai naahee |2|
English: He may make pilgrimages to river banks and sacred shrines all over the world, but his sense of duality will not leave him. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਤੀਰਥ ਜਾਇ ਬਸਿਓ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਵਤ ਧਰਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: man kaamanaa teerath jaae basio sir karavat dharaae |
English: His mind's desires may lead him to go and dwell at sacred places of pilgrimage, and offer his head to be sawn off;

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਜੇ ਲਖ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: man kee mail na utarai ih bidh je lakh jatan karaae |3|
English: but this will not cause the filth of his mind to depart, even though he may make thousands of efforts. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਨਿਕ ਕਾਮਿਨੀ ਹੈਵਰ ਗੈਵਰ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kanik kaaminee haivar gaivar bahu bidh daan daataaraa |
English: He may give gifts of all sorts - gold, women, horses and elephants.

Gurbani: ਅੰਨ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਭੂਮਿ ਬਹੁ ਅਰਪੇ ਨਹ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: an basatr bhoom bahu arape neh mileeai har duaaraa |4|
English: He may make offerings of corn, clothes and land in abundance, but this will not lead him to the Lord's Door. ||4||

Gurbani: ਪੂਜਾ ਅਰਚਾ ਬੰਦਨ ਡੰਡਉਤ ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਰਤੁ ਰਹਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: poojaa arachaa bandan ddanddaut khatt karamaa rat rahataa |
English: He may remain devoted to worship and adoration, bowing his forehead to the floor, practicing the six religious rituals.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤ ਬੰਧਨ ਮਹਿ ਪਰਿਆ ਨਹ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਇਹ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: hau hau karat bandhan meh pariaa neh mileeai ih jugataa |5|
English: He indulges in egotism and pride, and falls into entanglements, but he does not meet the Lord by these devices. ||5||

Gurbani: ਜੋਗ ਸਿਧ ਆਸਣ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਏ ਭੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jog sidh aasan chauraaseeh e bhee kar kar rahiaa |
English: He practices the eighty-four postures of Yoga, and acquires the supernatural powers of the Siddhas, but he gets tired of practicing these.

Gurbani: ਵਡੀ ਆਰਜਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਗਹਿਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: vaddee aarajaa fir fir janamai har siau sang na gahiaa |6|
English: He lives a long life, but is reincarnated again and again; he has not met with the Lord. ||6||

Gurbani: ਰਾਜ ਲੀਲਾ ਰਾਜਨ ਕੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਕਰਿਆ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਅਫਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: raaj leelaa raajan kee rachanaa kariaa hukam afaaraa |
English: He may enjoy princely pleasures, and regal pomp and ceremony, and issue unchallenged commands.

Gurbani: ਸੇਜ ਸੋਹਨੀ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਚੋਆ ਨਰਕ ਘੋਰ ਕਾ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: sej sohanee chandan choaa narak ghor kaa duaaraa |7|
English: He may lie on beautiful beds, perfumed with sandalwood oil, but this will led him only to the gates of the most horrible hell. ||7||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਮਨ ਕੈ ਕਰਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: har keerat saadhasangat hai sir karaman kai karamaa |
English: Singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is the highest of all actions.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਇਓ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਪੁਰਬ ਲਿਖੇ ਕਾ ਲਹਨਾ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak tis bheo paraapat jis purab likhe kaa lahanaa |8|
English: Says Nanak, he alone obtains it, who is pre-destined to receive it. ||8||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਇਹ ਰੰਗਿ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: tero sevak ih rang maataa |
English: Your slave is intoxicated with this Love of Yours.

Gurbani: ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥੩॥
Transliteration: bheo kripaal deen dukh bhanjan har har keeratan ihu man raataa | rahaau doojaa |1|3|
English: The Destroyer of the pains of the poor has become merciful to me, and this mind is imbued with the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||Second Pause||1||3||

[Ang 642 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੋਰਠਿ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲੇ ੪ ਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: raag soratth vaar mahale 4 kee |
English: Vaar Of Raag Sorat'h, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਜੇ ਸਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: soratth sadaa suhaavanee je sachaa man hoe |
English: Sorat'h is always beautiful, if it brings the True Lord to dwell in the mind of the soul-bride.

Gurbani: ਦੰਦੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਕਤੁ ਮਨਿ ਜੀਭੈ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: dandee mail na kat man jeebhai sachaa soe |
English: Her teeth are clean and her mind is not split by duality; the Name of the True Lord is on her tongue.

Gurbani: ਸਸੁਰੈ ਪੇਈਐ ਭੈ ਵਸੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਨਿਸੰਗ ॥
Transliteration: sasurai peeeai bhai vasee satigur sev nisang |
English: Here and hereafter, she abides in the Fear of God, and serves the True Guru without hesitation.

Gurbani: ਪਰਹਰਿ ਕਪੜੁ ਜੇ ਪਿਰ ਮਿਲੈ ਖੁਸੀ ਰਾਵੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: parahar kaparr je pir milai khusee raavai pir sang |
English: Discarding worldly adornments, she meets her Husband Lord, and she celebrates joyfully with Him.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸੀਗਾਰੀ ਨਾਉ ਮਨਿ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਮੈਲੁ ਪਤੰਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa seegaaree naau man kade na mail patang |
English: She is adorned forever with the Name in her mind, and she does not have even an iota of filth.

Gurbani: ਦੇਵਰ ਜੇਠ ਮੁਏ ਦੁਖਿ ਸਸੂ ਕਾ ਡਰੁ ਕਿਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: devar jetth mue dukh sasoo kaa ddar kis |
English: Her husband's younger and elder brothers, the corrupt desires, have died, suffering in pain; and now, who fears Maya, the mother-in-law?

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਪਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਕਰਮ ਮਣੀ ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: je pir bhaavai naanakaa karam manee sabh sach |1|
English: If she becomes pleasing to her Husband Lord, O Nanak, she bears the jewel of good karma upon her forehead, and everything is Truth to her. ||1||

[Ang 642 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 4 |
English: Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਤਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਢੰਢੋਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: soratth taam suhaavanee jaa har naam dtandtole |
English: Sorat'h is beautiful only when it leads the soul-bride to seek the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਨਾਵੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur purakh manaavai aapanaa guramatee har har bole |
English: She pleases her Guru and God; under Guru's Instruction, she speaks the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਕਸਾਈ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਚੋਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: har prem kasaaee dinas raat har ratee har rang chole |
English: She is attracted to the Lord's Name, day and night, and her body is drenched in the color of the Love of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੈਸਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਲਭਈ ਸਭੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਜਗਤੁ ਮੈ ਟੋਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: har jaisaa purakh na labhee sabh dekhiaa jagat mai ttole |
English: No other being like the Lord God can be found; I have looked and searched over the whole world.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਡੋਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur satigur naam drirraaeaa man anat na kaahoo ddole |
English: The Guru, the True Guru, has implanted the Naam within me; my mind does not waver any more.

Gurbani: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਗੋਲ ਗੋਲੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jan naanak har kaa daas hai gur satigur ke gol gole |2|
English: Servant Nanak is the Lord's slave, the slave of the slaves of the Guru, the True Guru. ||2||

[Ang 642 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: too aape sisatt karataa sirajanahaariaa |
English: You Yourself are the Creator, the Fashioner of the world.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: tudh aape khel rachaae tudh aap savaariaa |
English: You Yourself have arranged the play, and You Yourself arrange it.

Gurbani: ਦਾਤਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਭੋਗਣਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: daataa karataa aap aap bhoganahaariaa |
English: You Yourself are the Giver and the Creator; You Yourself are the Enjoyer.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਉਪਾਵਣਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabh teraa sabad varatai upaavanahaariaa |
English: The Word of Your Shabad is pervading everywhere, O Creator Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: hau guramukh sadaa salaahee gur kau vaariaa |1|
English: As Gurmukh, I ever praise the Lord; I am a sacrifice to the Guru. ||1||

[Ang 643 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਜਲਤੇ ਜਲਿ ਮੁਏ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਏ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: haumai jalate jal mue bhram aae doojai bhaae |
English: In the flames of egotism, he is burnt to death; he wanders in doubt and the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਆਪਣੈ ਪੰਨੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: poorai satigur raakh lee aapanai panai paae |
English: The Perfect True Guru saves him, making him His own.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਜਲਤਾ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: eihu jag jalataa nadaree aaeaa gur kai sabad subhaae |
English: This world is burning; through the Sublime Word of the Guru's Shabad, this comes to be seen.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਸੀਤਲ ਭਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sabad rate se seetal bhe naanak sach kamaae |1|
English: Those who are attuned to the Shabad are cooled and soothed; O Nanak, they practice Truth. ||1||

[Ang 643 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਫਲਿਓ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: safalio satigur seviaa dhan janam paravaan |
English: Service to the True Guru is fruitful and rewarding; blessed and acceptable is such a life.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਮੁਇਆ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਸੇਈ ਪੁਰਖ ਸੁਜਾਣ ॥
Transliteration: jinaa satigur jeevadiaa mueaa na visarai seee purakh sujaan |
English: Those who do not forget the True Guru, in life and in death, are truly wise people.

Gurbani: ਕੁਲੁ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: kul udhaare aapanaa so jan hovai paravaan |
English: Their families are saved, and they are approved by the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਏ ਜੀਵਦੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹਹਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh mue jeevade paravaan heh manamukh janam maraeh |
English: The Gurmukhs are approved in death as in life, while the self-willed manmukhs continue the cycle of birth and death.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੁਏ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਜਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak mue na aakheeeh ji gur kai sabad samaeh |2|
English: O Nanak, they are not described as dead, who are absorbed in the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2||

[Ang 643 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: har purakh niranjan sev har naam dhiaaeeai |
English: Serve the Immaculate Lord God, and meditate on the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਲਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: satasangat saadhoo lag har naam samaaeeai |
English: Join the Society of the Holy Saints, and be absorbed in the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡੀ ਕਾਰ ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: har teree vaddee kaar mai moorakh laaeeai |
English: O Lord, glorious and great is service to You; I am so foolish

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਗੋਲਾ ਲਾਲਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਮੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: hau golaa laalaa tudh mai hukam furamaaeeai |
English: - please, commit me to it. I am Your servant and slave; command me, according to Your Will.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਾ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: hau guramukh kaar kamaavaa ji gur samajhaaeeai |2|
English: As Gurmukh, I shall serve You, as Guru has instructed me. ||2||

[Ang 643 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਜਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਲਿਖਿਆਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: poorab likhiaa kamaavanaa ji karatai aap likhiaas |
English: He acts according to pre-ordained destiny, written by the Creator Himself.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹ ਠਗਉਲੀ ਪਾਈਅਨੁ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: moh tthgaulee paaeean visariaa gunataas |
English: Emotional attachment has drugged him, and he has forgotten the Lord, the treasure of virtue.

Gurbani: ਮਤੁ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਜੀਵਦਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਮੁਇਆਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: mat jaanahu jag jeevadaa doojai bhaae mueaas |
English: Don't think that he is alive in the world - he is dead, through the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਸੇ ਬਹਣਿ ਨ ਮਿਲਨੀ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: jinee guramukh naam na chetio se behan na milanee paas |
English: Those who do not meditate on the Lord, as Gurmukh, are not permitted to sit near the Lord.

Gurbani: ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਬਹੁ ਅਤਿ ਘਣਾ ਪੁਤੁ ਕਲਤੁ ਨ ਸਾਥਿ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: dukh laagaa bahu at ghanaa put kalat na saath koee jaas |
English: They suffer the most horrible pain and suffering, and neither their sons nor their wives go along with them.

Gurbani: ਲੋਕਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਮੁਹੁ ਕਾਲਾ ਹੋਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਉਭੇ ਸਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: lokaa vich muhu kaalaa hoaa andar ubhe saas |
English: Their faces are blackened among men, and they sigh in deep regret.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਕੋ ਨ ਵਿਸਹੀ ਚੁਕਿ ਗਇਆ ਵੇਸਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: manamukhaa no ko na visahee chuk geaa vesaas |
English: No one places any reliance in the self-willed manmukhs; trust in them is lost.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਅਗਲਾ ਜਿਨਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukhaa no sukh agalaa jinaa antar naam nivaas |1|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs live in absolute peace; the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides within them. ||1||

[Ang 643 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਸੈਣ ਸੇ ਸਜਣਾ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: se sain se sajanaa ji guramukh mileh subhaae |
English: They alone are relatives, and they alone are friends, who, as Gurmukh, join together in love.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur kaa bhaanaa anadin kareh se sach rahe samaae |
English: Night and day, they act according to the True Guru's Will; they remain absorbed in the True Name.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਲਗੇ ਸਜਣ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਵੇਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: doojai bhaae lage sajan na aakheeeh ji abhimaan kareh vekaar |
English: Those who are attached to the love of duality are not called friends; they practice egotism and corruption.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਆਪ ਸੁਆਰਥੀ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਨ ਸਕਹਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh aap suaarathee kaaraj na sakeh savaar |
English: The self-willed manmukhs are selfish; they cannot resolve anyone's affairs.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak poorab likhiaa kamaavanaa koe na mettanahaar |2|
English: O Nanak, they act according to their pre-ordained destiny; no one can erase it. ||2||

[Ang 643 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਆਪਿ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tudh aape jagat upaae kai aap khel rachaaeaa |
English: You Yourself created the world, and You Yourself arranged the play of it.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਆਪਿ ਸਿਰਜਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: trai gun aap sirajiaa maaeaa mohu vadhaaeaa |
English: You Yourself created the three qualities, and fostered emotional attachment to Maya.

Gurbani: ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: vich haumai lekhaa mangeeai fir aavai jaaeaa |
English: He is called to account for his deeds done in egotism; he continues coming and going in reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jinaa har aap kripaa kare se gur samajhaaeaa |
English: The Guru instructs those whom the Lord Himself blesses with Grace.

Gurbani: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਘੁਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: balihaaree gur aapane sadaa sadaa ghumaaeaa |3|
English: I am a sacrifice to my Guru; forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to Him. ||3||

[Ang 643 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਣੁ ਦੰਤਾ ਜਗੁ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mamataa mohanee jin vin dantaa jag khaaeaa |
English: The love of Maya is enticing; without teeth, it has eaten up the world.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਖਾਧੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh khaadhe guramukh ubare jinee sach naam chit laaeaa |
English: The self-willed manmukhs are eaten away, while the Gurmukhs are saved; they focus their consciousness on the True Name.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜਗੁ ਕਮਲਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bin naavai jag kamalaa firai guramukh nadaree aaeaa |
English: Without the Name, the world wanders around insane; the Gurmukhs come to see this.

Gurbani: ਧੰਧਾ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਨਿਹਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਨ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: dhandhaa karatiaa nihafal janam gavaaeaa sukhadaataa man na vasaaeaa |
English: Involved in worldly affairs, he wastes his life in vain; the peace-giving Lord does not come to abide in his mind.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak naam tinaa kau miliaa jin kau dhur likh paaeaa |1|
English: O Nanak, they alone obtain the Name, who have such pre-ordained destiny. ||1||

[Ang 644 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਭਰਪੂਰੁ ਹੈ ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: ghar hee meh amrit bharapoor hai manamukhaa saad na paaeaa |
English: The home within is filled with Ambrosial Nectar, but the self-willed manmukh does not get to taste it.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਕਸਤੂਰੀ ਮਿਰਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਭ੍ਰਮਦਾ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jiau kasatooree mirag na jaanai bhramadaa bharam bhulaaeaa |
English: He is like the deer, who does not recognize its own musk-scent; it wanders around, deluded by doubt.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤਜਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ ਕਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: amrit taj bikh sangrahai karatai aap khuaaeaa |
English: The manmukh forsakes the Ambrosial Nectar, and instead gathers poison; the Creator Himself has fooled him.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਈ ਤਿਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh virale sojhee pee tinaa andar braham dikhaaeaa |
English: How rare are the Gurmukhs, who obtain this understanding; they behold the Lord God within themselves.

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇਆ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tan man seetal hoeaa rasanaa har saad aaeaa |
English: Their minds and bodies are cooled and soothed, and their tongues enjoy the sublime taste of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੇ ਹੀ ਨਾਉ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabade hee naau aoopajai sabade mel milaaeaa |
English: Through the Word of the Shabad, the Name wells up; through the Shabad, we are united in the Lord's Union.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਬਉਰਾਨਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bin sabadai sabh jag bauraanaa birathaa janam gavaaeaa |
English: Without the Shabad, the whole world is insane, and it loses its life in vain.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਏਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: amrit eko sabad hai naanak guramukh paaeaa |2|
English: The Shabad alone is Ambrosial Nectar; O Nanak, the Gurmukhs obtain it. ||2||

[Ang 644 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: so har purakh agam hai kahu kit bidh paaeeai |
English: The Lord God is inaccessible; tell me, how can we find Him?

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖ ਅਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੁ ਕਹੁ ਜਨ ਕਿਉ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: tis roop na rekh adrisatt kahu jan kiau dhiaaeeai |
English: He has no form or feature, and He cannot be seen; tell me, how can we meditate on Him?

Gurbani: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: nirankaar niranjan har agam kiaa keh gun gaaeeai |
English: The Lord is formless, immaculate and inaccessible; which of His Virtues should we speak of and sing?

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: jis aap bujhaae aap su har maarag paaeeai |
English: They alone walk on the Lord's Path, whom the Lord Himself instructs.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਵੇਖਾਲਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: gur poorai vekhaaliaa gur sevaa paaeeai |4|
English: The Perfect Guru has revealed Him to me; serving the Guru, He is found. ||4||

[Ang 644 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਤਨੁ ਕੋਲੂ ਪੀੜੀਐ ਰਤੁ ਨ ਭੋਰੀ ਡੇਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jiau tan koloo peerreeai rat na bhoree ddehi |
English: It is as if my body has been crushed in the oil-press, without yielding even a drop of blood;

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਵੰਞੈ ਚਉ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਸਚੇ ਸੰਦੜੈ ਨੇਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jeeo vanyai chau khaneeai sache sandarrai nehi |
English: it is as if my soul has been cut apart into pieces for the sake of the Love of the True Lord;

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲੁ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਰਾਤੀ ਅਤੈ ਡੇਹ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak mel na chukee raatee atai ddeh |1|
English: O Nanak, still, night and day, my Union with the Lord is not broken. ||1||

[Ang 644 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਜਣੁ ਮੈਡਾ ਰੰਗੁਲਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਏ ਮਨੁ ਲੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: sajan maiddaa rangulaa rang laae man lee |
English: My Friend is so full of joy and love; He colors my mind with the color of His Love,

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਮਾਜੀਠੈ ਕਪੜੇ ਰੰਗੇ ਭੀ ਪਾਹੇਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jiau maajeetthai kaparre range bhee paahehi |
English: like the fabric which is treated to retain the color of the dye.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਬਿਆ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਕੇਹ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak rang na utarai biaa na lagai keh |2|
English: O Nanak, this color does not depart, and no other color can be imparted to this fabric. ||2||

[Ang 644 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਲਾਇਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: har aap varatai aap har aap bulaaeidaa |
English: The Lord Himself is pervading everywhere; the Lord Himself causes us to chant His Name.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: har aape srisatt savaar sir dhandhai laaeidaa |
English: The Lord Himself created the creation; He commits all to their tasks.

Gurbani: ਇਕਨਾ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਇ ਇਕਿ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਇਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: eikanaa bhagatee laae ik aap khuaaeidaa |
English: He engages some in devotional worship, and others, He causes to stray.

Gurbani: ਇਕਨਾ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਇ ਇਕਿ ਉਝੜਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: eikanaa maarag paae ik ujharr paaeidaa |
English: He places some on the Path, while He leads others into the wilderness.

Gurbani: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: jan naanak naam dhiaae guramukh gun gaaeidaa |5|
English: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; as Gurmukh, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||5||

[Ang 644 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਫਲੁ ਹੈ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur kee sevaa safal hai je ko kare chit laae |
English: Service to the True Guru is fruitful and rewarding, if one performs it with his mind focused on it.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਣਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man chindiaa fal paavanaa haumai vichahu jaae |
English: The fruits of the mind's desires are obtained, and egotism departs from within.

Gurbani: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋੜੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਚੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bandhan torrai mukat hoe sache rahai samaae |
English: His bonds are broken, and he is liberated; he remains absorbed in the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਲਭੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: eis jag meh naam alabh hai guramukh vasai man aae |
English: It is so difficult to obtain the Naam in this world; it comes to dwell in the mind of the Gurmukh.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak jo gur seveh aapanaa hau tin balihaarai jaau |1|
English: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to one who serves his True Guru. ||1||

[Ang 644 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੰਨੁ ਅਜਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh man ajit hai doojai lagai jaae |
English: The mind of the self-willed manmukh is so very stubborn; it is stuck in the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਨਹੀ ਦੁਖੇ ਦੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: tis no sukh supanai nahee dukhe dukh vihaae |
English: He does not find peace, even in dreams; he passes his life in misery and suffering.

Gurbani: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਥਕੇ ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: ghar ghar parr parr panddit thake sidh samaadh lagaae |
English: The Pandits have grown weary of going door to door, reading and reciting their scriptures; the Siddhas have gone into their trances of Samaadhi.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਵਸਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਥਕੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: eihu man vas na aavee thake karam kamaae |
English: This mind cannot be controlled; they are tired of performing religious rituals.

Gurbani: ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਿ ਥਕੇ ਅਠਿਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhekhadhaaree bhekh kar thake atthisatth teerath naae |
English: The impersonators have grown weary of wearing false costumes, and bathing at the sixty-eight sacred shrines.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man kee saar na jaananee haumai bharam bhulaae |
English: They do not know the state of their own minds; they are deluded by doubt and egotism.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਭਉ ਪਇਆ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee bhau peaa vaddabhaag vasiaa man aae |
English: By Guru's Grace, the Fear of God is obtained; by great good fortune, the Lord comes to abide in the mind.

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਪਇਐ ਮਨੁ ਵਸਿ ਹੋਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhai peiai man vas hoaa haumai sabad jalaae |
English: When the Fear of God comes, the mind is restrained, and through the Word of the Shabad, the ego is burnt away.

Gurbani: ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sach rate se niramale jotee jot milaae |
English: Those who are imbued with Truth are immaculate; their light merges in the Light.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: satigur miliai naau paaeaa naanak sukh samaae |2|
English: Meeting the True Guru, one obtains the Name; O Nanak, he is absorbed in peace. ||2||

[Ang 645 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਏਹ ਭੂਪਤਿ ਰਾਣੇ ਰੰਗ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: eeh bhoopat raane rang din chaar suhaavanaa |
English: The pleasures of kings and emperors are pleasing, but they last for only a few days.

Gurbani: ਏਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਵਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: ehu maaeaa rang kasunbh khin meh leh jaavanaa |
English: These pleasures of Maya are like the color of the safflower, which wears off in a moment.

Gurbani: ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਪਾਪ ਲੈ ਜਾਵਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: chaladiaa naal na chalai sir paap lai jaavanaa |
English: They do not go with him when he departs; instead, he carries the load of sins upon his head.

Gurbani: ਜਾਂ ਪਕੜਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ਕਾਲਿ ਤਾਂ ਖਰਾ ਡਰਾਵਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaan pakarr chalaaeaa kaal taan kharaa ddaraavanaa |
English: When death seizes him, and marches him away, then he looks absolutely hideous.

Gurbani: ਓਹ ਵੇਲਾ ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਣਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: oeh velaa hath na aavai fir pachhutaavanaa |6|
English: That lost opportunity will not come into his hands again, and in the end, he regrets and repents. ||6||

[Ang 645 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਮੁਹ ਫਿਰੇ ਸੇ ਬਧੇ ਦੁਖ ਸਹਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: satigur te jo muh fire se badhe dukh sahaeh |
English: Those who turn their faces away from the True Guru, suffer in sorrow and bondage.

Gurbani: ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਿਲਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੀ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਤੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: fir fir milan na paaeinee jameh tai mar jaeh |
English: Again and again, they are born only to die; they cannot meet their Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਹਸਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਈ ਦੁਖ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: sahasaa rog na chhoddee dukh hee meh dukh paeh |
English: The disease of doubt does not depart, and they find only pain and more pain.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੇਹਿ ਸਬਦੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak nadaree bakhas lehi sabade mel milaeh |1|
English: O Nanak, if the Gracious Lord forgives, then one is united in Union with the Word of the Shabad. ||1||

[Ang 645 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮੁਹ ਫਿਰੇ ਤਿਨਾ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਠਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo satigur te muh fire tinaa tthaur na tthaau |
English: Those who turn their faces away from the True Guru, shall find no place of rest or shelter.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਛੁਟੜਿ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਦੁਹਚਾਰਣਿ ਬਦਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jiau chhuttarr ghar ghar firai duhachaaran badanaau |
English: They wander around from door to door, like a woman forsaken, with a bad character and a bad reputation.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਖਸੀਅਹਿ ਸੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh bakhaseeeh se satigur mel milaau |2|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are forgiven, and united in Union with the True Guru. ||2||

[Ang 645 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਤਿ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ਸੇ ਭਵਜਲ ਤਰਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jo seveh sat muraar se bhavajal tar geaa |
English: Those who serve the True Lord, the Destroyer of ego, cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ਤਿਨ ਜਮੁ ਛਡਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jo boleh har har naau tin jam chhadd geaa |
English: Those who chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, are passed over by the Messenger of Death.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: se daragah paidhe jaeh jinaa har jap leaa |
English: Those who meditate on the Lord, go to His Court in robes of honor.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇਈ ਪੁਰਖ ਜਿਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਮਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: har seveh seee purakh jinaa har tudh meaa |
English: They alone serve You, O Lord, whom You bless with Grace.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭਉ ਗਇਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: gun gaavaa piaare nit guramukh bhram bhau geaa |7|
English: I sing continually Your Glorious Praises, O Beloved; as Gurmukh, my doubts and fears have been dispelled. ||7||

[Ang 645 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਥਾਲੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਤੈ ਵਸਤੂ ਪਈਓ ਹਰਿ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: thaalai vich tai vasatoo peeo har bhojan amrit saar |
English: Upon the plate, three things have been placed; this is the sublime, ambrosial food of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਖਾਧੈ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੀਐ ਪਾਈਐ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jit khaadhai man tripateeai paaeeai mokh duaar |
English: Eating this, the mind is satisfied, and the Door of Salvation is found.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਅਲਭੁ ਹੈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਲਭੈ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: eihu bhojan alabh hai santahu labhai gur veechaar |
English: It is so difficult to obtain this food, O Saints; it is obtained only by contemplating the Guru.

Gurbani: ਏਹ ਮੁਦਾਵਣੀ ਕਿਉ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਕਢੀਐ ਸਦਾ ਰਖੀਐ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: eeh mudaavanee kiau vichahu kadteeai sadaa rakheeai ur dhaar |
English: Why should we cast this riddle out of our minds? We should keep it ever enshrined in our hearts.

Gurbani: ਏਹ ਮੁਦਾਵਣੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਪਾਈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਲਧੀ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: eeh mudaavanee satiguroo paaee gurasikhaa ladhee bhaal |
English: The True Guru has posed this riddle. The Guru's Sikhs have found its solution.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੁ ਬੁਝਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਘਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak jis bujhaae su bujhasee har paaeaa guramukh ghaal |1|
English: O Nanak, he alone understands this, whom the Lord inspires to understand. The Gurmukhs work hard, and find the Lord. ||1||

[Ang 645 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jo dhur mele se mil rahe satigur siau chit laae |
English: Those whom the Primal Lord unites, remain in Union with Him; they focus their consciousness on the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਵਿਛੋੜੇਨੁ ਸੇ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: aap vichhorren se vichhurre doojai bhaae khuaae |
English: Those whom the Lord Himself separates, remain separated; in the love of duality, they are ruined.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕਿਆ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak vin karamaa kiaa paaeeai poorab likhiaa kamaae |2|
English: O Nanak, without good karma, what can anyone obtain? He earns what he is pre-destined to receive. ||2||

[Ang 645 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਬਹਿ ਸਖੀਆ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗਾਵਣਹਾਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: beh sakheea jas gaaveh gaavanahaareea |
English: Sitting together, the companions sing the Songs of the Lord's Praises.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: har naam salaahihu nit har kau balihaareea |
English: They praise the Lord's Name continually; they are a sacrifice to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ਤਿਨਾ ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: jinee sun maniaa har naau tinaa hau vaareea |
English: Those who hear, and believe in the Lord's Name, to them I am a sacrifice.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੁ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਹਾਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: guramukheea har mel milaavanahaareea |
English: O Lord, let me unite with the Gurmukhs, who are united with You.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਵਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਦੇਖਣਹਾਰੀਆ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: hau bal jaavaa din raat gur dekhanahaareea |8|
English: I am a sacrifice to those who, day and night, behold their Guru. ||8||

[Ang 645 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭਿ ਭਰਮਦੇ ਨਿਤ ਜਗਿ ਤੋਟਾ ਸੈਸਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: vin naavai sabh bharamade nit jag tottaa saisaar |
English: Without the Name of the Lord, everyone wanders around the world, losing.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਅੰਧੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh karam kamaavane haumai andh gubaar |
English: The self-willed manmukhs do their deeds in the pitch black darkness of egotism.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਣਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: guramukh amrit peevanaa naanak sabad veechaar |1|
English: The Gurmukhs drink in the Ambrosial Nectar, O Nanak, contemplating the Word of the Shabad. ||1||

[Ang 646 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਜਾਗੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: sahaje jaagai sahaje sovai |
English: He wakes in peace, and he sleeps in peace.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh anadin usatat hovai |
English: The Gurmukh praises the Lord night and day.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮੈ ਸਹਸਾ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh bharamai sahasaa hovai |
English: The self-willed manmukh remains deluded by his doubts.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਸੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: antar chintaa need na sovai |
English: He is filled with anxiety, and he cannot even sleep.

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਾਗਹਿ ਸਵਹਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: giaanee jaageh saveh subhaae |
English: The spiritually wise wake and sleep in peace.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤਿਆ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naam ratiaa bal jaau |2|
English: Nanak is a sacrifice to those who are imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

[Ang 646 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਰਤਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: se har naam dhiaaveh jo har ratiaa |
English: They alone meditate on the Lord's Name, who are imbued with the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਇਕੁ ਇਕੋ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: har ik dhiaaveh ik iko har satiaa |
English: They meditate on the One Lord; the One and Only Lord is True.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਇਕੁ ਇਕੋ ਉਤਪਤਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: har iko varatai ik iko utapatiaa |
English: The One Lord is pervading everywhere; the One Lord created the Universe.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਡਰੁ ਸਟਿ ਘਤਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jo har naam dhiaaveh tin ddar satt ghatiaa |
English: Those who meditate on the Lord's Name, cast out their fears.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਦੇਵੈ ਆਪਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: guramatee devai aap guramukh har japiaa |9|
English: The Lord Himself blesses them with Guru's Instruction; the Gurmukh meditates on the Lord. ||9||

[Ang 646 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਜਿਤੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: antar giaan na aaeo jit kichh sojhee paae |
English: Spiritual wisdom, which would bring understanding, does not enter into his mind.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਡਿਠਾ ਕਿਆ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਅੰਧਾ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: vin dditthaa kiaa saalaaheeai andhaa andh kamaae |
English: Without seeing, how can he praise the Lord? The blind act in blindness.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak sabad pachhaaneeai naam vasai man aae |1|
English: O Nanak, when one realizes the Word of the Shabad, then the Naam comes to abide in the mind. ||1||

[Ang 646 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਇਕਾ ਬਾਣੀ ਇਕੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਇਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: eikaa baanee ik gur iko sabad veechaar |
English: There is One Bani; there is One Guru; there is one Shabad to contemplate.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਸਉਦਾ ਹਟੁ ਸਚੁ ਰਤਨੀ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa saudaa hatt sach ratanee bhare bhanddaar |
English: True is the merchandise, and true is the shop; the warehouses are overflowing with jewels.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਅਨਿ ਜੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur kirapaa te paaeean je devai devanahaar |
English: By Guru's Grace, they are obtained, if the Great Giver gives them.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਸਉਦਾ ਲਾਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਖਟਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa saudaa laabh sadaa khattiaa naam apaar |
English: Dealing in this true merchandise, one earns the profit of the incomparable Naam.

Gurbani: ਵਿਖੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਆ ਕਰਮਿ ਪੀਆਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: vikh vich amrit pragattiaa karam peeaavanahaar |
English: In the midst of poison, the Ambrosial Nectar is revealed; by His Mercy, one drinks it in.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak sach salaaheeai dhan savaaranahaar |2|
English: O Nanak, praise the True Lord; blessed is the Creator, the Embellisher. ||2||

[Ang 646 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ॥
Transliteration: jinaa andar koorr varatai sach na bhaavee |
English: Those who are permeated by falsehood, do not love the Truth.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਕੂੜਾ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਵਈ ॥
Transliteration: je ko bolai sach koorraa jal jaavee |
English: If someone speaks the Truth, falsehood is burnt away.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜਿਆਰੀ ਰਜੈ ਕੂੜਿ ਜਿਉ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਕਾਗੁ ਖਾਵਈ ॥
Transliteration: koorriaaree rajai koorr jiau visattaa kaag khaavee |
English: The false are satisfied by falsehood, like the crows who eat manure.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਸੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਈ ॥
Transliteration: jis har hoe kripaal so naam dhiaavee |
English: When the Lord grants His Grace, then one meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਪਾਪੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਵਈ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: har guramukh naam araadh koorr paap leh jaavee |10|
English: As Gurmukh, worship the Lord's Name in adoration; fraud and sin shall disappear. ||10||

[Ang 646 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੇਖਾ ਚਉਚਕਿਆ ਚਉਵਾਇਆ ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਇਕਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਣਿ ॥
Transliteration: sekhaa chauchakiaa chauvaaeaa ehu man ikat ghar aan |
English: O Shaykh, you wander in the four directions, blown by the four winds; bring your mind back to the home of the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਏਹੜ ਤੇਹੜ ਛਡਿ ਤੂ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: eeharr teharr chhadd too gur kaa sabad pachhaan |
English: Renounce your petty arguments, and realize the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਗੈ ਢਹਿ ਪਉ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: satigur agai dteh pau sabh kichh jaanai jaan |
English: Bow in humble respect before the True Guru; He is the Knower who knows everything.

Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਜਲਾਇ ਤੂ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੁ ਮਿਹਮਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa manasaa jalaae too hoe rahu mihamaan |
English: Burn away your hopes and desires, and live like a guest in this world.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਭੀ ਚਲਹਿ ਤਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: satigur kai bhaanai bhee chaleh taa daragah paaveh maan |
English: If you walk in harmony with the True Guru's Will, then you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਨੀ ਤਿਨ ਧਿਗੁ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਧਿਗੁ ਖਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak ji naam na chetanee tin dhig painan dhig khaan |1|
English: O Nanak, those who do not contemplate the Naam, the Name of the Lord - cursed are their clothes, and cursed is their food. ||1||

[Ang 646 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: har gun tott na aavee keemat kehan na jaae |
English: There is no end to the Lord's Glorious Praises; His worth cannot be described.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh har gun raveh gun meh rahai samaae |2|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord; they are absorbed in His Glorious Virtues. ||2||

[Ang 646 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਚੋਲੀ ਦੇਹ ਸਵਾਰੀ ਕਢਿ ਪੈਧੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: har cholee deh savaaree kadt paidhee bhagat kar |
English: The Lord has adorned the coat of the body; He has embroidered it with devotional worship.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪਾਟੁ ਲਗਾ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ਬਹੁ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਭਾਤਿ ਕਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: har paatt lagaa adhikaaee bahu bahu bidh bhaat kar |
English: The Lord has woven His silk into it, in so many ways and fashions.

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਬੂਝਣਹਾਰਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਿਬੇਕੁ ਕਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: koee boojhai boojhanahaaraa antar bibek kar |
English: How rare is that man of understanding, who understands, and deliberates within.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਏਹੁ ਬਿਬੇਕੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: so boojhai ehu bibek jis bujhaae aap har |
English: He alone understands these deliberations, whom the Lord Himself inspires to understand.

Gurbani: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਹਰਿ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak kahai vichaaraa guramukh har sat har |11|
English: Poor servant Nanak speaks: the Gurmukhs know the Lord, the Lord is True. ||11||

[Ang 647 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪਰਥਾਇ ਸਾਖੀ ਮਹਾ ਪੁਰਖ ਬੋਲਦੇ ਸਾਝੀ ਸਗਲ ਜਹਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: parathaae saakhee mahaa purakh bolade saajhee sagal jahaanai |
English: Great men speak the teachings by relating them to individual situations, but the whole world shares in them.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਭਉ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh hoe su bhau kare aapanaa aap pachhaanai |
English: One who becomes Gurmukh knows the Fear of God, and realizes his own self.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee jeevat marai taa man hee te man maanai |
English: If, by Guru's Grace, one remains dead while yet alive, the mind becomes content in itself.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਥਹਿ ਗਿਆਨੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jin kau man kee parateet naahee naanak se kiaa katheh giaanai |1|
English: Those who have no faith in their own minds, O Nanak - how can they speak of spiritual wisdom? ||1||

[Ang 647 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਇਓ ਅੰਤਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਹੁਤਾ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh chit na laaeo ant dukh pahutaa aae |
English: Those who do not focus their consciousness on the Lord, as Gurmukh, suffer pain and grief in the end.

Gurbani: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਅੰਧਿਆਂ ਸੁਧਿ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: andarahu baaharahu andhiaan sudh na kaaee paae |
English: They are blind, inwardly and outwardly, and they do not understand anything.

Gurbani: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਬਰਕਤੀ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਖਾਇ ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: panddit tin kee barakatee sabh jagat khaae jo rate har naae |
English: O Pandit, O religious scholar, the whole world is fed for the sake of those who are attuned to the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jin gur kai sabad salaahiaa har siau rahe samaae |
English: Those who praise the Word of the Guru's Shabad, remain blended with the Lord.

Gurbani: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਬਰਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਾ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: panddit doojai bhaae barakat na hovee naa dhan palai paae |
English: O Pandit, O religious scholar, no one is satisfied, and no one finds true wealth through the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਪੜਿ ਥਕੇ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਲਤ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: parr thake santokh na aaeo anadin jalat vihaae |
English: They have grown weary of reading scriptures, but still, they do not find contentment, and they pass their lives burning, night and day.

Gurbani: ਕੂਕ ਪੂਕਾਰ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਨਾ ਸੰਸਾ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kook pookaar na chukee naa sansaa vichahu jaae |
English: Their cries and complaints never end, and doubt does not depart from within them.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣਿਆ ਮੁਹਿ ਕਾਲੈ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naam vihooniaa muhi kaalai utth jaae |2|
English: O Nanak, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, they rise up and depart with blackened faces. ||2||

[Ang 647 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣ ਮੇਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਦਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har sajan mel piaare mil panth dasaaee |
English: O Beloved, lead me to meet my True Friend; meeting with Him, I shall ask Him to show me the Path.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਦਸੇ ਮਿਤੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jo har dase mit tis hau bal jaaee |
English: I am a sacrifice to that Friend, who shows it to me.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਸਾਝੀ ਤਿਨ ਸਿਉ ਕਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: gun saajhee tin siau karee har naam dhiaaee |
English: I share His Virtues with Him, and meditate on the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵੀ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਨਿਤ ਸੇਵਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har sevee piaaraa nit sev har sukh paaee |
English: I serve my Beloved Lord forever; serving the Lord, I have found peace.

Gurbani: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: balihaaree satigur tis jin sojhee paaee |12|
English: I am a sacrifice to the True Guru, who has imparted this understanding to me. ||12||

[Ang 647 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਜੇ ਵੇਦ ਪੜੈ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: panddit mail na chukee je ved parrai jug chaar |
English: O Pandit, O religious scholar, your filth shall not be erased, even if you read the Vedas for four ages.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੂਲੁ ਹੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: trai gun maaeaa mool hai vich haumai naam visaar |
English: The three qualities are the roots of Maya; in egotism, one forgets the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਭੂਲੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਗੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਵਾਪਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: panddit bhoole doojai laage maaeaa kai vaapaar |
English: The Pandits are deluded, attached to duality, and they deal only in Maya.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਹੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਭੁਖਿਆ ਮੁਏ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: antar trisanaa bhukh hai moorakh bhukhiaa mue gavaar |
English: They are filled with thirst and hunger; the ignorant fools starve to death.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: satigur seviai sukh paaeaa sachai sabad veechaar |
English: Serving the True Guru, peace is obtained, contemplating the True Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਗਈ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: andarahu trisanaa bhukh gee sachai naae piaar |
English: Hunger and thirst have departed from within me; I am in love with the True Name.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਜੇ ਜਿਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak naam rate sahaje raje jinaa har rakhiaa ur dhaar |1|
English: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Naam, who keep the Lord clasped tightly to their hearts, are automatically satisfied. ||1||

[Ang 647 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਗਾ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh har naam na seviaa dukh lagaa bahutaa aae |
English: The self-willed manmukh does not serve the Lord's Name, and so he suffers in horrible pain.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਹੈ ਸੁਧਿ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: antar agiaan andher hai sudh na kaaee paae |
English: He is filled with the darkness of ignorance, and he does not understand anything.

Gurbani: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਨ ਬੀਜਿਓ ਭੁਖਾ ਕਿ ਅਗੈ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: manahatth sehaj na beejio bhukhaa ki agai khaae |
English: Because of his stubborn mind, he does not plant the seeds of intuitive peace; what will he eat in the world hereafter, to satisfy his hunger?

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: naam nidhaan visaariaa doojai lagaa jaae |
English: He has forgotten the treasure of the Naam; he is caught in the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਜੇ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh mileh vaddiaaeea je aape mel milaae |2|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are honored with glory, when the Lord Himself unites them in His Union. ||2||

[Ang 647 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਖਰੀ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: har rasanaa har jas gaavai kharee suhaavanee |
English: The tongue which sings the Lord's Praises, is so very beautiful.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲੈ ਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: jo man tan mukh har bolai saa har bhaavanee |
English: One who speaks the Lord's Name, with mind, body and mouth, is pleasing to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਖੈ ਸਾਦੁ ਸਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: jo guramukh chakhai saad saa tripataavanee |
English: That Gurmukh tastes the the sublime taste of the Lord, and is satisfied.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਝਾਵਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: gun gaavai piaare nit gun gaae gunee samajhaavanee |
English: She sings continually the Glorious Praises of her Beloved; singing His Glorious Praises, she is uplifted.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੂ ਬੁਲਾਵਣੀ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: jis hovai aap deaal saa satiguroo guroo bulaavanee |13|
English: She is blessed with the Lord's Mercy, and she chants the Words of the Guru, the True Guru. ||13||

[Ang 647 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਸਤੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਜਿਉ ਅੰਕਸੁ ਹੈ ਅਹਰਣਿ ਜਿਉ ਸਿਰੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: hasatee sir jiau ankas hai aharan jiau sir dee |
English: The elephant offers its head to the reins, and the anvil offers itself to the hammer;

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਆਗੈ ਰਾਖਿ ਕੈ ਊਭੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: man tan aagai raakh kai aoobhee sev karee |
English: just so, we offer our minds and bodies to our Guru; we stand before Him, and serve Him.

Gurbani: ਇਉ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਰਾਜੁ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਾ ਲੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: eiau guramukh aap nivaareeai sabh raaj srisatt kaa lee |
English: This is how the Gurmukhs eliminate their self-conceit, and come to rule the whole world.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh bujheeai jaa aape nadar karee |1|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh understands, when the Lord casts His Glance of Grace. ||1||

[Ang 648 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਆਏ ਤੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: jin guramukh naam dhiaaeaa aae te paravaan |
English: Blessed and approved is the coming into the world, of those Gurmukhs who meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak kul udhaareh aapanaa daragah paaveh maan |2|
English: O Nanak, they save their families, and they are honored in the Court of the Lord. ||2||

[Ang 648 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਖੀਆ ਸਿਖ ਗੁਰੂ ਮੇਲਾਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh sakheea sikh guroo melaaeea |
