English: The Guru unites His Sikhs, the Gurmukhs, with the Lord.

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ਇਕਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: eik sevak gur paas ik gur kaarai laaeea |
English: The Guru keeps some of them with Himself, and engages others in His Service.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਭਾਉ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੇਵਾਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: jinaa gur piaaraa man chit tinaa bhaau guroo devaaeea |
English: Those who cherish their Beloved in their conscious minds, the Guru blesses them with His Love.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖਾ ਇਕੋ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਤਾ ਪੁਤਾ ਭਾਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur sikhaa iko piaar gur mitaa putaa bhaaeea |
English: The Guru loves all of His Gursikhs equally well, like friends, children and siblings.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਸਭਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਖਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਜੀਵਾਈਆ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: gur satigur bolahu sabh gur aakh guroo jeevaaeea |14|
English: So chant the Name of the Guru, the True Guru, everyone! Chanting the Name of the Guru, Guru, you shall be rejuvenated. ||14||

[Ang 648 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਨੀ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਅਵਰੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: naanak naam na chetanee agiaanee andhule avare karam kamaeh |
English: O Nanak, the blind, ignorant fools do not remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord; they involve themselves in other activities.

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਪਚਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jam dar badhe maareeeh fir visattaa maeh pachaeh |1|
English: They are bound and gagged at the door of the Messenger of Death; they are punished, and in the end, they rot away in manure. ||1||

[Ang 648 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਚੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak satigur seveh aapanaa se jan sache paravaan |
English: O Nanak, those humble beings are true and approved, who serve their True Guru.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ਸਮਾਇ ਰਹੇ ਚੂਕਾ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har kai naae samaae rahe chookaa aavan jaan |2|
English: They remain absorbed in the Name of the Lord, and their comings and goings cease. ||2||

[Ang 648 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਸੰਪੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੰਚੀਐ ਅੰਤੇ ਦੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: dhan sanpai maaeaa sancheeai ante dukhadaaee |
English: Gathering the wealth and property of Maya, brings only pain in the end.

Gurbani: ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਲ ਸਵਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ghar mandar mehal savaareeeh kichh saath na jaaee |
English: Homes, mansions and adorned palaces will not go with anyone.

Gurbani: ਹਰ ਰੰਗੀ ਤੁਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਪਾਲੀਅਹਿ ਕਿਤੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: har rangee ture nit paaleeeh kitai kaam na aaee |
English: He may breed horses of various colors, but these will not be of any use to him.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਅੰਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jan laavahu chit har naam siau ant hoe sakhaaee |
English: O human, link your consciousness to the Lord's Name, and in the end, it shall be your companion and helper.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: jan naanak naam dhiaaeaa guramukh sukh paaee |15|
English: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the Gurmukh is blessed with peace. ||15||

[Ang 648 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਕਰਮੈ ਨਾਉ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin karamai naau na paaeeai poorai karam paaeaa jaae |
English: Without the karma of good actions, the Name is not obtained; it can be obtained only by perfect good karma.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਤਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak nadar kare je aapanee taa guramat mel milaae |1|
English: O Nanak, if the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, then under Guru's Instruction, one is united in His Union. ||1||

[Ang 648 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਇਕ ਦਝਹਿ ਇਕ ਦਬੀਅਹਿ ਇਕਨਾ ਕੁਤੇ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: eik dajheh ik dabeeeh ikanaa kute khaeh |
English: Some are cremated, and some are buried; some are eaten by dogs.

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਪਾਣੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਸਟੀਅਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਭੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਹਸਣਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: eik paanee vich usatteeeh ik bhee fir hasan paeh |
English: Some are thrown into water, while others are thrown into wells.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਵ ਨ ਜਾਪਈ ਕਿਥੈ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak ev na jaapee kithai jaae samaeh |2|
English: O Nanak, it is not known, where they go and into what they merge. ||2||

[Ang 648 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਖਾਧਾ ਪੈਧਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਨਾਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: tin kaa khaadhaa paidhaa maaeaa sabh pavit hai jo naam har raate |
English: The food and clothes, and all the worldly possessions of those who are attuned to the Lord's Name are sacred.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਲ ਸਰਾਈ ਸਭਿ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹਹਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਿਖ ਅਭਿਆਗਤ ਜਾਇ ਵਰਸਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: tin ke ghar mandar mehal saraaee sabh pavit heh jinee guramukh sevak sikh abhiaagat jaae varasaate |
English: All the homes, temples, palaces and way-stations are sacred, where the Gurmukhs, the selfless servants, the Sikhs and the renouncers of the world, go and take their rest.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਤੁਰੇ ਜੀਨ ਖੁਰਗੀਰ ਸਭਿ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹਹਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਿਖ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਤ ਚੜਿ ਜਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: tin ke ture jeen khurageer sabh pavit heh jinee guramukh sikh saadh sant charr jaate |
English: All the horses, saddles and horse blankets are sacred, upon which the Gurmukhs, the Sikhs, the Holy and the Saints, mount and ride.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਭਿ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹਹਿ ਜੋ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: tin ke karam dharam kaaraj sabh pavit heh jo boleh har har raam naam har saate |
English: All the rituals and Dharmic practices and deeds are sacred, for those who utter the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the True Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਪੋਤੈ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਸੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਿਖ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਤੇ ॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: jin kai potai pun hai se guramukh sikh guroo peh jaate |16|
English: Those Gurmukhs, those Sikhs, who have purity as their treasure, go to their Guru. ||16||

[Ang 648 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਘੁਥਿਆ ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak naavahu ghuthiaa halat palat sabh jaae |
English: O Nanak, forsaking the Name, he loses everything, in this world and the next.

Gurbani: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਿਰਿ ਲਇਆ ਮੁਠੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jap tap sanjam sabh hir leaa mutthee doojai bhaae |
English: Chanting, deep meditation and austere self-disciplined practices are all wasted; he is deceived by the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jam dar badhe maareeeh bahutee milai sajaae |1|
English: He is bound and gagged at the door of the Messenger of Death. He is beaten, and receives terrible punishment. ||1||

[Ang 649 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਵੈਰੁ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਦੁਸਟਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: santaa naal vair kamaavade dusattaa naal mohu piaar |
English: They inflict their hatred upon the Saints, and they love the wicked sinners.

Gurbani: ਅਗੈ ਪਿਛੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: agai pichhai sukh nahee mar jameh vaaro vaar |
English: They find no peace in either this world or the next; they are born only to die, again and again.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਬੁਝਈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: trisanaa kade na bujhee dubidhaa hoe khuaar |
English: Their hunger is never satisfied, and they are ruined by duality.

Gurbani: ਮੁਹ ਕਾਲੇ ਤਿਨਾ ਨਿੰਦਕਾ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: muh kaale tinaa nindakaa tith sachai darabaar |
English: The faces of these slanderers are blackened in the Court of the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣਿਆ ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naam vihooniaa naa uravaar na paar |2|
English: O Nanak, without the Naam, they find no shelter on either this shore, or the one beyond. ||2||

[Ang 649 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jo har naam dhiaaeide se har har naam rate man maahee |
English: Those who meditate on the Lord's Name, are imbued with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in their minds.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਇਕੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਇਕਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jinaa man chit ik araadhiaa tinaa ikas bin doojaa ko naahee |
English: For those who worship the One Lord in their conscious minds, there is no other than the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੇਈ ਪੁਰਖ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਜਿਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: seee purakh har sevade jin dhur masatak lekh likhaahee |
English: They alone serve the Lord, upon whose foreheads such pre-ordained destiny is written.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਵਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਝਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: har ke gun nit gaavade har gun gaae gunee samajhaahee |
English: They continually sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and singing the Glories of the Glorious Lord, they are uplifted.

Gurbani: ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: vaddiaaee vaddee guramukhaa gur poorai har naam samaahee |17|
English: Great is the greatness of the Gurmukhs, who, through the Perfect Guru, remain absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||17||

[Ang 649 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਗਾਖੜੀ ਸਿਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur kee sevaa gaakharree sir deejai aap gavaae |
English: It is very difficult to serve the True Guru; offer your head, and eradicate self-conceit.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਨਾ ਮਰਹਿ ਤਾ ਸੇਵਾ ਪਵੈ ਸਭ ਥਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabad mareh fir naa mareh taa sevaa pavai sabh thaae |
English: One who dies in the Word of the Shabad shall never have to die again; his service is totally approved.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸਿਐ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: paaras parasiai paaras hovai sach rahai liv laae |
English: Touching the philosopher's stone, one becomes the philosopher's stone, which transforms lead into gold; remain lovingly attached to the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: jis poorab hovai likhiaa tis satigur milai prabh aae |
English: One who has such pre-ordained destiny, comes to meet the True Guru and God.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਣਤੈ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਨਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਸੋ ਪਵੈ ਥਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak ganatai sevak naa milai jis bakhase so pavai thaae |1|
English: O Nanak, the Lord's servant does not meet Him because of his own account; he alone is acceptable, whom the Lord forgives. ||1||

[Ang 649 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਹਲੁ ਕੁਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਮੂਰਖ ਅਪਣੈ ਸੁਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: mehal kumahal na jaananee moorakh apanai suaae |
English: The fools do not know the difference between good and bad; they are deceived by their self-interests.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੁ ਚੀਨਹਿ ਤਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਲਹਹਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabad cheeneh taa mehal laheh jotee jot samaae |
English: But if they contemplate the Word of the Shabad, they obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and their light merges in the Light.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਚੇ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਾ ਸਭਾ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sache kaa bhau man vasai taa sabhaa sojhee paae |
English: The Fear of God is always on their minds, and so they come to understand everything.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਣੈ ਘਰਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur apanai ghar varatadaa aape le milaae |
English: The True Guru is pervading the homes within; He Himself blends them with the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਭ ਪੂਰੀ ਪਈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak satigur miliai sabh pooree pee jis no kirapaa kare rajaae |2|
English: O Nanak, they meet the True Guru, and all their desires are fulfilled, if the Lord grants His Grace and so wills. ||2||

[Ang 649 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਭਾਗ ਤਿਨਾ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਕਹਤਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan bhaag tinaa bhagat janaa jo har naamaa har mukh kahatiaa |
English: Blessed, blessed is the good fortune of those devotees, who, with their mouths, utter the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਭਾਗ ਤਿਨਾ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਸੁਣਤਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan bhaag tinaa sant janaa jo har jas sravanee sunatiaa |
English: Blessed, blessed is the good fortune of those Saints, who, with their ears, listen to the Lord's Praises.

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਭਾਗ ਤਿਨਾ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਇ ਗੁਣੀ ਜਨ ਬਣਤਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan bhaag tinaa saadh janaa har keeratan gaae gunee jan banatiaa |
English: Blessed, blessed is the good fortune of those holy people, who sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, and so become virtuous.

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਭਾਗ ਤਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਲੈ ਮਨੁ ਜਿਣਤਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan bhaag tinaa guramukhaa jo gurasikh lai man jinatiaa |
English: Blessed, blessed is the good fortune of those Gurmukhs, who live as Gursikhs, and conquer their minds.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਦੂ ਵਡੇ ਭਾਗ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਕੇ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਸਿਖ ਪੜਤਿਆ ॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: sabh doo vadde bhaag gurasikhaa ke jo gur charanee sikh parratiaa |18|
English: But the greatest good fortune of all, is that of the Guru's Sikhs, who fall at the Guru's feet. ||18||

[Ang 649 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬਿੰਦੈ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਏਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: braham bindai tis daa brahamat rahai ek sabad liv laae |
English: One who knows God, and who lovingly focuses his attention on the One Word of the Shabad, keeps his spirituality intact.

Gurbani: ਨਵ ਨਿਧੀ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਸਿਧੀ ਪਿਛੈ ਲਗੀਆ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਦਾ ਵਸਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: nav nidhee atthaarah sidhee pichhai lageea fireh jo har hiradai sadaa vasaae |
English: The nine treasures and the eighteen spiritual powers of the Siddhas follow him, who keeps the Lord enshrined in his heart.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਉ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਬੁਝਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: bin satigur naau na paaeeai bujhahu kar veechaar |
English: Without the True Guru, the Name is not found; understand this, and reflect upon it.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak poorai bhaag satigur milai sukh paae jug chaar |1|
English: O Nanak, through perfect good destiny, one meets the True Guru, and finds peace, throughout the four ages. ||1||

[Ang 649 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਗਭਰੂ ਕਿਆ ਬਿਰਧਿ ਹੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa gabharoo kiaa biradh hai manamukh trisanaa bhukh na jaae |
English: Whether he is young or old, the self-willed manmukh cannot escape hunger and thirst.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੇ ਰਤਿਆ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਏ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh sabade ratiaa seetal hoe aap gavaae |
English: The Gurmukhs are imbued with the Word of the Shabad; they are at peace, having lost their self-conceit.

Gurbani: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਸੰਤੋਖਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: andar tripat santokhiaa fir bhukh na lagai aae |
English: They are satisfied and satiated within; they never feel hungry again.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak ji guramukh kareh so paravaan hai jo naam rahe liv laae |2|
English: O Nanak, whatever the Gurmukhs do is acceptable; they remain lovingly absorbed in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

[Ang 650 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿੰਨ ਕੰਉ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਿਖਾ ॥
Transliteration: hau balihaaree tin knau jo guramukh sikhaa |
English: I am a sacrifice to those Sikhs who are Gurmukhs.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਿਖਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo har naam dhiaaeide tin darasan pikhaa |
English: I behold the Blessed Vision, the Darshan of those who meditate on the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਲਿਖਾ ॥
Transliteration: sun keeratan har gun ravaa har jas man likhaa |
English: Listening to the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, I contemplate His virtues; I write His Praises on the fabric of my mind.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕ੍ਰਿਖਾ ॥
Transliteration: har naam salaahee rang siau sabh kilavikh krikhaa |
English: I praise the Lord's Name with love, and eradicate all my sins.

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਸੋ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਥੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਧਰੇ ਵਿਖਾ ॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan suhaavaa so sareer thaan hai jithai meraa gur dhare vikhaa |19|
English: Blessed, blessed and beauteous is that body and place, where my Guru places His feet. ||19||

[Ang 650 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur bin giaan na hovee naa sukh vasai man aae |
English: Without the Guru, spiritual wisdom is not obtained, and peace does not come to abide in the mind.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੇ ਮਨਮੁਖੀ ਜਾਸਨਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak naam vihoone manamukhee jaasan janam gavaae |1|
English: O Nanak, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the self-willed manmukhs depart, after having wasted their lives. ||1||

[Ang 650 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਨਾਵੈ ਨੋ ਸਭਿ ਖੋਜਦੇ ਥਕਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sidh saadhik naavai no sabh khojade thak rahe liv laae |
English: All the Siddhas, spiritual masters and seekers search for the Name; they have grown weary of concentrating and focusing their attention.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin satigur kinai na paaeo guramukh milai milaae |
English: Without the True Guru, no one finds the Name; the Gurmukhs unite in Union with the Lord.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਖਾਣੁ ਸਭੁ ਬਾਦਿ ਹੈ ਧਿਗੁ ਸਿਧੀ ਧਿਗੁ ਕਰਮਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: bin naavai painan khaan sabh baad hai dhig sidhee dhig karamaat |
English: Without the Name, all food and clothes are worthless; cursed is such spirituality, and cursed are such miraculous powers.

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਸਿਧਿ ਸਾ ਕਰਮਾਤਿ ਹੈ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: saa sidh saa karamaat hai achint kare jis daat |
English: That alone is spirituality, and that alone is miraculous power, which the Carefree Lord spontaneously bestows.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਏਹਾ ਸਿਧਿ ਏਹਾ ਕਰਮਾਤਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh har naam man vasai ehaa sidh ehaa karamaat |2|
English: O Nanak, the Lord's Name abides in the mind of the Gurmukh; this is spirituality, and this is miraculous power. ||2||

[Ang 650 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਢਾਢੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਖਸਮ ਕੇ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਵਹ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਛੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: ham dtaadtee har prabh khasam ke nit gaavah har gun chhantaa |
English: I am a minstrel of God, my Lord and Master; every day, I sing the songs of the Lord's Glorious Praises.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕਰਹ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਣਹ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਵਲਾ ਕੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: har keeratan karah har jas sunah tis kavalaa kantaa |
English: I sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, and I listen to the Praises of the Lord, the Master of wealth and Maya.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਭਿਖਾਰੀਆ ਮੰਗਤ ਜਨ ਜੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: har daataa sabh jagat bhikhaareea mangat jan jantaa |
English: The Lord is the Great Giver; all the world is begging; all beings and creatures are beggars.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਥਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਮ ਜੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: har devahu daan deaal hoe vich paathar krim jantaa |
English: O Lord, You are kind and compassionate; You give Your gifts to even worms and insects among the rocks.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧਨਵੰਤਾ ॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: jan naanak naam dhiaaeaa guramukh dhanavantaa |20|
English: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; as Gurmukh, he has become truly wealthy. ||20||

[Ang 650 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪੜਣਾ ਗੁੜਣਾ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਹੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: parranaa gurranaa sansaar kee kaar hai andar trisanaa vikaar |
English: Reading and studying are just worldly pursuits, if there is thirst and corruption within.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਭਿ ਪੜਿ ਥਕੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: haumai vich sabh parr thake doojai bhaae khuaar |
English: Reading in egotism, all have grown weary; through the love of duality, they are ruined.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਪੜਿਆ ਸੋ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਬੀਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: so parriaa so panddit beenaa gur sabad kare veechaar |
English: He alone is educated, and he alone is a wise Pandit, who contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਖੋਜੈ ਤਤੁ ਲਹੈ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: andar khojai tat lahai paae mokh duaar |
English: He searches within himself, and finds the true essence; he finds the Door of Salvation.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: gun nidhaan har paaeaa sehaj kare veechaar |
English: He finds the Lord, the treasure of excellence, and peacefully contemplates Him.

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dhan vaapaaree naanakaa jis guramukh naam adhaar |1|
English: Blessed is the trader, O Nanak, who, as Gurmukh, takes the Name as his only Support. ||1||

[Ang 650 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਿਝਈ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕੋ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: vin man maare koe na sijhee vekhahu ko liv laae |
English: Without conquering his mind, no one can be successful. See this, and concentrate on it.

Gurbani: ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ ਤੀਰਥੀ ਭਵਿ ਥਕੇ ਨਾ ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhekhadhaaree teerathee bhav thake naa ehu man maariaa jaae |
English: The wandering holy men are tired of of making pilgrimages to sacred shrines; they have not been able to conquer their minds.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh ehu man jeevat marai sach rahai liv laae |
English: The Gurmukh has conquered his mind, and he remains lovingly absorbed in the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਇਉ ਉਤਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak is man kee mal iau utarai haumai sabad jalaae |2|
English: O Nanak, this is how the filth of the mind is removed; the Word of the Shabad burns away the ego. ||2||

[Ang 650 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵਹੁ ਇਕ ਕਿਨਕਾ ॥
Transliteration: har har sant milahu mere bhaaee har naam drirraavahu ik kinakaa |
English: O Saints of the Lord, O my Siblings of Destiny, please meet with me, and implant the Name of the One Lord within me.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਨਾਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਪੜੁ ਪਹਿਰਹੁ ਖਿਮ ਕਾ ॥
Transliteration: har har seegaar banaavahu har jan har kaaparr pahirahu khim kaa |
English: O humble servants of the Lord, adorn me with the decorations of the Lord, Har, Har; let me wear the robes of the Lord's forgiveness.

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਿਮ ਕਾ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa seegaar mere prabh bhaavai har laagai piaaraa prim kaa |
English: Such decorations are pleasing to my God; such love is dear to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟੈ ਇਕ ਪਲਕਾ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam bolahu din raatee sabh kilabikh kaattai ik palakaa |
English: I chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, day and night; in an instant, all sins are eradicated.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਉਪਰਿ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਿਣਕਾ ॥੨੧॥
Transliteration: har har deaal hovai jis upar so guramukh har jap jinakaa |21|
English: That Gurmukh, unto whom the Lord becomes merciful, chants the Lord's Name, and wins the game of life. ||21||

[Ang 651 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ ਕਾਲਾ ਹੋਆ ਸਿਆਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: janam janam kee is man kau mal laagee kaalaa hoaa siaahu |
English: The filth of countless incarnations sticks to this mind; it has become pitch black.

Gurbani: ਖੰਨਲੀ ਧੋਤੀ ਉਜਲੀ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜੇ ਸਉ ਧੋਵਣਿ ਪਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: khanalee dhotee ujalee na hovee je sau dhovan paahu |
English: The oily rag cannot be cleaned by merely washing it, even if it is washed a hundred times.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਉਲਟੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਮਤਿ ਬਦਲਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee jeevat marai ulattee hovai mat badalaahu |
English: By Guru's Grace, one remains dead while yet alive; his intellect is transformed, and he becomes detached from the world.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਨਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak mail na lagee naa fir jonee paahu |1|
English: O Nanak, no filth sticks to him, and he does not fall into the womb again. ||1||

[Ang 651 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗੀ ਕਲਿ ਕਾਲੀ ਕਾਂਢੀ ਇਕ ਉਤਮ ਪਦਵੀ ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: chahu jugee kal kaalee kaandtee ik utam padavee is jug maeh |
English: Kali Yuga is called the Dark Age, but the most sublime state is attained in this age.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh har keerat fal paaeeai jin kau har likh paeh |
English: The Gurmukh obtains the fruit, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises; this is his destiny, ordained by the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਚਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak gur parasaadee anadin bhagat har uchareh har bhagatee maeh samaeh |2|
English: O Nanak, by Guru's Grace, he worships the Lord night and day; he chants the Lord's Name, and remains absorbed in the Lord's devotional worship. ||2||

[Ang 651 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਲੀ ਬਾਣਿ ॥
Transliteration: har har mel saadh jan sangat mukh bolee har har bhalee baan |
English: O Lord, unite me with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, so that with my mouth, I may speak the sublime Word of the Guru's Bani.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਤ ਚਵਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਾਣਿ ॥
Transliteration: har gun gaavaa har nit chavaa guramatee har rang sadaa maan |
English: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and constantly chant the Lord's Name; through the Guru's Teachings, I enjoy the Lord's Love constantly.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਅਉਖਧ ਖਾਧਿਆ ਸਭਿ ਰੋਗ ਗਵਾਤੇ ਦੁਖਾ ਘਾਣਿ ॥
Transliteration: har jap jap aaukhadh khaadhiaa sabh rog gavaate dukhaa ghaan |
English: I take the medicine of meditation on the Lord's Name, which has cured all diseases and multitudes of sufferings.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਾ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਹੀ ਜਾਣਿ ॥
Transliteration: jinaa saas giraas na visarai se har jan poore sahee jaan |
English: Those who do not forget the Lord, while breathing or eating - know them to be the perfect servants of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਚੂਕੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਜਗਤ ਕਾਣਿ ॥੨੨॥
Transliteration: jo guramukh har aaraadhade tin chookee jam kee jagat kaan |22|
English: Those Gurmukhs who worship the Lord in adoration end their subservience to the Messenger of Death, and to the world. ||22||

[Ang 651 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰੇ ਜਨ ਉਥਾਰੈ ਦਬਿਓਹੁ ਸੁਤਿਆ ਗਈ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: re jan uthaarai dabiohu sutiaa gee vihaae |
English: O man, you have been tormented by a nightmare, and you have passed your life in sleep.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਨ ਜਾਗਿਓ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਚਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur kaa sabad sun na jaagio antar na upajio chaau |
English: You did not wake to hear the Word of the True Guru's Shabad; you have no inspiration within yourself.

Gurbani: ਸਰੀਰੁ ਜਲਉ ਗੁਣ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਕਾਰ ਨ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sareer jlau gun baaharaa jo gur kaar na kamaae |
English: That body burns, which has no virtue, and which does not serve the Guru.

Gurbani: ਜਗਤੁ ਜਲੰਦਾ ਡਿਠੁ ਮੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jagat jalandaa dditth mai haumai doojai bhaae |
English: I have seen that the world is burning, in egotism and the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak gur saranaaee ubare sach man sabad dhiaae |1|
English: O Nanak, those who seek the Guru's Sanctuary are saved; within their minds, they meditate on the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||

[Ang 651 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਈ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: sabad rate haumai gee sobhaavantee naar |
English: Attuned to the Word of the Shabad, the soul-bride is rid of egotism, and she is glorified.

Gurbani: ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸਦਾ ਚਲੈ ਤਾ ਬਨਿਆ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: pir kai bhaanai sadaa chalai taa baniaa seegaar |
English: If she walks steadily in the way of His Will, then she is adorned with decorations.

Gurbani: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: sej suhaavee sadaa pir raavai har var paaeaa naar |
English: Her couch becomes beautiful, and she constantly enjoys her Husband Lord; she obtains the Lord as her Husband.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਕਦੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: naa har marai na kade dukh laagai sadaa suhaagan naar |
English: The Lord does not die, and she never suffers pain; she is a happy soul-bride forever.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak har prabh mel lee gur kai het piaar |2|
English: O Nanak, the Lord God unites her with Himself; she enshrines love and affection for the Guru. ||2||

[Ang 651 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਪਿਆ ਆਪਣਾ ਤੇ ਨਰ ਬੁਰਿਆਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jinaa gur gopiaa aapanaa te nar buriaaree |
English: Those who conceal and deny their Guru, are the most evil people.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਪਾਪਿਸਟ ਹਤਿਆਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: har jeeo tin kaa darasan naa karahu paapisatt hatiaaree |
English: O Dear Lord, let me not even see them; they are the worst sinners and murderers.

Gurbani: ਓਹਿ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਕੁਸੁਧ ਮਨਿ ਜਿਉ ਧਰਕਟ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: ohi ghar ghar fireh kusudh man jiau dharakatt naaree |
English: They wander from house to house, with impure minds, like wicked, forsaken women.

Gurbani: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: vaddabhaagee sangat mile guramukh savaaree |
English: But by great good fortune, they may meet the Company of the Holy; as Gurmukhs, they are reformed.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੨੩॥
Transliteration: har melahu satigur deaa kar gur kau balihaaree |23|
English: O Lord, please be kind and let me meet the True Guru; I am a sacrifice to the Guru. ||23||

[Ang 651 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur sevaa te sukh aoopajai fir dukh na lagai aae |
English: Serving the Guru, peace is produced, and then, one does not suffer in pain.

Gurbani: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਇਆ ਕਾਲੈ ਕਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਬਸਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jaman maranaa mitt geaa kaalai kaa kichh na basaae |
English: The cycle of birth and death is brought to an end, and death has no power over at all.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਚੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: har setee man rav rahiaa sache rahiaa samaae |
English: His mind is imbued with the Lord, and he remains merged in the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿੰਨ ਕਉ ਜੋ ਚਲਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak hau balihaaree tin kau jo chalan satigur bhaae |1|
English: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those who walk in the Way of the True Guru's Will. ||1||

[Ang 651 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਸੁਧੁ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਕਰੈ ਸੀਗਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: bin sabadai sudh na hovee je anek karai seegaar |
English: Without the Word of the Shabad, purity is not obtained, even though the soul-bride may adorn herself with all sorts of decorations.

Gurbani: ਪਿਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: pir kee saar na jaanee doojai bhaae piaar |
English: She does not know the value of her Husband Lord; she is attached to the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਕੁਸੁਧ ਸਾ ਕੁਲਖਣੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਰੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਕੁਨਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saa kusudh saa kulakhanee naanak naaree vich kunaar |2|
English: She is impure, and ill-mannered, O Nanak; among women, she is the most evil woman. ||2||

[Ang 652 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਪਣੀ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲੀ ਬੈਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: har har apanee deaa kar har bolee bainee |
English: Be kind to me, Lord, that I might chant the Word of Your Bani.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਉਚਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਲੈਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: har naam dhiaaee har ucharaa har laahaa lainee |
English: May I meditate on the Lord's Name, chant the Lord's Name, and obtain the profit of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜਪਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਹਉ ਕੁਰਬੈਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: jo japade har har dinas raat tin hau kurabainee |
English: I am a sacrifice to those who chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, day and night.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਜਨ ਦੇਖਾ ਨੈਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: jinaa satigur meraa piaaraa araadhiaa tin jan dekhaa nainee |
English: May I behold with my eyes those who worship and adore my Beloved True Guru.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਅਪਣੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਉ ਜਿਨਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਮੇਲਿਆ ਸੈਣੀ ॥੨੪॥
Transliteration: hau vaariaa apane guroo kau jin meraa har sajan meliaa sainee |24|
English: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, who has united me with my Lord, my friend, my very best friend. ||24||

[Ang 652 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 4 |
English: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਨ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੋ ਮਿਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: har daasan siau preet hai har daasan ko mit |
English: The Lord loves His slaves; the Lord is the friend of His slaves.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਜਿਉ ਜੰਤੀ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਜੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: har daasan kai vas hai jiau jantee kai vas jant |
English: The Lord is under the control of His slaves, like the musical instrument under the control of the musician.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: har ke daas har dhiaaeide kar preetam siau nehu |
English: The Lord's slaves meditate on the Lord; they love their Beloved.

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਭ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਸੈ ਮੇਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: kirapaa kar kai sunahu prabh sabh jag meh varasai mehu |
English: Please, hear me, O God - let Your Grace rain over the whole world.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੀ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਹੈ ਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: jo har daasan kee usatat hai saa har kee vaddiaaee |
English: The praise of the Lord's slaves is the Glory of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਣੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਭਾਵਦੀ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har aapanee vaddiaaee bhaavadee jan kaa jaikaar karaaee |
English: The Lord loves His Own Glory, and so His humble servant is celebrated and hailed.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਇਕ ਸਮਾਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: so har jan naam dhiaaeidaa har har jan ik samaan |
English: That humble servant of the Lord meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the Lord, and the Lord's humble servant, are one and the same.

Gurbani: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਹੁ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak har kaa daas hai har paij rakhahu bhagavaan |1|
English: Servant Nanak is the slave of the Lord; O Lord, O God, please, preserve his honor. ||1||

[Ang 652 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 4 |
English: Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਈ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: naanak preet laaee tin saachai tis bin rehan na jaaee |
English: Nanak loves the True Lord; without Him, he cannot even survive.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: satigur milai ta pooraa paaeeai har ras rasan rasaaee |2|
English: Meeting the True Guru, one finds the Perfect Lord, and the tongue enjoys the sublime essence of the Lord. ||2||

[Ang 652 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਪਰਭਾਤਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਹੀ ਗਾਵਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: rain dinas parabhaat toohai hee gaavanaa |
English: Night and day, morning and night, I sing to You, Lord.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਰਬਤ ਨਾਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਧਿਆਵਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jant sarabat naau teraa dhiaavanaa |
English: All beings and creatures meditate on Your Name.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਿਤਾ ਖਾਵਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: too daataa daataar teraa ditaa khaavanaa |
English: You are the Giver, the Great Giver; we eat whatever You give us.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਪ ਗਵਾਵਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat janaa kai sang paap gavaavanaa |
English: In the congregation of the devotees, sins are eradicated.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਵਣਾ ॥੨੫॥
Transliteration: jan naanak sad balihaarai bal bal jaavanaa |25|
English: Servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, O Lord. ||25||

[Ang 652 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 4 |
English: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਭਈ ਮਤਿ ਮਧਿਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: antar agiaan bhee mat madhim satigur kee parateet naahee |
English: He has spiritual ignorance within, and his intellect is dull and dim; he does not place his faith in the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਪਟੋ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਪਟੇ ਖਪਹਿ ਖਪਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: andar kapatt sabh kapatto kar jaanai kapatte khapeh khapaahee |
English: He has deceit within himself, and so he sees deception in all others; through his deceptions, he is totally ruined.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਆਪਣੈ ਸੁਆਇ ਫਿਰਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: satigur kaa bhaanaa chit na aavai aapanai suaae firaahee |
English: The True Guru's Will does not enter into his consciousness, and so he wanders around, pursuing his own interests.

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kirapaa kare je aapanee taa naanak sabad samaahee |1|
English: If He grants His Grace, then Nanak is absorbed into the Word of the Shabad. ||1||

[Ang 652 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 4 |
English: Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਮਨੂਆ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh maaeaa mohi viaape doojai bhaae manooaa thir naeh |
English: The self-willed manmukhs are engrossed in emotional attachment to Maya; in the love of duality, their minds are unsteady.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਲਤ ਰਹਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਖਪਹਿ ਖਪਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: anadin jalat raheh din raatee haumai khapeh khapaeh |
English: Night and day, they are burning; day and night, they are totally ruined by their egotism.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਮਹਾ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: antar lobh mahaa gubaaraa tin kai nikatt na koee jaeh |
English: Within them, is the total pitch darkness of greed, and no one even approaches them.

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਆਪਿ ਦੁਖੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: oe aap dukhee sukh kabahoo na paaveh janam mareh mar jaeh |
English: They themselves are miserable, and they never find peace; they are born, only to die, and die again.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਜਿ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak bakhas le prabh saachaa ji gur charanee chit laeh |2|
English: O Nanak, the True Lord God forgives those, who focus their consciousness on the Guru's feet. ||2||

[Ang 652 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਭਗਤ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sant bhagat paravaan jo prabh bhaaeaa |
English: That Saint, that devotee, is acceptable, who is loved by God.

Gurbani: ਸੇਈ ਬਿਚਖਣ ਜੰਤ ਜਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: seee bichakhan jant jinee har dhiaaeaa |
English: Those beings are wise, who meditate on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: amrit naam nidhaan bhojan khaaeaa |
English: They eat the food, the treasure of the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sant janaa kee dhoor masatak laaeaa |
English: They apply the dust of the feet of the Saints to their foreheads.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਏ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਹਰਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਇਆ ॥੨੬॥
Transliteration: naanak bhe puneet har teerath naaeaa |26|
English: O Nanak, they are purified, bathing in the sacred shrine of the Lord. ||26||

[Ang 653 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 4 |
English: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਹੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh antar saant hai man tan naam samaae |
English: Within the Gurmukh is peace and tranquility; his mind and body are absorbed in the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੋ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੜੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: naamo chitavai naam parrai naam rahai liv laae |
English: He contemplates the Naam, he studies the Naam, and he remains lovingly absorbed in the Naam.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਗਈ ਬਿਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: naam padaarath paaeaa chintaa gee bilaae |
English: He obtains the treasure of the Naam, and his anxiety is dispelled.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਸਭ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur miliai naam aoopajai tisanaa bhukh sabh jaae |
English: Meeting with the Guru, the Naam wells up, and his thirst and hunger are completely relieved.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਤਿਆ ਨਾਮੋ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak naame ratiaa naamo palai paae |1|
English: O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, he gathers in the Naam. ||1||

[Ang 653 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 4 |
English: Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਜਿ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਆ ਘਰੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: satigur purakh ji maariaa bhram bhramiaa ghar chhodd geaa |
English: One who is cursed by the True Guru, abandons his home, and wanders around aimlessly.

Gurbani: ਓਸੁ ਪਿਛੈ ਵਜੈ ਫਕੜੀ ਮੁਹੁ ਕਾਲਾ ਆਗੈ ਭਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: os pichhai vajai fakarree muhu kaalaa aagai bheaa |
English: He is jeered at, and his face is blackened in the world hereafter.

Gurbani: ਓਸੁ ਅਰਲੁ ਬਰਲੁ ਮੁਹਹੁ ਨਿਕਲੈ ਨਿਤ ਝਗੂ ਸੁਟਦਾ ਮੁਆ ॥
Transliteration: os aral baral muhahu nikalai nit jhagoo suttadaa muaa |
English: He babbles incoherently, and foaming at the mouth, he dies.

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਿਸੈ ਹੀ ਦੈ ਕੀਤੈ ਜਾਂ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਓਸ ਦਾ ਏਹੋ ਜੇਹਾ ਪਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa hovai kisai hee dai keetai jaan dhur kirat os daa eho jehaa peaa |
English: What can anyone do? Such is his destiny, according to his past deeds.

Gurbani: ਜਿਥੈ ਓਹੁ ਜਾਇ ਤਿਥੈ ਓਹੁ ਝੂਠਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲੇ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jithai ohu jaae tithai ohu jhootthaa koorr bole kisai na bhaavai |
English: Wherever he goes, he is a liar, and by telling lies, he not liked by anyone.

Gurbani: ਵੇਖਹੁ ਭਾਈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਜੈਸਾ ਕੋਈ ਕਰੈ ਤੈਸਾ ਕੋਈ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: vekhahu bhaaee vaddiaaee har santahu suaamee apune kee jaisaa koee karai taisaa koee paavai |
English: O Siblings of Destiny, behold this, the glorious greatness of our Lord and Master, O Saints; as one behaves, so does he receive.

Gurbani: ਏਹੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਅਗੋ ਦੇ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ehu braham beechaar hovai dar saachai ago de jan naanak aakh sunaavai |2|
English: This shall be God's determination in His True Court; servant Nanak predicts and proclaims this. ||2||

[Ang 653 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਬਧਾ ਥੇਹੁ ਰਖਵਾਲੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur sachai badhaa thehu rakhavaale gur dite |
English: The True Guru has established the village; the Guru has appointed its guards and protectors.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਆਸ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਨ ਰਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: pooran hoee aas gur charanee man rate |
English: My hopes are fulfilled, and my mind is imbued with the love of the Guru's Feet.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਿ ਬੇਅੰਤਿ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਸਭਿ ਹਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur kripaal beant avagun sabh hate |
English: The Guru is infinitely merciful; He has erased all my sins.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਅਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਅਪਣੇ ਕਰਿ ਲਿਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur apanee kirapaa dhaar apane kar lite |
English: The Guru has showered me with His Mercy, and He has made me His own.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਇਤੇ ॥੨੭॥
Transliteration: naanak sad balihaar jis gur ke gun ite |27|
English: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to the Guru, who has countless virtues. ||27||

[Ang 653 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਰਜਾਇ ਲੇਖਿਆ ਪਾਇ ਅਬ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਜੈ ਪਾਂਡੇ ॥
Transliteration: taa kee rajaae lekhiaa paae ab kiaa keejai paandde |
English: By His Command, we receive our pre-ordained rewards; so what can we do now, O Pandit?

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੋਆ ਹਾਸਲੁ ਤਦੇ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਬੜਿਆ ਹੰਢਹਿ ਜੀਅ ਕਮਾਂਦੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: hukam hoaa haasal tade hoe nibarriaa handteh jeea kamaande |1|
English: When His Command is received, then it is decided; all beings move and act accordingly. ||1||

[Ang 653 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 2 |
English: Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਕਿ ਨਥ ਖਸਮ ਹਥ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਧਕੇ ਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: nak nath khasam hath kirat dhake de |
English: The string through the nose is in the hands of the Lord Master; one's own actions drive him on.

Gurbani: ਜਹਾ ਦਾਣੇ ਤਹਾਂ ਖਾਣੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਚੁ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jahaa daane tahaan khaane naanakaa sach he |2|
English: Wherever his food is, there he eats it; O Nanak, this is the Truth. ||2||

[Ang 653 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸਭੇ ਗਲਾ ਆਪਿ ਥਾਟਿ ਬਹਾਲੀਓਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: sabhe galaa aap thaatt bahaaleeon |
English: The Lord Himself puts everything in its proper place.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਇ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਘਾਲਿਓਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape rachan rachaae aape hee ghaalion |
English: He Himself created the creation, and He Himself destroys it.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਿਓਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape jant upaae aap pratipaalion |
English: He Himself fashions His creatures, and He Himself nourishes them.

Gurbani: ਦਾਸ ਰਖੇ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਓਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: daas rakhe kantth laae nadar nihaalion |
English: He hugs His slaves close in His embrace, and blesses them with His Glance of Grace.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਭਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ਜਾਲਿਓਨੁ ॥੨੮॥
Transliteration: naanak bhagataa sadaa anand bhaau doojaa jaalion |28|
English: O Nanak, His devotees are forever in bliss; they have burnt away the love of duality. ||28||

[Ang 653 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਏ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕ ਚਿਤਿ ਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: e man har jee dhiaae too ik man ik chit bhaae |
English: O mind, meditate on the Dear Lord, with single-minded conscious concentration.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਦੇਇ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: har keea sadaa sadaa vaddiaaeea dee na pachhotaae |
English: The glorious greatness of the Lord shall last forever and ever; He never regrets what He gives.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: hau har kai sad balihaaranai jit seviai sukh paae |
English: I am forever a sacrifice to the Lord; serving Him, peace is obtained.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh mil rahai haumai sabad jalaae |1|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh remains merged with the Lord; he burns away his ego through the Word of the Shabad. ||1||

[Ang 653 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: aape sevaa laaeian aape bakhas karee |
English: He Himself enjoins us to serve Him, and He Himself blesses us with forgiveness.

Gurbani: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਮਾ ਪਿਉ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabhanaa kaa maa piau aap hai aape saar karee |
English: He Himself is the father and mother of all; He Himself cares for us.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਤਿਨ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naam dhiaaein tin nij ghar vaas hai jug jug sobhaa hoe |2|
English: O Nanak, those who meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abide in the home of their inner being; they are honored throughout the ages. ||2||

[Ang 653 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਹਹਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: too karan kaaran samarath heh karate mai tujh bin avar na koee |
English: You are the Creator, all-powerful, able to do anything. Without You, there is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਸਿਰਜੀਆ ਆਪੇ ਫੁਨਿ ਗੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: tudh aape sisatt sirajeea aape fun goee |
English: You Yourself created the world, and You Yourself shall destroy it in the end.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਇਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: sabh iko sabad varatadaa jo kare su hoee |
English: The Word of Your Shabad alone is pervading everywhere; whatever You do, comes to pass.

Gurbani: ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: vaddiaaee guramukh dee prabh har paavai soee |
English: God blesses the Gurmukh with glorious greatness, and then, he finds the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਸਭਿ ਆਖਹੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੨੯॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ
Transliteration: guramukh naanak aaraadhiaa sabh aakhahu dhan dhan dhan gur soee |29|1| sudh
English: As Gurmukh, Nanak worships and adores the Lord; let everyone proclaim, "Blessed, blessed, blessed is He, the Guru!" ||29||1||Sudh||

[Ang 654 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੋਰਠਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਕੀ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raag soratth baanee bhagat kabeer jee kee ghar 1 |
English: Raag Sorat'h, The Word Of Devotee Kabeer Jee, First House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਬੁਤ ਪੂਜਿ ਪੂਜਿ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਮੂਏ ਤੁਰਕ ਮੂਏ ਸਿਰੁ ਨਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: but pooj pooj hindoo mooe turak mooe sir naaee |
English: Worshipping their idols, the Hindus die; the Muslims die bowing their heads.

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਲੇ ਜਾਰੇ ਓਇ ਲੇ ਗਾਡੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਦੁਹੂ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: oe le jaare oe le gaadde teree gat duhoo na paaee |1|
English: The Hindus cremate their dead, while the Muslims bury theirs; neither finds Your true state, Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਅੰਧ ਗਹੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: man re sansaar andh gaheraa |
English: O mind, the world is a deep, dark pit.

Gurbani: ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸ ਪਸਰਿਓ ਹੈ ਜਮ ਜੇਵਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: chahu dis pasario hai jam jevaraa |1| rahaau |
English: On all four sides, Death has spread his net. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਬਿਤ ਪੜੇ ਪੜਿ ਕਬਿਤਾ ਮੂਏ ਕਪੜ ਕੇਦਾਰੈ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kabit parre parr kabitaa mooe kaparr kedaarai jaaee |
English: Reciting their poems, the poets die; the mystical ascetics die while journeying to Kaydaar Naat'h.

Gurbani: ਜਟਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਮੂਏ ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਇਨਹਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jattaa dhaar dhaar jogee mooe teree gat ineh na paaee |2|
English: The Yogis die, with their matted hair, but even they do not find Your state, Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦਰਬੁ ਸੰਚਿ ਸੰਚਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਮੂਏ ਗਡਿ ਲੇ ਕੰਚਨ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: darab sanch sanch raaje mooe gadd le kanchan bhaaree |
English: The kings die, gathering and hoarding their money, burying great quantities of gold.

Gurbani: ਬੇਦ ਪੜੇ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮੂਏ ਰੂਪੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bed parre parr panddit mooe roop dekh dekh naaree |3|
English: The Pandits die, reading and reciting the Vedas; women die, gazing at their own beauty. ||3||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਭੈ ਬਿਗੂਤੇ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਨਿਰਖਿ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam bin sabhai bigoote dekhahu nirakh sareeraa |
English: Without the Lord's Name, all come to ruin; behold, and know this, O body.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਨਿ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਕਹਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਬੀਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: har ke naam bin kin gat paaee keh upades kabeeraa |4|1|
English: Without the Name of the Lord, who can find salvation? Kabeer speaks the Teachings. ||4||1||

[Ang 654 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਜਬ ਜਰੀਐ ਤਬ ਹੋਇ ਭਸਮ ਤਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਕਿਰਮ ਦਲ ਖਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jab jareeai tab hoe bhasam tan rahai kiram dal khaaee |
English: When the body is burnt, it turns to ashes; if it is not cremated, then it is eaten by armies of worms.

Gurbani: ਕਾਚੀ ਗਾਗਰਿ ਨੀਰੁ ਪਰਤੁ ਹੈ ਇਆ ਤਨ ਕੀ ਇਹੈ ਬਡਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kaachee gaagar neer parat hai eaa tan kee ihai baddaaee |1|
English: The unbaked clay pitcher dissolves, when water is poured into it; this is also the nature of the body. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੇ ਭਈਆ ਫਿਰਤੌ ਫੂਲਿਆ ਫੂਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: kaahe bheea firatau fooliaa fooliaa |
English: Why, O Siblings of Destiny, do you strut around, all puffed up with pride?

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਦਸ ਮਾਸ ਉਰਧ ਮੁਖ ਰਹਤਾ ਸੋ ਦਿਨੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਭੂਲਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jab das maas uradh mukh rahataa so din kaise bhooliaa |1| rahaau |
English: Have you forgotten those days, when you were hanging, face down, for ten months? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਮਧੁ ਮਾਖੀ ਤਿਉ ਸਠੋਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਜੋਰਿ ਜੋਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: jiau madh maakhee tiau satthor ras jor jor dhan keea |
English: Like the bee which collects honey, the fool eagerly gathers and collects wealth.

Gurbani: ਮਰਤੀ ਬਾਰ ਲੇਹੁ ਲੇਹੁ ਕਰੀਐ ਭੂਤੁ ਰਹਨ ਕਿਉ ਦੀਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: maratee baar lehu lehu kareeai bhoot rehan kiau deea |2|
English: At the time of death, they shout, "Take him away, take him away! Why leave a ghost lying around?" ||2||

Gurbani: ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਲਉ ਬਰੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਭਈ ਆਗੈ ਸਜਨ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: dehuree lau baree naar sang bhee aagai sajan suhelaa |
English: His wife accompanies him to the threshold, and his friends and companions beyond.

Gurbani: ਮਰਘਟ ਲਉ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਗੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਭਇਓ ਆਗੈ ਹੰਸੁ ਅਕੇਲਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: maraghatt lau sabh log kuttanb bheo aagai hans akelaa |3|
English: All the people and relatives go as far as the cremation grounds, and then, the soul-swan goes on alone. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਪਰੇ ਕਾਲ ਗ੍ਰਸ ਕੂਆ ॥
Transliteration: kehat kabeer sunahu re praanee pare kaal gras kooaa |
English: Says Kabeer, listen, O mortal being: you have been seized by Death, and you have fallen into the deep, dark pit.

Gurbani: ਝੂਠੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਆਪੁ ਬੰਧਾਇਆ ਜਿਉ ਨਲਨੀ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਸੂਆ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: jhootthee maaeaa aap bandhaaeaa jiau nalanee bhram sooaa |4|2|
English: You have entangled yourself in the false wealth of Maya, like the parrot caught in the trap. ||4||2||

[Ang 654 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਭੈ ਮਤ ਸੁਨਿ ਕੈ ਕਰੀ ਕਰਮ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: bed puraan sabhai mat sun kai karee karam kee aasaa |
English: Listening to all the teachings of the Vedas and the Puraanas, I wanted to perform the religious rituals.

Gurbani: ਕਾਲ ਗ੍ਰਸਤ ਸਭ ਲੋਗ ਸਿਆਨੇ ਉਠਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੈ ਚਲੇ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kaal grasat sabh log siaane utth panddit pai chale niraasaa |1|
English: But seeing all the wise men caught by Death, I arose and left the Pandits; now I am free of this desire. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਰਿਓ ਨ ਏਕੈ ਕਾਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: man re sario na ekai kaajaa |
English: O mind, you have not completed the only task you were given;

Gurbani: ਭਜਿਓ ਨ ਰਘੁਪਤਿ ਰਾਜਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhajio na raghupat raajaa |1| rahaau |
English: you have not meditated on the Lord, your King. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਨ ਖੰਡ ਜਾਇ ਜੋਗੁ ਤਪੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਕੰਦ ਮੂਲੁ ਚੁਨਿ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: ban khandd jaae jog tap keeno kand mool chun khaaeaa |
English: Going to the forests, they practice Yoga and deep, austere meditation; they live on roots and the fruits they gather.

Gurbani: ਨਾਦੀ ਬੇਦੀ ਸਬਦੀ ਮੋਨੀ ਜਮ ਕੇ ਪਟੈ ਲਿਖਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naadee bedee sabadee monee jam ke pattai likhaaeaa |2|
English: The musicians, the Vedic scholars, the chanters of one word and the men of silence, all are listed on the Register of Death. ||2||

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਨਾਰਦੀ ਰਿਦੈ ਨ ਆਈ ਕਾਛਿ ਕੂਛਿ ਤਨੁ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat naaradee ridai na aaee kaachh koochh tan deenaa |
English: Loving devotional worship does not enter into your heart; pampering and adorning your body, you must still give it up.

Gurbani: ਰਾਗ ਰਾਗਨੀ ਡਿੰਭ ਹੋਇ ਬੈਠਾ ਉਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਲੀਨਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: raag raaganee ddinbh hoe baitthaa un har peh kiaa leenaa |3|
English: You sit and play music, but you are still a hypocrite; what do you expect to receive from the Lord? ||3||

Gurbani: ਪਰਿਓ ਕਾਲੁ ਸਭੈ ਜਗ ਊਪਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਲਿਖੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: pario kaal sabhai jag aoopar maeh likhe bhram giaanee |
English: Death has fallen on the whole world; the doubting religious scholars are also listed on the Register of Death.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਨ ਭਏ ਖਾਲਸੇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਿਹ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੪॥੩॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer jan bhe khaalase prem bhagat jih jaanee |4|3|
English: Says Kabeer, those humble people become pure - they become Khalsa - who know the Lord's loving devotional worship. ||4||3||

[Ang 655 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: ghar 2 |
English: Second House||

Gurbani: ਦੁਇ ਦੁਇ ਲੋਚਨ ਪੇਖਾ ॥
Transliteration: due due lochan pekhaa |
English: With both of my eyes, I look around;

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਉਰੁ ਨ ਦੇਖਾ ॥
Transliteration: hau har bin aaur na dekhaa |
English: I don't see anything except the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨੈਨ ਰਹੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: nain rahe rang laaee |
English: My eyes gaze lovingly upon Him,

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਬੇ ਗਲ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ab be gal kehan na jaaee |1|
English: and now, I cannot speak of anything else. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਮਰਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: hamaraa bharam geaa bhau bhaagaa |
English: My doubts were removed, and my fear ran away,

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jab raam naam chit laagaa |1| rahaau |
English: when my consciousness became attached to the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਾਜੀਗਰ ਡੰਕ ਬਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: baajeegar ddank bajaaee |
English: When the magician beats his tambourine,

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਖਲਕ ਤਮਾਸੇ ਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: sabh khalak tamaase aaee |
English: everyone comes to see the show.

Gurbani: ਬਾਜੀਗਰ ਸ੍ਵਾਂਗੁ ਸਕੇਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: baajeegar svaang sakelaa |
English: When the magician winds up his show,

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੇ ਰੰਗ ਰਵੈ ਅਕੇਲਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: apane rang ravai akelaa |2|
English: then he enjoys its play all alone. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਥਨੀ ਕਹਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kathanee keh bharam na jaaee |
English: By preaching sermons, one's doubt is not dispelled.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਕਥਿ ਕਥਿ ਰਹੀ ਲੁਕਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kath kath rahee lukaaee |
English: Everyone is tired of preaching and teaching.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kau guramukh aap bujhaaee |
English: The Lord causes the Gurmukh to understand;

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: taa ke hiradai rahiaa samaaee |3|
English: his heart remains permeated with the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਿੰਚਤ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur kinchat kirapaa keenee |
English: When the Guru grants even a bit of His Grace,

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਹ ਹਰਿ ਲੀਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: sabh tan man deh har leenee |
English: one's body, mind and entire being are absorbed into the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: keh kabeer rang raataa |
English: Says Kabeer, I am imbued with the Lord's Love;

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿਓ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਦਾਤਾ ॥੪॥੪॥
Transliteration: milio jagajeevan daataa |4|4|
English: I have met with the Life of the world, the Great Giver. ||4||4||

[Ang 655 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਨਿਗਮ ਦੂਧ ਕੇ ਠਾਟਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaa ke nigam doodh ke tthaattaa |
English: Let the sacred scriptures be your milk and cream,

Gurbani: ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਬਿਲੋਵਨ ਕਉ ਮਾਟਾ ॥
Transliteration: samund bilovan kau maattaa |
English: and the ocean of the mind the churning vat.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਹੋਹੁ ਬਿਲੋਵਨਹਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: taa kee hohu bilovanahaaree |
English: Be the butter-churner of the Lord,

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਮੇਟੈ ਗੋ ਛਾਛਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kiau mettai go chhaachh tuhaaree |1|
English: and your buttermilk shall not be wasted. ||1||

Gurbani: ਚੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਰਸਿ ਭਤਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: cheree too raam na karas bhataaraa |
English: O soul-bride slave, why don't you take the Lord as your Husband?

Gurbani: ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jagajeevan praan adhaaraa |1| rahaau |
English: He is the Life of the world, the Support of the breath of life. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੇ ਗਲਹਿ ਤਉਕੁ ਪਗ ਬੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: tere galeh tauk pag beree |
English: The chain is around your neck, and the cuffs are on your feet.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਘਰ ਘਰ ਰਮਈਐ ਫੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: too ghar ghar rameeai feree |
English: The Lord has sent you wandering around from house to house.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਅਜਹੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਸਿ ਚੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: too ajahu na chetas cheree |
English: And still, you do not meditate on the Lord, O soul-bride, slave.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਜਮਿ ਬਪੁਰੀ ਹੈ ਹੇਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: too jam bapuree hai heree |2|
English: Death is watching you, O wretched woman. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨਹਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: prabh karan karaavanahaaree |
English: The Lord God is the Cause of causes.

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਚੇਰੀ ਹਾਥ ਬਿਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa cheree haath bichaaree |
English: What is in the hands of the poor soul-bride, the slave?

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: soee soee jaagee |
English: She awakens from her slumber,

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jit laaee tith laagee |3|
English: and she becomes attached to whatever the Lord attaches her. ||3||

Gurbani: ਚੇਰੀ ਤੈ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਕਹਾਂ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: cheree tai sumat kahaan te paaee |
English: O soul-bride, slave, where did you obtain that wisdom,

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੀ ਲੀਕ ਮਿਟਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jaa te bhram kee leek mittaaee |
English: by which you erased your inscription of doubt?

Gurbani: ਸੁ ਰਸੁ ਕਬੀਰੈ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: su ras kabeerai jaaniaa |
English: Kabeer has tasted that subtle essence;

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੋ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੪॥੫॥
Transliteration: mero gur prasaad man maaniaa |4|5|
English: by Guru's Grace, his mind is reconciled with the Lord. ||4||5||

[Ang 655 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਬਾਝੁ ਨ ਜੀਆ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jih baajh na jeea jaaee |
English: Without Him, we cannot even live;

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਘਾਲ ਅਘਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jau milai ta ghaal aghaaee |
English: when we meet Him, then our task is completed.

Gurbani: ਸਦ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਭਲੋ ਕਹਾਂਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: sad jeevan bhalo kahaanhee |
English: People say it is good to live forever,

Gurbani: ਮੂਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mooe bin jeevan naahee |1|
English: but without dying, there is no life. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਕਿਆ ਕਥੀਐ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: ab kiaa katheeai giaan beechaaraa |
English: So now, what sort wisdom should I contemplate and preach?

Gurbani: ਨਿਜ ਨਿਰਖਤ ਗਤ ਬਿਉਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: nij nirakhat gat biauhaaraa |1| rahaau |
English: As I watch, worldly things dissipate. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਘਸਿ ਕੁੰਕਮ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਗਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: ghas kunkam chandan gaariaa |
English: Saffron is ground up, and mixed with sandalwood;

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨੈਨਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਨਿਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: bin nainahu jagat nihaariaa |
English: without eyes, the world is seen.

Gurbani: ਪੂਤਿ ਪਿਤਾ ਇਕੁ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: poot pitaa ik jaaeaa |
English: The son has given birth to his father;

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਠਾਹਰ ਨਗਰੁ ਬਸਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bin tthaahar nagar basaaeaa |2|
English: without a place, the city has been established. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਾਚਕ ਜਨ ਦਾਤਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jaachak jan daataa paaeaa |
English: The humble beggar has found the Great Giver,

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਦੀਆ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: so deea na jaaee khaaeaa |
English: but he is unable to eat what he has been given.

Gurbani: ਛੋਡਿਆ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਮੂਕਾ ॥
Transliteration: chhoddiaa jaae na mookaa |
English: He cannot leave it alone, but it is never exhausted.

Gurbani: ਅਉਰਨ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਨਾ ਚੂਕਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aauran peh jaanaa chookaa |3|
English: He shall not go to beg from others any longer. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੀਵਨ ਮਰਨਾ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: jo jeevan maranaa jaanai |
English: Those select few, who know how to die while yet alive,

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਪੰਚ ਸੈਲ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: so panch sail sukh maanai |
English: Enjoy great peace.

Gurbani: ਕਬੀਰੈ ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kabeerai so dhan paaeaa |
English: Kabeer has found that wealth;

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟਤ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੬॥
Transliteration: har bhettat aap mittaaeaa |4|6|
English: meeting with the Lord, he has erased his self-conceit. ||4||6||

[Ang 655 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਪੜੀਐ ਕਿਆ ਗੁਨੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa parreeai kiaa guneeai |
English: What use is it to read, and what use is it to study?

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨਾਂ ਸੁਨੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa bed puraanaan suneeai |
English: What use is it to listen to the Vedas and the Puraanas?

Gurbani: ਪੜੇ ਸੁਨੇ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: parre sune kiaa hoee |
English: What use is reading and listening,

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਸਹਜ ਨ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jau sehaj na milio soee |1|
English: if celestial peace is not attained? ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਪਸਿ ਗਵਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam na japas gavaaraa |
English: The fool does not chant the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਸੋਚਹਿ ਬਾਰੰ ਬਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa socheh baaran baaraa |1| rahaau |
English: So what does he think of, over and over again? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅੰਧਿਆਰੇ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਚਹੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: andhiaare deepak chaheeai |
English: In the darkness, we need a lamp

Gurbani: ਇਕ ਬਸਤੁ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਲਹੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: eik basat agochar laheeai |
English: to find the incomprehensible thing.

Gurbani: ਬਸਤੁ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: basat agochar paaee |
English: I have found this incomprehensible thing;

Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ghatt deepak rahiaa samaaee |2|
English: my mind is illuminated and enlightened. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਅਬ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: keh kabeer ab jaaniaa |
English: Says Kabeer, now I know Him;

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਤਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jab jaaniaa tau man maaniaa |
English: since I know Him, my mind is pleased and appeased.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮਾਨੇ ਲੋਗੁ ਨ ਪਤੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: man maane log na pateejai |
English: My mind is pleased and appeased, and yet, people do not believe it.

Gurbani: ਨ ਪਤੀਜੈ ਤਉ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੩॥੭॥
Transliteration: n pateejai tau kiaa keejai |3|7|
English: They do not believe it, so what can I do? ||3||7||

[Ang 656 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਹ੍ਰਿਦੈ ਕਪਟੁ ਮੁਖ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: hridai kapatt mukh giaanee |
English: In his heart there is deception, and yet in his mouth are words of wisdom.

Gurbani: ਝੂਠੇ ਕਹਾ ਬਿਲੋਵਸਿ ਪਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jhootthe kahaa bilovas paanee |1|
English: You are false - why are you churning water? ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਾਂਇਆ ਮਾਂਜਸਿ ਕਉਨ ਗੁਨਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: kaaneaa maanjas kaun gunaan |
English: Why do you bother to wash your body?

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਹੈ ਮਲਨਾਂ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jau ghatt bheetar hai malanaan |1| rahaau |
English: Your heart is still full of filth. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਲਉਕੀ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨੑਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: laukee atthasatth teerath naaee |
English: The gourd may be washed at the sixty-eight sacred shrines,

Gurbani: ਕਉਰਾਪਨੁ ਤਊ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kauraapan taoo na jaaee |2|
English: but even then, its bitterness is not removed. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: keh kabeer beechaaree |
English: Says Kabeer after deep contemplation,

Gurbani: ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਾਰਿ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੩॥੮॥
Transliteration: bhav saagar taar muraaree |3|8|
English: please help me cross over the terrifying world-ocean, O Lord, O Destroyer of ego. ||3||8||

[Ang 656 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ॥
Transliteration: soratth |
English: Sorat'h:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਬਹੁ ਪਰਪੰਚ ਕਰਿ ਪਰ ਧਨੁ ਲਿਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: bahu parapanch kar par dhan liaavai |
English: Practicing great hypocrisy, he acquires the wealth of others.

Gurbani: ਸੁਤ ਦਾਰਾ ਪਹਿ ਆਨਿ ਲੁਟਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sut daaraa peh aan luttaavai |1|
English: Returning home, he squanders it on his wife and children. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਭੂਲੇ ਕਪਟੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: man mere bhoole kapatt na keejai |
English: O my mind, do not practice deception, even inadvertently.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਿ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਪਹਿ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ant niberaa tere jeea peh leejai |1| rahaau |
English: In the end, your own soul shall have to answer for its account. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਛਿਨੁ ਛਿਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਛੀਜੈ ਜਰਾ ਜਨਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: chhin chhin tan chheejai jaraa janaavai |
English: Moment by moment, the body is wearing away, and old age is asserting itself.

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਤੇਰੀ ਓਕ ਕੋਈ ਪਾਨੀਓ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tab teree ok koee paaneeo na paavai |2|
English: And then, when you are old, no one shall pour water into your cup. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਕੋਈ ਨਹੀ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kehat kabeer koee nahee teraa |
English: Says Kabeer, no one belongs to you.

Gurbani: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਕੀ ਨ ਜਪਹਿ ਸਵੇਰਾ ॥੩॥੯॥
Transliteration: hiradai raam kee na japeh saveraa |3|9|
English: Why not chant the Lord's Name in your heart, when you are still young? ||3||9||

[Ang 656 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਮਨ ਪਵਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਬਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: santahu man pavanai sukh baniaa |
English: O Saints, my windy mind has now become peaceful and still.

Gurbani: ਕਿਛੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਗਨਿਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kichh jog paraapat ganiaa | rahaau |
English: It seems that I have learned something of the science of Yoga. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਖਲਾਈ ਮੋਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur dikhalaaee moree |
English: The Guru has shown me the hole,

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਰਗ ਪੜਤ ਹੈ ਚੋਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jit mirag parrat hai choree |
English: through which the deer carefully enters.

Gurbani: ਮੂੰਦਿ ਲੀਏ ਦਰਵਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: moond lee daravaaje |
English: I have now closed off the doors,

Gurbani: ਬਾਜੀਅਲੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਜੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: baajeeale anahad baaje |1|
English: and the unstruck celestial sound current resounds. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕੁੰਭ ਕਮਲੁ ਜਲਿ ਭਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: kunbh kamal jal bhariaa |
English: The pitcher of my heart-lotus is filled with water;

Gurbani: ਜਲੁ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਊਭਾ ਕਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jal mettiaa aoobhaa kariaa |
English: I have spilled out the water, and set it upright.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer jan jaaniaa |
English: Says Kabeer, the Lord's humble servant, this I know.

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਤਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੨॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: jau jaaniaa tau man maaniaa |2|10|
English: Now that I know this, my mind is pleased and appeased. ||2||10||

[Ang 656 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੋਰਠਿ ॥
Transliteration: raag soratth |
English: Raag Sorat'h:

Gurbani: ਭੂਖੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: bhookhe bhagat na keejai |
English: I am so hungry, I cannot perform devotional worship service.

Gurbani: ਯਹ ਮਾਲਾ ਅਪਨੀ ਲੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: yeh maalaa apanee leejai |
English: Here, Lord, take back Your mala.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਮਾਂਗਉ ਸੰਤਨ ਰੇਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: hau maangau santan renaa |
English: I beg for the dust of the feet of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਸੀ ਕਾ ਦੇਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mai naahee kisee kaa denaa |1|
English: I do not owe anyone anything. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਾਧੋ ਕੈਸੀ ਬਨੈ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: maadho kaisee banai tum sange |
English: O Lord, how can I be with You?

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਨ ਦੇਹੁ ਤ ਲੇਵਉ ਮੰਗੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aap na dehu ta levau mange | rahaau |
English: If You do not give me Yourself, then I shall beg until I get You. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦੁਇ ਸੇਰ ਮਾਂਗਉ ਚੂਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: due ser maangau choonaa |
English: I ask for two kilos of flour,

Gurbani: ਪਾਉ ਘੀਉ ਸੰਗਿ ਲੂਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: paau gheeo sang loonaa |
English: and half a pound of ghee, and salt.

Gurbani: ਅਧ ਸੇਰੁ ਮਾਂਗਉ ਦਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: adh ser maangau daale |
English: I ask for a pound of beans,

Gurbani: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੋਨਉ ਵਖਤ ਜਿਵਾਲੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mo kau donau vakhat jivaale |2|
English: which I shall eat twice a day. ||2||

Gurbani: ਖਾਟ ਮਾਂਗਉ ਚਉਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: khaatt maangau chaupaaee |
English: I ask for a cot, with four legs,

Gurbani: ਸਿਰਹਾਨਾ ਅਵਰ ਤੁਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sirahaanaa avar tulaaee |
English: and a pillow and mattress.

Gurbani: ਊਪਰ ਕਉ ਮਾਂਗਉ ਖੀਂਧਾ ॥
Transliteration: aoopar kau maangau kheendhaa |
English: I ask for a quilt to cover myself.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਜਨੁ ਥਂੀਧਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: teree bhagat karai jan thaneedhaa |3|
English: Your humble servant shall perform Your devotional worship service with love. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੀਤਾ ਲਬੋ ॥
Transliteration: mai naahee keetaa labo |
English: I have no greed;

Gurbani: ਇਕੁ ਨਾਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਮੈ ਫਬੋ ॥
Transliteration: eik naau teraa mai fabo |
English: Your Name is the only ornament I wish for.

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: keh kabeer man maaniaa |
English: Says Kabeer, my mind is pleased and appeased;

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਤਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੪॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: man maaniaa tau har jaaniaa |4|11|
English: now that my mind is pleased and appeased, I have come to know the Lord. ||4||11||

[Ang 656 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Bhagat Namdev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੋਰਠਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਨਾਮਦੇ ਜੀ ਕੀ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: raag soratth baanee bhagat naamade jee kee ghar 2 |
English: Raag Sorat'h, The Word Of Devotee Naam Dayv Jee, Second House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਬ ਗਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: jab dekhaa tab gaavaa |
English: When I see Him, I sing His Praises.

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਜਨ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਪਾਵਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tau jan dheeraj paavaa |1|
English: Then I, his humble servant, become patient. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਾਦਿ ਸਮਾਇਲੋ ਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਲੇ ਦੇਵਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: naad samaaeilo re satigur bhettile devaa |1| rahaau |
English: Meeting the Divine True Guru, I merge into the sound current of the Naad. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਝਿਲਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਾਰੁ ਦਿਸੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeh jhil mil kaar disantaa |
English: Where the dazzling white light is seen,

Gurbani: ਤਹ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਬਜੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: teh anahad sabad bajantaa |
English: there the unstruck sound current of the Shabad resounds.

Gurbani: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: jotee jot samaanee |
English: One's light merges in the Light;

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mai gur parasaadee jaanee |2|
English: by Guru's Grace, I know this. ||2||

Gurbani: ਰਤਨ ਕਮਲ ਕੋਠਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: ratan kamal kottharee |
English: The jewels are in the treasure chamber of the heart-lotus.

Gurbani: ਚਮਕਾਰ ਬੀਜੁਲ ਤਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: chamakaar beejul tahee |
English: They sparkle and glitter like lightning.

Gurbani: ਨੇਰੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: nerai naahee door |
English: The Lord is near at hand, not far away.

Gurbani: ਨਿਜ ਆਤਮੈ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: nij aatamai rahiaa bharapoor |3|
English: He is totally permeating and pervading in my soul. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਅਨਹਤ ਸੂਰ ਉਜੵਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeh anahat soor ujayaaraa |
English: Where the light of the undying sun shines,

Gurbani: ਤਹ ਦੀਪਕ ਜਲੈ ਛੰਛਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: teh deepak jalai chhanchhaaraa |
English: the light of burning lamps seems insignificant.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee jaaniaa |
English: By Guru's Grace, I know this.

Gurbani: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਮਾ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: jan naamaa sehaj samaaniaa |4|1|
English: Servant Naam Dayv is absorbed in the Celestial Lord. ||4||1||

[Ang 657 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Bhagat Namdev Ji]
Gurbani: ਘਰੁ ੪ ਸੋਰਠਿ ॥
Transliteration: ghar 4 soratth |
English: Fourth House, Sorat'h:

Gurbani: ਪਾੜ ਪੜੋਸਣਿ ਪੂਛਿ ਲੇ ਨਾਮਾ ਕਾ ਪਹਿ ਛਾਨਿ ਛਵਾਈ ਹੋ ॥
Transliteration: paarr parrosan poochh le naamaa kaa peh chhaan chhavaaee ho |
English: The woman next door asked Naam Dayv, "Who built your house?

Gurbani: ਤੋ ਪਹਿ ਦੁਗਣੀ ਮਜੂਰੀ ਦੈਹਉ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਬੇਢੀ ਦੇਹੁ ਬਤਾਈ ਹੋ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: to peh duganee majooree daihau mo kau bedtee dehu bataaee ho |1|
English: I shall pay him double wages. Tell me, who is your carpenter?" ||1||

Gurbani: ਰੀ ਬਾਈ ਬੇਢੀ ਦੇਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ree baaee bedtee den na jaaee |
English: O sister, I cannot give this carpenter to you.

Gurbani: ਦੇਖੁ ਬੇਢੀ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: dekh bedtee rahio samaaee |
English: Behold, my carpenter is pervading everywhere.

Gurbani: ਹਮਾਰੈ ਬੇਢੀ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hamaarai bedtee praan adhaaraa |1| rahaau |
English: My carpenter is the Support of the breath of life. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬੇਢੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਜੂਰੀ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਜਉ ਕੋਊ ਛਾਨਿ ਛਵਾਵੈ ਹੋ ॥
Transliteration: bedtee preet majooree maangai jau koaoo chhaan chhavaavai ho |
English: This carpenter demands the wages of love, if someone wants Him to build their house.

Gurbani: ਲੋਗ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਭਹੁ ਤੇ ਤੋਰੈ ਤਉ ਆਪਨ ਬੇਢੀ ਆਵੈ ਹੋ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: log kuttanb sabhahu te torai tau aapan bedtee aavai ho |2|
English: When one breaks his ties with all the people and relatives, then the carpenter comes of His own accord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਐਸੋ ਬੇਢੀ ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰ ਸਭ ਠਾਂਈ ਹੋ ॥
Transliteration: aiso bedtee baran na saakau sabh antar sabh tthaanee ho |
English: I cannot describe such a carpenter, who is contained in everything, everywhere.

Gurbani: ਗੂੰਗੈ ਮਹਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਪੂਛੇ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਹੋ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: goongai mahaa amrit ras chaakhiaa poochhe kehan na jaaee ho |3|
English: The mute tastes the most sublime ambrosial nectar, but if you ask him to describe it, he cannot. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬੇਢੀ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਸੁਨਿ ਰੀ ਬਾਈ ਜਲਧਿ ਬਾਂਧਿ ਧ੍ਰੂ ਥਾਪਿਓ ਹੋ ॥
Transliteration: bedtee ke gun sun ree baaee jaladh baandh dhraoo thaapio ho |
English: Listen to the virtues of this carpenter, O sister; He stopped the oceans, and established Dhroo as the pole star.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੇ ਕੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੀਅ ਬਹੋਰੀ ਲੰਕ ਭਭੀਖਣ ਆਪਿਓ ਹੋ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: naame ke suaamee seea bahoree lank bhabheekhan aapio ho |4|2|
English: Naam Dayv's Lord Master brought Sita back, and gave Sri Lanka to Bhabheekhan. ||4||2||

[Ang 657 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Bhagat Namdev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: soratth ghar 3 |
English: Sorat'h, Third House:

Gurbani: ਅਣਮੜਿਆ ਮੰਦਲੁ ਬਾਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: anamarriaa mandal baajai |
English: The skinless drum plays.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਵਣ ਘਨਹਰੁ ਗਾਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: bin saavan ghanahar gaajai |
English: Without the rainy season, the clouds shake with thunder.

Gurbani: ਬਾਦਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਰਖਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: baadal bin barakhaa hoee |
English: Without clouds, the rain falls,

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਤਤੁ ਬਿਚਾਰੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
