Transliteration: jau tat bichaarai koee |1|
English: if one contemplates the essence of reality. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਨੇਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: mo kau milio raam sanehee |
English: I have met my Beloved Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਦੇਹ ਸੁਦੇਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jih miliai deh sudehee |1| rahaau |
English: Meeting with Him, my body is made beauteous and sublime. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਰਸ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਹੋਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: mil paaras kanchan hoeaa |
English: Touching the philosopher's stone, I have been transformed into gold.

Gurbani: ਮੁਖ ਮਨਸਾ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਰੋਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: mukh manasaa ratan paroeaa |
English: I have threaded the jewels into my mouth and mind.

Gurbani: ਨਿਜ ਭਾਉ ਭਇਆ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: nij bhaau bheaa bhram bhaagaa |
English: I love Him as my own, and my doubt has been dispelled.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਛੇ ਮਨੁ ਪਤੀਆਗਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur poochhe man pateeaagaa |2|
English: Seeking the Guru's guidance, my mind is content. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਲ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਕੁੰਭ ਸਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jal bheetar kunbh samaaniaa |
English: The water is contained within the pitcher;

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਰਾਮੁ ਏਕੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabh raam ek kar jaaniaa |
English: I know that the One Lord is contained in all.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲੇ ਹੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur chele hai man maaniaa |
English: The mind of the disciple has faith in the Guru.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਮੈ ਤਤੁ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥੩॥੩॥
Transliteration: jan naamai tat pachhaaniaa |3|3|
English: Servant Naam Dayv understands the essence of reality. ||3||3||

[Ang 657 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Bhagat Ravidas Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੋਰਠਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: raag soratth baanee bhagat ravidaas jee kee |
English: Raag Sorat'h, The Word Of Devotee Ravi Daas Jee:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਹਮ ਹੋਤੇ ਤਬ ਤੂ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਬ ਤੂਹੀ ਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jab ham hote tab too naahee ab toohee mai naahee |
English: When I am in my ego, then You are not with me. Now that You are with me, there is no egotism within me.

Gurbani: ਅਨਲ ਅਗਮ ਜੈਸੇ ਲਹਰਿ ਮਇ ਓਦਧਿ ਜਲ ਕੇਵਲ ਜਲ ਮਾਂਹੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: anal agam jaise lehar me odadh jal keval jal maanhee |1|
English: The wind may raise up huge waves in the vast ocean, but they are just water in water. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਾਧਵੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਐਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: maadhave kiaa kaheeai bhram aisaa |
English: O Lord, what can I say about such an illusion?

Gurbani: ਜੈਸਾ ਮਾਨੀਐ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਤੈਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaisaa maaneeai hoe na taisaa |1| rahaau |
English: Things are not as they seem. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਰਪਤਿ ਏਕੁ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਨਿ ਸੋਇਆ ਸੁਪਨੇ ਭਇਆ ਭਿਖਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: narapat ek singhaasan soeaa supane bheaa bhikhaaree |
English: It is like the king, who falls asleep upon his throne, and dreams that he is a beggar.

Gurbani: ਅਛਤ ਰਾਜ ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋ ਗਤਿ ਭਈ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: achhat raaj bichhurat dukh paaeaa so gat bhee hamaaree |2|
English: His kingdom is intact, but separated from it, he suffers in sorrow. Such is my own condition. ||2||

Gurbani: ਰਾਜ ਭੁਇਅੰਗ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਗ ਜੈਸੇ ਹਹਿ ਅਬ ਕਛੁ ਮਰਮੁ ਜਨਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: raaj bhueiang prasang jaise heh ab kachh maram janaaeaa |
English: Like the story of the rope mistaken for a snake, the mystery has now been explained to me.

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਕਟਕ ਜੈਸੇ ਭੂਲਿ ਪਰੇ ਅਬ ਕਹਤੇ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: anik kattak jaise bhool pare ab kahate kehan na aaeaa |3|
English: Like the many bracelets, which I mistakenly thought were gold; now, I do not say what I said then. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਰਬੇ ਏਕੁ ਅਨੇਕੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਭ ਘਟ ਭੋੁਗਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: sarabe ek anekai suaamee sabh ghatt bhuogavai soee |
English: The One Lord is pervading the many forms; He enjoys Himself in all hearts.

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਹਾਥ ਪੈ ਨੇਰੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: keh ravidaas haath pai nerai sahaje hoe su hoee |4|1|
English: Says Ravi Daas, the Lord is nearer than our own hands and feet. Whatever will be, will be. ||4||1||

[Ang 658 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Bhagat Ravidas Ji]
Gurbani: ਜਉ ਹਮ ਬਾਂਧੇ ਮੋਹ ਫਾਸ ਹਮ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਧਨਿ ਤੁਮ ਬਾਧੇ ॥
Transliteration: jau ham baandhe moh faas ham prem badhan tum baadhe |
English: If I am bound by the noose of emotional attachment, then I shall bind You, Lord, with the bonds of love.

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੇ ਛੂਟਨ ਕੋ ਜਤਨੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਮ ਛੂਟੇ ਤੁਮ ਆਰਾਧੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: apane chhoottan ko jatan karahu ham chhootte tum aaraadhe |1|
English: Go ahead and try to escape, Lord; I have escaped by worshipping and adoring You. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਾਧਵੇ ਜਾਨਤ ਹਹੁ ਜੈਸੀ ਤੈਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: maadhave jaanat hahu jaisee taisee |
English: O Lord, You know my love for You.

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਕਹਾ ਕਰਹੁਗੇ ਐਸੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ab kahaa karahuge aisee |1| rahaau |
English: Now, what will You do? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੀਨੁ ਪਕਰਿ ਫਾਂਕਿਓ ਅਰੁ ਕਾਟਿਓ ਰਾਂਧਿ ਕੀਓ ਬਹੁ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: meen pakar faankio ar kaattio raandh keeo bahu baanee |
English: A fish is caught, cut up, and cooked it in many different ways.

Gurbani: ਖੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਕਰਿ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਤਊ ਨ ਬਿਸਰਿਓ ਪਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: khandd khandd kar bhojan keeno taoo na bisario paanee |2|
English: Bit by bit, it is eaten, but still, it does not forget the water. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਪਨ ਬਾਪੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਸੀ ਕੋ ਭਾਵਨ ਕੋ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: aapan baapai naahee kisee ko bhaavan ko har raajaa |
English: The Lord, our King, is father to no one, except those who love Him.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹ ਪਟਲ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਬਿਆਪਿਓ ਭਗਤ ਨਹੀ ਸੰਤਾਪਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: moh pattal sabh jagat biaapio bhagat nahee santaapaa |3|
English: The veil of emotional attachment has been cast over the entire world, but it does not bother the Lord's devotee. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਭਗਤਿ ਇਕ ਬਾਢੀ ਅਬ ਇਹ ਕਾ ਸਿਉ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: keh ravidaas bhagat ik baadtee ab ih kaa siau kaheeai |
English: Says Ravi Daas, my devotion to the One Lord is increasing; now, who can I tell this to?

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਾਰਨਿ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਸੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਅਜਹੂ ਸਹੀਐ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: jaa kaaran ham tum aaraadhe so dukh ajahoo saheeai |4|2|
English: That which brought me to worship and adore You - I am still suffering that pain. ||4||2||

[Ang 658 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Bhagat Ravidas Ji]
Gurbani: ਦੁਲਭ ਜਨਮੁ ਪੁੰਨ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਓ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਤ ਅਬਿਬੇਕੈ ॥
Transliteration: dulabh janam pun fal paaeo birathaa jaat abibekai |
English: I obtained this precious human life as a reward for my past actions, but without discriminating wisdom, it is wasted in vain.

Gurbani: ਰਾਜੇ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਆਸਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਹ ਲੇਖੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: raaje indr samasar grih aasan bin har bhagat kahahu kih lekhai |1|
English: Tell me, without devotional worship of the Lord, of what use are mansions and thrones like those of King Indra? ||1||

Gurbani: ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਰਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: n beechaario raajaa raam ko ras |
English: You have not considered the sublime essence of the Name of the Lord, our King;

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਰਸ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਬੀਸਰਿ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jih ras an ras beesar jaahee |1| rahaau |
English: this sublime essence shall cause you to forget all other essences. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਾਨਿ ਅਜਾਨ ਭਏ ਹਮ ਬਾਵਰ ਸੋਚ ਅਸੋਚ ਦਿਵਸ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jaan ajaan bhe ham baavar soch asoch divas jaahee |
English: We do not know what we need to know, and we have become insane. We do not consider what we should consider; our days are passing away.

Gurbani: ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਸਬਲ ਨਿਬਲ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਰਮਾਰਥ ਪਰਵੇਸ ਨਹੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: eindree sabal nibal bibek budh paramaarath paraves nahee |2|
English: Our passions are strong, and our discriminating intellect is weak; we have no access to the supreme objective. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਹੀਅਤ ਆਨ ਅਚਰੀਅਤ ਅਨ ਕਛੁ ਸਮਝ ਨ ਪਰੈ ਅਪਰ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kaheeat aan achareeat an kachh samajh na parai apar maaeaa |
English: We say one thing, and do something else; entangled in endless Maya, we do not understand anything.

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਉਦਾਸ ਦਾਸ ਮਤਿ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਕੋਪੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਜੀਅ ਦਇਆ ॥੩॥੩॥
Transliteration: keh ravidaas udaas daas mat parahar kop karahu jeea deaa |3|3|
English: Says Ravi Daas, Your slave, O Lord, I am disillusioned and detached; please, spare me Your anger, and have mercy on my soul. ||3||3||

[Ang 658 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Bhagat Ravidas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸੁਰਤਰ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਨਿ ਕਾਮਧੇਨੁ ਬਸਿ ਜਾ ਕੇ ॥
Transliteration: sukh saagar suratar chintaaman kaamadhen bas jaa ke |
English: He is the ocean of peace; the miraculous tree of life, the wish-fulfilling jewel, and the Kaamadhayna, the cow which fulfills all desires, all are in His power.

Gurbani: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਅਸਟ ਦਸਾ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਕਰ ਤਲ ਤਾ ਕੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: chaar padaarath asatt dasaa sidh nav nidh kar tal taa ke |1|
English: The four great blessings, the eighteen supernatural spiritual powers of the Siddhas, and the nine treasures, are all in the palm of His hand. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨ ਜਪਹਿ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: har har har na japeh rasanaa |
English: You do not chant with your tongue the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰ ਸਭ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਬਚਨ ਰਚਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: avar sabh tiaag bachan rachanaa |1| rahaau |
English: Abandon your involvement in all other words. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਾ ਖਿਆਨ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਬੇਦ ਬਿਧਿ ਚਉਤੀਸ ਅਖਰ ਮਾਂਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: naanaa khiaan puraan bed bidh chautees akhar maanhee |
English: The various Shaastras, Puranaas, and the Vedas of Brahma, are made up of thirty-four letters.

Gurbani: ਬਿਆਸ ਬਿਚਾਰਿ ਕਹਿਓ ਪਰਮਾਰਥੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: biaas bichaar kahio paramaarath raam naam sar naahee |2|
English: After deep contemplation, Vyaas spoke of the supreme objective; there is nothing equal to the Lord's Name. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਰਹਤ ਫੁਨਿ ਬਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj samaadh upaadh rehat fun baddai bhaag liv laagee |
English: Very fortunate are those who are absorbed in celestial bliss, and released from their entanglements; they are lovingly attached to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਧਰਿ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਭੈ ਭਾਗੀ ॥੩॥੪॥
Transliteration: keh ravidaas pragaas ridai dhar janam maran bhai bhaagee |3|4|
English: Says Ravi Daas, enshrine the Lord's Light within your heart, and your fear of birth and death shall run away from you. ||3||4||

[Ang 658 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Bhagat Ravidas Ji]
Gurbani: ਜਉ ਤੁਮ ਗਿਰਿਵਰ ਤਉ ਹਮ ਮੋਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jau tum girivar tau ham moraa |
English: If You are the mountain, Lord, then I am the peacock.

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਤੁਮ ਚੰਦ ਤਉ ਹਮ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਚਕੋਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jau tum chand tau ham bhe hai chakoraa |1|
English: If You are the moon, then I am the partridge in love with it. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਾਧਵੇ ਤੁਮ ਨ ਤੋਰਹੁ ਤਉ ਹਮ ਨਹੀ ਤੋਰਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: maadhave tum na torahu tau ham nahee toreh |
English: O Lord, if You will not break with me, then I will not break with You.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਸਿਉ ਤੋਰਿ ਕਵਨ ਸਿਉ ਜੋਰਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tum siau tor kavan siau joreh |1| rahaau |
English: For, if I were to break with You, with whom would I then join? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਤੁਮ ਦੀਵਰਾ ਤਉ ਹਮ ਬਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: jau tum deevaraa tau ham baatee |
English: If You are the lamp, then I am the wick.

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਤੁਮ ਤੀਰਥ ਤਉ ਹਮ ਜਾਤੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jau tum teerath tau ham jaatee |2|
English: If You are the sacred place of pilgrimage, then I am the pilgrim. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਸਿਉ ਜੋਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: saachee preet ham tum siau joree |
English: I am joined in true love with You, Lord.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਸਿਉ ਜੋਰਿ ਅਵਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੋਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tum siau jor avar sang toree |3|
English: I am joined with You, and I have broken with all others. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਜਾਉ ਤਹਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeh jeh jaau tahaa teree sevaa |
English: Wherever I go, there I serve You.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਸੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਅਉਰੁ ਨ ਦੇਵਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: tum so tthaakur aaur na devaa |4|
English: There is no other Lord Master than You, O Divine Lord. ||4||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮਰੇ ਭਜਨ ਕਟਹਿ ਜਮ ਫਾਂਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: tumare bhajan katteh jam faansaa |
English: Meditating, vibrating upon You, the noose of death is cut away.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਹੇਤ ਗਾਵੈ ਰਵਿਦਾਸਾ ॥੫॥੫॥
Transliteration: bhagat het gaavai ravidaasaa |5|5|
English: To attain devotional worship, Ravi Daas sings to You, Lord. ||5||5||

[Ang 659 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Bhagat Ravidas Ji]
Gurbani: ਜਲ ਕੀ ਭੀਤਿ ਪਵਨ ਕਾ ਥੰਭਾ ਰਕਤ ਬੁੰਦ ਕਾ ਗਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jal kee bheet pavan kaa thanbhaa rakat bund kaa gaaraa |
English: The body is a wall of water, supported by the pillars of air; the egg and sperm are the mortar.

Gurbani: ਹਾਡ ਮਾਸ ਨਾੜਂੀ ਕੋ ਪਿੰਜਰੁ ਪੰਖੀ ਬਸੈ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: haadd maas naarranee ko pinjar pankhee basai bichaaraa |1|
English: The framework is made up of bones, flesh and veins; the poor soul-bird dwells within it. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਕਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਿਆ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: praanee kiaa meraa kiaa teraa |
English: O mortal, what is mine, and what is yours?

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਰਵਰ ਪੰਖਿ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaise taravar pankh baseraa |1| rahaau |
English: The soul is like a bird perched upon a tree. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਰਾਖਹੁ ਕੰਧ ਉਸਾਰਹੁ ਨੀਵਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: raakhahu kandh usaarahu neevaan |
English: You lay the foundation and build the walls.

Gurbani: ਸਾਢੇ ਤੀਨਿ ਹਾਥ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੀਵਾਂ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saadte teen haath teree seevaan |2|
English: But in the end, three and a half cubits will be your measured space. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬੰਕੇ ਬਾਲ ਪਾਗ ਸਿਰਿ ਡੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: banke baal paag sir dderee |
English: You make your hair beautiful, and wear a stylish turban on your head.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇਗੋ ਭਸਮ ਕੀ ਢੇਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: eihu tan hoeigo bhasam kee dteree |3|
English: But in the end, this body shall be reduced to a pile of ashes. ||3||

Gurbani: ਊਚੇ ਮੰਦਰ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: aooche mandar sundar naaree |
English: Your palaces are lofty, and your brides are beautiful.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: raam naam bin baajee haaree |4|
English: But without the Lord's Name, you shall lose the game entirely. ||4||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਕਮੀਨੀ ਪਾਂਤਿ ਕਮੀਨੀ ਓਛਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: meree jaat kameenee paant kameenee ochhaa janam hamaaraa |
English: My social status is low, my ancestry is low, and my life is wretched.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਸਰਨਾਗਤਿ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਚੰਦ ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਚਮਾਰਾ ॥੫॥੬॥
Transliteration: tum saranaagat raajaa raam chand keh ravidaas chamaaraa |5|6|
English: I have come to Your Sanctuary, O Luminous Lord, my King; so says Ravi Daas, the shoemaker. ||5||6||

[Ang 659 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Bhagat Ravidas Ji]
Gurbani: ਚਮਰਟਾ ਗਾਂਠਿ ਨ ਜਨਈ ॥
Transliteration: chamarattaa gaantth na janee |
English: I am a shoemaker, but I do not know how to mend shoes.

Gurbani: ਲੋਗੁ ਗਠਾਵੈ ਪਨਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: log gatthaavai panahee |1| rahaau |
English: People come to me to mend their shoes. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਰ ਨਹੀ ਜਿਹ ਤੋਪਉ ॥
Transliteration: aar nahee jih topau |
English: I have no awl to stitch them;

Gurbani: ਨਹੀ ਰਾਂਬੀ ਠਾਉ ਰੋਪਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: nahee raanbee tthaau ropau |1|
English: I have no knife to patch them. ||1||

Gurbani: ਲੋਗੁ ਗੰਠਿ ਗੰਠਿ ਖਰਾ ਬਿਗੂਚਾ ॥
Transliteration: log gantth gantth kharaa bigoochaa |
English: Mending, mending, people waste their lives and ruin themselves.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਾਂਠੇ ਜਾਇ ਪਹੂਚਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: hau bin gaantthe jaae pahoochaa |2|
English: Without wasting my time mending, I have found the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਰਵਿਦਾਸੁ ਜਪੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: ravidaas japai raam naamaa |
English: Ravi Daas chants the Lord's Name;

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਜਮ ਸਿਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਾਮਾ ॥੩॥੭॥
Transliteration: mohi jam siau naahee kaamaa |3|7|
English: he is not concerned with the Messenger of Death. ||3||7||

[Ang 659 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Bhagat Bheekhan Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੋਰਠਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਭੀਖਨ ਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: raag soratth baanee bhagat bheekhan kee |
English: Raag Sorat'h, The Word Of Devotee Bheekhan Jee:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਨੈਨਹੁ ਨੀਰੁ ਬਹੈ ਤਨੁ ਖੀਨਾ ਭਏ ਕੇਸ ਦੁਧ ਵਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: nainahu neer bahai tan kheenaa bhe kes dudh vaanee |
English: Tears well up in my eyes, my body has become weak, and my hair has become milky-white.

Gurbani: ਰੂਧਾ ਕੰਠੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਹੀ ਉਚਰੈ ਅਬ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: roodhaa kantth sabad nahee ucharai ab kiaa kareh paraanee |1|
English: My throat is tight, and I cannot utter even one word; what can I do now? I am a mere mortal. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਹੋਹਿ ਬੈਦ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: raam raae hohi baid banavaaree |
English: O Lord, my King, Gardener of the world-garden, be my Physician,

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੇ ਸੰਤਹ ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: apane santah lehu ubaaree |1| rahaau |
English: and save me, Your Saint. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਾਥੇ ਪੀਰ ਸਰੀਰਿ ਜਲਨਿ ਹੈ ਕਰਕ ਕਰੇਜੇ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: maathe peer sareer jalan hai karak kareje maahee |
English: My head aches, my body is burning, and my heart is filled with anguish.

Gurbani: ਐਸੀ ਬੇਦਨ ਉਪਜਿ ਖਰੀ ਭਈ ਵਾ ਕਾ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aisee bedan upaj kharee bhee vaa kaa aaukhadh naahee |2|
English: Such is the disease that has struck me; there is no medicine to cure it. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਇਹੁ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਜਗਿ ਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam amrit jal niramal ihu aaukhadh jag saaraa |
English: The Name of the Lord, the ambrosial, immaculate water, is the best medicine in the world.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਹੈ ਜਨੁ ਭੀਖਨੁ ਪਾਵਉ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥੩॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur parasaad kahai jan bheekhan paavau mokh duaaraa |3|1|
English: By Guru's Grace, says servant Bheekhan, I have found the Door of Salvation. ||3||1||

[Ang 659 | Raag: Raag Sorath | Author: Bhagat Bheekhan Ji]
Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੁ ਪੁੰਨਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa naam ratan niramolak pun padaarath paaeaa |
English: Such is the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the invaluable jewel, the most sublime wealth, which I have found through good deeds.

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਰਤਨੁ ਨ ਛਪੈ ਛਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: anik jatan kar hiradai raakhiaa ratan na chhapai chhapaaeaa |1|
English: By various efforts, I have enshrined it within my heart; this jewel cannot be hidden by hiding it. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਕਹਤੇ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har gun kahate kehan na jaaee |
English: The Glorious Praises of the Lord cannot be spoken by speaking.

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੇ ਗੂੰਗੇ ਕੀ ਮਿਠਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaise goonge kee mitthiaaee |1| rahaau |
English: They are like the sweet candies given to a mute. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਮਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਨਾ ਚਿਤ ਚੇਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: rasanaa ramat sunat sukh sravanaa chit chete sukh hoee |
English: The tongue speaks, the ears listen, and the mind contemplates the Lord; they find peace and comfort.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਭੀਖਨ ਦੁਇ ਨੈਨ ਸੰਤੋਖੇ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾਂ ਤਹ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥੨॥
Transliteration: kahu bheekhan due nain santokhe jeh dekhaan teh soee |2|2|
English: Says Bheekhan, my eyes are content; wherever I look, there I see the Lord. ||2||2||

[Ang 660 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 1 ghar 1 chaupade |
English: Dhanaasaree, First Mehl, First House, Chau-Padhay:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirbhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibhan gur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਡਰਤੁ ਹੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਉ ਕਰੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: jeeo ddarat hai aapanaa kai siau karee pukaar |
English: My soul is afraid; to whom should I complain?

Gurbani: ਦੂਖ ਵਿਸਾਰਣੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dookh visaaran seviaa sadaa sadaa daataar |1|
English: I serve Him, who makes me forget my pains; He is the Giver, forever and ever. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਨੀਤ ਨਵਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saahib meraa neet navaa sadaa sadaa daataar |1| rahaau |
English: My Lord and Master is forever new; He is the Giver, forever and ever. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਅੰਤਿ ਛਡਾਏ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: anadin saahib seveeai ant chhaddaae soe |
English: Night and day, I serve my Lord and Master; He shall save me in the end.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sun sun meree kaamanee paar utaaraa hoe |2|
English: Hearing and listening, O my dear sister, I have crossed over. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦਇਆਲ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: deaal terai naam taraa |
English: O Merciful Lord, Your Name carries me across.

Gurbani: ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੈ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sad kurabaanai jaau |1| rahaau |
English: I am forever a sacrifice to You. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਰਬੰ ਸਾਚਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: saraban saachaa ek hai doojaa naahee koe |
English: In all the world, there is only the One True Lord; there is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: taa kee sevaa so kare jaa kau nadar kare |3|
English: He alone serves the Lord, upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਾਝੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕੇਵ ਰਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: tudh baajh piaare kev rahaa |
English: Without You, O Beloved, how could I even live?

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਹਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: saa vaddiaaee dehi jit naam tere laag rahaan |
English: Bless me with such greatness, that I may remain attached to Your Name.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਾਇ ਕਹਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: doojaa naahee koe jis aagai piaare jaae kahaa |1| rahaau |
English: There is no other, O Beloved, to whom I can go and speak. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੇਵੀ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਚੰਉ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sevee saahib aapanaa avar na jaachnau koe |
English: I serve my Lord and Master; I ask for no other.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਬਿੰਦ ਬਿੰਦ ਚੁਖ ਚੁਖ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak taa kaa daas hai bind bind chukh chukh hoe |4|
English: Nanak is His slave; moment by moment, bit by bit, he is a sacrifice to Him. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਿੰਦ ਬਿੰਦ ਚੁਖ ਚੁਖ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: saahib tere naam vittahu bind bind chukh chukh hoe |1| rahaau |4|1|
English: O Lord Master, I am a sacrifice to Your Name, moment by moment, bit by bit. ||1||Pause||4||1||

[Ang 660 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 1 |
English: Dhanaasaree, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਆਦਮੀ ਹਾਂ ਇਕ ਦਮੀ ਮੁਹਲਤਿ ਮੁਹਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: ham aadamee haan ik damee muhalat muhat na jaanaa |
English: We are human beings of the briefest moment; we do not know the appointed time of our departure.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬਿਨਵੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਸਰੇਵਹੁ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਪਰਾਣਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak binavai tisai sarevahu jaa ke jeea paraanaa |1|
English: Prays Nanak, serve the One, to whom our soul and breath of life belong. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅੰਧੇ ਜੀਵਨਾ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਕੇ ਦਿਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: andhe jeevanaa veechaar dekh kete ke dinaa |1| rahaau |
English: You are blind - see and consider, how many days your life shall last. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਸੁ ਮਾਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਜੀਉ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਤੂ ਮੈ ਖਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: saas maas sabh jeeo tumaaraa too mai kharaa piaaraa |
English: My breath, my flesh and my soul are all Yours, Lord; You are so very dear to me.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਾਇਰੁ ਏਵ ਕਹਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੇ ਪਰਵਦਗਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak saaeir ev kehat hai sache paravadagaaraa |2|
English: Nanak, the poet, says this, O True Lord Cherisher. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਤੂ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਦੇਹੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਢੈ ਗਹਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: je too kisai na dehee mere saahibaa kiaa ko kadtai gahanaa |
English: If you gave nothing, O my Lord and Master, what could anyone pledge to You?

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬਿਨਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਲਿਖੇ ਕਾ ਲਹਣਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak binavai so kichh paaeeai purab likhe kaa lahanaa |3|
English: Nanak prays, we receive that which we are pre-destined to receive. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਕੀਆ ਕਪਟੀ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: naam khasam kaa chit na keea kapattee kapatt kamaanaa |
English: The deceitful person does not remember the Lord's Name; he practices only deceit.

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਜਾ ਪਕੜਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ਤਾ ਚਲਦਾ ਪਛੁਤਾਣਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jam duaar jaa pakarr chalaaeaa taa chaladaa pachhutaanaa |4|
English: When he is marched in chains to Death's door, then, he regrets his actions. ||4||

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਰਹੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: jab lag duneea raheeai naanak kichh suneeai kichh kaheeai |
English: As long as we are in this world, O Nanak, we should listen, and speak of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਭਾਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਹਮ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੀਵਤਿਆ ਮਰਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੫॥੨॥
Transliteration: bhaal rahe ham rehan na paaeaa jeevatiaa mar raheeai |5|2|
English: I have searched, but I have found no way to remain here; so, remain dead while yet alive. ||5||2||

[Ang 661 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 1 ghar doojaa |
English: Dhanaasaree, First Mehl, Second House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਸਿਮਰੀ ਸਿਵਰਿਆ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kiau simaree sivariaa nahee jaae |
English: How can I remember the Lord in meditation? I cannot meditate on Him in remembrance.

Gurbani: ਤਪੈ ਹਿਆਉ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: tapai hiaau jeearraa bilalaae |
English: My heart is burning, and my soul is crying out in pain.

Gurbani: ਸਿਰਜਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: siraj savaare saachaa soe |
English: The True Lord creates and adorns.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਸਰਿਐ ਚੰਗਾ ਕਿਉ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tis visariai changaa kiau hoe |1|
English: Forgetting Him, how can one be good? ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਿਕਮਤਿ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: hikamat hukam na paaeaa jaae |
English: By clever tricks and commands, He cannot be found.

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਮਿਲਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kiau kar saach milau meree maae |1| rahaau |
English: How am I to meet my True Lord, O my mother? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਵਖਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਖਣ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: vakhar naam dekhan koee jaae |
English: How rare is the one who goes out, and searches for the merchandise of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਚਾਖੈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: naa ko chaakhai naa ko khaae |
English: No one tastes it, and no one eats it.

Gurbani: ਲੋਕਿ ਪਤੀਣੈ ਨਾ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: lok pateenai naa pat hoe |
English: Honor is not obtained by trying to please other people.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਪਤਿ ਰਹੈ ਰਾਖੈ ਜਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: taa pat rahai raakhai jaa soe |2|
English: One's honor is preserved, only if the Lord preserves it. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jeh dekhaa teh rahiaa samaae |
English: Wherever I look, there I see Him, pervading and permeating.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: tudh bin doojee naahee jaae |
English: Without You, I have no other place of rest.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਕੀਤੈ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: je ko kare keetai kiaa hoe |
English: He may try, but what can anyone do by his own doing?

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਖਸੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jis no bakhase saachaa soe |3|
English: He alone is blessed, whom the True Lord forgives. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹੁਣਿ ਉਠਿ ਚਲਣਾ ਮੁਹਤਿ ਕਿ ਤਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: hun utth chalanaa muhat ki taal |
English: Now, I shall have to get up and depart, in an instant, in the clapping of hands.

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਦੇਸਾ ਗੁਣ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa muhu desaa gun nahee naal |
English: What face will I show the Lord? I have no virtue at all.

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤੈਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jaisee nadar kare taisaa hoe |
English: As is the Lord's Glance of Grace, so it is.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
Transliteration: vin nadaree naanak nahee koe |4|1|3|
English: Without His Glance of Grace, O Nanak, no one is blessed. ||4||1||3||

[Ang 661 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 1 |
English: Dhanaasaree, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਸਿਮਰਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: nadar kare taa simariaa jaae |
English: If the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, then one remembers Him in meditation.

Gurbani: ਆਤਮਾ ਦ੍ਰਵੈ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aatamaa dravai rahai liv laae |
English: The soul is softened, and he remains absorbed in the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਆਤਮਾ ਪਰਾਤਮਾ ਏਕੋ ਕਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: aatamaa paraatamaa eko karai |
English: His soul and the Supreme Soul become one.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਰੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: antar kee dubidhaa antar marai |1|
English: The duality of the inner mind is overcome. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee paaeaa jaae |
English: By Guru's Grace, God is found.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har siau chit laagai fir kaal na khaae |1| rahaau |
English: One's consciousness is attached to the Lord, and so Death does not devour him. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਚਿ ਸਿਮਰਿਐ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: sach simariai hovai paragaas |
English: Remembering the True Lord in meditation, one is enlightened.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਹਿ ਰਹੈ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: taa te bikhiaa meh rahai udaas |
English: Then, in the midst of Maya, he remains detached.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਐਸੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur kee aisee vaddiaaee |
English: Such is the Glory of the True Guru;

Gurbani: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਵਿਚੇ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: putr kalatr viche gat paaee |2|
English: in the midst of children and spouses, they attain emancipation. ||2||

Gurbani: ਐਸੀ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: aisee sevak sevaa karai |
English: Such is the service which the Lord's servant performs,

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਜੀਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਧਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: jis kaa jeeo tis aagai dharai |
English: that he dedicates his soul to the Lord, to whom it belongs.

Gurbani: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: saahib bhaavai so paravaan |
English: One who is pleasing to the Lord and Master is acceptable.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਣੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: so sevak daragah paavai maan |3|
English: Such a servant obtains honor in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: satigur kee moorat hiradai vasaae |
English: He enshrines the image of the True Guru in his heart.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਇਛੈ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jo ichhai soee fal paae |
English: He obtains the rewards which he desires.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: saachaa saahib kirapaa karai |
English: The True Lord and Master grants His Grace;

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਕੈਸਾ ਡਰੈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: so sevak jam te kaisaa ddarai |4|
English: how can such a servant be afraid of death? ||4||

Gurbani: ਭਨਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: bhanat naanak kare veechaar |
English: Prays Nanak, practice contemplation,

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਿਉ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: saachee baanee siau dhare piaar |
English: and enshrine love for the True Word of His Bani.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੋ ਪਾਵੈ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: taa ko paavai mokh duaar |
English: Then, you shall find the Gate of Salvation.

Gurbani: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸਭੁ ਇਹੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੫॥੨॥੪॥
Transliteration: jap tap sabh ihu sabad hai saar |5|2|4|
English: This Shabad is the most excellent of all chanting and austere meditations. ||5||2||4||

[Ang 661 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 1 |
English: Dhanaasaree, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਤਪਤੁ ਹੈ ਬਾਰੋ ਬਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: jeeo tapat hai baaro baar |
English: My soul burns, over and over again.

Gurbani: ਤਪਿ ਤਪਿ ਖਪੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬੇਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: tap tap khapai bahut bekaar |
English: Burning and burning, it is ruined, and it falls into evil.

Gurbani: ਜੈ ਤਨਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jai tan baanee visar jaae |
English: That body, which forgets the Word of the Guru's Bani,

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਪਕਾ ਰੋਗੀ ਵਿਲਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jiau pakaa rogee vilalaae |1|
English: cries out in pain, like a chronic patient. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਹੁਤਾ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਝਖਣੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bahutaa bolan jhakhan hoe |
English: To speak too much and babble is useless.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਬੋਲੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: vin bole jaanai sabh soe |1| rahaau |
English: Even without our speaking, He knows everything. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਨ ਕੀਤੇ ਅਖੀ ਨਾਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: jin kan keete akhee naak |
English: He created our ears, eyes and nose.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਦਿਤੀ ਬੋਲੇ ਤਾਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: jin jihavaa ditee bole taat |
English: He gave us our tongue to speak so fluently.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਅਗਨੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jin man raakhiaa aganee paae |
English: He preserved the mind in the fire of the womb;

Gurbani: ਵਾਜੈ ਪਵਣੁ ਆਖੈ ਸਭ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: vaajai pavan aakhai sabh jaae |2|
English: at His Command, the wind blows everywhere. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੇਤਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਪਰੀਤਿ ਸੁਆਦ ॥
Transliteration: jetaa mohu pareet suaad |
English: These worldly attachments, loves and pleasurable tastes,

Gurbani: ਸਭਾ ਕਾਲਖ ਦਾਗਾ ਦਾਗ ॥
Transliteration: sabhaa kaalakh daagaa daag |
English: all are just black stains.

Gurbani: ਦਾਗ ਦੋਸ ਮੁਹਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: daag dos muhi chaliaa laae |
English: One who departs, with these black stains of sin on his face

Gurbani: ਦਰਗਹ ਬੈਸਣ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: daragah baisan naahee jaae |3|
English: shall find no place to sit in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਆਖਣੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: karam milai aakhan teraa naau |
English: By Your Grace, we chant Your Name.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਲਗਿ ਤਰਣਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਥਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jit lag taranaa hor nahee thaau |
English: Becoming attached to it, one is saved; there is no other way.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਡੂਬੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: je ko ddoobai fir hovai saar |
English: Even if one is drowning, still, he may be saved.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਰਬ ਦਾਤਾਰ ॥੪॥੩॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak saachaa sarab daataar |4|3|5|
English: O Nanak, the True Lord is the Giver of all. ||4||3||5||

[Ang 662 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 1 |
English: Dhanaasaree, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਚੋਰੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਚੀਤੁ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: chor salaahe cheet na bheejai |
English: If a thief praises someone, his mind is not pleased.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਬਦੀ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਤਸੂ ਨ ਛੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: je badee kare taa tasoo na chheejai |
English: If a thief curses him, no damage is done.

Gurbani: ਚੋਰ ਕੀ ਹਾਮਾ ਭਰੇ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: chor kee haamaa bhare na koe |
English: No one will take responsibility for a thief.

Gurbani: ਚੋਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਚੰਗਾ ਕਿਉ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: chor keea changaa kiau hoe |1|
English: How can a thief's actions be good? ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਅੰਧੇ ਕੁਤੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ॥
Transliteration: sun man andhe kute koorriaar |
English: Listen, O mind, you blind, false dog!

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੋਲੇ ਬੂਝੀਐ ਸਚਿਆਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bin bole boojheeai sachiaar |1| rahaau |
English: Even without your speaking, the Lord knows and understands. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਚੋਰੁ ਸੁਆਲਿਉ ਚੋਰੁ ਸਿਆਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: chor suaaliau chor siaanaa |
English: A thief may be handsome, and a thief may be wise,

Gurbani: ਖੋਟੇ ਕਾ ਮੁਲੁ ਏਕੁ ਦੁਗਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: khotte kaa mul ek dugaanaa |
English: but he is still just a counterfeit coin, worth only a shell.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਸਾਥਿ ਰਖੀਐ ਦੀਜੈ ਰਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: je saath rakheeai deejai ralaae |
English: If it is kept and mixed with other coins,

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਪਰਖੀਐ ਖੋਟਾ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jaa parakheeai khottaa hoe jaae |2|
English: it will be found to be false, when the coins are inspected. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੈਸਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਤੈਸਾ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jaisaa kare su taisaa paavai |
English: As one acts, so does he receive.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਬੀਜਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਖਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: aap beej aape hee khaavai |
English: As he plants, so does he eat.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਆਪੇ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: je vaddiaaeea aape khaae |
English: He may praise himself gloriously,

Gurbani: ਜੇਹੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਤੇਹੈ ਰਾਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jehee surat tehai raeh jaae |3|
English: but still, according to his understanding, so is the path he must follow. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਕੂੜੀਆ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਬਾੜੁ ॥
Transliteration: je sau koorreea koorr kabaarr |
English: He may tell hundreds of lies to conceal his falsehood,

Gurbani: ਭਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਆਖਉ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: bhaavai sabh aakhau sansaar |
English: and all the world may call him good.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਅਧੀ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: tudh bhaavai adhee paravaan |
English: If it pleases You, Lord, even the foolish are approved.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਾਣੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੪॥੬॥
Transliteration: naanak jaanai jaan sujaan |4|4|6|
English: O Nanak, the Lord is wise, knowing, all-knowing. ||4||4||6||

[Ang 662 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 1 |
English: Dhanaasaree, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਮਨੁ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa kaagad man paravaanaa |
English: The body is the paper, and the mind is the inscription written upon it.

Gurbani: ਸਿਰ ਕੇ ਲੇਖ ਨ ਪੜੈ ਇਆਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: sir ke lekh na parrai eaanaa |
English: The ignorant fool does not read what is written on his forehead.

Gurbani: ਦਰਗਹ ਘੜੀਅਹਿ ਤੀਨੇ ਲੇਖ ॥
Transliteration: daragah gharreeeh teene lekh |
English: In the Court of the Lord, three inscriptions are recorded.

Gurbani: ਖੋਟਾ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਵੇਖੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: khottaa kaam na aavai vekh |1|
English: Behold, the counterfeit coin is worthless there. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਰੁਪਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak je vich rupaa hoe |
English: O Nanak, if there is silver in it,

Gurbani: ਖਰਾ ਖਰਾ ਆਖੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kharaa kharaa aakhai sabh koe |1| rahaau |
English: then everyone proclaims, "It is genuine, it is genuine." ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਾਦੀ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਮਲੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kaadee koorr bol mal khaae |
English: The Qazi tells lies and eats filth;

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜੀਆ ਘਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: braahaman naavai jeea ghaae |
English: the Brahmin kills and then takes cleansing baths.

Gurbani: ਜੋਗੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਅੰਧੁ ॥
Transliteration: jogee jugat na jaanai andh |
English: The Yogi is blind, and does not know the Way.

Gurbani: ਤੀਨੇ ਓਜਾੜੇ ਕਾ ਬੰਧੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: teene ojaarre kaa bandh |2|
English: The three of them devise their own destruction. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਜੋਗੀ ਜੋ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: so jogee jo jugat pachhaanai |
English: He alone is a Yogi, who understands the Way.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee eko jaanai |
English: By Guru's Grace, he knows the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਾਜੀ ਸੋ ਜੋ ਉਲਟੀ ਕਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: kaajee so jo ulattee karai |
English: He alone is a Qazi, who turns away from the world,

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee jeevat marai |
English: and who, by Guru's Grace, remains dead while yet alive.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਜੋ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: so braahaman jo braham beechaarai |
English: He alone is a Brahmin, who contemplates God.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aap tarai sagale kul taarai |3|
English: He saves himself, and saves all his generations as well. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦਾਨਸਬੰਦੁ ਸੋਈ ਦਿਲਿ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: daanasaband soee dil dhovai |
English: One who cleanses his own mind is wise.

Gurbani: ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੁ ਸੋਈ ਮਲੁ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: musalamaan soee mal khovai |
English: One who cleanses himself of impurity is a Muslim.

Gurbani: ਪੜਿਆ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: parriaa boojhai so paravaan |
English: One who reads and understands is acceptable.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਕਾ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੫॥੭॥
Transliteration: jis sir daragah kaa neesaan |4|5|7|
English: Upon his forehead is the Insignia of the Court of the Lord. ||4||5||7||

[Ang 662 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 1 ghar 3 |
English: Dhanaasaree, First Mehl, Third House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਕਾਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਜੋਗੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਤ ਕਾ ਢਬੁ ॥
Transliteration: kaal naahee jog naahee naahee sat kaa dtab |
English: No, no, this is not the time, when people know the way to Yoga and Truth.

Gurbani: ਥਾਨਸਟ ਜਗ ਭਰਿਸਟ ਹੋਏ ਡੂਬਤਾ ਇਵ ਜਗੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: thaanasatt jag bharisatt hoe ddoobataa iv jag |1|
English: The holy places of worship in the world are polluted, and so the world is drowning. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਲ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: kal meh raam naam saar |
English: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Lord's Name is the most sublime.

Gurbani: ਅਖੀ ਤ ਮੀਟਹਿ ਨਾਕ ਪਕੜਹਿ ਠਗਣ ਕਉ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: akhee ta meetteh naak pakarreh tthagan kau sansaar |1| rahaau |
English: Some people try to deceive the world by closing their eyes and holding their nostrils closed. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਂਟ ਸੇਤੀ ਨਾਕੁ ਪਕੜਹਿ ਸੂਝਤੇ ਤਿਨਿ ਲੋਅ ॥
Transliteration: aantt setee naak pakarreh soojhate tin loa |
English: They close off their nostrils with their fingers, and claim to see the three worlds.

Gurbani: ਮਗਰ ਪਾਛੈ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਏਹੁ ਪਦਮੁ ਅਲੋਅ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: magar paachhai kachh na soojhai ehu padam aloa |2|
English: But they cannot even see what is behind them. What a strange lotus pose this is! ||2||

Gurbani: ਖਤ੍ਰੀਆ ਤ ਧਰਮੁ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਮਲੇਛ ਭਾਖਿਆ ਗਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: khatreea ta dharam chhoddiaa malechh bhaakhiaa gahee |
English: The K'shatriyas have abandoned their religion, and have adopted a foreign language.

Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਇਕ ਵਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਧਰਮ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਰਹੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: srisatt sabh ik varan hoee dharam kee gat rahee |3|
English: The whole world has been reduced to the same social status; the state of righteousness and Dharma has been lost. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅਸਟ ਸਾਜ ਸਾਜਿ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਸੋਧਹਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੇਦ ਅਭਿਆਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: asatt saaj saaj puraan sodheh kareh bed abhiaas |
English: They analyze eight chapters of (Panini's) grammar and the Puraanas. They study the Vedas,

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੬॥੮॥
Transliteration: bin naam har ke mukat naahee kahai naanak daas |4|1|6|8|
English: but without the Lord's Name, no one is liberated; so says Nanak, the Lord's slave. ||4||1||6||8||

[Ang 663 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਆਰਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 1 aaratee |
English: Dhanaasaree, First Mehl, Aartee:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਗਗਨ ਮੈ ਥਾਲੁ ਰਵਿ ਚੰਦੁ ਦੀਪਕ ਬਨੇ ਤਾਰਿਕਾ ਮੰਡਲ ਜਨਕ ਮੋਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: gagan mai thaal rav chand deepak bane taarikaa manddal janak motee |
English: In the bowl of the sky, the sun and moon are the lamps; the stars in the constellations are the pearls.

Gurbani: ਧੂਪੁ ਮਲਆਨਲੋ ਪਵਣੁ ਚਵਰੋ ਕਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਬਨਰਾਇ ਫੂਲੰਤ ਜੋਤੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dhoop malaanalo pavan chavaro kare sagal banaraae foolant jotee |1|
English: The fragrance of sandalwood is the incense, the wind is the fan, and all the vegetation are flowers in offering to You, O Luminous Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕੈਸੀ ਆਰਤੀ ਹੋਇ ਭਵ ਖੰਡਨਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਰਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: kaisee aaratee hoe bhav khanddanaa teree aaratee |
English: What a beautiful lamp-lit worship service this is! O Destroyer of fear, this is Your Aartee, Your worship service.

Gurbani: ਅਨਹਤਾ ਸਬਦ ਵਾਜੰਤ ਭੇਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: anahataa sabad vaajant bheree |1| rahaau |
English: The sound current of the Shabad is the sounding of the temple drums. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਹਸ ਤਵ ਨੈਨ ਨਨ ਨੈਨ ਹੈ ਤੋਹਿ ਕਉ ਸਹਸ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਨਨਾ ਏਕ ਤੋਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: sehas tav nain nan nain hai tohi kau sehas moorat nanaa ek tohee |
English: Thousands are Your eyes, and yet You have no eyes. Thousands are Your forms, and yet You have not even one form.

Gurbani: ਸਹਸ ਪਦ ਬਿਮਲ ਨਨ ਏਕ ਪਦ ਗੰਧ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਹਸ ਤਵ ਗੰਧ ਇਵ ਚਲਤ ਮੋਹੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sehas pad bimal nan ek pad gandh bin sehas tav gandh iv chalat mohee |2|
English: Thousands are Your lotus feet, and yet You have no feet. Without a nose, thousands are Your noses. I am enchanted with Your play! ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਹੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabh meh jot jot hai soe |
English: The Divine Light is within everyone; You are that Light.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਚਾਨਣਿ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: tis kai chaanan sabh meh chaanan hoe |
English: Yours is that Light which shines within everyone.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸਾਖੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur saakhee jot paragatt hoe |
English: By the Guru's Teachings, this Divine Light is revealed.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਆਰਤੀ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jo tis bhaavai su aaratee hoe |3|
English: That which pleases the Lord is the true worship service. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਲੋਭਿਤ ਮਨੋ ਅਨਦਿਨੋ ਮੋਹਿ ਆਹੀ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: har charan kamal makarand lobhit mano anadino mohi aahee piaasaa |
English: My soul is enticed by the honey-sweet lotus feet of the Lord; night and day, I thirst for them.

Gurbani: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਜਲੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਰਿੰਗ ਕਉ ਹੋਇ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੭॥੯॥
Transliteration: kripaa jal dehi naanak saaring kau hoe jaa te terai naam vaasaa |4|1|7|9|
English: Bless Nanak, the thirsty song-bird, with the water of Your Mercy, that he may come to dwell in Your Name. ||4||1||7||9||

[Ang 663 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 3 ghar 2 chaupade |
English: Dhanaasaree, Third Mehl, Second House, Chau-Padhay:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ਨ ਨਿਖੁਟੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: eihu dhan akhutt na nikhuttai na jaae |
English: This wealth is inexhaustible. It shall never be exhausted, and it shall never be lost.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: poorai satigur deea dikhaae |
English: The Perfect True Guru has revealed it to me.

Gurbani: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: apune satigur kau sad bal jaaee |
English: I am forever a sacrifice to my True Guru.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur kirapaa te har man vasaaee |1|
English: By Guru's Grace, I have enshrined the Lord within my mind. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਧਨਵੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: se dhanavant har naam liv laae |
English: They alone are wealthy, who lovingly attune themselves to the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur poorai har dhan paragaasiaa har kirapaa te vasai man aae | rahaau |
English: The Perfect Guru has revealed to me the Lord's treasure; by the Lord's Grace, it has come to abide in my mind. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਵਗੁਣ ਕਾਟਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: avagun kaatt gun ridai samaae |
English: He is rid of his demerits, and his heart is permeated with merit and virtue.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: poore gur kai sehaj subhaae |
English: By Guru's Grace, he naturally dwells in celestial peace.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: poore gur kee saachee baanee |
English: True is the Word of the Perfect Guru's Bani.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sukh man antar sehaj samaanee |2|
English: They bring peace to the mind, and celestial peace is absorbed within. ||2||

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਜਨ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ek acharaj jan dekhahu bhaaee |
English: O my humble Siblings of Destiny, behold this strange and wonderful thing:

Gurbani: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: dubidhaa maar har man vasaaee |
English: duality is overcome, and the Lord dwells within his mind.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: naam amolak na paaeaa jaae |
English: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is priceless; it cannot be taken.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur parasaad vasai man aae |3|
English: By Guru's Grace, it comes to abide in the mind. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਸੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabh meh vasai prabh eko soe |
English: He is the One God, abiding within all.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਘਟਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramatee ghatt paragatt hoe |
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, He is revealed in the heart.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣਿ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sahaje jin prabh jaan pachhaaniaa |
English: One who intuitively knows and realizes God,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak naam milai man maaniaa |4|1|
English: O Nanak, obtains the Naam; his mind is pleased and appeased. ||4||1||

[Ang 664 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 3 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਅਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har naam dhan niramal at apaaraa |
English: The wealth of the Lord's Name is immaculate, and absolutely infinite.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad bhare bhanddaaraa |
English: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is over-flowing with treasure.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਧਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਹੋਰ ਸਭ ਬਿਖੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: naam dhan bin hor sabh bikh jaan |
English: Know that, except for the wealth of the Name, all other wealth is poison.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਜਲੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohi jalai abhimaan |1|
English: The egotistical people are burning in their attachment to Maya. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh har ras chaakhai koe |
English: How rare is that Gurmukh who tastes the sublime essence of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tis sadaa anand hovai din raatee poorai bhaag paraapat hoe | rahaau |
English: He is always in bliss, day and night; through perfect good destiny, he obtains the Name. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੁ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabad deepak varatai tihu loe |
English: The Word of the Shabad is a lamp, illuminating the three worlds.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਚਾਖੈ ਸੋ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jo chaakhai so niramal hoe |
English: One who tastes it, becomes immaculate.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: niramal naam haumai mal dhoe |
English: The immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord, washes off the filth of ego.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saachee bhagat sadaa sukh hoe |2|
English: True devotional worship brings lasting peace. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਲੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: jin har ras chaakhiaa so har jan log |
English: One who tastes the sublime essence of the Lord is the Lord's humble servant.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਦੇ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: tis sadaa harakh naahee kade sog |
English: He is forever happy; he is never sad.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਅਵਰਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਕਰਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: aap mukat avaraa mukat karaavai |
English: He himself is liberated, and he liberates others as well.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਹਰਿ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har naam japai har te sukh paavai |3|
English: He chants the Lord's Name, and through the Lord, he finds peace. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਭ ਮੁਈ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin satigur sabh muee bilalaae |
English: Without the True Guru, everyone dies, crying out in pain.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਦਾਝਹਿ ਸਾਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: anadin daajheh saat na paae |
English: Night and day, they burn, and find no peace.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਭੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: satigur milai sabh trisan bujhaae |
English: But meeting the True Guru, all thirst is quenched.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naam saant sukh paae |4|2|
English: O Nanak, through the Naam, one finds peace and tranquility. ||4||2||

[Ang 664 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 3 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਧਨੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa dhan antar naam samaale |
English: Gather in and cherish forever the wealth of the Lord's Name, deep within;

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਜਿਨਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jant jineh pratipaale |
English: He cherishes and nurtures all beings and creatures.

Gurbani: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: mukat padaarath tin kau paae |
English: They alone obtain the treasure of Liberation,

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har kai naam rate liv laae |1|
English: who are lovingly imbued with, and focused on the Lord's Name. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur sevaa te har naam dhan paavai |
English: Serving the Guru, one obtains the wealth of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: antar paragaas har naam dhiaavai | rahaau |
English: He is illumined and enlightened within, and he meditates on the Lord's Name. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਗੂੜਾ ਧਨ ਪਿਰ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: eihu har rang goorraa dhan pir hoe |
English: This love for the Lord is like the love of the bride for her husband.

Gurbani: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: saant seegaar raave prabh soe |
English: God ravishes and enjoys the soul-bride who is adorned with peace and tranquility.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: haumai vich prabh koe na paae |
English: No one finds God through egotism.

Gurbani: ਮੂਲਹੁ ਭੁਲਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: moolahu bhulaa janam gavaae |2|
English: Wandering away from the Primal Lord, the root of all, one wastes his life in vain. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਾਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur te saat sehaj sukh baanee |
English: Tranquility, celestial peace, pleasure and the Word of His Bani come from the Guru.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਾ ਸਾਚੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: sevaa saachee naam samaanee |
English: True is that service, which leads one to merge in the Naam.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: sabad milai preetam sadaa dhiaae |
English: Blessed with the Word of the Shabad, he meditates forever on the Lord, the Beloved.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: saach naam vaddiaaee paae |3|
English: Through the True Name, glorious greatness is obtained. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aape karataa jug jug soe |
English: The Creator Himself abides throughout the ages.

Gurbani: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: nadar kare melaavaa hoe |
English: If He casts His Glance of Grace, then we meet Him.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gurabaanee te har man vasaae |
English: Through the Word of Gurbani, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੪॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak saach rate prabh aap milaae |4|3|
English: O Nanak, God unites with Himself those who are imbued with Truth. ||4||3||

[Ang 664 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਤੀਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 3 teejaa |
English: Dhanaasaree, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਗੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਮੈਲੋ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jag mailaa mailo hoe jaae |
English: The world is polluted, and those in the world become polluted as well.

Gurbani: ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਦੂਜੈ ਲੋਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aavai jaae doojai lobhaae |
English: In attachment to duality, it comes and goes.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਸਭ ਪਰਜ ਵਿਗੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: doojai bhaae sabh paraj vigoee |
English: This love of duality has ruined the entire world.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਇ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: manamukh chottaa khaae apunee pat khoee |1|
English: The self-willed manmukh suffers punishment, and forfeits his honor. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur sevaa te jan niramal hoe |
English: Serving the Guru, one becomes immaculate.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਪਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: antar naam vasai pat aootam hoe | rahaau |
English: He enshrines the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within, and his state becomes exalted. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਬਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh ubare har saranaaee |
English: The Gurmukhs are saved, taking to the Lord's Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam raate bhagat drirraaee |
English: Attuned to the Lord's Name, they commit themselves to devotional worship.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਨੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat kare jan vaddiaaee paae |
English: The Lord's humble servant performs devotional worship, and is blessed with greatness.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saach rate sukh sehaj samaae |2|
English: Attuned to Truth, he is absorbed in celestial peace. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੇ ਕਾ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: saache kaa gaahak viralaa ko jaan |
English: Know that one who purchases the True Name is very rare.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad aap pachhaan |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he comes to understand himself.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੀ ਰਾਸਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: saachee raas saachaa vaapaar |
English: True is his capital, and true is his trade.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਧੰਨੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: so dhan purakh jis naam piaar |3|
English: Blessed is that person, who loves the Naam. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਇਕਿ ਸਚਿ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: tin prabh saachai ik sach laae |
English: God, the True Lord, has attached some to His True Name.

Gurbani: ਊਤਮ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aootam baanee sabad sunaae |
English: They listen to the most sublime Word of His Bani, and the Word of His Shabad.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੀ ਸਾਚੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: prabh saache kee saachee kaar |
English: True is service to the True Lord God.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰ ॥੪॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak naam savaaranahaar |4|4|
English: O Nanak, the Naam is the Embellisher. ||4||4||

[Ang 665 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 3 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo har seveh tin bal jaau |
English: I am a sacrifice to those who serve the Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tin hiradai saach sachaa mukh naau |
English: The Truth is in their hearts, and the True Name is on their lips.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੋ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਮਾਲਿਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: saacho saach samaalihu dukh jaae |
English: Dwelling upon the Truest of the True, their pains are dispelled.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saachai sabad vasai man aae |1|
English: Through the True Word of the Shabad, the Lord comes to dwell in their minds. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gurabaanee sun mail gavaae |
English: Listening to the Word of Gurbani, filth is washed off,

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sahaje har naam man vasaae |1| rahaau |
English: and they naturally enshrine the Lord's Name in their minds. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਸਤੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: koorr kusat trisanaa agan bujhaae |
English: One who conquers fraud, deceit and the fire of desire

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: antar saant sehaj sukh paae |
English: finds tranquility, peace and pleasure within.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲੈ ਤਾ ਆਪੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai bhaanai chalai taa aap jaae |
English: If one walks in harmony with the Guru's Will, he eliminates his self-conceit.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saach mehal paae har gun gaae |2|
English: He finds the True Mansion of the Lord's Presence, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: n sabad boojhai na jaanai baanee |
English: The blind, self-willed manmukh does not understand the Shabad; he does not know the Word of the Guru's Bani,

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧੇ ਦੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh andhe dukh vihaanee |
English: and so he passes his life in misery.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: satigur bhette taa sukh paae |
English: But if he meets the True Guru, then he finds peace,

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: haumai vichahu tthaak rahaae |3|
English: and the ego within is silenced. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਦਾਤਾ ਇਕੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: kis no kaheeai daataa ik soe |
English: Who else should I speak to? The One Lord is the Giver of all.

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: kirapaa kare sabad milaavaa hoe |
English: When He grants His Grace, then we obtain the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: mil preetam saache gun gaavaa |
English: Meeting with my Beloved, I sing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਭਾਵਾ ॥੪॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak saache saachaa bhaavaa |4|5|
English: O Nanak, becoming truthful, I have become pleasing to the True Lord. ||4||5||

[Ang 665 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 3 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਮਰੈ ਧਾਤੁ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man marai dhaat mar jaae |
English: When the mind is conquered, its turbulent wanderings are stopped.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਮਨ ਮੂਏ ਕੈਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin man mooe kaise har paae |
English: Without conquering the mind, how can the Lord be found?

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਰੈ ਦਾਰੂ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: eihu man marai daaroo jaanai koe |
English: Rare is the one who knows the medicine to conquer the mind.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: man sabad marai boojhai jan soe |1|
English: The mind is conquered through the Word of the Shabad; this is known to the Lord's humble servant. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਖਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: jis no bakhase har de vaddiaaee |
English: The Lord forgives him, and blesses him with glory.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaad vasai man aaee | rahaau |
English: By Guru's Grace, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh karanee kaar kamaavai |
English: The Gurmukh does good deeds,

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: taa is man kee sojhee paavai |
English: and so, he comes to understand this mind.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਮੈ ਮਤੁ ਮੈਗਲ ਮਿਕਦਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: man mai mat maigal mikadaaraa |
English: The mind is intoxicated, like the elephant with wine.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਅੰਕਸੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur ankas maar jeevaalanahaaraa |2|
English: The Guru places the harness upon it, and rejuvenates it. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਅਸਾਧੁ ਸਾਧੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: man asaadh saadhai jan koee |
English: The mind is undisciplined; only a rare few can discipline it.

Gurbani: ਅਚਰੁ ਚਰੈ ਤਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: achar charai taa niramal hoee |
English: If someone eats the uneatable, then he becomes immaculate.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਇਆ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh ihu man leaa savaar |
English: As Gurmukh, his mind is embellished.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਤਜੈ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: haumai vichahu tajai vikaar |3|
English: Egotism and corruption are eradicated from within. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਰਖਿਅਨੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jo dhur rakhian mel milaae |
English: Those whom the Primal Lord keeps united in His Union,

Gurbani: ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kade na vichhurreh sabad samaae |
English: shall never be separated from Him; they are merged in the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਆਪਣੀ ਕਲਾ ਆਪੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: aapanee kalaa aape prabh jaanai |
English: Only God Himself knows His own power.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੪॥੬॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh naam pachhaanai |4|6|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh realizes the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||6||

[Ang 665 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 3 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਾਚਾ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਗਾਵਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: kaachaa dhan sancheh moorakh gaavaar |
English: The ignorant fools amass false wealth.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭੂਲੇ ਅੰਧ ਗਾਵਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh bhoole andh gaavaar |
English: The blind, foolish, self-willed manmukhs have gone astray.

Gurbani: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕੈ ਧਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bikhiaa kai dhan sadaa dukh hoe |
English: Poisonous wealth brings constant pain.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਸਾਥਿ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naa saath jaae na paraapat hoe |1|
English: It will not go with you, and it will not yield any profit. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਾ ਧਨੁ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: saachaa dhan guramatee paae |
English: True wealth is obtained through the Guru's Teachings.

Gurbani: ਕਾਚਾ ਧਨੁ ਫੁਨਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਏ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kaachaa dhan fun aavai jaae | rahaau |
English: False wealth continues coming and going. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਸਭਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh bhoole sabh mareh gavaar |
English: The foolish self-willed manmukhs all go astray and die.

Gurbani: ਭਵਜਲਿ ਡੂਬੇ ਨ ਉਰਵਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: bhavajal ddoobe na uravaar na paar |
English: They drown in the terrifying world-ocean, and they cannot reach either this shore, or the one beyond.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: satigur bhette poorai bhaag |
English: But by perfect destiny, they meet the True Guru;

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਬੈਰਾਗਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saach rate ahinis bairaag |2|
English: imbued with the True Name, day and night, they remain detached from the world. ||2||

Gurbani: ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: chahu jug meh amrit saachee baanee |
English: Throughout the four ages, the True Bani of His Word is Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: poorai bhaag har naam samaanee |
English: By perfect destiny, one is absorbed in the True Name.

Gurbani: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਤਰਸਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਲੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sidh saadhik taraseh sabh loe |
English: The Siddhas, the seekers and all men long for the Name.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: poorai bhaag paraapat hoe |3|
English: It is obtained only by perfect destiny. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਹੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh saachaa saachaa hai soe |
English: The True Lord is everything; He is True.

Gurbani: ਊਤਮ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aootam braham pachhaanai koe |
English: Only a few realize the exalted Lord God.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਆਪਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sach saachaa sach aap drirraae |
English: He is the Truest of the True; He Himself implants the True Name within.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਆਪੇ ਸਚਿ ਲਾਏ ॥੪॥੭॥
Transliteration: naanak aape vekhai aape sach laae |4|7|
English: O Nanak, the Lord Himself sees all; He Himself links us to the Truth. ||4||7||

[Ang 666 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 3 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: naavai kee keemat mit kahee na jaae |
English: The value and worth of the Lord's Name cannot be described.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਿਨ ਇਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: se jan dhan jin ik naam liv laae |
English: Blessed are those humble beings, who lovingly focus their minds on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramat saachee saachaa veechaar |
English: True are the Guru's Teachings, and True is contemplative meditation.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਦੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aape bakhase de veechaar |1|
English: God Himself forgives, and bestows contemplative meditation. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: har naam acharaj prabh aap sunaae |
English: The Lord's Name is wonderful! God Himself imparts it.

Gurbani: ਕਲੀ ਕਾਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kalee kaal vich guramukh paae |1| rahaau |
English: In the Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Gurmukhs obtain it. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੂਰਖ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: ham moorakh moorakh man maeh |
English: We are ignorant; ignorance fills our minds.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਭ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: haumai vich sabh kaar kamaeh |
English: We do all our deeds in ego.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹੰਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee hnaumai jaae |
English: By Guru's Grace, egotism is eradicated.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aape bakhase le milaae |2|
English: Forgiving us, the Lord blends us with Himself. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕਾ ਧਨੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: bikhiaa kaa dhan bahut abhimaan |
English: Poisonous wealth gives rise to great arrogance.

Gurbani: ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਡੂਬੈ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: ahankaar ddoobai na paavai maan |
English: Drowning in egotism, no one is honored.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aap chhodd sadaa sukh hoee |
English: Forsaking self-conceit, one finds lasting peace.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: guramat saalaahee sach soee |3|
English: Under Guru's Instruction, he praises the True Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਜੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aape saaje karataa soe |
English: The Creator Lord Himself fashions all.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: tis bin doojaa avar na koe |
English: Without Him, there is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਚਿ ਲਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: jis sach laae soee laagai |
English: He alone is attached to Truth, whom the Lord Himself so attaches.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਆਗੈ ॥੪॥੮॥
Transliteration: naanak naam sadaa sukh aagai |4|8|
English: O Nanak, through the Naam, lasting peace is attained in the hereafter. ||4||8||

[Ang 666 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਧਨਾਸਿਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: raag dhanaasiree mahalaa 3 ghar 4 |
English: Raag Dhanaasaree, Third Mehl, Fourth House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਭੀਖਕ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਨਿਜ ਪਤਿ ਹੈ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: ham bheekhak bhekhaaree tere too nij pat hai daataa |
English: I am just a poor beggar of Yours; You are Your Own Lord Master, You are the Great Giver.

Gurbani: ਹੋਹੁ ਦੈਆਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਮੰਗਤ ਜਨ ਕੰਉ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਉ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: hohu daiaal naam dehu mangat jan knau sadaa rhau rang raataa |1|
English: Be Merciful, and bless me, a humble beggar, with Your Name, so that I may forever remain imbued with Your Love. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹੰਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ਸਾਚੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: hnau balihaarai jaau saache tere naam vittahu |
English: I am a sacrifice to Your Name, O True Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਏਕੋ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: karan kaaran sabhanaa kaa eko avar na doojaa koee |1| rahaau |
English: The One Lord is the Cause of causes; there is no other at all. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਹੁਤੇ ਫੇਰ ਪਏ ਕਿਰਪਨ ਕਉ ਅਬ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: bahute fer pe kirapan kau ab kichh kirapaa keejai |
English: I was wretched; I wandered through so many cycles of reincarnation. Now, Lord, please bless me with Your Grace.

Gurbani: ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਐਸੀ ਬਖਸ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: hohu deaal darasan dehu apunaa aisee bakhas kareejai |2|
English: Be merciful, and grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; please grant me such a gift. ||2||

Gurbani: ਭਨਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਰਮ ਪਟ ਖੂਲੑੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: bhanat naanak bharam patt khoolae gur parasaadee jaaniaa |
English: Prays Nanak, the shutters of doubt have been opened wide; by Guru's Grace, I have come to know the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਹੈ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੩॥੧॥੯॥
Transliteration: saachee liv laagee hai bheetar satigur siau man maaniaa |3|1|9|
English: I am filled to overflowing with true love; my mind is pleased and appeased by the True Guru. ||3||1||9||

[Ang 666 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 4 ghar 1 chaupade |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehl, First House, Chau-Padhay:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਭਗਤ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਪ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jo har seveh sant bhagat tin ke sabh paap nivaaree |
English: Those Saints and devotees who serve the Lord have all their sins washed away.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਖੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਤੁਮ ਜੁ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ham aoopar kirapaa kar suaamee rakh sangat tum ju piaaree |1|
English: Have Mercy on me, O Lord and Master, and keep me in the Sangat, the Congregation that You love. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: har gun keh na skau banavaaree |
English: I cannot even speak the Praises of the Lord, the Gardener of the world.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਪਾਥਰ ਨੀਰਿ ਡੁਬਤ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਾਖਣ ਹਮ ਤਾਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ham paapee paathar neer ddubat kar kirapaa paakhan ham taaree | rahaau |
English: We are sinners, sinking like stones in water; grant Your Grace, and carry us stones across. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਲਾਗੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਮੋਰਚਾ ਲਗਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: janam janam ke laage bikh morachaa lag sangat saadh savaaree |
English: The rust of poison and corruption from countless incarnations sticks to us; joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, it is cleaned away.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਬੈਸੰਤਰਿ ਤਾਇਓ ਮਲੁ ਕਾਟੀ ਕਟਿਤ ਉਤਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jiau kanchan baisantar taaeo mal kaattee kattit utaaree |2|
English: It is just like gold, which is heated in the fire, to remove the impurities from it. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨੁ ਜਪਉ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: har har japan jpau din raatee jap har har har ur dhaaree |
English: I chant the chant of the Name of the Lord, day and night; I chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, and enshrine it within my heart.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਜਗਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har har har aaukhadh jag pooraa jap har har haumai maaree |3|
English: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, is the most perfect medicine in this world; chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I have conquered my ego. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਪਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: har har agam agaadh bodh aparanpar purakh apaaree |
English: The Lord, Har, Har, is unapproachable, of unfathomable wisdom, unlimited, all-powerful and infinite.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਕਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: jan kau kripaa karahu jagajeevan jan naanak paij savaaree |4|1|
English: Show Mercy to Your humble servant, O Life of the world, and save the honor of servant Nanak. ||4||1||

[Ang 667 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 4 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: har ke sant janaa har japio tin kaa dookh bharam bhau bhaagee |
English: The humble Saints of the Lord meditate on the Lord; their pain, doubt and fear have run away.

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਗੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: apanee sevaa aap karaaee guramat antar jaagee |1|
English: The Lord Himself inspires them to serve Him; they are awakened within to the Guru's Teachings. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: har kai naam rataa bairaagee |
English: Imbued with the Lord's Name, they are unattached to the world.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣੀ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har har kathaa sunee man bhaaee guramat har liv laagee |1| rahaau |
English: Listening to the sermon of the Lord, Har, Har, their minds are pleased; through Guru's Instruction, they enshrine love for the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੁਮੑ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਮ ਸਾਂਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: sant janaa kee jaat har suaamee tuma tthaakur ham saangee |
English: God, the Lord and Master, is the caste and social status of His humble Saints. You are the Lord and Master; I am just Your puppet.

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੀ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਤੈਸੇ ਬੁਲਗ ਬੁਲਾਗੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jaisee mat devahu har suaamee ham taise bulag bulaagee |2|
English: As is the understanding You bless us with, so are the words we speak. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਹਮ ਕਿਰਮ ਨਾਨੑ ਨਿਕ ਕੀਰੇ ਤੁਮੑ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ ਵਡਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa ham kiram naana nik keere tuma vadd purakh vaddaagee |
English: What are we? Tiny worms, and microscopic germs. You are our great and glorious Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਮ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਲਹ ਅਭਾਗੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tumaree gat mit keh na sakah prabh ham kiau kar milah abhaagee |3|
English: I cannot describe Your state and extent. O God, how can we unfortunate ones meet with You? ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: har prabh suaamee kirapaa dhaarahu ham har har sevaa laagee |
English: O God, my Lord and Master, shower me with Your Mercy, and commit me to Your service.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਕਥਾਗੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak daasan daas karahu prabh ham har kathaa kathaagee |4|2|
English: Make Nanak the slave of Your slaves, God; I speak the speech of the Lord's sermon. ||4||2||

[Ang 667 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 4 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖਾ ਜੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa sant satagur sat purakhaa jo bolai har har baanee |
English: The True Guru is the Lord's Saint, the True Being, who chants the Bani of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਹੈ ਸੁਣੈ ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਹਮ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jo jo kahai sunai so mukataa ham tis kai sad kurabaanee |1|
English: Whoever chants it, and listens to it, is liberated; I am forever a sacrifice to him. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਜਸੁ ਕਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: har ke sant sunahu jas kaanee |
English: O Saints of the Lord, listen to the Lord's Praises with your ears.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਪਲ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har har kathaa sunahu ik nimakh pal sabh kilavikh paap leh jaanee |1| rahaau |
English: Listen to the sermon of the Lord, Har, Har, for a moment, for even an instant, and all your sins and mistakes shall be erased. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਸਾਧੁ ਜਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ ਵਡਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa sant saadh jin paaeaa te vadd purakh vaddaanee |
English: Those who find such humble, Holy Saints, are the greatest of the great persons.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਮੰਗਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਲੋਚ ਲੁਚਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tin kee dhoor mangah prabh suaamee ham har loch luchaanee |2|
English: I beg for the dust of their feet; I long for the longing for God, my Lord and Master. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਫਲਿਓ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਿਨ ਜਪਿਓ ਸੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: har har safalio birakh prabh suaamee jin japio se tripataanee |
English: The Name of God, the Lord and Master, Har, Har, is the fruit-bearing tree; those who meditate on it are satisfied.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੇ ਸਭ ਲਾਥੀ ਭੂਖ ਭੁਖਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har har amrit pee tripataase sabh laathee bhookh bhukhaanee |3|
English: Drinking in the ambrosia of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I am satisfied; all my hunger and thirst is quenched. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਵਡੇ ਭਾਗ ਵਡ ਊਚੇ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਜਪਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: jin ke vadde bhaag vadd aooche tin har japio japaanee |
English: Those who are blessed with the highest, loftiest destiny, chant and meditate on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਨੀ ॥੪॥੩॥
