Transliteration: tin har sangat mel prabh suaamee jan naanak daas dasaanee |4|3|
English: Let me join their congregation, O God, my Lord and Master; Nanak is the slave of their slaves. ||4||3||

[Ang 667 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 4 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਅੰਧ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਰਾਤੇ ਕਿਉ ਚਾਲਹ ਗੁਰ ਚਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: ham andhule andh bikhai bikh raate kiau chaalah gur chaalee |
English: I am blind, totally blind, entangled in corruption and poison. How can I walk on the Guru's Path?

Gurbani: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਹਮ ਲਾਵੈ ਆਪਨ ਪਾਲੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: satagur deaa kare sukhadaataa ham laavai aapan paalee |1|
English: If the True Guru, the Giver of peace, shows His kindness, He attaches us to the hem of His robe. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮੀਤ ਚਲਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਚਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: gurasikh meet chalahu gur chaalee |
English: O Sikhs of the Guru, O friends, walk on the Guru's Path.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo gur kahai soee bhal maanahu har har kathaa niraalee |1| rahaau |
English: Whatever the Guru says, accept that as good; the sermon of the Lord, Har, Har, is unique and wonderful. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਬੇਗਿ ਬੇਗਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: har ke sant sunahu jan bhaaee gur sevihu beg begaalee |
English: O Saints of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny, listen: serve the Guru, quickly now!

Gurbani: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਖਰਚੁ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਧਹੁ ਮਤ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਆਜੁ ਕਿ ਕਾਲੑੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: satagur sev kharach har baadhahu mat jaanahu aaj ki kaalaee |2|
English: Let your service to the True Guru be your supplies on the Lord's Path; pack them up, and don't think of today or tomorrow. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਪਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤੁ ਚਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: har ke sant japahu har japanaa har sant chalai har naalee |
English: O Saints of the Lord, chant the chant of the Lord's Name; the Lord's Saints walk with the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਏ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕੇਲ ਕੇਲਾਲੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jin har japiaa se har hoe har miliaa kel kelaalee |3|
English: Those who meditate on the Lord, become the Lord; the playful, wondrous Lord meets them. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨੁ ਜਪਿ ਲੋਚ ਲੋੁਚਾਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਬਨਵਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: har har japan jap loch luochaanee har kirapaa kar banavaalee |
English: To chant the chant of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, is the longing I long for; have Mercy upon me, O Lord of the world-forest.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਹਮ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਪਗ ਰਾਲੀ ॥੪॥੪॥
Transliteration: jan naanak sangat saadh har melahu ham saadh janaa pag raalee |4|4|
English: O Lord, unite servant Nanak with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; make me the dust of the feet of the Holy. ||4||4||

[Ang 668 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 4 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੂੰਦ ਭਏ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਬਿਲਲ ਬਿਲਲਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: har har boond bhe har suaamee ham chaatrik bilal bilalaatee |
English: The Lord, Har, Har, is the rain-drop; I am the song-bird, crying, crying out for it.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਮਖਾਤੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har har kripaa karahu prabh apanee mukh devahu har nimakhaatee |1|
English: O Lord God, please bless me with Your Mercy, and pour Your Name into my mouth, even if for only an instant. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਇਕ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: har bin reh na skau ik raatee |
English: Without the Lord, I cannot live for even a second.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਮਲੈ ਅਮਲੀ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਈ ਹੈ ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਮ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਤੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jiau bin amalai amalee mar jaaee hai tiau har bin ham mar jaatee | rahaau |
English: Like the addict who dies without his drug, I die without the Lord. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਵਰ ਅਤਿ ਅਗਾਹ ਹਮ ਲਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਹਿ ਅੰਤੁ ਮਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: tum har saravar at agaah ham leh na sakeh ant maatee |
English: You, Lord, are the deepest, most unfathomable ocean; I cannot find even a trace of Your limits.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਪਰੈ ਪਰੈ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮਿਤਿ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਆਪਨ ਗਾਤੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: too parai parai aparanpar suaamee mit jaanahu aapan gaatee |2|
English: You are the most remote of the remote, limitless and transcendent; O Lord Master, You alone know Your state and extent. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੈ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: har ke sant janaa har japio gur rang chaloolai raatee |
English: The Lord's humble Saints meditate on the Lord; they are imbued with the deep crimson color of the Guru's Love.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਨੀ ਅਤਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਊਤਮ ਪਾਤੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har har bhagat banee at sobhaa har japio aootam paatee |3|
English: Meditating on the Lord, they attain great glory, and the most sublime honor. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਆਪਿ ਬਨਾਵੈ ਭਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: aape tthaakur aape sevak aap banaavai bhaatee |
English: He Himself is the Lord and Master, and He Himself is the servant; He Himself creates His environments.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਨੁ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਲਾਜ ਭਗਾਤੀ ॥੪॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak jan tumaree saranaaee har raakhahu laaj bhagaatee |4|5|
English: Servant Nanak has come to Your Sanctuary, O Lord; protect and preserve the honor of Your devotee. ||4||5||

[Ang 668 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 4 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਕਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਭਾਈ ਕਿਵ ਛੂਟਹ ਹਮ ਛੁਟਕਾਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: kalijug kaa dharam kahahu tum bhaaee kiv chhoottah ham chhuttakaakee |
English: Tell me, O Siblings of Destiny, the religion for this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. I seek emancipation - how can I be emancipated?

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਬੇੜੀ ਹਰਿ ਤੁਲਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਤਰੈ ਤਰਾਕੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har har jap berree har tulahaa har japio tarai taraakee |1|
English: Meditation on the Lord, Har, Har, is the boat, the raft; meditating on the Lord, the swimmer swims across. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਲਾਜ ਰਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: har jee laaj rakhahu har jan kee |
English: O Dear Lord, protect and preserve the honor of Your humble servant.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨੁ ਜਪਾਵਹੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਹਮ ਮਾਗੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਇਕਾਕੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har har japan japaavahu apanaa ham maagee bhagat ikaakee | rahaau |
English: O Lord, Har, Har, please make me chant the chant of Your Name; I beg only for Your devotional worship. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਜਪਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਬਚਨਾਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: har ke sevak se har piaare jin japio har bachanaakee |
English: The Lord's servants are very dear to the Lord; they chant the Word of the Lord's Bani.

Gurbani: ਲੇਖਾ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਪਤਿ ਜੋ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸਭ ਛੂਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਬਾਕੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: lekhaa chitr gupat jo likhiaa sabh chhoottee jam kee baakee |2|
English: The account of the recording angels, Chitr and Gupt, and the account with the Messenger of Death is totally erased. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਪਿਓ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਗਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: har ke sant japio man har har lag sangat saadh janaa kee |
English: The Saints of the Lord meditate on the Lord in their minds; they join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਦਿਨੀਅਰੁ ਸੂਰੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਨੀ ਸਿਵ ਚਰਿਓ ਚੰਦੁ ਚੰਦਾਕੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: dineear soor trisanaa agan bujhaanee siv chario chand chandaakee |3|
English: The piercing sun of desires has set, and the cool moon has risen. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ ਵਡ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਤੁਮ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਅਪਾਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: tum vadd purakh vadd agam agochar tum aape aap apaakee |
English: You are the Greatest Being, absolutely unapproachable and unfathomable; You created the Universe from Your Own Being.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਜੈ ਕਰਿ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਕੀ ॥੪॥੬॥
Transliteration: jan naanak kau prabh kirapaa keejai kar daasan daas dasaakee |4|6|
English: O God, take pity on servant Nanak, and make him the slave of the slave of Your slaves. ||4||6||

[Ang 668 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 4 ghar 5 dupade |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehl, Fifth House, Dho-Padhay:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ਰਮੋ ਰਮੁ ਮਨਮੋਹਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: aur dhaar beechaar muraar ramo ram manamohan naam japeene |
English: Enshrine the Lord within your heart, and contemplate Him. Dwell upon Him, reflect upon Him, and chant the Name of the Lord, the Enticer of hearts.

Gurbani: ਅਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: adrisatt agochar aparanpar suaamee gur poorai pragatt kar deene |1|
English: The Lord Master is unseen, unfathomable and unreachable; through the Perfect Guru, He is revealed. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਪਾਰਸ ਚੰਦਨ ਹਮ ਕਾਸਟ ਲੋਸਟ ॥
Transliteration: raam paaras chandan ham kaasatt losatt |
English: The Lord is the philosopher's stone, which transforms lead into gold, and sandalwood, while I am just dry wood and iron.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਰੀ ਸਤਸੰਗੁ ਭਏ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਕੀਨੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har sang haree satasang bhe har kanchan chandan keene |1| rahaau |
English: Associating with the Lord, and the Sat Sangat, the Lord's True Congregation, the Lord has transformed me into gold and sandalwood. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਵ ਛਿਅ ਖਟੁ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਮੁਖ ਆਗਰ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਇਵ ਨ ਪਤੀਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: nav chhia khatt boleh mukh aagar meraa har prabh iv na pateene |
English: One may repeat, verbatim, the nine grammars and the six Shaastras, but my Lord God is not pleased by this.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਦ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਇਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਭੀਨੇ ॥੨॥੧॥੭॥
Transliteration: jan naanak har hiradai sad dhiaavahu iau har prabh meraa bheene |2|1|7|
English: O servant Nanak, meditate forever on the Lord in your heart; this is what pleases my Lord God. ||2||1||7||

[Ang 668 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 4 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਨ ਕਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਇਵ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: gun kahu har lahu kar sevaa satigur iv har har naam dhiaaee |
English: Chant His Praises, learn of the Lord, and serve the True Guru; in this way, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har daragah bhaaveh fir janam na aaveh har har har jot samaaee |1|
English: In the Court of the Lord, He shall be pleased with you, and you shall not have to enter the cycle of reincarnation again; you shall merge in the Divine Light of the Lord, Har, Har, Har. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੀ ਹੋਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖੀ ॥
Transliteration: jap man naam haree hohi sarab sukhee |
English: Chant the Name of the Lord, O my mind, and you shall be totally at peace.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਊਚ ਸਭਨਾ ਤੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿ ਛਡਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har jas aooch sabhanaa te aoopar har har har sev chhaddaaee | rahaau |
English: The Lord's Praises are the most sublime, the most exalted; serving the Lord, Har, Har, Har, you shall be emancipated. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਤਬ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: har kripaa nidh keenee gur bhagat har deenee tab har siau preet ban aaee |
English: The Lord, the treasure of mercy, blessed me, and so the Guru blessed me with the Lord's devotional worship; I have come to be in love with the Lord.

Gurbani: ਬਹੁ ਚਿੰਤ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੨॥੨॥੮॥
Transliteration: bahu chint visaaree har naam ur dhaaree naanak har bhe hai sakhaaee |2|2|8|
English: I have forgotten my cares and anxieties, and enshrined the Lord's Name in my heart; O Nanak, the Lord has become my friend and companion. ||2||2||8||

[Ang 669 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 4 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪੜੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਖੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਉ ਹਰਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: har parr har likh har jap har gaau har bhaujal paar utaaree |
English: Read about the Lord, write about the Lord, chant the Lord's Name, and sing the Lord's Praises; the Lord will carry you across the terrifying world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਬਚਨਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਸੰਤੁਸਟੁ ਇਵ ਭਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: man bachan ridai dhiaae har hoe santusatt iv bhan har naam muraaree |1|
English: In your mind, by your words, and within your heart, meditate on the Lord, and He will be pleased. In this way, repeat the Name of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਜਗਦੀਸ ॥
Transliteration: man japeeai har jagadees |
English: O mind, meditate on the Lord, the Lord of the World.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਮੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: mil sangat saadhoo meet |
English: Join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O friend.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa anand hovai din raatee har keerat kar banavaaree | rahaau |
English: You shall be happy forever, day and night; sing the Praises of the Lord, the Lord of the world-forest. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਤਬ ਭਇਓ ਮਨਿ ਉਦਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿਓ ਗਤਿ ਭਈ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: har har karee drisatt tab bheo man udam har har naam japio gat bhee hamaaree |
English: When the Lord, Har, Har, casts His Glance of Grace, then I made the effort in my mind; meditating on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I have been emancipated.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਆਇ ਪਰਿਓ ਹੈ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੨॥੩॥੯॥
Transliteration: jan naanak kee pat raakh mere suaamee har aae pario hai saran tumaaree |2|3|9|
English: Preserve the honor of servant Nanak, O my Lord and Master; I have come seeking Your Sanctuary. ||2||3||9||

[Ang 669 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 4 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਸਿਧ ਬੁਧ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਕੋਟਿ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸਭਿ ਚਾਹਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: chauraaseeh sidh budh tetees kott mun jan sabh chaaheh har jeeo tero naau |
English: The eighty-four Siddhas, the spiritual masters, the Buddhas, the three hundred thirty million gods and the silent sages, all long for Your Name, O Dear Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਲਿਲਾਟਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਭਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad ko viralaa paavai jin kau lilaatt likhiaa dhur bhaau |1|
English: By Guru's Grace, a rare few obtain it; upon their foreheads, the pre-ordained destiny of loving devotion is written. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਰਾਮੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਊਤਮ ਕਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: jap man raamai naam har jas aootam kaam |
English: O mind, chant the Name of the Lord; singing the Lord's Praises is the most exalted activity.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸੁਣਹਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo gaaveh suneh teraa jas suaamee hau tin kai sad balihaarai jaau | rahaau |
English: I am forever a sacrifice to those who sing, and hear Your Praises, O Lord and Master. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜੋ ਤੁਮ ਦੇਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਹਉ ਪਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saranaagat pratipaalak har suaamee jo tum dehu soee hau paau |
English: I seek Your Sanctuary, O Cherisher God, my Lord and Master; whatever You give me, I accept.

Gurbani: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਕਾ ਹੈ ਚਾਉ ॥੨॥੪॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: deen deaal kripaa kar deejai naanak har simaran kaa hai chaau |2|4|10|
English: O Lord, Merciful to the meek, give me this blessing; Nanak longs for the Lord's meditative remembrance. ||2||4||10||

[Ang 669 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 4 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਕ ਸਿਖ ਪੂਜਣ ਸਭਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਊਤਮ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: sevak sikh poojan sabh aaveh sabh gaaveh har har aootam baanee |
English: All the Sikhs and servants come to worship and adore You; they sing the sublime Bani of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਿਆ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gaaviaa suniaa tin kaa har thaae paavai jin satigur kee aagiaa sat sat kar maanee |1|
English: Their singing and listening is approved by the Lord; they accept the Order of the True Guru as True, totally True. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬੋਲਹੁ ਭਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਵਜਲ ਤੀਰਥਿ ॥
Transliteration: bolahu bhaaee har keerat har bhavajal teerath |
English: Chant the Lord's Praises, O Siblings of Destiny; the Lord is the sacred shrine of pilgrimage in the terrifying world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਊਤਮ ਬਾਤ ਹੈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਜਿਨ ਜਨਹੁ ਜਾਨੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har dar tin kee aootam baat hai santahu har kathaa jin janahu jaanee | rahaau |
English: They alone are praised in the Court of the Lord, O Saints, who know and understand the Lord's sermon. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲਾ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: aape gur chelaa hai aape aape har prabh choj viddaanee |
English: He Himself is the Guru, and He Himself is the disciple; the Lord God Himself plays His wondrous games.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਸੀ ਅਵਰ ਸਭ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਓਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਨੀ ॥੨॥੫॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak aap milaae soee har milasee avar sabh tiaag ohaa har bhaanee |2|5|11|
English: O servant Nanak, he alone merges with the Lord, whom the Lord Himself merges; all the others are forsaken, but the Lord loves him. ||2||5||11||

[Ang 669 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 4 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਇਛਾ ਪੂਰਕੁ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਕਾਮਧੇਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: eichhaa poorak sarab sukhadaataa har jaa kai vas hai kaamadhenaa |
English: The Lord is the Fulfiller of desires, the Giver of total peace; the Kaamadhaynaa, the wish-fulfilling cow, is in His power.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਤਾ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: so aisaa har dhiaaeeai mere jeearre taa sarab sukh paaveh mere manaa |1|
English: So meditate on such a Lord, O my soul. Then, you shall obtain total peace, O my mind. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: jap man sat naam sadaa sat naam |
English: Chant, O my mind, the True Name, Sat Naam, the True Name.

Gurbani: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: halat palat mukh aoojal hoee hai nit dhiaaeeai har purakh niranjanaa | rahaau |
English: In this world, and in the world beyond, your face shall be radiant, by meditating continually on the immaculate Lord God. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਭਇਆ ਤਹ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਗਤੁ ਕੀਨੀ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeh har simaran bheaa teh upaadh gat keenee vaddabhaagee har japanaa |
English: Wherever anyone remembers the Lord in meditation, disaster runs away from that place. By great good fortune, we meditate on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰਨਾ ॥੨॥੬॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: jan naanak kau gur ih mat deenee jap har bhavajal taranaa |2|6|12|
English: The Guru has blessed servant Nanak with this understanding, that by meditating on the Lord, we cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||6||12||

[Ang 670 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 4 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਾ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: mere saahaa mai har darasan sukh hoe |
English: O my King, beholding the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, I am at peace.

Gurbani: ਹਮਰੀ ਬੇਦਨਿ ਤੂ ਜਾਨਤਾ ਸਾਹਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hamaree bedan too jaanataa saahaa avar kiaa jaanai koe | rahaau |
English: You alone know my inner pain, O King; what can anyone else know? ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਚੁ ਸਭੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: saachaa saahib sach too mere saahaa teraa keea sach sabh hoe |
English: O True Lord and Master, You are truly my King; whatever You do, all that is True.

Gurbani: ਝੂਠਾ ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਆਖੀਐ ਸਾਹਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jhootthaa kis kau aakheeai saahaa doojaa naahee koe |1|
English: Who should I call a liar? There is no other than You, O King. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਭਨਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਤੂ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਸਾਹਾ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: sabhanaa vich too varatadaa saahaa sabh tujheh dhiaaveh din raat |
English: You are pervading and permeating in all; O King, everyone meditates on You, day and night.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਥਾਵਹੁ ਮੰਗਦੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਾ ਤੂ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਇਕ ਦਾਤਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sabh tujh hee thaavahu mangade mere saahaa too sabhanaa kareh ik daat |2|
English: Everyone begs of You, O my King; You alone give gifts to all. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਾ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: sabh ko tujh hee vich hai mere saahaa tujh te baahar koee naeh |
English: All are under Your Power, O my King; none at all are beyond You.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਸਭਸ ਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਾ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sabh jeea tere too sabhas daa mere saahaa sabh tujh hee maeh samaeh |3|
English: All beings are Yours-You belong to all, O my King. All shall merge and be absorbed in You. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਭਨਾ ਕੀ ਤੂ ਆਸ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹ ॥
Transliteration: sabhanaa kee too aas hai mere piaare sabh tujheh dhiaaveh mere saah |
English: You are the hope of all, O my Beloved; all meditate on You, O my King.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਖੁ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: jiau bhaavai tiau rakh too mere piaare sach naanak ke paatisaah |4|7|13|
English: As it pleases You, protect and preserve me, O my Beloved; You are the True King of Nanak. ||4||7||13||

[Ang 670 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ghar 1 chaupade |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl, First House, Chau-Padhay:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਭਵ ਖੰਡਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਸ੍ਵਾਮੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: bhav khanddan dukh bhanjan svaamee bhagat vachhal nirankaare |
English: O Destroyer of fear, Remover of suffering, Lord and Master, Lover of Your devotees, Formless Lord.

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰਾਧ ਮਿਟੇ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਜਾਂ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kott paraadh mitte khin bheetar jaan guramukh naam samaare |1|
English: Millions of sins are eradicated in an instant when, as Gurmukh, one contemplates the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਹੈ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: meraa man laagaa hai raam piaare |
English: My mind is attached to my Beloved Lord.

Gurbani: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਿ ਕਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਨੇ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: deen deaal karee prabh kirapaa vas keene panch dootaare |1| rahaau |
English: God, Merciful to the meek, granted His Grace, and placed the five enemies under my control. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: teraa thaan suhaavaa roop suhaavaa tere bhagat soheh darabaare |
English: Your place is so beautiful; Your form is so beautiful; Your devotees look so beautiful in Your Court.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sarab jeea ke daate suaamee kar kirapaa lehu ubaare |2|
English: O Lord and Master, Giver of all beings, please, grant Your Grace, and save me. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਵਰਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਉਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: teraa varan na jaapai roop na lakheeai teree kudarat kaun beechaare |
English: Your color is not known, and Your form is not seen; who can contemplate Your Almighty Creative Power?

Gurbani: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਠਾਈ ਅਗਮ ਰੂਪ ਗਿਰਧਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jal thal maheeal raviaa srab tthaaee agam roop giradhaare |3|
English: You are contained in the water, the land and the sky, everywhere, O Lord of unfathomable form, Holder of the mountain. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: keerat kareh sagal jan teree too abinaasee purakh muraare |
English: All beings sing Your Praises; You are the imperishable Primal Being, the Destroyer of ego.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: jiau bhaavai tiau raakhahu suaamee jan naanak saran duaare |4|1|
English: As it pleases You, please protect and preserve me; servant Nanak seeks Sanctuary at Your Door. ||4||1||

[Ang 670 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਤਜੇ ਹੈ ਮੀਨਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਲ ਸਿਉ ਹੇਤੁ ਬਢਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: bin jal praan taje hai meenaa jin jal siau het badtaaeo |
English: The fish out of water loses its life; it is deeply in love with the water.

Gurbani: ਕਮਲ ਹੇਤਿ ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਹੈ ਭਵਰਾ ਉਨਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਨਿਕਸਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kamal het binasio hai bhavaraa un maarag nikas na paaeo |1|
English: The bumble bee, totally in love with the lotus flower, is lost in it; it cannot find the way to escape from it. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਮਨ ਏਕਸ ਸਿਉ ਮੋਹੁ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: ab man ekas siau mohu keenaa |
English: Now, my mind has nurtured love for the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੰਗੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਚੀਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: marai na jaavai sad hee sange satigurasabadee cheenaa |1| rahaau |
English: He does not die, and is not born; He is always with me. Through the Word of the True Guru's Shabad, I know Him. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਾਮ ਹੇਤਿ ਕੁੰਚਰੁ ਲੈ ਫਾਂਕਿਓ ਓਹੁ ਪਰ ਵਸਿ ਭਇਓ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaam het kunchar lai faankio ohu par vas bheo bichaaraa |
English: Lured by sexual desire, the elephant is trapped; the poor beast falls into the power of another.

Gurbani: ਨਾਦ ਹੇਤਿ ਸਿਰੁ ਡਾਰਿਓ ਕੁਰੰਕਾ ਉਸ ਹੀ ਹੇਤ ਬਿਦਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naad het sir ddaario kurankaa us hee het bidaaraa |2|
English: Lured by the sound of the hunter's bell, the deer offers its head; because of this enticement, it is killed. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦੇਖਿ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਲੋਭਿ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਉ ਲਪਟਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: dekh kuttanb lobh mohio praanee maaeaa kau lapattaanaa |
English: Gazing upon his family, the mortal is enticed by greed; he clings in attachment to Maya.

Gurbani: ਅਤਿ ਰਚਿਓ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਨੋ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਉਨਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਸਰਾਪਰ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: at rachio kar leeno apunaa un chhodd saraapar jaanaa |3|
English: Totally engrossed in worldly things, he considers them to be his own; but in the end, he shall surely have to leave them behind. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਅਵਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਨੇਹਾ ਓਹੁ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: bin gobind avar sang nehaa ohu jaanahu sadaa duhelaa |
English: Know it well, that anyone who loves any other than God, shall be miserable forever.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਇਹੈ ਬੁਝਾਇਓ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸਦ ਕੇਲਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak gur ihai bujhaaeo preet prabhoo sad kelaa |4|2|
English: Says Nanak, the Guru has explained this to me, that love for God brings lasting bliss. ||4||2||

[Ang 671 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੀਓ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੇ ਛੁਟਕਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa deeo mohi naamaa bandhan te chhuttakaae |
English: Granting His Grace, God has blessed me with His Name, and released me of my bonds.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਤੇ ਬਿਸਰਿਓ ਸਗਲੋ ਧੰਧਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: man te bisario sagalo dhandhaa gur kee charanee laae |1|
English: I have forgotten all worldly entanglements, and I am attached to the Guru's feet. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਚਿੰਤ ਬਿਰਾਨੀ ਛਾਡੀ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang chint biraanee chhaaddee |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I have renounced my other cares and anxieties.

Gurbani: ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਮੋਹ ਮਨ ਬਾਸਨ ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਗਡਹਾ ਗਾਡੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ahanbudh moh man baasan de kar gaddahaa gaaddee |1| rahaau |
English: I dug a deep pit, and buried my egotistical pride, emotional attachment and the desires of my mind. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਦੁਸਮਨੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਨਾ ਹਮ ਕਿਸ ਕੇ ਬੈਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: naa ko meraa dusaman rahiaa naa ham kis ke bairaaee |
English: No one is my enemy, and I am no one's enemy.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਸਾਰੁ ਪਸਾਰਿਓ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: braham pasaar pasaario bheetar satigur te sojhee paaee |2|
English: God, who expanded His expanse, is within all; I learned this from the True Guru. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਮੀਤੁ ਹਮ ਆਪਨ ਕੀਨਾ ਹਮ ਸਭਨਾ ਕੇ ਸਾਜਨ ॥
Transliteration: sabh ko meet ham aapan keenaa ham sabhanaa ke saajan |
English: I am a friend to all; I am everyone's friend.

Gurbani: ਦੂਰਿ ਪਰਾਇਓ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਬਿਰਹਾ ਤਾ ਮੇਲੁ ਕੀਓ ਮੇਰੈ ਰਾਜਨ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: door paraaeo man kaa birahaa taa mel keeo merai raajan |3|
English: When the sense of separation was removed from my mind, then I was united with the Lord, my King. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਢੀਠਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵੂਠਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਲਗੋ ਗੁਰ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: binasio dteetthaa amrit vootthaa sabad lago gur meetthaa |
English: My stubbornness is gone, Ambrosial Nectar rains down, and the Word of the Guru's Shabad seems so sweet to me.

Gurbani: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਮਈਆ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
Transliteration: jal thal maheeal sarab nivaasee naanak rameea ddeetthaa |4|3|
English: He is pervading everywhere, in the water, on the land and in the sky; Nanak beholds the all-pervading Lord. ||4||3||

[Ang 671 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਭੇਟੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਭਲੇ ਦਿਨਸ ਓਇ ਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: jab te darasan bhette saadhoo bhale dinas oe aae |
English: Ever since I obtained the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the Holy, my days have been blessed and prosperous.

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mahaa anand sadaa kar keeratan purakh bidhaataa paae |1|
English: I have found lasting bliss, singing the Kirtan of the Praises of the Primal Lord, the Architect of destiny. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਜਸੋ ਮਨਿ ਗਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: ab mohi raam jaso man gaaeo |
English: Now, I sing the Praises of the Lord within my mind.

Gurbani: ਭਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bheo pragaas sadaa sukh man meh satigur pooraa paaeo |1| rahaau |
English: My mind has been illumined and enlightened, and it is always at peace; I have found the Perfect True Guru. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਰਿਦ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਤਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਭਰਮ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: gun nidhaan rid bheetar vasiaa taa dookh bharam bhau bhaagaa |
English: The Lord, the treasure of virtue, abides deep within the heart, and so pain, doubt and fear have been dispelled.

Gurbani: ਭਈ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bhee paraapat vasat agochar raam naam rang laagaa |2|
English: I have obtained the most incomprehensible thing, enshrining love for the Name of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਚਿੰਤ ਅਚਿੰਤਾ ਸੋਚ ਅਸੋਚਾ ਸੋਗੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਥਾਕਾ ॥
Transliteration: chint achintaa soch asochaa sog lobh mohu thaakaa |
English: I was anxious, and now I am free of anxiety; I was worried, and now I am free of worry; my grief, greed and emotional attachments are gone.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗ ਮਿਟੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਬਿਬਾਕਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: haumai rog mitte kirapaa te jam te bhe bibaakaa |3|
English: By His Grace, I am cured of the disease of egotism, and the Messenger of Death no longer terrifies me. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur kee ttehal guroo kee sevaa gur kee aagiaa bhaanee |
English: Working for the Guru, serving the Guru and the Guru's Command, all are pleasing to me.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਕਾਢੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੪॥੪॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak jin jam te kaadte tis gur kai kurabaanee |4|4|
English: Says Nanak, He has released me from the clutches of Death; I am a sacrifice to that Guru. ||4||4||

[Ang 671 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: jis kaa tan man dhan sabh tis kaa soee sugharr sujaanee |
English: Body, mind, wealth and everything belong to Him; He alone is all-wise and all-knowing.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਤਉ ਬਿਧਿ ਨੀਕੀ ਖਟਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tin hee suniaa dukh sukh meraa tau bidh neekee khattaanee |1|
English: He listens to my pains and pleasures, and then my condition improves. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਏਕੈ ਹੀ ਪਹਿ ਮਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: jeea kee ekai hee peh maanee |
English: My soul is satisfied with the One Lord alone.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰਿ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਜਾਨੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: avar jatan kar rahe bahutere tin til nahee keemat jaanee | rahaau |
English: People make all sorts of other efforts, but they have no value at all. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੁ ਹੀਰਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੋ ਮੰਤਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: amrit naam niramolak heeraa gur deeno mantaanee |
English: The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, is a priceless jewel. The Guru has given me this advice.

Gurbani: ਡਿਗੈ ਨ ਡੋਲੈ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ddigai na ddolai drirr kar rahio pooran hoe tripataanee |2|
English: It cannot be lost, and it cannot be shaken off; it remains steady, and I am perfectly satisfied with it. ||2||

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਜੁ ਬੀਚ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਕਛੁ ਹੋਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ਬਿਲਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: oe ju beech ham tum kachh hote tin kee baat bilaanee |
English: Those things which tore me away from You, Lord, are now gone.

Gurbani: ਅਲੰਕਾਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਥੈਲੀ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਕਨਿਕ ਵਖਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: alankaar mil thailee hoee hai taa te kanik vakhaanee |3|
English: When golden ornaments are melted down into a lump, they are still said to be gold. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਓ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖ ਸੋਭਾ ਬਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਤ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: pragattio jot sehaj sukh sobhaa baaje anahat baanee |
English: The Divine Light has illuminated me, and I am filled with celestial peace and glory; the unstruck melody of the Lord's Bani resounds within me.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਘਰੁ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਓ ਬੰਧਾਨੀ ॥੪॥੫॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak nihachal ghar baadhio gur keeo bandhaanee |4|5|
English: Says Nanak, I have built my eternal home; the Guru has constructed it for me. ||4||5||

[Ang 672 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਵਡੇ ਵਡੇ ਰਾਜਨ ਅਰੁ ਭੂਮਨ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਨ ਬੂਝੀ ॥
Transliteration: vadde vadde raajan ar bhooman taa kee trisan na boojhee |
English: The desires of the greatest of the great kings and landlords cannot be satisfied.

Gurbani: ਲਪਟਿ ਰਹੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਤੇ ਲੋਚਨ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਸੂਝੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: lapatt rahe maaeaa rang maate lochan kachhoo na soojhee |1|
English: They remain engrossed in Maya, intoxicated with the pleasures of their wealth; their eyes see nothing else at all. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਹਿ ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: bikhiaa meh kin hee tripat na paaee |
English: No one has ever found satisfaction in sin and corruption.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਈਧਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਹਾ ਅਘਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jiau paavak eedhan nahee dhraapai bin har kahaa aghaaee | rahaau |
English: The flame is not satisfied by more fuel; how can one be satisfied without the Lord? ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦਿਨੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਕਰਤ ਭੋਜਨ ਬਹੁ ਬਿੰਜਨ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਮਿਟੈ ਨ ਭੂਖਾ ॥
Transliteration: din din karat bhojan bahu binjan taa kee mittai na bhookhaa |
English: Day after day, he eats his meals with many different foods, but his hunger is not eradicated.

Gurbani: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੁਆਨ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਟਾ ਘੋਖਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: audam karai suaan kee niaaee chaare kunttaa ghokhaa |2|
English: He runs around like a dog, searching in the four directions. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਾਮਵੰਤ ਕਾਮੀ ਬਹੁ ਨਾਰੀ ਪਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਜੋਹ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ॥
Transliteration: kaamavant kaamee bahu naaree par grih joh na chookai |
English: The lustful, lecherous man desires many women, and he never stops peeking into the homes of others.

Gurbani: ਦਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਕਰੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਪੈ ਸੋਗ ਲੋਭ ਮਹਿ ਸੂਕੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: din prat karai karai pachhutaapai sog lobh meh sookai |3|
English: Day after day, he commits adultery again and again, and then he regrets his actions; he wastes away in misery and greed. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਮੋਲਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam apaar amolaa amrit ek nidhaanaa |
English: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is incomparable and priceless; it is the treasure of Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਸੂਖੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੬॥
Transliteration: sookh sehaj aanand santan kai naanak gur te jaanaa |4|6|
English: The Saints abide in peace, poise and bliss; O Nanak, through the Guru, this is known. ||4||6||

[Ang 672 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਗਨ ਕਉ ਹੈ ਕਛੂਐ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਫਿਰਿ ਇਹੁ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: lavai na laagan kau hai kachhooai jaa kau fir ihu dhaavai |
English: Nothing which this mortal being runs after, can compare to it.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੋ ਇਹੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਬਨਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jaa kau gur deeno ihu amrit tis hee kau ban aavai |1|
English: He alone comes to have it, whom the Guru blesses with this Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਆਇਓ ਏਕੁ ਰਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kau aaeo ek rasaa |
English: The desire to eat, to wear new clothes, and all other desires,

Gurbani: ਖਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਆਨ ਨਹੀ ਖੁਧਿਆ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਬਸਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: khaan paan aan nahee khudhiaa taa kai chit na basaa | rahaau |
English: Do not abide in the mind of one who comes to know the subtle essence of the One Lord. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਉਲਿਓ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇਓ ਹਰਿਆ ਏਕ ਬੂੰਦ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: maulio man tan hoeo hariaa ek boond jin paaee |
English: The mind and body blossom forth in abundance, when one receives even a drop of this Nectar.

Gurbani: ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: baran na saakau usatat taa kee keemat kehan na jaaee |2|
English: I cannot express His glory; I cannot describe His worth. ||2||

Gurbani: ਘਾਲ ਨ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਆਇ ਅਚਿੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: ghaal na milio sev na milio milio aae achintaa |
English: We cannot meet the Lord by our own efforts, nor can we meet Him through service; He comes and meets us spontaneously.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਕਮਾਨੋ ਮੰਤਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jaa kau deaa karee merai tthaakur tin gureh kamaano mantaa |3|
English: One who is blessed by my Lord Master's Grace, practices the Teachings of the Guru's Mantra. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦੀਨ ਦੈਆਲ ਸਦਾ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: deen daiaal sadaa kirapaalaa sarab jeea pratipaalaa |
English: He is merciful to the meek, always kind and compassionate; He cherishes and nurtures all beings.

Gurbani: ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਜਿਉ ਮਾਤਾ ਬਾਲ ਗੋੁਪਾਲਾ ॥੪॥੭॥
Transliteration: ot pot naanak sang raviaa jiau maataa baal guopaalaa |4|7|
English: The Lord is mingled with Nanak, through and through; He cherishes him, like the mother her child. ||4||7||

[Ang 672 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬਾਰਿ ਜਾਉ ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੑਾਯਾ ॥
Transliteration: baar jaau gur apune aoopar jin har har naam drirraayaa |
English: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, who has implanted the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, within me.

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਮਹਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਸੀਧਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦਿਖਾਯਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mahaa udiaan andhakaar meh jin seedhaa maarag dikhaayaa |1|
English: In the utter darkness of the wilderness, He showed me the straight path. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਮਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: hamare praan gupaal gobind |
English: The Lord of the universe, the Cherisher of the world, He is my breath of life.

Gurbani: ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਸਰਬ ਥੋਕ ਕੀ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਚਿੰਦ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: eehaa aoohaa sarab thok kee jiseh hamaaree chind |1| rahaau |
English: Here and hereafter, he takes care of everything for me. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ਮਾਨੁ ਮਹਤੁ ਪਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai simaran sarab nidhaanaa maan mehat pat pooree |
English: Meditating on Him in remembrance, I have found all treasures, respect, greatness and perfect honor.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਘ ਨਾਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਬਾਛਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਧੂਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naam lait kott agh naase bhagat baachheh sabh dhooree |2|
English: Remembering His Name, millions of sins are erased; all His devotees long for the dust of His feet. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਚਾਹੈ ਸੇਵੈ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: sarab manorath je ko chaahai sevai ek nidhaanaa |
English: If someone wishes for the fulfillment of all his hopes and desires, he should serve the one supreme treasure.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: paarabraham aparanpar suaamee simarat paar paraanaa |3|
English: He is the Supreme Lord God, infinite Lord and Master; meditating on Him in remembrance, one is carried across. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਓਲੑਾ ॥
Transliteration: seetal saant mahaa sukh paaeaa santasang rahio olaa |
English: I have found total peace and tranquility in the Society of the Saints; my honor has been preserved.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀਨੋ ਚੋਲੑਾ ॥੪॥੮॥
Transliteration: har dhan sanchan har naam bhojan ihu naanak keeno cholaa |4|8|
English: To gather in the Lord's wealth, and to taste the food of the Lord's Name - Nanak has made this his feast. ||4||8||

[Ang 673 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਕਰਣੀ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਸਰਮਿੰਦਾ ਇਹਾ ਕਮਾਨੀ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: jih karanee hoveh saramindaa ihaa kamaanee reet |
English: You have made it your habit to practice those deeds which will bring you shame.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਸਾਕਤ ਕੀ ਪੂਜਾ ਐਸੀ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੑੀ ਬਿਪਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sant kee nindaa saakat kee poojaa aisee drirraee bipareet |1|
English: You slander the Saints, and you worship the faithless cynics; such are the corrupt ways you have adopted. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਭੂਲੋ ਅਵਰੈ ਹੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa moh bhoolo avarai heet |
English: Deluded by your emotional attachment to Maya, you love other things,

Gurbani: ਹਰਿਚੰਦਉਰੀ ਬਨ ਹਰ ਪਾਤ ਰੇ ਇਹੈ ਤੁਹਾਰੋ ਬੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: harichandauree ban har paat re ihai tuhaaro beet |1| rahaau |
English: like the enchanted city of Hari-chandauree, or the green leaves of the forest - such is your way of life. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਚੰਦਨ ਲੇਪ ਹੋਤ ਦੇਹ ਕਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਗਰਧਭ ਭਸਮ ਸੰਗੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: chandan lep hot deh kau sukh garadhabh bhasam sangeet |
English: Its body may be anointed with sandalwood oil, but the donkey still loves to roll in the mud.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਹਿ ਰੁਚ ਆਵਤ ਬਿਖੈ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: amrit sang naeh ruch aavat bikhai tthgauree preet |2|
English: He is not fond of the Ambrosial Nectar; instead, he loves the poisonous drug of corruption. ||2||

Gurbani: ਉਤਮ ਸੰਤ ਭਲੇ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਪਵਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: autam sant bhale sanjogee is jug meh pavit puneet |
English: The Saints are noble and sublime; they are blessed with good fortune. They alone are pure and holy in this world.

Gurbani: ਜਾਤ ਅਕਾਰਥ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਕਾਚ ਬਾਦਰੈ ਜੀਤ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jaat akaarath janam padaarath kaach baadarai jeet |3|
English: The jewel of this human life is passing away uselessly, lost in exchange for mere glass. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਦੁਖ ਭਾਗੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਦੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: janam janam ke kilavikh dukh bhaage gur giaan anjan netr deet |
English: The sins and sorrows of uncounted incarnations run away, when the Guru applies the healing ointment of spiritual wisdom to the eyes.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਇਨ ਦੁਖ ਤੇ ਨਿਕਸਿਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕ ਪਰੀਤ ॥੪॥੯॥
Transliteration: saadhasang in dukh te nikasio naanak ek pareet |4|9|
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I have escaped from these troubles; Nanak loves the One Lord. ||4||9||

[Ang 673 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪਾਨੀ ਪਖਾ ਪੀਸਉ ਸੰਤ ਆਗੈ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: paanee pakhaa peesau sant aagai gun govind jas gaaee |
English: I carry the water, wave the fan, and grind the corn for the Saints; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਰੈ ਇਹੁ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saas saas man naam samaarai ihu bisraam nidh paaee |1|
English: With each and every breath, my mind remembers the Naam, the Name of the Lord; in this way, it finds the treasure of peace. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮੑ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: tuma karahu deaa mere saaee |
English: Have pity on me, O my Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਐਸੀ ਮਤਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aisee mat deejai mere tthaakur sadaa sadaa tudh dhiaaee |1| rahaau |
English: Bless me with such understanding, O my Lord and Master, that I may forever and ever meditate on You. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਛੂਟੈ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਭਰਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: tumaree kripaa te mohu maan chhoottai binas jaae bharamaaee |
English: By Your Grace, emotional attachment and egotism are eradicated, and doubt is dispelled.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦ ਰੂਪੁ ਰਵਿਓ ਸਭ ਮਧੇ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: anad roop ravio sabh madhe jat kat pekhau jaaee |2|
English: The Lord, the embodiment of bliss, is pervading and permeating in all; wherever I go, there I see Him. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮੑ ਦਇਆਲ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਗੋਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: tuma deaal kirapaal kripaa nidh patit paavan gosaaee |
English: You are kind and compassionate, the treasure of mercy, the Purifier of sinners, Lord of the world.

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਸੂਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਰਾਜ ਪਾਏ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਨਿਮਖ ਬੁਲਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kott sookh aanand raaj paae mukh te nimakh bulaaee |3|
English: I obtain millions of joys, comforts and kingdoms, if You inspire me to chant Your Name with my mouth, even for an instant. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਾ ਪੂਰੀ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jaap taap bhagat saa pooree jo prabh kai man bhaaee |
English: That alone is perfect chanting, meditation, penance and devotional worship service, which is pleasing to God's Mind.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਸਭ ਬੁਝੀ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: naam japat trisanaa sabh bujhee hai naanak tripat aghaaee |4|10|
English: Chanting the Naam, all thirst and desire is satisfied; Nanak is satisfied and fulfilled. ||4||10||

[Ang 673 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਨੇ ਵਸਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਭਵਣ ਚਤੁਰ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jin keene vas apunai trai gun bhavan chatur sansaaraa |
English: She controls the three qualities and the four directions of the world.

Gurbani: ਜਗ ਇਸਨਾਨ ਤਾਪ ਥਾਨ ਖੰਡੇ ਕਿਆ ਇਹੁ ਜੰਤੁ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jag isanaan taap thaan khandde kiaa ihu jant vichaaraa |1|
English: She destroys sacrificial feasts, cleansing baths, penances and sacred places of pilgrimage; what is this poor person to do? ||1||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਤਉ ਛੂਟੋ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kee ott gahee tau chhootto |
English: I grasped God's Support and Protection, and then I was emancipated.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਏ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਤਬ ਹੂਟੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saadh prasaad har har har gaae bikhai biaadh tab hootto |1| rahaau |
English: By the Grace of the Holy Saints, I sang the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, and my sins and afflictions were taken away. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਹ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਨਹ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਬਕੀਐ ਨਹ ਮੋਹੈ ਉਹ ਡੀਠੀ ॥
Transliteration: neh suneeai neh mukh te bakeeai neh mohai uh ddeetthee |
English: She is not heard - she does not speak with a mouth; she is not seen enticing mortals.

Gurbani: ਐਸੀ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਪਾਇ ਭੁਲਾਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਸਭ ਕੈ ਲਾਗੈ ਮੀਠੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aisee tthgauree paae bhulaavai man sabh kai laagai meetthee |2|
English: She administers her intoxicating drug, and so confuses them; thus she seems sweet to everyone's mind. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇ ਬਾਪ ਪੂਤ ਹਿਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਾ ਉਨਿ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮੇਲਿਓ ਦੂਆ ॥
Transliteration: maae baap poot hit bhraataa un ghar ghar melio dooaa |
English: In each and every home, she has implanted the sense of duality in mother, father, children, friends and siblings.

Gurbani: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਵਾਧਿ ਘਾਟਿ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਪਹਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਲਰਿ ਲਰਿ ਮੂਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kis hee vaadh ghaatt kis hee peh sagale lar lar mooaa |3|
English: Some have more, and some have less; they fight and fight, to the death. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਚਲਤੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau balihaaree satigur apune jin ihu chalat dikhaaeaa |
English: I am a sacrifice to my True Guru, who has shown me this wondrous play.

Gurbani: ਗੂਝੀ ਭਾਹਿ ਜਲੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ਭਗਤ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: goojhee bhaeh jalai sansaaraa bhagat na biaapai maaeaa |4|
English: The world is being consumed by this hidden fire, but Maya does not cling to the Lord's devotees. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਗਲੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੇ ॥
Transliteration: sant prasaad mahaa sukh paaeaa sagale bandhan kaatte |
English: By the Grace of the Saints, I have obtained supreme bliss, and all my bonds have been broken.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਘਰਿ ਲੈ ਆਇਆ ਖਾਟੇ ॥੫॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: har har naam naanak dhan paaeaa apunai ghar lai aaeaa khaatte |5|11|
English: Nanak has obtained the wealth of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; having earned his profits, he has now returned home. ||5||11||

[Ang 673 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਦਾਤੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕ ਨਾਇਕ ਖਸਮ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: tum daate tthaakur pratipaalak naaeik khasam hamaare |
English: You are the Giver, O Lord, O Cherisher, my Master, my Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਹੁ ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: nimakh nimakh tum hee pratipaalahu ham baarik tumare dhaare |1|
English: Each and every moment, You cherish and nurture me; I am Your child, and I rely upon You alone. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਏਕ ਕਵਨ ਗੁਨ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: jihavaa ek kavan gun kaheeai |
English: I have only one tongue - which of Your Glorious Virtues can I describe?

Gurbani: ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੇਰੋ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: besumaar beant suaamee tero ant na kin hee laheeai |1| rahaau |
English: Unlimited, infinite Lord and Master - no one knows Your limits. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰਾਧ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਖੰਡਹੁ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਿਧੀ ਸਮਝਾਵਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: kott paraadh hamaare khanddahu anik bidhee samajhaavahu |
English: You destroy millions of my sins, and teach me in so many ways.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅਲਪ ਮਤਿ ਥੋਰੀ ਤੁਮ ਆਪਨ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਰਖਾਵਹੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ham agiaan alap mat thoree tum aapan birad rakhaavahu |2|
English: I am so ignorant - I understand nothing at all. Please honor Your innate nature, and save me! ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਆਸਾ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਸਜਨ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: tumaree saran tumaaree aasaa tum hee sajan suhele |
English: I seek Your Sanctuary - You are my only hope. You are my companion, and my best friend.

Gurbani: ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਘਰ ਕੇ ਗੋਲੇ ॥੩॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: raakhahu raakhanahaar deaalaa naanak ghar ke gole |3|12|
English: Save me, O Merciful Saviour Lord; Nanak is the slave of Your home. ||3||12||

[Ang 674 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪੂਜਾ ਵਰਤ ਤਿਲਕ ਇਸਨਾਨਾ ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਬਹੁ ਦੈਨ ॥
Transliteration: poojaa varat tilak isanaanaa pun daan bahu dain |
English: Worship, fasting, ceremonial marks on one's forehead, cleansing baths, generous donations to charities and self-mortification

Gurbani: ਕਹੂੰ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਸੰਜਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਮੀਠੇ ਬੈਨ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kahoon na bheejai sanjam suaamee boleh meetthe bain |1|
English: - the Lord Master is not pleased with any of these rituals, no matter how sweetly one may speak. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਮਨ ਚੈਨ ॥
Transliteration: prabh jee ko naam japat man chain |
English: Chanting the Name of God, the mind is soothed and pacified.

Gurbani: ਬਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਖੋਜਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਲੈਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bahu prakaar khojeh sabh taa kau bikham na jaaee lain |1| rahaau |
English: Everyone searches for Him in different ways, but the search is so difficult, and He cannot be found. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਭ੍ਰਮਨ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਕਰਿ ਉਰਧ ਤਾਪ ਲੈ ਗੈਨ ॥
Transliteration: jaap taap bhraman basudhaa kar uradh taap lai gain |
English: Chanting, deep meditation and penance, wandering over the face of the earth, the performance of austerities with the arms stretched up to the sky

Gurbani: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਹ ਪਤੀਆਨੋ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੈਨ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: eih bidh neh pateeaano tthaakur jog jugat kar jain |2|
English: - the Lord is not pleased by any of these means, though one may follow the path of Yogis and Jains. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਓ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਿਰਪੈਨ ॥
Transliteration: amrit naam niramolak har jas tin paaeo jis kirapain |
English: The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, and the Praises of the Lord are priceless; he alone obtains them, whom the Lord blesses with His Mercy.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭੇਟੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਿ ਜਨ ਰੈਨ ॥੩॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: saadhasang rang prabh bhette naanak sukh jan rain |3|13|
English: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak lives in the Love of God; his life-night passes in peace. ||3||13||

[Ang 674 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੇ ਛੁਟਕਾਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: bandhan te chhuttakaavai prabhoo milaavai har har naam sunaavai |
English: Is there anyone who can release me from my bondage, unite me with God, recite the Name of the Lord, Har, Har,

Gurbani: ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਧਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: asathir kare nihachal ihu manooaa bahur na katahoo dhaavai |1|
English: and make this mind steady and stable, so that it no longer wanders around? ||1||

Gurbani: ਹੈ ਕੋਊ ਐਸੋ ਹਮਰਾ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: hai koaoo aiso hamaraa meet |
English: Do I have any such friend?

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਹੀਉ ਦੇਉ ਅਰਪਉ ਅਪਨੋ ਚੀਤੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sagal samagree jeeo heeo deo arpau apano cheet |1| rahaau |
English: I would give him all my property, my soul and my heart; I would devote my consciousness to him. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰ ਤਨ ਪਰ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਇਨ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: par dhan par tan par kee nindaa in siau preet na laagai |
English: Others' wealth, others' bodies, and the slander of others - do not attach your love to them.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਹ ਸੰਗੁ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਭਾਖਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: santah sang sant sanbhaakhan har keeratan man jaagai |2|
English: Associate with the Saints, speak with the Saints, and keep your mind awake to the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: gun nidhaan deaal purakh prabh sarab sookh deaalaa |
English: God is the treasure of virtue, kind and compassionate, the source of all comfort.

Gurbani: ਮਾਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਿਉ ਮਾਤਾ ਬਾਲ ਗੁਪਾਲਾ ॥੩॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: maagai daan naam tero naanak jiau maataa baal gupaalaa |3|14|
English: Nanak begs for the gift of Your Name; O Lord of the world, love him, like the mother loves her child. ||3||14||

[Ang 674 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਸੰਤ ਉਬਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: har har leene sant ubaar |
English: The Lord saves His Saints.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਬੁਰਿਆਈ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har ke daas kee chitavai buriaaee tis hee kau fir maar |1| rahaau |
English: One who wishes misfortune upon the Lord's slaves, shall be destroyed by the Lord eventually. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਕਾ ਆਪਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਹੋਆ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਭਾਗੇ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jan kaa aap sahaaee hoaa nindak bhaage haar |
English: He Himself is the help and support of His humble servants; He defeats the slanderers, and chases them away.

Gurbani: ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਊਹਾਂ ਹੀ ਮੂਏ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਨ ਮੰਝਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bhramat bhramat aoohaan hee mooe baahurr grihi na manjhaar |1|
English: Wandering around aimlessly, they die out there; they never return to their homes again. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: naanak saran pario dukh bhanjan gun gaavai sadaa apaar |
English: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Destroyer of pain; he sings the Glorious Praises of the infinite Lord forever.

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਾ ਮੁਖੁ ਕਾਲਾ ਹੋਆ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: nindak kaa mukh kaalaa hoaa deen duneea kai darabaar |2|15|
English: The faces of the slanderers are blackened in the courts of this world, and the world beyond. ||2||15||

[Ang 674 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਿਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasiree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੁ ਚਿਤਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: ab har raakhanahaar chitaariaa |
English: Now, I contemplate and meditate on the Lord, the Saviour Lord.

Gurbani: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਕੀਏ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸਗਲਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਬਿਦਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: patit puneet kee khin bheetar sagalaa rog bidaariaa |1| rahaau |
English: He purifies sinners in an instant, and cures all diseases. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੋਸਟਿ ਭਈ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਮਿ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: gosatt bhee saadh kai sangam kaam krodh lobh maariaa |
English: Talking with the Holy Saints, my sexual desire, anger and greed have been eradicated.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਸੰਗੀ ਸਗਲੇ ਤਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: simar simar pooran naaraaein sangee sagale taariaa |1|
English: Remembering, remembering the Perfect Lord in meditation, I have saved all my companions. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਉਖਧ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਮੂਲ ਮਨ ਏਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: aaukhadh mantr mool man ekai man bisvaas prabh dhaariaa |
English: The Mul Mantra, the Root Mantra, is the only cure for the mind; I have installed faith in God in my mind.

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਰੇਨ ਬਾਂਛੈ ਨਿਤ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪੁਨਹ ਪੁਨਹ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿਆ ॥੨॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: charan ren baanchhai nit naanak punah punah balihaariaa |2|16|
English: Nanak ever longs for the dust of the Lord's feet; again and again, he is a sacrifice to the Lord. ||2||16||

[Ang 675 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਲਾਗੋ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਹੇਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: meraa laago raam siau het |
English: I have fallen in love with the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਜਿਨਿ ਦੁਖ ਕਾ ਕਾਟਿਆ ਕੇਤੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur meraa sadaa sahaaee jin dukh kaa kaattiaa ket |1| rahaau |
English: My True Guru is always my help and support; He has torn down the banner of pain. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਸਗਲ ਮਿਟਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: haath dee raakhio apunaa kar birathaa sagal mittaaee |
English: Giving me His hand, He has protected me as His own, and removed all my troubles.

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਕਾਲੇ ਕੀਨੇ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਆਪਿ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: nindak ke mukh kaale keene jan kaa aap sahaaee |1|
English: He has blackened the faces of the slanderers, and He Himself has become the help and support of His humble servant. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਹੋਆ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: saachaa saahib hoaa rakhavaalaa raakh lee kantth laae |
English: The True Lord and Master has become my Saviour; hugging me close in His embrace, He has saved me.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਣੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੨॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: nirbhau bhe sadaa sukh maane naanak har gun gaae |2|17|
English: Nanak has become fearless, and he enjoys eternal peace, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||17||

[Ang 675 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਿਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasiree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਉਖਧੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
Transliteration: aaukhadh tero naam deaal |
English: Your Name is the medicine, O Merciful Lord.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਆਤੁਰ ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ਤੂੰ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mohi aatur teree gat nahee jaanee toon aap kareh pratipaal |1| rahaau |
English: I am so miserable, I do not know Your state; You Yourself cherish me, Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਧਾਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਭਾਉ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: dhaar anugrahu suaamee mere duteea bhaau nivaar |
English: Take pity on me, O my Lord and Master, and remove the love of duality from within me.

Gurbani: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਆਵਹ ਹਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bandhan kaatt lehu apune kar kabahoo na aavah haar |1|
English: Break my bonds, and take me as Your own, so that I may never come to lose. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਇਆ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਤੂੰ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: teree saran peaa hau jeevaan toon samrath purakh miharavaan |
English: Seeking Your Sanctuary, I live, almighty and merciful Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਆਰਾਧੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥੨॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar prabh kau aaraadhee naanak sad kurabaan |2|18|
English: Twenty-four hours a day, I worship God; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||18||

[Ang 675 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raag dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Raag Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਹਾ ਹਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: haa haa prabh raakh lehu |
English: O God, please save me!

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਤੇ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸ੍ਵਾਮੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ham te kichhoo na hoe mere svaamee kar kirapaa apunaa naam dehu |1| rahaau |
English: By myself, I cannot do anything, O my Lord and Master; by Your Grace, please bless me with Your Name. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਗਨਿ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: agan kuttanb saagar sansaar |
English: Family and worldly affairs are an ocean of fire.

Gurbani: ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bharam moh agiaan andhaar |1|
English: Through doubt, emotional attachment and ignorance, we are enveloped in darkness. ||1||

Gurbani: ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਸੂਖ ਦੂਖ ॥
Transliteration: aooch neech sookh dookh |
English: High and low, pleasure and pain.

Gurbani: ਧ੍ਰਾਪਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੂਖ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: dhraapas naahee trisanaa bhookh |2|
English: Hunger and thirst are not satisfied. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਰਚਿ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਆਧਿ ॥
Transliteration: man baasanaa rach bikhai biaadh |
English: The mind is engrossed in passion, and the disease of corruption.

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਹਾ ਅਸਾਧ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: panch doot sang mahaa asaadh |3|
English: The five thieves, the companions, are totally incorrigible. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜਹਾਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਧਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jahaan praan dhan teraa |
English: The beings and souls and wealth of the world are all Yours.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਨੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: naanak jaan sadaa har neraa |4|1|19|
English: O Nanak, know that the Lord is always near at hand. ||4||1||19||

[Ang 675 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦੀਨ ਦਰਦ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਰਾਖੈ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: deen darad nivaar tthaakur raakhai jan kee aap |
English: The Lord and Master destroys the pain of the poor; He preserves and protects the honor of His servants.

Gurbani: ਤਰਣ ਤਾਰਣ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਬਿਆਪਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: taran taaran har nidh dookh na sakai biaap |1|
English: The Lord is the ship to carry us across; He is the treasure of virtue - pain cannot touch Him. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਭਜਹੁ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: saadhoo sang bhajahu gupaal |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, meditate, vibrate upon the Lord of the world.

Gurbani: ਆਨ ਸੰਜਮ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਇਹ ਜਤਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਕਲਿ ਕਾਲ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aan sanjam kichh na soojhai ih jatan kaatt kal kaal | rahaau |
English: I cannot think of any other way; make this effort, and make it in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aad ant deaal pooran tis binaa nahee koe |
English: In the beginning, and in the end, there is none other than the perfect, merciful Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: janam maran nivaar har jap simar suaamee soe |2|
English: The cycle of birth and death is ended, chanting the Lord's Name, and remembering the Lord Master in meditation. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬੇਦ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਕਥੈ ਸਾਸਤ ਭਗਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: bed sinmrit kathai saasat bhagat kareh beechaar |
English: The Vedas, the Simritees, the Shaastras and the Lord's devotees contemplate Him;

Gurbani: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: mukat paaeeai saadhasangat binas jaae andhaar |3|
English: liberation is attained in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and the darkness of ignorance is dispelled. ||3||

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਰਾਸਿ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਏਕ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal adhaar jan kaa raas poonjee ek |
English: The lotus feet of the Lord are the support of His humble servants. They are his only capital and investment.

Gurbani: ਤਾਣੁ ਮਾਣੁ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਟੇਕ ॥੪॥੨॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: taan maan deebaan saachaa naanak kee prabh ttek |4|2|20|
English: The True Lord is Nanak's strength, honor and support; He alone is his protection. ||4||2||20||

[Ang 676 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਫਿਰਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਭੇਟੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: firat firat bhette jan saadhoo poorai gur samajhaaeaa |
English: Wandering and roaming around, I met the Holy Perfect Guru, who has taught me.

Gurbani: ਆਨ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਾਂਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aan sagal bidh kaam na aavai har har naam dhiaaeaa |1|
English: All other devices did not work, so I meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਓਟ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: taa te mohi dhaaree ott gopaal |
English: For this reason, I sought the Protection and Support of my Lord, the Cherisher of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਗਲ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saran pario pooran paramesur binase sagal janjaal | rahaau |
English: I sought the Sanctuary of the Perfect Transcendent Lord, and all my entanglements were dissolved. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੁਰਗ ਮਿਰਤ ਪਇਆਲ ਭੂ ਮੰਡਲ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਆਪੇ ਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: surag mirat peaal bhoo manddal sagal biaape maae |
English: Paradise, the earth, the nether regions of the underworld, and the globe of the world - all are engrossed in Maya.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਸਭ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jeea udhaaran sabh kul taaran har har naam dhiaae |2|
English: To save your soul, and liberate all your ancestors, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਗਾਈਐ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: naanak naam niranjan gaaeeai paaeeai sarab nidhaanaa |
English: O Nanak, singing the Naam, the Name of the Immaculate Lord, all treasures are obtained.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਬਿਰਲੇ ਕਾਹੂ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੩॥੩॥੨੧॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa jis dee suaamee birale kaahoo jaanaa |3|3|21|
English: Only that rare person, whom the Lord and Master blesses with His Grace, comes to know this. ||3||3||21||

[Ang 676 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ghar 2 chaupade |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl, Second House, Chau-Padhay:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਸੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: chhodd jaeh se kareh paraal |
English: You shall have to abandon the straw which you have collected.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: kaam na aaveh se janjaal |
English: These entanglements shall be of no use to you.

Gurbani: ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਸਿਉ ਹੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: sang na chaaleh tin siau heet |
English: You are in love with those things that will not go with you.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਬੈਰਾਈ ਸੇਈ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jo bairaaee seee meet |1|
English: You think that your enemies are friends. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aise bharam bhule sansaaraa |
English: In such confusion, the world has gone astray.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਖੋਇ ਗਵਾਰਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: janam padaarath khoe gavaaraa | rahaau |
English: The foolish mortal wastes this precious human life. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਵੈ ਡੀਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: saach dharam nahee bhaavai ddeetthaa |
English: He does not like to see Truth and righteousness.

Gurbani: ਝੂਠ ਧੋਹ ਸਿਉ ਰਚਿਓ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: jhootth dhoh siau rachio meetthaa |
English: He is attached to falsehood and deception; they seem sweet to him.

Gurbani: ਦਾਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: daat piaaree visariaa daataaraa |
English: He loves gifts, but he forgets the Giver.

Gurbani: ਜਾਣੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਰਣੁ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jaanai naahee maran vichaaraa |2|
English: The wretched creature does not even think of death. ||2||

Gurbani: ਵਸਤੁ ਪਰਾਈ ਕਉ ਉਠਿ ਰੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: vasat paraaee kau utth rovai |
English: He cries for the possessions of others.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਸਗਲਾ ਈ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: karam dharam sagalaa ee khovai |
English: He forfeits all the merits of his good deeds and religion.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: hukam na boojhai aavan jaane |
English: He does not understand the Hukam of the Lord's Command, and so he continues coming and going in reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਪਾਪ ਕਰੈ ਤਾ ਪਛੋਤਾਣੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: paap karai taa pachhotaane |3|
English: He sins, and then regrets and repents. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai so paravaan |
English: Whatever pleases You, Lord, that alone is acceptable.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੇ ਭਾਣੇ ਨੋ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: tere bhaane no kurabaan |
English: I am a sacrifice to Your Will.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗਰੀਬੁ ਬੰਦਾ ਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: naanak gareeb bandaa jan teraa |
English: Poor Nanak is Your slave, Your humble servant.

Gurbani: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਇ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੨੨॥
Transliteration: raakh lee saahib prabh meraa |4|1|22|
English: Save me, O my Lord God Master! ||4||1||22||

[Ang 676 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਮਸਕੀਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: mohi masakeen prabh naam adhaar |
English: I am meek and poor; the Name of God is my only Support.

Gurbani: ਖਾਟਣ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੋਜਗਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: khaattan kau har har rojagaar |
English: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is my occupation and earnings.

Gurbani: ਸੰਚਣ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: sanchan kau har eko naam |
English: I gather only the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਆਵੈ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: halat palat taa kai aavai kaam |1|
English: It is useful in both this world and the next. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰੰਗਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: naam rate prabh rang apaar |
English: Imbued with the Love of the Lord God's Infinite Name,

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਏਕ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saadh gaaveh gun ek nirankaar | rahaau |
English: the Holy Saints sing the Glorious Praises of the One Lord, the Formless Lord. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਅਤਿ ਮਸਕੀਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kee sobhaa at masakeenee |
English: The Glory of the Holy Saints comes from their total humility.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਵਡਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਚੀਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: sant vaddaaee har jas cheenee |
English: The Saints realize that their greatness rests in the Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: anad santan kai bhagat govind |
English: Meditating on the Lord of the Universe, the Saints are in bliss.

Gurbani: ਸੂਖੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਚਿੰਦ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sookh santan kai binasee chind |2|
English: The Saints find peace, and their anxieties are dispelled. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਤਨ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ॥
Transliteration: jeh saadh santan hoveh ikatr |
English: Wherever the Holy Saints gather,

Gurbani: ਤਹ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਨਾਦ ਕਵਿਤ ॥
Transliteration: teh har jas gaaveh naad kavit |
English: there they sing the Praises of the Lord, in music and poetry.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਸਭਾ ਮਹਿ ਅਨਦ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: saadh sabhaa meh anad bisraam |
English: In the Society of the Saints, there is bliss and peace.

Gurbani: ਉਨ ਸੰਗੁ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਕਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aun sang so paae jis masatak karaam |3|
English: They alone obtain this Society, upon whose foreheads such destiny is written. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਕਰੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: due kar jorr karee aradaas |
English: With my palms pressed together, I offer my prayer.

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਰਿ ਕਹਾਂ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: charan pakhaar kahaan gunataas |
English: I wash their feet, and chant the Praises of the Lord, the treasure of virtue.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਇਆਲ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: prabh deaal kirapaal hajoor |
English: O God, merciful and compassionate, let me remain in Your Presence.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਸੰਤਾ ਧੂਰਿ ॥੪॥੨॥੨੩॥
Transliteration: naanak jeevai santaa dhoor |4|2|23|
English: Nanak lives, in the dust of the Saints. ||4||2||23||

[Ang 677 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਕਤ ਡਰੈ ਜਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: so kat ddarai ji khasam samaarai |
English: One who contemplates his Lord and Master - why should he be afraid?

Gurbani: ਡਰਿ ਡਰਿ ਪਚੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਵੇਚਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ddar ddar pache manamukh vechaare |1| rahaau |
English: The wretched self-willed manmukhs are ruined through fear and dread. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: sir aoopar maat pitaa guradev |
English: The Divine Guru, my mother and father, is over my head.

Gurbani: ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: safal moorat jaa kee niramal sev |
English: His image brings prosperity; serving Him, we become pure.

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: ek niranjan jaa kee raas |
English: The One Lord, the Immaculate Lord, is our capital.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹੋਵਤ ਪਰਗਾਸ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mil saadhasangat hovat paragaas |1|
English: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, we are illumined and enlightened. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੀਅਨ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭ ਠਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jeean kaa daataa pooran sabh tthaae |
English: The Giver of all beings is totally pervading everywhere.

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kott kales mitteh har naae |
English: Millions of pains are removed by the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਸਗਲਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਾਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: janam maran sagalaa dukh naasai |
English: All the pains of birth and death are taken away

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਾਸੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: guramukh jaa kai man tan baasai |2|
English: from the Gurmukh, within whose mind and body the Lord dwells. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਲਏ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jis no aap le larr laae |
English: He alone, whom the Lord has attached to the hem of His robe,

Gurbani: ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: daragah milai tisai hee jaae |
English: obtains a place in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੇਈ ਭਗਤ ਜਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: seee bhagat ji saache bhaane |
English: They alone are devotees, who are pleasing to the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਮਕਾਲ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਨਿਕਾਣੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jamakaal te bhe nikaane |3|
English: They are freed from the Messenger of Death. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: saachaa saahib sach darabaar |
English: True is the Lord, and True is His Court.

Gurbani: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਉਣੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: keemat kaun kahai beechaar |
English: Who can contemplate and describe His value?

Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਗਲ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt antar sagal adhaar |
English: He is within each and every heart, the Support of all.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਸੰਤ ਰੇਣਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੩॥੨੪॥
Transliteration: naanak jaachai sant renaar |4|3|24|
English: Nanak begs for the dust of the Saints. ||4||3||24||

[Ang 677 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਘਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ਤੂ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਹੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: ghar baahar teraa bharavaasaa too jan kai hai sang |
English: At home, and outside, I place my trust in You; You are always with Your humble servant.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਉ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa preetam prabh apune naam jpau har rang |1|
English: Bestow Your Mercy, O my Beloved God, that I may chant the Lord's Name with love. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: jan kau prabh apane kaa taan |
English: God is the strength of His humble servants.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੂ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਰਾਵਹਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਾ ਮਸਲਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo too kareh karaaveh suaamee saa masalat paravaan | rahaau |
English: Whatever You do, or cause to be done, O Lord and Master, that outcome is acceptable to me. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪਤਿ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਗਤਿ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਧਨੁ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਖੀ ॥
Transliteration: pat paramesar gat naaraaein dhan gupaal gun saakhee |
English: The Transcendent Lord is my honor; the Lord is my emancipation; the glorious sermon of the Lord is my wealth.

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤੀ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਤੀ ॥੨॥੧॥੨੫॥
Transliteration: charan saran naanak daas har har santee ih bidh jaatee |2|1|25|
English: Slave Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord's feet; from the Saints, he has learned this way of life. ||2||1||25||

[Ang 677 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
Transliteration: sagal manorath prabh te paae kantth laae gur raakhe |
English: God has fulfilled all my desires. Holding me close in His embrace, the Guru has saved me.

Gurbani: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਜਲਨਿ ਨ ਦੀਨੇ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਭਾਖੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sansaar saagar meh jalan na deene kinai na dutar bhaakhe |1|
English: He has saved me from burning in the ocean of fire, and now, no one calls it impassible. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: jin kai man saachaa bisvaas |
English: Those who have true faith in their minds,

Gurbani: ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਆਨਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਉਲਾਸੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: pekh pekh suaamee kee sobhaa aanad sadaa ulaas | rahaau |
English: continually behold the Glory of the Lord; they are forever happy and blissful. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਾਖਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: charan saran pooran paramesur antarajaamee saakhio |
English: I seek the Sanctuary of the feet of the Perfect Transcendent Lord, the Searcher of hearts; I behold Him ever-present.
