Gurbani: ਜਾਨਿ ਬੂਝਿ ਅਪਨਾ ਕੀਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਾ ਅੰਕੁਰੁ ਰਾਖਿਓ ॥੨॥੨॥੨੬॥
Transliteration: jaan boojh apanaa keeo naanak bhagatan kaa ankur raakhio |2|2|26|
English: In His wisdom, the Lord has made Nanak His own; He has preserved the roots of His devotees. ||2||2||26||

[Ang 677 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਪੇਖਉ ਤਹ ਹਜੂਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਤਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jeh jeh pekhau teh hajoor door katahu na jaaee |
English: Wherever I look, there I see Him present; He is never far away.

Gurbani: ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਮੈ ਮਨ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: rav rahiaa sarabatr mai man sadaa dhiaaee |1|
English: He is all-pervading, everywhere; O my mind, meditate on Him forever. ||1||

Gurbani: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਨਹੀ ਬੀਛੁੜੈ ਸੋ ਸੰਗੀ ਗਨੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: eet aoot nahee beechhurrai so sangee ganeeai |
English: He alone is called your companion, who will not be separated from you, here or hereafter.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਜੋ ਨਿਮਖ ਮਹਿ ਸੋ ਅਲਪ ਸੁਖੁ ਭਨੀਐ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: binas jaae jo nimakh meh so alap sukh bhaneeai | rahaau |
English: That pleasure, which passes away in an instant, is trivial. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੈ ਅਪਿਆਉ ਦੇਇ ਕਛੁ ਊਨ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: pratipaalai apiaau dee kachh aoon na hoee |
English: He cherishes us, and gives us sustenance; He does not lack anything.

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸੰਮਾਲਤਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saas saas samaalataa meraa prabh soee |2|
English: With each and every breath, my God takes care of His creatures. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਛਲ ਅਛੇਦ ਅਪਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਊਚਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਰੂਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: achhal achhed apaar prabh aoochaa jaa kaa roop |
English: God is undeceiveable, impenetrable and infinite; His form is lofty and exalted.

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਜਨ ਅਚਰਜ ਆਨੂਪੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jap jap kareh anand jan acharaj aanoop |3|
English: Chanting and meditating on the embodiment of wonder and beauty, His humble servants are in bliss. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਿਤੁ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਅਰਾਧਾ ॥
Transliteration: saa mat dehu deaal prabh jit tumeh araadhaa |
English: Bless me with such understanding, O Merciful Lord God, that I might remember You.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰੇਨ ਪਗ ਸਾਧਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੨੭॥
Transliteration: naanak mangai daan prabh ren pag saadhaa |4|3|27|
English: Nanak begs God for the gift of the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||4||3||27||

[Ang 678 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਤੁਮ ਭੇਜੇ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਬੁਲਾਏ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਆਉ ॥
Transliteration: jin tum bheje tineh bulaae sukh sehaj setee ghar aau |
English: The One who sent you, has now recalled you; return to your home now in peace and pleasure.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਮਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: anad mangal gun gaau sehaj dhun nihachal raaj kamaau |1|
English: In bliss and ecstasy, sing His Glorious Praises; by this celestial tune, you shall acquire your everlasting kingdom. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਘਰਿ ਆਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: tum ghar aavahu mere meet |
English: Come back to your home, O my friend.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮਰੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਅਪਦਾ ਭਈ ਬਿਤੀਤ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tumare dokhee har aap nivaare apadaa bhee biteet | rahaau |
English: The Lord Himself has eliminated your enemies, and your misfortunes are past. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਕੀਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਨੇਹਾਰੇ ਨਾਸਨ ਭਾਜਨ ਥਾਕੇ ॥
Transliteration: pragatt keene prabh karanehaare naasan bhaajan thaake |
English: God, the Creator Lord, has glorified you, and your running and rushing around has ended.

Gurbani: ਘਰਿ ਮੰਗਲ ਵਾਜਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਵਾਜੇ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਖਸਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਜੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ghar mangal vaajeh nit vaaje apunai khasam nivaaje |2|
English: In your home, there is rejoicing; the musical instruments continually play, and your Husband Lord has exalted you. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਸਥਿਰ ਰਹਹੁ ਡੋਲਹੁ ਮਤ ਕਬਹੂ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਅਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: asathir rahahu ddolahu mat kabahoo gur kai bachan adhaar |
English: Remain firm and steady, and do not ever waver; take the Guru's Word as your Support.

Gurbani: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਭੂ ਮੰਡਲ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਦਰਬਾਰ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jai jai kaar sagal bhoo manddal mukh aoojal darabaar |3|
English: You shall be applauded and congratulated all over the world, and your face shall be radiant in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਤਿਨੈ ਹੀ ਫੇਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਭਇਆ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jin ke jeea tinai hee fere aape bheaa sahaaee |
English: All beings belong to Him; He Himself transforms them, and He Himself becomes their help and support.

Gurbani: ਅਚਰਜੁ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੪॥੪॥੨੮॥
Transliteration: acharaj keea karanaihaarai naanak sach vaddiaaee |4|4|28|
English: The Creator Lord has worked a wondrous miracle; O Nanak, His glorious greatness is true. ||4||4||28||

[Ang 678 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੬ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ghar 6 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl, Sixth House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਬਿਨਉ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: sunahu sant piaare binau hamaare jeeo |
English: Listen, O Dear Beloved Saints, to my prayer.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਜੀਉ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har bin mukat na kaahoo jeeo | rahaau |
English: Without the Lord, no one is liberated. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਤਾਰਨ ਤਰਨ ਹਰਿ ਅਵਰਿ ਜੰਜਾਲ ਤੇਰੈ ਕਾਹੂ ਨ ਕਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: man niramal karam kar taaran taran har avar janjaal terai kaahoo na kaam jeeo |
English: O mind, do only deeds of purity; the Lord is the only boat to carry you across. Other entanglements shall be of no use to you.

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਨ ਦੇਵਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੇਵਾ ਇਹੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jeevan devaa paarabraham sevaa ihu upades mo kau gur deenaa jeeo |1|
English: True living is serving the Divine, Supreme Lord God; the Guru has imparted this teaching to me. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਨ ਲਾਈਐ ਹੀਤੁ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਬੀਤੁ ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਬਾਰ ਓਹੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: tis siau na laaeeai heet jaa ko kichh naahee beet ant kee baar ohu sang na chaalai |
English: Do not fall in love with trivial things; in the end, they shall not go along with you.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਤੂ ਆਰਾਧ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਾਧ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਛੂਟੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: man tan too aaraadh har ke preetam saadh jaa kai sang tere bandhan chhoottai |2|
English: Worship and adore the Lord with your mind and body, O Beloved Saint of the Lord; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall be released from bondage. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗਹੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਰਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਮਲ ਚਰਨ ਅਵਰ ਆਸ ਕਛੁ ਪਟਲੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: gahu paarabraham saran hiradai kamal charan avar aas kachh pattal na keejai |
English: In your heart, hold fast to the Sanctuary of the lotus feet of the Supreme Lord God; do not place your hopes in any other support.

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਭਗਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਤਪਾ ਸੋਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੩॥੧॥੨੯॥
Transliteration: soee bhagat giaanee dhiaanee tapaa soee naanak jaa kau kirapaa keejai |3|1|29|
English: He alone is a devotee, spiritually wise, a meditator, and a penitent, O Nanak, who is blessed by the Lord's Mercy. ||3||1||29||

[Ang 678 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲ ਭਲੋ ਰੇ ਭਲੋ ਰੇ ਭਲੋ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਗਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: mere laal bhalo re bhalo re bhalo har manganaa |
English: O my dear beloved, it is good, it is better, it is best, to ask for the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਦੇਖਹੁ ਪਸਾਰਿ ਨੈਨ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੇ ਬੈਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਰਾਖੁ ਸਗਲ ਹੈ ਮਰਨਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dekhahu pasaar nain sunahu saadhoo ke bain praanapat chit raakh sagal hai maranaa | rahaau |
English: Behold, with your eyes wide-open, and listen to the Words of the Holy Saints; enshrine in your consciousness the Lord of Life - remember that all must die. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਚੰਦਨ ਚੋਆ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਕਰਤ ਅਨੇਕੈ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਦੇਖੁ ਸਗਲ ਹੈ ਫੀਕੇ ਏਕੈ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਨੀਕੋ ਕਹਤ ਹੈ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ॥
Transliteration: chandan choaa ras bhog karat anekai bikhiaa bikaar dekh sagal hai feeke ekai gobid ko naam neeko kehat hai saadh jan |
English: The application of sandalwood oil, the enjoyment of pleasures and the practice of many corrupt sins - look upon all of these as insipid and worthless. The Name of the Lord of the Universe alone is sublime; so say the Holy Saints.

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਆਪਨ ਥਾਪਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਨ ਨਿਮਖ ਜਾਪਿਓ ਅਰਥੁ ਦ੍ਰਬੁ ਦੇਖੁ ਕਛੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਚਲਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tan dhan aapan thaapio har jap na nimakh jaapio arath drab dekh kachh sang naahee chalanaa |1|
English: You claim that your body and wealth are your own; you do not chant the Lord's Name even for an instant. Look and see, that none of your possessions or riches shall go along with you. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੋ ਰੇ ਕਰਮੁ ਭਲਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਸੰਤ ਪਲਾ ਤਿਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਰੇ ਜਮੁ ਸੰਤਾਵੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaa ko re karam bhalaa tin ott gahee sant palaa tin naahee re jam santaavai saadhoo kee sanganaa |
English: One who has good karma, grasps the Protection of the hem of the Saint's robe; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Messenger of Death cannot threaten him.

Gurbani: ਪਾਇਓ ਰੇ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਮਿਟਿਓ ਹੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਏਕੈ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਲਗਨਾ ॥੨॥੨॥੩੦॥
Transliteration: paaeo re param nidhaan mittio hai abhimaan ekai nirankaar naanak man laganaa |2|2|30|
English: I have obtained the supreme treasure, and my egotism has been eradicated; Nanak's mind is attached to the One Formless Lord. ||2||2||30||

[Ang 679 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੭ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ghar 7 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl, Seventh House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har ek simar ek simar ek simar piaare |
English: Meditate in remembrance on the One Lord; meditate in remembrance on the One Lord; meditate in remembrance on the One Lord, O my Beloved.

Gurbani: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਮਹਾ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਾਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kal kales lobh moh mahaa bhaujal taare | rahaau |
English: He shall save you from strife, suffering, greed, attachment, and the most terrifying world-ocean. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਚਿਤਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: saas saas nimakh nimakh dinas rain chitaare |
English: With each and every breath, each and every instant, day and night, dwell upon Him.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗ ਜਪਿ ਨਿਸੰਗ ਮਨਿ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saadhasang jap nisang man nidhaan dhaare |1|
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, meditate on Him fearlessly, and enshrine the treasure of His Name in your mind. ||1||

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਗੁਨ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal namasakaar gun gobid beechaare |
English: Worship His lotus feet, and contemplate the glorious virtues of the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਰੇਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੰਗਲ ਸੂਖ ਸਧਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੧॥੩੧॥
Transliteration: saadh janaa kee ren naanak mangal sookh sadhaare |2|1|31|
English: O Nanak, the dust of the feet of the Holy shall bless you with pleasure and peace. ||2||1||31||

[Ang 679 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੮ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ghar 8 dupade |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl, Eighth House, Dho-Padhay:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਉ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਉ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: simrau simar simar sukh paavau saas saas samaale |
English: Remembering, remembering, remembering Him in meditation, I find peace; with each and every breath, I dwell upon Him.

Gurbani: ਇਹ ਲੋਕਿ ਪਰਲੋਕਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਮੋਹਿ ਰਖਵਾਲੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: eih lok paralok sang sahaaee jat kat mohi rakhavaale |1|
English: In this world, and in the world beyond, He is with me, as my help and support; wherever I go, He protects me. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਬਸੈ ਜੀਅ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa bachan basai jeea naale |
English: The Guru's Word abides with my soul.

Gurbani: ਜਲਿ ਨਹੀ ਡੂਬੈ ਤਸਕਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਲੇਵੈ ਭਾਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਜਾਲੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jal nahee ddoobai tasakar nahee levai bhaeh na saakai jaale |1| rahaau |
English: It does not sink in water; thieves cannot steal it, and fire cannot burn it. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਧਨ ਕਉ ਧਨੁ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਕਉ ਟਿਕ ਮਾਤ ਦੂਧੁ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: niradhan kau dhan andhule kau ttik maat doodh jaise baale |
English: It is like wealth to the poor, a cane for the blind, and mother's milk for the infant.

Gurbani: ਸਾਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੇ ॥੨॥੧॥੩੨॥
Transliteration: saagar meh bohith paaeo har naanak karee kripaa kirapaale |2|1|32|
English: In the ocean of the world, I have found the boat of the Lord; the Merciful Lord has bestowed His Mercy upon Nanak. ||2||1||32||

[Ang 679 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਿੰਚਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: bhe kripaal deaal gobindaa amrit ridai sinchaaee |
English: The Lord of the Universe has become kind and merciful; His Ambrosial Nectar permeates my heart.

Gurbani: ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੀ ਜਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: nav nidh ridh sidh har laag rahee jan paaee |1|
English: The nine treasures, riches and the miraculous spiritual powers of the Siddhas cling to the feet of the Lord's humble servant. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਨ ਕਉ ਅਨਦੁ ਸਗਲ ਹੀ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: santan kau anad sagal hee jaaee |
English: The Saints are in ecstasy everywhere.

Gurbani: ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਾ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਠਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: grihi baahar tthaakur bhagatan kaa rav rahiaa srab tthaaee |1| rahaau |
English: Within the home, and outside as well, the Lord and Master of His devotees is totally pervading and permeating everywhere. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਹੁਚਨਹਾਰਾ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅੰਗਿ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: taa kau koe na pahuchanahaaraa jaa kai ang gusaaee |
English: No one can equal one who has the Lord of the Universe on his side.

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਮਿਟੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੨॥੨॥੩੩॥
Transliteration: jam kee traas mittai jis simarat naanak naam dhiaaee |2|2|33|
English: The fear of the Messenger of Death is eradicated, remembering Him in meditation; Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||2||33||

[Ang 679 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦਰਬਵੰਤੁ ਦਰਬੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਗਰਬੈ ਭੂਮਵੰਤੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: darabavant darab dekh garabai bhoomavant abhimaanee |
English: The rich man gazes upon his riches, and is proud of himself; the landlord takes pride in his lands.

Gurbani: ਰਾਜਾ ਜਾਨੈ ਸਗਲ ਰਾਜੁ ਹਮਰਾ ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਟੇਕ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: raajaa jaanai sagal raaj hamaraa tiau har jan ttek suaamee |1|
English: The king believes that the whole kingdom belongs to him; in the same way, the humble servant of the Lord looks upon the support of his Lord and Master. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਕੋਊ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਓਟ ਸਮਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: je koaoo apunee ott samaarai |
English: When one considers the Lord to be his only support,

Gurbani: ਜੈਸਾ ਬਿਤੁ ਤੈਸਾ ਹੋਇ ਵਰਤੈ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਬਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਹਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaisaa bit taisaa hoe varatai apunaa bal nahee haarai |1| rahaau |
English: then the Lord uses His power to help him; this power cannot be defeated. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਨ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਭਏ ਇਕ ਆਸਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਕਰਿ ਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: aan tiaag bhe ik aasar saran saran kar aae |
English: Renouncing all others, I have sought the Support of the One Lord; I have come to Him, pleading, "Save me, save me!"

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ॥੨॥੩॥੩੪॥
Transliteration: sant anugrah bhe man niramal naanak har gun gaae |2|3|34|
English: By the kindness and the Grace of the Saints, my mind has been purified; Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||3||34||

[Ang 679 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਗੋ ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਸੋ ਕਹੀਅਤ ਹੈ ਸੂਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kau har rang laago is jug meh so kaheeat hai sooraa |
English: He alone is called a warrior, who is attached to the Lord's Love in this age.

Gurbani: ਆਤਮ ਜਿਣੈ ਸਗਲ ਵਸਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aatam jinai sagal vas taa kai jaa kaa satigur pooraa |1|
English: Through the Perfect True Guru, he conquers his own soul, and then everything comes under his control. ||1||

Gurbani: ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਗਾਈਐ ਆਤਮ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: tthaakur gaaeeai aatam rang |
English: Sing the Praises of the Lord and Master, with the love of your soul.

Gurbani: ਸਰਣੀ ਪਾਵਨ ਨਾਮ ਧਿਆਵਨ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਨ ਸੰਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saranee paavan naam dhiaavan sehaj samaavan sang |1| rahaau |
English: Those who seek His Sanctuary, and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are blended with the Lord in celestial peace. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਵਸਹਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ਦੇਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jan ke charan vaseh merai heearai sang puneetaa dehee |
English: The feet of the Lord's humble servant abide in my heart; with them, my body is made pure.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਏਹੀ ॥੨॥੪॥੩੫॥
Transliteration: jan kee dhoor dehu kirapaa nidh naanak kai sukh ehee |2|4|35|
English: O treasure of mercy, please bless Nanak with the dust of the feet of Your humble servants; this alone brings peace. ||2||4||35||

[Ang 680 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਤਨ ਕਰੈ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਡਹਕਾਵੈ ਓਹੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: jatan karai maanukh ddahakaavai ohu antarajaamee jaanai |
English: People try to deceive others, but the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, knows everything.

Gurbani: ਪਾਪ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਮੂਕਰਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਭੇਖ ਕਰੈ ਨਿਰਬਾਨੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: paap kare kar mookar paavai bhekh karai nirabaanai |1|
English: They commit sins, and then deny them, while they pretend to be in Nirvaanaa. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਾਨਤ ਦੂਰਿ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨੇਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jaanat door tumeh prabh ner |
English: They believe that You are far away, but You, O God, are near at hand.

Gurbani: ਉਤ ਤਾਕੈ ਉਤ ਤੇ ਉਤ ਪੇਖੈ ਆਵੈ ਲੋਭੀ ਫੇਰਿ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aut taakai ut te ut pekhai aavai lobhee fer | rahaau |
English: Looking around, this way and that, the greedy people come and go. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਤੁਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨ ਭਰਮਾ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jab lag tuttai naahee man bharamaa tab lag mukat na koee |
English: As long as the doubts of the mind are not removed, liberation is not found.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੰਤੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥੫॥੩੬॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak deaal suaamee sant bhagat jan soee |2|5|36|
English: Says Nanak, he alone is a Saint, a devotee, and a humble servant of the Lord, to whom the Lord and Master is merciful. ||2||5||36||

[Ang 680 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਓ ਹੈ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਕਰਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: naam gur deeo hai apunai jaa kai masatak karamaa |
English: My Guru gives the Naam, the Name of the Lord, to those who have such karma written on their foreheads.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਧਰਮਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naam drirraavai naam japaavai taa kaa jug meh dharamaa |1|
English: He implants the Naam, and inspires us to chant the Naam; this is Dharma, true religion, in this world. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਕਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਸੋਭ ॥
Transliteration: jan kau naam vaddaaee sobh |
English: The Naam is the glory and greatness of the Lord's humble servant.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੋ ਗਤਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਪਤਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਮਾਨੈ ਜੋ ਜੋ ਹੋਗ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: naamo gat naamo pat jan kee maanai jo jo hog |1| rahaau |
English: The Naam is his salvation, and the Naam is his honor; he accepts whatever comes to pass. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਪਾਲੈ ਸੋਈ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: naam dhan jis jan kai paalai soee pooraa saahaa |
English: That humble servant, who has the Naam as his wealth, is the perfect banker.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਉਹਾਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਧਾਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਲਾਹਾ ॥੨॥੬॥੩੭॥
Transliteration: naam biauhaaraa naanak aadhaaraa naam paraapat laahaa |2|6|37|
English: The Naam is his occupation, O Nanak, and his only support; the Naam is the profit he earns. ||2||6||37||

[Ang 680 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਭਏ ਦਰਸ ਪੇਖੇ ਮਾਥੈ ਪਰਉ ਰਵਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: netr puneet bhe daras pekhe maathai prau ravaal |
English: My eyes have been purified, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, and touching my forehead to the dust of His feet.

Gurbani: ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਉ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਮੋਰੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਸਹੁ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ras ras gun gaavau tthaakur ke morai hiradai basahu gopaal |1|
English: With joy and happiness, I sing the Glorious Praises of my Lord and Master; the Lord of the World abides within my heart. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਤਉ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
Transliteration: tum tau raakhanahaar deaal |
English: You are my Merciful Protector, Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸੁਘਰ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹੋਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sundar sughar beant pitaa prabh hohu prabhoo kirapaal |1| rahaau |
English: O beautiful, wise, infinite Father God, be Merciful to me, God. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਰੂਪ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਬਚਨ ਅਨੂਪ ਰਸਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: mahaa anand mangal roop tumare bachan anoop rasaal |
English: O Lord of supreme ecstasy and blissful form, Your Word is so beautiful, so drenched with Nectar.

Gurbani: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਚਰਣ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਂਧਿਓ ਪਾਲ ॥੨॥੭॥੩੮॥
Transliteration: hiradai charan sabad satigur ko naanak baandhio paal |2|7|38|
English: With the Lord's lotus feet enshrined in his heart, Nanak has tied the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru, to the hem of his robe. ||2||7||38||

[Ang 680 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੀ ਉਕਤਿ ਖਲਾਵੈ ਭੋਜਨ ਅਪਨੀ ਉਕਤਿ ਖੇਲਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: apanee ukat khalaavai bhojan apanee ukat khelaavai |
English: In His own way, He provides us with our food; in His own way, He plays with us.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਭੋਗ ਰਸ ਦੇਵੈ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sarab sookh bhog ras devai man hee naal samaavai |1|
English: He blesses us with all comforts, enjoyments and delicacies, and he permeates our minds. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਮਰੇ ਪਿਤਾ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
Transliteration: hamare pitaa gopaal deaal |
English: Our Father is the Lord of the World, the Merciful Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖੈ ਮਹਤਾਰੀ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਕਉ ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jiau raakhai mahataaree baarik kau taise hee prabh paal |1| rahaau |
English: Just as the mother protects her children, God nurtures and cares for us. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੀਤ ਸਾਜਨ ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਇਕ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: meet saajan sarab gun naaeik sadaa salaamat devaa |
English: You are my friend and companion, the Master of all excellences, O eternal and permanent Divine Lord.

Gurbani: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਤਤ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਸੇਵਾ ॥੨॥੮॥੩੯॥
Transliteration: eet aoot jat kat tat tum hee milai naanak sant sevaa |2|8|39|
English: Here, there and everywhere, You are pervading; please, bless Nanak to serve the Saints. ||2||8||39||

[Ang 680 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਦਮੋਦਰ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਬਿਖੁ ਜਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sant kripaal deaal damodar kaam krodh bikh jaare |
English: The Saints are kind and compassionate; they burn away their sexual desire, anger and corruption.

Gurbani: ਰਾਜੁ ਮਾਲੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਜੀਅਰਾ ਇਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਲੈ ਬਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: raaj maal joban tan jeearaa in aoopar lai baare |1|
English: My power, wealth, youth, body and soul are a sacrifice to them. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਹਿਤਕਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: man tan raam naam hitakaare |
English: With my mind and body, I love the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਸਹਿਤ ਭਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sookh sehaj aanand mangal sahit bhav nidh paar utaare | rahaau |
English: With peace, poise, pleasure and joy, He has carried me across the terrifying world-ocean. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਧੰਨਿ ਸੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਧੰਨਿ ਓਇ ਭਵਨਾ ਜਾ ਮਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਬਸਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: dhan su thaan dhan oe bhavanaa jaa meh sant basaare |
English: Blessed is that place, and blessed is that house, in which the Saints dwell.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਸਰਧਾ ਪੂਰਹੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੯॥੪੦॥
Transliteration: jan naanak kee saradhaa poorahu tthaakur bhagat tere namasakaare |2|9|40|
English: Fulfill this desire of servant Nanak, O Lord Master, that he may bow in reverence to Your devotees. ||2||9||40||

[Ang 681 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਛਡਾਇ ਲੀਓ ਮਹਾ ਬਲੀ ਤੇ ਅਪਨੇ ਚਰਨ ਪਰਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: chhaddaae leeo mahaa balee te apane charan paraat |
English: He has saved me from the awful power of Maya, by attaching me to His feet.

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਓ ਮਨ ਮੰਤਾ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਜਾਤਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ek naam deeo man mantaa binas na katahoo jaat |1|
English: He gave my mind the Mantra of the Naam, the Name of the One Lord, which shall never perish or leave me. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਕੀਨੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: satigur poorai keenee daat |
English: The Perfect True Guru has given this gift.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਓ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਕਉ ਭਈ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਗਾਤਿ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam deeo keeratan kau bhee hamaaree gaat | rahaau |
English: He has blessed me with the Kirtan of the Praises of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and I am emancipated. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਓ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੀ ਰਾਖੀ ਪਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: angeekaar keeo prabh apunai bhagatan kee raakhee paat |
English: My God has made me His own, and saved the honor of His devotee.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਰਨ ਗਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤਿ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੪੧॥
Transliteration: naanak charan gahe prabh apane sukh paaeo din raat |2|10|41|
English: Nanak has grasped the feet of his God, and has found peace, day and night. ||2||10||41||

[Ang 681 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪਰ ਹਰਨਾ ਲੋਭੁ ਝੂਠ ਨਿੰਦ ਇਵ ਹੀ ਕਰਤ ਗੁਦਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: par haranaa lobh jhootth nind iv hee karat gudaaree |
English: Stealing the property of others, acting in greed, lying and slandering - in these ways, he passes his life.

Gurbani: ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਆਸ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਮੀਠੀ ਇਹ ਟੇਕ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਾਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mrig trisanaa aas mithiaa meetthee ih ttek maneh saadhaaree |1|
English: He places his hopes in false mirages, believing them to be sweet; this is the support he installs in his mind. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤ ਕੀ ਆਵਰਦਾ ਜਾਇ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: saakat kee aavaradaa jaae brithaaree |
English: The faithless cynic passes his life uselessly.

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੇ ਕਾਗਦ ਕੇ ਭਾਰ ਮੂਸਾ ਟੂਕਿ ਗਵਾਵਤ ਕਾਮਿ ਨਹੀ ਗਾਵਾਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaise kaagad ke bhaar moosaa ttook gavaavat kaam nahee gaavaaree | rahaau |
English: He is like the mouse, gnawing away at the pile of paper, making it useless to the poor wretch. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਇਹ ਬੰਧਨ ਛੁਟਕਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa paarabraham suaamee ih bandhan chhuttakaaree |
English: Have mercy on me, O Supreme Lord God, and release me from these bonds.

Gurbani: ਬੂਡਤ ਅੰਧ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾਢਤ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਸੰਗਾਰੀ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੪੨॥
Transliteration: booddat andh naanak prabh kaadtat saadh janaa sangaaree |2|11|42|
English: The blind are sinking, O Nanak; God saves them, uniting them with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||11||42||

[Ang 681 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਸੀਤਲ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਛਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: simar simar suaamee prabh apanaa seetal tan man chhaatee |
English: Remembering, remembering God, the Lord Master in meditation, my body, mind and heart are cooled and soothed.

Gurbani: ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਸੂਖ ਧਨੁ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮੋਰੈ ਜਾਤੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: roop rang sookh dhan jeea kaa paarabraham morai jaatee |1|
English: The Supreme Lord God is my beauty, pleasure, peace, wealth, soul and social status. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਨਿ ਮਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: rasanaa raam rasaaein maatee |
English: My tongue is intoxicated with the Lord, the source of nectar.

Gurbani: ਰੰਗ ਰੰਗੀ ਰਾਮ ਅਪਨੇ ਕੈ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਨਿਧਿ ਥਾਤੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: rang rangee raam apane kai charan kamal nidh thaatee | rahaau |
English: I am in love, in love with the Lord's lotus feet, the treasure of riches. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਰਖਿ ਲੀਆ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਭਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: jis kaa saa tin hee rakh leea pooran prabh kee bhaatee |
English: I am His - He has saved me; this is God's perfect way.

Gurbani: ਮੇਲਿ ਲੀਓ ਆਪੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਪਾਤੀ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੪੩॥
Transliteration: mel leeo aape sukhadaatai naanak har raakhee paatee |2|12|43|
English: The Giver of peace has blended Nanak with Himself; the Lord has preserved his honor. ||2||12||43||

[Ang 681 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦੂਤ ਦੁਸਮਨ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਨਿਵਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: doot dusaman sabh tujh te nivareh pragatt prataap tumaaraa |
English: All demons and enemies are eradicated by You, Lord; Your glory is manifest and radiant.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਦੁਖਾਏ ਓਹੁ ਤਤਕਾਲ ਤੁਮ ਮਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jo jo tere bhagat dukhaae ohu tatakaal tum maaraa |1|
English: Whoever harms Your devotees, You destroy in an instant. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਖਉ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਓਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: nirkhau tumaree or har neet |
English: I look to You continually, Lord.

Gurbani: ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ਸਹਾਇ ਹੋਹੁ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਉਧਰਹੁ ਮੀਤ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: muraar sahaae hohu daas kau kar geh udharahu meet | rahaau |
English: O Lord, Destroyer of ego, please, be the helper and companion of Your slaves; take my hand, and save me, O my Friend! ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਖਸਮਾਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: sunee benatee tthaakur merai khasamaanaa kar aap |
English: My Lord and Master has heard my prayer, and given me His protection.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਦ ਭਏ ਦੁਖ ਭਾਗੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੨॥੧੩॥੪੪॥
Transliteration: naanak anad bhe dukh bhaage sadaa sadaa har jaap |2|13|44|
English: Nanak is in ecstasy, and his pains are gone; he meditates on the Lord, forever and ever. ||2||13||44||

[Ang 681 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਚਤੁਰ ਦਿਸਾ ਕੀਨੋ ਬਲੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਰੁ ਧਾਰਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: chatur disaa keeno bal apanaa sir aoopar kar dhaario |
English: He has extended His power in all four directions, and placed His hand upon my head.

Gurbani: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਟਾਖੵ ਅਵਲੋਕਨੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਦਾਸ ਕਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਬਿਦਾਰਿਓ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kripaa kattaakhay avalokan keeno daas kaa dookh bidaario |1|
English: Gazing upon me with his Eye of Mercy, He has dispelled the pains of His slave. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਰਾਖੇ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: har jan raakhe gur govind |
English: The Guru, the Lord of the Universe, has saved the Lord's humble servant.

Gurbani: ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਸਭਿ ਮੇਟੇ ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਖਸੰਦ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kantth laae avagun sabh mette deaal purakh bakhasand | rahaau |
English: Hugging me close in His embrace, the merciful, forgiving Lord has erased all my sins. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਤੇ ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਦੇਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jo maageh tthaakur apune te soee soee devai |
English: Whatever I ask for from my Lord and Master, he gives that to me.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਸਚੁ ਹੋਵੈ ॥੨॥੧੪॥੪੫॥
Transliteration: naanak daas mukh te jo bolai eehaa aoohaa sach hovai |2|14|45|
English: Whatever the Lord's slave Nanak utters with his mouth, proves to be true, here and hereafter. ||2||14||45||

[Ang 682 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਉਖੀ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਦੇਖਣ ਦੇਈ ਅਪਨਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: aaukhee gharree na dekhan deee apanaa birad samaale |
English: He does not let His devotees see the difficult times; this is His innate nature.

Gurbani: ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਰਾਖੈ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਉ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: haath dee raakhai apane kau saas saas pratipaale |1|
English: Giving His hand, He protects His devotee; with each and every breath, He cherishes him. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਮੇਰਾ ਚੀਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: prabh siau laag rahio meraa cheet |
English: My consciousness remains attached to God.

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਧੰਨੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਮੀਤੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aad ant prabh sadaa sahaaee dhan hamaaraa meet | rahaau |
English: In the beginning, and in the end, God is always my helper and companion; blessed is my friend. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਬਿਲਾਸ ਭਏ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੇ ਅਚਰਜ ਦੇਖਿ ਬਡਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: man bilaas bhe saahib ke acharaj dekh baddaaee |
English: My mind is delighted, gazing upon the marvellous, glorious greatness of the Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਆਨਦ ਕਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ॥੨॥੧੫॥੪੬॥
Transliteration: har simar simar aanad kar naanak prabh pooran paij rakhaaee |2|15|46|
English: Remembering, remembering the Lord in meditation, Nanak is in ecstasy; God, in His perfection, has protected and preserved his honor. ||2||15||46||

[Ang 682 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੋਈ ਗਨਹੁ ਅਭਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: jis kau bisarai praanapat daataa soee ganahu abhaagaa |
English: One who forgets the Lord of life, the Great Giver - know that he is most unfortunate.

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਗਿਓ ਅਮਿਅ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਪਾਗਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: charan kamal jaa kaa man raagio amia sarovar paagaa |1|
English: One whose mind is in love with the Lord's lotus feet, obtains the pool of ambrosial nectar. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਜਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਜਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: teraa jan raam naam rang jaagaa |
English: Your humble servant awakes in the Love of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਆਲਸੁ ਛੀਜਿ ਗਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aalas chheej geaa sabh tan te preetam siau man laagaa | rahaau |
English: All laziness has departed from his body, and his mind is attached to the Beloved Lord. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਪੇਖਉ ਤਹ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਮਹਿ ਤਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeh jeh pekhau teh naaraaein sagal ghattaa meh taagaa |
English: Wherever I look, the Lord is there; He is the string, upon which all hearts are strung.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਉਦਕੁ ਪੀਵਤ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਆਗੇ ਸਭਿ ਅਨੁਰਾਗਾ ॥੨॥੧੬॥੪੭॥
Transliteration: naam udak peevat jan naanak tiaage sabh anuraagaa |2|16|47|
English: Drinking in the water of the Naam, servant Nanak has renounced all other loves. ||2||16||47||

[Ang 682 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਏ ਕਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: jan ke pooran hoe kaam |
English: All the affairs of the Lord's humble servant are perfectly resolved.

Gurbani: ਕਲੀ ਕਾਲ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਹਿ ਲਜਾ ਰਾਖੀ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kalee kaal mahaa bikhiaa meh lajaa raakhee raam |1| rahaau |
English: In the utterly poisonous Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Lord preserves and protects his honor. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: simar simar suaamee prabh apunaa nikatt na aavai jaam |
English: Remembering, remembering God, his Lord and Master in meditation, the Messenger of Death does not approach him.

Gurbani: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਧਾਮ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mukat baikuntth saadh kee sangat jan paaeo har kaa dhaam |1|
English: Liberation and heaven are found in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; his humble servant finds the home of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਥਾਤੀ ਕੋਟਿ ਸੂਖ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal har jan kee thaatee kott sookh bisraam |
English: The Lord's lotus feet are the treasure of His humble servant; in them, he finds millions of pleasures and comforts.

Gurbani: ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਦਮੋਦਰ ਸਿਮਰਉ ਦਿਨ ਰੈਨਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ॥੨॥੧੭॥੪੮॥
Transliteration: gobind damodar simrau din rain naanak sad kurabaan |2|17|48|
English: He remembers the Lord God in meditation, day and night; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to him. ||2||17||48||

[Ang 682 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਾਂਗਉ ਰਾਮ ਤੇ ਇਕੁ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: maangau raam te ik daan |
English: I beg for one gift only from the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਸਿਮਰਉ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sagal manorath pooran hoveh simrau tumaraa naam |1| rahaau |
English: May all my desires be fulfilled, meditating on, and remembering Your Name, O Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਾਸਹਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: charan tumaare hiradai vaaseh santan kaa sang paavau |
English: May Your feet abide within my heart, and may I find the Society of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਸੋਗ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sog agan meh man na viaapai aatth pehar gun gaavau |1|
English: May my mind not be afflicted by the fire of sorrow; may I sing Your Glorious Praises, twenty-four hours a day. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸ੍ਵਸਤਿ ਬਿਵਸਥਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਮਧੵੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਪਣ ॥
Transliteration: svasat bivasathaa har kee sevaa madhayant prabh jaapan |
English: May I serve the Lord in my childhood and youth, and meditate on God in my middle and old age.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਗਾ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਜਨਮ ਨ ਛਾਪਣ ॥੨॥੧੮॥੪੯॥
Transliteration: naanak rang lagaa paramesar baahurr janam na chhaapan |2|18|49|
English: O Nanak, one who is imbued with the Love of the Transcendent Lord, is not reincarnated again to die. ||2||18||49||

[Ang 682 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਾਂਗਉ ਰਾਮ ਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਥੋਕ ॥
Transliteration: maangau raam te sabh thok |
English: I beg only from the Lord for all things.

Gurbani: ਮਾਨੁਖ ਕਉ ਜਾਚਤ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਮੋਖ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: maanukh kau jaachat sram paaeeai prabh kai simaran mokh |1| rahaau |
English: I would hesitate to beg from other people. Remembering God in meditation, liberation is obtained. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਘੋਖੇ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪੁਰਾਨਾਂ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਕਾਰਹਿ ਘੋਖ ॥
Transliteration: ghokhe mun jan sinmrit puraanaan bed pukaareh ghokh |
English: I have studied with the silent sages, and carefully read the Simritees, the Puraanas and the Vedas; they all proclaim that,

Gurbani: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਦੋਵੈ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਲੋਕ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kripaa sindh sev sach paaeeai dovai suhele lok |1|
English: by serving the Lord, the ocean of mercy, Truth is obtained, and both this world and the next are embellished. ||1||

Gurbani: ਆਨ ਅਚਾਰ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਹੈ ਜੇਤੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਫੋਕ ॥
Transliteration: aan achaar biauhaar hai jete bin har simaran fok |
English: All other rituals and customs are useless, without remembering the Lord in meditation.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭੈ ਕਾਟੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸੋਕ ॥੨॥੧੯॥੫੦॥
Transliteration: naanak janam maran bhai kaatte mil saadhoo binase sok |2|19|50|
English: O Nanak, the fear of birth and death has been removed; meeting the Holy Saint, sorrow is dispelled. ||2||19||50||

[Ang 682 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੁਝੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ॥
Transliteration: trisanaa bujhai har kai naam |
English: Desire is quenched, through the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mahaa santokh hovai gur bachanee prabh siau laagai pooran dhiaan |1| rahaau |
English: Great peace and contentment come through the Guru's Word, and one's meditation is perfectly focused upon God. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਕਲੋਲ ਬੁਝਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
Transliteration: mahaa kalol bujheh maaeaa ke kar kirapaa mere deen deaal |
English: Please shower Your Mercy upon me, and permit me to ignore the great enticements of Maya, O Lord, Merciful to the meek.

Gurbani: ਅਪਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਇ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਘਾਲ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: apanaa naam dehi jap jeevaa pooran hoe daas kee ghaal |1|
English: Give me Your Name - chanting it, I live; please bring the efforts of Your slave to fruition. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਰਾਜ ਸੂਖ ਰਸ ਸਦ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sarab manorath raaj sookh ras sad khuseea keeratan jap naam |
English: All desires, power, pleasure, joy and lasting bliss, are found by chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and singing the Kirtan of His Praises.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮ ॥੨॥੨੦॥੫੧॥
Transliteration: jis kai karam likhiaa dhur karatai naanak jan ke pooran kaam |2|20|51|
English: That humble servant of the Lord, who has such karma pre-ordained by the Creator Lord, O Nanak - his efforts are brought to perfect fruition. ||2||20||51||

[Ang 683 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਕੀਨੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਸਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: jan kee keenee paarabraham saar |
English: The Supreme Lord God takes care of His humble servant.

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਟਿਕਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਨਿ ਮੂਲੇ ਊਡਿ ਗਏ ਬੇਕਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: nindak ttikan na paavan moole aoodd ge bekaar |1| rahaau |
English: The slanderers are not allowed to stay; they are pulled out by their roots, like useless weeds. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਹੁਚਨਹਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: jeh jeh dekhau teh teh suaamee koe na pahuchanahaar |
English: Wherever I look, there I see my Lord and Master; no one can harm me.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਰੈ ਅਵਗਿਆ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਹੋਇ ਗਇਆ ਤਤ ਛਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jo jo karai avagiaa jan kee hoe geaa tat chhaar |1|
English: Whoever shows disrespect to the Lord's humble servant, is instantly reduced to ashes. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਰਨਹਾਰੁ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ਹੋਆ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: karanahaar rakhavaalaa hoaa jaa kaa ant na paaraavaar |
English: The Creator Lord has become my protector; He has no end or limitation.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਰਖੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਾਢੇ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੨੧॥੫੨॥
Transliteration: naanak daas rakhe prabh apunai nindak kaadte maar |2|21|52|
English: O Nanak, God has protected and saved His slaves; He has driven out and destroyed the slanderers. ||2||21||52||

[Ang 683 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੯ ਪੜਤਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ghar 9 parrataal |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl, Ninth House, Partaal:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨਾ ਦਾਸ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: har charan saran gobind dukh bhanjanaa daas apune kau naam devahu |
English: O Lord, I seek the Sanctuary of Your feet; Lord of the Universe, Destroyer of pain, please bless Your slave with Your Name.

Gurbani: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਤਾਰਹੁ ਭੁਜਾ ਗਹਿ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: drisatt prabh dhaarahu kripaa kar taarahu bhujaa geh koop te kaadt levahu | rahaau |
English: Be Merciful, God, and bless me with Your Glance of Grace; take my arm and save me - pull me up out of this pit! ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਕਰਿ ਅੰਧ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਬੰਧ ਅਨਿਕ ਦੋਖਾ ਤਨਿ ਛਾਦਿ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh kar andh maaeaa ke bandh anik dokhaa tan chhaad poore |
English: He is blinded by sexual desire and anger, bound by Maya; his body and clothes are filled with countless sins.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨਾ ਆਨ ਨ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਾਵਹੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਸੂਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: prabh binaa aan na raakhanahaaraa naam simaraavahu saran soore |1|
English: Without God, there is no other protector; help me to chant Your Name, Almighty Warrior, Sheltering Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣਾ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਤਾਰਣਾ ਬੇਦ ਉਚਾਰ ਨਹੀ ਅੰਤੁ ਪਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: patit udhaaranaa jeea jant taaranaa bed uchaar nahee ant paaeo |
English: Redeemer of sinners, Saving Grace of all beings and creatures, even those who recite the Vedas have not found Your limit.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣਹ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਰਤਨਾਗਰਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗਾਇਓ ॥੨॥੧॥੫੩॥
Transliteration: gunah sukh saagaraa braham ratanaagaraa bhagat vachhal naanak gaaeo |2|1|53|
English: God is the ocean of virtue and peace, the source of jewels; Nanak sings the Praises of the Lover of His devotees. ||2||1||53||

[Ang 683 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਲਤਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਲਤਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਿਮਰਨੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕਾ ਸਦਾ ਲੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: halat sukh palat sukh nit sukh simarano naam gobind kaa sadaa leejai |
English: Peace in this world, peace in the next world and peace forever, remembering Him in meditation. Chant forever the Name of the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਮਿਟਹਿ ਕਮਾਣੇ ਪਾਪ ਚਿਰਾਣੇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਮੁਆ ਜੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mitteh kamaane paap chiraane saadhasangat mil muaa jeejai |1| rahaau |
English: The sins of past lives are erased, by joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; new life is infused into the dead. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਰਾਜ ਜੋਬਨ ਬਿਸਰੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਏਹੁ ਮਹਾਂਤ ਕਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: raaj joban bisarant har maaeaa mahaa dukh ehu mahaant kahai |
English: In power, youth and Maya, the Lord is forgotten; this is the greatest tragedy - so say the spiritual sages.

Gurbani: ਆਸ ਪਿਆਸ ਰਮਣ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਏਹੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਭਾਗਵੰਤੁ ਲਹੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aas piaas raman har keeratan ehu padaarath bhaagavant lahai |1|
English: Hope and desire to sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises - this is the treasure of the most fortunate devotees. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਰਣਿ ਸਮਰਥ ਅਕਥ ਅਗੋਚਰਾ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: saran samarath akath agocharaa patit udhaaran naam teraa |
English: O Lord of Sanctuary, all-powerful, imperceptible and unfathomable - Your Name is the Purifier of sinners.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਰਬਤ ਪੂਰਨ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੨॥੨॥੫੪॥
Transliteration: antarajaamee naanak ke suaamee sarabat pooran tthaakur meraa |2|2|54|
English: The Inner-knower, the Lord and Master of Nanak is totally pervading and permeating everywhere; He is my Lord and Master. ||2||2||54||

[Ang 683 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧੨ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ghar 12 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl, Twelfth House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਬੰਦਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਬੰਦਨਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਰਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bandanaa har bandanaa gun gaavahu gopaal raae | rahaau |
English: I bow in reverence to the Lord, I bow in reverence. I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, my King. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਭੇਟੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: vaddai bhaag bhette guradevaa |
English: By great good fortune, one meets the Divine Guru.

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰਾਧ ਮਿਟੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kott paraadh mitte har sevaa |1|
English: Millions of sins are erased by serving the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal jaa kaa man raapai |
English: One whose mind is imbued with the Lord's lotus feet

Gurbani: ਸੋਗ ਅਗਨਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sog agan tis jan na biaapai |2|
English: is not afflicted by the fire of sorrow. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: saagar tariaa saadhoo sange |
English: He crosses over the world-ocean in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: nirbhau naam japahu har range |3|
English: He chants the Name of the Fearless Lord, and is imbued with the Lord's Love. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪਰ ਧਨ ਦੋਖ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਪ ਨ ਫੇੜੇ ॥
Transliteration: par dhan dokh kichh paap na ferre |
English: One who does not steal the wealth of others, who does not commit evil deeds or sinful acts

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨੇੜੇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jam jandaar na aavai nerre |4|
English: - the Messenger of Death does not even approach him. ||4||

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: trisanaa agan prabh aap bujhaaee |
English: God Himself quenches the fires of desire.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਧਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੫॥੧॥੫੫॥
Transliteration: naanak udhare prabh saranaaee |5|1|55|
English: O Nanak, in God's Sanctuary, one is saved. ||5||1||55||

[Ang 684 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਭਈ ਸਚੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tripat bhee sach bhojan khaaeaa |
English: I am satisfied and satiated, eating the food of Truth.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: man tan rasanaa naam dhiaaeaa |1|
English: With my mind, body and tongue, I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਵਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeevanaa har jeevanaa |
English: Life, spiritual life, is in the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jeevan har jap saadhasang |1| rahaau |
English: Spiritual life consists of chanting the Lord's Name in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰੀ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਓਢਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: anik prakaaree basatr odtaae |
English: He is dressed in robes of all sorts,

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: anadin keeratan har gun gaae |2|
English: if he sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Glorious Praises, day and night. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਸਤੀ ਰਥ ਅਸੁ ਅਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: hasatee rath as asavaaree |
English: He rides upon elephants, chariots and horses,

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har kaa maarag ridai nihaaree |3|
English: if he sees the Lord's Path within his own heart. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: man tan antar charan dhiaaeaa |
English: Meditating on the Lord's Feet, deep within his mind and body,

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੨॥੫੬॥
Transliteration: har sukh nidhaan naanak daas paaeaa |4|2|56|
English: slave Nanak has found the Lord, the treasure of peace. ||4||2||56||

[Ang 684 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur ke charan jeea kaa nisataaraa |
English: The Guru's feet emancipate the soul.

Gurbani: ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਤਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: samund saagar jin khin meh taaraa |1| rahaau |
English: They carry it across the world-ocean in an instant. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਹੋਆ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਰਤੁ ਕੋਈ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: koee hoaa kram rat koee teerath naaeaa |
English: Some love rituals, and some bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

Gurbani: ਦਾਸੰੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: daasanee har kaa naam dhiaaeaa |1|
English: The Lord's slaves meditate on His Name. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਨਹਾਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: bandhan kaattanahaar suaamee |
English: The Lord Master is the Breaker of bonds.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥੨॥੩॥੫੭॥
Transliteration: jan naanak simarai antarajaamee |2|3|57|
English: Servant Nanak meditates in remembrance on the Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||2||3||57||

[Ang 684 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਿਤੈ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰਿ ਨ ਤੂਟਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: kitai prakaar na toottau preet |
English: The lifestyle of Your slave is so pure,

Gurbani: ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: daas tere kee niramal reet |1| rahaau |
English: That nothing can break his love for You. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮਨ ਧਨ ਤੇ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeea praan man dhan te piaaraa |
English: He is more dear to me than my soul, my breath of life, my mind and my wealth.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਬੰਧੁ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: haumai bandh har devanahaaraa |1|
English: The Lord is the Giver, the Restrainer of the ego. ||1||

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗਉ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal siau laagau nehu |
English: I am in love with the Lord's lotus feet.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਏਹ ॥੨॥੪॥੫੮॥
Transliteration: naanak kee benantee eh |2|4|58|
English: This alone is Nanak's prayer. ||2||4||58||

[Ang 684 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 9 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Ninth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੇ ਰੇ ਬਨ ਖੋਜਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kaahe re ban khojan jaaee |
English: Why do you go looking for Him in the forest?

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਸਦਾ ਅਲੇਪਾ ਤੋਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sarab nivaasee sadaa alepaa tohee sang samaaee |1| rahaau |
English: Although he is unattached, he dwells everywhere. He is always with you as your companion. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪੁਹਪ ਮਧਿ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਸੁ ਬਸਤੁ ਹੈ ਮੁਕਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਛਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: puhap madh jiau baas basat hai mukar maeh jaise chhaaee |
English: Like the fragrance which remains in the flower, and like the reflection in the mirror,

Gurbani: ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਬਸੇ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਘਟ ਹੀ ਖੋਜਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: taise hee har base nirantar ghatt hee khojahu bhaaee |1|
English: the Lord dwells deep within; search for Him within your own heart, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਇਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬਤਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: baahar bheetar eko jaanahu ihu gur giaan bataaee |
English: Outside and inside, know that there is only the One Lord; the Guru has imparted this wisdom to me.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਆਪਾ ਚੀਨੈ ਮਿਟੈ ਨ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੀ ਕਾਈ ॥੨॥੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak bin aapaa cheenai mittai na bhram kee kaaee |2|1|
English: O servant Nanak, without knowing one's own self, the moss of doubt is not removed. ||2||1||

[Ang 684 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 9 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Ninth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੋ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਭਰਮ ਭੁਲਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: saadho ihu jag bharam bhulaanaa |
English: O Holy people, this world is deluded by doubt.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਹਾਥਿ ਬਿਕਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam kaa simaran chhoddiaa maaeaa haath bikaanaa |1| rahaau |
English: It has forsaken the meditative remembrance of the Lord's Name, and sold itself out to Maya. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਰਸਿ ਲਪਟਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: maat pitaa bhaaee sut banitaa taa kai ras lapattaanaa |
English: Mother, father, siblings, children and spouse - he is entangled in their love.

Gurbani: ਜੋਬਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਤਾ ਕੈ ਮਦ ਮੈ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਵਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: joban dhan prabhataa kai mad mai ahinis rahai divaanaa |1|
English: In the pride of youth, wealth and glory, day and night, he remains intoxicated. ||1||

Gurbani: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਲਗਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: deen deaal sadaa dukh bhanjan taa siau man na lagaanaa |
English: God is merciful to the meek, and forever the Destroyer of pain, but the mortal does not center his mind on Him.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੋਟਨ ਮੈ ਕਿਨਹੂ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥੨॥੨॥
Transliteration: jan naanak kottan mai kinahoo guramukh hoe pachhaanaa |2|2|
English: O servant Nanak, among millions, only a rare few, as Gurmukh, realize God. ||2||2||

[Ang 685 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 9 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Ninth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤਿਹ ਜੋਗੀ ਕਉ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਨਉ ॥
Transliteration: tih jogee kau jugat na jaanau |
English: That Yogi does not know the way.

Gurbani: ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਮਤਾ ਫੁਨਿ ਜਿਹ ਘਟਿ ਮਾਹਿ ਪਛਾਨਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: lobh moh maaeaa mamataa fun jih ghatt maeh pachhaanau |1| rahaau |
English: Understand that his heart is filled with greed, emotional attachment, Maya and egotism. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਹ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕੰਚਨ ਲੋਹ ਸਮਾਨੋ ॥
Transliteration: par nindaa usatat neh jaa kai kanchan loh samaano |
English: One who does not slander or praise others, who looks upon gold and iron alike,

Gurbani: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਤੇ ਰਹੈ ਅਤੀਤਾ ਜੋਗੀ ਤਾਹਿ ਬਖਾਨੋ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: harakh sog te rahai ateetaa jogee taeh bakhaano |1|
English: who is free from pleasure and pain - he alone is called a true Yogi. ||1||

Gurbani: ਚੰਚਲ ਮਨੁ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਕਉ ਧਾਵਤ ਅਚਲ ਜਾਹਿ ਠਹਰਾਨੋ ॥
Transliteration: chanchal man deh dis kau dhaavat achal jaeh tthaharaano |
English: The restless mind wanders in the ten directions - it needs to be pacified and restrained.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੋ ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਮਾਨੋ ॥੨॥੩॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak ih bidh ko jo nar mukat taeh tum maano |2|3|
English: Says Nanak, whoever knows this technique is judged to be liberated. ||2||3||

[Ang 685 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 9 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Ninth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਮੈ ਕਉਨੁ ਉਪਾਉ ਕਰਉ ॥
Transliteration: ab mai kaun upaau krau |
English: Now, what efforts should I make?

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਨ ਕੋ ਸੰਸਾ ਚੂਕੈ ਭਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jih bidh man ko sansaa chookai bhau nidh paar prau |1| rahaau |
English: How can I dispel the anxieties of my mind? How can I cross over the terrifying world-ocean? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਾਇ ਕਛੁ ਭਲੋ ਨ ਕੀਨੋ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਅਧਿਕ ਡਰਉ ॥
Transliteration: janam paae kachh bhalo na keeno taa te adhik ddrau |
English: Obtaining this human incarnation, I have done no good deeds; this makes me very afraid!

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਨਹੀ ਗਾਏ ਯਹ ਜੀਅ ਸੋਚ ਧਰਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: man bach kram har gun nahee gaae yeh jeea soch dhrau |1|
English: In thought, word and deed, I have not sung the Lord's Praises; this thought worries my mind. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਕਛੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਪਸੁ ਜਿਉ ਉਦਰੁ ਭਰਉ ॥
Transliteration: guramat sun kachh giaan na upajio pas jiau udar bhrau |
English: I listened to the Guru's Teachings, but spiritual wisdom did not well up within me; like a beast, I fill my belly.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਪਛਾਨਉ ਤਬ ਹਉ ਪਤਿਤ ਤਰਉ ॥੨॥੪॥੯॥੯॥੧੩॥੫੮॥੪॥੯੩॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak prabh birad pachhaanau tab hau patit trau |2|4|9|9|13|58|4|93|
English: Says Nanak, O God, please confirm Your Law of Grace; for only then can I, the sinner, be saved. ||2||4||9||9||13||58||4||93||

[Ang 685 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 1 ghar 2 asattapadeea |
English: Dhanaasaree, First Mehl, Second House, Ashtpadheeyaa:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਰਤਨੀ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur saagar ratanee bharapoore |
English: The Guru is the ocean, filled with pearls.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸੰਤ ਚੁਗਹਿ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: amrit sant chugeh nahee doore |
English: The Saints gather in the Ambrosial Nectar; they do not go far away from there.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚੋਗ ਚੁਗਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: har ras chog chugeh prabh bhaavai |
English: They taste the subtle essence of the Lord; they are loved by God.

Gurbani: ਸਰਵਰ ਮਹਿ ਹੰਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saravar meh hans praanapat paavai |1|
English: Within this pool, the swans find their Lord, the Lord of their souls. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਬਗੁ ਬਪੁੜਾ ਛਪੜੀ ਨਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa bag bapurraa chhaparree naae |
English: What can the poor crane accomplish by bathing in the mud puddle?

Gurbani: ਕੀਚੜਿ ਡੂਬੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: keecharr ddoobai mail na jaae |1| rahaau |
English: It sinks into the mire, and its filth is not washed away. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਰਖਿ ਰਖਿ ਚਰਨ ਧਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: rakh rakh charan dhare veechaaree |
English: After careful deliberation, the thoughtful person takes a step.

Gurbani: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਛੋਡਿ ਭਏ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: dubidhaa chhodd bhe nirankaaree |
English: Forsaking duality, he becomes a devotee of the Formless Lord.

Gurbani: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਚਾਖੇ ॥
Transliteration: mukat padaarath har ras chaakhe |
English: He obtains the treasure of liberation, and enjoys the sublime essence of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣ ਰਹੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aavan jaan rahe gur raakhe |2|
English: His comings and goings end, and the Guru protects him. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਰਵਰ ਹੰਸਾ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: saravar hansaa chhodd na jaae |
English: The swan do not leave this pool.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: prem bhagat kar sehaj samaae |
English: In loving devotional worship, they merge in the Celestial Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਰਵਰ ਮਹਿ ਹੰਸੁ ਹੰਸ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: saravar meh hans hans meh saagar |
English: The swans are in the pool, and the pool is in the swans.

Gurbani: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਆਦਰੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: akath kathaa gur bachanee aadar |3|
English: They speak the Unspoken Speech, and they honor and revere the Guru's Word. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਨ ਮੰਡਲ ਇਕੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਬੈਸੇ ॥
Transliteration: sun manddal ik jogee baise |
English: The Yogi, the Primal Lord, sits within the celestial sphere of deepest Samaadhi.

Gurbani: ਨਾਰਿ ਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਕੋਊ ਕੈਸੇ ॥
Transliteration: naar na purakh kahahu koaoo kaise |
English: He is not male, and He is not female; how can anyone describe Him?

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: tribhavan jot rahe liv laaee |
English: The three worlds continue to center their attention on His Light.

Gurbani: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਨਾਥ ਸਚੇ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: sur nar naath sache saranaaee |4|
English: The silent sages and the Yogic masters seek the Sanctuary of the True Lord. ||4||

Gurbani: ਆਨੰਦ ਮੂਲੁ ਅਨਾਥ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: aanand mool anaath adhaaree |
English: The Lord is the source of bliss, the support of the helpless.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh bhagat sehaj beechaaree |
English: The Gurmukhs worship and contemplate the Celestial Lord.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਭੈ ਕਾਟਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat vachhal bhai kaattanahaare |
English: God is the Lover of His devotees, the Destroyer of fear.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਗੁ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: haumai maar mile pag dhaare |5|
English: Subduing ego, one meets the Lord, and places his feet on the Path. ||5||

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਸੰਤਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: anik jatan kar kaal santaae |
English: He makes many efforts, but still, the Messenger of Death tortures him.

Gurbani: ਮਰਣੁ ਲਿਖਾਇ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ ਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: maran likhaae manddal meh aae |
English: Destined only to die, he comes into the world.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: janam padaarath dubidhaa khovai |
English: He wastes this precious human life through duality.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਨ ਚੀਨਸਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਰੋਵੈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: aap na cheenas bhram bhram rovai |6|
English: He does not know his own self, and trapped by doubts, he cries out in pain. ||6||

Gurbani: ਕਹਤਉ ਪੜਤਉ ਸੁਣਤਉ ਏਕ ॥
Transliteration: kahtau parrtau suntau ek |
English: Speak, read and hear of the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਧੀਰਜ ਧਰਮੁ ਧਰਣੀਧਰ ਟੇਕ ॥
Transliteration: dheeraj dharam dharaneedhar ttek |
English: The Support of the earth shall bless you with courage, righteousness and protection.

Gurbani: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jat sat sanjam ridai samaae |
English: Chastity, purity and self-restraint are infused into the heart,

Gurbani: ਚਉਥੇ ਪਦ ਕਉ ਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਪਤੀਆਏ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: chauthe pad kau je man pateeae |7|
English: when one centers his mind in the fourth state. ||7||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: saache niramal mail na laagai |
English: They are immaculate and true, and filth does not stick to them.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਭਰਮ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad bharam bhau bhaagai |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, their doubt and fear depart.

Gurbani: ਸੂਰਤਿ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਆਦਿ ਅਨੂਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: soorat moorat aad anoop |
English: The form and personality of the Primal Lord are incomparably beautiful.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਰੂਪੁ ॥੮॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak jaachai saach saroop |8|1|
English: Nanak begs for the Lord, the Embodiment of Truth. ||8||1||

[Ang 686 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 1 |
English: Dhanaasaree, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj milai miliaa paravaan |
English: That union with the Lord is acceptable, which is united in intuitive poise.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: naa tis maran na aavan jaan |
English: Thereafter, one does not die, and does not come and go in reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮਹਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਦਾਸ ਮਹਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: tthaakur meh daas daas meh soe |
English: The Lord's slave is in the Lord, and the Lord is in His slave.

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jeh dekhaa teh avar na koe |1|
English: Wherever I look, I see none other than the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh bhagat sehaj ghar paaeeai |
English: The Gurmukhs worship the Lord, and find His celestial home.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਮਰਿ ਆਈਐ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bin gur bhette mar aaeeai jaaeeai |1| rahaau |
English: Without meeting the Guru, they die, and come and go in reincarnation. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਉ ਜਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: so gur krau ji saach drirraavai |
English: So make Him your Guru, who implants the Truth within you,

Gurbani: ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥਾਵੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: akath kathaavai sabad milaavai |
English: who leads you to speak the Unspoken Speech, and who merges you in the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਗ ਅਵਰ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har ke log avar nahee kaaraa |
English: God's people have no other work to do;

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਉ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saachau tthaakur saach piaaraa |2|
English: they love the True Lord and Master, and they love the Truth. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਚਾ ॥
Transliteration: tan meh manooaa man meh saachaa |
English: The mind is in the body, and the True Lord is in the mind.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਾਚਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਰਾਚਾ ॥
Transliteration: so saachaa mil saache raachaa |
English: Merging into the True Lord, one is absorbed into Truth.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਕੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਲਾਗੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sevak prabh kai laagai paae |
English: God's servant bows at His feet.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: satigur pooraa milai milaae |3|
English: Meeting the True Guru, one meets with the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: aap dikhaavai aape dekhai |
English: He Himself watches over us, and He Himself makes us see.

Gurbani: ਹਠਿ ਨ ਪਤੀਜੈ ਨਾ ਬਹੁ ਭੇਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: hatth na pateejai naa bahu bhekhai |
English: He is not pleased by stubborn-mindedness, nor by various religious robes.

Gurbani: ਘੜਿ ਭਾਡੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gharr bhaadde jin amrit paaeaa |
English: He fashioned the body-vessels, and infused the Ambrosial Nectar into them;

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮਨੁ ਪਤੀਆਇਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: prem bhagat prabh man pateeaeaa |4|
English: God's Mind is pleased only by loving devotional worship. ||4||

Gurbani: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਭੂਲਹਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: parr parr bhooleh chottaa khaeh |
English: Reading and studying, one becomes confused, and suffers punishment.

Gurbani: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: bahut siaanap aaveh jaeh |
English: By great cleverness, one is consigned to coming and going in reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਭਉ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: naam japai bhau bhojan khaae |
English: One who chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and eats the food of the Fear of God

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: guramukh sevak rahe samaae |5|
English: becomes Gurmukh, the Lord's servant, and remains absorbed in the Lord. ||5||

Gurbani: ਪੂਜਿ ਸਿਲਾ ਤੀਰਥ ਬਨ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: pooj silaa teerath ban vaasaa |
English: He worships stones, dwells at sacred shrines of pilgrimage and in the jungles,

Gurbani: ਭਰਮਤ ਡੋਲਤ ਭਏ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: bharamat ddolat bhe udaasaa |
English: wanders, roams around and becomes a renunciate.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਮੈਲੈ ਸੂਚਾ ਕਿਉ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: man mailai soochaa kiau hoe |
English: But his mind is still filthy - how can he become pure?

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਾਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: saach milai paavai pat soe |6|
English: One who meets the True Lord obtains honor. ||6||

Gurbani: ਆਚਾਰਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਸਰੀਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: aachaaraa veechaar sareer |
English: One who embodies good conduct and contemplative meditation,

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: aad jugaad sehaj man dheer |
English: his mind abides in intuitive poise and contentment, since the beginning of time, and throughout the ages.

Gurbani: ਪਲ ਪੰਕਜ ਮਹਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: pal pankaj meh kott udhaare |
English: In the twinkling of an eye, he saves millions.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa gur mel piaare |7|
English: Have mercy on me, O my Beloved, and let me meet the Guru. ||7||

Gurbani: ਕਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: kis aagai prabh tudh saalaahee |
English: Unto whom, O God, should I praise You?

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਮੈ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: tudh bin doojaa mai ko naahee |
English: Without You, there is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖੁ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jiau tudh bhaavai tiau raakh rajaae |
English: As it pleases You, keep me under Your Will.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਭਾਇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੮॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak sehaj bhaae gun gaae |8|2|
English: Nanak, with intuitive poise and natural love, sings Your Glorious Praises. ||8||2||

[Ang 686 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੬ ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ghar 6 asattapadee |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl, Sixth House, Ashtapadee:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਜੂਨੀ ਆਇਓ ਤਿਹ ਤਿਹ ਉਰਝਾਇਓ ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਸੰਜੋਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jo jo joonee aaeo tih tih urajhaaeo maanas janam sanjog paaeaa |
English: Whoever is born into the world, is entangled in it; human birth is obtained only by good destiny.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਹੈ ਓਟ ਸਾਧ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਥ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: taa kee hai ott saadh raakhahu de kar haath kar kirapaa melahu har raaeaa |1|
English: I look to Your support, O Holy Saint; give me Your hand, and protect me. By Your Grace, let me meet the Lord, my King. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਨਮ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਥਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: anik janam bhram thit nahee paaee |
English: I wandered through countless incarnations, but I did not find stability anywhere.

Gurbani: ਕਰਉ ਸੇਵਾ ਗੁਰ ਲਾਗਉ ਚਰਨ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਜੀ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਜੀ ਬਤਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: krau sevaa gur laagau charan govind jee kaa maarag dehu jee bataaee |1| rahaau |
English: I serve the Guru, and I fall at His feet, praying, "O Dear Lord of the Universe, please, show me the way." ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਉਪਾਵ ਕਰਉ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਉ ਬਚਿਤਿ ਧਰਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਤ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਵਿਹਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: anik upaav krau maaeaa kau bachit dhrau meree meree karat sad hee vihaavai |
English: I have tried so many things to acquire the wealth of Maya, and to cherish it in my mind; I have passed my life constantly crying out, "Mine, mine!"

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਐਸੋ ਰੇ ਭੇਟੈ ਸੰਤੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਲਾਹੈ ਸਗਲ ਚਿੰਤ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਰਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: koee aiso re bhettai sant meree laahai sagal chint tthaakur siau meraa rang laavai |2|
English: Is there any such Saint, who would meet with me, take away my anxiety, and lead me to enshrine love for my Lord and Master. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪੜੇ ਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਬੇਦ ਨਹ ਚੂਕੈ ਮਨ ਭੇਦ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਨ ਧੀਰਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਘਰ ਕੇ ਪੰਚਾ ॥
Transliteration: parre re sagal bed neh chookai man bhed ik khin na dheereh mere ghar ke panchaa |
English: I have read all the Vedas, and yet the sense of separation in my mind still has not been removed; the five thieves of my house are not quieted, even for an instant.

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਐਸੋ ਰੇ ਭਗਤੁ ਜੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਰਹਤੁ ਇਕੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਿੰਚਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: koee aiso re bhagat ju maaeaa te rehat ik amrit naam merai ridai sinchaa |3|
English: Is there any devotee, who is unattached to Maya, who may irrigate my mind with the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the One Lord? ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੇਤੇ ਰੇ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਏ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਲਾਏ ਘਰ ਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: jete re teerath naae ahanbudh mail laae ghar ko tthaakur ik til na maanai |
English: In spite of the many places of pilgrimage for people to bathe in, their minds are still stained by their stubborn ego; the Lord Master is not pleased by this at all.

Gurbani: ਕਦਿ ਪਾਵਉ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: kad paavau saadhasang har har sadaa aanand giaan anjan meraa man isanaanai |4|
English: When will I find the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy? There, I shall be always in the ecstasy of the Lord, Har, Har, and my mind shall take its cleansing bath in the healing ointment of spiritual wisdom. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਅਸ੍ਰਮ ਕੀਨੇ ਮਨੂਆ ਨਹ ਪਤੀਨੇ ਬਿਬੇਕਹੀਨ ਦੇਹੀ ਧੋਏ ॥
Transliteration: sagal asram keene manooaa neh pateene bibekaheen dehee dhoe |
English: I have followed the four stages of life, but my mind is not satisfied; I wash my body, but it is totally lacking in understanding.

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਪਾਈਐ ਰੇ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਲੁ ਖੋਏ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: koee paaeeai re purakh bidhaataa paarabraham kai rang raataa mere man kee duramat mal khoe |5|
English: If only I could meet some devotee of the Supreme Lord God, imbued with the Lord's Love, who could eradicate the filthy evil-mindedness from my mind. ||5||

Gurbani: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਜੁਗਤਾ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਹੇਤੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਗਰਬਿ ਗਰਬਿ ਪੜੈ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਲੇਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: karam dharam jugataa nimakh na het karataa garab garab parrai kahee na lekhai |
English: One who is attached to religious rituals, does not love the Lord, even for an instant; he is filled with pride, and he is of no account.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਸਦਾ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਕੋਊ ਨੇਤ੍ਰਹੁ ਪੇਖੈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: jis bhetteeai safal moorat karai sadaa keerat gur parasaad koaoo netrahu pekhai |6|
English: One who meets with the rewarding personality of the Guru, continually sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. By Guru's Grace, such a rare one beholds the Lord with his eyes. ||6||

Gurbani: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਜੋ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਲੇਖੈ ਪਾਵੈ ਬਗੁਲ ਜਿਉ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਲਾਵੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੇ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: manahatth jo kamaavai til na lekhai paavai bagul jiau dhiaan laavai maaeaa re dhaaree |
English: One who acts through stubbornness is of no account at all; like a crane, he pretends to meditate, but he is still stuck in Maya.

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਐਸੋ ਰੇ ਸੁਖਹ ਦਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: koee aiso re sukhah daaee prabh kee kathaa sunaaee tis bhette gat hoe hamaaree |7|
English: Is there any such Giver of peace, who can recite to me the sermon of God? Meeting him, I would be emancipated. ||7||

Gurbani: ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਰਾਇ ਕਾਟੈ ਰੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਮਾਇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: suprasan gopaal raae kaattai re bandhan maae gur kai sabad meraa man raataa |
English: When the Lord, my King, is totally pleased with me, He will break the bonds of Maya for me; my mind is imbued with the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਸੁਖ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਾਧੇ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਪਰਾਤਾ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa aanand bhettio nirabhai gobind sukh naanak laadhe har charan paraataa |8|
English: I am in ecstasy, forever and ever, meeting the Fearless Lord, the Lord of the Universe. Falling at the Lord's Feet, Nanak has found peace. ||8||

Gurbani: ਸਫਲ ਸਫਲ ਭਈ ਸਫਲ ਜਾਤ੍ਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: safal safal bhee safal jaatraa |
English: My Yatra, my life pilgrimage, has become fruitful, fruitful, fruitful.

Gurbani: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣ ਰਹੇ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਾਧਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥੩॥
Transliteration: aavan jaan rahe mile saadhaa |1| rahaau doojaa |1|3|
English: My comings and goings have ended, since I met the Holy Saint. ||1||Second Pause||1||3||

[Ang 687 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਛੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 1 chhant |
English: Dhanaasaree, First Mehl, Chhant:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵਣ ਜਾਉ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: teerath naavan jaau teerath naam hai |
English: Why should I bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage? The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the sacred shrine of pilgrimage.

Gurbani: ਤੀਰਥੁ ਸਬਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: teerath sabad beechaar antar giaan hai |
English: My sacred shrine of pilgrimage is spiritual wisdom within, and contemplation on the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਥਾਨੁ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਦਸ ਪੁਰਬ ਸਦਾ ਦਸਾਹਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur giaan saachaa thaan teerath das purab sadaa dasaaharaa |
English: The spiritual wisdom given by the Guru is the True sacred shrine of pilgrimage, where the ten festivals are always observed.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਚਉ ਦੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਰਣੀਧਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: hau naam har kaa sadaa jaachau dehu prabh dharaneedharaa |
English: I constantly beg for the Name of the Lord; grant it to me, O God, Sustainer of the world.

Gurbani: ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਰੋਗੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਰੂ ਮੈਲੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਚ ਬਿਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: sansaar rogee naam daaroo mail laagai sach binaa |
English: The world is sick, and the Naam is the medicine to cure it; without the True Lord, filth sticks to it.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਵਾਕੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਚੁ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਮਜਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur vaak niramal sadaa chaanan nit saach teerath majanaa |1|
English: The Guru's Word is immaculate and pure; it radiates a steady Light. Constantly bathe in such a true shrine of pilgrimage. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਕਿਆ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: saach na laagai mail kiaa mal dhoeeai |
English: Filth does not stick to the true ones; what filth do they have to wash off?

Gurbani: ਗੁਣਹਿ ਹਾਰੁ ਪਰੋਇ ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਰੋਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: guneh haar paroe kis kau roeeai |
English: If one strings a garland of virtues for oneself, what is there to cry for?

Gurbani: ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਮਾਰੈ ਤਰੈ ਤਾਰੈ ਉਲਟਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਆਵਏ ॥
Transliteration: veechaar maarai tarai taarai ulatt jon na aave |
English: One who conquers his own self through contemplation is saved, and saves others as well; he does not come to be born again.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਰਮ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
