Transliteration: aap paaras param dhiaanee saach saache bhaave |
English: The supreme meditator is Himself the philosopher's stone, which transforms lead into gold. The true man is pleasing to the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਨੰਦੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਖੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਦੂਖ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪਰਹਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aanand anadin harakh saachaa dookh kilavikh parahare |
English: He is in ecstasy, truly happy, night and day; his sorrows and sins are taken away.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਮੈਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਚ ਮਨੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sach naam paaeaa gur dikhaaeaa mail naahee sach mane |2|
English: He finds the True Name, and beholds the Guru; with the True Name in his mind, no filth sticks to him. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੀਤ ਮਿਲਾਪੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਨਾਵਣੋ ॥
Transliteration: sangat meet milaap pooraa naavano |
English: O friend, association with the Holy is the perfect cleansing bath.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵੈ ਗਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੋ ॥
Transliteration: gaavai gaavanahaar sabad suhaavano |
English: The singer who sings the Lord's Praises is adorned with the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਮੰਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਦਇਆ ਮਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: saalaeh saache man satigur pun daan deaa mate |
English: Worship the True Lord, and believe in the True Guru; this brings the merit of making donations to charity, kindness and compassion.

Gurbani: ਪਿਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਬੇਣੀ ਤ ਸੰਗਮੁ ਸਤ ਸਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: pir sang bhaavai sehaj naavai benee ta sangam sat sate |
English: The soul-bride who loves to be with her Husband Lord bathes at the true Triveni of the soul, which she regards as the sacred place where the Ganges, Jamuna and Saraswaati Rivers converge.

Gurbani: ਆਰਾਧਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਿਤ ਦੇਇ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aaraadh ekankaar saachaa nit dee charrai savaaeaa |
English: Worship and adore the One Creator, the True Lord, who constantly gives, whose gifts continually increase.

Gurbani: ਗਤਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੀਤਾ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gat sang meetaa santasangat kar nadar mel milaaeaa |3|
English: Salvation is attained by associating with the Society of the Saints, O friend; granting His Grace, God unites us in His Union. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹਣੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਆਖੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: kehan kahai sabh koe kevadd aakheeai |
English: Everyone speaks and talks; how great should I say He is?

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਅਜਾਣੁ ਸਮਝਾ ਸਾਖੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: hau moorakh neech ajaan samajhaa saakheeai |
English: I am foolish, lowly and ignorant; it is only through the Guru's Teachings that I understand.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਖੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਾਖੀ ਤਿਤੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sach gur kee saakhee amrit bhaakhee tith man maaniaa meraa |
English: True are the Teachings of the Guru. His Words are Ambrosial Nectar; my mind is pleased and appeased by them.

Gurbani: ਕੂਚੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਲਾਦੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kooch kareh aaveh bikh laade sabad sachai gur meraa |
English: Loaded down with corruption and sin, people depart, and then come back again; the True Shabad is found through my Guru.

Gurbani: ਆਖਣਿ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aakhan tott na bhagat bhanddaaree bharipur rahiaa soee |
English: There is no end to the treasure of devotion; the Lord is pervading everywhere.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਂਜੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak saach kahai benantee man maanjai sach soee |4|1|
English: Nanak utters this true prayer; one who purifies his mind is True. ||4||1||

[Ang 688 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 1 |
English: Dhanaasaree, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਾ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਇ ਮਨਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: jeevaa terai naae man aanand hai jeeo |
English: I live by Your Name; my mind is in ecstasy, Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੋ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਉ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: saacho saachaa naau gun govind hai jeeo |
English: True is the Name of the True Lord. Glorious are the Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਰਜੀ ਤਿਨਿ ਗੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur giaan apaaraa sirajanahaaraa jin sirajee tin goee |
English: Infinite is the spiritual wisdom imparted by the Guru. The Creator Lord who created, shall also destroy.

Gurbani: ਪਰਵਾਣਾ ਆਇਆ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਪਠਾਇਆ ਫੇਰਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: paravaanaa aaeaa hukam patthaaeaa fer na sakai koee |
English: The call of death is sent out by the Lord's Command; no one can challenge it.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਆਪੇ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aape kar vekhai sir sir lekhai aape surat bujhaaee |
English: He Himself creates, and watches; His written command is above each and every head. He Himself imparts understanding and awareness.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਜੀਵਾ ਸਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak saahib agam agochar jeevaa sachee naaee |1|
English: O Nanak, the Lord Master is inaccessible and unfathomable; I live by His True Name. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਸਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਆਇਆ ਜਾਇਸੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: tum sar avar na koe aaeaa jaaeisee jeeo |
English: No one can compare to You, Lord; all come and go.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਬੇੜੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਸੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: hukamee hoe niberr bharam chukaaeisee jeeo |
English: By Your Command, the account is settled, and doubt is dispelled.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਹਾਏ ਸਚ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur bharam chukaae akath kahaae sach meh saach samaanaa |
English: The Guru dispels doubt, and makes us speak the Unspoken Speech; the true ones are absorbed into Truth.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: aap upaae aap samaae hukamee hukam pachhaanaa |
English: He Himself creates, and He Himself destroys; I accept the Command of the Commander Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ਤੂ ਮਨਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sachee vaddiaaee gur te paaee too man ant sakhaaee |
English: True greatness comes from the Guru; You alone are the mind's companion in the end.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਮਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak saahib avar na doojaa naam terai vaddiaaee |2|
English: O Nanak, there is no other than the Lord and Master; greatness comes from Your Name. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਸਚਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੁ ਅਲਖ ਸਿਰੰਦਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: too sachaa sirajanahaar alakh sirandiaa jeeo |
English: You are the True Creator Lord, the unknowable Maker.

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਦੁਇ ਰਾਹ ਵਾਦ ਵਧੰਦਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: ek saahib due raah vaad vadhandiaa jeeo |
English: There is only the One Lord and Master, but there are two paths, by which conflict increases.

Gurbani: ਦੁਇ ਰਾਹ ਚਲਾਏ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਬਾਏ ਜਨਮਿ ਮੁਆ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: due raah chalaae hukam sabaae janam muaa sansaaraa |
English: All follow these two paths, by the Hukam of the Lord's Command; the world is born, only to die.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਬੇਲੀ ਬਿਖੁ ਲਾਦੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: naam binaa naahee ko belee bikh laadee sir bhaaraa |
English: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mortal has no friend at all; he carries loads of sin on his head.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਆਇਆ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: hukamee aaeaa hukam na boojhai hukam savaaranahaaraa |
English: By the Hukam of the Lord's Command, he comes, but he does not understand this Hukam; the Lord's Hukam is the Embellisher.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਿਞਾਪੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak saahib sabad siyaapai saachaa sirajanahaaraa |3|
English: O Nanak, through the Shabad, the Word of the Lord and Master, the True Creator Lord is realized. ||3||

Gurbani: ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਦਰਵਾਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat soheh daravaar sabad suhaaeaa jeeo |
English: Your devotees look beautiful in Your Court, embellished with the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਬੋਲਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: boleh amrit baan rasan rasaaeaa jeeo |
English: They chant the Ambrosial Word of His Bani, savoring it with their tongues.

Gurbani: ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਏ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਿਸਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਿਕਾਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: rasan rasaae naam tisaae gur kai sabad vikaane |
English: Savoring it with their tongues, they thirst for the Naam; they are a sacrifice to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਸਿ ਪਰਸਿਐ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਹੋਏ ਜਾ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: paaras parasiai paaras hoe jaa terai man bhaane |
English: Touching the philosopher's stone, they become the philosopher's stone, which transforms lead into gold; O Lord, they become pleasing to your mind.

Gurbani: ਅਮਰਾ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਗਿਆਨ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: amaraa pad paaeaa aap gavaaeaa viralaa giaan veechaaree |
English: They attain the immortal status and eradicate their self-conceit; how rare is that person, who contemplates spiritual wisdom.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੇ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak bhagat sohan dar saachai saache ke vaapaaree |4|
English: O Nanak, the devotees look beautiful in the Court of the True Lord; they are dealers in the Truth. ||4||

Gurbani: ਭੂਖ ਪਿਆਸੋ ਆਥਿ ਕਿਉ ਦਰਿ ਜਾਇਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhookh piaaso aath kiau dar jaaeisaa jeeo |
English: I am hungry and thirsty for wealth; how will I be able to go to the Lord's Court?

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਛਉ ਜਾਇ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur poochhau jaae naam dhiaaeisaa jeeo |
English: I shall go and ask the True Guru, and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਸਾਚੁ ਚਵਾਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: sach naam dhiaaee saach chavaaee guramukh saach pachhaanaa |
English: I meditate on the True Name, chant the True Name, and as Gurmukh, I realize the True Name.

Gurbani: ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: deenaa naath deaal niranjan anadin naam vakhaanaa |
English: Night and day, I chant the Name of the merciful, immaculate Lord, the Master of the poor.

Gurbani: ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਰ ਧੁਰਹੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਈ ਆਪਿ ਮੁਆ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: karanee kaar dhurahu furamaaee aap muaa man maaree |
English: The Primal Lord has ordained the tasks to be done; self-conceit is overcome, and the mind is subdued.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥੫॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naam mahaa ras meetthaa trisanaa naam nivaaree |5|2|
English: O Nanak, the Naam is the sweetest essence; through the Naam, thirst and desire are stilled. ||5||2||

[Ang 689 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree chhant mahalaa 1 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Chhant, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪਿਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੂਠੜੀਏ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: pir sang moottharree khabar na paaeea jeeo |
English: Your Husband Lord is with you, O deluded soul-bride, but you do are not aware of Him.

Gurbani: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਅੜਾ ਲੇਖੁ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਕਮਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: masatak likhiarraa lekh purab kamaaeaa jeeo |
English: Your destiny is written on your forehead, according to your past actions.

Gurbani: ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਮਿਟਈ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਕਮਾਇਆ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਣਾ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: lekh na mittee purab kamaaeaa kiaa jaanaa kiaa hosee |
English: This inscription of past deeds cannot be erased; what do I know about what will happen?

Gurbani: ਗੁਣੀ ਅਚਾਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਬਹਿ ਬਹਿ ਰੋਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: gunee achaar nahee rang raatee avagun beh beh rosee |
English: You have not adopted a virtuous lifestyle, and you are not attuned to the Lord's Love; you sit there, crying over your past misdeeds.

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਆਕ ਕੀ ਛਾਇਆ ਬਿਰਧਿ ਭਏ ਦਿਨ ਪੁੰਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: dhan joban aak kee chhaaeaa biradh bhe din puniaa |
English: Wealth and youth are like the shade of the bitter swallow-wort plant; you are growing old, and your days are coming to their end.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਦੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਛੂਟੀ ਝੂਠਿ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak naam binaa dohaagan chhoottee jhootth vichhuniaa |1|
English: O Nanak, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, you shall end up as a discarded, divorced bride; your own falsehood shall separate you from the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬੂਡੀ ਘਰੁ ਘਾਲਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਚਲੋ ॥
Transliteration: booddee ghar ghaalio gur kai bhaae chalo |
English: You have drowned, and your house is ruined; walk in the Way of the Guru's Will.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਮਹਲੋ ॥
Transliteration: saachaa naam dhiaae paaveh sukh mahalo |
English: Meditate on the True Name, and you shall find peace in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har naam dhiaae taa sukh paae peeearrai din chaare |
English: Meditate on the Lord's Name, and you shall find peace; your stay in this world shall last only four days.

Gurbani: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਬਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਏ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: nij ghar jaae bahai sach paae anadin naal piaare |
English: Sit in the home of your own being, and you shall find Truth; night and day, be with your Beloved.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਸੁਣਿਅਹੁ ਲੋਕ ਸਬਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: vin bhagatee ghar vaas na hovee suniahu lok sabaae |
English: Without loving devotion, you cannot dwell in your own home - listen, everyone!

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਸੀ ਤਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਏ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak sarasee taa pir paae raatee saachai naae |2|
English: O Nanak, she is happy, and she obtains her Husband Lord, if she is attuned to the True Name. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪਿਰੁ ਧਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਪਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: pir dhan bhaavai taa pir bhaavai naaree jeeo |
English: If the soul-bride is pleasing to her Husband Lord, then the Husband Lord will love His bride.

Gurbani: ਰੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: rang preetam raatee gur kai sabad veechaaree jeeo |
English: Imbued with the love of her Beloved, she contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਨਾਹ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur sabad veechaaree naah piaaree niv niv bhagat kareee |
English: She contemplates the Guru's Shabads, and her Husband Lord loves her; in deep humility, she worships Him in loving devotion.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਜਲਾਏ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਰਸ ਮਹਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਰੇਈ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohu jalaae preetam ras meh rang kareee |
English: She burns away her emotional attachment to Maya, and in love, she loves her Beloved.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗੇਤੀ ਲਾਲ ਭਈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: prabh saache setee rang rangetee laal bhee man maaree |
English: She is imbued and drenched with the Love of the True Lord; she has become beautiful, by conquering her mind.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਿ ਵਸੀ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਪਿਰ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak saach vasee sohaagan pir siau preet piaaree |3|
English: O Nanak, the happy soul-bride abides in Truth; she loves to love her Husband Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪਿਰ ਘਰਿ ਸੋਹੈ ਨਾਰਿ ਜੇ ਪਿਰ ਭਾਵਏ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: pir ghar sohai naar je pir bhaave jeeo |
English: The soul-bride looks so beautiful in the home of her Husband Lord, if she is pleasing to Him.

Gurbani: ਝੂਠੇ ਵੈਣ ਚਵੇ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਏ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: jhootthe vain chave kaam na aave jeeo |
English: It is of no use at all to speak false words.

Gurbani: ਝੂਠੁ ਅਲਾਵੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਨੈਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: jhootth alaavai kaam na aavai naa pir dekhai nainee |
English: If she speaks false, it is of no use to her, and she does not see her Husband Lord with her eyes.

Gurbani: ਅਵਗੁਣਿਆਰੀ ਕੰਤਿ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ਛੂਟੀ ਵਿਧਣ ਰੈਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: avaguniaaree kant visaaree chhoottee vidhan rainee |
English: Worthless, forgotten and abandoned by her Husband Lord, she passes her life-night without her Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਮਾਨੈ ਫਾਹੀ ਫਾਥੀ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gurasabad na maanai faahee faathee saa dhan mehal na paae |
English: Such a wife does not believe in the Word of the Guru's Shabad; she is caught in the net of the world, and does not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak aape aap pachhaanai guramukh sehaj samaae |4|
English: O Nanak, if she understands her own self, then, as Gurmukh, she merges in celestial peace. ||4||

Gurbani: ਧਨ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਰਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: dhan sohaagan naar jin pir jaaniaa jeeo |
English: Blessed is that soul-bride, who knows her Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਣਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: naam binaa koorriaar koorr kamaaniaa jeeo |
English: Without the Naam, she is false, and her actions are false as well.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਵੀ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: har bhagat suhaavee saache bhaavee bhaae bhagat prabh raatee |
English: Devotional worship of the Lord is beautiful; the True Lord loves it. So immerse yourself in loving devotional worship of God.

Gurbani: ਪਿਰੁ ਰਲੀਆਲਾ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਬਾਲਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: pir raleeaalaa joban baalaa tis raave rang raatee |
English: My Husband Lord is playful and innocent; imbued with His Love, I enjoy Him.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਿਗਾਸੀ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਵਾਸੀ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur sabad vigaasee sahu raavaasee fal paaeaa gunakaaree |
English: She blossoms forth through the Word of the Guru's Shabad; she ravishes her Husband Lord, and obtains the most noble reward.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪਿਰ ਘਰਿ ਸੋਹੈ ਨਾਰੀ ॥੫॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak saach milai vaddiaaee pir ghar sohai naaree |5|3|
English: O Nanak, in Truth, she obtains glory; in her Husband's home, the soul-bride looks beautiful. ||5||3||

[Ang 690 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree chhant mahalaa 4 ghar 1 |
English: Dhanaasaree, Chhant, Fourth Mehl, First House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har jeeo kripaa kare taa naam dhiaaeeai jeeo |
English: When the Dear Lord grants His Grace, one meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਸਹਜਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur milai subhaae sehaj gun gaaeeai jeeo |
English: Meeting the True Guru, through loving faith and devotion, one intuitively sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਸਦਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾ ਆਪਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
Transliteration: gun gaae vigasai sadaa anadin jaa aap saache bhaave |
English: Singing His Glorious Praises continually, night and day, one blossoms forth, when it is pleasing to the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਏ ॥
Transliteration: ahankaar haumai tajai maaeaa sehaj naam samaave |
English: Egotism, self-conceit and Maya are forsaken, and he is intuitively absorbed into the Naam.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਆਪਿ ਦੇਇ ਤ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: aap karataa kare soee aap dee ta paaeeai |
English: The Creator Himself acts; when He gives, then we receive.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har jeeo kripaa kare taa naam dhiaaeeai jeeo |1|
English: When the Dear Lord grants His Grace, we meditate on the Naam. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: andar saachaa nehu poore satigurai jeeo |
English: Deep within, I feel true love for the Perfect True Guru.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਮੈ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: hau tis sevee din raat mai kade na veesarai jeeo |
English: I serve Him day and night; I never forget Him.

Gurbani: ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਮੑਾਰੀ ਜਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਈ ਤਾ ਜੀਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: kade na visaaree anadin samaaree jaa naam lee taa jeevaa |
English: I never forget Him; I remember Him night and day. When I chant the Naam, then I live.

Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਸੁਣੀ ਤ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: sravanee sunee ta ihu man tripatai guramukh amrit peevaa |
English: With my ears, I hear about Him, and my mind is satisfied. As Gurmukh, I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਚਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: nadar kare taa satigur mele anadin bibek budh bicharai |
English: If He bestows His Glance of Grace, then I shall meet the True Guru; my discriminating intellect would contemplate Him, night and day.

Gurbani: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: andar saachaa nehu poore satigurai |2|
English: Deep within, I feel true love for the Perfect True Guru. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਆਵਏ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: satasangat milai vaddabhaag taa har ras aave jeeo |
English: By great good fortune, one joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation; then, one comes to savor the subtle essence of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ਤ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਏ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: anadin rahai liv laae ta sehaj samaave jeeo |
English: Night and day, he remains lovingly focused on the Lord; he merges in celestial peace.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj samaavai taa har man bhaavai sadaa ateet bairaagee |
English: Merging in celestial peace, he becomes pleasing to the Lord's Mind; he remains forever unattached and untouched.

Gurbani: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਜਗ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: halat palat sobhaa jag antar raam naam liv laagee |
English: He receives honor in this world and the next, lovingly focused on the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਦੁਹਾ ਤੇ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
Transliteration: harakh sog duhaa te mukataa jo prabh kare su bhaave |
English: He is liberated from both pleasure and pain; he is pleased by whatever God does.

Gurbani: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਆਵਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: satasangat milai vaddabhaag taa har ras aave jeeo |3|
English: By great good fortune, one joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and then, one comes to savor the subtle essence of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਜਮਿ ਜੋਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: doojai bhaae dukh hoe manamukh jam johiaa jeeo |
English: In the love of duality, there is pain and suffering; the Messenger of Death eyes the self-willed manmukhs.

Gurbani: ਹਾਇ ਹਾਇ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੁਖਿ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: haae haae kare din raat maaeaa dukh mohiaa jeeo |
English: They cry and howl, day and night, caught by the pain of Maya.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਦੁਖਿ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਹਿਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਤ ਵਿਹਾਵਏ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa dukh mohiaa haumai rohiaa meree meree karat vihaave |
English: Caught by the pain of Maya, provoked by his ego, he passes his life crying out, "Mine, mine!".

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੇਇ ਤਿਸੁ ਚੇਤੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਏ ॥
Transliteration: jo prabh dee tis chetai naahee ant geaa pachhutaave |
English: He does not remember God, the Giver, and in the end, he departs regretting and repenting.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਧੋਹਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: bin naavai ko saath na chaalai putr kalatr maaeaa dhohiaa |
English: Without the Name, nothing shall go along with him; not his children, spouse or the enticements of Maya.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜਮਿ ਜੋਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: doojai bhaae dukh hoe manamukh jam johiaa jeeo |4|
English: In the love of duality, there is pain and suffering; the Messenger of Death eyes the self-willed manmukhs. ||4||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੇਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਮਹਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa lehu milaae mehal har paaeaa jeeo |
English: Granting His Grace, the Lord has merged me with Himself; I have found the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa rahai kar jorr prabh man bhaaeaa jeeo |
English: I remain standing with my palms pressed together; I have become pleasing to God's Mind.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: prabh man bhaavai taa hukam samaavai hukam man sukh paaeaa |
English: When one is pleasing to God's Mind, then he merges in the Hukam of the Lord's Command; surrendering to His Hukam, he finds peace.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਪਤ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: anadin japat rahai din raatee sahaje naam dhiaaeaa |
English: Night and day, he chants the Lord's Name, day and night; intuitively, naturally, he meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
Transliteration: naamo naam milee vaddiaaee naanak naam man bhaave |
English: Through the Naam, the glorious greatness of the Naam is obtained; the Naam is pleasing to Nanak's mind.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੇਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਮਹਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥੧॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa lehu milaae mehal har paave jeeo |5|1|
English: Granting His Grace, the Lord has merged me with Himself; I have found the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||5||1||

[Ang 691 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 chhant |
English: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl, Chhant:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਜਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਵੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur deen deaal jis sang har gaaveeai jeeo |
English: The True Guru is merciful to the meek; in His Presence, the Lord's Praises are sung.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਵੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: amrit har kaa naam saadhasang raaveeai jeeo |
English: The Ambrosial Name of the Lord is chanted in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਭਜੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਇਕੁ ਅਰਾਧੂ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖ ਨਾਸਏ ॥
Transliteration: bhaj sang saadhoo ik araadhoo janam maran dukh naase |
English: Vibrating, and worshipping the One Lord in the Company of the Holy, the pains of birth and death are removed.

Gurbani: ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਿਖਿਆ ਕਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਏ ॥
Transliteration: dhur karam likhiaa saach sikhiaa kattee jam kee faase |
English: Those who have such karma pre-ordained, study and learn the Truth; the noose of Death is removed from their necks.

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਭਰਮ ਨਾਠੇ ਛੁਟੀ ਗਾਠੇ ਜਮ ਪੰਥਿ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਆਵੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: bhai bharam naatthe chhuttee gaatthe jam panth mool na aaveeai |
English: Their fears and doubts are dispelled, the knot of death is untied, and they never have to walk on Death's path.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਧਾਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੀਐ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak dhaar kirapaa sadaa har gun gaaveeai |1|
English: Prays Nanak, shower me with Your Mercy, Lord; let me sing Your Glorious Praises forever. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਿਧਰਿਆ ਧਰ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੋ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: nidhariaa dhar ek naam niranjano jeeo |
English: The Name of the One, Immaculate Lord is the Support of the unsupported.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਸਰਬ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੋ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: too daataa daataar sarab dukh bhanjano jeeo |
English: You are the Giver, the Great Giver, the Dispeller of all sorrow.

Gurbani: ਦੁਖ ਹਰਤ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੁਖਹ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: dukh harat karataa sukhah suaamee saran saadhoo aaeaa |
English: O Destroyer of pain, Creator Lord, Master of peace and bliss, I have come seeking the Sanctuary of the Holy;

Gurbani: ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖੜਾ ਪਲ ਏਕ ਮਾਹਿ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sansaar saagar mahaa bikharraa pal ek maeh taraaeaa |
English: please, help me to cross over the terrifying and difficult world-ocean in an instant.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬ ਥਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨੇਤ੍ਰੀ ਅੰਜਨੋ ॥
Transliteration: poor rahiaa sarab thaaee gur giaan netree anjano |
English: I saw the Lord pervading and permeating everywhere, when the healing ointment of the Guru's wisdom was applied to my eyes.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਸਿਮਰੀ ਸਰਬ ਦੁਖ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨੋ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak sadaa simaree sarab dukh bhai bhanjano |2|
English: Prays Nanak, remember Him forever in meditation, the Destroyer of all sorrow and fear. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਲੀਏ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: aap lee larr laae kirapaa dhaareea jeeo |
English: He Himself has attached me to the hem of His robe; He has showered me with His Mercy.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਣੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੀਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: mohi niragun neech anaath prabh agam apaareea jeeo |
English: I am worthless, lowly and helpless; God is unfathomable and infinite.

Gurbani: ਦਇਆਲ ਸਦਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨੀਚ ਥਾਪਣਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: deaal sadaa kripaal suaamee neech thaapanahaariaa |
English: My Lord and Master is always merciful, kind and compassionate; He uplifts and establishes the lowly.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਵਸਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਗਲ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jant sabh vas terai sagal teree saariaa |
English: All beings and creatures are under Your power; You take care of all.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਸਗਲ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: aap karataa aap bhugataa aap sagal beechaareea |
English: He Himself is the Creator, and He Himself is the Enjoyer; He Himself is the Contemplator of all.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਜੀਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਉ ਬਨਵਾਰੀਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak gun gaae jeevaa har jap jpau banavaareea |3|
English: Prays Nanak, singing Your Glorious Praises, I live, chanting the Chant of the Lord, the Lord of the world-forest. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: teraa daras apaar naam amolee jeeo |
English: The Blessed Vision of Your Darshan is incomparable; Your Name is utterly priceless.

Gurbani: ਨਿਤਿ ਜਪਹਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਤੋਲਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: nit japeh tere daas purakh atolee jeeo |
English: O my Incomputable Lord, Your humble servants ever meditate on You.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਰਸਨ ਵੂਠਾ ਆਪਿ ਤੂਠਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਹਿ ਸੇਈ ਮਾਤਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sant rasan vootthaa aap tootthaa har raseh seee maatiaa |
English: You dwell on the tongues of the Saints, by Your own pleasure; they are intoxicated with Your sublime essence, O Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਲਾਗੇ ਮਹਾ ਭਾਗੇ ਸਦਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur charan laage mahaa bhaage sadaa anadin jaagiaa |
English: Those who are attached to Your feet are very blessed; night and day, they remain always awake and aware.

Gurbani: ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਤਬੵ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਗੁਣ ਬੋਲਈ ॥
Transliteration: sad sadaa sinmratabay suaamee saas saas gun bolee |
English: Forever and ever, meditate in remembrance on the Lord and Master; with each and every breath, speak His Glorious Praises.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਧੂਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਅਮੋਲਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak dhoor saadhoo naam prabhoo amolee |4|1|
English: Prays Nanak, let me become the dust of the feet of the Saints. God's Name is invaluable. ||4||1||

[Ang 691 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: raag dhanaasaree baanee bhagat kabeer jee kee |
English: Raag Dhanaasaree, The Word Of Devotee Kabeer Jee:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸਨਕ ਸਨੰਦ ਮਹੇਸ ਸਮਾਨਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: sanak sanand mahes samaanaan |
English: Beings like Sanak, Sanand, Shiva and Shaysh-naaga

Gurbani: ਸੇਖਨਾਗਿ ਤੇਰੋ ਮਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sekhanaag tero maram na jaanaan |1|
English: - none of them know Your mystery, Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: santasangat raam ridai basaaee |1| rahaau |
English: In the Society of the Saints, the Lord dwells within the heart. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਨੂਮਾਨ ਸਰਿ ਗਰੁੜ ਸਮਾਨਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: hanoomaan sar garurr samaanaan |
English: Beings like Hanumaan, Garura, Indra the King of the gods and the rulers of humans

Gurbani: ਸੁਰਪਤਿ ਨਰਪਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਗੁਨ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: surapat narapat nahee gun jaanaan |2|
English: - none of them know Your Glories, Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਚਾਰਿ ਬੇਦ ਅਰੁ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪੁਰਾਨਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: chaar bed ar sinmrit puraanaan |
English: The four Vedas, the Simritees and the Puraanas, Vishnu the Lord of Lakshmi

Gurbani: ਕਮਲਾਪਤਿ ਕਵਲਾ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kamalaapat kavalaa nahee jaanaan |3|
English: And Lakshmi herself - none of them know the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੋ ਭਰਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: keh kabeer so bharamai naahee |
English: Says Kabeer, one who falls at the Lord's feet,

Gurbani: ਪਗ ਲਗਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਹੈ ਸਰਨਾਂਹੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: pag lag raam rahai saranaanhee |4|1|
English: And remains in His Sanctuary, does not wander around lost. ||4||1||

[Ang 692 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਦਿਨ ਤੇ ਪਹਰ ਪਹਰ ਤੇ ਘਰੀਆਂ ਆਵ ਘਟੈ ਤਨੁ ਛੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: din te pehar pehar te ghareean aav ghattai tan chheejai |
English: Day by day, hour by hour, life runs its course, and the body withers away.

Gurbani: ਕਾਲੁ ਅਹੇਰੀ ਫਿਰੈ ਬਧਿਕ ਜਿਉ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਵਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kaal aheree firai badhik jiau kahahu kavan bidh keejai |1|
English: Death, like a hunter, a butcher, is on the prowl; tell me, what can we do? ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਦਿਨੁ ਆਵਨ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: so din aavan laagaa |
English: That day is rapidly approaching.

Gurbani: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਕਹਹੁ ਕੋਊ ਹੈ ਕਾ ਕਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: maat pitaa bhaaee sut banitaa kahahu koaoo hai kaa kaa |1| rahaau |
English: Mother, father, siblings, children and spouse - tell me, who belongs to whom? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜੋਤਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਮਹਿ ਬਰਤੈ ਆਪਾ ਪਸੂ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
Transliteration: jab lag jot kaaeaa meh baratai aapaa pasoo na boojhai |
English: As long as the light remains in the body, the beast does not understand himself.

Gurbani: ਲਾਲਚ ਕਰੈ ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦ ਕਾਰਨ ਲੋਚਨ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: laalach karai jeevan pad kaaran lochan kachhoo na soojhai |2|
English: He acts in greed to maintain his life and status, and sees nothing with his eyes. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਛੋਡਹੁ ਮਨ ਕੇ ਭਰਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: kehat kabeer sunahu re praanee chhoddahu man ke bharamaa |
English: Says Kabeer, listen, O mortal: Renounce the doubts of your mind.

Gurbani: ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਪਰਹੁ ਏਕ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾਂ ॥੩॥੨॥
Transliteration: keval naam japahu re praanee parahu ek kee saranaan |3|2|
English: Chant only the One Naam, the Name of the Lord, O mortal, and seek the Sanctuary of the One Lord. ||3||2||

[Ang 692 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਛੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਕਾਹੋ ॥
Transliteration: jo jan bhaau bhagat kachh jaanai taa kau acharaj kaaho |
English: That humble being, who knows even a little about loving devotional worship - what surprises are there for him?

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਜਲੁ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਪੈਸਿ ਨ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਤਿਉ ਢੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਜੁਲਾਹੋ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jiau jal jal meh pais na nikasai tiau dtur milio julaaho |1|
English: Like water, dripping into water, which cannot be separated out again, so is the weaver Kabeer, with softened heart, merged into the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਗਾ ਮੈ ਤਉ ਮਤਿ ਕਾ ਭੋਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har ke logaa mai tau mat kaa bhoraa |
English: O people of the Lord, I am just a simple-minded fool.

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਤਨੁ ਕਾਸੀ ਤਜਹਿ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਰਮਈਐ ਕਹਾ ਨਿਹੋਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jau tan kaasee tajeh kabeeraa rameeai kahaa nihoraa |1| rahaau |
English: If Kabeer were to leave his body at Benares, and so liberate himself, what obligation would he have to the Lord? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਲੋਈ ਭਰਮਿ ਨ ਭੂਲਹੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: kehat kabeer sunahu re loee bharam na bhoolahu koee |
English: Says Kabeer, listen, O people - do not be deluded by doubt.

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਕਾਸੀ ਕਿਆ ਊਖਰੁ ਮਗਹਰੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਜਉ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥੩॥
Transliteration: kiaa kaasee kiaa aookhar magahar raam ridai jau hoee |2|3|
English: What is the difference between Benares and the barren land of Maghar, if the Lord is within one's heart? ||2||3||

[Ang 692 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਲੋਕ ਸਿਵ ਲੋਕਹਿ ਜੈਬੋ ॥
Transliteration: eindr lok siv lokeh jaibo |
English: Mortals may go to the Realm of Indra, or the Realm of Shiva,

Gurbani: ਓਛੇ ਤਪ ਕਰਿ ਬਾਹੁਰਿ ਐਬੋ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ochhe tap kar baahur aibo |1|
English: but because of their hypocrisy and false prayers, they must leave again. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਮਾਂਗਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa maangau kichh thir naahee |
English: What should I ask for? Nothing lasts forever.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਖੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam rakh man maahee |1| rahaau |
English: Enshrine the Lord's Name within your mind. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੋਭਾ ਰਾਜ ਬਿਭੈ ਬਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: sobhaa raaj bibhai baddiaaee |
English: Fame and glory, power, wealth and glorious greatness

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਿ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਸੰਗ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ant na kaahoo sang sahaaee |2|
English: - none of these will go with you or help you in the end. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਲਛਮੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: putr kalatr lachhamee maaeaa |
English: Children, spouse, wealth and Maya

Gurbani: ਇਨ ਤੇ ਕਹੁ ਕਵਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ein te kahu kavanai sukh paaeaa |3|
English: - who has ever obtained peace from these? ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਅਵਰ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: kehat kabeer avar nahee kaamaa |
English: Says Kabeer, nothing else is of any use.

Gurbani: ਹਮਰੈ ਮਨ ਧਨ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੪॥੪॥
Transliteration: hamarai man dhan raam ko naamaa |4|4|
English: Within my mind is the wealth of the Lord's Name. ||4||4||

[Ang 692 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: raam simar raam simar raam simar bhaaee |
English: Remember the Lord, remember the Lord, remember the Lord in meditation, O Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਡਤੇ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam simaran bin booddate adhikaaee |1| rahaau |
English: Without remembering the Lord's Name in meditation, a great many are drowned. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਨਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਦੇਹ ਗ੍ਰੇਹ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: banitaa sut deh greh sanpat sukhadaaee |
English: Your spouse, children, body, house and possessions - you think these will give you peace.

Gurbani: ਇਨੑ ਮੈ ਕਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਤੇਰੋ ਕਾਲ ਅਵਧ ਆਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: eina mai kachh naeh tero kaal avadh aaee |1|
English: But none of these shall be yours, when the time of death comes. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਜਾਮਲ ਗਜ ਗਨਿਕਾ ਪਤਿਤ ਕਰਮ ਕੀਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: ajaamal gaj ganikaa patit karam keene |
English: Ajaamal, the elephant, and the prostitute committed many sins,

Gurbani: ਤੇਊ ਉਤਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲੀਨੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: teaoo utar paar pare raam naam leene |2|
English: but still, they crossed over the world-ocean, by chanting the Lord's Name. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੂਕਰ ਕੂਕਰ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੇ ਤਊ ਲਾਜ ਨ ਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: sookar kookar jon bhrame taoo laaj na aaee |
English: You have wandered in reincarnation, as pigs and dogs - did you feel no shame?

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਛਾਡਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਾਹੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: raam naam chhaadd amrit kaahe bikh khaaee |3|
English: Forsaking the Ambrosial Name of the Lord, why do you eat poison? ||3||

Gurbani: ਤਜਿ ਭਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਿਖੇਧ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: taj bharam karam bidh nikhedh raam naam lehee |
English: Abandon your doubts about do's and dont's, and take to the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਜਨ ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਸਨੇਹੀ ॥੪॥੫॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad jan kabeer raam kar sanehee |4|5|
English: By Guru's Grace, O servant Kabeer, love the Lord. ||4||5||

[Ang 692 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Bhagat Namdev Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree baanee bhagat naamadev jee kee |
English: Dhanaasaree, The Word Of Devotee Naam Dayv Jee:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਗਹਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਨੀਵ ਖੁਦਾਈ ਊਪਰਿ ਮੰਡਪ ਛਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gaharee kar kai neev khudaaee aoopar manddap chhaae |
English: They dig deep foundations, and build lofty palaces.

Gurbani: ਮਾਰਕੰਡੇ ਤੇ ਕੋ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ਜਿਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਧਰਿ ਮੂੰਡ ਬਲਾਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: maarakandde te ko adhikaaee jin trin dhar moondd balaae |1|
English: Can anyone live longer than Markanda, who passed his days with only a handful of straw upon his head? ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਮਰੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਨੇਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: hamaro karataa raam sanehee |
English: The Creator Lord is our only friend.

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੇ ਰੇ ਨਰ ਗਰਬੁ ਕਰਤ ਹਹੁ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਝੂਠੀ ਦੇਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kaahe re nar garab karat hahu binas jaae jhootthee dehee |1| rahaau |
English: O man, why are you so proud? This body is only temporary - it shall pass away. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕੈਰਉ ਕਰਤੇ ਦੁਰਜੋਧਨ ਸੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: meree meree kairau karate durajodhan se bhaaee |
English: The Kaurvas, who had brothers like Duryodhan, used to proclaim, "This is ours! This is ours!"

Gurbani: ਬਾਰਹ ਜੋਜਨ ਛਤ੍ਰੁ ਚਲੈ ਥਾ ਦੇਹੀ ਗਿਰਝਨ ਖਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: baarah jojan chhatru chalai thaa dehee girajhan khaaee |2|
English: Their royal procession extended over sixty miles, and yet their bodies were eaten by vultures. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਸੋੁਇਨ ਕੀ ਲੰਕਾ ਹੋਤੀ ਰਾਵਨ ਸੇ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sarab suoein kee lankaa hotee raavan se adhikaaee |
English: Sri Lanka was totally rich with gold; was anyone greater than its ruler Raavan?

Gurbani: ਕਹਾ ਭਇਓ ਦਰਿ ਬਾਂਧੇ ਹਾਥੀ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਭਈ ਪਰਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kahaa bheo dar baandhe haathee khin meh bhee paraaee |3|
English: What happened to the elephants, tethered at his gate? In an instant, it all belonged to someone else. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦੁਰਬਾਸਾ ਸਿਉ ਕਰਤ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਜਾਦਵ ਏ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: durabaasaa siau karat tthgauree jaadav e fal paae |
English: The Yaadvas deceived Durbaasaa, and received their rewards.

Gurbani: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਜਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਊਪਰ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: kripaa karee jan apune aoopar naamadeo har gun gaae |4|1|
English: The Lord has shown mercy to His humble servant, and now Naam Dayv sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||1||

[Ang 693 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Bhagat Namdev Ji]
Gurbani: ਦਸ ਬੈਰਾਗਨਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਸਿ ਕੀਨੑੀ ਪੰਚਹੁ ਕਾ ਮਿਟ ਨਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: das bairaagan mohi bas keenaee panchahu kaa mitt naavau |
English: I have brought the ten sensory organs under my control, and erased every trace of the five thieves.

Gurbani: ਸਤਰਿ ਦੋਇ ਭਰੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਕਉ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਢਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: satar doe bhare amrit sar bikh kau maar kadtaavau |1|
English: I have filled the seventy-two thousand nerve channels with Ambrosial Nectar, and drained out the poison. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪਾਛੈ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਨੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: paachhai bahur na aavan paavau |
English: I shall not come into the world again.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਘਟ ਤੇ ਉਚਰਉ ਆਤਮ ਕਉ ਸਮਝਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: amrit baanee ghatt te uchrau aatam kau samajhaavau |1| rahaau |
English: I chant the Ambrosial Bani of the Word from the depths of my heart, and I have instructed my soul. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਜਰ ਕੁਠਾਰੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਹੈ ਛੀਨਾਂ ਕਰਿ ਮਿੰਨਤਿ ਲਗਿ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: bajar kutthaar mohi hai chheenaan kar minat lag paavau |
English: I fell at the Guru's feet and begged of Him; with the mighty axe, I have chopped off emotional attachment.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੇ ਹਮ ਉਲਟੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਭਗਤਨ ਤੇ ਡਰਪਾਵਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: santan ke ham ulatte sevak bhagatan te ddarapaavau |2|
English: Turning away from the world, I have become the servant of the Saints; I fear no one except the Lord's devotees. ||2||

Gurbani: ਇਹ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਤੇ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਛੂਟਉ ਜਉ ਮਾਇਆ ਨਹ ਲਪਟਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: eih sansaar te tab hee chhoottau jau maaeaa neh lapattaavau |
English: I shall be released from this world, when I stop clinging to Maya.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਕਾ ਤਿਹ ਤਜਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: maaeaa naam garabh jon kaa tih taj darasan paavau |3|
English: Maya is the name of the power which causes us to be born; renouncing it, we obtain the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||3||

Gurbani: ਇਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਜੋ ਜਨ ਤਿਨ ਭਉ ਸਗਲ ਚੁਕਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: eit kar bhagat kareh jo jan tin bhau sagal chukaaeeai |
English: That humble being, who performs devotional worship in this way, is rid of all fear.

Gurbani: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਆ ਭਰਮਹੁ ਇਹ ਸੰਜਮ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: kehat naamadeo baahar kiaa bharamahu ih sanjam har paaeeai |4|2|
English: Says Naam Dayv, why are you wandering around out there? This is the way to find the Lord. ||4||2||

[Ang 693 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Bhagat Namdev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰਵਾੜਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਨੀਰੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਬੇਲਿ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਕਰਹਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: maaravaarr jaise neer baalahaa bel baalahaa karahalaa |
English: As water is very precious in the desert, and the creeper weeds are dear to the camel,

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਕੁਰੰਕ ਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਦੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਤਿਉ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਰਾਮਈਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jiau kurank nis naad baalahaa tiau merai man raameea |1|
English: and the tune of the hunter's bell at night is enticing to the deer, so is the Lord to my mind. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰੂੜੋ ਰੂਪੁ ਰੂੜੋ ਅਤਿ ਰੰਗ ਰੂੜੋ ਮੇਰੋ ਰਾਮਈਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: teraa naam roorro roop roorro at rang roorro mero raameea |1| rahaau |
English: Your Name is so beautiful! Your form is so beautiful! Your Love is so very beautiful, O my Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਧਰਣੀ ਕਉ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਕੁਸਮ ਬਾਸੁ ਜੈਸੇ ਭਵਰਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: jiau dharanee kau indru baalahaa kusam baas jaise bhavaralaa |
English: As rain is dear to the earth, and the flower's fragrance is dear to the bumble bee,

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਕੋਕਿਲ ਕਉ ਅੰਬੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਤਿਉ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਰਾਮਈਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jiau kokil kau anb baalahaa tiau merai man raameea |2|
English: and the mango is dear to the cuckoo, so is the Lord to my mind. ||2||

Gurbani: ਚਕਵੀ ਕਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਸੂਰੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਮਾਨ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਹੰਸੁਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: chakavee kau jaise soor baalahaa maan sarovar hansulaa |
English: As the sun is dear to the chakvi duck, and the lake of Man Sarovar is dear to the swan,

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਤਰੁਣੀ ਕਉ ਕੰਤੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਤਿਉ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਰਾਮਈਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jiau tarunee kau kant baalahaa tiau merai man raameea |3|
English: and the husband is dear to his wife, so is the Lord to my mind. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬਾਰਿਕ ਕਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਖੀਰੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਮੁਖ ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲਧਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: baarik kau jaise kheer baalahaa chaatrik mukh jaise jaladharaa |
English: As milk is dear to the baby, and the raindrop is dear to the mouth of the rainbird,

Gurbani: ਮਛੁਲੀ ਕਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਨੀਰੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਤਿਉ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਰਾਮਈਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: machhulee kau jaise neer baalahaa tiau merai man raameea |4|
English: and as water is dear to the fish, so is the Lord to my mind. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਸਗਲ ਮੁਨਿ ਚਾਹਹਿ ਬਿਰਲੇ ਕਾਹੂ ਡੀਠੁਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: saadhik sidh sagal mun chaaheh birale kaahoo ddeetthulaa |
English: All the seekers, Siddhas and silent sages seek Him, but only a rare few behold Him.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਭਵਣ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਤਿਉ ਨਾਮੇ ਮਨਿ ਬੀਠੁਲਾ ॥੫॥੩॥
Transliteration: sagal bhavan tero naam baalahaa tiau naame man beetthulaa |5|3|
English: Just as Your Name is dear to all the Universe, so is the Lord dear to Naam Dayv's mind. ||5||3||

[Ang 693 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Bhagat Namdev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਹਿਲ ਪੁਰੀਏ ਪੁੰਡਰਕ ਵਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: pahil puree punddarak vanaa |
English: First of all, the lotuses bloomed in the woods;

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਚੇ ਹੰਸਾ ਸਗਲੇ ਜਨਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: taa che hansaa sagale janaan |
English: from them, all the swan-souls came into being.

Gurbani: ਕ੍ਰਿਸ੍ਨਾ ਤੇ ਜਾਨਊ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਚੰਤੀ ਨਾਚਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: krisanaa te jaanaoo har har naachantee naachanaa |1|
English: Know that, through Krishna, the Lord, Har, Har, the dance of creation dances. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪਹਿਲ ਪੁਰਸਾਬਿਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: pahil purasaabiraa |
English: First of all, there was only the Primal Being.

Gurbani: ਅਥੋਨ ਪੁਰਸਾਦਮਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: athon purasaadamaraa |
English: From that Primal Being, Maya was produced.

Gurbani: ਅਸਗਾ ਅਸ ਉਸਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: asagaa as usagaa |
English: All that is, is His.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਬਾਗਰਾ ਨਾਚੈ ਪਿੰਧੀ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਗਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa baagaraa naachai pindhee meh saagaraa |1| rahaau |
English: In this Garden of the Lord, we all dance, like water in the pots of the Persian wheel. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾਚੰਤੀ ਗੋਪੀ ਜੰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: naachantee gopee janaa |
English: Women and men both dance.

Gurbani: ਨਈਆ ਤੇ ਬੈਰੇ ਕੰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: neea te baire kanaa |
English: There is no other than the Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਰਕੁ ਨ ਚਾ ॥
Transliteration: tarak na chaa |
English: Don't dispute this,

Gurbani: ਭ੍ਰਮੀਆ ਚਾ ॥
Transliteration: bhrameea chaa |
English: and don't doubt this.

Gurbani: ਕੇਸਵਾ ਬਚਉਨੀ ਅਈਏ ਮਈਏ ਏਕ ਆਨ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kesavaa bchaunee aeee meee ek aan jeeo |2|
English: The Lord says, "This creation and I are one and the same." ||2||

Gurbani: ਪਿੰਧੀ ਉਭਕਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: pindhee ubhakale sansaaraa |
English: Like the pots on the Persian wheel, sometimes the world is high, and sometimes it is low.

Gurbani: ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਏ ਤੁਮ ਚੇ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: bhram bhram aae tum che duaaraa |
English: Wandering and roaming around, I have come at last to Your Door.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਕੁਨੁ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: too kun re |
English: "Who are you?"

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਜੀ ॥ ਨਾਮਾ ॥ ਹੋ ਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: mai jee | naamaa | ho jee |
English: "I am Naam Dayv, Sir."

Gurbani: ਆਲਾ ਤੇ ਨਿਵਾਰਣਾ ਜਮ ਕਾਰਣਾ ॥੩॥੪॥
Transliteration: aalaa te nivaaranaa jam kaaranaa |3|4|
English: O Lord, please save me from Maya, the cause of death. ||3||4||

[Ang 694 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Bhagat Namdev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਮਾਧਉ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: patit paavan maadhau birad teraa |
English: O Lord, You are the Purifier of sinners - this is Your innate nature.

Gurbani: ਧੰਨਿ ਤੇ ਵੈ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਜਿਨ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dhan te vai mun jan jin dhiaaeo har prabh meraa |1|
English: Blessed are those silent sages and humble beings, who meditate on my Lord God. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਾਥੈ ਲਾਗੀ ਲੇ ਧੂਰਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਚਰਨਨ ਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: merai maathai laagee le dhoor gobind charanan kee |
English: I have applied to my forehead the dust of the feet of the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਤਿਨਹੂ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sur nar mun jan tinahoo te door |1| rahaau |
English: This is something which is far away from the gods, mortal men and silent sages. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦੀਨ ਕਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਮਾਧੌ ਗਰਬ ਪਰਹਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: deen kaa deaal maadhau garab parahaaree |
English: O Lord, Merciful to the meek, Destroyer of pride

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਨਾਮਾ ਬਲਿ ਤਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੨॥੫॥
Transliteration: charan saran naamaa bal tihaaree |2|5|
English: - Naam Dayv seeks the Sanctuary of Your feet; he is a sacrifice to You. ||2||5||

[Ang 694 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Bhagat Ravidas Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਭਗਤ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree bhagat ravidaas jee kee |
English: Dhanaasaree, Devotee Ravi Daas Jee:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਸਰਿ ਦੀਨੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਨ ਤੁਮ ਸਰਿ ਅਬ ਪਤੀਆਰੁ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: ham sar deen deaal na tum sar ab pateeaar kiaa keejai |
English: There is none as forlorn as I am, and none as Compassionate as You; what need is there to test us now?

Gurbani: ਬਚਨੀ ਤੋਰ ਮੋਰ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bachanee tor mor man maanai jan kau pooran deejai |1|
English: May my mind surrender to Your Word; please, bless Your humble servant with this perfection. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ਰਮਈਆ ਕਾਰਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: hau bal bal jaau rameea kaarane |
English: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਾਰਨ ਕਵਨ ਅਬੋਲ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kaaran kavan abol | rahaau |
English: O Lord, why are You silent? ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਹੁਤ ਜਨਮ ਬਿਛੁਰੇ ਥੇ ਮਾਧਉ ਇਹੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ਲੇਖੇ ॥
Transliteration: bahut janam bichhure the maadhau ihu janam tumaare lekhe |
English: For so many incarnations, I have been separated from You, Lord; I dedicate this life to You.

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਆਸ ਲਗਿ ਜੀਵਉ ਚਿਰ ਭਇਓ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ॥੨॥੧॥
Transliteration: keh ravidaas aas lag jeevau chir bheo darasan dekhe |2|1|
English: Says Ravi Daas: placing my hopes in You, I live; it is so long since I have gazed upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||2||1||

[Ang 694 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Bhagat Ravidas Ji]
Gurbani: ਚਿਤ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਕਰਉ ਨੈਨ ਅਵਿਲੋਕਨੋ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਬਾਨੀ ਸੁਜਸੁ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਾਖਉ ॥
Transliteration: chit simaran krau nain avilokano sravan baanee sujas poor raakhau |
English: In my consciousness, I remember You in meditation; with my eyes, I behold You; I fill my ears with the Word of Your Bani, and Your Sublime Praise.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਸੁ ਮਧੁਕਰੁ ਕਰਉ ਚਰਨ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਧਰਉ ਰਸਨ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਭਾਖਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: man su madhukar krau charan hirade dhrau rasan amrit raam naam bhaakhau |1|
English: My mind is the bumble bee; I enshrine Your feet within my heart, and with my tongue, I chant the Ambrosial Name of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਿਉ ਜਿਨਿ ਘਟੈ ॥
Transliteration: meree preet gobind siau jin ghattai |
English: My love for the Lord of the Universe does not decrease.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਤਉ ਮੋਲਿ ਮਹਗੀ ਲਈ ਜੀਅ ਸਟੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mai tau mol mahagee lee jeea sattai |1| rahaau |
English: I paid for it dearly, in exchange for my soul. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਿਨਾ ਭਾਉ ਨਹੀ ਊਪਜੈ ਭਾਵ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਹੋਇ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasangat binaa bhaau nahee aoopajai bhaav bin bhagat nahee hoe teree |
English: Without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, love for the Lord does not well up; without this love, Your devotional worship cannot be performed.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਰਵਿਦਾਸੁ ਇਕ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪੈਜ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਮੇਰੀ ॥੨॥੨॥
Transliteration: kahai ravidaas ik benatee har siau paij raakhahu raajaa raam meree |2|2|
English: Ravi Daas offers this one prayer unto the Lord: please preserve and protect my honor, O Lord, my King. ||2||2||

[Ang 694 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Bhagat Ravidas Ji]
Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਆਰਤੀ ਮਜਨੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: naam tero aaratee majan muraare |
English: Your Name, Lord, is my adoration and cleansing bath.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਝੂਠੇ ਸਗਲ ਪਾਸਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har ke naam bin jhootthe sagal paasaare |1| rahaau |
English: Without the Name of the Lord, all ostentatious displays are useless. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਆਸਨੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਉਰਸਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੇਸਰੋ ਲੇ ਛਿਟਕਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: naam tero aasano naam tero urasaa naam teraa kesaro le chhittakaare |
English: Your Name is my prayer mat, and Your Name is the stone to grind the sandalwood. Your Name is the saffron which I take and sprinkle in offering to You.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਭੁਲਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਚੰਦਨੋ ਘਸਿ ਜਪੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਕਉ ਚਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naam teraa anbhulaa naam tero chandano ghas jape naam le tujheh kau chaare |1|
English: Your Name is the water, and Your Name is the sandalwood. The chanting of Your Name is the grinding of the sandalwood. I take it and offer all this to You. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦੀਵਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਬਾਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਤੇਲੁ ਲੇ ਮਾਹਿ ਪਸਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: naam teraa deevaa naam tero baatee naam tero tel le maeh pasaare |
English: Your Name is the lamp, and Your Name is the wick. Your Name is the oil I pour into it.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਲਗਾਈ ਭਇਓ ਉਜਿਆਰੋ ਭਵਨ ਸਗਲਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naam tere kee jot lagaaee bheo ujiaaro bhavan sagalaare |2|
English: Your Name is the light applied to this lamp, which enlightens and illuminates the entire world. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਤਾਗਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਫੂਲ ਮਾਲਾ ਭਾਰ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਸਗਲ ਜੂਠਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: naam tero taagaa naam fool maalaa bhaar atthaarah sagal jootthaare |
English: Your Name is the thread, and Your Name is the garland of flowers. The eighteen loads of vegetation are all too impure to offer to You.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੋ ਕੀਆ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਅਰਪਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੁਹੀ ਚਵਰ ਢੋਲਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tero keea tujheh kiaa arpau naam teraa tuhee chavar dtolaare |3|
English: Why should I offer to You, that which You Yourself created? Your Name is the fan, which I wave over You. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦਸ ਅਠਾ ਅਠਸਠੇ ਚਾਰੇ ਖਾਣੀ ਇਹੈ ਵਰਤਣਿ ਹੈ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: das atthaa atthasatthe chaare khaanee ihai varatan hai sagal sansaare |
English: The whole world is engrossed in the eighteen Puraanas, the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, and the four sources of creation.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਰਵਿਦਾਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਆਰਤੀ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਭੋਗ ਤੁਹਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੩॥
Transliteration: kahai ravidaas naam tero aaratee sat naam hai har bhog tuhaare |4|3|
English: Says Ravi Daas, Your Name is my Aartee, my lamp-lit worship-service. The True Name, Sat Naam, is the food which I offer to You. ||4||3||

[Ang 695 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Bhagat Trilochan Ji]
Gurbani: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਾਂ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaasaree baanee bhagataan kee trilochan |
English: Dhanaasaree, The Word Of Devotee Trilochan Jee:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਨਿੰਦਸਿ ਕਾਇ ਭੂਲੀ ਗਵਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: naaraaein nindas kaae bhoolee gavaaree |
English: Why do you slander the Lord? You are ignorant and deluded.

Gurbani: ਦੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਥਾਰੋ ਕਰਮੁ ਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dukrit sukrit thaaro karam ree |1| rahaau |
English: Pain and pleasure are the result of your own actions. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੰਕਰਾ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਬਸਤਾ ਸੁਰਸਰੀ ਇਸਨਾਨ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sankaraa masatak basataa surasaree isanaan re |
English: The moon dwells in Shiva's forehead; it takes its cleansing bath in the Ganges.

Gurbani: ਕੁਲ ਜਨ ਮਧੇ ਮਿਲੵਿੋ ਸਾਰਗ ਪਾਨ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kul jan madhe milayio saarag paan re |
English: Among the men of the moon's family, Krishna was born;

Gurbani: ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਕਲੰਕੁ ਮਫੀਟਸਿ ਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: karam kar kalank mafeettas ree |1|
English: even so, the stains from its past actions remain on the moon's face. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਿਸ੍ਵ ਕਾ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਸ੍ਵਾਮੀ ਤਾ ਚੇ ਰੇ ਸੁਆਰਥੀ ਪੰਖੀ ਰਾਇ ਗਰੁੜ ਤਾ ਚੇ ਬਾਧਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: bisv kaa deepak svaamee taa che re suaarathee pankhee raae garurr taa che baadhavaa |
English: Aruna was a charioteer; his master was the sun, the lamp of the world. His brother was Garuda, the king of birds;

Gurbani: ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਅਰੁਣ ਪਿੰਗੁਲਾ ਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: karam kar arun pingulaa ree |2|
English: and yet, Aruna was made a cripple, because of the karma of his past actions. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਪਾਤਿਕ ਹਰਤਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਨਾਥੁ ਰੀ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਤਾ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: anik paatik harataa tribhavan naath ree teerath teerath bhramataa lahai na paar ree |
English: Shiva, the destroyer of countless sins, the Lord and Master of the three worlds, wandered from sacred shrine to sacred shrine; he never found an end to them.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਕਪਾਲੁ ਮਫੀਟਸਿ ਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: karam kar kapaal mafeettas ree |3|
English: And yet, he could not erase the karma of cutting off Brahma's head. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਸੀਅ ਧੇਨ ਲਛਿਮੀ ਕਲਪਤਰ ਸਿਖਰਿ ਸੁਨਾਗਰ ਨਦੀ ਚੇ ਨਾਥੰ ॥
Transliteration: amrit saseea dhen lachhimee kalapatar sikhar sunaagar nadee che naathan |
English: Through the nectar, the moon, the wish-fulfilling cow, Lakshmi, the miraculous tree of life, Sikhar the sun's horse, and Dhanavantar the wise physician - all arose from the ocean, the lord of rivers;

Gurbani: ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਖਾਰੁ ਮਫੀਟਸਿ ਰੀ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: karam kar khaar mafeettas ree |4|
English: and yet, because of its karma, its saltiness has not left it. ||4||

Gurbani: ਦਾਧੀਲੇ ਲੰਕਾ ਗੜੁ ਉਪਾੜੀਲੇ ਰਾਵਣ ਬਣੁ ਸਲਿ ਬਿਸਲਿ ਆਣਿ ਤੋਖੀਲੇ ਹਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: daadheele lankaa garr upaarreele raavan ban sal bisal aan tokheele haree |
English: Hanuman burnt the fortress of Sri Lanka, uprooted the garden of Raawan, and brought healing herbs for the wounds of Lachhman, pleasing Lord Raamaa;

Gurbani: ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਕਛਉਟੀ ਮਫੀਟਸਿ ਰੀ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: karam kar kchhauttee mafeettas ree |5|
English: and yet, because of his karma, he could not be rid of his loin cloth. ||5||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਬਲੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਰਮੁ ਨ ਮਿਟੈ ਰੀ ਘਰ ਗੇਹਣਿ ਤਾ ਚੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਜਾਪੀਅਲੇ ਰਾਮ ਚੇ ਨਾਮੰ ॥
Transliteration: poorabalo krit karam na mittai ree ghar gehan taa che mohi jaapeeale raam che naaman |
English: The karma of past actions cannot be erased, O wife of my house; this is why I chant the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਬਦਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨ ਰਾਮ ਜੀ ॥੬॥੧॥
Transliteration: badat trilochan raam jee |6|1|
English: So prays Trilochan, Dear Lord. ||6||1||

[Ang 695 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Bhagat Sain Ji]
Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਸੈਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: sree sain |
English: Sri Sain:

Gurbani: ਧੂਪ ਦੀਪ ਘ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਾਜਿ ਆਰਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: dhoop deep ghrit saaj aaratee |
English: With incense, lamps and ghee, I offer this lamp-lit worship service.

Gurbani: ਵਾਰਨੇ ਜਾਉ ਕਮਲਾ ਪਤੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: vaarane jaau kamalaa patee |1|
English: I am a sacrifice to the Lord of Lakshmi. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੰਗਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਗਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: mangalaa har mangalaa |
English: Hail to You, Lord, hail to You!

Gurbani: ਨਿਤ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: nit mangal raajaa raam raae ko |1| rahaau |
English: Again and again, hail to You, Lord King, Ruler of all! ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਊਤਮੁ ਦੀਅਰਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: aootam deearaa niramal baatee |
English: Sublime is the lamp, and pure is the wick.

Gurbani: ਤੁਹਂੀ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਕਮਲਾ ਪਾਤੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tuhanee niranjan kamalaa paatee |2|
English: You are immaculate and pure, O Brilliant Lord of Wealth! ||2||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਾਮਾਨੰਦੁ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: raamaa bhagat raamaanand jaanai |
English: Raamaanand knows the devotional worship of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦੁ ਬਖਾਨੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: pooran paramaanand bakhaanai |3|
English: He says that the Lord is all-pervading, the embodiment of supreme joy. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਦਨ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਭੈ ਤਾਰਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: madan moorat bhai taar gobinde |
English: The Lord of the world, of wondrous form, has carried me across the terrifying world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਸੈਨੁ ਭਣੈ ਭਜੁ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: sain bhanai bhaj paramaanande |4|2|
English: Says Sain, remember the Lord, the embodiment of supreme joy! ||4||2||

[Ang 695 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Bhagat Pipa Ji]
Gurbani: ਪੀਪਾ ॥
Transliteration: peepaa |
English: Peepaa:

Gurbani: ਕਾਯਉ ਦੇਵਾ ਕਾਇਅਉ ਦੇਵਲ ਕਾਇਅਉ ਜੰਗਮ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: kaayau devaa kaaeaau deval kaaeaau jangam jaatee |
English: Within the body, the Divine Lord is embodied. The body is the temple, the place of pilgrimage, and the pilgrim.

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਅਉ ਧੂਪ ਦੀਪ ਨਈਬੇਦਾ ਕਾਇਅਉ ਪੂਜਉ ਪਾਤੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kaaeaau dhoop deep neebedaa kaaeaau poojau paatee |1|
English: Within the body are incense, lamps and offerings. Within the body are the flower offerings. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਬਹੁ ਖੰਡ ਖੋਜਤੇ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa bahu khandd khojate nav nidh paaee |
English: I searched throughout many realms, but I found the nine treasures within the body.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਕਛੁ ਆਇਬੋ ਨਾ ਕਛੁ ਜਾਇਬੋ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਦੁਹਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: naa kachh aaeibo naa kachh jaaeibo raam kee duhaaee |1| rahaau |
English: Nothing comes, and nothing goes; I pray to the Lord for Mercy. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡੇ ਸੋਈ ਪਿੰਡੇ ਜੋ ਖੋਜੈ ਸੋ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jo brahamandde soee pindde jo khojai so paavai |
English: The One who pervades the Universe also dwells in the body; whoever seeks Him, finds Him there.

Gurbani: ਪੀਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਪਰਮ ਤਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਲਖਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੩॥
Transliteration: peepaa pranavai param tat hai satigur hoe lakhaavai |2|3|
English: Peepaa prays, the Lord is the supreme essence; He reveals Himself through the True Guru. ||2||3||

[Ang 695 | Raag: Raag Dhanaasree | Author: Bhagat Dhanna Ji]
Gurbani: ਧੰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaa |
English: Dhannaa:

Gurbani: ਗੋਪਾਲ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: gopaal teraa aarataa |
English: O Lord of the world, this is Your lamp-lit worship service.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੰਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo jan tumaree bhagat karante tin ke kaaj savaarataa |1| rahaau |
English: You are the Arranger of the affairs of those humble beings who perform Your devotional worship service. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦਾਲਿ ਸੀਧਾ ਮਾਗਉ ਘੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: daal seedhaa maagau gheeo |
English: Lentils, flour and ghee - these things, I beg of You.

Gurbani: ਹਮਰਾ ਖੁਸੀ ਕਰੈ ਨਿਤ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: hamaraa khusee karai nit jeeo |
English: My mind shall ever be pleased.

Gurbani: ਪਨੑੀਆ ਛਾਦਨੁ ਨੀਕਾ ॥
Transliteration: panaeea chhaadan neekaa |
English: Shoes, fine clothes,

Gurbani: ਅਨਾਜੁ ਮਗਉ ਸਤ ਸੀ ਕਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: anaaj mgau sat see kaa |1|
English: And grain of seven kinds - I beg of You. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗਊ ਭੈਸ ਮਗਉ ਲਾਵੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaoo bhais mgau laaveree |
English: A milk cow, and a water buffalo, I beg of You,

Gurbani: ਇਕ ਤਾਜਨਿ ਤੁਰੀ ਚੰਗੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: eik taajan turee changeree |
English: and a fine Turkestani horse.

Gurbani: ਘਰ ਕੀ ਗੀਹਨਿ ਚੰਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: ghar kee geehan changee |
English: A good wife to care for my home

Gurbani: ਜਨੁ ਧੰਨਾ ਲੇਵੈ ਮੰਗੀ ॥੨॥੪॥
Transliteration: jan dhanaa levai mangee |2|4|
English: - Your humble servant Dhanna begs for these things, Lord. ||2||4||

[Ang 696 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 4 ghar 1 chaupade |
English: Jaitsree, Fourth Mehl, First House, Chau-Padhay:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਰਤਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਬਸਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਹਾਥੁ ਧਰਿਓ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਾਥਾ ॥
Transliteration: merai heearai ratan naam har basiaa gur haath dhario merai maathaa |
English: The Jewel of the Lord's Name abides within my heart; the Guru has placed His hand on my forehead.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਦੁਖ ਉਤਰੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਓ ਰਿਨੁ ਲਾਥਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: janam janam ke kilabikh dukh utare gur naam deeo rin laathaa |1|
English: The sins and pains of countless incarnations have been cast out. The Guru has blessed me with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and my debt has been paid off. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਭਜੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਭਿ ਅਰਥਾ ॥
Transliteration: mere man bhaj raam naam sabh arathaa |
English: O my mind, vibrate the Lord's Name, and all your affairs shall be resolved.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur poorai har naam drirraaeaa bin naavai jeevan birathaa | rahaau |
English: The Perfect Guru has implanted the Lord's Name within me; without the Name, life is useless. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੂੜ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਨਿਤ ਫਾਥਾ ॥
Transliteration: bin gur moorr bhe hai manamukh te moh maaeaa nit faathaa |
English: Without the Guru, the self-willed manmukhs are foolish and ignorant; they are forever entangled in emotional attachment to Maya.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਣ ਨ ਸੇਵੇ ਕਬਹੂ ਤਿਨ ਸਭੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਕਾਥਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tin saadhoo charan na seve kabahoo tin sabh janam akaathaa |2|
English: They never serve the feet of the Holy; their lives are totally useless. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਣ ਸਾਧ ਪਗ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਿਨ ਸਫਲਿਓ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਨਾਥਾ ॥
Transliteration: jin saadhoo charan saadh pag seve tin safalio janam sanaathaa |
English: Those who serve at the feet of the Holy, the feet of the Holy, their lives are made fruitful, and they belong to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕੀਜੈ ਦਾਸੁ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੋ ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਿ ਜਗੰਨਾਥਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: mo kau keejai daas daas daasan ko har deaa dhaar jaganaathaa |3|
English: Make me the slave of the slave of the slaves of the Lord; bless me with Your Mercy, O Lord of the Universe. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਗਿਆਨਹੀਨ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਿਉ ਚਾਲਹ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪੰਥਾ ॥
Transliteration: ham andhule giaanaheen agiaanee kiau chaalah maarag panthaa |
English: I am blind, ignorant and totally without wisdom; how can I walk on the Path?

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਕਉ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਚਲੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਚਲਹ ਮਿਲੰਥਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: ham andhule kau gur anchal deejai jan naanak chalah milanthaa |4|1|
English: I am blind - O Guru, please let me grasp the hem of Your robe, so that servant Nanak may walk in harmony with You. ||4||1||

[Ang 696 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 4 |
English: Jaitsree, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹੀਰਾ ਲਾਲੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਾਹਕ ਮੀਕਾ ਕਾਖਾ ॥
Transliteration: heeraa laal amolak hai bhaaree bin gaahak meekaa kaakhaa |
English: A jewel or a diamond may be very valuable and heavy, but without a purchaser, it is worth only straw.

Gurbani: ਰਤਨ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਤਬ ਰਤਨੁ ਬਿਕਾਨੋ ਲਾਖਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ratan gaahak gur saadhoo dekhio tab ratan bikaano laakhaa |1|
English: When the Holy Guru, the Purchaser, saw this jewel, He purchased it for hundreds of thousands of dollars. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਗੁਪਤ ਹੀਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਾ ॥
Transliteration: merai man gupat heer har raakhaa |
English: The Lord has kept this jewel hidden within my mind.

Gurbani: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਓ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹੀਰੁ ਪਰਾਖਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: deen deaal milaaeo gur saadhoo gur miliai heer paraakhaa | rahaau |
English: The Lord, merciful to the meek, led me to meet the Holy Guru; meeting the Guru, I came to appreciate this jewel. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕੋਠੀ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਤਿਨ ਘਰਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਖਾ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh kotthee agiaan andheraa tin ghar ratan na laakhaa |
English: The rooms of the self-willed manmukhs are dark with ignorance; in their homes, the jewel is not visible.

Gurbani: ਤੇ ਊਝੜਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਮੁਏ ਗਾਵਾਰੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਭੁਅੰਗ ਬਿਖੁ ਚਾਖਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: te aoojharr bharam mue gaavaaree maaeaa bhuang bikh chaakhaa |2|
English: Those fools die, wandering in the wilderness, eating the poison of the snake, Maya. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਜਨ ਨੀਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਣਿ ਹਮ ਰਾਖਾ ॥
Transliteration: har har saadh melahu jan neeke har saadhoo saran ham raakhaa |
English: O Lord, Har, Har, let me meet the humble, holy beings; O Lord, keep me in the Sanctuary of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਪਰੇ ਭਾਗਿ ਤੁਮ ਪਾਖਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har angeekaar karahu prabh suaamee ham pare bhaag tum paakhaa |3|
English: O Lord, make me Your own; O God, Lord and Master, I have hurried to Your side. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣਹ ਤੁਮ ਵਡ ਅਗਮ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖਾ ॥
Transliteration: jihavaa kiaa gun aakh vakhaanah tum vadd agam vadd purakhaa |
English: What Glorious Virtues of Yours can I speak and describe? You are great and unfathomable, the Greatest Being.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਪਾਖਾਣੁ ਡੁਬਤ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: jan naanak har kirapaa dhaaree paakhaan ddubat har raakhaa |4|2|
English: The Lord has bestowed His Mercy on servant Nanak; He has saved the sinking stone. ||4||2||

[Ang 697 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 4 |
English: Jaitsree, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਕਛੂਅ ਨ ਜਾਨਹ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਇਆਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: ham baarik kachhooa na jaanah gat mit tere moorakh mugadh eaanaa |
English: I am Your child; I know nothing about Your state and extent; I am foolish, idiotic and ignorant.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਜੈ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਸਿਆਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har kirapaa dhaar deejai mat aootam kar leejai mugadh siaanaa |1|
English: O Lord, shower me with Your Mercy; bless me with an enlightened intellect; I am foolish - make me clever. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਆਲਸੀਆ ਉਘਲਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: meraa man aalaseea ughalaanaa |
English: My mind is lazy and sleepy.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਨਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਓ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਕਪਟ ਖੁਲਾਨਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har har aan milaaeo gur saadhoo mil saadhoo kapatt khulaanaa | rahaau |
English: The Lord, Har, Har, has led me to meet the Holy Guru; meeting the Holy, the shutters have been opened wide. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur khin khin preet lagaavahu merai heearai mere preetam naam paraanaa |
English: O Guru, each and every instant, fill my heart with love; the Name of my Beloved is my breath of life.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਜਿਉ ਅਮਲੀ ਅਮਲਿ ਲੁਭਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bin naavai mar jaaeeai mere tthaakur jiau amalee amal lubhaanaa |2|
English: Without the Name, I would die; the Name of my Lord and Master is to me like the drug to the addict. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਭਾਗ ਪੁਰਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jin man preet lagee har keree tin dhur bhaag puraanaa |
English: Those who enshrine love for the Lord within their minds fulfill their pre-ordained destiny.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਹਮ ਚਰਣ ਸਰੇਵਹ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tin ham charan sarevah khin khin jin har meetth lagaanaa |3|
English: I worship their feet, each and every instant; the Lord seems very sweet to them. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਬਿਛੁਰਿਆ ਚਿਰੀ ਮਿਲਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: har har kripaa dhaaree merai tthaakur jan bichhuriaa chiree milaanaa |
English: My Lord and Master, Har, Har, has showered His Mercy upon His humble servant; separated for so long, he is now re-united with the Lord.

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan satigur jin naam drirraaeaa jan naanak tis kurabaanaa |4|3|
English: Blessed, blessed is the True Guru, who has implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord within me; servant Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||4||3||

[Ang 697 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 4 |
English: Jaitsree, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਵਡ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਫਲ ਲਾਗਿਬਾ ॥
Transliteration: satigur saajan purakh vadd paaeaa har rasak rasak fal laagibaa |
English: I have found the True Guru, my Friend, the Greatest Being. Love and affection for the Lord has blossomed forth.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਭੁਇਅੰਗ ਗ੍ਰਸਿਓ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਬਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਢਿਬਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: maaeaa bhueiang grasio hai praanee gur bachanee bis har kaadtibaa |1|
English: Maya, the snake, has seized the mortal; through the Word of the Guru, the Lord neutralizes the venom. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਸਿ ਲਾਗਿਬਾ ॥
Transliteration: meraa man raam naam ras laagibaa |
English: My mind is attached to the sublime essence of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧ ਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਬਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har kee patit pavitr mil saadh gur har naamai har ras chaakhibaa | rahaau |
English: The Lord has purified the sinners, uniting them with the Holy Guru; now, they taste the Lord's Name, and the sublime essence of the Lord. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਵਡਭਾਗ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਲਿਵ ਉਨਮਨਿ ਲਾਗਿਬਾ ॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan vaddabhaag milio gur saadhoo mil saadhoo liv unaman laagibaa |
English: Blessed, blessed is the good fortune of those who meet the Holy Guru; meeting with the Holy, they lovingly center themselves in the state of absolute absorption.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇਬਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: trisanaa agan bujhee saant paaee har niramal niramal gun gaaeibaa |2|
English: The fire of desire within them is quenched, and they find peace; they sing the Glorious Praises of the Immaculate Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਭਾਗ ਖੀਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਰਸੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਬਾ ॥
Transliteration: tin ke bhaag kheen dhur paae jin satigur daras na paaeibaa |
English: Those who do not obtain the Blessed Vision of the True Guru's Darshan, have misfortune pre-ordained for them.

Gurbani: ਤੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਵਹਿ ਗ੍ਰਭ ਜੋਨੀ ਸਭੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਿਨ ਜਾਇਬਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: te doojai bhaae paveh grabh jonee sabh birathaa janam tin jaaeibaa |3|
English: In the love of duality, they are consigned to reincarnation through the womb, and they pass their lives totally uselessly. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਬਿਮਲ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਧ ਪਗ ਸੇਵਹ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਇਬਾ ॥
Transliteration: har dehu bimal mat gur saadh pag sevah ham har meetth lagaaeibaa |
English: O Lord, please, bless me with pure understanding, that I may serve the Feet of the Holy Guru; the Lord seems sweet to me.

Gurbani: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਰੇਣ ਸਾਧ ਪਗ ਮਾਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦਿਵਾਇਬਾ ॥੪॥੪॥
Transliteration: jan naanak ren saadh pag maagai har hoe deaal divaaeibaa |4|4|
English: Servant Nanak begs for the dust of the feet of the Holy; O Lord, be Merciful, and bless me with it. ||4||4||

[Ang 697 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 4 |
English: Jaitsree, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਬਸਿਓ ਤਿਨ ਮਾਤ ਕੀਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਂਝਾ ॥
Transliteration: jin har hiradai naam na basio tin maat keejai har baanjhaa |
English: The Lord's Name does not abide within their hearts - their mothers should have been sterile.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਸੁੰਞੀ ਦੇਹ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਓਇ ਖਪਿ ਖਪਿ ਮੁਏ ਕਰਾਂਝਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tin sunyee deh fireh bin naavai oe khap khap mue karaanjhaa |1|
English: These bodies wander around, forlorn and abandoned, without the Name; their lives waste away, and they die, crying out in pain. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਝਾ ॥
Transliteration: mere man jap raam naam har maajhaa |
English: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, the Lord within you.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਦੀਓ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har har kripaal kripaa prabh dhaaree gur giaan deeo man samajhaa | rahaau |
English: The Merciful Lord God, Har, Har, has showered me with His Mercy; the Guru has imparted spiritual wisdom to me, and my mind has been instructed. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਲਜੁਗਿ ਪਦੁ ਊਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਾਝਾ ॥
Transliteration: har keerat kalajug pad aootam har paaeeai satigur maajhaa |
English: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise brings the most noble and exalted status; the Lord is found through the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਝਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: hau balihaaree satigur apune jin gupat naam paragaajhaa |2|
English: I am a sacrifice to my True Guru, who has revealed the Lord's hidden Name to me. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸਾਧ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਗਏ ਗਵਾਝਾ ॥
Transliteration: darasan saadh milio vaddabhaagee sabh kilabikh ge gavaajhaa |
English: By great good fortune, I obtained the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the Holy; it removes all stains of sin.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਹੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਡ ਦਾਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਬਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਝਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: satigur saahu paaeaa vadd daanaa har kee bahu gun saajhaa |3|
English: I have found the True Guru, the great, all-knowing King; He has shared with me the many Glorious Virtues of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਜਗਜੀਵਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਮਨ ਮਾਝਾ ॥
Transliteration: jin kau kripaa karee jagajeevan har ur dhaario man maajhaa |
English: Those, unto whom the Lord, the Life of the world, has shown Mercy, enshrine Him within their hearts, and cherish Him in their minds.

Gurbani: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਦਰਿ ਕਾਗਦ ਫਾਰੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੇਖਾ ਸਮਝਾ ॥੪॥੫॥
Transliteration: dharam raae dar kaagad faare jan naanak lekhaa samajhaa |4|5|
English: The Righteous Judge of Dharma, in the Court of the Lord, has torn up my papers; servant Nanak's account has been settled. ||4||5||

[Ang 698 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 4 |
English: Jaitsree, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਪਾਈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮਨੁ ਚਲਤੌ ਭਇਓ ਅਰੂੜਾ ॥
Transliteration: satasangat saadh paaee vaddabhaagee man chalatau bheo aroorraa |
English: In the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I found the Holy, by great good fortune; my restless mind has been quieted.

Gurbani: ਅਨਹਤ ਧੁਨਿ ਵਾਜਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਵਾਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰ ਰਸਿ ਲੀੜਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: anahat dhun vaajeh nit vaaje har amrit dhaar ras leerraa |1|
English: The unstruck melody ever vibrates and resounds; I have taken in the sublime essence of the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar, showering down. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੂੜਾ ॥
Transliteration: mere man jap raam naam har roorraa |
English: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, the beauteous Lord.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਲਾਇ ਝਪੀੜਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: merai man tan preet lagaaee satigur har milio laae jhapeerraa | rahaau |
English: The True Guru has drenched my mind and body with the Love of the Lord, who has met me and lovingly embraced me. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤ ਬੰਧ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਸੰਚਹਿ ਲਾਇ ਜਕੀੜਾ ॥
Transliteration: saakat bandh bhe hai maaeaa bikh sancheh laae jakeerraa |
English: The faithless cynics are bound and gagged in the chains of Maya; they are actively engaged, gathering in the poisonous wealth.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਅਰਥਿ ਖਰਚਿ ਨਹ ਸਾਕਹਿ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਸਹਹਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਪੀੜਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har kai arath kharach neh saakeh jamakaal saheh sir peerraa |2|
English: They cannot spend this in harmony with the Lord, and so they must endure the pain which the Messenger of Death inflicts upon their heads. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਅਰਥਿ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਲਗਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਬਹੁ ਸਰਧਾ ਲਾਇ ਮੁਖਿ ਧੂੜਾ ॥
Transliteration: jin har arath sareer lagaaeaa gur saadhoo bahu saradhaa laae mukh dhoorraa |
