English: The Holy Guru has dedicated His Being to the Lord's service; with great devotion, apply the dust of His feet to your face.

Gurbani: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਗਾ ਮਨਿ ਗੂੜਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: halat palat har sobhaa paaveh har rang lagaa man goorraa |3|
English: In this world and the next, you shall receive the Lord's honor, and your mind shall be imbued with the permanent color of the Lord's Love. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਜਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਹਮ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਕੀੜਾ ॥
Transliteration: har har mel mel jan saadhoo ham saadh janaa kaa keerraa |
English: O Lord, Har, Har, please unite me with the Holy; compared to these Holy people, I am just a worm.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਪਗ ਸਾਧ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਪਾਖਾਣੁ ਹਰਿਓ ਮਨੁ ਮੂੜਾ ॥੪॥੬॥
Transliteration: jan naanak preet lagee pag saadh gur mil saadhoo paakhaan hario man moorraa |4|6|
English: Servant Nanak has enshrined love for the feet of the Holy Guru; meeting with this Holy One, my foolish, stone-like mind has blossomed forth in lush profusion. ||4||6||

[Ang 698 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 4 ghar 2 |
English: Jaitsree, Fourth Mehl, Second House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har har simarahu agam apaaraa |
English: Remember in meditation the Lord, Har, Har, the unfathomable, infinite Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jis simarat dukh mittai hamaaraa |
English: Remembering Him in meditation, pains are dispelled.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har har satigur purakh milaavahu gur miliai sukh hoee raam |1|
English: O Lord, Har, Har, lead me to meet the True Guru; meeting the Guru, I am at peace. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਮੀਤ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har gun gaavahu meet hamaare |
English: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, O my friend.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖਹੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam rakhahu ur dhaare |
English: Cherish the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in your heart.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਚਨ ਸੁਣਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har har amrit bachan sunaavahu gur miliai paragatt hoee raam |2|
English: Read the Ambrosial Words of the Lord, Har, Har; meeting with the Guru, the Lord is revealed. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਧੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: madhusoodan har maadho praanaa |
English: The Lord, the Slayer of demons, is my breath of life.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: merai man tan amrit meetth lagaanaa |
English: His Ambrosial Amrit is so sweet to my mind and body.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har har deaa karahu gur melahu purakh niranjan soee raam |3|
English: O Lord, Har, Har, have mercy upon me, and lead me to meet the Guru, the immaculate Primal Being. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam sadaa sukhadaataa |
English: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is forever the Giver of peace.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: har kai rang meraa man raataa |
English: My mind is imbued with the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਹਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੧॥੭॥
Transliteration: har har mahaa purakh gur melahu gur naanak naam sukh hoee raam |4|1|7|
English: O Lord Har, Har, lead me to meet the Guru, the Greatest Being; through the Name of Guru Nanak, I have found peace. ||4||1||7||

[Ang 698 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 4 |
English: Jaitsree, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: har har har har naam japaahaa |
English: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh naam sadaa lai laahaa |
English: As Gurmukh, ever earn the profit of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har har har har bhagat drirraavahu har har naam oumaahaa raam |1|
English: Implant within yourself devotion to the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har; sincerely dedicate yourself to the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਧਿਆਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam deaal dhiaahaa |
English: Meditate on the Name of the Merciful Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: har kai rang sadaa gun gaahaa |
English: WIth love, forever sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਘੂਮਰਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har har har jas ghoomar paavahu mil satasang oumaahaa raam |2|
English: Dance to the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har; meet with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, with sincerity. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਉ ਸਖੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: aau sakhee har mel milaahaa |
English: Come, O companions - let us unite in the Lord's Union.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: sun har kathaa naam lai laahaa |
English: Listening to the sermon of the Lord, earn the profit of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har har kripaa dhaar gur melahu gur miliai har oumaahaa raam |3|
English: O Lord, Har, Har, be merciful to me, and lead me to meet the Guru; meeting the Guru, a sincere yearning for the Lord wells up in me. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਜਸੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: kar keerat jas agam athaahaa |
English: Praise Him, the unfathomable and inaccessible Lord.

Gurbani: ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਗਾਵਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: khin khin raam naam gaavaahaa |
English: Each and every moment, sing the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਧਾਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਦਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਿ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੨॥੮॥
Transliteration: mo kau dhaar kripaa mileeai gur daate har naanak bhagat oumaahaa raam |4|2|8|
English: Be merciful, and meet me, O Guru, Great Giver; Nanak yearns for the Lord's devotional worship. ||4||2||8||

[Ang 699 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 4 |
English: Jaitsree, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਸਾਲੁ ਸਲਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: ras ras raam rasaal salaahaa |
English: With love and energetic affection, praise the Lord, the storehouse of Nectar.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਭੀਨਾ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: man raam naam bheenaa lai laahaa |
English: My mind is drenched with the Lord's Name, and so it earns this profit.

Gurbani: ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: khin khin bhagat karah din raatee guramat bhagat oumaahaa raam |1|
English: Each and every moment, worship Him in devotion, day and night; through the Guru's Teachings, sincere love and devotion well up. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਜਪਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: har har gun govind japaahaa |
English: Chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਜੀਤਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: man tan jeet sabad lai laahaa |
English: Conquering mind and body, I have earned the profit of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਵਸਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਓਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: guramat panch doot vas aaveh man tan har omaahaa raam |2|
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, the five demons are over-powered, and the mind and body are filled with a sincere yearning for the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: naam ratan har naam japaahaa |
English: The Name is a jewel - chant the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਸਦਾ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: har gun gaae sadaa lai laahaa |
English: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and forever earn this profit.

Gurbani: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਧੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: deen deaal kripaa kar maadho har har naam oumaahaa raam |3|
English: O Lord, merciful to the meek, be kind to me, and bless me with sincere longing for the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਜਗਦੀਸੁ ਜਪਉ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: jap jagadees jpau man maahaa |
English: Meditate on the Lord of the world - meditate within your mind.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਗੰਨਾਥੁ ਜਗਿ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: har har jaganaath jag laahaa |
English: The Lord of the Universe, Har, Har, is the only real profit in this world.

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਵਡੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਿ ਓਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੩॥੯॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan vadde tthaakur prabh mere jap naanak bhagat omaahaa raam |4|3|9|
English: Blessed, blessed, is my Great Lord and Master God; O Nanak, meditate on Him, worship Him with sincere love and devotion. ||4||3||9||

[Ang 699 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 4 |
English: Jaitsree, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਜੋਗੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜੁਗਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape jogee jugat jugaahaa |
English: He Himself is the Yogi, and the way throughout the ages.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape nirbhau taarree laahaa |
English: The Fearless Lord Himself is absorbed in Samaadhi.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਆਪੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aape hee aap aap varatai aape naam oumaahaa raam |1|
English: He Himself, all by Himself, is all-pervading; He Himself blesses us with sincere love for the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਦੀਪ ਲੋਅ ਦੀਪਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape deep loa deepaahaa |
English: He Himself is the lamp, and the Light pervading all the worlds.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਮਥਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape satigur samund mathaahaa |
English: He Himself is the True Guru; He Himself churns the ocean.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮਥਿ ਮਥਿ ਤਤੁ ਕਢਾਏ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aape math math tat kadtaae jap naam ratan oumaahaa raam |2|
English: He Himself churns it, churning up the essence; meditating on the jewel of the Naam, sincere love comes to the surface. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਖੀ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: sakhee milahu mil gun gaavaahaa |
English: O my companions, let us meet and join together, and sing His Glorious Praises.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh naam japahu har laahaa |
English: As Gurmukh, chant the Naam, and earn the profit of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੀ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har har bhagat drirree man bhaaee har har naam oumaahaa raam |3|
English: Devotional worship of the Lord, Har, Har, has been implanted within me; it is pleasing to my mind. The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, brings a sincere love. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਵਡ ਦਾਣਾ ਵਡ ਸਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape vadd daanaa vadd saahaa |
English: He Himself is supremely wise, the greatest King.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh poonjee naam visaahaa |
English: As Gurmukh, purchase the merchandise of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: har har daat karahu prabh bhaavai gun naanak naam oumaahaa raam |4|4|10|
English: O Lord God, Har, Har, bless me with such a gift, that Your Glorious Virtues seem pleasing to me; Nanak is filled with sincere love and yearning for the Lord. ||4||4||10||

[Ang 699 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 4 |
English: Jaitsree, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਗੁਰਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: mil satasangat sang guraahaa |
English: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and associating with the Guru,

Gurbani: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੇਸਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: poonjee naam guramukh vesaahaa |
English: the Gurmukh gathers in the merchandise of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har har kripaa dhaar madhusoodan mil satasang oumaahaa raam |1|
English: O Lord, Har, Har, Destroyer of demons, have mercy upon me; bless me with a sincere yearning to join the Sat Sangat. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਬਾਣੀ ਸ੍ਰਵਣਿ ਸੁਣਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: har gun baanee sravan sunaahaa |
English: Let me hear with my ears the Banis, the Hymns, in praise of the Lord;

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa satiguroo milaahaa |
English: be merciful, and let me meet the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ ਗੁਣ ਬੋਲਹ ਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਜਪਿ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gun gaavah gun bolah baanee har gun jap oumaahaa raam |2|
English: I sing His Glorious Praises, I speak the Bani of His Word; chanting His Glorious Praises, a sincere yearning for the Lord wells up. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਵਰਤ ਜਗ ਪੁੰਨ ਤੋੁਲਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabh teerath varat jag pun tuolaahaa |
English: I have tried visiting all the sacred shrines of pilgrimage, fasting, ceremonial feasts and giving to charities.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਪੁਜਹਿ ਪੁਜਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam na pujeh pujaahaa |
English: They do not measure up to the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਤੋਲੁ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਪਿ ਓੁਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har har atul tol at bhaaree guramat jap oumaahaa raam |3|
English: The Lord's Name is unweighable, utterly heavy in weight; through the Guru's Teachings, a sincere yearning to chant the Name has welled up in me. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabh karam dharam har naam japaahaa |
English: All good karma and righteous living are found in meditation on the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਮੈਲੁ ਪਾਪ ਧੋਵਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: kilavikh mail paap dhovaahaa |
English: It washes away the stains of sins and mistakes.

Gurbani: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਹੋਹੁ ਜਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਓਮਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: deen deaal hohu jan aoopar dehu naanak naam omaahaa raam |4|5|11|
English: Be merciful to meek, humble Nanak; bless him with sincere love and yearning for the Lord. ||4||5||11||

[Ang 700 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 5 ghar 3 |
English: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl, Third House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਜਾਨੈ ਕਵਨੁ ਈਹਾ ਜਗਿ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: koee jaanai kavan eehaa jag meet |
English: Does anyone know, who is our friend in this world?

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਸੋਈ ਬਿਧਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jis hoe kripaal soee bidh boojhai taa kee niramal reet |1| rahaau |
English: He alone understands this, whom the Lord blesses with His Mercy. Immaculate and unstained is his way of life. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪ ਇਸਟ ਮੀਤ ਅਰੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: maat pitaa banitaa sut bandhap isatt meet ar bhaaee |
English: Mother, father, spouse, children, relatives, lovers, friends and siblings meet,

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਬ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਅੰਤਹਿ ਕੋ ਨ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: poorab janam ke mile sanjogee anteh ko na sahaaee |1|
English: Having been associated in previous lives; but none of them will be your companion and support in the end. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਮਾਲ ਕਨਿਕ ਲਾਲ ਹੀਰਾ ਮਨ ਰੰਜਨ ਕੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: mukat maal kanik laal heeraa man ranjan kee maaeaa |
English: Pearl necklaces, gold, rubies and diamonds please the mind, but they are only Maya.

Gurbani: ਹਾ ਹਾ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਹਾਨੀ ਅਵਧਹਿ ਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: haa haa karat bihaanee avadheh taa meh santokh na paaeaa |2|
English: Possessing them, one passes his life in agony; he obtains no contentment from them. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਸਤਿ ਰਥ ਅਸ੍ਵ ਪਵਨ ਤੇਜ ਧਣੀ ਭੂਮਨ ਚਤੁਰਾਂਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: hasat rath asv pavan tej dhanee bhooman chaturaangaa |
English: Elephants, chariots, horses as fast as the wind, wealth, land, and armies of four kinds

Gurbani: ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲਿਓ ਇਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਛੂਐ ਊਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਇਓ ਨਾਂਗਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sang na chaalio in meh kachhooai aootth sidhaaeo naangaa |3|
English: - none of these will go with him; he must get up and depart, naked. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: har ke sant pria preetam prabh ke taa kai har har gaaeeai |
English: The Lord's Saints are the beloved lovers of God; sing of the Lord, Har, Har, with them.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਈਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਆਗੈ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak eehaa sukh aagai mukh aoojal sang santan kai paaeeai |4|1|
English: O Nanak, in the Society of the Saints, you shall obtain peace in this world, and in the next world, your face shall be radiant and bright. ||4||1||

[Ang 700 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 5 ghar 3 dupade |
English: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl, Third House, Dho-Padhay:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਦੇਹੁ ਸੰਦੇਸਰੋ ਕਹੀਅਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਕਹੀਅਉ ॥
Transliteration: dehu sandesaro kaheeo pria kaheeo |
English: Give me a message from my Beloved - tell me, tell me!

Gurbani: ਬਿਸਮੁ ਭਈ ਮੈ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਸੁਨਤੇ ਕਹਹੁ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਸਹੀਅਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bisam bhee mai bahu bidh sunate kahahu suhaagan saheeo |1| rahaau |
English: I am wonder-struck, hearing the many reports of Him; tell them to me, O my happy sister soul-brides. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕੋ ਕਹਤੋ ਸਭ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਕਹਤੋ ਸਭ ਮਹੀਅਉ ॥
Transliteration: ko kahato sabh baahar baahar ko kahato sabh maheeo |
English: Some say that He is beyond the world - totally beyond it, while others say that He is totally within it.

Gurbani: ਬਰਨੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਚਿਹਨੁ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਸਾਤਿ ਬੁਝਹੀਅਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: baran na deesai chihan na lakheeai suhaagan saat bujhaheeo |1|
English: His color cannot be seen, and His pattern cannot be discerned. O happy soul-brides, tell me the truth! ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਵਾਸੀ ਲੇਪੁ ਨਹੀ ਅਲਪਹੀਅਉ ॥
Transliteration: sarab nivaasee ghatt ghatt vaasee lep nahee alapaheeo |
English: He is pervading everywhere, and He dwells in each and every heart; He is not stained - He is unstained.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹਤ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਲੋਗਾ ਸੰਤ ਰਸਨ ਕੋ ਬਸਹੀਅਉ ॥੨॥੧॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak kehat sunahu re logaa sant rasan ko basaheeo |2|1|2|
English: Says Nanak, listen, O people: He dwells upon the tongues of the Saints. ||2||1||2||

[Ang 700 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਧੀਰਉ ਸੁਨਿ ਧੀਰਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dheerau sun dheerau prabh kau |1| rahaau |
English: I am calmed, calmed and soothed, hearing of God. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਅਰਪਉ ਨੀਰਉ ਪੇਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਨੀਰਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jeea praan man tan sabh arpau neerau pekh prabh kau neerau |1|
English: I dedicate my soul, my breath of life, my mind, body and everything to Him: I behold God near, very near. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਬਡ ਦਾਤਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਗਹੀਰਉ ਪੇਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: besumaar beant badd daataa maneh gaheerau pekh prabh kau |2|
English: Beholding God, the inestimable, infinite and Great Giver, I cherish Him in my mind. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਚਾਹਉ ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਵਉ ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰਉ ਜਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jo chaahau soee soee paavau aasaa manasaa poorau jap prabh kau |3|
English: Whatever I wish for, I receive; my hopes and desires are fulfilled, meditating on God. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਦੂਖਿ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਝੂਰਉ ਬੁਝਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ॥੪॥੨॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad naanak man vasiaa dookh na kabahoo jhoorau bujh prabh kau |4|2|3|
English: By Guru's Grace, God dwells in Nanak's mind; he never suffers or grieves, having realized God. ||4||2||3||

[Ang 700 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਲੋੜੀਦੜਾ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: lorreedarraa saajan meraa |
English: I seek my Friend the Lord.

Gurbani: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮੰਗਲ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਨੀਕੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ghar ghar mangal gaavahu neeke ghatt ghatt tiseh baseraa |1| rahaau |
English: In each and every home, sing the sublime songs of rejoicing; He abides in each and every heart. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੂਖਿ ਅਰਾਧਨੁ ਦੂਖਿ ਅਰਾਧਨੁ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਬੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sookh araadhan dookh araadhan bisarai na kaahoo beraa |
English: In good times, worship and adore Him; in bad times, worship and adore Him; do not ever forget Him.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਕੋਟਿ ਸੂਰ ਉਜਾਰਾ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਭਰਮੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naam japat kott soor ujaaraa binasai bharam andheraa |1|
English: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the light of millions of suns shines forth, and the darkness of doubt is dispelled. ||1||

Gurbani: ਥਾਨਿ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਸਭਨੀ ਜਾਈ ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: thaan thanantar sabhanee jaaee jo deesai so teraa |
English: In all the spaces and interspaces, everywhere, whatever we see is Yours.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਜੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਫੇਰਾ ॥੨॥੩॥੪॥
Transliteration: santasang paavai jo naanak tis bahur na hoee hai feraa |2|3|4|
English: One who finds the Society of the Saints, O Nanak, is not consigned to reincarnation again. ||2||3||4||

[Ang 701 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 5 ghar 4 dupade |
English: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House, Dho-Padhay:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਮੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੵਿ ॥
Transliteration: ab mai sukh paaeo gur aagay |
English: Now, I have found peace, bowing before the Guru.

Gurbani: ਤਜੀ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਚਿੰਤ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ਅਹੰ ਛੋਡਿਓ ਹੈ ਤਿਆਗੵਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tajee siaanap chint visaaree ahan chhoddio hai tiaagay |1| rahaau |
English: I have abandoned cleverness, quieted my anxiety, and renounced my egotism. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਉ ਸਗਲ ਮੋਹਿ ਮੋਹੀਅਉ ਤਉ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: jau dekhau tau sagal mohi moheeo tau saran pario gur bhaag |
English: When I looked, I saw that everyone was enticed by emotional attachment; then, I hurried to the Guru's Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਟਹਲ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਇਓ ਤਉ ਜਮਿ ਛੋਡੀ ਮੋਰੀ ਲਾਗਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa ttehal har laaeo tau jam chhoddee moree laag |1|
English: In His Grace, the Guru engaged me in the Lord's service, and then, the Messenger of Death gave up pursuing me. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤਰਿਓ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਪਾਵਕ ਕੋ ਜਉ ਸੰਤ ਭੇਟੇ ਵਡ ਭਾਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: tario saagar paavak ko jau sant bhette vadd bhaag |
English: I swam across the ocean of fire, when I met the Saints, through great good fortune.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਰੋ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਗਿ ॥੨॥੧॥੫॥
Transliteration: jan naanak sarab sukh paae moro har charanee chit laag |2|1|5|
English: O servant Nanak, I have found total peace; my consciousness is attached to the Lord's feet. ||2||1||5||

[Ang 701 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: man meh satigur dhiaan dharaa |
English: Within my mind, I cherish and meditate on the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਦ੍ਰਿੜਿੑਓ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਮਇਆ ਕਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: drirrao giaan mantru har naamaa prabh jeeo meaa karaa |1| rahaau |
English: He has implanted within me spiritual wisdom and the Mantra of the Lord's Name; Dear God has shown mercy to me. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਾਲ ਜਾਲ ਅਰੁ ਮਹਾ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ ਛੁਟਕੇ ਜਮਹਿ ਡਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaal jaal ar mahaa janjaalaa chhuttake jameh ddaraa |
English: Death's noose and its mighty entanglements have vanished, along with the fear of death.

Gurbani: ਆਇਓ ਦੁਖ ਹਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਕਰੁਣਾਪਤਿ ਗਹਿਓ ਚਰਣ ਆਸਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aaeo dukh haran saran karunaapat gahio charan aasaraa |1|
English: I have come to the Sanctuary of the Merciful Lord, the Destroyer of pain; I am holding tight to the Support of His feet. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਾਵ ਰੂਪ ਭਇਓ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਭਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: naav roop bheo saadhasang bhav nidh paar paraa |
English: The Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, has assumed the form of a boat, to cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀਓ ਗਤੁ ਥੀਓ ਭਰਮਾ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰਾ ॥੨॥੨॥੬॥
Transliteration: apiau peeo gat theeo bharamaa kahu naanak ajar jaraa |2|2|6|
English: I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar, and my doubts are shattered; says Nanak, I can bear the unbearable. ||2||2||6||

[Ang 701 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਏ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kau bhe govind sahaaee |
English: One who has the Lord of the Universe as his help and support

Gurbani: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਉ ਵਾ ਕਉ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sookh sehaj aanand sagal siau vaa kau biaadh na kaaee |1| rahaau |
English: is blessed with all peace, poise and bliss; no afflictions cling to him. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦੀਸਹਿ ਸਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਅਲੇਪਾ ਨਹ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਉਨ ਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: deeseh sabh sang raheh alepaa neh viaapai un maaee |
English: He appears to keep company with everyone, but he remains detached, and Maya does not cling to him.

Gurbani: ਏਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਤਤ ਕੇ ਬੇਤੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ekai rang tat ke bete satigur te budh paaee |1|
English: He is absorbed in love of the One Lord; he understands the essence of reality, and he is blessed with wisdom by the True Guru. ||1||

Gurbani: ਦਇਆ ਮਇਆ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਈ ਸੰਤ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: deaa meaa kirapaa tthaakur kee seee sant subhaaee |
English: Those whom the Lord and Master blesses with His kindness, compassion and mercy are the sublime and sanctified Saints.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਸਤਰੀਐ ਜਿਨ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਈ ॥੨॥੩॥੭॥
Transliteration: tin kai sang naanak nisatareeai jin ras ras har gun gaaee |2|3|7|
English: Associating with them, Nanak is saved; with love and exuberant joy, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||3||7||

[Ang 701 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਜੀਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਧਨ ਰੂਪ ॥
Transliteration: gobind jeevan praan dhan roop |
English: The Lord of the Universe is my existence, my breath of life, wealth and beauty.

Gurbani: ਅਗਿਆਨ ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਮਹਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੇ ਮਹਿ ਦੀਪ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: agiaan moh magan mahaa praanee andhiaare meh deep |1| rahaau |
English: The ignorant are totally intoxicated with emotional attachment; in this darkness, the Lord is the only lamp. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਆਨੂਪ ॥
Transliteration: safal darasan tumaraa prabh preetam charan kamal aanoop |
English: Fruitful is the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, O Beloved God; Your lotus feet are incomparably beautiful!

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਰ ਕਰਉ ਤਿਹ ਬੰਦਨ ਮਨਹਿ ਚਰ੍ਹਾਵਉ ਧੂਪ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: anik baar krau tih bandan maneh charhaavau dhoop |1|
English: So many times, I bow in reverence to Him, offering my mind as incense to Him. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਾਰਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਤੁਮੑਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੑੁ ਕਰਿ ਗਹੀ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ਲੂਕ ॥
Transliteration: haar pario tumarai prabh duaarai drirrau kar gahee tumaaree look |
English: Exhausted, I have fallen at Your Door, O God; I am holding tight to Your Support.

Gurbani: ਕਾਢਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਉ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਪਾਵਕ ਕੇ ਕੂਪ ॥੨॥੪॥੮॥
Transliteration: kaadt lehu naanak apune kau sansaar paavak ke koop |2|4|8|
English: Please, lift Your humble servant Nanak up, out of the pit of fire of the world. ||2||4||8||

[Ang 701 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਦੇਵੈ ਜੋਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: koee jan har siau devai jor |
English: If only someone would unite me with the Lord!

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਗਹਉ ਬਕਉ ਸੁਭ ਰਸਨਾ ਦੀਜਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਕੋਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: charan ghau bkau subh rasanaa deejeh praan akor |1| rahaau |
English: I hold tight to His feet, and utter sweet words with my tongue; I make my breath of life an offering to Him. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰਤ ਕਿਆਰੋ ਹਰਿ ਸਿੰਚੈ ਸੁਧਾ ਸੰਜੋਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: man tan niramal karat kiaaro har sinchai sudhaa sanjor |
English: I make my mind and body into pure little gardens, and irrigate them with the sublime essence of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਇਆ ਰਸ ਮਹਿ ਮਗਨੁ ਹੋਤ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਤੇ ਤੋਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: eaa ras meh magan hot kirapaa te mahaa bikhiaa te tor |1|
English: I am drenched with this sublime essence by His Grace, and the powerful hold of Maya's corruption has been broken. ||1||

Gurbani: ਆਇਓ ਸਰਣਿ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਓਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: aaeo saran deen dukh bhanjan chitvau tumaree or |
English: I have come to Your Sanctuary, O Destroyer of the suffering of the innocent; I keep my consciousness focused on You.

Gurbani: ਅਭੈ ਪਦੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਬੰਧਨ ਛੋਰਿ ॥੨॥੫॥੯॥
Transliteration: abhai pad daan simaran suaamee ko prabh naanak bandhan chhor |2|5|9|
English: Bless me with the gifts of the state of fearlessness, and meditative remembrance, Lord and Master; O Nanak, God is the Breaker of bonds. ||2||5||9||

[Ang 702 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਬਰਸਤ ਮੇਂਹ ॥
Transliteration: chaatrik chitavat barasat menh |
English: The rainbird longs for the rain to fall.

Gurbani: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਕੋ ਨੇਂਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kripaa sindh karunaa prabh dhaarahu har prem bhagat ko nenh |1| rahaau |
English: O God, ocean of mercy, shower Your mercy on me, that I may yearn for loving devotional worship of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਸੂਖ ਚਕਵੀ ਨਹੀ ਚਾਹਤ ਅਨਦ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੇਖਿ ਦੇਂਹ ॥
Transliteration: anik sookh chakavee nahee chaahat anad pooran pekh denh |
English: The chakvi duck does not desire many comforts, but it is filled with bliss upon seeing the dawn.

Gurbani: ਆਨ ਉਪਾਵ ਨ ਜੀਵਤ ਮੀਨਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਮਰਨਾ ਤੇਂਹ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aan upaav na jeevat meenaa bin jal maranaa tenh |1|
English: The fish cannot survive any other way - without water, it dies. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਅਨਾਥ ਨਾਥ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣੀ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇਂਹ ॥
Transliteration: ham anaath naath har saranee apunee kripaa karenh |
English: I am a helpless orphan - I seek Your Sanctuary, O My Lord and Master; please bless me with Your mercy.

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਰਾਧੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਆਨ ਨ ਕੇਂਹ ॥੨॥੬॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: charan kamal naanak aaraadhai tis bin aan na kenh |2|6|10|
English: Nanak worships and adores the Lord's lotus feet; without Him, there is no other at all. ||2||6||10||

[Ang 702 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਸਿ ਰਹੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: man tan bas rahe mere praan |
English: The Lord, my very breath of life, abides in my mind and body.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਭੇਟੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਸੁਜਾਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa saadhoo sang bhette pooran purakh sujaan |1| rahaau |
English: Bless me with Your mercy, and unite me with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O perfect, all-knowing Lord God. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪਾਈ ਤਿਨ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਅਉ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: prem tthgauree jin kau paaee tin ras peeo bhaaree |
English: Those, unto whom You give the intoxicating herb of Your Love, drink in the supreme sublime essence.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਵਨ ਹਮੑਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: taa kee keemat kehan na jaaee kudarat kavan hamaaree |1|
English: I cannot describe their value; what power do I have? ||1||

Gurbani: ਲਾਇ ਲਏ ਲੜਿ ਦਾਸ ਜਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਉਧਰੇ ਉਧਰਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: laae le larr daas jan apune udhare udharanahaare |
English: The Lord attaches His humble servants to the hem of His robe, and they swim across the world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: prabh simar simar simar sukh paaeo naanak saran duaare |2|7|11|
English: Meditating, meditating, meditating in remembrance on God, peace is obtained; Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of Your Door. ||2||7||11||

[Ang 702 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਏ ਅਨਿਕ ਜਨਮ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਸਰਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: aae anik janam bhram saranee |
English: After wandering through so many incarnations, I have come to Your Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਉਧਰੁ ਦੇਹ ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਚਰਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: audhar deh andh koop te laavahu apunee charanee |1| rahaau |
English: Save me - lift my body up out of the deep, dark pit of the world, and attach me to Your feet. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ਨਾਹਿਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: giaan dhiaan kichh karam na jaanaa naahin niramal karanee |
English: I do not know anything about spiritual wisdom, meditation or karma, and my way of life is not clean and pure.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਅੰਚਲਿ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਬਿਖਮ ਨਦੀ ਜਾਇ ਤਰਣੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saadhasangat kai anchal laavahu bikham nadee jaae taranee |1|
English: Please attach me to the hem of the robe of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; help me to cross over the terrible river. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਰਸ ਮੀਠੇ ਇਹ ਨਹੀ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਧਰਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: sukh sanpat maaeaa ras meetthe ih nahee man meh dharanee |
English: Comforts, riches and the sweet pleasures of Maya - do not implant these within your mind.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਪਾਵਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗ ਆਭਰਣੀ ॥੨॥੮॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: har darasan tripat naanak daas paavat har naam rang aabharanee |2|8|12|
English: Slave Nanak is satisfied and satiated by the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan; his only ornamentation is the love of the Lord's Name. ||2||8||12||

[Ang 702 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 5 |
English: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: har jan simarahu hiradai raam |
English: O humble servants of the Lord, remember the Lord in meditation within your heart.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਅਪਦਾ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਦਾਸ ਕੇ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har jan kau apadaa nikatt na aavai pooran daas ke kaam |1| rahaau |
English: Misfortune does not even approach the Lord's humble servant; the works of His slave are perfectly fulfilled. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਬਿਘਨ ਬਿਨਸਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਗੋਵਿਦ ਧਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: kott bighan binaseh har sevaa nihachal govid dhaam |
English: Millions of obstacles are removed, by serving the Lord, and one enters into the eternal dwelling of the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਭਗਵੰਤ ਭਗਤ ਕਉ ਭਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਆਦਰੁ ਦੇਵਤ ਜਾਮ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bhagavant bhagat kau bhau kichh naahee aadar devat jaam |1|
English: The Lord's devotee is very fortunate; he has absolutely no fear. Even the Messenger of Death pays homage to him. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤਜਿ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਆਨ ਜੋ ਕਰਣੀ ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਬਿਨਸਤ ਖਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: taj gopaal aan jo karanee soee soee binasat khaam |
English: Forsaking the Lord of the world, he does other deeds, but these are temporary and transitory.

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖ ਸਮੂਹ ਬਿਸਰਾਮ ॥੨॥੯॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: charan kamal hiradai gahu naanak sukh samooh bisaraam |2|9|13|
English: Grasp the Lord's lotus feet, and hold them in your heart, O Nanak; you shall obtain absolute peace and bliss. ||2||9||13||

[Ang 702 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji]
Gurbani: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 9 |
English: Jaitsree, Ninth Mehl: One Universal Creator God.

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਭੂਲਿਓ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਉਰਝਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: bhoolio man maaeaa urajhaaeo |
English: My mind is deluded, entangled in Maya.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਰਮ ਕੀਓ ਲਾਲਚ ਲਗਿ ਤਿਹ ਤਿਹ ਆਪੁ ਬੰਧਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo jo karam keeo laalach lag tih tih aap bandhaaeo |1| rahaau |
English: Whatever I do, while engaged in greed, only serves to bind me down. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਮਝ ਨ ਪਰੀ ਬਿਖੈ ਰਸ ਰਚਿਓ ਜਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਬਿਸਰਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: samajh na paree bikhai ras rachio jas har ko bisaraaeo |
English: I have no understanding at all; I am engrossed in the pleasures of corruption, and I have forgotten the Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੋ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਨਾਹਿਨ ਬਨੁ ਖੋਜਨ ਕਉ ਧਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sang suaamee so jaanio naahin ban khojan kau dhaaeo |1|
English: The Lord and Master is with me, but I do not know Him. Instead, I run into the forest, looking for Him. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਤਨੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਘਟ ਹੀ ਕੇ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: ratan raam ghatt hee ke bheetar taa ko giaan na paaeo |
English: The Jewel of the Lord is deep within my heart, but I do not have any knowledge of Him.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਓ ॥੨॥੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak bhagavant bhajan bin birathaa janam gavaaeo |2|1|
English: O servant Nanak, without vibrating, meditating on the Lord God, human life is uselessly wasted and lost. ||2||1||

[Ang 703 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji]
Gurbani: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 9 |
English: Jaitsree, Ninth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੂ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਪਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: har joo raakh lehu pat meree |
English: O Dear Lord, please, save my honor!

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਕੋ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਭਇਓ ਉਰ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਤੇਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jam ko traas bheo ur antar saran gahee kirapaa nidh teree |1| rahaau |
English: The fear of death has entered my heart; I cling to the Protection of Your Sanctuary, O Lord, ocean of mercy. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਪਤਿਤ ਮੁਗਧ ਲੋਭੀ ਫੁਨਿ ਕਰਤ ਪਾਪ ਅਬ ਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: mahaa patit mugadh lobhee fun karat paap ab haaraa |
English: I am a great sinner, foolish and greedy; but now, at last, I have grown weary of committing sins.

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਮਰਬੇ ਕੋ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਨਾਹਿਨ ਤਿਹ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਤਨੁ ਜਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bhai marabe ko bisarat naahin tih chintaa tan jaaraa |1|
English: I cannot forget the fear of dying; this anxiety is consuming my body. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕੀਏ ਉਪਾਵ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕੇ ਕਾਰਨਿ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਕਉ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kee upaav mukat ke kaaran deh dis kau utth dhaaeaa |
English: I have been trying to liberate myself, running around in the ten directions.

Gurbani: ਘਟ ਹੀ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਬਸੈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਮਰਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ghatt hee bheetar basai niranjan taa ko maram na paaeaa |2|
English: The pure, immaculate Lord abides deep within my heart, but I do not understand the secret of His mystery. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਾਹਿਨ ਗੁਨੁ ਨਾਹਿਨ ਕਛੁ ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਅਬ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: naahin gun naahin kachh jap tap kaun karam ab keejai |
English: I have no merit, and I know nothing about meditation or austerities; what should I do now?

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਾਰਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਸਰਨਾਗਤਿ ਅਭੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੩॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak haar pario saranaagat abhai daan prabh deejai |3|2|
English: O Nanak, I am exhausted; I seek the shelter of Your Sanctuary; O God, please bless me with the gift of fearlessness. ||3||2||

[Ang 703 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji]
Gurbani: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 9 |
English: Jaitsree, Ninth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਗਹੋ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: man re saachaa gaho bichaaraa |
English: O mind, embrace true contemplation.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਮਾਨੋ ਸਗਰੋ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam bin mithiaa maano sagaro ihu sansaaraa |1| rahaau |
English: Without the Lord's Name, know that this whole world is false. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਜੋਗੀ ਖੋਜਤ ਹਾਰੇ ਪਾਇਓ ਨਾਹਿ ਤਿਹ ਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kau jogee khojat haare paaeo naeh tih paaraa |
English: The Yogis are tired of searching for Him, but they have not found His limit.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੁਮ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਪਛਾਨੋ ਰੂਪ ਰੇਖ ਤੇ ਨਿਆਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: so suaamee tum nikatt pachhaano roop rekh te niaaraa |1|
English: You must understand that the Lord and Master is near at hand, but He has no form or feature. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪਾਵਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਗਤ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਕਬਹੂ ਨਾਹਿ ਸੰਭਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: paavan naam jagat mai har ko kabahoo naeh sanbhaaraa |
English: The Naam, the Name of the Lord is purifying in the world, and yet you never remember it.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਜਗ ਬੰਦਨ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਤੁਹਾਰਾ ॥੨॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak saran pario jag bandan raakhahu birad tuhaaraa |2|3|
English: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the One, before whom the whole world bows down; please, preserve and protect me, by Your innate nature. ||2||3||

[Ang 703 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 5 chhant ghar 1 |
English: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl, Chhant, First House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਦਰਸਨ ਪਿਆਸੀ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: darasan piaasee dinas raat chitvau anadin neet |
English: I am thirsty for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, day and night; I yearn for Him constantly, night and day.

Gurbani: ਖੋਲਿੑ ਕਪਟ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੀਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: khola kapatt gur meleea naanak har sang meet |1|
English: Opening the door, O Nanak, the Guru has led me to meet with the Lord, my Friend. ||1||

[Ang 703 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਛੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: chhant |
English: Chhant:

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਯਾਰ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਸਜਣ ਇਕ ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨੰਤੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: sun yaar hamaare sajan ik krau benanteea |
English: Listen, O my intimate friend - I have just one prayer to make.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਮੋਹਨ ਲਾਲ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਉ ਫਿਰਉ ਖੋਜੰਤੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: tis mohan laal piaare hau firau khojanteea |
English: I have been wandering around, searching for that enticing, sweet Beloved.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਦਸਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਿਰੁ ਧਰੀ ਉਤਾਰੇ ਇਕ ਭੋਰੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: tis das piaare sir dharee utaare ik bhoree darasan deejai |
English: Whoever leads me to my Beloved - I would cut off my head and offer it to him, even if I were granted the Blessed Vision of His Darshan for just an instant.

Gurbani: ਨੈਨ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਰੰਗ ਰੰਗਾਰੇ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਭੀ ਨਾ ਧੀਰੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: nain hamaare pria rang rangaare ik til bhee naa dheereejai |
English: My eyes are drenched with the Love of my Beloved; without Him, I do not have even a moment's peace.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਮੀਨਾ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਜਿਵੈ ਤਿਸੰਤੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: prabh siau man leenaa jiau jal meenaa chaatrik jivai tisanteea |
English: My mind is attached to the Lord, like the fish to the water, and the rainbird, thirsty for the raindrops.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਗਲੀ ਤਿਖਾ ਬੁਝੰਤੀਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak gur pooraa paaeaa sagalee tikhaa bujhanteea |1|
English: Servant Nanak has found the Perfect Guru; his thirst is totally quenched. ||1||

Gurbani: ਯਾਰ ਵੇ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਹਭੇ ਸਖੀਆ ਮੂ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜੇਹੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: yaar ve pria habhe sakheea moo kahee na jeheea |
English: O intimate friend, my Beloved has all these loving companions; I cannot compare to any of them.

Gurbani: ਯਾਰ ਵੇ ਹਿਕ ਡੂੰ ਹਿਕਿ ਚਾੜੈ ਹਉ ਕਿਸੁ ਚਿਤੇਹੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: yaar ve hik ddoon hik chaarrai hau kis chiteheea |
English: O intimate friend, each of them is more beautiful than the others; who could consider me?

Gurbani: ਹਿਕ ਦੂੰ ਹਿਕਿ ਚਾੜੇ ਅਨਿਕ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਕਰਦੇ ਭੋਗ ਬਿਲਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: hik doon hik chaarre anik piaare nit karade bhog bilaasaa |
English: Each of them is more beautiful than the others; countless are His lovers, constantly enjoying bliss with Him.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਉਠੰਦਾ ਹਉ ਕਦਿ ਪਾਈ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: tinaa dekh man chaau utthandaa hau kad paaee gunataasaa |
English: Beholding them, desire wells up in my mind; when will I obtain the Lord, the treasure of virtue?

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਮੈਡਾ ਲਾਲੁ ਰੀਝਾਇਆ ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਮਨੁ ਡੇਂਹੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: jinee maiddaa laal reejhaaeaa hau tis aagai man ddenheea |
English: I dedicate my mind to those who please and attract my Beloved.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਬਿਨਉ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਮੂ ਦਸਿ ਡਿਖਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਕੇਹੀਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak kahai sun binau suhaagan moo das ddikhaa pir keheea |2|
English: Says Nanak, hear my prayer, O happy soul-brides; tell me, what does my Husband Lord look like? ||2||

Gurbani: ਯਾਰ ਵੇ ਪਿਰੁ ਆਪਣ ਭਾਣਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਨੀਸੀ ਛੰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: yaar ve pir aapan bhaanaa kichh neesee chhandaa |
English: O intimate friend, my Husband Lord does whatever He pleases; He is not dependent on anyone.

Gurbani: ਯਾਰ ਵੇ ਤੈ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਲਾਲਨੁ ਮੂ ਦਸਿ ਦਸੰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: yaar ve tai raaviaa laalan moo das dasandaa |
English: O intimate friend, you have enjoyed your Beloved; please, tell me about Him.

Gurbani: ਲਾਲਨੁ ਤੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਜੈ ਧਨ ਭਾਗ ਮਥਾਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: laalan tai paaeaa aap gavaaeaa jai dhan bhaag mathaane |
English: They alone find their Beloved, who eradicate self-conceit; such is the good destiny written on their foreheads.

Gurbani: ਬਾਂਹ ਪਕੜਿ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਹਉ ਘਿਧੀ ਗੁਣ ਅਵਗਣ ਨ ਪਛਾਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: baanh pakarr tthaakur hau ghidhee gun avagan na pachhaane |
English: Taking me by the arm, the Lord and Master has made me His own; He has not considered my merits or demerits.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਹਾਰੁ ਤੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਹਭੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੁਹੰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: gun haar tai paaeaa rang laal banaaeaa tis habho kichh suhandaa |
English: She, whom You have adorned with the necklace of virtue, and dyed in the deep crimson color of His Love - everything looks beautiful on her.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਧੰਨਿ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਾਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਭਤਾਰੁ ਵਸੰਦਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jan naanak dhan suhaagan saaee jis sang bhataar vasandaa |3|
English: O servant Nanak, blessed is that happy soul-bride, who dwells with her Husband Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਯਾਰ ਵੇ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਖ ਸੁਖੇਦੀ ਸਾ ਮੈ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: yaar ve nit sukh sukhedee saa mai paaee |
English: O intimate friend, I have found that peace which I sought.

Gurbani: ਵਰੁ ਲੋੜੀਦਾ ਆਇਆ ਵਜੀ ਵਾਧਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: var lorreedaa aaeaa vajee vaadhaaee |
English: My sought-after Husband Lord has come home, and now, congratulations are pouring in.

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਰਹਸੁ ਥੀਆ ਪਿਰੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਸਦ ਨਵ ਰੰਗੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: mahaa mangal rehas theea pir deaal sad nav rangeea |
English: Great joy and happiness welled up, when my Husband Lord, of ever-fresh beauty, showed mercy to me.

Gurbani: ਵਡ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸਤਸੰਗੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: vadd bhaag paaeaa gur milaaeaa saadh kai satasangeea |
English: By great good fortune, I have found Him; the Guru has united me with Him, through the Saadh Sangat, the True Congregation of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਸਗਲ ਪੂਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਅੰਕਿ ਅੰਕੁ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa manasaa sagal pooree pria ank ank milaaee |
English: My hopes and desires have all been fulfilled; my Beloved Husband Lord has hugged me close in His embrace.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੁਖ ਸੁਖੇਦੀ ਸਾ ਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak sukh sukhedee saa mai gur mil paaee |4|1|
English: Prays Nanak, I have found that peace which I sought, meeting with the Guru. ||4||1||

[Ang 704 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਛੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 5 ghar 2 chhant |
English: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl, Second House, Chhant:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਊਚਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਅਕਥੁ ॥
Transliteration: aoochaa agam apaar prabh kathan na jaae akath |
English: God is lofty, unapproachable and infinite. He is indescribable - He cannot be described.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਰਾਖਨ ਕਉ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak prabh saranaagatee raakhan kau samarath |1|
English: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God, who is all-powerful to save us. ||1||

[Ang 704 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: chhant |
English: Chhant:

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jiau jaanahu tiau raakh har prabh teriaa |
English: Save me, any way You can; O Lord God, I am Yours.

Gurbani: ਕੇਤੇ ਗਨਉ ਅਸੰਖ ਅਵਗਣ ਮੇਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: kete gnau asankh avagan meriaa |
English: My demerits are uncountable; how many of them should I count?

Gurbani: ਅਸੰਖ ਅਵਗਣ ਖਤੇ ਫੇਰੇ ਨਿਤਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਸਦ ਭੂਲੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: asankh avagan khate fere nitaprat sad bhooleeai |
English: The sins and crimes I committed are countless; day by day, I continually make mistakes.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ਮਾਇਆ ਤਉ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੀ ਘੂਲੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: moh magan bikaraal maaeaa tau prasaadee ghooleeai |
English: I am intoxicated by emotional attachment to Maya, the treacherous one; by Your Grace alone can I be saved.

Gurbani: ਲੂਕ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਬਿਖੜੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨੇਰ ਹੂ ਤੇ ਨੇਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: look karat bikaar bikharre prabh ner hoo te neriaa |
English: Secretly, I commit hideous sins of corruption, even though God is the nearest of the near.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਕਾਢਿ ਭਵਜਲ ਫੇਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak deaa dhaarahu kaadt bhavajal feriaa |1|
English: Prays Nanak, shower me with Your Mercy, Lord, and lift me up, out of the whirlpool of the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||

[Ang 704 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਤਿ ਨ ਪਵੈ ਅਸੰਖ ਗੁਣ ਊਚਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: nirat na pavai asankh gun aoochaa prabh kaa naau |
English: Countless are His virtues; they cannot be enumerated. God's Name is lofty and exalted.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀਆ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਥਾਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak kee benanteea milai nithaave thaau |2|
English: This is Nanak's humble prayer, to bless the homeless with a home. ||2||

[Ang 704 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: chhant |
English: Chhant:

Gurbani: ਦੂਸਰ ਨਾਹੀ ਠਾਉ ਕਾ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: doosar naahee tthaau kaa peh jaaeeai |
English: There is no other place at all - where else should I go?

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar kar jorr so prabh dhiaaeeai |
English: Twenty-four hours a day, with my palms pressed together, I meditate on God.

Gurbani: ਧਿਆਇ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: dhiaae so prabh sadaa apunaa maneh chindiaa paaeeai |
English: Meditating forever on my God, I receive the fruits of my mind's desires.

Gurbani: ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਏਕ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: taj maan mohu vikaar doojaa ek siau liv laaeeai |
English: Renouncing pride, attachment, corruption and duality, I lovingly center my attention on the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਰਪਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਆਗੈ ਆਪੁ ਸਗਲ ਮਿਟਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: arap man tan prabhoo aagai aap sagal mittaaeeai |
English: Dedicate your mind and body to God; eradicate all your self-conceit.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਧਾਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਾਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak dhaar kirapaa saach naam samaaeeai |2|
English: Prays Nanak, shower me with Your mercy, Lord, that I may be absorbed in Your True Name. ||2||

[Ang 704 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
Transliteration: re man taa kau dhiaaeeai sabh bidh jaa kai haath |
English: O mind, meditate on the One, who holds everything in His hands.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਸਾਥਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: raam naam dhan sancheeai naanak nibahai saath |3|
English: Gather the wealth of the Lord's Name; O Nanak, it shall always be with You. ||3||

[Ang 704 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: chhant |
English: Chhant:

Gurbani: ਸਾਥੀਅੜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਦੂਸਰ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: saatheearraa prabh ek doosar naeh koe |
English: God is our only True Friend; there is not any other.

Gurbani: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਪੂਰ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: thaan thanantar aap jal thal poor soe |
English: In the places and interspaces, in the water and on the land, He Himself is pervading everywhere.

Gurbani: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬ ਦਾਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: jal thal maheeal poor rahiaa sarab daataa prabh dhanee |
English: He is totally permeating the water, the land and the sky; God is the Great Giver, the Lord and Master of all.

Gurbani: ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਗੁਣ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਕਿਆ ਗਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: gopaal gobind ant naahee beant gun taa ke kiaa ganee |
English: The Lord of the world, the Lord of the universe has no limit; His Glorious Virtues are unlimited - how can I count them?

Gurbani: ਭਜੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਖਹ ਗਾਮੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨਾ ਅਨ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhaj saran suaamee sukhah gaamee tis binaa an naeh koe |
English: I have hurried to the Sanctuary of the Lord Master, the Bringer of peace; without Him, there is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak deaa dhaarahu tis paraapat naam hoe |3|
English: Prays Nanak, that being, unto whom the Lord shows mercy - he alone obtains the Naam. ||3||

[Ang 705 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਚਿਤਿ ਜਿ ਚਿਤਵਿਆ ਸੋ ਮੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: chit ji chitaviaa so mai paaeaa |
English: Whatever I wish for, that I receive.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਸੁਖ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak naam dhiaae sukh sabaaeaa |4|
English: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Nanak has found total peace. ||4||

[Ang 705 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: chhant |
English: Chhant:

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਮਨੁ ਛੂਟਿ ਗਇਆ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: ab man chhoott geaa saadhoo sang mile |
English: My mind is now emancipated; I have joined the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਇਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh naam leaa jotee jot rale |
English: As Gurmukh, I chant the Naam, and my light has merged into the Light.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮਿਟੇ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਬੁਝੀ ਤਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: har naam simarat mitte kilabikh bujhee tapat aghaaniaa |
English: Remembering the Lord's Name in meditation, my sins have been erased; the fire has been extinguished, and I am satisfied.

Gurbani: ਗਹਿ ਭੁਜਾ ਲੀਨੇ ਦਇਆ ਕੀਨੇ ਆਪਨੇ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: geh bhujaa leene deaa keene aapane kar maaniaa |
English: He has taken me by the arm, and blessed me with His kind mercy; He has accepted me His own.

Gurbani: ਲੈ ਅੰਕਿ ਲਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣਾ ਦੁਖ ਜਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: lai ank laae har milaae janam maranaa dukh jale |
English: The Lord has hugged me in His embrace, and merged me with Himself; the pains of birth and death have been burnt away.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰੀ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਇਕ ਪਲੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak deaa dhaaree mel leene ik pale |4|2|
English: Prays Nanak, He has blessed me with His kind mercy; in an instant, He unites me with Himself. ||4||2||

[Ang 705 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: jaitasaree chhant mahalaa 5 |
English: Jaitsree, Chhant, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪਾਧਾਣੂ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਗਾਰਬਿ ਅਟਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: paadhaanoo sansaar gaarab attiaa |
English: The world is like a temporary way-station, but it is filled with pride.

Gurbani: ਕਰਤੇ ਪਾਪ ਅਨੇਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ਰਟਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: karate paap anek maaeaa rang rattiaa |
English: People commit countless sins; they are dyed in the color of the love of Maya.

Gurbani: ਲੋਭਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਿ ਬੂਡੇ ਮਰਣੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਏ ॥
Transliteration: lobh mohi abhimaan boodde maran cheet na aave |
English: In greed, emotional attachment and egotism, they are drowning; they do not even think of dying.

Gurbani: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਏਹ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਹਾਵਏ ॥
Transliteration: putr mitr biauhaar banitaa eeh karat bihaave |
English: Children, friends, worldly occupations and spouses - they talk of these things, while their lives are passing away.

Gurbani: ਪੁਜਿ ਦਿਵਸ ਆਏ ਲਿਖੇ ਮਾਏ ਦੁਖੁ ਧਰਮ ਦੂਤਹ ਡਿਠਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: puj divas aae likhe maae dukh dharam dootah dditthiaa |
English: When their pre-ordained days have run their course, O mother, they behold the Messengers of the Righteous Judge of Dharma, and they suffer.

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਤ ਕਰਮ ਨ ਮਿਟੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਖਟਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kirat karam na mittai naanak har naam dhan nahee khattiaa |1|
English: The karma of their past deeds cannot be erased, O Nanak, if they have not earned the wealth of the Lord's Name. ||1||

Gurbani: ਉਦਮ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਨੇਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਗਾਵਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: audam kareh anek har naam na gaavahee |
English: He makes all sorts of efforts, but he does not sing the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਭਰਮਹਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਅਸੰਖ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਆਵਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: bharameh jon asankh mar janameh aavahee |
English: He wanders around in countless incarnations; he dies, only to be born again.

Gurbani: ਪਸੂ ਪੰਖੀ ਸੈਲ ਤਰਵਰ ਗਣਤ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਆਵਏ ॥
Transliteration: pasoo pankhee sail taravar ganat kachhoo na aave |
English: As beasts, birds, stones and trees - their number cannot be known.

Gurbani: ਬੀਜੁ ਬੋਵਸਿ ਭੋਗ ਭੋਗਹਿ ਕੀਆ ਅਪਣਾ ਪਾਵਏ ॥
Transliteration: beej bovas bhog bhogeh keea apanaa paave |
English: As are the seeds he plants, so are the pleasures he enjoys; he receives the consequences of his own actions.

Gurbani: ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਹਾਰੰਤ ਜੂਐ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਆਪਿ ਨ ਭਾਵਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: ratan janam haarant jooai prabhoo aap na bhaavahee |
English: He loses the jewel of this human life in the gamble, and God is not pleased with him at all.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਰਮਹਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਏ ਖਿਨੁ ਏਕੁ ਟਿਕਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak bharameh bhramaae khin ek ttikan na paavahee |2|
English: Prays Nanak, wandering in doubt, he does not find any rest, even for an instant. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੋਬਨੁ ਗਇਆ ਬਿਤੀਤਿ ਜਰੁ ਮਲਿ ਬੈਠੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: joban geaa biteet jar mal baittheea |
English: Youth has passed, and old age has taken its place.

Gurbani: ਕਰ ਕੰਪਹਿ ਸਿਰੁ ਡੋਲ ਨੈਣ ਨ ਡੀਠਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: kar kanpeh sir ddol nain na ddeetthiaa |
English: The hands tremble, the head shakes, and the eyes do not see.

Gurbani: ਨਹ ਨੈਣ ਦੀਸੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਜਨ ਈਸੈ ਛੋਡਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਚਾਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: neh nain deesai bin bhajan eesai chhodd maaeaa chaaliaa |
English: The eyes do not see, without vibrating and meditating on the Lord; he must leave behind the attractions of Maya, and depart.

Gurbani: ਕਹਿਆ ਨ ਮਾਨਹਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਖਾਕੁ ਛਾਨਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਜਾਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: kahiaa na maaneh sir khaak chhaaneh jin sang man tan jaaliaa |
English: He burnt his mind and body for his relatives, but now, they do not listen to him, and they throw dust on his head.

Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰੀਰਾਮ ਰੰਗ ਅਪਾਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਨਹ ਨਿਮਖ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਵੂਠਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sreeraam rang apaar pooran neh nimakh man meh vootthiaa |
English: Love for the infinite, Perfect Lord does not abide in his mind, even for an instant.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੋਟਿ ਕਾਗਰ ਬਿਨਸ ਬਾਰ ਨ ਝੂਠਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak kott kaagar binas baar na jhootthiaa |3|
English: Prays Nanak, the fort of paper is false - it is destroyed in an instant. ||3||

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਰਣਾਇ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal saranaae naanak aaeaa |
English: Nanak has come to the Sanctuary of the Lord's lotus feet.

Gurbani: ਦੁਤਰੁ ਭੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: dutar bhai sansaar prabh aap taraaeaa |
English: God Himself has carried Him across the impassable, terrifying world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇ ਭਜੇ ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਕਰਿ ਅੰਗੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਤਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: mil saadhasange bhaje sreedhar kar ang prabh jee taariaa |
English: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I vibrate and meditate on the Lord; God has made me His own, and saved me.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਮਾਨਿ ਲੀਏ ਨਾਮ ਦੀਏ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: har maan lee naam dee avar kachh na beechaariaa |
English: The Lord has approved of me, and blessed me with His Name; He did not take anything else into consideration.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਅਪਾਰ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮਨਿ ਲੋੜੀਦਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gun nidhaan apaar tthaakur man lorreedaa paaeaa |
English: I have found the infinite Lord and Master, the treasure of virtue, which my mind had yearned for.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਦਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਖਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੨॥੩॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak sadaa tripate har naam bhojan khaaeaa |4|2|3|
English: Prays Nanak, I am satisfied forever; I have eaten the food of the Lord's Name. ||4||2||3||

[Ang 705 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਵਾਰ ਸਲੋਕਾ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: jaitasaree mahalaa 5 vaar salokaa naal |
English: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehl, Vaar With Saloks:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਮਧਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਅੰਤਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰਹ ॥
Transliteration: aad pooran madh pooran ant pooran paramesurah |
English: In the beginning, He was pervading; in the middle, He is pervading; in the end, He will be pervading. He is the Transcendent Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰੰਤਿ ਸੰਤ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਰਮਣੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਘਨਾਸਨ ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰਹ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: simarant sant sarabatr ramanan naanak aghanaasan jagadeesurah |1|
English: The Saints remember in meditation the all-pervading Lord God. O Nanak, He is the Destroyer of sins, the Lord of the universe. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪੇਖਨ ਸੁਨਨ ਸੁਨਾਵਨੋ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੀਐ ਸਾਚੁ ॥
Transliteration: pekhan sunan sunaavano man meh drirreeai saach |
English: See, hear, speak and implant the True Lord within your mind.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਮੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਚੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: poor rahio sarabatr mai naanak har rang raach |2|
English: He is all-pervading, permeating everywhere; O Nanak, be absorbed in the Lord's Love. ||2||

[Ang 706 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਗਾਈਐ ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: har ek niranjan gaaeeai sabh antar soee |
English: Sing the Praise of the One, the Immaculate Lord; He is contained within all.

Gurbani: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: karan kaaran samarath prabh jo kare su hoee |
English: The Cause of causes, the Almighty Lord God; whatever He wills, comes to pass.

Gurbani: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਦਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: khin meh thaap uthaapadaa tis bin nahee koee |
English: In an instant, He establishes and disestablishes; without Him, there is no other.

Gurbani: ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਪਾਤਾਲ ਦੀਪ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਭ ਲੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: khandd brahamandd paataal deep raviaa sabh loee |
English: He pervades the continents, solar systems, nether worlds, islands and all worlds.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋ ਬੁਝਸੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jis aap bujhaae so bujhasee niramal jan soee |1|
English: He alone understands, whom the Lord Himself instructs; he alone is a pure and unstained being. ||1||

[Ang 706 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਰਚੰਤਿ ਜੀਅ ਰਚਨਾ ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਅਸਥਾਪਨੰ ॥
Transliteration: rachant jeea rachanaa maat garabh asathaapanan |
English: Creating the soul, the Lord places this creation in the womb of the mother.

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਿਮਰੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਹਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਬਿਨਾਸਨੰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saas saas simarant naanak mahaa agan na binaasanan |1|
English: With each and every breath, it meditates in remembrance on the Lord, O Nanak; it is not consumed by the great fire. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੁਖੁ ਤਲੈ ਪੈਰ ਉਪਰੇ ਵਸੰਦੋ ਕੁਹਥੜੈ ਥਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: mukh talai pair upare vasando kuhatharrai thaae |
English: With its head down, and feet up, it dwells in that slimy place.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਧਣੀ ਕਿਉ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਓ ਉਧਰਹਿ ਜਿਸ ਦੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak so dhanee kiau visaario udhareh jis dai naae |2|
English: O Nanak, how could we forget the Master? Through His Name, we are saved. ||2||

[Ang 706 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਰਕਤੁ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਕਰਿ ਨਿੰਮਿਆ ਅਗਨਿ ਉਦਰ ਮਝਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: rakat bind kar ninmiaa agan udar majhaar |
English: From egg and sperm, you were conceived, and placed in the fire of the womb.

Gurbani: ਉਰਧ ਮੁਖੁ ਕੁਚੀਲ ਬਿਕਲੁ ਨਰਕਿ ਘੋਰਿ ਗੁਬਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: auradh mukh kucheel bikal narak ghor gubaar |
English: Head downwards, you abided restlessly in that dark, dismal, terrible hell.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਤੂ ਨਾ ਜਲਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: har simarat too naa jaleh man tan ur dhaar |
English: Remembering the Lord in meditation, you were not burnt; enshrine Him in your heart, mind and body.

Gurbani: ਬਿਖਮ ਥਾਨਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਖਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: bikham thaanahu jin rakhiaa tis til na visaar |
English: In that treacherous place, He protected and preserved you; do not forget Him, even for an instant.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਕਦੇ ਨਾਹਿ ਜਾਸਹਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਹਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: prabh bisarat sukh kade naeh jaaseh janam haar |2|
English: Forgetting God, you shall never find peace; you shall forfeit your life, and depart. ||2||

[Ang 706 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਇਛਾ ਦਾਨ ਕਰਣੰ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਆਸਾ ਪੂਰਨਹ ॥
Transliteration: man ichhaa daan karanan sarabatr aasaa pooranah |
English: He grants our hearts' desires, and fulfills all our hopes.

Gurbani: ਖੰਡਣੰ ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਹ ਦੂਰਣਹ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: khanddanan kal kalesah prabh simar naanak neh dooranah |1|
English: He destroys pain and suffering; remember God in meditation, O Nanak - He is not far away. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਭਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣਹਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੈ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਈਐ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: habh rang maaneh jis sang tai siau laaeeai nehu |
English: Love Him, with whom you enjoy all pleasures.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਬਿੰਦ ਨ ਵਿਸਰਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਰਚਿਆ ਦੇਹੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: so sahu bind na visrau naanak jin sundar rachiaa dehu |2|
English: Do not forget that Lord, even for an instant; O Nanak, He fashioned this beautiful body. ||2||

[Ang 706 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਦੀਨੇ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: jeeo praan tan dhan deea deene ras bhog |
English: He gave you your soul, breath of life, body and wealth; He gave you pleasures to enjoy.

Gurbani: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮੰਦਰ ਰਥ ਅਸੁ ਦੀਏ ਰਚਿ ਭਲੇ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: grih mandar rath as dee rach bhale sanjog |
English: He gave you households, mansions, chariots and horses; He ordained your good destiny.

Gurbani: ਸੁਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਸਾਜਨ ਸੇਵਕ ਦੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਵਨ ਜੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: sut banitaa saajan sevak dee prabh devan jog |
English: He gave you your children, spouse, friends and servants; God is the all-powerful Great Giver.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਵਿਜੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: har simarat tan man hariaa leh jaeh vijog |
English: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, the body and mind are rejuvenated, and sorrow departs.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਮਹੁ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਭਿ ਰੋਗ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: saadhasang har gun ramahu binase sabh rog |3|
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, chant the Praises of the Lord, and all your sickness shall vanish. ||3||

[Ang 706 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਕੁਟੰਬ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਣੰ ਮਾਇਆ ਅਨੇਕ ਉਦਮਹ ॥
Transliteration: kuttanb jatan karanan maaeaa anek udamah |
English: For his family, he works very hard; for the sake of Maya, he makes countless efforts.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਵ ਹੀਣੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰੇਤਤਹ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har bhagat bhaav heenan naanak prabh bisarat te pretatah |1|
English: But without loving devotional worship of the Lord, O Nanak, he forgets God, and then, he is a mere ghost. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੁਟੜੀਆ ਸਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਜੋ ਲਾਈ ਬਿਅੰਨ ਸਿਉ ॥
Transliteration: tuttarreea saa preet jo laaee bian siau |
English: That love shall break, which is established with any other than the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੀ ਰੀਤਿ ਸਾਂਈ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak sachee reet saanee setee ratiaa |2|
English: O Nanak, that way of life is true, which inspires love of the Lord. ||2||

[Ang 706 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਤਨੁ ਭਸਮ ਹੋਇ ਕਹਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: jis bisarat tan bhasam hoe kahate sabh pret |
English: Forgetting Him, one's body turns to dust, and everyone calls him a ghost.

Gurbani: ਖਿਨੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ ਬਸਨ ਨ ਦੇਵਹੀ ਜਿਨ ਸਿਉ ਸੋਈ ਹੇਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: khin grih meh basan na devahee jin siau soee het |
English: And those, with whom he was so much in love - they do not let him stay in their home, even for an instant.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਅਨਰਥ ਦਰਬੁ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਸੋ ਕਾਰਜਿ ਕੇਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: kar anarath darab sanchiaa so kaaraj ket |
English: Practicing exploitation, he gathers wealth, but what use will it be in the end?

Gurbani: ਜੈਸਾ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋ ਲੁਣੈ ਕਰਮ ਇਹੁ ਖੇਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: jaisaa beejai so lunai karam ihu khet |
English: As one plants, so does he harvest; the body is the field of actions.

Gurbani: ਅਕਿਰਤਘਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਜੋਨੀ ਭਰਮੇਤੁ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: akirataghanaa har visariaa jonee bharamet |4|
English: The ungrateful wretches forget the Lord, and wander in reincarnation. ||4||

[Ang 706 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਦਾਨ ਇਸਨਾਨੰ ਅਨਿਕ ਸੋਧਨ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਤਹ ॥
Transliteration: kott daan isanaanan anik sodhan pavitratah |
English: The benefits of millions of charitable donations and cleansing baths, and countless ceremonies of purification and piety,

Gurbani: ਉਚਰੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਸਰਬ ਪਾਪ ਬਿਮੁਚਤੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aucharant naanak har har rasanaa sarab paap bimuchate |1|
English: O Nanak, are obtained by chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har with one's tongue; all sins are washed away. ||1||

Gurbani: ਈਧਣੁ ਕੀਤੋਮੂ ਘਣਾ ਭੋਰੀ ਦਿਤੀਮੁ ਭਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: eedhan keetomoo ghanaa bhoree diteem bhaeh |
English: I gathered together a great stack of firewood, and applied a tiny flame to light it.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਵਸੰਦੜੋ ਸਚੁ ਸਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਭੇ ਡੁਖੜੇ ਉਲਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: man vasandarro sach sahu naanak habhe ddukharre ulaeh |2|
English: When the True Lord and Master abides in one's mind, O Nanak, all sins are dispelled. ||2||

[Ang 707 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਅਘਾ ਸਭਿ ਨਾਸ ਹੋਹਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kott aghaa sabh naas hohi simarat har naau |
English: Millions of sins are totally erased, by meditating on the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: man chinde fal paaeeeh har ke gun gaau |
English: The fruits of one's heart's desires are obtained, by singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭੈ ਕਟੀਅਹਿ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਸਚੁ ਥਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: janam maran bhai katteeeh nihachal sach thaau |
English: The fear of birth and death is eradicated, and one's eternal, unchanging true home is obtained.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਸਮਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: poorab hovai likhiaa har charan samaau |
English: If it is so pre-ordained, one is absorbed in the Lord's lotus feet.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh raakh lehu naanak bal jaau |5|
English: Bless me with Your mercy, God - please preserve and save me! Nanak is a sacrifice to You. ||5||

[Ang 707 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਰਚਨਾ ਅਪਾਰੰ ਮਨਿ ਬਿਲਾਸ ਸੁਆਦੰ ਰਸਹ ॥
Transliteration: grih rachanaa apaaran man bilaas suaadan rasah |
English: They are involved in their beautiful houses, and the pleasures of the mind's desires.

Gurbani: ਕਦਾਂਚ ਨਹ ਸਿਮਰੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਜੰਤ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਮਹ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kadaanch neh simarant naanak te jant bisattaa krimah |1|
English: They never remember the Lord in meditation; O Nanak, they are like maggots in manure. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੁਚੁ ਅਡੰਬਰੁ ਹਭੁ ਕਿਹੁ ਮੰਝਿ ਮੁਹਬਤਿ ਨੇਹ ॥
Transliteration: much addanbar habh kihu manjh muhabat neh |
English: They are engrossed in ostentatious displays, lovingly attached to all their possessions.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਾਂਈ ਜੈਂ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਤਨੁ ਖੇਹ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: so saanee jain visarai naanak so tan kheh |2|
English: That body which forgets the Lord, O Nanak, shall be reduced to ashes. ||2||

[Ang 707 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸੇਜ ਅਨੇਕ ਸੁਖ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sundar sej anek sukh ras bhogan poore |
English: He may enjoy a beautiful bed, countless pleasures and all sorts of enjoyments.

Gurbani: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਸੋਇਨ ਚੰਦਨ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਲਾਇ ਮੋਤੀ ਹੀਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: grih soein chandan sugandh laae motee heere |
English: He may possess mansions of gold, studded with pearls and rubies, plastered with fragrant sandalwood oil.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਣਦਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਵਿਸੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: man ichhe sukh maanadaa kichh naeh visoore |
English: He may relish in the pleasures of his mind's desires, and have no anxiety at all.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਕੇ ਕੀਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: so prabh chit na aavee visattaa ke keere |
English: But if he does not remember God, he is like a maggot in manure.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰੇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: bin har naam na saant hoe kit bidh man dheere |6|
English: Without the Lord's Name, there is no peace at all. How can the mind be comforted? ||6||

[Ang 707 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਬਿਰਹੰ ਖੋਜੰਤ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਹ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal birahan khojant bairaagee deh disah |
English: One who loves the Lord's lotus feet searches for Him in the ten directions.

Gurbani: ਤਿਆਗੰਤ ਕਪਟ ਰੂਪ ਮਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਨੰਦ ਰੂਪ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਮਹ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tiaagant kapatt roop maaeaa naanak aanand roop saadh sangamah |1|
English: He renounces the deceptive illusion of Maya, and joins the blissful form of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਸਾਂਈ ਮੁਖਿ ਉਚਰਾ ਵਤਾ ਹਭੇ ਲੋਅ ॥
Transliteration: man saanee mukh ucharaa vataa habhe loa |
English: The Lord is in my mind, and with my mouth I chant His Name; I seek Him in all the lands of the world.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਭਿ ਅਡੰਬਰ ਕੂੜਿਆ ਸੁਣਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak habh addanbar koorriaa sun jeevaa sachee soe |2|
English: O Nanak, all ostentatious displays are false; hearing the Praises of the True Lord, I live. ||2||

[Ang 707 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਬਸਤਾ ਤੂਟੀ ਝੁੰਪੜੀ ਚੀਰ ਸਭਿ ਛਿੰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: basataa toottee jhunparree cheer sabh chhinaa |
English: He dwells in a broken-down shack, in tattered clothes,

Gurbani: ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਪਤਿ ਨ ਆਦਰੋ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਭ੍ਰਮਿੰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaat na pat na aadaro udiaan bhraminaa |
English: with no social status, no honor and no respect; he wanders in the wilderness,

Gurbani: ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਨ ਇਠ ਧਨ ਰੂਪਹੀਣ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਕੁ ਨ ਸਿੰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: mitr na itth dhan roopaheen kichh saak na sinaa |
English: with no friend or lover, without wealth, beauty, relatives or relations.

Gurbani: ਰਾਜਾ ਸਗਲੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਭਿੰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: raajaa sagalee srisatt kaa har naam man bhinaa |
English: Even so, he is the king of the whole world, if his mind is imbued with the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਧੂੜਿ ਮਨੁ ਉਧਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨਾ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: tis kee dhoorr man udharai prabh hoe suprasanaa |7|
English: With the dust of his feet, men are redeemed, because God is very pleased with him. ||7||

[Ang 707 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਲੀਲਾ ਰਾਜ ਰਸ ਰੂਪੰ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਚਮਰ ਤਖਤ ਆਸਨੰ ॥
Transliteration: anik leelaa raaj ras roopan chhatr chamar takhat aasanan |
English: The various sorts of pleasures, powers, joys, beauty, canopies, cooling fans and thrones to sit on

Gurbani: ਰਚੰਤਿ ਮੂੜ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਪਨ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: rachant moorr agiaan andhah naanak supan manorath maaeaa |1|
English: - the foolish, ignorant and blind are engrossed in these things. O Nanak, desire for Maya is just a dream. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁਪਨੈ ਹਭਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣਿਆ ਮਿਠਾ ਲਗੜਾ ਮੋਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: supanai habh rang maaniaa mitthaa lagarraa mohu |
English: In a dream, he enjoys all sorts of pleasures, and emotional attachment seems so sweet.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੀਆ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਧ੍ਰੋਹੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naam vihooneea sundar maaeaa dhrohu |2|
English: O Nanak, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the beauty of Maya's illusion is fake. ||2||

[Ang 707 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸੁਪਨੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਮੂਰਖਿ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: supane setee chit moorakh laaeaa |
English: The fool attaches his consciousness to the dream.

Gurbani: ਬਿਸਰੇ ਰਾਜ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਜਾਗਤ ਭਖਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bisare raaj ras bhog jaagat bhakhalaaeaa |
English: When he awakes, he forgets the power, pleasures and enjoyments, and he is sad.

Gurbani: ਆਰਜਾ ਗਈ ਵਿਹਾਇ ਧੰਧੈ ਧਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aarajaa gee vihaae dhandhai dhaaeaa |
English: He passes his life chasing after worldly affairs.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਭਏ ਨ ਕਾਮ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: pooran bhe na kaam mohiaa maaeaa |
English: His works are not completed, because he is enticed by Maya.

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ਜੰਤੁ ਜਾ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: kiaa vechaaraa jant jaa aap bhulaaeaa |8|
English: What can the poor helpless creature do? The Lord Himself has deluded him. ||8||

[Ang 707 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਬਸੰਤਿ ਸ੍ਵਰਗ ਲੋਕਹ ਜਿਤਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਵੀ ਨਵ ਖੰਡਣਹ ॥
Transliteration: basant svarag lokah jitate prithavee nav khanddanah |
English: They may live in heavenly realms, and conquer the nine regions of the world,

Gurbani: ਬਿਸਰੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਪਾਲਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਭਰਮਣਹ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bisarant har gopaalah naanak te praanee udiaan bharamanah |1|
English: but if they forget the Lord of the world, O Nanak, they are just wanderers in the wilderness. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਉਤਕ ਕੋਡ ਤਮਾਸਿਆ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਸੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kautak kodd tamaasiaa chit na aavas naau |
English: In the midst of millions of games and entertainments, the Lord's Name does not come to their minds.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੋੜੀ ਨਰਕ ਬਰਾਬਰੇ ਉਜੜੁ ਸੋਈ ਥਾਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak korree narak baraabare ujarr soee thaau |2|
English: O Nanak, their home is like a wilderness, in the depths of hell. ||2||

[Ang 707 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਭਇਆਨ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਨਗਰ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: mahaa bheaan udiaan nagar kar maaniaa |
English: He sees the terrible, awful wilderness as a city.

Gurbani: ਝੂਠ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਪੇਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jhootth samagree pekh sach kar jaaniaa |
English: Gazing upon the false objects, he believes them to be real.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਦੇਵਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh ahankaar fireh devaaniaa |
English: Engrossed in sexual desire, anger and egotism, he wanders around insane.

Gurbani: ਸਿਰਿ ਲਗਾ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਤਾ ਪਛੁਤਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sir lagaa jam ddandd taa pachhutaaniaa |
English: When the Messenger of Death hits him on the head with his club, then he regrets and repents.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਫਿਰੈ ਸੈਤਾਨਿਆ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: bin poore guradev firai saitaaniaa |9|
English: Without the Perfect, Divine Guru, he roams around like Satan. ||9||

[Ang 708 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਰਾਜ ਕਪਟੰ ਰੂਪ ਕਪਟੰ ਧਨ ਕਪਟੰ ਕੁਲ ਗਰਬਤਹ ॥
