Transliteration: raaj kapattan roop kapattan dhan kapattan kul garabatah |
English: Power is fraudulent, beauty is fraudulent, and wealth is fraudulent, as is pride of ancestry.

Gurbani: ਸੰਚੰਤਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਛਲੰ ਛਿਦ੍ਰੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲਤੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sanchant bikhiaa chhalan chhidran naanak bin har sang na chaalate |1|
English: One may gather poison through deception and fraud, O Nanak, but without the Lord, nothing shall go along with him in the end. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪੇਖੰਦੜੋ ਕੀ ਭੁਲੁ ਤੁੰਮਾ ਦਿਸਮੁ ਸੋਹਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: pekhandarro kee bhul tunmaa disam sohanaa |
English: Beholding the bitter melon, he is deceived, since it appears so pretty

Gurbani: ਅਢੁ ਨ ਲਹੰਦੜੋ ਮੁਲੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਜੁਲਈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: adt na lahandarro mul naanak saath na julee maaeaa |2|
English: But it is not worth even a shell, O Nanak; the riches of Maya will not go along with anyone. ||2||

[Ang 708 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਸੰਜੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: chaladiaa naal na chalai so kiau sanjeeai |
English: It shall not go along with you when you depart - why do you bother to collect it?

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਜਤਨੁ ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਵੰਜੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: tis kaa kahu kiaa jatan jis te vanjeeai |
English: Tell me, why do you try so hard to acquire that which you must leave behind in the end?

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਿਐ ਕਿਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵੈ ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਜੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: har bisariai kiau tripataavai naa man ranjeeai |
English: Forgetting the Lord, how can you be satisfied? Your mind cannot be pleased.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਛੋਡਿ ਅਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਨਰਕਿ ਸਮੰਜੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: prabhoo chhodd an laagai narak samanjeeai |
English: One who forsakes God, and attaches himself to another, shall be immersed in hell.

Gurbani: ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਉ ਭੰਜੀਐ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: hohu kripaal deaal naanak bhau bhanjeeai |10|
English: Be kind and compassionate to Nanak, O Lord, and dispel his fear. ||10||

[Ang 708 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਨਚ ਰਾਜ ਸੁਖ ਮਿਸਟੰ ਨਚ ਭੋਗ ਰਸ ਮਿਸਟੰ ਨਚ ਮਿਸਟੰ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: nach raaj sukh misattan nach bhog ras misattan nach misattan sukh maaeaa |
English: Princely pleasures are not sweet; sensual enjoyments are not sweet; the pleasures of Maya are not sweet.

Gurbani: ਮਿਸਟੰ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਮਿਸਟੰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸਨੰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: misattan saadhasang har naanak daas misattan prabh darasanan |1|
English: The Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is sweet, O slave Nanak; the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan is sweet. ||1||

Gurbani: ਲਗੜਾ ਸੋ ਨੇਹੁ ਮੰਨ ਮਝਾਹੂ ਰਤਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: lagarraa so nehu man majhaahoo ratiaa |
English: I have enshrined that love which drenches my soul.

Gurbani: ਵਿਧੜੋ ਸਚ ਥੋਕਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਠੜਾ ਸੋ ਧਣੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: vidharro sach thok naanak mittharraa so dhanee |2|
English: I have been pierced by the Truth, O Nanak; the Master seems so sweet to me. ||2||

[Ang 708 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਲਾਗਈ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਉ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: har bin kachhoo na laagee bhagatan kau meetthaa |
English: Nothing seems sweet to His devotees, except the Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਨ ਸੁਆਦ ਸਭਿ ਫੀਕਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਰਨਉ ਡੀਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: aan suaad sabh feekiaa kar nirnau ddeetthaa |
English: All other tastes are bland and insipid; I have tested them and seen them.

Gurbani: ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਟਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਬਸੀਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: agiaan bharam dukh kattiaa gur bhe baseetthaa |
English: Ignorance, doubt and suffering are dispelled, when the Guru becomes one's advocate.

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਜਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਜੀਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal man bedhiaa jiau rang majeetthaa |
English: The Lord's lotus feet have pierced my mind, and I am dyed in the deep crimson color of His Love.

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਭਿ ਝੂਠਾ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: jeeo praan tan man prabhoo binase sabh jhootthaa |11|
English: My soul, breath of life, body and mind belong to God; all falsehood has left me. ||11||

[Ang 708 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਤਿਅਕਤ ਜਲੰ ਨਹ ਜੀਵ ਮੀਨੰ ਨਹ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਮੇਘ ਮੰਡਲਹ ॥
Transliteration: tiakat jalan neh jeev meenan neh tiaag chaatrik megh manddalah |
English: Leaving the water, the fish cannot live; the rainbird cannot live without the raindrops from the clouds.

Gurbani: ਬਾਣ ਬੇਧੰਚ ਕੁਰੰਕ ਨਾਦੰ ਅਲਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਕੁਸਮ ਬਾਸਨਹ ॥
Transliteration: baan bedhanch kurank naadan al bandhan kusam baasanah |
English: The deer is enticed by the sound of the hunter's bell, and shot through with the arrow; the bumble bee is entangled in the fragrance of the flowers.

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਚੰਤਿ ਸੰਤਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਨ ਨ ਰੁਚਤੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: charan kamal rachant santah naanak aan na ruchate |1|
English: The Saints are entranced by the Lord's lotus feet; O Nanak, they desire nothing else. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੁਖੁ ਡੇਖਾਊ ਪਲਕ ਛਡਿ ਆਨ ਨ ਡੇਊ ਚਿਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: mukh ddekhaaoo palak chhadd aan na ddeaoo chit |
English: Show me Your face, for even an instant, Lord, and I will not give my consciousness to any other.

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਣ ਸੰਗਮੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਧਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤਾਂ ਮਿਤੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jeevan sangam tis dhanee har naanak santaan mit |2|
English: My life is with the Lord Master, O Nanak, the Friend of the Saints. ||2||

[Ang 708 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਾਣੀਐ ਕਿਉ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jiau machhulee bin paaneeai kiau jeevan paavai |
English: How can the fish live without water?

Gurbani: ਬੂੰਦ ਵਿਹੂਣਾ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕੋ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: boond vihoonaa chaatriko kiau kar tripataavai |
English: Without the raindrops, how can the rainbird be satisfied?

Gurbani: ਨਾਦ ਕੁਰੰਕਹਿ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: naad kurankeh bedhiaa sanamukh utth dhaavai |
English: The deer, entranced by the sound of the hunter's bell, runs straight to him;

Gurbani: ਭਵਰੁ ਲੋਭੀ ਕੁਸਮ ਬਾਸੁ ਕਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਆਪੁ ਬੰਧਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: bhavar lobhee kusam baas kaa mil aap bandhaavai |
English: the bumble bee is greedy for the flower's fragrance; finding it, he traps himself in it.

Gurbani: ਤਿਉ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹੈ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਅਘਾਵੈ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: tiau sant janaa har preet hai dekh daras aghaavai |12|
English: Just so, the humble Saints love the Lord; beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, they are satisfied and satiated. ||12||

[Ang 708 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਚਿਤਵੰਤਿ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲੰ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਅਰਾਧਨਹ ॥
Transliteration: chitavant charan kamalan saas saas araadhanah |
English: They contemplate the Lord's lotus feet; they worship and adore Him with each and every breath.

Gurbani: ਨਹ ਬਿਸਰੰਤਿ ਨਾਮ ਅਚੁਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਸ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰਹ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: neh bisarant naam achut naanak aas pooran paramesurah |1|
English: They do not forget the Name of the imperishable Lord; O Nanak, the Transcendent Lord fulfills their hopes. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੀਤੜਾ ਮੰਨ ਮੰਝਾਹਿ ਪਲਕ ਨ ਥੀਵੈ ਬਾਹਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: seetarraa man manjhaeh palak na theevai baaharaa |
English: He is woven into the fabric of my mind; He is not outside of it, even for an instant.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਸੜੀ ਨਿਬਾਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਪੇਖੰਦੋ ਸਚੁ ਧਣੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak aasarree nibaeh sadaa pekhando sach dhanee |2|
English: O Nanak, the True Lord and Master fulfills my hopes, and always watches over me. ||2||

[Ang 708 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਆਸਾਵੰਤੀ ਆਸ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਪੂਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: aasaavantee aas gusaaee pooreeai |
English: My hopes rest in You, O Lord of the universe; please, fulfill them.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਝੂਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: mil gopaal gobind na kabahoo jhooreeai |
English: Meeting with the Lord of the world, the Lord of the universe, I shall never grieve.

Gurbani: ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਵਿਸੂਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: dehu daras man chaau leh jaeh visooreeai |
English: Grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, the desire of my mind, and my worries shall be over.

Gurbani: ਹੋਇ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਚਰਨਾ ਧੂਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: hoe pavitr sareer charanaa dhooreeai |
English: By body is sanctified, by the dust of Your feet.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰੀਐ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: paarabraham guradev sadaa hajooreeai |13|
English: O Supreme Lord God, Divine Guru, You are always with me, ever-present. ||13||

[Ang 709 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਰਸਨਾ ਉਚਰੰਤਿ ਨਾਮੰ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੰ ਸੁਨੰਤਿ ਸਬਦ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਹ ॥
Transliteration: rasanaa ucharant naaman sravanan sunant sabad amritah |
English: With my tongue, I chant the Lord's Name; with my ears, I listen to the Ambrosial Word of His Shabad.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੰ ਜਿਨਾ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਣਹ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak tin sad balihaaran jinaa dhiaan paarabrahamanah |1|
English: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to those who meditate on the Supreme Lord God. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਭਿ ਕੂੜਾਵੇ ਕੰਮ ਇਕਸੁ ਸਾਈ ਬਾਹਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: habh koorraave kam ikas saaee baahare |
English: All concerns are false, except those of the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਈ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਿਨਾ ਪਿਰਹੜੀ ਸਚ ਸਿਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak seee dhan jinaa piraharree sach siau |2|
English: O Nanak, blessed are those, who are in love with their True Lord. ||2||

[Ang 709 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਨਾ ਜਿ ਸੁਨਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ॥
Transliteration: sad balihaaree tinaa ji sunate har kathaa |
English: I am forever a sacrifice to those who listen to the sermon of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਰਧਾਨ ਨਿਵਾਵਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਥਾ ॥
Transliteration: poore te paradhaan nivaaveh prabh mathaa |
English: Those who bow their heads before God are perfect and distinguished.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਲਿਖਹਿ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਸੇ ਹਥਾ ॥
Transliteration: har jas likheh beant soheh se hathaa |
English: Those hands, which write the Praises of the infinite Lord are beautiful.

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਚਾਲਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਥਾ ॥
Transliteration: charan puneet pavitr chaaleh prabh pathaa |
English: Those feet which walk on God's Path are pure and holy.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਾਂ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਾਰੁ ਸਗਲਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਥਾ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: santaan sang udhaar sagalaa dukh lathaa |14|
English: In the Society of the Saints, they are emancipated; all their sorrows depart. ||14||

[Ang 709 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਭਾਵੀ ਉਦੋਤ ਕਰਣੰ ਹਰਿ ਰਮਣੰ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਪੂਰਨਹ ॥
Transliteration: bhaavee udot karanan har ramanan sanjog pooranah |
English: One's destiny is activated, when one chants the Lord's Name, through perfect good fortune.

Gurbani: ਗੋਪਾਲ ਦਰਸ ਭੇਟੰ ਸਫਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਮਹੂਰਤਹ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gopaal daras bhettan safal naanak so mahooratah |1|
English: Fruitful is that moment, O Nanak, when one obtains the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the Lord of the Universe. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕੀਮ ਨ ਸਕਾ ਪਾਇ ਸੁਖ ਮਿਤੀ ਹੂ ਬਾਹਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: keem na sakaa paae sukh mitee hoo baahare |
English: Its value cannot be estimated; it brings peace beyond measure.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾ ਵੇਲੜੀ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲੰਦੜੋ ਮਾ ਪਿਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak saa velarree paravaan jit milandarro maa piree |2|
English: O Nanak, that time alone is approved, when my Beloved meets with me. ||2||

[Ang 709 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਵੇਲਾ ਕਹੁ ਕਉਣੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: saa velaa kahu kaun hai jit prabh kau paaee |
English: Tell me, what is that time, when I shall find God?

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਮੂਰਤੁ ਭਲਾ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: so moorat bhalaa sanjog hai jit milai gusaaee |
English: Blessed and auspicious is that moment, and that destiny, when I shall find the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਕੈ ਮਨ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar har dhiaae kai man ichh pujaaee |
English: Meditating on the Lord, twenty-four hours a day, my mind's desires are fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਸੰਗੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: vaddai bhaag satasang hoe niv laagaa paaee |
English: By great good fortune, I have found the Society of the Saints; I bow and touch their feet.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: man darasan kee piaas hai naanak bal jaaee |15|
English: My mind thirsts for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan; Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||15||

[Ang 709 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਹ ਸਰਬ ਦੋਖ ਨਿਵਾਰਣਹ ॥
Transliteration: patit puneet gobindah sarab dokh nivaaranah |
English: The Lord of the Universe is the Purifier of sinners; He is the Dispeller of all distress.

Gurbani: ਸਰਣਿ ਸੂਰ ਭਗਵਾਨਹ ਜਪੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saran soor bhagavaanah japant naanak har har hare |1|
English: The Lord God is Mighty, giving His Protective Sanctuary; Nanak chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

Gurbani: ਛਡਿਓ ਹਭੁ ਆਪੁ ਲਗੜੋ ਚਰਣਾ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: chhaddio habh aap lagarro charanaa paas |
English: Renouncing all self-conceit, I hold tight to the Lord's Feet.

Gurbani: ਨਠੜੋ ਦੁਖ ਤਾਪੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੇਖੰਦਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: nattharro dukh taap naanak prabh pekhandiaa |2|
English: My sorrows and troubles have departed, O Nanak, beholding God. ||2||

[Ang 709 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਢਹਿ ਪਏ ਦੁਆਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: mel laihu deaal dteh pe duaariaa |
English: Unite with me, O Merciful Lord; I have fallen at Your Door.

Gurbani: ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਬਹੁ ਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: rakh levahu deen deaal bhramat bahu haariaa |
English: O Merciful to the meek, save me. I have wandered enough; now I am tired.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat vachhal teraa birad har patit udhaariaa |
English: It is Your very nature to love Your devotees, and save sinners.

Gurbani: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ਬਿਨਉ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: tujh bin naahee koe binau mohi saariaa |
English: Without You, there is no other at all; I offer this prayer to You.

Gurbani: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਸਾਰਿਆ ॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: kar geh lehu deaal saagar sansaariaa |16|
English: Take me by the hand, O Merciful Lord, and carry me across the world-ocean. ||16||

[Ang 709 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਉਧਰਣ ਦਇਆਲੰ ਆਸਰੰ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਕੀਰਤਨਹ ॥
Transliteration: sant udharan deaalan aasaran gopaal keeratanah |
English: The Merciful Lord is the Savior of the Saints; their only support is to sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲੰ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗੇਣ ਓਟ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰਹ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: niramalan sant sangen ott naanak paramesurah |1|
English: One becomes immaculate and pure, by associating with the Saints, O Nanak, and taking the Protection of the Transcendent Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਚੰਦਨ ਚੰਦੁ ਨ ਸਰਦ ਰੁਤਿ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਮਿਟਈ ਘਾਂਮ ॥
Transliteration: chandan chand na sarad rut mool na mittee ghaam |
English: The burning of the heart is not dispelled at all, by sandalwood paste, the moon, or the cold season.

Gurbani: ਸੀਤਲੁ ਥੀਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਪੰਦੜੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: seetal theevai naanakaa japandarro har naam |2|
English: It only becomes cool, O Nanak, by chanting the Name of the Lord. ||2||

[Ang 709 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਉਧਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਜਨ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal kee ott udhare sagal jan |
English: Through the Protection and Support of the Lord's lotus feet, all beings are saved.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਮਨ ॥
Transliteration: sun parataap govind nirbhau bhe man |
English: Hearing of the Glory of the Lord of the Universe, the mind becomes fearless.

Gurbani: ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਮੂਲਿ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨ ॥
Transliteration: tott na aavai mool sanchiaa naam dhan |
English: Nothing at all is lacking, when one gathers the wealth of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਸਿਉ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡੈ ਪੁਨ ॥
Transliteration: sant janaa siau sang paaeeai vaddai pun |
English: The Society of the Saints is obtained, by very good deeds.

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਨ ॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar har dhiaae har jas nit sun |17|
English: Twenty-four hours a day, meditate on the Lord, and listen continually to the Lord's Praises. ||17||

[Ang 709 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਦਇਆ ਕਰਣੰ ਦੁਖ ਹਰਣੰ ਉਚਰਣੰ ਨਾਮ ਕੀਰਤਨਹ ॥
Transliteration: deaa karanan dukh haranan ucharanan naam keeratanah |
English: The Lord grants His Grace, and dispels the pains of those who sing the Kirtan of the Praises of His Name.

Gurbani: ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਭਗਵਾਨਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਪਤ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: deaal purakh bhagavaanah naanak lipat na maaeaa |1|
English: When the Lord God shows His Kindness, O Nanak, one is no longer engrossed in Maya. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਾਹਿ ਬਲੰਦੜੀ ਬੁਝਿ ਗਈ ਰਖੰਦੜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: bhaeh balandarree bujh gee rakhandarro prabh aap |
English: The burning fire has been put out; God Himself has saved me.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਮੇਦਨੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jin upaaee medanee naanak so prabh jaap |2|
English: Meditate on that God, O Nanak, who created the universe. ||2||

[Ang 710 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jaa prabh bhe deaal na biaapai maaeaa |
English: When God becomes merciful, Maya does not cling.

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਅਘਾ ਗਏ ਨਾਸ ਹਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kott aghaa ge naas har ik dhiaaeaa |
English: Millions of sins are eliminated, by meditating on the Naam, the Name of the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਭਏ ਸਰੀਰ ਜਨ ਧੂਰੀ ਨਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: niramal bhe sareer jan dhooree naaeaa |
English: The body is made immaculate and pure, bathing in the dust of the feet of the Lord's humble servants.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਭਏ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: man tan bhe santokh pooran prabh paaeaa |
English: The mind and body become contented, finding the Perfect Lord God.

Gurbani: ਤਰੇ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸੰਗਿ ਲੋਗ ਕੁਲ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: tare kuttanb sang log kul sabaaeaa |18|
English: One is saved, along with his family, and all his ancestors. ||18||

[Ang 710 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੁਰ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਨਾਰਾਇਣਹ ॥
Transliteration: gur gobind gopaal gur gur pooran naaraaeinah |
English: The Guru is the Lord of the Universe; the Guru is the Lord of the world; the Guru is the Perfect Pervading Lord God.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਮਰਥ ਗੁਰ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣਹ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur deaal samarath gur gur naanak patit udhaaranah |1|
English: The Guru is compassionate; the Guru is all-powerful; the Guru, O Nanak, is the Saving Grace of sinners. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਉਜਲੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਅਸਗਾਹੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਬੋਹਿਥੈ ਤਾਰਿਅਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: bhaujal bikham asagaahu gur bohithai taariam |
English: The Guru is the boat, to cross over the dangerous, treacherous, unfathomable world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰ ਕਰੰਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਗਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak poor karam satigur charanee lagiaa |2|
English: O Nanak, by perfect good karma, one is attached to the feet of the True Guru. ||2||

[Ang 710 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਜਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan guradev jis sang har jape |
English: Blessed, blessed is the Divine Guru; associating with Him, one meditates on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਜਬ ਭਏ ਤ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਸਭਿ ਛਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur kripaal jab bhe ta avagun sabh chhape |
English: When the Guru becomes merciful, then all one's demerits are dispelled.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਨੀਚਹੁ ਉਚ ਥਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham guradev neechahu uch thape |
English: The Supreme Lord God, the Divine Guru, uplifts and exalts the lowly.

Gurbani: ਕਾਟਿ ਸਿਲਕ ਦੁਖ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਅਪ ਦਸੇ ॥
Transliteration: kaatt silak dukh maaeaa kar leene ap dase |
English: Cutting away the painful noose of Maya, He makes us His own slaves.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੇ ॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: gun gaae beant rasanaa har jase |19|
English: With my tongue, I sing the Glorious Praises of the infinite Lord God. ||19||

[Ang 710 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੰਤ ਏਕੋ ਸੁਨੀਅੰਤ ਏਕੋ ਵਰਤੰਤ ਏਕੋ ਨਰਹਰਹ ॥
Transliteration: drisattant eko suneeant eko varatant eko naraharah |
English: I see only the One Lord; I hear only the One Lord; the One Lord is all-pervading.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਜਾਚੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naam daan jaachant naanak deaal purakh kripaa karah |1|
English: Nanak begs for the gift of the Naam; O Merciful Lord God, please grant Your Grace. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਿਕੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਹਿਕੁ ਸੰਮਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਇਕਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: hik sevee hik samalaa har ikas peh aradaas |
English: I serve the One Lord, I contemplate the One Lord, and to the One Lord, I offer my prayer.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਵਖਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naam vakhar dhan sanchiaa naanak sachee raas |2|
English: Nanak has gathered in the wealth, the merchandise of the Naam; this is the true capital. ||2||

[Ang 710 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਇਆਲ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਪੂਰਨ ਇਕੁ ਏਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: prabh deaal beant pooran ik ehu |
English: God is merciful and infinite. The One and Only is all-pervading.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਕਹਾ ਕੇਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh aape aap doojaa kahaa kehu |
English: He Himself is all-in-all. Who else can we speak of?

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਲੇਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: aap karahu prabh daan aape aap lehu |
English: God Himself grants His gifts, and He Himself receives them.

Gurbani: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਥੇਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: aavan jaanaa hukam sabh nihachal tudh thehu |
English: Coming and going are all by the Hukam of Your Will; Your place is steady and unchanging.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ॥੨੦॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak mangai daan kar kirapaa naam dehu |20|1|
English: Nanak begs for this gift; by Your Grace, Lord, please grant me Your Name. ||20||1||

[Ang 710 | Raag: Raag Jaithsree | Author: Bhagat Ravidas Ji]
Gurbani: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: jaitasaree baanee bhagataa kee |
English: Jaitsree, The Word Of The Devotees:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਨਾਥ ਕਛੂਅ ਨ ਜਾਨਉ ॥
Transliteration: naath kachhooa na jaanau |
English: O my Lord and Master, I know nothing.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਹਾਥਿ ਬਿਕਾਨਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: man maaeaa kai haath bikaanau |1| rahaau |
English: My mind has sold out, and is in Maya's hands. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਕਹੀਅਤ ਹੌ ਜਗਤ ਗੁਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: tum kaheeat hau jagat gur suaamee |
English: You are called the Lord and Master, the Guru of the World.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਕਹੀਅਤ ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਕੇ ਕਾਮੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ham kaheeat kalijug ke kaamee |1|
English: I am called a lustful being of the Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||1||

Gurbani: ਇਨ ਪੰਚਨ ਮੇਰੋ ਮਨੁ ਜੁ ਬਿਗਾਰਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: ein panchan mero man ju bigaario |
English: The five vices have corrupted my mind.

Gurbani: ਪਲੁ ਪਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਤੇ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਪਾਰਿਓ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: pal pal har jee te antar paario |2|
English: Moment by moment, they lead me further away from the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਤ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਤ ਦੁਖ ਕੀ ਰਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: jat dekhau tat dukh kee raasee |
English: Wherever I look, I see loads of pain and suffering.

Gurbani: ਅਜੌਂ ਨ ਪਤੵਾਇ ਨਿਗਮ ਭਏ ਸਾਖੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ajauan na patayaae nigam bhe saakhee |3|
English: I do not have faith, even though the Vedas bear witness to the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੋਤਮ ਨਾਰਿ ਉਮਾਪਤਿ ਸ੍ਵਾਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: gotam naar umaapat svaamee |
English: Shiva cut off Brahma's head, and Gautam's wife and the Lord Indra mated;

Gurbani: ਸੀਸੁ ਧਰਨਿ ਸਹਸ ਭਗ ਗਾਂਮੀ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: sees dharan sehas bhag gaamee |4|
English: Brahma's head got stuck to Shiva's hand, and Indra came to bear the marks of a thousand female organs. ||4||

Gurbani: ਇਨ ਦੂਤਨ ਖਲੁ ਬਧੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਰਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: ein dootan khal badh kar maario |
English: These demons have fooled, bound and destroyed me.

Gurbani: ਬਡੋ ਨਿਲਾਜੁ ਅਜਹੂ ਨਹੀ ਹਾਰਿਓ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: baddo nilaaj ajahoo nahee haario |5|
English: I am very shameless - even now, I am not tired of them. ||5||

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਕਹਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: keh ravidaas kahaa kaise keejai |
English: Says Ravi Daas, what am I to do now?

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਰਘੁਨਾਥ ਸਰਨਿ ਕਾ ਕੀ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੬॥੧॥
Transliteration: bin raghunaath saran kaa kee leejai |6|1|
English: Without the Sanctuary of the Lord's Protection, who else's should I seek? ||6||1||

[Ang 711 | Raag: Raag Todee | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirbhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibhan gur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raag ttoddee mahalaa 4 ghar 1 |
English: Raag Todee, Chau-Padhay, Fourth Mehl, First House:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har bin reh na sakai man meraa |
English: Without the Lord, my mind cannot survive.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਭਵਜਲਿ ਫੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mere preetam praan har prabh gur mele bahur na bhavajal feraa |1| rahaau |
English: If the Guru unites me with my Beloved Lord God, my breath of life, then I shall not have to face the wheel of reincarnation again in the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਲੋਚ ਲਗੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਨੈਨਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: merai heearai loch lagee prabh keree har nainahu har prabh heraa |
English: My heart is gripped by a yearning for my Lord God, and with my eyes, I behold my Lord God.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਇਆਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਧਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: satigur deaal har naam drirraaeaa har paadhar har prabh keraa |1|
English: The merciful True Guru has implanted the Name of the Lord within me; this is the Path leading to my Lord God. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har rangee har naam prabh paaeaa har govind har prabh keraa |
English: Through the Lord's Love, I have found the Naam, the Name of my Lord God, the Lord of the Universe, the Lord my God.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਗਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਚੰਗੇਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har hiradai man tan meetthaa laagaa mukh masatak bhaag changeraa |2|
English: The Lord seems so very sweet to my heart, mind and body; upon my face, upon my forehead, my good destiny is inscribed. ||2||

Gurbani: ਲੋਭ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਜਿਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਚੰਗੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: lobh vikaar jinaa man laagaa har visariaa purakh changeraa |
English: Those whose minds are attached to greed and corruption forget the Lord, the good Lord God.

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂੜ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਮੰਦੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: oe manamukh moorr agiaanee kaheeeh tin masatak bhaag manderaa |3|
English: Those self-willed manmukhs are called foolish and ignorant; misfortune and bad destiny are written on their foreheads. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: bibek budh satigur te paaee gur giaan guroo prabh keraa |
English: From the True Guru, I have obtained a discriminating intellect; the Guru has revealed the spiritual wisdom of God.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਲਿਖੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak naam guroo te paaeaa dhur masatak bhaag likheraa |4|1|
English: Servant Nanak has obtained the Naam from the Guru; such is the destiny inscribed upon his forehead. ||4||1||

[Ang 711 | Raag: Raag Todee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: ttoddee mahalaa 5 ghar 1 dupade |
English: Todee, Fifth Mehl, First House, Dho-Padhay:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਨ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: santan avar na kaahoo jaanee |
English: The Saints do not know any other.

Gurbani: ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਪਾਖੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: beparavaah sadaa rang har kai jaa ko paakh suaamee | rahaau |
English: They are carefree, ever in the Lord's Love; the Lord and Master is on their side. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਊਚ ਸਮਾਨਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੇਰੋ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਤਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: aooch samaanaa tthaakur tero avar na kaahoo taanee |
English: Your canopy is so high, O Lord and Master; no one else has any power.

Gurbani: ਐਸੋ ਅਮਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਉ ਰਾਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aiso amar milio bhagatan kau raach rahe rang giaanee |1|
English: Such is the immortal Lord and Master the devotees have found; the spiritually wise remain absorbed in His Love. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਦੁਖ ਜਰਾ ਮਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਨਹਿ ਨਹੀ ਨਿਕਟਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: rog sog dukh jaraa maraa har janeh nahee nikattaanee |
English: Disease, sorrow, pain, old age and death do not even approach the humble servant of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਏਕੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੀ ॥੨॥੧॥
Transliteration: nirbhau hoe rahe liv ekai naanak har man maanee |2|1|
English: They remain fearless, in the Love of the One Lord; O Nanak, they have surrendered their minds to the Lord. ||2||1||

[Ang 711 | Raag: Raag Todee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: ttoddee mahalaa 5 |
English: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਸਦਾ ਖੁਆਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: har bisarat sadaa khuaaree |
English: Forgetting the Lord, one is ruined forever.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਧੋਖਾ ਕਹਾ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਓਟ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: taa kau dhokhaa kahaa biaapai jaa kau ott tuhaaree | rahaau |
English: How can anyone be deceived, who has Your Support, O Lord? ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਜੋ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਬਲਨਾ ਸਰਪ ਜੈਸੇ ਅਰਜਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: bin simaran jo jeevan balanaa sarap jaise arajaaree |
English: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, life is like a burning fire, even if one lives long, like a snake.

Gurbani: ਨਵ ਖੰਡਨ ਕੋ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਅੰਤਿ ਚਲੈਗੋ ਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: nav khanddan ko raaj kamaavai ant chalaigo haaree |1|
English: One may rule over the nine regions of the earth, but in the end, he shall have to depart, losing the game of life. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਗੁਣ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਗਾਏ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: gun nidhaan gun tin hee gaae jaa kau kirapaa dhaaree |
English: He alone sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the treasure of virtue, upon whom the Lord showers His Grace.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਧੰਨੁ ਉਸੁ ਜਨਮਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੨॥੨॥
Transliteration: so sukheea dhan us janamaa naanak tis balihaaree |2|2|
English: He is at peace, and his birth is blessed; Nanak is a sacrifice to him. ||2||2||

[Ang 712 | Raag: Raag Todee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: ttoddee mahalaa 5 ghar 2 chaupade |
English: Todee, Fifth Mehl, Second House, Chau-Padhay:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਧਾਇਓ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: dhaaeo re man deh dis dhaaeo |
English: The mind wanders, wandering in the ten directions.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਗਨ ਸੁਆਦਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਤਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਓ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa magan suaad lobh mohio tin prabh aap bhulaaeo | rahaau |
English: It is intoxicated by Maya, enticed by the taste of greed. God Himself has deluded it. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਇਕੁ ਮੁਹਤੁ ਨ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: har kathaa har jas saadhasangat siau ik muhat na ihu man laaeo |
English: He does not focus his mind, even for a moment, on the Lord's sermon, or the Lord's Praises, or the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਬਿਗਸਿਓ ਪੇਖਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਕੋ ਪਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਜੋਹਨਿ ਜਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bigasio pekh rang kasunbh ko par grih johan jaaeo |1|
English: He is excited, gazing on the transitory color of the safflower, and looking at other men's wives. ||1||

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਕੀਨੋ ਨਹ ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਨਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal siau bhaau na keeno neh sat purakh manaaeo |
English: He does not love the Lord's lotus feet, and he does not please the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਧਾਵਤ ਕਉ ਧਾਵਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤੀ ਜਿਉ ਤੇਲੀ ਬਲਦੁ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: dhaavat kau dhaaveh bahu bhaatee jiau telee balad bhramaaeo |2|
English: He runs around chasing the fleeting objects of the world, in all directions, like the ox around the oil press. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਨ ਕੀਓ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: naam daan isanaan na keeo ik nimakh na keerat gaaeo |
English: He does not practice the Naam, the Name of the Lord; nor does he practice charity or inner cleansing.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਾ ਝੂਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਮਨੁ ਤੋਖਿਓ ਨਹ ਬੂਝਿਓ ਅਪਨਾਇਓ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanaa jhootth laae man tokhio neh boojhio apanaaeo |3|
English: He does not sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, even for an instant. Clinging to his many falsehoods, he does not please his own mind, and he does not understand his own self. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਕੀਏ ਨਹੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਧਿਆਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: praupakaar na kabahoo kee nahee satigur sev dhiaaeo |
English: He never does good deeds for others; he does not serve or meditate on the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਰਚਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੋਸਟਿ ਮਤਵਾਰੋ ਮਦ ਮਾਇਓ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: panch doot rach sangat gosatt matavaaro mad maaeo |4|
English: He is entangled in the company and the advice of the five demons, intoxicated by the wine of Maya. ||4||

Gurbani: ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: krau benatee saadhasangat har bhagat vachhal sun aaeo |
English: I offer my prayer in the Saadh Sangat; hearing that the Lord is the Lover of His devotees, I have come.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਛੈ ਰਾਖੁ ਲਾਜ ਅਪੁਨਾਇਓ ॥੫॥੧॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak bhaag pario har paachhai raakh laaj apunaaeo |5|1|3|
English: Nanak runs after the Lord, and pleads, "Protect my honor, Lord, and make me Your own." ||5||1||3||

[Ang 712 | Raag: Raag Todee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: ttoddee mahalaa 5 |
English: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਾਨੁਖੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: maanukh bin boojhe birathaa aaeaa |
English: Without understanding, his coming into the world is useless.

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਸਾਜ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਿਉ ਮਿਰਤਕੁ ਓਢਾਇਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: anik saaj seegaar bahu karataa jiau miratak odtaaeaa | rahaau |
English: He puts on various ornaments and many decorations, but it is like dressing a corpse. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਧਾਇ ਧਾਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਨ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਕਰੀ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: dhaae dhaae kripan sram keeno ikatr karee hai maaeaa |
English: With great effort and exertion, the miser works to gather in the riches of Maya.

Gurbani: ਦਾਨੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਸੰਤਨ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਿਤ ਹੀ ਕਾਜਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: daan pun nahee santan sevaa kit hee kaaj na aaeaa |1|
English: He does not give anything in charity or generosity, and he does not serve the Saints; his wealth does not do him any good at all. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਆਭਰਣ ਸਵਾਰੀ ਸੇਜਾ ਕਾਮਨਿ ਥਾਟੁ ਬਨਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kar aabharan savaaree sejaa kaaman thaatt banaaeaa |
English: The soul-bride puts on her ornaments, embellishes her bed, and fashions decorations.

Gurbani: ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਭਰਤੇ ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sang na paaeo apune bharate pekh pekh dukh paaeaa |2|
English: But if she does not obtain the company of her Husband Lord, the sight of these decorations only brings her pain. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਾਰੋ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਮਜੂਰੀ ਕਰਤਾ ਤੁਹੁ ਮੂਸਲਹਿ ਛਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: saaro dinas majooree karataa tuhu moosaleh chharaaeaa |
English: The man works all day long, threshing the husks with the pestle.

Gurbani: ਖੇਦੁ ਭਇਓ ਬੇਗਾਰੀ ਨਿਆਈ ਘਰ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: khed bheo begaaree niaaee ghar kai kaam na aaeaa |3|
English: He is depressed, like a forced laborer, and so he is of no use to his own home. ||3||

Gurbani: ਭਇਓ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bheo anugrahu jaa kau prabh ko tis hiradai naam vasaaeaa |
English: But when God shows His Mercy and Grace, He implants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within the heart.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਰਿਅਉ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੨॥੪॥
Transliteration: saadhasangat kai paachhai pariaau jan naanak har ras paaeaa |4|2|4|
English: Search the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, and find the sublime essence of the Lord. ||4||2||4||

[Ang 712 | Raag: Raag Todee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: ttoddee mahalaa 5 |
English: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਬਸਹੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਨੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: kripaa nidh basahu ridai har neet |
English: O Lord, ocean of mercy, please abide forever in my heart.

Gurbani: ਤੈਸੀ ਬੁਧਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: taisee budh karahu paragaasaa laagai prabh sang preet | rahaau |
English: Please awaken such understanding within me, that I may be in love with You, God. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦਾਸ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਕੀ ਪਾਵਉ ਧੂਰਾ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇ ਲੇ ਲਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: daas tumaare kee paavau dhooraa masatak le le laavau |
English: Please, bless me with the dust of the feet of Your slaves; I touch it to my forehead.

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਪਤਿਤ ਤੇ ਹੋਤ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mahaa patit te hot puneetaa har keeratan gun gaavau |1|
English: I was a great sinner, but I have been made pure, singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Glorious Praises. ||1||

Gurbani: ਆਗਿਆ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਮੀਠੀ ਲਾਗਉ ਕੀਓ ਤੁਹਾਰੋ ਭਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: aagiaa tumaree meetthee laagau keeo tuhaaro bhaavau |
English: Your Will seems so sweet to me; whatever You do, is pleasing to me.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ ਤਹੀ ਇਹੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੈ ਆਨ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਧਾਵਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jo too dehi tahee ihu tripatai aan na katahoo dhaavau |2|
English: Whatever You give me, with that I am satisfied; I shall chase after no one else. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਦ ਹੀ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਜਾਨਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਗਲ ਰੇਣ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: sad hee nikatt jaanau prabh suaamee sagal ren hoe raheeai |
English: I know that my Lord and Master God is always with me; I am the dust of all men's feet.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: saadhoo sangat hoe paraapat taa prabh apunaa laheeai |3|
English: If I find the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I shall obtain God. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਮ ਛੋਹਰੇ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਤੂ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਮਰੋ ਮੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa ham chhohare tumare too prabh hamaro meeraa |
English: Forever and ever, I am Your child; You are my God, my King.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤੁਮ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰੋ ਖੀਰਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak baarik tum maat pitaa mukh naam tumaaro kheeraa |4|3|5|
English: Nanak is Your child; You are my mother and father; please, give me Your Name, like milk in my mouth. ||4||3||5||

[Ang 713 | Raag: Raag Todee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: ttoddee mahalaa 5 ghar 2 dupade |
English: Todee, Fifth Mehl, Second House, Dho-Padhay:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਮਾਗਉ ਦਾਨੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਨਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: maagau daan tthaakur naam |
English: I beg for the Gift of Your Name, O my Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰੁ ਕਛੂ ਮੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਮਿਲੈ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: avar kachhoo merai sang na chaalai milai kripaa gun gaam |1| rahaau |
English: Nothing else shall go along with me in the end; by Your Grace, please allow me to sing Your Glorious Praises. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਰਾਜੁ ਮਾਲੁ ਅਨੇਕ ਭੋਗ ਰਸ ਸਗਲ ਤਰਵਰ ਕੀ ਛਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: raaj maal anek bhog ras sagal taravar kee chhaam |
English: Power, wealth, various pleasures and enjoyments, all are just like the shadow of a tree.

Gurbani: ਧਾਇ ਧਾਇ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਉ ਧਾਵੈ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਰਾਰਥ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dhaae dhaae bahu bidh kau dhaavai sagal niraarath kaam |1|
English: He runs, runs, runs around in many directions, but all of his pursuits are useless. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਅਵਰੁ ਜੇ ਚਾਹਉ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਗਲ ਬਾਤ ਹੈ ਖਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: bin govind avar je chaahau deesai sagal baat hai khaam |
English: Except for the Lord of the Universe, everything he desires appears transitory.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਰੇਨ ਮਾਗਉ ਮੇਰੋ ਮਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥੧॥੬॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak sant ren maagau mero man paavai bisraam |2|1|6|
English: Says Nanak, I beg for the dust of the feet of the Saints, so that my mind may find peace and tranquility. ||2||1||6||

[Ang 713 | Raag: Raag Todee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: ttoddee mahalaa 5 |
English: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਾਧਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: prabh jee ko naam maneh saadhaarai |
English: The Naam, the Name of the Dear Lord, is the Support of my mind.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸੂਖ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਬਰਤਨਿ ਏਹ ਹਮਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jeea praan sookh is man kau baratan eeh hamaarai |1| rahaau |
English: It is my life, my breath of life, my peace of mind; for me, it is an article of daily use. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਪਤਿ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਪਰਵਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: naam jaat naam meree pat hai naam merai paravaarai |
English: The Naam is my social status, the Naam is my honor; the Naam is my family.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਮੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naam sakhaaee sadaa merai sang har naam mo kau nisataarai |1|
English: The Naam is my companion; it is always with me. The Lord's Name is my emancipation. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਲਾਸ ਕਹੀਅਤ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਚਲਤ ਨ ਕਛੂ ਸੰਗਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: bikhai bilaas kaheeat bahutere chalat na kachhoo sangaarai |
English: Sensual pleasures are talked about a lot, but none of them goes along with anyone in the end.

Gurbani: ਇਸਟੁ ਮੀਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਭੰਡਾਰੈ ॥੨॥੨॥੭॥
Transliteration: eisatt meet naam naanak ko har naam merai bhanddaarai |2|2|7|
English: The Naam is Nanak's dearest friend; the Lord's Name is my treasure. ||2||2||7||

[Ang 713 | Raag: Raag Todee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: ttoddee mahalaa 5 |
English: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨੀਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ਮਿਟਹੀ ਰੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: neeke gun gaau mittahee rog |
English: Sing the sublime Praises of the Lord, and your disease shall be eradicated.

Gurbani: ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਤੇਰੋ ਰਹੈ ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਲੋਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mukh aoojal man niramal hoee hai tero rahai eehaa aoohaa log |1| rahaau |
English: Your face shall become radiant and bright, and your mind shall be immaculately pure. You shall be saved here and hereafter. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਰਿ ਕਰਉ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਚਰਾਵਉ ਭੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: charan pakhaar krau gur sevaa maneh charaavau bhog |
English: I wash the Guru's feet and serve Him; I dedicate my mind as an offering to Him.

Gurbani: ਛੋਡਿ ਆਪਤੁ ਬਾਦੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ਮਾਨੁ ਸੋਈ ਜੋ ਹੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: chhodd aapat baad ahankaaraa maan soee jo hog |1|
English: Renounce self-conceit, negativity and egotism, and accept what comes to pass. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਟਹਲ ਸੋਈ ਹੈ ਲਾਗਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲਿਖੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: sant ttehal soee hai laagaa jis masatak likhiaa likhog |
English: He alone commits himself to the service of the Saints, upon whose forehead such destiny is inscribed.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੨॥੩॥੮॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak ek bin doojaa avar na karanai jog |2|3|8|
English: Says Nanak, other than the One Lord, there is not any other able to act. ||2||3||8||

[Ang 713 | Raag: Raag Todee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: ttoddee mahalaa 5 |
English: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਇਓ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: satigur aaeo saran tuhaaree |
English: O True Guru, I have come to Your Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲੈ ਸੂਖੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਲਾਹਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: milai sookh naam har sobhaa chintaa laeh hamaaree |1| rahaau |
English: Grant me the peace and glory of the Lord's Name, and remove my anxiety. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਵਰ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਦੂਜੀ ਠਾਹਰ ਹਾਰਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਤਉ ਦੁਆਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: avar na soojhai doojee tthaahar haar pario tau duaaree |
English: I cannot see any other place of shelter; I have grown weary, and collapsed at Your door.

Gurbani: ਲੇਖਾ ਛੋਡਿ ਅਲੇਖੈ ਛੂਟਹ ਹਮ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: lekhaa chhodd alekhai chhoottah ham niragun lehu ubaaree |1|
English: Please ignore my account; only then may I be saved. I am worthless - please, save me! ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਦ ਬਖਸਿੰਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨਾ ਸਭਨਾ ਦੇਇ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: sad bakhasind sadaa miharavaanaa sabhanaa dee adhaaree |
English: You are always forgiving, and always merciful; You give support to all.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸੰਤ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਰਿਓ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਇਹ ਬਾਰੀ ॥੨॥੪॥੯॥
Transliteration: naanak daas sant paachhai pario raakh lehu ih baaree |2|4|9|
English: Slave Nanak follows the Path of the Saints; save him, O Lord, this time. ||2||4||9||

[Ang 713 | Raag: Raag Todee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: ttoddee mahalaa 5 |
English: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਨਿਧਿ ਗਾਇਣ ॥
Transliteration: rasanaa gun gopaal nidh gaaein |
English: My tongue sings the Praises of the Lord of the world, the ocean of virtue.

Gurbani: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜੁ ਰਹਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਪਲਾਇਣ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saant sehaj rehas man upajio sagale dookh palaaein |1| rahaau |
English: Peace, tranquility, poise and delight well up in my mind, and all sorrows run away. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸੇਵਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਰਸਾਇਣ ॥
Transliteration: jo maageh soee soee paaveh sev har ke charan rasaaein |
English: Whatever I ask for, I receive; I serve at the Lord's feet, the source of nectar.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਹਹੂ ਤੇ ਛੂਟਹਿ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਾਇਣ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: janam maran duhahoo te chhootteh bhavajal jagat taraaein |1|
English: I am released from the bondage of birth and death, and so I cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||

Gurbani: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਦਾਸ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਪਰਾਇਣ ॥
Transliteration: khojat khojat tat beechaario daas govind paraaein |
English: Searching and seeking, I have come to understand the essence of reality; the slave of the Lord of the Universe is dedicated to Him.

Gurbani: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਖੇਮ ਚਾਹਹਿ ਜੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ॥੨॥੫॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: abinaasee khem chaaheh je naanak sadaa simar naaraaein |2|5|10|
English: If you desire eternal bliss, O Nanak, ever remember the Lord in meditation. ||2||5||10||

[Ang 714 | Raag: Raag Todee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: ttoddee mahalaa 5 |
English: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਾਟਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: nindak gur kirapaa te haattio |
English: The slanderer, by Guru's Grace, has been turned away.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਸਿਵ ਕੈ ਬਾਣਿ ਸਿਰੁ ਕਾਟਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham prabh bhe deaalaa siv kai baan sir kaattio |1| rahaau |
English: The Supreme Lord God has become merciful; with Shiva's arrow, He shot his head off. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਾਲੁ ਜਾਲੁ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਸਚ ਕਾ ਪੰਥਾ ਥਾਟਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: kaal jaal jam johi na saakai sach kaa panthaa thaattio |
English: Death, and the noose of death, cannot see me; I have adopted the Path of Truth.

Gurbani: ਖਾਤ ਖਰਚਤ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਿਖੁਟਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਰਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਖਾਟਿਓ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: khaat kharachat kichh nikhuttat naahee raam ratan dhan khaattio |1|
English: I have earned the wealth, the jewel of the Lord's Name; eating and spending, it is never used up. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਸਮਾ ਭੂਤ ਹੋਆ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਅਪਨਾ ਕੀਆ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bhasamaa bhoot hoaa khin bheetar apanaa keea paaeaa |
English: In an instant, the slanderer was reduced to ashes; he received the rewards of his own actions.

Gurbani: ਆਗਮ ਨਿਗਮੁ ਕਹੈ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਭੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਲੋਕੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੨॥੬॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: aagam nigam kahai jan naanak sabh dekhai lok sabaaeaa |2|6|11|
English: Servant Nanak speaks the truth of the scriptures; the whole world is witness to it. ||2||6||11||

[Ang 714 | Raag: Raag Todee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: ttoddee mahalaa 5 |
English: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਪਨ ਤਨ ਮਨ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਭਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kirapan tan man kilavikh bhare |
English: O miser, your body and mind are full of sin.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਭਜਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਢਾਕਨ ਕਉ ਇਕੁ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang bhajan kar suaamee dtaakan kau ik hare |1| rahaau |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, vibrate, meditate on the Lord and Master; He alone can cover your sins. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਕੇ ਛੁਟਕਤ ਥਾਮ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ਕਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: anik chhidr bohith ke chhuttakat thaam na jaahee kare |
English: When many holes appear in your boat, you cannot plug them with your hands.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਖੋਟੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਖਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jis kaa bohith tis aaraadhe khotte sang khare |1|
English: Worship and adore the One, to whom your boat belongs; He saves the counterfeit along with the genuine. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗਲੀ ਸੈਲ ਉਠਾਵਤ ਚਾਹੈ ਓਇ ਊਹਾ ਹੀ ਹੈ ਧਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: galee sail utthaavat chaahai oe aoohaa hee hai dhare |
English: People want to lift up the mountain with mere words, but it just stays there.

Gurbani: ਜੋਰੁ ਸਕਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: jor sakat naanak kichh naahee prabh raakhahu saran pare |2|7|12|
English: Nanak has no strength or power at all; O God, please protect me - I seek Your Sanctuary. ||2||7||12||

[Ang 714 | Raag: Raag Todee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: ttoddee mahalaa 5 |
English: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਉ ॥
Transliteration: har ke charan kamal man dhiaau |
English: Meditate on the lotus feet of the Lord within your mind.

Gurbani: ਕਾਢਿ ਕੁਠਾਰੁ ਪਿਤ ਬਾਤ ਹੰਤਾ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kaadt kutthaar pit baat hantaa aaukhadh har ko naau |1| rahaau |
English: The Name of the Lord is the medicine; it is like an axe, which destroys the diseases caused by anger and egotism. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੀਨੇ ਤਾਪ ਨਿਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ਦੁਖ ਹੰਤਾ ਸੁਖ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: teene taap nivaaranahaaraa dukh hantaa sukh raas |
English: The Lord is the One who removes the three fevers; He is the Destroyer of pain, the warehouse of peace.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਲਾਗੈ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਗੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: taa kau bighan na koaoo laagai jaa kee prabh aagai aradaas |1|
English: No obstacles block the path of one who prays before God. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਬੈਦ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕ ॥
Transliteration: sant prasaad baid naaraaein karan kaaran prabh ek |
English: By the Grace of the Saints, the Lord has become my physician; God alone is the Doer, the Cause of causes.

Gurbani: ਬਾਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਟੇਕ ॥੨॥੮॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: baal budh pooran sukhadaataa naanak har har ttek |2|8|13|
English: He is the Giver of perfect peace to the innocent-minded people; O Nanak, the Lord, Har, Har, is my support. ||2||8||13||

[Ang 714 | Raag: Raag Todee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: ttoddee mahalaa 5 |
English: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam sadaa sad jaap |
English: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, forever and ever.

Gurbani: ਧਾਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਵਸਦੀ ਕੀਨੀ ਆਪਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dhaar anugrahu paarabraham suaamee vasadee keenee aap |1| rahaau |
English: Showering His Kind Mercy, the Supreme Lord God Himself has blessed the town. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਸੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥
Transliteration: jis ke se fir tin hee samaale binase sog santaap |
English: The One who owns me, has again taken care of me; my sorrow and suffering is past.

Gurbani: ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਰਾਖੇ ਜਨ ਅਪਨੇ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਏ ਮਾਈ ਬਾਪ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: haath dee raakhe jan apane har hoe maaee baap |1|
English: He gave me His hand, and saved me, His humble servant; the Lord is my mother and father. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਹੋਏ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨਾ ਦਯਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਥ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jant hoe miharavaanaa dayaa dhaaree har naath |
English: All beings and creatures have become kind to me; my Lord and Master blessed me with His Kind Mercy.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੇ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਬਡ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥੨॥੯॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: naanak saran pare dukh bhanjan jaa kaa badd parataap |2|9|14|
English: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord, the Destroyer of pain; His glory is so great! ||2||9||14||

[Ang 714 | Raag: Raag Todee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: ttoddee mahalaa 5 |
English: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸ੍ਵਾਮੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: svaamee saran pario darabaare |
English: O Lord and Master, I seek the Sanctuary of Your Court.

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਅਪਰਾਧ ਖੰਡਨ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kott aparaadh khanddan ke daate tujh bin kaun udhaare |1| rahaau |
English: Destroyer of millions of sins, O Great Giver, other than You, who else can save me? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਬਹੁ ਪਰਕਾਰੇ ਸਰਬ ਅਰਥ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: khojat khojat bahu parakaare sarab arath beechaare |
English: Searching, searching in so many ways, I have contemplated all the objects of life.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਾਇਆ ਰਚਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਹਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saadhasang param gat paaeeai maaeaa rach bandh haare |1|
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the supreme state is attained. But those who are engrossed in the bondage of Maya, lose the game of life. ||1||

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਸੁਰਿ ਜਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal sang preet man laagee sur jan mile piaare |
English: My mind is in love with the Lord's lotus feet; I have met the Beloved Guru, the noble, heroic being.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਦ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਰੋਗ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: naanak anad kare har jap jap sagale rog nivaare |2|10|15|
English: Nanak celebrates in bliss; chanting and meditating on the Lord, all sickness has been cured. ||2||10||15||

[Ang 715 | Raag: Raag Todee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: ttoddee mahalaa 5 ghar 3 chaupade |
English: Todee, Fifth Mehl, Third House, Chau-Padhay:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਹਾਂ ਹਾਂ ਲਪਟਿਓ ਰੇ ਮੂੜੑੇ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਥੋਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: haan haan lapattio re moorrae kachhoo na thoree |
English: Oh! Oh! You cling to Maya, you fool; this is not a trivial matter.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੋ ਨਹੀ ਸੁ ਜਾਨੀ ਮੋਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tero nahee su jaanee moree | rahaau |
English: That which you consider to be yours, is not yours. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਪਨ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੋ ਖਿਨੂਆ ॥
Transliteration: aapan raam na cheeno khinooaa |
English: You do not remember your Lord, even for an instant.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਪਰਾਈ ਸੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਮਨੂਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jo paraaee su apanee manooaa |1|
English: That which belongs to others, you believe to be your own. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਗੀ ਸੋ ਮਨਿ ਨ ਬਸਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: naam sangee so man na basaaeo |
English: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is always with you, but you do not enshrine it within your mind.

Gurbani: ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਵਾਹੂ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: chhodd jaeh vaahoo chit laaeo |2|
English: You have attached your consciousness to that which you must eventually abandon. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸੰਚਿਓ ਜਿਤੁ ਭੂਖ ਤਿਸਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: so sanchio jit bhookh tisaaeo |
English: You collect that which will bring you only hunger and thirst.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੋਸਾ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: amrit naam tosaa nahee paaeo |3|
English: You have not obtained the supplies of the Ambrosial Naam. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਮੋਹ ਕੂਪਿ ਪਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh moh koop pariaa |
English: You have fallen into the pit of sexual desire, anger and emotional attachment.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੋ ਤਰਿਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad naanak ko tariaa |4|1|16|
English: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, a rare few are saved. ||4||1||16||

[Ang 715 | Raag: Raag Todee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: ttoddee mahalaa 5 |
English: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਮਾਰੈ ਏਕੈ ਹਰੀ ਹਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: hamaarai ekai haree haree |
English: I have only the One Lord, my God.

Gurbani: ਆਨ ਅਵਰ ਸਿਞਾਣਿ ਨ ਕਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aan avar siyaan na karee | rahaau |
English: I do not recognize any other. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਪਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: vaddai bhaag gur apunaa paaeo |
English: By great good fortune, I have found my Guru.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur mo kau har naam drirraaeo |1|
English: The Guru has implanted the Name of the Lord within me. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਨੇਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: har har jaap taap brat nemaa |
English: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is my meditation, austerity, fasting and daily religious practice.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਕੁਸਲ ਸਭਿ ਖੇਮਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har har dhiaae kusal sabh khemaa |2|
English: Meditating on the Lord, Har, Har, I have found total joy and bliss. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਚਾਰ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਜਾਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: aachaar biauhaar jaat har guneea |
English: The Praises of the Lord are my good conduct, occupation and social class.

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਨੀਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: mahaa anand keeratan har suneea |3|
English: Listening to the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, I am in absolute ecstasy. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak jin tthaakur paaeaa |
English: Says Nanak, everything comes to the homes

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh tis ke grih meh aaeaa |4|2|17|
English: Of those who have found their Lord and Master. ||4||2||17||

[Ang 715 | Raag: Raag Todee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: ttoddee mahalaa 5 ghar 4 dupade |
English: Todee, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House, Dho-Padhay:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਰੂੜੋ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੋ ਲੋੜੈ ॥
Transliteration: roorro man har rango lorrai |
English: My beautiful mind longs for the Love of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗਾਲੀ ਹਰਿ ਨੀਹੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gaalee har neehu na hoe | rahaau |
English: By mere words, the Lord's Love does not come. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਢੂਢੇਦੀ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਬੀਥੀ ਬੀਥੀ ਪੇਖਾ ॥
Transliteration: hau dtoodtedee darasan kaaran beethee beethee pekhaa |
English: I have searched for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, looking in each and every street.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur mil bharam gavaaeaa he |1|
English: Meeting with the Guru, my doubts have been dispelled. ||1||

Gurbani: ਇਹ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਈ ਮੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੰਨਹੁ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਿਓ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਾਥੈ ॥
Transliteration: eih budh paaee mai saadhoo kanahu lekh likhio dhur maathai |
English: I have obtained this wisdom from the Holy Saints, according to the pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon my forehead.

Gurbani: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਨੈਣ ਅਲੋਇ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: eih bidh naanak har nain aloe |2|1|18|
English: In this way, Nanak has seen the Lord with his eyes. ||2||1||18||

[Ang 715 | Raag: Raag Todee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: ttoddee mahalaa 5 |
English: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗਰਬਿ ਗਹਿਲੜੋ ਮੂੜੜੋ ਹੀਓ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: garab gahilarro moorrarro heeo re |
English: My foolish heart is in the grip of pride.

Gurbani: ਹੀਓ ਮਹਰਾਜ ਰੀ ਮਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: heeo maharaaj ree maaeo |
English: By the Will of my Lord God, Maya,

Gurbani: ਡੀਹਰ ਨਿਆਈ ਮੋਹਿ ਫਾਕਿਓ ਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ddeehar niaaee mohi faakio re | rahaau |
English: Like a witch, has swallowed my soul. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਘਣੋ ਘਣੋ ਘਣੋ ਸਦ ਲੋੜੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਲਹਣੇ ਕੈਠੈ ਪਾਇਓ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: ghano ghano ghano sad lorrai bin lahane kaitthai paaeo re |
English: More and more, he continually yearns for more; but unless he is destined to receive, how can he obtain it?

Gurbani: ਮਹਰਾਜ ਰੋ ਗਾਥੁ ਵਾਹੂ ਸਿਉ ਲੁਭੜਿਓ ਨਿਹਭਾਗੜੋ ਭਾਹਿ ਸੰਜੋਇਓ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: maharaaj ro gaath vaahoo siau lubharrio nihabhaagarro bhaeh sanjoeo re |1|
English: He is entangled in wealth, bestowed by the Lord God; the unfortunate one attaches himself to the fire of desires. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਸੀਖ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਸਗਲੋ ਥਾਰੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਛਤ ਮਿਟਿਓ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sun man seekh saadhoo jan sagalo thaare sagale praachhat mittio re |
English: Listen, O mind, to the Teachings of the Holy Saints, and all your sins shall be totally washed away.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੋ ਲਹਣੋ ਮਹਰਾਜ ਰੀ ਗਾਠੜੀਓ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗਰਭਾਸਿ ਨ ਪਉੜਿਓ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: jaa ko lahano maharaaj ree gaattharreeo jan naanak garabhaas na paurrio re |2|2|19|
English: One who is destined to receive from the Lord, O servant Nanak, shall not be cast into the womb of reincarnation again. ||2||2||19||

[Ang 716 | Raag: Raag Todee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: ttoddee mahalaa 5 ghar 5 dupade |
English: Todee, Fifth Mehl, Fifth House, Dho-Padhay:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਐਸੋ ਗੁਨੁ ਮੇਰੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਕੀਨ ॥
Transliteration: aiso gun mero prabh jee keen |
English: Such is the blessing my God has bestowed upon me.

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਦੋਖ ਅਰੁ ਅਹੰ ਰੋਗ ਇਹ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਸਗਲ ਦੂਰਿ ਕੀਨ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: panch dokh ar ahan rog ih tan te sagal door keen | rahaau |
English: He has totally banished the five evils and the illness of egotism from my body. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋਰਿ ਛੋਰਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਦੀਨ ॥
Transliteration: bandhan tor chhor bikhiaa te gur ko sabad merai heearai deen |
English: Breaking my bonds, and releasing me from vice and corruption, He has enshrined the Word of the Guru's Shabad within my heart.

Gurbani: ਰੂਪੁ ਅਨਰੂਪੁ ਮੋਰੋ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਗਹਿਓ ਮੋਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਭੀਨ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: roop anaroop moro kachh na beechaario prem gahio mohi har rang bheen |1|
English: The Lord has not considered my beauty or ugliness; instead, He has held me with love. I am drenched with His Love. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪੇਖਿਓ ਲਾਲਨੁ ਪਾਟ ਬੀਚ ਖੋਏ ਅਨਦ ਚਿਤਾ ਹਰਖੇ ਪਤੀਨ ॥
Transliteration: pekhio laalan paatt beech khoe anad chitaa harakhe pateen |
English: I behold my Beloved, now that the curtain has been torn away. My mind is happy, pleased and satisfied.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੋ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੋ ਧੀਨ ॥੨॥੧॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: tis hee ko grihu soee prabh naanak so tthaakur tis hee ko dheen |2|1|20|
English: My house is His; He is my God. Nanak is obedient to His Lord and Master. ||2||1||20||

[Ang 716 | Raag: Raag Todee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: ttoddee mahalaa 5 |
English: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਾਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: maaee mere man kee preet |
English: O my mother, my mind is in love.

Gurbani: ਏਹੀ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਜਪ ਏਹੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੈ ਰੀਤਿ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ehee karam dharam jap ehee raam naam niramal hai reet | rahaau |
English: This is my karma and my Dharma; this is my meditation. The Lord's Name is my immaculate, unstained way of life. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰ ਜੀਵਨ ਧਨ ਮੋਰੈ ਦੇਖਨ ਕਉ ਦਰਸਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: praan adhaar jeevan dhan morai dekhan kau darasan prabh neet |
English: The Support of my breath of life, the wealth of my life, is to gaze upon the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan.

Gurbani: ਬਾਟ ਘਾਟ ਤੋਸਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੋਰੈ ਮਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਉ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਖਾ ਕੀਤ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: baatt ghaatt tosaa sang morai man apune kau mai har sakhaa keet |1|
English: On the road, and on the river, these supplies are always with me. I have made my mind the Lord's companion. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: sant prasaad bhe man niramal kar kirapaa apune kar leet |
English: By the Grace of the Saints, my mind has become immaculate and pure. In His mercy, He has made me His own.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੇ ਮੀਤ ॥੨॥੨॥੨੧॥
Transliteration: simar simar naanak sukh paaeaa aad jugaad bhagatan ke meet |2|2|21|
English: Remembering, remembering Him in meditation, Nanak has found peace. From the very beginning, and throughout the ages, He is the friend of His devotees. ||2||2||21||

[Ang 716 | Raag: Raag Todee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: ttoddee mahalaa 5 |
English: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਮਿਲੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: prabh jee mil mere praan |
English: Dear God, please meet me; You are my breath of life.

Gurbani: ਬਿਸਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਨਿਮਖ ਹੀਅਰੇ ਤੇ ਅਪਨੇ ਭਗਤ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਨ ਦਾਨ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bisar nahee nimakh heeare te apane bhagat kau pooran daan | rahaau |
English: Do not let me forget You from my heart, even for an instant; please, bless Your devotee with Your gift of perfection. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਖੋਵਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸੁਘੜ ਸੁਜਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: khovahu bharam raakh mere preetam antarajaamee sugharr sujaan |
English: Dispel my doubt, and save me, O my Beloved, all-knowing Lord, O Inner-knower, O Searcher of hearts.

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਰਾਜ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਨ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kott raaj naam dhan merai amrit drisatt dhaarahu prabh maan |1|
English: The wealth of the Naam is worth millions of kingdoms to me; O God, please bless me with Your Ambrosial Glance of Grace. ||1||

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ਜਸੁ ਪੂਰਿ ਅਘਾਵਹਿ ਸਮਰਥ ਕਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar rasanaa gun gaavai jas poor aghaaveh samarath kaan |
English: Twenty-four hours a day, I sing Your Glorious Praises. They totally satisfy my ears, O my all-powerful Lord.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਜੀਅਨ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ॥੨॥੩॥੨੨॥
Transliteration: teree saran jeean ke daate sadaa sadaa naanak kurabaan |2|3|22|
English: I seek Your Sanctuary, O Lord, O Giver of life to the soul; forever and ever, Nanak is a sacrifice to You. ||2||3||22||

[Ang 716 | Raag: Raag Todee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: ttoddee mahalaa 5 |
English: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੇ ਪਗ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: prabh tere pag kee dhoor |
English: O God, I am the dust of Your feet.

Gurbani: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮਨਮੋਹਨ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਲੋਚਾ ਪੂਰਿ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: deen deaal preetam manamohan kar kirapaa meree lochaa poor | rahaau |
English: O merciful to the meek, Beloved mind-enticing Lord, by Your Kind Mercy, please fulfill my yearning. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਜਸੁ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: deh dis rav rahiaa jas tumaraa antarajaamee sadaa hajoor |
English: In the ten directions, Your Praises are permeating and pervading, O Inner-knower, Searcher of hearts, O Lord ever-present.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਮਰਤੇ ਝੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jo tumaraa jas gaaveh karate se jan kabahu na marate jhoor |1|
English: Those who sing Your Praises, O Creator Lord, those humble beings never die or grieve. ||1||

Gurbani: ਧੰਧ ਬੰਧ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਟੇ ਬਿਸੂਰ ॥
Transliteration: dhandh bandh binase maaeaa ke saadhoo sangat mitte bisoor |
English: The worldly affairs and entanglements of Maya disappear, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; all sorrows are taken away.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਭੋਗ ਇਸੁ ਜੀਅ ਕੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਨੇ ਕੂਰ ॥੨॥੪॥੨੩॥
Transliteration: sukh sanpat bhog is jeea ke bin har naanak jaane koor |2|4|23|
English: The comforts of wealth and the enjoyments of the soul - O Nanak, without the Lord, know them to be false. ||2||4||23||

[Ang 716 | Raag: Raag Todee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: ttoddee mahalaa 5 |
English: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਾਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
Transliteration: maaee mere man kee piaas |
English: O my mother, my mind is so thirsty.

Gurbani: ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਦਰਸਨ ਦੇਖਨ ਕਉ ਧਾਰੀ ਮਨਿ ਆਸ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: eik khin reh na skau bin preetam darasan dekhan kau dhaaree man aas | rahaau |
English: I cannot survive, even for an instant, without my Beloved. My mind is filled with the desire to behold the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਕਰਤੇ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਨਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: simrau naam niranjan karate man tan te sabh kilavikh naas |
English: I meditate in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of the immaculate Creator Lord; all the sins and errors of my mind and body are washed away.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਬਿਮਲ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਸ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: pooran paarabraham sukhadaate abinaasee bimal jaa ko jaas |1|
English: The Perfect Supreme Lord God, the eternal, imperishable Giver of peace - spotless and pure are His Praises. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਪੂਰ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭੇਟੇ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: sant prasaad mere poor manorath kar kirapaa bhette gunataas |
English: By the Grace of the Saints, my desires have been fulfilled; in His Mercy, the Lord, the treasure of virtue, has met me.

Gurbani: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੂਖ ਮਨਿ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਕੋਟਿ ਸੂਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰਗਾਸ ॥੨॥੫॥੨੪॥
Transliteration: saant sehaj sookh man upajio kott soor naanak paragaas |2|5|24|
English: Peace and tranquility, poise and pleasure, have welled up within my mind; millions of suns, O Nanak, illuminate me. ||2||5||24||

[Ang 717 | Raag: Raag Todee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: ttoddee mahalaa 5 |
English: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ॥
Transliteration: har har patit paavan |
English: The Lord, Har, Har, is the Purifier of sinners;

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮਾਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਮਨ ਕੋ ਭਾਵਨ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jeea praan maan sukhadaataa antarajaamee man ko bhaavan | rahaau |
English: He is the soul, the breath of life, the Giver of peace and honor, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts; He is pleasing to my mind. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਸਭ ਬੇਤਾ ਰਿਦ ਦਾਸ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਭਗਤ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਨ ॥
Transliteration: sundar sugharr chatur sabh betaa rid daas nivaas bhagat gun gaavan |
English: He is beautiful and wise, clever and all-knowing. He dwells within the hearts of His slaves; His devotees sing His Glorious Praises.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੂਪ ਅਨੂਪ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਰਮ ਭੂਮਿ ਬੀਜਨ ਸੋ ਖਾਵਨ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: niramal roop anoop suaamee karam bhoom beejan so khaavan |1|
English: His form is immaculate and pure; He is the incomparable Lord and Master. Upon the field of actions and karma, whatever one plants, one eats. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਿਸਮਨ ਬਿਸਮ ਭਏ ਬਿਸਮਾਦਾ ਆਨ ਨ ਬੀਓ ਦੂਸਰ ਲਾਵਨ ॥
Transliteration: bisaman bisam bhe bisamaadaa aan na beeo doosar laavan |
English: I am amazed, and wonder-struck by His wonder. There is none other than Him.

Gurbani: ਰਸਨਾ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਜੀਵਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਦਾ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਵਨ ॥੨॥੬॥੨੫॥
Transliteration: rasanaa simar simar jas jeevaa naanak daas sadaa bal jaavan |2|6|25|
English: Meditating in remembrance on His Praises with my tongue, I live; slave Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||6||25||

[Ang 717 | Raag: Raag Todee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: ttoddee mahalaa 5 |
English: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਾਈ ਮਾਇਆ ਛਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: maaee maaeaa chhal |
English: O my mother, Maya is so misleading and deceptive.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਕੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਮੇਘ ਕੀ ਛਾਇਆ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਹੜ ਕਾ ਜਲੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: trin kee agan megh kee chhaaeaa gobid bhajan bin harr kaa jal | rahaau |
English: Without meditating on the Lord of the Universe, it is like straw on fire, or the shadow of a cloud, or the running of the flood-waters. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਛੋਡਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਬਹੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਸਾਧ ਮਗਿ ਚਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: chhodd siaanap bahu chaturaaee due kar jorr saadh mag chal |
English: Renounce your cleverness and all your mental tricks; with your palms pressed together, walk on the Path of the Holy Saints.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਦੇਹ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਊਤਮ ਫਲੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: simar suaamee antarajaamee maanukh deh kaa ihu aootam fal |1|
English: Remember the Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts; this is the most sublime reward of this human incarnation. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬੇਦ ਬਖਿਆਨ ਕਰਤ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਭਾਗਹੀਨ ਸਮਝਤ ਨਹੀ ਖਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: bed bakhiaan karat saadhoo jan bhaagaheen samajhat nahee khal |
English: The Holy Saints preach the teachings of the Vedas, but the unfortunate fools do not understand them.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਾਚੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਦਹਨ ਭਏ ਮਲ ॥੨॥੭॥੨੬॥
Transliteration: prem bhagat raache jan naanak har simaran dehan bhe mal |2|7|26|
English: Servant Nanak is absorbed in loving devotional worship; meditating in remembrance on the Lord, one's dirt is burnt away. ||2||7||26||

[Ang 717 | Raag: Raag Todee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: ttoddee mahalaa 5 |
English: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਾਈ ਚਰਨ ਗੁਰ ਮੀਠੇ ॥
Transliteration: maaee charan gur meetthe |
English: O mother, the Guru's feet are so sweet.

Gurbani: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਕੋਟਿ ਫਲਾ ਦਰਸਨ ਗੁਰ ਡੀਠੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: vaddai bhaag devai paramesar kott falaa darasan gur ddeetthe | rahaau |
English: By great good fortune, the Transcendent Lord has blessed me with them. Millions of rewards come from the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਅਚੁਤ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਮਦ ਢੀਠੇ ॥
Transliteration: gun gaavat achut abinaasee kaam krodh binase mad dteetthe |
English: Singing the Glorious Praises of the imperishable, indestructible Lord, sexual desire, anger and stubborn pride vanish.

Gurbani: ਅਸਥਿਰ ਭਏ ਸਾਚ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਬਾਹੁਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਪੀਠੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: asathir bhe saach rang raate janam maran baahur nahee peetthe |1|
English: Those who are imbued with the Love of the True Lord become permanent and eternal; birth and death do not grind them down any more. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨ ਰੰਗ ਰਸ ਜੇਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਦਇਆਲ ਜਾਨੇ ਸਭਿ ਝੂਠੇ ॥
Transliteration: bin har bhajan rang ras jete sant deaal jaane sabh jhootthe |
English: Without the Lord's meditation, all joys and pleasures are totally false and worthless; by the Kind Mercy of the Saints, I know this.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਚਲੇ ਸਭਿ ਮੂਠੇ ॥੨॥੮॥੨੭॥
Transliteration: naam ratan paaeo jan naanak naam bihoon chale sabh mootthe |2|8|27|
English: Servant Nanak has found the jewel of the Naam; without the Naam, all must depart, cheated and plundered. ||2||8||27||

[Ang 717 | Raag: Raag Todee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: ttoddee mahalaa 5 |
English: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਿਤਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang har har naam chitaaraa |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I contemplate the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜਿ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਅੰਕੁਰੁ ਭਲੋ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj anand hovai din raatee ankur bhalo hamaaraa | rahaau |
English: I am in peaceful poise and bliss, day and night; the seed of my destiny has sprouted. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur pooraa bhettio baddabhaagee jaa ko ant na paaraavaaraa |
English: I have met the True Guru, by great good fortune; He has no end or limitation.

Gurbani: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੀਓ ਜਨੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kar geh kaadt leeo jan apunaa bikh saagar sansaaraa |1|
English: Taking His humble servant by the hand, He pulls him out of the poisonous world-ocean. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕਾਟੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਸੰਕਟ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: janam maran kaatte gur bachanee bahurr na sankatt duaaraa |
English: Birth and death are ended for me, by the Word of the Guru's Teachings; I shall no longer pass through the door of pain and suffering.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੀ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੀ ਪੁਨਹ ਪੁਨਹ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਾ ॥੨॥੯॥੨੮॥
Transliteration: naanak saran gahee suaamee kee punah punah namasakaaraa |2|9|28|
English: Nanak holds tight to the Sanctuary of his Lord and Master; again and again, he bows in humility and reverence to Him. ||2||9||28||

[Ang 717 | Raag: Raag Todee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: ttoddee mahalaa 5 |
English: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਾਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕੋ ਸੁਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: maaee mere man ko sukh |
English: O my mother, my mind is at peace.

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਅਨੰਦ ਰਾਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਭੁਗਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਸਭ ਦੁਖੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kott anand raaj sukh bhugavai har simarat binasai sabh dukh |1| rahaau |
English: I enjoy the ecstasy of millions of princely pleasures; remembering the Lord in meditation, all pains have been dispelled. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਨਾਸਹਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਤਨ ਮਨ ਸੁਖ ॥
Transliteration: kott janam ke kilabikh naaseh simarat paavan tan man sukh |
English: The sins of millions of lifetimes are erased, by meditating on the Lord; becoming pure, my mind and body have found peace.

Gurbani: ਦੇਖਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਭਈ ਆਸਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਉਤਰੀ ਭੁਖ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dekh saroop pooran bhee aasaa darasan bhettat utaree bhukh |1|
English: Gazing upon the Lord's form of perfect beauty, my hopes have been fulfilled; attaining the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, my hunger has been appeased. ||1||

Gurbani: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਅਸਟ ਮਹਾ ਸਿਧਿ ਕਾਮਧੇਨੁ ਪਾਰਜਾਤ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੁਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: chaar padaarath asatt mahaa sidh kaamadhen paarajaat har har rukh |
English: The four great blessings, the eight supernatural spiritual powers of the Siddhas, the wish-fulfilling Elysian cow, and the wish-fulfilling tree of life - all these come from the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੀ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਫਿਰਿ ਗਰਭ ਨ ਧੁਖੁ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੨੯॥
Transliteration: naanak saran gahee sukh saagar janam maran fir garabh na dhukh |2|10|29|
English: O Nanak, holding tight to the Sanctuary of the Lord, the ocean of peace, you shall not suffer the pains of birth and death, or fall into the womb of reincarnation again. ||2||10||29||

[Ang 718 | Raag: Raag Todee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: ttoddee mahalaa 5 |
English: Todee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਰਿਦੈ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har har charan ridai ur dhaare |
English: I have enshrined the Lord's Feet within my heart.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਫਲ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: simar suaamee satigur apunaa kaaraj safal hamaare |1| rahaau |
English: Contemplating my Lord and Master, my True Guru, all my affairs have been resolved. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਪੂਜਾ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: pun daan poojaa paramesur har keerat tat beechaare |
English: The merits of giving donations to charity and devotional worship come from the Kirtan of the Praises of the Transcendent Lord; this is the true essence of wisdom.

Gurbani: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਅਤੁਲ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gun gaavat atul sukh paaeaa tthaakur agam apaare |1|
English: Singing the Praises of the unapproachable, infinite Lord and Master, I have found immeasurable peace. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਅਪਨੇ ਕੀਨੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਬਾਹੁਰਿ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jo jan paarabraham apane keene tin kaa baahur kachh na beechaare |
English: The Supreme Lord God does not consider the merits and demerits of those humble beings whom He makes His own.
