Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਸੁਨਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੰਠ ਮਝਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੩੦॥
Transliteration: naam ratan sun jap jap jeevaa har naanak kantth majhaare |2|11|30|
English: Hearing, chanting and meditating on the jewel of the Naam, I live; Nanak wears the Lord as his necklace. ||2||11||30||

[Ang 718 | Raag: Raag Todee | Author: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji]
Gurbani: ਟੋਡੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: ttoddee mahalaa 9 |
English: Todee, Ninth Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਕਹਉ ਕਹਾ ਅਪਨੀ ਅਧਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: khau kahaa apanee adhamaaee |
English: What can I say about my base nature?

Gurbani: ਉਰਝਿਓ ਕਨਕ ਕਾਮਨੀ ਕੇ ਰਸ ਨਹ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aurajhio kanak kaamanee ke ras neh keerat prabh gaaee |1| rahaau |
English: I am entangled in the love of gold and women, and I have not sung the Kirtan of God's Praises. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਗ ਝੂਠੇ ਕਉ ਸਾਚੁ ਜਾਨਿ ਕੈ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਰੁਚ ਉਪਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jag jhootthe kau saach jaan kai taa siau ruch upajaaee |
English: I judge the false world to be true, and I have fallen in love with it.

Gurbani: ਦੀਨ ਬੰਧ ਸਿਮਰਿਓ ਨਹੀ ਕਬਹੂ ਹੋਤ ਜੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: deen bandh simario nahee kabahoo hot ju sang sahaaee |1|
English: I have never contemplated the friend of the poor, who shall be my companion and helper in the end. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਗਨ ਰਹਿਓ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੈ ਨਿਸ ਦਿਨਿ ਛੁਟੀ ਨ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਕਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: magan rahio maaeaa mai nis din chhuttee na man kee kaaee |
English: I remain intoxicated by Maya, night and day, and the filth of my mind will not depart.

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਬ ਨਾਹਿ ਅਨਤ ਗਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥੨॥੧॥੩੧॥
Transliteration: keh naanak ab naeh anat gat bin har kee saranaaee |2|1|31|
English: Says Nanak, now, without the Lord's Sanctuary, I cannot find salvation in any other way. ||2||1||31||

[Ang 718 | Raag: Raag Todee | Author: Bhagat Namdev Ji]
Gurbani: ਟੋਡੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਾਂ ਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: ttoddee baanee bhagataan kee |
English: Todee, The Word Of The Devotees:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਬੋਲੈ ਨਿਰਵਾ ਕੋਈ ਬੋਲੈ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: koee bolai niravaa koee bolai door |
English: Some say that He is near, and others say that He is far away.

Gurbani: ਜਲ ਕੀ ਮਾਛੁਲੀ ਚਰੈ ਖਜੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jal kee maachhulee charai khajoor |1|
English: We might just as well say that the fish climbs out of the water, up the tree. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਾਂਇ ਰੇ ਬਕਬਾਦੁ ਲਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: kaane re bakabaad laaeo |
English: Why do you speak such nonsense?

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਓ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਛਪਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jin har paaeo tineh chhapaaeo |1| rahaau |
English: One who has found the Lord, keeps quiet about it. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਬੇਦੁ ਬਖਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: panddit hoe kai bed bakhaanai |
English: Those who become Pandits, religious scholars, recite the Vedas,

Gurbani: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਰਾਮਹਿ ਜਾਨੈ ॥੨॥੧॥
Transliteration: moorakh naamadeo raameh jaanai |2|1|
English: but foolish Naam Dayv knows only the Lord. ||2||1||

Gurbani: ਕਉਨ ਕੋ ਕਲੰਕੁ ਰਹਿਓ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਤ ਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: kaun ko kalank rahio raam naam let hee |
English: Whose blemishes remain, when one chants the Lord's Name?

Gurbani: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵਿਤ ਭਏ ਰਾਮੁ ਕਹਤ ਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: patit pavit bhe raam kehat hee |1| rahaau |
English: Sinners become pure, chanting the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਤਗਿਆ ਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: raam sang naamadev jan kau pratagiaa aaee |
English: With the Lord, servant Naam Dayv has come to have faith.

Gurbani: ਏਕਾਦਸੀ ਬ੍ਰਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਤੀਰਥ ਜਾੲਂੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ekaadasee brat rahai kaahe kau teerath jaaenee |1|
English: I have stopped fasting on the eleventh day of each month; why should I bother to go on pilgrimages to sacred shrines? ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਨਤਿ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਭਏ ॥
Transliteration: bhanat naamadeo sukrit sumat bhe |
English: Prays Naam Dayv, I have become a man of good deeds and good thoughts.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਕਹਿ ਕੋ ਕੋ ਨ ਬੈਕੁੰਠਿ ਗਏ ॥੨॥੨॥
Transliteration: guramat raam keh ko ko na baikuntth ge |2|2|
English: Chanting the Lord's Name, under Guru's Instructions, who has not gone to heaven? ||2||2||

[Ang 718 | Raag: Raag Todee | Author: Bhagat Namdev Ji]
Gurbani: ਤੀਨਿ ਛੰਦੇ ਖੇਲੁ ਆਛੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: teen chhande khel aachhai |1| rahaau |
English: Here is a verse with a three-fold play on words. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕੁੰਭਾਰ ਕੇ ਘਰ ਹਾਂਡੀ ਆਛੈ ਰਾਜਾ ਕੇ ਘਰ ਸਾਂਡੀ ਗੋ ॥
Transliteration: kunbhaar ke ghar haanddee aachhai raajaa ke ghar saanddee go |
English: In the potter's home there are pots, and in the king's home there are camels.

Gurbani: ਬਾਮਨ ਕੇ ਘਰ ਰਾਂਡੀ ਆਛੈ ਰਾਂਡੀ ਸਾਂਡੀ ਹਾਂਡੀ ਗੋ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: baaman ke ghar raanddee aachhai raanddee saanddee haanddee go |1|
English: In the Brahmin's home there are widows. So here they are: haandee, saandee, raandee. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਾਣੀਏ ਕੇ ਘਰ ਹੀਂਗੁ ਆਛੈ ਭੈਸਰ ਮਾਥੈ ਸੀਂਗੁ ਗੋ ॥
Transliteration: baanee ke ghar heeng aachhai bhaisar maathai seeng go |
English: In the home of the grocer there is asafoetida; on the forehead of the buffalo there are horns.

Gurbani: ਦੇਵਲ ਮਧੇ ਲੀਗੁ ਆਛੈ ਲੀਗੁ ਸੀਗੁ ਹੀਗੁ ਗੋ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: deval madhe leeg aachhai leeg seeg heeg go |2|
English: In the temple of Shiva there are lingams. So here they are: heeng, seeng, leeng. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੇਲੀ ਕੈ ਘਰ ਤੇਲੁ ਆਛੈ ਜੰਗਲ ਮਧੇ ਬੇਲ ਗੋ ॥
Transliteration: telee kai ghar tel aachhai jangal madhe bel go |
English: In the house of the oil-presser there is oil; in the forest there are vines.

Gurbani: ਮਾਲੀ ਕੇ ਘਰ ਕੇਲ ਆਛੈ ਕੇਲ ਬੇਲ ਤੇਲ ਗੋ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: maalee ke ghar kel aachhai kel bel tel go |3|
English: In the gardener's home there are bananas. So here they are: tayl, bayl, kayl. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਾਂ ਮਧੇ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਆਛੈ ਗੋਕਲ ਮਧੇ ਸਿਆਮ ਗੋ ॥
Transliteration: santaan madhe gobind aachhai gokal madhe siaam go |
English: The Lord of the Universe, Govind, is within His Saints; Krishna, Shyaam, is in Gokal.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੇ ਮਧੇ ਰਾਮੁ ਆਛੈ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਆਮ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੋ ॥੪॥੩॥
Transliteration: naame madhe raam aachhai raam siaam gobind go |4|3|
English: The Lord, Raam, is in Naam Dayv. So here they are: Raam, Shyaam, Govind. ||4||3||

[Ang 719 | Raag: Raag Bairaaree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਬੈਰਾੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: raag bairaarree mahalaa 4 ghar 1 dupade |
English: Raag Bairaaree, Fourth Mehl, First House, Dho-Padhay:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸੁਨਿ ਮਨ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sun man akath kathaa har naam |
English: Listen, O mind, to the Unspoken Speech of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਰਿਧਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਭਜੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ridh budh sidh sukh paaveh bhaj guramat har raam raam |1| rahaau |
English: Riches, wisdom, supernatural spiritual powers and peace are obtained, by vibrating, meditating on the Lord God, under Guru's Instruction. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਾ ਖਿਆਨ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਜਸੁ ਊਤਮ ਖਟ ਦਰਸਨ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: naanaa khiaan puraan jas aootam khatt darasan gaaveh raam |
English: Numerous legends, the Puraanas, and the six Shaastras, sing the sublime Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੰਕਰ ਕ੍ਰੋੜਿ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਮਰਮਾਮ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sankar krorr tetees dhiaaeo nahee jaanio har maramaam |1|
English: Shiva and the three hundred thirty million gods meditate on the Lord, but they do not know the secret of His mystery. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਗਣ ਗੰਧ੍ਰਬ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਭ ਗਾਵਤ ਜੇਤ ਉਪਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sur nar gan gandhrab jas gaaveh sabh gaavat jet upaam |
English: The angelic and divine beings, and the celestial singers sing His Praises; all Creation sings of Him.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਭਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak kripaa karee har jin kau te sant bhale har raam |2|1|
English: O Nanak, those whom the Lord blesses with His Kind Mercy, become the good Saints of the Lord God. ||2||1||

[Ang 719 | Raag: Raag Bairaaree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਬੈਰਾੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: bairaarree mahalaa 4 |
English: Bairaaree, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: man mil sant janaa jas gaaeo |
English: O mind, those who meet the Lord's humble servants, sing His Praises.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨੀਕੋ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦਿਵਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har har ratan ratan har neeko gur satigur daan divaaeo |1| rahaau |
English: They are blessed with the gift of the jewel of the Lord, Har, Har, the sublime jewel of the Lord, by the Guru, the True Guru. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਦੇਵਉ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: tis jan kau man tan sabh devau jin har har naam sunaaeo |
English: I offer my mind, body and everything to that humble being who recites the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੰਪੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਵਉ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਤੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dhan maaeaa sanpai tis devau jin har meet milaaeo |1|
English: I offer my wealth, the riches of Maya and my property to that one who leads me to meet the Lord, my friend. ||1||

Gurbani: ਖਿਨੁ ਕਿੰਚਿਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਜਗਦੀਸਰਿ ਤਬ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਧਿਆਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: khin kinchit kripaa karee jagadeesar tab har har har jas dhiaaeo |
English: When the Lord of the world bestowed just a tiny bit of His Mercy, for just an instant, then I meditated on the Praise of the Lord, Har, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਵਾਇਓ ॥੨॥੨॥
Transliteration: jan naanak kau har bhette suaamee dukh haumai rog gavaaeo |2|2|
English: The Lord and Master has met servant Nanak, and the pain of the sickness of egotism has been eliminated. ||2||2||

[Ang 719 | Raag: Raag Bairaaree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਬੈਰਾੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: bairaarree mahalaa 4 |
English: Bairaaree, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: har jan raam naam gun gaavai |
English: The Lord's humble servant sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ਨਿੰਦ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਗੁਨੁ ਨ ਗਵਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: je koee nind kare har jan kee apunaa gun na gavaavai |1| rahaau |
English: Even if someone slanders the Lord's humble servant, he does not give up his own goodness. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jo kichh kare su aape suaamee har aape kaar kamaavai |
English: Whatever the Lord and Master does, He does by Himself; the Lord Himself does the deeds.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਬੋਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har aape hee mat devai suaamee har aape bol bulaavai |1|
English: The Lord and Master Himself imparts understanding; the Lord Himself inspires us to speak. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਬਿਸਥਾਰਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਧਾਤੂ ਪੰਚ ਆਪਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: har aape panch tat bisathaaraa vich dhaatoo panch aap paavai |
English: The Lord Himself directs the evolution of the world of the five elements; He Himself infuses the five senses into it.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਝਗਰੁ ਚੁਕਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੩॥
Transliteration: jan naanak satigur mele aape har aape jhagar chukaavai |2|3|
English: O servant Nanak, the Lord Himself unites us with the True Guru; He Himself resolves the conflicts. ||2||3||

[Ang 720 | Raag: Raag Bairaaree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਬੈਰਾੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: bairaarree mahalaa 4 |
English: Bairaaree, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jap man raam naam nisataaraa |
English: Chant the Name of the Lord, O mind, and you shall be emancipated.

Gurbani: ਕੋਟ ਕੋਟੰਤਰ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਸਭਿ ਖੋਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kott kottantar ke paap sabh khovai har bhavajal paar utaaraa |1| rahaau |
English: The Lord shall destroy all the sins of millions upon millions of incarnations, and carry you across the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰਿ ਬਸਤ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa nagar basat har suaamee har nirbhau niravair nirankaaraa |
English: In the body-village, the Lord Master abides; the Lord is without fear, without vengeance, and without form.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਬਸਤ ਕਛੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਧਾ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har nikatt basat kachh nadar na aavai har laadhaa gur veechaaraa |1|
English: The Lord is dwelling near at hand, but He cannot be seen. By the Guru's Teachings, the Lord is obtained. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਰਾਫੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਹੀਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਕੀਆ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har aape saahu saraaf ratan heeraa har aap keea paasaaraa |
English: The Lord Himself is the banker, the jeweller, the jewel, the gem; the Lord Himself created the entire expanse of the creation.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਹਾਝੇ ਸੋ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਚਾ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ॥੨॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak jis kripaa kare su har naam vihaajhe so saahu sachaa vanajaaraa |2|4|
English: O Nanak, one who is blessed by the Lord's Kind Mercy, trades in the Lord's Name; He alone is the true banker, the true trader. ||2||4||

[Ang 720 | Raag: Raag Bairaaree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਬੈਰਾੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: bairaarree mahalaa 4 |
English: Bairaaree, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jap man har niranjan nirankaaraa |
English: Meditate, O mind, on the immaculate, formless Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa har dhiaaeeai sukhadaataa jaa kaa ant na paaraavaaraa |1| rahaau |
English: Forever and ever, meditate on the Lord, the Giver of peace; He has no end or limitation. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਗਨਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਮਹਿ ਉਰਧ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਉਦਰ ਮੰਝਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: agan kuntt meh uradh liv laagaa har raakhai udar manjhaaraa |
English: In the fiery pit of the womb, when you were hanging upside-down, the Lord absorbed You in His Love, and preserved You.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਛਡਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: so aisaa har sevahu mere man har ant chhaddaavanahaaraa |1|
English: So serve such a Lord, O my mind; the Lord shall deliver you in the end. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਸਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai hiradai basiaa meraa har har tis jan kau karahu namasakaaraa |
English: Bow down in reverence to that humble being, within whose heart the Lord, Har, Har, abides.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੨॥੫॥
Transliteration: har kirapaa te paaeeai har jap naanak naam adhaaraa |2|5|
English: By the Lord's Kind Mercy, O Nanak, one obtains the Lord's meditation, and the support of the Naam. ||2||5||

[Ang 720 | Raag: Raag Bairaaree | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਬੈਰਾੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: bairaarree mahalaa 4 |
English: Bairaaree, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: jap man har har naam nit dhiaae |
English: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; meditate on it continually.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਇਛਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo ichheh soee fal paaveh fir dookh na laagai aae |1| rahaau |
English: You shall obtain the fruits of your heart's desires, and pain shall never touch you again. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਜਪੁ ਸੋ ਤਪੁ ਸਾ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਪੂਜਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: so jap so tap saa brat poojaa jit har siau preet lagaae |
English: That is chanting, that is deep meditation and austerity, that is fasting and worship, which inspires love for the Lord.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹੋਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਭ ਝੂਠੀ ਇਕ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਸਰਿ ਸਭ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bin har preet hor preet sabh jhootthee ik khin meh bisar sabh jaae |1|
English: Without the Lord's Love, every other love is false; in an instant, it is all forgotten. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਸਰਬ ਕਲ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: too beant sarab kal pooraa kichh keemat kahee na jaae |
English: You are infinite, the Master of all power; Your value cannot be described at all.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੨॥੬॥
Transliteration: naanak saran tumaaree har jeeo bhaavai tivai chhaddaae |2|6|
English: Nanak has come to Your Sanctuary, O Dear Lord; as it pleases You, save him. ||2||6||

[Ang 720 | Raag: Raag Bairaaree | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਬੈਰਾੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raag bairaarree mahalaa 5 ghar 1 |
English: Raag Bairaaree, Fifth Mehl, First House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: sant janaa mil har jas gaaeo |
English: Meeting with the humble Saints, sing the Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਦੂਖ ਗਵਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kott janam ke dookh gavaaeo |1| rahaau |
English: The pains of millions of incarnations shall be eradicated. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਚਾਹਤ ਸੋਈ ਮਨਿ ਪਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: jo chaahat soee man paaeo |
English: Whatever your mind desires, that you shall obtain.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿਵਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa har naam divaaeo |1|
English: By His Kind Mercy, the Lord blesses us with His Name. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sarab sookh har naam vaddaaee |
English: All happiness and greatness are in the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥੧॥੭॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad naanak mat paaee |2|1|7|
English: By Guru's Grace, Nanak has gained this understanding. ||2||1||7||

[Ang 721 | Raag: Raag Tilang | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raag tilang mahalaa 1 ghar 1 |
English: Raag Tilang, First Mehl, First House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirbhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibhan gur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

Gurbani: ਯਕ ਅਰਜ ਗੁਫਤਮ ਪੇਸਿ ਤੋ ਦਰ ਗੋਸ ਕੁਨ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: yak araj gufatam pes to dar gos kun karataar |
English: I offer this one prayer to You; please listen to it, O Creator Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਕਾ ਕਬੀਰ ਕਰੀਮ ਤੂ ਬੇਐਬ ਪਰਵਦਗਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: hakaa kabeer kareem too beaib paravadagaar |1|
English: You are true, great, merciful and spotless, O Cherisher Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਮੁਕਾਮੇ ਫਾਨੀ ਤਹਕੀਕ ਦਿਲ ਦਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: duneea mukaame faanee tahakeek dil daanee |
English: The world is a transitory place of mortality - know this for certain in your mind.

Gurbani: ਮਮ ਸਰ ਮੂਇ ਅਜਰਾਈਲ ਗਿਰਫਤਹ ਦਿਲ ਹੇਚਿ ਨ ਦਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mam sar mooe ajaraaeel girafatah dil hech na daanee |1| rahaau |
English: Azraa-eel, the Messenger of Death, has caught me by the hair on my head, and yet, I do not know it at all in my mind. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਪਿਸਰ ਪਦਰ ਬਿਰਾਦਰਾਂ ਕਸ ਨੇਸ ਦਸਤੰਗੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: jan pisar padar biraadaraan kas nes dasatangeer |
English: Spouse, children, parents and siblings - none of them will be there to hold your hand.

Gurbani: ਆਖਿਰ ਬਿਅਫਤਮ ਕਸ ਨ ਦਾਰਦ ਚੂੰ ਸਵਦ ਤਕਬੀਰ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aakhir biafatam kas na daarad choon savad takabeer |2|
English: And when at last I fall, and the time of my last prayer has come, there shall be no one to rescue me. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਬ ਰੋਜ ਗਸਤਮ ਦਰ ਹਵਾ ਕਰਦੇਮ ਬਦੀ ਖਿਆਲ ॥
Transliteration: sab roj gasatam dar havaa karadem badee khiaal |
English: Night and day, I wandered around in greed, contemplating evil schemes.

Gurbani: ਗਾਹੇ ਨ ਨੇਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਦਮ ਮਮ ੲਂੀ ਚਿਨੀ ਅਹਵਾਲ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gaahe na nekee kaar karadam mam enee chinee ahavaal |3|
English: I never did good deeds; this is my condition. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬਦਬਖਤ ਹਮ ਚੁ ਬਖੀਲ ਗਾਫਿਲ ਬੇਨਜਰ ਬੇਬਾਕ ॥
Transliteration: badabakhat ham chu bakheel gaafil benajar bebaak |
English: I am unfortunate, miserly, negligent, shameless and without the Fear of God.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬੁਗੋਯਦ ਜਨੁ ਤੁਰਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਚਾਕਰਾਂ ਪਾ ਖਾਕ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak bugoyad jan turaa tere chaakaraan paa khaak |4|1|
English: Says Nanak, I am Your humble servant, the dust of the feet of Your slaves. ||4||1||

[Ang 721 | Raag: Raag Tilang | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: tilang mahalaa 1 ghar 2 |
English: Tilang, First Mehl, Second House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਭਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਂਗ ਖਲੜੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਚੀਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: bhau teraa bhaang khalarree meraa cheet |
English: The Fear of You, O Lord God, is my marijuana; my consciousness is the pouch which holds it.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਦੇਵਾਨਾ ਭਇਆ ਅਤੀਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: mai devaanaa bheaa ateet |
English: I have become an intoxicated hermit.

Gurbani: ਕਰ ਕਾਸਾ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਭੂਖ ॥
Transliteration: kar kaasaa darasan kee bhookh |
English: My hands are my begging bowl; I am so hungry for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਦਰਿ ਮਾਗਉ ਨੀਤਾ ਨੀਤ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mai dar maagau neetaa neet |1|
English: I beg at Your Door, day after day. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਕਰਉ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: tau darasan kee krau samaae |
English: I long for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਦਰਿ ਮਾਗਤੁ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mai dar maagat bheekhiaa paae |1| rahaau |
English: I am a beggar at Your Door - please bless me with Your charity. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕੇਸਰਿ ਕੁਸਮ ਮਿਰਗਮੈ ਹਰਣਾ ਸਰਬ ਸਰੀਰੀ ਚੜੑਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: kesar kusam miragamai haranaa sarab sareeree charranaa |
English: Saffron, flowers, musk oil and gold embellish the bodies of all.

Gurbani: ਚੰਦਨ ਭਗਤਾ ਜੋਤਿ ਇਨੇਹੀ ਸਰਬੇ ਪਰਮਲੁ ਕਰਣਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: chandan bhagataa jot inehee sarabe paramal karanaa |2|
English: The Lord's devotees are like sandalwood, which imparts its fragrance to everyone. ||2||

Gurbani: ਘਿਅ ਪਟ ਭਾਂਡਾ ਕਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: ghia patt bhaanddaa kahai na koe |
English: No one says that ghee or silk are polluted.

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਭਗਤੁ ਵਰਨ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa bhagat varan meh hoe |
English: Such is the Lord's devotee, no matter what his social status is.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵੇ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: terai naam nive rahe liv laae |
English: Those who bow in reverence to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, remain absorbed in Your Love.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਦਰਿ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਪਾਇ ॥੩॥੧॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak tin dar bheekhiaa paae |3|1|2|
English: Nanak begs for charity at their door. ||3||1||2||

[Ang 721 | Raag: Raag Tilang | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: tilang mahalaa 1 ghar 3 |
English: Tilang, First Mehl, Third House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਪਾਹਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਲੀਤੜਾ ਲਬਿ ਰੰਗਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: eihu tan maaeaa paahiaa piaare leetarraa lab rangaae |
English: This body fabric is conditioned by Maya, O beloved; this cloth is dyed in greed.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੈ ਕੰਤ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਚੋਲੜਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕਿਉ ਧਨ ਸੇਜੈ ਜਾਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: merai kant na bhaavai cholarraa piaare kiau dhan sejai jaae |1|
English: My Husband Lord is not pleased by these clothes, O Beloved; how can the soul-bride go to His bed? ||1||

Gurbani: ਹੰਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੈ ਜਾਉ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨਾ ਹੰਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hnau kurabaanai jaau miharavaanaa hnau kurabaanai jaau |
English: I am a sacrifice, O Dear Merciful Lord; I am a sacrifice to You.

Gurbani: ਹੰਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੈ ਜਾਉ ਤਿਨਾ ਕੈ ਲੈਨਿ ਜੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hnau kurabaanai jaau tinaa kai lain jo teraa naau |
English: I am a sacrifice to those who take to Your Name.

Gurbani: ਲੈਨਿ ਜੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ਤਿਨਾ ਕੈ ਹੰਉ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੈ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: lain jo teraa naau tinaa kai hnau sad kurabaanai jaau |1| rahaau |
English: Unto those who take to Your Name, I am forever a sacrifice. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਰੰਙਣਿ ਜੇ ਥੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਉ ਮਜੀਠ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa rangan je theeai piaare paaeeai naau majeetth |
English: If the body becomes the dyer's vat, O Beloved, and the Name is placed within it as the dye,

Gurbani: ਰੰਙਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਜੇ ਰੰਙੈ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਐਸਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਡੀਠ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: rangan vaalaa je rangai saahib aisaa rang na ddeetth |2|
English: and if the Dyer who dyes this cloth is the Lord Master - O, such a color has never been seen before! ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਚੋਲੇ ਰਤੜੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕੰਤੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਕੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: jin ke chole ratarre piaare kant tinaa kai paas |
English: Those whose shawls are so dyed, O Beloved, their Husband Lord is always with them.

Gurbani: ਧੂੜਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਕੀ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਜੀ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: dhoorr tinaa kee je milai jee kahu naanak kee aradaas |3|
English: Bless me with the dust of those humble beings, O Dear Lord. Says Nanak, this is my prayer. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਜੇ ਆਪੇ ਰੰਗੇ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: aape saaje aape range aape nadar karee |
English: He Himself creates, and He Himself imbues us. He Himself bestows His Glance of Grace.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਕੰਤੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਰਾਵੇਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak kaaman kantai bhaavai aape hee raavee |4|1|3|
English: O Nanak, if the soul-bride becomes pleasing to her Husband Lord, He Himself enjoys her. ||4||1||3||

[Ang 722 | Raag: Raag Tilang | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: tilang mahalaa 1 |
English: Tilang, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਇਆਨੜੀਏ ਮਾਨੜਾ ਕਾਇ ਕਰੇਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: eaanarree maanarraa kaae karehi |
English: O foolish and ignorant soul-bride, why are you so proud?

Gurbani: ਆਪਨੜੈ ਘਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੋ ਕੀ ਨ ਮਾਣੇਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: aapanarrai ghar har rango kee na maanehi |
English: Within the home of your own self, why do you not enjoy the Love of your Lord?

Gurbani: ਸਹੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਧਨ ਕੰਮਲੀਏ ਬਾਹਰੁ ਕਿਆ ਢੂਢੇਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: sahu nerrai dhan kamalee baahar kiaa dtoodtehi |
English: Your Husband Lord is so very near, O foolish bride; why do you search for Him outside?

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਕੀਆ ਦੇਹਿ ਸਲਾਈਆ ਨੈਣੀ ਭਾਵ ਕਾ ਕਰਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: bhai keea dehi salaaeea nainee bhaav kaa kar seegaaro |
English: Apply the Fear of God as the maascara to adorn your eyes, and make the Love of the Lord your ornament.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਲਾਗੀ ਜਾ ਸਹੁ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: taa sohaagan jaaneeai laagee jaa sahu dhare piaaro |1|
English: Then, you shall be known as a devoted and committed soul-bride, when you enshrine love for your Husband Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਇਆਣੀ ਬਾਲੀ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਜਾ ਧਨ ਕੰਤ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: eaanee baalee kiaa kare jaa dhan kant na bhaavai |
English: What can the silly young bride do, if she is not pleasing to her Husband Lord?

Gurbani: ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਹ ਕਰੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: karan palaah kare bahutere saa dhan mehal na paavai |
English: She may plead and implore so many times, but still, such a bride shall not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਹੀ ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰਾ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: vin karamaa kichh paaeeai naahee je bahuteraa dhaavai |
English: Without the karma of good deeds, nothing is obtained, although she may run around frantically.

Gurbani: ਲਬ ਲੋਭ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ਕੀ ਮਾਤੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: lab lobh ahankaar kee maatee maaeaa maeh samaanee |
English: She is intoxicated with greed, pride and egotism, and engrossed in Maya.

Gurbani: ਇਨੀ ਬਾਤੀ ਸਹੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਹੀ ਭਈ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਇਆਣੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: einee baatee sahu paaeeai naahee bhee kaaman eaanee |2|
English: She cannot obtain her Husband Lord in these ways; the young bride is so foolish! ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਾਇ ਪੁਛਹੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਵਾਹੈ ਕਿਨੀ ਬਾਤੀ ਸਹੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: jaae puchhahu sohaaganee vaahai kinee baatee sahu paaeeai |
English: Go and ask the happy, pure soul-brides, how did they obtain their Husband Lord?

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਭਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੀਐ ਹਿਕਮਤਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: jo kichh kare so bhalaa kar maaneeai hikamat hukam chukaaeeai |
English: Whatever the Lord does, accept that as good; do away with your own cleverness and self-will.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਤਉ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai prem padaarath paaeeai tau charanee chit laaeeai |
English: By His Love, true wealth is obtained; link your consciousness to His lotus feet.

Gurbani: ਸਹੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੋ ਕੀਜੈ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੋ ਦੀਜੈ ਐਸਾ ਪਰਮਲੁ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: sahu kahai so keejai tan mano deejai aisaa paramal laaeeai |
English: As your Husband Lord directs, so you must act; surrender your body and mind to Him, and apply this perfume to yourself.

Gurbani: ਏਵ ਕਹਹਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਭੈਣੇ ਇਨੀ ਬਾਤੀ ਸਹੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ev kaheh sohaaganee bhaine inee baatee sahu paaeeai |3|
English: So speaks the happy soul-bride, O sister; in this way, the Husband Lord is obtained. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ਤਾ ਸਹੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਉਰੁ ਕੈਸੀ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aap gavaaeeai taa sahu paaeeai aaur kaisee chaturaaee |
English: Give up your selfhood, and so obtain your Husband Lord; what other clever tricks are of any use?

Gurbani: ਸਹੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਸੋ ਦਿਨੁ ਲੇਖੈ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sahu nadar kar dekhai so din lekhai kaaman nau nidh paaee |
English: When the Husband Lord looks upon the soul-bride with His Gracious Glance, that day is historic - the bride obtains the nine treasures.

Gurbani: ਆਪਣੇ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਸਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾ ਸਭਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aapane kant piaaree saa sohaagan naanak saa sabharaaee |
English: She who is loved by her Husband Lord, is the true soul-bride; O Nanak, she is the queen of all.

Gurbani: ਐਸੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਹਜ ਕੀ ਮਾਤੀ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭਾਇ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: aisai rang raatee sehaj kee maatee ahinis bhaae samaanee |
English: Thus she is imbued with His Love, intoxicated with delight; day and night, she is absorbed in His Love.

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਸਾਇ ਸਰੂਪ ਬਿਚਖਣਿ ਕਹੀਐ ਸਾ ਸਿਆਣੀ ॥੪॥੨॥੪॥
Transliteration: sundar saae saroop bichakhan kaheeai saa siaanee |4|2|4|
English: She is beautiful, glorious and brilliant; she is known as truly wise. ||4||2||4||

[Ang 722 | Raag: Raag Tilang | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: tilang mahalaa 1 |
English: Tilang, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੀ ਮੈ ਆਵੈ ਖਸਮ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਤੈਸੜਾ ਕਰੀ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਵੇ ਲਾਲੋ ॥
Transliteration: jaisee mai aavai khasam kee baanee taisarraa karee giaan ve laalo |
English: As the Word of the Forgiving Lord comes to me, so do I express it, O Lalo.

Gurbani: ਪਾਪ ਕੀ ਜੰਞ ਲੈ ਕਾਬਲਹੁ ਧਾਇਆ ਜੋਰੀ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਵੇ ਲਾਲੋ ॥
Transliteration: paap kee jany lai kaabalahu dhaaeaa joree mangai daan ve laalo |
English: Bringing the marriage party of sin, Babar has invaded from Kaabul, demanding our land as his wedding gift, O Lalo.

Gurbani: ਸਰਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਦੁਇ ਛਪਿ ਖਲੋਏ ਕੂੜੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਵੇ ਲਾਲੋ ॥
Transliteration: saram dharam due chhap khaloe koorr firai paradhaan ve laalo |
English: Modesty and righteousness both have vanished, and falsehood struts around like a leader, O Lalo.

Gurbani: ਕਾਜੀਆ ਬਾਮਣਾ ਕੀ ਗਲ ਥਕੀ ਅਗਦੁ ਪੜੈ ਸੈਤਾਨੁ ਵੇ ਲਾਲੋ ॥
Transliteration: kaajeea baamanaa kee gal thakee agad parrai saitaan ve laalo |
English: The Qazis and the Brahmins have lost their roles, and Satan now conducts the marriage rites, O Lalo.

Gurbani: ਮੁਸਲਮਾਨੀਆ ਪੜਹਿ ਕਤੇਬਾ ਕਸਟ ਮਹਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਵੇ ਲਾਲੋ ॥
Transliteration: musalamaaneea parreh katebaa kasatt meh kareh khudaae ve laalo |
English: The Muslim women read the Koran, and in their misery, they call upon God, O Lalo.

Gurbani: ਜਾਤਿ ਸਨਾਤੀ ਹੋਰਿ ਹਿਦਵਾਣੀਆ ਏਹਿ ਭੀ ਲੇਖੈ ਲਾਇ ਵੇ ਲਾਲੋ ॥
Transliteration: jaat sanaatee hor hidavaaneea ehi bhee lekhai laae ve laalo |
English: The Hindu women of high social status, and others of lowly status as well, are put into the same category, O Lalo.

Gurbani: ਖੂਨ ਕੇ ਸੋਹਿਲੇ ਗਾਵੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਤੁ ਕਾ ਕੁੰਗੂ ਪਾਇ ਵੇ ਲਾਲੋ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: khoon ke sohile gaaveeeh naanak rat kaa kungoo paae ve laalo |1|
English: The wedding songs of murder are sung, O Nanak, and blood is sprinkled instead of saffron, O Lalo. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਮਾਸ ਪੁਰੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਖੁ ਮਸੋਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: saahib ke gun naanak gaavai maas puree vich aakh masolaa |
English: Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord and Master in the city of corpses, and voices this account.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਵਾਈ ਬੈਠਾ ਵੇਖੈ ਵਖਿ ਇਕੇਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: jin upaaee rang ravaaee baitthaa vekhai vakh ikelaa |
English: The One who created, and attached the mortals to pleasures, sits alone, and watches this.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਸੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਤਪਾਵਸੁ ਸਚੜਾ ਨਿਆਉ ਕਰੇਗੁ ਮਸੋਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa so saahib sach tapaavas sacharraa niaau kareg masolaa |
English: The Lord and Master is True, and True is His justice. He issues His Commands according to His judgement.

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਪੜੁ ਟੁਕੁ ਟੁਕੁ ਹੋਸੀ ਹਿਦੁਸਤਾਨੁ ਸਮਾਲਸੀ ਬੋਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa kaparr ttuk ttuk hosee hidusataan samaalasee bolaa |
English: The body-fabric will be torn apart into shreds, and then India will remember these words.

Gurbani: ਆਵਨਿ ਅਠਤਰੈ ਜਾਨਿ ਸਤਾਨਵੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਭੀ ਉਠਸੀ ਮਰਦ ਕਾ ਚੇਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: aavan atthatarai jaan sataanavai hor bhee utthasee marad kaa chelaa |
English: Coming in seventy-eight (1521 A.D.), they will depart in ninety-seven (1540 A.D.), and then another disciple of man will rise up.

Gurbani: ਸਚ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਸੀ ਸਚ ਕੀ ਬੇਲਾ ॥੨॥੩॥੫॥
Transliteration: sach kee baanee naanak aakhai sach sunaaeisee sach kee belaa |2|3|5|
English: Nanak speaks the Word of Truth; he proclaims the Truth at this, the right time. ||2||3||5||

[Ang 723 | Raag: Raag Tilang | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: tilang mahalaa 4 ghar 2 |
English: Tilang, Fourth Mehl, Second House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਆਏ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਖਸਮਾਹੁ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਭ ਵਰਤਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: sabh aae hukam khasamaahu hukam sabh varatanee |
English: Everyone comes by Command of the Lord and Master. The Hukam of His Command extends to all.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sach saahib saachaa khel sabh har dhanee |1|
English: True is the Lord and Master, and True is His play. The Lord is the Master of all. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਾਲਾਹਿਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: saalaahihu sach sabh aoopar har dhanee |
English: So praise the True Lord; the Lord is the Master over all.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ਸਰੀਕੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਲੇਖੈ ਹਉ ਗਨੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jis naahee koe sareek kis lekhai hau ganee | rahaau |
English: No one is equal to Him; am I of any account? ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪਉਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਧਰਤੀ ਆਕਾਸੁ ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਹਰਿ ਬਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: paun paanee dharatee aakaas ghar mandar har banee |
English: Air, water, earth and sky - the Lord has made these His home and temple.

Gurbani: ਵਿਚਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਝੂਠੁ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਗਨੀ ॥੨॥੧॥
Transliteration: vich varatai naanak aap jhootth kahu kiaa ganee |2|1|
English: He Himself is pervading everywhere, O Nanak. Tell me: what can be counted as false? ||2||1||

[Ang 723 | Raag: Raag Tilang | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: tilang mahalaa 4 |
English: Tilang, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ਬਫਾਵੈ ਦੁਰਮਤੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: nit nihafal karam kamaae bafaavai duramateea |
English: The evil-minded person continually does fruitless deeds, all puffed up with pride.

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਆਣੈ ਵਲਵੰਚ ਕਰਿ ਝੂਠੁ ਤਬ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਗੁ ਜਿਤੀਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jab aanai valavanch kar jhootth tab jaanai jag jiteea |1|
English: When he brings home what he has acquired, by practicing deception and falsehood, he thinks that he has conquered the world. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਬਾਜੀ ਸੈਸਾਰੁ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa baajee saisaar na chetai har naamaa |
English: Such is the drama of the world, that he does not contemplate the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਸਭੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਧਿਆਇ ਰਾਮਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: khin meh binasai sabh jhootth mere man dhiaae raamaa | rahaau |
English: In an instant, all this false play shall perish; O my mind, meditate on the Lord. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਵੇਲਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਆਇ ਕੰਟਕੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਗ੍ਰਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: saa velaa chit na aavai jit aae kanttak kaal grasai |
English: He does not think of that time, when Death, the Torturer, shall come and seize him.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸੈ ॥੨॥੨॥
Transliteration: tis naanak le chhaddaae jis kirapaa kar hiradai vasai |2|2|
English: O Nanak, the Lord saves that one, within whose heart the Lord, in His Kind Mercy, dwells. ||2||2||

[Ang 723 | Raag: Raag Tilang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: tilang mahalaa 5 ghar 1 |
English: Tilang, Fifth Mehl, First House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਖਾਕ ਨੂਰ ਕਰਦੰ ਆਲਮ ਦੁਨੀਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: khaak noor karadan aalam duneeae |
English: The Lord infused His Light into the dust, and created the world, the universe.

Gurbani: ਅਸਮਾਨ ਜਿਮੀ ਦਰਖਤ ਆਬ ਪੈਦਾਇਸਿ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: asamaan jimee darakhat aab paidaaeis khudaae |1|
English: The sky, the earth, the trees, and the water - all are the Creation of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬੰਦੇ ਚਸਮ ਦੀਦੰ ਫਨਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bande chasam deedan fanaae |
English: O human being, whatever you can see with your eyes, shall perish.

Gurbani: ਦੁਨਂੀਆ ਮੁਰਦਾਰ ਖੁਰਦਨੀ ਗਾਫਲ ਹਵਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dunaneea muradaar khuradanee gaafal havaae | rahaau |
English: The world eats dead carcasses, living by neglect and greed. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੈਬਾਨ ਹੈਵਾਨ ਹਰਾਮ ਕੁਸਤਨੀ ਮੁਰਦਾਰ ਬਖੋਰਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gaibaan haivaan haraam kusatanee muradaar bakhoraae |
English: Like a goblin, or a beast, they kill and eat the forbidden carcasses of meat.

Gurbani: ਦਿਲ ਕਬਜ ਕਬਜਾ ਕਾਦਰੋ ਦੋਜਕ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: dil kabaj kabajaa kaadaro dojak sajaae |2|
English: So control your urges, or else you will be seized by the Lord, and thrown into the tortures of hell. ||2||

Gurbani: ਵਲੀ ਨਿਆਮਤਿ ਬਿਰਾਦਰਾ ਦਰਬਾਰ ਮਿਲਕ ਖਾਨਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: valee niaamat biraadaraa darabaar milak khaanaae |
English: Your benefactors, presents, companions, courts, lands and homes

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਅਜਰਾਈਲੁ ਬਸਤਨੀ ਤਬ ਚਿ ਕਾਰੇ ਬਿਦਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jab ajaraaeel basatanee tab chi kaare bidaae |3|
English: - when Azraa-eel, the Messenger of Death seizes you, what good will these be to you then? ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਵਾਲ ਮਾਲੂਮੁ ਕਰਦੰ ਪਾਕ ਅਲਾਹ ॥
Transliteration: havaal maaloom karadan paak alaah |
English: The Pure Lord God knows your condition.

Gurbani: ਬੁਗੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਪੇਸਿ ਦਰਵੇਸ ਬੰਦਾਹ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: bugo naanak aradaas pes daraves bandaah |4|1|
English: O Nanak, recite your prayer to the holy people. ||4||1||

[Ang 723 | Raag: Raag Tilang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: tilang ghar 2 mahalaa 5 |
English: Tilang, Second House, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: tudh bin doojaa naahee koe |
English: There is no other than You, Lord.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: too karataar kareh so hoe |
English: You are the Creator; whatever You do, that alone happens.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਜੋਰੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਮਨਿ ਟੇਕ ॥
Transliteration: teraa jor teree man ttek |
English: You are the strength, and You are the support of the mind.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa jap naanak ek |1|
English: Forever and ever, meditate, O Nanak, on the One. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sabh aoopar paarabraham daataar |
English: The Great Giver is the Supreme Lord God over all.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: teree ttek teraa aadhaar | rahaau |
English: You are our support, You are our sustainer. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹੈ ਤੂਹੈ ਤੂ ਹੋਵਨਹਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: hai toohai too hovanahaar |
English: You are, You are, and You shall ever be,

Gurbani: ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਊਚ ਆਪਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: agam agaadh aooch aapaar |
English: O inaccessible, unfathomable, lofty and infinite Lord.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਭਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jo tudh seveh tin bhau dukh naeh |
English: Those who serve You, are not touched by fear or suffering.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur parasaad naanak gun gaeh |2|
English: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਰੂਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: jo deesai so teraa roop |
English: Whatever is seen, is Your form, O treasure of virtue,

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਅਨੂਪ ॥
Transliteration: gun nidhaan govind anoop |
English: O Lord of the Universe, O Lord of incomparable beauty.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਜਨ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: simar simar simar jan soe |
English: Remembering, remembering, remembering the Lord in meditation, His humble servant becomes like Him.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak karam paraapat hoe |3|
English: O Nanak, by His Grace, we obtain Him. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: jin japiaa tis kau balihaar |
English: I am a sacrifice to those who meditate on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: tis kai sang tarai sansaar |
English: Associating with them, the whole world is saved.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਲੋਚਾ ਪੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak prabh lochaa poor |
English: Says Nanak, God fulfills our hopes and aspirations.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਛਉ ਧੂਰਿ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: sant janaa kee baachhau dhoor |4|2|
English: I long for the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||4||2||

[Ang 724 | Raag: Raag Tilang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: tilang mahalaa 5 ghar 3 |
English: Tilang, Fifth Mehl, Third House:

Gurbani: ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ॥ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: miharavaan saahib miharavaan | saahib meraa miharavaan |
English: Merciful, the Lord Master is Merciful. My Lord Master is Merciful.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਸਗਲ ਕਉ ਦੇਇ ਦਾਨੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jeea sagal kau dee daan | rahaau |
English: He gives His gifts to all beings. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਕਾਹੇ ਡੋਲਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਰਾਖੈਗਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: too kaahe ddoleh praaneea tudh raakhaigaa sirajanahaar |
English: Why do you waver, O mortal being? The Creator Lord Himself shall protect you.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਪੈਦਾਇਸਿ ਤੂ ਕੀਆ ਸੋਈ ਦੇਇ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jin paidaaeis too keea soee dee aadhaar |1|
English: He who created you, will also give you nourishment. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਮੇਦਨੀ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਦਾ ਸਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: jin upaaee medanee soee karadaa saar |
English: The One who created the world, takes care of it.

Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਮਾਲਕੁ ਦਿਲਾ ਕਾ ਸਚਾ ਪਰਵਦਗਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt maalak dilaa kaa sachaa paravadagaar |2|
English: In each and every heart and mind, the Lord is the True Cherisher. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਵਡਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: kudarat keem na jaaneeai vaddaa veparavaahu |
English: His creative potency and His value cannot be known; He is the Great and carefree Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਬੰਦੇ ਤੂ ਬੰਦਗੀ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਘਟ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਹੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kar bande too bandagee jichar ghatt meh saahu |3|
English: O human being, meditate on the Lord, as long as there is breath in your body. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਅਕਥੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: too samarath akath agochar jeeo pindd teree raas |
English: O God, You are all-powerful, inexpressible and imperceptible; my soul and body are Your capital.

Gurbani: ਰਹਮ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੩॥
Transliteration: reham teree sukh paaeaa sadaa naanak kee aradaas |4|3|
English: By Your Mercy, may I find peace; this is Nanak's lasting prayer. ||4||3||

[Ang 724 | Raag: Raag Tilang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: tilang mahalaa 5 ghar 3 |
English: Tilang, Fifth Mehl, Third House:

Gurbani: ਕਰਤੇ ਕੁਦਰਤੀ ਮੁਸਤਾਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: karate kudaratee musataak |
English: O Creator, through Your creative potency, I am in love with You.

Gurbani: ਦੀਨ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਏਕ ਤੂਹੀ ਸਭ ਖਲਕ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਪਾਕੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: deen duneea ek toohee sabh khalak hee te paak | rahaau |
English: You alone are my spiritual and temporal Lord; and yet, You are detached from all Your creation. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਖਿਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਦਾ ਆਚਰਜ ਤੇਰੇ ਰੂਪ ॥
Transliteration: khin maeh thaap uthaapadaa aacharaj tere roop |
English: In an instant, You establish and disestablish. Wondrous is Your form!

Gurbani: ਕਉਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਚਲਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੇ ਮਹਿ ਦੀਪ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kaun jaanai chalat tere andhiaare meh deep |1|
English: Who can know Your play? You are the Light in the darkness. ||1||

Gurbani: ਖੁਦਿ ਖਸਮ ਖਲਕ ਜਹਾਨ ਅਲਹ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: khud khasam khalak jahaan alah miharavaan khudaae |
English: You are the Master of Your creation, the Lord of all the world, O Merciful Lord God.

Gurbani: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਜਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਅਰਾਧੇ ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਦੋਜਕਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: dinas rain ji tudh araadhe so kiau dojak jaae |2|
English: One who worships You day and night - why should he have to go to hell? ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਜਰਾਈਲੁ ਯਾਰੁ ਬੰਦੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: ajaraaeel yaar bande jis teraa aadhaar |
English: Azraa-eel, the Messenger of Death, is the friend of the human being who has Your support, Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਨਹ ਉਸ ਕੇ ਸਗਲ ਆਫੂ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਦੀਦਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gunah us ke sagal aafoo tere jan dekheh deedaar |3|
English: His sins are all forgiven; Your humble servant gazes upon Your Vision. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਚੀਜ ਫਿਲਹਾਲ ਸਗਲੇ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: duneea cheej filahaal sagale sach sukh teraa naau |
English: All worldly considerations are for the present only. True peace comes only from Your Name.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬੂਝਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਏਕਸੁ ਗਾਉ ॥੪॥੪॥
Transliteration: gur mil naanak boojhiaa sadaa ekas gaau |4|4|
English: Meeting the Guru, Nanak understands; He sings only Your Praises forever, O Lord. ||4||4||

[Ang 724 | Raag: Raag Tilang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: tilang mahalaa 5 |
English: Tilang, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੀਰਾਂ ਦਾਨਾਂ ਦਿਲ ਸੋਚ ॥
Transliteration: meeraan daanaan dil soch |
English: Think of the Lord in your mind, O wise one.

Gurbani: ਮੁਹਬਤੇ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਸੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹ ਬੰਦੀ ਮੋਚ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: muhabate man tan basai sach saah bandee moch |1| rahaau |
English: Enshrine love for the True Lord in your mind and body; He is the Liberator from bondage. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦੀਦਨੇ ਦੀਦਾਰ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਇਸ ਕਾ ਮੋਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: deedane deedaar saahib kachh nahee is kaa mol |
English: The value of seeing the Vision of the Lord Master cannot be estimated.

Gurbani: ਪਾਕ ਪਰਵਦਗਾਰ ਤੂ ਖੁਦਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਵਡਾ ਅਤੋਲੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: paak paravadagaar too khud khasam vaddaa atol |1|
English: You are the Pure Cherisher; You Yourself are the great and immeasurable Lord and Master. ||1||

Gurbani: ਦਸ੍ਤਗੀਰੀ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਿਲਾਵਰ ਤੂਹੀ ਤੂਹੀ ਏਕ ॥
Transliteration: dastageeree dehi dilaavar toohee toohee ek |
English: Give me Your help, O brave and generous Lord; You are the One, You are the Only Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਰਤਾਰ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਰਣ ਖਾਲਕ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ॥੨॥੫॥
Transliteration: karataar kudarat karan khaalak naanak teree ttek |2|5|
English: O Creator Lord, by Your creative potency, You created the world; Nanak holds tight to Your support. ||2||5||

[Ang 724 | Raag: Raag Tilang | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: tilang mahalaa 1 ghar 2 |
English: Tilang, First Mehl, Second House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jin keea tin dekhiaa kiaa kaheeai re bhaaee |
English: The One who created the world watches over it; what more can we say, O Siblings of Destiny?

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਵਾੜੀ ਹੈ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aape jaanai kare aap jin vaarree hai laaee |1|
English: He Himself knows, and He Himself acts; He laid out the garden of the world. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਇਸਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕਾ ਰਾਇਸਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raaeisaa piaare kaa raaeisaa jit sadaa sukh hoee | rahaau |
English: Savor the story, the story of the Beloved Lord, which brings a lasting peace. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਸਾ ਪਛੋ ਰੇ ਤਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: jin rang kant na raaviaa saa pachho re taanee |
English: She who does not enjoy the Love of her Husband Lord, shall come to regret and repent in the end.

Gurbani: ਹਾਥ ਪਛੋੜੈ ਸਿਰੁ ਧੁਣੈ ਜਬ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: haath pachhorrai sir dhunai jab rain vihaanee |2|
English: She wrings her hands, and bangs her head, when the night of her life has passed away. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪਛੋਤਾਵਾ ਨਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਬ ਚੂਕੈਗੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: pachhotaavaa naa milai jab chookaigee saaree |
English: Nothing comes from repentance, when the game is already finished.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਰਾਵੀਐ ਜਬ ਆਵੈਗੀ ਵਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: taa fir piaaraa raaveeai jab aavaigee vaaree |3|
English: She shall have the opportunity to enjoy her Beloved, only when her turn comes again. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕੰਤੁ ਲੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਮੈ ਤੇ ਵਧਵੀ ਏਹ ॥
Transliteration: kant leea sohaaganee mai te vadhavee eh |
English: The happy soul-bride attains her Husband Lord - she is so much better than I am.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਗੁਣ ਮੁਝੈ ਨ ਆਵਨੀ ਕੈ ਜੀ ਦੋਸੁ ਧਰੇਹ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: se gun mujhai na aavanee kai jee dos dhareh |4|
English: I have none of her merits or virtues; whom should I blame? ||4||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਪੂਛਉਗੀ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jinee sakhee sahu raaviaa tin poochhaugee jaae |
English: I shall go and ask those sisters who have enjoyed their Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਪਾਇ ਲਗਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕਰਉ ਲੇਉਗੀ ਪੰਥੁ ਬਤਾਏ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: paae lgau benatee krau leaugee panth bataae |5|
English: I touch their feet, and ask them to show me the Path. ||5||

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਭਉ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: hukam pachhaanai naanakaa bhau chandan laavai |
English: She who understands the Hukam of His Command, O Nanak, applies the Fear of God as her sandalwood oil;

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਕਾਮਣ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਕਰੈ ਤਉ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕਉ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: gun kaaman kaaman karai tau piaare kau paavai |6|
English: she charms her Beloved with her virtue, and so obtains Him. ||6||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਦਿਲਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਰੇ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jo dil miliaa su mil rahiaa miliaa kaheeai re soee |
English: She who meets her Beloved in her heart, remains united with Him; this is truly called union.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰਾ ਲੋਚੀਐ ਬਾਤੀ ਮੇਲੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: je bahuteraa locheeai baatee mel na hoee |7|
English: As much as she may long for Him, she shall not meet Him through mere words. ||7||

Gurbani: ਧਾਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਫੁਨਿ ਧਾਤੁ ਕਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਿਵੈ ਕਉ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: dhaat milai fun dhaat kau liv livai kau dhaavai |
English: As metal melts into metal again, so does love melt into love.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਤਉ ਅਨਭਉ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee jaaneeai tau anbhau paavai |8|
English: By Guru's Grace, this understanding is obtained, and then, one obtains the Fearless Lord. ||8||

Gurbani: ਪਾਨਾ ਵਾੜੀ ਹੋਇ ਘਰਿ ਖਰੁ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: paanaa vaarree hoe ghar khar saar na jaanai |
English: There may be an orchard of betel nut trees in the garden, but the donkey does not appreciate its value.

Gurbani: ਰਸੀਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੁਸਕ ਕਾ ਤਬ ਫੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: raseea hovai musak kaa tab fool pachhaanai |9|
English: If someone savors a fragrance, then he can truly appreciate its flower. ||9||

Gurbani: ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀਵੈ ਜੋ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: apiau peevai jo naanakaa bhram bhram samaavai |
English: One who drinks in the ambrosia, O Nanak, abandons his doubts and wanderings.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਅਮਰਾ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧੦॥੧॥
Transliteration: sahaje sahaje mil rahai amaraa pad paavai |10|1|
English: Easily and intuitively, he remains blended with the Lord, and obtains the immortal status. ||10||1||

[Ang 725 | Raag: Raag Tilang | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: tilang mahalaa 4 |
English: Tilang, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਕਥਾ ਕਹਾਣੀਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੀਤਿ ਸੁਣਾਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: har keea kathaa kahaaneea gur meet sunaaeea |
English: The Guru, my friend, has told me the stories and the sermon of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: balihaaree gur aapane gur kau bal jaaeea |1|
English: I am a sacrifice to my Guru; to the Guru, I am a sacrifice. ||1||

Gurbani: ਆਇ ਮਿਲੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੁ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aae mil gurasikh aae mil too mere guroo ke piaare | rahaau |
English: Come, join with me, O Sikh of the Guru, come and join with me. You are my Guru's Beloved. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵਦੇ ਸੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: har ke gun har bhaavade se guroo te paae |
English: The Glorious Praises of the Lord are pleasing to the Lord; I have obtained them from the Guru.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਘੁਮਿ ਘੁਮਿ ਜਾਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jin gur kaa bhaanaa maniaa tin ghum ghum jaae |2|
English: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to those who surrender to, and obey the Guru's Will. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jin satigur piaaraa dekhiaa tin kau hau vaaree |
English: I am dedicated and devoted to those who gaze upon the Beloved True Guru.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕੀਤੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jin gur kee keetee chaakaree tin sad balihaaree |3|
English: I am forever a sacrifice to those who perform service for the Guru. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਦੁਖ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har har teraa naam hai dukh mettanahaaraa |
English: Your Name, O Lord, Har, Har, is the Destroyer of sorrow.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: gur sevaa te paaeeai guramukh nisataaraa |4|
English: Serving the Guru, it is obtained, and as Gurmukh, one is emancipated. ||4||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo har naam dhiaaeide te jan paravaanaa |
English: Those humble beings who meditate on the Lord's Name, are celebrated and acclaimed.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: tin vittahu naanak vaariaa sadaa sadaa kurabaanaa |5|
English: Nanak is a sacrifice to them, forever and ever a devoted sacrifice. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: saa har teree usatat hai jo har prabh bhaavai |
English: O Lord, that alone is Praise to You, which is pleasing to Your Will, O Lord God.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: jo guramukh piaaraa sevade tin har fal paavai |6|
English: Those Gurmukhs, who serve their Beloved Lord, obtain Him as their reward. ||6||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਪਿਰਹੜੀ ਤਿਨਾ ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: jinaa har setee piraharree tinaa jeea prabh naale |
English: Those who cherish love for the Lord, their souls are always with God.

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਜੀਵਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: oe jap jap piaaraa jeevade har naam samaale |7|
English: Chanting and meditating on their Beloved, they live in, and gather in, the Lord's Name. ||7||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਘੁਮਿ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jin guramukh piaaraa seviaa tin kau ghum jaaeaa |
English: I am a sacrifice to those Gurmukhs who serve their Beloved Lord.

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਆਪਿ ਛੁਟੇ ਪਰਵਾਰ ਸਿਉ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਛਡਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: oe aap chhutte paravaar siau sabh jagat chhaddaaeaa |8|
English: They themselves are saved, along with their families, and through them, all the world is saved. ||8||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਧੰਨੋ ॥
Transliteration: gur piaarai har seviaa gur dhan gur dhano |
English: My Beloved Guru serves the Lord. Blessed is the Guru, Blessed is the Guru.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦਸਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਵਡ ਪੁੰਨੋ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: gur har maarag dasiaa gur pun vadd puno |9|
English: The Guru has shown me the Lord's Path; the Guru has done the greatest good deed. ||9||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਸੇ ਪੁੰਨ ਪਰਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: jo gurasikh gur sevade se pun paraanee |
English: Those Sikhs of the Guru, who serve the Guru, are the most blessed beings.

Gurbani: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: jan naanak tin kau vaariaa sadaa sadaa kurabaanee |10|
English: Servant Nanak is a sacrifice to them; He is forever and ever a sacrifice. ||10||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀਆ ਸੇ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh sakhee saheleea se aap har bhaaeea |
English: The Lord Himself is pleased with the Gurmukhs, the fellowship of the companions.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਨਾਈਆ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਈਆ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: har daragah painaaeea har aap gal laaeea |11|
English: In the Lord's Court, they are given robes of honor, and the Lord Himself hugs them close in His embrace. ||11||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: jo guramukh naam dhiaaeide tin darasan deejai |
English: Please bless me with the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of those Gurmukhs, who meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਪਖਾਲਦੇ ਧੂੜਿ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੋਲਿ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: ham tin ke charan pakhaalade dhoorr ghol ghol peejai |12|
English: I wash their feet, and drink in the dust of their feet, dissolved in the wash water. ||12||

Gurbani: ਪਾਨ ਸੁਪਾਰੀ ਖਾਤੀਆ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੀੜੀਆ ਲਾਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: paan supaaree khaateea mukh beerreea laaeea |
English: Those who eat betel nuts and betel leaf and smoke intoxicants,

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਜਮਿ ਪਕੜਿ ਚਲਾਈਆ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: har har kade na chetio jam pakarr chalaaeea |13|
English: but do not contemplate the Lord, Har, Har - the Messenger of Death will seize them and take them away. ||13||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿਆ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jin har naamaa har chetiaa hiradai ur dhaare |
English: The Messenger of Death does not even approach those who contemplate the Name of the Lord, Har, Har,

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਗੁਰ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: tin jam nerr na aavee gurasikh gur piaare |14|
English: And keep Him enshrined in their hearts. The Guru's Sikhs are the Guru's Beloveds. ||14||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam nidhaan hai koee guramukh jaanai |
English: The Name of the Lord is a treasure, known only to the few Gurmukhs.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਣੈ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: naanak jin satigur bhettiaa rang raleea maanai |15|
English: O Nanak, those who meet with the True Guru, enjoy peace and pleasure. ||15||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਤੁਸਿ ਕਰੇ ਪਸਾਓ ॥
Transliteration: satigur daataa aakheeai tus kare pasaao |
English: The True Guru is called the Giver; in His Mercy, He grants His Grace.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਸਦ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਦਿਤੜਾ ਨਾਓ ॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: hau gur vittahu sad vaariaa jin ditarraa naao |16|
English: I am forever a sacrifice to the Guru, who has blessed me with the Lord's Name. ||16||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਇ ਸਨੇਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: so dhan guroo saabaas hai har dee sanehaa |
English: Blessed, very blessed is the Guru, who brings the Lord's message.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵੇਖਿ ਵੇਖਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਵਿਗਸਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੇਹਾ ॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: hau vekh vekh guroo vigasiaa gur satigur dehaa |17|
English: I gaze upon the Guru, the Guru, the True Guru embodied, and I blossom forth in bliss. ||17||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਰਸਨਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬੋਲਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur rasanaa amrit boladee har naam suhaavee |
English: The Guru's tongue recites Words of Ambrosial Nectar; He is adorned with the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਿਖਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਸਭ ਜਾਵੀ ॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: jin sun sikhaa gur maniaa tinaa bhukh sabh jaavee |18|
English: Those Sikhs who hear and obey the Guru - all their desires depart. ||18||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa maarag aakheeai kahu kit bidh jaaeeai |
English: Some speak of the Lord's Path; tell me, how can I walk on it?

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਖਰਚੁ ਲੈ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: har har teraa naam hai har kharach lai jaaeeai |19|
English: O Lord, Har, Har, Your Name is my supplies; I will take it with me and set out. ||19||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਸੇ ਸਾਹ ਵਡ ਦਾਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: jin guramukh har aaraadhiaa se saah vadd daane |
English: Those Gurmukhs who worship and adore the Lord, are wealthy and very wise.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: hau satigur kau sad vaariaa gur bachan samaane |20|
English: I am forever a sacrifice to the True Guru; I am absorbed in the Words of the Guru's Teachings. ||20||

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਤੂ ਸਾਹਿਬੋ ਤੂਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: too tthaakur too saahibo toohai meraa meeraa |
English: You are the Master, my Lord and Master; You are my Ruler and King.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਬੰਦਗੀ ਤੂ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰਾ ॥੨੧॥
Transliteration: tudh bhaavai teree bandagee too gunee gaheeraa |21|
English: If it is pleasing to Your Will, then I worship and serve You; You are the treasure of virtue. ||21||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਇਕ ਰੰਗੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: aape har ik rang hai aape bahu rangee |
English: The Lord Himself is absolute; He is The One and Only; but He Himself is also manifested in many forms.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਾਈ ਗਲ ਚੰਗੀ ॥੨੨॥੨॥
Transliteration: jo tis bhaavai naanakaa saaee gal changee |22|2|
English: Whatever pleases Him, O Nanak, that alone is good. ||22||2||

[Ang 726 | Raag: Raag Tilang | Author: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji]
Gurbani: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ਕਾਫੀ ॥
Transliteration: tilang mahalaa 9 kaafee |
English: Tilang, Ninth Mehl, Kaafee:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਚੇਤਨਾ ਹੈ ਤਉ ਚੇਤ ਲੈ ਨਿਸਿ ਦਿਨਿ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: chetanaa hai tau chet lai nis din mai praanee |
English: If you are conscious, then be conscious of Him night and day, O mortal.

Gurbani: ਛਿਨੁ ਛਿਨੁ ਅਉਧ ਬਿਹਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਫੂਟੈ ਘਟ ਜਿਉ ਪਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: chhin chhin aaudh bihaat hai foottai ghatt jiau paanee |1| rahaau |
English: Each and every moment, your life is passing away, like water from a cracked pitcher. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਕਾਹਿ ਨ ਗਾਵਹੀ ਮੂਰਖ ਅਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: har gun kaeh na gaavahee moorakh agiaanaa |
English: Why do you not sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, you ignorant fool?

Gurbani: ਝੂਠੈ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਕੈ ਨਹਿ ਮਰਨੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jhootthai laalach laag kai neh maran pachhaanaa |1|
English: You are attached to false greed, and you do not even consider death. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਜਹੂ ਕਛੁ ਬਿਗਰਿਓ ਨਹੀ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: ajahoo kachh bigario nahee jo prabh gun gaavai |
English: Even now, no harm has been done, if you will only sing God's Praises.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਹ ਭਜਨ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੧॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak tih bhajan te nirabhai pad paavai |2|1|
English: Says Nanak, by meditating and vibrating upon Him, you shall obtain the state of fearlessness. ||2||1||

[Ang 726 | Raag: Raag Tilang | Author: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji]
Gurbani: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: tilang mahalaa 9 |
English: Tilang, Ninth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਾਗ ਲੇਹੁ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਜਾਗ ਲੇਹੁ ਕਹਾ ਗਾਫਲ ਸੋਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jaag lehu re manaa jaag lehu kahaa gaafal soeaa |
English: Wake up, O mind! Wake up! Why are you sleeping unaware?

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤਨੁ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਸੰਗ ਹੀ ਸੋ ਭੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਹੋਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo tan upajiaa sang hee so bhee sang na hoeaa |1| rahaau |
English: That body, which you were born with, shall not go along with you in the end. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧ ਜਨ ਹਿਤੁ ਜਾ ਸਿਉ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: maat pitaa sut bandh jan hit jaa siau keenaa |
English: Mother, father, children and relatives whom you love,

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਛੂਟਿਓ ਜਬ ਦੇਹ ਤੇ ਡਾਰਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਮੈ ਦੀਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jeeo chhoottio jab deh te ddaar agan mai deenaa |1|
English: will throw your body into the fire, when your soul departs from it. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਤ ਲਉ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਜਗ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਜਾਨਉ ॥
Transliteration: jeevat lau biauhaar hai jag kau tum jaanau |
English: Your worldly affairs exist only as long as you are alive; know this well.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਲੈ ਸਭ ਸੁਫਨ ਸਮਾਨਉ ॥੨॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak har gun gaae lai sabh sufan samaanau |2|2|
English: O Nanak, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; everything is like a dream. ||2||2||

[Ang 727 | Raag: Raag Tilang | Author: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji]
Gurbani: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: tilang mahalaa 9 |
English: Tilang, Ninth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਗਾਇ ਲੈ ਜੋ ਸੰਗੀ ਹੈ ਤੇਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: har jas re manaa gaae lai jo sangee hai tero |
English: Sing the Lord's Praises, O mind; He is your only true companion.

Gurbani: ਅਉਸਰੁ ਬੀਤਿਓ ਜਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਕਹਿਓ ਮਾਨ ਲੈ ਮੇਰੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aausar beetio jaat hai kahio maan lai mero |1| rahaau |
English: Your time is passing away; listen carefully to what I say. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੰਪਤਿ ਰਥ ਧਨ ਰਾਜ ਸਿਉ ਅਤਿ ਨੇਹੁ ਲਗਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: sanpat rath dhan raaj siau at nehu lagaaeo |
English: You are so in love with property, chariots, wealth and power.

Gurbani: ਕਾਲ ਫਾਸ ਜਬ ਗਲਿ ਪਰੀ ਸਭ ਭਇਓ ਪਰਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kaal faas jab gal paree sabh bheo paraaeo |1|
English: When the noose of death tightens around your neck, they will all belong to others. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਾਨਿ ਬੂਝ ਕੈ ਬਾਵਰੇ ਤੈ ਕਾਜੁ ਬਿਗਾਰਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: jaan boojh kai baavare tai kaaj bigaario |
English: Know this well, O madman - you have ruined your affairs.

Gurbani: ਪਾਪ ਕਰਤ ਸੁਕਚਿਓ ਨਹੀ ਨਹ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿਓ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: paap karat sukachio nahee neh garab nivaario |2|
English: You did not restrain yourself from committing sins, and you did not eradicate your ego. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਸੋ ਸੁਨੁ ਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jih bidh gur upadesiaa so sun re bhaaee |
English: So listen to the Teachings imparted by the Guru, O Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਤ ਪੁਕਾਰਿ ਕੈ ਗਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥੩॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak kehat pukaar kai gahu prabh saranaaee |3|3|
English: Nanak proclaims: hold tight to the Protection and the Sanctuary of God. ||3||3||

[Ang 727 | Raag: Raag Tilang | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: tilang baanee bhagataa kee kabeer jee |
English: Tilang, The Word Of Devotee Kabeer Jee:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਇਫਤਰਾ ਭਾਈ ਦਿਲ ਕਾ ਫਿਕਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bed kateb ifataraa bhaaee dil kaa fikar na jaae |
English: The Vedas and the Scriptures are only make-believe, O Siblings of Destiny; they do not relieve the anxiety of the heart.

Gurbani: ਟੁਕੁ ਦਮੁ ਕਰਾਰੀ ਜਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਾਜਿਰ ਹਜੂਰਿ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ttuk dam karaaree jau karahu haajir hajoor khudaae |1|
English: If you will only center yourself on the Lord, even for just a breath, then you shall see the Lord face-to-face, present before you. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬੰਦੇ ਖੋਜੁ ਦਿਲ ਹਰ ਰੋਜ ਨਾ ਫਿਰੁ ਪਰੇਸਾਨੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: bande khoj dil har roj naa fir paresaanee maeh |
English: O human being, search your own heart every day, and do not wander around in confusion.

Gurbani: ਇਹ ਜੁ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਸਿਹਰੁ ਮੇਲਾ ਦਸਤਗੀਰੀ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: eih ju duneea sihar melaa dasatageeree naeh |1| rahaau |
English: This world is just a magic-show; no one will be holding your hand. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦਰੋਗੁ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਖੁਸੀ ਹੋਇ ਬੇਖਬਰ ਬਾਦੁ ਬਕਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: darog parr parr khusee hoe bekhabar baad bakaeh |
English: Reading and studying falsehood, people are happy; in their ignorance, they speak nonsense.

Gurbani: ਹਕੁ ਸਚੁ ਖਾਲਕੁ ਖਲਕ ਮਿਆਨੇ ਸਿਆਮ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: hak sach khaalak khalak miaane siaam moorat naeh |2|
English: The True Creator Lord is diffused into His creation; He is not just the dark-skinned Krishna of legends. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਸਮਾਨ ਮੵਿਾਨੇ ਲਹੰਗ ਦਰੀਆ ਗੁਸਲ ਕਰਦਨ ਬੂਦ ॥
Transliteration: asamaan mayiaane lahang dareea gusal karadan bood |
English: Through the Tenth Gate, the stream of nectar flows; take your bath in this.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਫਕਰੁ ਦਾਇਮ ਲਾਇ ਚਸਮੇ ਜਹ ਤਹਾ ਮਉਜੂਦੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kar fakar daaeim laae chasame jeh tahaa maujood |3|
English: Serve the Lord forever; use your eyes, and see Him ever-present everywhere. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅਲਾਹ ਪਾਕੰ ਪਾਕ ਹੈ ਸਕ ਕਰਉ ਜੇ ਦੂਸਰ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: alaah paakan paak hai sak krau je doosar hoe |
English: The Lord is the purest of the pure; only through doubt could there be another.

Gurbani: ਕਬੀਰ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਰੀਮ ਕਾ ਉਹੁ ਕਰੈ ਜਾਨੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: kabeer karam kareem kaa uhu karai jaanai soe |4|1|
English: O Kabeer, mercy flows from the Merciful Lord; He alone knows who acts. ||4||1||

[Ang 727 | Raag: Raag Tilang | Author: Bhagat Namdev Ji]
Gurbani: ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: naamadev jee |
English: Naam Dayv Jee:

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਖੁੰਦਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: mai andhule kee ttek teraa naam khundakaaraa |
English: I am blind; Your Name, O Creator Lord, is my only anchor and support.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਗਰੀਬ ਮੈ ਮਸਕੀਨ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mai gareeb mai masakeen teraa naam hai adhaaraa |1| rahaau |
English: I am poor, and I am meek. Your Name is my only support. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਰੀਮਾਂ ਰਹੀਮਾਂ ਅਲਾਹ ਤੂ ਗਨਂੀ ॥
Transliteration: kareemaan raheemaan alaah too gananee |
English: O beautiful Lord, benevolent and merciful Lord, You are so wealthy and generous.

Gurbani: ਹਾਜਰਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਪੇਸਿ ਤੂੰ ਮਨਂੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: haajaraa hajoor dar pes toon mananee |1|
English: You are ever-present in every presence, within and before me. ||1||

Gurbani: ਦਰੀਆਉ ਤੂ ਦਿਹੰਦ ਤੂ ਬਿਸੀਆਰ ਤੂ ਧਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: dareeaau too dihand too biseeaar too dhanee |
English: You are the river of life, You are the Giver of all; You are so very wealthy.

Gurbani: ਦੇਹਿ ਲੇਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਤੂੰ ਦਿਗਰ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: dehi lehi ek toon digar ko nahee |2|
English: You alone give, and You alone take away; there is no other at all. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਨਾਂ ਤੂੰ ਬੀਨਾਂ ਮੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: toon daanaan toon beenaan mai beechaar kiaa karee |
English: You are wise, You are the supreme seer; how could I make You an object of thought?

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੇ ਚੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਬਖਸੰਦ ਤੂੰ ਹਰੀ ॥੩॥੧॥੨॥
Transliteration: naame che suaamee bakhasand toon haree |3|1|2|
English: O Lord and Master of Naam Dayv, You are the merciful Lord of forgiveness. ||3||1||2||

[Ang 727 | Raag: Raag Tilang | Author: Bhagat Namdev Ji]
Gurbani: ਹਲੇ ਯਾਰਾਂ ਹਲੇ ਯਾਰਾਂ ਖੁਸਿਖਬਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: hale yaaraan hale yaaraan khusikhabaree |
English: Hello, my friend, hello my friend. Is there any good news?

Gurbani: ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਂਉ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਂਉ ॥ ਨੀਕੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਿਗਾਰੀ ਆਲੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bal bal jaanau hau bal bal jaanau | neekee teree bigaaree aale teraa naau |1| rahaau |
English: I am a sacrifice, a devoted sacrifice, a dedicated and devoted sacrifice, to You. Slavery to You is so sublime; Your Name is noble and exalted. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕੁਜਾ ਆਮਦ ਕੁਜਾ ਰਫਤੀ ਕੁਜਾ ਮੇ ਰਵੀ ॥
Transliteration: kujaa aamad kujaa rafatee kujaa me ravee |
English: Where did you come from? Where have You been? And where are You going?

Gurbani: ਦ੍ਵਾਰਿਕਾ ਨਗਰੀ ਰਾਸਿ ਬੁਗੋਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dvaarikaa nagaree raas bugoee |1|
English: Tell me the truth, in the holy city of Dwaarikaa. ||1||

Gurbani: ਖੂਬੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਪਗਰੀ ਮੀਠੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਬੋਲ ॥
Transliteration: khoob teree pagaree meetthe tere bol |
English: How handsome is your turban! And how sweet is your speech.

Gurbani: ਦ੍ਵਾਰਿਕਾ ਨਗਰੀ ਕਾਹੇ ਕੇ ਮਗੋਲ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: dvaarikaa nagaree kaahe ke magol |2|
English: Why are there Moghals in the holy city of Dwaarikaa? ||2||

Gurbani: ਚੰਦਂੀ ਹਜਾਰ ਆਲਮ ਏਕਲ ਖਾਨਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: chandanee hajaar aalam ekal khaanaan |
English: You alone are the Lord of so many thousands of worlds.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਚਿਨੀ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਸਾਂਵਲੇ ਬਰਨਾਂ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ham chinee paatisaah saanvale baranaan |3|
English: You are my Lord King, like the dark-skinned Krishna. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅਸਪਤਿ ਗਜਪਤਿ ਨਰਹ ਨਰਿੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: asapat gajapat narah narind |
English: You are the Lord of the sun, Lord Indra and Lord Brahma, the King of men.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੇ ਕੇ ਸ੍ਵਾਮੀ ਮੀਰ ਮੁਕੰਦ ॥੪॥੨॥੩॥
Transliteration: naame ke svaamee meer mukand |4|2|3|
English: You are the Lord and Master of Naam Dayv, the King, the Liberator of all. ||4||2||3||

[Ang 728 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirbhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibhan gur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raag soohee mahalaa 1 chaupade ghar 1 |
English: Raag Soohee, First Mehl, Chau-Padhay, First House:

Gurbani: ਭਾਂਡਾ ਧੋਇ ਬੈਸਿ ਧੂਪੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਤਉ ਦੂਧੈ ਕਉ ਜਾਵਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: bhaanddaa dhoe bais dhoop devahu tau doodhai kau jaavahu |
English: Wash the vessel, sit down and anoint it with fragrance; then, go out and get the milk.

Gurbani: ਦੂਧੁ ਕਰਮ ਫੁਨਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਇਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਜਮਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: doodh karam fun surat samaaein hoe niraas jamaavahu |1|
English: Add the rennet of clear consciousness to the milk of good deeds, and then, free of desire, let it curdle. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਪਹੁ ਤ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: japahu ta eko naamaa |
English: Chant the Name of the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰਿ ਨਿਰਾਫਲ ਕਾਮਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: avar niraafal kaamaa |1| rahaau |
English: All other actions are fruitless. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਈਟੀ ਹਾਥਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਫੁਨਿ ਨੇਤ੍ਰਉ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: eihu man eettee haath karahu fun netrau need na aavai |
English: Let your mind be the handles, and then churn it, without sleeping.

Gurbani: ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਤਬ ਮਥੀਐ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: rasanaa naam japahu tab matheeai in bidh amrit paavahu |2|
English: If you chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord ,with your tongue, then the curd will be churned. In this way, the Ambrosial Nectar is obtained. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਸੰਪਟੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਤ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਵਣੁ ਭਾਵਨ ਪਾਤੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਕਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: man sanpatt jit sat sar naavan bhaavan paatee tripat kare |
English: Wash your mind in the pool of Truth, and let it be the vessel of the Lord; let this be your offering to please Him.

Gurbani: ਪੂਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜੇ ਸੇਵੇ ਇਨੑ ਬਿਧਿ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਰਵਤੁ ਰਹੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: poojaa praan sevak je seve ina bidh saahib ravat rahai |3|
English: That humble servant who dedicates and offers his life, and who serves in this way, remains absorbed in his Lord and Master. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹਦੇ ਕਹਹਿ ਕਹੇ ਕਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਸਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: kahade kaheh kahe keh jaaveh tum sar avar na koee |
English: The speakers speak and speak and speak, and then they depart. There is no other to compare to You.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਹੀਣੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਨੁ ਜੰਪੈ ਹਉ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: bhagat heen naanak jan janpai hau saalaahee sachaa soee |4|1|
English: Servant Nanak, lacking devotion, humbly prays: may I sing the Praises of the True Lord. ||4||1||

[Ang 728 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 1 ghar 2 |
English: Soohee, First Mehl, Second House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਨ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: antar vasai na baahar jaae |
English: Deep within the self, the Lord abides; do not go outside looking for Him.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: amrit chhodd kaahe bikh khaae |1|
English: You have renounced the Ambrosial Nectar - why are you eating poison? ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa giaan japahu man mere |
English: Meditate on such spiritual wisdom, O my mind,

Gurbani: ਹੋਵਹੁ ਚਾਕਰ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hovahu chaakar saache kere |1| rahaau |
English: and become the slave of the True Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਰਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: giaan dhiaan sabh koee ravai |
English: Everyone speaks of wisdom and meditation;

Gurbani: ਬਾਂਧਨਿ ਬਾਂਧਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਭਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: baandhan baandhiaa sabh jag bhavai |2|
English: but bound in bondage, the whole world is wandering around in confusion. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਚਾਕਰੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sevaa kare su chaakar hoe |
English: One who serves the Lord is His servant.

Gurbani: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jal thal maheeal rav rahiaa soe |3|
English: The Lord is pervading and permeating the water, the land, and the sky. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਨਹੀ ਚੰਗੇ ਬੁਰਾ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: ham nahee change buraa nahee koe |
English: I am not good; no one is bad.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਾਰੇ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੨॥
Transliteration: pranavat naanak taare soe |4|1|2|
English: Prays Nanak, He alone saves us! ||4||1||2||

[Ang 729 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੬ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 1 ghar 6 |
English: Soohee, First Mehl, Sixth House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਉਜਲੁ ਕੈਹਾ ਚਿਲਕਣਾ ਘੋਟਿਮ ਕਾਲੜੀ ਮਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: aujal kaihaa chilakanaa ghottim kaalarree mas |
English: Bronze is bright and shiny, but when it is rubbed, its blackness appears.

Gurbani: ਧੋਤਿਆ ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਜੇ ਸਉ ਧੋਵਾ ਤਿਸੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dhotiaa jootth na utarai je sau dhovaa tis |1|
English: Washing it, its impurity is not removed, even if it is washed a hundred times. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਜਣ ਸੇਈ ਨਾਲਿ ਮੈ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਚਲੰਨਿੑ ॥
Transliteration: sajan seee naal mai chaladiaa naal chalana |
English: They alone are my friends, who travel along with me;

Gurbani: ਜਿਥੈ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਤਿਥੈ ਖੜੇ ਦਿਸੰਨਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jithai lekhaa mangeeai tithai kharre disan |1| rahaau |
English: and in that place, where the accounts are called for, they appear standing with me. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕੋਠੇ ਮੰਡਪ ਮਾੜੀਆ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਚਿਤਵੀਆਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: kotthe manddap maarreea paasahu chitaveeaahaa |
English: There are houses, mansions and tall buildings, painted on all sides;

Gurbani: ਢਠੀਆ ਕੰਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਨੑੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਸਖਣੀਆਹਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: dtattheea kam na aavanaee vichahu sakhaneeaahaa |2|
English: but they are empty within, and they crumble like useless ruins. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬਗਾ ਬਗੇ ਕਪੜੇ ਤੀਰਥ ਮੰਝਿ ਵਸੰਨਿੑ ॥
Transliteration: bagaa bage kaparre teerath manjh vasana |
English: The herons in their white feathers dwell in the sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

Gurbani: ਘੁਟਿ ਘੁਟਿ ਜੀਆ ਖਾਵਣੇ ਬਗੇ ਨਾ ਕਹੀਅਨਿੑ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ghutt ghutt jeea khaavane bage naa kaheeana |3|
English: They tear apart and eat the living beings, and so they are not called white. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਿੰਮਲ ਰੁਖੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਮੈ ਮੈਜਨ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੁਲੰਨਿੑ ॥
Transliteration: sinmal rukh sareer mai maijan dekh bhulana |
English: My body is like the simmal tree; seeing me, other people are fooled.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਫਲ ਕੰਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਨੑੀ ਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਮੈ ਤਨਿ ਹੰਨਿੑ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: se fal kam na aavanaee te gun mai tan hana |4|
English: Its fruits are useless - just like the qualities of my body. ||4||

Gurbani: ਅੰਧੁਲੈ ਭਾਰੁ ਉਠਾਇਆ ਡੂਗਰ ਵਾਟ ਬਹੁਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: andhulai bhaar utthaaeaa ddoogar vaatt bahut |
English: The blind man is carrying such a heavy load, and his journey through the mountains is so long.

Gurbani: ਅਖੀ ਲੋੜੀ ਨਾ ਲਹਾ ਹਉ ਚੜਿ ਲੰਘਾ ਕਿਤੁ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: akhee lorree naa lahaa hau charr langhaa kit |5|
English: My eyes can see, but I cannot find the Way. How can I climb up and cross over the mountain? ||5||

Gurbani: ਚਾਕਰੀਆ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਅਵਰ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਕਿਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: chaakareea changiaaeea avar siaanap kit |
English: What good does it do to serve, and be good, and be clever?

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਤੂੰ ਬਧਾ ਛੁਟਹਿ ਜਿਤੁ ॥੬॥੧॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak naam samaal toon badhaa chhutteh jit |6|1|3|
English: O Nanak, contemplate the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and you shall be released from bondage. ||6||1||3||

[Ang 729 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
