English: O sister, please teach me, please show me. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੂਹਬ ਸੂਹਬ ਸੂਹਵੀ ॥
Transliteration: soohab soohab soohavee |
English: Crimson, crimson, crimson

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: apane preetam kai rang ratee |1| rahaau |
English: - this is the color of the soul-bride who is imbued with the Love of her Beloved. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪਾਵ ਮਲੋਵਉ ਸੰਗਿ ਨੈਨ ਭਤੀਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: paav malovau sang nain bhateeree |
English: I wash Your Feet with my eye-lashes.

Gurbani: ਜਹਾ ਪਠਾਵਹੁ ਜਾਂਉ ਤਤੀ ਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jahaa patthaavahu jaanau tatee ree |2|
English: Wherever You send me, there I will go. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਦੇਉ ਜਤੀ ਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jap tap sanjam deo jatee ree |
English: I would trade meditation, austerity, self-discipline and celibacy,

Gurbani: ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤੀ ਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: eik nimakh milaavahu mohi praanapatee ree |3|
English: if I could only meet the Lord of my life, for even an instant. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਾਣੁ ਤਾਣੁ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਹਤੀ ਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: maan taan ahanbudh hatee ree |
English: She who eradicates her self-conceit, power and arrogant intellect,

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਹਾਗਵਤੀ ਰੀ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: saa naanak sohaagavatee ree |4|4|10|
English: O Nanak, is the true soul-bride. ||4||4||10||

[Ang 739 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: toon jeevan toon praan adhaaraa |
English: You are my Life, the very Support of my breath of life.

Gurbani: ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tujh hee pekh pekh man saadhaaraa |1|
English: Gazing upon You, beholding You, my mind is soothed and comforted. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: toon saajan toon preetam meraa |
English: You are my Friend, You are my Beloved.

Gurbani: ਚਿਤਹਿ ਨ ਬਿਸਰਹਿ ਕਾਹੂ ਬੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: chiteh na bisareh kaahoo beraa |1| rahaau |
English: I shall never forget You. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬੈ ਖਰੀਦੁ ਹਉ ਦਾਸਰੋ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: bai khareed hau daasaro teraa |
English: I am Your indentured servant; I am Your slave.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਭਾਰੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੇਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: toon bhaaro tthaakur gunee gaheraa |2|
English: You are my Great Lord and Master, the treasure of excellence. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਦਾਸ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kott daas jaa kai darabaare |
English: There are millions of servants in Your Court - Your Royal Darbaar.

Gurbani: ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਵਸੈ ਤਿਨੑ ਨਾਲੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: nimakh nimakh vasai tina naale |3|
English: Each and every instant, You dwell with them. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: hau kichh naahee sabh kichh teraa |
English: I am nothing; everything is Yours.

Gurbani: ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: ot pot naanak sang baseraa |4|5|11|
English: Through and through, You abide with Nanak. ||4||5||11||

[Ang 739 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੂਖ ਮਹਲ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਊਚ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sookh mehal jaa ke aooch duaare |
English: His Mansions are so comfortable, and His gates are so lofty.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਵਾਸਹਿ ਭਗਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: taa meh vaaseh bhagat piaare |1|
English: Within them, His beloved devotees dwell. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਹਜ ਕਥਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਅਤਿ ਮੀਠੀ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj kathaa prabh kee at meetthee |
English: The Natural Speech of God is so very sweet.

Gurbani: ਵਿਰਲੈ ਕਾਹੂ ਨੇਤ੍ਰਹੁ ਡੀਠੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: viralai kaahoo netrahu ddeetthee |1| rahaau |
English: How rare is that person, who sees it with his eyes. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤਹ ਗੀਤ ਨਾਦ ਅਖਾਰੇ ਸੰਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: teh geet naad akhaare sangaa |
English: There, in the arena of the congregation, the divine music of the Naad, the sound current, is sung.

Gurbani: ਊਹਾ ਸੰਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aoohaa sant kareh har rangaa |2|
English: There, the Saints celebrate with their Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤਹ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਨ ਹਰਖਾ ॥
Transliteration: teh maran na jeevan sog na harakhaa |
English: Neither birth nor death is there, neither pain nor pleasure.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵਰਖਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: saach naam kee amrit varakhaa |3|
English: The Ambrosial Nectar of the True Name rains down there. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਹਜ ਕਥਾ ਇਹ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: guhaj kathaa ih gur te jaanee |
English: From the Guru, I have come to know the mystery of this speech.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: naanak bolai har har baanee |4|6|12|
English: Nanak speaks the Bani of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||6||12||

[Ang 739 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਦਰਸਿ ਪਾਪ ਕੋਟਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai daras paap kott utaare |
English: By the Blessed Vision of their Darshan, millions of sins are erased.

Gurbani: ਭੇਟਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਇਹੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bhettat sang ihu bhavajal taare |1|
English: Meeting with them, this terrifying world-ocean is crossed over||1||

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਸਾਜਨ ਓਇ ਮੀਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: oe saajan oe meet piaare |
English: They are my companions, and they are my dear friends,

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਿਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo ham kau har naam chitaare |1| rahaau |
English: who inspire me to remember the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਨਤ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kaa sabad sunat sukh saare |
English: Hearing the Word of His Shabad, I am totally at peace.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਜਮਦੂਤ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jaa kee ttehal jamadoot bidaare |2|
English: When I serve Him, the Messenger of Death is chased away. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਧੀਰਕ ਇਸੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kee dheerak is maneh sadhaare |
English: His comfort and consolation soothes and supports my mind.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jaa kai simaran mukh ujalaare |3|
English: Remembering Him in meditation, my face is radiant and bright. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: prabh ke sevak prabh aap savaare |
English: God embellishes and supports His servants.

Gurbani: ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨੑ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: saran naanak tina sad balihaare |4|7|13|
English: Nanak seeks the Protection of their Sanctuary; he is forever a sacrifice to them. ||4||7||13||

[Ang 740 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: rehan na paaveh sur nar devaa |
English: The angelic beings and demi-gods are not permitted to remain here.

Gurbani: ਊਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aootth sidhaare kar mun jan sevaa |1|
English: The silent sages and humble servants also must arise and depart. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਤ ਪੇਖੇ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jeevat pekhe jinaee har har dhiaaeaa |
English: Only those who meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, are seen to live on.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang tinaee darasan paaeaa |1| rahaau |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, they obtain the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਾਦਿਸਾਹ ਸਾਹ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਮਰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: baadisaah saah vaapaaree maranaa |
English: Kings, emperors and merchants must die.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਕਾਲਹਿ ਖਰਨਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jo deesai so kaaleh kharanaa |2|
English: Whoever is seen shall be consumed by death. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕੂੜੈ ਮੋਹਿ ਲਪਟਿ ਲਪਟਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: koorrai mohi lapatt lapattaanaa |
English: Mortal beings are entangled, clinging to false worldly attachments.

Gurbani: ਛੋਡਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਤਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: chhodd chaliaa taa fir pachhutaanaa |3|
English: And when they must leave them behind, then they regret and grieve. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: kripaa nidhaan naanak kau karahu daat |
English: O Lord, O treasure of mercy, please bless Nanak with this gift,

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਪੀ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥੪॥੮॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: naam teraa japee din raat |4|8|14|
English: that he may chant Your Name, day and night. ||4||8||14||

[Ang 740 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਬਸਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt antar tumeh basaare |
English: You dwell deep within the heart of each and every being.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਸੂਤਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sagal samagree soot tumaare |1|
English: The entire universe is strung on Your Thread. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: toon preetam toon praan adhaare |
English: You are my Beloved, the Support of my breath of life.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਗਸਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tum hee pekh pekh man bigasaare |1| rahaau |
English: Beholding You, gazing upon You, my mind blossoms forth. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: anik jon bhram bhram bhram haare |
English: Wandering, wandering, wandering through countless incarnations, I have grown so weary.

Gurbani: ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਅਬ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ott gahee ab saadh sangaare |2|
English: Now, I hold tight to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: agam agochar alakh apaare |
English: You are inaccessible, incomprehensible, invisible and infinite.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਾਰੇ ॥੩॥੯॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: naanak simarai din rainaare |3|9|15|
English: Nanak remembers You in meditation, day and night. ||3||9||15||

[Ang 740 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਵਨ ਕਾਜ ਮਾਇਆ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: kavan kaaj maaeaa vaddiaaee |
English: What is the use of the glory of Maya?

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਬਿਨਸਤ ਬਾਰ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jaa kau binasat baar na kaaee |1|
English: It disappears in no time at all. ||1||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਸੋਵਤ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: eihu supanaa sovat nahee jaanai |
English: This is a dream, but the sleeper does not know it.

Gurbani: ਅਚੇਤ ਬਿਵਸਥਾ ਮਹਿ ਲਪਟਾਨੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: achet bivasathaa meh lapattaanai |1| rahaau |
English: In his unconscious state, he clings to it. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਗਾਵਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: mahaa mohi mohio gaavaaraa |
English: The poor fool is enticed by the great attachments of the world.

Gurbani: ਪੇਖਤ ਪੇਖਤ ਊਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: pekhat pekhat aootth sidhaaraa |2|
English: Gazing upon them, watching them, he must still arise and depart. ||2||

Gurbani: ਊਚ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aooch te aooch taa kaa darabaaraa |
English: The Royal Court of His Darbaar is the highest of the high.

Gurbani: ਕਈ ਜੰਤ ਬਿਨਾਹਿ ਉਪਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kee jant binaeh upaaraa |3|
English: He creates and destroys countless beings. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦੂਸਰ ਹੋਆ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: doosar hoaa naa ko hoee |
English: There has never been any other, and there shall never be.

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: jap naanak prabh eko soee |4|10|16|
English: O Nanak, meditate on the One God. ||4||10||16||

[Ang 740 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: simar simar taa kau hau jeevaa |
English: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on Him, I live.

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਤੇਰੇ ਧੋਇ ਧੋਇ ਪੀਵਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: charan kamal tere dhoe dhoe peevaa |1|
English: I wash Your Lotus Feet, and drink in the wash water. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: so har meraa antarajaamee |
English: He is my Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat janaa kai sang suaamee |1| rahaau |
English: My Lord and Master abides with His humble devotees. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: sun sun amrit naam dhiaavaa |
English: Hearing, hearing Your Ambrosial Naam, I meditate on it.

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar tere gun gaavaa |2|
English: Twenty-four hours a day, I sing Your Glorious Praises. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਲੀਲਾ ਮਨਿ ਆਨੰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: pekh pekh leelaa man aanandaa |
English: Beholding, beholding Your divine play, my mind is in bliss.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਅਪਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gun apaar prabh paramaanandaa |3|
English: Your Glorious Virtues are infinite, O God, O Lord of supreme bliss. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਕਛੁ ਭਉ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai simaran kachh bhau na biaapai |
English: Meditating in remembrance on Him, fear cannot touch me.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa naanak har jaapai |4|11|17|
English: Forever and ever, Nanak meditates on the Lord. ||4||11||17||

[Ang 740 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai bachan ridai dhiaan dhaaree |
English: Within my heart, I meditate on the Word of the Guru's Teachings.

Gurbani: ਰਸਨਾ ਜਾਪੁ ਜਪਉ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: rasanaa jaap jpau banavaaree |1|
English: With my tongue, I chant the Chant of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: safal moorat darasan balihaaree |
English: The image of His vision is fruitful; I am a sacrifice to it.

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal man praan adhaaree |1| rahaau |
English: His Lotus Feet are the Support of the mind, the Support of the very breath of life. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang janam maran nivaaree |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the cycle of birth and death is ended.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਕਰਨ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: amrit kathaa sun karan adhaaree |2|
English: To hear the Ambrosial Sermon is the support of my ears. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਤਜਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh lobh moh tajaaree |
English: I have renounced sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment.

Gurbani: ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਸੁਚਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: drirr naam daan isanaan suchaaree |3|
English: I have enshrined the Naam within myself, with charity, true cleansing and righteous conduct. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak ihu tat beechaaree |
English: Says Nanak, I have contemplated this essence of reality;

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਜਪਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: raam naam jap paar utaaree |4|12|18|
English: chanting the Name of the Lord, I am carried across. ||4||12||18||

[Ang 740 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਲੋਭਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਗਨ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ॥
Transliteration: lobh mohi magan aparaadhee |
English: The sinner is absorbed in greed and emotional attachment.

Gurbani: ਕਰਣਹਾਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਸਾਧੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: karanahaar kee sev na saadhee |1|
English: He has not performed any service to the Creator Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: patit paavan prabh naam tumaare |
English: O God, Your Name is the Purifier of sinners.

Gurbani: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨੀਆਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raakh lehu mohi niraguneeaare |1| rahaau |
English: I am worthless - please save me! ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: toon daataa prabh antarajaamee |
English: O God, You are the Great Giver, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

Gurbani: ਕਾਚੀ ਦੇਹ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kaachee deh maanukh abhimaanee |2|
English: The body of the egotistical human is perishable. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੁਆਦ ਬਾਦ ਈਰਖ ਮਦ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: suaad baad eerakh mad maaeaa |
English: Tastes and pleasures, conflicts and jealousy, and intoxication with Maya

Gurbani: ਇਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ein sang laag ratan janam gavaaeaa |3|
English: - attached to these, the jewel of human life is wasted. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: dukh bhanjan jagajeevan har raaeaa |
English: The Sovereign Lord King is the Destroyer of pain, the Life of the world.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਰਣਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: sagal tiaag naanak saranaaeaa |4|13|19|
English: Forsaking everything, Nanak has entered His Sanctuary. ||4||13||19||

[Ang 741 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪੇਖਤ ਚਾਖਤ ਕਹੀਅਤ ਅੰਧਾ ਸੁਨੀਅਤ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: pekhat chaakhat kaheeat andhaa suneeat suneeai naahee |
English: He sees with his eyes, but he is called blind; he hears, but he does not hear.

Gurbani: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਕਉ ਜਾਣੈ ਦੂਰੇ ਪਾਪੀ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: nikatt vasat kau jaanai doore paapee paap kamaahee |1|
English: And the One who dwells near at hand, he thinks that He is far away; the sinner is committing sins. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਛੁਟਹਿ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: so kichh kar jit chhutteh paraanee |
English: Do only those deeds which will save you, O mortal being.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam jap amrit baanee |1| rahaau |
English: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and the Ambrosial Word of His Bani. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਘੋਰ ਮਹਲ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: ghor mehal sadaa rang raataa |
English: You are forever imbued with the love of horses and mansions.

Gurbani: ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੈ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sang tumaarai kachhoo na jaataa |2|
English: Nothing shall go along with you. ||2||

Gurbani: ਰਖਹਿ ਪੋਚਾਰਿ ਮਾਟੀ ਕਾ ਭਾਂਡਾ ॥
Transliteration: rakheh pochaar maattee kaa bhaanddaa |
English: You may clean and decorate the vessel of clay,

Gurbani: ਅਤਿ ਕੁਚੀਲ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਮ ਡਾਂਡਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: at kucheel milai jam ddaanddaa |3|
English: but it is so very filthy; it shall receive its punishment from the Messenger of Death. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਾਧਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh lobh mohi baadhaa |
English: You are bound by sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment.

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਗਰਤ ਮਹਿ ਨਿਘਰਤ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: mahaa garat meh nigharat jaataa |4|
English: You are sinking down into the great pit. ||4||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਸੁਣੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: naanak kee aradaas suneejai |
English: Hear this prayer of Nanak, O Lord;

Gurbani: ਡੂਬਤ ਪਾਹਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੫॥੧੪॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: ddoobat paahan prabh mere leejai |5|14|20|
English: I am a stone, sinking down - please, rescue me! ||5||14||20||

[Ang 741 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰੈ ਬੁਝੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jeevat marai bujhai prabh soe |
English: One who remains dead while yet alive understands God.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tis jan karam paraapat hoe |1|
English: He meets that humble being according to the karma of his past actions. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਇਉ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: sun saajan iau dutar tareeai |
English: Listen, O friend - this is how to cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਚਰੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mil saadhoo har naam uchareeai |1| rahaau |
English: Meet with the Holy, and chant the Lord's Name||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਬਿਨਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: ek binaa doojaa nahee jaanai |
English: There is no other to know, except for the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt antar paarabraham pachhaanai |2|
English: So realize that the Supreme Lord God is within each and every heart. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: jo kichh karai soee bhal maanai |
English: Whatever He does, accept that as good.

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਜਾਨੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aad ant kee keemat jaanai |3|
English: Know the value of the beginning and the end. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak tis jan balihaaree |
English: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to that humble being,

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਹਿ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੨੧॥
Transliteration: jaa kai hiradai vaseh muraaree |4|15|21|
English: within whose heart the Lord dwells. ||4||15||21||

[Ang 741 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur paramesar karanaihaar |
English: The Guru is the Transcendent Lord, the Creator Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਉ ਦੇ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sagal srisatt kau de aadhaar |1|
English: He gives His Support to the entire Universe. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਮਨ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur ke charan kamal man dhiaae |
English: Meditate within your mind on the Lotus Feet of the Guru.

Gurbani: ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dookh darad is tan te jaae |1| rahaau |
English: Pain and suffering shall leave this body. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਭਵਜਲਿ ਡੂਬਤ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਕਾਢੈ ॥
Transliteration: bhavajal ddoobat satigur kaadtai |
English: The True Guru saves the drowning being from the terrifying world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਟੂਟਾ ਗਾਢੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: janam janam kaa ttoottaa gaadtai |2|
English: He reunites those who were separated for countless incarnations. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: gur kee sevaa karahu din raat |
English: Serve the Guru, day and night.

Gurbani: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਮਨਿ ਆਵੈ ਸਾਂਤਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sookh sehaj man aavai saant |3|
English: Your mind shall come to have peace, pleasure and poise. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur kee ren vaddabhaagee paavai |
English: By great good fortune, one obtains the dust of the feet of the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੨੨॥
Transliteration: naanak gur kau sad bal jaavai |4|16|22|
English: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to the True Guru. ||4||16||22||

[Ang 741 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: gur apune aoopar bal jaaeeai |
English: I am a sacrifice to my True Guru.

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar har har jas gaaeeai |1|
English: Twenty-four hours a day, I sing the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਉ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: simrau so prabh apanaa suaamee |
English: Meditate in remembrance on God, your Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sagal ghattaa kaa antarajaamee |1| rahaau |
English: He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of all hearts. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal siau laagee preet |
English: So love the Lord's Lotus Feet,

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saachee pooran niramal reet |2|
English: and live a lifestyle which is true, perfect and spotless. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: sant prasaad vasai man maahee |
English: By the Grace of the Saints, the Lord comes to dwell within the mind,

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: janam janam ke kilavikh jaahee |3|
English: and the sins of countless incarnations are eradicated. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh deen deaalaa |
English: Please be Merciful, O God, O Merciful to the meek.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਸੰਤ ਰਵਾਲਾ ॥੪॥੧੭॥੨੩॥
Transliteration: naanak maagai sant ravaalaa |4|17|23|
English: Nanak begs for the dust of the Saints. ||4||17||23||

[Ang 742 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਗੁਰ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: darasan dekh jeevaa gur teraa |
English: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, I live.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: pooran karam hoe prabh meraa |1|
English: My karma is perfect, O my God. ||1||

Gurbani: ਇਹ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: eih benantee sun prabh mere |
English: Please, listen to this prayer, O my God.

Gurbani: ਦੇਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਅਪਣੇ ਚੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dehi naam kar apane chere |1| rahaau |
English: Please bless me with Your Name, and make me Your chaylaa, Your disciple. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਪਣੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਰਾਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: apanee saran raakh prabh daate |
English: Please keep me under Your Protection, O God, O Great Giver.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਜਾਤੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad kinai viralai jaate |2|
English: By Guru's Grace, a few people understand this. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਬਿਨਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: sunahu binau prabh mere meetaa |
English: Please hear my prayer, O God, my Friend.

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਵਸਹਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਚੀਤਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: charan kamal vaseh merai cheetaa |3|
English: May Your Lotus Feet abide within my consciousness. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਏਕ ਕਰੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: naanak ek karai aradaas |
English: Nanak makes one prayer:

Gurbani: ਵਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੧੮॥੨੪॥
Transliteration: visar naahee pooran gunataas |4|18|24|
English: may I never forget You, O perfect treasure of virtue. ||4||18||24||

[Ang 742 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੀਤੁ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: meet saajan sut bandhap bhaaee |
English: He is my friend, companion, child, relative and sibling.

Gurbani: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jat kat pekhau har sang sahaaee |1|
English: Wherever I look, I see the Lord as my companion and helper. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਪਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਧਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: jat meree pat meree dhan har naam |
English: The Lord's Name is my social status, my honor and wealth.

Gurbani: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਬਿਸਰਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sookh sehaj aanand bisaraam |1| rahaau |
English: He is my pleasure, poise, bliss and peace. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਪਹਿਰਿ ਸਨਾਹ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham jap pahir sanaah |
English: I have strapped on the armor of meditation on the Supreme Lord God.

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਆਵਧ ਤਿਸੁ ਬੇਧਤ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kott aavadh tis bedhat naeh |2|
English: It cannot be pierced, even by millions of weapons. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਣ ਗੜ ਕੋਟ ਹਮਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: har charan saran garr kott hamaarai |
English: The Sanctuary of the Lord's Feet is my fortress and battlement.

Gurbani: ਕਾਲੁ ਕੰਟਕੁ ਜਮੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਨ ਬਿਦਾਰੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kaal kanttak jam tis na bidaarai |3|
English: The Messenger of Death, the torturer, cannot demolish it. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਦਾ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: naanak daas sadaa balihaaree |
English: Slave Nanak is forever a sacrifice

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਕ ਸੰਤ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੧੯॥੨੫॥
Transliteration: sevak sant raajaa raam muraaree |4|19|25|
English: to the selfless servants and Saints of the Sovereign Lord, the Destroyer of ego. ||4||19||25||

[Ang 742 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: gun gopaal prabh ke nit gaahaa |
English: Where the Glorious Praises of God, the Lord of the world are continually sung,

Gurbani: ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਸੁਖ ਤਾਹਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: anad binod mangal sukh taahaa |1|
English: there is bliss, joy, happiness and peace. ||1||

Gurbani: ਚਲੁ ਸਖੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਵਣ ਜਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: chal sakhee prabh raavan jaahaa |
English: Come, O my companions - let us go and enjoy God.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਪਾਹਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saadh janaa kee charanee paahaa |1| rahaau |
English: Let us fall at the feet of the holy, humble beings. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਜਨ ਧੂਰਿ ਬਾਛਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: kar benatee jan dhoor baachhaahaa |
English: I pray for the dust of the feet of the humble.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਲਾਹਾਂ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: janam janam ke kilavikh laahaan |2|
English: It shall wash away the sins of countless incarnations. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਜੀਉ ਅਰਪਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: man tan praan jeeo arapaahaa |
English: I dedicate my mind, body, breath of life and soul to God.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਕਟਾਹਾਂ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har simar simar maan mohu kattaahaan |3|
English: Remembering the Lord in meditation, I have eradicated pride and emotional attachment. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕਰਹੁ ਉਤਸਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: deen deaal karahu utasaahaa |
English: O Lord, O Merciful to the meek, please give me faith and confidence,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ॥੪॥੨੦॥੨੬॥
Transliteration: naanak daas har saran samaahaa |4|20|26|
English: so that slave Nanak may remain absorbed in Your Sanctuary. ||4||20||26||

[Ang 742 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਨਗਰੁ ਜਹਾ ਸੰਤ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: baikuntth nagar jahaa sant vaasaa |
English: The city of heaven is where the Saints dwell.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਰਿਦ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: prabh charan kamal rid maeh nivaasaa |1|
English: They enshrine the Lotus Feet of God within their hearts. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਤੁਝੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਦਿਖਲਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: sun man tan tujh sukh dikhalaavau |
English: Listen, O my mind and body, and let me show you the way to find peace,

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਿੰਜਨ ਤੁਝੁ ਭੋਗ ਭੁੰਚਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har anik binjan tujh bhog bhunchaavau |1| rahaau |
English: so that you may eat and enjoy the various delicacies of the Lord||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਭੁੰਚੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: amrit naam bhunch man maahee |
English: Taste the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within your mind.

Gurbani: ਅਚਰਜ ਸਾਦ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਬਰਨੇ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: acharaj saad taa ke barane na jaahee |2|
English: Its taste is wondrous - it cannot be described. ||2||

Gurbani: ਲੋਭੁ ਮੂਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੁਝਿ ਥਾਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: lobh mooaa trisanaa bujh thaakee |
English: Your greed shall die, and your thirst shall be quenched.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਜਨ ਤਾਕੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: paarabraham kee saran jan taakee |3|
English: The humble beings seek the Sanctuary of the Supreme Lord God. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਭੈ ਮੋਹ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: janam janam ke bhai moh nivaare |
English: The Lord dispels the fears and attachments of countless incarnations.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੨੧॥੨੭॥
Transliteration: naanak daas prabh kirapaa dhaare |4|21|27|
English: God has showered His Mercy and Grace upon slave Nanak. ||4||21||27||

[Ang 742 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਬੀਂਗ ਦਾਸ ਕੇ ਪਰਹਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: anik beeng daas ke parahariaa |
English: God covers the many shortcomings of His slaves.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨਾ ਕਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh apanaa kariaa |1|
English: Granting His Mercy, God makes them His own. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮਹਿ ਛਡਾਇ ਲੀਓ ਜਨੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: tumeh chhaddaae leeo jan apanaa |
English: You emancipate Your humble servant,

Gurbani: ਉਰਝਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਜਾਲੁ ਜਗੁ ਸੁਪਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aurajh pario jaal jag supanaa |1| rahaau |
English: and rescue him from the noose of the world, which is just a dream. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪਰਬਤ ਦੋਖ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਕਰਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: parabat dokh mahaa bikaraalaa |
English: Even huge mountains of sin and corruption

Gurbani: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: khin meh door kee deaalaa |2|
English: are removed in an instant by the Merciful Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੋਗ ਰੋਗ ਬਿਪਤਿ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: sog rog bipat at bhaaree |
English: Sorrow, disease and the most terrible calamities

Gurbani: ਦੂਰਿ ਭਈ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: door bhee jap naam muraaree |3|
English: are removed by meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਲੀਨੋ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: drisatt dhaar leeno larr laae |
English: Bestowing His Glance of Grace, He attaches us to the hem of His robe.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਗਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥੪॥੨੨॥੨੮॥
Transliteration: har charan gahe naanak saranaae |4|22|28|
English: Grasping the Lord's Feet, O Nanak, we enter His Sanctuary. ||4||22||28||

[Ang 743 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦੀਨੁ ਛਡਾਇ ਦੁਨੀ ਜੋ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: deen chhaddaae dunee jo laae |
English: One who withdraws from God's Path, and attaches himself to the world,

Gurbani: ਦੁਹੀ ਸਰਾਈ ਖੁਨਾਮੀ ਕਹਾਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: duhee saraaee khunaamee kahaae |1|
English: is known as a sinner in both worlds. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: jo tis bhaavai so paravaan |
English: He alone is approved, who pleases the Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਪਣੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aapanee kudarat aape jaan |1| rahaau |
English: Only He Himself knows His creative omnipotence. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਭਲਾ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa dharam pun bhalaa karaae |
English: One who practices truth, righteous living, charity and good deeds,

Gurbani: ਦੀਨ ਕੈ ਤੋਸੈ ਦੁਨੀ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: deen kai tosai dunee na jaae |2|
English: has the supplies for God's Path. Worldly success shall not fail him. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: sarab nirantar eko jaagai |
English: Within and among all, the One Lord is awake.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jit jit laaeaa tith tit ko laagai |3|
English: As He attaches us, so are we attached. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: agam agochar sach saahib meraa |
English: You are inaccessible and unfathomable, O my True Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਬੋਲਾਇਆ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੨੯॥
Transliteration: naanak bolai bolaaeaa teraa |4|23|29|
English: Nanak speaks as You inspire him to speak. ||4||23||29||

[Ang 743 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਾਤਹਕਾਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: praatahakaal har naam uchaaree |
English: In the early hours of the morning, I chant the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: eet aoot kee ott savaaree |1|
English: I have fashioned a shelter for myself, hear and hereafter. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa japeeai har naam |
English: Forever and ever, I chant the Lord's Name,

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਮਨ ਕੇ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: pooran hoveh man ke kaam |1| rahaau |
English: and the desires of my mind are fulfilled. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਗਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: prabh abinaasee rain din gaau |
English: Sing the Praises of the Eternal, Imperishable Lord God, night and day.

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰਤ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਥਾਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jeevat marat nihachal paaveh thaau |2|
English: In life, and in death, you shall find your eternal, unchanging home. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਾਹੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: so saahu sev jit tott na aavai |
English: So serve the Sovereign Lord, and you shall never lack anything.

Gurbani: ਖਾਤ ਖਰਚਤ ਸੁਖਿ ਅਨਦਿ ਵਿਹਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: khaat kharachat sukh anad vihaavai |3|
English: While eating and consuming, you shall pass your life in peace. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jagajeevan purakh saadhasang paaeaa |
English: O Life of the World, O Primal Being, I have found the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੨੪॥੩੦॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad naanak naam dhiaaeaa |4|24|30|
English: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||24||30||

[Ang 743 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਜਬ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
Transliteration: gur poore jab bhe deaal |
English: When the Perfect Guru becomes merciful,

Gurbani: ਦੁਖ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਈ ਘਾਲ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dukh binase pooran bhee ghaal |1|
English: my pains are taken away, and my works are perfectly completed. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: pekh pekh jeevaa daras tumaaraa |
English: Gazing upon, beholding the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, I live;

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਜਾਈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal jaaee balihaaraa |
English: I am a sacrifice to Your Lotus Feet.

Gurbani: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਵਨੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tujh bin tthaakur kavan hamaaraa |1| rahaau |
English: Without You, O my Lord and Master, who belongs to me? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasangat siau preet ban aaee |
English: I have fallen in love with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy,

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਬ ਕਰਮਿ ਲਿਖਤ ਧੁਰਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: poorab karam likhat dhur paaee |2|
English: by the karma of my past actions and my pre-ordained destiny. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥
Transliteration: jap har har naam acharaj parataap |
English: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; how wondrous is His glory!

Gurbani: ਜਾਲਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਹਿ ਤੀਨੇ ਤਾਪ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jaal na saakeh teene taap |3|
English: The three types of illness cannot consume it. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਬਿਸਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: nimakh na bisareh har charan tumaare |
English: May I never forget, even for an instant, the Lord's Feet.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੪॥੨੫॥੩੧॥
Transliteration: naanak maagai daan piaare |4|25|31|
English: Nanak begs for this gift, O my Beloved. ||4||25||31||

[Ang 743 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਕਰਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: se sanjog karahu mere piaare |
English: May there be such an auspicious time, O my Beloved,

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਚਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jit rasanaa har naam uchaare |1|
English: when, with my tongue, I may chant the Lord's Name||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: sun benatee prabh deen deaalaa |
English: Hear my prayer, O God, O Merciful to the meek.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਦਾ ਰਸਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saadh gaaveh gun sadaa rasaalaa |1| rahaau |
English: The Holy Saints ever sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the Source of Nectar. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਨ ਰੂਪੁ ਸਿਮਰਣੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeevan roop simaran prabh teraa |
English: Your meditation and remembrance is life-giving, God.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਸਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਨੇਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jis kripaa kareh baseh tis neraa |2|
English: You dwell near those upon whom You show mercy. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਭੂਖ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jan kee bhookh teraa naam ahaar |
English: Your Name is the food to satisfy the hunger of Your humble servants.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: toon daataa prabh devanahaar |3|
English: You are the Great Giver, O Lord God. ||3||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਰਮਤ ਸੰਤਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: raam ramat santan sukh maanaa |
English: The Saints take pleasure in repeating the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰ ਸੁਜਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੨੬॥੩੨॥
Transliteration: naanak devanahaar sujaanaa |4|26|32|
English: O Nanak, the Lord, the Great Giver, is All-knowing. ||4||26||32||

[Ang 743 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬਹਤੀ ਜਾਤ ਕਦੇ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨ ਧਾਰਤ ॥
Transliteration: bahatee jaat kade drisatt na dhaarat |
English: Your life is slipping away, but you never even notice.

Gurbani: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਮੋਹ ਬੰਧਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਪਾਰਚ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mithiaa moh bandheh nit paarach |1|
English: You are constantly entangled in false attachments and conflicts. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਾਧਵੇ ਭਜੁ ਦਿਨ ਨਿਤ ਰੈਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: maadhave bhaj din nit rainee |
English: Meditate, vibrate constantly, day and night, on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜੀਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: janam padaarath jeet har saranee |1| rahaau |
English: You shall be victorious in this priceless human life, in the Protection of the Lord's Sanctuary. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਰਤ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਦੋਊ ਕਰ ਝਾਰਤ ॥
Transliteration: karat bikaar doaoo kar jhaarat |
English: You eagerly commit sins and practice corruption,

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਰਿਦ ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਧਾਰਤ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: raam ratan rid til nahee dhaarat |2|
English: But you do not enshrine the jewel of the Lord's Name within your heart, even for an instant. ||2||

Gurbani: ਭਰਣ ਪੋਖਣ ਸੰਗਿ ਅਉਧ ਬਿਹਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: bharan pokhan sang aaudh bihaanee |
English: Feeding and pampering your body, your life is passing away,

Gurbani: ਜੈ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jai jagadees kee gat nahee jaanee |3|
English: but you do not experience the state of victory of the Lord of the Universe. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਰਣਿ ਸਮਰਥ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: saran samarath agochar suaamee |
English: So enter the Sanctuary of the All-powerful, Unfathomable Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਉਧਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥੪॥੨੭॥੩੩॥
Transliteration: audhar naanak prabh antarajaamee |4|27|33|
English: O God, O Searcher of hearts, please, save Nanak! ||4||27||33||

[Ang 744 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਤਰੈ ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang tarai bhai saagar |
English: Cross over the terrifying world-ocean in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਰਤਨਾਗਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har har naam simar ratanaagar |1|
English: Remember in meditation the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the source of jewels. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ॥
Transliteration: simar simar jeevaa naaraaein |
English: Remembering, remembering the Lord in meditation, I live.

Gurbani: ਦੂਖ ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਸਭਿ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਪ ਤਜਾਇਣ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dookh rog sog sabh binase gur poore mil paap tajaaein |1| rahaau |
English: All pain, disease and suffering is dispelled, meeting the Perfect Guru; sin has been eradicated. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦਵੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jeevan padavee har kaa naau |
English: The immortal status is obtained through the Name of the Lord;

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: man tan niramal saach suaau |2|
English: the mind and body become spotless and pure, which is the true purpose of life. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar paarabraham dhiaaeeai |
English: Twenty-four hours a day, meditate on the Supreme Lord God.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਹੋਇ ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: poorab likhat hoe taa paaeeai |3|
English: By pre-ordained destiny, the Name is obtained. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਏ ਜਪਿ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: saran pe jap deen deaalaa |
English: I have entered His Sanctuary, and I meditate on the Lord, Merciful to the meek.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਸੰਤ ਰਵਾਲਾ ॥੪॥੨੮॥੩੪॥
Transliteration: naanak jaachai sant ravaalaa |4|28|34|
English: Nanak longs for the dust of the Saints. ||4||28||34||

[Ang 744 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਘਰ ਕਾ ਕਾਜੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ਰੂੜਾ ॥
Transliteration: ghar kaa kaaj na jaanee roorraa |
English: The beautiful one does not know the work of his own home.

Gurbani: ਝੂਠੈ ਧੰਧੈ ਰਚਿਓ ਮੂੜਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jhootthai dhandhai rachio moorraa |1|
English: The fool is engrossed in false attachments. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਤੂੰ ਲਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jit toon laaveh tith tit laganaa |
English: As You attach us, so we are attached.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ਜਪਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaa toon dehi teraa naau japanaa |1| rahaau |
English: When You bless us with Your Name, we chant it. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: har ke daas har setee raate |
English: The Lord's slaves are imbued with the Love of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਮਾਤੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: raam rasaaein anadin maate |2|
English: They are intoxicated with the Lord, night and day. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬਾਹ ਪਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਢੇ ॥
Transliteration: baah pakar prabh aape kaadte |
English: Reaching out to grasp hold of our arms, God lifts us up.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਟੂਟੇ ਗਾਢੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: janam janam ke ttootte gaadte |3|
English: Separated for countless incarnations, we are united with Him again. ||3||

Gurbani: ਉਧਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: audhar suaamee prabh kirapaa dhaare |
English: Save me, O God, O my Lord and Master - shower me with Your Mercy.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੪॥੨੯॥੩੫॥
Transliteration: naanak daas har saran duaare |4|29|35|
English: Slave Nanak seeks Sanctuary at Your Door, O Lord. ||4||29||35||

[Ang 744 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sant prasaad nihachal ghar paaeaa |
English: By the Grace of the Saints, I have found my eternal home.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਫਿਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਡੋੁਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sarab sookh fir nahee dduolaaeaa |1|
English: I have found total peace, and I shall not waver again. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੂ ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਮਨਿ ਚੀਨੑੇ ॥
Transliteration: guroo dhiaae har charan man cheenae |
English: I meditate on the Guru, and the Lord's Feet, within my mind.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਕਰਤੈ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਕੀਨੑੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: taa te karatai asathir keenae |1| rahaau |
English: In this way, the Creator Lord has made me steady and stable. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ ਅਚੁਤ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: gun gaavat achut abinaasee |
English: I sing the Glorious Praises of the unchanging, eternal Lord God,

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਕਾਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: taa te kaattee jam kee faasee |2|
English: and the noose of death is snapped. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੀਨੇ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa leene larr laae |
English: Showering His Mercy, he has attached me to the hem of His robe.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਅਨਦੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੩॥੩੦॥੩੬॥
Transliteration: sadaa anad naanak gun gaae |3|30|36|
English: In constant bliss, Nanak sings His Glorious Praises. ||3||30||36||

[Ang 744 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਚਨ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: amrit bachan saadh kee baanee |
English: The Words, the Teachings of the Holy Saints, are Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਜਪੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਤ ਰਸਨ ਬਖਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo jo japai tis kee gat hovai har har naam nit rasan bakhaanee |1| rahaau |
English: Whoever meditates on the Lord's Name is emancipated; he chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, with his tongue. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਲੀ ਕਾਲ ਕੇ ਮਿਟੇ ਕਲੇਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: kalee kaal ke mitte kalesaa |
English: The pains and sufferings of the Dark Age of Kali Yuga are eradicated,

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਪਰਵੇਸਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: eko naam man meh paravesaa |1|
English: when the One Name abides within the mind. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: saadhoo dhoor mukh masatak laaee |
English: I apply the dust of the feet of the Holy to my face and forehead.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਧਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੨॥੩੧॥੩੭॥
Transliteration: naanak udhare har gur saranaaee |2|31|37|
English: Nanak has been saved, in the Sanctuary of the Guru, the Lord. ||2||31||37||

[Ang 744 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ghar 3 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl: Third House:

Gurbani: ਗੋਬਿੰਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: gobindaa gun gaau deaalaa |
English: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, the Merciful Lord.

Gurbani: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: darasan dehu pooran kirapaalaa | rahaau |
English: Please, bless me with the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, O Perfect, Compassionate Lord. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa tum hee pratipaalaa |
English: Please, grant Your Grace, and cherish me.

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਮਾਲਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jeeo pindd sabh tumaraa maalaa |1|
English: My soul and body are all Your property. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਲੈ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: amrit naam chalai jap naalaa |
English: Only meditation on the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, will go along with you.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਸੰਤ ਰਵਾਲਾ ॥੨॥੩੨॥੩੮॥
Transliteration: naanak jaachai sant ravaalaa |2|32|38|
English: Nanak begs for the dust of the Saints. ||2||32||38||

[Ang 744 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: tis bin doojaa avar na koee |
English: Without Him, there is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਥੰਮੈ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aape thamai sachaa soee |1|
English: The True Lord Himself is our anchor. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam meraa aadhaar |
English: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is our only support.

Gurbani: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: karan kaaran samarath apaar |1| rahaau |
English: The Creator, the Cause of causes, is All-powerful and Infinite. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਰੋਗ ਮਿਟਾਵੇ ਨਵਾ ਨਿਰੋਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabh rog mittaave navaa niroaa |
English: He has eradicated all illness, and healed me.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਖਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੋਆ ॥੨॥੩੩॥੩੯॥
Transliteration: naanak rakhaa aape hoaa |2|33|39|
English: O Nanak, He Himself has become my Savior. ||2||33||39||

[Ang 745 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: darasan kau lochai sabh koee |
English: Everyone longs for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: poorai bhaag paraapat hoee | rahaau |
English: By perfect destiny, it is obtained. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਿਆਮ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਤਜਿ ਨੀਦ ਕਿਉ ਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: siaam sundar taj need kiau aaee |
English: Forsaking the Beautiful Lord, how can they go to sleep?

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਦੂਤਾ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mahaa mohanee dootaa laaee |1|
English: The great enticer Maya has led them down the path of sin. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਿਛੋਹਾ ਕਰਤ ਕਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: prem bichhohaa karat kasaaee |
English: This butcher has separated them from the Beloved Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਦੈ ਜੰਤੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਦਇਆ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: niradai jant tis deaa na paaee |2|
English: This merciless one shows no mercy at all to the poor beings. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਨਮ ਬੀਤੀਅਨ ਭਰਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: anik janam beeteean bharamaaee |
English: Countless lifetimes have passed away, wandering aimlessly.

Gurbani: ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਨ ਦੇਵੈ ਦੁਤਰ ਮਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ghar vaas na devai dutar maaee |3|
English: The terrible, treacherous Maya does not even allow them to dwell in their own home. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਅਪਨਾ ਕੀਆ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: din rain apanaa keea paaee |
English: Day and night, they receive the rewards of their own actions.

Gurbani: ਕਿਸੁ ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਦੀਜੈ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਭਵਾਈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: kis dos na deejai kirat bhavaaee |4|
English: Don't blame anyone else; your own actions lead you astray. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sun saajan sant jan bhaaee |
English: Listen, O Friend, O Saint, O humble Sibling of Destiny:

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੫॥੩੪॥੪੦॥
Transliteration: charan saran naanak gat paaee |5|34|40|
English: in the Sanctuary of the Lord's Feet, Nanak has found Salvation. ||5||34||40||

[Ang 745 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: raag soohee mahalaa 5 ghar 4 |
English: Raag Soohee, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਭਲੀ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਛਾਪਰੀ ਜਾ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: bhalee suhaavee chhaaparee jaa meh gun gaae |
English: Even a crude hut is sublime and beautiful, if the Lord's Praises are sung within it.

Gurbani: ਕਿਤ ਹੀ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਧਉਲਹਰ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kit hee kaam na dhaulahar jit har bisaraae |1| rahaau |
English: Those mansions where the Lord is forgotten are useless. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਨਦੁ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: anad gareebee saadhasang jit prabh chit aae |
English: Even poverty is bliss, if God comes to mind in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਜਲਿ ਜਾਉ ਏਹੁ ਬਡਪਨਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਲਪਟਾਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jal jaau ehu baddapanaa maaeaa lapattaae |1|
English: This worldly glory might just as well burn; it only traps the mortals in Maya. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪੀਸਨੁ ਪੀਸਿ ਓਢਿ ਕਾਮਰੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੰਤੋਖਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: peesan pees odt kaamaree sukh man santokhaae |
English: One may have to grind corn, and wear a coarse blanket, but still, one can find peace of mind and contentment.

Gurbani: ਐਸੋ ਰਾਜੁ ਨ ਕਿਤੈ ਕਾਜਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਨਹ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aiso raaj na kitai kaaj jit neh tripataae |2|
English: Even empires are of no use at all, if they do not bring satisfaction. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਗਨ ਫਿਰਤ ਰੰਗਿ ਏਕ ਕੈ ਓਹੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: nagan firat rang ek kai ohu sobhaa paae |
English: Someone may wander around naked, but if he loves the One Lord, he receives honor and respect.

Gurbani: ਪਾਟ ਪਟੰਬਰ ਬਿਰਥਿਆ ਜਿਹ ਰਚਿ ਲੋਭਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: paatt pattanbar birathiaa jih rach lobhaae |3|
English: Silk and satin clothes are worthless, if they lead to greed. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਮੑਰੈ ਹਾਥਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh tumarai haath prabh aap kare karaae |
English: Everything is in Your Hands, God. You Yourself are the Doer, the Cause of causes.

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਰਹਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੧॥੪੧॥
Transliteration: saas saas simarat rahaa naanak daan paae |4|1|41|
English: With each and every breath, may I continue to remember You. Please, bless Nanak with this gift. ||4||1||41||

[Ang 745 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਪਰਾਨ ਧਨ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਪਨਿਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa sant paraan dhan tis kaa panihaaraa |
English: The Lord's Saint is my life and wealth. I am his water-carrier.

Gurbani: ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤ ਸੁਤ ਸਗਲ ਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਹੂੰ ਤੇ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhaaee meet sut sagal te jeea hoon te piaaraa |1| rahaau |
English: He is dearer to me than all my siblings, friends and children. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕੇਸਾ ਕਾ ਕਰਿ ਬੀਜਨਾ ਸੰਤ ਚਉਰੁ ਢੁਲਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: kesaa kaa kar beejanaa sant chaur dtulaavau |
English: I make my hair into a fan, and wave it over the Saint.

Gurbani: ਸੀਸੁ ਨਿਹਾਰਉ ਚਰਣ ਤਲਿ ਧੂਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sees nihaarau charan tal dhoor mukh laavau |1|
English: I bow my head low, to touch his feet, and apply his dust to my face. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਿਸਟ ਬਚਨ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕਰਉ ਦੀਨ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: misatt bachan benatee krau deen kee niaaee |
English: I offer my prayer with sweet words, in sincere humility.

Gurbani: ਤਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਰਉ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: taj abhimaan saranee prau har gun nidh paaee |2|
English: Renouncing egotism, I enter His Sanctuary. I have found the Lord, the treasure of virtue. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਵਲੋਕਨ ਪੁਨਹ ਪੁਨਹ ਕਰਉ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: avalokan punah punah krau jan kaa darasaar |
English: I gaze upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord's humble servant, again and again.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਚਨ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਿੰਚਉ ਬੰਦਉ ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: amrit bachan man meh sinchau bandau baar baar |3|
English: I cherish and gather in His Ambrosial Words within my mind; time and time again, I bow to Him. ||3||

Gurbani: ਚਿਤਵਉ ਮਨਿ ਆਸਾ ਕਰਉ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਮਾਗਉ ॥
Transliteration: chitvau man aasaa krau jan kaa sang maagau |
English: In my mind, I wish, hope and beg for the Society of the Lord's humble servants.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਦਾਸ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗਉ ॥੪॥੨॥੪੨॥
Transliteration: naanak kau prabh deaa kar daas charanee laagau |4|2|42|
English: Be Merciful to Nanak, O God, and lead him to the feet of Your slaves. ||4||2||42||

[Ang 745 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਮੋਹੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਤਾਹੂ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jin mohe brahamandd khandd taahoo meh paau |
English: She has enticed the worlds and solar systems; I have fallen into her clutches.

Gurbani: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਇਹੁ ਬਿਖਈ ਜੀਉ ਦੇਹੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raakh lehu ihu bikhee jeeo dehu apunaa naau |1| rahaau |
English: O Lord, please save this corrupt soul of mine; please bless me with Your Name. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਸੁਖੀ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaa te naahee ko sukhee taa kai paachhai jaau |
English: She has not brought anyone peace, but still, I chase after her.

Gurbani: ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਜੋ ਸਗਲ ਕਉ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਲਪਟਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: chhodd jaeh jo sagal kau fir fir lapattaau |1|
English: She forsakes everyone, but still, I cling to her, again and again. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੁਣਾਪਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: karahu kripaa karunaapate tere har gun gaau |
English: Have Mercy on me, O Lord of Compassion; please let me sing Your Glorious Praises, O Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੨॥੩॥੪੩॥
Transliteration: naanak kee prabh benatee saadhasang samaau |2|3|43|
English: This is Nanak's prayer, O Lord, that he may join and merge with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||3||43||

[Ang 746 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੫ ਪੜਤਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: raag soohee mahalaa 5 ghar 5 parrataal |
English: Raag Soohee, Fifth Mehl, Fifth House, Partaal:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਗੁਰੀਆ ਮੋਹਨ ਲਾਲਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: preet preet gureea mohan laalanaa |
English: Love of the enticing Beloved Lord is the most glorious love.

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਏਕੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋ ਲੇਖੈ ਸੰਤ ਲਾਗੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਛਾਡੁ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਕੀ ਕੁਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jap man gobind ekai avar nahee ko lekhai sant laag maneh chhaadd dubidhaa kee kureea |1| rahaau |
English: Meditate, O mind, on the One Lord of the Universe - nothing else is of any account. Attach your mind to the Saints, and abandon the path of duality. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਹਰੀਆ ਸਰਗੁਨ ਧਰੀਆ ਅਨਿਕ ਕੋਠਰੀਆ ਭਿੰਨ ਭਿੰਨ ਭਿੰਨ ਭਿਨ ਕਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: niragun hareea saragun dhareea anik kotthareea bhin bhin bhin bhin kareea |
English: The Lord is absolute and unmanifest; He has assumed the most sublime manifestation. He has fashioned countless body chambers of many, varied, different, myriad forms.

Gurbani: ਵਿਚਿ ਮਨ ਕੋਟਵਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: vich man kottavareea |
English: Within them, the mind is the policeman;

Gurbani: ਨਿਜ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਪਿਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: nij mandar pireea |
English: my Beloved lives in the temple of my inner self.

Gurbani: ਤਹਾ ਆਨਦ ਕਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: tahaa aanad kareea |
English: He plays there in ecstasy.

Gurbani: ਨਹ ਮਰੀਆ ਨਹ ਜਰੀਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: neh mareea neh jareea |1|
English: He does not die, and he never grows old. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਤਨਿ ਜੁਰੀਆ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਫਿਰੀਆ ਪਰ ਕਉ ਹਿਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: kiratan jureea bahu bidh fireea par kau hireea |
English: He is engrossed in worldly activities, wandering around in various ways. He steals the property of others,

Gurbani: ਬਿਖਨਾ ਘਿਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: bikhanaa ghireea |
English: and is surrounded by corruption and sin.

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: ab saadhoo sang pareea |
English: But now, he joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy,

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਖਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: har duaarai khareea |
English: and stands before the Lord's Gate.

Gurbani: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਕਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: darasan kareea |
English: He obtains the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: naanak gur mireea |
English: Nanak has met the Guru;

Gurbani: ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਫਿਰੀਆ ॥੨॥੧॥੪੪॥
Transliteration: bahur na fireea |2|1|44|
English: he shall not be reincarnated again. ||2||1||44||

[Ang 746 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਾਸਿ ਮੰਡਲੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਆਖਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: raas manddal keeno aakhaaraa |
English: The Lord has made this world a stage;

Gurbani: ਸਗਲੋ ਸਾਜਿ ਰਖਿਓ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sagalo saaj rakhio paasaaraa |1| rahaau |
English: He fashioned the expanse of the entire creation. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਆਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: bahu bidh roop rang aapaaraa |
English: He fashioned it in various ways, with limitless colors and forms.

Gurbani: ਪੇਖੈ ਖੁਸੀ ਭੋਗ ਨਹੀ ਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: pekhai khusee bhog nahee haaraa |
English: He watches over it with joy, and He never tires of enjoying it.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਲੈਤ ਬਸਤ ਨਿਰਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sabh ras lait basat niraaraa |1|
English: He enjoys all the delights, and yet He remains unattached. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਰਨੁ ਚਿਹਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੁਖੁ ਨ ਮਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: baran chihan naahee mukh na maasaaraa |
English: He has no color, no sign, no mouth and no beard.

Gurbani: ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਖੇਲੁ ਤੁਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kehan na jaaee khel tuhaaraa |
English: I cannot describe Your play.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੇਣ ਸੰਤ ਚਰਨਾਰਾ ॥੨॥੨॥੪੫॥
Transliteration: naanak ren sant charanaaraa |2|2|45|
English: Nanak is the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||2||2||45||

[Ang 746 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਮੈ ਆਇਆ ਸਰਨੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tau mai aaeaa saranee aaeaa |
English: I have come to You. I have come to Your Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਭਰੋਸੈ ਆਇਆ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bharosai aaeaa kirapaa aaeaa |
English: I have come to place my faith in You. I have come seeking Mercy.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਪਠਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jiau bhaavai tiau raakhahu suaamee maarag gureh patthaaeaa |1| rahaau |
English: If it pleases You, save me, O my Lord and Master. The Guru has placed me upon the Path. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: mahaa dutar maaeaa |
English: Maya is very treacherous and difficult to pass through.

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੇ ਪਵਨੁ ਝੁਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jaise pavan jhulaaeaa |1|
English: It is like a violent wind-storm. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਹੀ ਡਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sun sun hee ddaraaeaa |
English: I am so afraid to hear

Gurbani: ਕਰਰੋ ਧ੍ਰਮਰਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kararo dhramaraaeaa |2|
English: that the Righteous Judge of Dharma is so strict and stern. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: grih andh koopaaeaa |
English: The world is a deep, dark pit;

Gurbani: ਪਾਵਕੁ ਸਗਰਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: paavak sagaraaeaa |3|
English: it is all on fire. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗਹੀ ਓਟ ਸਾਧਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gahee ott saadhaaeaa |
English: I have grasped the Support of the Holy Saints.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: naanak har dhiaaeaa |
English: Nanak meditates on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਮੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੩॥੪੬॥
Transliteration: ab mai pooraa paaeaa |4|3|46|
English: Now, I have found the Perfect Lord. ||4||3||46||

[Ang 746 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੬ ॥
Transliteration: raag soohee mahalaa 5 ghar 6 |
English: Raag Soohee, Fifth Mehl, Sixth House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ਬੇਨੰਤੀਆ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: satigur paas benanteea milai naam aadhaaraa |
English: I offer this prayer to the True Guru, to bless me with the sustenance of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਤੁਠਾ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਤਾਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tutthaa sachaa paatisaahu taap geaa sansaaraa |1|
English: When the True King is pleased, the world is rid of its diseases. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਤੂੰ ਸੰਤਾ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhagataa kee ttek toon santaa kee ott toon sachaa sirajanahaaraa |1| rahaau |
English: You are the Support of Your devotees, and the Shelter of the Saints, O True Creator Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਾਮਗਰੀ ਸਚੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sach teree saamagaree sach teraa darabaaraa |
English: True are Your devices, and True is Your Court.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਤੇਰੇ ਖਾਜੀਨਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sach tere khaajeeniaa sach teraa paasaaraa |2|
English: True are Your treasures, and True is Your expanse. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਅਨੂਪੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਰਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: teraa roop agam hai anoop teraa darasaaraa |
English: Your Form is inaccessible, and Your Vision is incomparably beautiful.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਤੇਰਿਆ ਸੇਵਕਾ ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: hau kurabaanee teriaa sevakaa jina har naam piaaraa |3|
English: I am a sacrifice to Your servants; they love Your Name, O Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਭੇ ਇਛਾ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਜਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabhe ichhaa pooreea jaa paaeaa agam apaaraa |
English: All desires are fulfilled, when the Inaccessible and Infinite Lord is obtained.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਤੇਰਿਆ ਚਰਣਾ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੪੭॥
Transliteration: gur naanak miliaa paarabraham teriaa charanaa kau balihaaraa |4|1|47|
English: Guru Nanak has met the Supreme Lord God; I am a sacrifice to Your Feet. ||4||1||47||

[Ang 747 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੭ ॥
Transliteration: raag soohee mahalaa 5 ghar 7 |
English: Raag Soohee, Fifth Mehl, Seventh House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਤੂਹੈ ਮਨਾਇਹਿ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੋਹਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: teraa bhaanaa toohai manaaeihi jis no hohi deaalaa |
English: He alone obeys Your Will, O Lord, unto whom You are Merciful.

Gurbani: ਸਾਈ ਭਗਤਿ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੂੰ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saaee bhagat jo tudh bhaavai toon sarab jeea pratipaalaa |1|
English: That alone is devotional worship, which is pleasing to Your Will. You are the Cherisher of all beings. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਸੰਤਾ ਟੇਕ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: mere raam raae santaa ttek tumaaree |
English: O my Sovereign Lord, You are the Support of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai so paravaan man tan toohai adhaaree |1| rahaau |
English: Whatever pleases You, they accept. You are the sustenance of their minds and bodies. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: toon deaal kripaal kripaa nidh manasaa pooranahaaraa |
English: You are kind and compassionate, the treasure of mercy, the fulfiller of our hopes.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣਪਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਤੂੰ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bhagat tere sabh praanapat preetam toon bhagatan kaa piaaraa |2|
English: You are the Beloved Lord of life of all Your devotees; You are the Beloved of Your devotees. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਅਤਿ ਊਚਾ ਕੋਈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਤੇਰੀ ਭਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: too athaahu apaar at aoochaa koee avar na teree bhaate |
English: You are unfathomable, infinite, lofty and exalted. There is no one else like You.

Gurbani: ਇਹ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਵਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: eih aradaas hamaaree suaamee visar naahee sukhadaate |3|
English: This is my prayer, O my Lord and Master; may I never forget You, O Peace-giving Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਜੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: din rain saas saas gun gaavaa je suaamee tudh bhaavaa |
English: Day and night, with each and every breath, I sing Your Glorious Praises, if it is pleasing to Your Will.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੁਠੈ ਪਾਵਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੪੮॥
Transliteration: naam teraa sukh naanak maagai saahib tutthai paavaa |4|1|48|
English: Nanak begs for the peace of Your Name, O Lord and Master; as it is pleasing to Your Will, I shall attain it. ||4||1||48||

[Ang 747 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਤੂ ਕਬਹੂ ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੇਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: visareh naahee jit too kabahoo so thaan teraa kehaa |
English: Where is that place, where You are never forgotten, Lord?

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਜਿਤੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਵੈ ਦੇਹਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar jit tudh dhiaaee niramal hovai dehaa |1|
English: Twenty-four hours a day, they meditate on You, and their bodies become spotless and pure. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਹਉ ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਭਾਲਣ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: mere raam hau so thaan bhaalan aaeaa |
English: O my Lord, I have come searching for that place.

Gurbani: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਭਇਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਤਿਨੑ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: khojat khojat bheaa saadhasang tina saranaaee paaeaa |1| rahaau |
English: After seeking and searching, I found Sanctuary in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬੇਦ ਪੜੇ ਪੜਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਹਾਰੇ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: bed parre parr brahame haare ik til nahee keemat paaee |
English: Reading and reciting the Vedas, Brahma grew weary, but he did not find even a tiny bit of God's worth.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਬਿਲਲਾਤੇ ਤੇ ਭੀ ਮੋਹੇ ਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saadhik sidh fireh bilalaate te bhee mohe maaee |2|
English: The seekers and Siddhas wander around bewailing; they too are enticed by Maya. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦਸ ਅਉਤਾਰ ਰਾਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਵਰਤੇ ਮਹਾਦੇਵ ਅਉਧੂਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: das aautaar raaje hoe varate mahaadev aaudhootaa |
English: There were ten regal incarnations of Vishnu; and then there was Shiva, the renunciate.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨੑ ਭੀ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਤੇਰਾ ਲਾਇ ਥਕੇ ਬਿਭੂਤਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tina bhee ant na paaeo teraa laae thake bibhootaa |3|
English: He did not find Your limits either, although he grew weary of smearing his body with ashes. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਹਜ ਸੂਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਨਾਮ ਰਸ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤੀ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj sookh aanand naam ras har santee mangal gaaeaa |
English: Peace, poise and bliss are found in the subtle essence of the Naam. The Lord's Saints sing the songs of joy.

Gurbani: ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੨॥੪੯॥
Transliteration: safal darasan bhettio gur naanak taa man tan har har dhiaaeaa |4|2|49|
English: I have obtained the Fruitful Vision of Guru Nanak's Darshan, and with my mind and body I meditate on the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||2||49||

[Ang 747 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਪਾਖੰਡ ਜੋ ਦੀਸਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਜਮੁ ਜਾਗਾਤੀ ਲੂਟੈ ॥
Transliteration: karam dharam paakhandd jo deeseh tin jam jaagaatee loottai |
English: The religious rites, rituals and hypocrisies which are seen, are plundered by the Messenger of Death, the ultimate tax collector.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਬਾਣ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਾ ਨਿਮਖ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਜਿਤੁ ਛੂਟੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: nirabaan keeratan gaavahu karate kaa nimakh simarat jit chhoottai |1|
English: In the state of Nirvaanaa, sing the Kirtan of the Creator's Praises; contemplating Him in meditation, even for an instant, one is saved. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: santahu saagar paar utareeai |
English: O Saints, cross over the world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਬਚਨੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ ਸੋ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਤਰੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: je ko bachan kamaavai santan kaa so gur parasaadee tareeai |1| rahaau |
English: One who practices the Teachings of the Saints, by Guru's Grace, is carried across. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਮਜਨ ਇਸਨਾਨਾ ਇਸੁ ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: kott teerath majan isanaanaa is kal meh mail bhareejai |
English: Millions of cleansing baths at sacred shrines of pilgrimage only fill the mortal with filth in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saadhasang jo har gun gaavai so niramal kar leejai |2|
English: One who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, becomes spotlessly pure. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਭਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਇਨੑ ਪੜਿਆ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: bed kateb simrit sabh saasat ina parriaa mukat na hoee |
English: One may read all the books of the Vedas, the Bible, the Simritees and the Shaastras, but they will not bring liberation.

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਅਖਰੁ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਪੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ek akhar jo guramukh jaapai tis kee niramal soee |3|
English: One who, as Gurmukh, chants the One Word, acquires a spotlessly pure reputation. ||3||

Gurbani: ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣ ਸੂਦ ਵੈਸ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਚਹੁ ਵਰਨਾ ਕਉ ਸਾਝਾ ॥
Transliteration: khatree braahaman sood vais upades chahu varanaa kau saajhaa |
English: The four castes - the Kh'shaatriyas, Brahmins, Soodras and Vaishyas - are equal in respect to the teachings.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਉਧਰੈ ਸੋ ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਾਝਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੫੦॥
Transliteration: guramukh naam japai udharai so kal meh ghatt ghatt naanak maajhaa |4|3|50|
English: One who, as Gurmukh, chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is saved. In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, O Nanak, God is permeating the hearts of each and every being. ||4||3||50||

[Ang 748 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਨਹਿ ਓਇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: jo kichh karai soee prabh maaneh oe raam naam rang raate |
English: Whatever God causes to happen is accepted, by those who are attuned to the Love of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ਜਿਨੑ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਪਰਾਤੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tina kee sobhaa sabhanee thaaee jina prabh ke charan paraate |1|
English: Those who fall at the Feet of God are respected everywhere. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਾ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: mere raam har santaa jevadd na koee |
English: O my Lord, no one is as great as the Lord's Saints.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਾ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ ਸਿਉ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhagataa ban aaee prabh apane siau jal thal maheeal soee |1| rahaau |
English: The devotees are in harmony with their God; He is in the water, the land, and the sky. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਅਪ੍ਰਾਧੀ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਰੈ ਜਮੁ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: kott apraadhee santasang udharai jam taa kai nerr na aavai |
English: Millions of sinners have been saved in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; the Messenger of Death does not even approach them.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਬਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਆਣਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: janam janam kaa bichhurriaa hovai tina har siau aan milaavai |2|
English: Those who have been separated from the Lord, for countless incarnations, are reunited with the Lord again. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਕਾਟੈ ਸੰਤ ਸਰਣਿ ਜੋ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa moh bharam bhau kaattai sant saran jo aavai |
English: Attachment to Maya, doubt and fear are eradicated, when one enters the Sanctuary of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਜੇਹਾ ਮਨੋਰਥੁ ਕਰਿ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਸੋ ਸੰਤਨ ਤੇ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jehaa manorath kar aaraadhe so santan te paavai |3|
English: Whatever wishes one harbors, are obtained from the Saints. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕੇਤਕ ਬਰਨਉ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: jan kee mahimaa ketak barnau jo prabh apane bhaane |
English: How can I describe the glory of the Lord's humble servants? They are pleasing to their God.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਸੇ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਨਿਕਾਣੇ ॥੪॥੪॥੫੧॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak jin satigur bhettiaa se sabh te bhe nikaane |4|4|51|
English: Says Nanak, those who meet the True Guru, become independent of all obligations. ||4||4||51||

[Ang 748 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਤੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਹਾਥ ਦੇ ਰਾਖੇ ਪਏ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: mahaa agan te tudh haath de raakhe pe teree saranaaee |
English: Giving me Your Hand, You saved me from the terrible fire, when I sought Your Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਮਾਣੁ ਤਾਣੁ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹੋਰ ਦੂਜੀ ਆਸ ਚੁਕਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: teraa maan taan rid antar hor doojee aas chukaaee |1|
English: Deep within my heart, I respect Your strength; I have abandoned all other hopes. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਤੁਧੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਇਐ ਉਬਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: mere raam raae tudh chit aaeiai ubare |
English: O my Sovereign Lord, when You enter my consciousness, I am saved.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ਤੁਮੑਰਾ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ਉਧਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: teree ttek bharavaasaa tumaraa jap naam tumaaraa udhare |1| rahaau |
English: You are my support. I count on You. Meditating on You, I am saved. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੀਏ ਤੁਮੑ ਆਪਿ ਭਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: andh koop te kaadt lee tuma aap bhe kirapaalaa |
English: You pulled me up out of the deep, dark pit. You have become merciful to me.

Gurbani: ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਦੀਏ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saar samaal sarab sukh dee aap kare pratipaalaa |2|
English: You care for me, and bless me with total peace; You Yourself cherish me. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਪਣੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਛਡਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aapanee nadar kare paramesar bandhan kaatt chhaddaae |
English: The Transcendent Lord has blessed me with His Glance of Grace; breaking my bonds, He has delivered me.

Gurbani: ਆਪਣੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਈ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aapanee bhagat prabh aap karaaee aape sevaa laae |3|
English: God Himself inspires me to worship Him; He Himself inspires me to serve Him. ||3||

Gurbani: ਭਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਭੈ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਵਿਸੂਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: bharam geaa bhai moh binaase mittiaa sagal visooraa |
English: My doubts have gone, my fears and infatuations have been dispelled, and all my sorrows are gone.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੀ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੈ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥੪॥੫॥੫੨॥
Transliteration: naanak deaa karee sukhadaatai bhettiaa satigur pooraa |4|5|52|
English: O Nanak, the Lord, the Giver of peace has been merciful to me. I have met the Perfect True Guru. ||4||5||52||

[Ang 748 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਸੀਓ ਤਬ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਵਨ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jab kachh na seeo tab kiaa karataa kavan karam kar aaeaa |
English: When nothing existed, what deeds were being done? And what karma caused anyone to be born at all?

Gurbani: ਅਪਨਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: apanaa khel aap kar dekhai tthaakur rachan rachaaeaa |1|
English: The Lord Himself set His play in motion, and He Himself beholds it. He created the Creation. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਮੁਝ ਤੇ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: mere raam raae mujh te kachhoo na hoee |
