English: O my Sovereign Lord, I cannot do anything at all by myself.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aape karataa aap karaae sarab nirantar soee |1| rahaau |
English: He Himself is the Creator, He Himself is the Cause. He is pervading deep within all. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗਣਤੀ ਗਣੀ ਨ ਛੂਟੈ ਕਤਹੂ ਕਾਚੀ ਦੇਹ ਇਆਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: ganatee ganee na chhoottai katahoo kaachee deh eaanee |
English: If my account were to be judged, I would never be saved. My body is transitory and ignorant.

Gurbani: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਖਸ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kripaa karahu prabh karanaihaare teree bakhas niraalee |2|
English: Take pity upon me, O Creator Lord God; Your Forgiving Grace is singular and unique. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀਤੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਤੁਹੀ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jant sabh tere keete ghatt ghatt tuhee dhiaaeeai |
English: You created all beings and creatures. Each and every heart meditates on You.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: teree gat mit toohai jaaneh kudarat keem na paaeeai |3|
English: Your condition and expanse are known only to You; the value of Your creative omnipotence cannot be estimated. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਗੁਣੁ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਅਜਾਣੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: niragun mugadh ajaan agiaanee karam dharam nahee jaanaa |
English: I am worthless, foolish, thoughtless and ignorant. I know nothing about good actions and righteous living.

Gurbani: ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਮਿਠਾ ਲਗੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥੪॥੬॥੫੩॥
Transliteration: deaa karahu naanak gun gaavai mitthaa lagai teraa bhaanaa |4|6|53|
English: Take pity on Nanak, that he may sing Your Glorious Praises; and that Your Will may seem sweet to him. ||4||6||53||

[Ang 748 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਭਾਗਠੜੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ਜਿਨੑ ਘਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: bhaagattharre har sant tumaare jina ghar dhan har naamaa |
English: Your Saints are very fortunate; their homes are filled with the wealth of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਗਣੀ ਸੇਈ ਇਹ ਆਏ ਸਫਲ ਤਿਨਾ ਕੇ ਕਾਮਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: paravaan ganee seee ih aae safal tinaa ke kaamaa |1|
English: Their birth is approved, and their actions are fruitful. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: mere raam har jan kai hau bal jaaee |
English: O my Lord, I am a sacrifice to the humble servants of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕੇਸਾ ਕਾ ਕਰਿ ਚਵਰੁ ਢੁਲਾਵਾ ਚਰਣ ਧੂੜਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kesaa kaa kar chavar dtulaavaa charan dhoorr mukh laaee |1| rahaau |
English: I make my hair into a fan, and wave it over them; I apply the dust of their feet to my face. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਹਹੂ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਨ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ ਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: janam maran duhahoo meh naahee jan praupakaaree aae |
English: Those generous, humble beings are above both birth and death.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਇਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਲੈਨਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jeea daan de bhagatee laaein har siau lain milaae |2|
English: They give the gift of the soul, and practice devotional worship; they inspire others to meet the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਅਮਰੁ ਸਚੀ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀ ਸਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa amar sachee paatisaahee sache setee raate |
English: True are their commands, and true are their empires; they are attuned to the Truth.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਸੇ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਾਤੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sachaa sukh sachee vaddiaaee jis ke se tin jaate |3|
English: True is their happiness, and true is their greatness. They know the Lord, to whom they belong. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪਖਾ ਫੇਰੀ ਪਾਣੀ ਢੋਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਪੀਸਣੁ ਪੀਸਿ ਕਮਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: pakhaa feree paanee dtovaa har jan kai peesan pees kamaavaa |
English: I wave the fan over them, carry water for them, and grind corn for the humble servants of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸਿ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਦੇਖਣੁ ਪਾਵਾ ॥੪॥੭॥੫੪॥
Transliteration: naanak kee prabh paas benantee tere jan dekhan paavaa |4|7|54|
English: Nanak offers this prayer to God - please, grant me the sight of Your humble servants. ||4||7||54||

[Ang 749 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham paramesar satigur aape karanaihaaraa |
English: The True Guru is the Transcendent Lord, the Supreme Lord God; He Himself is the Creator Lord.

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਧੂੜਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: charan dhoorr teree sevak maagai tere darasan kau balihaaraa |1|
English: Your servant begs for the dust of Your feet. I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: mere raam raae jiau raakheh tiau raheeai |
English: O my Sovereign Lord, as You keep me, so do I remain.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵਹਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਿਤਾ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tudh bhaavai taa naam japaaveh sukh teraa ditaa laheeai |1| rahaau |
English: When it pleases You, I chant Your Name. You alone can grant me peace. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਇਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: mukat bhugat jugat teree sevaa jis toon aap karaaeihi |
English: Liberation, comfort and proper lifestyle come from serving You; You alone cause us to serve You.

Gurbani: ਤਹਾ ਬੈਕੁੰਠੁ ਜਹ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਸਰਧਾ ਲਾਇਹਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tahaa baikuntth jeh keeratan teraa toon aape saradhaa laaeihi |2|
English: That place is heaven, where the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises are sung. You Yourself instill faith into us. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀਵਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: simar simar simar naam jeevaa tan man hoe nihaalaa |
English: Meditating, meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Naam, I live; my mind and body are enraptured.

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਤੇਰੇ ਧੋਇ ਧੋਇ ਪੀਵਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: charan kamal tere dhoe dhoe peevaa mere satigur deen deaalaa |3|
English: I wash Your Lotus Feet, and drink in this water, O my True Guru, O Merciful to the meek. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਜਾਈ ਉਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਤੁਮਰੈ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kurabaan jaaee us velaa suhaavee jit tumarai duaarai aaeaa |
English: I am a sacrifice to that most wonderful time when I came to Your Door.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੮॥੫੫॥
Transliteration: naanak kau prabh bhe kripaalaa satigur pooraa paaeaa |4|8|55|
English: God has become compassionate to Nanak; I have found the Perfect True Guru. ||4||8||55||

[Ang 749 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਏ ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਸੋ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: tudh chit aae mahaa anandaa jis visareh so mar jaae |
English: When You come to mind, I am totally in bliss. One who forgets You might just as well be dead.

Gurbani: ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਸੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: deaal hoveh jis aoopar karate so tudh sadaa dhiaae |1|
English: That being, whom You bless with Your Mercy, O Creator Lord, constantly meditates on You. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੂੰ ਮੈ ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: mere saahib toon mai maan nimaanee |
English: O my Lord and Master, You are the honor of the dishonored such as me.

Gurbani: ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਕਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ ਆਗੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aradaas karee prabh apane aagai sun sun jeevaa teree baanee |1| rahaau |
English: I offer my prayer to You, God; listening, listening to the Word of Your Bani, I live. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਧੂੜਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਹੋਵਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: charan dhoorr tere jan kee hovaa tere darasan kau bal jaaee |
English: May I become the dust of the feet of Your humble servants. I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਚਨ ਰਿਦੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਤਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: amrit bachan ridai ur dhaaree tau kirapaa te sang paaee |2|
English: I enshrine Your Ambrosial Word within my heart. By Your Grace, I have found the Company of the Holy. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਹਿ ਸਾਰੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: antar kee gat tudh peh saaree tudh jevadd avar na koee |
English: I place the state of my inner being before You; there is no other as great as You.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਾਇ ਲੈਹਿ ਸੋ ਲਾਗੈ ਭਗਤੁ ਤੁਹਾਰਾ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jis no laae laihi so laagai bhagat tuhaaraa soee |3|
English: He alone is attached, whom You attach; he alone is Your devotee. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਮਾਗਉ ਇਕੁ ਦਾਨਾ ਸਾਹਿਬਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: due kar jorr maagau ik daanaa saahib tutthai paavaa |
English: With my palms pressed together, I beg for this one gift; O my Lord and Master, if it pleases You, I shall obtain it.

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ॥੪॥੯॥੫੬॥
Transliteration: saas saas naanak aaraadhe aatth pehar gun gaavaa |4|9|56|
English: With each and every breath, Nanak adores You; twenty-four hours a day, I sing Your Glorious Praises. ||4||9||56||

[Ang 749 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਤੂੰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਕੈਸਾ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jis ke sir aoopar toon suaamee so dukh kaisaa paavai |
English: When You stand over our heads, O Lord and Master, how can we suffer in pain?

Gurbani: ਬੋਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦਿ ਮਾਤਾ ਮਰਣਾ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bol na jaanai maaeaa mad maataa maranaa cheet na aavai |1|
English: The mortal being does not know how to chant Your Name - he is intoxicated with the wine of Maya, and the thought of death does not even enter his mind. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਤੂੰ ਸੰਤਾ ਕਾ ਸੰਤ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: mere raam raae toon santaa kaa sant tere |
English: O my Sovereign Lord, You belong to the Saints, and the Saints belong to You.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਭਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ਨੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tere sevak kau bhau kichh naahee jam nahee aavai nere |1| rahaau |
English: Your servant is not afraid of anything; the Messenger of Death cannot even approach him. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਾ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo terai rang raate suaamee tina kaa janam maran dukh naasaa |
English: Those who are attuned to Your Love, O my Lord and Master, are released from the pains of birth and death.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੀ ਬਖਸ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਿਲਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: teree bakhas na mettai koee satigur kaa dilaasaa |2|
English: No one can erase Your Blessings; the True Guru has given me this assurance. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਆਰਾਧਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: naam dhiaaein sukh fal paaein aatth pehar aaraadheh |
English: Those who meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, obtain the fruits of peace. Twenty-four hours a day, they worship and adore You.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਭਰਵਾਸੈ ਪੰਚ ਦੁਸਟ ਲੈ ਸਾਧਹਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: teree saran terai bharavaasai panch dusatt lai saadheh |3|
English: In Your Sanctuary, with Your Support, they subdue the five villains. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: giaan dhiaan kichh karam na jaanaa saar na jaanaa teree |
English: I know nothing about wisdom, meditation and good deeds; I know nothing about Your excellence.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਵਡਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਲ ਰਾਖੀ ਮੇਰੀ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੫੭॥
Transliteration: sabh te vaddaa satigur naanak jin kal raakhee meree |4|10|57|
English: Guru Nanak is the greatest of all; He saved my honor in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||4||10||57||

[Ang 750 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਇਆ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sagal tiaag gur saranee aaeaa raakhahu raakhanahaare |
English: Renouncing everything, I have come to the Guru's Sanctuary; save me, O my Savior Lord!

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਤੂ ਲਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਹਮ ਲਾਗਹ ਕਿਆ ਏਹਿ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jit too laaveh tith ham laagah kiaa ehi jant vichaare |1|
English: Whatever You link me to, to that I am linked; what can this poor creature do? ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਜੀ ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: mere raam jee toon prabh antarajaamee |
English: O my Dear Lord God, You are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa guradev deaalaa gun gaavaa nit suaamee |1| rahaau |
English: Be Merciful to me, O Divine, Compassionate Guru, that I may constantly sing the Glorious Praises of my Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਭਉ ਤਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar prabh apanaa dhiaaeeai gur prasaad bhau tareeai |
English: Twenty-four hours a day, I meditate on my God; by Guru's Grace, I cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਹੋਈਐ ਸਭ ਰੇਣਾ ਜੀਵਤਿਆ ਇਉ ਮਰੀਐ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aap tiaag hoeeai sabh renaa jeevatiaa iau mareeai |2|
English: Renouncing self-conceit, I have become the dust of all men's feet; in this way, I die, while I am still alive. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਜਗ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਉ ਜਾਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: safal janam tis kaa jag bheetar saadhasang naau jaape |
English: How fruitful is the life of that being in this world, who chants the Name in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਜਿਸੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sagal manorath tis ke pooran jis deaa kare prabh aape |3|
English: All desires are fulfilled, for the one who is blessed with God's Kindness and Mercy. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: deen deaal kripaal prabh suaamee teree saran deaalaa |
English: O Merciful to the meek, Kind and Compassionate Lord God, I seek Your Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਰਵਾਲਾ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੫੮॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa apanaa naam deejai naanak saadh ravaalaa |4|11|58|
English: Take pity upon me, and bless me with Your Name. Nanak is the dust of the feet of the Holy. ||4||11||58||

[Ang 750 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raag soohee asattapadeea mahalaa 1 ghar 1 |
English: Raag Soohee, Ashtapadee, First Mehl, First House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਮੈ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: sabh avagan mai gun nahee koee |
English: I am totally without virtue; I have no virtue at all.

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਕੰਤ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kiau kar kant milaavaa hoee |1|
English: How can I meet my Husband Lord? ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਮੈ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਬੰਕੇ ਨੈਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: naa mai roop na banke nainaa |
English: I have no beauty, no enticing eyes.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਕੁਲ ਢੰਗੁ ਨ ਮੀਠੇ ਬੈਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: naa kul dtang na meetthe bainaa |1| rahaau |
English: I do not have a noble family, good manners or a sweet voice. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਹਜਿ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਕਰਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj seegaar kaaman kar aavai |
English: The soul-bride adorns herself with peace and poise.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਜਾ ਕੰਤੈ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: taa sohaagan jaa kantai bhaavai |2|
English: But she is a happy soul-bride, only if her Husband Lord is pleased with her. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਕਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: naa tis roop na rekhiaa kaaee |
English: He has no form or feature;

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਿ ਨ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਿਮਰਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ant na saahib simariaa jaaee |3|
English: at the very last instant, he cannot suddenly be contemplated. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: surat mat naahee chaturaaee |
English: I have no understanding, intellect or cleverness.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh laavahu paaee |4|
English: Have Mercy upon me, God, and attach me to Your Feet. ||4||

Gurbani: ਖਰੀ ਸਿਆਣੀ ਕੰਤ ਨ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: kharee siaanee kant na bhaanee |
English: She may be very clever, but this does not please her Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਲਾਗੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੀ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: maaeaa laagee bharam bhulaanee |5|
English: Attached to Maya, she is deluded by doubt. ||5||

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਈ ਤਾ ਕੰਤ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: haumai jaaee taa kant samaaee |
English: But if she gets rid of her ego, then she merges in her Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: tau kaaman piaare nav nidh paaee |6|
English: Only then can the soul-bride obtain the nine treasures of her Beloved. ||6||

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਨਮ ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: anik janam bichhurat dukh paaeaa |
English: Separated from You for countless incarnations, I have suffered in pain.

Gurbani: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: kar geh lehu preetam prabh raaeaa |7|
English: Please take my hand, O my Beloved Sovereign Lord God. ||7||

Gurbani: ਭਣਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਹੁ ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: bhanat naanak sahu hai bhee hosee |
English: Prays Nanak, the Lord is, and shall always be.

Gurbani: ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਤੈ ਰਾਵੇਸੀ ॥੮॥੧॥
Transliteration: jai bhaavai piaaraa tai raavesee |8|1|
English: She alone is ravished and enjoyed, with whom the Beloved Lord is pleased. ||8||1||

[Ang 751 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 1 ghar 9 |
English: Soohee, First Mehl, Ninth House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਕਚਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਕਾ ਥੋੜੜਿਆ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: kachaa rang kasunbh kaa thorrarriaa din chaar jeeo |
English: The color of safflower is transitory; it lasts for only a few days.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੀਆ ਠਗਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: vin naavai bhram bhuleea tthag mutthee koorriaar jeeo |
English: Without the Name, the false woman is deluded by doubt and plundered by thieves.

Gurbani: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਦੂਜੀ ਵਾਰ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sache setee ratiaa janam na doojee vaar jeeo |1|
English: But those who are attuned to the True Lord, are not reincarnated again. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰੰਗੇ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਰੰਗੀਐ ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: range kaa kiaa rangeeai jo rate rang laae jeeo |
English: How can one who is already dyed in the color of the Lord's Love, be colored any other color?

Gurbani: ਰੰਗਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: rangan vaalaa seveeai sache siau chit laae jeeo |1| rahaau |
English: So serve God the Dyer, and focus your consciousness on the True Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਜੇ ਭਵਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: chaare kunddaa je bhaveh bin bhaagaa dhan naeh jeeo |
English: You wander around in the four directions, but without the good fortune of destiny, you shall never obtain wealth.

Gurbani: ਅਵਗਣਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਜੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਬਧਿਕ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: avagan mutthee je fireh badhik thaae na paeh jeeo |
English: If you are plundered by corruption and vice, you shall wander around, but like a fugitive, you shall find no place of rest.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur raakhe se ubare sabad rate man maeh jeeo |2|
English: Only those who are protected by the Guru are saved; their minds are attuned to the Word of the Shabad. ||2||

Gurbani: ਚਿਟੇ ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਕਪੜੇ ਮੈਲੇ ਚਿਤ ਕਠੋਰ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: chitte jin ke kaparre maile chit katthor jeeo |
English: Those who wear white clothes, but have filthy and stone-hearted minds,

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਚੋਰ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: tin mukh naam na aoopajai doojai viaape chor jeeo |
English: may chant the Lord's Name with their mouths, but they are engrossed in duality; they are thieves.

Gurbani: ਮੂਲੁ ਨ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੇ ਪਸੂਆ ਸੇ ਢੋਰ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: mool na boojheh aapanaa se pasooaa se dtor jeeo |3|
English: They do not understand their own roots; they are beasts. They are just animals! ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਮਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਮੰਗੈ ਸੁਖ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: nit nit khuseea man kare nit nit mangai sukh jeeo |
English: Constantly, continually, the mortal seeks pleasures. Constantly, continually, he begs for peace.

Gurbani: ਕਰਤਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਲਗਹਿ ਦੁਖ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: karataa chit na aavee fir fir lageh dukh jeeo |
English: But he does not think of the Creator Lord, and so he is overtaken by pain, again and again.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਦਾਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਕੈਸੀ ਭੁਖ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: sukh dukh daataa man vasai tith tan kaisee bhukh jeeo |4|
English: But one, within whose mind the Giver of pleasure and pain dwells - how can his body feel any need? ||4||

Gurbani: ਬਾਕੀ ਵਾਲਾ ਤਲਬੀਐ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: baakee vaalaa talabeeai sir maare jandaar jeeo |
English: One who has a karmic debt to pay off is summoned, and the Messenger of Death smashes his head.

Gurbani: ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੈ ਦੇਵਣਾ ਪੁਛੈ ਕਰਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: lekhaa mangai devanaa puchhai kar beechaar jeeo |
English: When his account is called for, it has to be given. After it is reviewed, payment is demanded.

Gurbani: ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਲਿਵ ਉਬਰੈ ਬਖਸੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: sache kee liv ubarai bakhase bakhasanahaar jeeo |5|
English: Only love for the True One will save you; the Forgiver forgives. ||5||

Gurbani: ਅਨ ਕੋ ਕੀਜੈ ਮਿਤੜਾ ਖਾਕੁ ਰਲੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: an ko keejai mitarraa khaak ralai mar jaae jeeo |
English: If you make any friend other than God, you shall die and mingle with the dust.

Gurbani: ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਭੁਲਿ ਭੁਲਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: bahu rang dekh bhulaaeaa bhul bhul aavai jaae jeeo |
English: Gazing upon the many games of love, you are beguiled and bewildered; you come and go in reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਨਦਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤੇ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਨਦਰੀ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: nadar prabhoo te chhutteeai nadaree mel milaae jeeo |6|
English: Only by God's Grace can you be saved. By His Grace, He unites in His Union. ||6||

Gurbani: ਗਾਫਲ ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਹੂਣਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਭਾਲਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: gaafal giaan vihooniaa gur bin giaan na bhaal jeeo |
English: O careless one, you are totally lacking any wisdom; do not seek wisdom without the Guru.

Gurbani: ਖਿੰਚੋਤਾਣਿ ਵਿਗੁਚੀਐ ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਦੁਇ ਨਾਲਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: khinchotaan vigucheeai buraa bhalaa due naal jeeo |
English: By indecision and inner conflict, you shall come to ruin. Good and bad both pull at you.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਭੈ ਰਤਿਆ ਸਭ ਜੋਹੀ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: bin sabadai bhai ratiaa sabh johee jamakaal jeeo |7|
English: Without being attuned to the Word of the Shabad and the Fear of God, all come under the gaze of the Messenger of Death. ||7||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਧਾਰਿਆ ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇਇ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: jin kar kaaran dhaariaa sabhasai dee aadhaar jeeo |
English: He who created the creation and sustains it, gives sustenance to all.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: so kiau manahu visaareeai sadaa sadaa daataar jeeo |
English: How can you forget Him from your mind? He is the Great Giver, forever and ever.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਨਿਧਾਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੮॥੧॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naam na veesarai nidhaaraa aadhaar jeeo |8|1|2|
English: Nanak shall never forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the Support of the unsupported. ||8||1||2||

[Ang 751 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਕਾਫੀ ਘਰੁ ੧੦ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 1 kaafee ghar 10 |
English: Soohee, First Mehl, Kaafee, Tenth House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਦੁਲੰਭੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: maanas janam dulanbh guramukh paaeaa |
English: For if you depart with virtue, then pain shall never afflict you. ||5||

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਚੁਲੰਭੁ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: man tan hoe chulanbh je satigur bhaaeaa |1|
English: The mind and body are dyed in the deep red color of devotional love, if it pleases the True Guru. ||1||

Gurbani: ਚਲੈ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਿ ਵਖਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: chalai janam savaar vakhar sach lai |
English: He departs with his life embellished and successful, taking the merchandise of the True Name.

Gurbani: ਪਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਭੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: pat paae darabaar satigur sabad bhai |1| rahaau |
English: He is honored in the Darbaar, the Royal Court, of the Lord, through the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru, and the Fear of God. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: man tan sach salaeh saache man bhaaeaa |
English: One who praises the True Lord with his mind and body, pleases the Mind of the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਲਾਲਿ ਰਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: laal rataa man maaniaa gur pooraa paaeaa |2|
English: Attuned to the Beloved Lord, the mind is appeased, and finds the Perfect Guru. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੂ ਵਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: hau jeevaa gun saar antar too vasai |
English: I live, by cherishing Your Glorious Virtues; You dwell deep within me.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਵਸਹਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਸਿ ਰਸੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: toon vaseh man maeh sahaje ras rasai |3|
English: You dwell within my mind, and so it naturally celebrates in joyful delight. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮੂਰਖ ਮਨ ਸਮਝਾਇ ਆਖਉ ਕੇਤੜਾ ॥
Transliteration: moorakh man samajhaae aakhau ketarraa |
English: O my foolish mind, how can I teach and instruct you?

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗੇਤੜਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: guramukh har gun gaae rang rangetarraa |4|
English: As Gurmukh, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and so become attuned to His Love. ||4||

Gurbani: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਆਪਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: nit nit ridai samaal preetam aapanaa |
English: Continually, continuously, remember and cherish your Beloved Lord in your heart.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਚਲਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਲਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੰਤਾਪਣਾ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: je chaleh gun naal naahee dukh santaapanaa |5|
English: For if you depart with virtue, then pain shall never afflict you. ||5||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣਾ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh bharam bhulaanaa naa tis rang hai |
English: The self-willed manmukh wanders around, deluded by doubt; he does not enshrine love for the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਰਸੀ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਡਾਣਾ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਭੰਗੁ ਹੈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: marasee hoe viddaanaa man tan bhang hai |6|
English: He dies as a stranger to his own self, and his mind and body are spoiled. ||6||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ਲਾਹਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur kee kaar kamaae laahaa ghar aaniaa |
English: Performing service to the Guru, you shall go home with the profit.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: gurabaanee nirabaan sabad pachhaaniaa |7|
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Bani, and the Shabad, the Word of God, the state of Nirvaanaa is attained. ||7||

Gurbani: ਇਕ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: eik naanak kee aradaas je tudh bhaavasee |
English: Nanak makes this one prayer: if it pleases Your Will,

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਸੀ ॥੮॥੧॥੩॥
Transliteration: mai deejai naam nivaas har gun gaavasee |8|1|3|
English: bless me with a home in Your Name, Lord, that I may sing Your Glorious Praises. ||8||1||3||

[Ang 752 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 1 |
English: Soohee, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਆਰਣਿ ਲੋਹਾ ਪਾਇ ਭੰਨਿ ਘੜਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: jiau aaran lohaa paae bhan gharraaeeai |
English: As iron is melted in the forge and re-shaped,

Gurbani: ਤਿਉ ਸਾਕਤੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਇ ਭਵੈ ਭਵਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tiau saakat jonee paae bhavai bhavaaeeai |1|
English: so is the godless materialist reincarnated, and forced to wander aimlessly. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: bin boojhe sabh dukh dukh kamaavanaa |
English: Without understanding, everything is suffering, earning only more suffering.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਵਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: haumai aavai jaae bharam bhulaavanaa |1| rahaau |
English: In his ego, he comes and goes, wandering in confusion, deluded by doubt. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਖਣਹਾਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: toon guramukh rakhanahaar har naam dhiaaeeai |
English: You save those who are Gurmukh, O Lord, through meditation on Your Naam.

Gurbani: ਮੇਲਹਿ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਰਜਾਇ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: meleh tujheh rajaae sabad kamaaeeai |2|
English: You blend with Yourself, by Your Will, those who practice the Word of the Shabad. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: toon kar kar vekheh aap dehi su paaeeai |
English: You created the Creation, and You Yourself gaze upon it; whatever You give, is received.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਿ ਦਰਿ ਬੀਨਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: too dekheh thaap uthaap dar beenaaeeai |3|
English: You watch, establish and disestablish; You keep all in Your vision at Your Door. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦੇਹੀ ਹੋਵਗਿ ਖਾਕੁ ਪਵਣੁ ਉਡਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: dehee hovag khaak pavan uddaaeeai |
English: The body shall turn to dust, and the soul shall fly away.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਕਿਥੈ ਘਰੁ ਅਉਤਾਕੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: eihu kithai ghar aautaak mehal na paaeeai |4|
English: So where are their homes and resting places now? They do not find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, either. ||4||

Gurbani: ਦਿਹੁ ਦੀਵੀ ਅੰਧ ਘੋਰੁ ਘਬੁ ਮੁਹਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: dihu deevee andh ghor ghab muhaaeeai |
English: In the pitch darkness of broad daylight, their wealth is being plundered.

Gurbani: ਗਰਬਿ ਮੁਸੈ ਘਰੁ ਚੋਰੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਰੂਆਈਐ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: garab musai ghar chor kis rooaaeeai |5|
English: Pride is looting their homes like a thief; where can they file their complaint? ||5||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚੋਰੁ ਨ ਲਾਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਜਗਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh chor na laag har naam jagaaeeai |
English: The thief does not break into the home of the Gurmukh; he is awake in the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਆਗਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਦੀਪਾਈਐ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: sabad nivaaree aag jot deepaaeeai |6|
English: The Word of the Shabad puts out the fire of desire; God's Light illuminates and enlightens. ||6||

Gurbani: ਲਾਲੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਬੁਝਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: laal ratan har naam gur surat bujhaaeeai |
English: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is a jewel, a ruby; the Guru has taught me the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਹਕਾਮੁ ਜੇ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: sadaa rahai nihakaam je guramat paaeeai |7|
English: One who follows the Guru's Teachings remains forever free of desire. ||7||

Gurbani: ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: raat dihai har naau man vasaaeeai |
English: Night and day, enshrine the Lord's Name within your mind.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਈਐ ॥੮॥੨॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak mel milaae je tudh bhaaeeai |8|2|4|
English: Please unite Nanak in Union, O Lord, if it is pleasing to Your Will. ||8||2||4||

[Ang 752 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 1 |
English: Soohee, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: manahu na naam visaar ahinis dhiaaeeai |
English: Never forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord, from your mind; night and day, meditate on it.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਤਿਵੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jiau raakheh kirapaa dhaar tivai sukh paaeeai |1|
English: As You keep me, in Your Merciful Grace, so do I find peace. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਕੁਟੀ ਟੋਹਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: mai andhule har naam lakuttee ttohanee |
English: I am blind, and the Lord's Name is my cane.

Gurbani: ਰਹਉ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਨ ਮੋਹੈ ਮੋਹਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: rhau saahib kee ttek na mohai mohanee |1| rahaau |
English: I remain under the Sheltering Support of my Lord and Master; I am not enticed by Maya the enticer. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਹ ਨਾਲਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੇਖਾਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jeh dekhau teh naal gur dekhaaliaa |
English: Wherever I look, there the Guru has shown me that God is always with me.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭਾਲਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: antar baahar bhaal sabad nihaaliaa |2|
English: Searching inwardly and outwardly as well, I came to see Him, through the Word of the Shabad. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੇਵੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: sevee satigur bhaae naam niranjanaa |
English: So serve the True Guru with love, through the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਰਜਾਇ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tudh bhaavai tivai rajaae bharam bhau bhanjanaa |3|
English: As it pleases You, so by Your Will, You destroy my doubts and fears. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਨਮਤ ਹੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਮਰਣਾ ਆਇ ਕੈ ॥
Transliteration: janamat hee dukh laagai maranaa aae kai |
English: At the very moment of birth, he is afflicted with pain, and in the end, he comes only to die.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਕੈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: janam maran paravaan har gun gaae kai |4|
English: Birth and death are validated and approved, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੂ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤੁਧ ਹੀ ਸਾਜਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau naahee too hoveh tudh hee saajiaa |
English: When there is no ego, there You are; You fashioned all of this.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਜਿਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: aape thaap uthaap sabad nivaajiaa |5|
English: You Yourself establish and disestablish; through the Word of Your Shabad, You elevate and exalt. ||5||

Gurbani: ਦੇਹੀ ਭਸਮ ਰੁਲਾਇ ਨ ਜਾਪੀ ਕਹ ਗਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: dehee bhasam rulaae na jaapee keh geaa |
English: When the body rolls in the dust, it is not known where the soul has gone.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ਸੋ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: aape rahiaa samaae so visamaad bheaa |6|
English: He Himself is permeating and pervading; this is wonderful and amazing! ||6||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਨਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੂਰਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸਭ ਤੂ ਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: toon naahee prabh door jaaneh sabh too hai |
English: You are not far away, God; You know everything.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੇਖਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਭੀ ਤੂ ਹੈ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: guramukh vekh hadoor antar bhee too hai |7|
English: The Gurmukh sees You ever-present; You are deep within the nucleus of our inner self. ||7||

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: mai deejai naam nivaas antar saant hoe |
English: Please, bless me with a home in Your Name; may my inner self be at peace.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਇ ॥੮॥੩॥੫॥
Transliteration: gun gaavai naanak daas satigur mat dee |8|3|5|
English: May slave Nanak sing Your Glorious Praises; O True Guru, please share the Teachings with me. ||8||3||5||

[Ang 753 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: raag soohee mahalaa 3 ghar 1 asattapadeea |
English: Raag Soohee, Third Mehl, First House, Ashtpadheeyaa:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: naamai hee te sabh kichh hoaa bin satigur naam na jaapai |
English: Everything comes from the Naam, the Name of the Lord; without the True Guru, the Naam is not experienced.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਚਾਖੇ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa sabad mahaa ras meetthaa bin chaakhe saad na jaapai |
English: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is the sweetest and most sublime essence, but without tasting it, its flavor cannot be experienced.

Gurbani: ਕਉਡੀ ਬਦਲੈ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਚੀਨਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਆਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: kauddee badalai janam gavaaeaa cheenas naahee aapai |
English: He wastes this human life in exchange for a mere shell; he does not understand his own self.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: guramukh hovai taa eko jaanai haumai dukh na santaapai |1|
English: But, if he becomes Gurmukh, then he comes to know the One Lord, and the disease of egotism does not afflict him. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਅਪਣੇ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: balihaaree gur apane vittahu jin saache siau liv laaee |
English: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, who has lovingly attached me to the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੁ ਚੀਨਿੑ ਆਤਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sabad cheena aatam paragaasiaa sahaje rahiaa samaaee |1| rahaau |
English: Concentrating on the Word of the Shabad, the soul is illumined and enlightened. I remain absorbed in celestial ecstasy. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh gaavai guramukh boojhai guramukh sabad beechaare |
English: The Gurmukh sings the Praises of the Lord; the Gurmukh understands. The Gurmukh contemplates the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jeeo pindd sabh gur te upajai guramukh kaaraj savaare |
English: Body and soul are totally rejuvenated through the Guru; the Gurmukh's affairs are resolved in his favor.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧਾ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਟੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh andhaa andh kamaavai bikh khatte sansaare |
English: The blind self-willed manmukh acts blindly, and earns only poison in this world.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohi sadaa dukh paae bin gur at piaare |2|
English: Enticed by Maya, he suffers in constant pain, without the most Beloved Guru. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਚਾਲੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: soee sevak je satigur seve chaalai satigur bhaae |
English: He alone is a selfless servant, who serves the True Guru, and walks in harmony with the True Guru's Will.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਹੈ ਸਾਚੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: saachaa sabad sifat hai saachee saachaa man vasaae |
English: The True Shabad, the Word of God, is the True Praise of God; enshrine the True Lord within your mind.

Gurbani: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਖੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sachee baanee guramukh aakhai haumai vichahu jaae |
English: The Gurmukh speaks the True Word of Gurbani, and egotism departs from within.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਦਾਤਾ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aape daataa karam hai saachaa saachaa sabad sunaae |3|
English: He Himself is the Giver, and True are His actions. He proclaims the True Word of the Shabad. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਘਾਲੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖਟੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh ghaale guramukh khatte guramukh naam japaae |
English: The Gurmukh works, and the Gurmukh earns; the Gurmukh inspires others to chant the Naam.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa alipat saachai rang raataa gur kai sehaj subhaae |
English: He is forever unattached, imbued with the Love of the True Lord, intuitively in harmony with the Guru.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਕੂੜੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਬੀਜੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh sad hee koorro bolai bikh beejai bikh khaae |
English: The self-willed manmukh always tells lies; he plants the seeds of poison, and eats only poison.

Gurbani: ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ਬਾਧਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਦਾਧਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਵਣੁ ਛਡਾਏ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jamakaal baadhaa trisanaa daadhaa bin gur kavan chhaddaae |4|
English: He is bound and gagged by the Messenger of Death, and burnt in the fire of desire; who can save him, except the Guru? ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਤ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਵਣੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa teerath jit sat sar naavan guramukh aap bujhaae |
English: True is that place of pilgrimage, where one bathes in the pool of Truth, and achieves self-realization as Gurmukh. The Gurmukh understands his own self.

Gurbani: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਤਿਤੁ ਨਾਤੈ ਮਲੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: atthasatth teerath gur sabad dikhaae tith naatai mal jaae |
English: The Lord has shown that the Word of the Guru's Shabad is the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage; bathing in it, filth is washed away.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚਾ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾ ਮਲੁ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa sabad sachaa hai niramal naa mal lagai na laae |
English: True and Immaculate is the True Word of His Shabad; no filth touches or clings to Him.

Gurbani: ਸਚੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਚੀ ਸਾਲਾਹ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: sachee sifat sachee saalaah poore gur te paae |5|
English: True Praise, True Devotional Praise, is obtained from the Perfect Guru. ||5||

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੇਰਾ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: tan man sabh kichh har tis keraa duramat kehan na jaae |
English: Body, mind, everything belongs to the Lord; but the evil-minded ones cannot even say this.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: hukam hovai taa niramal hovai haumai vichahu jaae |
English: If such is the Hukam of the Lord's Command, then one becomes pure and spotless, and the ego is taken away from within.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਖੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਚਾਖੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur kee saakhee sahaje chaakhee trisanaa agan bujhaae |
English: I have intuitively tasted the Guru's Teachings, and the fire of my desire has been quenched.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad raataa sahaje maataa sahaje rahiaa samaae |6|
English: Attuned to the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one is naturally intoxicated, merging imperceptibly into the Lord. ||6||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam sat kar jaanai gur kai bhaae piaare |
English: The Name of the Lord is known as True, through the Love of the Beloved Guru.

Gurbani: ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sachee vaddiaaee gur te paaee sachai naae piaare |
English: True Glorious Greatness is obtained from the Guru, through the Beloved True Name.

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਸਚਾ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: eko sachaa sabh meh varatai viralaa ko veechaare |
English: The One True Lord is permeating and pervading among all; how rare is the one who contemplates this.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਤਾ ਬਖਸੇ ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: aape mel le taa bakhase sachee bhagat savaare |7|
English: The Lord Himself unites us in Union, and forgives us; He embellishes us with true devotional worship. ||7||

Gurbani: ਸਭੋ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: sabho sach sach sach varatai guramukh koee jaanai |
English: All is Truth; Truth, and Truth alone is pervading; how rare is the Gurmukh who knows this.

Gurbani: ਜੰਮਣ ਮਰਣਾ ਹੁਕਮੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: jaman maranaa hukamo varatai guramukh aap pachhaanai |
English: Birth and death occur by the Hukam of His Command; the Gurmukh understands his own self.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭਾਏ ਜੋ ਇਛੈ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: naam dhiaae taa satigur bhaae jo ichhai so fal paae |
English: He meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and so pleases the True Guru. He receives whatever rewards he desires.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥੮॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak tis daa sabh kichh hovai ji vichahu aap gavaae |8|1|
English: O Nanak, one who eradicates self-conceit from within, has everything. ||8||1||

[Ang 754 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 3 |
English: Soohee, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਅਤਿ ਸੁਆਲਿੑਉ ਪਿਰੁ ਵਸੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa kaaman at suaalau pir vasai jis naale |
English: The body-bride is very beautiful; she dwells with her Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਪਿਰ ਸਚੇ ਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: pir sache te sadaa suhaagan gur kaa sabad samaale |
English: She becomes the happy soul-bride of her True Husband Lord, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਲੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har kee bhagat sadaa rang raataa haumai vichahu jaale |1|
English: The Lord's devotee is forever attuned to the Lord's Love; her ego is burnt away from within. ||1||

Gurbani: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: vaahu vaahu poore gur kee baanee |
English: Waaho! Waaho! Blessed, blessed is the Word of the Perfect Guru's Bani.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੀ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: poore gur te upajee saach samaanee |1| rahaau |
English: It wells up and springs forth from the Perfect Guru, and merges into Truth. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਵਸੈ ਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ ਪਾਤਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa andar sabh kichh vasai khandd manddal paataalaa |
English: Everything is within the Lord - the continents, worlds and nether regions.

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਦਾਤਾ ਵਸੈ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa andar jagajeevan daataa vasai sabhanaa kare pratipaalaa |
English: The Life of the World, the Great Giver, dwells within the body; He is the Cherisher of all.

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa kaaman sadaa suhelee guramukh naam samaalaa |2|
English: The body-bride is eternally beautiful; the Gurmukh contemplates the Naam. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਵਸੈ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa andar aape vasai alakh na lakhiaa jaaee |
English: The Lord Himself dwells within the body; He is invisible and cannot be seen.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭਾਲਣਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh mugadh boojhai naahee baahar bhaalan jaaee |
English: The foolish self-willed manmukh does not understand; he goes out searching for the Lord externally.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਦਿਤਾ ਲਖਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: satigur seve sadaa sukh paae satigur alakh ditaa lakhaaee |3|
English: One who serves the True Guru is always at peace; the True Guru has shown me the Invisible Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa andar ratan padaarath bhagat bhare bhanddaaraa |
English: Within the body there are jewels and precious treasures, the over-flowing treasure of devotion.

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਉਖੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੀ ਹਾਟ ਪਟਣ ਬਾਜਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: eis kaaeaa andar naukhandd prithamee haatt pattan baajaaraa |
English: Within this body are the nine continents of the earth, its markets, cities and streets.

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: eis kaaeaa andar naam nau nidh paaeeai gur kai sabad veechaaraa |4|
English: Within this body are the nine treasures of the Naam; contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it is obtained. ||4||

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤੋਲਿ ਤੁਲਾਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਤੋਲਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa andar tol tulaavai aape tolanahaaraa |
English: Within the body, the Lord estimates the weight; He Himself is the weigher.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਜਵਾਹਰ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਮੋਲੁ ਅਫਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: eihu man ratan javaahar maanak tis kaa mol afaaraa |
English: This mind is the jewel, the gem, the diamond; it is absolutely priceless.

Gurbani: ਮੋਲਿ ਕਿਤ ਹੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: mol kit hee naam paaeeai naahee naam paaeeai gur beechaaraa |5|
English: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, cannot be purchased at any price; the Naam is obtained by contemplating the Guru. ||5||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਖੋਜੈ ਹੋਰ ਸਭ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh hovai su kaaeaa khojai hor sabh bharam bhulaaee |
English: One who becomes Gurmukh searches this body; all others just wander around in confusion.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਹੋਰ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jis no dee soee jan paavai hor kiaa ko kare chaturaaee |
English: That humble being alone obtains it, unto whom the Lord bestows it. What other clever tricks can anyone try?

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਭਉ ਭਾਉ ਵਸੈ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa andar bhau bhaau vasai gur parasaadee paaee |6|
English: Within the body, the Fear of God and Love for Him abides; by Guru's Grace, they are obtained. ||6||

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸਾ ਸਭ ਓਪਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa andar brahamaa bisan mahesaa sabh opat jit sansaaraa |
English: Within the body, are Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva, from whom the whole world emanated.

Gurbani: ਸਚੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sachai aapanaa khel rachaaeaa aavaa gaun paasaaraa |
English: The True Lord has staged and contrived His own play; the expanse of the Universe comes and goes.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: poorai satigur aap dikhaaeaa sach naam nisataaraa |7|
English: The Perfect True Guru Himself has made it clear, that emancipation comes through the True Name. ||7||

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਕਾਇਆ ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੈ ਸਚੈ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: saa kaaeaa jo satigur sevai sachai aap savaaree |
English: That body, which serves the True Guru, is embellished by the True Lord Himself.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦਰਿ ਢੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਾ ਜਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਆਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: vin naavai dar dtoee naahee taa jam kare khuaaree |
English: Without the Name, the mortal finds no place of rest in the Court of the Lord; he shall be tortured by the Messenger of Death.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੮॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak sach vaddiaaee paae jis no har kirapaa dhaaree |8|2|
English: O Nanak, true glory is bestowed, when the Lord showers His Mercy. ||8||2||

[Ang 755 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧੦ ॥
Transliteration: raag soohee mahalaa 3 ghar 10 |
English: Raag Soohee, Third Mehl, Tenth House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਨ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਜੋ ਮਰਿ ਵੰਞਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: duneea na saalaeh jo mar vanyasee |
English: Do not praise the world; it shall simply pass away.

Gurbani: ਲੋਕਾ ਨ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਜੋ ਮਰਿ ਖਾਕੁ ਥੀਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: lokaa na saalaeh jo mar khaak theeee |1|
English: Do not praise other people; they shall die and turn to dust. ||1||

Gurbani: ਵਾਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਵਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: vaahu mere saahibaa vaahu |
English: Waaho! Waaho! Hail, hail to my Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਸਚਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh sadaa salaaheeai sachaa veparavaahu |1| rahaau |
English: As Gurmukh, forever praise the One who is forever True, Independent and Carefree. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕੇਰੀ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦਝਿ ਮਰੰਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: duneea keree dosatee manamukh dajh maran |
English: Making worldly friendships, the self-willed manmukhs burn and die.

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਵੇਲਾ ਨ ਲਾਹੰਨਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jam pur badhe maareeeh velaa na laahan |2|
English: In the City of Death, they are bound and gagged and beaten; this opportunity shall never come again. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਕਾਰਥਾ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਗੰਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh janam sakaarathaa sachai sabad lagan |
English: The lives of the Gurmukhs are fruitful and blessed; they are committed to the True Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਰਹੰਨਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aatam raam pragaasiaa sahaje sukh rahan |3|
English: Their souls are illuminated by the Lord, and they dwell in peace and pleasure. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਰਚੰਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa sabad visaariaa doojai bhaae rachan |
English: Those who forget the Word of the Guru's Shabad are engrossed in the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਲਤ ਫਿਰੰਨਿ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: tisanaa bhukh na utarai anadin jalat firan |4|
English: Their hunger and thirst never leave them, and night and day, they wander around burning. ||4||

Gurbani: ਦੁਸਟਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਸੰਤਾ ਵੈਰੁ ਕਰੰਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: dusattaa naal dosatee naal santaa vair karan |
English: Those who make friendships with the wicked, and harbor animosity to the Saints,

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਡੁਬੇ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਿਉ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਡੋਬੰਨਿ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: aap ddube kuttanb siau sagale kul ddoban |5|
English: shall drown with their families, and their entire lineage shall be obliterated. ||5||

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਭਲੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਕੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਕਰੰਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: nindaa bhalee kisai kee naahee manamukh mugadh karan |
English: It is not good to slander anyone, but the foolish, self-willed manmukhs still do it.

Gurbani: ਮੁਹ ਕਾਲੇ ਤਿਨ ਨਿੰਦਕਾ ਨਰਕੇ ਘੋਰਿ ਪਵੰਨਿ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: muh kaale tin nindakaa narake ghor pavan |6|
English: The faces of the slanderers turn black, and they fall into the most horrible hell. ||6||

Gurbani: ਏ ਮਨ ਜੈਸਾ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤੈਸਾ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤੇਹੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: e man jaisaa seveh taisaa hoveh tehe karam kamaae |
English: O mind, as you serve, so do you become, and so are the deeds that you do.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਬੀਜਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਖਾਵਣਾ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: aap beej aape hee khaavanaa kahanaa kichhoo na jaae |7|
English: Whatever you yourself plant, that is what you shall have to eat; nothing else can be said about this. ||7||

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਪੁਰਖਾ ਕਾ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਿਤੈ ਪਰਥਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: mahaa purakhaa kaa bolanaa hovai kitai parathaae |
English: The speech of the great spiritual beings has a higher purpose.

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਰੇ ਭਰਪੂਰ ਹਹਿ ਓਨਾ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਇ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: oe amrit bhare bharapoor heh onaa til na tamaae |8|
English: They are filled to over-flowing with Ambrosial Nectar, and they have absolutely no greed at all. ||8||

Gurbani: ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਘਰੈ ਅਵਰਾ ਉਪਦੇਸੇਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: gunakaaree gun sangharai avaraa upadesen |
English: The virtuous accumulate virtue, and teach others.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿ ਓਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਏਨਿ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: se vaddabhaagee ji onaa mil rahe anadin naam len |9|
English: Those who meet with them are so very fortunate; night and day, they chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||9||

Gurbani: ਦੇਸੀ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਮੇਦਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: desee rijak sanbaeh jin upaaee medanee |
English: He who created the Universe, gives sustenance to it.

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਹੈ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਆਪਿ ਧਣੀ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: eko hai daataar sachaa aap dhanee |10|
English: The One Lord alone is the Great Giver. He Himself is the True Master. ||10||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: so sach terai naal hai guramukh nadar nihaal |
English: That True Lord is always with you; the Gurmukh is blessed with His Glance of Grace.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: aape bakhase mel le so prabh sadaa samaal |11|
English: He Himself shall forgive you, and merge you into Himself; forever cherish and contemplate God. ||11||

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man mailaa sach niramalaa kiau kar miliaa jaae |
English: The mind is impure; only the True Lord is pure. So how can it merge into Him?

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਤਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: prabh mele taa mil rahai haumai sabad jalaae |12|
English: God merges it into Himself, and then it remains merged; through the Word of His Shabad, the ego is burnt away. ||12||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਸਚਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: so sahu sachaa veesarai dhrig jeevan sansaar |
English: Cursed is the life in this world, of one who forgets her True Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਨਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: nadar kare naa veesarai guramatee veechaar |13|
English: The Lord grants His Mercy, and she does not forget Him, if she contemplates the Guru's Teachings. ||13||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਤਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹਾ ਸਾਚੁ ਰਖਾ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: satigur mele taa mil rahaa saach rakhaa ur dhaar |
English: The True Guru unites her, and so she remains united with Him, with the True Lord enshrined within her heart.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਵੀਛੁੜੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: miliaa hoe na veechhurrai gur kai het piaar |14|
English: And so united, she will not be separated again; she remains in the love and affection of the Guru. ||14||

Gurbani: ਪਿਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: pir saalaahee aapanaa gur kai sabad veechaar |
English: I praise my Husband Lord, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: mil preetam sukh paaeaa sobhaavantee naar |15|
English: Meeting with my Beloved, I have found peace; I am His most beautiful and happy soul-bride. ||15||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਭਿਜਈ ਅਤਿ ਮੈਲੇ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਠੋਰ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh man na bhijee at maile chit katthor |
English: The mind of the self-willed manmukh is not softened; his consciousness is totally polluted and stone-hearted.

Gurbani: ਸਪੈ ਦੁਧੁ ਪੀਆਈਐ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਿਸੁ ਨਿਕੋਰ ॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: sapai dudh peeaeeai andar vis nikor |16|
English: Even if the venomous snake is fed on milk, it shall still be filled with poison. ||16||

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: aap kare kis aakheeai aape bakhasanahaar |
English: He Himself does - who else should I ask? He Himself is the Forgiving Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਬਣਿਆ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: gurasabadee mail utarai taa sach baniaa seegaar |17|
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, filth is washed away, and then, one is embellished with the ornament of Truth. ||17||

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਚੇ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ਓਥੈ ਕੂੜੇ ਨਾ ਟਿਕੰਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa saahu sache vanajaare othai koorre naa ttikan |
English: True is the Banker, and True are His traders. The false ones cannot remain there.

Gurbani: ਓਨਾ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ਦੁਖ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਪਚੰਨਿ ॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: onaa sach na bhaavee dukh hee maeh pachan |18|
English: They do not love the Truth - they are consumed by their pain. ||18||

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲਾ ਜਗੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: haumai mailaa jag firai mar jamai vaaro vaar |
English: The world wanders around in the filth of egotism; it dies, and is re-born, over and again.

Gurbani: ਪਇਐ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰ ॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: peiai kirat kamaavanaa koe na mettanahaar |19|
English: He acts in accordance with the karma of his past actions, which no one can erase. ||19||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਤਾ ਸਚਿ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: santaa sangat mil rahai taa sach lagai piaar |
English: But if he joins the Society of the Saints, then he comes to embrace love for the Truth.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: sach salaahee sach man dar sachai sachiaar |20|
English: Praising the True Lord with a truthful mind, he becomes true in the Court of the True Lord. ||20||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਹੈ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur poore pooree mat hai ahinis naam dhiaae |
English: The Teachings of the Perfect Guru are perfect; meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, day and night.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਵਡ ਰੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਇ ॥੨੧॥
Transliteration: haumai meraa vadd rog hai vichahu tthaak rahaae |21|
English: Egotism and self-conceit are terrible diseases; tranquility and stillness come from within. ||21||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur saalaahee aapanaa niv niv laagaa paae |
English: I praise my Guru; bowing down to Him again and again, I fall at His Feet.

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਉਪੀ ਆਗੈ ਧਰੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੨੨॥
Transliteration: tan man saupee aagai dharee vichahu aap gavaae |22|
English: I place my body and mind in offering unto Him, eradicating self-conceit from within. ||22||

Gurbani: ਖਿੰਚੋਤਾਣਿ ਵਿਗੁਚੀਐ ਏਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: khinchotaan vigucheeai ekas siau liv laae |
English: Indecision leads to ruin; focus your attention on the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਛਡਿ ਤੂ ਤਾ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨੩॥
Transliteration: haumai meraa chhadd too taa sach rahai samaae |23|
English: Renounce egotism and self-conceit, and remain merged in Truth. ||23||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨੋ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਿ ਭਾਇਰਾ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਗੰਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: satigur no mile si bhaaeiraa sachai sabad lagan |
English: Those who meet with the True Guru are my Siblings of Destiny; they are committed to the True Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਦਿਸੰਨਿ ॥੨੪॥
Transliteration: sach mile se na vichhurreh dar sachai disan |24|
English: Those who merge with the True Lord shall not be separated again; they are judged to be True in the Court of the Lord. ||24||

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਭਾਈ ਸੇ ਸਜਣਾ ਜੋ ਸਚਾ ਸੇਵੰਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: se bhaaee se sajanaa jo sachaa sevan |
English: They are my Siblings of Destiny, and they are my friends, who serve the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਵਗਣ ਵਿਕਣਿ ਪਲੑਰਨਿ ਗੁਣ ਕੀ ਸਾਝ ਕਰੰਨਿੑ ॥੨੫॥
Transliteration: avagan vikan palaran gun kee saajh karana |25|
English: They sell off their sins and demerits like straw, and enter into the partnership of virtue. ||25||

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਕੀ ਸਾਝ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: gun kee saajh sukh aoopajai sachee bhagat karen |
English: In the partnership of virtue, peace wells up, and they perform true devotional worship service.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜਹਿ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਏਨਿ ॥੨੬॥
Transliteration: sach vananjeh gurasabad siau laahaa naam len |26|
English: They deal in Truth, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and they earn the profit of the Naam. ||26||

Gurbani: ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਪਾਪ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਚੀਐ ਚਲੈ ਨ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: sueinaa rupaa paap kar kar sancheeai chalai na chaladiaa naal |
English: Gold and silver may be earned by committing sins, but they will not go with you when you die.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲਸੀ ਸਭ ਮੁਠੀ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ॥੨੭॥
Transliteration: vin naavai naal na chalasee sabh mutthee jamakaal |27|
English: Nothing will go with you in the end, except the Name; all are plundered by the Messenger of Death. ||27||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਤੋਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਖਹੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: man kaa tosaa har naam hai hiradai rakhahu samaal |
English: The Lord's Name is the nourishment of the mind; cherish it, and preserve it carefully within your heart.

Gurbani: ਏਹੁ ਖਰਚੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੨੮॥
Transliteration: ehu kharach akhutt hai guramukh nibahai naal |28|
English: This nourishment is inexhaustible; it is always with the Gurmukhs. ||28||

Gurbani: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੂਲਹੁ ਭੁਲਿਆ ਜਾਸਹਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: e man moolahu bhuliaa jaaseh pat gavaae |
English: O mind, if you forget the Primal Lord, you shall depart, having lost your honor.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੨੯॥
Transliteration: eihu jagat mohi doojai viaapiaa guramatee sach dhiaae |29|
English: This world is engrossed in the love of duality; follow the Guru's Teachings, and meditate on the True Lord. ||29||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਲਿਖਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: har kee keemat naa pavai har jas likhan na jaae |
English: The Lord's value cannot be estimated; the Lord's Praises cannot be written down.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਪੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩੦॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad man tan rapai har siau rahai samaae |30|
English: When one's mind and body are attuned to the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one remains merged in the Lord. ||30||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਰੰਗੁਲਾ ਰੰਗੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: so sahu meraa rangulaa range sehaj subhaae |
English: My Husband Lord is playful; He has imbued me with His Love, with natural ease.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਤਾ ਚੜੈ ਜਾ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩੧॥
Transliteration: kaaman rang taa charrai jaa pir kai ank samaae |31|
English: The soul-bride is imbued with His Love, when her Husband Lord merges her into His Being. ||31||

Gurbani: ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੇ ਭੀ ਮਿਲਨਿ ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੰਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: chiree vichhune bhee milan jo satigur sevan |
English: Even those who have been separated for so very long, are reunited with Him, when they serve the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਖਾਨਿ ਖਰਚਨਿ ਨ ਨਿਖੁਟਈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਹਜਿ ਰਵੰਨਿ ॥੩੨॥
Transliteration: antar nav nidh naam hai khaan kharachan na nikhuttee har gun sehaj ravan |32|
English: The nine treasures of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are deep within the nucleus of the self; consuming them, they are still never exhausted. Chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, with natural ease. ||32||

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਓਇ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਨਾ ਮਰਹਿ ਨਾ ਓਇ ਦੁਖ ਸਹੰਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: naa oe janameh naa mareh naa oe dukh sahan |
English: They are not born, and they do not die; they do not suffer in pain.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਕੇਲ ਕਰੰਨਿ ॥੩੩॥
Transliteration: gur raakhe se ubare har siau kel karan |33|
English: Those who are protected by the Guru are saved. They celebrate with the Lord. ||33||

Gurbani: ਸਜਣ ਮਿਲੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਜਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਮਿਲੇ ਰਹੰਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: sajan mile na vichhurreh ji anadin mile rahan |
English: Those who are united with the Lord, the True Friend, are not separated again; night and day, they remain blended with Him.

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਲਹੰਨਿ ॥੩੪॥੧॥੩॥
Transliteration: eis jag meh virale jaaneeeh naanak sach lahan |34|1|3|
English: In this world, only a rare few are known, O Nanak, to have obtained the True Lord. ||34||1||3||

[Ang 756 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 3 |
English: Soohee, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਸੂਖਮੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: har jee sookham agam hai kit bidh miliaa jaae |
English: The Dear Lord is subtle and inaccessible; how can we ever meet Him?

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad bhram katteeai achint vasai man aae |1|
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, doubt is dispelled, and the Carefree Lord comes to abide in the mind. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੰਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh har har naam japan |
English: The Gurmukhs chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਦਾ ਰਵੰਨਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hau tin kai balihaaranai man har gun sadaa ravan |1| rahaau |
English: I am a sacrifice to those who chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord in their minds forever. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਮਾਨ ਸਰੋਵਰੁ ਹੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਲਹੰਨਿੑ ॥
Transliteration: gur saravar maan sarovar hai vaddabhaagee purakh lahana |
English: The Guru is like the Mansarovar Lake; only the very fortunate beings find Him.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਜਿਆ ਸੇ ਹੰਸੁਲੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਹੰਨਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sevak guramukh khojiaa se hansule naam lahan |2|
English: The Gurmukhs, the selfless servants, seek out the Guru; the swan-souls feed there on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿੑ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗੰਨਿੑ ॥
Transliteration: naam dhiaaeina rang siau guramukh naam lagana |
English: The Gurmukhs meditate on the Naam, and remain linked to the Naam.

Gurbani: ਧੁਰਿ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਲਏਨਿੑ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: dhur poorab hovai likhiaa gur bhaanaa man lena |3|
English: Whatever is pre-ordained, accept it as the Will of the Guru. ||3||

Gurbani: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਘਰੁ ਖੋਜਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: vaddabhaagee ghar khojiaa paaeaa naam nidhaan |
English: By great good fortune, I searched my home, and found the treasure of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਵੇਖਾਲਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਨੁ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: gur poorai vekhaaliaa prabh aatam raam pachhaan |4|
English: The Perfect Guru has shown God to me; I have realized the Lord, the Supreme Soul. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabhanaa kaa prabh ek hai doojaa avar na koe |
English: There is One God of all; there is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee man vasai tith ghatt paragatt hoe |5|
English: By Guru's Grace, the Lord comes to abide in the mind; in the heart of such a one, He is revealed. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਸਭ ਥਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabh antarajaamee braham hai braham vasai sabh thaae |
English: God is the Inner-knower of all hearts; God dwells in every place.

Gurbani: ਮੰਦਾ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: mandaa kis no aakheeai sabad vekhahu liv laae |6|
English: So who should we call evil? Behold the Word of the Shabad, and lovingly dwell upon it. ||6||

Gurbani: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਤਿਚਰੁ ਆਖਦਾ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਹੈ ਦੁਹੁ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: buraa bhalaa tichar aakhadaa jichar hai duhu maeh |
English: He calls others bad and good, as long as he is in duality.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੋ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਏਕਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: guramukh eko bujhiaa ekas maeh samaae |7|
English: The Gurmukh understands the One and Only Lord; He is absorbed in the One Lord. ||7||

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਾ ਸਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਸੀ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਏ ਥਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sevaa saa prabh bhaavasee jo prabh paae thaae |
English: That is selfless service, which pleases God, and which is approved by God.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੮॥੨॥੪॥੯॥
Transliteration: jan naanak har aaraadhiaa gur charanee chit laae |8|2|4|9|
English: Servant Nanak worships the Lord in adoration; he focuses his consciousness on the Guru's Feet. ||8||2||4||9||

[Ang 757 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: raag soohee asattapadeea mahalaa 4 ghar 2 |
English: Raag Soohee, Ashtpadheeyaa, Fourth Mehl, Second House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਆਣਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਆਪੁ ਵੇਚਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: koee aan milaavai meraa preetam piaaraa hau tis peh aap vechaaee |1|
English: If only someone would come, and lead me to meet my Darling Beloved; I would sell myself to him. ||1||

Gurbani: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਖਣ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: darasan har dekhan kai taaee |
English: I long for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

Gurbani: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kripaa kareh taa satigur meleh har har naam dhiaaee |1| rahaau |
English: When the Lord shows Mercy unto me, then I meet the True Guru; I meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਤ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਅਰਾਧੀ ਦੁਖਿ ਭੀ ਤੁਝੈ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: je sukh dehi ta tujheh araadhee dukh bhee tujhai dhiaaee |2|
English: If You will bless me with happiness, then I will worship and adore You. Even in pain, I will meditate on You. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਭੁਖ ਦੇਹਿ ਤ ਇਤ ਹੀ ਰਾਜਾ ਦੁਖ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੂਖ ਮਨਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: je bhukh dehi ta it hee raajaa dukh vich sookh manaaee |3|
English: Even if You give me hunger, I will still feel satisfied; I am joyful, even in the midst of sorrow. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਕਾਟਿ ਕਾਟਿ ਸਭੁ ਅਰਪੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਅਗਨੀ ਆਪੁ ਜਲਾਈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: tan man kaatt kaatt sabh arapee vich aganee aap jalaaee |4|
English: I would cut my mind and body apart into pieces, and offer them all to You; I would burn myself in fire. ||4||

Gurbani: ਪਖਾ ਫੇਰੀ ਪਾਣੀ ਢੋਵਾ ਜੋ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਸੋ ਖਾਈ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: pakhaa feree paanee dtovaa jo deveh so khaaee |5|
English: I wave the fan over You, and carry water for You; whatever You give me, I take. ||5||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗਰੀਬੁ ਢਹਿ ਪਇਆ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: naanak gareeb dteh peaa duaarai har mel laihu vaddiaaee |6|
English: Poor Nanak has fallen at the Lord's Door; please, O Lord, unite me with Yourself, by Your Glorious Greatness. ||6||

Gurbani: ਅਖੀ ਕਾਢਿ ਧਰੀ ਚਰਣਾ ਤਲਿ ਸਭ ਧਰਤੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਤ ਪਾਈ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: akhee kaadt dharee charanaa tal sabh dharatee fir mat paaee |7|
English: Taking out my eyes, I place them at Your Feet; after travelling over the entire earth, I have come to understand this. ||7||

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਪਾਸਿ ਬਹਾਲਹਿ ਤਾ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਅਰਾਧੀ ਜੇ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਢਹਿ ਭੀ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: je paas bahaaleh taa tujheh araadhee je maar kadteh bhee dhiaaee |8|
English: If You seat me near You, then I worship and adore You. Even if You beat me and drive me out, I will still meditate on You. ||8||

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਲੋਕੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਤਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਜੇ ਨਿੰਦੈ ਤ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: je lok salaahe taa teree upamaa je nindai ta chhodd na jaaee |9|
English: If people praise me, the praise is Yours. Even if they slander me, I will not leave You. ||9||

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਤਾ ਕੋਈ ਕਿਹੁ ਆਖਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਸਰਿਐ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: je tudh val rahai taa koee kihu aakhau tudh visariai mar jaaee |10|
English: If You are on my side, then anyone can say anything. But if I were to forget You, then I would die. ||10||

Gurbani: ਵਾਰਿ ਵਾਰਿ ਜਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਪੈ ਪੈਰੀ ਸੰਤ ਮਨਾਈ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: vaar vaar jaaee gur aoopar pai pairee sant manaaee |11|
English: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to my Guru; falling at His Feet, I surrender to the Saintly Guru. ||11||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ਭਇਆ ਦਿਵਾਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਤਉ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: naanak vichaaraa bheaa divaanaa har tau darasan kai taaee |12|
English: Poor Nanak has gone insane, longing for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||12||

Gurbani: ਝਖੜੁ ਝਾਗੀ ਮੀਹੁ ਵਰਸੈ ਭੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਖਣ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: jhakharr jhaagee meehu varasai bhee gur dekhan jaaee |13|
English: Even in violent storms and torrential rain, I go out to catch a glimpse of my Guru. ||13||

Gurbani: ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਬਹੁ ਖਾਰਾ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਲੰਘਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: samund saagar hovai bahu khaaraa gurasikh langh gur peh jaaee |14|
English: Even though the oceans and the salty seas are very vast, the GurSikh will cross over it to get to his Guru. ||14||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਹੈ ਮਰਤਾ ਤਿਉ ਸਿਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: jiau praanee jal bin hai marataa tiau sikh gur bin mar jaaee |15|
English: Just as the mortal dies without water, so does the Sikh die without the Guru. ||15||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਧਰਤੀ ਸੋਭ ਕਰੇ ਜਲੁ ਬਰਸੈ ਤਿਉ ਸਿਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਬਿਗਸਾਈ ॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: jiau dharatee sobh kare jal barasai tiau sikh gur mil bigasaaee |16|
English: Just as the earth looks beautiful when the rain falls, so does the Sikh blossom forth meeting the Guru. ||16||

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਕ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਵਰਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਨਉ ਬੁਲਾਈ ॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: sevak kaa hoe sevak varataa kar kar binau bulaaee |17|
English: I long to be the servant of Your servants; I call upon You reverently in prayer. ||17||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਗੁਰ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: naanak kee benantee har peh gur mil gur sukh paaee |18|
English: Nanak offers this prayer to the Lord, that he may meet the Guru, and find peace. ||18||

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲਾ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰ ਵਿਚੁ ਦੇ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: too aape gur chelaa hai aape gur vich de tujheh dhiaaee |19|
English: You Yourself are the Guru, and You Yourself are the chaylaa, the disciple; through the Guru, I meditate on You. ||19||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੋ ਤੂਹੈ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਸੇਵਕ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: jo tudh seveh so toohai hoveh tudh sevak paij rakhaaee |20|
English: Those who serve You, become You. You preserve the honor of Your servants. ||20||

Gurbani: ਭੰਡਾਰ ਭਰੇ ਭਗਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਵਾਈ ॥੨੧॥
Transliteration: bhanddaar bhare bhagatee har tere jis bhaavai tis devaaee |21|
English: O Lord, Your devotional worship is a treasure over-flowing. One who loves You, is blessed with it. ||21||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਹੋਰ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਸਭ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥੨੨॥
Transliteration: jis toon dehi soee jan paae hor nihafal sabh chaturaaee |22|
English: That humble being alone receives it, unto whom You bestow it. All other clever tricks are fruitless. ||22||

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਸੋਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਜਾਗਾਈ ॥੨੩॥
Transliteration: simar simar simar gur apunaa soeaa man jaagaaee |23|
English: Remembering, remembering, remembering my Guru in meditation, my sleeping mind is awakened. ||23||

Gurbani: ਇਕੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਰਾਈ ॥੨੪॥
Transliteration: eik daan mangai naanak vechaaraa har daasan daas karaaee |24|
English: Poor Nanak begs for this one blessing, that he may become the slave of the slaves of the Lord. ||24||

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਝਿੜਕੇ ਤ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਜੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਤ ਗੁਰ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨੫॥
Transliteration: je gur jhirrake ta meetthaa laagai je bakhase ta gur vaddiaaee |25|
English: Even if the Guru rebukes me, He still seems very sweet to me. And if He actually forgives me, that is the Guru's greatness. ||25||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਸੋ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਏ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੨੬॥
Transliteration: guramukh boleh so thaae paae manamukh kichh thaae na paaee |26|
English: That which Gurmukh speaks is certified and approved. Whatever the self-willed manmukh says is not accepted. ||26||

Gurbani: ਪਾਲਾ ਕਕਰੁ ਵਰਫ ਵਰਸੈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਦੇਖਣ ਜਾਈ ॥੨੭॥
Transliteration: paalaa kakar varaf varasai gurasikh gur dekhan jaaee |27|
English: Even in the cold, the frost and the snow, the GurSikh still goes out to see his Guru. ||27||

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਦੇਖਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਅਖੀ ਗੁਰ ਪੈਰ ਧਰਾਈ ॥੨੮॥
Transliteration: sabh dinas rain dekhau gur apunaa vich akhee gur pair dharaaee |28|
English: All day and night, I gaze upon my Guru; I install the Guru's Feet in my eyes. ||28||

Gurbani: ਅਨੇਕ ਉਪਾਵ ਕਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਈ ॥੨੯॥
Transliteration: anek upaav karee gur kaaran gur bhaavai so thaae paaee |29|
English: I make so many efforts for the sake of the Guru; only that which pleases the Guru is accepted and approved. ||29||

Gurbani: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਅਰਾਧੀ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਈ ॥੩੦॥
Transliteration: rain dinas gur charan araadhee deaa karahu mere saaee |30|
English: Night and day, I worship the Guru's Feet in adoration; have Mercy upon me, O my Lord and Master. ||30||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਈ ॥੩੧॥
Transliteration: naanak kaa jeeo pindd guroo hai gur mil tripat aghaaee |31|
English: The Guru is Nanak's body and soul; meeting the Guru, he is satisfied and satiated. ||31||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਹੈ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਤਤ ਗੋਸਾਈ ॥੩੨॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak kaa prabh poor rahio hai jat kat tat gosaaee |32|1|
English: Nanak's God is perfectly permeating and all-pervading. Here and there and everywhere, the Lord of the Universe. ||32||1||

[Ang 758 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੧੦ ॥
Transliteration: raag soohee mahalaa 4 asattapadeea ghar 10 |
English: Raag Soohee, Fourth Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa, Tenth House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਆਪਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: andar sachaa nehu laaeaa preetam aapanai |
English: Deep within myself, I have enshrined true love for my Beloved.

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਜਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਖਾ ਸਾਮੑਣੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tan man hoe nihaal jaa gur dekhaa saamane |1|
English: My body and soul are in ecstasy; I see my Guru before me. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: mai har har naam visaahu |
English: I have purchased the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur poore te paaeaa amrit agam athaahu |1| rahaau |
English: I have obtained the Inaccessible and Unfathomable Ambrosial Nectar from the Perfect Guru. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਗਾ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: hau satigur vekh vigaseea har naame lagaa piaar |
English: Gazing upon the True Guru, I blossom forth in ecstasy; I am in love with the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਮੇਲਿਅਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kirapaa kar kai melian paaeaa mokh duaar |2|
English: Through His Mercy, the Lord has united me with Himself, and I have found the Door of Salvation. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬਿਰਹੀ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur birahee naam kaa je milai ta tan man deo |
English: The True Guru is the Lover of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Meeting Him, I dedicate my body and mind to Him.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਪੀਏਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: je poorab hovai likhiaa taa amrit sehaj peeo |3|
English: And if it is so pre-ordained, then I shall automatically drink in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੁਤਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਉਠਦਿਆ ਭੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਲਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sutiaa gur saalaaheeai utthadiaa bhee gur aalaau |
English: Praise the Guru while you are asleep, and call on the Guru while you are up.

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਐਸਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਉ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਧੋਵਾ ਪਾਉ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: koee aisaa guramukh je milai hau taa ke dhovaa paau |4|
English: If only I could meet such a Gurmukh; I would wash His Feet. ||4||

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਐਸਾ ਸਜਣੁ ਲੋੜਿ ਲਹੁ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਦੇਇ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: koee aisaa sajan lorr lahu mai preetam dee milaae |
