English: I long for such a Friend, to unite me with my Beloved.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: satigur miliai har paaeaa miliaa sehaj subhaae |5|
English: Meeting the True Guru, I have found the Lord. He has met me, easily and effortlessly. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਮੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਖਣ ਕਾ ਚਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur saagar gun naam kaa mai tis dekhan kaa chaau |
English: The True Guru is the Ocean of Virtue of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. I have such a yearning to see Him!

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਜੀਵਊ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: hau tis bin gharree na jeevaoo bin dekhe mar jaau |6|
English: Without Him, I cannot live, even for an instant. If I do not see Him, I die. ||6||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਵਿਣੁ ਪਾਣੀਐ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਕਿਤੈ ਉਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jiau machhulee vin paaneeai rahai na kitai upaae |
English: As the fish cannot survive at all without water,

Gurbani: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਤੁ ਨ ਜੀਵਈ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: tiau har bin sant na jeevee bin har naamai mar jaae |7|
English: the Saint cannot live without the Lord. Without the Lord's Name, he dies. ||7||

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਪਿਰਹੜੀ ਕਿਉ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਵਾ ਮਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mai satigur setee piraharree kiau gur bin jeevaa maau |
English: I am so much in love with my True Guru! How could I even live without the Guru, O my mother?

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹਾਉ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: mai gurabaanee aadhaar hai gurabaanee laag rahaau |8|
English: I have the Support of the Word of the Guru's Bani. Attached to Gurbani, I survive. ||8||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਦੇਵੈ ਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam ratan hai gur tutthaa devai maae |
English: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is a jewel; by the Pleasure of His Will, the Guru has given it, O my mother.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਧਰ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹਾ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: mai dhar sache naam kee har naam rahaa liv laae |9|
English: The True Name is my only Support. I remain lovingly absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||9||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਦੇਇ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur giaan padaarath naam hai har naamo dee drirraae |
English: The wisdom of the Guru is the treasure of the Naam. The Guru implants and enshrines the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਸੋ ਲਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਇ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: jis paraapat so lahai gur charanee laagai aae |10|
English: He alone receives it, he alone gets it, who comes and falls at the Guru's Feet. ||10||

Gurbani: ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੀ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਆਖੈ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: akath kahaanee prem kee ko preetam aakhai aae |
English: If only someone would come and tell me the Unspoken Speech of the Love of my Beloved.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਵਾ ਮਨੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਪਾਇ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: tis devaa man aapanaa niv niv laagaa paae |11|
English: I would dedicate my mind to him; I would bow down in humble respect, and fall at his feet. ||11||

Gurbani: ਸਜਣੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: sajan meraa ek toon karataa purakh sujaan |
English: You are my only Friend, O my All-knowing, All-powerful Creator Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੀਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਮੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: satigur meet milaaeaa mai sadaa sadaa teraa taan |12|
English: You have brought me to meet with my True Guru. Forever and ever, You are my only strength. ||12||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਾ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur meraa sadaa sadaa naa aavai naa jaae |
English: My True Guru, forever and ever, does not come and go.

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: ohu abinaasee purakh hai sabh meh rahiaa samaae |13|
English: He is the Imperishable Creator Lord; He is permeating and pervading among all. ||13||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਸਾਬਤੁ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam dhan sanchiaa saabat poonjee raas |
English: I have gathered in the wealth of the Lord's Name. My facilities and faculties are intact, safe and sound.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਗਹ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥੧੪॥੧॥੨॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: naanak daragah maniaa gur poore saabaas |14|1|2|11|
English: O Nanak, I am approved and respected in the Court of the Lord; the Perfect Guru has blessed me! ||14||1||2||11||

[Ang 759 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raag soohee asattapadeea mahalaa 5 ghar 1 |
English: Raag Soohee, Ashtpadheeyaa, Fifth Mehl, First House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਉਰਝਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: aurajh rahio bikhiaa kai sangaa |
English: He is entangled in sinful associations;

Gurbani: ਮਨਹਿ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਅਨਿਕ ਤਰੰਗਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: maneh biaapat anik tarangaa |1|
English: his mind is troubled by so very many waves. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ॥
Transliteration: mere man agam agochar |
English: O my mind, how can the Unapproachable and Incomprehensible Lord be found?

Gurbani: ਕਤ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kat paaeeai pooran paramesar |1| rahaau |
English: He is the Perfect Transcendent Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਿਆਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: moh magan meh rahiaa biaape |
English: He remains entangled in the intoxication of worldly love.

Gurbani: ਅਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਕਬਹੂ ਨਹੀ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: at trisanaa kabahoo nahee dhraape |2|
English: His excessive thirst is never quenched. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬਸਇ ਕਰੋਧੁ ਸਰੀਰਿ ਚੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: base karodh sareer chanddaaraa |
English: Anger is the outcaste which hides within his body;

Gurbani: ਅਗਿਆਨਿ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਮਹਾ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: agiaan na soojhai mahaa gubaaraa |3|
English: he is in the utter darkness of ignorance, and he does not understand. ||3||

Gurbani: ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਜਰੇ ਕਿਵਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: bhramat biaapat jare kivaaraa |
English: Afflicted by doubt, the shutters are shut tight;

Gurbani: ਜਾਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jaan na paaeeai prabh darabaaraa |4|
English: he cannot go to God's Court. ||4||

Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਬੰਧਿ ਪਰਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa andesaa bandh paraanaa |
English: The mortal is bound and gagged by hope and fear;

Gurbani: ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਫਿਰਤ ਬਿਗਾਨਾ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: mehal na paavai firat bigaanaa |5|
English: he cannot find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and so he wanders around like a stranger. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: sagal biaadh kai vas kar deenaa |
English: He falls under the power of all negative influences;

Gurbani: ਫਿਰਤ ਪਿਆਸ ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੀਨਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: firat piaas jiau jal bin meenaa |6|
English: he wanders around thirsty like a fish out of water. ||6||

Gurbani: ਕਛੂ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਉਕਤਿ ਨ ਮੋਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kachhoo siaanap ukat na moree |
English: I have no clever tricks or techniques;

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਆਸ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੋਰੀ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: ek aas tthaakur prabh toree |7|
English: You are my only hope, O my Lord God Master. ||7||

Gurbani: ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਸੰਤਨ ਪਾਸੇ ॥
Transliteration: krau benatee santan paase |
English: Nanak offers this prayer to the Saints

Gurbani: ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਰਦਾਸੇ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: mel laihu naanak aradaase |8|
English: - please let me merge and blend with You. ||8||

Gurbani: ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bheo kripaal saadhasang paaeaa |
English: God has shown Mercy, and I have found the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak tripate pooraa paaeaa |1| rahaau doojaa |1|
English: Nanak is satisfied, finding the Perfect Lord. ||1||Second Pause||1||

[Ang 760 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: raag soohee mahalaa 5 ghar 3 |
English: Raag Soohee, Fifth Mehl, Third House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਮਿਥਨ ਮੋਹ ਅਗਨਿ ਸੋਕ ਸਾਗਰ ॥
Transliteration: mithan moh agan sok saagar |
English: Attachment to sex is an ocean of fire and pain.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਉਧਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਗਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa udhar har naagar |1|
English: By Your Grace, O Sublime Lord, please save me from it. ||1||

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਸਰਣਾਇ ਨਰਾਇਣ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal saranaae naraaein |
English: I seek the Sanctuary of the Lotus Feet of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਭਗਤ ਪਰਾਇਣ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: deenaa naath bhagat paraaein |1| rahaau |
English: He is the Master of the meek, the Support of His devotees. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਨਾਥਾ ਨਾਥ ਭਗਤ ਭੈ ਮੇਟਨ ॥
Transliteration: anaathaa naath bhagat bhai mettan |
English: Master of the masterless, Patron of the forlorn, Eradicator of fear of His devotees.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਮਦੂਤ ਨ ਭੇਟਨ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saadhasang jamadoot na bhettan |2|
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Messenger of Death cannot even touch them. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਨ ਰੂਪ ਅਨੂਪ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeevan roop anoop deaalaa |
English: The Merciful, Incomparably Beautiful, Embodiment of Life.

Gurbani: ਰਵਣ ਗੁਣਾ ਕਟੀਐ ਜਮ ਜਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ravan gunaa katteeai jam jaalaa |3|
English: Vibrating the Glorious Virtues of the Lord, the noose of the Messenger of Death is cut away. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਨ ਨਿਤ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: amrit naam rasan nit jaapai |
English: One who constantly chants the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam with his tongue,

Gurbani: ਰੋਗ ਰੂਪ ਮਾਇਆ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: rog roop maaeaa na biaapai |4|
English: is not touched or affected by Maya, the embodiment of disease. ||4||

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸੰਗੀ ਸਭਿ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jap gobind sangee sabh taare |
English: Chant and meditate on God, the Lord of the Universe, and all of your companions shall be carried across;

Gurbani: ਪੋਹਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਪੰਚ ਬਟਵਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: pohat naahee panch battavaare |5|
English: the five thieves will not even approach. ||5||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: man bach kram prabh ek dhiaae |
English: One who meditates on the One God in thought, word and deed

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਫਲਾ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: sarab falaa soee jan paae |6|
English: - that humble being receives the fruits of all rewards. ||6||

Gurbani: ਧਾਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: dhaar anugrahu apanaa prabh keenaa |
English: Showering His Mercy, God has made me His own;

Gurbani: ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਸੁ ਦੀਨਾ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: keval naam bhagat ras deenaa |7|
English: He has blessed me with the unique and singular Naam, and the sublime essence of devotion. ||7||

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aad madh ant prabh soee |
English: In the beginning, in the middle, and in the end, He is God.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੮॥੧॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak tis bin avar na koee |8|1|2|
English: O Nanak, without Him, there is no other at all. ||8||1||2||

[Ang 760 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: raag soohee mahalaa 5 asattapadeea ghar 9 |
English: Raag Soohee, Fifth Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa, Ninth House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਡਿਠਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਰਹਸੀਐ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਤਿਨੑ ਸੰਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: jin dditthiaa man rahaseeai kiau paaeeai tina sang jeeo |
English: Gazing upon them, my mind is enraptured. How can I join them and be with them?

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਸਜਨ ਮਨ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੇ ਲਾਇਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: sant sajan man mitr se laaein prabh siau rang jeeo |
English: They are Saints and friends, good friends of my mind, who inspire me and help me tune in to God's Love.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨੑ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਤੁਟਈ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਭੰਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tina siau preet na tuttee kabahu na hovai bhang jeeo |1|
English: My love for them shall never die; it shall never, ever be broken. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham prabh kar deaa gun gaavaa tere nit jeeo |
English: O Supreme Lord God, please grant me Your Grace, that I might constantly sing Your Glorious Praises.

Gurbani: ਆਇ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਸਜਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹ ਮਨ ਮਿਤ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aae milahu sant sajanaa naam japah man mit jeeo |1| rahaau |
English: Come, and meet with me, O Saints, and good friends; let us chant and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the Best Friend of my mind. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦੇਖੈ ਸੁਣੇ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਅੰਧੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: dekhai sune na jaanee maaeaa mohiaa andh jeeo |
English: He does not see, he does not hear, and he does not understand; he is blind, enticed and bewitched by Maya.

Gurbani: ਕਾਚੀ ਦੇਹਾ ਵਿਣਸਣੀ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਧੰਧੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: kaachee dehaa vinasanee koorr kamaavai dhandh jeeo |
English: His body is false and transitory; it shall perish. And still, he entangles himself in false pursuits.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਿਣਿ ਚਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਨਬੰਧੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naam dhiaaveh se jin chale gur poore sanabandh jeeo |2|
English: They alone depart victorious, who have meditated on the Naam; they stick with the Perfect Guru. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ਚਲਣੁ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸੰਜੋਗਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: hukame jug meh aaeaa chalan hukam sanjog jeeo |
English: By the Hukam of God's Will, they come into this world, and they leave upon receipt of His Hukam.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਕਰੇ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: hukame parapanch pasariaa hukam kare ras bhog jeeo |
English: By His Hukam, the Expanse of the Universe is expanded. By His Hukam, they enjoy pleasures.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਾ ਸੋਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jis no karataa visarai tiseh vichhorraa sog jeeo |3|
English: One who forgets the Creator Lord, suffers sorrow and separation. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਪਨੜੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣਿਆ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: aapanarre prabh bhaaniaa daragah paidhaa jaae jeeo |
English: One who is pleasing to his God, goes to His Court dressed in robes of honor.

Gurbani: ਐਥੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਉਜਲਾ ਇਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: aithai sukh mukh ujalaa iko naam dhiaae jeeo |
English: One who meditates on the Naam, the One Name, finds peace in this world; his face is radiant and bright.

Gurbani: ਆਦਰੁ ਦਿਤਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਸਤ ਭਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: aadar ditaa paarabraham gur seviaa sat bhaae jeeo |4|
English: The Supreme Lord confers honor and respect on those who serve the Guru with true love. ||4||

Gurbani: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: thaan thanantar rav rahiaa sarab jeea pratipaal jeeo |
English: He is pervading and permeating the spaces and interspaces; He loves and cherishes all beings.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: sach khajaanaa sanchiaa ek naam dhan maal jeeo |
English: I have accumulated the true treasure, the wealth and riches of the One Name.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਤੇ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: man te kabahu na veesarai jaa aape hoe deaal jeeo |5|
English: I shall never forget Him from my mind, since He has been so merciful to me. ||5||

Gurbani: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣਾ ਰਹਿ ਗਏ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: aavan jaanaa reh ge man vutthaa nirankaar jeeo |
English: My comings and goings have ended; the Formless Lord now dwells within my mind.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਊਚਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: taa kaa ant na paaeeai aoochaa agam apaar jeeo |
English: His limits cannot be found; He is lofty and exalted, inaccessible and infinite.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਸੋ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਲਖ ਵਾਰ ਜੀਉ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: jis prabh apanaa visarai so mar jamai lakh vaar jeeo |6|
English: One who forgets His God, shall die and be reincarnated, hundreds of thousands of times. ||6||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੁ ਨੇਹੁ ਤਿਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਾ ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਆਪਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: saach nehu tin preetamaa jin man vutthaa aap jeeo |
English: They alone bear true love for their God, within whose minds He Himself dwells.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਸਾਝੀ ਤਿਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸੇ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਪਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: gun saajhee tin sang base aatth pehar prabh jaap jeeo |
English: So dwell only with those who share their virtues; chant and meditate on God, twenty-four hours a day.

Gurbani: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੈ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਤਾਪ ਜੀਉ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: rang rate paramesarai binase sagal santaap jeeo |7|
English: They are attuned to the Love of the Transcendent Lord; all their sorrows and afflictions are dispelled. ||7||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਏਕੁ ਅਨੇਕ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: toon karataa toon karanahaar toohai ek anek jeeo |
English: You are the Creator, You are the Cause of causes; You are the One and the many.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਤੂ ਸਰਬ ਮੈ ਤੂਹੈ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: too samarath too sarab mai toohai budh bibek jeeo |
English: You are All-powerful, You are present everywhere; You are the subtle intellect, the clear wisdom.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਜਪੀ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਜੀਉ ॥੮॥੧॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak naam sadaa japee bhagat janaa kee ttek jeeo |8|1|3|
English: Nanak chants and meditates forever on the Naam, the Support of the humble devotees. ||8||1||3||

[Ang 761 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੧੦ ਕਾਫੀ ॥
Transliteration: raag soohee mahalaa 5 asattapadeea ghar 10 kaafee |
English: Raag Soohee, Fifth Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa, Tenth House, Kaafee:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਭੁਲੀ ਜੇ ਚੁਕੀ ਸਾੲਂੀ ਭੀ ਤਹਿੰਜੀ ਕਾਢੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: je bhulee je chukee saaenee bhee tahinjee kaadteea |
English: Even though I have made mistakes, and even though I have been wrong, I am still called Yours, O my Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਦੂਜਾਣੇ ਲਗਾ ਝੂਰਿ ਮਰਹੁ ਸੇ ਵਾਢੀਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jinaa nehu doojaane lagaa jhoor marahu se vaadteea |1|
English: Those who enshrine love for another, die regretting and repenting. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਨਾ ਛੋਡਉ ਕੰਤ ਪਾਸਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: hau naa chhoddau kant paasaraa |
English: I shall never leave my Husband Lord's side.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗੀਲਾ ਲਾਲੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਏਹੁ ਮਹਿੰਜਾ ਆਸਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa rangeelaa laal piaaraa ehu mahinjaa aasaraa |1| rahaau |
English: My Beloved Lover is always and forever beautiful. He is my hope and inspiration. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਜਣੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਸੈਣੁ ਤੂ ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਉਪਰਿ ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: sajan toohai sain too mai tujh upar bahu maaneea |
English: You are my Best Friend; You are my relative. I am so proud of You.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤੂ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤਾ ਸੁਖੇ ਤੂੰ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਮਾਣੀਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jaa too andar taa sukhe toon nimaanee maaneea |2|
English: And when You dwell within me, I am at peace. I am without honor - You are my honor. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਤੂ ਤੁਠਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਵੇਖਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: je too tutthaa kripaa nidhaan naa doojaa vekhaal |
English: And when You are pleased with me, O treasure of mercy, then I do not see any other.

Gurbani: ਏਹਾ ਪਾਈ ਮੂ ਦਾਤੜੀ ਨਿਤ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਖਾ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ehaa paaee moo daatarree nit hiradai rakhaa samaal |3|
English: Please grant me this blessing, that that I may forever dwell upon You and cherish You within my heart. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪਾਵ ਜੁਲਾਈ ਪੰਧ ਤਉ ਨੈਣੀ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: paav julaaee pandh tau nainee daras dikhaal |
English: Let my feet walk on Your Path, and let my eyes behold the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਸੁਣੀ ਕਹਾਣੀਆ ਜੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਥੀਵੈ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਿ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: sravanee sunee kahaaneea je gur theevai kirapaal |4|
English: With my ears, I will listen to Your Sermon, if the Guru becomes merciful to me. ||4||

Gurbani: ਕਿਤੀ ਲਖ ਕਰੋੜਿ ਪਿਰੀਏ ਰੋਮ ਨ ਪੁਜਨਿ ਤੇਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: kitee lakh karorr piree rom na pujan teriaa |
English: Hundreds of thousands and millions do not equal even one hair of Yours, O my Beloved.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਸਾਹੀ ਹੂ ਸਾਹੁ ਹਉ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਾ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰਿਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: too saahee hoo saahu hau keh na sakaa gun teriaa |5|
English: You are the King of kings; I cannot even describe Your Glorious Praises. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸਹੀਆ ਤਊ ਅਸੰਖ ਮੰਞਹੁ ਹਭਿ ਵਧਾਣੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: saheea taoo asankh manyahu habh vadhaaneea |
English: Your brides are countless; they are all greater than I am.

Gurbani: ਹਿਕ ਭੋਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: hik bhoree nadar nihaal dehi daras rang maaneea |6|
English: Please bless me with Your Glance of Grace, even for an instant; please bless me with Your Darshan, that I may revel in Your Love. ||6||

Gurbani: ਜੈ ਡਿਠੇ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰੀਐ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਵੰਞਨਿੑ ਦੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jai dditthe man dheereeai kilavikh vanyana doore |
English: Seeing Him, my mind is comforted and consoled, and my sins and mistakes are far removed.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਮਾਉ ਮੈ ਜੋ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: so kiau visarai maau mai jo rahiaa bharapoore |7|
English: How could I ever forget Him, O my mother? He is permeating and pervading everywhere. ||7||

Gurbani: ਹੋਇ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਢਹਿ ਪਈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: hoe nimaanee dteh pee miliaa sehaj subhaae |
English: In humility, I bowed down in surrender to Him, and He naturally met me.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਇ ॥੮॥੧॥੪॥
Transliteration: poorab likhiaa paaeaa naanak sant sahaae |8|1|4|
English: I have received what was pre-ordained for me, O Nanak, with the help and assistance of the Saints. ||8||1||4||

[Ang 761 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਪੁਕਾਰਨਿ ਪੋਥੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: simrit bed puraan pukaaran potheea |
English: The Simritees, the Vedas, the Puraanas and the other holy scriptures proclaim

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਸਭਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਗਾਲੑੀ ਹੋਛੀਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naam binaa sabh koorr gaalaee hochheea |1|
English: that without the Naam, everything is false and worthless. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਭਗਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: naam nidhaan apaar bhagataa man vasai |
English: The infinite treasure of the Naam abides within the minds of the devotees.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਮੋਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਸੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: janam maran mohu dukh saadhoo sang nasai |1| rahaau |
English: Birth and death, attachment and suffering, are erased in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਬਾਦਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਸਰਪਰ ਰੁੰਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: mohi baad ahankaar sarapar runiaa |
English: Those who indulge in attachment, conflict and egotism shall surely weep and cry.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਨਿੑ ਮੂਲਿ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sukh na paaeina mool naam vichhuniaa |2|
English: Those who are separated from the Naam shall never find any peace. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਧਾਰਿ ਬੰਧਨਿ ਬੰਧਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: meree meree dhaar bandhan bandhiaa |
English: Crying out, Mine! Mine!, he is bound in bondage.

Gurbani: ਨਰਕਿ ਸੁਰਗਿ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਧੰਧਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: narak surag avataar maaeaa dhandhiaa |3|
English: Entangled in Maya, he is reincarnated in heaven and hell. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੋਧਤ ਸੋਧਤ ਸੋਧਿ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sodhat sodhat sodh tat beechaariaa |
English: Searching, searching, searching, I have come to understand the essence of reality.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਸਰਪਰ ਹਾਰਿਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: naam binaa sukh naeh sarapar haariaa |4|
English: Without the Naam, there is no peace at all, and the mortal will surely fail. ||4||

Gurbani: ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਅਨੇਕ ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: aaveh jaeh anek mar mar janamate |
English: Many come and go; they die, and die again, and are reincarnated.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਸਭੁ ਵਾਦਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਭਰਮਤੇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: bin boojhe sabh vaad jonee bharamate |5|
English: Without understanding, they are totally useless, and they wander in reincarnation. ||5||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ ਤਿਨੑ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jina kau bhe deaal tina saadhoo sang bheaa |
English: They alone join the Saadh Sangat, unto whom the Lord becomes Merciful.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਜਨੀ ਜਪਿ ਲਇਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: amrit har kaa naam tinaee janee jap leaa |6|
English: They chant and meditate on the Ambrosial Name of the Lord. ||6||

Gurbani: ਖੋਜਹਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਸੰਖ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਨੰਤ ਕੇ ॥
Transliteration: khojeh kott asankh bahut anant ke |
English: Uncounted millions, so many they are endless, search for Him.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਨੇੜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: jis bujhaae aap nerraa tis he |7|
English: But only that one, who understands his own self, sees God near at hand. ||7||

Gurbani: ਵਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਦਾਤਾਰ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: visar naahee daataar aapanaa naam dehu |
English: Never forget me, O Great Giver - please bless me with Your Naam.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਚਾਉ ਏਹੁ ॥੮॥੨॥੫॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: gun gaavaa din raat naanak chaau ehu |8|2|5|16|
English: To sing Your Glorious Praises day and night - O Nanak, this is my heart-felt desire. ||8||2||5||16||

[Ang 762 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਕੁਚਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: raag soohee mahalaa 1 kuchajee |
English: Raag Soohee, First Mehl, Kuchajee ~ The Ungraceful Bride:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਮੰਞੁ ਕੁਚਜੀ ਅੰਮਾਵਣਿ ਡੋਸੜੇ ਹਉ ਕਿਉ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਵਣਿ ਜਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: many kuchajee amaavan ddosarre hau kiau sahu raavan jaau jeeo |
English: I am ungraceful and ill-mannered, full of endless faults. How can I go to enjoy my Husband Lord?

Gurbani: ਇਕ ਦੂ ਇਕਿ ਚੜੰਦੀਆ ਕਉਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: eik doo ik charrandeea kaun jaanai meraa naau jeeo |
English: Each of His soul-brides is better than the rest - who even knows my name?

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਸੇ ਅੰਬੀ ਛਾਵੜੀਏਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: jinaee sakhee sahu raaviaa se anbee chhaavarreehi jeeo |
English: Those brides who enjoy their Husband Lord are very blessed, resting in the shade of the mango tree.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਗੁਣ ਮੰਞੁ ਨ ਆਵਨੀ ਹਉ ਕੈ ਜੀ ਦੋਸ ਧਰੇਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: se gun many na aavanee hau kai jee dos dhareo jeeo |
English: I do not have their virtue - who can I blame for this?

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਵਿਥਰਾ ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਕਿਆ ਘਿਨਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa gun tere vitharaa hau kiaa kiaa ghinaa teraa naau jeeo |
English: Which of Your Virtues, O Lord, should I speak of? Which of Your Names should I chant?

Gurbani: ਇਕਤੁ ਟੋਲਿ ਨ ਅੰਬੜਾ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਜਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: eikat ttol na anbarraa hau sad kurabaanai terai jaau jeeo |
English: I cannot even reach one of Your Virtues. I am forever a sacrifice to You.

Gurbani: ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਰੰਗੁਲਾ ਮੋਤੀ ਤੈ ਮਾਣਿਕੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: sueinaa rupaa rangulaa motee tai maanik jeeo |
English: Gold, silver, pearls and rubies are pleasing.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਵਸਤੂ ਸਹਿ ਦਿਤੀਆ ਮੈ ਤਿਨੑ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਇਆ ਚਿਤੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: se vasatoo seh diteea mai tina siau laaeaa chit jeeo |
English: My Husband Lord has blessed me with these things, and I have focused my thoughts on them.

Gurbani: ਮੰਦਰ ਮਿਟੀ ਸੰਦੜੇ ਪਥਰ ਕੀਤੇ ਰਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: mandar mittee sandarre pathar keete raas jeeo |
English: Palaces of brick and mud are built and decorated with stones;

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਏਨੀ ਟੋਲੀ ਭੁਲੀਅਸੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੰਤ ਨ ਬੈਠੀ ਪਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: hau enee ttolee bhuleeas tis kant na baitthee paas jeeo |
English: I have been fooled by these decorations, and I do not sit near my Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਅੰਬਰਿ ਕੂੰਜਾ ਕੁਰਲੀਆ ਬਗ ਬਹਿਠੇ ਆਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: anbar koonjaa kuraleea bag bahitthe aae jeeo |
English: The cranes shriek overhead in the sky, and the herons have come to rest.

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਚਲੀ ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਦੇਸੀ ਅਗੈ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: saa dhan chalee saahurai kiaa muhu desee agai jaae jeeo |
English: The bride has gone to her father-in-law's house; in the world hereafter, what face will she show?

Gurbani: ਸੁਤੀ ਸੁਤੀ ਝਾਲੁ ਥੀਆ ਭੁਲੀ ਵਾਟੜੀਆਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: sutee sutee jhaal theea bhulee vaattarreeaas jeeo |
English: She kept sleeping as the day dawned; she forgot all about her journey.

Gurbani: ਤੈ ਸਹ ਨਾਲਹੁ ਮੁਤੀਅਸੁ ਦੁਖਾ ਕੂੰ ਧਰੀਆਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: tai seh naalahu muteeas dukhaa koon dhareeaas jeeo |
English: She separated herself from her Husband Lord, and now she suffers in pain.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਗੁਣ ਮੈ ਸਭਿ ਅਵਗਣਾ ਇਕ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: tudh gun mai sabh avaganaa ik naanak kee aradaas jeeo |
English: Virtue is in You, O Lord; I am totally without virtue. This is Nanak's only prayer:

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਮੈ ਡੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਕਾਈ ਰਾਤਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sabh raatee sohaaganee mai ddohaagan kaaee raat jeeo |1|
English: You give all Your nights to the virtuous soul-brides. I know I am unworthy, but isn't there a night for me as well? ||1||

[Ang 762 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਸੁਚਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 1 suchajee |
English: Soohee, First Mehl, Suchajee ~ The Noble And Graceful Bride:

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤੂ ਤਾ ਮੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੂ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਰਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaa too taa mai sabh ko too saahib meree raas jeeo |
English: When I have You, then I have everything. O my Lord and Master, You are my wealth and capital.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਉ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸਾ ਤੂੰ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: tudh antar hau sukh vasaa toon antar saabaas jeeo |
English: Within You, I abide in peace; within You, I am congratulated.

Gurbani: ਭਾਣੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਵਡਾਈਆ ਭਾਣੈ ਭੀਖ ਉਦਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhaanai takhat vaddaaeea bhaanai bheekh udaas jeeo |
English: By the Pleasure of Your Will, You bestow thrones and greatness. And by the Pleasure of Your Will, You make us beggars and wanderers.

Gurbani: ਭਾਣੈ ਥਲ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਰੁ ਵਹੈ ਕਮਲੁ ਫੁਲੈ ਆਕਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhaanai thal sir sar vahai kamal fulai aakaas jeeo |
English: By the Pleasure of Your Will, the ocean flows in the desert, and the lotus blossoms in the sky.

Gurbani: ਭਾਣੈ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਲੰਘੀਐ ਭਾਣੈ ਮੰਝਿ ਭਰੀਆਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhaanai bhavajal langheeai bhaanai manjh bhareeaas jeeo |
English: By the Pleasure of Your Will, one crosses over the terrifying world-ocean; by the Pleasure of Your Will, he sinks down into it.

Gurbani: ਭਾਣੈ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਰੰਗੁਲਾ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਰਤਾ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhaanai so sahu rangulaa sifat rataa gunataas jeeo |
English: By the Pleasure of His Will, that Lord becomes my Husband, and I am imbued with the Praises of the Lord, the treasure of virtue.

Gurbani: ਭਾਣੈ ਸਹੁ ਭੀਹਾਵਲਾ ਹਉ ਆਵਣਿ ਜਾਣਿ ਮੁਈਆਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhaanai sahu bheehaavalaa hau aavan jaan mueeaas jeeo |
English: By the Pleasure of Your Will, O my Husband Lord, I am afraid of You, and I come and go, and die.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਸਹੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਤੋਲਵਾ ਹਉ ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਢਹਿ ਪਈਆਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: too sahu agam atolavaa hau keh keh dteh peeaas jeeo |
English: You, O my Husband Lord, are inaccessible and immeasurable; talking and speaking of You, I have fallen at Your Feet.

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਮਾਗਉ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਮੈ ਦਰਸਨ ਭੂਖ ਪਿਆਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa maagau kiaa keh sunee mai darasan bhookh piaas jeeo |
English: What should I beg for? What should I say and hear? I am hungry and thirsty for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਹੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gurasabadee sahu paaeaa sach naanak kee aradaas jeeo |2|
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, I have found my Husband Lord. This is Nanak's true prayer. ||2||

[Ang 763 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 gunavantee |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl, Gunvantee ~ The Worthy And Virtuous Bride:

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo deesai gurasikharraa tis niv niv laagau paae jeeo |
English: When I see a Sikh of the Guru, I humbly bow and fall at his feet.

Gurbani: ਆਖਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: aakhaa birathaa jeea kee gur sajan dehi milaae jeeo |
English: I tell to him the pain of my soul, and beg him to unite me with the Guru, my Best Friend.

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਦਸਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੜਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: soee das upadesarraa meraa man anat na kaahoo jaae jeeo |
English: I ask that he impart to me such an understanding, that my mind will not go out wandering anywhere else.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤੈ ਕੂੰ ਡੇਵਸਾ ਮੈ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਬਤਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: eihu man tai koon ddevasaa mai maarag dehu bataae jeeo |
English: I dedicate this mind to you. Please, show me the Path to God.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਆਇਆ ਦੂਰਹੁ ਚਲਿ ਕੈ ਮੈ ਤਕੀ ਤਉ ਸਰਣਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: hau aaeaa doorahu chal kai mai takee tau saranaae jeeo |
English: I have come so far, seeking the Protection of Your Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਆਸਾ ਰਖੀ ਚਿਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਭੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: mai aasaa rakhee chit meh meraa sabho dukh gavaae jeeo |
English: Within my mind, I place my hopes in You; please, take my pain and suffering away!

Gurbani: ਇਤੁ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਲੇ ਭਾਈਅੜੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: eit maarag chale bhaaeearre gur kahai su kaar kamaae jeeo |
English: So walk on this Path, O sister soul-brides; do that work which the Guru tells you to do.

Gurbani: ਤਿਆਗੇਂ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤੜੀ ਵਿਸਾਰੇਂ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: tiaagen man kee matarree visaaren doojaa bhaau jeeo |
English: Abandon the intellectual pursuits of the mind, and forget the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਇਉ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਾਵੜਾ ਨਹ ਲਗੈ ਤਤੀ ਵਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: eiau paaveh har darasaavarraa neh lagai tatee vaau jeeo |
English: In this way, you shall obtain the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan; the hot winds shall not even touch you.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਆਪਹੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਮੈ ਕਹਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਹੁਕਮਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: hau aapahu bol na jaanadaa mai kahiaa sabh hukamaau jeeo |
English: By myself, I do not even know how to speak; I speak all that the Lord commands.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਬਖਸਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਕੀਆ ਪਸਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har bhagat khajaanaa bakhasiaa gur naanak keea pasaau jeeo |
English: I am blessed with the treasure of the Lord's devotional worship; Guru Nanak has been kind and compassionate to me.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖੜੀ ਹਉ ਰਜਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: mai bahurr na trisanaa bhukharree hau rajaa tripat aghaae jeeo |
English: I shall never again feel hunger or thirst; I am satisfied, satiated and fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਿਖੜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jo gur deesai sikharraa tis niv niv laagau paae jeeo |3|
English: When I see a Sikh of the Guru, I humbly bow and fall at his feet. ||3||

[Ang 763 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raag soohee chhant mahalaa 1 ghar 1 |
English: Raag Soohee, Chhant, First Mehl, First House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਭਰਿ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਮੈ ਮਤ ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਹੁਣੀ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhar joban mai mat peeearrai ghar paahunee bal raam jeeo |
English: Intoxicated with the wine of youth, I did not realize that I was only a guest at my parents' home (in this world).

Gurbani: ਮੈਲੀ ਅਵਗਣਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਗੁਣ ਨ ਸਮਾਵਨੀ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: mailee avagan chit bin gur gun na samaavanee bal raam jeeo |
English: My consciousness is polluted with faults and mistakes; without the Guru, virtue does not even enter into me.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੀ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਬਾਦਿ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gun saar na jaanee bharam bhulaanee joban baad gavaaeaa |
English: I have not known the value of virtue; I have been deluded by doubt. I have wasted away my youth in vain.

Gurbani: ਵਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤਾ ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: var ghar dar darasan nahee jaataa pir kaa sehaj na bhaaeaa |
English: I have not known my Husband Lord, His celestial home and gate, or the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. I have not had the pleasure of my Husband Lord's celestial peace.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਛਿ ਨ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਾਲੀ ਸੂਤੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: satigur poochh na maarag chaalee sootee rain vihaanee |
English: After consulting the True Guru, I have not walked on the Path; the night of my life is passing away in sleep.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਲਤਣਿ ਰਾਡੇਪਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਧਨ ਕੁਮਲਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak baalatan raaddepaa bin pir dhan kumalaanee |1|
English: O Nanak, in the prime of my youth, I am a widow; without my Husband Lord, the soul-bride is wasting away. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਾਬਾ ਮੈ ਵਰੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: baabaa mai var dehi mai har var bhaavai tis kee bal raam jeeo |
English: O father, give me in marriage to the Lord; I am pleased with Him as my Husband. I belong to Him.

Gurbani: ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਬਾਣੀ ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: rav rahiaa jug chaar tribhavan baanee jis kee bal raam jeeo |
English: He is pervading throughout the four ages, and the Word of His Bani permeates the three worlds.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਕੰਤੁ ਰਵੈ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਅਵਗਣਵੰਤੀ ਦੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: tribhavan kant ravai sohaagan avaganavantee doore |
English: The Husband Lord of the three worlds ravishes and enjoys His virtuous brides, but He keeps the ungraceful and unvirtuous ones far away.

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੀ ਆਸਾ ਤੈਸੀ ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jaisee aasaa taisee manasaa poor rahiaa bharapoore |
English: As are our hopes, so are our minds' desires, which the All-pervading Lord brings to fulfillment.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਸੁ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਰਾਂਡ ਨ ਮੈਲੈ ਵੇਸੇ ॥
Transliteration: har kee naar su sarab suhaagan raandd na mailai vese |
English: The bride of the Lord is forever happy and virtuous; she shall never be a widow, and she shall never have to wear dirty clothes.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈ ਵਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਭਾਵੈ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਤੈਸੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak mai var saachaa bhaavai jug jug preetam taise |2|
English: O Nanak, I love my True Husband Lord; my Beloved is the same, age after age. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬਾਬਾ ਲਗਨੁ ਗਣਾਇ ਹੰ ਭੀ ਵੰਞਾ ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: baabaa lagan ganaae han bhee vanyaa saahurai bal raam jeeo |
English: O Baba, calculate that auspicious moment, when I too shall be going to my in-laws' house.

Gurbani: ਸਾਹਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਰਜਾਇ ਸੋ ਨ ਟਲੈ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰੈ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: saahaa hukam rajaae so na ttalai jo prabh karai bal raam jeeo |
English: The moment of that marriage will be set by the Hukam of God's Command; His Will cannot be changed.

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਤੁ ਪਇਆ ਕਰਤੈ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: kirat peaa karatai kar paaeaa mett na sakai koee |
English: The karmic record of past deeds, written by the Creator Lord, cannot be erased by anyone.

Gurbani: ਜਾਞੀ ਨਾਉ ਨਰਹ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jaayee naau narah nihakeval rav rahiaa tihu loee |
English: The most respected member of the marriage party, my Husband, is the independent Lord of all beings, pervading and permeating the three worlds.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇ ਨਿਰਾਸੀ ਰੋਇ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੀ ਬਾਲੀ ਬਾਲੈ ਹੇਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: maae niraasee roe vichhunee baalee baalai hete |
English: Maya, crying out in pain, leaves, seeing that the bride and the groom are in love.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਖ ਮਹਲੀ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚੇਤੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak saach sabad sukh mahalee gur charanee prabh chete |3|
English: O Nanak, the peace of the Mansion of God's Presence comes through the True Word of the Shabad; the bride keeps the Guru's Feet enshrined in her mind. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬਾਬੁਲਿ ਦਿਤੜੀ ਦੂਰਿ ਨਾ ਆਵੈ ਘਰਿ ਪੇਈਐ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: baabul ditarree door naa aavai ghar peeeai bal raam jeeo |
English: My father has given me in marriage far away, and I shall not return to my parents' home.

Gurbani: ਰਹਸੀ ਵੇਖਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਪਿਰਿ ਰਾਵੀ ਘਰਿ ਸੋਹੀਐ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: rahasee vekh hadoor pir raavee ghar soheeai bal raam jeeo |
English: I am delighted to see my Husband Lord near at hand; in His Home, I am so beautiful.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੇ ਪਿਰ ਲੋੜੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਜੋੜੀ ਮਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਪਰਧਾਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: saache pir lorree preetam jorree mat pooree paradhaane |
English: My True Beloved Husband Lord desires me; He has joined me to Himself, and made my intellect pure and sublime.

Gurbani: ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਮੇਲਾ ਥਾਨਿ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: sanjogee melaa thaan suhelaa gunavantee gur giaane |
English: By good destiny I met Him, and was given a place of rest; through the Guru's Wisdom, I have become virtuous.

Gurbani: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਪਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਪਿਰ ਭਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sat santokh sadaa sach palai sach bolai pir bhaae |
English: I gather lasting Truth and contentment in my lap, and my Beloved is pleased with my truthful speech.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਨਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak vichhurr naa dukh paae guramat ank samaae |4|1|
English: O Nanak, I shall not suffer the pain of separation; through the Guru's Teachings, I merge into the loving embrace of the Lord's Being. ||4||1||

[Ang 764 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਛੰਤੁ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: raag soohee mahalaa 1 chhant ghar 2 |
English: Raag Soohee, First Mehl, Chhant, Second House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਘਰਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: ham ghar saajan aae |
English: My friends have come into my home.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੈ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: saachai mel milaae |
English: The True Lord has united me with them.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਏ ਪੰਚ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj milaae har man bhaae panch mile sukh paaeaa |
English: The Lord automatically united me with them when it pleased Him; uniting with the chosen ones, I have found peace.

Gurbani: ਸਾਈ ਵਸਤੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: saaee vasat paraapat hoee jis setee man laaeaa |
English: I have obtained that thing, which my mind desired.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਮੇਲੁ ਭਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਸੋਹਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: anadin mel bheaa man maaniaa ghar mandar sohaae |
English: Meeting with them, night and day, my mind is pleased; my home and mansion are beautified.

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਵਾਜੇ ਹਮ ਘਰਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਆਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: panch sabad dhun anahad vaaje ham ghar saajan aae |1|
English: The unstruck sound current of the Panch Shabad, the Five Primal Sounds, vibrates and resounds; my friends have come into my home. ||1||

Gurbani: ਆਵਹੁ ਮੀਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aavahu meet piaare |
English: So come, my beloved friends,

Gurbani: ਮੰਗਲ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਨਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: mangal gaavahu naare |
English: And sing the songs of joy, O sisters.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਹੁ ਸੋਹਿਲੜਾ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sach mangal gaavahu taa prabh bhaavahu sohilarraa jug chaare |
English: Sing the true songs of joy and God will be pleased. You shall be celebrated throughout the four ages.

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਥਾਨਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: apanai ghar aaeaa thaan suhaaeaa kaaraj sabad savaare |
English: My Husband Lord has come into my home, and my place is adorned and decorated. Through the Shabad, my affairs have been resolved.

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਨੇਤ੍ਰੀ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਰੂਪੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: giaan mahaa ras netree anjan tribhavan roop dikhaaeaa |
English: Applying the ointment, the supreme essence, of divine wisdom to my eyes, I see the Lord's form throughout the three worlds.

Gurbani: ਸਖੀ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਰਸਿ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਹਮ ਘਰਿ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sakhee milahu ras mangal gaavahu ham ghar saajan aaeaa |2|
English: So join with me, my sisters, and sing the songs of joy and delight; my friends have come into my home. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਭਿੰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: man tan amrit bhinaa |
English: My mind and body are drenched with Ambrosial Nectar;

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਰਤੰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: antar prem ratanaa |
English: deep within the nucleus of my self, is the jewel of the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਪਰਮ ਤਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: antar ratan padaarath merai param tat veechaaro |
English: This invaluable jewel is deep within me; I contemplate the supreme essence of reality.

Gurbani: ਜੰਤ ਭੇਖ ਤੂ ਸਫਲਿਓ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: jant bhekh too safalio daataa sir sir devanahaaro |
English: Living beings are mere beggars; You are the Giver of rewards; You are the Giver to each and every being.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਜਾਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: too jaan giaanee antarajaamee aape kaaran keenaa |
English: You are Wise and All-knowing, the Inner-knower; You Yourself created the creation.

Gurbani: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਸਖੀ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਨਿ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਭੀਨਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sunahu sakhee man mohan mohiaa tan man amrit bheenaa |3|
English: So listen, O my sisters - the Enticer has enticed my mind. My body and mind are drenched with Nectar. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aatam raam sansaaraa |
English: O Supreme Soul of the World,

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: saachaa khel tumaaraa |
English: Your play is true.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਉਣੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sach khel tumaaraa agam apaaraa tudh bin kaun bujhaae |
English: Your play is true, O Inaccessible and Infinite Lord; without You, who can make me understand?

Gurbani: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਆਣੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਵਣੁ ਕਹਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sidh saadhik siaane kete tujh bin kavan kahaae |
English: There are millions of Siddhas and enlightened seekers, but without You, who can call himself one?

Gurbani: ਕਾਲੁ ਬਿਕਾਲੁ ਭਏ ਦੇਵਾਨੇ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਠਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: kaal bikaal bhe devaane man raakhiaa gur tthaae |
English: Death and rebirth drive the mind insane; only the Guru can hold it in its place.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਵਗਣ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗਮਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੧॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak avagan sabad jalaae gun sangam prabh paae |4|1|2|
English: O Nanak, one who burns away his demerits and faults with the Shabad, accumulates virtue, and finds God. ||4||1||2||

[Ang 764 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: raag soohee mahalaa 1 ghar 3 |
English: Raag Soohee, First Mehl, Third House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਆਵਹੁ ਸਜਣਾ ਹਉ ਦੇਖਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: aavahu sajanaa hau dekhaa darasan teraa raam |
English: Come, my friend, so that I may behold the blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

Gurbani: ਘਰਿ ਆਪਨੜੈ ਖੜੀ ਤਕਾ ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਘਨੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: ghar aapanarrai kharree takaa mai man chaau ghaneraa raam |
English: I stand in my doorway, watching for You; my mind is filled with such a great yearning.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਘਨੇਰਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: man chaau ghaneraa sun prabh meraa mai teraa bharavaasaa |
English: My mind is filled with such a great yearning; hear me, O God - I place my faith in You.

Gurbani: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਭਈ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: darasan dekh bhee nihakeval janam maran dukh naasaa |
English: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, I have become free of desire; the pains of birth and death are taken away.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਤੂ ਸੋਈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sagalee jot jaataa too soee miliaa bhaae subhaae |
English: Your Light is in everyone; through it, You are known. Through love, You are easily met.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਜਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਸਾਚਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak saajan kau bal jaaeeai saach mile ghar aae |1|
English: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to my Friend; He has come home to meet with those who are true. ||1||

Gurbani: ਘਰਿ ਆਇਅੜੇ ਸਾਜਨਾ ਤਾ ਧਨ ਖਰੀ ਸਰਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: ghar aaeiarre saajanaa taa dhan kharee sarasee raam |
English: When her Friend comes to her home, the bride is very pleased.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਮੋਹਿਅੜੀ ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਦੇਖਿ ਰਹੰਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: har mohiarree saach sabad tthaakur dekh rahansee raam |
English: She is fascinated with the True Word of the Lord's Shabad; gazing upon her Lord and Master, she is filled with joy.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਹੰਸੀ ਖਰੀ ਸਰਸੀ ਜਾ ਰਾਵੀ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੈ ॥
Transliteration: gun sang rahansee kharee sarasee jaa raavee rang raatai |
English: She is filled with virtuous joy, and is totally pleased, when she is ravished and enjoyed by her Lord, and imbued with His Love.

Gurbani: ਅਵਗਣ ਮਾਰਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਘਰੁ ਛਾਇਆ ਪੂਰੈ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਬਿਧਾਤੈ ॥
Transliteration: avagan maar gunee ghar chhaaeaa poorai purakh bidhaatai |
English: Her faults and demerits are eradicated, and she roofs her home with virtue, through the Perfect Lord, the Architect of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਤਸਕਰ ਮਾਰਿ ਵਸੀ ਪੰਚਾਇਣਿ ਅਦਲੁ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: tasakar maar vasee panchaaein adal kare veechaare |
English: Conquering the thieves, she dwells as the mistress of her home, and administers justice wisely.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak raam naam nisataaraa guramat mileh piaare |2|
English: O Nanak, through the Lord's Name, she is emancipated; through the Guru's Teachings, she meets her Beloved. ||2||

Gurbani: ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਅੜਾ ਬਾਲੜੀਏ ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: var paaeiarraa baalarree aasaa manasaa pooree raam |
English: The young bride has found her Husband Lord; her hopes and desires are fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਪਿਰਿ ਰਾਵਿਅੜੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਲੀ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਨਹ ਦੂਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: pir raaviarree sabad ralee rav rahiaa neh dooree raam |
English: She enjoys and ravishes her Husband Lord, and blends into the Word of the Shabad, pervading and permeating everywhere; the Lord is not far away.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸੋਈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਸਬਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: prabh door na hoee ghatt ghatt soee tis kee naar sabaaee |
English: God is not far away; He is in each and every heart. All are His brides.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਰਸੀਆ ਆਪੇ ਰਾਵੇ ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: aape raseea aape raave jiau tis dee vaddiaaee |
English: He Himself is the Enjoyer, He Himself ravishes and enjoys; this is His glorious greatness.

Gurbani: ਅਮਰ ਅਡੋਲੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: amar addol amol apaaraa gur poorai sach paaeeai |
English: He is imperishable, immovable, invaluable and infinite. The True Lord is obtained through the Perfect Guru.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਜੋਗ ਸਜੋਗੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak aape jog sajogee nadar kare liv laaeeai |3|
English: O Nanak, He Himself unites in Union; by His Glance of Grace, He lovingly attunes them to Himself. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪਿਰੁ ਉਚੜੀਐ ਮਾੜੜੀਐ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਆ ਸਿਰਤਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: pir ucharreeai maarrarreeai tihu loaa sirataajaa raam |
English: My Husband Lord dwells in the loftiest balcony; He is the Supreme Lord of the three worlds.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਬਿਸਮ ਭਈ ਦੇਖਿ ਗੁਣਾ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਅਗਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: hau bisam bhee dekh gunaa anahad sabad agaajaa raam |
English: I am amazed, gazing upon His glorious excellence; the unstruck sound current of the Shabad vibrates and resonates.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੋ ॥
Transliteration: sabad veechaaree karanee saaree raam naam neesaano |
English: I contemplate the Shabad, and perform sublime deeds; I am blessed with the insignia, the banner of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਖੋਟੇ ਨਹੀ ਠਾਹਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੋ ॥
Transliteration: naam binaa khotte nahee tthaahar naam ratan paravaano |
English: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the false find no place of rest; only the jewel of the Naam brings acceptance and renown.

Gurbani: ਪਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ਨਾ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਜਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: pat mat pooree pooraa paravaanaa naa aavai naa jaasee |
English: Perfect is my honor, perfect is my intellect and password. I shall not have to come or go.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੈਸੇ ਅਵਿਨਾਸੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh aap pachhaanai prabh jaise avinaasee |4|1|3|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh understands her own self; she becomes like her Imperishable Lord God. ||4||1||3||

[Ang 765 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: raag soohee chhant mahalaa 1 ghar 4 |
English: Raag Soohee, Chhant, First Mehl, Fourth House:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਜਗੁ ਧੰਧੜੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jin keea tin dekhiaa jag dhandharrai laaeaa |
English: The One who created the world, watches over it; He enjoins the people of the world to their tasks.

Gurbani: ਦਾਨਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਤਨਿ ਚੰਦੁ ਦੀਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: daan terai ghatt chaananaa tan chand deepaaeaa |
English: Your gifts, O Lord, illuminate the heart, and the moon casts its light on the body.

Gurbani: ਚੰਦੋ ਦੀਪਾਇਆ ਦਾਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਉਠਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: chando deepaaeaa daan har kai dukh andheraa utth geaa |
English: The moon glows, by the Lord's gift, and the darkness of suffering is taken away.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਜੰਞ ਲਾੜੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਸੋਹੈ ਪਰਖਿ ਮੋਹਣੀਐ ਲਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gun jany laarre naal sohai parakh mohaneeai leaa |
English: The marriage party of virtue looks beautiful with the Groom; He chooses His enticing bride with care.

Gurbani: ਵੀਵਾਹੁ ਹੋਆ ਸੋਭ ਸੇਤੀ ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: veevaahu hoaa sobh setee panch sabadee aaeaa |
English: The wedding is performed with glorious splendor; He has arrived, accompanied by the vibrations of the Panch Shabad, the Five Primal Sounds.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਜਗੁ ਧੰਧੜੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jin keea tin dekhiaa jag dhandharrai laaeaa |1|
English: The One who created the world, watches over it; He enjoins the people of the world to their tasks. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਾਜਨਾ ਮੀਤਾ ਅਵਰੀਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: hau balihaaree saajanaa meetaa avareetaa |
English: I am a sacrifice to my pure friends, the immaculate Saints.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਜਿਨ ਸਿਉ ਗਾਡਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਅੜਾ ਦੀਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: eihu tan jin siau gaaddiaa man leearraa deetaa |
English: This body is attached to them, and we have shared our minds.

Gurbani: ਲੀਆ ਤ ਦੀਆ ਮਾਨੁ ਜਿਨੑ ਸਿਉ ਸੇ ਸਜਨ ਕਿਉ ਵੀਸਰਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: leea ta deea maan jina siau se sajan kiau veesareh |
English: We have shared our minds - how could I forget those friends?

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑ ਦਿਸਿ ਆਇਆ ਹੋਹਿ ਰਲੀਆ ਜੀਅ ਸੇਤੀ ਗਹਿ ਰਹਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jina dis aaeaa hohi raleea jeea setee geh raheh |
English: Seeing them brings joy to my heart; I keep them clasped to my soul.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਗੁਣ ਅਵਗਣੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਹੋਹਿ ਨੀਤਾ ਨੀਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: sagal gun avagan na koee hohi neetaa neetaa |
English: They have all virtues and merits, forever and ever; they have no demerits or faults at all.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਾਜਨਾ ਮੀਤਾ ਅਵਰੀਤਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: hau balihaaree saajanaa meetaa avareetaa |2|
English: I am a sacrifice to my pure friends, the immaculate Saints. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਣਾ ਕਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਵਾਸੁਲਾ ਕਢਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਲਈਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: gunaa kaa hovai vaasulaa kadt vaas leejai |
English: One who has a basket of fragrant virtues, should enjoy its fragrance.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਹੋਵਨਿੑ ਸਾਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਝ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: je gun hovana saajanaa mil saajh kareejai |
English: If my friends have virtues, I will share in them.

Gurbani: ਸਾਝ ਕਰੀਜੈ ਗੁਣਹ ਕੇਰੀ ਛੋਡਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਚਲੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: saajh kareejai gunah keree chhodd avagan chaleeai |
English: Let us form a partnership, and share our virtues; let us abandon our faults, and walk on the Path.

Gurbani: ਪਹਿਰੇ ਪਟੰਬਰ ਕਰਿ ਅਡੰਬਰ ਆਪਣਾ ਪਿੜੁ ਮਲੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: pahire pattanbar kar addanbar aapanaa pirr maleeai |
English: Let us wear our virtues like silk clothes; let us decorate ourselves, and enter the arena.

Gurbani: ਜਿਥੈ ਜਾਇ ਬਹੀਐ ਭਲਾ ਕਹੀਐ ਝੋਲਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: jithai jaae baheeai bhalaa kaheeai jhol amrit peejai |
English: Let us speak of goodness, wherever we go and sit; let us skim off the Ambrosial Nectar, and drink it in.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣਾ ਕਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਵਾਸੁਲਾ ਕਢਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਲਈਜੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gunaa kaa hovai vaasulaa kadt vaas leejai |3|
English: One who has a basket of fragrant virtues, should enjoy its fragrance. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਹੋਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aap kare kis aakheeai hor kare na koee |
English: He Himself acts; unto whom should we complain? No one else does anything.

Gurbani: ਆਖਣ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਜਾਈਐ ਜੇ ਭੂਲੜਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aakhan taa kau jaaeeai je bhoolarraa hoee |
English: Go ahead and complain to Him, if He makes a mistake.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਭੂਲਾ ਜਾਇ ਕਹੀਐ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਿਉ ਭੁਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: je hoe bhoolaa jaae kaheeai aap karataa kiau bhulai |
English: If He makes a mistake, go ahead and complain to Him; but how can the Creator Himself make a mistake?

Gurbani: ਸੁਣੇ ਦੇਖੇ ਬਾਝੁ ਕਹਿਐ ਦਾਨੁ ਅਣਮੰਗਿਆ ਦਿਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: sune dekhe baajh kahiai daan anamangiaa divai |
English: He sees, He hears, and without our asking, without our begging, He gives His gifts.

Gurbani: ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਦਾਤਾ ਜਗਿ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: daan dee daataa jag bidhaataa naanakaa sach soee |
English: The Great Giver, the Architect of the Universe, gives His gifts. O Nanak, He is the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਹੋਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੪॥
Transliteration: aap kare kis aakheeai hor kare na koee |4|1|4|
English: He Himself acts; unto whom should we complain? No one else does anything. ||4||1||4||

[Ang 766 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 1 |
English: Soohee, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: meraa man raataa gun ravai man bhaavai soee |
English: My mind is imbued with His Glorious Praises; I chant them, and He is pleasing to my mind.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਉੜੀ ਸਾਚ ਕੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur kee paurree saach kee saachaa sukh hoee |
English: Truth is the ladder to the Guru; climbing up to the True Lord, peace is obtained.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਆਵੈ ਸਾਚ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਚ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਕਿਉ ਟਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: sukh sehaj aavai saach bhaavai saach kee mat kiau ttalai |
English: Celestial peace comes; the Truth pleases me. How could these True Teachings ever be erased?

Gurbani: ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਸੁਗਿਆਨੁ ਮਜਨੁ ਆਪਿ ਅਛਲਿਓ ਕਿਉ ਛਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: eisanaan daan sugiaan majan aap achhalio kiau chhalai |
English: He Himself is Undeceivable; how could He ever be deceived by cleansing baths, charity, spiritual wisdom or ritual bathings?

Gurbani: ਪਰਪੰਚ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਥਾਕੇ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਨ ਦੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: parapanch moh bikaar thaake koorr kapatt na doee |
English: Fraud, attachment and corruption are taken away, as are falsehood, hypocrisy and duality.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: meraa man raataa gun ravai man bhaavai soee |1|
English: My mind is imbued with His Glorious Praises; I chant them, and He is pleasing to my mind. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: saahib so saalaaheeai jin kaaran keea |
English: So praise your Lord and Master, who created the creation.

Gurbani: ਮੈਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ ਮਨਿ ਮੈਲਿਐ ਕਿਨੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: mail laagee man mailiai kinai amrit peea |
English: Filth sticks to the polluted mind; how rare are those who drink in the Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਮਥਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਮੋਲੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: math amrit peea ihu man deea gur peh mol karaaeaa |
English: Churn this Ambrosial Nectar, and drink it in; dedicate this mind to the Guru, and He will value it highly.

Gurbani: ਆਪਨੜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਜਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aapanarraa prabh sehaj pachhaataa jaa man saachai laaeaa |
English: I intuitively realized my God, when I linked my mind to the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵਾ ਕਿਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਹੋਇ ਪਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tis naal gun gaavaa je tis bhaavaa kiau milai hoe paraaeaa |
English: I will sing the Lord's Glorious Praises with Him, if it pleases Him; how could I meet Him by being a stranger to Him?

Gurbani: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saahib so saalaaheeai jin jagat upaaeaa |2|
English: So praise your Lord and Master, who created the creation. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਇ ਗਇਆ ਕੀ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਕਿਉ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: aae geaa kee na aaeo kiau aavai jaataa |
English: When He comes, what else remains behind? How can there be any coming or going then?

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: preetam siau man maaniaa har setee raataa |
English: When the mind is reconciled with its Beloved Lord, it is blended with Him.

Gurbani: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਚ ਕੀ ਬਾਤਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਬਿੰਬ ਕਾ ਕੋਟੁ ਉਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: saahib rang raataa sach kee baataa jin binb kaa kott usaariaa |
English: True is the speech of one who is imbued with the Love of his Lord and Master, who fashioned the body fortress from a mere bubble.

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਭੂ ਨਾਇਕੋ ਆਪਿ ਸਿਰੰਦਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚ ਕਾ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: panch bhoo naaeiko aap sirandaa jin sach kaa pindd savaariaa |
English: He is the Master of the five elements; He Himself is the Creator Lord. He embellished the body with Truth.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਅਵਗਣਿਆਰੇ ਤੂ ਸੁਣਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: ham avaganiaare too sun piaare tudh bhaavai sach soee |
English: I am worthless; please hear me, O my Beloved! Whatever pleases You is True.

Gurbani: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਸਾਚੀ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aavan jaanaa naa theeai saachee mat hoee |3|
English: One who is blessed with true understanding, does not come and go. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅੰਜਨੁ ਤੈਸਾ ਅੰਜੀਐ ਜੈਸਾ ਪਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: anjan taisaa anjeeai jaisaa pir bhaavai |
English: Apply such an ointment to your eyes, which is pleasing to your Beloved.

Gurbani: ਸਮਝੈ ਸੂਝੈ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜੇ ਆਪਿ ਜਾਣਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: samajhai soojhai jaaneeai je aap jaanaavai |
English: I realize, understand and know Him, only if He Himself causes me to know Him.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਜਾਣਾਵੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਮਨੂਆ ਲੇਵਏ ॥
Transliteration: aap jaanaavai maarag paavai aape manooaa leve |
English: He Himself shows me the Way, and He Himself leads me to it, attracting my mind.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮ ਸੁਕਰਮ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਉਣ ਅਭੇਵਏ ॥
Transliteration: karam sukaram karaae aape keemat kaun abheve |
English: He Himself causes us to do good and bad deeds; who can know the value of the Mysterious Lord?

Gurbani: ਤੰਤੁ ਮੰਤੁ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: tant mant paakhandd na jaanaa raam ridai man maaniaa |
English: I know nothing of Tantric spells, magical mantras and hypocritical rituals; enshrining the Lord within my heart, my mind is satisfied.

Gurbani: ਅੰਜਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਤੇ ਸੂਝੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: anjan naam tisai te soojhai gurasabadee sach jaaniaa |4|
English: The ointment of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is only understood by one who realizes the Lord, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਾਜਨ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਆਪਣੇ ਕਿਉ ਪਰ ਘਰ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: saajan hovan aapane kiau par ghar jaahee |
English: I have my own friends; why should I go to the home of a stranger?

Gurbani: ਸਾਜਨ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਚ ਕੇ ਸੰਗੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: saajan raate sach ke sange man maahee |
English: My friends are imbued with the True Lord; He is with them, in their minds.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਕਰਹਿ ਰਲੀਆ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: man maeh saajan kareh raleea karam dharam sabaaeaa |
English: In their minds, these friends celebrate in happiness; all good karma, righteousness and Dharma,

Gurbani: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਪੁੰਨ ਪੂਜਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: atthasatth teerath pun poojaa naam saachaa bhaaeaa |
English: The sixty-eight holy places of pilgrimage, charity and worship, are found in the love of the True Name.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਸਾਜੇ ਥਾਪਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aap saaje thaap vekhai tisai bhaanaa bhaaeaa |
English: He Himself creates, establishes and beholds all, by the Pleasure of His Will.

Gurbani: ਸਾਜਨ ਰਾਂਗਿ ਰੰਗੀਲੜੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: saajan raang rangeelarre rang laal banaaeaa |5|
English: My friends are happy in the Love of the Lord; they nurture love for their Beloved. ||5||

Gurbani: ਅੰਧਾ ਆਗੂ ਜੇ ਥੀਐ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਧਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: andhaa aagoo je theeai kiau paadhar jaanai |
English: If a blind man is made the leader, how will he know the way?

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਮੁਸੈ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਛੀਐ ਕਿਉ ਰਾਹੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: aap musai mat hochheeai kiau raahu pachhaanai |
English: He is impaired, and his understanding is inadequate; how will he know the way?

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਰਾਹਿ ਜਾਵੈ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਅੰਧ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਅੰਧਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: kiau raeh jaavai mehal paavai andh kee mat andhalee |
English: How can he follow the path and reach the Mansion of the Lord's Presence? Blind is the understanding of the blind.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਅੰਧੁ ਬੂਡੌ ਧੰਧਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: vin naam har ke kachh na soojhai andh booddau dhandhalee |
English: Without the Lord's Name, they cannot see anything; the blind are drowned in worldly entanglements.

Gurbani: ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਚਾਉ ਉਪਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: din raat chaanan chaau upajai sabad gur kaa man vasai |
English: Day and night, the Divine Light shines forth and joy wells up, when the Word of the Guru's Shabad abides in the mind.

Gurbani: ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਰਾਹੁ ਪਾਧਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਸੈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: kar jorr gur peh kar binantee raahu paadhar gur dasai |6|
English: With your palms pressed together, pray to the Guru to show you the way. ||6||

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਪਰਦੇਸੀ ਜੇ ਥੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਦੇਸੁ ਪਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: man paradesee je theeai sabh des paraaeaa |
English: If the man becomes a stranger to God, then all the world becomes a stranger to him.

Gurbani: ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਖੋਲੑਉ ਗੰਠੜੀ ਦੂਖੀ ਭਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kis peh kholau ganttharree dookhee bhar aaeaa |
English: Unto whom should I tie up and give the bundle of my pains?

Gurbani: ਦੂਖੀ ਭਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ਕਉਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਬਿਧਿ ਮੇਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: dookhee bhar aaeaa jagat sabaaeaa kaun jaanai bidh mereea |
English: The whole world is overflowing with pain and suffering; who can know the state of my inner self?

Gurbani: ਆਵਣੇ ਜਾਵਣੇ ਖਰੇ ਡਰਾਵਣੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਫੇਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: aavane jaavane khare ddaraavane tott na aavai fereea |
English: Comings and goings are terrible and dreadful; there is no end to the rounds of reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੇ ਊਣੇ ਝੂਣੇ ਨਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: naam vihoone aoone jhoone naa gur sabad sunaaeaa |
English: Without the Naam, he is vacant and sad; he does not listen to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਪਰਦੇਸੀ ਜੇ ਥੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਦੇਸੁ ਪਰਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: man paradesee je theeai sabh des paraaeaa |7|
English: If the mind becomes a stranger to God, then all the world becomes a stranger to him. ||7||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਮਹਲੀ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਸੋ ਭਰਪੁਰਿ ਲੀਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur mahalee ghar aapanai so bharapur leenaa |
English: One who finds the Guru's Mansion within the home of his own being, merges in the All-pervading Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਤਾਂ ਕਰੇ ਸਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਤੀਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: sevak sevaa taan kare sach sabad pateenaa |
English: The sevadar performs selfless service when he is pleased, and confirmed in the True Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੇ ਪਤੀਜੈ ਅੰਕੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਸੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ਅੰਤਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sabade pateejai ank bheejai su mehal mahalaa antare |
English: Confirmed in the Shabad, with her being softened by devotion, the bride dwells in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, deep within her being.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aap karataa kare soee prabh aap ant nirantare |
English: The Creator Himself creates; God Himself, in the end, is endless.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਮੇਲਾ ਤਾਂ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਬਾਜੰਤ ਅਨਹਦ ਬੀਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur sabad melaa taan suhelaa baajant anahad beenaa |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the mortal is united, and then embellished; the unstruck melody of the sound current resounds.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਮਹਲੀ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਸੋ ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਲੀਣਾ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: gur mahalee ghar aapanai so bharipur leenaa |8|
English: One who finds the Guru's Mansion within the home of his own being, merges in the All-pervading Lord. ||8||

Gurbani: ਕੀਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: keetaa kiaa saalaaheeai kar vekhai soee |
English: Why praise that which is created? Praise instead the One who created it and watches over it.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: taa kee keemat naa pavai je lochai koee |
English: His value cannot be estimated, no matter how much one may wish.

Gurbani: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਵੈ ਆਪਿ ਜਾਣਾਵੈ ਆਪਿ ਅਭੁਲੁ ਨ ਭੁਲਏ ॥
Transliteration: keemat so paavai aap jaanaavai aap abhul na bhule |
English: He alone can estimate the Lord's value, whom the Lord Himself causes to know. He is not mistaken; He does not make mistakes.

Gurbani: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਮੁਲਏ ॥
Transliteration: jai jai kaar kareh tudh bhaaveh gur kai sabad amule |
English: He alone celebrates victory, who is pleasing to You, through the Invaluable Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਹੀਣਉ ਨੀਚੁ ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਉ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: heenau neech krau benantee saach na chhoddau bhaaee |
English: I am lowly and abject - I offer my prayer; may I never forsake the True Name, O Sibling of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਦੇਵੈ ਮਤਿ ਸਾਈ ॥੯॥੨॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak jin kar dekhiaa devai mat saaee |9|2|5|
English: O Nanak, the One who created the creation, watches over it; He alone bestows understanding. ||9||2||5||

[Ang 767 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: raag soohee chhant mahalaa 3 ghar 2 |
English: Raag Soohee, Chhant, Third Mehl, Second House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਸੋਹਿਲੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: sukh sohilarraa har dhiaavahu |
English: Meditate on the Lord, and find peace and pleasure.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh har fal paavahu |
English: As Gurmukh, obtain the Lord's fruitful rewards.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh fal paavahu har naam dhiaavahu janam janam ke dookh nivaare |
English: As Gurmukh, obtain the fruit of the Lord, and meditate on the Lord's Name; the pains of countless lifetimes shall be erased.

Gurbani: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਅਪਣੇ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਭਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: balihaaree gur apane vittahu jin kaaraj sabh savaare |
English: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, who has arranged and resolved all my affairs.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪਹੁ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: har prabh kripaa kare har jaapahu sukh fal har jan paavahu |
English: The Lord God will bestow His Grace, if you meditate on the Lord; O humble servant of the Lord, you shall obtain the fruit of peace.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਖ ਸੋਹਿਲੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak kahai sunahu jan bhaaee sukh sohilarraa har dhiaavahu |1|
English: Says Nanak, listen O humble Sibling of Destiny: meditate on the Lord, and find peace and pleasure. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਭੀਨੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sun har gun bheene sehaj subhaae |
English: Hearing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, I am intuitively drenched with His Love.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: guramat sahaje naam dhiaae |
English: Under Guru's Instruction, I meditate intuitively on the Naam.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: jin kau dhur likhiaa tin gur miliaa tin janam maran bhau bhaagaa |
English: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny, meet the Guru, and their fears of birth and death leave them.

Gurbani: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੂਜੀ ਖੋਈ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: andarahu duramat doojee khoee so jan har liv laagaa |
English: One who eliminates evil-mindedness and duality from within himself, that humble being lovingly focuses his mind on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕੀਨੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਨ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jin kau kripaa keenee merai suaamee tin anadin har gun gaae |
English: Those, upon whom my Lord and Master bestows His Grace, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, night and day.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਭੀਨੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sun man bheene sehaj subhaae |2|
English: Hearing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, I am intuitively drenched with His Love. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jug meh raam naam nisataaraa |
English: In this age, emancipation comes only from the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur te upajai sabad veechaaraa |
English: Contemplative meditation on the Word of the Shabad emanates from the Guru.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gurasabad veechaaraa raam naam piaaraa jis kirapaa kare su paae |
English: Contemplating the Guru's Shabad, one comes to love the Lord's Name; he alone obtains it, unto whom the Lord shows Mercy.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਸਭਿ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sahaje gun gaavai din raatee kilavikh sabh gavaae |
English: In peace and poise, he sings the Lord's Praises day and night, and all sins are eradicated.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਹਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabh ko teraa too sabhanaa kaa hau teraa too hamaaraa |
English: All are Yours, and You belong to all. I am Yours, and You are mine.

Gurbani: ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jug meh raam naam nisataaraa |3|
English: In this age, emancipation comes only from the Lord's Name. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਾਜਨ ਆਇ ਵੁਠੇ ਘਰ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: saajan aae vutthe ghar maahee |
English: The Lord, my Friend has come to dwell within the home of my heart;

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: har gun gaaveh tripat aghaahee |
English: singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, one is satisfied and fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਸਦਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: har gun gaae sadaa tripataasee fir bhookh na laagai aae |
English: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, one is satisfied forever, never to feel hunger again.

Gurbani: ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਪੂਜ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: deh dis pooj hovai har jan kee jo har har naam dhiaae |
English: That humble servant of the Lord, who meditates on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is worshipped in the ten directions.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਜੋੜਿ ਵਿਛੋੜੇ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: naanak har aape jorr vichhorre har bin ko doojaa naahee |
English: O Nanak, He Himself joins and separates; there is no other than the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਾਜਨ ਆਇ ਵੁਠੇ ਘਰ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: saajan aae vutthe ghar maahee |4|1|
English: The Lord, my Friend has come to dwell within the home of my heart. ||4||1||

[Ang 768 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: raag soohee mahalaa 3 ghar 3 |
English: Raag Soohee, Third Mehl, Third House:

Gurbani: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਰਾਖੈ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਰਖਦਾ ਆਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat janaa kee har jeeo raakhai jug jug rakhadaa aaeaa raam |
English: The Dear Lord protects His humble devotees; throughout the ages, He has protected them.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਭਗਤੁ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: so bhagat jo guramukh hovai haumai sabad jalaaeaa raam |
English: Those devotees who become Gurmukh burn away their ego, through the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਇਆ ਜਿਸ ਦੀ ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: haumai sabad jalaaeaa mere har bhaaeaa jis dee saachee baanee |
English: Those who burn away their ego through the Shabad, become pleasing to my Lord; their speech becomes True.

Gurbani: ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: sachee bhagat kareh din raatee guramukh aakh vakhaanee |
English: They perform the Lord's true devotional service, day and night, as the Guru has instructed them.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਚਾਲ ਸਚੀ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bhagataa kee chaal sachee at niramal naam sachaa man bhaaeaa |
English: The devotees' lifestyle is true, and absolutely pure; the True Name is pleasing to their minds.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak bhagat soheh dar saachai jinee sacho sach kamaaeaa |1|
English: O Nanak, the those devotees, who practice Truth, and only Truth, look beauteous in the Court of the True Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਹੈ ਭਗਤ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: har bhagataa kee jaat pat hai bhagat har kai naam samaane raam |
English: The Lord is the social class and honor of His devotees; the Lord's devotees merge in the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਵਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਣ ਅਵਗਣ ਪਛਾਣੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: har bhagat kareh vichahu aap gavaaveh jin gun avagan pachhaane raam |
English: They worship the Lord in devotion, and eradicate self-conceit from within themselves; they understand merits and demerits.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਅਉਗਣ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਭੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਮੀਠੀ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: gun aaugan pachhaanai har naam vakhaanai bhai bhagat meetthee laagee |
English: They understand merits and demerits, and chant the Lord's Name; devotional worship is sweet to them.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: anadin bhagat kareh din raatee ghar hee meh bairaagee |
English: Night and day, they perform devotional worship, day and night, and in the home of the self, they remain detached.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤੀ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: bhagatee raate sadaa man niramal har jeeo vekheh sadaa naale |
English: Imbued with devotion, their minds remain forever immaculate and pure; they see their Dear Lord always with them.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak se bhagat har kai dar saache anadin naam samaale |2|
English: O Nanak, those devotees are True in the Court of the Lord; night and day, they dwell upon the Naam. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh bhagat kareh bin satigur vin satigur bhagat na hoee raam |
English: The self-willed manmukhs practice devotional rituals without the True Guru, but without the True Guru, there is no devotion.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੋਗਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: haumai maaeaa rog viaape mar janameh dukh hoee raam |
English: They are afflicted with the diseases of egotism and Maya, and they suffer the pains of death and rebirth.

Gurbani: ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਰਜ ਵਿਗੋਈ ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: mar janameh dukh hoee doojai bhaae paraj vigoee vin gur tat na jaaniaa |
English: The world suffers the pains of death and rebirth, and through the love of duality, it is ruined; without the Guru, the essence of reality is not known.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਿਹੂਣਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਭਰਮਿਆ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat vihoonaa sabh jag bharamiaa ant geaa pachhutaaniaa |
English: Without devotional worship, everyone in the world is deluded and confused, and in the end, they depart with regrets.

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਕਿਨੈ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: kott madhe kinai pachhaaniaa har naamaa sach soee |
English: Among millions, there is scarcely one who realizes the Name of the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak naam milai vaddiaaee doojai bhaae pat khoee |3|
English: O Nanak, through the Naam, greatness is obtained; in the love of duality, all honor is lost. ||3||

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਾ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਦਾ ਵਖਾਣੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: bhagataa kai ghar kaaraj saachaa har gun sadaa vakhaane raam |
English: In the home of the devotees, is the joy of true marriage; they chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord forever.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਆਪੇ ਦੀਆ ਕਾਲੁ ਕੰਟਕੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat khajaanaa aape deea kaal kanttak maar samaane raam |
English: He Himself blesses them with the treasure of devotion; conquering the thorny pain of death, they merge in the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਾਲੁ ਕੰਟਕੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
