Transliteration: kaal kanttak maar samaane har man bhaane naam nidhaan sach paaeaa |
English: Conquering the thorny pain of death, they merge in the Lord; they are pleasing to the Lord's Mind, and they obtain the true treasure of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਅਖੁਟੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਨਿਖੁਟੈ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa akhutt kade na nikhuttai har deea sehaj subhaaeaa |
English: This treasure is inexhaustible; it will never be exhausted. The Lord automatically blesses them with it.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਊਚੇ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਊਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: har jan aooche sad hee aooche gur kai sabad suhaaeaa |
English: The humble servants of the Lord are exalted and elevated, forever on high; they are adorned with the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak aape bakhas milaae jug jug sobhaa paaeaa |4|1|2|
English: O Nanak, He Himself forgives them, and merges them with Himself; throughout the ages, they are glorified. ||4||1||2||

[Ang 769 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 3 |
English: Soohee, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਜਿਥੈ ਸਚੇ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਵੀਚਾਰੋ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sabad sachai sach sohilaa jithai sache kaa hoe veechaaro raam |
English: Through the True Word of the Shabad, true happiness prevails, there where the True Lord is contemplated.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਾਟੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: haumai sabh kilavikh kaatte saach rakhiaa ur dhaare raam |
English: Egotism and all sins are eradicated, when one keeps the True Lord enshrined in the heart.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰਣੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: sach rakhiaa ur dhaare dutar taare fir bhavajal taran na hoee |
English: One who keeps the True Lord enshrined in the heart, crosses over the terrible and dreadful world-ocean; he shall not have to cross over it again.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਵਿਖਾਲਿਆ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa satigur sachee baanee jin sach vikhaaliaa soee |
English: True is the True Guru, and True is the Word of His Bani; through it, the True Lord is seen.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਸਚੁ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: saache gun gaavai sach samaavai sach vekhai sabh soee |
English: One who sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord merges in Truth; he beholds the True Lord everywhere.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਾਚੀ ਨਾਈ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak saachaa saahib saachee naaee sach nisataaraa hoee |1|
English: O Nanak, True is the Lord and Master, and True is His Name; through Truth, comes emancipation. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: saachai satigur saach bujhaaeaa pat raakhai sach soee raam |
English: The True Guru reveals the True Lord; the True Lord preserves our honor.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭਾਉ ਸਚਾ ਹੈ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa bhojan bhaau sachaa hai sachai naam sukh hoee raam |
English: The true food is love for the True Lord; through the True Name, peace is obtained.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਗਰਭਿ ਨ ਜੂਨੀ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: saachai naam sukh hoee marai na koee garabh na joonee vaasaa |
English: Through the True Name, the mortal finds peace; he shall never die, and never again enter the womb of reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਇ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: jotee jot milaaee sach samaaee sach naae paragaasaa |
English: His light blends with the Light, and he merges into the True Lord; he is illuminated and enlightened with the True Name.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਸੇ ਸਚੇ ਹੋਏ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: jinee sach jaataa se sache hoe anadin sach dhiaaein |
English: Those who know the Truth are True; night and day, they meditate on Truth.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਿਆ ਨਾ ਵੀਛੁੜਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਨਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak sach naam jin hiradai vasiaa naa veechhurr dukh paaein |2|
English: O Nanak, those whose hearts are filled with the True Name, never suffer the pains of separation. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sachee baanee sache gun gaaveh tith ghar sohilaa hoee raam |
English: In that home, and in that heart, where the True Bani of the Lord's True Praises are sung, the songs of joy resound.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਚੇ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: niramal gun saache tan man saachaa vich saachaa purakh prabh soee raam |
English: Through the immaculate virtues of the True Lord, the body and mind are rendered True, and God, the True Primal Being, dwells within.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਚੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਜੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: sabh sach varatai sacho bolai jo sach karai su hoee |
English: Such a person practices only Truth, and speaks only Truth; whatever the True Lord does, that alone comes to pass.

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਸਚੁ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jeh dekhaa teh sach pasariaa avar na doojaa koee |
English: Wherever I look, there I see the True Lord pervading; there is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਸਚੇ ਉਪਜੈ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: sache upajai sach samaavai mar janamai doojaa hoee |
English: From the True Lord, we emanate, and into the True Lord, we shall merge; death and birth come from duality.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak sabh kichh aape karataa aap karaavai soee |3|
English: O Nanak, He Himself does everything; He Himself is the Cause. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਚੇ ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਦਰਵਾਰੇ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਾਣੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sache bhagat soheh daravaare sacho sach vakhaane raam |
English: The true devotees look beautiful in the Darbaar of the Lord's Court. They speak Truth, and only Truth.

Gurbani: ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰੇ ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਾਚੋ ਆਪਿ ਪਛਾਣੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt antare saachee baanee saacho aap pachhaane raam |
English: Deep within the nucleus of their heart, is the True Word of the Lord's Bani. Through the Truth, they understand themselves.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aap pachhaaneh taa sach jaaneh saache sojhee hoee |
English: They understand themselves, and so know the True Lord, through their true intuition.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚੀ ਹੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਸਾਚੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa sabad sachee hai sobhaa saache hee sukh hoee |
English: True is the Shabad, and True is its Glory; peace comes only from Truth.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਭਗਤ ਇਕ ਰੰਗੀ ਦੂਜਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: saach rate bhagat ik rangee doojaa rang na koee |
English: Imbued with Truth, the devotees love the One Lord; they do not love any other.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਚੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੨॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak jis kau masatak likhiaa tis sach paraapat hoee |4|2|3|
English: O Nanak, he alone obtains the True Lord, who has such pre-ordained destiny written upon his forehead. ||4||2||3||

[Ang 769 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 3 |
English: Soohee, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਧਨ ਜੇ ਭਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: jug chaare dhan je bhavai bin satigur sohaag na hoee raam |
English: The soul-bride may wander throughout the four ages, but still, without the True Guru, she will not find her True Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਰਾਜੁ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਰਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: nihachal raaj sadaa har keraa tis bin avar na koee raam |
English: The Kingdom of the Lord is permanent, and forever unchanging; there is no other than Him.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: tis bin avar na koee sadaa sach soee guramukh eko jaaniaa |
English: There is no other than Him - He is True forever; the Gurmukh knows the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਧਨ ਪਿਰ ਮੇਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: dhan pir melaavaa hoaa guramatee man maaniaa |
English: That soul-bride, whose mind accepts the Guru's Teachings, meets her Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur miliaa taa har paaeaa bin har naavai mukat na hoee |
English: Meeting the True Guru, she finds the Lord; without the Lord's Name, there is no liberation.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਕੰਤੈ ਰਾਵੇ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਨਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak kaaman kantai raave man maaniai sukh hoee |1|
English: O Nanak, the soul-bride ravishes and enjoys her Husband Lord; her mind accepts Him, and she finds peace. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਧਨ ਬਾਲੜੀਏ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sev dhan baalarree har var paaveh soee raam |
English: Serve the True Guru, O young and innocent bride; thus you shall obtain the Lord as your Husband.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਮੈਲਾ ਵੇਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa hoveh sohaaganee fir mailaa ves na hoee raam |
English: You shall be the virtuous and happy bride of the True Lord forever; and you shall never again wear soiled clothes.

Gurbani: ਫਿਰਿ ਮੈਲਾ ਵੇਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: fir mailaa ves na hoee guramukh boojhai koee haumai maar pachhaaniaa |
English: Your clothes shall never again be soiled; how rare are those few, who, as Gurmukh, recognize this, and conquer their ego.

Gurbani: ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: karanee kaar kamaavai sabad samaavai antar eko jaaniaa |
English: So make your practice the practice of good deeds; merge into the Word of the Shabad, and deep within, come to know the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਾਚੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh prabh raave din raatee aapanaa saachee sobhaa hoee |
English: The Gurmukh enjoys God, day and night, and so obtains true glory.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak kaaman pir raave aapanaa rav rahiaa prabh soee |2|
English: O Nanak, the soul-bride enjoys and ravishes her Beloved; God is pervading and permeating everywhere. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਧਨ ਬਾਲੜੀਏ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਦੇਇ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: gur kee kaar kare dhan baalarree har var dee milaae raam |
English: Serve the Guru, O young and innocent soul-bride, and he will lead to you meet your Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੀ ਹੈ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: har kai rang ratee hai kaaman mil preetam sukh paae raam |
English: The bride is imbued with the Love of her Lord; meeting with her Beloved, she finds peace.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: mil preetam sukh paae sach samaae sach varatai sabh thaaee |
English: Meeting her Beloved, she finds peace, and merges in the True Lord; the True Lord is pervading everywhere.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa seegaar kare din raatee kaaman sach samaaee |
English: The bride makes Truth her decorations, day and night, and remains absorbed in the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਲਇਆ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: har sukhadaataa sabad pachhaataa kaaman leaa kantth laae |
English: The Lord, the Giver of peace, is realized through His Shabad; He hugs His bride close in His embrace.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਹਲੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak mahalee mehal pachhaanai guramatee har paae |3|
English: O Nanak, the bride obtains the Mansion of His Presence; through the Guru's Teachings, she finds her Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਬਾਲੀ ਧੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: saa dhan baalee dhur melee merai prabh aap milaaee raam |
English: The Primal Lord, my God, has united His young and innocent bride with Himself.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਹੋਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: guramatee ghatt chaanan hoaa prabh rav rahiaa sabh thaaee raam |
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, her heart is illumined and enlightened; God is permeating and pervading everywhere.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: prabh rav rahiaa sabh thaaee man vasaaee poorab likhiaa paaeaa |
English: God is permeating and pervading everywhere; He dwells in her mind, and she realizes her pre-ordained destiny.

Gurbani: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sej sukhaalee mere prabh bhaanee sach seegaar banaaeaa |
English: On his cozy bed, she is pleasing to my God; she fashions her decorations of Truth.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਖੋਈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kaaman niramal haumai mal khoee guramat sach samaaee |
English: The bride is immaculate and pure; she washes away the filth of egotism, and through the Guru's Teachings, she merges in the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਕਰਤੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਵੈ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੩॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak aap milaaee karatai naam navai nidh paaee |4|3|4|
English: O Nanak, the Creator Lord blends her into Himself, and she obtains the nine treasure of the Naam. ||4||3||4||

[Ang 770 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 3 |
English: Soohee, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖੇ ਪਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: har hare har gun gaavahu har guramukhe paae raam |
English: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har; the Gurmukh obtains the Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੋ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਵਹੁ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਵਜਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: anadino sabad ravahu anahad sabad vajaae raam |
English: Night and day, chant the Word of the Shabad; night and day, the Shabad shall vibrate and resound.

Gurbani: ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਵਜਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: anahad sabad vajaae har jeeo ghar aae har gun gaavahu naaree |
English: The unstruck melody of the Shabad vibrates, and the Dear Lord comes into the home of my heart; O ladies, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: anadin bhagat kareh gur aagai saa dhan kant piaaree |
English: That soul-bride, who performs devotional worship service to the Guru night and day, becomes the Beloved bride of her Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa sabad vasiaa ghatt antar se jan sabad suhaae |
English: Those humble beings, whose hearts are filled with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, are adorned with the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਘਰਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak tin ghar sad hee sohilaa har kar kirapaa ghar aae |1|
English: O Nanak, their hearts are forever filled with happiness; the Lord, in His Mercy, enters into their hearts. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: bhagataa man aanand bheaa har naam rahe liv laae raam |
English: The minds of the devotees are filled with bliss; they remain lovingly absorbed in the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖੇ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: guramukhe man niramal hoaa niramal har gun gaae raam |
English: The mind of the Gurmukh is immaculate and pure; she sings the Immaculate Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: niramal gun gaae naam man vasaae har kee amrit baanee |
English: Singing His Immaculate Praises, she enshrines in her mind the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and the Ambrosial Word of His Bani.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਨਿਸਤਰੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: jina man vasiaa seee jan nisatare ghatt ghatt sabad samaanee |
English: Those humble beings, within whose minds it abides, are emancipated; the Shabad permeates each and every heart.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਬਦੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: tere gun gaaveh sehaj samaaveh sabade mel milaae |
English: Singing Your Glorious Praises, they merge naturally into You, O Lord; through the Shabad, they are united in Union with You.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੇਰਾ ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak safal janam tin keraa ji satigur har maarag paae |2|
English: O Nanak, their lives are fruitful; the True Guru places them on the Lord's Path. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਲੁ ਭਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: santasangat siau mel bheaa har har naam samaae raam |
English: Those who join the Society of the Saints are absorbed in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤ ਭਏ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad sad jeevan mukat bhe har kai naam liv laae raam |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they are forever 'jivan mukta' - liberated while yet alive; they are lovingly absorbed in the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਮਨੂਆ ਰਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: har naam chit laae gur mel milaae manooaa rataa har naale |
English: They center their consciousness on the Lord's Name; through the Guru, they are united in His Union. Their minds are imbued with the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: sukhadaataa paaeaa mohu chukaaeaa anadin naam samaale |
English: They find the Lord, the Giver of peace, and they eradicate attachments; night and day, they contemplate the Naam.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੇ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gurasabade raataa sahaje maataa naam man vasaae |
English: They are imbued with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and intoxicated with celestial peace; the Naam abides in their minds.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਘਰਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak tin ghar sad hee sohilaa ji satigur sev samaae |3|
English: O Nanak, the homes of their hearts are filled with happiness, forever and always; they are absorbed in serving the True Guru. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਜਗੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: bin satigur jag bharam bhulaaeaa har kaa mehal na paaeaa raam |
English: Without the True Guru, the world is deluded by doubt; it does not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖੇ ਇਕਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਦੂਖ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: guramukhe ik mel milaaeaa tin ke dookh gavaaeaa raam |
English: As Gurmukh, some are united in the Lord's Union, and their pains are dispelled.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਦੂਖ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ਸਦਾ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: tin ke dookh gavaaeaa jaa har man bhaaeaa sadaa gaaveh rang raate |
English: Their pains are dispelled, when it is pleasing to the Lord's Mind; imbued with His Love, they sing His Praises forever.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਭਗਤ ਸਦਾ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਜਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: har ke bhagat sadaa jan niramal jug jug sad hee jaate |
English: The Lord's devotees are pure and humble forever; throughout the ages, they are forever respected.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਰਿ ਜਾਪਹਿ ਘਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: saachee bhagat kareh dar jaapeh ghar dar sachaa soee |
English: They perform true devotional worship service, and are honored in the Lord's Court; the True Lord is their hearth and home.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਸਚੀ ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੪॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak sachaa sohilaa sachee sach baanee sabade hee sukh hoee |4|4|5|
English: O Nanak, true are their songs of joy, and true is their word; through the Word of the Shabad, they find peace. ||4||4||5||

[Ang 771 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਵਰੁ ਬਾਲੜੀਏ ਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: je lorreh var baalarree taa gur charanee chit laae raam |
English: If you long for your Husband Lord, O young and innocent bride, then focus your consciousness on the Guru's feet.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa hoveh sohaaganee har jeeo marai na jaae raam |
English: You shall be a happy soul bride of your Dear Lord forever; He does not die or leave.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: har jeeo marai na jaae gur kai sehaj subhaae saa dhan kant piaaree |
English: The Dear Lord does not die, and He does not leave; through the peaceful poise of the Guru, the soul bride becomes the lover of her Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਚਿ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: sach sanjam sadaa hai niramal gur kai sabad seegaaree |
English: Through truth and self-control, she is forever immaculate and pure; she is embellished with the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: meraa prabh saachaa sad hee saachaa jin aape aap upaaeaa |
English: My God is True, forever and ever; He Himself created Himself.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak sadaa pir raave aapanaa jin gur charanee chit laaeaa |1|
English: O Nanak, she who focuses her consciousness on the Guru's feet, enjoys her Husband Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਅੜਾ ਬਾਲੜੀਏ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: pir paaeiarraa baalarree anadin sahaje maatee raam |
English: When the young, innocent bride finds her Husband Lord, she is automatically intoxicated with Him, night and day.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: guramatee man anad bheaa tith tan mail na raatee raam |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, her mind becomes blissful, and her body is not tinged with filth at all.

Gurbani: ਤਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: tit tan mail na raatee har prabh raatee meraa prabh mel milaae |
English: Her body is not tinged with filth at all, and she is imbued with her Lord God; my God unites her in Union.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: anadin raave har prabh apanaa vichahu aap gavaae |
English: Night and day, she enjoys her Lord God; her egotism is banished from within.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਅਪਣੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: guramat paaeaa sehaj milaaeaa apane preetam raatee |
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, she easily finds and meets Him. She is imbued with her Beloved.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naam milai vaddiaaee prabh raave rang raatee |2|
English: O Nanak, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, she obtains glorious greatness. She ravishes and enjoys her God; she is imbued with His Love. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੜੀਏ ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: pir raave rang raatarree pir kaa mehal tin paaeaa raam |
English: Ravishing her Husband Lord, she is imbued with His Love; she obtains the Mansion of His Presence.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਹੋ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: so saho at niramal daataa jin vichahu aap gavaaeaa raam |
English: She is utterly immaculate and pure; the Great Giver banishes self-conceit from within her.

Gurbani: ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: vichahu mohu chukaaeaa jaa har bhaaeaa har kaaman man bhaanee |
English: The Lord drives out attachment from within her, when it pleases Him. The soul bride becomes pleasing to the Lord's Mind.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਚੇ ਕਥੇ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: anadin gun gaavai nit saache kathe akath kahaanee |
English: Night and day, she continually sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord; she speaks the Unspoken Speech.

Gurbani: ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਏਕੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jug chaare saachaa eko varatai bin gur kinai na paaeaa |
English: Throughout the four ages, the One True Lord is permeating and pervading; without the Guru, no one finds Him.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਵੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak rang ravai rang raatee jin har setee chit laaeaa |3|
English: O Nanak, she revels in joy, imbued with His Love; she focuses her consciousness on the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਹਿਲੜਾ ਸਾਜਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: kaaman man sohilarraa saajan mile piaare raam |
English: The mind of the soul bride is very happy, when she meets her Friend, her Beloved Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: guramatee man niramal hoaa har raakhiaa ur dhaare raam |
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, her mind becomes immaculate; she enshrines the Lord within her heart.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ਅਪਨਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: har raakhiaa ur dhaare apanaa kaaraj savaare guramatee har jaataa |
English: Keeping the Lord enshrined within her heart, her affairs are arranged and resolved; through the Guru's Teachings, she knows her Lord.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਲਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: preetam mohi leaa man meraa paaeaa karam bidhaataa |
English: My Beloved has enticed my mind; I have obtained the Lord, the Architect of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮੰਨਿ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sev sadaa sukh paaeaa har vasiaa man muraare |
English: Serving the True Guru, she finds lasting peace; the Lord, the Destroyer of pride, dwells in her mind.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਈ ਗੁਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੫॥੬॥
Transliteration: naanak mel lee gur apunai gur kai sabad savaare |4|5|6|
English: O Nanak, she merges with her Guru, embellished and adorned with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||4||5||6||

[Ang 772 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੋਹਿਲੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sohilarraa har raam naam gurasabadee veechaare raam |
English: The song of joy is the Naam, the Name of the Lord; contemplate it, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭੀਜੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: har man tano guramukh bheejai raam naam piaare raam |
English: The mind and body of the Gurmukh is drenched with the Lord, the Beloved Lord.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam piaare sabh kul udhaare raam naam mukh baanee |
English: Through the Name of the Beloved Lord, all one's ancestors and generations are redeemed; chant the Lord's Name with your mouth.

Gurbani: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣ ਰਹੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਘਰਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: aavan jaan rahe sukh paaeaa ghar anahad surat samaanee |
English: Comings and goings cease, peace is obtained, and in the home of the heart, one's awareness is absorbed in the unstruck melody of the sound current.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har har eko paaeaa har prabh naanak kirapaa dhaare |
English: I have found the One and only Lord, Har, Har. The Lord God has showered His Mercy upon Nanak.

Gurbani: ਸੋਹਿਲੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sohilarraa har raam naam gurasabadee veechaare |1|
English: The song of joy is the Naam, the Name of the Lord; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, contemplate it. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਨੀਵੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਤਿ ਊਚਾ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: ham neevee prabh at aoochaa kiau kar miliaa jaae raam |
English: I am lowly, and God is lofty and exalted. How will I ever meet Him?

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਬਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: gur melee bahu kirapaa dhaaree har kai sabad subhaae raam |
English: The Guru has very mercifully blessed me and united me with the Lord; through the Shabad, the Word of the Lord, I am lovingly embellished.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: mil sabad subhaae aap gavaae rang siau raleea maane |
English: Merging in the Word of the Shabad, I am lovingly embellished; my ego is eradicated, and I revel in joyous love.

Gurbani: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: sej sukhaalee jaa prabh bhaaeaa har har naam samaane |
English: My bed is so comfortable, since I became pleasing to God; I am absorbed in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜੇ ਚਲੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: naanak sohaagan saa vaddabhaagee je chalai satigur bhaae |
English: O Nanak, that soul bride is so very blessed, who walks in harmony with the True Guru's Will.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਨੀਵੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਤਿ ਊਚਾ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ham neevee prabh at aoochaa kiau kar miliaa jaae raam |2|
English: I am lowly, and God is lofty and exalted. How will I ever meet Him? ||2||

Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਘਟੇ ਸਭਨਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੋ ਰਾਮ ਭਤਾਰੋ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatte sabhanaa vich eko eko raam bhataaro raam |
English: In each and every heart, and deep within all, is the One Lord, the Husband Lord of all.

Gurbani: ਇਕਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਇਕਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਆਧਾਰੋ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: eikanaa prabh door vasai ikanaa man aadhaaro raam |
English: God dwells far away from some, while for others, He is the Support of the mind.

Gurbani: ਇਕਨਾ ਮਨ ਆਧਾਰੋ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: eikanaa man aadhaaro sirajanahaaro vaddabhaagee gur paaeaa |
English: For some, the Creator Lord is the Support of the mind; He is obtained by great good fortune, through the Guru.

Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt har prabh eko suaamee guramukh alakh lakhaaeaa |
English: The One Lord God, the Master, is in each and every heart; the Gurmukh sees the unseen.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਅਨਦੁ ਹੋਆ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: sahaje anad hoaa man maaniaa naanak braham beechaaro |
English: The mind is satisfied, in natural ecstasy, O Nanak, contemplating God.

Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਘਟੇ ਸਭਨਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੋ ਰਾਮ ਭਤਾਰੋ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatte sabhanaa vich eko eko raam bhataaro raam |3|
English: In each and every heart, and deep within all, is the One Lord, the Husband Lord of all. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: gur sevan satigur daataa har har naam samaaeaa raam |
English: Those who serve the Guru, the True Guru, the Giver, merge in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਧੂੜਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਮੈ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: har dhoorr devahu mai poore gur kee ham paapee mukat karaaeaa raam |
English: O Lord, please bless me with the dust of the feet of the Perfect Guru, so that I, a sinner, may be liberated.

Gurbani: ਪਾਪੀ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: paapee mukat karaae aap gavaae nij ghar paaeaa vaasaa |
English: Even sinners are liberated, by eradicating their egotism; they obtain a home within their own heart.

Gurbani: ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੁਧੀ ਸੁਖਿ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: bibek budhee sukh rain vihaanee guramat naam pragaasaa |
English: With clear unerstanding, the night of their lives passes peacefully; through the Guru's Teachings, the Naam is revealed to them.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: har har anad bheaa din raatee naanak har meetth lagaae |
English: Through the Lord, Har, Har, I am in ecstasy, day and night. O Nanak, the Lord seems sweet.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੪॥੬॥੭॥੫॥੭॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: gur sevan satigur daataa har har naam samaae |4|6|7|5|7|12|
English: Those who serve the Guru, the True Guru, the Giver, merge in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||6||7||5||7||12||

[Ang 773 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raag soohee mahalaa 4 chhant ghar 1 |
English: Raag Soohee, Fourth Mehl, Chhant, First House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਅਵਗਣ ਵਿਕਣਾ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਾ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur purakh milaae avagan vikanaa gun ravaa bal raam jeeo |
English: If only I could meet the True Guru, the Primal Being. Discarding my faults and sins, I would chant the Lord's Glorious Praises.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਚਵਾ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam dhiaae gurabaanee nit nit chavaa bal raam jeeo |
English: I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. Continuously, continually, I chant the Word of the Guru's Bani.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਸਦ ਮੀਠੀ ਲਾਗੀ ਪਾਪ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gurabaanee sad meetthee laagee paap vikaar gavaaeaa |
English: Gurbani always seems so sweet; I have eradicated the sins from within.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: haumai rog geaa bhau bhaagaa sahaje sehaj milaaeaa |
English: The disease of egotism is gone, fear has left, and I am absorbed in celestial peace.

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਸੇਜ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਗਿਆਨ ਤਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਭੋਗੋ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa sej gur sabad sukhaalee giaan tat kar bhogo |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the bed of my body has become cozy and beautiful, and I enjoy the essence of spiritual wisdom.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੁਖਿ ਮਾਣੇ ਨਿਤ ਰਲੀਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਧੁਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੋ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: anadin sukh maane nit raleea naanak dhur sanjogo |1|
English: Night and day, I continually enjoy peace and pleasure. O Nanak, this is my pre-ordained destiny. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਉ ਕੁੜਮੁ ਕੁੜਮਾਈ ਆਇਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: sat santokh kar bhaau kurram kurramaaee aaeaa bal raam jeeo |
English: The soul-bride is lovingly embellished with truth and contentment; her Father, the Guru, has come to engage her in marriage to her Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਮੇਲੁ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਗਾਵਾਈਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: sant janaa kar mel gurabaanee gaavaaeea bal raam jeeo |
English: Joining with the humble Saints, I sing Gurbani.

Gurbani: ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਗਾਈ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਪੰਚ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੋਹਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: baanee gur gaaee param gat paaee panch mile sohaaeaa |
English: Singing the Guru's Bani, I have obtained the supreme status; meeting with the Saints, the self-elect, I am blessed and adorned.

Gurbani: ਗਇਆ ਕਰੋਧੁ ਮਮਤਾ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਠੀ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: geaa karodh mamataa tan naatthee paakhandd bharam gavaaeaa |
English: Anger and attachment have left my body and run away; I have eradicated hypocrisy and doubt.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਪੀਰ ਗਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਰੋਗਤ ਭਏ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: haumai peer gee sukh paaeaa aarogat bhe sareeraa |
English: The pain of egotism is gone, and I have found peace; my body has become healthy and free of disease.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee braham pachhaataa naanak gunee gaheeraa |2|
English: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, I have realized God, the ocean of virtue. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਛੁੜੀ ਦੂਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਬਲਿ ਗਈ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh vichhurree door mehal na paae bal gee bal raam jeeo |
English: The self-willed manmukh is separated, far away from God; she does not obtain the Mansion of His Presence, and she burns.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਮਤਾ ਕੂਰਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਵਿਹਾਝੇ ਕੂੜਿ ਲਈ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: antar mamataa koor koorr vihaajhe koorr lee bal raam jeeo |
English: Egotism and falsehood are deep within her; deluded by falsehood, she deals only in falsehood.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: koorr kapatt kamaavai mahaa dukh paavai vin satigur mag na paaeaa |
English: Practicing fraud and falsehood, she suffers terrible pain; without the True Guru, she does not find the way.

Gurbani: ਉਝੜ ਪੰਥਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੈ ਗਾਵਾਰੀ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਧਕੇ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aujharr panth bhramai gaavaaree khin khin dhake khaaeaa |
English: The foolish soul-bride wanders along dismal pathways; each and every moment, she is bumped and pushed.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aape deaa kare prabh daataa satigur purakh milaae |
English: God, the Great Giver, shows His Mercy, and leads her to meet the True Guru, the Primal Being.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਜਨ ਮੇਲੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: janam janam ke vichhurre jan mele naanak sehaj subhaae |3|
English: Those beings who have been separated for countless incarnations, O Nanak, are reunited with the Lord, with intuitive ease. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਇਆ ਲਗਨੁ ਗਣਾਇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਧਨ ਓਮਾਹੀਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: aaeaa lagan ganaae hiradai dhan omaaheea bal raam jeeo |
English: Calculating the most auspicious moment, the Lord comes into the bride's home; her heart is filled with ecstasy.

Gurbani: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪਾਧੇ ਆਣਿ ਪਤੀ ਬਹਿ ਵਾਚਾਈਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: panddit paadhe aan patee beh vaachaaeea bal raam jeeo |
English: The Pandits and astrologers have come, to sit and consult the almanacs.

Gurbani: ਪਤੀ ਵਾਚਾਈ ਮਨਿ ਵਜੀ ਵਧਾਈ ਜਬ ਸਾਜਨ ਸੁਣੇ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: patee vaachaaee man vajee vadhaaee jab saajan sune ghar aae |
English: They have consulted the almanacs, and the bride's mind vibrates with bliss, when she hears that her Friend is coming into the home of her heart.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣੀ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਬਹਿ ਮਤਾ ਪਕਾਇਆ ਫੇਰੇ ਤਤੁ ਦਿਵਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gunee giaanee beh mataa pakaaeaa fere tat divaae |
English: The virtuous and wise men sat down and decided to perform the marriage immediately.

Gurbani: ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਦ ਨਵਤਨੁ ਬਾਲ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: var paaeaa purakh agam agochar sad navatan baal sakhaaee |
English: She has found her Husband, the Inaccessible, Unfathomable Primal Lord, who is forever young; He is her Best Friend from her earliest childhood.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak kirapaa kar kai mele vichhurr kade na jaaee |4|1|
English: O Nanak, he has mercifully united the bride with Himself. She shall never be separated again. ||4||1||

[Ang 773 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 4 |
English: Soohee, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪਹਿਲੜੀ ਲਾਵ ਪਰਵਿਰਤੀ ਕਰਮ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har pahilarree laav paraviratee karam drirraaeaa bal raam jeeo |
English: In the first round of the marriage ceremony, the Lord sets out His Instructions for performing the daily duties of married life.

Gurbani: ਬਾਣੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਵੇਦੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਹੁ ਪਾਪ ਤਜਾਇਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: baanee brahamaa ved dharam drirrahu paap tajaaeaa bal raam jeeo |
English: Instead of the hymns of the Vedas to Brahma, embrace the righteous conduct of Dharma, and renounce sinful actions.

Gurbani: ਧਰਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: dharam drirrahu har naam dhiaavahu simrit naam drirraaeaa |
English: Meditate on the Lord's Name; embrace and enshrine the contemplative remembrance of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਆਰਾਧਹੁ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: satigur gur pooraa aaraadhahu sabh kilavikh paap gavaaeaa |
English: Worship and adore the Guru, the Perfect True Guru, and all your sins shall be dispelled.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੋਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj anand hoaa vaddabhaagee man har har meetthaa laaeaa |
English: By great good fortune, celestial bliss is attained, and the Lord, Har, Har, seems sweet to the mind.

Gurbani: ਜਨੁ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਲਾਵ ਪਹਿਲੀ ਆਰੰਭੁ ਕਾਜੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jan kahai naanak laav pahilee aaranbh kaaj rachaaeaa |1|
English: Servant Nanak proclaims that, in this, the first round of the marriage ceremony, the marriage ceremony has begun. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦੂਜੜੀ ਲਾਵ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har doojarree laav satigur purakh milaaeaa bal raam jeeo |
English: In the second round of the marriage ceremony, the Lord leads you to meet the True Guru, the Primal Being.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭੈ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: nirbhau bhai man hoe haumai mail gavaaeaa bal raam jeeo |
English: With the Fear of God, the Fearless Lord in the mind, the filth of egotism is eradicated.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਭਉ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਹਦੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: niramal bhau paaeaa har gun gaaeaa har vekhai raam hadoore |
English: In the Fear of God, the Immaculate Lord, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and behold the Lord's Presence before you.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਸਾਰਿਆ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਰਬ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har aatam raam pasaariaa suaamee sarab rahiaa bharapoore |
English: The Lord, the Supreme Soul, is the Lord and Master of the Universe; He is pervading and permeating everywhere, fully filling all spaces.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮੰਗਲ ਗਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: antar baahar har prabh eko mil har jan mangal gaae |
English: Deep within, and outside as well, there is only the One Lord God. Meeting together, the humble servants of the Lord sing the songs of joy.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੂਜੀ ਲਾਵ ਚਲਾਈ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਵਜਾਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jan naanak doojee laav chalaaee anahad sabad vajaae |2|
English: Servant Nanak proclaims that, in this, the second round of the marriage ceremony, the unstruck sound current of the Shabad resounds. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਤੀਜੜੀ ਲਾਵ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਭਇਆ ਬੈਰਾਗੀਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har teejarree laav man chaau bheaa bairaageea bal raam jeeo |
English: In the third round of the marriage ceremony, the mind is filled with Divine Love.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: sant janaa har mel har paaeaa vaddabhaageea bal raam jeeo |
English: Meeting with the humble Saints of the Lord, I have found the Lord, by great good fortune.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੀ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: niramal har paaeaa har gun gaaeaa mukh bolee har baanee |
English: I have found the Immaculate Lord, and I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. I speak the Word of the Lord's Bani.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਕਥੀਐ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: sant janaa vaddabhaagee paaeaa har katheeai akath kahaanee |
English: By great good fortune, I have found the humble Saints, and I speak the Unspoken Speech of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: hiradai har har har dhun upajee har japeeai masatak bhaag jeeo |
English: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, vibrates and resounds within my heart; meditating on the Lord, I have realized the destiny inscribed upon my forehead.

Gurbani: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੇ ਤੀਜੀ ਲਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਮਨਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jan naanak bole teejee laavai har upajai man bairaag jeeo |3|
English: Servant Nanak proclaims that, in this, the third round of the marriage ceremony, the mind is filled with Divine Love for the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਚਉਥੜੀ ਲਾਵ ਮਨਿ ਸਹਜੁ ਭਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har chautharree laav man sehaj bheaa har paaeaa bal raam jeeo |
English: In the fourth round of the marriage ceremony, my mind has become peaceful; I have found the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਇਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh miliaa subhaae har man tan meetthaa laaeaa bal raam jeeo |
English: As Gurmukh, I have met Him, with intuitive ease; the Lord seems so sweet to my mind and body.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਇਆ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har meetthaa laaeaa mere prabh bhaaeaa anadin har liv laaee |
English: The Lord seems so sweet; I am pleasing to my God. Night and day, I lovingly focus my consciousness on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਜੀ ਵਾਧਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: man chindiaa fal paaeaa suaamee har naam vajee vaadhaaee |
English: I have obtained my Lord and Master, the fruit of my mind's desires. The Lord's Name resounds and resonates.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਕਾਜੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ਧਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਿਗਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: har prabh tthaakur kaaj rachaaeaa dhan hiradai naam vigaasee |
English: The Lord God, my Lord and Master, blends with His bride, and her heart blossoms forth in the Naam.

Gurbani: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੇ ਚਉਥੀ ਲਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਵਿਨਾਸੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: jan naanak bole chauthee laavai har paaeaa prabh avinaasee |4|2|
English: Servant Nanak proclaims that, in this, the fourth round of the marriage ceremony, we have found the Eternal Lord God. ||4||2||

[Ang 774 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: raag soohee chhant mahalaa 4 ghar 2 |
English: Raag Soohee, Chhant, Fourth Mehl, Second House:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh har gun gaae |
English: The Gurmukhs sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord;

Gurbani: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: hiradai rasan rasaae |
English: in their hearts, and on their tongues, they enjoy and savor His taste.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਏ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਏ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: har rasan rasaae mere prabh bhaae miliaa sehaj subhaae |
English: They enjoy and savor His taste, and are pleasing to my God, who meets them with natural ease.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭੋਗ ਭੋਗੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੋਵੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: anadin bhog bhoge sukh sovai sabad rahai liv laae |
English: Night and day, they enjoy enjoyments, and they sleep in peace; they remain lovingly absorbed in the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: vaddai bhaag gur pooraa paaeeai anadin naam dhiaae |
English: By great good fortune, one obtains the Perfect Guru; night and day, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sahaje sehaj miliaa jagajeevan naanak sun samaae |1|
English: In absolute ease and poise, one meets the Life of the World. O Nanak, one is absorbed in the state of absolute absorption. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sangat sant milaae |
English: Joining the Society of the Saints,

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਿ ਨਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: har sar niramal naae |
English: I bathe in the Immaculate Pool of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲਿ ਜਲਿ ਨਾਏ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਭਏ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: niramal jal naae mail gavaae bhe pavit sareeraa |
English: Bathing in these Immaculate Waters, my filth is removed, and my body is purified and sanctified.

Gurbani: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਈ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਨਠੀ ਪੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: duramat mail gee bhram bhaagaa haumai binatthee peeraa |
English: The filth of intellectual evil-mindedness is removed, doubt is gone, and the pain of egotism is dispelled.

Gurbani: ਨਦਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਹੋਆ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: nadar prabhoo satasangat paaee nij ghar hoaa vaasaa |
English: By God's Grace, I found the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. I dwell in the home of my own inner being.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਗਲ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har mangal ras rasan rasaae naanak naam pragaasaa |2|
English: My tongue tastes the taste of the Lord's joyous song; O Nanak, the Naam shines forth brightly. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: antar ratan beechaare |
English: The Gurmukh loves the Name of the Lord;

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh naam piaare |
English: Deep within, she contemplates the jewel of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅਧੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: har naam piaare sabad nisataare agiaan adher gavaaeaa |
English: Those who love the Lord's Name are emancipated through the Word of the Shabad. The darkness of ignorance is dispelled.

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡੁ ਬਲਿਆ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਸੋਹਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: giaan prachandd baliaa ghatt chaanan ghar mandar sohaaeaa |
English: Spiritual wisdom burns brilliantly, illuminating the heart; their homes and temples are embellished and blessed.

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਬਣਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tan man arap seegaar banaae har prabh saache bhaaeaa |
English: I have made my body and mind into adornments, and dedicated them to the True Lord God, pleasing Him.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਪਰੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jo prabh kahai soee par keejai naanak ank samaaeaa |3|
English: Whatever God says, I gladly do. O Nanak, I have merged into the fiber of His Being. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਾਜੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: har prabh kaaj rachaaeaa |
English: The Lord God has arranged the marriage ceremony;

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੀਆਹਣਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh veeaahan aaeaa |
English: He has come to marry the Gurmukh.

Gurbani: ਵੀਆਹਣਿ ਆਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: veeaahan aaeaa guramukh har paaeaa saa dhan kant piaaree |
English: He has come to marry the Gurmukh, who has found the Lord. That bride is very dear to her Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਮੰਗਲ ਗਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: sant janaa mil mangal gaae har jeeo aap savaaree |
English: The humble Saints join together and sing the songs of joy; the Dear Lord Himself has adorned the soul-bride.

Gurbani: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਮਿਲਿ ਆਏ ਅਪੂਰਬ ਜੰਞ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sur nar gan gandharab mil aae apoorab jany banaaee |
English: The angels and mortal beings, the heavenly heralds and celestial singers, have come together and formed a wondrous wedding party.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾ ਕਦੇ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak prabh paaeaa mai saachaa naa kade marai na jaaee |4|1|3|
English: O Nanak, I have found my True Lord God, who never dies, and is not born. ||4||1||3||

[Ang 775 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: raag soohee chhant mahalaa 4 ghar 3 |
English: Raag Soohee, Chhant, Fourth Mehl, Third House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਆਵਹੋ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: aavaho sant janahu gun gaavah govind kere raam |
English: Come, humble Saints, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਜਹਿ ਸਬਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh mil raheeai ghar vaajeh sabad ghanere raam |
English: Let us gather together as Gurmukh; within the home of our own heart, the Shabad vibrates and resonates.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sabad ghanere har prabh tere too karataa sabh thaaee |
English: The many melodies of the Shabad are Yours, O Lord God; O Creator Lord, You are everywhere.

Gurbani: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਜਪੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ahinis japee sadaa saalaahee saach sabad liv laaee |
English: Day and night, I chant His Praises forever, lovingly focusing on the True Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: anadin sehaj rahai rang raataa raam naam rid poojaa |
English: Night and day, I remain intuitively attuned to the Lord's Love; in my heart, I worship the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh ek pachhaanai avar na jaanai doojaa |1|
English: O Nanak, as Gurmukh, I have realized the One Lord; I do not know any other. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sabh meh rav rahiaa so prabh antarajaamee raam |
English: He is contained amongst all; He is God, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਵੈ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: gur sabad ravai rav rahiaa so prabh meraa suaamee raam |
English: One who meditates and dwells upon God, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, knows that God, my Lord and Master, is pervading everywhere.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: prabh meraa suaamee antarajaamee ghatt ghatt raviaa soee |
English: God, my Lord and Master, is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts; He pervades and permeates each and every heart.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramat sach paaeeai sehaj samaaeeai tis bin avar na koee |
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, Truth is obtained, and then, one merges in celestial bliss. There is no other than Him.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਜੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਾ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sahaje gun gaavaa je prabh bhaavaa aape le milaae |
English: I sing His Praises with intuitive ease. If it pleases God, He shall unite me with Himself.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਜਾਪੈ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak so prabh sabade jaapai ahinis naam dhiaae |2|
English: O Nanak, through the Shabad, God is known; meditate on the Naam, day and night. ||2||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੋ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: eihu jago dutar manamukh paar na paaee raam |
English: This world is treacherous and impassable; the self-willed manmukh cannot cross over.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: antare haumai mamataa kaam krodh chaturaaee raam |
English: Within him is egotism, self-conceit, sexual desire, anger and cleverness.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: antar chaturaaee thaae na paaee birathaa janam gavaaeaa |
English: Within him is cleverness; he is not approved, and his life is uselessly wasted and lost.

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਮਗਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਵੈ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jam mag dukh paavai chottaa khaavai ant geaa pachhutaaeaa |
English: On the Path of Death, he suffers in pain, and must endure abuse; in the end, he departs regretfully.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਬੇਲੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਪੁਤੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਸੁਤੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: bin naavai ko belee naahee put kuttanb sut bhaaee |
English: Without the Name, he has no friends, no children, family or relatives.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਪਸਾਰਾ ਆਗੈ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak maaeaa mohu pasaaraa aagai saath na jaaee |3|
English: O Nanak, the wealth of Maya, attachment and ostentatious shows - none of them shall go along with him to the world hereafter. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਪੂਛਉ ਅਪਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਕਿਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰੀਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: hau poochhau apanaa satigur daataa kin bidh dutar tareeai raam |
English: I ask my True Guru, the Giver, how to cross over the treacherous and difficult world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ਚਲਹੁ ਜੀਵਤਿਆ ਇਵ ਮਰੀਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: satigur bhaae chalahu jeevatiaa iv mareeai raam |
English: Walk in harmony with the True Guru's Will, and remain dead while yet alive.

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਤਿਆ ਮਰੀਐ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jeevatiaa mareeai bhaujal tareeai guramukh naam samaavai |
English: Remaining dead while yet alive, cross over the terrifying world-ocean; as Gurmukh, merge in the Naam.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: pooraa purakh paaeaa vaddabhaagee sach naam liv laavai |
English: One obtains the Perfect Primal Lord, by great good fortune, lovingly focusing on the True Name.

Gurbani: ਮਤਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਭਈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: mat paragaas bhee man maaniaa raam naam vaddiaaee |
English: The intellect is enlightened, and the mind is satisfied, through the glory of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak prabh paaeaa sabad milaaeaa jotee jot milaaee |4|1|4|
English: O Nanak, God is found, merging in the Shabad, and one's light blends into the Light. ||4||1||4||

[Ang 776 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 4 ghar 5 |
English: Soohee, Fourth Mehl, Fifth House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨੋ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਮੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੁਝਿ ਗਈਆਸੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur sant jano piaaraa mai miliaa meree trisanaa bujh geeaase |
English: O humble Saints, I have met my Beloved Guru; the fire of my desire is quenched, and my yearning is gone.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਦੇਵਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੈ ਮੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੇ ॥
Transliteration: hau man tan devaa satigurai mai mele prabh gunataase |
English: I dedicate my mind and body to the True Guru; I pray that may He unite me with God, the treasure of virtue.

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਮੈ ਦਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਬਾਸੇ ॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan guroo vadd purakh hai mai dase har saabaase |
English: Blessed, blessed is the Guru, the Supreme Being, who tells me of the most blessed Lord.

Gurbani: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਿਗਾਸੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: vaddabhaagee har paaeaa jan naanak naam vigaase |1|
English: By great good fortune, servant Nanak has found the Lord; he blossoms forth in the Naam. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਮੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪੰਥੁ ਦਸਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur sajan piaaraa mai miliaa har maarag panth dasaahaa |
English: I have met my Beloved Friend, the Guru, who has shown me the Path to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਘਰਿ ਆਵਹੁ ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ਮਿਲੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: ghar aavahu chiree vichhuniaa mil sabad guroo prabh naahaa |
English: Come home - I have been separated from You for so long! Please, let me merge with You, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, O my Lord God.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਤੁਝੁ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਖਰੀ ਉਡੀਣੀਆ ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੀਨੁ ਮਰਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: hau tujh baajhahu kharee uddeeneea jiau jal bin meen maraahaa |
English: Without You, I am so sad; like a fish out of water, I shall die.

Gurbani: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: vaddabhaagee har dhiaaeaa jan naanak naam samaahaa |2|
English: The very fortunate ones meditate on the Lord; servant Nanak merges into the Naam. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਚਲਿ ਚਲਿ ਭਰਮਿਆ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: man deh dis chal chal bharamiaa manamukh bharam bhulaaeaa |
English: The mind runs around in the ten directions; the self-willed manmukh wanders around, deluded by doubt.

Gurbani: ਨਿਤ ਆਸਾ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਮਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਲਗਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: nit aasaa man chitavai man trisanaa bhukh lagaaeaa |
English: In his mind, he continually conjures up hopes; his mind is gripped by hunger and thirst.

Gurbani: ਅਨਤਾ ਧਨੁ ਧਰਿ ਦਬਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਭਾਲਣ ਗਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: anataa dhan dhar dabiaa fir bikh bhaalan geaa |
English: There is an infinite treasure buried within the mind, but still, he goes out, searching for poison.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਤੂ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪਚਿ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jan naanak naam salaeh too bin naavai pach pach mueaa |3|
English: O servant Nanak, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord; without the Name, he rots away, and wastes away to death. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਮੋਹਨੁ ਪਾਇ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਾਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur sundar mohan paae kare har prem baanee man maariaa |
English: Finding the beautiful and fascinating Guru, I have conquered my mind, through the Bani, the Word of my Beloved Lord.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸੁਧਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਗਈ ਮਨ ਆਸਾ ਚਿੰਤ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: merai hiradai sudh budh visar gee man aasaa chint visaariaa |
English: My heart has forgotten its common sense and wisdom; my mind has forgotten its hopes and cares.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵੇਦਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੀ ਗੁਰ ਦੇਖਤ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: mai antar vedan prem kee gur dekhat man saadhaariaa |
English: Deep within my self, I feel the pains of divine love. Beholding the Guru, my mind is comforted and consoled.

Gurbani: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੁ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੫॥
Transliteration: vaddabhaagee prabh aae mil jan naanak khin khin vaariaa |4|1|5|
English: Awaken my good destiny, O God - please, come and meet me! Each and every instant, servant Nanak is a sacrifice to You. ||4||1||5||

[Ang 776 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: soohee chhant mahalaa 4 |
English: Soohee, Chhant, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਾਰੇਹਿਸੁ ਵੇ ਜਨ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਣ ਨ ਦਿਤੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: maarehis ve jan haumai bikhiaa jin har prabh milan na diteea |
English: Eradicate the poison of egotism, O human being; it is holding you back from meeting your Lord God.

Gurbani: ਦੇਹ ਕੰਚਨ ਵੇ ਵੰਨੀਆ ਇਨਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਵਿਗੁਤੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: deh kanchan ve vaneea in haumai maar viguteea |
English: This golden-colored body has been disfigured and ruined by egotism.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਵੇ ਸਭ ਕਾਲਖਾ ਇਨਿ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮੂੜਿ ਸਜੁਤੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: mohu maaeaa ve sabh kaalakhaa in manamukh moorr sajuteea |
English: Attachment to Maya is total darkness; this foolish, self-willed manmukh is attached to it.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਬਰੇ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਛੁਟੀਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak guramukh ubare gurasabadee haumai chhutteea |1|
English: O servant Nanak, the Gurmukh is saved; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he is released from egotism. ||1||

Gurbani: ਵਸਿ ਆਣਿਹੁ ਵੇ ਜਨ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਮਨੁ ਬਾਸੇ ਜਿਉ ਨਿਤ ਭਉਦਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: vas aanihu ve jan is man kau man baase jiau nit bhaudiaa |
English: Overcome and subdue this mind; your mind wanders around continually, like a falcon.

Gurbani: ਦੁਖਿ ਰੈਣਿ ਵੇ ਵਿਹਾਣੀਆ ਨਿਤ ਆਸਾ ਆਸ ਕਰੇਦਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: dukh rain ve vihaaneea nit aasaa aas karediaa |
English: The mortal's life-night passes painfully, in constant hope and desire.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਵੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨੋ ਮਨਿ ਆਸ ਪੂਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਚਉਦਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur paaeaa ve sant jano man aas pooree har chaudiaa |
English: I have found the Guru, O humble Saints; my mind's hopes are fulfilled, chanting the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਤੀ ਛਡਿ ਆਸਾ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਉਦਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jan naanak prabh dehu matee chhadd aasaa nit sukh saudiaa |2|
English: Please bless servant Nanak, O God, with such understanding, that abandoning false hopes, he may always sleep in peace. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਆਸਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੇਜੜੀਐ ਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: saa dhan aasaa chit kare raam raajiaa har prabh sejarreeai aaee |
English: The bride hopes in her mind, that her Sovereign Lord God will come to her bed.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਅਗਮ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੇਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: meraa tthaakur agam deaal hai raam raajiaa kar kirapaa lehu milaaee |
English: My Lord and Master is infinitely compassionate; O Sovereign Lord, be merciful, and merge me into Yourself.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਲੋਚਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਧਾ ਸੇਜ ਵਿਛਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: merai man tan lochaa guramukhe raam raajiaa har saradhaa sej vichhaaee |
English: My mind and body long to behold the Guru's face. O Sovereign Lord, I have spread out my bed of loving faith.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣੀਆ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜਿਆ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jan naanak har prabh bhaaneea raam raajiaa miliaa sehaj subhaaee |3|
English: O servant Nanak, when the bride pleases her Lord God, her Sovereign Lord meets her with natural ease. ||3||

Gurbani: ਇਕਤੁ ਸੇਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੋ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇਈ ॥
Transliteration: eikat sejai har prabho raam raajiaa gur dase har meleee |
English: My Lord God, my Sovereign Lord, is on the one bed. The Guru has shown me how to meet my Lord.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਹੈ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇਈ ॥
Transliteration: mai man tan prem bairaag hai raam raajiaa gur mele kirapaa kareee |
English: My mind and body are filled with love and affection for my Sovereign Lord. In His Mercy, the Guru has united me with Him.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੁਮਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜਿਆ ਜੀਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਦੇਈ ॥
Transliteration: hau gur vittahu ghol ghumaaeaa raam raajiaa jeeo satigur aagai deee |
English: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, O my Sovereign Lord; I surrender my soul to the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਜੀਉ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜਿਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇਈ ॥੪॥੨॥੬॥੫॥੭॥੬॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: gur tutthaa jeeo raam raajiaa jan naanak har meleee |4|2|6|5|7|6|18|
English: When the Guru is totally pleased, O servant Nanak, he unites the soul with the Lord, the Sovereign Lord. ||4||2||6||5||7||6||18||

[Ang 777 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raag soohee chhant mahalaa 5 ghar 1 |
English: Raag Soohee, Chhant, Fifth Mehl, First House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਬਾਵਰੇ ਤੂ ਕਾਏ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੁਲਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: sun baavare too kaae dekh bhulaanaa |
English: Listen, madman: gazing upon the world, why have you gone crazy?

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਬਾਵਰੇ ਨੇਹੁ ਕੂੜਾ ਲਾਇਓ ਕੁਸੰਭ ਰੰਗਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: sun baavare nehu koorraa laaeo kusanbh rangaanaa |
English: Listen, madman: you have been trapped by false love, which is transitory, like the fading color of the safflower.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜੀ ਡੇਖਿ ਭੁਲੋ ਅਢੁ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਮੁਲੋ ਗੋਵਿਦ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਜੀਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: koorree ddekh bhulo adt lahai na mulo govid naam majeetthaa |
English: Gazing upon the false world, you are fooled. It is not worth even half a shell. Only the Name of the Lord of the Universe is permanent.

Gurbani: ਥੀਵਹਿ ਲਾਲਾ ਅਤਿ ਗੁਲਾਲਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਚੀਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: theeveh laalaa at gulaalaa sabad cheen gur meetthaa |
English: You shall take on the deep and lasting red color of the poppy, contemplating the sweet Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਗਨੁ ਥੀ ਰਹਿਆ ਝੂਠ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਪਟਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: mithiaa mohi magan thee rahiaa jhootth sang lapattaanaa |
English: You remain intoxicated with false emotional attachment; you are attached to falsehood.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਨ ਸਰਣਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਰਾਖੁ ਲਾਜ ਭਗਤਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak deen saran kirapaa nidh raakh laaj bhagataanaa |1|
English: Nanak, meek and humble, seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord, the treasure of mercy. He preserves the honor of His devotees. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਬਾਵਰੇ ਸੇਵਿ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਨਾਥੁ ਪਰਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: sun baavare sev tthaakur naath paraanaa |
English: Listen, madman: serve your Lord, the Master of the breath of life.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਬਾਵਰੇ ਜੋ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: sun baavare jo aaeaa tis jaanaa |
English: Listen, madman: whoever comes, shall go.

Gurbani: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹਭ ਵੈਸੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਪਰਦੇਸੀ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: nihachal habh vaisee sun paradesee santasang mil raheeai |
English: Listen, O wandering stranger: that which you believe to be permanent, shall all pass away; so remain in the Saints' Congregation.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਭਾਗੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਚਰਣ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਗਹਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: har paaeeai bhaagee sun bairaagee charan prabhoo geh raheeai |
English: Listen, renunciate: by your good destiny, obtain the Lord, and remain attached to God's Feet.

Gurbani: ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਸੰਕ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਜਿ ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: ehu man deejai sank na keejai guramukh taj bahu maanaa |
English: Dedicate and surrender this mind to the Lord, and have no doubts; as Gurmukh, renounce your great pride.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਨ ਭਗਤ ਭਵ ਤਾਰਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak deen bhagat bhav taaran tere kiaa gun aakh vakhaanaa |2|
English: O Nanak, the Lord carries the meek and humble devotees across the terrifying world-ocean. What Glorious Virtues of Your should I chant and recite? ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਬਾਵਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਚੈ ਕੂੜਾ ਮਾਨੋ ॥
Transliteration: sun baavare kiaa keechai koorraa maano |
English: Listen, madman: why do you harbor false pride?

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਬਾਵਰੇ ਹਭੁ ਵੈਸੀ ਗਰਬੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੋ ॥
Transliteration: sun baavare habh vaisee garab gumaano |
English: Listen, madman: all your egotism and pride shall be overcome.

Gurbani: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹਭ ਜਾਣਾ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਮਾਣਾ ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹੋਇ ਦਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: nihachal habh jaanaa mithiaa maanaa sant prabhoo hoe daasaa |
English: What you think is permanent, shall all pass away. Pride is false, so become the slave of God's Saints.

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰੀਐ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰੀਐ ਜੇ ਥੀਵੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਲਿਖਿਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeevat mareeai bhaujal tareeai je theevai karam likhiaasaa |
English: Remain dead while still alive, and you shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean, if it is your pre-ordained destiny.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀਜੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਾਵਹਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨੋ ॥
Transliteration: gur seveejai amrit peejai jis laaveh sehaj dhiaano |
English: One whom the Lord causes to meditate intuitively, serves the Guru, and drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੋ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak saran peaa har duaarai hau bal bal sad kurabaano |3|
English: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord's Door; I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, forever a sacrifice to Him. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਬਾਵਰੇ ਮਤੁ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sun baavare mat jaaneh prabh mai paaeaa |
English: Listen, madman: do not think that you have found God.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਬਾਵਰੇ ਥੀਉ ਰੇਣੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sun baavare theeo ren jinee prabh dhiaaeaa |
English: Listen, madman: be the dust under the feet of those who meditate on God.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: jin prabh dhiaaeaa tin sukh paaeaa vaddabhaagee darasan paaeeai |
English: Those who meditate on God find peace. By great good fortune, the Blessed Vision of their Darshan is obtained.

Gurbani: ਥੀਉ ਨਿਮਾਣਾ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣਾ ਸਗਲਾ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਟਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: theeo nimaanaa sad kurabaanaa sagalaa aap mittaaeeai |
English: Be humble, and be forever a sacrifice, and your self-conceit shall be totally eradicated.

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਭਾਗ ਸੁਧਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਧਾ ਹਮ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਆਪੁ ਵੇਚਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: ohu dhan bhaag sudhaa jin prabh ladhaa ham tis peh aap vechaaeaa |
English: One who has found God is pure, with blessed destiny. I would sell myself to him.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਨ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਰਾਖੁ ਲਾਜ ਅਪਨਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak deen saran sukh saagar raakh laaj apanaaeaa |4|1|
English: Nanak, the meek and humble, seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord, the ocean of peace. Make him Your own, and preserve his honor. ||4||1||

[Ang 777 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਤੀ ਤੁਸਿ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har charan kamal kee ttek satigur ditee tus kai bal raam jeeo |
English: The True Guru was satisfied with me, and blessed me with the Support of the Lord's Lotus Feet. I am a sacrifice to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੈ ਘਰਿ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har amrit bhare bhanddaar sabh kichh hai ghar tis kai bal raam jeeo |
English: The Lord's Ambrosial Nectar is an overflowing treasure; everything is in His Home. I am a sacrifice to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਬਾਬੁਲੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਵਡ ਸਮਰਥਾ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: baabul meraa vadd samarathaa karan kaaran prabh haaraa |
English: My Father is absolutely all-powerful. God is the Doer, the Cause of causes.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਕੋਈ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jis simarat dukh koee na laagai bhaujal paar utaaraa |
English: Remembering Him in meditation, pain does not touch me; thus I cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਾ ਰਾਖਾ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੀਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: aad jugaad bhagatan kaa raakhaa usatat kar kar jeevaa |
English: In the beginning, and throughout the ages, He is the Protector of His devotees. Praising Him continually, I live.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪੀਵਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak naam mahaa ras meetthaa anadin man tan peevaa |1|
English: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the sweetest and most sublime essence. Night and day, I drink it in with my mind and body. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਕਿਉ ਵੇਛੋੜਾ ਥੀਵਈ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har aape le milaae kiau vechhorraa theevee bal raam jeeo |
English: The Lord unites me with Himself; how could I feel any separation? I am a sacrifice to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਸੋ ਸਦਾ ਸਦ ਜੀਵਈ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: jis no teree ttek so sadaa sad jeevee bal raam jeeo |
English: One who has Your Support lives forever and ever. I am a sacrifice to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਤੁਝੈ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: teree ttek tujhai te paaee saache sirajanahaaraa |
English: I take my support from You alone, O True Creator Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਖਾਲੀ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ ਐਸਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jis te khaalee koee naahee aisaa prabhoo hamaaraa |
English: No one lacks this Support; such is my God.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਆ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਆਸ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: sant janaa mil mangal gaaeaa din rain aas tumaaree |
English: Meeting with the humble Saints, I sing the songs of joy; day and night, I place my hopes in You.

Gurbani: ਸਫਲੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: safal daras bhettiaa gur pooraa naanak sad balihaaree |2|
English: I have obtained the Blessed Vision, the Darshan of the Perfect Guru. Nanak is forever a sacrifice. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੰਮੑਲਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਮਹਤੁ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: samaliaa sach thaan maan mehat sach paaeaa bal raam jeeo |
English: Contemplating, dwelling upon the Lord's true home, I receive honor, greatness and truth. I am a sacrifice to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਗੁਣ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਗਾਇਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur miliaa deaal gun abinaasee gaaeaa bal raam jeeo |
English: Meeting the Merciful True Guru, I sing the Praises of the Imperishable Lord. I am a sacrifice to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗਾਉ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਆਮੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: gun govind gaau nit nit praan preetam suaameea |
English: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, continually, continuously; He is the Beloved Master of the breath of life.

Gurbani: ਸੁਭ ਦਿਵਸ ਆਏ ਗਹਿ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਏ ਮਿਲੇ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: subh divas aae geh kantth laae mile antarajaameea |
English: Good times have come; the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, has met me, and hugged me close in His Embrace.

Gurbani: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਵਜਹਿ ਵਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦਾ ਝੁਣਕਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sat santokh vajeh vaaje anahadaa jhunakaare |
English: The musical instruments of truth and contentment vibrate, and the unstruck melody of the sound current resounds.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਭੈ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਸਗਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sun bhai binaase sagal naanak prabh purakh karanaihaare |3|
English: Hearing this, all my fears have been dispelled; O Nanak, God is the Primal Being, the Creator Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਉਪਜਿਆ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਪੇਈਐ ਇਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: aupajiaa tat giaan saahurai peeeai ik har bal raam jeeo |
English: The essence of spiritual wisdom has welled up; in this world, and the next, the One Lord is pervading. I am a sacrifice to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਭਿੰਨ ਕਰਿ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: brahamai braham miliaa koe na saakai bhin kar bal raam jeeo |
English: When God meets the God within the self, no one can separate them. I am a sacrifice to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਬਿਸਮੁ ਪੇਖੈ ਬਿਸਮੁ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bisam pekhai bisam suneeai bisamaad nadaree aaeaa |
English: I gaze upon the Wondrous Lord, and listen to the Wondrous Lord; the Wondrous Lord has come into my vision.

Gurbani: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jal thal maheeal pooran suaamee ghatt ghatt rahiaa samaaeaa |
English: The Perfect Lord and Master is pervading the water, the land and the sky, in each and every heart.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jis te upajiaa tis maeh samaaeaa keemat kehan na jaae |
English: I have merged again into the One from whom I originated. The value of this cannot be described.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਚਲਤ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ਲਖਣੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਏ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: jis ke chalat na jaahee lakhane naanak tiseh dhiaae |4|2|
English: Nanak meditates on Him. ||4||2||

[Ang 778 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: raag soohee chhant mahalaa 5 ghar 2 |
English: Raag Soohee, Chhant, Fifth Mehl, Second House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: gobind gun gaavan laage |
English: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: har rang anadin jaage |
English: I am awake, night and day, in the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਜਾਗੇ ਪਾਪ ਭਾਗੇ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: har rang jaage paap bhaage mile sant piaariaa |
English: Awake to the Lord's Love, my sins have left me. I meet with the Beloved Saints.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਲਾਗੇ ਭਰਮ ਭਾਗੇ ਕਾਜ ਸਗਲ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur charan laage bharam bhaage kaaj sagal savaariaa |
English: Attached to the Guru's Feet, my doubts are dispelled, and all my affairs are resolved.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਣ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਜਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਵਡਭਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: sun sravan baanee sehaj jaanee har naam jap vaddabhaagai |
English: Listening to the Word of the Guru's Bani with my ears, I know celestial peace. By great good fortune, I meditate on the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਗੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak saran suaamee jeeo pindd prabh aagai |1|
English: Prays Nanak, I have entered my Lord and Master's Sanctuary. I dedicate my body and soul to God. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਨਹਤ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: anahat sabad suhaavaa |
English: The unstruck melody of the Shabad, the Word of God is so very beautiful.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: sach mangal har jas gaavaa |
English: True joy comes from singing the Lord's Praises.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੂਖ ਨਾਸੇ ਰਹਸੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਮਨਿ ਘਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: gun gaae har har dookh naase rehas upajai man ghanaa |
English: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, pain is dispelled, and my mind is filled with tremendous joy.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤੰਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਭਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: man tan niramal dekh darasan naam prabh kaa mukh bhanaa |
English: My mind and body have become immaculate and pure, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan; I chant the Name of God.

Gurbani: ਹੋਇ ਰੇਣ ਸਾਧੂ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਰਾਧੂ ਆਪਣੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: hoe ren saadhoo prabh araadhoo aapane prabh bhaavaa |
English: I am the dust of the feet of the Holy. Worshipping God in adoration, my God is pleased with me.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak deaa dhaarahu sadaa har gun gaavaa |2|
English: Prays Nanak, please bless me with Your Mercy, that I may sing Your Glorious Praises forever. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur mil saagar tariaa |
English: Meeting with the Guru, I cross over the world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਜਪਤ ਨਿਸਤਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: har charan japat nisatariaa |
English: Meditating on the Lord's Feet, I am emancipated.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਧਿਆਏ ਸਭਿ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਮਿਟੇ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: har charan dhiaae sabh fal paae mitte aavan jaanaa |
English: Meditating on the Lord's Feet, I have obtained the fruits of all rewards, and my comings and goings have ceased.

Gurbani: ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਆਪਣੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: bhaae bhagat subhaae har jap aapane prabh bhaavaa |
English: With loving devotional worship, I meditate intuitively on the Lord, and my God is pleased.

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਏਕੁ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jap ek alakh apaar pooran tis binaa nahee koee |
English: Meditate on the One, Unseen, Infinite, Perfect Lord; there is no other than Him.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਖੋਇਆ ਜਤ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਤ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak gur bharam khoeaa jat dekhaa tat soee |3|
English: Prays Nanak, the Guru has erased my doubts; wherever I look, there I see Him. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: patit paavan har naamaa |
English: The Lord's Name is the Purifier of sinners.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੇ ਕਾਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: pooran sant janaa ke kaamaa |
English: It resolves the affairs of the humble Saints.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੰਤੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਸਗਲ ਇਛਾ ਪੁੰਨੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur sant paaeaa prabh dhiaaeaa sagal ichhaa puneea |
English: I have found the Saintly Guru, meditating on God. All my desires have been fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਤਾਪ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਰਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲੇ ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau taap binase sadaa sarase prabh mile chiree vichhuniaa |
English: The fever of egotism has been dispelled, and I am always happy. I have met God, from whom I was separated for so long.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਸਾਤਿ ਆਈ ਵਜੀ ਵਧਾਈ ਮਨਹੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: man saat aaee vajee vadhaaee manahu kade na veesarai |
English: My mind has found peace and tranquility; congratulations are pouring in. I shall never forget Him from my mind.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਸਦਾ ਭਜੁ ਜਗਦੀਸਰੈ ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
