Transliteration: binavant naanak satigur drirraaeaa sadaa bhaj jagadeesarai |4|1|3|
English: Prays Nanak, the True Guru has taught me this, to vibrate and meditate forever on the Lord of the Universe. ||4||1||3||

[Ang 779 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: raag soohee chhant mahalaa 5 ghar 3 |
English: Raag Soohee, Chhant, Fifth Mehl, Third House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਠਾਕੁਰੋ ਬੈਰਾਗਰੋ ਮੈ ਜੇਹੀ ਘਣ ਚੇਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: too tthaakuro bairaagaro mai jehee ghan cheree raam |
English: O my Lord and Master, You are unattached; You have so many hand-maidens like me, Lord.

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਸਾਗਰੋ ਰਤਨਾਗਰੋ ਹਉ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: toon saagaro ratanaagaro hau saar na jaanaa teree raam |
English: You are the ocean, the source of jewels; I do not know Your value, Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਤੂ ਵਡ ਦਾਣਾ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਹਰੰਮਤਿ ਸਾਂਈ ॥
Transliteration: saar na jaanaa too vadd daanaa kar miharamat saanee |
English: I do not know Your value; You are the wisest of all; please show Mercy unto me, O Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਜੈ ਸਾ ਮਤਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: kirapaa keejai saa mat deejai aatth pehar tudh dhiaaee |
English: Show Your Mercy, and bless me with such understanding, that I may meditate on You, twenty-four hours a day.

Gurbani: ਗਰਬੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਰੇਣ ਹੋਵੀਜੈ ਤਾ ਗਤਿ ਜੀਅਰੇ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: garab na keejai ren hoveejai taa gat jeeare teree |
English: O soul, don't be so arrogant - become the dust of all, and you shall be saved.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮੈ ਜੇਹੀ ਘਣ ਚੇਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sabh aoopar naanak kaa tthaakur mai jehee ghan cheree raam |1|
English: Nanak's Lord is the Master of all; He has so many hand-maidens like me. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮੑ ਗਉਹਰ ਅਤਿ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ ਤੁਮ ਪਿਰ ਹਮ ਬਹੁਰੀਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: tuma gauhar at gahir ganbheeraa tum pir ham bahureea raam |
English: Your depth is profound and utterly unfathomable; You are my Husband Lord, and I am Your bride.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਵਡੇ ਵਡੇ ਵਡ ਊਚੇ ਹਉ ਇਤਨੀਕ ਲਹੁਰੀਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: tum vadde vadde vadd aooche hau itaneek lahureea raam |
English: You are the greatest of the great, exalted and lofty on high; I am infinitesimally small.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਏਕੋ ਤੂਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਜਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: hau kichh naahee eko toohai aape aap sujaanaa |
English: I am nothing; You are the One and only. You Yourself are All-knowing.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨਿਮਖ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਵਾ ਸਰਬ ਰੰਗ ਰਸ ਮਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: amrit drisatt nimakh prabh jeevaa sarab rang ras maanaa |
English: With just a momentary Glance of Your Grace, God, I live; I enjoy all pleasures and delights.

Gurbani: ਚਰਣਹ ਸਰਨੀ ਦਾਸਹ ਦਾਸੀ ਮਨਿ ਮਉਲੈ ਤਨੁ ਹਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: charanah saranee daasah daasee man maulai tan hareea |
English: I seek the Sanctuary of Your Feet; I am the slave of Your slaves. My mind has blossomed forth, and my body is rejuvenated.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਣਾ ਆਪਨ ਭਾਵਨ ਕਰੀਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak tthaakur sarab samaanaa aapan bhaavan kareea |2|
English: O Nanak, the Lord and Master is contained amongst all; He does just as He pleases. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੁਝੁ ਊਪਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਹੈ ਮਾਣਾ ਤੂਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਤਾਣਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: tujh aoopar meraa hai maanaa toohai meraa taanaa raam |
English: I take pride in You; You are my only Strength, Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਜਾਣਾਇਹਿ ਜਾਣਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: surat mat chaturaaee teree too jaanaaeihi jaanaa raam |
English: You are my understanding, intellect and knowledge. I know only what You cause me to know, Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਈ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਸਿਰੰਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: soee jaanai soee pachhaanai jaa kau nadar sirande |
English: He alone knows, and he alone understands, upon whom the Creator Lord bestows His Grace.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਭੂਲੀ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਰਾਹੀ ਫਾਥੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਫੰਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh bhoolee bahutee raahee faathee maaeaa fande |
English: The self-willed manmukh wanders along many paths, and is trapped in the net of Maya.

Gurbani: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਾਣੀ ਸਾ ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਸਭ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: tthaakur bhaanee saa gunavantee tin hee sabh rang maanaa |
English: She alone is virtuous, who is pleasing to her Lord and Master. She alone enjoys all the pleasures.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਧਰ ਤੂਹੈ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੂ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਮਾਣਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak kee dhar toohai tthaakur too naanak kaa maanaa |3|
English: You, O Lord, are Nanak's only support. You are Nanak's only pride. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਵੰਞਾ ਘੋਲੀ ਵੰਞਾ ਤੂ ਪਰਬਤੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਓਲੑਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: hau vaaree vanyaa gholee vanyaa too parabat meraa olaa raam |
English: I am a sacrifice, devoted and dedicated to You; You are my sheltering mountain, Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਬਰੀਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਪਰਦਾ ਖੋਲੑਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: hau bal jaaee lakh lakh lakh bareea jin bhram paradaa kholaa raam |
English: I am a sacrifice, thousands, hundreds of thousands of times, to the Lord. He has torn away the veil of doubt;

Gurbani: ਮਿਟੇ ਅੰਧਾਰੇ ਤਜੇ ਬਿਕਾਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: mitte andhaare taje bikaare tthaakur siau man maanaa |
English: darkness has been eliminated, and I have renounced corruption and sin. My mind is reconciled with my Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਭਾਣੀ ਭਈ ਨਿਕਾਣੀ ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: prabh jee bhaanee bhee nikaanee safal janam paravaanaa |
English: I have become pleasing to my Dear God, and I have become carefree. My life is fulfilled and approved.

Gurbani: ਭਈ ਅਮੋਲੀ ਭਾਰਾ ਤੋਲੀ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਦਰੁ ਖੋਲੑਾ ॥
Transliteration: bhee amolee bhaaraa tolee mukat jugat dar kholaa |
English: I have become invaluable, of tremendous weight and value. The Door, and the Path of liberation are open to me now.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹੋਈ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਓਲੑਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੪॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak hau nirbhau hoee so prabh meraa olaa |4|1|4|
English: Says Nanak, I am fearless; God has become my Shelter and Shield. ||4||1||4||

[Ang 780 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਾਜਨੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: saajan purakh satigur meraa pooraa tis bin avar na jaanaa raam |
English: My Perfect True Guru is my Best Friend, the Primal Being. I do not know any other than Him, Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪ ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: maat pitaa bhaaee sut bandhap jeea praan man bhaanaa raam |
English: He is my mother, father, sibling, child, relative, soul and breath of life. He is so pleasing to my mind, O Lord.

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਦੀਆ ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣਾ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jeeo pindd sabh tis kaa deea sarab gunaa bharapoore |
English: My body and soul are all His blessings. He is overflowing with every quality of virtue.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਰਬ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: antarajaamee so prabh meraa sarab rahiaa bharapoore |
English: My God is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. He is totally permeating and pervading everywhere.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ਹੋਏ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਿਆਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: taa kee saran sarab sukh paae hoe sarab kaliaanaa |
English: In His Sanctuary, I receive every comfort and pleasure. I am totally, completely happy.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa prabh kau balihaarai naanak sad kurabaanaa |1|
English: Forever and ever, Nanak is a sacrifice to God, forever, a devoted sacrifice. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਪੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa gur vaddabhaagee paaeeai jit miliai prabh jaapai raam |
English: By great good fortune, one finds such a Guru, meeting whom, the Lord God is known.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਧੂੜੀ ਨਿਤ ਨਾਪੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: janam janam ke kilavikh utareh har sant dhoorree nit naapai raam |
English: The sins of countless lifetimes are erased, bathing continually in the dust of the feet of God's Saints.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਧੂੜੀ ਨਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਆਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: har dhoorree naaeeai prabhoo dhiaaeeai baahurr jon na aaeeai |
English: Bathing in the dust of the feet of the Lord, and meditating on God, you shall not have to enter into the womb of reincarnation again.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੇ ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: gur charanee laage bhram bhau bhaage man chindiaa fal paaeeai |
English: Grasping hold of the Guru's Feet, doubt and fear are dispelled, and you receive the fruits of your mind's desires.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਏ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਫਿਰਿ ਸੋਗੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: har gun nit gaae naam dhiaae fir sog naahee santaapai |
English: Continually singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, you shall no longer suffer in pain and sorrow.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਪਰਤਾਪੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak so prabh jeea kaa daataa pooraa jis parataapai |2|
English: O Nanak, God is the Giver of all souls; His radiant glory is perfect! ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਆਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: har hare har gun nidhe har santan kai vas aae raam |
English: The Lord, Har, Har, is the treasure of virtue; the Lord is under the power of His Saints.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਚਰਣ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੇ ਤਿਨੀ ਪਰਮ ਪਦ ਪਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sant charan gur sevaa laage tinee param pad paae raam |
English: Those who are dedicated to the feet of the Saints, and to serving the Guru, obtain the supreme status, O Lord.

Gurbani: ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: param pad paaeaa aap mittaaeaa har pooran kirapaa dhaaree |
English: They obtain the supreme status, and eradicate self-conceit; the Perfect Lord showers His Grace upon them.

Gurbani: ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਹੋਆ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਏਕੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: safal janam hoaa bhau bhaagaa har bhettiaa ek muraaree |
English: Their lives are fruitful, their fears are dispelled, and they meet the One Lord, the Destroyer of ego.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੀਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jis kaa saa tin hee mel leea jotee jot samaaeaa |
English: He blends into the One, to whom he belongs; his light merges into the Light.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਜਪੀਐ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak naam niranjan japeeai mil satigur sukh paaeaa |3|
English: O Nanak, chant the Naam, the Name of the Immaculate Lord; meeting the True Guru, peace is obtained. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗਾਉ ਮੰਗਲੋ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਜਨਹੁ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਇਛ ਸਬਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: gaau mangalo nit har janahu punee ichh sabaaee raam |
English: Sing continually the songs of joy, O humble beings of the Lord; all your desires shall be fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: rang rate apune suaamee setee marai na aavai jaaee raam |
English: Those who are imbued with the Love of their Lord and Master do not die, or come or go in reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: abinaasee paaeaa naam dhiaaeaa sagal manorath paae |
English: The Imperishable Lord is obtained, meditating on the Naam, and all one's wishes are fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: saant sehaj aanand ghanere gur charanee man laae |
English: Peace, poise, and all ecstasy are obtained, attaching one's mind to the Guru's feet.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: poor rahiaa ghatt ghatt abinaasee thaan thanantar saaee |
English: The Imperishable Lord is permeating and pervading each and every heart; He is in all places and interspaces.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਈ ॥੪॥੨॥੫॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak kaaraj sagale poore gur charanee man laaee |4|2|5|
English: Says Nanak, all affairs are perfectly resolved, focusing one's mind on the Guru's Feet. ||4||2||5||

[Ang 780 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa mere preetam suaamee netr dekheh daras teraa raam |
English: Be Merciful, O my Beloved Lord and Master, that I may behold the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan with my eyes.

Gurbani: ਲਾਖ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਦੇਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮੁਖੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: laakh jihavaa dehu mere piaare mukh har aaraadhe meraa raam |
English: Please bless me, O my Beloved, with thousands of tongues, to worship and adore You with my mouth, O Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਜਮ ਪੰਥੁ ਸਾਧੇ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: har aaraadhe jam panth saadhe dookh na viaapai koee |
English: Worshipping the Lord in adoration, the Path of Death is overcome, and no pain or suffering will afflict you.

Gurbani: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਤ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਤ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jal thal maheeal pooran suaamee jat dekhaa tat soee |
English: The Lord and Master is pervading and permeating the water, the land and the sky; wherever I look, there He is.

Gurbani: ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਨਾਠੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨੇਰ ਹੂ ਤੇ ਨੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: bharam moh bikaar naatthe prabh ner hoo te neraa |
English: Doubt, attachment and corruption are gone. God is the nearest of the near.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਜੈ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak kau prabh kirapaa keejai netr dekheh daras teraa |1|
English: Please bless Nanak with Your Merciful Grace, O God, that his eyes may behold the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਕਰਨ ਦੀਜਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸੁਣੀਅਹਿ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: kott karan deejeh prabh preetam har gun suneeeh abinaasee raam |
English: Please bless me, O Beloved God, with millions of ears, with which I may hear the Glorious Praises of the Imperishable Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਟੀਐ ਕਾਲ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sun sun ihu man niramal hovai katteeai kaal kee faasee raam |
English: Listening, listening to these, this mind becomes spotless and pure, and the noose of Death is cut.

Gurbani: ਕਟੀਐ ਜਮ ਫਾਸੀ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਸਗਲ ਮੰਗਲ ਸੁਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: katteeai jam faasee simar abinaasee sagal mangal sugiaanaa |
English: The noose of Death is cut, meditating on the Imperishable Lord, and all happiness and wisdom are obtained.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: har har jap japeeai din raatee laagai sehaj dhiaanaa |
English: Chant, and meditate, day and night, on the Lord, Har, Har. Focus your meditation on the Celestial Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਲਮਲ ਦੁਖ ਜਾਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਚਿਤਾਰੇ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: kalamal dukh jaare prabhoo chitaare man kee duramat naasee |
English: The painful sins are burnt away, by keeping God in one's thoughts; evil-mindedness is erased.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸੁਣੀਅਹਿ ਅਵਿਨਾਸੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak prabh kirapaa keejai har gun suneeeh avinaasee |2|
English: Says Nanak, O God, please be Merciful to me, that I may listen to Your Glorious Praises, O Imperishable Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਰੋੜਿ ਹਸਤ ਤੇਰੀ ਟਹਲ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਚਰਣ ਚਲਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: karorr hasat teree ttehal kamaaveh charan chaleh prabh maarag raam |
English: Please give me millions of hands to serve You, God, and let my feet walk on Your Path.

Gurbani: ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰ ਨਾਵ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਜੋ ਚੜੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਾਰਗਿ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: bhav saagar naav har sevaa jo charrai tis taarag raam |
English: Service to the Lord is the boat to carry us across the terrifying world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: bhavajal tariaa har har simariaa sagal manorath poore |
English: So cross over the terrifying world-ocean, meditating in remembrance on the Lord, Har, Har; all wishes shall be fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਗਏ ਸੁਖ ਉਪਜੇ ਬਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਤੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: mahaa bikaar ge sukh upaje baaje anahad toore |
English: Even the worst corruption is taken away; peace wells up, and the unstruck celestial harmony vibrates and resounds.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੀਮ ਅਪਾਰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: man baanchhat fal paae sagale kudarat keem apaarag |
English: All the fruits of the mind's desires are obtained; His creative power is infinitely valuable.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਜੈ ਮਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਚਲੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak prabh kirapaa keejai man sadaa chalai terai maarag |3|
English: Says Nanak, please be Merciful to me, God, that my mind may follow Your Path forever. ||3||

Gurbani: ਏਹੋ ਵਰੁ ਏਹਾ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਵਡਭਾਗਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: eho var ehaa vaddiaaee ihu dhan hoe vaddabhaagaa raam |
English: This opportunity, this glorious greatness, this blessing and wealth, come by great good fortune.

Gurbani: ਏਹੋ ਰੰਗੁ ਏਹੋ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: eho rang eho ras bhogaa har charanee man laagaa raam |
English: These pleasures, these delightful enjoyments, come when my mind is attached to the Lord's Feet.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਚਰਣੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੇ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: man laagaa charane prabh kee sarane karan kaaran gopaalaa |
English: My mind is attached to God's Feet; I seek His Sanctuary. He is the Creator, the Cause of causes, the Cherisher of the world.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh teraa too prabh meraa mere tthaakur deen deaalaa |
English: Everything is Yours; You are my God, O my Lord and Master, Merciful to the meek.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਨੁ ਜਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: mohi niragun preetam sukh saagar santasang man jaagaa |
English: I am worthless, O my Beloved, ocean of peace. In the Saints' Congregation, my mind is awakened.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਨੑੀ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੬॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak prabh kirapaa keenaee charan kamal man laagaa |4|3|6|
English: Says Nanak, God has been Merciful to me; my mind is attached to His Lotus Feet. ||4||3||6||

[Ang 781 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਸੰਤ ਭਗਤ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: har jape har mandar saajiaa sant bhagat gun gaaveh raam |
English: Meditating on the Lord, the Lord's Temple has been built; the Saints and devotees sing the Lord's Glorious Praises.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਸਗਲੇ ਪਾਪ ਤਜਾਵਹਿ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: simar simar suaamee prabh apanaa sagale paap tajaaveh raam |
English: Meditating, meditating in remembrance of God, their Lord and Master, they discard and renounce all their sins.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਊਤਮ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: har gun gaae param pad paaeaa prabh kee aootam baanee |
English: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the supreme status is obtained. The Word of God's Bani is sublime and exalted.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜ ਕਥਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਅਤਿ ਮੀਠੀ ਕਥੀ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj kathaa prabh kee at meetthee kathee akath kahaanee |
English: God's Sermon is so very sweet. It brings celestial peace. It is to speak the Unspoken Speech.

Gurbani: ਭਲਾ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਮੂਰਤੁ ਪਲੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਅਬਿਚਲ ਨੀਵ ਰਖਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: bhalaa sanjog moorat pal saachaa abichal neev rakhaaee |
English: The time and the moment were auspicious, blessed and true, when the eternal foundation of this Temple was placed.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak prabh bhe deaalaa sarab kalaa ban aaee |1|
English: O servant Nanak, God has been kind and compassionate; with all His powers, He has blessed me. ||1||

Gurbani: ਆਨੰਦਾ ਵਜਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਵਾਜੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵੂਠਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: aanandaa vajeh nit vaaje paarabraham man vootthaa raam |
English: The sounds of ecstasy vibrate through me continuously. I have enshrined the Supreme Lord within my mind.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖੇ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੈ ਝੂਠਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: guramukhe sach karanee saaree binase bhram bhai jhootthaa raam |
English: As Gurmukh, my lifestyle is excellent and true; my false hopes and doubts are dispelled.

Gurbani: ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: anahad baanee guramukh vakhaanee jas sun sun man tan hariaa |
English: The Gurmukh chants the Bani of the unstruck melody; hearing it, listening to it, my mind and body are rejuvenated.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਬਣਿ ਆਏ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨਾ ਕਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sarab sukhaa tis hee ban aae jo prabh apanaa kariaa |
English: All pleasures are obtained, by that one whom God makes His Own.

Gurbani: ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: ghar meh nav nidh bhare bhanddaaraa raam naam rang laagaa |
English: Within the home of the heart are the nine treasures, filled to overflowing. He has fallen in love with the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak jan prabh kade na visarai pooran jaa ke bhaagaa |2|
English: Servant Nanak shall never forget God; his destiny is perfectly fulfilled. ||2||

Gurbani: ਛਾਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤਿ ਕੀਨੑੀ ਸਗਲੀ ਤਪਤਿ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: chhaaeaa prabh chhatrapat keenaee sagalee tapat binaasee raam |
English: God, the King, has given me shade under His canopy, and the fire of desire has been totally extinguished.

Gurbani: ਦੂਖ ਪਾਪ ਕਾ ਡੇਰਾ ਢਾਠਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਆਇਆ ਰਾਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: dookh paap kaa dderaa dtaatthaa kaaraj aaeaa raasee raam |
English: The home of sorrow and sin has been demolished, and all affairs have been resolved.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ਮਿਟੀ ਬਲਾਇਆ ਸਾਚੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਫਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: har prabh furamaaeaa mittee balaaeaa saach dharam pun faliaa |
English: When the Lord God so commands, misfortune is averted; true righteousness, Dharma and charity flourish.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸੋਵਤ ਬੈਸਤ ਖਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: so prabh apunaa sadaa dhiaaeeai sovat baisat khaliaa |
English: Meditate forever on your God, when you sleep and sit and stand.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: gun nidhaan sukh saagar suaamee jal thal maheeal soee |
English: The Lord and Master is the treasure of virtue, the ocean of peace; He pervades the water, the land and the sky.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jan naanak prabh kee saranaaee tis bin avar na koee |3|
English: Servant Nanak has entered God's Sanctuary; there is no other than Him. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਘਰੁ ਬਨਿਆ ਬਨੁ ਤਾਲੁ ਬਨਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਰਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: meraa ghar baniaa ban taal baniaa prabh parase har raaeaa raam |
English: My home is made, the garden and pool are made, and my Sovereign Lord God has met me.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਸੋਹਿਆ ਮੀਤ ਸਾਜਨ ਸਰਸੇ ਗੁਣ ਮੰਗਲ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: meraa man sohiaa meet saajan sarase gun mangal har gaaeaa raam |
English: My mind is adorned, and my friends rejoice; I sing the songs of joy, and the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਗਲ ਇਛਾ ਪਾਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: gun gaae prabhoo dhiaae saachaa sagal ichhaa paaeea |
English: Singing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord God, all desires are fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਲਾਗੇ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਗੇ ਮਨਿ ਵਜੀਆ ਵਾਧਾਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur charan laage sadaa jaage man vajeea vaadhaaeea |
English: Those who are attached to the Guru's Feet are always awake and aware; His Praises resound and resonate through their minds.

Gurbani: ਕਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਖਹ ਗਾਮੀ ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: karee nadar suaamee sukhah gaamee halat palat savaariaa |
English: My Lord and Master, the bringer of peace, has blessed me with His Grace; He has arranged this world, and the world hereafter for me.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥੪॥੪॥੭॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak nit naam japeeai jeeo pindd jin dhaariaa |4|4|7|
English: Prays Nanak, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord forever; He is the Support of the body and soul. ||4||4||7||

[Ang 782 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰੋ ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: bhai saagaro bhai saagar tariaa har har naam dhiaae raam |
English: The terrifying world-ocean, the terrifying world-ocean - I have crossed over it, meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਬੋਹਿਥੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਅਰਾਧੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਰਿ ਲਘਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: bohitharraa har charan araadhe mil satigur paar laghaae raam |
English: I worship and adore the Lord's Feet, the boat to carry me across. Meeting the True Guru, I am carried over.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਤਰੀਐ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਮਰੀਐ ਚੂਕੈ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: gurasabadee tareeai bahurr na mareeai chookai aavan jaanaa |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I cross over, and I shall not die again; my comings and goings are ended.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨਉ ਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo kichh karai soee bhal maanau taa man sehaj samaanaa |
English: Whatever He does, I accept as good, and my mind merges in celestial peace.

Gurbani: ਦੂਖ ਨ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: dookh na bhookh na rog na biaapai sukh saagar saranee paae |
English: Neither pain, nor hunger, nor disease afflicts me. I have found the Sanctuary of the Lord, the ocean of peace.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਤ ਮਿਟਾਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har simar simar naanak rang raataa man kee chint mittaae |1|
English: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Lord, Nanak is imbued with His Love; his mind's anxieties are dispelled. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਕੀਨੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sant janaa har mantru drirraaeaa har saajan vasagat keene raam |
English: The humble Saints have implanted the Lord's Mantra within me, and the Lord, my Best Friend, has come under my power.

Gurbani: ਆਪਨੜਾ ਮਨੁ ਆਗੈ ਧਰਿਆ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: aapanarraa man aagai dhariaa sarabas tthaakur deene raam |
English: I have dedicated my mind to my Lord and Master, and offered it to Him, and He has blessed me with everything.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਦਾਸੀ ਮਿਟੀ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਥਿਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kar apunee daasee mittee udaasee har mandar thit paaee |
English: He has made me His hand-maiden and slave; my sadness is dispelled, and in the Lord's Temple, I have found stability.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: anad binod simarahu prabh saachaa vichhurr kabahoo na jaaee |
English: My joy and bliss are in meditating on my True God; I shall never be separated from Him again.

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਵਡਭਾਗਣਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਚੀਨੑੇ ॥
Transliteration: saa vaddabhaagan sadaa sohaagan raam naam gun cheenae |
English: She alone is very fortunate, and a true soul-bride, who contemplates the Glorious Vision of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਵਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਮਹਾ ਰਸਿ ਭੀਨੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak raveh rang raate prem mahaa ras bheene |2|
English: Says Nanak, I am imbued with His Love, drenched in the supreme, sublime essence of His Love. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਭਏ ਨਿਤ ਸਖੀਏ ਮੰਗਲ ਸਦਾ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: anad binod bhe nit sakhee mangal sadaa hamaarai raam |
English: I am in continual bliss and ecstasy, O my companions; I sing the songs of joy forever.

Gurbani: ਆਪਨੜੈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੀ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: aapanarrai prabh aap seegaaree sobhaavantee naare raam |
English: God Himself has embellished her, and she has become His virtuous soul-bride.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਭਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ਗੁਣ ਅਵਗਣ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj subhaae bhe kirapaalaa gun avagan na beechaariaa |
English: With natural ease, He has become Merciful to her. He does not consider her merits or demerits.

Gurbani: ਕੰਠਿ ਲਗਾਇ ਲੀਏ ਜਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: kantth lagaae lee jan apune raam naam ur dhaariaa |
English: He hugs His humble servants close in His Loving Embrace; they enshrine the Lord's Name in their hearts.

Gurbani: ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹ ਮਦ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਆਪੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: maan moh mad sagal biaapee kar kirapaa aap nivaare |
English: Everyone is engrossed in arrogant pride, attachment and intoxication; in His Mercy, He has freed me of them.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਜ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak bhai saagar tariaa pooran kaaj hamaare |3|
English: Says Nanak, I have crossed over the terrifying world-ocean, and all my affairs are perfectly resolved. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਸਖੀਹੋ ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: gun gopaal gaavahu nit sakheeho sagal manorath paae raam |
English: Continually sing the Glorious Praises of the World-Lord, O my companions; all your wishes shall be granted.

Gurbani: ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਹੋਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: safal janam hoaa mil saadhoo ekankaar dhiaae raam |
English: Life becomes fruitful, meeting with the Holy Saints, and meditating on the One God, the Creator of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਏਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਅਨੇਕ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਰਬ ਮੰਡਲਿ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jap ek prabhoo anek raviaa sarab manddal chhaaeaa |
English: Chant, and meditate on the One God, who permeates and pervades the many beings of the whole Universe.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੋ ਪਸਾਰਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: brahamo pasaaraa braham pasariaa sabh braham drisattee aaeaa |
English: God created it, and God spreads through it everywhere. Everywhere I look, I see God.

Gurbani: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jal thal maheeal poor pooran tis binaa nahee jaae |
English: The Perfect Lord is perfectly pervading and permeating the water, the land and the sky; there is no place without Him.

Gurbani: ਪੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਗਸੇ ਆਪਿ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੪॥੫॥੮॥
Transliteration: pekh darasan naanak bigase aap le milaae |4|5|8|
English: Beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, Nanak has blossomed forth; the Lord has united him in Union. ||4||5||8||

[Ang 783 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਬਿਚਲ ਨਗਰੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: abichal nagar gobind guroo kaa naam japat sukh paaeaa raam |
English: Eternal and immovable is the City of God and Guru; chanting His Name, I have found peace.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਸੇਈ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਕਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: man ichhe seee fal paae karatai aap vasaaeaa raam |
English: I have obtained the fruits of my mind's desires; the Creator Himself established it.

Gurbani: ਕਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਆ ਪੁਤ ਭਾਈ ਸਿਖ ਬਿਗਾਸੇ ॥
Transliteration: karatai aap vasaaeaa sarab sukh paaeaa put bhaaee sikh bigaase |
English: The Creator Himself established it. I have found total peace; my children, siblings and Sikhs have all blossomed forth in bliss.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਆਇਆ ਰਾਸੇ ॥
Transliteration: gun gaaveh pooran paramesur kaaraj aaeaa raase |
English: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Perfect Transcendent Lord, my affairs have come to be resolved.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਪੇ ਰਖਾ ਆਪਿ ਪਿਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: prabh aap suaamee aape rakhaa aap pitaa aap maaeaa |
English: God Himself is my Lord and Master. He Himself is my Saving Grace; He Himself is my father and mother.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak satigur balihaaree jin ehu thaan suhaaeaa |1|
English: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the True Guru, who has embellished and adorned this place. ||1||

Gurbani: ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਹਟਨਾਲੇ ਸੋਹੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: ghar mandar hattanaale sohe jis vich naam nivaasee raam |
English: Homes, mansions, stores and markets are beautiful, when the Lord's Name abides within.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਭਗਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ ਕਟੀਐ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sant bhagat har naam araadheh katteeai jam kee faasee raam |
English: The Saints and devotees worship the Lord's Name in adoration, and the noose of Death is cut away.

Gurbani: ਕਾਟੀ ਜਮ ਫਾਸੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: kaattee jam faasee prabh abinaasee har har naam dhiaae |
English: The noose of Death is cut away, meditating on the Name of the Eternal, Unchanging Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sagal samagree pooran hoee man ichhe fal paae |
English: Everything is perfect for them, and they obtain the fruits of their mind's desires.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਸਜਨ ਸੁਖਿ ਮਾਣਹਿ ਰਲੀਆ ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਨਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: sant sajan sukh maaneh raleea dookh darad bhram naasee |
English: The Saints and friends enjoy peace and pleasure; their pain, suffering and doubts are dispelled.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਸੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sabad savaare satigur poorai naanak sad bal jaasee |2|
English: The Perfect True Guru has embellished them with the Word of the Shabad; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to them. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦਾਤਿ ਖਸਮ ਕੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਹੋਈ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: daat khasam kee pooree hoee nit nit charrai savaaee raam |
English: The gift of our Lord and Master is perfect; it increases day by day.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਖਸਮਾਨਾ ਕੀਆ ਜਿਸ ਦੀ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham khasamaanaa keea jis dee vaddee vaddiaaee raam |
English: The Supreme Lord God has made me His own; His Glorious Greatness is so great!

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਾ ਰਾਖਾ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭਇਆ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: aad jugaad bhagatan kaa raakhaa so prabh bheaa deaalaa |
English: From the very beginning, and throughout the ages, He is the Protector of His devotees; God has become merciful to me.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖੀ ਵਸਾਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jant sabh sukhee vasaae prabh aape kar pratipaalaa |
English: All beings and creatures now dwell in peace; God Himself cherishes and cares for them.

Gurbani: ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: deh dis poor rahiaa jas suaamee keemat kehan na jaaee |
English: The Praises of the Lord and Master are totally pervading in the ten directions; I cannot express His worth.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਅਬਿਚਲ ਨੀਵ ਰਖਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak satigur balihaaree jin abichal neev rakhaaee |3|
English: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the True Guru, who has laid this eternal foundation. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: giaan dhiaan pooran paramesur har har kathaa nit suneeai raam |
English: The spiritual wisdom and meditation of the Perfect Transcendent Lord, and the Sermon of the Lord, Har, Har, are continually heard there.

Gurbani: ਅਨਹਦ ਚੋਜ ਭਗਤ ਭਵ ਭੰਜਨ ਅਨਹਦ ਵਾਜੇ ਧੁਨੀਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: anahad choj bhagat bhav bhanjan anahad vaaje dhuneeai raam |
English: The devotees of the Lord, the Destroyer of fear, play endlessly there, and the unstruck melody resounds and vibrates there.

Gurbani: ਅਨਹਦ ਝੁਣਕਾਰੇ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ਸੰਤ ਗੋਸਟਿ ਨਿਤ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: anahad jhunakaare tat beechaare sant gosatt nit hovai |
English: The unstruck melody resounds and resonates, and the Saints contemplate the essence of reality; this discourse is their daily routine.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਸਭ ਕਾਟਹਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਸਗਲੇ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: har naam araadheh mail sabh kaatteh kilavikh sagale khovai |
English: They worship the Lord's Name, and all their filth is washed away; they rid themselves of all sins.

Gurbani: ਤਹ ਜਨਮ ਨ ਮਰਣਾ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੋੁਨੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: teh janam na maranaa aavan jaanaa bahurr na paaeeai juoneeai |
English: There is no birth or death there, no coming or going, and no entering into the womb of reincarnation again.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਇਛ ਪੁਨੀਐ ॥੪॥੬॥੯॥
Transliteration: naanak gur paramesar paaeaa jis prasaad ichh puneeai |4|6|9|
English: Nanak has found the Guru, the Transcendent Lord; by His Grace, desires are fulfilled. ||4||6||9||

[Ang 783 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 |
English: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਾ ਕੇ ਕਾਰਜਿ ਆਪਿ ਖਲੋਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਮੁ ਕਰਾਵਣਿ ਆਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: santaa ke kaaraj aap khaloeaa har kam karaavan aaeaa raam |
English: The Lord Himself has stood up to resolve the affairs of the Saints; He has come to complete their tasks.

Gurbani: ਧਰਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਤਾਲੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਲੁ ਛਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: dharat suhaavee taal suhaavaa vich amrit jal chhaaeaa raam |
English: The land is beautiful, and the pool is beautiful; within it is contained the Ambrosial Water.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਲੁ ਛਾਇਆ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਾਜੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: amrit jal chhaaeaa pooran saaj karaaeaa sagal manorath poore |
English: The Ambrosial Water is filling it, and my job is perfectly complete; all my desires are fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਭਇਆ ਜਗ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲਾਥੇ ਸਗਲ ਵਿਸੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jai jai kaar bheaa jag antar laathe sagal visoore |
English: Congratulations are pouring in from all over the world; all my sorrows are eliminated.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਚੁਤ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਜਸੁ ਵੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣੀ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: pooran purakh achut abinaasee jas ved puraanee gaaeaa |
English: The Vedas and the Puraanas sing the Praises of the Perfect, Unchanging, Imperishable Primal Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਪਨਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: apanaa birad rakhiaa paramesar naanak naam dhiaaeaa |1|
English: The Transcendent Lord has kept His promise, and confirmed His nature; Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਦੀਨੇ ਕਰਤੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: nav nidh sidh ridh deene karate tott na aavai kaaee raam |
English: The Creator has given me the nine treasures, wealth and spiritual powers, and I do not lack anything.

Gurbani: ਖਾਤ ਖਰਚਤ ਬਿਲਛਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਸਵਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: khaat kharachat bilachhat sukh paaeaa karate kee daat savaaee raam |
English: Eating, spending and enjoying, I have found peace; the gifts of the Creator Lord continually increase.

Gurbani: ਦਾਤਿ ਸਵਾਈ ਨਿਖੁਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: daat savaaee nikhutt na jaaee antarajaamee paaeaa |
English: His gifts increase and shall never be exhausted; I have found the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਬਿਘਨ ਸਗਲੇ ਉਠਿ ਨਾਠੇ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਨੇੜੈ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kott bighan sagale utth naatthe dookh na nerrai aaeaa |
English: Millions of obstacles have all been removed, and pain does not even approach me.

Gurbani: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਭੂਖ ਸਬਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: saant sehaj aanand ghanere binasee bhookh sabaaee |
English: Tranquility, peace, poise and bliss in abundance prevail, and all my hunger is satisfied.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੇ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak gun gaaveh suaamee ke acharaj jis vaddiaaee raam |2|
English: Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of his Lord and Master, whose Glorious Greatness is wonderful and amazing. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਕੀਆ ਮਾਣਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: jis kaa kaaraj tin hee keea maanas kiaa vechaaraa raam |
English: It was His job, and He has done it; what can the mere mortal being do?

Gurbani: ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਜੈਕਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat sohan har ke gun gaaveh sadaa kareh jaikaaraa raam |
English: The devotees are adorned, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; they proclaim His eternal victory.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਅਨਦ ਉਪਜੇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: gun gaae gobind anad upaje saadhasangat sang banee |
English: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, bliss wells up, and we are friends with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਉਦਮੁ ਕੀਆ ਤਾਲ ਕੇਰਾ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਕਿਆ ਗਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: jin udam keea taal keraa tis kee upamaa kiaa ganee |
English: He who made the effort to construct this sacred pool - how can his praises be recounted?

Gurbani: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਪੁੰਨ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਮਹਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: atthasatth teerath pun kiriaa mahaa niramal chaaraa |
English: The merits of the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, charity, good deeds and immaculate lifestyle, are found in this sacred pool.

Gurbani: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨੁ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: patit paavan birad suaamee naanak sabad adhaaraa |3|
English: It is the natural way of the Lord and Master to purify sinners; Nanak takes the Support of the Word of the Shabad. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਉਨੁ ਕਰੀਜੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: gun nidhaan meraa prabh karataa usatat kaun kareejai raam |
English: The treasure of virtue is my God, the Creator Lord; what Praises of Yours should I sing, O Lord?

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਾ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: santaa kee benantee suaamee naam mahaa ras deejai raam |
English: The prayer of the Saints is, "O Lord and Master, please bless us with the supreme, sublime essence of Your Name."

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਬਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਇਕ ਖਿਨੋ ॥
Transliteration: naam deejai daan keejai bisar naahee ik khino |
English: Please, grant us Your Name, grant us this blessing, and do not forget us, even for an instant.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਉਚਰੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਸਦਾ ਗਾਈਐ ਅਨਦਿਨੋ ॥
Transliteration: gun gopaal uchar rasanaa sadaa gaaeeai anadino |
English: Chant the Glorious Praises of the World-Lord, O my tongue; sing them forever, night and day.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਨਾਮ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: jis preet laagee naam setee man tan amrit bheejai |
English: One who enshrines love for the Naam, the Name of the Lord, his mind and body are drenched with Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਪੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਜੀਜੈ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak ichh punee pekh darasan jeejai |4|7|10|
English: Prays Nanak, my desires have been fulfilled; gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord, I live. ||4||7||10||

[Ang 784 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: raag soohee mahalaa 5 chhant |
English: Raag Soohee, Fifth Mehl, Chhant:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਮਿਠ ਬੋਲੜਾ ਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੋਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: mitth bolarraa jee har sajan suaamee moraa |
English: My Dear Lord and Master, my Friend, speaks so sweetly.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਸੰਮਲਿ ਥਕੀ ਜੀ ਓਹੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਬੋਲੈ ਕਉਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: hau samal thakee jee ohu kade na bolai kauraa |
English: I have grown weary of testing Him, but still, He never speaks harshly to me.

Gurbani: ਕਉੜਾ ਬੋਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਗਵਾਨੈ ਅਉਗਣੁ ਕੋ ਨ ਚਿਤਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kaurraa bol na jaanai pooran bhagavaanai aaugan ko na chitaare |
English: He does not know any bitter words; the Perfect Lord God does not even consider my faults and demerits.

Gurbani: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸਦਾਏ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਭੰਨੈ ਘਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: patit paavan har birad sadaae ik til nahee bhanai ghaale |
English: It is the Lord's natural way to purify sinners; He does not overlook even an iota of service.

Gurbani: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਵਾਸੀ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਨੇਰੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਨੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt vaasee sarab nivaasee nerai hee te neraa |
English: He dwells in each and every heart, pervading everywhere; He is the nearest of the near.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਜਣੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak daas sadaa saranaagat har amrit sajan meraa |1|
English: Slave Nanak seeks His Sanctuary forever; the Lord is my Ambrosial Friend. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਬਿਸਮੁ ਭਈ ਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: hau bisam bhee jee har darasan dekh apaaraa |
English: I am wonder-struck, gazing upon the incomparable Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜੀ ਹਉ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਪਗ ਛਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: meraa sundar suaamee jee hau charan kamal pag chhaaraa |
English: My Dear Lord and Master is so beautiful; I am the dust of His Lotus Feet.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੇਖਤ ਜੀਵਾ ਠੰਢੀ ਥੀਵਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: prabh pekhat jeevaa tthandtee theevaa tis jevadd avar na koee |
English: Gazing upon God, I live, and I am at peace; no one else is as great as He is.

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਮਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aad ant madh prabh raviaa jal thal maheeal soee |
English: Present at the beginning, end and middle of time, He pervades the sea, the land and the sky.

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਜਪਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਭਵਜਲ ਉਤਰੇ ਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal jap saagar tariaa bhavajal utare paaraa |
English: Meditating on His Lotus Feet, I have crossed over the sea, the terrifying world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak saran pooran paramesur teraa ant na paaraavaaraa |2|
English: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Perfect Transcendent Lord; You have no end or limitation, Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਛੋਡਾ ਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: hau nimakh na chhoddaa jee har preetam praan adhaaro |
English: I shall not forsake, even for an instant, my Dear Beloved Lord, the Support of the breath of life.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਹਿਆ ਜੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਅਗਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: gur satigur kahiaa jee saachaa agam beechaaro |
English: The Guru, the True Guru, has instructed me in the contemplation of the True, Inaccessible Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਦੀਨਾ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੀਨਾ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖ ਨਾਠੇ ॥
Transliteration: mil saadhoo deenaa taa naam leenaa janam maran dukh naatthe |
English: Meeting with the humble, Holy Saint, I obtained the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and the pains of birth and death left me.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜ ਸੂਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਨਠੀ ਗਾਠੇ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj sookh aanand ghanere haumai binatthee gaatthe |
English: I have been blessed with peace, poise and abundant bliss, and the knot of egotism has been untied.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਕੈ ਮਧਿ ਸਭ ਹੂ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਰਾਗ ਦੋਖ ਤੇ ਨਿਆਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kai madh sabh hoo te baahar raag dokh te niaaro |
English: He is inside all, and outside of all; He is untouched by love or hate.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਧਾਰੋ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak daas gobind saranaaee har preetam maneh sadhaaro |3|
English: Slave Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Lord of the Universe; the Beloved Lord is the Support of the mind. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸੁ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: mai khojat khojat jee har nihachal su ghar paaeaa |
English: I searched and searched, and found the immovable, unchanging home of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਅਧ੍ਰੁਵ ਡਿਠੇ ਜੀਉ ਤਾ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabh adhruv dditthe jeeo taa charan kamal chit laaeaa |
English: I have seen that everything is transitory and perishable, and so I have linked my consciousness to the Lotus Feet of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਹਉ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਦਾਸੀ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: prabh abinaasee hau tis kee daasee marai na aavai jaae |
English: God is eternal and unchanging, and I am just His hand-maiden; He does not die, or come and go in reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਧਰਮ ਅਰਥ ਕਾਮ ਸਭਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦੀ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: dharam arath kaam sabh pooran man chindee ichh pujaae |
English: He is overflowing with Dharmic faith, wealth and success; He fulfills the desires of the mind.

Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰੁਤਿ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: srut simrit gun gaaveh karate sidh saadhik mun jan dhiaaeaa |
English: The Vedas and the Simritees sing the Praises of the Creator, while the Siddhas, seekers and silent sages meditate on Him.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: naanak saran kripaa nidh suaamee vaddabhaagee har har gaaeaa |4|1|11|
English: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of his Lord and Master, the treasure of mercy; by great good fortune, he sings the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||1||11||

[Ang 785 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਵਾਰ ਸੂਹੀ ਕੀ ਸਲੋਕਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: vaar soohee kee salokaa naal mahalaa 3 |
English: Vaar Of Soohee, With Saloks Of The Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੂਹੈ ਵੇਸਿ ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਪਰ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵਣ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: soohai ves dohaaganee par pir raavan jaae |
English: In her red robes, the discarded bride goes out, seeking enjoyment with another's husband.

Gurbani: ਪਿਰੁ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਮੋਹੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: pir chhoddiaa ghar aapanai mohee doojai bhaae |
English: She leaves the husband of her own home, enticed by her love of duality.

Gurbani: ਮਿਠਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਖਾਇਆ ਬਹੁ ਸਾਦਹੁ ਵਧਿਆ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: mitthaa kar kai khaaeaa bahu saadahu vadhiaa rog |
English: She finds it sweet, and eats it up; her excessive sensuality only makes her disease worse.

Gurbani: ਸੁਧੁ ਭਤਾਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਲਗਾ ਜਾਇ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: sudh bhataar har chhoddiaa fir lagaa jaae vijog |
English: She forsakes the Lord, her sublime Husband, and then later, she suffers the pain of separation from Him.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਪਲਟਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਾਜਿ ਸੀਗਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh hovai su palattiaa har raatee saaj seegaar |
English: But she who becomes Gurmukh, turns away from corruption and adorns herself, attuned to the Love of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜਿ ਸਚੁ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj sach pir raaviaa har naamaa ur dhaar |
English: She enjoys her celestial Husband Lord, and enshrines the Lord's Name within her heart.

Gurbani: ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ਸਦਾ ਸੋੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਆਪਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: aagiaakaaree sadaa suohaagan aap melee karataar |
English: She is humble and obedient; she is His virtuous bride forever; the Creator unites her with Himself.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੋੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak pir paaeaa har saachaa sadaa suohaagan naar |1|
English: O Nanak, she who has obtained the True Lord as her husband, is a happy soul-bride forever. ||1||

[Ang 785 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੂਹਵੀਏ ਨਿਮਾਣੀਏ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: soohavee nimaanee so sahu sadaa samaal |
English: O meek, red-robed bride, keep your Husband Lord always in your thoughts.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਕੁਲੁ ਭੀ ਛੁਟੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak janam savaareh aapanaa kul bhee chhuttee naal |2|
English: O Nanak, your life shall be embellished, and your generations shall be saved along with you. ||2||

[Ang 785 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਤਖਤੁ ਰਚਾਇਓਨੁ ਆਕਾਸ ਪਤਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape takhat rachaaeon aakaas pataalaa |
English: He Himself established His throne, in the Akaashic ethers and the nether worlds.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਸਚੀ ਧਰਮਸਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: hukame dharatee saajeean sachee dharamasaalaa |
English: By the Hukam of His Command, He created the earth, the true home of Dharma.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਖਪਾਇਦਾ ਸਚੇ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: aap upaae khapaaeidaa sache deen deaalaa |
English: He Himself created and destroys; He is the True Lord, merciful to the meek.

Gurbani: ਸਭਨਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹਿਦਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabhanaa rijak sanbaahidaa teraa hukam niraalaa |
English: You give sustenance to all; how wonderful and unique is the Hukam of Your Command!

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aape aap varatadaa aape pratipaalaa |1|
English: You Yourself are permeating and pervading; You Yourself are the Cherisher. ||1||

[Ang 785 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੂਹਬ ਤਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: soohab taa sohaaganee jaa man laihi sach naau |
English: The red-robed woman becomes a happy soul-bride, only when she accepts the True Name.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਮਨਾਇ ਲੈ ਰੂਪੁ ਚੜੀ ਤਾ ਅਗਲਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਥਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur apanaa manaae lai roop charree taa agalaa doojaa naahee thaau |
English: Become pleasing to your True Guru, and you shall be totally beautified; otherwise, there is no place of rest.

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਇ ਤੂ ਮੈਲਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਭਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa seegaar banaae too mailaa kade na hovee ahinis laagai bhaau |
English: So decorate yourself with the decorations that will never stain, and love the Lord day and night.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਚਿਹਨੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਉਜਲਾ ਖਸਮੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak sohaagan kaa kiaa chihan hai andar sach mukh ujalaa khasamai maeh samaae |1|
English: O Nanak, what is the character of the happy soul-bride? Within her, is Truth; her face is bright and radiant, and she is absorbed in her Lord and Master. ||1||

[Ang 785 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਲੋਕਾ ਵੇ ਹਉ ਸੂਹਵੀ ਸੂਹਾ ਵੇਸੁ ਕਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: lokaa ve hau soohavee soohaa ves karee |
English: O people: I am in red, dressed in a red robe.

Gurbani: ਵੇਸੀ ਸਹੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਸ ਰਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: vesee sahu na paaeeai kar kar ves rahee |
English: But my Husband Lord is not obtained by any robes; I have tried and tried, and given up wearing robes.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨੀ ਸਹੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: naanak tinee sahu paaeaa jinee gur kee sikh sunee |
English: O Nanak, they alone obtain their Husband Lord, who listen to the Guru's Teachings.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੰਤ ਮਿਲੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jo tis bhaavai so theeai in bidh kant milee |2|
English: Whatever pleases Him, happens. In this way, the Husband Lord is met. ||2||

[Ang 786 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਬਹੁ ਭਿਤਿ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: hukamee srisatt saajeean bahu bhit sansaaraa |
English: By His Command, He created the creation, the world with its many species of beings.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੀ ਕੇਤੜਾ ਸਚੇ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: teraa hukam na jaapee ketarraa sache alakh apaaraa |
English: I do not know how great Your Command is, O Unseen and Infinite True Lord.

Gurbani: ਇਕਨਾ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: eikanaa no too mel laihi gur sabad beechaaraa |
English: You join some with Yourself; they reflect on the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sach rate se niramale haumai taj vikaaraa |
English: Those who are imbued with the True Lord are immaculate and pure; they conquer egotism and corruption.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਸੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋਈ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jis too meleh so tudh milai soee sachiaaraa |2|
English: He alone is united with You, whom You unite with Yourself; he alone is true. ||2||

[Ang 786 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੂਹਵੀਏ ਸੂਹਾ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: soohavee soohaa sabh sansaar hai jin duramat doojaa bhaau |
English: O red-robed woman, the whole world is red, engrossed in evil-mindedness and the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਝੂਠੁ ਸਭੁ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਜਿਉ ਟਿਕੈ ਨ ਬਿਰਖ ਕੀ ਛਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: khin meh jhootth sabh binas jaae jiau ttikai na birakh kee chhaau |
English: In an instant, this falsehood totally vanishes; like the shade of a tree, it is gone.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਲੋ ਲਾਲੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਉ ਰੰਗਿ ਮਜੀਠ ਸਚੜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh laalo laal hai jiau rang majeetth sacharraau |
English: The Gurmukh is the deepest crimson of crimson, dyed in the permanent color of the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਉਲਟੀ ਸਕਤਿ ਸਿਵੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aulattee sakat sivai ghar aaee man vasiaa har amrit naau |
English: She turns away from Maya, and enters the celestial home of the Lord; the Ambrosial Name of the Lord dwells within her mind.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak balihaaree gur aapane jit miliai har gun gaau |1|
English: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to my Guru; meeting Him, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

[Ang 786 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੂਹਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: soohaa rang vikaar hai kant na paaeaa jaae |
English: The red color is vain and useless; it cannot help you obtain your Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਲਹਦੇ ਬਿਲਮ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਰੰਡ ਬੈਠੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: eis lahade bilam na hovee randd baitthee doojai bhaae |
English: This color does not take long to fade; she who loves duality, ends up a widow.

Gurbani: ਮੁੰਧ ਇਆਣੀ ਦੁੰਮਣੀ ਸੂਹੈ ਵੇਸਿ ਲੋੁਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: mundh eaanee dunmanee soohai ves luobhaae |
English: She who loves to wear her red dress is foolish and double-minded.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabad sachai rang laal kar bhai bhaae seegaar banaae |
English: So make the True Word of the Shabad your red dress, and let the Fear of God, and the Love of God, be your ornaments and decorations.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿ ਚਲਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak sadaa sohaaganee ji chalan satigur bhaae |2|
English: O Nanak, she is a happy soul-bride forever, who walks in harmony with the Will of the True Guru. ||2||

[Ang 786 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇਅਨੁ ਆਪਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aape aap upaaeian aap keemat paaee |
English: He Himself created Himself, and He Himself evaluates Himself.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਪਈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: tis daa ant na jaapee gur sabad bujhaaee |
English: His limits cannot be known; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is understood.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohu gubaar hai doojai bharamaaee |
English: In the darkness of attachment to Maya, the world wanders in duality.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੑੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh tthaur na paaeinaee fir aavai jaaee |
English: The self-willed manmukhs find no place of rest; they continue coming and going.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਸਭ ਚਲੈ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jo tis bhaavai so theeai sabh chalai rajaaee |3|
English: Whatever pleases Him, that alone happens. All walk according to His Will. ||3||

[Ang 786 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੂਹੈ ਵੇਸਿ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਕੁਲਖਣੀ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਛੋਡਿ ਪਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: soohai ves kaaman kulakhanee jo prabh chhodd par purakh dhare piaar |
English: The red-robed bride is vicious; she forsakes God, and cultivates love for another man.

Gurbani: ਓਸੁ ਸੀਲੁ ਨ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਝੂਠੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਮ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: os seel na sanjam sadaa jhootth bolai manamukh karam khuaar |
English: She has neither modesty or self-discipline; the self-willed manmukh constantly tells lies, and is ruined by the bad karma of evil deeds.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jis poorab hovai likhiaa tis satigur milai bhataar |
English: She who has such pre-ordained destiny, obtains the True Guru has her Husband.

Gurbani: ਸੂਹਾ ਵੇਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਉਤਾਰਿ ਧਰੇ ਗਲਿ ਪਹਿਰੈ ਖਿਮਾ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: soohaa ves sabh utaar dhare gal pahirai khimaa seegaar |
English: She discards all her red dresses, and wears the ornaments of mercy and forgiveness around her neck.

Gurbani: ਪੇਈਐ ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਬਹੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੂਜ ਕਰੇ ਸਭੁ ਸੈਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: peeeai saahurai bahu sobhaa paae tis pooj kare sabh saisaar |
English: In this world and the next, she receives great honor, and the whole world worships her.

Gurbani: ਓਹ ਰਲਾਈ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੀ ਨਾ ਰਲੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: oeh ralaaee kisai dee naa ralai jis raave sirajanahaar |
English: She who is enjoyed by her Creator Lord stands out, and does not blend in with the crowd.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਅਵਿਨਾਸੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਭਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh sadaa suhaaganee jis avinaasee purakh bharataar |1|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is the happy soul-bride forever; she has the Imperishable Lord God as her Husband. ||1||

[Ang 786 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੂਹਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਨਿਸੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਤਾਗੇ ਗਲਿ ਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: soohaa rang supanai nisee bin taage gal haar |
English: The red color is like a dream in the night; it is like a necklace without a string.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਜੀਠ ਕਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa rang majeetth kaa guramukh braham beechaar |
English: The Gurmukhs take on the permanent color, contemplating the Lord God.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੀ ਸਭਿ ਬੁਰਿਆਈਆ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak prem mahaa rasee sabh buriaaeea chhaar |2|
English: O Nanak, with the supreme sublime essence of the Lord's Love, all sins and evil deeds are turned to ashes. ||2||

[Ang 786 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: eihu jag aap upaaeon kar choj viddaan |
English: He Himself created this world, and staged this wondrous play.

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਧਾਤੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਈਅਨੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: panch dhaat vich paaeean mohu jhootth gumaan |
English: Into the body of the five elements, He infused attachment, falsehood and self-conceit.

Gurbani: ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਭਵਾਈਐ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: aavai jaae bhavaaeeai manamukh agiaan |
English: The ignorant, self-willed manmukh comes and goes, wandering in reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਇਕਨਾ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਓਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: eikanaa aap bujhaaeon guramukh har giaan |
English: He Himself teaches some to become Gurmukh, through the spiritual wisdom of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਬਖਸਿਓਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: bhagat khajaanaa bakhasion har naam nidhaan |4|
English: He blesses them with the treasure of devotional worship, and the wealth of the Lord's Name. ||4||

[Ang 786 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੂਹਵੀਏ ਸੂਹਾ ਵੇਸੁ ਛਡਿ ਤੂ ਤਾ ਪਿਰ ਲਗੀ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: soohavee soohaa ves chhadd too taa pir lagee piaar |
English: O red-robed woman, discard your red dress, and then, you shall come to love your Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੂਹੈ ਵੇਸਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦਝਿ ਮੁਈ ਗਾਵਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: soohai ves pir kinai na paaeo manamukh dajh muee gaavaar |
English: By wearing her red dress, no one has found her Husband Lord; the self-willed manmukh is burnt to death.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸੂਹਾ ਵੇਸੁ ਗਇਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: satigur miliai soohaa ves geaa haumai vichahu maar |
English: Meeting the True Guru, she discards her red dress, and eradicates egotism from within.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਲਾਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: man tan rataa laal hoaa rasanaa ratee gun saar |
English: Her mind and body are imbued with the deep red color of His Love, and her tongue is imbued, singing His Praises and excellences.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨਿ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਕਰੇ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sohaagan sabad man bhai bhaae kare seegaar |
English: She becomes His soul-bride forever, with the Word of the Shabad in her mind; she makes the Fear of God and the Love of God her ornaments and decorations.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਮੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak karamee mehal paaeaa pir raakhiaa ur dhaar |1|
English: O Nanak, by His Merciful Grace, she obtains the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and keeps Him enshrined in her heart. ||1||

[Ang 787 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੁੰਧੇ ਸੂਹਾ ਪਰਹਰਹੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: mundhe soohaa paraharahu laal karahu seegaar |
English: O bride, forsake your red dress, and decorate yourself with the crimson color of His Love.

Gurbani: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: aavan jaanaa veesarai gurasabadee veechaar |
English: Your comings and goings shall be forgotten, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਮੁੰਧ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸੋਹਣੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਘਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: mundh suhaavee sohanee jis ghar sehaj bhataar |
English: The soul-bride is adorned and beautiful; the Celestial Lord, her Husband, abides in her home.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਰਾਵੀਐ ਰਾਵੇ ਰਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak saa dhan raaveeai raave raavanahaar |2|
English: O Nanak, the bride ravishes and enjoys Him; and He, the Ravisher, ravishes and enjoys her. ||2||

[Ang 787 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਮੋਹੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਹੈ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: mohu koorr kuttanb hai manamukh mugadh rataa |
English: The foolish, self-willed manmukh is engrossed in false attachment to family.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਏ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਲਿਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: haumai meraa kar mue kichh saath na litaa |
English: Practicing egotism and self-conceit, he dies and departs, taking nothing along with him.

Gurbani: ਸਿਰ ਉਪਰਿ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: sir upar jamakaal na sujhee doojai bharamitaa |
English: He does not understand that the Messenger of Death is hovering over his head; he is deluded by duality.

Gurbani: ਫਿਰਿ ਵੇਲਾ ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ਵਸਿ ਕਿਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: fir velaa hath na aavee jamakaal vas kitaa |
English: This opportunity will not come into his hands again; the Messenger of Death will seize him.

Gurbani: ਜੇਹਾ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਸੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਿਤਾ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: jehaa dhur likh paaeon se karam kamitaa |5|
English: He acts according to his pre-ordained destiny. ||5||

[Ang 787 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤੀਆ ਏਹਿ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ ਜੋ ਮੜਿਆ ਲਗਿ ਜਲੰਨਿੑ ॥
Transliteration: sateea ehi na aakheean jo marriaa lag jalana |
English: Do not call them 'satee', who burn themselves along with their husbands' corpses.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤੀਆ ਜਾਣੀਅਨਿੑ ਜਿ ਬਿਰਹੇ ਚੋਟ ਮਰੰਨਿੑ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak sateea jaaneeana ji birahe chott marana |1|
English: O Nanak, they alone are known as 'satee', who die from the shock of separation. ||1||

[Ang 787 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਭੀ ਸੋ ਸਤੀਆ ਜਾਣੀਅਨਿ ਸੀਲ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਰਹੰਨਿੑ ॥
Transliteration: bhee so sateea jaaneean seel santokh rahana |
English: They are also known as 'satee', who abide in modesty and contentment.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸਾਈ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਿਤ ਉਠਿ ਸੰਮੑਾਲੰਨਿੑ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sevan saaee aapanaa nit utth samaalana |2|
English: They serve their Lord, and rise in the early hours to contemplate Him. ||2||

[Ang 787 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕੰਤਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਮਹੇਲੀਆ ਸੇਤੀ ਅਗਿ ਜਲਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: kantaa naal maheleea setee ag jalaeh |
English: The widows burn themselves in the fire, along with their husbands' corpses.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਾ ਤਨਿ ਦੁਖ ਸਹਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: je jaaneh pir aapanaa taa tan dukh sahaeh |
English: If they truly knew their husbands, then they suffer terrible bodily pain.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੰਤ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਸੇ ਕਿਉ ਅਗਿ ਜਲਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: naanak kant na jaananee se kiau ag jalaeh |
English: O Nanak, if they did not truly know their husbands, why should they burn themselves in the fire?

Gurbani: ਭਾਵੈ ਜੀਵਉ ਕੈ ਮਰਉ ਦੂਰਹੁ ਹੀ ਭਜਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bhaavai jeevau kai mrau doorahu hee bhaj jaeh |3|
English: Whether their husbands are alive or dead, those wives remain far away from them. ||3||

[Ang 787 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਲੇਖੁ ਕਰਤੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: tudh dukh sukh naal upaaeaa lekh karatai likhiaa |
English: You created pain along with pleasure; O Creator, such is the writ You have written.

Gurbani: ਨਾਵੈ ਜੇਵਡ ਹੋਰ ਦਾਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰਿਖਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: naavai jevadd hor daat naahee tis roop na rikhiaa |
English: There is no other gift as great as the Name; it has no form or sign.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: naam akhutt nidhaan hai guramukh man vasiaa |
English: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is an inexhaustible treasure; it abides in the mind of the Gurmukh.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵਸੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਲਿਖਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa naam devasee fir lekh na likhiaa |
English: In His Mercy, He blesses us with the Naam, and then, the writ of pain and pleasure is not written.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਕ ਭਾਇ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਿਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: sevak bhaae se jan mile jin har jap japiaa |6|
English: Those humble servants who serve with love, meet the Lord, chanting the Chant of the Lord. ||6||

[Ang 787 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 2 |
English: Salok, Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਚਲਣੁ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਸੇ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਿਥਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: jinee chalan jaaniaa se kiau kareh vithaar |
English: They know that they will have to depart, so why do they make such ostentatious displays?

Gurbani: ਚਲਣ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: chalan saar na jaananee kaaj savaaranahaar |1|
English: Those who do not know that they will have to depart, continue to arrange their affairs. ||1||

[Ang 787 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 2 |
English: Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਾਤਿ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚੀਐ ਭਲਕੇ ਚਲਣੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: raat kaaran dhan sancheeai bhalake chalan hoe |
English: He accumulates wealth during the night of his life, but in the morning, he must depart.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naal na chalee fir pachhutaavaa hoe |2|
English: O Nanak, it shall not go along with him, and so he regrets. ||2||

[Ang 787 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 2 |
English: Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬਧਾ ਚਟੀ ਜੋ ਭਰੇ ਨਾ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾ ਉਪਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: badhaa chattee jo bhare naa gun naa upakaar |
English: Paying a fine under pressure, does not bring either merit or goodness.

Gurbani: ਸੇਤੀ ਖੁਸੀ ਸਵਾਰੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: setee khusee savaareeai naanak kaaraj saar |3|
English: That alone is a good deed, O Nanak, which is done by one's own free will. ||3||

[Ang 787 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 2 |
English: Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਤਰਫ ਨ ਜਿਪਈ ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਘਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: manahatth taraf na jipee je bahutaa ghaale |
English: Stubborn-mindedness will not win the Lord to one's side, no matter how much it is tried.

Gurbani: ਤਰਫ ਜਿਣੈ ਸਤ ਭਾਉ ਦੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: taraf jinai sat bhaau de jan naanak sabad veechaare |4|
English: The Lord is won over to your side, by offering Him your true love, O servant Nanak, and contemplating the Word of the Shabad. ||4||

[Ang 787 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਕਰਤੈ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: karatai kaaran jin keea so jaanai soee |
English: The Creator created the world; He alone understands it.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਫੁਨਿ ਗੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aape srisatt upaaeean aape fun goee |
English: He Himself created the Universe, and He Himself shall destroy it afterwards.

Gurbani: ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਸਭ ਭਵਿ ਥਕੀ ਕਿਨਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jug chaare sabh bhav thakee kin keemat hoee |
English: All have grown weary of wandering throughout the four ages, but none know the Lord's worth.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਵਿਖਾਲਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur ek vikhaaliaa man tan sukh hoee |
English: The True Guru has shown me the One Lord, and my mind and body are at peace.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: guramukh sadaa salaaheeai karataa kare su hoee |7|
English: The Gurmukh praises the Lord forever; that alone happens, which the Creator Lord does. ||7||

[Ang 788 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 2 |
English: Salok, Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਾ ਭਉ ਤਿਨੑ ਨਾਹਿ ਭਉ ਮੁਚੁ ਭਉ ਨਿਭਵਿਆਹ ॥
Transliteration: jinaa bhau tina naeh bhau much bhau nibhaviaah |
English: Those who have the Fear of God, have no other fears; those who do not have the Fear of God, are very afraid.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਹੁ ਪਟੰਤਰਾ ਤਿਤੁ ਦੀਬਾਣਿ ਗਇਆਹ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak ehu pattantaraa tith deebaan geaah |1|
English: O Nanak, this mystery is revealed at the Court of the Lord. ||1||

[Ang 788 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 2 |
English: Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤੁਰਦੇ ਕਉ ਤੁਰਦਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਉਡਤੇ ਕਉ ਉਡਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: turade kau turadaa milai uddate kau uddataa |
English: That which flows, mingles with that which flows; that which blows, mingles with that which blows.

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਤੇ ਕਉ ਜੀਵਤਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਮੂਏ ਕਉ ਮੂਆ ॥
Transliteration: jeevate kau jeevataa milai mooe kau mooaa |
English: The living mingle with the living, and the dead mingle with the dead.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak so saalaaheeai jin kaaran keea |2|
English: O Nanak, praise the One who created the creation. ||2||

[Ang 788 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਸੇ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: sach dhiaaein se sache gur sabad veechaaree |
English: Those who meditate on the True Lord are true; they contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: haumai maar man niramalaa har naam ur dhaaree |
English: They subdue their ego, purify their minds, and enshrine the Lord's Name within their hearts.

Gurbani: ਕੋਠੇ ਮੰਡਪ ਮਾੜੀਆ ਲਗਿ ਪਏ ਗਾਵਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kotthe manddap maarreea lag pe gaavaaree |
English: The fools are attached to their homes, mansions and balconies.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿੑ ਕੀਏ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਬਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jina kee tiseh na jaananee manamukh gubaaree |
English: The self-willed manmukhs are caught in darkness; they do not know the One who created them.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਹਿ ਸੋ ਬੁਝਸੀ ਸਚਿਆ ਕਿਆ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੀ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: jis bujhaaeihi so bujhasee sachiaa kiaa jant vichaaree |8|
English: He alone understands, whom the True Lord causes to understand; what can the helpless creatures do? ||8||

[Ang 788 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਤਉ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਕੰਤੁ ਮਨਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kaaman tau seegaar kar jaa pahilaan kant manaae |
English: O bride, decorate yourself, after you surrender and accept your Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਤੁ ਸੇਜੈ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਏਵੈ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: mat sejai kant na aavee evai birathaa jaae |
English: Otherwise, your Husband Lord will not come to your bed, and your ornaments will be useless.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਪਿਰ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਤਉ ਬਣਿਆ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: kaaman pir man maaniaa tau baniaa seegaar |
English: O bride, your decorations will adorn you, only when your Husband Lord's Mind is pleased.

Gurbani: ਕੀਆ ਤਉ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਸਹੁ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: keea tau paravaan hai jaa sahu dhare piaar |
English: Your ornaments will be acceptable and approved, only when your Husband Lord loves you.

Gurbani: ਭਉ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਤਬੋਲ ਰਸੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭਾਉ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhau seegaar tabol ras bhojan bhaau karee |
English: So make the Fear of God your ornaments, joy your betel nuts to chew, and love your food.

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਉਪੇ ਕੰਤ ਕਉ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਭੋਗੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tan man saupe kant kau tau naanak bhog karee |1|
English: Surrender your body and mind to your Husband Lord, and then, O Nanak, He will enjoy you. ||1||

[Ang 788 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਾਜਲ ਫੂਲ ਤੰਬੋਲ ਰਸੁ ਲੇ ਧਨ ਕੀਆ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: kaajal fool tanbol ras le dhan keea seegaar |
English: The wife takes flowers, and fragrance of betel, and decorates herself.

Gurbani: ਸੇਜੈ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਏਵੈ ਭਇਆ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sejai kant na aaeo evai bheaa vikaar |2|
English: But her Husband Lord does not come to her bed, and so these efforts are useless. ||2||

[Ang 788 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਧਨ ਪਿਰੁ ਏਹਿ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ ਬਹਨਿ ਇਕਠੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: dhan pir ehi na aakheean behan ikatthe hoe |
English: They are not said to be husband and wife, who merely sit together.

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਜੋਤਿ ਦੁਇ ਮੂਰਤੀ ਧਨ ਪਿਰੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ek jot due mooratee dhan pir kaheeai soe |3|
English: They alone are called husband and wife, who have one light in two bodies. ||3||

[Ang 788 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: bhai bin bhagat na hovee naam na lagai piaar |
English: Without the Fear of God, there is no devotional worship, and no love for the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਭਉ ਊਪਜੈ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਰੰਗੁ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: satigur miliai bhau aoopajai bhai bhaae rang savaar |
English: Meeting with the True Guru, the Fear of God wells up, and one is embellished with the Fear and the Love of God.

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: tan man rataa rang siau haumai trisanaa maar |
English: When the body and mind are imbued with the Lord's Love, egotism and desire are conquered and subdued.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਅਤਿ ਸੋਹਣਾ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: man tan niramal at sohanaa bhettiaa krisan muraar |
English: The mind and body become immaculately pure and very beautiful, when one meets the Lord, the Destroyer of ego.

Gurbani: ਭਉ ਭਾਉ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: bhau bhaau sabh tis daa so sach varatai sansaar |9|
English: Fear and love all belong to Him; He is the True Lord, permeating and pervading the Universe. ||9||

[Ang 788 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਵਾਹੁ ਖਸਮ ਤੂ ਵਾਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਿ ਰਚਨਾ ਹਮ ਕੀਏ ॥
Transliteration: vaahu khasam too vaahu jin rach rachanaa ham kee |
English: Waaho! Waaho! You are wonderful and great, O Lord and Master; You created the creation, and made us.

Gurbani: ਸਾਗਰ ਲਹਰਿ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਸਰ ਵੇਲਿ ਵਰਸ ਵਰਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: saagar lehar samund sar vel varas varaahu |
English: You made the waters, waves, oceans, pools, plants, clouds and mountains.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਖੜੋਵਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਿ ਆਪੀਣੈ ਆਪਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: aap kharroveh aap kar aapeenai aapaahu |
English: You Yourself stand in the midst of what You Yourself created.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਥਾਇ ਪਵੈ ਉਨਮਨਿ ਤਤੁ ਕਮਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh sevaa thaae pavai unaman tat kamaahu |
English: The selfless service of the Gurmukhs is approved; in celestial peace, they live the essence of reality.

Gurbani: ਮਸਕਤਿ ਲਹਹੁ ਮਜੂਰੀਆ ਮੰਗਿ ਮੰਗਿ ਖਸਮ ਦਰਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: masakat lahahu majooreea mang mang khasam daraahu |
English: They receive the wages of their labor, begging at the Door of their Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੁਰ ਦਰ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹ ਤਉ ਦਰਿ ਊਣਾ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋ ਸਚਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak pur dar veparavaah tau dar aoonaa naeh ko sachaa veparavaahu |1|
