English: O Nanak, the Court of the Lord is overflowing and carefree; O my True Carefree Lord, no one returns empty-handed from Your Court. ||1||

[Ang 788 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਉਜਲ ਮੋਤੀ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਰਤਨਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਜੁੜੰਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: aujal motee sohane ratanaa naal jurran |
English: The teeth are like brilliant, beautiful pearls, and the eyes are like sparkling jewels.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਜਰੁ ਵੈਰੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿ ਬੁਢੇ ਥੀਇ ਮਰੰਨਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tin jar vairee naanakaa ji budte thee maran |2|
English: Old age is their enemy, O Nanak; when they grow old, they waste away. ||2||

[Ang 789 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਉਪਿ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: har saalaahee sadaa sadaa tan man saup sareer |
English: Praise the Lord, forever and ever; dedicate your body and mind to Him.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚਾ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: gurasabadee sach paaeaa sachaa gahir ganbheer |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I have found the True, Profound and Unfathomable Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਹੀਰਾ ਹੀਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: man tan hiradai rav rahiaa har heeraa heer |
English: The Lord, the jewel of jewels, is permeating my mind, body and heart.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਇਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਵੈ ਨ ਫੀਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: janam maran kaa dukh geaa fir pavai na feer |
English: The pains of birth and death are gone, and I shall never again be consigned to the cycle of reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰੁ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: naanak naam salaeh too har gunee gaheer |10|
English: O Nanak, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the ocean of excellence. ||10||

[Ang 789 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਜਾਲਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਲਿਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: naanak ihu tan jaal jin jaliai naam visaariaa |
English: O Nanak, burn this body; this burnt body has forgotten the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਪਉਦੀ ਜਾਇ ਪਰਾਲਿ ਪਿਛੈ ਹਥੁ ਨ ਅੰਬੜੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਨਿਵੰਧੈ ਤਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: paudee jaae paraal pichhai hath na anbarrai tith nivandhai taal |1|
English: The dirt is piling up, and in the world hereafter, your hand shall not be able to reach down into this stagnant pond to clean it out. ||1||

[Ang 789 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨ ਕੇ ਕੰਮ ਫਿਟਿਆ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਆਵਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: naanak man ke kam fittiaa ganat na aavahee |
English: O Nanak, wicked are the uncountable actions of the mind.

Gurbani: ਕਿਤੀ ਲਹਾ ਸਹੰਮ ਜਾ ਬਖਸੇ ਤਾ ਧਕਾ ਨਹੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kitee lahaa saham jaa bakhase taa dhakaa nahee |2|
English: They bring terrible and painful retributions, but if the Lord forgives me, then I will be spared this punishment. ||2||

[Ang 789 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਅਮਰੁ ਚਲਾਇਓਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa amar chalaaeon kar sach furamaan |
English: True is the Command He sends forth, and True are the Orders He issues.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa nihachal rav rahiaa so purakh sujaan |
English: Forever unmoving and unchanging, permeating and pervading everywhere, He is the All-knowing Primal Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee seveeai sach sabad neesaan |
English: By Guru's Grace, serve Him, through the True Insignia of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਾ ਥਾਟੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਰੰਗੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: pooraa thaatt banaaeaa rang guramat maan |
English: That which He makes is perfect; through the Guru's Teachings, enjoy His Love.

Gurbani: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: agam agochar alakh hai guramukh har jaan |11|
English: He is inaccessible, unfathomable and unseen; as Gurmukh, know the Lord. ||11||

[Ang 789 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਦਰਾ ਮਾਲ ਕਾ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਧਰਿਆ ਆਣਿ ॥
Transliteration: naanak badaraa maal kaa bheetar dhariaa aan |
English: O Nanak, the bags of coins are brought in

Gurbani: ਖੋਟੇ ਖਰੇ ਪਰਖੀਅਨਿ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੈ ਦੀਬਾਣਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: khotte khare parakheean saahib kai deebaan |1|
English: and placed in the Court of our Lord and Master, and there, the genuine and the counterfeit are separated. ||1||

[Ang 789 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਵਣ ਚਲੇ ਤੀਰਥੀ ਮਨਿ ਖੋਟੈ ਤਨਿ ਚੋਰ ॥
Transliteration: naavan chale teerathee man khottai tan chor |
English: They go and bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, but their minds are still evil, and their bodies are thieves.

Gurbani: ਇਕੁ ਭਾਉ ਲਥੀ ਨਾਤਿਆ ਦੁਇ ਭਾ ਚੜੀਅਸੁ ਹੋਰ ॥
Transliteration: eik bhaau lathee naatiaa due bhaa charreeas hor |
English: Some of their filth is washed off by these baths, but they only accumulate twice as much.

Gurbani: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਧੋਤੀ ਤੂਮੜੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਿਸੁ ਨਿਕੋਰ ॥
Transliteration: baahar dhotee toomarree andar vis nikor |
English: Like a gourd, they may be washed off on the outside, but on the inside, they are still filled with poison.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਭਲੇ ਅਣਨਾਤਿਆ ਚੋਰ ਸਿ ਚੋਰਾ ਚੋਰ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saadh bhale ananaatiaa chor si choraa chor |2|
English: The holy man is blessed, even without such bathing, while a thief is a thief, no matter how much he bathes. ||2||

[Ang 789 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚਲਾਇਦਾ ਜਗੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aape hukam chalaaeidaa jag dhandhai laaeaa |
English: He Himself issues His Commands, and links the people of the world to their tasks.

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪਿ ਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: eik aape hee aap laaeian gur te sukh paaeaa |
English: He Himself joins some to Himself, and through the Guru, they find peace.

Gurbani: ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਾਵਦਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: deh dis ihu man dhaavadaa gur tthaak rahaaeaa |
English: The mind runs around in the ten directions; the Guru holds it still.

Gurbani: ਨਾਵੈ ਨੋ ਸਭ ਲੋਚਦੀ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: naavai no sabh lochadee guramatee paaeaa |
English: Everyone longs for the Name, but it is only found through the Guru's Teachings.

Gurbani: ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਕੀਐ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: dhur likhiaa mett na sakeeai jo har likh paaeaa |12|
English: Your pre-ordained destiny, written by the Lord in the very beginning, cannot be erased. ||12||

[Ang 789 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦੁਇ ਦੀਵੇ ਚਉਦਹ ਹਟਨਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: due deeve chaudah hattanaale |
English: The two lamps light the fourteen markets.

Gurbani: ਜੇਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਤੇ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jete jeea tete vanajaare |
English: There are just as many traders as there are living beings.

Gurbani: ਖੁਲੑੇ ਹਟ ਹੋਆ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: khulae hatt hoaa vaapaar |
English: The shops are open, and trading is going on;

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਸੋ ਚਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jo pahuchai so chalanahaar |
English: whoever comes there, is bound to depart.

Gurbani: ਧਰਮੁ ਦਲਾਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: dharam dalaal paae neesaan |
English: The Righteous Judge of Dharma is the broker, who gives his sign of approval.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak naam laahaa paravaan |
English: O Nanak, those who earn the profit of the Naam are accepted and approved.

Gurbani: ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ਵਜੀ ਵਾਧਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ghar aae vajee vaadhaaee |
English: And when they return home, they are greeted with cheers;

Gurbani: ਸਚ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਮਿਲੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sach naam kee milee vaddiaaee |1|
English: they obtain the glorious greatness of the True Name. ||1||

[Ang 789 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਾਤੀ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਕਾਲੀਆ ਸੁਪੇਦਾ ਸੇ ਵੰਨ ॥
Transliteration: raatee hovan kaaleea supedaa se van |
English: Even when the night is dark, whatever is white retains its white color.

Gurbani: ਦਿਹੁ ਬਗਾ ਤਪੈ ਘਣਾ ਕਾਲਿਆ ਕਾਲੇ ਵੰਨ ॥
Transliteration: dihu bagaa tapai ghanaa kaaliaa kaale van |
English: And even when the light of day is dazzlingly bright, whatever is black retains its black color.

Gurbani: ਅੰਧੇ ਅਕਲੀ ਬਾਹਰੇ ਮੂਰਖ ਅੰਧ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: andhe akalee baahare moorakh andh giaan |
English: The blind fools have no wisdom at all; their understanding is blind.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਬਾਹਰੇ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak nadaree baahare kabeh na paaveh maan |2|
English: O Nanak, without the Lord's Grace, they will never receive honor. ||2||

[Ang 789 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋਟੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਆਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa kott rachaaeaa har sachai aape |
English: The True Lord Himself created the body-fortress.

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਇਅਨੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: eik doojai bhaae khuaaeian haumai vich viaape |
English: Some are ruined through the love of duality, engrossed in egotism.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਦੁਲੰਭੁ ਸਾ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸੰਤਾਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: eihu maanas janam dulanbh saa manamukh santaape |
English: This human body is so difficult to obtain; the self-willed manmukhs suffer in pain.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋ ਬੁਝਸੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਥਾਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: jis aap bujhaae so bujhasee jis satigur thaape |
English: He alone understands, whom the Lord Himself causes to understand; he is blessed by the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਓਨੁ ਸਭ ਵਰਤੈ ਆਪੇ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: sabh jag khel rachaaeon sabh varatai aape |13|
English: He created the entire world for His play; He is pervading amongst all. ||13||

[Ang 790 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਚੋਰਾ ਜਾਰਾ ਰੰਡੀਆ ਕੁਟਣੀਆ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: choraa jaaraa randdeea kuttaneea deebaan |
English: Thieves, adulterers, prostitutes and pimps,

Gurbani: ਵੇਦੀਨਾ ਕੀ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਵੇਦੀਨਾ ਕਾ ਖਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: vedeenaa kee dosatee vedeenaa kaa khaan |
English: Make friendships with the unrighteous, and eat with the unrighteous.

Gurbani: ਸਿਫਤੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਸਦਾ ਵਸੈ ਸੈਤਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: sifatee saar na jaananee sadaa vasai saitaan |
English: They do not know the value of the Lord's Praises, and Satan is always with them.

Gurbani: ਗਦਹੁ ਚੰਦਨਿ ਖਉਲੀਐ ਭੀ ਸਾਹੂ ਸਿਉ ਪਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: gadahu chandan khauleeai bhee saahoo siau paan |
English: If a donkey is anointed with sandalwood paste, he still loves to roll in the dirt.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੂੜੈ ਕਤਿਐ ਕੂੜਾ ਤਣੀਐ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak koorrai katiai koorraa taneeai taan |
English: O Nanak, by spinning falsehood, a fabric of falsehood is woven.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜਾ ਕਪੜੁ ਕਛੀਐ ਕੂੜਾ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਮਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: koorraa kaparr kachheeai koorraa painan maan |1|
English: False is the cloth and its measurement, and false is pride in such a garment. ||1||

[Ang 790 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬਾਂਗਾ ਬੁਰਗੂ ਸਿੰਙੀਆ ਨਾਲੇ ਮਿਲੀ ਕਲਾਣ ॥
Transliteration: baangaa buragoo singeea naale milee kalaan |
English: The callers to prayer, the flute-players, the horn-blowers, and also the singers

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਦਾਤੇ ਇਕਿ ਮੰਗਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: eik daate ik mangate naam teraa paravaan |
English: - some are givers, and some are beggars; they become acceptable only through Your Name, Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਕੈ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਹਉ ਤਿਨਾ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak jinaee sun kai maniaa hau tinaa vittahu kurabaan |2|
English: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those who hear and accept the Name. ||2||

[Ang 790 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਹੈ ਕੂੜੋ ਹੋਇ ਗਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohu sabh koorr hai koorro hoe geaa |
English: Attachment to Maya is totally false, and false are those who go that way.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਝਗੜਾ ਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਝਗੜੈ ਜਗੁ ਮੁਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: haumai jhagarraa paaeon jhagarrai jag mueaa |
English: Through egotism, the world is caught in conflict and strife, and it dies.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਝਗੜੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਓਨੁ ਇਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh jhagarr chukaaeon iko rav rahiaa |
English: The Gurmukh is free of conflict and strife, and sees the One Lord, pervading everywhere.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabh aatam raam pachhaaniaa bhaujal tar geaa |
English: Recognizing that the Supreme Soul is everywhere, he crosses over the terrifying world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: jot samaanee jot vich har naam sameaa |14|
English: His light merges into the Light, and he is absorbed into the Lord's Name. ||14||

[Ang 790 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਦੇਹਿ ਮੈ ਤੂੰ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: satigur bheekhiaa dehi mai toon samrath daataar |
English: O True Guru, bless me with Your charity; You are the All-powerful Giver.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੀਐ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: haumai garab nivaareeai kaam krodh ahankaar |
English: May I subdue and quiet my egotism, pride, sexual desire, anger and self-conceit.

Gurbani: ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਪਰਜਾਲੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: lab lobh parajaaleeai naam milai aadhaar |
English: Burn away all my greed, and give me the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਵਤਨ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਮੈਲਾ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: ahinis navatan niramalaa mailaa kabahoon na hoe |
English: Day and night, keep me ever-fresh and new, spotless and pure; let me never be soiled by sin.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਨਦਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak ih bidh chhutteeai nadar teree sukh hoe |1|
English: O Nanak, in this way I am saved; by Your Grace, I have found peace. ||1||

[Ang 790 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਇਕੋ ਕੰਤੁ ਸਬਾਈਆ ਜਿਤੀ ਦਰਿ ਖੜੀਆਹ ॥
Transliteration: eiko kant sabaaeea jitee dar kharreeaah |
English: There is only the one Husband Lord, for all who stand at His Door.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੰਤੈ ਰਤੀਆ ਪੁਛਹਿ ਬਾਤੜੀਆਹ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak kantai rateea puchheh baatarreeaah |2|
English: O Nanak, they ask for news of their Husband Lord, from those who are imbued with His Love. ||2||

[Ang 790 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਭੇ ਕੰਤੈ ਰਤੀਆ ਮੈ ਦੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਕਿਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: sabhe kantai rateea mai dohaagan kit |
English: All are imbued with love for their Husband Lord; I am a discarded bride - what good am I?

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਤਨਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਏਤੜੇ ਖਸਮੁ ਨ ਫੇਰੇ ਚਿਤੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: mai tan avagan etarre khasam na fere chit |3|
English: My body is filled with so many faults; my Lord and Master does not even turn His thoughts to me. ||3||

[Ang 790 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਦੈ ਵਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: hau balihaaree tin kau sifat jinaa dai vaat |
English: I am a sacrifice to those who praise the Lord with their mouths.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਇਕ ਮੈ ਦੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਰਾਤਿ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: sabh raatee sohaaganee ik mai dohaagan raat |4|
English: All the nights are for the happy soul-brides; I am a discarded bride - if only I could have even one night with Him! ||4||

[Ang 790 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਦਰਿ ਮੰਗਤੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: dar mangat jaachai daan har deejai kripaa kar |
English: I am a beggar at Your Door, begging for charity; O Lord, please grant me Your Mercy, and give to me.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh lehu milaae jan paavai naam har |
English: As Gurmukh, unite me, your humble servant, with You, that I may receive Your Name.

Gurbani: ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਇ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਧਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: anahad sabad vajaae jotee jot dhar |
English: Then, the unstruck melody of the Shabad will vibrate and resound, and my light will blend with the Light.

Gurbani: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਜੈ ਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਹਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: hiradai har gun gaae jai jai sabad har |
English: Within my heart, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and celebrate the Word of the Lord's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: jag meh varatai aap har setee preet kar |15|
English: The Lord Himself is pervading and permeating the world; so fall in love with Him! ||15||

[Ang 790 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਕੰਤ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jinee na paaeo prem ras kant na paaeo saau |
English: Those who do not obtain the sublime essence, the love and delight of their Husband Lord,

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਞੇ ਘਰ ਕਾ ਪਾਹੁਣਾ ਜਿਉ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਉ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sunye ghar kaa paahunaa jiau aaeaa tiau jaau |1|
English: are like guests in a deserted house; they leave just as they have come, empty-handed. ||1||

[Ang 790 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਉ ਓਲਾਮੑੇ ਦਿਨੈ ਕੇ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਿਲਨਿੑ ਸਹੰਸ ॥
Transliteration: sau olaamae dinai ke raatee milana sahans |
English: He receives hundreds and thousands of reprimands, day and night;

Gurbani: ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਲਾਹਣੁ ਛਡਿ ਕੈ ਕਰੰਗੀ ਲਗਾ ਹੰਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: sifat salaahan chhadd kai karangee lagaa hans |
English: the swan-soul has renounced the Lord's Praises, and attached itself to a rotting carcass.

Gurbani: ਫਿਟੁ ਇਵੇਹਾ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਜਿਤੁ ਖਾਇ ਵਧਾਇਆ ਪੇਟੁ ॥
Transliteration: fitt ivehaa jeeviaa jit khaae vadhaaeaa pett |
English: Cursed is that life, in which one only eats to fill his belly.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਭੋ ਦੁਸਮਨੁ ਹੇਤੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak sache naam vin sabho dusaman het |2|
English: O Nanak, without the True Name, all one's friends turn to enemies. ||2||

[Ang 790 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਢਾਢੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: dtaadtee gun gaavai nit janam savaariaa |
English: The minstrel continually sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, to embellish his life.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਸਚਾ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh sev salaeh sachaa ur dhaariaa |
English: The Gurmukh serves and praises the True Lord, enshrining Him within his heart.

Gurbani: ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਹਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: ghar dar paavai mehal naam piaariaa |
English: He obtains his own home and mansion, by loving the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਉ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh paaeaa naam hau gur kau vaariaa |
English: As Gurmukh, I have obtained the Naam; I am a sacrifice to the Guru.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰਿਆ ॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: too aap savaareh aap sirajanahaariaa |16|
English: You Yourself embellish and adorn us, O Creator Lord. ||16||

[Ang 791 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦੀਵਾ ਬਲੈ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: deevaa balai andheraa jaae |
English: When the lamp is lit, the darkness is dispelled;

Gurbani: ਬੇਦ ਪਾਠ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਪਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bed paatth mat paapaa khaae |
English: reading the Vedas, sinful intellect is destroyed.

Gurbani: ਉਗਵੈ ਸੂਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ਚੰਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: augavai soor na jaapai chand |
English: When the sun rises, the moon is not visible.

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਗਿਆਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਮਿਟੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: jeh giaan pragaas agiaan mittant |
English: Wherever spiritual wisdom appears, ignorance is dispelled.

Gurbani: ਬੇਦ ਪਾਠ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: bed paatth sansaar kee kaar |
English: Reading the Vedas is the world's occupation;

Gurbani: ਪੜਿੑ ਪੜਿੑ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: parra parra panddit kareh beechaar |
English: the Pandits read them, study them and contemplate them.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਸਭ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰ ॥
Transliteration: bin boojhe sabh hoe khuaar |
English: Without understanding, all are ruined.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh utaras paar |1|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is carried across. ||1||

[Ang 791 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੈ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sabadai saad na aaeo naam na lago piaar |
English: Those who do not savor the Word of the Shabad, do not love the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਰਸਨਾ ਫਿਕਾ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: rasanaa fikaa bolanaa nit nit hoe khuaar |
English: They speak insipidly with their tongues, and are continually disgraced.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਇਐ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak peiai kirat kamaavanaa koe na mettanahaar |2|
English: O Nanak, they act according to the karma of their past actions, which no one can erase. ||2||

[Ang 791 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਜਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੋ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: ji prabh saalaahe aapanaa so sobhaa paae |
English: One who praises his God, receives honor.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: haumai vichahu door kar sach man vasaae |
English: He drives out egotism from within himself, and enshrines the True Name within his mind.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ ਸਚਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sach baanee gun ucharai sachaa sukh paae |
English: Through the True Word of the Guru's Bani, he chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and finds true peace.

Gurbani: ਮੇਲੁ ਭਇਆ ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: mel bheaa chiree vichhuniaa gur purakh milaae |
English: He is united with the Lord, after being separated for so long; the Guru, the Primal Being, unites him with the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਇਵ ਸੁਧੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: man mailaa iv sudh hai har naam dhiaae |17|
English: In this way, his filthy mind is cleansed and purified, and he meditates on the Name of the Lord. ||17||

[Ang 791 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੂਮਲ ਫੁਲ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਪਸਿ ਮਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa koomal ful gun naanak gupas maal |
English: With the fresh leaves of the body, and the flowers of virtue, Nanak has weaved his garland.

Gurbani: ਏਨੀ ਫੁਲੀ ਰਉ ਕਰੇ ਅਵਰ ਕਿ ਚੁਣੀਅਹਿ ਡਾਲ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: enee fulee rau kare avar ki chuneeeh ddaal |1|
English: The Lord is pleased with such garlands, so why pick any other flowers? ||1||

[Ang 791 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 2 |
English: Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨਾ ਬਸੰਤੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨੑ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਕੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak tinaa basant hai jina ghar vasiaa kant |
English: O Nanak, it is the spring season for those, within whose homes their Husband Lord abides.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਕੰਤ ਦਿਸਾਪੁਰੀ ਸੇ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਜਲੰਤ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jin ke kant disaapuree se ahinis fireh jalant |2|
English: But those, whose Husband Lord is far away in distant lands, continue burning, day and night. ||2||

[Ang 791 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: aape bakhase deaa kar gur satigur bachanee |
English: The Merciful Lord Himself forgives those who dwell upon the Word of the Guru, the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਚੈ ਰਚਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: anadin sevee gun ravaa man sachai rachanee |
English: Night and day, I serve the True Lord, and chant His Glorious Praises; my mind merges into Him.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਲਖਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: prabh meraa beant hai ant kinai na lakhanee |
English: My God is infinite; no one knows His limit.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਗਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਤ ਜਪਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: satigur charanee lagiaa har naam nit japanee |
English: Grasping hold of the feet of the True Guru, meditate continually on the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਇਛੈ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ ਸਭਿ ਘਰੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਚਨੀ ॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: jo ichhai so fal paaeisee sabh gharai vich jachanee |18|
English: Thus you shall obtain the fruits of your desires, and all wishes shall be fulfilled within your home. ||18||

[Ang 791 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪਹਿਲ ਬਸੰਤੈ ਆਗਮਨਿ ਪਹਿਲਾ ਮਉਲਿਓ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: pahil basantai aagaman pahilaa maulio soe |
English: Spring brings forth the first blossoms, but the Lord blossoms earlier still.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਮਉਲਿਐ ਸਭ ਮਉਲੀਐ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਮਉਲਿਹੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jit mauliai sabh mauleeai tiseh na maulihu koe |1|
English: By His blossoming, everything blossoms; no one else causes Him to blossom forth. ||1||

[Ang 791 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 2 |
English: Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪਹਿਲ ਬਸੰਤੈ ਆਗਮਨਿ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: pahil basantai aagaman tis kaa karahu beechaar |
English: He blossoms forth even earlier than the spring; reflect upon Him.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿ ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak so saalaaheeai ji sabhasai de aadhaar |2|
English: O Nanak, praise the One who gives Support to all. ||2||

[Ang 791 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 2 |
English: Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿਐ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਨਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: miliai miliaa naa milai milai miliaa je hoe |
English: By uniting, the united one is not united; he unites, only if he is united.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰ ਆਤਮੈ ਜੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: antar aatamai jo milai miliaa kaheeai soe |3|
English: But if he unites deep within his soul, then he is said to be united. ||3||

[Ang 791 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam salaaheeai sach kaar kamaavai |
English: Praise the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and practice truthful deeds.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਗਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: doojee kaarai lagiaa fir jonee paavai |
English: Attached to other deeds, one is consigned to wander in reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਮੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: naam ratiaa naam paaeeai naame gun gaavai |
English: Attuned to the Name, one obtains the Name, and through the Name, sings the Lord's Praises.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad salaaheeai har naam samaavai |
English: Praising the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he merges in the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਫਲ ਹੈ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਫਲ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: satigur sevaa safal hai seviai fal paavai |19|
English: Service to the True Guru is fruitful and rewarding; serving Him, the fruits are obtained. ||19||

[Ang 791 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 2 |
English: Salok, Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਕੋਇ ਮੰਞੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਇਕੁ ਤੂ ॥
Transliteration: kis hee koee koe many nimaanee ik too |
English: Some people have others, but I am forlorn and dishonored; I have only You, Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਨ ਮਰੀਜੈ ਰੋਇ ਜਾ ਲਗੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਹੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kiau na mareejai roe jaa lag chit na aavahee |1|
English: I might as well just die crying, if You will not come into my mind. ||1||

[Ang 792 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 2 |
English: Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਾਂ ਸੁਖੁ ਤਾ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਵਿਓ ਦੁਖਿ ਭੀ ਸੰਮੑਾਲਿਓਇ ॥
Transliteration: jaan sukh taa sahu raavio dukh bhee samaalioe |
English: When there is peace and pleasure, that is the time to remember your Husband Lord. In times of suffering and pain, remember Him then as well.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਿਆਣੀਏ ਇਉ ਕੰਤ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak kahai siaanee iau kant milaavaa hoe |2|
English: Says Nanak, O wise bride, this is the way to meet your Husband Lord. ||2||

[Ang 792 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਕਿਰਮ ਜੰਤੁ ਵਡੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: hau kiaa saalaahee kiram jant vaddee teree vaddiaaee |
English: I am a worm - how can I praise You, O Lord; Your glorious greatness is so great!

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਅਗਮ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਆਪਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: too agam deaal agam hai aap laihi milaaee |
English: You are inaccessible, merciful and unapproachable; You Yourself unite us with Yourself.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੇਲੀ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਤੂ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: mai tujh bin belee ko nahee too ant sakhaaee |
English: I have no other friend except You; in the end, You alone will be my Companion and Support.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਤਿਨ ਲੈਹਿ ਛਡਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jo teree saranaagatee tin laihi chhaddaaee |
English: You save those who enter Your Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਈ ॥੨੦॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak veparavaahu hai tis til na tamaaee |20|1|
English: O Nanak, He is care-free; He has no greed at all. ||20||1||

[Ang 792 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਤਥਾ ਸਭਨਾ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ॥ ਕਬੀਰ ਕੇ ॥
Transliteration: raag soohee baanee sree kabeer jeeo tathaa sabhanaa bhagataa kee | kabeer ke |
English: Raag Soohee, The Word Of Kabeer Jee, And Other Devotees. Of Kabeer

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਅਵਤਰਿ ਆਇ ਕਹਾ ਤੁਮ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: avatar aae kahaa tum keenaa |
English: Since your birth, what have you done?

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਲੀਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: raam ko naam na kabahoo leenaa |1|
English: You have never even chanted the Name of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨ ਜਪਹੁ ਕਵਨ ਮਤਿ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: raam na japahu kavan mat laage |
English: You have not meditated on the Lord; what thoughts are you attached to?

Gurbani: ਮਰਿ ਜਇਬੇ ਕਉ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਅਭਾਗੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mar jeibe kau kiaa karahu abhaage |1| rahaau |
English: What preparations are you making for your death, O unfortunate one? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਜੀਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: dukh sukh kar kai kuttanb jeevaaeaa |
English: Through pain and pleasure, you have taken care of your family.

Gurbani: ਮਰਤੀ ਬਾਰ ਇਕਸਰ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: maratee baar ikasar dukh paaeaa |2|
English: But at the time of death, you shall have to endure the agony all alone. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕੰਠ ਗਹਨ ਤਬ ਕਰਨ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kantth gehan tab karan pukaaraa |
English: When you are seized by the neck, then you shall cry out.

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਆਗੇ ਤੇ ਨ ਸੰਮੑਾਰਾ ॥੩॥੧॥
Transliteration: keh kabeer aage te na samaaraa |3|1|
English: Says Kabeer, why didn't you remember the Lord before this? ||3||1||

[Ang 792 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: soohee kabeer jee |
English: Soohee, Kabeer Jee:

Gurbani: ਥਰਹਰ ਕੰਪੈ ਬਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: tharahar kanpai baalaa jeeo |
English: My innocent soul trembles and shakes.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਜਾਨਉ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਸੀ ਪੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naa jaanau kiaa karasee peeo |1|
English: I do not know how my Husband Lord will deal with me. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰੈਨਿ ਗਈ ਮਤ ਦਿਨੁ ਭੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: rain gee mat din bhee jaae |
English: The night of my youth has passed away; will the day of old age also pass away?

Gurbani: ਭਵਰ ਗਏ ਬਗ ਬੈਠੇ ਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhavar ge bag baitthe aae |1| rahaau |
English: My dark hairs, like bumble bees, have gone away, and grey hairs, like cranes, have settled upon my head. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਾਚੈ ਕਰਵੈ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਪਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: kaachai karavai rahai na paanee |
English: Water does not remain in the unbaked clay pot;

Gurbani: ਹੰਸੁ ਚਲਿਆ ਕਾਇਆ ਕੁਮਲਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: hans chaliaa kaaeaa kumalaanee |2|
English: when the soul-swan departs, the body withers away. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕੁਆਰ ਕੰਨਿਆ ਜੈਸੇ ਕਰਤ ਸੀਗਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kuaar kaniaa jaise karat seegaaraa |
English: I decorate myself like a young virgin;

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਨੈ ਬਾਝੁ ਭਤਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kiau raleea maanai baajh bhataaraa |3|
English: but how can I enjoy pleasures, without my Husband Lord? ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਾਗ ਉਡਾਵਤ ਭੁਜਾ ਪਿਰਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: kaag uddaavat bhujaa piraanee |
English: My arm is tired, driving away the crows.

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਇਹ ਕਥਾ ਸਿਰਾਨੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: keh kabeer ih kathaa siraanee |4|2|
English: Says Kabeer, this is the way the story of my life ends. ||4||2||

[Ang 792 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: soohee kabeer jeeo |
English: Soohee, Kabeer Jee:

Gurbani: ਅਮਲੁ ਸਿਰਾਨੋ ਲੇਖਾ ਦੇਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: amal siraano lekhaa denaa |
English: Your time of service is at its end, and you will have to give your account.

Gurbani: ਆਏ ਕਠਿਨ ਦੂਤ ਜਮ ਲੇਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: aae katthin doot jam lenaa |
English: The hard-hearted Messenger of Death has come to take you away.

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਤੈ ਖਟਿਆ ਕਹਾ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa tai khattiaa kahaa gavaaeaa |
English: What have you earned, and what have you lost?

Gurbani: ਚਲਹੁ ਸਿਤਾਬ ਦੀਬਾਨਿ ਬੁਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: chalahu sitaab deebaan bulaaeaa |1|
English: Come immediately! You are summoned to His Court! ||1||

Gurbani: ਚਲੁ ਦਰਹਾਲੁ ਦੀਵਾਨਿ ਬੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: chal darahaal deevaan bulaaeaa |
English: Get going! Come just as you are! You have been summoned to His Court.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਨੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਕਾ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har furamaan daragah kaa aaeaa |1| rahaau |
English: The Order has come from the Court of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਰਉ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਗਾਵ ਕਿਛੁ ਬਾਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: krau aradaas gaav kichh baakee |
English: I pray to the Messenger of Death: please, I still have some outstanding debts to collect in the village.

Gurbani: ਲੇਉ ਨਿਬੇਰਿ ਆਜੁ ਕੀ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: leo niber aaj kee raatee |
English: I will collect them tonight;

Gurbani: ਕਿਛੁ ਭੀ ਖਰਚੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ਸਾਰਉ ॥
Transliteration: kichh bhee kharach tumaaraa saarau |
English: I will also pay you something for your expenses,

Gurbani: ਸੁਬਹ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਸਰਾਇ ਗੁਜਾਰਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: subah nivaaj saraae gujaarau |2|
English: and I will recite my morning prayers on the way. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang jaa kau har rang laagaa |
English: Blessed, blessed is the most fortunate servant of the Lord,

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਭਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan so jan purakh sabhaagaa |
English: Who is imbued with the Lord's Love, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਜਨ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: eet aoot jan sadaa suhele |
English: Here and there, the humble servants of the Lord are always happy.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜੀਤਿ ਅਮੋਲੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: janam padaarath jeet amole |3|
English: They win the priceless treasure of this human life. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਾਗਤੁ ਸੋਇਆ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jaagat soeaa janam gavaaeaa |
English: When he is awake, he is sleeping, and so he loses this life.

Gurbani: ਮਾਲੁ ਧਨੁ ਜੋਰਿਆ ਭਇਆ ਪਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: maal dhan joriaa bheaa paraaeaa |
English: The property and wealth he has accumulated passes on to someone else.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਤੇਈ ਨਰ ਭੂਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer teee nar bhoole |
English: Says Kabeer, those people are deluded,

Gurbani: ਖਸਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਮਾਟੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਰੂਲੇ ॥੪॥੩॥
Transliteration: khasam bisaar maattee sang roole |4|3|
English: who forget their Lord and Master, and roll in the dust. ||4||3||

[Ang 793 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਲਲਿਤ ॥
Transliteration: soohee kabeer jeeo lalit |
English: Soohee, Kabeer Jee, Lallit:

Gurbani: ਥਾਕੇ ਨੈਨ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸੁਨਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਥਾਕੀ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਕਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: thaake nain sravan sun thaake thaakee sundar kaaeaa |
English: My eyes are exhausted, and my ears are tired of hearing; my beautiful body is exhausted.

Gurbani: ਜਰਾ ਹਾਕ ਦੀ ਸਭ ਮਤਿ ਥਾਕੀ ਏਕ ਨ ਥਾਕਸਿ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jaraa haak dee sabh mat thaakee ek na thaakas maaeaa |1|
English: Driven forward by old age, all my senses are exhausted; only my attachment to Maya is not exhausted. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਾਵਰੇ ਤੈ ਗਿਆਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: baavare tai giaan beechaar na paaeaa |
English: O mad man, you have not obtained spiritual wisdom and meditation.

Gurbani: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: birathaa janam gavaaeaa |1| rahaau |
English: You have wasted this human life, and lost. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਤਿਸੈ ਸਰੇਵਹੁ ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਘਟ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: tab lag praanee tisai sarevahu jab lag ghatt meh saasaa |
English: O mortal, serve the Lord, as long as the breath of life remains in the body.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਘਟੁ ਜਾਇ ਤ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਜਾਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: je ghatt jaae ta bhaau na jaasee har ke charan nivaasaa |2|
English: And even when your body dies, your love for the Lord shall not die; you shall dwell at the Feet of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਸਬਦੁ ਬਸਾਵੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚੂਕੈ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: jis kau sabad basaavai antar chookai tiseh piaasaa |
English: When the Word of the Shabad abides deep within, thirst and desire are quenched.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਚਉਪੜਿ ਖੇਲੈ ਮਨੁ ਜਿਣਿ ਢਾਲੇ ਪਾਸਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: hukamai boojhai chauparr khelai man jin dtaale paasaa |3|
English: When one understands the Hukam of the Lord's Command, he plays the game of chess with the Lord; throwing the dice, he conquers his own mind. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਜਾਨਿ ਭਜਹਿ ਅਬਿਗਤ ਕਉ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਨਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo jan jaan bhajeh abigat kau tin kaa kachhoo na naasaa |
English: Those humble beings, who know the Imperishable Lord and meditate on Him, are not destroyed at all.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਹਾਰਹਿ ਢਾਲਿ ਜੁ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਪਾਸਾ ॥੪॥੪॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer te jan kabahu na haareh dtaal ju jaaneh paasaa |4|4|
English: Says Kabeer, those humble beings who know how to throw these dice, never lose the game of life. ||4||4||

[Ang 793 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਲਲਿਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: soohee lalit kabeer jeeo |
English: Soohee, Lalit, Kabeer Jee:

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਕੋਟੁ ਪੰਚ ਸਿਕਦਾਰਾ ਪੰਚੇ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਹਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: ek kott panch sikadaaraa panche maageh haalaa |
English: In the one fortress of the body, there are five rulers, and all five demand payment of taxes.

Gurbani: ਜਿਮੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੈ ਕਿਸੀ ਕੀ ਬੋਈ ਐਸਾ ਦੇਨੁ ਦੁਖਾਲਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jimee naahee mai kisee kee boee aisaa den dukhaalaa |1|
English: I have not farmed anyone's land, so such payment is difficult for me to pay. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਗਾ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਨੀਤਿ ਡਸੈ ਪਟਵਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: har ke logaa mo kau neet ddasai pattavaaree |
English: O people of the Lord, the tax-collector is constantly torturing me!

Gurbani: ਊਪਰਿ ਭੁਜਾ ਕਰਿ ਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਹਉ ਲੀਆ ਉਬਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aoopar bhujaa kar mai gur peh pukaariaa tin hau leea ubaaree |1| rahaau |
English: Raising my arms up, I complained to my Guru, and He has saved me. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਉ ਡਾਡੀ ਦਸ ਮੁੰਸਫ ਧਾਵਹਿ ਰਈਅਤਿ ਬਸਨ ਨ ਦੇਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: nau ddaaddee das munsaf dhaaveh reeat basan na dehee |
English: The nine tax-assessors and the ten magistrates go out; they do not allow their subjects to live in peace.

Gurbani: ਡੋਰੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਾਪਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਸਟਾਲਾ ਲੇਹੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ddoree pooree maapeh naahee bahu bisattaalaa lehee |2|
English: They do not measure with a full tape, and they take huge amounts in bribes. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬਹਤਰਿ ਘਰ ਇਕੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਮਾਇਆ ਉਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਿਖਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: bahatar ghar ik purakh samaaeaa un deea naam likhaaee |
English: The One Lord is contained in the seventy-two chambers of the body, and He has written off my account.

Gurbani: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕਾ ਦਫਤਰੁ ਸੋਧਿਆ ਬਾਕੀ ਰਿਜਮ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: dharam raae kaa dafatar sodhiaa baakee rijam na kaaee |3|
English: The records of the Righteous Judge of Dharma have been searched, and I owe absolutely nothing. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਤਿ ਕੋਈ ਨਿੰਦਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਰਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਏਕੋੁ ॥
Transliteration: santaa kau mat koee nindahu sant raam hai ekuo |
English: Let no one slander the Saints, because the Saints and the Lord are as one.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਮੈ ਸੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ਬਿਬੇਕੋੁ ॥੪॥੫॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer mai so gur paaeaa jaa kaa naau bibekuo |4|5|
English: Says Kabeer, I have found that Guru, whose Name is Clear Understanding. ||4||5||

[Ang 793 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Bhagat Ravidas Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: raag soohee baanee sree ravidaas jeeo kee |
English: Raag Soohee, The Word Of Sree Ravi Daas Jee:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸਹ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: seh kee saar suhaagan jaanai |
English: The happy soul-bride knows the worth of her Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਸੁਖ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: taj abhimaan sukh raleea maanai |
English: Renouncing pride, she enjoys peace and pleasure.

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਨ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: tan man dee na antar raakhai |
English: She surrenders her body and mind to Him, and does not remain separate from Him.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਨ ਸੁਨੈ ਅਭਾਖੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: avaraa dekh na sunai abhaakhai |1|
English: She does not see or hear, or speak to another. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਕਤ ਜਾਨੈ ਪੀਰ ਪਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: so kat jaanai peer paraaee |
English: How can anyone know the pain of another,

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਦਰਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai antar darad na paaee |1| rahaau |
English: if there is no compassion and sympathy within? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦੁਖੀ ਦੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਦੁਇ ਪਖ ਹੀਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: dukhee duhaagan due pakh heenee |
English: The discarded bride is miserable, and loses both worlds;

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਹ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਕੀਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: jin naah nirantar bhagat na keenee |
English: she does not worship her Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਪੁਰ ਸਲਾਤ ਕਾ ਪੰਥੁ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: pur salaat kaa panth duhelaa |
English: The bridge over the fire of hell is difficult and treacherous.

Gurbani: ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਸਾਥੀ ਗਵਨੁ ਇਕੇਲਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sang na saathee gavan ikelaa |2|
English: No one will accompany you there; you will have to go all alone. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦੁਖੀਆ ਦਰਦਵੰਦੁ ਦਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: dukheea daradavand dar aaeaa |
English: Suffering in pain, I have come to Your Door, O Compassionate Lord.

Gurbani: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪਿਆਸ ਜਬਾਬੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bahut piaas jabaab na paaeaa |
English: I am so thirsty for You, but You do not answer me.

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਸਰਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: keh ravidaas saran prabh teree |
English: Says Ravi Daas, I seek Your Sanctuary, God;

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਕਰੁ ਗਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ॥੩॥੧॥
Transliteration: jiau jaanahu tiau kar gat meree |3|1|
English: as You know me, so will You save me. ||3||1||

[Ang 793 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Bhagat Ravidas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: soohee |
English: Soohee:

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਦਿਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਸੋ ਦਿਨ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jo din aaveh so din jaahee |
English: That day which comes, that day shall go.

Gurbani: ਕਰਨਾ ਕੂਚੁ ਰਹਨੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: karanaa kooch rehan thir naahee |
English: You must march on; nothing remains stable.

Gurbani: ਸੰਗੁ ਚਲਤ ਹੈ ਹਮ ਭੀ ਚਲਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: sang chalat hai ham bhee chalanaa |
English: Our companions are leaving, and we must leave as well.

Gurbani: ਦੂਰਿ ਗਵਨੁ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਮਰਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: door gavan sir aoopar maranaa |1|
English: We must go far away. Death is hovering over our heads. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਤੂ ਸੋਇਆ ਜਾਗੁ ਇਆਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa too soeaa jaag eaanaa |
English: Why are you asleep? Wake up, you ignorant fool!

Gurbani: ਤੈ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਜਗਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tai jeevan jag sach kar jaanaa |1| rahaau |
English: You believe that your life in the world is true. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਜੀਉ ਦੀਆ ਸੁ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਅੰਬਰਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jin jeeo deea su rijak anbaraavai |
English: The One who gave you life shall also provide you with nourishment.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਹਾਟੁ ਚਲਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: sabh ghatt bheetar haatt chalaavai |
English: In each and every heart, He runs His shop.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਬੰਦਿਗੀ ਛਾਡਿ ਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kar bandigee chhaadd mai meraa |
English: Meditate on the Lord, and renounce your egotism and self-conceit.

Gurbani: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਰਿ ਸਵੇਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: hiradai naam samaar saveraa |2|
English: Within your heart, contemplate the Naam, the Name of the Lord, sometime. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਨਮੁ ਸਿਰਾਨੋ ਪੰਥੁ ਨ ਸਵਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: janam siraano panth na savaaraa |
English: Your life has passed away, but you have not arranged your path.

Gurbani: ਸਾਂਝ ਪਰੀ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: saanjh paree deh dis andhiaaraa |
English: Evening has set in, and soon there will be darkness on all sides.

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਨਿਦਾਨਿ ਦਿਵਾਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: keh ravidaas nidaan divaane |
English: Says Ravi Daas, O ignorant mad-man,

Gurbani: ਚੇਤਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਫਨ ਖਾਨੇ ॥੩॥੨॥
Transliteration: chetas naahee duneea fan khaane |3|2|
English: don't you realize, that this world is the house of death?! ||3||2||

[Ang 794 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Bhagat Ravidas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: soohee |
English: Soohee:

Gurbani: ਊਚੇ ਮੰਦਰ ਸਾਲ ਰਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aooche mandar saal rasoee |
English: You may have lofty mansions, halls and kitchens.

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਘਰੀ ਫੁਨਿ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ek gharee fun rehan na hoee |1|
English: But you cannot stay in them, even for an instant, after death. ||1||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਐਸਾ ਜੈਸੇ ਘਾਸ ਕੀ ਟਾਟੀ ॥
Transliteration: eihu tan aisaa jaise ghaas kee ttaattee |
English: This body is like a house of straw.

Gurbani: ਜਲਿ ਗਇਓ ਘਾਸੁ ਰਲਿ ਗਇਓ ਮਾਟੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jal geo ghaas ral geo maattee |1| rahaau |
English: When it is burnt, it mixes with dust. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਭਾਈ ਬੰਧ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਹੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: bhaaee bandh kuttanb saheraa |
English: Even relatives, family and friends begin to say,

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਭੀ ਲਾਗੇ ਕਾਢੁ ਸਵੇਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: oe bhee laage kaadt saveraa |2|
English: "Take his body out, immediately!" ||2||

Gurbani: ਘਰ ਕੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਉਰਹਿ ਤਨ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: ghar kee naar ureh tan laagee |
English: And the wife of his house, who was so attached to his body and heart,

Gurbani: ਉਹ ਤਉ ਭੂਤੁ ਭੂਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਗੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: auh tau bhoot bhoot kar bhaagee |3|
English: runs away, crying out, "Ghost! Ghost!" ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਸਭੈ ਜਗੁ ਲੂਟਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: keh ravidaas sabhai jag loottiaa |
English: Says Ravi Daas, the whole world has been plundered,

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਤਉ ਏਕ ਰਾਮੁ ਕਹਿ ਛੂਟਿਆ ॥੪॥੩॥
Transliteration: ham tau ek raam keh chhoottiaa |4|3|
English: but I have escaped, chanting the Name of the One Lord. ||4||3||

[Ang 794 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Sheikh Farid Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: Raag Soohee, The Word Of Shaykh Fareed Jee:

Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: raag soohee baanee sekh fareed jee kee |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਤਪਿ ਤਪਿ ਲੁਹਿ ਲੁਹਿ ਹਾਥ ਮਰੋਰਉ ॥
Transliteration: tap tap luhi luhi haath marorau |
English: Burning and burning, writhing in pain, I wring my hands.

Gurbani: ਬਾਵਲਿ ਹੋਈ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਲੋਰਉ ॥
Transliteration: baaval hoee so sahu lorau |
English: I have gone insane, seeking my Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਤੈ ਸਹਿ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਕੀਆ ਰੋਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: tai seh man meh keea ros |
English: O my Husband Lord, You are angry with me in Your Mind.

Gurbani: ਮੁਝੁ ਅਵਗਨ ਸਹ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੋਸੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mujh avagan seh naahee dos |1|
English: The fault is with me, and not with my Husband Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੈ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੀ ਮੈ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: tai saahib kee mai saar na jaanee |
English: O my Lord and Master, I do not know Your excellence and worth.

Gurbani: ਜੋਬਨੁ ਖੋਇ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: joban khoe paachhai pachhutaanee |1| rahaau |
English: Having wasted my youth, now I come to regret and repent. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਾਲੀ ਕੋਇਲ ਤੂ ਕਿਤ ਗੁਨ ਕਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: kaalee koeil too kit gun kaalee |
English: O black bird, what qualities have made you black?

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕੇ ਹਉ ਬਿਰਹੈ ਜਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: apane preetam ke hau birahai jaalee |
English: "I have been burnt by separation from my Beloved."

Gurbani: ਪਿਰਹਿ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਕਤਹਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: pireh bihoon kateh sukh paae |
English: Without her Husband Lord, how can the soul-bride ever find peace?

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jaa hoe kripaal taa prabhoo milaae |2|
English: When He becomes merciful, then God unites us with Himself. ||2||

Gurbani: ਵਿਧਣ ਖੂਹੀ ਮੁੰਧ ਇਕੇਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: vidhan khoohee mundh ikelee |
English: The lonely soul-bride suffers in the pit of the world.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਸਾਥੀ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਬੇਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: naa ko saathee naa ko belee |
English: She has no companions, and no friends.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh saadhasang melee |
English: In His Mercy, God has united me with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਅਲਹੁ ਬੇਲੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jaa fir dekhaa taa meraa alahu belee |3|
English: And when I look again, then I find God as my Helper. ||3||

Gurbani: ਵਾਟ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਖਰੀ ਉਡੀਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: vaatt hamaaree kharee uddeenee |
English: The path upon which I must walk is very depressing.

Gurbani: ਖੰਨਿਅਹੁ ਤਿਖੀ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪਿਈਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: khaniahu tikhee bahut pieenee |
English: It is sharper than a two-edged sword, and very narrow.

Gurbani: ਉਸੁ ਊਪਰਿ ਹੈ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aus aoopar hai maarag meraa |
English: That is where my path lies.

Gurbani: ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦਾ ਪੰਥੁ ਸਮੑਾਰਿ ਸਵੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: sekh fareedaa panth samaar saveraa |4|1|
English: O Shaykh Fareed, think of that path early on. ||4||1||

[Ang 794 | Raag: Raag Soohee | Author: Sheikh Farid Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੂਹੀ ਲਲਿਤ ॥
Transliteration: soohee lalit |
English: Soohee, Lalit:

Gurbani: ਬੇੜਾ ਬੰਧਿ ਨ ਸਕਿਓ ਬੰਧਨ ਕੀ ਵੇਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: berraa bandh na sakio bandhan kee velaa |
English: You were not able to make yourself a raft when you should have.

Gurbani: ਭਰਿ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਜਬ ਊਛਲੈ ਤਬ ਤਰਣੁ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bhar saravar jab aoochhalai tab taran duhelaa |1|
English: When the ocean is churning and over-flowing, then it is very difficult to cross over it. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਥੁ ਨ ਲਾਇ ਕਸੁੰਭੜੈ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਸੀ ਢੋਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hath na laae kasunbharrai jal jaasee dtolaa |1| rahaau |
English: Do not touch the safflower with your hands; its color will fade away, my dear. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਇਕ ਆਪੀਨੑੈ ਪਤਲੀ ਸਹ ਕੇਰੇ ਬੋਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: eik aapeenai patalee seh kere bolaa |
English: First, the bride herself is weak, and then, her Husband Lord's Order is hard to bear.

Gurbani: ਦੁਧਾ ਥਣੀ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਲਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: dudhaa thanee na aavee fir hoe na melaa |2|
English: Milk does not return to the breast; it will not be collected again. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਫਰੀਦੁ ਸਹੇਲੀਹੋ ਸਹੁ ਅਲਾਏਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: kahai fareed saheleeho sahu alaaesee |
English: Says Fareed, O my companions, when our Husband Lord calls,

Gurbani: ਹੰਸੁ ਚਲਸੀ ਡੁੰਮਣਾ ਅਹਿ ਤਨੁ ਢੇਰੀ ਥੀਸੀ ॥੩॥੨॥
Transliteration: hans chalasee ddunmanaa eh tan dteree theesee |3|2|
English: the soul departs, sad at heart, and this body returns to dust. ||3||2||

[Ang 795 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirbhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibhan gur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raag bilaaval mahalaa 1 chaupade ghar 1 |
English: Raag Bilaaval, First Mehl, Chau-Padhay, First House:

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਸੁਲਤਾਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਹਉ ਮੀਆ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਵਨ ਵਡਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: too sulataan kahaa hau meea teree kavan vaddaaee |
English: You are the Emperor, and I call You a chief - how does this add to Your greatness?

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੁ ਕਹਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jo too dehi su kahaa suaamee mai moorakh kehan na jaaee |1|
English: As You permit me, I praise You, O Lord and Master; I am ignorant, and I cannot chant Your Praises. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਦੇਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: tere gun gaavaa dehi bujhaaee |
English: Please bless me with such understanding, that I may sing Your Glorious Praises.

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੇ ਸਚ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਉ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaise sach meh rhau rajaaee |1| rahaau |
English: May I dwell in Truth, according to Your Will. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਭ ਅਸਨਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jo kichh hoaa sabh kichh tujh te teree sabh asanaaee |
English: Whatever has happened, has all come from You. You are All-knowing.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਮੈ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਕਿਆ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: teraa ant na jaanaa mere saahib mai andhule kiaa chaturaaee |2|
English: Your limits cannot be known, O my Lord and Master; I am blind - what wisdom do I have? ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਹਉ ਕਥੀ ਕਥੇ ਕਥਿ ਦੇਖਾ ਮੈ ਅਕਥੁ ਨ ਕਥਨਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa hau kathee kathe kath dekhaa mai akath na kathanaa jaaee |
English: What should I say? While talking, I talk of seeing, but I cannot describe the indescribable.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਆਖਾ ਤਿਲੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai soee aakhaa til teree vaddiaaee |3|
English: As it pleases Your Will, I speak; it is just the tiniest bit of Your greatness. ||3||

Gurbani: ਏਤੇ ਕੂਕਰ ਹਉ ਬੇਗਾਨਾ ਭਉਕਾ ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਤਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ete kookar hau begaanaa bhaukaa is tan taaee |
English: Among so many dogs, I am an outcast; I bark for my body's belly.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਹੀਣੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜੇ ਹੋਇਗਾ ਤਾ ਖਸਮੈ ਨਾਉ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: bhagat heen naanak je hoeigaa taa khasamai naau na jaaee |4|1|
English: Without devotional worship, O Nanak, even so, still, my Master's Name does not leave me. ||4||1||

[Ang 795 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 1 |
English: Bilaawal, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਤਨੁ ਵੇਸ ਕਲੰਦਰੁ ਘਟ ਹੀ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: man mandar tan ves kalandar ghatt hee teerath naavaa |
English: My mind is the temple, and my body is the simple cloth of the humble seeker; deep within my heart, I bathe at the sacred shrine.

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਿ ਬਸਤੁ ਹੈ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ek sabad merai praan basat hai baahurr janam na aavaa |1|
English: The One Word of the Shabad abides within my mind; I shall not come to be born again. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੇਤੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: man bedhiaa deaal setee meree maaee |
English: My mind is pierced through by the Merciful Lord, O my mother!

Gurbani: ਕਉਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਪੀਰ ਪਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kaun jaanai peer paraaee |
English: Who can know the pain of another?

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਨਾਹੀ ਚਿੰਤ ਪਰਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ham naahee chint paraaee |1| rahaau |
English: I think of none other than the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: agam agochar alakh apaaraa chintaa karahu hamaaree |
English: O Lord, inaccessible, unfathomable, invisible and infinite: please, take care of me!

Gurbani: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਲੀਣਾ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jal thal maheeal bharipur leenaa ghatt ghatt jot tumaaree |2|
English: In the water, on the land and in sky, You are totally pervading. Your Light is in each and every heart. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਿਖ ਮਤਿ ਸਭ ਬੁਧਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ਮੰਦਿਰ ਛਾਵਾ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sikh mat sabh budh tumaaree mandir chhaavaa tere |
English: All teachings, instructions and understandings are Yours; the mansions and sanctuaries are Yours as well.

Gurbani: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਨਿਤ ਤੇਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tujh bin avar na jaanaa mere saahibaa gun gaavaa nit tere |3|
English: Without You, I know no other, O my Lord and Master; I continually sing Your Glorious Praises. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ਸਰਬ ਚਿੰਤ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਾਸੇ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jant sabh saran tumaaree sarab chint tudh paase |
English: All beings and creatures seek the Protection of Your Sanctuary; all thought of their care rests with You.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਚੰਗਾ ਇਕ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai soee changaa ik naanak kee aradaase |4|2|
English: That which pleases Your Will is good; this alone is Nanak's prayer. ||4||2||

[Ang 795 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 1 |
English: Bilaawal, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਆਪੇ ਨੀਸਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape sabad aape neesaan |
English: He Himself is the Word of the Shabad, and He Himself is the Insignia.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸੁਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape surataa aape jaan |
English: He Himself is the Listener, and He Himself is the Knower.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape kar kar vekhai taan |
English: He Himself created the creation, and He Himself beholds His almighty power.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: too daataa naam paravaan |1|
English: You are the Great Giver; Your Name alone is approved. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਦੇਉ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa naam niranjan deo |
English: Such is the Name of the Immaculate, Divine Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਜਾਚਿਕੁ ਤੂ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hau jaachik too alakh abheo |1| rahaau |
English: I am just a beggar; You are invisible and unknowable. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਧਰਕਟੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohu dharakattee naar |
English: Love of Maya is like a cursed woman,

Gurbani: ਭੂੰਡੀ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਕਾਮਣਿਆਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: bhoonddee kaaman kaamaniaar |
English: Ugly, dirty and promiscuous.

Gurbani: ਰਾਜੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਝੂਠਾ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: raaj roop jhootthaa din chaar |
English: Power and beauty are false, and last for only a few days.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naam milai chaanan andhiaar |2|
English: But when one is blessed with the Naam, the darkness within is illuminated. ||2||

Gurbani: ਚਖਿ ਛੋਡੀ ਸਹਸਾ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: chakh chhoddee sahasaa nahee koe |
English: I tasted Maya and renounced it, and now, I have no doubts.

Gurbani: ਬਾਪੁ ਦਿਸੈ ਵੇਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: baap disai vejaat na hoe |
English: One whose father is known, cannot be illegitimate.

Gurbani: ਏਕੇ ਕਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਭਉ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: eke kau naahee bhau koe |
English: One who belongs to the One Lord, has no fear.

Gurbani: ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: karataa kare karaavai soe |3|
English: The Creator acts, and causes all to act. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਮੁਏ ਮਨੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabad mue man man te maariaa |
English: One who dies in the Word of the Shabad conquers his mind, through his mind.

Gurbani: ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹੇ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: tthaak rahe man saachai dhaariaa |
English: Keeping his mind restrained, he enshrines the True Lord within his heart.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: avar na soojhai gur kau vaariaa |
English: He does not know any other, and he is a sacrifice to the Guru.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿਆ ॥੪॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak naam rate nisataariaa |4|3|
English: O Nanak, attuned to the Naam, he is emancipated. ||4||3||

[Ang 796 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 1 |
English: Bilaaval, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਮਨੁ ਸਹਜ ਧਿਆਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur bachanee man sehaj dhiaane |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, the mind intuitively meditates on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: har kai rang rataa man maane |
English: Imbued with the Lord's Love, the mind is satisfied.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੇ ਬਉਰਾਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh bharam bhule bauraane |
English: The insane, self-willed manmukhs wander around, deluded by doubt.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਨੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har bin kiau raheeai gur sabad pachhaane |1|
English: Without the Lord, how can anyone survive? Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is realized. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੈਸੇ ਜੀਵਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: bin darasan kaise jeevau meree maaee |
English: Without the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, how can I live, O my mother?

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਅਰਾ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har bin jeearaa reh na sakai khin satigur boojh bujhaaee |1| rahaau |
English: Without the Lord, my soul cannot survive, even for an instant; the True Guru has helped me understand this. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਹਉ ਮਰਉ ਦੁਖਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: meraa prabh bisarai hau mrau dukhaalee |
English: Forgetting my God, I die in pain.

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਜਪਉ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: saas giraas jpau apune har bhaalee |
English: With each breath and morsel of food, I meditate on my Lord, and seek Him.

Gurbani: ਸਦ ਬੈਰਾਗਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਹਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: sad bairaagan har naam nihaalee |
English: I remain always detached, but I am enraptured with the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਜਾਨੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ab jaane guramukh har naalee |2|
English: Now, as Gurmukh, I know that the Lord is always with me. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਕਹੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: akath kathaa kaheeai gur bhaae |
English: The Unspoken Speech is spoken, by the Will of the Guru.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਦੇਇ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: prabh agam agochar dee dikhaae |
English: He shows us that God is unapproachable and unfathomable.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਿਆ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin gur karanee kiaa kaar kamaae |
English: Without the Guru, what lifestyle could we practice, and what work could we do?

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਟਿ ਚਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: haumai mett chalai gur sabad samaae |3|
English: Eradicating egotism, and walking in harmony with the Guru's Will, I am absorbed in the Word of the Shabad. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਵਿਛੁੜੈ ਖੋਟੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh vichhurrai khottee raas |
English: The self-willed manmukhs are separated from the Lord, gathering false wealth.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh naam milai saabaas |
English: The Gurmukhs are celebrated with the glory of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: har kirapaa dhaaree daasan daas |
English: The Lord has showered His Mercy upon me, and made me the slave of His slaves.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੪॥
Transliteration: jan naanak har naam dhan raas |4|4|
English: The Name of the Lord is the wealth and capital of servant Nanak. ||4||4||

[Ang 796 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 3 ghar 1 |
English: Bilaaval, Third Mehl, First House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਖਾਇਆ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਸੋਇਆ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਕਾਪੜੁ ਅੰਗਿ ਚੜਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: dhrig dhrig khaaeaa dhrig dhrig soeaa dhrig dhrig kaaparr ang charraaeaa |
English: Cursed, cursed is the food; cursed, cursed is the sleep; cursed, cursed are the clothes worn on the body.

Gurbani: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਹਿਤ ਸਿਉ ਜਿਤੁ ਹੁਣਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: dhrig sareer kuttanb sahit siau jit hun khasam na paaeaa |
English: Cursed is the body, along with family and friends, when one does not find his Lord and Master in this life.

Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ਛੁੜਕੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਹਾਥਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਅਹਿਲਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: paurree chhurrakee fir haath na aavai ahilaa janam gavaaeaa |1|
English: He misses the step of the ladder, and this opportunity will not come into his hands again; his life is wasted, uselessly. ||1||

Gurbani: ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗਣਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਵਿਸਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: doojaa bhaau na deee liv laagan jin har ke charan visaare |
English: The love of duality does not allow him to lovingly focus his attention on the Lord; he forgets the Feet of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਦਾਤਾ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਕ ਤੇਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਤੈ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jagajeevan daataa jan sevak tere tin ke tai dookh nivaare |1| rahaau |
English: O Life of the World, O Great Giver, you eradicate the sorrows of your humble servants. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦਇਆਪਤਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਏਹਿ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: too deaal deaapat daataa kiaa ehi jant vichaare |
English: You are Merciful, O Great Giver of Mercy; what are these poor beings?

Gurbani: ਮੁਕਤ ਬੰਧ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਹੋਏ ਐਸਾ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: mukat bandh sabh tujh te hoe aisaa aakh vakhaane |
English: All are liberated or placed into bondage by You; this is all one can say.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬੰਧ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: guramukh hovai so mukat kaheeai manamukh bandh vichaare |2|
English: One who becomes Gurmukh is said to be liberated, while the poor self-willed manmukhs are in bondage. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: so jan mukat jis ek liv laagee sadaa rahai har naale |
English: He alone is liberated, who lovingly focuses his attention on the One Lord, always dwelling with the Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਗਹਣ ਗਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਸਚੈ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: tin kee gehan gat kahee na jaaee sachai aap savaare |
English: His depth and condition cannot be described. The True Lord Himself embellishes him.

Gurbani: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੇ ਸਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bharam bhulaane si manamukh kaheeeh naa uravaar na paare |3|
English: Those who wander around, deluded by doubt, are called manmukhs; they are neither on this side, nor on the other side. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: jis no nadar kare soee jan paae gur kaa sabad samaale |
English: That humble being, who is blessed by the Lord's Glance of Grace obtains Him, and contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har jan maaeaa maeh nisataare |
English: In the midst of Maya, the Lord's servant is emancipated.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਾਗੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਕਾਲਹਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak bhaag hovai jis masatak kaaleh maar bidaare |4|1|
English: O Nanak, one who has such destiny inscribed upon his forehead, conquers and destroys death. ||4||1||

[Ang 797 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 3 |
English: Bilaaval, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਤੁਲੁ ਕਿਉ ਤੋਲਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: atul kiau toliaa jaae |
English: How can the unweighable be weighed?

Gurbani: ਦੂਜਾ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: doojaa hoe ta sojhee paae |
English: If there is anyone else as great, then he alone could understand the Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: tis te doojaa naahee koe |
English: There is no other than Him.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਕੂ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tis dee keemat kikoo hoe |1|
English: How can His value be estimated? ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaad vasai man aae |
English: By Guru's Grace, He comes to dwell in the mind.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: taa ko jaanai dubidhaa jaae |1| rahaau |
English: One comes to know Him, when duality departs. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਸਰਾਫੁ ਕਸਵਟੀ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aap saraaf kasavattee laae |
English: He Himself is the Assayer, applying the touch-stone to test it.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਪਰਖੇ ਆਪਿ ਚਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aape parakhe aap chalaae |
English: He Himself analyzes the coin, and He Himself approves it as currency.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਤੋਲੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aape tole pooraa hoe |
English: He Himself weights it perfectly.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aape jaanai eko soe |2|
English: He alone knows; He is the One and Only Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa kaa roop sabh tis te hoe |
English: All the forms of Maya emanate from Him.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jis no mele su niramal hoe |
English: He alone becomes pure and immaculate, who is united with the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਾਏ ਲਗੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: jis no laae lagai tis aae |
English: He alone is attached, whom the Lord attaches.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਦਿਖਾਲੇ ਤਾ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sabh sach dikhaale taa sach samaae |3|
English: All Truth is revealed to him, and then, he merges in the True Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਲਿਵ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: aape liv dhaat hai aape |
English: He Himself leads the mortals to focus on Him, and He Himself causes them to chase after Maya.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: aap bujhaae aape jaape |
English: He Himself imparts understanding, and He reveals Himself.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: aape satigur sabad hai aape |
English: He Himself is the True Guru, and He Himself is the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ਆਪੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak aakh sunaae aape |4|2|
English: O Nanak, He Himself speaks and teaches. ||4||2||

[Ang 797 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 3 |
English: Bilaaval, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੇ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸੇਵ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੇ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਬਹਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: saahib te sevak sev saahib te kiaa ko kahai bahaanaa |
English: My Lord and Master has made me His servant, and blessed me with His service; how can anyone argue about this?

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਇਕੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਬਨਿਆ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aisaa ik teraa khel baniaa hai sabh meh ek samaanaa |1|
English: Such is Your play, One and Only Lord; You are the One, contained among all. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪਰਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: satigur parachai har naam samaanaa |
English: When the True Guru is pleased and appeased, one is absorbed in the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਏ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਹਜ ਧਿਆਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jis karam hovai so satigur paae anadin laagai sehaj dhiaanaa |1| rahaau |
English: One who is blessed by the Lord's Mercy, finds the True Guru; night and day, he automatically remains focused on the Lord's meditation. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਕੋਈ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa koee teree sevaa kare kiaa ko kare abhimaanaa |
English: How can I serve You? How can I be proud of this?

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਖਿੰਚਹਿ ਤੂ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਬ ਕੋਈ ਕਰਉ ਦਿਖਾ ਵਖਿਆਨਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jab apunee jot khincheh too suaamee tab koee krau dikhaa vakhiaanaa |2|
English: When You withdraw Your Light, O Lord and Master, then who can speak and teach? ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲਾ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape gur chelaa hai aape aape gunee nidhaanaa |
English: You Yourself are the Guru, and You Yourself are the chaylaa, the humble disciple; You Yourself are the treasure of virtue.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਆਪਿ ਚਲਾਏ ਤਿਵੈ ਕੋਈ ਚਾਲੈ ਜਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਭਗਵਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jiau aap chalaae tivai koee chaalai jiau har bhaavai bhagavaanaa |3|
English: As You cause us to move, so do we move, according to the Pleasure of Your Will, O Lord God. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤੂ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਕਉਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਾਮਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: kehat naanak too saachaa saahib kaun jaanai tere kaamaan |
English: Says Nanak, You are the True Lord and Master; who can know Your actions?

Gurbani: ਇਕਨਾ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਇਕਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭਵਹਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
Transliteration: eikanaa ghar meh de vaddiaaee ik bharam bhaveh abhimaanaa |4|3|
English: Some are blessed with glory in their own homes, while others wander in doubt and pride. ||4||3||

[Ang 797 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 3 |
English: Bilaaval, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਾ ਥਾਟੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਪੂਰੈ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: pooraa thaatt banaaeaa poorai vekhahu ek samaanaa |
English: The perfect Lord has fashioned the Perfect Creation. Behold the Lord pervading everywhere.

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਪਰਪੰਚ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਮਤੁ ਕੋ ਧਰਹੁ ਗੁਮਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: eis parapanch meh saache naam kee vaddiaaee mat ko dharahu gumaanaa |1|
English: In this play of the world, is the glorious greatness of the True Name. No one should take pride in himself. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਮਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: satigur kee jis no mat aavai so satigur maeh samaanaa |
English: One who accepts the wisdom of the True Guru's Teachings, is absorbed into the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਇਹ ਬਾਣੀ ਜੋ ਜੀਅਹੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: eih baanee jo jeeahu jaanai tis antar ravai har naamaa |1| rahaau |
English: The Lord's Name abides deep within the nucleus of one who realizes the Bani of the Guru's Word within his soul. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗਾ ਕਾ ਹੁਣਿ ਨਿਬੇੜਾ ਨਰ ਮਨੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: chahu jugaa kaa hun niberraa nar manukhaa no ek nidhaanaa |
English: Now, this is the essence of the teachings of the four ages: for the human race, the Name of the One Lord is the greatest treasure.

Gurbani: ਜਤੁ ਸੰਜਮ ਤੀਰਥ ਓਨਾ ਜੁਗਾ ਕਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਹੈ ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jat sanjam teerath onaa jugaa kaa dharam hai kal meh keerat har naamaa |2|
English: Celibacy, self-discipline and pilgrimages were the essence of Dharma in those past ages; but in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Praise of the Lord's Name is the essence of Dharma. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਆਪੋ ਆਪਣਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਧਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jug jug aapo aapanaa dharam hai sodh dekhahu bed puraanaa |
English: Each and every age has its own essence of Dharma; study the Vedas and the Puraanas, and see this as true.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਗਿ ਤੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: guramukh jinee dhiaaeaa har har jag te poore paravaanaa |3|
English: They are Gurmukh, who meditate on the Lord, Har, Har; in this world, they are perfect and approved. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਏ ਚੂਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: kehat naanak sache siau preet laae chookai man abhimaanaa |
English: Says Nanak, loving the True Lord, the mind's egotism and self-conceit is eradicated.

Gurbani: ਕਹਤ ਸੁਣਤ ਸਭੇ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਾਨਤ ਪਾਹਿ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੪॥
Transliteration: kehat sunat sabhe sukh paaveh maanat paeh nidhaanaa |4|4|
English: Those who speak and listen to the Lord's Name, all find peace. Those who believe in it, obtain the supreme treasure. ||4||4||

[Ang 798 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 3 |
English: Bilaaval, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪੇ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh preet jis no aape laae |
English: The Lord Himself attaches the Gurmukh to His Love;

Gurbani: ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: tit ghar bilaaval gur sabad suhaae |
English: joyful melodies permeate his home, and he is embellished with the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਮੰਗਲੁ ਨਾਰੀ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: mangal naaree gaaveh aae |
English: The women come and sing the songs of joy.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mil preetam sadaa sukh paae |1|
English: Meeting with their Beloved, lasting peace is obtained. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: hau tin balihaarai jina har man vasaae |
English: I am a sacrifice to those, whose minds are filled with the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har jan kau miliaa sukh paaeeai har gun gaavai sehaj subhaae |1| rahaau |
English: Meeting with the humble servant of the Lord, peace is obtained, and one intuitively sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਤੇਰੈ ਚਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa rang raate terai chaae |
English: They are always imbued with Your Joyful Love;

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: har jeeo aap vasai man aae |
English: O Dear Lord, You Yourself come to dwell in their minds.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸੋਭਾ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aape sobhaa sad hee paae |
English: They obtain eternal glory.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲੈ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: guramukh melai mel milaae |2|
English: The Gurmukhs are united in the Lord's Union. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਰੰਗਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh raate sabad rangaae |
English: The Gurmukhs are imbued with the love of the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: nij ghar vaasaa har gun gaae |
English: They abide in the home of their own being, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਭਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: rang chaloolai har ras bhaae |
English: They are dyed in the deep crimson color of the Lord's Love; they look so beautiful.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: eihu rang kade na utarai saach samaae |3|
English: This dye never fades away; they are absorbed in the True Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: antar sabad mittiaa agiaan andheraa |
English: The Shabad deep within the nucleus of the self dispels the darkness of ignorance.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: satigur giaan miliaa preetam meraa |
English: Meeting with my Friend, the True Guru, I have obtained spiritual wisdom.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਫੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo sach raate tin bahurr na feraa |
English: Those who are attuned to the True Lord, do not have to enter the cycle of reincarnation again.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak naam drirraae pooraa gur meraa |4|5|
English: O Nanak, my Perfect Guru implants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, deep within. ||4||5||

[Ang 798 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 3 |
English: Bilaaval, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: poore gur te vaddiaaee paaee |
English: From the Perfect Guru, I have obtained glorious greatness.

Gurbani: ਅਚਿੰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: achint naam vasiaa man aaee |
English: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, has spontaneously come to abide in my mind.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: haumai maaeaa sabad jalaaee |
English: Through the Word of the Shabad, I have burnt away egotism and Maya.

Gurbani: ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dar saachai gur te sobhaa paaee |1|
English: Through the Guru, I have obtained honor in the Court of the True Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਗਦੀਸ ਸੇਵਉ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਾਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: jagadees sevau mai avar na kaajaa |
English: I serve the Lord of the Universe; I have no other work to do.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਅਨਦੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਗਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਵਾਜਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
