Transliteration: anadin anad hovai man merai guramukh maagau teraa naam nivaajaa |1| rahaau |
English: Night and day, my mind is in ecstasy; as Gurmukh, I beg for the bliss-giving Naam. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: man kee parateet man te paaee |
English: From the mind itself, mental faith is obtained.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: poore gur te sabad bujhaaee |
English: Through the Guru, I have realized the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਣ ਮਰਣੁ ਕੋ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: jeevan maran ko samasar vekhai |
English: How rare is that person, who looks upon life and death alike.

Gurbani: ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਮਰੈ ਨਾ ਜਮੁ ਪੇਖੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bahurr na marai naa jam pekhai |2|
English: She shall never die again, and shall not have to see the Messenger of Death. ||2||

Gurbani: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਕੋਟ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: ghar hee meh sabh kott nidhaan |
English: Within the home of the self are all the millions of treasures.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਗਇਆ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: satigur dikhaae geaa abhimaan |
English: The True Guru has revealed them, and my egotistical pride is gone.

Gurbani: ਸਦ ਹੀ ਲਾਗਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨ ॥
Transliteration: sad hee laagaa sehaj dhiaan |
English: I keep my meditation always focused on the Cosmic Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: anadin gaavai eko naam |3|
English: Night and day, I sing the One Name. ||3||

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: eis jug meh vaddiaaee paaee |
English: I have obtained glorious greatness in this age,

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: poore gur te naam dhiaaee |
English: from the Perfect Guru, meditating on the Naam.

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jeh dekhaa teh rahiaa samaaee |
English: Wherever I look, I see the Lord permeating and pervading.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: sadaa sukhadaataa keemat nahee paaee |4|
English: He is forever the Giver of peace; His worth cannot be estimated. ||4||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: poorai bhaag gur pooraa paaeaa |
English: By perfect destiny, I have found the Perfect Guru.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: antar naam nidhaan dikhaaeaa |
English: He has revealed to me the treasure of the Naam, deep within the nucleus of my self.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਤਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa sabad at meetthaa laaeaa |
English: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is so very sweet.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਬੁਝੀ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੫॥੬॥੪॥੬॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: naanak trisan bujhee man tan sukh paaeaa |5|6|4|6|10|
English: O Nanak, my thirst is quenched, and my mind and body have found peace. ||5||6||4||6||10||

[Ang 798 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: raag bilaaval mahalaa 4 ghar 3 |
English: Raag Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl, Third House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਉਦਮ ਮਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੇਰੇ ਤਿਉ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: audam mat prabh antarajaamee jiau prere tiau karanaa |
English: Effort and intelligence come from God, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts; as He wills, they act.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਨਟੂਆ ਤੰਤੁ ਵਜਾਏ ਤੰਤੀ ਤਿਉ ਵਾਜਹਿ ਜੰਤ ਜਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jiau nattooaa tant vajaae tantee tiau vaajeh jant janaa |1|
English: As the violinist plays upon the strings of the violin, so does the Lord play the living beings. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jap man raam naam rasanaa |
English: Chant the Name of the Lord with your tongue, O mind.

Gurbani: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਤ ਲਿਖੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਸਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: masatak likhat likhe gur paaeaa har hiradai har basanaa |1| rahaau |
English: According to the pre-ordained destiny written upon my forehead, I have found the Guru, and the Lord abides within my heart. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਗਿਰਸਤਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਤੁ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਜਨੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa girasat bhramat hai praanee rakh levahu jan apanaa |
English: Entangled in Maya, the mortal wanders around. Save Your humble servant, O Lord,

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦੁ ਹਰਣਾਖਸਿ ਗ੍ਰਸਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਨਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jiau prahilaad haranaakhas grasio har raakhio har saranaa |2|
English: as you saved Prahlaad from the clutches of Harnaakash; keep him in Your Sanctuary, Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਵਨ ਕਵਨ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਹੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵੰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: kavan kavan kee gat mit kaheeai har kee patit pavanaa |
English: How can I describe the state and the condition, O Lord, of those many sinners you have purified?

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਢੋਵੈ ਢੋਰ ਹਾਥਿ ਚਮੁ ਚਮਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਉਧਰਿਓ ਪਰਿਓ ਸਰਨਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ohu dtovai dtor haath cham chamare har udhario pario saranaa |3|
English: Ravi Daas, the leather-worker, who worked with hides and carried dead animals was saved, by entering the Lord's Sanctuary. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਭਗਤ ਭਵ ਤਾਰਨ ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਰਾਖੁ ਪਪਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: prabh deen deaal bhagat bhav taaran ham paapee raakh papanaa |
English: O God, Merciful to the meek, carry Your devotees across the world-ocean; I am a sinner - save me from sin!

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਨ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸ ਹਮ ਕਰੀਅਹੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸੰਨਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: har daasan daas daas ham kareeahu jan naanak daas daasanaa |4|1|
English: O Lord, make me the slave of the slave of Your slaves; servant Nanak is the slave of Your slaves. ||4||1||

[Ang 799 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 4 |
English: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਮਤੀ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਜਨਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: ham moorakh mugadh agiaan matee saranaagat purakh ajanamaa |
English: I am foolish, idiotic and ignorant; I seek Your Sanctuary, O Primal Being, O Lord beyond birth.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਮ ਪਾਥਰ ਹੀਨ ਅਕਰਮਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa rakh levahu mere tthaakur ham paathar heen akaramaa |1|
English: Have Mercy upon me, and save me, O my Lord and Master; I am a lowly stone, with no good karma at all. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਭਜੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੈ ਰਾਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: mere man bhaj raam naamai raamaa |
English: O my mind, vibrate and meditate on the Lord, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਹੋਰਿ ਤਿਆਗਹੁ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਕਾਮਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: guramat har ras paaeeai hor tiaagahu nihafal kaamaa |1| rahaau |
English: Under Guru's Instructions, obtain the sublime, subtle essence of the Lord; renounce other fruitless actions. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਤਾਰੇ ਹਮ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਰਾਖੁ ਉਪਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: har jan sevak se har taare ham niragun raakh upamaa |
English: The humble servants of the Lord are saved by the Lord; I am worthless - it is Your glory to save me.

Gurbani: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਵਡੇ ਕਰੰਮਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tujh bin avar na koee mere tthaakur har japeeai vadde karamaa |2|
English: I have no other than You, O my Lord and Master; I meditate on the Lord, by my good karma. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਹੀਨ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਵਡ ਦੂਖ ਸਹੰਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: naamaheen dhrig jeevate tin vadd dookh sahamaa |
English: Those who lack the Naam, the Name of the Lord, their lives are cursed, and they must endure terrible pain.

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਭਵਾਈਅਹਿ ਮੰਦਭਾਗੀ ਮੂੜ ਅਕਰਮਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: oe fir fir jon bhavaaeeeh mandabhaagee moorr akaramaa |3|
English: They are consigned to reincarnation over and over again; they are the most unfortunate fools, with no good karma at all. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖੇ ਵਡ ਕਰਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: har jan naam adhaar hai dhur poorab likhe vadd karamaa |
English: The Naam is the Support of the Lord's humble servants; their good karma is pre-ordained.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨੰਮਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur satigur naam drirraaeaa jan naanak safal janamaa |4|2|
English: The Guru, the True Guru, has implanted the Naam within servant Nanak, and his life is fruitful. ||4||2||

[Ang 799 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 4 |
English: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਮਰਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਲੁਭਤ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਹੁ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: hamaraa chit lubhat mohi bikhiaa bahu duramat mail bharaa |
English: My consciousness is lured by emotional attachment and corruption; is is filled with evil-minded filth.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਿ ਨ ਸਕਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਮ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਗਧ ਤਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tumaree sevaa kar na sakah prabh ham kiau kar mugadh taraa |1|
English: I cannot serve You, O God; I am ignorant - how can I cross over? ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਨਰਹਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਰਹਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: mere man jap narahar naam naraharaa |
English: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, the Lord, the Lord of man.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jan aoopar kirapaa prabh dhaaree mil satigur paar paraa |1| rahaau |
English: God has showered His Mercy upon His humble servant; meeting with the True Guru, he is carried across. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਮਰੇ ਪਿਤਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਤੀ ਜਸੁ ਕਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: hamare pitaa tthaakur prabh suaamee har dehu matee jas karaa |
English: O my Father, my Lord and Master, Lord God, please bless me with such understanding, that I may sing Your Praises.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮੑਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਗੇ ਸੇ ਉਧਰੇ ਜਿਉ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਾਸਟ ਲੋਹ ਤਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tumarai sang lage se udhare jiau sang kaasatt loh taraa |2|
English: Those who are attached to You are saved, like iron which is carried across with wood. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤ ਨਰ ਹੋਛੀ ਮਤਿ ਮਧਿਮ ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਕਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: saakat nar hochhee mat madhim jina har har sev na karaa |
English: The faithless cynics have little or no understanding; they do not serve the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਤੇ ਨਰ ਭਾਗਹੀਨ ਦੁਹਚਾਰੀ ਓਇ ਜਨਮਿ ਮੁਏ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: te nar bhaagaheen duhachaaree oe janam mue fir maraa |3|
English: Those beings are unfortunate and vicious; they die, and are consigned to reincarnation, over and over again. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਤੁਮੑ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੇ ਨੑਾਏ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jin kau tuma har melahu suaamee te naae santokh gur saraa |
English: Those whom You unite with Yourself, O Lord and Master, bathe in the Guru's cleansing pool of contentment.

Gurbani: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਈ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਿਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
Transliteration: duramat mail gee har bhajiaa jan naanak paar paraa |4|3|
English: Vibrating upon the Lord, the filth of their evil-mindedness is washed away; servant Nanak is carried across. ||4||3||

[Ang 799 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 4 |
English: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਕਰਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: aavahu sant milahu mere bhaaee mil har har kathaa karahu |
English: Come, O Saints, and join together, O my Siblings of Destiny; let us tell the Stories of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਹੈ ਕਲਜੁਗਿ ਖੇਵਟੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਰਹੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har har naam bohith hai kalajug khevatt gur sabad tarahu |1|
English: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the boat in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga; the Word of the Guru's Shabad is the boatman to ferry us across. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਹਰਿ ਉਚਰਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: mere man har gun har ucharahu |
English: O my mind, chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਤ ਲਿਖੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: masatak likhat likhe gun gaae mil sangat paar parahu |1| rahaau |
English: According to the pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon your forehead, sing the Praises of the Lord; join the Holy Congregation, and cross over the world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਊਤਮੁ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਰਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa nagar meh raam ras aootam kiau paaeeai upades jan karahu |
English: Within the body-village is the Lord's supreme, sublime essence. How can I obtain it? Teach me, O humble Saints.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਫਲ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਅਹੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: satigur sev safal har darasan mil amrit har ras peeahu |2|
English: Serving the True Guru, you shall obtain the Fruitful Vision of the Lord's Darshan; meeting Him, drink in the ambrosial essence of the Lord's Nectar. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਚਾਖਿ ਦਿਖਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam amrit har meetthaa har santahu chaakh dikhahu |
English: The Ambrosial Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is so sweet; O Saints of the Lord, taste it, and see.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਗਾ ਤਿਨ ਬਿਸਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਬਿਖ ਰਸਹੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: guramat har ras meetthaa laagaa tin bisare sabh bikh rasahu |3|
English: Under Guru's Instruction, the Lord's essence seems so sweet; through it, all corrupt sensual pleasures are forgotten. ||3||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸੁ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam ras raam rasaaein har sevahu sant janahu |
English: The Name of the Lord is the medicine to cure all diseases; so serve the Lord, O humble Saints.

Gurbani: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਚਾਰੇ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਹੁ ॥੪॥੪॥
Transliteration: chaar padaarath chaare paae guramat naanak har bhajahu |4|4|
English: The four great blessings are obtained, O Nanak, by vibrating upon the Lord, under Guru's Instruction. ||4||4||

[Ang 800 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 4 |
English: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਸੂਦੁ ਵੈਸੁ ਕੋ ਜਾਪੈ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਜਪੈਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: khatree braahaman sood vais ko jaapai har mantru japainee |
English: Anyone, from any class - Kh'shaatriya, Brahman, Soodra or Vaishya - can chant, and meditate on the Mantra of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਪੂਜਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਸਭ ਰੈਨੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur satigur paarabraham kar poojahu nit sevahu dinas sabh rainee |1|
English: Worship the Guru, the True Guru, as the Supreme Lord God; serve Him constantly, all day and night. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨੈਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: har jan dekhahu satigur nainee |
English: O humble servants of the Lord, behold the True Guru with your eyes.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਇਛਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਬੈਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo ichhahu soee fal paavahu har bolahu guramat bainee |1| rahaau |
English: Whatever you wish for, you shall receive, chanting the Word of the Lord's Name, under Guru's Instruction. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਉਪਾਵ ਚਿਤਵੀਅਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਸਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿ ਬਾਤ ਹੋਵੈਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: anik upaav chitaveeeh bahutere saa hovai ji baat hovainee |
English: People think of many and various efforts, but that alone happens, which is to happen.

Gurbani: ਅਪਨਾ ਭਲਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਬਾਛੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਚਿਤੈਨੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: apanaa bhalaa sabh koee baachhai so kare ji merai chit na chitainee |2|
English: All beings seek goodness for themselves, but what the Lord does - that may not be what we think and expect. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਤਿਆਗਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਏਹਾ ਬਾਤ ਕਠੈਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: man kee mat tiaagahu har jan ehaa baat katthainee |
English: So renounce the clever intellect of your mind, O humble servants of the Lord, no matter how hard this may be.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਲੈਨੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: anadin har har naam dhiaavahu gur satigur kee mat lainee |3|
English: Night and day, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; accept the wisdom of the Guru, the True Guru. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਤਿ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਵਸਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਜੰਤ ਤੂ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਜੰਤੈਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: mat sumat terai vas suaamee ham jant too purakh jantainee |
English: Wisdom, balanced wisdom is in Your power, O Lord and Master; I am the instrument, and You are the player, O Primal Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਤੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਬੁਲੈਨੀ ॥੪॥੫॥
Transliteration: jan naanak ke prabh karate suaamee jiau bhaavai tivai bulainee |4|5|
English: O God, O Creator, Lord and Master of servant Nanak, as You wish, so do I speak. ||4||5||

[Ang 800 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 4 |
English: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਨਦ ਮੂਲੁ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਅਨਦ ਅਨੰਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: anad mool dhiaaeo purakhotam anadin anad anande |
English: I meditate on the source of bliss, the Sublime Primal Being; night and day, I am in ecstasy and bliss.

Gurbani: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ਚੁਕਾਈ ਸਭਿ ਚੂਕੇ ਜਮ ਕੇ ਛੰਦੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dharam raae kee kaan chukaaee sabh chooke jam ke chhande |1|
English: The Righteous Judge of Dharma has no power over me; I have cast off all subservience to the Messenger of Death. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੋੁਬਿੰਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: jap man har har naam guobinde |
English: Meditate, O mind, on the Naam, the Name of the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: vaddabhaagee gur satigur paaeaa gun gaae paramaanande |1| rahaau |
English: By great good fortune, I have found the Guru, the True Guru; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of supreme bliss. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤ ਮੂੜ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਬਧਿਕ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਫਿਰੰਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: saakat moorr maaeaa ke badhik vich maaeaa fireh firande |
English: The foolish faithless cynics are held captive by Maya; in Maya, they continue wandering, wandering around.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਲਤ ਕਿਰਤ ਕੇ ਬਾਧੇ ਜਿਉ ਤੇਲੀ ਬਲਦ ਭਵੰਦੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: trisanaa jalat kirat ke baadhe jiau telee balad bhavande |2|
English: Burnt by desire, and bound by the karma of their past actions, they go round and round, like the ox at the mill press. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵ ਲਗੇ ਸੇ ਉਧਰੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੰਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh sev lage se udhare vaddabhaagee sev karande |
English: The Gurmukhs, who focus on serving the Guru, are saved; by great good fortune, they perform service.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਭਿ ਤੂਟੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਫੰਦੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jin har japiaa tin fal paaeaa sabh tootte maaeaa fande |3|
English: Those who meditate on the Lord obtain the fruits of their rewards, and the bonds of Maya are all broken. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: aape tthaakur aape sevak sabh aape aap govinde |
English: He Himself is the Lord and Master, and He Himself is the servant. The Lord of the Universe Himself is all by Himself.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਸਭੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਰਹੰਦੇ ॥੪॥੬॥
Transliteration: jan naanak aape aap sabh varatai jiau raakhai tivai rahande |4|6|
English: O servant Nanak, He Himself is All-pervading; as He keeps us, we remain. ||4||6||

[Ang 800 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਪੜਤਾਲ ਘਰੁ ੧੩ ॥
Transliteration: raag bilaaval mahalaa 4 parrataal ghar 13 |
English: Raag Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl, Partaal, Thirteenth House:

Gurbani: ਬੋਲਹੁ ਭਈਆ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨੋ ॥ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਭਗਤ ਤਾਰਨੋ ॥
Transliteration: bolahu bheea raam naam patit paavano | har sant bhagat taarano |
English: O Siblings of Destiny, chant the Name of the Lord, the Purifier of sinners. The Lord emancipates his Saints and devotees.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਭਰਿਪੁਰੇ ਰਹਿਆ ॥ ਜਲਿ ਥਲੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ॥ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਸਾਰਨੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har bharipure rahiaa | jal thale raam naam | nit gaaeeai har dookh bisaarano |1| rahaau |
English: The Lord is totally permeating and pervading everywhere; The Name of the Lord is pervading the water and the land. So sing continuously of the Lord, the Dispeller of pain. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਹੈ ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har keea hai safal janam hamaaraa |
English: The Lord has made my life fruitful and rewarding.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਸਾਰਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har japiaa har dookh bisaaranahaaraa |
English: I meditate on the Lord, the Dispeller of pain.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਹੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur bhettiaa hai mukat daataa |
English: I have met the Guru, the Giver of liberation.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਈ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਸਫਲ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: har keeee hamaaree safal jaataa |
English: The Lord has made my life's journey fruitful and rewarding.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਨੋ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mil sangatee gun gaavano |1|
English: Joining the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕਰਿ ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: man raam naam kar aasaa |
English: O mortal, place your hopes in the Name of the Lord,

Gurbani: ਭਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਬਿਨਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: bhaau doojaa binas binaasaa |
English: and your love of duality shall simply vanish.

Gurbani: ਵਿਚਿ ਆਸਾ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਰਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: vich aasaa hoe niraasee |
English: One who, in hope, remains unattached to hope,

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: so jan miliaa har paasee |
English: such a humble being meets with his Lord.

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਨੋ ॥
Transliteration: koee raam naam gun gaavano |
English: And one who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name

Gurbani: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਗਿ ਲਾਵਨੋ ॥੨॥੧॥੭॥੪॥੬॥੭॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: jan naanak tis pag laavano |2|1|7|4|6|7|17|
English: - servant Nanak falls at his feet. ||2||1||7||4||6||7||17||

[Ang 801 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raag bilaaval mahalaa 5 chaupade ghar 1 |
English: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Chau-Padhay, First House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਮੋਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: nadaree aavai tis siau mohu |
English: He is attached to what he sees.

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਤੋਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: kiau mileeai prabh abinaasee tohi |
English: How can I meet You, O Imperishable God?

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa mohi maarag paavahu |
English: Have Mercy upon me, and place me upon the Path;

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਅੰਚਲਿ ਲਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saadhasangat kai anchal laavahu |1|
English: let me be attached to the hem of the robe of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਤਰੀਐ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: kiau tareeai bikhiaa sansaar |
English: How can I cross over the poisonous world-ocean?

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur bohith paavai paar |1| rahaau |
English: The True Guru is the boat to carry us across. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪਵਨ ਝੁਲਾਰੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: pavan jhulaare maaeaa dee |
English: The wind of Maya blows and shakes us,

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਭਗਤ ਸਦਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਸੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: har ke bhagat sadaa thir see |
English: but the Lord's devotees remain ever-stable.

Gurbani: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਤੇ ਰਹਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: harakh sog te raheh niraaraa |
English: They remain unaffected by pleasure and pain.

Gurbani: ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਰਖਵਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sir aoopar aap guroo rakhavaaraa |2|
English: The Guru Himself is the Savior above their heads. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪਾਇਆ ਵੇੜੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਰਬ ਭੁਇਅੰਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: paaeaa verr maaeaa sarab bhueiangaa |
English: Maya, the snake, holds all in her coils.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਪਚੇ ਦੀਪਕ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਤੰਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: haumai pache deepak dekh patangaa |
English: They burn to death in egotism, like the moth lured by seeing the flame.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: sagal seegaar kare nahee paavai |
English: They make all sorts of decorations, but they do not find the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਤਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jaa hoe kripaal taa guroo milaavai |3|
English: When the Guru becomes Merciful, He leads them to meet the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਫਿਰਉ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਮੈ ਇਕੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਦਸਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau firau udaasee mai ik ratan dasaaeaa |
English: I wander around, sad and depressed, seeking the jewel of the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੁ ਹੀਰਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਨ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: niramolak heeraa milai na upaaeaa |
English: This priceless jewel is not obtained by any efforts.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਲਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa mandar tis meh laal |
English: That jewel is within the body, the Temple of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਲਿਆ ਪੜਦਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਭਈ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: gur kholiaa parradaa dekh bhee nihaal |4|
English: The Guru has torn away the veil of illusion, and beholding the jewel, I am delighted. ||4||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਇਆ ਸਾਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: jin chaakhiaa tis aaeaa saad |
English: One who has tasted it, comes to know its flavor;

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਗੂੰਗਾ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: jiau goongaa man meh bisamaad |
English: he is like the mute, whose mind is filled with wonder.

Gurbani: ਆਨਦ ਰੂਪੁ ਸਭੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aanad roop sabh nadaree aaeaa |
English: I see the Lord, the source of bliss, everywhere.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਆਖਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੫॥੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak har gun aakh samaaeaa |5|1|
English: Servant Nanak speaks the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and merges in Him. ||5||1||

[Ang 801 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਕੀਏ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: sarab kaliaan kee guradev |
English: The Divine Guru has blessed me with total happiness.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਕੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਲਾਇਓ ਸੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: sevak apanee laaeo sev |
English: He has linked His servant to His service.

Gurbani: ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਜਪਿ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bighan na laagai jap alakh abhev |1|
English: No obstacles block my path, meditating on the incomprehensible, inscrutable Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਧਰਤਿ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਭਈ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: dharat puneet bhee gun gaae |
English: The soil has been sanctified, singing the Glories of His Praises.

Gurbani: ਦੁਰਤੁ ਗਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: durat geaa har naam dhiaae |1| rahaau |
English: The sins are eradicated, meditating on the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਂਈ ਰਵਿਆ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: sabhanee thaanee raviaa aap |
English: He Himself is pervading everywhere;

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਵਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: aad jugaad jaa kaa vadd parataap |
English: from the very beginning, and throughout the ages, His Glory has been radiantly manifest.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur parasaad na hoe santaap |2|
English: By Guru's Grace, sorrow does not touch me. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਲਗੇ ਮਨਿ ਮੀਠੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur ke charan lage man meetthe |
English: The Guru's Feet seem so sweet to my mind.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਬਿਘਨ ਹੋਇ ਸਭ ਥਾਂਈ ਵੂਠੇ ॥
Transliteration: nirabighan hoe sabh thaanee vootthe |
English: He is unobstructed, dwelling everywhere.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੂਠੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sabh sukh paae satigur tootthe |3|
English: I found total peace, when the Guru was pleased. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਰਖਵਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham prabh bhe rakhavaale |
English: The Supreme Lord God has become my Savior.

Gurbani: ਜਿਥੈ ਕਿਥੈ ਦੀਸਹਿ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: jithai kithai deeseh naale |
English: Wherever I look, I see Him there with me.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਖਸਮਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak daas khasam pratipaale |4|2|
English: O Nanak, the Lord and Master protects and cherishes His slaves. ||4||2||

[Ang 801 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sukh nidhaan preetam prabh mere |
English: You are the treasure of peace, O my Beloved God.

Gurbani: ਅਗਨਤ ਗੁਣ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aganat gun tthaakur prabh tere |
English: Your Glories are uncounted, O God, my Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਅਨਾਥ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: mohi anaath tumaree saranaaee |
English: I am an orphan, entering Your Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa har charan dhiaaee |1|
English: Have Mercy on me, O Lord, that I may meditate on Your Feet. ||1||

Gurbani: ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਬਸਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: deaa karahu basahu man aae |
English: Take pity upon me, and abide within my mind;

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਲੀਜੈ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mohi niragun leejai larr laae | rahaau |
English: I am worthless - please let me grasp hold of the hem of Your robe. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾ ਕੈਸੀ ਭੀੜ ॥
Transliteration: prabh chit aavai taa kaisee bheerr |
English: When God comes into my consciousness, what misfortune can strike me?

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਮ ਪੀੜ ॥
Transliteration: har sevak naahee jam peerr |
English: The Lord's servant does not suffer pain from the Messenger of Death.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਦੂਖ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਸੇ ॥
Transliteration: sarab dookh har simarat nase |
English: All pains are dispelled, when one remembers the Lord in meditation;

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਸੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jaa kai sang sadaa prabh basai |2|
English: God abides with him forever. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kaa naam man tan aadhaar |
English: The Name of God is the Support of my mind and body.

Gurbani: ਬਿਸਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੋਵਤ ਤਨੁ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: bisarat naam hovat tan chhaar |
English: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the body is reduced to ashes.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਏ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭ ਕਾਜ ॥
Transliteration: prabh chit aae pooran sabh kaaj |
English: When God comes into my consciousness, all my affairs are resolved.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਸਭ ਕਾ ਮੁਹਤਾਜ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har bisarat sabh kaa muhataaj |3|
English: Forgetting the Lord, one becomes subservient to all. ||3||

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal sang laagee preet |
English: I am in love with the Lotus Feet of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਬਿਸਰਿ ਗਈ ਸਭ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: bisar gee sabh duramat reet |
English: I am rid of all evil-minded ways.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: man tan antar har har mant |
English: The Mantra of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, is deep within my mind and body.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦ ॥੪॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak bhagatan kai ghar sadaa anand |4|3|
English: O Nanak, eternal bliss fills the home of the Lord's devotees. ||4||3||

[Ang 802 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਯਾਨੜੀਏ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਗਾਵਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: raag bilaaval mahalaa 5 ghar 2 yaanarree kai ghar gaavanaa |
English: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Second House, To Be Sung To The Tune Of Yaan-Ree-Ay:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ॥
Transliteration: mai man teree ttek mere piaare mai man teree ttek |
English: You are the Support of my mind, O my Beloved, You are the Support of my mind.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਬਿਰਥੀਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਾਖਨ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਏਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: avar siaanapaa biratheea piaare raakhan kau tum ek |1| rahaau |
English: All other clever tricks are useless, O Beloved; You alone are my Protector. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਹੋਤ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: satigur pooraa je milai piaare so jan hot nihaalaa |
English: One who meets with the Perfect True Guru, O Beloved, that humble person is enraptured.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur kee sevaa so kare piaare jis no hoe deaalaa |
English: He alone serves the Guru, O Beloved, unto whom the Lord becomes merciful.

Gurbani: ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: safal moorat guradeo suaamee sarab kalaa bharapoore |
English: Fruitful is the form of the Divine Guru, O Lord and Master; He is overflowing with all powers.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak gur paarabraham paramesar sadaa sadaa hajoore |1|
English: O Nanak, the Guru is the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord; He is ever-present, forever and ever. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਸੋਇ ਤਿਨਾ ਕੀ ਜਿਨੑ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: sun sun jeevaa soe tinaa kee jina apunaa prabh jaataa |
English: I live by hearing, hearing of those who know their God.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: har naam araadheh naam vakhaaneh har naame hee man raataa |
English: They contemplate the Lord's Name, they chant the Lord's Name, and their minds are imbued with the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਮਾਗੈ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਕਮਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: sevak jan kee sevaa maagai poorai karam kamaavaa |
English: I am Your servant; I beg to serve Your humble servants. By the karma of perfect destiny, I do this.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਦੇਖਣੁ ਪਾਵਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak kee benantee suaamee tere jan dekhan paavaa |2|
English: This is Nanak's prayer: O my Lord and Master, may I obtain the Blessed Vision of Your humble servants. ||2||

Gurbani: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸੇ ਕਾਢੀਅਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਵਾਸੋ ॥
Transliteration: vaddabhaagee se kaadteeeh piaare santasangat jinaa vaaso |
English: They are said to be very fortunate, O Beloved, who dwell in the Society of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧੀਐ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮਨੈ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਗਾਸੋ ॥
Transliteration: amrit naam araadheeai niramal manai hovai paragaaso |
English: They contemplate the Immaculate, Ambrosial Naam, and their minds are illuminated.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਚੂਕੈ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਕਾਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: janam maran dukh kaatteeai piaare chookai jam kee kaane |
English: The pains of birth and death are eradicated, O Beloved, and the fear of the Messenger of Death is ended.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨਾ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਣੇ ਭਾਣੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tinaa paraapat darasan naanak jo prabh apane bhaane |3|
English: They alone obtain the Blessed Vision of this Darshan, O Nanak, who are pleasing to their God. ||3||

Gurbani: ਊਚ ਅਪਾਰ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਉਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aooch apaar beant suaamee kaun jaanai gun tere |
English: O my lofty, incomparable and infinite Lord and Master, who can know Your Glorious Virtues?

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਤੇ ਉਧਰਹਿ ਸੁਣਤੇ ਉਧਰਹਿ ਬਿਨਸਹਿ ਪਾਪ ਘਨੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gaavate udhareh sunate udhareh binaseh paap ghanere |
English: Those who sing them are saved, and those who listen to them are saved; all their sins are erased.

Gurbani: ਪਸੂ ਪਰੇਤ ਮੁਗਧ ਕਉ ਤਾਰੇ ਪਾਹਨ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: pasoo paret mugadh kau taare paahan paar utaarai |
English: You save the beasts, demons and fools, and even stones are carried across.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ॥੪॥੧॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak daas teree saranaaee sadaa sadaa balihaarai |4|1|4|
English: Slave Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary; he is forever and ever a sacrifice to You. ||4||1||4||

[Ang 802 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬਿਖੈ ਬਨੁ ਫੀਕਾ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਰੀ ਸਖੀਏ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਓ ॥
Transliteration: bikhai ban feekaa tiaag ree sakhee naam mahaa ras peeo |
English: Renounce the tasteless water of corruption, O my companion, and drink in the supreme nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਰਸ ਚਾਖੇ ਬੁਡਿ ਗਈ ਸਗਲੀ ਸੁਖੀ ਨ ਹੋਵਤ ਜੀਓ ॥
Transliteration: bin ras chaakhe budd gee sagalee sukhee na hovat jeeo |
English: Without the taste of this nectar, all have drowned, and their souls have not found happiness.

Gurbani: ਮਾਨੁ ਮਹਤੁ ਨ ਸਕਤਿ ਹੀ ਕਾਈ ਸਾਧਾ ਦਾਸੀ ਥੀਓ ॥
Transliteration: maan mehat na sakat hee kaaee saadhaa daasee theeo |
English: You have no honor, glory or power - become the slave of the Holy Saints.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੇ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਕੀਓ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak se dar sobhaavante jo prabh apunai keeo |1|
English: O Nanak, they alone look beautiful in the Court of the Lord, whom the Lord has made His Own. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿਚੰਦਉਰੀ ਚਿਤ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਸਖੀਏ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: harichandauree chit bhram sakhee mrig trisanaa drum chhaaeaa |
English: Maya is a mirage, which deludes the mind, O my companion, like the scent-crazed deer, or the transitory shade of a tree.

Gurbani: ਚੰਚਲਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲਤੀ ਸਖੀਏ ਅੰਤਿ ਤਜਿ ਜਾਵਤ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: chanchal sang na chaalatee sakhee ant taj jaavat maaeaa |
English: Maya is fickle, and does not go with you, O my companion; in the end, it will leave you.

Gurbani: ਰਸਿ ਭੋਗਣ ਅਤਿ ਰੂਪ ਰਸ ਮਾਤੇ ਇਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੂਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: ras bhogan at roop ras maate in sang sookh na paaeaa |
English: He may enjoy pleasures and sensual delights with supremely beautiful women, but no one finds peace in this way.

Gurbani: ਧੰਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਸਖੀਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan har saadh jan sakhee naanak jinee naam dhiaaeaa |2|
English: Blessed, blessed are the humble, Holy Saints of the Lord, O my companion. O Nanak, they meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਾਇ ਬਸਹੁ ਵਡਭਾਗਣੀ ਸਖੀਏ ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: jaae basahu vaddabhaaganee sakhee santaa sang samaaeeai |
English: Go, O my very fortunate companion: dwell in the Company of the Saints, and merge with the Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਹ ਦੂਖ ਨ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਰੋਗੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: teh dookh na bhookh na rog biaapai charan kamal liv laaeeai |
English: There, neither pain nor hunger nor disease will afflict you; enshrine love for the Lord's Lotus Feet.

Gurbani: ਤਹ ਜਨਮ ਨ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: teh janam na maran na aavan jaanaa nihachal saranee paaeeai |
English: There is no birth or death there, no coming or going in reincarnation, when you enter the Sanctuary of the Eternal Lord.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਿਛੋਹੁ ਨ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: prem bichhohu na mohu biaapai naanak har ek dhiaaeeai |3|
English: Love does not end, and attachment does not grip you, O Nanak, when you meditate on the One Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਤੜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: drisatt dhaar man bedhiaa piaare ratarre sehaj subhaae |
English: Bestowing His Glance of Grace, my Beloved has pierced my mind, and I am intuitively attuned to His Love.

Gurbani: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sej suhaavee sang mil preetam anad mangal gun gaae |
English: My bed is embellished, meeting with my Beloved; in ecstasy and bliss, I sing His Glorious Praises.

Gurbani: ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sakhee sahelee raam rang raatee man tan ichh pujaae |
English: O my friends and companions, I am imbued with the Lord's Love; the desires of my mind and body are satisfied.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਅਚਰਜ ਸਿਉ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥੪॥੨॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak acharaj acharaj siau miliaa kahanaa kachhoo na jaae |4|2|5|
English: O Nanak, the wonder-struck soul blends with the Wonderful Lord; this state cannot be described. ||4||2||5||

[Ang 803 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: raag bilaaval mahalaa 5 ghar 4 |
English: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਰੂਪ ਸਗਲੋ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: ek roop sagalo paasaaraa |
English: The entire Universe is the form of the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਬਨਜੁ ਆਪਿ ਬਿਉਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aape banaj aap biauhaaraa |1|
English: He Himself is the trade, and He Himself is the trader. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸੋ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬਿਰਲੋ ਈ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aiso giaan biralo ee paae |
English: How rare is that one who is blessed with such spiritual wisdom.

Gurbani: ਜਤ ਜਤ ਜਾਈਐ ਤਤ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jat jat jaaeeai tat drisattaae |1| rahaau |
English: Wherever I go, there I see Him. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਰੰਗ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਇਕ ਰੰਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: anik rang niragun ik rangaa |
English: He manifests many forms, while still unmanifest and absolute, and yet He has One Form.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਜਲੁ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਤਰੰਗਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aape jal aap hee tarangaa |2|
English: He Himself is the water, and He Himself is the waves. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਪ ਹੀ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਆਪਹਿ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: aap hee mandar aapeh sevaa |
English: He Himself is the temple, and He Himself is selfless service.

Gurbani: ਆਪ ਹੀ ਪੂਜਾਰੀ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਦੇਵਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aap hee poojaaree aap hee devaa |3|
English: He Himself is the worshipper, and He Himself is the idol. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਪਹਿ ਜੋਗ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: aapeh jog aap hee jugataa |
English: He Himself is the Yoga; He Himself is the Way.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੬॥
Transliteration: naanak ke prabh sad hee mukataa |4|1|6|
English: Nanak's God is forever liberated. ||4||1||6||

[Ang 803 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਵਨ ਆਪਿ ਸਧਰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: aap upaavan aap sadharanaa |
English: He Himself creates, and He Himself supports.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਲੈਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aap karaavan dos na lainaa |1|
English: He Himself causes all to act; He takes no blame Himself. ||1||

Gurbani: ਆਪਨ ਬਚਨੁ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: aapan bachan aap hee karanaa |
English: He Himself is the teaching, and He Himself is the teacher.

Gurbani: ਆਪਨ ਬਿਭਉ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਜਰਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aapan bibhau aap hee jaranaa |1| rahaau |
English: He Himself is the splendor, and He Himself is the experiencer of it. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਪ ਹੀ ਮਸਟਿ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਬੁਲਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: aap hee masatt aap hee bulanaa |
English: He Himself is silent, and He Himself is the speaker.

Gurbani: ਆਪ ਹੀ ਅਛਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਛਲਨਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aap hee achhal na jaaee chhalanaa |2|
English: He Himself is undeceivable; He cannot be deceived. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਪ ਹੀ ਗੁਪਤ ਆਪਿ ਪਰਗਟਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: aap hee gupat aap paragattanaa |
English: He Himself is hidden, and He Himself is manifest.

Gurbani: ਆਪ ਹੀ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਆਪਿ ਅਲਿਪਨਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aap hee ghatt ghatt aap alipanaa |3|
English: He Himself is in each and every heart; He Himself is unattached. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਅਵਿਗਤੁ ਆਪ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਚਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape avigat aap sang rachanaa |
English: He Himself is absolute, and He Himself is with the Universe.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਜਚਨਾ ॥੪॥੨॥੭॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak prabh ke sabh jachanaa |4|2|7|
English: Says Nanak, all are beggars of God. ||4||2||7||

[Ang 803 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਭੂਲੇ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਜਿਨਹਿ ਬਤਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bhoole maarag jineh bataaeaa |
English: He places the one who strays back on the Path;

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aisaa gur vaddabhaagee paaeaa |1|
English: such a Guru is found by great good fortune. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਮਨਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਿਤਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: simar manaa raam naam chitaare |
English: Meditate, contemplate the Name of the Lord, O mind.

Gurbani: ਬਸਿ ਰਹੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bas rahe hiradai gur charan piaare |1| rahaau |
English: The Beloved Feet of the Guru abide within my heart. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh lobh mohi man leenaa |
English: The mind is engrossed in sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment.

Gurbani: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bandhan kaatt mukat gur keenaa |2|
English: Breaking my bonds, the Guru has liberated me. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਕਰਤ ਜਨਮਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਮੂਆ ॥
Transliteration: dukh sukh karat janam fun mooaa |
English: Experiencing pain and pleasure, one is born, only to die again.

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਗੁਰਿ ਆਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਦੀਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: charan kamal gur aasram deea |3|
English: The Lotus Feet of the Guru bring peace and shelter. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਬੂਡਤ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: agan saagar booddat sansaaraa |
English: The world is drowning in the ocean of fire.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਹ ਪਕਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੮॥
Transliteration: naanak baah pakar satigur nisataaraa |4|3|8|
English: O Nanak, holding me by the arm, the True Guru has saved me. ||4||3||8||

[Ang 804 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਅਰਪਉ ਸਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: tan man dhan arpau sabh apanaa |
English: Body, mind, wealth and everything, I surrender to my Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਮਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kavan su mat jit har har japanaa |1|
English: What is that wisdom, by which I may come to chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har? ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਆਸਾ ਆਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਗਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: kar aasaa aaeo prabh maagan |
English: Nurturing hope, I have come to beg from God.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮੑ ਪੇਖਤ ਸੋਭਾ ਮੇਰੈ ਆਗਨਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tuma pekhat sobhaa merai aagan |1| rahaau |
English: Gazing upon You, the courtyard of my heart is embellished. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਉ ॥
Transliteration: anik jugat kar bahut beechaarau |
English: Trying several methods, I reflect deeply upon the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਇਸੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਉਧਾਰਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saadhasang is maneh udhaarau |2|
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, this mind is saved. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: mat budh surat naahee chaturaaee |
English: I have neither intelligence, wisdom, common sense nor cleverness.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਜਾ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: taa mileeai jaa le milaaee |3|
English: I meet You, only if You lead me to meet You. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨੈਨ ਸੰਤੋਖੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: nain santokhe prabh darasan paaeaa |
English: My eyes are content, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਫਲੁ ਸੋ ਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੪॥੯॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak safal so aaeaa |4|4|9|
English: Says Nanak, such a life is fruitful and rewarding. ||4||4||9||

[Ang 804 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: maat pitaa sut saath na maaeaa |
English: Mother, father, children and the wealth of Maya, will not go along with you.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸਭੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saadhasang sabh dookh mittaaeaa |1|
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, all pain is dispelled. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਆਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: rav rahiaa prabh sabh meh aape |
English: God Himself is pervading, and permeating all.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har jap rasanaa dukh na viaape |1| rahaau |
English: Chant the Name of the Lord with your tongue, and pain will not afflict you. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤਿਖਾ ਭੂਖ ਬਹੁ ਤਪਤਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: tikhaa bhookh bahu tapat viaapiaa |
English: One who is afflicted by the terrible fire of thirst and desire,

Gurbani: ਸੀਤਲ ਭਏ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਜਾਪਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: seetal bhe har har jas jaapiaa |2|
English: becomes cool, chanting the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਤਨ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kott jatan santokh na paaeaa |
English: By millions of efforts, peace is not obtained;

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: man tripataanaa har gun gaaeaa |3|
English: the mind is satisfied only by singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦੇਹੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: dehu bhagat prabh antarajaamee |
English: Please bless me with devotion, O God, O Searcher of hearts.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: naanak kee benantee suaamee |4|5|10|
English: This is Nanak's prayer, O Lord and Master. ||4||5||10||

[Ang 804 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: gur pooraa vaddabhaagee paaeeai |
English: By great good fortune, the Perfect Guru is found.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mil saadhoo har naam dhiaaeeai |1|
English: Meeting with the Holy Saints, meditate on the Name of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham prabh teree saranaa |
English: O Supreme Lord God, I seek Your Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟੈ ਭਜੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kilabikh kaattai bhaj gur ke charanaa |1| rahaau |
English: Meditating on the Guru's Feet, sinful mistakes are erased. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਵਰਿ ਕਰਮ ਸਭਿ ਲੋਕਾਚਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: avar karam sabh lokaachaar |
English: All other rituals are just worldly affairs;

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੋਇ ਉਧਾਰ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mil saadhoo sang hoe udhaar |2|
English: joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one is saved. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sinmrit saasat bed beechaare |
English: One may contemplate the Simritees, Shaastras and Vedas,

Gurbani: ਜਪੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: japeeai naam jit paar utaare |3|
English: but only by chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is one saved and carried across. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: jan naanak kau prabh kirapaa kareeai |
English: Have Mercy upon servant Nanak, O God,

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਿਸਤਰੀਐ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: saadhoo dhoor milai nisatareeai |4|6|11|
English: and bless him with the dust of the feet of the Holy, that he may be emancipated. ||4||6||11||

[Ang 804 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਿਦੇ ਮਹਿ ਚੀਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa sabad ride meh cheenaa |
English: I contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad within my heart;

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸੀਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sagal manorath pooran aaseenaa |1|
English: all my hopes and desires are fulfilled. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲੁ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: sant janaa kaa mukh aoojal keenaa |
English: The faces of the humble Saints are radiant and bright;

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa apunaa naam deenaa |1| rahaau |
English: the Lord has mercifully blessed them with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: andh koop te kar geh leenaa |
English: Holding them by the hand, He has lifted them up out of the deep, dark pit,

Gurbani: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਜਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀਨਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jai jai kaar jagat pragatteenaa |2|
English: and their victory is celebrated throughout the world. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨੀਚਾ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਊਨ ਪੂਰੀਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: neechaa te aooch aoon pooreenaa |
English: He elevates and exalts the lowly, and fills the empty.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਲੀਨਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: amrit naam mahaa ras leenaa |3|
English: They receive the supreme, sublime essence of the Ambrosial Naam. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਪਾਪ ਜਲਿ ਖੀਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: man tan niramal paap jal kheenaa |
English: The mind and body are made immaculate and pure, and sins are burnt to ashes.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਪ੍ਰਸੀਨਾ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak prabh bhe praseenaa |4|7|12|
English: Says Nanak, God is pleased with me. ||4||7||12||

[Ang 804 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: sagal manorath paaeeeh meetaa |
English: All desires are fulfilled, O my friend,

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਈਐ ਚੀਤਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: charan kamal siau laaeeai cheetaa |1|
English: lovingly centering your consciousness on the Lord's Lotus Feet. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਧਿਆਵਤ ॥
Transliteration: hau balihaaree jo prabhoo dhiaavat |
English: I am a sacrifice to those who meditate on God.

Gurbani: ਜਲਨਿ ਬੁਝੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jalan bujhai har har gun gaavat |1| rahaau |
English: The fire of desire is quenched, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਹੋਵਤ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: safal janam hovat vaddabhaagee |
English: One's life become fruitful and rewarding, by great good fortune.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਮਹਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saadhasang raameh liv laagee |2|
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, enshrine love for the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: mat pat dhan sukh sehaj anandaa |
English: Wisdom, honor, wealth, peace and celestial bliss are attained,

Gurbani: ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਵਿਸਰਹੁ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: eik nimakh na visarahu paramaanandaa |3|
English: If one does not forget the Lord of supreme bliss, even for an instant. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਮਨਿ ਪਿਆਸ ਘਨੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: har darasan kee man piaas ghaneree |
English: My mind is so very thirsty for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

Gurbani: ਭਨਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ॥੪॥੮॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: bhanat naanak saran prabh teree |4|8|13|
English: Prays Nanak, O God, I seek Your Sanctuary. ||4||8||13||

[Ang 805 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਸਭ ਗੁਣਹ ਬਿਹੂਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: mohi niragun sabh gunah bihoonaa |
English: I am worthless, totally lacking all virtues.

Gurbani: ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਿ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: deaa dhaar apunaa kar leenaa |1|
English: Bless me with Your Mercy, and make me Your Own. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਪਾਲਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: meraa man tan har gopaal suhaaeaa |
English: My mind and body are embellished by the Lord, the Lord of the World.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh ghar meh aaeaa |1| rahaau |
English: Granting His Mercy, God has come into the home of my heart. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਭੈ ਕਾਟਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat vachhal bhai kaattanahaare |
English: He is the Lover and Protector of His devotees, the Destroyer of fear.

Gurbani: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਅਬ ਉਤਰੇ ਪਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sansaar saagar ab utare paare |2|
English: Now, I have been carried across the world-ocean. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਬੇਦਿ ਲੇਖਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: patit paavan prabh birad bed lekhiaa |
English: It is God's Way to purify sinners, say the Vedas.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸੋ ਨੈਨਹੁ ਪੇਖਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: paarabraham so nainahu pekhiaa |3|
English: I have seen the Supreme Lord with my eyes. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang pragatte naaraaein |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Lord becomes manifest.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਭਿ ਦੂਖ ਪਲਾਇਣ ॥੪॥੯॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: naanak daas sabh dookh palaaein |4|9|14|
English: O slave Nanak, all pains are relieved. ||4||9||14||

[Ang 805 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਵਨੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: kavan jaanai prabh tumaree sevaa |
English: Who can know the value of serving You, God?

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਵਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: prabh avinaasee alakh abhevaa |1|
English: God is imperishable, invisible and incomprehensible. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gun beant prabh gahir ganbheere |
English: His Glorious Virtues are infinite; God is profound and unfathomable.

Gurbani: ਊਚ ਮਹਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aooch mehal suaamee prabh mere |
English: The Mansion of God, my Lord and Master, is lofty and high.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: too aparanpar tthaakur mere |1| rahaau |
English: You are unlimited, O my Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਏਕਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: ekas bin naahee ko doojaa |
English: There is no other than the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮੑ ਹੀ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਪੂਜਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tuma hee jaanahu apanee poojaa |2|
English: You alone know Your worship and adoration. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਪਹੁ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵਤ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aapahu kachhoo na hovat bhaaee |
English: No one can do anything by himself, O Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jis prabh devai so naam paaee |3|
English: He alone obtains the Naam, the Name of the Lord, unto whom God bestows it. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak jo jan prabh bhaaeaa |
English: Says Nanak, that humble being who pleases God,

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: gun nidhaan prabh tin hee paaeaa |4|10|15|
English: he alone finds God, the treasure of virtue. ||4||10||15||

[Ang 805 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਮਹਿ ਹਾਥ ਦੇ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: maat garabh meh haath de raakhiaa |
English: Extending His Hand, the Lord protected you in your mother's womb.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har ras chhodd bikhiaa fal chaakhiaa |1|
English: Renouncing the sublime essence of the Lord, you have tasted the fruit of poison. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਜੁ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਸਭ ਛੋਡਿ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: bhaj gobid sabh chhodd janjaal |
English: Meditate, vibrate on the Lord of the Universe, and renounce all entanglements.

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਜਮੁ ਆਇ ਸੰਘਾਰੈ ਮੂੜੇ ਤਬ ਤਨੁ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਬੇਹਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jab jam aae sanghaarai moorre tab tan binas jaae behaal |1| rahaau |
English: When the Messenger of Death comes to murder you, O fool, then your body will be shattered and helplessly crumble. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਪਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: tan man dhan apanaa kar thaapiaa |
English: You hold onto your body, mind and wealth as your own,

Gurbani: ਕਰਨਹਾਰੁ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਜਾਪਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: karanahaar ik nimakh na jaapiaa |2|
English: and you do not meditate on the Creator Lord, even for an instant. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹ ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਪਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: mahaa moh andh koop pariaa |
English: You have fallen into the deep, dark pit of great attachment.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਪਟਲਿ ਬਿਸਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: paarabraham maaeaa pattal bisariaa |3|
English: Caught in the illusion of Maya, you have forgotten the Supreme Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: vaddai bhaag prabh keeratan gaaeaa |
English: By great good fortune, one sings the Kirtan of God's Praises.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: santasang naanak prabh paaeaa |4|11|16|
English: In the Society of the Saints, Nanak has found God. ||4||11||16||

[Ang 805 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: maat pitaa sut bandhap bhaaee |
English: Mother, father, children, relatives and siblings

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੋਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak hoaa paarabraham sahaaee |1|
English: - O Nanak, the Supreme Lord is our help and support. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਘਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: sookh sehaj aanand ghane |
English: He blesses us with peace, and abundant celestial bliss.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪੂਰੀ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਅਨਿਕ ਗੁਣਾ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਨ ਗਣੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur pooraa pooree jaa kee baanee anik gunaa jaa ke jaeh na gane |1| rahaau |
English: Perfect is the Bani, the Word of the Perfect Guru. His Virtues are so many, they cannot be counted. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਸਰੰਜਾਮ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: sagal saranjaam kare prabh aape |
English: God Himself makes all arrangements.

Gurbani: ਭਏ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਪੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bhe manorath so prabh jaape |2|
English: Meditating on God, desires are fulfilled. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਰਥ ਧਰਮ ਕਾਮ ਮੋਖ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: arath dharam kaam mokh kaa daataa |
English: He is the Giver of wealth, Dharmic faith, pleasure and liberation.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੀ ਭਈ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: pooree bhee simar simar bidhaataa |3|
English: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Creator Lord, the Architect of Destiny, I am fulfilled. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang naanak rang maaniaa |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak enjoys the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਆਣਿਆ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: ghar aaeaa poorai gur aaniaa |4|12|17|
English: He has returned home, with the Perfect Guru. ||4||12||17||

[Ang 806 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: srab nidhaan pooran guradev |1| rahaau |
English: All treasures come from the Perfect Divine Guru. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਨਰ ਜੀਵੇ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam japat nar jeeve |
English: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the man lives.

Gurbani: ਮਰਿ ਖੁਆਰੁ ਸਾਕਤ ਨਰ ਥੀਵੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mar khuaar saakat nar theeve |1|
English: The faithless cynic dies in shame and misery. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੋਆ ਰਖਵਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam hoaa rakhavaaraa |
English: The Name of the Lord has become my Protector.

Gurbani: ਝਖ ਮਾਰਉ ਸਾਕਤੁ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jhakh maarau saakat vechaaraa |2|
English: The wretched, faithless cynic makes only useless efforts. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਪਚਹਿ ਘਨੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: nindaa kar kar pacheh ghanere |
English: Spreading slander, many have been ruined.

Gurbani: ਮਿਰਤਕ ਫਾਸ ਗਲੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਪੈਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: miratak faas galai sir paire |3|
English: Their necks, heads and feet are tied by death's noose. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪਹਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak japeh jan naam |
English: Says Nanak, the humble devotees chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਮ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: taa ke nikatt na aavai jaam |4|13|18|
English: The Messenger of Death does not even approach them. ||4||13||18||

[Ang 806 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: raag bilaaval mahalaa 5 ghar 4 dupade |
English: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House, Dho-Padhay:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਕਵਨ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਮਿਲਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: kavan sanjog milau prabh apane |
English: What blessed destiny will lead me to meet my God?

Gurbani: ਪਲੁ ਪਲੁ ਨਿਮਖ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: pal pal nimakh sadaa har japane |1|
English: Each and every moment and instant, I continually meditate on the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal prabh ke nit dhiaavau |
English: I meditate continually on the Lotus Feet of God.

Gurbani: ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਮਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kavan su mat jit preetam paavau |1| rahaau |
English: What wisdom will lead me to attain my Beloved? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਐਸੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aisee kripaa karahu prabh mere |
English: Please, bless me with such Mercy, O my God,

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਸਰੁ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਬੇਰੇ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: har naanak bisar na kaahoo bere |2|1|19|
English: that Nanak may never, ever forget You. ||2||1||19||

[Ang 806 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal prabh hiradai dhiaae |
English: Within my heart, I meditate on the Lotus Feet of God.

Gurbani: ਰੋਗ ਗਏ ਸਗਲੇ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: rog ge sagale sukh paae |1|
English: Disease is gone, and I have found total peace. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟਿਆ ਦੀਨੋ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur dukh kaattiaa deeno daan |
English: The Guru relieved my sufferings, and blessed me with the gift.

Gurbani: ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਜੀਵਨ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: safal janam jeevan paravaan |1| rahaau |
English: My birth has been rendered fruitful, and my life is approved. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: akath kathaa amrit prabh baanee |
English: The Ambrosial Bani of God's Word is the Unspoken Speech.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵੇ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥੨॥੨॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak jap jeeve giaanee |2|2|20|
English: Says Nanak, the spiritually wise live by meditating on God. ||2||2||20||

[Ang 806 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: saant paaee gur satigur poore |
English: The Guru, the Perfect True Guru, has blessed me with peace and tranquility.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਉਪਜੇ ਬਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਤੂਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sukh upaje baaje anahad toore |1| rahaau |
English: Peace and joy have welled up, and the mystical trumpets of the unstruck sound current vibrate. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤਾਪ ਪਾਪ ਸੰਤਾਪ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ॥
Transliteration: taap paap santaap binaase |
English: Sufferings, sins and afflictions have been dispelled.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਸਭਿ ਨਾਸੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har simarat kilavikh sabh naase |1|
English: Remembering the Lord in meditation, all sinful mistakes have been erased. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਨਦੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: anad karahu mil sundar naaree |
English: Joining together, O beautiful soul-brides, celebrate and make merry.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੨॥੩॥੨੧॥
Transliteration: gur naanak meree paij savaaree |2|3|21|
English: Guru Nanak has saved my honor. ||2||3||21||

[Ang 806 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹ ਧ੍ਰੋਹ ਮਦਿ ਮਾਤਾ ਬੰਧਨਿ ਬਾਧਿਆ ਅਤਿ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: mamataa moh dhroh mad maataa bandhan baadhiaa at bikaraal |
English: Intoxicated with the wine of attachment, love of worldly possessions and deceit, and bound in bondage, he is wild and hideous.

Gurbani: ਦਿਨੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਛਿਜਤ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਕਰਤ ਅਉਧ ਫਾਹੀ ਫਾਥਾ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਜਾਲ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: din din chhijat bikaar karat aaudh faahee faathaa jam kai jaal |1|
English: Day by day, his life is winding down; practicing sin and corruption, he is trapped by the noose of Death. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: teree saran prabh deen deaalaa |
English: I seek Your Sanctuary, O God, Merciful to the meek.

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਮ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ਉਧਰਹੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਵਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mahaa bikham saagar at bhaaree udharahu saadhoo sang ravaalaa |1| rahaau |
English: I have crossed over the terrible, treacherous, enormous world-ocean, with the dust of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਸਮਰਥ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਮਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: prabh sukhadaate samarath suaamee jeeo pindd sabh tumaraa maal |
English: O God, Giver of peace, All-powerful Lord and Master, my soul, body and all wealth are Yours.

Gurbani: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਹੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਦਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥੨॥੪॥੨੨॥
Transliteration: bhram ke bandhan kaattahu paramesar naanak ke prabh sadaa kripaal |2|4|22|
English: Please, break my bonds of doubt, O Transcendent Lord, forever Merciful God of Nanak. ||2||4||22||

[Ang 806 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਕੀਆ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਅਪਣਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸਮੑਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sagal anand keea paramesar apanaa birad samaariaa |
English: The Transcendent Lord has brought bliss to all; He has confirmed His Natural Way.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਹੋਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ਬਿਗਸੇ ਸਭਿ ਪਰਵਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saadh janaa hoe kirapaalaa bigase sabh paravaariaa |1|
English: He has become Merciful to the humble, holy Saints, and all my relatives blossom forth in joy. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: kaaraj satigur aap savaariaa |
English: The True Guru Himself has resolved my affairs.

Gurbani: ਵਡੀ ਆਰਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕੀ ਸੂਖ ਮੰਗਲ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: vaddee aarajaa har gobind kee sookh mangal kaliaan beechaariaa |1| rahaau |
English: He has blessed Hargobind with long life, and taken care of my comfort, happiness and well-being. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਵਣ ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਏ ਸਗਲੇ ਜੀਅ ਸਾਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: van trin tribhavan hariaa hoe sagale jeea saadhaariaa |
English: The forests, meadows and the three worlds have blossomed forth in greenery; He gives His Support to all beings.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਪੂਰਨ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਰਿਆ ॥੨॥੫॥੨੩॥
Transliteration: man ichhe naanak fal paae pooran ichh pujaariaa |2|5|23|
English: Nanak has obtained the fruits of his mind's desires; his desires are totally fulfilled. ||2||5||23||

[Ang 807 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਊਪਰਿ ਹੋਵਤ ਦਇਆਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: jis aoopar hovat deaal |
English: One who is blessed by the Lord's Mercy,

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਕਾਟੈ ਸੋ ਕਾਲੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har simarat kaattai so kaal |1| rahaau |
English: passes his time in contemplative meditation. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਭਜੀਐ ਗੋਪਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang bhajeeai gopaal |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, meditate, and vibrate upon the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਤੂਟੈ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gun gaavat toottai jam jaal |1|
English: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the noose of death is cut away. ||1||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: aape satigur aape pratipaal |
English: He Himself is the True Guru, and He Himself is the Cherisher.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਸਾਧ ਰਵਾਲ ॥੨॥੬॥੨੪॥
Transliteration: naanak jaachai saadh ravaal |2|6|24|
English: Nanak begs for the dust of the feet of the Holy. ||2||6||24||

[Ang 807 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਿੰਚਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: man meh sinchahu har har naam |
English: Irrigate your mind with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਮ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: anadin keeratan har gun gaam |1|
English: Night and day, sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aisee preet karahu man mere |
English: Enshrine such love, O my mind,

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਨੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar prabh jaanahu nere |1| rahaau |
English: that twenty-four hours a day, God will seem near to you. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਭਾਗ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak jaa ke niramal bhaag |
English: Says Nanak, one who has such immaculate destiny

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨੀ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗ ॥੨॥੭॥੨੫॥
Transliteration: har charanee taa kaa man laag |2|7|25|
English: - his mind is attached to the Lord's Feet. ||2||7||25||

[Ang 807 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: rog geaa prabh aap gavaaeaa |
English: The disease is gone; God Himself took it away.

Gurbani: ਨੀਦ ਪਈ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਘਰੁ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: need pee sukh sehaj ghar aaeaa |1| rahaau |
English: I sleep in peace; peaceful poise has come to my home. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਰਜਿ ਰਜਿ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਖਾਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: raj raj bhojan khaavahu mere bhaaee |
English: Eat to your fill, O my Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦ ਮਾਹਿ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: amrit naam rid maeh dhiaaee |1|
English: Meditate on the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, within your heart. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: naanak gur poore saranaaee |
English: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Perfect Guru,

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਅਪਨੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ॥੨॥੮॥੨੬॥
Transliteration: jin apane naam kee paij rakhaaee |2|8|26|
English: who has preserved the honor of His Name. ||2||8||26||

[Ang 807 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੇ ਅਸਥਿਰ ਘਰ ਬਾਰ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur kar deene asathir ghar baar | rahaau |
English: The True Guru has protected my hearth and home, and made them permanent. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਨਿੰਦ ਕਰੈ ਇਨ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਨ ਕੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਹੀ ਮਾਰੈ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jo jo nind karai in grihan kee tis aagai hee maarai karataar |1|
English: Whoever slanders these homes, is pre-destined by the Creator Lord to be destroyed. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾਈ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਖੰਡ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੨॥੯॥੨੭॥
Transliteration: naanak daas taa kee saranaaee jaa ko sabad akhandd apaar |2|9|27|
English: Slave Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God; the Word of His Shabad is unbreakable and infinite. ||2||9||27||

[Ang 807 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤਾਪ ਸੰਤਾਪ ਸਗਲੇ ਗਏ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਤੇ ਰੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: taap santaap sagale ge binase te rog |
English: The fever and sickness are gone, and the diseases are all dispelled.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਤੂ ਬਖਸਿਆ ਸੰਤਨ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham too bakhasiaa santan ras bhog | rahaau |
English: The Supreme Lord God has forgiven you, so enjoy the happiness of the Saints. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਮੰਡਲੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਆਰੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: sarab sukhaa teree manddalee teraa man tan aarog |
English: All joys have entered your world, and your mind and body are free of disease.

Gurbani: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਰਾਮ ਕੇ ਇਹ ਅਵਖਦ ਜੋਗ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gun gaavahu nit raam ke ih avakhad jog |1|
English: So chant continuously the Glorious Praises of the Lord; this is the only potent medicine. ||1||

Gurbani: ਆਇ ਬਸਹੁ ਘਰ ਦੇਸ ਮਹਿ ਇਹ ਭਲੇ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: aae basahu ghar des meh ih bhale sanjog |
English: So come, and dwell in your home and native land; this is such a blessed and auspicious occasion.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਲਹਿ ਗਏ ਬਿਓਗ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੨੮॥
Transliteration: naanak prabh suprasan bhe leh ge biog |2|10|28|
English: O Nanak, God is totally pleased with you; your time of separation has come to an end. ||2||10||28||

[Ang 807 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲਹੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: kaahoo sang na chaalahee maaeaa janjaal |
English: The entanglements of Maya do not go along with anyone.

Gurbani: ਊਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਰੇ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਖਿਆਲ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aootth sidhaare chhatrapat santan kai khiaal | rahaau |
English: Even kings and rulers must arise and depart, according to the wisdom of the Saints. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਕਉ ਬਿਨਸਨਾ ਇਹ ਧੁਰ ਕੀ ਢਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: ahanbudh kau binasanaa ih dhur kee dtaal |
English: Pride goes before the fall - this is a primal law.

Gurbani: ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bahu jonee janameh mareh bikhiaa bikaraal |1|
English: Those who practice corruption and sin, are born into countless incarnations, only to die again. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿ ਬਚਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਕਹਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਜਪਹਿ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: sat bachan saadhoo kaheh nit japeh gupaal |
English: The Holy Saints chant Words of Truth; they meditate continually on the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਰੰਗ ਲਾਲ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੨੯॥
Transliteration: simar simar naanak tare har ke rang laal |2|11|29|
English: Meditating, meditating in remembrance, O Nanak, those who are imbued with the color of the Lord's Love are carried across. ||2||11||29||

[Ang 807 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਅਨੰਦ ਸੂਖ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj samaadh anand sookh poore gur deen |
English: The Perfect Guru has blessed me with celestial Samaadhi, bliss and peace.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਗੁਣ ਚੀਨ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sahaaee sang prabh amrit gun cheen | rahaau |
English: God is always my Helper and Companion; I contemplate His Ambrosial Virtues. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਜਗਤ੍ਰ ਮਹਿ ਲੋਚਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਜੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: jai jai kaar jagatr meh locheh sabh jeea |
English: Triumphant cheers greet me all across the world, and all beings yearn for me.

Gurbani: ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕਛੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਥੀਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: suprasan bhe satigur prabhoo kachh bighan na theea |1|
English: The True Guru and God are totally pleased with me; no obstacle blocks my way. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਗੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਸਭ ਦਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kaa ang deaal prabh taa ke sabh daas |
English: One who has the Merciful Lord God on his side - everyone becomes his slave.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੩੦॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa vaddiaaeea naanak gur paas |2|12|30|
English: Forever and ever, O Nanak, glorious greatness rests with the Guru. ||2||12||30||

[Ang 808 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: raag bilaaval mahalaa 5 ghar 5 chaupade |
English: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Fifth House, Chau-Padhay:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਮੰਡਲ ਜਗੁ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਲੂ ਘਰ ਬਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: mrit manddal jag saajiaa jiau baaloo ghar baar |
English: This perishable realm and world has been made like a house of sand.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਸਤ ਬਾਰ ਨ ਲਾਗਈ ਜਿਉ ਕਾਗਦ ਬੂੰਦਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: binasat baar na laagee jiau kaagad boondaar |1|
English: In no time at all, it is destroyed, like the paper drenched with water. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁਨਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਤਿ ਦੇਖੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: sun meree manasaa manai maeh sat dekh beechaar |
English: Listen to me, people: behold, and consider this within your mind.

Gurbani: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਜੋਗੀ ਤਜਿ ਗਏ ਘਰ ਬਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sidh saadhik girahee jogee taj ge ghar baar |1| rahaau |
English: The Siddhas, the seekers, house-holders and Yogis have forsaken their homes and left. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੈਸਾ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਰੈਨਿ ਕਾ ਤੈਸਾ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: jaisaa supanaa rain kaa taisaa sansaar |
English: This world is like a dream in the night.

Gurbani: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿਮਾਨ ਸਭੁ ਬਿਨਸੀਐ ਕਿਆ ਲਗਹਿ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: drisattimaan sabh binaseeai kiaa lageh gavaar |2|
English: All that is seen shall perish. Why are you attached to it, you fool? ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਹਾ ਸੁ ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤ ਹੈ ਦੇਖੁ ਨੈਨ ਪਸਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: kahaa su bhaaee meet hai dekh nain pasaar |
English: Where are your brothers and friends? Open your eyes and see!

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਚਾਲੇ ਇਕਿ ਚਾਲਸਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਅਪਨੀ ਵਾਰ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: eik chaale ik chaalaseh sabh apanee vaar |3|
English: Some have gone, and some will go; everyone must take his turn. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਸੇ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jin pooraa satigur seviaa se asathir har duaar |
English: Those who serve the Perfect True Guru, remain ever-stable at the Door of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਰਾਖੁ ਪੈਜ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak har kaa daas hai raakh paij muraar |4|1|31|
English: Servant Nanak is the Lord's slave; preserve his honor, O Lord, Destroyer of ego. ||4||1||31||

[Ang 808 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
