Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਲੋਕਨ ਕੀਆ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਬੈਸੰਤਰਿ ਪਾਗਉ ॥
Transliteration: lokan keea vaddiaaeea baisantar paagau |
English: The glories of the world, I cast into the fire.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪਨਾ ਤੇ ਬੋਲ ਕਰਾਗਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jiau milai piaaraa aapanaa te bol karaagau |1|
English: I chant those words, by which I may meet my Beloved. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਦਇਆਲ ਹੋਇ ਤਉ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਗਉ ॥
Transliteration: jau prabh jeeo deaal hoe tau bhagatee laagau |
English: When God becomes Merciful, then He enjoins me to His devotional service.

Gurbani: ਲਪਟਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਮਨੁ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਇਹ ਤਿਆਗਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: lapatt rahio man baasanaa gur mil ih tiaagau |1| rahaau |
English: My mind clings to worldly desires; meeting with the Guru, I have renounced them. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਅਤਿ ਘਨੀ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਹੋਮਾਗਉ ॥
Transliteration: krau benatee at ghanee ihu jeeo homaagau |
English: I pray with intense devotion, and offer this soul to Him.

Gurbani: ਅਰਥ ਆਨ ਸਭਿ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਨਿਮਖ ਸੋਹਾਗਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: arath aan sabh vaariaa pria nimakh sohaagau |2|
English: I would sacrifice all other riches, for a moment's union with my Beloved. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਸੰਗੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਛੁਟੇ ਦੋਖ ਅਰੁ ਰਾਗਉ ॥
Transliteration: panch sang gur te chhutte dokh ar raagau |
English: Through the Guru, I am rid of the five villains, as well as emotional love and hate.

Gurbani: ਰਿਦੈ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਇਆ ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਜਾਗਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ridai pragaas pragatt bheaa nis baasur jaagau |3|
English: My heart is illumined, and the Lord has become manifest; night and day, I remain awake and aware. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਰਣਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਨਿ ਆਇਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗਉ ॥
Transliteration: saran sohaagan aaeaa jis masatak bhaagau |
English: The blessed soul-bride seeks His Sanctuary; her destiny is recorded on her forehead.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲਾਗਉ ॥੪॥੨॥੩੨॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak tin paaeaa tan man seetalaagau |4|2|32|
English: Says Nanak, she obtains her Husband Lord; her body and mind are cooled and soothed. ||4||2||32||

[Ang 808 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਲਾਲ ਰੰਗੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਲਗਾ ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਵਡਭਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: laal rang tis kau lagaa jis ke vaddabhaagaa |
English: One is dyed in the color of the Lord's Love, by great good fortune.

Gurbani: ਮੈਲਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਹ ਲਾਗੈ ਦਾਗਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mailaa kade na hovee neh laagai daagaa |1|
English: This color is never muddied; no stain ever sticks to it. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁਖਦਾਈਆ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਖ ਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: prabh paaeaa sukhadaaeea miliaa sukh bhaae |
English: He finds God, the Giver of peace, with feelings of joy.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ਭੀਤਰੇ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਨਹ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj samaanaa bheetare chhoddiaa neh jaae |1| rahaau |
English: The Celestial Lord blends into his soul, and he can never leave Him. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਰਾ ਮਰਾ ਨਹ ਵਿਆਪਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jaraa maraa neh viaapee fir dookh na paaeaa |
English: Old age and death cannot touch him, and he shall not suffer pain again.

Gurbani: ਪੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਆਘਾਨਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਅਮਰੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: pee amrit aaghaaniaa gur amar karaaeaa |2|
English: Drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar, he is satisfied; the Guru makes him immortal. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਜਾਨੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: so jaanai jin chaakhiaa har naam amolaa |
English: He alone knows its taste, who tastes the Priceless Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: keemat kahee na jaaeeai kiaa keh mukh bolaa |3|
English: Its value cannot be estimated; what can I say with my mouth? ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: safal daras teraa paarabraham gun nidh teree baanee |
English: Fruitful is the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, O Supreme Lord God. The Word of Your Bani is the treasure of virtue.

Gurbani: ਪਾਵਉ ਧੂਰਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੪॥੩॥੩੩॥
Transliteration: paavau dhoor tere daas kee naanak kurabaanee |4|3|33|
English: Please bless me with the dust of the feet of Your slaves; Nanak is a sacrifice. ||4||3||33||

[Ang 809 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਾਖਹੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: raakhahu apanee saran prabh mohi kirapaa dhaare |
English: Keep me under Your Protection, God; shower me with Your Mercy.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਨਊ ਨੀਚੁ ਮੂਰਖਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sevaa kachhoo na jaanaoo neech moorakhaare |1|
English: I do not know how to serve You; I am just a low-life fool. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਾਨੁ ਕਰਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਊਪਰੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: maan krau tudh aoopare mere preetam piaare |
English: I take pride in You, O my Darling Beloved.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਸਦ ਭੂਲਤੇ ਤੁਮੑ ਬਖਸਨਹਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ham aparaadhee sad bhoolate tuma bakhasanahaare |1| rahaau |
English: I am a sinner, continuously making mistakes; You are the Forgiving Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਅਵਗਨ ਕਰਹ ਅਸੰਖ ਨੀਤਿ ਤੁਮੑ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਦਾਤਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: ham avagan karah asankh neet tuma niragun daataare |
English: I make mistakes each and every day. You are the Great Giver;

Gurbani: ਦਾਸੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਏ ਕਰਮ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: daasee sangat prabhoo tiaag e karam hamaare |2|
English: I am worthless. I associate with Maya, your hand-maiden, and I renounce You, God; such are my actions. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮੑ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਿ ਹਮ ਅਕਿਰਤਘਨਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: tuma devahu sabh kichh deaa dhaar ham akirataghanaare |
English: You bless me with everything, showering me with Mercy; And I am such an ungrateful wretch!

Gurbani: ਲਾਗਿ ਪਰੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਨ ਸਿਉ ਨਹ ਚਿਤਿ ਖਸਮਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: laag pare tere daan siau neh chit khasamaare |3|
English: I am attached to Your gifts, but I do not even think of You, O my Lord and Master. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਭਵ ਕਾਟਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: tujh te baahar kichh nahee bhav kaattanahaare |
English: There is none other than You, O Lord, Destroyer of fear.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੁਰ ਲੇਹੁ ਮੁਗਧ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੪॥੩੪॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak saran deaal gur lehu mugadh udhaare |4|4|34|
English: Says Nanak, I have come to Your Sanctuary, O Merciful Guru; I am so foolish - please, save me! ||4||4||34||

[Ang 809 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਦੀਜੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: dos na kaahoo deejeeai prabh apanaa dhiaaeeai |
English: Don't blame anyone else; meditate on your God.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਘਨਾ ਮਨ ਸੋਈ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jit seviai sukh hoe ghanaa man soee gaaeeai |1|
English: Serving Him, great peace is obtained; O mind, sing His Praises. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਹੀਐ ਕਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤੁਝੁ ਬਿਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaheeai kaae piaare tujh binaa |
English: O Beloved, other than You, who else should I ask?

Gurbani: ਤੁਮੑ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਭ ਅਵਗਨ ਹਮਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tuma deaal suaamee sabh avagan hamaa |1| rahaau |
English: You are my Merciful Lord and Master; I am filled with all faults. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਤੁਮੑ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਰਹਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jiau tuma raakhahu tiau rahaa avar nahee chaaraa |
English: As You keep me, I remain; there is no other way.

Gurbani: ਨੀਧਰਿਆ ਧਰ ਤੇਰੀਆ ਇਕ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: needhariaa dhar tereea ik naam adhaaraa |2|
English: You are the Support of the unsupported; You Name is my only Support. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੁਮੑ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਭਲਾ ਮਨਿ ਲੇਤਾ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo tuma karahu soee bhalaa man letaa mukataa |
English: One who accepts whatever You do as good - that mind is liberated.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਤੇਰੀਆ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sagal samagree tereea sabh teree jugataa |3|
English: The entire creation is Yours; all are subject to Your Ways. ||3||

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਰਉ ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਜੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: charan pakhaarau kar sevaa je tthaakur bhaavai |
English: I wash Your Feet and serve You, if it pleases You, O Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੫॥੩੫॥
Transliteration: hohu kripaal deaal prabh naanak gun gaavai |4|5|35|
English: Be Merciful, O God of Compassion, that Nanak may sing Your Glorious Praises. ||4||5||35||

[Ang 809 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਿਰਤੁ ਹਸੈ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰੇ ਪਸੂਆ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
Transliteration: mirat hasai sir aoopare pasooaa nahee boojhai |
English: Death hovers over his head, laughing, but the beast does not understand.

Gurbani: ਬਾਦ ਸਾਦ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ਮਹਿ ਮਰਣਾ ਨਹੀ ਸੂਝੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: baad saad ahankaar meh maranaa nahee soojhai |1|
English: Entangled in conflict, pleasure and egotism, he does not even think of death. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਆਪਨਾ ਕਾਹੇ ਫਿਰਹੁ ਅਭਾਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sevahu aapanaa kaahe firahu abhaage |
English: So serve your True Guru; why wander around miserable and unfortunate?

Gurbani: ਦੇਖਿ ਕਸੁੰਭਾ ਰੰਗੁਲਾ ਕਾਹੇ ਭੂਲਿ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dekh kasunbhaa rangulaa kaahe bhool laage |1| rahaau |
English: You gaze upon the transitory, beautiful safflower, but why do you get attached to it? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਪ ਦਰਬੁ ਕੀਆ ਵਰਤਣ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kar kar paap darab keea varatan kai taaee |
English: You commit sins again and again, to gather wealth to spend.

Gurbani: ਮਾਟੀ ਸਿਉ ਮਾਟੀ ਰਲੀ ਨਾਗਾ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: maattee siau maattee ralee naagaa utth jaaee |2|
English: But your dust shall mix with dust; you shall arise and depart naked. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕੀਐ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਰੈ ਤੇ ਬੈਰ ਬਿਰੋਧੀ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai keeai sram karai te bair birodhee |
English: Those for whom you work, will become your spiteful enemies.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਭਜਿ ਜਾਹਿਗੇ ਕਾਹੇ ਜਲਹੁ ਕਰੋਧੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ant kaal bhaj jaahige kaahe jalahu karodhee |3|
English: In the end, they will run away from you; why do you burn for them in anger? ||3||

Gurbani: ਦਾਸ ਰੇਣੁ ਸੋਈ ਹੋਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਕਰਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: daas ren soee hoaa jis masatak karamaa |
English: He alone becomes the dust of the Lord's slaves, who has such good karma upon his forehead.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬੰਧਨ ਛੁਟੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾ ॥੪॥੬॥੩੬॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak bandhan chhutte satigur kee saranaa |4|6|36|
English: Says Nanak, he is released from bondage, in the Sanctuary of the True Guru. ||4||6||36||

[Ang 809 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪਿੰਗੁਲ ਪਰਬਤ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰੇ ਖਲ ਚਤੁਰ ਬਕੀਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: pingul parabat paar pare khal chatur bakeetaa |
English: The cripple crosses over the mountain, the fool becomes a wise man,

Gurbani: ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੂਝਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟਿ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: andhule tribhavan soojhiaa gur bhett puneetaa |1|
English: and the blind man sees the three worlds, by meeting with the True Guru and being purified. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਹਿਮਾ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗ ਕੀ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: mahimaa saadhoo sang kee sunahu mere meetaa |
English: This is the Glory of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; listen, O my friends.

Gurbani: ਮੈਲੁ ਖੋਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਘ ਹਰੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਭਏ ਚੀਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mail khoee kott agh hare niramal bhe cheetaa |1| rahaau |
English: Filth is washed away, millions of sins are dispelled, and the consciousness becomes immaculate and pure. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਐਸੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕੀ ਕੀਟਿ ਹਸਤੀ ਜੀਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: aisee bhagat govind kee keett hasatee jeetaa |
English: Such is devotional worship of the Lord of the Universe, that the ant can overpower the elephant.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕੀਨੋ ਆਪਨੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਅਭੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਤਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jo jo keeno aapano tis abhai daan deetaa |2|
English: Whoever the Lord makes His own, is blessed with the gift of fearlessness. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਿੰਘੁ ਬਿਲਾਈ ਹੋਇ ਗਇਓ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਮੇਰੁ ਦਿਖੀਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: singh bilaaee hoe geo trin mer dikheetaa |
English: The lion becomes a cat, and the mountain looks like a blade of grass.

Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਦਮ ਆਢ ਕਉ ਤੇ ਗਨੀ ਧਨੀਤਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sram karate dam aadt kau te ganee dhaneetaa |3|
English: Those who worked for half a shell, will be judged very wealthy. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਵਨ ਵਡਾਈ ਕਹਿ ਸਕਉ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਗੁਨੀਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: kavan vaddaaee keh skau beant guneetaa |
English: What glorious greatness of Yours can I describe, O Lord of infinite excellences?

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸ ਰੀਤਾ ॥੪॥੭॥੩੭॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa mohi naam dehu naanak daras reetaa |4|7|37|
English: Please bless me with Your Mercy, and grant me Your Name; O Nanak, I am lost without the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||4||7||37||

[Ang 810 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਪਰਬਾਦ ਨੀਤ ਲੋਭ ਰਸਨਾ ਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ahanbudh parabaad neet lobh rasanaa saad |
English: He is constantly entangled in pride, conflict, greed and tasty flavors.

Gurbani: ਲਪਟਿ ਕਪਟਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਬਿਖਿਆਦਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: lapatt kapatt grihi bedhiaa mithiaa bikhiaad |1|
English: He is involved in deception, fraud, household affairs and corruption. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸੀ ਪੇਖੀ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਮਹਿ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: aisee pekhee netr meh poore gur parasaad |
English: I have seen this with my eyes, by the Grace of the Perfect Guru.

Gurbani: ਰਾਜ ਮਿਲਖ ਧਨ ਜੋਬਨਾ ਨਾਮੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਾਦਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raaj milakh dhan jobanaa naamai bin baad |1| rahaau |
English: Power, property, wealth and youth are useless, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਰੂਪ ਧੂਪ ਸੋਗੰਧਤਾ ਕਾਪਰ ਭੋਗਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: roop dhoop sogandhataa kaapar bhogaad |
English: Beauty, incense, scented oils, beautiful clothes and foods

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਪਿਸਟ ਤਨ ਹੋਏ ਦੁਰਗਾਦਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: milat sang paapisatt tan hoe duragaad |2|
English: - when they come into contact with the body of the sinner, they stink. ||2||

Gurbani: ਫਿਰਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਮਾਨੁਖੁ ਭਇਆ ਖਿਨ ਭੰਗਨ ਦੇਹਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: firat firat maanukh bheaa khin bhangan dehaad |
English: Wandering, wandering around, the soul is reincarnated as a human, but this body lasts only for an instant.

Gurbani: ਇਹ ਅਉਸਰ ਤੇ ਚੂਕਿਆ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਦਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: eih aausar te chookiaa bahu jon bhramaad |3|
English: Losing this opportunity, he must wander again through countless incarnations. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kirapaa te gur mile har har bisamaad |
English: By God's Grace, he meets the Guru; contemplating the Lord, Har, Har, he is wonderstruck.

Gurbani: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨੰਦ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਨਾਦ ॥੪॥੮॥੩੮॥
Transliteration: sookh sehaj naanak anand taa kai pooran naad |4|8|38|
English: He is blessed with peace, poise and bliss, O Nanak, through the perfect sound current of the Naad. ||4||8||38||

[Ang 810 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਭਏ ਸੰਤ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਤਰੇ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਜੇਤ ॥
Transliteration: charan bhe sant bohithaa tare saagar jet |
English: The feet of the Saints are the boat, to cross over the world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਮਾਰਗ ਪਾਏ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਦਸੇ ਭੇਤ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: maarag paae udiaan meh gur dase bhet |1|
English: In the wilderness, the Guru places them on the Path, and reveals the secrets of the Lord's Mystery. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹੇਤ ॥
Transliteration: har har har har har hare har har har het |
English: O Lord, Har Har Har, Har Har Haray, Har Har Har, I love You.

Gurbani: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸੋਵਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aootthat baitthat sovate har har har chet |1| rahaau |
English: While standing up, sitting down and sleeping, think of the Lord, Har Har Har. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਆਗੈ ਭਗੇ ਜਬ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇਤ ॥
Transliteration: panch chor aagai bhage jab saadhasanget |
English: The five thieves run away, when one joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਾਬਤੁ ਘਣੋ ਲਾਭੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਸੇਤ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: poonjee saabat ghano laabh grihi sobhaa set |2|
English: His investment is intact, and he earns great profits; his household is blessed with honor. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਿਹਚਲ ਆਸਣੁ ਮਿਟੀ ਚਿੰਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਡੋਲੇਤ ॥
Transliteration: nihachal aasan mittee chint naahee ddolet |
English: His position is unmoving and eternal, his anxiety is ended, and he wavers no more.

Gurbani: ਭਰਮੁ ਭੁਲਾਵਾ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੇਖਤ ਨੇਤ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bharam bhulaavaa mitt geaa prabh pekhat net |3|
English: His doubts and misgivings are dispelled, and he sees God everywhere. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗਭੀਰ ਗੁਨ ਨਾਇਕਾ ਗੁਣ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਕੇਤ ॥
Transliteration: gun gabheer gun naaeikaa gun kaheeeh ket |
English: The Virtues of our Virtuous Lord and Master are so profound; how many of His Glorious Virtues should I speak?

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰੇਤ ॥੪॥੯॥੩੯॥
Transliteration: naanak paaeaa saadhasang har har amret |4|9|39|
English: Nanak has obtained the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord, Har, Har, in the Company of the Holy. ||4||9||39||

[Ang 810 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਜੋ ਜੀਵਨਾ ਤੇਤੋ ਬਿਰਥਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: bin saadhoo jo jeevanaa teto birathaaree |
English: That life, which has no contact with the Holy, is useless.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਭਿ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਮਿਟੇ ਗਤਿ ਭਈ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: milat sang sabh bhram mitte gat bhee hamaaree |1|
English: Joining their congregation, all doubts are dispelled, and I am emancipated. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਦਿਨ ਭੇਟੇ ਸਾਧ ਮੋਹਿ ਉਆ ਦਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jaa din bhette saadh mohi uaa din balihaaree |
English: That day, when I meet with the Holy - I am a sacrifice to that day.

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਪਨੋ ਜੀਅਰਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tan man apano jeearaa fir fir hau vaaree |1| rahaau |
English: Again and again, I sacrifice my body, mind and soul to them. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਏਤ ਛਡਾਈ ਮੋਹਿ ਤੇ ਇਤਨੀ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਤਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: et chhaddaaee mohi te itanee drirrataaree |
English: They have helped me renounce this ego, and implant this humility within myself.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਰੇਨ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭਇਆ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਅਪਧਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sagal ren ihu man bheaa binasee apadhaaree |2|
English: This mind has become the dust of all men's feet, and my self-conceit has been dispelled. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦ ਚਿੰਦ ਪਰ ਦੂਖਨਾ ਏ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: nind chind par dookhanaa e khin meh jaaree |
English: In an instant, I burnt away the ideas of slander and ill-will towards others.

Gurbani: ਦਇਆ ਮਇਆ ਅਰੁ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਪੇਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੂਰਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: deaa meaa ar nikatt pekh naahee dooraaree |3|
English: I see close at hand, the Lord of mercy and compassion; He is not far away at all. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤਨ ਮਨ ਸੀਤਲ ਭਏ ਅਬ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: tan man seetal bhe ab mukate sansaaree |
English: My body and mind are cooled and soothed, and now, I am liberated from the world.

Gurbani: ਹੀਤ ਚੀਤ ਸਭ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਧਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੪੦॥
Transliteration: heet cheet sabh praan dhan naanak darasaaree |4|10|40|
English: Love, consciousness, the breath of life, wealth and everything, O Nanak, are in the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||4||10||40||

[Ang 810 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਟਹਲ ਕਰਉ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਪਗ ਝਾਰਉ ਬਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: ttehal krau tere daas kee pag jhaarau baal |
English: I perform service for Your slave, O Lord, and wipe his feet with my hair.

Gurbani: ਮਸਤਕੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਭੇਟ ਦੇਉ ਗੁਨ ਸੁਨਉ ਰਸਾਲ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: masatak apanaa bhett deo gun sunau rasaal |1|
English: I offer my head to him, and listen to the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the source of bliss. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮੑ ਮਿਲਤੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਓ ਤੁਮੑ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
Transliteration: tuma milate meraa man jeeo tuma milahu deaal |
English: Meeting You, my mind is rejuvenated, so please meet me, O Merciful Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਹੋਤ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: nis baasur man anad hot chitavat kirapaal |1| rahaau |
English: Night and day, my mind enjoys bliss, contemplating the Lord of Compassion. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਗਤ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਸਾਧ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਿਨੑ ਲਾਗਹੁ ਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: jagat udhaaran saadh prabh tina laagahu paal |
English: God's Holy people are the saviors of the world; I grab hold of the hem of their robes.

Gurbani: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੀਜੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਤਨ ਪਗ ਰਾਲ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mo kau deejai daan prabh santan pag raal |2|
English: Bless me, O God, with the gift of the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||2||

Gurbani: ਉਕਤਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਕਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਘਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: aukat siaanap kachh nahee naahee kachh ghaal |
English: I have no skill or wisdom at all, nor any work to my credit.

Gurbani: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੈ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਮੋਹ ਤੇ ਕਾਟਹੁ ਜਮ ਜਾਲ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bhram bhai raakhahu moh te kaattahu jam jaal |3|
English: Please, protect me from doubt, fear and emotional attachment, and cut away the noose of Death from my neck. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰਉ ਕਰੁਣਾਪਤੇ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: binau krau karunaapate pitaa pratipaal |
English: I beg of You, O Lord of Mercy, O my Father, please cherish me!

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਉ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਲ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੪੧॥
Transliteration: gun gaavau tere saadhasang naanak sukh saal |4|11|41|
English: I sing Your Glorious Praises, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Lord, Home of peace. ||4||11||41||

[Ang 811 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕੀਤਾ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਸੋ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: keetaa lorreh so kareh tujh bin kachh naeh |
English: Whatever You wish, You do. Without You, there is nothing.

Gurbani: ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ ਜਮਦੂਤ ਛਡਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: parataap tumaaraa dekh kai jamadoot chhadd jaeh |1|
English: Gazing upon Your Glory, the Messenger of Death leaves and goes away. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਅਹੰਮੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: tumaree kripaa te chhootteeai binasai ahamev |
English: By Your Grace, one is emancipated, and egotism is dispelled.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਸਮਰਥ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sarab kalaa samarath prabh poore guradev |1| rahaau |
English: God is omnipotent, possessing all powers; He is obtained through the Perfect, Divine Guru. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਿਆ ਨਾਮੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੂਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: khojat khojat khojiaa naamai bin koor |
English: Searching, searching, searching - without the Naam, everything is false.

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jeevan sukh sabh saadhasang prabh manasaa poor |2|
English: All the comforts of life are found in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; God is the Fulfiller of desires. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਹਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਸਭ ਜਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: jit jit laavahu tith tit lageh siaanap sabh jaalee |
English: Whatever You attach me to, to that I am attached; I have burnt away all my cleverness.

Gurbani: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਤੁਮੑ ਭਰਪੂਰ ਹਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jat kat tuma bharapoor hahu mere deen deaalee |3|
English: You are permeating and pervading everywhere, O my Lord, Merciful to the meek. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਮਾਗਨਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh tum te maaganaa vaddabhaagee paae |
English: I ask for everything from You, but only the very fortunate ones obtain it.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਵਾ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੪੨॥
Transliteration: naanak kee aradaas prabh jeevaa gun gaae |4|12|42|
English: This is Nanak's prayer, O God, I live by singing Your Glorious Praises. ||4||12||42||

[Ang 811 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਬਾਸਬੈ ਕਲਮਲ ਸਭਿ ਨਸਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasangat kai baasabai kalamal sabh nasanaa |
English: Dwelling in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, all sins are erased.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੇਤੀ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਿਆ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਗਰਭਿ ਨ ਗ੍ਰਸਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: prabh setee rang raatiaa taa te garabh na grasanaa |1|
English: One who is attuned to the Love of God, is not cast into the womb of reincarnation. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਕਹਤ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕਾ ਸੂਚੀ ਭਈ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: naam kehat govind kaa soochee bhee rasanaa |
English: Chanting the Name of the Lord of the Universe, the tongue becomes holy.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: man tan niramal hoee hai gur kaa jap japanaa |1| rahaau |
English: The mind and body become immaculate and pure, chanting the Chant of the Guru. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਤ ਧ੍ਰਾਪਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਰਸੁ ਲੈ ਹਸਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: har ras chaakhat dhraapiaa man ras lai hasanaa |
English: Tasting the subtle essence of the Lord, one is satisfied; receiving this essence, the mind becomes happy.

Gurbani: ਬੁਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਈ ਉਲਟਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਸਨਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: budh pragaas pragatt bhee ulatt kamal bigasanaa |2|
English: The intellect is brightened and illuminated; turning away from the world, the heart-lotus blossoms forth. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਭ ਬੂਝੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: seetal saant santokh hoe sabh boojhee trisanaa |
English: He is cooled and soothed, peaceful and content; all his thirst is quenched.

Gurbani: ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਵਤ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਥਾਨਿ ਬਸਨਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: deh dis dhaavat mitt ge niramal thaan basanaa |3|
English: The mind's wandering in the ten directions is stopped, and one dwells in the immaculate place. ||3||

Gurbani: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੈ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਭਏ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭਸਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: raakhanahaarai raakhiaa bhe bhram bhasanaa |
English: The Savior Lord saves him, and his doubts are burnt to ashes.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੀ ਪੇਖਿ ਸਾਧ ਦਰਸਨਾ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੪੩॥
Transliteration: naam nidhaan naanak sukhee pekh saadh darasanaa |4|13|43|
English: Nanak is blessed with the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. He finds peace, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Saints' Darshan. ||4||13||43||

[Ang 811 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪਾਣੀ ਪਖਾ ਪੀਸੁ ਦਾਸ ਕੈ ਤਬ ਹੋਹਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: paanee pakhaa pees daas kai tab hohi nihaal |
English: Carry water for the Lord's slave, wave the fan over him, and grind his corn; then, you shall be happy.

Gurbani: ਰਾਜ ਮਿਲਖ ਸਿਕਦਾਰੀਆ ਅਗਨੀ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: raaj milakh sikadaareea aganee meh jaal |1|
English: Burn in the fire your power, property and authority. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਛੋਹਰਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: sant janaa kaa chhoharaa tis charanee laag |
English: Grasp hold of the feet of the servant of the humble Saints.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆਧਾਰੀ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤਿ ਤਿਨੑ ਛੋਡਉ ਤਿਆਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaadhaaree chhatrapat tina chhoddau tiaag |1| rahaau |
English: Renounce and abandon the wealthy, the regal overlords and kings. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ ਦਾਨਾ ਰੂਖਾ ਸੋ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: santan kaa daanaa rookhaa so sarab nidhaan |
English: The dry bread of the Saints is equal to all treasures.

Gurbani: ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਸਾਕਤ ਛਤੀਹ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਤੇ ਬਿਖੂ ਸਮਾਨ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: grihi saakat chhateeh prakaar te bikhoo samaan |2|
English: The thirty-six tasty dishes of the faithless cynic, are just like poison. ||2||

Gurbani: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਲੂਗਰਾ ਓਢਿ ਨਗਨ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat janaa kaa loogaraa odt nagan na hoee |
English: Wearing the old blankets of the humble devotees, one is not naked.

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤ ਸਿਰਪਾਉ ਰੇਸਮੀ ਪਹਿਰਤ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: saakat sirapaau resamee pahirat pat khoee |3|
English: But by putting on the silk clothes of the faithless cynic, one loses one's honor. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤ ਸਿਉ ਮੁਖਿ ਜੋਰਿਐ ਅਧ ਵੀਚਹੁ ਟੂਟੈ ॥
Transliteration: saakat siau mukh joriai adh veechahu ttoottai |
English: Friendship with the faithless cynic breaks down mid-way.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਇਤ ਊਤਹਿ ਛੂਟੈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: har jan kee sevaa jo kare it aooteh chhoottai |4|
English: But whoever serves the humble servants of the Lord, is emancipated here and hereafter. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਮੑ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਹੋਆ ਆਪਿ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh tuma hee te hoaa aap banat banaaee |
English: Everything comes from You, O Lord; You Yourself created the creation.

Gurbani: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਸਾਧ ਕਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥੫॥੧੪॥੪੪॥
Transliteration: darasan bhettat saadh kaa naanak gun gaaee |5|14|44|
English: Blessed with the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the Holy, Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||5||14||44||

[Ang 812 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰਵਨੀ ਸੁਨਉ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: sravanee sunau har har hare tthaakur jas gaavau |
English: With my ears, I listen to the Lord, Har, Har; I sing the Praises of my Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਚਰਣ ਕਰ ਸੀਸੁ ਧਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sant charan kar sees dhar har naam dhiaavau |1|
English: I place my hands and my head upon the feet of the Saints, and meditate on the Lord's Name. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਇਹ ਨਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa deaal prabh ih nidh sidh paavau |
English: Be kind to me, O Merciful God, and bless me with this wealth and success.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁਕਾ ਲੈ ਮਾਥੈ ਲਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sant janaa kee renukaa lai maathai laavau |1| rahaau |
English: Obtaining the dust of the feet of the Saints, I apply it to my forehead. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨੀਚ ਤੇ ਨੀਚੁ ਅਤਿ ਨੀਚੁ ਹੋਇ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਨਉ ਬੁਲਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: neech te neech at neech hoe kar binau bulaavau |
English: I am the lowest of the low, absolutely the lowest; I offer my humble prayer.

Gurbani: ਪਾਵ ਮਲੋਵਾ ਆਪੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਵਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: paav malovaa aap tiaag santasang samaavau |2|
English: I wash their feet, and renounce my self-conceit; I merge in the Saints' Congregation. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਨਹ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਅਨ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਧਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: saas saas neh veesarai an kateh na dhaavau |
English: With each and every breath, I never forget the Lord; I never go to another.

Gurbani: ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਮਾਨੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਿਟਾਵਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: safal darasan gur bhetteeai maan mohu mittaavau |3|
English: Obtaining the Fruitful Vision of the Guru's Darshan, I discard my pride and attachment. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਨਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: sat santokh deaa dharam seegaar banaavau |
English: I am embellished with truth, contentment, compassion and Dharmic faith.

Gurbani: ਸਫਲ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਉ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੪੫॥
Transliteration: safal suhaagan naanakaa apune prabh bhaavau |4|15|45|
English: My spiritual marriage is fruitful, O Nanak; I am pleasing to my God. ||4||15||45||

[Ang 812 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਟਲ ਬਚਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨਾ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: attal bachan saadhoo janaa sabh meh pragattaaeaa |
English: The words of the Holy are eternal and unchanging; this is apparent to everyone.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਹੋਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jis jan hoaa saadhasang tis bhettai har raaeaa |1|
English: That humble being, who joins the Saadh Sangat, meets the Sovereign Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਇਹ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕੀ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: eih parateet govind kee jap har sukh paaeaa |
English: This faith in the Lord of the Universe, and peace, are found by meditating on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਤਾ ਸਭਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਲੈ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: anik baataa sabh kar rahe gur ghar lai aaeaa |1| rahaau |
English: Everyone is speaking in various ways, but the Guru has brought the Lord into the home of my self. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਕੀ ਰਾਖਤਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਹਸਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: saran pare kee raakhataa naahee sahasaaeaa |
English: He preserves the honor of those who seek His Sanctuary; there is no doubt about this at all.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮ ਭੂਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੋਇ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਦੁਲਭਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: karam bhoom har naam boe aausar dulabhaaeaa |2|
English: In the field of actions and karma, plant the Lord's Name; this opportunity is so difficult to obtain! ||2||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: antarajaamee aap prabh sabh kare karaaeaa |
English: God Himself is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts; He does, and causes everything to be done.

Gurbani: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਘਣੇ ਕਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਬਿਰਦਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: patit puneet ghane kare tthaakur biradaaeaa |3|
English: He purifies so many sinners; this is the natural way of our Lord and Master. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਤ ਭੂਲਹੁ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਜਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਭਰਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: mat bhoolahu maanukh jan maaeaa bharamaaeaa |
English: Don't be fooled, O mortal being, by the illusion of Maya.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖਸੀ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪਹਿਰਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੪੬॥
Transliteration: naanak tis pat raakhasee jo prabh pahiraaeaa |4|16|46|
English: O Nanak, God saves the honor of those of whom He approves. ||4||16||46||

[Ang 812 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਾਟੀ ਤੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਦੁਰਲਭ ਦੇਹ ॥
Transliteration: maattee te jin saajiaa kar duralabh deh |
English: He fashioned you from clay, and made your priceless body.

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਢਕੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੇਹ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: anik chhidr man meh dtake niramal drisatteh |1|
English: He covers the many faults in your mind, and makes you look immaculate and pure. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨੈ ਤੇ ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਏਹ ॥
Transliteration: kiau bisarai prabh manai te jis ke gun eh |
English: So why do you forget God from your mind? He has done so many good things for you.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਜਿ ਰਚੇ ਜਿ ਆਨ ਸਿਉ ਸੋ ਰਲੀਐ ਖੇਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: prabh taj rache ji aan siau so raleeai kheh |1| rahaau |
English: One who forsakes God, and blends himself with another, in the end is blended with dust. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਮਤ ਬਿਲਮ ਕਰੇਹ ॥
Transliteration: simarahu simarahu saas saas mat bilam kareh |
English: Meditate, meditate in remembrance with each and every breath - do not delay!

Gurbani: ਛੋਡਿ ਪ੍ਰਪੰਚੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਰਚਹੁ ਤਜਿ ਕੂੜੇ ਨੇਹ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: chhodd prapanch prabh siau rachahu taj koorre neh |2|
English: Renounce worldly affairs, and merge yourself into God; forsake false loves. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਏਕ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗ ਕੀਏ ਹੈ ਹੋਸੀ ਏਹ ॥
Transliteration: jin anik ek bahu rang kee hai hosee eh |
English: He is many, and He is One; He takes part in the many plays. This is as He is, and shall be.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਤਿ ਲੇਹ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kar sevaa tis paarabraham gur te mat leh |3|
English: So serve that Supreme Lord God, and accept the Guru's Teachings. ||3||

Gurbani: ਊਚੇ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ਵਡਾ ਸਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਰਨੇਹ ॥
Transliteration: aooche te aoochaa vaddaa sabh sang baraneh |
English: God is said to be the highest of the high, the greatest of all, our companion.

Gurbani: ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸ ਕੋ ਦਾਸਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਿ ਲੇਹ ॥੪॥੧੭॥੪੭॥
Transliteration: daas daas ko daasaraa naanak kar leh |4|17|47|
English: Please, let Nanak be the slave of the slave of Your slaves. ||4||17||47||

[Ang 812 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕੀ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਅਨ ਆਸ ॥
Transliteration: ek ttek govind kee tiaagee an aas |
English: The Lord of the Universe is my only Support. I have renounced all other hopes.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਸਮਰਥ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੂਰਨ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sabh aoopar samarath prabh pooran gunataas |1|
English: God is All-powerful, above all; He is the perfect treasure of virtue. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jan kaa naam adhaar hai prabh saranee paeh |
English: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the Support of the humble servant who seeks God's Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਕਾ ਆਸਰਾ ਸੰਤਨ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: paramesar kaa aasaraa santan man maeh |1| rahaau |
English: In their minds, the Saints take the Support of the Transcendent Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਰਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਦੇਵਸੀ ਆਪੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: aap rakhai aap devasee aape pratipaarai |
English: He Himself preserves, and He Himself gives. He Himself cherishes.

Gurbani: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧੇ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਮੑਾਰੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: deen deaal kripaa nidhe saas saas samaarai |2|
English: Merciful to the meek, the treasure of mercy, He remembers and protects us with each and every breath. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਜੋ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਾਈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: karanahaar jo kar rahiaa saaee vaddiaaee |
English: Whatever the Creator Lord does is glorious and great.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਖਸਮ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur poorai upadesiaa sukh khasam rajaaee |3|
English: The Perfect Guru has instructed me, that peace comes by the Will of our Lord and Master. ||3||

Gurbani: ਚਿੰਤ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਗਣਤ ਤਜਿ ਜਨਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: chint andesaa ganat taj jan hukam pachhaataa |
English: Anxieties, worries and calculations are dismissed; the Lord's humble servant accepts the Hukam of His Command.

Gurbani: ਨਹ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਨਹ ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਇ ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੪॥੧੮॥੪੮॥
Transliteration: neh binasai neh chhodd jaae naanak rang raataa |4|18|48|
English: He does not die, and He does not leave; Nanak is attuned to His Love. ||4||18||48||

[Ang 813 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਤਪਤਿ ਤੇ ਭਈ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਪਰਸਤ ਪਾਪ ਨਾਠੇ ॥
Transliteration: mahaa tapat te bhee saant parasat paap naatthe |
English: The great fire is put out and cooled; meeting with the Guru, sins run away.

Gurbani: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਿ ਗਲਤ ਥੇ ਕਾਢੇ ਦੇ ਹਾਥੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: andh koop meh galat the kaadte de haathe |1|
English: I fell into the deep dark pit; giving me His Hand, He pulled me out. ||1||

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਸਾਜਨਾ ਹਮ ਉਨ ਕੀ ਰੇਨ ॥
Transliteration: oe hamaare saajanaa ham un kee ren |
English: He is my friend; I am the dust of His Feet.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਭੇਟਤ ਹੋਵਤ ਸੁਖੀ ਜੀਅ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jin bhettat hovat sukhee jeea daan den |1| rahaau |
English: Meeting with Him, I am at peace; He blesses me with the gift of the soul. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪਰਾ ਪੂਰਬਲਾ ਲੀਖਿਆ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਅਬ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: paraa poorabalaa leekhiaa miliaa ab aae |
English: I have now received my pre-ordained destiny.

Gurbani: ਬਸਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: basat sang har saadh kai pooran aasaae |2|
English: Dwelling with the Lord's Holy Saints, my hopes are fulfilled. ||2||

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਕ ਕੇ ਪਾਏ ਸੁਖ ਥਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: bhai binase tihu lok ke paae sukh thaan |
English: The fear of the three worlds is dispelled, and I have found my place of rest and peace.

Gurbani: ਦਇਆ ਕਰੀ ਸਮਰਥ ਗੁਰਿ ਬਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: deaa karee samarath gur basiaa man naam |3|
English: The all-powerful Guru has taken pity upon me, and the Naam has come to dwell in my mind. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਤੂ ਟੇਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: naanak kee too ttek prabh teraa aadhaar |
English: O God, You are the Anchor and Support of Nanak.

Gurbani: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੪॥੧੯॥੪੯॥
Transliteration: karan kaaran samarath prabh har agam apaar |4|19|49|
English: He is the Doer, the Cause of causes; the All-powerful Lord God is inaccessible and infinite. ||4||19||49||

[Ang 813 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਮਲੀਨੁ ਦੀਨੁ ਹੀਨੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਿਸਰਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: soee maleen deen heen jis prabh bisaraanaa |
English: One who forgets God is filthy, poor and low.

Gurbani: ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੁ ਨ ਬੂਝਈ ਆਪੁ ਗਨੈ ਬਿਗਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: karanaihaar na boojhee aap ganai bigaanaa |1|
English: The fool does not understand the Creator Lord; instead, he thinks that he himself is the doer. ||1||

Gurbani: ਦੂਖੁ ਤਦੇ ਜਦਿ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: dookh tade jad veesarai sukh prabh chit aae |
English: Pain comes, when one forgets Him. Peace comes when one remembers God.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਏਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: santan kai aanand ehu nit har gun gaae |1| rahaau |
English: This is the way the Saints are in bliss - they continually sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਊਚੇ ਤੇ ਨੀਚਾ ਕਰੈ ਨੀਚ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: aooche te neechaa karai neech khin meh thaapai |
English: The high, He makes low, and the low, he elevates in an instant.

Gurbani: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪਰਤਾਪੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: keemat kahee na jaaeeai tthaakur parataapai |2|
English: The value of the glory of our Lord and Master cannot be estimated. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪੇਖਤ ਲੀਲਾ ਰੰਗ ਰੂਪ ਚਲਨੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: pekhat leelaa rang roop chalanai din aaeaa |
English: While he gazes upon beautiful dramas and plays, the day of his departure dawns.

Gurbani: ਸੁਪਨੇ ਕਾ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਭਇਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: supane kaa supanaa bheaa sang chaliaa kamaaeaa |3|
English: The dream becomes the dream, and his actions do not go along with him. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: karan kaaran samarath prabh teree saranaaee |
English: God is All-powerful, the Cause of causes; I seek Your Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਪੈ ਸਦ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੪॥੨੦॥੫੦॥
Transliteration: har dinas rain naanak japai sad sad bal jaaee |4|20|50|
English: Day and night, Nanak meditates on the Lord; forever and ever he is a sacrifice. ||4||20||50||

[Ang 813 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਲੁ ਢੋਵਉ ਇਹ ਸੀਸ ਕਰਿ ਕਰ ਪਗ ਪਖਲਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: jal dtovau ih sees kar kar pag pakhalaavau |
English: I carry water on my head, and with my hands I wash their feet.

Gurbani: ਬਾਰਿ ਜਾਉ ਲਖ ਬੇਰੀਆ ਦਰਸੁ ਪੇਖਿ ਜੀਵਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: baar jaau lakh bereea daras pekh jeevaavau |1|
English: Tens of thousands of times, I am a sacrifice to them; gazing upon the Blessed Vision of their Darshan, I live. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਰਉ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਮਨੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਅਪਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: krau manorath manai maeh apane prabh te paavau |
English: The hopes which I cherish in my mind - my God fulfills them all.

Gurbani: ਦੇਉ ਸੂਹਨੀ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਬੀਜਨੁ ਢੋਲਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: deo soohanee saadh kai beejan dtolaavau |1| rahaau |
English: With my broom, I sweep the homes of the Holy Saints, and wave the fan over them. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਤ ਬੋਲਤੇ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨਹਿ ਪੀਲਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: amrit gun sant bolate sun maneh peelaavau |
English: The Saints chant the Ambrosial Praises of the Lord; I listen, and my mind drinks it in.

Gurbani: ਉਆ ਰਸ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਖੈ ਜਲਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਵਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: auaa ras meh saant tripat hoe bikhai jalan bujhaavau |2|
English: That sublime essence calms and soothes me, and quenches the fire of sin and corruption. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਮੰਡਲੀ ਤਿਨੑ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: jab bhagat kareh sant manddalee tina mil har gaavau |
English: When the galaxy of Saints worship the Lord in devotion, I join them, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਰਉ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਭਗਤ ਜਨ ਧੂਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਵਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: krau namasakaar bhagat jan dhoor mukh laavau |3|
English: I bow in reverence to the humble devotees, and apply the dust of their feet to my face. ||3||

Gurbani: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਜਪਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਇਹੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਮਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: aootthat baitthat jpau naam ihu karam kamaavau |
English: Sitting down and standing up, I chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord; this is what I do.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਮਾਵਉ ॥੪॥੨੧॥੫੧॥
Transliteration: naanak kee prabh benatee har saran samaavau |4|21|51|
English: This is Nanak's prayer to God, that he may merge in the Lord's Sanctuary. ||4||21||51||

[Ang 813 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸੋਈ ਤਰੈ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: eihu saagar soee tarai jo har gun gaae |
English: He alone crosses over this world-ocean, who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਵਸੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saadhasangat kai sang vasai vaddabhaagee paae |1|
English: He dwells with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; by great good fortune, he finds the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੁਮੑ ਬਾਣੀ ਜਨ ਆਖੀ ॥
Transliteration: sun sun jeevai daas tuma baanee jan aakhee |
English: Your slave lives by hearing, hearing the Word of Your Bani, chanted by Your humble servant.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਈ ਸਭ ਲੋਅ ਮਹਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਰਾਖੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: pragatt bhee sabh loa meh sevak kee raakhee |1| rahaau |
English: The Guru is revealed in all the worlds; He saves the honor of His servant. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਤੇ ਕਾਢਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਜਲਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: agan saagar te kaadtiaa prabh jalan bujhaaee |
English: God has pulled me out of the ocean of fire, and quenched my burning thirst.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਲੁ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: amrit naam jal sanchiaa gur bhe sahaaee |2|
English: The Guru has sprinkled the Ambrosial Water of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; He has become my Helper. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਟਿਆ ਸੁਖ ਕਾ ਥਾਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: janam maran dukh kaattiaa sukh kaa thaan paaeaa |
English: The pains of birth and death are removed, and I have obtained a resting place of peace.

Gurbani: ਕਾਟੀ ਸਿਲਕ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਕੀ ਅਪਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kaattee silak bhram moh kee apane prabh bhaaeaa |3|
English: The noose of doubt and emotional attachment has been snapped; I have become pleasing to my God. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਤ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਛੁ ਸਭ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
Transliteration: mat koee jaanahu avar kachh sabh prabh kai haath |
English: Let no one think that there is any other at all; everything is in the Hands of God.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਏ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਸਾਥਿ ॥੪॥੨੨॥੫੨॥
Transliteration: sarab sookh naanak paae sang santan saath |4|22|52|
English: Nanak has found total peace, in the Society of the Saints. ||4||22||52||

[Ang 814 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੇ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਹੋਆ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: bandhan kaatte aap prabh hoaa kirapaal |
English: My bonds have been snapped; God Himself has become compassionate.

Gurbani: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: deen deaal prabh paarabraham taa kee nadar nihaal |1|
English: The Supreme Lord God is Merciful to the meek; by His Glance of Grace, I am in ecstasy. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਕਾਟਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur poorai kirapaa karee kaattiaa dukh rog |
English: The Perfect Guru has shown mercy to me, and eradicated my pains and illnesses.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸੁਖੀ ਭਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਿਆਵਨ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: man tan seetal sukhee bheaa prabh dhiaavan jog |1| rahaau |
English: My mind and body have been cooled and soothed, meditating on God, most worthy of meditation. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਉਖਧੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: aaukhadh har kaa naam hai jit rog na viaapai |
English: The Name of the Lord is the medicine to cure all disease; with it, no disease afflicts me.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹਿਤੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saadhasang man tan hitai fir dookh na jaapai |2|
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the mind and body are tinged with the Lord's Love, and I do not suffer pain any longer. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪੀਐ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har har har har jaapeeai antar liv laaee |
English: I chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har, lovingly centering my inner being on Him.

Gurbani: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਸੁਧੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kilavikh utareh sudh hoe saadhoo saranaaee |3|
English: Sinful mistakes are erased and I am sanctified, in the Sanctuary of the Holy Saints. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੁਨਤ ਜਪਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਜਸੁ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਦੂਰਿ ਬਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sunat japat har naam jas taa kee door balaaee |
English: Misfortune is kept far away from those who hear and chant the Praises of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਥੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੫੩॥
Transliteration: mahaa mantru naanak kathai har ke gun gaaee |4|23|53|
English: Nanak chants the Mahaa Mantra, the Great Mantra, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||23||53||

[Ang 814 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਾਂਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: bhai te upajai bhagat prabh antar hoe saant |
English: From the Fear of God, devotion wells up, and deep within, there is peace.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕਾ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭ੍ਰਾਂਤਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naam japat govind kaa binasai bhram bhraant |1|
English: Chanting the Name of the Lord of the Universe, doubt and delusions are dispelled. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸੁਖਿ ਪਰਵੇਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur pooraa jis bhettiaa taa kai sukh paraves |
English: One who meets with the Perfect Guru, is blessed with peace.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਤਿਆਗੀਐ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: man kee mat tiaageeai suneeai upades |1| rahaau |
English: So renounce the intellectual cleverness of your mind, and listen to the Teachings. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: simarat simarat simareeai so purakh daataar |
English: Meditate, meditate, meditate in remembrance on the Primal Lord, the Great Giver.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਤੇ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: man te kabahu na veesarai so purakh apaar |2|
English: May I never forget that Primal, Infinite Lord from my mind. ||2||

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਗਾ ਅਚਰਜ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal siau rang lagaa acharaj guradev |
English: I have enshrined love for the Lotus Feet of the Wondrous Divine Guru.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਸੇਵ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jaa kau kirapaa karahu prabh taa kau laavahu sev |3|
English: One who is blessed by Your Mercy, God, is committed to Your service. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਿਧਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਆਨੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: nidh nidhaan amrit peea man tan aanand |
English: I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar, the treasure of wealth, and my mind and body are in bliss.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ ॥੪॥੨੪॥੫੪॥
Transliteration: naanak kabahu na veesarai prabh paramaanand |4|24|54|
English: Nanak never forgets God, the Lord of supreme bliss. ||4||24||54||

[Ang 814 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਬੁਝੀ ਮਮਤਾ ਗਈ ਨਾਠੇ ਭੈ ਭਰਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: trisan bujhee mamataa gee naatthe bhai bharamaa |
English: Desire is stilled, and egotism is gone; fear and doubt have run away.

Gurbani: ਥਿਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਆਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੇ ਧਰਮਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: thit paaee aanad bheaa gur keene dharamaa |1|
English: I have found stability, and I am in ecstasy; the Guru has blessed me with Dharmic faith. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: gur pooraa aaraadhiaa binasee meree peer |
English: Worshipping the Perfect Guru in adoration, my anguish is eradicated.

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਭਇਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਬੀਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tan man sabh seetal bheaa paaeaa sukh beer |1| rahaau |
English: My body and mind are totally cooled and soothed; I have found peace, O my brother. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੋਵਤ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਾਗਿਆ ਪੇਖਿਆ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: sovat har jap jaagiaa pekhiaa bisamaad |
English: I have awakened from sleep, chanting the Name of the Lord; gazing upon Him, I am filled with wonder.

Gurbani: ਪੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸਿਆ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅਚਰਜ ਸੁਆਦੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: pee amrit tripataasiaa taa kaa acharaj suaad |2|
English: Drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar, I am satisfied. How wondrous is its taste! ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਸੰਗੀ ਤਰੇ ਕੁਲ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aap mukat sangee tare kul kuttanb udhaare |
English: I myself am liberated, and my companions swim across; my family and ancestors are also saved.

Gurbani: ਸਫਲ ਸੇਵਾ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: safal sevaa guradev kee niramal darabaare |3|
English: Service to the Divine Guru is fruitful; it has made me pure in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨੀਚੁ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਅਜਾਨੁ ਮੈ ਨਿਰਗੁਨੁ ਗੁਣਹੀਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: neech anaath ajaan mai niragun gunaheen |
English: I am lowly, without a master, ignorant, worthless and without virtue.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਈ ਦਾਸੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਕੀਨੁ ॥੪॥੨੫॥੫੫॥
Transliteration: naanak kau kirapaa bhee daas apanaa keen |4|25|55|
English: Nanak has been blessed with God's Mercy; God has made him His Slave. ||4||25||55||

[Ang 815 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਕਾ ਆਸਰਾ ਅਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਠਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har bhagataa kaa aasaraa an naahee tthaau |
English: The Lord is the Hope and Support of His devotees; there is nowhere else for them to go.

Gurbani: ਤਾਣੁ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਪਰਵਾਰ ਧਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: taan deebaan paravaar dhan prabh teraa naau |1|
English: O God, Your Name is my power, realm, relatives and riches. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਣੀ ਅਪਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਰਖਿ ਲੀਏ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh aapanee apane daas rakh lee |
English: God has granted His Mercy, and saved His slaves.

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਪਚੇ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ਗ੍ਰਸੀਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: nindak nindaa kar pache jamakaal grasee |1| rahaau |
English: The slanderers rot in their slander; they are seized by the Messenger of Death. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਵਨਾ ਦੂਸਰ ਕੋ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: santaa ek dhiaavanaa doosar ko naeh |
English: The Saints meditate on the One Lord, and no other.

Gurbani: ਏਕਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਰਵਿਆ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਥਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ekas aagai benatee raviaa srab thaae |2|
English: They offer their prayers to the One Lord, who is pervading and permeating all places. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਥਾ ਪੁਰਾਤਨ ਇਉ ਸੁਣੀ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: kathaa puraatan iau sunee bhagatan kee baanee |
English: I have heard this old story, spoken by the devotees,

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਦੁਸਟ ਖੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਕੀਏ ਜਨ ਲੀਏ ਮਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sagal dusatt khandd khandd kee jan lee maanee |3|
English: that all the wicked are cut apart into pieces, while His humble servants are blessed with honor. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿ ਬਚਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਪਰਗਟ ਸਭ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: sat bachan naanak kahai paragatt sabh maeh |
English: Nanak speaks the true words, which are obvious to all.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਭਉ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੪॥੨੬॥੫੬॥
Transliteration: prabh ke sevak saran prabh tin kau bhau naeh |4|26|56|
English: God's servants are under God's Protection; they have absolutely no fear. ||4||26||56||

[Ang 815 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੈ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਲ ਹਾਥ ॥
Transliteration: bandhan kaattai so prabhoo jaa kai kal haath |
English: God breaks the bonds which hold us; He holds all power in His hands.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰ ਕਰਮ ਨਹੀ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਥ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: avar karam nahee chhootteeai raakhahu har naath |1|
English: No other actions will bring release; save me, O my Lord and Master. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਮਾਧਵੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
Transliteration: tau saranaagat maadhave pooran deaal |
English: I have entered Your Sanctuary, O Perfect Lord of Mercy.

Gurbani: ਛੂਟਿ ਜਾਇ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਤੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: chhoott jaae sansaar te raakhai gopaal |1| rahaau |
English: Those whom You preserve and protect, O Lord of the Universe, are saved from the trap of the world. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਭਰਮ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮੋਹ ਇਨ ਮਹਿ ਲੋਭਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa bharam bikaar moh in meh lobhaanaa |
English: Hope, doubt, corruption and emotional attachment - in these, he is engrossed.

Gurbani: ਝੂਠੁ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jhootth samagree man vasee paarabraham na jaanaa |2|
English: The false material world abides in his mind, and he does not understand the Supreme Lord God. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪਰਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: param jot pooran purakh sabh jeea tumaare |
English: O Perfect Lord of Supreme Light, all beings belong to You.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਰਹਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jiau too raakheh tiau rahaa prabh agam apaare |3|
English: As You keep us, we live, O infinite, inaccessible God. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਹਿ ਅਪਨਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: karan kaaran samarath prabh dehi apanaa naau |
English: Cause of causes, All-powerful Lord God, please bless me with Your Name.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਰੀਐ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੪॥੨੭॥੫੭॥
Transliteration: naanak tareeai saadhasang har har gun gaau |4|27|57|
English: Nanak is carried across in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||27||57||

[Ang 815 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਵਨੁ ਕਵਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਤਰਿਆ ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: kavan kavan nahee patariaa tumaree parateet |
English: Who? Who has not fallen, by placing their hopes in you?

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਨਰਕ ਕੀ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mahaa mohanee mohiaa narak kee reet |1|
English: You are enticed by the great enticer - this is the way to hell! ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਖੁਟਹਰ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਸਾਸੁ ਤੂ ਮਹਾ ਉਦਮਾਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: man khuttahar teraa nahee bisaas too mahaa udamaadaa |
English: O vicious mind, no faith can be placed in you; you are totally intoxicated.

Gurbani: ਖਰ ਕਾ ਪੈਖਰੁ ਤਉ ਛੁਟੈ ਜਉ ਊਪਰਿ ਲਾਦਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: khar kaa paikhar tau chhuttai jau aoopar laadaa |1| rahaau |
English: The donkey's leash is only removed, after the load is placed on his back. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਤੁਮੑ ਖੰਡੇ ਜਮ ਕੇ ਦੁਖ ਡਾਂਡ ॥
Transliteration: jap tap sanjam tuma khandde jam ke dukh ddaandd |
English: You destroy the value of chanting, intensive meditation and self-discipline; you shall suffer in pain, beaten by the Messenger of Death.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਜੋਨਿ ਦੁਖ ਨਿਰਲਜੇ ਭਾਂਡ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: simareh naahee jon dukh niralaje bhaandd |2|
English: You do not meditate, so you shall suffer the pains of reincarnation, you shameless buffoon! ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਮਹਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਤਿਸ ਸਿਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਭੇਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: har sang sahaaee mahaa meet tis siau teraa bhed |
English: The Lord is your Companion, your Helper, your Best Friend; but you disagree with Him.

Gurbani: ਬੀਧਾ ਪੰਚ ਬਟਵਾਰਈ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਮਹਾ ਖੇਦੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: beedhaa panch battavaaree upajio mahaa khed |3|
English: You are in love with the five thieves; this brings terrible pain. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਸੰਤਨ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਜਿਨ ਮਨੁ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: naanak tin santan saranaagatee jin man vas keenaa |
English: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Saints, who have conquered their minds.

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਦੀਨੑਾ ॥੪॥੨੮॥੫੮॥
Transliteration: tan dhan sarabas aapanaa prabh jan kau deenaa |4|28|58|
English: He gives body, wealth and everything to the slaves of God. ||4||28||58||

[Ang 815 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਤ ਆਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: audam karat aanad bheaa simarat sukh saar |
English: Try to meditate, and contemplate the source of peace, and bliss will come to you.

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jap jap naam gobind kaa pooran beechaar |1|
English: Chanting, and meditating on the Name of the Lord of the Universe, perfect understanding is achieved. ||1||

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਜਪਤ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal gur ke japat har jap hau jeevaa |
English: Meditating on the Lotus Feet of the Guru, and chanting the Name of the Lord, I live.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਆਰਾਧਤੇ ਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham aaraadhate mukh amrit peevaa |1| rahaau |
English: Worshipping the Supreme Lord God in adoration, my mouth drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਬਸੇ ਸਭ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਲੋਚ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jant sabh sukh base sabh kai man loch |
English: All beings and creatures dwell in peace; the minds of all yearn for the Lord.

Gurbani: ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਤ ਚਿਤਵਤੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਪੋਚ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: praupakaar nit chitavate naahee kachh poch |2|
English: Those who continually remember the Lord, do good deeds for others; they harbor no ill will towards anyone. ||2||

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਬਸੰਤ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਹ ਜਪੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: dhan su thaan basant dhan jeh japeeai naam |
English: Blessed is that place, and blessed are those who dwell there, where they chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਥਾ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਅਤਿ ਘਨਾ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kathaa keeratan har at ghanaa sukh sehaj bisraam |3|
English: The Sermon and the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises are sung there very often; there is peace, poise and tranquility. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਤੇ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਅਨਾਥ ਕੋ ਨਾਥ ॥
Transliteration: man te kade na veesarai anaath ko naath |
English: In my mind, I never forget the Lord; He is the Master of the masterless.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹਾਥ ॥੪॥੨੯॥੫੯॥
Transliteration: naanak prabh saranaagatee jaa kai sabh kichh haath |4|29|59|
English: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of God; everything is in His hands. ||4||29||59||

[Ang 816 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂ ਬੰਧਿ ਕਰਿ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਫੁਨਿ ਸੁਖ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jin too bandh kar chhoddiaa fun sukh meh paaeaa |
English: The One who bound you in the womb and then released you, placed you in the world of joy.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਚਰਣਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਸੀਤਲ ਹੋਤਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sadaa simar charanaarabind seetal hotaaeaa |1|
English: Contemplate His Lotus Feet forever, and you shall be cooled and soothed. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਤਿਆ ਅਥਵਾ ਮੁਇਆ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jeevatiaa athavaa mueaa kichh kaam na aavai |
English: In life and in death, this Maya is of no use.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹੁ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ਕੋਊ ਤਿਸ ਸਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jin ehu rachan rachaaeaa koaoo tis siau rang laavai |1| rahaau |
English: He created this creation, but rare are those who enshrine love for Him. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਉਸਨ ਸੀਤ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੈ ਘਾਮ ਤੇ ਕਾਢੈ ॥
Transliteration: re praanee usan seet karataa karai ghaam te kaadtai |
English: O mortal, the Creator Lord made summer and winter; He saves you from the heat.

Gurbani: ਕੀਰੀ ਤੇ ਹਸਤੀ ਕਰੈ ਟੂਟਾ ਲੇ ਗਾਢੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: keeree te hasatee karai ttoottaa le gaadtai |2|
English: From the ant, He makes an elephant; He reunites those who have been separated. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅੰਡਜ ਜੇਰਜ ਸੇਤਜ ਉਤਭੁਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਇਹ ਕਿਰਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: anddaj jeraj setaj utabhujaa prabh kee ih kirat |
English: Eggs, wombs, sweat and earth - these are God's workshops of creation.

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਤ ਕਮਾਵਨ ਸਰਬ ਫਲ ਰਵੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਤਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kirat kamaavan sarab fal raveeai har nirat |3|
English: It is fruitful for all to practice contemplation of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਤੇ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵਨਾ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਧ ॥
Transliteration: ham te kachhoo na hovanaa saran prabh saadh |
English: I cannot do anything; O God, I seek the Sanctuary of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਕੂਪ ਅੰਧ ਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਕਾਢ ॥੪॥੩੦॥੬੦॥
Transliteration: moh magan koop andh te naanak gur kaadt |4|30|60|
English: Guru Nanak pulled me up, out of the deep, dark pit, the intoxication of attachment. ||4||30||60||

[Ang 816 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਮੈ ਫਿਰਾ ਖੋਜਉ ਬਨ ਥਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: khojat khojat mai firaa khojau ban thaan |
English: Searching, searching, I wander around searching, in the woods and other places.

Gurbani: ਅਛਲ ਅਛੇਦ ਅਭੇਦ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਐਸੇ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: achhal achhed abhed prabh aise bhagavaan |1|
English: He is undeceivable, imperishable, inscrutable; such is my Lord God. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਬ ਦੇਖਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਨਾ ਆਤਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: kab dekhau prabh aapanaa aatam kai rang |
English: When shall I behold my God, and delight my soul?

Gurbani: ਜਾਗਨ ਤੇ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਭਲਾ ਬਸੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaagan te supanaa bhalaa baseeai prabh sang |1| rahaau |
English: Even better than being awake, is the dream in which I dwell with God. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਰਨ ਆਸ੍ਰਮ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਨਉ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
Transliteration: baran aasram saasatr sunau darasan kee piaas |
English: Listening to the Shaastras teaching about the four social classes and the four stages of life, I grow thirsty for the Blessed Vision of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਪੰਚ ਤਤ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਬਿਨਾਸ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: roop na rekh na panch tat tthaakur abinaas |2|
English: He has no form or outline, and He is not made of the five elements; our Lord and Master is imperishable. ||2||

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਹਹਿ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਜੋਗੀਸੁਰ ॥
Transliteration: ohu saroop santan kaheh virale jogeesur |
English: How rare are those Saints and great Yogis, who describe the beautiful form of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੇ ਧਨਿ ਧਨਿ ਤੇ ਈਸੁਰ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa jaa kau mile dhan dhan te eesur |3|
English: Blessed, blessed are they, whom the Lord meets in His Mercy. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੋ ਬਾਹਰੇ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਤਹ ਭਰਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: so antar so baahare binase teh bharamaa |
English: They know that He is deep within, and outside as well; their doubts are dispelled.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਰਮਾ ॥੪॥੩੧॥੬੧॥
Transliteration: naanak tis prabh bhettiaa jaa ke pooran karamaa |4|31|61|
English: O Nanak, God meets those, whose karma is perfect. ||4||31||61||

[Ang 816 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਦੇਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jant suprasan bhe dekh prabh parataap |
English: All beings and creatures are totally pleased, gazing on God's glorious radiance.

Gurbani: ਕਰਜੁ ਉਤਾਰਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕਰਿ ਆਹਰੁ ਆਪ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: karaj utaariaa satiguroo kar aahar aap |1|
English: The True Guru has paid off my debt; He Himself did it. ||1||

Gurbani: ਖਾਤ ਖਰਚਤ ਨਿਬਹਤ ਰਹੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਅਖੂਟ ॥
Transliteration: khaat kharachat nibahat rahai gurasabad akhoott |
English: Eating and expending it, it is always available; the Word of the Guru's Shabad is inexhaustible.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਭਈ ਸਮਗਰੀ ਕਬਹੂ ਨਹੀ ਤੂਟ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: pooran bhee samagaree kabahoo nahee toott |1| rahaau |
English: Everything is perfectly arranged; it is never exhausted. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਆਰਾਧਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਆਪਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang aaraadhanaa har nidh aapaar |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I worship and adore the Lord, the infinite treasure.

Gurbani: ਧਰਮ ਅਰਥ ਅਰੁ ਕਾਮ ਮੋਖ ਦੇਤੇ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਰ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: dharam arath ar kaam mokh dete nahee baar |2|
English: He does not hesitate to bless me with Dharmic faith, wealth, fulfilment of desires and liberation. ||2||

Gurbani: ਭਗਤ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ ਏਕ ਰੰਗਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat araadheh ek rang gobind gupaal |
English: The devotees worship and adore the Lord of the Universe with single-minded love.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਹੀ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: raam naam dhan sanchiaa jaa kaa nahee sumaar |3|
English: They gather in the wealth of the Lord's Name, which cannot be estimated. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: saran pare prabh tereea prabh kee vaddiaaee |
English: O God, I seek Your Sanctuary, the glorious greatness of God. Nanak:

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥੪॥੩੨॥੬੨॥
Transliteration: naanak ant na paaeeai beant gusaaee |4|32|62|
English: Your end or limitation cannot be found, O Infinite World-Lord. ||4||32||62||

[Ang 816 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕਾਰਜ ਭਏ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: simar simar pooran prabhoo kaaraj bhe raas |
English: Meditate, meditate in remembrance of the Perfect Lord God, and your affairs shall be perfectly resolved.

Gurbani: ਕਰਤਾਰ ਪੁਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਵਸੈ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: karataar pur karataa vasai santan kai paas |1| rahaau |
English: In Kartaarpur, the City of the Creator Lord, the Saints dwell with the Creator. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਲਾਗਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: bighan na koaoo laagataa gur peh aradaas |
English: No obstacles will block your way, when you offer your prayers to the Guru.

Gurbani: ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਰਾਇ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: rakhavaalaa gobind raae bhagatan kee raas |1|
English: The Sovereign Lord of the Universe is the Saving Grace, the Protector of the capital of His devotees. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕਦੇ ਮੂਲਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: tott na aavai kade mool pooran bhanddaar |
English: There is never any deficiency at all; the Lord's treasures are over-flowing.

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: charan kamal man tan base prabh agam apaar |2|
English: His Lotus Feet are enshrined within my mind and body; God is inaccessible and infinite. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬਸਤ ਕਮਾਵਤ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਊਨ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: basat kamaavat sabh sukhee kichh aoon na deesai |
English: All those who work for Him dwell in peace; you can see that they lack nothing.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਭੇਟੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਪੂਰਨ ਜਗਦੀਸੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sant prasaad bhette prabhoo pooran jagadeesai |3|
English: By the Grace of the Saints, I have met God, the Perfect Lord of the Universe. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਸਭੈ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jai jai kaar sabhai kareh sach thaan suhaaeaa |
English: Everyone congratulates me, and celebrates my victory; the home of the True Lord is so beautiful!

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸੁਖ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੩੩॥੬੩॥
Transliteration: jap naanak naam nidhaan sukh pooraa gur paaeaa |4|33|63|
English: Nanak chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the treasure of peace; I have found the Perfect Guru. ||4||33||63||

[Ang 817 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਹੋਈਐ ਆਰੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: har har har aaraadheeai hoeeai aarog |
English: Worship and adore the Lord, Har, Har, Har, and you shall be free of disease.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮਚੰਦ ਕੀ ਲਸਟਿਕਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਰੋਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raamachand kee lasattikaa jin maariaa rog |1| rahaau |
English: This is the Lord's healing rod, which eradicates all disease. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪੀਐ ਨਿਤ ਕੀਚੈ ਭੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur pooraa har jaapeeai nit keechai bhog |
English: Meditating on the Lord, through the Perfect Guru, he constantly enjoys pleasure.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਵਾਰਣੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saadhasangat kai vaaranai miliaa sanjog |1|
English: I am devoted to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; I have been united with my Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਬਿਓਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: jis simarat sukh paaeeai binasai biog |
English: Contemplating Him, peace is obtained, and separation is ended.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੨॥੩੪॥੬੪॥
Transliteration: naanak prabh saranaagatee karan kaaran jog |2|34|64|
English: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God, the All-powerful Creator, the Cause of causes. ||2||34||64||

[Ang 817 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raag bilaaval mahalaa 5 dupade ghar 5 |
English: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Dho-Padhay, Fifth House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਅਵਰਿ ਉਪਾਵ ਸਭਿ ਤਿਆਗਿਆ ਦਾਰੂ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: avar upaav sabh tiaagiaa daaroo naam leaa |
English: I have given up all other efforts, and have taken the medicine of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਾਪ ਪਾਪ ਸਭਿ ਮਿਟੇ ਰੋਗ ਸੀਤਲ ਮਨੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: taap paap sabh mitte rog seetal man bheaa |1|
English: Fevers, sins and all diseases are eradicated, and my mind is cooled and soothed. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਸਗਲਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur pooraa aaraadhiaa sagalaa dukh geaa |
English: Worshipping the Perfect Guru in adoration, all pains are dispelled.

Gurbani: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੈ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਅਪਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਮਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raakhanahaarai raakhiaa apanee kar meaa |1| rahaau |
English: The Savior Lord has saved me; He has blessed me with His Kind Mercy. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਾਹ ਪਕੜਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਾਢਿਆ ਕੀਨਾ ਅਪਨਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: baah pakarr prabh kaadtiaa keenaa apaneaa |
English: Grabbing hold of my arm, God has pulled me up and out; He has made me His own.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਸੁਖੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਭਇਆ ॥੨॥੧॥੬੫॥
Transliteration: simar simar man tan sukhee naanak nirabheaa |2|1|65|
English: Meditating, meditating in remembrance, my mind and body are at peace; Nanak has become fearless. ||2||1||65||

[Ang 817 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਰੁ ਧਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਥਾਪਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਨੋ ਦਾਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: kar dhar masatak thaapiaa naam deeno daan |
English: Placing His Hand upon my forehead, God has given me the gift of His Name.

Gurbani: ਸਫਲ ਸੇਵਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਨਹੀ ਹਾਨਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: safal sevaa paarabraham kee taa kee nahee haan |1|
English: One who performs fruitful service for the Supreme Lord God, never suffers any loss. ||1||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਖਤਾ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੀ ਆਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: aape hee prabh raakhataa bhagatan kee aan |
English: God Himself saves the honor of His devotees.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਚਿਤਵਹਿ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਸੋ ਲੇਤਾ ਮਾਨਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo jo chitaveh saadh jan so letaa maan |1| rahaau |
English: Whatever God's Holy servants wish for, He grants to them. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਚਰਣਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: saran pare charanaarabind jan prabh ke praan |
English: God's humble servants seek the Sanctuary of His Lotus Feet; they are God's very breath of life.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲੇ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਨ ॥੨॥੨॥੬੬॥
Transliteration: sehaj subhaae naanak mile jotee jot samaan |2|2|66|
English: O Nanak, they automatically, intuitively meet God; their light merges into the Light. ||2||2||66||

[Ang 817 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਕਾ ਆਸਰਾ ਦੀਨੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal kaa aasaraa deeno prabh aap |
English: God Himself has given me the Support of His Lotus Feet.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਜਨ ਪਰੇ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਸਦ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: prabh saranaagat jan pare taa kaa sad parataap |1|
English: God's humble servants seek His Sanctuary; they are respected and famous forever. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: raakhanahaar apaar prabh taa kee niramal sev |
English: God is the unparalleled Savior and Protector; service to Him is immaculate and pure.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਪੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੑੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raam raaj raamadaas pur keenae guradev |1| rahaau |
English: The Divine Guru has built the City of Ramdaspur, the royal domain of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਕਿਛੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa har dhiaaeeai kichh bighan na laagai |
English: Forever and ever, meditate on the Lord, and no obstacles will obstruct you.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਭਇ ਦੁਸਮਨ ਭਾਗੈ ॥੨॥੩॥੬੭॥
Transliteration: naanak naam salaaheeai bhe dusaman bhaagai |2|3|67|
English: O Nanak, praising the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the fear of enemies runs away. ||2||3||67||

[Ang 817 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧ ਸਮਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: man tan prabh aaraadheeai mil saadh samaagai |
English: Worship and adore God in your mind and body; join the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਉਚਰਤ ਗੁਨ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਜਸੁ ਦੂਰ ਤੇ ਜਮੁ ਭਾਗੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aucharat gun gopaal jas door te jam bhaagai |1|
English: Chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, the Messenger of Death runs far away. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਜਪੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦ ਜਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam jo jan japai anadin sad jaagai |
English: That humble being who chants the Lord's Name, remains always awake and aware, night and day.

Gurbani: ਤੰਤੁ ਮੰਤੁ ਨਹ ਜੋਹਈ ਤਿਤੁ ਚਾਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tant mant neh johee tith chaakh na laagai |1| rahaau |
English: He is not affected by charms and spells, nor is he harmed by the evil eye. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮਦ ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਅਨਰਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh mad maan moh binase anaraagai |
English: Sexual desire, anger, the intoxication of egotism and emotional attachment are dispelled, by loving devotion.

Gurbani: ਆਨੰਦ ਮਗਨ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਾਗੈ ॥੨॥੪॥੬੮॥
Transliteration: aanand magan ras raam rang naanak saranaagai |2|4|68|
English: One who enters the Lord's Sanctuary, O Nanak, remains merged in ecstasy in the subtle essence of the Lord's Love. ||2||4||68||

[Ang 818 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਵਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕੈ ਜੋ ਕਹੈ ਸੁ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jugat vas prabhoo kai jo kahai su karanaa |
English: The living creatures and their ways are in God's power. Whatever He says, they do.

Gurbani: ਭਏ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਰਾਇ ਭਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਕਰਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bhe prasan gopaal raae bhau kichh nahee karanaa |1|
English: When the Sovereign Lord of the Universe is pleased, there is nothing at all to fear. ||1||

Gurbani: ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕਦੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਚਿਤਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: dookh na laagai kade tudh paarabraham chitaare |
English: Pain shall never afflict you, if you remember the Supreme Lord God.

Gurbani: ਜਮਕੰਕਰੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jamakankar nerr na aavee gurasikh piaare |1| rahaau |
English: The Messenger of Death does not even approach the beloved Sikhs of the Guru. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਹੋਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: karan kaaran samarath hai tis bin nahee hor |
English: The All-powerful Lord is the Cause of causes; there is no other than Him.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਜੋਰੁ ॥੨॥੫॥੬੯॥
Transliteration: naanak prabh saranaagatee saachaa man jor |2|5|69|
English: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of God; the True Lord has given strength to the mind. ||2||5||69||

[Ang 818 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਨਾ ਨਾਠਾ ਦੁਖ ਠਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: simar simar prabh aapanaa naatthaa dukh tthaau |
