English: Remembering, remembering my God in meditation, the house of pain is removed.

Gurbani: ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਪਾਏ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਧਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bisraam paae mil saadhasang taa te bahurr na dhaau |1|
English: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I have found peace and tranquility; I shall not wander away from there again. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਨੇ ਚਰਨਨੑ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: balihaaree gur aapane charanana bal jaau |
English: I am devoted to my Guru; I am a sacrifice to His Feet.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦ ਸੂਖ ਮੰਗਲ ਬਨੇ ਪੇਖਤ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: anad sookh mangal bane pekhat gun gaau |1| rahaau |
English: I am blessed with ecstasy, peace and happiness, gazing upon the Guru, and singing the Lord's Glorious Praises. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਥਾ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਬਨਿਓ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
Transliteration: kathaa keeratan raag naad dhun ihu banio suaau |
English: This is my life's purpose, to sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, and listen to the vibrations of the sound current of the Naad.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਫਲ ਪਾਉ ॥੨॥੬॥੭੦॥
Transliteration: naanak prabh suprasan bhe baanchhat fal paau |2|6|70|
English: O Nanak, God is totally pleased with me; I have obtained the fruits of my desires. ||2||6||70||

[Ang 818 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਰਿਦ ਕਰਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: daas tere kee benatee rid kar paragaas |
English: This is the prayer of Your slave: please enlighten my heart.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਦੋਖਨ ਕੋ ਨਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tumaree kripaa te paarabraham dokhan ko naas |1|
English: By Your Mercy, O Supreme Lord God, please erase my sins. ||1||

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਕਾ ਆਸਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੁਰਖ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal kaa aasaraa prabh purakh gunataas |
English: I take the Support of Your Lotus Feet, O God, Primal Lord, treasure of virtue.

Gurbani: ਕੀਰਤਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਰਹਉ ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਘਟਿ ਸਾਸੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: keeratan naam simarat rhau jab lag ghatt saas |1| rahaau |
English: I shall meditate in remembrance on the Praises of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, as long as there is breath in my body. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਬੰਧਪ ਤੂਹੈ ਤੂ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: maat pitaa bandhap toohai too sarab nivaas |
English: You are my mother, father and relative; You are abiding within all.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਾਸੁ ॥੨॥੭॥੭੧॥
Transliteration: naanak prabh saranaagatee jaa ko niramal jaas |2|7|71|
English: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God; His Praise is immaculate and pure. ||2||7||71||

[Ang 818 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਸਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਈਐ ਸਭਿ ਭਲਾ ਮਨਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: sarab sidh har gaaeeai sabh bhalaa manaaveh |
English: All perfect spiritual powers are obtained, when one sings the Lord's Praises; everyone wishes him well.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੁ ਸਾਧੁ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਕਹਹਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਦਾਸ ਮਿਲਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saadh saadh mukh te kaheh sun daas milaaveh |1|
English: Everyone calls him holy and spiritual; hearing of him, the Lord's slaves come to meet him. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਰਸ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੑ ॥
Transliteration: sookh sehaj kaliaan ras poorai gur keena |
English: The Perfect Guru blesses him with peace, poise, salvation and happiness.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਸਗਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਭਏ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੀਨੑ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jeea sagal deaal bhe har har naam cheena |1| rahaau |
English: All living beings become compassionate to him; he remembers the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: poor rahio sarabatr meh prabh gunee gaheer |
English: He is permeating and pervading everywhere; God is the ocean of virtue.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤ ਆਨੰਦ ਮੈ ਪੇਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਧੀਰ ॥੨॥੮॥੭੨॥
Transliteration: naanak bhagat aanand mai pekh prabh kee dheer |2|8|72|
English: O Nanak, the devotees are in bliss, gazing upon God's abiding stability. ||2||8||72||

[Ang 818 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਦਾਤਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਹੋਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: aradaas sunee daataar prabh hoe kirapaal |
English: God, the Great Giver, has become merciful; He has listened to my prayer.

Gurbani: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਆ ਅਪਨਾ ਸੇਵਕੋ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: raakh leea apanaa sevako mukh nindak chhaar |1|
English: He has saved His servant, and put ashes into the mouth of the slanderer. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੁਝਹਿ ਨ ਜੋਹੈ ਕੋ ਮੀਤ ਜਨ ਤੂੰ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: tujheh na johai ko meet jan toon gur kaa daas |
English: No one can threaten you now, O my humble friend, for you are the slave of the Guru.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਦੇ ਅਪਨੇ ਹਾਥ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham too raakhiaa de apane haath |1| rahaau |
English: The Supreme Lord God reached out with His Hand and saved you. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੀਅਨ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਬੀਆ ਨਹੀ ਹੋਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jeean kaa daataa ek hai beea nahee hor |
English: The One Lord is the Giver of all beings; there is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀਆ ਮੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਜੋਰੁ ॥੨॥੯॥੭੩॥
Transliteration: naanak kee benanteea mai teraa jor |2|9|73|
English: Nanak prays, You are my only strength, God. ||2||9||73||

[Ang 818 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੀਤ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਸਾਜਨਾ ਰਾਖੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: meet hamaare saajanaa raakhe govind |
English: The Lord of the Universe has saved my friends and companions.

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਮਿਰਤਕ ਹੋਇ ਗਏ ਤੁਮੑ ਹੋਹੁ ਨਿਚਿੰਦ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: nindak miratak hoe ge tuma hohu nichind |1| rahaau |
English: The slanderers have died, so do not worry. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਏ ਭੇਟੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: sagal manorath prabh kee bhette guradev |
English: God has fulfilled all hopes and desires; I have met the Divine Guru.

Gurbani: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਜਗਤ ਮਹਿ ਸਫਲ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jai jai kaar jagat meh safal jaa kee sev |1|
English: God is celebrated and acclaimed all over the world; it is fruitful and rewarding to serve Him. ||1||

Gurbani: ਊਚ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਗਨਤ ਹਰਿ ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
Transliteration: aooch apaar aganat har sabh jeea jis haath |
English: Lofty, infinite and immeasurable is the Lord; all beings are in His Hands.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਮੇਰੈ ਸਾਥਿ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੭੪॥
Transliteration: naanak prabh saranaagatee jat kat merai saath |2|10|74|
English: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of God; He is with me everywhere. ||2||10||74||

[Ang 819 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਹੋਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: gur pooraa aaraadhiaa hoe kirapaal |
English: I worship the Perfect Guru in adoration; He has become merciful to me.

Gurbani: ਮਾਰਗੁ ਸੰਤਿ ਬਤਾਇਆ ਤੂਟੇ ਜਮ ਜਾਲ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: maarag sant bataaeaa tootte jam jaal |1|
English: The Saint has shown me the Way, and the noose of Death has been cut away. ||1||

Gurbani: ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਸੰਸਾ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਗਾਵਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: dookh bhookh sansaa mittiaa gaavat prabh naam |
English: Pain, hunger and scepticism have been dispelled, singing the Name of God.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜ ਸੂਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਰਸ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj sookh aanand ras pooran sabh kaam |1| rahaau |
English: I am blessed with celestial peace, poise, bliss and pleasure, and all my affairs have been perfectly resolved. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਲਨਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਸੀਤਲ ਭਏ ਰਾਖੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪ ॥
Transliteration: jalan bujhee seetal bhe raakhe prabh aap |
English: The fire of desire has been quenched, and I am cooled and soothed; God Himself saved me.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਵਡ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੭੫॥
Transliteration: naanak prabh saranaagatee jaa kaa vadd parataap |2|11|75|
English: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of God; His glorious radiance is so great! ||2||11||75||

[Ang 819 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਧਰਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸਫਲ ਥਾਨੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਏ ਕਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: dharat suhaavee safal thaan pooran bhe kaam |
English: The earth is beautified, all places are fruitful, and my affairs are perfectly resolved.

Gurbani: ਭਉ ਨਾਠਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਇਆ ਰਵਿਆ ਨਿਤ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bhau naatthaa bhram mitt geaa raviaa nit raam |1|
English: Fear runs away, and doubt is dispelled, dwelling constantly upon the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸਤ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: saadh janaa kai sang basat sukh sehaj bisraam |
English: Dwelling with the humble Holy people, one finds peace, poise and tranquility.

Gurbani: ਸਾਈ ਘੜੀ ਸੁਲਖਣੀ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saaee gharree sulakhanee simarat har naam |1| rahaau |
English: Blessed and auspicious is that time, when one meditates in remembrance on the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਏ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਮਹਿ ਫਿਰਤੇ ਪਹਨਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: pragatt bhe sansaar meh firate pahanaam |
English: They have become famous throughout the world; before this, no one even knew their names.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਸਭ ਜਾਨ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੭੬॥
Transliteration: naanak tis saranaagatee ghatt ghatt sabh jaan |2|12|76|
English: Nanak has come to the Sanctuary of the One who knows each and every heart. ||2||12||76||

[Ang 819 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰੋਗੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: rog mittaaeaa aap prabh upajiaa sukh saant |
English: God Himself eradicated the disease; peace and tranquility have welled up.

Gurbani: ਵਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਅਚਰਜ ਰੂਪੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਨੑੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: vadd parataap acharaj roop har keenaee daat |1|
English: The Lord blessed me with the gifts of great, glorious radiance and wondrous form. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur govind kripaa karee raakhiaa meraa bhaaee |
English: The Guru, the Lord of the Universe, has shown mercy to me, and saved my brother.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਜੋ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ham tis kee saranaagatee jo sadaa sahaaee |1| rahaau |
English: I am under His Protection; He is always my help and support. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਿਰਥੀ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: birathee kade na hovee jan kee aradaas |
English: The prayer of the Lord's humble servant is never offered in vain.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋਰੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਿ ॥੨॥੧੩॥੭੭॥
Transliteration: naanak jor govind kaa pooran gunataas |2|13|77|
English: Nanak takes the strength of the Perfect Lord of the Universe, the treasure of excellence. ||2||13||77||

[Ang 819 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੇ ਜਿਨ ਬਿਸਰਿਆ ਜੀਵਨ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: mar mar janame jin bisariaa jeevan kaa daataa |
English: Those who forget the Giver of life, die, over and over again, only to be reborn and die.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: paarabraham jan seviaa anadin rang raataa |1|
English: The humble servant of the Supreme Lord God serves Him; night and day, he remains imbued with His Love. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜੁ ਆਨਦੁ ਘਨਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਈ ਆਸ ॥
Transliteration: saant sehaj aanad ghanaa pooran bhee aas |
English: I have found peace, tranquility and great ecstasy; my hopes have been fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sukh paaeaa har saadhasang simarat gunataas |1| rahaau |
English: I have found peace in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; I meditate in remembrance on the Lord, the treasure of virtue. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਜਨ ਤੁਮੑ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: sun suaamee aradaas jan tuma antarajaamee |
English: O my Lord and Master, please listen to the prayer of Your humble servant; You are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

Gurbani: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੨॥੧੪॥੭੮॥
Transliteration: thaan thanantar rav rahe naanak ke suaamee |2|14|78|
English: Nanak's Lord and Master is permeating and pervading all places and interspaces. ||2||14||78||

[Ang 819 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤਾਤੀ ਵਾਉ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: taatee vaau na lagee paarabraham saranaaee |
English: The hot wind does not even touch one who is under the Protection of the Supreme Lord God.

Gurbani: ਚਉਗਿਰਦ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਰਾਮ ਕਾਰ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: chaugirad hamaarai raam kaar dukh lagai na bhaaee |1|
English: On all four sides I am surrounded by the Lord's Circle of Protection; pain does not afflict me, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur pooraa bhettiaa jin banat banaaee |
English: I have met the Perfect True Guru, who has done this deed.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਦੀਆ ਏਕਾ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam aaukhadh deea ekaa liv laaee |1| rahaau |
English: He has given me the medicine of the Lord's Name, and I enshrine love for the One Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਤਿਨਿ ਰਖਨਹਾਰਿ ਸਭ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਮਿਟਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: raakh lee tin rakhanahaar sabh biaadh mittaaee |
English: The Savior Lord has saved me, and eradicated all my sickness.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੨॥੧੫॥੭੯॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak kirapaa bhee prabh bhe sahaaee |2|15|79|
English: Says Nanak, God has showered me with His Mercy; He has become my help and support. ||2||15||79||

[Ang 819 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਪਣੇ ਬਾਲਕ ਆਪਿ ਰਖਿਅਨੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: apane baalak aap rakhian paarabraham guradev |
English: The Supreme Lord God, through the Divine Guru, has Himself protected and preserved His children.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਆਨਦ ਭਏ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਈ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sukh saant sehaj aanad bhe pooran bhee sev |1| rahaau |
English: Celestial peace, tranquility and bliss have come to pass; my service has been perfect. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਸੁਣੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat janaa kee benatee sunee prabh aap |
English: God Himself has heard the prayers of His humble devotees.

Gurbani: ਰੋਗ ਮਿਟਾਇ ਜੀਵਾਲਿਅਨੁ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਵਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: rog mittaae jeevaalian jaa kaa vadd parataap |1|
English: He dispelled my disease, and rejuvenated me; His glorious radiance is so great! ||1||

Gurbani: ਦੋਖ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਬਖਸਿਅਨੁ ਅਪਣੀ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: dokh hamaare bakhasian apanee kal dhaaree |
English: He has forgiven me for my sins, and interceded with His power.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਫਲ ਦਿਤਿਅਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੨॥੧੬॥੮੦॥
Transliteration: man baanchhat fal ditian naanak balihaaree |2|16|80|
English: I have been blessed with the fruits of my mind's desires; Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||2||16||80||

[Ang 820 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਦੁਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੬ ॥
Transliteration: raag bilaaval mahalaa 5 chaupade dupade ghar 6 |
English: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Chau-Padhay And Dho-Padhay, Sixth House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮੋਹਨ ਸ੍ਰਵਨੀ ਇਹ ਨ ਸੁਨਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: mere mohan sravanee ih na sunaae |
English: O my fascinating Lord, let me not listen to the faithless cynic,

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤ ਗੀਤ ਨਾਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਗਾਵਤ ਬੋਲਤ ਬੋਲ ਅਜਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saakat geet naad dhun gaavat bolat bol ajaae |1| rahaau |
English: Singing his songs and tunes, and chanting his useless words. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਤ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੇਵਉ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਉ ਕਿਰਤਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sevat sev sev saadh sevau sadaa krau kirataae |
English: I serve, serve, serve, serve the Holy Saints; forever and ever, I do this.

Gurbani: ਅਭੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਪਾਵਉ ਪੁਰਖ ਦਾਤੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: abhai daan paavau purakh daate mil sangat har gun gaae |1|
English: The Primal Lord, the Great Giver, has blessed me with the gift of fearlessness. Joining the Company of the Holy, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਸਨਾ ਅਗਹ ਅਗਹ ਗੁਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਨੈਨ ਦਰਸ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: rasanaa agah agah gun raatee nain daras rang laae |
English: My tongue is imbued with the Praises of the inaccessible and unfathomable Lord, and my eyes are drenched with the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

Gurbani: ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਮੋਹਿ ਚਰਣ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: hohu kripaal deen dukh bhanjan mohi charan ridai vasaae |2|
English: Be Merciful to me, O Destroyer of the pains of the meek, that I may enshrine Your Lotus Feet within my heart. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਭਹੂ ਤਲੈ ਤਲੈ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਏਹ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sabhahoo talai talai sabh aoopar eeh drisatt drisattaae |
English: Beneath all, and above all; this is the vision I saw.

Gurbani: ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਖੋਇ ਖੋਇ ਖੋਇ ਖੋਈ ਹਉ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: abhimaan khoe khoe khoe khoee hau mo kau satigur mantru drirraae |3|
English: I have destroyed, destroyed, destroyed my pride, since the True Guru implanted His Mantra within me. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅਤੁਲੁ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਨਹ ਤੁਲੀਐ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਕਿਰਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: atul atul atul neh tuleeai bhagat vachhal kirapaae |
English: Immeasurable, immeasurable, immeasurable is the Merciful Lord; he cannot be weighed. He is the Lover of His devotees.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਭੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੧॥੮੧॥
Transliteration: jo jo saran pario gur naanak abhai daan sukh paae |4|1|81|
English: Whoever enters the Sanctuary of Guru Nanak, is blessed with the gifts of fearlessness and peace. ||4||||1||81||

[Ang 820 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: prabh jee too mere praan adhaarai |
English: O Dear God, You are the Support of my breath of life.

Gurbani: ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਡੰਡਉਤਿ ਬੰਦਨਾ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਰ ਜਾਉ ਬਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: namasakaar ddanddaut bandanaa anik baar jaau baarai |1| rahaau |
English: I bow in humility and reverence to You; so many times, I am a sacrifice. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਜਾਗਤ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਚਿਤਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: aootthat baitthat sovat jaagat ihu man tujheh chitaarai |
English: Sitting down, standing up, sleeping and waking, this mind thinks of You.

Gurbani: ਸੂਖ ਦੂਖ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਆਗੈ ਸਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sookh dookh is man kee birathaa tujh hee aagai saarai |1|
English: I describe to You my pleasure and pain, and the state of this mind. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਮੇਰੀ ਓਟ ਬਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਧਨੁ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਪਰਵਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: too meree ott bal budh dhan tum hee tumeh merai paravaarai |
English: You are my shelter and support, power, intellect and wealth; You are my family.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੁਮ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਹਮਰੈ ਪੇਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖ ਚਰਨਾਰੈ ॥੨॥੨॥੮੨॥
Transliteration: jo tum karahu soee bhal hamarai pekh naanak sukh charanaarai |2|2|82|
English: Whatever You do, I know that is good. Gazing upon Your Lotus Feet, Nanak is at peace. ||2||2||82||

[Ang 820 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੁਨੀਅਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਉ ਸਗਲ ਉਧਾਰਨ ॥
Transliteration: suneeat prabh tau sagal udhaaran |
English: I have heard that God is the Savior of all.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਪਤਿਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਐਸੇ ਮਨਹਿ ਬਿਸਾਰਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: moh magan patit sang praanee aise maneh bisaaran |1| rahaau |
English: Intoxicated by attachment, in the company of sinners, the mortal has forgotten such a Lord from his mind. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੰਚਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਲੇ ਗ੍ਰਾਹਜੁ ਕੀਨੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਡਾਰਨ ॥
Transliteration: sanch bikhiaa le graahaj keenee amrit man te ddaaran |
English: He has collected poison, and grasped it firmly. But he has cast out the Ambrosial Nectar from his mind.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਰਤੁ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਬਿਦਾਰਨ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh lobh rat nindaa sat santokh bidaaran |1|
English: He is imbued with sexual desire, anger, greed and slander; he has abandoned truth and contentment. ||1||

Gurbani: ਇਨ ਤੇ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਾਰਿ ਪਰੇ ਤੁਮੑ ਸਾਰਨ ॥
Transliteration: ein te kaadt lehu mere suaamee haar pare tuma saaran |
English: Lift me up, and pull me out of these, O my Lord and Master. I have entered Your Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਹਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਰੰਕ ਤਾਰਨ ॥੨॥੩॥੮੩॥
Transliteration: naanak kee benantee prabh peh saadhasang rank taaran |2|3|83|
English: Nanak prays to God: I am a poor beggar; carry me across, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||3||83||

[Ang 820 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਸੁਨੀਅਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ॥
Transliteration: santan kai suneeat prabh kee baat |
English: I listen to God's Teachings from the Saints.

Gurbani: ਕਥਾ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਆਨੰਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਧੁਨਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੀ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਅਰੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kathaa keeratan aanand mangal dhun poor rahee dinas ar raat |1| rahaau |
English: The Lord's Sermon, the Kirtan of His Praises and the songs of bliss perfectly resonate, day and night. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨੇ ਨਾਮ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਕੀਨੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa apane prabh keene naam apune kee keenee daat |
English: In His Mercy, God has made them His own, and blessed them with the gift of His Name.

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਜਾਤ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar gun gaavat prabh ke kaam krodh is tan te jaat |1|
English: Twenty-four hours a day, I sing the Glorious Praises of God. Sexual desire and anger have left this body. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਏ ਪੇਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਖਾਤ ॥
Transliteration: tripat aghaae pekh prabh darasan amrit har ras bhojan khaat |
English: I am satisfied and satiated, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan. I eat the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's sublime food.

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਤ ॥੨॥੪॥੮੪॥
Transliteration: charan saran naanak prabh teree kar kirapaa santasang milaat |2|4|84|
English: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of Your Feet, O God; in Your Mercy, unite him with the Society of the Saints. ||2||4||84||

[Ang 821 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਅਪਨੇ ਜਨ ਆਪ ॥
Transliteration: raakh lee apane jan aap |
English: He Himself has saved His humble servant.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਨੋ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਗਏ ਸਭ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa har har naam deeno binas ge sabh sog santaap |1| rahaau |
English: In His Mercy, the Lord, Har, Har, has blessed me with His Name, and all my pains and afflictions have been dispelled. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਸਭਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਰਾਗ ਰਤਨ ਰਸਨਾ ਆਲਾਪ ॥
Transliteration: gun govind gaavahu sabh har jan raag ratan rasanaa aalaap |
English: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, all you humble servants of the Lord; chant the jewels, the songs of the Lord with your tongue.

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਨਿਵਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣਿ ਆਤਮ ਧ੍ਰਾਪ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kott janam kee trisanaa nivaree raam rasaaein aatam dhraap |1|
English: The desires of millions of incarnations shall be quenched, and your soul shall be satisfied with the sweet, sublime essence of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਗਹੇ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਜਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪ ॥
Transliteration: charan gahe saran sukhadaate gur kai bachan jape har jaap |
English: I have grasped the Sanctuary of the Lord's Feet; He is the Giver of peace; through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, I meditate and chant the Chant of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਾਗਰ ਤਰੇ ਭਰਮ ਭੈ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥੨॥੫॥੮੫॥
Transliteration: saagar tare bharam bhai binase kahu naanak tthaakur parataap |2|5|85|
English: I have crossed over the world-ocean, and my doubt and fear are dispelled, says Nanak, through the glorious granduer of our Lord and Master. ||2||5||85||

[Ang 821 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤਾਪੁ ਲਾਹਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: taap laahiaa gur sirajanahaar |
English: Through the Guru, the Creator Lord has subdued the fever.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੀ ਸਾਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur apane kau bal jaaee jin paij rakhee saarai sansaar |1| rahaau |
English: I am a sacrifice to my True Guru, who has saved the honor of the whole world. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਰੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਬਾਲਿਕੁ ਰਖਿ ਲੀਨੋ ॥
Transliteration: kar masatak dhaar baalik rakh leeno |
English: Placing His Hand on the child's forehead, He saved him.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਦੀਨੋ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: prabh amrit naam mahaa ras deeno |1|
English: God blessed me with the supreme, sublime essence of the Ambrosial Naam. ||1||

Gurbani: ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਲਾਜ ਰਖੈ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: daas kee laaj rakhai miharavaan |
English: The Merciful Lord saves the honor of His slave.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥੨॥੬॥੮੬॥
Transliteration: gur naanak bolai daragah paravaan |2|6|86|
English: Guru Nanak speaks - it is confirmed in the Court of the Lord. ||2||6||86||

[Ang 821 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਦੁਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੭ ॥
Transliteration: raag bilaaval mahalaa 5 chaupade dupade ghar 7 |
English: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Chau-Padhay And Dho-Padhay, Seventh House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਉਜਾਰੋ ਦੀਪਾ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sabad ujaaro deepaa |
English: The Shabad, the Word of the True Guru, is the light of the lamp.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਤਿਹ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਰਤਨ ਕੋਠੜੀ ਖੁਲੑੀ ਅਨੂਪਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: binasio andhakaar tih mandar ratan kottharree khulaee anoopaa |1| rahaau |
English: It dispels the darkness from the body-mansion, and opens the beautiful chamber of jewels. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਿਸਮਨ ਬਿਸਮ ਭਏ ਜਉ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: bisaman bisam bhe jau pekhio kehan na jaae vaddiaaee |
English: I was wonderstruck and astonished, when I looked inside; I cannot even describe its glory and grandeur.

Gurbani: ਮਗਨ ਭਏ ਊਹਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਤੇ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਲਪਟਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: magan bhe aoohaa sang maate ot pot lapattaaee |1|
English: I am intoxicated and enraptured with it, and I am wrapped in it, through and through. ||1||

Gurbani: ਆਲ ਜਾਲ ਨਹੀ ਕਛੂ ਜੰਜਾਰਾ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਨਹੀ ਭੋਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aal jaal nahee kachhoo janjaaraa ahanbudh nahee bhoraa |
English: No worldly entanglements or snares can trap me, and no trace of egotistical pride remains.

Gurbani: ਊਚਨ ਊਚਾ ਬੀਚੁ ਨ ਖੀਚਾ ਹਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਮੋਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aoochan aoochaa beech na kheechaa hau teraa toon moraa |2|
English: You are the highest of the high, and no curtain separates us; I am Yours, and You are mine. ||2||

Gurbani: ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ਏਕੈ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: ekankaar ek paasaaraa ekai apar apaaraa |
English: The One Creator Lord created the expanse of the one universe; the One Lord is unlimited and infinite.

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਬਿਸਥੀਰਨੁ ਏਕੁ ਸੰਪੂਰਨੁ ਏਕੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ek bisatheeran ek sanpooran ekai praan adhaaraa |3|
English: The One Lord pervades the one universe; the One Lord is totally permeating everywhere; the One Lord is the Support of the breath of life. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੂਚਾ ਸੂਚੋ ਸੂਚਾ ਸੂਚੋ ਸੂਚਾ ॥
Transliteration: niramal niramal soochaa soocho soochaa soocho soochaa |
English: He is the most immaculate of the immaculate, the purest of the pure, so pure, so pure.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤ ਨ ਅੰਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਬੇਅੰਤਾ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਊਚੋ ਊਚਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੮੭॥
Transliteration: ant na antaa sadaa beantaa kahu naanak aoocho aoochaa |4|1|87|
English: He has no end or limitation; He is forever unlimited. Says Nanak, He is the highest of the high. ||4||1||87||

[Ang 821 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਤ ਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: bin har kaam na aavat he |
English: Without the Lord, nothing is of any use.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਚਿ ਮਾਚਿ ਤੁਮੑ ਲਾਗੇ ਓਹ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਮੋਹਾਵਤ ਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaa siau raach maach tuma laage oeh mohanee mohaavat he |1| rahaau |
English: You are totally attached to that Enticer Maya; she is enticing you. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਨਿਕ ਕਾਮਿਨੀ ਸੇਜ ਸੋਹਨੀ ਛੋਡਿ ਖਿਨੈ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਵਤ ਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: kanik kaaminee sej sohanee chhodd khinai meh jaavat he |
English: You shall have to leave behind your gold, your woman and your beautiful bed; you shall have to depart in an instant.

Gurbani: ਉਰਝਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਰਸ ਪ੍ਰੇਰਿਓ ਬਿਖੈ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਖਾਵਤ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aurajh rahio indree ras prerio bikhai tthgauree khaavat he |1|
English: You are entangled in the lures of sexual pleasures, and you are eating poisonous drugs. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਕੋ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਓ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਤਲੈ ਜਰਾਵਤ ਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: trin ko mandar saaj savaario paavak talai jaraavat he |
English: You have built and adorned a palace of straw, and under it, you light a fire.

Gurbani: ਐਸੇ ਗੜ ਮਹਿ ਐਠਿ ਹਠੀਲੋ ਫੂਲਿ ਫੂਲਿ ਕਿਆ ਪਾਵਤ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aise garr meh aitth hattheelo fool fool kiaa paavat he |2|
English: Sitting all puffed-up in such a castle, you stubborn-minded fool, what do you think you will gain? ||2||

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਮੂਡ ਪਰਿ ਠਾਢੇ ਕੇਸ ਗਹੇ ਫੇਰਾਵਤ ਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: panch doot moodd par tthaadte kes gahe feraavat he |
English: The five thieves stand over your head and seize you. Grabbing you by your hair, they will drive you on.

Gurbani: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਅੰਧ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਸੋਇ ਰਹਿਓ ਮਦ ਮਾਵਤ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: drisatt na aaveh andh agiaanee soe rahio mad maavat he |3|
English: You do not see them, you blind and ignorant fool; intoxicated with ego, you just keep sleeping. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਾਲੁ ਪਸਾਰਿ ਚੋਗ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੀ ਪੰਖੀ ਜਿਉ ਫਾਹਾਵਤ ਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: jaal pasaar chog bisathaaree pankhee jiau faahaavat he |
English: The net has been spread out, and the bait has been scattered; like a bird, you are being trapped.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਨ ਕਉ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਧਿਆਵਤ ਹੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੮੮॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak bandhan kaattan kau mai satigur purakh dhiaavat he |4|2|88|
English: Says Nanak, my bonds have been broken; I meditate on the True Guru, the Primal Being. ||4||2||88||

[Ang 822 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਮੋਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam apaar amolee |
English: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is infinite and priceless.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪਿਆਰੋ ਮਨਹਿ ਅਧਾਰੋ ਚੀਤਿ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਪਾਨ ਤੰਬੋਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: praan piaaro maneh adhaaro cheet chitvau jaise paan tanbolee |1| rahaau |
English: It is the Beloved of my breath of life, and the Support of my mind; I remember it, as the betel leaf chewer remembers the betel leaf. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਓ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਬਤਾਇਓ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਤਨ ਕੀ ਚੋਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj samaaeo gureh bataaeo rang rangee mere tan kee cholee |
English: I have been absorbed in celestial bliss, following the Guru's Teachings; my body-garment is imbued with the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੋ ਜਉ ਵਡਭਾਗੋ ਸੁਹਾਗੁ ਹਮਾਰੋ ਕਤਹੁ ਨ ਡੋਲੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: pria mukh laago jau vaddabhaago suhaag hamaaro katahu na ddolee |1|
English: I come face to face with my Beloved, by great good fortune; my Husband Lord never wavers. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰੂਪ ਨ ਧੂਪ ਨ ਗੰਧ ਨ ਦੀਪਾ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਉਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: roop na dhoop na gandh na deepaa ot pot ang ang sang maulee |
English: I do not need any image, or incense, or perfume, or lamps; through and through, He is blossoming forth, with me, life and limb.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਰਵੀ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਅਤਿ ਨੀਕੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਬਨੀ ਖਟੋਲੀ ॥੨॥੩॥੮੯॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak pria ravee suhaagan at neekee meree banee khattolee |2|3|89|
English: Says Nanak, my Husband Lord has ravished and enjoyed His soul-bride; my bed has become very beautiful and sublime. ||2||3||89||

[Ang 822 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਮਈ ॥
Transliteration: gobind gobind gobind mee |
English: Chanting the Name of the Lord of the Universe, Gobind, Gobind, Gobind, we become like Him.

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਭੇਟੇ ਸਾਧ ਦਇਆਰਾ ਤਬ ਤੇ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਭਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jab te bhette saadh deaaraa tab te duramat door bhee |1| rahaau |
English: Since I met the compassionate, Holy Saints, my evil-mindedness has been driven far away. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸੰਪੂਰਨ ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਦਈ ॥
Transliteration: pooran poor rahio sanpooran seetal saant deaal dee |
English: The Perfect Lord is perfectly pervading everywhere. He is cool and calm, peaceful and compassionate.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਹੋਏ ਸਗਲ ਖਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh trisanaa ahankaaraa tan te hoe sagal khee |1|
English: Sexual desire, anger and egotistical desires have all been eliminated from my body. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ ਸੁਚਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਤੇ ਇਹੁ ਮੰਤੁ ਲਈ ॥
Transliteration: sat santokh deaa dharam such santan te ihu mant lee |
English: Truth, contentment, compassion, Dharmic faith and purity - I have received these from the Teachings of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਮਨਹੁ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਸਗਲੀ ਸੋਝ ਪਈ ॥੨॥੪॥੯੦॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak jin manahu pachhaaniaa tin kau sagalee sojh pee |2|4|90|
English: Says Nanak, one who realizes this in his mind, achieves total understanding. ||2||4||90||

[Ang 822 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਹਮ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਬੇਚਾਰੇ ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਹ ਏਕ ਰੋਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa ham jeea jant bechaare baran na saakah ek romaaee |
English: What am I? Just a poor living being. I cannot even describe one of Your hairs, O Lord.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮਹੇਸ ਸਿਧ ਮੁਨਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: braham mahes sidh mun indraa beant tthaakur teree gat nahee paaee |1|
English: Even Brahma, Shiva, the Siddhas and the silent sages do not know Your State, O Infinite Lord and Master. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਕਥੀਐ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa katheeai kichh kathan na jaaee |
English: What can I say? I cannot say anything.

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jeh jeh dekhaa teh rahiaa samaaee |1| rahaau |
English: Wherever I look, I see the Lord pervading. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਮਹਾ ਭਇਆਨ ਦੂਖ ਜਮ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਤਹ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੂਹੈ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jeh mahaa bheaan dookh jam suneeai teh mere prabh toohai sahaaee |
English: And there, where the most terrible tortures are heard to be inflicted by the Messenger of Death, You are my only help and support, O my God.

Gurbani: ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਗਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੨॥੫॥੯੧॥
Transliteration: saran pario har charan gahe prabh gur naanak kau boojh bujhaaee |2|5|91|
English: I have sought His Sanctuary, and grasped hold of the Lord's Lotus Feet; God has helped Guru Nanak to understand this understanding. ||2||5||91||

[Ang 822 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਗਮ ਰੂਪ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਕਰਤਾ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵਿਤ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਜਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: agam roop abinaasee karataa patit pavit ik nimakh japaaeeai |
English: O Inaccessible, Beautiful, Imperishable Creator Lord, Purifier of sinners, let me meditate on You, even for an instant.

Gurbani: ਅਚਰਜੁ ਸੁਨਿਓ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਭੇਟੁਲੇ ਸੰਤ ਚਰਨ ਚਰਨ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: acharaj sunio paraapat bhettule sant charan charan man laaeeai |1|
English: O Wondrous Lord, I have heard that You are found by meeting the Saints, and focusing the mind on their feet, their holy feet. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧੀਐ ਕਿਤੁ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: kit bidheeai kit sanjam paaeeai |
English: In what way, and by what discipline, is He obtained?

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਸੁਰਜਨ ਕਿਤੁ ਜੁਗਤੀ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kahu surajan kit jugatee dhiaaeeai |1| rahaau |
English: Tell me, O good man, by what means can we meditate on Him? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਮਾਨੁਖੁ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਓਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਲਈ ਲਈ ਫੁਨਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: jo maanukh maanukh kee sevaa ohu tis kee lee lee fun jaaeeai |
English: If one human being serves another human being, the one served stands by him.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਮੋਹਿ ਟੇਕ ਤੇਰੋ ਇਕ ਨਾਈਐ ॥੨॥੬॥੯੨॥
Transliteration: naanak saran saran sukh saagar mohi ttek tero ik naaeeai |2|6|92|
English: Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary and Protection, O Lord, ocean of peace; He takes the Support of Your Name alone. ||2||6||92||

[Ang 822 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੰਤ ਟਹਲ ਕਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: sant saran sant ttehal karee |
English: I seek the Sanctuary of the Saints, and I serve the Saints.

Gurbani: ਧੰਧੁ ਬੰਧੁ ਅਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਜੰਜਾਰੋ ਅਵਰ ਕਾਜ ਤੇ ਛੂਟਿ ਪਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dhandh bandh ar sagal janjaaro avar kaaj te chhoott paree |1| rahaau |
English: I am rid of all worldly concerns, bonds, entanglements and other affairs. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਅਰੁ ਘਨੋ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਓ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: sookh sehaj ar ghano anandaa gur te paaeo naam haree |
English: I have obtained peace, poise and great bliss from the Guru, through the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਐਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਉਲਟਿ ਧਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aiso har ras baran na saakau gur poorai meree ulatt dharee |1|
English: Such is the sublime essence of the Lord, that I cannot describe it. The Perfect Guru has turned me away from the world. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪੇਖਿਓ ਮੋਹਨੁ ਸਭ ਕੈ ਸੰਗੇ ਊਨ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਸਗਲ ਭਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: pekhio mohan sabh kai sange aoon na kaahoo sagal bharee |
English: I behold the Fascinating Lord with everyone. No one is without Him - He is pervading everywhere.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਪਰੀ ॥੨॥੭॥੯੩॥
Transliteration: pooran poor rahio kirapaa nidh kahu naanak meree pooree paree |2|7|93|
English: The Perfect Lord, the treasure of mercy, is permeating everywhere. Says Nanak, I am fully fulfilled. ||2||7||93||

[Ang 823 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਤਾ ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: man kiaa kahataa hau kiaa kahataa |
English: What does the mind say? What can I say?

Gurbani: ਜਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaan prabeen tthaakur prabh mere tis aagai kiaa kahataa |1| rahaau |
English: You are wise and all-knowing, O God, my Lord and Master; what can I say to You? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਨਬੋਲੇ ਕਉ ਤੁਹੀ ਪਛਾਨਹਿ ਜੋ ਜੀਅਨ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: anabole kau tuhee pachhaaneh jo jeean meh hotaa |
English: You know even what is not said, whatever is in the soul.

Gurbani: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਕਾਇ ਕਹਾ ਲਉ ਡਹਕਹਿ ਜਉ ਪੇਖਤ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਨਤਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: re man kaae kahaa lau ddahakeh jau pekhat hee sang sunataa |1|
English: O mind, why do you deceive others? How long will you do this? The Lord is with you; He hears and sees everything. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸੋ ਜਾਨਿ ਭਏ ਮਨਿ ਆਨਦ ਆਨ ਨ ਬੀਓ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: aiso jaan bhe man aanad aan na beeo karataa |
English: Knowing this, my mind has become blissful; there is no other Creator.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਲਹਤਾ ॥੨॥੮॥੯੪॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak gur bhe deaaraa har rang na kabahoo lahataa |2|8|94|
English: Says Nanak, the Guru has become kind to me; my love for the Lord shall never wear off. ||2||8||94||

[Ang 823 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਐਸੇ ਹੀ ਝਰਿ ਪਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: nindak aise hee jhar pareeai |
English: Thus, the slanderer crumbles away.

Gurbani: ਇਹ ਨੀਸਾਨੀ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਭਾਈ ਜਿਉ ਕਾਲਰ ਭੀਤਿ ਗਿਰੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: eih neesaanee sunahu tum bhaaee jiau kaalar bheet gireeai |1| rahaau |
English: This is the distinctive sign - listen, O Siblings of Destiny: he collapses like a wall of sand. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਦੇਖੈ ਛਿਦ੍ਰੁ ਤਉ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਉਮਾਹੈ ਭਲੋ ਦੇਖਿ ਦੁਖ ਭਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: jau dekhai chhidru tau nindak umaahai bhalo dekh dukh bhareeai |
English: When the slanderer sees a fault in someone else, he is pleased. Seeing goodness, he is depressed.

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਨਹੀ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਬੁਰਾ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਮਰੀਐ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar chitavai nahee pahuchai buraa chitavat chitavat mareeai |1|
English: Twenty-four hours a day, he plots, but nothing works. The evil man dies, constantly thinking up evil plans. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਕਾਲੁ ਨੇਰੈ ਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸਿਉ ਬਾਦੁ ਉਠਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: nindak prabhoo bhulaaeaa kaal nerai aaeaa har jan siau baad utthareeai |
English: The slanderer forgets God, death approaches him, and he starts to argue with the humble servant of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਰਾਖਾ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਿਆ ਮਾਨਸ ਬਪੁਰੇ ਕਰੀਐ ॥੨॥੯॥੯੫॥
Transliteration: naanak kaa raakhaa aap prabh suaamee kiaa maanas bapure kareeai |2|9|95|
English: God Himself, the Lord and Master, is Nanak's protector. What can any wretched person do to him? ||2||9||95||

[Ang 823 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਐਸੇ ਕਾਹੇ ਭੂਲਿ ਪਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aise kaahe bhool pare |
English: Why do you wander in delusion like this?

Gurbani: ਕਰਹਿ ਕਰਾਵਹਿ ਮੂਕਰਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਪੇਖਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kareh karaaveh mookar paaveh pekhat sunat sadaa sang hare |1| rahaau |
English: You act, and incite others to act, and then deny it. The Lord is always with you; He sees and hears everything. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਾਚ ਬਿਹਾਝਨ ਕੰਚਨ ਛਾਡਨ ਬੈਰੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੇਤੁ ਸਾਜਨ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਖਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kaach bihaajhan kanchan chhaaddan bairee sang het saajan tiaag khare |
English: You purchase glass, and discard gold; you are in love with your enemy, while you renounce your true friend.

Gurbani: ਹੋਵਨੁ ਕਉਰਾ ਅਨਹੋਵਨੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਹਿ ਲਪਟਾਇ ਜਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: hovan kauraa anahovan meetthaa bikhiaa meh lapattaae jare |1|
English: That which exists, seems bitter; that which does not exist, seems sweet to you. Engrossed in corruption, you are burning away. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਪਰਾਨੀ ਭਰਮ ਗੁਬਾਰ ਮੋਹ ਬੰਧਿ ਪਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: andh koop meh pario paraanee bharam gubaar moh bandh pare |
English: The mortal has fallen into the deep, dark pit, and is entangled in the darkness of doubt, and the bondage of emotional attachment.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹੋਤ ਦਇਆਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਕਾਢੈ ਬਾਹ ਫਰੇ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੯੬॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak prabh hot deaaraa gur bhettai kaadtai baah fare |2|10|96|
English: Says Nanak, when God becomes merciful, one meets with the Guru, who takes him by the arm, and lifts him out. ||2||10||96||

[Ang 823 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਚੀਨੑਾ ॥
Transliteration: man tan rasanaa har cheenaa |
English: With my mind, body and tongue, I remember the Lord.

Gurbani: ਭਏ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਮਿਟੇ ਅੰਦੇਸੇ ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੑਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhe anandaa mitte andese sarab sookh mo kau gur deenaa |1| rahaau |
English: I am in ecstasy, and my anxieties are dispelled; the Guru has blessed me with total peace. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਇਆਨਪ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਭਈ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਦਾਨਾ ਬੀਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: eaanap te sabh bhee siaanap prabh meraa daanaa beenaa |
English: My ignorance has been totally transformed into wisdom. My God is wise and all-knowing.

Gurbani: ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਰਾਖੈ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਉ ਕਾਹੂ ਨ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਛੁ ਖੀਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: haath dee raakhai apane kau kaahoo na karate kachh kheenaa |1|
English: Giving me His Hand, He saved me, and now no one can harm me at all. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਲਿ ਜਾਵਉ ਦਰਸਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੀਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: bal jaavau darasan saadhoo kai jih prasaad har naam leenaa |
English: I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of the Holy; by their Grace, I contemplate the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਾਰੋਸੈ ਕਹੂ ਨ ਮਾਨਿਓ ਮਨਿ ਛੀਨਾ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੯੭॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak tthaakur bhaarosai kahoo na maanio man chheenaa |2|11|97|
English: Says Nanak, I place my faith in my Lord and Master; within my mind, I do not believe in any other, even for an instant. ||2||11||97||

[Ang 823 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਰਾਖਿ ਲਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur poorai meree raakh lee |
English: The Perfect Guru has has saved me.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੇ ਮਹਿ ਦੀਨੋ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: amrit naam ride meh deeno janam janam kee mail gee |1| rahaau |
English: He has enshrined the Ambrosial Name of the Lord within my heart, and the filth of countless incarnations has been washed away. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਿਵਰੇ ਦੂਤ ਦੁਸਟ ਬੈਰਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕਾ ਜਪਿਆ ਜਾਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: nivare doot dusatt bairaaee gur poore kaa japiaa jaap |
English: The demons and wicked enemies are driven out, by meditating, and chanting the Chant of the Perfect Guru.

Gurbani: ਕਹਾ ਕਰੈ ਕੋਈ ਬੇਚਾਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਾ ਬਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kahaa karai koee bechaaraa prabh mere kaa badd parataap |1|
English: What can any wretched creature do to me? The radiance of my God is gloriously great. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਖੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: simar simar simar sukh paaeaa charan kamal rakh man maahee |
English: Meditating, meditating, meditating in remembrance, I have found peace; I have enshrined His Lotus Feet within my mind.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੯੮॥
Transliteration: taa kee saran pario naanak daas jaa te aoopar ko naahee |2|12|98|
English: Slave Nanak has entered His Sanctuary; there is none above Him. ||2||12||98||

[Ang 824 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਪੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa japeeai prabh naam |
English: Forever and ever, chant the Name of God.

Gurbani: ਜਰਾ ਮਰਾ ਕਛੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਆਗੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaraa maraa kachh dookh na biaapai aagai daragah pooran kaam |1| rahaau |
English: The pains of old age and death shall not afflict you, and in the Court of the Lord hereafter, your affairs shall be perfectly resolved. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਪਰੀਐ ਨਿਤ ਸਰਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਏਹੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: aap tiaag pareeai nit saranee gur te paaeeai ehu nidhaan |
English: So forsake your self-conceit, and ever seek Sanctuary. This treasure is obtained only from the Guru.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕੀ ਕਟੀਐ ਫਾਸੀ ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਕਾ ਨੀਸਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: janam maran kee katteeai faasee saachee daragah kaa neesaan |1|
English: The noose of birth and death is snapped; this is the insignia, the hallmark, of the Court of the True Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੁਮੑ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨਉ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੈ ਸਗਲ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: jo tuma karahu soee bhal maanau man te chhoottai sagal gumaan |
English: Whatever You do, I accept as good. I have eradicated all egotistical pride from my mind.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਗਲ ਜਹਾਨੁ ॥੨॥੧੩॥੯੯॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak taa kee saranaaee jaa kaa keea sagal jahaan |2|13|99|
English: Says Nanak, I am under His protection; He created the entire Universe. ||2||13||99||

[Ang 824 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: man tan antar prabh aahee |
English: Deep within the nucleus of his mind and body, is God.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਨਿਤ ਤਿਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਕਾ ਮੋਲੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har gun gaavat praupakaar nit tis rasanaa kaa mol kichh naahee |1| rahaau |
English: He continually sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and always does good for others; his tongue is priceless. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕੁਲ ਸਮੂਹ ਉਧਰੇ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: kul samooh udhare khin bheetar janam janam kee mal laahee |
English: All his generations are redeemed and saved in an instant, and the filth of countless incarnations is washed away.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਅਨਦ ਸੇਤੀ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਨੁ ਗਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: simar simar suaamee prabh apanaa anad setee bikhiaa ban gaahee |1|
English: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on God, his Lord and Master, he passes blissfully through the forest of poison. ||1||

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕੇ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਪਾਏ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: charan prabhoo ke bohith paae bhav saagar paar paraahee |
English: I have obtained the boat of God's Feet, to carry me across the terrifying world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਸੇਵਕ ਭਗਤ ਹਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਹੈ ਤਾਹੀ ॥੨॥੧੪॥੧੦੦॥
Transliteration: sant sevak bhagat har taa ke naanak man laagaa hai taahee |2|14|100|
English: The Saints, servants and devotees belong to the Lord; Nanak's mind is attached to Him. ||2||14||100||

[Ang 824 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਧੀਰਉ ਦੇਖਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ਰੰਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: dheerau dekh tumaare rangaa |
English: I am reassured, gazing upon Your wondrous play.

Gurbani: ਤੁਹੀ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਤੂਹੀ ਵਸਹਿ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tuhee suaamee antarajaamee toohee vaseh saadh kai sangaa |1| rahaau |
English: You are my Lord and Master, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts; You dwell with the Holy Saints. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਨਿਵਾਜੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਨੀਚ ਕੀਟ ਤੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਰਾਜੰਗਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: khin meh thaap nivaaje tthaakur neech keett te kareh raajangaa |1|
English: In an instant, our Lord and Master establishes and exalts. From a lowly worm, He creates a king. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਹੀਏ ਮੋਰੇ ਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਇਹੀ ਦਾਨੁ ਮੰਗਾ ॥੨॥੧੫॥੧੦੧॥
Transliteration: kabahoo na bisarai hee more te naanak daas ihee daan mangaa |2|15|101|
English: May I never forget You from my heart; slave Nanak prays for this blessing. ||2||15||101||

[Ang 824 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਚੁਤ ਪੂਜਾ ਜੋਗ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: achut poojaa jog gopaal |
English: The imperishable Lord God is worthy of worship and adoration.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਰਖਉ ਹਰਿ ਆਗੈ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: man tan arap rkhau har aagai sarab jeea kaa hai pratipaal |1| rahaau |
English: Dedicating my mind and body, I place them before the Lord, the Cherisher of all beings. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਰਨਿ ਸਮ੍ਰਥ ਅਕਥ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਬਡੋ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
Transliteration: saran samrath akath sukhadaataa kirapaa sindh baddo deaal |
English: His Sanctuary is All-powerful; He cannot be described; He is the Giver of peace, the ocean of mercy, supremely compassionate.

Gurbani: ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਰਾਖੈ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਉ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਤਾਤੀ ਬਾਲ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kantth laae raakhai apane kau tis no lagai na taatee baal |1|
English: Holding him close in His embrace, the Lord protects and saves him, and then even the hot wind cannot touch him. ||1||

Gurbani: ਦਾਮੋਦਰ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਧਨ ਮਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: daamodar deaal suaamee sarabas sant janaa dhan maal |
English: Our Merciful Lord and Master is wealth, property and everything to His humble Saints.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਦਰਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਗੈ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਰਵਾਲ ॥੨॥੧੬॥੧੦੨॥
Transliteration: naanak jaachik daras prabh maagai sant janaa kee milai ravaal |2|16|102|
English: Nanak, a beggar, asks for the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan; please, bless him with the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||2||16||102||

[Ang 824 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੋਟਿ ਜਤਨ ਭਏ ॥
Transliteration: simarat naam kott jatan bhe |
English: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is equal to millions of efforts.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ਜਮਦੂਤਨ ਕਉ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਅਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang mil har gun gaae jamadootan kau traas ahe |1| rahaau |
English: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and the Messenger of Death will be frightened away. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੇਤੇ ਪੁਨਹਚਰਨ ਸੇ ਕੀਨੑੇ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਗਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: jete punahacharan se keenae man tan prabh ke charan gahe |
English: To enshrine the Feet of God in one's mind and body, is to perform all sorts of acts of atonement.

Gurbani: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਨਾਠਾ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਦਹੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aavan jaan bharam bhau naatthaa janam janam ke kilavikh dahe |1|
English: Coming and going, doubt and fear have run away, and the sins of countless incarnations are burnt away. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹੋਇ ਭਜਹੁ ਜਗਦੀਸੈ ਏਹੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਲਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: nirbhau hoe bhajahu jagadeesai ehu padaarath vaddabhaag lahe |
English: So become fearless, and vibrate upon the Lord of the Universe. This is true wealth, obtained only by great good fortune.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਕਹੇ ॥੨॥੧੭॥੧੦੩॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa pooran prabh daate niramal jas naanak daas kahe |2|17|103|
English: Be merciful, O Perfect God, Great Giver, that slave Nanak may chant Your immaculate Praises. ||2||17||103||

[Ang 825 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੁਲਹੀ ਤੇ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: sulahee te naaraaein raakh |
English: The Lord saved me from Sulhi Khan.

Gurbani: ਸੁਲਹੀ ਕਾ ਹਾਥੁ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਸੁਲਹੀ ਹੋਇ ਮੂਆ ਨਾਪਾਕੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sulahee kaa haath kahee na pahuchai sulahee hoe mooaa naapaak |1| rahaau |
English: The emperor did not succeed in his plot, and he died in disgrace. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਾਢਿ ਕੁਠਾਰੁ ਖਸਮਿ ਸਿਰੁ ਕਾਟਿਆ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਗਇਆ ਹੈ ਖਾਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: kaadt kutthaar khasam sir kaattiaa khin meh hoe geaa hai khaak |
English: The Lord and Master raised His axe, and chopped off his head; in an instant, he was reduced to dust. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੰਦਾ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਪਚਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਦੀਨਾ ਧਾਕੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mandaa chitavat chitavat pachiaa jin rachiaa tin deenaa dhaak |1|
English: Plotting and planning evil, he was destroyed. The One who created him, gave him a push.

Gurbani: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਮੀਤ ਧਨੁ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਰਹਿਓ ਸੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਗਇਆ ਸਭ ਭਾਈ ਸਾਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: putr meet dhan kichhoo na rahio su chhodd geaa sabh bhaaee saak |
English: Of his sons, friends and wealth, nothing remains; he departed, leaving behind all his brothers and relatives.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਕੀਨੋ ਪੂਰਨ ਵਾਕੁ ॥੨॥੧੮॥੧੦੪॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak tis prabh balihaaree jin jan kaa keeno pooran vaak |2|18|104|
English: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to God, who fulfilled the word of His slave. ||2||18||104||

[Ang 825 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਸੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: poore gur kee pooree sev |
English: Perfect is service to the Perfect Guru.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਕੀਆ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aape aap varatai suaamee kaaraj raas keea guradev |1| rahaau |
English: Our Lord and Master Himself is Himself all-pervading. The Divine Guru has resolved all my affairs. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅੰਤਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਪਨਾ ਥਾਟੁ ਬਨਾਇਓ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: aad madh prabh ant suaamee apanaa thaatt banaaeo aap |
English: In the beginning, in the middle and in the end, God is our only Lord and Master. He Himself fashioned His Creation.

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਆਪੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਕੋ ਵਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: apane sevak kee aape raakhai prabh mere ko vadd parataap |1|
English: He Himself saves His servant. Great is the glorious grandeur of my God! ||1||

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਨੑੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਜੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham paramesur satigur vas keenae jin sagale jant |
English: The Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord is the True Guru; all beings are in His power.

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਜਪਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮੰਤ ॥੨॥੧੯॥੧੦੫॥
Transliteration: charan kamal naanak saranaaee raam naam jap niramal mant |2|19|105|
English: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of His Lotus Feet, chanting the Lord's Name, the immaculate Mantra. ||2||19||105||

[Ang 825 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤਾਪ ਪਾਪ ਤੇ ਰਾਖੇ ਆਪ ॥
Transliteration: taap paap te raakhe aap |
English: He Himself protects me from suffering and sin.

Gurbani: ਸੀਤਲ ਭਏ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ ਲਾਗੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਪ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: seetal bhe gur charanee laage raam naam hirade meh jaap |1| rahaau |
English: Falling at the Guru's Feet, I am cooled and soothed; I meditate on the Lord's Name within my heart. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਸਤ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦੀਨੇ ਜਗਤ ਉਧਾਰ ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa hasat prabh deene jagat udhaar nav khandd prataap |
English: Granting His Mercy, God has extended His Hands. He is the Emancipator of the World; His glorious radiance pervades the nine continents.

Gurbani: ਦੁਖ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸੁਖ ਅਨਦ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਬੁਝੀ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਸਚੁ ਧ੍ਰਾਪ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dukh binase sukh anad pravesaa trisan bujhee man tan sach dhraap |1|
English: My pain has been dispelled, and peace and pleasure have come; my desire is quenched, and my mind and body are truly satisfied. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਨਾਥ ਕੋ ਨਾਥੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਮਰਥਾ ਸਗਲ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕੋ ਮਾਈ ਬਾਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: anaath ko naath saran samarathaa sagal srisatt ko maaee baap |
English: He is the Master of the masterless, All-powerful to give Sanctuary. He is the Mother and Father of the whole Universe.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਲਾਪ ॥੨॥੨੦॥੧੦੬॥
Transliteration: bhagat vachhal bhai bhanjan suaamee gun gaavat naanak aalaap |2|20|106|
English: He is the Lover of His devotees, the Destroyer of fear; Nanak sings and chants the Glorious Praises of his Lord and Master. ||2||20||106||

[Ang 825 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਛਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: jis te upajiaa tiseh pachhaan |
English: Acknowledge the One, from whom You originated.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਕੁਸਲ ਖੇਮ ਹੋਏ ਕਲਿਆਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham paramesar dhiaaeaa kusal khem hoe kaliaan |1| rahaau |
English: Meditating on the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, I have found peace, pleasure and salvation. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਬਡ ਭਾਗੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur pooraa bhettio badd bhaagee antarajaamee sugharr sujaan |
English: I met the Perfect Guru, by great good fortune, and so found the wise and all-knowing Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

Gurbani: ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਰਾਖੇ ਕਰਿ ਅਪਨੇ ਬਡ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਨਿਮਾਣਿਆ ਕੋ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: haath dee raakhe kar apane badd samarath nimaaniaa ko maan |1|
English: He gave me His Hand, and making me His own, He saved me; He is absolutely all-powerful, the honor of the dishonored. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੈ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਗਏ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਚਾਨਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: bhram bhai binas ge khin bheetar andhakaar pragatte chaanaan |
English: Doubt and fear have been dispelled in an instant, and in the darkness, the Divine Light shines forth.

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਆਰਾਧੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਈਐ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥੨॥੨੧॥੧੦੭॥
Transliteration: saas saas aaraadhai naanak sadaa sadaa jaaeeai kurabaan |2|21|107|
English: With each and every breath, Nanak worships and adores the Lord; forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to Him. ||2||21||107||

[Ang 825 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦੋਵੈ ਥਾਵ ਰਖੇ ਗੁਰ ਸੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: dovai thaav rakhe gur soore |
English: Both here and hereafter, the Mighty Guru protects me.

Gurbani: ਹਲਤ ਪਲਤ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਹੋਏ ਸਗਲੇ ਪੂਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: halat palat paarabraham savaare kaaraj hoe sagale poore |1| rahaau |
English: God has embellished this world and the next for me, and all my affairs are perfectly resolved. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਜਨੁ ਹੋਵਤ ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam japat sukh sahaje majan hovat saadhoo dhoore |
English: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I have found peace and poise, bathing in the dust of the feet of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣ ਰਹੇ ਥਿਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕੇ ਮਿਟੇ ਬਿਸੂਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aavan jaan rahe thit paaee janam maran ke mitte bisoore |1|
English: Comings and goings have ceased, and I have found stability; the pains of birth and death are eradicated. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੈ ਤਰੇ ਛੁਟੇ ਭੈ ਜਮ ਕੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਏਕੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: bhram bhai tare chhutte bhai jam ke ghatt ghatt ek rahiaa bharapoore |
English: I cross over the ocean of doubt and fear, and the fear of death is gone; the One Lord is permeating and pervading in each and every heart.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਹਜੂਰੇ ॥੨॥੨੨॥੧੦੮॥
Transliteration: naanak saran pario dukh bhanjan antar baahar pekh hajoore |2|22|108|
English: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Destroyer of pain; I behold His Presence deep within, and all around as well. ||2||22||108||

[Ang 826 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਤ ਦੋਖ ਨਸੇ ॥
Transliteration: darasan dekhat dokh nase |
English: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, all pains run away.

Gurbani: ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਹੋਵਹੁ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kabahu na hovahu drisatt agochar jeea kai sang base |1| rahaau |
English: Please, never leave my vision, O Lord; please abide with my soul. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: preetam praan adhaar suaamee |
English: My Beloved Lord and Master is the Support of the breath of life.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: poor rahe prabh antarajaamee |1|
English: God, the Inner-knower, is all-pervading. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮੑਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa gun tere saar samaaree |
English: Which of Your Glorious Virtues should I contemplate and remember?

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਚਿਤਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saas saas prabh tujheh chitaaree |2|
English: With each and every breath, O God, I remember You. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: kirapaa nidh prabh deen deaalaa |
English: God is the ocean of mercy, merciful to the meek;

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਕੀ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jeea jant kee karahu pratipaalaa |3|
English: He cherishes all beings and creatures. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar teraa naam jan jaape |
English: Twenty-four hours a day, Your humble servant chants Your Name.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੧੦੯॥
Transliteration: naanak preet laaee prabh aape |4|23|109|
English: You Yourself, O God, have inspired Nanak to love You. ||4||23||109||

[Ang 826 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਚਲਤ ਗਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tan dhan joban chalat geaa |
English: Body, wealth and youth pass away.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਭਜਨੁ ਨ ਕੀਨੋ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਨਿਸਿ ਭੋਰੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam kaa bhajan na keeno karat bikaar nis bhor bheaa |1| rahaau |
English: You have not meditated and vibrated upon the Lord's Name; while you commit your sins of corruption in the night, the light of day dawns upon you. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਭੋਜਨ ਨਿਤ ਖਾਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਦੰਤਾ ਘਸਿ ਖੀਨ ਖਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: anik prakaar bhojan nit khaate mukh dantaa ghas kheen kheaa |
English: Continually eating all sorts of foods, the teeth in your mouth crumble, decay and fall out.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਮੂਠਉ ਪਾਪ ਕਰਤ ਨਹ ਪਰੀ ਦਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: meree meree kar kar mootthau paap karat neh paree deaa |1|
English: Living in egotism and possessiveness, you are deluded; committing sins, you have no kindness for others. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਘੋਰ ਦੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਗਲਤੁ ਪਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: mahaa bikaar ghor dukh saagar tis meh praanee galat peaa |
English: The great sins are the terrible ocean of pain; the mortal is engrossed in them.

Gurbani: ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੀ ਬਾਹ ਪਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਲਇਆ ॥੨॥੨੪॥੧੧੦॥
Transliteration: saran pare naanak suaamee kee baah pakar prabh kaadt leaa |2|24|110|
English: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of his Lord and Master; taking him by the arm, God has lifted him up and out. ||2||24||110||

[Ang 826 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਪਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਇਆ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: aapanaa prabh aaeaa cheet |
English: God Himself has come into my consciousness.

Gurbani: ਦੁਸਮਨ ਦੁਸਟ ਰਹੇ ਝਖ ਮਾਰਤ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਭਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dusaman dusatt rahe jhakh maarat kusal bheaa mere bhaaee meet |1| rahaau |
English: My enemies and opponents have grown weary of attacking me, and now, I have become happy, O my friends and Siblings of Destiny. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗਈ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਸਭ ਨਾਸੀ ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਓ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: gee biaadh upaadh sabh naasee angeekaar keeo karataar |
English: The disease is gone, and all misfortunes have been averted; the Creator Lord has made me His own.

Gurbani: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੂਖ ਅਰੁ ਅਨਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਉਰ ਹਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saant sookh ar anad ghanere preetam naam ridai ur haar |1|
English: I have found peace, tranquility and total bliss, enshrining the Name of my Beloved Lord within my heart. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂੰ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeeo pindd dhan raas prabh teree toon samarath suaamee meraa |
English: My soul, body and wealth are all Your capital; O God, You are my All-powerful Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਦਾਸ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਉ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਚੇਰਾ ॥੨॥੨੫॥੧੧੧॥
Transliteration: daas apune kau raakhanahaaraa naanak daas sadaa hai cheraa |2|25|111|
English: You are the Saving Grace of Your slaves; slave Nanak is forever Your slave. ||2||25||111||

[Ang 826 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਹੋਆ ਕਲਿਆਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: gobid simar hoaa kaliaan |
English: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord of the Universe, I am emancipated.

Gurbani: ਮਿਟੀ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਭਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਿਮਰਿਆ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mittee upaadh bheaa sukh saachaa antarajaamee simariaa jaan |1| rahaau |
English: Suffering is eradicated, and true peace has come, meditating on the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਤਿਨਿ ਕੀਏ ਸੁਖਾਲੇ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਸਾਚਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: jis ke jeea tin kee sukhaale bhagat janaa kau saachaa taan |
English: All beings belong to Him - He makes them happy. He is the true power of His humble devotees.

Gurbani: ਦਾਸ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਆਪੇ ਰਾਖੀ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਮਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: daas apune kee aape raakhee bhai bhanjan aoopar karate maan |1|
English: He Himself saves and protects His slaves, who believe in their Creator, the Destroyer of fear. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਈ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾਈ ਮਿਟੀ ਬੁਰਾਈ ਦ੍ਰੁਸਟ ਦੂਤ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਢੇ ਛਾਣਿ ॥
Transliteration: bhee mitraaee mittee buraaee drusatt doot har kaadte chhaan |
English: I have found friendship, and hatred has been eradicated; the Lord has rooted out the enemies and villains.

Gurbani: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣਹ ਵਖਾਣਿ ॥੨॥੨੬॥੧੧੨॥
Transliteration: sookh sehaj aanand ghanere naanak jeevai har gunah vakhaan |2|26|112|
English: Nanak has been blessed with celestial peace and poise and total bliss; chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord, he lives. ||2||26||112||

[Ang 826 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham prabh bhe kripaal |
English: The Supreme Lord God has become Merciful.

Gurbani: ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kaaraj sagal savaare satigur jap jap saadhoo bhe nihaal |1| rahaau |
English: The True Guru has arranged all my affairs; chanting and meditating with the Holy Saints, I have become happy. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨੈ ਦੋਖੀ ਸਗਲੇ ਭਏ ਰਵਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: angeekaar keea prabh apanai dokhee sagale bhe ravaal |
English: God has made me His own, and all my enemies have been reduced to dust.

Gurbani: ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਰਾਖੇ ਜਨ ਅਪਨੇ ਉਧਰਿ ਲੀਏ ਲਾਇ ਅਪਨੈ ਪਾਲ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kantth laae raakhe jan apane udhar lee laae apanai paal |1|
English: He hugs us close in His embrace, and protects His humble servants; attaching us to the hem of His robe, he saves us. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਹੀ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਹੋਏ ਕਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: sahee salaamat mil ghar aae nindak ke mukh hoe kaal |
English: Safe and sound, we have returned home, while the slanderer's face is blackened.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੨॥੨੭॥੧੧੩॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak meraa satigur pooraa gur prasaad prabh bhe nihaal |2|27|113|
English: Says Nanak, my True Guru is Perfect; by the Grace of God and Guru, I am so happy. ||2||27||113||

[Ang 827 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੂ ਲਾਲਨ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਨੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: moo laalan siau preet banee | rahaau |
English: I have fallen in love with my Beloved Lord. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੋਰੀ ਨ ਤੂਟੈ ਛੋਰੀ ਨ ਛੂਟੈ ਐਸੀ ਮਾਧੋ ਖਿੰਚ ਤਨੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: toree na toottai chhoree na chhoottai aisee maadho khinch tanee |1|
English: Cutting it, it does not break, and releasing it, it does not let go. Such is the string the Lord has tied me with. ||1||

Gurbani: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਬਸਤੁ ਹੈ ਤੂ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: dinas rain man maeh basat hai too kar kirapaa prabh apanee |2|
English: Day and night, He dwells within my mind; please bless me with Your Mercy, O my God. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ਸਿਆਮ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਕਉ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ਸੁਨੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bal bal jaau siaam sundar kau akath kathaa jaa kee baat sunee |3|
English: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to my beauteous Lord; I have heard his Unspoken Speech and Story. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹੀਅਤ ਹੈ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੀ ॥੪॥੨੮॥੧੧੪॥
Transliteration: jan naanak daasan daas kaheeat hai mohi karahu kripaa tthaakur apunee |4|28|114|
English: Servant Nanak is said to be the slave of His slaves; O my Lord and Master, please bless me with Your Mercy. ||4||28||114||

[Ang 827 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਜਪਿ ਜਾਂਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: har ke charan jap jaanau kurabaan |
English: I meditate on the Lord's Feet; I am a sacrifice to Them.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਧਰਿ ਮਨ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur meraa paarabraham paramesur taa kaa hiradai dhar man dhiaan |1| rahaau |
English: My Guru is the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord; I enshrine Him within my heart, and meditate on Him within my mind. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਗਲ ਜਹਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: simar simar simar sukhadaataa jaa kaa keea sagal jahaan |
English: Meditate, meditate, meditate in remembrance on the Giver of peace, who created the whole Universe.

Gurbani: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਵਹੁ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: rasanaa ravahu ek naaraaein saachee daragah paavahu maan |1|
English: With your tongue, savor the One Lord, and you shall be honored in the Court of the True Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਏਹੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: saadhoo sang paraapat jaa kau tin hee paaeaa ehu nidhaan |
English: He alone obtains this treasure, who joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਉ ਗੁਣ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਜੈ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੨॥੨੯॥੧੧੫॥
Transliteration: gaavau gun keeratan nit suaamee kar kirapaa naanak deejai daan |2|29|115|
English: O Lord and Master, mercifully bless Nanak with this gift, that he may ever sing the Glorious Praises of Your Kirtan. ||2||29||115||

[Ang 827 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣ ॥
Transliteration: raakh lee satigur kee saran |
English: I have been saved, in the Sanctuary of the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਹੋਆ ਜਗ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਮੇਰੋ ਤਾਰਣ ਤਰਣ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jai jai kaar hoaa jag antar paarabraham mero taaran taran |1| rahaau |
English: I am cheered and applauded throughout the world; my Supreme Lord God carries me across. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਿਸ੍ਵੰਭਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਪੋਖਣ ਭਰਣ ॥
Transliteration: bisvanbhar pooran sukhadaataa sagal samagree pokhan bharan |
English: The Perfect Lord fills the Universe; He is the Giver of peace; He cherishes and fulfills the whole Universe.

Gurbani: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਂਈ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: thaan thanantar sarab nirantar bal bal jaanee har ke charan |1|
English: He is completely filling all places and interspaces; I am a devoted sacrifice to the Lord's Feet. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਵਸਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਰਬ ਸਿਧਿ ਤੁਮ ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਣ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jugat vas mere suaamee sarab sidh tum kaaran karan |
English: The ways of all beings are in Your Power, O my Lord and Master. All supernatural spiritual powers are Yours; You are the Creator, the Cause of causes.

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਖਦਾ ਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਹੀ ਡਰਣ ॥੨॥੩੦॥੧੧੬॥
Transliteration: aad jugaad prabh rakhadaa aaeaa har simarat naanak nahee ddaran |2|30|116|
English: In the beginning, and throughout the ages, God is our Savior and Protector; remembering the Lord in meditation, O Nanak, fear is eliminated. ||2||30||116||

[Ang 827 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੮ ॥
Transliteration: raag bilaaval mahalaa 5 dupade ghar 8 |
English: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Dho-Padhay, Eighth House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: mai naahee prabh sabh kichh teraa |
English: I am nothing, God; everything is Yours.

Gurbani: ਈਘੈ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਊਘੈ ਸਰਗੁਨ ਕੇਲ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਚਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: eeghai niragun aooghai saragun kel karat bich suaamee meraa |1| rahaau |
English: In this world, You are the absolute, formless Lord; in the world hereafter, You are the related Lord of form. You play it both ways, O my Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਆਪਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਕੋ ਸਗਲ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: nagar meh aap baahar fun aapan prabh mere ko sagal baseraa |
English: You exist within the city, and beyond it as well; O my God, You are everywhere.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਰਾਜਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਰਾਇਆ ਕਹ ਕਹ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕਹ ਕਹ ਚੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aape hee raajan aape hee raaeaa keh keh tthaakur keh keh cheraa |1|
English: You Yourself are the King, and You Yourself are the subject. In one place, You are the Lord and Master, and in another place, You are the slave. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਾ ਕਉ ਦੁਰਾਉ ਕਾ ਸਿਉ ਬਲਬੰਚਾ ਜਹ ਜਹ ਪੇਖਉ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਨੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaa kau duraau kaa siau balabanchaa jeh jeh pekhau teh teh neraa |
English: From whom should I hide? Whom should I try to deceive? Wherever I look, I see Him near at hand.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਬੂੰਦ ਨਹੀ ਅਨ ਹੇਰਾ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੧੭॥
Transliteration: saadh moorat gur bhettio naanak mil saagar boond nahee an heraa |2|1|117|
English: I have met with Guru Nanak, the Embodiment of the Holy Saints. When the drop of water merges into the ocean, it cannot be distinguished as separate again. ||2||1||117||

[Ang 827 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤੁਮੑ ਸਮਰਥਾ ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨ ॥
Transliteration: tuma samarathaa kaaran karan |
English: You are the all-powerful Cause of causes.

Gurbani: ਢਾਕਨ ਢਾਕਿ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਸਰਨ ਚਰਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dtaakan dtaak gobid gur mere mohi aparaadhee saran charan |1| rahaau |
English: Please cover my faults, Lord of the Universe, O my Guru; I am a sinner - I seek the Sanctuary of Your Feet. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕੀਨੋ ਸੋ ਤੁਮੑ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਠਉਰ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਢੀਠ ਮੁਕਰਨ ॥
Transliteration: jo jo keeno so tuma jaanio pekhio tthaur naahee kachh dteetth mukaran |
English: Whatever we do, You see and know; there is no way anyone can stubbornly deny this.

Gurbani: ਬਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਸੁਨਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮੑਰੋ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਘਾ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਨ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: badd parataap sunio prabh tumaro kott aghaa tero naam haran |1|
English: Your glorious radiance is great! So I have heard, O God. Millions of sins are destroyed by Your Name. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਮਰੋ ਸਹਾਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਦ ਭੂਲਨ ਤੁਮੑਰੋ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਰਨ ॥
Transliteration: hamaro sahaau sadaa sad bhoolan tumaro birad patit udharan |
English: It is my nature to make mistakes, forever and ever; it is Your Natural Way to save sinners.

Gurbani: ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੧੮॥
Transliteration: karunaa mai kirapaal kripaa nidh jeevan pad naanak har darasan |2|2|118|
English: You are the embodiment of kindness, and the treasure of compassion, O Merciful Lord; through the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, Nanak has found the state of redemption in life. ||2||2||118||

[Ang 828 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਐਸੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਰਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: aisee kirapaa mohi karahu |
English: Bless me with such mercy, Lord,

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਹ ਚਰਣ ਹਮਾਰੋ ਮਾਥਾ ਨੈਨ ਦਰਸੁ ਤਨਿ ਧੂਰਿ ਪਰਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: santah charan hamaaro maathaa nain daras tan dhoor parahu |1| rahaau |
English: that my forehead may touch the feet of the Saints, and my eyes may behold the Blessed Vision of their Darshan, and my body may fall at the dust of their feet. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਬਾਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਮਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਧਰਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur ko sabad merai heearai baasai har naamaa man sang dharahu |
English: May the Word of the Guru's Shabad abide within my heart, and the Lord's Name be enshrined within my mind.

Gurbani: ਤਸਕਰ ਪੰਚ ਨਿਵਾਰਹੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਗਲੋ ਭਰਮਾ ਹੋਮਿ ਜਰਹੁ ॥੧॥
