Transliteration: tasakar panch nivaarahu tthaakur sagalo bharamaa hom jarahu |1|
English: Drive out the five thieves, O my Lord and Master, and let my doubts all burn like incense. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੁਮੑ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨੈ ਭਾਵਨੁ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਟਰਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: jo tuma karahu soee bhal maanai bhaavan dubidhaa door ttarahu |
English: Whatever You do, I accept as good; I have driven out the sense of duality.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਦਾਤੇ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਲੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਉਧਰਹੁ ॥੨॥੩॥੧੧੯॥
Transliteration: naanak ke prabh tum hee daate santasang le mohi udharahu |2|3|119|
English: You are Nanak's God, the Great Giver; in the Congregation of the Saints, emancipate me. ||2||3||119||

[Ang 828 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਐਸੀ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਜਨ ਸਿਉ ਮੰਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: aisee deekhiaa jan siau mangaa |
English: I ask for such advice from Your humble servants,

Gurbani: ਤੁਮੑਰੋ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੋ ਰੰਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: tumaro dhiaan tumaaro rangaa |
English: that I may meditate on You, and love You,

Gurbani: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ਅੰਗਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tumaree sevaa tumaare angaa |1| rahaau |
English: and serve You, and become part and parcel of Your Being. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਸੰਭਾਖਨੁ ਜਨ ਸਿਉ ਊਠਨੁ ਬੈਠਨੁ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: jan kee ttehal sanbhaakhan jan siau aootthan baitthan jan kai sangaa |
English: I serve His humble servants, and speak with them, and abide with them.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਚਰ ਰਜ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਥੈ ਲਾਗੀ ਆਸਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਨੰਤ ਤਰੰਗਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jan char raj mukh maathai laagee aasaa pooran anant tarangaa |1|
English: I apply the dust of the feet of His humble servants to my face and forehead; my hopes, and the many waves of desire, are fulfilled. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਤੀਰਥ ਕੋਟਿ ਗੰਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: jan paarabraham jaa kee niramal mahimaa jan ke charan teerath kott gangaa |
English: Immaculate and pure are the praises of the humble servants of the Supreme Lord God; the feet of His humble servants are equal to millions of sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਕੀਓ ਮਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਹਰੇ ਕਲੰਗਾ ॥੨॥੪॥੧੨੦॥
Transliteration: jan kee dhoor keeo majan naanak janam janam ke hare kalangaa |2|4|120|
English: Nanak bathes in the dust of the feet of His humble servants; the sinful resides of countless incarnations have been washed away. ||2||4||120||

[Ang 828 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਮੋਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: jiau bhaavai tiau mohi pratipaal |
English: If it pleases You, then cherish me.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤੁਮੑ ਪਿਤਾ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham paramesar satigur ham baarik tuma pitaa kirapaal |1| rahaau |
English: O Supreme Lord God, Transcendent Lord, O True Guru, I am Your child, and You are my Merciful Father. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਪਹੁਚਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਘਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: mohi niragun gun naahee koee pahuch na saakau tumaree ghaal |
English: I am worthless; I have no virtues at all. I cannot understand Your actions.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੁਮਰੋ ਮਾਲ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tumaree gat mit tum hee jaanahu jeeo pindd sabh tumaro maal |1|
English: You alone know Your state and extent. My soul, body and property are all Yours. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਨਬੋਲਤ ਹੀ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਹਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: antarajaamee purakh suaamee anabolat hee jaanahu haal |
English: You are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, the Primal Lord and Master; You know even what is unspoken.

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਹਮਾਰੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੨॥੫॥੧੨੧॥
Transliteration: tan man seetal hoe hamaaro naanak prabh jeeo nadar nihaal |2|5|121|
English: My body and mind are cooled and soothed, O Nanak, by God's Glance of Grace. ||2||5||121||

[Ang 828 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਾਖੁ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੈ ਸਾਥ ॥
Transliteration: raakh sadaa prabh apanai saath |
English: Keep me with You forever, O God.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਹਮਰੋ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮਨਮੋਹਨੁ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਸਗਲ ਅਕਾਥ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: too hamaro preetam manamohan tujh bin jeevan sagal akaath |1| rahaau |
English: You are my Beloved, the Enticer of my mind; without You, my life is totally useless. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਰੰਕ ਤੇ ਰਾਉ ਕਰਤ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰੋ ਅਨਾਥ ਕੋ ਨਾਥ ॥
Transliteration: rank te raau karat khin bheetar prabh mero anaath ko naath |
English: In an instant, You transform the beggar into a king; O my God, You are the Master of the masterless.

Gurbani: ਜਲਤ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਜਨ ਆਪਿ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਦੇ ਰਾਖੇ ਹਾਥ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jalat agan meh jan aap udhaare kar apune de raakhe haath |1|
English: You save Your humble servants from the burning fire; You make them Your own, and with Your Hand, You protect them. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੀਤਲ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਮਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸ੍ਰਮ ਸਗਲੇ ਲਾਥ ॥
Transliteration: seetal sukh paaeo man tripate har simarat sram sagale laath |
English: I have found peace and cool tranquility, and my mind is satisfied; meditating in remembrance on the Lord, all struggles are ended.

Gurbani: ਨਿਧਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਅਵਰ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਸਗਲ ਅਕਾਥ ॥੨॥੬॥੧੨੨॥
Transliteration: nidh nidhaan naanak har sevaa avar siaanap sagal akaath |2|6|122|
English: Service to the Lord, O Nanak, is the treasure of treasures; all other clever tricks are useless. ||2||6||122||

[Ang 829 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਬਿਸਾਰਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: apane sevak kau kabahu na bisaarahu |
English: Never forget Your servant, O Lord.

Gurbani: ਉਰਿ ਲਾਗਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਪੂਰਬ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਬੀਚਾਰਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aur laagahu suaamee prabh mere poorab preet gobind beechaarahu |1| rahaau |
English: Hug me close in Your embrace, O God, my Lord and Master; consider my primal love for You, O Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੋ ਹਮਰੇ ਦੋਖ ਰਿਦੈ ਮਤ ਧਾਰਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: patit paavan prabh birad tumaaro hamare dokh ridai mat dhaarahu |
English: It is Your Natural Way, God, to purify sinners; please do not keep my errors in Your Heart.

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਪਟਲੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਰਹੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jeevan praan har dhan sukh tum hee haumai pattal kripaa kar jaarahu |1|
English: You are my life, my breath of life, O Lord, my wealth and peace; be merciful to me, and burn away the curtain of egotism. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਲ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਮੀਨ ਕਤ ਜੀਵਨ ਦੂਧ ਬਿਨਾ ਰਹਨੁ ਕਤ ਬਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: jal bihoon meen kat jeevan doodh binaa rehan kat baaro |
English: Without water, how can the fish survive? Without milk, how can the baby survive?

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਆਸ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲਨੑ ਕੀ ਪੇਖਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੋ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੨੩॥
Transliteration: jan naanak piaas charan kamalana kee pekh daras suaamee sukh saaro |2|7|123|
English: Servant Nanak thirsts for the Lord's Lotus Feet; gazing upon the Blessed Vision of his Lord and Master's Darshan, he finds the essence of peace. ||2||7||123||

Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

[Ang 829 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਗੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aagai paachhai kusal bheaa |
English: Here, and hereafter, there is happiness.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪੂਰੀ ਸਭ ਰਾਖੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਮਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur poorai pooree sabh raakhee paarabraham prabh keenee meaa |1| rahaau |
English: The Perfect Guru has perfectly, totally saved me; the Supreme Lord God has been kind to me. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਸਗਲਾ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: man tan rav rahiaa har preetam dookh darad sagalaa mitt geaa |
English: The Lord, my Beloved, is pervading and permeating my mind and body; all my pains and sufferings are dispelled.

Gurbani: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਆਨਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਦੂਤ ਦੁਸਟ ਸਭਿ ਹੋਏ ਖਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saant sehaj aanad gun gaae doot dusatt sabh hoe kheaa |1|
English: In celestial peace, tranquility and bliss, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; my enemies and adversaries have been totally destroyed. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਨੁ ਅਵਗੁਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gun avagun prabh kachh na beechaario kar kirapaa apunaa kar leaa |
English: God has not considered my merits and demerits; in His Mercy, He has made me His own.

Gurbani: ਅਤੁਲ ਬਡਾਈ ਅਚੁਤ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਉਚਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਜਇਆ ॥੨॥੮॥੧੨੪॥
Transliteration: atul baddaaee achut abinaasee naanak ucharai har kee jeaa |2|8|124|
English: Unweighable is the greatness of the immovable and imperishable Lord; Nanak proclaims the victory of the Lord. ||2||8||124||

[Ang 829 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਭੈ ਭਗਤੀ ਤਰਨੁ ਕੈਸੇ ॥
Transliteration: bin bhai bhagatee taran kaise |
English: Without the Fear of God, and devotional worship, how can anyone cross over the world-ocean?

Gurbani: ਕਰਹੁ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਰਾਖੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਪ ਭਰੋਸੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: karahu anugrahu patit udhaaran raakh suaamee aap bharose |1| rahaau |
English: Be kind to me, O Saving Grace of sinners; preserve my faith in You, O my Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਆਵਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਮਦ ਮਾਵਤ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਾਤਾ ਸੁਆਨ ਜੈਸੇ ॥
Transliteration: simaran nahee aavat firat mad maavat bikhiaa raataa suaan jaise |
English: The mortal does not remember the Lord in meditation; he wanders around intoxicated by egotism; he is engrossed in corruption like a dog.

Gurbani: ਅਉਧ ਬਿਹਾਵਤ ਅਧਿਕ ਮੋਹਾਵਤ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਵਤ ਬੁਡੇ ਐਸੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aaudh bihaavat adhik mohaavat paap kamaavat budde aise |1|
English: Utterly cheated, his life is slipping away; committing sins, he is sinking away. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਰਨਿ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਰਵਣੁ ਜੈਸੇ ॥
Transliteration: saran dukh bhanjan purakh niranjan saadhoo sangat ravan jaise |
English: I have come to Your Sanctuary, Destroyer of pain; O Primal Immaculate Lord, may I dwell upon You in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਕੇਸਵ ਕਲੇਸ ਨਾਸ ਅਘ ਖੰਡਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵਤ ਦਰਸ ਦਿਸੇ ॥੨॥੯॥੧੨੫॥
Transliteration: kesav kales naas agh khanddan naanak jeevat daras dise |2|9|125|
English: O Lord of beautiful hair, Destroyer of pain, Eradicator of sins, Nanak lives, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||2||9||125||

[Ang 829 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: raag bilaaval mahalaa 5 dupade ghar 9 |
English: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Dho-Padhay, Ninth House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਆਪਹਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ॥
Transliteration: aapeh mel le |
English: He Himself merges us with Himself.

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਸਰਨਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਆਏ ਤਬ ਤੇ ਦੋਖ ਗਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jab te saran tumaaree aae tab te dokh ge |1| rahaau |
English: When I came to Your Sanctuary, my sins vanished. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਅਰੁ ਚਿੰਤ ਬਿਰਾਨੀ ਸਾਧਹ ਸਰਨ ਪਏ ॥
Transliteration: taj abhimaan ar chint biraanee saadhah saran pe |
English: Renouncing egotistical pride and other anxieties, I have sought the Sanctuary of the Holy Saints.

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੋ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਰੋਗ ਖਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jap jap naam tumaaro preetam tan te rog khe |1|
English: Chanting, meditating on Your Name, O my Beloved, disease is eradicated from my body. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਮੁਗਧ ਅਜਾਨ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਰਾਖੇ ਧਾਰਿ ਦਏ ॥
Transliteration: mahaa mugadh ajaan agiaanee raakhe dhaar de |
English: Even utterly foolish, ignorant and thoughtless persons have been saved by the Kind Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਆਵਨ ਜਾਨ ਰਹੇ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੨੬॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak gur pooraa bhettio aavan jaan rahe |2|1|126|
English: Says Nanak, I have met the Perfect Guru; my comings and goings have ended. ||2||1||126||

[Ang 829 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: jeevau naam sunee |
English: Hearing Your Name, I live.

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤਬ ਮੇਰੀ ਆਸ ਪੁਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jau suprasan bhe gur poore tab meree aas punee |1| rahaau |
English: When the Perfect Guru became pleased with me, then my hopes were fulfilled. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪੀਰ ਗਈ ਬਾਧੀ ਮਨਿ ਧੀਰਾ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਅਨਦ ਧੁਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: peer gee baadhee man dheeraa mohio anad dhunee |
English: Pain is gone, and my mind is comforted; the music of bliss fascinates me.

Gurbani: ਉਪਜਿਓ ਚਾਉ ਮਿਲਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਖਿਨੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aupajio chaau milan prabh preetam rehan na jaae khinee |1|
English: The yearning to meet my Beloved God has welled up within me. I cannot live without Him, even for an instant. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਭਗਤ ਅਨਿਕ ਜਨ ਤਾਰੇ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਮੁਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: anik bhagat anik jan taare simareh anik munee |
English: You have saved so many devotees, so many humble servants; so many silent sages contemplate You.

Gurbani: ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਟਿਕ ਨਿਰਧਨ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਗੁਨੀ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੨੭॥
Transliteration: andhule ttik niradhan dhan paaeo prabh naanak anik gunee |2|2|127|
English: The support of the blind, the wealth of the poor; Nanak has found God, of endless virtues. ||2||2||127||

[Ang 830 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧੩ ਪੜਤਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: raag bilaaval mahalaa 5 ghar 13 parrataal |
English: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Thirteenth House, Partaal:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਨ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਾਵੈ ਹਾਰ ਕਜਰ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਭਰਨ ਕੀਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: mohan need na aavai haavai haar kajar basatr abharan keene |
English: O Enticing Lord, I cannot sleep; I sigh. I am adorned with necklaces, gowns, ornaments and make-up.

Gurbani: ਉਡੀਨੀ ਉਡੀਨੀ ਉਡੀਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: auddeenee uddeenee uddeenee |
English: I am sad, sad and depressed.

Gurbani: ਕਬ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kab ghar aavai ree |1| rahaau |
English: When will You come home? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਰਨਿ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਚਰਨ ਸੀਸੁ ਧਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: saran suhaagan charan sees dhar |
English: I seek the Sanctuary of the happy soul-brides; I place my head upon their feet.

Gurbani: ਲਾਲਨੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: laalan mohi milaavahu |
English: Unite me with my Beloved.

Gurbani: ਕਬ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kab ghar aavai ree |1|
English: When will He come to my home? ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਸਹੇਰੀ ਮਿਲਨ ਬਾਤ ਕਹਉ ਸਗਰੋ ਅਹੰ ਮਿਟਾਵਹੁ ਤਉ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਲਾਲਨੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: sunahu saheree milan baat khau sagaro ahan mittaavahu tau ghar hee laalan paavahu |
English: Listen, my companions: tell me how to meet Him. Eradicate all egotism, and then you shall find your Beloved Lord within the home of your heart.

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਰਸ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: tab ras mangal gun gaavahu |
English: Then, in delight, you shall sing the songs of joy and praise.

Gurbani: ਆਨਦ ਰੂਪ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: aanad roop dhiaavahu |
English: Meditate on the Lord, the embodiment of bliss.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਆਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: naanak duaarai aaeo |
English: O Nanak, I came to the Lord's Door,

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਮੈ ਲਾਲਨੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tau mai laalan paaeo ree |2|
English: and then, I found my Beloved. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਨ ਰੂਪੁ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: mohan roop dikhaavai |
English: The Enticing Lord has revealed His form to me,

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਨੀਦ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: ab mohi need suhaavai |
English: and now, sleep seems sweet to me.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਮੇਰੀ ਤਿਖਾ ਬੁਝਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: sabh meree tikhaa bujhaanee |
English: My thirst is totally quenched,

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਮੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: ab mai sehaj samaanee |
English: and now, I am absorbed in celestial bliss.

Gurbani: ਮੀਠੀ ਪਿਰਹਿ ਕਹਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: meetthee pireh kahaanee |
English: How sweet is the story of my Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਨੁ ਲਾਲਨੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥੧੨੮॥
Transliteration: mohan laalan paaeo ree | rahaau doojaa |1|128|
English: I have found my Beloved, Enticing Lord. ||Second Pause||1||128||

[Ang 830 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੋਰੀ ਅਹੰ ਜਾਇ ਦਰਸਨ ਪਾਵਤ ਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: moree ahan jaae darasan paavat he |
English: My ego is gone; I have obtained the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

Gurbani: ਰਾਚਹੁ ਨਾਥ ਹੀ ਸਹਾਈ ਸੰਤਨਾ ॥ ਅਬ ਚਰਨ ਗਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raachahu naath hee sahaaee santanaa | ab charan gahe |1| rahaau |
English: I am absorbed in my Lord and Master, the help and support of the Saints. Now, I hold tight to His Feet. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਹੇ ਮਨ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਚਰਨਾਵੈ ਚਰਨਾਵੈ ਉਲਝਿਓ ਅਲਿ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਕਮਲ ਜਿਉ ॥
Transliteration: aahe man avar na bhaavai charanaavai charanaavai ulajhio al makarand kamal jiau |
English: My mind longs for Him, and does not love any other. I am totally absorbed, in love with His Lotus Feet, like the bumble bee attached to the honey of the lotus flower.

Gurbani: ਅਨ ਰਸ ਨਹੀ ਚਾਹੈ ਏਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਹੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: an ras nahee chaahai ekai har laahai |1|
English: I do not desire any other taste; I seek only the One Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਨ ਤੇ ਟੂਟੀਐ ਰਿਖ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: an te ttootteeai rikh te chhootteeai |
English: I have broken away from the others, and I have been released from the Messenger of Death.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਘੂਟੀਐ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਉਲਟੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: man har ras ghootteeai sang saadhoo ulatteeai |
English: O mind, drink in the subtle essence of the Lord; join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and turn away from the world.

Gurbani: ਅਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: an naahee naahee re |
English: There is no other, none other than the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਚਰਨ ਚਰਨ ਹੇ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੨੯॥
Transliteration: naanak preet charan charan he |2|2|129|
English: O Nanak, love the Feet, the Feet of the Lord. ||2||2||129||

[Ang 830 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: raag bilaaval mahalaa 9 dupade |
English: Raag Bilaaval, Ninth Mehl, Dho-Padhay:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਦੁਖ ਹਰਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਨੋ ॥
Transliteration: dukh harataa har naam pachhaano |
English: The Name of the Lord is the Dispeller of sorrow - realize this.

Gurbani: ਅਜਾਮਲੁ ਗਨਿਕਾ ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮੁਕਤ ਭਏ ਜੀਅ ਜਾਨੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ajaamal ganikaa jih simarat mukat bhe jeea jaano |1| rahaau |
English: Remembering Him in meditation, even Ajaamal the robber and Ganikaa the prostitute were liberated; let your soul know this. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗਜ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਮਿਟੀ ਛਿਨਹੂ ਮਹਿ ਜਬ ਹੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਬਖਾਨੋ ॥
Transliteration: gaj kee traas mittee chhinahoo meh jab hee raam bakhaano |
English: The elephant's fear was taken away in an instant, as soon as he chanted the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਨਾਰਦ ਕਹਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਧ੍ਰੂਅ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਭਜਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਲਪਟਾਨੋ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naarad kehat sunat dhraooa baarik bhajan maeh lapattaano |1|
English: Listening to Naarad's teachings, the child Dhroo was absorbed in deep meditation. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਚਲ ਅਮਰ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਜਗਤ ਜਾਹਿ ਹੈਰਾਨੋ ॥
Transliteration: achal amar nirabhai pad paaeo jagat jaeh hairaano |
English: He obtained the immovable, eternal state of fearlessness, and all the world was amazed.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਤ ਭਗਤ ਰਛਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਮਾਨੋ ॥੨॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak kehat bhagat rachhak har nikatt taeh tum maano |2|1|
English: Says Nanak, the Lord is the Saving Grace and the Protector of His devotees; believe it - He is close to you. ||2||1||

[Ang 830 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 9 |
English: Bilaaval, Ninth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: har ke naam binaa dukh paavai |
English: Without the Name of the Lord, you shall only find pain.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਬਿਨਾ ਸਹਸਾ ਨਹ ਚੂਕੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਇਹੁ ਭੇਦੁ ਬਤਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat binaa sahasaa neh chookai gur ihu bhed bataavai |1| rahaau |
English: Without devotional worship, doubt is not dispelled; the Guru has revealed this secret. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਹਾ ਭਇਓ ਤੀਰਥ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਕੀਏ ਰਾਮ ਸਰਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: kahaa bheo teerath brat kee raam saran nahee aavai |
English: Of what use are sacred shrines of pilgrimage, if one does not enter the Sanctuary of the Lord?

Gurbani: ਜੋਗ ਜਗ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਤਿਹ ਮਾਨਉ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਸੁ ਬਿਸਰਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jog jag nihafal tih maanau jo prabh jas bisaraavai |1|
English: Know that Yoga and sacrificial feasts are fruitless, if one forgets the Praises of God. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹ ਦੋਨੋ ਕਉ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: maan moh dono kau parahar gobind ke gun gaavai |
English: One who lays aside both pride and attachment, sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੨॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak ih bidh ko praanee jeevan mukat kahaavai |2|2|
English: Says Nanak, the mortal who does this is said to be 'jivan mukta' - liberated while yet alive. ||2||2||

[Ang 831 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 9 |
English: Bilaaval, Ninth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਮੈ ਭਜਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jaa mai bhajan raam ko naahee |
English: There is no meditation on the Lord within him.

Gurbani: ਤਿਹ ਨਰ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਕਾਰਥੁ ਖੋਇਆ ਯਹ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tih nar janam akaarath khoeaa yeh raakhahu man maahee |1| rahaau |
English: That man wastes his life uselessly - keep this in mind. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੀਰਥ ਕਰੈ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਫੁਨਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਨਹ ਮਨੂਆ ਬਸਿ ਜਾ ਕੋ ॥
Transliteration: teerath karai brat fun raakhai neh manooaa bas jaa ko |
English: He bathes at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, and adheres to fasts, but he has no control over his mind.

Gurbani: ਨਿਹਫਲ ਧਰਮੁ ਤਾਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਮਾਨਹੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹਤ ਮੈ ਯਾ ਕਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: nihafal dharam taeh tum maanahu saach kehat mai yaa kau |1|
English: Know that such religion is useless to him. I speak the Truth for his sake. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੇ ਪਾਹਨੁ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਭੇਦੈ ਨਾਹਿ ਤਿਹ ਪਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: jaise paahan jal meh raakhio bhedai naeh tih paanee |
English: It's like a stone, kept immersed in water; still, the water does not penetrate it.

Gurbani: ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਤੁਮ ਤਾਹਿ ਪਛਾਨਹੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੀਨ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: taise hee tum taeh pachhaanahu bhagat heen jo praanee |2|
English: So, understand it: that mortal being who lacks devotional worship is just like that. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਲ ਮੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਾਮ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਤ ਗੁਰੁ ਯਹ ਭੇਦੁ ਬਤਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: kal mai mukat naam te paavat gur yeh bhed bataavai |
English: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, liberation comes from the Naam. The Guru has revealed this secret.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਈ ਨਰੁ ਗਰੂਆ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੩॥੩॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak soee nar garooaa jo prabh ke gun gaavai |3|3|
English: Says Nanak, he alone is a great man, who sings the Praises of God. ||3||3||

[Ang 831 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧੦ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval asattapadeea mahalaa 1 ghar 10 |
English: Bilaaval, Ashtpadheeyaa, First Mehl, Tenth House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਦੇਖੈ ਸਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: nikatt vasai dekhai sabh soee |
English: He dwells close at hand, and sees all,

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh viralaa boojhai koee |
English: but how rare is the Gurmukh who understands this.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਭੈ ਪਇਐ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: vin bhai peiai bhagat na hoee |
English: Without the Fear of God, there is no devotional worship.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sabad rate sadaa sukh hoee |1|
English: Imbued with the Word of the Shabad, eternal peace is attained. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa giaan padaarath naam |
English: Such is the spiritual wisdom, the treasure of the Naam;

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh paavas ras ras maan |1| rahaau |
English: obtaining it, the Gurmukhs enjoy the subtle essence of this nectar. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਕਥੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: giaan giaan kathai sabh koee |
English: Everyone talks about spiritual wisdom and spiritual knowledge.

Gurbani: ਕਥਿ ਕਥਿ ਬਾਦੁ ਕਰੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: kath kath baad kare dukh hoee |
English: Talking, talking, they argue, and suffer.

Gurbani: ਕਥਿ ਕਹਣੈ ਤੇ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: kath kahanai te rahai na koee |
English: No one can stop talking and discussing it.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਰਸ ਰਾਤੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bin ras raate mukat na hoee |2|
English: Without being imbued with the subtle essence, there is no liberation. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: giaan dhiaan sabh gur te hoee |
English: Spiritual wisdom and meditation all come from the Guru.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੀ ਰਹਤ ਸਾਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: saachee rehat saachaa man soee |
English: Through the lifestyle of Truth, the True Lord comes to dwell in the mind.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਥਨੀ ਹੈ ਪਰੁ ਰਹਤ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh kathanee hai par rehat na hoee |
English: The self-willed manmukh talks about it, but does not practice it.

Gurbani: ਨਾਵਹੁ ਭੂਲੇ ਥਾਉ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naavahu bhoole thaau na koee |3|
English: Forgetting the Name, he finds no place of rest. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਬੰਧਿਓ ਸਰ ਜਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: man maaeaa bandhio sar jaal |
English: Maya has caught the mind in the trap of the whirlpool.

Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਬਿਆਪਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਬਿਖੁ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt biaap rahio bikh naal |
English: Each and every heart is trapped by this bait of poison and sin.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਆਂਜੈ ਸੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਕਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: jo aanjai so deesai kaal |
English: See that whoever has come, is subject to death.

Gurbani: ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸੀਧੋ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: kaaraj seedho ridai samaal |4|
English: Your affairs shall be adjusted, if you contemplate the Lord in your heart. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: so giaanee jin sabad liv laaee |
English: He alone is a spiritual teacher, who lovingly focuses his consciousness on the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh haumai pat gavaaee |
English: The self-willed, egotistical manmukh loses his honor.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aape karatai bhagat karaaee |
English: The Creator Lord Himself inspires us to His devotional worship.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: guramukh aape de vaddiaaee |5|
English: He Himself blesses the Gurmukh with glorious greatness. ||5||

Gurbani: ਰੈਣਿ ਅੰਧਾਰੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: rain andhaaree niramal jot |
English: The life-night is dark, while the Divine Light is immaculate.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਝੂਠੇ ਕੁਚਲ ਕਛੋਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: naam binaa jhootthe kuchal kachhot |
English: Those who lack the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are false, filthy and untouchable.

Gurbani: ਬੇਦੁ ਪੁਕਾਰੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਰੋਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: bed pukaarai bhagat sarot |
English: The Vedas preach sermons of devotional worship.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਾਨੈ ਵੇਖੈ ਜੋਤਿ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: sun sun maanai vekhai jot |6|
English: Listening, hearing and believing, one beholds the Divine Light. ||6||

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਮੰ ॥
Transliteration: saasatr simrit naam drirraaman |
English: The Shaastras and Simritees implant the Naam within.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਕਰਾਮੰ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh saant aootam karaaman |
English: The Gurmukh lives in peace and tranquility, doing deeds of sublime purity.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਦੂਖ ਸਹਾਮੰ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh jonee dookh sahaaman |
English: The self-willed manmukh suffers the pains of reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੂਟੇ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਮੰ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: bandhan tootte ik naam vasaaman |7|
English: His bonds are broken, enshrining the Name of the One Lord. ||7||

Gurbani: ਮੰਨੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚੀ ਪਤਿ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: mane naam sachee pat poojaa |
English: Believing in the Naam, one obtains true honor and adoration.

Gurbani: ਕਿਸੁ ਵੇਖਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: kis vekhaa naahee ko doojaa |
English: Who should I see? There is none other than the Lord.

Gurbani: ਦੇਖਿ ਕਹਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: dekh khau bhaavai man soe |
English: I see, and I say, that He alone is pleasing to my mind.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥੮॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak kahai avar nahee koe |8|1|
English: Says Nanak, there is no other at all. ||8||1||

[Ang 832 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 1 |
English: Bilaaval, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਮਨਸਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: man kaa kahiaa manasaa karai |
English: The human acts according to the wishes of the mind.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਪਾਪੁ ਉਚਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: eihu man pun paap ucharai |
English: This mind feeds on virtue and vice.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦਿ ਮਾਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mad maate tripat na aavai |
English: Intoxicated with the wine of Maya, satisfaction never comes.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tripat mukat man saachaa bhaavai |1|
English: Satisfaction and liberation come, only to one whose mind is pleasing to the True Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਕਲਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਦੇਖੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: tan dhan kalat sabh dekh abhimaanaa |
English: Gazing upon his body, wealth, wife and all his possessions, he is proud.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bin naavai kichh sang na jaanaa |1| rahaau |
English: But without the Name of the Lord, nothing shall go along with him. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕੀਚਹਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਮਨ ਕੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: keecheh ras bhog khuseea man keree |
English: He enjoys tastes, pleasures and joys in his mind.

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਤਨੁ ਭਸਮੈ ਢੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: dhan lokaan tan bhasamai dteree |
English: But his wealth will pass on to other people, and his body will be reduced to ashes.

Gurbani: ਖਾਕੂ ਖਾਕੁ ਰਲੈ ਸਭੁ ਫੈਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: khaakoo khaak ralai sabh fail |
English: The entire expanse, like dust, shall mix with dust.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਨਹੀ ਉਤਰੈ ਮੈਲੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bin sabadai nahee utarai mail |2|
English: Without the Word of the Shabad, his filth is not removed. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੀਤ ਰਾਗ ਘਨ ਤਾਲ ਸਿ ਕੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: geet raag ghan taal si koore |
English: The various songs, tunes and rhythms are false.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਦੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: trihu gun upajai binasai doore |
English: Trapped by the three qualities, people come and go, far from the Lord.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦਰਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: doojee duramat darad na jaae |
English: In duality, the pain of their evil-mindedness does not leave them.

Gurbani: ਛੂਟੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦਾਰੂ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: chhoottai guramukh daaroo gun gaae |3|
English: But the Gurmukh is emancipated by taking the medicine, and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਧੋਤੀ ਊਜਲ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਗਲਿ ਮਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: dhotee aoojal tilak gal maalaa |
English: He may wear a clean loin-cloth, apply the ceremonial mark to his forehead, and wear a mala around his neck;

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਪੜਹਿ ਨਾਟ ਸਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: antar krodh parreh naatt saalaa |
English: but if there is anger within him, he is merely reading his part, like an actor in a play.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦੁ ਪੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: naam visaar maaeaa mad peea |
English: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he drinks in the wine of Maya.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਥੀਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: bin gur bhagat naahee sukh theea |4|
English: Without devotional worship to the Guru, there is no peace. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸੂਕਰ ਸੁਆਨ ਗਰਧਭ ਮੰਜਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sookar suaan garadhabh manjaaraa |
English: The human is a pig, a dog, a donkey, a cat,

Gurbani: ਪਸੂ ਮਲੇਛ ਨੀਚ ਚੰਡਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: pasoo malechh neech chanddaalaa |
English: a beast, a filthy, lowly wretch, an outcast,

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮੁਹੁ ਫੇਰੇ ਤਿਨੑ ਜੋਨਿ ਭਵਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: gur te muhu fere tina jon bhavaaeeai |
English: if he turns his face away from the Guru. He shall wander in reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਬੰਧਨਿ ਬਾਧਿਆ ਆਈਐ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: bandhan baadhiaa aaeeai jaaeeai |5|
English: Bound in bondage, he comes and goes. ||5||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਲਹੈ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur sevaa te lahai padaarath |
English: Serving the Guru, the treasure is found.

Gurbani: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਕਿਰਤਾਰਥੁ ॥
Transliteration: hiradai naam sadaa kirataarath |
English: With the Naam in the heart, one always prospers.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੂਛ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: saachee daragah poochh na hoe |
English: And in the Court of the True Lord, you shall not called to account.

Gurbani: ਮਾਨੇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸੀਝੈ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: maane hukam seejhai dar soe |6|
English: One who obeys the Hukam of the Lord's Command, is approved at the Lord's Door. ||6||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur milai ta tis kau jaanai |
English: Meeting the True Guru, one knows the Lord.

Gurbani: ਰਹੈ ਰਜਾਈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: rahai rajaaee hukam pachhaanai |
English: Understanding the Hukam of His Command, one acts according to His Will.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: hukam pachhaan sachai dar vaas |
English: Understanding the Hukam of His Command, he dwells in the Court of the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਾਲ ਬਿਕਾਲ ਸਬਦਿ ਭਏ ਨਾਸੁ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: kaal bikaal sabad bhe naas |7|
English: Through the Shabad, death and birth are ended. ||7||

Gurbani: ਰਹੈ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ॥
Transliteration: rahai ateet jaanai sabh tis kaa |
English: He remains detached, knowing that everything belongs to God.

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪੈ ਹੈ ਇਹੁ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ॥
Transliteration: tan man arapai hai ihu jis kaa |
English: He dedicates his body and mind unto the One who owns them.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: naa ohu aavai naa ohu jaae |
English: He does not come, and he does not go.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੮॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak saache saach samaae |8|2|
English: O Nanak, absorbed in Truth, he merges in the True Lord. ||8||2||

[Ang 832 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ਘਰੁ ੧੦ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 3 asattapadee ghar 10 |
English: Bilaaval, Third Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa, Tenth House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਜਗੁ ਕਊਆ ਮੁਖਿ ਚੁੰਚ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: jag kaooaa mukh chunch giaan |
English: The world is like a crow; with its beak, it croaks spiritual wisdom.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: antar lobh jhootth abhimaan |
English: But deep within there is greed, falsehood and pride.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪਾਜੁ ਲਹਗੁ ਨਿਦਾਨਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bin naavai paaj lehag nidaan |1|
English: Without the Name of the Lord, your thin outer covering shall wear off, you fool. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sev naam vasai man cheet |
English: Serving the True Guru, the Naam shall dwell in your conscious mind.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੇਤਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਹੋਰ ਝੂਠੁ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur bhette har naam chetaavai bin naavai hor jhootth pareet |1| rahaau |
English: Meeting with the Guru, the Name of the Lord comes to mind. Without the Name, other loves are false. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਸਾ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur kahiaa saa kaar kamaavahu |
English: So do that work, which the Guru tells you to do.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੁ ਚੀਨਿੑ ਸਹਜ ਘਰਿ ਆਵਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: sabad cheena sehaj ghar aavahu |
English: Contemplating the Word of the Shabad, you shall come to the home of celestial bliss.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਵਡਾਈ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saachai naae vaddaaee paavahu |2|
English: Through the True Name, you shall obtain glorious greatness. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਲੋਕ ਬੁਝਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: aap na boojhai lok bujhaavai |
English: One who does not understand his own self, but still tries to instruct others,

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਅੰਧਾ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: man kaa andhaa andh kamaavai |
English: is mentally blind, and acts in blindness.

Gurbani: ਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਠਉਰੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: dar ghar mehal tthaur kaise paavai |3|
English: How can he ever find a home and a place of rest, in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence? ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: har jeeo seveeai antarajaamee |
English: Serve the Dear Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts;

Gurbani: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt antar jis kee jot samaanee |
English: deep within each and every heart, His Light is shining forth.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਕਿਆ ਚਲੈ ਪਹਨਾਮੀ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: tis naal kiaa chalai pahanaamee |4|
English: How can anyone hide anything from Him? ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: saachaa naam saachai sabad jaanai |
English: The True Name is known through the True Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਚੂਕੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: aapai aap milai chookai abhimaanai |
English: The Lord Himself meets that one who eradicates egotistical pride.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਵਖਾਨੈ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: guramukh naam sadaa sadaa vakhaanai |5|
English: The Gurmukh chants the Naam, forever and ever. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਦੂਜੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur seviai doojee duramat jaaee |
English: Serving the True Guru, duality and evil-mindedness are taken away.

Gurbani: ਅਉਗਣ ਕਾਟਿ ਪਾਪਾ ਮਤਿ ਖਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aaugan kaatt paapaa mat khaaee |
English: Guilty mistakes are erased, and the sinful intellect is cleansed.

Gurbani: ਕੰਚਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: kanchan kaaeaa jotee jot samaaee |6|
English: One's body sparkles like gold, and one's light merges into the Light. ||6||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur miliai vaddee vaddiaaee |
English: Meeting with the True Guru, one is blessed with glorious greatness.

Gurbani: ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: dukh kaattai hiradai naam vasaaee |
English: Pain is taken away, and the Naam comes to dwell within the heart.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: naam rate sadaa sukh paaee |7|
English: Imbued with the Naam, one finds eternal peace. ||7||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramat maaniaa karanee saar |
English: Obeying the Gur's instructions, one's actions are purified.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramat maaniaa mokh duaar |
English: Obeying the Guru's Instructions, one finds the state of salvation.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਪਰਵਾਰੈ ਸਾਧਾਰੁ ॥੮॥੧॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak guramat maaniaa paravaarai saadhaar |8|1|3|
English: O Nanak, those who follow the Guru's Teachings are saved, along with their families. ||8||1||3||

[Ang 833 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੧੧ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 4 asattapadeea ghar 11 |
English: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa, Eleventh House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਖਾਇ ਹਉ ਮੇਟੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਗੀਤ ਗਵਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: aapai aap khaae hau mettai anadin har ras geet gaveea |
English: One who eliminates his self-centeredness, and eradicates his ego, night and day sings the songs of the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਚੈ ਕੰਚਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਈਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: guramukh parachai kanchan kaaeaa nirbhau jotee jot mileea |1|
English: The Gurmukh is inspired, his body is golden, and his light merges into the Light of the Fearless Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਰਮਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: mai har har naam adhaar rameea |
English: I take the Support of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਠ ਪੜਈਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: khin pal reh na skau bin naavai guramukh har har paatth parreea |1| rahaau |
English: I cannot live, for a moment, even for an instant, without the Name of the Lord; the Gurmukh reads the Sermon of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਗਿਰਹੁ ਦਸ ਦੁਆਰ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਤਸਕਰ ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਲਗਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: ek girahu das duaar hai jaa ke ahinis tasakar panch chor lageea |
English: In the one house of the body, there are ten gates; night and day, the five thieves break in.

Gurbani: ਧਰਮੁ ਅਰਥੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਿਰਿ ਲੇ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਪਈਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: dharam arath sabh hir le jaaveh manamukh andhule khabar na peea |2|
English: They steal the entire wealth of one's Dharmic faith, but the blind, self-willed manmukh does not know it. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕੰਚਨ ਕੋਟੁ ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣਕਿ ਭਰਿਆ ਜਾਗੇ ਗਿਆਨ ਤਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: kanchan kott bahu maanak bhariaa jaage giaan tat liv leea |
English: The fortress of the body is overflowing with gold and jewels; when it is awakened by spiritual wisdom, one enshrines love for the essence of reality.

Gurbani: ਤਸਕਰ ਹੇਰੂ ਆਇ ਲੁਕਾਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਕੜਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਪਈਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tasakar heroo aae lukaane gur kai sabad pakarr bandh peea |3|
English: The thieves and robbers hide out in the body; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they are arrested and locked up. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੋਤੁ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਖੇਵਟੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam pot bohithaa khevatt sabad gur paar langheea |
English: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is the boat, and the Word of the Guru's Shabad is the boatman, to carry us across.

Gurbani: ਜਮੁ ਜਾਗਾਤੀ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਤਸਕਰੁ ਚੋਰੁ ਲਗਈਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jam jaagaatee nerr na aavai naa ko tasakar chor lageea |4|
English: The Messenger of Death, the tax collector, does not even come close, and no thieves or robbers can plunder you. ||4||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਹਤੇ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਲਹੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: har gun gaavai sadaa din raatee mai har jas kahate ant na laheea |
English: I continuously sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, day and night; singing the Lord's Praises, I cannot find His limits.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਇਕਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਮਿਲਉ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ਨੀਸਾਨੁ ਬਜਈਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: guramukh manooaa ikat ghar aavai milau guopaal neesaan bajeea |5|
English: The mind of the Gurmukh returns to its own home; it meets the Lord of the Universe, to the beat of the celestial drum. ||5||

Gurbani: ਨੈਨੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੈ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: nainee dekh daras man tripatai sravan baanee gurasabad suneea |
English: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan with my eyes, my mind is satisfied; with my ears, I listen to the Guru's Bani, and the Word of His Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਆਤਮ ਦੇਵ ਹੈ ਭੀਨੇ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਮ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਰਵਈਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: sun sun aatam dev hai bheene ras ras raam gopaal raveea |6|
English: Listening, listening, my soul is softened, delighted by His subtle essence, chanting the Name of the Lord of the Universe. ||6||

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਤੁਰੀਆ ਗੁਣੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਹੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: trai gun maaeaa mohi viaape tureea gun hai guramukh laheea |
English: In the grip of the three qualities, they are engrossed in love and attachment to Maya; only as Gurmukh do they find the absolute quality, absorption in bliss.

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਸਰਈਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: ek drisatt sabh sam kar jaanai nadaree aavai sabh braham pasareea |7|
English: With a single, impartial eye, look upon all alike, and see God pervading all. ||7||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਾਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੇ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam hai jot sabaaee guramukh aape alakh lakheea |
English: The Light of the Lord's Name permeates all; the Gurmukh knows the unknowable.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਈਆ ॥੮॥੧॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak deen deaal bhe hai bhagat bhaae har naam sameea |8|1|4|
English: O Nanak, the Lord has become merciful to the meek; through loving adoration, he merges in the Lord's Name. ||8||1||4||

[Ang 833 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 4 |
English: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੀਤਲ ਜਲੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਚੰਦਨ ਵਾਸੁ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਗੰਧਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam seetal jal dhiaavahu har chandan vaas sugandh gandheea |
English: Meditate on the cool water of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. Perfume yourself with the fragrant scent of the Lord, the sandalwood tree.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੈ ਹਿਰਡ ਪਲਾਸ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੁਹੀਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mil satasangat param pad paaeaa mai hiradd palaas sang har buheea |1|
English: Joining the Society of the Saints, I have obtained the supreme status. I am just a castor-oil tree, made fragrant by their association. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਜਗੰਨਾਥ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਗੁਸਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: jap jaganaath jagadees guseea |
English: Meditate on the Lord of the Universe, the Master of the world, the Lord of creation.

Gurbani: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦ ਉਧਾਰਿ ਸਮਈਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saran pare seee jan ubare jiau prahilaad udhaar sameea |1| rahaau |
English: Those humble beings who seek the Lord's Sanctuary are saved, like Prahlaad; they are emancipated and merge with the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਭਾਰ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਮਹਿ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਊਤਮ ਚੰਦਨ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਸਭ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਹੁਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: bhaar atthaarah meh chandan aootam chandan nikatt sabh chandan hueea |
English: Of all plants, the sandalwood tree is the most sublime. Everything near the sandalwood tree becomes fragrant like sandalwood.

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤ ਕੂੜੇ ਊਭ ਸੁਕ ਹੂਏ ਮਨਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਗਈਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saakat koorre aoobh suk hooe man abhimaan vichhurr door geea |2|
English: The stubborn, false faithless cynics are dried up; their egotistical pride separates them far from the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਬਨਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: har gat mit karataa aape jaanai sabh bidh har har aap baneea |
English: Only the Creator Lord Himself knows the state and condition of everyone; the Lord Himself makes all the arrangements.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਸੁ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਨ ਮਿਟਈਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jis satigur bhette su kanchan hovai jo dhur likhiaa su mittai na mitteea |3|
English: One who meets the True Guru is transformed into gold. Whatever is pre-ordained, is not erased by erasing. ||3||

Gurbani: ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਸਾਗਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਖੁਲੑਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: ratan padaarath guramat paavai saagar bhagat bhanddaar khulaeea |
English: The treasure of jewels is found in the ocean of the Guru's Teachings. The treasure of devotional worship is opened to me.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਇਕ ਸਰਧਾ ਉਪਜੀ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਭਈਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: gur charanee ik saradhaa upajee mai har gun kahate tripat na bheea |4|
English: Focused on the Guru's Feet, faith wells up within me; chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord, I hunger for more. ||4||

Gurbani: ਪਰਮ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਏ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਤੇ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਕਹੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: param bairaag nit nit har dhiaae mai har gun kahate bhaavanee kaheea |
English: I am totally detached, continually, continuously meditating on the Lord; chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord, I express my love for Him.

Gurbani: ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਪਰੈ ਪਰਈਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: baar baar khin khin pal kaheeai har paar na paavai parai pareea |5|
English: Time and time again, each and every moment and instant, I express it. I cannot find the Lord's limits; He is the farthest of the far. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਤ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਪੁਕਾਰਹਿ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: saasat bed puraan pukaareh dharam karahu khatt karam drirreea |
English: The Shaastras, the Vedas and the Puraanas advise righteous actions, and the performance of the six religious rituals.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਵਿਗੂਤੇ ਲੋਭ ਲਹਰਿ ਨਾਵ ਭਾਰਿ ਬੁਡਈਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: manamukh paakhandd bharam vigoote lobh lehar naav bhaar buddeea |6|
English: The hypocritical, self-willed manmukhs are ruined by doubt; in the waves of greed, their boat is heavily loaded, and it sinks. ||6||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: naam japahu naame gat paavahu simrit saasatr naam drirreea |
English: So chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and through the Naam, find emancipation. The Simritees and Shaastras recommend the Naam.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ਤ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਚੈ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਈਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: haumai jaae ta niramal hovai guramukh parachai param pad peea |7|
English: Eradicating egotism, one becomes pure. The Gurmukh is inspired, and obtains the supreme status. ||7||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਵਰਨੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: eihu jag varan roop sabh teraa jit laaveh se karam kameea |
English: This world, with its colors and forms, is all Yours, O Lord; as You attach us, so do we do our deeds.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੰਤ ਵਜਾਏ ਵਾਜਹਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਰਾਹਿ ਚਲਈਆ ॥੮॥੨॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak jant vajaae vaajeh jit bhaavai tith raeh chaleea |8|2|5|
English: O Nanak, we are the instruments upon which He plays; as He wills, so is the path we take. ||8||2||5||

[Ang 834 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 4 |
English: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh agam agochar dhiaaeaa hau bal bal satigur sat purakheea |
English: The Gurmukh meditates on the Inaccessible, Unfathomable Lord. I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the True Guru, the True Primal Being.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣਿ ਵਸਾਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਈਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: raam naam merai praan vasaae satigur paras har naam sameea |1|
English: He has brought the Lord's Name to dwell upon my breath of life; meeting with the True Guru, I am absorbed into the Lord's Name. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਟਿਕਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: jan kee ttek har naam ttikeea |
English: The Name of the Lord is the only Support of His humble servants.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਧਰ ਲਾਗਾ ਜਾਵਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰੁ ਲਹੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur kee dhar laagaa jaavaa gur kirapaa te har dar laheea |1| rahaau |
English: I shall live under the protection of the True Guru. By Guru's Grace, I shall attain the Court of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਕਰਮ ਕੀ ਧਰਤੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਥਿ ਮਥਿ ਤਤੁ ਕਢਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: eihu sareer karam kee dharatee guramukh math math tat kadteea |
English: This body is the field of karma; the Gurmukhs plow and work it, and harvest the essence.

Gurbani: ਲਾਲੁ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਭਾਂਡੈ ਭਾਉ ਪਵੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਅਈਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: laal javehar naam pragaasiaa bhaanddai bhaau pavai tith aeea |2|
English: The priceless jewel of the Naam becomes manifest, and it pours into their vessels of love. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੀਐ ਜੋ ਜਨ ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤ ਨਿਜ ਭਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: daasan daas daas hoe raheeai jo jan raam bhagat nij bheea |
English: Become the slave of the slave of the slave, of that humble being who has become the devotee of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਬੁਧਿ ਅਰਪਿ ਧਰਉ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮੈ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥਈਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: man budh arap dhrau gur aagai gur parasaadee mai akath katheea |3|
English: I dedicate my mind and intellect, and place them in offering before my Guru; by Guru's Grace, I speak the Unspoken. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਲਤ ਤਿਖਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh maaeaa mohi viaape ihu man trisanaa jalat tikheea |
English: The self-willed manmukhs are engrossed in attachment to Maya; their minds are thirsty, burning with desire.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਈਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: guramat naam amrit jal paaeaa agan bujhee gur sabad bujheea |4|
English: Following the Guru's Teachings, I have obtained the Ambrosial Water of the Naam, and the fire has been put out. The Word of the Guru's Shabad has put it out. ||4||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਾਚੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਤੂਰ ਵਜਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: eihu man naachai satigur aagai anahad sabad dhun toor vajeea |
English: This mind dances before the True Guru. The unstruck sound current of the Shabad resounds, vibrating the celestial melody.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਰਖਿ ਰਖਿ ਚਰਣ ਹਰਿ ਤਾਲ ਪੂਰਈਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: har har usatat karai din raatee rakh rakh charan har taal pooreea |5|
English: I praise the Lord, day and night, moving my feet to the beat of the drum. ||5||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਾਲ ਰਸਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਵਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: har kai rang rataa man gaavai ras rasaal ras sabad raveea |
English: Imbued with the Lord's Love, my mind sings His Praise, joyfully chanting the Shabad, the source of nectar and bliss.

Gurbani: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਧਾਰ ਚੁਐ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੀਆ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਲਹੀਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: nij ghar dhaar chuai at niramal jin peea tin hee sukh laheea |6|
English: The stream of immaculate purity flows through the home of the self within; one who drinks it in, finds peace. ||6||

Gurbani: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਲਕ ਬਾਲੂ ਘਰ ਉਸਰਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: manahatth karam karai abhimaanee jiau baalak baaloo ghar usareea |
English: The stubborn-minded, egotistical, proud-minded person performs rituals, but these are like sand castles built by children.

Gurbani: ਆਵੈ ਲਹਰਿ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਸਾਗਰ ਕੀ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਭਿੰਨ ਭਿੰਨ ਢਹਿ ਪਈਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: aavai lehar samund saagar kee khin meh bhin bhin dteh peea |7|
English: When the waves of the ocean come in, they crumble and dissolve in an instant. ||7||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਖੇਲਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: har sar saagar har hai aape ihu jag hai sabh khel kheleea |
English: The Lord is the pool, and the Lord Himself is the ocean; this world is all a play which He has staged.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਤਰੰਗ ਜਲੁ ਜਲਹਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਰਮਈਆ ॥੮॥੩॥੬॥
Transliteration: jiau jal tarang jal jaleh samaaveh naanak aape aap rameea |8|3|6|
English: As the waves of water merge into the water again, O Nanak, so does He merge into Himself. ||8||3||6||

[Ang 835 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 4 |
English: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਚੈ ਮਨਿ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਪਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਤਨਿ ਭਸਮ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: satigur parachai man mundraa paaee gur kaa sabad tan bhasam drirreea |
English: My mind wears the ear-rings of the True Guru's acquaintance; I apply the ashes of the Word of the Guru's Shabad to my body.

Gurbani: ਅਮਰ ਪਿੰਡ ਭਏ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੋਊ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਈਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: amar pindd bhe saadhoo sang janam maran doaoo mitt geea |1|
English: My body has become immortal, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. Both birth and death have come to an end for me. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: mere man saadhasangat mil raheea |
English: O my mind, remain united with the Saadh Sangat.

Gurbani: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਮਧਸੂਦਨ ਮਾਧਉ ਮੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਣ ਪਖਈਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kripaa karahu madhasoodan maadhau mai khin khin saadhoo charan pakheea |1| rahaau |
English: Be merciful to me, O Lord; each and every instant, let me wash the Feet of the Holy. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤਜੈ ਗਿਰਸਤੁ ਭਇਆ ਬਨ ਵਾਸੀ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਟਿਕੈ ਨ ਟਿਕਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: tajai girasat bheaa ban vaasee ik khin manooaa ttikai na ttikeea |
English: Forsaking family life, he wanders in the forest, but his mind does not remain at rest, even for an instant.

Gurbani: ਧਾਵਤੁ ਧਾਇ ਤਦੇ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਵਈਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: dhaavat dhaae tade ghar aavai har har saadhoo saran paveea |2|
English: The wandering mind returns home, only when it seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord's Holy people. ||2||

Gurbani: ਧੀਆ ਪੂਤ ਛੋਡਿ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਆਸਾ ਆਸ ਮਨਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕਰਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: dheea poot chhodd saniaasee aasaa aas man bahut kareea |
English: The Sannyaasi renounces his daughters and sons, but his mind still conjures up all sorts of hopes and desires.

Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਆਸ ਕਰੈ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਸੁਖੁ ਲਹੀਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aasaa aas karai nahee boojhai gur kai sabad niraas sukh laheea |3|
English: With these hopes and desires, he still does not understand, that only through the Word of the Guru's Shabad does one become free of desires, and find peace. ||3||

Gurbani: ਉਪਜੀ ਤਰਕ ਦਿਗੰਬਰੁ ਹੋਆ ਮਨੁ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਚਲਿ ਚਲਿ ਗਵਨੁ ਕਰਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: aupajee tarak diganbar hoaa man deh dis chal chal gavan kareea |
English: When detachment from the world wells up within, he become a naked hermit, but still, his mind roams, wanders and rambles in the ten directions.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭਵਨੁ ਕਰੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਨਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧ ਦਇਆ ਘਰੁ ਲਹੀਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: prabhavan karai boojhai nahee trisanaa mil sang saadh deaa ghar laheea |4|
English: He wanders around, but his desires are not satisfied; joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he finds the house of kindness and compassion. ||4||

Gurbani: ਆਸਣ ਸਿਧ ਸਿਖਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਚੇਟਕ ਚੇਟਕਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: aasan sidh sikheh bahutere man maageh ridh sidh chettak chettakeea |
English: The Siddhas learn many Yogis postures, but their minds still yearn for riches, miraculous powers and energy.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਈਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: tripat santokh man saant na aavai mil saadhoo tripat har naam sidh peea |5|
English: Satisfaction, contentment and tranquility do not come to their minds; but meeting the Holy Saints, they are satisfied, and through the Name of the Lord, spiritual perfection is attained. ||5||

Gurbani: ਅੰਡਜ ਜੇਰਜ ਸੇਤਜ ਉਤਭੁਜ ਸਭਿ ਵਰਨ ਰੂਪ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: anddaj jeraj setaj utabhuj sabh varan roop jeea jant upeea |
English: Life is born from the egg, from the womb, from sweat and from the earth; God created the beings and creatures of all colors and forms.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੈ ਸੋ ਉਬਰੈ ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਸੂਦੁ ਵੈਸੁ ਚੰਡਾਲੁ ਚੰਡਈਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: saadhoo saran parai so ubarai khatree braahaman sood vais chanddaal chanddeea |6|
English: One who seeks the Sanctuary of the Holy is saved, whether he is a Kh'shaatriya, a Brahmin, a Soodra, a Vaishya or the most untouchable of the untouchables. ||6||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਾ ਜੈਦੇਉ ਕੰਬੀਰੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨੁ ਅਉਜਾਤਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸੁ ਚਮਿਆਰੁ ਚਮਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: naamaa jaideo kanbeer trilochan aaujaat ravidaas chamiaar chameea |
English: Naam Dayv, Jai Dayv, Kabeer, Trilochan and Ravi Daas the low-caste leather-worker,

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨਾ ਜਟੁ ਸੈਣੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਦਈਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: jo jo milai saadhoo jan sangat dhan dhanaa jatt sain miliaa har deea |7|
English: blessed Dhanna and Sain; all those who joined the humble Saadh Sangat, met the Merciful Lord. ||7||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: sant janaa kee har paij rakhaaee bhagat vachhal angeekaar kareea |
English: The Lord protects the honor of His humble servants; He is the Lover of His devotees - He makes them His own.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਖਈਆ ॥੮॥੪॥੭॥
Transliteration: naanak saran pare jagajeevan har har kirapaa dhaar rakheea |8|4|7|
English: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Lord, the Life of the world, who has showered His Mercy upon him, and saved him. ||8||||4||7||

[Ang 835 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 4 |
English: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਿਆਸ ਉਠੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਮਨਿ ਤੀਰ ਲਗਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: antar piaas utthee prabh keree sun gur bachan man teer lageea |
English: The thirst for God has welled up deep within me; hearing the Word of the Guru's Teachings, my mind is pierced by His arrow.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਜਾਣੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋ ਪੀਰ ਪਰਈਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: man kee birathaa man hee jaanai avar ki jaanai ko peer pareea |1|
English: The pain of my mind is known only to my own mind; who can know the pain of another? ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੋਹਨਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਲਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: raam gur mohan mohi man leea |
English: The Lord, the Guru, the Enticer, has enticed my mind.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਆਕਲ ਬਿਕਲ ਭਈ ਗੁਰ ਦੇਖੇ ਹਉ ਲੋਟ ਪੋਟ ਹੋਇ ਪਈਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hau aakal bikal bhee gur dekhe hau lott pott hoe peea |1| rahaau |
English: I am stunned and amazed, gazing upon my Guru; I have entered the realm of wonder and bliss. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਨਿਰਖਤ ਫਿਰਉ ਸਭਿ ਦੇਸ ਦਿਸੰਤਰ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਖਨ ਕੋ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮਨਿ ਚਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau nirakhat firau sabh des disantar mai prabh dekhan ko bahut man cheea |
English: I wander around, exploring all lands and foreign countries; within my mind, I have such a great longing to see my God.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਕਾਟਿ ਦੇਉ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪੰਥੁ ਦਿਖਈਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: man tan kaatt deo gur aagai jin har prabh maarag panth dikheea |2|
English: I sacrifice my mind and body to the Guru, who has shown me the Way, the Path to my Lord God. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਆਣਿ ਸਦੇਸਾ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰਾ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: koee aan sadesaa dee prabh keraa rid antar man tan meetth lageea |
English: If only someone would bring me news of God; He seems so sweet to my heart, mind and body.

Gurbani: ਮਸਤਕੁ ਕਾਟਿ ਦੇਉ ਚਰਣਾ ਤਲਿ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਈਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: masatak kaatt deo charanaa tal jo har prabh mele mel mileea |3|
English: I would cut off my head and place it under the feet of that one who leads me to meet and unite with my Lord God. ||3||

Gurbani: ਚਲੁ ਚਲੁ ਸਖੀ ਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਰਬੋਧਹ ਗੁਣ ਕਾਮਣ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਹੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: chal chal sakhee ham prabh parabodhah gun kaaman kar har prabh laheea |
English: Let us go, O my companions, and understand our God; with the spell of virtue, let us obtain our Lord God.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਉਆ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਹੀਅਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਈਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: bhagat vachhal uaa ko naam kaheeat hai saran prabhoo tis paachhai peea |4|
English: He is called the Lover of His devotees; let us follow in the footsteps of those who seek God's Sanctuary. ||4||

Gurbani: ਖਿਮਾ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਮਨਿ ਦੀਪਕ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬਲਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: khimaa seegaar kare prabh khuseea man deepak gur giaan baleea |
English: If the soul-bride adorns herself with compassion and forgiveness, God is pleased, and her mind is illumined with the lamp of the Guru's wisdom.

Gurbani: ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਭੋਗ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਮ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਜੀਉ ਕਟਿ ਕਟਿ ਪਈਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: ras ras bhog kare prabh meraa ham tis aagai jeeo katt katt peea |5|
English: With happiness and ecstasy, my God enjoys her; I offer each and every bit of my soul to Him. ||5||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਾਰੁ ਕੰਠਿ ਹੈ ਬਨਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਤੀਚੂਰੁ ਵਡ ਗਹਨ ਗਹਨਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: har har haar kantth hai baniaa man moteechoor vadd gehan gahaneea |
English: I have made the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, my necklace; my mind tinged with devotion is the intricate ornament of crowning glory.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਧਾ ਸੇਜ ਵਿਛਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਈਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: har har saradhaa sej vichhaaee prabh chhodd na sakai bahut man bheea |6|
English: I have spread out my bed of faith in the Lord, Har, Har. I cannot abandon Him - my mind is filled with such a great love for Him. ||6||

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਸਭੁ ਬਾਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਫੋਕਟ ਫੋਕਟਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: kahai prabh avar avar kichh keejai sabh baad seegaar fokatt fokatteea |
English: If God says one thing, and the soul-bride does something else, then all her decorations are useless and false.

Gurbani: ਕੀਓ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਮਿਲਣ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲੀਓ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਥੂਕ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਈਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: keeo seegaar milan kai taaee prabh leeo suhaagan thook mukh peea |7|
English: She may adorn herself to meet her Husband Lord, but still, only the virtuous soul-bride meets God, and the other's face is spat upon. ||7||

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਚੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਅਗਮ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਕਿਆ ਹਮ ਕਰਹ ਤੇਰੈ ਵਸਿ ਪਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: ham cheree too agam gusaaee kiaa ham karah terai vas peea |
English: I am Your hand-maiden, O Inaccessible Lord of the Universe; what can I do by myself? I am under Your power.

Gurbani: ਦਇਆ ਦੀਨ ਕਰਹੁ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਮਈਆ ॥੮॥੫॥੮॥
Transliteration: deaa deen karahu rakh levahu naanak har gur saran sameea |8|5|8|
English: Be merciful, Lord, to the meek, and save them; Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Lord, and the Guru. ||8||5||8||

[Ang 836 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 4 |
English: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਅਗਮ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਾ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਸਰਧਾ ਮਨਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਉਠਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: mai man tan prem agam tthaakur kaa khin khin saradhaa man bahut uttheea |
English: My mind and body are filled with love for my Inaccessible Lord and Master. Each and every instant, I am filled with immense faith and devotion.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਦੇਖੇ ਸਰਧਾ ਮਨ ਪੂਰੀ ਜਿਉ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਬੂੰਦ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਈਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur dekhe saradhaa man pooree jiau chaatrik priau priau boond mukh peea |1|
English: Gazing upon the Guru, my mind's faith is fulfilled, like the song-bird, which cries and cries, until the rain-drop falls into its mouth. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਿਲੁ ਮਿਲੁ ਸਖੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: mil mil sakhee har kathaa suneea |
English: Join with me, join with me, O my companions, and teach me the Sermon of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਸਿਰੁ ਕਟਿ ਕਟਿ ਪਈਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur deaa kare prabh mele mai tis aagai sir katt katt peea |1| rahaau |
English: The True Guru has mercifully united me with God. Cutting off my head, and chopping it into pieces, I offer it to Him. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਰੋਮਿ ਰੋਮਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਇਕ ਬੇਦਨ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਖੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਪਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: rom rom man tan ik bedan mai prabh dekhe bin need na peea |
English: Each and every hair on my head, and my mind and body, suffer the pains of separation; without seeing my God, I cannot sleep.

Gurbani: ਬੈਦਕ ਨਾਟਿਕ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੁਲਾਨੇ ਮੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪੀਰ ਲਗਈਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: baidak naattik dekh bhulaane mai hiradai man tan prem peer lageea |2|
English: The doctors and healers look at me, and are perplexed. Within my heart, mind and body, I feel the pain of divine love. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਜਿਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਮਲੈ ਅਮਲੀ ਮਰਿ ਗਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: hau khin pal reh na skau bin preetam jiau bin amalai amalee mar geea |
English: I cannot live for a moment, for even an instant, without my Beloved, like the opium addict who cannot live without opium.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪਿਆਸ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰੀ ਤਿਨੑ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਦੁਈਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jin kau piaas hoe prabh keree tina avar na bhaavai bin har ko dueea |3|
English: Those who thirst for God, do not love any other. Without the Lord, there is no other at all. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਆਨਿ ਆਨਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਘੁਮਿ ਗਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: koee aan aan meraa prabhoo milaavai hau tis vittahu bal bal ghum geea |
English: If only someone would come and unite me with God; I am devoted, dedicated, a sacrifice to him.

Gurbani: ਅਨੇਕ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਜਨ ਮੇਲੇ ਜਾ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਵਈਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: anek janam ke vichhurre jan mele jaa sat sat satigur saran paveea |4|
English: After being separated from the Lord for countless incarnations, I am re-united with Him, entering the Sanctuary of the True, True, True Guru. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸੇਜ ਏਕ ਏਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: sej ek eko prabh tthaakur mehal na paavai manamukh bharameea |
English: There is one bed for the soul-bride, and the same bed for God, her Lord and Master. The self-willed manmukh does not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence; she wanders around, in limbo.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤ ਸਰਣਿ ਜੇ ਆਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਢੀਲ ਨ ਪਈਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: gur gur karat saran je aavai prabh aae milai khin dteel na peea |5|
English: Uttering, "Guru, Guru", she seeks His Sanctuary; so God comes to meet her, without a moment's delay. ||5||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਿਆਚਾਰ ਵਧਾਏ ਮਨਿ ਪਾਖੰਡ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਪਟ ਲੋਭਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: kar kar kiriaachaar vadhaae man paakhandd karam kapatt lobheea |
English: One may perform many rituals, but the mind is filled with hypocrisy, evil deeds and greed.

Gurbani: ਬੇਸੁਆ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਬੇਟਾ ਜਨਮਿਆ ਪਿਤਾ ਤਾਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਈਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: besuaa kai ghar bettaa janamiaa pitaa taeh kiaa naam sadeea |6|
English: When a son is born in the house of a prostitute, who can tell the name of his father? ||6||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਬ ਜਨਮਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਆਏ ਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਮਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: poorab janam bhagat kar aae gur har har har har bhagat jameea |
English: Because of devotional worship in my past incarnations, I have been born into this life. The Guru has inspired me to worship the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਈਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: bhagat bhagat karate har paaeaa jaa har har har har naam sameea |7|
English: Worshipping, worshipping Him with devotion, I found the Lord, and then I merged into the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har. ||7||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਣਿ ਆਣਿ ਮਹਿੰਦੀ ਪੀਸਾਈ ਆਪੇ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੋਲਿ ਅੰਗਿ ਲਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: prabh aan aan mahindee peesaaee aape ghol ghol ang leea |
English: God Himself came and ground the henna leaves into powder, and applied it to my body.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਬਾਹ ਪਕਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਢਿ ਲਈਆ ॥੮॥੬॥੨॥੧॥੬॥੯॥
Transliteration: jin kau tthaakur kirapaa dhaaree baah pakar naanak kadt leea |8|6|2|1|6|9|
English: Our Lord and Master showers His Mercy upon us, and grasps hold of our arms; O Nanak, He lifts us up and saves us. ||8||6||9||2||1||6||9||

[Ang 837 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ਘਰੁ ੧੨ ॥
Transliteration: raag bilaaval mahalaa 5 asattapadee ghar 12 |
English: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa, Twelfth House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਉਪਮਾ ਜਾਤ ਨ ਕਹੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਜਾਤ ਨ ਕਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: aupamaa jaat na kahee mere prabh kee upamaa jaat na kahee |
English: I cannot express the Praises of my God; I cannot express His Praises.

Gurbani: ਤਜਿ ਆਨ ਸਰਣਿ ਗਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: taj aan saran gahee |1| rahaau |
English: I have abandoned all others, seeking His Sanctuary. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: prabh charan kamal apaar |
English: God's Lotus Feet are Infinite.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਜਾਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: hau jaau sad balihaar |
English: I am forever a sacrifice to Them.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਤਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: man preet laagee taeh |
English: My mind is in love with Them.

Gurbani: ਤਜਿ ਆਨ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: taj aan kateh na jaeh |1|
English: If I were to abandon Them, there is nowhere else I could go. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਸਨਾ ਕਹਨ ॥
Transliteration: har naam rasanaa kehan |
English: I chant the Lord's Name with my tongue.

Gurbani: ਮਲ ਪਾਪ ਕਲਮਲ ਦਹਨ ॥
Transliteration: mal paap kalamal dehan |
English: The filth of my sins and evil mistakes is burnt off.

Gurbani: ਚੜਿ ਨਾਵ ਸੰਤ ਉਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: charr naav sant udhaar |
English: Climbing aboard the Boat of the Saints, I am emancipated.

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਤਰੇ ਸਾਗਰ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bhai tare saagar paar |2|
English: I have been carried across the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਡੋਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: man ddor prem pareet |
English: My mind is tied to the Lord with the string of love and devotion.

Gurbani: ਇਹ ਸੰਤ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: eih sant niramal reet |
English: This is the Immaculate Way of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਤਜਿ ਗਏ ਪਾਪ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: taj ge paap bikaar |
English: They forsake sin and corruption.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har mile prabh nirankaar |3|
English: They meet the Formless Lord God. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੇਖੀਐ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥
Transliteration: prabh pekheeai bisamaad |
English: Gazing upon God, I am wonderstruck.

Gurbani: ਚਖਿ ਅਨਦ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਾਦ ॥
Transliteration: chakh anad pooran saad |
English: I taste the Perfect Flavor of Bliss.

Gurbani: ਨਹ ਡੋਲੀਐ ਇਤ ਊਤ ॥
Transliteration: neh ddoleeai it aoot |
English: I do not waver or wander here or there.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚੀਤ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: prabh base har har cheet |4|
English: The Lord God, Har, Har, dwells within my consciousness. ||4||

Gurbani: ਤਿਨੑ ਨਾਹਿ ਨਰਕ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: tina naeh narak nivaas |
English: Those who constantly remember God,

Gurbani: ਨਿਤ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: nit simar prabh gunataas |
English: The treasure of virtue, will never go to hell.

Gurbani: ਤੇ ਜਮੁ ਨ ਪੇਖਹਿ ਨੈਨ ॥
Transliteration: te jam na pekheh nain |
English: Those who listen, fascinated, to the Unstruck Sound-Current of the Word,

Gurbani: ਸੁਨਿ ਮੋਹੇ ਅਨਹਤ ਬੈਨ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: sun mohe anahat bain |5|
English: Will never have to see the Messenger of Death with their eyes. ||5||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੂਰ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: har saran soor gupaal |
English: I seek the Sanctuary of the Lord, the Heroic Lord of the World.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਗਤ ਵਸਿ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
Transliteration: prabh bhagat vas deaal |
English: The Merciful Lord God is under the power of His devotees.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਗਮ ਲਹਹਿ ਨ ਭੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: har nigam laheh na bhev |
English: The Vedas do not know the Mystery of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਿਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸੇਵ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: nit kareh mun jan sev |6|
English: The silent sages constantly serve Him. ||6||

Gurbani: ਦੁਖ ਦੀਨ ਦਰਦ ਨਿਵਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: dukh deen darad nivaar |
English: He is the Destroyer of the pains and sorrows of the poor.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖੜੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kee mahaa bikharree kaar |
English: It is so very difficult to serve Him.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਮਿਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: taa kee mit na jaanai koe |
English: No one knows His limits.

Gurbani: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: jal thal maheeal soe |7|
English: He is pervading the water, the land and the sky. ||7||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਬੰਦਨਾ ਲਖ ਬਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: kar bandanaa lakh baar |
English: Hundreds of thousands of times, I humbly bow to Him.

Gurbani: ਥਕਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਬਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: thak pario prabh darabaar |
English: I have grown weary, and I have collapsed at God's Door.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਹੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: prabh karahu saadhoo dhoor |
English: O God, make me the dust of the feet of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰਿ ॥੮॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak manasaa poor |8|1|
English: Please fulfill this, Nanak's wish. ||8||1||

[Ang 837 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: prabh janam maran nivaar |
English: God, please release me from birth and death.

Gurbani: ਹਾਰਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਦੁਆਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: haar pario duaar |
English: I have grown weary, and collapsed at Your door.

Gurbani: ਗਹਿ ਚਰਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗ ॥
Transliteration: geh charan saadhoo sang |
English: I grasp Your Feet, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮਿਸਟ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ॥
Transliteration: man misatt har har rang |
English: The Love of the Lord, Har, Har, is sweet to my mind.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਲੇਹੁ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kar deaa lehu larr laae |
English: Be Merciful, and attach me to the hem of Your robe.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanakaa naam dhiaae |1|
English: Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਦਇਆਲ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
Transliteration: deenaa naath deaal mere suaamee deenaa naath deaal |
English: O Merciful Master of the meek, You are my Lord and Master, O Merciful Master of the meek.

Gurbani: ਜਾਚਉ ਸੰਤ ਰਵਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaachau sant ravaal |1| rahaau |
English: I yearn for the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕੂਪ ॥
Transliteration: sansaar bikhiaa koop |
English: The world is a pit of poison,

Gurbani: ਤਮ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਮੋਹਤ ਘੂਪ ॥
Transliteration: tam agiaan mohat ghoop |
English: filled with the utter darkness of ignorance and emotional attachment.

Gurbani: ਗਹਿ ਭੁਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਲੇਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: geh bhujaa prabh jee lehu |
English: Please take my hand, and save me, Dear God.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਦੇਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: har naam apunaa dehu |
English: Please bless me with Your Name, Lord.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਹੀ ਠਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: prabh tujh binaa nahee tthaau |
English: Without You, God, I have no place at all.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕਾ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanakaa bal bal jaau |2|
English: Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to You. ||2||

Gurbani: ਲੋਭਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਾਧੀ ਦੇਹ ॥
Transliteration: lobh mohi baadhee deh |
English: The human body is in the grip of greed and attachment.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਜਨ ਹੋਵਤ ਖੇਹ ॥
Transliteration: bin bhajan hovat kheh |
English: Without meditating and vibrating upon the Lord, it is reduced to ashes.

Gurbani: ਜਮਦੂਤ ਮਹਾ ਭਇਆਨ ॥
Transliteration: jamadoot mahaa bheaan |
English: The Messenger of Death is dreadful and horrible.

Gurbani: ਚਿਤ ਗੁਪਤ ਕਰਮਹਿ ਜਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: chit gupat karameh jaan |
English: The recording scribes of the conscious and the unconscious, Chitr and Gupt, know all actions and karma.

Gurbani: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਸਾਖਿ ਸੁਨਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: din rain saakh sunaae |
English: Day and night, they bear witness.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਨਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanakaa har saranaae |3|
English: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨਾ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: bhai bhanjanaa muraar |
English: O Lord, Destroyer of fear and egotism,

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: kar deaa patit udhaar |
English: be merciful, and save the sinners.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਦੋਖ ਗਨੇ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: mere dokh gane na jaeh |
English: My sins cannot even be counted.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨਾ ਕਤਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: har binaa kateh samaeh |
English: Without the Lord, who can hide them?

Gurbani: ਗਹਿ ਓਟ ਚਿਤਵੀ ਨਾਥ ॥
Transliteration: geh ott chitavee naath |
English: I thought of Your Support, and seized it, O my Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕਾ ਦੇ ਰਖੁ ਹਾਥ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanakaa de rakh haath |4|
English: Please, give Nanak Your hand and save him, Lord! ||4||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧੇ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: har gun nidhe gopaal |
English: The Lord, the treasure of virtue, the Lord of the world,

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਘਟ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: sarab ghatt pratipaal |
English: cherishes and and sustains every heart.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
Transliteration: man preet darasan piaas |
English: My mind is thirsty for Your Love, and the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

Gurbani: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸ ॥
Transliteration: gobind pooran aas |
English: O Lord of the Universe, please fulfill my hopes.

Gurbani: ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: eik nimakh rehan na jaae |
English: I cannot survive, even for an instant.

Gurbani: ਵਡ ਭਾਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: vadd bhaag naanak paae |5|
English: By great good fortune, Nanak has found the Lord. ||5||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਹੀ ਹੋਰ ॥
Transliteration: prabh tujh binaa nahee hor |
English: Without You, God, there is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਚੰਦ ਚਕੋਰ ॥
Transliteration: man preet chand chakor |
English: My mind loves You, as the partridge loves the moon,

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਮੀਨ ਜਲ ਸਿਉ ਹੇਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: jiau meen jal siau het |
English: as the fish loves the water,

Gurbani: ਅਲਿ ਕਮਲ ਭਿੰਨੁ ਨ ਭੇਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: al kamal bhin na bhet |
