English: as the bee and the lotus cannot be separated.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਚਕਵੀ ਸੂਰਜ ਆਸ ॥
Transliteration: jiau chakavee sooraj aas |
English: As the chakvi bird longs for the sun,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਰਨ ਪਿਆਸ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: naanak charan piaas |6|
English: so does Nanak thirst for the Lord's feet. ||6||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਤਰੁਨਿ ਭਰਤ ਪਰਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: jiau tarun bharat paraan |
English: As the young bride places the hopes of her life in her husband,

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਲੋਭੀਐ ਧਨੁ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: jiau lobheeai dhan daan |
English: as the greedy person looks upon the gift of wealth,

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਦੂਧ ਜਲਹਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: jiau doodh jaleh sanjog |
English: as milk is joined to water,

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਮਹਾ ਖੁਧਿਆਰਥ ਭੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: jiau mahaa khudhiaarath bhog |
English: as food is to the very hungry man,

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਮਾਤ ਪੂਤਹਿ ਹੇਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: jiau maat pooteh het |
English: and as the mother loves her son,

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨੇਤ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: har simar naanak net |7|
English: so does Nanak constantly remember the Lord in meditation. ||7||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਦੀਪ ਪਤਨ ਪਤੰਗ ॥
Transliteration: jiau deep patan patang |
English: As the moth falls into the lamp,

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਚੋਰੁ ਹਿਰਤ ਨਿਸੰਗ ॥
Transliteration: jiau chor hirat nisang |
English: as the thief steals without hesitation,

Gurbani: ਮੈਗਲਹਿ ਕਾਮੈ ਬੰਧੁ ॥
Transliteration: maigaleh kaamai bandh |
English: as the elephant is trapped by its sexual urges,

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਗ੍ਰਸਤ ਬਿਖਈ ਧੰਧੁ ॥
Transliteration: jiau grasat bikhee dhandh |
English: as the sinner is caught in his sins,

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਜੂਆਰ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jiau jooaar bisan na jaae |
English: as the gambler's addiction does not leave him,

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: har naanak ihu man laae |8|
English: so is this mind of Nanak's attached to the Lord. ||8||

Gurbani: ਕੁਰੰਕ ਨਾਦੈ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: kurank naadai nehu |
English: As the deer loves the sound of the bell,

Gurbani: ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕੁ ਚਾਹਤ ਮੇਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: chaatrik chaahat mehu |
English: and as the song-bird longs for the rain,

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਜੀਵਨਾ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: jan jeevanaa satasang |
English: the Lord's humble servant lives in the Society of the Saints,

Gurbani: ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਭਜਨਾ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: gobid bhajanaa rang |
English: lovingly meditating and vibrating upon the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਰਸਨਾ ਬਖਾਨੈ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: rasanaa bakhaanai naam |
English: My tongue chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸਨ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: naanak darasan daan |9|
English: Please bless Nanak with the gift of the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||9||

Gurbani: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਸੁਨਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਦੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: gun gaae sun likh dee |
English: One who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and hears them, and writes them,

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਰਬ ਫਲ ਹਰਿ ਲੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: so sarab fal har lee |
English: receives all fruits and rewards from the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕੁਲ ਸਮੂਹ ਕਰਤ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: kul samooh karat udhaar |
English: He saves all his ancestors and generations,

Gurbani: ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: sansaar utaras paar |
English: and crosses over the world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਤਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: har charan bohith taeh |
English: The Lord's Feet are the boat to carry him across.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: mil saadhasang jas gaeh |
English: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he sings the Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੈ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: har paij rakhai muraar |
English: The Lord protects his honor.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਦੁਆਰਿ ॥੧੦॥੨॥
Transliteration: har naanak saran duaar |10|2|
English: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord's door. ||10||2||

[Ang 838 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਥਿਤੀ ਘਰੁ ੧੦ ਜਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 1 thitee ghar 10 jat |
English: Bilaaval, First Mehl, T'hitee ~ The Lunar Days, Tenth House, To The Drum-Beat Jat:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਏਕਮ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: ekam ekankaar niraalaa |
English: The First Day: The One Universal Creator is unique,

Gurbani: ਅਮਰੁ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: amar ajonee jaat na jaalaa |
English: immortal, unborn, beyond social class or involvement.

Gurbani: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: agam agochar roop na rekhiaa |
English: He is inaccessible and unfathomable, with no form or feature.

Gurbani: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: khojat khojat ghatt ghatt dekhiaa |
English: Searching, searching, I have seen Him in each and every heart.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jo dekh dikhaavai tis kau bal jaaee |
English: I am a sacrifice to one who sees, and inspires others to see Him.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur parasaad param pad paaee |1|
English: By Guru's Grace, I have obtained the supreme status. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਗਦੀਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa jap jaapau bin jagadeesai |
English: Whose Name should I chant, and meditate on, except the Lord of the Universe?

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਘਰੁ ਦੀਸੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad mehal ghar deesai |1| rahaau |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is revealed within the home of one's own heart. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਲਗੇ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: doojai bhaae lage pachhutaane |
English: The Second Day: Those who are in love with another, come to regret and repent.

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਾਧੇ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: jam dar baadhe aavan jaane |
English: The are tied up at Death's door, and continue coming and going.

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਲੈ ਆਵਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਲੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa lai aaveh kiaa le jaeh |
English: What have they brought, and what will they take with them when they go?

Gurbani: ਸਿਰਿ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਸਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: sir jamakaal si chottaa khaeh |
English: The Messenger of Death looms over their heads, and they endure his beating.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਨ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin gurasabad na chhoottas koe |
English: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, no one finds release.

Gurbani: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਕੀਨੑੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: paakhandd keenai mukat na hoe |2|
English: Practicing hypocrisy, no one finds liberation. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਚੁ ਕੀਆ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ॥
Transliteration: aape sach keea kar jorr |
English: The True Lord Himself created the universe, joining the elements together.

Gurbani: ਅੰਡਜ ਫੋੜਿ ਜੋੜਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਿ ॥
Transliteration: anddaj forr jorr vichhorr |
English: Breaking the cosmic egg, He united, and separated.

Gurbani: ਧਰਤਿ ਅਕਾਸੁ ਕੀਏ ਬੈਸਣ ਕਉ ਥਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dharat akaas kee baisan kau thaau |
English: He made the earth and the sky into places to live.

Gurbani: ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਨੰਤੁ ਕੀਏ ਭਉ ਭਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raat dinant kee bhau bhaau |
English: He created day and night, fear and love.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਏ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jin kee kar vekhanahaaraa |
English: The One who created the Creation, also watches over it.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: avar na doojaa sirajanahaaraa |3|
English: There is no other Creator Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਤੀਆ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: triteea brahamaa bisan mahesaa |
English: The Third Day: He created Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva,

Gurbani: ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵ ਉਪਾਏ ਵੇਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: devee dev upaae vesaa |
English: the gods, goddesses and various manifestations.

Gurbani: ਜੋਤੀ ਜਾਤੀ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jotee jaatee ganat na aavai |
English: The lights and forms cannot be counted.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਜੀ ਸੋ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jin saajee so keemat paavai |
English: The One who fashioned them, knows their value.

Gurbani: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: keemat paae rahiaa bharapoor |
English: He evaluates them, and totally pervades them.

Gurbani: ਕਿਸੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖਾ ਦੂਰਿ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: kis nerrai kis aakhaa door |4|
English: Who is close, and who is far away? ||4||

Gurbani: ਚਉਥਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਚਾਰੇ ਬੇਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: chauth upaae chaare bedaa |
English: The Fourth Day: He created the four Vedas,

Gurbani: ਖਾਣੀ ਚਾਰੇ ਬਾਣੀ ਭੇਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: khaanee chaare baanee bhedaa |
English: the four sources of creation, and distinct forms of speech.

Gurbani: ਅਸਟ ਦਸਾ ਖਟੁ ਤੀਨਿ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: asatt dasaa khatt teen upaae |
English: He created the eighteen Puraanas, the six Shaastras and the three qualities.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: so boojhai jis aap bujhaae |
English: He alone understands, whom the Lord causes to understand.

Gurbani: ਤੀਨਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਚਉਥੈ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: teen samaavai chauthai vaasaa |
English: One who overcomes the three qualities, dwells in the fourth state.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਮ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: pranavat naanak ham taa ke daasaa |5|
English: Prays Nanak, I am his slave. ||5||

Gurbani: ਪੰਚਮੀ ਪੰਚ ਭੂਤ ਬੇਤਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: panchamee panch bhoot betaalaa |
English: The Fifth Day: The five elements are demons.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: aap agochar purakh niraalaa |
English: The Lord Himself is unfathomable and detached.

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੂਖੇ ਮੋਹ ਪਿਆਸੇ ॥
Transliteration: eik bhram bhookhe moh piaase |
English: Some are gripped by doubt, hunger, emotional attachment and desire.

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੇ ॥
Transliteration: eik ras chaakh sabad tripataase |
English: Some taste the sublime essence of the Shabad, and are satisfied.

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਇਕਿ ਮਰਿ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: eik rang raate ik mar dhoor |
English: Some are imbued with the Lord's Love, while some die, and are reduced to dust.

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਦੇਖਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: eik dar ghar saachai dekh hadoor |6|
English: Some attain the Court and the Mansion of the True Lord, and behold Him, ever-present. ||6||

Gurbani: ਝੂਠੇ ਕਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਤਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jhootthe kau naahee pat naau |
English: The false one has no honor or fame;

Gurbani: ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਸੂਚਾ ਕਾਲਾ ਕਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kabahu na soochaa kaalaa kaau |
English: like the black crow, he never becomes pure.

Gurbani: ਪਿੰਜਰਿ ਪੰਖੀ ਬੰਧਿਆ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: pinjar pankhee bandhiaa koe |
English: He is like the bird, imprisoned in a cage;

Gurbani: ਛੇਰੀਂ ਭਰਮੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: chhereen bharamai mukat na hoe |
English: he paces back and forth behind the bars, but he is not released.

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਛੂਟੈ ਜਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਛਡਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: tau chhoottai jaa khasam chhaddaae |
English: He alone is emancipated, whom the Lord and Master emancipates.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: guramat mele bhagat drirraae |7|
English: He follows the Guru's Teachings, and enshrines devotional worship. ||7||

Gurbani: ਖਸਟੀ ਖਟੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: khasattee khatt darasan prabh saaje |
English: The Sixth Day: God organized the six systems of Yoga.

Gurbani: ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ਵਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: anahad sabad niraalaa vaaje |
English: The unstruck sound current of the Shabad vibrates of itself.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: je prabh bhaavai taa mehal bulaavai |
English: If God wills it so, then one is summoned to the Mansion of His Presence.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੇ ਭੇਦੇ ਤਉ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: sabade bhede tau pat paavai |
English: One who is pierced through by the Shabad, obtains honor.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਸ ਖਪਹਿ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: kar kar ves khapeh jal jaaveh |
English: Those who wear religious robes burn, and are ruined.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: saachai saache saach samaaveh |8|
English: Through Truth, the truthful ones merge into the True Lord. ||8||

Gurbani: ਸਪਤਮੀ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸਰੀਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: sapatamee sat santokh sareer |
English: The Seventh Day: When the body is imbued with Truth and contentment,

Gurbani: ਸਾਤ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਭਰੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨੀਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: saat samund bhare niramal neer |
English: the seven seas within are filled with the Immaculate Water.

Gurbani: ਮਜਨੁ ਸੀਲੁ ਸਚੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: majan seel sach ridai veechaar |
English: Bathing in good conduct, and contemplating the True Lord within the heart,

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad paavai sabh paar |
English: one obtains the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and carries everyone across.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚਉ ਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man saachaa mukh saachau bhaae |
English: With the True Lord in the mind, and the True Lord lovingly on one's lips,

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੈ ਠਾਕ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: sach neesaanai tthaak na paae |9|
English: one is blessed with the banner of Truth, and meets with no obstructions. ||9||

Gurbani: ਅਸਟਮੀ ਅਸਟ ਸਿਧਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਾਧੈ ॥
Transliteration: asattamee asatt sidh budh saadhai |
English: The Eighth Day: The eight miraculous powers come when one subdues his own mind,

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੁ ਕਰਮਿ ਅਰਾਧੈ ॥
Transliteration: sach nihakeval karam araadhai |
English: and contemplates the True Lord through pure actions.

Gurbani: ਪਉਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਅਗਨੀ ਬਿਸਰਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: paun paanee aganee bisaraau |
English: Forget the three qualities of wind, water and fire,

Gurbani: ਤਹੀ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸਾਚੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tahee niranjan saacho naau |
English: and concentrate on the pure True Name.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਰਹਿਆ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: tis meh manooaa rahiaa liv laae |
English: That human who remains lovingly focused on the Lord,

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: pranavat naanak kaal na khaae |10|
English: prays Nanak, shall not be consumed by death. ||10||

Gurbani: ਨਾਉ ਨਉਮੀ ਨਵੇ ਨਾਥ ਨਵ ਖੰਡਾ ॥
Transliteration: naau naumee nave naath nav khanddaa |
English: The Ninth Day: The Name is the supreme almighty Master of the nine masters of Yoga,

Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਨਾਥੁ ਮਹਾ ਬਲਵੰਡਾ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt naath mahaa balavanddaa |
English: The nine realms of the earth, and each and every heart.

Gurbani: ਆਈ ਪੂਤਾ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aaee pootaa ihu jag saaraa |
English: This whole world is the child of Maya.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਆਦਿ ਰਖਵਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: prabh aades aad rakhavaaraa |
English: I bow in submission to God, my Protector from the very beginning of time.

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: aad jugaadee hai bhee hog |
English: He was in the beginning, He has been throughout the ages, He is now, and He shall always be.

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਕਰਣੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: ohu aparanpar karanai jog |11|
English: He is unlimited, and capable of doing everything. ||11||

Gurbani: ਦਸਮੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: dasamee naam daan isanaan |
English: The Tenth Day: Meditate on the Naam, give to charity, and purify yourself.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਮਜਨੁ ਸਚਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: anadin majan sachaa gun giaan |
English: Night and day, bathe in spiritual wisdom and the Glorious Virtues of the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਚਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: sach mail na laagai bhram bhau bhaagai |
English: Truth cannot be polluted; doubt and fear run away from it.

Gurbani: ਬਿਲਮੁ ਨ ਤੂਟਸਿ ਕਾਚੈ ਤਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: bilam na toottas kaachai taagai |
English: The flimsy thread breaks in an instant.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਤਾਗਾ ਜਗੁ ਏਵੈ ਜਾਣਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: jiau taagaa jag evai jaanahu |
English: Know that the world is just like this thread.

Gurbani: ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਚੀਤੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਹੁ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: asathir cheet saach rang maanahu |12|
English: Your consciousness shall become steady and stable, enjoying the Love of the True Lord. ||12||

Gurbani: ਏਕਾਦਸੀ ਇਕੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: ekaadasee ik ridai vasaavai |
English: The Eleventh Day: Enshrine the One Lord within your heart.

Gurbani: ਹਿੰਸਾ ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: hinsaa mamataa mohu chukaavai |
English: Eradicate cruelty, egotism and emotional attachment.

Gurbani: ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਬ੍ਰਤੁ ਆਤਮ ਚੀਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: fal paavai brat aatam cheenai |
English: Earn the fruitful rewards, by observing the fast of knowing your own self.

Gurbani: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਰਾਚਿ ਤਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਬੀਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: paakhandd raach tat nahee beenai |
English: One who is engrossed in hypocrisy, does not see the true essence.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਾਹਾਰੁ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: niramal niraahaar nihakeval |
English: The Lord is immaculate, self-sustaining and unattached.

Gurbani: ਸੂਚੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਮਲੁ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: soochai saache naa laagai mal |13|
English: The Pure, True Lord cannot be polluted. ||13||

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਹ ਏਕੋ ਏਕਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeh dekhau teh eko ekaa |
English: Wherever I look, I see the One Lord there.

Gurbani: ਹੋਰਿ ਜੀਅ ਉਪਾਏ ਵੇਕੋ ਵੇਕਾ ॥
Transliteration: hor jeea upaae veko vekaa |
English: He created the other beings, of many and various kinds.

Gurbani: ਫਲੋਹਾਰ ਕੀਏ ਫਲੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: falohaar kee fal jaae |
English: Eating only fruits, one loses the fruits of life.

Gurbani: ਰਸ ਕਸ ਖਾਏ ਸਾਦੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: ras kas khaae saad gavaae |
English: Eating only delicacies of various sorts, one loses the true taste.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜੈ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਲਪਟੈ ਲਪਟਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: koorrai laalach lapattai lapattaae |
English: In fraud and greed, people are engrossed and entangled.

Gurbani: ਛੂਟੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: chhoottai guramukh saach kamaae |14|
English: The Gurmukh is emancipated, practicing Truth. ||14||

Gurbani: ਦੁਆਦਸਿ ਮੁਦ੍ਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਅਉਧੂਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: duaadas mudraa man aaudhootaa |
English: The Twelfth Day: One whose mind is not attached to the twelve signs,

Gurbani: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਜਾਗਹਿ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਸੂਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: ahinis jaageh kabeh na sootaa |
English: remains awake day and night, and never sleeps.

Gurbani: ਜਾਗਤੁ ਜਾਗਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jaagat jaag rahai liv laae |
English: He remains awake and aware, lovingly centered on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਚੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur parachai tis kaal na khaae |
English: With faith in the Guru, he is not consumed by death.

Gurbani: ਅਤੀਤ ਭਏ ਮਾਰੇ ਬੈਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ateet bhe maare bairaaee |
English: Those who become detached, and conquer the five enemies

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਹ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: pranavat naanak teh liv laaee |15|
English: - prays Nanak, they are lovingly absorbed in the Lord. ||15||

Gurbani: ਦੁਆਦਸੀ ਦਇਆ ਦਾਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: duaadasee deaa daan kar jaanai |
English: The Twelfth Day: Know, and practice, compassion and charity.

Gurbani: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਾਤੋ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਆਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: baahar jaato bheetar aanai |
English: Bring your out-going mind back home.

Gurbani: ਬਰਤੀ ਬਰਤ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: baratee barat rahai nihakaam |
English: Observe the fast of remaining free of desire.

Gurbani: ਅਜਪਾ ਜਾਪੁ ਜਪੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: ajapaa jaap japai mukh naam |
English: Chant the unchanted Chant of the Naam with your mouth.

Gurbani: ਤੀਨਿ ਭਵਣ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: teen bhavan meh eko jaanai |
English: Know that the One Lord is contained in the three worlds.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਚਿ ਸੰਜਮ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: sabh such sanjam saach pachhaanai |16|
English: Purity and self-discipline are all contained in knowing the Truth. ||16||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਸਿ ਤਰਵਰ ਸਮੁਦ ਕਨਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: teras taravar samud kanaarai |
English: The Thirteenth Day: He is like a tree on the sea-shore.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮੂਲੁ ਸਿਖਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਤਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: amrit mool sikhar liv taarai |
English: But his roots can become immortal, if his mind is attuned to the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਡਰ ਡਰਿ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਬੂਡੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: ddar ddar marai na booddai koe |
English: Then, he will not die of fear or anxiety, and he will never drown.

Gurbani: ਨਿਡਰੁ ਬੂਡਿ ਮਰੈ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: niddar boodd marai pat khoe |
English: Without the Fear of God, he drowns and dies, and loses his honor.

Gurbani: ਡਰ ਮਹਿ ਘਰੁ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਡਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: ddar meh ghar ghar meh ddar jaanai |
English: With the Fear of God in his heart, and his heart in the Fear of God, he knows God.

Gurbani: ਤਖਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੈ ॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: takhat nivaas sach man bhaanai |17|
English: He sits on the throne, and becomes pleasing to the Mind of the True Lord. ||17||

Gurbani: ਚਉਦਸਿ ਚਉਥੇ ਥਾਵਹਿ ਲਹਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: chaudas chauthe thaaveh leh paavai |
English: The Fourteenth Day: One who enters into the fourth state,

Gurbani: ਰਾਜਸ ਤਾਮਸ ਸਤ ਕਾਲ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: raajas taamas sat kaal samaavai |
English: overcomes time, and the three qualities of raajas, taamas and satva.

Gurbani: ਸਸੀਅਰ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਸੂਰੁ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: saseear kai ghar soor samaavai |
English: Then the sun enters into the house of the moon,

Gurbani: ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jog jugat kee keemat paavai |
English: and one knows the value of the technology of Yoga.

Gurbani: ਚਉਦਸਿ ਭਵਨ ਪਾਤਾਲ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: chaudas bhavan paataal samaae |
English: He remains lovingly focused on God, who is permeating the fourteen worlds,

Gurbani: ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਰਹਿਆ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: khandd brahamandd rahiaa liv laae |18|
English: The nether regions of the underworld, the galaxies and solar systems. ||18||

Gurbani: ਅਮਾਵਸਿਆ ਚੰਦੁ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਗੈਣਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: amaavasiaa chand gupat gainaar |
English: Amaavas - The Night of the New Moon: The moon is hidden in the sky.

Gurbani: ਬੂਝਹੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: boojhahu giaanee sabad beechaar |
English: O wise one, understand and contemplate the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਸੀਅਰੁ ਗਗਨਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: saseear gagan jot tihu loee |
English: The moon in the sky illuminates the three worlds.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: kar kar vekhai karataa soee |
English: Creating the creation, the Creator beholds it.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: gur te deesai so tis hee maeh |
English: One who sees, through the Guru, merges into Him.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: manamukh bhoole aaveh jaeh |19|
English: The self-willed manmukhs are deluded, coming and going in reincarnation. ||19||

Gurbani: ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਥਾਪਿ ਥਿਰੁ ਥਾਨਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: ghar dar thaap thir thaan suhaavai |
English: One who establishes his home within his own heart, obtains the most beautiful, permanent place.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: aap pachhaanai jaa satigur paavai |
English: One comes to understand his own self, when he finds the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਆਸਾ ਤਹ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਬਿਨਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeh aasaa teh binas binaasaa |
English: Wherever there is hope, there is destruction and desolation.

Gurbani: ਫੂਟੈ ਖਪਰੁ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਨਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: foottai khapar dubidhaa manasaa |
English: The bowl of duality and selfishness breaks.

Gurbani: ਮਮਤਾ ਜਾਲ ਤੇ ਰਹੈ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: mamataa jaal te rahai udaasaa |
English: Prays Nanak, I am the slave of that one,

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਮ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੨੦॥੧॥
Transliteration: pranavat naanak ham taa ke daasaa |20|1|
English: Who remains detached amidst the traps of attachment. ||20||1||

[Ang 841 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਵਾਰ ਸਤ ਘਰੁ ੧੦ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 3 vaar sat ghar 10 |
English: Bilaaval, Third Mehl, The Seven Days, Tenth House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਆਦਿਤ ਵਾਰਿ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aadit vaar aad purakh hai soee |
English: Sunday: He, the Lord, is the Primal Being.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਵਰਤੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aape varatai avar na koee |
English: He Himself is the Pervading Lord; there is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਜਗੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਪਰੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: ot pot jag rahiaa paroee |
English: Through and through, He is woven into the fabric of the world.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aape karataa karai su hoee |
English: Whatever the Creator Himself does, that alone happens.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: naam rate sadaa sukh hoee |
English: Imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one is forever in peace.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: guramukh viralaa boojhai koee |1|
English: But how rare is the one, who, as Gurmukh, understands this. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਪਨੀ ਜਪਉ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: hiradai japanee jpau gunataasaa |
English: Within my heart, I chant the Chant of the Lord, the treasure of virtue.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਨ ਪਗਿ ਲਗਿ ਧਿਆਵਉ ਹੋਇ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har agam agochar aparanpar suaamee jan pag lag dhiaavau hoe daasan daasaa |1| rahaau |
English: The Lord, my Lord and Master, is inaccessible, unfathomable and unlimited. Grasping the feet of the Lord's humble servants, I meditate on Him, and become the slave of His slaves. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੋਮਵਾਰਿ ਸਚਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: somavaar sach rahiaa samaae |
English: Monday: The True Lord is permeating and pervading.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: tis kee keemat kahee na jaae |
English: His value cannot be described.

Gurbani: ਆਖਿ ਆਖਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਭਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aakh aakh rahe sabh liv laae |
English: Talking and speaking about Him, all keep themselves lovingly focused on Him.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jis devai tis palai paae |
English: Devotion falls into the laps of those whom He so blesses.

Gurbani: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਲਖਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: agam agochar lakhiaa na jaae |
English: He is inaccessible and unfathomable; He cannot be seen.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad har rahiaa samaae |2|
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord is seen to be permeating and pervading everywhere. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮੰਗਲਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: mangal maaeaa mohu upaaeaa |
English: Tuesday: The Lord created love and attachment to Maya.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aape sir sir dhandhai laaeaa |
English: He Himself has enjoined each and every being to their tasks.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
Transliteration: aap bujhaae soee boojhai |
English: He alone understands, whom the Lord causes to understand.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad dar ghar soojhai |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one understands his heart and home.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: prem bhagat kare liv laae |
English: He worships the Lord in loving devotion.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: haumai mamataa sabad jalaae |3|
English: His egotism and self-conceit are burnt away by the Shabad. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬੁਧਵਾਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: budhavaar aape budh saar |
English: Wednesday: He Himself bestows sublime understanding.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh karanee sabad veechaar |
English: The Gurmukh does good deeds, and contemplates the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: naam rate man niramal hoe |
English: Imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind become pure and immaculate.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਖੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: har gun gaavai haumai mal khoe |
English: He sings the Glorious Glorious Praises of the Lord, and washes off the filth of egotism.

Gurbani: ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਦ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: dar sachai sad sobhaa paae |
English: In the Court of the True Lord, he obtains lasting glory.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਏ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: naam rate gur sabad suhaae |4|
English: Imbued with the Naam, he is embellished with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||4||

Gurbani: ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਦੁਆਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: laahaa naam paae gur duaar |
English: The profit of the Naam is obtained through the Door of the Guru.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape devai devanahaar |
English: The Great Giver Himself gives it.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: jo devai tis kau bal jaaeeai |
English: I am a sacrifice to the One who gives it.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee aap gavaaeeai |
English: By Guru's Grace, self-conceit is eradicated.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖਹੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: naanak naam rakhahu ur dhaar |
English: O Nanak, enshrine the Naam within your heart.

Gurbani: ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੇ ਕਉ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: devanahaare kau jaikaar |5|
English: I celebrate the victory of the Lord, the Great Giver. ||5||

Gurbani: ਵੀਰਵਾਰਿ ਵੀਰ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: veeravaar veer bharam bhulaae |
English: Thursday: The fifty-two warriors were deluded by doubt.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਭੂਤ ਸਭਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: pret bhoot sabh doojai laae |
English: All the goblins and demons are attached to duality.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਵੇਕਾ ॥
Transliteration: aap upaae kar vekhai vekaa |
English: God Himself created them, and sees each one distinct.

Gurbani: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਰਤੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabhanaa karate teree ttekaa |
English: O Creator Lord, You are the Support of all.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jant teree saranaaee |
English: The beings and creatures are under Your protection.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਲੈਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: so milai jis laihi milaaee |6|
English: He alone meets You, whom You Yourself meet. ||6||

Gurbani: ਸੁਕ੍ਰਵਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sukravaar prabh rahiaa samaaee |
English: Friday: God is permeating and pervading everywhere.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਸਭ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aap upaae sabh keemat paaee |
English: He Himself created all, and appraises the value of all.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਕਰੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh hovai su karai beechaar |
English: One who become Gurmukh, contemplates the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਹੈ ਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: sach sanjam karanee hai kaar |
English: He practices truth and self-restraint.

Gurbani: ਵਰਤੁ ਨੇਮੁ ਨਿਤਾਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: varat nem nitaaprat poojaa |
English: Without genuine understanding, all fasts,

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਸਭੁ ਭਾਉ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: bin boojhe sabh bhaau hai doojaa |7|
English: Religious rituals and daily worship services lead only to the love of duality. ||7||

Gurbani: ਛਨਿਛਰਵਾਰਿ ਸਉਣ ਸਾਸਤ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: chhanichharavaar saun saasat beechaar |
English: Saturday: Contemplating good omens and the Shaastras,

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਭਰਮੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: haumai meraa bharamai sansaar |
English: in egotism and self-conceit, the world wanders in delusion.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅੰਧਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh andhaa doojai bhaae |
English: The blind, self-willed manmukh in engrossed in the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਾਧਾ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jam dar baadhaa chottaa khaae |
English: Bound and gagged at death's door, he is beaten and punished.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee sadaa sukh paae |
English: By Guru's Grace, one finds lasting peace.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਚਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: sach karanee saach liv laae |8|
English: He practices Truth, and lovingly focuses on the Truth. ||8||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: satigur seveh se vaddabhaagee |
English: Those who serve the True Guru are very fortunate.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਚਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: haumai maar sach liv laagee |
English: Conquering their ego, they embrace love for the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: terai rang raate sehaj subhaae |
English: They are automatically imbued with Your Love, O Lord.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਲੈਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: too sukhadaataa laihi milaae |
English: You are the Giver of peace; You merge them into Yourself.

Gurbani: ਏਕਸ ਤੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: ekas te doojaa naahee koe |
English: Everything comes from the One and only Lord; there is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਇ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: guramukh boojhai sojhee hoe |9|
English: The Gurmukh realizes this, and understands. ||9||

Gurbani: ਪੰਦ੍ਰਹ ਥਿਤਂੀ ਤੈ ਸਤ ਵਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: pandrah thitanee tai sat vaar |
English: The fifteen lunar days, the seven days of the week,

Gurbani: ਮਾਹਾ ਰੁਤੀ ਆਵਹਿ ਵਾਰ ਵਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: maahaa rutee aaveh vaar vaar |
English: the months, seasons, days and nights, come over and over again;

Gurbani: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਤਿਵੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: dinas rain tivai sansaar |
English: so the world goes on.

Gurbani: ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: aavaa gaun keea karataar |
English: Coming and going were created by the Creator Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਕਲ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: nihachal saach rahiaa kal dhaar |
English: The True Lord remains steady and stable, by His almighty power.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧੦॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh boojhai ko sabad veechaar |10|1|
English: O Nanak, how rare is that Gurmukh who understands, and contemplates the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||10||1||

[Ang 842 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 3 |
English: Bilaaval, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: aad purakh aape srisatt saaje |
English: The Primal Lord Himself formed the Universe.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਪਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jant maaeaa mohi paaje |
English: The beings and creatures are engrossed in emotional attachment to Maya.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਰਪੰਚਿ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: doojai bhaae parapanch laage |
English: In the love of duality, they are attached to the illusory material world.

Gurbani: ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਅਭਾਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: aaveh jaaveh mareh abhaage |
English: The unfortunate ones die, and continue to come and go.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਭੇਟਿਐ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur bhettiai sojhee paae |
English: Meeting with the True Guru, understanding is obtained.

Gurbani: ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਚੂਕੈ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: parapanch chookai sach samaae |1|
English: Then, the illusion of the material world is shattered, and one merges in Truth. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai masatak likhiaa lekh |
English: One who has such pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon his forehead

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: taa kai man vasiaa prabh ek |1| rahaau |
English: - the One God abides within his mind. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਆਪੇ ਸਭੁ ਵੇਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: srisatt upaae aape sabh vekhai |
English: He created the Universe, and He Himself beholds all.

Gurbani: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਲੇਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: koe na mettai terai lekhai |
English: No one can erase Your record, Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sidh saadhik je ko kahai kahaae |
English: If someone calls himself a Siddha or a seeker,

Gurbani: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: bharame bhoolaa aavai jaae |
English: he is deluded by doubt, and will continue coming and going.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sevai so jan boojhai |
English: That humble being alone understands, who serves the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਾ ਦਰੁ ਸੂਝੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: haumai maare taa dar soojhai |2|
English: Conquering his ego, he finds the Lord's Door. ||2||

Gurbani: ਏਕਸੁ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਹੂਆ ॥
Transliteration: ekas te sabh doojaa hooaa |
English: From the One Lord, all others were formed.

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਬੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: eko varatai avar na beea |
English: The One Lord is pervading everywhere; there is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੇ ਤੇ ਜੇ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: dooje te je eko jaanai |
English: Renouncing duality, one comes to know the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad har dar neesaanai |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one knows the Lord's Door, and His Banner.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਤਾ ਏਕੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: satigur bhette taa eko paae |
English: Meeting the True Guru, one finds the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਵਿਚਹੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: vichahu doojaa tthaak rahaae |3|
English: Duality is subdued within. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਡਾਢਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jis daa saahib ddaadtaa hoe |
English: One who belongs to the All-powerful Lord and Master

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਮਾਰਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: tis no maar na saakai koe |
English: no one can destroy him.

Gurbani: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਰਹੈ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: saahib kee sevak rahai saranaaee |
English: The Lord's servant remains under His protection;

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: aape bakhase de vaddiaaee |
English: The Lord Himself forgives him, and blesses him with glorious greatness.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: tis te aoopar naahee koe |
English: There is none higher than Him.

Gurbani: ਕਉਣੁ ਡਰੈ ਡਰੁ ਕਿਸ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: kaun ddarai ddar kis kaa hoe |4|
English: Why should he be afraid? What should he ever fear? ||4||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: guramatee saant vasai sareer |
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, peace and tranquility abide within the body.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੁ ਚੀਨਿੑ ਫਿਰਿ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਪੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: sabad cheena fir lagai na peer |
English: Remember the Word of the Shabad, and you shall never suffer pain.

Gurbani: ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਨਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aavai na jaae naa dukh paae |
English: You shall not have to come or go, or suffer in sorrow.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੇ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: naame raate sehaj samaae |
English: Imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, you shall merge in celestial peace.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh vekhai hadoor |
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh beholds Him ever-present, close at hand.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: meraa prabh sad rahiaa bharapoor |5|
English: My God is always fully pervading everywhere. ||5||

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਇਕਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: eik sevak ik bharam bhulaae |
English: Some are selfless servants, while others wander, deluded by doubt.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aape kare har aap karaae |
English: The Lord Himself does, and causes everything to be done.

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: eko varatai avar na koe |
English: The One Lord is all-pervading; there is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਰੋਸੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਜੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: man ros keejai je doojaa hoe |
English: The mortal might complain, if there were any other.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: satigur seve karanee saaree |
English: Serve the True Guru; this is the most excellent action.

Gurbani: ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: dar saachai saache veechaaree |6|
English: In the Court of the True Lord, you shall be judged true. ||6||

Gurbani: ਥਿਤੀ ਵਾਰ ਸਭਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: thitee vaar sabh sabad suhaae |
English: All the lunar days, and the days of the week are beautiful, when one contemplates the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: satigur seve taa fal paae |
English: If one serves the True Guru, he obtains the fruits of his rewards.

Gurbani: ਥਿਤੀ ਵਾਰ ਸਭਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: thitee vaar sabh aaveh jaeh |
English: The omens and days all come and go.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: gurasabad nihachal sadaa sach samaeh |
English: But the Word of the Guru's Shabad is eternal and unchanging. Through it, one merges in the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਥਿਤੀ ਵਾਰ ਤਾ ਜਾ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: thitee vaar taa jaa sach raate |
English: The days are auspicious, when one is imbued with Truth.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭਿ ਭਰਮਹਿ ਕਾਚੇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: bin naavai sabh bharameh kaache |7|
English: Without the Name, all the false ones wander deluded. ||7||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਰਹਿ ਮਰਿ ਬਿਗਤੀ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh mareh mar bigatee jaeh |
English: The self-willed manmukhs die, and dead, they fall into the most evil state.

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਲੋਭਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: ek na cheteh doojai lobhaeh |
English: They do not remember the One Lord; they are deluded by duality.

Gurbani: ਅਚੇਤ ਪਿੰਡੀ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: achet pinddee agiaan andhaar |
English: The human body is unconscious, ignorant and blind.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਏ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: bin sabadai kiau paae paar |
English: Without the Word of the Shabad, how can anyone cross over?

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਉਪਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: aap upaae upaavanahaar |
English: The Creator Himself creates.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: aape keeton gur veechaar |8|
English: He Himself contemplates the Guru's Word. ||8||

Gurbani: ਬਹੁਤੇ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਹਿ ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: bahute bhekh kareh bhekhadhaaree |
English: The religious fanatics wear all sorts of religious robes.

Gurbani: ਭਵਿ ਭਵਿ ਭਰਮਹਿ ਕਾਚੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: bhav bhav bharameh kaachee saaree |
English: They roll around and wander around, like the false dice on the board.

Gurbani: ਐਥੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਆਗੈ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aithai sukh na aagai hoe |
English: They find no peace, here or hereafter.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਏ ਅਪਣਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਖੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh mue apanaa janam khoe |
English: The self-willed manmukhs waste away their lives, and die.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: satigur seve bharam chukaae |
English: Serving the True Guru, doubt is driven away.

Gurbani: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: ghar hee andar sach mehal paae |9|
English: Deep within the home of the heart, one finds the Mansion of the True Lord's Presence. ||9||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aape pooraa kare su hoe |
English: Whatever the Perfect Lord does, that alone happens.

Gurbani: ਏਹਿ ਥਿਤੀ ਵਾਰ ਦੂਜਾ ਦੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: ehi thitee vaar doojaa doe |
English: Concern with these omens and days leads only to duality.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: satigur baajhahu andh gubaar |
English: Without the True Guru, there is only pitch darkness.

Gurbani: ਥਿਤੀ ਵਾਰ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਮੁਗਧ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: thitee vaar seveh mugadh gavaar |
English: Only idiots and fools worry about these omens and days.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh boojhai sojhee paae |
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh obtains understanding and realization;

Gurbani: ਇਕਤੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧੦॥੨॥
Transliteration: eikat naam sadaa rahiaa samaae |10|2|
English: he remains forever merged in the Name of the One Lord. ||10||2||

[Ang 843 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਛੰਤ ਦਖਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 1 chhant dakhanee |
English: Bilaaval, First Mehl, Chhant, Dakhnee:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਮੁੰਧ ਨਵੇਲੜੀਆ ਗੋਇਲਿ ਆਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: mundh navelarreea goeil aaee raam |
English: The young, innocent soul-bride has come to the pasture lands of the world.

Gurbani: ਮਟੁਕੀ ਡਾਰਿ ਧਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: mattukee ddaar dharee har liv laaee raam |
English: Laying aside her pitcher of worldly concern, she lovingly attunes herself to her Lord.

Gurbani: ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹੀ ਗੋਇਲਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: liv laae har siau rahee goeil sehaj sabad seegaareea |
English: She remains lovingly absorbed in the pasture of the Lord, automatically embellished with the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਿਆਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: kar jorr gur peh kar binantee milahu saach piaareea |
English: With her palms pressed together, she prays to the Guru, to unite her with her True Beloved Lord.

Gurbani: ਧਨ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: dhan bhaae bhagatee dekh preetam kaam krodh nivaariaa |
English: Seeing His bride's loving devotion, the Beloved Lord eradicates unfulfilled sexual desire and unresolved anger.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੁੰਧ ਨਵੇਲ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਸਾਧਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak mundh navel sundar dekh pir saadhaariaa |1|
English: O Nanak, the young, innocent bride is so beautiful; seeing her Husband Lord, she is comforted. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਚਿ ਨਵੇਲੜੀਏ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਬਾਲੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sach navelarree joban baalee raam |
English: Truthfully, O young soul-bride, your youth keeps you innocent.

Gurbani: ਆਉ ਨ ਜਾਉ ਕਹੀ ਅਪਨੇ ਸਹ ਨਾਲੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: aau na jaau kahee apane seh naalee raam |
English: Do not come and go anywhere; stay with your Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਹ ਅਪਨੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਦਾਸੀ ਮੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
Transliteration: naah apane sang daasee mai bhagat har kee bhaave |
English: I will stay with my Husband Lord; I am His hand-maiden. Devotional worship to the Lord is pleasing to me.

Gurbani: ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥੀਐ ਸਹਜਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਏ ॥
Transliteration: agaadh bodh akath katheeai sehaj prabh gun gaave |
English: I know the unknowable, and speak the unspoken; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Celestial Lord God.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਸਾਲ ਰਸੀਆ ਰਵੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਿਆਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam rasaal raseea ravai saach piaareea |
English: She who chants and savors the taste of the Lord's Name is loved by the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਦੀਆ ਦਾਨੁ ਕੀਆ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur sabad deea daan keea naanakaa veechaareea |2|
English: The Guru grants her the gift of the Shabad; O Nanak, she contemplates and reflects upon it. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਮੋਹਿਅੜੀ ਪਿਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੂਤੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sreedhar mohiarree pir sang sootee raam |
English: She who is fascinated by the Supreme Lord, sleeps with her Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਚਲੋ ਸਾਚਿ ਸੰਗੂਤੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai bhaae chalo saach sangootee raam |
English: She walks in harmony with the Guru's Will, attuned to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਧਨ ਸਾਚਿ ਸੰਗੂਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੂਤੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: dhan saach sangootee har sang sootee sang sakhee saheleea |
English: The soul-bride is attuned to the Truth, and sleeps with the Lord, along with her companions and sister soul-brides.

Gurbani: ਇਕ ਭਾਇ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹਮ ਮੇਲੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: eik bhaae ik man naam vasiaa satiguroo ham meleea |
English: Loving the One Lord, with one-pointed mind, the Naam dwells within; I am united with the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਚਸਾ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੋ ॥
Transliteration: din rain gharree na chasaa visarai saas saas niranjano |
English: Day and night, with each and every breath, I do not forget the Immaculate Lord, for a moment, even for an instant.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਾਇ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੋ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sabad jot jagaae deepak naanakaa bhau bhanjano |3|
English: So light the lamp of the Shabad, O Nanak, and burn away your fear. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਾਇੜੀਏ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: jot sabaaeirree tribhavan saare raam |
English: O soul-bride, the Lord's Light pervades all the three worlds.

Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt rav rahiaa alakh apaare raam |
English: He is pervading each and every heart, the Invisible and Infinite Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਆਪੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: alakh apaar apaar saachaa aap maar milaaeeai |
English: He is Invisible and Infinite, Infinite and True; subduing his self-conceit, one meets Him.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਲੋਭੁ ਜਾਲਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: haumai mamataa lobh jaalahu sabad mail chukaaeeai |
English: So burn away your egotistical pride, attachment and greed, with the Word of the Shabad; wash away your filth.

Gurbani: ਦਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਕਰੀ ਭਾਣੈ ਤਾਰਿ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: dar jaae darasan karee bhaanai taar taaranahaariaa |
English: When you go to the Lord's Door, you shall receive the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; by His Will, the Savior will carry you across and save you.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਚਾਖਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: har naam amrit chaakh tripatee naanakaa ur dhaariaa |4|1|
English: Tasting the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Name, the soul-bride is satisfied; O Nanak, she enshrines Him in her heart. ||4||1||

[Ang 843 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 1 |
English: Bilaaval, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਘਣਾ ਸਾਚਿ ਵਿਗਾਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: mai man chaau ghanaa saach vigaasee raam |
English: My mind is filled with such a great joy; I have blossomed forth in Truth.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: mohee prem pire prabh abinaasee raam |
English: I am enticed by the love of my Husband Lord, the Eternal, Imperishable Lord God.

Gurbani: ਅਵਿਗਤੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਥੁ ਨਾਥਹ ਤਿਸੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: avigato har naath naathah tisai bhaavai so theeai |
English: The Lord is everlasting, the Master of masters. Whatever He wills, happens.

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੀਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤੂੰ ਜੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: kirapaal sadaa deaal daataa jeea andar toon jeeai |
English: O Great Giver, You are always kind and compassionate. You infuse life into all living beings.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਪੂਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਿ ਰਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: mai avar giaan na dhiaan poojaa har naam antar vas rahe |
English: I have no other spiritual wisdom, meditation or worship; the Name of the Lord alone dwells deep within me.

Gurbani: ਭੇਖੁ ਭਵਨੀ ਹਠੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਚੁ ਗਹਿ ਰਹੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bhekh bhavanee hatth na jaanaa naanakaa sach geh rahe |1|
English: I know nothing about religious robes, pilgrimages or stubborn fanaticism; O Nanak, I hold tight to the Truth. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਿੰਨੜੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਭਲੀ ਦਿਨਸ ਸੁਹਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: bhinarree rain bhalee dinas suhaae raam |
English: The night is beautiful, drenched with dew, and the day is delightful,

Gurbani: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਸੂਤੜੀਏ ਪਿਰਮੁ ਜਗਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: nij ghar sootarree piram jagaae raam |
English: when her Husband Lord wakes the sleeping soul-bride, in the home of the self.

Gurbani: ਨਵ ਹਾਣਿ ਨਵ ਧਨ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਾਗੀ ਆਪਣੇ ਪਿਰ ਭਾਣੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: nav haan nav dhan sabad jaagee aapane pir bhaaneea |
English: The young bride has awakened to the Word of the Shabad; she is pleasing to her Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਜਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਲੋਕਾਣੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: taj koorr kapatt subhaau doojaa chaakaree lokaaneea |
English: So renounce falsehood, fraud, love of duality and working for people.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਹਾਰੁ ਕੰਠੇ ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: mai naam har kaa haar kantthe saach sabad neesaaniaa |
English: The Name of the Lord is my necklace, and I am anointed with the True Shabad.

Gurbani: ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kar jorr naanak saach maagai nadar kar tudh bhaaniaa |2|
English: With his palms pressed together, Nanak begs for the gift of the True Name; please, bless me with Your Grace, through the pleasure of Your Will. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਾਗੁ ਸਲੋਨੜੀਏ ਬੋਲੈ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: jaag salonarree bolai gurabaanee raam |
English: Awake, O bride of splendored eyes, and chant the Word of the Guru's Bani.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਨਿਅੜੀ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: jin sun maniarree akath kahaanee raam |
English: Listen, and place your faith in the Unspoken Speech of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝਏ ॥
Transliteration: akath kahaanee pad nirabaanee ko viralaa guramukh boojhe |
English: The Unspoken Speech, the state of Nirvaanaa - how rare is the Gurmukh who understands this.

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੋਝੀ ਸੂਝਏ ॥
Transliteration: ohu sabad samaae aap gavaae tribhavan sojhee soojhe |
English: Merging in the Word of the Shabad, self-conceit is eradicated, and the three worlds are revealed to her understanding.

Gurbani: ਰਹੈ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਾਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: rahai ateet aparanpar raataa saach man gun saariaa |
English: Remaining detached, with infinity infusing, the true mind cherishes the virtues of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬ ਠਾਈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ohu poor rahiaa sarab tthaaee naanakaa ur dhaariaa |3|
English: He is fully pervading and permeating all places; Nanak has enshrined Him within his heart. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਇੜੀਏ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਨੇਹੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: mehal bulaaeirree bhagat sanehee raam |
English: The Lord is calling you to the Mansion of His Presence; O soul-bride, He is the Lover of His devotees.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਰਹਸੀ ਸੀਝਸਿ ਦੇਹੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: guramat man rahasee seejhas dehee raam |
English: Following the Guru's Teachings, your mind shall be delighted, and your body shall be fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਰੀਝੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਝੈ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਲੋਕ ਨਾਥੁ ਪਛਾਣਏ ॥
Transliteration: man maar reejhai sabad seejhai trai lok naath pachhaane |
English: Conquer and subdue your mind, and love the Word of the Shabad; reform yourself, and realize the Lord of the three worlds.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਡੀਗਿ ਡੋਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਕਤ ਹੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਜਾਣਏ ॥
Transliteration: man ddeeg ddol na jaae kat hee aapanaa pir jaane |
English: Her mind shall not waver or wander anywhere else, when she comes to know her Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਖਸਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੈ ਤਾਣੁ ਤਕੀਆ ਤੇਰਓ ॥
Transliteration: mai aadhaar teraa too khasam meraa mai taan takeea tero |
English: You are my only Support, You are my Lord and Master. You are my strength and anchor.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਿ ਸੂਚਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਝਗਰੁ ਨਿਬੇਰਓ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: saach soochaa sadaa naanak gur sabad jhagar nibero |4|2|
English: She is forever truthful and pure, O Nanak; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, conflicts are resolved. ||4||2||

[Ang 844 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਛੰਤ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਮੰਗਲ ॥
Transliteration: chhant bilaaval mahalaa 4 mangal |
English: Chhant, Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl, Mangal ~ The Song Of Joy:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਜੈ ਆਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: meraa har prabh sejai aaeaa man sukh samaanaa raam |
English: My Lord God has come to my bed, and my mind is merged with the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਣਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: gur tutthai har prabh paaeaa rang raleea maanaa raam |
English: As it pleases the Guru, I have found the Lord God, and I revel and delight in His Love.

Gurbani: ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਮਾਣਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: vaddabhaageea sohaaganee har masatak maanaa raam |
English: Very fortunate are those happy soul-brides, who have the jewel of the Naam upon their foreheads.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har prabh har sohaag hai naanak man bhaanaa raam |1|
English: The Lord, the Lord God, is Nanak's Husband Lord, pleasing to his mind. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਮਾਣਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: ninmaaniaa har maan hai har prabh har aapai raam |
English: The Lord is the honor of the dishonored. The Lord, the Lord God is Himself by Himself.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh aap gavaaeaa nit har har jaapai raam |
English: The Gurmukh eradicates self-conceit, and constantly chants the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਪੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: mere har prabh bhaavai so karai har rang har raapai raam |
English: My Lord God does whatever He pleases; the Lord imbues mortal beings with the color of His Love.

Gurbani: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੈ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jan naanak sehaj milaaeaa har ras har dhraapai raam |2|
English: Servant Nanak is easily merged into the Celestial Lord. He is satisfied with the sublime essence of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਵਣ ਵੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: maanas janam har paaeeai har raavan veraa raam |
English: The Lord is found only through this human incarnation. This is the time to contemplate the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਹੋਇ ਘਣੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh mil sohaaganee rang hoe ghaneraa raam |
English: As Gurmukhs, the happy soul-brides meet Him, and their love for Him is abundant.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਭਾਗੁ ਮੰਦੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: jin maanas janam na paaeaa tina bhaag manderaa raam |
English: Those who have not attained human incarnation, are cursed by evil destiny.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har har har har raakh prabh naanak jan teraa raam |3|
English: O Lord, God, Har, Har, Har, Har, save Nanak; he is Your humble servant. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਭੀਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: gur har prabh agam drirraaeaa man tan rang bheenaa raam |
English: The Guru has implanted within me the Name of the Inaccessible Lord God; my mind and body are drenched with the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਲੀਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat vachhal har naam hai guramukh har leenaa raam |
English: The Name of the Lord is the Lover of His devotees; the Gurmukhs attain the Lord.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਜੀਵਦੇ ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੀਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: bin har naam na jeevade jiau jal bin meenaa raam |
English: Without the Name of the Lord, they cannot even live, like the fish without water.

Gurbani: ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
Transliteration: safal janam har paaeaa naanak prabh keenaa raam |4|1|3|
English: Finding the Lord, my life has become fruitful; O Nanak, the Lord God has fulfilled me. ||4||1||3||

[Ang 845 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 4 salok |
English: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl, Salok:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਲੋੜਿ ਲਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: har prabh sajan lorr lahu man vasai vaddabhaag |
English: Seek out the Lord God, your only true Friend. He shall dwell in your mind, by great good fortune.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਵੇਖਾਲਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur poorai vekhaaliaa naanak har liv laag |1|
English: The True Guru shall reveal Him to you; O Nanak, lovingly focus yourself on the Lord. ||1||

[Ang 845 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਛੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: chhant |
English: Chhant:

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਵਣਿ ਆਈਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਝਾਗੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: meraa har prabh raavan aaeea haumai bikh jhaage raam |
English: The soul-bride has come to ravish and enjoy her Lord God, after eradicating the poison of egotism.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: guramat aap mittaaeaa har har liv laage raam |
English: Following the Guru's Teachings, she has eliminated her self-conceit; she is lovingly attuned to her Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਾਗੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: antar kamal paragaasiaa gur giaanee jaage raam |
English: Her heart-lotus deep within has blossomed forth, and through the Guru, spiritual wisdom has been awakened within her.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪੂਰੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੇ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak har prabh paaeaa poorai vaddabhaage raam |1|
English: Servant Nanak has found the Lord God, by perfect, great good fortune. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਧਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: har prabh har man bhaaeaa har naam vadhaaee raam |
English: The Lord, the Lord God, is pleasing to her mind; the Lord's Name resounds within her.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: gur poorai prabh paaeaa har har liv laaee raam |
English: Through the Perfect Guru, God is obtained; she is lovingly focused on the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਕਟਿਆ ਜੋਤਿ ਪਰਗਟਿਆਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: agiaan andheraa kattiaa jot paragattiaaee raam |
English: The darkness of ignorance is dispelled, and the Divine Light radiantly shines forth.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jan naanak naam adhaar hai har naam samaaee raam |2|
English: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is Nanak's only Support; he merges into the Lord's Name. ||2||

Gurbani: ਧਨ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪਿਆਰੈ ਰਾਵੀਆ ਜਾਂ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: dhan har prabh piaarai raaveea jaan har prabh bhaaee raam |
English: The soul-bride is ravished and enjoyed by her Beloved Lord God, when the Lord God is pleased with her.

Gurbani: ਅਖੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕਸਾਈਆ ਜਿਉ ਬਿਲਕ ਮਸਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: akhee prem kasaaeea jiau bilak masaaee raam |
English: My eyes are drawn to His Love, like the cat to the mouse.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਆਘਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: gur poorai har meliaa har ras aaghaaee raam |
English: The Perfect Guru has united me with the Lord; I am satisfied by the subtle essence of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਿਗਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jan naanak naam vigasiaa har har liv laaee raam |3|
English: Servant Nanak blossoms forth in the Naam, the Name of the Lord; he is lovingly attuned to the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: ham moorakh mugadh milaaeaa har kirapaa dhaaree raam |
English: I am a fool and an idiot, but the Lord showered me with His Mercy, and united me with Himself.

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan guroo saabaas hai jin haumai maaree raam |
English: Blessed, blessed is the most wonderful Guru, who has conquered egotism.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: jina vaddabhaageea vaddabhaag hai har har ur dhaaree raam |
English: Very fortunate, of blessed destiny are those, who enshrine the Lord, Har, Har, in their hearts.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਤੂ ਨਾਮੇ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੨॥੪॥
Transliteration: jan naanak naam salaeh too naame balihaaree raam |4|2|4|
English: O servant Nanak, praise the Naam, and be a sacrifice to the Naam. ||4||2||4||

[Ang 845 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 chhant |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Chhant:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਮੰਗਲ ਸਾਜੁ ਭਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਗਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: mangal saaj bheaa prabh apanaa gaaeaa raam |
English: The time of rejoicing has come; I sing of my Lord God.

Gurbani: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਵਰੁ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਚਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: abinaasee var suniaa man upajiaa chaaeaa raam |
English: I have heard of my Imperishable Husband Lord, and happiness fills my mind.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗੈ ਕਬ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: man preet laagai vaddai bhaagai kab mileeai pooran pate |
English: My mind is in love with Him; when shall I realize my great good fortune, and meet with my Perfect Husband?

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਸਮਾਈਐ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਦੇਹੁ ਸਖੀਏ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: sahaje samaaeeai govind paaeeai dehu sakhee mohi mate |
English: If only I could meet the Lord of the Universe, and be automatically absorbed into Him; tell me how, O my companions!

Gurbani: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਠਾਢੀ ਕਰਉ ਸੇਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਵਨ ਜੁਗਤੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: din rain tthaadtee krau sevaa prabh kavan jugatee paaeaa |
English: Day and night, I stand and serve my God; how can I attain Him?

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੈਹੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak karahu kirapaa laihu mohi larr laaeaa |1|
English: Prays Nanak, have mercy on me, and attach me to the hem of Your robe, O Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਇਆ ਸਮਾਹੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਵਿਸਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: bheaa samaaharraa har ratan visaahaa raam |
English: Joy has come! I have purchased the jewel of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਖੋਜੀ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਧਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਪਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: khojee khoj ladhaa har santan paahaa raam |
English: Searching, the seeker has found the Lord with the Saints.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲੇ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰੇ ਕਥਹਿ ਅਕਥ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: mile sant piaare deaa dhaare katheh akath beechaaro |
English: I have met the Beloved Saints, and they have blessed me with their kindness; I contemplate the Unspoken Speech of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਇਕ ਚਿਤਿ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਲਾਇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: eik chit ik man dhiaae suaamee laae preet piaaro |
English: With my consciousness centered, and my mind one-pointed, I meditate on my Lord and Master, with love and affection.

Gurbani: ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: kar jorr prabh peh kar binantee milai har jas laahaa |
English: With my palms pressed together, I pray unto God, to bless me with the profit of the Lord's Praise.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak daas teraa meraa prabh agam athaahaa |2|
English: Prays Nanak, I am Your slave. My God is inaccessible and unfathomable. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਾਹਾ ਅਟਲੁ ਗਣਿਆ ਪੂਰਨ ਸੰਜੋਗੋ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: saahaa attal ganiaa pooran sanjogo raam |
English: The date for my wedding is set, and cannot be changed; my union with the Lord is perfect.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖਹ ਸਮੂਹ ਭਇਆ ਗਇਆ ਵਿਜੋਗੋ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sukhah samooh bheaa geaa vijogo raam |
English: I am totally at peace, and my separation from Him has ended.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤ ਆਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਿਆਏ ਬਣੇ ਅਚਰਜ ਜਾਞੀਆਂ ॥
Transliteration: mil sant aae prabh dhiaae bane acharaj jaayeean |
English: The Saints meet and come together, and meditate on God; they form a wondrous wedding party.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਹੋਏ ਸਹਜਿ ਢੋਏ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਉਪਜੀ ਮਾਞੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: mil ikatr hoe sehaj dtoe man preet upajee maayeea |
English: Gathering together, they arrive with poise and grace, and love fills the minds of the bride's family.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗੋ ॥
Transliteration: mil jot jotee ot potee har naam sabh ras bhogo |
English: Her light blends with His Light, through and through, and everyone enjoys the Nectar of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭ ਸੰਤਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਜੋਗੋ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak sabh sant melee prabh karan kaaran jogo |3|
English: Prays Nanak, the Saints have totally united me with God, the All-powerful Cause of causes. ||3||

Gurbani: ਭਵਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵੜਾ ਧਰਤਿ ਸਭਾਗੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: bhavan suhaavarraa dharat sabhaagee raam |
English: Beautiful is my home, and beauteous is the earth.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਅੜਾ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: prabh ghar aaeiarraa gur charanee laagee raam |
English: God has entered the home of my heart; I touch the Guru's feet.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਲਾਗੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਜਾਗੀ ਸਗਲ ਇਛਾ ਪੁੰਨੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur charan laagee sehaj jaagee sagal ichhaa puneea |
English: Grasping the Guru's feet, I awake in peace and poise. All my desires are fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੀ ਆਸ ਪੂਰੀ ਸੰਤ ਧੂਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਕੰਤ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: meree aas pooree sant dhooree har mile kant vichhuniaa |
English: My hopes are fulfilled, through the dust of the feet of the Saints. After such a long separation, I have met my Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਨੰਦ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਵਜਹਿ ਵਾਜੇ ਅਹੰ ਮਤਿ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: aanand anadin vajeh vaaje ahan mat man kee tiaagee |
English: Night and day, the sounds of ecstasy resound and resonate; I have forsaken my stubborn-minded intellect.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak saran suaamee santasang liv laagee |4|1|
English: Prays Nanak, I seek the Sanctuary of my Lord and Master; in the Society of the Saints, I am lovingly attuned to Him. ||4||1||

[Ang 846 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਭਾਗ ਸੁਲਖਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਤੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: bhaag sulakhanaa har kant hamaaraa raam |
English: By blessed destiny, I have found my Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਜਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਧੁਨਿ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: anahad baajitraa tis dhun darabaaraa raam |
English: The unstruck sound current vibrates and resounds in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਨੰਦ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਵਜਹਿ ਵਾਜੇ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਉਮਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: aanand anadin vajeh vaaje dinas rain umaahaa |
English: Night and day, the sounds of ecstasy resound and resonate; day and night, I am enraptured.

Gurbani: ਤਹ ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਨ ਦੂਖੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਤਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: teh rog sog na dookh biaapai janam maran na taahaa |
English: Disease, sorrow and suffering do not afflict anyone there; there is no birth or death there.

Gurbani: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਸੁਧਾ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: ridh sidh sudhaa ras amrit bhagat bhare bhanddaaraa |
English: There are treasures overflowing there - wealth, miraculous powers, ambrosial nectar and devotional worship.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿ ਵੰਞਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak balihaar vanyaa paarabraham praan adhaaraa |1|
English: Prays Nanak, I am a sacrifice, devoted to the Supreme Lord God, the Support of the breath of life. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਖੀਅ ਸਹੇਲੜੀਹੋ ਮਿਲਿ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਵਹ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sun sakheea sahelarreeho mil mangal gaavah raam |
English: Listen, O my companions, and sister soul-brides, let's join together and sing the songs of joy.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਰਾਵਹ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: man tan prem kare tis prabh kau raavah raam |
English: Loving our God with mind and body, let's ravish and enjoy Him.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਰਾਵਹ ਤਿਸੈ ਭਾਵਹ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਪਲਕ ਨ ਤਿਆਗੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: kar prem raavah tisai bhaavah ik nimakh palak na tiaageeai |
English: Lovingly enjoying Him, we become pleasing to Him; let's not reject Him, for a moment, even for an instant.

Gurbani: ਗਹਿ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਈਐ ਨਹ ਲਜਾਈਐ ਚਰਨ ਰਜ ਮਨੁ ਪਾਗੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: geh kantth laaeeai neh lajaaeeai charan raj man paageeai |
English: Let's hug Him close in our embrace, and not feel shy; let's bathe our minds in the dust of His feet.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਪਾਇ ਮੋਹਹ ਅਨਤ ਕਤਹੂ ਨ ਧਾਵਹ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat tthgauree paae mohah anat katahoo na dhaavah |
English: With the intoxicating drug of devotional worship, let's entice Him, and not wander anywhere else.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਅਮਰ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਵਹ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak mil sang saajan amar padavee paavah |2|
English: Prays Nanak, meeting with our True Friend, we attain the immortal status. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬਿਸਮਨ ਬਿਸਮ ਭਈ ਪੇਖਿ ਗੁਣ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: bisaman bisam bhee pekh gun abinaasee raam |
English: I am wonder-struck and amazed, gazing upon the Glories of my Imperishable Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਭੁਜਾ ਗਹੀ ਕਟਿ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: kar geh bhujaa gahee katt jam kee faasee raam |
English: He took my hand, and held my arm, and cut away the noose of Death.

Gurbani: ਗਹਿ ਭੁਜਾ ਲੀਨੑੀ ਦਾਸਿ ਕੀਨੑੀ ਅੰਕੁਰਿ ਉਦੋਤੁ ਜਣਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: geh bhujaa leenaee daas keenaee ankur udot janaaeaa |
English: Holding me by the arm, He made me His slave; the branch has sprouted in abundance.

Gurbani: ਮਲਨ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਨਾਠੇ ਦਿਵਸ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: malan moh bikaar naatthe divas niramal aaeaa |
English: Pollution, attachment and corruption have run away; the immaculate day has dawned.

Gurbani: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਮਨਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: drisatt dhaaree man piaaree mahaa duramat naasee |
English: Casting His Glance of Grace, the Lord loves me with His Mind; my immense evil-mindedness is dispelled.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਈ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲੇ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak bhee niramal prabh mile abinaasee |3|
English: Prays Nanak, I have become immaculate and pure; I have met the Imperishable Lord God. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੂਰਜ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਜਲ ਕਾ ਜਲੁ ਹੂਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sooraj kiran mile jal kaa jal hooaa raam |
English: The rays of light merge with the sun, and water merges with water.

Gurbani: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਲੀ ਸੰਪੂਰਨੁ ਥੀਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: jotee jot ralee sanpooran theea raam |
English: One's light blends with the Light, and one becomes totally perfect.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਦੀਸੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਏਕੁ ਏਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: braham deesai braham suneeai ek ek vakhaaneeai |
English: I see God, hear God, and speak of the One and only God.

Gurbani: ਆਤਮ ਪਸਾਰਾ ਕਰਣਹਾਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: aatam pasaaraa karanahaaraa prabh binaa nahee jaaneeai |
English: The soul is the Creator of the expanse of creation. Without God, I know no other at all.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: aap karataa aap bhugataa aap kaaran keea |
English: He Himself is the Creator, and He Himself is the Enjoyer. He created the Creation.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਈ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak seee jaaneh jinaee har ras peea |4|2|
English: Prays Nanak, they alone know this, who drink in the subtle essence of the Lord. ||4||2||

[Ang 847 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 chhant |
English: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl, Chhant:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸਖੀ ਆਉ ਸਖੀ ਵਸਿ ਆਉ ਸਖੀ ਅਸੀ ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਵਹ ॥
Transliteration: sakhee aau sakhee vas aau sakhee asee pir kaa mangal gaavah |
English: Come, O my sisters, come, O my companions, and let us remain under the Lord's control. Let's sing the Songs of Bliss of our Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਸਖੀ ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਸਖੀ ਮਤੁ ਆਪਣੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਭਾਵਹ ॥
Transliteration: taj maan sakhee taj maan sakhee mat aapane preetam bhaavah |
English: Renounce your pride, O my companions, renounce your egotistical pride, O my sisters, so that you may become pleasing to your Beloved.

Gurbani: ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਿਕਾਰੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਸੇਵਿ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੋ ॥
Transliteration: taj maan mohu bikaar doojaa sev ek niranjano |
English: Renounce pride, emotional attachment, corruption and duality, and serve the One Immaculate Lord.

Gurbani: ਲਗੁ ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਗਲ ਦੁਰਤ ਬਿਖੰਡਨੋ ॥
Transliteration: lag charan saran deaal preetam sagal durat bikhanddano |
English: Hold tight to the Sanctuary of the Feet of the Merciful Lord, your Beloved, the Destroyer of all sins.

Gurbani: ਹੋਇ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸੀ ਤਜਿ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਬਿਧੀ ਨ ਧਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: hoe daas daasee taj udaasee bahurr bidhee na dhaavaa |
English: Be the slave of His slaves, forsake sorrow and sadness, and do not bother with other devices.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤਾਮਿ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਵਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak peianpai karahu kirapaa taam mangal gaavaa |1|
English: Prays Nanak, O Lord, please bless me with Your Mercy, that I may sing Your songs of bliss. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੈ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਟੋਹਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: amrit pria kaa naam mai andhule ttohanee |
English: The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of my Beloved, is like a cane to a blind man.

Gurbani: ਓਹ ਜੋਹੈ ਬਹੁ ਪਰਕਾਰ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਮੋਹਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: oeh johai bahu parakaar sundar mohanee |
English: Maya seduces in so many ways, like a beautiful enticing woman.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਨੀ ਮਹਾ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰਿ ਚੰਚਲਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਵ ਦਿਖਾਵਏ ॥
Transliteration: mohanee mahaa bachitr chanchal anik bhaav dikhaave |
English: This enticer is so incredibly beautiful and clever; she entices with countless suggestive gestures.

Gurbani: ਹੋਇ ਢੀਠ ਮੀਠੀ ਮਨਹਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਣ ਨ ਆਵਏ ॥
Transliteration: hoe dteetth meetthee maneh laagai naam lain na aave |
English: Maya is stubborn and persistent; she seems so sweet to the mind, and then he does not chant the Naam.

Gurbani: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਬਨਹਿ ਤੀਰੈ ਬਰਤ ਪੂਜਾ ਬਾਟ ਘਾਟੈ ਜੋਹਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: grih baneh teerai barat poojaa baatt ghaattai johanee |
English: At home, in the forest, on the banks of sacred rivers, fasting, worshipping, on the roads and on the shore, she is spying.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਮੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਟੋਹਨੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak peianpai deaa dhaarahu mai naam andhule ttohanee |2|
English: Prays Nanak, please bless me with Your Kindness, Lord; I am blind, and Your Name is my cane. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਅਨਾਥ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਨਾਥ ਜਿਉ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਰਖਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: mohi anaath pria naath jiau jaanahu tiau rakhahu |
English: I am helpless and masterless; You, O my Beloved, are my Lord and Master. As it pleases You, so do You protect me.

Gurbani: ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਾਹਿ ਰੀਝਾਵਉ ਕਹਿ ਮੁਖਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: chaturaaee mohi naeh reejhaavau keh mukhahu |
English: I have no wisdom or cleverness; what face should I put on to please You?

Gurbani: ਨਹ ਚਤੁਰਿ ਸੁਘਰਿ ਸੁਜਾਨ ਬੇਤੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨਿ ਗੁਨੁ ਨਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: neh chatur sughar sujaan betee mohi niragun gun nahee |
English: I am not clever, skillful or wise; I am worthless, without any virtue at all.

Gurbani: ਨਹ ਰੂਪ ਧੂਪ ਨ ਨੈਣ ਬੰਕੇ ਜਹ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਹ ਰਖੁ ਤੁਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: neh roop dhoop na nain banke jeh bhaavai teh rakh tuhee |
English: I have no beauty or pleasing smell, no beautiful eyes. As it pleases You, please preserve me, O Lord.

Gurbani: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਜਇਅੰਪਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕਰੁਣਾਪਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਕਿਨਿ ਲਖਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: jai jai jeianpeh sagal jaa kau karunaapat gat kin lakhahu |
English: His victory is celebrated by all; how can I know the state of the Lord of Mercy?

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਸੇਵ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜਿਉ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਮੋਹਿ ਰਖਹੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak peianpai sev sevak jiau jaanahu tiau mohi rakhahu |3|
English: Prays Nanak, I am the servant of Your servants; as it pleases You, please preserve me. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਤੁਮ ਨੀਰ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਸਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: mohi machhulee tum neer tujh bin kiau sarai |
English: I am the fish, and You are the water; without You, what can I do?

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਤੁਮੑ ਬੂੰਦ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਉ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: mohi chaatrik tuma boond triptau mukh parai |
English: I am the rainbird, and You are the rain-drop; when it falls into my mouth, I am satisfied.

Gurbani: ਮੁਖਿ ਪਰੈ ਹਰੈ ਪਿਆਸ ਮੇਰੀ ਜੀਅ ਹੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: mukh parai harai piaas meree jeea heea praanapate |
English: When it falls into my mouth, my thirst is quenched; You are the Lord of my soul, my heart, my breath of life.

Gurbani: ਲਾਡਿਲੇ ਲਾਡ ਲਡਾਇ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਮਿਲੁ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਹੋਇ ਗਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: laaddile laadd laddaae sabh meh mil hamaaree hoe gate |
English: Touch me, and caress me, O Lord, You are in all; let me meet You, so that I may be emancipated.

Gurbani: ਚੀਤਿ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਮਿਟੁ ਅੰਧਾਰੇ ਜਿਉ ਆਸ ਚਕਵੀ ਦਿਨੁ ਚਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: cheet chitvau mitt andhaare jiau aas chakavee din charai |
English: In my consciousness I remember You, and the darkness is dispelled, like the chakvi duck, which longs to see the dawn.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਨੀਰੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak peianpai pria sang melee machhulee neer na veesarai |4|
English: Prays Nanak, O my Beloved, please unite me with Yourself; the fish never forgets the water. ||4||

Gurbani: ਧਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਭਾਗ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਪਿਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan hamaare bhaag ghar aaeaa pir meraa |
English: Blessed, blessed is my destiny; my Husband Lord has come into my home.

Gurbani: ਸੋਹੇ ਬੰਕ ਦੁਆਰ ਸਗਲਾ ਬਨੁ ਹਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sohe bank duaar sagalaa ban haraa |
English: The gate of my mansion is so beautiful, and all my gardens are so green and alive.

Gurbani: ਹਰ ਹਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਖਹ ਗਾਮੀ ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਰਸੁ ਘਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: har haraa suaamee sukhah gaamee anad mangal ras ghanaa |
English: My peace-giving Lord and Master has rejuvenated me, and blessed me with great joy, bliss and love.

Gurbani: ਨਵਲ ਨਵਤਨ ਨਾਹੁ ਬਾਲਾ ਕਵਨ ਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਨ ਭਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: naval navatan naahu baalaa kavan rasanaa gun bhanaa |
English: My Young Husband Lord is eternally young, and His body is forever youthful; what tongue can I use to chant His Glorious Praises?

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੀ ਸੇਜ ਸੋਹੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਮੋਹੀ ਸਗਲ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: meree sej sohee dekh mohee sagal sahasaa dukh haraa |
English: My bed is beautiful; gazing upon Him, I am fascinated, and all my doubts and pains are dispelled.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਆਸ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਾ ॥੫॥੧॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak peianpai meree aas pooree mile suaamee aparanparaa |5|1|3|
English: Prays Nanak, my hopes are fulfilled; my Lord and Master is unlimited. ||5||1||3||

[Ang 847 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ਮੰਗਲ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 chhant mangal |
