Transliteration: maanau sabh sukh nau nidh taa kai sehaj sehaj jas bolai dev | rahaau |
English: I know that all comforts, and the nine treasures, come to one who intuitively, naturally, chants the Praise of the Divine Lord. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਜਉ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਪੇਖੈ ਕੁਟਿਲ ਗਾਂਠਿ ਜਬ ਖੋਲੈ ਦੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: tab ih mat jau sabh meh pekhai kuttil gaantth jab kholai dev |
English: Such wisdom comes, only when one sees the Lord in all, and unties the knot of hypocrisy.

Gurbani: ਬਾਰੰ ਬਾਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਅਟਕੈ ਲੈ ਨਰਜਾ ਮਨੁ ਤੋਲੈ ਦੇਵ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: baaran baar maaeaa te attakai lai narajaa man tolai dev |1|
English: Time and time again, he must hold himself back from Maya; let him take the scale of the Lord, and weigh his mind. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਉਹੁ ਜਾਇ ਤਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਤਾਸੁ ਨ ਝੋਲੈ ਦੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: jeh uhu jaae tahee sukh paavai maaeaa taas na jholai dev |
English: Then wherever he goes, he will find peace, and Maya will not shake him.

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਰਾਮ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕੀਓ ਲੈ ਦੇਵ ॥੨॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: keh kabeer meraa man maaniaa raam preet keeo lai dev |2|12|
English: Says Kabeer, my mind believes in the Lord; I am absorbed in the Love of the Divine Lord. ||2||12||

[Ang 857 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Bhagat Namdev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval baanee bhagat naamadev jee kee |
English: Bilaaval, The Word Of Devotee Naam Dayv Jee:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਗੁਰ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: safal janam mo kau gur keenaa |
English: The Guru has made my life fruitful.

Gurbani: ਦੁਖ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਸੁਖ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੀਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dukh bisaar sukh antar leenaa |1|
English: My pain is forgotten, and I have found peace deep within myself. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: giaan anjan mo kau gur deenaa |
English: The Guru has blessed me with the ointment of spiritual wisdom.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਮਨ ਹੀਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam bin jeevan man heenaa |1| rahaau |
English: Without the Lord's Name, life is mindless. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਦੇਇ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: naamadee simaran kar jaanaan |
English: Meditating in remembrance, Naam Dayv has come to know the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਸਿਉ ਜੀਉ ਸਮਾਨਾਂ ॥੨॥੧॥
Transliteration: jagajeevan siau jeeo samaanaan |2|1|
English: His soul is blended with the Lord, the Life of the World. ||2||1||

[Ang 858 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Bhagat Ravidas Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਭਗਤ ਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval baanee ravidaas bhagat kee |
English: Bilaaval, The Word Of Devotee Ravi Daas:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਦਾਰਿਦੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਭ ਕੋ ਹਸੈ ਐਸੀ ਦਸਾ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: daarid dekh sabh ko hasai aisee dasaa hamaaree |
English: Seeing my poverty, everyone laughed. Such was my condition.

Gurbani: ਅਸਟ ਦਸਾ ਸਿਧਿ ਕਰ ਤਲੈ ਸਭ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: asatt dasaa sidh kar talai sabh kripaa tumaaree |1|
English: Now, I hold the eighteen miraculous spiritual powers in the palm of my hand; everything is by Your Grace. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਜਾਨਤ ਮੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਭਵ ਖੰਡਨ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: too jaanat mai kichh nahee bhav khanddan raam |
English: You know, and I am nothing, O Lord, Destroyer of fear.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਜੀਅ ਸਰਨਾਗਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sagal jeea saranaagatee prabh pooran kaam |1| rahaau |
English: All beings seek Your Sanctuary, O God, Fulfiller, Resolver of our affairs. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਨਾਗਤਾ ਤਿਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਭਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jo teree saranaagataa tin naahee bhaar |
English: Whoever enters Your Sanctuary, is relieved of his burden of sin.

Gurbani: ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਤਰੇ ਆਲਜੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aooch neech tum te tare aalaj sansaar |2|
English: You have saved the high and the low from the shameless world. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬਹੁ ਕਾਇ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: keh ravidaas akath kathaa bahu kaae kareejai |
English: Says Ravi Daas, what more can be said about the Unspoken Speech?

Gurbani: ਜੈਸਾ ਤੂ ਤੈਸਾ ਤੁਹੀ ਕਿਆ ਉਪਮਾ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੩॥੧॥
Transliteration: jaisaa too taisaa tuhee kiaa upamaa deejai |3|1|
English: Whatever You are, You are, O Lord; how can anything compare with Your Praises? ||3||1||

[Ang 858 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Bhagat Ravidas Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval |
English: Bilaaval:

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਕੁਲ ਸਾਧੁ ਬੈਸਨੌ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jih kul saadh baisanau hoe |
English: That family, into which a holy person is born,

Gurbani: ਬਰਨ ਅਬਰਨ ਰੰਕੁ ਨਹੀ ਈਸੁਰੁ ਬਿਮਲ ਬਾਸੁ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਜਗਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: baran abaran rank nahee eesur bimal baas jaaneeai jag soe |1| rahaau |
English: whether of high or low social class, whether rich or poor, shall have its pure fragrance spread all over the world. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਨ ਬੈਸ ਸੂਦ ਅਰੁ ਖੵਤ੍ਰੀ ਡੋਮ ਚੰਡਾਰ ਮਲੇਛ ਮਨ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: brahaman bais sood ar khayatree ddom chanddaar malechh man soe |
English: Whether he is a Brahmin, a Vaishya, a Soodra, or a Kh'shaatriya; whether he is a poet, an outcaste, or a filthy-minded person,

Gurbani: ਹੋਇ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਭਜਨ ਤੇ ਆਪੁ ਤਾਰਿ ਤਾਰੇ ਕੁਲ ਦੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: hoe puneet bhagavant bhajan te aap taar taare kul doe |1|
English: he becomes pure, by meditating on the Lord God. He saves himself, and the families of both his parents. ||1||

Gurbani: ਧੰਨਿ ਸੁ ਗਾਉ ਧੰਨਿ ਸੋ ਠਾਉ ਧੰਨਿ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਭ ਲੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: dhan su gaau dhan so tthaau dhan puneet kuttanb sabh loe |
English: Blessed is that village, and blessed is the place of his birth; blessed is his pure family, throughout all the worlds.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਪੀਆ ਸਾਰ ਰਸੁ ਤਜੇ ਆਨ ਰਸ ਹੋਇ ਰਸ ਮਗਨ ਡਾਰੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਖੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jin peea saar ras taje aan ras hoe ras magan ddaare bikh khoe |2|
English: One who drinks in the sublime essence abandons other tastes; intoxicated with this divine essence, he discards sin and corruption. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਸੂਰ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤਿ ਰਾਜਾ ਭਗਤ ਬਰਾਬਰਿ ਅਉਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: panddit soor chhatrapat raajaa bhagat baraabar aaur na koe |
English: Among the religious scholars, warriors and kings, there is no other equal to the Lord's devotee.

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੇ ਪੁਰੈਨ ਪਾਤ ਰਹੈ ਜਲ ਸਮੀਪ ਭਨਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜਨਮੇ ਜਗਿ ਓਇ ॥੩॥੨॥
Transliteration: jaise purain paat rahai jal sameep bhan ravidaas janame jag oe |3|2|
English: As the leaves of the water lily float free in the water, says Ravi Daas, so is their life in the world. ||3||2||

[Ang 858 | Raag: Raag Bilaaval | Author: Bhagat Sadhna Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਾਣੀ ਸਧਨੇ ਕੀ ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: baanee sadhane kee raag bilaaval |
English: The Word Of Sadhana, Raag Bilaaval:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਕੰਨਿਆ ਕੇ ਕਾਰਨੈ ਇਕੁ ਭਇਆ ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: nrip kaniaa ke kaaranai ik bheaa bhekhadhaaree |
English: For a king's daughter, a man disguised himself as Vishnu.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮਾਰਥੀ ਸੁਆਰਥੀ ਵਾ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kaamaarathee suaarathee vaa kee paij savaaree |1|
English: He did it for sexual exploitation, and for selfish motives, but the Lord protected his honor. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤਵ ਗੁਨ ਕਹਾ ਜਗਤ ਗੁਰਾ ਜਉ ਕਰਮੁ ਨ ਨਾਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: tav gun kahaa jagat guraa jau karam na naasai |
English: What is Your value, O Guru of the world, if You will not erase the karma of my past actions?

Gurbani: ਸਿੰਘ ਸਰਨ ਕਤ ਜਾਈਐ ਜਉ ਜੰਬੁਕੁ ਗ੍ਰਾਸੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: singh saran kat jaaeeai jau janbuk graasai |1| rahaau |
English: Why seek safety from a lion, if one is to be eaten by a jackal? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਬੂੰਦ ਜਲ ਕਾਰਨੇ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: ek boond jal kaarane chaatrik dukh paavai |
English: For the sake of a single rain-drop, the rainbird suffers in pain.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਗਏ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਫੁਨਿ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: praan ge saagar milai fun kaam na aavai |2|
English: When its breath of life is gone, even an ocean is of no use to it. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਜੁ ਥਾਕੇ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੈਸੇ ਬਿਰਮਾਵਉ ॥
Transliteration: praan ju thaake thir nahee kaise biramaavau |
English: Now, my life has grown weary, and I shall not last much longer; how can I be patient?

Gurbani: ਬੂਡਿ ਮੂਏ ਨਉਕਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਕਹੁ ਕਾਹਿ ਚਢਾਵਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: boodd mooe naukaa milai kahu kaeh chadtaavau |3|
English: If I drown and die, and then a boat comes along, tell me, how shall I climb aboard? ||3||

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਹਉ ਨਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਹਿ ਨ ਮੋਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: mai naahee kachh hau nahee kichh aaeh na moraa |
English: I am nothing, I have nothing, and nothing belongs to me.

Gurbani: ਅਉਸਰ ਲਜਾ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਸਧਨਾ ਜਨੁ ਤੋਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: aausar lajaa raakh lehu sadhanaa jan toraa |4|1|
English: Now, protect my honor; Sadhana is Your humble servant. ||4||1||

[Ang 859 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirbhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibhan gur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੋਂਡ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raag gondd chaupade mahalaa 4 ghar 1 |
English: Raag Gond, Chau-Padhay, Fourth Mehl, First House:

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਸ ਰਖਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਊਪਰਿ ਤਾ ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਨੇਕ ਫਲ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: je man chit aas rakheh har aoopar taa man chinde anek anek fal paaee |
English: If, in his conscious mind, he places his hopes in the Lord, then he shall obtain the fruits of all the many desires of his mind.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜੋ ਜੀਇ ਵਰਤੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਘਾਲਿਆ ਕਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har jaanai sabh kichh jo jee varatai prabh ghaaliaa kisai kaa ik til na gavaaee |
English: The Lord knows everything which happens to the soul. Not even an iota of one's effort goes to waste.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਕੀਜੈ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੋ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har tis kee aas keejai man mere jo sabh meh suaamee rahiaa samaaee |1|
English: Place your hopes in the Lord, O my mind; the Lord and Master is pervading and permeating all. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਆਸਾ ਕਰਿ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: mere man aasaa kar jagadees gusaaee |
English: O my mind, place your hopes in the Lord of the World, the Master of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਸ ਅਵਰ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੀ ਕੀਜੈ ਸਾ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਆਸ ਸਭ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo bin har aas avar kaahoo kee keejai saa nihafal aas sabh birathee jaaee |1| rahaau |
English: That hope which is placed in any other than the Lord - that hope is fruitless, and totally useless. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਸਭੁ ਮਤ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਲਗਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jo deesai maaeaa moh kuttanb sabh mat tis kee aas lag janam gavaaee |
English: That which you can see, Maya, and all attachment to family - don't place your hopes in them, or your life will be wasted and lost.

Gurbani: ਇਨੑ ਕੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਹਾਥਿ ਨਹੀ ਕਹਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਇਹਿ ਬਪੁੜੇ ਇਨੑ ਕਾ ਵਾਹਿਆ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: eina kai kichh haath nahee kahaa kareh ihi bapurre ina kaa vaahiaa kachh na vasaaee |
English: Nothing is in their hands; what can these poor creatures do? By their actions, nothing can be done.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਆਸ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਜੋ ਤੁਝੁ ਤਾਰੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਸਭੁ ਛਡਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mere man aas kar har preetam apune kee jo tujh taarai teraa kuttanb sabh chhaddaaee |2|
English: O my mind, place your hopes in the Lord, your Beloved, who shall carry you across, and save your whole family as well. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਸ ਅਵਰ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰਮਿਤ੍ਰੀ ਮਤ ਤੂੰ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਕਿਤੈ ਕੰਮਿ ਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: je kichh aas avar kareh paramitree mat toon jaaneh terai kitai kam aaee |
English: If you place your hopes in any other, in any friend other than the Lord, then you shall come to know that it is of no use at all.

Gurbani: ਇਹ ਆਸ ਪਰਮਿਤ੍ਰੀ ਭਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ਹੈ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਝੂਠੁ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਸਭ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: eih aas paramitree bhaau doojaa hai khin meh jhootth binas sabh jaaee |
English: This hope placed in other friends comes from the love of duality. In an instant, it is gone; it is totally false.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਆਸਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੀ ਜੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਘਾਲਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: mere man aasaa kar har preetam saache kee jo teraa ghaaliaa sabh thaae paaee |3|
English: O my mind, place your hopes in the Lord, your True Beloved, who shall approve and reward you for all your efforts. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜੈਸੀ ਤੂ ਆਸ ਕਰਾਵਹਿ ਤੈਸੀ ਕੋ ਆਸ ਕਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa manasaa sabh teree mere suaamee jaisee too aas karaaveh taisee ko aas karaaee |
English: Hope and desire are all Yours, O my Lord and Master. As You inspire hope, so are the hopes held.

Gurbani: ਕਿਛੁ ਕਿਸੀ ਕੈ ਹਥਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਐਸੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kichh kisee kai hath naahee mere suaamee aisee merai satigur boojh bujhaaee |
English: Nothing is in the hands of anyone, O my Lord and Master; such is the understanding the True Guru has given me to understand.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਤੂ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak kee aas too jaaneh har darasan dekh har darasan tripataaee |4|1|
English: You alone know the hope of servant Nanak, O Lord; gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, he is satisfied. ||4||1||

[Ang 860 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: gondd mahalaa 4 |
English: Gond, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਜੋ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਸਭਿ ਕਰੇ ਬਿਨਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa har seveeai nit dhiaaeeai jo khin meh kilavikh sabh kare binaasaa |
English: Serve such a Lord, and ever meditate on Him, who in an instant erases all sins and mistakes.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਅਵਰ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਕੀਜੈ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਸਭ ਘਾਲ ਗਵਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: je har tiaag avar kee aas keejai taa har nihafal sabh ghaal gavaasaa |
English: If someone forsakes the Lord and places his hopes in another, then all his service to the Lord is rendered fruitless.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸਭ ਭੁਖ ਲਹਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mere man har sevihu sukhadaataa suaamee jis seviai sabh bhukh lahaasaa |1|
English: O my mind, serve the Lord, the Giver of peace; serving Him, all your hunger shall depart. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਊਪਰਿ ਕੀਜੈ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: mere man har aoopar keejai bharavaasaa |
English: O my mind, place your faith in the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਜਾਈਐ ਤਹ ਨਾਲਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਅਪਨੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੈ ਜਨ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jeh jaaeeai teh naal meraa suaamee har apanee paij rakhai jan daasaa |1| rahaau |
English: Wherever I go, my Lord and Master is there with me. The Lord saves the honor of His humble servants and slaves. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਅਪਨੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕਹਹੁ ਅਵਰਾ ਪਹਿ ਤਾ ਆਗੈ ਅਪਨੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਬਹੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕਢਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: je apanee birathaa kahahu avaraa peh taa aagai apanee birathaa bahu bahut kadtaasaa |
English: If you tell your sorrows to another, then he, in return, will tell you of his greater sorrows.

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕਹਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪਹਿ ਜੋ ਤੁਮੑਰੇ ਦੂਖ ਤਤਕਾਲ ਕਟਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: apanee birathaa kahahu har apune suaamee peh jo tumare dookh tatakaal kattaasaa |
English: So tell your sorrows to the Lord, your Lord and Master, who shall instantly dispel your pain.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਐਸਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਅਪਨੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਅਵਰਾ ਪਹਿ ਕਹੀਐ ਅਵਰਾ ਪਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਮਨ ਲਾਜ ਮਰਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: so aisaa prabh chhodd apanee birathaa avaraa peh kaheeai avaraa peh keh man laaj maraasaa |2|
English: Forsaking such a Lord God, if you tell your sorrows to another, then you shall die of shame. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਸੰਸਾਰੈ ਕੇ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਭਾਈ ਦੀਸਹਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਅਪਨੈ ਸੁਆਇ ਮਿਲਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo sansaarai ke kuttanb mitr bhaaee deeseh man mere te sabh apanai suaae milaasaa |
English: The relatives, friends and siblings of the world that you see, O my mind, all meet with you for their own purposes.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਦਿਨਿ ਉਨੑ ਕਾ ਸੁਆਉ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਦਿਨਿ ਨੇੜੈ ਕੋ ਨ ਢੁਕਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: jit din una kaa suaau hoe na aavai tith din nerrai ko na dtukaasaa |
English: And that day, when their self-interests are not served, on that day, they shall not come near you.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਅਪਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਉਪਕਰੈ ਦੂਖਿ ਸੁਖਾਸਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: man mere apanaa har sev din raatee jo tudh upakarai dookh sukhaasaa |3|
English: O my mind, serve your Lord, day and night; He shall help you in good times and bad. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ਕਿਉ ਕੀਜੈ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੋ ਅੰਤੀ ਅਉਸਰਿ ਰਖਿ ਨ ਸਕਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: tis kaa bharavaasaa kiau keejai man mere jo antee aausar rakh na sakaasaa |
English: Why place your faith in anyone, O my mind, who cannot come to your rescue at the last instant?

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਮੰਤੁ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਲੈ ਜਾਪਹੁ ਤਿਨੑ ਅੰਤਿ ਛਡਾਏ ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਚਿਤਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: har jap mant gur upades lai jaapahu tina ant chhaddaae jina har preet chitaasaa |
English: Chant the Lord's Mantra, take the Guru's Teachings, and meditate on Him. In the end, the Lord saves those who love Him in their consciousness.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਇਹੁ ਛੂਟਣ ਕਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: jan naanak anadin naam japahu har santahu ihu chhoottan kaa saachaa bharavaasaa |4|2|
English: Servant Nanak speaks: night and day, chant the Lord's Name, O Saints; this is the only true hope for emancipation. ||4||2||

[Ang 860 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: gondd mahalaa 4 |
English: Gond, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਦਾ ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੀਤਲ ਮਨੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: har simarat sadaa hoe anand sukh antar saant seetal man apanaa |
English: Remembering the Lord in meditation, you shall find bliss and peace forever deep within, and your mind will become tranquil and cool.

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੇ ਸਕਤਿ ਸੂਰੁ ਬਹੁ ਜਲਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਸਿ ਦੇਖੇ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ ਸਭ ਤਪਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jaise sakat soor bahu jalataa gur sas dekhe leh jaae sabh tapanaa |1|
English: It is like the harsh sun of Maya, with its burning heat; seeing the moon, the Guru, its heat totally vanishes. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: mere man anadin dhiaae naam har japanaa |
English: O my mind, night and day, meditate, and chant the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਜਹਾ ਕਹਾ ਤੁਝੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ਸੋ ਐਸਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਤੂ ਅਪਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jahaa kahaa tujh raakhai sabh tthaaee so aisaa prabh sev sadaa too apanaa |1| rahaau |
English: Here and hereafter, He shall protect you, everywhere; serve such a God forever. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਮਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਤਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaa meh sabh nidhaan so har jap man mere guramukh khoj lahahu har ratanaa |
English: Meditate on the Lord, who contains all treasures, O my mind; as Gurmukh, search for the jewel, the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਮਲਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਸਨਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jin har dhiaaeaa tin har paaeaa meraa suaamee tin ke charan malahu har dasanaa |2|
English: Those who meditate on the Lord, find the Lord, my Lord and Master; I wash the feet of those slaves of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਓਹੁ ਊਤਮੁ ਸੰਤੁ ਭਇਓ ਬਡ ਬਡਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabad pachhaan raam ras paavahu ohu aootam sant bheo badd baddanaa |
English: One who realizes the Word of the Shabad, obtains the sublime essence of the Lord; such a Saint is lofty and sublime, the greatest of the great.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਧਾਈ ਓਹੁ ਘਟੈ ਨ ਕਿਸੈ ਕੀ ਘਟਾਈ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਤਿਲਨਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tis jan kee vaddiaaee har aap vadhaaee ohu ghattai na kisai kee ghattaaee ik til til tilanaa |3|
English: The Lord Himself magnifies the glory of that humble servant. No one can lessen or decrease that glory, not even a bit. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੋ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇ ਨਿਤ ਕਰ ਜੁਰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jis te sukh paaveh man mere so sadaa dhiaae nit kar juranaa |
English: He shall give you peace, O my mind; meditate forever, every day on Him, with your palms pressed together.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਕੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਿਤ ਬਸਹਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਚਰਨਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
Transliteration: jan naanak kau har daan ik deejai nit baseh ridai haree mohi charanaa |4|3|
English: Please bless servant Nanak with this one gift, O Lord, that Your feet may dwell within my heart forever. ||4||3||

[Ang 861 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: gondd mahalaa 4 |
English: Gond, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਤਨੇ ਸਾਹ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਉਮਰਾਵ ਸਿਕਦਾਰ ਚਉਧਰੀ ਸਭਿ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਝੂਠੁ ਭਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: jitane saah paatisaah umaraav sikadaar chaudharee sabh mithiaa jhootth bhaau doojaa jaan |
English: All the kings, emperors, nobles, lords and chiefs are false and transitory, engrossed in duality - know this well.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਸਦਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਭਜੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har abinaasee sadaa thir nihachal tis mere man bhaj paravaan |1|
English: The eternal Lord is permanent and unchanging; meditate on Him, O my mind, and you shall be approved. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੀ ਭਜੁ ਸਦਾ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: mere man naam haree bhaj sadaa deebaan |
English: O my mind, vibrate, and meditate on the Lord's Name, which shall be your defender forever.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਦਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo har mehal paavai gur bachanee tis jevadd avar naahee kisai daa taan |1| rahaau |
English: One who obtains the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, through the Word of the Guru's Teachings - no one else's power is as great as his. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਤਨੇ ਧਨਵੰਤ ਕੁਲਵੰਤ ਮਿਲਖਵੰਤ ਦੀਸਹਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਜਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਕਚਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: jitane dhanavant kulavant milakhavant deeseh man mere sabh binas jaeh jiau rang kasunbh kachaan |
English: All the wealthy, high class property owners which you see, O my mind, shall vanish, like the fading color of the safflower.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੇਵਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਤੂ ਮਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har sat niranjan sadaa sev man mere jit har daragah paaveh too maan |2|
English: Serve the True, Immaculate Lord forever, O my mind, and you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਸੂਦ ਵੈਸ ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਚਾਰਿ ਆਸ੍ਰਮ ਹਹਿ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: braahaman khatree sood vais chaar varan chaar aasram heh jo har dhiaavai so paradhaan |
English: There are four castes: Brahmin, Kh'shaatriya, Soodra and Vaishya, and there are four stages of life. One who meditates on the Lord, is the most distinguished and renowned.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਚੰਦਨ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਿਰਡੁ ਬਪੁੜਾ ਤਿਉ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jiau chandan nikatt vasai hiradd bapurraa tiau satasangat mil patit paravaan |3|
English: The poor castor oil plant, growing near the sandalwood tree, becomes fragrant; in the same way, the sinner, associating with the Saints, becomes acceptable and approved. ||3||

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਸੂਚਾ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਿਆ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: ohu sabh te aoochaa sabh te soochaa jaa kai hiradai vasiaa bhagavaan |
English: He, within whose heart the Lord abides, is the highest of all, and the purest of all.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਲੈ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਸੇਵਕਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੪॥
Transliteration: jan naanak tis ke charan pakhaalai jo har jan neech jaat sevakaan |4|4|
English: Servant Nanak washes the feet of that humble servant of the Lord; he may be from a low class family, but he is now the Lord's servant. ||4||4||

[Ang 861 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: gondd mahalaa 4 |
English: Gond, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਭਤੈ ਵਰਤੈ ਜੇਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਤੇਹਾ ਕੋ ਕਰਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: har antarajaamee sabhatai varatai jehaa har karaae tehaa ko kareeai |
English: The Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is all-pervading. As the Lord causes them to act, so do they act.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੋ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਸਭ ਦੂ ਰਖਿ ਲਈਐ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: so aisaa har sev sadaa man mere jo tudhano sabh doo rakh leeai |1|
English: So serve forever such a Lord, O my mind, who will protect you from everything. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਤ ਪੜਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: mere man har jap har nit parreeai |
English: O my mind, meditate on the Lord, and read about the Lord every day.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਤਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕਾਇਤੁ ਕੜਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har bin ko maar jeevaal na saakai taa mere man kaaeit karreeai |1| rahaau |
English: Other than the Lord, no one can kill you or save you; so why do you worry, O my mind? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਕਰਤੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਧਰਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: har parapanch keea sabh karatai vich aape aapanee jot dhareeai |
English: The Creator created the entire universe, and infused His Light into it.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਬੁਲਾਏ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਦਿਖਈਐ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har eko bolai har ek bulaae gur poorai har ek dikheeai |2|
English: The One Lord speaks, and the One Lord causes all to speak.The Perfect Guru has revealed the One Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ਕਹੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਮਨ ਕਿਆ ਚੋਰਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: har antar naale baahar naale kahu tis paasahu man kiaa choreeai |
English: The Lord is with you, inside and out; tell me, O mind, how can You hide anything from Him?

Gurbani: ਨਿਹਕਪਟ ਸੇਵਾ ਕੀਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਰੀ ਤਾਂ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਈਐ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: nihakapatt sevaa keejai har keree taan mere man sarab sukh peeai |3|
English: Serve the Lord open-heartedly, and then, O my mind, you shall find total peace. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਦੈ ਵਸਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੋ ਸਭ ਦੂ ਵਡਾ ਸੋ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਅਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: jis dai vas sabh kichh so sabh doo vaddaa so mere man sadaa dhiaeeai |
English: Everything is under His control; He is the greatest of all. O my mind, meditate forever on Him.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲਿ ਹੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਤੁਧੁ ਲਏ ਛਡਈਐ ॥੪॥੫॥
Transliteration: jan naanak so har naal hai terai har sadaa dhiaae too tudh le chhaddeeai |4|5|
English: O Servant Nanak, that Lord is always with you. Meditate forever on your Lord, and He shall emancipate you. ||4||5||

[Ang 861 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: gondd mahalaa 4 |
English: Gond, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਬਹੁ ਤਪਤੈ ਜਿਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾਵੰਤੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਨੀਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har darasan kau meraa man bahu tapatai jiau trikhaavant bin neer |1|
English: My mind yearns so deeply for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, like the thirsty man without water. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਲਗੋ ਹਰਿ ਤੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: merai man prem lago har teer |
English: My mind is pierced through by the arrow of the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਹਮਰੀ ਬੇਦਨ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਪੀਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hamaree bedan har prabh jaanai mere man antar kee peer |1| rahaau |
English: The Lord God knows my anguish, and the pain deep within my mind. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕੀ ਕੋਈ ਬਾਤ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਭਾਈ ਸੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਬੀਰ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mere har preetam kee koee baat sunaavai so bhaaee so meraa beer |2|
English: Whoever tells me the Stories of my Beloved Lord is my Sibling of Destiny, and my friend. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਿਲੁ ਮਿਲੁ ਸਖੀ ਗੁਣ ਕਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਲੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਧੀਰ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: mil mil sakhee gun kahu mere prabh ke le satigur kee mat dheer |3|
English: Come, and join together, O my companions; let's sing the Glorious Praises of my God, and follow the comforting advice of the True Guru.. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਆਸ ਪੁਜਾਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਰੀਰ ॥੪॥੬॥ ਛਕਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: jan naanak kee har aas pujaavahu har darasan saant sareer |4|6| chhakaa 1 |
English: Please fulfill the hopes of servant Nanak, O Lord; his body finds peace and tranquility in the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||4||6|| First set of six. ||

[Ang 862 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raag gondd mahalaa 5 chaupade ghar 1 |
English: Raag Gond, Fifth Mehl, Chau-Padhay, First House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਭੁਗਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sabh karataa sabh bhugataa |1| rahaau |
English: He is the Creator of all, He is the Enjoyer of all. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੁਨਤੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੇਖਤ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: sunato karataa pekhat karataa |
English: The Creator listens, and the Creator sees.

Gurbani: ਅਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੋ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: adrisatto karataa drisatto karataa |
English: The Creator is unseen, and the Creator is seen.

Gurbani: ਓਪਤਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਪਰਲਉ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: opat karataa parlau karataa |
English: The Creator forms, and the Creator destroys.

Gurbani: ਬਿਆਪਤ ਕਰਤਾ ਅਲਿਪਤੋ ਕਰਤਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: biaapat karataa alipato karataa |1|
English: The Creator touches, and the Creator is detached. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਕਤੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਬੂਝਤ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: bakato karataa boojhat karataa |
English: The Creator is the One who speaks, and the Creator is the One who understands.

Gurbani: ਆਵਤੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਾਤੁ ਭੀ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: aavat karataa jaat bhee karataa |
English: The Creator comes, and the Creator also goes.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਰਗੁਨ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: niragun karataa saragun karataa |
English: The Creator is absolute and without qualities; the Creator is related, with the most excellent qualities.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਮਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾ ॥੨॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad naanak samadrisattaa |2|1|
English: By Guru's Grace, Nanak looks upon all the same. ||2||1||

[Ang 862 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gondd mahalaa 5 |
English: Gond, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਫਾਕਿਓ ਮੀਨ ਕਪਿਕ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ ਤੂ ਉਰਝਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਕੁਸੰਭਾਇਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: faakio meen kapik kee niaaee too urajh rahio kusanbhaaeile |
English: You are caught, like the fish and the monkey; you are entangled in the transitory world.

Gurbani: ਪਗ ਧਾਰਹਿ ਸਾਸੁ ਲੇਖੈ ਲੈ ਤਉ ਉਧਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਲੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: pag dhaareh saas lekhai lai tau udhareh har gun gaaeile |1|
English: Your foot-steps and your breaths are numbered; only by singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord will you be saved. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਸਮਝੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਆਵਾਇਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: man samajh chhodd aavaaeile |
English: O mind, reform yourself, and forsake your aimless wandering.

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੇ ਰਹਨ ਕਉ ਠਉਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਕਾਏ ਪਰ ਕੈ ਜਾਇਲੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: apane rehan kau tthaur na paaveh kaae par kai jaaeile |1| rahaau |
English: You have found no place of rest for yourself; so why do you try to teach others? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਮੈਗਲੁ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਰਸਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਰਿਓ ਤੂ ਲਾਗਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਕੁਟੰਬਾਇਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: jiau maigal indree ras prerio too laag pario kuttanbaaeile |
English: Like the elephant, driven by sexual desire, you are attached to your family.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਪੰਖੀ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਹੋਇ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਿਛੁਰੈ ਥਿਰੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਲੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jiau pankhee ikatr hoe fir bichhurai thir sangat har har dhiaaeile |2|
English: People are like birds that come together, and fly apart again; you shall become stable and steady, only when you meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, in the Company of the Holy. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੇ ਮੀਨੁ ਰਸਨ ਸਾਦਿ ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਓਹੁ ਮੂਠੌ ਮੂੜ ਲੋਭਾਇਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: jaise meen rasan saad binasio ohu mootthau moorr lobhaaeile |
English: Like the fish, which perishes because of its desire to taste, the fool is ruined by his greed.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਹੋਆ ਪੰਚ ਵਾਸਿ ਵੈਰੀ ਕੈ ਛੂਟਹਿ ਪਰੁ ਸਰਨਾਇਲੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: too hoaa panch vaas vairee kai chhootteh par saranaaeile |3|
English: You have fallen under the power of the five thieves; escape is only possible in the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਮੑਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤਾਇਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: hohu kripaal deen dukh bhanjan sabh tumare jeea jantaaeile |
English: Be Merciful to me, O Destroyer of the pains of the meek; all beings and creatures belong to You.

Gurbani: ਪਾਵਉ ਦਾਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਪੇਖਾ ਮਿਲੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਇਲੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: paavau daan sadaa daras pekhaa mil naanak daas dasaaeile |4|2|
English: May I obtain the gift of always seeing the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; meeting with You, Nanak is the slave of Your slaves. ||4||2||

[Ang 862 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: raag gondd mahalaa 5 chaupade ghar 2 |
English: Raag Gond, Fifth Mehl, Chau-Padhay, Second House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਕੀਏ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਜਿ ॥
Transliteration: jeea praan kee jin saaj |
English: He fashioned the soul and the breath of life,

Gurbani: ਮਾਟੀ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਖੀ ਨਿਵਾਜਿ ॥
Transliteration: maattee meh jot rakhee nivaaj |
English: and infused His Light into the dust;

Gurbani: ਬਰਤਨ ਕਉ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਭੋਜਨ ਭੋਗਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: baratan kau sabh kichh bhojan bhogaae |
English: He exalted you and gave you everything to use, and food to eat and enjoy

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਜਿ ਮੂੜੇ ਕਤ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: so prabh taj moorre kat jaae |1|
English: - how can you forsake that God, you fool! Where else will you go? ||1||

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਲਾਗਉ ਸੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham kee laagau sev |
English: Commit yourself to the service of the Transcendent Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸੁਝੈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਦੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur te sujhai niranjan dev |1| rahaau |
English: Through the Guru, one understands the Immaculate, Divine Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਏ ਰੰਗ ਅਨਿਕ ਪਰਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: jin kee rang anik parakaar |
English: He created plays and dramas of all sorts;

Gurbani: ਓਪਤਿ ਪਰਲਉ ਨਿਮਖ ਮਝਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: opat parlau nimakh majhaar |
English: He creates and destroys in an instant;

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kee gat mit kahee na jaae |
English: His state and condition cannot be described.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: so prabh man mere sadaa dhiaae |2|
English: Meditate forever on that God, O my mind. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਇ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਧਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: aae na jaavai nihachal dhanee |
English: The unchanging Lord does not come or go.

Gurbani: ਬੇਅੰਤ ਗੁਨਾ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਕੇਤਕ ਗਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: beant gunaa taa ke ketak ganee |
English: His Glorious Virtues are infinite; how many of them can I count?

Gurbani: ਲਾਲ ਨਾਮ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: laal naam jaa kai bhare bhanddaar |
English: His treasure is overflowing with the rubies of the Name.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਦੇਵੈ ਆਧਾਰ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sagal ghattaa devai aadhaar |3|
English: He gives Support to all hearts. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਹੈ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sat purakh jaa ko hai naau |
English: The Name is the True Primal Being;

Gurbani: ਮਿਟਹਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਘ ਨਿਮਖ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mitteh kott agh nimakh jas gaau |
English: millions of sins are washed away in an instant, singing His Praises.

Gurbani: ਬਾਲ ਸਖਾਈ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੋ ਮੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: baal sakhaaee bhagatan ko meet |
English: The Lord God is your best friend, your playmate from earliest childhood.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਿਤ ਚੀਤ ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
Transliteration: praan adhaar naanak hit cheet |4|1|3|
English: He is the Support of the breath of life; O Nanak, He is love, He is consciousness. ||4||1||3||

[Ang 863 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gondd mahalaa 5 |
English: Gond, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਕੀਨੋ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: naam sang keeno biauhaar |
English: I trade in the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੋੁ ਹੀ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: naamuo hee is man kaa adhaar |
English: The Naam is the Support of the mind.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੋ ਹੀ ਚਿਤਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਓਟ ॥
Transliteration: naamo hee chit keenee ott |
English: My consciousness takes to the Shelter of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਪਾਪ ਕੋਟਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naam japat mitteh paap kott |1|
English: Chanting the Naam, millions of sins are erased. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਸਿ ਦੀਈ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: raas deeee har eko naam |
English: The Lord has blessed me with the wealth of the Naam, the Name of the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਇਸਟੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: man kaa isatt gur sang dhiaan |1| rahaau |
English: The wish of my mind is to meditate on the Naam, in association with the Guru. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: naam hamaare jeea kee raas |
English: The Naam is the wealth of my soul.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੋ ਸੰਗੀ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਜਾਤ ॥
Transliteration: naamo sangee jat kat jaat |
English: Wherever I go, the Naam is with me.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੋ ਹੀ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: naamo hee man laagaa meetthaa |
English: The Naam is sweet to my mind.

Gurbani: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jal thal sabh meh naamo ddeetthaa |2|
English: In the water, on the land, and everywhere, I see the Naam. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: naame daragah mukh ujale |
English: Through the Naam, one's face becomes radiant in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: naame sagale kul udhare |
English: Through the Naam, all one's generations are saved.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਿ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਸੀਧ ॥
Transliteration: naam hamaare kaaraj seedh |
English: Through the Naam, my affairs are resolved.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਗੀਧ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naam sang ihu manooaa geedh |3|
English: My mind is accustomed to the Naam. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਹਮ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ॥
Transliteration: naame hee ham nirbhau bhe |
English: Through the Naam, I have become fearless.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੇ ਆਵਨ ਜਾਵਨ ਰਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: naame aavan jaavan rahe |
English: Through the Naam, my comings and goings have ceased.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: gur poorai mele gunataas |
English: The Perfect Guru has united me with the Lord, the treasure of virtue.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੪॥੨॥੪॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak sukh sehaj nivaas |4|2|4|
English: Says Nanak, I dwell in celestial peace. ||4||2||4||

[Ang 863 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gondd mahalaa 5 |
English: Gond, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਿਮਾਨੇ ਕਉ ਜੋ ਦੇਤੋ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: nimaane kau jo deto maan |
English: He grants honor to the dishonored,

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਭੂਖੇ ਕਉ ਕਰਤਾ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: sagal bhookhe kau karataa daan |
English: and gives gifts to all the hungry;

Gurbani: ਗਰਭ ਘੋਰ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: garabh ghor meh raakhanahaar |
English: he protects those in the terrible womb.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tis tthaakur kau sadaa namasakaar |1|
English: So humbly bow forever to that Lord and Master. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: aiso prabh man maeh dhiaae |
English: Meditate on such a God in your mind.

Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਅਵਘਟਿ ਜਤ ਕਤਹਿ ਸਹਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt avaghatt jat kateh sahaae |1| rahaau |
English: He shall be your help and support everywhere, in good times and bad. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਰੰਕੁ ਰਾਉ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: rank raau jaa kai ek samaan |
English: The beggar and the king are all the same to Him.

Gurbani: ਕੀਟ ਹਸਤਿ ਸਗਲ ਪੂਰਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: keett hasat sagal pooraan |
English: He sustains and fulfills both the ant and the elephant.

Gurbani: ਬੀਓ ਪੂਛਿ ਨ ਮਸਲਤਿ ਧਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: beeo poochh na masalat dharai |
English: He does not consult or seek anyone's advice.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਆਪਹਿ ਕਰੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jo kichh karai su aapeh karai |2|
English: Whatever He does, He does Himself. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਸਿ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kaa ant na jaanas koe |
English: No one knows His limit.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aape aap niranjan soe |
English: He Himself is the Immaculate Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਅਕਾਰੁ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: aap akaar aap nirankaar |
English: He Himself is formed, and He Himself is formless.

Gurbani: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਘਟਿ ਸਭ ਘਟ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt ghatt sabh ghatt aadhaar |3|
English: In the heart, in each and every heart, He is the Support of all hearts. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਭਗਤ ਭਏ ਲਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: naam rang bhagat bhe laal |
English: Through the Love of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the devotees become His Beloveds.

Gurbani: ਜਸੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: jas karate sant sadaa nihaal |
English: Singing the Praises of the Creator, the Saints are forever in bliss.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਜਨ ਰਹੇ ਅਘਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: naam rang jan rahe aghaae |
English: Through the Love of the Naam, the Lord's humble servants remain satisfied.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਜਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥੩॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak tin jan laagai paae |4|3|5|
English: Nanak falls at the feet of those humble servants of the Lord. ||4||3||5||

[Ang 863 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gondd mahalaa 5 |
English: Gond, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai sang ihu man niramal |
English: Associating with them, this mind becomes immaculate and pure.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai sang har har simaran |
English: Associating with them, one meditates in remembrance on the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਹੋਹਿ ਨਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai sang kilabikh hohi naas |
English: Associating with them, all the sins are erased.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਪਰਗਾਸ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jaa kai sang ridai paragaas |1|
English: Associating with them, the heart is illumined. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਸੰਤਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: se santan har ke mere meet |
English: Those Saints of the Lord are my friends.

Gurbani: ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਗਾਈਐ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਨੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: keval naam gaaeeai jaa kai neet |1| rahaau |
English: It is their custom to sing only the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮੰਤ੍ਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai mantr har har man vasai |
English: By their mantra, the Lord, Har, Har, dwells in the mind.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਨਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai upades bharam bhau nasai |
English: By their teachings, doubt and fear are dispelled.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai keerat niramal saar |
English: By their kirtan, they become immaculate and sublime.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਰੇਨੁ ਬਾਂਛੈ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jaa kee ren baanchhai sansaar |2|
English: The world longs for the dust of their feet. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: kott patit jaa kai sang udhaar |
English: Millions of sinners are saved by associating with them.

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: ek nirankaar jaa kai naam adhaar |
English: They have the Support of the Name of the One Formless Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆਂ ਕਾ ਜਾਨੈ ਭੇਉ ॥
Transliteration: sarab jeean kaa jaanai bheo |
English: He knows the secrets of all beings;

Gurbani: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਦੇਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kripaa nidhaan niranjan deo |3|
English: He is the treasure of mercy, the divine immaculate Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਜਬ ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham jab bhe kripaal |
English: When the Supreme Lord God becomes merciful,

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਭੇਟੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਧ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
Transliteration: tab bhette gur saadh deaal |
English: then one meets the Merciful Holy Guru.

Gurbani: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: din rain naanak naam dhiaae |
English: Day and night, Nanak meditates on the Naam.

Gurbani: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਏ ॥੪॥੪॥੬॥
Transliteration: sookh sehaj aanand har naae |4|4|6|
English: Through the Lord's Name, he is blessed with peace, poise and bliss. ||4||4||6||

[Ang 864 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gondd mahalaa 5 |
English: Gond, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur kee moorat man meh dhiaan |
English: Meditate on the image of the Guru within your mind;

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad mantru man maan |
English: let your mind accept the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and His Mantra.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਰਿਦੈ ਲੈ ਧਾਰਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur ke charan ridai lai dhaarau |
English: Enshrine the Guru's feet within your heart.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur paarabraham sadaa namasakaarau |1|
English: Bow in humility forever before the Guru, the Supreme Lord God. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਤ ਕੋ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: mat ko bharam bhulai sansaar |
English: Let no one wander in doubt in the world.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur bin koe na utaras paar |1| rahaau |
English: Without the Guru, no one can cross over. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਭੂਲੇ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bhoole kau gur maarag paaeaa |
English: The Guru shows the Path to those who have wandered off.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: avar tiaag har bhagatee laaeaa |
English: He leads them to renounce others, and attaches them to devotional worship of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਮਿਟਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: janam maran kee traas mittaaee |
English: He obliterates the fear of birth and death.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਵਡਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur poore kee beant vaddaaee |2|
English: The glorious greatness of the Perfect Guru is endless. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਊਰਧ ਕਮਲ ਬਿਗਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad aooradh kamal bigaas |
English: By Guru's Grace, the inverted heart-lotus blossoms forth,

Gurbani: ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਮਹਿ ਭਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: andhakaar meh bheaa pragaas |
English: and the Light shines forth in the darkness.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jin keea so gur te jaaniaa |
English: Through the Guru, know the One who created you.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਮੁਗਧ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur kirapaa te mugadh man maaniaa |3|
English: By the Guru's Mercy, the foolish mind comes to believe. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਣੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur karataa gur karanai jog |
English: The Guru is the Creator; the Guru has the power to do everything.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur paramesar hai bhee hog |
English: The Guru is the Transcendent Lord; He is, and always shall be.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਇਹੈ ਜਨਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak prabh ihai janaaee |
English: Says Nanak, God has inspired me to know this.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਭਾਈ ॥੪॥੫॥੭॥
Transliteration: bin gur mukat na paaeeai bhaaee |4|5|7|
English: Without the Guru, liberation is not obtained, O Siblings of Destiny. ||4||5||7||

[Ang 864 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gondd mahalaa 5 |
English: Gond, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਨ ਮੋਰ ॥
Transliteration: guroo guroo gur kar man mor |
English: Chant Guru, Guru, Guru, O my mind.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੂ ਬਿਨਾ ਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਹੋਰ ॥
Transliteration: guroo binaa mai naahee hor |
English: I have no other than the Guru.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਰਹਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: gur kee ttek rahahu din raat |
English: I lean upon the Support of the Guru, day and night.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਦਾਤਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jaa kee koe na mettai daat |1|
English: No one can decrease His bounty. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur paramesar eko jaan |
English: Know that the Guru and the Transcendent Lord are One.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo tis bhaavai so paravaan |1| rahaau |
English: Whatever pleases Him is acceptable and approved. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur charanee jaa kaa man laagai |
English: One whose mind is attached to the Guru's feet

Gurbani: ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: dookh darad bhram taa kaa bhaagai |
English: his pains, sufferings and doubts run away.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਪਾਏ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur kee sevaa paae maan |
English: Serving the Guru, honor is obtained.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur aoopar sadaa kurabaan |2|
English: I am forever a sacrifice to the Guru. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa darasan dekh nihaal |
English: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan, I am exalted.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਘਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: gur ke sevak kee pooran ghaal |
English: The work of the Guru's servant is perfect.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur ke sevak kau dukh na biaapai |
English: Pain does not afflict the Guru's servant.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur kaa sevak deh dis jaapai |3|
English: The Guru's servant is famous in the ten directions. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur kee mahimaa kathan na jaae |
English: The Guru's glory cannot be described.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham gur rahiaa samaae |
English: The Guru remains absorbed in the Supreme Lord God.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਭਾਗ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak jaa ke poore bhaag |
English: Says Nanak, one who is blessed with perfect destiny

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗ ॥੪॥੬॥੮॥
Transliteration: gur charanee taa kaa man laag |4|6|8|
English: - his mind is attached to the Guru's feet. ||4||6||8||

[Ang 864 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gondd mahalaa 5 |
English: Gond, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੂਜਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur meree poojaa gur gobind |
English: I worship and adore my Guru; the Guru is the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਭਗਵੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur meraa paarabraham gur bhagavant |
English: My Guru is the Supreme Lord God; the Guru is the Lord God.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਦੇਉ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur meraa deo alakh abheo |
English: My Guru is divine, invisible and mysterious.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਪੂਜ ਚਰਨ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sarab pooj charan gur seo |1|
English: I serve at the Guru's feet, which are worshipped by all. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੈ ਥਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur bin avar naahee mai thaau |
English: Without the Guru, I have no other place at all.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਪਉ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: anadin jpau guroo gur naau |1| rahaau |
English: Night and day, I chant the Name of Guru, Guru. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur meraa giaan gur ridai dhiaan |
English: The Guru is my spiritual wisdom, the Guru is the meditation within my heart.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਪਾਲੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur gopaal purakh bhagavaan |
English: The Guru is the Lord of the World, the Primal Being, the Lord God.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਰਹਉ ਕਰ ਜੋਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: gur kee saran rhau kar jor |
English: With my palms pressed together, I remain in the Guru's Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੂ ਬਿਨਾ ਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਹੋਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: guroo binaa mai naahee hor |2|
English: Without the Guru, I have no other at all. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਤਾਰੇ ਭਵ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: gur bohith taare bhav paar |
English: The Guru is the boat to cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਛੁਟਕਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: gur sevaa jam te chhuttakaar |
English: Serving the Guru, one is released from the Messenger of Death.

Gurbani: ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਉਜਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: andhakaar meh gur mantru ujaaraa |
English: In the darkness, the Guru's Mantra shines forth.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur kai sang sagal nisataaraa |3|
English: With the Guru, all are saved. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur pooraa paaeeai vaddabhaagee |
English: The Perfect Guru is found, by great good fortune.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur kee sevaa dookh na laagee |
English: Serving the Guru, pain does not afflict anyone.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa sabad na mettai koe |
English: No one can erase the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੭॥੯॥
Transliteration: gur naanak naanak har soe |4|7|9|
English: Nanak is the Guru; Nanak is the Lord Himself. ||4||7||9||

[Ang 865 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gondd mahalaa 5 |
English: Gond, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: raam raam sang kar biauhaar |
English: Deal and trade only with the Lord, Raam, Raam.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: raam raam raam praan adhaar |
English: The Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam, is the Support of the breath of life.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: raam raam raam keeratan gaae |
English: Sing the Kirtan of the Praises of the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam.

Gurbani: ਰਮਤ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਭ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ramat raam sabh rahio samaae |1|
English: The Lord is ever-present, all-pervading. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sant janaa mil bolahu raam |
English: Joining the humble Saints, chant the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sabh te niramal pooran kaam |1| rahaau |
English: This is the most immaculate and perfect occupation of all. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: raam raam dhan sanch bhanddaar |
English: Gather the treasure, the wealth of the Lord, Raam, Raam.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਕਰਿ ਆਹਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: raam raam raam kar aahaar |
English: Let your sustenance be the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਵੀਸਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: raam raam veesar nahee jaae |
English: Never forget the Lord, Raam, Raam.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਬਤਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa gur deea bataae |2|
English: In His Mercy, the Guru has revealed this to me. ||2||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: raam raam raam sadaa sahaae |
English: The Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam, is always our help and support.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: raam raam raam liv laae |
English: Embrace love for the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਜਪਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਭਏ ॥
Transliteration: raam raam jap niramal bhe |
English: Through the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam, I have become immaculate.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਗਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: janam janam ke kilabikh ge |3|
English: The sins of countless incarnations have been taken away. ||3||

Gurbani: ਰਮਤ ਰਾਮ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: ramat raam janam maran nivaarai |
English: Uttering the Lord's Name, birth and death are finished.

Gurbani: ਉਚਰਤ ਰਾਮ ਭੈ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: aucharat raam bhai paar utaarai |
English: Repeating the Lord's Name, one crosses over the terrifying world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਰਾਮ ਪਰਗਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: sabh te aooch raam paragaas |
English: The Luminous Lord is the highest of all.

Gurbani: ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ॥੪॥੮॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: nis baasur jap naanak daas |4|8|10|
English: Night and day, servant Nanak meditates on Him. ||4||8||10||

[Ang 865 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gondd mahalaa 5 |
English: Gond, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਉਨ ਕਉ ਖਸਮਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਠਾਕਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aun kau khasam keenee tthaakahaare |
English: My Lord and Master has held back the five demons.

Gurbani: ਦਾਸ ਸੰਗ ਤੇ ਮਾਰਿ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: daas sang te maar bidaare |
English: He conquered them, and scared them away from the Lord's slave.

Gurbani: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਗਤ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gobind bhagat kaa mehal na paaeaa |
English: They cannot find the mansion of the Lord's devotee.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: raam janaa mil mangal gaaeaa |1|
English: Joining together, the Lord's humble servants sing the songs of joy. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕੇ ਪੰਚ ਸਿਕਦਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: sagal srisatt ke panch sikadaar |
English: The five demons are the rulers of the whole world,

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤ ਕੇ ਪਾਨੀਹਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raam bhagat ke paaneehaar |1| rahaau |
English: but they are just water-carriers for the Lord's devotee. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਗਤ ਪਾਸ ਤੇ ਲੇਤੇ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: jagat paas te lete daan |
English: They collect taxes from the world,

Gurbani: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਗਤ ਕਉ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਲਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: gobind bhagat kau kareh salaam |
English: but they bow in subservience to God's devotees.

Gurbani: ਲੂਟਿ ਲੇਹਿ ਸਾਕਤ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: loott lehi saakat pat khoveh |
English: They plunder and dishonor the faithless cynics,

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਪਗ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਧੋਵਹਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saadh janaa pag mal mal dhoveh |2|
English: but they massage and wash the feet of the Holy. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਪੂਤ ਜਣੇ ਇਕ ਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: panch poot jane ik maae |
English: The One Mother gave birth to the five sons,

Gurbani: ਉਤਭੁਜ ਖੇਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਗਤ ਵਿਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: autabhuj khel kar jagat viaae |
English: and began the play of the created world.

Gurbani: ਤੀਨਿ ਗੁਣਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਚਿ ਰਸੇ ॥
Transliteration: teen gunaa kai sang rach rase |
English: With the three qualities joined together, they celebrate.

Gurbani: ਇਨ ਕਉ ਛੋਡਿ ਊਪਰਿ ਜਨ ਬਸੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ein kau chhodd aoopar jan base |3|
English: Renouncing these three qualities, the Lord's humble servants rise above them. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਨ ਲੀਏ ਛਡਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa jan lee chhaddaae |
English: In His Mercy, He saves His humble servants.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਸੇ ਤਿਨਿ ਰਖੇ ਹਟਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jis ke se tin rakhe hattaae |
English: They belong to Him, and so He saves them by driving out the five.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak bhagat prabh saar |
English: Says Nanak, devotion to God is noble and sublime.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਸਭ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੪॥੯॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: bin bhagatee sabh hoe khuaar |4|9|11|
English: Without devotion, all just waste away uselessly. ||4||9||11||

[Ang 865 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gondd mahalaa 5 |
English: Gond, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਿਟੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kal kales mitte har naae |
English: Suffering and troubles are eradicated by the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਦੁਖ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸੁਖ ਕੀਨੋ ਠਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dukh binase sukh keeno tthaau |
English: Pain is dispelled, and peace takes its place.

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਘਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jap jap amrit naam aghaae |
English: Meditating, chanting the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, I am satisfied.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸਗਲ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sant prasaad sagal fal paae |1|
English: By the Grace of the Saints, I have received all fruitful rewards. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਜਪਤ ਜਨ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: raam japat jan paar pare |
English: Meditating on the Lord, His humble servant is carried across,

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: janam janam ke paap hare |1| rahaau |
English: and the sins of countless incarnations are taken away. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਰਿਦੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur ke charan ridai ur dhaare |
English: I have enshrined the Guru's feet within my heart,

Gurbani: ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਤੇ ਉਤਰੇ ਪਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: agan saagar te utare paare |
English: and crossed over the ocean of fire.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਸਭ ਮਿਟੀ ਉਪਾਧਿ ॥
Transliteration: janam maran sabh mittee upaadh |
English: All the painful diseases of birth and death have been eradicated.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: prabh siau laagee sehaj samaadh |2|
English: I am attached to God in celestial Samaadhi. ||2||

Gurbani: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: thaan thanantar eko suaamee |
English: In all places and interspaces, the One, our Lord and Master is contained.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: sagal ghattaa kaa antarajaamee |
English: He is the Inner-knower of all hearts.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa jaa kau mat dee |
English: One whom the Lord blesses with understanding,

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ਲੇਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar prabh kaa naau lee |3|
English: chants the Name of God, twenty-four hours a day. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai antar vasai prabh aap |
English: Deep within, God Himself abides;

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: taa kai hiradai hoe pragaas |
English: within his heart, the Divine Light shines forth.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat bhaae har keeratan kareeai |
English: With loving devotion, sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਸਤਰੀਐ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: jap paarabraham naanak nisatareeai |4|10|12|
English: Meditate on the Supreme Lord God, O Nanak, and you shall be saved. ||4||10||12||

[Ang 865 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gondd mahalaa 5 |
English: Gond, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: gur ke charan kamal namasakaar |
English: Bow in humility to the lotus feet of the Guru.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh is tan te maar |
English: Eliminate sexual desire and anger from this body.

Gurbani: ਹੋਇ ਰਹੀਐ ਸਗਲ ਕੀ ਰੀਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: hoe raheeai sagal kee reenaa |
English: Be the dust of all,

Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਮਈਆ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਚੀਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt rameea sabh meh cheenaa |1|
English: and see the Lord in each and every heart, in all. ||1||

Gurbani: ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਰਮਹੁ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੋੁਬਿੰਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: ein bidh ramahu gopaal guobind |
English: In this way, dwell upon the Lord of the World, the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਜਿੰਦੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tan dhan prabh kaa prabh kee jind |1| rahaau |
English: My body and wealth belong to God; my soul belongs to God. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar har ke gun gaau |
English: Twenty-four hours a day, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਕੋ ਇਹੈ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
Transliteration: jeea praan ko ihai suaau |
English: This is the purpose of human life.

Gurbani: ਤਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਜਾਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: taj abhimaan jaan prabh sang |
English: Renounce your egotistical pride, and know that God is with you.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saadh prasaad har siau man rang |2|
English: By the Grace of the Holy, let your mind be imbued with the Lord's Love. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂੰ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: jin toon keea tis kau jaan |
English: Know the One who created you,

Gurbani: ਆਗੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: aagai daragah paavai maan |
English: and in the world hereafter you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: man tan niramal hoe nihaal |
English: Your mind and body will be immaculate and blissful;

Gurbani: ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: rasanaa naam japat gopaal |3|
English: chant the Name of the Lord of the Universe with your tongue. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa mere deen deaalaa |
English: Grant Your Kind Mercy, O my Lord, Merciful to the meek.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਮਨੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਰਵਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: saadhoo kee man mangai ravaalaa |
English: My mind begs for the dust of the feet of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਦੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: hohu deaal dehu prabh daan |
English: Be merciful, and bless me with this gift,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: naanak jap jeevai prabh naam |4|11|13|
English: that Nanak may live, chanting God's Name. ||4||11||13||

[Ang 866 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gondd mahalaa 5 |
English: Gond, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਧੂਪ ਦੀਪ ਸੇਵਾ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: dhoop deep sevaa gopaal |
English: My incense and lamps are my service to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਰ ਬੰਦਨ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: anik baar bandan karataar |
English: Time and time again, I humbly bow to the Creator.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਗਹੀ ਸਭ ਤਿਆਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kee saran gahee sabh tiaag |
English: I have renounced everything, and grasped the Sanctuary of God.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur suprasan bhe vaddabhaag |1|
English: By great good fortune, the Guru has become pleased and satisfied with me. ||1||

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗਾਈਐ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar gaaeeai gobind |
English: Twenty-four hours a day, I sing of the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਜਿੰਦੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tan dhan prabh kaa prabh kee jind |1| rahaau |
English: My body and wealth belong to God; my soul belongs to God. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਮਤ ਭਏ ਆਨੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: har gun ramat bhe aanand |
English: Chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord, I am in bliss.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਬਖਸੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham pooran bakhasand |
English: The Supreme Lord God is the Perfect Forgiver.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa jan sevaa laae |
English: Granting His Mercy, He has linked His humble servants to His service.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖ ਮੇਟਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: janam maran dukh mett milaae |2|
English: He has rid me of the pains of birth and death, and merged me with Himself. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਇਹੁ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: karam dharam ihu tat giaan |
English: This is the essence of karma, righteous conduct and spiritual wisdom,

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang japeeai har naam |
English: to chant the Lord's Name in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਸਾਗਰ ਤਰਿ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਰਣ ॥
Transliteration: saagar tar bohith prabh charan |
English: God's Feet are the boat to cross over the world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਣ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: antarajaamee prabh kaaran karan |3|
English: God, the Inner-knower, is the Cause of causes. ||3||

Gurbani: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਅਪਨੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: raakh lee apanee kirapaa dhaar |
English: Showering His Mercy, He Himself has saved me.

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਭਾਗੇ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: panch doot bhaage bikaraal |
English: The five hideous demons have run away.

Gurbani: ਜੂਐ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jooai janam na kabahoo haar |
English: Do not lose your life in the gamble.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਅੰਗੁ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: naanak kaa ang keea karataar |4|12|14|
English: The Creator Lord has taken Nanak's side. ||4||12||14||

[Ang 866 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gondd mahalaa 5 |
English: Gond, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸੁਖ ਅਨਦ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa sukh anad karee |
English: In His Mercy, He has blessed me with peace and bliss.

Gurbani: ਬਾਲਕ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਗੁਰਦੇਵਿ ॥
Transliteration: baalak raakh lee guradev |
English: The Divine Guru has saved His child.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੋੁਬਿੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kirapaal deaal guobind |
English: God is kind and compassionate; He is the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਗਲੇ ਬਖਸਿੰਦ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jeea jant sagale bakhasind |1|
English: He forgives all beings and creatures. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
Transliteration: teree saran prabh deen deaal |
English: I seek Your Sanctuary, O God, O Merciful to the meek.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਜਪਿ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham jap sadaa nihaal |1| rahaau |
English: Meditating on the Supreme Lord God, I am forever in ecstasy. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਇਆਲ ਦੂਸਰ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: prabh deaal doosar koee naahee |
English: There is no other like the Merciful Lord God.

Gurbani: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt antar sarab samaahee |
English: He is contained deep within each and every heart.

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਾ ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਸਵਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: apane daas kaa halat palat savaarai |
English: He embellishes His slave, here and hereafter.

Gurbani: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: patit paavan prabh birad tumaarai |2|
English: It is Your nature, God, to purify sinners. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਉਖਧ ਕੋਟਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: aaukhadh kott simar gobind |
English: Meditation on the Lord of the Universe is the medicine to cure millions of illnesses.

Gurbani: ਤੰਤੁ ਮੰਤੁ ਭਜੀਐ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: tant mant bhajeeai bhagavant |
English: My Tantra and Mantra is to meditate, to vibrate upon the Lord God.

Gurbani: ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਮਿਟੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: rog sog mitte prabh dhiaae |
English: Illnesses and pains are dispelled, meditating on God.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਪੂਰਨ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: man baanchhat pooran fal paae |3|
English: The fruits of the mind's desires are fulfilled. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਰਨ ਕਾਰਨ ਸਮਰਥ ਦਇਆਰ ॥
Transliteration: karan kaaran samarath deaar |
English: He is the Cause of causes, the All-powerful Merciful Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਮਹਾ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: sarab nidhaan mahaa beechaar |
English: Contemplating Him is the greatest of all treasures.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: naanak bakhas lee prabh aap |
English: God Himself has forgiven Nanak;

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਏਕੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa eko har jaap |4|13|15|
English: forever and ever, he chants the Name of the One Lord. ||4||13||15||

[Ang 866 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gondd mahalaa 5 |
English: Gond, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam japahu mere meet |
English: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my friend.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਇ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ਚੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: niramal hoe tumaaraa cheet |
English: Your consciousness shall become immaculate and pure.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਮਿਟੈ ਬਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man tan kee sabh mittai balaae |
English: All the misfortunes of your mind and body shall be taken away,

Gurbani: ਦੂਖੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਸਗਲਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dookh andheraa sagalaa jaae |1|
English: and all your pain and darkness will be dispelled. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ ਤਰੀਐ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: har gun gaavat tareeai sansaar |
English: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, cross over the world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: vaddabhaagee paaeeai purakh apaar |1| rahaau |
English: By great good fortune, one attains the Infinite Lord, the Primal Being. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਕਰੈ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: jo jan karai keeratan gopaal |
English: The Messenger of Death cannot even touch that humble being,

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਪੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: tis kau pohi na sakai jamakaal |
English: Who sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

Gurbani: ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: jag meh aaeaa so paravaan |
English: The Gurmukh realizes his Lord and Master;

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਪਨਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: guramukh apanaa khasam pachhaan |2|
English: His coming into this world is approved. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: har gun gaavai sant prasaad |
English: He sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, by the Grace of the Saints;

Gurbani: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਉਨਮਾਦ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh mitteh unamaad |
English: his sexual desire, anger and madness are eradicated.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ਜਾਣੁ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa hajoor jaan bhagavant |
English: He knows the Lord God to be ever-present.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਮੰਤ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: poore gur kaa pooran mant |3|
English: This is the Perfect Teaching of the Perfect Guru. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਾਟਿ ਕੀਏ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: har dhan khaatt kee bhanddaar |
English: He earns the treasure of the Lord's wealth.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: mil satigur sabh kaaj savaar |
English: Meeting with the True Guru, all his affairs are resolved.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: har ke naam rang sang jaagaa |
English: He is awake and aware in the Love of the Lord's Name;

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: har charanee naanak man laagaa |4|14|16|
English: O Nanak, his mind is attached to the Lord's Feet. ||4||14||16||

[Ang 867 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gondd mahalaa 5 |
English: Gond, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ॥
Transliteration: bhav saagar bohith har charan |
English: The Lord's Feet are the boat to cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਰਣ ॥
Transliteration: simarat naam naahee fir maran |
English: Meditating in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he does not die again.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਮਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਮ ਪੰਥ ॥
Transliteration: har gun ramat naahee jam panth |
English: Chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord, he does not have to walk on the Path of Death.

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਬੀਚਾਰ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤਹ ਮੰਥ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mahaa beechaar panch dootah manth |1|
English: Contemplating the Supreme Lord, the five demons are conquered. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਪੂਰਨ ਨਾਥ ॥
Transliteration: tau saranaaee pooran naath |
English: I have entered Your Sanctuary, O Perfect Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਜੰਤ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਉ ਦੀਜਹਿ ਹਾਥ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jant apane kau deejeh haath |1| rahaau |
English: Please give Your hand to Your creatures. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ॥
Transliteration: simrit saasatr bed puraan |
English: The Simritees, Shaastras, Vedas and Puraanas

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਖਿਆਣ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham kaa kareh vakhiaan |
English: expound upon the Supreme Lord God.

Gurbani: ਜੋਗੀ ਜਤੀ ਬੈਸਨੋ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: jogee jatee baisano raamadaas |
English: The Yogis, celibates, Vaishnavs and followers of Ram Das

Gurbani: ਮਿਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਬਿਨਾਸ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mit naahee braham abinaas |2|
English: cannot find the limits of the Eternal Lord God. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਹ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਿਵ ਦੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: karan palaah kareh siv dev |
English: Shiva and the gods lament and moan,

Gurbani: ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: til nahee boojheh alakh abhev |
English: but they do not understand even a tiny bit of the unseen and unknown Lord.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: prem bhagat jis aape dee |
English: One whom the Lord Himself blesses with loving devotional worship,

Gurbani: ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕੇਈ ਕੇਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jag meh virale keee kee |3|
English: is very rare in this world. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਗੁਣੁ ਕਿਛਹੂ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: mohi niragun gun kichhahoo naeh |
English: I am worthless, with absolutely no virtue at all;

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਤੇਰੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: sarab nidhaan teree drisattee maeh |
English: all treasures are in Your Glance of Grace.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦੀਨੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: naanak deen jaachai teree sev |
English: Nanak, the meek, desires only to serve You.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੀਜੈ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa deejai guradev |4|15|17|
English: Please be merciful, and grant him this blessing, O Divine Guru. ||4||15||17||

[Ang 867 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gondd mahalaa 5 |
English: Gond, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਲੀਆ ਧਰਤਿ ਬਿਦਾਰਉ ॥
Transliteration: sant kaa leea dharat bidaarau |
English: One who is cursed by the Saints, is thrown down on the ground.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਅਕਾਸ ਤੇ ਟਾਰਉ ॥
Transliteration: sant kaa nindak akaas te ttaarau |
English: The slanderer of the Saints is thrown down from the skies.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕਉ ਰਾਖਉ ਅਪਨੇ ਜੀਅ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: sant kau raakhau apane jeea naal |
English: I hold the Saints close to my soul.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਉਧਾਰਉ ਤਤਖਿਣ ਤਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sant udhaarau tatakhin taal |1|
English: The Saints are saved instantaneously. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਸੰਤੁ ਜਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: soee sant ji bhaavai raam |
English: He alone is a Saint, who is pleasing to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕੈ ਏਕੈ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sant gobind kai ekai kaam |1| rahaau |
English: The Saints, and God, have only one job to do. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਊਪਰਿ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਾਥ ॥
Transliteration: sant kai aoopar dee prabh haath |
English: God gives His hand to shelter the Saints.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: sant kai sang basai din raat |
English: He dwells with His Saints, day and night.

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸੰਤਹ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: saas saas santah pratipaal |
English: With each and every breath, He cherishes His Saints.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਰਾਜ ਤੇ ਟਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sant kaa dokhee raaj te ttaal |2|
English: He takes the power away from the enemies of the Saints. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sant kee nindaa karahu na koe |
English: Let no one slander the Saints.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਨਿੰਦੈ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਪਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jo nindai tis kaa patan hoe |
English: Whoever slanders them, will be destroyed.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਰਾਖੈ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jis kau raakhai sirajanahaar |
English: One who is protected by the Creator Lord,

Gurbani: ਝਖ ਮਾਰਉ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jhakh maarau sagal sansaar |3|
English: cannot be harmed, no matter how much the whole world may try. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਾ ਭਇਆ ਬਿਸਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: prabh apane kaa bheaa bisaas |
English: I place my faith in my God.

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: jeeo pindd sabh tis kee raas |
English: My soul and body all belong to Him.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਉਪਜੀ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: naanak kau upajee parateet |
English: This is the faith which inspires Nanak:

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਹਾਰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਸਦ ਜੀਤਿ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: manamukh haar guramukh sad jeet |4|16|18|
English: the self-willed manmukhs will fail, while the Gurmukhs will always win. ||4||16||18||

[Ang 867 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gondd mahalaa 5 |
English: Gond, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਨੀਰਿ ਨਰਾਇਣ ॥
Transliteration: naam niranjan neer naraaein |
English: The Name of the Immaculate Lord is the Ambrosial Water.

Gurbani: ਰਸਨਾ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪਾਪ ਬਿਲਾਇਣ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: rasanaa simarat paap bilaaein |1| rahaau |
English: Chanting it with the tongue, sins are washed away. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਸਭ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: naaraaein sabh maeh nivaas |
English: The Lord abides in everyone.

Gurbani: ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪਰਗਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: naaraaein ghatt ghatt paragaas |
English: The Lord illumines each and every heart.

Gurbani: ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਕਹਤੇ ਨਰਕਿ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: naaraaein kahate narak na jaeh |
English: Chanting the Lord's Name, one does not fall into hell.

Gurbani: ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਗਲ ਫਲ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naaraaein sev sagal fal paeh |1|
English: Serving the Lord, all fruitful rewards are obtained. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: naaraaein man maeh adhaar |
English: Within my mind is the Support of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: naaraaein bohith sansaar |
English: The Lord is the boat to cross over the world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਕਹਤ ਜਮੁ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਲਾਇਣ ॥
Transliteration: naaraaein kehat jam bhaag palaaein |
English: Chant the Lord's Name, and the Messenger of Death will run away.

Gurbani: ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਦੰਤ ਭਾਨੇ ਡਾਇਣ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naaraaein dant bhaane ddaaein |2|
English: The Lord breaks the teeth of Maya, the witch. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਸਦ ਸਦ ਬਖਸਿੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: naaraaein sad sad bakhasind |
English: The Lord is forever and ever the Forgiver.

Gurbani: ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਕੀਨੇ ਸੂਖ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: naaraaein keene sookh anand |
English: The Lord blesses us with peace and bliss.

Gurbani: ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਕੀਨੋ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥
Transliteration: naaraaein pragatt keeno parataap |
English: The Lord has revealed His glory.
