Gurbani: ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਸੰਤ ਕੋ ਮਾਈ ਬਾਪ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naaraaein sant ko maaee baap |3|
English: The Lord is the mother and father of His Saint. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਰਾਇਣ ॥
Transliteration: naaraaein saadhasang naraaein |
English: The Lord, the Lord, is in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਬਾਰੰ ਬਾਰ ਨਰਾਇਣ ਗਾਇਣ ॥
Transliteration: baaran baar naraaein gaaein |
English: Time and time again, I sing the Lord's Praises.

Gurbani: ਬਸਤੁ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਲਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: basat agochar gur mil lahee |
English: Meeting with the Guru, I have attained the incomprehensible object.

Gurbani: ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਓਟ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਗਹੀ ॥੪॥੧੭॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: naaraaein ott naanak daas gahee |4|17|19|
English: Slave Nanak has grasped the Support of the Lord. ||4||17||19||

[Ang 868 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gondd mahalaa 5 |
English: Gond, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਰਾਖੈ ਰਾਖਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kau raakhai raakhanahaar |
English: One who is protected by the Protector Lord

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਅੰਗੁ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tis kaa ang kare nirankaar |1| rahaau |
English: - the Formless Lord is on his side. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਮਹਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਜੋਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: maat garabh meh agan na johai |
English: In the mother's womb, the fire does not touch him.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਨ ਪੋਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh lobh mohu na pohai |
English: Sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment do not affect him.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਪੈ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang japai nirankaar |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he meditates on the Formless Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: nindak kai muhi laagai chhaar |1|
English: Dust is thrown into the faces of the slanderers. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਕਵਚੁ ਦਾਸ ਕਾ ਸੰਨਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: raam kavach daas kaa sanaahu |
English: The Lord's protective spell is the armor of His slave.

Gurbani: ਦੂਤ ਦੁਸਟ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੋਹਤ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: doot dusatt tis pohat naeh |
English: The wicked, evil demons cannot even touch him.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਗਰਬੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jo jo garab kare so jaae |
English: Whoever indulges in egotistical pride, shall waste away to ruin.

Gurbani: ਗਰੀਬ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gareeb daas kee prabh saranaae |2|
English: God is the Sanctuary of His humble slave. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jo jo saran peaa har raae |
English: Whoever enters the Sanctuary of the Sovereign Lord

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਦਾਸੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਅਪਣੈ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: so daas rakhiaa apanai kantth laae |
English: - He saves that slave, hugging him close in His embrace.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕਰੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: je ko bahut kare ahankaar |
English: Whoever takes great pride in himself,

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਰੁਲਤਾ ਖਾਕੂ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ohu khin meh rulataa khaakoo naal |3|
English: in an instant, shall be like dust mixing with dust. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹੈ ਭੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਹੋਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: hai bhee saachaa hovanahaar |
English: The True Lord is, and shall always be.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਾੲਂੀ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa jaaenee balihaar |
English: Forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to Him.

Gurbani: ਅਪਣੇ ਦਾਸ ਰਖੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: apane daas rakhe kirapaa dhaar |
English: Granting His Mercy, He saves His slaves.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰ ॥੪॥੧੮॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: naanak ke prabh praan adhaar |4|18|20|
English: God is the Support of Nanak's breath of life. ||4||18||20||

[Ang 868 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gondd mahalaa 5 |
English: Gond, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਚਰਜ ਕਥਾ ਮਹਾ ਅਨੂਪ ॥
Transliteration: acharaj kathaa mahaa anoop |
English: Wondrous and beautiful is the description of the beauty of the Supreme Soul,

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਾਤਮਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਾ ਰੂਪੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: praatamaa paarabraham kaa roop | rahaau |
English: The Supreme Lord God. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਬੂਢਾ ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਬਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: naa ihu boodtaa naa ihu baalaa |
English: He is not old; He is not young.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਇਸੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਮ ਜਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: naa is dookh nahee jam jaalaa |
English: He is not in pain; He is not caught in Death's noose.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: naa ihu binasai naa ihu jaae |
English: He does not die; He does not go away.

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aad jugaadee rahiaa samaae |1|
English: In the beginning, and throughout the ages, He is permeating everywhere. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਇਸੁ ਉਸਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਇਸੁ ਸੀਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: naa is usan nahee is seet |
English: He is not hot; He is not cold.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਇਸੁ ਦੁਸਮਨੁ ਨਾ ਇਸੁ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: naa is dusaman naa is meet |
English: He has no enemy; He has no friend.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਇਸੁ ਹਰਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਇਸੁ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: naa is harakh nahee is sog |
English: He is not happy; He is not sad.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਇਸ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਕਰਨੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh is kaa ihu karanai jog |2|
English: Everything belongs to Him; He can do anything. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਇਸੁ ਬਾਪੁ ਨਹੀ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: naa is baap nahee is maaeaa |
English: He has no father; He has no mother.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਹੋਤਾ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: eihu aparanpar hotaa aaeaa |
English: He is beyond the beyond, and has always been so.

Gurbani: ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਕਾ ਇਸੁ ਲੇਪੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: paap pun kaa is lep na laagai |
English: He is not affected by virtue or vice.

Gurbani: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਜਾਗੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt antar sad hee jaagai |3|
English: Deep within each and every heart, He is always awake and aware. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤੀਨਿ ਗੁਣਾ ਇਕ ਸਕਤਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: teen gunaa ik sakat upaaeaa |
English: From the three qualities, the one mechanism of Maya was produced.

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਹੈ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: mahaa maaeaa taa kee hai chhaaeaa |
English: The great Maya is only His shadow.

Gurbani: ਅਛਲ ਅਛੇਦ ਅਭੇਦ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
Transliteration: achhal achhed abhed deaal |
English: He is undeceivable, impenetrable, unfathomable and merciful.

Gurbani: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਦਾ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: deen deaal sadaa kirapaal |
English: He is merciful to the meek, forever compassionate.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: taa kee gat mit kachhoo na paae |
English: His state and limits cannot ever be known.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੯॥੨੧॥
Transliteration: naanak taa kai bal bal jaae |4|19|21|
English: Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to Him. ||4||19||21||

[Ang 869 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: gondd mahalaa 5 |
English: Gond, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: santan kai balihaarai jaau |
English: I am a sacrifice to the Saints.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: santan kai sang raam gun gaau |
English: Associating with the Saints, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਸਭਿ ਗਏ ॥
Transliteration: sant prasaad kilavikh sabh ge |
English: By the Grace of the Saints, all the sins are taken away.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਸਰਣਿ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sant saran vaddabhaagee pe |1|
English: By great good fortune, one finds the Sanctuary of the Saints. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਕਛੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: raam japat kachh bighan na viaapai |
English: Meditating on the Lord, no obstacles will block your way.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad apunaa prabh jaapai |1| rahaau |
English: By Guru's Grace, meditate on God. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਬ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham jab hoe deaal |
English: When the Supreme Lord God becomes merciful,

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਕਰੈ ਰਵਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: saadhoo jan kee karai ravaal |
English: he makes me the dust of the feet of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh is tan te jaae |
English: Sexual desire and anger leave his body,

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: raam ratan vasai man aae |2|
English: and the Lord, the jewel, comes to dwell in his mind. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਾਂ ਕਾ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: safal janam taan kaa paravaan |
English: Fruitful and approved is the life of one

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham nikatt kar jaan |
English: who knows the Supreme Lord God to be close.

Gurbani: ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਰਤਨਿ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: bhaae bhagat prabh keeratan laagai |
English: One who is committed to loving devotional worship of God, and the Kirtan of His Praises,

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਸੋਇਆ ਜਾਗੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: janam janam kaa soeaa jaagai |3|
English: awakens from the sleep of countless incarnations. ||3||

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal jan kaa aadhaar |
English: The Lord's Lotus Feet are the Support of His humble servant.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਰਉਂ ਸਚੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: gun govind raun sach vaapaar |
English: To chant the Praises of the Lord of the Universe is the true trade.

Gurbani: ਦਾਸ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: daas janaa kee manasaa poor |
English: Please fulfill the hopes of Your humble slave.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਨ ਧੂਰਿ ॥੪॥੨੦॥੨੨॥੬॥੨੮॥
Transliteration: naanak sukh paavai jan dhoor |4|20|22|6|28|
English: Nanak finds peace in the dust of the feet of the humble. ||4||20||22||6||28||

[Ang 869 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੋਂਡ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: raag gondd asattapadeea mahalaa 5 ghar 2 |
English: Raag Gond, Ashtpadheeyaa, Fifth Mehl, Second House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: kar namasakaar poore guradev |
English: Humbly bow to the Perfect Divine Guru.

Gurbani: ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਸਫਲ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: safal moorat safal jaa kee sev |
English: Fruitful is His image, and fruitful is service to Him.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: antarajaamee purakh bidhaataa |
English: He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, the Architect of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar naam rang raataa |1|
English: Twenty-four hours a day, he remains imbued with the love of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: gur gobind guroo gopaal |
English: The Guru is the Lord of the Universe, the Guru is the Lord of the World.

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: apane daas kau raakhanahaar |1| rahaau |
English: He is the Saving Grace of His slaves. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਸਾਹ ਉਮਰਾਉ ਪਤੀਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: paatisaah saah umaraau pateeae |
English: He satisfies the kings, emperors and nobles.

Gurbani: ਦੁਸਟ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਚਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: dusatt ahankaaree maar pachaae |
English: He destroys the egotistical villains.

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਕੀਨੋ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: nindak kai mukh keeno rog |
English: He puts illness into the mouths of the slanderers.

Gurbani: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਕਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਗੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jai jai kaar karai sabh log |2|
English: All the people celebrate His victory. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: santan kai man mahaa anand |
English: Supreme bliss fills the minds of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਜਪਹਿ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਭਗਵੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: sant japeh guradeo bhagavant |
English: The Saints meditate on the Divine Guru, the Lord God.

Gurbani: ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਭਏ ॥
Transliteration: sangat ke mukh aoojal bhe |
English: The faces of His companions become radiant and bright.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਥਾਨ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕੇ ਗਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sagal thaan nindak ke ge |3|
English: The slanderers lose all places of rest. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਜਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: saas saas jan sadaa salaahe |
English: With each and every breath, the Lord's humble slaves praise Him.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham gur beparavaahe |
English: The Supreme Lord God and the Guru are care-free.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਭੈ ਮਿਟੇ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: sagal bhai mitte jaa kee saran |
English: All fears are eradicated, in His Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਾਏ ਸਭਿ ਧਰਨਿ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: nindak maar paae sabh dharan |4|
English: Smashing all the slanderers, the Lord knocks them to the ground. ||4||

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jan kee nindaa karai na koe |
English: Let no one slander the Lord's humble servants.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਰੈ ਸੋ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jo karai so dukheea hoe |
English: Whoever does so, will be miserable.

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਜਨੁ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar jan ek dhiaae |
English: Twenty-four hours a day, the Lord's humble servant meditates on Him alone.

Gurbani: ਜਮੂਆ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: jamooaa taa kai nikatt na jaae |5|
English: The Messenger of Death does not even approach him. ||5||

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਿਰਵੈਰ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jan niravair nindak ahankaaree |
English: The Lord's humble servant has no vengeance. The slanderer is egotistical.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਭਲ ਮਾਨਹਿ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਵੇਕਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jan bhal maaneh nindak vekaaree |
English: The Lord's humble servant wishes well, while the slanderer dwells on evil.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਿਖਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sikh satiguroo dhiaaeaa |
English: The Sikh of the Guru meditates on the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਉਬਰੇ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਨਰਕਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: jan ubare nindak narak paaeaa |6|
English: The Lord's humble servants are saved, while the slanderer is cast into hell. ||6||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sun saajan mere meet piaare |
English: Listen, O my beloved friends and companions:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿ ਬਚਨ ਵਰਤਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sat bachan varateh har duaare |
English: these words shall be true in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜੈਸਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਤੈਸਾ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jaisaa kare su taisaa paae |
English: As you plant, so shall you harvest.

Gurbani: ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਕੀ ਜੜ ਸਰਪਰ ਜਾਏ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: abhimaanee kee jarr sarapar jaae |7|
English: The proud, egotistical person will surely be uprooted. ||7||

Gurbani: ਨੀਧਰਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਧਰ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: needhariaa satigur dhar teree |
English: O True Guru, You are the Support of the unsupported.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਜਨ ਕੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa raakhahu jan keree |
English: Be merciful, and save Your humble servant.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak tis gur balihaaree |
English: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Guru;

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੮॥੧॥੨੯॥
Transliteration: jaa kai simaran paij savaaree |8|1|29|
English: remembering Him in meditation, my honor has been saved. ||8||1||29||

[Ang 870 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੋਂਡ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ॥ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raag gondd baanee bhagataa kee | kabeer jee ghar 1 |
English: Raag Gond, The Word Of The Devotees. Kabeer Jee, First House:

[Ang 870 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸੰਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: sant milai kichh suneeai kaheeai |
English: When you meet a Saint, talk to him and listen.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲੈ ਅਸੰਤੁ ਮਸਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: milai asant masatt kar raheeai |1|
English: Meeting with an unsaintly person, just remain silent. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਾਬਾ ਬੋਲਨਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: baabaa bolanaa kiaa kaheeai |
English: O father, if I speak, what words should I utter?

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaise raam naam rav raheeai |1| rahaau |
English: Speak such words, by which you may remain absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਨ ਸਿਉ ਬੋਲੇ ਉਪਕਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: santan siau bole upakaaree |
English: Speaking with the Saints, one becomes generous.

Gurbani: ਮੂਰਖ ਸਿਉ ਬੋਲੇ ਝਖ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: moorakh siau bole jhakh maaree |2|
English: To speak with a fool is to babble uselessly. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬੋਲਤ ਬੋਲਤ ਬਢਹਿ ਬਿਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: bolat bolat badteh bikaaraa |
English: By speaking and only speaking, corruption only increases.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੋਲੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bin bole kiaa kareh beechaaraa |3|
English: If I do not speak, what can the poor wretch do? ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਛੂਛਾ ਘਟੁ ਬੋਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer chhoochhaa ghatt bolai |
English: Says Kabeer, the empty pitcher makes noise,

Gurbani: ਭਰਿਆ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਡੋਲੈ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: bhariaa hoe su kabahu na ddolai |4|1|
English: but that which is full makes no sound. ||4||1||

[Ang 870 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੋਂਡ ॥
Transliteration: gondd |
English: Gond:

Gurbani: ਨਰੂ ਮਰੈ ਨਰੁ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: naroo marai nar kaam na aavai |
English: When a man dies, he is of no use to anyone.

Gurbani: ਪਸੂ ਮਰੈ ਦਸ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: pasoo marai das kaaj savaarai |1|
English: But when an animal dies, it is used in ten ways. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੇ ਕਰਮ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮੈ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਨਉ ॥
Transliteration: apane karam kee gat mai kiaa jaanau |
English: What do I know, about the state of my karma?

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਨਉ ਬਾਬਾ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mai kiaa jaanau baabaa re |1| rahaau |
English: What do I know, O Baba? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਾਡ ਜਲੇ ਜੈਸੇ ਲਕਰੀ ਕਾ ਤੂਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: haadd jale jaise lakaree kaa toolaa |
English: His bones burn, like a bundle of logs;

Gurbani: ਕੇਸ ਜਲੇ ਜੈਸੇ ਘਾਸ ਕਾ ਪੂਲਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kes jale jaise ghaas kaa poolaa |2|
English: his hair burns like a bale of hay. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਨਰੁ ਜਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer tab hee nar jaagai |
English: Says Kabeer, the man wakes up,

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਕਾ ਡੰਡੁ ਮੂੰਡ ਮਹਿ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੩॥੨॥
Transliteration: jam kaa ddandd moondd meh laagai |3|2|
English: only when the Messenger of Death hits him over the head with his club. ||3||2||

[Ang 870 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੋਂਡ ॥
Transliteration: gondd |
English: Gond:

Gurbani: ਆਕਾਸਿ ਗਗਨੁ ਪਾਤਾਲਿ ਗਗਨੁ ਹੈ ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸਿ ਗਗਨੁ ਰਹਾਇਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: aakaas gagan paataal gagan hai chahu dis gagan rahaaeile |
English: The Celestial Lord is in the Akaashic ethers of the skies, the Celestial Lord is in the nether regions of the underworld; in the four directions, the Celestial Lord is pervading.

Gurbani: ਆਨਦ ਮੂਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮੁ ਘਟੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਗਗਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇਲੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aanad mool sadaa purakhotam ghatt binasai gagan na jaaeile |1|
English: The Supreme Lord God is forever the source of bliss. When the vessel of the body perishes, the Celestial Lord does not perish. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਭਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: mohi bairaag bheo |
English: I have become sad,

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਆਇ ਕਹਾ ਗਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: eihu jeeo aae kahaa geo |1| rahaau |
English: wondering where the soul comes from, and where it goes. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਕੀਨੑੀ ਤਤੁ ਕਹਾ ਤੇ ਕੀਨੁ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: panch tat mil kaaeaa keenaee tat kahaa te keen re |
English: The body is formed from the union of the five tatvas; but where were the five tatvas created?

Gurbani: ਕਰਮ ਬਧ ਤੁਮ ਜੀਉ ਕਹਤ ਹੌ ਕਰਮਹਿ ਕਿਨਿ ਜੀਉ ਦੀਨੁ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: karam badh tum jeeo kehat hau karameh kin jeeo deen re |2|
English: You say that the soul is tied to its karma, but who gave karma to the body? ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਮਹਿ ਤਨੁ ਹੈ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹੈ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਸੋਇ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har meh tan hai tan meh har hai sarab nirantar soe re |
English: The body is contained in the Lord, and the Lord is contained in the body. He is permeating within all.

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਉ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਰੇ ॥੩॥੩॥
Transliteration: keh kabeer raam naam na chhoddau sahaje hoe su hoe re |3|3|
English: Says Kabeer, I shall not renounce the Lord's Name. I shall accept whatever happens. ||3||3||

[Ang 870 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੋਂਡ ਬਾਣੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: raag gondd baanee kabeer jeeo kee ghar 2 |
English: Raag Gond, The Word Of Kabeer Jee, Second House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਭੁਜਾ ਬਾਂਧਿ ਭਿਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਡਾਰਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: bhujaa baandh bhilaa kar ddaario |
English: They tied my arms, bundled me up, and threw me before an elephant.

Gurbani: ਹਸਤੀ ਕ੍ਰੋਪਿ ਮੂੰਡ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਰਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: hasatee krop moondd meh maario |
English: The elephant driver struck him on the head, and infuriated him.

Gurbani: ਹਸਤਿ ਭਾਗਿ ਕੈ ਚੀਸਾ ਮਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: hasat bhaag kai cheesaa maarai |
English: But the elephant ran away, trumpeting,

Gurbani: ਇਆ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: eaa moorat kai hau balihaarai |1|
English: "I am a sacrifice to this image of the Lord." ||1||

Gurbani: ਆਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: aaeh mere tthaakur tumaraa jor |
English: O my Lord and Master, You are my strength.

Gurbani: ਕਾਜੀ ਬਕਿਬੋ ਹਸਤੀ ਤੋਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kaajee bakibo hasatee tor |1| rahaau |
English: The Qazi shouted at the driver to drive the elephant on. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਰੇ ਮਹਾਵਤ ਤੁਝੁ ਡਾਰਉ ਕਾਟਿ ॥
Transliteration: re mahaavat tujh ddaarau kaatt |
English: He yelled out, "O driver, I shall cut you into pieces.

Gurbani: ਇਸਹਿ ਤੁਰਾਵਹੁ ਘਾਲਹੁ ਸਾਟਿ ॥
Transliteration: eiseh turaavahu ghaalahu saatt |
English: Hit him, and drive him on!"

Gurbani: ਹਸਤਿ ਨ ਤੋਰੈ ਧਰੈ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: hasat na torai dharai dhiaan |
English: But the elephant did not move; instead, he began to meditate.

Gurbani: ਵਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸੈ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: vaa kai ridai basai bhagavaan |2|
English: The Lord God abides within his mind. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਅਪਰਾਧੁ ਸੰਤ ਹੈ ਕੀਨੑਾ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa aparaadh sant hai keenaa |
English: What sin has this Saint committed,

Gurbani: ਬਾਂਧਿ ਪੋਟ ਕੁੰਚਰ ਕਉ ਦੀਨੑਾ ॥
Transliteration: baandh pott kunchar kau deenaa |
English: that you have made him into a bundle and thrown him before the elephant?

Gurbani: ਕੁੰਚਰੁ ਪੋਟ ਲੈ ਲੈ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: kunchar pott lai lai namasakaarai |
English: Lifting up the bundle, the elephant bows down before it.

Gurbani: ਬੂਝੀ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਜੀ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: boojhee nahee kaajee andhiaarai |3|
English: The Qazi could not understand it; he was blind. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤੀਨਿ ਬਾਰ ਪਤੀਆ ਭਰਿ ਲੀਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: teen baar pateea bhar leenaa |
English: Three times, he tried to do it.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕਠੋਰੁ ਅਜਹੂ ਨ ਪਤੀਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: man katthor ajahoo na pateenaa |
English: Even then, his hardened mind was not satisfied.

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਹਮਰਾ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: keh kabeer hamaraa gobind |
English: Says Kabeer, such is my Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਚਉਥੇ ਪਦ ਮਹਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਜਿੰਦੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੪॥
Transliteration: chauthe pad meh jan kee jind |4|1|4|
English: The soul of His humble servant dwells in the fourth state. ||4||1||4||

[Ang 871 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੋਂਡ ॥
Transliteration: gondd |
English: Gond:

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਮਾਨਸੁ ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਦੇਉ ॥
Transliteration: naa ihu maanas naa ihu deo |
English: It is not human, and it is not a god.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਜਤੀ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਸੇਉ ॥
Transliteration: naa ihu jatee kahaavai seo |
English: It is not called celibate, or a worshipper of Shiva.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਨਾ ਅਵਧੂਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: naa ihu jogee naa avadhootaa |
English: It is not a Yogi, and it is not a hermit.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਇ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਪੂਤਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naa is maae na kaahoo pootaa |1|
English: It is not a mother, or anyone's son. ||1||

Gurbani: ਇਆ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਿ ਕੌਨ ਬਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: eaa mandar meh kauan basaaee |
English: Then what is it, which dwells in this temple of the body?

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: taa kaa ant na koaoo paaee |1| rahaau |
English: No one can find its limits. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਨਾ ਓਦਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: naa ihu girahee naa odaasee |
English: It is not a house-holder, and it is not a renouncer of the world.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਰਾਜ ਨ ਭੀਖ ਮੰਗਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: naa ihu raaj na bheekh mangaasee |
English: It is not a king, and it is not a beggar.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਇਸੁ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਨ ਰਕਤੂ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: naa is pindd na rakatoo raatee |
English: It has no body, no drop of blood.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਨੁ ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਖਾਤੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naa ihu brahaman naa ihu khaatee |2|
English: It is not a Brahmin, and it is not a Kh'shaatriya. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਤਪਾ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਸੇਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: naa ihu tapaa kahaavai sekh |
English: It is not called a man of austere self-discipline, or a Shaykh.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਨ ਮਰਤਾ ਦੇਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: naa ihu jeevai na marataa dekh |
English: It does not live, and it is not seen to die.

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਮਰਤੇ ਕਉ ਜੇ ਕੋਊ ਰੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: eis marate kau je koaoo rovai |
English: If someone cries over its death,

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਰੋਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਵੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jo rovai soee pat khovai |3|
English: that person loses his honor. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮੈ ਡਗਰੋ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad mai ddagaro paaeaa |
English: By Guru's Grace, I have found the Path.

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਨ ਮਰਨੁ ਦੋਊ ਮਿਟਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jeevan maran doaoo mittavaaeaa |
English: Birth and death have both been erased.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਇਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਅੰਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer ihu raam kee ans |
English: Says Kabeer, this is formed of the same essence as the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਸ ਕਾਗਦ ਪਰ ਮਿਟੈ ਨ ਮੰਸੁ ॥੪॥੨॥੫॥
Transliteration: jas kaagad par mittai na mans |4|2|5|
English: It is like the ink on the paper which cannot be erased. ||4||2||5||

[Ang 871 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੋਂਡ ॥
Transliteration: gondd |
English: Gond:

Gurbani: ਤੂਟੇ ਤਾਗੇ ਨਿਖੁਟੀ ਪਾਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: tootte taage nikhuttee paan |
English: The threads are broken, and the starch has run out.

Gurbani: ਦੁਆਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਝਿਲਕਾਵਹਿ ਕਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: duaar aoopar jhilakaaveh kaan |
English: Bare reeds glisten at the front door.

Gurbani: ਕੂਚ ਬਿਚਾਰੇ ਫੂਏ ਫਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: kooch bichaare fooe faal |
English: The poor brushes are scattered in pieces.

Gurbani: ਇਆ ਮੁੰਡੀਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਚਢਿਬੋ ਕਾਲ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: eaa munddeea sir chadtibo kaal |1|
English: Death has entered this shaven head. ||1||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮੁੰਡੀਆ ਸਗਲੋ ਦ੍ਰਬੁ ਖੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: eihu munddeea sagalo drab khoee |
English: This shaven-headed mendicant has wasted all his wealth.

Gurbani: ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਨਾਕ ਸਰ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aavat jaat naak sar hoee |1| rahaau |
English: All this coming and going has irritated him. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੁਰੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਕੀ ਛੋਡੀ ਬਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: turee naar kee chhoddee baataa |
English: He has given up all talk of his weaving equipment.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਵਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam vaa kaa man raataa |
English: His mind is attuned to the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਲਰਿਕੀ ਲਰਿਕਨ ਖੈਬੋ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: larikee larikan khaibo naeh |
English: His daughters and sons have nothing to eat,

Gurbani: ਮੁੰਡੀਆ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਧਾਪੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: munddeea anadin dhaape jaeh |2|
English: while the shaven-headed mendicants night and day eat their fill. ||2||

Gurbani: ਇਕ ਦੁਇ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਇਕ ਦੁਇ ਬਾਟ ॥
Transliteration: eik due mandar ik due baatt |
English: One or two are in the house, and one or two more are on the way.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਕਉ ਸਾਥਰੁ ਉਨ ਕਉ ਖਾਟ ॥
Transliteration: ham kau saathar un kau khaatt |
English: We sleep on the floor, while they sleep in the beds.

Gurbani: ਮੂਡ ਪਲੋਸਿ ਕਮਰ ਬਧਿ ਪੋਥੀ ॥
Transliteration: moodd palos kamar badh pothee |
English: They rub their bare heads, and carry prayer-books in their waist-bands.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਕਉ ਚਾਬਨੁ ਉਨ ਕਉ ਰੋਟੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ham kau chaaban un kau rottee |3|
English: We get dry grains, while they get loaves of bread. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮੁੰਡੀਆ ਮੁੰਡੀਆ ਹੂਏ ਏਕ ॥
Transliteration: munddeea munddeea hooe ek |
English: He will become one of these shaven-headed mendicants.

Gurbani: ਏ ਮੁੰਡੀਆ ਬੂਡਤ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ॥
Transliteration: e munddeea booddat kee ttek |
English: They are the support of the drowning.

Gurbani: ਸੁਨਿ ਅੰਧਲੀ ਲੋਈ ਬੇਪੀਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: sun andhalee loee bepeer |
English: Listen, O blind and unguided Loi:

Gurbani: ਇਨੑ ਮੁੰਡੀਅਨ ਭਜਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਕਬੀਰ ॥੪॥੩॥੬॥
Transliteration: eina munddeean bhaj saran kabeer |4|3|6|
English: Kabeer has taken shelter with these shaven-headed mendicants. ||4||3||6||

[Ang 871 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੋਂਡ ॥
Transliteration: gondd |
English: Gond:

Gurbani: ਖਸਮੁ ਮਰੈ ਤਉ ਨਾਰਿ ਨ ਰੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: khasam marai tau naar na rovai |
English: When her husband dies, the woman does not cry.

Gurbani: ਉਸੁ ਰਖਵਾਰਾ ਅਉਰੋ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: aus rakhavaaraa aauro hovai |
English: Someone else becomes her protector.

Gurbani: ਰਖਵਾਰੇ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਨਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: rakhavaare kaa hoe binaas |
English: When this protector dies,

Gurbani: ਆਗੈ ਨਰਕੁ ਈਹਾ ਭੋਗ ਬਿਲਾਸ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aagai narak eehaa bhog bilaas |1|
English: he falls into the world of hell hereafter, for the sexual pleasures he enjoyed in this world. ||1||

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਜਗਤ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: ek suhaagan jagat piaaree |
English: The world loves only the one bride, Maya.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਕੀ ਨਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sagale jeea jant kee naaree |1| rahaau |
English: She is the wife of all beings and creatures. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੋਹਾਗਨਿ ਗਲਿ ਸੋਹੈ ਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sohaagan gal sohai haar |
English: With her necklace around her neck, this bride looks beautiful.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕਉ ਬਿਖੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sant kau bikh bigasai sansaar |
English: She is poison to the Saint, but the world is delighted with her.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਹੈ ਪਖਿਆਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kar seegaar bahai pakhiaaree |
English: Adorning herself, she sits like a prostitute.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਠਿਠਕੀ ਫਿਰੈ ਬਿਚਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sant kee tthitthakee firai bichaaree |2|
English: Cursed by the Saints, she wanders around like a wretch. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਭਾਗਿ ਓਹ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: sant bhaag oeh paachhai parai |
English: She runs around, chasing after the Saints.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਾਰਹੁ ਡਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee maarahu ddarai |
English: She is afraid of being beaten by those blessed with the Guru's Grace.

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤ ਕੀ ਓਹ ਪਿੰਡ ਪਰਾਇਣਿ ॥
Transliteration: saakat kee oeh pindd paraaein |
English: She is the body, the breath of life, of the faithless cynics.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਕਉ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਪਰੈ ਤ੍ਰਖਿ ਡਾਇਣਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ham kau drisatt parai trakh ddaaein |3|
English: She appears to me like a blood-thirsty witch. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਬਹੁ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਭੇਉ ॥
Transliteration: ham tis kaa bahu jaaniaa bheo |
English: I know her secrets well

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਹੂਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ॥
Transliteration: jab hooe kripaal mile guradeo |
English: in His Mercy, the Divine Guru met me.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਅਬ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਪਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer ab baahar paree |
English: Says Kabeer, now I have thrown her out.

Gurbani: ਸੰਸਾਰੈ ਕੈ ਅੰਚਲਿ ਲਰੀ ॥੪॥੪॥੭॥
Transliteration: sansaarai kai anchal laree |4|4|7|
English: She clings to the skirt of the world. ||4||4||7||

[Ang 872 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੋਂਡ ॥
Transliteration: gondd |
English: Gond:

Gurbani: ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰੇ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: grihi sobhaa jaa kai re naeh |
English: When someone's household has no glory,

Gurbani: ਆਵਤ ਪਹੀਆ ਖੂਧੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: aavat paheea khoodhe jaeh |
English: the guests who come there depart still hungry.

Gurbani: ਵਾ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: vaa kai antar nahee santokh |
English: Deep within, there is no contentment.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਨਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਦੋਖੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bin sohaagan laagai dokh |1|
English: Without his bride, the wealth of Maya, he suffers in pain. ||1||

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਨਿ ਮਹਾ ਪਵੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: dhan sohaagan mahaa paveet |
English: So praise this bride, which can shake the consciousness

Gurbani: ਤਪੇ ਤਪੀਸਰ ਡੋਲੈ ਚੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tape tapeesar ddolai cheet |1| rahaau |
English: Of even the most dedicated ascetics and sages. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੋਹਾਗਨਿ ਕਿਰਪਨ ਕੀ ਪੂਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: sohaagan kirapan kee pootee |
English: This bride is the daughter of a wretched miser.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਕ ਤਜਿ ਜਗਤ ਸਿਉ ਸੂਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: sevak taj jagat siau sootee |
English: Abandoning the Lord's servant, she sleeps with the world.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਠਾਢੀ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: saadhoo kai tthaadtee darabaar |
English: Standing at the door of the holy man,

Gurbani: ਸਰਨਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saran teree mo kau nisataar |2|
English: she says, "I have come to your sanctuary; now save me!" ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੋਹਾਗਨਿ ਹੈ ਅਤਿ ਸੁੰਦਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: sohaagan hai at sundaree |
English: This bride is so beautiful.

Gurbani: ਪਗ ਨੇਵਰ ਛਨਕ ਛਨਹਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: pag nevar chhanak chhanaharee |
English: The bells on her ankles make soft music.

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਲਗੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਤਊ ਲਗੁ ਸੰਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: jau lag praan taoo lag sange |
English: As long as there is the breath of life in the man, she remains attached to him.

Gurbani: ਨਾਹਿ ਤ ਚਲੀ ਬੇਗਿ ਉਠਿ ਨੰਗੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naeh ta chalee beg utth nange |3|
English: But when it is no more, she quickly gets up and departs, bare-footed. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੋਹਾਗਨਿ ਭਵਨ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਲੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: sohaagan bhavan trai leea |
English: This bride has conquered the three worlds.

Gurbani: ਦਸ ਅਠ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਤੀਰਥ ਰਸ ਕੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: das atth puraan teerath ras keea |
English: The eighteen Puraanas and the sacred shrines of pilgrimage love her as well.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸਰ ਬੇਧੇ ॥
Transliteration: brahamaa bisan mahesar bedhe |
English: She pierced the hearts of Brahma, Shiva and Vishnu.

Gurbani: ਬਡੇ ਭੂਪਤਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਹੈ ਛੇਧੇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: badde bhoopat raaje hai chhedhe |4|
English: She destroyed the great emperors and kings of the world. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸੋਹਾਗਨਿ ਉਰਵਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: sohaagan uravaar na paar |
English: This bride has no restraint or limits.

Gurbani: ਪਾਂਚ ਨਾਰਦ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਿਧਵਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: paanch naarad kai sang bidhavaar |
English: She is in collusion with the five thieving passions.

Gurbani: ਪਾਂਚ ਨਾਰਦ ਕੇ ਮਿਟਵੇ ਫੂਟੇ ॥
Transliteration: paanch naarad ke mittave footte |
English: When the clay pot of these five passions bursts,

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਛੂਟੇ ॥੫॥੫॥੮॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer gur kirapaa chhootte |5|5|8|
English: then, says Kabeer, by Guru's Mercy, one is released. ||5||5||8||

[Ang 872 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੋਂਡ ॥
Transliteration: gondd |
English: Gond:

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੇ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਿ ਬਲਹਰ ਨਾ ਠਾਹਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: jaise mandar meh balahar naa tthaaharai |
English: As the house will not stand when the supporting beams are removed from within it,

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: naam binaa kaise paar utarai |
English: just so, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, how can anyone be carried across?

Gurbani: ਕੁੰਭ ਬਿਨਾ ਜਲੁ ਨਾ ਟੀਕਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: kunbh binaa jal naa tteekaavai |
English: Without the pitcher, the water is not contained;

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਬਿਨੁ ਐਸੇ ਅਬਗਤੁ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saadhoo bin aise abagat jaavai |1|
English: just so, without the Holy Saint, the mortal departs in misery. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਾਰਉ ਤਿਸੈ ਜੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ॥
Transliteration: jaarau tisai ju raam na chetai |
English: One who does not remember the Lord - let him burn;

Gurbani: ਤਨ ਮਨ ਰਮਤ ਰਹੈ ਮਹਿ ਖੇਤੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tan man ramat rahai meh khetai |1| rahaau |
English: his body and mind have remained absorbed in this field of the world. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੇ ਹਲਹਰ ਬਿਨਾ ਜਿਮੀ ਨਹੀ ਬੋਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: jaise halahar binaa jimee nahee boeeai |
English: Without a farmer, the land is not planted;

Gurbani: ਸੂਤ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਮਣੀ ਪਰੋਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: soot binaa kaise manee paroeeai |
English: without a thread, how can the beads be strung?

Gurbani: ਘੁੰਡੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਆ ਗੰਠਿ ਚੜ੍ਹਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: ghunddee bin kiaa gantth charrhaaeeai |
English: Without a loop, how can the knot be tied?

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਬਿਨੁ ਤੈਸੇ ਅਬਗਤੁ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saadhoo bin taise abagat jaaeeai |2|
English: Just so, without the Holy Saint, the mortal departs in misery. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੇ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਾਲੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jaise maat pitaa bin baal na hoee |
English: Without a mother or father there is no child;

Gurbani: ਬਿੰਬ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਕਪਰੇ ਧੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: binb binaa kaise kapare dhoee |
English: just so, without water, how can the clothes be washed?

Gurbani: ਘੋਰ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਅਸਵਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: ghor binaa kaise asavaar |
English: Without a horse, how can there be a rider?

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਦਰਵਾਰ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: saadhoo bin naahee daravaar |3|
English: Without the Holy Saint, one cannot reach the Court of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੇ ਬਾਜੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਲੀਜੈ ਫੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jaise baaje bin nahee leejai feree |
English: Just as without music, there is no dancing,

Gurbani: ਖਸਮਿ ਦੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਤਜਿ ਅਉਹੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: khasam duhaagan taj aauheree |
English: the bride rejected by her husband is dishonored.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਏਕੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: kahai kabeer ekai kar karanaa |
English: Says Kabeer, do this one thing:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਮਰਨਾ ॥੪॥੬॥੯॥
Transliteration: guramukh hoe bahur nahee maranaa |4|6|9|
English: become Gurmukh, and you shall never die again. ||4||6||9||

[Ang 872 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੋਂਡ ॥
Transliteration: gondd |
English: Gond:

Gurbani: ਕੂਟਨੁ ਸੋਇ ਜੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਕੂਟੈ ॥
Transliteration: koottan soe ju man kau koottai |
English: He alone is a pimp, who pounds down his mind.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕੂਟੈ ਤਉ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੈ ॥
Transliteration: man koottai tau jam te chhoottai |
English: Pounding down his mind, he escapes from the Messenger of Death.

Gurbani: ਕੁਟਿ ਕੁਟਿ ਮਨੁ ਕਸਵਟੀ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: kutt kutt man kasavattee laavai |
English: Pounding and beating his mind, he puts it to the test;

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਕੂਟਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: so koottan mukat bahu paavai |1|
English: such a pimp attains total liberation. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕੂਟਨੁ ਕਿਸੈ ਕਹਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: koottan kisai kahahu sansaar |
English: Who is called a pimp in this world?

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਬੋਲਨ ਕੇ ਮਾਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sagal bolan ke maeh beechaar |1| rahaau |
English: In all speech, one must carefully consider. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾਚਨੁ ਸੋਇ ਜੁ ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਨਾਚੈ ॥
Transliteration: naachan soe ju man siau naachai |
English: He alone is a dancer, who dances with his mind.

Gurbani: ਝੂਠਿ ਨ ਪਤੀਐ ਪਰਚੈ ਸਾਚੈ ॥
Transliteration: jhootth na pateeai parachai saachai |
English: The Lord is not satisfied with falsehood; He is pleased only with Truth.

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਆਗੇ ਪੂਰੈ ਤਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: eis man aage poorai taal |
English: So play the beat of the drum in the mind.

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਨਾਚਨ ਕੇ ਮਨ ਰਖਵਾਲ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: eis naachan ke man rakhavaal |2|
English: The Lord is the Protector of the dancer with such a mind. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬਜਾਰੀ ਸੋ ਜੁ ਬਜਾਰਹਿ ਸੋਧੈ ॥
Transliteration: bajaaree so ju bajaareh sodhai |
English: She alone is a street-dancer, who cleanses her body-street,

Gurbani: ਪਾਂਚ ਪਲੀਤਹ ਕਉ ਪਰਬੋਧੈ ॥
Transliteration: paanch paleetah kau parabodhai |
English: and educates the five passions.

Gurbani: ਨਉ ਨਾਇਕ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: nau naaeik kee bhagat pachhaanai |
English: She who embraces devotional worship for the Lord

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਬਾਜਾਰੀ ਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਮਾਨੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: so baajaaree ham gur maane |3|
English: - I accept such a street-dancer as my Guru. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤਸਕਰੁ ਸੋਇ ਜਿ ਤਾਤਿ ਨ ਕਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: tasakar soe ji taat na karai |
English: He alone is a thief, who is above envy,

Gurbani: ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਕੈ ਜਤਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਚਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: eindree kai jatan naam ucharai |
English: and who uses his sense organs to chant the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਹਮ ਐਸੇ ਲਖਨ ॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer ham aise lakhan |
English: Says Kabeer, these are the qualities of the one

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਅਤਿ ਰੂਪ ਬਿਚਖਨ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: dhan guradev at roop bichakhan |4|7|10|
English: I know as my Blessed Divine Guru, who is the most beautiful and wise. ||4||7||10||

[Ang 873 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੋਂਡ ॥
Transliteration: gondd |
English: Gond:

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: dhan gupaal dhan guradev |
English: Blessed is the Lord of the World. Blessed is the Divine Guru.

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਭੂਖੇ ਕਵਲੁ ਟਹਕੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: dhan anaad bhookhe kaval ttahakev |
English: Blessed is that grain, by which the heart-lotus of the hungry blossoms forth.

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਓਇ ਸੰਤ ਜਿਨ ਐਸੀ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: dhan oe sant jin aisee jaanee |
English: Blessed are those Saints, who know this.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਿਬੋ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਪਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tin kau milibo saaringapaanee |1|
English: Meeting with them, one meets the Lord, the Sustainer of the World. ||1||

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਅਨਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: aad purakh te hoe anaad |
English: This grain comes from the Primal Lord God.

Gurbani: ਜਪੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਨ ਕੈ ਸਾਦਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: japeeai naam an kai saad |1| rahaau |
English: One chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, only when he tastes this grain. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਪੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਅੰਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: japeeai naam japeeai an |
English: Meditate on the Naam, and meditate on this grain.

Gurbani: ਅੰਭੈ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨੀਕਾ ਵੰਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: anbhai kai sang neekaa van |
English: Mixed with water, its taste becomes sublime.

Gurbani: ਅੰਨੈ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜੋ ਨਰ ਹੋਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: anai baahar jo nar hoveh |
English: One who abstains from this grain,

Gurbani: ਤੀਨਿ ਭਵਨ ਮਹਿ ਅਪਨੀ ਖੋਵਹਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: teen bhavan meh apanee khoveh |2|
English: loses his honor in the three worlds. ||2||

Gurbani: ਛੋਡਹਿ ਅੰਨੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਾਖੰਡ ॥
Transliteration: chhoddeh an kareh paakhandd |
English: One who discards this grain, is practicing hypocrisy.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਨਿ ਨਾ ਓਹਿ ਰੰਡ ॥
Transliteration: naa sohaagan naa ohi randd |
English: She is neither a happy soul-bride, nor a widow.

Gurbani: ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਬਕਤੇ ਦੂਧਾਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jag meh bakate doodhaadhaaree |
English: Those who claim in this world that they live on milk alone,

Gurbani: ਗੁਪਤੀ ਖਾਵਹਿ ਵਟਿਕਾ ਸਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gupatee khaaveh vattikaa saaree |3|
English: secretly eat whole loads of food. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅੰਨੈ ਬਿਨਾ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਕਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: anai binaa na hoe sukaal |
English: Without this grain, time does not pass in peace.

Gurbani: ਤਜਿਐ ਅੰਨਿ ਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਪਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: tajiai an na milai gupaal |
English: Forsaking this grain, one does not meet the Lord of the World.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਹਮ ਐਸੇ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: kahu kabeer ham aise jaaniaa |
English: Says Kabeer, this I know:

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੪॥੮॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: dhan anaad tthaakur man maaniaa |4|8|11|
English: blessed is that grain, which brings faith in the Lord and Master to the mind. ||4||8||11||

[Ang 873 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Bhagat Namdev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੋਂਡ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀ ਕੀ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raag gondd baanee naamadeo jee kee ghar 1 |
English: Raag Gond, The Word Of Naam Dayv Jee, First House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਅਸੁਮੇਧ ਜਗਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: asumedh jagane |
English: The ritual sacrifice of horses,

Gurbani: ਤੁਲਾ ਪੁਰਖ ਦਾਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: tulaa purakh daane |
English: giving one's weight in gold to charities,

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਾਗ ਇਸਨਾਨੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: praag isanaane |1|
English: and ceremonial cleansing baths -||1||

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਨ ਪੁਜਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: tau na pujeh har keerat naamaa |
English: These are not equal to singing the Praises of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਰਾਮਹਿ ਭਜੁ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਆਲਸੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: apune raameh bhaj re man aalaseea |1| rahaau |
English: Meditate on your Lord, you lazy man! ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗਇਆ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਭਰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: geaa pindd bharataa |
English: Offering sweet rice at Gaya,

Gurbani: ਬਨਾਰਸਿ ਅਸਿ ਬਸਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: banaaras as basataa |
English: living on the river banks at Benares,

Gurbani: ਮੁਖਿ ਬੇਦ ਚਤੁਰ ਪੜਤਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mukh bed chatur parrataa |2|
English: reciting the four Vedas by heart;||2||

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਧਰਮ ਅਛਿਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: sagal dharam achhitaa |
English: Completing all religious rituals,

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur giaan indree drirrataa |
English: restraining sexual passion by the spiritual wisdom given by the Guru,

Gurbani: ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮ ਸਹਿਤ ਰਹਤਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: khatt karam sahit rahataa |3|
English: and performing the six rituals;||3||

Gurbani: ਸਿਵਾ ਸਕਤਿ ਸੰਬਾਦੰ ॥
Transliteration: sivaa sakat sanbaadan |
English: Expounding on Shiva and Shakti

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਛੋਡਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਸਗਲ ਭੇਦੰ ॥
Transliteration: man chhodd chhodd sagal bhedan |
English: O man, renounce and abandon all these things.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੰ ॥
Transliteration: simar simar gobindan |
English: Meditate, meditate in remembrance on the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਭਜੁ ਨਾਮਾ ਤਰਸਿ ਭਵ ਸਿੰਧੰ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: bhaj naamaa taras bhav sindhan |4|1|
English: Meditate, O Naam Dayv, and cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||4||1||

[Ang 873 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Bhagat Namdev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੋਂਡ ॥
Transliteration: gondd |
English: Gond:

Gurbani: ਨਾਦ ਭ੍ਰਮੇ ਜੈਸੇ ਮਿਰਗਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: naad bhrame jaise miragaae |
English: The deer is lured by the sound of the hunter's bell;

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਤਜੇ ਵਾ ਕੋ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: praan taje vaa ko dhiaan na jaae |1|
English: it loses its life, but it cannot stop thinking about it. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸੇ ਰਾਮਾ ਐਸੇ ਹੇਰਉ ॥
Transliteration: aise raamaa aise herau |
English: In the same way, I look upon my Lord.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਫੇਰਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raam chhodd chit anat na ferau |1| rahaau |
English: I will not abandon my Lord, and turn my thoughts to another. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਮੀਨਾ ਹੇਰੈ ਪਸੂਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jiau meenaa herai pasooaaraa |
English: As the fisherman looks upon the fish,

Gurbani: ਸੋਨਾ ਗਢਤੇ ਹਿਰੈ ਸੁਨਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sonaa gadtate hirai sunaaraa |2|
English: and the goldsmith looks upon the gold he fashions;||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਬਿਖਈ ਹੇਰੈ ਪਰ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jiau bikhee herai par naaree |
English: As the man driven by sex looks upon another man's wife,

Gurbani: ਕਉਡਾ ਡਾਰਤ ਹਿਰੈ ਜੁਆਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kauddaa ddaarat hirai juaaree |3|
English: and the gambler looks upon the throwing of the dice -||3||

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਰਾਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeh jeh dekhau teh teh raamaa |
English: In the same way, wherever Naam Dayv looks, he sees the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: har ke charan nit dhiaavai naamaa |4|2|
English: Naam Dayv meditates continuously on the Feet of the Lord. ||4||2||

[Ang 873 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Bhagat Namdev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੋਂਡ ॥
Transliteration: gondd |
English: Gond:

Gurbani: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਤਾਰਿ ਲੇ ਰਾਮਾ ਤਾਰਿ ਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: mo kau taar le raamaa taar le |
English: Carry me across, O Lord, carry me across.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਅਜਾਨੁ ਜਨੁ ਤਰਿਬੇ ਨ ਜਾਨਉ ਬਾਪ ਬੀਠੁਲਾ ਬਾਹ ਦੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mai ajaan jan taribe na jaanau baap beetthulaa baah de |1| rahaau |
English: I am ignorant, and I do not know how to swim. O my Beloved Father, please give me Your arm. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਰ ਤੇ ਸੁਰ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਤ ਨਿਮਖ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਿਖਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: nar te sur hoe jaat nimakh mai satigur budh sikhalaaee |
English: I have been transformed from a mortal being into an angel, in an instant; the True Guru has taught me this.

Gurbani: ਨਰ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਿ ਸੁਰਗ ਕਉ ਜੀਤਿਓ ਸੋ ਅਵਖਧ ਮੈ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: nar te upaj surag kau jeetio so avakhadh mai paaee |1|
English: Born of human flesh, I have conquered the heavens; such is the medicine I was given. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਹਾ ਜਹਾ ਧੂਅ ਨਾਰਦੁ ਟੇਕੇ ਨੈਕੁ ਟਿਕਾਵਹੁ ਮੋਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jahaa jahaa dhooa naarad tteke naik ttikaavahu mohi |
English: Please place me where You placed Dhroo and Naarad, O my Master.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਅਵਿਲੰਬਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਜਨ ਉਧਰੇ ਨਾਮੇ ਕੀ ਨਿਜ ਮਤਿ ਏਹ ॥੨॥੩॥
Transliteration: tere naam avilanb bahut jan udhare naame kee nij mat eh |2|3|
English: With the Support of Your Name, so many have been saved; this is Naam Dayv's understanding. ||2||3||

[Ang 874 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Bhagat Namdev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੋਂਡ ॥
Transliteration: gondd |
English: Gond:

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਲਾਗਤੀ ਤਾਲਾਬੇਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: mohi laagatee taalaabelee |
English: I am restless and unhappy.

Gurbani: ਬਛਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਾਇ ਅਕੇਲੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bachhare bin gaae akelee |1|
English: Without her calf, the cow is lonely. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪਾਨੀਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੀਨੁ ਤਲਫੈ ॥
Transliteration: paaneea bin meen talafai |
English: Without water, the fish writhes in pain.

Gurbani: ਐਸੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਾਪੁਰੋ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aise raam naamaa bin baapuro naamaa |1| rahaau |
English: So is poor Naam Dayv without the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੇ ਗਾਇ ਕਾ ਬਾਛਾ ਛੂਟਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaise gaae kaa baachhaa chhoottalaa |
English: Like the cow's calf, which, when let loose,

Gurbani: ਥਨ ਚੋਖਤਾ ਮਾਖਨੁ ਘੂਟਲਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: than chokhataa maakhan ghoottalaa |2|
English: sucks at her udders and drinks her milk -||2||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਨਾਰਾਇਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: naamadeo naaraaein paaeaa |
English: So has Naam Dayv found the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur bhettat alakh lakhaaeaa |3|
English: Meeting the Guru, I have seen the Unseen Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਖੈ ਹੇਤ ਪਰ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jaise bikhai het par naaree |
English: As the man driven by sex wants another man's wife,

Gurbani: ਐਸੇ ਨਾਮੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: aise naame preet muraaree |4|
English: so does Naam Dayv love the Lord. ||4||

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਾਪਤੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਘਾਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaise taapate niramal ghaamaa |
English: As the earth burns in the dazzling sunlight,

Gurbani: ਤੈਸੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਾਪੁਰੋ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੫॥੪॥
Transliteration: taise raam naamaa bin baapuro naamaa |5|4|
English: so does poor Naam Dayv burn without the Lord's Name. ||5||4||

[Ang 874 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Bhagat Namdev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੋਂਡ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: raag gondd baanee naamadeo jeeo kee ghar 2 |
English: Raag Gond, The Word Of Naam Dayv Jee, Second House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤ ਮਿਟੇ ਸਭਿ ਭਰਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: har har karat mitte sabh bharamaa |
English: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, all doubts are dispelled.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈ ਊਤਮ ਧਰਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: har ko naam lai aootam dharamaa |
English: Chanting the Name of the Lord is the highest religion.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤ ਜਾਤਿ ਕੁਲ ਹਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: har har karat jaat kul haree |
English: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, erases social classes and ancestral pedigrees.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਕੀ ਲਾਕਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: so har andhule kee laakaree |1|
English: The Lord is the walking stick of the blind. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਏ ਨਮਸਤੇ ਹਰਏ ਨਮਹ ॥
Transliteration: hare namasate hare namah |
English: I bow to the Lord, I humbly bow to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤ ਨਹੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਮਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har har karat nahee dukh jamah |1| rahaau |
English: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, you will not be tormented by the Messenger of Death. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਨਾਕਸ ਹਰੇ ਪਰਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: har haranaakas hare paraan |
English: The Lord took the life of Harnaakhash,

Gurbani: ਅਜੈਮਲ ਕੀਓ ਬੈਕੁੰਠਹਿ ਥਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: ajaimal keeo baikunttheh thaan |
English: and gave Ajaamal a place in heaven.

Gurbani: ਸੂਆ ਪੜਾਵਤ ਗਨਿਕਾ ਤਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: sooaa parraavat ganikaa taree |
English: Teaching a parrot to speak the Lord's Name, Ganika the prostitute was saved.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਨੈਨਹੁ ਕੀ ਪੂਤਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: so har nainahu kee pootaree |2|
English: That Lord is the light of my eyes. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤ ਪੂਤਨਾ ਤਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: har har karat pootanaa taree |
English: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Pootna was saved,

Gurbani: ਬਾਲ ਘਾਤਨੀ ਕਪਟਹਿ ਭਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: baal ghaatanee kapatteh bharee |
English: even though she was a deceitful child-killer.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਨ ਦ੍ਰੋਪਦ ਸੁਤ ਉਧਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: simaran dropad sut udharee |
English: Contemplating the Lord, Dropadi was saved.

Gurbani: ਗਊਤਮ ਸਤੀ ਸਿਲਾ ਨਿਸਤਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gaootam satee silaa nisataree |3|
English: Gautam's wife, turned to stone, was saved. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕੇਸੀ ਕੰਸ ਮਥਨੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: kesee kans mathan jin keea |
English: The Lord, who killed Kaysee and Kans,

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਦਾਨੁ ਕਾਲੀ ਕਉ ਦੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: jeea daan kaalee kau deea |
English: gave the gift of life to Kali.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਨਾਮਾ ਐਸੋ ਹਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: pranavai naamaa aiso haree |
English: Prays Naam Dayv, such is my Lord;

Gurbani: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਭੈ ਅਪਦਾ ਟਰੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੫॥
Transliteration: jaas japat bhai apadaa ttaree |4|1|5|
English: meditating on Him, fear and suffering are dispelled. ||4||1||5||

[Ang 874 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Bhagat Namdev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੋਂਡ ॥
Transliteration: gondd |
English: Gond:

Gurbani: ਭੈਰਉ ਭੂਤ ਸੀਤਲਾ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: bhairau bhoot seetalaa dhaavai |
English: One who chases after the god Bhairau, evil spirits and the goddess of smallpox,

Gurbani: ਖਰ ਬਾਹਨੁ ਉਹੁ ਛਾਰੁ ਉਡਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: khar baahan uhu chhaar uddaavai |1|
English: is riding on a donkey, kicking up the dust. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਤਉ ਏਕੁ ਰਮਈਆ ਲੈਹਉ ॥
Transliteration: hau tau ek rameea laihau |
English: I take only the Name of the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਬਦਲਾਵਨਿ ਦੈਹਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aan dev badalaavan daihau |1| rahaau |
English: I have given away all other gods in exchange for Him. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਿਵ ਸਿਵ ਕਰਤੇ ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: siv siv karate jo nar dhiaavai |
English: That man who chants "Shiva, Shiva", and meditates on him,

Gurbani: ਬਰਦ ਚਢੇ ਡਉਰੂ ਢਮਕਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: barad chadte ddauroo dtamakaavai |2|
English: is riding on a bull, shaking a tambourine. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਮਾਈ ਕੀ ਪੂਜਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: mahaa maaee kee poojaa karai |
English: One who worships the Great Goddess Maya

Gurbani: ਨਰ ਸੈ ਨਾਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਉਤਰੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: nar sai naar hoe aautarai |3|
English: will be reincarnated as a woman, and not a man. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਕਹੀਅਤ ਹੀ ਆਦਿ ਭਵਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: too kaheeat hee aad bhavaanee |
English: You are called the Primal Goddess.

Gurbani: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕੀ ਬਰੀਆ ਕਹਾ ਛਪਾਨੀ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: mukat kee bareea kahaa chhapaanee |4|
English: At the time of liberation, where will you hide then? ||4||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗਹੁ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: guramat raam naam gahu meetaa |
English: Follow the Guru's Teachings, and hold tight to the Lord's Name, O friend.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਨਾਮਾ ਇਉ ਕਹੈ ਗੀਤਾ ॥੫॥੨॥੬॥
Transliteration: pranavai naamaa iau kahai geetaa |5|2|6|
English: Thus prays Naam Dayv, and so says the Gita as well. ||5||2||6||

[Ang 874 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Bhagat Namdev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਗੋਂਡ ॥
Transliteration: bilaaval gondd |
English: Bilaaval Gond:

Gurbani: ਆਜੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਬੀਠਲੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਮੂਰਖ ਕੋ ਸਮਝਾਊ ਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aaj naame beetthal dekhiaa moorakh ko samajhaaoo re | rahaau |
English: Today, Naam Dayv saw the Lord, and so I will instruct the ignorant. ||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪਾਂਡੇ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਗਾਇਤ੍ਰੀ ਲੋਧੇ ਕਾ ਖੇਤੁ ਖਾਤੀ ਥੀ ॥
Transliteration: paandde tumaree gaaeitree lodhe kaa khet khaatee thee |
English: O Pandit, O religious scholar, your Gayatri was grazing in the fields.

Gurbani: ਲੈ ਕਰਿ ਠੇਗਾ ਟਗਰੀ ਤੋਰੀ ਲਾਂਗਤ ਲਾਂਗਤ ਜਾਤੀ ਥੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: lai kar tthegaa ttagaree toree laangat laangat jaatee thee |1|
English: Taking a stick, the farmer broke its leg, and now it walks with a limp. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪਾਂਡੇ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਮਹਾਦੇਉ ਧਉਲੇ ਬਲਦ ਚੜਿਆ ਆਵਤੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਥਾ ॥
Transliteration: paandde tumaraa mahaadeo dhaule balad charriaa aavat dekhiaa thaa |
English: O Pandit, I saw your great god Shiva, riding along on a white bull.

Gurbani: ਮੋਦੀ ਕੇ ਘਰ ਖਾਣਾ ਪਾਕਾ ਵਾ ਕਾ ਲੜਕਾ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਥਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: modee ke ghar khaanaa paakaa vaa kaa larrakaa maariaa thaa |2|
English: In the merchant's house, a banquet was prepared for him - he killed the merchant's son. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪਾਂਡੇ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਰਾਮਚੰਦੁ ਸੋ ਭੀ ਆਵਤੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਥਾ ॥
Transliteration: paandde tumaraa raamachand so bhee aavat dekhiaa thaa |
English: O Pandit, I saw your Raam Chand coming too

Gurbani: ਰਾਵਨ ਸੇਤੀ ਸਰਬਰ ਹੋਈ ਘਰ ਕੀ ਜੋਇ ਗਵਾਈ ਥੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: raavan setee sarabar hoee ghar kee joe gavaaee thee |3|
English: ; he lost his wife, fighting a war against Raawan. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਿੰਦੂ ਅੰਨੑਾ ਤੁਰਕੂ ਕਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: hindoo anaa turakoo kaanaa |
English: The Hindu is sightless; the Muslim has only one eye.

Gurbani: ਦੁਹਾਂ ਤੇ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸਿਆਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: duhaan te giaanee siaanaa |
English: The spiritual teacher is wiser than both of them.

Gurbani: ਹਿੰਦੂ ਪੂਜੈ ਦੇਹੁਰਾ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੁ ਮਸੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: hindoo poojai dehuraa musalamaan maseet |
English: The Hindu worships at the temple, the Muslim at the mosque.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੇ ਸੋਈ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਜਹ ਦੇਹੁਰਾ ਨ ਮਸੀਤਿ ॥੪॥੩॥੭॥
Transliteration: naame soee seviaa jeh dehuraa na maseet |4|3|7|
English: Naam Dayv serves that Lord, who is not limited to either the temple or the mosque. ||4||3||7||

[Ang 875 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Bhagat Ravidas Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੋਂਡ ਬਾਣੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: raag gondd baanee ravidaas jeeo kee ghar 2 |
English: Raag Gond, The Word Of Ravi Daas Jee, Second House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਮੁਕੰਦ ਮੁਕੰਦ ਜਪਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: mukand mukand japahu sansaar |
English: Meditate on the Lord Mukanday, the Liberator, O people of the world.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕੰਦ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਅਉਹਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: bin mukand tan hoe aauhaar |
English: Without Mukanday, the body shall be reduced to ashes.

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਮੁਕੰਦੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: soee mukand mukat kaa daataa |
English: Mukanday is the Giver of liberation.

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਮੁਕੰਦੁ ਹਮਰਾ ਪਿਤ ਮਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: soee mukand hamaraa pit maataa |1|
English: Mukanday is my father and mother. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਤ ਮੁਕੰਦੇ ਮਰਤ ਮੁਕੰਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: jeevat mukande marat mukande |
English: Meditate on Mukanday in life, and meditate on Mukanday in death.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: taa ke sevak kau sadaa anande |1| rahaau |
English: His servant is blissful forever. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੁਕੰਦ ਮੁਕੰਦ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੰ ॥
Transliteration: mukand mukand hamaare praanan |
English: The Lord, Mukanday, is my breath of life.

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਮੁਕੰਦ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਨੀਸਾਨੰ ॥
Transliteration: jap mukand masatak neesaanan |
English: Meditating on Mukanday, one's forehead will bear the Lord's insignia of approval.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵ ਮੁਕੰਦ ਕਰੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: sev mukand karai bairaagee |
English: The renunciate serves Mukanday.

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਮੁਕੰਦੁ ਦੁਰਬਲ ਧਨੁ ਲਾਧੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: soee mukand durabal dhan laadhee |2|
English: Mukanday is the wealth of the poor and forlorn. ||2||

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਮੁਕੰਦੁ ਕਰੈ ਉਪਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: ek mukand karai upakaar |
English: When the One Liberator does me a favor,

Gurbani: ਹਮਰਾ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: hamaraa kahaa karai sansaar |
English: then what can the world do to me?

Gurbani: ਮੇਟੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਹੂਏ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: mettee jaat hooe darabaar |
English: Erasing my social status, I have entered His Court.

Gurbani: ਤੁਹੀ ਮੁਕੰਦ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗ ਤਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tuhee mukand jog jug taar |3|
English: You, Mukanday, are potent throughout the four ages. ||3||

Gurbani: ਉਪਜਿਓ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਹੂਆ ਪਰਗਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: aupajio giaan hooaa paragaas |
English: Spiritual wisdom has welled up, and I have been enlightened.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੀਨੇ ਕੀਟ ਦਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa leene keett daas |
English: In His Mercy, the Lord has made this worm His slave.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਅਬ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਚੂਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: kahu ravidaas ab trisanaa chookee |
English: Says Ravi Daas, now my thirst is quenched;

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਮੁਕੰਦ ਸੇਵਾ ਤਾਹੂ ਕੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: jap mukand sevaa taahoo kee |4|1|
English: I meditate on Mukanday the Liberator, and I serve Him. ||4||1||

[Ang 875 | Raag: Raag Gond | Author: Bhagat Ravidas Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੋਂਡ ॥
Transliteration: gondd |
English: Gond:

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਓਹੁ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨੑਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: je ohu atthasatth teerath naavai |
English: Someone may bathe at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage,

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਓਹੁ ਦੁਆਦਸ ਸਿਲਾ ਪੂਜਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: je ohu duaadas silaa poojaavai |
English: and worship the twelve Shiva-lingam stones,

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਓਹੁ ਕੂਪ ਤਟਾ ਦੇਵਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: je ohu koop tattaa devaavai |
English: and dig wells and pools,

Gurbani: ਕਰੈ ਨਿੰਦ ਸਭ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: karai nind sabh birathaa jaavai |1|
English: but if he indulges in slander, then all of this is useless. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕਾ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਤਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kaa nindak kaise tarai |
English: How can the slanderer of the Holy Saints be saved?

Gurbani: ਸਰਪਰ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਨਰਕ ਹੀ ਪਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sarapar jaanahu narak hee parai |1| rahaau |
English: Know for certain, that he shall go to hell. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਓਹੁ ਗ੍ਰਹਨ ਕਰੈ ਕੁਲਖੇਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: je ohu grahan karai kulakhet |
English: Someone may bathe at Kuruk-shaytra during a solar eclipse,

Gurbani: ਅਰਪੈ ਨਾਰਿ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਸਮੇਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: arapai naar seegaar samet |
English: and give his decorated wife in offering,

Gurbani: ਸਗਲੀ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਨੀ ਸੁਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: sagalee sinmrit sravanee sunai |
English: and listen to all the Simritees,

Gurbani: ਕਰੈ ਨਿੰਦ ਕਵਨੈ ਨਹੀ ਗੁਨੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: karai nind kavanai nahee gunai |2|
English: but if he indulges in slander, these are of no account. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਓਹੁ ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦ ਕਰਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: je ohu anik prasaad karaavai |
English: Someone may give countless feasts,

Gurbani: ਭੂਮਿ ਦਾਨ ਸੋਭਾ ਮੰਡਪਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: bhoom daan sobhaa manddap paavai |
English: and donate land, and build splendid buildings;

Gurbani: ਅਪਨਾ ਬਿਗਾਰਿ ਬਿਰਾਂਨਾ ਸਾਂਢੈ ॥
Transliteration: apanaa bigaar biraanaa saandtai |
English: he may neglect his own affairs to work for others,

Gurbani: ਕਰੈ ਨਿੰਦ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਹਾਂਢੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: karai nind bahu jonee haandtai |3|
English: but if he indulges in slander, he shall wander in countless incarnations. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਹਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: nindaa kahaa karahu sansaaraa |
English: Why do you indulge in slander, O people of the world?

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਾ ਪਰਗਟਿ ਪਾਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: nindak kaa paragatt paahaaraa |
English: The emptiness of the slanderer is soon exposed.

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਸੋਧਿ ਸਾਧਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: nindak sodh saadh beechaariaa |
English: I have thought, and determined the fate of the slanderer.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਪਾਪੀ ਨਰਕਿ ਸਿਧਾਰਿਆ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੧॥੭॥੨॥੪੯॥ ਜੋੜੁ ॥
Transliteration: kahu ravidaas paapee narak sidhaariaa |4|2|11|7|2|49| jorr |
English: Says Ravi Daas, he is a sinner; he shall go to hell. ||4||2||11||7||2||49|| Total||

[Ang 876 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 1 ghar 1 chaupade |
English: Raamkalee, First Mehl, First House, Chau-Padhay:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirbhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibhan gur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਪੜਤਾ ਸਹਸਾਕਿਰਤਾ ਕੋਈ ਪੜੈ ਪੁਰਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: koee parrataa sahasaakirataa koee parrai puraanaa |
English: Some read the Sanskrit scriptures, and some read the Puraanas.

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਜਪਮਾਲੀ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਧਿਆਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: koee naam japai japamaalee laagai tisai dhiaanaa |
English: Some meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and chant it on their malas, focusing on it in meditation.

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਹੀ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ab hee kab hee kichhoo na jaanaa teraa eko naam pachhaanaa |1|
English: I know nothing, now or ever; I recognize only Your One Name, Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਹਰੇ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਵਨ ਗਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: n jaanaa hare meree kavan gate |
English: I do not know, Lord, what my condition shall be.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਲਾਜ ਪਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ham moorakh agiaan saran prabh teree kar kirapaa raakhahu meree laaj pate |1| rahaau |
English: I am foolish and ignorant; I seek Your Sanctuary, God. Please, save my honor and my self-respect. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਬਹੂ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਊਭਿ ਚੜਤੁ ਹੈ ਕਬਹੂ ਜਾਇ ਪਇਆਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: kabahoo jeearraa aoobh charrat hai kabahoo jaae peaale |
English: Sometimes, the soul soars high in the heavens, and sometimes it falls to the depths of the nether regions.

Gurbani: ਲੋਭੀ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਤੁ ਹੈ ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਭਾਲੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: lobhee jeearraa thir na rehat hai chaare kunddaa bhaale |2|
English: The greedy soul does not remain stable; it searches in the four directions. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਰਣੁ ਲਿਖਾਇ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ ਆਏ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸਾਜਹਿ ਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: maran likhaae manddal meh aae jeevan saajeh maaee |
English: With death pre-ordained, the soul comes into the world, gathering the riches of life.

Gurbani: ਏਕਿ ਚਲੇ ਹਮ ਦੇਖਹ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਭਾਹਿ ਬਲੰਤੀ ਆਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ek chale ham dekhah suaamee bhaeh balantee aaee |3|
English: I see that some have already gone, O my Lord and Master; the burning fire is coming closer! ||3||

Gurbani: ਨ ਕਿਸੀ ਕਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਨ ਕਿਸੀ ਕਾ ਭਾਈ ਨਾ ਕਿਸੈ ਬਾਪੁ ਨ ਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: n kisee kaa meet na kisee kaa bhaaee naa kisai baap na maaee |
English: No one has any friend, and no one has any brother; no one has any father or mother.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੇ ਤੂ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਅੰਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: pranavat naanak je too deveh ante hoe sakhaaee |4|1|
English: Prays Nanak, if You bless me with Your Name, it shall be my help and support in the end. ||4||1||

[Ang 876 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 1 |
English: Raamkalee, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਪਸਰਿ ਰਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: sarab jot teree pasar rahee |
English: Your Light is prevailing everywhere.

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਨਰਹਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jeh jeh dekhaa teh naraharee |1|
English: Wherever I look, there I see the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਨ ਤਲਬ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: jeevan talab nivaar suaamee |
English: Please rid me of the desire to live, O my Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਗਾਡਿਆ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਉਤਰਉ ਪਾਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: andh koop maaeaa man gaaddiaa kiau kar utrau paar suaamee |1| rahaau |
English: My mind is entangled in the deep dark pit of Maya. How can I cross over, O Lord and Master? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਬਸਿਆ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jeh bheetar ghatt bheetar basiaa baahar kaahe naahee |
English: He dwells deep within, inside the heart; how can He not be outside as well?

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਦਾ ਚਿੰਤ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tin kee saar kare nit saahib sadaa chint man maahee |2|
English: Our Lord and Master always takes care of us, and keeps us in His thoughts. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਨੇੜੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: aape nerrai aape door |
English: He Himself is near at hand, and He is far away.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਰਬ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: aape sarab rahiaa bharapoor |
English: He Himself is all-pervading, permeating everywhere.

Gurbani: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: satagur milai andheraa jaae |
English: Meeting the True Guru, the darkness is dispelled.

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jeh dekhaa teh rahiaa samaae |3|
English: Wherever I look, there I see Him pervading. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਹਸਾ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਨੈਣੀ ਲਾਗਸਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: antar sahasaa baahar maaeaa nainee laagas baanee |
English: There is doubt within me, and Maya is outside; it hits me in the eyes like an arrow.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਪਰਤਾਪਹਿਗਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: pranavat naanak daasan daasaa parataapahigaa praanee |4|2|
English: Prays Nanak, the slave of the Lord's slaves: such a mortal suffers terribly. ||4||2||

[Ang 877 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 1 |
English: Raamkalee, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਦਰਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਕਵਨੁ ਦਰੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਦਰਾ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਦਰੁ ਕਵਨੁ ਲਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: jit dar vaseh kavan dar kaheeai daraa bheetar dar kavan lahai |
English: Where is that door, where You live, O Lord? What is that door called? Among all doors, who can find that door?

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਦਰ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਫਿਰਾ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ਕੋਈ ਆਇ ਕਹੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jis dar kaaran firaa udaasee so dar koee aae kahai |1|
English: For the sake of that door, I wander around sadly, detached from the world; if only someone would come and tell me about that door. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਿਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: kin bidh saagar tareeai |
English: How can I cross over the world-ocean?

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਤਿਆ ਨਹ ਮਰੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jeevatiaa neh mareeai |1| rahaau |
English: While I am living, I cannot be dead. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦੁਖੁ ਦਰਵਾਜਾ ਰੋਹੁ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ਆਸਾ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਦੁਇ ਪਟ ਜੜੇ ॥
Transliteration: dukh daravaajaa rohu rakhavaalaa aasaa andesaa due patt jarre |
English: Pain is the door, and anger is the guard; hope and anxiety are the two shutters.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਜਲੁ ਖਾਈ ਪਾਣੀ ਘਰੁ ਬਾਧਿਆ ਸਤ ਕੈ ਆਸਣਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਰਹੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: maaeaa jal khaaee paanee ghar baadhiaa sat kai aasan purakh rahai |2|
English: Maya is the water in the moat; in the middle of this moat, he has built his home. The Primal Lord sits in the Seat of Truth. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਿੰਤੇ ਨਾਮਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਤੁਮ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਵਰੁ ਹਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kinte naamaa ant na jaaniaa tum sar naahee avar hare |
English: You have so many Names, Lord, I do not know their limit. There is no other equal to You.

Gurbani: ਊਚਾ ਨਹੀ ਕਹਣਾ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਣਾ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aoochaa nahee kahanaa man meh rahanaa aape jaanai aap kare |3|
English: Do not speak out loud - remain in your mind. The Lord Himself knows, and He Himself acts. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਆਸਾ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਕਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: jab aasaa andesaa tab hee kiau kar ek kahai |
English: As long as there is hope, there is anxiety; so how can anyone speak of the One Lord?

Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੁ ਮਿਲੈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: aasaa bheetar rahai niraasaa tau naanak ek milai |4|
English: In the midst of hope, remain untouched by hope; then, O Nanak, you shall meet the One Lord. ||4||

Gurbani: ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: ein bidh saagar tareeai |
English: In this way, you shall cross over the world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਤਿਆ ਇਉ ਮਰੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jeevatiaa iau mareeai |1| rahaau doojaa |3|
English: This is the way to remain dead while yet alive. ||1||Second Pause||3||

[Ang 877 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 1 |
English: Raamkalee, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਾਖੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਸਿੰਙੀ ਬਾਜੈ ਲੋਕੁ ਸੁਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: surat sabad saakhee meree singee baajai lok sune |
English: Awareness of the Shabad and the Teachings is my horn; the people hear the sound of its vibrations.

Gurbani: ਪਤੁ ਝੋਲੀ ਮੰਗਣ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੜੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: pat jholee mangan kai taaee bheekhiaa naam parre |1|
English: Honor is my begging-bowl, and the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the charity I receive. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਾਬਾ ਗੋਰਖੁ ਜਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: baabaa gorakh jaagai |
English: O Baba, Gorakh is the Lord of the Universe; He is always awake and aware.

Gurbani: ਗੋਰਖੁ ਸੋ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੋਇ ਉਠਾਲੀ ਕਰਤੇ ਬਾਰ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gorakh so jin goe utthaalee karate baar na laagai |1| rahaau |
English: He alone is Gorakh, who sustains the earth; He created it in an instant. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪਾਣੀ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਪਵਣਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੀਏ ॥
Transliteration: paanee praan pavan bandh raakhe chand sooraj mukh dee |
English: Binding together water and air, He infused the breath of life into the body, and made the lamps of the sun and the moon.

Gurbani: ਮਰਣ ਜੀਵਣ ਕਉ ਧਰਤੀ ਦੀਨੀ ਏਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਵਿਸਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: maran jeevan kau dharatee deenee ete gun visare |2|
English: To die and to live, He gave us the earth, but we have forgotten these blessings. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਅਰੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਜੰਗਮ ਪੀਰ ਪੁਰਸ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sidh saadhik ar jogee jangam peer puras bahutere |
English: There are so many Siddhas, seekers, Yogis, wandering pilgrims, spiritual teachers and good people.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਤਿਨ ਮਿਲਾ ਤ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਆਖਾ ਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: je tin milaa ta keerat aakhaa taa man sev kare |3|
English: If I meet them, I chant the Lord's Praises, and then, my mind serves Him. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਾਗਦੁ ਲੂਣੁ ਰਹੈ ਘ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੰਗੇ ਪਾਣੀ ਕਮਲੁ ਰਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: kaagad loon rahai ghrit sange paanee kamal rahai |
English: Paper and salt, protected by ghee, remain untouched by water, as the lotus remains unaffected in water.

Gurbani: ਐਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਜਮੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੈ ॥੪॥੪॥
Transliteration: aise bhagat mileh jan naanak tin jam kiaa karai |4|4|
English: Those who meet with such devotees, O servant Nanak - what can death do to them? ||4||4||

[Ang 877 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 1 |
English: Raamkalee, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਾਛਿੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: sun maachhindraa naanak bolai |
English: Listen, Machhindra, to what Nanak says.

Gurbani: ਵਸਗਤਿ ਪੰਚ ਕਰੇ ਨਹ ਡੋਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: vasagat panch kare neh ddolai |
English: One who subdues the five passions does not waver.

Gurbani: ਐਸੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜੋਗ ਕਉ ਪਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: aisee jugat jog kau paale |
English: One who practices Yoga in such a way,

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aap tarai sagale kul taare |1|
English: saves himself, and saves all his generations. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਅਉਧੂਤੁ ਐਸੀ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: so aaudhoot aisee mat paavai |
English: He alone is a hermit, who attains such understanding.

Gurbani: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ahinis sun samaadh samaavai |1| rahaau |
English: Day and night, he remains absorbed in deepest Samaadhi. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਭਿਖਿਆ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੈ ਚਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: bhikhiaa bhaae bhagat bhai chalai |
English: He begs for loving devotion to the Lord, and lives in the Fear of God.

Gurbani: ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਅਮੁਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: hovai su tripat santokh amulai |
English: He is satisfied, with the priceless gift of contentment.

Gurbani: ਧਿਆਨ ਰੂਪਿ ਹੋਇ ਆਸਣੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: dhiaan roop hoe aasan paavai |
English: Becoming the embodiment of meditation, he attains the true Yogic posture.

Gurbani: ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਾੜੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sach naam taarree chit laavai |2|
English: He focuses his consciousness in the deep trance of the True Name. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: naanak bolai amrit baanee |
English: Nanak chants the Ambrosial Bani.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਾਛਿੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਅਉਧੂ ਨੀਸਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: sun maachhindraa aaudhoo neesaanee |
English: Listen, O Machhindra: this is the insignia of the true hermit.

Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਸੁ ਵਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa maeh niraas valaae |
English: One who, in the midst of hope, remains untouched by hope,

Gurbani: ਨਿਹਚਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤੇ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: nihchau naanak karate paae |3|
English: shall truly find the Creator Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: pranavat naanak agam sunaae |
English: Prays Nanak, I share the mysterious secrets of God.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲੇ ਕੀ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur chele kee sandh milaae |
English: The Guru and His disciple are joined together!

Gurbani: ਦੀਖਿਆ ਦਾਰੂ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: deekhiaa daaroo bhojan khaae |
English: One who eats this food, this medicine of the Teachings,

Gurbani: ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥੫॥
Transliteration: chhia darasan kee sojhee paae |4|5|
English: has the wisdom of the six Shaastras. ||4||5||

[Ang 878 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 1 |
English: Raamkalee, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਡੋਲਤ ਬੇੜੀ ਪਾਪ ਭਰੀ ਹੈ ਪਵਣੁ ਲਗੈ ਮਤੁ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ham ddolat berree paap bharee hai pavan lagai mat jaaee |
English: My boat is wobbly and unsteady; it is filled with sins. The wind is rising - what if it tips over?

Gurbani: ਸਨਮੁਖ ਸਿਧ ਭੇਟਣ ਕਉ ਆਏ ਨਿਹਚਉ ਦੇਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sanamukh sidh bhettan kau aae nihchau dehi vaddiaaee |1|
English: As sunmukh, I have turned to the Guru; O my Perfect Master; please be sure to bless me with Your glorious greatness. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਤਾਰਿ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur taar taaranahaariaa |
English: O Guru, my Saving Grace, please carry me across the world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਦੇਹਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਵਿਨਾਸੀ ਹਉ ਤੁਝ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dehi bhagat pooran avinaasee hau tujh kau balihaariaa |1| rahaau |
English: Bless me with devotion to the perfect, imperishable Lord God; I am a sacrifice to You. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਜੋਗੀ ਅਰੁ ਜੰਗਮ ਏਕੁ ਸਿਧੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sidh saadhik jogee ar jangam ek sidh jinee dhiaaeaa |
English: He alone is a Siddha, a seeker, a Yogi, a wandering pilgrim, who meditates on the One Perfect Lord.

Gurbani: ਪਰਸਤ ਪੈਰ ਸਿਝਤ ਤੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਖਰੁ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: parasat pair sijhat te suaamee akhar jin kau aaeaa |2|
English: Touching the feet of the Lord Master, they are emancipated; they come to receive the Word of the Teachings. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਕਰਮ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jap tap sanjam karam na jaanaa naam japee prabh teraa |
English: I know nothing of charity, meditation, self-discipline or religious rituals; I only chant Your Name, God.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥੩॥੬॥
Transliteration: gur paramesar naanak bhettio saachai sabad niberaa |3|6|
English: Nanak has met the Guru, the Transcendent Lord God; through the True Word of His Shabad, he is set free. ||3||6||

[Ang 878 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 1 |
English: Raamkalee, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੁਰਤੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਰਲਾਈਐ ਏਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: suratee surat ralaaeeai et |
English: Focus your consciousness in deep absorption on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਤੁਲਹਾ ਲੰਘਹਿ ਜੇਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: tan kar tulahaa langheh jet |
English: Make your body a raft, to cross over.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਭਾਹਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਤੂ ਰਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: antar bhaeh tisai too rakh |
English: Deep within is the fire of desire; keep it in check.

Gurbani: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਦੀਵਾ ਬਲੈ ਅਥਕੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ahinis deevaa balai athak |1|
English: Day and night, that lamp shall burn unceasingly. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਦੀਵਾ ਨੀਰਿ ਤਰਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa deevaa neer taraae |
English: Float such a lamp upon the water;

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਦੀਵੈ ਸਭ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jit deevai sabh sojhee paae |1| rahaau |
English: this lamp will bring total understanding. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਛੀ ਮਿਟੀ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: hachhee mittee sojhee hoe |
English: This understanding is good clay;

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਮਾਨੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: taa kaa keea maanai soe |
English: a lamp made of such clay is acceptable to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਰਣੀ ਤੇ ਕਰਿ ਚਕਹੁ ਢਾਲਿ ॥
