Transliteration: karanee te kar chakahu dtaal |
English: So shape this lamp on the wheel of good actions.

Gurbani: ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਨਿਬਹੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aithai othai nibahee naal |2|
English: In this world and in the next, this lamp shall be with you. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aape nadar kare jaa soe |
English: When He Himself grants His Grace,

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh viralaa boojhai koe |
English: then, as Gurmukh, one may understand Him.

Gurbani: ਤਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਦੀਵਾ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: tit ghatt deevaa nihachal hoe |
English: Within the heart, this lamp is permanently lit.

Gurbani: ਪਾਣੀ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: paanee marai na bujhaaeaa jaae |
English: It is not extinguished by water or wind.

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਦੀਵਾ ਨੀਰਿ ਤਰਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aisaa deevaa neer taraae |3|
English: Such a lamp will carry you across the water. ||3||

Gurbani: ਡੋਲੈ ਵਾਉ ਨ ਵਡਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: ddolai vaau na vaddaa hoe |
English: Wind does not shake it, or put it out.

Gurbani: ਜਾਪੈ ਜਿਉ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਣਿ ਲੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jaapai jiau singhaasan loe |
English: Its light reveals the Divine Throne.

Gurbani: ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਸੂਦੁ ਕਿ ਵੈਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: khatree braahaman sood ki vais |
English: The Kh'shaatriyas, Brahmins, Soodras and Vaishyas

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ਗਣੀ ਸਹੰਸ ॥
Transliteration: nirat na paaeea ganee sahans |
English: cannot find its value, even by thousands of calculations.

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਦੀਵਾ ਬਾਲੇ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa deevaa baale koe |
English: If any of them lights such a lamp,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪਾਰੰਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੭॥
Transliteration: naanak so paarangat hoe |4|7|
English: O Nanak, he is emancipated. ||4||7||

[Ang 878 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 1 |
English: Raamkalee, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤੁਧਨੋ ਨਿਵਣੁ ਮੰਨਣੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tudhano nivan manan teraa naau |
English: To place one's faith in Your Name, Lord, is true worship.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੁ ਭੇਟ ਬੈਸਣ ਕਉ ਥਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saach bhett baisan kau thaau |
English: With an offering of Truth, one obtains a place to sit.

Gurbani: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: sat santokh hovai aradaas |
English: If a prayer is offered with truth and contentment,

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਦਿ ਬਹਾਲੇ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: taa sun sad bahaale paas |1|
English: the Lord will hear it, and call him in to sit by Him. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak birathaa koe na hoe |
English: O Nanak, no one returns empty-handed;

Gurbani: ਐਸੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aisee daragah saachaa soe |1| rahaau |
English: such is the Court of the True Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤਿ ਪੋਤਾ ਕਰਮੁ ਪਸਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: praapat potaa karam pasaau |
English: The treasure I seek is the gift of Your Grace.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਮੰਗਤ ਜਨ ਚਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: too deveh mangat jan chaau |
English: Please bless this humble beggar - this is what I seek.

Gurbani: ਭਾਡੈ ਭਾਉ ਪਵੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhaaddai bhaau pavai tith aae |
English: Please, pour Your Love into the cup of my heart.

Gurbani: ਧੁਰਿ ਤੈ ਛੋਡੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: dhur tai chhoddee keemat paae |2|
English: This is Your pre-determined value. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: jin kichh keea so kichh karai |
English: The One who created everything, does everything.

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਧਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: apanee keemat aape dharai |
English: He Himself appraises His own value.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh paragatt hoaa har raae |
English: The Sovereign Lord King becomes manifest to the Gurmukh.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naa ko aavai naa ko jaae |3|
English: He does not come, and He does not go. ||3||

Gurbani: ਲੋਕੁ ਧਿਕਾਰੁ ਕਹੈ ਮੰਗਤ ਜਨ ਮਾਗਤ ਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: lok dhikaar kahai mangat jan maagat maan na paaeaa |
English: People curse at the beggar; by begging, he does not receive honor.

Gurbani: ਸਹ ਕੀਆ ਗਲਾ ਦਰ ਕੀਆ ਬਾਤਾ ਤੈ ਤਾ ਕਹਣੁ ਕਹਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੮॥
Transliteration: seh keea galaa dar keea baataa tai taa kehan kahaaeaa |4|8|
English: O Lord, You inspire me to speak Your Words, and tell the Story of Your Court. ||4||8||

[Ang 878 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 1 |
English: Raamkalee, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਾਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਬੂੰਦ ਬੂੰਦ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਕਵਣੁ ਬੁਝੈ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: saagar meh boond boond meh saagar kavan bujhai bidh jaanai |
English: The drop is in the ocean, and the ocean is in the drop. Who understands, and knows this?

Gurbani: ਉਤਭੁਜ ਚਲਤ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਿ ਚੀਨੈ ਆਪੇ ਤਤੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: autabhuj chalat aap kar cheenai aape tat pachhaanai |1|
English: He Himself creates the wondrous play of the world. He Himself contemplates it, and understands its true essence. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa giaan beechaarai koee |
English: How rare are those who contemplate this spiritual wisdom.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tis te mukat param gat hoee |1| rahaau |
English: Through this, the supreme state of liberation is attained. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਰੈਣਿ ਰੈਣਿ ਮਹਿ ਦਿਨੀਅਰੁ ਉਸਨ ਸੀਤ ਬਿਧਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: din meh rain rain meh dineear usan seet bidh soee |
English: The night is in the day, and the day is in the night. The same is true of hot and cold.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਮਝ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: taa kee gat mit avar na jaanai gur bin samajh na hoee |2|
English: No one else knows His state and extent; without the Guru, this is not understood. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪੁਰਖ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਰਿ ਨਾਰਿ ਮਹਿ ਪੁਰਖਾ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: purakh meh naar naar meh purakhaa boojhahu braham giaanee |
English: The female is in the male, and the male is in the female. Understand this, O God-realized being!

Gurbani: ਧੁਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: dhun meh dhiaan dhiaan meh jaaniaa guramukh akath kahaanee |3|
English: The meditation is in the music, and knowledge is in meditation. Become Gurmukh, and speak the Unspoken Speech. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਪੰਚ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: man meh jot jot meh manooaa panch mile gur bhaaee |
English: The Light is in the mind, and the mind is in the Light. The Guru brings the five senses together, like brothers.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਜਿਨ ਏਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੪॥੯॥
Transliteration: naanak tin kai sad balihaaree jin ek sabad liv laaee |4|9|
English: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to those who enshrine love for the One Word of the Shabad. ||4||9||

[Ang 879 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 1 |
English: Raamkalee, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jaa har prabh kirapaa dhaaree |
English: When the Lord God showered His Mercy,

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: taa haumai vichahu maaree |
English: egotism was eradicated from within me.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕਿ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: so sevak raam piaaree |
English: That humble servant who contemplates the

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jo gurasabadee beechaaree |1|
English: Word of the Guru's Shabad, is very dear to the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: so har jan har prabh bhaavai |
English: That humble servant of the Lord is pleasing to his Lord God;

Gurbani: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਲਾਜ ਛੋਡਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ahinis bhagat kare din raatee laaj chhodd har ke gun gaavai |1| rahaau |
English: day and night, he performs devotional worship, day and night. Disregarding his own honor, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਧੁਨਿ ਵਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਘੋਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: dhun vaaje anahad ghoraa |
English: The unstruck melody of the sound current resonates and resounds;

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਮੋਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: man maaniaa har ras moraa |
English: my mind is appeased by the subtle essence of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur poorai sach samaaeaa |
English: Through the Perfect Guru, I am absorbed in Truth.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur aad purakh har paaeaa |2|
English: Through the Guru, I have found the Lord, the Primal Being. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਨਾਦ ਬੇਦ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: sabh naad bed gurabaanee |
English: Gurbani is the sound current of the Naad, the Vedas, everything.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਾਰਿਗਪਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: man raataa saarigapaanee |
English: My mind is attuned to the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਤਹ ਤੀਰਥ ਵਰਤ ਤਪ ਸਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: teh teerath varat tap saare |
English: He is my sacred shrine of pilgrimage, fasting and austere self-discipline.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur miliaa har nisataare |3|
English: The Lord saves, and carries across, those who meet with the Guru. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਆਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeh aap geaa bhau bhaagaa |
English: One whose self-conceit is gone, sees his fears run away.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur charanee sevak laagaa |
English: That servant grasps the Guru's feet.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur satigur bharam chukaaeaa |
English: The Guru, the True Guru, has expelled my doubts.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak sabad milaaeaa |4|10|
English: Says Nanak, I have merged into the Word of the Shabad. ||4||10||

[Ang 879 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 1 |
English: Raamkalee, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਛਾਦਨੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਮਾਗਤੁ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: chhaadan bhojan maagat bhaagai |
English: He runs around, begging for clothes and food.

Gurbani: ਖੁਧਿਆ ਦੁਸਟ ਜਲੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਆਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: khudhiaa dusatt jalai dukh aagai |
English: He burns with hunger and corruption, and will suffer in the world hereafter.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਲੀਨੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramat nahee leenee duramat pat khoee |
English: He does not follow the Guru's Teachings; through his evil-mindedness, he loses his honor.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: guramat bhagat paavai jan koee |1|
English: Only through the Guru's Teachings will such a person become devoted. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੋਗੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: jogee jugat sehaj ghar vaasai |
English: The way of the Yogi is to dwell in the celestial home of bliss.

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਏਕੋ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਭਾਇ ਸਬਦਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ek drisatt eko kar dekhiaa bheekhiaa bhaae sabad tripataasai |1| rahaau |
English: He looks impartially, equally upon all. He receives the charity of the Lord's Love, and the Word of the Shabad, and so he is satisfied. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਬੈਲ ਗਡੀਆ ਦੇਹ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: panch bail gaddeea deh dhaaree |
English: The five bulls, the senses, pull the wagon of the body around.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਕਲਾ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਪਤਿ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: raam kalaa nibahai pat saaree |
English: By the Lord's power, one's honor is preserved.

Gurbani: ਧਰ ਤੂਟੀ ਗਾਡੋ ਸਿਰ ਭਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: dhar toottee gaaddo sir bhaar |
English: But when the axle breaks, the wagon falls and crashes.

Gurbani: ਲਕਰੀ ਬਿਖਰਿ ਜਰੀ ਮੰਝ ਭਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: lakaree bikhar jaree manjh bhaar |2|
English: It falls apart, like a pile of logs. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਜੋਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa sabad veechaar jogee |
English: Contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad, Yogi.

Gurbani: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੋਗ ਬਿਓਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: dukh sukh sam karanaa sog biogee |
English: Look upon pain and pleasure as one and the same, sorrow and separation.

Gurbani: ਭੁਗਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: bhugat naam gur sabad beechaaree |
English: Let your food be contemplative meditation upon the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਕੰਧੁ ਜਪੈ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: asathir kandh japai nirankaaree |3|
English: Your wall shall be permanent, by meditating on the Formless Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਹਜ ਜਗੋਟਾ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੇ ਛੂਟਾ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj jagottaa bandhan te chhoottaa |
English: Wear the loin-cloth of poise, and be free of entanglements.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਲੂਟਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh gurasabadee loottaa |
English: The Guru's Word shall release you from sexual desire and anger.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: man meh mundraa har gur saranaa |
English: In your mind, let your ear-rings be the Sanctuary of the Guru, the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਨ ਤਰਣਾ ॥੪॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: naanak raam bhagat jan taranaa |4|11|
English: O Nanak, worshipping the Lord in deep devotion, the humble are carried across. ||4||11||

[Ang 880 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 3 ghar 1 |
English: Raamkalee, Third Mehl, First House:

Gurbani: ਸਤਜੁਗਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: satajug sach kahai sabh koee |
English: In the Golden Age of Sat Yuga, everyone spoke the Truth.

Gurbani: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: ghar ghar bhagat guramukh hoee |
English: In each and every home, devotional worship was performed by the people, according to the Guru's Teachings.

Gurbani: ਸਤਜੁਗਿ ਧਰਮੁ ਪੈਰ ਹੈ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: satajug dharam pair hai chaar |
English: In that Golden Age, Dharma had four feet.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: guramukh boojhai ko beechaar |1|
English: How rare are those people who, as Gurmukh, contemplate this and understand. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jug chaare naam vaddiaaee hoee |
English: In all four ages, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is glory and greatness.

Gurbani: ਜਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ji naam laagai so mukat hovai gur bin naam na paavai koee |1| rahaau |
English: One who holds tight to the Naam is liberated; without the Guru, no one obtains the Naam. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰੇਤੈ ਇਕ ਕਲ ਕੀਨੀ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: tretai ik kal keenee door |
English: In the Silver Age of Traytaa Yuga, one leg was removed.

Gurbani: ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: paakhandd varatiaa har jaanan door |
English: Hypocrisy became prevalent, and people thought that the Lord was far away.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh boojhai sojhee hoee |
English: The Gurmukhs still understood and realized;

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: antar naam vasai sukh hoee |2|
English: the Naam abided deep within them, and they were at peace. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦੁਆਪੁਰਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: duaapur doojai dubidhaa hoe |
English: In the Brass Age of Dwaapur Yuga, duality and double-mindedness arose.

Gurbani: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਨੇ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਦੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: bharam bhulaane jaaneh doe |
English: Deluded by doubt, they knew duality.

Gurbani: ਦੁਆਪੁਰਿ ਧਰਮਿ ਦੁਇ ਪੈਰ ਰਖਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: duaapur dharam due pair rakhaae |
English: In this Brass Age, Dharma was left with only two feet.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: guramukh hovai ta naam drirraae |3|
English: Those who became Gurmukh implanted the Naam deep within. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਲਜੁਗਿ ਧਰਮ ਕਲਾ ਇਕ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: kalajug dharam kalaa ik rahaae |
English: In the Iron Age of Kali Yuga, Dharma was left with only one power.

Gurbani: ਇਕ ਪੈਰਿ ਚਲੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਧਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: eik pair chalai maaeaa mohu vadhaae |
English: It walks on just one foot; love and emotional attachment to Maya have increased.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਤਿ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohu at gubaar |
English: Love and emotional attachment to Maya bring total darkness.

Gurbani: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: satagur bhettai naam udhaar |4|
English: If someone meets the True Guru, he is saved, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: sabh jug meh saachaa eko soee |
English: Throughout the ages, there is only the One True Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: sabh meh sach doojaa nahee koee |
English: Among all, is the True Lord; there is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੀ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: saachee keerat sach sukh hoee |
English: Praising the True Lord, true peace is attained.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: guramukh naam vakhaanai koee |5|
English: How rare are those, who as Gurmukh, chant the Naam. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਊਤਮੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: sabh jug meh naam aootam hoee |
English: Throughout all the ages, the Naam is the ultimate, the most sublime.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh viralaa boojhai koee |
English: How rare are those, who as Gurmukh, understand this.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਭਗਤੁ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: har naam dhiaae bhagat jan soee |
English: One who meditates on the Lord's Name is a humble devotee.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak jug jug naam vaddiaaee hoee |6|1|
English: O Nanak, in each and every age, the Naam is glory and greatness. ||6||1||

[Ang 880 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 4 ghar 1 |
English: Raamkalee, Fourth Mehl, First House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਵਡਭਾਗ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: je vaddabhaag hoveh vaddabhaagee taa har har naam dhiaavai |
English: If someone is very fortunate, and is blessed with great high destiny, then he meditates on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਨਾਮੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naam japat naame sukh paavai har naame naam samaavai |1|
English: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he finds peace, and merges in the Naam. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਸਦ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh bhagat karahu sad praanee |
English: O mortal, as Gurmukh, worship the Lord in devotion forever.

Gurbani: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hiradai pragaas hovai liv laagai guramat har har naam samaanee |1| rahaau |
English: Your heart shall be illumined; through the Guru's Teachings, lovingly attune yourself to the Lord. You shall merge in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹੀਰਾ ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਮਾਣਕ ਬਹੁ ਸਾਗਰ ਭਰਪੂਰੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: heeraa ratan javehar maanak bahu saagar bharapoor keea |
English: The Great Giver is filled with diamonds, emeralds, rubies and pearls;

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਵਡ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਢਿ ਕਢਿ ਲੀਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jis vaddabhaag hovai vadd masatak tin guramat kadt kadt leea |2|
English: one who has good fortune and great destiny inscribed upon his forehead, digs them out, by following the Guru's Teachings. ||2||

Gurbani: ਰਤਨੁ ਜਵੇਹਰੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਤਲੀ ਦਿਖਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: ratan javehar laal har naamaa gur kaadt talee dikhalaaeaa |
English: The Lord's Name is the jewel, the emerald, the ruby; digging it out, the Guru has placed it in your palm.

Gurbani: ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਨਹੀ ਲੀਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਓਲੈ ਲਾਖੁ ਛਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bhaagaheen manamukh nahee leea trin olai laakh chhapaaeaa |3|
English: The unfortunate, self-willed manmukh does not obtain it; this priceless jewel remains hidden behind a curtain of straw. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: masatak bhaag hovai dhur likhiaa taa satagur sevaa laae |
English: If such pre-ordained destiny is written upon one's forehead, then the True Guru enjoins him to serve Him.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਪਾਵੈ ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak ratan javehar paavai dhan dhan guramat har paae |4|1|
English: O Nanak, then he obtains the jewel, the gem; blessed, blessed is that one who follows the Guru's Teachings, and finds the Lord. ||4||1||

[Ang 880 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 4 |
English: Raamkalee, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਇਆ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਨੀਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: raam janaa mil bheaa anandaa har neekee kathaa sunaae |
English: Meeting with the humble servants of the Lord, I am in ecstasy; they preach the sublime sermon of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਈ ਸਭ ਨੀਕਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: duramat mail gee sabh neekal satasangat mil budh paae |1|
English: The filth of evil-mindedness is totally washed away; joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, one is blessed with understanding. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਜਨ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਬੋਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: raam jan guramat raam bolaae |
English: O humble servant of the Lord, follow the Guru's Teachings, and chant the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸੁਣੈ ਕਹੈ ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਰਾਮ ਜਪਤ ਸੋਹਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo jo sunai kahai so mukataa raam japat sohaae |1| rahaau |
English: Whoever hears and speaks it is liberated; chanting the Lord's Name, one is embellished with beauty. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਵਡਭਾਗ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਜਨਾ ਭੇਟਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: je vaddabhaag hoveh mukh masatak har raam janaa bhettaae |
English: If someone has supremely high destiny written on his forehead, the Lord leads him to meet the humble servants of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸੰਤ ਦੇਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਭੁ ਦਾਲਦੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: darasan sant dehu kar kirapaa sabh daalad dukh leh jaae |2|
English: Be merciful, and grant me the Blessed Vision of the Saints' Darshan, which shall rid me of all poverty and pain. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਗ ਰਾਮ ਜਨ ਨੀਕੇ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਨ ਸੁਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: har ke log raam jan neeke bhaagaheen na sukhaae |
English: The Lord's people are good and sublime; the unfortunate ones do not like them at all.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਰਾਮ ਕਹਹਿ ਜਨ ਊਚੇ ਨਰ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਡੰਸੁ ਲਗਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jiau jiau raam kaheh jan aooche nar nindak ddans lagaae |3|
English: The more the Lord's exalted servants speak of Him, the more the slanderers attack and sting them. ||3||

Gurbani: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਨਰ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਜਿਨ ਜਨ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸਖਾ ਸਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: dhrig dhrig nar nindak jin jan nahee bhaae har ke sakhaa sakhaae |
English: Cursed, cursed are the slanderers who do not like the humble, the friends and companions of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚੋਰ ਵੇਮੁਖ ਮੁਖ ਕਾਲੇ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਨ ਭਾਇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: se har ke chor vemukh mukh kaale jin gur kee paij na bhaae |4|
English: Those who do not like the honor and glory of the Guru are faithless, black-faced thieves, who have turned their backs on the Lord. ||4||

Gurbani: ਦਇਆ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਹਮ ਦੀਨ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: deaa deaa kar raakhahu har jeeo ham deen teree saranaae |
English: Have mercy, have mercy, please save me, Dear Lord. I am meek and humble - I seek Your protection.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤੁਮ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੫॥੨॥
Transliteration: ham baarik tum pitaa prabh mere jan naanak bakhas milaae |5|2|
English: I am Your child, and You are my father, God. Please forgive servant Nanak and merge him with Yourself. ||5||2||

[Ang 881 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 4 |
English: Raamkalee, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸਖਾ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਨੀਕੇ ਤਿਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਹਾਥੁ ਵਤਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: har ke sakhaa saadh jan neeke tin aoopar haath vataavai |
English: The friends of the Lord, the humble, Holy Saints are sublime; the Lord spreads out His protecting hands above them.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੇਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਏ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: guramukh saadh seee prabh bhaae kar kirapaa aap milaavai |1|
English: The Gurmukhs are the Holy Saints, pleasing to God; in His mercy, He blends them with Himself. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: raam mo kau har jan mel man bhaavai |
English: O Lord, my mind longs to meet with the humble servants of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਮਿਉ ਅਮਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਹੈ ਮੀਠਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: amiau amiau har ras hai meetthaa mil sant janaa mukh paavai |1| rahaau |
English: The sweet, subtle essence of the Lord is immortalizing ambrosia. Meeting the Saints, I drink it in. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਗ ਰਾਮ ਜਨ ਊਤਮ ਮਿਲਿ ਊਤਮ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: har ke log raam jan aootam mil aootam padavee paavai |
English: The Lord's people are the most lofty and exalted. Meeting with them, the most exalted status is obtained.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਹੋਵਤ ਚੇਰੀ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਖੁਸੀ ਕਰਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ham hovat cheree daas daasan kee meraa tthaakur khusee karaavai |2|
English: I am the slave of the slave of the Lord's slaves; my Lord and Master is pleased with me. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਕ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਰਿਦ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: sevak jan seveh se vaddabhaagee rid man tan preet lagaavai |
English: The humble servant serves; one who enshrines love for the Lord in his heart, mind and body is very fortunate.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤੀ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਬਾਤਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਕੂੜੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bin preetee kareh bahu baataa koorr bol koorro fal paavai |3|
English: One who talks too much without love, speaks falsely, and obtains only false rewards. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਧਾਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਦਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਪਗੀ ਲੇ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: mo kau dhaar kripaa jagajeevan daate har sant pagee le paavai |
English: Take pity on me, O Lord of the World, O Great Giver; let me fall at the feet of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਕਾਟਉ ਕਾਟਿ ਬਾਢਿ ਸਿਰੁ ਰਾਖਉ ਜਿਤੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤੁ ਚੜਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੪॥੩॥
Transliteration: hau kaattau kaatt baadt sir raakhau jit naanak sant charr aavai |4|3|
English: I would cut off my head, and cut it into pieces, O Nanak, and set it down for the Saints to walk upon. ||4||3||

[Ang 881 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 4 |
English: Raamkalee, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਵਡਭਾਗ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਵਡ ਮੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਮਿਲਦਿਆ ਢਿਲ ਨ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: je vaddabhaag hoveh vadd mere jan miladiaa dtil na laaeeai |
English: If I am blessed with supreme high destiny, I will meet the humble servants of the Lord, without delay.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕੁੰਟ ਸਰ ਨੀਕੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਤਿਤੁ ਨਾਵਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har jan amrit kuntt sar neeke vaddabhaagee tith naavaaeeai |1|
English: The Lord's humble servants are pools of ambrosial nectar; by great good fortune, one bathes in them. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: raam mo kau har jan kaarai laaeeai |
English: O Lord, let me work for the humble servants of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਖਾ ਪੀਸਉ ਸੰਤ ਆਗੈ ਪਗ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਧੂਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hau paanee pakhaa peesau sant aagai pag mal mal dhoor mukh laaeeai |1| rahaau |
English: I carry water, wave the fan and grind the corn for them; I massage and wash their feet. I apply the dust of their feet to my forehead. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਵਡੇ ਵਡੇ ਵਡ ਊਚੇ ਜੋ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: har jan vadde vadde vadd aooche jo satagur mel milaaeeai |
English: The Lord's humble servants are great, very great, the greatest and most exalted; they lead us to meet the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: satagur jevadd avar na koee mil satagur purakh dhiaaeeai |2|
English: No one else is as great as the True Guru; meeting the True Guru, I meditate on the Lord, the Primal Being. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਲਾਜ ਰਖਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: satagur saran pare tin paaeaa mere tthaakur laaj rakhaaeeai |
English: Those who seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru find the Lord. My Lord and Master saves their honor.

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਅਪਣੈ ਸੁਆਇ ਆਇ ਬਹਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਜਿਉ ਬਗੁਲ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: eik apanai suaae aae baheh gur aagai jiau bagul samaadh lagaaeeai |3|
English: Some come for their own purposes, and sit before the Guru; they pretend to be in Samaadhi, like storks with their eyes closed. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬਗੁਲਾ ਕਾਗ ਨੀਚ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਾਇ ਕਰੰਗ ਬਿਖੂ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: bagulaa kaag neech kee sangat jaae karang bikhoo mukh laaeeai |
English: Associating with the wretched and the lowly, like the stork and the crow, is like feeding on a carcass of poison.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹੰਸੁ ਕਰਾਈਐ ॥੪॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak mel mel prabh sangat mil sangat hans karaaeeai |4|4|
English: Nanak: O God, unite me with the Sangat, the Congregation. United with the Sangat, I will become a swan. ||4||4||

[Ang 882 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 4 |
English: Raamkalee, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: satagur deaa karahu har melahu mere preetam praan har raaeaa |
English: O True Guru, please be kind, and unite me with the Lord. My Sovereign Lord is the Beloved of my breath of life.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਚੇਰੀ ਹੋਇ ਲਗਹ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪੰਥੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ham cheree hoe lagah gur charanee jin har prabh maarag panth dikhaaeaa |1|
English: I am a slave; I fall at the Guru's feet. He has shown me the Path, the Way to my Lord God. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: raam mai har har naam man bhaaeaa |
English: The Name of my Lord, Har, Har, is pleasing to my mind.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਬੇਲੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਖਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mai har bin avar na koee belee meraa pitaa maataa har sakhaaeaa |1| rahaau |
English: I have no friend except the Lord; the Lord is my father, my mother, my companion. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਨ ਰਹਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ਮਰਹਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: mere ik khin praan na raheh bin preetam bin dekhe mareh meree maaeaa |
English: My breath of life will not survive for an instant, without my Beloved; unless I see Him, I will die, O my mother!

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਵਡਭਾਗ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਏ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan vaddabhaag gur saranee aae har gur mil darasan paaeaa |2|
English: Blessed, blessed is my great, high destiny, that I have come to the Guru's Sanctuary. Meeting with the Guru, I have obtained the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਸੂਝੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਉ ਜਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: mai avar na koee soojhai boojhai man har jap jpau japaaeaa |
English: I do not know or understand any other within my mind; I meditate and chant the Lord's Chant.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਹੀਣ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਨਕਟੇ ਤਿਨ ਘਸਿ ਘਸਿ ਨਕ ਵਢਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naamaheen fireh se nakatte tin ghas ghas nak vadtaaeaa |3|
English: Those who lack the Naam, wander in shame; their noses are chopped off, bit by bit. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਜੀਵਾਲਿ ਲੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: mo kau jagajeevan jeevaal lai suaamee rid antar naam vasaaeaa |
English: O Life of the World, rejuvenate me! O my Lord and Master, enshrine Your Name deep within my heart.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak guroo guroo hai pooraa mil satigur naam dhiaaeaa |4|5|
English: O Nanak, perfect is the Guru, the Guru. Meeting the True Guru, I meditate on the Naam. ||4||5||

[Ang 882 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 4 |
English: Raamkalee, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਵਡਾ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: satagur daataa vaddaa vadd purakh hai jit miliai har ur dhaare |
English: The True Guru, the Great Giver, is the Great, Primal Being; meeting Him, the Lord is enshrined within the heart.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਦਾਨੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jeea daan gur poorai deea har amrit naam samaare |1|
English: The Perfect Guru has granted me the life of the soul; I meditate in remembrance on the Ambrosial Name of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੰਠਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: raam gur har har naam kantth dhaare |
English: O Lord, the Guru has implanted the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, within my heart.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣੀ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਵਡਭਾਗ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh kathaa sunee man bhaaee dhan dhan vaddabhaag hamaare |1| rahaau |
English: As Gurmukh, I have heard His sermon, which pleases my mind; blessed, blessed is my great destiny. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਪਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kott kott tetees dhiaaveh taa kaa ant na paaveh paare |
English: Millions, three hundred thirty millions of gods meditate on Him, but they cannot find His end or limitation.

Gurbani: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਾਮ ਕਾਮਨੀ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਹਾਥੁ ਪਸਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: hiradai kaam kaamanee maageh ridh maageh haath pasaare |2|
English: With sexual urges in their hearts, they beg for beautiful women; stretching out their hands, they beg for riches. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਜਪਿ ਜਪੁ ਵਡਾ ਵਡੇਰਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਖਉ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har jas jap jap vaddaa vadderaa guramukh rkhau ur dhaare |
English: One who chants the Praises of the Lord is the greatest of the great; the Gurmukh keeps the Lord clasped to his heart.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਵਡਭਾਗ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: je vaddabhaag hoveh taa japeeai har bhaujal paar utaare |3|
English: If one is blessed with high destiny, he meditates on the Lord, who carries him across the terrifying world-ocean. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਕੰਠਿ ਜਨ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har jan nikatt nikatt har jan hai har raakhai kantth jan dhaare |
English: The Lord is close to His humble servant, and His humble servant is close to the Lord; He keeps His humble servant clasped to His Heart.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਤਾ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: naanak pitaa maataa hai har prabh ham baarik har pratipaare |4|6|18|
English: O Nanak, the Lord God is our father and mother. I am His child; the Lord cherishes me. ||4||6||18||

[Ang 882 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raag raamakalee mahalaa 5 ghar 1 |
English: Raag Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl, First House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਦੀਨ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਣੁ ਅਵਗਣੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਹੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: kirapaa karahu deen ke daate meraa gun avagan na beechaarahu koee |
English: Have mercy on me, O Generous Giver, Lord of the meek; please do not consider my merits and demerits.

Gurbani: ਮਾਟੀ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਧੋਪੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮਾਣਸ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਏਹੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: maattee kaa kiaa dhopai suaamee maanas kee gat ehee |1|
English: How can dust be washed? O my Lord and Master, such is the state of mankind. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: mere man satigur sev sukh hoee |
English: O my mind, serve the True Guru, and be at peace.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਇਛਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo ichhahu soee fal paavahu fir dookh na viaapai koee |1| rahaau |
English: Whatever you desire, you shall receive that reward, and you shall not be afflicted by pain any longer. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਾਚੇ ਭਾਡੇ ਸਾਜਿ ਨਿਵਾਜੇ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kaache bhaadde saaj nivaaje antar jot samaaee |
English: He creates and adorns the earthen vessels; He infuses His Light within them.

Gurbani: ਜੈਸਾ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਹਮ ਤੈਸੀ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jaisaa likhat likhiaa dhur karatai ham taisee kirat kamaaee |2|
English: As is the destiny pre-ordained by the Creator, so are the deeds we do. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਥਾਪਿ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਏਹੋ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: man tan thaap keea sabh apanaa eho aavan jaanaa |
English: He believes the mind and body are all his own; this is the cause of his coming and going.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਸੋ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਮੋਹਿ ਅੰਧੁ ਲਪਟਾਣਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jin deea so chit na aavai mohi andh lapattaanaa |3|
English: He does not think of the One who gave him these; he is blind, entangled in emotional attachment. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਸੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jin keea soee prabh jaanai har kaa mehal apaaraa |
English: One who knows that God created him, reaches the Incomparable Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: bhagat karee har ke gun gaavaa naanak daas tumaaraa |4|1|
English: Worshipping the Lord, I sing His Glorious Praises. Nanak is Your slave. ||4||1||

[Ang 883 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪਵਹੁ ਚਰਣਾ ਤਲਿ ਊਪਰਿ ਆਵਹੁ ਐਸੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਵਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: pavahu charanaa tal aoopar aavahu aisee sev kamaavahu |
English: Place yourself beneath all men's feet, and you will be uplifted; serve Him in this way.

Gurbani: ਆਪਸ ਤੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਸਭ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਤਉ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aapas te aoopar sabh jaanahu tau daragah sukh paavahu |1|
English: Know that all are above you, and you shall find peace in the Court of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਐਸੀ ਕਥਹੁ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: santahu aisee kathahu kahaanee |
English: O Saints, speak that speech which purifies the gods and sanctifies the divine beings.

Gurbani: ਸੁਰ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਰ ਦੇਵ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਖਿਨੁ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sur pavitr nar dev pavitraa khin bolahu guramukh baanee |1| rahaau |
English: As Gurmukh, chant the Word of His Bani, even for an instant. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਸਹਜ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਸਹੁ ਝੂਠਾ ਕਹਹੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: parapanch chhodd sehaj ghar baisahu jhootthaa kahahu na koee |
English: Renounce your fraudulent plans, and dwell in the celestial palace; do not call anyone else false.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਨਵੈ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਤਤੁ ਬਿਲੋਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: satigur milahu navai nidh paavahu in bidh tat biloee |2|
English: Meeting with the True Guru, you shall receive the nine treasures; in this way, you shall find the essence of reality. ||2||

Gurbani: ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਆਤਮੁ ਚੀਨਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: bharam chukaavahu guramukh liv laavahu aatam cheenahu bhaaee |
English: Eradicate doubt, and as Gurmukh, enshrine love for the Lord; understand your own soul, O Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਾਜਰੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੁਰਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: nikatt kar jaanahu sadaa prabh haajar kis siau karahu buraaee |3|
English: Know that God is near at hand, and ever-present. How could you try to hurt anyone else? ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: satigur miliai maarag mukataa sahaje mile suaamee |
English: Meeting with the True Guru, your path shall be clear, and you shall easily meet your Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਜਿਨੀ ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan se jan jinee kal meh har paaeaa jan naanak sad kurabaanee |4|2|
English: Blessed, blessed are those humble beings, who, in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, find the Lord. Nanak is forever a sacrifice to them. ||4||2||

[Ang 883 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਵਤ ਹਰਖ ਨ ਜਾਵਤ ਦੂਖਾ ਨਹ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਮਨ ਰੋਗਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: aavat harakh na jaavat dookhaa neh biaapai man roganee |
English: Coming does not please me, and going does not bring me pain, and so my mind is not afflicted by disease.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਉ ਉਤਰੀ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਓਗਨੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sadaa anand gur pooraa paaeaa tau utaree sagal bioganee |1|
English: I am in bliss forever, for I have found the Perfect Guru; my separation from the Lord is totally ended. ||1||

Gurbani: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਹੈ ਮਨੁ ਜੋਗਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: eih bidh hai man joganee |
English: This is how I have joined my mind to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਲੋਗੁ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਤਹ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mohu sog rog log na biaapai teh har har har ras bhoganee |1| rahaau |
English: Attachment, sorrow, disease and public opinion do not affect me, and so, I enjoy the subtle essence of the Lord, Har, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੁਰਗ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਮਿਰਤ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਪਇਆਲ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਅਲੋਗਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: surag pavitraa mirat pavitraa peaal pavitr aloganee |
English: I am pure in the heavenly realm, pure on this earth, and pure in the nether regions of the underworld. I remain apart from the people of the world.

Gurbani: ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਭੁੰਚੈ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aagiaakaaree sadaa sukh bhunchai jat kat pekhau har gunee |2|
English: Obedient to the Lord, I enjoy peace forever; wherever I look, I see the Lord of glorious virtues. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਹ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਜਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਵਨਾ ਤਹ ਅਕਾਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਮੇਦਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: neh siv sakatee jal nahee pavanaa teh akaar nahee medanee |
English: There is no Shiva or Shakti, no energy or matter, no water or wind, no world of form there,

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਜੋਗ ਕਾ ਤਹਾ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ਜਹ ਅਵਿਗਤ ਨਾਥੁ ਅਗਮ ਧਨੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: satigur jog kaa tahaa nivaasaa jeh avigat naath agam dhanee |3|
English: where the True Guru, the Yogi, dwells, where the Imperishable Lord God, the Unapproachable Master abides. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਧਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਗਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: tan man har kaa dhan sabh har kaa har ke gun hau kiaa ganee |
English: Body and mind belong to the Lord; all wealth belongs to the Lord; what glorious virtues of the Lord can I describe?

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਈ ਹੈ ਅੰਭੈ ਅੰਭੁ ਮਿਲੋਗਨੀ ॥੪॥੩॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak ham tum gur khoee hai anbhai anbh miloganee |4|3|
English: Says Nanak, the Guru has destroyed my sense of 'mine and yours'. Like water with water, I am blended with God. ||4||3||

[Ang 883 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਰਹਤ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: trai gun rehat rahai niraaree saadhik sidh na jaanai |
English: It is beyond the three qualities; it remains untouched. The seekers and Siddhas do not know it.

Gurbani: ਰਤਨ ਕੋਠੜੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੰਪੂਰਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਖਜਾਨੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ratan kottharree amrit sanpooran satigur kai khajaanai |1|
English: There is a chamber filled with jewels, overflowing with Ambrosial Nectar, in the Guru's Treasury. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਚਰਜੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: acharaj kichh kehan na jaaee |
English: This thing is wonderful and amazing! It cannot be described.

Gurbani: ਬਸਤੁ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: basat agochar bhaaee |1| rahaau |
English: It is an unfathomable object, O Siblings of Destiny! ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੋਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਕਰਣੈ ਜੋਗਾ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: mol naahee kachh karanai jogaa kiaa ko kahai sunaavai |
English: Its value cannot be estimated at all; what can anyone say about it?

Gurbani: ਕਥਨ ਕਹਣ ਕਉ ਸੋਝੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜੋ ਪੇਖੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਣਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kathan kehan kau sojhee naahee jo pekhai tis ban aavai |2|
English: By speaking and describing it, it cannot be understood; only one who sees it realizes it. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਬੇਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: soee jaanai karanaihaaraa keetaa kiaa bechaaraa |
English: Only the Creator Lord knows it; what can any poor creature do?

Gurbani: ਆਪਣੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਪੂਰ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aapanee gat mit aape jaanai har aape poor bhanddaaraa |3|
English: Only He Himself knows His own state and extent. The Lord Himself is the treasure overflowing. ||3||

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਰਹੇ ਆਘਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa ras amrit man chaakhiaa tripat rahe aaghaaee |
English: Tasting such Ambrosial Nectar, the mind remains satisfied and satiated.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰੀ ਆਸਾ ਪੂਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੪॥੪॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak meree aasaa pooree satigur kee saranaaee |4|4|
English: Says Nanak, my hopes are fulfilled; I have found the Guru's Sanctuary. ||4||4||

[Ang 884 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨੈ ਬੈਰੀ ਸਗਲੇ ਸਾਧੇ ॥
Transliteration: angeekaar keea prabh apanai bairee sagale saadhe |
English: God has made me His own, and vanquished all my enemies.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਬੈਰੀ ਹੈ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਲੂਟਿਆ ਤੇ ਬੈਰੀ ਲੈ ਬਾਧੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jin bairee hai ihu jag loottiaa te bairee lai baadhe |1|
English: Those enemies who have plundered this world, have all been placed in bondage. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: satigur paramesar meraa |
English: The True Guru is my Transcendent Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਰਾਜ ਭੋਗ ਰਸ ਮਾਣੀ ਨਾਉ ਜਪੀ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: anik raaj bhog ras maanee naau japee bharavaasaa teraa |1| rahaau |
English: I enjoy countless pleasures of power and tasty delights, chanting Your Name, and placing my faith in You. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਸਿ ਦੂਜੀ ਬਾਤਾ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਰਖਵਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: cheet na aavas doojee baataa sir aoopar rakhavaaraa |
English: I do not think of any other at all. The Lord is my protector, above my head.

Gurbani: ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਰਹਤ ਹੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਇਕ ਨਾਮ ਕੈ ਆਧਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: beparavaahu rehat hai suaamee ik naam kai aadhaaraa |2|
English: I am carefree and independent, when I have the Support of Your Name, O my Lord and Master. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਇ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਊਨ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਬਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: pooran hoe milio sukhadaaee aoon na kaaee baataa |
English: I have become perfect, meeting with the Giver of peace, and now, I lack nothing at all.

Gurbani: ਤਤੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tat saar param pad paaeaa chhodd na katahoo jaataa |3|
English: I have obtained the essence of excellence, the supreme status; I shall not forsake it to go anywhere else. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਜੈਸਾ ਤੂ ਹੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: baran na saakau jaisaa too hai saache alakh apaaraa |
English: I cannot describe how You are, O True Lord, unseen, infinite,

Gurbani: ਅਤੁਲ ਅਥਾਹ ਅਡੋਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਖਸਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੫॥
Transliteration: atul athaah addol suaamee naanak khasam hamaaraa |4|5|
English: immeasurable, unfathomable and unmoving Lord. O Nanak, He is my Lord and Master. ||4||5||

[Ang 884 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਦਾਨਾ ਤੂ ਅਬਿਚਲੁ ਤੂਹੀ ਤੂ ਜਾਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਪਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: too daanaa too abichal toohee too jaat meree paatee |
English: You are wise; You are eternal and unchanging. You are my social class and honor.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਅਡੋਲੁ ਕਦੇ ਡੋਲਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਾ ਹਮ ਕੈਸੀ ਤਾਤੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: too addol kade ddoleh naahee taa ham kaisee taatee |1|
English: You are unmoving - You never move at all. How can I be worried? ||1||

Gurbani: ਏਕੈ ਏਕੈ ਏਕ ਤੂਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: ekai ekai ek toohee |
English: You alone are the One and only Lord;

Gurbani: ਏਕੈ ਏਕੈ ਤੂ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: ekai ekai too raaeaa |
English: You alone are the king.

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tau kirapaa te sukh paaeaa |1| rahaau |
English: By Your Grace, I have found peace. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਹਮ ਹੰਸ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਤੁਮ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਣਕ ਲਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: too saagar ham hans tumaare tum meh maanak laalaa |
English: You are the ocean, and I am Your swan; the pearls and rubies are in You.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਸੰਕ ਨ ਮਾਨਹੁ ਹਮ ਭੁੰਚਹ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tum devahu til sank na maanahu ham bhunchah sadaa nihaalaa |2|
English: You give, and You do not hesitate for an instant; I receive, forever enraptured. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤੁਮ ਪਿਤਾ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਤੁਮ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਖੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: ham baarik tum pitaa hamaare tum mukh devahu kheeraa |
English: I am Your child, and You are my father; You place the milk in my mouth.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਖੇਲਹ ਸਭਿ ਲਾਡ ਲਡਾਵਹ ਤੁਮ ਸਦ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ham khelah sabh laadd laddaavah tum sad gunee gaheeraa |3|
English: I play with You, and You caress me in every way. You are forever the ocean of excellence. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਸੰਪੂਰਨ ਹਮ ਭੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਅਘਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: tum pooran poor rahe sanpooran ham bhee sang aghaae |
English: You are perfect, perfectly all-pervading; I am fulfilled with You as well.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਤ ਮਿਲਤ ਮਿਲਤ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥੪॥੬॥
Transliteration: milat milat milat mil rahiaa naanak kehan na jaae |4|6|
English: I am merged, merged, merged and remain merged; O Nanak, I cannot describe it! ||4||6||

[Ang 884 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਰ ਕਰਿ ਤਾਲ ਪਖਾਵਜੁ ਨੈਨਹੁ ਮਾਥੈ ਵਜਹਿ ਰਬਾਬਾ ॥
Transliteration: kar kar taal pakhaavaj nainahu maathai vajeh rabaabaa |
English: Make your hands the cymbals, your eyes the tambourines, and your forehead the guitar you play.

Gurbani: ਕਰਨਹੁ ਮਧੁ ਬਾਸੁਰੀ ਬਾਜੈ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਧੁਨਿ ਆਗਾਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: karanahu madh baasuree baajai jihavaa dhun aagaajaa |
English: Let the sweet flute music resound in your ears, and with your tongue, vibrate this song.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਨਾਚੈ ਆਣੇ ਘੂਘਰ ਸਾਜਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: nirat kare kar manooaa naachai aane ghooghar saajaa |1|
English: Move your mind like the rhythmic hand-motions; do the dance, and shake your ankle bracelets. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਨਿਰਤਿਕਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: raam ko niratikaaree |
English: This is the rhythmic dance of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਪੇਖੈ ਪੇਖਨਹਾਰੁ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਜੇਤਾ ਸਾਜੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: pekhai pekhanahaar deaalaa jetaa saaj seegaaree |1| rahaau |
English: The Merciful Audience, the Lord, sees all your make-up and decorations. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਖਾਰ ਮੰਡਲੀ ਧਰਣਿ ਸਬਾਈ ਊਪਰਿ ਗਗਨੁ ਚੰਦੋਆ ॥
Transliteration: aakhaar manddalee dharan sabaaee aoopar gagan chandoaa |
English: The whole earth is the stage, with the canopy of the sky overhead.

Gurbani: ਪਵਨੁ ਵਿਚੋਲਾ ਕਰਤ ਇਕੇਲਾ ਜਲ ਤੇ ਓਪਤਿ ਹੋਆ ॥
Transliteration: pavan vicholaa karat ikelaa jal te opat hoaa |
English: The wind is the director; people are born of water.

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਪੁਤਰਾ ਕੀਨਾ ਕਿਰਤ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: panch tat kar putaraa keenaa kirat milaavaa hoaa |2|
English: From the five elements, the puppet was created with its actions. ||2||

Gurbani: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਜਰੇ ਚਰਾਗਾ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
Transliteration: chand sooraj due jare charaagaa chahu kuntt bheetar raakhe |
English: The sun and the moon are the two lamps which shine, with the four corners of the world placed between them.

Gurbani: ਦਸ ਪਾਤਉ ਪੰਚ ਸੰਗੀਤਾ ਏਕੈ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸਾਥੇ ॥
Transliteration: das paatau panch sangeetaa ekai bheetar saathe |
English: The ten senses are the dancing girls, and the five passions are the chorus; they sit together within the one body.

Gurbani: ਭਿੰਨ ਭਿੰਨ ਹੋਇ ਭਾਵ ਦਿਖਾਵਹਿ ਸਭਹੁ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ਭਾਖੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bhin bhin hoe bhaav dikhaaveh sabhahu niraaree bhaakhe |3|
English: They all put on their own shows, and speak in different languages. ||3||

Gurbani: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਨਿਰਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਵਾਜੈ ਤੂਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: ghar ghar nirat hovai din raatee ghatt ghatt vaajai tooraa |
English: In each and every home there is dancing, day and night; in each and every home, the bugles blow.

Gurbani: ਏਕਿ ਨਚਾਵਹਿ ਏਕਿ ਭਵਾਵਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਆਇ ਜਾਇ ਹੋਇ ਧੂਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: ek nachaaveh ek bhavaaveh ik aae jaae hoe dhooraa |
English: Some are made to dance, and some are whirled around; some come and some go, and some are reduced to dust.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਨਾਚੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਪੂਰਾ ॥੪॥੭॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak so bahur na naachai jis gur bhettai pooraa |4|7|
English: Says Nanak, one who meets with the True Guru, does not have to dance the dance of reincarnation again. ||4||7||

[Ang 885 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਏਕ ਧੁਨਿ ਏਕੈ ਏਕੈ ਰਾਗੁ ਅਲਾਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: oankaar ek dhun ekai ekai raag alaapai |
English: He sings the song of the One Universal Creator; he sings the tune of the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਏਕਾ ਦੇਸੀ ਏਕੁ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਏਕੋ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: ekaa desee ek dikhaavai eko rahiaa biaapai |
English: He lives in the land of the One Lord, shows the way to the One Lord, and remains attuned to the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਏਕਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਏਕਾ ਹੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਏਕੋ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ekaa surat ekaa hee sevaa eko gur te jaapai |1|
English: He centers his consciousness on the One Lord, and serves only the One Lord, who is known through the Guru. ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਲੋ ਭਲੋ ਰੇ ਕੀਰਤਨੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: bhalo bhalo re keerataneea |
English: Blessed and good is such a kirtanee, who sings such Praises.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਰਮਾ ਰਾਮਾ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raam ramaa raamaa gun gaau |
English: He sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord,

Gurbani: ਛੋਡਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਧੰਧ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: chhodd maaeaa ke dhandh suaau |1| rahaau |
English: and renounces the entanglements and pursuits of Maya. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਬਜਿਤ੍ਰ ਕਰੇ ਸੰਤੋਖਾ ਸਾਤ ਸੁਰਾ ਲੈ ਚਾਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: panch bajitr kare santokhaa saat suraa lai chaalai |
English: He makes the five virtues, like contentment, his musical instruments, and plays the seven notes of the love of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਬਾਜਾ ਮਾਣੁ ਤਾਣੁ ਤਜਿ ਤਾਨਾ ਪਾਉ ਨ ਬੀਗਾ ਘਾਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: baajaa maan taan taj taanaa paau na beegaa ghaalai |
English: The notes he plays are the renunciation of pride and power; his feet keep the beat on the straight path.

Gurbani: ਫੇਰੀ ਫੇਰੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਏਕੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੰਧਿ ਪਾਲੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: feree fer na hovai kab hee ek sabad bandh paalai |2|
English: He does not enter the cycle of reincarnation ever again; he keeps the One Word of the Shabad tied to the hem of his robe. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਾਰਦੀ ਨਰਹਰ ਜਾਣਿ ਹਦੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: naaradee narahar jaan hadoore |
English: To play like Naarad, is to know that the Lord is ever-present.

Gurbani: ਘੂੰਘਰ ਖੜਕੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਵਿਸੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: ghoonghar kharrak tiaag visoore |
English: The tinkling of the ankle bells is the shedding of sorrows and worries.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj anand dikhaavai bhaavai |
English: The dramatic gestures of acting are celestial bliss.

Gurbani: ਏਹੁ ਨਿਰਤਿਕਾਰੀ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ehu niratikaaree janam na aavai |3|
English: Such a dancer is not reincarnated again. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਅਪਨੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: je ko apane tthaakur bhaavai |
English: If anyone, out of millions of people, becomes pleasing to his Lord and Master,

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧਿ ਏਹੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: kott madh ehu keeratan gaavai |
English: He sings the Lord's Praises in this way.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੀ ਜਾਵਉ ਟੇਕ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasangat kee jaavau ttek |
English: I have taken the Support of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਏਕ ॥੪॥੮॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak tis keeratan ek |4|8|
English: Says Nanak, the Kirtan of the One Lord's Praises are sung there. ||4||8||

[Ang 885 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਬੋਲੈ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਕੋਈ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: koee bolai raam raam koee khudaae |
English: Some call Him, 'Raam, Raam', and some call Him, 'Khudaa-i'.

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਸੇਵੈ ਗੁਸਈਆ ਕੋਈ ਅਲਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: koee sevai guseea koee alaeh |1|
English: Some serve Him as 'Gusain', others as 'Allaah'. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਣ ਕਰੀਮ ॥
Transliteration: kaaran karan kareem |
English: He is the Cause of causes, the Generous Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਹੀਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kirapaa dhaar raheem |1| rahaau |
English: He showers His Grace and Mercy upon us. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਨਾਵੈ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਕੋਈ ਹਜ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: koee naavai teerath koee haj jaae |
English: Some bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, and some make the pilgrimage to Mecca.|

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਕਰੈ ਪੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ ਸਿਰੁ ਨਿਵਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: koee karai poojaa koee sir nivaae |2|
English: Some perform devotional worship services, and some bow their heads in prayer. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਪੜੈ ਬੇਦ ਕੋਈ ਕਤੇਬ ॥
Transliteration: koee parrai bed koee kateb |
English: Some read the Vedas, and some the Koran.

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਓਢੈ ਨੀਲ ਕੋਈ ਸੁਪੇਦ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: koee odtai neel koee suped |3|
English: Some wear blue robes, and some wear white. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਕਹੈ ਤੁਰਕੁ ਕੋਈ ਕਹੈ ਹਿੰਦੂ ॥
Transliteration: koee kahai turak koee kahai hindoo |
English: Some call themselves Muslim, and some call themselves Hindu.

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਬਾਛੈ ਭਿਸਤੁ ਕੋਈ ਸੁਰਗਿੰਦੂ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: koee baachhai bhisat koee suragindoo |4|
English: Some yearn for paradise, and others long for heaven. ||4||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak jin hukam pachhaataa |
English: Says Nanak, one who realizes the Hukam of God's Will,

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਭੇਦੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੫॥੯॥
Transliteration: prabh saahib kaa tin bhed jaataa |5|9|
English: knows the secrets of his Lord and Master. ||5||9||

[Ang 885 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪਵਨੈ ਮਹਿ ਪਵਨੁ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: pavanai meh pavan samaaeaa |
English: The wind merges into the wind.

Gurbani: ਜੋਤੀ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਲਿ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jotee meh jot ral jaaeaa |
English: The light blends into the light.

Gurbani: ਮਾਟੀ ਮਾਟੀ ਹੋਈ ਏਕ ॥
Transliteration: maattee maattee hoee ek |
English: The dust becomes one with the dust.

Gurbani: ਰੋਵਨਹਾਰੇ ਕੀ ਕਵਨ ਟੇਕ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: rovanahaare kee kavan ttek |1|
English: What support is there for the one who is lamenting? ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਉਨੁ ਮੂਆ ਰੇ ਕਉਨੁ ਮੂਆ ॥
Transliteration: kaun mooaa re kaun mooaa |
English: Who has died? O, who has died?

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ਇਹੁ ਤਉ ਚਲਤੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: braham giaanee mil karahu beechaaraa ihu tau chalat bheaa |1| rahaau |
English: O God-realized beings, meet together and consider this. What a wondrous thing has happened! ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਗਲੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: agalee kichh khabar na paaee |
English: No one knows what happens after death.

Gurbani: ਰੋਵਨਹਾਰੁ ਭਿ ਊਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: rovanahaar bhi aootth sidhaaee |
English: The one who is lamenting will also arise and depart.

Gurbani: ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਕੇ ਬਾਂਧੇ ਬੰਧ ॥
Transliteration: bharam moh ke baandhe bandh |
English: Mortal beings are bound by the bonds of doubt and attachment.

Gurbani: ਸੁਪਨੁ ਭਇਆ ਭਖਲਾਏ ਅੰਧ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: supan bheaa bhakhalaae andh |2|
English: When life becomes a dream, the blind man babbles and grieves in vain. ||2||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਤਉ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਿਆ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: eihu tau rachan rachiaa karataar |
English: The Creator Lord created this creation.

Gurbani: ਆਵਤ ਜਾਵਤ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: aavat jaavat hukam apaar |
English: It comes and goes, subject to the Will of the Infinite Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਹ ਕੋ ਮੂਆ ਨ ਮਰਣੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: neh ko mooaa na maranai jog |
English: No one dies; no one is capable of dying.

Gurbani: ਨਹ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਹੋਗੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: neh binasai abinaasee hog |3|
English: The soul does not perish; it is imperishable. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਇਹੁ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਸੋ ਇਹੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jo ihu jaanahu so ihu naeh |
English: That which is known, does not exist.

Gurbani: ਜਾਨਣਹਾਰੇ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaananahaare kau bal jaau |
English: I am a sacrifice to the one who knows this.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak gur bharam chukaaeaa |
English: Says Nanak, the Guru has dispelled my doubt.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਕੋਈ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: naa koee marai na aavai jaaeaa |4|10|
English: No one dies; no one comes or goes. ||4||10||

[Ang 885 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਲਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: jap gobind gopaal laal |
English: Meditate on the Lord of the Universe, the Beloved Lord of the World.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਤੂ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਨ ਖਾਈ ਮਹਾ ਕਾਲੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam simar too jeeveh fir na khaaee mahaa kaal |1| rahaau |
English: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord's Name, you shall live, and the Great Death shall not consume you ever again. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: kott janam bhram bhram bhram aaeo |
English: Through millions of incarnations, you have come, wandering, wandering, wandering.

Gurbani: ਬਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: baddai bhaag saadhasang paaeo |1|
English: By the highest destiny, you found the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: bin gur poore naahee udhaar |
English: Without the Perfect Guru, no one is saved.

Gurbani: ਬਾਬਾ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ ਏਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੨॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: baabaa naanak aakhai ehu beechaar |2|11|
English: This is what Baba Nanak says, after deep reflection. ||2||11||

[Ang 886 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: raag raamakalee mahalaa 5 ghar 2 |
English: Raag Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl, Second House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਚਾਰਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਹਿ ਨਾ ਤੂ ਮਾਨਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: chaar pukaareh naa too maaneh |
English: The four Vedas proclaim it, but you don't believe them.

Gurbani: ਖਟੁ ਭੀ ਏਕਾ ਬਾਤ ਵਖਾਨਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: khatt bhee ekaa baat vakhaaneh |
English: The six Shaastras also say one thing.

Gurbani: ਦਸ ਅਸਟੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਏਕੋ ਕਹਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: das asattee mil eko kahiaa |
English: The eighteen Puraanas all speak of the One God.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਭੀ ਜੋਗੀ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਲਹਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: taa bhee jogee bhed na lahiaa |1|
English: Even so, Yogi, you do not understand this mystery. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਿੰਕੁਰੀ ਅਨੂਪ ਵਾਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: kinkuree anoop vaajai |
English: The celestial harp plays the incomparable melody,

Gurbani: ਜੋਗੀਆ ਮਤਵਾਰੋ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jogeea matavaaro re |1| rahaau |
English: but in your intoxication, you do not hear it, O Yogi. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਥਮੇ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਤ ਕਾ ਖੇੜਾ ॥
Transliteration: prathame vasiaa sat kaa kherraa |
English: In the first age, the Golden Age, the village of truth was inhabited.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਤੀਏ ਮਹਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਭਇਆ ਦੁਤੇੜਾ ॥
Transliteration: tritee meh kichh bheaa duterraa |
English: In the Silver Age of Traytaa Yuga, things began to decline.

Gurbani: ਦੁਤੀਆ ਅਰਧੋ ਅਰਧਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: duteea aradho aradh samaaeaa |
English: In the Brass Age of Dwaapur Yuga, half of it was gone.

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ek rahiaa taa ek dikhaaeaa |2|
English: Now, only one leg of Truth remains, and the One Lord is revealed. ||2||

Gurbani: ਏਕੈ ਸੂਤਿ ਪਰੋਏ ਮਣੀਏ ॥
Transliteration: ekai soot paroe manee |
English: The beads are strung upon the one thread.

Gurbani: ਗਾਠੀ ਭਿਨਿ ਭਿਨਿ ਭਿਨਿ ਭਿਨਿ ਤਣੀਏ ॥
Transliteration: gaatthee bhin bhin bhin bhin tanee |
English: By means of many, various, diverse knots, they are tied, and kept separate on the string.

Gurbani: ਫਿਰਤੀ ਮਾਲਾ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: firatee maalaa bahu bidh bhaae |
English: The beads of the mala are lovingly chanted upon in many ways.

Gurbani: ਖਿੰਚਿਆ ਸੂਤੁ ਤ ਆਈ ਥਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: khinchiaa soot ta aaee thaae |3|
English: When the thread is pulled out, the beads come together in one place. ||3||

Gurbani: ਚਹੁ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੈ ਮਟੁ ਹੈ ਕੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: chahu meh ekai matt hai keea |
English: Throughout the four ages, the One Lord made the body His temple.

Gurbani: ਤਹ ਬਿਖੜੇ ਥਾਨ ਅਨਿਕ ਖਿੜਕੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: teh bikharre thaan anik khirrakeea |
English: It is a treacherous place, with several windows.

Gurbani: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਦੁਆਰੇ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: khojat khojat duaare aaeaa |
English: Searching and searching, one comes to the Lord's door.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋਗੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: taa naanak jogee mehal ghar paaeaa |4|
English: Then, O Nanak, the Yogi attains a home in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||4||

Gurbani: ਇਉ ਕਿੰਕੁਰੀ ਆਨੂਪ ਵਾਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: eiau kinkuree aanoop vaajai |
English: Thus, the celestial harp plays the incomparable melody;

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਮੀਠੀ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: sun jogee kai man meetthee laagai |1| rahaau doojaa |1|12|
English: hearing it, the Yogi's mind finds it sweet. ||1||Second Pause||1||12||

[Ang 886 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤਾਗਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਲਾਈ ਥਿਗਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: taagaa kar kai laaee thigalee |
English: The body is a patch-work of threads.

Gurbani: ਲਉ ਨਾੜੀ ਸੂਆ ਹੈ ਅਸਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: lau naarree sooaa hai asatee |
English: The muscles are stitched together with the needles of the bones.

Gurbani: ਅੰਭੈ ਕਾ ਕਰਿ ਡੰਡਾ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: anbhai kaa kar ddanddaa dhariaa |
English: The Lord has erected a pillar of water.

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਤੂ ਜੋਗੀ ਗਰਬਹਿ ਪਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kiaa too jogee garabeh pariaa |1|
English: O Yogi, why are you so proud? ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਨਾਥੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jap naath din rainaaee |
English: Meditate on your Lord Master, day and night.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੀ ਖਿੰਥਾ ਦੋ ਦਿਹਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: teree khinthaa do dihaaee |1| rahaau |
English: The patched coat of the body shall last for only a few days. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗਹਰੀ ਬਿਭੂਤ ਲਾਇ ਬੈਠਾ ਤਾੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: gaharee bibhoot laae baitthaa taarree |
English: Smearing ashes on your body, you sit in a deep meditative trance.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: meree teree mundraa dhaaree |
English: You wear the ear-rings of 'mine and yours'.

Gurbani: ਮਾਗਹਿ ਟੂਕਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: maageh ttookaa tripat na paavai |
English: You beg for bread, but you are not satisfied.

Gurbani: ਨਾਥੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਚਹਿ ਲਾਜ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naath chhodd jaacheh laaj na aavai |2|
English: Abandoning your Lord Master, you beg from others; you should feel ashamed. ||2||

Gurbani: ਚਲ ਚਿਤ ਜੋਗੀ ਆਸਣੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: chal chit jogee aasan teraa |
English: Your consciousness is restless, Yogi, as you sit in your Yogic postures.

Gurbani: ਸਿੰਙੀ ਵਾਜੈ ਨਿਤ ਉਦਾਸੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: singee vaajai nit udaaseraa |
English: You blow your horn, but still feel sad.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਗੋਰਖ ਕੀ ਤੈ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur gorakh kee tai boojh na paaee |
English: You do not understand Gorakh, your guru.

Gurbani: ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: fir fir jogee aavai jaaee |3|
English: Again and again, Yogi, you come and go. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੋਆ ਨਾਥੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: jis no hoaa naath kripaalaa |
English: He, unto whom the Master shows Mercy

Gurbani: ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: raharaas hamaaree gur gopaalaa |
English: unto Him, the Guru, the Lord of the World, I offer my prayer.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੈ ਖਿੰਥਾ ਨਾਮੈ ਬਸਤਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: naamai khinthaa naamai basatar |
English: One who has the Name as his patched coat, and the Name as his robe,

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋਗੀ ਹੋਆ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jan naanak jogee hoaa asathir |4|
English: O servant Nanak, such a Yogi is steady and stable. ||4||

Gurbani: ਇਉ ਜਪਿਆ ਨਾਥੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: eiau japiaa naath din rainaaee |
English: One who meditates on the Master in this way, night and day,

Gurbani: ਹੁਣਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਸਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੨॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: hun paaeaa gur gosaaee |1| rahaau doojaa |2|13|
English: finds the Guru, the Lord of the World, in this life. ||1||Second Pause||2||13||

[Ang 886 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: karan karaavan soee |
English: He is the Creator, the Cause of causes;

Gurbani: ਆਨ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aan na deesai koee |
English: I do not see any other at all.

Gurbani: ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: tthaakur meraa sugharr sujaanaa |
English: My Lord and Master is wise and all-knowing.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: guramukh miliaa rang maanaa |1|
English: Meeting with the Gurmukh, I enjoy His Love. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸੋ ਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: aiso re har ras meetthaa |
English: Such is the sweet, subtle essence of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh kinai viralai ddeetthaa |1| rahaau |
English: How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, taste it. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: niramal jot amrit har naam |
English: The Light of the Ambrosial Name of the Lord is immaculate and pure.

Gurbani: ਪੀਵਤ ਅਮਰ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: peevat amar bhe nihakaam |
English: Drinking it in, one becomes immortal and free of desire.

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: tan man seetal agan nivaaree |
English: The body and mind are cooled and soothed, and the fire is extinguished.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦ ਰੂਪ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: anad roop pragatte sansaaree |2|
English: Such a being is the embodiment of bliss, famous throughout the world. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਦੇਵਉ ਜਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa devau jaa sabh kichh teraa |
English: What can I offer You, Lord? Everything belongs to You.

Gurbani: ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿ ਜਾਉ ਲਖ ਬੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sad balihaar jaau lakh beraa |
English: I am forever a sacrifice to You, hundreds of thousands of times.

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਦੇ ਸਾਜਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: tan man jeeo pindd de saajiaa |
English: You blessed me, and fashioned my body, mind and soul.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਨੀਚੁ ਨਿਵਾਜਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur kirapaa te neech nivaajiaa |3|
English: By Guru's Grace, this lowly being was exalted. ||3||

Gurbani: ਖੋਲਿ ਕਿਵਾਰਾ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: khol kivaaraa mehal bulaaeaa |
English: Opening the door, You summoned me to the Mansion of Your Presence.

Gurbani: ਜੈਸਾ ਸਾ ਤੈਸਾ ਦਿਖਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jaisaa saa taisaa dikhalaaeaa |
English: As You are, so You have revealed Yourself to me.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭੁ ਪੜਦਾ ਤੂਟਾ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak sabh parradaa toottaa |
English: Says Nanak, the screen is totally torn away;

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਵੂਠਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: hau teraa too mai man vootthaa |4|3|14|
English: I am Yours, and You are enshrined within my mind. ||4||3||14||

[Ang 887 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਕੁ ਲਾਇਓ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਸੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: sevak laaeo apunee sev |
English: He has linked His servant to His service.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਓ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: amrit naam deeo mukh dev |
English: The Divine Guru has poured the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, into his mouth.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: sagalee chintaa aap nivaaree |
English: He has subdued all his anxiety.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tis gur kau hau sad balihaaree |1|
English: I am forever a sacrifice to that Guru. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਾਜ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਗੁਰ ॥
Transliteration: kaaj hamaare poore satagur |
English: The True Guru has perfectly resolved my affairs.

Gurbani: ਬਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਤੂਰੇ ਸਤਗੁਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: baaje anahad toore satagur |1| rahaau |
English: The True Guru vibrates the unstruck melody of the sound current. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਹਿਮਾ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: mahimaa jaa kee gahir ganbheer |
English: His Glory is profound and unfathomable.

Gurbani: ਹੋਇ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਦੇਇ ਜਿਸੁ ਧੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: hoe nihaal dee jis dheer |
English: One whom He blesses with patience becomes blissful.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੇ ਰਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jaa ke bandhan kaatte raae |
English: One whose bonds are shattered by the Sovereign Lord

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਨਰੁ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: so nar bahur na jonee paae |2|
English: is not cast into the womb of reincarnation again. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਓ ਆਪ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai antar pragattio aap |
English: One who is illuminated by the Lord's radiance within,

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੂਖ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥
Transliteration: taa kau naahee dookh santaap |
English: is not touched by pain and sorrow.

Gurbani: ਲਾਲੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਾਲੈ ਪਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: laal ratan tis paalai pariaa |
English: He holds in his robe the gems and jewels.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਓਹੁ ਜਨੁ ਲੈ ਤਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sagal kuttanb ohu jan lai tariaa |3|
English: That humble being is saved, along with all his generations. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: naa kichh bharam na dubidhaa doojaa |
English: He has no doubt, double-mindedness or duality at all.

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: eko ek niranjan poojaa |
English: He worships and adores the One Immaculate Lord alone.

Gurbani: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਦੇਖਉ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
Transliteration: jat kat dekhau aap deaal |
English: Wherever I look, I see the Merciful Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲੇ ਰਸਾਲ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak prabh mile rasaal |4|4|15|
English: Says Nanak, I have found God, the source of nectar. ||4||4||15||

[Ang 887 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤਨ ਤੇ ਛੁਟਕੀ ਅਪਨੀ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: tan te chhuttakee apanee dhaaree |
English: My self-conceit has been eliminated from my body.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਲਗੀ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kee aagiaa lagee piaaree |
English: The Will of God is dear to me.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo kichh karai su man merai meetthaa |
English: Whatever He does, seems sweet to my mind.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਇਹੁ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਨੈਨਹੁ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: taa ihu acharaj nainahu ddeetthaa |1|
English: And then, these eyes behold the wondrous Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਜਾਨੀ ਰੇ ਮੇਰੀ ਗਈ ਬਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: ab mohi jaanee re meree gee balaae |
English: Now, I have become wise and my demons are gone.

Gurbani: ਬੁਝਿ ਗਈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਮਮਤਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਲੀਓ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bujh gee trisan nivaaree mamataa gur poorai leeo samajhaae |1| rahaau |
English: My thirst is quenched, and my attachment is dispelled. The Perfect Guru has instructed me. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa raakhio gur saranaa |
English: In His Mercy, the Guru has kept me under His protection.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪਕਰਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur pakaraae har ke charanaa |
English: The Guru has attached me to the Lord's Feet.

Gurbani: ਬੀਸ ਬਿਸੁਏ ਜਾ ਮਨ ਠਹਰਾਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: bees bisue jaa man tthaharaane |
English: When the mind is totally held in check,

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਏਕੈ ਹੀ ਜਾਨੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur paarabraham ekai hee jaane |2|
English: one sees the Guru and the Supreme Lord God as one and the same. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕੀਨੋ ਹਮ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: jo jo keeno ham tis ke daas |
English: Whoever You have created, I am his slave.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਕੋ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: prabh mere ko sagal nivaas |
English: My God dwells in all.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਦੂਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਬੈਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: naa ko doot nahee bairaaee |
English: I have no enemies, no adversaries.

Gurbani: ਗਲਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਚਾਲੇ ਏਕੈ ਭਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gal mil chaale ekai bhaaee |3|
English: I walk arm in arm, like brothers, with all. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਏ ਸੂਖਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kau gur har dee sookhaa |
English: One whom the Guru, the Lord, blesses with peace,

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਲਾਗਹਿ ਦੂਖਾ ॥
Transliteration: taa kau bahur na laageh dookhaa |
English: does not suffer in pain any longer.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਸਰਬ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: aape aap sarab pratipaal |
English: He Himself cherishes all.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਤਉ ਰੰਗਿ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: naanak raatau rang gopaal |4|5|16|
English: Nanak is imbued with the love of the Lord of the World. ||4||5||16||

[Ang 887 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਪੜਤਾ ਟੀਕਾ ਸਹਿਤ ॥
Transliteration: mukh te parrataa tteekaa sahit |
English: You read the scriptures, and the commentaries,

Gurbani: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਰਹਤ ॥
Transliteration: hiradai raam nahee pooran rehat |
English: but the Perfect Lord does not dwell in your heart.

Gurbani: ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਲੋਕ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: aupades kare kar lok drirraavai |
English: You preach to others to have faith,

Gurbani: ਅਪਨਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਨ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: apanaa kahiaa aap na kamaavai |1|
English: but you do not practice what you preach. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਬੇਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ॥
Transliteration: panddit bed beechaar panddit |
English: O Pandit, O religious scholar, contemplate the Vedas.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: man kaa krodh nivaar panddit |1| rahaau |
English: Eradicate anger from your mind, O Pandit. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਗੈ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਸਾਲ ਗਿਰਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: aagai raakhio saal giraam |
English: You place your stone god before yourself,

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: man keeno deh dis bisraam |
English: but your mind wanders in the ten directions.

Gurbani: ਤਿਲਕੁ ਚਰਾਵੈ ਪਾਈ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: tilak charaavai paaee paae |
English: You apply a ceremonial tilak mark to its forehead, and fall at its feet.

Gurbani: ਲੋਕ ਪਚਾਰਾ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: lok pachaaraa andh kamaae |2|
English: You try to appease the people, and act blindly. ||2||

Gurbani: ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਅਰੁ ਆਸਣੁ ਧੋਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: khatt karamaa ar aasan dhotee |
English: You perform the six religious rituals, and sit wearing your loin-cloth.

Gurbani: ਭਾਗਠਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਪੜੈ ਨਿਤ ਪੋਥੀ ॥
Transliteration: bhaagatth grihi parrai nit pothee |
English: In the homes of the wealthy, you read the prayer book.

Gurbani: ਮਾਲਾ ਫੇਰੈ ਮੰਗੈ ਬਿਭੂਤ ॥
Transliteration: maalaa ferai mangai bibhoot |
English: You chant on your mala, and beg for money.

Gurbani: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਤਰਿਓ ਮੀਤ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: eih bidh koe na tario meet |3|
English: No one has ever been saved in this way, friend. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: so panddit gurasabad kamaae |
English: He alone is a Pandit, who lives the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਕੀ ਓਸੁ ਉਤਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: trai gun kee os utaree maae |
English: Maya, of the three qualities, leaves him.

Gurbani: ਚਤੁਰ ਬੇਦ ਪੂਰਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: chatur bed pooran har naae |
English: The four Vedas are completely contained within the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: naanak tis kee saranee paae |4|6|17|
English: Nanak seeks His Sanctuary. ||4||6||17||

[Ang 888 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਬਿਘਨ ਨਹੀ ਆਵਹਿ ਨੇਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: kott bighan nahee aaveh ner |
English: Millions of troubles do not come near him;

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਹੈ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਚੇਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: anik maaeaa hai taa kee cher |
English: the many manifestations of Maya are his hand-maidens;

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਪਾਪ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਪਾਨੀਹਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: anik paap taa ke paaneehaar |
