English: countless sins are his water-carriers;

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਮਇਆ ਭਈ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jaa kau meaa bhee karataar |1|
English: he is blessed with the Grace of the Creator Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਹੋਇ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: jiseh sahaaee hoe bhagavaan |
English: One who has the Lord God as his help and support

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਉਆ ਕੈ ਸਰੰਜਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: anik jatan uaa kai saranjaam |1| rahaau |
English: - all his efforts are fulfilled. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਰਤਾ ਰਾਖੈ ਕੀਤਾ ਕਉਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: karataa raakhai keetaa kaun |
English: He is protected by the Creator Lord; what harm can anyone do to him?

Gurbani: ਕੀਰੀ ਜੀਤੋ ਸਗਲਾ ਭਵਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: keeree jeeto sagalaa bhavan |
English: Even an ant can conquer the whole world.

Gurbani: ਬੇਅੰਤ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੇਤਕ ਬਰਨ ॥
Transliteration: beant mahimaa taa kee ketak baran |
English: His glory is endless; how can I describe it?

Gurbani: ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bal bal jaaeeai taa ke charan |2|
English: I am a sacrifice, a devoted sacrifice, to His feet. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਕੀਆ ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: tin hee keea jap tap dhiaan |
English: He alone performs worship, austerities and meditation;

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: anik prakaar keea tin daan |
English: he alone is a giver to various charities;

Gurbani: ਭਗਤੁ ਸੋਈ ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat soee kal meh paravaan |
English: he alone is approved in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga,

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jaa kau tthaakur deea maan |3|
English: whom the Lord Master blesses with honor. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਏ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang mil bhe pragaas |
English: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I am enlightened.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜ ਸੂਖ ਆਸ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj sookh aas nivaas |
English: I have found celestial peace, and my hopes are fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਬਿਸਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: poorai satigur deea bisaas |
English: The Perfect True Guru has blessed me with faith.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੋਏ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: naanak hoe daasan daas |4|7|18|
English: Nanak is the slave of His slaves. ||4||7||18||

[Ang 888 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਦੀਜੈ ਕਾਹੂ ਲੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: dos na deejai kaahoo log |
English: Don't blame others, O people;

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਮਾਵਨੁ ਸੋਈ ਭੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: jo kamaavan soee bhog |
English: as you plant, so shall you harvest.

Gurbani: ਆਪਨ ਕਰਮ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਬੰਧ ॥
Transliteration: aapan karam aape hee bandh |
English: By your actions, you have bound yourself.

Gurbani: ਆਵਨੁ ਜਾਵਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਧੰਧ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aavan jaavan maaeaa dhandh |1|
English: You come and go, entangled in Maya. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸੀ ਜਾਨੀ ਸੰਤ ਜਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: aisee jaanee sant janee |
English: Such is the understanding of the Saintly people.

Gurbani: ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਭਇਆ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: paragaas bheaa poore gur bachanee |1| rahaau |
English: You shall be enlightened, through the Word of the Perfect Guru. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਕਲਤੁ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: tan dhan kalat mithiaa bisathaar |
English: Body, wealth, spouse and ostentatious displays are false.

Gurbani: ਹੈਵਰ ਗੈਵਰ ਚਾਲਨਹਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: haivar gaivar chaalanahaar |
English: Horses and elephants will pass away.

Gurbani: ਰਾਜ ਰੰਗ ਰੂਪ ਸਭਿ ਕੂਰ ॥
Transliteration: raaj rang roop sabh koor |
English: Power, pleasures and beauty are all false.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਸੀ ਧੂਰ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naam binaa hoe jaasee dhoor |2|
English: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, everything is reduced to dust. ||2||

Gurbani: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਬਾਦਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: bharam bhoole baad ahankaaree |
English: The egotistical people are deluded by useless doubt.

Gurbani: ਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਪਸਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: sang naahee re sagal pasaaree |
English: Of all this expanse, nothing shall go along with you.

Gurbani: ਸੋਗ ਹਰਖ ਮਹਿ ਦੇਹ ਬਿਰਧਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: sog harakh meh deh biradhaanee |
English: Through pleasure and pain, the body is growing old.

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤ ਇਵ ਹੀ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਹਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: saakat iv hee karat bihaanee |3|
English: Doing these things, the faithless cynics are passing their lives. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਕਲਿ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam amrit kal maeh |
English: The Name of the Lord is Ambrosial Nectar in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.

Gurbani: ਏਹੁ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ਸਾਧੂ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: ehu nidhaanaa saadhoo paeh |
English: This treasure is obtained from the Holy.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: naanak gur govid jis tootthaa |
English: O Nanak, whoever pleases the Guru,

Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਮਈਆ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੪॥੮॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt rameea tin hee ddeetthaa |4|8|19|
English: the Lord of the Universe, beholds the Lord in each and every heart. ||4||8||19||

[Ang 888 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦ ਤਹ ਪੂਰਨ ਨਾਦ ॥
Transliteration: panch sabad teh pooran naad |
English: The Panch Shabad, the five primal sounds, echo the perfect sound current of the Naad.

Gurbani: ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਜੇ ਅਚਰਜ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥
Transliteration: anahad baaje acharaj bisamaad |
English: The wondrous, amazing unstruck melody vibrates.

Gurbani: ਕੇਲ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਲੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: kel kareh sant har log |
English: The Saintly people play there with the Lord.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਨਿਰਜੋਗ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: paarabraham pooran nirajog |1|
English: They remain totally detached, absorbed in the Supreme Lord God. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਭਵਨ ॥
Transliteration: sookh sehaj aanand bhavan |
English: It is the realm of celestial peace and bliss.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਬੈਸਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਤਹ ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਨਹੀ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang bais gun gaaveh teh rog sog nahee janam maran |1| rahaau |
English: The Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, sits and sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. There is no disease or sorrow there, no birth or death. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਊਹਾ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: aoohaa simareh keval naam |
English: There, they meditate only on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਬਿਰਲੇ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਓਹੁ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: birale paaveh ohu bisraam |
English: How rare are those who find this place of rest.

Gurbani: ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭਾਉ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: bhojan bhaau keeratan aadhaar |
English: The love of God is their food, and the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise is their support.

Gurbani: ਨਿਹਚਲ ਆਸਨੁ ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: nihachal aasan besumaar |2|
English: They obtain a permanent seat in the infinite. ||2||

Gurbani: ਡਿਗਿ ਨ ਡੋਲੈ ਕਤਹੂ ਨ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: ddig na ddolai katahoo na dhaavai |
English: No one falls there, or wavers, or goes anywhere.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਕੋ ਇਹੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad ko ihu mehal paavai |
English: By Guru's Grace, some find this mansion.

Gurbani: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੈ ਮੋਹ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: bhram bhai moh na maaeaa jaal |
English: They are not touched by doubt, fear, attachment or the traps of Maya.

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sun samaadh prabhoo kirapaal |3|
English: They enter the deepest state of Samaadhi, through the kind mercy of God. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: taa kaa ant na paaraavaar |
English: He has no end or limitation.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape gupat aape paasaar |
English: He Himself is unmanifest, and He Himself is manifest.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai antar har har suaad |
English: One who enjoys the taste of the Lord, Har, Har, deep within himself,

Gurbani: ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ॥੪॥੯॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: kehan na jaaee naanak bisamaad |4|9|20|
English: O Nanak, his wondrous state cannot be described. ||4||9||20||

[Ang 889 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਭੇਟਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bhettat sang paarabraham chit aaeaa |
English: Meeting with the Sangat, the Congregation, the Supreme Lord God has come into my consciousness.

Gurbani: ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰਤ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਮਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sangat karat santokh man paaeaa |
English: In the Sangat, my mind has found contentment.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਹ ਚਰਨ ਮਾਥਾ ਮੇਰੋ ਪਉਤ ॥
Transliteration: santah charan maathaa mero paut |
English: I touch my forehead to the feet of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਰ ਸੰਤਹ ਡੰਡਉਤ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: anik baar santah ddanddaut |1|
English: Countless times, I humbly bow to the Saints. ||1||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: eihu man santan kai balihaaree |
English: This mind is a sacrifice to the Saints;

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਾਖੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kee ott gahee sukh paaeaa raakhe kirapaa dhaaree |1| rahaau |
English: holding tight to their support, I have found peace, and in their mercy, they have protected me. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਹ ਚਰਣ ਧੋਇ ਧੋਇ ਪੀਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: santah charan dhoe dhoe peevaa |
English: I wash the feet of the Saints, and drink in that water.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਹ ਦਰਸੁ ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਜੀਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: santah daras pekh pekh jeevaa |
English: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Saints' Darshan, I live.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਹ ਕੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਸ ॥
Transliteration: santah kee merai man aas |
English: My mind rests its hopes in the Saints.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sant hamaaree niramal raas |2|
English: The Saints are my immaculate wealth. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਪੜਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: sant hamaaraa raakhiaa parradaa |
English: The Saints have covered my faults.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਕੜਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: sant prasaad mohi kabahoo na karradaa |
English: By the Grace of the Saints, I am no longer tormented.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਹ ਸੰਗੁ ਦੀਆ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: santah sang deea kirapaal |
English: The Merciful Lord has blessed me with the Saints' Congregation.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sant sahaaee bhe deaal |3|
English: The Compassionate Saints have become my help and support. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: surat mat budh paragaas |
English: My consciousness, intellect and wisdom have been enlightened.

Gurbani: ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: gahir ganbheer apaar gunataas |
English: The Lord is profound, unfathomable, infinite, the treasure of virtue.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਗਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jant sagale pratipaal |
English: He cherishes all beings and creatures.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤਹ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੨੧॥
Transliteration: naanak santah dekh nihaal |4|10|21|
English: Nanak is enraptured, seeing the Saints. ||4||10||21||

[Ang 889 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੈ ਕਾਜਿ ਨ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਰਾਜੁ ਮਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: terai kaaj na grihu raaj maal |
English: Your home, power and wealth will be of no use to you.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੈ ਕਾਜਿ ਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਜੰਜਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: terai kaaj na bikhai janjaal |
English: Your corrupt worldly entanglements will be of no use to you.

Gurbani: ਇਸਟ ਮੀਤ ਜਾਣੁ ਸਭ ਛਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: eisatt meet jaan sabh chhalai |
English: Know that all your dear friends are fake.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਚਲੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har har naam sang terai chalai |1|
English: Only the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, will go along with you. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਲੇ ਮੀਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਤੇਰੀ ਲਾਜ ਰਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam gun gaae le meetaa har simarat teree laaj rahai |
English: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name, O friend; remembering the Lord in meditation, your honor shall be saved.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਜਮੁ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਕਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har simarat jam kachh na kahai |1| rahaau |
English: Remembering the Lord in meditation, the Messenger of Death will not touch you. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਰਾਰਥ ਕਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: bin har sagal niraarath kaam |
English: Without the Lord, all pursuits are useless.

Gurbani: ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਮਾਟੀ ਦਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sueinaa rupaa maattee daam |
English: Gold, silver and wealth are just dust.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਜਾਪਿ ਮਨ ਸੁਖਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa sabad jaap man sukhaa |
English: Chanting the Word of the Guru's Shabad, your mind shall be at peace.

Gurbani: ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਤੇਰੋ ਊਜਲ ਮੁਖਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: eehaa aoohaa tero aoojal mukhaa |2|
English: Here and hereafter, your face shall be radiant and bright. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਵਡੇ ਵਡੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kar kar thaake vadde vaddere |
English: Even the greatest of the great worked and worked until they were exhausted.

Gurbani: ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਨ ਕੀਏ ਕਾਜ ਮਾਇਆ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kin hee na kee kaaj maaeaa poore |
English: None of them ever accomplished the tasks of Maya.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam japai jan koe |
English: Any humble being who chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har,

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: taa kee aasaa pooran hoe |3|
English: will have all his hopes fulfilled. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: har bhagatan ko naam adhaar |
English: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the anchor and support of the Lord's devotees.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤੀ ਜੀਤਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: santee jeetaa janam apaar |
English: The Saints are victorious in this priceless human life.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: har sant kare soee paravaan |
English: Whatever the Lord's Saint does, is approved and accepted.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੨੨॥
Transliteration: naanak daas taa kai kurabaan |4|11|22|
English: Slave Nanak is a sacrifice to him. ||4||11||22||

[Ang 889 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਿੰਚਹਿ ਦਰਬੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਲੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: sincheh darab dehi dukh log |
English: You gather wealth by exploiting people.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੈ ਕਾਜਿ ਨ ਅਵਰਾ ਜੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: terai kaaj na avaraa jog |
English: It is of no use to you; it was meant for others.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਵਰਤਹਿ ਅੰਧ ॥
Transliteration: kar ahankaar hoe varateh andh |
English: You practice egotism, and act like a blind man.

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਕੀ ਜੇਵੜੀ ਤੂ ਆਗੈ ਬੰਧ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jam kee jevarree too aagai bandh |1|
English: In the world hereafter, you shall be tied to the leash of the Messenger of Death. ||1||

Gurbani: ਛਾਡਿ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ਤਾਤਿ ਮੂੜੇ ॥
Transliteration: chhaadd viddaanee taat moorre |
English: Give up your envy of others, you fool!

Gurbani: ਈਹਾ ਬਸਨਾ ਰਾਤਿ ਮੂੜੇ ॥
Transliteration: eehaa basanaa raat moorre |
English: You only live here for a night, you fool!

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਮਾਤੇ ਤੈ ਉਠਿ ਚਲਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa ke maate tai utth chalanaa |
English: You are intoxicated with Maya, but you must soon arise and depart.

Gurbani: ਰਾਚਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਤੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਪਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raach rahio too sang supanaa |1| rahaau |
English: You are totally involved in the dream. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਾਲ ਬਿਵਸਥਾ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਅੰਧ ॥
Transliteration: baal bivasathaa baarik andh |
English: In his childhood, the child is blind.

Gurbani: ਭਰਿ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ॥
Transliteration: bhar joban laagaa duragandh |
English: In the fullness of youth, he is involved in foul-smelling sins.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਤੀਅ ਬਿਵਸਥਾ ਸਿੰਚੇ ਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: triteea bivasathaa sinche maae |
English: In the third stage of life, he gathers the wealth of Maya.

Gurbani: ਬਿਰਧਿ ਭਇਆ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਲਿਓ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: biradh bheaa chhodd chalio pachhutaae |2|
English: And when he grows old, he must leave all this; he departs regretting and repenting. ||2||

Gurbani: ਚਿਰੰਕਾਲ ਪਾਈ ਦ੍ਰੁਲਭ ਦੇਹ ॥
Transliteration: chirankaal paaee drulabh deh |
English: After a very long time, one obtains this precious human body, so difficult to obtain.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਣੀ ਹੋਈ ਖੇਹ ॥
Transliteration: naam bihoonee hoee kheh |
English: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, it is reduced to dust.

Gurbani: ਪਸੂ ਪਰੇਤ ਮੁਗਧ ਤੇ ਬੁਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: pasoo paret mugadh te buree |
English: Worse than a beast, a demon or an idiot,

Gurbani: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹ ਸਿਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tiseh na boojhai jin eeh siree |3|
English: is that one who does not understand who created him. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਕਰਤਾਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: sun karataar govind gopaal |
English: Listen, O Creator Lord, Lord of the Universe, Lord of the World,

Gurbani: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਦਾ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: deen deaal sadaa kirapaal |
English: Merciful to the meek, forever compassionate

Gurbani: ਤੁਮਹਿ ਛਡਾਵਹੁ ਛੁਟਕਹਿ ਬੰਧ ॥
Transliteration: tumeh chhaddaavahu chhuttakeh bandh |
English: If You emancipate the human, then his bonds are broken.

Gurbani: ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਗ ਅੰਧ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੨੩॥
Transliteration: bakhas milaavahu naanak jag andh |4|12|23|
English: O Nanak, the people of world are blind; please, Lord, forgive them, and unite them with Yourself. ||4||12||23||

[Ang 890 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਬਨਾਈ ਕਾਛਿ ॥
Transliteration: kar sanjog banaaee kaachh |
English: Joining the elements together, the robe of the body is fashioned.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਇਆਨਾ ਰਾਚਿ ॥
Transliteration: tis sang rahio eaanaa raach |
English: The ignorant fool is engrossed in it.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰੈ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: pratipaarai nit saar samaarai |
English: He cherishes it, and constantly takes care of it.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਬਾਰ ਊਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ant kee baar aootth sidhaarai |1|
English: But at the very last moment, he must arise and depart. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਸਭੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: naam binaa sabh jhootth paraanee |
English: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, everything is false, O mortal.

Gurbani: ਗੋਵਿਦ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੂਠੁ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: govid bhajan bin avar sang raate te sabh maaeaa mootth paraanee |1| rahaau |
English: Those who do not vibrate and meditate on the Lord of the Universe, but instead are imbued with other things, - all those mortals are plundered by Maya. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਇ ਨ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਮੈਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: teerath naae na utaras mail |
English: Bathing at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, filth is not washed off.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਸਭਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਫੈਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: karam dharam sabh haumai fail |
English: Religious rituals are all just egotistical displays.

Gurbani: ਲੋਕ ਪਚਾਰੈ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: lok pachaarai gat nahee hoe |
English: By pleasing and appeasing people, no one is saved.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਣੇ ਚਲਸਹਿ ਰੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naam bihoone chalaseh roe |2|
English: Without the Naam, they shall depart weeping. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਟੂਟਸਿ ਪਟਲ ॥
Transliteration: bin har naam na ttoottas pattal |
English: Without the Lord's Name, the screen is not torn away.

Gurbani: ਸੋਧੇ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਗਲ ॥
Transliteration: sodhe saasatr simrit sagal |
English: I have studied all the Shaastras and Simritees.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਜਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: so naam japai jis aap japaae |
English: He alone chants the Naam, whom the Lord Himself inspires to chant.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਫਲਾ ਸੇ ਸੂਖਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sagal falaa se sookh samaae |3|
English: He obtains all fruits and rewards, and merges in peace. ||3||

Gurbani: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੇ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: raakhanahaare raakhahu aap |
English: O Savior Lord, please save me!

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਸੁਖਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਰੈ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
Transliteration: sagal sukhaa prabh tumarai haath |
English: All peace and comforts are in Your Hand, God.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਗਹ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: jit laaveh tith laagah suaamee |
English: Whatever you attach me to, to that I am attached, O my Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੨੪॥
Transliteration: naanak saahib antarajaamee |4|13|24|
English: O Nanak, the Lord is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||4||13||24||

[Ang 890 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo kichh karai soee sukh jaanaa |
English: Whatever He does makes me happy.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਅਸਮਝੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪਤੀਆਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: man asamajh saadhasang pateeaanaa |
English: The ignorant mind is encouraged, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਡੋਲਨ ਤੇ ਚੂਕਾ ਠਹਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: ddolan te chookaa tthaharaaeaa |
English: Now, it does not waver at all; it has become stable and steady.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿ ਮਾਹਿ ਲੇ ਸਤਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sat maeh le sat samaaeaa |1|
English: Receiving Truth, it is merged in the True Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਦੂਖੁ ਗਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: dookh geaa sabh rog geaa |
English: Pain is gone, and all illness is gone.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਨੀ ਮਹਾ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kee aagiaa man meh maanee mahaa purakh kaa sang bheaa |1| rahaau |
English: I have accepted the Will of God in my mind, associating with the Great Person, the Guru. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: sagal pavitr sarab niramalaa |
English: All is pure; all is immaculate.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਵਰਤਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਭਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo varataae soee bhalaa |
English: Whatever exists is good.

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਰਾਖੈ ਸੋਈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: jeh raakhai soee mukat thaan |
English: Wherever He keeps me, that is the place of liberation for me.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜਪਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jo japaae soee naam |2|
English: Whatever He makes me chant, is His Name. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਜਹ ਸਾਧ ਪਗ ਧਰਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: atthasatth teerath jeh saadh pag dhareh |
English: That is the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, where the Holy place their feet,

Gurbani: ਤਹ ਬੈਕੁੰਠੁ ਜਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਚਰਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: teh baikuntth jeh naam uchareh |
English: and that is heaven, where the Naam is chanted.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਅਨੰਦ ਜਬ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: sarab anand jab darasan paaeeai |
English: All bliss comes, when one obtains the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਗੁਣਾ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: raam gunaa nit nit har gaaeeai |3|
English: I sing continuously, continually, the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਿਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: aape ghatt ghatt rahiaa biaap |
English: The Lord Himself is pervading in each and every heart.

Gurbani: ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਪਰਗਟ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥
Transliteration: deaal purakh paragatt parataap |
English: The glory of the Merciful Lord is radiant and manifest.

Gurbani: ਕਪਟ ਖੁਲਾਨੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਨਾਠੇ ਦੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kapatt khulaane bhram naatthe doore |
English: The shutters are opened, and doubts have run away.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਪੂਰੇ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੨੫॥
Transliteration: naanak kau gur bhette poore |4|14|25|
English: Nanak has met with the Perfect Guru. ||4||14||25||

[Ang 890 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: kott jaap taap bisraam |
English: Millions of meditations and austerities rest in him,

Gurbani: ਰਿਧਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਸੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ॥
Transliteration: ridh budh sidh sur giaan |
English: along with wealth, wisdom, miraculous spiritual powers and angelic spiritual insight.

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਭੋਗ ਰਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: anik roop rang bhog rasai |
English: He enjoys the various shows and forms, pleasures and delicacies;

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਮਖ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: guramukh naam nimakh ridai vasai |1|
English: the Naam, the Name of the Lord, dwells within the heart of the Gurmukh. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: har ke naam kee vaddiaaee |
English: Such is the glorious greatness of the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: keemat kehan na jaaee |1| rahaau |
English: Its value cannot be described. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੂਰਬੀਰ ਧੀਰਜ ਮਤਿ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: soorabeer dheeraj mat pooraa |
English: He alone is brave, patient and perfectly wise;

Gurbani: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਧੁਨਿ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj samaadh dhun gahir ganbheeraa |
English: he is intuitively in Samaadhi, profound and unfathomable.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਕਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa mukat taa ke poore kaam |
English: He is liberated forever and all his affairs are perfectly resolved;

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jaa kai ridai vasai har naam |2|
English: the Lord's Name abides within his heart. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਸੂਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਅਰੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: sagal sookh aanand arog |
English: He is totally peaceful, blissful and healthy;

Gurbani: ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਨਿਰਜੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: samadarasee pooran nirajog |
English: he looks upon all impartially, and is perfectly detached.

Gurbani: ਆਇ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਡੋਲੈ ਕਤ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: aae na jaae ddolai kat naahee |
English: He does not come and go, and he never wavers;

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jaa kai naam basai man maahee |3|
English: the Naam abides in his mind. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: deen deaal guopaal govind |
English: God is Merciful to the meek; He is the Lord of the World, the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਉਤਰੈ ਚਿੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh japeeai utarai chind |
English: The Gurmukh meditates on Him, and his worries are gone.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak kau gur deea naam |
English: The Guru has blessed Nanak with the Naam;

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਕਾਮੁ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੨੬॥
Transliteration: santan kee ttehal sant kaa kaam |4|15|26|
English: he serves the Saints, and works for the Saints. ||4||15||26||

[Ang 891 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬੀਜ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: beej mantru har keeratan gaau |
English: Sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, and the Beej Mantra, the Seed Mantra.

Gurbani: ਆਗੈ ਮਿਲੀ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਥਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aagai milee nithaave thaau |
English: Even the homeless find a home in the world hereafter.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur poore kee charanee laag |
English: Fall at the feet of the Perfect Guru;

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਸੋਇਆ ਜਾਗੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: janam janam kaa soeaa jaag |1|
English: you have slept for so many incarnations - wake up! ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪੁ ਜਪਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: har har jaap japalaa |
English: Chant the Chant of the Lord's Name, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਾਸੈ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur kirapaa te hiradai vaasai bhaujal paar paralaa |1| rahaau |
English: By Guru's Grace, it shall be enshrined within your heart, and you shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਮਨ ਅਟਲ ॥
Transliteration: naam nidhaan dhiaae man attal |
English: Meditate on the eternal treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O mind,

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਛੂਟਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਪਟਲ ॥
Transliteration: taa chhootteh maaeaa ke pattal |
English: and then, the screen of Maya shall be torn away.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa sabad amrit ras peeo |
English: Drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Guru's Shabad,

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: taa teraa hoe niramal jeeo |2|
English: and then your soul shall be rendered immaculate and pure. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੋਧਤ ਸੋਧਤ ਸੋਧਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sodhat sodhat sodh beechaaraa |
English: Searching, searching, searching, I have realized

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਛੁਟਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: bin har bhagat nahee chhuttakaaraa |
English: that without devotional worship of the Lord, no one is saved.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨੁ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: so har bhajan saadh kai sang |
English: So vibrate, and meditate on that Lord in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy;

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਪੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: man tan raapai har kai rang |3|
English: your mind and body shall be imbued with love for the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਛੋਡਿ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਬਹੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: chhodd siaanap bahu chaturaaee |
English: Renounce all your cleverness and trickery.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: man bin har naavai jaae na kaaee |
English: O mind, without the Lord's Name, there is no place of rest.

Gurbani: ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰੀ ਗੋਵਿਦ ਗੋੁਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: deaa dhaaree govid guosaaee |
English: The Lord of the Universe, the Lord of the World, has taken pity on me.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਟੇਕ ਟਿਕਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੨੭॥
Transliteration: har har naanak ttek ttikaaee |4|16|27|
English: Nanak seeks the protection and support of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||16||27||

[Ang 891 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗ ਕੇਲ ॥
Transliteration: sant kai sang raam rang kel |
English: In the Saints' Congregation, play joyfully with the Lord,

Gurbani: ਆਗੈ ਜਮ ਸਿਉ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਲ ॥
Transliteration: aagai jam siau hoe na mel |
English: and you will not have to meet the Messenger of Death hereafter.

Gurbani: ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਕਾ ਭਇਆ ਬਿਨਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: ahanbudh kaa bheaa binaas |
English: Your egotistical intellect shall be dispelled,

Gurbani: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਹੋਈ ਸਗਲੀ ਨਾਸ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: duramat hoee sagalee naas |1|
English: and your evil-mindedness will be totally taken away. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਪੰਡਿਤ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam gun gaae panddit |
English: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name, O Pandit.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮ ਕਾਂਡ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਨ ਕਾਜੈ ਕੁਸਲ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: karam kaandd ahankaar na kaajai kusal setee ghar jaeh panddit |1| rahaau |
English: Religious rituals and egotism are of no use at all. You shall go home with happiness, O Pandit. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਜਸੁ ਨਿਧਿ ਲੀਆ ਲਾਭ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa jas nidh leea laabh |
English: I have earned the profit, the wealth of the Lord's praise.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਭਏ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਸਾਭ ॥
Transliteration: pooran bhe manorath saabh |
English: All my hopes have been fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਦੁਖੁ ਨਾਠਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: dukh naatthaa sukh ghar meh aaeaa |
English: Pain has left me, and peace has come to my home.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਸਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sant prasaad kamal bigasaaeaa |2|
English: By the Grace of the Saints, my heart-lotus blossoms forth. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: naam ratan jin paaeaa daan |
English: One who is blessed with the gift of the jewel of the Name,

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਹੋਏ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: tis jan hoe sagal nidhaan |
English: obtains all treasures.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਆਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: santokh aaeaa man pooraa paae |
English: His mind becomes content, finding the Perfect Lord.

Gurbani: ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਾਗਨ ਕਾਹੇ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: fir fir maagan kaahe jaae |3|
English: Why should he ever go begging again? ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਤ ਪਵਿਤ ॥
Transliteration: har kee kathaa sunat pavit |
English: Hearing the Lord's sermon, he becomes pure and holy.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਬਕਤ ਪਾਈ ਗਤਿ ਮਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: jihavaa bakat paaee gat mat |
English: Chanting it with his tongue, he finds the way to salvation.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: so paravaan jis ridai vasaaee |
English: He alone is approved, who enshrines the Lord within his heart.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਊਤਮ ਭਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੭॥੨੮॥
Transliteration: naanak te jan aootam bhaaee |4|17|28|
English: Nanak: such a humble being is exalted, O Siblings of Destiny. ||4||17||28||

[Ang 891 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਪਕਰੀ ਨ ਆਈ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
Transliteration: gahu kar pakaree na aaee haath |
English: No matter how hard you try to grab it, it does not come into your hands.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਚਾਲੀ ਨਹੀ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
Transliteration: preet karee chaalee nahee saath |
English: No matter how much you may love it, it does not go along with you.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਉ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਦਈ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak jau tiaag dee |
English: Says Nanak, when you abandon it,

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਓਹ ਚਰਣੀ ਆਇ ਪਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tab oeh charanee aae pee |1|
English: then it comes and falls at your feet. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: sun santahu niramal beechaar |
English: Listen, O Saints: this is the pure philosophy.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਈ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਤ ਉਧਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam bin gat nahee kaaee gur pooraa bhettat udhaar |1| rahaau |
English: Without the Lord's Name, there is no salvation. Meeting with the Perfect Guru, one is saved. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਉਸ ਕਉ ਕੋਈ ਦੇਵੈ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: jab us kau koee devai maan |
English: When someone tries to appease her,

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਆਪਸ ਊਪਰਿ ਰਖੈ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: tab aapas aoopar rakhai gumaan |
English: then she takes pride in herself.

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਉਸ ਕਉ ਕੋਈ ਮਨਿ ਪਰਹਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: jab us kau koee man paraharai |
English: But when someone puts her out of his thoughts,

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਓਹ ਸੇਵਕਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tab oeh sevak sevaa karai |2|
English: then she serves him like a slave. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮੁਖਿ ਬੇਰਾਵੈ ਅੰਤਿ ਠਗਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: mukh beraavai ant tthagaavai |
English: She seems to please, but in the end, she deceives.

Gurbani: ਇਕਤੁ ਠਉਰ ਓਹ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: eikat tthaur oeh kahee na samaavai |
English: She does not remain in any one place.

Gurbani: ਉਨਿ ਮੋਹੇ ਬਹੁਤੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ॥
Transliteration: aun mohe bahute brahamandd |
English: She has bewitched a great many worlds.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਜਨੀ ਕੀਨੀ ਖੰਡ ਖੰਡ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: raam janee keenee khandd khandd |3|
English: The Lord's humble servants cut her apart into pieces. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਮਾਗੈ ਸੋ ਭੂਖਾ ਰਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: jo maagai so bhookhaa rahai |
English: Whoever begs from her remains hungry.

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਚੈ ਸੁ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਲਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: eis sang raachai su kachhoo na lahai |
English: Whoever is infatuated with her obtains nothing.

Gurbani: ਇਸਹਿ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: eiseh tiaag satasangat karai |
English: But one who renounces her, and joins the Society of the Saints,

Gurbani: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਓਹੁ ਤਰੈ ॥੪॥੧੮॥੨੯॥
Transliteration: vaddabhaagee naanak ohu tarai |4|18|29|
English: by great good fortune, O Nanak, is saved. ||4||18||29||

[Ang 892 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਰਬ ਮਹਿ ਪੇਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: aatam raam sarab meh pekh |
English: See the Lord, the Universal Soul, in all.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: pooran poor rahiaa prabh ek |
English: The One God is perfect, and all-pervading.

Gurbani: ਰਤਨੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਰਿਦੇ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: ratan amol ride meh jaan |
English: Know that the priceless jewel is within your own heart.

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੀ ਵਸਤੁ ਤੂ ਆਪਿ ਪਛਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: apanee vasat too aap pachhaan |1|
English: Realize that your essence is within your own self. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: pee amrit santan parasaad |
English: Drink in the Ambrosial Nectar, by the Grace of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਵਡੇ ਭਾਗ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੁਆਦੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: vadde bhaag hoveh tau paaeeai bin jihavaa kiaa jaanai suaad |1| rahaau |
English: One who is blessed with high destiny, obtains it. Without a tongue, how can one know the taste? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਠ ਦਸ ਬੇਦ ਸੁਨੇ ਕਹ ਡੋਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: atth das bed sune keh ddoraa |
English: How can a deaf person listen to the eighteen Puraanas and the Vedas?

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਨ ਦਿਸੈ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kott pragaas na disai andheraa |
English: The blind man cannot see even a million lights.

Gurbani: ਪਸੂ ਪਰੀਤਿ ਘਾਸ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਚੈ ॥
Transliteration: pasoo pareet ghaas sang rachai |
English: The beast loves grass, and remains attached to it.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਹੀ ਬੁਝਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਬੁਝੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jis nahee bujhaavai so kit bidh bujhai |2|
English: One who has not been taught - how can he understand? ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਾਨਣਹਾਰੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: jaananahaar rahiaa prabh jaan |
English: God, the Knower, knows all.

Gurbani: ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਭਗਤਨ ਸੰਗਾਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: ot pot bhagatan sangaan |
English: He is with His devotees, through and through.

Gurbani: ਬਿਗਸਿ ਬਿਗਸਿ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਗਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: bigas bigas apunaa prabh gaaveh |
English: Those who sing God's Praises with joy and delight,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਜਮ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ॥੩॥੧੯॥੩੦॥
Transliteration: naanak tin jam nerr na aaveh |3|19|30|
English: O Nanak - the Messenger of Death does not even approach them. ||3||19||30||

[Ang 892 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦੀਨੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੀਓ ਪਵਿਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: deeno naam keeo pavit |
English: Blessing me with His Name, He has purified and sanctified me.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਇਹ ਬਿਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: har dhan raas niraas ih bit |
English: The Lord's wealth is my capital. False hope has left me; this is my wealth.

Gurbani: ਕਾਟੀ ਬੰਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: kaattee bandh har sevaa laae |
English: Breaking my bonds, the Lord has linked me to His service.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har har bhagat raam gun gaae |1|
English: I am a devotee of the Lord, Har, Har; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: baaje anahad baajaa |
English: The unstruck sound current vibrates and resounds.

Gurbani: ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਅਪਨੈ ਗੁਰਦੇਵਿ ਨਿਵਾਜਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: rasak rasak gun gaaveh har jan apanai guradev nivaajaa |1| rahaau |
English: The Lord's humble servants sing His Glorious Praises with love and delight; they are honored by the Divine Guru. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਇ ਬਨਿਓ ਪੂਰਬਲਾ ਭਾਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: aae banio poorabalaa bhaag |
English: My pre-ordained destiny has been activated;

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਸੋਇਆ ਜਾਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: janam janam kaa soeaa jaag |
English: I have awakened from the sleep of countless incarnations.

Gurbani: ਗਈ ਗਿਲਾਨਿ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: gee gilaan saadh kai sang |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, my aversion is gone.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਤੋ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: man tan raato har kai rang |2|
English: My mind and body are imbued with love for the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਰਾਖੇ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
Transliteration: raakhe raakhanahaar deaal |
English: The Merciful Savior Lord has saved me.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਘਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: naa kichh sevaa naa kichh ghaal |
English: I have no service or work to my credit.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਦਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh keenee deaa |
English: In His Mercy, God has taken pity on me;

Gurbani: ਬੂਡਤ ਦੁਖ ਮਹਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਲਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: booddat dukh meh kaadt leaa |3|
English: He lifted me up and pulled me out, when I was suffering in pain. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਚਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sun sun upajio man meh chaau |
English: Listening, listening to His Praises, joy has welled up within my mind.

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar har ke gun gaau |
English: Twenty-four hours a day, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਤ ਗਾਵਤ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: gaavat gaavat param gat paaee |
English: Singing, singing His Praises, I have obtained the supreme status.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੪॥੨੦॥੩੧॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad naanak liv laaee |4|20|31|
English: By Guru's Grace, Nanak is lovingly focused on the Lord. ||4||20||31||

[Ang 892 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਉਡੀ ਬਦਲੈ ਤਿਆਗੈ ਰਤਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: kauddee badalai tiaagai ratan |
English: In exchange for a shell, he gives up a jewel.

Gurbani: ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਇ ਤਾਹੂ ਕਾ ਜਤਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: chhodd jaae taahoo kaa jatan |
English: He tries to get what he must give up.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸੰਚੈ ਜੋ ਹੋਛੀ ਬਾਤ ॥
Transliteration: so sanchai jo hochhee baat |
English: He collects those things which are worthless.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਟੇਢਉ ਜਾਤ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohiaa ttedtau jaat |1|
English: Enticed by Maya, he takes the crooked path. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਭਾਗੇ ਤੈ ਲਾਜ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: abhaage tai laaj naahee |
English: You unfortunate man - have you no shame?

Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sukh saagar pooran paramesar har na chetio man maahee |1| rahaau |
English: You do not remember in your mind the ocean of peace, the perfect Transcendent Lord God. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਕਉਰਾ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮੀਠੀ ॥
Transliteration: amrit kauraa bikhiaa meetthee |
English: Nectar seems bitter to you, and poison is sweet.

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤ ਕੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਨੈਨਹੁ ਡੀਠੀ ॥
Transliteration: saakat kee bidh nainahu ddeetthee |
English: Such is your condition, you faithless cynic, which I have seen with my own eyes.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜਿ ਕਪਟਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਰੀਝਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: koorr kapatt ahankaar reejhaanaa |
English: You are fond of falsehood, fraud and egotism.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਤ ਜਨੁ ਬਿਛੂਅ ਡਸਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naam sunat jan bichhooa ddasaanaa |2|
English: If you hear the Naam, the Name of the Lord, you feel like you have been stung by a scorpion. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਝੂਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa kaaran sad hee jhoorai |
English: You continually yearn for Maya,

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: man mukh kabeh na usatat karai |
English: and you never chant the Lord's Praises with your mouth.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: nirbhau nirankaar daataar |
English: The Lord is fearless and formless; He is the Great Giver.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਕਰੈ ਗਵਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tis siau preet na karai gavaar |3|
English: But you do not love Him, you fool! ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਸਾਹਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: sabh saahaa sir saachaa saahu |
English: God, the True King, is above the heads of all kings.

Gurbani: ਵੇਮੁਹਤਾਜੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: vemuhataaj pooraa paatisaahu |
English: He is the independent, perfect Lord King.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਲਪਟਿਓ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਗਿਰਹ ॥
Transliteration: moh magan lapattio bhram girah |
English: People are intoxicated by emotional attachment, entangled in doubt and family life.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਰੀਐ ਤੇਰੀ ਮਿਹਰ ॥੪॥੨੧॥੩੨॥
Transliteration: naanak tareeai teree mihar |4|21|32|
English: Nanak: they are saved only by Your Mercy, Lord. ||4||21||32||

[Ang 893 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਜਪਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: rain dinas jpau har naau |
English: Night and day, I chant the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਆਗੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵਉ ਥਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aagai daragah paavau thaau |
English: Hereafter, I shall obtain a seat in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa anand na hovee sog |
English: I am in bliss forever; I have no sorrow.

Gurbani: ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kabahoo na biaapai haumai rog |1|
English: The disease of ego never afflicts me. ||1||

Gurbani: ਖੋਜਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: khojahu santahu har braham giaanee |
English: O Saints of the Lord, seek out those who know God.

Gurbani: ਬਿਸਮਨ ਬਿਸਮ ਭਏ ਬਿਸਮਾਦਾ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bisaman bisam bhe bisamaadaa param gat paaveh har simar paraanee |1| rahaau |
English: You shall be wonderstruck with wonder at the wonderful Lord; meditate in remembrance on the Lord, O mortal, and obtain the supreme status. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗਨਿ ਮਿਨਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਸਗਲ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: gan min dekhahu sagal beechaar |
English: Calculating, measuring, and thinking in every way,

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੋ ਸਕੈ ਨ ਤਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: naam binaa ko sakai na taar |
English: see that without the Naam, no one can be carried across.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਉਪਾਵ ਨ ਚਾਲਹਿ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: sagal upaav na chaaleh sang |
English: Of all your efforts, none will go along with you.

Gurbani: ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bhavajal tareeai prabh kai rang |2|
English: You can cross over the terrifying world-ocean only through the love of God. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦੇਹੀ ਧੋਇ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਮੈਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: dehee dhoe na utarai mail |
English: By merely washing the body, one's filth is not removed.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਫੈਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: haumai biaapai dubidhaa fail |
English: Afflicted by egotism, duality only increases.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: har har aaukhadh jo jan khaae |
English: That humble being who takes the medicine of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਸਗਲ ਮਿਟਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: taa kaa rog sagal mitt jaae |3|
English: - all his diseases are eradicated. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa paarabraham deaal |
English: Take pity on me, O merciful, Supreme Lord God;

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਤੇ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਬਿਸਰੁ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: man te kabahu na bisar guopaal |
English: let me never forget the Lord of the World from my mind.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਹੋਵਾ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: tere daas kee hovaa dhoor |
English: Let me be the dust of the feet of Your slaves;

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਧਾ ਪੂਰਿ ॥੪॥੨੨॥੩੩॥
Transliteration: naanak kee prabh saradhaa poor |4|22|33|
English: O God, please fulfill Nanak's hope. ||4||22||33||

[Ang 893 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: teree saran poore guradev |
English: You are my Protection, O perfect Divine Guru.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: tudh bin doojaa naahee koe |
English: There is no other than You.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: too samarath pooran paarabraham |
English: You are all-powerful, O perfect Supreme Lord God.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਧਿਆਏ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰਮੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: so dhiaae pooraa jis karam |1|
English: He alone meditates on You, whose karma is perfect. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤਰਣ ਤਾਰਣ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: taran taaran prabh tero naau |
English: You Name, God, is the boat to carry us across.

Gurbani: ਏਕਾ ਸਰਣਿ ਗਹੀ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਠਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ekaa saran gahee man merai tudh bin doojaa naahee tthaau |1| rahaau |
English: My mind has grasped Your protection alone. Other than You, I have no place of rest at all. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jap jap jeevaa teraa naau |
English: Chanting, meditating on Your Name, I live,

Gurbani: ਆਗੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵਉ ਠਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aagai daragah paavau tthaau |
English: and hereafter, I will obtain a seat in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਦੂਖੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: dookh andheraa man te jaae |
English: Pain and darkness are gone from my mind;

Gurbani: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਰਾਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: duramat binasai raachai har naae |2|
English: my evil-mindedness is dispelled, and I am absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||2||

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal siau laagee preet |
English: I have enshrined love for the Lord's lotus feet.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: gur poore kee niramal reet |
English: The lifestyle of the Perfect Guru is immaculate and pure.

Gurbani: ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: bhau bhaagaa nirbhau man basai |
English: My fear has run away, and the fearless Lord dwells within my mind.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਿਤ ਜਪੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: amrit naam rasanaa nit japai |3|
English: My tongue continually chants the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਾਟੇ ਫਾਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: kott janam ke kaatte faahe |
English: The nooses of millions of incarnations are cut away.

Gurbani: ਪਾਇਆ ਲਾਭੁ ਸਚਾ ਧਨੁ ਲਾਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: paaeaa laabh sachaa dhan laahe |
English: I have obtained the profit of the true wealth.

Gurbani: ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਅਖੁਟ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: tott na aavai akhutt bhanddaar |
English: This treasure is inexhaustible; it will never run out.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੩੪॥
Transliteration: naanak bhagat soheh har duaar |4|23|34|
English: O Nanak, the devotees look beautiful in the Court of the Lord. ||4||23||34||

[Ang 893 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਨਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: ratan javehar naam |
English: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is a jewel, a ruby.

Gurbani: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਗਿਆਨ ॥
Transliteration: sat santokh giaan |
English: It brings Truth, contentment and spiritual wisdom.

Gurbani: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਦਇਆ ਕਾ ਪੋਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: sookh sehaj deaa kaa potaa |
English: The Lord entrusts the treasures of peace,

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਹਵਾਲੈ ਹੋਤਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har bhagataa havaalai hotaa |1|
English: Intuition and kindness to His devotees. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: mere raam ko bhanddaar |
English: This is the treasure of my Lord.

Gurbani: ਖਾਤ ਖਰਚਿ ਕਛੁ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: khaat kharach kachh tott na aavai ant nahee har paaraavaar |1| rahaau |
English: Consuming and expending it, it is never used up. The Lord has no end or limitation. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕ ਹੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: keeratan niramolak heeraa |
English: The Kirtan of the Lord's Praise is a priceless diamond.

Gurbani: ਆਨੰਦ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aanand gunee gaheeraa |
English: It is the ocean of bliss and virtue.

Gurbani: ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਣੀ ਪੂੰਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: anahad baanee poonjee |
English: In the Word of the Guru's Bani is the wealth of the unstruck sound current.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਨ ਹਥਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਕੂੰਜੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: santan hath raakhee koonjee |2|
English: The Saints hold the key to it in their hands. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਗੁਫਾ ਤਹ ਆਸਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: sun samaadh gufaa teh aasan |
English: They sit there, in the cave of deep Samaadhi;

Gurbani: ਕੇਵਲ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਤਹ ਬਾਸਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: keval braham pooran teh baasan |
English: the unique, perfect Lord God dwells there.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਗੋਸਟਿ ਕਰਤ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat sang prabh gosatt karat |
English: God holds conversations with His devotees.

Gurbani: ਤਹ ਹਰਖ ਨ ਸੋਗ ਨ ਜਨਮ ਨ ਮਰਤ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: teh harakh na sog na janam na marat |3|
English: There is no pleasure or pain, no birth or death there. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਦਿਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa jis aap divaaeaa |
English: One whom the Lord Himself blesses with His Mercy,

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang tin har dhan paaeaa |
English: obtains the Lord's wealth in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: deaal purakh naanak aradaas |
English: Nanak prays to the merciful Primal Lord;

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਵਰਤਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੨੪॥੩੫॥
Transliteration: har meree varatan har meree raas |4|24|35|
English: the Lord is my merchandise, and the Lord is my capital. ||4||24||35||

[Ang 894 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਹਿਮਾ ਨ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਬੇਦ ॥
Transliteration: mahimaa na jaaneh bed |
English: The Vedas do not know His greatness.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਭੇਦ ॥
Transliteration: brahame nahee jaaneh bhed |
English: Brahma does not know His mystery.

Gurbani: ਅਵਤਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਅੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: avataar na jaaneh ant |
English: Incarnated beings do not know His limit.

Gurbani: ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: paramesar paarabraham beant |1|
English: The Transcendent Lord, the Supreme Lord God, is infinite. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੀ ਗਤਿ ਆਪਿ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: apanee gat aap jaanai |
English: Only He Himself knows His own state.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਅਵਰ ਵਖਾਨੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sun sun avar vakhaanai |1| rahaau |
English: Others speak of Him only by hearsay. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੰਕਰਾ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਭੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: sankaraa nahee jaaneh bhev |
English: Shiva does not know His mystery.

Gurbani: ਖੋਜਤ ਹਾਰੇ ਦੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: khojat haare dev |
English: The gods gave grown weary of searching for Him.

Gurbani: ਦੇਵੀਆ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੈ ਮਰਮ ॥
Transliteration: deveea nahee jaanai maram |
English: The goddesses do not know His mystery.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਅਲਖ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sabh aoopar alakh paarabraham |2|
English: Above all is the unseen, Supreme Lord God. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਕੇਲ ॥
Transliteration: apanai rang karataa kel |
English: The Creator Lord plays His own plays.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਬਿਛੋਰੈ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲ ॥
Transliteration: aap bichhorai aape mel |
English: He Himself separates, and He Himself unites.

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਭਰਮੇ ਇਕਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: eik bharame ik bhagatee laae |
English: Some wander around, while others are linked to His devotional worship.

Gurbani: ਅਪਣਾ ਕੀਆ ਆਪਿ ਜਣਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: apanaa keea aap janaae |3|
English: By His actions, He makes Himself known. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਸਾਖੀ ॥
Transliteration: santan kee sun saachee saakhee |
English: Listen to the true story of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਜੋ ਪੇਖਹਿ ਆਖੀ ॥
Transliteration: so boleh jo pekheh aakhee |
English: They speak only of what they see with their eyes.

Gurbani: ਨਹੀ ਲੇਪੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੁੰਨਿ ਨ ਪਾਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: nahee lep tis pun na paap |
English: He is not involved with virtue or vice.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ॥੪॥੨੫॥੩੬॥
Transliteration: naanak kaa prabh aape aap |4|25|36|
English: Nanak's God is Himself all-in-all. ||4||25||36||

[Ang 894 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਿਛਹੂ ਕਾਜੁ ਨ ਕੀਓ ਜਾਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: kichhahoo kaaj na keeo jaan |
English: I have not tried to do anything through knowledge.

Gurbani: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਗਿਆਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: surat mat naahee kichh giaan |
English: I have no knowledge, intelligence or spiritual wisdom.

Gurbani: ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਸੀਲ ਨਹੀ ਧਰਮ ॥
Transliteration: jaap taap seel nahee dharam |
English: I have not practiced chanting, deep meditation, humility or righteousness.

Gurbani: ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਨਉ ਕੈਸਾ ਕਰਮ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kichhoo na jaanau kaisaa karam |1|
English: I know nothing of such good karma. ||1||

Gurbani: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: tthaakur preetam prabh mere |
English: O my Beloved God, my Lord and Master,

Gurbani: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਭੂਲਹ ਚੂਕਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tujh bin doojaa avar na koee bhoolah chookah prabh tere |1| rahaau |
English: there is none other than You. Even though I wander and make mistakes, I am still Yours, God. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਰਿਧਿ ਨ ਬੁਧਿ ਨ ਸਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: ridh na budh na sidh pragaas |
English: I have no wealth, no intelligence, no miraculous spiritual powers; I am not enlightened.

Gurbani: ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਕੇ ਗਾਵ ਮਹਿ ਬਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: bikhai biaadh ke gaav meh baas |
English: I dwell in the village of corruption and sickness.

Gurbani: ਕਰਣਹਾਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕ ॥
Transliteration: karanahaar mere prabh ek |
English: O my One Creator Lord God,

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਟੇਕ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naam tere kee man meh ttek |2|
English: Your Name is the support of my mind. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਜੀਵਉ ਮਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: sun sun jeevau man ihu bisraam |
English: Hearing, hearing Your Name, I live; this is my mind's consolation.

Gurbani: ਪਾਪ ਖੰਡਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: paap khanddan prabh tero naam |
English: Your Name, God, is the Destroyer of sins.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਅਗਨਤੁ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: too aganat jeea kaa daataa |
English: You, O Limitless Lord, are the Giver of the soul.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਜਣਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਤੂ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jiseh janaaveh tin too jaataa |3|
English: He alone knows You, unto whom You reveal Yourself. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਉਪਾਇਓ ਤਿਸੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਸ ॥
Transliteration: jo upaaeo tis teree aas |
English: Whoever has been created, rests his hopes in You.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: sagal araadheh prabh gunataas |
English: All worship and adore You, God, O treasure of excellence.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੈ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak daas terai kurabaan |
English: Slave Nanak is a sacrifice to You.

Gurbani: ਬੇਅੰਤ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੨੬॥੩੭॥
Transliteration: beant saahib meraa miharavaan |4|26|37|
English: My merciful Lord and Master is infinite. ||4||26||37||

[Ang 894 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
Transliteration: raakhanahaar deaal |
English: The Savior Lord is merciful.

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਭਵ ਖੰਡੇ ਨਿਮਖ ਖਿਆਲ ॥
Transliteration: kott bhav khandde nimakh khiaal |
English: Millions of incarnations are eradicated in an instant, contemplating the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ ਜੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: sagal araadheh jant |
English: All beings worship and adore Him.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਮੰਤ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mileeai prabh gur mil mant |1|
English: Receiving the Guru's Mantra, one meets God. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੀਅਨ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ॥
Transliteration: jeean ko daataa meraa prabh |
English: My God is the Giver of souls.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: pooran paramesur suaamee ghatt ghatt raataa meraa prabh |1| rahaau |
English: The Perfect Transcendent Lord Master, my God, imbues each and every heart. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਹੀ ਮਨ ਓਟ ॥
Transliteration: taa kee gahee man ott |
English: My mind has grasped His Support.

Gurbani: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ਛੋਟ ॥
Transliteration: bandhan te hoee chhott |
English: My bonds have been shattered.

Gurbani: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਪਿ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: hiradai jap paramaanand |
English: Within my heart, I meditate on the Lord, the embodiment of supreme bliss.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਭਏ ਅਨੰਦ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: man maeh bhe anand |2|
English: My mind is filled with ecstasy. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤਾਰਣ ਤਰਣ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣ ॥
Transliteration: taaran taran har saran |
English: The Lord's Sanctuary is the boat to carry us across.

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਨ ਰੂਪ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ॥
Transliteration: jeevan roop har charan |
English: The Lord's Feet are the embodiment of life itself.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: santan ke praan adhaar |
English: They are the Support of the breath of life of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਊਚੇ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aooche te aooch apaar |3|
English: God is infinite, the highest of the high. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੁ ਮਤਿ ਸਾਰੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: su mat saar jit har simareejai |
English: That mind is excellent and sublime, which meditates in remembrance on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa jis aape deejai |
English: In His Mercy, the Lord Himself bestows it.

Gurbani: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sookh sehaj aanand har naau |
English: Peace, intuitive poise and bliss are found in the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥੨੭॥੩੮॥
Transliteration: naanak japiaa gur mil naau |4|27|38|
English: Meeting with the Guru, Nanak chants the Name. ||4||27||38||

[Ang 895 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਛਾਡਿ ॥
Transliteration: sagal siaanap chhaadd |
English: Abandon all your clever tricks.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਾਜਿ ॥
Transliteration: kar sevaa sevak saaj |
English: Become His servant, and serve Him.

Gurbani: ਅਪਨਾ ਆਪੁ ਸਗਲ ਮਿਟਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: apanaa aap sagal mittaae |
English: Totally erase your self-conceit.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦੇ ਸੇਈ ਫਲ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: man chinde seee fal paae |1|
English: You shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹੋਹੁ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ॥
Transliteration: hohu saavadhaan apune gur siau |
English: Be awake and aware with your Guru.

Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa manasaa pooran hovai paaveh sagal nidhaan gur siau |1| rahaau |
English: Your hopes and desires shall be fulfilled, and you shall obtain all treasures from the Guru. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦੂਜਾ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: doojaa nahee jaanai koe |
English: Let no one think that God and Guru are separate.

Gurbani: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: satagur niranjan soe |
English: The True Guru is the Immaculate Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਾਨੁਖ ਕਾ ਕਰਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: maanukh kaa kar roop na jaan |
English: Do not believe that He is a mere human being;

Gurbani: ਮਿਲੀ ਨਿਮਾਨੇ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: milee nimaane maan |2|
English: He gives honor to the dishonored. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਟੇਕ ਟਿਕਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur kee har ttek ttikaae |
English: Hold tight to the Support of the Guru, the Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰ ਆਸਾ ਸਭ ਲਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: avar aasaa sabh laeh |
English: Give up all other hopes.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਾਗੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam maag nidhaan |
English: Ask for the treasure of the Name of the Lord,

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: taa daragah paaveh maan |3|
English: and then you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਜਪਿ ਮੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa bachan jap mant |
English: Chant the Mantra of the Guru's Word.

Gurbani: ਏਹਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਾਰ ਤਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: ehaa bhagat saar tat |
English: This is the essence of true devotional worship.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
Transliteration: satigur bhe deaal |
English: When the True Guru becomes merciful,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੪॥੨੮॥੩੯॥
Transliteration: naanak daas nihaal |4|28|39|
English: slave Nanak is enraptured. ||4||28||39||

[Ang 895 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: hovai soee bhal maan |
English: Whatever happens, accept that as good.

Gurbani: ਆਪਨਾ ਤਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: aapanaa taj abhimaan |
English: Leave your egotistical pride behind.

Gurbani: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: din rain sadaa gun gaau |
English: Day and night, continually sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਏਹੀ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: pooran ehee suaau |1|
English: This is the perfect purpose of human life. ||1||

Gurbani: ਆਨੰਦ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: aanand kar sant har jap |
English: Meditate on the Lord, O Saints, and be in bliss.

Gurbani: ਛਾਡਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਬਹੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਜਪਿ ਮੰਤੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: chhaadd siaanap bahu chaturaaee gur kaa jap mant niramal |1| rahaau |
English: Renounce your cleverness and all your tricks. Chant the Immaculate Chant of the Guru's Mantra. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਆਸ ਭੀਤਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: ek kee kar aas bheetar |
English: Place the hopes of your mind in the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: niramal jap naam har har |
English: Chant the Immaculate Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: gur ke charan namasakaar |
English: Bow down to the Guru's Feet,

Gurbani: ਭਵਜਲੁ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bhavajal utareh paar |2|
English: and cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰ ਦਾਤਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: devanahaar daataar |
English: The Lord God is the Great Giver.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: ant na paaraavaar |
English: He has no end or limitation.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai ghar sarab nidhaan |
English: All treasures are in His home.

Gurbani: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰ ਨਿਦਾਨ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: raakhanahaar nidaan |3|
English: He will be your Saving Grace in the end. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਇਆ ਏਹੁ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: naanak paaeaa ehu nidhaan |
English: Nanak has obtained this treasure,

Gurbani: ਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: hare har niramal naam |
English: the immaculate Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜਪੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jo japai tis kee gat hoe |
English: Whoever chants it, is emancipated.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੨੯॥੪੦॥
Transliteration: naanak karam paraapat hoe |4|29|40|
English: It is obtained only by His Grace. ||4||29||40||

[Ang 895 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦੁਲਭ ਦੇਹ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: dulabh deh savaar |
English: Make this invaluable human life fruitful.

Gurbani: ਜਾਹਿ ਨ ਦਰਗਹ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jaeh na daragah haar |
English: You shall not be destroyed when you go to the Lord's Court.

Gurbani: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਹੋਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: halat palat tudh hoe vaddiaaee |
English: In this world and the next, you shall obtain honor and glory.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਬੇਲਾ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ant kee belaa le chhaddaaee |1|
English: At the very last moment, He will save you. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raam ke gun gaau |
English: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਹੋਹਿ ਦੋਵੈ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਅਚਰਜ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਧਿਆਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: halat palat hohi dovai suhele acharaj purakh dhiaau |1| rahaau |
English: In both this world and the next, you shall be embellished with beauty, meditating on the wondrous Primal Lord God. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: aootthat baitthat har jaap |
English: While standing up and sitting down, meditate on the Lord,

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਸੈ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: binasai sagal santaap |
English: and all your troubles shall depart.

Gurbani: ਬੈਰੀ ਸਭਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਮੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: bairee sabh hoveh meet |
English: All your enemies will become friends.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਚੀਤ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: niramal teraa hovai cheet |2|
English: Your consciousness shall be immaculate and pure. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਤਮ ਇਹੁ ਕਰਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: sabh te aootam ihu karam |
English: This is the most exalted deed.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਧਰਮ ਮਹਿ ਸ੍ਰੇਸਟ ਧਰਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: sagal dharam meh sresatt dharam |
English: Of all faiths, this is the most sublime and excellent faith.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੋਇ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: har simaran teraa hoe udhaar |
English: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, you shall be saved.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਉਤਰੈ ਭਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: janam janam kaa utarai bhaar |3|
English: You shall be rid of the burden of countless incarnations. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਤੇਰੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਆਸ ॥
Transliteration: pooran teree hovai aas |
English: Your hopes shall be fulfilled,

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਕੀ ਕਟੀਐ ਤੇਰੀ ਫਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: jam kee katteeai teree faas |
English: and the noose of the Messenger of Death will be cut away.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸੁਨੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa upades suneejai |
English: So listen to the Guru's Teachings.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮੀਜੈ ॥੪॥੩੦॥੪੧॥
Transliteration: naanak sukh sehaj sameejai |4|30|41|
English: O Nanak, you shall be absorbed in celestial peace. ||4||30||41||

[Ang 896 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: jis kee tis kee kar maan |
English: Honor the One, to whom everything belongs.

Gurbani: ਆਪਨ ਲਾਹਿ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: aapan laeh gumaan |
English: Leave your egotistical pride behind.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਤੂ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jis kaa too tis kaa sabh koe |
English: You belong to Him; everyone belongs to Him.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tiseh araadh sadaa sukh hoe |1|
English: Worship and adore Him, and you shall be at peace forever. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਹਿ ਬਿਗਾਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: kaahe bhram bhrameh bigaane |
English: Why do you wander in doubt, you fool?

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪਛੁਤਾਨੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: naam binaa kichh kaam na aavai meraa meraa kar bahut pachhutaane |1| rahaau |
English: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, nothing is of any use at all. Crying out, 'Mine, mine', a great many have departed, regretfully repenting. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਰੈ ਸੋਈ ਮਾਨਿ ਲੇਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: jo jo karai soee maan lehu |
English: Whatever the Lord has done, accept that as good.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਮਾਨੇ ਰਲਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਖੇਹ ॥
Transliteration: bin maane ral hoveh kheh |
English: Without accepting, you shall mingle with dust.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: tis kaa bhaanaa laagai meetthaa |
English: His Will seems sweet to me.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਮਨਿ ਵੂਠਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad virale man vootthaa |2|
English: By Guru's Grace, He comes to dwell in the mind. ||2||

Gurbani: ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: veparavaahu agochar aap |
English: He Himself is carefree and independent, imperceptible.

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਮਨ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar man taa kau jaap |
English: Twenty-four hours a day, O mind, meditate on Him.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਏ ਬਿਨਸਹਿ ਦੁਖਾ ॥
Transliteration: jis chit aae binaseh dukhaa |
English: When He comes into the consciousness, pain is dispelled.

Gurbani: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਊਜਲ ਮੁਖਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: halat palat teraa aoojal mukhaa |3|
English: Here and hereafter, your face shall be radiant and bright. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਉਨ ਕਉਨ ਉਧਰੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kaun kaun udhare gun gaae |
English: Who, and how many have been saved, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord?

Gurbani: ਗਨਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: ganan na jaaee keem na paae |
English: They cannot be counted or evaluated.

Gurbani: ਬੂਡਤ ਲੋਹ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਤਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: booddat loh saadhasang tarai |
English: Even the sinking iron is saved, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਕਰੈ ॥੪॥੩੧॥੪੨॥
Transliteration: naanak jiseh paraapat karai |4|31|42|
English: O Nanak, as His Grace is received. ||4||31||42||

[Ang 896 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਜਾਪਿ ਭਗਵੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: man maeh jaap bhagavant |
English: In your mind, meditate on the Lord God.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਇਹੁ ਦੀਨੋ ਮੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur poorai ihu deeno mant |
English: This is the Teaching given by the Perfect Guru.

Gurbani: ਮਿਟੇ ਸਗਲ ਭੈ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: mitte sagal bhai traas |
English: All fears and terrors are taken away,

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਆਸ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: pooran hoee aas |1|
English: and your hopes shall be fulfilled. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਫਲ ਸੇਵਾ ਗੁਰਦੇਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: safal sevaa guradevaa |
English: Service to the Divine Guru is fruitful and rewarding.

Gurbani: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਚੁ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: keemat kichh kehan na jaaee saache sach alakh abhevaa |1| rahaau |
English: His value cannot be described; the True Lord is unseen and mysterious. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: karan karaavan aap |
English: He Himself is the Doer, the Cause of causes.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਮਨ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: tis kau sadaa man jaap |
English: Meditate on Him forever, O my mind,

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਿ ਨੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: tis kee sevaa kar neet |
English: And continually serve Him.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮੀਤ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sach sehaj sukh paaveh meet |2|
English: You shall be blessed with truth, intuition and peace, O my friend. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: saahib meraa at bhaaraa |
English: My Lord and Master is so very great.

Gurbani: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: khin meh thaap uthaapanahaaraa |
English: In an instant, He establishes and disestablishes.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: tis bin avar na koee |
English: There is no other than Him.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਕਾ ਰਾਖਾ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jan kaa raakhaa soee |3|
English: He is the Saving Grace of His humble servant. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਸੁਣੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa aradaas suneejai |
English: Please take pity on me, and hear my prayer,

Gurbani: ਅਪਣੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: apane sevak kau darasan deejai |
English: that Your servant may behold the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਪੀ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak jaapee jap jaap |
English: Nanak chants the Chant of the Lord,

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥੪॥੩੨॥੪੩॥
Transliteration: sabh te aooch jaa kaa parataap |4|32|43|
English: whose glory and radiance are the highest of all. ||4||32||43||

[Ang 896 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ਲੋਕ ॥
Transliteration: birathaa bharavaasaa lok |
English: Reliance on mortal man is useless.

Gurbani: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ॥
Transliteration: tthaakur prabh teree ttek |
English: O God, my Lord and Master, You are my only Support.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰ ਛੂਟੀ ਸਭ ਆਸ ॥
Transliteration: avar chhoottee sabh aas |
English: I have discarded all other hopes.

Gurbani: ਅਚਿੰਤ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: achint tthaakur bhette gunataas |1|
English: I have met with my carefree Lord and Master, the treasure of virtue. ||1||

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: eko naam dhiaae man mere |
English: Meditate on the Name of the Lord alone, O my mind.

Gurbani: ਕਾਰਜੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kaaraj teraa hovai pooraa har har har gun gaae man mere |1| rahaau |
English: Your affairs shall be perfectly resolved; sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, O my mind. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨ ॥
Transliteration: tum hee kaaran karan |
English: You are the Doer, the Cause of causes.

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਨ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal har saran |
English: Your lotus feet, Lord, are my Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਓਹੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: man tan har ohee dhiaaeaa |
English: I meditate on the Lord in my mind and body.

Gurbani: ਆਨੰਦ ਹਰਿ ਰੂਪ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aanand har roop dikhaaeaa |2|
English: The blissful Lord has revealed His form to me. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਸਦੀਵ ॥
Transliteration: tis hee kee ott sadeev |
English: I seek His eternal support;

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਕੀਨੇ ਹੈ ਜੀਵ ॥
Transliteration: jaa ke keene hai jeev |
English: He is the Creator of all beings.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: simarat har karat nidhaan |
English: Remembering the Lord in meditation, the treasure is obtained.

Gurbani: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰ ਨਿਦਾਨ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: raakhanahaar nidaan |3|
English: At the very last instant, He shall be your Savior. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਕੀ ਰੇਣ ਹੋਵੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: sarab kee ren hoveejai |
English: Be the dust of all men's feet.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਮਿਟਾਇ ਮਿਲੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: aap mittaae mileejai |
English: Eradicate self-conceit, and merge in the Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: anadin dhiaaeeai naam |
English: Night and day, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਫਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਕਾਮੁ ॥੪॥੩੩॥੪੪॥
Transliteration: safal naanak ihu kaam |4|33|44|
English: O Nanak, this is the most rewarding activity. ||4||33||44||

[Ang 896 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨ ਕਰੀਮ ॥
Transliteration: kaaran karan kareem |
English: He is the Doer, the Cause of causes, the bountiful Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਰਹੀਮ ॥
Transliteration: sarab pratipaal raheem |
English: The merciful Lord cherishes all.

Gurbani: ਅਲਹ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: alah alakh apaar |
English: The Lord is unseen and infinite.

Gurbani: ਖੁਦਿ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਵਡ ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: khud khudaae vadd besumaar |1|
English: God is great and endless. ||1||

Gurbani: ਓੁਂ ਨਮੋ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: oun namo bhagavant gusaaee |
English: I humbly pray to invoke the Universal Lord God, the Lord of the World.

Gurbani: ਖਾਲਕੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬ ਠਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: khaalak rav rahiaa sarab tthaaee |1| rahaau |
English: The Creator Lord is all-pervading, everywhere. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਗੰਨਾਥ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਮਾਧੋ ॥
Transliteration: jaganaath jagajeevan maadho |
English: He is the Lord of the Universe, the Life of the World.

Gurbani: ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨ ਰਿਦ ਮਾਹਿ ਅਰਾਧੋ ॥
Transliteration: bhau bhanjan rid maeh araadho |
English: Within your heart, worship and adore the Destroyer of fear.

Gurbani: ਰਿਖੀਕੇਸ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੋੁਵਿੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: rikheekes gopaal guovind |
English: The Master Rishi of the senses, Lord of the World, Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਮੁਕੰਦ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: pooran sarabatr mukand |2|
English: He is perfect, ever-present everywhere, the Liberator. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਮਉਲਾ ਤੂਹੀ ਏਕ ॥
Transliteration: miharavaan maulaa toohee ek |
English: You are the One and only merciful Master,

Gurbani: ਪੀਰ ਪੈਕਾਂਬਰ ਸੇਖ ॥
Transliteration: peer paikaanbar sekh |
English: spiritual teacher, prophet, religious teacher.

Gurbani: ਦਿਲਾ ਕਾ ਮਾਲਕੁ ਕਰੇ ਹਾਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: dilaa kaa maalak kare haak |
English: Master of hearts, Dispenser of justice,

Gurbani: ਕੁਰਾਨ ਕਤੇਬ ਤੇ ਪਾਕੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kuraan kateb te paak |3|
English: more sacred than the Koran and the Bible. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਨਰਹਰ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
Transliteration: naaraaein narahar deaal |
English: The Lord is powerful and merciful.

Gurbani: ਰਮਤ ਰਾਮ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਆਧਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: ramat raam ghatt ghatt aadhaar |
English: The all-pervading Lord is the support of each and every heart.

Gurbani: ਬਾਸੁਦੇਵ ਬਸਤ ਸਭ ਠਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: baasudev basat sabh tthaae |
English: The luminous Lord dwells everywhere.

Gurbani: ਲੀਲਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਲਖੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: leelaa kichh lakhee na jaae |4|
English: His play cannot be known. ||4||

Gurbani: ਮਿਹਰ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: mihar deaa kar karanaihaar |
English: Be kind and compassionate to me, O Creator Lord.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਬੰਦਗੀ ਦੇਹਿ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat bandagee dehi sirajanahaar |
English: Bless me with devotion and meditation, O Lord Creator.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਏ ਭਰਮ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak gur khoe bharam |
English: Says Nanak, the Guru has rid me of doubt.

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਅਲਹੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ॥੫॥੩੪॥੪੫॥
Transliteration: eko alahu paarabraham |5|34|45|
English: The Muslim God Allah and the Hindu God Paarbrahm are one and the same. ||5||34||45||

[Ang 897 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਪਾਪ ॥
Transliteration: kott janam ke binase paap |
English: The sins of millions of incarnations are eradicated.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥
Transliteration: har har japat naahee santaap |
