English: Meditating on the Lord, Har, Har, pain will not afflict you.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur ke charan kamal man vase |
English: When the Lord's lotus feet are enshrined in the mind,

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਨਸੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mahaa bikaar tan te sabh nase |1|
English: all terrible evils are taken away from the body. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੋਪਾਲ ਕੋ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: gopaal ko jas gaau praanee |
English: Sing the Praise of the Lord of the World, O mortal being.

Gurbani: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਸਾਚੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੂਰਨ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: akath kathaa saachee prabh pooran jotee jot samaanee |1| rahaau |
English: The Unspoken Speech of the True Lord God is perfect. Dwelling upon it, one's light merges into the Light. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੂਖ ਸਭ ਨਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: trisanaa bhookh sabh naasee |
English: Hunger and thirst are totally quenched;

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: sant prasaad japiaa abinaasee |
English: by the Grace of the Saints, meditate on the immortal Lord.

Gurbani: ਰੈਨਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: rain dinas prabh sev kamaanee |
English: Night and day, serve God.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਣੈ ਕੀ ਏਹ ਨੀਸਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har milanai kee eeh neesaanee |2|
English: This is the sign that one has met with the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਿਟੇ ਜੰਜਾਲ ਹੋਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
Transliteration: mitte janjaal hoe prabh deaal |
English: Worldly entanglements are ended, when God becomes merciful.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa darasan dekh nihaal |
English: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan, I am enraptured.

Gurbani: ਪਰਾ ਪੂਰਬਲਾ ਕਰਮੁ ਬਣਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: paraa poorabalaa karam ban aaeaa |
English: My perfect pre-destined karma has been activated.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਤ ਰਸਨਾ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har ke gun nit rasanaa gaaeaa |3|
English: With my tongue, I continually sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਸਦਾ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: har ke sant sadaa paravaan |
English: The Saints of the Lord are accepted and approved forever.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: sant janaa masatak neesaan |
English: The foreheads of the Saintly people are marked with the Lord's insignia.

Gurbani: ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਪਾਏ ਜੇ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: daas kee ren paae je koe |
English: One who is blessed with the dust of the feet of the Lord's slave,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੩੫॥੪੬॥
Transliteration: naanak tis kee param gat hoe |4|35|46|
English: O Nanak, obtains the supreme status. ||4||35||46||

[Ang 897 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਜਾਈਐ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: darasan kau jaaeeai kurabaan |
English: Let yourself be a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਧਰਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal hiradai dhar dhiaan |
English: Focus your heart's meditation on the Lord's lotus feet.

Gurbani: ਧੂਰਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: dhoor santan kee masatak laae |
English: Apply the dust of the feet of the Saints to your forehead,

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਲੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: janam janam kee duramat mal jaae |1|
English: and the filthy evil-mindedness of countless incarnations will be washed off. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਮਿਟੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: jis bhettat mittai abhimaan |
English: Meeting Him, egotistical pride is eradicated,

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham sabh nadaree aavai kar kirapaa pooran bhagavaan |1| rahaau |
English: and you will come to see the Supreme Lord God in all. The Perfect Lord God has showered His Mercy. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur kee keerat japeeai har naau |
English: This is the Guru's Praise, to chant the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur kee bhagat sadaa gun gaau |
English: This is devotion to the Guru, to sing forever the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur kee surat nikatt kar jaan |
English: This is contemplation upon the Guru, to know that the Lord is close at hand.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur kaa sabad sat kar maan |2|
English: Accept the Word of the Guru's Shabad as Truth. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਸੁਖ ਦੂਖ ॥
Transliteration: gur bachanee samasar sukh dookh |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, look upon pleasure and pain as one and the same.

Gurbani: ਕਦੇ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੂਖ ॥
Transliteration: kade na biaapai trisanaa bhookh |
English: Hunger and thirst shall never afflict you.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: man santokh sabad gur raaje |
English: The mind becomes content and satisfied through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਪੜਦੇ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਜੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jap gobind parrade sabh kaaje |3|
English: Meditate on the Lord of the Universe, and He will cover all your faults. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur paramesar gur govind |
English: The Guru is the Supreme Lord God; the Guru is the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਦਇਆਲ ਬਖਸਿੰਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur daataa deaal bakhasind |
English: The Guru is the Great Giver, merciful and forgiving.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur charanee jaa kaa man laagaa |
English: One whose mind is attached to the Guru's feet,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੪॥੩੬॥੪੭॥
Transliteration: naanak daas tis pooran bhaagaa |4|36|47|
English: O slave Nanak, is blessed with perfect destiny. ||4||36||47||

[Ang 898 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਿਸੁ ਭਰਵਾਸੈ ਬਿਚਰਹਿ ਭਵਨ ॥
Transliteration: kis bharavaasai bichareh bhavan |
English: What supports you in this world?

Gurbani: ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੰਗੀ ਕਵਨ ॥
Transliteration: moorr mugadh teraa sangee kavan |
English: You ignorant fool, who is your companion?

Gurbani: ਰਾਮੁ ਸੰਗੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: raam sangee tis gat nahee jaaneh |
English: The Lord is your only companion; no one knows His condition.

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਬਟਵਾਰੇ ਸੇ ਮੀਤ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਹਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: panch battavaare se meet kar maaneh |1|
English: You look upon the five thieves as your friends. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਉਧਰਹਿ ਮੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: so ghar sev jit udhareh meet |
English: Serve that home, which will save you, my friend.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਰਵੀਅਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gun govind raveeeh din raatee saadhasang kar man kee preet |1| rahaau |
English: Chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, day and night; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, love Him in your mind. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਨਮੁ ਬਿਹਾਨੋ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਅਰੁ ਵਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: janam bihaano ahankaar ar vaad |
English: This human life is passing away in egotism and conflict.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: tripat na aavai bikhiaa saad |
English: You are not satisfied; such is the flavor of sin.

Gurbani: ਭਰਮਤ ਭਰਮਤ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bharamat bharamat mahaa dukh paaeaa |
English: Wandering and roaming around, you suffer terrible pain.

Gurbani: ਤਰੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਦੁਤਰ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: taree na jaaee dutar maaeaa |2|
English: You cannot cross over the impassable sea of Maya. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਸੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: kaam na aavai su kaar kamaavai |
English: You do the deeds which do not help you at all.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਬੀਜਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਖਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: aap beej aape hee khaavai |
English: As you plant, so shall you harvest.

Gurbani: ਰਾਖਨ ਕਉ ਦੂਸਰ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: raakhan kau doosar nahee koe |
English: There is none other than the Lord to save you.

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਨਿਸਤਰੈ ਜਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tau nisatarai jau kirapaa hoe |3|
English: You will be saved, only if God grants His Grace. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: patit puneet prabh tero naam |
English: Your Name, God, is the Purifier of sinners.

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਕੀਜੈ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: apane daas kau keejai daan |
English: Please bless Your slave with that gift.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh gat kar meree |
English: Please grant Your Grace, God, and emancipate me.

Gurbani: ਸਰਣਿ ਗਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ॥੪॥੩੭॥੪੮॥
Transliteration: saran gahee naanak prabh teree |4|37|48|
English: Nanak has grasped Your Sanctuary, God. ||4||37||48||

[Ang 898 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਇਹ ਲੋਕੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: eih loke sukh paaeaa |
English: I have found peace in this world.

Gurbani: ਨਹੀ ਭੇਟਤ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: nahee bhettat dharam raaeaa |
English: I will not have to appear before the Righteous Judge of Dharma to give my account.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: har daragah sobhaavant |
English: I will be respected in the Court of the Lord,

Gurbani: ਫੁਨਿ ਗਰਭਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਸੰਤ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: fun garabh naahee basant |1|
English: and I will not have to enter the womb of reincarnation ever again. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਾਨੀ ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jaanee sant kee mitraaee |
English: Now, I know the value of friendship with the Saints.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੀਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਸੰਜੋਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa deeno har naamaa poorab sanjog milaaee |1| rahaau |
English: In His Mercy, the Lord has blessed me with His Name. My pre-ordained destiny has been fulfilled. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਚਰਣਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai charan chit laagaa |
English: My consciousness is attached to the Guru's feet.

Gurbani: ਧੰਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਸਭਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan sanjog sabhaagaa |
English: Blessed, blessed is this fortunate time of union.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਾਥੇ ॥
Transliteration: sant kee dhoor laagee merai maathe |
English: I have applied the dust of the Saints' feet to my forehead,

Gurbani: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਦੁਖ ਸਗਲੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਥੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kilavikh dukh sagale mere laathe |2|
English: and all my sins and pains have been eradicated. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸਚੁ ਟਹਲ ਕਮਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: saadh kee sach ttehal kamaanee |
English: Performing true service to the Holy,

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਹੋਏ ਮਨ ਸੁਧ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: tab hoe man sudh paraanee |
English: the mortal's mind is purified.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਕਾ ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸੁ ਡੀਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: jan kaa safal daras ddeetthaa |
English: I have seen the fruitful vision of the Lord's humble slave.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕਾ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਵੂਠਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naam prabhoo kaa ghatt ghatt vootthaa |3|
English: God's Name dwells within each and every heart. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਿਟਾਨੇ ਸਭਿ ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ॥
Transliteration: mittaane sabh kal kales |
English: All my troubles and sufferings have been taken away;

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਪਰਵੇਸ ॥
Transliteration: jis te upaje tis meh paraves |
English: I have merged into the One, from whom I originated.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਆਨੂਪ ਗੋੁਵਿੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: pragatte aanoop guovind |
English: The Lord of the Universe, incomparably beautiful, has become merciful.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੂਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸਿੰਦ ॥੪॥੩੮॥੪੯॥
Transliteration: prabh poore naanak bakhasind |4|38|49|
English: O Nanak, God is perfect and forgiving. ||4||38||49||

[Ang 898 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗਊ ਕਉ ਚਾਰੇ ਸਾਰਦੂਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: gaoo kau chaare saaradool |
English: The tiger leads the cow to the pasture,

Gurbani: ਕਉਡੀ ਕਾ ਲਖ ਹੂਆ ਮੂਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: kauddee kaa lakh hooaa mool |
English: the shell is worth thousands of dollars,

Gurbani: ਬਕਰੀ ਕਉ ਹਸਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: bakaree kau hasatee pratipaale |
English: and the elephant nurses the goat,

Gurbani: ਅਪਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: apanaa prabh nadar nihaale |1|
English: when God bestows His Glance of Grace. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kripaa nidhaan preetam prabh mere |
English: You are the treasure of mercy, O my Beloved Lord God.

Gurbani: ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਬਹੁ ਗੁਨ ਤੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: baran na saakau bahu gun tere |1| rahaau |
English: I cannot even describe Your many Glorious Virtues. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦੀਸਤ ਮਾਸੁ ਨ ਖਾਇ ਬਿਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: deesat maas na khaae bilaaee |
English: The cat sees the meat, but does not eat it,

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਕਸਾਬਿ ਛੁਰੀ ਸਟਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: mahaa kasaab chhuree satt paaee |
English: and the great butcher throws away his knife;

Gurbani: ਕਰਣਹਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵੂਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: karanahaar prabh hiradai vootthaa |
English: the Creator Lord God abides in the heart;

Gurbani: ਫਾਥੀ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਕਾ ਜਾਲਾ ਤੂਟਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: faathee machhulee kaa jaalaa toottaa |2|
English: the net holding the fish breaks apart. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੂਕੇ ਕਾਸਟ ਹਰੇ ਚਲੂਲ ॥
Transliteration: sooke kaasatt hare chalool |
English: The dry wood blossoms forth in greenery and red flowers;

Gurbani: ਊਚੈ ਥਲਿ ਫੂਲੇ ਕਮਲ ਅਨੂਪ ॥
Transliteration: aoochai thal foole kamal anoop |
English: in the high desert, the beautiful lotus flower blooms.

Gurbani: ਅਗਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੇਵ ॥
Transliteration: agan nivaaree satigur dev |
English: The Divine True Guru puts out the fire.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਕੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਲਾਇਓ ਸੇਵ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sevak apanee laaeo sev |3|
English: He links His servant to His service. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅਕਿਰਤਘਣਾ ਕਾ ਕਰੇ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: akirataghanaa kaa kare udhaar |
English: He saves even the ungrateful;

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: prabh meraa hai sadaa deaar |
English: my God is forever merciful.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sant janaa kaa sadaa sahaaee |
English: He is forever the helper and support of the humble Saints.

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੪॥੩੯॥੫੦॥
Transliteration: charan kamal naanak saranaaee |4|39|50|
English: Nanak has found the Sanctuary of His lotus feet. ||4||39||50||

[Ang 898 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਸਿੰਘ ਰਾਖੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: panch singh raakhe prabh maar |
English: God killed the five tigers.

Gurbani: ਦਸ ਬਿਘਿਆੜੀ ਲਈ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: das bighiaarree lee nivaar |
English: He has driven out the ten wolves.

Gurbani: ਤੀਨਿ ਆਵਰਤ ਕੀ ਚੂਕੀ ਘੇਰ ॥
Transliteration: teen aavarat kee chookee gher |
English: The three whirl-pools have stopped spinning.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਚੂਕੇ ਭੈ ਫੇਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saadhasang chooke bhai fer |1|
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the fear of reincarnation is gone. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: simar simar jeevaa govind |
English: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Lord of the Universe, I live.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਦਾਸੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਬਖਸਿੰਦ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa raakhio daas apanaa sadaa sadaa saachaa bakhasind |1| rahaau |
English: In His Mercy, He protects His slave; the True Lord is forever and ever the forgiver. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦਾਝਿ ਗਏ ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਪਾਪ ਸੁਮੇਰ ॥
Transliteration: daajh ge trin paap sumer |
English: The mountain of sin is burnt down, like straw,

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੂਜੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੈਰ ॥
Transliteration: jap jap naam pooje prabh pair |
English: by chanting and meditating on the Name, and worshipping God's feet.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦ ਰੂਪ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਓ ਸਭ ਥਾਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: anad roop pragattio sabh thaan |
English: God, the embodiment of bliss, becomes manifest everywhere.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਜੋਰੀ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਨਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: prem bhagat joree sukh maan |2|
English: Linked to His loving devotional worship, I enjoy peace. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਿਓ ਬਾਛਰ ਖੋਜ ॥
Transliteration: saagar tario baachhar khoj |
English: I have crossed over the world-ocean, as if it were no bigger than a calf's footprint on the ground.

Gurbani: ਖੇਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਨਹ ਫੁਨਿ ਰੋਜ ॥
Transliteration: khed na paaeo neh fun roj |
English: I shall never again have to endure suffering or grief.

Gurbani: ਸਿੰਧੁ ਸਮਾਇਓ ਘਟੁਕੇ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: sindh samaaeo ghattuke maeh |
English: The ocean is contained in the pitcher.

Gurbani: ਕਰਣਹਾਰ ਕਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: karanahaar kau kichh acharaj naeh |3|
English: This is not such an amazing thing for the Creator to do. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਛੂਟਉ ਤਉ ਜਾਇ ਪਇਆਲ ॥
Transliteration: jau chhoottau tau jaae peaal |
English: When I am separated from Him, then I am consigned to the nether regions.

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਕਾਢਿਓ ਤਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: jau kaadtio tau nadar nihaal |
English: When He lifts me up and pulls me out, then I am enraptured by His Glance of Grace.

Gurbani: ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਹਮਰੈ ਵਸਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: paap pun hamarai vas naeh |
English: Vice and virtue are not under my control.

Gurbani: ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹਿ ॥੪॥੪੦॥੫੧॥
Transliteration: rasak rasak naanak gun gaeh |4|40|51|
English: With love and affection, Nanak sings His Glorious Praises. ||4||40||51||

[Ang 899 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਤੋਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: naa tan teraa naa man tohi |
English: Neither your body nor your mind belong to you.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਿਆਪਿਆ ਧੋਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohi biaapiaa dhohi |
English: Attached to Maya, you are entangled in fraud.

Gurbani: ਕੁਦਮ ਕਰੈ ਗਾਡਰ ਜਿਉ ਛੇਲ ॥
Transliteration: kudam karai gaaddar jiau chhel |
English: You play like a baby lamb.

Gurbani: ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਜਾਲੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਚਕ੍ਰੁ ਪੇਲ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: achint jaal kaal chakru pel |1|
English: But suddenly, Death will catch you in its noose. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਰਨਾਇ ਮਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: har charan kamal saranaae manaa |
English: Seek the Sanctuary of the Lord's lotus feet, O my mind.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਧਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam jap sang sahaaee guramukh paaveh saach dhanaa |1| rahaau |
English: Chant the Name of the Lord, which will be your help and support. As Gurmukh, you shall obtain the true wealth. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਊਨੇ ਕਾਜ ਨ ਹੋਵਤ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aoone kaaj na hovat poore |
English: Your unfinished worldly affairs will never be resolved.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਮਦਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਝੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh mad sad hee jhoore |
English: You shall always regret your sexual desire, anger and pride.

Gurbani: ਕਰੈ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਜੀਅਰੇ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: karai bikaar jeeare kai taaee |
English: You act in corruption in order to survive,

Gurbani: ਗਾਫਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਤਸੂਆ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gaafal sang na tasooaa jaaee |2|
English: but not even an iota will go along with you, you ignorant fool! ||2||

Gurbani: ਧਰਤ ਧੋਹ ਅਨਿਕ ਛਲ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: dharat dhoh anik chhal jaanai |
English: You practice deception, and you know many tricks;

Gurbani: ਕਉਡੀ ਕਉਡੀ ਕਉ ਖਾਕੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: kauddee kauddee kau khaak sir chhaanai |
English: for the sake of mere shells, you throw dust upon your head.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਤਿਸੈ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਮੂਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: jin deea tisai na chetai mool |
English: You never even think of the One who gave you life.

Gurbani: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਲੋਭੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਸੂਲੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: mithiaa lobh na utarai sool |3|
English: The pain of false greed never leaves you. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਜਬ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham jab bhe deaal |
English: When the Supreme Lord God becomes merciful,

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਾਧ ਰਵਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: eihu man hoaa saadh ravaal |
English: this mind becomes the dust of the feet of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਹਸਤ ਕਮਲ ਲੜਿ ਲੀਨੋ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: hasat kamal larr leeno laae |
English: With His lotus hands, He has attached us to the hem of His robe.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੪੧॥੫੨॥
Transliteration: naanak saachai saach samaae |4|41|52|
English: Nanak merges in the Truest of the True. ||4||41||52||

[Ang 899 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: raajaa raam kee saranaae |
English: I seek the Sanctuary of the Sovereign Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: nirbhau bhe gobind gun gaavat saadhasang dukh jaae |1| rahaau |
English: I have become fearless, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe. In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, my pains have been taken away. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਬਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai raam basai man maahee |
English: That person, within whose mind the Lord abides,

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਪੇਖਤ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: so jan dutar pekhat naahee |
English: does not see the impassible world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲੇ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਅਪਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: sagale kaaj savaare apane |
English: All one's affairs are resolved,

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਨ ਨਿਤ ਜਪਨੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har har naam rasan nit japane |1|
English: by chanting continually the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹਾਥੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਧਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: jis kai masatak haath gur dharai |
English: Why should His slave feel any anxiety?

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਦਾਸੁ ਅਦੇਸਾ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: so daas adesaa kaahe karai |
English: The Guru places His hand upon my forehead.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕੀ ਚੂਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ॥
Transliteration: janam maran kee chookee kaan |
English: The fear of birth and death is dispelled;

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਕੁਰਬਾਣ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: poore gur aoopar kurabaan |2|
English: I am a sacrifice to the Perfect Guru. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਭੇਟਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: gur paramesar bhett nihaal |
English: I am enraptured, meeting with the Guru, the Transcendent Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: so darasan paae jis hoe deaal |
English: He alone obtains the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, who is blessed by His Mercy.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham jis kirapaa karai |
English: One who is blessed by the Grace of the Supreme Lord God,

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸੋ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: saadhasang so bhavajal tarai |3|
English: crosses over the terrifying world-ocean in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਹੁ ਸਾਧ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: amrit peevahu saadh piaare |
English: Drink in the Ambrosial Nectar, O Beloved Holy people.

Gurbani: ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਸਾਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: mukh aoojal saachai darabaare |
English: Your face shall be radiant and bright in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦ ਕਰਹੁ ਤਜਿ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: anad karahu taj sagal bikaar |
English: Celebrate and be blissful, and abandon all corruption.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਉਤਰਹੁ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੪੨॥੫੩॥
Transliteration: naanak har jap utarahu paar |4|42|53|
English: O Nanak, meditate on the Lord and cross over. ||4||42||53||

[Ang 900 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ੲੰੀਧਨ ਤੇ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: eneedhan te baisantar bhaagai |
English: The fire runs away from the fuel.

Gurbani: ਮਾਟੀ ਕਉ ਜਲੁ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਤਿਆਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: maattee kau jal deh dis tiaagai |
English: The water runs away from the dust in all directions.

Gurbani: ਊਪਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਤਲੈ ਆਕਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: aoopar charan talai aakaas |
English: The feet are above, and the sky is beneath.

Gurbani: ਘਟ ਮਹਿ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਕੀਓ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ghatt meh sindh keeo paragaas |1|
English: The ocean appears in the cup. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa samrath har jeeo aap |
English: Such is our all-powerful dear Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਜੀਅ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੈ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਮਨ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: nimakh na bisarai jeea bhagatan kai aatth pehar man taa kau jaap |1| rahaau |
English: His devotees do not forget Him, even for an instant. Twenty-four hours a day, O mind, meditate on Him. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਥਮੇ ਮਾਖਨੁ ਪਾਛੈ ਦੂਧੁ ॥
Transliteration: prathame maakhan paachhai doodh |
English: First comes the butter, and then the milk.

Gurbani: ਮੈਲੂ ਕੀਨੋ ਸਾਬੁਨੁ ਸੂਧੁ ॥
Transliteration: mailoo keeno saabun soodh |
English: The dirt cleans the soap.

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਡਰਤਾ ਫਿਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: bhai te nirbhau ddarataa firai |
English: The fearless are afraid of fear.

Gurbani: ਹੋਂਦੀ ਕਉ ਅਣਹੋਂਦੀ ਹਿਰੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: hondee kau anahondee hirai |2|
English: The living are killed by the dead. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦੇਹੀ ਗੁਪਤ ਬਿਦੇਹੀ ਦੀਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: dehee gupat bidehee deesai |
English: The visible body is hidden, and the etheric body is seen.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲੇ ਸਾਜਿ ਕਰਤ ਜਗਦੀਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: sagale saaj karat jagadeesai |
English: The Lord of the world does all these things.

Gurbani: ਠਗਣਹਾਰ ਅਣਠਗਦਾ ਠਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: tthaganahaar anatthagadaa tthaagai |
English: The one who is cheated, is not cheated by the cheat.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਵਖਰ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਉਠਿ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bin vakhar fir fir utth laagai |3|
English: With no merchandise, the trader trades again and again. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਬਖਿਆਣ ॥
Transliteration: sant sabhaa mil karahu bakhiaan |
English: So join the Society of the Saints, and chant the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ॥
Transliteration: sinmrit saasat bed puraan |
English: So say the Simritees, Shaastras, Vedas and Puraanas.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: braham beechaar beechaare koe |
English: Rare are those who contemplate and meditate on God.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੪੩॥੫੪॥
Transliteration: naanak taa kee param gat hoe |4|43|54|
English: O Nanak, they attain the supreme status. ||4||43||54||

[Ang 900 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: jo tis bhaavai so theea |
English: Whatever pleases Him happens.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਆਨ ਬੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa har kee saranaaee prabh bin naahee aan beea |1| rahaau |
English: Forever and ever, I seek the Sanctuary of the Lord.There is none other than God. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪੁਤੁ ਕਲਤ੍ਰੁ ਲਖਿਮੀ ਦੀਸੈ ਇਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਲੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: put kalatru lakhimee deesai in meh kichhoo na sang leea |
English: You look upon your children, spouse and wealth; none of these will go along with you.

Gurbani: ਬਿਖੈ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਖਾਇ ਭੁਲਾਨਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਗਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bikhai tthgauree khaae bhulaanaa maaeaa mandar tiaag geaa |1|
English: Eating the poisonous potion, you have gone astray. You will have to go, and leave Maya and your mansions. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਵਿਗੂਤਾ ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਪਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: nindaa kar kar bahut vigootaa garabh jon meh kirat peaa |
English: Slandering others, you are totally ruined; because of your past actions, you shall be consigned to the womb of reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਪੁਰਬ ਕਮਾਣੇ ਛੋਡਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਮਦੂਤਿ ਗ੍ਰਾਸਿਓ ਮਹਾ ਭਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: purab kamaane chhoddeh naahee jamadoot graasio mahaa bheaa |2|
English: Your past actions will not just go away; the most horrible Messenger of Death shall seize you. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬੋਲੈ ਝੂਠੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਅਵਰਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਹਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bolai jhootth kamaavai avaraa trisan na boojhai bahut heaa |
English: You tell lies, and do not practice what you preach. Your desires are not satisfied - what a shame.

Gurbani: ਅਸਾਧ ਰੋਗੁ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਸੰਤ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਦੇਹ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਮਹਾ ਖਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: asaadh rog upajiaa sant dookhan deh binaasee mahaa kheaa |3|
English: You have contracted an incurable disease; slandering the Saints, your body is wasting away; you are utterly ruined. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਹਿ ਨਿਵਾਜੇ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਸਾਜੇ ਆਪੇ ਕੀਨੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jineh nivaaje tin hee saaje aape keene sant jeaa |
English: He embellishes those whom He has fashioned. He Himself gave life to the Saints.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਰਾਖੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮਇਆ ॥੪॥੪੪॥੫੫॥
Transliteration: naanak daas kantth laae raakhe kar kirapaa paarabraham meaa |4|44|55|
English: O Nanak, He hugs His slaves close in His Embrace. Please grant Your Grace, O Supreme Lord God, and be kind to me as well. ||4||44||55||

[Ang 900 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa pooraa guradeo sahaaee |
English: Such is the Perfect Divine Guru, my help and support.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kaa simaran birathaa na jaaee |1| rahaau |
English: Meditation on Him is not wasted. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਤ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: darasan pekhat hoe nihaal |
English: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, I am enraptured.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਕਾਟੈ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kee dhoor kaattai jam jaal |
English: The dust of His feet snaps the noose of Death.

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਬਸੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕੇ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal base mere man ke |
English: His lotus feet dwell within my mind,

Gurbani: ਕਾਰਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਤਨ ਕੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kaaraj savaare sagale tan ke |1|
English: and so all the affairs of my body are arranged and resolved. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਹਾਥੁ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai masatak raakhai haath |
English: One upon whom He places His Hand, is protected.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰੋ ਅਨਾਥ ਕੋ ਨਾਥੁ ॥
Transliteration: prabh mero anaath ko naath |
English: My God is the Master of the masterless.

Gurbani: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: patit udhaaran kripaa nidhaan |
English: He is the Savior of sinners, the treasure of mercy.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਈਐ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa jaaeeai kurabaan |2|
English: Forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to Him. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮੰਤੁ ਦੇਇ ਜਿਸੁ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: niramal mant dee jis daan |
English: One whom He blesses with His Immaculate Mantra,

Gurbani: ਤਜਹਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: tajeh bikaar binasai abhimaan |
English: renounces corruption; his egotistical pride is dispelled.

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: ek dhiaaeeai saadh kai sang |
English: Meditate on the One Lord in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਪਾਪ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: paap binaase naam kai rang |3|
English: Sins are erased, through the love of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: gur paramesur sagal nivaas |
English: The Guru, the Transcendent Lord, dwells among all.

Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt rav rahiaa gunataas |
English: The treasure of virtue pervades and permeates each and every heart.

Gurbani: ਦਰਸੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਧਾਰਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਸ ॥
Transliteration: daras dehi dhaarau prabh aas |
English: Please grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan;

Gurbani: ਨਿਤ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਸਚੁ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੪੫॥੫੬॥
Transliteration: nit naanak chitavai sach aradaas |4|45|56|
English: O God, I place my hopes in You. Nanak continually offers this true prayer. ||4||45||56||

[Ang 901 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: raag raamakalee mahalaa 5 ghar 2 dupade |
English: Raag Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl, Second House, Dho-Padhay:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: gaavahu raam ke gun geet |
English: Sing the songs of Praise of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: naam japat param sukh paaeeai aavaa gaun mittai mere meet |1| rahaau |
English: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, total peace is obtained; coming and going is ended, my friend. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ ਹੋਵਤ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: gun gaavat hovat paragaas |
English: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, one is enlightened,

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: charan kamal meh hoe nivaas |1|
English: and comes to dwell in His lotus feet. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: santasangat meh hoe udhaar |
English: In the Society of the Saints, one is saved.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੧॥੫੭॥
Transliteration: naanak bhavajal utaras paar |2|1|57|
English: O Nanak, he crosses over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||1||57||

[Ang 901 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur pooraa meraa gur pooraa |
English: My Guru is perfect, my Guru is perfect.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਰੋਗ ਕੂਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam jap sadaa suhele sagal binaase rog kooraa |1| rahaau |
English: Chanting the Lord's Name, I am always at peace; all my illness and fraud is dispelled. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਅਰਾਧਹੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: ek araadhahu saachaa soe |
English: Worship and adore that One Lord alone.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jaa kee saran sadaa sukh hoe |1|
English: In His Sanctuary, eternal peace is obtained. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨੀਦ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਲਾਗੀ ਭੂਖ ॥
Transliteration: need suhelee naam kee laagee bhookh |
English: One who feels hunger for the Naam sleeps in peace.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਭ ਦੂਖ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har simarat binase sabh dookh |2|
English: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, all pains are dispelled. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਹਜਿ ਅਨੰਦ ਕਰਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj anand karahu mere bhaaee |
English: Enjoy celestial bliss, O my Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਭ ਚਿੰਤ ਮਿਟਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur poorai sabh chint mittaaee |3|
English: The Perfect Guru has eradicated all anxiety. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar prabh kaa jap jaap |
English: Twenty-four hours a day, chant God's Chant.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਖਾ ਹੋਆ ਆਪਿ ॥੪॥੨॥੫੮॥
Transliteration: naanak raakhaa hoaa aap |4|2|58|
English: O Nanak, He Himself shall save you. ||4||2||58||

[Ang 901 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਪੜਤਾਲ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: raag raamakalee mahalaa 5 parrataal ghar 3 |
English: Raag Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl, Partaal, Third House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਨਰਨਰਹ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੰ ॥
Transliteration: naranarah namasakaaran |
English: I humbly bow to the Lord, the Supreme Being.

Gurbani: ਜਲਨ ਥਲਨ ਬਸੁਧ ਗਗਨ ਏਕ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jalan thalan basudh gagan ek ekankaaran |1| rahaau |
English: The One, the One and Only Creator Lord permeates the water, the land, the earth and the sky. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਨ ਧਰਨ ਪੁਨ ਪੁਨਹ ਕਰਨ ॥
Transliteration: haran dharan pun punah karan |
English: Over and over again, the Creator Lord destroys, sustains and creates.

Gurbani: ਨਹ ਗਿਰਹ ਨਿਰੰਹਾਰੰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: neh girah niranhaaran |1|
English: He has no home; He needs no nourishment. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੰਭੀਰ ਧੀਰ ਨਾਮ ਹੀਰ ਊਚ ਮੂਚ ਅਪਾਰੰ ॥
Transliteration: ganbheer dheer naam heer aooch mooch apaaran |
English: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is deep and profound, strong, poised, lofty, exalted and infinite.

Gurbani: ਕਰਨ ਕੇਲ ਗੁਣ ਅਮੋਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੰ ॥੨॥੧॥੫੯॥
Transliteration: karan kel gun amol naanak balihaaran |2|1|59|
English: He stages His plays; His Virtues are priceless. Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||2||1||59||

[Ang 901 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਭੋਗ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਚਲੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਛਲੇ ਕਨਿਕ ਕਾਮਿਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: roop rang sugandh bhog tiaag chale maaeaa chhale kanik kaaminee |1| rahaau |
English: You must abandon your beauty, pleasures, fragrances and enjoyments; beguiled by gold and sexual desire, you must still leave Maya behind. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਭੰਡਾਰ ਦਰਬ ਅਰਬ ਖਰਬ ਪੇਖਿ ਲੀਲਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਧਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: bhanddaar darab arab kharab pekh leelaa man sadhaarai |
English: You gaze upon billions and trillions of treasures and riches, which delight and comfort your mind,

Gurbani: ਨਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਗਾਮਨੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: neh sang gaamanee |1|
English: but these will not go along with you. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁਤ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਮੀਤ ਉਰਝਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਭਰਮਿ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਇਹ ਬਿਰਖ ਛਾਮਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: sut kalatr bhraat meet urajh pario bharam mohio ih birakh chhaamanee |
English: Entangled with children, spouse, siblings and friends, you are enticed and fooled; these pass like the shadow of a tree.

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਰਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਸੰਤ ਭਾਵਨੀ ॥੨॥੨॥੬੦॥
Transliteration: charan kamal saran naanak sukh sant bhaavanee |2|2|60|
English: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of His lotus feet; He has found peace in the faith of the Saints. ||2||2||60||

[Ang 901 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ਤਿਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: raag raamakalee mahalaa 9 tipade |
English: Raag Raamkalee, Ninth Mehl, Thi-Padhay:

Gurbani: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਓਟ ਲੇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: re man ott lehu har naamaa |
English: O mind, take the sheltering support of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਸੈ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai simaran duramat naasai paaveh pad nirabaanaa |1| rahaau |
English: Remembering Him in meditation, evil-mindedness is dispelled, and the state of Nirvaanaa is obtained. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ਤਿਹ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: baddabhaagee tih jan kau jaanahu jo har ke gun gaavai |
English: Know that one who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord is very fortunate.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਖੋਇ ਕੈ ਫੁਨਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: janam janam ke paap khoe kai fun baikuntth sidhaavai |1|
English: The sins of countless incarnations are washed off, and he attains the heavenly realm. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਜਾਮਲ ਕਉ ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਸੁਧਿ ਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: ajaamal kau ant kaal meh naaraaein sudh aaee |
English: At the very last moment, Ajaamal became aware of the Lord;

Gurbani: ਜਾਂ ਗਤਿ ਕਉ ਜੋਗੀਸੁਰ ਬਾਛਤ ਸੋ ਗਤਿ ਛਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jaan gat kau jogeesur baachhat so gat chhin meh paaee |2|
English: that state which even the supreme Yogis desire - he attained that state in an instant. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਾਹਿਨ ਗੁਨੁ ਨਾਹਿਨ ਕਛੁ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਗਜਿ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: naahin gun naahin kachh bidiaa dharam kaun gaj keenaa |
English: The elephant had no virtue and no knowledge; what religious rituals has he performed?

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਰਾਮ ਕਾ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਅਭੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਤਿਹ ਦੀਨਾ ॥੩॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak birad raam kaa dekhahu abhai daan tih deenaa |3|1|
English: O Nanak, behold the way of the Lord, who bestowed the gift of fearlessness. ||3||1||

[Ang 902 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 9 |
English: Raamkalee, Ninth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੋ ਕਉਨ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਅਬ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: saadho kaun jugat ab keejai |
English: Holy people: what way should I now adopt,

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaa te duramat sagal binaasai raam bhagat man bheejai |1| rahaau |
English: by which all evil-mindedness may be dispelled, and the mind may vibrate in devotional worship to the Lord? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਿ ਉਰਝਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਹੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਨਹ ਕਛੁ ਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: man maaeaa meh urajh rahio hai boojhai neh kachh giaanaa |
English: My mind is entangled in Maya; it knows nothing at all of spiritual wisdom.

Gurbani: ਕਉਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਗੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਪਾਵੈ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kaun naam jag jaa kai simarai paavai pad nirabaanaa |1|
English: What is that Name, by which the world, contemplating it, might attain the state of Nirvaanaa? ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਤਬ ਇਹ ਬਾਤ ਬਤਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: bhe deaal kripaal sant jan tab ih baat bataaee |
English: When the Saints became kind and compassionate, they told me this.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਧਰਮ ਮਾਨੋ ਤਿਹ ਕੀਏ ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sarab dharam maano tih kee jih prabh keerat gaaee |2|
English: Understand, that whoever sings the Kirtan of God's Praises, has performed all religious rituals. ||2||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਰੁ ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਮਹਿ ਨਿਮਖ ਏਕ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam nar nis baasur meh nimakh ek ur dhaarai |
English: One who enshrines the Lord's Name in his heart night and day - even for an instant

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਕੋ ਤ੍ਰਾਸੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਹ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰੈ ॥੩॥੨॥
Transliteration: jam ko traas mittai naanak tih apuno janam savaarai |3|2|
English: - has his fear of Death eradicated. O Nanak, his life is approved and fulfilled. ||3||2||

[Ang 902 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 9 |
English: Raamkalee, Ninth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਸੁਧਿ ਲੇਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: praanee naaraaein sudh lehi |
English: O mortal, focus your thoughts on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਛਿਨੁ ਛਿਨੁ ਅਉਧ ਘਟੈ ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਜਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਦੇਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: chhin chhin aaudh ghattai nis baasur brithaa jaat hai deh |1| rahaau |
English: Moment by moment, your life is running out; night and day, your body is passing away in vain. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤਰਨਾਪੋ ਬਿਖਿਅਨ ਸਿਉ ਖੋਇਓ ਬਾਲਪਨੁ ਅਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: taranaapo bikhian siau khoeo baalapan agiaanaa |
English: You have wasted your youth in corrupt pleasures, and your childhood in ignorance.

Gurbani: ਬਿਰਧਿ ਭਇਓ ਅਜਹੂ ਨਹੀ ਸਮਝੈ ਕਉਨ ਕੁਮਤਿ ਉਰਝਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: biradh bheo ajahoo nahee samajhai kaun kumat urajhaanaa |1|
English: You have grown old, and even now, you do not understand, the evil-mindedness in which you are entangled. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਦੀਓ ਜਿਹ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਸੋ ਤੈ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: maanas janam deeo jih tthaakur so tai kiau bisaraaeo |
English: Why have you forgotten your Lord and Master, who blessed you with this human life?

Gurbani: ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹੋਤ ਨਰ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਗਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mukat hot nar jaa kai simarai nimakh na taa kau gaaeo |2|
English: Remembering Him in meditation, one is liberated. And yet, you do not sing His Praises, even for an instant. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਕੋ ਮਦੁ ਕਹਾ ਕਰਤੁ ਹੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa ko mad kahaa karat hai sang na kaahoo jaaee |
English: Why are you intoxicated with Maya? It will not go along with you.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹਤੁ ਚੇਤਿ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਹੈ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੩॥੩॥੮੧॥
Transliteration: naanak kehat chet chintaaman hoe hai ant sahaaee |3|3|81|
English: Says Nanak, think of Him, remember Him in your mind. He is the Fulfiller of desires, who will be your help and support in the end. ||3||3||81||

[Ang 902 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 1 asattapadeea |
English: Raamkalee, First Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਚੰਦੁ ਚੜਹਿ ਸੇ ਤਾਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਦਿਨੀਅਰੁ ਤਪਤ ਰਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: soee chand charreh se taare soee dineear tapat rahai |
English: The same moon rises, and the same stars; the same sun shines in the sky.

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਧਰਤੀ ਸੋ ਪਉਣੁ ਝੁਲਾਰੇ ਜੁਗ ਜੀਅ ਖੇਲੇ ਥਾਵ ਕੈਸੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saa dharatee so paun jhulaare jug jeea khele thaav kaise |1|
English: The earth is the same, and the same wind blows. The age in which we dwell affects living beings, but not these places. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਨ ਤਲਬ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jeevan talab nivaar |
English: Give up your attachment to life.

Gurbani: ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਧਿਙਾਣਾ ਕਲਿ ਲਖਣ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hovai paravaanaa kareh dhingaanaa kal lakhan veechaar |1| rahaau |
English: Those who act like tyrants are accepted and approved - recognize that this is the sign of the Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਿਤੈ ਦੇਸਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਤੀਰਥ ਪਾਸਿ ਨ ਬੈਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: kitai des na aaeaa suneeai teerath paas na baitthaa |
English: Kali Yuga has not been heard to have come to any country, or to be sitting at any sacred shrine.

Gurbani: ਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਹਲ ਉਸਾਰਿ ਨ ਬੈਠਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: daataa daan kare teh naahee mehal usaar na baitthaa |2|
English: It is not where the generous person gives to charities, nor seated in the mansion he has built. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਸਤੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਛੀਜੈ ਤਪ ਘਰਿ ਤਪੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: je ko sat kare so chheejai tap ghar tap na hoee |
English: If someone practices Truth, he is frustrated; prosperity does not come to the home of the sincere.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ਲਏ ਬਦਨਾਵੀ ਕਲਿ ਕੇ ਲਖਣ ਏਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: je ko naau le badanaavee kal ke lakhan eee |3|
English: If someone chants the Lord's Name, he is scorned. These are the signs of Kali Yuga. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਕਦਾਰੀ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਖੁਆਰੀ ਚਾਕਰ ਕੇਹੇ ਡਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: jis sikadaaree tiseh khuaaree chaakar kehe ddaranaa |
English: Whoever is in charge, is humiliated. Why should the servant be afraid,

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਸਿਕਦਾਰੈ ਪਵੈ ਜੰਜੀਰੀ ਤਾ ਚਾਕਰ ਹਥਹੁ ਮਰਣਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jaa sikadaarai pavai janjeeree taa chaakar hathahu maranaa |4|
English: when the master is put in chains? He dies at the hands of his servant. ||4||

Gurbani: ਆਖੁ ਗੁਣਾ ਕਲਿ ਆਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: aakh gunaa kal aaeeai |
English: Chant the Praises of the Lord; Kali Yuga has come.

Gurbani: ਤਿਹੁ ਜੁਗ ਕੇਰਾ ਰਹਿਆ ਤਪਾਵਸੁ ਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਦੇਹਿ ਤ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tihu jug keraa rahiaa tapaavas je gun dehi ta paaeeai |1| rahaau |
English: The justice of the previous three ages is gone. One obtains virtue, only if the Lord bestows it. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਲਿ ਕਲਵਾਲੀ ਸਰਾ ਨਿਬੇੜੀ ਕਾਜੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਹੋਆ ॥
Transliteration: kal kalavaalee saraa niberree kaajee krisanaa hoaa |
English: In this turbulent age of Kali Yuga, Muslim law decides the cases, and the blue-robed Qazi is the judge.

Gurbani: ਬਾਣੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬੇਦੁ ਅਥਰਬਣੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਲਹਿਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: baanee brahamaa bed atharaban karanee keerat lahiaa |5|
English: The Guru's Bani has taken the place of Brahma's Veda, and the singing of the Lord's Praises are good deeds. ||5||

Gurbani: ਪਤਿ ਵਿਣੁ ਪੂਜਾ ਸਤ ਵਿਣੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਜਤ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਾਹੇ ਜਨੇਊ ॥
Transliteration: pat vin poojaa sat vin sanjam jat vin kaahe janeaoo |
English: Worship without faith; self-discipline without truthfulness; the ritual of the sacred thread without chastity - what good are these?

Gurbani: ਨਾਵਹੁ ਧੋਵਹੁ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਚੜਾਵਹੁ ਸੁਚ ਵਿਣੁ ਸੋਚ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: naavahu dhovahu tilak charraavahu such vin soch na hoee |6|
English: You may bathe and wash, and apply a ritualistic tilak mark to your forehead, but without inner purity, there is no understanding. ||6||

Gurbani: ਕਲਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਕਤੇਬ ਕੁਰਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: kal paravaan kateb kuraan |
English: In Kali Yuga, the Koran and the Bible have become famous.

Gurbani: ਪੋਥੀ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਰਹੇ ਪੁਰਾਣ ॥
Transliteration: pothee panddit rahe puraan |
English: The Pandit's scriptures and the Puraanas are not respected.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਉ ਭਇਆ ਰਹਮਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak naau bheaa rahamaan |
English: O Nanak, the Lord's Name now is Rehmaan, the Merciful.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਤੂ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: kar karataa too eko jaan |7|
English: Know that there is only One Creator of the creation. ||7||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਏਦੂ ਉਪਰਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਨਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: naanak naam milai vaddiaaee edoo upar karam nahee |
English: Nanak has obtained the glorious greatness of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. There is no action higher than this.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਘਰਿ ਹੋਦੈ ਮੰਗਣਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਫਿਰਿ ਓਲਾਮਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਹੀ ॥੮॥੧॥
Transliteration: je ghar hodai mangan jaaeeai fir olaamaa milai tahee |8|1|
English: If someone goes out to beg for what is already in his own home, then he should be chastised. ||8||1||

[Ang 903 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 1 |
English: Raamkalee, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਗੁ ਪਰਬੋਧਹਿ ਮੜੀ ਬਧਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jag parabodheh marree badhaaveh |
English: You preach to the world, and set up your house.

Gurbani: ਆਸਣੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: aasan tiaag kaahe sach paaveh |
English: Abandoning your Yogic postures, how will you find the True Lord?

Gurbani: ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਹਿਤਕਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: mamataa mohu kaaman hitakaaree |
English: You are attached to possessiveness and the love of sexual pleasure.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਅਉਧੂਤੀ ਨਾ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naa aaudhootee naa sansaaree |1|
English: You are not a renunciate, nor a man of the world. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੋਗੀ ਬੈਸਿ ਰਹਹੁ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: jogee bais rahahu dubidhaa dukh bhaagai |
English: Yogi, remain seated, and the pain of duality will run away from you.

Gurbani: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮਾਗਤ ਲਾਜ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ghar ghar maagat laaj na laagai |1| rahaau |
English: You beg from door to door, and you don't feel ashamed. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗੀਤ ਨ ਚੀਨਹਿ ਆਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: gaaveh geet na cheeneh aap |
English: You sing the songs, but you do not understand your own self.

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਲਾਗੀ ਨਿਵਰੈ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: kiau laagee nivarai parataap |
English: How will the burning pain within be relieved?

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਚੈ ਮਨ ਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad rachai man bhaae |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, let your mind be absorbed in the Lord's Love,

Gurbani: ਭਿਖਿਆ ਸਹਜ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਖਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bhikhiaa sehaj veechaaree khaae |2|
English: and you will intuitively experience the charity of contemplation. ||2||

Gurbani: ਭਸਮ ਚੜਾਇ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ॥
Transliteration: bhasam charraae kareh paakhandd |
English: You apply ashes to your body, while acting in hypocrisy.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਹਹਿ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohi saheh jam ddandd |
English: Attached to Maya, you will be beaten by Death's heavy club.

Gurbani: ਫੂਟੈ ਖਾਪਰੁ ਭੀਖ ਨ ਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: foottai khaapar bheekh na bhaae |
English: Your begging bowl is broken; it will not hold the charity of the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਬੰਧਨਿ ਬਾਧਿਆ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bandhan baadhiaa aavai jaae |3|
English: Bound in bondage, you come and go. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬਿੰਦੁ ਨ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਜਤੀ ਕਹਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: bind na raakheh jatee kahaaveh |
English: You do not control your seed and semen, and yet you claim to practice abstinence.

Gurbani: ਮਾਈ ਮਾਗਤ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਲੋਭਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: maaee maagat trai lobhaaveh |
English: You beg from Maya, lured by the three qualities.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਦਇਆ ਨਹੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਉਜਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: niradeaa nahee jot ujaalaa |
English: You have no compassion; the Lord's Light does not shine in you.

Gurbani: ਬੂਡਤ ਬੂਡੇ ਸਰਬ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: booddat boodde sarab janjaalaa |4|
English: You are drowned, drowned in worldly entanglements. ||4||

Gurbani: ਭੇਖ ਕਰਹਿ ਖਿੰਥਾ ਬਹੁ ਥਟੂਆ ॥
Transliteration: bhekh kareh khinthaa bahu thattooaa |
English: You wear religious robes, and your patched coat assumes many disguises.

Gurbani: ਝੂਠੋ ਖੇਲੁ ਖੇਲੈ ਬਹੁ ਨਟੂਆ ॥
Transliteration: jhoottho khel khelai bahu nattooaa |
English: You play all sorts of false tricks, like a juggler.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਬਹੁ ਜਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: antar agan chintaa bahu jaare |
English: The fire of anxiety burns brightly within you.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਪਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: vin karamaa kaise utaras paare |5|
English: Without the karma of good actions, how can you cross over? ||5||

Gurbani: ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਫਟਕ ਬਨਾਈ ਕਾਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: mundraa fattak banaaee kaan |
English: You make ear-rings of glass to wear in your ears.

Gurbani: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਬਿਗਿਆਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: mukat nahee bidiaa bigiaan |
English: But liberation does not come from learning without understanding.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਸਾਦਿ ਲੋੁਭਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jihavaa indree saad luobhaanaa |
English: You are lured by the tastes of the tongue and sex organs.

Gurbani: ਪਸੂ ਭਏ ਨਹੀ ਮਿਟੈ ਨੀਸਾਨਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: pasoo bhe nahee mittai neesaanaa |6|
English: You have become a beast; this sign cannot be erased. ||6||

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਲੋਗਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਜੋਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: tribidh logaa tribidh jogaa |
English: The people of the world are entangled in the three modes; the Yogis are entangled in the three modes.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੈ ਚੂਕਸਿ ਸੋਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabad veechaarai chookas sogaa |
English: Contemplating the Word of the Shabad, sorrows are dispelled.

Gurbani: ਊਜਲੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਸੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aoojal saach su sabad hoe |
English: Through the Shabad, one becomes radiant, pure and truthful.

Gurbani: ਜੋਗੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ਸੋਇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: jogee jugat veechaare soe |7|
English: One who contemplates the true lifestyle is a Yogi. ||7||

Gurbani: ਤੁਝ ਪਹਿ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਤੂ ਕਰਣੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: tujh peh nau nidh too karanai jog |
English: The nine treasures are with You, Lord; You are potent, the Cause of causes.

Gurbani: ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: thaap uthaape kare su hog |
English: You establish and disestablish; whatever You do, happens.

Gurbani: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਚੀਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: jat sat sanjam sach sucheet |
English: One who practices celibacy, chastity, self-control, truth and pure consciousness

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋਗੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਮੀਤੁ ॥੮॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak jogee tribhavan meet |8|2|
English: - O Nanak, that Yogi is the friend of the three worlds. ||8||2||

[Ang 903 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 1 |
English: Raamkalee, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਖਟੁ ਮਟੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: khatt matt dehee man bairaagee |
English: Above the six chakras of the body dwells the detached mind.

Gurbani: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਧੁਨਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: surat sabad dhun antar jaagee |
English: Awareness of the vibration of the Word of the Shabad has been awakened deep within.

Gurbani: ਵਾਜੈ ਅਨਹਦੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: vaajai anahad meraa man leenaa |
English: The unstruck melody of the sound current resonates and resounds within; my mind is attuned to it.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਤੀਣਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur bachanee sach naam pateenaa |1|
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, my faith is confirmed in the True Name. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: praanee raam bhagat sukh paaeeai |
English: O mortal, through devotion to the Lord, peace is obtained.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh har har meetthaa laagai har har naam samaaeeai |1| rahaau |
English: The Lord, Har, Har, seems sweet to the Gurmukh, who merges in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਿਵਰਜਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohu bivaraj samaae |
English: Eradicating attachment to Maya, one merges into the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: satigur bhettai mel milaae |
English: Meeting with the True Guru, we unite in His Union.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੁ ਹੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: naam ratan niramolak heeraa |
English: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is a priceless jewel, a diamond.

Gurbani: ਤਿਤੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tit raataa meraa man dheeraa |2|
English: Attuned to it, the mind is comforted and encouraged. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: haumai mamataa rog na laagai |
English: The diseases of egotism and possessiveness do not afflict

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: raam bhagat jam kaa bhau bhaagai |
English: one who worships the Lord. Fear of the Messenger of Death runs away.

Gurbani: ਜਮੁ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਮੋਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jam jandaar na laagai mohi |
English: The Messenger of Death, the enemy of the soul, does not touch me at all.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਹਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: niramal naam ridai har sohi |3|
English: The Immaculate Name of the Lord illuminates my heart. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਭਏ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: sabad beechaar bhe nirankaaree |
English: Contemplating the Shabad, we become Nirankaari - we come to belong to the Formless Lord God.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਗੇ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਰਹਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: guramat jaage duramat parahaaree |
English: Awakening to the Guru's Teachings, evil-mindedness is taken away.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: anadin jaag rahe liv laaee |
English: Remaining awake and aware night and day, lovingly focused on the Lord,

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jeevan mukat gat antar paaee |4|
English: one becomes Jivan Mukta - liberated while yet alive. He finds this state deep within himself. ||4||

Gurbani: ਅਲਿਪਤ ਗੁਫਾ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: alipat gufaa meh raheh niraare |
English: In the secluded cave, I remain unattached.

Gurbani: ਤਸਕਰ ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੰਘਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: tasakar panch sabad sanghaare |
English: With the Word of the Shabad, I have killed the five thieves.

Gurbani: ਪਰ ਘਰ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਮਨੁ ਡੋਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: par ghar jaae na man ddolaae |
English: My mind does not waver or go to the home of any other.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਰਹਉ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: sehaj nirantar rhau samaae |5|
English: I remain intuitively absorbed deep within. ||5||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਗਿ ਰਹੇ ਅਉਧੂਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh jaag rahe aaudhootaa |
English: As Gurmukh, I remain awake and aware, unattached.

Gurbani: ਸਦ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਤਤੁ ਪਰੋਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: sad bairaagee tat parotaa |
English: Forever detached, I am woven into the essence of reality.

Gurbani: ਜਗੁ ਸੂਤਾ ਮਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jag sootaa mar aavai jaae |
English: The world is asleep; it dies, and comes and goes in reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਨ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: bin gurasabad na sojhee paae |6|
English: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it does not understand. ||6||

Gurbani: ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: anahad sabad vajai din raatee |
English: The unstruck sound current of the Shabad vibrates day and night.

Gurbani: ਅਵਿਗਤ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: avigat kee gat guramukh jaatee |
English: The Gurmukh knows the state of the eternal, unchanging Lord God.

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਜਾਨੀ ਜਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: tau jaanee jaa sabad pachhaanee |
English: When someone realizes the Shabad, then he truly knows.

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਨਿਰਬਾਨੀ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: eko rav rahiaa nirabaanee |7|
English: The One Lord is permeating and pervading everywhere in Nirvaanaa. ||7||

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: sun samaadh sehaj man raataa |
English: My mind is intuitively absorbed in the state of deepest Samaadhi;

Gurbani: ਤਜਿ ਹਉ ਲੋਭਾ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: taj hau lobhaa eko jaataa |
English: renouncing egotism and greed, I have come to know the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲੇ ਅਪਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur chele apanaa man maaniaa |
English: When the disciple's mind accepts the Guru,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੂਜਾ ਮੇਟਿ ਸਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੮॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak doojaa mett samaaniaa |8|3|
English: O Nanak, duality is eradicated, and he merges in the Lord. ||8||3||

[Ang 904 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 1 |
English: Raamkalee, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਾਹਾ ਗਣਹਿ ਨ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: saahaa ganeh na kareh beechaar |
English: You calculate the auspicious days, but you do not understand

Gurbani: ਸਾਹੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: saahe aoopar ekankaar |
English: that the One Creator Lord is above these auspicious days.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋਈ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: jis gur milai soee bidh jaanai |
English: He alone knows the way, who meets the Guru.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: guramat hoe ta hukam pachhaanai |1|
English: When one follows the Guru's Teachings, then he realizes the Hukam of God's Command. ||1||

Gurbani: ਝੂਠੁ ਨ ਬੋਲਿ ਪਾਡੇ ਸਚੁ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: jhootth na bol paadde sach kaheeai |
English: Do not tell lies, O Pandit; O religious scholar, speak the Truth.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ਸਬਦਿ ਘਰੁ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: haumai jaae sabad ghar laheeai |1| rahaau |
English: When egotism is eradicated through the Word of the Shabad, then one finds His home. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗਣਿ ਗਣਿ ਜੋਤਕੁ ਕਾਂਡੀ ਕੀਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: gan gan jotak kaanddee keenee |
English: Calculating and counting, the astrologer draws the horoscope.

Gurbani: ਪੜੈ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: parrai sunaavai tat na cheenee |
English: He studies it and announces it, but he does not understand reality.

Gurbani: ਸਭਸੈ ਊਪਰਿ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sabhasai aoopar gurasabad beechaar |
English: Understand, that the Word of the Guru's Shabad is above all.

Gurbani: ਹੋਰ ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਉ ਨ ਸਗਲੀ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: hor kathanee bdau na sagalee chhaar |2|
English: Do not speak of anything else; it is all just ashes. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਾਵਹਿ ਧੋਵਹਿ ਪੂਜਹਿ ਸੈਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: naaveh dhoveh poojeh sailaa |
English: You bathe, wash, and worship stones.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਮੈਲੋ ਮੈਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: bin har raate mailo mailaa |
English: But without being imbued with the Lord, you are the filthiest of the filthy.

Gurbani: ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਰਥਿ ॥
Transliteration: garab nivaar milai prabh saarath |
English: Subduing your pride, you shall receive the supreme wealth of God.

Gurbani: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਤਾਰਥਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: mukat praan jap har kirataarath |3|
English: The mortal is liberated and emancipated, meditating on the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਵਾਚੈ ਵਾਦੁ ਨ ਬੇਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: vaachai vaad na bed beechaarai |
English: You study the arguments, but do not contemplate the Vedas.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਡੁਬੈ ਕਿਉ ਪਿਤਰਾ ਤਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: aap ddubai kiau pitaraa taarai |
English: You drown yourself - how will you save your ancestors?

Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਚੀਨੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt braham cheenai jan koe |
English: How rare is that person who realizes that God is in each and every heart.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: satigur milai ta sojhee hoe |4|
English: When one meets the True Guru, then he understands. ||4||

Gurbani: ਗਣਤ ਗਣੀਐ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਜੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: ganat ganeeai sahasaa dukh jeeai |
English: Making his calculations, cynicism and suffering afflict his soul.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਵੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਥੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: gur kee saran pavai sukh theeai |
English: Seeking the Sanctuary of the Guru, peace is found.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਅਪਰਾਧ ਸਰਣਿ ਹਮ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kar aparaadh saran ham aaeaa |
English: I sinned and made mistakes, but now I seek Your Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟੇ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: gur har bhette purab kamaaeaa |5|
English: The Guru led me to meet the Lord, according to my past actions. ||5||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਨ ਆਈਐ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: gur saran na aaeeai braham na paaeeai |
English: If one does not enter the Guru's Sanctuary, God cannot be found.

Gurbani: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈਐ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰਿ ਆਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: bharam bhulaaeeai janam mar aaeeai |
English: Deluded by doubt, one is born, only to die, and come back again.

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਾਧਉ ਮਰੈ ਬਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jam dar baadhau marai bikaar |
English: Dying in corruption, he is bound and gagged at Death's door.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਚਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: naa ridai naam na sabad achaar |6|
English: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is not in his heart, and he does not act according to the Shabad. ||6||

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਪਾਧੇ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮਿਸਰ ਕਹਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: eik paadhe panddit misar kahaaveh |
English: Some call themselves Pandits, religious scholars and spiritual teachers.

Gurbani: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਰਾਤੇ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: dubidhaa raate mehal na paaveh |
English: Tinged with double-mindedness, they do not find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jis gur parasaadee naam adhaar |
English: One who takes the Support of the Naam, by Guru's Grace,

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਕੋ ਜਨੁ ਆਪਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: kott madhe ko jan aapaar |7|
English: is a rare person, one among millions, incomparable. ||7||

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਸਚੁ ਏਕੈ ॥
Transliteration: ek buraa bhalaa sach ekai |
English: One is bad, and another good, but the One True Lord is contained in all.

Gurbani: ਬੂਝੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਟੇਕੈ ॥
Transliteration: boojh giaanee satagur kee ttekai |
English: Understand this, O spiritual teacher, through the support of the True Guru:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੀ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh viralee eko jaaniaa |
English: rare indeed is that Gurmukh, who realizes the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣਾ ਮੇਟਿ ਸਮਾਣਿਆ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: aavan jaanaa mett samaaniaa |8|
English: His comings and goings cease, and he merges in the Lord. ||8||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jin kai hiradai ekankaar |
English: Those who have the One Universal Creator Lord within their hearts,

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sarab gunee saachaa beechaar |
English: possess all virtues; they contemplate the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai bhaanai karam kamaavai |
English: One who acts in harmony with the Guru's Will,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੯॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak saache saach samaavai |9|4|
English: O Nanak, is absorbed in the Truest of the True. ||9||4||

[Ang 905 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 1 |
English: Raamkalee, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਠੁ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਛੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: hatth nigrahu kar kaaeaa chheejai |
English: Practicing restraint by Hatha Yoga, the body wears away.

Gurbani: ਵਰਤੁ ਤਪਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: varat tapan kar man nahee bheejai |
English: The mind is not softened by fasting or austerities.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਪੂਜੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: raam naam sar avar na poojai |1|
English: Nothing else is equal to worship of the Lord's Name. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਮਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸੰਗੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur sev manaa har jan sang keejai |
English: Serve the Guru, O mind, and associate with the humble servants of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਮੁ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨਹੀ ਸਾਕੈ ਸਰਪਨਿ ਡਸਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jam jandaar johi nahee saakai sarapan ddas na sakai har kaa ras peejai |1| rahaau |
English: The tyrannical Messenger of Death cannot touch you, and the serpent of Maya cannot sting you, when you drink in the sublime essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਵਾਦੁ ਪੜੈ ਰਾਗੀ ਜਗੁ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: vaad parrai raagee jag bheejai |
English: The world reads the arguments, and is softened only by music.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: trai gun bikhiaa janam mareejai |
English: In the three modes and corruption, they are born and die.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਸਹੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: raam naam bin dookh saheejai |2|
English: Without the Lord's Name, they endure suffering and pain. ||2||

Gurbani: ਚਾੜਸਿ ਪਵਨੁ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: chaarras pavan singhaasan bheejai |
English: The Yogi draws the breath upwards, and opens the Tenth Gate.

Gurbani: ਨਿਉਲੀ ਕਰਮ ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: niaulee karam khatt karam kareejai |
English: He practices inner cleansing and the six rituals of purification.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਸਾਸੁ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: raam naam bin birathaa saas leejai |3|
English: But without the Lord's Name, the breath he draws is useless. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪੰਚ ਅਗਨਿ ਕਿਉ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਧੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: antar panch agan kiau dheeraj dheejai |
English: The fire of the five passions burns within him; how can he be calm?

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚੋਰੁ ਕਿਉ ਸਾਦੁ ਲਹੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: antar chor kiau saad laheejai |
English: The thief is within him; how can he taste the taste?

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਕਾਇਆ ਗੜੁ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: guramukh hoe kaaeaa garr leejai |4|
English: One who becomes Gurmukh conquers the body-fortress. ||4||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਤੀਰਥ ਭਰਮੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: antar mail teerath bharameejai |
English: With filth within, he wanders around at places of pilgrimage.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਸੂਚਾ ਕਿਆ ਸੋਚ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: man nahee soochaa kiaa soch kareejai |
English: His mind is not pure, so what is the use of performing ritual cleansings?

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਤੁ ਪਇਆ ਦੋਸੁ ਕਾ ਕਉ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: kirat peaa dos kaa kau deejai |5|
English: He carries the karma of his own past actions; who else can he blame? ||5||

Gurbani: ਅੰਨੁ ਨ ਖਾਹਿ ਦੇਹੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: an na khaeh dehee dukh deejai |
English: He does not eat food; he tortures his body.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਥੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: bin gur giaan tripat nahee theejai |
English: Without the Guru's wisdom, he is not satisfied.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੀਜੈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: manamukh janamai janam mareejai |6|
English: The self-willed manmukh is born only to die, and be born again. ||6||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਛਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur poochh sangat jan keejai |
English: Go, and ask the True Guru, and associate with the Lord's humble servants.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਚੈ ਨਹੀ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: man har raachai nahee janam mareejai |
English: Your mind shall merge into the Lord, and you shall not be reincarnated to die again.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਮੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: raam naam bin kiaa karam keejai |7|
English: Without the Lord's Name, what can anyone do? ||7||

Gurbani: ਊਂਦਰ ਦੂੰਦਰ ਪਾਸਿ ਧਰੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: aoondar doondar paas dhareejai |
English: Silence the mouse scurrying around within you.

Gurbani: ਧੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: dhur kee sevaa raam raveejai |
English: Serve the Primal Lord, by chanting the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੮॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak naam milai kirapaa prabh keejai |8|5|
English: O Nanak, God blesses us with His Name, when He grants His Grace. ||8||5||

[Ang 905 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 1 |
English: Raamkalee, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਉਤਭੁਜੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: antar utabhuj avar na koee |
English: The created Universe emanated from within You; there is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jo kaheeai so prabh te hoee |
English: Whatever is said to be, is from You, O God.

Gurbani: ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jugah jugantar saahib sach soee |
English: He is the True Lord and Master, throughout the ages.

Gurbani: ਉਤਪਤਿ ਪਰਲਉ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: autapat parlau avar na koee |1|
English: Creation and destruction do not come from anyone else. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa meraa tthaakur gahir ganbheer |
English: Such is my Lord and Master, profound and unfathomable.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਜਮ ਤੀਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jin japiaa tin hee sukh paaeaa har kai naam na lagai jam teer |1| rahaau |
English: Whoever meditates on Him, finds peace. The arrow of the Messenger of Death does not strike one who has the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਹੀਰਾ ਨਿਰਮੋਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: naam ratan heeraa niramol |
English: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is a priceless jewel, a diamond.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅਮਰੁ ਅਤੋਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: saachaa saahib amar atol |
English: The True Lord Master is immortal and immeasurable.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਸੂਚੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਬੋਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: jihavaa soochee saachaa bol |
English: That tongue which chants the True Name is pure.

Gurbani: ਘਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਰੋਲੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ghar dar saachaa naahee rol |2|
English: The True Lord is in the home of the self; there is no doubt about it. ||2||

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਬਨ ਮਹਿ ਬੈਸਹਿ ਡੂਗਰਿ ਅਸਥਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: eik ban meh baiseh ddoogar asathaan |
English: Some sit in the forests, and some make their home in the mountains.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਪਚਹਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: naam bisaar pacheh abhimaan |
English: Forgetting the Naam, they rot away in egotistical pride.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕਿਆ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: naam binaa kiaa giaan dhiaan |
English: Without the Naam, what is the use of spiritual wisdom and meditation?

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: guramukh paaveh darageh maan |3|
English: The Gurmukhs are honored in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਠੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਕਰੈ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: hatth ahankaar karai nahee paavai |
English: Acting stubbornly in egotism, one does not find the Lord.

Gurbani: ਪਾਠ ਪੜੈ ਲੇ ਲੋਕ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: paatth parrai le lok sunaavai |
English: Studying the scriptures, reading them to other people,

Gurbani: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਭਰਮਸਿ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: teerath bharamas biaadh na jaavai |
English: and wandering around at places of pilgrimage, the disease is not taken away.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: naam binaa kaise sukh paavai |4|
English: Without the Naam, how can one find peace? ||4||

Gurbani: ਜਤਨ ਕਰੈ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਕਿਵੈ ਨ ਰਹਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jatan karai bind kivai na rahaaee |
English: No matter how much he tries, he cannot control his semen and seed.

Gurbani: ਮਨੂਆ ਡੋਲੈ ਨਰਕੇ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: manooaa ddolai narake paaee |
English: His mind wavers, and he falls into hell.

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਾਧੋ ਲਹੈ ਸਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jam pur baadho lahai sajaaee |
English: Bound and gagged in the City of Death, he is tortured.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ ਜਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: bin naavai jeeo jal bal jaaee |5|
English: Without the Name, his soul cries out in agony. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਕੇਤੇ ਮੁਨਿ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: sidh saadhik kete mun devaa |
English: The many Siddhas and seekers, silent sages and demi-gods

Gurbani: ਹਠਿ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵਹਿ ਭੇਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: hatth nigreh na tripataaveh bhevaa |
English: cannot satisfy themselves by practicing restraint through Hatha Yoga.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਗਹਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabad veechaar gaheh gur sevaa |
English: One who contemplates the Word of the Shabad, and serves the Guru

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ਅਭੇਵਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: man tan niramal abhimaan abhevaa |6|
English: - his mind and body become immaculate, and his egotistical pride is obliterated. ||6||

Gurbani: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਾਵੈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: karam milai paavai sach naau |
English: Blessed with Your Grace, I obtain the True Name.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਰਹਉ ਸੁਭਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tum saranaagat rhau subhaau |
English: I remain in Your Sanctuary, in loving devotion.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਭਗਤੀ ਭਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tum te upajio bhagatee bhaau |
English: Love for Your devotional worship has welled up within me.

Gurbani: ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਉ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: jap jaapau guramukh har naau |7|
English: As Gurmukh, I chant and meditate on the Lord's Name. ||7||

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਜਾਇ ਮਨ ਭੀਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: haumai garab jaae man bheenai |
English: When one is rid of egotism and pride, his mind is drenched in the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਝੂਠਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਸਿ ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਕੀਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: jhootth na paavas paakhandd keenai |
English: Practicing fraud and hypocrisy, he does not find God.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਨਹੀ ਘਰੁ ਬਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: bin gurasabad nahee ghar baar |
English: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he cannot find the Lord's Door.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੮॥੬॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh tat beechaar |8|6|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh contemplates the essence of reality. ||8||6||

[Ang 906 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 1 |
English: Raamkalee, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਉ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਬਉਰੇ ਜਿਉ ਜਨਮੇ ਤਿਉ ਮਰਣੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jiau aaeaa tiau jaaveh baure jiau janame tiau maran bheaa |
English: As you come, so will you leave, you fool; as you were born, so will you die.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਕੀਏ ਤੇਤਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਭਵਜਲਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jiau ras bhog kee tetaa dukh laagai naam visaar bhavajal peaa |1|
English: As you enjoy pleasures, so will you suffer pain. Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, you will fall into the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਦੇਖਤ ਗਰਬਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tan dhan dekhat garab geaa |
English: Gazing upon your body and wealth, you are so proud.

Gurbani: ਕਨਿਕ ਕਾਮਨੀ ਸਿਉ ਹੇਤੁ ਵਧਾਇਹਿ ਕੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਹਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਗਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kanik kaamanee siau het vadhaaeihi kee naam visaareh bharam geaa |1| rahaau |
English: Your love for gold and sexual pleasures increases; why have you forgotten the Naam, and why do you wander in doubt? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸੀਲੁ ਨ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਪਿੰਜਰ ਮਹਿ ਕਾਸਟੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jat sat sanjam seel na raakhiaa pret pinjar meh kaasatt bheaa |
English: You do not practice truth, abstinence, self-discipline or humility; the ghost within your skeleton has turned to dry wood.

Gurbani: ਪੁੰਨੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਨ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਾਦਿ ਜਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: pun daan isanaan na sanjam saadhasangat bin baad jeaa |2|
English: You have not practiced charity, donations, cleansing baths or austerities. Without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, your life has gone in vain. ||2||

Gurbani: ਲਾਲਚਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਓ ਆਵਤ ਜਾਵਤ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: laalach laagai naam bisaario aavat jaavat janam geaa |
English: Attached to greed, you have forgotten the Naam. Coming and going, your life has been ruined.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਜਮੁ ਧਾਇ ਕੇਸ ਗਹਿ ਮਾਰੈ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਲ ਗਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jaa jam dhaae kes geh maarai surat nahee mukh kaal geaa |3|
English: When the Messenger of Death grabs you by your hair, you will be punished. You are unconscious, and have fallen into Death's mouth. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਤਾਤਿ ਪਰਾਈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਸਰਬ ਦਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: ahinis nindaa taat paraaee hiradai naam na sarab deaa |
English: Day and night, you jealously slander others; in your heart, you have neither the Naam, nor compassion for all.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਨ ਗਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਰਕਿ ਗਇਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: bin gurasabad na gat pat paaveh raam naam bin narak geaa |4|
English: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, you will not find salvation or honor. Without the Lord's Name, you shall go to hell. ||4||

Gurbani: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਵੇਸ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਟੂਆ ਜਿਉ ਮੋਹ ਪਾਪ ਮਹਿ ਗਲਤੁ ਗਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: khin meh ves kareh nattooaa jiau moh paap meh galat geaa |
English: In an instant, you change into various costumes, like a juggler; you are entangled in emotional attachment and sin.

Gurbani: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਸਾਰੀ ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਮਗਨੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: eit ut maaeaa dekh pasaaree moh maaeaa kai magan bheaa |5|
English: You gaze here and there upon the expanse of Maya; you are intoxicated with attachment to Maya. ||5||

Gurbani: ਕਰਹਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਵਿਥਾਰ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਪਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kareh bikaar vithaar ghanere surat sabad bin bharam peaa |
English: You act in corruption, and put on ostentatious shows, but without awareness of the Shabad, you have fallen into confusion.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: haumai rog mahaa dukh laagaa guramat levahu rog geaa |6|
English: You suffer great pain from the disease of egotism. Following the Guru's Teachings, you shall be rid of this disease. ||6||
