Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਕਉ ਆਵਤ ਦੇਖੈ ਸਾਕਤ ਮਨਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sukh sanpat kau aavat dekhai saakat man abhimaan bheaa |
English: Seeing peace and wealth come to him, the faithless cynic become proud in his mind.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੋ ਫਿਰਿ ਲੇਵੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਪਇਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: jis kaa ihu tan dhan so fir levai antar sahasaa dookh peaa |7|
English: But He who owns this body and wealth, takes them back again, and then the mortal feels anxiety and pain deep within. ||7||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਮਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: ant kaal kichh saath na chaalai jo deesai sabh tiseh meaa |
English: At the very last instant, nothing goes along with you; all is visible only by His Mercy.

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਲੈ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: aad purakh aparanpar so prabh har naam ridai lai paar peaa |8|
English: God is our Primal and Infinite Lord; enshrining the Lord's Name in the heart, one crosses over. ||8||

Gurbani: ਮੂਏ ਕਉ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਕਿਸਹਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਹਿ ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰ ਅਸਰਾਲਿ ਪਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: mooe kau roveh kiseh sunaaveh bhai saagar asaraal peaa |
English: You weep for the dead, but who hears you weeping? The dead have fallen to the serpent in the terrifying world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਦੇਖਿ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਸਾਕਤੁ ਜੰਜਾਲਿ ਪਰਾਲਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: dekh kuttanb maaeaa grih mandar saakat janjaal paraal peaa |9|
English: Gazing upon his family, wealth, household and mansions, the faithless cynic is entangled in worthless worldly affairs. ||9||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਆਏ ਤਾ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਪਠਾਏ ਚਾਲੇ ਤਿਨੈ ਬੁਲਾਇ ਲਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jaa aae taa tineh patthaae chaale tinai bulaae leaa |
English: He comes when the Lord sends him; when the Lord calls him back, he goes.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੋ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੈ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: jo kichh karanaa so kar rahiaa bakhasanahaarai bakhas leaa |10|
English: Whatever he does, the Lord is doing. The Forgiving Lord forgives him. ||10||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਖੋਜੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jin ehu chaakhiaa raam rasaaein tin kee sangat khoj bheaa |
English: I seek to be with those who have tasted this sublime essence of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: ridh sidh budh giaan guroo te paaeaa mukat padaarath saran peaa |11|
English: Wealth, miraculous spiritual powers, wisdom and spiritual knowledge, are obtained from the Guru. The treasure of liberation is obtained in His Sanctuary. ||11||

Gurbani: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣਾ ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਤੇ ਬਿਰਕਤੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: dukh sukh guramukh sam kar jaanaa harakh sog te birakat bheaa |
English: The Gurmukh looks upon pain and pleasure as one and the same; he remains untouched by joy and sorrow.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਲਇਆ ॥੧੨॥੭॥
Transliteration: aap maar guramukh har paae naanak sehaj samaae leaa |12|7|
English: Conquering his self-conceit, the Gurmukh finds the Lord; O Nanak, he intuitively merges into the Lord. ||12||7||

[Ang 907 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਦਖਣੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee dakhanee mahalaa 1 |
English: Raamkalee, Dakhanee, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਸਿ ਲੀਣਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jat sat sanjam saach drirraaeaa saach sabad ras leenaa |1|
English: Abstinence, chastity, self-control and truthfulness have been implanted within me; I am imbued with the sublime essence of the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਲੀਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: meraa gur deaal sadaa rang leenaa |
English: My Merciful Guru remains forever imbued with the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਰਹੈ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਤੀਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ahinis rahai ek liv laagee saache dekh pateenaa |1| rahaau |
English: Day and night, He remains lovingly focused on the One Lord; gazing upon the True Lord, He is pleased. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਰਹੈ ਗਗਨ ਪੁਰਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਮੈਸਰਿ ਅਨਹਤ ਸਬਦਿ ਰੰਗੀਣਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: rahai gagan pur drisatt samaisar anahat sabad rangeenaa |2|
English: He abides in the Tenth Gate, and looks equally upon all; He is imbued with the unstruck sound current of the Shabad. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਤੁ ਬੰਧਿ ਕੁਪੀਨ ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਲੀਣਾ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਸੀਣਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sat bandh kupeen bharipur leenaa jihavaa rang raseenaa |3|
English: Wearing the loin-cloth of chastity, He remains absorbed in the all-pervading Lord; His tongue enjoys the taste of God's Love. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਚੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚੁ ਰਾਚੇ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਪਤੀਣਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: milai gur saache jin rach raache kirat veechaar pateenaa |4|
English: The One who created the creation has met the True Guru; contemplating the Guru's lifestyle, He is pleased. ||4||

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਮਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਸਰਬ ਮਹਿ ਏਕਾ ਏਹ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: ek meh sarab sarab meh ekaa eeh satigur dekh dikhaaee |5|
English: All are in the One, and the One is in all. This is what the True Guru has shown me. ||5||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਏ ਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡਾ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਖਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: jin kee khandd manddal brahamanddaa so prabh lakhan na jaaee |6|
English: He who created the worlds, solar systems and galaxies - that God cannot be known. ||6||

Gurbani: ਦੀਪਕ ਤੇ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਜੋਤਿ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: deepak te deepak paragaasiaa tribhavan jot dikhaaee |7|
English: From the lamp of God, the lamp within is lit; the Divine Light illuminates the three worlds. ||7||

Gurbani: ਸਚੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਸਚ ਮਹਲੀ ਬੈਠੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: sachai takhat sach mahalee baitthe nirbhau taarree laaee |8|
English: The Guru sits on the true throne in the true mansion; He is attuned, absorbed in the Fearless Lord. ||8||

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਗਇਆ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਜੋਗੀ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਵਾਈ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: mohi geaa bairaagee jogee ghatt ghatt kinguree vaaee |9|
English: The Guru, the detached Yogi, has enticed the hearts of all; He plays His harp in each and every heart. ||9||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕੀ ਛੂਟੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਚੁ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੧੦॥੮॥
Transliteration: naanak saran prabhoo kee chhootte satigur sach sakhaaee |10|8|
English: O Nanak, in God's Sanctuary, one is emancipated; the True Guru becomes our true help and support. ||10||8||

[Ang 907 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 1 |
English: Raamkalee, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਉਹਠਿ ਹਸਤ ਮੜੀ ਘਰੁ ਛਾਇਆ ਧਰਣਿ ਗਗਨ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aauhatth hasat marree ghar chhaaeaa dharan gagan kal dhaaree |1|
English: He has made His home in the monastery of the heart; He has infused His power into the earth and the sky. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੇਤੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਉਧਾਰੀ ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh ketee sabad udhaaree santahu |1| rahaau |
English: Through the Word of the Shabad, the Gurmukhs have saved so very many, O Saints. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਮਤਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਸੋਖੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mamataa maar haumai sokhai tribhavan jot tumaaree |2|
English: He conquers attachment, and eradicates egotism, and sees Your Divine Light pervading the three worlds, Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨੈ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: manasaa maar manai meh raakhai satigur sabad veechaaree |3|
English: He conquers desire, and enshrines the Lord within his mind; he contemplates the Word of the True Guru's Shabad. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਿੰਙੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਅਨਾਹਦਿ ਵਾਜੈ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: singee surat anaahad vaajai ghatt ghatt jot tumaaree |4|
English: The horn of consciousness vibrates the unstruck sound current; Your Light illuminates each and every heart, Lord. ||4||

Gurbani: ਪਰਪੰਚ ਬੇਣੁ ਤਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਗਨਿ ਪਰਜਾਰੀ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: parapanch ben tahee man raakhiaa braham agan parajaaree |5|
English: He plays the flute of the universe in his mind, and lights the fire of God. ||5||

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: panch tat mil ahinis deepak niramal jot apaaree |6|
English: Bringing together the five elements, day and night, the Lord's lamp shines with the Immaculate Light of the Infinite. ||6||

Gurbani: ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਲਉਕੇ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਵਾਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: rav sas lauke ihu tan kinguree vaajai sabad niraaree |7|
English: The right and left nostrils, the sun and the moon channels, are the strings of the body-harp; they vibrate the wondrous melody of the Shabad. ||7||

Gurbani: ਸਿਵ ਨਗਰੀ ਮਹਿ ਆਸਣੁ ਅਉਧੂ ਅਲਖੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੀ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: siv nagaree meh aasan aaudhoo alakh agam apaaree |8|
English: The true hermit obtains a seat in the City of God, the invisible, inaccessible, infinite. ||8||

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਪੰਚ ਵਸਹਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa nagaree ihu man raajaa panch vaseh veechaaree |9|
English: The mind is the king of the city of the body; the five sources of knowledge dwell within it. ||9||

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਵੈ ਆਸਣਿ ਘਰਿ ਰਾਜਾ ਅਦਲੁ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: sabad ravai aasan ghar raajaa adal kare gunakaaree |10|
English: Seated in his home, this king chants the Shabad; he administers justice and virtue. ||10||

Gurbani: ਕਾਲੁ ਬਿਕਾਲੁ ਕਹੇ ਕਹਿ ਬਪੁਰੇ ਜੀਵਤ ਮੂਆ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: kaal bikaal kahe keh bapure jeevat mooaa man maaree |11|
English: What can poor death or birth say to him? Conquering his mind, he remains dead while yet alive. ||11||

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸ ਇਕ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਾਰੀ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: brahamaa bisan mahes ik moorat aape karataa kaaree |12|
English: Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva are manifestations of the One God. He Himself is the Doer of deeds. ||12||

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਸੋਧਿ ਤਰੈ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਆਤਮ ਤਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa sodh tarai bhav saagar aatam tat veechaaree |13|
English: One who purifies his body, crosses over the terrifying world-ocean; he contemplates the essence of his own soul. ||13||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: gur sevaa te sadaa sukh paaeaa antar sabad raviaa gunakaaree |14|
English: Serving the Guru, he finds everlasting peace; deep within, the Shabad permeates him, coloring him with virtue. ||14||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: aape mel le gunadaataa haumai trisanaa maaree |15|
English: The Giver of virtue unites with Himself, one who conquers egotism and desire. ||15||

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮੇਟੇ ਚਉਥੈ ਵਰਤੈ ਏਹਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: trai gun mette chauthai varatai ehaa bhagat niraaree |16|
English: Eradicating the three qualities, dwell in the fourth state. This is the unparalleled devotional worship. ||16||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋਗ ਸਬਦਿ ਆਤਮੁ ਚੀਨੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਏਕੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: guramukh jog sabad aatam cheenai hiradai ek muraaree |17|
English: This is the Yoga of the Gurmukh: Through the Shabad, he understands his own soul, and he enshrines within his heart the One Lord. ||17||

Gurbani: ਮਨੂਆ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਰਾਤਾ ਏਹਾ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: manooaa asathir sabade raataa ehaa karanee saaree |18|
English: Imbued with the Shabad, his mind becomes steady and stable; this is the most excellent action. ||18||

Gurbani: ਬੇਦੁ ਬਾਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਅਉਧੂ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: bed baad na paakhandd aaudhoo guramukh sabad beechaaree |19|
English: This true hermit does not enter into religious debates or hypocrisy; the Gurmukh contemplates the Shabad. ||19||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋਗੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਅਉਧੂ ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: guramukh jog kamaavai aaudhoo jat sat sabad veechaaree |20|
English: The Gurmukh practices Yoga - he is the true hermit; he practices abstinence and truth, and contemplates the Shabad. ||20||

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਅਉਧੂ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨੧॥
Transliteration: sabad marai man maare aaudhoo jog jugat veechaaree |21|
English: One who dies in the Shabad and conquers his mind is the true hermit; he understands the Way of Yoga. ||21||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਹੈ ਅਵਧੂ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਰੈ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੀ ॥੨੨॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohu bhavajal hai avadhoo sabad tarai kul taaree |22|
English: Attachment to Maya is the terrifying world-ocean; through the Shabad, the true hermit saves himself, and his ancestors as well. ||22||

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਸੂਰ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਅਉਧੂ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨੩॥
Transliteration: sabad soor jug chaare aaudhoo baanee bhagat veechaaree |23|
English: Contemplating the Shabad, you shall be a hero throughout the four ages, O hermit; contemplate the Word of the Guru's Bani in devotion. ||23||

Gurbani: ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਅਉਧੂ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨੪॥
Transliteration: ehu man maaeaa mohiaa aaudhoo nikasai sabad veechaaree |24|
English: This mind is enticed by Maya, O hermit; contemplating the Shabad, you shall find release. ||24||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੨੫॥੯॥
Transliteration: aape bakhase mel milaae naanak saran tumaaree |25|9|
English: He Himself forgives, and unites in His Union; Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary, Lord. ||25||9||

[Ang 908 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 3 asattapadeea |
English: Raamkalee, Third Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸਰਮੈ ਦੀਆ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਕੰਨੀ ਪਾਇ ਜੋਗੀ ਖਿੰਥਾ ਕਰਿ ਤੂ ਦਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: saramai deea mundraa kanee paae jogee khinthaa kar too deaa |
English: Make humility your ear-rings, Yogi, and compassion your patched coat.

Gurbani: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਬਿਭੂਤਿ ਲਾਇ ਜੋਗੀ ਤਾ ਤੀਨਿ ਭਵਣ ਜਿਣਿ ਲਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aavan jaan bibhoot laae jogee taa teen bhavan jin leaa |1|
English: Let coming and going be the ashes you apply to your body, Yogi, and then you shall conquer the three worlds. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸੀ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਵਜਾਇ ਜੋਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: aisee kinguree vajaae jogee |
English: Play that harp, Yogi,

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਅਨਹਦੁ ਵਾਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jit kinguree anahad vaajai har siau rahai liv laae |1| rahaau |
English: which vibrates the unstruck sound current, and remain lovingly absorbed in the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਪਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਝੋਲੀ ਜੋਗੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sat santokh pat kar jholee jogee amrit naam bhugat paaee |
English: Make truth and contentment your plate and pouch, Yogi; take the Ambrosial Naam as your food.

Gurbani: ਧਿਆਨ ਕਾ ਕਰਿ ਡੰਡਾ ਜੋਗੀ ਸਿੰਙੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਵਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: dhiaan kaa kar ddanddaa jogee singee surat vajaaee |2|
English: Make meditation your walking stick, Yogi, and make higher consciousness the horn you blow. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਆਸਣਿ ਬੈਸੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਤਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਲਪਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: man drirr kar aasan bais jogee taa teree kalapanaa jaaee |
English: Make your stable mind the Yogic posture you sit in, Yogi, and then you shall be rid of your tormenting desires.

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰੀ ਮਹਿ ਮੰਗਣਿ ਚੜਹਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa nagaree meh mangan charreh jogee taa naam palai paaee |3|
English: Go begging in the village of the body, Yogi, and then, you shall obtain the Naam in your lap. ||3||

Gurbani: ਇਤੁ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਜੋਗੀ ਨਾ ਸਚੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: eit kinguree dhiaan na laagai jogee naa sach palai paae |
English: This harp does not center you in meditation, Yogi, nor does it bring the True Name into your lap.

Gurbani: ਇਤੁ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜੋਗੀ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: eit kinguree saant na aavai jogee abhimaan na vichahu jaae |4|
English: This harp does not bring you peace, Yogi, nor eliminate egotism from within you. ||4||

Gurbani: ਭਉ ਭਾਉ ਦੁਇ ਪਤ ਲਾਇ ਜੋਗੀ ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਡੰਡੀ ॥
Transliteration: bhau bhaau due pat laae jogee ihu sareer kar ddanddee |
English: Make the Fear of God, and the Love of God, the two gourds of your lute, Yogi, and make this body its neck.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਤੰਤੀ ਵਾਜੈ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਖੰਡੀ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: guramukh hoveh taa tantee vaajai in bidh trisanaa khanddee |5|
English: Become Gurmukh, and then vibrate the strings; in this way, your desires shall depart. ||5||

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੁਝੈ ਸੋ ਜੋਗੀ ਕਹੀਐ ਏਕਸ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: hukam bujhai so jogee kaheeai ekas siau chit laae |
English: One who understands the Hukam of the Lord's Command is called a Yogi; he links his consciousness to the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਹਸਾ ਤੂਟੈ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਇਵ ਪਾਏ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: sahasaa toottai niramal hovai jog jugat iv paae |6|
English: His cynicism is dispelled, and he becomes immaculately pure; this is how he finds the Way of Yoga. ||6||

Gurbani: ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵਦਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: nadaree aavadaa sabh kichh binasai har setee chit laae |
English: Everything that comes into view shall be destroyed; focus your consciousness on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਾ ਇਹ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: satigur naal teree bhaavanee laagai taa ih sojhee paae |7|
English: Enshrine love for the True Guru, and then you shall obtain this understanding. ||7||

Gurbani: ਏਹੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਿ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਪਰਭਵਣੁ ਕਰਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: ehu jog na hovai jogee ji kuttanb chhodd parabhavan kareh |
English: This is not Yoga, O Yogi, to abandon your family and wander around.

Gurbani: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਸਰੀਰ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਅਪਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਹਹਿ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: grih sareer meh har har naam gur parasaadee apanaa har prabh laheh |8|
English: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is within the household of the body. By Guru's Grace, you shall find your Lord God. ||8||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਮਿਟੀ ਕਾ ਪੁਤਲਾ ਜੋਗੀ ਇਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਰੋਗੁ ਵਡਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: eihu jagat mittee kaa putalaa jogee is meh rog vaddaa trisanaa maaeaa |
English: This world is a puppet of clay, Yogi; the terrible disease, the desire for Maya is in it.

Gurbani: ਅਨੇਕ ਜਤਨ ਭੇਖ ਕਰੇ ਜੋਗੀ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: anek jatan bhekh kare jogee rog na jaae gavaaeaa |9|
English: Making all sorts of efforts, and wearing religious robes, Yogi, this disease cannot be cured. ||9||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਹੈ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam aaukhadh hai jogee jis no man vasaae |
English: The Name of the Lord is the medicine, Yogi; the Lord enshrines it in the mind.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: guramukh hovai soee boojhai jog jugat so paae |10|
English: One who becomes Gurmukh understands this; he alone finds the Way of Yoga. ||10||

Gurbani: ਜੋਗੈ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਹੈ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jogai kaa maarag bikham hai jogee jis no nadar kare so paae |
English: The Path of Yoga is very difficult, Yogi; he alone finds it, whom God blesses with His Grace.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਖੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: antar baahar eko vekhai vichahu bharam chukaae |11|
English: Inside and outside, he sees the One Lord; he eliminates doubt from within himself. ||11||

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਵਜਾਈ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਵਾਜੈ ਜੋਗੀ ਸਾ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਵਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: vin vajaaee kinguree vaajai jogee saa kinguree vajaae |
English: So play the harp which vibrates without being played, Yogi.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਰਹਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧੨॥੧॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: kahai naanak mukat hoveh jogee saache raheh samaae |12|1|10|
English: Says Nanak, thus you shall be liberated, Yogi, and remain merged in the True Lord. ||12||1||10||

[Ang 909 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 3 |
English: Raamkalee, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bhagat khajaanaa guramukh jaataa satigur boojh bujhaaee |1|
English: The treasure of devotional worship is revealed to the Gurmukh; the True Guru has inspired me to understand this understanding. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: santahu guramukh dee vaddiaaee |1| rahaau |
English: O Saints, the Gurmukh is blessed with glorious greatness. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਚਿ ਰਹਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਜੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sach rahahu sadaa sehaj sukh upajai kaam krodh vichahu jaaee |2|
English: Dwelling always in Truth, celestial peace wells up; sexual desire and anger are eliminated from within. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਮਮਤਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aap chhodd naam liv laagee mamataa sabad jalaaee |3|
English: Eradicating self-conceit, remain lovingly focused on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; through the Word of the Shabad, burn away possessiveness. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੈ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਅੰਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jis te upajai tis te binasai ante naam sakhaaee |4|
English: By Him we are created, and by Him we are destroyed; in the end, the Naam will be our only help and support. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਨਹ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਰਚਨਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਾਈ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: sadaa hajoor door neh dekhahu rachanaa jin rachaaee |5|
English: He is ever-present; don't think that He is far away. He created the creation. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਵੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: sachaa sabad ravai ghatt antar sache siau liv laaee |6|
English: Deep within your heart, chant the True Word of the Shabad; remain lovingly absorbed in the True Lord. ||6||

Gurbani: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੁ ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਈ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: satasangat meh naam niramolak vaddai bhaag paaeaa jaaee |7|
English: The Priceless Naam is in the Society of the Saints; by great good fortune, it is obtained. ||7||

Gurbani: ਭਰਮਿ ਨ ਭੂਲਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਇਕ ਠਾਈ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: bharam na bhoolahu satigur sevahu man raakhahu ik tthaaee |8|
English: Do not be deluded by doubt; serve the True Guru, and keep your mind steady in one place. ||8||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਭੂਲੀ ਫਿਰਦੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: bin naavai sabh bhoolee firadee birathaa janam gavaaee |9|
English: Without the Name, everyone wanders around in confusion; they waste away their lives in vain. ||9||

Gurbani: ਜੋਗੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ਹੰਢੈ ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: jogee jugat gavaaee handtai paakhandd jog na paaee |10|
English: Yogi, you have lost the Way; you wander around confused. Through hypocrisy, Yoga is not attained. ||10||

Gurbani: ਸਿਵ ਨਗਰੀ ਮਹਿ ਆਸਣਿ ਬੈਸੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਜੋਗੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: siv nagaree meh aasan baisai gurasabadee jog paaee |11|
English: Sitting in Yogic postures in the City of God, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, you shall find Yoga. ||11||

Gurbani: ਧਾਤੁਰ ਬਾਜੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਈ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: dhaatur baajee sabad nivaare naam vasai man aaee |12|
English: Restrain your restless wanderings through the Shabad, and the Naam will come to dwell in your mind. ||12||

Gurbani: ਏਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਹੈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: ehu sareer saravar hai santahu isanaan kare liv laaee |13|
English: This body is a pool, O Saints; bathe in it, and enshrine love for the Lord. ||13||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਿ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਬਦੇ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: naam isanaan kareh se jan niramal sabade mail gavaaee |14|
English: Those who cleanse themselves through the Naam, are the most immaculate people; through the Shabad, they wash off their filth. ||14||

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਅਚੇਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: trai gun achet naam cheteh naahee bin naavai binas jaaee |15|
English: Trapped by the three qualities, the unconscious person does not think of the Naam; without the Name, he wastes away. ||15||

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਣਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: brahamaa bisan mahes trai moorat trigun bharam bhulaaee |16|
English: The three forms of Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva are trapped in the three qualities, lost in confusion. ||16||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਛੂਟੈ ਚਉਥੈ ਪਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee trikuttee chhoottai chauthai pad liv laaee |17|
English: By Guru's Grace, this triad is eradicated, and one is lovingly absorbed in the fourth state. ||17||

Gurbani: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਹਿ ਪੜਿ ਵਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਤਿੰਨਾ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: panddit parreh parr vaad vakhaaneh tinaa boojh na paaee |18|
English: The Pandits, the religious scholars, read, study and discuss the arguments; they do not understand. ||18||

Gurbani: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਾਤੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਹਹਿ ਕਿਸੁ ਭਾਈ ॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: bikhiaa maate bharam bhulaae upades kaheh kis bhaaee |19|
English: Engrossed in corruption, they wander in confusion; who can they possibly instruct, O Siblings of Destiny? ||19||

Gurbani: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਊਤਮ ਬਾਣੀ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਰਹੀ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: bhagat janaa kee aootam baanee jug jug rahee samaaee |20|
English: The Bani, the Word of the humble devotee is the most sublime and exalted; it prevails throughout the ages. ||20||

Gurbani: ਬਾਣੀ ਲਾਗੈ ਸੋ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਸਬਦੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੨੧॥
Transliteration: baanee laagai so gat paae sabade sach samaaee |21|
English: One who is committed to this Bani is emancipated, and through the Shabad, merges in Truth. ||21||

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰੀ ਸਬਦੇ ਖੋਜੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਵੰ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੨੨॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa nagaree sabade khoje naam navan nidh paaee |22|
English: One who searches the village of the body, through the Shabad, obtains the nine treasures of the Naam. ||22||

Gurbani: ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਾਈ ॥੨੩॥
Transliteration: manasaa maar man sehaj samaanaa bin rasanaa usatat karaaee |23|
English: Conquering desire, the mind is absorbed in intuitive ease, and then one chants the Lord's Praises without speaking. ||23||

Gurbani: ਲੋਇਣ ਦੇਖਿ ਰਹੇ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਅਦਿਸਟਿ ਲਗਾਈ ॥੨੪॥
Transliteration: loein dekh rahe bisamaadee chit adisatt lagaaee |24|
English: Let your eyes gaze upon the Wondrous Lord; let your consciousness be attached to the Unseen Lord. ||24||

Gurbani: ਅਦਿਸਟੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੨੫॥
Transliteration: adisatt sadaa rahai niraalam jotee jot milaaee |25|
English: The Unseen Lord is forever absolute and immaculate; one's light merges into the Light. ||25||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਦਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੨੬॥
Transliteration: hau gur saalaahee sadaa aapanaa jin saachee boojh bujhaaee |26|
English: I praise my Guru forever, who has inspired me to understand this true understanding. ||26||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਏਕ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਗਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੨੭॥੨॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: naanak ek kahai benantee naavahu gat pat paaee |27|2|11|
English: Nanak offers this one prayer: through the Name, may I find salvation and honor. ||27||2||11||

[Ang 910 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 3 |
English: Raamkalee, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਪੂਜਾ ਦੁਲੰਭ ਹੈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har kee poojaa dulanbh hai santahu kahanaa kachhoo na jaaee |1|
English: It is so hard to obtain that devotional worship of the Lord, O Saints. It cannot be described at all. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: santahu guramukh pooraa paaee |
English: O Saints, as Gurmukh, find the Perfect Lord,

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੋ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: naamo pooj karaaee |1| rahaau |
English: and worship the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਹਉ ਪੂਜ ਚੜਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har bin sabh kichh mailaa santahu kiaa hau pooj charraaee |2|
English: Without the Lord, everything is filthy, O Saints; what offering should I place before Him? ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾ ਪੂਜਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਭਾਣਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har saache bhaavai saa poojaa hovai bhaanaa man vasaaee |3|
English: Whatever pleases the True Lord is devotional worship; His Will abides in the mind. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪੂਜਾ ਕਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਕੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: poojaa karai sabh lok santahu manamukh thaae na paaee |4|
English: Everyone worships Him, O Saints, but the self-willed manmukh is not accepted or approved. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਏਹ ਪੂਜਾ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਈ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: sabad marai man niramal santahu eeh poojaa thaae paaee |5|
English: If someone dies in the Word of the Shabad, his mind become immaculate, O Saints; such worship is accepted and approved. ||5||

Gurbani: ਪਵਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਚੇ ਏਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: pavit paavan se jan saache ek sabad liv laaee |6|
English: Sanctified and pure are those true beings, who enshrine love for the Shabad. ||6||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਹੋਰ ਪੂਜ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੀ ਲੋਕਾਈ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: bin naavai hor pooj na hovee bharam bhulee lokaaee |7|
English: There is no worship of the Lord, other than the Name; the world wanders, deluded by doubt. ||7||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: guramukh aap pachhaanai santahu raam naam liv laaee |8|
English: The Gurmukh understands his own self, O Saints; he lolvingly centers his mind on the Lord's Name. ||8||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਏ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਈ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: aape niramal pooj karaae gurasabadee thaae paaee |9|
English: The Immaculate Lord Himself inspires worship of Him; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it is accepted and approved. ||9||

Gurbani: ਪੂਜਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਈ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: poojaa kareh par bidh nahee jaaneh doojai bhaae mal laaee |10|
English: Those who worship Him, but do not know the Way, are polluted with the love of duality. ||10||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਪੂਜਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਭਾਣਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: guramukh hovai su poojaa jaanai bhaanaa man vasaaee |11|
English: One who becomes Gurmukh, knows what worship is; the Lord's Will abides within his mind. ||11||

Gurbani: ਭਾਣੇ ਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਅੰਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: bhaane te sabh sukh paavai santahu ante naam sakhaaee |12|
English: One who accepts the Lord's Will obtains total peace, O Saints; in the end, the Naam will be our help and support. ||12||

Gurbani: ਅਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਕੂੜਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: apanaa aap na pachhaaneh santahu koorr kareh vaddiaaee |13|
English: One who does not understand his own self, O Saints, falsely flatters himself. ||13||

Gurbani: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਕੀਨੈ ਜਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਛੋਡੈ ਲੈ ਜਾਸੀ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: paakhandd keenai jam nahee chhoddai lai jaasee pat gavaaee |14|
English: The Messenger of Death does not give up on those who practices hypocrisy; they are dragged away in disgrace. ||14||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: jin antar sabad aap pachhaaneh gat mit tin hee paaee |15|
English: Those who have the Shabad deep within, understand themselves; they find the way of salvation. ||15||

Gurbani: ਏਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਵੈ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: ehu manooaa sun samaadh lagaavai jotee jot milaaee |16|
English: Their minds enter into the deepest state of Samaadhi, and their light is absorbed into the Light. ||16||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਾਈ ॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: sun sun guramukh naam vakhaaneh satasangat melaaee |17|
English: The Gurmukhs listen constantly to the Naam, and chant it in the True Congregation. ||17||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਵੈ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: guramukh gaavai aap gavaavai dar saachai sobhaa paaee |18|
English: The Gurmukhs sing the Lord's Praises, and erase self-conceit; they obtain true honor in the Court of the Lord. ||18||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: saachee baanee sach vakhaanai sach naam liv laaee |19|
English: True are their words; they speak only the Truth; they lovingly focus on the True Name. ||19||

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਅਤਿ ਪਾਪ ਨਿਖੰਜਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: bhai bhanjan at paap nikhanjan meraa prabh ant sakhaaee |20|
English: My God is the Destroyer of fear, the Destroyer of sin; in the end, He is our only help and support. ||20||

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨੧॥੩॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh aape aap varatai naanak naam vaddiaaee |21|3|12|
English: He Himself pervades and permeates everything; O Nanak, glorious greatness is obtained through the Naam. ||21||3||12||

[Ang 910 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 3 |
English: Raamkalee, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਕੁਚਲ ਕੁਚੀਲ ਅਤਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਬਦੇ ਮੈਲੁ ਉਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ham kuchal kucheel at abhimaanee mil sabade mail utaaree |1|
English: I am filthy and polluted, proud and egotistical; receiving the Word of the Shabad, my filth is taken away. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: santahu guramukh naam nisataaree |
English: O Saints, the Gurmukhs are saved through the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa naam vasiaa ghatt antar karatai aap savaaree |1| rahaau |
English: The True Name abides deep within their hearts. The Creator Himself embellishes them. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਹੋਏ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਅਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: paaras parase fir paaras hoe har jeeo apanee kirapaa dhaaree |2|
English: Touching the philosopher's stone, they themselves become the philosopher's stone; the Dear Lord Himself blesses them with His Mercy. ||2||

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਹਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਤਿਨ ਜੂਐ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: eik bhekh kareh fireh abhimaanee tin jooai baajee haaree |3|
English: Some wear religious robes, and wander around in pride; they lose their life in the gamble. ||3||

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: eik anadin bhagat kareh din raatee raam naam ur dhaaree |4|
English: Some worship the Lord in devotion, night and day; day and night, they keep the Lord's Name enshrined in their hearts. ||4||

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: anadin raate sahaje maate sahaje haumai maaree |5|
English: Those who are imbued with Him night and day, are spontaneously intoxicated with Him; they intuitively conquer their ego. ||5||

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: bhai bin bhagat na hoee kab hee bhai bhaae bhagat savaaree |6|
English: Without the Fear of God, devotional worship is never performed; through the Love and the Fear of God, devotional worship is embellished. ||6||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇਆ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਤਤਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohu sabad jalaaeaa giaan tat beechaaree |7|
English: The Shabad burns away emotional attachment to Maya, and then one contemplates the essence of spiritual wisdom. ||7||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: aape aap karaae karataa aape bakhas bhanddaaree |8|
English: The Creator Himself inspires us to act; He Himself blesses us with His treasure. ||8||

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਉ ਗਾਵਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: tis kiaa gunaa kaa ant na paaeaa hau gaavaa sabad veechaaree |9|
English: The limits of His virtues cannot be found; I sing His Praises and contemplate the Word of the Shabad. ||9||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਜਪੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: har jeeo japee har jeeo saalaahee vichahu aap nivaaree |10|
English: I chant the Lord's Name, and praise my Dear Lord; egotism is eradicated from within me. ||10||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਖੁਟ ਸਚੇ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: naam padaarath gur te paaeaa akhutt sache bhanddaaree |11|
English: The treasure of the Naam is obtained from the Guru; the treasures of the True Lord are inexhaustible. ||11||

Gurbani: ਅਪਣਿਆ ਭਗਤਾ ਨੋ ਆਪੇ ਤੁਠਾ ਅਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: apaniaa bhagataa no aape tutthaa apanee kirapaa kar kal dhaaree |12|
English: He Himself is pleased with His devotees; by His Grace, He infuses His strength within them. ||12||

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਸਦਾ ਭੁਖ ਲਾਗੀ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: tin saache naam kee sadaa bhukh laagee gaavan sabad veechaaree |13|
English: They always feel hunger for the True Name; they sing and contemplate the Shabad. ||13||

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਆਖਣੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: jeeo pindd sabh kichh hai tis kaa aakhan bikham beechaaree |14|
English: Soul, body and everything are His; it is so difficult to speak of, and contemplate Him. ||14||

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਲਗੇ ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਨਿਸਤਰੇ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੀ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: sabad lage seee jan nisatare bhaujal paar utaaree |15|
English: Those humble beings who are attached to the Shabad are saved; they cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||15||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੋ ਪਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: bin har saache ko paar na paavai boojhai ko veechaaree |16|
English: Without the True Lord, no one can cross over; how rare are those who contemplate and understand this. ||16||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: jo dhur likhiaa soee paaeaa mil har sabad savaaree |17|
English: We obtain only that which is pre-ordained; receiving the Lord's Shabad, we are embellished. ||17||

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa kanchan sabade raatee saachai naae piaaree |18|
English: Imbued with the Shabad, the body becomes golden, and loves only the True Name. ||18||

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਰਹੀ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa amrit rahee bharapoore paaeeai sabad veechaaree |19|
English: The body is then filled to overflowing with Ambrosial Nectar, obtained by contemplating the Shabad. ||19||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਖੋਜਹਿ ਸੇਈ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਹੋਰਿ ਫੂਟਿ ਮੂਏ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: jo prabh khojeh seee paaveh hor foott mooe ahankaaree |20|
English: Those who seek God, find Him; others burst and die from their own egotism. ||20||

Gurbani: ਬਾਦੀ ਬਿਨਸਹਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੨੧॥
Transliteration: baadee binaseh sevak seveh gur kai het piaaree |21|
English: The debaters waste away, while the servants serve, with love and affection for the Guru. ||21||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਜੋਗੀ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੨੨॥
Transliteration: so jogee tat giaan beechaare haumai trisanaa maaree |22|
English: He alone is a Yogi, who contemplates the essence of spiritual wisdom, and conquers egotism and thirsty desire. ||22||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਤਿਨੈ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੨੩॥
Transliteration: satigur daataa tinai pachhaataa jis no kripaa tumaaree |23|
English: The True Guru, the Great Giver, is revealed to those upon whom You bestow Your Grace, O Lord. ||23||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਲਾਗੇ ਡੂਬਿ ਮੂਏ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥੨੪॥
Transliteration: satigur na seveh maaeaa laage ddoob mooe ahankaaree |24|
English: Those who do not serve the True Guru, and who are attached to Maya, are drowned; they die in their own egotism. ||24||

Gurbani: ਜਿਚਰੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਾਸੁ ਤਿਚਰੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕੀਚੈ ਜਾਇ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਰਾਮ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੨੫॥
Transliteration: jichar andar saas tichar sevaa keechai jaae mileeai raam muraaree |25|
English: As long as there is breath within you, so long you should serve the Lord; then, you will go and meet the Lord. ||25||

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਤ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਅਪਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੨੬॥
Transliteration: anadin jaagat rahai din raatee apane pria preet piaaree |26|
English: Night and day, she remains awake and aware, day and night; she is the darling bride of her Beloved Husband Lord. ||26||

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਵਾਰੀ ਵਾਰਿ ਘੁਮਾਈ ਅਪਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੨੭॥
Transliteration: tan man vaaree vaar ghumaaee apane gur vittahu balihaaree |27|
English: I offer my body and mind in sacrifice to my Guru; I am a sacrifice to Him. ||27||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇਗਾ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨੮॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohu binas jaaeigaa ubare sabad veechaaree |28|
English: Attachment to Maya will end and go away; only by contemplating the Shabad will you be saved. ||28||

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਜਗਾਏ ਸੇਈ ਜਾਗੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨੯॥
Transliteration: aap jagaae seee jaage gur kai sabad veechaaree |29|
English: They are awake and aware, whom the Lord Himself awakens; so contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||29||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਈ ਮੂਏ ਜਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਭਗਤ ਜੀਵੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੩੦॥੪॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: naanak seee mooe ji naam na cheteh bhagat jeeve veechaaree |30|4|13|
English: O Nanak, those who do not remember the Naam are dead. The devotees live in contemplative meditation. ||30||4||13||

[Ang 911 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 3 |
English: Raamkalee, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਰਹੇ ਆਘਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naam khajaanaa gur te paaeaa tripat rahe aaghaaee |1|
English: Receiving the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, from the Guru, I remain satisfied and fulfilled. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: santahu guramukh mukat gat paaee |
English: O Saints, the Gurmukhs attain the state of liberation.

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ek naam vasiaa ghatt antar poore kee vaddiaaee |1| rahaau |
English: The One Name abides deep within my heart; such is the glorious greatness of the Perfect Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਦੇਦਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਬਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aape karataa aape bhugataa dedaa rijak sabaaee |2|
English: He Himself is the Creator, and He Himself is the Enjoyer. He Himself gives sustenance to all. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੋ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jo kichh karanaa so kar rahiaa avar na karanaa jaaee |3|
English: Whatever He wants to do, He is doing; no one else can do anything. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਜੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: aape saaje srisatt upaae sir sir dhandhai laaee |4|
English: He Himself fashions and creates the creation; He links each and every person to their task. ||4||

Gurbani: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਸਰੇਵਹੁ ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: tiseh sarevahu taa sukh paavahu satigur mel milaaee |5|
English: If you serve Him, then you will find peace; the True Guru will unite you in His Union. ||5||

Gurbani: ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: aapanaa aap aap upaae alakh na lakhanaa jaaee |6|
English: The Lord Himself creates Himself; the Unseen Lord cannot be seen. ||6||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲੇ ਆਪੇ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਈ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: aape maar jeevaale aape tis no til na tamaaee |7|
English: He Himself kills, and brings back to life; He does not have even an iota of greed. ||7||

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਦਾਤੇ ਇਕਿ ਮੰਗਤੇ ਕੀਤੇ ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਈ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: eik daate ik mangate keete aape bhagat karaaee |8|
English: Some are made givers, and some are made beggars; He Himself inspires us to devotional worship. ||8||

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿਨੀ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ਸਚੇ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: se vaddabhaagee jinee eko jaataa sache rahe samaaee |9|
English: Those who know the One Lord are very fortunate; they remain absorbed in the True Lord. ||9||

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਆਪੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: aap saroop siaanaa aape keemat kehan na jaaee |10|
English: He Himself is beautiful, He Himself is wise and clever; His worth cannot be expressed. ||10||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: aape dukh sukh paae antar aape bharam bhulaaee |11|
English: He Himself infuses pain and pleasure; He Himself makes them wander around in doubt. ||11||

Gurbani: ਵਡਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਨਿਗੁਰੀ ਅੰਧ ਫਿਰੈ ਲੋਕਾਈ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: vaddaa daataa guramukh jaataa niguree andh firai lokaaee |12|
English: The Great Giver is revealed to the Gurmukh; without the Guru, the world wanders in darkness. ||12||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਸਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: jinee chaakhiaa tinaa saad aaeaa satigur boojh bujhaaee |13|
English: Those who taste, enjoy the flavor; the True Guru imparts this understanding. ||13||

Gurbani: ਇਕਨਾ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਇਕਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: eikanaa naavahu aap bhulaae ikanaa guramukh dee bujhaaee |14|
English: Some, the Lord causes to forget and lose the Name; others become Gurmukh, and are granted this understanding. ||14||

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa saalaahihu santahu tis dee vaddee vaddiaaee |15|
English: Forever and ever, praise the Lord, O Saints; how glorious is His greatness! ||15||

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਰਾਜਾ ਕਰਿ ਤਪਾਵਸੁ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: tis bin avar na koee raajaa kar tapaavas banat banaaee |16|
English: There is no other King except Him; He administers justice, as He has made it. ||16||

Gurbani: ਨਿਆਉ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਹੈ ਸਦ ਸਾਚਾ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਈ ॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: niaau tisai kaa hai sad saachaa virale hukam manaaee |17|
English: His justice is always True; how rare are those who accept His Command. ||17||

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: tis no praanee sadaa dhiaavahu jin guramukh banat banaaee |18|
English: O mortal, meditate forever on the Lord, who has made the Gurmukh in His making. ||18||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੈ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸੀਝੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਈ ॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: satigur bhettai so jan seejhai jis hiradai naam vasaaee |19|
English: That humble being who meets with the True Guru is fulfilled; the Naam abides in his heart. ||19||

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਆਪਿ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਣਾਈ ॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: sachaa aap sadaa hai saachaa baanee sabad sunaaee |20|
English: The True Lord is Himself forever True; He announces His Bani, the Word of His Shabad. ||20||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਣਿ ਵੇਖਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਥਾਈ ॥੨੧॥੫॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: naanak sun vekh rahiaa visamaad meraa prabh raviaa srab thaaee |21|5|14|
English: Nanak is wonderstruck, hearing and seeing His Lord; my God is all-pervading, everywhere. ||21||5||14||

[Ang 912 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 asattapadeea |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਕੀਆ ਪਰਵਿਰਤਿ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kinahee keea paravirat pasaaraa |
English: Some make a big show of their worldly influence.

Gurbani: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਕੀਆ ਪੂਜਾ ਬਿਸਥਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kinahee keea poojaa bisathaaraa |
English: Some make a big show of devotional worship.

Gurbani: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਨਿਵਲ ਭੁਇਅੰਗਮ ਸਾਧੇ ॥
Transliteration: kinahee nival bhueiangam saadhe |
English: Some practice inner cleansing teahniques, and control the breath through Kundalini Yoga.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਦੀਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mohi deen har har aaraadhe |1|
English: I am meek; I worship and adore the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਭਰੋਸਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: teraa bharosaa piaare |
English: I place my faith in You alone, O Beloved Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਨ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ਵੇਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aan na jaanaa vesaa |1| rahaau |
English: I do not know any other way. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਤਜਿ ਵਣ ਖੰਡਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kinahee grihu taj van khandd paaeaa |
English: Some abandon their homes, and live in the forests.

Gurbani: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਮੋਨਿ ਅਉਧੂਤੁ ਸਦਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kinahee mon aaudhoot sadaaeaa |
English: Some put themselves on silence, and call themselves hermits.

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਕਹਤਉ ਅਨੰਨਿ ਭਗਉਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: koee kahtau anan bhgautee |
English: Some claim that they are devotees of the One Lord alone.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਦੀਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਓਟ ਲੀਤੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mohi deen har har ott leetee |2|
English: I am meek; I seek the shelter and support of the Lord, Har, Har. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਕਹਿਆ ਹਉ ਤੀਰਥ ਵਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: kinahee kahiaa hau teerath vaasee |
English: Some say that they live at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਅੰਨੁ ਤਜਿ ਭਇਆ ਉਦਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: koee an taj bheaa udaasee |
English: Some refuse food and become Udaasis, shaven-headed renunciates.

Gurbani: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਭਵਨੁ ਸਭ ਧਰਤੀ ਕਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: kinahee bhavan sabh dharatee kariaa |
English: Some have wandered all across the earth.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਦੀਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਪਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: mohi deen har har dar pariaa |3|
English: I am meek; I have fallen at the door of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਕਹਿਆ ਮੈ ਕੁਲਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: kinahee kahiaa mai kuleh vaddiaaee |
English: Some say that they belong to great and noble families.

Gurbani: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਕਹਿਆ ਬਾਹ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kinahee kahiaa baah bahu bhaaee |
English: Some say that they have the arms of their many brothers to protect them.

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਕਹੈ ਮੈ ਧਨਹਿ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: koee kahai mai dhaneh pasaaraa |
English: Some say that they have great expanses of wealth.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਦੀਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਧਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: mohi deen har har aadhaaraa |4|
English: I am meek; I have the support of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||

Gurbani: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਘੂਘਰ ਨਿਰਤਿ ਕਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kinahee ghooghar nirat karaaee |
English: Some dance, wearing ankle bells.

Gurbani: ਕਿਨਹੂ ਵਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਮਾਲਾ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kinahoo varat nem maalaa paaee |
English: Some fast and take vows, and wear malas.

Gurbani: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਗੋਪੀ ਚੰਦਨ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kinahee tilak gopee chandan laaeaa |
English: Some apply ceremonial tilak marks to their foreheads.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਦੀਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: mohi deen har har har dhiaaeaa |5|
English: I am meek; I meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, Har. ||5||

Gurbani: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਸਿਧ ਬਹੁ ਚੇਟਕ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: kinahee sidh bahu chettak laae |
English: Some work spells using the miraculous spiritual powers of the Siddhas.

Gurbani: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਭੇਖ ਬਹੁ ਥਾਟ ਬਨਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: kinahee bhekh bahu thaatt banaae |
English: Some wear various religious robes and establish their authority.

Gurbani: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਤੰਤ ਮੰਤ ਬਹੁ ਖੇਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: kinahee tant mant bahu khevaa |
English: Some perform Tantric spells, and chant various mantras.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਦੀਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: mohi deen har har har sevaa |6|
English: I am meek; I serve the Lord, Har, Har, Har. ||6||

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਪੰਡਿਤ ॥
Transliteration: koee chatur kahaavai panddit |
English: One calls himself a wise Pandit, a religious scholar.

Gurbani: ਕੋ ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮ ਸਹਿਤ ਸਿਉ ਮੰਡਿਤ ॥
Transliteration: ko khatt karam sahit siau manddit |
English: One performs the six rituals to appease Shiva.

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਕਰੈ ਆਚਾਰ ਸੁਕਰਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: koee karai aachaar sukaranee |
English: One maintains the rituals of pure lifestyle, and does good deeds.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਦੀਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣੀ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: mohi deen har har har saranee |7|
English: I am meek; I seek the Sanctuary of the Lord, Har, Har, Har. ||7||

Gurbani: ਸਗਲੇ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਜੁਗ ਸੋਧੇ ॥
Transliteration: sagale karam dharam jug sodhe |
English: I have studied the religions and rituals of all the ages.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਪ੍ਰਬੋਧੇ ॥
Transliteration: bin naavai ihu man na prabodhe |
English: Without the Name, this mind is not awakened.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਉ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak jau saadhasang paaeaa |
English: Says Nanak, when I found the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy,

Gurbani: ਬੂਝੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਹਾ ਸੀਤਲਾਇਆ ॥੮॥੧॥
Transliteration: boojhee trisanaa mahaa seetalaaeaa |8|1|
English: my thirsty desires were satisfied, and I was totally cooled and soothed. ||8||1||

[Ang 913 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਪਾਨੀ ਤੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂ ਘਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: eis paanee te jin too ghariaa |
English: He created you out of this water.

Gurbani: ਮਾਟੀ ਕਾ ਲੇ ਦੇਹੁਰਾ ਕਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: maattee kaa le dehuraa kariaa |
English: From clay, He fashioned your body.

Gurbani: ਉਕਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਲੈ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਪਰੀਖਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: aukat jot lai surat pareekhiaa |
English: He blessed you with the light of reason and clear consciousness.

Gurbani: ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਮਹਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: maat garabh meh jin too raakhiaa |1|
English: In your mother's womb, He preserved you. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੁ ਸਮ੍ਹਾਰਿ ਜਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: raakhanahaar samhaar janaa |
English: Contemplate your Savior Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲੇ ਛੋਡਿ ਬੀਚਾਰ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sagale chhodd beechaar manaa |1| rahaau |
English: Give up all others thoughts, O mind. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਏ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਾਪ ਮਹਤਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jin dee tudh baap mahataaree |
English: He gave you your mother and father;

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਏ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਪੁਤ ਹਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jin dee bhraat put haaree |
English: he gave you your charming children and siblings;

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਏ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਅਰੁ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: jin dee tudh banitaa ar meetaa |
English: he gave you your spouse and friends;

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਉ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਚੀਤਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tis tthaakur kau rakh lehu cheetaa |2|
English: enshrine that Lord and Master in your consciousness. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਵਨੁ ਅਮੋਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: jin deea tudh pavan amolaa |
English: He gave you the invaluable air;

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਨੀਰੁ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: jin deea tudh neer niramolaa |
English: He gave you the priceless water;

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਬਲਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jin deea tudh paavak balanaa |
English: He gave you burning fire;

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੀ ਰਹੁ ਮਨ ਸਰਨਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tis tthaakur kee rahu man saranaa |3|
English: let your mind remain in the Sanctuary of that Lord and Master. ||3||

Gurbani: ਛਤੀਹ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਿਨਿ ਭੋਜਨ ਦੀਏ ॥
Transliteration: chhateeh amrit jin bhojan dee |
English: He gave you the thirty-six varieties of tasty foods;

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਥਾਨ ਠਹਰਾਵਨ ਕਉ ਕੀਏ ॥
Transliteration: antar thaan tthaharaavan kau kee |
English: He gave you a place within to hold them;

Gurbani: ਬਸੁਧਾ ਦੀਓ ਬਰਤਨਿ ਬਲਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: basudhaa deeo baratan balanaa |
English: He gave you the earth, and things to use;

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਿਤਿ ਰਖੁ ਚਰਨਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: tis tthaakur ke chit rakh charanaa |4|
English: enshrine in your consciousness the feet of that Lord and Master. ||4||

Gurbani: ਪੇਖਨ ਕਉ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਨਨ ਕਉ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: pekhan kau netr sunan kau karanaa |
English: He gave you eyes to see, and ears to hear;

Gurbani: ਹਸਤ ਕਮਾਵਨ ਬਾਸਨ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: hasat kamaavan baasan rasanaa |
English: He gave you hands to work with, and a nose and a tongue;

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਚਲਨ ਕਉ ਸਿਰੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: charan chalan kau sir keeno meraa |
English: He gave you feet to walk upon, and the crowning glory of your head;

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਪੂਜਹੁ ਪੈਰਾ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: man tis tthaakur ke poojahu pairaa |5|
English: O mind, worship the Feet of that Lord and Master. ||5||

Gurbani: ਅਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂ ਕਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: apavitr pavitru jin too kariaa |
English: He transformed you from impure to pure;

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਜੋਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਤੂ ਸਿਰਿ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sagal jon meh too sir dhariaa |
English: He installed you above the heads of all creatures;

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਤੂ ਸੀਝੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਹੀ ਸੀਝੈ ॥
Transliteration: ab too seejh bhaavai nahee seejhai |
English: now, you may fulfill your destiny or not;

Gurbani: ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਵਰੈ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਈਜੈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: kaaraj savarai man prabh dhiaaeejai |6|
English: Your affairs shall be resolved, O mind, meditating on God. ||6||

Gurbani: ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਏਕੈ ਓਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: eehaa aoohaa ekai ohee |
English: Here and there, only the One God exists.

Gurbani: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਤਤ ਤਤ ਤੋਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jat kat dekheeai tat tat tohee |
English: Wherever I look, there You are.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਵਤ ਮਨਿ ਆਲਸੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: tis sevat man aalas karai |
English: My mind is reluctant to serve Him;

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਸਰਿਐ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਸਰੈ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: jis visariai ik nimakh na sarai |7|
English: forgetting Him, I cannot survive, even for an instant. ||7||

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਨਿਰਗੁਨੀਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: ham aparaadhee niraguneeaare |
English: I am a sinner, without any virtue at all.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਾ ਕਰਮਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: naa kichh sevaa naa karamaare |
English: I do not serve You, or do any good deeds.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮਿਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur bohith vaddabhaagee miliaa |
English: By great good fortune, I have found the boat - the Guru.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਥਰ ਤਰਿਆ ॥੮॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak daas sang paathar tariaa |8|2|
English: Slave Nanak has crossed over, with Him. ||8||2||

[Ang 913 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਰੰਗ ਰਸ ਰੂਪ ॥
Transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai rang ras roop |
English: Some pass their lives enjoying pleasures and beauty.

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਮਾਇ ਬਾਪ ਪੂਤ ॥
Transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai maae baap poot |
English: Some pass their lives with their mothers, fathers and children.

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਰਾਜ ਮਿਲਖ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai raaj milakh vaapaaraa |
English: Some pass their lives in power, estates and trade.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sant bihaavai har naam adhaaraa |1|
English: The Saints pass their lives with the support of the Lord's Name. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਚਨਾ ਸਾਚੁ ਬਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: rachanaa saach banee |
English: The world is the creation of the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਕਾ ਏਕੁ ਧਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kaa ek dhanee |1| rahaau |
English: He alone is the Master of all. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਬੇਦ ਅਰੁ ਬਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai bed ar baad |
English: Some pass their lives in arguments and debates about scriptures.

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਰਸਨਾ ਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai rasanaa saad |
English: Some pass their lives tasting flavors.

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਲਪਟਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai lapatt sang naaree |
English: Some pass their lives attached to women.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਰਚੇ ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sant rache keval naam muraaree |2|
English: The Saints are absorbed only in the Name of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਖੇਲਤ ਜੂਆ ॥
Transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai khelat jooaa |
English: Some pass their lives gambling.

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਅਮਲੀ ਹੂਆ ॥
Transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai amalee hooaa |
English: Some pass their lives getting drunk.

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਪਰ ਦਰਬ ਚੋੁਰਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai par darab chuoraae |
English: Some pass their lives stealing the property of others.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਨਾਮ ਧਿਆਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har jan bihaavai naam dhiaae |3|
English: The humble servants of the Lord pass their lives meditating on the Naam. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਜੋਗ ਤਪ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai jog tap poojaa |
English: Some pass their lives in Yoga, strict meditation, worship and adoration.

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੂ ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਭਰਮੀਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaahoo rog sog bharameejaa |
English: Some, in sickness, sorrow and doubt.

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੂ ਪਵਨ ਧਾਰ ਜਾਤ ਬਿਹਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: kaahoo pavan dhaar jaat bihaae |
English: Some pass their lives practicing control of the breath.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਏ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: sant bihaavai keeratan gaae |4|
English: The Saints pass their lives singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||4||

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਚਾਲਤ ॥
Transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai din rain chaalat |
English: Some pass their lives walking day and night.

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਿੜੁ ਮਾਲਤ ॥
Transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai so pirr maalat |
English: Some pass their lives on the fields of battle.

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਬਾਲ ਪੜਾਵਤ ॥
Transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai baal parraavat |
English: Some pass their lives teaching children.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਤ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: sant bihaavai har jas gaavat |5|
English: The Saints pass their lives singing the Lord's Praise. ||5||

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਨਟ ਨਾਟਿਕ ਨਿਰਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai natt naattik nirate |
English: Some pass their lives as actors, acting and dancing.

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਜੀਆਇਹ ਹਿਰਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai jeeaeih hirate |
English: Some pass their lives taking the lives of others.

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਰਾਜ ਮਹਿ ਡਰਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai raaj meh ddarate |
English: Some pass their lives ruling by intimidation.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਰਤੇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: sant bihaavai har jas karate |6|
English: The Saints pass their lives chanting the Lord's Praises. ||6||

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਮਤਾ ਮਸੂਰਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai mataa masoorat |
English: Some pass their lives counseling and giving advice.

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਸੇਵਾ ਜਰੂਰਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai sevaa jaroorat |
English: Some pass their lives forced to serve others.

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਸੋਧਤ ਜੀਵਤ ॥
Transliteration: kaahoo bihaavai sodhat jeevat |
English: Some pass their lives exploring life's mysteries.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਤ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: sant bihaavai har ras peevat |7|
English: The Saints pass their lives drinking in the sublime essence of the Lord. ||7||

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਲਗਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jit ko laaeaa tith hee lagaanaa |
English: As the Lord attaches us, so we are attached.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਮੂੜੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋ ਸਿਆਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: naa ko moorr nahee ko siaanaa |
English: No one is foolish, and no one is wise.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa jis devai naau |
English: Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to those who are blessed

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੮॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak taa kai bal bal jaau |8|3|
English: By His Grace to receive His Name. ||8||3||

[Ang 914 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦਾਵਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਰਹੇ ਹਰਿ ਬੂਟ ॥
Transliteration: daavaa agan rahe har boott |
English: Even in a forest fire, some trees remain green.

Gurbani: ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਸੰਕਟ ਤੇ ਛੂਟ ॥
Transliteration: maat garabh sankatt te chhoott |
English: The infant is released from the pain of the mother's womb.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਭਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kaa naam simarat bhau jaae |
English: Meditating in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, fear is dispelled.

Gurbani: ਤੈਸੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਰਾਖੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: taise sant janaa raakhai har raae |1|
English: Just so, the Sovereign Lord protects and saves the Saints. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸੇ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
Transliteration: aise raakhanahaar deaal |
English: Such is the Merciful Lord, my Protector.

Gurbani: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਦੇਖਉ ਤੁਮ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jat kat dekhau tum pratipaal |1| rahaau |
English: Wherever I look, I see You cherishing and nurturing. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਲੁ ਪੀਵਤ ਜਿਉ ਤਿਖਾ ਮਿਟੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: jal peevat jiau tikhaa mittant |
English: As thirst is quenched by drinking water;

Gurbani: ਧਨ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਆਵਤ ਕੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: dhan bigasai grihi aavat kant |
English: as the bride blossoms forth when her husband comes home;

Gurbani: ਲੋਭੀ ਕਾ ਧਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: lobhee kaa dhan praan adhaar |
English: as wealth is the support of the greedy person

Gurbani: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tiau har jan har har naam piaar |2|
English: - just so, the humble servant of the Lord loves the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਸਾਨੀ ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖੈ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: kirasaanee jiau raakhai rakhavaalaa |
English: As the farmer protects his fields;

Gurbani: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਦਇਆ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: maat pitaa deaa jiau baalaa |
English: as the mother and father show compassion to their child;

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: preetam dekh preetam mil jaae |
English: as the lover merges on seeing the beloved;

Gurbani: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਰਾਖੈ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tiau har jan raakhai kantth laae |3|
English: just so does the Lord hug His humble servant close in His Embrace. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਪੇਖਤ ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: jiau andhule pekhat hoe anand |
English: As the blind man is in ecstasy, when he can see again;

Gurbani: ਗੂੰਗਾ ਬਕਤ ਗਾਵੈ ਬਹੁ ਛੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: goongaa bakat gaavai bahu chhand |
English: and the mute, when he is able to speak and sing songs;

Gurbani: ਪਿੰਗੁਲ ਪਰਬਤ ਪਰਤੇ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: pingul parabat parate paar |
English: and the cripple, being able to climb over the mountain

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਗਲ ਉਧਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: har kai naam sagal udhaar |4|
English: - just so, the Name of the Lord saves all. ||4||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਪਾਵਕ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੀਤ ਕੋ ਨਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: jiau paavak sang seet ko naas |
English: As cold is dispelled by fire,

Gurbani: ਐਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਛਤ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਬਿਨਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: aise praachhat santasang binaas |
English: sins are driven out in the Society of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਸਾਬੁਨਿ ਕਾਪਰ ਊਜਲ ਹੋਤ ॥
Transliteration: jiau saabun kaapar aoojal hot |
English: As cloth is cleaned by soap,

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਜਪਤ ਸਭੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਖੋਤ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: naam japat sabh bhram bhau khot |5|
English: just so, by chanting the Naam, all doubts and fears are dispelled. ||5||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਚਕਵੀ ਸੂਰਜ ਕੀ ਆਸ ॥
Transliteration: jiau chakavee sooraj kee aas |
English: As the chakvi bird longs for the sun,

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਬੂੰਦ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
Transliteration: jiau chaatrik boond kee piaas |
English: as the rainbird thirsts for the rain drop,

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਕੁਰੰਕ ਨਾਦ ਕਰਨ ਸਮਾਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: jiau kurank naad karan samaane |
English: as the deer's ears are attuned to the sound of the bell,

Gurbani: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮਨਹਿ ਸੁਖਾਨੇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: tiau har naam har jan maneh sukhaane |6|
English: the Lord's Name is pleasing to the mind of the Lord's humble servant. ||6||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਲਾਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: tumaree kripaa te laagee preet |
English: By Your Grace, we love You.

Gurbani: ਦਇਆਲ ਭਏ ਤਾ ਆਏ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: deaal bhe taa aae cheet |
English: When You show Mercy, then You come into our minds.

Gurbani: ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰੀ ਤਿਨਿ ਧਾਰਣਹਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: deaa dhaaree tin dhaaranahaar |
English: When the Support of the earth granted His Grace,

Gurbani: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ਛੁਟਕਾਰ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: bandhan te hoee chhuttakaar |7|
English: then I was released from my bonds. ||7||

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਥਾਨ ਦੇਖੇ ਨੈਣ ਅਲੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabh thaan dekhe nain aloe |
English: I have seen all places with my eyes wide open.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: tis bin doojaa avar na koe |
English: There is no other than Him.

Gurbani: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੈ ਛੂਟੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦ ॥
Transliteration: bhram bhai chhootte gur parasaad |
English: Doubt and fear are dispelled, by Guru's Grace.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਸਭੁ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥੮॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak pekhio sabh bisamaad |8|4|
English: Nanak sees the wondrous Lord everywhere. ||8||4||

[Ang 915 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਪੇਖੀਅਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਗਲ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਧਾਰਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jeea jant sabh pekheeeh prabh sagal tumaaree dhaaranaa |1|
English: All beings and creatures that are seen, God, depend on Your Support. ||1||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਉਧਾਰਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: eihu man har kai naam udhaaranaa |1| rahaau |
English: This mind is saved through the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੇ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸਭਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੇ ਕਾਰਨਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: khin meh thaap uthaape kudarat sabh karate ke kaaranaa |2|
English: In an instant, He establishes and disestablishes, by His Creative Power. All is the Creation of the Creator. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਿਦਾਰਨਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh lobh jhootth nindaa saadhoo sang bidaaranaa |3|
English: Sexual desire, anger, greed, falsehood and slander are banished in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੂਖੇ ਸੂਖਿ ਗੁਦਾਰਨਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: naam japat man niramal hovai sookhe sookh gudaaranaa |4|
English: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind becomes immaculate, and life is passed in absolute peace. ||4||

Gurbani: ਭਗਤ ਸਰਣਿ ਜੋ ਆਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਨ ਹਾਰਨਾ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: bhagat saran jo aavai praanee tis eehaa aoohaa na haaranaa |5|
English: That mortal who enters the Sanctuary of the devotees, does not lose out, here or hereafter. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸੂਖ ਦੂਖ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਆਗੈ ਸਾਰਨਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: sookh dookh is man kee birathaa tum hee aagai saaranaa |6|
English: Pleasure and pain, and the condition of this mind, I place before You, Lord. ||6||

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਆਪਨ ਕੀਆ ਪਾਲਨਾ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: too daataa sabhanaa jeea kaa aapan keea paalanaa |7|
English: You are the Giver of all beings; You cherish what You have made. ||7||

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਰ ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵੰਞੈ ਵਾਰਨਾ ॥੮॥੫॥
Transliteration: anik baar kott jan aoopar naanak vanyai vaaranaa |8|5|
English: So many millions of times, Nanak is a sacrifice to Your humble servants. ||8||5||

[Ang 915 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 asattapadee |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl, Ashtapadee:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਪਾਪ ਸਭਿ ਨਾਸਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਦੇਇ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: darasan bhettat paap sabh naaseh har siau dee milaaee |1|
English: Receiving the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, all sins are erased, and He unites me with the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: meraa gur paramesar sukhadaaee |
English: My Guru is the Transcendent Lord, the Giver of peace.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਅੰਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham kaa naam drirraae ante hoe sakhaaee |1| rahaau |
English: He implants the Naam, the Name of the Supreme Lord God within us; in the end, He is our help and support. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਦੂਖ ਕਾ ਡੇਰਾ ਭੰਨਾ ਸੰਤ ਧੂਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sagal dookh kaa dderaa bhanaa sant dhoor mukh laaee |2|
English: The source of all pain within is destroyed; I apply the dust of the feet of the Saints to my forehead. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਕੀਏ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਵੰਞਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: patit puneet kee khin bheetar agiaan andher vanyaaee |3|
English: In an instant, He purifies the sinners, and dispels the darkness of ignorance. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: karan kaaran samarath suaamee naanak tis saranaaee |4|
English: The Lord is all-powerful, the Cause of causes. Nanak seeks His Sanctuary. ||4||

Gurbani: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋੜਿ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਏਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: bandhan torr charan kamal drirraae ek sabad liv laaee |5|
English: Shattering the bonds, the Guru implants the Lord's lotus feet within, and lovingly attunes us to the One Word of the Shabad. ||5||

Gurbani: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਤੇ ਕਾਢਿਓ ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: andh koop bikhiaa te kaadtio saach sabad ban aaee |6|
English: He has lifted me up, and pulled me out of the deep, dark pit of sin; I am attuned to the True Shabad. ||6||

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕਾ ਸਹਸਾ ਚੂਕਾ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਕਤਹੁ ਨ ਧਾਈ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: janam maran kaa sahasaa chookaa baahurr katahu na dhaaee |7|
English: The fear of birth and death is taken away; I shall never wander again. ||7||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਈ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: naam rasaaein ihu man raataa amrit pee tripataaee |8|
English: This mind is imbued with the sublime elixir of the Naam; drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar, it is satisfied. ||8||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਇਆ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਵਸਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: santasang mil keeratan gaaeaa nihachal vasiaa jaaee |9|
English: Joining the Society of the Saints, I sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises; I dwell in the eternal, unchanging place. ||9||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਆਨ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: poorai gur pooree mat deenee har bin aan na bhaaee |10|
English: The Perfect Guru has given me the perfect teachings; there is nothing except the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny. ||10||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਰਕਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: naam nidhaan paaeaa vaddabhaagee naanak narak na jaaee |11|
English: I have obtained the treasure of the Naam, by great good fortune; O Nanak, I shall not fall into hell. ||11||

Gurbani: ਘਾਲ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਉਕਤਿ ਨ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਮਾਈ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: ghaal siaanap ukat na meree poorai guroo kamaaee |12|
English: Clever tricks have not worked for me; I shall act according to the Instructions of the Perfect Guru. ||12||

Gurbani: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਸੁਚਿ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਈ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: jap tap sanjam such hai soee aape kare karaaee |13|
English: He is chanting, intense meditation, austere self-discipline and purification. He Himself acts, and causes us to act. ||13||

Gurbani: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਲਾਇ ਤਰਾਈ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: putr kalatr mahaa bikhiaa meh gur saachai laae taraaee |14|
English: In the midst of children and spouse, and utter corruption, the True Guru has carried me across. ||14||

Gurbani: ਅਪਣੇ ਜੀਅ ਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਸਮ੍ਹਾਲੇ ਆਪਿ ਲੀਏ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਈ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: apane jeea tai aap samhaale aap lee larr laaee |15|
English: You Yourself take care of Your beings; You Yourself attach them to the hem of Your robe. ||15||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚ ਧਰਮ ਕਾ ਬੇੜਾ ਬਾਂਧਿਆ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਵਾਈ ॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: saach dharam kaa berraa baandhiaa bhavajal paar pavaaee |16|
English: I have built the boat of true Dharmic faith, to cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||16||

Gurbani: ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: besumaar beant suaamee naanak bal bal jaaee |17|
English: The Lord Master is unlimited and endless; Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to Him. ||17||

Gurbani: ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੰਭਉ ਕਲਿ ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਦੀਪਾਈ ॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: akaal moorat ajoonee sanbhau kal andhakaar deepaaee |18|
English: Being of Immortal Manifestation, He is not born; He is self-existent; He is the Light in the darkness of Kali Yuga. ||18||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜੀਅਨ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਦੇਖਤ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਈ ॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: antarajaamee jeean kaa daataa dekhat tripat aghaaee |19|
English: He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, the Giver of souls; gazing upon Him, I am satisfied and fulfilled. ||19||

Gurbani: ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸਭ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: ekankaar niranjan nirbhau sabh jal thal rahiaa samaaee |20|
English: He is the One Universal Creator Lord, immaculate and fearless; He is permeating and pervading all the water and the land. ||20||

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਭਗਤਾ ਕਉ ਦੀਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਮਾਈ ॥੨੧॥੧॥੬॥
Transliteration: bhagat daan bhagataa kau deenaa har naanak jaachai maaee |21|1|6|
English: He blesses His devotees with the Gift of devotional worship; Nanak longs for the Lord, O my mother. ||21||1||6||

[Ang 916 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl,

Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਸਿਖਹੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਿਆਰਿਹੋ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ॥
Transliteration: sikhahu sabad piaariho janam maran kee ttek |
English: Study the Word of the Shabad, O beloveds. It is your anchoring support in life and in death.

Gurbani: ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਏਕ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mukh aoojal sadaa sukhee naanak simarat ek |1|
English: Your face shall be radiant, and you will be at peace forever, O Nanak, meditating in remembrance on the One Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: man tan raataa raam piaare har prem bhagat ban aaee santahu |1|
English: My mind and body are imbued with my Beloved Lord; I have been blessed with loving devotion to the Lord, O Saints. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਖੇਪ ਨਿਬਾਹੀ ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: satigur khep nibaahee santahu |
English: The True Guru has approved my cargo, O Saints.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਦੀਆ ਸਗਲੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਉਲਾਹੀ ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har naam laahaa daas kau deea sagalee trisan ulaahee santahu |1| rahaau |
English: He has blessed His slave with the profit of the Lord's Name; all my thirst is quenched, O Saints. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਲਾਲੁ ਇਕੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: khojat khojat laal ik paaeaa har keemat kehan na jaaee santahu |2|
English: Searching and searching, I have found the One Lord, the jewel; I cannot express His value, O Saints. ||2||

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੋ ਧਿਆਨਾ ਸਾਚੈ ਦਰਸਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: charan kamal siau laago dhiaanaa saachai daras samaaee santahu |3|
English: I focus my meditation on His Lotus Feet; I am absorbed in the True Vision of His Darshan, O Saints. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ ਗਾਵਤ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: gun gaavat gaavat bhe nihaalaa har simarat tripat aghaaee santahu |4|
English: Singing, singing His Glorious Praises, I am enraptured; meditating in remembrance on the Lord, I am satisfied and fulfilled, O Saints. ||4||

Gurbani: ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਤ ਆਵੈ ਕਤ ਜਾਈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: aatam raam raviaa sabh antar kat aavai kat jaaee santahu |5|
English: The Lord, the Supreme Soul, is permeating within all; what comes, and what goes, O Saints? ||5||

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਸਭ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: aad jugaadee hai bhee hosee sabh jeea kaa sukhadaaee santahu |6|
English: At the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages, He is, and He shall always be; He is the Giver of peace to all beings, O Saints. ||6||

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: aap beant ant nahee paaeeai poor rahiaa sabh tthaaee santahu |7|
English: He Himself is endless; His end cannot be found. He is totally pervading and permeating everywhere, O Saints. ||7||

Gurbani: ਮੀਤ ਸਾਜਨ ਮਾਲੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਸੁਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਪੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥੮॥੨॥੭॥
Transliteration: meet saajan maal joban sut har naanak baap meree maaee santahu |8|2|7|
English: Nanak: the Lord is my friend, companion, wealth, youth, son, father and mother, O Saints. ||8||2||7||

[Ang 916 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਿਤਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: man bach kram raam naam chitaaree |
English: In thought, word and deed, I contemplate the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਘੂਮਨ ਘੇਰਿ ਮਹਾ ਅਤਿ ਬਿਖੜੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ghooman gher mahaa at bikharree guramukh naanak paar utaaree |1| rahaau |
English: The horrible world-ocean is very treacherous; O Nanak, the Gurmukh is carried across. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੂਖਾ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੂਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਮਲਨ ਭਏ ਦੁਸਟਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: antar sookhaa baahar sookhaa har jap malan bhe dusattaaree |1|
English: Inwardly, peace, and outwardly, peace; meditating on the Lord, evil tendencies are crushed. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਲਾਗੇ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਅਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jis te laage tineh nivaare prabh jeeo apanee kirapaa dhaaree |2|
English: He has rid me of what was clinging to me; my Dear Lord God has blessed me with His Grace. ||2||

Gurbani: ਉਧਰੇ ਸੰਤ ਪਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਨੀ ਪਚਿ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਮਹਾ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: audhare sant pare har saranee pach binase mahaa ahankaaree |3|
English: The Saints are saved, in His Sanctuary; the very egotistical people rot away and die. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਇਹੁ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਇਕੁ ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: saadhoo sangat ihu fal paaeaa ik keval naam adhaaree |4|
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I have obtained this fruit, the Support of the One Name alone. ||4||

Gurbani: ਨ ਕੋਈ ਸੂਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਹੀਣਾ ਸਭ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: n koee soor na koee heenaa sabh pragattee jot tumaaree |5|
English: No one is strong, and no one is weak; all are manifestations of Your Light, Lord. ||5||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮੑ ਸਮਰਥ ਅਕਥ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਰਵਿਆ ਏਕੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: tuma samarath akath agochar raviaa ek muraaree |6|
English: You are the all-powerful, indescribable, unfathomable, all-pervading Lord. ||6||

Gurbani: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਉਣੁ ਕਰੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਰਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੀ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: keemat kaun kare teree karate prabh ant na paaraavaaree |7|
English: Who can estimate Your value, O Creator Lord? God has no end or limitation. ||7||
