Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਤੇਰਿਆ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਰੇਣਾਰੀ ॥੮॥੩॥੮॥੨੨॥
Transliteration: naam daan naanak vaddiaaee teriaa sant janaa renaaree |8|3|8|22|
English: Please bless Nanak with the glorious greatness of the gift of the Naam, and the dust of the feet of Your Saints. ||8||3||8||22||

[Ang 917 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 3 anand |
English: Raamkalee, Third Mehl, Anand ~ The Song Of Bliss:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਅਨੰਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਮੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: anand bheaa meree maae satiguroo mai paaeaa |
English: I am in ecstasy, O my mother, for I have found my True Guru.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਜੀਆ ਵਾਧਾਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: satigur ta paaeaa sehaj setee man vajeea vaadhaaeea |
English: I have found the True Guru, with intuitive ease, and my mind vibrates with the music of bliss.

Gurbani: ਰਾਗ ਰਤਨ ਪਰਵਾਰ ਪਰੀਆ ਸਬਦ ਗਾਵਣ ਆਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: raag ratan paravaar pareea sabad gaavan aaeea |
English: The jewelled melodies and their related celestial harmonies have come to sing the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੋ ਤ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਹਰੀ ਕੇਰਾ ਮਨਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabado ta gaavahu haree keraa man jinee vasaaeaa |
English: The Lord dwells within the minds of those who sing the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਮੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kahai naanak anand hoaa satiguroo mai paaeaa |1|
English: Says Nanak, I am in ecstasy, for I have found my True Guru. ||1||

Gurbani: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਤੂ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: e man meriaa too sadaa rahu har naale |
English: O my mind, remain always with the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲਿ ਰਹੁ ਤੂ ਮੰਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਦੂਖ ਸਭਿ ਵਿਸਾਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: har naal rahu too man mere dookh sabh visaaranaa |
English: Remain always with the Lord, O my mind, and all sufferings will be forgotten.

Gurbani: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਓਹੁ ਕਰੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਭਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: angeekaar ohu kare teraa kaaraj sabh savaaranaa |
English: He will accept You as His own, and all your affairs will be perfectly arranged.

Gurbani: ਸਭਨਾ ਗਲਾ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sabhanaa galaa samarath suaamee so kiau manahu visaare |
English: Our Lord and Master is all-powerful to do all things, so why forget Him from your mind?

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kahai naanak man mere sadaa rahu har naale |2|
English: Says Nanak, O my mind, remain always with the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਕਿਆ ਨਾਹੀ ਘਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: saache saahibaa kiaa naahee ghar terai |
English: O my True Lord and Master, what is there which is not in Your celestial home?

Gurbani: ਘਰਿ ਤ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੁ ਪਾਵਏ ॥
Transliteration: ghar ta terai sabh kichh hai jis dehi su paave |
English: Everything is in Your home; they receive, unto whom You give.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਲਾਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਏ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sifat salaah teree naam man vasaave |
English: Constantly singing Your Praises and Glories, Your Name is enshrined in the mind.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਵਾਜੇ ਸਬਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: naam jin kai man vasiaa vaaje sabad ghanere |
English: The divine melody of the Shabad vibrates for those, within whose minds the Naam abides.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕਿਆ ਨਾਹੀ ਘਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kahai naanak sache saahib kiaa naahee ghar terai |3|
English: Says Nanak, O my True Lord and Master, what is there which is not in Your home? ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: saachaa naam meraa aadhaaro |
English: The True Name is my only support.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਭੁਖਾ ਸਭਿ ਗਵਾਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: saach naam adhaar meraa jin bhukhaa sabh gavaaeea |
English: The True Name is my only support; it satisfies all hunger.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੁਖ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ਵਸਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਇਛਾ ਸਭਿ ਪੁਜਾਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: kar saant sukh man aae vasiaa jin ichhaa sabh pujaaeea |
English: It has brought peace and tranquility to my mind; it has fulfilled all my desires.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਜਿਸ ਦੀਆ ਏਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa kurabaan keetaa guroo vittahu jis deea ehi vaddiaaeea |
English: I am forever a sacrifice to the Guru, who possesses such glorious greatness.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਧਰਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: kahai naanak sunahu santahu sabad dharahu piaaro |
English: Says Nanak, listen, O Saints; enshrine love for the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੋ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: saachaa naam meraa aadhaaro |4|
English: The True Name is my only support. ||4||

Gurbani: ਵਾਜੇ ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦ ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਸਭਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: vaaje panch sabad tith ghar sabhaagai |
English: The Panch Shabad, the five primal sounds, vibrate in that blessed house.

Gurbani: ਘਰਿ ਸਭਾਗੈ ਸਬਦ ਵਾਜੇ ਕਲਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਧਾਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: ghar sabhaagai sabad vaaje kalaa jit ghar dhaareea |
English: In that blessed house, the Shabad vibrates; He infuses His almighty power into it.

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਤੇ ਕਾਲੁ ਕੰਟਕੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: panch doot tudh vas keete kaal kanttak maariaa |
English: Through You, we subdue the five demons of desire, and slay Death, the torturer.

Gurbani: ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਸਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: dhur karam paaeaa tudh jin kau si naam har kai laage |
English: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny are attached to the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਹ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਆ ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਵਾਜੇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: kahai naanak teh sukh hoaa tith ghar anahad vaaje |5|
English: Says Nanak, they are at peace, and the unstruck sound current vibrates within their homes. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੀ ਲਿਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੇਹ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: saachee livai bin deh nimaanee |
English: Without the true love of devotion, the body is without honor.

Gurbani: ਦੇਹ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਲਿਵੈ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਵੇਚਾਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: deh nimaanee livai baajhahu kiaa kare vechaareea |
English: The body is dishonored without devotional love; what can the poor wretches do?

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਾਝੁ ਸਮਰਥ ਕੋਇ ਨਾਹੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਬਨਵਾਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: tudh baajh samarath koe naahee kripaa kar banavaareea |
English: No one except You is all-powerful; please bestow Your Mercy, O Lord of all nature.

Gurbani: ਏਸ ਨਉ ਹੋਰੁ ਥਾਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਸਵਾਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: es nau hor thaau naahee sabad laag savaareea |
English: There is no place of rest, other than the Name; attached to the Shabad, we are embellished with beauty.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਲਿਵੈ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਵੇਚਾਰੀਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: kahai naanak livai baajhahu kiaa kare vechaareea |6|
English: Says Nanak, without devotional love, what can the poor wretches do? ||6||

Gurbani: ਆਨੰਦੁ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: aanand aanand sabh ko kahai aanand guroo te jaaniaa |
English: Bliss, bliss - everyone talks of bliss; bliss is known only through the Guru.

Gurbani: ਜਾਣਿਆ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jaaniaa aanand sadaa gur te kripaa kare piaariaa |
English: Eternal bliss in known only through the Guru, when the Beloved Lord grants His Grace.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਟੇ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa kilavikh katte giaan anjan saariaa |
English: Granting His Grace, He cuts away our sins; He blesses us with the healing ointment of spiritual wisdom.

Gurbani: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਜਿਨ ਕਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਤੁਟਾ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚੈ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: andarahu jin kaa mohu tuttaa tin kaa sabad sachai savaariaa |
English: Those who eradicate attachment from within themselves, are adorned with the Shabad, the Word of the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਏਹੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: kahai naanak ehu anand hai aanand gur te jaaniaa |7|
English: Says Nanak, this alone is bliss - bliss which is known through the Guru. ||7||

Gurbani: ਬਾਬਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: baabaa jis too dehi soee jan paavai |
English: O Baba, he alone receives it, unto whom You give it.

Gurbani: ਪਾਵੈ ਤ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੋਰਿ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਵੇਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: paavai ta so jan dehi jis no hor kiaa kareh vechaariaa |
English: He alone receives it, unto whom You give it; what can the other poor wretched beings do?

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਇਕਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: eik bharam bhoole fireh deh dis ik naam laag savaariaa |
English: Some are deluded by doubt, wandering in the ten directions; some are adorned with attachment to the Naam.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਨੁ ਭਇਆ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਜਿਨਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee man bheaa niramal jinaa bhaanaa bhaave |
English: By Guru's Grace, the mind becomes immaculate and pure, for those who follow God's Will.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਵਏ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: kahai naanak jis dehi piaare soee jan paave |8|
English: Says Nanak, he alone receives it, unto whom You give it, O Beloved Lord. ||8||

Gurbani: ਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰਿਹੋ ਅਕਥ ਕੀ ਕਰਹ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: aavahu sant piaariho akath kee karah kahaanee |
English: Come, Beloved Saints, let us speak the Unspoken Speech of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਰਹ ਕਹਾਣੀ ਅਕਥ ਕੇਰੀ ਕਿਤੁ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: karah kahaanee akath keree kit duaarai paaeeai |
English: How can we speak the Unspoken Speech of the Lord? Through which door will we find Him?

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਉਪਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: tan man dhan sabh saup gur kau hukam maniai paaeeai |
English: Surrender body, mind, wealth, and everything to the Guru; obey the Order of His Will, and you will find Him.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨਿਹੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੇਰਾ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: hukam manihu guroo keraa gaavahu sachee baanee |
English: Obey the Hukam of the Guru's Command, and sing the True Word of His Bani.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਕਥਿਹੁ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: kahai naanak sunahu santahu kathihu akath kahaanee |9|
English: Says Nanak, listen, O Saints, and speak the Unspoken Speech of the Lord. ||9||

Gurbani: ਏ ਮਨ ਚੰਚਲਾ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: e man chanchalaa chaturaaee kinai na paaeaa |
English: O fickle mind, through cleverness, no one has found the Lord.

Gurbani: ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਿਨੈ ਤੂ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: chaturaaee na paaeaa kinai too sun man meriaa |
English: Through cleverness, no one has found Him; listen, O my mind.

Gurbani: ਏਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਏਤੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: eeh maaeaa mohanee jin et bharam bhulaaeaa |
English: This Maya is so fascinating; because of it, people wander in doubt.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਤ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਤਿਨੈ ਕੀਤੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਠਗਉਲੀ ਪਾਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa ta mohanee tinai keetee jin tthgaulee paaeea |
English: This fascinating Maya was created by the One who has administered this potion.

Gurbani: ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਤਿਸੈ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kurabaan keetaa tisai vittahu jin mohu meetthaa laaeaa |
English: I am a sacrifice to the One who has made emotional attachment sweet.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਨ ਚੰਚਲ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: kahai naanak man chanchal chaturaaee kinai na paaeaa |10|
English: Says Nanak, O fickle mind, no one has found Him through cleverness. ||10||

Gurbani: ਏ ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਤੂ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: e man piaariaa too sadaa sach samaale |
English: O beloved mind, contemplate the True Lord forever.

Gurbani: ਏਹੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਤੂ ਜਿ ਦੇਖਦਾ ਚਲੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: ehu kuttanb too ji dekhadaa chalai naahee terai naale |
English: This family which you see shall not go along with you.

Gurbani: ਸਾਥਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਚਲੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਕਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: saath terai chalai naahee tis naal kiau chit laaeeai |
English: They shall not go along with you, so why do you focus your attention on them?

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਕੰਮੁ ਮੂਲੇ ਨ ਕੀਚੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਅੰਤਿ ਪਛੋਤਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa kam moole na keechai jit ant pachhotaaeeai |
English: Don't do anything that you will regret in the end.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕਾ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਤੂ ਹੋਵੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: satiguroo kaa upades sun too hovai terai naale |
English: Listen to the Teachings of the True Guru - these shall go along with you.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤੂ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: kahai naanak man piaare too sadaa sach samaale |11|
English: Says Nanak, O beloved mind, contemplate the True Lord forever. ||11||

Gurbani: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: agam agocharaa teraa ant na paaeaa |
English: O inaccessible and unfathomable Lord, Your limits cannot be found.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤੋ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਿਨੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਤੂ ਜਾਣਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: anto na paaeaa kinai teraa aapanaa aap too jaanahe |
English: No one has found Your limits; only You Yourself know.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਖੇਲੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣਏ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jant sabh khel teraa kiaa ko aakh vakhaane |
English: All living beings and creatures are Your play; how can anyone describe You?

Gurbani: ਆਖਹਿ ਤ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਸਭੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aakheh ta vekheh sabh toohai jin jagat upaaeaa |
English: You speak, and You gaze upon all; You created the Universe.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤੂ ਸਦਾ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: kahai naanak too sadaa agam hai teraa ant na paaeaa |12|
English: Says Nanak, You are forever inaccessible; Your limits cannot be found. ||12||

Gurbani: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਖੋਜਦੇ ਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sur nar mun jan amrit khojade su amrit gur te paaeaa |
English: The angelic beings and the silent sages search for the Ambrosial Nectar; this Amrit is obtained from the Guru.

Gurbani: ਪਾਇਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕੀਨੀ ਸਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: paaeaa amrit gur kripaa keenee sachaa man vasaaeaa |
English: This Amrit is obtained, when the Guru grants His Grace; He enshrines the True Lord within the mind.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਉਪਾਏ ਇਕਿ ਵੇਖਿ ਪਰਸਣਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jant sabh tudh upaae ik vekh parasan aaeaa |
English: All living beings and creatures were created by You; only some come to see the Guru, and seek His blessing.

Gurbani: ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਚੂਕਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਭਲਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: lab lobh ahankaar chookaa satiguroo bhalaa bhaaeaa |
English: Their greed, avarice and egotism are dispelled, and the True Guru seems sweet.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਤੁਠਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: kahai naanak jis no aap tutthaa tin amrit gur te paaeaa |13|
English: Says Nanak, those with whom the Lord is pleased, obtain the Amrit, through the Guru. ||13||

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਚਾਲ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: bhagataa kee chaal niraalee |
English: The lifestyle of the devotees is unique and distinct.

Gurbani: ਚਾਲਾ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ਭਗਤਾਹ ਕੇਰੀ ਬਿਖਮ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਲਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: chaalaa niraalee bhagataah keree bikham maarag chalanaa |
English: The devotees' lifestyle is unique and distinct; they follow the most difficult path.

Gurbani: ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਤਜਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਬੋਲਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: lab lobh ahankaar taj trisanaa bahut naahee bolanaa |
English: They renounce greed, avarice, egotism and desire; they do not talk too much.

Gurbani: ਖੰਨਿਅਹੁ ਤਿਖੀ ਵਾਲਹੁ ਨਿਕੀ ਏਤੁ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: khaniahu tikhee vaalahu nikee et maarag jaanaa |
English: The path they take is sharper than a two-edged sword, and finer than a hair.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਿਨੀ ਆਪੁ ਤਜਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਵਾਸਨਾ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee jinee aap tajiaa har vaasanaa samaanee |
English: By Guru's Grace, they shed their selfishness and conceit; their hopes are merged in the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਚਾਲ ਭਗਤਾ ਜੁਗਹੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: kahai naanak chaal bhagataa jugahu jug niraalee |14|
English: Says Nanak, the lifestyle of the devotees, in each and every age, is unique and distinct. ||14||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਤੂ ਚਲਾਇਹਿ ਤਿਵ ਚਲਹ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹੋਰੁ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਣਾ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jiau too chalaaeihi tiv chalah suaamee hor kiaa jaanaa gun tere |
English: As You make me walk, so do I walk, O my Lord and Master; what else do I know of Your Glorious Virtues?

Gurbani: ਜਿਵ ਤੂ ਚਲਾਇਹਿ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਹ ਜਿਨਾ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਵਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: jiv too chalaaeihi tivai chalah jinaa maarag paavahe |
English: As You cause them to walk, they walk - You have placed them on the Path.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਨ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਇਹਿ ਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਵਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa jin naam laaeihi si har har sadaa dhiaavahe |
English: In Your Mercy, You attach them to the Naam; they meditate forever on the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਇਹਿ ਆਪਣੀ ਸਿ ਗੁਰਦੁਆਰੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: jis no kathaa sunaaeihi aapanee si guraduaarai sukh paavahe |
English: Those whom You cause to listen to Your sermon, find peace in the Gurdwara, the Guru's Gate.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਵਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: kahai naanak sache saahib jiau bhaavai tivai chalaavahe |15|
English: Says Nanak, O my True Lord and Master, you make us walk according to Your Will. ||15||

Gurbani: ਏਹੁ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: ehu sohilaa sabad suhaavaa |
English: This song of praise is the Shabad, the most beautiful Word of God.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੋ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabado suhaavaa sadaa sohilaa satiguroo sunaaeaa |
English: This beauteous Shabad is the everlasting song of praise, spoken by the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਏਹੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਧੁਰਹੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: ehu tin kai man vasiaa jin dhurahu likhiaa aaeaa |
English: This is enshrined in the minds of those who are so pre-destined by the Lord.

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਗਲਾ ਗਲੀ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: eik fireh ghanere kareh galaa galee kinai na paaeaa |
English: Some wander around, babbling on and on, but none obtain Him by babbling.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: kahai naanak sabad sohilaa satiguroo sunaaeaa |16|
English: Says Nanak, the Shabad, this song of praise, has been spoken by the True Guru. ||16||

Gurbani: ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹੋਏ ਸੇ ਜਨਾ ਜਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: pavit hoe se janaa jinee har dhiaaeaa |
English: Those humble beings who meditate on the Lord become pure.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹੋਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: har dhiaaeaa pavit hoe guramukh jinee dhiaaeaa |
English: Meditating on the Lord, they become pure; as Gurmukh, they meditate on Him.

Gurbani: ਪਵਿਤੁ ਮਾਤਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਹਿਤ ਸਿਉ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਬਾਈਆ ॥
Transliteration: pavit maataa pitaa kuttanb sahit siau pavit sangat sabaaeea |
English: They are pure, along with their mothers, fathers, family and friends; all their companions are pure as well.

Gurbani: ਕਹਦੇ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਸੁਣਦੇ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਸੇ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kahade pavit sunade pavit se pavit jinee man vasaaeaa |
English: Pure are those who speak, and pure are those who listen; those who enshrine it within their minds are pure.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੇ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: kahai naanak se pavit jinee guramukh har har dhiaaeaa |17|
English: Says Nanak, pure and holy are those who, as Gurmukh, meditate on the Lord, Har, Har. ||17||

Gurbani: ਕਰਮੀ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਹਜੈ ਸਹਸਾ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: karamee sehaj na aoopajai vin sahajai sahasaa na jaae |
English: By religious rituals, intuitive poise is not found; without intuitive poise, skepticism does not depart.

Gurbani: ਨਹ ਜਾਇ ਸਹਸਾ ਕਿਤੈ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਰਹੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: neh jaae sahasaa kitai sanjam rahe karam kamaae |
English: Skepticism does not depart by contrived actions; everybody is tired of performing these rituals.

Gurbani: ਸਹਸੈ ਜੀਉ ਮਲੀਣੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਤੁ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਧੋਤਾ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sahasai jeeo maleen hai kit sanjam dhotaa jaae |
English: The soul is polluted by skepticism; how can it be cleansed?

Gurbani: ਮੰਨੁ ਧੋਵਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਾਗਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹਹੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man dhovahu sabad laagahu har siau rahahu chit laae |
English: Wash your mind by attaching it to the Shabad, and keep your consciousness focused on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਹਜੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਇਹੁ ਸਹਸਾ ਇਵ ਜਾਇ ॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: kahai naanak gur parasaadee sehaj upajai ihu sahasaa iv jaae |18|
English: Says Nanak, by Guru's Grace, intuitive poise is produced, and this skepticism is dispelled. ||18||

Gurbani: ਜੀਅਹੁ ਮੈਲੇ ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ॥
Transliteration: jeeahu maile baaharahu niramal |
English: Inwardly polluted, and outwardly pure.

Gurbani: ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੀਅਹੁ ਤ ਮੈਲੇ ਤਿਨੀ ਜਨਮੁ ਜੂਐ ਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: baaharahu niramal jeeahu ta maile tinee janam jooai haariaa |
English: Those who are outwardly pure and yet polluted within, lose their lives in the gamble.

Gurbani: ਏਹ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਵਡਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਲਗਾ ਮਰਣੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: eeh tisanaa vaddaa rog lagaa maran manahu visaariaa |
English: They contract this terrible disease of desire, and in their minds, they forget about dying.

Gurbani: ਵੇਦਾ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਤਮੁ ਸੋ ਸੁਣਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਜਿਉ ਬੇਤਾਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: vedaa meh naam utam so suneh naahee fireh jiau betaaliaa |
English: In the Vedas, the ultimate objective is the Naam, the Name of the Lord; but they do not hear this, and they wander around like demons.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਿਨ ਸਚੁ ਤਜਿਆ ਕੂੜੇ ਲਾਗੇ ਤਿਨੀ ਜਨਮੁ ਜੂਐ ਹਾਰਿਆ ॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: kahai naanak jin sach tajiaa koorre laage tinee janam jooai haariaa |19|
English: Says Nanak, those who forsake Truth and cling to falsehood, lose their lives in the gamble. ||19||

Gurbani: ਜੀਅਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ॥
Transliteration: jeeahu niramal baaharahu niramal |
English: Inwardly pure, and outwardly pure.

Gurbani: ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਤ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੀਅਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਮਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: baaharahu ta niramal jeeahu niramal satigur te karanee kamaanee |
English: Those who are outwardly pure and also pure within, through the Guru, perform good deeds.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜ ਕੀ ਸੋਇ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨਸਾ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: koorr kee soe pahuchai naahee manasaa sach samaanee |
English: Not even an iota of falsehood touches them; their hopes are absorbed in the Truth.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਖਟਿਆ ਭਲੇ ਸੇ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: janam ratan jinee khattiaa bhale se vanajaare |
English: Those who earn the jewel of this human life, are the most excellent of merchants.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਿਨ ਮੰਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਲੇ ॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: kahai naanak jin man niramal sadaa raheh gur naale |20|
English: Says Nanak, those whose minds are pure, abide with the Guru forever. ||20||

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਸਿਖੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸੇਤੀ ਸਨਮੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: je ko sikh guroo setee sanamukh hovai |
English: If a Sikh turns to the Guru with sincere faith, as sunmukh

Gurbani: ਹੋਵੈ ਤ ਸਨਮੁਖੁ ਸਿਖੁ ਕੋਈ ਜੀਅਹੁ ਰਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: hovai ta sanamukh sikh koee jeeahu rahai gur naale |
English: if a Sikh turns to the Guru with sincere faith, as sunmukh, his soul abides with the Guru.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਧਿਆਏ ਅੰਤਰ ਆਤਮੈ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur ke charan hiradai dhiaae antar aatamai samaale |
English: Within his heart, he meditates on the lotus feet of the Guru; deep within his soul, he contemplates Him.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਛਡਿ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਪਰਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਏ ॥
Transliteration: aap chhadd sadaa rahai paranai gur bin avar na jaanai koe |
English: Renouncing selfishness and conceit, he remains always on the side of the Guru; he does not know anyone except the Guru.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਸੋ ਸਿਖੁ ਸਨਮੁਖੁ ਹੋਏ ॥੨੧॥
Transliteration: kahai naanak sunahu santahu so sikh sanamukh hoe |21|
English: Says Nanak, listen, O Saints: such a Sikh turns toward the Guru with sincere faith, and becomes sunmukh. ||21||

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਵੇਮੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: je ko gur te vemukh hovai bin satigur mukat na paavai |
English: One who turns away from the Guru, and becomes baymukh - without the True Guru, he shall not find liberation.

Gurbani: ਪਾਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਰ ਥੈ ਕੋਈ ਪੁਛਹੁ ਬਿਬੇਕੀਆ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: paavai mukat na hor thai koee puchhahu bibekeea jaae |
English: He shall not find liberation anywhere else either; go and ask the wise ones about this.

Gurbani: ਅਨੇਕ ਜੂਨੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਆਵੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: anek joonee bharam aavai vin satigur mukat na paae |
English: He shall wander through countless incarnations; without the True Guru, he shall not find liberation.

Gurbani: ਫਿਰਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਲਾਗਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: fir mukat paae laag charanee satiguroo sabad sunaae |
English: But liberation is attained, when one is attached to the feet of the True Guru, chanting the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥੨੨॥
Transliteration: kahai naanak veechaar dekhahu vin satigur mukat na paae |22|
English: Says Nanak, contemplate this and see, that without the True Guru, there is no liberation. ||22||

Gurbani: ਆਵਹੁ ਸਿਖ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਹੋ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: aavahu sikh satiguroo ke piaariho gaavahu sachee baanee |
English: Come, O beloved Sikhs of the True Guru, and sing the True Word of His Bani.

Gurbani: ਬਾਣੀ ਤ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: baanee ta gaavahu guroo keree baaneea sir baanee |
English: Sing the Guru's Bani, the supreme Word of Words.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਤਿਨਾ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: jin kau nadar karam hovai hiradai tinaa samaanee |
English: Those who are blessed by the Lord's Glance of Grace - their hearts are imbued with this Bani.

Gurbani: ਪੀਵਹੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਜਪਿਹੁ ਸਾਰਿਗਪਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: peevahu amrit sadaa rahahu har rang japihu saarigapaanee |
English: Drink in this Ambrosial Nectar, and remain in the Lord's Love forever; meditate on the Lord, the Sustainer of the world.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਦਾ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਏਹ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੨੩॥
Transliteration: kahai naanak sadaa gaavahu eeh sachee baanee |23|
English: Says Nanak, sing this True Bani forever. ||23||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਬਿਨਾ ਹੋਰ ਕਚੀ ਹੈ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: satiguroo binaa hor kachee hai baanee |
English: Without the True Guru, other songs are false.

Gurbani: ਬਾਣੀ ਤ ਕਚੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਹੋਰ ਕਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: baanee ta kachee satiguroo baajhahu hor kachee baanee |
English: The songs are false without the True Guru; all other songs are false.

Gurbani: ਕਹਦੇ ਕਚੇ ਸੁਣਦੇ ਕਚੇ ਕਚਂੀ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: kahade kache sunade kache kachanee aakh vakhaanee |
English: The speakers are false, and the listeners are false; those who speak and recite are false.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: har har nit kareh rasanaa kahiaa kachhoo na jaanee |
English: They may continually chant, 'Har, Har' with their tongues, but they do not know what they are saying.

Gurbani: ਚਿਤੁ ਜਿਨ ਕਾ ਹਿਰਿ ਲਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਬੋਲਨਿ ਪਏ ਰਵਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: chit jin kaa hir leaa maaeaa bolan pe ravaanee |
English: Their consciousness is lured by Maya; they are just reciting mechanically.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਹੋਰ ਕਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੨੪॥
Transliteration: kahai naanak satiguroo baajhahu hor kachee baanee |24|
English: Says Nanak, without the True Guru, other songs are false. ||24||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਤੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਹੀਰੇ ਜਿਤੁ ਜੜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa sabad ratan hai heere jit jarraau |
English: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is a jewel, studded with diamonds.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਮੰਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਏਹੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਮਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sabad ratan jit man laagaa ehu hoaa samaau |
English: The mind which is attached to this jewel, merges into the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਚੈ ਲਾਇਆ ਭਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sabad setee man miliaa sachai laaeaa bhaau |
English: One whose mind is attuned to the Shabad, enshrines love for the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਹੀਰਾ ਰਤਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aape heeraa ratan aape jis no dee bujhaae |
English: He Himself is the diamond, and He Himself is the jewel; one who is blessed, understands its value.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਹੈ ਹੀਰਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਜੜਾਉ ॥੨੫॥
Transliteration: kahai naanak sabad ratan hai heeraa jit jarraau |25|
English: Says Nanak, the Shabad is a jewel, studded with diamonds. ||25||

Gurbani: ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤਿ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਵਰਤਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: siv sakat aap upaae kai karataa aape hukam varataae |
English: He Himself created Shiva and Shakti, mind and matter; the Creator subjects them to His Command.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਵਰਤਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: hukam varataae aap vekhai guramukh kisai bujhaae |
English: Enforcing His Order, He Himself sees all. How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, come to know Him.

Gurbani: ਤੋੜੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: torre bandhan hovai mukat sabad man vasaae |
English: They break their bonds, and attain liberation; they enshrine the Shabad within their minds.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਏਕਸ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh jis no aap kare su hovai ekas siau liv laae |
English: Those whom the Lord Himself makes Gurmukh, lovingly focus their consciousness on the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥੨੬॥
Transliteration: kahai naanak aap karataa aape hukam bujhaae |26|
English: Says Nanak, He Himself is the Creator; He Himself reveals the Hukam of His Command. ||26||

Gurbani: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਪੁੰਨ ਪਾਪ ਬੀਚਾਰਦੇ ਤਤੈ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: simrit saasatr pun paap beechaarade tatai saar na jaanee |
English: The Simritees and the Shaastras discriminate between good and evil, but they do not know the true essence of reality.

Gurbani: ਤਤੈ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਤਤੈ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: tatai saar na jaanee guroo baajhahu tatai saar na jaanee |
English: They do not know the true essence of reality without the Guru; they do not know the true essence of reality.

Gurbani: ਤਿਹੀ ਗੁਣੀ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਸੁਤਾ ਸੁਤਿਆ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: tihee gunee sansaar bhram sutaa sutiaa rain vihaanee |
English: The world is asleep in the three modes and doubt; it passes the night of its life sleeping.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਜਾਗੇ ਜਿਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur kirapaa te se jan jaage jinaa har man vasiaa boleh amrit baanee |
English: Those humble beings remain awake and aware, within whose minds, by Guru's Grace, the Lord abides; they chant the Ambrosial Word of the Guru's Bani.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੋ ਤਤੁ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੈ ਜਾਗਤ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ॥੨੭॥
Transliteration: kahai naanak so tat paae jis no anadin har liv laagai jaagat rain vihaanee |27|
English: Says Nanak, they alone obtain the essence of reality, who night and day remain lovingly absorbed in the Lord; they pass the night of their life awake and aware. ||27||

Gurbani: ਮਾਤਾ ਕੇ ਉਦਰ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: maataa ke udar meh pratipaal kare so kiau manahu visaareeai |
English: He nourished us in the mother's womb; why forget Him from the mind?

Gurbani: ਮਨਹੁ ਕਿਉ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਏਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਜਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਆਹਾਰੁ ਪਹੁਚਾਵਏ ॥
Transliteration: manahu kiau visaareeai evadd daataa ji agan meh aahaar pahuchaave |
English: Why forget from the mind such a Great Giver, who gave us sustenance in the fire of the womb?

Gurbani: ਓਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਹੁ ਪੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੀ ਜਿਸ ਨਉ ਆਪਣੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਏ ॥
Transliteration: os no kihu pohi na sakee jis nau aapanee liv laave |
English: Nothing can harm one, whom the Lord inspires to embrace His Love.

Gurbani: ਆਪਣੀ ਲਿਵ ਆਪੇ ਲਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: aapanee liv aape laae guramukh sadaa samaaleeai |
English: He Himself is the love, and He Himself is the embrace; the Gurmukh contemplates Him forever.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਏਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ॥੨੮॥
Transliteration: kahai naanak evadd daataa so kiau manahu visaareeai |28|
English: Says Nanak, why forget such a Great Giver from the mind? ||28||

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਉਦਰ ਮਹਿ ਤੈਸੀ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jaisee agan udar meh taisee baahar maaeaa |
English: As is the fire within the womb, so is Maya outside.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਭ ਇਕੋ ਜੇਹੀ ਕਰਤੈ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa agan sabh iko jehee karatai khel rachaaeaa |
English: The fire of Maya is one and the same; the Creator has staged this play.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਾ ਜੰਮਿਆ ਪਰਵਾਰਿ ਭਲਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jaa tis bhaanaa taa jamiaa paravaar bhalaa bhaaeaa |
English: According to His Will, the child is born, and the family is very pleased.

Gurbani: ਲਿਵ ਛੁੜਕੀ ਲਗੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਅਮਰੁ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: liv chhurrakee lagee trisanaa maaeaa amar varataaeaa |
English: Love for the Lord wears off, and the child becomes attached to desires; the script of Maya runs its course.

Gurbani: ਏਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਭਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: eeh maaeaa jit har visarai mohu upajai bhaau doojaa laaeaa |
English: This is Maya, by which the Lord is forgotten; emotional attachment and love of duality well up.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਿਨਾ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਤਿਨੀ ਵਿਚੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨੯॥
Transliteration: kahai naanak gur parasaadee jinaa liv laagee tinee viche maaeaa paaeaa |29|
English: Says Nanak, by Guru's Grace, those who enshrine love for the Lord find Him, in the midst of Maya. ||29||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਅਮੁਲਕੁ ਹੈ ਮੁਲਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: har aap amulak hai mul na paaeaa jaae |
English: The Lord Himself is priceless; His worth cannot be estimated.

Gurbani: ਮੁਲਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ਕਿਸੈ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਰਹੇ ਲੋਕ ਵਿਲਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: mul na paaeaa jaae kisai vittahu rahe lok vilalaae |
English: His worth cannot be estimated, even though people have grown weary of trying.

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਿਰੁ ਸਉਪੀਐ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa satigur je milai tis no sir saupeeai vichahu aap jaae |
English: If you meet such a True Guru, offer your head to Him; your selfishness and conceit will be eradicated from within.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਜੀਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: jis daa jeeo tis mil rahai har vasai man aae |
English: Your soul belongs to Him; remain united with Him, and the Lord will come to dwell in your mind.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਅਮੁਲਕੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਗ ਤਿਨਾ ਕੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੩੦॥
Transliteration: har aap amulak hai bhaag tinaa ke naanakaa jin har palai paae |30|
English: The Lord Himself is priceless; very fortunate are those, O Nanak, who attain to the Lord. ||30||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਾਸਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਨੁ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har raas meree man vanajaaraa |
English: The Lord is my capital; my mind is the merchant.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਾਸਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਨੁ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਰਾਸਿ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: har raas meree man vanajaaraa satigur te raas jaanee |
English: The Lord is my capital, and my mind is the merchant; through the True Guru, I know my capital.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਤ ਜਪਿਹੁ ਜੀਅਹੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਖਟਿਹੁ ਦਿਹਾੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: har har nit japihu jeeahu laahaa khattihu dihaarree |
English: Meditate continually on the Lord, Har, Har, O my soul, and you shall collect your profits daily.

Gurbani: ਏਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: ehu dhan tinaa miliaa jin har aape bhaanaa |
English: This wealth is obtained by those who are pleasing to the Lord's Will.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਸਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਆ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ॥੩੧॥
Transliteration: kahai naanak har raas meree man hoaa vanajaaraa |31|
English: Says Nanak, the Lord is my capital, and my mind is the merchant. ||31||

Gurbani: ਏ ਰਸਨਾ ਤੂ ਅਨ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਚਿ ਰਹੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: e rasanaa too an ras raach rahee teree piaas na jaae |
English: O my tongue, you are engrossed in other tastes, but your thirsty desire is not quenched.

Gurbani: ਪਿਆਸ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਹੋਰਤੁ ਕਿਤੈ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਲੈ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: piaas na jaae horat kitai jichar har ras palai na paae |
English: Your thirst shall not be quenched by any means, until you attain the subtle essence of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇ ਪਲੈ ਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: har ras paae palai peeai har ras bahurr na trisanaa laagai aae |
English: If you do obtain the subtle essence of the Lord, and drink in this essence of the Lord, you shall not be troubled by desire again.

Gurbani: ਏਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਕਰਮੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: ehu har ras karamee paaeeai satigur milai jis aae |
English: This subtle essence of the Lord is obtained by good karma, when one comes to meet with the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹੋਰਿ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਸਭਿ ਵੀਸਰੇ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੩੨॥
Transliteration: kahai naanak hor an ras sabh veesare jaa har vasai man aae |32|
English: Says Nanak, all other tastes and essences are forgotten, when the Lord comes to dwell within the mind. ||32||

Gurbani: ਏ ਸਰੀਰਾ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਤੁਮ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਖੀ ਤਾ ਤੂ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: e sareeraa meriaa har tum meh jot rakhee taa too jag meh aaeaa |
English: O my body, the Lord infused His Light into you, and then you came into the world.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਖੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਤਾ ਤੂ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: har jot rakhee tudh vich taa too jag meh aaeaa |
English: The Lord infused His Light into you, and then you came into the world.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਮਾਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਪਿਤਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਜੀਉ ਉਪਾਇ ਜਗਤੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: har aape maataa aape pitaa jin jeeo upaae jagat dikhaaeaa |
English: The Lord Himself is your mother, and He Himself is your father; He created the created beings, and revealed the world to them.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਤਾ ਚਲਤੁ ਹੋਆ ਚਲਤੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee bujhiaa taa chalat hoaa chalat nadaree aaeaa |
English: By Guru's Grace, some understand, and then it's a show; it seems like just a show.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਰਚਿਆ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਤਾ ਤੂ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੩੩॥
Transliteration: kahai naanak srisatt kaa mool rachiaa jot raakhee taa too jag meh aaeaa |33|
English: Says Nanak, He laid the foundation of the Universe, and infused His Light, and then you came into the world. ||33||

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਭਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਗਮੁ ਸੁਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: man chaau bheaa prabh aagam suniaa |
English: My mind has become joyful, hearing of God's coming.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਉ ਸਖੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਬਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: har mangal gaau sakhee grihu mandar baniaa |
English: Sing the songs of joy to welcome the Lord, O my companions; my household has become the Lord's Mansion.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗਾਉ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਨਿਤ ਸਖੀਏ ਸੋਗੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪਏ ॥
Transliteration: har gaau mangal nit sakhee sog dookh na viaape |
English: Sing continually the songs of joy to welcome the Lord, O my companions, and sorrow and suffering will not afflict you.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਲਾਗੇ ਦਿਨ ਸਭਾਗੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਜਾਪਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur charan laage din sabhaage aapanaa pir jaape |
English: Blessed is that day, when I am attached to the Guru's feet and meditate on my Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਨਹਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਭੋਗੋ ॥
Transliteration: anahat baanee gur sabad jaanee har naam har ras bhogo |
English: I have come to know the unstruck sound current and the Word of the Guru's Shabad; I enjoy the sublime essence of the Lord, the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਜੋਗੋ ॥੩੪॥
Transliteration: kahai naanak prabh aap miliaa karan kaaran jogo |34|
English: Says Nanak, God Himself has met me; He is the Doer, the Cause of causes. ||34||

Gurbani: ਏ ਸਰੀਰਾ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਆਇ ਕੈ ਕਿਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: e sareeraa meriaa is jag meh aae kai kiaa tudh karam kamaaeaa |
English: O my body, why have you come into this world? What actions have you committed?

Gurbani: ਕਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਰੀਰਾ ਜਾ ਤੂ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: ki karam kamaaeaa tudh sareeraa jaa too jag meh aaeaa |
English: And what actions have you committed, O my body, since you came into this world?

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਿਆ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਨ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jin har teraa rachan rachiaa so har man na vasaaeaa |
English: The Lord who formed your form - you have not enshrined that Lord in your mind.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee har man vasiaa poorab likhiaa paaeaa |
English: By Guru's Grace, the Lord abides within the mind, and one's pre-ordained destiny is fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਏਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੋਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੩੫॥
Transliteration: kahai naanak ehu sareer paravaan hoaa jin satigur siau chit laaeaa |35|
English: Says Nanak, this body is adorned and honored, when one's consciousness is focused on the True Guru. ||35||

Gurbani: ਏ ਨੇਤ੍ਰਹੁ ਮੇਰਿਹੋ ਹਰਿ ਤੁਮ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਧਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: e netrahu meriho har tum meh jot dharee har bin avar na dekhahu koee |
English: O my eyes, the Lord has infused His Light into you; do not look upon any other than the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਕੋਈ ਨਦਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: har bin avar na dekhahu koee nadaree har nihaaliaa |
English: Do not look upon any other than the Lord; the Lord alone is worthy of beholding.

Gurbani: ਏਹੁ ਵਿਸੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਤੁਮ ਦੇਖਦੇ ਏਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: ehu vis sansaar tum dekhade ehu har kaa roop hai har roop nadaree aaeaa |
English: This whole world which you see is the image of the Lord; only the image of the Lord is seen.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਜਾ ਵੇਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee bujhiaa jaa vekhaa har ik hai har bin avar na koee |
English: By Guru's Grace, I understand, and I see only the One Lord; there is no one except the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਏਹਿ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਅੰਧ ਸੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਦਿਬ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੩੬॥
Transliteration: kahai naanak ehi netr andh se satigur miliai dib drisatt hoee |36|
English: Says Nanak, these eyes were blind; but meeting the True Guru, they became all-seeing. ||36||

Gurbani: ਏ ਸ੍ਰਵਣਹੁ ਮੇਰਿਹੋ ਸਾਚੈ ਸੁਨਣੈ ਨੋ ਪਠਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: e sravanahu meriho saachai sunanai no patthaae |
English: O my ears, you were created only to hear the Truth.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੈ ਸੁਨਣੈ ਨੋ ਪਠਾਏ ਸਰੀਰਿ ਲਾਏ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਸਤਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: saachai sunanai no patthaae sareer laae sunahu sat baanee |
English: To hear the Truth, you were created and attached to the body; listen to the True Bani.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਸੁਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਆ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਸਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: jit sunee man tan hariaa hoaa rasanaa ras samaanee |
English: Hearing it, the mind and body are rejuvenated, and the tongue is absorbed in Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਅਲਖ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sach alakh viddaanee taa kee gat kahee na jaae |
English: The True Lord is unseen and wondrous; His state cannot be described.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਹੋਵਹੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਸੁਨਣੈ ਨੋ ਪਠਾਏ ॥੩੭॥
Transliteration: kahai naanak amrit naam sunahu pavitr hovahu saachai sunanai no patthaae |37|
English: Says Nanak, listen to the Ambrosial Naam and become holy; you were created only to hear the Truth. ||37||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਗੁਫਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਖਿ ਕੈ ਵਾਜਾ ਪਵਣੁ ਵਜਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: har jeeo gufaa andar rakh kai vaajaa pavan vajaaeaa |
English: The Lord placed the soul to the cave of the body, and blew the breath of life into the musical instrument of the body.

Gurbani: ਵਜਾਇਆ ਵਾਜਾ ਪਉਣ ਨਉ ਦੁਆਰੇ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਕੀਏ ਦਸਵਾ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਰਖਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: vajaaeaa vaajaa paun nau duaare paragatt kee dasavaa gupat rakhaaeaa |
English: He blew the breath of life into the musical instrument of the body, and revealed the nine doors; but He kept the Tenth Door hidden.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਦੁਆਰੈ ਲਾਇ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਇਕਨਾ ਦਸਵਾ ਦੁਆਰੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: guraduaarai laae bhaavanee ikanaa dasavaa duaar dikhaaeaa |
English: Through the Gurdwara, the Guru's Gate, some are blessed with loving faith, and the Tenth Door is revealed to them.

Gurbani: ਤਹ ਅਨੇਕ ਰੂਪ ਨਾਉ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: teh anek roop naau nav nidh tis daa ant na jaaee paaeaa |
English: There are many images of the Lord, and the nine treasures of the Naam; His limits cannot be found.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੈ ਜੀਉ ਗੁਫਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਖਿ ਕੈ ਵਾਜਾ ਪਵਣੁ ਵਜਾਇਆ ॥੩੮॥
Transliteration: kahai naanak har piaarai jeeo gufaa andar rakh kai vaajaa pavan vajaaeaa |38|
English: Says Nanak, the Lord placed the soul to the cave of the body, and blew the breath of life into the musical instrument of the body. ||38||

Gurbani: ਏਹੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਸਾਚੈ ਘਰਿ ਗਾਵਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: ehu saachaa sohilaa saachai ghar gaavahu |
English: Sing this true song of praise in the true home of your soul.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਹੁ ਤ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਘਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਜਿਥੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: gaavahu ta sohilaa ghar saachai jithai sadaa sach dhiaavahe |
English: Sing the song of praise in your true home; meditate there on the True Lord forever.

Gurbani: ਸਚੋ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਬੁਝਾਵਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: sacho dhiaaveh jaa tudh bhaaveh guramukh jinaa bujhaavahe |
English: They alone meditate on You, O True Lord, who are pleasing to Your Will; as Gurmukh, they understand.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਵਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: eihu sach sabhanaa kaa khasam hai jis bakhase so jan paavahe |
English: This Truth is the Lord and Master of all; whoever is blessed, obtains it.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਸਚੈ ਘਰਿ ਗਾਵਹੇ ॥੩੯॥
Transliteration: kahai naanak sach sohilaa sachai ghar gaavahe |39|
English: Says Nanak, sing the true song of praise in the true home of your soul. ||39||

Gurbani: ਅਨਦੁ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਹੋ ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: anad sunahu vaddabhaageeho sagal manorath poore |
English: Listen to the song of bliss, O most fortunate ones; all your longings shall be fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਉਤਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਵਿਸੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: paarabraham prabh paaeaa utare sagal visoore |
English: I have obtained the Supreme Lord God, and all sorrows have been forgotten.

Gurbani: ਦੂਖ ਰੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪ ਉਤਰੇ ਸੁਣੀ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: dookh rog santaap utare sunee sachee baanee |
English: Pain, illness and suffering have departed, listening to the True Bani.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਸਾਜਨ ਭਏ ਸਰਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: sant saajan bhe sarase poore gur te jaanee |
English: The Saints and their friends are in ecstasy, knowing the Perfect Guru.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਤੇ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਕਹਤੇ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sunate puneet kahate pavit satigur rahiaa bharapoore |
English: Pure are the listeners, and pure are the speakers; the True Guru is all-pervading and permeating.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਲਾਗੇ ਵਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਤੂਰੇ ॥੪੦॥੧॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak gur charan laage vaaje anahad toore |40|1|
English: Prays Nanak, touching the Guru's Feet, the unstruck sound current of the celestial bugles vibrates and resounds. ||40||1||

[Ang 923 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Baba Sundar]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਸਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee sad |
English: Raamkalee, Sadd ~ The Call Of Death:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਜਗਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੋਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: jag daataa soe bhagat vachhal tihu loe jeeo |
English: He is the Great Giver of the Universe, the Lover of His devotees, throughout the three worlds.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਵਏ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur sabad samaave avar na jaanai koe jeeo |
English: One who is merged in the Word of the Guru's Shabad does not know any other.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰੋ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: avaro na jaaneh sabad gur kai ek naam dhiaavahe |
English: Dwelling upon the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he does not know any other; he meditates on the One Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੂ ਅੰਗਦ ਪਰਮ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਵਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: parasaad naanak guroo angad param padavee paavahe |
English: By the Grace of Guru Nanak and Guru Angad, Guru Amar Das obtained the supreme status.

Gurbani: ਆਇਆ ਹਕਾਰਾ ਚਲਣਵਾਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aaeaa hakaaraa chalanavaaraa har raam naam samaaeaa |
English: And when the call came for Him to depart, He merged in the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਗਿ ਅਮਰੁ ਅਟਲੁ ਅਤੋਲੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jag amar attal atol tthaakur bhagat te har paaeaa |1|
English: Through devotional worship in this world, the imperishable, immovable, immeasurable Lord is found. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਇਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਜਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har bhaanaa gur bhaaeaa gur jaavai har prabh paas jeeo |
English: The Guru gladly accepted the Lord's Will, and so the Guru easily reached the Lord God's Presence.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਹਿ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਹੁ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur kare har peh benatee meree paij rakhahu aradaas jeeo |
English: The True Guru prays to the Lord, "Please, save my honor. This is my prayer".

Gurbani: ਪੈਜ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨਹ ਕੇਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੋ ॥
Transliteration: paij raakhahu har janah keree har dehu naam niranjano |
English: Please save the honor of Your humble servant, O Lord; please bless him with Your Immaculate Name.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਿ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਹੋਇ ਬੇਲੀ ਜਮਦੂਤ ਕਾਲੁ ਨਿਖੰਜਨੋ ॥
Transliteration: ant chaladiaa hoe belee jamadoot kaal nikhanjano |
English: At this time of final departure, it is our only help and support; it destroys death, and the Messenger of Death.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਪਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: satiguroo kee benatee paaee har prabh sunee aradaas jeeo |
English: The Lord God heard the prayer of the True Guru, and granted His request.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har dhaar kirapaa satigur milaaeaa dhan dhan kahai saabaas jeeo |2|
English: The Lord showered His Mercy, and blended the True Guru with Himself; He said, "Blessed! Blessed! Wonderful!" ||2||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਪੁਤ ਭਾਈਹੋ ਮੇਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਆਉ ਮੈ ਪਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: mere sikh sunahu put bhaaeeho merai har bhaanaa aau mai paas jeeo |
English: Listen O my Sikhs, my children and Siblings of Destiny; it is my Lord's Will that I must now go to Him.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਇਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰੇ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har bhaanaa gur bhaaeaa meraa har prabh kare saabaas jeeo |
English: The Guru gladly accepted the Lord's Will, and my Lord God applauded Him.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੋਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat satigur purakh soee jis har prabh bhaanaa bhaave |
English: One who is pleased with the Lord God's Will is a devotee, the True Guru, the Primal Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਨੰਦ ਅਨਹਦ ਵਜਹਿ ਵਾਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਗਲਿ ਮੇਲਾਵਏ ॥
Transliteration: aanand anahad vajeh vaaje har aap gal melaave |
English: The unstruck sound current of bliss resounds and vibrates; the Lord hugs him close in His embrace.

Gurbani: ਤੁਸੀ ਪੁਤ ਭਾਈ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨਿ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਰਜਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: tusee put bhaaee paravaar meraa man vekhahu kar nirajaas jeeo |
English: O my children, siblings and family, look carefully in your minds, and see.

Gurbani: ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਜਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: dhur likhiaa paravaanaa firai naahee gur jaae har prabh paas jeeo |3|
English: The pre-ordained death warrant cannot be avoided; the Guru is going to be with the Lord God. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਭਾਣੈ ਆਪਣੈ ਬਹਿ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ਸਦਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: satigur bhaanai aapanai beh paravaar sadaaeaa |
English: The True Guru, in His Own Sweet Will, sat up and summoned His family.

Gurbani: ਮਤ ਮੈ ਪਿਛੈ ਕੋਈ ਰੋਵਸੀ ਸੋ ਮੈ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: mat mai pichhai koee rovasee so mai mool na bhaaeaa |
English: Let no one weep for me after I am gone. That would not please me at all.

Gurbani: ਮਿਤੁ ਪੈਝੈ ਮਿਤੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਿਤ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
Transliteration: mit paijhai mit bigasai jis mit kee paij bhaave |
English: When a friend receives a robe of honor, then his friends are pleased with his honor.

Gurbani: ਤੁਸੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਪੁਤ ਭਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਪੈਨਾਵਏ ॥
Transliteration: tusee veechaar dekhahu put bhaaee har satiguroo painaave |
English: Consider this and see, O my children and siblings; the Lord has given the True Guru the robe of supreme honor.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਪਰਤਖਿ ਹੋਦੈ ਬਹਿ ਰਾਜੁ ਆਪਿ ਟਿਕਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: satiguroo paratakh hodai beh raaj aap ttikaaeaa |
English: The True Guru Himself sat up, and appointed the successor to the Throne of Raja Yoga, the Yoga of Meditation and Success.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਸਿਖ ਬੰਧਪ ਪੁਤ ਭਾਈ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: sabh sikh bandhap put bhaaee raamadaas pairee paaeaa |4|
English: All the Sikhs, relatives, children and siblings have fallen at the Feet of Guru Ram Das. ||4||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਮੈ ਪਿਛੈ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕਰਿਅਹੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: ante satigur boliaa mai pichhai keeratan kariahu nirabaan jeeo |
English: Finally, the True Guru said, "When I am gone, sing Kirtan in Praise of the Lord, in Nirvaanaa."

Gurbani: ਕੇਸੋ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਸਦਿਅਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਪੜਹਿ ਪੁਰਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: keso gopaal panddit sadiahu har har kathaa parreh puraan jeeo |
English: Call in the long-haired scholarly Saints of the Lord, to read the sermon of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਪੜੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਬੇਬਾਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
Transliteration: har kathaa parreeai har naam suneeai bebaan har rang gur bhaave |
English: Read the sermon of the Lord, and listen to the Lord's Name; the Guru is pleased with love for the Lord.

Gurbani: ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪਤਲਿ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਦੀਵਾ ਫੁਲ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਿ ਪਾਵਏ ॥
Transliteration: pindd patal kiriaa deevaa ful har sar paave |
English: Do not bother with offering rice-balls on leaves, lighting lamps, and other rituals like floating the body out on the Ganges; instead, let my remains be given up to the Lord's Pool.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਭਾਇਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har bhaaeaa satigur boliaa har miliaa purakh sujaan jeeo |
English: The Lord was pleased as the True Guru spoke; he was blended then with the all-knowing Primal Lord God.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਸੋਢੀ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਦੀਆ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਸਚੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: raamadaas sodtee tilak deea gurasabad sach neesaan jeeo |5|
English: The Guru then blessed the Sodhi Ram Das with the ceremonial tilak mark, the insignia of the True Word of the Shabad. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਜਿ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਲਈ ਰਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur purakh ji boliaa gurasikhaa man lee rajaae jeeo |
English: And as the True Guru, the Primal Lord spoke, and the Gursikhs obeyed His Will.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਰੀ ਪੁਤੁ ਸਨਮੁਖੁ ਹੋਇਆ ਰਾਮਦਾਸੈ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: moharee put sanamukh hoeaa raamadaasai pairee paae jeeo |
English: His son Mohri turned sunmukh, and become obedient to Him; he bowed, and touched Ram Das' feet.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਪਵੈ ਪੈਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੇਰੀ ਜਿਥੈ ਗੁਰੂ ਆਪੁ ਰਖਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabh pavai pairee satiguroo keree jithai guroo aap rakhiaa |
English: Then, everyone bowed and touched the feet of Ram Das, into whom the Guru infused His essence.

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਕਰਿ ਬਖੀਲੀ ਨਿਵੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਆਣਿ ਨਿਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: koee kar bakheelee nivai naahee fir satiguroo aan nivaaeaa |
English: And any that did not bow then because of envy - later, the True Guru brought them around to bow in humility.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਦੀਈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ ਰਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har gureh bhaanaa deeee vaddiaaee dhur likhiaa lekh rajaae jeeo |
English: It pleased the Guru, the Lord, to bestow glorious greatness upon Him; such was the pre-ordained destiny of the Lord's Will.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੬॥੧॥
Transliteration: kahai sundar sunahu santahu sabh jagat pairee paae jeeo |6|1|
English: Says Sundar, listen, O Saints: all the world fell at His feet. ||6||1||

[Ang 924 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 chhant |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl, Chhant:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸਾਜਨੜਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਜਨੜਾ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਖਲੋਇਅੜਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਜਨੜਾ ॥
Transliteration: saajanarraa meraa saajanarraa nikatt khaloeiarraa meraa saajanarraa |
English: Friend, my Friend - standing so near to me is my Friend!

Gurbani: ਜਾਨੀਅੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਨੀਅੜਾ ਨੈਣ ਅਲੋਇਅੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਨੀਅੜਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaaneearraa har jaaneearraa nain aloeiarraa har jaaneearraa |
English: Beloved, the Lord my Beloved - with my eyes, I have seen the Lord, my Beloved!

Gurbani: ਨੈਣ ਅਲੋਇਆ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸੋਇਆ ਅਤਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਗੂੜਾ ॥
Transliteration: nain aloeaa ghatt ghatt soeaa at amrit pria goorraa |
English: With my eyes I have seen Him, sleeping upon the bed within each and every heart; my Beloved is the sweetest ambrosial nectar.

Gurbani: ਨਾਲਿ ਹੋਵੰਦਾ ਲਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੰਦਾ ਸੁਆਉ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਮੂੜਾ ॥
Transliteration: naal hovandaa leh na sakandaa suaau na jaanai moorraa |
English: He is with all, but he cannot be found; the fool does not know His taste.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦਿ ਮਾਤਾ ਹੋਛੀ ਬਾਤਾ ਮਿਲਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਭਰਮ ਧੜਾ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mad maataa hochhee baataa milan na jaaee bharam dharraa |
English: Intoxicated with the wine of Maya, the mortal babbles on about trivial affairs; giving in to the illusion, he cannot meet the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੂਝੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਸਭ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਖੜਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak gur bin naahee soojhai har saajan sabh kai nikatt kharraa |1|
English: Says Nanak, without the Guru, he cannot understand the Lord, the Friend who is standing near everyone. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੋਬਿੰਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: gobindaa mere gobindaa praan adhaaraa mere gobindaa |
English: God, my God - the Support of the breath of life is my God.

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ਦਾਨ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: kirapaalaa mere kirapaalaa daan daataaraa mere kirapaalaa |
English: Merciful Lord, my Merciful Lord - the Giver of gifts is my Merciful Lord.

Gurbani: ਦਾਨ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੋਹਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: daan daataaraa apar apaaraa ghatt ghatt antar sohaniaa |
English: The Giver of gifts is infinite and unlimited; deep within each and every heart, He is so beautiful!

Gurbani: ਇਕ ਦਾਸੀ ਧਾਰੀ ਸਬਲ ਪਸਾਰੀ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਲੈ ਮੋਹਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: eik daasee dhaaree sabal pasaaree jeea jant lai mohaniaa |
English: He created Maya, His slave, so powerfully pervasive - she has enticed all beings and creatures.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਰਾਖੈ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਭਾਖੈ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jis no raakhai so sach bhaakhai gur kaa sabad beechaaraa |
English: One whom the Lord saves, chants the True Name, and contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak jo prabh kau bhaanaa tis hee kau prabh piaaraa |2|
English: Says Nanak, one who is pleasing to God - God is very dear to him. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਾਣੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਣੋ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਮਾਣੋ ॥
Transliteration: maano prabh maano mere prabh kaa maano |
English: I take pride, I take pride in God; I take pride in my God.

Gurbani: ਜਾਣੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੋ ॥
Transliteration: jaano prabh jaano suaamee sugharr sujaano |
English: Wise, God is wise; my Lord and Master is all-wise, and all-knowing.

Gurbani: ਸੁਘੜ ਸੁਜਾਨਾ ਸਦ ਪਰਧਾਨਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: sugharr sujaanaa sad paradhaanaa amrit har kaa naamaa |
English: All-wise and all-knowing, and forever supreme; the Name of the Lord is Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਚਾਖਿ ਅਘਾਣੇ ਸਾਰਿਗਪਾਣੇ ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਭਾਗ ਮਥਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: chaakh aghaane saarigapaane jin kai bhaag mathaanaa |
English: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny recorded upon their foreheads, taste it, and are satisfied with the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਸਗਲ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਮਾਣੋ ॥
Transliteration: tin hee paaeaa tineh dhiaaeaa sagal tisai kaa maano |
English: They meditate on Him, and find Him; they place all their pride in Him.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਥਿਰੁ ਤਖਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਸਚੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਦੀਬਾਣੋ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak thir takhat nivaasee sach tisai deebaano |3|
English: Says Nanak, He is seated on His eternal throne; True is His royal court. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮੰਗਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਗਲਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਮੰਗਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: mangalaa har mangalaa mere prabh kai suneeai mangalaa |
English: The song of joy, the Lord's song of joy; listen to the song of joy of my God.

Gurbani: ਸੋਹਿਲੜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੋਹਿਲੜਾ ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨੀਐ ਸੋਹਿਲੜਾ ॥
Transliteration: sohilarraa prabh sohilarraa anahad dhuneeai sohilarraa |
English: The wedding song, God's wedding song; the unstruck sound current of His wedding song resounds.

Gurbani: ਅਨਹਦ ਵਾਜੇ ਸਬਦ ਅਗਾਜੇ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਵਧਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: anahad vaaje sabad agaaje nit nit jiseh vadhaaee |
English: The unstruck sound current vibrates, and the Word of the Shabad resounds; there is continuous, continual rejoicing.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: so prabh dhiaaeeai sabh kichh paaeeai marai na aavai jaaee |
English: Meditating on that God, everything is obtained; He does not die, or come or go.

Gurbani: ਚੂਕੀ ਪਿਆਸਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੁ ਨਿਰਗੁਨੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: chookee piaasaa pooran aasaa guramukh mil niraguneeai |
English: Thirst is quenched, and hopes are fulfilled; the Gurmukh meets with the absolute, unmanifest Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਘਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਕੈ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਸੁਨੀਐ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak ghar prabh mere kai nit nit mangal suneeai |4|1|
English: Says Nanak, in the Home of my God, the songs of joy are continuously, continually heard. ||4||1||

[Ang 925 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਮਨਾ ਖਿਨੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: har har dhiaae manaa khin na visaareeai |
English: Meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, O mind; don't forget Him, even for an instant.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਮਾ ਕੰਠਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: raam raamaa raam ramaa kantth ur dhaareeai |
English: Enshrine the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam, Raam, within your heart and throat.

Gurbani: ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੋ ॥
Transliteration: aur dhaar har har purakh pooran paarabraham niranjano |
English: Enshrine within your heart the Primal Lord, Har, Har, the all-pervading, supreme, immaculate Lord God.

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਪਾਪ ਹਰਤਾ ਦੁਸਹ ਦੁਖ ਭਵ ਖੰਡਨੋ ॥
Transliteration: bhai door karataa paap harataa dusah dukh bhav khanddano |
English: He sends fear far away; He is the Destroyer of sin; He eradicates the unbearable pains of the terrifying world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਜਗਦੀਸ ਈਸ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ਮਾਧੋ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: jagadees ees guopaal maadho gun govind veechaareeai |
English: Contemplate the Lord of the World, the Cherisher of the World, the Lord, the Virtuous Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਚਿਤਾਰੀਐ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak mil sang saadhoo dinas rain chitaareeai |1|
English: Prays Nanak, joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, remember the Lord, day and night. ||1||

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਆਸਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal aadhaar jan kaa aasaraa |
English: His lotus feet are the support and anchor of His humble servants.

Gurbani: ਮਾਲੁ ਮਿਲਖ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਨੰਤ ਧਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: maal milakh bhanddaar naam anant dharaa |
English: He takes the Naam, the Name of the Infinite Lord, as his wealth, property and treasure.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਰਹਰ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਏਕ ਨਰਾਇਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: naam narahar nidhaan jin kai ras bhog ek naraaeinaa |
English: Those who have the treasure of the Lord's Name, enjoy the taste of the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਰਸ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਅਨੰਤ ਬੀਠਲ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਧਿਆਇਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: ras roop rang anant beetthal saas saas dhiaaeinaa |
English: They meditate on the Infinite Lord with each and every breath, as their pleasure, joy and beauty.

Gurbani: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਹਰਣਾ ਨਾਮ ਪੁਨਹਚਰਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਹਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kilavikh haranaa naam punahacharanaa naam jam kee traas haraa |
English: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the Destroyer of sins, the only deed of redemption. The Naam drives out the fear of the Messenger of Death.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਸਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲਹ ਆਸਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak raas jan kee charan kamalah aasaraa |2|
English: Prays Nanak, the support of His lotus feet is the capital of His humble servant. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਨਈ ॥
Transliteration: gun beant suaamee tere koe na jaanee |
English: Your Glorious Virtues are endless, O my Lord and Master; no one knows them all.

Gurbani: ਦੇਖਿ ਚਲਤ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੁਣਿ ਭਗਤ ਵਖਾਨਈ ॥
Transliteration: dekh chalat deaal sun bhagat vakhaanee |
English: Seeing and hearing of Your wondrous plays, O Merciful Lord, Your devotees narrate them.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਝੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਪੁਰਖਪਤਿ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jant sabh tujh dhiaaveh purakhapat paramesaraa |
English: All beings and creatures meditate on You, O Primal Transcendent Lord, Master of men.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਏਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਜਗਦੀਸਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sarab jaachik ek daataa karunaa mai jagadeesaraa |
English: All beings are beggars; You are the One Giver, O Lord of the Universe, Embodiment of mercy.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਤੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਸੋਈ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਮਾਨਈ ॥
Transliteration: saadhoo sant sujaan soee jiseh prabh jee maanee |
English: He alone is holy, a Saint, a truly wise person, who is accepted by the Dear Lord.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸੋਇ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਪਛਾਨਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak karahu kirapaa soe tujheh pachhaanee |3|
English: Prays Nanak, they alone realize You, unto whom You show Mercy. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: mohi niragun anaath saranee aaeaa |
English: I am unworthy and without any master; I seek Your Sanctuary, Lord.

Gurbani: ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bal bal bal guradev jin naam drirraaeaa |
English: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Divine Guru, who has implanted the Naam within me.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਥੀਆ ਸਰਬ ਇਛਾ ਪੁੰਨੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur naam deea kusal theea sarab ichhaa puneea |
English: The Guru blessed me with the Naam; happiness came, and all my desires were fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਜਲਨੇ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਆਈ ਮਿਲੇ ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jalane bujhaaee saant aaee mile chiree vichhuniaa |
English: The fire of desire has been quenched, and peace and tranquility have come; after such a long separation, I have met my Lord again.

Gurbani: ਆਨੰਦ ਹਰਖ ਸਹਜ ਸਾਚੇ ਮਹਾ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aanand harakh sehaj saache mahaa mangal gun gaaeaa |
English: I have found ecstasy, pleasure and true intuitive poise, singing the great glories, the song of bliss of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak naam prabh kaa gur poore te paaeaa |4|2|
English: Prays Nanak, I have obtained the Name of God from the Perfect Guru. ||4||2||

[Ang 925 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰੁਣ ਝੁਣੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਨਾਹਦੁ ਨਿਤ ਉਠਿ ਗਾਈਐ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ॥
Transliteration: run jhuno sabad anaahad nit utth gaaeeai santan kai |
English: Rise early each morning, and with the Saints, sing the melodious harmony, the unstruck sound current of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਸਭਿ ਦੋਖ ਬਿਨਾਸਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤਨ ਕੈ ॥
Transliteration: kilavikh sabh dokh binaasan har naam japeeai gur mantan kai |
English: All sins and sufferings are erased, chanting the Lord's Name, under Guru's Instructions.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੀਜੈ ਅਮਿਉ ਪੀਜੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਅਰਾਧੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: har naam leejai amiau peejai rain dinas araadheeai |
English: Dwell upon the Lord's Name, and drink in the Nectar; day and night, worship and adore Him.

Gurbani: ਜੋਗ ਦਾਨ ਅਨੇਕ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਲਗਿ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲਹ ਸਾਧੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: jog daan anek kiriaa lag charan kamalah saadheeai |
English: The merits of Yoga, charity and religious rituals are obtained by grasping His lotus feet.

Gurbani: ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਮੋਹਨ ਦੂਖ ਸਗਲੇ ਪਰਹਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: bhaau bhagat deaal mohan dookh sagale paraharai |
English: Loving devotion to the merciful, enticing Lord takes away all pain.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਰੈ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨਰਹਰੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak tarai saagar dhiaae suaamee naraharai |1|
English: Prays Nanak, cross over the world-ocean, meditating on the Lord, your Lord and Master. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਿਮਰਣੁ ਭਗਤ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: sukh saagar gobind simaran bhagat gaaveh gun tere raam |
English: Meditation on the Lord of the Universe is an ocean of peace; Your devotees sing Your Glorious Praises, Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੇ ਪਾਏ ਸੂਖ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: anad mangal gur charanee laage paae sookh ghanere raam |
English: Ecstasy, bliss and great happiness are obtained by grasping hold of the Guru's feet.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਦੂਖ ਹਰਿਆ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sukh nidhaan miliaa dookh hariaa kripaa kar prabh raakhiaa |
English: Meeting with the treasure of peace, their pains are taken away; granting His Grace, God protects them.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਲਾਗਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਭਾਖਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: har charan laagaa bhram bhau bhaagaa har naam rasanaa bhaakhiaa |
English: Those who grasp the Lord's feet - their fears and doubts run away, and they chant the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: har ek chitavai prabh ek gaavai har ek drisattee aaeaa |
English: He thinks of the One Lord, and he sings of the One God; he gazes upon the One Lord alone.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਰੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak prabh karee kirapaa pooraa satigur paaeaa |2|
English: Prays Nanak, God has granted His Grace, and I have found the Perfect True Guru. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: mil raheeai prabh saadh janaa mil har keeratan suneeai raam |
English: Meet with the holy, humble servants of God; meeting with the Lord, listen to the Kirtan of His Praises.

Gurbani: ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਾਮੋਦਰ ਮਾਧੋ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਨੀਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: deaal prabhoo daamodar maadho ant na paaeeai guneeai raam |
English: God is the Merciful Master, the Lord of wealth; there is no end to His Virtues.

Gurbani: ਦਇਆਲ ਦੁਖ ਹਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਗਲ ਦੋਖ ਨਿਵਾਰਣੋ ॥
Transliteration: deaal dukh har saran daataa sagal dokh nivaarano |
English: The Merciful Lord is the Dispeller of pain, the Giver of Sanctuary, the Eradicator of all evil.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹ ਸੋਗ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਬਿਖੜੇ ਜਪਤ ਨਾਮ ਉਧਾਰਣੋ ॥
Transliteration: moh sog vikaar bikharre japat naam udhaarano |
English: Emotional attachment, sorrow, corruption and pain - chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one is saved from these.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਭ ਰੇਣ ਥੀਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabh jeea tere prabhoo mere kar kirapaa sabh ren theevaa |
English: All beings are Yours, O my God; bless me with Your Mercy, that I may become the dust under the feet of all men.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਇਆ ਕੀਜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak prabh meaa keejai naam teraa jap jeevaa |3|
English: Prays Nanak, O God, be kind to me, that I may chant Your Name, and live. ||3||

Gurbani: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਅਪਣੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: raakh lee prabh bhagat janaa apanee charanee laae raam |
English: God saves His humble devotees, attaching them to His feet.

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਅਪਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਿਮਰਹ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar apanaa prabh simarah eko naam dhiaae raam |
English: Twenty-four hours a day, they meditate in remembrance on their God; they meditae on the One Name.

Gurbani: ਧਿਆਇ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਰੇ ਭਵਜਲ ਰਹੇ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: dhiaae so prabh tare bhavajal rahe aavan jaanaa |
English: Meditating on that God, they cross over the terrifying world-ocean, and their comings and goings cease.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਲਗਾ ਮੀਠਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sukh kaliaan keeratan prabh lagaa meetthaa bhaanaa |
English: They enjoy eternal peace and pleasure, singing the Kirtan of God's Praises; His Will seems so sweet to them.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਆਸ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabh ichh punee aas pooree mile satigur pooriaa |
English: All my desires are fulfilled, meeting with the Perfect True Guru.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੂਖ ਵਿਸੂਰਿਆ ॥੪॥੩॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak prabh aap mele fir naahee dookh visooriaa |4|3|
English: Prays Nanak, God has blended me with Himself; I shall never suffer pain or sorrow again. ||4||3||

[Ang 926 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 chhant |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl, Chhant.

[Ang 926 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal saranaagatee anad mangal gun gaam |
English: In the Sanctuary of His lotus feet, I sing His Glorious Praises in ecstasy and bliss.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਬਿਪਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਰਣ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak prabh aaraadheeai bipat nivaaran raam |1|
English: O Nanak, worship God in adoration, the Eradicator of misfortune. ||1||

[Ang 926 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: chhant |
English: Chhant:

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਪਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਰਣੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: prabh bipat nivaarano tis bin avar na koe jeeo |
English: God is the Eradicator of misfortune; there is none other than Him.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਸੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa har simareeai jal thal maheeal soe jeeo |
English: Forever and ever, remember the Lord in meditation; He is permeating the water, the land and the sky.

Gurbani: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: jal thal maheeal poor rahiaa ik nimakh manahu na veesarai |
English: He is permeating and pervading the water, the land and the sky; do not forget Him from your mind, even for an instant.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਲਾਗੇ ਦਿਨ ਸਭਾਗੇ ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣ ਜਗਦੀਸਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur charan laage din sabhaage sarab gun jagadeesarai |
English: Blessed was that day, when I grasped the Guru's feet; all virtues rest in the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਹੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: kar sev sevak dinas rainee tis bhaavai so hoe jeeo |
English: So serve Him day and night, O servant; whatever pleases Him, happens.

Gurbani: ਬਲਿ ਜਾਇ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੁਖਹ ਦਾਤੇ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bal jaae naanak sukhah daate paragaas man tan hoe jeeo |1|
English: Nanak is a sacrifice to the Giver of peace; his mind and body are enlightened. ||1||

[Ang 926 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੁਖੀ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਸੋਚ ॥
Transliteration: har simarat man tan sukhee binasee duteea soch |
English: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, the mind and body find peace; the thought of duality is dispelled.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਟੇਕ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ਕੀ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਸੰਕਟ ਮੋਚ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak ttek guopaal kee govind sankatt moch |1|
English: Nanak takes the support of the Lord of the World, the Lord of the Universe, the Destroyer of troubles. ||1||

[Ang 926 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: chhant |
English: Chhant:

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਸੰਕਟ ਕਾਟੇ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਦਇਆਲ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhai sankatt kaatte naaraaein deaal jeeo |
English: The Merciful Lord has eradicated my fears and troubles.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਆਨੰਦ ਗਾਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har gun aanand gaae prabh deenaa naath pratipaal jeeo |
English: In ecstasy, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; God is the Cherisher, the Master of the meek.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਅਚੁਤ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਏਕੋ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਸਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: pratipaal achut purakh eko tiseh siau rang laagaa |
English: The Cherishing Lord is imperishable, the One and only Primal Lord; I am imbued with His Love.

Gurbani: ਕਰ ਚਰਨ ਮਸਤਕੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਸਦਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: kar charan masatak mel leene sadaa anadin jaagaa |
English: When I placed my hands and forehead upon His Feet, He blended me with Himself; I became awake and aware forever, night and day.

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਤਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: jeeo pindd grihu thaan tis kaa tan joban dhan maal jeeo |
English: My soul, body, household and home belong to Him, along with my body, youth, wealth and property.

Gurbani: ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਇ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sad sadaa bal jaae naanak sarab jeea pratipaal jeeo |2|
English: Forever and ever, Nanak is a sacrifice to Him, who cherishes and nurtures all beings. ||2||

[Ang 926 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਰਸਨਾ ਉਚਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਵਖਿਆਨ ॥
Transliteration: rasanaa ucharai har hare gun govind vakhiaan |
English: My tongue chants the Name of the Lord, and chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਕੜੀ ਟੇਕ ਏਕ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਰਖੈ ਨਿਦਾਨ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak pakarree ttek ek paramesar rakhai nidaan |1|
English: Nanak has grasped the sheltering support of the One Transcendent Lord, who shall save him in the end. ||1||

[Ang 926 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: chhant |
English: Chhant:

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਖਕੋ ਅੰਚਲਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਲਾਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: so suaamee prabh rakhako anchal taa kai laag jeeo |
English: He is God, our Lord and Master, our Saving Grace. Grab hold of the hem of His robe.

Gurbani: ਭਜੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਦੇਵ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਤਿਆਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhaj saadhoo sang deaal dev man kee mat tiaag jeeo |
English: Vibrate, and meditate on the Merciful Divine Lord in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; renounce your intellectual mind.

Gurbani: ਇਕ ਓਟ ਕੀਜੈ ਜੀਉ ਦੀਜੈ ਆਸ ਇਕ ਧਰਣੀਧਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: eik ott keejai jeeo deejai aas ik dharaneedharai |
English: Seek the Support of the One Lord, and surrender your soul to Him; place your hopes only in the Sustainer of the World.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasange har naam range sansaar saagar sabh tarai |
English: Those who are imbued with the Lord's Name, in the Saadh Sangat, cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਛੂਟੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਦਾਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: janam maran bikaar chhootte fir na laagai daag jeeo |
English: The corrupting sins of birth and death are eradicated, and no stain ever sticks to them again.

Gurbani: ਬਲਿ ਜਾਇ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਪੂਰਨ ਥਿਰੁ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bal jaae naanak purakh pooran thir jaa kaa sohaag jeeo |3|
English: Nanak is a sacrifice to the Perfect Primal Lord; His marriage is eternal. ||3||

[Ang 927 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਧਰਮ ਅਰਥ ਅਰੁ ਕਾਮ ਮੋਖ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਨਾਥ ॥
Transliteration: dharam arath ar kaam mokh mukat padaarath naath |
English: Righteous faith, wealth, fulfilment of desires and salvation; the Lord bestows these four blessings.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਮਾਥ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sagal manorath pooriaa naanak likhiaa maath |1|
English: One who has such pre-ordained destiny upon his forehead, O Nanak, has all his desires fulfilled. ||1||

[Ang 927 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: chhant |
English: Chhant:

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਇਛ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੁੰਨੀਆ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਰਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: sagal ichh meree puneea miliaa niranjan raae jeeo |
English: All my desires are fulfilled, meeting with my Immaculate, Sovereign Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਹੋ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: anad bheaa vaddabhaageeho grihi pragatte prabh aae jeeo |
English: I am in ecstasy, O very fortunate ones; the Dear Lord has become manifest in my own home.

Gurbani: ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਲਾਲ ਆਏ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਕਮਾਏ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਕਿਆ ਗਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: grihi laal aae purab kamaae taa kee upamaa kiaa ganaa |
English: My Beloved has come to my home, because of my past actions; how can I count His Glories?

Gurbani: ਬੇਅੰਤ ਪੂਰਨ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਦਾਤਾ ਕਵਨ ਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਣ ਭਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: beant pooran sukh sehaj daataa kavan rasanaa gun bhanaa |
English: The Lord, the Giver of peace and intuition, is infinite and perfect; with what tongue can I describe His Glorious Virtues?

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਗਹਿ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: aape milaae geh kantth laae tis binaa nahee jaae jeeo |
English: He hugs me close in His embrace, and merges me into Himself; there is no place of rest other than Him.

Gurbani: ਬਲਿ ਜਾਇ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਤੇ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੪॥
