Transliteration: bal jaae naanak sadaa karate sabh meh rahiaa samaae jeeo |4|4|
English: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to the Creator, who is contained in, and permeating all. ||4||4||

[Ang 927 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raag raamakalee mahalaa 5 |
English: Raag Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਣ ਝੁੰਝਨੜਾ ਗਾਉ ਸਖੀ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: ran jhunjhanarraa gaau sakhee har ek dhiaavahu |
English: Sing the melodious harmonies, O my companions, and meditate on the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਮ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਖੀ ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦਿਅੜਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: satigur tum sev sakhee man chindiarraa fal paavahu |
English: Serve your True Guru, O my companions, and you shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires.

[Ang 927 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਰੁਤੀ ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 5 rutee salok |
English: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl, Ruti ~ The Seasons. Salok:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਬੰਦਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਾਛਉ ਸਾਧਹ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: kar bandan prabh paarabraham baachhau saadhah dhoor |
English: Bow to the Supreme Lord God, and seek the dust of the feet of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aap nivaar har har bhjau naanak prabh bharapoor |1|
English: Cast out your self-conceit, and vibrate, meditate, on the Lord, Har, Har. O Nanak, God is all-pervading. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਾਟਣ ਭੈ ਹਰਣ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kilavikh kaattan bhai haran sukh saagar har raae |
English: He is the Eradicator of sins, the Destroyer of fear, the Ocean of peace, the Sovereign Lord King.

Gurbani: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਨੀਤ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: deen deaal dukh bhanjano naanak neet dhiaae |2|
English: Merciful to the meek, the Destroyer of pain: O Nanak, always meditate on Him. ||2||

[Ang 927 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: chhant |
English: Chhant:

Gurbani: ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਹੋ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: jas gaavahu vaddabhaageeho kar kirapaa bhagavant jeeo |
English: Sing His Praises, O very fortunate ones, and the Dear Lord God shall bless you with His Mercy.

Gurbani: ਰੁਤੀ ਮਾਹ ਮੂਰਤ ਘੜੀ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰਤ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: rutee maah moorat gharree gun ucharat sobhaavant jeeo |
English: Blessed and auspicious is that season, that month, that moment, that hour, when you chant the Lord's Glorious Praises.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਧੰਨਿ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਜਿਨੀ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gun rang raate dhan te jan jinee ik man dhiaaeaa |
English: Blessed are those humble beings, who are imbued with love for His Praises, and who meditate single-mindedly on Him.

Gurbani: ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਭਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਜਿਨੀ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: safal janam bheaa tin kaa jinee so prabh paaeaa |
English: Their lives become fruitful, and they find that Lord God.

Gurbani: ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਨ ਤੁਲਿ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਪਾਪਾ ਹੰਤ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: pun daan na tul kiriaa har sarab paapaa hant jeeo |
English: Donations to charities and religious rituals are not equal to meditation on the Lord, who destroys all sins.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਰਹੰਤ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak simar jeevaa janam maran rahant jeeo |1|
English: Prays Nanak, meditating in remembrance on Him, I live; birth and death are finished for me. ||1||

[Ang 927 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਉਦਮੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੋ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: audam agam agocharo charan kamal namasakaar |
English: Strive for the inaccessible and unfathomable Lord, and bow in humility to His lotus feet.

Gurbani: ਕਥਨੀ ਸਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਸੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kathanee saa tudh bhaavasee naanak naam adhaar |1|
English: O Nanak, that sermon alone is pleasing to You, Lord, which inspires us to take the Support of the Name. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਪਰਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਅਨੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: sant saran saajan parahu suaamee simar anant |
English: Seek the Sanctuary of the Saints, O friends; meditate in remembrance on your infinite Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਸੂਕੇ ਤੇ ਹਰਿਆ ਥੀਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪਿ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sooke te hariaa theea naanak jap bhagavant |2|
English: The dried branch shall blossom forth in its greenery again, O Nanak, meditating on the Lord God. ||2||

[Ang 927 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: chhant |
English: Chhant:

Gurbani: ਰੁਤਿ ਸਰਸ ਬਸੰਤ ਮਾਹ ਚੇਤੁ ਵੈਸਾਖ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: rut saras basant maah chet vaisaakh sukh maas jeeo |
English: The season of spring is delightful; the months of Chayt and Baisaakhi are the most pleasant months.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਨਾਹੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮਉਲਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: har jeeo naahu miliaa mauliaa man tan saas jeeo |
English: I have obtained the Dear Lord as my Husband, and my mind, body and breath have blossomed forth.

Gurbani: ਘਰਿ ਨਾਹੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਅਨਦੁ ਸਖੀਏ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰਫੁਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: ghar naahu nihachal anad sakhee charan kamal prafuliaa |
English: The eternal, unchanging Lord has come into my home as my Husband, O my companions; dwelling upon His lotus feet, I blossom forth in bliss.

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਬੇਤਾ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਅਮੁਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sundar sugharr sujaan betaa gun govind amuliaa |
English: The Lord of the Universe is beautiful, proficient, wise and all-knowing;

Gurbani: ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਭਈ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: vaddabhaag paaeaa dukh gavaaeaa bhee pooran aas jeeo |
English: His Virtues are priceless. By great good fortune, I have found Him; my pain is dispelled, and my hopes are fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਮਿਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak saran teree mittee jam kee traas jeeo |2|
English: Prays Nanak, I have entered Your Sanctuary, Lord, and my fear of death is eradicated. ||2||

[Ang 928 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਮੁਈ ਕਰਤੀ ਕਰਮ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasangat bin bhram muee karatee karam anek |
English: Without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one dies wandering around in confusion, performing all sorts of rituals.

Gurbani: ਕੋਮਲ ਬੰਧਨ ਬਾਧੀਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਮਹਿ ਲੇਖ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: komal bandhan baadheea naanak karameh lekh |1|
English: O Nanak, all are bound by the attractive bonds of Maya, and the karmic record of past actions. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਭਾਣੇ ਸੇ ਮੇਲਿਆ ਵਿਛੋੜੇ ਭੀ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: jo bhaane se meliaa vichhorre bhee aap |
English: Those who are pleasing to God are united with Him; He separates others from Himself.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਵਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak prabh saranaagatee jaa kaa vadd parataap |2|
English: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of God; His greatness is glorious! ||2||

[Ang 928 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: chhant |
English: Chhant:

Gurbani: ਗ੍ਰੀਖਮ ਰੁਤਿ ਅਤਿ ਗਾਖੜੀ ਜੇਠ ਅਖਾੜੈ ਘਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: greekham rut at gaakharree jetth akhaarrai ghaam jeeo |
English: In the summer season, in the months of Jayt'h and Asaarh, the heat is terrible, intense and severe.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਿਛੋਹੁ ਦੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨ ਕਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: prem bichhohu duhaaganee drisatt na karee raam jeeo |
English: The discarded bride is separated from His Love, and the Lord does not even look at her.

Gurbani: ਨਹ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਆਵੈ ਮਰਤ ਹਾਵੈ ਮਹਾ ਗਾਰਬਿ ਮੁਠੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: neh drisatt aavai marat haavai mahaa gaarab muttheea |
English: She does not see her Lord, and she dies with an aching sigh; she is defrauded and plundered by her great pride.

Gurbani: ਜਲ ਬਾਝੁ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਤੜਫੜਾਵੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੁਠੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: jal baajh machhulee tarrafarraavai sang maaeaa ruttheea |
English: She flails around, like a fish out of water; attached to Maya, she is alienated from the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਪਾਪ ਜੋਨੀ ਭੈ ਭੀਤ ਹੋਈ ਦੇਇ ਸਾਸਨ ਜਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: kar paap jonee bhai bheet hoee dee saasan jaam jeeo |
English: She sins, and so she is fearful of reincarnation; the Messenger of Death will surely punish her.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਓਟ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਾਖੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak ott teree raakh pooran kaam jeeo |3|
English: Prays Nanak, take me under Your sheltering support, Lord, and protect me; You are the Fulfiller of desire. ||3||

[Ang 928 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਸਰਧਾ ਲਾਗੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੈ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: saradhaa laagee sang preetamai ik til rehan na jaae |
English: With loving faith, I am attached to my Beloved; I cannot survive without Him, even for an instant.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: man tan antar rav rahe naanak sehaj subhaae |1|
English: He is permeating and pervading my mind and body, O Nanak, with intuitive ease. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨੀ ਸਾਜਨਹਿ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਮੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: kar geh leenee saajaneh janam janam ke meet |
English: My Friend has taken me by the hand; He has been my best friend, lifetime after lifetime.

Gurbani: ਚਰਨਹ ਦਾਸੀ ਕਰਿ ਲਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਿਤ ਚੀਤ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: charanah daasee kar lee naanak prabh hit cheet |2|
English: He has made me the slave of His feet; O Nanak, my consciousness is filled with love for God. ||2||

[Ang 928 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: chhant |
English: Chhant:

Gurbani: ਰੁਤਿ ਬਰਸੁ ਸੁਹੇਲੀਆ ਸਾਵਣ ਭਾਦਵੇ ਆਨੰਦ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: rut baras suheleea saavan bhaadave aanand jeeo |
English: The rainy season is beautiful; the months of Saawan and Bhaadon bring bliss.

Gurbani: ਘਣ ਉਨਵਿ ਵੁਠੇ ਜਲ ਥਲ ਪੂਰਿਆ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: ghan unav vutthe jal thal pooriaa makarand jeeo |
English: The clouds are low, and heavy with rain; the waters and the lands are filled with honey.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬ ਠਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਭਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: prabh poor rahiaa sarab tthaaee har naam nav nidh grih bhare |
English: God is all-pervading everywhere; the nine treasures of the Lord's Name fill the homes of all hearts.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਕੁਲ ਸਮੂਹਾ ਸਭਿ ਤਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: simar suaamee antarajaamee kul samoohaa sabh tare |
English: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord and Master, the Searcher of hearts, all one's ancestry is saved.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਰੰਗਿ ਜਾਗੇ ਨਹ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਲਾਗੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਸਦ ਬਖਸਿੰਦੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: pria rang jaage neh chhidr laage kripaal sad bakhasind jeeo |
English: No blemish sticks to that being who remains awake and aware in the Love of the Lord; the Merciful Lord is forever forgiving.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਤੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੰਦੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak har kant paaeaa sadaa man bhaavand jeeo |4|
English: Prays Nanak, I have found my Husband Lord, who is forever pleasing to my mind. ||4||

[Ang 928 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਆਸ ਪਿਆਸੀ ਮੈ ਫਿਰਉ ਕਬ ਪੇਖਉ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: aas piaasee mai firau kab pekhau gopaal |
English: Thirsty with desire, I wander around; when will I behold the Lord of the World?

Gurbani: ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: hai koee saajan sant jan naanak prabh melanahaar |1|
English: Is there any humble Saint, any friend, O Nanak, who can lead me to meet with God? ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਮਿਲਬੇ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਤਿਲੁ ਪਲੁ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin milabe saant na aoopajai til pal rehan na jaae |
English: Without meeting Him, I have no peace or tranquility; I cannot survive for a moment, even for an instant.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧਹ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਸ ਪੁਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har saadhah saranaagatee naanak aas pujaae |2|
English: Entering the Sanctuary of the Lord's Holy Saints, O Nanak, my desires are fulfilled. ||2||

[Ang 928 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: chhant |
English: Chhant:

Gurbani: ਰੁਤਿ ਸਰਦ ਅਡੰਬਰੋ ਅਸੂ ਕਤਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਸ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: rut sarad addanbaro asoo katake har piaas jeeo |
English: In the cool, autumn season, in the months of Assu and Katik, I am thirsty for the Lord.

Gurbani: ਖੋਜੰਤੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਫਿਰਤ ਕਬ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: khojantee darasan firat kab mileeai gunataas jeeo |
English: Searching for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, I wander around wondering, when will I meet my Lord, the treasure of virtue?

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਹ ਸੂਖ ਸਾਰੇ ਹਾਰ ਕੰਙਣ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਬਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: bin kant piaare neh sookh saare haar kangan dhrig banaa |
English: Without my Beloved Husband Lord, I find no peace, and all my necklaces and bracelets become cursed.

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਸੁਜਾਣਿ ਚਤੁਰਿ ਬੇਤੀ ਸਾਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੈਸੇ ਤਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: sundar sujaan chatur betee saas bin jaise tanaa |
English: So beautiful, so wise, so clever and knowing; still, without the breath, it is just a body.

Gurbani: ਈਤ ਉਤ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਅਲੋਕਨ ਮਨਿ ਮਿਲਨ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਿਆਸ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: eet ut deh dis alokan man milan kee prabh piaas jeeo |
English: I look here and there, in the ten directions; my mind is so thirsty to meet God!

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਧਾਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak dhaar kirapaa melahu prabh gunataas jeeo |5|
English: Prays Nanak, shower Your Mercy upon me; unite me with Yourself, O God, O treasure of virtue. ||5||

[Ang 928 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਜਲਣਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਸੀਤਲ ਭਏ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਉਪਜੀ ਸਾਂਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: jalan bujhee seetal bhe man tan upajee saant |
English: The fire of desire is cooled and quenched; my mind and body are filled with peace and tranquility.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੂਰਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਭ੍ਰਾਂਤਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak prabh pooran mile duteea binasee bhraant |1|
English: O Nanak, I have met my Perfect God; the illusion of duality is dispelled. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਪਠਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: saadh patthaae aap har ham tum te naahee door |
English: The Lord Himself sent His Holy Saints, to tell us that He is not far away.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੈ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਰਮਣ ਰਾਮ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak bhram bhai mitt ge raman raam bharapoor |2|
English: O Nanak, doubt and fear are dispelled, chanting the Name of the all-pervading Lord. ||2||

[Ang 929 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: chhant |
English: Chhant:

Gurbani: ਰੁਤਿ ਸਿਸੀਅਰ ਸੀਤਲ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਮੰਘਰ ਪੋਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: rut siseear seetal har pragatte manghar pohi jeeo |
English: In the cold season of Maghar and Poh, the Lord reveals Himself.

Gurbani: ਜਲਨਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਦਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਧ੍ਰੋਹ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: jalan bujhee daras paaeaa binase maaeaa dhroh jeeo |
English: My burning desires were quenched, when I obtained the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; the fraudulent illusion of Maya is gone.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਕਾਮ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਜੂਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਸੇਵਕਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kaam poore mil hajoore har charan sevak seviaa |
English: All my desires have been fulfilled, meeting the Lord face-to-face; I am His servant, I serve at His feet.

Gurbani: ਹਾਰ ਡੋਰ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: haar ddor seegaar sabh ras gun gaau alakh abheviaa |
English: My necklaces, hair-ties, all decorations and adornments, are in singing the Glorious Praises of the unseen, mysterious Lord.

Gurbani: ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਜਮੁ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਜੋਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhaau bhagat govind baanchhat jam na saakai johi jeeo |
English: I long for loving devotion to the Lord of the Universe, and so the Messenger of Death cannot even see me.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਤਹ ਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਿਛੋਹ ਜੀਉ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak prabh aap melee teh na prem bichhoh jeeo |6|
English: Prays Nanak, God has united me with Himself; I shall never suffer separation from my Beloved again. ||6||

[Ang 929 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਡੋਲਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਚੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: har dhan paaeaa sohaaganee ddolat naahee cheet |
English: The happy soul bride has found the wealth of the Lord; her consciousness does not waver.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sant sanjogee naanakaa grihi pragatte prabh meet |1|
English: Joining together with the Saints, O Nanak, God, my Friend, has revealed Himself in my home. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਾਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਅਨੰਦ ਕੋਡ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: naad binod anand kodd pria preetam sang bane |
English: With her Beloved Husband Lord, she enjoys millions of melodies, pleasures and joys.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਭਨੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: man baanchhat fal paaeaa har naanak naam bhane |2|
English: The fruits of the mind's desires are obtained, O Nanak, chanting the Lord's Name. ||2||

[Ang 929 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: chhant |
English: Chhant:

Gurbani: ਹਿਮਕਰ ਰੁਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਤੀ ਮਾਘੁ ਫਗਣੁ ਗੁਣਵੰਤ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: himakar rut man bhaavatee maagh fagan gunavant jeeo |
English: The snowy winter season, the months of Maagh and Phagun, are pleasing and ennobling to the mind.

Gurbani: ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਗਾਉ ਮੰਗਲੋ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਆਏ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਤ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: sakhee sahelee gaau mangalo grihi aae har kant jeeo |
English: O my friends and companions, sing the songs of joy; my Husband Lord has come into my home.

Gurbani: ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਲਾਲ ਆਏ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਏ ਸੇਜ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਸੋਹੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: grihi laal aae man dhiaae sej sundar soheea |
English: My Beloved has come into my home; I meditate on Him in my mind. The bed of my heart is beautifully adorned.

Gurbani: ਵਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਭਏ ਹਰਿਆ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਮੋਹੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: van trin tribhavan bhe hariaa dekh darasan moheea |
English: The woods, the meadows and the three worlds have blossomed forth in their greenery; gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, I am fascinated.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਮਨਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮੰਤ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: mile suaamee ichh punee man japiaa niramal mant jeeo |
English: I have met my Lord and Master, and my desires are fulfilled; my mind chants His Immaculate Mantra.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਤ ਕਰਹੁ ਰਲੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਕੰਤ ਜੀਉ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak nit karahu raleea har mile sreedhar kant jeeo |7|
English: Prays Nanak, I celebrate continuously; I have met my Husband Lord, the Lord of excellence. ||7||

[Ang 929 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ਜੀਅ ਕੇ ਭਵਜਲ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: sant sahaaee jeea ke bhavajal taaranahaar |
English: The Saints are the helpers, the support of the soul; they carry us cross the terrifying world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚੇ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਪਿਆਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sabh te aooche jaaneeeh naanak naam piaar |1|
English: Know that they are the highest of all; O Nanak, they love the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਸੇਈ ਤਰੇ ਸੇ ਸੂਰੇ ਸੇ ਬੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: jin jaaniaa seee tare se soore se beer |
English: Those who know Him, cross over; they are the brave heroes, the heroic warriors.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਉਤਰੇ ਤੀਰ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak tin balihaaranai har jap utare teer |2|
English: Nanak is a sacrifice to those who meditate on the Lord, and cross over to the other shore. ||2||

[Ang 929 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: chhant |
English: Chhant:

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਬਿਰਾਜਿਤ ਸਭ ਊਪਰੇ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਕਲੇਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: charan biraajit sabh aoopare mittiaa sagal kales jeeo |
English: His feet are exalted above all. They eradicate all suffering.

Gurbani: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਵਣ ਦੁਖ ਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕੀਆ ਪਰਵੇਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: aavan jaavan dukh hare har bhagat keea paraves jeeo |
English: They destroy the pains of coming and going. They bring loving devotion to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਾਤੇ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਬੀਸਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: har rang raate sehaj maate til na man te beesarai |
English: Imbued with the Lord's Love, one is intoxicated with intuitive peace and poise, and does not forget the Lord from his mind, even for an instant.

Gurbani: ਤਜਿ ਆਪੁ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਰੇ ਚਰਨੀ ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣ ਜਗਦੀਸਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: taj aap saranee pare charanee sarab gun jagadeesarai |
English: Shedding my self-conceit, I have entered the Sanctuary of His Feet; all virtues rest in the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਸ੍ਰੀਰੰਗ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਦਿ ਕਉ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: govind gun nidh sreerang suaamee aad kau aades jeeo |
English: I bow in humility to the Lord of the Universe, the treasure of virtue, the Lord of excellence, our Primal Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਇਆ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੋ ਇਕ ਵੇਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੮॥੧॥੬॥੮॥
Transliteration: binavant naanak meaa dhaarahu jug jugo ik ves jeeo |8|1|6|8|
English: Prays Nanak, shower me with Your Mercy, Lord; throughout the ages, You take the same form. ||8||1||6||8||

[Ang 929 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਦਖਣੀ ਓਅੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 1 dakhanee oankaar |
English: Raamkalee, First Mehl, Dakhanee, Ongkaar:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਉਤਪਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: oankaar brahamaa utapat |
English: From Ongkaar, the One Universal Creator God, Brahma was created.

Gurbani: ਓਅੰਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: oankaar keea jin chit |
English: He kept Ongkaar in his consciousness.

Gurbani: ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਸੈਲ ਜੁਗ ਭਏ ॥
Transliteration: oankaar sail jug bhe |
English: From Ongkaar, the mountains and the ages were created.

Gurbani: ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਬੇਦ ਨਿਰਮਏ ॥
Transliteration: oankaar bed nirame |
English: Ongkaar created the Vedas.

Gurbani: ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਉਧਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: oankaar sabad udhare |
English: Ongkaar saves the world through the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: oankaar guramukh tare |
English: Ongkaar saves the Gurmukhs.

Gurbani: ਓਨਮ ਅਖਰ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: onam akhar sunahu beechaar |
English: Listen to the Message of the Universal, Imperishable Creator Lord.

Gurbani: ਓਨਮ ਅਖਰੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: onam akhar tribhavan saar |1|
English: The Universal, Imperishable Creator Lord is the essence of the three worlds. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਪਾਡੇ ਕਿਆ ਲਿਖਹੁ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: sun paadde kiaa likhahu janjaalaa |
English: Listen, O Pandit, O religious scholar, why are you writing about worldly debates?

Gurbani: ਲਿਖੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: likh raam naam guramukh gopaalaa |1| rahaau |
English: As Gurmukh, write only the Name of the Lord, the Lord of the World. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਸੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਤੀਨਿ ਭਵਨ ਇਕ ਜੋਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: sasai sabh jag sehaj upaaeaa teen bhavan ik jotee |
English: Sassa: He created the entire universe with ease; His One Light pervades the three worlds.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਚੁਣਿ ਲੈ ਮਾਣਕ ਮੋਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh vasat paraapat hovai chun lai maanak motee |
English: Become Gurmukh, and obtain the real thing; gather the gems and pearls.

Gurbani: ਸਮਝੈ ਸੂਝੈ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਅੰਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ॥
Transliteration: samajhai soojhai parr parr boojhai ant nirantar saachaa |
English: If one understands, realizes and comprehends what he reads and studies, in the end he shall realize that the True Lord dwells deep within his nucleus.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਜਗੁ ਕਾਚਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: guramukh dekhai saach samaale bin saache jag kaachaa |2|
English: The Gurmukh sees and contemplates the True Lord; without the True Lord, the world is false. ||2||

Gurbani: ਧਧੈ ਧਰਮੁ ਧਰੇ ਧਰਮਾ ਪੁਰਿ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: dhadhai dharam dhare dharamaa pur gunakaaree man dheeraa |
English: Dhadha: Those who enshrine Dharmic faith and dwell in the City of Dharma are worthy; their minds are steadfast and stable.

Gurbani: ਧਧੈ ਧੂਲਿ ਪੜੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਕੰਚਨ ਭਏ ਮਨੂਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: dhadhai dhool parrai mukh masatak kanchan bhe manooraa |
English: Dhadha: If the dust of their feet touches one's face and forehead, he is transformed from iron into gold.

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਧਰਣੀਧਰੁ ਆਪਿ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਤੋਲਿ ਬੋਲਿ ਸਚੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: dhan dharaneedhar aap ajonee tol bol sach pooraa |
English: Blessed is the Support of the Earth; He Himself is not born; His measure and speech are perfect and True.

Gurbani: ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੈ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੂਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: karate kee mit karataa jaanai kai jaanai gur sooraa |3|
English: Only the Creator Himself knows His own extent; He alone knows the Brave Guru. ||3||

Gurbani: ਙਿਆਨੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਇਆ ਗਰਬਿ ਗਲੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: ngiaan gavaaeaa doojaa bhaaeaa garab gale bikh khaaeaa |
English: In love with duality, spiritual wisdom is lost; the mortal rots away in pride, and eats poison.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਰਸੁ ਗੀਤ ਬਾਦ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur ras geet baad nahee bhaavai suneeai gahir ganbheer gavaaeaa |
English: He thinks that the sublime essence of the Guru's song is useless, and he does not like to hear it. He loses the profound, unfathomable Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਹਿਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਲਹਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਸੁਖਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur sach kahiaa amrit lahiaa man tan saach sukhaaeaa |
English: Through the Guru's Words of Truth, the Ambrosial Nectar is obtained, and the mind and body find joy in the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਇਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: aape guramukh aape devai aape amrit peeaeaa |4|
English: He Himself is the Gurmukh, and He Himself bestows the Ambrosial Nectar; He Himself leads us to drink it in. ||4||

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਵਿਆਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: eko ek kahai sabh koee haumai garab viaapai |
English: Everyone says that God is the One and only, but they are engrossed in egotism and pride.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਇਉ ਘਰੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਸਿਞਾਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: antar baahar ek pachhaanai iau ghar mehal siyaapai |
English: Realize that the One God is inside and outside; understand this, that the Mansion of His Presence is within the home of your heart.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਹਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਏਕੋ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਬਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: prabh nerrai har door na jaanahu eko srisatt sabaaee |
English: God is near at hand; do not think that God is far away. The One Lord permeates the entire universe.

Gurbani: ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੁ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: ekankaar avar nahee doojaa naanak ek samaaee |5|
English: There in One Universal Creator Lord; there is no other at all. O Nanak, merge into the One Lord. ||5||

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਉ ਕਿਉ ਗਹਿ ਰਾਖਉ ਅਫਰਿਓ ਤੁਲਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: eis karate kau kiau geh raakhau afario tulio na jaaee |
English: How can you keep the Creator under your control? He cannot be seized or measured.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਦੇਵਾਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਝੂਠਿ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa ke devaane praanee jhootth tthgauree paaee |
English: Maya has made the mortal insane; she has administered the poisonous drug of falsehood.

Gurbani: ਲਬਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਮੁਹਤਾਜਿ ਵਿਗੂਤੇ ਇਬ ਤਬ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: lab lobh muhataaj vigoote ib tab fir pachhutaaee |
English: Addicted to greed and avarice, the mortal is ruined, and then later, he regrets and repents.

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਸਰੇਵੈ ਤਾ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਰਹਾਈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: ek sarevai taa gat mit paavai aavan jaan rahaaee |6|
English: So serve the One Lord, and attain the state of Salvation; your comings and goings shall cease. ||6||

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਅਚਾਰੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਇਕੁ ਰੂਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: ek achaar rang ik roop |
English: The One Lord is in all actions, colors and forms.

Gurbani: ਪਉਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਅਗਨੀ ਅਸਰੂਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: paun paanee aganee asaroop |
English: He manifests in many shapes through wind, water and fire.

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਭਵਰੁ ਭਵੈ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: eko bhavar bhavai tihu loe |
English: The One Soul wanders through the three worlds.

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੂਝੈ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: eko boojhai soojhai pat hoe |
English: One who understands and comprehends the One Lord is honored.

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਲੇ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਰਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: giaan dhiaan le samasar rahai |
English: One who gathers in spiritual wisdom and meditation, dwells in the state of balance.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੁ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋ ਲਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh ek viralaa ko lahai |
English: How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, attain the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jis no dee kirapaa te sukh paae |
English: They alone find peace, whom the Lord blesses with His Grace.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: guroo duaarai aakh sunaae |7|
English: In the Gurdwara, the Guru's Door, they speak and hear of the Lord. ||7||

Gurbani: ਊਰਮ ਧੂਰਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਉਜਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: aooram dhooram jot ujaalaa |
English: His Light illuminates the ocean and the earth.

Gurbani: ਤੀਨਿ ਭਵਣ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: teen bhavan meh gur gopaalaa |
English: Throughout the three worlds, is the Guru, the Lord of the World.

Gurbani: ਊਗਵਿਆ ਅਸਰੂਪੁ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: aoogaviaa asaroop dikhaavai |
English: The Lord reveals His various forms;

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa apunai ghar aavai |
English: granting His Grace, He enters the home of the heart.

Gurbani: ਊਨਵਿ ਬਰਸੈ ਨੀਝਰ ਧਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aoonav barasai neejhar dhaaraa |
English: The clouds hang low, and the rain is pouring down.

Gurbani: ਊਤਮ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aootam sabad savaaranahaaraa |
English: The Lord embellishes and exalts with the Sublime Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਏਕੇ ਕਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਭੇਉ ॥
Transliteration: eis eke kaa jaanai bheo |
English: One who knows the mystery of the One God,

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਉ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: aape karataa aape deo |8|
English: is Himself the Creator, Himself the Divine Lord. ||8||

Gurbani: ਉਗਵੈ ਸੂਰੁ ਅਸੁਰ ਸੰਘਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: augavai soor asur sanghaarai |
English: When the sun rises, the demons are slain;

Gurbani: ਊਚਉ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: aoochau dekh sabad beechaarai |
English: the mortal looks upwards, and contemplates the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਊਪਰਿ ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aoopar aad ant tihu loe |
English: The Lord is beyond the beginning and the end, beyond the three worlds.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੈ ਕਥੈ ਸੁਣੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aape karai kathai sunai soe |
English: He Himself acts, speaks and listens.

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: ohu bidhaataa man tan dee |
English: He is the Architect of Destiny; He blesses us with mind and body.

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: ohu bidhaataa man mukh soe |
English: That Architect of Destiny is in my mind and mouth.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: prabh jagajeevan avar na koe |
English: God is the Life of the world; there is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: naanak naam rate pat hoe |9|
English: O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one is honored. ||9||

Gurbani: ਰਾਜਨ ਰਾਮ ਰਵੈ ਹਿਤਕਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: raajan raam ravai hitakaar |
English: One who lovingly chants the Name of the Sovereign Lord King,

Gurbani: ਰਣ ਮਹਿ ਲੂਝੈ ਮਨੂਆ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: ran meh loojhai manooaa maar |
English: fights the battle and conquers his own mind;

Gurbani: ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਨੰਤਿ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: raat dinant rahai rang raataa |
English: day and night, he remains imbued with the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਤੀਨਿ ਭਵਨ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: teen bhavan jug chaare jaataa |
English: He is famous throughout the three worlds and the four ages.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਜੇਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: jin jaataa so tis hee jehaa |
English: One who knows the Lord, becomes like Him.

Gurbani: ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਾਇਲੁ ਸੀਝਸਿ ਦੇਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: at niramaaeil seejhas dehaa |
English: He becomes absolutely immaculate, and his body is sanctified.

Gurbani: ਰਹਸੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਇਕ ਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: rahasee raam ridai ik bhaae |
English: His heart is happy, in love with the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: antar sabad saach liv laae |10|
English: He lovingly centers his attention deep within upon the True Word of the Shabad. ||10||

Gurbani: ਰੋਸੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ ਰਹਣੁ ਨਹੀ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: ros na keejai amrit peejai rehan nahee sansaare |
English: Don't be angry - drink in the Ambrosial Nectar; you shall not remain in this world forever.

Gurbani: ਰਾਜੇ ਰਾਇ ਰੰਕ ਨਹੀ ਰਹਣਾ ਆਇ ਜਾਇ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: raaje raae rank nahee rahanaa aae jaae jug chaare |
English: The ruling kings and the paupers shall not remain; they come and go, throughout the four ages.

Gurbani: ਰਹਣ ਕਹਣ ਤੇ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਉ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: rehan kehan te rahai na koee kis peh krau binantee |
English: Everyone says that they will remain, but none of them remain; unto whom should I offer my prayer?

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਰੋਧਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਮਤੀ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: ek sabad raam naam nirodhar gur devai pat matee |11|
English: The One Shabad, the Name of the Lord, will never fail you; the Guru grants honor and understanding. ||11||

Gurbani: ਲਾਜ ਮਰੰਤੀ ਮਰਿ ਗਈ ਘੂਘਟੁ ਖੋਲਿ ਚਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: laaj marantee mar gee ghooghatt khol chalee |
English: My shyness and hesitation have died and gone, and I walk with my face unveiled.

Gurbani: ਸਾਸੁ ਦਿਵਾਨੀ ਬਾਵਰੀ ਸਿਰ ਤੇ ਸੰਕ ਟਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: saas divaanee baavaree sir te sank ttalee |
English: The confusion and doubt from my crazy, insane mother-in-law has been removed from over my head.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਬੁਲਾਈ ਰਲੀ ਸਿਉ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: prem bulaaee ralee siau man meh sabad anand |
English: My Beloved has summoned me with joyful caresses; my mind is filled with the bliss of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਲਾਲਿ ਰਤੀ ਲਾਲੀ ਭਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਈ ਨਿਚਿੰਦੁ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: laal ratee laalee bhee guramukh bhee nichind |12|
English: Imbued with the Love of my Beloved, I have become Gurmukh, and carefree. ||12||

Gurbani: ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਜਪਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: laahaa naam ratan jap saar |
English: Chant the jewel of the Naam, and earn the profit of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: lab lobh buraa ahankaar |
English: Greed, avarice, evil and egotism;

Gurbani: ਲਾੜੀ ਚਾੜੀ ਲਾਇਤਬਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: laarree chaarree laaeitabaar |
English: slander, inuendo and gossip;

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅੰਧਾ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਗਵਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh andhaa mugadh gavaar |
English: the self-willed manmukh is blind, foolish and ignorant.

Gurbani: ਲਾਹੇ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਆਇਆ ਜਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: laahe kaaran aaeaa jag |
English: For the sake of earning the profit of the Lord, the mortal comes into the world.

Gurbani: ਹੋਇ ਮਜੂਰੁ ਗਇਆ ਠਗਾਇ ਠਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: hoe majoor geaa tthagaae tthag |
English: But he becomes a mere slave laborer, and is mugged by the mugger, Maya.

Gurbani: ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: laahaa naam poonjee vesaahu |
English: One who earns the profit of the Naam, with the capital of faith,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੀ ਪਤਿ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: naanak sachee pat sachaa paatisaahu |13|
English: O Nanak, is truly honored by the True Supreme King. ||13||

Gurbani: ਆਇ ਵਿਗੂਤਾ ਜਗੁ ਜਮ ਪੰਥੁ ॥
Transliteration: aae vigootaa jag jam panth |
English: The world is ruined on the path of Death.

Gurbani: ਆਈ ਨ ਮੇਟਣ ਕੋ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥
Transliteration: aaee na mettan ko samarath |
English: No one has the power to erase Maya's influence.

Gurbani: ਆਥਿ ਸੈਲ ਨੀਚ ਘਰਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aath sail neech ghar hoe |
English: If wealth visits the home of the lowliest clown,

Gurbani: ਆਥਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aath dekh nivai jis doe |
English: seeing that wealth, all pay their respects to him.

Gurbani: ਆਥਿ ਹੋਇ ਤਾ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਸਿਆਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: aath hoe taa mugadh siaanaa |
English: Even an idiot is thought of as clever, if he is rich.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਬਿਹੂਨਾ ਜਗੁ ਬਉਰਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat bihoonaa jag bauraanaa |
English: Without devotional worship, the world is insane.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabh meh varatai eko soe |
English: The One Lord is contained among all.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: jis no kirapaa kare tis paragatt hoe |14|
English: He reveals Himself, unto those whom He blesses with His Grace. ||14||

Gurbani: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jug jug thaap sadaa niravair |
English: Throughout the ages, the Lord is eternally established; He has no vengeance.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰਣਿ ਨਹੀ ਧੰਧਾ ਧੈਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: janam maran nahee dhandhaa dhair |
English: He is not subject to birth and death; He is not entangled in worldly affairs.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: jo deesai so aape aap |
English: Whatever is seen, is the Lord Himself.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਆਪੇ ਘਟ ਥਾਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: aap upaae aape ghatt thaap |
English: Creating Himself, He establishes Himself in the heart.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਲੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aap agochar dhandhai loee |
English: He Himself is unfathomable; He links people to their affairs.

Gurbani: ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jog jugat jagajeevan soee |
English: He is the Way of Yoga, the Life of the World.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਆਚਾਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: kar aachaar sach sukh hoee |
English: Living a righteous lifestyle, true peace is found.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣਾ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਿਵ ਹੋਈ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: naam vihoonaa mukat kiv hoee |15|
English: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, how can anyone find liberation? ||15||

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਵੇਰੋਧੁ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: vin naavai verodh sareer |
English: Without the Name, even one's own body is an enemy.

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਨ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਕਾਟਹਿ ਮਨ ਪੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: kiau na mileh kaatteh man peer |
English: Why not meet the Lord, and take away the pain of your mind?

Gurbani: ਵਾਟ ਵਟਾਊ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: vaatt vattaaoo aavai jaae |
English: The traveller comes and goes along the highway.

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਲੇ ਆਇਆ ਕਿਆ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa le aaeaa kiaa palai paae |
English: What did he bring when he came, and what will he take away when he goes?

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਤੋਟਾ ਸਭ ਥਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: vin naavai tottaa sabh thaae |
English: Without the Name, one loses everywhere.

Gurbani: ਲਾਹਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਾ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: laahaa milai jaa dee bujhaae |
English: The profit is earned, when the Lord grants understanding.

Gurbani: ਵਣਜੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ਵਣਜੈ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: vanaj vaapaar vanajai vaapaaree |
English: In merchandise and trade, the merchant is trading.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੈਸੀ ਪਤਿ ਸਾਰੀ ॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: vin naavai kaisee pat saaree |16|
English: Without the Name, how can one find honor and nobility? ||16||

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: gun veechaare giaanee soe |
English: One who contemplates the Lord's Virtues is spiritually wise.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: gun meh giaan paraapat hoe |
English: Through His Virtues, one receives spiritual wisdom.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: gunadaataa viralaa sansaar |
English: How rare in this world, is the Giver of virtue.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੀ ਕਰਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: saachee karanee gur veechaar |
English: The True way of life comes through contemplation of the Guru.

Gurbani: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: agam agochar keemat nahee paae |
English: The Lord is inaccessible and unfathomable. His worth cannot be estimated.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਜਾ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: taa mileeai jaa le milaae |
English: They alone meet Him, whom the Lord causes to meet.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੇ ਨੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: gunavantee gun saare neet |
English: The virtuous soul bride continually contemplates His Virtues.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਮੀਤ ॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: naanak guramat mileeai meet |17|
English: O Nanak, following the Guru's Teachings, one meets the Lord, the true friend. ||17||

Gurbani: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਕਉ ਗਾਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh kaaeaa kau gaalai |
English: Unfulfilled sexual desire and unresolved anger waste the body away,

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਕੰਚਨ ਸੋਹਾਗਾ ਢਾਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: jiau kanchan sohaagaa dtaalai |
English: as gold is dissolved by borax.

Gurbani: ਕਸਿ ਕਸਵਟੀ ਸਹੈ ਸੁ ਤਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kas kasavattee sahai su taau |
English: The gold is touched to the touchstone, and tested by fire;

Gurbani: ਨਦਰਿ ਸਰਾਫ ਵੰਨੀ ਸਚੜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: nadar saraaf vanee sacharraau |
English: when its pure color shows through, it is pleasing to the eye of the assayer.

Gurbani: ਜਗਤੁ ਪਸੂ ਅਹੰ ਕਾਲੁ ਕਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jagat pasoo ahan kaal kasaaee |
English: The world is a beast, and arrogent Death is the butcher.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kar karatai karanee kar paaee |
English: The created beings of the Creator receive the karma of their actions.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤੀ ਤਿਨਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jin keetee tin keemat paaee |
English: He who created the world, knows its worth.

Gurbani: ਹੋਰ ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: hor kiaa kaheeai kichh kehan na jaaee |18|
English: What else can be said? There is nothing at all to say. ||18||

Gurbani: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: khojat khojat amrit peea |
English: Searching, searching, I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਖਿਮਾ ਗਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: khimaa gahee man satagur deea |
English: I have adopted the way of tolerance, and given my mind to the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਖਰਾ ਖਰਾ ਆਖੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: kharaa kharaa aakhai sabh koe |
English: Everyone calls himself true and genuine.

Gurbani: ਖਰਾ ਰਤਨੁ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: kharaa ratan jug chaare hoe |
English: He alone is true, who obtains the jewel throughout the four ages.

Gurbani: ਖਾਤ ਪੀਅੰਤ ਮੂਏ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: khaat peeant mooe nahee jaaniaa |
English: Eating and drinking, one dies, but still does not know.

Gurbani: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਮੂਏ ਜਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: khin meh mooe jaa sabad pachhaaniaa |
English: He dies in an instant, when he realizes the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਚੀਤੁ ਮਰਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: asathir cheet maran man maaniaa |
English: His consciousness becomes permanently stable, and his mind accepts death.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: gur kirapaa te naam pachhaaniaa |19|
English: By Guru's Grace, he realizes the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||19||

Gurbani: ਗਗਨ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ਗਗਨੰਤਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: gagan ganbheer gaganantar vaas |
English: The Profound Lord dwells in the sky of the mind, the Tenth Gate;

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: gun gaavai sukh sehaj nivaas |
English: singing His Glorious Praises, one dwells in intuitive poise and peace.

Gurbani: ਗਇਆ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਆਇ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: geaa na aavai aae na jaae |
English: He does not go to come, or come to go.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaad rahai liv laae |
English: By Guru's Grace, he remains lovingly focused on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗਗਨੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਅਜੋਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: gagan agam anaath ajonee |
English: The Lord of the mind-sky is inaccessible, independent and beyond birth.

Gurbani: ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਚੀਤੁ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਗੋਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: asathir cheet samaadh sagonee |
English: The most worthy Samaadhi is to keep the consciousness stable, focused on Him.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੇਤਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਵਹਿ ਨ ਜੂਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: har naam chet fir paveh na joonee |
English: Remembering the Lord's Name, one is not subject to reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਰੁ ਹੋਰ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਨੀ ॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: guramat saar hor naam bihoonee |20|
English: The Guru's Teachings are the most Excellent; all other ways lack the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||20||

Gurbani: ਘਰ ਦਰ ਫਿਰਿ ਥਾਕੀ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: ghar dar fir thaakee bahutere |
English: Wandering to countless doorsteps and homes, I have grown weary.

Gurbani: ਜਾਤਿ ਅਸੰਖ ਅੰਤ ਨਹੀ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jaat asankh ant nahee mere |
English: My incarnations are countless, without limit.

Gurbani: ਕੇਤੇ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਧੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: kete maat pitaa sut dheea |
English: I have had so many mothers and fathers, sons and daughters.

Gurbani: ਕੇਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲੇ ਫੁਨਿ ਹੂਆ ॥
Transliteration: kete gur chele fun hooaa |
English: I have had so many gurus and disciples.

Gurbani: ਕਾਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੂਆ ॥
Transliteration: kaache gur te mukat na hooaa |
English: Through a false guru, liberation is not found.

Gurbani: ਕੇਤੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: ketee naar var ek samaal |
English: There are so many brides of the One Husband Lord - consider this.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh maran jeevan prabh naal |
English: The Gurmukh dies, and lives with God.

Gurbani: ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਢੂਢਿ ਘਰੈ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: deh dis dtoodt gharai meh paaeaa |
English: Searching in the ten directions, I found Him within my own home.

Gurbani: ਮੇਲੁ ਭਇਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੨੧॥
Transliteration: mel bheaa satiguroo milaaeaa |21|
English: I have met Him; the True Guru has led me to meet Him. ||21||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh gaavai guramukh bolai |
English: The Gurmukh sings, and the Gurmukh speaks.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤੋਲਿ ਤੋੁਲਾਵੈ ਤੋਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh tol tuolaavai tolai |
English: The Gurmukh evaluates the value of the Lord, and inspires others to evaluate Him as well.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਨਿਸੰਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh aavai jaae nisang |
English: The Gurmukh comes and goes without fear.

Gurbani: ਪਰਹਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਜਲਾਇ ਕਲੰਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: parahar mail jalaae kalank |
English: His filth is taken away, and his stains are burnt off.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਦ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh naad bed beechaar |
English: The Gurmukh contemplates the sound current of the Naad for his Vedas.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਜਨੁ ਚਜੁ ਅਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh majan chaj achaar |
English: The Gurmukh's cleansing bath is the performance of good deeds.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh sabad amrit hai saar |
English: For the Gurmukh, the Shabad is the most excellent Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੨੨॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh paavai paar |22|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh crosses over. ||22||

Gurbani: ਚੰਚਲੁ ਚੀਤੁ ਨ ਰਹਈ ਠਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: chanchal cheet na rahee tthaae |
English: The fickle consciousness does not remain stable.

Gurbani: ਚੋਰੀ ਮਿਰਗੁ ਅੰਗੂਰੀ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: choree mirag angooree khaae |
English: The deer secretly nibbles at the green sprouts.

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ਚੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal ur dhaare cheet |
English: One who enshrines the Lord's lotus feet in his heart and consciousness

Gurbani: ਚਿਰੁ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਚੇਤਨੁ ਨਿਤ ਨੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: chir jeevan chetan nit neet |
English: lives long, always remembering the Lord.

Gurbani: ਚਿੰਤਤ ਹੀ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: chintat hee deesai sabh koe |
English: Everyone has worries and cares.

Gurbani: ਚੇਤਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਤਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: cheteh ek tahee sukh hoe |
English: He alone finds peace, who thinks of the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਚਿਤਿ ਵਸੈ ਰਾਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: chit vasai raachai har naae |
English: When the Lord dwells in the consciousness, and one is absorbed in the Lord's Name,

Gurbani: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਇਆ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੨੩॥
Transliteration: mukat bheaa pat siau ghar jaae |23|
English: one is liberated, and returns home with honor. ||23||

Gurbani: ਛੀਜੈ ਦੇਹ ਖੁਲੈ ਇਕ ਗੰਢਿ ॥
Transliteration: chheejai deh khulai ik gandt |
English: The body falls apart, when one knot is untied.

Gurbani: ਛੇਆ ਨਿਤ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਜਗਿ ਹੰਢਿ ॥
Transliteration: chheaa nit dekhahu jag handt |
English: Behold, the world is on the decline; it will be totally destroyed.

Gurbani: ਧੂਪ ਛਾਵ ਜੇ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: dhoop chhaav je sam kar jaanai |
English: Only one who looks alike upon sunshine and shade

Gurbani: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: bandhan kaatt mukat ghar aanai |
English: has his bonds shattered; he is liberated and returns home.

Gurbani: ਛਾਇਆ ਛੂਛੀ ਜਗਤੁ ਭੁਲਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: chhaaeaa chhoochhee jagat bhulaanaa |
English: Maya is empty and petty; she has defrauded the world.

Gurbani: ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਧੁਰੇ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: likhiaa kirat dhure paravaanaa |
English: Such destiny is pre-ordained by past actions.

Gurbani: ਛੀਜੈ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਜਰੂਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: chheejai joban jarooaa sir kaal |
English: Youth is wasting away; old age and death hover above the head.

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਛੀਜੈ ਭਈ ਸਿਬਾਲੁ ॥੨੪॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa chheejai bhee sibaal |24|
English: The body falls apart, like algae upon the water. ||24||

Gurbani: ਜਾਪੈ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jaapai aap prabhoo tihu loe |
English: God Himself appears throughout the three worlds.

Gurbani: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jug jug daataa avar na koe |
English: Throughout the ages, He is the Great Giver; there is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: jiau bhaavai tiau raakheh raakh |
English: As it pleases You, You protect and preserve us.

Gurbani: ਜਸੁ ਜਾਚਉ ਦੇਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਸਾਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: jas jaachau devai pat saakh |
English: I ask for the Lord's Praises, which bless me with honor and credit.

Gurbani: ਜਾਗਤੁ ਜਾਗਿ ਰਹਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaagat jaag rahaa tudh bhaavaa |
English: Remaining awake and aware, I am pleasing to You, O Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤੂ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਤਾ ਤੁਝੈ ਸਮਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaa too meleh taa tujhai samaavaa |
English: When You unite me with Yourself, then I am merged in You.

Gurbani: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਜਪਉ ਜਗਦੀਸ ॥
Transliteration: jai jai kaar jpau jagadees |
English: I chant Your Victorious Praises, O Life of the World.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਬੀਸ ਇਕੀਸ ॥੨੫॥
Transliteration: guramat mileeai bees ikees |25|
English: Accepting the Guru's Teachings, one is sure to merge in the One Lord. ||25||

Gurbani: ਝਖਿ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਕਿਆ ਜਗ ਸਿਉ ਵਾਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: jhakh bolan kiaa jag siau vaad |
English: Why do you speak such nonsense, and argue with the world?

Gurbani: ਝੂਰਿ ਮਰੈ ਦੇਖੈ ਪਰਮਾਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: jhoor marai dekhai paramaad |
English: You shall die repenting, when you see your own insanity.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮਿ ਮੂਏ ਨਹੀ ਜੀਵਣ ਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: janam mooe nahee jeevan aasaa |
English: He is born, only to die, but he does not wish to live.

Gurbani: ਆਇ ਚਲੇ ਭਏ ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aae chale bhe aas niraasaa |
English: He comes hopeful, and then goes, without hope.

Gurbani: ਝੁਰਿ ਝੁਰਿ ਝਖਿ ਮਾਟੀ ਰਲਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jhur jhur jhakh maattee ral jaae |
English: Regretting, repenting and grieving, he is dust mixing with dust.

Gurbani: ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਚਾਂਪੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kaal na chaanpai har gun gaae |
English: Death does not chew up one who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਪਾਈ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: paaee nav nidh har kai naae |
English: The nine treasures are obtained through the Name of the Lord;

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੨੬॥
Transliteration: aape devai sehaj subhaae |26|
English: the Lord bestows intuitive peace and poise. ||26||

Gurbani: ਞਿਆਨੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਆਪੇ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
Transliteration: yiaano bolai aape boojhai |
English: He speaks spiritual wisdom, and He Himself understands it.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਮਝੈ ਆਪੇ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
Transliteration: aape samajhai aape soojhai |
English: He Himself knows it, and He Himself comprehends it.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa kahiaa ank samaavai |
English: One who takes the Words of the Guru into his very fiber,

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੂਚੇ ਸਾਚੋ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: niramal sooche saacho bhaavai |
English: is immaculate and holy, and is pleasing to the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਰਤਨੀ ਨਹੀ ਤੋਟ ॥
Transliteration: gur saagar ratanee nahee tott |
English: In the ocean of the Guru, there is no shortage of pearls.

Gurbani: ਲਾਲ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਸਾਚੁ ਅਖੋਟ ॥
Transliteration: laal padaarath saach akhott |
English: The treasure of jewels is truly inexhaustible.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਸਾ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur kahiaa saa kaar kamaavahu |
English: Do those deeds which the Guru has ordained.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਹੇ ਧਾਵਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur kee karanee kaahe dhaavahu |
English: Why are you chasing after the Guru's actions?

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਹੁ ॥੨੭॥
Transliteration: naanak guramat saach samaavahu |27|
English: O Nanak, through the Guru's Teachings, merge in the True Lord. ||27||

Gurbani: ਟੂਟੈ ਨੇਹੁ ਕਿ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਸਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: ttoottai nehu ki boleh sahee |
English: Love is broken, when one speaks in defiance.

Gurbani: ਟੂਟੈ ਬਾਹ ਦੁਹੂ ਦਿਸ ਗਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: ttoottai baah duhoo dis gahee |
English: The arm is broken, when it is pulled from both sides.

Gurbani: ਟੂਟਿ ਪਰੀਤਿ ਗਈ ਬੁਰ ਬੋਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: ttoott pareet gee bur bol |
English: Love breaks, when the speech goes sour.

Gurbani: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਛਾਡੀ ਢੋਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: duramat parahar chhaaddee dtol |
English: The Husband Lord abandons and leaves behind the evil-minded bride.

Gurbani: ਟੂਟੈ ਗੰਠਿ ਪੜੈ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: ttoottai gantth parrai veechaar |
English: The broken knot is tied again, through contemplation and meditation.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਘਰਿ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: gurasabadee ghar kaaraj saar |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one's affairs are resolved in one's own home.

Gurbani: ਲਾਹਾ ਸਾਚੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਤੋਟਾ ॥
Transliteration: laahaa saach na aavai tottaa |
English: One who earns the profit of the True Name, will not lose it again;

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮੋਟਾ ॥੨੮॥
Transliteration: tribhavan tthaakur preetam mottaa |28|
English: the Lord and Master of the three worlds is your best friend. ||28||

Gurbani: ਠਾਕਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਠਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: tthaakahu manooaa raakhahu tthaae |
English: Control your mind, and keep it in its place.

Gurbani: ਠਹਕਿ ਮੁਈ ਅਵਗੁਣਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: tthehak muee avagun pachhutaae |
English: The world is destroyed by conflict, regretting its sinful mistakes.

Gurbani: ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਸਬਾਈ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: tthaakur ek sabaaee naar |
English: There is one Husband Lord, and all are His brides.

Gurbani: ਬਹੁਤੇ ਵੇਸ ਕਰੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: bahute ves kare koorriaar |
English: The false bride wears many costumes.

Gurbani: ਪਰ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਤੀ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: par ghar jaatee tthaak rahaaee |
English: He stops her from going into the homes of others;

Gurbani: ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਈ ਠਾਕ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: mehal bulaaee tthaak na paaee |
English: He summons her to the Mansion of His Presence, and no obstacles block her path.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: sabad savaaree saach piaaree |
English: She is embellished with the Word of the Shabad, and is loved by the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਾਈ ਸੋੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੨੯॥
Transliteration: saaee suohaagan tthaakur dhaaree |29|
English: She is the happy soul bride, who takes the Support of her Lord and Master. ||29||

Gurbani: ਡੋਲਤ ਡੋਲਤ ਹੇ ਸਖੀ ਫਾਟੇ ਚੀਰ ਸੀਗਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: ddolat ddolat he sakhee faatte cheer seegaar |
English: Wandering and roaming around, O my companion, your beautiful robes are torn.

Gurbani: ਡਾਹਪਣਿ ਤਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਡਰ ਬਿਣਠੀ ਡਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: ddaahapan tan sukh nahee bin ddar binatthee ddaar |
English: In jealousy, the body is not at peace; without the Fear of God, multitudes are ruined.

Gurbani: ਡਰਪਿ ਮੁਈ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਡੀਠੀ ਕੰਤਿ ਸੁਜਾਣਿ ॥
Transliteration: ddarap muee ghar aapanai ddeetthee kant sujaan |
English: One who remains dead within her own home, through the Fear of God, is looked upon with favor by her all-knowing Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਡਰੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣਿ ॥
Transliteration: ddar raakhiaa gur aapanai nirbhau naam vakhaan |
English: She maintains fear of her Guru, and chants the Name of the Fearless Lord.

Gurbani: ਡੂਗਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਤਿਖਾ ਘਣੀ ਜਬ ਦੇਖਾ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: ddoogar vaas tikhaa ghanee jab dekhaa nahee door |
English: Living on the mountain, I suffer such great thirst; when I see Him, I know that He is not far away.

Gurbani: ਤਿਖਾ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: tikhaa nivaaree sabad man amrit peea bharapoor |
English: My thirst is quenched, and I have accepted the Word of the Shabad. I drink my fill of the Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਦੇਹਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਆਖੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: dehi dehi aakhai sabh koee jai bhaavai tai dee |
English: Everyone says, "Give! Give!" As He pleases, He gives.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਦੇਵਸੀ ਤਿਖਾ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੩੦॥
Transliteration: guroo duaarai devasee tikhaa nivaarai soe |30|
English: Through the Gurdwara, the Guru's Door, He gives, and quenches the thirst. ||30||

Gurbani: ਢੰਢੋਲਤ ਢੂਢਤ ਹਉ ਫਿਰੀ ਢਹਿ ਢਹਿ ਪਵਨਿ ਕਰਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: dtandtolat dtoodtat hau firee dteh dteh pavan karaar |
English: Searching and seeking, I fell down and collapsed upon the bank of the river of life.

Gurbani: ਭਾਰੇ ਢਹਤੇ ਢਹਿ ਪਏ ਹਉਲੇ ਨਿਕਸੇ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: bhaare dtahate dteh pe haule nikase paar |
English: Those who are heavy with sin sink down, but those who are light swim across.

Gurbani: ਅਮਰ ਅਜਾਚੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: amar ajaachee har mile tin kai hau bal jaau |
English: I am a sacrifice to those who meet the immortal and immeasurable Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਧੂੜਿ ਅਘੁਲੀਐ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tin kee dhoorr aghuleeai sangat mel milaau |
English: The dust of their feet brings emancipation; in their company, we are united in the Lord's Union.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: man deea gur aapanai paaeaa niramal naau |
English: I gave my mind to my Guru, and received the Immaculate Name.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਵਸਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jin naam deea tis sevasaa tis balihaarai jaau |
English: I serve the One who gave me the Naam; I am a sacrifice to Him.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਉਸਾਰੇ ਸੋ ਢਾਹਸੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jo usaare so dtaahasee tis bin avar na koe |
English: He who builds, also demolishes; there is no other than Him.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਮੑਲਾ ਤਾ ਤਨਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੩੧॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee tis samalaa taa tan dookh na hoe |31|
English: By Guru's Grace, I contemplate Him, and then my body does not suffer in pain. ||31||

Gurbani: ਣਾ ਕੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਿਸੁ ਗਹੀ ਣਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਆ ਨ ਹੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: naa ko meraa kis gahee naa ko hoaa na hog |
English: No one is mine - whose gown should I grasp and hold? No one ever was, and no one shall ever be mine.

Gurbani: ਆਵਣਿ ਜਾਣਿ ਵਿਗੁਚੀਐ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: aavan jaan vigucheeai dubidhaa viaapai rog |
English: Coming and going, one is ruined, afflicted with the disease of dual-mindedness.

Gurbani: ਣਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੇ ਆਦਮੀ ਕਲਰ ਕੰਧ ਗਿਰੰਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: naam vihoone aadamee kalar kandh girant |
English: Those beings who lack the Naam, the Name of the Lord, collapse like pillars of salt.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਉ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਜਾਇ ਰਸਾਤਲਿ ਅੰਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: vin naavai kiau chhootteeai jaae rasaatal ant |
English: Without the Name, how can they find release? They fall into hell in the end.

Gurbani: ਗਣਤ ਗਣਾਵੈ ਅਖਰੀ ਅਗਣਤੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: ganat ganaavai akharee aganat saachaa soe |
English: Using a limited number of words, we describe the unlimited True Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਮਤਿਹੀਣੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: agiaanee matiheen hai gur bin giaan na hoe |
English: The ignorant lack understanding. Without the Guru, there is no spiritual wisdom.

Gurbani: ਤੂਟੀ ਤੰਤੁ ਰਬਾਬ ਕੀ ਵਾਜੈ ਨਹੀ ਵਿਜੋਗਿ ॥
Transliteration: toottee tant rabaab kee vaajai nahee vijog |
English: The separated soul is like the broken string of a guitar, which does not vibrate its sound.

Gurbani: ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਮੇਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥੩੨॥
Transliteration: vichhurriaa melai prabhoo naanak kar sanjog |32|
English: God unites the separated souls with Himself, awakening their destiny. ||32||

Gurbani: ਤਰਵਰੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਪੰਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਰਵਰਿ ਪੰਖੀ ਪੰਚ ॥
Transliteration: taravar kaaeaa pankh man taravar pankhee panch |
English: The body is the tree, and the mind is the bird; the birds in the tree are the five senses.

Gurbani: ਤਤੁ ਚੁਗਹਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਏਕਸੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਫਾਸ ਨ ਰੰਚ ॥
Transliteration: tat chugeh mil ekase tin kau faas na ranch |
English: They peck at the essence of reality, and merge with the One Lord. They are never trapped at all.

Gurbani: ਉਡਹਿ ਤ ਬੇਗੁਲ ਬੇਗੁਲੇ ਤਾਕਹਿ ਚੋਗ ਘਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: auddeh ta begul begule taakeh chog ghanee |
English: But the others fly away in a hurry, when they see the food.

Gurbani: ਪੰਖ ਤੁਟੇ ਫਾਹੀ ਪੜੀ ਅਵਗੁਣਿ ਭੀੜ ਬਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: pankh tutte faahee parree avagun bheerr banee |
English: Their feathers are clipped, and they are caught in the noose; through their mistakes, they are caught in disaster.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਕਿਉ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਕਰਮਿ ਮਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: bin saache kiau chhootteeai har gun karam manee |
English: Without the True Lord, how can anyone find release? The jewel of the Lord's Glorious Praises comes by the karma of good actions.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਛਡਾਏ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਵਡਾ ਆਪਿ ਧਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: aap chhaddaae chhootteeai vaddaa aap dhanee |
English: When He Himself releases them, only then are they released. He Himself is the Great Master.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee chhootteeai kirapaa aap karee |
English: By Guru's Grace, they are released, when He Himself grants His Grace.

Gurbani: ਅਪਣੈ ਹਾਥਿ ਵਡਾਈਆ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥੩੩॥
Transliteration: apanai haath vaddaaeea jai bhaavai tai dee |33|
English: Glorious greatness rests in His Hands. He blesses those with whom He is pleased. ||33||

Gurbani: ਥਰ ਥਰ ਕੰਪੈ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਥਾਨ ਵਿਹੂਣਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: thar thar kanpai jeearraa thaan vihoonaa hoe |
English: The soul trembles and shakes, when it loses its mooring and support.

Gurbani: ਥਾਨਿ ਮਾਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਕਾਜੁ ਨ ਫੀਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: thaan maan sach ek hai kaaj na feettai koe |
English: Only the support of the True Lord brings honor and glory. Through it, one's works are never in vain.

Gurbani: ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਥਿਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: thir naaraaein thir guroo thir saachaa beechaar |
English: The Lord is eternal and forever stable; the Guru is stable, and contemplation upon the True Lord is stable.

Gurbani: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਨਾਥਹ ਨਾਥੁ ਤੂ ਨਿਧਾਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sur nar naathah naath too nidhaaraa aadhaar |
English: O Lord and Master of angels, men and Yogic masters, You are the support of the unsupported.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬੇ ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰੀ ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sarabe thaan thanantaree too daataa daataar |
English: In all places and interspaces, You are the Giver, the Great Giver.

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਏਕੁ ਤੂ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jeh dekhaa teh ek too ant na paaraavaar |
English: Wherever I look, there I see You, Lord; You have no end or limitation.

Gurbani: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: thaan thanantar rav rahiaa gurasabadee veechaar |
English: You are pervading and permeating the places and interspaces; reflecting upon the Word of the Guru's Shabad, You are found.

Gurbani: ਅਣਮੰਗਿਆ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵਸੀ ਵਡਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੩੪॥
Transliteration: anamangiaa daan devasee vaddaa agam apaar |34|
English: You give gifts even when they are not asked for; You are great, inaccessible and infinite. ||34||

Gurbani: ਦਇਆ ਦਾਨੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤੂ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: deaa daan deaal too kar kar dekhanahaar |
English: O Merciful Lord, You are the embodiment of mercy; creating the Creation, You behold it.

Gurbani: ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਢਾਹਿ ਉਸਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: deaa kareh prabh mel laihi khin meh dtaeh usaar |
English: Please shower Your Mercy upon me, O God, and unite me with Yourself. In an instant, You destroy and rebuild.

Gurbani: ਦਾਨਾ ਤੂ ਬੀਨਾ ਤੁਹੀ ਦਾਨਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: daanaa too beenaa tuhee daanaa kai sir daan |
English: You are all-wise and all-seeing; You are the Greatest Giver of all givers.

Gurbani: ਦਾਲਦ ਭੰਜਨ ਦੁਖ ਦਲਣ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੩੫॥
Transliteration: daalad bhanjan dukh dalan guramukh giaan dhiaan |35|
English: He is the Eradicator of poverty, and the Destroyer of pain; the Gurmukh realizes spiritual wisdom and meditation. ||35||

Gurbani: ਧਨਿ ਗਇਐ ਬਹਿ ਝੂਰੀਐ ਧਨ ਮਹਿ ਚੀਤੁ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: dhan geiai beh jhooreeai dhan meh cheet gavaar |
English: Losing his wealth, he cries out in anguish; the fool's consciousness is engrossed in wealth.

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਵਿਰਲੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: dhan viralee sach sanchiaa niramal naam piaar |
English: How rare are those who gather the wealth of Truth, and love the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਗਇਆ ਤਾ ਜਾਣ ਦੇਹਿ ਜੇ ਰਾਚਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਏਕ ॥
Transliteration: dhan geaa taa jaan dehi je raacheh rang ek |
English: If by losing your wealth, you may become absorbed in the Love of the One Lord, then just let it go.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਸਿਰੁ ਸਉਪੀਐ ਭੀ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ॥
Transliteration: man deejai sir saupeeai bhee karate kee ttek |
English: Dedicate your mind, and surrender your head; seek only the Support of the Creator Lord.

Gurbani: ਧੰਧਾ ਧਾਵਤ ਰਹਿ ਗਏ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: dhandhaa dhaavat reh ge man meh sabad anand |
English: Worldly affairs and wanderings cease, when the mind is filled with the bliss of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਦੁਰਜਨ ਤੇ ਸਾਜਨ ਭਏ ਭੇਟੇ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: durajan te saajan bhe bhette gur govind |
English: Even one's enemies become friends, meeting with the Guru, the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਬਨੁ ਬਨੁ ਫਿਰਤੀ ਢੂਢਤੀ ਬਸਤੁ ਰਹੀ ਘਰਿ ਬਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: ban ban firatee dtoodtatee basat rahee ghar baar |
English: Wandering from forest to forest searching, you will find that those things are within the home of your own heart.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥੩੬॥
Transliteration: satigur melee mil rahee janam maran dukh nivaar |36|
English: United by the True Guru, you shall remain united, and the pains of birth and death will be ended. ||36||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਾ ਕਰਤ ਨ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਣ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: naanaa karat na chhootteeai vin gun jam pur jaeh |
English: Through various rituals, one does not find release. Without virtue, one is sent to the City of Death.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਏਹੁ ਨ ਓਹੁ ਹੈ ਅਵਗੁਣਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: naa tis ehu na ohu hai avagun fir pachhutaeh |
English: One will not have this world or the next; committing sinful mistakes, one comes to regret and repent in the end.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਹੈ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: naa tis giaan na dhiaan hai naa tis dharam dhiaan |
English: He has neither spiritual wisdom or meditation; neither Dharmic faith mor meditation.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕਹਾ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਣਾ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: vin naavai nirbhau kahaa kiaa jaanaa abhimaan |
English: Without the Name, how can one be fearless? How can he understand egotistical pride?

Gurbani: ਥਾਕਿ ਰਹੀ ਕਿਵ ਅਪੜਾ ਹਾਥ ਨਹੀ ਨਾ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: thaak rahee kiv aparraa haath nahee naa paar |
English: I am so tired - how can I get there? This ocean has no bottom or end.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਸਾਜਨ ਸੇ ਰੰਗੁਲੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਕਰੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: naa saajan se rangule kis peh karee pukaar |
English: I have no loving companions, whom I can ask for help.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਜੇ ਕਰੀ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak priau priau je karee mele melanahaar |
English: O Nanak, crying out, "Beloved, Beloved", we are united with the Uniter.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਛੋੜੀ ਸੋ ਮੇਲਸੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥੩੭॥
Transliteration: jin vichhorree so melasee gur kai het apaar |37|
English: He who separated me, unites me again; my love for the Guru is infinite. ||37||

Gurbani: ਪਾਪੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਪਾਪੀ ਕਉ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: paap buraa paapee kau piaaraa |
English: Sin is bad, but it is dear to the sinner.

Gurbani: ਪਾਪਿ ਲਦੇ ਪਾਪੇ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: paap lade paape paasaaraa |
English: He loads himself with sin, and expands his world through sin.

Gurbani: ਪਰਹਰਿ ਪਾਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਆਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: parahar paap pachhaanai aap |
English: Sin is far away from one who understands himself.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: naa tis sog vijog santaap |
English: He is not afflicted by sorrow or separation.

Gurbani: ਨਰਕਿ ਪੜੰਤਉ ਕਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਕਿਉ ਬੰਚੈ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: narak parrantau kiau rahai kiau banchai jamakaal |
English: How can one avoid falling into hell? How can he cheat the Messenger of Death?

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਝੂਠੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਖੈ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: kiau aavan jaanaa veesarai jhootth buraa khai kaal |
English: How can coming and going be forgotten? Falsehood is bad, and death is cruel.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਜੰਜਾਲੀ ਵੇੜਿਆ ਭੀ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: man janjaalee verriaa bhee janjaalaa maeh |
English: The mind is enveloped by entanglements, and into entanglements it falls.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਉ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਪਾਪੇ ਪਚਹਿ ਪਚਾਹਿ ॥੩੮॥
Transliteration: vin naavai kiau chhootteeai paape pacheh pachaeh |38|
English: Without the Name, how can anyone be saved? They rot away in sin. ||38||

Gurbani: ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਾਹੀ ਫਾਸੈ ਕਊਆ ॥
Transliteration: fir fir faahee faasai kaooaa |
English: Again and again, the crow falls into the trap.

Gurbani: ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਨਾ ਅਬ ਕਿਆ ਹੂਆ ॥
Transliteration: fir pachhutaanaa ab kiaa hooaa |
English: Then he regrets it, but what can he do now?

Gurbani: ਫਾਥਾ ਚੋਗ ਚੁਗੈ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
Transliteration: faathaa chog chugai nahee boojhai |
English: Even though he is trapped, he pecks at the food; he does not understand.

Gurbani: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਆਖੀ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
Transliteration: satagur milai ta aakhee soojhai |
English: If he meets the True Guru, then he sees with his eyes.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਫਾਥੀ ਜਮ ਜਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: jiau machhulee faathee jam jaal |
English: Like a fish, he is caught in the noose of death.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਦਾਤੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: vin gur daate mukat na bhaal |
English: Do not seek liberation from anyone else, except the Guru, the Great Giver.

Gurbani: ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: fir fir aavai fir fir jaae |
English: Over and over again, he comes; over and over again, he goes.

Gurbani: ਇਕ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਚੈ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: eik rang rachai rahai liv laae |
English: Be absorbed in love for the One Lord, and remain lovingly focused on Him.

Gurbani: ਇਵ ਛੂਟੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਾਸ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੩੯॥
Transliteration: eiv chhoottai fir faas na paae |39|
English: In this way you shall be saved, and you shall not fall into the trap again. ||39||

Gurbani: ਬੀਰਾ ਬੀਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੀ ਬੀਰ ਭਏ ਬੈਰਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: beeraa beeraa kar rahee beer bhe bairaae |
English: She calls out, "Brother, O brother - stay, O brother!" But he becomes a stranger.

Gurbani: ਬੀਰ ਚਲੇ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਬਹਿਣ ਬਿਰਹਿ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: beer chale ghar aapanai bahin bireh jal jaae |
English: Her brother departs for his own home, and his sister burns with the pain of separation.

Gurbani: ਬਾਬੁਲ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਬੇਟੜੀ ਬਾਲੀ ਬਾਲੈ ਨੇਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: baabul kai ghar bettarree baalee baalai nehi |
English: In this world, her father's home, the daughter, the innocent soul bride, loves her Young Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਵਰੁ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤੇਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: je lorreh var kaamanee satigur seveh tehi |
English: If you long for your Husband Lord, O soul bride, then serve the True Guru with love.

Gurbani: ਬਿਰਲੋ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਬੂਝਣਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਮਿਲੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: biralo giaanee boojhnau satigur saach milee |
English: How rare are the spiritually wise, who meet the True Guru, and truly understand.

Gurbani: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਾਥਿ ਵਡਾਈਆ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: tthaakur haath vaddaaeea jai bhaavai tai dee |
English: All glorious greatness rests in the Lord and Master's Hands. He grants them, when He is pleased.

Gurbani: ਬਾਣੀ ਬਿਰਲਉ ਬੀਚਾਰਸੀ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: baanee birlau beechaarasee je ko guramukh hoe |
English: How rare are those who contemplate the Word of the Guru's Bani; they become Gurmukh.

Gurbani: ਇਹ ਬਾਣੀ ਮਹਾ ਪੁਰਖ ਕੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੪੦॥
Transliteration: eih baanee mahaa purakh kee nij ghar vaasaa hoe |40|
English: This is the Bani of the Supreme Being; through it, one dwells within the home of his inner being. ||40||

Gurbani: ਭਨਿ ਭਨਿ ਘੜੀਐ ਘੜਿ ਘੜਿ ਭਜੈ ਢਾਹਿ ਉਸਾਰੈ ਉਸਰੇ ਢਾਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: bhan bhan gharreeai gharr gharr bhajai dtaeh usaarai usare dtaahai |
English: Shattering and breaking apart, He creates and re-creates; creating, He shatters again. He builds up what He has demolished, and demolishes what He has built.

Gurbani: ਸਰ ਭਰਿ ਸੋਖੈ ਭੀ ਭਰਿ ਪੋਖੈ ਸਮਰਥ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: sar bhar sokhai bhee bhar pokhai samarath veparavaahai |
English: He dries up the pools which are full, and fills the dried tanks again. He is all-powerful and independent.

Gurbani: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਨੇ ਭਏ ਦਿਵਾਨੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਕਿਆ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: bharam bhulaane bhe divaane vin bhaagaa kiaa paaeeai |
English: Deluded by doubt, they have gone insane; without destiny, what do they obtain?

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਡੋਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪਕੜੀ ਜਿਨ ਖਿੰਚੈ ਤਿਨ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh giaan ddoree prabh pakarree jin khinchai tin jaaeeai |
English: The Gurmukhs know that God holds the string; wherever He pulls it, they must go.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: har gun gaae sadaa rang raate bahurr na pachhotaaeeai |
English: Those who sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, are forever imbued with His Love; they never again feel regret.

Gurbani: ਭਭੈ ਭਾਲਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਤਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: bhabhai bhaaleh guramukh boojheh taa nij ghar vaasaa paaeeai |
English: Bhabha: If someone seeks, and then becomes Gurmukh, then he comes to dwell in the home of his own heart.

Gurbani: ਭਭੈ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਵਿਖੜਾ ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ਤਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: bhabhai bhaujal maarag vikharraa aas niraasaa tareeai |
English: Bhabha: The way of the terrifying world-ocean is treacherous. Remain free of hope, in the midst of hope, and you shall cross over.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਆਪੋ ਚੀਨੑੈ ਜੀਵਤਿਆ ਇਵ ਮਰੀਐ ॥੪੧॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee aapo cheenai jeevatiaa iv mareeai |41|
English: By Guru's Grace, one comes to understand himself; in this way, he remains dead while yet alive. ||41||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਏ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa maaeaa kar mue maaeaa kisai na saath |
English: Crying out for the wealth and riches of Maya, they die; but Maya does not go along with them.

Gurbani: ਹੰਸੁ ਚਲੈ ਉਠਿ ਡੁਮਣੋ ਮਾਇਆ ਭੂਲੀ ਆਥਿ ॥
Transliteration: hans chalai utth ddumano maaeaa bhoolee aath |
English: The soul-swan arises and departs, sad and depressed, leaving its wealth behind.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਝੂਠਾ ਜਮਿ ਜੋਹਿਆ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਚਲਹਿ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: man jhootthaa jam johiaa avagun chaleh naal |
English: The false mind is hunted by the Messenger of Death; it carries its faults along when it goes.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਉਲਟੋ ਮਰੈ ਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: man meh man ulatto marai je gun hoveh naal |
English: The mind turns inward, and merges with mind, when it is with virtue.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਏ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: meree meree kar mue vin naavai dukh bhaal |
English: Crying out, "Mine, mine!", they have died, but without the Name, they find only pain.

Gurbani: ਗੜ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਲਾ ਕਹਾ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਜੀ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: garr mandar mahalaa kahaa jiau baajee deebaan |
English: So where are their forts, mansions, palaces and courts? They are like a short story.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਣੁ ਝੂਠਾ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak sache naam vin jhootthaa aavan jaan |
English: O Nanak, without the True Name, the false just come and go.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥੪੨॥
Transliteration: aape chatur saroop hai aape jaan sujaan |42|
English: He Himself is clever and so very beautiful; He Himself is wise and all-knowing. ||42||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਆਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਆਇ ਗਏ ਪਛੁਤਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jo aaveh se jaeh fun aae ge pachhutaeh |
English: Those who come, must go in the end; they come and go, regretting and repenting.

Gurbani: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਮੇਦਨੀ ਘਟੈ ਨ ਵਧੈ ਉਤਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh medanee ghattai na vadhai utaeh |
English: They will pass through 8.4 millions species; this number does not decrease or rise.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: se jan ubare jin har bhaaeaa |
English: They alone are saved, who love the Lord.

Gurbani: ਧੰਧਾ ਮੁਆ ਵਿਗੂਤੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: dhandhaa muaa vigootee maaeaa |
English: Their worldly entanglements are ended, and Maya is conquered.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਚਾਲਸੀ ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਮੀਤੁ ਕਰੇਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo deesai so chaalasee kis kau meet kareo |
English: Whoever is seen, shall depart; who should I make my friend?

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਸਮਪਉ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਆਗੈ ਦੇਉ ॥
Transliteration: jeeo sampau aapanaa tan man aagai deo |
English: I dedicate my soul, and place my body and mind in offering before Him.

Gurbani: ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਤੂ ਧਣੀ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੀ ਮੈ ਓਟ ॥
Transliteration: asathir karataa too dhanee tis hee kee mai ott |
English: You are eternally stable, O Creator, Lord and Master; I lean on Your Support.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਕੀ ਮਾਰੀ ਹਉ ਮੁਈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੀ ਮਨਿ ਚੋਟ ॥੪੩॥
Transliteration: gun kee maaree hau muee sabad ratee man chott |43|
English: Conquered by virtue, egotism is killed; imbued with the Word of the Shabad, the mind rejects the world. ||43||

Gurbani: ਰਾਣਾ ਰਾਉ ਨ ਕੋ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਤੁੰਗੁ ਫਕੀਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: raanaa raau na ko rahai rang na tung fakeer |
English: Neither the kings nor the nobles will remain; neither the rich nor the poor will remain.

Gurbani: ਵਾਰੀ ਆਪੋ ਆਪਣੀ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਬੰਧੈ ਧੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: vaaree aapo aapanee koe na bandhai dheer |
English: When one's turn comes, no one can stay here.

Gurbani: ਰਾਹੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਭੀਹਾਵਲਾ ਸਰ ਡੂਗਰ ਅਸਗਾਹ ॥
Transliteration: raahu buraa bheehaavalaa sar ddoogar asagaah |
English: The path is difficult and treacherous; the pools and mountains are impassable.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਤਨਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਝੁਰਿ ਮੁਈ ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਣ ਕਿਉ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਹ ॥
Transliteration: mai tan avagan jhur muee vin gun kiau ghar jaah |
English: My body is filled with faults; I am dying of grief. Without virtue, how can I enter my home?

Gurbani: ਗੁਣੀਆ ਗੁਣ ਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲੇ ਕਿਉ ਤਿਨ ਮਿਲਉ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: guneea gun le prabh mile kiau tin milau piaar |
English: The virtuous take virtue, and meet God; how can I meet them with love?

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਜੈਸੀ ਥੀ ਰਹਾਂ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: tin hee jaisee thee rahaan jap jap ridai muraar |
English: If ony I could be like them, chanting and meditating within my heart on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਵਗੁਣੀ ਭਰਪੂਰ ਹੈ ਗੁਣ ਭੀ ਵਸਹਿ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: avagunee bharapoor hai gun bhee vaseh naal |
English: He is overflowing with faults and demerits, but virtue dwells within him as well.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਗੁਣ ਨ ਜਾਪਨੀ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੪੪॥
Transliteration: vin satagur gun na jaapanee jichar sabad na kare beechaar |44|
English: Without the True Guru, he does not see God's Virtues; he does not chant the Glorious Virtues of God. ||44||

Gurbani: ਲਸਕਰੀਆ ਘਰ ਸੰਮਲੇ ਆਏ ਵਜਹੁ ਲਿਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: lasakareea ghar samale aae vajahu likhaae |
English: God's soldiers take care of their homes; their pay is pre-ordained, before they come into the world.

Gurbani: ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਧਣੀ ਲਾਹਾ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kaar kamaaveh sir dhanee laahaa palai paae |
English: They serve their Supreme Lord and Master, and obtain the profit.

Gurbani: ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਬੁਰਿਆਈਆ ਛੋਡੇ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: lab lobh buriaaeea chhodde manahu visaar |
English: They renounce greed, avarice and evil, and forget them from their minds.

Gurbani: ਗੜਿ ਦੋਹੀ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਕੀ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: garr dohee paatisaah kee kade na aavai haar |
English: In the fortress of the body, they announce the victory of their Supreme King; they are never ever vanquished.

Gurbani: ਚਾਕਰੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਸਉਹੇ ਉਤਰ ਦੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: chaakar kaheeai khasam kaa sauhe utar dee |
English: One who calls himself a servant of his Lord and Master, and yet speaks defiantly to Him,

Gurbani: ਵਜਹੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਖਤਿ ਨ ਬੈਸਹਿ ਸੇਇ ॥
