Transliteration: vajahu gavaae aapanaa takhat na baiseh see |
English: shall forfeit his pay, and not be seated upon the throne.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਹਥਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: preetam hath vaddiaaeea jai bhaavai tai dee |
English: Glorious greatness rests in the hands of my Beloved; He gives, according to the Pleasure of His Will.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੪੫॥
Transliteration: aap kare kis aakheeai avar na koe karee |45|
English: He Himself does everything; who else should we address? No one else does anything. ||45||

Gurbani: ਬੀਜਉ ਸੂਝੈ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਬਹੈ ਦੁਲੀਚਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: beejau soojhai ko nahee bahai duleechaa paae |
English: I cannot conceive of any other, who could be seated upon the royal cushions.

Gurbani: ਨਰਕ ਨਿਵਾਰਣੁ ਨਰਹ ਨਰੁ ਸਾਚਉ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: narak nivaaran narah nar saachau saachai naae |
English: The Supreme Man of men eradicates hell; He is True, and True is His Name.

Gurbani: ਵਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਢੂਢਤ ਫਿਰਿ ਰਹੀ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਰਉ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: van trin dtoodtat fir rahee man meh krau beechaar |
English: I wandered around searching for Him in the forests and meadows; I contemplate Him within my mind.

Gurbani: ਲਾਲ ਰਤਨ ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣਕੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਾਥਿ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: laal ratan bahu maanakee satigur haath bhanddaar |
English: The treasures of myriads of pearls, jewels and emeralds are in the hands of the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਊਤਮੁ ਹੋਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਏਕੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aootam hovaa prabh milai ik man ekai bhaae |
English: Meeting with God, I am exalted and elevated; I love the One Lord single-mindedly.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਰਸਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਲਾਹਾ ਲੈ ਪਰਥਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak preetam ras mile laahaa lai parathaae |
English: O Nanak, one who lovingly meets with his Beloved, earns profit in the world hereafter.

Gurbani: ਰਚਨਾ ਰਾਚਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਰਿਆ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: rachanaa raach jin rachee jin siriaa aakaar |
English: He who created and formed the creation, made your form as well.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੪੬॥
Transliteration: guramukh beant dhiaaeeai ant na paaraavaar |46|
English: As Gurmukh, meditate on the Infinite Lord, who has no end or limitation. ||46||

Gurbani: ੜਾੜੈ ਰੂੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: rraarrai roorraa har jeeo soee |
English: Rharha: The Dear Lord is beautiful;

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: tis bin raajaa avar na koee |
English: There is no other king, except Him.

Gurbani: ੜਾੜੈ ਗਾਰੁੜੁ ਤੁਮ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: rraarrai gaarurr tum sunahu har vasai man maeh |
English: Rharha: Listen to the spell, and the Lord will come to dwell in your mind.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਤੁ ਕੋ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee har paaeeai mat ko bharam bhulaeh |
English: By Guru's Grace, one finds the Lord; do not be deluded by doubt.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: so saahu saachaa jis har dhan raas |
English: He alone is the true banker, who has the capital of the wealth of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh pooraa tis saabaas |
English: The Gurmukh is perfect - applaud him!

Gurbani: ਰੂੜੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: roorree baanee har paaeaa gurasabadee beechaar |
English: Through the beautiful Word of the Guru's Bani, the Lord is obtained; contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਟਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਰਿ ॥੪੭॥
Transliteration: aap geaa dukh kattiaa har var paaeaa naar |47|
English: Self-conceit is eliminated, and pain is eradicated; the soul bride obtains her Husband Lord. ||47||

Gurbani: ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਸੰਚੀਐ ਧਨੁ ਕਾਚਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sueinaa rupaa sancheeai dhan kaachaa bikh chhaar |
English: He hoards gold and silver, but this wealth is false and poisonous, nothing more than ashes.

Gurbani: ਸਾਹੁ ਸਦਾਏ ਸੰਚਿ ਧਨੁ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: saahu sadaae sanch dhan dubidhaa hoe khuaar |
English: He calls himself a banker, gathering wealth, but he is ruined by his dual-mindedness.

Gurbani: ਸਚਿਆਰੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਸਾਚਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: sachiaaree sach sanchiaa saachau naam amol |
English: The truthful ones gather Truth; the True Name is priceless.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਾਇਲੁ ਊਜਲੋ ਪਤਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਸਚੁ ਬੋਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: har niramaaeil aoojalo pat saachee sach bol |
English: The Lord is immaculate and pure; through Him, their honor is true, and their speech is true.

Gurbani: ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੀਤੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਤੂ ਤੂ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਤੂ ਹੰਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: saajan meet sujaan too too saravar too hans |
English: You are my friend and companion, all-knowing Lord; You are the lake, and You are the swan.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਉ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: saachau tthaakur man vasai hau balihaaree tis |
English: I am a sacrifice to that being, whose mind is filled with the True Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤੀ ਸੋ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mamataa mohanee jin keetee so jaan |
English: Know the One who created love and attachment to Maya, the Enticer.

Gurbani: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥੪੮॥
Transliteration: bikhiaa amrit ek hai boojhai purakh sujaan |48|
English: One who realizes the all-knowing Primal Lord, looks alike upon poison and nectar. ||48||

Gurbani: ਖਿਮਾ ਵਿਹੂਣੇ ਖਪਿ ਗਏ ਖੂਹਣਿ ਲਖ ਅਸੰਖ ॥
Transliteration: khimaa vihoone khap ge khoohan lakh asankh |
English: Without patience and forgiveness, countless hundreds of thousands have perished.

Gurbani: ਗਣਤ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕਿਉ ਗਣੀ ਖਪਿ ਖਪਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਸੰਖ ॥
Transliteration: ganat na aavai kiau ganee khap khap mue bisankh |
English: Their numbers cannot be counted; how could I count them? Bothered and bewildered, uncounted numbers have died.

Gurbani: ਖਸਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਖੂਲੈ ਬੰਧੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: khasam pachhaanai aapanaa khoolai bandh na paae |
English: One who realizes his Lord and Master is set free, and not bound by chains.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਹਲੀ ਖਰਾ ਤੂ ਖਿਮਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਖ ਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabad mahalee kharaa too khimaa sach sukh bhaae |
English: Through the Word of the Shabad, enter the Mansion of the Lord's Presence; you shall be blessed with patience, forgiveness, truth and peace.

Gurbani: ਖਰਚੁ ਖਰਾ ਧਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਵਸਹਿ ਸਰੀਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: kharach kharaa dhan dhiaan too aape vaseh sareer |
English: Partake of the true wealth of meditation, and the Lord Himself shall abide within your body.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਪੈ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਧੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: man tan mukh jaapai sadaa gun antar man dheer |
English: With mind, body and mouth, chant His Glorious Virtues forever; courage and composure shall enter deep within your mind.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਖਪੈ ਖਪਾਇਸੀ ਬੀਜਉ ਵਥੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: haumai khapai khapaaeisee beejau vath vikaar |
English: Through egotism, one is distracted and ruined; other than the Lord, all things are corrupt.

Gurbani: ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਇਅਨੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਅਲਗੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੪੯॥
Transliteration: jant upaae vich paaeian karataa alag apaar |49|
English: Forming His creatures, He placed Himself within them; the Creator is unattached and infinite. ||49||

Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟੇ ਭੇਉ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: srisatte bheo na jaanai koe |
English: No one knows the mystery of the Creator of the World.

Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਾ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਨਿਹਚਉ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: srisattaa karai su nihchau hoe |
English: Whatever the Creator of the World does, is certain to occur.

Gurbani: ਸੰਪੈ ਕਉ ਈਸਰੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: sanpai kau eesar dhiaaeeai |
English: For wealth, some meditate on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੰਪੈ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਲਿਖੇ ਕੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: sanpai purab likhe kee paaeeai |
English: By pre-ordained destiny, wealth is obtained.

Gurbani: ਸੰਪੈ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਚਾਕਰ ਚੋਰ ॥
Transliteration: sanpai kaaran chaakar chor |
English: For the sake of wealth, some become servants or thieves.

Gurbani: ਸੰਪੈ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਹੋਰ ॥
Transliteration: sanpai saath na chaalai hor |
English: Wealth does not go along with them when they die; it passes into the hands of others.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਹੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: bin saache nahee daragah maan |
English: Without Truth, honor is not obtained in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਛੁਟੈ ਨਿਦਾਨਿ ॥੫੦॥
Transliteration: har ras peevai chhuttai nidaan |50|
English: Drinking in the subtle essence of the Lord, one is emancipated in the end. ||50||

Gurbani: ਹੇਰਤ ਹੇਰਤ ਹੇ ਸਖੀ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੀ ਹੈਰਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: herat herat he sakhee hoe rahee hairaan |
English: Seeing and perceiving, O my companions, I am wonder-struck and amazed.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤੀ ਮੈ ਮੁਈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: hau hau karatee mai muee sabad ravai man giaan |
English: My egotism, which proclaimed itself in possessiveness and self-conceit, is dead. My mind chants the Word of the Shabad, and attains spiritual wisdom.

Gurbani: ਹਾਰ ਡੋਰ ਕੰਕਨ ਘਣੇ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਕੀ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: haar ddor kankan ghane kar thaakee seegaar |
English: I am so tired of wearing all these necklaces, hair-ties and bracelets, and decorating myself.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਗਲ ਗੁਣਾ ਗਲਿ ਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: mil preetam sukh paaeaa sagal gunaa gal haar |
English: Meeting with my Beloved, I have found peace; now, I wear the necklace of total virtue.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh paaeeai har siau preet piaar |
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh attains the Lord, with love and affection.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: har bin kin sukh paaeaa dekhahu man beechaar |
English: Without the Lord, who has found peace? Reflect upon this in your mind, and see.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪੜਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਬੁਝਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਖਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: har parranaa har bujhanaa har siau rakhahu piaar |
English: Read about the Lord, understand the Lord, and enshrine love for the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥੫੧॥
Transliteration: har japeeai har dhiaaeeai har kaa naam adhaar |51|
English: Chant the Lord's Name, and meditate on the Lord; hold tight to the Support of the Name of the Lord. ||51||

Gurbani: ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਮਿਟਈ ਹੇ ਸਖੀ ਜੋ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: lekh na mittee he sakhee jo likhiaa karataar |
English: The inscription inscribed by the Creator Lord cannot be erased, O my companions.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਗੁ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: aape kaaran jin keea kar kirapaa pag dhaar |
English: He who created the universe, in His Mercy, installs His Feet within us.

Gurbani: ਕਰਤੇ ਹਥਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: karate hath vaddiaaeea boojhahu gur beechaar |
English: Glorious greatness rests in the Hands of the Creator; reflect upon the Guru, and understand this.

Gurbani: ਲਿਖਿਆ ਫੇਰਿ ਨ ਸਕੀਐ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੀ ਤਿਉ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: likhiaa fer na sakeeai jiau bhaavee tiau saar |
English: This inscription cannot be challenged. As it pleases You, You care for me.

Gurbani: ਨਦਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: nadar teree sukh paaeaa naanak sabad veechaar |
English: By Your Glance of Grace, I have found peace; O Nanak, reflect upon the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭੂਲੇ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਉਬਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh bhoole pach mue ubare gur beechaar |
English: The self-willed manmukhs are confused; they rot away and die. Only by reflecting upon the Guru can they be saved.

Gurbani: ਜਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: ji purakh nadar na aavee tis kaa kiaa kar kahiaa jaae |
English: What can anyone say, about that Primal Lord, who cannot be seen?

Gurbani: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦਿਤਾ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥੫੨॥
Transliteration: balihaaree gur aapane jin hiradai ditaa dikhaae |52|
English: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, who has revealed Him to me, within my own heart. ||52||

Gurbani: ਪਾਧਾ ਪੜਿਆ ਆਖੀਐ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਬਿਚਰੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: paadhaa parriaa aakheeai bidiaa bicharai sehaj subhaae |
English: That Pandit, that religious scholar, is said to be well-educated, if he contemplates knowledge with intuitive ease.

Gurbani: ਬਿਦਿਆ ਸੋਧੈ ਤਤੁ ਲਹੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bidiaa sodhai tat lahai raam naam liv laae |
English: Considering his knowledge, he finds the essence of reality, and lovingly focuses his attention on the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਬਿਕ੍ਰਦਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਟੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh bidiaa bikradaa bikh khatte bikh khaae |
English: The self-willed manmukh sells his knowledge; he earns poison, and eats poison.

Gurbani: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਚੀਨਈ ਸੂਝ ਬੂਝ ਨਹ ਕਾਇ ॥੫੩॥
Transliteration: moorakh sabad na cheenee soojh boojh neh kaae |53|
English: The fool does not think of the Word of the Shabad. He has no understanding, no comprehension. ||53||

Gurbani: ਪਾਧਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਖੀਐ ਚਾਟੜਿਆ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: paadhaa guramukh aakheeai chaattarriaa mat dee |
English: That Pandit is called Gurmukh, who imparts understanding to his students.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਹੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਗਰਹੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਲੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: naam samaalahu naam sangarahu laahaa jag meh lee |
English: Contemplate the Naam, the Name of the Lord; gather in the Naam, and earn the true profit in this world.

Gurbani: ਸਚੀ ਪਟੀ ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਪੜੀਐ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sachee pattee sach man parreeai sabad su saar |
English: With the true notebook of the true mind, study the most sublime Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪੜਿਆ ਸੋ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਬੀਨਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਗਲਿ ਹਾਰੁ ॥੫੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak so parriaa so panddit beenaa jis raam naam gal haar |54|1|
English: O Nanak, he alone is learned, and he alone is a wise Pandit, who wears the necklace of the Lord's Name. ||54||1||

[Ang 938 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਸਿਧ ਗੋਸਟਿ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 1 sidh gosatt |
English: Raamkalee, First Mehl, Sidh Gosht ~ Conversations With The Siddhas:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸਿਧ ਸਭਾ ਕਰਿ ਆਸਣਿ ਬੈਠੇ ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਜੈਕਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: sidh sabhaa kar aasan baitthe sant sabhaa jaikaaro |
English: The Siddhas formed an assembly; sitting in their Yogic postures, they shouted, "Salute this gathering of Saints."

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: tis aagai raharaas hamaaree saachaa apar apaaro |
English: I offer my salutation to the One who is true, infinite and incomparably beautiful.

Gurbani: ਮਸਤਕੁ ਕਾਟਿ ਧਰੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਆਗੈ ਦੇਉ ॥
Transliteration: masatak kaatt dharee tis aagai tan man aagai deo |
English: I cut off my head, and offer it to Him; I dedicate my body and mind to Him.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਹਜ ਭਾਇ ਜਸੁ ਲੇਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak sant milai sach paaeeai sehaj bhaae jas leo |1|
English: O Nanak, meeting with the Saints, Truth is obtained, and one is spontaneously blessed with distinction. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਭਵੀਐ ਸਚਿ ਸੂਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa bhaveeai sach soochaa hoe |
English: What is the use of wandering around? Purity comes only through Truth.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saach sabad bin mukat na koe |1| rahaau |
English: Without the True Word of the Shabad, no one finds liberation. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਵਨ ਤੁਮੇ ਕਿਆ ਨਾਉ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਕਉਨੁ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਸੁਆਓ ॥
Transliteration: kavan tume kiaa naau tumaaraa kaun maarag kaun suaao |
English: Who are you? What is your name? What is your way? What is your goal?

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹਉ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਹਉ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਓ ॥
Transliteration: saach khau aradaas hamaaree hau sant janaa bal jaao |
English: We pray that you will answer us truthfully; we are a sacrifice to the humble Saints.

Gurbani: ਕਹ ਬੈਸਹੁ ਕਹ ਰਹੀਐ ਬਾਲੇ ਕਹ ਆਵਹੁ ਕਹ ਜਾਹੋ ॥
Transliteration: keh baisahu keh raheeai baale keh aavahu keh jaaho |
English: Where is your seat? Where do you live, boy? Where did you come from, and where are you going?

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਕਿਆ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਰਾਹੋ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak bolai sun bairaagee kiaa tumaaraa raaho |2|
English: Tell us, Nanak - the detached Siddhas wait to hear your reply. What is your path?" ||2||

[Ang 938 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਬੈਸਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਚਾਲਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt bais nirantar raheeai chaaleh satigur bhaae |
English: He dwells deep within the nucleus of each and every heart. This is my seat and my home. I walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਆਏ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਿਧਾਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਰਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sahaje aae hukam sidhaae naanak sadaa rajaae |
English: I came from the Celestial Lord God; I go wherever He orders me to go. I am Nanak, forever under the Command of His Will.

Gurbani: ਆਸਣਿ ਬੈਸਣਿ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਐਸੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aasan baisan thir naaraaein aisee guramat paae |
English: I sit in the posture of the eternal, imperishable Lord. These are the Teachings I have received from the Guru.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: guramukh boojhai aap pachhaanai sache sach samaae |3|
English: As Gurmukh, I have come to understand and realize myself; I merge in the Truest of the True. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: duneea saagar dutar kaheeai kiau kar paaeeai paaro |
English: "The world-ocean is treacherous and impassable; how can one cross over?"

Gurbani: ਚਰਪਟੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਅਉਧੂ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਹੁ ਸਚਾ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: charapatt bolai aaudhoo naanak dehu sachaa beechaaro |
English: Charpat the Yogi says, "O Nanak, think it over, and give us your true reply."

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਆਖੈ ਆਪੇ ਸਮਝੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਉਤਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: aape aakhai aape samajhai tis kiaa utar deejai |
English: What answer can I give to someone, who claims to understand himself?

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਪਾਰਗਰਾਮੀ ਤੁਝੁ ਕਿਆ ਬੈਸਣੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: saach kahahu tum paaragaraamee tujh kiaa baisan deejai |4|
English: I speak the Truth; if you have already crossed over, how can I argue with you? ||4||

[Ang 938 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਮੁਰਗਾਈ ਨੈ ਸਾਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: jaise jal meh kamal niraalam muragaaee nai saane |
English: The lotus flower floats untouched upon the surface of the water, and the duck swims through the stream;

Gurbani: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: surat sabad bhav saagar tareeai naanak naam vakhaane |
English: with one's consciousness focused on the Word of the Shabad, one crosses over the terrifying world-ocean. O Nanak, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਰਹਹਿ ਇਕਾਂਤਿ ਏਕੋ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਆਸਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਸੋ ॥
Transliteration: raheh ikaant eko man vasiaa aasaa maeh niraaso |
English: One who lives alone, as a hermit, enshrining the One Lord in his mind, remaining unaffected by hope in the midst of hope,

Gurbani: ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੋ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: agam agochar dekh dikhaae naanak taa kaa daaso |5|
English: sees and inspires others to see the inaccessible, unfathomable Lord. Nanak is his slave. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਪੂਛਉ ਸਾਚੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: sun suaamee aradaas hamaaree poochhau saach beechaaro |
English: "Listen, Lord, to our prayer. We seek your true opinion.

Gurbani: ਰੋਸੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਉਤਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਦੁਆਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: ros na keejai utar deejai kiau paaeeai gur duaaro |
English: Don't be angry with us - please tell us: How can we find the Guru's Door?"

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਚਲਤਉ ਸਚ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਸੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: eihu man chaltau sach ghar baisai naanak naam adhaaro |
English: This fickle mind sits in its true home, O Nanak, through the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: aape mel milaae karataa laagai saach piaaro |6|
English: The Creator Himself unites us in Union, and inspires us to love the Truth. ||6||

[Ang 938 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਹਾਟੀ ਬਾਟੀ ਰਹਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਲੇ ਰੂਖਿ ਬਿਰਖਿ ਉਦਿਆਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: haattee baattee raheh niraale rookh birakh udiaane |
English: "Away from stores and highways, we live in the woods, among plants and trees.

Gurbani: ਕੰਦ ਮੂਲੁ ਅਹਾਰੋ ਖਾਈਐ ਅਉਧੂ ਬੋਲੈ ਗਿਆਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: kand mool ahaaro khaaeeai aaudhoo bolai giaane |
English: For food, we take fruits and roots. This is the spiritual wisdom spoken by the renunciates.

Gurbani: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਈਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: teerath naaeeai sukh fal paaeeai mail na laagai kaaee |
English: We bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, and obtain the fruits of peace; not even an iota of filth sticks to us.

Gurbani: ਗੋਰਖ ਪੂਤੁ ਲੋਹਾਰੀਪਾ ਬੋਲੈ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਸਾਈ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: gorakh poot lohaareepaa bolai jog jugat bidh saaee |7|
English: Luhaareepaa, the disciple of Gorakh says, this is the Way of Yoga." ||7||

Gurbani: ਹਾਟੀ ਬਾਟੀ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਪਰ ਘਰਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਡੋੁਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: haattee baattee need na aavai par ghar chit na dduolaaee |
English: In the stores and on the road, do not sleep; do not let your consciousness covet anyone else's home.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮਨੁ ਟੇਕ ਨ ਟਿਕਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: bin naavai man ttek na ttikee naanak bhookh na jaaee |
English: Without the Name, the mind has no firm support; O Nanak, this hunger never departs.

Gurbani: ਹਾਟੁ ਪਟਣੁ ਘਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: haatt pattan ghar guroo dikhaaeaa sahaje sach vaapaaro |
English: The Guru has revealed the stores and the city within the home of my own heart, where I intuitively carry on the true trade.

Gurbani: ਖੰਡਿਤ ਨਿਦ੍ਰਾ ਅਲਪ ਅਹਾਰੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: khanddit nidraa alap ahaaran naanak tat beechaaro |8|
English: Sleep little, and eat little; O Nanak, this is the essence of wisdom. ||8||

[Ang 939 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਹੁ ਜੋਗਿੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਝੋਲੀ ਖਿੰਥਾ ॥
Transliteration: darasan bhekh karahu jogindraa mundraa jholee khinthaa |
English: "Wear the robes of the sect of Yogis who follow Gorakh; put on the ear-rings, begging wallet and patched coat.

Gurbani: ਬਾਰਹ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਸਰੇਵਹੁ ਖਟੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਇਕ ਪੰਥਾ ॥
Transliteration: baarah antar ek sarevahu khatt darasan ik panthaa |
English: Among the twelve schools of Yoga, ours is the highest; among the six schools of philosophy, ours is the best path.

Gurbani: ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਪੁਰਖਾ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਚੋਟ ਨ ਖਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: ein bidh man samajhaaeeai purakhaa baahurr chott na khaaeeai |
English: This is the way to instruct the mind, so you will never suffer beatings again."

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਇਵ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: naanak bolai guramukh boojhai jog jugat iv paaeeai |9|
English: Nanak speaks: the Gurmukh understands; this is the way that Yoga is attained. ||9||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਮੁਦ੍ਰਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: antar sabad nirantar mudraa haumai mamataa door karee |
English: Let constant absorption in the Word of the Shabad deep within be your ear-rings; eradicate egotism and attachment.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁ ਸਮਝ ਪਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh ahankaar nivaarai gur kai sabad su samajh paree |
English: Discard sexual desire, anger and egotism, and through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, attain true understanding.

Gurbani: ਖਿੰਥਾ ਝੋਲੀ ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾਰੈ ਏਕੁ ਹਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: khinthaa jholee bharipur rahiaa naanak taarai ek haree |
English: For your patched coat and begging bowl, see the Lord God pervading and permeating everywhere; O Nanak, the One Lord will carry you across.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਾਚੀ ਨਾਈ ਪਰਖੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ਖਰੀ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: saachaa saahib saachee naaee parakhai gur kee baat kharee |10|
English: True is our Lord and Master, and True is His Name. Analyze it, and you shall find the Word of the Guru to be True. ||10||

[Ang 939 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਊਂਧਉ ਖਪਰੁ ਪੰਚ ਭੂ ਟੋਪੀ ॥
Transliteration: aoondhau khapar panch bhoo ttopee |
English: Let your mind turn away in detachment from the world, and let this be your begging bowl. Let the lessons of the five elements be your cap.

Gurbani: ਕਾਂਇਆ ਕੜਾਸਣੁ ਮਨੁ ਜਾਗੋਟੀ ॥
Transliteration: kaaneaa karraasan man jaagottee |
English: Let the body be your meditation mat, and the mind your loin cloth.

Gurbani: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: sat santokh sanjam hai naal |
English: Let truth, contentment and self-discipline be your companions.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh naam samaal |11|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh dwells on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||11||

Gurbani: ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਗੁਪਤਾ ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: kavan su gupataa kavan su mukataa |
English: "Who is hidden? Who is liberated?

Gurbani: ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: kavan su antar baahar jugataa |
English: Who is united, inwardly and outwardly?

Gurbani: ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਆਵੈ ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kavan su aavai kavan su jaae |
English: Who comes, and who goes?

Gurbani: ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: kavan su tribhavan rahiaa samaae |12|
English: Who is permeating and pervading the three worlds?" ||12||

[Ang 939 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਗੁਪਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt gupataa guramukh mukataa |
English: He is hidden within each and every heart. The Gurmukh is liberated.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: antar baahar sabad su jugataa |
English: Through the Word of the Shabad, one is united, inwardly and outwardly.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh binasai aavai jaae |
English: The self-willed manmukh perishes, and comes and goes.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh saach samaae |13|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh merges in Truth. ||13||

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਬਾਧਾ ਸਰਪਨਿ ਖਾਧਾ ॥
Transliteration: kiau kar baadhaa sarapan khaadhaa |
English: "How is one placed in bondage, and consumed by the serpent of Maya?

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਖੋਇਆ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਲਾਧਾ ॥
Transliteration: kiau kar khoeaa kiau kar laadhaa |
English: How does one lose, and how does one gain?

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kiau kar niramal kiau kar andhiaaraa |
English: How does one become immaculate and pure? How is the darkness of ignorance removed?

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ਸੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: eihu tat beechaarai su guroo hamaaraa |14|
English: One who understands this essence of reality is our Guru." ||14||

[Ang 939 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਬਾਧਾ ਸਰਪਨਿ ਖਾਧਾ ॥
Transliteration: duramat baadhaa sarapan khaadhaa |
English: Man is bound by evil-mindedness, and consumed by Maya, the serpent.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਧਾ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh khoeaa guramukh laadhaa |
English: The self-willed manmukh loses, and the Gurmukh gains.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur milai andheraa jaae |
English: Meeting the True Guru, darkness is dispelled.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਟਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: naanak haumai mett samaae |15|
English: O Nanak, eradicating egotism, one merges in the Lord. ||15||

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਨ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਬੰਧੁ ॥
Transliteration: sun nirantar deejai bandh |
English: Focused deep within, in perfect absorption,

Gurbani: ਉਡੈ ਨ ਹੰਸਾ ਪੜੈ ਨ ਕੰਧੁ ॥
Transliteration: auddai na hansaa parrai na kandh |
English: the soul-swan does not fly away, and the body-wall does not collapse.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜ ਗੁਫਾ ਘਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਾਚਾ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj gufaa ghar jaanai saachaa |
English: Then, one knows that his true home is in the cave of intuitive poise.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਚਾ ॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: naanak saache bhaavai saachaa |16|
English: O Nanak, the True Lord loves those who are truthful. ||16||

[Ang 939 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਕਿਸੁ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਤਜਿਓ ਉਦਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: kis kaaran grihu tajio udaasee |
English: "Why have you left your house and become a wandering Udaasee?

Gurbani: ਕਿਸੁ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਇਹੁ ਭੇਖੁ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: kis kaaran ihu bhekh nivaasee |
English: Why have you adopted these religious robes?

Gurbani: ਕਿਸੁ ਵਖਰ ਕੇ ਤੁਮ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kis vakhar ke tum vanajaare |
English: What merchandise do you trade?

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਥੁ ਲੰਘਾਵਹੁ ਪਾਰੇ ॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: kiau kar saath langhaavahu paare |17|
English: How will you carry others across with you?" ||17||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਜਤ ਭਏ ਉਦਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh khojat bhe udaasee |
English: I became a wandering Udaasee, searching for the Gurmukhs.

Gurbani: ਦਰਸਨ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ਭੇਖ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: darasan kai taaee bhekh nivaasee |
English: I have adopted these robes seeking the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚ ਵਖਰ ਕੇ ਹਮ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: saach vakhar ke ham vanajaare |
English: I trade in the merchandise of Truth.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਪਾਰੇ ॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh utaras paare |18|
English: O Nanak, as Gurmukh, I carry others across. ||18||

[Ang 939 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਪੁਰਖਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਵਟਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kit bidh purakhaa janam vattaaeaa |
English: "How have you changed the course of your life?

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਤੁਝੁ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kaahe kau tujh ihu man laaeaa |
English: With what have you linked your mind?

Gurbani: ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਖਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kit bidh aasaa manasaa khaaee |
English: How have you subdued your hopes and desires?

Gurbani: ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kit bidh jot nirantar paaee |
English: How have you found the Light deep within your nucleus?

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਦੰਤਾ ਕਿਉ ਖਾਈਐ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: bin dantaa kiau khaaeeai saar |
English: Without teeth, how can you eat iron?

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: naanak saachaa karahu beechaar |19|
English: Give us your true opinion, Nanak." ||19||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਜਨਮੇ ਗਵਨੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: satigur kai janame gavan mittaaeaa |
English: Born into the House of the True Guru, my wandering in reincarnation ended.

Gurbani: ਅਨਹਤਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: anahat raate ihu man laaeaa |
English: My mind is attached and attuned to the unstruck sound current.

Gurbani: ਮਨਸਾ ਆਸਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: manasaa aasaa sabad jalaaee |
English: Through the Word of the Shabad, my hopes and desires have been burnt away.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh jot nirantar paaee |
English: As Gurmukh, I found the Light deep within the nucleus of my self.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮੇਟੇ ਖਾਈਐ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: trai gun mette khaaeeai saar |
English: Eradicating the three qualities, one eats iron.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾਰੇ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: naanak taare taaranahaar |20|
English: O Nanak, the Emancipator emancipates. ||20||

[Ang 940 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਕਉ ਕਵਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਕਥੀਅਲੇ ਸੁੰਨ ਕਹਾ ਘਰ ਵਾਸੋ ॥
Transliteration: aad kau kavan beechaar katheeale sun kahaa ghar vaaso |
English: "What can you tell us about the beginning? In what home did the absolute dwell then?

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨ ਕੀ ਮੁਦ੍ਰਾ ਕਵਨ ਕਥੀਅਲੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਕਵਨ ਨਿਵਾਸੋ ॥
Transliteration: giaan kee mudraa kavan katheeale ghatt ghatt kavan nivaaso |
English: What are the ear-rings of spiritual wisdom? Who dwells in each and every heart?

Gurbani: ਕਾਲ ਕਾ ਠੀਗਾ ਕਿਉ ਜਲਾਈਅਲੇ ਕਿਉ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: kaal kaa ttheegaa kiau jalaaeeale kiau nirbhau ghar jaaeeai |
English: How can one avoid the attack of death? How can one enter the home of fearlessness?

Gurbani: ਸਹਜ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਕਾ ਆਸਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਿਉ ਛੇਦੇ ਬੈਰਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj santokh kaa aasan jaanai kiau chhede bairaaeeai |
English: How can one know the posture of intuition and contentment, and overcome one's adversaries?"

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਰੈ ਤਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਵਾਸੋ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad haumai bikh maarai taa nij ghar hovai vaaso |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, egotism and corruption are conquered, and then one comes to dwell in the home of the self within.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਿ ਰਚਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੋ ॥੨੧॥
Transliteration: jin rach rachiaa tis sabad pachhaanai naanak taa kaa daaso |21|
English: One who realizes the Shabad of the One who created the creation - Nanak is his slave. ||21||

Gurbani: ਕਹਾ ਤੇ ਆਵੈ ਕਹਾ ਇਹੁ ਜਾਵੈ ਕਹਾ ਇਹੁ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kahaa te aavai kahaa ihu jaavai kahaa ihu rahai samaaee |
English: "Where did we come from? Where are we going? Where will we be absorbed?

Gurbani: ਏਸੁ ਸਬਦ ਕਉ ਜੋ ਅਰਥਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: es sabad kau jo arathaavai tis gur til na tamaaee |
English: One who reveals the meaning of this Shabad is the Guru, who has no greed at all.

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਤਤੈ ਅਵਿਗਤੈ ਪਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: kiau tatai avigatai paavai guramukh lagai piaaro |
English: How can one find the essence of the unmanifest reality? How does one become Gurmukh, and enshrine love for the Lord?

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸੁਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: aape surataa aape karataa kahu naanak beechaaro |
English: He Himself is consciousness, He Himself is the Creator; share with us, Nanak, your wisdom."

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਆਵੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਜਾਵੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: hukame aavai hukame jaavai hukame rahai samaaee |
English: By His Command we come, and by His Command we go; by His Command, we merge in absorption.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਸਬਦੇ ਪਾਈ ॥੨੨॥
Transliteration: poore gur te saach kamaavai gat mit sabade paaee |22|
English: Through the Perfect Guru, live the Truth; through the Word of the Shabad, the state of dignity is attained. ||22||

[Ang 940 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਕਉ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਕਥੀਅਲੇ ਸੁੰਨ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਲੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: aad kau bisamaad beechaar katheeale sun nirantar vaas leea |
English: We can only express a sense of wonder about the beginning. The absolute abided endlessly deep within Himself then.

Gurbani: ਅਕਲਪਤ ਮੁਦ੍ਰਾ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਅਲੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: akalapat mudraa gur giaan beechaareeale ghatt ghatt saachaa sarab jeea |
English: Consider freedom from desire to be the ear-rings of the Guru's spiritual wisdom. The True Lord, the Soul of all, dwells within each and every heart.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਅਵਿਗਤਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ਤਤੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਲਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur bachanee avigat samaaeeai tat niranjan sehaj lahai |
English: Through the Guru's Word, one merges in the absolute, and intuitively receives the immaculate essence.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੂਜੀ ਕਾਰ ਨ ਕਰਣੀ ਸੇਵੈ ਸਿਖੁ ਸੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: naanak doojee kaar na karanee sevai sikh su khoj lahai |
English: O Nanak, that Sikh who seeks and finds the Way does not serve any other.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਜੀਅ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: hukam bisamaad hukam pachhaanai jeea jugat sach jaanai soee |
English: Wonderful and amazing is His Command; He alone realizes His Command and knows the true way of life of His creatures.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਮੇਟਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਕਹੀਐ ਸੋਈ ॥੨੩॥
Transliteration: aap mett niraalam hovai antar saach jogee kaheeai soee |23|
English: One who eradicates his self-conceit becomes free of desire; he alone is a Yogi, who enshrines the True Lord deep within. ||23||

Gurbani: ਅਵਿਗਤੋ ਨਿਰਮਾਇਲੁ ਉਪਜੇ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਤੇ ਸਰਗੁਣੁ ਥੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: avigato niramaaeil upaje niragun te saragun theea |
English: From His state of absolute existence, He assumed the immaculate form; from formless, He assumed the supreme form.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਰਚੈ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਲੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: satigur parachai param pad paaeeai saachai sabad samaae leea |
English: By pleasing the True Guru, the supreme status is obtained, and one is absorbed in the True Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਏਕੇ ਕਉ ਸਚੁ ਏਕਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਕੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: eke kau sach ekaa jaanai haumai doojaa door keea |
English: He knows the True Lord as the One and only; he sends his egotism and duality far away.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਜੋਗੀ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਥੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: so jogee gurasabad pachhaanai antar kamal pragaas theea |
English: He alone is a Yogi, who realizes the Word of the Guru's Shabad; the lotus of the heart blossoms forth within.

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਰਬ ਦਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jeevat marai taa sabh kichh soojhai antar jaanai sarab deaa |
English: If one remains dead while yet alive, then he understands everything; he knows the Lord deep within himself, who is kind and compassionate to all.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ॥੨੪॥
Transliteration: naanak taa kau milai vaddaaee aap pachhaanai sarab jeea |24|
English: O Nanak, he is blessed with glorious greatness; he realizes himself in all beings. ||24||

[Ang 940 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਚੌ ਉਪਜੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਸੂਚੇ ਏਕ ਮਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: saachau upajai saach samaavai saache sooche ek meaa |
English: We emerge from Truth, and merge into Truth again. The pure being merges into the One True Lord.

Gurbani: ਝੂਠੇ ਆਵਹਿ ਠਵਰ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jhootthe aaveh tthavar na paaveh doojai aavaa gaun bheaa |
English: The false come, and find no place of rest; in duality, they come and go.

Gurbani: ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਆਪੇ ਪਰਖੈ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aavaa gaun mittai gurasabadee aape parakhai bakhas leaa |
English: This coming and going in reincarnation is ended through the Word of the Guru's Shabad; the Lord Himself analyzes and grants His forgiveness.

Gurbani: ਏਕਾ ਬੇਦਨ ਦੂਜੈ ਬਿਆਪੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਵੀਸਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: ekaa bedan doojai biaapee naam rasaaein veesariaa |
English: One who suffers from the disease of duality, forgets the Naam, the source of nectar.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: so boojhai jis aap bujhaae gur kai sabad su mukat bheaa |
English: He alone understands, whom the Lord inspires to understand. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one is liberated.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾਰੇ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਪਰਹਰਿਆ ॥੨੫॥
Transliteration: naanak taare taaranahaaraa haumai doojaa parahariaa |25|
English: O Nanak, the Emancipator emancipates one who drives out egotism and duality. ||25||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਭੂਲੈ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh bhoolai jam kee kaan |
English: The self-willed manmukhs are deluded, under the shadow of death.

Gurbani: ਪਰ ਘਰੁ ਜੋਹੈ ਹਾਣੇ ਹਾਣਿ ॥
Transliteration: par ghar johai haane haan |
English: They look into the homes of others, and lose.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭਵੈ ਬੇਬਾਣਿ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh bharam bhavai bebaan |
English: The manmukhs are confused by doubt, wandering in the wilderness.

Gurbani: ਵੇਮਾਰਗਿ ਮੂਸੈ ਮੰਤ੍ਰਿ ਮਸਾਣਿ ॥
Transliteration: vemaarag moosai mantr masaan |
English: Having lost their way, they are plundered; they chant their mantras at cremation grounds.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੈ ਲਵੈ ਕੁਬਾਣਿ ॥
Transliteration: sabad na cheenai lavai kubaan |
English: They do not think of the Shabad; instead, they utter obscenities.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾਣਿ ॥੨੬॥
Transliteration: naanak saach rate sukh jaan |26|
English: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Truth know peace. ||26||

[Ang 941 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh saache kaa bhau paavai |
English: The Gurmukh lives in the Fear of God, the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਅਘੜੁ ਘੜਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh baanee agharr gharraavai |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Bani, the Gurmukh refines the unrefined.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh niramal har gun gaavai |
English: The Gurmukh sings the immaculate, Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh pavitru param pad paavai |
English: The Gurmukh attains the supreme, sanctified status.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰੋਮਿ ਰੋਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh rom rom har dhiaavai |
English: The Gurmukh meditates on the Lord with every hair of his body.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੨੭॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh saach samaavai |27|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh merges in Truth. ||27||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਚੈ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh parachai bed beechaaree |
English: The Gurmukh is pleasing to the True Guru; this is contemplation on the Vedas.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਚੈ ਤਰੀਐ ਤਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh parachai tareeai taaree |
English: Pleasing the True Guru, the Gurmukh is carried across.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਚੈ ਸੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh parachai su sabad giaanee |
English: Pleasing the True Guru, the Gurmukh receives the spiritual wisdom of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਚੈ ਅੰਤਰ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh parachai antar bidh jaanee |
English: Pleasing the True Guru, the Gurmukh comes to know the path within.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh paaeeai alakh apaar |
English: The Gurmukh attains the unseen and infinite Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੨੮॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh mukat duaar |28|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh finds the door of liberation. ||28||

[Ang 941 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥੈ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh akath kathai beechaar |
English: The Gurmukh speaks the unspoken wisdom.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਸਪਰਵਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh nibahai saparavaar |
English: In the midst of his family, the Gurmukh lives a spiritual life.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh japeeai antar piaar |
English: The Gurmukh lovingly meditates deep within.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh paaeeai sabad achaar |
English: The Gurmukh obtains the Shabad, and righteous conduct.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਭੇਦਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਾਣਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sabad bhed jaanai jaanaaee |
English: He knows the mystery of the Shabad, and inspires others to know it.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਲਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੨੯॥
Transliteration: naanak haumai jaal samaaee |29|
English: O Nanak, burning away his ego, he merges in the Lord. ||29||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh dharatee saachai saajee |
English: The True Lord fashioned the earth for the sake of the Gurmukhs.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਮਹਿ ਓਪਤਿ ਖਪਤਿ ਸੁ ਬਾਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: tis meh opat khapat su baajee |
English: There, he set in motion the play of creation and destruction.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਪੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad rapai rang laae |
English: One who is filled with the Word of the Guru's Shabad enshrines love for the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤਉ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: saach rtau pat siau ghar jaae |
English: Attuned to the Truth, he goes to his home with honor.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: saach sabad bin pat nahee paavai |
English: Without the True Word of the Shabad, no one receives honor.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਉ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੩੦॥
Transliteration: naanak bin naavai kiau saach samaavai |30|
English: O Nanak, without the Name, how can one be absorbed in Truth? ||30||

[Ang 941 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਸਟ ਸਿਧੀ ਸਭਿ ਬੁਧੀ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh asatt sidhee sabh budhee |
English: The Gurmukh obtains the eight miraculous spiritual powers, and all wisdom.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰੀਐ ਸਚ ਸੁਧੀ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh bhavajal tareeai sach sudhee |
English: The Gurmukh crosses over the terrifying world-ocean, and obtains true understanding.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਰ ਅਪਸਰ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh sar apasar bidh jaanai |
English: The Gurmukh knows the ways of truth and untruth.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਵਿਰਤਿ ਨਰਵਿਰਤਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh paravirat naravirat pachhaanai |
English: The Gurmukh knows worldliness and renunciation.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਾਰੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh taare paar utaare |
English: The Gurmukh crosses over, and carries others across as well.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੩੧॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh sabad nisataare |31|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is emancipated through the Shabad. ||31||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੇ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: naame raate haumai jaae |
English: Attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, egotism is dispelled.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: naam rate sach rahe samaae |
English: Attuned to the Naam, they remain absorbed in the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: naam rate jog jugat beechaar |
English: Attuned to the Naam, they contemplate the Way of Yoga.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: naam rate paaveh mokh duaar |
English: Attuned to the Naam, they find the door of liberation.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: naam rate tribhavan sojhee hoe |
English: Attuned to the Naam, they understand the three worlds.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੩੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naam rate sadaa sukh hoe |32|
English: O Nanak, attuned to the Naam, eternal peace is found. ||32||

[Ang 941 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਿਧ ਗੋਸਟਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: naam rate sidh gosatt hoe |
English: Attuned to the Naam, they attain Sidh Gosht - conversation with the Siddhas.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਤਪੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: naam rate sadaa tap hoe |
English: Attuned to the Naam, they practice intense meditation forever.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: naam rate sach karanee saar |
English: Attuned to the Naam, they live the true and excellent lifestyle.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਿਆਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: naam rate gun giaan beechaar |
English: Attuned to the Naam, they contemplate the Lord's virtues and spiritual wisdom.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਬੋਲੈ ਸਭੁ ਵੇਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: bin naavai bolai sabh vekaar |
English: Without the Name, all that is spoken is useless.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ॥੩੩॥
Transliteration: naanak naam rate tin kau jaikaar |33|
English: O Nanak, attuned to the Naam, their victory is celebrated. ||33||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: poore gur te naam paaeaa jaae |
English: Through the Perfect Guru, one obtains the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jog jugat sach rahai samaae |
English: The Way of Yoga is to remain absorbed in Truth.

Gurbani: ਬਾਰਹ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਭਰਮਾਏ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਛਿਅ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: baarah meh jogee bharamaae saniaasee chhia chaar |
English: The Yogis wander in the twelve schools of Yoga; the Sannyaasis in six and four.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜੋ ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad jo mar jeevai so paae mokh duaar |
English: One who remains dead while yet alive, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, finds the door of liberation.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਸਭਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਗੇ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: bin sabadai sabh doojai laage dekhahu ridai beechaar |
English: Without the Shabad, all are attached to duality. Contemplate this in your heart, and see.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਡੇ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੩੪॥
Transliteration: naanak vadde se vaddabhaagee jinee sach rakhiaa ur dhaar |34|
English: O Nanak, blessed and very fortunate are those who keep the True Lord enshrined in their hearts. ||34||

[Ang 942 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਲਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh ratan lahai liv laae |
English: The Gurmukh obtains the jewel, lovingly focused on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਖੈ ਰਤਨੁ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh parakhai ratan subhaae |
English: The Gurmukh intuitively recognizes the value of this jewel.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh saachee kaar kamaae |
English: The Gurmukh practices Truth in action.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਮਨੁ ਪਤੀਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh saache man pateeae |
English: The mind of the Gurmukh is pleased with the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh alakh lakhaae tis bhaavai |
English: The Gurmukh sees the unseen, when it pleases the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚੋਟ ਨ ਖਾਵੈ ॥੩੫॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh chott na khaavai |35|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh does not have to endure punishment. ||35||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh naam daan isanaan |
English: The Gurmukh is blessed with the Name, charity and purification.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh laagai sehaj dhiaan |
English: The Gurmukh centers his meditation on the celestial Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh paavai daragah maan |
English: The Gurmukh obtains honor in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh bhau bhanjan paradhaan |
English: The Gurmukh obtains the Supreme Lord, the Destroyer of fear.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh karanee kaar karaae |
English: The Gurmukh does good deeds, an inspires others to do so.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੩੬॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh mel milaae |36|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh unites in the Lord's Union. ||36||

[Ang 942 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਬੇਦ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh saasatr simrit bed |
English: The Gurmukh understands the Simritees, the Shaastras and the Vedas.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਭੇਦ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh paavai ghatt ghatt bhed |
English: The Gurmukh knows the secrets of each and every heart.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੈਰ ਵਿਰੋਧ ਗਵਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh vair virodh gavaavai |
English: The Gurmukh eliminates hate and envy.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਗਲੀ ਗਣਤ ਮਿਟਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh sagalee ganat mittaavai |
English: The Gurmukh erases all accounting.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh raam naam rang raataa |
English: The Gurmukh is imbued with love for the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥੩੭॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh khasam pachhaataa |37|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh realizes his Lord and Master. ||37||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਰਮੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin gur bharamai aavai jaae |
English: Without the Guru, one wanders, coming and going in reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਘਾਲ ਨ ਪਵਈ ਥਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin gur ghaal na pavee thaae |
English: Without the Guru, one's work is useless.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਨੂਆ ਅਤਿ ਡੋਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin gur manooaa at ddolaae |
English: Without the Guru, the mind is totally unsteady.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin gur tripat nahee bikh khaae |
English: Without the Guru, one is unsatisfied, and eats poison.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਸੀਅਰੁ ਡਸੈ ਮਰਿ ਵਾਟ ॥
Transliteration: bin gur biseear ddasai mar vaatt |
English: Without the Guru, one is stung by the poisonous snake of Maya, and dies.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਘਾਟੇ ਘਾਟ ॥੩੮॥
Transliteration: naanak gur bin ghaatte ghaatt |38|
English: O Nanak without the Guru, all is lost. ||38||

[Ang 942 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: jis gur milai tis paar utaarai |
English: One who meets the Guru is carried across.

Gurbani: ਅਵਗਣ ਮੇਟੈ ਗੁਣਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: avagan mettai gun nisataarai |
English: His sins are erased, and he is emancipated through virtue.

Gurbani: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: mukat mahaa sukh gurasabad beechaar |
English: The supreme peace of liberation is attained, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh kade na aavai haar |
English: The Gurmukh is never defeated.

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਹਟੜੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: tan hattarree ihu man vanajaaraa |
English: In the store of the body, this mind is the merchant;

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚੁ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥੩੯॥
Transliteration: naanak sahaje sach vaapaaraa |39|
English: O Nanak, it deals intuitively in Truth. ||39||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਾਂਧਿਓ ਸੇਤੁ ਬਿਧਾਤੈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh baandhio set bidhaatai |
English: The Gurmukh is the bridge, built by the Architect of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਲੰਕਾ ਲੂਟੀ ਦੈਤ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: lankaa loottee dait santaapai |
English: The demons of passion which plundered Sri Lanka - the body - have been conquered.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮਚੰਦਿ ਮਾਰਿਓ ਅਹਿ ਰਾਵਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: raamachand maario eh raavan |
English: Ram Chand - the mind - has slaughtered Raawan - pride;

Gurbani: ਭੇਦੁ ਬਭੀਖਣ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਚਾਇਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: bhed babheekhan guramukh parachaaein |
English: the Gurmukh understands the secret revealed by Babheekhan.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਇਰਿ ਪਾਹਣ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh saaeir paahan taare |
English: The Gurmukh carries even stones across the ocean.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥੪੦॥
Transliteration: guramukh kott tetees udhaare |40|
English: The Gurmukh saves millions of people. ||40||

[Ang 942 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚੂਕੈ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh chookai aavan jaan |
English: The comings and goings in reincarnation are ended for the Gurmukh.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh daragah paavai maan |
English: The Gurmukh is honored in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਟੇ ਖਰੇ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh khotte khare pachhaan |
English: The Gurmukh distinguishes the true from the false.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh laagai sehaj dhiaan |
English: The Gurmukh focuses his meditation on the celestial Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh daragah sifat samaae |
English: In the Court of the Lord, the Gurmukh is absorbed in His Praises.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੰਧੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੪੧॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh bandh na paae |41|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is not bound by bonds. ||41||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh naam niranjan paae |
English: The Gurmukh obtains the Name of the Immaculate Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh haumai sabad jalaae |
English: Through the Shabad, the Gurmukh burns away his ego.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh saache ke gun gaae |
English: The Gurmukh sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh saachai rahai samaae |
English: The Gurmukh remains absorbed in the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh saach naam pat aootam hoe |
English: Through the True Name, the Gurmukh is honored and exalted.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਗਲ ਭਵਣ ਕੀ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਇ ॥੪੨॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh sagal bhavan kee sojhee hoe |42|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh understands all the worlds. ||42||

[Ang 942 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਕਵਣ ਮੂਲੁ ਕਵਣ ਮਤਿ ਵੇਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: kavan mool kavan mat velaa |
English: "What is the root, the source of all? What teachings hold for these times?

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਕਵਣੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਤੂ ਚੇਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: teraa kavan guroo jis kaa too chelaa |
English: Who is your guru? Whose disciple are you?

Gurbani: ਕਵਣ ਕਥਾ ਲੇ ਰਹਹੁ ਨਿਰਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: kavan kathaa le rahahu niraale |
English: What is that speech, by which you remain unattached?

Gurbani: ਬੋਲੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਬਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: bolai naanak sunahu tum baale |
English: Listen to what we say, O Nanak, you little boy.

Gurbani: ਏਸੁ ਕਥਾ ਕਾ ਦੇਇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: es kathaa kaa dee beechaar |
English: Give us your opinion on what we have said.

Gurbani: ਭਵਜਲੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਲੰਘਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੪੩॥
Transliteration: bhavajal sabad langhaavanahaar |43|
English: How can the Shabad carry us across the terrifying world-ocean?" ||43||

Gurbani: ਪਵਨ ਅਰੰਭੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਤਿ ਵੇਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: pavan aranbh satigur mat velaa |
English: From the air came the beginning. This is the age of the True Guru's Teachings.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਧੁਨਿ ਚੇਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabad guroo surat dhun chelaa |
English: The Shabad is the Guru, upon whom I lovingly focus my consciousness; I am the chaylaa, the disciple.

Gurbani: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਲੇ ਰਹਉ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: akath kathaa le rhau niraalaa |
English: Speaking the Unspoken Speech, I remain unattached.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: naanak jug jug gur gopaalaa |
English: O Nanak, throughout the ages, the Lord of the World is my Guru.

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਕਥਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: ek sabad jit kathaa veechaaree |
English: I contemplate the sermon of the Shabad, the Word of the One God.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥੪੪॥
Transliteration: guramukh haumai agan nivaaree |44|
English: The Gurmukh puts out the fire of egotism. ||44||

[Ang 943 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮੈਣ ਕੇ ਦੰਤ ਕਿਉ ਖਾਈਐ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: main ke dant kiau khaaeeai saar |
English: "With teeth of wax, how can one chew iron?

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਗਰਬੁ ਜਾਇ ਸੁ ਕਵਣੁ ਆਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jit garab jaae su kavan aahaar |
English: What is that food, which takes away pride?

Gurbani: ਹਿਵੈ ਕਾ ਘਰੁ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਪਿਰਾਹਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: hivai kaa ghar mandar agan piraahan |
English: How can one live in the palace, the home of snow, wearing robes of fire?

Gurbani: ਕਵਨ ਗੁਫਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਅਵਾਹਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: kavan gufaa jit rahai avaahan |
English: Where is that cave, within which one may remain unshaken?

Gurbani: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਜਾਣਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: eit ut kis kau jaan samaavai |
English: Who should we know to be pervading here and there?

Gurbani: ਕਵਨ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੪੫॥
Transliteration: kavan dhiaan man maneh samaavai |45|
English: What is that meditation, which leads the mind to be absorbed in itself?" ||45||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਮੈ ਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: hau hau mai mai vichahu khovai |
English: Eradicating egotism and individualism from within,

Gurbani: ਦੂਜਾ ਮੇਟੈ ਏਕੋ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: doojaa mettai eko hovai |
English: and erasing duality, the mortal becomes one with God.

Gurbani: ਜਗੁ ਕਰੜਾ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਗਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jag kararraa manamukh gaavaar |
English: The world is difficult for the foolish, self-willed manmukh;

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ਖਾਈਐ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sabad kamaaeeai khaaeeai saar |
English: practicing the Shabad, one chews iron.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: antar baahar eko jaanai |
English: Know the One Lord, inside and out.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ॥੪੬॥
Transliteration: naanak agan marai satigur kai bhaanai |46|
English: O Nanak, the fire is quenched, through the Pleasure of the True Guru's Will. ||46||

[Ang 943 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਚ ਭੈ ਰਾਤਾ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: sach bhai raataa garab nivaarai |
English: Imbued with the True Fear of God, pride is taken away;

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: eko jaataa sabad veechaarai |
English: realize that He is One, and contemplate the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸੈ ਸਚੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabad vasai sach antar heea |
English: With the True Shabad abiding deep within the heart,

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: tan man seetal rang rangeea |
English: the body and mind are cooled and soothed, and colored with the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh bikh agan nivaare |
English: The fire of sexual desire, anger and corruption is quenched.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੪੭॥
Transliteration: naanak nadaree nadar piaare |47|
English: O Nanak, the Beloved bestows His Glance of Grace. ||47||

Gurbani: ਕਵਨ ਮੁਖਿ ਚੰਦੁ ਹਿਵੈ ਘਰੁ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kavan mukh chand hivai ghar chhaaeaa |
English: "The moon of the mind is cool and dark; how is it enlightened?

Gurbani: ਕਵਨ ਮੁਖਿ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਤਪੈ ਤਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kavan mukh sooraj tapai tapaaeaa |
English: How does the sun blaze so brilliantly?

Gurbani: ਕਵਨ ਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਜੋਹਤ ਨਿਤ ਰਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: kavan mukh kaal johat nit rahai |
English: How can the constant watchful gaze of Death be turned away?

Gurbani: ਕਵਨ ਬੁਧਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਤਿ ਰਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: kavan budh guramukh pat rahai |
English: By what understanding is the honor of the Gurmukh preserved?

Gurbani: ਕਵਨੁ ਜੋਧੁ ਜੋ ਕਾਲੁ ਸੰਘਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: kavan jodh jo kaal sanghaarai |
English: Who is the warrior, who conquers Death?

Gurbani: ਬੋਲੈ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ॥੪੮॥
Transliteration: bolai baanee naanak beechaarai |48|
English: Give us your thoughtful reply, O Nanak." ||48||

[Ang 943 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਬਦੁ ਭਾਖਤ ਸਸਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabad bhaakhat sas jot apaaraa |
English: Giving voice to the Shabad, the moon of the mind is illuminated with infinity.

Gurbani: ਸਸਿ ਘਰਿ ਸੂਰੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਿਟੈ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sas ghar soor vasai mittai andhiaaraa |
English: When the sun dwells in the house of the moon, the darkness is dispelled.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sukh dukh sam kar naam adhaaraa |
English: Pleasure and pain are just the same, when one takes the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape paar utaaranahaaraa |
English: He Himself saves, and carries us across.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਚੈ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur parachai man saach samaae |
English: With faith in the Guru, the mind merges in Truth,

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥੪੯॥
Transliteration: pranavat naanak kaal na khaae |49|
English: and then, prays Nanak, one is not consumed by Death. ||49||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਤਤੁ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: naam tat sabh hee sir jaapai |
English: The essence of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is known to be the most exalted and excellent of all.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: bin naavai dukh kaal santaapai |
English: Without the Name, one is afflicted by pain and death.

Gurbani: ਤਤੋ ਤਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: tato tat milai man maanai |
English: When one's essence merges into the essence, the mind is satisfied and fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜਾ ਜਾਇ ਇਕਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: doojaa jaae ikat ghar aanai |
English: Duality is gone, and one enters into the home of the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਬੋਲੈ ਪਵਨਾ ਗਗਨੁ ਗਰਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: bolai pavanaa gagan garajai |
English: The breath blows across the sky of the Tenth Gate and vibrates.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਮਿਲਣੁ ਸਹਜੈ ॥੫੦॥
Transliteration: naanak nihachal milan sahajai |50|
English: O Nanak, the mortal then intuitively meets the eternal, unchanging Lord. ||50||

[Ang 943 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੁੰਨੰ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੁੰਨੰ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੁੰਨ ਮਸੁੰਨੰ ॥
Transliteration: antar sunan baahar sunan tribhavan sun masunan |
English: The absolute Lord is deep within; the absolute Lord is outside us as well. The absolute Lord totally fills the three worlds.

Gurbani: ਚਉਥੇ ਸੁੰਨੈ ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਪਾਪੁ ਨ ਪੁੰਨੰ ॥
Transliteration: chauthe sunai jo nar jaanai taa kau paap na punan |
English: One who knows the Lord in the fourth state, is not subject to virtue or vice.

Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸੁੰਨ ਕਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਭੇਉ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt sun kaa jaanai bheo |
English: One who knows the mystery of God the Absolute, who pervades each and every heart,

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਦੇਉ ॥
Transliteration: aad purakh niranjan deo |
English: Knows the Primal Being, the Immaculate Divine Lord.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo jan naam niranjan raataa |
English: That humble being who is imbued with the Immaculate Naam,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥੫੧॥
Transliteration: naanak soee purakh bidhaataa |51|
English: O Nanak, is himself the Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny. ||51||

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਨੋ ਸੁੰਨੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: suno sun kahai sabh koee |
English: "Everyone speaks of the Absolute Lord, the unmanifest void.

Gurbani: ਅਨਹਤ ਸੁੰਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: anahat sun kahaa te hoee |
English: How can one find this absolute void?

Gurbani: ਅਨਹਤ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਕੈਸੇ ॥
Transliteration: anahat sun rate se kaise |
English: Who are they, who are attuned to this absolute void?"

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੇ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਜੈਸੇ ॥
Transliteration: jis te upaje tis hee jaise |
English: They are like the Lord, from whom they originated.

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਮਰਹਿ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: oe janam na mareh na aaveh jaeh |
English: They are not born, they do not die; they do not come and go.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਹਿ ॥੫੨॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh man samajhaeh |52|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs instruct their minds. ||52||

[Ang 943 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਨਉ ਸਰ ਸੁਭਰ ਦਸਵੈ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: nau sar subhar dasavai poore |
English: By practicing control over the nine gates, one attains perfect control over the Tenth Gate.

Gurbani: ਤਹ ਅਨਹਤ ਸੁੰਨ ਵਜਾਵਹਿ ਤੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: teh anahat sun vajaaveh toore |
English: There, the unstruck sound current of the absolute Lord vibrates and resounds.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੈ ਰਾਚੇ ਦੇਖਿ ਹਜੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: saachai raache dekh hajoore |
English: Behold the True Lord ever-present, and merge with Him.

Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt saach rahiaa bharapoore |
English: The True Lord is pervading and permeating each and every heart.

Gurbani: ਗੁਪਤੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: gupatee baanee paragatt hoe |
English: The hidden Bani of the Word is revealed.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰਖਿ ਲਏ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੫੩॥
Transliteration: naanak parakh le sach soe |53|
English: O Nanak, the True Lord is revealed and known. ||53||

Gurbani: ਸਹਜ ਭਾਇ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj bhaae mileeai sukh hovai |
English: Meeting with the Lord through intuition and love, peace is found.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਗੈ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਸੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh jaagai need na sovai |
English: The Gurmukh remains awake and aware; he does not fall sleep.

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਨ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਿ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: sun sabad aparanpar dhaarai |
English: He enshrines the unlimited, absolute Shabad deep within.

Gurbani: ਕਹਤੇ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: kahate mukat sabad nisataarai |
English: Chanting the Shabad, he is liberated, and saves others as well.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਸੇ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur kee deekhiaa se sach raate |
English: Those who practice the Guru's Teachings are attuned to the Truth.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਮਿਲਣ ਨਹੀ ਭ੍ਰਾਤੇ ॥੫੪॥
Transliteration: naanak aap gavaae milan nahee bhraate |54|
English: O Nanak, those who eradicate their self-conceit meet with the Lord; they do not remain separated by doubt. ||54||

[Ang 944 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਕੁਬੁਧਿ ਚਵਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਿਤੁ ਠਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kubudh chavaavai so kit tthaae |
English: "Where is that place, where evil thoughts are destroyed?

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kiau tat na boojhai chottaa khaae |
English: The mortal does not understand the essence of reality; why must he suffer in pain?"

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਾਧੇ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: jam dar baadhe koe na raakhai |
English: No one can save one who is tied up at Death's door.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਤਿ ਸਾਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: bin sabadai naahee pat saakhai |
English: Without the Shabad, no one has any credit or honor.

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਪਾਵੈ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: kiau kar boojhai paavai paar |
English: "How can one obtain understanding and cross over?"

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਨ ਬੁਝੈ ਗਵਾਰੁ ॥੫੫॥
Transliteration: naanak manamukh na bujhai gavaar |55|
English: O Nanak, the foolish self-willed manmukh does not understand. ||55||

Gurbani: ਕੁਬੁਧਿ ਮਿਟੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: kubudh mittai gurasabad beechaar |
English: Evil thoughts are erased, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
Transliteration: satigur bhettai mokh duaar |
English: Meeting with the True Guru, the door of liberation is found.

Gurbani: ਤਤੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੈ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: tat na cheenai manamukh jal jaae |
English: The self-willed manmukh does not understand the essence of reality, and is burnt to ashes.

Gurbani: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: duramat vichhurr chottaa khaae |
English: His evil-mindedness separates him from the Lord, and he suffers.

Gurbani: ਮਾਨੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਭੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਿਆਨ ॥
Transliteration: maanai hukam sabhe gun giaan |
English: Accepting the Hukam of the Lord's Command, he is blessed with all virtues and spiritual wisdom.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੫੬॥
Transliteration: naanak daragah paavai maan |56|
English: O Nanak, he is honored in the Court of the Lord. ||56||

[Ang 944 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਚੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: saach vakhar dhan palai hoe |
English: One who possesses the merchandise, the wealth of the True Name,

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਤਾਰੇ ਭੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aap tarai taare bhee soe |
English: crosses over, and carries others across with him as well.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜਿ ਰਤਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj rataa boojhai pat hoe |
English: One who intuitively understands, and is attuned to the Lord, is honored.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: taa kee keemat karai na koe |
English: No one can estimate his worth.

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jeh dekhaa teh rahiaa samaae |
English: Wherever I look, I see the Lord permeating and pervading.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰੈ ਸਚ ਭਾਇ ॥੫੭॥
Transliteration: naanak paar parai sach bhaae |57|
English: O Nanak, through the Love of the True Lord, one crosses over. ||57||

Gurbani: ਸੁ ਸਬਦ ਕਾ ਕਹਾ ਵਾਸੁ ਕਥੀਅਲੇ ਜਿਤੁ ਤਰੀਐ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: su sabad kaa kahaa vaas katheeale jit tareeai bhavajal sansaaro |
English: "Where is the Shabad said to dwell? What will carry us across the terrifying world-ocean?

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਸਤ ਅੰਗੁਲ ਵਾਈ ਕਹੀਐ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਹੁ ਕਵਨੁ ਅਧਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: trai sat angul vaaee kaheeai tis kahu kavan adhaaro |
English: The breath, when exhaled, extends out ten finger lengths; what is the support of the breath?

Gurbani: ਬੋਲੈ ਖੇਲੈ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: bolai khelai asathir hovai kiau kar alakh lakhaae |
English: Speaking and playing, how can one be stable and steady? How can the unseen be seen?"

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਅਪਣੇ ਮਨ ਸਮਝਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sun suaamee sach naanak pranavai apane man samajhaae |
English: Listen, O master; Nanak prays truly. Instruct your own mind.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੇ ਸਚਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੈ ਕਰਿ ਨਦਰੀ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh sabade sach liv laagai kar nadaree mel milaae |
English: The Gurmukh is lovingly attuned to the True Shabad. Bestowing His Glance of Grace, He unites us in His Union.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਦਾਨਾ ਆਪੇ ਬੀਨਾ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੫੮॥
Transliteration: aape daanaa aape beenaa poorai bhaag samaae |58|
English: He Himself is all-knowing and all-seeing. By perfect destiny, we merge in Him. ||58||

[Ang 944 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੁ ਸਬਦ ਕਉ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਅਲਖੰ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: su sabad kau nirantar vaas alakhan jeh dekhaa teh soee |
English: That Shabad dwells deep within the nucleus of all beings. God is invisible; wherever I look, there I see Him.

Gurbani: ਪਵਨ ਕਾ ਵਾਸਾ ਸੁੰਨ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ਅਕਲ ਕਲਾ ਧਰ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: pavan kaa vaasaa sun nivaasaa akal kalaa dhar soee |
English: The air is the dwelling place of the absolute Lord. He has no qualities; He has all qualities.

Gurbani: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਘਟ ਮਹਿ ਵਸੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: nadar kare sabad ghatt meh vasai vichahu bharam gavaae |
English: When He bestows His Glance of Grace, the Shabad comes to abide within the heart, and doubt is eradicated from within.

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮੋੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: tan man niramal niramal baanee naamuo man vasaae |
English: The body and mind become immaculate, through the Immaculate Word of His Bani. Let His Name be enshrined in your mind.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਭਵਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰੀਐ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: sabad guroo bhavasaagar tareeai it ut eko jaanai |
English: The Shabad is the Guru, to carry you across the terrifying world-ocean. Know the One Lord alone, here and hereafter.

Gurbani: ਚਿਹਨੁ ਵਰਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਛਾਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੫੯॥
Transliteration: chihan varan nahee chhaaeaa maaeaa naanak sabad pachhaanai |59|
English: He has no form or color, shadow or illusion; O Nanak, realize the Shabad. ||59||

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਸਤ ਅੰਗੁਲ ਵਾਈ ਅਉਧੂ ਸੁੰਨ ਸਚੁ ਆਹਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: trai sat angul vaaee aaudhoo sun sach aahaaro |
English: O reclusive hermit, the True, Absolute Lord is the support of the exhaled breath, which extends out ten finger lengths.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੈ ਤਤੁ ਬਿਰੋਲੈ ਚੀਨੈ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh bolai tat birolai cheenai alakh apaaro |
English: The Gurmukh speaks and churns the essence of reality, and realizes the unseen, infinite Lord.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮੇਟੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸਾਏ ਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਚੂਕੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: trai gun mettai sabad vasaae taa man chookai ahankaaro |
English: Eradicating the three qualities, he enshrines the Shabad within, and then, his mind is rid of egotism.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: antar baahar eko jaanai taa har naam lagai piaaro |
English: Inside and out, he knows the One Lord alone; he is in love with the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖਮਨਾ ਇੜਾ ਪਿੰਗੁਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sukhamanaa irraa pingulaa boojhai jaa aape alakh lakhaae |
English: He understands the Sushmana, Ida and Pingala, when the unseen Lord reveals Himself.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਹੁ ਤੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੬੦॥
Transliteration: naanak tihu te aoopar saachaa satigur sabad samaae |60|
English: O Nanak, the True Lord is above these three energy channels. Through the Word, the Shabad of the True Guru, one merges with Him. ||60||

[Ang 944 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਜੀਉ ਪਵਨੁ ਕਥੀਅਲੇ ਪਵਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: man kaa jeeo pavan katheeale pavan kahaa ras khaaee |
English: "The air is said to be the soul of the mind. But what does the air feed on?

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨ ਕੀ ਮੁਦ੍ਰਾ ਕਵਨ ਅਉਧੂ ਸਿਧ ਕੀ ਕਵਨ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: giaan kee mudraa kavan aaudhoo sidh kee kavan kamaaee |
English: What is the way of the spiritual teacher, and the reclusive hermit? What is the occupation of the Siddha?"

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਰਸੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਅਉਧੂ ਹਉਮੈ ਪਿਆਸ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: bin sabadai ras na aavai aaudhoo haumai piaas na jaaee |
English: Without the Shabad, the essence does not come, O hermit, and the thirst of egotism does not depart.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਚੇ ਰਹੇ ਅਘਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sabad rate amrit ras paaeaa saache rahe aghaaee |
English: Imbued with the Shabad, one finds the ambrosial essence, and remains fulfilled with the True Name.

Gurbani: ਕਵਨ ਬੁਧਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਰਹੀਐ ਕਿਤੁ ਭੋਜਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: kavan budh jit asathir raheeai kit bhojan tripataasai |
English: "What is that wisdom, by which one remains steady and stable? What food brings satisfaction?"

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਪੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਗ੍ਰਾਸੈ ॥੬੧॥
Transliteration: naanak dukh sukh sam kar jaapai satigur te kaal na graasai |61|
English: O Nanak, when one looks upon pain and pleasure alike, through the True Guru, then he is not consumed by Death. ||61||

Gurbani: ਰੰਗਿ ਨ ਰਾਤਾ ਰਸਿ ਨਹੀ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: rang na raataa ras nahee maataa |
English: If one is not imbued with the Lord's Love, nor intoxicated with His subtle essence,

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੈ ਜਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਤਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: bin gurasabadai jal bal taataa |
English: without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he is frustrated, and consumed by his own inner fire.

Gurbani: ਬਿੰਦੁ ਨ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਭਾਖਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: bind na raakhiaa sabad na bhaakhiaa |
English: He does not preserve his semen and seed, and does not chant the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਪਵਨੁ ਨ ਸਾਧਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: pavan na saadhiaa sach na araadhiaa |
English: He does not control his breath; he does not worship and adore the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਲੇ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: akath kathaa le sam kar rahai |
English: But one who speaks the Unspoken Speech, and remains balanced,

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮ ਕਉ ਲਹੈ ॥੬੨॥
Transliteration: tau naanak aatam raam kau lahai |62|
English: O Nanak, attains the Lord, the Supreme Soul. ||62||

[Ang 945 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਰੰਗੇ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee range raataa |
English: By Guru's Grace, one is attuned to the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ਸਾਚੇ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: amrit peea saache maataa |
English: Drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar, he is intoxicated with the Truth.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur veechaaree agan nivaaree |
English: Contemplating the Guru, the fire within is put out.

Gurbani: ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀਓ ਆਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: apiau peeo aatam sukh dhaaree |
English: Drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar, the soul settles in peace.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: sach araadhiaa guramukh tar taaree |
English: Worshipping the True Lord in adoration, the Gurmukh crosses over the river of life.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੬੩॥
Transliteration: naanak boojhai ko veechaaree |63|
English: O Nanak, after deep contemplation, this is understood. ||63||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੈਗਲੁ ਕਹਾ ਬਸੀਅਲੇ ਕਹਾ ਬਸੈ ਇਹੁ ਪਵਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: eihu man maigal kahaa baseeale kahaa basai ihu pavanaa |
English: "Where does this mind-elephant live? Where does the breath reside?

Gurbani: ਕਹਾ ਬਸੈ ਸੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਉਧੂ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਚੂਕੈ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਭਵਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: kahaa basai su sabad aaudhoo taa kau chookai man kaa bhavanaa |
English: Where should the Shabad reside, so that the wanderings of the mind may cease?"

Gurbani: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਤਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: nadar kare taa satigur mele taa nij ghar vaasaa ihu man paae |
English: When the Lord blesses one with His Glance of Grace, he leads him to the True Guru. Then, this mind dwells in its own home within.

Gurbani: ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਖਾਇ ਤਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਵਰਜਿ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aapai aap khaae taa niramal hovai dhaavat varaj rahaae |
English: When the individual consumes his egotism, he becomes immaculate, and his wandering mind is restrained.

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਮੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਆਤਮੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਿਉ ਸਸਿ ਘਰਿ ਸੂਰੁ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: kiau mool pachhaanai aatam jaanai kiau sas ghar soor samaavai |
English: "How can the root, the source of all be realized? How can the soul know itself? How can the sun enter into the house of the moon?"

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਖੋਵੈ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੬੪॥
Transliteration: guramukh haumai vichahu khovai tau naanak sehaj samaavai |64|
English: The Gurmukh eliminates egotism from within; then, O Nanak, the sun naturally enters into the home of the moon. ||64||

[Ang 945 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸੀਅਲੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਣਿ ਰਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: eihu man nihachal hiradai vaseeale guramukh mool pachhaan rahai |
English: When the mind becomes steady and stable, it abides in the heart, and then the Gurmukh realizes the root, the source of all.

Gurbani: ਨਾਭਿ ਪਵਨੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਸਣਿ ਬੈਸੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਜਤ ਤਤੁ ਲਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: naabh pavan ghar aasan baisai guramukh khojat tat lahai |
English: The breath is seated in the home of the navel; the Gurmukh searches, and finds the essence of reality.

Gurbani: ਸੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਆਛੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਜੋਤਿ ਸੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: su sabad nirantar nij ghar aachhai tribhavan jot su sabad lahai |
English: This Shabad permeates the nucleus of the self, deep within, in its own home; the Light of this Shabad pervades the three worlds.

Gurbani: ਖਾਵੈ ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸਿ ਰਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: khaavai dookh bhookh saache kee saache hee tripataas rahai |
English: Hunger for the True Lord shall consume your pain, and through the True Lord, you shall be satisfied.

Gurbani: ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣੀ ਬਿਰਲੋ ਕੋ ਅਰਥਾਵੈ ॥
