Transliteration: anahad baanee guramukh jaanee biralo ko arathaavai |
English: The Gurmukh knows the unstruck sound current of the Bani; how rare are those who understand.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਭਾਖੈ ਸਚਿ ਰਪੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੬੫॥
Transliteration: naanak aakhai sach subhaakhai sach rapai rang kabahoo na jaavai |65|
English: Says Nanak, one who speaks the Truth is dyed in the color of Truth, which will never fade away. ||65||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਇਹੁ ਹਿਰਦਾ ਦੇਹ ਨ ਹੋਤੀ ਤਉ ਮਨੁ ਕੈਠੈ ਰਹਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaa ihu hiradaa deh na hotee tau man kaitthai rahataa |
English: "When this heart and body did not exist, where did the mind reside?

Gurbani: ਨਾਭਿ ਕਮਲ ਅਸਥੰਭੁ ਨ ਹੋਤੋ ਤਾ ਪਵਨੁ ਕਵਨ ਘਰਿ ਸਹਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: naabh kamal asathanbh na hoto taa pavan kavan ghar sahataa |
English: When there was no support of the navel lotus, then in which home did the breath reside?

Gurbani: ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਹੋਤੋ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਤਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਕਹਾ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: roop na hoto rekh na kaaee taa sabad kahaa liv laaee |
English: When there was no form or shape, then how could anyone lovingly focus on the Shabad?

Gurbani: ਰਕਤੁ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਕੀ ਮੜੀ ਨ ਹੋਤੀ ਮਿਤਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: rakat bind kee marree na hotee mit keemat nahee paaee |
English: When there was no dungeon formed from egg and sperm, who could measure the Lord's value and extent?

Gurbani: ਵਰਨੁ ਭੇਖੁ ਅਸਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੀ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਪਸਿ ਸਾਚਾ ॥
Transliteration: varan bhekh asaroop na jaapee kiau kar jaapas saachaa |
English: When color, dress and form could not be seen, how could the True Lord be known?"

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਇਬ ਤਬ ਸਾਚੋ ਸਾਚਾ ॥੬੬॥
Transliteration: naanak naam rate bairaagee ib tab saacho saachaa |66|
English: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are detached. Then and now, they see the Truest of the True. ||66||

Gurbani: ਹਿਰਦਾ ਦੇਹ ਨ ਹੋਤੀ ਅਉਧੂ ਤਉ ਮਨੁ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਰਹੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: hiradaa deh na hotee aaudhoo tau man sun rahai bairaagee |
English: When the heart and the body did not exist, O hermit, then the mind resided in the absolute, detached Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਭਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਅਸਥੰਭੁ ਨ ਹੋਤੋ ਤਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਬਸਤਉ ਪਵਨੁ ਅਨਰਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: naabh kamal asathanbh na hoto taa nij ghar bastau pavan anaraagee |
English: When there was no support of the lotus of the navel, the breath remained in its own home, attuned to the Lord's Love.

Gurbani: ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਤੀ ਤਉ ਅਕੁਲੀਣਿ ਰਹਤਉ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: roop na rekhiaa jaat na hotee tau akuleen rahtau sabad su saar |
English: When there was no form or shape or social class, then the Shabad, in its essence, resided in the unmanifest Lord.

Gurbani: ਗਉਨੁ ਗਗਨੁ ਜਬ ਤਬਹਿ ਨ ਹੋਤਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਜੋਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: gaun gagan jab tabeh na hotau tribhavan jot aape nirankaar |
English: When the world and the sky did not even exist, the Light of the Formless Lord filled the three worlds.

Gurbani: ਵਰਨੁ ਭੇਖੁ ਅਸਰੂਪੁ ਸੁ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: varan bhekh asaroop su eko eko sabad viddaanee |
English: Color, dress and form were contained in the One Lord; the Shabad was contained in the One, Wondrous Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚ ਬਿਨਾ ਸੂਚਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥੬੭॥
Transliteration: saach binaa soochaa ko naahee naanak akath kahaanee |67|
English: Without the True Name, no one can become pure; O Nanak, this is the Unspoken Speech. ||67||

[Ang 946 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਕਿਤੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਗੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਪੁਰਖਾ ਕਿਤੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਦੁਖਿ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kit kit bidh jag upajai purakhaa kit kit dukh binas jaaee |
English: "How, in what way, was the world formed, O man? And what disaster will end it?"

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਗੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਪੁਰਖਾ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਿਸਰਿਐ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: haumai vich jag upajai purakhaa naam visariai dukh paaee |
English: In egotism, the world was formed, O man; forgetting the Naam, it suffers and dies.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh hovai su giaan tat beechaarai haumai sabad jalaae |
English: One who becomes Gurmukh contemplates the essence of spiritual wisdom; through the Shabad, he burns away his egotism.

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਾਚੈ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: tan man niramal niramal baanee saachai rahai samaae |
English: His body and mind become immaculate, through the Immaculate Bani of the Word. He remains absorbed in Truth.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: naame naam rahai bairaagee saach rakhiaa ur dhaare |
English: Through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he remains detached; he enshrines the True Name in his heart.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜੋਗੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੬੮॥
Transliteration: naanak bin naavai jog kade na hovai dekhahu ridai beechaare |68|
English: O Nanak, without the Name, Yoga is never attained; reflect upon this in your heart, and see. ||68||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh saach sabad beechaarai koe |
English: The Gurmukh is one who reflects upon the True Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh sach baanee paragatt hoe |
English: The True Bani is revealed to the Gurmukh.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh man bheejai viralaa boojhai koe |
English: The mind of the Gurmukh is drenched with the Lord's Love, but how rare are those who understand this.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh nij ghar vaasaa hoe |
English: The Gurmukh dwells in the home of the self, deep within.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh jogee jugat pachhaanai |
English: The Gurmukh realizes the Way of Yoga.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥੬੯॥
Transliteration: guramukh naanak eko jaanai |69|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh knows the One Lord alone. ||69||

[Ang 946 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: bin satigur seve jog na hoee |
English: Without serving the True Guru, Yoga is not attained;

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: bin satigur bhette mukat na koee |
English: without meeting the True Guru, no one is liberated.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin satigur bhette naam paaeaa na jaae |
English: Without meeting the True Guru, the Naam cannot be found.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin satigur bhette mahaa dukh paae |
English: Without meeting the True Guru, one suffers in terrible pain.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਮਹਾ ਗਰਬਿ ਗੁਬਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: bin satigur bhette mahaa garab gubaar |
English: Without meeting the True Guru, there is only the deep darkness of egotistical pride.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਆ ਜਨਮੁ ਹਾਰਿ ॥੭੦॥
Transliteration: naanak bin gur muaa janam haar |70|
English: O Nanak, without the True Guru, one dies, having lost the opportunity of this life. ||70||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਤਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh man jeetaa haumai maar |
English: The Gurmukh conquers his mind by subduing his ego.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh saach rakhiaa ur dhaar |
English: The Gurmukh enshrines Truth in his heart.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਗੁ ਜੀਤਾ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਬਿਦਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh jag jeetaa jamakaal maar bidaar |
English: The Gurmukh conquers the world; he knocks down the Messenger of Death, and kills it.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh daragah na aavai haar |
English: The Gurmukh does not lose in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਸੋੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh mel milaae suo jaanai |
English: The Gurmukh is united in God's Union; he alone knows.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੭੧॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh sabad pachhaanai |71|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh realizes the Word of the Shabad. ||71||

[Ang 946 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਬਦੈ ਕਾ ਨਿਬੇੜਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਤੂ ਅਉਧੂ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: sabadai kaa niberraa sun too aaudhoo bin naavai jog na hoee |
English: This is the essence of the Shabad - listen, you hermits and Yogis. Without the Name, there is no Yoga.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੇ ਰਾਤੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਮਾਤੇ ਨਾਮੈ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: naame raate anadin maate naamai te sukh hoee |
English: Those who are attuned to the Name, remain intoxicated night and day; through the Name, they find peace.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: naamai hee te sabh paragatt hovai naame sojhee paaee |
English: Through the Name, everything is revealed; through the Name, understanding is obtained.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਸਚੈ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: bin naavai bhekh kareh bahutere sachai aap khuaaee |
English: Without the Name, people wear all sorts of religious robes; the True Lord Himself has confused them.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਉਧੂ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਤਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur te naam paaeeai aaudhoo jog jugat taa hoee |
English: The Name is obtained only from the True Guru, O hermit, and then, the Way of Yoga is found.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਮਨਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੭੨॥
Transliteration: kar beechaar man dekhahu naanak bin naavai mukat na hoee |72|
English: Reflect upon this in your mind, and see; O Nanak, without the Name, there is no liberation. ||72||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: teree gat mit toohai jaaneh kiaa ko aakh vakhaanai |
English: You alone know Your state and extent, Lord; What can anyone say about it?

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਪਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਭਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: too aape gupataa aape paragatt aape sabh rang maanai |
English: You Yourself are hidden, and You Yourself are revealed. You Yourself enjoy all pleasures.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਗੁਰੂ ਬਹੁ ਚੇਲੇ ਖੋਜਤ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: saadhik sidh guroo bahu chele khojat fireh furamaanai |
English: The seekers, the Siddhas, the many gurus and disciples wander around searching for You, according to Your Will.

Gurbani: ਮਾਗਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇ ਇਹ ਭਿਖਿਆ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: maageh naam paae ih bhikhiaa tere darasan kau kurabaanai |
English: They beg for Your Name, and You bless them with this charity. I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

Gurbani: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: abinaasee prabh khel rachaaeaa guramukh sojhee hoee |
English: The eternal imperishable Lord God has staged this play; the Gurmukh understands it.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭਿ ਜੁਗ ਆਪੇ ਵਰਤੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੭੩॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak sabh jug aape varatai doojaa avar na koee |73|1|
English: O Nanak, He extends Himself throughout the ages; there is no other than Him. ||73||1||

[Ang 947 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥ ਜੋਧੈ ਵੀਰੈ ਪੂਰਬਾਣੀ ਕੀ ਧੁਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee kee vaar mahalaa 3 | jodhai veerai poorabaanee kee dhunee |
English: Vaar Of Raamkalee, Third Mehl, To Be Sung To The Tune Of 'Jodha And Veera Poorbaanee':

Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਹਜੈ ਦਾ ਖੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਾਏ ਭਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sahajai daa khet hai jis no laae bhaau |
English: The True Guru is the field of intuitive wisdom. One who is inspired to love Him,

Gurbani: ਨਾਉ ਬੀਜੇ ਨਾਉ ਉਗਵੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: naau beeje naau ugavai naame rahai samaae |
English: plants the seed of the Name there. The Name sprouts up, and he remains absorbed in the Name.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਏਹੋ ਬੀਜੁ ਹੈ ਸਹਸਾ ਗਇਆ ਵਿਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: haumai eho beej hai sahasaa geaa vilaae |
English: But this egotism is the seed of skepticism; it has been uprooted.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਬੀਜੇ ਨ ਉਗਵੈ ਜੋ ਬਖਸੇ ਸੋ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: naa kichh beeje na ugavai jo bakhase so khaae |
English: It is not planted there, and it does not sprout; whatever God grants us, we eat.

Gurbani: ਅੰਭੈ ਸੇਤੀ ਅੰਭੁ ਰਲਿਆ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਨਿਕਸਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: anbhai setee anbh raliaa bahurr na nikasiaa jaae |
English: When water mixes with water, it cannot be separated again.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਲਤੁ ਹੈ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਲੋਕਾ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh chalat hai vekhahu lokaa aae |
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is wonderful; come, poeple, and see!

Gurbani: ਲੋਕੁ ਕਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਬਪੁੜਾ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਸੋਝੀ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: lok ki vekhai bapurraa jis no sojhee naeh |
English: But what can the poor people see? They do not understand.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਵੇਖਾਲੇ ਸੋ ਵੇਖੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jis vekhaale so vekhai jis vasiaa man maeh |1|
English: He alone sees, whom the Lord causes to see; the Lord comes to dwell in his mind. ||1||

[Ang 947 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਦੁਖ ਕਾ ਖੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਬੀਜੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh dukh kaa khet hai dukh beeje dukh khaae |
English: The self-willed manmukh is the field of sorrow and suffering. He plains sorrow, and eats sorrow.

Gurbani: ਦੁਖ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਦੁਖਿ ਮਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਤ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: dukh vich jamai dukh marai haumai karat vihaae |
English: In sorrow he is born, and in sorrow he dies. Acting in egotism, his life passes away.

Gurbani: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਅੰਧਾ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aavan jaan na sujhee andhaa andh kamaae |
English: He does not understand the coming and going of reincarnation; the blind man acts in blindness.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਦਿਤੇ ਕਉ ਲਪਟਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jo devai tisai na jaanee dite kau lapattaae |
English: He does not know the One who gives, but he is attached to what is given.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak poorab likhiaa kamaavanaa avar na karanaa jaae |2|
English: O Nanak, he acts according to his pre-ordained destiny. He cannot do anything else. ||2||

[Ang 947 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur miliai sadaa sukh jis no aape mele soe |
English: Meeting the True Guru, everlasting peace is obtained. He Himself leads us to meet Him.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖੈ ਏਹੁ ਬਿਬੇਕੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sukhai ehu bibek hai antar niramal hoe |
English: This is the true meaning of peace, that one becomes immaculate within oneself.

Gurbani: ਅਗਿਆਨ ਕਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: agiaan kaa bhram katteeai giaan paraapat hoe |
English: The doubt of ignorance is eradicated, and spiritual wisdom is obtained.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੋ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak eko nadaree aaeaa jeh dekhaa teh soe |3|
English: Nanak comes to gaze upon the One Lord alone; wherever he looks, there He is. ||3||

[Ang 947 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸਚੈ ਤਖਤੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ਬੈਸਣ ਕਉ ਜਾਂਈ ॥
Transliteration: sachai takhat rachaaeaa baisan kau jaanee |
English: The True Lord created His throne, upon which He sits.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਣਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh aape aap hai gur sabad sunaaee |
English: He Himself is everything; this is what the Word of the Guru's Shabad says.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਹਲ ਸਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aape kudarat saajeean kar mehal saraaee |
English: Through His almighty creative power, He created and fashioned the mansions and hotels.

Gurbani: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਚਾਨਣੇ ਪੂਰੀ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: chand sooraj due chaanane pooree banat banaaee |
English: He made the two lamps, the sun and the moon; He formed the perfect form.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਸੁਣੇ ਆਪਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aape vekhai sune aap gur sabad dhiaaee |1|
English: He Himself sees, and He Himself hears; meditate on the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

Gurbani: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਚੇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਤੂ ਸਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: vaahu vaahu sache paatisaah too sachee naaee |1| rahaau |
English: Waaho! Waaho! Hail, hail, O True King! True is Your Name. ||1||Pause||

[Ang 947 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਕਬੀਰ ਮਹਿਦੀ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਘਾਲਿਆ ਆਪੁ ਪੀਸਾਇ ਪੀਸਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kabeer mahidee kar kai ghaaliaa aap peesaae peesaae |
English: Kabeer, I have ground myself into henna paste.

Gurbani: ਤੈ ਸਹ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਪੁਛੀਆ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਲਾਈ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tai seh baat na puchheea kabahoo na laaee paae |1|
English: O my Husband Lord, You took no notice of me; You never applied me to Your feet. ||1||

[Ang 947 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਹਿਦੀ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਰਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak mahidee kar kai rakhiaa so sahu nadar karee |
English: O Nanak, my Husband Lord keeps me like henna paste; He blesses me with His Glance of Grace.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਪੀਸੈ ਆਪੇ ਘਸੈ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਲਾਇ ਲਏਇ ॥
Transliteration: aape peesai aape ghasai aape hee laae lee |
English: He Himself grinds me, and He Himself rubs me; He Himself applies me to His feet.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: eihu piram piaalaa khasam kaa jai bhaavai tai dee |2|
English: This is the cup of love of my Lord and Master; He gives it as He chooses. ||2||

[Ang 947 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਵੇਕੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈਅਨੁ ਸਭ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: vekee srisatt upaaeean sabh hukam aavai jaae samaahee |
English: You created the world with its variety; by the Hukam of Your Command, it comes, goes, and merges again in You.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸਦਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: aape vekh vigasadaa doojaa ko naahee |
English: You Yourself see, and blossom forth; there is no one else at all.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਖੁ ਤੂ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jiau bhaavai tiau rakh too gur sabad bujhaahee |
English: As it pleases You, You keep me. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I understand You.

Gurbani: ਸਭਨਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਜੋਰੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: sabhanaa teraa jor hai jiau bhaavai tivai chalaahee |
English: You are the strength of all. As it pleases You, You lead us on.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡ ਮੈ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tudh jevadd mai naeh ko kis aakh sunaaee |2|
English: There is no other as great as You; unto whom should I speak and talk? ||2||

[Ang 947 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਫਿਰੀ ਫਾਵੀ ਹੋਈ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: bharam bhulaaee sabh jag firee faavee hoee bhaal |
English: Deluded by doubt, I wandered over the whole world. Searching, I became frustrated.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਦੇਵਈ ਕਿਆ ਚਲੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: so sahu saant na devee kiaa chalai tis naal |
English: My Husband Lord has not blessed me with peace and tranquility; what will work with Him?

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਖੀਐ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee har dhiaaeeai antar rakheeai ur dhaar |
English: By Guru's Grace, I meditate on the Lord; I enshrine Him deep within my heart.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਠਿਆ ਸਹੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਤੀ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak ghar baitthiaa sahu paaeaa jaa kirapaa keetee karataar |1|
English: O Nanak, seated in his her own home, she finds her Husband Lord, when the Creator Lord grants His Grace. ||1||

[Ang 948 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਧੰਧਾ ਧਾਵਤ ਦਿਨੁ ਗਇਆ ਰੈਣਿ ਗਵਾਈ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: dhandhaa dhaavat din geaa rain gavaaee soe |
English: Chasing after worldly affairs, the day is wasted, and the night passes in sleep.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇਆ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਰੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: koorr bol bikh khaaeaa manamukh chaliaa roe |
English: Speaking lies, one eats poison; the self-willed manmukh departs, crying out in pain.

Gurbani: ਸਿਰੈ ਉਪਰਿ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sirai upar jam ddandd hai doojai bhaae pat khoe |
English: The Mesenger of Death holds his club over the mortal's head; in the love of duality, he loses his honor.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: har naam kade na chetio fir aavan jaanaa hoe |
English: He never even thinks of the Name of the Lord; over and over again, he comes and goes in reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee har man vasai jam ddandd na laagai koe |
English: But if, by Guru's Grace, the Lord's Name comes to dwell in his mind, then the Messenger of Death will not strike him down with his club.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak sahaje mil rahai karam paraapat hoe |2|
English: Then, O Nanak, he merges intuitively into the Lord, receiving His Grace. ||2||

[Ang 948 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਆਪਣੀ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਦੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: eik aapanee sifatee laaeian de satigur matee |
English: Some are linked to His Praises, when the Lord blesses them with the Guru's Teachings.

Gurbani: ਇਕਨਾ ਨੋ ਨਾਉ ਬਖਸਿਓਨੁ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: eikanaa no naau bakhasion asathir har satee |
English: Some are blessed with the Name of the eternal, unchanging True Lord.

Gurbani: ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੋ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਭਗਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: paun paanee baisantaro hukam kareh bhagatee |
English: Water, air and fire, by His Will, worship Him.

Gurbani: ਏਨਾ ਨੋ ਭਉ ਅਗਲਾ ਪੂਰੀ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: enaa no bhau agalaa pooree banat banatee |
English: They are held in the Fear of God; He has formed the perfect form.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਇਕੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sabh iko hukam varatadaa maniai sukh paaee |3|
English: The Hukam, the Command of the One Lord is all-pervasive; accepting it, peace is found. ||3||

[Ang 948 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਕਬੀਰ ਕਸਉਟੀ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਝੂਠਾ ਟਿਕੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: kabeer ksauttee raam kee jhootthaa ttikai na koe |
English: Kabeer, such is the touchstone of the Lord; the false cannot even touch it.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਕਸਉਟੀ ਸੋ ਸਹੈ ਜੋ ਮਰਜੀਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: raam ksauttee so sahai jo marajeevaa hoe |1|
English: He alone passes this test of the Lord, who remains dead while yet alive. ||1||

[Ang 948 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਰਤਕੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: kiau kar ihu man maareeai kiau kar miratak hoe |
English: How can this mind be conquered? How can it be killed?

Gurbani: ਕਹਿਆ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਮਾਨਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਛਡੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: kahiaa sabad na maanee haumai chhaddai na koe |
English: If one does not accept the Word of the Shabad, egotism does not depart.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਛੁਟੈ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਸੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee haumai chhuttai jeevan mukat so hoe |
English: By Guru's Grace, egotism is eradicated, and then, one is Jivan Mukta - liberated while yet alive.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਖਸੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak jis no bakhase tis milai tis bighan na laagai koe |2|
English: O Nanak, one whom the Lord forgives is united with Him, and then no obstacles block his way. ||2||

[Ang 948 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰਣਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਿਉ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jeevat maranaa sabh ko kahai jeevan mukat kiau hoe |
English: Everyone can say that they are dead while yet alive; how can they be liberated while yet alive?

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਕਾ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਦਾਰੂ ਭਾਉ ਲਾਏਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhai kaa sanjam je kare daaroo bhaau laaee |
English: If someone restrains himself through the Fear of God, and takes the medicine of the Love of God,

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: anadin gun gaavai sukh sahaje bikh bhavajal naam taree |
English: night and day, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. In celestial peace and poise, he crosses over the poisonous, terrifying world-ocean, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh paaeeai jaa kau nadar karee |3|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh finds the Lord; he is blessed with His Glance of Grace. ||3||

[Ang 948 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਰਚਾਇਓਨੁ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: doojaa bhaau rachaaeon trai gun varataaraa |
English: God created the love of duality, and the three modes which pervade the universe.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਉਪਾਇਅਨੁ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਕਮਾਵਨਿ ਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: brahamaa bisan mahes upaaeian hukam kamaavan kaaraa |
English: He created Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva, who act according to His Will.

Gurbani: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਦੇ ਜੋਤਕੀ ਨਾ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: panddit parrade jotakee naa boojheh beechaaraa |
English: The Pandits, the religious scholars, and the astrologers study their books, but they do not understand contemplation.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh teraa khel hai sach sirajanahaaraa |
English: Everything is Your play, O True Creator Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jis bhaavai tis bakhas laihi sach sabad samaaee |4|
English: As it pleases You, You bless us with forgiveness, and merge us in the True Word of the Shabad. ||4||

[Ang 948 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਝੂਠਾ ਝੂਠੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: man kaa jhootthaa jhootth kamaavai |
English: The man of false mind practices falsehood.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਨੋ ਫਿਰੈ ਤਪਾ ਸਦਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa no firai tapaa sadaavai |
English: He runs after Maya, and yet pretends to be a man of disciplined meditation.

Gurbani: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਸਭਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਗਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: bharame bhoolaa sabh teerath gahai |
English: Deluded by doubt, he visits all the sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਤਪਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਲਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: ohu tapaa kaise param gat lahai |
English: How can such a man of disciplined meditation attain the supreme status?

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee ko sach kamaavai |
English: By Guru's Grace, one lives the Truth.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਤਪਾ ਮੋਖੰਤਰੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak so tapaa mokhantar paavai |1|
English: O Nanak, such a man of disciplined meditation attains liberation. ||1||

[Ang 948 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਤਪਾ ਜਿ ਇਹੁ ਤਪੁ ਘਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: so tapaa ji ihu tap ghaale |
English: He alone is a man of disciplined meditation, who practices this self-discipline.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur no milai sabad samaale |
English: Meeting with the True Guru, he contemplates the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਇਹੁ ਤਪੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: satigur kee sevaa ihu tap paravaan |
English: Serving the True Guru - this is the only acceptable disciplined meditation.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਤਪਾ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak so tapaa darageh paavai maan |2|
English: O Nanak, such a man of disciplined meditation is honored in the Court of the Lord. ||2||

[Ang 948 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਉਪਾਇਅਨੁ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕੀ ਵਰਤਣਿ ॥
Transliteration: raat dinas upaaeian sansaar kee varatan |
English: He created the night and the day, for the activities of the world.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਆਨੇਰੁ ਬਿਨਾਸਣਿ ॥
Transliteration: guramatee ghatt chaananaa aaner binaasan |
English: Following the Guru's Teachings, one's heart is illumined, and the darkness is dispelled.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹੀ ਸਭ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਭ ਵਣਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਣਿ ॥
Transliteration: hukame hee sabh saajeean raviaa sabh van trin |
English: By the Hukam of His Command, He creates everything; He pervades and permeates all the woods and meadows.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਣਿ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh aape aap hai guramukh sadaa har bhan |
English: He Himself is everything; the Gurmukh constantly chants the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੇ ਹੀ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਈ ਸਚੈ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: sabade hee sojhee pee sachai aap bujhaaee |5|
English: Through the Shabad, understanding comes; the True Lord Himself inspires us to understand. ||5||

[Ang 949 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਭਿਆਗਤ ਏਹਿ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਚਿਤ ਮਹਿ ਭਰਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: abhiaagat ehi na aakheean jin ke chit meh bharam |
English: He is not called a renunciate, whose consciousness is filled with doubt.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਦੈ ਦਿਤੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਤੇਹੋ ਜੇਹਾ ਧਰਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: tis dai ditai naanakaa teho jehaa dharam |
English: Donations to him bring proportionate rewards.

Gurbani: ਅਭੈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਭੂਖਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: abhai niranjan param pad taa kaa bhookhaa hoe |
English: He hungers for the supreme status of the Fearless, Immaculate Lord;

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tis kaa bhojan naanakaa viralaa paae koe |1|
English: O Nanak, how rare are those who offer him this food. ||1||

[Ang 949 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਭਿਆਗਤ ਏਹਿ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ ਜਿ ਪਰ ਘਰਿ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: abhiaagat ehi na aakheean ji par ghar bhojan karen |
English: They are not called renunciates, who take food in the homes of others.

Gurbani: ਉਦਰੈ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਆਪਣੇ ਬਹਲੇ ਭੇਖ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: audarai kaaran aapane bahale bhekh karen |
English: For the sake of their bellies, they wear various religious robes.

Gurbani: ਅਭਿਆਗਤ ਸੇਈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿ ਆਤਮ ਗਉਣੁ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: abhiaagat seee naanakaa ji aatam gaun karen |
English: They alone are renunciates, O Nanak, who enter into their own souls.

Gurbani: ਭਾਲਿ ਲਹਨਿ ਸਹੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਰਹਣੁ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bhaal lehan sahu aapanaa nij ghar rehan karen |2|
English: They seek and find their Husband Lord; they dwell within the home of their own inner self. ||2||

[Ang 949 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਅੰਬਰੁ ਧਰਤਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਿਅਨੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਚਾ ਅਸਰਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: anbar dharat vichhorrian vich sachaa asaraau |
English: They sky and the earth are separate, but the True Lord supports them from within.

Gurbani: ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਸਭੋ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ghar dar sabho sach hai jis vich sachaa naau |
English: True are all those homes and gates, within which the True Name is enshrined.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਸਚਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sabh sachaa hukam varatadaa guramukh sach samaau |
English: The Hukam of the True Lord's Command is effective everywhere. The Gurmukh merges in the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਆਪਿ ਤਖਤੁ ਸਚਾ ਬਹਿ ਸਚਾ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਆਉ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa aap takhat sachaa beh sachaa kare niaau |
English: He Himself is True, and True is His throne. Seated upon it, He administers true justice.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: sabh sacho sach varatadaa guramukh alakh lakhaaee |6|
English: The Truest of the True is all-pervading everywhere; the Gurmukh sees the unseen. ||6||

[Ang 949 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰੈਣਾਇਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਅਨੰਤੁ ਹੈ ਕੂੜੀ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: rainaaeir maeh anant hai koorree aavai jaae |
English: In the world-ocean, the Infinite Lord abides. The false come and go in reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲੈ ਆਪਣੈ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਲਹੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhaanai chalai aapanai bahutee lahai sajaae |
English: One who walks according to his own will, suffers terrible punishment.

Gurbani: ਰੈਣਾਇਰ ਮਹਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੈ ਕਰਮੀ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: rainaaeir meh sabh kichh hai karamee palai paae |
English: All things are in the world-ocean, but they are obtained only by the karma of good actions.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੇ ਚਲੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak nau nidh paaeeai je chalai tisai rajaae |1|
English: O Nanak, he alone obtains the nine treasures, who walks in the Will of the Lord. ||1||

[Ang 949 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਨਮਿ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: sahaje satigur na sevio vich haumai janam binaas |
English: One who doesn't intuitively serve the True Guru, loses his life in egotism.

Gurbani: ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਨ ਚਖਿਓ ਕਮਲੁ ਨ ਹੋਇਓ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: rasanaa har ras na chakhio kamal na hoeo paragaas |
English: His tongue does not taste the sublime essence of the Lord, and his heart-lotus does not blossom forth.

Gurbani: ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਧੀ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਮੁਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: bikh khaadhee manamukh muaa maaeaa mohi vinaas |
English: The self-willed manmukh eats poison and dies; he is ruined by love and attachment to Maya.

Gurbani: ਇਕਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਣੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: eikas har ke naam vin dhrig jeevan dhrig vaas |
English: Without the Name of the One Lord, his life is cursed, and his home is cursed as well.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਚਾ ਤਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: jaa aape nadar kare prabh sachaa taa hovai daasan daas |
English: When God Himself bestows His Glance of Grace, then one becomes the slave of His slaves.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਪਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: taa anadin sevaa kare satiguroo kee kabeh na chhoddai paas |
English: And then, night and day, he serves the True Guru, and never leaves His side.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਅਲਿਪਤੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਤਿਉ ਵਿਚੇ ਗਿਰਹ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: jiau jal meh kamal alipato varatai tiau viche girah udaas |
English: As the lotus flower floats unaffected in the water, so does he remain detached in his own household.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jan naanak kare karaaeaa sabh ko jiau bhaavai tiv har gunataas |2|
English: O servant Nanak, the Lord acts, and inspires everyone to act, according to the Pleasure of His Will. He is the treasure of virtue. ||2||

[Ang 949 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਛਤੀਹ ਜੁਗ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਸਾ ਆਪੇ ਗਣਤ ਕੀਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: chhateeh jug gubaar saa aape ganat keenee |
English: For thirty-six ages, there was utter darkness. Then, the Lord revealed Himself.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਆਪਿ ਮਤਿ ਦੀਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: aape srisatt sabh saajeean aap mat deenee |
English: He Himself created the entire universe. He Himself blessed it with understanding.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਸਾਜਿਅਨੁ ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਗਣਤ ਗਣੀਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: simrit saasat saajian paap pun ganat ganeenee |
English: He created the Simritees and the Shaastras; He calculates the accounts of virtue and vice.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋ ਬੁਝਸੀ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਤੀਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: jis bujhaae so bujhasee sachai sabad pateenee |
English: He alone understands, whom the Lord inspires to understand and to be pleased with the True Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: sabh aape aap varatadaa aape bakhas milaaee |7|
English: He Himself is all-pervading; He Himself forgives, and unites with Himself. ||7||

[Ang 949 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਭੋ ਰਤੁ ਹੈ ਰਤੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਤੰਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: eihu tan sabho rat hai rat bin tan na hoe |
English: This body is all blood; without blood, the body cannot exist.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਸਹਿ ਰਤੇ ਆਪਣੈ ਤਿਨ ਤਨਿ ਲੋਭ ਰਤੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jo seh rate aapanai tin tan lobh rat na hoe |
English: Those who are attuned to their Lord - their bodies are not filled with the blood of greed.

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਪਇਐ ਤਨੁ ਖੀਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਲੋਭ ਰਤੁ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhai peiai tan kheen hoe lobh rat vichahu jaae |
English: In the Fear of God, the body becomes thin, and the blood of greed passes out of the body.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਬੈਸੰਤਰਿ ਧਾਤੁ ਸੁਧੁ ਹੋਇ ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jiau baisantar dhaat sudh hoe tiau har kaa bhau duramat mail gavaae |
English: As fire purifies metal, so does the Fear of the Lord eradicate the filth of evil-mindedness.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak te jan sohane jo rate har rang laae |1|
English: O Nanak, beautiful are those humble beings, who are imbued with the Lord's Love. ||1||

[Ang 950 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਤਾ ਬਨਿਆ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee raam man vasiaa taa baniaa seegaar |
English: In Raamkalee, I have enshrined the Lord in my mind; thus I have been embellished.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਸਿਆ ਤਾ ਸਉਪਿਆ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad kamal bigasiaa taa saupiaa bhagat bhanddaar |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, my heart-lotus has blossomed forth; the Lord blessed me with the treasure of devotional worship.

Gurbani: ਭਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਤਾ ਜਾਗਿਆ ਚੂਕਾ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: bharam geaa taa jaagiaa chookaa agiaan andhaar |
English: My doubt was dispelled, and I woke up; the darkness of ignorance was dispelled.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਤਿ ਅਗਲਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: tis no roop at agalaa jis har naal piaar |
English: She who is in love with her Lord, is the most infinitely beautiful.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਰਵੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa ravai pir aapanaa sobhaavantee naar |
English: Such a beautiful, happy soul-bride enjoys her Husband Lord forever.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਜਾਸਨਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh seegaar na jaananee jaasan janam sabh haar |
English: The self-willed manmukhs do not know how to decorate themselves; wasting their whole lives, they depart.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: bin har bhagatee seegaar kareh nit jameh hoe khuaar |
English: Those who decorate themselves without devotional worship to the Lord, are continually reincarnated to suffer.

Gurbani: ਸੈਸਾਰੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੋਭ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੀ ਅਗੈ ਜਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: saisaarai vich sobh na paaeinee agai ji kare su jaanai karataar |
English: They do not obtain respect in this world; the Creator Lord alone knows what will happen to them in the world hereafter.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਦੁਹੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਹੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak sachaa ek hai duhu vich hai sansaar |
English: O Nanak, the True Lord is the One and only; duality exists only in the world.

Gurbani: ਚੰਗੈ ਮੰਦੈ ਆਪਿ ਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਸੋ ਕਰਨਿ ਜਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: changai mandai aap laaeian so karan ji aap karaae karataar |2|
English: He Himself enjoins them to good and bad; they do only that which the Creator Lord causes them to do. ||2||

[Ang 950 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin satigur seve saant na aavee doojee naahee jaae |
English: Without serving the True Guru, tranquility is not obtained. It cannot be found anywhere else.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰਾ ਲੋਚੀਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: je bahuteraa locheeai vin karamaa paaeaa na jaae |
English: No matter how much one may long for it, without the karma of good actions, it cannot be found.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: antar lobh vikaar hai doojai bhaae khuaae |
English: Those whose inner beings are filled with greed and corruption, are ruined through the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: tin jaman maran na chukee haumai vich dukh paae |
English: The cycle of birth and death is not ended, and filled with egotism, they suffer in pain.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਸੋ ਖਾਲੀ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jinee satigur siau chit laaeaa so khaalee koee naeh |
English: Those who focus their consciousness on the True Guru, do not remain unfulfilled.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤਲਬ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਾ ਓਇ ਦੁਖ ਸਹਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: tin jam kee talab na hovee naa oe dukh sahaeh |
English: They are not summoned by the Messenger of Death, and they do not suffer in pain.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh ubare sachai sabad samaeh |3|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is saved, merging in the True Word of the Shabad. ||3||

[Ang 950 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਹੋਰਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਸਭਿ ਧਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: aap alipat sadaa rahai hor dhandhai sabh dhaaveh |
English: He Himself remains unattached forever; all others run after worldly affairs.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਅਚਲੁ ਹੈ ਹੋਰਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: aap nihachal achal hai hor aaveh jaaveh |
English: He Himself is eternal, unchanging and unmoving; the others continue coming and going in reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa har dhiaaeeai guramukh sukh paaveh |
English: Meditating on the Lord forever and ever, the Gurmukh finds peace.

Gurbani: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚਿ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: nij ghar vaasaa paaeeai sach sifat samaaveh |
English: He dwells in the home of his own inner being, absorbed in the Praise of the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: sachaa gahir ganbheer hai gur sabad bujhaaee |8|
English: The True Lord is profound and unfathomable; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is understood. ||8||

[Ang 950 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਸਭੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਚੁ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa naam dhiaae too sabho varatai sach |
English: Meditate on the True Name; the True Lord is all-pervading.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਜੋ ਬੁਝੈ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਸਚੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak hukamai jo bujhai so fal paae sach |
English: O Nanak, one who realizes the Hukam of the Lord's Command, obtains the fruit of Truth.

Gurbani: ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਨੀ ਕਰਤਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਚੁ ॥
Transliteration: kathanee badanee karataa firai hukam na boojhai sach |
English: One who merely mouths the words, does not understand the Hukam of the True Lord's Command.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨੇ ਸੋ ਭਗਤੁ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਣੁ ਮੰਨੇ ਕਚੁ ਨਿਕਚੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak har kaa bhaanaa mane so bhagat hoe vin mane kach nikach |1|
English: O Nanak, one who accepts the Will of the Lord is His devotee. Without accepting it, he is the falsest of the false. ||1||

[Ang 950 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬੋਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਓਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh bol na jaananee onaa andar kaam krodh ahankaar |
English: The self-willed manmukhs do not know what they are saying. They are filled with sexual desire, anger and egotism.

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਥਾਉ ਕੁਥਾਉ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਉਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: oe thaau kuthaau na jaananee un antar lobh vikaar |
English: They do not understand right places and wrong places; they are filled with greed and corruption.

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਆਪਣੈ ਸੁਆਇ ਆਇ ਬਹਿ ਗਲਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਓਨਾ ਮਾਰੇ ਜਮੁ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: oe aapanai suaae aae beh galaa kareh onaa maare jam jandaar |
English: They come, and sit and talk for their own purposes. The Messenger of Death strikes them down.

Gurbani: ਅਗੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਲੇਖੈ ਮੰਗਿਐ ਮਾਰਿ ਖੁਆਰੁ ਕੀਚਹਿ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ॥
Transliteration: agai daragah lekhai mangiai maar khuaar keecheh koorriaar |
English: Hereafter, they are called to account in the Court of the Lord; the false ones are struck down and humiliated.

Gurbani: ਏਹ ਕੂੜੈ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਕਿਉ ਉਤਰੈ ਕੋਈ ਕਢਹੁ ਇਹੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: eeh koorrai kee mal kiau utarai koee kadtahu ihu veechaar |
English: How can this filth of falsehood be washed off? Can anyone think about this, and find the way?

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜਾਏ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: satigur milai taa naam dirraae sabh kilavikh kattanahaar |
English: If one meets with the True Guru, He implants the Naam, the Name of the Lord within; all his sins are destroyed.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇ ਨਾਮੋ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਸਭਿ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: naam jape naamo aaraadhe tis jan kau karahu sabh namasakaar |
English: Let all bow in humility to that humble being who chants the Naam, and worships the Naam in adoration.

Gurbani: ਮਲੁ ਕੂੜੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਉਤਾਰੀਅਨੁ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: mal koorree naam utaareean jap naam hoaa sachiaar |
English: The Naam washes off the filth of falsehood; chanting the Naam, one becomes truthful.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸ ਦੇ ਏਹਿ ਚਲਤ ਹਹਿ ਸੋ ਜੀਵਉ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jan naanak jis de ehi chalat heh so jeevau devanahaar |2|
English: O servant Nanak, wondrous are the plays of the Lord, the Giver of life. ||2||

[Ang 951 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਹਿ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: tudh jevadd daataa naeh kis aakh sunaaeeai |
English: You are the Great Giver; no other is as great as You. Unto whom should I speak and talk?

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਇ ਜਿਥਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee paae jithahu haumai jaaeeai |
English: By Guru's Grace, I find You; You eradicate egotism from within.

Gurbani: ਰਸ ਕਸ ਸਾਦਾ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: ras kas saadaa baaharaa sachee vaddiaaeeai |
English: You are beyond sweet and salty flavors; True is Your glorious greatness.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਖਸੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਇ ਆਪਿ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: jis no bakhase tis dee aap le milaaeeai |
English: You bless those whom You forgive, and unite them with Yourself.

Gurbani: ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਪਿਆਈ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: ghatt antar amrit rakhion guramukh kisai piaaee |9|
English: You have placed the Ambrosial Nectar deep within the heart; the Gurmukh drinks it in. ||9||

[Ang 951 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬਾਬਾਣੀਆ ਕਹਾਣੀਆ ਪੁਤ ਸਪੁਤ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: baabaaneea kahaaneea put saput karen |
English: The stories of one's ancestors make the children good children.

Gurbani: ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਲੈਨਿ ਸੇਈ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: ji satigur bhaavai su man lain seee karam karen |
English: They accept what is pleasing to the Will of the True Guru, and act accordingly.

Gurbani: ਜਾਇ ਪੁਛਹੁ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਬਿਆਸ ਸੁਕ ਨਾਰਦ ਬਚਨ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: jaae puchhahu simrit saasat biaas suk naarad bachan sabh srisatt karen |
English: Go and consult the Simritees, the Shaastras, the writings of Vyaas, Suk Dayv, Naarad, and all those who preach to the world.

Gurbani: ਸਚੈ ਲਾਏ ਸਚਿ ਲਗੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਲੇਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: sachai laae sach lage sadaa sach samaalen |
English: Those, whom the True Lord attaches, are attached to the Truth; they contemplate the True Name forever.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਏ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਭਏ ਜਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੇਨਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak aae se paravaan bhe ji sagale kul taaren |1|
English: O Nanak, their coming into the world is approved; they redeem all their ancestors. ||1||

[Ang 951 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੂ ਜਿਨਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਧੁਲਾ ਸਿਖ ਭੀ ਅੰਧੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: guroo jinaa kaa andhulaa sikh bhee andhe karam karen |
English: The disciples whose teacher is blind, act blindly as well.

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲਨਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਨਿਤ ਝੂਠੋ ਝੂਠੁ ਬੋਲੇਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: oe bhaanai chalan aapanai nit jhoottho jhootth bolen |
English: They walk according to their own wills, and continually speak falsehood and lies.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਸਤੁ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: koorr kusat kamaavade par nindaa sadaa karen |
English: They practice falsehood and deception, and endlessly slander others.

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਆਪਿ ਡੁਬੇ ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਕਾ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਡੋਬੇਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: oe aap ddube par nindakaa sagale kul ddoben |
English: Slandering others, they drown themselves, and drown all their generations as well.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਤੁ ਓਇ ਲਾਏ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗੇ ਉਇ ਬਪੁੜੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak jit oe laae tith lage ue bapurre kiaa karen |2|
English: O Nanak, whatever the Lord links them to, to that they are linked; what can the poor creatures do? ||2||

[Ang 951 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਨਦਰੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਖਦਾ ਜੇਤੀ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਕੀਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: sabh nadaree andar rakhadaa jetee sisatt sabh keetee |
English: He keeps all under His Gaze; He created the entire Universe.

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਕੂੜਿ ਕੁਸਤਿ ਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਵਿਗੂਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: eik koorr kusat laaeian manamukh vigootee |
English: He has linked some to falsehood and deception; these self-willed manmukhs are plundered.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh sadaa dhiaaeeai andar har preetee |
English: The Gurmukhs meditate on the Lord forever; their inner beings are filled with love.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੋਤੈ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਨੑ ਵਾਤਿ ਸਿਪੀਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: jin kau potai pun hai tina vaat sipeetee |
English: Those who have the treasure of virtue, chant the Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਚੁ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਨਾਈ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: naanak naam dhiaaeeai sach sifat sanaaee |10|
English: O Nanak, meditate on the Naam, and the Glorious Praises of the True Lord. ||10||

[Ang 951 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤੀ ਪਾਪੁ ਕਰਿ ਸਤੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: satee paap kar sat kamaeh |
English: Men of charity gather wealth by committing sins, and then give it away in donations to charity.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਘਰਿ ਦੇਵਣ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: gur deekhiaa ghar devan jaeh |
English: Their spiritual teachers go to their homes to instruct them.

Gurbani: ਇਸਤਰੀ ਪੁਰਖੈ ਖਟਿਐ ਭਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: eisataree purakhai khattiai bhaau |
English: The woman loves the man only for his wealth;

Gurbani: ਭਾਵੈ ਆਵਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhaavai aavau bhaavai jaau |
English: they come and go as they please.

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਤੁ ਬੇਦੁ ਨ ਮਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: saasat bed na maanai koe |
English: No one obeys the Shaastras or the Vedas.

Gurbani: ਆਪੋ ਆਪੈ ਪੂਜਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aapo aapai poojaa hoe |
English: Everyone worships himself.

Gurbani: ਕਾਜੀ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਬਹੈ ਨਿਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: kaajee hoe kai bahai niaae |
English: Becoming judges, they sit and administer justice.

Gurbani: ਫੇਰੇ ਤਸਬੀ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: fere tasabee kare khudaae |
English: They chant on their malas, and call upon God.

Gurbani: ਵਢੀ ਲੈ ਕੈ ਹਕੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: vadtee lai kai hak gavaae |
English: They accept bribes, and block justice.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਪੁਛੈ ਤਾ ਪੜਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: je ko puchhai taa parr sunaae |
English: If someone asks them, they read quotations from their books.

Gurbani: ਤੁਰਕ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਕਨਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: turak mantru kan ridai samaeh |
English: The Muslim scriptures are in their ears and in their hearts.

Gurbani: ਲੋਕ ਮੁਹਾਵਹਿ ਚਾੜੀ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: lok muhaaveh chaarree khaeh |
English: They plunder the people, and engage in gossip and flattery.

Gurbani: ਚਉਕਾ ਦੇ ਕੈ ਸੁਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: chaukaa de kai suchaa hoe |
English: They anoint their kitchens to try to become pure.

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa hindoo vekhahu koe |
English: Behold, such is the Hindu.

Gurbani: ਜੋਗੀ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਜਟਾ ਬਿਭੂਤ ॥
Transliteration: jogee girahee jattaa bibhoot |
English: The Yogi, with matted hair and ashes on his body, has become a householder.

Gurbani: ਆਗੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਪੂਤ ॥
Transliteration: aagai paachhai roveh poot |
English: The children weep in front of him and behind him.

Gurbani: ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jog na paaeaa jugat gavaaee |
English: He does not attain Yoga - he has lost his way.

Gurbani: ਕਿਤੁ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਾਈ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kit kaaran sir chhaaee paaee |
English: Why does he apply ashes to his forehead?

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਲਿ ਕਾ ਏਹੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak kal kaa ehu paravaan |
English: O Nanak, this is the sign of the Dark Age of Kali Yuga;

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਆਖਣੁ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aape aakhan aape jaan |1|
English: everyone says that he himself knows. ||1||

[Ang 951 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਿੰਦੂ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: hindoo kai ghar hindoo aavai |
English: The Hindu comes to the house of a Hindu.

Gurbani: ਸੂਤੁ ਜਨੇਊ ਪੜਿ ਗਲਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: soot janeaoo parr gal paavai |
English: He puts the sacred thread around his neck and reads the scriptures.

Gurbani: ਸੂਤੁ ਪਾਇ ਕਰੇ ਬੁਰਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: soot paae kare buriaaee |
English: He puts on the thread, but does evil deeds.

Gurbani: ਨਾਤਾ ਧੋਤਾ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: naataa dhotaa thaae na paaee |
English: His cleansings and washings will not be approved.

Gurbani: ਮੁਸਲਮਾਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: musalamaan kare vaddiaaee |
English: The Muslim glorifies his own faith.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੀਰੈ ਕੋ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: vin gur peerai ko thaae na paaee |
English: Without the Guru or a spiritual teacher, no one is accepted.

Gurbani: ਰਾਹੁ ਦਸਾਇ ਓਥੈ ਕੋ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: raahu dasaae othai ko jaae |
English: They may be shown the way, but only a few go there.

Gurbani: ਕਰਣੀ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਭਿਸਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: karanee baajhahu bhisat na paae |
English: Without the karma of good actions, heaven is not attained.

Gurbani: ਜੋਗੀ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਦਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jogee kai ghar jugat dasaaee |
English: The Way of Yoga is demonstrated in the Yogi's monastery.

Gurbani: ਤਿਤੁ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਕਨਿ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: tit kaaran kan mundraa paaee |
English: They wear ear-rings to show the way.

Gurbani: ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਪਾਇ ਫਿਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: mundraa paae firai sansaar |
English: Wearing ear-rings, they wander around the world.

Gurbani: ਜਿਥੈ ਕਿਥੈ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jithai kithai sirajanahaar |
English: The Creator Lord is everywhere.

Gurbani: ਜੇਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਤੇ ਵਾਟਾਊ ॥
Transliteration: jete jeea tete vaattaaoo |
English: There are as many travellers as there are beings.

Gurbani: ਚੀਰੀ ਆਈ ਢਿਲ ਨ ਕਾਊ ॥
Transliteration: cheeree aaee dtil na kaaoo |
English: When one's death warrant is issued, there is no delay.

Gurbani: ਏਥੈ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੁ ਜਾਇ ਸਿਞਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: ethai jaanai su jaae siyaanai |
English: One who knows the Lord here, realizes Him there as well.

Gurbani: ਹੋਰੁ ਫਕੜੁ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: hor fakarr hindoo musalamaanai |
English: Others, whether Hindu or Muslim, are just babbling.

Gurbani: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਦਰਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabhanaa kaa dar lekhaa hoe |
English: Everyone's account is read in the Court of the Lord;

Gurbani: ਕਰਣੀ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਤਰੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: karanee baajhahu tarai na koe |
English: without the karma of good actions, no one crosses over.

Gurbani: ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: sacho sach vakhaanai koe |
English: One who speaks the True Name of the True Lord,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਗੈ ਪੁਛ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak agai puchh na hoe |2|
English: O Nanak, is not called to account hereafter. ||2||

[Ang 952 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋਟੁ ਗੜੁ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa mandar aakheeai kaaeaa kott garr |
English: The fortress of the body is called the Mansion of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਲਾਲ ਜਵੇਹਰੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੜੁ ॥
Transliteration: andar laal javeharee guramukh har naam parr |
English: The rubies and gems are found within it; the Gurmukh chants the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਅਤਿ ਸੋਹਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜੁ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa mandar sareer at sohanaa har har naam dirr |
English: The body, the Mansion of the Lord, is very beautiful, when the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is implanted deep within.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਇਅਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਨਿਤ ਕੜੁ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh aap khuaaeian maaeaa moh nit karr |
English: The self-willed manmukhs ruin themselves; they boil continuously in attachment to Maya.

Gurbani: ਸਭਨਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: sabhanaa saahib ek hai poorai bhaag paaeaa jaaee |11|
English: The One Lord is the Master of all. He is found only by perfect destiny. ||11||

[Ang 952 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਸਤਿ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਨਾ ਸਤਿ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਨਾ ਸਤਿ ਪਾਣੀ ਜੰਤ ਫਿਰਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: naa sat dukheea naa sat sukheea naa sat paanee jant fireh |
English: There is no Truth in suffering, there is no Truth in comfort. There is no Truth in wandering like animals through the water.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਸਤਿ ਮੂੰਡ ਮੁਡਾਈ ਕੇਸੀ ਨਾ ਸਤਿ ਪੜਿਆ ਦੇਸ ਫਿਰਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: naa sat moondd muddaaee kesee naa sat parriaa des fireh |
English: There is no Truth in shaving one's head; there is no Truth is studying the scriptures or wandering in foreign lands.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਸਤਿ ਰੁਖੀ ਬਿਰਖੀ ਪਥਰ ਆਪੁ ਤਛਾਵਹਿ ਦੁਖ ਸਹਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: naa sat rukhee birakhee pathar aap tachhaaveh dukh saheh |
English: There is no Truth in trees, plants or stones, in mutilating oneself or suffering in pain.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਸਤਿ ਹਸਤੀ ਬਧੇ ਸੰਗਲ ਨਾ ਸਤਿ ਗਾਈ ਘਾਹੁ ਚਰਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: naa sat hasatee badhe sangal naa sat gaaee ghaahu chareh |
English: There is no Truth in binding elephants in chains; there is no Truth in grazing cows.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਹਥਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਜੇ ਸੋਈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: jis hath sidh devai je soee jis no dee tis aae milai |
English: He alone grants it, whose hands hold spritual perfection; he alone receives it, unto whom it is given.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: naanak taa kau milai vaddaaee jis ghatt bheetar sabad ravai |
English: O Nanak, he alone is blessed with glorious greatness, whose heart is filled with the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਘਟ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਉ ਸਭਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਖੁਆਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਉਣੁ ਕਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: sabh ghatt mere hau sabhanaa andar jiseh khuaaee tis kaun kahai |
English: God says, all hearts are mine, and I am in all hearts. Who can explain this to one who is confused?

Gurbani: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਲਾ ਵਾਟੜੀ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਭੁਲਾਵੈ ਕਉਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: jiseh dikhaalaa vaattarree tiseh bhulaavai kaun |
English: Who can confuse that being, unto whom I have shown the Way?

Gurbani: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ਪੰਧ ਸਿਰਿ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਕਉਣੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jiseh bhulaaee pandh sir tiseh dikhaavai kaun |1|
English: And who can show the Path to that being whom I have confused since the beginning of time? ||1||

[Ang 952 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਜੋ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: so girahee jo nigrahu karai |
English: He alone is a householder, who restrains his passions

Gurbani: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਕਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: jap tap sanjam bheekhiaa karai |
English: and begs for meditation, austerity and self-discipline.

Gurbani: ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਕਾ ਕਰੇ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: pun daan kaa kare sareer |
English: He gives donations to charity with his body;

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਗੰਗਾ ਕਾ ਨੀਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: so girahee gangaa kaa neer |
English: such a householder is as pure as the water of the Ganges.

Gurbani: ਬੋਲੈ ਈਸਰੁ ਸਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: bolai eesar sat saroop |
English: Says Eeshar, the Lord is the embodiment of Truth.

Gurbani: ਪਰਮ ਤੰਤ ਮਹਿ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਰੂਪੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: param tant meh rekh na roop |2|
English: The supreme essence of reality has no shape or form. ||2||

[Ang 952 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਅਉਧੂਤੀ ਜੋ ਧੂਪੈ ਆਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: so aaudhootee jo dhoopai aap |
English: He alone is a detached hermit, who burns away his self-conceit.

Gurbani: ਭਿਖਿਆ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: bhikhiaa bhojan karai santaap |
English: He begs for suffering as his food.

Gurbani: ਅਉਹਠ ਪਟਣ ਮਹਿ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਕਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: aauhatth pattan meh bheekhiaa karai |
English: In the city of the heart, he begs for charity.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਅਉਧੂਤੀ ਸਿਵ ਪੁਰਿ ਚੜੈ ॥
Transliteration: so aaudhootee siv pur charrai |
English: Such a renunciate ascends to the City of God.

Gurbani: ਬੋਲੈ ਗੋਰਖੁ ਸਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: bolai gorakh sat saroop |
English: Says Gorakh, God is the embodiment of Truth;

Gurbani: ਪਰਮ ਤੰਤ ਮਹਿ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਰੂਪੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: param tant meh rekh na roop |3|
English: the supreme essence of reality has no shape or form. ||3||

[Ang 952 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਜਿ ਪਾਲੇ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: so udaasee ji paale udaas |
English: He alone is an Udasi, a shaven-headed renunciate, who embraces renunciation.

Gurbani: ਅਰਧ ਉਰਧ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: aradh uradh kare niranjan vaas |
English: He sees the Immaculate Lord dwelling in both the upper and lower regions.

Gurbani: ਚੰਦ ਸੂਰਜ ਕੀ ਪਾਏ ਗੰਢਿ ॥
Transliteration: chand sooraj kee paae gandt |
English: He balances the sun and the moon energies.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਕਾ ਪੜੈ ਨ ਕੰਧੁ ॥
Transliteration: tis udaasee kaa parrai na kandh |
English: The body-wall of such an Udasi does not collapse.

Gurbani: ਬੋਲੈ ਗੋਪੀ ਚੰਦੁ ਸਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: bolai gopee chand sat saroop |
English: Says Gopi Chand, God is the embodiment of Truth;

Gurbani: ਪਰਮ ਤੰਤ ਮਹਿ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਰੂਪੁ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: param tant meh rekh na roop |4|
English: the supreme essence of reality has no shape or form. ||4||

[Ang 952 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਪਾਖੰਡੀ ਜਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਪਖਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: so paakhanddee ji kaaeaa pakhaale |
English: He alone is a Paakhandi, who cleanses his body of filth.

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਜਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa kee agan braham parajaale |
English: The fire of his body illuminates God within.

Gurbani: ਸੁਪਨੈ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਝਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: supanai bind na deee jharanaa |
English: He does not waste his energy in wet dreams.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਪਾਖੰਡੀ ਜਰਾ ਨ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: tis paakhanddee jaraa na maranaa |
English: Such a Paakhandi does not grow old or die.

Gurbani: ਬੋਲੈ ਚਰਪਟੁ ਸਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: bolai charapatt sat saroop |
English: Says Charpat, God is the embodiment of Truth;

Gurbani: ਪਰਮ ਤੰਤ ਮਹਿ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਰੂਪੁ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: param tant meh rekh na roop |5|
English: the supreme essence of reality has no shape or form. ||5||

[Ang 953 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਜਿ ਉਲਟੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: so bairaagee ji ulatte braham |
English: He alone is a Bairaagi, who turns himself toward God.

Gurbani: ਗਗਨ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ ਰੋਪੈ ਥੰਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: gagan manddal meh ropai tham |
English: In the Tenth Gate, the sky of the mind, he erects his pillar.

Gurbani: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਹੈ ਧਿਆਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: ahinis antar rahai dhiaan |
English: Night and day, he remains in deep inner meditation.

Gurbani: ਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਸਤ ਸਮਾਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: te bairaagee sat samaan |
English: Such a Bairaagi is just like the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਬੋਲੈ ਭਰਥਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: bolai bharathar sat saroop |
English: Says Bhart'har, God is the embodiment of Truth;

Gurbani: ਪਰਮ ਤੰਤ ਮਹਿ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਰੂਪੁ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: param tant meh rekh na roop |6|
English: the supreme essence of reality has no shape or form. ||6||

[Ang 953 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਮਰੈ ਮੰਦਾ ਕਿਉ ਜੀਵੈ ਜੁਗਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: kiau marai mandaa kiau jeevai jugat |
English: How is evil eradicated? How can the true way of life be found?

Gurbani: ਕੰਨ ਪੜਾਇ ਕਿਆ ਖਾਜੈ ਭੁਗਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: kan parraae kiaa khaajai bhugat |
English: What is the use of piercing the ears, or begging for food?

Gurbani: ਆਸਤਿ ਨਾਸਤਿ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aasat naasat eko naau |
English: Throughout existence and non-existence, there is only the Name of the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਅਖਰੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਹਿਆਉ ॥
Transliteration: kaun su akhar jit rahai hiaau |
English: What is that Word, which holds the heart in its place?

Gurbani: ਧੂਪ ਛਾਵ ਜੇ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਸਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: dhoop chhaav je sam kar sahai |
English: When you look alike upon sunshine and shade,

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: taa naanak aakhai gur ko kahai |
English: says Nanak, then the Guru will speak to you.

Gurbani: ਛਿਅ ਵਰਤਾਰੇ ਵਰਤਹਿ ਪੂਤ ॥
Transliteration: chhia varataare varateh poot |
English: The students follow the six systems.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ਨਾ ਅਉਧੂਤ ॥
Transliteration: naa sansaaree naa aaudhoot |
English: They are neither worldly people, nor detached renunciates.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਿ ਜੋ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: nirankaar jo rahai samaae |
English: One who remains absorbed in the Formless Lord

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੇ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਮੰਗਣਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: kaahe bheekhiaa mangan jaae |7|
English: - why should he go out begging? ||7||

[Ang 953 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਸੋਈ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿਥਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: har mandar soee aakheeai jithahu har jaataa |
English: That alone is said to be the Lord's temple, where the Lord is known.

Gurbani: ਮਾਨਸ ਦੇਹ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: maanas deh gur bachanee paaeaa sabh aatam raam pachhaataa |
English: In the human body, the Guru's Word is found, when one understands that the Lord, the Supreme Soul, is in all.

Gurbani: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਖੋਜੀਐ ਘਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: baahar mool na khojeeai ghar maeh bidhaataa |
English: Don't look for Him outside your self. The Creator, the Architect of Destiny, is within the home of your own heart.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਤਿਨੀ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh har mandar kee saar na jaananee tinee janam gavaataa |
English: The self-willed manmukh does not appreciate the value of the Lord's temple; they waste away and lose their lives.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: sabh meh ik varatadaa gurasabadee paaeaa jaaee |12|
English: The One Lord is pervading in all; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He can be found. ||12||

[Ang 953 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਸੁਣੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਕਾ ਕਹਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: moorakh hovai so sunai moorakh kaa kahanaa |
English: Only a fool listens to the words of the fool.

Gurbani: ਮੂਰਖ ਕੇ ਕਿਆ ਲਖਣ ਹੈ ਕਿਆ ਮੂਰਖ ਕਾ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: moorakh ke kiaa lakhan hai kiaa moorakh kaa karanaa |
English: What are the signs of the fool? What does the fool do?

Gurbani: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਓਹੁ ਜਿ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਹੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੇ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: moorakh ohu ji mugadh hai ahankaare maranaa |
English: A fool is stupid; he dies of egotism.

Gurbani: ਏਤੁ ਕਮਾਣੈ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੁਖ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: et kamaanai sadaa dukh dukh hee meh rahanaa |
English: His actions always bring him pain; he lives in pain.

Gurbani: ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਪਵੈ ਖੂਹਿ ਕਿਹੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: at piaaraa pavai khoohi kihu sanjam karanaa |
English: If someone's beloved friend falls into the pit, what can be used to pull him out?

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਓਸੁ ਅਲਿਪਤੋ ਰਹਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh hoe su kare veechaar os alipato rahanaa |
English: One who becomes Gurmukh contemplates the Lord, and remains detached.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਆਪਿ ਉਧਰੈ ਓਸੁ ਪਿਛੈ ਡੁਬਦੇ ਭੀ ਤਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: har naam japai aap udharai os pichhai ddubade bhee taranaa |
English: Chanting the Lord's Name, he saves himself, and he carries across those who are drowning as well.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜੋ ਦੇਇ ਸੁ ਸਹਣਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak jo tis bhaavai so kare jo dee su sahanaa |1|
English: O Nanak, he acts in accordance with the Will of God; he endures whatever he is given. ||1||

[Ang 953 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਸਿਖ ਸਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: naanak aakhai re manaa suneeai sikh sahee |
English: Says Nanak, listen, O mind, to the True Teachings.

Gurbani: ਲੇਖਾ ਰਬੁ ਮੰਗੇਸੀਆ ਬੈਠਾ ਕਢਿ ਵਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: lekhaa rab mangeseea baitthaa kadt vahee |
English: Opening His ledger, God will call you to account.

Gurbani: ਤਲਬਾ ਪਉਸਨਿ ਆਕੀਆ ਬਾਕੀ ਜਿਨਾ ਰਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: talabaa pausan aakeea baakee jinaa rahee |
English: Those rebels who have unpaid accounts shall be called out.

Gurbani: ਅਜਰਾਈਲੁ ਫਰੇਸਤਾ ਹੋਸੀ ਆਇ ਤਈ ॥
Transliteration: ajaraaeel faresataa hosee aae tee |
English: Azraa-eel, the Angel of Death, shall be appointed to punish them.

Gurbani: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਭੀੜੀ ਗਲੀ ਫਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: aavan jaan na sujhee bheerree galee fahee |
English: They will find no way to escape coming and going in reincarnation; they are trapped in the narrow path.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜ ਨਿਖੁਟੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਓੜਕਿ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: koorr nikhutte naanakaa orrak sach rahee |2|
English: Falsehood will come to an end, O Nanak, and Truth will prevail in the end. ||2||

[Ang 953 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਆਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa sabh sareer hai har rav rahiaa sabh aapai |
English: The body and everything belongs to the Lord; the Lord Himself is all-pervading.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: har kee keemat naa pavai kichh kehan na jaapai |
English: The Lord's value cannot be estimated; nothing can be said about it.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਾਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee saalaaheeai har bhagatee raapai |
English: By Guru's Grace, one praises the Lord, imbued with feelings of devotion.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਗਵਾਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: sabh man tan hariaa hoeaa ahankaar gavaapai |
English: The mind and body are totally rejuvenated, and egotism is eradicated.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh har kaa khel hai guramukh kisai bujhaaee |13|
English: Everything is the play of the Lord. The Gurmukh understands this. ||13||

[Ang 953 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਹੰਸਰ ਦਾਨ ਦੇ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੁ ਰੋਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sahansar daan de indru roaaeaa |
English: Branded with a thousand marks of disgrace, Indra cried in shame.

Gurbani: ਪਰਸ ਰਾਮੁ ਰੋਵੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: paras raam rovai ghar aaeaa |
English: Paras Raam returned home crying.

Gurbani: ਅਜੈ ਸੁ ਰੋਵੈ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: ajai su rovai bheekhiaa khaae |
English: Ajai cried and wept, when he was made to eat the manure he had given, pretending it was charity.

Gurbani: ਐਸੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aisee daragah milai sajaae |
English: Such is the punishment received in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਰੋਵੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਨਿਕਾਲਾ ਭਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: rovai raam nikaalaa bheaa |
English: Rama wept when he was sent into exile,

Gurbani: ਸੀਤਾ ਲਖਮਣੁ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: seetaa lakhaman vichhurr geaa |
English: and separated from Sita and Lakhshman.

Gurbani: ਰੋਵੈ ਦਹਸਿਰੁ ਲੰਕ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: rovai dahasir lank gavaae |
English: The ten-headed Raawan, who stole away Sita with the beat of his tambourine,

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੀਤਾ ਆਦੀ ਡਉਰੂ ਵਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jin seetaa aadee ddauroo vaae |
English: Wept when he lost Sri Lanka.

Gurbani: ਰੋਵਹਿ ਪਾਂਡਵ ਭਏ ਮਜੂਰ ॥
Transliteration: roveh paanddav bhe majoor |
English: The Paandavas once lived in the Presence of the Lord;

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਹਤ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jin kai suaamee rehat hadoor |
English: They were made slaves, and wept.

Gurbani: ਰੋਵੈ ਜਨਮੇਜਾ ਖੁਇ ਗਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: rovai janamejaa khue geaa |
English: Janmayjaa wept, that he had lost his way.

Gurbani: ਏਕੀ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਪਾਪੀ ਭਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: ekee kaaran paapee bheaa |
English: One mistake, and he became a sinner.

Gurbani: ਰੋਵਹਿ ਸੇਖ ਮਸਾਇਕ ਪੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: roveh sekh masaaeik peer |
English: The Shaykhs, Pirs and spiritual teachers weep;

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਮਤੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਭੀੜ ॥
Transliteration: ant kaal mat laagai bheerr |
English: at the very last instant, they suffer in agony.

Gurbani: ਰੋਵਹਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਕੰਨ ਪੜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: roveh raaje kan parraae |
English: The kings weep - their ears are cut;

Gurbani: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: ghar ghar maageh bheekhiaa jaae |
English: they go begging from house to house.

Gurbani: ਰੋਵਹਿ ਕਿਰਪਨ ਸੰਚਹਿ ਧਨੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: roveh kirapan sancheh dhan jaae |
English: The miser weeps; he has to leave behind the wealth he has gathered.

Gurbani: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: panddit roveh giaan gavaae |
English: The Pandit, the religious scholar, weeps when his learning is gone.

Gurbani: ਬਾਲੀ ਰੋਵੈ ਨਾਹਿ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: baalee rovai naeh bhataar |
English: The young woman weeps because she has no husband.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak dukheea sabh sansaar |
English: O Nanak, the whole world is suffering.

Gurbani: ਮੰਨੇ ਨਾਉ ਸੋਈ ਜਿਣਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: mane naau soee jin jaae |
English: He alone is victorious, who believes in the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਅਉਰੀ ਕਰਮ ਨ ਲੇਖੈ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aauree karam na lekhai laae |1|
English: No other action is of any account. ||1||

[Ang 954 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 2 |
English: Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਅਵਰਿ ਕਾਰਾ ਸਭਿ ਬਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: jap tap sabh kichh maniai avar kaaraa sabh baad |
English: Meditation, austerity and everything come through belief in the Lord's Name. All other actions are useless.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak maniaa maneeai bujheeai gur parasaad |2|
English: O Nanak, believe in the One who is worth believing in. By Guru's Grace, he is realized. ||2||

[Ang 954 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਹੰਸ ਧੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੁ ਕਰਤੈ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa hans dhur mel karatai likh paaeaa |
English: The union of the body and the soul-swan was pre-ordained by the Creator Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabh meh gupat varatadaa guramukh pragattaaeaa |
English: He is hidden, and yet pervading all. He is revealed to the Gurmukh.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gun gaavai gun ucharai gun maeh samaaeaa |
English: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and chanting His Praises, one merges in His Glories.

Gurbani: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sachee baanee sach hai sach mel milaaeaa |
English: True is the True Word of the Guru's Bani. One unites in Union with the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh aape aap hai aape dee vaddiaaee |14|
English: He Himself is everything; He Himself grants glorious greatness. ||14||

[Ang 954 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 2 |
English: Salok, Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਧਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਰਤਨਾ ਪਰਖਣ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak andhaa hoe kai ratanaa parakhan jaae |
English: O Nanak, the blind man may go to appraise the jewels,

Gurbani: ਰਤਨਾ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਆਵੈ ਆਪੁ ਲਖਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ratanaa saar na jaanee aavai aap lakhaae |1|
English: but he will not know their value; he will return home after exposing his ignorance. ||1||

[Ang 954 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 2 |
English: Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਤਨਾ ਕੇਰੀ ਗੁਥਲੀ ਰਤਨੀ ਖੋਲੀ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: ratanaa keree guthalee ratanee kholee aae |
English: The Jeweller has come, and opened up the bag of jewels.

Gurbani: ਵਖਰ ਤੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਦੁਹਾ ਰਹੀ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: vakhar tai vanajaariaa duhaa rahee samaae |
English: The merchandise and the merchant are merged together.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਣੁ ਪਲੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਮਾਣਕ ਵਣਜਹਿ ਸੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: jin gun palai naanakaa maanak vanajeh see |
English: They alone purchase the gem, O Nanak, who have virtue in their purse.

Gurbani: ਰਤਨਾ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਅੰਧੇ ਵਤਹਿ ਲੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ratanaa saar na jaananee andhe vateh loe |2|
English: Those who do not appreciate the value of the jewels, wander like blind men in the world. ||2||

[Ang 954 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਨਉ ਦਰਵਾਜੇ ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋਟੁ ਹੈ ਦਸਵੈ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਰਖੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: nau daravaaje kaaeaa kott hai dasavai gupat rakheejai |
English: The fortress of the body has nine gates; the tenth gate is kept hidden.

Gurbani: ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਨ ਖੁਲਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਖੁਲੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: bajar kapaatt na khulanee gur sabad khuleejai |
English: The rigid door is not open; only through the Word of the Guru's Shabad can it be opened.

Gurbani: ਅਨਹਦ ਵਾਜੇ ਧੁਨਿ ਵਜਦੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਣੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: anahad vaaje dhun vajade gur sabad suneejai |
English: The unstruck sound current resounds and vibrates there. The Word of the Guru's Shabad is heard.

Gurbani: ਤਿਤੁ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਕਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: tit ghatt antar chaananaa kar bhagat mileejai |
English: Deep within the nucleus of the heart, the Divine Light shines forth. Through devotional worship, one meets the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੇ ਰਚਨ ਰਚਾਈ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: sabh meh ek varatadaa jin aape rachan rachaaee |15|
English: The One Lord is pervading and permeating all. He Himself created the creation. ||15||

[Ang 954 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 2 |
English: Salok, Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅੰਧੇ ਕੈ ਰਾਹਿ ਦਸਿਐ ਅੰਧਾ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: andhe kai raeh dasiai andhaa hoe su jaae |
English: He is truly blind, who follows the way shown by the blind man.

Gurbani: ਹੋਇ ਸੁਜਾਖਾ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਉਝੜਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: hoe sujaakhaa naanakaa so kiau ujharr paae |
English: O Nanak, why should the one who can see, get lost?

Gurbani: ਅੰਧੇ ਏਹਿ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ ਜਿਨ ਮੁਖਿ ਲੋਇਣ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: andhe ehi na aakheean jin mukh loein naeh |
English: Do not call them blind, who have no eyes in their face.

Gurbani: ਅੰਧੇ ਸੇਈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਖਸਮਹੁ ਘੁਥੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: andhe seee naanakaa khasamahu ghuthe jaeh |1|
English: They alone are blind, O Nanak, who wander away from their Lord and Master. ||1||
