[Ang 954 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 2 |
English: Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਾਹਿਬਿ ਅੰਧਾ ਜੋ ਕੀਆ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਜਾਖਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: saahib andhaa jo keea kare sujaakhaa hoe |
English: One whom the Lord has made blind - the Lord can make him see again.

Gurbani: ਜੇਹਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਤੇਹੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਜੇ ਸਉ ਆਖੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jehaa jaanai teho varatai je sau aakhai koe |
English: He acts only as he knows, although he may be spoken to a hundred times.

Gurbani: ਜਿਥੈ ਸੁ ਵਸਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਪਈ ਆਪੇ ਵਰਤਉ ਜਾਣਿ ॥
Transliteration: jithai su vasat na jaapee aape vartau jaan |
English: Where the real thing is not seen, self-conceit prevails there - know this well.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਕਿਉ ਲਏ ਸਕੈ ਨ ਵਸਤੁ ਪਛਾਣਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak gaahak kiau le sakai na vasat pachhaan |2|
English: O Nanak, how can the purshaser purchase the real thing, if he cannot recognize it? ||2||

[Ang 954 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 2 |
English: Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਅੰਧਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿ ਹੁਕਮਹੁ ਅੰਧਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: so kiau andhaa aakheeai ji hukamahu andhaa hoe |
English: How can someone be called blind, if he was made blind by the Lord's Command?

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੁਝਈ ਅੰਧਾ ਕਹੀਐ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak hukam na bujhee andhaa kaheeai soe |3|
English: O Nanak, one who does not understand the Hukam of the Lord's Command should be called blind. ||3||

[Ang 955 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਗੜੁ ਕੋਟੁ ਹੈ ਸਭਿ ਦਿਸੰਤਰ ਦੇਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa andar garr kott hai sabh disantar desaa |
English: Deep within the body is the fortress of the Lord, and all lands and countries.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈਅਨੁ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਪਰਵੇਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape taarree laaeean sabh meh paravesaa |
English: He Himself sits in primal, profound Samaadhi; He Himself is all-pervading.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਆਪਿ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਰਖੇਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape srisatt saajeean aap gupat rakhesaa |
English: He Himself created the Universe, and He Himself remains hidden within it.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਪਰਗਟੀਏਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur sevaa te jaaniaa sach paragatteesaa |
English: Serving the Guru, the Lord is known, and the Truth is revealed.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh sacho sach hai gur sojhee paaee |16|
English: He is True, the Truest of the True; the Guru has imparted this understanding. ||16||

[Ang 955 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਾਵਣੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਅਹਾੜੁ ਦਿਹੁ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਦੁਇ ਖੇਤ ॥
Transliteration: saavan raat ahaarr dihu kaam krodh due khet |
English: Night is the summer season, and day is the winter season; sexual desire and anger are the two fields planted.

Gurbani: ਲਬੁ ਵਤ੍ਰ ਦਰੋਗੁ ਬੀਉ ਹਾਲੀ ਰਾਹਕੁ ਹੇਤ ॥
Transliteration: lab vatr darog beeo haalee raahak het |
English: Greed prepares the soil, and the seed of falsehood is planted; attachment and love are the farmer and hired hand.

Gurbani: ਹਲੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਮਣ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਖਟੇ ਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: hal beechaar vikaar man hukamee khatte khaae |
English: Contemplation is the plow, and corruption is the harvest; this is what one earns and eats, according to the Hukam of the Lord's Command.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਲੇਖੈ ਮੰਗਿਐ ਅਉਤੁ ਜਣੇਦਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak lekhai mangiai aaut janedaa jaae |1|
English: O Nanak, when one is called to give his account, he will be barren and infertile. ||1||

[Ang 955 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਭਉ ਭੁਇ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਬਲੇਦ ॥
Transliteration: bhau bhue pavit paanee sat santokh baled |
English: Make the Fear of God the farm, purity the water, truth and contentment the cows and bulls,

Gurbani: ਹਲੁ ਹਲੇਮੀ ਹਾਲੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਚੇਤਾ ਵਤ੍ਰ ਵਖਤ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: hal halemee haalee chit chetaa vatr vakhat sanjog |
English: humility the plow, consciousness the plowman, remembrance the preparation of the soil, and union with the Lord the planting time.

Gurbani: ਨਾਉ ਬੀਜੁ ਬਖਸੀਸ ਬੋਹਲ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਸਗਲ ਦਰੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: naau beej bakhasees bohal duneea sagal darog |
English: Let the Lord's Name be the seed, and His Forgiving Grace the harvest. Do this, and the whole world will seem false.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਵਿਜੋਗ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak nadaree karam hoe jaaveh sagal vijog |2|
English: O Nanak, if He bestows His Merciful Glance of Grace, then all your separation will be ended. ||2||

[Ang 955 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਬੋਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh mohu gubaar hai doojai bhaae bolai |
English: The self-willed manmukh is trapped in the darkness of emotional attachment; in the love of duality he speaks.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਨਿਤ ਨੀਰੁ ਵਿਰੋਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: doojai bhaae sadaa dukh hai nit neer virolai |
English: The love of duality brings pain forever; he churns the water endlessly.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਮਥਿ ਤਤੁ ਕਢੋਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh naam dhiaaeeai math tat kadtolai |
English: The Gurmukh meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; he churns, and obtains the essence of reality.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਲਧਾ ਟੋਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: antar paragaas ghatt chaananaa har ladhaa ttolai |
English: The Divine Light illuminates his heart deep within; he seeks the Lord, and obtains Him.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਦਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: aape bharam bhulaaeidaa kichh kehan na jaaee |17|
English: He Himself deludes in doubt; no one can comment on this. ||17||

[Ang 955 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Angad Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 2 |
English: Salok, Second Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਹੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak chintaa mat karahu chintaa tis hee hee |
English: O Nanak, don't be anxious; the Lord will take care of you.

Gurbani: ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇਅਨੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਭਿ ਰੋਜੀ ਦੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: jal meh jant upaaeian tinaa bhi rojee dee |
English: He created the creatures in water, and He gives them their nourishment.

Gurbani: ਓਥੈ ਹਟੁ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਕਿਰਸ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: othai hatt na chalee naa ko kiras karee |
English: There are no stores open there, and no one farms there.

Gurbani: ਸਉਦਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਲਏ ਨ ਦੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: saudaa mool na hovee naa ko le na dee |
English: No business is ever transacted there, and no one buys or sells.

Gurbani: ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਆਹਾਰੁ ਜੀਅ ਖਾਣਾ ਏਹੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: jeea kaa aahaar jeea khaanaa ehu karee |
English: Animals eat other animals; this is what the Lord has given them as food.

Gurbani: ਵਿਚਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਸਾਇਰਾ ਤਿਨਾ ਭਿ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: vich upaae saaeiraa tinaa bhi saar karee |
English: He created them in the oceans, and He provides for them as well.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਤ ਕਰਹੁ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਹੇਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak chintaa mat karahu chintaa tis hee hee |1|
English: O Nanak, don't be anxious; the Lord will take care of you. ||1||

[Ang 955 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਝੀਵਰੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak ihu jeeo machhulee jheevar trisanaa kaal |
English: O Nanak, this soul is the fish, and death is the hungry fisherman.

Gurbani: ਮਨੂਆ ਅੰਧੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਈ ਪੜੈ ਅਚਿੰਤਾ ਜਾਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: manooaa andh na chetee parrai achintaa jaal |
English: The blind man does not even think of this. And suddenly, the net is cast.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਿਤੁ ਅਚੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਬਧਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak chit achet hai chintaa badhaa jaae |
English: O Nanak, his consciousness is unconscious, and he departs, bound by anxiety.

Gurbani: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: nadar kare je aapanee taa aape le milaae |2|
English: But if the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, then He unites the soul with Himself. ||2||

[Ang 955 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: se jan saache sadaa sadaa jinee har ras peetaa |
English: They are true, forever true, who drink in the sublime essence of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਉਦਾ ਕੀਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh sachaa man vasai sach saudaa keetaa |
English: The True Lord abides in the mind of the Gurmukh; He strikes the true bargain.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਹੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਲੀਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh ghar hee maeh hai vaddabhaagee leetaa |
English: Everything is in the home of the self within; only the very fortunate obtain it.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਰਿ ਗਈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੀਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: antar trisanaa mar gee har gun gaaveetaa |
English: The hunger within is conquered and overcome, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: aape mel milaaeian aape dee bujhaaee |18|
English: He Himself unites in His Union; He Himself blesses them with understanding. ||18||

[Ang 955 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਵੇਲਿ ਪਿੰਞਾਇਆ ਕਤਿ ਵੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: vel pinyaaeaa kat vunaaeaa |
English: The cotton is ginned, woven and spun;

Gurbani: ਕਟਿ ਕੁਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਖੁੰਬਿ ਚੜਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: katt kutt kar khunb charraaeaa |
English: the cloth is laid out, washed and bleached white.

Gurbani: ਲੋਹਾ ਵਢੇ ਦਰਜੀ ਪਾੜੇ ਸੂਈ ਧਾਗਾ ਸੀਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: lohaa vadte darajee paarre sooee dhaagaa seevai |
English: The tailor cuts it with his scissors, and sews it with his thread.

Gurbani: ਇਉ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਟੀ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਸੀਪੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵਤ ਜੀਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: eiau pat paattee sifatee seepai naanak jeevat jeevai |
English: Thus, the torn and tattered honor is sewn up again, through the Lord's Praise, O Nanak, and one lives the true life.

Gurbani: ਹੋਇ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ ਕਪੜੁ ਪਾਟੈ ਸੂਈ ਧਾਗਾ ਗੰਢੈ ॥
Transliteration: hoe puraanaa kaparr paattai sooee dhaagaa gandtai |
English: Becoming worn, the cloth is torn; with needle and thread it is sewn up again.

Gurbani: ਮਾਹੁ ਪਖੁ ਕਿਹੁ ਚਲੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਘੜੀ ਮੁਹਤੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੰਢੈ ॥
Transliteration: maahu pakh kihu chalai naahee gharree muhat kichh handtai |
English: It will not last for a month, or even a week. It barely lasts for an hour, or even a moment.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੀਤਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਪਾਟੈ ॥
Transliteration: sach puraanaa hovai naahee seetaa kade na paattai |
English: But the Truth does not grow old; and when it is stitched, it is never torn again.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੋ ਸਚਾ ਤਿਚਰੁ ਜਾਪੀ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak saahib sacho sachaa tichar jaapee jaapai |1|
English: O Nanak, the Lord and Master is the Truest of the True. While we meditate on Him, we see Him. ||1||

[Ang 956 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਚ ਕੀ ਕਾਤੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sach kee kaatee sach sabh saar |
English: The knife is Truth, and its steel is totally True.

Gurbani: ਘਾੜਤ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: ghaarrat tis kee apar apaar |
English: Its workmanship is incomparably beautiful.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੇ ਸਾਣ ਰਖਾਈ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sabade saan rakhaaee laae |
English: It is sharpened on the grindstone of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਕੀ ਥੇਕੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gun kee thekai vich samaae |
English: It is placed in the scabbard of virtue.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਕੁਠਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੇਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: tis daa kutthaa hovai sekh |
English: If the Shaykh is killed with that,

Gurbani: ਲੋਹੂ ਲਬੁ ਨਿਕਥਾ ਵੇਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: lohoo lab nikathaa vekh |
English: then the blood of greed will spill out.

Gurbani: ਹੋਇ ਹਲਾਲੁ ਲਗੈ ਹਕਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: hoe halaal lagai hak jaae |
English: One who is slaughtered in this ritualistic way, will be attached to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਿ ਦੀਦਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak dar deedaar samaae |2|
English: O Nanak, at the Lord's door, he is absorbed into His Blessed Vision. ||2||

[Ang 956 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਮਰਿ ਕਟਾਰਾ ਬੰਕੁੜਾ ਬੰਕੇ ਕਾ ਅਸਵਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: kamar kattaaraa bankurraa banke kaa asavaar |
English: A beautiful dagger hangs by your waist, and you ride such a beautiful horse.

Gurbani: ਗਰਬੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਮਤੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਭਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: garab na keejai naanakaa mat sir aavai bhaar |3|
English: But don't be too proud; O Nanak, you may fall head first to the ground. ||3||

[Ang 956 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: so satasangat sabad milai jo guramukh chalai |
English: They alone walk as Gurmukh, who receive the Shabad in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਸੇ ਸਚੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਖਰਚੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: sach dhiaaein se sache jin har kharach dhan palai |
English: Meditating on the True Lord, they become truthful; they carry in their robes the supplies of the Lord's wealth.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਦੇ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਅਚਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat sohan gun gaavade guramat achalai |
English: The devotees look beautiful, singing the Praises of the Lord; following the Guru's Teachings, they become stable and unchanging.

Gurbani: ਰਤਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਭਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: ratan beechaar man vasiaa gur kai sabad bhalai |
English: They enshrine the jewel of contemplation within their minds, and the most sublime Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: aape mel milaaeidaa aape dee vaddiaaee |19|
English: He Himself unites in His Union; He Himself grants glorious greatness. ||19||

[Ang 956 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 3 |
English: Salok, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਕੋਇ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa andar sabh ko koe niraasaa hoe |
English: Everyone is filled with hope; hardly anyone is free of hope.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਸਹਿਲਾ ਆਇਆ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak jo mar jeeviaa sahilaa aaeaa soe |1|
English: O Nanak, blessed is the birth of one, who remains dead while yet alive. ||1||

[Ang 956 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 3 |
English: Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਸਾ ਹਥਿ ਹੈ ਕੇਉ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: naa kichh aasaa hath hai keo niraasaa hoe |
English: Nothing is in the hands of hope. How can one become free of hope?

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਏਹ ਬਪੁੜੀ ਜਾਂ ਭੋੁਲਾਏ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kiaa kare eeh bapurree jaan bhuolaae soe |2|
English: What can this poor being do? The Lord Himself creates confusion. ||2||

[Ang 956 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: dhrig jeevan sansaar sache naam bin |
English: Cursed is the life in this world, without the True Name.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਤਾਰ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਏਹੁ ਧਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: prabh daataa daataar nihachal ehu dhan |
English: God is the Great Giver of givers. His wealth is permanent and unchanging.

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸੋਇ ਜਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: saas saas aaraadhe niramal soe jan |
English: That humble being is immaculate, who worships the Lord with each and every breath.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਅਗਮੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਏਕੁ ਭਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: antarajaamee agam rasanaa ek bhan |
English: With your tongue, vibrate the One Inaccessible Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

Gurbani: ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: rav rahiaa sarabat naanak bal jaaee |20|
English: He is all-pervading everywhere. Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||20||

[Ang 956 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 |
English: Salok, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਰਵਰ ਹੰਸ ਧੁਰੇ ਹੀ ਮੇਲਾ ਖਸਮੈ ਏਵੈ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: saravar hans dhure hee melaa khasamai evai bhaanaa |
English: The union between the lake of the True Guru, and the swan of the soul, was pre-ordained from the very beginning, by the Pleasure of the Lord's Will.

Gurbani: ਸਰਵਰ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹੀਰਾ ਮੋਤੀ ਸੋ ਹੰਸਾ ਕਾ ਖਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: saravar andar heeraa motee so hansaa kaa khaanaa |
English: The diamonds are in this lake; they are the food of the swans.

Gurbani: ਬਗੁਲਾ ਕਾਗੁ ਨ ਰਹਈ ਸਰਵਰਿ ਜੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਤਿ ਸਿਆਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: bagulaa kaag na rahee saravar je hovai at siaanaa |
English: The cranes and the ravens may be very wise, but they do not remain in this lake.

Gurbani: ਓਨਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਨ ਪਇਓ ਓਥੈ ਓਨੑਾ ਹੋਰੋ ਖਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: onaa rijak na peo othai onaa horo khaanaa |
English: They do not find their food there; their food is different.

Gurbani: ਸਚਿ ਕਮਾਣੈ ਸਚੋ ਪਾਈਐ ਕੂੜੈ ਕੂੜਾ ਮਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: sach kamaanai sacho paaeeai koorrai koorraa maanaa |
English: Practicing Truth, the True Lord is found. False is the pride of the false.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੌ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਿਨਾ ਧੁਰੇ ਪੈਯਾ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak tin kau satigur miliaa jinaa dhure paiyaa paravaanaa |1|
English: O Nanak, they alone meet the True Guru, who are so pre-destined by the Lord's Command. ||1||

[Ang 956 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 1 |
English: First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਉਜਲਾ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: saahib meraa ujalaa je ko chit karee |
English: My Lord and Master is immaculate, as are those who think of Him.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਈ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜੋ ਦੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak soee seveeai sadaa sadaa jo dee |
English: O Nanak, serve Him, who gives to you forever and ever.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਈ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak soee seveeai jit seviai dukh jaae |
English: O Nanak, serve Him; by serving Him, sorrow is dispelled.

Gurbani: ਅਵਗੁਣ ਵੰਞਨਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸੈ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: avagun vanyan gun raveh man sukh vasai aae |2|
English: Faults and demerits vanish, and virtues take their place; peace comes to dwell in the mind. ||2||

[Ang 956 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਆਪਿ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈਅਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape aap varatadaa aap taarree laaeean |
English: He Himself is all-pervading; He Himself is absorbed in the profound state of Samaadhi.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਉਪਦੇਸਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਤੀਆਈਅਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape hee upadesadaa guramukh pateeaeean |
English: He Himself instructs; the Gurmukh is satisfied and fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਆਪੇ ਉਝੜਿ ਪਾਇਅਨੁ ਇਕਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਇਅਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: eik aape ujharr paaeian ik bhagatee laaeian |
English: Some, He causes to wander in the wilderness, while others are committed to His devotional worship.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋ ਬੁਝਸੀ ਆਪੇ ਨਾਇ ਲਾਈਅਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: jis aap bujhaae so bujhasee aape naae laaeean |
English: He alone understands, whom the Lord causes to understand; He Himself attaches mortals to His Name.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨੧॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak naam dhiaaeeai sachee vaddiaaee |21|1| sudh |
English: O Nanak, meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, true greatness is obtained. ||21||1|| Sudh||

[Ang 957 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee kee vaar mahalaa 5 |
English: Vaar Of Raamkalee, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੈਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੁਣੀਦਾ ਤੈਸੋ ਹੀ ਮੈ ਡੀਠੁ ॥
Transliteration: jaisaa satigur suneedaa taiso hee mai ddeetth |
English: As I have heard of the True Guru, so I have seen Him.

Gurbani: ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਮੇਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਕਾ ਬਸੀਠੁ ॥
Transliteration: vichhurriaa mele prabhoo har daragah kaa baseetth |
English: He re-unites the separated ones with God; He is the Mediator at the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਦਾ ਕਟੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: har naamo mantru drirraaeidaa katte haumai rog |
English: He implants the Mantra of the Lord's Name, and eradicates the illness of egotism.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਾ ਧੁਰੇ ਪਇਆ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak satigur tinaa milaaeaa jinaa dhure peaa sanjog |1|
English: O Nanak, he alone meets the True Guru, who has such union pre-ordained. ||1||

[Ang 957 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਇਕੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਸਭਿ ਸਜਣਾ ਇਕੁ ਵੈਰੀ ਸਭਿ ਵਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: eik sajan sabh sajanaa ik vairee sabh vaad |
English: If the One Lord is my Friend, then all are my friends. If the One Lord is my enemy, then all fight with me.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੇਖਾਲਿਆ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਬਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: gur poorai dekhaaliaa vin naavai sabh baad |
English: The Perfect Guru has shown me that, without the Name, everything is useless.

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤ ਦੁਰਜਨ ਭਰਮਿਆ ਜੋ ਲਗੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: saakat durajan bharamiaa jo lage doojai saad |
English: The faithless cynics and the evil people wander in reincarnation; they are attached to other tastes.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jan naanak har prabh bujhiaa gur satigur kai parasaad |2|
English: Servant Nanak has realized the Lord God, by the Grace of the Guru, the True Guru. ||2||

[Ang 957 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਥਟਣਹਾਰੈ ਥਾਟੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਥਟਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: thattanahaarai thaatt aape hee thattiaa |
English: The Creator Lord created the Creation.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਖਟਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: aape pooraa saahu aape hee khattiaa |
English: He Himself is the perfect Banker; He Himself earns His profit.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਸਾਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਰੰਗ ਰਟਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: aape kar paasaar aape rang rattiaa |
English: He Himself made the expansive Universe; He Himself is imbued with joy.

Gurbani: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਇ ਅਲਖ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਟਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: kudarat keem na paae alakh brahamattiaa |
English: The value of God's almighty creative power cannot be estimated.

Gurbani: ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਪਰੈ ਪਰਟਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: agam athaah beant parai parattiaa |
English: He is inaccessible, unfathomable, endless, the farthest of the far.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਵਡ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਵਜੀਰਟਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: aape vadd paatisaahu aap vajeerattiaa |
English: He Himself is the greatest Emperor; He Himself is His own Prime Minister.

Gurbani: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੀਮ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਮਟਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: koe na jaanai keem kevadd mattiaa |
English: No one knows His worth, or the greatness of His resting place.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਆਪਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਟਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sachaa saahib aap guramukh paragattiaa |1|
English: He Himself is our True Lord and Master. He reveals Himself to the Gurmukh. ||1||

[Ang 957 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਜਣ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਿਖਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: sun sajan preetam meriaa mai satigur dehu dikhaal |
English: Listen, O my beloved friend: please show me the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਵਾ ਮਨੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਿਤ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਖਾ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: hau tis devaa man aapanaa nit hiradai rakhaa samaal |
English: I dedicate my mind to Him; I keep Him continually enshrined within my heart.

Gurbani: ਇਕਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: eikas satigur baaharaa dhrig jeevan sansaar |
English: Without the One and Only True Guru, life in this world is cursed.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਮਿਲਾਇਓਨੁ ਜਿਨ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਵਰਤੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak satigur tinaa milaaeon jin sad hee varatai naal |1|
English: O servant Nanak, they alone meet the True Guru, with whom He constantly abides. ||1||

[Ang 957 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਚਾ ਮਿਲਣ ਕੀ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੋਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: merai antar lochaa milan kee kiau paavaa prabh tohi |
English: Deep within me is the longing to meet You; how can I find You, God?

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਐਸਾ ਸਜਣੁ ਲੋੜਿ ਲਹੁ ਜੋ ਮੇਲੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮੋਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: koee aisaa sajan lorr lahu jo mele preetam mohi |
English: I will search for someone, some friend, who will unite me with my Beloved.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਮੇਲਾਇਆ ਜਤ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਤ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur poorai melaaeaa jat dekhaa tat soe |
English: The Perfect Guru has united me with Him; wherever I look, there He is.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jan naanak so prabh seviaa tis jevadd avar na koe |2|
English: Servant Nanak serves that God; there is no other as great as He is. ||2||

[Ang 957 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: devanahaar daataar kit mukh saalaaheeai |
English: He is the Great Giver, the Generous Lord; with what mouth can I praise Him?

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਰਖੈ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਮਾਹੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: jis rakhai kirapaa dhaar rijak samaaheeai |
English: In His Mercy, He protects, preserves and sustains us.

Gurbani: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਵਸਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਇਕ ਧਰ ॥
Transliteration: koe na kis hee vas sabhanaa ik dhar |
English: No one is under anyone else's control; He is the One Support of all.

Gurbani: ਪਾਲੇ ਬਾਲਕ ਵਾਗਿ ਦੇ ਕੈ ਆਪਿ ਕਰ ॥
Transliteration: paale baalak vaag de kai aap kar |
English: He cherishes all as His children, and reaches out with His hand.

Gurbani: ਕਰਦਾ ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: karadaa anad binod kichhoo na jaaneeai |
English: He stages His joyous plays, which no one understands at all.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਧਾਰ ਸਮਰਥ ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: sarab dhaar samarath hau tis kurabaaneeai |
English: The all-powerful Lord gives His Support to all; I am a sacrifice to Him.

Gurbani: ਗਾਈਐ ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਨੰਤੁ ਗਾਵਣ ਜੋਗਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: gaaeeai raat dinant gaavan jogiaa |
English: Night and day, sing the Praises of the One who is worthy of being praised.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਹਿ ਤਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਭੋਗਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jo gur kee pairee paeh tinee har ras bhogiaa |2|
English: Those who fall at the Guru's Feet, enjoy the sublime essence of the Lord. ||2||

[Ang 957 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਭੀੜਹੁ ਮੋਕਲਾਈ ਕੀਤੀਅਨੁ ਸਭ ਰਖੇ ਕੁਟੰਬੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: bheerrahu mokalaaee keeteean sabh rakhe kuttanbai naal |
English: He has widened the narrow path for me, and preserved my integrity, along with that of my family.

Gurbani: ਕਾਰਜ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਅਨੁ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਦਾ ਸਭਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: kaaraj aap savaarian so prabh sadaa sabhaal |
English: He Himself has arranged and resolved my affairs. I dwell upon that God forever.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇਦਾ ਲਹੁੜੇ ਬਾਲਕ ਪਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: prabh maat pitaa kantth laaeidaa lahurre baalak paal |
English: God is my mother and father; He hugs me close in His embrace, and cherishes me, like His tiny baby.

Gurbani: ਦਇਆਲ ਹੋਏ ਸਭ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: deaal hoe sabh jeea jantr har naanak nadar nihaal |1|
English: All beings and creatures have become kind and compassionate to me. O Nanak, the Lord has blessed me with His Glance of Grace. ||1||

[Ang 958 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਜਿ ਮੰਗਣਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਦੁਖਾ ਕੈ ਦੁਖ ॥
Transliteration: vin tudh hor ji manganaa sir dukhaa kai dukh |
English: To ask for any other than You, Lord, is the most miserable of miseries.

Gurbani: ਦੇਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ ਉਤਰੈ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਭੁਖ ॥
Transliteration: dehi naam santokheea utarai man kee bhukh |
English: Please bless me with Your Name, and make me content; may the hunger of my mind be satisfied.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਵਣੁ ਤਿਣੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਕੀਤਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਆ ਮਨੁਖ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur van tin hariaa keetiaa naanak kiaa manukh |2|
English: The Guru has made the woods and meadows green again. O Nanak, is it any wonder that He blesses human beings as well? ||2||

[Ang 958 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਐਸਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: so aisaa daataar manahu na veesarai |
English: Such is that Great Giver; may I never forget Him from my mind.

Gurbani: ਘੜੀ ਨ ਮੁਹਤੁ ਚਸਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾ ਸਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: gharree na muhat chasaa tis bin naa sarai |
English: I cannot survive without Him, for an instant, for a moment, for a second.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਲੁਕਿ ਕਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: antar baahar sang kiaa ko luk karai |
English: Inwardly and outwardly, He is with us; how can we hide anything from Him?

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਤਿ ਰਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਸੋ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: jis pat rakhai aap so bhavajal tarai |
English: One whose honor He Himself has preserved, crosses over the terrifying world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਤਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat giaanee tapaa jis kirapaa karai |
English: He alone is a devotee, a spiritual teacher, and a disciplined pratictioner of meditation, whom the Lord has so blessed.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਲੁ ਧਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: so pooraa paradhaan jis no bal dharai |
English: He alone is perfect and renowned as supreme, whom the Lord has blessed with His power.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਜਰਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਸੋਈ ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: jiseh jaraae aap soee ajar jarai |
English: He alone endures the unendurable, whom the Lord inspires to endure it.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਨਿ ਧਰੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tis hee miliaa sach mantru gur man dharai |3|
English: And he alone meets the True Lord, within whose mind the Guru's Mantra is implanted. ||3||

[Ang 958 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਰਾਗ ਸੁਰੰਗੜੇ ਆਲਾਪਤ ਸਭ ਤਿਖ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: dhan su raag surangarre aalaapat sabh tikh jaae |
English: Blessed are those beautiful Ragas which, when chanted, quench all thirst.

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਜੰਤ ਸੁਹਾਵੜੇ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਪਦੇ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dhan su jant suhaavarre jo guramukh japade naau |
English: Blessed are those beautiful people who, as Gurmukh, chant the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jinee ik man ik araadhiaa tin sad balihaarai jaau |
English: I am a sacrifice to those who single-mindedly worship and adore the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਧੂੜਿ ਹਮ ਬਾਛਦੇ ਕਰਮੀ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: tin kee dhoorr ham baachhade karamee palai paae |
English: I yearn for the dust of their feet; by His Grace, it is obtained.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਗੋਵਿਦ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo rate rang govid kai hau tin balihaarai jaau |
English: I am a sacrifice to those who are imbued with love for the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਆਖਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਰਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aakhaa birathaa jeea kee har sajan melahu raae |
English: I tell them the state of my soul, and pray that I may be united with the Sovereign Lord King, my Friend.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਮੇਲਾਇਆ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur poorai melaaeaa janam maran dukh jaae |
English: The Perfect Guru has united me with Him, and the pains of birth and death have departed.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਗਮ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak paaeaa agam roop anat na kaahoo jaae |1|
English: Servant Nanak has found the inaccessible, infinitely beautiful Lord, and he will not go anywhere else. ||1||

[Ang 958 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਘੜੀ ਧੰਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਮੂਰਤੁ ਪਲੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: dhan su velaa gharree dhan dhan moorat pal saar |
English: Blessed is that time, blessed is that hour, blessed is that second, excellent is that instant;

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਸੰਜੋਗੜਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਡਿਠਾ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: dhan su dinas sanjogarraa jit dditthaa gur darasaar |
English: blessed is that day, and that opportunity, when I gazed upon the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕੀਆ ਇਛਾ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: man keea ichhaa pooreea har paaeaa agam apaar |
English: The mind's desires are fulfilled, when the inaccessible, unfathomable Lord is obtained.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਤੁਟਾ ਮੋਹੜਾ ਇਕੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: haumai tuttaa moharraa ik sach naam aadhaar |
English: Egotism and emotional attachment are eradicated, and one leans only on the Support of the True Name.

Gurbani: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਲਗਾ ਸੇਵ ਹਰਿ ਉਧਰਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jan naanak lagaa sev har udhariaa sagal sansaar |2|
English: O servant Nanak, one who is committed to the Lord's service - the whole world is saved along with him. ||2||

[Ang 958 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਲਾਹਣੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਦਿਤੀਅਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: sifat salaahan bhagat virale diteean |
English: How rare are those who are blessed to praise the Lord, in devotional worship.

Gurbani: ਸਉਪੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਫਿਰਿ ਪੁਛ ਨ ਲੀਤੀਅਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: saupe jis bhanddaar fir puchh na leeteean |
English: Those who are blessed with the Lord's treasures are not called to give their account again.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਗਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਸੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jis no lagaa rang se rang ratiaa |
English: Those who are imbued with His Love are absorbed in ecstasy.

Gurbani: ਓਨਾ ਇਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਇਕਾ ਉਨ ਭਤਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: onaa iko naam adhaar ikaa un bhatiaa |
English: They take the Support of the One Name; the One Name is their only food.

Gurbani: ਓਨਾ ਪਿਛੈ ਜਗੁ ਭੁੰਚੈ ਭੋਗਈ ॥
Transliteration: onaa pichhai jag bhunchai bhogee |
English: For their sake, the world eats and enjoys.

Gurbani: ਓਨਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਰਬੁ ਓਨਾਹਾ ਜੋਗਈ ॥
Transliteration: onaa piaaraa rab onaahaa jogee |
English: Their Beloved Lord belongs to them alone.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਇ ਤਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jis miliaa gur aae tin prabh jaaniaa |
English: The Guru comes and meets them; they alone know God.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਜਿ ਖਸਮੈ ਭਾਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: hau balihaaree tin ji khasamai bhaaniaa |4|
English: I am a sacrifice to those who are pleasing to their Lord and Master. ||4||

[Ang 958 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਇਕਸੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਮੈ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਇਕਸੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਮੈ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: har ikasai naal mai dosatee har ikasai naal mai rang |
English: My friendship is with the One Lord alone; I am in love with the One Lord alone.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਜਣੋ ਹਰਿ ਇਕਸੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਮੈ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: har iko meraa sajano har ikasai naal mai sang |
English: The Lord is my only friend; my companionship is with the One Lord alone.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਇਕਸੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਮੈ ਗੋਸਟੇ ਮੁਹੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਕਰੈ ਨ ਭੰਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: har ikasai naal mai gosatte muhu mailaa karai na bhang |
English: My conversation is with the One Lord alone; He never frowns, or turns His face away.

Gurbani: ਜਾਣੈ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਮੋੜੈ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: jaanai birathaa jeea kee kade na morrai rang |
English: He alone knows the state of my soul; He never ignores my love.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਸਲਤੀ ਭੰਨਣ ਘੜਨ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥
Transliteration: har iko meraa masalatee bhanan gharran samarath |
English: He is my only counselor, all-powerful to destroy and create.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਦਾਤਿਆ ਜਗ ਹਥੁ ॥
Transliteration: har iko meraa daataar hai sir daatiaa jag hath |
English: The Lord is my only Giver. He places His hand upon the heads of the generous in the world.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਇਕਸੈ ਦੀ ਮੈ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥
Transliteration: har ikasai dee mai ttek hai jo sir sabhanaa samarath |
English: I take the Support of the One Lord alone; He is all-powerful, over the heads of all.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੰਤੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਰਿ ਕੈ ਹਥੁ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sant milaaeaa masatak dhar kai hath |
English: The Saint, the True Guru, has united me with the Lord. He placed His hand on my forehead.

Gurbani: ਵਡਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਤਾਰਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਜਗਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: vaddaa saahib guroo milaaeaa jin taariaa sagal jagat |
English: The Guru led me to meet the greatest Lord and Master; He saved the whole world.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਕੀਆ ਇਛਾ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: man keea ichhaa pooreea paaeaa dhur sanjog |
English: The desires of the mind are fulfilled; I have attained my pre-destined Union with God.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਭੋਗੇ ਭੋਗ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak paaeaa sach naam sad hee bhoge bhog |1|
English: Nanak has obtained the True Name; He enjoys the enjoyments forever. ||1||

[Ang 959 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਕੇਰੀ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਸਨਬੰਧੁ ॥
Transliteration: manamukhaa keree dosatee maaeaa kaa sanabandh |
English: Friendship with the self-willed manmukhs is an alliance with Maya.

Gurbani: ਵੇਖਦਿਆ ਹੀ ਭਜਿ ਜਾਨਿ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਬੰਧੁ ॥
Transliteration: vekhadiaa hee bhaj jaan kade na paaein bandh |
English: As we watch, they run away; they never stand firm.

Gurbani: ਜਿਚਰੁ ਪੈਨਨਿ ਖਾਵਨੑੇ ਤਿਚਰੁ ਰਖਨਿ ਗੰਢੁ ॥
Transliteration: jichar painan khaavanae tichar rakhan gandt |
English: As long as they get food and clothing, they stick around.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਦਿਨਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਤਿਤੁ ਦਿਨਿ ਬੋਲਨਿ ਗੰਧੁ ॥
Transliteration: jit din kichh na hovee tith din bolan gandh |
English: But on that day when they receive nothing, then they start to curse.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧੁ ॥
Transliteration: jeea kee saar na jaananee manamukh agiaanee andh |
English: The self-willed manmukhs are ignorant and blind; they do not know the secrets of the soul.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜਾ ਗੰਢੁ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਚਿਕੜਿ ਪਥਰ ਬੰਧੁ ॥
Transliteration: koorraa gandt na chalee chikarr pathar bandh |
English: The false bond does not last; it is like stones joined with mud.

Gurbani: ਅੰਧੇ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਫਕੜੁ ਪਿਟਨਿ ਧੰਧੁ ॥
Transliteration: andhe aap na jaananee fakarr pittan dhandh |
English: The blind do not understand themselves; they are engrossed in false worldly entanglements.

Gurbani: ਝੂਠੈ ਮੋਹਿ ਲਪਟਾਇਆ ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਹੰਧੁ ॥
Transliteration: jhootthai mohi lapattaaeaa hau hau karat bihandh |
English: Entangled in false attachments, they pass their lives in egotism and self-conceit.

Gurbani: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਧੁਰਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: kripaa kare jis aapanee dhur pooraa karam karee |
English: But that being, whom the Lord has blessed with His Mercy from the very beginning, does perfect deeds, and accumulates good karma.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਉਬਰੇ ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jan naanak se jan ubare jo satigur saran pare |2|
English: O servant Nanak, those humble beings alone are saved, who enter the Sanctuary of the True Guru. ||2||

[Ang 959 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਦੀਦਾਰ ਸੇਈ ਸਚੁ ਹਾਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: jo rate deedaar seee sach haak |
English: Those who are imbued with the Lord's Vision, speak the Truth.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਜਾਤਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਕਿਉ ਲਭੈ ਤਿਨਾ ਖਾਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: jinee jaataa khasam kiau labhai tinaa khaak |
English: How can I obtain the dust of those who realize their Lord and Master?

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਵੇਕਾਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: man mailaa vekaar hovai sang paak |
English: The mind, stained by corruption, becomes pure by associating with them.

Gurbani: ਦਿਸੈ ਸਚਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਖੁਲੈ ਭਰਮ ਤਾਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: disai sachaa mehal khulai bharam taak |
English: One sees the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, when the door of doubt is opened.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਲੇ ਮਹਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਧਾਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: jiseh dikhaale mehal tis na milai dhaak |
English: That one, unto whom the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is revealed, is never pushed or shoved.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਬਿੰਦਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਝਾਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: man tan hoe nihaal bindak nadar jhaak |
English: My mind and body are enraptured, when the Lord blesses me, even for an instant, with His Glance of Grace.

Gurbani: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਾਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: nau nidh naam nidhaan gur kai sabad laag |
English: The nine treasures, and the treasure of the Naam are obtained by commitment to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੈ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੰਤ ਖਾਕੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਜਿਸੈ ਭਾਗੁ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: tisai milai sant khaak masatak jisai bhaag |5|
English: He alone is blessed with the dust of the feet of the Saints, upon whose forehead such pre-ordained desiny is inscribed. ||5||

[Ang 959 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਣਾਖੀ ਕੂ ਸਚੁ ਵੈਣੁ ਸੁਣਾਈ ਜੋ ਤਉ ਕਰੇ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: haranaakhee koo sach vain sunaaee jo tau kare udhaaran |
English: O deer-eyed bride, I speak the Truth, which shall save you.

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਬਚਨ ਤੁਮ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਛਬੀਲੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਤੈਡਾ ਮਨ ਸਾਧਾਰਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: sundar bachan tum sunahu chhabeelee pir taiddaa man saadhaaran |
English: Listen to these beautiful words, O beauteous bride; your Beloved Lord is your mind's only support.

Gurbani: ਦੁਰਜਨ ਸੇਤੀ ਨੇਹੁ ਰਚਾਇਓ ਦਸਿ ਵਿਖਾ ਮੈ ਕਾਰਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: durajan setee nehu rachaaeo das vikhaa mai kaaran |
English: You have fallen in love with an evil person; tell me - show me why!

Gurbani: ਊਣੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਝੂਣੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਵਿਹੂਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: aoonee naahee jhoonee naahee naahee kisai vihoonee |
English: I lack nothing, and I am not sad or depressed; I have no deficiency at all.

Gurbani: ਪਿਰੁ ਛੈਲੁ ਛਬੀਲਾ ਛਡਿ ਗਵਾਇਓ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਰਮਿ ਵਿਹੂਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: pir chhail chhabeelaa chhadd gavaaeo duramat karam vihoonee |
English: I abandoned and lost my fascinating and beautiful Husband Lord; in this evil-mindedness, I have lost my good fortune.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਹਉ ਭੁਲੀ ਨਾ ਹਉ ਚੁਕੀ ਨਾ ਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੋਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: naa hau bhulee naa hau chukee naa mai naahee dosaa |
English: I am not mistaken, and I am not confused; I have no egotism, and commit no offense.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਹਉ ਲਾਈ ਤਿਤੁ ਹਉ ਲਗੀ ਤੂ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਦੇਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: jit hau laaee tith hau lagee too sun sach sandesaa |
English: As You have linked me, so I am linked; listen to my true message.

Gurbani: ਸਾਈ ਸੋੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਾਈ ਭਾਗਣਿ ਜੈ ਪਿਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: saaee suohaagan saaee bhaagan jai pir kirapaa dhaaree |
English: She alone is the blessed soul-bride, and she alone is fortunate, upon whom the Husband Lord has showered His Mercy.

Gurbani: ਪਿਰਿ ਅਉਗਣ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਗਵਾਏ ਗਲ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਾਇ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: pir aaugan tis ke sabh gavaae gal setee laae savaaree |
English: Her Husband Lord takes away all her faults and mistakes; hugging her close in His embrace, He embellishes her.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮਹੀਣ ਧਨ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਕਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਵੈ ਵਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: karamaheen dhan karai binantee kad naanak aavai vaaree |
English: The unfortunate soul-bride makes this prayer: O Nanak, when will my turn come?

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਮਾਣਹਿ ਰਲੀਆ ਇਕ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sabh suhaagan maaneh raleea ik devahu raat muraaree |1|
English: All the blessed soul-brides celebrate and make merry; bless me as well with a night of bliss, O Lord. ||1||

[Ang 959 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੇ ਮਨ ਤੂ ਡੋਲਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: kaahe man too ddolataa har manasaa pooranahaar |
English: Why do you waver, O my mind? The Lord is the Fulfiller of hopes and desires.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖ ਵਿਸਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: satigur purakh dhiaae too sabh dukh visaaranahaar |
English: Meditate on the True Guru, the Primal Being; He is the Destroyer of all pains.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਆਰਾਧਿ ਮਨ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਜਾਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: har naamaa aaraadh man sabh kilavikh jaeh vikaar |
English: Worship and adore the Lord's Name, O my mind; all sins and corruption shall be washed away.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਗਾ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: jin kau poorab likhiaa tin rang lagaa nirankaar |
English: Those who are blessed with such pre-ordained destiny, are in love with the Formless Lord.

Gurbani: ਓਨੀ ਛਡਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੁਆਵੜਾ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: onee chhaddiaa maaeaa suaavarraa dhan sanchiaa naam apaar |
English: They abandon the tastes of Maya, and gather in the infinite wealth of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਅਠੇ ਪਹਰ ਇਕਤੈ ਲਿਵੈ ਮੰਨੇਨਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: atthe pehar ikatai livai manen hukam apaar |
English: Twenty-four hours a day, they are lovingly absorbed in the One Lord; they surrender and accept the Will of the Infinite Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਕੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jan naanak mangai daan ik dehu daras man piaar |2|
English: Servant Nanak begs for this one gift: please bless me, Lord, with the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; my mind is in love with You. ||2||

[Ang 960 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖ ॥
Transliteration: jis too aaveh chit tis no sadaa sukh |
English: One who is conscious of You finds everlasting peace.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਮ ਨਾਹਿ ਦੁਖ ॥
Transliteration: jis too aaveh chit tis jam naeh dukh |
English: One who is conscious of You does not suffer at the hands of the Messenger of Death.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਿ ਕਾੜਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jis too aaveh chit tis ki kaarriaa |
English: One who is conscious of You is not anxious.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jis daa karataa mitru sabh kaaj savaariaa |
English: One who has the Creator as his Friend - all his affairs are resolved.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਜਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: jis too aaveh chit so paravaan jan |
English: One who is conscious of You is renowned and respected.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਧਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: jis too aaveh chit bahutaa tis dhan |
English: One who is conscious of You becomes very wealthy.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਸੋ ਵਡ ਪਰਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jis too aaveh chit so vadd paravaariaa |
English: One who is conscious of You has a great family.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰਿਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: jis too aaveh chit tin kul udhaariaa |6|
English: One who is conscious of You saves his ancestors. ||6||

[Ang 960 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਅੰਨਾ ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਅੰਨਾ ਕੂੜੀ ਕੂੜੀ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: andarahu anaa baaharahu anaa koorree koorree gaavai |
English: Blind inwardly, and blind outwardly, he sings falsely, falsely.

Gurbani: ਦੇਹੀ ਧੋਵੈ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਬਣਾਏ ਮਾਇਆ ਨੋ ਬਹੁ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: dehee dhovai chakr banaae maaeaa no bahu dhaavai |
English: He washes his body, and draws ritual marks on it, and totally runs after wealth.

Gurbani: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: andar mail na utarai haumai fir fir aavai jaavai |
English: But the filth of his egotism is not removed from within, and over and over again, he comes and goes in reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਨੀਂਦ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਕਾਮਿ ਸੰਤਾਪਿਆ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: neend viaapiaa kaam santaapiaa mukhahu har har kahaavai |
English: Engulfed in sleep, and tormented by frustrated sexual desire, he chants the Lord's Name with his mouth.

Gurbani: ਬੈਸਨੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਮ ਹਉ ਜੁਗਤਾ ਤੁਹ ਕੁਟੇ ਕਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: baisano naam karam hau jugataa tuh kutte kiaa fal paavai |
English: He is called a Vaishnav, but he is bound to deeds of egotism; by threshing only husks, what rewards can be obtained?

Gurbani: ਹੰਸਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਬੈਠਾ ਬਗੁ ਨ ਬਣਈ ਨਿਤ ਬੈਠਾ ਮਛੀ ਨੋ ਤਾਰ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: hansaa vich baitthaa bag na banee nit baitthaa machhee no taar laavai |
English: Sitting among the swans, the crane does not become one of them; sitting there, he keeps staring at the fish.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਹੰਸ ਸਭਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਨਿ ਤਾ ਬਗਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਜੋੜੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jaa hans sabhaa veechaar kar dekhan taa bagaa naal jorr kade na aavai |
English: And when the gathering of swans looks and sees, they realize that they can never form an alliance with the crane.

Gurbani: ਹੰਸਾ ਹੀਰਾ ਮੋਤੀ ਚੁਗਣਾ ਬਗੁ ਡਡਾ ਭਾਲਣ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: hansaa heeraa motee chuganaa bag ddaddaa bhaalan jaavai |
English: The swans peck at the diamonds and pearls, while the crane chases after frogs.

Gurbani: ਉਡਰਿਆ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ਬਗੁਲਾ ਮਤੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੰਞੁ ਲਖਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: auddariaa vechaaraa bagulaa mat hovai many lakhaavai |
English: The poor crane flies away, so that his secret will not be exposed.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਲਾਗਾ ਕਿਸੁ ਦੋਸੁ ਦਿਚੈ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਏਵੈ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jit ko laaeaa tith hee laagaa kis dos dichai jaa har evai bhaavai |
English: Whatever the Lord attaches one to, to that he is attached. Who is to blame, when the Lord wills it so?

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਰਤਨੀ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur saravar ratanee bharapoore jis praapat so paavai |
English: The True Guru is the lake, overflowing with pearls. One who meets the True Guru obtains them.

Gurbani: ਸਿਖ ਹੰਸ ਸਰਵਰਿ ਇਕਠੇ ਹੋਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੁਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: sikh hans saravar ikatthe hoe satigur kai hukamaavai |
English: The Sikh-swans gather at the lake, according to the Will of the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਮਾਣਕ ਸਰਵਰਿ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ਖਾਇ ਖਰਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: ratan padaarath maanak saravar bharapoore khaae kharach rahe tott na aavai |
English: The lake is filled with the wealth of these jewels and pearls; they are spent and consumed, but they never run out.

Gurbani: ਸਰਵਰ ਹੰਸੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਕਰਤੇ ਏਵੈ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: saravar hans door na hoee karate evai bhaavai |
English: The swan never leaves the lake; such is the Pleasure of the Creator's Will.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸ ਦੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਸਿਖੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਹਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jan naanak jis dai masatak bhaag dhur likhiaa so sikh guroo peh aavai |
English: O servant Nanak, one who has such pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon his forehead - that Sikh comes to the Guru.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਤਰਿਆ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਭਿ ਤਾਰੇ ਸਭਾ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਛਡਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aap tariaa kuttanb sabh taare sabhaa srisatt chhaddaavai |1|
English: He saves himself, and saves all his generations as well; he emancipates the whole world. ||1||

[Ang 960 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਆਖਾਏ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਰਾਹੀ ਕੋਰੜ ਮੋਠ ਜਿਨੇਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: panddit aakhaae bahutee raahee korarr motth jinehaa |
English: He is called a Pandit, a religious scholar, and yet he wanders along many pathways. He is as hard as uncooked beans.

Gurbani: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਭਰਮਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਤਿਸਟਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੇਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: andar mohu nit bharam viaapiaa tisattas naahee dehaa |
English: He is filled with attachment, and constantly engrossed in doubt; his body cannot hold still.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜੀ ਆਵੈ ਕੂੜੀ ਜਾਵੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੀ ਨਿਤ ਜੋਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: koorree aavai koorree jaavai maaeaa kee nit johaa |
English: False is his coming, and false is his going; he is continually on the lookout for Maya.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਤਾ ਛੋਹੋ ਆਵੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਰੋਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: sach kahai taa chhoho aavai antar bahutaa rohaa |
English: If someone speaks the truth, then he is aggravated; he is totally filled with anger.

Gurbani: ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕੁਬੁਧਿ ਕੁਮੂੜਾ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੋਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: viaapiaa duramat kubudh kumoorraa man laagaa tis mohaa |
English: The evil fool is engrossed in evil-mindedness and false intellectualizations; his mind is attached to emotional attachment.

Gurbani: ਠਗੈ ਸੇਤੀ ਠਗੁ ਰਲਿ ਆਇਆ ਸਾਥੁ ਭਿ ਇਕੋ ਜੇਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: tthagai setee tthag ral aaeaa saath bhi iko jehaa |
English: The deceiver abides with the five deceivers; it is a gathering of like minds.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਰਾਫੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਵਿਚਦੋ ਕਢੈ ਤਾਂ ਉਘੜਿ ਆਇਆ ਲੋਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: satigur saraaf nadaree vichado kadtai taan ugharr aaeaa lohaa |
English: And when the Jeweller, the True Guru, appraises him, then he is exposed as mere iron.

Gurbani: ਬਹੁਤੇਰੀ ਥਾਈ ਰਲਾਇ ਰਲਾਇ ਦਿਤਾ ਉਘੜਿਆ ਪੜਦਾ ਅਗੈ ਆਇ ਖਲੋਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: bahuteree thaaee ralaae ralaae ditaa ugharriaa parradaa agai aae khalohaa |
English: Mixed and mingled with others, he was passed off as genuine in many places; but now, the veil has been lifted, and he stands naked before all.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਜੇ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਵੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਨੂਰਹੁ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਹੋਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: satigur kee je saranee aavai fir manoorahu kanchan hohaa |
English: One who comes to the Sanctuary of the True Guru, shall be transformed from iron into gold.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਮਾਨੇ ਅਉਗਣ ਕਟੇ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਧੁ ਦੇਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: satigur niravair putr satr samaane aaugan katte kare sudh dehaa |
English: The True Guru has no anger or vengeance; He looks upon son and enemy alike. Removing faults and mistakes, He purifies the human body.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਸਨੇਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: naanak jis dhur masatak hovai likhiaa tis satigur naal sanehaa |
English: O Nanak, one who has such pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon his forehead, is in love with the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸੇਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: amrit baanee satigur poore kee jis kirapaal hovai tis ridai vasehaa |
English: The Word of the Perfect True Guru's Bani is Ambrosial Nectar; it dwells in the heart of one who is blessed by the Guru's Mercy.

Gurbani: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਕਟੀਐ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਹਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aavan jaanaa tis kaa katteeai sadaa sadaa sukh hohaa |2|
English: His coming and going in reincarnation is ended; forever and ever, he is at peace. ||2||

[Ang 961 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਜੰਤੁ ਸੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਬੁਝਈ ॥
Transliteration: jo tudh bhaanaa jant so tudh bujhee |
English: He alone understands You, Lord, with whom You are pleased.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਜੰਤੁ ਸੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਿਝਈ ॥
Transliteration: jo tudh bhaanaa jant su daragah sijhee |
English: He alone is approved in the Court of the Lord, with whom You are pleased.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਗਈ ॥
Transliteration: jis no teree nadar haumai tis gee |
English: Egotism is eradicated, when You bestow Your Grace.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਸੰਤੁਸਟੁ ਕਲਮਲ ਤਿਸੁ ਖਈ ॥
Transliteration: jis no too santusatt kalamal tis khee |
English: Sins are erased, when You are thoroughly pleased.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਵਲਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸੋ ਭਈ ॥
Transliteration: jis kai suaamee val nirbhau so bhee |
English: One who has the Lord Master on his side, becomes fearless.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਸਚਾ ਸੋ ਥਿਅਈ ॥
Transliteration: jis no too kirapaal sachaa so thiaee |
English: One who is blessed with Your Mercy, becomes truthful.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਮਇਆ ਨ ਪੋਹੈ ਅਗਨਈ ॥
Transliteration: jis no teree meaa na pohai aganee |
English: One who is blessed with Your Kindness, is not touched by fire.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਤਿ ਲਈ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: tis no sadaa deaal jin gur te mat lee |7|
English: You are forever Merciful to those who are receptive to the Guru's Teachings. ||7||

[Ang 961 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa kirapaal aape bakhas lai |
English: Please grant Your Grace, O Merciful Lord; please forgive me.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਪੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਇ ਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa japee teraa naam satigur paae pai |
English: Forever and ever, I chant Your Name; I fall at the feet of the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸੁ ਦੂਖਾ ਨਾਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: man tan antar vas dookhaa naas hoe |
English: Please, dwell within my mind and body, and end my sufferings.

Gurbani: ਹਥ ਦੇਇ ਆਪਿ ਰਖੁ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਭਉ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: hath dee aap rakh viaapai bhau na koe |
English: Please give me Your hand, and save me, that fear may not afflict me.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਏਤੈ ਕੰਮਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gun gaavaa din rain etai kam laae |
English: May I sing Your Glorious Praises day and night; please commit me to this task.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sant janaa kai sang haumai rog jaae |
English: Associating with the humble Saints, the disease of egotism is eradicated.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sarab nirantar khasam eko rav rahiaa |
English: The One Lord and Master is all-pervading, permeating everywhere.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਲਹਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee sach sacho sach lahiaa |
English: By Guru's Grace, I have truly found the Truest of the True.

Gurbani: ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਅਪਣੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਦੇਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: deaa karahu deaal apanee sifat dehu |
English: Please bless me with Your Kindness, O Kind Lord, and bless me with Your Praises.

Gurbani: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਏਹ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: darasan dekh nihaal naanak preet eh |1|
English: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, I am in ecstasy; this is what Nanak loves. ||1||

[Ang 961 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਜਪੀਐ ਮਨੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਇਕਸ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: eko japeeai manai maeh ikas kee saranaae |
English: Meditate on the One Lord within your mind, and enter the Sanctuary of the One Lord alone.

Gurbani: ਇਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਪਿਰਹੜੀ ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: eikas siau kar piraharree doojee naahee jaae |
English: Be in love with the One Lord; there is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਇਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: eiko daataa mangeeai sabh kichh palai paae |
English: Beg from the One Lord, the Great Giver, and you will be blessed with everything.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਇਕੋ ਇਕੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: man tan saas giraas prabh iko ik dhiaae |
English: In your mind and body, with each breath and morsel of food, meditate on the One and only Lord God.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: amrit naam nidhaan sach guramukh paaeaa jaae |
English: The Gurmukh obtains the true treasure, the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: vaddabhaagee te sant jan jin man vutthaa aae |
English: Very fortunate are those humble Saints, within whose minds the Lord has come to abide.

Gurbani: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jal thal maheeal rav rahiaa doojaa koee naeh |
English: He is pervading and permeating the water, the land and the sky; there is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਚਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਖਸਮ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naam dhiaaee naam ucharaa naanak khasam rajaae |2|
English: Meditating on the Naam, and chanting the Naam, Nanak abides in the Will of his Lord and Master. ||2||

[Ang 961 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਉਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: jis no too rakhavaalaa maare tis kaun |
English: One who has You as his Saving Grace - who can kill him?

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ਜਿਤਾ ਤਿਨੈ ਭੈਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: jis no too rakhavaalaa jitaa tinai bhain |
English: One who has You as his Saving Grace conquers the three worlds.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਗੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਉਜਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: jis no teraa ang tis mukh ujalaa |
English: One who has You on his side - his face is radiant and bright.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਗੁ ਸੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੀ ਹੂੰ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: jis no teraa ang su niramalee hoon niramalaa |
English: One who has You on his side, is the purest of the Pure.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਲੇਖਾ ਪੁਛੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: jis no teree nadar na lekhaa puchheeai |
English: One who is blessed with Your Grace is not called to give his account.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਖੁਸੀ ਤਿਨਿ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਭੁੰਚੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: jis no teree khusee tin nau nidh bhuncheeai |
English: One with whom You are pleased, obtains the nine treasures.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਵਲਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹਛੰਦਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: jis no too prabh val tis kiaa muhachhandagee |
English: One who has You on his side, God - unto whom is he subservient?

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਮਿਹਰ ਸੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਬੰਦਿਗੀ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: jis no teree mihar su teree bandigee |8|
English: One who is blessed with Your Kind Mercy is dedicated to Your worship. ||8||

[Ang 961 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੰਤਾਂ ਸੰਗਿ ਵਿਹਾਵੇ ॥
Transliteration: hohu kripaal suaamee mere santaan sang vihaave |
English: Be Merciful, O my Lord and Master, that I may pass my life in the Society of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧਹੁ ਭੁਲੇ ਸਿ ਜਮਿ ਜਮਿ ਮਰਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚੁਕਨਿ ਹਾਵੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tudhahu bhule si jam jam marade tin kade na chukan haave |1|
English: Those who forget You are born only to die and be reincarnated again; their sufferings will never end. ||1||

[Ang 961 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਘਟਿ ਅਵਘਟਿ ਘਟ ਘਾਟ ॥
Transliteration: satigur simarahu aapanaa ghatt avaghatt ghatt ghaatt |
English: Meditate in remembrance within your heart on the True Guru, whether you are on the most difficult path, on the mountain or by the river bank.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੰਤਿਆ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਬੰਧੈ ਵਾਟ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har har naam japantiaa koe na bandhai vaatt |2|
English: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, no one shall block your way. ||2||

[Ang 961 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਤਿਥੈ ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਜਿਥੈ ਕੋਇ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: tithai too samarath jithai koe naeh |
English: Where You are, Almighty Lord, there is no one else.

Gurbani: ਓਥੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਖ ਅਗਨੀ ਉਦਰ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: othai teree rakh aganee udar maeh |
English: There, in the fire of the mother's womb, You protected us.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਕੈ ਜਮ ਕੇ ਦੂਤ ਨਾਇ ਤੇਰੈ ਛਡਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: sun kai jam ke doot naae terai chhadd jaeh |
English: Hearing Your Name, the Messenger of Death runs away.

Gurbani: ਭਉਜਲੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਅਸਗਾਹੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: bhaujal bikham asagaahu gurasabadee paar paeh |
English: The terrifying, treacherous, impassible world-ocean is crossed over, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਲਗੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸੇਇ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jin kau lagee piaas amrit see khaeh |
English: Those who feel thirst for You, take in Your Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਏਹੋ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: kal meh eho pun gun govind gaeh |
English: This is the only act of goodness in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, to sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਸਭਸੈ ਨੋ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ਸਾਹਿ ਸਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: sabhasai no kirapaal samaale saeh saeh |
English: He is Merciful to all; He sustains us with each and every breath.

Gurbani: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਜਿ ਆਵੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਹਿ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: birathaa koe na jaae ji aavai tudh aaeh |9|
English: Those who come to You with love and faith are never turned away empty-handed. ||9||

[Ang 962 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦੂਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਨ ਬੁਝਾਇਹੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: doojaa tis na bujhaaeihu paarabraham naam dehu aadhaar |
English: Those whom You bless with the Support of Your Name, O Supreme Lord God, do not know any other.

Gurbani: ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੋ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸਚੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: agam agochar saahibo samarath sach daataar |
English: Inaccessible, Unfathomable Lord and Master, All-powerful True Great Giver:

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: too nihachal niravair sach sachaa tudh darabaar |
English: You are eternal and unchanging, without vengeance and True; True is the Darbaar of Your Court.

Gurbani: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: keemat kehan na jaaeeai ant na paaraavaar |
English: Your worth cannot be described; You have no end or limitation.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਹੋਰੁ ਜਿ ਮੰਗਣਾ ਸਭੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਸ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: prabh chhodd hor ji manganaa sabh bikhiaa ras chhaar |
English: To forsake God, and ask for something else, is all corruption and ashes.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹ ਸੇ ਜਿਨ ਸਚਾ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: se sukhee sach saah se jin sachaa biauhaar |
English: They alone find peace, and they are the true kings, whose dealings are true.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਾ ਲਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jinaa lagee preet prabh naam sehaj sukh saar |
English: Those who are in love with God's Name, intuitively enjoy the essence of peace.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਕੁ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਸੰਤਨ ਰੇਣਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak ik aaraadhe santan renaar |1|
English: Nanak worships and adores the One Lord; he seeks the dust of the Saints. ||1||

[Ang 962 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਨਦ ਸੂਖ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: anad sookh bisraam nit har kaa keeratan gaae |
English: Singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, bliss, peace and rest are obtained.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਛਾਡਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਉਧਰਸਿ ਨਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: avar siaanap chhaadd dehi naanak udharas naae |2|
English: Forsake other clever tricks, O Nanak; only through the Name will you be saved. ||2||

[Ang 962 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਵਸਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਘਿਣਾਵਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: naa too aaveh vas bahut ghinaavane |
English: No one can bring You under control, by despising the world.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਵਸਿ ਬੇਦ ਪੜਾਵਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: naa too aaveh vas bed parraavane |
English: No one can bring You under control, by studying the Vedas.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਵਸਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: naa too aaveh vas teerath naaeeai |
English: No one can bring You under control, by bathing at the holy places.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਵਸਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਧਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: naa too aaveh vas dharatee dhaaeeai |
English: No one can bring You under control, by wandering all over the world.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਵਸਿ ਕਿਤੈ ਸਿਆਣਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: naa too aaveh vas kitai siaanapai |
English: No one can bring You under control, by any clever tricks.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਵਸਿ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: naa too aaveh vas bahutaa daan de |
English: No one can bring You under control, by giving huge donations to charities.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਵਸਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabh ko terai vas agam agocharaa |
English: Everyone is under Your power, O inaccessible, unfathomable Lord.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਤਾਣੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: too bhagataa kai vas bhagataa taan teraa |10|
English: You are under the control of Your devotees; You are the strength of Your devotees. ||10||

[Ang 962 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਵੈਦੁ ਆਪਿ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape vaid aap naaraaein |
English: The Lord Himself is the true physician.

Gurbani: ਏਹਿ ਵੈਦ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਇਣ ॥
Transliteration: ehi vaid jeea kaa dukh laaein |
English: These physicians of the world only burden the soul with pain.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਇਣ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa sabad amrit ras khaaein |
English: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is Ambrosial Nectar; it is so delicious to eat.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਦੂਖ ਮਿਟਾਇਣ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak jis man vasai tis ke sabh dookh mittaaein |1|
English: O Nanak, one whose mind is filled with this Nectar - all his pains are dispelled. ||1||

[Ang 962 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਉਛਲੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਰਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: hukam uchhalai hukame rahai |
English: By the Hukam of Lord's Command, they move about; by the Lord's Command, they remain still.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਸਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: hukame dukh sukh sam kar sahai |
English: By His Hukam, they endure pain and pleasure alike.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: hukame naam japai din raat |
English: By His Hukam, they chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, day and night.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: naanak jis no hovai daat |
English: O Nanak, he alone does so, who is blessed.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹੀ ਜੀਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: hukam marai hukame hee jeevai |
English: By the Hukam of the Lord's Command, they die; by the Hukam of His Command, they live.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਨਾਨੑਾ ਵਡਾ ਥੀਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: hukame naanaa vaddaa theevai |
English: By His Hukam, they become tiny, and huge.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸੋਗ ਹਰਖ ਆਨੰਦ ॥
Transliteration: hukame sog harakh aanand |
English: By His Hukam, they receive pain, happiness and bliss.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਜਪੈ ਨਿਰੋਧਰ ਗੁਰਮੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: hukame japai nirodhar guramant |
English: By His Hukam, they chant the Guru's Mantra, which always works.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: hukame aavan jaan rahaae |
English: By His Hukam, coming and going in reincarnation cease,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak jaa kau bhagatee laae |2|
English: O Nanak, when He links them to His devotional worship. ||2||

[Ang 962 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਢਾਢੀ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਜਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੇਵਦਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: hau tis dtaadtee kurabaan ji teraa sevadaar |
English: I am a sacrifice to that musician who is Your servant, O Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਢਾਢੀ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ਜਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: hau tis dtaadtee balihaar ji gaavai gun apaar |
English: I am a sacrifice to that musician who sings the Glorious Praises of the Infinite Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਢਾਢੀ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਲੋੜੇ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: so dtaadtee dhan dhan jis lorre nirankaar |
English: Blessed, blessed is that musician, for whom the Formless Lord Himself longs.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਢਾਢੀ ਭਾਗਠੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਚਾ ਦੁਆਰ ਬਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: so dtaadtee bhaagatth jis sachaa duaar baar |
English: Very fortunate is that musician who comes to the gate of the Court of the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਢਾਢੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਕਲਾਣੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: ohu dtaadtee tudh dhiaae kalaane din rainaar |
English: That musician meditates on You, Lord, and praises You day and night.

Gurbani: ਮੰਗੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕਦੇ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: mangai amrit naam na aavai kade haar |
English: He begs for the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, and will never be defeated.

Gurbani: ਕਪੜੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਰਹਦਾ ਲਿਵੈ ਧਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: kaparr bhojan sach rahadaa livai dhaar |
English: His clothes and his food are true, and he enshrines love for the Lord within.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਢਾਢੀ ਗੁਣਵੰਤੁ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: so dtaadtee gunavant jis no prabh piaar |11|
English: Praiseworthy is that musician who loves God. ||11||

[Ang 963 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਅਮਿਉ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: amrit baanee amiau ras amrit har kaa naau |
English: The Bani of the Guru's Word is Ambrosial Nectar; its taste is sweet. The Name of the Lord is Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: man tan hiradai simar har aatth pehar gun gaau |
English: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord in your mind, body and heart; twenty-four hours a day, sing His Glorious Praises.

Gurbani: ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਹੁ ਸਚਾ ਇਹੈ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
Transliteration: aupades sunahu tum gurasikhahu sachaa ihai suaau |
English: Listen to these Teachings, O Sikhs of the Guru. This is the true purpose of life.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਲਾਇਹੁ ਭਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: janam padaarath safal hoe man meh laaeihu bhaau |
English: This priceless human life will be made fruitful; embrace love for the Lord in your mind.

Gurbani: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨਦੁ ਘਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਪਤਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: sookh sehaj aanad ghanaa prabh japatiaa dukh jaae |
English: Celestial peace and absolute bliss come when one meditates on God - suffering is dispelled.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਈਐ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak naam japat sukh aoopajai daragah paaeeai thaau |1|
English: O Nanak, chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, peace wells up, and one obtains a place in the Court of the Lord. ||1||

[Ang 963 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak naam dhiaaeeai gur pooraa mat dee |
English: O Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; this is the Teaching imparted by the Perfect Guru.

Gurbani: ਭਾਣੈ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮੋ ਭਾਣੈ ਹੀ ਕਢਿ ਲੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhaanai jap tap sanjamo bhaanai hee kadt lee |
English: In the Lord's Will, they practice meditation, austerity and self-discipline; in the Lord's Will, they are released.

Gurbani: ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋਨਿ ਭਵਾਈਐ ਭਾਣੈ ਬਖਸ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhaanai jon bhavaaeeai bhaanai bakhas karee |
English: In the Lord's Will, they are made to wander in reincarnation; in the Lord's Will, they are forgiven.

Gurbani: ਭਾਣੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਭੋਗੀਐ ਭਾਣੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhaanai dukh sukh bhogeeai bhaanai karam karee |
English: In the Lord's Will, pain and pleasure are experienced; in the Lord's Will, actions are performed.

Gurbani: ਭਾਣੈ ਮਿਟੀ ਸਾਜਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋਤਿ ਧਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhaanai mittee saaj kai bhaanai jot dharee |
English: In the Lord's Will, clay is fashioned into form; in the Lord's Will, His Light is infused into it.

Gurbani: ਭਾਣੈ ਭੋਗ ਭੋਗਾਇਦਾ ਭਾਣੈ ਮਨਹਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhaanai bhog bhogaaeidaa bhaanai maneh karee |
English: In the Lord's Will, enjoyments are enjoyed; in the Lord's Will, these enjoyments are denied.

Gurbani: ਭਾਣੈ ਨਰਕਿ ਸੁਰਗਿ ਅਉਤਾਰੇ ਭਾਣੈ ਧਰਣਿ ਪਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhaanai narak surag aautaare bhaanai dharan paree |
English: In the Lord's Will, they are incarnated in heaven and hell; in the Lord's Will, they fall to the ground.

Gurbani: ਭਾਣੈ ਹੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bhaanai hee jis bhagatee laae naanak virale he |2|
English: In the Lord's Will, they are committed to His devotional worship and Praise; O Nanak, how rare are these! ||2||

[Ang 963 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: vaddiaaee sache naam kee hau jeevaa sun sune |
English: Hearing, hearing of the glorious greatness of the True Name, I live.

Gurbani: ਪਸੂ ਪਰੇਤ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਇਕ ਖਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: pasoo paret agiaan udhaare ik khane |
English: Even ignorant beasts and goblins can be saved, in an instant.

Gurbani: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਦ ਜਾਪੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: dinas rain teraa naau sadaa sad jaapeeai |
English: Day and night, chant the Name, forever and ever.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਵਿਕਰਾਲ ਨਾਇ ਤੇਰੈ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: trisanaa bhukh vikaraal naae terai dhraapeeai |
English: The most horrible thirst and hunger is satisfied through Your Name, O Lord.

Gurbani: ਰੋਗੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਵੰਞੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਉ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: rog sog dukh vanyai jis naau man vasai |
English: Disease, sorrow and pain run away, when the Name dwells within the mind.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਲਾਲੁ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਰਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: tiseh paraapat laal jo gurasabadee rasai |
English: He alone attains his Beloved, who loves the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਉਧਾਰਣਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: khandd brahamandd beant udhaaranahaariaa |
English: The worlds and solar systems are saved by the Infinite Lord.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਚੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: teree sobhaa tudh sache mere piaariaa |12|
English: Your glory is Yours alone, O my Beloved True Lord. ||12||

[Ang 963 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀ ਮੈ ਛਡਿ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਰੰਗਿ ਕਸੁੰਭੈ ਭੁਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: mitru piaaraa naanak jee mai chhadd gavaaeaa rang kasunbhai bhulee |
English: I abandoned and lost my Beloved Friend, O Nanak; I was fooled by the transitory color of the safflower, which fades away.

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਸਜਣ ਕੀ ਮੈ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਉਦੀ ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਢੁ ਨ ਲਹਦੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tau sajan kee mai keem na paudee hau tudh bin adt na lahadee |1|
English: I did not know Your value, O my Friend; without You, I am not worth even half a shell. ||1||

[Ang 963 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਸੁ ਵਿਰਾਇਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਉ ਸਸੁਰਾ ਵਾਦੀ ਜੇਠੋ ਪਉ ਪਉ ਲੂਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: sas viraaein naanak jeeo sasuraa vaadee jettho pau pau loohai |
English: My mother-in-law is my enemy, O Nanak; my father-in-law is argumentative and my brother-in-law burns me at every step.

Gurbani: ਹਭੇ ਭਸੁ ਪੁਣੇਦੇ ਵਤਨੁ ਜਾ ਮੈ ਸਜਣੁ ਤੂਹੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: habhe bhas punede vatan jaa mai sajan toohai |2|
English: They can all just play in the dust, when You are my Friend, O Lord. ||2||

[Ang 963 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਵੁਠਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਣੋ ॥
Transliteration: jis too vutthaa chit tis darad nivaarano |
English: You relieve the pains of those, within whose consciousness You dwell, O Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਵੁਠਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹਾਰਣੋ ॥
Transliteration: jis too vutthaa chit tis kade na haarano |
English: Those, within whose consciousness You dwell, never lose.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਸੁ ਸਰਪਰ ਤਾਰਣੋ ॥
Transliteration: jis miliaa pooraa guroo su sarapar taarano |
English: One who meets the Perfect Guru will surely be saved.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਾਏ ਸਚਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਣੋ ॥
Transliteration: jis no laae sach tis sach samaalano |
English: One who is attached to Truth, contemplates Truth.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਇਆ ਹਥਿ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਾਲਣੋ ॥
Transliteration: jis aaeaa hath nidhaan su rahiaa bhaalano |
English: One, into whose hands the treasure comes, stops searching.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਇਕੋ ਰੰਗੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਸੋ ਜਾਨਣੋ ॥
Transliteration: jis no iko rang bhagat so jaanano |
English: He alone is known as a devotee, who loves the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਬਿਰਹੀ ਚਾਰਣੋ ॥
Transliteration: ohu sabhanaa kee ren birahee chaarano |
English: He is the dust under the feet of all; he is the lover of the Lord's feet.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਾਰਣੋ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: sabh tere choj viddaan sabh teraa kaarano |13|
English: Everything is Your wonderful play; the whole creation is Yours. ||13||

[Ang 963 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀ ਮੈ ਹਭ ਵਞਾਈ ਛੋੜਿਆ ਹਭੁ ਕਿਝੁ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: ausatat nindaa naanak jee mai habh vayaaee chhorriaa habh kijh tiaagee |
English: I have totally discarded praise and slander, O Nanak; I have forsaken and abandoned everything.
