Gurbani: ਹਭੇ ਸਾਕ ਕੂੜਾਵੇ ਡਿਠੇ ਤਉ ਪਲੈ ਤੈਡੈ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: habhe saak koorraave dditthe tau palai taiddai laagee |1|
English: I have seen that all relationships are false, and so I have grasped hold of the hem of Your robe, Lord. ||1||

[Ang 963 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਫਿਰਦੀ ਫਿਰਦੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਉ ਹਉ ਫਾਵੀ ਥੀਈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦਿਸਾਵਰ ਪੰਧਾ ॥
Transliteration: firadee firadee naanak jeeo hau faavee theeee bahut disaavar pandhaa |
English: I wandered and wandered and went crazy, O Nanak, in countless foreign lands and pathways.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਹਉ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਸੁਤੀ ਜਾ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਮੈ ਲਧਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: taa hau sukh sukhaalee sutee jaa gur mil sajan mai ladhaa |2|
English: But then, I slept in peace and comfort, when I met the Guru, and found my Friend. ||2||

[Ang 964 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸਭੇ ਦੁਖ ਸੰਤਾਪ ਜਾਂ ਤੁਧਹੁ ਭੁਲੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: sabhe dukh santaap jaan tudhahu bhuleeai |
English: When I forget You, I endure all pains and afflictions.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਕੀਚਨਿ ਲਖ ਉਪਾਵ ਤਾਂ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਘੁਲੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: je keechan lakh upaav taan kahee na ghuleeai |
English: Making thousands of efforts, they are still not eliminated.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਨਾਉ ਸੁ ਨਿਰਧਨੁ ਕਾਂਢੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: jis no visarai naau su niradhan kaandteeai |
English: One who forgets the Name, is known as a poor person.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਨਾਉ ਸੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਹਾਂਢੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: jis no visarai naau su jonee haandteeai |
English: One who forgets the Name, wanders in reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਖਸਮੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਮੁ ਡੰਡੁ ਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: jis khasam na aavai chit tis jam ddandd de |
English: One who does not remember his Lord and Master, is punished by the Messenger of Death.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਖਸਮੁ ਨ ਆਵੀ ਚਿਤਿ ਰੋਗੀ ਸੇ ਗਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: jis khasam na aavee chit rogee se gane |
English: One who does not remember his Lord and Master, is judged to be a sick person.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਖਸਮੁ ਨ ਆਵੀ ਚਿਤਿ ਸੁ ਖਰੋ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: jis khasam na aavee chit su kharo ahankaareea |
English: One who does not remember his Lord and Master, is egotistical and proud.

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ਜਗਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਉ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਆ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: soee duhelaa jag jin naau visaareea |14|
English: One who forgets the Name is miserable in this world. ||14||

[Ang 964 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤੈਡੀ ਬੰਦਸਿ ਮੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਡਿਠਾ ਤੂ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: taiddee bandas mai koe na dditthaa too naanak man bhaanaa |
English: I have not seen any other like You. You alone are pleasing to Nanak's mind.

Gurbani: ਘੋਲਿ ਘੁਮਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਵਿਚੋਲੇ ਜੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੰਤੁ ਪਛਾਣਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ghol ghumaaee tis mitr vichole jai mil kant pachhaanaa |1|
English: I am a dedicated, devoted sacrifice to that friend, that mediator, who leads me to recognize my Husband Lord. ||1||

[Ang 964 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪਾਵ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ ਜਾਂ ਤਉ ਧਿਰਿ ਜੁਲਦੇ ਸੀਸੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਚਰਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: paav suhaave jaan tau dhir julade sees suhaavaa charanee |
English: Beautiful are those feet which walk towards You; beautiful is that head which falls at Your Feet.

Gurbani: ਮੁਖੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਜਾਂ ਤਉ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ ਪਇਆ ਤਉ ਸਰਣੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mukh suhaavaa jaan tau jas gaavai jeeo peaa tau saranee |2|
English: Beautiful is that mouth which sings Your Praises; beautiful is that soul which seeks Your Sanctuary. ||2||

[Ang 964 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਰੀ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਵੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: mil naaree satasang mangal gaaveea |
English: Meeting the Lord's brides, in the True Congregation, I sing the songs of joy.

Gurbani: ਘਰ ਕਾ ਹੋਆ ਬੰਧਾਨੁ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਧਾਵੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: ghar kaa hoaa bandhaan bahurr na dhaaveea |
English: The home of my heart is now held steady, and I shall not go out wandering again.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਠੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੁਰਤੁ ਸੋਇ ਕੂੜਾਵੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: binatthee duramat durat soe koorraaveea |
English: Evil-mindedness has been dispelled, along with sin and my bad reputation.

Gurbani: ਸੀਲਵੰਤਿ ਪਰਧਾਨਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਚਾਵੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: seelavant paradhaan ridai sachaaveea |
English: I am well-known as being calm and good-natured; my heart is filled with Truth.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਇਕ ਰੀਤਾਵੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: antar baahar ik ik reetaaveea |
English: Inwardly and outwardly, the One and only Lord is my way.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਚਰਣ ਦਾਸਾਵੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: man darasan kee piaas charan daasaaveea |
English: My mind is thirsty for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. I am a slave at His feet.

Gurbani: ਸੋਭਾ ਬਣੀ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਖਸਮਿ ਜਾਂ ਰਾਵੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: sobhaa banee seegaar khasam jaan raaveea |
English: I am glorified and embellished, when my Lord and Master enjoys me.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲੀਆ ਆਇ ਸੰਜੋਗਿ ਜਾਂ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੀਆ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: mileea aae sanjog jaan tis bhaaveea |15|
English: I meet Him through my blessed destiny, when it is pleasing to His Will. ||15||

[Ang 964 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਭਿ ਗੁਣ ਤੈਡੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਉ ਮੈ ਕੂ ਥੀਏ ਮੈ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਤੇ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: habh gun taidde naanak jeeo mai koo thee mai niragun te kiaa hovai |
English: All virtues are Yours, Dear Lord; You bestow them upon us. I am unworthy - what can I achieve, O Nanak?

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਚਕੁ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਚੋਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tau jevadd daataar na koee jaachak sadaa jaachovai |1|
English: There is no other Giver as great as You. I am a beggar; I beg from You forever. ||1||

[Ang 964 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦੇਹ ਛਿਜੰਦੜੀ ਊਣ ਮਝੂਣਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਜਣਿ ਜੀਉ ਧਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: deh chhijandarree aoon majhoonaa gur sajan jeeo dharaaeaa |
English: My body was wasting away, and I was depressed. The Guru, my Friend, has encouraged and consoled me.

Gurbani: ਹਭੇ ਸੁਖ ਸੁਹੇਲੜਾ ਸੁਤਾ ਜਿਤਾ ਜਗੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: habhe sukh suhelarraa sutaa jitaa jag sabaaeaa |2|
English: I sleep in total peace and comfort; I have conquered the whole world. ||2||

[Ang 964 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਵਡਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਤਖਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: vaddaa teraa darabaar sachaa tudh takhat |
English: The Darbaar of Your Court is glorious and great. Your holy throne is True.

Gurbani: ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਚਉਰੁ ਛਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: sir saahaa paatisaahu nihachal chaur chhat |
English: You are the Emperor over the heads of kings. Your canopy and chauree (fly-brush) are permanent and unchanging.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਭਾਵੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੋਈ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਆਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo bhaavai paarabraham soee sach niaau |
English: That alone is true justice, which is pleasing to the Will of the Supreme Lord God.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਥਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: je bhaavai paarabraham nithaave milai thaau |
English: Even the homeless receive a home, when it is pleasing to the Will of the Supreme Lord God.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕੀਨੑੀ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ਸਾਈ ਭਲੀ ਗਲ ॥
Transliteration: jo keenaee karataar saaee bhalee gal |
English: Whatever the Creator Lord does, is a good thing.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਸੇ ਦਰਗਾਹ ਮਲ ॥
Transliteration: jinaee pachhaataa khasam se daragaah mal |
English: Those who recognize their Lord and Master, are seated in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਹੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਫੁਰਮਾਨੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਫੇਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: sahee teraa furamaan kinai na fereeai |
English: True is Your Command; no one can challenge it.

Gurbani: ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਣ ਕਰੀਮ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਤੇਰੀਐ ॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: kaaran karan kareem kudarat tereeai |16|
English: O Merciful Lord, Cause of causes, Your creative power is all-powerful. ||16||

[Ang 964 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੋਇ ਸੁਣੰਦੜੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਉਲਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੰਦੜੀ ਲਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: soe sunandarree meraa tan man maulaa naam japandarree laalee |
English: Hearing of You, my body and mind have blossomed forth; chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, I am flushed with life.

Gurbani: ਪੰਧਿ ਜੁਲੰਦੜੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਅੰਦਰੁ ਠੰਢਾ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: pandh julandarree meraa andar tthandtaa gur darasan dekh nihaalee |1|
English: Walking on the Path, I have found cool tranquility deep within; gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan, I am enraptured. ||1||

[Ang 964 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਠ ਮੰਝਾਹੂ ਮੈ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਲਧਾ ॥
Transliteration: hatth manjhaahoo mai maanak ladhaa |
English: I have found the jewel within my heart.

Gurbani: ਮੁਲਿ ਨ ਘਿਧਾ ਮੈ ਕੂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: mul na ghidhaa mai koo satigur ditaa |
English: I was not charged for it; the True Guru gave it to me.

Gurbani: ਢੂੰਢ ਵਞਾਈ ਥੀਆ ਥਿਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: dtoondt vayaaee theea thitaa |
English: My search has ended, and I have become stable.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਤਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: janam padaarath naanak jitaa |2|
English: O Nanak, I have conquered this priceless human life. ||2||

[Ang 964 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: jis kai masatak karam hoe so sevaa laagaa |
English: One who has such good karma inscribed upon his forehead, is committed to the Lord's service.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਸੋ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: jis gur mil kamal pragaasiaa so anadin jaagaa |
English: One whose heart lotus blossoms forth upon meeting the Guru, remains awake and aware, night and day.

Gurbani: ਲਗਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਚਰਣਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਸਭੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: lagaa rang charanaarabind sabh bhram bhau bhaagaa |
English: All doubt and fear run away from one who is in love with the Lord's lotus feet.

Gurbani: ਆਤਮੁ ਜਿਤਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਆਗੰਜਤ ਪਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: aatam jitaa guramatee aaganjat paagaa |
English: He conquers his soul, following the Guru's Teachings, and attains the Imperishable Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸੋ ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਤਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: jiseh dhiaaeaa paarabraham so kal meh taagaa |
English: He alone keeps up in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, who meditates on the Supreme Lord God.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਮਜਨਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: saadhoo sangat niramalaa atthasatth majanaagaa |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he is immaculate, as if he has bathed at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਭਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: jis prabh miliaa aapanaa so purakh sabhaagaa |
English: He alone is a man of good fortune, who has met with God.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਏਵਡ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: naanak tis balihaaranai jis evadd bhaagaa |17|
English: Nanak is a sacrifice to such a one, whose destiny is so great! ||17||

[Ang 965 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਾਂ ਪਿਰੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤਾਂ ਧਨ ਬਾਹਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jaan pir andar taan dhan baahar |
English: When the Husband Lord is within the heart, then Maya, the bride, goes outside.

Gurbani: ਜਾਂ ਪਿਰੁ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਤਾਂ ਧਨ ਮਾਹਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jaan pir baahar taan dhan maahar |
English: When one's Husband Lord is outside of oneself, then Maya, the bride, is supreme.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਹੁ ਫੇਰ ਫਿਰਾਹਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: bin naavai bahu fer firaahar |
English: Without the Name, one wanders all around.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਜਾਹਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sang dikhaaeaa jaahar |
English: The True Guru shows us that the Lord is with us.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak sache sach samaahar |1|
English: Servant Nanak merges in the Truest of the True. ||1||

[Ang 965 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਹਰ ਸਭਿ ਕਰਦਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਆਹਰੁ ਇਕੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aahar sabh karadaa firai aahar ik na hoe |
English: Making all sorts of efforts, they wander around; but they do not make even one effort.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਤੁ ਆਹਰਿ ਜਗੁ ਉਧਰੈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak jit aahar jag udharai viralaa boojhai koe |2|
English: O Nanak, how rare are those who understand the effort which saves the world. ||2||

[Ang 965 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਵਡੀ ਹੂ ਵਡਾ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਮਰਤਬਾ ॥
Transliteration: vaddee hoo vaddaa apaar teraa maratabaa |
English: The greatest of the great, infinite is Your dignity.

Gurbani: ਰੰਗ ਪਰੰਗ ਅਨੇਕ ਨ ਜਾਪਨਿੑ ਕਰਤਬਾ ॥
Transliteration: rang parang anek na jaapana karatabaa |
English: Your colors and hues are so numerous; no one can know Your actions.

Gurbani: ਜੀਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeea andar jeeo sabh kichh jaanalaa |
English: You are the Soul within all souls; You alone know everything.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਵਸਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਘਰੁ ਭਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh terai vas teraa ghar bhalaa |
English: Everything is under Your control; Your home is beautiful.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਵਧਾਈ ਤੁਧੁ ਘਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: terai ghar aanand vadhaaee tudh ghar |
English: Your home is filled with bliss, which resonates and resounds throughout Your home.

Gurbani: ਮਾਣੁ ਮਹਤਾ ਤੇਜੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪਿ ਜਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: maan mahataa tej aapanaa aap jar |
English: Your honor, majesty and glory are Yours alone.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਭਰਪੂਰੁ ਦਿਸੈ ਜਤ ਕਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: sarab kalaa bharapoor disai jat kataa |
English: You are overflowing with all powers; wherever we look, there You are.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਗੈ ਬਿਨਵਤਾ ॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: naanak daasan daas tudh aagai binavataa |18|
English: Nanak, the slave of Your slaves, prays to You alone. ||18||

[Ang 965 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਛਤੜੇ ਬਾਜਾਰ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਪਾਰੀਏ ॥
Transliteration: chhatarre baajaar sohan vich vapaaree |
English: Your streets are covered with canopies; under them, the traders look beautiful.

Gurbani: ਵਖਰੁ ਹਿਕੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਖਟੇ ਸੋ ਧਣੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: vakhar hik apaar naanak khatte so dhanee |1|
English: O Nanak, he alone is truly a banker, who buys the infinite commodity. ||1||

[Ang 965 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਬੀਰਾ ਹਮਰਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਹਮ ਕਿਸ ਹੂ ਕੇ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: kabeeraa hamaraa ko nahee ham kis hoo ke naeh |
English: Kabeer, no one is mine, and I belong to no one.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jin ihu rachan rachaaeaa tis hee maeh samaeh |2|
English: I am absorbed in the One, who created this creation. ||2||

[Ang 965 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਸਫਲਿਉ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਸੁਹਾਵੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਫਲ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: safaliau birakh suhaavarraa har safal amritaa |
English: The Lord is the most beautiful fruit tree, bearing fruits of Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਲੋਚੈ ਉਨੑ ਮਿਲਣ ਕਉ ਕਿਉ ਵੰਞੈ ਘਿਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: man lochai una milan kau kiau vanyai ghitaa |
English: My mind longs to meet Him; how can I ever find Him?

Gurbani: ਵਰਨਾ ਚਿਹਨਾ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਓਹੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਜਿਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: varanaa chihanaa baaharaa ohu agam ajitaa |
English: He has no color or form; He is inaccessible and unconquerable.

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਜੋ ਖੋਲੑੈ ਭਿਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: ohu piaaraa jeea kaa jo kholai bhitaa |
English: I love Him with all my soul; He opens the door for me.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੀ ਤੁਸਾੜੀਆ ਮੈ ਦਸਿਹੁ ਮਿਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: sevaa karee tusaarreea mai dasihu mitaa |
English: I shall serve you forever, if you tell me of my Friend.

Gurbani: ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਵੰਞਾ ਵਾਰਣੈ ਬਲੇ ਬਲਿ ਕਿਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: kurabaanee vanyaa vaaranai bale bal kitaa |
English: I am a sacrifice, a dedicated, devoted sacrifice to Him.

Gurbani: ਦਸਨਿ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਲਾਇ ਚਿਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: dasan sant piaariaa sunahu laae chitaa |
English: The Beloved Saints tell us, to listen with our consciousness.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਉ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਤਾ ॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: jis likhiaa naanak daas tis naau amrit satigur ditaa |19|
English: One who has such pre-ordained destiny, O slave Nanak, is blessed with the Ambrosial Name by the True Guru. ||19||

[Ang 965 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਬੀਰ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਤਸਕਰ ਬੈਸਹਿ ਗਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: kabeer dharatee saadh kee tasakar baiseh gaeh |
English: Kabeer, the earth belongs to the Holy, but the thieves have come and now sit among them.

Gurbani: ਧਰਤੀ ਭਾਰਿ ਨ ਬਿਆਪਈ ਉਨ ਕਉ ਲਾਹੂ ਲਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dharatee bhaar na biaapee un kau laahoo laeh |1|
English: The earth does not feel their weight; even they profit. ||1||

[Ang 965 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਬੀਰ ਚਾਵਲ ਕਾਰਣੇ ਤੁਖ ਕਉ ਮੁਹਲੀ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kabeer chaaval kaarane tukh kau muhalee laae |
English: Kabeer, for the sake of the rice, the husks are beaten and threshed.

Gurbani: ਸੰਗਿ ਕੁਸੰਗੀ ਬੈਸਤੇ ਤਬ ਪੂਛੇ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sang kusangee baisate tab poochhe dharam raae |2|
English: When one sits in the company of evil people, then he will be called to account by the Righteous Judge of Dharma. ||2||

[Ang 965 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਵਡ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ਆਪਿ ਇਕਾਤੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: aape hee vadd paravaar aap ikaateea |
English: He Himself has the greatest family; He Himself is all alone.

Gurbani: ਆਪਣੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਜਾਤੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: aapanee keemat aap aape hee jaateea |
English: He alone knows His own worth.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਉਪੰਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh aape aap aap upaniaa |
English: He Himself, by Himself, created everything.

Gurbani: ਆਪਣਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਰੰਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: aapanaa keetaa aap aap varaniaa |
English: Only He Himself can describe His own creation.

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਥਾਨੁ ਜਿਥੈ ਤੂ ਵੁਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: dhan su teraa thaan jithai too vutthaa |
English: Blessed is Your place, where You dwell, Lord.

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਸਚੁ ਤੂੰ ਡਿਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: dhan su tere bhagat jinaee sach toon dditthaa |
English: Blessed are Your devotees, who see You, O True Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਇਆ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਸੋਇ ਤੁਧੁ ॥
Transliteration: jis no teree deaa salaahe soe tudh |
English: He alone praises You, who is blessed by Your Grace.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਧੁ ॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: jis gur bhette naanak niramal soee sudh |20|
English: One who meets the Guru, O Nanak, is immaculate and sanctified. ||20||

[Ang 966 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਭੂਮਿ ਰੰਗਾਵਲੀ ਮੰਝਿ ਵਿਸੂਲਾ ਬਾਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: fareedaa bhoom rangaavalee manjh visoolaa baag |
English: Fareed, this world is beautiful, but there is a thorny garden within it.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਨਰ ਪੀਰਿ ਨਿਵਾਜਿਆ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਅੰਚ ਨ ਲਾਗ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jo nar peer nivaajiaa tinaa anch na laag |1|
English: Those who are blessed by their spiritual teacher are not even scratched. ||1||

[Ang 966 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਉਮਰ ਸੁਹਾਵੜੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਵੰਨੜੀ ਦੇਹ ॥
Transliteration: fareedaa umar suhaavarree sang suvanarree deh |
English: Fareed, blessed is the life, with such a beautiful body.

Gurbani: ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕੇਈ ਪਾਈਅਨਿੑ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨੇਹ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: virale keee paaeeana jinaa piaare neh |2|
English: How rare are those who are found to love their Beloved Lord. ||2||

[Ang 966 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jap tap sanjam deaa dharam jis dehi su paae |
English: He alone obtains meditation, austerities, self-discipline, compassion and Dharmic faith, whom the Lord so blesses.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਹਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਆਪਿ ਸੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: jis bujhaaeihi agan aap so naam dhiaae |
English: He alone meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, whose fire the Lord puts out.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਅਗਮ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਇਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਿਖਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: antarajaamee agam purakh ik drisatt dikhaae |
English: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, the Inaccessible Primal Lord, inspires us to look upon all with an impartial eye.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਆਸਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasangat kai aasarai prabh siau rang laae |
English: With the support of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one falls in love with God.

Gurbani: ਅਉਗਣ ਕਟਿ ਮੁਖੁ ਉਜਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਰਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aaugan katt mukh ujalaa har naam taraae |
English: One's faults are eradicated, and one's face becomes radiant and bright; through the Lord's Name, one crosses over.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭਉ ਕਟਿਓਨੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: janam maran bhau kattion fir jon na paae |
English: The fear of birth and death is removed, and he is not reincarnated again.

Gurbani: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਕਾਢਿਅਨੁ ਲੜੁ ਆਪਿ ਫੜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: andh koop te kaadtian larr aap farraae |
English: God lifts him up and pulls him out of the deep, dark pit, and attaches him to the hem of His robe.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਰਖੇ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਏ ॥੨੧॥
Transliteration: naanak bakhas milaaeian rakhe gal laae |21|
English: O Nanak, God forgives him, and holds him close in His embrace. ||21||

[Ang 966 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 |
English: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੁਹਬਤਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਦੀ ਰਤਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: muhabat jis khudaae dee rataa rang chalool |
English: One who loves God is imbued with the deep crimson color of His love.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਮੂਲਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak virale paaeeeh tis jan keem na mool |1|
English: O Nanak, such a person is rarely found; the value of such a humble person can never be estimated. ||1||

[Ang 966 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਃ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: mahalaa 5 |
English: Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਵਿਧਾ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭੀ ਸਚੁ ਡਿਠੋਮਿ ॥
Transliteration: andar vidhaa sach naae baahar bhee sach dditthom |
English: The True Name has pierced the nucleus of my self deep within. Outside, I see the True Lord as well.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਵਿਆ ਹਭ ਥਾਇ ਵਣਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਣਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਰੋਮਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak raviaa habh thaae van trin tribhavan rom |2|
English: O Nanak, He is pervading and permeating all places, the forests and the meadows, the three worlds, and every hair. ||2||

[Ang 966 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: paurree |
English: Pauree:

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕੀਤੋ ਰਚਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਰਤਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: aape keeto rachan aape hee ratiaa |
English: He Himself created the Universe; He Himself imbues it.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਹੋਇਓ ਇਕੁ ਆਪੇ ਬਹੁ ਭਤਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: aape hoeo ik aape bahu bhatiaa |
English: He Himself is One, and He Himself has numerous forms.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਭਨਾ ਮੰਝਿ ਆਪੇ ਬਾਹਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape sabhanaa manjh aape baaharaa |
English: He Himself is within all, and He Himself is beyond them.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਜਾਹਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape jaaneh door aape hee jaaharaa |
English: He Himself is known to be far away, and He Himself is right here.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਆਪੇ ਪਰਗਟੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: aape hoveh gupat aape paragatteeai |
English: He Himself is hidden, and He Himself is revealed.

Gurbani: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਪਾਇ ਤੇਰੀ ਥਟੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: keemat kisai na paae teree thatteeai |
English: No one can estimate the value of Your Creation, Lord.

Gurbani: ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਅਗਣਤੁ ਤੂੰ ॥
Transliteration: gahir ganbheer athaahu apaar aganat toon |
English: You are deep and profound, unfathomable, infinite and invaluable.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਰਤੈ ਇਕੁ ਇਕੋ ਇਕੁ ਤੂੰ ॥੨੨॥੧॥੨॥ ਸੁਧੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak varatai ik iko ik toon |22|1|2| sudh |
English: O Nanak, the One Lord is all-pervading. You are the One and only. ||22||1||2|| Sudh||

[Ang 966 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Satta and Balwand]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਰਾਇ ਬਲਵੰਡਿ ਤਥਾ ਸਤੈ ਡੂਮਿ ਆਖੀ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee kee vaar raae balavandd tathaa satai ddoom aakhee |
English: Vaar Of Raamkalee, Uttered By Satta And Balwand The Drummer:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਨਾਉ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਾਦਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਉ ਬੋਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੋਖੀਵਦੈ ॥
Transliteration: naau karataa kaadar kare kiau bol hovai jokheevadai |
English: One who chants the Name of the Almighty Creator - how can his words be judged?

Gurbani: ਦੇ ਗੁਨਾ ਸਤਿ ਭੈਣ ਭਰਾਵ ਹੈ ਪਾਰੰਗਤਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਪੜੀਵਦੈ ॥
Transliteration: de gunaa sat bhain bharaav hai paarangat daan parreevadai |
English: His divine virtues are the true sisters and brothers; through them, the gift of supreme status is obtained.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕਿ ਰਾਜੁ ਚਲਾਇਆ ਸਚੁ ਕੋਟੁ ਸਤਾਣੀ ਨੀਵ ਦੈ ॥
Transliteration: naanak raaj chalaaeaa sach kott sataanee neev dai |
English: Nanak established the kingdom; He built the true fortress on the strongest foundations.

Gurbani: ਲਹਣੇ ਧਰਿਓਨੁ ਛਤੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਦੈ ॥
Transliteration: lahane dharion chhat sir kar sifatee amrit peevadai |
English: He installed the royal canopy over Lehna's head; chanting the Lord's Praises, He drank in the Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਆਤਮ ਦੇਵ ਦੀ ਖੜਗਿ ਜੋਰਿ ਪਰਾਕੁਇ ਜੀਅ ਦੈ ॥
Transliteration: mat gur aatam dev dee kharrag jor paraakue jeea dai |
English: The Guru implanted the almighty sword of the Teachings to illuminate his soul.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਚੇਲੇ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਕੀਈ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਥੀਵਦੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur chele raharaas keeee naanak salaamat theevadai |
English: The Guru bowed down to His disciple, while Nanak was still alive.

Gurbani: ਸਹਿ ਟਿਕਾ ਦਿਤੋਸੁ ਜੀਵਦੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: seh ttikaa ditos jeevadai |1|
English: The King, while still alive, applied the ceremonial mark to his forehead. ||1||

[Ang 966 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Satta and Balwand]
Gurbani: ਲਹਣੇ ਦੀ ਫੇਰਾਈਐ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਦੋਹੀ ਖਟੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: lahane dee feraaeeai naanakaa dohee khatteeai |
English: Nanak proclaimed Lehna's succession - he earned it.

Gurbani: ਜੋਤਿ ਓਹਾ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਾਇ ਸਹਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਫੇਰਿ ਪਲਟੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: jot ohaa jugat saae seh kaaeaa fer palatteeai |
English: They shared the One Light and the same way; the King just changed His body.

Gurbani: ਝੁਲੈ ਸੁ ਛਤੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੀ ਮਲਿ ਤਖਤੁ ਬੈਠਾ ਗੁਰ ਹਟੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: jhulai su chhat niranjanee mal takhat baitthaa gur hatteeai |
English: The immaculate canopy waves over Him, and He sits on the throne in the Guru's shop.

Gurbani: ਕਰਹਿ ਜਿ ਗੁਰ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ਸਿਲ ਜੋਗੁ ਅਲੂਣੀ ਚਟੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: kareh ji gur furamaaeaa sil jog aloonee chatteeai |
English: He does as the Guru commands; He tasted the tasteless stone of Yoga.

Gurbani: ਲੰਗਰੁ ਚਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੀ ਖਟੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: langar chalai gur sabad har tott na aavee khatteeai |
English: The Langar - the Kitchen of the Guru's Shabad has been opened, and its supplies never run short.

Gurbani: ਖਰਚੇ ਦਿਤਿ ਖਸੰਮ ਦੀ ਆਪ ਖਹਦੀ ਖੈਰਿ ਦਬਟੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: kharache dit khasam dee aap khahadee khair dabatteeai |
English: Whatever His Master gave, He spent; He distributed it all to be eaten.

Gurbani: ਹੋਵੈ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਖਸੰਮ ਦੀ ਨੂਰੁ ਅਰਸਹੁ ਕੁਰਸਹੁ ਝਟੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: hovai sifat khasam dee noor arasahu kurasahu jhatteeai |
English: The Praises of the Master were sung, and the Divine Light descended from the heavens to the earth.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਡਿਠੇ ਸਚੇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਮਲੁ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਦੀ ਕਟੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: tudh dditthe sache paatisaah mal janam janam dee katteeai |
English: Gazing upon You, O True King, the filth of countless past lives is washed away.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ਕਿਉ ਏਦੂ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਹਟੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: sach ji gur furamaaeaa kiau edoo bolahu hatteeai |
English: The Guru gave the True Command; why should we hesitate to proclaim this?

Gurbani: ਪੁਤ੍ਰੀ ਕਉਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਲਿਓ ਕਰਿ ਪੀਰਹੁ ਕੰਨੑ ਮੁਰਟੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: putree kaul na paalio kar peerahu kana muratteeai |
English: His sons did not obey His Word; they turned their backs on Him as Guru.

Gurbani: ਦਿਲਿ ਖੋਟੈ ਆਕੀ ਫਿਰਨਿੑ ਬੰਨਿੑ ਭਾਰੁ ਉਚਾਇਨਿੑ ਛਟੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: dil khottai aakee firana bana bhaar uchaaeina chhatteeai |
English: These evil-hearted ones became rebellious; they carry loads of sin on their backs.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਆਖੀ ਸੋਈ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤੀ ਤਿਨੈ ਥਟੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: jin aakhee soee kare jin keetee tinai thatteeai |
English: Whatever the Guru said, Lehna did, and so he was installed on the throne.

Gurbani: ਕਉਣੁ ਹਾਰੇ ਕਿਨਿ ਉਵਟੀਐ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kaun haare kin uvatteeai |2|
English: Who has lost, and who has won? ||2||

[Ang 967 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Satta and Balwand]
Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤੀ ਸੋ ਮੰਨਣਾ ਕੋ ਸਾਲੁ ਜਿਵਾਹੇ ਸਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: jin keetee so mananaa ko saal jivaahe saalee |
English: He who did the work, is accepted as Guru; so which is better - the thistle or the rice?

Gurbani: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਹੈ ਦੇਵਤਾ ਲੈ ਗਲਾ ਕਰੇ ਦਲਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: dharam raae hai devataa lai galaa kare dalaalee |
English: The Righteous Judge of Dharma considered the arguments and made the decision.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਖੈ ਸਚਾ ਕਰੇ ਸਾ ਬਾਤ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਰਹਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: satigur aakhai sachaa kare saa baat hovai darahaalee |
English: Whatever the True Guru says, the True Lord does; it comes to pass instantaneously.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਅੰਗਦ ਦੀ ਦੋਹੀ ਫਿਰੀ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਤੈ ਬੰਧਿ ਬਹਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur angad dee dohee firee sach karatai bandh bahaalee |
English: Guru Angad was proclaimed, and the True Creator confirmed it.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਪਲਟੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਲਿ ਤਖਤੁ ਬੈਠਾ ਸੈ ਡਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: naanak kaaeaa palatt kar mal takhat baitthaa sai ddaalee |
English: Nanak merely changed his body; He still sits on the throne, with hundreds of branches reaching out.

Gurbani: ਦਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਉਮਤਿ ਖੜੀ ਮਸਕਲੈ ਹੋਇ ਜੰਗਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: dar seve umat kharree masakalai hoe jangaalee |
English: Standing at His door, His followers serve Him; by this service, their rust is scraped off.

Gurbani: ਦਰਿ ਦਰਵੇਸੁ ਖਸੰਮ ਦੈ ਨਾਇ ਸਚੈ ਬਾਣੀ ਲਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: dar daraves khasam dai naae sachai baanee laalee |
English: He is the Dervish - the Saint, at the door of His Lord and Master; He loves the True Name, and the Bani of the Guru's Word.

Gurbani: ਬਲਵੰਡ ਖੀਵੀ ਨੇਕ ਜਨ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਛਾਉ ਪਤ੍ਰਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: balavandd kheevee nek jan jis bahutee chhaau patraalee |
English: Balwand says that Khivi, the Guru's wife, is a noble woman, who gives soothing, leafy shade to all.

Gurbani: ਲੰਗਰਿ ਦਉਲਤਿ ਵੰਡੀਐ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਖੀਰਿ ਘਿਆਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: langar daulat vanddeeai ras amrit kheer ghiaalee |
English: She distributes the bounty of the Guru's Langar; the kheer - the rice pudding and ghee, is like sweet ambrosia.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਥੀਏ ਪਰਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: gurasikhaa ke mukh ujale manamukh thee paraalee |
English: The faces of the Guru's Sikhs are radiant and bright; the self-willed manmukhs are pale, like straw.

Gurbani: ਪਏ ਕਬੂਲੁ ਖਸੰਮ ਨਾਲਿ ਜਾਂ ਘਾਲ ਮਰਦੀ ਘਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: pe kabool khasam naal jaan ghaal maradee ghaalee |
English: The Master gave His approval, when Angad exerted Himself heroically.

Gurbani: ਮਾਤਾ ਖੀਵੀ ਸਹੁ ਸੋਇ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੋਇ ਉਠਾਲੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: maataa kheevee sahu soe jin goe utthaalee |3|
English: Such is the Husband of mother Khivi; He sustains the world. ||3||

[Ang 967 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Satta and Balwand]
Gurbani: ਹੋਰਿਂਓ ਗੰਗ ਵਹਾਈਐ ਦੁਨਿਆਈ ਆਖੈ ਕਿ ਕਿਓਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: horino gang vahaaeeai duniaaee aakhai ki kion |
English: It is as if the Guru made the Ganges flow in the opposite direction, and the world wonders: what has he done?

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਈਸਰਿ ਜਗਨਾਥਿ ਉਚਹਦੀ ਵੈਣੁ ਵਿਰਿਕਿਓਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak eesar jaganaath uchahadee vain virikion |
English: Nanak, the Lord, the Lord of the World, spoke the words out loud.

Gurbani: ਮਾਧਾਣਾ ਪਰਬਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਨੇਤ੍ਰਿ ਬਾਸਕੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਿੜਕਿਓਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: maadhaanaa parabat kar netr baasak sabad rirrakion |
English: Making the mountain his churning stick, and the snake-king his churning string, He has churned the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਚਉਦਹ ਰਤਨ ਨਿਕਾਲਿਅਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਚਿਲਕਿਓਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: chaudah ratan nikaalian kar aavaa gaun chilakion |
English: From it, He extracted the fourteen jewels, and illuminated the world.

Gurbani: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਅਹਿ ਵੇਖਾਲੀਅਨੁ ਜਿਣਿ ਐਵਡ ਪਿਡ ਠਿਣਕਿਓਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: kudarat eh vekhaaleean jin aivadd pidd tthinakion |
English: He revealed such creative power, and touched such greatness.

Gurbani: ਲਹਣੇ ਧਰਿਓਨੁ ਛਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਅਸਮਾਨਿ ਕਿਆੜਾ ਛਿਕਿਓਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: lahane dharion chhatru sir asamaan kiaarraa chhikion |
English: He raised the royal canopy to wave over the head of Lehna, and raised His glory to the skies.

Gurbani: ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਾਹਿ ਆਪੁ ਆਪੈ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਿਕਿਓਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: jot samaanee jot maeh aap aapai setee mikion |
English: His Light merged into the Light, and He blended Him into Himself.

Gurbani: ਸਿਖਾਂ ਪੁਤ੍ਰਾਂ ਘੋਖਿ ਕੈ ਸਭ ਉਮਤਿ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਜਿ ਕਿਓਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: sikhaan putraan ghokh kai sabh umat vekhahu ji kion |
English: Guru Nanak tested His Sikhs and His sons, and everyone saw what happened.

Gurbani: ਜਾਂ ਸੁਧੋਸੁ ਤਾਂ ਲਹਣਾ ਟਿਕਿਓਨੁ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jaan sudhos taan lahanaa ttikion |4|
English: When Lehna alone was found to be pure, then He was set on the throne. ||4||

[Ang 967 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Satta and Balwand]
Gurbani: ਫੇਰਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ਫੇਰੁਆਣਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਖਾਡੂਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: fer vasaaeaa feruaan satigur khaaddoor |
English: Then, the True Guru, the son of Pheru, came to dwell at Khadoor.

Gurbani: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਮੁਚੁ ਗਰੂਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jap tap sanjam naal tudh hor much garoor |
English: Meditation, austerities and self-discipline rest with You, while the others are filled with excessive pride.

Gurbani: ਲਬੁ ਵਿਣਾਹੇ ਮਾਣਸਾ ਜਿਉ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੂਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: lab vinaahe maanasaa jiau paanee boor |
English: Greed ruins mankind, like the green algae in the water.

Gurbani: ਵਰ੍ਹਿਐ ਦਰਗਹ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ ਕੁਦਰਤੀ ਨੂਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: varhiai daragah guroo kee kudaratee noor |
English: In the Guru's Court, the Divine Light shines in its creative power.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਸੁ ਹਾਥ ਨ ਲਭਈ ਤੂੰ ਓਹੁ ਠਰੂਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jit su haath na labhee toon ohu ttharoor |
English: You are the cooling peace, whose depth cannot be found.

Gurbani: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਭਰਪੂਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: nau nidh naam nidhaan hai tudh vich bharapoor |
English: You are overflowing with the nine treasures, and the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਵੰਞੈ ਚੂਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: nindaa teree jo kare so vanyai choor |
English: Whoever slanders You will be totally ruined and destroyed.

Gurbani: ਨੇੜੈ ਦਿਸੈ ਮਾਤ ਲੋਕ ਤੁਧੁ ਸੁਝੈ ਦੂਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: nerrai disai maat lok tudh sujhai door |
English: People of the world can see only what is near at hand, but You can see far beyond.

Gurbani: ਫੇਰਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ਫੇਰੁਆਣਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਖਾਡੂਰੁ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: fer vasaaeaa feruaan satigur khaaddoor |5|
English: Then the True Guru, the son of Pheru, came to dwell at Khadoor. ||5||

[Ang 968 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Satta and Balwand]
Gurbani: ਸੋ ਟਿਕਾ ਸੋ ਬੈਹਣਾ ਸੋਈ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: so ttikaa so baihanaa soee deebaan |
English: The same mark on the forehead, the same throne, and the same Royal Court.

Gurbani: ਪਿਯੂ ਦਾਦੇ ਜੇਵਿਹਾ ਪੋਤਾ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: piyoo daade jevihaa potaa paravaan |
English: Just like the father and grandfather, the son is approved.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਬਾਸਕੁ ਨੇਤ੍ਰੈ ਘਤਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਨੇਹੀ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: jin baasak netrai ghatiaa kar nehee taan |
English: He took the thousand-headed serpent as his churning string, and with the force of devotional love,

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਵਿਰੋਲਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਮੇਰੁ ਮਧਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: jin samund viroliaa kar mer madhaan |
English: he churned the ocean of the world with his churning stick, the Sumayr mountain.

Gurbani: ਚਉਦਹ ਰਤਨ ਨਿਕਾਲਿਅਨੁ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਚਾਨਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: chaudah ratan nikaalian keeton chaanaan |
English: He extracted the fourteen jewels, and brought forth the Divine Light.

Gurbani: ਘੋੜਾ ਕੀਤੋ ਸਹਜ ਦਾ ਜਤੁ ਕੀਓ ਪਲਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: ghorraa keeto sehaj daa jat keeo palaan |
English: He made intuition his horse, and chastity his saddle.

Gurbani: ਧਣਖੁ ਚੜਾਇਓ ਸਤ ਦਾ ਜਸ ਹੰਦਾ ਬਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: dhanakh charraaeo sat daa jas handaa baan |
English: He placed the arrow of the Lord's Praise in the bow of Truth.

Gurbani: ਕਲਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਧੂ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ਸਾ ਚੜਿਆ ਰੈ ਭਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: kal vich dhoo andhaar saa charriaa rai bhaan |
English: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, there was only pitch darkness. Then, He rose like the sun to illuminate the darkness.

Gurbani: ਸਤਹੁ ਖੇਤੁ ਜਮਾਇਓ ਸਤਹੁ ਛਾਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: satahu khet jamaaeo satahu chhaavaan |
English: He farms the field of Truth, and spreads out the canopy of Truth.

Gurbani: ਨਿਤ ਰਸੋਈ ਤੇਰੀਐ ਘਿਉ ਮੈਦਾ ਖਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: nit rasoee tereeai ghiau maidaa khaan |
English: Your kitchen always has ghee and flour to eat.

Gurbani: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾਂ ਸੁਝੀਓਸੁ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: chaare kunddaan sujheeos man meh sabad paravaan |
English: You understand the four corners of the universe; in your mind, the Word of the Shabad is approved and supreme.

Gurbani: ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿਓ ਕਰਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: aavaa gaun nivaario kar nadar neesaan |
English: You eliminate the comings and goings of reincarnation, and bestow the insignia of Your Glance of Grace.

Gurbani: ਅਉਤਰਿਆ ਅਉਤਾਰੁ ਲੈ ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: aautariaa aautaar lai so purakh sujaan |
English: You are the Avataar, the Incarnation of the all-knowing Primal Lord.

Gurbani: ਝਖੜਿ ਵਾਉ ਨ ਡੋਲਈ ਪਰਬਤੁ ਮੇਰਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: jhakharr vaau na ddolee parabat meraan |
English: You are not pushed or shaken by the storm and the wind; you are like the Sumayr Mountain.

Gurbani: ਜਾਣੈ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਜਾਣੀ ਹੂ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: jaanai birathaa jeea kee jaanee hoo jaan |
English: You know the inner state of the soul; You are the Knower of knowers.

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਚੇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਜਾਂ ਤੂ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa saalaahee sache paatisaah jaan too sugharr sujaan |
English: How can I praise You, O True Supreme King, when You are so wise and all-knowing?

Gurbani: ਦਾਨੁ ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਵਸੀ ਸੋ ਸਤੇ ਦਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: daan ji satigur bhaavasee so sate daan |
English: Those blessings granted by the Pleasure of the True Guru - please bless Satta with those gifts.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੰਦਾ ਛਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਉਮਤਿ ਹੈਰਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: naanak handaa chhatru sir umat hairaan |
English: Seeing Nanak's canopy waving over Your head, everyone was astonished.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਟਿਕਾ ਸੋ ਬੈਹਣਾ ਸੋਈ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: so ttikaa so baihanaa soee deebaan |
English: The same mark on the forehead, the same throne, and the same Royal Court.

Gurbani: ਪਿਯੂ ਦਾਦੇ ਜੇਵਿਹਾ ਪੋਤ੍ਰਾ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: piyoo daade jevihaa potraa paravaan |6|
English: Just like the father and grandfather, the son is approved. ||6||

[Ang 968 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Satta and Balwand]
Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਰਿਆ ਤਿਨੈ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan raamadaas gur jin siriaa tinai savaariaa |
English: Blessed, blessed is Guru Raam Daas; He who created You, has also exalted You.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੀ ਹੋਈ ਕਰਾਮਾਤਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੈ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: pooree hoee karaamaat aap sirajanahaarai dhaariaa |
English: Perfect is Your miracle; the Creator Lord Himself has installed You on the throne.

Gurbani: ਸਿਖੀ ਅਤੈ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sikhee atai sangatee paarabraham kar namasakaariaa |
English: The Sikhs and all the Congregation recognize You as the Supreme Lord God, and bow down to You.

Gurbani: ਅਟਲੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਅਤੋਲੁ ਤੂ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: attal athaahu atol too teraa ant na paaraavaariaa |
English: You are unchanging, unfathomable and immeasurable; You have no end or limitation.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਤੂੰ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਸੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jinaee toon seviaa bhaau kar se tudh paar utaariaa |
English: Those who serve You with love - You carry them across.

Gurbani: ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਢੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਪਰਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: lab lobh kaam krodh mohu maar kadte tudh saparavaariaa |
English: Greed, envy, sexual desire, anger and emotional attachment - You have beaten them and driven them out.

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਥਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਪੈਸਕਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: dhan su teraa thaan hai sach teraa paisakaariaa |
English: Blessed is Your place, and True is Your magnificent glory.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤੂ ਲਹਣਾ ਤੂਹੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਮਰੁ ਤੂ ਵੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: naanak too lahanaa toohai gur amar too veechaariaa |
English: You are Nanak, You are Angad, and You are Amar Daas; so do I recognize You.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਡਿਠਾ ਤਾਂ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਧਾਰਿਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: gur dditthaa taan man saadhaariaa |7|
English: When I saw the Guru, then my mind was comforted and consoled. ||7||

[Ang 968 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Satta and Balwand]
Gurbani: ਚਾਰੇ ਜਾਗੇ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗੀ ਪੰਚਾਇਣੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੋਆ ॥
Transliteration: chaare jaage chahu jugee panchaaein aape hoaa |
English: The four Gurus enlightened the four ages; the Lord Himself assumed the fifth form.

Gurbani: ਆਪੀਨੑੈ ਆਪੁ ਸਾਜਿਓਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਥੰਮਿੑ ਖਲੋਆ ॥
Transliteration: aapeenai aap saajion aape hee thama khaloaa |
English: He created Himself, and He Himself is the supporting pillar.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਪਟੀ ਕਲਮ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਲਿਖਣਹਾਰਾ ਹੋਆ ॥
Transliteration: aape pattee kalam aap aap likhanahaaraa hoaa |
English: He Himself is the paper, He Himself is the pen, and He Himself is the writer.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਉਮਤਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਵਣੀ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਨਵਾ ਨਿਰੋਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabh umat aavan jaavanee aape hee navaa niroaa |
English: All His followers come and go; He alone is fresh and new.

Gurbani: ਤਖਤਿ ਬੈਠਾ ਅਰਜਨ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਖਿਵੈ ਚੰਦੋਆ ॥
Transliteration: takhat baitthaa arajan guroo satigur kaa khivai chandoaa |
English: Guru Arjun sits on the throne; the royal canopy waves over the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਉਗਵਣਹੁ ਤੈ ਆਥਵਣਹੁ ਚਹੁ ਚਕੀ ਕੀਅਨੁ ਲੋਆ ॥
Transliteration: augavanahu tai aathavanahu chahu chakee keean loaa |
English: From east to west, He illuminates the four directions.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਪਇਆ ਮੋਆ ॥
Transliteration: jinaee guroo na sevio manamukhaa peaa moaa |
English: Those self-willed manmukhs who do not serve the Guru die in shame.

Gurbani: ਦੂਣੀ ਚਉਣੀ ਕਰਾਮਾਤਿ ਸਚੇ ਕਾ ਸਚਾ ਢੋਆ ॥
Transliteration: doonee chaunee karaamaat sache kaa sachaa dtoaa |
English: Your miracles increase two-fold, even four-fold; this is the True Lord's true blessing.

Gurbani: ਚਾਰੇ ਜਾਗੇ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗੀ ਪੰਚਾਇਣੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੋਆ ॥੮॥੧॥
Transliteration: chaare jaage chahu jugee panchaaein aape hoaa |8|1|
English: The four Gurus enlightened the four ages; the Lord Himself assumed the fifth form. ||8||1||

[Ang 968 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ॥ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee baanee bhagataa kee | kabeer jeeo |
English: Raamkalee, The Word Of The Devotees. Kabeer Jee:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਲਾਲਨਿ ਲਾਹਨਿ ਮੇਲਉ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁੜੁ ਕੀਨੁ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa kalaalan laahan melau gur kaa sabad gurr keen re |
English: Make your body the vat, and mix in the yeast. Let the Word of the Guru's Shabad be the molasses.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਮਦ ਮਤਸਰ ਕਾਟਿ ਕਾਟਿ ਕਸੁ ਦੀਨੁ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: trisanaa kaam krodh mad matasar kaatt kaatt kas deen re |1|
English: Cut up desire, sexuality, anger, pride and envy, and let them be the fermenting bark. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਸੰਤੁ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਦੇਉ ਦਲਾਲੀ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: koee hai re sant sehaj sukh antar jaa kau jap tap deo dalaalee re |
English: Is there any Saint, with intuitive peace and poise deep within, unto whom I might offer my meditation and austerities as payment?

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਬੂੰਦ ਭਰਿ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਵਉ ਜੋ ਮਦੁ ਦੇਇ ਕਲਾਲੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ek boond bhar tan man devau jo mad dee kalaalee re |1| rahaau |
English: I dedicate my body and mind to whoever gives me even a drop of this wine from such a vat. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਭਵਨ ਚਤੁਰ ਦਸ ਭਾਠੀ ਕੀਨੑੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਗਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਜਾਰੀ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: bhavan chatur das bhaatthee keenaee braham agan tan jaaree re |
English: I have made the fourteen worlds the furnace, and I have burnt my body with the fire of God.

Gurbani: ਮੁਦ੍ਰਾ ਮਦਕ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਸੁਖਮਨ ਪੋਚਨਹਾਰੀ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mudraa madak sehaj dhun laagee sukhaman pochanahaaree re |2|
English: My mudra - my hand-gesture, is the pipe; tuning into the celestial sound current within, the Shushmanaa - the central spinal channel, is my cooling pad. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੀਰਥ ਬਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਸੁਚਿ ਸੰਜਮ ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਗਹਨੈ ਦੇਉ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: teerath barat nem such sanjam rav sas gahanai deo re |
English: Pilgrimages, fasting, vows, purifications, self-discipline, austerities and breath control through the sun and moon channels - all these I pledge.

Gurbani: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਪਿਆਲ ਸੁਧਾ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਏਹੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਪੇਉ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: surat piaal sudhaa ras amrit ehu mahaa ras peo re |3|
English: My focused consciousness is the cup, and the Ambrosial Nectar is the pure juice. I drink in the supreme, sublime essence of this juice. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਿਝਰ ਧਾਰ ਚੁਐ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਇਹ ਰਸ ਮਨੂਆ ਰਾਤੋ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: nijhar dhaar chuai at niramal ih ras manooaa raato re |
English: The pure stream constantly trickles forth, and my mind is intoxicated by this sublime essence.

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਸਗਲੇ ਮਦ ਛੂਛੇ ਇਹੈ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਸਾਚੋ ਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: keh kabeer sagale mad chhoochhe ihai mahaa ras saacho re |4|1|
English: Says Kabeer, all other wines are trivial and tasteless; this is the only true, sublime essence. ||4||1||

[Ang 969 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਗੁੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਹੂਆ ਭਉ ਭਾਠੀ ਮਨ ਧਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: gurr kar giaan dhiaan kar mahooaa bhau bhaatthee man dhaaraa |
English: Make spiritual wisdom the molasses, meditation the flowers, and the Fear of God the fire enshrined in your mind.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖਮਨ ਨਾਰੀ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਨੀ ਪੀਵੈ ਪੀਵਨਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sukhaman naaree sehaj samaanee peevai peevanahaaraa |1|
English: The Shushmanaa, the central spinal channel, is intuitively balanced, and the drinker drinks in this wine. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਉਧੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਤਵਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aaudhoo meraa man matavaaraa |
English: O hermit Yogi, my mind is intoxicated.

Gurbani: ਉਨਮਦ ਚਢਾ ਮਦਨ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਨ ਭਇਆ ਉਜਿਆਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aunamad chadtaa madan ras chaakhiaa tribhavan bheaa ujiaaraa |1| rahaau |
English: When that wine rises up, one tastes the sublime essence of this juice, and sees across the three worlds. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦੁਇ ਪੁਰ ਜੋਰਿ ਰਸਾਈ ਭਾਠੀ ਪੀਉ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: due pur jor rasaaee bhaatthee peeo mahaa ras bhaaree |
English: Joining the two channels of the breath, I have lit the furnace, and I drink in the supreme, sublime essence.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਦੁਇ ਕੀਏ ਜਲੇਤਾ ਛੂਟਿ ਗਈ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh due kee jaletaa chhoott gee sansaaree |2|
English: I have burnt both sexual desire and anger, and I have been emancipated from the world. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਗੰਮਿਤ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸੁਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: pragatt pragaas giaan gur gamit satigur te sudh paaee |
English: The light of spiritual wisdom enlightens me; meeting with the Guru, the True Guru, I have obtained this understanding.

Gurbani: ਦਾਸੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਤਾਸੁ ਮਦ ਮਾਤਾ ਉਚਕਿ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥੨॥
Transliteration: daas kabeer taas mad maataa uchak na kabahoo jaaee |3|2|
English: Slave Kabeer is intoxicated with that wine, which never wears off. ||3||2||

[Ang 969 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੋ ਮੇਰੁ ਪਰਬਤੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਮੈ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: toon mero mer parabat suaamee ott gahee mai teree |
English: You are my Sumayr Mountain, O my Lord and Master; I have grasped Your Support.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਤੁਮ ਡੋਲਹੁ ਨਾ ਹਮ ਗਿਰਤੇ ਰਖਿ ਲੀਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naa tum ddolahu naa ham girate rakh leenee har meree |1|
English: You do not shake, and I do not fall. You have preserved my honor. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਤਬ ਜਬ ਕਬ ਤੁਹੀ ਤੁਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: ab tab jab kab tuhee tuhee |
English: Now and then, here and there, You, only You.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਤੁਅ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਸੁਖੀ ਸਦ ਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ham tua parasaad sukhee sad hee |1| rahaau |
English: By Your Grace, I am forever in peace. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੋਰੇ ਭਰੋਸੇ ਮਗਹਰ ਬਸਿਓ ਮੇਰੇ ਤਨ ਕੀ ਤਪਤਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: tore bharose magahar basio mere tan kee tapat bujhaaee |
English: Relying upon You, I can live even in the cursed place of Magahar; You have put out the fire of my body.

Gurbani: ਪਹਿਲੇ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਮਗਹਰ ਪਾਇਓ ਫੁਨਿ ਕਾਸੀ ਬਸੇ ਆਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: pahile darasan magahar paaeo fun kaasee base aaee |2|
English: First, I obtained the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan in Magahar; then, I came to dwell at Benares. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੈਸਾ ਮਗਹਰੁ ਤੈਸੀ ਕਾਸੀ ਹਮ ਏਕੈ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: jaisaa magahar taisee kaasee ham ekai kar jaanee |
English: As is Magahar, so is Benares; I see them as one and the same.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਨਿਰਧਨ ਜਿਉ ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਰਤੇ ਫੂਟਿ ਗੁਮਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ham niradhan jiau ihu dhan paaeaa marate foott gumaanee |3|
English: I am poor, but I have obtained this wealth of the Lord; the proud are bursting with pride, and die. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਰੈ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ਚੁਭਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੂਲਾ ਕੋ ਕਾਢਨ ਕਉ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: karai gumaan chubheh tis soolaa ko kaadtan kau naahee |
English: One who takes pride in himself is stuck with thorns; no one can pull them out.

Gurbani: ਅਜੈ ਸੁ ਚੋਭ ਕਉ ਬਿਲਲ ਬਿਲਾਤੇ ਨਰਕੇ ਘੋਰ ਪਚਾਹੀ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: ajai su chobh kau bilal bilaate narake ghor pachaahee |4|
English: Here, he cries bitterly, and hereafter, he burns in the most hideous hell. ||4||

Gurbani: ਕਵਨੁ ਨਰਕੁ ਕਿਆ ਸੁਰਗੁ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ਸੰਤਨ ਦੋਊ ਰਾਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: kavan narak kiaa surag bichaaraa santan doaoo raade |
English: What is hell, and what is heaven? The Saints reject them both.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ਨ ਕਢਤੇ ਅਪਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: ham kaahoo kee kaan na kadtate apane gur parasaade |5|
English: I have no obligation to either of them, by the Grace of my Guru. ||5||

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਤਉ ਜਾਇ ਚਢੇ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਨਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਹੈ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਪਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: ab tau jaae chadte singhaasan mile hai saaringapaanee |
English: Now, I have mounted to the throne of the Lord; I have met the Lord, the Sustainer of the World.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਏਕ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਪਛਾਨੀ ॥੬॥੩॥
Transliteration: raam kabeeraa ek bhe hai koe na sakai pachhaanee |6|3|
English: The Lord and Kabeer have become one. No one can tell them apart. ||6||3||

[Ang 969 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਸੰਤਾ ਮਾਨਉ ਦੂਤਾ ਡਾਨਉ ਇਹ ਕੁਟਵਾਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: santaa maanau dootaa ddaanau ih kuttavaaree meree |
English: I honor and obey the Saints, and punish the wicked; this is my duty as God's police officer.

Gurbani: ਦਿਵਸ ਰੈਨਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਪਾਉ ਪਲੋਸਉ ਕੇਸ ਚਵਰ ਕਰਿ ਫੇਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: divas rain tere paau palosau kes chavar kar feree |1|
English: Day and night, I wash Your feet, Lord; I wave my hair as the chauree, to brush away the flies. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਕੂਕਰ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: ham kookar tere darabaar |
English: I am a dog at Your Court, Lord.

Gurbani: ਭਉਕਹਿ ਆਗੈ ਬਦਨੁ ਪਸਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhaukeh aagai badan pasaar |1| rahaau |
English: I open my snout and bark before it. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਬ ਜਨਮ ਹਮ ਤੁਮੑਰੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਅਬ ਤਉ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: poorab janam ham tumare sevak ab tau mittiaa na jaaee |
English: In my past life, I was Your servant; now, I cannot leave You.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੇ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਧੁਨਿ ਸਹਜ ਕੀ ਮਾਥੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਦਗਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tere duaarai dhun sehaj kee maathai mere dagaaee |2|
English: The celestial sound current resounds at Your Door. Your insignia is stamped upon my forehead. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦਾਗੇ ਹੋਹਿ ਸੁ ਰਨ ਮਹਿ ਜੂਝਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਦਾਗੇ ਭਗਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: daage hohi su ran meh joojheh bin daage bhag jaaee |
English: Those who are branded with Your brand fight bravely in battle; those without Your brand run away.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਛਾਨੈ ਹਰਿ ਲਏ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: saadhoo hoe su bhagat pachhaanai har le khajaanai paaee |3|
English: One who becomes a Holy person, appreciates the value of devotional worship to the Lord. The Lord places him in His treasury. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕੋਠਰੇ ਮਹਿ ਕੋਠਰੀ ਪਰਮ ਕੋਠੀ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: kotthare meh kottharee param kotthee beechaar |
English: In the fortress is the chamber; by contemplative meditation it becomes the supreme chamber.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਬਸਤੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਕਉ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਬਸਤੁ ਸਮੑਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: gur deenee basat kabeer kau levahu basat samaar |4|
English: The Guru has blessed Kabeer with the commodity, saying, "Take this commodity; cherish it and keep it secure." ||4||

Gurbani: ਕਬੀਰਿ ਦੀਈ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕਉ ਲੀਨੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: kabeer deeee sansaar kau leenee jis masatak bhaag |
English: Kabeer gives it to the world, but he alone receives it, upon whose forehead such destiny is recorded.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਥਿਰੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ॥੫॥੪॥
Transliteration: amrit ras jin paaeaa thir taa kaa sohaag |5|4|
English: Permanent is the marriage, of one who receives this ambrosial essence. ||5||4||

[Ang 970 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਮੁਖ ਬੇਦੁ ਗਾਇਤ੍ਰੀ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਨੁ ਬਿਸਰੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: jih mukh bed gaaeitree nikasai so kiau brahaman bisar karai |
English: O Brahmin, how can you forget the One, from whose mouth the Vedas and the Gayitri prayer issured forth?

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਪਾਇ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਨ ਕਹੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jaa kai paae jagat sabh laagai so kiau panddit har na kahai |1|
English: The whole world falls at His feet; why don't you chant the Name of that Lord, O Pandit? ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਾਹੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਮੑਨ ਹਰਿ ਨ ਕਹਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: kaahe mere baaman har na kaheh |
English: Why, O my Brahmin, do you not chant the Lord's Name?

Gurbani: ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਪਾਡੇ ਦੋਜਕੁ ਭਰਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raam na boleh paadde dojak bhareh |1| rahaau |
English: If you don't chant the Lord's Name, O Pandit, you will only suffer in hell. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਪਨ ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਘਰਿ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਹਠੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਉਦਰੁ ਭਰਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: aapan aooch neech ghar bhojan hatthe karam kar udar bhareh |
English: You think that you are high, but you take food from the houses of the lowly; you fill up your belly by forcibly practicing your rituals.

Gurbani: ਚਉਦਸ ਅਮਾਵਸ ਰਚਿ ਰਚਿ ਮਾਂਗਹਿ ਕਰ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਲੈ ਕੂਪਿ ਪਰਹਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: chaudas amaavas rach rach maangeh kar deepak lai koop pareh |2|
English: On the fourteenth day, and the night of the new moon, you go out begging; even though you hold the lamp in your hands, still, you fall into the pit. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੂੰ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਨੁ ਮੈ ਕਾਸੀਕ ਜੁਲਹਾ ਮੁਹਿ ਤੋਹਿ ਬਰਾਬਰੀ ਕੈਸੇ ਕੈ ਬਨਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: toon brahaman mai kaaseek julahaa muhi tohi baraabaree kaise kai baneh |
English: You are a Brahmin, and I am only a weaver from Benares. How can I compare to you?

Gurbani: ਹਮਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕਹਿ ਉਬਰੇ ਬੇਦ ਭਰੋਸੇ ਪਾਂਡੇ ਡੂਬਿ ਮਰਹਿ ॥੩॥੫॥
Transliteration: hamare raam naam keh ubare bed bharose paandde ddoob mareh |3|5|
English: Chanting the Lord's Name, I have been saved; relying on the Vedas, O Brahmin, you shall drown and die. ||3||5||

[Ang 970 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਤਰਵਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਅਨੰਤ ਡਾਰ ਸਾਖਾ ਪੁਹਪ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਰਸ ਭਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: taravar ek anant ddaar saakhaa puhap patr ras bhareea |
English: There is a single tree, with countless branches and twigs; its flowers and leaves are filled with its juice.

Gurbani: ਇਹ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕੀ ਬਾੜੀ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਤਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰੀਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: eih amrit kee baarree hai re tin har poorai kareea |1|
English: This world is a garden of Ambrosial Nectar. The Perfect Lord created it. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਾਨੀ ਜਾਨੀ ਰੇ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਕਹਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: jaanee jaanee re raajaa raam kee kahaanee |
English: I have come to know the story of my Sovereign Lord.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਿਰਲੈ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: antar jot raam paragaasaa guramukh biralai jaanee |1| rahaau |
English: How rare is that Gurmukh who knows, and whose inner being is illumined by the Lord's Light. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਭਵਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਪੁਹਪ ਰਸ ਬੀਧਾ ਬਾਰਹ ਲੇ ਉਰ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: bhavar ek puhap ras beedhaa baarah le ur dhariaa |
English: The bumble bee, addicted to the nectar of the twelve-petalled flowers, enshrines it in the heart.

Gurbani: ਸੋਰਹ ਮਧੇ ਪਵਨੁ ਝਕੋਰਿਆ ਆਕਾਸੇ ਫਰੁ ਫਰਿਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sorah madhe pavan jhakoriaa aakaase far fariaa |2|
English: He holds his breath suspended in the sixteen-petalled sky of the Akaashic Ethers, and beats his wings in esctasy. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਹਜ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਇਕੁ ਬਿਰਵਾ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਧਰਤੀ ਜਲਹਰੁ ਸੋਖਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj sun ik biravaa upajiaa dharatee jalahar sokhiaa |
English: In the profound void of intuitive Samaadhi, the one tree rises up; it soaks up the water of desire from the ground.

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਹਉ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਬਿਰਵਾ ਦੇਖਿਆ ॥੩॥੬॥
Transliteration: keh kabeer hau taa kaa sevak jin ihu biravaa dekhiaa |3|6|
English: Says Kabeer, I am the servant of those who have seen this celestial tree. ||3||6||

[Ang 970 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਮੋਨਿ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਝੋਲੀ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਕਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: mundraa mon deaa kar jholee patr kaa karahu beechaar re |
English: Make silence your ear-rings, and compassion your wallet; let meditation be your begging bowl.

Gurbani: ਖਿੰਥਾ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਅਉ ਅਪਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਉ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: khinthaa ihu tan seeo apanaa naam krau aadhaar re |1|
English: Sew this body as your patched coat, and take the Lord's Name as your support. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਜੋਗੁ ਕਮਾਵਹੁ ਜੋਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa jog kamaavahu jogee |
English: Practice such Yoga, O Yogi.

Gurbani: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭੋਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jap tap sanjam guramukh bhogee |1| rahaau |
English: As Gurmukh, enjoy meditation, austerities and self-discipline. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਭੂਤਿ ਚਢਾਵਉ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਸਿੰਗੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: budh bibhoot chadtaavau apunee singee surat milaaee |
English: Apply the ashes of wisdom to your body; let your horn be your focused consciousness.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਫਿਰਉ ਤਨਿ ਨਗਰੀ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਬਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kar bairaag firau tan nagaree man kee kinguree bajaaee |2|
English: Become detached, and wander through the city of your body; play the harp of your mind. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਲੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਲਮ ਤਾੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: panch tat lai hiradai raakhahu rahai niraalam taarree |
English: Enshrine the five tatvas - the five elements, within your heart; let your deep meditative trance be undisturbed.

Gurbani: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਬਾੜੀ ॥੩॥੭॥
Transliteration: kehat kabeer sunahu re santahu dharam deaa kar baarree |3|7|
English: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints: make righteousness and compassion your garden. ||3||7||

[Ang 970 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਕਵਨ ਕਾਜ ਸਿਰਜੇ ਜਗ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਕਵਨ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kavan kaaj siraje jag bheetar janam kavan fal paaeaa |
English: For what purpose were you created and brought into the world? What rewards have you received in this life?

Gurbani: ਭਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਤਰਨ ਤਾਰਨ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਨਿ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bhav nidh taran taaran chintaaman ik nimakh na ihu man laaeaa |1|
English: God is the boat to carry you across the terrifying world-ocean; He is the Fulfiller of the mind's desires. You have not centered your mind on Him, even for an instant. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਹਮ ਐਸੇ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ॥
Transliteration: gobind ham aise aparaadhee |
English: O Lord of the Universe, I am such a sinner!

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਥਾ ਦੀਆ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਸਾਧੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jin prabh jeeo pindd thaa deea tis kee bhaau bhagat nahee saadhee |1| rahaau |
English: God gave me body and soul, but I have not practiced loving devotional worship to Him. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰ ਤਨ ਪਰ ਤੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਪਰ ਅਪਬਾਦੁ ਨ ਛੂਟੈ ॥
Transliteration: par dhan par tan par tee nindaa par apabaad na chhoottai |
English: Others' wealth, others' bodies, others' wives, others' slander and others' fights - I have not given them up.

Gurbani: ਆਵਾ ਗਵਨੁ ਹੋਤੁ ਹੈ ਫੁਨਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਪਰਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਤੂਟੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aavaa gavan hot hai fun fun ihu parasang na toottai |2|
English: For the sake of these, coming and going in reincarnation happens over and over again, and this story never ends. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਘਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਹੋਤ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਕੀਨੑੋ ਮੈ ਫੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jih ghar kathaa hot har santan ik nimakh na keenao mai feraa |
English: That house, in which the Saints speak of the Lord - I have not visited it, even for an instant.

Gurbani: ਲੰਪਟ ਚੋਰ ਦੂਤ ਮਤਵਾਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਦਾ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: lanpatt chor doot matavaare tin sang sadaa baseraa |3|
English: Drunkards, thieves, and evil-doers - I constantly dwell with them. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦ ਮਤਸਰ ਏ ਸੰਪੈ ਮੋ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh maaeaa mad matasar e sanpai mo maahee |
English: Sexual desire, anger, the wine of Maya, and envy - these are what I collect within myself.

Gurbani: ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ ਅਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਏ ਸੁਪਨੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: deaa dharam ar gur kee sevaa e supanantar naahee |4|
English: Compassion, righteousness, and service to the Guru - these do not visit me, even in my dreams. ||4||

Gurbani: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਮੋਦਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਛਲ ਭੈ ਹਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: deen deaal kripaal damodar bhagat bachhal bhai haaree |
English: He is merciful to the meek, compassionate and benevolent, the Lover of His devotees, the Destroyer of fear.

Gurbani: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਭੀਰ ਜਨ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਉ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥੫॥੮॥
Transliteration: kehat kabeer bheer jan raakhahu har sevaa krau tumaaree |5|8|
English: Says Kabeer, please protect Your humble servant from disaster; O Lord, I serve only You. ||5||8||

[Ang 971 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jih simaran hoe mukat duaar |
English: Remembering Him in meditation, the door of liberation is found.

Gurbani: ਜਾਹਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠਿ ਨਹੀ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jaeh baikuntth nahee sansaar |
English: You shall go to heaven, and not return to this earth.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਬਜਾਵਹਿ ਤੂਰ ॥
Transliteration: nirbhau kai ghar bajaaveh toor |
English: In the home of the Fearless Lord, the celestial trumpets resound.

Gurbani: ਅਨਹਦ ਬਜਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਭਰਪੂਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: anahad bajeh sadaa bharapoor |1|
English: The unstruck sound current will vibrate and resonate forever. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa simaran kar man maeh |
English: Practice such meditative remembrance in your mind.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਤ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bin simaran mukat kat naeh |1| rahaau |
English: Without this meditative remembrance, liberation will never be found. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਨਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jih simaran naahee nanakaar |
English: Remembering Him in meditation, you will meet with no obstruction.

Gurbani: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਉਤਰੈ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: mukat karai utarai bahu bhaar |
English: You will be liberated, and the great load will be taken away.

Gurbani: ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: namasakaar kar hiradai maeh |
English: Bow in humility within your heart,

Gurbani: ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਵਨੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: fir fir teraa aavan naeh |2|
English: and you will not have to be reincarnated over and over again. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੂ ਕੇਲ ॥
Transliteration: jih simaran kareh too kel |
English: Remember Him in meditation, celebrate and be happy.

Gurbani: ਦੀਪਕੁ ਬਾਂਧਿ ਧਰਿਓ ਬਿਨੁ ਤੇਲ ॥
Transliteration: deepak baandh dhario bin tel |
English: God has placed His lamp deep within you, which burns without any oil.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਅਮਰਕੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: so deepak amarak sansaar |
English: That lamp makes the world immortal;

Gurbani: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਬਿਖੁ ਕਾਢੀਲੇ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh bikh kaadteele maar |3|
English: it conquers and drives out the poisons of sexual desire and anger. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jih simaran teree gat hoe |
English: Remembering Him in meditation, you shall obtain salvation.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਰਖੁ ਕੰਠਿ ਪਰੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: so simaran rakh kantth paroe |
English: Wear that meditative remembrance as your necklace.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਰਾਖੁ ਉਤਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: so simaran kar nahee raakh utaar |
English: Practice that meditative remembrance, and never let it go.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee utareh paar |4|
English: By Guru's Grace, you shall cross over. ||4||

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੁਹਿ ਕਾਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: jih simaran naahee tuhi kaan |
English: Remembering Him in meditation, you shall not be obligated to others.

Gurbani: ਮੰਦਰਿ ਸੋਵਹਿ ਪਟੰਬਰ ਤਾਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: mandar soveh pattanbar taan |
English: You shall sleep in your mansion, in blankets of silk.

Gurbani: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: sej sukhaalee bigasai jeeo |
English: Your soul shall blossom forth in happiness, on this comfortable bed.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਤੂ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਪੀਉ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: so simaran too anadin peeo |5|
English: So drink in this meditative remembrance, night and day. ||5||

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਜਾਇ ਬਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jih simaran teree jaae balaae |
English: Remembering Him in meditation, your troubles will depart.

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਤੁਝੁ ਪੋਹੈ ਨ ਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jih simaran tujh pohai na maae |
English: Remembering Him in meditation, Maya will not bother you.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: simar simar har har man gaaeeai |
English: Meditate, meditate in remembrance on the Lord, Har, Har, and sing His Praises in your mind.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: eihu simaran satigur te paaeeai |6|
English: This meditative remembrance is obtained from the True Guru. ||6||

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa simar din raat |
English: Forever and ever, remember Him, day and night,

Gurbani: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: aootthat baitthat saas giraas |
English: while standing up and sitting down, with every breath and morsel of food.

Gurbani: ਜਾਗੁ ਸੋਇ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: jaag soe simaran ras bhog |
English: While awake and asleep, enjoy the essence of this meditative remembrance.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: har simaran paaeeai sanjog |7|
English: The Lord's meditative remembrance is obtained by good destiny. ||7||

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੁਝੁ ਭਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: jih simaran naahee tujh bhaar |
English: Remembering Him in meditation, you shall not be loaded down.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: so simaran raam naam adhaar |
English: Make this meditative remembrance of the Lord's Name your Support.

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਹੀ ਅੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: keh kabeer jaa kaa nahee ant |
English: Says Kabeer, He has no limits;

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਆਗੇ ਤੰਤੁ ਨ ਮੰਤੁ ॥੮॥੯॥
Transliteration: tis ke aage tant na mant |8|9|
English: no tantras or mantras can be used against Him. ||8||9||

[Ang 971 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਬਾਣੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee ghar 2 baanee kabeer jee kee |
English: Raamkalee, Second House, The Word Of Kabeer Jee:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਬੰਧਚਿ ਬੰਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bandhach bandhan paaeaa |
English: Maya, the Trapper, has sprung her trap.

Gurbani: ਮੁਕਤੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਅਨਲੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: mukatai gur anal bujhaaeaa |
English: The Guru, the Liberated One, has put out the fire.

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਨਖ ਸਿਖ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਚੀਨੑਾ ॥
Transliteration: jab nakh sikh ihu man cheenaa |
English: When I came to understand this mind, from the tips of my toes to the crown of my head,

Gurbani: ਤਬ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਜਨੁ ਕੀਨੑਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tab antar majan keenaa |1|
English: then I took my cleansing bath, deep within my self. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪਵਨਪਤਿ ਉਨਮਨਿ ਰਹਨੁ ਖਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: pavanapat unaman rehan kharaa |
English: The mind, the master of the breath, abides in the state of supreme bliss.

Gurbani: ਨਹੀ ਮਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਜਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: nahee mirat na janam jaraa |1| rahaau |
English: There is no death, no re-birth, and no aging for me now. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਉਲਟੀ ਲੇ ਸਕਤਿ ਸਹਾਰੰ ॥
Transliteration: aulattee le sakat sahaaran |
English: Turning away from materialism, I have found intuitive support.

Gurbani: ਪੈਸੀਲੇ ਗਗਨ ਮਝਾਰੰ ॥
Transliteration: paiseele gagan majhaaran |
English: I have entered into the sky of the mind, and opened the Tenth Gate.

Gurbani: ਬੇਧੀਅਲੇ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਭੁਅੰਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: bedheeale chakr bhuangaa |
English: The chakras of the coiled Kundalini energy have been opened,

Gurbani: ਭੇਟੀਅਲੇ ਰਾਇ ਨਿਸੰਗਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bhetteeale raae nisangaa |2|
English: and I have met my Sovereign Lord King without fear. ||2||

Gurbani: ਚੂਕੀਅਲੇ ਮੋਹ ਮਇਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: chookeeale moh meaasaa |
English: My attachment to Maya has been eradicated;

Gurbani: ਸਸਿ ਕੀਨੋ ਸੂਰ ਗਿਰਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: sas keeno soor giraasaa |
English: the moon energy has devoured the sun energy.

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਕੁੰਭਕੁ ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਲੀਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: jab kunbhak bharipur leenaa |
English: When I was focused and merged into the all-pervading Lord,

Gurbani: ਤਹ ਬਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਬੀਣਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: teh baaje anahad beenaa |3|
English: then the unstruck sound current began to vibrate. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬਕਤੈ ਬਕਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਨਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bakatai bak sabad sunaaeaa |
English: The Speaker has spoken, and proclaimed the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸੁਨਤੈ ਸੁਨਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਬਸਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sunatai sun man basaaeaa |
English: The hearer has heard, and enshrined it in the mind.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਪਾਰੰ ॥
Transliteration: kar karataa utaras paaran |
English: Chanting to the Creator, one crosses over.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਸਾਰੰ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: kahai kabeeraa saaran |4|1|10|
English: Says Kabeer, this is the essence. ||4||1||10||

[Ang 972 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: chand sooraj due jot saroop |
English: The moon and the sun are both the embodiment of light.

Gurbani: ਜੋਤੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਅਨੂਪੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jotee antar braham anoop |1|
English: Within their light, is God, the incomparable. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਰੁ ਰੇ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: kar re giaanee braham beechaar |
English: O spiritual teacher, contemplate God.

Gurbani: ਜੋਤੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਧਰਿਆ ਪਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jotee antar dhariaa pasaar |1| rahaau |
English: In this light is contained the expanse of the created universe. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹੀਰਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਹੀਰੇ ਕਰਉ ਆਦੇਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: heeraa dekh heere krau aades |
English: Gazing upon the diamond, I humbly salute this diamond.

Gurbani: ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਅਲੇਖੁ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: kahai kabeer niranjan alekh |2|2|11|
English: Says Kabeer, the Immaculate Lord is indescribable. ||2||2||11||

[Ang 972 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Bhagat Kabir Ji]
Gurbani: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਹੁਸੀਆਰ ਬੇਦਾਰ ਜਾਗਤ ਮੁਸੀਅਤ ਹਉ ਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: duneea huseeaar bedaar jaagat museeat hau re bhaaee |
English: People of the world, remain awake and aware. Even though you are awake, you are being robbed, O Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਨਿਗਮ ਹੁਸੀਆਰ ਪਹਰੂਆ ਦੇਖਤ ਜਮੁ ਲੇ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: nigam huseeaar paharooaa dekhat jam le jaaee |1| rahaau |
English: While the Vedas stand guard watching, the Messenger of Death carries you away. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨੰੀਬੁ ਭਇਓ ਆਂਬੁ ਆਂਬੁ ਭਇਓ ਨੰੀਬਾ ਕੇਲਾ ਪਾਕਾ ਝਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: naneeb bheo aanb aanb bheo naneebaa kelaa paakaa jhaar |
English: He thinks that the bitter nimm fruit is a mango, and the mango is a bitter nimm. He imagines the ripe banana on the thorny bush.

Gurbani: ਨਾਲੀਏਰ ਫਲੁ ਸੇਬਰਿ ਪਾਕਾ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naaleer fal sebar paakaa moorakh mugadh gavaar |1|
English: He thinks that the ripe coconut hangs on the barren simmal tree; what a stupid, idiotic fool he is! ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਭਇਓ ਖਾਂਡੁ ਰੇਤੁ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਖਰਿਓ ਹਸਤੰੀ ਚੁਨਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har bheo khaandd ret meh bikhario hasatanee chunio na jaaee |
English: The Lord is like sugar, spilled onto the sand; the elephant cannot pick it up.

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਕਮੀਰ ਕੁਲ ਜਾਤਿ ਪਾਂਤਿ ਤਜਿ ਚੀਟੀ ਹੋਇ ਚੁਨਿ ਖਾਈ ॥੨॥੩॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: keh kameer kul jaat paant taj cheettee hoe chun khaaee |2|3|12|
English: Says Kabeer, give up your ancestry, social status and honor; be like the tiny ant - pick up and eat the sugar. ||2||3||12||

[Ang 972 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Bhagat Namdev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: baanee naamadeo jeeo kee raamakalee ghar 1 |
English: The Word Of Naam Dayv Jee, Raamkalee, First House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਆਨੀਲੇ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਕਾਟੀਲੇ ਗੂਡੀ ਆਕਾਸ ਮਧੇ ਭਰਮੀਅਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: aaneele kaagad kaatteele gooddee aakaas madhe bharameeale |
English: The boy takes paper, cuts it and makes a kite, and flies it in the sky.

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਜਨਾ ਸਿਉ ਬਾਤ ਬਤਊਆ ਚੀਤੁ ਸੁ ਡੋਰੀ ਰਾਖੀਅਲੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: panch janaa siau baat btaooaa cheet su ddoree raakheeale |1|
English: Talking with his friends, he still keeps his attention on the kite string. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਬੇਧੀਅਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: man raam naamaa bedheeale |
English: My mind has been pierced by the Name of the Lord,

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੇ ਕਨਿਕ ਕਲਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਮਾਂਡੀਅਲੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaise kanik kalaa chit maanddeeale |1| rahaau |
English: like the goldsmith, whose attention is held by his work. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਨੀਲੇ ਕੁੰਭੁ ਭਰਾਈਲੇ ਊਦਕ ਰਾਜ ਕੁਆਰਿ ਪੁਰੰਦਰੀਏ ॥
Transliteration: aaneele kunbh bharaaeele aoodak raaj kuaar purandaree |
English: The young girl in the city takes a pitcher, and fills it with water.

Gurbani: ਹਸਤ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਬੀਚਾਰ ਕਰਤੀ ਹੈ ਚੀਤੁ ਸੁ ਗਾਗਰਿ ਰਾਖੀਅਲੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: hasat binod beechaar karatee hai cheet su gaagar raakheeale |2|
English: She laughs, and plays, and talks with her friends, but she keeps her attention focused on the pitcher of water. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮੰਦਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਦੁਆਰ ਦਸ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਗਊ ਚਰਾਵਨ ਛਾਡੀਅਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: mandar ek duaar das jaa ke gaoo charaavan chhaaddeeale |
English: The cow is let loose, out of the mansion of the ten gates, to graze in the field.

Gurbani: ਪਾਂਚ ਕੋਸ ਪਰ ਗਊ ਚਰਾਵਤ ਚੀਤੁ ਸੁ ਬਛਰਾ ਰਾਖੀਅਲੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: paanch kos par gaoo charaavat cheet su bachharaa raakheeale |3|
English: It grazes up to five miles away, but keeps its attention focused on its calf. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਤਿਲੋਚਨ ਬਾਲਕੁ ਪਾਲਨ ਪਉਢੀਅਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: kehat naamadeo sunahu tilochan baalak paalan paudteeale |
English: Says Naam Dayv, listen, O Trilochan: the child is laid down in the cradle.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਾਜ ਬਿਰੂਧੀ ਚੀਤੁ ਸੁ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਰਾਖੀਅਲੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: antar baahar kaaj biroodhee cheet su baarik raakheeale |4|1|
English: Its mother is at work, inside and outside, but she holds her child in her thoughts. ||4||1||

[Ang 972 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Bhagat Namdev Ji]
Gurbani: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਆਨੰਤਾ ਗੀਤ ਕਬਿਤ ਨ ਗਾਵਉਗੋ ॥
Transliteration: bed puraan saasatr aanantaa geet kabit na gaavaugo |
English: There are countless Vedas, Puraanas and Shaastras; I do not sing their songs and hymns.

Gurbani: ਅਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਮਹਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਬੇਨੁ ਬਜਾਵਉਗੋ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: akhandd manddal nirankaar meh anahad ben bajaavaugo |1|
English: In the imperishable realm of the Formless Lord, I play the flute of the unstruck sound current. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਰਾਮਹਿ ਗਾਵਉਗੋ ॥
Transliteration: bairaagee raameh gaavaugo |
English: Becoming detached, I sing the Lord's Praises.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਅਤੀਤ ਅਨਾਹਦਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਆਕੁਲ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਉਗੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sabad ateet anaahad raataa aakul kai ghar jaaugo |1| rahaau |
English: Imbued with the unattached, unstruck Word of the Shabad, I shall go to the home of the Lord, who has no ancestors. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਇੜਾ ਪਿੰਗੁਲਾ ਅਉਰੁ ਸੁਖਮਨਾ ਪਉਨੈ ਬੰਧਿ ਰਹਾਉਗੋ ॥
Transliteration: eirraa pingulaa aaur sukhamanaa paunai bandh rahaaugo |
English: Then, I shall no longer control the breath through the energy channels of the Ida, Pingala and Shushmanaa.

Gurbani: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਉ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਾਉਗੋ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: chand sooraj due sam kar raakhau braham jot mil jaaugo |2|
English: I look upon both the moon and the sun as the same, and I shall merge in the Light of God. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੀਰਥ ਦੇਖਿ ਨ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਪੈਸਉ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਨ ਸਤਾਵਉਗੋ ॥
Transliteration: teerath dekh na jal meh paisau jeea jant na sataavaugo |
English: I do not go to see sacred shrines of pilgrimage, or bathe in their waters; I do not bother any beings or creatures.

Gurbani: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਘਟ ਹੀ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਨੑਾਉਗੋ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: atthasatth teerath guroo dikhaae ghatt hee bheetar naaugo |3|
English: The Guru has shown me the sixty-eight places of pilgrimage within my own heart, where I now take my cleansing bath. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਸਹਾਈ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਭਲੋ ਭਲੋ ਨ ਕਹਾਵਉਗੋ ॥
Transliteration: panch sahaaee jan kee sobhaa bhalo bhalo na kahaavaugo |
English: I do not pay attention to anyone praising me, or calling me good and nice.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਾ ਕਹੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਤਾ ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਮਾਉਗੋ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: naamaa kahai chit har siau raataa sun samaadh samaaugo |4|2|
English: Says Naam Dayv, my consciousness is imbued with the Lord; I am absorbed in the profound state of Samaadhi. ||4||2||

[Ang 973 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Bhagat Namdev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਇ ਨ ਹੋਤੀ ਬਾਪੁ ਨ ਹੋਤਾ ਕਰਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਤੀ ਕਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: maae na hotee baap na hotaa karam na hotee kaaeaa |
English: When there was no mother and no father, no karma and no human body,

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਨਹੀ ਹੋਤੇ ਤੁਮ ਨਹੀ ਹੋਤੇ ਕਵਨੁ ਕਹਾਂ ਤੇ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ham nahee hote tum nahee hote kavan kahaan te aaeaa |1|
English: when I was not and you were not, then who came from where? ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: raam koe na kis hee keraa |
English: O Lord, no one belongs to anyone else.

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਰਵਰਿ ਪੰਖਿ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaise taravar pankh baseraa |1| rahaau |
English: We are like birds perched on a tree. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਚੰਦੁ ਨ ਹੋਤਾ ਸੂਰੁ ਨ ਹੋਤਾ ਪਾਨੀ ਪਵਨੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: chand na hotaa soor na hotaa paanee pavan milaaeaa |
English: When there was no moon and no sun, then water and air were blended together.

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਤੁ ਨ ਹੋਤਾ ਬੇਦੁ ਨ ਹੋਤਾ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਹਾਂ ਤੇ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saasat na hotaa bed na hotaa karam kahaan te aaeaa |2|
English: When there were no Shaastras and no Vedas, then where did karma come from? ||2||

Gurbani: ਖੇਚਰ ਭੂਚਰ ਤੁਲਸੀ ਮਾਲਾ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: khechar bhoochar tulasee maalaa gur parasaadee paaeaa |
English: Control of the breath and positioning of the tongue, focusing at the third eye and wearing malas of tulsi beads, are all obtained through Guru's Grace.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਾ ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਪਰਮ ਤਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹੋਇ ਲਖਾਇਆ ॥੩॥੩॥
Transliteration: naamaa pranavai param tat hai satigur hoe lakhaaeaa |3|3|
