English: Naam Dayv prays, this is the supreme essence of reality; the True Guru has inspired this realization. ||3||3||

[Ang 973 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Bhagat Namdev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee ghar 2 |
English: Raamkalee, Second House:

Gurbani: ਬਾਨਾਰਸੀ ਤਪੁ ਕਰੈ ਉਲਟਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਮਰੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਦਹੈ ਕਾਇਆ ਕਲਪੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: baanaarasee tap karai ulatt teerath marai agan dahai kaaeaa kalap keejai |
English: Someone may practice austerities at Benares, or die upside-down at a sacred shrine of pilgrimage, or burn his body in fire, or rejuvenate his body to live almost forever;

Gurbani: ਅਸੁਮੇਧ ਜਗੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਸੋਨਾ ਗਰਭ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਰਿ ਤਊ ਨ ਪੂਜੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: asumedh jag keejai sonaa garabh daan deejai raam naam sar taoo na poojai |1|
English: he may perform the horse-sacrifice ceremony, or give donations of gold covered over, but none of these is equal to the worship of the Lord's Name. ||1||

Gurbani: ਛੋਡਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਰੇ ਪਾਖੰਡੀ ਮਨ ਕਪਟੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: chhodd chhodd re paakhanddee man kapatt na keejai |
English: O hypocrite, renounce and abandon your hypocrisy; do not practice deception.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤਹਿ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam nit niteh leejai |1| rahaau |
English: Constantly, continually, chant the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੰਗਾ ਜਉ ਗੋਦਾਵਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਕੁੰਭਿ ਜਉ ਕੇਦਾਰ ਨੑਾਈਐ ਗੋਮਤੀ ਸਹਸ ਗਊ ਦਾਨੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: gangaa jau godaavar jaaeeai kunbh jau kedaar naaeeai gomatee sehas gaoo daan keejai |
English: Someone may go to the Ganges or the Godaavari, or to the Kumbha festival, or bathe at Kaydaar Naat'h, or make donations of thousands of cows at Gomti;

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਉ ਤੀਰਥ ਕਰੈ ਤਨੁ ਜਉ ਹਿਵਾਲੇ ਗਾਰੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਰਿ ਤਊ ਨ ਪੂਜੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kott jau teerath karai tan jau hivaale gaarai raam naam sar taoo na poojai |2|
English: he may make millions of pilgrimages to sacred shrines, or freeze his body in the Himalayas; still, none of these is equal to the worship of the Lord's Name. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਸੁ ਦਾਨ ਗਜ ਦਾਨ ਸਿਹਜਾ ਨਾਰੀ ਭੂਮਿ ਦਾਨ ਐਸੋ ਦਾਨੁ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤਹਿ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: as daan gaj daan sihajaa naaree bhoom daan aiso daan nit niteh keejai |
English: Someone may give away horses and elephants, or women on their beds, or land; he may give such gifts over and over again.

Gurbani: ਆਤਮ ਜਉ ਨਿਰਮਾਇਲੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਆਪ ਬਰਾਬਰਿ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਰਿ ਤਊ ਨ ਪੂਜੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aatam jau niramaaeil keejai aap baraabar kanchan deejai raam naam sar taoo na poojai |3|
English: He may purify his soul, and give away in charity his body weight in gold; none of these is equal to the worship of the Lord's Name. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਨਹਿ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਰੋਸੁ ਜਮਹਿ ਨ ਦੀਜੈ ਦੋਸੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਬਾਣ ਪਦੁ ਚੀਨਿੑ ਲੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: maneh na keejai ros jameh na deejai dos niramal nirabaan pad cheena leejai |
English: Do not harbor anger in your mind, or blame the Messenger of Death; instead, realize the immaculate state of Nirvaanaa.

Gurbani: ਜਸਰਥ ਰਾਇ ਨੰਦੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਚੰਦੁ ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਨਾਮਾ ਤਤੁ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੪॥੪॥
Transliteration: jasarath raae nand raajaa meraa raam chand pranavai naamaa tat ras amrit peejai |4|4|
English: My Sovereign Lord King is Raam Chandra, the Son of the King Dasrat'h; prays Naam Dayv, I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||4||4||

[Ang 973 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Bhagat Ravidas Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee baanee ravidaas jee kee |
English: Raamkalee, The Word Of Ravi Daas Jee:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਪੜੀਐ ਗੁਨੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਅਨਭਉ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਦਰਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: parreeai guneeai naam sabh suneeai anbhau bhaau na darasai |
English: They read and reflect upon all the Names of God; they listen, but they do not see the Lord, the embodiment of love and intuition.

Gurbani: ਲੋਹਾ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਹਿਰਨ ਹੋਇ ਕੈਸੇ ਜਉ ਪਾਰਸਹਿ ਨ ਪਰਸੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: lohaa kanchan hiran hoe kaise jau paaraseh na parasai |1|
English: How can iron be transformed into gold, unless it touches the Philosopher's Stone? ||1||

Gurbani: ਦੇਵ ਸੰਸੈ ਗਾਂਠਿ ਨ ਛੂਟੈ ॥
Transliteration: dev sansai gaantth na chhoottai |
English: O Divine Lord, the knot of skepticism cannot be untied.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦ ਮਤਸਰ ਇਨ ਪੰਚਹੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਲੂਟੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh maaeaa mad matasar in panchahu mil lootte |1| rahaau |
English: Sexual desire, anger, Maya, intoxication and jealousy - these five have combined to plunder the world. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਬਡ ਕਬਿ ਕੁਲੀਨ ਹਮ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਹਮ ਜੋਗੀ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: ham badd kab kuleen ham panddit ham jogee saniaasee |
English: I am a great poet, of noble heritage; I am a Pandit, a religious scholar, a Yogi and a Sannyaasi;

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਗੁਨੀ ਸੂਰ ਹਮ ਦਾਤੇ ਇਹ ਬੁਧਿ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਨਾਸੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: giaanee gunee soor ham daate ih budh kabeh na naasee |2|
English: I am a spiritual teacher, a warrior and a giver - such thinking never ends. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਸਭੈ ਨਹੀ ਸਮਝਸਿ ਭੂਲਿ ਪਰੇ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਉਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kahu ravidaas sabhai nahee samajhas bhool pare jaise baure |
English: Says Ravi Daas, no one understands; they all run around, deluded like madmen.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਜੀਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਧਨ ਮੋਰੇ ॥੩॥੧॥
Transliteration: mohi adhaar naam naaraaein jeevan praan dhan more |3|1|
English: The Lord's Name is my only Support; He is my life, my breath of life, my wealth. ||3||1||

[Ang 974 | Raag: Raag Raamkalee | Author: Bhagat Beni Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਬੇਣੀ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: raamakalee baanee benee jeeo kee |
English: Raamkalee, The Word Of Baynee Jee:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਇੜਾ ਪਿੰਗੁਲਾ ਅਉਰ ਸੁਖਮਨਾ ਤੀਨਿ ਬਸਹਿ ਇਕ ਠਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: eirraa pingulaa aaur sukhamanaa teen baseh ik tthaaee |
English: The energy channels of the Ida, Pingala and Shushmanaa: these three dwell in one place.

Gurbani: ਬੇਣੀ ਸੰਗਮੁ ਤਹ ਪਿਰਾਗੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਜਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਥਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: benee sangam teh piraag man majan kare tithaaee |1|
English: This is the true place of confluence of the three sacred rivers: this is where my mind takes its cleansing bath. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਤਹਾ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਰਾਮੁ ਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: santahu tahaa niranjan raam hai |
English: O Saints, the Immaculate Lord dwells there;

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਗਮਿ ਚੀਨੈ ਬਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur gam cheenai biralaa koe |
English: how rare are those who go to the Guru, and understand this.

Gurbani: ਤਹਾਂ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਰਮਈਆ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tahaan niranjan rameea hoe |1| rahaau |
English: The all-pervading immaculate Lord is there. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦੇਵ ਸਥਾਨੈ ਕਿਆ ਨੀਸਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: dev sathaanai kiaa neesaanee |
English: What is the insignia of the Divine Lord's dwelling?

Gurbani: ਤਹ ਬਾਜੇ ਸਬਦ ਅਨਾਹਦ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: teh baaje sabad anaahad baanee |
English: The unstruck sound current of the Shabad vibrates there.

Gurbani: ਤਹ ਚੰਦੁ ਨ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਪਉਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: teh chand na sooraj paun na paanee |
English: There is no moon or sun, no air or water there.

Gurbani: ਸਾਖੀ ਜਾਗੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saakhee jaagee guramukh jaanee |2|
English: The Gurmukh becomes aware, and knows the Teachings. ||2||

Gurbani: ਉਪਜੈ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਛੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: aupajai giaan duramat chheejai |
English: Spiritual wisdom wells up, and evil-mindedness departs;

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸਿ ਗਗਨੰਤਰਿ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: amrit ras gaganantar bheejai |
English: the nucleus of the mind sky is drenched with Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਏਸੁ ਕਲਾ ਜੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਭੇਉ ॥
Transliteration: es kalaa jo jaanai bheo |
English: One who knows the secret of this device,

Gurbani: ਭੇਟੈ ਤਾਸੁ ਪਰਮ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bhettai taas param guradeo |3|
English: meets the Supreme Divine Guru. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦਸਮ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਪਰਮ ਪੁਰਖ ਕੀ ਘਾਟੀ ॥
Transliteration: dasam duaaraa agam apaaraa param purakh kee ghaattee |
English: The Tenth Gate is the home of the inaccessible, infinite Supreme Lord.

Gurbani: ਊਪਰਿ ਹਾਟੁ ਹਾਟ ਪਰਿ ਆਲਾ ਆਲੇ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਥਾਤੀ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: aoopar haatt haatt par aalaa aale bheetar thaatee |4|
English: Above the store is a niche, and within this niche is the commodity. ||4||

Gurbani: ਜਾਗਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਸੁ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਸੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jaagat rahai su kabahu na sovai |
English: One who remains awake, never sleeps.

Gurbani: ਤੀਨਿ ਤਿਲੋਕ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਪਲੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: teen tilok samaadh palovai |
English: The three qualities and the three worlds vanish, in the state of Samaadhi.

Gurbani: ਬੀਜ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਲੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: beej mantru lai hiradai rahai |
English: He takes the Beej Mantra, the Seed Mantra, and keeps it in his heart.

Gurbani: ਮਨੂਆ ਉਲਟਿ ਸੁੰਨ ਮਹਿ ਗਹੈ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: manooaa ulatt sun meh gahai |5|
English: Turning his mind away from the world, he focuses on the cosmic void of the absolute Lord. ||5||

Gurbani: ਜਾਗਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਅਲੀਆ ਭਾਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: jaagat rahai na aleea bhaakhai |
English: He remains awake, and he does not lie.

Gurbani: ਪਾਚਉ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਬਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: paachau indree bas kar raakhai |
English: He keeps the five sensory organs under his control.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਖੀ ਰਾਖੈ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: gur kee saakhee raakhai cheet |
English: He cherishes in his consciousness the Guru's Teachings.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪੈ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: man tan arapai krisan pareet |6|
English: He dedicates his mind and body to the Lord's Love. ||6||

Gurbani: ਕਰ ਪਲਵ ਸਾਖਾ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kar palav saakhaa beechaare |
English: He considers his hands to be the leaves and branches of the tree.

Gurbani: ਅਪਨਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਜੂਐ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: apanaa janam na jooai haare |
English: He does not lose his life in the gamble.

Gurbani: ਅਸੁਰ ਨਦੀ ਕਾ ਬੰਧੈ ਮੂਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: asur nadee kaa bandhai mool |
English: He plugs up the source of the river of evil tendencies.

Gurbani: ਪਛਿਮ ਫੇਰਿ ਚੜਾਵੈ ਸੂਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: pachhim fer charraavai soor |
English: Turning away from the west, he makes the sun rise in the east.

Gurbani: ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰੈ ਸੁ ਨਿਝਰੁ ਝਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: ajar jarai su nijhar jharai |
English: He bears the unbearable, and the drops trickle down within;

Gurbani: ਜਗੰਨਾਥ ਸਿਉ ਗੋਸਟਿ ਕਰੈ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: jaganaath siau gosatt karai |7|
English: then, he speaks with the Lord of the world. ||7||

Gurbani: ਚਉਮੁਖ ਦੀਵਾ ਜੋਤਿ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
Transliteration: chaumukh deevaa jot duaar |
English: The four-sided lamp illuminates the Tenth Gate.

Gurbani: ਪਲੂ ਅਨਤ ਮੂਲੁ ਬਿਚਕਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: paloo anat mool bichakaar |
English: The Primal Lord is at the center of the countless leaves.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਲੇ ਆਪੇ ਰਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: sarab kalaa le aape rahai |
English: He Himself abides there with all His powers.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਰਤਨਾ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਹੈ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: man maanak ratanaa meh guhai |8|
English: He weaves the jewels into the pearl of the mind. ||8||

Gurbani: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਪਦਮੁ ਦੁਆਲੈ ਮਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: masatak padam duaalai manee |
English: The lotus is at the forehead, and the jewels surround it.

Gurbani: ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਧਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: maeh niranjan tribhavan dhanee |
English: Within it is the Immaculate Lord, the Master of the three worlds.

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦ ਨਿਰਮਾਇਲ ਬਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: panch sabad niramaaeil baaje |
English: The Panch Shabad, the five primal sounds, resound and vibrate their in their purity.

Gurbani: ਢੁਲਕੇ ਚਵਰ ਸੰਖ ਘਨ ਗਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: dtulake chavar sankh ghan gaaje |
English: The chauris - the fly brushes wave, and the conch shells blare like thunder.

Gurbani: ਦਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਦੈਤਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: dal mal daitahu guramukh giaan |
English: The Gurmukh tramples the demons underfoot with his spiritual wisdom.

Gurbani: ਬੇਣੀ ਜਾਚੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੯॥੧॥
Transliteration: benee jaachai teraa naam |9|1|
English: Baynee longs for Your Name, Lord. ||9||1||

[Ang 975 | Raag: Raag Nat Naaraayan | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਨਟ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: raag natt naaraaein mahalaa 4 |
English: Raag Nat Naaraayan, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirbhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibhan gur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: mere man jap ahinis naam hare |
English: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, day and night.

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਦੋਖ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਨੇ ਸਭ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਪਾਸਿ ਧਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kott kott dokh bahu keene sabh parahar paas dhare |1| rahaau |
English: Millions and millions of sins and mistakes, committed through countless lifetimes, shall all be put aside and sent away. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹਿ ਆਰਾਧਹਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਭਾਇ ਖਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam japeh aaraadheh sevak bhaae khare |
English: Those who chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and worship Him in adoration, and serve Him with love, are genuine.

Gurbani: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਦੋਖ ਗਏ ਸਭ ਨੀਕਰਿ ਜਿਉ ਪਾਨੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kilabikh dokh ge sabh neekar jiau paanee mail hare |1|
English: All their sins are erased, just as water washes off the dirt. ||1||

Gurbani: ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਨਰੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਨੁ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਨਰ ਨਰਹਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: khin khin nar naaraaein gaaveh mukh boleh nar narahare |
English: That being, who sings the Lord's Praises each and every instant, chants with his mouth the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਦੋਖ ਅਸਾਧ ਨਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: panch dokh asaadh nagar meh ik khin pal door kare |2|
English: In a moment, in an instant, the Lord rids him of the five incurable diseases of the body-village. ||2||

Gurbani: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਭਗਤ ਹਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: vaddabhaagee har naam dhiaaveh har ke bhagat hare |
English: Very fortunate are those who meditate on the Lord's Name; they alone are the Lord's devotees.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਚਉ ਮੈ ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ ਨਿਸਤਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tin kee sangat dehi prabh jaachau mai moorr mugadh nisatare |3|
English: I beg for the Sangat, the Congregation; O God, please bless me with them. I am a fool, and an idiot - please save me! ||3||

Gurbani: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kripaa kripaa dhaar jagajeevan rakh levahu saran pare |
English: Shower me with Your Mercy and Grace, O Life of the World; save me, I seek Your Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਨੁ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਸਰਨਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਲਾਜ ਹਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak jan tumaree saranaaee har raakhahu laaj hare |4|1|
English: Servant Nanak has entered Your Sanctuary; O Lord, please preserve my honor! ||4||1||

[Ang 975 | Raag: Raag Nat Naaraayan | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: natt mahalaa 4 |
English: Nat, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਜਪਿ ਜਨ ਰਾਮੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: raam jap jan raamai naam rale |
English: Meditating on the Lord, His humble servants are blended with the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਲੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam japio gur bachanee har dhaaree har kripale |1| rahaau |
English: Chanting the Lord's Name, following the Guru's Teachings, the Lord showers His Mercy upon them. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਨ ਜਪਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਲਲ ਸਲਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: har har agam agochar suaamee jan jap mil salal salale |
English: Our Lord and Master, Har, Har, is inaccessible and unfathomable. Meditating on Him, His humble servant merges with Him, like water with water.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਮ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਲੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har ke sant mil raam ras paaeaa ham jan kai bal balale |1|
English: Meeting with the Lord's Saints, I have obtained the sublime essence of the Lord. I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to His humble servants. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨਿ ਗਾਇਓ ਸਭਿ ਦਾਲਦ ਦੁਖ ਦਲਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: purakhotam har naam jan gaaeo sabh daalad dukh dalale |
English: The Lord's humble servant sings the Praises of the Name of the Supreme, Primal Soul, and all poverty and pain are destroyed.

Gurbani: ਵਿਚਿ ਦੇਹੀ ਦੋਖ ਅਸਾਧ ਪੰਚ ਧਾਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਖਿਨ ਪਰਲੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: vich dehee dokh asaadh panch dhaatoo har kee khin parale |2|
English: Within the body are the five evil and uncontrollable passions. The Lord destroys them in an instant. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਈ ਜਿਉ ਦੇਖੈ ਸਸਿ ਕਮਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: har ke sant man preet lagaaee jiau dekhai sas kamale |
English: The Lord's Saint loves the Lord in his mind, like the lotus flower gazing at the moon.

Gurbani: ਉਨਵੈ ਘਨੁ ਘਨ ਘਨਿਹਰੁ ਗਰਜੈ ਮਨਿ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਮੋਰ ਮੁਰਲੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aunavai ghan ghan ghanihar garajai man bigasai mor murale |3|
English: The clouds hang low, the clouds tremble with thunder, and the mind dances joyfully like the peacock. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਮਰੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਲੋਚ ਹਮ ਲਾਈ ਹਮ ਜੀਵਹ ਦੇਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: hamarai suaamee loch ham laaee ham jeevah dekh har mile |
English: My Lord and Master has placed this yearning within me; I live by seeing and meeting my Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਅਮਲ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਅਨਦ ਭਲੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: jan naanak har amal har laae har melahu anad bhale |4|2|
English: Servant Nanak is addicted to the intoxication of the Lord; meeting with the Lord, he finds sublime bliss. ||4||2||

[Ang 975 | Raag: Raag Nat Naaraayan | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: natt mahalaa 4 |
English: Nat, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖੇ ॥
Transliteration: mere man jap har har naam sakhe |
English: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, your only Friend.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਹਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਪਖੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee har naam dhiaaeo ham satigur charan pakhe |1| rahaau |
English: By Guru's Grace, I meditate on the Name of the Lord; I wash the Feet of the True Guru. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਊਤਮ ਜਗੰਨਾਥ ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰ ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਰਖੇ ॥
Transliteration: aootam jaganaath jagadeesur ham paapee saran rakhe |
English: The Exalted Lord of the World, the Master of the Universe, keeps a sinner like me in His Sanctuary

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਓ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਖੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tum vadd purakh deen dukh bhanjan har deeo naam mukhe |1|
English: You are the Greatest Being, Lord, Destroyer of the pains of the meek; You have placed Your Name in my mouth, Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਹਮ ਗਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਖੇ ॥
Transliteration: har gun aooch neech ham gaae gur satigur sang sakhe |
English: I am lowly, but I sing the Lofty Praises of the Lord, meeting with the Guru, the True Guru, my Friend.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਚੰਦਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸੈ ਨਿੰਮੁ ਬਿਰਖਾ ਗੁਨ ਚੰਦਨ ਕੇ ਬਸਖੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jiau chandan sang basai ninm birakhaa gun chandan ke basakhe |2|
English: Like the bitter nimm tree, growing near the sandalwood tree, I am permeated with the fragrance of sandalwood. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਮਰੇ ਅਵਗਨ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਖੈ ਕੇ ਬਹੁ ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ਨਿਮਖੇ ॥
Transliteration: hamare avagan bikhiaa bikhai ke bahu baar baar nimakhe |
English: My faults and sins of corruption are countless; over and over again, I commit them.

Gurbani: ਅਵਗਨਿਆਰੇ ਪਾਥਰ ਭਾਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਤਾਰੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਨਖੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: avaganiaare paathar bhaare har taare sang janakhe |3|
English: I am unworthy, I am a heavy stone sinking down; but the Lord has carried me across, in association with His humble servants. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਭ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਕ੍ਰਿਖੇ ॥
Transliteration: jin kau tum har raakhahu suaamee sabh tin ke paap krikhe |
English: Those whom You save, Lord - all their sins are destroyed.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੁਮ ਦੁਸਟ ਤਾਰੇ ਹਰਣਖੇ ॥੪॥੩॥
Transliteration: jan naanak ke deaal prabh suaamee tum dusatt taare haranakhe |4|3|
English: O Merciful God, Lord and Master of servant Nanak, You have carried across even evil villains like Harnaakhash. ||4||3||

[Ang 976 | Raag: Raag Nat Naaraayan | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: natt mahalaa 4 |
English: Nat, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: mere man jap har har raam range |
English: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, with love.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਜਨ ਪਗਿ ਲਗੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har har kripaa karee jagadeesur har dhiaaeo jan pag lage |1| rahaau |
English: When the Lord of the Universe, Har, Har, granted His Grace, then I fell at the feet of the humble, and I meditate on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਭੂਲ ਚੂਕ ਹਮ ਅਬ ਆਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਨਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: janam janam ke bhool chook ham ab aae prabh saranage |
English: Mistaken and confused for so many past lives, I have now come and entered the Sanctuary of God.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਵਡ ਪਾਪਗੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tum saranaagat pratipaalak suaamee ham raakhahu vadd paapage |1|
English: O my Lord and Master, You are the Cherisher of those who come to Your Sanctuary. I am such a great sinner - please save me! ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਕੋ ਨ ਉਧਰਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਏ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: tumaree sangat har ko ko na udhario prabh kee patit pavage |
English: Associating with You, Lord, who would not be saved? Only God sanctifies the sinners.

Gurbani: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਛੀਪਾ ਦੁਸਟਾਰਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਪੈਜ ਜਨਗੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gun gaavat chheepaa dusattaario prabh raakhee paij janage |2|
English: Naam Dayv, the calico printer, was driven out by the evil villains, as he sang Your Glorious Praises; O God, You protected the honor of Your humble servant. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਤਿਨਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: jo tumare gun gaaveh suaamee hau bal bal bal tinage |
English: Those who sing Your Glorious Praises, O my Lord and Master - I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice to them.

Gurbani: ਭਵਨ ਭਵਨ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਭਿ ਕੀਏ ਜਹ ਧੂਰਿ ਪਰੀ ਜਨ ਪਗੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bhavan bhavan pavitr sabh kee jeh dhoor paree jan page |3|
English: Those houses and homes are sanctified, upon which the dust of the feet of the humble settles. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮਰੇ ਗੁਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਹਿ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਵਡ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ ਵਡਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: tumare gun prabh keh na sakeh ham tum vadd vadd purakh vaddage |
English: I cannot describe Your Glorious Virtues, God; You are the greatest of the great, O Great Primal Lord God.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਦਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਹਮ ਸੇਵਹ ਤੁਮ ਜਨ ਪਗੇ ॥੪॥੪॥
Transliteration: jan naanak kau deaa prabh dhaarahu ham sevah tum jan page |4|4|
English: Please shower Your Mercy upon servant Nanak, God; I serve at the feet of Yor humble servants. ||4||4||

[Ang 976 | Raag: Raag Nat Naaraayan | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: natt mahalaa 4 |
English: Nat, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: mere man jap har har naam mane |
English: O my mind, believe in and chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਜਗੰਨਾਥਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮ ਬਨੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaganaath kirapaa prabh dhaaree mat guramat naam bane |1| rahaau |
English: God, the Master of the Universe, has showered His Mercy upon me, and through the Guru's Teachings, my intellect has been molded by the Naam. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਇਓ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰ ਸੁਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: har jan har jas har har gaaeo upades guroo gur sune |
English: The Lord's humble servant sings the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, listening to the Guru's Teachings.

Gurbani: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਟੇ ਜਿਵ ਖੇਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਾਨਿ ਲੁਨੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kilabikh paap naam har kaatte jiv khet krisaan lune |1|
English: The Lord's Name cuts down all sins, like the farmer cutting down his crops. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਹਮ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: tumaree upamaa tum hee prabh jaanahu ham keh na sakeh har gune |
English: You alone know Your Praises, God; I cannot even describe Your Glorious Virtues, Lord.

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੇ ਤੁਮ ਤੈਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਗੁਨ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jaise tum taise prabh tum hee gun jaanahu prabh apune |2|
English: You are what You are, God; You alone know Your Glorious Virtues, God. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਫਾਸ ਬੰਧ ਬਹੁ ਬੰਧੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਖੁਲ ਖੁਲਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa faas bandh bahu bandhe har japio khul khulane |
English: The mortals are bound by the many bonds of Maya's noose. Meditating on the Lord, the knot is untied,

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਕੁੰਚਰੁ ਤਦੂਐ ਬਾਂਧਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਮੋਖ ਮੁਖਨੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jiau jal kunchar tadooai baandhio har chetio mokh mukhane |3|
English: like the elephant, which was caught in the water by the crococile; it remembered the Lord, and chanted the Lord's Name, and was released. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਤੁਮ ਖੋਜਹੁ ਜੁਗ ਜੁਗਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: suaamee paarabraham paramesar tum khojahu jug jugane |
English: O my Lord and Master, Supreme Lord God, Transcendent Lord, throughout the ages, mortals search for You.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਥਾਹ ਪਾਈ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਵਡਨੇ ॥੪॥੫॥
Transliteration: tumaree thaah paaee nahee paavai jan naanak ke prabh vaddane |4|5|
English: Your extent cannot be estimated or known, O Great God of servant Nanak. ||4||5||

[Ang 976 | Raag: Raag Nat Naaraayan | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: natt mahalaa 4 |
English: Nat, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕਲਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਵਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: mere man kal keerat har pravane |
English: O my mind, in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises is worthy and commendable.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆਲਿ ਦਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਾਰੀ ਲਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਣੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har har deaal deaa prabh dhaaree lag satigur har japane |1| rahaau |
English: When the Merciful Lord God shows kindness and compassion, then one falls at the feet of the True Guru, and meditates on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਤੁਮ ਵਡ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਭਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੁੜਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: har tum vadd agam agochar suaamee sabh dhiaaveh har rurrane |
English: O my Lord and Master, You are great, inaccessible and unfathomable; all meditate on You, O Beautiful Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਤੁਮੑਰੇ ਵਡ ਕਟਾਖ ਹੈ ਤੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਣੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jin kau tumare vadd kattaakh hai te guramukh har simarane |1|
English: Those whom You view with Your Great Eye of Grace, meditate on You, Lord, and become Gurmukh. ||1||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਕੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਜੁਗਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: eihu parapanch keea prabh suaamee sabh jagajeevan jugane |
English: The expanse of this creation is Your work, O God, my Lord and Master, Life of the entire universe, united with all.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਸਲਲੈ ਸਲਲ ਉਠਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਲਹਰੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਲਲੈ ਸਲਲ ਸਮਣੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jiau salalai salal uttheh bahu laharee mil salalai salal samane |2|
English: Countless waves rise up from the water, and then they merge into the water again. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਆ ਸੁ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਹਮ ਨਹ ਜਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਗਹਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: jo prabh keea su tum hee jaanahu ham neh jaanee har gahane |
English: You alone, God, know whatever You do. O Lord, I do not know.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਕਉ ਰਿਦ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਹਮ ਕਰਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸਿਮਰਣੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ham baarik kau rid usatat dhaarahu ham karah prabhoo simarane |3|
English: I am Your child; please enshrine Your Praises within my heart, God, so that I may remember You in meditation. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਜਲ ਨਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਨ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਜੋ ਸੇਵੈ ਸਭ ਫਲਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: tum jal nidh har maan sarovar jo sevai sabh falane |
English: You are the treasure of water, O Lord, the Maansarovar Lake. Whoever serves You receives all fruitful rewards.

Gurbani: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਂਛੈ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਣੇ ॥੪॥੬॥
Transliteration: jan naanak har har har har baanchhai har devahu kar kripane |4|6|
English: Servant Nanak longs for the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har; bless him, Lord, with Your Mercy. ||4||6||

[Ang 977 | Raag: Raag Nat Naaraayan | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਨਟ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਪੜਤਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: natt naaraaein mahalaa 4 parrataal |
English: Nat Naaraayan, Fourth Mehl, Partaal:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸੇਵ ਸਫਲ ਹਰਿ ਘਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: mere man sev safal har ghaal |
English: O my mind, serve the Lord, and receive the fruits of your rewards.

Gurbani: ਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਗ ਰੇਨ ਰਵਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: le gur pag ren ravaal |
English: Receive the dust of the Guru's feet.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਦਾਲਿਦ ਭੰਜਿ ਦੁਖ ਦਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: sabh daalid bhanj dukh daal |
English: All poverty will be eliminated, and your pains will disappear.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹੋ ਹੋ ਹੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har ho ho ho nadar nihaal |1| rahaau |
English: The Lord shall bless you with His Glance of Grace, and you shall be enraptured. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਰੰਗ ਮਹਲ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਲਾਲ ਲਾਲ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa grihu har aap savaario har rang rang mehal beant laal laal har laal |
English: The Lord Himself embellishes His household. The Lord's Mansion of Love is studded with countless jewels, the jewels of the Beloved Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਨੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਆਪਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਆਇਓ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੀਈ ਹੈ ਬਸੀਠੀ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਖੇ ਭਈ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har aapanee kripaa karee aap grihi aaeo ham har kee gur keeee hai baseetthee ham har dekhe bhee nihaal nihaal nihaal nihaal |1|
English: The Lord Himself has granted His Grace, and He has come into my home.The Guru is my advocate before the Lord. Gazing upon the Lord, I have become blissful, blissful, blissful. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਵਤੇ ਕੀ ਖਬਰਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਾਈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਆਨਦੋ ਆਨੰਦ ਭਏ ਹਰਿ ਆਵਤੇ ਸੁਨੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: har aavate kee khabar gur paaee man tan aanado aanand bhe har aavate sune mere laal har laal |
English: From the Guru, I received news of the Lord's arrival. My mind and body became ecstatic and blissful, hearing of the arrival of the Lord, my Beloved Love, my Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਭਏ ਗਲਤਾਨ ਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੨॥੧॥੭॥
Transliteration: jan naanak har har mile bhe galataan haal nihaal nihaal |2|1|7|
English: Servant Nanak has met with the Lord, Har, Har; he is intoxicated, enraptured, enraptured. ||2||1||7||

[Ang 977 | Raag: Raag Nat Naaraayan | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: natt mahalaa 4 |
English: Nat, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮਿਲੁ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੁਭਵੰਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: man mil santasangat subhavantee |
English: O mind, join the Society of the Saints, and become noble and exalted.

Gurbani: ਸੁਨਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਖਵੰਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: sun akath kathaa sukhavantee |
English: Listen to the Unspoken Speech of the peace-giving Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਲਹੰਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kilabikh paap lahantee |
English: All sins will be washed away.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹੋ ਹੋ ਹੋ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਲਿਖੰਤੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har ho ho ho likhat likhantee |1| rahaau |
English: Meet with the Lord, according to your pre-ordained destiny. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਲਜੁਗ ਵਿਚਿ ਊਤਮ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਥਾ ਭਜੰਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: har keerat kalajug vich aootam mat guramat kathaa bhajantee |
English: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise is lofty and exalted. Following the Guru's Teachings, the intellect dwells on the sermon of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਮਨੀ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੰਤੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jin jan sunee manee hai jin jan tis jan kai hau kurabaanantee |1|
English: I am a sacrifice to that person who listens and believes. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਕਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਸਭ ਭੂਖ ਲਹੰਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: har akath kathaa kaa jin ras chaakhiaa tis jan sabh bhookh lahantee |
English: One who tastes the sublime essence of the Unspoken Speech of the Lord - all his hunger is satisfied.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੇ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਵੰਤੀ ॥੨॥੨॥੮॥
Transliteration: naanak jan har kathaa sun tripate jap har har har hovantee |2|2|8|
English: Servant Nanak listens to the sermon of the Lord, and is satisfied; chanting the Lord's Name, Har, Har, Har, he has become like the Lord. ||2||2||8||

[Ang 977 | Raag: Raag Nat Naaraayan | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: natt mahalaa 4 |
English: Nat, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਆਨਿ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: koee aan sunaavai har kee har gaal |
English: If only someone would come and tell me the Lord's sermon.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: tis kau hau bal bal baal |
English: I would be a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice to him.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਹੈ ਭਲ ਭਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: so har jan hai bhal bhaal |
English: That humble servant of the Lord is the best of the best.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹੋ ਹੋ ਹੋ ਮੇਲਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har ho ho ho mel nihaal |1| rahaau |
English: Meeting with the Lord, you be enraptured. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਤਿ ਬਤਾਇਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਚਾਲ ਦਿਖਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਚਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa maarag gur sant bataaeo gur chaal dikhaaee har chaal |
English: The Guru, the Saint, has shown me the Lord's Path. The Guru has shown me the way to walk on the Lord's Path.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਹੁ ਨਿਹਕਪਟ ਕਮਾਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਘਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: antar kapatt chukaavahu mere gurasikhahu nihakapatt kamaavahu har kee har ghaal nihaal nihaal nihaal |1|
English: Cast out deception from within yourself, O my Gursikhs, and without deception, serve the Lord. You shall be enraptured, enraptured, enraptured. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਸਿਖ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਭਾਏ ਜਿਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਮੇਰਾ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: te gur ke sikh mere har prabh bhaae jinaa har prabh jaanio meraa naal |
English: Those Sikhs of the Guru, who realize that my Lord God is with them, are pleasing to my Lord God.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੨॥੩॥੯॥
Transliteration: jan naanak kau mat har prabh deenee har dekh nikatt hadoor nihaal nihaal nihaal nihaal |2|3|9|
English: The Lord God has blessed servant Nanak with understanding; seeing his Lord hear at hand, his is enraptured, enraptured, enraptured, enraptured. ||2||3||9||

[Ang 978 | Raag: Raag Nat Naaraayan | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਨਟ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raag natt naaraaein mahalaa 5 |
English: Raag Nat Naaraayan, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਨਾ ਕਿਆ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: raam hau kiaa jaanaa kiaa bhaavai |
English: O Lord, how can I know what pleases You?

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਪਿਆਸ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦਰਸਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: man piaas bahut darasaavai |1| rahaau |
English: Within my mind is such a great thirst for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਊਪਰਿ ਰੁਚ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: soee giaanee soee jan teraa jis aoopar ruch aavai |
English: He alone is a spiritual teacher, and he alone is Your humble servant, to whom You have given Your approval.

Gurbani: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ਸੋ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kripaa karahu jis purakh bidhaate so sadaa sadaa tudh dhiaavai |1|
English: He alone meditates on You forever and ever, O Primal Lord, O Architect of Destiny, unto whom You grant Your Grace. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਵਨ ਜੋਗ ਕਵਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨਾ ਕਵਨ ਗੁਨੀ ਰੀਝਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: kavan jog kavan giaan dhiaanaa kavan gunee reejhaavai |
English: What sort of Yoga, what spiritual wisdom and meditation, and what virtues please You?

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ਨਿਜ ਭਗਤਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਊਪਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: soee jan soee nij bhagataa jis aoopar rang laavai |2|
English: He alone is a humble servant, and he alone is God's own devotee, with whom You are in love. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਾਈ ਮਤਿ ਸਾਈ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਜਿਤੁ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਿਸਰਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: saaee mat saaee budh siaanap jit nimakh na prabh bisaraavai |
English: That alone is intelligence, that alone is wisdom and cleverness, which inspires one to never forget God, even for an instant.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਲਗਿ ਏਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: santasang lag ehu sukh paaeo har gun sad hee gaavai |3|
English: Joining the Society of the Saints, I have found this peace, singing forever the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦੇਖਿਓ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਮਹਾ ਮੰਗਲ ਰੂਪ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਨ ਨਹੀ ਦਿਸਟਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: dekhio acharaj mahaa mangal roop kichh aan nahee disattaavai |
English: I have seen the Wondrous Lord, the embodiment of supreme bliss, and now, I see nothing else at all.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੋਰਚਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਲਾਹਿਓ ਤਹ ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਕਹ ਆਵੈ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak morachaa gur laahio teh garabh jon keh aavai |4|1|
English: Says Nanak, the Guru has rubbed sway the rust; now how could I ever enter the womb of reincarnation again? ||4||1||

[Ang 978 | Raag: Raag Nat Naaraayan | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਨਟ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: natt naaraaein mahalaa 5 dupade |
English: Raag Nat Naaraayan, Fifth Mehl, Dho-Padhay:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਉਲਾਹਨੋ ਮੈ ਕਾਹੂ ਨ ਦੀਓ ॥
Transliteration: aulaahano mai kaahoo na deeo |
English: I don't blame anyone else.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮੀਠ ਤੁਹਾਰੋ ਕੀਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: man meetth tuhaaro keeo |1| rahaau |
English: Whatever You do is sweet to my mind. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਗਿਆ ਮਾਨਿ ਜਾਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਹਾਰੋ ਜੀਓ ॥
Transliteration: aagiaa maan jaan sukh paaeaa sun sun naam tuhaaro jeeo |
English: Understanding and obeying Your Order, I have found peace; hearing, listening to Your Name, I live.

Gurbani: ਈਹਾਂ ਊਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਇਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੀਓ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: eehaan aoohaa har tum hee tum hee ihu gur te mantru drirreeo |1|
English: Here and hereafter, O Lord, You, only You. The Guru has implanted this Mantra within me. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਜਾਨਿ ਪਾਈ ਏਹ ਬਾਤਾ ਤਬ ਕੁਸਲ ਖੇਮ ਸਭ ਥੀਓ ॥
Transliteration: jab te jaan paaee eeh baataa tab kusal khem sabh theeo |
English: Since I came to realize this, I have been blessed with total peace and pleasure.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਓ ਆਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਰੇ ਬੀਓ ॥੨॥੧॥੨॥
Transliteration: saadhasang naanak paragaasio aan naahee re beeo |2|1|2|
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, this has been revealed to Nanak, and now, there is no other for him at all. ||2||1||2||

[Ang 978 | Raag: Raag Nat Naaraayan | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: natt mahalaa 5 |
English: Nat, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਈ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਧੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kau bhee tumaaree dheer |
English: Whoever has You for support,

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਮਿਟੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਿਕਸੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਪੀਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jam kee traas mittee sukh paaeaa nikasee haumai peer |1| rahaau |
English: has the fear of death removed; peace is found, and the disease of egotism is taken away. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤਪਤਿ ਬੁਝਾਨੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਨੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੇ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਖੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: tapat bujhaanee amrit baanee tripate jiau baarik kheer |
English: The fire within is quenched, and one is satisfied through the Ambrosial Word of the Guru's Bani, as the baby is satisfied by milk.

Gurbani: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸਾਜਨ ਸੰਤ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ਬੀਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: maat pitaa saajan sant mere sant sahaaee beer |1|
English: The Saints are my mother, father and friends. The Saints are my help and support, and my brothers. ||1||

Gurbani: ਖੁਲੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੀਤਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ਹੀਰੈ ਬੇਧੇ ਹੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: khule bhram bheet mile gopaalaa heerai bedhe heer |
English: The doors of doubt are thrown open, and I have met the Lord of the World; God's diamond has pierced the diamond of my mind.

Gurbani: ਬਿਸਮ ਭਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਤ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਗੁਨੀ ਗਹੀਰ ॥੨॥੨॥੩॥
Transliteration: bisam bhe naanak jas gaavat tthaakur gunee gaheer |2|2|3|
English: Nanak blossoms forth in ecstasy, singing the Lord's Praises; my Lord and Master is the ocean of virtue. ||2||2||3||

[Ang 979 | Raag: Raag Nat Naaraayan | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: natt mahalaa 5 |
English: Nat, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਪਨਾ ਜਨੁ ਆਪਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਉਧਾਰਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: apanaa jan aapeh aap udhaario |
English: He Himself saves His humble servant.

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸਿਓ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਨਾਹਿ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar jan kai sang basio man te naeh bisaario |1| rahaau |
English: Twenty-four hours a day, He dwells with His humble servant; He never forgets him from His Mind. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਰਨੁ ਚਿਹਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਦਾਸ ਕਾ ਕੁਲੁ ਨ ਬਿਚਾਰਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: baran chihan naahee kichh pekhio daas kaa kul na bichaario |
English: The Lord does not look at his color or form; He does not consider the ancestry of His slave.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਓ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਸਵਾਰਿਓ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa naam har deeo sehaj subhaae savaario |1|
English: Granting His Grace, the Lord blesses him with His Name, and embellishes him with intuitive ease. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਕਾ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: mahaa bikham agan kaa saagar tis te paar utaario |
English: The ocean of fire is treacherous and difficult, but he is carried across.

Gurbani: ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਗਸਾਨੋ ਪੁਨਹ ਪੁਨਹ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿਓ ॥੨॥੩॥੪॥
Transliteration: pekh pekh naanak bigasaano punah punah balihaario |2|3|4|
English: Seeing, seeing Him, Nanak blossoms forth, over and over again, a sacrifice to Him. ||2||3||4||

[Ang 979 | Raag: Raag Nat Naaraayan | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: natt mahalaa 5 |
English: Nat, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਹਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: har har man meh naam kahio |
English: One who chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, within his mind

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਅਪ੍ਰਾਧ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਰਹਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kott apraadh mitteh khin bheetar taa kaa dukh na rahio |1| rahaau |
English: - millions of sins are erased in an instant, and pain is relieved. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਭਇਓ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਹਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: khojat khojat bheo bairaagee saadhoo sang lahio |
English: Seeking and searching, I have become detached; I have found the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਗਹਿਓ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sagal tiaag ek liv laagee har har charan gahio |1|
English: Renouncing everything, I am lovingly focused on the One Lord. I grab hold of the feet of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਹਤ ਮੁਕਤ ਸੁਨਤੇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: kehat mukat sunate nisataare jo jo saran peo |
English: Whoever chants His Name is liberated; whoever listens to it is saved, as is anyone who seeks His Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਓ ॥੨॥੪॥੫॥
Transliteration: simar simar suaamee prabh apunaa kahu naanak anad bheo |2|4|5|
English: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on God the Lord and Master, says Nanak, I am in ecstasy! ||2||4||5||

[Ang 979 | Raag: Raag Nat Naaraayan | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: natt mahalaa 5 |
English: Nat, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਡੋਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal sang laagee ddoree |
English: I am in love with Your Lotus Feet.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਕਰਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਮੋਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sukh saagar kar param gat moree |1| rahaau |
English: O Lord, ocean of peace, please bless me with the supreme status. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅੰਚਲਾ ਗਹਾਇਓ ਜਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਉ ਮਨੁ ਬੀਧੋ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੀ ਖੋਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: anchalaa gahaaeo jan apune kau man beedho prem kee khoree |
English: He has inspired His humble servant to grasp the hem of His robe; his mind is pierced through with the intoxication of divine love.

Gurbani: ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਤ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਸੁ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੀ ਜਾਲੀ ਤੋਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jas gaavat bhagat ras upajio maaeaa kee jaalee toree |1|
English: Singing His Praises, love wells up within the devotee, and the trap of Maya is broken. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਆਨ ਨ ਪੇਖਉ ਹੋਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: pooran poor rahe kirapaa nidh aan na pekhau horee |
English: The Lord, the ocean of mercy, is all-pervading, permeating everywhere; I do not see any other at all.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੀਓ ਦਾਸੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਥੋਰੀ ॥੨॥੫॥੬॥
Transliteration: naanak mel leeo daas apunaa preet na kabahoo thoree |2|5|6|
English: He has united slave Nanak with Himself; His Love never diminishes. ||2||5||6||

[Ang 979 | Raag: Raag Nat Naaraayan | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: natt mahalaa 5 |
English: Nat, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ॥
Transliteration: mere man jap jap har naaraaein |
English: O my mind, chant, and meditate on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਬਿਸਰਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੇ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇਣ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kabahoo na bisarahu man mere te aatth pehar gun gaaein |1| rahaau |
English: I shall never forget Him from my mind; twenty-four hours a day, I sing His Glorious Praises. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰਿ ਕਰਉ ਨਿਤ ਮਜਨੁ ਸਭ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਗਵਾਇਣ ॥
Transliteration: saadhoo dhoor krau nit majan sabh kilabikh paap gavaaein |
English: I take my daily cleansing bath in the dust of the feet of the Holy, and I am rid of all my sins.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਦਿਸਟਿ ਸਮਾਇਣੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: pooran poor rahe kirapaa nidh ghatt ghatt disatt samaaein |1|
English: The Lord, the ocean of mercy, is all-pervading, permeating everywhere; He is seen to be contained in each and every heart. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਕੋਟਿ ਲਖ ਪੂਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਲਾਇਣ ॥
Transliteration: jaap taap kott lakh poojaa har simaran tul na laaein |
English: Hundreds of thousands and millions of meditations, austerities and worships are not equal to remembering the Lord in meditation.

Gurbani: ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਇਣੁ ॥੨॥੬॥੭॥
Transliteration: due kar jorr naanak daan maangai tere daasan daas dasaaein |2|6|7|
English: With his palms pressed together, Nanak begs for this blessing, that he may become the slave of the slaves of Your slaves. ||2||6||7||

[Ang 979 | Raag: Raag Nat Naaraayan | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: natt mahalaa 5 |
English: Nat, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੈ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: merai sarabas naam nidhaan |
English: The treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is everything for me.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੋ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa saadhoo sang milio satigur deeno daan |1| rahaau |
English: Granting His Grace, He has led me to join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; the True Guru has granted this gift. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨਹਾਰਾ ਗਾਉ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: sukhadaataa dukh bhanjanahaaraa gaau keeratan pooran giaan |
English: Sing the Kirtan, the Praises of the Lord, the Giver of peace, the Destroyer of pain; He shall bless you with perfect spiritual wisdom.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਖੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਕੀਨੑੇ ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਮੂੜ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh lobh khandd khandd keenae binasio moorr abhimaan |1|
English: Sexual desire, anger and greed shall be shattered and destroyed, and your foolish ego will be dispelled. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa gun tere aakh vakhaanaa prabh antarajaamee jaan |
English: What Glorious Virtues of Yours should I chant? O God, You are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਰਨਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥੨॥੭॥੮॥
Transliteration: charan kamal saran sukh saagar naanak sad kurabaan |2|7|8|
English: I seek the Sanctuary of Your Lotus Feet, O Lord, ocean of peace; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to You. ||2||7||8||

[Ang 980 | Raag: Raag Nat Naaraayan | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: natt mahalaa 5 |
English: Nat, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਵਾਰਿ ਵਾਰਿ ਜਾਉ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hau vaar vaar jaau gur gopaal |1| rahaau |
English: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Guru, the Lord of the World. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਤੁਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਦਾਤੇ ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mohi niragun tum pooran daate deenaa naath deaal |1|
English: I am unworthy; You are the Perfect Giver. You are the Merciful Master of the meek. ||1||

Gurbani: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਜਾਗਤ ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਧਨ ਮਾਲ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aootthat baitthat sovat jaagat jeea praan dhan maal |2|
English: While standing up and sitting down, while sleeping and awake, You are my soul, my breath of life, my wealth and property. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦਰਸਨ ਪਿਆਸ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮਨਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੩॥੮॥੯॥
Transliteration: darasan piaas bahut man merai naanak daras nihaal |3|8|9|
English: Within my mind there is such a great thirst for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. Nanak is enraptured with Your Glance of Grace. ||3||8||9||

[Ang 980 | Raag: Raag Nat Naaraayan | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਨਟ ਪੜਤਾਲ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: natt parrataal mahalaa 5 |
English: Nat Partaal, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਕੋਊ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੋ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: koaoo hai mero saajan meet |
English: Is there any friend or companion of mine,

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ਨੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: har naam sunaavai neet |
English: who will constantly share the Lord's Name with me?

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਸੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਬਿਪਰੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: binasai dukh bipareet |
English: Will he rid me of my pains and evil tendencies?

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਅਰਪਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਚੀਤੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sabh arpau man tan cheet |1| rahaau |
English: I would surrender my mind, body, consciousness and everything. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਆਪਨ ਕੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: koee viralaa aapan keet |
English: How rare is that one whom the Lord makes His own,

Gurbani: ਸੰਗਿ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: sang charan kamal man seet |
English: and whose mind is sewn into the Lord's Lotus Feet.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਦੀਤ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa har jas deet |1|
English: Granting His Grace, the Lord blesses him with His Praise. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਭਜਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: har bhaj janam padaarath jeet |
English: Vibrating, meditating on the Lord, he is victorious in this precious human life,

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਹੋਹਿ ਪੁਨੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: kott patit hohi puneet |
English: and millions of sinners are sanctified.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਕੀਤ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੦॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: naanak daas bal bal keet |2|1|10|19|
English: Slave Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to Him. ||2||1||10||19||

[Ang 980 | Raag: Raag Nat Naaraayan | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਨਟ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: natt asattapadeea mahalaa 4 |
English: Nat Ashtpadheeyaa, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: raam mere man tan naam adhaare |
English: O Lord, Your Name is the support of my mind and body.

Gurbani: ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਮੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: khin pal reh na skau bin sevaa mai guramat naam samaare |1| rahaau |
English: I cannot survive for a moment, even for an instant, without serving You. Following the Guru's Teachings, I dwell upon the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har har har har har man dhiaavahu mai har har naam piaare |
English: Within my mind, I meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har, Har. The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is so dear to me.

Gurbani: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਭਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: deen deaal bhe prabh tthaakur gur kai sabad savaare |1|
English: When God, my Lord and Master, became merciful to me the meek one, I was exalted by the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਧਸੂਦਨ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਮਾਧੋ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: madhasoodan jagajeevan maadho mere tthaakur agam apaare |
English: Almighty Lord, Slayer of demons, Life of the World, my Lord and Master, inaccessible and infinite:

Gurbani: ਇਕ ਬਿਨਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕਰਉ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਮੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: eik binau benatee krau gur aagai mai saadhoo charan pakhaare |2|
English: I offer this one prayer to the Guru, to bless me, that I may wash the feet of the Holy. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਹਸ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sehas netr netr hai prabh kau prabh eko purakh niraare |
English: The thousands of eyes are the eyes of God; the One God, the Primal Being, remains unattached.

Gurbani: ਸਹਸ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਏਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sehas moorat eko prabh tthaakur prabh eko guramat taare |3|
English: The One God, our Lord and Master, has thousands of forms; God alone, through the Guru's Teachings, saves us. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਮੋਦਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: guramat naam damodar paaeaa har har naam ur dhaare |
English: Following the Guru's Teachings, I have been blessed with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. I have enshrined within my heart the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਬਨੀ ਅਤਿ ਮੀਠੀ ਜਿਉ ਗੂੰਗਾ ਗਟਕ ਸਮੑਾਰੇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: har har kathaa banee at meetthee jiau goongaa gattak samaare |4|
English: The sermon of the Lord, Har, Har, is so very sweet; like the mute, I taste its sweetness, but I cannot describe it at all. ||4||

Gurbani: ਰਸਨਾ ਸਾਦ ਚਖੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੂਜੈ ਅਤਿ ਫੀਕੇ ਲੋਭ ਬਿਕਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: rasanaa saad chakhai bhaae doojai at feeke lobh bikaare |
English: The tongue savors the bland, insipid taste of the love of duality, greed and corruption.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਦ ਚਖਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਸਭ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਸਾਦ ਬਿਸਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: jo guramukh saad chakheh raam naamaa sabh an ras saad bisaare |5|
English: The Gurmukh tastes the flavor of the Lord's Name, and all other tastes and flavors are forgotten. ||5||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁਣਿ ਕਹਤਿਆ ਪਾਪ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: guramat raam naam dhan paaeaa sun kahatiaa paap nivaare |
English: Following the Guru's Teachings, I have obtained the wealth of the Lord's Name; hearing it, and chanting it, sins are eradicated.

Gurbani: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: dharam raae jam nerr na aavai mere tthaakur ke jan piaare |6|
English: The Messenger of Death and the Righteous Judge of Dharma do not even approach the beloved servant of my Lord and Master. ||6||

Gurbani: ਸਾਸ ਸਾਸ ਸਾਸ ਹੈ ਜੇਤੇ ਮੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: saas saas saas hai jete mai guramat naam samaare |
English: With as many breaths as I have, I chant the Naam, under Guru's Instructions.

Gurbani: ਸਾਸੁ ਸਾਸੁ ਜਾਇ ਨਾਮੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੋ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਸਾਸੁ ਬਿਕਾਰੇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: saas saas jaae naamai bin so birathaa saas bikaare |7|
English: Each and every breath which escapes me without the Naam - that breath is useless and corrupt. ||7||

Gurbani: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਨੀ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮੇਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kripaa kripaa kar deen prabh saranee mo kau har jan mel piaare |
English: Please grant Your Grace; I am meek; I seek Your Sanctuary, God. Unite me with Your beloved, humble servants.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹਤੁ ਹੈ ਹਮ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੇ ਪਨਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੮॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak daasan daas kehat hai ham daasan ke panihaare |8|1|
English: Nanak, the slave of Your slaves, says, I am the water-carrier of Your slaves. ||8||1||

[Ang 981 | Raag: Raag Nat Naaraayan | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: natt mahalaa 4 |
English: Nat, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਹਮ ਪਾਥਰ ਨਿਰਗੁਨੀਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: raam ham paathar niraguneeaare |
English: O Lord, I am an unworthy stone.

Gurbani: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਹਮ ਪਾਹਨ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kripaa kripaa kar guroo milaae ham paahan sabad gur taare |1| rahaau |
English: The Merciful Lord, in His Mercy, has led me to meet the Guru; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, this stone is carried across. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਅਤਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਮੈਲਾਗਰੁ ਮਲਗਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur naam drirraae at meetthaa mailaagar malagaare |
English: The True Guru has implanted within me the exceedingly sweet Naam, the Name of the Lord; it is like the most fragrant sandalwood.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੈ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਵਜੀ ਹੈ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਸਕੀ ਮੁਸਕ ਗੰਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naamai surat vajee hai deh dis har musakee musak gandhaare |1|
English: Through the Name, my awareness extends in the ten directions; the fragrance of the fragrant Lord permeates the air. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੀ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਕਥਾ ਕਥਾ ਹੈ ਮੀਠੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਨੀਕੇ ਬਚਨ ਸਮਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: teree niragun kathaa kathaa hai meetthee gur neeke bachan samaare |
English: Your unlimited sermon is the most sweet sermon; I contemplate the most Sublime Word of the Guru.

Gurbani: ਗਾਵਤ ਗਾਵਤ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gaavat gaavat har gun gaae gun gaavat gur nisataare |2|
English: Singing, singing, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; singing His Glorious Praises, the Guru saves me. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬਿਬੇਕੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਸੰਕ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: bibek guroo guroo samadarasee tis mileeai sank utaare |
English: The Guru is wise and clear; the Guru looks upon all alike. Meeting with Him, doubt and skepticism are removed.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: satigur miliai param pad paaeaa hau satigur kai balihaare |3|
English: Meeting with the True Guru, I have obtained the supreme status. I am a sacrifice to the True Guru. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪਾਖੰਡ ਪਾਖੰਡ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਭਰਮੇ ਲੋਭੁ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਜਗਿ ਬੁਰਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: paakhandd paakhandd kar kar bharame lobh paakhandd jag buriaare |
English: Practicing hypocrisy and deception, people wander around in confusion. Greed and hypocrisy are evils in this world.

Gurbani: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਦੁਖਦਾਈ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਖੜਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰੇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: halat palat dukhadaaee hoveh jamakaal kharraa sir maare |4|
English: In this world and the next, they are miserable; the Messenger of Death hovers over their heads, and strikes them down. ||4||

Gurbani: ਉਗਵੈ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਆਲੁ ਜਾਲੁ ਸਮੑਾਲੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: augavai dinas aal jaal samaalai bikh maaeaa ke bisathaare |
English: At the break of day, they take care of their affairs, and the poisonous entanglements of Maya.

Gurbani: ਆਈ ਰੈਨਿ ਭਇਆ ਸੁਪਨੰਤਰੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਭੀ ਦੁਖ ਸਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: aaee rain bheaa supanantar bikh supanai bhee dukh saare |5|
English: When night falls, they enter the land of dreams, and even in dreams, they take care of their corruptions and pains. ||5||

Gurbani: ਕਲਰੁ ਖੇਤੁ ਲੈ ਕੂੜੁ ਜਮਾਇਆ ਸਭ ਕੂੜੈ ਕੇ ਖਲਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kalar khet lai koorr jamaaeaa sabh koorrai ke khalavaare |
English: Taking a barren field, they plant falsehood; they shall harvest only falsehood.

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤ ਨਰ ਸਭਿ ਭੂਖ ਭੁਖਾਨੇ ਦਰਿ ਠਾਢੇ ਜਮ ਜੰਦਾਰੇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: saakat nar sabh bhookh bhukhaane dar tthaadte jam jandaare |6|
English: The materialistic people shall all remain hungry; the brutal Messenger of Death stands waiting at their door. ||6||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਰਜੁ ਚੜਿਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ ਉਤਰੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh karaj charriaa bikh bhaaree utarai sabad veechaare |
English: The self-willed manmukh has accumulated a tremendous load of debt in sin; only by contemplating the Word of the Shabad, can this debt be paid off.

Gurbani: ਜਿਤਨੇ ਕਰਜ ਕਰਜ ਕੇ ਮੰਗੀਏ ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਪਗਿ ਲਗਿ ਵਾਰੇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: jitane karaj karaj ke mangee kar sevak pag lag vaare |7|
English: As much debt and as many creditors as there are, the Lord makes them into servants, who fall at his feet. ||7||

Gurbani: ਜਗੰਨਾਥ ਸਭਿ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਉਪਾਏ ਨਕਿ ਖੀਨੀ ਸਭ ਨਥਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jaganaath sabh jantr upaae nak kheenee sabh nathahaare |
English: All the beings which the Lord of the Universe created - He puts the rings through their noses, and leads them all along.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਖਿੰਚੈ ਤਿਵ ਚਲੀਐ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੮॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak prabh khinchai tiv chaleeai jiau bhaavai raam piaare |8|2|
English: O Nanak, as God drives us on, so do we follow; it is all the Will of the Beloved Lord. ||8||2||

[Ang 981 | Raag: Raag Nat Naaraayan | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: natt mahalaa 4 |
English: Nat, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: raam har amrit sar naavaare |
English: The Lord has bathed me in the pool of Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਮਜਨੁ ਹੈ ਨੀਕੋ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਲਮਲ ਪਾਪ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur giaan majan hai neeko mil kalamal paap utaare |1| rahaau |
English: The spiritual wisdom of the True Guru is the most excellent cleansing bath; bathing in it, all the filthy sins are washed away. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਾ ਗੁਨੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ਪੜਿ ਸੂਆ ਗਨਕ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sangat kaa gun bahut adhikaaee parr sooaa ganak udhaare |
English: The virtues of the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, are so very great. Even the prostitute was saved, by teaching the parrot to speak the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਪਰਸ ਨਪਰਸ ਭਏ ਕੁਬਿਜਾ ਕਉ ਲੈ ਬੈਕੁੰਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: paras naparas bhe kubijaa kau lai baikuntth sidhaare |1|
English: Krishna was pleased, and so he touched the hunch-back Kubija, and she was transported to the heavens. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਜਾਮਲ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਬੋਲਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: ajaamal preet putr prat keenee kar naaraaein bolaare |
English: Ajaamal loved his son Naaraayan, and called out his name.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਜਮਕੰਕਰ ਮਾਰਿ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mere tthaakur kai man bhaae bhaavanee jamakankar maar bidaare |2|
English: His loving devotion pleased my Lord and Master, who struck down and drove off the Messengers of Death. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਾਨੁਖੁ ਕਥੈ ਕਥਿ ਲੋਕ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ਜੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਸੋ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: maanukh kathai kath lok sunaavai jo bolai so na beechaare |
English: The mortal speaks and by speaking, makes the people listen; but he does not reflect upon what he himself says.

Gurbani: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਦਿੜਤਾ ਆਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: satasangat milai ta dirrataa aavai har raam naam nisataare |3|
English: But when he joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, he is confirmed in his faith, and he is saved by the Name of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਬਤੁ ਤਬ ਲਗਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਸਮਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jab lag jeeo pindd hai saabat tab lag kichh na samaare |
English: As long as his soul and body are healthy and strong, he does not remember the Lord at all.

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਆਗਿ ਲਗਾਨੀ ਕਢਿ ਕੂਪੁ ਕਢੈ ਪਨਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jab ghar mandar aag lagaanee kadt koop kadtai panihaare |4|
English: But when his home and mansion catch fire, then, he wants to dig the well to draw water. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤ ਸਿਉ ਮਨ ਮੇਲੁ ਨ ਕਰੀਅਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: saakat siau man mel na kareeahu jin har har naam bisaare |
English: O mind, do not join with the faithless cynic, who has forgotten the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤ ਬਚਨ ਬਿਛੂਆ ਜਿਉ ਡਸੀਐ ਤਜਿ ਸਾਕਤ ਪਰੈ ਪਰਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: saakat bachan bichhooaa jiau ddaseeai taj saakat parai paraare |5|
English: The word of the faithless cynic stings like a scorpion; leave the faithless cynic far, far behind. ||5||

Gurbani: ਲਗਿ ਲਗਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਈ ਲਗਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: lag lag preet bahu preet lagaaee lag saadhoo sang savaare |
English: Fall in love, fall deeply in love with the Lord; clinging to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you will be exalted and embellished.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਬਚਨ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: gur ke bachan sat sat kar maane mere tthaakur bahut piaare |6|
English: Those who accept the Word of the Guru as True, totally True, are very dear to my Lord and Master. ||6||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਪਰਚੂਨ ਕਮਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: poorab janam parachoon kamaae har har har naam piaare |
English: Because of actions committed in past lives, one comes to love the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਰਸੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad amrit ras paaeaa ras gaavai ras veechaare |7|
English: By Guru's Grace, you shall obtain the ambrosial essence; sing of this essence, and reflect upon this essence. ||7||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲਨ ਲਾਲ ਗੁਲਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har har roop rang sabh tere mere laalan laal gulaare |
English: O Lord, Har, Har, all forms and colors are Yours; O my Beloved, my deep crimson ruby.

Gurbani: ਜੈਸਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ॥੮॥੩॥
Transliteration: jaisaa rang dehi so hovai kiaa naanak jant vichaare |8|3|
English: Only that color which You impart, Lord, exists; O Nanak, what can the poor wretched being do? ||8||3||

[Ang 982 | Raag: Raag Nat Naaraayan | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: natt mahalaa 4 |
English: Nat, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਰਖਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: raam gur saran prabhoo rakhavaare |
English: In the Sanctuary of the Guru, the Lord God saves and protects us,

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਕੁੰਚਰੁ ਤਦੂਐ ਪਕਰਿ ਚਲਾਇਓ ਕਰਿ ਊਪਰੁ ਕਢਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jiau kunchar tadooai pakar chalaaeo kar aoopar kadt nisataare |1| rahaau |
English: as He protected the elephant, when the crocodile seized it and pulled it into the water; He lifted him up and pulled him out. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਤਿ ਨੀਕੇ ਮਨਿ ਸਰਧਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: prabh ke sevak bahut at neeke man saradhaa kar har dhaare |
English: God's servants are sublime and exalted; they enshrine faith for Him in their minds.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸਰਧਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mere prabh saradhaa bhagat man bhaavai jan kee paij savaare |1|
English: Faith and devotion are pleasing to my God's Mind; He saves the honor of His humble servants. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਭੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਸਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har har sevak sevaa laagai sabh dekhai braham pasaare |
English: The servant of the Lord, Har, Har, is committed to His service; He sees God pervading the entire expanse of the universe.

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਇਕੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵੈ ਸਭ ਏਕਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ek purakh ik nadaree aavai sabh ekaa nadar nihaare |2|
English: He sees the One and only Primal Lord God, who blesses all with His Glance of Grace. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ਸਭੁ ਚੇਰੀ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਮਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har prabh tthaakur raviaa sabh tthaaee sabh cheree jagat samaare |
English: God, our Lord and Master, is permeating and pervading all places; He takes care of the whole world as His slave.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦਇਆ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਥਰ ਕੀਰੇ ਕਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aap deaal deaa daan devai vich paathar keere kaare |3|
English: The Merciful Lord Himself mercifully gives His gifts, even to worms in stones. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮੁਸਕਾਈ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੂਲਾ ਮਿਰਗੁ ਸਿੰਙ੍ਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: antar vaas bahut musakaaee bhram bhoolaa mirag singhaare |
English: Within the deer is the heavy fragrance of musk, but he is confused and deluded, and he shakes his horns looking for it.

Gurbani: ਬਨੁ ਬਨੁ ਢੂਢਿ ਢੂਢਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਥਾਕੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਘਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: ban ban dtoodt dtoodt fir thaakee gur poorai ghar nisataare |4|
English: Wandering, rambling and roaming through the forests and woods, I exhausted myself, and then in my own home, the Perfect Guru saved me. ||4||

Gurbani: ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਬਾਣੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: baanee guroo guroo hai baanee vich baanee amrit saare |
English: The Word, the Bani is Guru, and Guru is the Bani. Within the Bani, the Ambrosial Nectar is contained.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਕਹੈ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਪਰਤਖਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: gur baanee kahai sevak jan maanai paratakh guroo nisataare |5|
English: If His humble servant believes, and acts according to the Words of the Guru's Bani, then the Guru, in person, emancipates him. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਹੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹੈ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਬੀਜਿਆ ਖਾਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sabh hai braham braham hai pasariaa man beejiaa khaavaare |
English: All is God, and God is the whole expanse; man eats what he has planted.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਜਨ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਹਾਂਸੁ ਦੁਖਿਆ ਧ੍ਰਿਸਟਬੁਧੀ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਘਰੁ ਲੂਕੀ ਜਾਰੇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: jiau jan chandrahaans dukhiaa dhrisattabudhee apunaa ghar lookee jaare |6|
English: When Dhrishtabudhi tormented the humble devotee Chandrahaans, he only set his own house on fire. ||6||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਜਨੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਿਦ ਲੋਚੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਸਾਸ ਨਿਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kau jan antar rid lochai prabh jan ke saas nihaare |
English: God's humble servant longs for Him within his heart; God watches over each breath of His humble servant.

Gurbani: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਜਨ ਪੀਛੈ ਜਗੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: kripaa kripaa kar bhagat drirraae jan peechhai jag nisataare |7|
English: Mercifully, mercifully, He implants devotion within his humble servant; for his sake, God saves the whole world. ||7||

Gurbani: ਆਪਨ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aapan aap aap prabh tthaakur prabh aape srisatt savaare |
English: God, our Lord and Master, is Himself by Himself; God Himself embellishes the universe.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਸਭੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਕਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੮॥੪॥
Transliteration: jan naanak aape aap sabh varatai kar kripaa aap nisataare |8|4|
English: O servant Nanak, He Himself is all-pervading; in His Mercy, He Himself emancipates all. ||8||4||

[Ang 982 | Raag: Raag Nat Naaraayan | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: natt mahalaa 4 |
English: Nat, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: raam kar kirapaa lehu ubaare |
English: Grant Your Grace, Lord, and save me,

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਪਕਰਿ ਦ੍ਰੋਪਤੀ ਦੁਸਟਾਂ ਆਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਜ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jiau pakar dropatee dusattaan aanee har har laaj nivaare |1| rahaau |
English: as You saved Dropadi from shame when she was seized and brought before the court by the evil villians. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਇਕੁ ਮਾਗਉ ਦਾਨੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa jaachik jan tere ik maagau daan piaare |
English: Bless me with Your Grace - I am just a humble beggar of Yours; I beg for a single blessing, O my Beloved.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਨਿਤ ਸਰਧਾ ਲਾਗੀ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: satigur kee nit saradhaa laagee mo kau har gur mel savaare |1|
English: I long constantly for the True Guru. Lead me to meet the Guru, O Lord, that I may be exalted and embellished. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤ ਕਰਮ ਪਾਣੀ ਜਿਉ ਮਥੀਐ ਨਿਤ ਪਾਣੀ ਝੋਲ ਝੁਲਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: saakat karam paanee jiau matheeai nit paanee jhol jhulaare |
English: The actions of the faithless cynic are like the churning of water; he churns, constantly churning only water.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਢਿ ਮਾਖਨ ਕੇ ਗਟਕਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mil satasangat param pad paaeaa kadt maakhan ke gattakaare |2|
English: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, the supreme status is obtained; the butter is produced, and eaten with delight. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਕਾਇਆ ਮਜਨੁ ਕੀਆ ਨਿਤ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਦੇਹ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: nit nit kaaeaa majan keea nit mal mal deh savaare |
English: He may constantly and continually wash his body; he may constantly rub, clean and polish his body.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਮਨਿ ਬਚਨ ਨ ਭਾਏ ਸਭ ਫੋਕਟ ਚਾਰ ਸੀਗਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: mere satigur ke man bachan na bhaae sabh fokatt chaar seegaare |3|
English: But if the Word of my True Guru is not pleasing to his mind, then all his preparations and beautiful decorations are useless. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਟਕਿ ਮਟਕਿ ਚਲੁ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਸਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: mattak mattak chal sakhee sahelee mere tthaakur ke gun saare |
English: Walk playfully and carefree, O my friends and companions; cherish the Glorious Virtues of my Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਈ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਰੇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: guramukh sevaa mere prabh bhaaee mai satigur alakh lakhaare |4|
English: To serve, as Gurmukh, is pleasing to my God. Through the True Guru, the unknown is known. ||4||

Gurbani: ਨਾਰੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਭ ਨਾਰੀ ਸਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: naaree purakh purakh sabh naaree sabh eko purakh muraare |
English: Women and men, all the men and women, all came from the One Primal Lord God.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਰੇਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: sant janaa kee ren man bhaaee mil har jan har nisataare |5|
English: My mind loves the dust of the feet of the humble; the Lord emancipates those who meet with the Lord's humble servants. ||5||

Gurbani: ਗ੍ਰਾਮ ਗ੍ਰਾਮ ਨਗਰ ਸਭ ਫਿਰਿਆ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਭਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: graam graam nagar sabh firiaa rid antar har jan bhaare |
English: From village to village, throughout all the cities I wandered; and then, inspired by the Lord's humble servants, I found Him deep within the nucleus of my heart.

Gurbani: ਸਰਧਾ ਸਰਧਾ ਉਪਾਇ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: saradhaa saradhaa upaae milaae mo kau har gur gur nisataare |6|
English: Faith and longing have welled up within me, and I have been blended with the Lord; the Guru, the Guru, has saved me. ||6||

Gurbani: ਪਵਨ ਸੂਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਨੀਕਾ ਕਰਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: pavan soot sabh neekaa kariaa satigur sabad veechaare |
English: The thread of my breath has been made totally sublime and pure; I contemplate the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਨੈਨਾ ਜਗਤੁ ਨਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: nij ghar jaae amrit ras peea bin nainaa jagat nihaare |7|
English: I came back to the home of my own inner self; drinking in the ambrosial essence, I see the world, without my eyes. ||7||

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਗੁਨ ਈਸ ਬਰਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਸਾਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਮੰਦਰ ਹਮ ਨਿਕ ਕੀਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: tau gun ees baran nahee saakau tum mandar ham nik keere |
English: I cannot describe Your Glorious Virtues, Lord; You are the temple, and I am just a tiny worm.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਮੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰੇ ॥੮॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak kripaa karahu gur melahu mai raam japat man dheere |8|5|
English: Bless Nanak with Your Mercy, and unite him with the Guru; meditating on my Lord, my mind is comforted and consoled. ||8||5||

[Ang 983 | Raag: Raag Nat Naaraayan | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: natt mahalaa 4 |
English: Nat, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਭਜੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: mere man bhaj tthaakur agam apaare |
English: O my mind, vibrate, meditate on the inaccessible and infinite Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਬਹੁ ਨਿਰਗੁਣੀਆਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ham paapee bahu niraguneeaare kar kirapaa gur nisataare |1| rahaau |
English: I am such a great sinner; I am so unworthy. And yet the Guru, in His Mercy, has saved me. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧੂ ਪੁਰਖ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਪਾਏ ਇਕ ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰਉ ਗੁਰ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: saadhoo purakh saadh jan paae ik binau krau gur piaare |
English: I have found the Holy Person, the Holy and humble servant of the Lord; I offer a prayer to Him, my Beloved Guru.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਪੂਜੀ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਭੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: raam naam dhan poojee devahu sabh tisanaa bhookh nivaare |1|
English: Please, bless me with the wealth, the capital of the Lord's Name, and take away all my hunger and thirst. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪਚੈ ਪਤੰਗੁ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਭ੍ਰਿੰਗ ਕੁੰਚਰ ਮੀਨ ਇਕ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਪਕਰਿ ਸਘਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: pachai patang mrig bhring kunchar meen ik indree pakar saghaare |
English: The moth, the deer, the bumble bee, the elephant and the fish are ruined, each by the one passion that controls them.

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਭੂਤ ਸਬਲ ਹੈ ਦੇਹੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਪ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: panch bhoot sabal hai dehee gur satigur paap nivaare |2|
English: The five powerful demons are in the body; the Guru, the True Guru turns out these sins. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੇਦ ਸੋਧਿ ਸੋਧਿ ਦੇਖੇ ਮੁਨਿ ਨਾਰਦ ਬਚਨ ਪੁਕਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: saasatr bed sodh sodh dekhe mun naarad bachan pukaare |
English: I searched and searched through the Shaastras and the Vedas; Naarad the silent sage proclaimed these words as well.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੜਹੁ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: raam naam parrahu gat paavahu satasangat gur nisataare |3|
English: Chanting the Lord's Name, salvation is attained; the Guru saves those in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰੀ ਜਿਵ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਕਮਲੁ ਨਿਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: preetam preet lagee prabh keree jiv sooraj kamal nihaare |
English: In love with the Beloved Lord God, one looks at Him as the lotus looks at the sun.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰ ਸੁਮੇਰ ਮੋਰੁ ਬਹੁ ਨਾਚੈ ਜਬ ਉਨਵੈ ਘਨ ਘਨਹਾਰੇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: mer sumer mor bahu naachai jab unavai ghan ghanahaare |4|
English: The peacock dances on the mountain, when the clouds hang low and heavy. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤ ਕਉ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਹੁ ਸਿੰਚਹੁ ਸਭ ਡਾਲ ਫੂਲ ਬਿਸੁਕਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: saakat kau amrit bahu sinchahu sabh ddaal fool bisukaare |
English: The faithless cyinc may be totally drenched with ambrosial nectar, but even so, all his branches and flowers are filled with venom.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਨਿਵਹਿ ਸਾਕਤ ਨਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਛੇੜਿ ਛੇੜਿ ਕਢੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: jiau jiau niveh saakat nar setee chherr chherr kadtai bikh khaare |5|
English: The more one bows down in humility before the faithless cyinc, the more he provokes, and stabs, and spits out his poison. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਨ ਸੰਤ ਸਾਧ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਗੁਣ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: santan sant saadh mil raheeai gun boleh praupakaare |
English: Remain with the Holy man, the Saint of the Saints, who chants the Lord's Praises for the benefit of all.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤੈ ਸੰਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਮਲ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: santai sant milai man bigasai jiau jal mil kamal savaare |6|
English: Meeting the Saint of Saints, the mind blossoms forth, like the lotus, exalted by obtaining the water. ||6||

Gurbani: ਲੋਭ ਲਹਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਸੁਆਨੁ ਹਲਕੁ ਹੈ ਹਲਕਿਓ ਸਭਹਿ ਬਿਗਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: lobh lehar sabh suaan halak hai halakio sabheh bigaare |
English: The waves of greed are like mad dogs with rabies. Their madness ruins everything.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੈ ਦੀਬਾਨਿ ਖਬਰਿ ਹੋੁਈ ਗੁਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਖੜਗੁ ਲੈ ਮਾਰੇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: mere tthaakur kai deebaan khabar huoee gur giaan kharrag lai maare |7|
English: When the news reached the Court of my Lord and Master, the Guru took up the sword of spiritual wisdom, and killed them. ||7||

Gurbani: ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੈ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: raakh raakh raakh prabh mere mai raakhahu kirapaa dhaare |
English: Save me, save me, save me, O my God; shower me with Your Mercy, and save me!

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈ ਧਰ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੮॥੬॥ ਛਕਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: naanak mai dhar avar na kaaee mai satigur gur nisataare |8|6| chhakaa 1 |
English: O Nanak, I have no other support; the Guru, the True Guru, has saved me. ||8||6|| First Set of Six Hymns||

[Ang 984 | Raag: Raag Maalee Gauraa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: raag maalee gaurraa mahalaa 4 |
English: Raag Maalee Gauraa, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirbhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibhan gur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: anik jatan kar rahe har ant naahee paaeaa |
English: Countless have tried, but none have found the Lord's limit.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har agam agam agaadh bodh aades har prabh raaeaa |1| rahaau |
English: The Lord is inaccessible, unapproachable and unfathomable; I humbly bow to the Lord God, my King. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਝਗਰਤੇ ਝਗਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh lobh mohu nit jhagarate jhagaraaeaa |
English: Sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment bring continual conflict and strife.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਦੀਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
