Transliteration: ham raakh raakh deen tere har saran har prabh aaeaa |1|
English: Save me, save me, I am your humble creature, O Lord; I have come to Your Sanctuary, O my Lord God. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਲਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਨਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: saranaagatee prabh paalate har bhagat vachhal naaeaa |
English: You protect and preserve those who take to Your Sanctuary, God; You are called the Lover of Your devotees.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦੁ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਨਾਖਿ ਪਕਰਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਓ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: prahilaad jan haranaakh pakariaa har raakh leeo taraaeaa |2|
English: Prahlaad, Your humble servant, was caught by Harnaakhash; but You saved Him and carried him across, Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਵਣ ਸਭ ਦੂਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: har chet re man mehal paavan sabh dookh bhanjan raaeaa |
English: Remember the Lord, O mind, and rise up to the Mansion of His Presence; the Sovereign Lord is the Destroyer of pain.

Gurbani: ਭਉ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bhau janam maran nivaar tthaakur har guramatee prabh paaeaa |3|
English: Our Lord and Master takes away the fear of birth and death; following the Guru's Teachings, the Lord God is found. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਭਉ ਭਗਤ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: har patit paavan naam suaamee bhau bhagat bhanjan gaaeaa |
English: The Name of the Lord, our Lord and Master, is the Purifier of sinners; I sing of the Lord, the Destroyer of the fears of His devotees.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਾਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: har haar har ur dhaario jan naanak naam samaaeaa |4|1|
English: One who wears the necklace of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in his heart, O servant Nanak, merges in the Naam. ||4||1||

[Ang 984 | Raag: Raag Maalee Gauraa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: maalee gaurraa mahalaa 4 |
English: Maalee Gauraa, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: jap man raam naam sukhadaataa |
English: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, the Giver of peace.

Gurbani: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: satasangat mil har saad aaeaa guramukh braham pachhaataa |1| rahaau |
English: One who joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and enjoys the sublime taste of the Lord, as Gurmukh, comes to realize God. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: vaddabhaagee gur darasan paaeaa gur miliai har prabh jaataa |
English: By great good fortune, one obtains the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan; meeting with the Guru, the Lord God is known.

Gurbani: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਈ ਸਭ ਨੀਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: duramat mail gee sabh neekar har amrit har sar naataa |1|
English: The filth of evil-mindedness is totally washed away, bathing in the Lord's ambrosial pool of nectar. ||1||

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਾਧ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਪੂਛਉ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਬਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan saadh jinaee har prabh paaeaa tina poochhau har kee baataa |
English: Blessed, blessed are the Holy, who have found their Lord God; I ask them to tell me the stories of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਪਾਇ ਲਗਉ ਨਿਤ ਕਰਉ ਜੁਦਰੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਕਰਮਿ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: paae lgau nit krau judareea har melahu karam bidhaataa |2|
English: I fall at their feet, and always pray to them, to mercifully unite me with my Lord, the Architect of Destiny. ||2||

Gurbani: ਲਿਲਾਟ ਲਿਖੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: lilaatt likhe paaeaa gur saadhoo gur bachanee man tan raataa |
English: Through the destiny written on my forehead, I have found the Holy Guru; my mind and body are imbued with the Guru's Word.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਭ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਗਵਾਤਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har prabh aae mile sukh paaeaa sabh kilavikh paap gavaataa |3|
English: The Lord God has come to meet me; I have found peace, and I am rid of all the sins. ||3||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਜਿਨੑ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਊਤਮ ਬਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: raam rasaaein jina guramat paaeaa tina kee aootam baataa |
English: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings find the Lord, the source of nectar; their words are sublime and exalted.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਪੰਕ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਚਰਨਿ ਪਰਾਤਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: tin kee pank paaeeai vaddabhaagee jan naanak charan paraataa |4|2|
English: By great good fortune, one is blessed with the dust of their feet; servant Nanak falls at their feet. ||4||2||

[Ang 985 | Raag: Raag Maalee Gauraa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: maalee gaurraa mahalaa 4 |
English: Maalee Gauraa, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: sabh sidh saadhik mun janaa man bhaavanee har dhiaaeo |
English: All the Siddhas, seekers and silent sages, with their minds full of love, meditate on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਪਰੰਪਰੋ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਲਖਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aparanparo paarabraham suaamee har alakh guroo lakhaaeo |1| rahaau |
English: The Supreme Lord God, my Lord and Master, is limitless; the Guru has inspired me to know the unknowable Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਨੀਚ ਮਧਿਮ ਕਰਮ ਕੀਏ ਨਹੀ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: ham neech madhim karam kee nahee chetio har raaeo |
English: I am low, and I commit evil actions; I have not remembered my Sovereign Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਆਨਿ ਮੇਲਿਓ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਖਿਨੁ ਬੰਧ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har aan melio satiguroo khin bandh mukat karaaeo |1|
English: The Lord has led me to meet the True Guru; in an instant, He liberated me from bondage. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮਸਤਕੇ ਧੁਰਿ ਲੀਖਿਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: prabh masatake dhur leekhiaa guramatee har liv laaeo |
English: Such is the destiny God wrote on my forehead; following the Guru's Teachings, I enshrine love for the Lord.

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦ ਦਰਗਹ ਬਾਜਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: panch sabad daragah baajiaa har milio mangal gaaeo |2|
English: The Panch Shabad, the five primal sounds, vibrate and resound in the Court of the Lord; meeting the Lord, I sing the songs of joy. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਰਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਭਾਗੀਆਂ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: patit paavan naam narahar mandabhaageean nahee bhaaeo |
English: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the Purifier of sinners; the unfortunate wretches do not like this.

Gurbani: ਤੇ ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨੀ ਗਾਲੀਅਹਿ ਜਿਉ ਲੋਨੁ ਜਲਹਿ ਗਲਾਇਓ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: te garabh jonee gaaleeeh jiau lon jaleh galaaeo |3|
English: They rot away in the womb of reincarnation; they fall apart like salt in water. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਤਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਗਮ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਮਨੁ ਮੈ ਲਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: mat dehi har prabh agam tthaakur gur charan man mai laaeo |
English: Please bless me with such understanding, O Inaccessible Lord God, my Lord and Master, that my mind may remain attached to the Guru's feet.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੈ ਰਹਉ ਲਾਗੋ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਓ ॥੪॥੩॥
Transliteration: har raam naamai rhau laago jan naanak naam samaaeo |4|3|
English: Servant Nanak remains attached to the Name of the Lord; he is merged in the Naam. ||4||3||

[Ang 985 | Raag: Raag Maalee Gauraa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: maalee gaurraa mahalaa 4 |
English: Maalee Gauraa, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਸਿ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: meraa man raam naam ras laagaa |
English: My mind is addicted to the juice of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਭਇਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kamal pragaas bheaa gur paaeaa har japio bhram bhau bhaagaa |1| rahaau |
English: My heart-lotus has blossomed forth, and I have found the Guru. Meditating on the Lord, my doubts and fears have run away. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਲਾਗੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਹੀਅਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਸੋਇਓ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: bhai bhaae bhagat laago meraa heearaa man soeo guramat jaagaa |
English: In the Fear of God, my heart is committed in loving devotion to Him; following the Guru's Teachings, my sleeping mind has awakened.

Gurbani: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਖੀਨ ਭਏ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਵਡਭਾਗਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kilabikh kheen bhe saant aaee har ur dhaario vaddabhaagaa |1|
English: All my sins have been erased, and I have found peace and tranquility; I have enshrined the Lord within my heart, by great good fortune. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭੁ ਹੈ ਕਚੂਆ ਜਿਉ ਕੁਸਮ ਚਾਰਿ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh rang kasunbh hai kachooaa jiau kusam chaar din chaagaa |
English: The self-willed manmukh is like the false color of the safflower, which fades away; its color lasts for only a few days.

Gurbani: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਪਰਤਾਪੈ ਡੰਡੁ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕਾ ਲਾਗਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: khin meh binas jaae parataapai ddandd dharam raae kaa laagaa |2|
English: He perishes in an instant; he is tormented, and punished by the Righteous Judge of Dharma. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਅਤਿ ਗੂੜੀ ਜਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਜੀਠ ਬਹੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: satasangat preet saadh at goorree jiau rang majeetth bahu laagaa |
English: The Lord's Love, found in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, is absolutely permanent, and colorfast.

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਾਪਰੁ ਚੀਰ ਬਹੁ ਫਾਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਲਹੈ ਸਭਾਗਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa kaapar cheer bahu faare har rang na lahai sabhaagaa |3|
English: The cloth of the body may be torn to shreds, but still, this beautiful color of the Lord's Love does not fade away. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਚਾਰ੍ਹਿਓ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੈ ਰਾਂਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: har chaarhio rang milai gur sobhaa har rang chaloolai raangaa |
English: Meeting with the Blessed Guru, one is dyed in the color of the Lord's Love, imbued with this deep crimson color.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਰੈ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨੀ ਜਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥੪॥੪॥
Transliteration: jan naanak tin ke charan pakhaarai jo har charanee jan laagaa |4|4|
English: Servant Nanak washes the feet of that humble being, who is attached to the feet of the Lord. ||4||4||

[Ang 985 | Raag: Raag Maalee Gauraa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: maalee gaurraa mahalaa 4 |
English: Maalee Gauraa, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਭਜੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਪਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: mere man bhaj har har naam gupaalaa |
English: O my mind, meditate, vibrate upon the Name of the Lord, the Lord of the World, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਲੀਨੁ ਭਇਆ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੈ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: meraa man tan leen bheaa raam naamai mat guramat raam rasaalaa |1| rahaau |
English: My mind and body are merged in the Lord's Name, and through the Guru's Teachings, my intellect is imbued with the Lord, the source of nectar. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਮਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: guramat naam dhiaaeeai har har man japeeai har japamaalaa |
English: Follow the Guru's Teachings, and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. Chant, and meditate, on the beads of the mala of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੀਖਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਬਨਮਾਲਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jina kai masatak leekhiaa har miliaa har banamaalaa |1|
English: Those who have such destiny inscribed upon their foreheads, meet with the Lord, adorned with garlands of flowers. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਚੂਕੇ ਸਰਬ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: jina har naam dhiaaeaa tina chooke sarab janjaalaa |
English: Those who meditate on the Name of the Lord - all their entanglements are ended.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨੑ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tina jam nerr na aavee gur raakhe har rakhavaalaa |2|
English: The Messenger of Death does not even approach them; the Guru, the Savior Lord, saves them. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੂ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: ham baarik kichhoo na jaanahoo har maat pitaa pratipaalaa |
English: I am a child; I know nothing at all. The Lord cherishes me, as my mother and father.

Gurbani: ਕਰੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਅਗਨਿ ਨਿਤ ਮੇਲਤੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kar maaeaa agan nit melate gur raakhe deen deaalaa |3|
English: I continually put my hands into the fire of Maya, but the Guru saves me; He is merciful to the meek. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬਹੁ ਮੈਲੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਇਆ ਸਭ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਹਰਿ ਜਸਿ ਜਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: bahu maile niramal hoeaa sabh kilabikh har jas jaalaa |
English: I was filthy, but I have become immaculate. Singing the Lord's Praises, all sins have been burnt to ashes.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥੪॥੫॥
Transliteration: man anad bheaa gur paaeaa jan naanak sabad nihaalaa |4|5|
English: My mind is in esctasy, having found the Guru; servant Nanak is enraptured through the Word of the Shabad. ||4||5||

[Ang 985 | Raag: Raag Maalee Gauraa | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: maalee gaurraa mahalaa 4 |
English: Maalee Gauraa, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਸਭ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟ ॥
Transliteration: mere man har bhaj sabh kilabikh kaatt |
English: O my mind, meditate, vibrate on the Lord, and all sins will be eradicated.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੀਸੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਗੁਰ ਵਾਟ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har har ur dhaario gur poorai meraa sees keejai gur vaatt |1| rahaau |
English: The Guru has enshried the Lord, Har, Har, within my heart; I place my head on the Guru's Path. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਮੈ ਬਾਤ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਵਉ ਕਟਿ ਕਾਟ ॥
Transliteration: mere har prabh kee mai baat sunaavai tis man devau katt kaatt |
English: Whoever tells me the stories of my Lord God, I would cut my mind into slices, and dedicate it to him.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੇਲਿਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਬਿਕਾਨੋ ਹਟਿ ਹਾਟ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har saajan melio gur poorai gur bachan bikaano hatt haatt |1|
English: The Perfect Guru has united me with the Lord, my Friend; I have sold myself at each and every store for the Guru's Word. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਕਰ ਪ੍ਰਾਗਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਆ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਦੀਓ ਅਧ ਕਾਟਿ ॥
Transliteration: makar praag daan bahu keea sareer deeo adh kaatt |
English: One may give donations in charity at Prayaag, and cut the body in two at Benares,

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕੋ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਬਹੁ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਕਟਿ ਕਾਟ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bin har naam ko mukat na paavai bahu kanchan deejai katt kaatt |2|
English: but without the Lord's Name, no one attains liberation, even though one may give away huge amounts of gold. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਓ ਮਨਿ ਉਘਰੇ ਕਪਟ ਕਪਾਟ ॥
Transliteration: har keerat guramat jas gaaeo man ughare kapatt kapaatt |
English: When one follows the Guru's Teachings, and sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, the doors of the mind, held shut by deception, are thrown open again.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਫੋਰਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ਲਜ ਭਾਨੀ ਮਟੁਕੀ ਮਾਟ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: trikuttee for bharam bhau bhaagaa laj bhaanee mattukee maatt |3|
English: The three qualities are shattered, doubt and fear run away, and the clay pot of public opinion is broken. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਲਜੁਗਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖੇ ਲਿਲਾਟ ॥
Transliteration: kalajug gur pooraa tin paaeaa jin dhur masatak likhe lilaatt |
English: They alone find the Perfect Guru in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, upon whose foreheads such pre-ordained destiny is inscribed.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ਸਭ ਲਾਥੀ ਭੂਖ ਤਿਖਾਟ ॥੪॥੬॥ ਛਕਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: jan naanak ras amrit peea sabh laathee bhookh tikhaatt |4|6| chhakaa 1 |
English: Servant Nanak drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar; all his hunger and thirst are quenched. ||4||6|| Set of Six Hymns 1||

[Ang 986 | Raag: Raag Maalee Gauraa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maalee gaurraa mahalaa 5 |
English: Maalee Gauraa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਟਹਲ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: re man ttehal har sukh saar |
English: O mind, true peace comes from serving the Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰ ਟਹਲਾ ਝੂਠੀਆ ਨਿਤ ਕਰੈ ਜਮੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: avar ttahalaa jhoottheea nit karai jam sir maar |1| rahaau |
English: Other services are false, and as punishment for them, the Messenger of Death bashes in one's head. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਾ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੀਖਿਆ ਤੇ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੰਗਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: jinaa masatak leekhiaa te mile sangaar |
English: They alone join the Sangat, the Congregation, upon whose forehead such destiny is inscribed.

Gurbani: ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਾਰਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sansaar bhaujal taariaa har sant purakh apaar |1|
English: They are carried across the terrifying world-ocean by the Saints of the Infinite, Primal Lord God. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਿਤ ਚਰਨ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸਾਧ ਕੇ ਤਜਿ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: nit charan sevahu saadh ke taj lobh moh bikaar |
English: Serve forever at the feet of the Holy; renounce greed, emotional attachment and corruption.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਤਜਹੁ ਦੂਜੀ ਆਸੜੀ ਰਖੁ ਆਸ ਇਕ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sabh tajahu doojee aasarree rakh aas ik nirankaar |2|
English: Abandon all other hopes, and rest your hopes in the One Formless Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਸਾਕਤਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਧ ਅੰਧਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: eik bharam bhoole saakataa bin gur andh andhaar |
English: Some are faithless cynics, deluded by doubt; without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness.

Gurbani: ਧੁਰਿ ਹੋਵਨਾ ਸੁ ਹੋਇਆ ਕੋ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: dhur hovanaa su hoeaa ko na mettanahaar |3|
English: Whatever is pre-ordained, comes to pass; no one can erase it. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅਗਮ ਰੂਪੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕਾ ਅਨਿਕ ਨਾਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: agam roop gobind kaa anik naam apaar |
English: The beauty of the Lord of the Universe is profound and unfathomable; the Names of the Infinite Lord are immunerable.

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan te jan naanakaa jin har naamaa ur dhaar |4|1|
English: Blessed, blessed are those humble beings, O Nanak, who enshrine the Lord's Name in their hearts. ||4||1||

[Ang 986 | Raag: Raag Maalee Gauraa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maalee gaurraa mahalaa 5 |
English: Maalee Gauraa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕਉ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam kau namasakaar |
English: I humbly bow to the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਹੋਵਤ ਉਧਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaas japat hovat udhaar |1| rahaau |
English: Chanting it, one is saved. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਧੰਧ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai simaran mitteh dhandh |
English: Meditating on Him in remembrance, conflicts are ended.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਛੂਟਹਿ ਬੰਧ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai simaran chhootteh bandh |
English: Meditating on Him, one's bonds are untied.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਚਤੁਰ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai simaran moorakh chatur |
English: Meditating on Him, the fool becomes wise.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਕੁਲਹ ਉਧਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jaa kai simaran kulah udhar |1|
English: Meditating on Him, one's ancestors are saved. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਭਉ ਦੁਖ ਹਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai simaran bhau dukh harai |
English: Meditating on Him, fear and pain are taken away.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਅਪਦਾ ਟਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai simaran apadaa ttarai |
English: Meditating on Him, misfortune is avoided.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਮੁਚਤ ਪਾਪ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai simaran muchat paap |
English: Meditating on Him, sins are erased.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jaa kai simaran nahee santaap |2|
English: Meditating on Him, agony is ended. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਰਿਦ ਬਿਗਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai simaran rid bigaas |
English: Meditating on Him, the heart blossoms forth.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਕਵਲਾ ਦਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai simaran kavalaa daas |
English: Meditating on Him, Maya becomes one's slave.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai simaran nidh nidhaan |
English: Meditating on Him, one is blessed with the treasures of wealth.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਤਰੇ ਨਿਦਾਨ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jaa kai simaran tare nidaan |3|
English: Meditating on Him, one crosses over in the end. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: patit paavan naam haree |
English: The Name of the Lord is the Purifier of sinners.

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਭਗਤ ਉਧਾਰੁ ਕਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kott bhagat udhaar karee |
English: It saves millions of devotees.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਾ ਦੀਨੁ ਸਰਨ ॥
Transliteration: har daas daasaa deen saran |
English: I am meek; I seek the Sanctuary of the slaves of the Lord's slaves.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਾਥਾ ਸੰਤ ਚਰਨ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak maathaa sant charan |4|2|
English: Nanak lays his forehead on the feet of the Saints. ||4||2||

[Ang 986 | Raag: Raag Maalee Gauraa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maalee gaurraa mahalaa 5 |
English: Maalee Gauraa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਐਸੋ ਸਹਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: aiso sahaaee har ko naam |
English: This is the sort of helper the Name of the Lord is.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਭਜੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasangat bhaj pooran kaam |1| rahaau |
English: Meditating in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one's affairs are perfectly resolved. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬੂਡਤ ਕਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਬੇੜੀ ਮਿਲਤ ॥
Transliteration: booddat kau jaise berree milat |
English: It is like a boat to a drowning man.

Gurbani: ਬੂਝਤ ਦੀਪਕ ਮਿਲਤ ਤਿਲਤ ॥
Transliteration: boojhat deepak milat tilat |
English: It is like oil to the lamp whose flame is dying out.

Gurbani: ਜਲਤ ਅਗਨੀ ਮਿਲਤ ਨੀਰ ॥
Transliteration: jalat aganee milat neer |
English: It is like water poured on the burning fire.

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੇ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਮੁਖਹਿ ਖੀਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jaise baarik mukheh kheer |1|
English: It is like milk poured into the baby's mouth. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੇ ਰਣ ਮਹਿ ਸਖਾ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ॥
Transliteration: jaise ran meh sakhaa bhraat |
English: As one's brother becomes a helper on the field of battle;

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੇ ਭੂਖੇ ਭੋਜਨ ਮਾਤ ॥
Transliteration: jaise bhookhe bhojan maat |
English: as one's hunger is satisfied by food;

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੇ ਕਿਰਖਹਿ ਬਰਸ ਮੇਘ ॥
Transliteration: jaise kirakheh baras megh |
English: as the cloudburst saves the crops;

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੇ ਪਾਲਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਸੇਂਘ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jaise paalan saran sengh |2|
English: as one is protected in the tiger's lair;||2||

Gurbani: ਗਰੁੜ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਹੀ ਸਰਪ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: garurr mukh nahee sarap traas |
English: As with the magic spell of Garuda the eagle upon one's lips, one does not fear the snake;

Gurbani: ਸੂਆ ਪਿੰਜਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਖਾਇ ਬਿਲਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: sooaa pinjar nahee khaae bilaas |
English: as the cat cannot eat the parrot in its cage;

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੋ ਆਂਡੋ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jaiso aanddo hirade maeh |
English: as the bird cherishes her eggs in her heart;

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੋ ਦਾਨੋ ਚਕੀ ਦਰਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jaiso daano chakee daraeh |3|
English: as the grains are spared, by sticking to the central post of the mill;||3||

Gurbani: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਓਪਮਾ ਥੋਰ ਕਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: bahut opamaa thor kahee |
English: Your Glory is so great; I can describe only a tiny bit of it.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਤੁਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: har agam agam agaadh tuhee |
English: O Lord, You are inaccessible, unapproachable and unfathomable.

Gurbani: ਊਚ ਮੂਚੌ ਬਹੁ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: aooch moochau bahu apaar |
English: You are lofty and high, utterly great and infinite.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਰੇ ਸਾਰ ॥੪॥੩॥
Transliteration: simarat naanak tare saar |4|3|
English: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, O Nanak, one is carried across. ||4||3||

[Ang 987 | Raag: Raag Maalee Gauraa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maalee gaurraa mahalaa 5 |
English: Maalee Gauraa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਇਹੀ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਸਫਲ ਕਾਜ ॥
Transliteration: eihee hamaarai safal kaaj |
English: Please let my works be rewarding and fruitful.

Gurbani: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਲੇਹੁ ਨਿਵਾਜਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: apune daas kau lehu nivaaj |1| rahaau |
English: Please cherish and exalt Your slave. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਸੰਤਹ ਮਾਥ ਮੋਰ ॥
Transliteration: charan santah maath mor |
English: I lay my forehead on the feet of the Saints,

Gurbani: ਨੈਨਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਪੇਖਉ ਨਿਸਿ ਭੋਰ ॥
Transliteration: nain daras pekhau nis bhor |
English: and with my eyes, I gaze upon the Blessed Vision of their Darshan, day and night.

Gurbani: ਹਸਤ ਹਮਰੇ ਸੰਤ ਟਹਲ ॥
Transliteration: hasat hamare sant ttehal |
English: With my hands, I work for the Saints.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਤ ਬਹਲ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: praan man dhan sant behal |1|
English: I dedicate my breath of life, my mind and wealth to the Saints. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: santasang mere man kee preet |
English: My mind loves the Society of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਗੁਨ ਬਸਹਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: sant gun baseh merai cheet |
English: The Virtues of the Saints abide within my consciousness.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਆਗਿਆ ਮਨਹਿ ਮੀਠ ॥
Transliteration: sant aagiaa maneh meetth |
English: The Will of the Saints is sweet to my mind.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਸੰਤ ਡੀਠ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: meraa kamal bigasai sant ddeetth |2|
English: Seeing the Saints, my heart-lotus blossoms forth. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: santasang meraa hoe nivaas |
English: I dwell in the Society of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
Transliteration: santan kee mohi bahut piaas |
English: I have such a great thirst for the Saints.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਬਚਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਹਿ ਮੰਤ ॥
Transliteration: sant bachan mere maneh mant |
English: The Words of the Saints are the Mantras of my mind.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਿਖੈ ਹੰਤ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sant prasaad mere bikhai hant |3|
English: By the Grace of the Saints, my corruption is taken away. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਏਹਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: mukat jugat ehaa nidhaan |
English: This way of liberation is my treasure.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਇਆਲ ਮੋਹਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: prabh deaal mohi devahu daan |
English: O Merciful God, please bless me with this gift.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: naanak kau prabh deaa dhaar |
English: O God, shower Your Mercy upon Nanak.

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਿਦੇ ਮਝਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੪॥
Transliteration: charan santan ke mere ride majhaar |4|4|
English: I have enshrined the feet of the Saints within my heart. ||4||4||

[Ang 987 | Raag: Raag Maalee Gauraa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maalee gaurraa mahalaa 5 |
English: Maalee Gauraa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਕੈ ਸੰਗੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kai sangee naahee door |
English: He is with all; He is not far away.

Gurbani: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਹਾਜਰਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: karan karaavan haajaraa hajoor |1| rahaau |
English: He is the Cause of causes, ever-present here and now. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੁਨਤ ਜੀਓ ਜਾਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: sunat jeeo jaas naam |
English: Hearing His Name, one comes to life.

Gurbani: ਦੁਖ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸੁਖ ਕੀਓ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: dukh binase sukh keeo bisraam |
English: Pain is dispelled; peace and tranquility come to dwell within.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਨਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sagal nidh har har hare |
English: The Lord, Har, Har, is all treasure.

Gurbani: ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mun jan taa kee sev kare |1|
English: The silent sages serve Him. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai ghar sagale samaeh |
English: Everything is contained in His home.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕੋਇ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jis te birathaa koe naeh |
English: No one is turned away empty-handed.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jantr kare pratipaal |
English: He cherishes all beings and creatures.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa sevahu kirapaal |2|
English: Forever and ever, serve the Merciful Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਦੀਬਾਣਿ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa dharam jaa kai deebaan |
English: Righteous justice is dispensed in His Court forever.

Gurbani: ਬੇਮੁਹਤਾਜ ਨਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਾਣਿ ॥
Transliteration: bemuhataaj nahee kichh kaan |
English: He is carefree, and owes allegiance to no one.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਨਾ ਆਪਨ ਆਪਿ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh karanaa aapan aap |
English: He Himself, by Himself, does everything.

Gurbani: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: re man mere too taa kau jaap |3|
English: O my mind, meditate on Him. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasangat kau hau balihaar |
English: I am a sacrifice to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਜਾਸੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jaas mil hovai udhaar |
English: Joining them, I am saved.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਨ ਤਨਹਿ ਰਾਤ ॥
Transliteration: naam sang man taneh raat |
English: My mind and body are attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਰੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥੪॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak kau prabh karee daat |4|5|
English: God has blessed Nanak with this gift. ||4||5||

[Ang 987 | Raag: Raag Maalee Gauraa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: maalee gaurraa mahalaa 5 dupade |
English: Maalee Gauraa, Fifth Mehl, Dho-Padhay:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਮਰਥ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: har samarath kee saranaa |
English: I seek the Sanctuary of the all-powerful Lord.

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕ ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jeeo pindd dhan raas meree prabh ek kaaran karanaa |1| rahaau |
English: My soul, body, wealth and capital belong to the One God, the Cause of causes. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੀਵਣੈ ਕਾ ਮੂਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: simar simar sadaa sukh paaeeai jeevanai kaa mool |
English: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on Him, I have found everlasting peace. He is the source of life.

Gurbani: ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬਤ ਠਾਈ ਸੂਖਮੋ ਅਸਥੂਲ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: rav rahiaa sarabat tthaaee sookhamo asathool |1|
English: He is all-pervading, permeating all places; He is in subtle essence and manifest form. ||1||

Gurbani: ਆਲ ਜਾਲ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਤਜਿ ਸਭਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨਾ ਨਿਤਿ ਗਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aal jaal bikaar taj sabh har gunaa nit gaau |
English: Abandon all your entanglements and corruption; sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord forever.

Gurbani: ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਦੇਹੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥੧॥੬॥
Transliteration: kar jorr naanak daan maangai dehu apanaa naau |2|1|6|
English: With palms pressed together, Nanak begs for this blessing; please bless me with Your Name. ||2||1||6||

[Ang 988 | Raag: Raag Maalee Gauraa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maalee gaurraa mahalaa 5 |
English: Maalee Gauraa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਮਰਥ ਦੇਵ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: prabh samarath dev apaar |
English: God is all-powerful, divine and infinite.

Gurbani: ਕਉਨੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਚਲਿਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kaun jaanai chalit tere kichh ant naahee paar |1| rahaau |
English: Who knows Your wondrous plays? You have no end or limitation. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਇਕ ਖਿਨਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਦਾ ਘੜਿ ਭੰਨਿ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: eik khineh thaap uthaapadaa gharr bhan karanaihaar |
English: In an instant, You establish and disestablish; You create and destroy, O Creator Lord.

Gurbani: ਜੇਤ ਕੀਨ ਉਪਾਰਜਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਦਾਤਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jet keen upaarajanaa prabh daan dee daataar |1|
English: As many beings as You created, God, so many You bless with Your blessings. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਆਇਓ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਊਚ ਅਗਮ ਮੁਰਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: har saran aaeo daas teraa prabh aooch agam muraar |
English: I have come to Your Sanctuary, Lord; I am Your slave, O Inaccessible Lord God.

Gurbani: ਕਢਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਭਉਜਲ ਬਿਖਮ ਤੇ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥੨॥੨॥੭॥
Transliteration: kadt lehu bhaujal bikham te jan naanak sad balihaar |2|2|7|
English: Lift me up and pull me out of the terrifying, treacherous world-ocean; servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice to You. ||2||2||7||

[Ang 988 | Raag: Raag Maalee Gauraa | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maalee gaurraa mahalaa 5 |
English: Maalee Gauraa, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਸਿ ਰਹੇ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: man tan bas rahe gopaal |
English: The Lord of the World abides in my mind and body.

Gurbani: ਦੀਨ ਬਾਂਧਵ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: deen baandhav bhagat vachhal sadaa sadaa kripaal |1| rahaau |
English: Friend of the meek, Lover of His devotees, forever and ever merciful. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤੇ ਮਧਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aad ante madh toohai prabh binaa naahee koe |
English: In the beginning, in the end and in the middle, You alone exist, God; there is none other than You.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਮੰਡਲ ਏਕੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: poor rahiaa sagal manddal ek suaamee soe |1|
English: He is totally permeating and pervading all worlds; He is the One and only Lord and Master. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਰਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਰਸਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: karan har jas netr darasan rasan har gun gaau |
English: With my ears I hear God's Praises, and with my eyes I behold the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; with my tongue I sing the Lord's Glorious Praises.

Gurbani: ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿ ਜਾਏ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥੩॥੮॥੬॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: balihaar jaae sadaa naanak dehu apanaa naau |2|3|8|6|14|
English: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to You; please, bless me with Your Name. ||2||3||8||6||14||

[Ang 988 | Raag: Raag Maalee Gauraa | Author: Bhagat Namdev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਲੀ ਗਉੜਾ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: maalee gaurraa baanee bhagat naamadev jee kee |
English: Maalee Gauraa, The Word Of Devotee Naam Dayv Jee:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਧਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਓ ਰਾਮ ਬੇਨੁ ਬਾਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan o raam ben baajai |
English: Blessed, blessed is that flute which the Lord plays.

Gurbani: ਮਧੁਰ ਮਧੁਰ ਧੁਨਿ ਅਨਹਤ ਗਾਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: madhur madhur dhun anahat gaajai |1| rahaau |
English: The sweet, sweet unstruck sound current sings forth. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਧਨਿ ਧਨਿ ਮੇਘਾ ਰੋਮਾਵਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan meghaa romaavalee |
English: Blessed, blessed is the wool of the sheep;

Gurbani: ਧਨਿ ਧਨਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਓਢੈ ਕਾਂਬਲੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan krisan odtai kaanbalee |1|
English: blessed, blessed is the blanket worn by Krishna. ||1||

Gurbani: ਧਨਿ ਧਨਿ ਤੂ ਮਾਤਾ ਦੇਵਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan too maataa devakee |
English: Blessed, blessed are you, O mother Dayvakee;

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਰਮਈਆ ਕਵਲਾਪਤੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jih grih rameea kavalaapatee |2|
English: into your home the Lord was born. ||2||

Gurbani: ਧਨਿ ਧਨਿ ਬਨ ਖੰਡ ਬਿੰਦ੍ਰਾਬਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: dhan dhan ban khandd bindraabanaa |
English: Blessed, blessed are the forests of Brindaaban;

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਖੇਲੈ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਨਾਰਾਇਨਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jeh khelai sree naaraaeinaa |3|
English: the Supreme Lord plays there. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬੇਨੁ ਬਜਾਵੈ ਗੋਧਨੁ ਚਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: ben bajaavai godhan charai |
English: He plays the flute, and herds the cows;

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੇ ਕਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਨਦ ਕਰੈ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: naame kaa suaamee aanad karai |4|1|
English: Naam Dayv's Lord and Master plays happily. ||4||1||

[Ang 988 | Raag: Raag Maalee Gauraa | Author: Bhagat Namdev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮੇਰੋ ਬਾਪੁ ਮਾਧਉ ਤੂ ਧਨੁ ਕੇਸੌ ਸਾਂਵਲੀਓ ਬੀਠੁਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mero baap maadhau too dhan kesau saanvaleeo beetthulaae |1| rahaau |
English: O my Father, Lord of wealth, blessed are You, long-haired, dark-skinned, my darling. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਰ ਧਰੇ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਤੇ ਆਏ ਗਜ ਹਸਤੀ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਉਧਾਰੀਅਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: kar dhare chakr baikuntth te aae gaj hasatee ke praan udhaareeale |
English: You hold the steel chakra in Your hand; You came down from Heaven, and saved the life of the elephant.

Gurbani: ਦੁਹਸਾਸਨ ਕੀ ਸਭਾ ਦ੍ਰੋਪਤੀ ਅੰਬਰ ਲੇਤ ਉਬਾਰੀਅਲੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: duhasaasan kee sabhaa dropatee anbar let ubaareeale |1|
English: In the court of Duhsaasan, You saved the honor of Dropati, when her clothes were being removed. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੋਤਮ ਨਾਰਿ ਅਹਲਿਆ ਤਾਰੀ ਪਾਵਨ ਕੇਤਕ ਤਾਰੀਅਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: gotam naar ahaliaa taaree paavan ketak taareeale |
English: You saved Ahliyaa, the wife of Gautam; how many have You purified and carried across?

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਅਧਮੁ ਅਜਾਤਿ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਤਉ ਸਰਨਾਗਤਿ ਆਈਅਲੇ ॥੨॥੨॥
Transliteration: aisaa adham ajaat naamadeo tau saranaagat aaeeale |2|2|
English: Such a lowly outcaste as Naam Dayv has come seeking Your Sanctuary. ||2||2||

[Ang 988 | Raag: Raag Maalee Gauraa | Author: Bhagat Namdev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਭੈ ਘਟ ਰਾਮੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਰਾਮਾ ਬੋਲੈ ॥
Transliteration: sabhai ghatt raam bolai raamaa bolai |
English: Within all hearts, the Lord speaks, the Lord speaks.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raam binaa ko bolai re |1| rahaau |
English: Who else speaks, other than the Lord? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਏਕਲ ਮਾਟੀ ਕੁੰਜਰ ਚੀਟੀ ਭਾਜਨ ਹੈਂ ਬਹੁ ਨਾਨਾ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: ekal maattee kunjar cheettee bhaajan hain bahu naanaa re |
English: Out of the same clay, the elephant, the ant, and the many sorts of species are formed.

Gurbani: ਅਸਥਾਵਰ ਜੰਗਮ ਕੀਟ ਪਤੰਗਮ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਨਾ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: asathaavar jangam keett patangam ghatt ghatt raam samaanaa re |1|
English: In stationary life forms, moving beings, worms, moths and within each and every heart, the Lord is contained. ||1||

Gurbani: ਏਕਲ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਰਾਖੁ ਅਨੰਤਾ ਅਉਰ ਤਜਹੁ ਸਭ ਆਸਾ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: ekal chintaa raakh anantaa aaur tajahu sabh aasaa re |
English: Remember the One, Infinite Lord; abandon all other hopes.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਨਾਮਾ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਕਾਮਾ ਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕੋ ਦਾਸਾ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੩॥
Transliteration: pranavai naamaa bhe nihakaamaa ko tthaakur ko daasaa re |2|3|
English: Naam Dayv prays, I have become dispassionate and detached; who is the Lord and Master, and who is the slave? ||2||3||

[Ang 989 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: raag maaroo mahalaa 1 ghar 1 chaupade |
English: Raag Maaroo, First Mehl, First House, Chau-Padhay:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirbhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibhan gur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਸਾਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਚਰਨ ਕੀ ਹੋਇ ਰਹਾ ਸਦ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: saajan tere charan kee hoe rahaa sad dhoor |
English: O my Friend, I shall forever remain the dust of Your feet.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੀਆ ਪੇਖਉ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak saran tuhaareea pekhau sadaa hajoor |1|
English: Nanak seeks Your protection, and beholds You ever-present, here and now. ||1||

[Ang 989 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਬਦ ॥
Transliteration: sabad |
English: Shabad:

Gurbani: ਪਿਛਹੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਦੜਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਲੇਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: pichhahu raatee sadarraa naam khasam kaa lehi |
English: Those who receive the call in the last hours of the night, chant the Name of their Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਖੇਮੇ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਸਰਾਇਚੇ ਦਿਸਨਿ ਰਥ ਪੀੜੇ ॥
Transliteration: kheme chhatr saraaeiche disan rath peerre |
English: Tents, canopies, pavilions and carriages are prepared and made ready for them.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਸਦਿ ਮਿਲੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jinee teraa naam dhiaaeaa tin kau sad mile |1|
English: You send out the call, Lord, to those who meditate on Your Name. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਾਬਾ ਮੈ ਕਰਮਹੀਣ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ॥
Transliteration: baabaa mai karamaheen koorriaar |
English: Father, I am unfortunate, a fraud.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਧਾ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੂਲਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: naam na paaeaa teraa andhaa bharam bhoolaa man meraa |1| rahaau |
English: I have not found Your Name; my mind is blind and deluded by doubt. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਦ ਕੀਤੇ ਦੁਖ ਪਰਫੁੜੇ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖੇ ਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: saad keete dukh parafurre poorab likhe maae |
English: I have enjoyed the tastes, and now my pains have come to fruition; such is my pre-ordained destiny, O my mother.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਥੋੜੇ ਦੁਖ ਅਗਲੇ ਦੂਖੇ ਦੂਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sukh thorre dukh agale dookhe dookh vihaae |2|
English: Now my joys are few, and my pains are many. In utter agony, I pass my life. ||2||

Gurbani: ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਵੀਛੁੜੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਮੇਲੁ ॥
Transliteration: vichhurriaa kaa kiaa veechhurrai miliaa kaa kiaa mel |
English: What separation could be worse than separation from the Lord? For those who are united with Him, what other union can there be?

Gurbani: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਖੇਲੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: saahib so saalaaheeai jin kar dekhiaa khel |3|
English: Praise the Lord and Master, who, having created this play, beholds it. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਮੇਲਾਵੜਾ ਇਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਕੀਤੇ ਭੋਗ ॥
Transliteration: sanjogee melaavarraa in tan keete bhog |
English: By good destiny, this union comes about; this body enjoys its pleasures.

Gurbani: ਵਿਜੋਗੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਭੀ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: vijogee mil vichhurre naanak bhee sanjog |4|1|
English: Those who have lost their destiny, suffer separation from this union. O Nanak, they may still be united once again! ||4||1||

[Ang 989 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 |
English: Maaroo, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: mil maat pitaa pindd kamaaeaa |
English: The union of the mother and father brings the body into being.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tin karatai lekh likhaaeaa |
English: The Creator inscribes upon it the inscription of its destiny.

Gurbani: ਲਿਖੁ ਦਾਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: likh daat jot vaddiaaee |
English: According to this inscription, gifts, light and glorious greatness are received.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mil maaeaa surat gavaaee |1|
English: Joining with Maya, the spiritual consciousness is lost. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੂਰਖ ਮਨ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਰਸਹਿ ਮਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: moorakh man kaahe karaseh maanaa |
English: O foolish mind, why are you so proud?

Gurbani: ਉਠਿ ਚਲਣਾ ਖਸਮੈ ਭਾਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: autth chalanaa khasamai bhaanaa |1| rahaau |
English: You shall have to arise and depart when it pleases your Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤਜਿ ਸਾਦ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: taj saad sehaj sukh hoee |
English: Abandon the tastes of the world, and find intuitive peace.

Gurbani: ਘਰ ਛਡਣੇ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: ghar chhaddane rahai na koee |
English: All must abandon their worldly homes; no one remains here forever.

Gurbani: ਕਿਛੁ ਖਾਜੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਧਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: kichh khaajai kichh dhar jaaeeai |
English: Eat some, and save the rest,

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਆਈਐ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: je baahurr duneea aaeeai |2|
English: if you are destined to return to the world again. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਜੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਪਟੁ ਹਢਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: saj kaaeaa patt hadtaae |
English: He adorns his body and ress in silk robes.

Gurbani: ਫੁਰਮਾਇਸਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਚਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: furamaaeis bahut chalaae |
English: He issues all sorts of commands.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਸੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: kar sej sukhaalee sovai |
English: Preparing his comfortable bed, he sleeps.

Gurbani: ਹਥੀ ਪਉਦੀ ਕਾਹੇ ਰੋਵੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: hathee paudee kaahe rovai |3|
English: When he falls into the hands of the Messenger of Death, what good does it do to cry out? ||3||

Gurbani: ਘਰ ਘੁੰਮਣਵਾਣੀ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ghar ghunmanavaanee bhaaee |
English: Household affairs are whirlpools of entanglements, O Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਪਾਪ ਪਥਰ ਤਰਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: paap pathar taran na jaaee |
English: Sin is a stone which does not float.

Gurbani: ਭਉ ਬੇੜਾ ਜੀਉ ਚੜਾਊ ॥
Transliteration: bhau berraa jeeo charraaoo |
English: So let the Fear of God be the boat to carry your soul across.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਵੈ ਕਾਹੂ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak devai kaahoo |4|2|
English: Says Nanak, rare are those who are blessed with this Boat. ||4||2||

[Ang 990 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ghar 1 |
English: Maaroo, First Mehl, First House:

Gurbani: ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਸਵਾਣੀ ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਦੁਇ ਲੇਖ ਪਏ ॥
Transliteration: karanee kaagad man masavaanee buraa bhalaa due lekh pe |
English: Actions are the paper, and the mind is the ink; good and bad are both recorded upon it.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਚਲਾਏ ਤਿਉ ਚਲੀਐ ਤਉ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਹੀ ਅੰਤੁ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jiau jiau kirat chalaae tiau chaleeai tau gun naahee ant hare |1|
English: As their past actions drive them, so are mortals driven. There is no end to Your Glorious Virtues, Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਚਿਤ ਚੇਤਸਿ ਕੀ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਵਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: chit chetas kee nahee baavariaa |
English: Why do you not keep Him in your consciousness, you mad man?

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਲਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har bisarat tere gun galiaa |1| rahaau |
English: Forgetting the Lord, your own virtues shall rot away. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਾਲੀ ਰੈਨਿ ਜਾਲੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਹੂਆ ਜੇਤੀ ਘੜੀ ਫਾਹੀ ਤੇਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: jaalee rain jaal din hooaa jetee gharree faahee tetee |
English: The night is a net, and the day is a net; there are as many traps as there are moments.

Gurbani: ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਚੋਗ ਚੁਗਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਫਾਸਹਿ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਮੂੜੇ ਕਵਨ ਗੁਣੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ras ras chog chugeh nit faaseh chhoottas moorre kavan gunee |2|
English: With relish and delight, you continually bite at the bait; you are trapped, you fool - how will you ever escape? ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਆਰਣੁ ਮਨੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਲੋਹਾ ਪੰਚ ਅਗਨਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa aaran man vich lohaa panch agan tith laag rahee |
English: The body is a furnace, and the mind is the iron within it; the five fires are heating it.

Gurbani: ਕੋਇਲੇ ਪਾਪ ਪੜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਊਪਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਜਲਿਆ ਸੰਨੑੀ ਚਿੰਤ ਭਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: koeile paap parre tis aoopar man jaliaa sanaee chint bhee |3|
English: Sin is the charcoal placed upon it, which burns the mind; the tongs are anxiety and worry. ||3||

Gurbani: ਭਇਆ ਮਨੂਰੁ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਨੇਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: bheaa manoor kanchan fir hovai je gur milai tinehaa |
English: What was turned to slag is again transformed into gold, if one meets with the Guru.

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਓਹੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਟਸਿ ਦੇਹਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
Transliteration: ek naam amrit ohu devai tau naanak trisattas dehaa |4|3|
English: He blesses the mortal with the Ambrosial Name of the One Lord, and then, O Nanak, the body is held steady. ||4||3||

[Ang 990 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 |
English: Maaroo, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬਿਮਲ ਮਝਾਰਿ ਬਸਸਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਲ ਪਦਮਨਿ ਜਾਵਲ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: bimal majhaar basas niramal jal padaman jaaval re |
English: In the pure, immaculate waters, both the lotus and the slimy scum are found.

Gurbani: ਪਦਮਨਿ ਜਾਵਲ ਜਲ ਰਸ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਦੋਖ ਨਹੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: padaman jaaval jal ras sangat sang dokh nahee re |1|
English: The lotus flower is with the scum and the water, but it remains untouched by any pollution. ||1||

Gurbani: ਦਾਦਰ ਤੂ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਨਸਿ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: daadar too kabeh na jaanas re |
English: You frog, you will never understand.

Gurbani: ਭਖਸਿ ਸਿਬਾਲੁ ਬਸਸਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਲ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨ ਲਖਸਿ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bhakhas sibaal basas niramal jal amrit na lakhas re |1| rahaau |
English: You eat the dirt, while you dwell in the immaculate waters. You know nothing of the ambrosial nectar there. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਸੁ ਜਲ ਨਿਤ ਨ ਵਸਤ ਅਲੀਅਲ ਮੇਰ ਚਚਾ ਗੁਨ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: bas jal nit na vasat aleeal mer chachaa gun re |
English: You dwell continually in the water; the bumble bee does not dwell there, but it is intoxicated with its fragrance from afar.

Gurbani: ਚੰਦ ਕੁਮੁਦਨੀ ਦੂਰਹੁ ਨਿਵਸਸਿ ਅਨਭਉ ਕਾਰਨਿ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: chand kumudanee doorahu nivasas anbhau kaaran re |2|
English: Intuitively sensing the moon in the distance, the lotus bows its head. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਖੰਡੁ ਦੂਧਿ ਮਧੁ ਸੰਚਸਿ ਤੂ ਬਨ ਚਾਤੁਰ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: amrit khandd doodh madh sanchas too ban chaatur re |
English: The realms of nectar are irrigated with milk and honey; you think you are clever to live in the water.

Gurbani: ਅਪਨਾ ਆਪੁ ਤੂ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਸਿ ਪਿਸਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਜਿਉ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: apanaa aap too kabahu na chhoddas pisan preet jiau re |3|
English: You can never escape your own inner tendencies, like the love of the flea for blood. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਜਨ ਮੂਰਖ ਆਗਮ ਸਾਸ ਸੁਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: panddit sang vaseh jan moorakh aagam saas sune |
English: The fool may live with the Pandit, the religious scholar, and listen to the Vedas and the Shaastras.

Gurbani: ਅਪਨਾ ਆਪੁ ਤੂ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਸਿ ਸੁਆਨ ਪੂਛਿ ਜਿਉ ਰੇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: apanaa aap too kabahu na chhoddas suaan poochh jiau re |4|
English: You can never escape your own inner tendencies, like the crooked tail of the dog. ||4||

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਪਾਖੰਡੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਰਾਚਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: eik paakhanddee naam na raacheh ik har har charanee re |
English: Some are hypocrites; they do not merge with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Some are absorbed in the Feet of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਵਸਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਰੇ ॥੫॥੪॥
Transliteration: poorab likhiaa paavas naanak rasanaa naam jap re |5|4|
English: The mortals obtain what they are predestined to receive; O Nanak, with your tongue, chant the Naam. ||5||4||

[Ang 990 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 |
English: Maaroo, First Mehl,

[Ang 990 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
Transliteration: salok |
English: Salok:

Gurbani: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਅਸੰਖ ਹੋਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗ ॥
Transliteration: patit puneet asankh hohi har charanee man laag |
English: Countless sinners are sanctified, attaching their minds to the Feet of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: atthasatth teerath naam prabh naanak jis masatak bhaag |1|
English: The merits of the sixty-eight places of pilgrimage are found in God's Name, O Nanak, when such destiny is inscribed upon one's forehead. ||1||

[Ang 990 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਬਦੁ ॥
Transliteration: sabad |
English: Shabad:

Gurbani: ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਗਰਬਿ ਗਹੇਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: sakhee sahelee garab gahelee |
English: O friends and companions, so puffed up with pride,

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਹ ਕੀ ਇਕ ਬਾਤ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sun seh kee ik baat suhelee |1|
English: listen to this one joyous story of your Husband Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਮੈ ਬੇਦਨ ਸਾ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖਾ ਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jo mai bedan saa kis aakhaa maaee |
English: Who can I tell about my pain, O my mother?

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਉ ਨ ਰਹੈ ਕੈਸੇ ਰਾਖਾ ਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har bin jeeo na rahai kaise raakhaa maaee |1| rahaau |
English: Without the Lord, my soul cannot survive; how can I comfort it, O my mother? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਦੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਖਰੀ ਰੰਞਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: hau dohaagan kharee ranyaanee |
English: I am a dejected, discarded bride, totally miserable.

Gurbani: ਗਇਆ ਸੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਧਨ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: geaa su joban dhan pachhutaanee |2|
English: I have lost my youth; I regret and repent. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਦਾਨਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: too daanaa saahib sir meraa |
English: You are my wise Lord and Master, above my head.

Gurbani: ਖਿਜਮਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਜਨੁ ਬੰਦਾ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: khijamat karee jan bandaa teraa |3|
English: I serve You as Your humble slave. ||3||

Gurbani: ਭਣਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਏਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: bhanat naanak andesaa ehee |
English: Nanak humbly prays, this is my only concern:

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੈਸੇ ਰਵਉ ਸਨੇਹੀ ॥੪॥੫॥
Transliteration: bin darasan kaise rvau sanehee |4|5|
English: without the Blessed Vision of my Beloved, how can I enjoy Him? ||4||5||

[Ang 991 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 |
English: Maaroo, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੁਲ ਖਰੀਦੀ ਲਾਲਾ ਗੋਲਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ਸਭਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: mul khareedee laalaa golaa meraa naau sabhaagaa |
English: I am Your slave, Your bonded servant, and so I am called fortunate.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਚਨੀ ਹਾਟਿ ਬਿਕਾਨਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur kee bachanee haatt bikaanaa jit laaeaa tith laagaa |1|
English: I sold myself at Your store in exchange for the Guru's Word; whatever You link me to, to that I am linked. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੇ ਲਾਲੇ ਕਿਆ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: tere laale kiaa chaturaaee |
English: What cleverness can Your servant try with You?

Gurbani: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saahib kaa hukam na karanaa jaaee |1| rahaau |
English: O my Lord and Master, I cannot carry out the Hukam of Your Command. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਾ ਲਾਲੀ ਪਿਉ ਲਾਲਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਉ ਲਾਲੇ ਕਾ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: maa laalee piau laalaa meraa hau laale kaa jaaeaa |
English: My mother is Your slave, and my father is Your slave; I am the child of Your slaves.

Gurbani: ਲਾਲੀ ਨਾਚੈ ਲਾਲਾ ਗਾਵੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਉ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: laalee naachai laalaa gaavai bhagat krau teree raaeaa |2|
English: My slave mother dances, and my slave father sings; I practice devotional worship to You, O my Sovereign Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪੀਅਹਿ ਤ ਪਾਣੀ ਆਣੀ ਮੀਰਾ ਖਾਹਿ ਤ ਪੀਸਣ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: peeeh ta paanee aanee meeraa khaeh ta peesan jaau |
English: If You wish to drink, then I shall get water for You; if You wish to eat, I shall grind the corn for You.

Gurbani: ਪਖਾ ਫੇਰੀ ਪੈਰ ਮਲੋਵਾ ਜਪਤ ਰਹਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: pakhaa feree pair malovaa japat rahaa teraa naau |3|
English: I wave the fan over You, and wash Your feet, and continue to chant Your Name. ||3||

Gurbani: ਲੂਣ ਹਰਾਮੀ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਲਾਲਾ ਬਖਸਿਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: loon haraamee naanak laalaa bakhasihi tudh vaddiaaee |
English: I have been untrue to myself, but Nanak is Your slave; please forgive him, by Your glorious greatness.

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਦਇਆਪਤਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੬॥
Transliteration: aad jugaad deaapat daataa tudh vin mukat na paaee |4|6|
English: Since the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages, You have been the merciful and generous Lord. Without You, liberation cannot be attained. ||4||6||

[Ang 991 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 |
English: Maaroo, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਆਖੈ ਭੂਤਨਾ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਤਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: koee aakhai bhootanaa ko kahai betaalaa |
English: Some call him a ghost; some say that he is a demon.

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਆਖੈ ਆਦਮੀ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: koee aakhai aadamee naanak vechaaraa |1|
English: Some call him a mere mortal; O, poor Nanak! ||1||

Gurbani: ਭਇਆ ਦਿਵਾਨਾ ਸਾਹ ਕਾ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬਉਰਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: bheaa divaanaa saah kaa naanak bauraanaa |
English: Crazy Nanak has gone insane, after his Lord, the King.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hau har bin avar na jaanaa |1| rahaau |
English: I know of none other than the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਦੇਵਾਨਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਭੈ ਦੇਵਾਨਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: tau devaanaa jaaneeai jaa bhai devaanaa hoe |
English: He alone is known to be insane, when he goes insane with the Fear of God.

Gurbani: ਏਕੀ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ekee saahib baaharaa doojaa avar na jaanai koe |2|
English: He recognizes none other than the One Lord and Master. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਦੇਵਾਨਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਏਕਾ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: tau devaanaa jaaneeai jaa ekaa kaar kamaae |
English: He alone is known to be insane, if he works for the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਦੂਜੀ ਅਵਰ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਕਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: hukam pachhaanai khasam kaa doojee avar siaanap kaae |3|
English: Recognizing the Hukam, the Command of his Lord and Master, what other cleverness is there? ||3||

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਦੇਵਾਨਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: tau devaanaa jaaneeai jaa saahib dhare piaar |
English: He alone is known to be insane, when he falls in love with his Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਮੰਦਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪ ਕਉ ਅਵਰੁ ਭਲਾ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੭॥
Transliteration: mandaa jaanai aap kau avar bhalaa sansaar |4|7|
English: He sees himself as bad, and all the rest of the world as good. ||4||7||

[Ang 991 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 |
English: Maaroo, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਰਬ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: eihu dhan sarab rahiaa bharapoor |
English: This wealth is all-pervading, permeating all.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਸਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਦੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: manamukh fireh si jaaneh door |1|
English: The self-willed manmukh wanders around, thinking that it is far away. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਮਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: so dhan vakhar naam ridai hamaarai |
English: That commodity, the wealth of the Naam, is within my heart.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jis too dehi tisai nisataarai |1| rahaau |
English: Whoever You bless with it, is emancipated. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨ ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਜਲੈ ਨ ਤਸਕਰੁ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: n ihu dhan jalai na tasakar lai jaae |
English: This wealth does not burn; it cannot be stolen by a thief.

Gurbani: ਨ ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਡੂਬੈ ਨ ਇਸੁ ਧਨ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: n ihu dhan ddoobai na is dhan kau milai sajaae |2|
English: This wealth does not drown, and its owner is never punished. ||2||

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਧਨ ਕੀ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: eis dhan kee dekhahu vaddiaaee |
English: Gaze upon the glorious greatness of this wealth,

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sahaje maate anadin jaaee |3|
English: and your nights and days will pass, imbued with celestial peace. ||3||

Gurbani: ਇਕ ਬਾਤ ਅਨੂਪ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਨਰ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: eik baat anoop sunahu nar bhaaee |
English: Listen to this incomparably beautiful story, O my brothers, O Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਧਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: eis dhan bin kahahu kinai param gat paaee |4|
English: Tell me, without this wealth, who has ever obtained the supreme status? ||4||

Gurbani: ਭਣਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਅਕਥ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: bhanat naanak akath kee kathaa sunaae |
English: Nanak humbly prays, I proclaim the Unspoken Speech of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੫॥੮॥
Transliteration: satigur milai ta ihu dhan paae |5|8|
English: If one meets the True Guru, then this wealth is obtained. ||5||8||

[Ang 991 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 |
English: Maaroo, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੂਰ ਸਰੁ ਸੋਸਿ ਲੈ ਸੋਮ ਸਰੁ ਪੋਖਿ ਲੈ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਰਤੁ ਸੁ ਸਨਬੰਧੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: soor sar sos lai som sar pokh lai jugat kar marat su sanabandh keejai |
English: Heat up the sun energy of the right nostril, and cool down the moon energy of the left nostril; practicing this breath-control, bring them into perfect balance.

Gurbani: ਮੀਨ ਕੀ ਚਪਲ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖੀਐ ਉਡੈ ਨਹ ਹੰਸੁ ਨਹ ਕੰਧੁ ਛੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: meen kee chapal siau jugat man raakheeai uddai neh hans neh kandh chheejai |1|
English: In this way, the fickle fish of the mind will be held steady; the swan-soul shall not fly away, and the body-wall will not crumble. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੂੜੇ ਕਾਇਚੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: moorre kaaeiche bharam bhulaa |
English: You fool, why are you deluded by doubt?

Gurbani: ਨਹ ਚੀਨਿਆ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: neh cheeniaa paramaanand bairaagee |1| rahaau |
English: You do not remember the detached Lord of supreme bliss. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਜਰ ਗਹੁ ਜਾਰਿ ਲੈ ਅਮਰ ਗਹੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਲੈ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਿ ਤਜਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਤਉ ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: ajar gahu jaar lai amar gahu maar lai bhraat taj chhodd tau apiau peejai |
English: Seize and burn the unbearable; seize and kill the imperishable; leave behind your doubts, and then, you shall drink in the Nectar.

Gurbani: ਮੀਨ ਕੀ ਚਪਲ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖੀਐ ਉਡੈ ਨਹ ਹੰਸੁ ਨਹ ਕੰਧੁ ਛੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: meen kee chapal siau jugat man raakheeai uddai neh hans neh kandh chheejai |2|
English: In this way, the fickle fish of the mind will be held steady; the swan-soul shall not fly away, and the body-wall shall not crumble. ||2||

Gurbani: ਭਣਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਨੋ ਰਵੈ ਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਮਨੋ ਮਨ ਪਵਨ ਸਿਉ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: bhanat naanak jano ravai je har mano man pavan siau amrit peejai |
English: Nanak humbly prays, if the Lord's humble servant dwells upon Him, in his mind of minds, with his every breath, then he drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਮੀਨ ਕੀ ਚਪਲ ਸਿਉ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖੀਐ ਉਡੈ ਨਹ ਹੰਸੁ ਨਹ ਕੰਧੁ ਛੀਜੈ ॥੩॥੯॥
Transliteration: meen kee chapal siau jugat man raakheeai uddai neh hans neh kandh chheejai |3|9|
English: In this way, the fickle fish of the mind will be held steady; the swan-soul shall not fly away, and the body-wall shall not crumble. ||3||9||

[Ang 992 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 |
English: Maaroo, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੁਈ ਨ ਮਨੁ ਮੁਆ ਸਰੁ ਲਹਰੀ ਮੈ ਮਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa muee na man muaa sar laharee mai mat |
English: Maya is not conquered, and the mind is not subdued; the waves of desire in the world-ocean are intoxicating wine.

Gurbani: ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਜਲ ਸਿਰਿ ਤਰਿ ਟਿਕੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਵਖਰੁ ਜਿਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: bohith jal sir tar ttikai saachaa vakhar jit |
English: The boat crosses over the water, carrying the true merchandise.

Gurbani: ਮਾਣਕੁ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਸੀ ਸਚਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: maanak man meh man maarasee sach na laagai kat |
English: The jewel within the mind subdues the mind; attached to the Truth, it is not broken.

Gurbani: ਰਾਜਾ ਤਖਤਿ ਟਿਕੈ ਗੁਣੀ ਭੈ ਪੰਚਾਇਣ ਰਤੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: raajaa takhat ttikai gunee bhai panchaaein rat |1|
English: The king is seated upon the throne, imbued with the Fear of God and the five qualities. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਾਬਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਦੇਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: baabaa saachaa saahib door na dekh |
English: O Baba, do not see your True Lord and Master as being far away.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਜੀਵਨਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਲੇਖੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sarab jot jagajeevanaa sir sir saachaa lekh |1| rahaau |
English: He is the Light of all, the Life of the world; The True Lord writes His Inscription on each and every head. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਰਿਖੀ ਮੁਨੀ ਸੰਕਰੁ ਇੰਦੁ ਤਪੈ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: brahamaa bisan rikhee munee sankar ind tapai bhekhaaree |
English: Brahma and Vishnu, the Rishis and the silent sages, Shiva and Indra, penitents and beggars

Gurbani: ਮਾਨੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸੋਹੈ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਆਕੀ ਮਰਹਿ ਅਫਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: maanai hukam sohai dar saachai aakee mareh afaaree |
English: - whoever obeys the Hukam of the Lord's Command, looks beautiful in the Court of the True Lord, while the stubborn rebels die.

Gurbani: ਜੰਗਮ ਜੋਧ ਜਤੀ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jangam jodh jatee saniaasee gur poorai veechaaree |
English: The wandering beggars, warriors, celibates and Sannyaasee hermits - through the Perfect Guru, consider this:

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਫਲੁ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਸਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bin sevaa fal kabahu na paavas sevaa karanee saaree |2|
English: without selfless service, no one ever receives the fruits of their rewards. Serving the Lord is the most excellent action. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਿਧਨਿਆ ਧਨੁ ਨਿਗੁਰਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਿੰਮਾਣਿਆ ਤੂ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: nidhaniaa dhan niguriaa gur ninmaaniaa too maan |
English: You are the wealth of the poor, the Guru of the guru-less, the honor of the dishonored.

Gurbani: ਅੰਧੁਲੈ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਕੜਿਆ ਨਿਤਾਣਿਆ ਤੂ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: andhulai maanak gur pakarriaa nitaaniaa too taan |
English: I am blind; I have grasped hold of the jewel, the Guru. You are the strength of the weak.

Gurbani: ਹੋਮ ਜਪਾ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: hom japaa nahee jaaniaa guramatee saach pachhaan |
English: He is not known through burnt offerings and ritual chanting; the True Lord is known through the Guru's Teachings.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਦਰਿ ਢੋਈ ਝੂਠਾ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naam binaa naahee dar dtoee jhootthaa aavan jaan |3|
English: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, no one finds shelter in the Court of the Lord; the false come and go in reincarnation. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਸਾਚੇ ਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: saachaa naam salaaheeai saache te tripat hoe |
English: So praise the True Name, and through the True Name, you will find satisfaction.

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਜੀਐ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਮੈਲਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: giaan ratan man maajeeai bahurr na mailaa hoe |
English: When the mind is cleaned with the jewel of spiritual wisdom, it does not become dirty again.

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jab lag saahib man vasai tab lag bighan na hoe |
English: As long as the Lord and Master dwells in the mind, no obstacles are encountered.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਰੁ ਦੇ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: naanak sir de chhutteeai man tan saachaa soe |4|10|
English: O Nanak, giving one's head, one is emancipated, and the mind and body become true. ||4||10||

[Ang 992 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 |
English: Maaroo, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੋਗੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰਮਾਇਲੁ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: jogee jugat naam niramaaeil taa kai mail na raatee |
English: The Yogi who is joined to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is pure; he is not stained by even a particle of dirt.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਨਾਥੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਗੇ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਗਤਿ ਬੀਤੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: preetam naath sadaa sach sange janam maran gat beetee |1|
English: The True Lord, his Beloved, is always with him; the rounds of birth and death are ended for him. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਸਾਈ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: gusaaee teraa kahaa naam kaise jaatee |
English: O Lord of the Universe, what is Your Name, and what is it like?

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤਉ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਵਹਿ ਪੂਛਉ ਬਾਤ ਨਿਰੰਤੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaa tau bheetar mehal bulaaveh poochhau baat nirantee |1| rahaau |
English: If You summon me into the Mansion of Your Presence, I will ask You, how I can become one with You. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਇਸਨਾਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਪੂਜੇ ਪਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: brahaman braham giaan isanaanee har gun pooje paatee |
English: He alone is a Brahmin, who takes his cleansing bath in the spiritual wisdom of God, and whose leaf-offerings in worship are the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਏਕਾ ਜੋਤੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: eko naam ek naaraaein tribhavan ekaa jotee |2|
English: The One Name, the One Lord, and His One Light pervade the three worlds. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਡੰਡੀ ਇਹੁ ਘਟੁ ਛਾਬਾ ਤੋਲਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਜਾਚੀ ॥
Transliteration: jihavaa ddanddee ihu ghatt chhaabaa tolau naam ajaachee |
English: My tongue is the balance of the scale, and this heart of mine is the pan of the scale; I weigh the immeasurable Naam.

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਹਾਟੁ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ਇਕ ਭਾਤੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: eko haatt saahu sabhanaa sir vanajaare ik bhaatee |3|
English: There is one store, and one banker above all; the merchants deal in the one commodity. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦੋਵੈ ਸਿਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਨਿਬੇੜੇ ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਜੀਅਹੁ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਭਰਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: dovai sire satiguroo niberre so boojhai jis ek liv laagee jeeahu rahai nibharaatee |
English: The True Guru saves us at both ends; he alone understands, who is lovingly focused on the One Lord; his inner being remains free of doubt.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸਾਏ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ਸਦਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: sabad vasaae bharam chukaae sadaa sevak din raatee |4|
English: The Word of the Shabad abides within, and doubt is ended, for those who constantly serve, day and night. ||4||

Gurbani: ਊਪਰਿ ਗਗਨੁ ਗਗਨ ਪਰਿ ਗੋਰਖੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅਗਮੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਪੁਨਿ ਵਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: aoopar gagan gagan par gorakh taa kaa agam guroo pun vaasee |
English: Above is the sky of the mind, and beyond this sky is the Lord, the Protector of the World; the Inaccessible Lord God; the Guru abides there as well.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਭਇਆ ਉਦਾਸੀ ॥੫॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: gur bachanee baahar ghar eko naanak bheaa udaasee |5|11|
English: According to the Word of the Guru's Teachings, what is outside is the same as what is inside the home of the self. Nanak has become a detached renunciate. ||5||11||

[Ang 993 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: raag maaroo mahalaa 1 ghar 5 |
English: Raag Maaroo, First Mehl, Fifth House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਜਾਗੈ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਸੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: ahinis jaagai need na sovai |
English: Day and night, he remains awake and aware; he never sleeps or dreams.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਵੇਦਨ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: so jaanai jis vedan hovai |
English: He alone knows this, who feels the pain of separation from God.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੇ ਕਾਨ ਲਗੇ ਤਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਵੈਦੁ ਕਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: prem ke kaan lage tan bheetar vaid ki jaanai kaaree jeeo |1|
English: My body is pierced through with the arrow of love. How can any physician know the cure? ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jis no saachaa sifatee laae |
English: Rare is that one, who as Gurmukh,

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕਿਸੈ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh virale kisai bujhaae |
English: Understands, and whom the True Lord links to His Praise.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: amrit kee saar soee jaanai ji amrit kaa vaapaaree jeeo |1| rahaau |
English: He alone appreciates the value of the Ambsosial Nectar, who deals in this Ambrosia. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪਿਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਧਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਰਚਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: pir setee dhan prem rachaae |
English: The soul-bride is in love with her Husband Lord;

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਥਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad tathaa chit laae |
English: She focuses her consciousness on the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜ ਸੇਤੀ ਧਨ ਖਰੀ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਤਿਖਾ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sehaj setee dhan kharee suhelee trisanaa tikhaa nivaaree jeeo |2|
English: The soul-bride is joyously embellished with intuitive ease; her hunger and thirst are taken away. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਹਸਾ ਤੋੜੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sahasaa torre bharam chukaae |
English: Tear down skepticism and dispel your doubt;

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਧਣਖੁ ਚੜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sahaje sifatee dhanakh charraae |
English: with your intuition, draw the bow of the Praise of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਜੋਗਾਧਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad marai man maare sundar jogaadhaaree jeeo |3|
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, conquer and subdue your mind; take the support of Yoga - Union with the beautiful Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਜਲਿਆ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: haumai jaliaa manahu visaare |
English: Burnt by egotism, one forgets the Lord from his mind.

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਵਜਹਿ ਖੜਗ ਕਰਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jam pur vajeh kharrag karaare |
English: In the City of Death, he is attacked with massive swords.

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਕੈ ਕਹਿਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਮਿਲਈ ਤੂ ਸਹੁ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਭਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: ab kai kahiai naam na milee too sahu jeearre bhaaree jeeo |4|
English: Then, even if he asks for it, he will not receive the Lord's Name; O soul, you shall suffer terrible punishment. ||4||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਮਤਾ ਪਵਹਿ ਖਿਆਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mamataa paveh khiaalee |
English: You are distracted by thoughts of Maya and worldly attachment.

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਫਾਸਹਿਗਾ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: jam pur faasahigaa jam jaalee |
English: In the City of Death, you will be caught by the noose of the Messenger of Death.

Gurbani: ਹੇਤ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋੜਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਹਿ ਤਾ ਜਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਆਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: het ke bandhan torr na saakeh taa jam kare khuaaree jeeo |5|
English: You cannot break free from the bondage of loving attachment, and so the Messenger of Death will torture you. ||5||

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਹਉ ਕਰਤਾ ਨਾ ਮੈ ਕੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: naa hau karataa naa mai keea |
English: I have done nothing; I am doing nothing now.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: amrit naam satigur deea |
English: The True Guru has blessed me with the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਿਆ ਚਾਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੬॥੧॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: jis too dehi tisai kiaa chaaraa naanak saran tumaaree jeeo |6|1|12|
English: What other efforts can anyone make, when You bestow Your blessing? Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary. ||6||1||12||

[Ang 993 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 ghar 1 |
English: Maaroo, Third Mehl, First House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਬੈਸਾਲਹਿ ਤਹ ਬੈਸਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਹ ਭੇਜਹਿ ਤਹ ਜਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeh baisaaleh teh baisaa suaamee jeh bhejeh teh jaavaa |
English: Wherever You seat me, there I sit, O my Lord and Master; wherever You send me, there I go.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਨਗਰੀ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੋ ਰਾਜਾ ਸਭੇ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹਹਿ ਥਾਵਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sabh nagaree meh eko raajaa sabhe pavit heh thaavaa |1|
English: In the entire village, there is only One King; all places are sacred. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਾਬਾ ਦੇਹਿ ਵਸਾ ਸਚ ਗਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: baabaa dehi vasaa sach gaavaa |
English: O Baba, while I dwell in this body, let me sing Your True Praises,

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaa te sahaje sehaj samaavaa |1| rahaau |
English: that I may intuitively merge with You. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪਸ ਤੇ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਏਈ ਸਗਲ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: buraa bhalaa kichh aapas te jaaniaa eee sagal vikaaraa |
English: He thinks that good and bad deeds come from himself; this is the source of all evil.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਹੋਆ ਵਰਤੈ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: eihu furamaaeaa khasam kaa hoaa varatai ihu sansaaraa |2|
English: Whatever happens in this world is only by the Order of our Lord and Master. ||2||

Gurbani: ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਧਾਤੁ ਸਬਲ ਕਹੀਅਤ ਹੈ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਕਿਸ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: eindree dhaat sabal kaheeat hai indree kis te hoee |
English: Sexual desires are so strong and compelling; where has this sexual desire come from?

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲ ਕਰੈ ਸਭਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਐਸਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aape khel karai sabh karataa aisaa boojhai koee |3|
English: The Creator Himself stages all the plays; how rare are those who realize this. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਤਦੇ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee ek liv laagee dubidhaa tade binaasee |
English: By Guru's Grace, one is lovingly focused on the One Lord, and then, duality is ended.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਸੋ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਕਾਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jo tis bhaanaa so sat kar maaniaa kaattee jam kee faasee |4|
English: Whatever is in harmony with His Will, he accepts as True; the noose of Death is loosened from around his neck. ||4||

Gurbani: ਭਣਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਲੇਖਾ ਮਾਗੈ ਕਵਨਾ ਜਾ ਚੂਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: bhanat naanak lekhaa maagai kavanaa jaa chookaa man abhimaanaa |
English: Prays Nanak, who can call him to account, when the egotistical pride of his mind has been silenced?

Gurbani: ਤਾਸੁ ਤਾਸੁ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਜਪਤੁ ਹੈ ਪਏ ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾ ॥੫॥੧॥
Transliteration: taas taas dharam raae japat hai pe sache kee saranaa |5|1|
English: Even the Righteous Judge of Dharma is intimidated and afraid of him; he has entered the Sanctuary of the True Lord. ||5||1||

[Ang 993 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 |
English: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: aavan jaanaa naa theeai nij ghar vaasaa hoe |
English: Coming and going in reincarnation no longer exist, when one dwells in the home of the self within.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਬਖਸਿਆ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sach khajaanaa bakhasiaa aape jaanai soe |1|
English: He bestowed the Blessing of His treasure of truth; only He Himself knows. ||1||

Gurbani: ਏ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਚੇਤਿ ਤੂ ਮਨਹੁ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: e man har jeeo chet too manahu taj vikaar |
English: O my mind, remember the Dear Lord, and abandon the corruption of your mind.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਸਚਿ ਲਗੀ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad dhiaae too sach lagee piaar |1| rahaau |
English: Meditate on the Word of the Guru's Shabad; focus lovingly on the Truth. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਐਥੈ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਭੁਲਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਹਥੁ ਕਿਥਾਊ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aithai naavahu bhuliaa fir hath kithaaoo na paae |
English: One who forgets the Name in this world, shall not find any place of rest anywhere else.

Gurbani: ਜੋਨੀ ਸਭਿ ਭਵਾਈਅਨਿ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jonee sabh bhavaaeean bisattaa maeh samaae |2|
English: He shall wander in all sorts of reincarnations, and rot away in manure. ||2||

Gurbani: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: vaddabhaagee gur paaeaa poorab likhiaa maae |
English: By great good fortune, I have found the Guru, according to my pre-ordained destiny, O my mother.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: anadin sachee bhagat kar sachaa le milaae |3|
English: Night and day, I practice true devotional worship; I am united with the True Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: aape srisatt sabh saajeean aape nadar karee |
English: He Himself fashioned the entire universe; He Himself bestows His Glance of Grace.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naam vaddiaaeea jai bhaavai tai dee |4|2|
English: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is glorious and great; as He pleases, He bestows His Blessings. ||4||2||

[Ang 994 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 |
English: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪਿਛਲੇ ਗੁਨਹ ਬਖਸਾਇ ਜੀਉ ਅਬ ਤੂ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: pichhale gunah bakhasaae jeeo ab too maarag paae |
English: Please forgive my past mistakes, O my Dear Lord; now, please place me on the Path.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹਾ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har kee charanee laag rahaa vichahu aap gavaae |1|
English: I remain attached to the Lord's Feet, and eradicate self-conceit from within. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
Transliteration: mere man guramukh naam har dhiaae |
English: O my mind, as Gurmukh, meditate on the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹਾ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਏਕੈ ਭਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa har charanee laag rahaa ik man ekai bhaae |1| rahaau |
English: Remain attached forever to the Lord's Feet, single-mindedly, with love for the One Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਮੈ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਪਤਿ ਹੈ ਨਾ ਮੈ ਥੇਹੁ ਨ ਥਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: naa mai jaat na pat hai naa mai thehu na thaau |
English: I have no social status or honor; I have no place or home.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਭੇਦਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਟਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sabad bhed bhram kattiaa gur naam deea samajhaae |2|
English: Pierced through by the Word of the Shabad, my doubts have been cut away. The Guru has inspired me to understand the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਲਚ ਕਰਦਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: eihu man laalach karadaa firai laalach laagaa jaae |
English: This mind wanders around, driven by greed, totally attached to greed.

Gurbani: ਧੰਧੈ ਕੂੜਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: dhandhai koorr viaapiaa jam pur chottaa khaae |3|
English: He is engrossed in false pursuits; he shall endure beatings in the City of Death. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak sabh kichh aape aap hai doojaa naahee koe |
English: O Nanak, God Himself Himself is all-in-all. There is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਬਖਸਿਓਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੩॥
Transliteration: bhagat khajaanaa bakhasion guramukhaa sukh hoe |4|3|
English: He bestows the treasure of devotional worship, and the Gurmukhs abide in peace. ||4||3||

[Ang 994 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 |
English: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਟੋਲਿ ਲਹੁ ਸੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: sach rate se ttol lahu se virale sansaar |
English: Seek and find those who are imbued with Truth; they are so rare in this world.
