Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮੁਖੁ ਉਜਲਾ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tin miliaa mukh ujalaa jap naam muraar |1|
English: Meeting with them, one's face becomes radiant and bright, chanting the Name of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਾਬਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: baabaa saachaa saahib ridai samaal |
English: O Baba, contemplate and cherish the True Lord and Master within your heart.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਪੁਛਿ ਦੇਖੁ ਲੇਹੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਭਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur apanaa puchh dekh lehu vakhar bhaal |1| rahaau |
English: Seek out and see, and ask your True Guru, and obtain the true commodity. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਇਕੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਭ ਸੇਵਦੀ ਧੁਰਿ ਭਾਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: eik sachaa sabh sevadee dhur bhaag milaavaa hoe |
English: All serve the One True Lord; through pre-ordained destiny, they meet Him.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: guramukh mile se na vichhurreh paaveh sach soe |2|
English: The Gurmukhs merge with Him, and will not be separated from Him again; they attain the True Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: eik bhagatee saar na jaananee manamukh bharam bhulaae |
English: Some do not appreciate the value of devotional worship; the self-willed manmukhs are deluded by doubt.

Gurbani: ਓਨਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਕਰਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: onaa vich aap varatadaa karanaa kichhoo na jaae |3|
English: They are fillled with self-conceit; they cannot accomplish anything. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਜੋਰੁ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਖਲੇ ਕੀਚੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: jis naal jor na chalee khale keechai aradaas |
English: Stand and offer your prayer, to the One who cannot be moved by force.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਕਰੇ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh naam man vasai taa sun kare saabaas |4|4|
English: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides within the mind of the Gurmukh; hearing his prayer, the Lord applauds him. ||4||4||

[Ang 994 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 |
English: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਤੇ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਕਰੇ ਮਨੂਰਹੁ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo te seetal kare manoorahu kanchan hoe |
English: He transforms the burning desert into a cool oasis; he transmutes rusted iron into gold.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: so saachaa saalaaheeai tis jevadd avar na koe |1|
English: So praise the True Lord; there is none other as great as He is. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mere man anadin dhiaae har naau |
English: O my mind, night and day, meditate on the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਤੂ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur kai bachan araadh too anadin gun gaau |1| rahaau |
English: Contemplate the Word of the Guru's Teachings, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, night and day. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh eko jaaneeai jaa satigur dee bujhaae |
English: As Gurmukh, one comes to know the One Lord, when the True Guru instructs him.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਦੂ ਏਹ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: so satigur saalaaheeai jidoo eeh sojhee paae |2|
English: Praise the True Guru, who imparts this understanding. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਨਿ ਅਗੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur chhodd doojai lage kiaa karan agai jaae |
English: Those who forsake the True Guru, and attach themselves to duality - what will they do when they go to the world hereafter?

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jam pur badhe maareeeh bahutee milai sajaae |3|
English: Bound and gagged in the City of Death, they will be beaten. They will be punished severely. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਹੈ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: meraa prabh veparavaahu hai naa tis til na tamaae |
English: My God is independent and self-sufficient; he does not have even an iota of greed.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਭਜਿ ਪਉ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak tis saranaaee bhaj pau aape bakhas milaae |4|5|
English: O Nanak, run to His Sanctuary; granting His forgiveness, He merges us into Himself. ||4||5||

[Ang 995 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 4 ghar 2 |
English: Maaroo, Fourth Mehl, Second House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਜਪਿਓ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਕ ਜਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: japio naam suk janak gur bachanee har har saran pare |
English: Suk-deva and Janak meditated on the Naam; following the Guru's Teachings, they sought the Sanctuary of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਦਾਲਦੁ ਭੰਜਿ ਸੁਦਾਮੇ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਭਗਤੀ ਭਾਇ ਤਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: daalad bhanj sudaame milio bhagatee bhaae tare |
English: God met Sudama and removed his poverty; through loving devotional worship, he crossed over.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਤਾਰਥੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bhagat vachhal har naam kritaarath guramukh kripaa kare |1|
English: God is the Lover of His devotees; the Lord's Name is fufilling; God showers His Mercy on the Gurmukhs. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਉਧਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: mere man naam japat udhare |
English: O my mind, chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, you will be saved.

Gurbani: ਧ੍ਰੂ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦੁ ਬਿਦਰੁ ਦਾਸੀ ਸੁਤੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dhraoo prahilaad bidar daasee sut guramukh naam tare |1| rahaau |
English: Dhroo, Prahlaad and Bidar the slave-girl's son, became Gurmukh, and through the Naam, crossed over. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਲਜੁਗਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਉਧਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kalajug naam pradhaan padaarath bhagat janaa udhare |
English: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Naam is the supreme wealth; it saves the humble devotees.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਾ ਜੈਦੇਉ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨੁ ਸਭਿ ਦੋਖ ਗਏ ਚਮਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: naamaa jaideo kabeer trilochan sabh dokh ge chamare |
English: All the faults of Naam Dayv, Jai Dayv, Kabeer, Trilochan and Ravi Daas the leather-worker were covered.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗੇ ਸੇ ਉਧਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਟਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: guramukh naam lage se udhare sabh kilabikh paap ttare |2|
English: Those who become Gurmukh, and remain attached to the Naam, are saved; all their sins are washed off. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਸਭਿ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਦੋਖ ਪਰਹਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jo jo naam japai aparaadhee sabh tin ke dokh parahare |
English: Whoever chants the Naam, all his sins and mistakes are taken away.

Gurbani: ਬੇਸੁਆ ਰਵਤ ਅਜਾਮਲੁ ਉਧਰਿਓ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੈ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਨਰਹਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: besuaa ravat ajaamal udhario mukh bolai naaraaein narahare |
English: Ajaamal, who had sex with prostitites, was saved, by chanting the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਉਗ੍ਰਸੈਣਿ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਤੋੜਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naam japat ugrasain gat paaee torr bandhan mukat kare |3|
English: Chanting the Naam, Ugar Sain obtained salvation; his bonds were broken, and he was liberated. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਕਉ ਆਪਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਕੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jan kau aap anugrahu keea har angeekaar kare |
English: God Himself takes pity on His humble servants, and makes them His own.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਕ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਉਧਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sevak paij rakhai meraa govid saran pare udhare |
English: My Lord of the Universe saves the honor of His servants; those who seek His Sanctuary are saved.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਉਰ ਧਰਿਓ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: jan naanak har kirapaa dhaaree ur dhario naam hare |4|1|
English: The Lord has showered servant Nanak with His Mercy; he has enshrined the Lord's Name within his heart. ||4||1||

[Ang 995 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 4 |
English: Maaroo, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਪਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sidh samaadh japio liv laaee saadhik mun japiaa |
English: The Siddhas in Samaadhi meditate on Him; they are lovingly focused on Him. The seekers and the silent sages meditate on Him as well.

Gurbani: ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਮੁਖਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਦਿਕ ਰਵਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jatee satee santokhee dhiaaeaa mukh indraadik raviaa |
English: The celibates, the true and contented beings meditate on Him; Indra and the other gods chant His Name with their mouths.

Gurbani: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਜਪਿਓ ਤੇ ਭਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saran pare japio te bhaae guramukh paar peaa |1|
English: Those who seek His Sanctuary meditate on Him; they become Gurmukh and swim across. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਤਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: mere man naam japat tariaa |
English: O my mind, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and cross over.

Gurbani: ਧੰਨਾ ਜਟੁ ਬਾਲਮੀਕੁ ਬਟਵਾਰਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dhanaa jatt baalameek battavaaraa guramukh paar peaa |1| rahaau |
English: Dhanna the farmer, and Balmik the highway robber, became Gurmukh, and crossed over. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬੇ ਜਪਿਓ ਰਿਖਿ ਬਪੁਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sur nar gan gandharabe japio rikh bapurai har gaaeaa |
English: Angels, men, heavenly heralds and celestial singers meditate on Him; even the humble Rishis sing of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੰਕਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੈ ਦੇਵੀ ਜਪਿਓ ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sankar brahamai devee japio mukh har har naam japiaa |
English: Shiva, Brahma and the goddess Lakhshmi, meditate, and chant with their mouths the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਨਾ ਤੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har har naam jinaa man bheenaa te guramukh paar peaa |2|
English: Those whose minds are drenched with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, as Gurmukh, cross over. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤਿਆ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kott kott tetees dhiaaeo har japatiaa ant na paaeaa |
English: Millions and millions, three hundred thirty million gods meditate on Him; there is no end to those who meditate on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bed puraan simrit har japiaa mukh panddit har gaaeaa |
English: The Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees meditate on the Lord; the Pandits, the religious scholars, sing the Lord's Praises as well.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਾਲੁ ਜਿਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਤੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naam rasaal jinaa man vasiaa te guramukh paar peaa |3|
English: Those whose minds are filled with the Naam, the source of nectar - as Gurmukh, they cross over. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅਨਤ ਤਰੰਗੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਨ ਜਪਿਆ ਮੈ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਕਰਿ ਸਕਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: anat tarangee naam jin japiaa mai ganat na kar sakiaa |
English: Those who chant the Naam in endless waves - I cannot even count their number.

Gurbani: ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਏ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gobid kripaa kare thaae paae jo har prabh man bhaaeaa |
English: The Lord of the Universe bestows His Mercy, and those who are pleasing to the Mind of the Lord God, find their place.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਓ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਇਆ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur dhaar kripaa har naam drirraaeo jan naanak naam leaa |4|2|
English: The Guru, granting His Grace, implants the Lord's Name within; servant Nanak chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||2||

[Ang 996 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 4 ghar 3 |
English: Maaroo, Fourth Mehl, Third House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਲੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam nidhaan lai guramat har pat paae |
English: Take the treasure of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. Follow the Guru's Teachings, and the Lord shall bless you with honor.

Gurbani: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਨਾਲਿ ਚਲਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤੇ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: halat palat naal chaladaa har ante le chhaddaae |
English: Here and hereafter, the Lord goes with you; in the end, He shall deliver you.

Gurbani: ਜਿਥੈ ਅਵਘਟ ਗਲੀਆ ਭੀੜੀਆ ਤਿਥੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jithai avaghatt galeea bheerreea tithai har har mukat karaae |1|
English: Where the path is difficult and the street is narrow, there the Lord shall liberate you. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਾ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: mere satiguraa mai har har naam drirraae |
English: O my True Guru, implant within me the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪੋ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: meraa maat pitaa sut bandhapo mai har bin avar na maae |1| rahaau |
English: The Lord is my mother, father, child and relative; I have none other than the Lord, O my mother. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਰਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਆਣਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਮਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: mai har birahee har naam hai koee aan milaavai maae |
English: I feel the pains of love and yearning for the Lord, and the Name of the Lord. If only someone would come and unite me with Him, O my mother.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਮੈ ਜੋਦੜੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਦੇਇ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: tis aagai mai jodarree meraa preetam dee milaae |
English: I bow in humble devotion to one who inspires me to meet with my Beloved.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਢਿਲ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: satigur purakh deaal prabh har mele dtil na paae |2|
English: The almighty and merciful True Guru unites me with the Lord God instantaneously. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਸੇ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jin har har naam na chetio se bhaagaheen mar jaae |
English: Those who do not remember the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, are most unfortunate, and are slaughtered.

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਭਵਾਈਅਹਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: oe fir fir jon bhavaaeeeh mar jameh aavai jaae |
English: They wander in reincarnation, again and again; they die, and are re-born, and continue coming and going.

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: oe jam dar badhe maareeeh har daragah milai sajaae |3|
English: Bound and gagged at Death's Door, they are cruelly beaten, and punished in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਮ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: too prabh ham saranaagatee mo kau mel laihu har raae |
English: O God, I seek Your Sanctuary; O my Sovereign Lord King, please unite me with Yourself.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਜਗਜੀਵਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: har dhaar kripaa jagajeevanaa gur satigur kee saranaae |
English: O Lord, Life of the World, please shower me with Your Mercy; grant me the Sanctuary of the Guru, the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
Transliteration: har jeeo aap deaal hoe jan naanak har melaae |4|1|3|
English: The Dear Lord, becoming merciful, has blended servant Nanak with Himself. ||4||1||3||

[Ang 996 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 4 |
English: Maaroo, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਸਾਇਦਾ ਕੋ ਦਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: hau poonjee naam dasaaeidaa ko dase har dhan raas |
English: I inquire about the commodity of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Is there anyone who can show me the wealth, the capital of the Lord?

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਖਨ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਮੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: hau tis vittahu khan khaneeai mai mele har prabh paas |
English: I cut myself into pieces, and make myself a sacrifice to that one who leads me to meet my Lord God.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਪਿਰੰਮ ਕਾ ਕਿਉ ਸਜਣੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mai antar prem piram kaa kiau sajan milai milaas |1|
English: I am filled with the Love of my Beloved; how can I meet my Friend, and merge with Him? ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: man piaariaa mitraa mai har har naam dhan raas |
English: O my beloved friend, my mind, I take the wealth, the capital of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਧੀਰਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur poorai naam drirraaeaa har dheerak har saabaas |1| rahaau |
English: The Perfect Guru has implanted the Naam within me; the Lord is my support - I celebrate the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੈ ਦਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: har har aap milaae gur mai dase har dhan raas |
English: O my Guru, please unite me with the Lord, Har, Har; show me the wealth, the capital of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਨ ਲਭਈ ਜਨ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਨਿਰਜਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: bin gur prem na labhee jan vekhahu man nirajaas |
English: Without the Guru, love does not well up; see this, and know it in your mind.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਪੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har gur vich aap rakhiaa har mele gur saabaas |2|
English: The Lord has installed Himself within the Guru; so praise the Guru, who unites us with the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਾਗਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: saagar bhagat bhanddaar har poore satigur paas |
English: The ocean, the treasure of devotional worship of the Lord, rests with the Perfect True Guru.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਖੋਲਿ ਦੇਇ ਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: satigur tutthaa khol dee mukh guramukh har paragaas |
English: When it pleases the True Guru, He opens the treasure, and and the Gurmukhs are illuminated by the Lord's Light.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਭਾਗ ਵਿਹੂਣਿਆ ਤਿਖ ਮੁਈਆ ਕੰਧੀ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: manamukh bhaag vihooniaa tikh mueea kandhee paas |3|
English: The unfortunate self-willed manmukhs die of thirst, on the very bank of the river. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਹਉ ਮਾਗਉ ਦਾਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: gur daataa daataar hai hau maagau daan gur paas |
English: The Guru is the Great Giver; I beg for this gift from the Guru,

Gurbani: ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਾ ਮੇਲਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਵਡੜੀ ਆਸ ॥
Transliteration: chiree vichhunaa mel prabh mai man tan vaddarree aas |
English: that He may unite me with God, from whom I was separated for so long! This is the great hope of my mind and body.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੨॥੪॥
Transliteration: gur bhaavai sun benatee jan naanak kee aradaas |4|2|4|
English: If it pleases You, O my Guru, please listen to my prayer; this is servant Nanak's prayer. ||4||2||4||

[Ang 996 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 4 |
English: Maaroo, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: har har kathaa sunaae prabh guramat har ridai samaanee |
English: O Lord God, please preach Your sermon to me. Through the Guru's Teachings, the Lord is merged into my heart.

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਉਤਮ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: jap har har kathaa vaddabhaageea har utam pad nirabaanee |
English: Meditate on the sermon of the Lord, Har, Har, O very fortunate ones; the Lord shall bless you with the most sublime status of Nirvaanaa.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਮਨਿ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: guramukhaa man parateet hai gur poorai naam samaanee |1|
English: The minds of the Gurmukhs are filled with faith; through the Perfect Guru, they merge in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: man mere mai har har kathaa man bhaanee |
English: O my mind, the sermon of the Lord, Har, Har, is pleasing to my mind.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਨਿਤ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har har kathaa nit sadaa kar guramukh akath kahaanee |1| rahaau |
English: Continually and forever, speak the sermon of the Lord, Har, Har; as Gurmukh, speak the Unspoken Speech. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਢੰਢੋਲਿਆ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: mai man tan khoj dtandtoliaa kiau paaeeai akath kahaanee |
English: I have searched through and through my mind and body; how can I attain this Unspoken Speech?

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁਣਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: sant janaa mil paaeaa sun akath kathaa man bhaanee |
English: Meeting with the humble Saints, I have found it; listening to the Unspoken Speech, my mind is pleased.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: merai man tan naam adhaar har mai mele purakh sujaanee |2|
English: The Lord's Name is the Support of my mind and body; I am united with the all-knowing Primal Lord God. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖੈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੁਰਤੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur purakhai purakh milaae prabh mil suratee surat samaanee |
English: The Guru, the Primal Being, has united me with the Primal Lord God. My consciousness has merged into the supreme consciousness.

Gurbani: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁਘੜ ਸੁਜਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: vaddabhaagee gur seviaa har paaeaa sugharr sujaanee |
English: By great good fortune, I serve the Guru, and I have found my Lord, all-wise and all-knowing.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਾਗ ਵਿਹੂਣਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਦੁਖੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: manamukh bhaag vihooniaa tin dukhee rain vihaanee |3|
English: The self-willed manmukhs are very unfortunate; they pass their life-night in misery and pain. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਦੀਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਿਆ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: ham jaachik deen prabh teriaa mukh deejai amrit baanee |
English: I am just a meek beggar at Your Door, God; please, place the Ambrosial Word of Your Bani in my mouth.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੁਘੜ ਸੁਜਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: satigur meraa mitru prabh har melahu sugharr sujaanee |
English: The True Guru is my friend; He unites me with my all-wise, all-knowing Lord God.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੪॥੩॥੫॥
Transliteration: jan naanak saranaagatee kar kirapaa naam samaanee |4|3|5|
English: Servant Nanak has entered Your Sanctuary; grant Your Grace, and merge me into Your Name. ||4||3||5||

[Ang 997 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 4 |
English: Maaroo, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਭਾਉ ਲਗਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: har bhaau lagaa bairaageea vaddabhaagee har man raakh |
English: Detached from the world, I am in love with the Lord; by great good fortune, I have enshrined the Lord within my mind.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਰਧਾ ਊਪਜੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: mil sangat saradhaa aoopajai gurasabadee har ras chaakh |
English: Joining the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, faith has welled up within me; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I taste the sublime essence of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਭਾਖੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sabh man tan hariaa hoeaa gurabaanee har gun bhaakh |1|
English: My mind and body have totally blossomed forth; through the Word of the Guru's Bani, I chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: man piaariaa mitraa har har naam ras chaakh |
English: O my beloved mind, my friend, taste the sublime essence of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur poorai har paaeaa halat palat pat raakh |1| rahaau |
English: Through the Perfect Guru, I have found the Lord, who saves my honor, here and hereafter. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਾਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam dhiaaeeai har keerat guramukh chaakh |
English: Meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; as Gurmukh, taste the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਧਰਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਬੀਜੀਐ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: tan dharatee har beejeeai vich sangat har prabh raakh |
English: Plant the seed of the Lord in the body-farm. The Lord God is enshrined within the Sangat, the Holy Congregation.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: amrit har har naam hai gur poorai har ras chaakh |2|
English: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is Ambrosial Nectar. Through the Perfect Guru, taste the sublime essence of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਮਨਿ ਆਸਾ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਬਹੁ ਲਾਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh trisanaa bhar rahe man aasaa deh dis bahu laakh |
English: The self-willed manmukhs are filled with hunger and thirst; their minds run around in the ten directions, hoping for great wealth.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਦੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: bin naavai dhrig jeevade vich bisattaa manamukh raakh |
English: Without the Name of the Lord, their life is cursed; the manmukhs are stuck in manure.

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਭਵਾਈਅਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਭਾਖੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: oe aaveh jaeh bhavaaeeeh bahu jonee duragandh bhaakh |3|
English: They come and go, and are consigned to wander through uncounted incarnations, eating stinking rot. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਾਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਾਹਿ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: traeh traeh saranaagatee har deaa dhaar prabh raakh |
English: Begging, imploring, I seek Your Sanctuary; Lord, shower me with Your Mercy, and save me, God.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਾਪੁ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਤਿ ਸਾਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: santasangat melaap kar har naam milai pat saakh |
English: Lead me to join the Society of the Saints, and bless me with the honor and glory of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਾਖੁ ॥੪॥੪॥੬॥
Transliteration: har har naam dhan paaeaa jan naanak guramat bhaakh |4|4|6|
English: I have obtained the wealth of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; servant Nanak chants the Lord's Name, through the Guru's Teachings. ||4||4||6||

[Ang 997 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 4 ghar 5 |
English: Maaroo, Fourth Mehl, Fifth House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har har bhagat bhare bhanddaaraa |
English: Devotional worship to the Lord, Har, Har, is an overflowing treasure.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh raam kare nisataaraa |
English: The Gurmukh is emancipated by the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jis no kripaa kare meraa suaamee so har ke gun gaavai jeeo |1|
English: One who is blessed by the Mercy of my Lord and Master sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਬਨਵਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: har har kripaa kare banavaalee |
English: O Lord, Har, Har, take pity on me,

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: har hiradai sadaa sadaa samaalee |
English: that within my heart, I may dwell upon You, Lord, forever and ever.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਛਡਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam japahu mere jeearre jap har har naam chhaddaavai jeeo |1| rahaau |
English: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my soul; chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, you shall be emancipated. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sukh saagar amrit har naau |
English: The Ambrosial Name of the Lord is the ocean of peace.

Gurbani: ਮੰਗਤ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਪਸਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mangat jan jaachai har dehu pasaau |
English: The beggar begs for it; O Lord, please bless him, in Your kindness.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har sat sat sadaa har sat har sat merai man bhaavai jeeo |2|
English: True, True is the Lord; the Lord is forever True; the True Lord is pleasing to my mind. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਵੇ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਸ੍ਰਵਹਿ ਅਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: nave chhidr sraveh apavitraa |
English: The nine holes pour out filth.

Gurbani: ਬੋਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: bol har naam pavitr sabh kitaa |
English: Chanting the Lord's Name, they are all purified and sanctified.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮਲੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: je har suprasan hovai meraa suaamee har simarat mal leh jaavai jeeo |3|
English: When my Lord and Master is totally pleased, He leads the mortal to meditate in remembrance on the Lord, and then his filth is taken away. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohu bikham hai bhaaree |
English: Attachment to Maya is terribly treacherous.

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਤਰੀਐ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kiau tareeai dutar sansaaree |
English: How can one cross over the difficult world-ocean?

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: satigur bohith dee prabh saachaa jap har har paar langhaavai jeeo |4|
English: The True Lord bestows the boat of the True Guru; meditating on the Lord, Har, Har, one is carried across. ||4||

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: too sarabatr teraa sabh koee |
English: You are everywhere; all are Yours.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੂ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jo too kareh soee prabh hoee |
English: Whatever You do, God, that alone comes to pass.

Gurbani: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਬੇਚਾਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥੧॥੭॥
Transliteration: jan naanak gun gaavai bechaaraa har bhaavai har thaae paavai jeeo |5|1|7|
English: Poor servant Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord; as it pleases the Lord, He bestows His approval. ||5||1||7||

[Ang 998 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 4 |
English: Maaroo, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam japahu man mere |
English: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਾਟੈ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kilavikh kaattai har tere |
English: The Lord shall eradicate all your sins.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਸਖਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har dhan raakhahu har dhan sanchahu har chaladiaa naal sakhaaee jeeo |1|
English: Treasure the Lord's wealth, and gather in the Lord's wealth; when you depart in the end, the Lord shall go along with you as your only friend and companion. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jis no kripaa kare so dhiaavai |
English: He alone meditates on the Lord, unto whom He grants His Grace.

Gurbani: ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪੈ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: nit har jap jaapai jap har sukh paavai |
English: He continually chants the Lord's Chant; meditating on the Lord, one finds peace.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਆਵੈ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee har ras aavai jap har har paar langhaaee jeeo |1| rahaau |
English: By Guru's Grace, the sublime essence of the Lord is obtained. Meditating on the Lord, Har, Har, one is carried across. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: nirbhau nirankaar sat naam |
English: The fearless, formless Lord - the Name is Truth.

Gurbani: ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਸ੍ਰੇਸਟੁ ਊਤਮ ਕਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: jag meh sresatt aootam kaam |
English: To chant it is the most sublime and exalted activity in this world.

Gurbani: ਦੁਸਮਨ ਦੂਤ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਠੇਹ ਮਾਰਉ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: dusaman doot jamakaal ttheh maarau har sevak nerr na jaaee jeeo |2|
English: Doing so, the Messenger of Death, the evil enemy, is killed. Death does not even approach the Lord's servant. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਉਪਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jis upar har kaa man maaniaa |
English: One whose mind is satisfied with the Lord

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਟ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: so sevak chahu jug chahu kuntt jaaniaa |
English: that servant is known throughout the four ages, in all four directions.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਉਸ ਕਾ ਬੁਰਾ ਕਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਪਾਪੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਮਕੰਕਰੁ ਖਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: je us kaa buraa kahai koee paapee tis jamakankar khaaee jeeo |3|
English: If some sinner speaks evil of him, the Messenger of Death chews him up. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabh meh ek niranjan karataa |
English: The One Pure Creator Lord is in all.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਅਪਣੇ ਚਲਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kar kar vekhai apane chalataa |
English: He stages all His wondrous plays, and watches them.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਉਣੁ ਮਾਰੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਛਡਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jis har raakhai tis kaun maarai jis karataa aap chhaddaaee jeeo |4|
English: Who can kill that person, whom the Lord has saved? The Creator Lord Himself delivers him. ||4||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਈ ਕਰਤਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: hau anadin naam lee karataare |
English: I chant the Name of the Creator Lord, night and day.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਭਗਤ ਸਭੇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jin sevak bhagat sabhe nisataare |
English: He saves all His servants and devotees.

Gurbani: ਦਸ ਅਠ ਚਾਰਿ ਵੇਦ ਸਭਿ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਛਡਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥੨॥੮॥
Transliteration: das atth chaar ved sabh poochhahu jan naanak naam chhaddaaee jeeo |5|2|8|
English: Consult the eighteen Puraanas and the four Vedas; O servant Nanak, only the Naam, the Name of the Lord, will deliver you. ||5||2||8||

[Ang 998 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ghar 2 |
English: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl, Second House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਡਰਪੈ ਧਰਤਿ ਅਕਾਸੁ ਨਖੵਤ੍ਰਾ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਅਮਰੁ ਕਰਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: ddarapai dharat akaas nakhayatraa sir aoopar amar karaaraa |
English: The earth, the Akaashic ethers and the stars abide in the Fear of God. The almighty Order of the Lord is over the heads of all.

Gurbani: ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਡਰਪੈ ਡਰਪੈ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੁ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: paun paanee baisantar ddarapai ddarapai indru bichaaraa |1|
English: Wind, water and fire abide in the Fear of God; poor Indra abides in the Fear of God as well. ||1||

Gurbani: ਏਕਾ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਬਾਤ ਸੁਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: ekaa nirbhau baat sunee |
English: I have heard one thing, that the One Lord alone is fearless.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਸੋ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਗਾਇ ਗੁਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: so sukheea so sadaa suhelaa jo gur mil gaae gunee |1| rahaau |
English: He alone is at peace, and he alone is embellished forever, who meets with the Guru, and sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦੇਹਧਾਰ ਅਰੁ ਦੇਵਾ ਡਰਪਹਿ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਡਰਿ ਮੁਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: dehadhaar ar devaa ddarapeh sidh saadhik ddar mueaa |
English: The embodied and the divine beings abide in the Fear of God. The Siddhas and seekers die in the Fear of God.

Gurbani: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਜੋਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh mar mar janame fir fir jonee joeaa |2|
English: The 8.4 millions species of beings die, and die again, and are born over and over again. They are consigned to reincarnation. ||2||

Gurbani: ਰਾਜਸੁ ਸਾਤਕੁ ਤਾਮਸੁ ਡਰਪਹਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਰੂਪ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: raajas saatak taamas ddarapeh kete roop upaaeaa |
English: Those who embody the energies of sattva-white light, raajas-red passion, and taamas-black darkness, abide in the Fear of God, along with the many created forms.

Gurbani: ਛਲ ਬਪੁਰੀ ਇਹ ਕਉਲਾ ਡਰਪੈ ਅਤਿ ਡਰਪੈ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: chhal bapuree ih kaulaa ddarapai at ddarapai dharam raaeaa |3|
English: This miserable deceiver Maya abides in the Fear of God; the Righteous Judge of Dharma is utterly afraid of Him as well. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਡਰਹਿ ਬਿਆਪੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਡਰ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sagal samagree ddareh biaapee bin ddar karanaihaaraa |
English: The entire expanse of the Universe is in the Fear of God; only the Creator Lord is without this Fear.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੀ ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak bhagatan kaa sangee bhagat soheh darabaaraa |4|1|
English: Says Nanak, God is the companion of His devotees; His devotees look beautiful in the Court of the Lord. ||4||1||

[Ang 999 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 |
English: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪਾਂਚ ਬਰਖ ਕੋ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਧ੍ਰੂ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਅਮਰ ਅਟਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: paanch barakh ko anaath dhraoo baarik har simarat amar attaare |
English: The five year old orphan boy Dhroo, by meditating in remembrance on the Lord, became stationary and permanent.

Gurbani: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਹੇਤਿ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਕਹਿਓ ਜਮਕੰਕਰ ਮਾਰਿ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: putr het naaraaein kahio jamakankar maar bidaare |1|
English: For the sake of his son, Ajaamal called out, "O Lord, Naaraayan", who struck down and killed the Messenger of Death. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਅਗਨਤ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: mere tthaakur kete aganat udhaare |
English: My Lord and Master has saved many, countless beings.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਦੀਨ ਅਲਪ ਮਤਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਪਰਿਓ ਸਰਣਿ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mohi deen alap mat niragun pario saran duaare |1| rahaau |
English: I am meek, with little or no understanding, and unworthy; I seek protection at the Lord's Door. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਾਲਮੀਕੁ ਸੁਪਚਾਰੋ ਤਰਿਓ ਬਧਿਕ ਤਰੇ ਬਿਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: baalameek supachaaro tario badhik tare bichaare |
English: Baalmeek the outcaste was saved, and the poor hunter was saved as well.

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਅਰਾਧਿਓ ਗਜਪਤਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ek nimakh man maeh araadhio gajapat paar utaare |2|
English: The elephant remembered the Lord in his mind for an instant, and so was carried across. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕੀਨੀ ਰਖਿਆ ਭਗਤ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦੈ ਹਰਨਾਖਸ ਨਖਹਿ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: keenee rakhiaa bhagat prahilaadai haranaakhas nakheh bidaare |
English: He saved His devotee Prahlaad, and tore Harnaakhash with his nails.

Gurbani: ਬਿਦਰੁ ਦਾਸੀ ਸੁਤੁ ਭਇਓ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਉਜਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bidar daasee sut bheo puneetaa sagale kul ujaare |3|
English: Bidar, the son of a slave-girl, was purified, and all his generations were redeemed. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਵਨ ਪਰਾਧ ਬਤਾਵਉ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kavan paraadh bataavau apune mithiaa moh maganaare |
English: What sins of mine should I speak of? I am intoxicated with false emotional attachment.

Gurbani: ਆਇਓ ਸਾਮ ਨਾਨਕ ਓਟ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਲੀਜੈ ਭੁਜਾ ਪਸਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
Transliteration: aaeo saam naanak ott har kee leejai bhujaa pasaare |4|2|
English: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Lord; please, reach out and take me into Your embrace. ||4||2||

[Ang 999 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 |
English: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਵਿਤ ਨਵਿਤ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਓ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤੀ ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਧਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: vit navit bhramio bahu bhaatee anik jatan kar dhaae |
English: For the sake of riches, I wandered around in so many ways; I rushed around, making all sorts of efforts.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਰਮ ਕੀਏ ਹਉ ਹਉਮੈ ਤੇ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਅਜਾਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jo jo karam kee hau haumai te te bhe ajaae |1|
English: The deeds I did in egotism and pride, have all been done in vain. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਵਰ ਦਿਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਕਾਜ ਨ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: avar din kaahoo kaaj na laae |
English: Other days are of no use to me;

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਦਿਨੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੀਜੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਜਾ ਦਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: so din mo kau deejai prabh jeeo jaa din har jas gaae |1| rahaau |
English: please bless me with those days, O Dear God, on which I may sing the Lord's Praises. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਸਾਰਾ ਇਸ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਉਰਝਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: putr kalatr grih dekh pasaaraa is hee meh urajhaae |
English: Gazing upon children, spouse, household and possessions, one is entangled in these.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦ ਚਾਖਿ ਭਏ ਉਦਮਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਗਾਏ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mad chaakh bhe udamaate har har kabahu na gaae |2|
English: Tasting the wine of Maya, one is intoxicated, and never sings of the Lord, Har, Har. ||2||

Gurbani: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਖੋਜੀ ਬਹੁ ਪਰਕਾਰਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: eih bidh khojee bahu parakaaraa bin santan nahee paae |
English: In this way, I have examined lots of methods, but without the Saints, it is not found.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਦਾਤਾਰ ਵਡੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥ ਮਾਗਨ ਕਉ ਦਾਨੁ ਆਏ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tum daataar vadde prabh samrath maagan kau daan aae |3|
English: You are the Great Giver, the great and almighty God; I have come to beg a gift from You. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤਿਆਗਿਓ ਸਗਲਾ ਮਾਨੁ ਮਹਤਾ ਦਾਸ ਰੇਣ ਸਰਣਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: tiaagio sagalaa maan mahataa daas ren saranaae |
English: Abandoning all pride and self-importance, I have sought the Sanctuary of the dust of the feet of the Lord's slave.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਏ ਏਕੈ ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੩॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak har mil bhe ekai mahaa anand sukh paae |4|3|
English: Says Nanak, meeting with the Lord, I have become one with Him; I have found supreme bliss and peace. ||4||3||

[Ang 999 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 |
English: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਵਨ ਥਾਨ ਧੀਰਿਓ ਹੈ ਨਾਮਾ ਕਵਨ ਬਸਤੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kavan thaan dheerio hai naamaa kavan basat ahankaaraa |
English: In what place is the Name established? Where does egotism dwell?

Gurbani: ਕਵਨ ਚਿਹਨ ਸੁਨਿ ਊਪਰਿ ਛੋਹਿਓ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਸੁਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਗਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kavan chihan sun aoopar chhohio mukh te sun kar gaaraa |1|
English: What injury have you suffered, listening to abuse from someone else's mouth? ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਤੂ ਕਉਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਤੇ ਆਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: sunahu re too kaun kahaa te aaeo |
English: Listen: who are you, and where did you come from?

Gurbani: ਏਤੀ ਨ ਜਾਨਉ ਕੇਤੀਕ ਮੁਦਤਿ ਚਲਤੇ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: etee na jaanau keteek mudat chalate khabar na paaeo |1| rahaau |
English: You don't even know how long you will stay here; you have no hint of when you shall leave. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਹਨ ਸੀਲ ਪਵਨ ਅਰੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਖਿਮਾ ਨਿਭਰਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: sehan seel pavan ar paanee basudhaa khimaa nibharaate |
English: Wind and water have patience and tolerance; the earth has compassion and forgiveness, no doubt.

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਤਤ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਇਓ ਸੰਜੋਗਾ ਇਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਵਨ ਦੁਰਾਤੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: panch tat mil bheo sanjogaa in meh kavan duraate |2|
English: The union of the five tattvas - the five elements - has brought you into being. Which of these is evil? ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਿ ਰਚਿਆ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਬਿਧਾਤੈ ਨਾਲੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jin rach rachiaa purakh bidhaatai naale haumai paaee |
English: The Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny, formed your form; He also burdened you with egotism.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣੁ ਉਸ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਓਹਾ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: janam maran us hee kau hai re ohaa aavai jaaee |3|
English: He alone is born and dies; He alone comes and goes. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬਰਨੁ ਚਿਹਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਰਚਨਾ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: baran chihan naahee kichh rachanaa mithiaa sagal pasaaraa |
English: Nothing of the color and the form of the creation shall remain; the entire expanse is transitory.

Gurbani: ਭਣਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਬ ਖੇਲੁ ਉਝਾਰੈ ਤਬ ਏਕੈ ਏਕੰਕਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੪॥
Transliteration: bhanat naanak jab khel ujhaarai tab ekai ekankaaraa |4|4|
English: Prays Nanak, when He brings His play to its close, then only the One, the One Lord remains. ||4||4||

[Ang 1000 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 |
English: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹ ਅਰੁ ਲੋਭ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ਬੀਓ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਘਾਲਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: maan moh ar lobh vikaaraa beeo cheet na ghaalio |
English: Pride, emotional attachment, greed and corruption are gone; I have not placed anything else, other than the Lord, within my consciousness.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਗੁਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਬਣਜੇ ਲਾਦਿ ਵਖਰੁ ਲੈ ਚਾਲਿਓ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naam ratan gunaa har banaje laad vakhar lai chaalio |1|
English: I have purchased the jewel of the Naam and the Glorious Praises of the Lord; loading this merchandise, I have set out on my journey. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਓੜਕਿ ਨਿਬਹੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: sevak kee orrak nibahee preet |
English: The love which the Lord's servant feels for the Lord lasts forever.

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਤ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਅਪਨਾ ਚਲਤੇ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਚੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jeevat saahib sevio apanaa chalate raakhio cheet |1| rahaau |
English: In my life, I served my Lord and Master, and as I depart, I keep Him enshrined in my consciousness. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੈਸੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਕੀਨੀ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਮੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਮੋਰਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: jaisee aagiaa keenee tthaakur tis te mukh nahee morio |
English: I have not turned my face away from my Lord and Master's Command.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਰਖਿਓ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਉਠਿ ਉਆਹੂ ਕਉ ਦਉਰਿਓ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sehaj anand rakhio grih bheetar utth uaahoo kau daurio |2|
English: He fills my household with celestial peace and bliss; if He asks me to leave, I leave at once. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਗਿਆ ਮਹਿ ਭੂਖ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਿ ਸੂਖਾ ਸੋਗ ਹਰਖ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: aagiaa meh bhookh soee kar sookhaa sog harakh nahee jaanio |
English: When I am under the Lord's Command, I find even hunger pleasurable; I know no difference between sorrow and joy.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਭਇਓ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕਾ ਸੋ ਮਾਥੈ ਲੇ ਮਾਨਿਓ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jo jo hukam bheo saahib kaa so maathai le maanio |3|
English: Whatever the Command of my Lord and Master is, I bow my forehead and accept it. ||3||

Gurbani: ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਸਵਰੇ ਹਲਤ ਪਲਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: bheo kripaal tthaakur sevak kau savare halat palaataa |
English: The Lord and Master has become merciful to His servant; He has embellished both this world and the next.

Gurbani: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਓਹੁ ਆਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਖਸਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥੪॥੫॥
Transliteration: dhan sevak safal ohu aaeaa jin naanak khasam pachhaataa |4|5|
English: Blessed is that servant, and fruitful is his birth; O Nanak, he realizes his Lord and Master. ||4||5||

[Ang 1000 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 |
English: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਖੁਲਿਆ ਕਰਮੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਭਈ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: khuliaa karam kripaa bhee tthaakur keeratan har har gaaee |
English: Good karma has dawned for me - my Lord and Master has become merciful. I sing the Kirtan of the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har.

Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਥਾਕਾ ਪਾਏ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮਾ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਈ ਸਗਲੀ ਧਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sram thaakaa paae bisraamaa mitt gee sagalee dhaaee |1|
English: My struggle is ended; I have found peace and tranquility. All my wanderings have ceased. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ab mohi jeevan padavee paaee |
English: Now, I have obtained the state of eternal life.

Gurbani: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਇਓ ਮਨਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: cheet aaeo man purakh bidhaataa santan kee saranaaee |1| rahaau |
English: The Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny, has come into my conscious mind; I seek the Sanctuary of the Saints. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਨਿਵਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਬੈਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh lobh mohu nivaare nivare sagal bairaaee |
English: Sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment are eradicated; all my enemies are eliminated.

Gurbani: ਸਦ ਹਜੂਰਿ ਹਾਜਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਜਰੁ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਭਇਓ ਦੂਰਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sad hajoor haajar hai naajar kateh na bheo dooraaee |2|
English: He is always ever-present, here and now, watching over me; He is never far away. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਸੀਤਲ ਸਰਧਾ ਸਭ ਪੂਰੀ ਹੋਏ ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sukh seetal saradhaa sabh pooree hoe sant sahaaee |
English: In peace and cool tranquility, my faith has been totally fulfilled; the Saints are my Helpers and Support.

Gurbani: ਪਾਵਨ ਪਤਿਤ ਕੀਏ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: paavan patit kee khin bheetar mahimaa kathan na jaaee |3|
English: He has purified the sinners in an instant; I cannot express His Glorious Praises. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਸਗਲ ਭੈ ਖੋਏ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਚਰਣ ਓਟਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: nirbhau bhe sagal bhai khoe gobid charan ottaaee |
English: I have become fearless; all fear has departed. The feet of the Lord of the Universe are my only Shelter.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਾ ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੪॥੬॥
Transliteration: naanak jas gaavai tthaakur kaa rain dinas liv laaee |4|6|
English: Nanak sings the Praises of his Lord and Master; night and day, he is lovingly focused on Him. ||4||6||

[Ang 1000 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 |
English: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਇਕੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਗਾਵਸਿ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jo samarath sarab gun naaeik tis kau kabahu na gaavas re |
English: He is all-powerful, the Master of all virtues, but you never sing of Him!

Gurbani: ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਇ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਉਆ ਕਉ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਧਾਵਸਿ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: chhodd jaae khin bheetar taa kau uaa kau fir fir dhaavas re |1|
English: You shall have to leave all this in an instant, but again and again, you chase after it. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਕਿਉ ਨ ਸਮਾਰਸਿ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: apune prabh kau kiau na samaaras re |
English: Why do you not contemplate your God?

Gurbani: ਬੈਰੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਰੰਗ ਰਸਿ ਰਚਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਜੀਅਰਾ ਜਾਰਸਿ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bairee sang rang ras rachiaa tis siau jeearaa jaaras re |1| rahaau |
English: You are entangled in association with your enemies, and the enjoyment of pleasures; your soul is burning up with them! ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਨਿਐ ਜਮੁ ਛੋਡੈ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਸਿ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai naam suniai jam chhoddai taa kee saran na paavas re |
English: Hearing His Name, the Messenger of Death will release you, and yet, you do not enter His Sanctuary!

Gurbani: ਕਾਢਿ ਦੇਇ ਸਿਆਲ ਬਪੁਰੇ ਕਉ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਟਿਕਾਵਸਿ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: kaadt dee siaal bapure kau taa kee ott ttikaavas re |2|
English: Turn out this wretched jackal, and seek the Shelter of that God. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਜਾਸੁ ਸੁਨਤ ਭਵ ਤਰੀਐ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਲਾਵਸਿ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jis kaa jaas sunat bhav tareeai taa siau rang na laavas re |
English: Praising Him, you shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean, and yet, you have not fallen in love with Him!

Gurbani: ਥੋਰੀ ਬਾਤ ਅਲਪ ਸੁਪਨੇ ਕੀ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਅਟਕਾਵਸਿ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: thoree baat alap supane kee bahur bahur attakaavas re |3|
English: This meager, short-lived dream, this thing - you are engrossed in it, over and over again. ||3||

Gurbani: ਭਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: bheo prasaad kripaa nidh tthaakur santasang pat paaee |
English: When our Lord and Master, the ocean of mercy, grants His Grace, one finds honor in the Society of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਛੂਟਾ ਜਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੪॥੭॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak trai gun bhram chhoottaa jau prabh bhe sahaaee |4|7|
English: Says Nanak, I am rid of the illusion of the three-phased Maya, when God becomes my help and support. ||4||7||

[Ang 1000 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 |
English: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਕਹਾ ਦੁਲਾਰਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: antarajaamee sabh bidh jaanai tis te kahaa dulaario |
English: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, knows everything; what can anyone hide from Him?

Gurbani: ਹਸਤ ਪਾਵ ਝਰੇ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਰਿਓ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: hasat paav jhare khin bheetar agan sang lai jaario |1|
English: Your hands and feet will fall off in an instant, when you are burnt in the fire. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੂੜੇ ਤੈ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਰਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: moorre tai man te raam bisaario |
English: You fool, you have forgotten the Lord from your mind!

Gurbani: ਲੂਣੁ ਖਾਇ ਕਰਹਿ ਹਰਾਮਖੋਰੀ ਪੇਖਤ ਨੈਨ ਬਿਦਾਰਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: loon khaae kareh haraamakhoree pekhat nain bidaario |1| rahaau |
English: You eat His salt, and then you are untrue to Him; before your very eyes, you shall be torn apart. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਸਾਧ ਰੋਗੁ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਤਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਟਰਤ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਟਾਰਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: asaadh rog upajio tan bheetar ttarat na kaahoo ttaario |
English: The incurable disease has arisen in your body; it cannot be removed or overcome.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ॥੨॥੮॥
Transliteration: prabh bisarat mahaa dukh paaeo ihu naanak tat beechaario |2|8|
English: Forgetting God, one endures utter agony; this is the essence of reality which Nanak has realized. ||2||8||

[Ang 1001 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 |
English: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖੇ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal prabh raakhe cheet |
English: I have enshrined the lotus feet of God within my consciousness.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ ਨੀਤਾ ਨੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: har gun gaavah neetaa neet |
English: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, continually, continuously.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ॥
Transliteration: tis bin doojaa avar na koaoo |
English: There is none other than Him at all.

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਹੈ ਸੋਊ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aad madh ant hai soaoo |1|
English: He alone exists, in the beginning, in the middle, and in the end. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: santan kee ott aape aap |1| rahaau |
English: He Himself is the Shelter of the Saints. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai vas hai sagal sansaar |
English: The entire universe is under His control.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape aap aap nirankaar |
English: He Himself, the Formless Lord, is Himself by Himself.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਹਿਓ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: naanak gahio saachaa soe |
English: Nanak holds tight to that True Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥੯॥
Transliteration: sukh paaeaa fir dookh na hoe |2|9|
English: He has found peace, and shall never suffer pain again. ||2||9||

[Ang 1001 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ghar 3 |
English: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl, Third House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਜੀਅ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਤੁਮ ਕਾਹੇ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਓ ਅਗਿਆਨਥ ॥
Transliteration: praan sukhadaataa jeea sukhadaataa tum kaahe bisaario agiaanath |
English: He is the Giver of peace to the breath of life, the Giver of life to the soul; how can you forget Him, you ignorant person?

Gurbani: ਹੋਛਾ ਮਦੁ ਚਾਖਿ ਹੋਏ ਤੁਮ ਬਾਵਰ ਦੁਲਭ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਕਾਰਥ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: hochhaa mad chaakh hoe tum baavar dulabh janam akaarath |1|
English: You taste the weak, insipid wine, and you have gone insane. You have uselessly wasted this precious human life. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰੇ ਨਰ ਐਸੀ ਕਰਹਿ ਇਆਨਥ ॥
Transliteration: re nar aisee kareh eaanath |
English: O man, such is the foolishness you practice.

Gurbani: ਤਜਿ ਸਾਰੰਗਧਰ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਤੂ ਭੂਲਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਲਪਟਿਓ ਦਾਸੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਨਥ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: taj saarangadhar bhram too bhoolaa mohi lapattio daasee sang saanath |1| rahaau |
English: Renouncing the Lord, the Support of the earth, you wander, deluded by doubt; you are engrossed in emotional attachment, associating with Maya, the slave-girl. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਧਰਣੀਧਰੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਨੀਚ ਕੁਲ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਹਾਵਥ ॥
Transliteration: dharaneedhar tiaag neech kul seveh hau hau karat bihaavath |
English: Abandoning the Lord, the Support of the earth, you serve her of lowly ancestry, and you pass you life acting egotistically.

Gurbani: ਫੋਕਟ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧ ਕਹਾਵਥ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: fokatt karam kareh agiaanee manamukh andh kahaavath |2|
English: You do useless deeds, you ignorant person; this is why you are called a blind, self-willed manmukh. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿ ਹੋਤਾ ਅਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਜੋ ਬਿਨਸਤ ਸੋ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਜਾਨਥ ॥
Transliteration: sat hotaa asat kar maaniaa jo binasat so nihachal jaanath |
English: That which is true, you believe to be untrue; what is transitory, you believe to be permanent.

Gurbani: ਪਰ ਕੀ ਕਉ ਅਪਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਪਕਰੀ ਐਸੇ ਭੂਲ ਭੁਲਾਨਥ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: par kee kau apanee kar pakaree aise bhool bhulaanath |3|
English: You grasp as your own, what belongs to others; in such delusions you are deluded. ||3||

Gurbani: ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣ ਸੂਦ ਵੈਸ ਸਭ ਏਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਰਾਨਥ ॥
Transliteration: khatree braahaman sood vais sabh ekai naam taraanath |
English: The Kh'shaatriyas, Brahmins, Soodras and Vaishyas all cross over, through the Name of the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਹਤੁ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਸੁਨੈ ਸੋ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਨਥ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: gur naanak upades kehat hai jo sunai so paar paraanath |4|1|10|
English: Guru Nanak speaks the Teachings; whoever listens to them is carried across. ||4||1||10||

[Ang 1001 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 |
English: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਪਤੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਡਹਕਾਵਏ ਮਨੁਖਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gupat karataa sang so prabh ddahakaave manukhaae |
English: You may act in secrecy, but God is still with you; you can only deceive other people.

Gurbani: ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਬਿਖੈ ਭੋਗਹਿ ਤਪਤ ਥੰਮ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bisaar har jeeo bikhai bhogeh tapat tham gal laae |1|
English: Forgetting your Dear Lord, you enjoy corrupt pleasures, and so you shall have to embrace red-hot pillars. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰੇ ਨਰ ਕਾਇ ਪਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: re nar kaae par grihi jaae |
English: O man, why do you go out to the households of others?

Gurbani: ਕੁਚਲ ਕਠੋਰ ਕਾਮਿ ਗਰਧਭ ਤੁਮ ਨਹੀ ਸੁਨਿਓ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kuchal katthor kaam garadhabh tum nahee sunio dharam raae |1| rahaau |
English: You filthy, heartless, lustful donkey! Haven't you heard of the Righteous Judge of Dharma? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਿਕਾਰ ਪਾਥਰ ਗਲਹਿ ਬਾਧੇ ਨਿੰਦ ਪੋਟ ਸਿਰਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bikaar paathar galeh baadhe nind pott siraae |
English: The stone of corruption is tied around your neck, and the load of slander is on your head.

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸਮੁਦੁ ਲੰਘਨਾ ਪਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਰਨਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mahaa saagar samud langhanaa paar na paranaa jaae |2|
English: You must cross over the vast open ocean, but you cannot cross over to the other side. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਿਆਪਿਓ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਰਖੇ ਫਿਰਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh lobh mohi biaapio netr rakhe firaae |
English: You are engrossed in sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment; you have turned your eyes away from the Truth.

Gurbani: ਸੀਸੁ ਉਠਾਵਨ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਮਿਲਈ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਤਰ ਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sees utthaavan na kabahoo milee mahaa dutar maae |3|
English: You cannot even raise your head above the water of the vast, impassable sea of Maya. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੂਰੁ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਸਸੀ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਅਲਿਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: soor mukataa sasee mukataa braham giaanee alipaae |
English: The sun is liberated, and the moon is liberated; the God-realized being is pure and untouched.

Gurbani: ਸੁਭਾਵਤ ਜੈਸੇ ਬੈਸੰਤਰ ਅਲਿਪਤ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਮਲਾਇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: subhaavat jaise baisantar alipat sadaa niramalaae |4|
English: His inner nature is like that of fire, untouched and forever immaculate. ||4||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਖੁਲਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਹਿਆ ਪੜਦਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jis karam khuliaa tis lahiaa parradaa jin gur peh maniaa subhaae |
English: When good karma dawns, the wall of doubt is torn down. He lovingly accepts the Guru's Will.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਅਵਖਧੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਨਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਕਟ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੫॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur mantru avakhadh naam deenaa jan naanak sankatt jon na paae |5|2|
English: One who is blessed with the medicine of the GurMantra, the Name of the Lord, O servant Nanak, does not suffer the agonies of reincarnation. ||5||2||

Gurbani: ਰੇ ਨਰ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: re nar in bidh paar paraae |
English: O man, in this way, you shall cross over to the other side.

Gurbani: ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਹੋਇ ਮਿਰਤਕੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੨॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: dhiaae har jeeo hoe miratak tiaag doojaa bhaau | rahaau doojaa |2|11|
English: Meditate on your Dear Lord, and be dead to the world; renounce your love of duality. ||Second Pause||2||11||

[Ang 1002 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 |
English: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਢੂਢਨ ਤੇ ਛੂਟਿ ਪਰੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਥਾ ॥
Transliteration: baahar dtoodtan te chhoott pare gur ghar hee maeh dikhaaeaa thaa |
English: I have quit searching outside; the Guru has shown me that God is within the home of my own heart.

Gurbani: ਅਨਭਉ ਅਚਰਜ ਰੂਪੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੇਖਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਜਾਇਆ ਥਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: anbhau acharaj roop prabh pekhiaa meraa man chhodd na katahoo jaaeaa thaa |1|
English: I have seen God, fearless, of wondrous beauty; my mind shall never leave Him to go anywhere else. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਾਨਕੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਰੇ ਪਾਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਥਾ ॥
Transliteration: maanak paaeo re paaeo har pooraa paaeaa thaa |
English: I have found the jewel; I have found the Perfect Lord.

Gurbani: ਮੋਲਿ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਈ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਵਾਇਆ ਥਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mol amol na paaeaa jaaee kar kirapaa guroo divaaeaa thaa |1| rahaau |
English: The invaluable value cannot be obtained; in His Mercy, the Guru bestows it. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਦਿਸਟੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥਾਇਆ ਥਾ ॥
Transliteration: adisatt agochar paarabraham mil saadhoo akath kathaaeaa thaa |
English: The Supreme Lord God is imperceptible and unfathomable; meeting the Holy Saint, I speak the Unspoken Speech.

Gurbani: ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦੁ ਦਸਮ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਵਜਿਓ ਤਹ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੁਆਇਆ ਥਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: anahad sabad dasam duaar vajio teh amrit naam chuaaeaa thaa |2|
English: The unstruck sound current of the Shabad vibrates and resounds in the Tenth Gate; the Ambrosial Naam trickles down there. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੋਟਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੂਝੀ ਅਖੁਟ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਸਮਾਇਆ ਥਾ ॥
Transliteration: tott naahee man trisanaa boojhee akhutt bhanddaar samaaeaa thaa |
English: I lack nothing; the thirsty desires of my mind are satisfied. The inexhaustible treasure has entered into my being.

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਚਰਣ ਚਰਣ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਅਘੜੁ ਘੜਿਓ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਥਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: charan charan charan gur seve agharr gharrio ras paaeaa thaa |3|
English: I serve the feet, the feet, the feet of the Guru, and manage the unmanageable. I have found the juice, the sublime essence. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਆਵਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਜਾਵਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਖੇਲਾਇਆ ਥਾ ॥
Transliteration: sahaje aavaa sahaje jaavaa sahaje man khelaaeaa thaa |
English: Intuitively I come, and intuively I go; my mind intuitively plays.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਰਮੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਇਆ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਹਲੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਥਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak bharam gur khoeaa taa har mahalee mehal paaeaa thaa |4|3|12|
English: Says Nanak, when the Guru drives out doubt, then the soul-bride enters the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||4||3||12||

[Ang 1002 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 |
English: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਸਾਜਿ ਨਿਵਾਜਿਆ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਸਿਉ ਰੁਚ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jiseh saaj nivaajiaa tiseh siau ruch naeh |
English: You feel no love for the One who created and embellished you.

Gurbani: ਆਨ ਰੂਤੀ ਆਨ ਬੋਈਐ ਫਲੁ ਨ ਫੂਲੈ ਤਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aan rootee aan boeeai fal na foolai taeh |1|
English: The seed, planted out season, does not germinate; it does not produce flower or fruit. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਵਤ੍ਰ ਬੀਜਣ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: re man vatr beejan naau |
English: O mind, this is the time to plant the seed of the Name.

Gurbani: ਬੋਇ ਖੇਤੀ ਲਾਇ ਮਨੂਆ ਭਲੋ ਸਮਉ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: boe khetee laae manooaa bhalo smau suaau |1| rahaau |
English: Focus your mind, and cultivate this crop; at the proper time, make this your purpose. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਖੋਇ ਖਹੜਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: khoe khaharraa bharam man kaa satigur saranee jaae |
English: Eradicate the stubbornness and doubt of your mind, and go to the Sanctuary of the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮੁ ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਧੁਰਹੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋਈ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: karam jis kau dhurahu likhiaa soee kaar kamaae |2|
English: He alone does such deeds, who has such pre-ordained karma. ||2||

Gurbani: ਭਾਉ ਲਾਗਾ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਸਿਉ ਘਾਲ ਪਾਈ ਥਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhaau laagaa gobid siau ghaal paaee thaae |
English: He falls in love with the Lord of the Universe, and his efforts are approved.

Gurbani: ਖੇਤਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਜੰਮਿਆ ਨਿਖੁਟਿ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: khet merai jamiaa nikhutt na kabahoo jaae |3|
English: My crop has germinated, and it shall never be used up. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪਾਇਆ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੋ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: paaeaa amol padaaratho chhodd na katahoo jaae |
English: I have obtained the priceless wealth, which shall never leave me or go anywhere else.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਰਹੇ ਆਘਾਇ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak sukh paaeaa tripat rahe aaghaae |4|4|13|
English: Says Nanak, I have found peace; I am satisfied and fulfilled. ||4||4||13||

[Ang 1002 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 |
English: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਫੂਟੋ ਆਂਡਾ ਭਰਮ ਕਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਭਇਓ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: footto aanddaa bharam kaa maneh bheo paragaas |
English: The egg of doubt has burst; my mind has been enlightened.

Gurbani: ਕਾਟੀ ਬੇਰੀ ਪਗਹ ਤੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਬੰਦਿ ਖਲਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kaattee beree pagah te gur keenee band khalaas |1|
English: The Guru has shattered the shackles on my feet, and has set me free. ||1||

Gurbani: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਰਹਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: aavan jaan rahio |
English: My coming and going in reincarnation is ended.

Gurbani: ਤਪਤ ਕੜਾਹਾ ਬੁਝਿ ਗਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਸੀਤਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tapat karraahaa bujh geaa gur seetal naam deeo |1| rahaau |
English: The boiling cauldron has cooled down; the Guru has blessed me with the cooling, soothing Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਭਇਆ ਤਉ ਛੋਡਿ ਗਏ ਨਿਗਹਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: jab te saadhoo sang bheaa tau chhodd ge nigahaar |
English: Since I joined the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, those who were eyeing me have left.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਅਟਕ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਛੁਟੀ ਤਉ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੈ ਕੋਟਵਾਰ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jis kee attak tis te chhuttee tau kahaa karai kottavaar |2|
English: The one who tied me up, has released me; what can the Watchman of Death do to me now? ||2||

Gurbani: ਚੂਕਾ ਭਾਰਾ ਕਰਮ ਕਾ ਹੋਏ ਨਿਹਕਰਮਾ ॥
Transliteration: chookaa bhaaraa karam kaa hoe nihakaramaa |
English: The load of my karma has been removed, and I am now free of karma.

Gurbani: ਸਾਗਰ ਤੇ ਕੰਢੈ ਚੜੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੇ ਧਰਮਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: saagar te kandtai charre gur keene dharamaa |3|
English: I have crossed the world-ocean, and reached the other shore; the Guru has blessed me with this Dharma. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਬੈਠਕਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਆਉ ਬਣਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sach thaan sach baitthakaa sach suaau banaaeaa |
English: True is my place, and True is my seat; I have made Truth my life's purpose.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਰੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: sach poonjee sach vakharo naanak ghar paaeaa |4|5|14|
English: True is my capital, and True is the merchandise, which Nanak has placed into the home of the heart. ||4||5||14||

[Ang 1002 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 |
English: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬੇਦੁ ਪੁਕਾਰੈ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਪੰਡਤ ਕਾਮਾਮਨ ਕਾ ਮਾਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: bed pukaarai mukh te panddat kaamaaman kaa maatthaa |
English: The Pandit, the religious scholar, proclaims the Vedas, but he is slow to act on them.

Gurbani: ਮੋਨੀ ਹੋਇ ਬੈਠਾ ਇਕਾਂਤੀ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਲਪਨ ਗਾਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: monee hoe baitthaa ikaantee hiradai kalapan gaatthaa |
English: Another person on silence sits alone, but his heart is tied in knots of desire.

Gurbani: ਹੋਇ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਤਜਿ ਚਲਿਓ ਛੁਟਕੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਠਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: hoe udaasee grihu taj chalio chhuttakai naahee naatthaa |1|
English: Another becomes an Udaasi, a renunciate; he abandons his home and walks out on his family, but his wandering impulses do not leave him. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਕੈ ਪਹਿ ਬਾਤ ਕਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeea kee kai peh baat kahaa |
English: Who can I tell about the state of my soul?

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਐਸੋ ਕਹਾ ਲਹਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aap mukat mo kau prabh mele aiso kahaa lahaa |1| rahaau |
English: Where can I find such a person who is liberated, and who can unite me with my God? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤਪਸੀ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਦੇਹੀ ਸਾਧੀ ਮਨੂਆ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: tapasee kar kai dehee saadhee manooaa deh dis dhaanaa |
English: Someone may practice intensive meditation, and discipline his body, but his mind still runs around in ten directions.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਚਾਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਚਜੁ ਕੀਨਾ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਭਇਆ ਗੁਮਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: brahamachaar brahamachaj keenaa hiradai bheaa gumaanaa |
English: The celibate practices celibacy, but his heart is filled with pride.

Gurbani: ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਓ ਉਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਬਿਗਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saniaasee hoe kai teerath bhramio us meh krodh bigaanaa |2|
English: The Sannyaasi wanders around at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, but his mindless anger is still within him. ||2||

Gurbani: ਘੂੰਘਰ ਬਾਧਿ ਭਏ ਰਾਮਦਾਸਾ ਰੋਟੀਅਨ ਕੇ ਓਪਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: ghoonghar baadh bhe raamadaasaa rotteean ke opaavaa |
English: The temple dancers tie bells around their ankles to earn their living.

Gurbani: ਬਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਕਰਮ ਖਟ ਕੀਨੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭੇਖ ਦਿਖਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: barat nem karam khatt keene baahar bhekh dikhaavaa |
English: Others go on fasts, take vows, perform the six rituals and wear religious robes for show.

Gurbani: ਗੀਤ ਨਾਦ ਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਗ ਅਲਾਪੇ ਮਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਵਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: geet naad mukh raag alaape man nahee har har gaavaa |3|
English: Some sing songs and melodies and hymns, but their minds do not sing of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਰਹਤ ਹਹਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: harakh sog lobh moh rehat heh niramal har ke santaa |
English: The Lord's Saints are immaculately pure; they are beyond pleasure and pain, beyond greed and attachment.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਧੂੜਿ ਪਾਏ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਜਾ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: tin kee dhoorr paae man meraa jaa deaa kare bhagavantaa |
English: My mind obtains the dust of their feet, when the Lord God shows mercy.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਾਂ ਉਤਰੀ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak gur pooraa miliaa taan utaree man kee chintaa |4|
English: Says Nanak, I met the Perfect Guru, and then the anxiety of my mind was removed. ||4||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: meraa antarajaamee har raaeaa |
English: My Sovereign Lord is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਬਿਸਰਿ ਗਏ ਬਕਬਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੬॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh jaanai mere jeea kaa preetam bisar ge bakabaaeaa |1| rahaau doojaa |6|15|
English: The Beloved of my soul knows everything; all trivial talk is forgotten. ||1||Second Pause||6||15||

[Ang 1003 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 |
English: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਲਾਖ ਸਰਬ ਕੋ ਰਾਜਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kott laakh sarab ko raajaa jis hiradai naam tumaaraa |
English: One who has Your Name in his heart is the king of all the hundreds of thousands and millions of beings.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਦੀਆ ਮੇਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੇ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਗਾਵਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jaa kau naam na deea merai satigur se mar janameh gaavaaraa |1|
English: Those, whom my True Guru has not blessed with Your Name, are poor idiots, who die and are reborn. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹੀ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: mere satigur hee pat raakh |
English: My True Guru protects and preserves my honor.

Gurbani: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਪਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਰਲੀਐ ਖਾਕੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: cheet aaveh tab hee pat pooree bisarat raleeai khaak |1| rahaau |
English: When You come to mind, Lord, then I obtain perfect honor. Forgetting You, I roll in the dust. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਮਨ ਭੋਗਣ ਤੇ ਤੇ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: roop rang khuseea man bhogan te te chhidr vikaaraa |
English: The mind's pleasures of love and beauty bring just as many blames and sins.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਕਲਿਆਣਾ ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜੁ ਇਹੁ ਸਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam nidhaan kaliaanaa sookh sehaj ihu saaraa |2|
English: The Name of the Lord is the treasure of Emancipation; it is absolute peace and poise. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ਬਿਰੰਗ ਖਿਨੈ ਮਹਿ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਦਰ ਕੀ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa rang birang khinai meh jiau baadar kee chhaaeaa |
English: The pleasures of Maya fade away in an instant, like the shade of a passing cloud.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਲਾਲ ਭਏ ਗੂੜੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: se laal bhe goorrai rang raate jin gur mil har har gaaeaa |3|
English: They alone are dyed in the deep crimson of the Lord's Love, who meet the Guru, and sing the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

Gurbani: ਊਚ ਮੂਚ ਅਪਾਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਗਮ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aooch mooch apaar suaamee agam darabaaraa |
English: My Lord and Master is lofty and exalted, grand and infinite. The Darbaar of His Court is inaccessible.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੋ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸੋਭਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਖਸਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: naamo vaddiaaee sobhaa naanak khasam piaaraa |4|7|16|
English: Through the Naam, glorious greatness and respect are obtained; O Nanak, my Lord and Master is my Beloved. ||4||7||16||

[Ang 1003 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ghar 4 |
English: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਉਤਪਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: oankaar utapaatee |
English: The One Universal Creator Lord created the creation.

Gurbani: ਕੀਆ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਸਭ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: keea dinas sabh raatee |
English: He made all the days and the nights.

Gurbani: ਵਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: van trin tribhavan paanee |
English: The forests, meadows, three worlds, water,

Gurbani: ਚਾਰਿ ਬੇਦ ਚਾਰੇ ਖਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: chaar bed chaare khaanee |
English: the four Vedas, the four sources of creation,

Gurbani: ਖੰਡ ਦੀਪ ਸਭਿ ਲੋਆ ॥
Transliteration: khandd deep sabh loaa |
English: the countries, the continents and all the worlds,

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਕਵਾਵੈ ਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਹੋਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ek kavaavai te sabh hoaa |1|
English: have all come from the One Word of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਾ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: karanaihaaraa boojhahu re |
English: Hey - understand the Creator Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਸੂਝੈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: satigur milai ta soojhai re |1| rahaau |
English: If you meet the True Guru, then you'll understand. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਕੀਆ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: trai gun keea pasaaraa |
English: He formed the expanse of the entire universe from the three gunas, the three qualities.

Gurbani: ਨਰਕ ਸੁਰਗ ਅਵਤਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: narak surag avataaraa |
English: People are incarnated in heaven and in hell.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: haumai aavai jaaee |
English: In egotism, they come and go.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਟਿਕਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: man ttikan na paavai raaee |
English: The mind cannot hold still, even for an instant.

Gurbani: ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: baajh guroo gubaaraa |
English: Without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mil satigur nisataaraa |2|
English: Meeting with the True Guru, one is emancipated. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: hau hau karam kamaane |
English: All the deeds done in egotism,

Gurbani: ਤੇ ਤੇ ਬੰਧ ਗਲਾਣੇ ॥
Transliteration: te te bandh galaane |
English: are just chains around the neck.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: meree meree dhaaree |
English: Harboring self-conceit and self-interest

Gurbani: ਓਹਾ ਪੈਰਿ ਲੋਹਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: ohaa pair lohaaree |
English: is just like placing chains around one's ankles.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: so gur mil ek pachhaanai |
English: He alone meets with the Guru, and realizes the One Lord,

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਭਾਗੁ ਮਥਾਣੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jis hovai bhaag mathaanai |3|
English: who has such destiny written on his forehead. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: so miliaa ji har man bhaaeaa |
English: He alone meets the Lord, who is pleasing to His Mind.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਭੂਲਾ ਜਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: so bhoolaa ji prabhoo bhulaaeaa |
English: He alone is deluded, who is deluded by God.

Gurbani: ਨਹ ਆਪਹੁ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: neh aapahu moorakh giaanee |
English: No one, by himself, is ignorant or wise.

Gurbani: ਜਿ ਕਰਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: ji karaavai su naam vakhaanee |
English: He alone chants the Naam, whom the Lord inspires to do so.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: teraa ant na paaraavaaraa |
English: You have no end or limitation.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: jan naanak sad balihaaraa |4|1|17|
English: Servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice to You. ||4||1||17||

[Ang 1004 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 |
English: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਨੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੀਏ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਨੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: mohanee mohi lee trai guneea |
English: Maya, the enticer, has enticed the world of the three gunas, the three qualities.

Gurbani: ਲੋਭਿ ਵਿਆਪੀ ਝੂਠੀ ਦੁਨੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: lobh viaapee jhootthee duneea |
English: The false world is engrossed in greed.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਸੰਚੀ ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਬਾਰ ਸਗਲ ਲੇ ਛਲੀਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: meree meree kar kai sanchee ant kee baar sagal le chhaleea |1|
English: Crying out, "Mine, mine!" they collect possessions, but in the end, they are all deceived. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਦਇਅਲੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: nirbhau nirankaar deialeea |
English: The Lord is fearless, formless and merciful.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਗਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਲੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jant sagale pratipaleea |1| rahaau |
English: He is the Cherisher of all beings and creatures. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਏਕੈ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਗਾਡੀ ਗਡਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: ekai sram kar gaaddee gaddahai |
English: Some collect wealth, and bury it in the ground.

Gurbani: ਏਕਹਿ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਦਾਮੁ ਨ ਛਡਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: ekeh supanai daam na chhaddahai |
English: Some cannot abandon wealth, even in their dreams.

Gurbani: ਰਾਜੁ ਕਮਾਇ ਕਰੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਥੈਲੀ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚੰਚਲਿ ਚਲੀਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: raaj kamaae karee jin thailee taa kai sang na chanchal chaleea |2|
English: The king exercises his power, and fills his money-bags, but this fickle companion will not go along with him. ||2||

Gurbani: ਏਕਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਪਿੰਡ ਤੇ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: ekeh praan pindd te piaaree |
English: Some love this wealth even more than their body and breath of life.

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਸੰਚੀ ਤਜਿ ਬਾਪ ਮਹਤਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: ek sanchee taj baap mahataaree |
English: Some collect it, forsaking their fathers and mothers.

Gurbani: ਸੁਤ ਮੀਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਤੇ ਗੁਹਜੀ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਖਲੀਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sut meet bhraat te guhajee taa kai nikatt na hoee khaleea |3|
English: Some hide it from their children, friends and siblings, but it will not remain with them. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹੋਇ ਅਉਧੂਤ ਬੈਠੇ ਲਾਇ ਤਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: hoe aaudhoot baitthe laae taaree |
English: Some become hermits, and sit in meditative trances.

Gurbani: ਜੋਗੀ ਜਤੀ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jogee jatee panddit beechaaree |
English: Some are Yogis, celibates, religious scholars and thinkers.

Gurbani: ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਮੜੀ ਮਸਾਣੀ ਬਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਸਤੇ ਊਠਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਕੈ ਲਾਗੀ ਪਲੀਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: grihi marree masaanee ban meh basate aootth tinaa kai laagee paleea |4|
English: Some dwell in homes, graveyards, cremation grounds and forests; but Maya still clings to them there. ||4||

Gurbani: ਕਾਟੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਜਾ ਕੇ ॥
Transliteration: kaatte bandhan tthaakur jaa ke |
English: When the Lord and Master releases one from his bonds,

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਸਿਓ ਜੀਅ ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam basio jeea taa kai |
English: the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, comes to dwell in his soul.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਭਏ ਜਨ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਲੀਆ ॥੫॥੨॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: saadhasang bhe jan mukate gat paaee naanak nadar nihaleea |5|2|18|
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, His humble servants are liberated; O Nanak, they are redeemed and enraptured by the Lord's Glance of Grace. ||5||2||18||

[Ang 1004 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 |
English: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਸੋਊ ॥
