Transliteration: simarahu ek niranjan soaoo |
English: Meditate in remembrance on the One Immaculate Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਤ ਨ ਕੋਊ ॥
Transliteration: jaa te birathaa jaat na koaoo |
English: No one is turned away from Him empty-handed.

Gurbani: ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਮਹਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: maat garabh meh jin pratipaariaa |
English: He cherished and preserved you in your mother's womb;

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਦੇ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: jeeo pindd de saaj savaariaa |
English: He blessed you with body and soul, and embellished you.

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਜਪੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: soee bidhaataa khin khin japeeai |
English: Each and every instant, meditate on that Creator Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਸਭਿ ਢਕੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: jis simarat avagun sabh dtakeeai |
English: Meditating in remembrance on Him, all faults and mistakes are covered.

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਉਰ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਧਾਰਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal ur antar dhaarahu |
English: Enshrine the Lord's lotus feet deep within the nucleus of your self.

Gurbani: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਨ ਤੇ ਜੀਉ ਉਧਾਰਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: bikhiaa ban te jeeo udhaarahu |
English: Save your soul from the waters of corruption.

Gurbani: ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਹ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਬਿਲਲਾਟਾ ॥
Transliteration: karan palaah mitteh bilalaattaa |
English: Your cries and shrieks shall be ended;

Gurbani: ਜਪਿ ਗੋਵਿਦ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਫਾਟਾ ॥
Transliteration: jap govid bharam bhau faattaa |
English: meditating on the Lord of the Universe, your doubts and fears shall be dispelled.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasang viralaa ko paae |
English: Rare is that being, who finds the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਏ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak taa kai bal bal jaae |1|
English: Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to Him. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਆਧਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam man tan aadhaaraa |
English: The Lord's Name is the support of my mind and body.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo simarai tis kaa nisataaraa |1| rahaau |
English: Whoever meditates on Him is emancipated. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਵਸਤੁ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: mithiaa vasat sat kar maanee |
English: He believes that the false thing is true.

Gurbani: ਹਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਓ ਸਠ ਮੂੜ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: hit laaeo satth moorr agiaanee |
English: The ignorant fool falls in love with it.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮਦ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh lobh mad maataa |
English: He is intoxicated with the wine of sexual desire, anger and greed;

Gurbani: ਕਉਡੀ ਬਦਲੈ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: kauddee badalai janam gavaataa |
English: he loses this human life in exchance for a mere shell.

Gurbani: ਅਪਨਾ ਛੋਡਿ ਪਰਾਇਐ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: apanaa chhodd paraaeiai raataa |
English: He abandons his own, and loves that of others.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mad man tan sang jaataa |
English: His mind and body are permeated with the intoxication of Maya.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਕਰਤ ਕਲੋਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: trisan na boojhai karat kalolaa |
English: His thirsty desires are not quenched, although he indulges in pleasures.

Gurbani: ਊਣੀ ਆਸ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਸਭਿ ਬੋਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: aoonee aas mithiaa sabh bolaa |
English: His hopes are not fulfilled, and all his words are false.

Gurbani: ਆਵਤ ਇਕੇਲਾ ਜਾਤ ਇਕੇਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: aavat ikelaa jaat ikelaa |
English: He comes alone, and he goes alone.

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਝੂਠੇ ਸਭਿ ਬੋਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: ham tum sang jhootthe sabh bolaa |
English: False is all his talk of me and you.

Gurbani: ਪਾਇ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: paae tthgauree aap bhulaaeo |
English: The Lord Himself administers the poisonous potion, to mislead and delude.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਮਿਟਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak kirat na jaae mittaaeo |2|
English: O Nanak, the the karma of past actions cannot be erased. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪਸੁ ਪੰਖੀ ਭੂਤ ਅਰੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: pas pankhee bhoot ar pretaa |
English: Beasts, birds, demons and ghosts

Gurbani: ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਫਿਰਤ ਅਨੇਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: bahu bidh jonee firat anetaa |
English: - in these many ways, the false wander in reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਜਾਨੋ ਤਹ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jeh jaano teh rehan na paavai |
English: Wherever they go, they cannot remain there.

Gurbani: ਥਾਨ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਉਠਿ ਉਠਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: thaan bihoon utth utth fir dhaavai |
English: They have no place of rest; they rise up again and again and run around.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਿਸਥਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: man tan baasanaa bahut bisathaaraa |
English: Their minds and bodies are filled with immense, expansive desires.

Gurbani: ਅਹੰਮੇਵ ਮੂਠੋ ਬੇਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: ahamev moottho bechaaraa |
English: The poor wretches are cheated by egotism.

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਦੋਖ ਅਰੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: anik dokh ar bahut sajaaee |
English: They are filled with countless sins, and are severely punished.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: taa kee keemat kehan na jaaee |
English: The extent of this cannot be estimated.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਨਰਕ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: prabh bisarat narak meh paaeaa |
English: Forgetting God, they fall into hell.

Gurbani: ਤਹ ਮਾਤ ਨ ਬੰਧੁ ਨ ਮੀਤ ਨ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: teh maat na bandh na meet na jaaeaa |
English: There are no mothers there, no siblings, no friends and no spouses.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਹੋਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: jis kau hot kripaal suaamee |
English: Those humble beings, unto whom the Lord and Master becomes Merciful,

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਗਰਾਮੀ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: so jan naanak paaragaraamee |3|
English: O Nanak, cross over. ||3||

Gurbani: ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਨੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bhramat bhramat prabh saranee aaeaa |
English: Rambling and roaming, wandering around, I came to seek the Sanctuary of God.

Gurbani: ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਜਗਤ ਪਿਤ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: deenaa naath jagat pit maaeaa |
English: He is the Master of the meek, the father and mother of the world.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਇਆਲ ਦੁਖ ਦਰਦ ਬਿਦਾਰਣ ॥
Transliteration: prabh deaal dukh darad bidaaran |
English: The Merciful Lord God is the Destroyer of sorrow and suffering.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਣ ॥
Transliteration: jis bhaavai tis hee nisataaran |
English: He emancipates whoever He pleases.

Gurbani: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਕਾਢਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: andh koop te kaadtanahaaraa |
English: He lifts them up and pulls him out of the deep dark pit.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੋਵਤ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: prem bhagat hovat nisataaraa |
English: Emancipation comes through loving devotional worship.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਰੂਪ ਅਪਨਾ ਤਨੁ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: saadh roop apanaa tan dhaariaa |
English: The Holy Saint is the very embodiment of the Lord's form.

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਤੇ ਆਪਿ ਉਬਾਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: mahaa agan te aap ubaariaa |
English: He Himself saves us from the great fire.

Gurbani: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਇਸ ਤੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jap tap sanjam is te kichh naahee |
English: By myself, I cannot practice meditation, austerities, penance and self-discipline.

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: aad ant prabh agam agaahee |
English: In the beginning and in the end, God is inaccessible and unfathomable.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਮਾਗੈ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: naam dehi maagai daas teraa |
English: Please bless me with Your Name, Lord; Your slave begs only for this.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: har jeevan pad naanak prabh meraa |4|3|19|
English: O Nanak, my Lord God is the Giver of the true state of life. ||4||3||19||

[Ang 1005 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 |
English: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਤ ਕਉ ਡਹਕਾਵਹੁ ਲੋਗਾ ਮੋਹਨ ਦੀਨ ਕਿਰਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kat kau ddahakaavahu logaa mohan deen kirapaaee |1|
English: Why do you try to deceive others, O people of the world? The Fascinating Lord is Merciful to the meek. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸੀ ਜਾਨਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aisee jaan paaee |
English: This is what I have come to know.

Gurbani: ਸਰਣਿ ਸੂਰੋ ਗੁਰ ਦਾਤਾ ਰਾਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਵਡਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saran sooro gur daataa raakhai aap vaddaaee |1| rahaau |
English: The brave and heroic Guru, the Generous Giver, gives Sanctuary and preserves our honor. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਾ ਕਾ ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bhagataa kaa aagiaakaaree sadaa sadaa sukhadaaee |2|
English: He submits to the Will of His devotees; He is forever and ever the Giver of peace. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੇ ਕਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੀਅਹੁ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: apane kau kirapaa kareeahu ik naam dhiaaee |3|
English: Please bless me with Your Mercy, that I may meditate on Your Name alone. ||3||

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦੀਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਈ ॥੪॥੪॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: naanak deen naam maagai duteea bharam chukaaee |4|4|20|
English: Nanak, the meek and humble, begs for the Naam, the Name of the Lord; it eradicates duality and doubt. ||4||4||20||

[Ang 1005 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 |
English: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: meraa tthaakur at bhaaraa |
English: My Lord and Master is utterly powerful.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਬੇਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mohi sevak bechaaraa |1|
English: I am just His poor servant. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਨੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: mohan laal meraa preetam man praanaa |
English: My Enticing Beloved is very dear to my mind and my breath of life.

Gurbani: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mo kau dehu daanaa |1| rahaau |
English: He blesses me with His gift. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਗਲੇ ਮੈ ਦੇਖੇ ਜੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: sagale mai dekhe joee |
English: I have seen and tested all.

Gurbani: ਬੀਜਉ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: beejau avar na koee |2|
English: There is none other than Him. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੀਅਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਿ ਸਮਾਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: jeean pratipaal samaahai |
English: He sustains and nurtures all beings.

Gurbani: ਹੈ ਹੋਸੀ ਆਹੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: hai hosee aahe |3|
English: He was, and shall always be. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਕੀਜੈ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: deaa mohi keejai devaa |
English: Please bless me with Your Mercy, O Divine Lord,

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਾਗੋ ਸੇਵਾ ॥੪॥੫॥੨੧॥
Transliteration: naanak laago sevaa |4|5|21|
English: and link Nanak to Your service. ||4||5||21||

[Ang 1005 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 |
English: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਤਾਰਨ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲੇ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: patit udhaaran taaran bal bal bale bal jaaeeai |
English: The Redeemer of sinners, who carries us across; I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice to Him.

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਕੋਈ ਭੇਟੈ ਸੰਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aisaa koee bhettai sant jit har hare har dhiaaeeai |1|
English: If only I could meet with such a Saint, who would inspire me to meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, Har. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਨਤ ਕਹੀਅਤ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: mo kau koe na jaanat kaheeat daas tumaaraa |
English: No one knows me; I am called Your slave.

Gurbani: ਏਹਾ ਓਟ ਆਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ehaa ott aadhaaraa |1| rahaau |
English: This is my support and sustenance. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਧਾਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰਨ ਇਕ ਬਿਨਉ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: sarab dhaaran pratipaaran ik binau deenaa |
English: You support and cherish all; I am meek and humble - this is my only prayer.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਜਲ ਹਮ ਮੀਨਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tumaree bidh tum hee jaanahu tum jal ham meenaa |2|
English: You alone know Your Way; You are the water, and I am the fish. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਬਿਸਥੀਰਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਹਿ ਆਇਓ ਪਾਛੈ ॥
Transliteration: pooran bisatheeran suaamee aaeh aaeo paachhai |
English: O Perfect and Expansive Lord and Master, I follow You in love.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲੋ ਭੂ ਮੰਡਲ ਖੰਡਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਆਛੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sagalo bhoo manddal khanddal prabh tum hee aachhai |3|
English: O God, You are pervading all the worlds, solar systems and galaxies. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅਟਲ ਅਖਇਓ ਦੇਵਾ ਮੋਹਨ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: attal akheo devaa mohan alakh apaaraa |
English: You are eternal and unchanging, imperishable, invisible and infinite, O divine fascinating Lord.

Gurbani: ਦਾਨੁ ਪਾਵਉ ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਰੇਨੁ ਦਾਸਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੬॥੨੨॥
Transliteration: daan paavau santaa sang naanak ren daasaaraa |4|6|22|
English: Please bless Nanak with the gift of the Society of the Saints, and the dust of the feet of Your slaves. ||4||6||22||

[Ang 1006 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 |
English: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਆਘਾਏ ਸੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: tripat aaghaae santaa |
English: The Saints are fulfilled and satisfied;

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਜਾਨੇ ਜਿਨ ਮੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur jaane jin mantaa |
English: they know the Guru's Mantra and the Teachings.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: taa kee kichh kehan na jaaee |
English: They cannot even be described;

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਾਮ ਬਡਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jaa kau naam baddaaee |1|
English: they are blessed with the glorious greatness of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਲਾਲੁ ਅਮੋਲਾ ਲਾਲੋ ॥
Transliteration: laal amolaa laalo |
English: My Beloved is a priceless jewel.

Gurbani: ਅਗਹ ਅਤੋਲਾ ਨਾਮੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: agah atolaa naamo |1| rahaau |
English: His Name is unattainable and immeasurable. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਵਿਗਤ ਸਿਉ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਮਾਨੋ ॥
Transliteration: avigat siau maaniaa maano |
English: One whose mind is satisfied believing in the imperishable Lord God,

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੋ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh tat giaano |
English: becomes Gurmukh and attains the essence of spiritual wisdom.

Gurbani: ਪੇਖਤ ਸਗਲ ਧਿਆਨੋ ॥
Transliteration: pekhat sagal dhiaano |
English: He sees all in his meditation.

Gurbani: ਤਜਿਓ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੋ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tajio man te abhimaano |2|
English: He banishes egotistical pride from his mind. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਠਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: nihachal tin kaa tthaanaa |
English: Permanent is the place of those

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਛਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur te mehal pachhaanaa |
English: who, through the Guru, realize the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: anadin gur mil jaage |
English: Meeting the Guru, they remain awake and aware night and day;

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: har kee sevaa laage |3|
English: they are committed to the Lord's service. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: pooran tripat aghaae |
English: They are perfectly fulfilled and satisfied,

Gurbani: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj samaadh subhaae |
English: intuitively absorbed in Samaadhi.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ਹਾਥਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: har bhanddaar haath aaeaa |
English: The Lord's treasure comes into their hands;

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੭॥੨੩॥
Transliteration: naanak gur te paaeaa |4|7|23|
English: O Nanak, through the Guru, they attain it. ||4||7||23||

[Ang 1006 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੬ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ghar 6 dupade |
English: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl, Sixth House, Dho-Padhay:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਛੋਡਿ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: chhodd sagal siaanapaa mil saadh tiaag gumaan |
English: Abandon all your clever tricks; meet with the Holy, and renounce your egotistical pride.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਵਖਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: avar sabh kichh mithiaa rasanaa raam raam vakhaan |1|
English: Everything else is false; with your tongue, chant the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕਰਨ ਸੁਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: mere man karan sun har naam |
English: O my mind, with your ears, listen to the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਿਟਹਿ ਅਘ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਵਨੁ ਬਪੁਰੋ ਜਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mitteh agh tere janam janam ke kavan bapuro jaam |1| rahaau |
English: The sins of your many past lifetimes shall be washed away; then, what can the wretched Messenger of Death do to you? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦੂਖ ਦੀਨ ਨ ਭਉ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥
Transliteration: dookh deen na bhau biaapai milai sukh bisraam |
English: Pain, poverty and fear shall not afflict you, and you shall find peace and pleasure.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬਖਾਨੈ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨੁ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੨॥੧॥੨੪॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad naanak bakhaanai har bhajan tat giaan |2|1|24|
English: By Guru's Grace, Nanak speaks; meditation on the Lord is the essence of spiritual wisdom. ||2||1||24||

[Ang 1006 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 |
English: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਸੇ ਹੋਤ ਦੇਖੇ ਖੇਹ ॥
Transliteration: jinee naam visaariaa se hot dekhe kheh |
English: Those who have forgotten the Naam, the Name of the Lord - I have seen them reduced to dust.

Gurbani: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਬਿਲਾਸ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਤੂਟਤੇ ਏ ਨੇਹ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: putr mitr bilaas banitaa toottate e neh |1|
English: The love of children and friends, and the pleasures of married life are torn apart. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਲੇਹ ॥
Transliteration: mere man naam nit nit leh |
English: O my mind, continually, continuously chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਲਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੂਖੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਦੇਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jalat naahee agan saagar sookh man tan deh |1| rahaau |
English: You shall not burn in the ocean of fire, and your mind and body shall be blessed with peace. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਿਰਖ ਛਾਇਆ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਨਸਤ ਪਵਨ ਝੂਲਤ ਮੇਹ ॥
Transliteration: birakh chhaaeaa jaise binasat pavan jhoolat meh |
English: Like the shade of a tree, these things shall pass away, like the clouds blown away by the wind.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਮਿਲੁ ਸਾਧ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇਰੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਆਵਤ ਏਹ ॥੨॥੨॥੨੫॥
Transliteration: har bhagat drirr mil saadh naanak terai kaam aavat eh |2|2|25|
English: Meeting with the Holy, devotional worship to the Lord is implanted within; O Nanak, only this shall work for you. ||2||2||25||

[Ang 1006 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 |
English: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਸੁਖਹ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸਤੋ ਨੀਤ ॥
Transliteration: purakh pooran sukhah daataa sang basato neet |
English: The perfect, primal Lord is the Giver of peace; He is always with you.

Gurbani: ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਉਸਨ ਨ ਸੀਤ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: marai na aavai na jaae binasai biaapat usan na seet |1|
English: He does not die, and he does not come or go in reincarnation. He does not perish, and He is not affected by heat or cold. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: mere man naam siau kar preet |
English: O my mind, be in love with the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਚੇਤਿ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ਏਹ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: chet man meh har har nidhaanaa eeh niramal reet |1| rahaau |
English: Within the mind, think of the Lord, Har, Har, the treasure. This is the purest way of life. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਜੋ ਜਪੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੀਧਿ ॥
Transliteration: kripaal deaal gopaal gobid jo japai tis seedh |
English: Whoever meditates on the merciful compassionate Lord, the Lord of the Universe, is successful.

Gurbani: ਨਵਲ ਨਵਤਨ ਚਤੁਰ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਮਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਬੀਧਿ ॥੨॥੩॥੨੬॥
Transliteration: naval navatan chatur sundar man naanak tis sang beedh |2|3|26|
English: He is always new, fresh and young, clever and beautiful; Nanak's mind is pierced through with His Love. ||2||3||26||

[Ang 1006 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 |
English: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਚਲਤ ਬੈਸਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਜਾਗਤ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਚਿਤਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: chalat baisat sovat jaagat gur mantru ridai chitaar |
English: While walking and sitting, sleeping and waking, contemplate within your heart the GurMantra.

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਭਜੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: charan saran bhaj sang saadhoo bhav saagar utareh paar |1|
English: Run to the Lord's lotus feet, and join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. Cross over the terrifying world-ocean, and reach the other side. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: mere man naam hiradai dhaar |
English: O my mind, enshrine the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within your heart.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਲਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਅਵਰ ਸਗਲ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kar preet man tan laae har siau avar sagal visaar |1| rahaau |
English: Love the Lord, and commit your mind and body to Him; forget everything else. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਤੂ ਆਪਨ ਆਪੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jeeo man tan praan prabh ke too aapan aap nivaar |
English: Soul, mind, body and breath of life belong to God; eliminate your self-conceit.

Gurbani: ਗੋਵਿਦ ਭਜੁ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਆਰਥ ਪੂਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਹਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੪॥੨੭॥
Transliteration: govid bhaj sabh suaarath poore naanak kabahu na haar |2|4|27|
English: Meditate, vibrate on the Lord of the Universe, and all your desires shall be fulfilled; O Nanak, you shall never be defeated. ||2||4||27||

[Ang 1007 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 |
English: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤਜਿ ਆਪੁ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਤਾਪੁ ਰੇਣ ਸਾਧੂ ਥੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: taj aap binasee taap ren saadhoo theeo |
English: Renounce your self-conceit, and the fever shall depart; become the dust of the feet of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tiseh paraapat naam teraa kar kripaa jis deeo |1|
English: He alone receives Your Name, Lord, whom You bless with Your Mercy. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: mere man naam amrit peeo |
English: O my mind, drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਨ ਸਾਦ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਹੋਛੇ ਅਮਰੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aan saad bisaar hochhe amar jug jug jeeo |1| rahaau |
English: Abandon other bland, insipid tastes; become immortal, and live throughout the ages. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਇਕ ਰਸ ਰੰਗ ਨਾਮਾ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਲੀਉ ॥
Transliteration: naam ik ras rang naamaa naam laagee leeo |
English: Savor the essence of the One and only Naam; love the Naam, focus and attune yourself to the Naam.

Gurbani: ਮੀਤੁ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਸਖਾ ਬੰਧਪੁ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀਉ ॥੨॥੫॥੨੮॥
Transliteration: meet saajan sakhaa bandhap har ek naanak keeo |2|5|28|
English: Nanak has made the One Lord his only friend, companion and relative. ||2||5||28||

[Ang 1007 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 |
English: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਿ ਮਾਤਾ ਉਦਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਲਗਨਿ ਦੇਤ ਨ ਸੇਕ ॥
Transliteration: pratipaal maataa udar raakhai lagan det na sek |
English: He nourishes and preserves mortals in the womb of the mother, so that the fiery heat does not hurt them.

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਈਹਾ ਰਾਖੈ ਬੂਝੁ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: soee suaamee eehaa raakhai boojh budh bibek |1|
English: That Lord and Master protects us here. Understand this in your mind. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਟੇਕ ॥
Transliteration: mere man naam kee kar ttek |
English: O my mind, take the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਬੂਝੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂ ਕੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਏਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tiseh boojh jin too keea prabh karan kaaran ek |1| rahaau |
English: Understand the One who created you; the One God is the Cause of causes. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਚੇਤਿ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਤਜਿ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਛੋਡਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਭੇਖ ॥
Transliteration: chet man meh taj siaanap chhodd sagale bhekh |
English: Remember the One Lord in your mind, renounce your clever tricks, and give up all your religious robes.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਰੇ ਕਈ ਅਨੇਕ ॥੨॥੬॥੨੯॥
Transliteration: simar har har sadaa naanak tare kee anek |2|6|29|
English: Meditating in remembrance forever on the Lord, Har, Har, O Nanak, countless beings have been saved. ||2||6||29||

[Ang 1007 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 |
English: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਅਨਾਥ ਕੋ ਹੈ ਨਾਥੁ ॥
Transliteration: patit paavan naam jaa ko anaath ko hai naath |
English: His Name is the Purifier of sinners; He is the Master of the masterless.

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਭਉਜਲ ਮਾਹਿ ਤੁਲਹੋ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਲਿਖਿਓ ਮਾਥ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mahaa bhaujal maeh tulaho jaa ko likhio maath |1|
English: In the vast and terrifying world-ocean, he is the raft for those who have such destiny inscribed on their foreheads. ||1||

Gurbani: ਡੂਬੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਘਨ ਸਾਥ ॥
Transliteration: ddoobe naam bin ghan saath |
English: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, huge numbers of companions have drowned.

Gurbani: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਹਾਥ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: karan kaaran chit na aavai de kar raakhai haath |1| rahaau |
English: Even if someone does not remember the Lord, the Cause of causes, still, the Lord reaches out with His hand, and saves him. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਾਰਣ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪਾਥ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasangat gun uchaaran har naam amrit paath |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and take the Path of the Ambrosial Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ਮਾਧਉ ਸੁਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵੈ ਗਾਥ ॥੨॥੭॥੩੦॥
Transliteration: karahu kripaa muraar maadhau sun naanak jeevai gaath |2|7|30|
English: Shower me with Your Mercy, O Lord; listening to Your sermon, Nanak lives. ||2||7||30||

[Ang 1007 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਅੰਜੁਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੭ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo anjulee mahalaa 5 ghar 7 |
English: Maaroo, Anjulee ~ With Hands Cupped In Prayer, Fifth Mehl, Seventh House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਧੁਰਹੁ ਹੀ ਹੂਆ ॥
Transliteration: sanjog vijog dhurahu hee hooaa |
English: Union and separation are ordained by the Primal Lord God.

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਧਾਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਪੁਤਲਾ ਕੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: panch dhaat kar putalaa keea |
English: The puppet is made from the five elements.

Gurbani: ਸਾਹੈ ਕੈ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਅੜੈ ਜੀ ਦੇਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਇ ਪਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saahai kai furamaaeiarrai jee dehee vich jeeo aae peaa |1|
English: By the Command of the Dear Lord King, the soul came and entered into the body. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਿਥੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਭਖੈ ਭੜਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jithai agan bhakhai bharrahaare |
English: In that place, where the fire rages like an oven,

Gurbani: ਊਰਧ ਮੁਖ ਮਹਾ ਗੁਬਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aooradh mukh mahaa gubaare |
English: in that darkness where the body lies face down

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਸੋਈ ਓਥੈ ਖਸਮਿ ਛਡਾਇ ਲਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saas saas samaale soee othai khasam chhaddaae leaa |2|
English: - there, one remembers his Lord and Master with each and every breath, and then he is rescued. ||2||

Gurbani: ਵਿਚਹੁ ਗਰਭੈ ਨਿਕਲਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: vichahu garabhai nikal aaeaa |
English: Then, one comes out from within the womb,

Gurbani: ਖਸਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਦੁਨੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: khasam visaar dunee chit laaeaa |
English: and forgetting his Lord and Master, he attaches his consciousness to the world.

Gurbani: ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਭਵਾਈਐ ਜੋਨੀ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਕਿਤਹੀ ਥਾਇ ਭਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aavai jaae bhavaaeeai jonee rehan na kitahee thaae bheaa |3|
English: He comes and goes, and wanders in reincarnation; he cannot remain anywhere. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨਿ ਰਖਿ ਲਇਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: miharavaan rakh leian aape |
English: The Merciful Lord Himself emancipates.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਥਾਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jant sabh tis ke thaape |
English: He created and established all beings and creatures.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜਿਣਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਇਆ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਥਿਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੧॥
Transliteration: janam padaarath jin chaliaa naanak aaeaa so paravaan thiaa |4|1|31|
English: Those who depart after having been victorious in this priceless human life - O Nanak, their coming into the world is approved. ||4||1||31||

[Ang 1008 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 |
English: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਵੈਦੋ ਨ ਵਾਈ ਭੈਣੋ ਨ ਭਾਈ ਏਕੋ ਸਹਾਈ ਰਾਮੁ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: vaido na vaaee bhaino na bhaaee eko sahaaee raam he |1|
English: The One Lord alone is our help and support; neither physician nor friend, nor sister nor brother can be this. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕੀਤਾ ਜਿਸੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਾਪਾਂ ਮਲੋ ਧੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: keetaa jiso hovai paapaan malo dhovai so simarahu paradhaan he |2|
English: His actions alone come to pass; He washes off the filth of sins. Meditate in remembrance on that Supreme Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਘਟੇ ਵਾਸੀ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਥਾਨੁ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatte vaasee sarab nivaasee asathir jaa kaa thaan he |3|
English: He abides in each and every heart, and dwells in all; His seat and place are eternal. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ਸੰਗੇ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕਾਮੁ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: aavai na jaavai sange samaavai pooran jaa kaa kaam he |4|
English: He does not come or go, and He is always with us. His actions are perfect. ||4||

Gurbani: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਰਾਖਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat janaa kaa raakhanahaaraa |
English: He is the Savior and the Protector of His devotees.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਜਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sant jeeveh jap praan adhaaraa |
English: The Saints live by meditating on God, the support of the breath of life.

Gurbani: ਕਰਨ ਕਾਰਨ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ਹੇ ॥੫॥੨॥੩੨॥
Transliteration: karan kaaran samarath suaamee naanak tis kurabaan he |5|2|32|
English: The Almighty Lord and Master is the Cause of causes; Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||5||2||32||

[Ang 1008 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 9 |
English: Maaroo, Ninth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har ko naam sadaa sukhadaaee |
English: The Name of the Lord is forever the Giver of peace.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਅਜਾਮਲੁ ਉਧਰਿਓ ਗਨਿਕਾ ਹੂ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kau simar ajaamal udhario ganikaa hoo gat paaee |1| rahaau |
English: Meditating in remembrance on it, Ajaamal was saved, and Ganika the prostitute was emancipated. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪੰਚਾਲੀ ਕਉ ਰਾਜ ਸਭਾ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੁਧਿ ਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: panchaalee kau raaj sabhaa meh raam naam sudh aaee |
English: Dropadi the princess of Panchaala remembered the Lord's Name in the royal court.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੋ ਦੂਖੁ ਹਰਿਓ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਅਪਨੀ ਪੈਜ ਬਢਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: taa ko dookh hario karunaa mai apanee paij badtaaee |1|
English: The Lord, the embodiment of mercy, removed her suffering; thus His own glory was increased. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਨਰ ਜਸੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਗਾਇਓ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਭਇਓ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jih nar jas kirapaa nidh gaaeo taa kau bheo sahaaee |
English: That man, who sings the Praise of the Lord, the treasure of mercy, has the help and support of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈ ਇਹੀ ਭਰੋਸੈ ਗਹੀ ਆਨਿ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥੨॥੧॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak mai ihee bharosai gahee aan saranaaee |2|1|
English: Says Nanak, I have come to rely on this. I seek the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||2||1||

[Ang 1008 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 9 |
English: Maaroo, Ninth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਮੈ ਕਹਾ ਕਰਉ ਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ab mai kahaa krau ree maaee |
English: What should I do now, O mother?

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਬਿਖਿਅਨ ਸਿਉ ਖੋਇਆ ਸਿਮਰਿਓ ਨਾਹਿ ਕਨੑਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sagal janam bikhian siau khoeaa simario naeh kanaaee |1| rahaau |
English: I have wasted my whole life in sin and corruption; I never remembered the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਾਲ ਫਾਸ ਜਬ ਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਤਿਹ ਸੁਧਿ ਸਭ ਬਿਸਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kaal faas jab gar meh melee tih sudh sabh bisaraaee |
English: When Death places the noose around my neck, then I lose all my senses.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਯਾ ਸੰਕਟ ਮਹਿ ਕੋ ਅਬ ਹੋਤ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: raam naam bin yaa sankatt meh ko ab hot sahaaee |1|
English: Now, in this disaster, other than the Name of the Lord, who will be my help and support? ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਅਪਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੀ ਛਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਭਈ ਪਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jo sanpat apanee kar maanee chhin meh bhee paraaee |
English: That wealth, which he believes to be his own, in an instant, belongs to another.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਯਹ ਸੋਚ ਰਹੀ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਗਾਈ ॥੨॥੨॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak yeh soch rahee man har jas kabahoo na gaaee |2|2|
English: Says Nanak, this still really bothers my mind - I never sang the Praises of the Lord. ||2||2||

[Ang 1008 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 9 |
English: Maaroo, Ninth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਾਈ ਮੈ ਮਨ ਕੋ ਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਤਿਆਗਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: maaee mai man ko maan na tiaagio |
English: O my mother, I have not renounced the pride of my mind.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਮਦਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਿਰਾਇਓ ਰਾਮ ਭਜਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਲਾਗਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa ke mad janam siraaeo raam bhajan nahee laagio |1| rahaau |
English: I have wasted my life intoxicated with Maya; I have not focused myself in meditation on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਕੋ ਡੰਡੁ ਪਰਿਓ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਤਬ ਸੋਵਤ ਤੈ ਜਾਗਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: jam ko ddandd pario sir aoopar tab sovat tai jaagio |
English: When Death's club falls on my head, then I will be wakened from my sleep.

Gurbani: ਕਹਾ ਹੋਤ ਅਬ ਕੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਏ ਛੂਟਤ ਨਾਹਿਨ ਭਾਗਿਓ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kahaa hot ab kai pachhutaae chhoottat naahin bhaagio |1|
English: But what good will it do to repent at that time? I cannot escape by running away. ||1||

Gurbani: ਇਹ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਉਪਜੀ ਘਟ ਮਹਿ ਜਬ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨਨ ਅਨੁਰਾਗਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: eih chintaa upajee ghatt meh jab gur charanan anuraagio |
English: When this anxiety arises in the heart, then, one comes to love the Guru's feet.

Gurbani: ਸੁਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਬ ਹੂਆ ਜਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਸ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਗਿਓ ॥੨॥੩॥
Transliteration: sufal janam naanak tab hooaa jau prabh jas meh paagio |2|3|
English: My life becomes fruitful, O Nanak, only when I am absorbed in the Praises of God. ||2||3||

[Ang 1008 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo asattapadeea mahalaa 1 ghar 1 |
English: Maaroo, Ashtpadheeyaa, First Mehl, First House:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਕਥੇ ਸੁਣੇ ਹਾਰੇ ਮੁਨੀ ਅਨੇਕਾ ॥
Transliteration: bed puraan kathe sune haare munee anekaa |
English: Reciting and listening to the Vedas and the Puraanas, countless wise men have grown weary.

Gurbani: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਬਹੁ ਘਣਾ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਭੇਖਾ ॥
Transliteration: atthasatth teerath bahu ghanaa bhram thaake bhekhaa |
English: So many in their various religious robes have grown weary, wandering to the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੋ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਨੈ ਏਕਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saacho saahib niramalo man maanai ekaa |1|
English: The True Lord and Master is immaculate and pure. The mind is satisfied only by the One Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਅਜਰਾਵਰੁ ਅਮਰੁ ਤੂ ਸਭ ਚਾਲਣਹਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: too ajaraavar amar too sabh chaalanahaaree |
English: You are eternal; You do not grow old. All others pass away.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਭਾਇ ਲੈ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: naam rasaaein bhaae lai parahar dukh bhaaree |1| rahaau |
English: One who lovingly focuses on the Naam, the source of nectar - his pains are taken away. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪੜੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਉਧਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har parreeai har bujheeai guramatee naam udhaaraa |
English: Study the Lord's Name, and understand the Lord's Name; follow the Guru's Teachings, and through the Naam, you shall be saved.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਹੈ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur poorai pooree mat hai poorai sabad beechaaraa |
English: Perfect are the Teachings of the Perfect Guru; contemplate the Perfect Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਾਟਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: atthasatth teerath har naam hai kilavikh kaattanahaaraa |2|
English: The Lord's Name is the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, and the Eradicator of sins. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਲੁ ਬਿਲੋਵੈ ਜਲੁ ਮਥੈ ਤਤੁ ਲੋੜੈ ਅੰਧੁ ਅਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jal bilovai jal mathai tat lorrai andh agiaanaa |
English: The blind ignorant mortal stirs the water and churns the water, wishing to obtain butter.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਦਧਿ ਮਥੀਐ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: guramatee dadh matheeai amrit paaeeai naam nidhaanaa |
English: Following the Guru's Teachings, one churns the cream, and the treasure of the Ambrosial Naam is obtained.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਪਸੂ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: manamukh tat na jaananee pasoo maeh samaanaa |3|
English: The self-willed manmukh is a beast; he does not know the essence of reality that is contained within himself. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਰੀ ਮਰੁ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: haumai meraa maree mar mar jamai vaaro vaar |
English: Dying in egotism and self-conceit, one dies, and dies again, only to be reincarnated over and over again.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਦੂਜੀ ਵਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabade je marai fir marai na doojee vaar |
English: But when he dies in the Word of the Guru's Shabad, then he does not die, ever again.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਭਿ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰਣਹਾਰ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: guramatee jagajeevan man vasai sabh kul udhaaranahaar |4|
English: When he follows the Guru's Teachings, and enshrines the Lord, the Life of the World, within his mind, he redeems all his generations. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਵਖਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਸਚਾ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa vakhar naam hai sachaa vaapaaraa |
English: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the true object, the true commodity.

Gurbani: ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: laahaa naam sansaar hai guramatee veechaaraa |
English: The Naam is the only true profit in this world. Follow the Guru's Teachings, and contemplate it.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਨਿਤ ਤੋਟਾ ਸੈਸਾਰਾ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: doojai bhaae kaar kamaavanee nit tottaa saisaaraa |5|
English: To work in the love of duality, brings constant loss in this world. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਥਾਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਘਰ ਬਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: saachee sangat thaan sach sache ghar baaraa |
English: True is one's association, true is one's place,

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭਾਉ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa bhojan bhaau sach sach naam adhaaraa |
English: And true is one's hearth and home, when one has the support of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸੰਤੋਖਿਆ ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: sachee baanee santokhiaa sachaa sabad veechaaraa |6|
English: Contemplating the True Word of the Guru's Bani, and the True Word of the Shabad, one becomes content. ||6||

Gurbani: ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀਆ ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਘਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: ras bhogan paatisaaheea dukh sukh sanghaaraa |
English: Enjoying princely pleasures, one shall be destroyed in pain and pleasure.

Gurbani: ਮੋਟਾ ਨਾਉ ਧਰਾਈਐ ਗਲਿ ਅਉਗਣ ਭਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: mottaa naau dharaaeeai gal aaugan bhaaraa |
English: Adopting a name of greatness, one strings heavy sins around his neck.

Gurbani: ਮਾਣਸ ਦਾਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਾਰਾ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: maanas daat na hovee too daataa saaraa |7|
English: Mankind cannot give gifts; You alone are the Giver of everything. ||7||

Gurbani: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਤੂ ਧਣੀ ਅਵਿਗਤੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: agam agochar too dhanee avigat apaaraa |
English: You are inaccessible and unfathomable; O Lord, You are imperishable and infinite.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਦਰੁ ਜੋਈਐ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: gurasabadee dar joeeai mukate bhanddaaraa |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, seeking at the Lord's Door, one finds the treasure of liberation.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲੁ ਨ ਚੂਕਈ ਸਾਚੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥੮॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak mel na chookee saache vaapaaraa |8|1|
English: O Nanak, this union is not broken, if one deals in the merchandise of Truth. ||8||1||

[Ang 1009 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 |
English: Maaroo, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬਿਖੁ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਲਾਦਿਆ ਦੀਆ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਮੰਝਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: bikh bohithaa laadiaa deea samund manjhaar |
English: The boat is loaded with sin and corruption, and launched into the sea.

Gurbani: ਕੰਧੀ ਦਿਸਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: kandhee dis na aavee naa uravaar na paar |
English: The shore cannot be seen on this side, nor on the shore beyond.

Gurbani: ਵੰਝੀ ਹਾਥਿ ਨ ਖੇਵਟੂ ਜਲੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਅਸਰਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: vanjhee haath na khevattoo jal saagar asaraal |1|
English: There are no oars, nor any boatmen, to cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਾਬਾ ਜਗੁ ਫਾਥਾ ਮਹਾ ਜਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: baabaa jag faathaa mahaa jaal |
English: O Baba, the world is caught in the great noose.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee ubare sachaa naam samaal |1| rahaau |
English: By Guru's Grace, they are saved, contemplating the True Name. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਲੰਘਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: satiguroo hai bohithaa sabad langhaavanahaar |
English: The True Guru is the boat; the Word of the Shabad will carry them across.

Gurbani: ਤਿਥੈ ਪਵਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਕੋ ਨਾ ਜਲੁ ਨਾ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: tithai pavan na paavako naa jal naa aakaar |
English: There is neither wind nor fire, neither water nor form there.

Gurbani: ਤਿਥੈ ਸਚਾ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਇ ਭਵਜਲ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tithai sachaa sach naae bhavajal taaranahaar |2|
English: The True Name of the True Lord is there; it carries them across the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲੰਘੇ ਸੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਏ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh langhe se paar pe sache siau liv laae |
English: The Gurmukhs reach the shore beyond, lovingly focusing on the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: aavaa gaun nivaariaa jotee jot milaae |
English: Their comings and goings are ended, and their light merges into the Light.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਹਜੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਚੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: guramatee sehaj aoopajai sache rahai samaae |3|
English: Following the Guru's Teachings, intuitive peace wells up within them, and they remain merged in the True Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਪੁ ਪਿੜਾਈ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਖੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਰੋਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: sap pirraaee paaeeai bikh antar man ros |
English: The snake may be locked in a basket, but it is still poisonous, and the anger within its mind remains.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੀਜੈ ਦੋਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: poorab likhiaa paaeeai kis no deejai dos |
English: One obtains what is pre-ordained; why does he blame others?

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਰੜੁ ਜੇ ਸੁਣੇ ਮੰਨੇ ਨਾਉ ਸੰਤੋਸੁ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: guramukh gaararr je sune mane naau santos |4|
English: If one, as Gurmukh, hears and believes in the Name, the charm against poison, his mind becomes content. ||4||

Gurbani: ਮਾਗਰਮਛੁ ਫਹਾਈਐ ਕੁੰਡੀ ਜਾਲੁ ਵਤਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: maagaramachh fahaaeeai kunddee jaal vataae |
English: The crocodile is caught by the hook and line;

Gurbani: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਫਾਥਾ ਫਾਹੀਐ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੋਤਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: duramat faathaa faaheeai fir fir pachhotaae |
English: caught in the trap of evil-mindedness, he regrets and repents, again and again.

Gurbani: ਜੰਮਣ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: jaman maran na sujhee kirat na mettiaa jaae |5|
English: He does not understand birth and death; the inscription of one's past actions cannot be erased. ||5||

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਪਾਇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: haumai bikh paae jagat upaaeaa sabad vasai bikh jaae |
English: Injecting the poison of egotism, the world was created; with the Shabad enshrined within, the poison is eliminated.

Gurbani: ਜਰਾ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਈ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jaraa johi na sakee sach rahai liv laae |
English: Old age cannot torment one who remains lovingly absorbed in the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਸੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: jeevan mukat so aakheeai jis vichahu haumai jaae |6|
English: He alone is called Jivan-Mikta, liberated while yet alive, from within whom egotism is eradicated. ||6||

Gurbani: ਧੰਧੈ ਧਾਵਤ ਜਗੁ ਬਾਧਿਆ ਨਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: dhandhai dhaavat jag baadhiaa naa boojhai veechaar |
English: The world is chasing after worldly affairs; caught and bound, it does not understand contemplative meditation.

Gurbani: ਜੰਮਣ ਮਰਣੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਗਵਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: jaman maran visaariaa manamukh mugadh gavaar |
English: The foolish, ignorant, self-willed manmukh has forgotten birth and death.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: gur raakhe se ubare sachaa sabad veechaar |7|
English: Those whom the Guru has protected are saved, contemplating the True Word of the Shabad. ||7||

Gurbani: ਸੂਹਟੁ ਪਿੰਜਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੈ ਬੋਲੈ ਬੋਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: soohatt pinjar prem kai bolai bolanahaar |
English: In the cage of divine love, the parrot, speaks.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਚੁਗੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਐ ਉਡੈ ਤ ਏਕਾ ਵਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: sach chugai amrit peeai uddai ta ekaa vaar |
English: It pecks at the Truth, and drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar; it flies away, only once.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਖਸਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੮॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur miliai khasam pachhaaneeai kahu naanak mokh duaar |8|2|
English: Meeting with the Guru, one recognizes his Lord and Master; says Nanak, he finds the gate of liberation. ||8||2||

[Ang 1010 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 |
English: Maaroo, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਰੁ ਭਾਗੋ ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sabad marai taa maar mar bhaago kis peh jaau |
English: One who dies in the Word of the Shabad conquers death; otherwise, where can you run?

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਡਰਿ ਭੈ ਭਾਗੀਐ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jis kai ddar bhai bhaageeai amrit taa ko naau |
English: Through the Fear of God, fear runs away; His Name is Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਮਾਰਹਿ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਤੂ ਬੀਜਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: maareh raakheh ek too beejau naahee thaau |1|
English: You alone kill and protect; except for You, there is no place at all. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਾਬਾ ਮੈ ਕੁਚੀਲੁ ਕਾਚਉ ਮਤਿਹੀਨ ॥
Transliteration: baabaa mai kucheel kaachau matiheen |
English: O Baba, I am filthy, shallow and totally without understanding.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੋ ਕਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਕੀਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: naam binaa ko kachh nahee gur poorai pooree mat keen |1| rahaau |
English: Without the Naam, no one is anything; the Perfect Guru has made my intellect perfect. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਵਗਣਿ ਸੁਭਰ ਗੁਣ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਕਿਉ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: avagan subhar gun nahee bin gun kiau ghar jaau |
English: I am full of faults, and I have no virtue at all. Without virtues, how can I go home?

Gurbani: ਸਹਜਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj sabad sukh aoopajai bin bhaagaa dhan naeh |
English: Through the Word of the Shabad, intuitive peace wells up; without good destiny, the wealth is not obtained.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸੇ ਬਾਧੇ ਦੂਖ ਸਹਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jin kai naam na man vasai se baadhe dookh sahaeh |2|
English: Those whose minds are not filled with the Naam are bound and gagged, and suffer in pain. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਸੇ ਕਿਤੁ ਆਏ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jinee naam visaariaa se kit aae sansaar |
English: Those who have forgotten the Naam - why have they even come into the world?

Gurbani: ਆਗੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਗਾਡੇ ਲਾਦੇ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: aagai paachhai sukh nahee gaadde laade chhaar |
English: Here and hereafter, they do not find any peace; they have loaded their carts with ashes.

Gurbani: ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਮੇਲਾ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਜਮ ਦੁਆਰਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: vichhurriaa melaa nahee dookh ghano jam duaar |3|
English: Those who are separated, do not meet with the Lord; they suffer in terrible pain at Death's Door. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅਗੈ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਣਾ ਨਾਹਿ ਮੈ ਭੂਲੇ ਤੂ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: agai kiaa jaanaa naeh mai bhoole too samajhaae |
English: I do not know what will happen in the world hereafter; I am so confused - please teach me, Lord!

Gurbani: ਭੂਲੇ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਜੋ ਦਸੇ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhoole maarag jo dase tis kai laagau paae |
English: I am confused; I would fall at the feet of one who shows me the Way.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: gur bin daataa ko nahee keemat kehan na jaae |4|
English: Without the Guru, there is no giver at all; His value cannot be described. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਾਜਨੁ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਾ ਗਲਿ ਮਿਲਾ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਠਾਇਓ ਲੇਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: saajan dekhaa taa gal milaa saach patthaaeo lekh |
English: If I see my friend, then I will embrace Him; I have sent Him the letter of Truth.

Gurbani: ਮੁਖਿ ਧਿਮਾਣੈ ਧਨ ਖੜੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਖੀ ਦੇਖੁ ॥
Transliteration: mukh dhimaanai dhan kharree guramukh aakhee dekh |
English: His soul-bride stands waiting expectantly; as Gurmukh, I see Him with my eyes.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੂ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਨਦਰੀ ਕਰਮਿ ਵਿਸੇਖੁ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: tudh bhaavai too man vaseh nadaree karam visekh |5|
English: By the Pleasure of Your Will, You abide in my mind, and bless me with Your Glance of Grace. ||5||

Gurbani: ਭੂਖ ਪਿਆਸੋ ਜੇ ਭਵੈ ਕਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਗਉ ਦੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: bhookh piaaso je bhavai kiaa tis maagau dee |
English: One who is wandering hungry and thirsty - what can he give, and what can anyone ask from him?

Gurbani: ਬੀਜਉ ਸੂਝੈ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: beejau soojhai ko nahee man tan pooran dee |
English: I cannot conceive of any other, who can bless my mind and body with perfection.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਦੇਇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: jin keea tin dekhiaa aap vaddaaee dee |6|
English: The One who created me takes care of me; He Himself blesses me with glory. ||6||

Gurbani: ਨਗਰੀ ਨਾਇਕੁ ਨਵਤਨੋ ਬਾਲਕੁ ਲੀਲ ਅਨੂਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: nagaree naaeik navatano baalak leel anoop |
English: In the body-village is my Lord and Master, whose body is ever-new, Innocent and child-like, incomparably playful.

Gurbani: ਨਾਰਿ ਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਪੰਖਣੂ ਸਾਚਉ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਸਰੂਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: naar na purakh na pankhanoo saachau chatur saroop |
English: He is neither a woman, nor a man, nor a bird; the True Lord is so wise and beautiful.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਤੂ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਤੂ ਧੂਪੁ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: jo tis bhaavai so theeai too deepak too dhoop |7|
English: Whatever pleases Him, happens; You are the lamp, and You are the incense. ||7||

Gurbani: ਗੀਤ ਸਾਦ ਚਾਖੇ ਸੁਣੇ ਬਾਦ ਸਾਦ ਤਨਿ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: geet saad chaakhe sune baad saad tan rog |
English: He hears the songs and tastes the flavors, but these flavors are useless and insipid, and bring only disease to the body.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਚਉ ਚਵੈ ਛੂਟੈ ਸੋਗ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: sach bhaavai saachau chavai chhoottai sog vijog |
English: One who loves the Truth and speaks the Truth, escapes from the sorrow of separation.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਗੁ ॥੮॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak naam na veesarai jo tis bhaavai su hog |8|3|
English: Nanak does not forget the Naam; whatever happens is by the Lord's Will. ||8||3||

[Ang 1010 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 |
English: Maaroo, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਹੋਰਿ ਲਾਲਚ ਬਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: saachee kaar kamaavanee hor laalach baad |
English: Practice Truth - other greed and attachments are useless.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਸਚਿ ਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: eihu man saachai mohiaa jihavaa sach saad |
English: The True Lord has fascinated this mind, and my tongue enjoys the taste of Truth.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਰਸੁ ਨਹੀ ਹੋਰਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਲਾਦਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bin naavai ko ras nahee hor chaleh bikh laad |1|
English: Without the Name, there is no juice; the others depart, loaded with poison. ||1||

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਲਾਲਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲ ਕੋ ਸੁਣਿ ਖਸਮ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aisaa laalaa mere laal ko sun khasam hamaare |
English: I am such a slave of Yours, O my Beloved Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਫੁਰਮਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਚਲਾ ਸਚੁ ਲਾਲ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jiau furamaaveh tiau chalaa sach laal piaare |1| rahaau |
English: I walk in harmony with Your Command, O my True, Sweet Beloved. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਾਲੇ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਗੋਲੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਮੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: anadin laale chaakaree gole sir meeraa |
English: Night and day, the slave works for his overlord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਮਨੁ ਵੇਚਿਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur bachanee man vechiaa sabad man dheeraa |
English: I have sold my mind for the Word of the Guru's Shabad; my mind is comforted and consoled by the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਕਾਟੈ ਮਨ ਪੀਰਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur poore saabaas hai kaattai man peeraa |2|
English: The Perfect Guru is honored and celebrated; He has taken away the pains of my mind. ||2||

Gurbani: ਲਾਲਾ ਗੋਲਾ ਧਣੀ ਕੋ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਉ ਵਡਿਆਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: laalaa golaa dhanee ko kiaa khau vaddiaaeeai |
English: I am the servant and slave of my Master; what glorious greatness of His can I describe?

Gurbani: ਭਾਣੈ ਬਖਸੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਧਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: bhaanai bakhase pooraa dhanee sach kaar kamaaeeai |
English: The Perfect Master, by the Pleasure of His Will, forgives, and then one practices Truth.

Gurbani: ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਕਉ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: vichhurriaa kau mel le gur kau bal jaaeeai |3|
English: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, who re-unites the separated ones. ||3||

Gurbani: ਲਾਲੇ ਗੋਲੇ ਮਤਿ ਖਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਨੀਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: laale gole mat kharee gur kee mat neekee |
English: The intellect of His servant and slave is noble and true; it is made so by the Guru's intellect.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਤਿ ਫੀਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: saachee surat suhaavanee manamukh mat feekee |
English: The intuition of those who are true is beautiful; the intellect of the self-willed manmukh is insipid.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸਚੁ ਧੀਰਕ ਧੁਰ ਕੀ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: man tan teraa too prabhoo sach dheerak dhur kee |4|
English: My mind and body belong to You, God; from the very beginning, Truth has been my only support. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੈ ਬੈਸਣੁ ਉਠਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭਾਖਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: saachai baisan utthanaa sach bhojan bhaakhiaa |
English: In Truth I sit and stand; I eat and speak the Truth.

Gurbani: ਚਿਤਿ ਸਚੈ ਵਿਤੋ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: chit sachai vito sachaa saachaa ras chaakhiaa |
English: With Truth in my consciousness, I gather the wealth of Truth, and drink in the sublime essence of Truth.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੈ ਘਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਰਖੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਸੁਭਾਖਿਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: saachai ghar saachai rakhe gur bachan subhaakhiaa |5|
English: In the home of Truth, the True Lord protects me; I speak the Words of the Guru's Teachings with love. ||5||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਉ ਆਲਸੁ ਘਣੋ ਫਾਥੇ ਓਜਾੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh kau aalas ghano faathe ojaarree |
English: The self-willed manmukh is very lazy; he is trapped in the wilderness.

Gurbani: ਫਾਥਾ ਚੁਗੈ ਨਿਤ ਚੋਗੜੀ ਲਗਿ ਬੰਧੁ ਵਿਗਾੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: faathaa chugai nit chogarree lag bandh vigaarree |
English: He is drawn to the bait, and continually pecking at it, he is trapped; his link to the Lord is ruined.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਿਜ ਤਾੜੀ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee mukat hoe saache nij taarree |6|
English: By Guru's Grace, one is liberated, absorbed in the primal trance of Truth. ||6||

Gurbani: ਅਨਹਤਿ ਲਾਲਾ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: anahat laalaa bedhiaa prabh het piaaree |
English: His slave remains continually pierced through with love and affection for God.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਜੀਉ ਜਲਿ ਬਲਉ ਝੂਠੇ ਵੇਕਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: bin saache jeeo jal blau jhootthe vekaaree |
English: Without the True Lord, the soul of the false, corrupt person is burnt to ashes.

Gurbani: ਬਾਦਿ ਕਾਰਾ ਸਭਿ ਛੋਡੀਆ ਸਾਚੀ ਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੀ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: baad kaaraa sabh chhoddeea saachee tar taaree |7|
English: Abandoning all evil actions, he crosses over in the boat of Truth. ||7||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਠਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jinee naam visaariaa tinaa tthaur na tthaau |
English: Those who have forgotten the Naam have no home, no place of rest.

Gurbani: ਲਾਲੈ ਲਾਲਚੁ ਤਿਆਗਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: laalai laalach tiaagiaa paaeaa har naau |
English: The Lord's slave renounces greed and attachment, and obtains the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਬਖਸਹਿ ਤਾ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੮॥੪॥
Transliteration: too bakhaseh taa mel laihi naanak bal jaau |8|4|
English: If You forgive him, Lord, then He is united with You; Nanak is a sacrifice. ||8||4||

[Ang 1011 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 |
English: Maaroo, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਲਾਲੈ ਗਾਰਬੁ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: laalai gaarab chhoddiaa gur kai bhai sehaj subhaaee |
English: The Lord's slave renounces his egotistical pride, through the Guru's Fear, intuitively and easily.

Gurbani: ਲਾਲੈ ਖਸਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: laalai khasam pachhaaniaa vaddee vaddiaaee |
English: The slave realizes his Lord and Master; glorious is his greatness!

Gurbani: ਖਸਮਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: khasam miliai sukh paaeaa keemat kehan na jaaee |1|
English: Meeting with his Lord and Master, he finds peace; His value cannot be desribed. ||1||

Gurbani: ਲਾਲਾ ਗੋਲਾ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਖਸਮੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: laalaa golaa khasam kaa khasamai vaddiaaee |
English: I am the slave and servant of my Lord and Master; all glory is to my Master.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਉਬਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee ubare har kee saranaaee |1| rahaau |
English: By Guru's Grace, I am saved, in the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਲਾਲੇ ਨੋ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰ ਹੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਖਸਮਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: laale no sir kaar hai dhur khasam furamaaee |
English: The slave has been given the most excellent task, by the Primal Command of the Master.

Gurbani: ਲਾਲੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਰਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: laalai hukam pachhaaniaa sadaa rahai rajaaee |
English: The slave realizes the Hukam of His Command, and submits to His Will forever.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮੀਰਾ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aape meeraa bakhas le vaddee vaddiaaee |2|
English: The Lord King Himself grants forgiveness; how glorious is His greatness! ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਸਚਾ ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aap sachaa sabh sach hai gur sabad bujhaaee |
English: He Himself is True, and everything is True; this is revealed through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲੈਹਿ ਤੂ ਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: teree sevaa so kare jis no laihi too laaee |
English: He alone serves You, whom You have enjoined to do so.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਖੁਆਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bin sevaa kinai na paaeaa doojai bharam khuaaee |3|
English: Without serving Him, no one finds Him; in duality and doubt, they are ruined. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਨਿਤ ਦੇਵੈ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: so kiau manahu visaareeai nit devai charrai savaaeaa |
English: How could we forget Him from our minds? The gifts which he bestows increase day by day.

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਤਿਨੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jeeo pindd sabh tis daa saahu tinai vich paaeaa |
English: Soul and body, all belong to Him; He infused the breath into us.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jaa kripaa kare taa seveeai sev sach samaaeaa |4|
English: If he shows His Mercy, then we serve Him; serving Him, we merge in Truth. ||4||

Gurbani: ਲਾਲਾ ਸੋ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਮਰਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: laalaa so jeevat marai mar vichahu aap gavaae |
English: He alone is the Lord's slave, who remains dead while yet alive, and eradicates egotism from within.

Gurbani: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੂਟਹਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: bandhan tootteh mukat hoe trisanaa agan bujhaae |
English: His bonds are broken, the fire of his desire is quenched, and he is liberated.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੋ ਪਾਏ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: sabh meh naam nidhaan hai guramukh ko paae |5|
English: The treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is within all, but how rare are those who, as Gurmukh, obtain it. ||5||

Gurbani: ਲਾਲੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਗੁਣੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਲਾਲਾ ਅਵਗਣਿਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: laale vich gun kichh nahee laalaa avaganiaar |
English: Within the Lord's slave, there is no virtue at all; the Lord's slave is totally unworthy.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਤੂ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: tudh jevadd daataa ko nahee too bakhasanahaar |
English: There is no Giver as great as You, Lord; You alone are the Forgiver.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਲਾਲਾ ਮੰਨੇ ਏਹ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: teraa hukam laalaa mane eeh karanee saar |6|
English: Your slave obeys the Hukam of Your Command; this is the most excellent action. ||6||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੁ ਜੋ ਇਛੇ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur saagar amrit sar jo ichhe so fal paae |
English: The Guru is the pool of nectar in the world-ocean; whatever one desires, that fruit is obtained.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਅਮਰੁ ਹੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: naam padaarath amar hai hiradai man vasaae |
English: The treasure of the Naam brings immortality; enshrine it in your heart and mind.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਏ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: gur sevaa sadaa sukh hai jis no hukam manaae |7|
English: Serving the Guru, eternal peace is obtained, by those whom the Lord inspires to obey the Hukam of His Command. ||7||

Gurbani: ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਸਭ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਮਾਟੀ ਰਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sueinaa rupaa sabh dhaat hai maattee ral jaaee |
English: Gold and silver, and all metals, mix with dust in the end

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: bin naavai naal na chalee satigur boojh bujhaaee |
English: Without the Name, nothing goes along with you; the True Guru has imparted this understanding.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਸਾਚੈ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੮॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak naam rate se niramale saachai rahe samaaee |8|5|
English: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam are immaculate and pure; they remain merged in the Truth. ||8||5||

[Ang 1012 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 |
English: Maaroo, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਭਇਆ ਰਹਣਾ ਨਹੀ ਧੁਰਿ ਫਾਟੇ ਚੀਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: hukam bheaa rahanaa nahee dhur faatte cheerai |
English: The Order is issued, and he cannot remain; the permit to stay has been torn up.

Gurbani: ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਵਗਣਿ ਬਾਧਿਆ ਸਹੁ ਦੇਹ ਸਰੀਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: ehu man avagan baadhiaa sahu deh sareerai |
English: This mind is tied to its faults; it suffers terrible pain in its body.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਬਖਸਾਈਅਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਗੁਨਹ ਫਕੀਰੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: poorai gur bakhasaaeeeh sabh gunah fakeerai |1|
English: The Perfect Guru forgives all the mistakes of the beggar at His Door. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ ਉਠਿ ਚਲਣਾ ਬੁਝੁ ਸਬਦ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kiau raheeai utth chalanaa bujh sabad beechaaraa |
English: How can he stay here? He must get up and depart. Contemplate the Word of the Shabad, and understand this.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jis too meleh so milai dhur hukam apaaraa |1| rahaau |
English: He alone is united, whom You, O Lord, unite. Such is the Primal Command of the Infinite Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਰਹਾ ਜੋ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੁ ਖਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jiau too raakheh tiau rahaa jo dehi su khaau |
English: As You keep me, I remain; whatever You give me, I eat.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਤੂ ਚਲਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਚਲਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jiau too chalaaveh tiau chalaa mukh amrit naau |
English: As You lead me, I follow, with the Ambrosial Name in my mouth.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਥਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mere tthaakur hath vaddiaaeea meleh man chaau |2|
English: All glorious greatness rests in the hands of my Lord and Master; my mind yearns to unite with You. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕੀਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: keetaa kiaa saalaaheeai kar dekhai soee |
English: Why should anyone praise any other created being? That Lord acts and sees.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jin keea so man vasai mai avar na koee |
English: The One who created me, abides within my mind; there is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਸਾਚੀ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: so saachaa saalaaheeai saachee pat hoee |3|
English: So praise that True Lord, and you shall be blessed with true honor. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਪੜਿ ਨ ਪਹੁਚਈ ਬਹੁ ਆਲ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: panddit parr na pahuchee bahu aal janjaalaa |
English: The Pandit, the religious scholar, reads, but does not reach the Lord; he is totally entangled in worldly affairs.

Gurbani: ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਦੁਇ ਸੰਗਮੇ ਖੁਧਿਆ ਜਮਕਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: paap pun due sangame khudhiaa jamakaalaa |
English: He keeps the company of both virtue and vice, tormented by hunger and the Messenger of Death.

Gurbani: ਵਿਛੋੜਾ ਭਉ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: vichhorraa bhau veesarai pooraa rakhavaalaa |4|
English: One who is protected by the Perfect Lord, forgets separation and fear. ||4||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕੀ ਲੇਖੈ ਪਤਿ ਪਵੈ ਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jin kee lekhai pat pavai se poore bhaaee |
English: They alone are perfect, O Siblings of Destiny, whose honor is certified.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਹੈ ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: poore pooree mat hai sachee vaddiaaee |
English: Perfect is the intellect of the Perfect Lord. True is His glorious greatness.

Gurbani: ਦੇਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਲੈ ਲੈ ਥਕਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: dede tott na aavee lai lai thak paaee |5|
English: His gifts never run short, although those who receive may grow weary of receiving. ||5||

Gurbani: ਖਾਰ ਸਮੁਦ੍ਰੁ ਢੰਢੋਲੀਐ ਇਕੁ ਮਣੀਆ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: khaar samudru dtandtoleeai ik maneea paavai |
English: Searching the salty sea, one finds the pearl.

Gurbani: ਦੁਇ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਾ ਮਾਟੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਖਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: due din chaar suhaavanaa maattee tis khaavai |
English: It looks beautiful for a few days, but in the end, it is eaten away by dust.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸਤਿ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: gur saagar sat seveeai de tott na aavai |6|
English: If one serves the Guru, the ocean of Truth, the gifts one receives never run short. ||6||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਨਿ ਸੇ ਊਜਲੇ ਸਭ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: mere prabh bhaavan se aoojale sabh mail bhareejai |
English: They alone are pure, who are pleasing to my God; all others are soiled with filth.

Gurbani: ਮੈਲਾ ਊਜਲੁ ਤਾ ਥੀਐ ਪਾਰਸ ਸੰਗਿ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: mailaa aoojal taa theeai paaras sang bheejai |
English: The filthy become pure, when they meet with the Guru, the Philosopher's Stone.

Gurbani: ਵੰਨੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਲਾਲ ਕੀ ਕਿਨਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: vanee saache laal kee kin keemat keejai |7|
English: Who can estimate the value of the color of the true jewel? ||7||

Gurbani: ਭੇਖੀ ਹਾਥ ਨ ਲਭਈ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਹੀ ਦਾਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: bhekhee haath na labhee teerath nahee daane |
English: Wearing religious robes, the Lord is not obtained, nor is He obtained by giving donations at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

Gurbani: ਪੂਛਉ ਬੇਦ ਪੜੰਤਿਆ ਮੂਠੀ ਵਿਣੁ ਮਾਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: poochhau bed parrantiaa mootthee vin maane |
English: Go and ask the readers of the Vedas; without faith, the world is cheated.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਗਿਆਨੇ ॥੮॥੬॥
Transliteration: naanak keemat so kare pooraa gur giaane |8|6|
English: O Nanak, he alone values the jewel, who is blessed with the spiritual wisdom of the Perfect Guru. ||8||6||

[Ang 1012 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 |
English: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਲਹਰਿ ਘਰੁ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਗੂਚੈ ਅਵਰਾ ਕੇ ਘਰ ਹੇਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh lehar ghar taj vigoochai avaraa ke ghar herai |
English: The self-willed manmukh, in a fit of passion, abandons his home, and is ruined; then, he spies on the homes of others.

Gurbani: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਧਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਭੇਟੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਘੂਮਨ ਘੇਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: grih dharam gavaae satigur na bhettai duramat ghooman gherai |
English: He neglects his household duties, and does not meet with the True Guru; he is caught in the whirlpool of evil-mindedness.

Gurbani: ਦਿਸੰਤਰੁ ਭਵੈ ਪਾਠ ਪੜਿ ਥਾਕਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਹੋਇ ਵਧੇਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: disantar bhavai paatth parr thaakaa trisanaa hoe vadherai |
English: Wandering in foreign lands and reading scriptures, he grows weary, and his thirsty desires only increase.

Gurbani: ਕਾਚੀ ਪਿੰਡੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੈ ਉਦਰੁ ਭਰੈ ਜੈਸੇ ਢੋਰੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kaachee pinddee sabad na cheenai udar bharai jaise dtorai |1|
English: His perishable body does not remember the Word of the Shabad; like a beast, he fills his belly. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਾਬਾ ਐਸੀ ਰਵਤ ਰਵੈ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: baabaa aisee ravat ravai saniaasee |
English: O Baba, this is the way of life of the Sannyaasi, the renunciate.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad ek liv laagee terai naam rate tripataasee |1| rahaau |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he is to enshrine love for the One Lord. Imbued with Your Name, Lord, he remains satisfied and fulfilled. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਘੋਲੀ ਗੇਰੂ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਇਆ ਵਸਤ੍ਰ ਭੇਖ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: gholee geroo rang charraaeaa vasatr bhekh bhekhaaree |
English: He dyes his robes with saffron dye, and wearing these robes, he goes out begging.

Gurbani: ਕਾਪੜ ਫਾਰਿ ਬਨਾਈ ਖਿੰਥਾ ਝੋਲੀ ਮਾਇਆਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kaaparr faar banaaee khinthaa jholee maaeaadhaaree |
English: Tearing his robes, he makes a patched coat, and puts the money in his wallet.

Gurbani: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮਾਗੈ ਜਗੁ ਪਰਬੋਧੈ ਮਨਿ ਅੰਧੈ ਪਤਿ ਹਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: ghar ghar maagai jag parabodhai man andhai pat haaree |
English: From house to house he goes begging, and tries to teach the world; but his mind is blind, and so he loses his honor.

Gurbani: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੈ ਜੂਐ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bharam bhulaanaa sabad na cheenai jooai baajee haaree |2|
English: He is deluded by doubt, and does not remember the Word of the Shabad. He loses his life in the gamble. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਪੂਅਰ ਤਾਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: antar agan na gur bin boojhai baahar pooar taapai |
English: Without the Guru, the fire within is not quenched; and outside, the fire still burns.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਚੀਨਸਿ ਆਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur sevaa bin bhagat na hovee kiau kar cheenas aapai |
English: Without serving the Guru, there is no devotional worship. How can anyone, by himself, know the Lord?

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਨਰਕ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਆਤਮ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: nindaa kar kar narak nivaasee antar aatam jaapai |
English: Slandering others, one lives in hell; within him is hazy darkness.

Gurbani: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਭਰਮਿ ਵਿਗੂਚਹਿ ਕਿਉ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਪੈ ਪਾਪੈ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: atthasatth teerath bharam vigoocheh kiau mal dhopai paapai |3|
English: Wandering to the eixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, he is ruined. How can the filth of sin be washed away? ||3||

Gurbani: ਛਾਣੀ ਖਾਕੁ ਬਿਭੂਤ ਚੜਾਈ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਮਗੁ ਜੋਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: chhaanee khaak bibhoot charraaee maaeaa kaa mag johai |
English: He sifts through the dust, and applies ashes to his body, but he is searching for the path of Maya's wealth.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੇ ਤੇ ਛੋਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: antar baahar ek na jaanai saach kahe te chhohai |
English: Inwardly and outwardly, he does not know the One Lord; if someone tells him the Truth, he grows angry.

Gurbani: ਪਾਠੁ ਪੜੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਝੂਠੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਨਿਗੁਰੇ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਓਹੈ ॥
Transliteration: paatth parrai mukh jhoottho bolai nigure kee mat ohai |
English: He reads the scriptures, but tells lies; such is the intellect of one who has no guru.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਪਈ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਉ ਸੋਹੈ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: naam na japee kiau sukh paavai bin naavai kiau sohai |4|
English: Without chanting the Naam, how can he find peace? Without the Name, how can he look good? ||4||

Gurbani: ਮੂੰਡੁ ਮੁਡਾਇ ਜਟਾ ਸਿਖ ਬਾਧੀ ਮੋਨਿ ਰਹੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: moondd muddaae jattaa sikh baadhee mon rahai abhimaanaa |
English: Some shave their heads, some keep their hair in matted tangles; some keep it in braids, while some keep silent, filled with egotistical pride.

Gurbani: ਮਨੂਆ ਡੋਲੈ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਤ ਆਤਮ ਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: manooaa ddolai deh dis dhaavai bin rat aatam giaanaa |
English: Their minds waver and wander in ten directions, without loving devotion and enlightenment of the soul.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਦੇਵਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: amrit chhodd mahaa bikh peevai maaeaa kaa devaanaa |
English: They abandon the Ambrosial Nectar, and drink the deadly poison, driven mad by Maya.

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਮਿਟਈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਪਸੂਆ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: kirat na mittee hukam na boojhai pasooaa maeh samaanaa |5|
English: Past actions cannot be erased; without understanding the Hukam of the Lord's Command, they become beasts. ||5||

Gurbani: ਹਾਥ ਕਮੰਡਲੁ ਕਾਪੜੀਆ ਮਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਉਪਜੀ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: haath kamanddal kaaparreea man trisanaa upajee bhaaree |
English: With bowl in hand, wearing his patched coat, great desires well up in his mind.

Gurbani: ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਤਜਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਮਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਪਰ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: eisatree taj kar kaam viaapiaa chit laaeaa par naaree |
English: Abandoning his own wife, he is engrossed in sexual desire; his thoughts are on the wives of others.

Gurbani: ਸਿਖ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੈ ਲੰਪਟੁ ਹੈ ਬਾਜਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: sikh kare kar sabad na cheenai lanpatt hai baajaaree |
English: He teaches and preaches, but does not contemplate the Shabad; he is bought and sold on the street.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨਿਭਰਾਤੀ ਤਾ ਜਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਆਰੀ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: antar bikh baahar nibharaatee taa jam kare khuaaree |6|
English: With poison within, he pretends to be free of doubt; he is ruined and humiliated by the Messenger of Death. ||6||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: so saniaasee jo satigur sevai vichahu aap gavaae |
English: He alone is a Sannyaasi, who serves the True Guru, and removes his self-conceit from within.

Gurbani: ਛਾਦਨ ਭੋਜਨ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਨ ਕਰਈ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: chhaadan bhojan kee aas na karee achint milai so paae |
English: He does not ask for clothes or food; without asking, he accepts whatever he receives.

Gurbani: ਬਕੈ ਨ ਬੋਲੈ ਖਿਮਾ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ ਤਾਮਸੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: bakai na bolai khimaa dhan sangrahai taamas naam jalaae |
English: He does not speak empty words; he gathers in the wealth of tolerance, and burns away his anger with the Naam.

Gurbani: ਧਨੁ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: dhan girahee saniaasee jogee ji har charanee chit laae |7|
English: Blessed is such a householder, Sannyaasi and Yogi, who focuses his consciousness on the Lord's feet. ||7||

Gurbani: ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਰਹੈ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਏਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aas niraas rahai saniaasee ekas siau liv laae |
English: Amidst hope, the Sannyaasi remains unmoved by hope; he remains lovingly focused on the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਤਾ ਸਾਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: har ras peevai taa saat aavai nij ghar taarree laae |
English: He drinks in the sublime essence of the Lord, and so finds peace and tranquility; in the home of his own being, he remains absorbed in the deep trance of meditation.

Gurbani: ਮਨੂਆ ਨ ਡੋਲੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਵਰਜਿ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: manooaa na ddolai guramukh boojhai dhaavat varaj rahaae |
English: His mind does not waver; as Gurmukh, he understands. He restrains it from wandering out.

Gurbani: ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਖੋਜੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: grihu sareer guramatee khoje naam padaarath paae |8|
English: Following the Guru's Teachings, he searches the home of his body, and obtains the wealth of the Naam. ||8||

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਸਰੇਸਟ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: brahamaa bisan mahes saresatt naam rate veechaaree |
English: Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva are exalted, imbued with contemplative meditation on the Naam.

Gurbani: ਖਾਣੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਗਗਨ ਪਤਾਲੀ ਜੰਤਾ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: khaanee baanee gagan pataalee jantaa jot tumaaree |
English: The sources of creation, speech, the heavens and the underworld, all beings and creatures, are infused with Your Light.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਾਮ ਧੁਨਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: sabh sukh mukat naam dhun baanee sach naam ur dhaaree |
English: All comforts and liberation are found in the Naam, and the vibrations of the Guru's Bani; I have enshrined the True Name within my heart.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਹੀ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੀ ਤਰੁ ਤੂ ਤਾਰੀ ॥੯॥੭॥
Transliteration: naam binaa nahee chhoottas naanak saachee tar too taaree |9|7|
English: Without the Naam, no one is saved; O Nanak, with the Truth, cross over to the other side. ||9||7||

[Ang 1013 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 |
English: Maaroo, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੰਜੋਗਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਰਕਤੁ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਕਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: maat pitaa sanjog upaae rakat bind mil pindd kare |
English: Through the union of mother and father, the fetus is formed. The egg and sperm join together to make the body.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗਰਭ ਉਰਧਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਰੇ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: antar garabh uradh liv laagee so prabh saare daat kare |1|
English: Upside-down within the womb, it lovingly dwells on the Lord; God provides for it, and gives it nourishment there. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਕਿਉ ਤਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: sansaar bhavajal kiau tarai |
English: How can he cross over the terrifying world-ocean?

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਫਰਿਓ ਭਾਰੁ ਅਫਾਰੁ ਟਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh naam niranjan paaeeai afario bhaar afaar ttarai |1| rahaau |
English: The Gurmukh obtains the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord; the unbearable load of sins is removed. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਗਏ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਮੈ ਬਉਰਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਉ ਹਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: te gun visar ge aparaadhee mai bauraa kiaa krau hare |
English: I have forgotten Your Virtues, Lord; I am insane - what can I do now?

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਸਭੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਦਾਤਿ ਸਮਾਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: too daataa deaal sabhai sir ahinis daat samaar kare |2|
English: You are the Merciful Giver, above the heads of all. Day and night, You give gifts, and take care of all. ||2||

Gurbani: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਲੈ ਜਗਿ ਜਨਮਿਆ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਧਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: chaar padaarath lai jag janamiaa siv sakatee ghar vaas dhare |
English: One is born to achieve the four great objectives of life. The spirit has taken up its home in the material world.

Gurbani: ਲਾਗੀ ਭੂਖ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਗੁ ਜੋਹੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਖਰੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: laagee bhookh maaeaa mag johai mukat padaarath mohi khare |3|
English: Driven by hunger, it sees the path of Maya's riches; this emotional attachment takes away the treasure of liberation. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਵ ਕਰੇ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵੈ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਢੂਢਤ ਥਾਕਿ ਪਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: karan palaav kare nahee paavai it ut dtoodtat thaak pare |
English: Weeping and wailing, he does not receive them; he searches here and there, and grows weary.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਕੂੜ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh ahankaar viaape koorr kuttanb siau preet kare |4|
English: Engrossed in sexual desire, anger and egotism, he falls in love with his false relatives. ||4||

Gurbani: ਖਾਵੈ ਭੋਗੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਪਹਿਰਿ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਕਾਲ ਘਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: khaavai bhogai sun sun dekhai pahir dikhaavai kaal ghare |
English: He eats and enjoys, listens and watches, and dresses up to show off in this house of death.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਕਾਲੁ ਟਰੇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: bin gurasabad na aap pachhaanai bin har naam na kaal ttare |5|
English: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he does not undersand himself. Without the Lord's Name, death cannot be avoided. ||5||
