Gurbani: ਜੇਤਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਤੇ ਛੀਨਿ ਖਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jetaa mohu haumai kar bhoole meree meree karate chheen khare |
English: The more attachment and egotism delude and confuse him, the more he cries out, "Mine, mine!", and the more he loses out.

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਸਹਸੈ ਸਹਸਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਵੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਧੂਰਿ ਪਰੇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: tan dhan binasai sahasai sahasaa fir pachhutaavai mukh dhoor pare |6|
English: His body and wealth pass away, and he is torn by skepticism and cynicism; in the end, he regrets and repents, when the dust falls on his face. ||6||

Gurbani: ਬਿਰਧਿ ਭਇਆ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਖਿਸਿਆ ਕਫੁ ਕੰਠੁ ਬਿਰੂਧੋ ਨੈਨਹੁ ਨੀਰੁ ਢਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: biradh bheaa joban tan khisiaa kaf kantth biroodho nainahu neer dtare |
English: He grows old, his body and youth waste away, and his throat is plugged with mucous; water flows from his eyes.

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਰਹੇ ਕਰ ਕੰਪਣ ਲਾਗੇ ਸਾਕਤ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰੇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: charan rahe kar kanpan laage saakat raam na ridai hare |7|
English: He feet fail him, and his hands shake and tremble; the faithless cynic does not enshrine the Lord in his heart. ||7||

Gurbani: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗਈ ਕਾਲੀ ਹੂ ਧਉਲੇ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਰਖਿਓ ਘਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: surat gee kaalee hoo dhaule kisai na bhaavai rakhio ghare |
English: His intellect fails him, his black hair turns white, and no one wants to keep him in their home.

Gurbani: ਬਿਸਰਤ ਨਾਮ ਐਸੇ ਦੋਖ ਲਾਗਹਿ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਰੇ ਨਰਕਿ ਖਰੇ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: bisarat naam aise dokh laageh jam maar samaare narak khare |8|
English: Forgetting the Naam, these are the stigmas which stick to him; the Messenger of Death beats him, and drags him to hell. ||8||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਬ ਜਨਮ ਕੋ ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਮਿਟਈ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਕਾ ਕਉ ਦੋਸੁ ਧਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: poorab janam ko lekh na mittee janam marai kaa kau dos dhare |
English: The record of one's past actions cannot be erased; who else is to blame for one's birth and death?

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਾਦਿ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੈ ਜਨਮੁ ਜਰੇ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: bin gur baad jeevan hor maranaa bin gurasabadai janam jare |9|
English: Without the Guru, life and death are pointless; without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, life just burns away. ||9||

Gurbani: ਖੁਸੀ ਖੁਆਰ ਭਏ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣ ਫੋਕਟ ਕਰਮ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਕਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: khusee khuaar bhe ras bhogan fokatt karam vikaar kare |
English: The pleasures enjoyed in happiness bring ruin; acting in corruption is useless indulgence.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਮੂਲੁ ਖੋਇਓ ਸਿਰਿ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕਾ ਡੰਡੁ ਪਰੇ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: naam bisaar lobh mool khoeo sir dharam raae kaa ddandd pare |10|
English: Forgetting the Naam, and caught by greed, he betrays his own source; the club of the Righteous Judge of Dharma will strike him over the head. ||10||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh raam naam gun gaaveh jaa kau har prabh nadar kare |
English: The Gurmukhs sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name; the Lord God blesses them with His Glance of Grace.

Gurbani: ਤੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਹਰੇ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: te niramal purakh aparanpar poore te jag meh gur govind hare |11|
English: Those beings are pure, perfect unlimited and infinite; in this world, they are the embodiment of the Guru, the Lord of the Universe. ||11||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਸਮਾਰਹੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਭਾਉ ਕਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har simarahu gur bachan samaarahu sangat har jan bhaau kare |
English: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord; meditate and contemplate the Guru's Word, and love to associate with the humble servants of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਹਰੇ ॥੧੨॥੮॥
Transliteration: har jan gur paradhaan duaarai naanak tin jan kee ren hare |12|8|
English: The Lord's humble servants are the embodiment of the Guru; they are supreme and respected in the Court of the Lord. Nanak seeks the dust of the feet of those humble servants of the Lord. ||12||8||

[Ang 1014 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਕਾਫੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo kaafee mahalaa 1 ghar 2 |
English: Maaroo, Kaafee, First Mehl, Second House:

Gurbani: ਆਵਉ ਵੰਞਉ ਡੁੰਮਣੀ ਕਿਤੀ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਕਰੇਉ ॥
Transliteration: aavau vanyau ddunmanee kitee mitr kareo |
English: The double-minded person comes and goes, and has numerous friends.

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਢੋਈ ਨ ਲਹੈ ਵਾਢੀ ਕਿਉ ਧੀਰੇਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saa dhan dtoee na lahai vaadtee kiau dheereo |1|
English: The soul-bride is separated from her Lord, and she has no place of rest; how can she be comforted? ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੈਡਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਆਪਨੜੇ ਪਿਰ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: maiddaa man rataa aapanarre pir naal |
English: My mind is attuned to the Love of my Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੁਮਾਈ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਕੀਤੀ ਹਿਕ ਭੋਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hau ghol ghumaaee khaneeai keetee hik bhoree nadar nihaal |1| rahaau |
English: I am devoted, dedicated, a sacrifice to the Lord; if only He would bless me with His Glance of Grace, even for an instant! ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਡੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਕਿਉ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: peeearrai ddohaaganee saahurarrai kiau jaau |
English: I am a rejected bride, abandoned in my parents' home; how can I go to my in-laws now?

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਗਲਿ ਅਉਗਣ ਮੁਠੜੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਝੂਰਿ ਮਰਾਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mai gal aaugan muttharree bin pir jhoor maraau |2|
English: I wear my faults around my neck; without my Husband Lord, I am grieving, and wasting away to death. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਸੰਮਲਾ ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: peeearrai pir samalaa saahurarrai ghar vaas |
English: But if, in my parents' home, I remember my Husband Lord, then I will come to dwell in the home of my in-laws yet.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖਿ ਸਵੰਧਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sukh savandh sohaaganee pir paaeaa gunataas |3|
English: The happy soul-brides sleep in peace; they find their Husband Lord, the treasure of virtue. ||3||

Gurbani: ਲੇਫੁ ਨਿਹਾਲੀ ਪਟ ਕੀ ਕਾਪੜੁ ਅੰਗਿ ਬਣਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: lef nihaalee patt kee kaaparr ang banaae |
English: Their blankets and mattresses are made of silk, and so are the clothes on their bodies.

Gurbani: ਪਿਰੁ ਮੁਤੀ ਡੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਤਿਨ ਡੁਖੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: pir mutee ddohaaganee tin ddukhee rain vihaae |4|
English: The Lord rejects the impure soul-brides. Their life-night passes in misery. ||4||

Gurbani: ਕਿਤੀ ਚਖਉ ਸਾਡੜੇ ਕਿਤੀ ਵੇਸ ਕਰੇਉ ॥
Transliteration: kitee chkhau saaddarre kitee ves kareo |
English: I have tasted many flavors, and worn many robes,

Gurbani: ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਬਾਦਿ ਗਇਅਮੁ ਵਾਢੀ ਝੂਰੇਦੀ ਝੂਰੇਉ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: pir bin joban baad geiam vaadtee jhooredee jhooreo |5|
English: but without my Husband Lord, my youth is slipping away uselessly; I am separated from Him, and I cry out in pain. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸਚੇ ਸੰਦਾ ਸਦੜਾ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: sache sandaa sadarraa suneeai gur veechaar |
English: I have heard the True Lord's message, contemplating the Guru.

Gurbani: ਸਚੇ ਸਚਾ ਬੈਹਣਾ ਨਦਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: sache sachaa baihanaa nadaree nadar piaar |6|
English: True is the home of the True Lord; by His Gracious Grace, I love Him. ||6||

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਸਚ ਕਾ ਡੇਖੈ ਡੇਖਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: giaanee anjan sach kaa ddekhai ddekhanahaar |
English: The spiritual teacher applies the ointment of Truth to his eyes, and sees God, the Seer.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: guramukh boojhai jaaneeai haumai garab nivaar |7|
English: The Gurmukh comes to know and understand; ego and pride are subdued. ||7||

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਭਾਵਨਿ ਤਉ ਜੇਹੀਆ ਮੂ ਜੇਹੀਆ ਕਿਤੀਆਹ ॥
Transliteration: tau bhaavan tau jeheea moo jeheea kiteeaah |
English: O Lord, You are pleased with those who are like Yourself; there are many more like me.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਛੁੜੈ ਤਿਨ ਸਚੈ ਰਤੜੀਆਹ ॥੮॥੧॥੯॥
Transliteration: naanak naahu na veechhurrai tin sachai ratarreeaah |8|1|9|
English: O Nanak, the Husband does not separate from those who are imbued with Truth. ||8||1||9||

[Ang 1015 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 |
English: Maaroo, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਭੈਣਾ ਭਰਜਾਈਆ ਨਾ ਸੇ ਸਸੁੜੀਆਹ ॥
Transliteration: naa bhainaa bharajaaeea naa se sasurreeaah |
English: Neither the sisters, nor the sisters-in-law, nor the mothers-in-law, shall remain.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਕੁ ਨ ਤੁਟਈ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਸਹੀਆਹ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sachaa saak na tuttee gur mele saheeaah |1|
English: The true relationship with the Lord cannot be broken; it was established by the Lord, O sister soul-brides. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: balihaaree gur aapane sad balihaarai jaau |
English: I am a sacrifice to my Guru; I am forever a sacrifice to Him.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਏਤਾ ਭਵਿ ਥਕੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਮੇਲਿਮੁ ਦਿਤਮੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur bin etaa bhav thakee gur pir melim ditam milaae |1| rahaau |
English: Wandering so far without the Guru, I grew weary; now, the Guru has united me in Union with my Husband Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਫੁਫੀ ਨਾਨੀ ਮਾਸੀਆ ਦੇਰ ਜੇਠਾਨੜੀਆਹ ॥
Transliteration: fufee naanee maaseea der jetthaanarreeaah |
English: Aunts, uncles, grandparents and sisters-in-law

Gurbani: ਆਵਨਿ ਵੰਞਨਿ ਨਾ ਰਹਨਿ ਪੂਰ ਭਰੇ ਪਹੀਆਹ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aavan vanyan naa rehan poor bhare paheeaah |2|
English: - they all come and go; they cannot remain. They are like boatloads of passengers embarking. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਾਮੇ ਤੈ ਮਾਮਾਣੀਆ ਭਾਇਰ ਬਾਪ ਨ ਮਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: maame tai maamaaneea bhaaeir baap na maau |
English: Uncles, aunts, and cousins of all sorts, cannot remain.

Gurbani: ਸਾਥ ਲਡੇ ਤਿਨ ਨਾਠੀਆ ਭੀੜ ਘਣੀ ਦਰੀਆਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: saath ladde tin naattheea bheerr ghanee dareeaau |3|
English: The caravans are full, and great crowds of them are loading up at the riverbank. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਉ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗਾਵਲੋ ਸਖੀ ਹਮਾਰੋ ਕੰਤੁ ॥
Transliteration: saachau rang rangaavalo sakhee hamaaro kant |
English: O sister-friends, my Husband Lord is dyed in the color of Truth.

Gurbani: ਸਚਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਾ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਵੰਤੁ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: sach vichhorraa naa theeai so sahu rang ravant |4|
English: She who lovingly remembers her True Husband Lord is not separated from Him again. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਭੇ ਰੁਤੀ ਚੰਗੀਆ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: sabhe rutee changeea jit sache siau nehu |
English: All the seasons are good, in which the soul-bride falls in love with the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਕੰਤੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੁਤੀ ਨਿਸਿ ਡੇਹੁ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: saa dhan kant pachhaaniaa sukh sutee nis ddehu |5|
English: That soul-bride, who knows her Husband Lord, sleeps in peace, night and day. ||5||

Gurbani: ਪਤਣਿ ਕੂਕੇ ਪਾਤਣੀ ਵੰਞਹੁ ਧ੍ਰੁਕਿ ਵਿਲਾੜਿ ॥
Transliteration: patan kooke paatanee vanyahu dhruk vilaarr |
English: At the ferry, the ferryman announces, "O travellers, hurry up and cross over."

Gurbani: ਪਾਰਿ ਪਵੰਦੜੇ ਡਿਠੁ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੋਹਿਥਿ ਚਾੜਿ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: paar pavandarre dditth mai satigur bohith chaarr |6|
English: I have seen them crossing over there, on the boat of the True Guru. ||6||

Gurbani: ਹਿਕਨੀ ਲਦਿਆ ਹਿਕਿ ਲਦਿ ਗਏ ਹਿਕਿ ਭਾਰੇ ਭਰ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Transliteration: hikanee ladiaa hik lad ge hik bhaare bhar naal |
English: Some are getting on board, and some have already set out; some are weighed down with their loads.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜਿਆ ਸੇ ਸਚੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: jinee sach vananjiaa se sache prabh naal |7|
English: Those who deal in Truth, remain with their True Lord God. ||7||

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਹਮ ਚੰਗੇ ਆਖੀਅਹ ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਦਿਸੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: naa ham change aakheeah buraa na disai koe |
English: I am not called good, and I see none who are bad.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਸਚੇ ਜੇਹੜਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੮॥੨॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: naanak haumai maareeai sache jeharraa soe |8|2|10|
English: O Nanak, one who conquers and subdues his ego, becomes just like the True Lord. ||8||2||10||

[Ang 1015 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 |
English: Maaroo, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਜਾਣਾ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਨਾ ਜਾਣਾ ਸਿਆਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: naa jaanaa moorakh hai koee naa jaanaa siaanaa |
English: I do not believe that anyone is foolish; I do not believe that anyone is clever.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੈ ਰੰਗੇ ਰਾਤਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sadaa saahib kai range raataa anadin naam vakhaanaa |1|
English: Imbued forever with the Love of my Lord and Master, I chant His Name, night and day. ||1||

Gurbani: ਬਾਬਾ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਹਾ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: baabaa moorakh haa naavai bal jaau |
English: O Baba, I am so foolish, but I am a sacrifice to the Name.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਤੂ ਦਾਨਾ ਬੀਨਾ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਰਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: too karataa too daanaa beenaa terai naam taraau |1| rahaau |
English: You are the Creator, You are wise and all-seeing. Through Your Name, we are carried across. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਏਕ ਜੋਤਿ ਦੁਇ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: moorakh siaanaa ek hai ek jot due naau |
English: The same person is foolish and wise; the same light within has two names.

Gurbani: ਮੂਰਖਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਿ ਮੰਨੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: moorakhaa sir moorakh hai ji mane naahee naau |2|
English: The most foolish of the foolish are those who do not believe in the Name. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਲੈ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur duaarai naau paaeeai bin satigur palai na paae |
English: Through the Guru's Gate, the Gurdwara, the Name is obtained. Without the True Guru, it is not received.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਾ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: satigur kai bhaanai man vasai taa ahinis rahai liv laae |3|
English: Through the Pleasure of the True Guru's Will, the Name comes to dwell in the mind, and then, night and day, one remains lovingly absorbed in the Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਰਾਜੰ ਰੰਗੰ ਰੂਪੰ ਮਾਲੰ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਤੇ ਜੂਆਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: raajan rangan roopan maalan joban te jooaaree |
English: In power, pleasures, beauty, wealth and youth, one gambles his life away.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਬਾਧੇ ਪਾਸੈ ਖੇਲਹਿ ਚਉਪੜਿ ਏਕਾ ਸਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: hukamee baadhe paasai kheleh chauparr ekaa saaree |4|
English: Bound by the Hukam of God's Command, the dice are thrown; he is just a piece in the game of chess. ||4||

Gurbani: ਜਗਿ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣਾ ਨਾਉ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਹਿ ਗਾਵਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jag chatur siaanaa bharam bhulaanaa naau panddit parreh gaavaaree |
English: The world is clever and wise, but it is deluded by doubt, and forgets the Name; the Pandit, the religious scholar, studies the scriptures, but he is still a fool.

Gurbani: ਨਾਉ ਵਿਸਾਰਹਿ ਬੇਦੁ ਸਮਾਲਹਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਭੂਲੇ ਲੇਖਾਰੀ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: naau visaareh bed samaaleh bikh bhoole lekhaaree |5|
English: Forgetting the Name, he dwells upon the Vedas; he writes, but he is confused by his poisonous corruption. ||5||

Gurbani: ਕਲਰ ਖੇਤੀ ਤਰਵਰ ਕੰਠੇ ਬਾਗਾ ਪਹਿਰਹਿ ਕਜਲੁ ਝਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: kalar khetee taravar kantthe baagaa pahireh kajal jharai |
English: He is like the crop planted in the salty soil, or the tree growing on the river bank, or the white clothes sprinkled with dirt.

Gurbani: ਏਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਕੀ ਕੋਠੀ ਜੋ ਪੈਸੈ ਸੋ ਗਰਬਿ ਜਰੈ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: ehu sansaar tisai kee kotthee jo paisai so garab jarai |6|
English: This world is the house of desire; whoever enters it, is burnt down by egotistical pride. ||6||

Gurbani: ਰਯਤਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਕਹਾ ਸਬਾਏ ਦੁਹੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੋ ਜਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: rayat raaje kahaa sabaae duhu antar so jaasee |
English: Where are all the kings and their subjects? Those who are immersed in duality are destroyed.

Gurbani: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਪਉੜੀ ਰਹਸੀ ਅਲਖੁ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ॥੭॥੩॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: kehat naanak gur sache kee paurree rahasee alakh nivaasee |7|3|11|
English: Says Nanak, these are the steps of the ladder, of the Teachings of the True Guru; only the Unseen Lord shall remain. ||7||3||11||

[Ang 1016 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 ghar 5 asattapadee |
English: Maaroo, Third Mehl, Fifth House, Ashtpadheeyaa:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jis no prem man vasaae |
English: One whose mind is filled with the Lord's Love,

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: saachai sabad sehaj subhaae |
English: is intuitively exalted by the True Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਏਹਾ ਵੇਦਨ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ehaa vedan soee jaanai avar ki jaanai kaaree jeeo |1|
English: He alone knows the pain of this love; what does anyone else know about its cure? ||1||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aape mele aap milaae |
English: He Himself unites in His Union.

Gurbani: ਆਪਣਾ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aapanaa piaar aape laae |
English: He Himself inspires us with His Love.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: prem kee saar soee jaanai jis no nadar tumaaree jeeo |1| rahaau |
English: He alone appreciates the value of Your Love, upon whom You shower Your Grace, O Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦਿਬ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਜਾਗੈ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: dib drisatt jaagai bharam chukaae |
English: One whose spiritual vision is awakened - his doubt is driven out.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaad param pad paae |
English: By Guru's Grace, he obtains the supreme status.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਜੋਗੀ ਇਹ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: so jogee ih jugat pachhaanai gur kai sabad beechaaree jeeo |2|
English: He alone is a Yogi, who understands this way, and contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਧਨ ਪਿਰ ਮੇਲਾ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: sanjogee dhan pir melaa hovai |
English: By good destiny, the soul-bride is united with her Husband Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: guramat vichahu duramat khovai |
English: Following the Guru's Teachings, she eradicates her evil-mindedness from within.

Gurbani: ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਨਿਤ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਣੈ ਅਪਣੇ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: rang siau nit raleea maanai apane kant piaaree jeeo |3|
English: With love, she continually enjoys pleasure with Him; she becomes the beloved of her Husband Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਵੈਦੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur baajhahu vaid na koee |
English: Other than the True Guru, there is no physician.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aape aap niranjan soee |
English: He Himself is the Immaculate Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਮਰੈ ਮੰਦਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਗਿਆਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: satigur miliai marai mandaa hovai giaan beechaaree jeeo |4|
English: Meeting with the True Guru, evil is conquered, and spiritual wisdom is contemplated. ||4||

Gurbani: ਏਹੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: ehu sabad saar jis no laae |
English: One who is committed to this most sublime Shabad

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh trisanaa bhukh gavaae |
English: becomes Gurmukh, and is rid of thirst and hunger.

Gurbani: ਆਪਣ ਲੀਆ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: aapan leea kichhoo na paaeeai kar kirapaa kal dhaaree jeeo |5|
English: By one's own efforts, nothing can be accomplished; the Lord, in His Mercy, bestows power. ||5||

Gurbani: ਅਗਮ ਨਿਗਮੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: agam nigam satiguroo dikhaaeaa |
English: The True Guru has revealed the essence of the Shaastras and the Vedas.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪਨੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa apanai ghar aaeaa |
English: In His Mercy, He has come into the home of my self.

Gurbani: ਅੰਜਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: anjan maeh niranjan jaataa jin kau nadar tumaaree jeeo |6|
English: In the midst of Maya, the Immaculate Lord is known, by those upon whom You bestow Your Grace. ||6||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਤਤੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh hovai so tat paae |
English: One who becomes Gurmukh, obtains the essence of reality;

Gurbani: ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aapanaa aap vichahu gavaae |
English: he eradictes his self-conceit from within.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਧੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: satigur baajhahu sabh dhandh kamaavai vekhahu man veechaaree jeeo |7|
English: Without the True Guru, all are entangled in worldly affairs; consider this in your mind, and see. ||7||

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: eik bhram bhoole fireh ahankaaree |
English: Some are deluded by doubt; they strut around egotistically.

Gurbani: ਇਕਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: eikanaa guramukh haumai maaree |
English: Some, as Gurmukh, subdue their egotism.

Gurbani: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਹੋਰਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੇ ਗਾਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: sachai sabad rate bairaagee hor bharam bhule gaavaaree jeeo |8|
English: Attuned to the True Word of the Shabad, they remain detached from the world. The other ignorant fools wander, confused and deluded by doubt. ||8||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh jinee naam na paaeaa |
English: Those who have not become Gurmukh, and who have not found the Naam, the Name of the Lord

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh birathaa janam gavaaeaa |
English: those self-willed manmukhs waste their lives uselessly.

Gurbani: ਅਗੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਬੇਲੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: agai vin naavai ko belee naahee boojhai gur beechaaree jeeo |9|
English: In the world hereafter, nothing except the Name will be of any assistance; this is understood by contemplating the Guru. ||9||

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: amrit naam sadaa sukhadaataa |
English: The Ambrosial Naam is the Giver of peace forever.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur poorai jug chaare jaataa |
English: Throughout the four ages, it is known through the Perfect Guru.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੦॥੧॥
Transliteration: jis too deveh soee paae naanak tat beechaaree jeeo |10|1|
English: He alone receives it, unto whom You bestow it; this is the essence of reality which Nanak has realized. ||10||1||

[Ang 1017 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ghar 3 asattapadeea |
English: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl, Third House, Ashtpadheeyaa:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਭ੍ਰਮਤੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਤੇ ਦੁਲਭ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਬ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh bhramate bhramate dulabh janam ab paaeo |1|
English: Wandering and roaming through 8.4 million incarnations, you have now been given this human life, so difficult to obtain. ||1||

Gurbani: ਰੇ ਮੂੜੇ ਤੂ ਹੋਛੈ ਰਸਿ ਲਪਟਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: re moorre too hochhai ras lapattaaeo |
English: You fool! You are attached and clinging to such trivial pleasures!

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸਤੁ ਹੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸਿਉ ਉਰਝਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: amrit sang basat hai terai bikhiaa siau urajhaaeo |1| rahaau |
English: The Ambrosial Nectar abides with you, but you are engrossed in sin and corruption. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਬਨਜਨਿ ਆਇਓ ਕਾਲਰੁ ਲਾਦਿ ਚਲਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: ratan javehar banajan aaeo kaalar laad chalaaeo |2|
English: You have come to trade in gems and jewels, but you have loaded only barren soil. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਿਹ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਰਹਨਾ ਬਸਨਾ ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਇਓ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jih ghar meh tudh rahanaa basanaa so ghar cheet na aaeo |3|
English: That home within which you live - you have not kept that home in your thoughts. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅਟਲ ਅਖੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਹੀ ਤੁਝੁ ਗਾਇਓ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: attal akhandd praan sukhadaaee ik nimakh nahee tujh gaaeo |4|
English: He is immovable, indestructible, the Giver of peace to the soul; and yet you do not sing His Praises, even for an instant. ||4||

Gurbani: ਜਹਾ ਜਾਣਾ ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਓ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਇਓ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: jahaa jaanaa so thaan visaario ik nimakh nahee man laaeo |5|
English: You have forgotten that place where you must go; you have not attached your mind to the Lord, even for an instant. ||5||

Gurbani: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਇਸ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਉਰਝਾਇਓ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: putr kalatr grih dekh samagree is hee meh urajhaaeo |6|
English: Gazing upon your children, spouse, household and paraphernalia, you are entangled in them. ||6||

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਇਓ ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਲਾਗਾ ਤੈਸੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਓ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: jit ko laaeo tith hee laagaa taise karam kamaaeo |7|
English: As God links the mortals, so are they linked, and so are the deeds they do. ||7||

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਤਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਓ ॥੮॥੧॥
Transliteration: jau bheo kripaal taa saadhasang paaeaa jan naanak braham dhiaaeo |8|1|
English: When He becomes Merciful, then the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is found; servant Nanak meditates on God. ||8||1||

[Ang 1017 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 |
English: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਨੋ ਭਇਓ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
Transliteration: kar anugrahu raakh leeno bheo saadhoo sang |
English: Granting His Grace, He has protected me; I have found the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਉਚਾਰੈ ਮਿਸਟ ਗੂੜਾ ਰੰਗੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har naam ras rasanaa uchaarai misatt goorraa rang |1|
English: My tongue lovingly chants the Lord's Name; this love is so sweet and intense! ||1||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਾਨ ਕੋ ਅਸਥਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: mere maan ko asathaan |
English: He is the place of rest for my mind,

Gurbani: ਮੀਤ ਸਾਜਨ ਸਖਾ ਬੰਧਪੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: meet saajan sakhaa bandhap antarajaamee jaan |1| rahaau |
English: my friend, companion, associate and relative; He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਇਓ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਗਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: sansaar saagar jin upaaeo saran prabh kee gahee |
English: He created the world-ocean; I seek the Sanctuary of that God.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਰਾਧੇ ਜਮਕੰਕਰੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਕਹੀ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur prasaadee prabh araadhe jamakankar kichh na kahee |2|
English: By Guru's Grace, I worship and adore God; the Messenger of Death can't say anything to me. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮੋਖ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਤ ਰਿਦਾ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: mokh mukat duaar jaa kai sant ridaa bhanddaar |
English: Emancipation and liberation are at His Door; He is the treasure in the hearts of the Saints.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਦਾ ਰਾਖਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jeea jugat sujaan suaamee sadaa raakhanahaar |3|
English: The all-knowing Lord and Master shows us the true way of life; He is our Savior and Protector forever. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਕਲੇਸ ਬਿਨਸਹਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: dookh darad kales binaseh jis basai man maeh |
English: Pain, suffering and troubles are eradicated, when the Lord abides in the mind.

Gurbani: ਮਿਰਤੁ ਨਰਕੁ ਅਸਥਾਨ ਬਿਖੜੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਨ ਪੋਹੈ ਤਾਹਿ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: mirat narak asathaan bikharre bikh na pohai taeh |4|
English: Death, hell and the most horrible dwelling of sin and corruption cannot even touch such a person. ||4||

Gurbani: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਾ ਪਰਵਾਹ ॥
Transliteration: ridh sidh nav nidh jaa kai amritaa paravaah |
English: Wealth, miraculous spiritual powers and the nine treasures come from the Lord, as do the streams of Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤੇ ਮਧਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਊਚ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਹ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: aad ante madh pooran aooch agam agaah |5|
English: In the beginning, in the middle, and in the end, He is perfect, lofty, unapproachable and unfathomable. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਦੇਵ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਬੇਦ ਕਰਹਿ ਉਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sidh saadhik dev mun jan bed kareh uchaar |
English: The Siddhas, seekers, angelic beings, silent sages, and the Vedas speak of Him.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜਿ ਭੁੰਚਹਿ ਨਹੀ ਅੰਤੁ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: simar suaamee sukh sehaj bhuncheh nahee ant paaraavaar |6|
English: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord and Master, celestial peace is enjoyed; He has no end or limitation. ||6||

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਛਤ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਜਪਿ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: anik praachhat mitteh khin meh ridai jap bhagavaan |
English: Countless sins are erased in an instant, meditating on the Benevolent Lord within the heart.

Gurbani: ਪਾਵਨਾ ਤੇ ਮਹਾ ਪਾਵਨ ਕੋਟਿ ਦਾਨ ਇਸਨਾਨ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: paavanaa te mahaa paavan kott daan isanaan |7|
English: Such a person becomes the purest of the pure, and is blessed with the merits of millions of donations to charity and cleansing baths. ||7||

Gurbani: ਬਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਸੁਧਿ ਪਰਾਣ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਸੰਤਨਾ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: bal budh sudh paraan sarabas santanaa kee raas |
English: God is power, intellect, understanding, the breath of life, wealth, and everything for the Saints.

Gurbani: ਬਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਿਮਖ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੮॥੨॥
Transliteration: bisar naahee nimakh man te naanak kee aradaas |8|2|
English: May I never forget Him from my mind, even for an instant - this is Nanak's prayer. ||8||2||

[Ang 1017 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 |
English: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਸਤ੍ਰਿ ਤੀਖਣਿ ਕਾਟਿ ਡਾਰਿਓ ਮਨਿ ਨ ਕੀਨੋ ਰੋਸੁ ॥
Transliteration: sasatr teekhan kaatt ddaario man na keeno ros |
English: The sharp tool cuts down the tree, but it does not feel anger in its mind.

Gurbani: ਕਾਜੁ ਉਆ ਕੋ ਲੇ ਸਵਾਰਿਓ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਦੀਨੋ ਦੋਸੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kaaj uaa ko le savaario til na deeno dos |1|
English: It serves the purpose of the cutter, and does not blame him at all. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਉ ਨਿਤ ਨੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: man mere raam rau nit neet |
English: O my mind, continually, continuously, meditate on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਦਇਆਲ ਦੇਵ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸੁਨਿ ਸੰਤਨਾ ਕੀ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: deaal dev kripaal gobind sun santanaa kee reet |1| rahaau |
English: The Lord of the Universe is merciful, divine and compassionate. Listen - this is the way of the Saints. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਤਲੈ ਉਗਾਹਿ ਬੈਸਿਓ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਨ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਰੀਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: charan talai ugaeh baisio sram na rahio sareer |
English: He plants his feet in the boat, and then sits down in it; the fatigue of his body is relieved.

Gurbani: ਮਹਾ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਨਹ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਖਿਨਹਿ ਉਤਰਿਓ ਤੀਰਿ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mahaa saagar neh viaapai khineh utario teer |2|
English: The great ocean does not even affect him; in an instant, he arrives on the other shore. ||2||

Gurbani: ਚੰਦਨ ਅਗਰ ਕਪੂਰ ਲੇਪਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਗੇ ਨਹੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
Transliteration: chandan agar kapoor lepan tis sange nahee preet |
English: Sandalwood, aloe, and camphor-paste - the earth does not love them.

Gurbani: ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮੂਤ੍ਰ ਖੋਦਿ ਤਿਲੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਮਨਿ ਨ ਮਨੀ ਬਿਪਰੀਤਿ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bisattaa mootr khod til til man na manee bipareet |3|
English: But it doesn't mind, if someone digs it up bit by bit, and applies manure and urine to it. ||3||

Gurbani: ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੰਲਗਨ ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਛਤ੍ਰ ॥
Transliteration: aooch neech bikaar sukrit sanlagan sabh sukh chhatr |
English: High and low, bad and good - the comforting canopy of the sky stretches evenly over all.

Gurbani: ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਨ ਕਛੂ ਜਾਨੈ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਅ ਸਮਤ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: mitr satru na kachhoo jaanai sarab jeea samat |4|
English: It knows nothing of friend and enemy; all beings are alike to it. ||4||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਓ ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਬਿਨਾਸ ॥
Transliteration: kar pragaas prachandd pragattio andhakaar binaas |
English: Blazing with its dazzling light, the sun rises, and dispels the darkness.

Gurbani: ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਅਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਹ ਕਿਰਣ ਲਾਗੇ ਮਨਿ ਨ ਭਇਓ ਬਿਖਾਦੁ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: pavitr apavitrah kiran laage man na bheo bikhaad |5|
English: Touching both the pure and the impure, it harbors no hatred to any. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸੀਤ ਮੰਦ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਚਲਿਓ ਸਰਬ ਥਾਨ ਸਮਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: seet mand sugandh chalio sarab thaan samaan |
English: The cool and fragrant wind gently blows upon all places alike.

Gurbani: ਜਹਾ ਸਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਹਾ ਲਾਗਿਓ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਸੰਕਾ ਮਾਨ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: jahaa saa kichh tahaa laagio til na sankaa maan |6|
English: Wherever anything is, it touches it there, and does not hesitate a bit. ||6||

Gurbani: ਸੁਭਾਇ ਅਭਾਇ ਜੁ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਆਵੈ ਸੀਤੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: subhaae abhaae ju nikatt aavai seet taa kaa jaae |
English: Good or bad, whoever comes close to the fire - his cold is taken away.

Gurbani: ਆਪ ਪਰ ਕਾ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: aap par kaa kachh na jaanai sadaa sehaj subhaae |7|
English: It knows nothing of its own or others'; it is constant in the same quality. ||7||

Gurbani: ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਸਨਾਥ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਲਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: charan saran sanaath ihu man rang raate laal |
English: Whoever seeks the Sancuary of the feet of the Sublime Lord - his mind is attuned to the Love of the Beloved.

Gurbani: ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥੮॥੩॥
Transliteration: gopaal gun nit gaau naanak bhe prabh kirapaal |8|3|
English: Constantly singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the World, O Nanak, God becomes merciful to us. ||8||3||

[Ang 1018 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ghar 4 asattapadeea |
English: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House, Ashtpadheeyaa:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਚਾਦਨਾ ਚਾਦਨੁ ਆਂਗਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚਾਦਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: chaadanaa chaadan aangan prabh jeeo antar chaadanaa |1|
English: Moonlight, moonlight - in the courtyard of the mind, let the moonlight of God shine down. ||1||

Gurbani: ਆਰਾਧਨਾ ਅਰਾਧਨੁ ਨੀਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਨਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aaraadhanaa araadhan neekaa har har naam araadhanaa |2|
English: Meditation, meditation - sublime is meditation on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤਿਆਗਨਾ ਤਿਆਗਨੁ ਨੀਕਾ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਤਿਆਗਨਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: tiaaganaa tiaagan neekaa kaam krodh lobh tiaaganaa |3|
English: Renunciation, renunciation - noble is the renunciation of sexual desire, anger and greed. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਾਗਨਾ ਮਾਗਨੁ ਨੀਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਾਗਨਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: maaganaa maagan neekaa har jas gur te maaganaa |4|
English: Begging, begging - it is noble to beg for the Lord's Praise from the Guru. ||4||

Gurbani: ਜਾਗਨਾ ਜਾਗਨੁ ਨੀਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਗਨਾ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: jaaganaa jaagan neekaa har keeratan meh jaaganaa |5|
English: Vigils, vigils - sublime is the vigil spent singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||5||

Gurbani: ਲਾਗਨਾ ਲਾਗਨੁ ਨੀਕਾ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਨਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: laaganaa laagan neekaa gur charanee man laaganaa |6|
English: Attachment, attachment - sublime is the attachment of the mind to the Guru's Feet. ||6||

Gurbani: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤੇ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗਨਾ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: eih bidh tiseh paraapate jaa kai masatak bhaaganaa |7|
English: He alone is blessed with this way of life, upon whose forehead such destiny is recorded. ||7||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨੀਕਾ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾਗਨਾ ॥੮॥੧॥੪॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak tis sabh kichh neekaa jo prabh kee saranaaganaa |8|1|4|
English: Says Nanak, everything is sublime and noble, for one who enters the Sanctuary of God. ||8||1||4||

[Ang 1018 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 |
English: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਉ ਜੀ ਤੂ ਆਉ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸੁਨਾਵਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aau jee too aau hamaarai har jas sravan sunaavanaa |1| rahaau |
English: Please come, O please come into the home of my heart, that I may hear with my ears the Lord's Praises. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਵਤ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਗਾਵਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tudh aavat meraa man tan hariaa har jas tum sang gaavanaa |1|
English: With your coming, my soul and body are rejuvenated, and I sing with you the Lord's Praises. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਾਸੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਮਿਟਾਵਨਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sant kripaa te hiradai vaasai doojaa bhaau mittaavanaa |2|
English: By the Grace of the Saint, the Lord dwells within the heart, and the love of duality is eradicated. ||2||

Gurbani: ਭਗਤ ਦਇਆ ਤੇ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੂਖ ਤਜਾਵਨਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bhagat deaa te budh paragaasai duramat dookh tajaavanaa |3|
English: By the kindness of the devotee, the intellect is enlightened, and pain and evil-mindedness are eradicated. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਹੋਤ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ਪੁਨਰਪਿ ਗਰਭਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਨਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: darasan bhettat hot puneetaa punarap garabh na paavanaa |4|
English: Beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, one is sanctified, and is no longer consigned to the womb of reincarnation. ||4||

Gurbani: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ਜੋ ਤੁਮਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਨਾ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: nau nidh ridh sidh paaee jo tumarai man bhaavanaa |5|
English: The nine treasures, wealth and miraculous spiritual powers are obtained, by one who is pleasing to Your mind. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਬਿਨਾ ਮੈ ਥਾਉ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਜਾਵਨਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: sant binaa mai thaau na koee avar na soojhai jaavanaa |6|
English: Without the Saint, I have no place of rest at all; I cannot think of any other place to go. ||6||

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਕਉ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਰਾਖੈ ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਵਨਾ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: mohi niragun kau koe na raakhai santaa sang samaavanaa |7|
English: I am unworthy; no one gives me sanctuary. But in the Society of the Saints, I merge in God. ||7||

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਚਲਤੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਮਨ ਮਧੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਵਨਾ ॥੮॥੨॥੫॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak gur chalat dikhaaeaa man madhe har har raavanaa |8|2|5|
English: Says Nanak, the Guru has revealed this miracle; within my mind, I enjoy the Lord, Har, Har. ||8||2||5||

[Ang 1019 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 |
English: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਨਾ ਸਫਲ ਜੀਵਨ ਸੁਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਸਦ ਜੀਵਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jeevanaa safal jeevan sun har jap jap sad jeevanaa |1| rahaau |
English: Fruitful is the life, the life of one who hears about the Lord, and chants and meditates on Him; he lives forever. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪੀਵਨਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਨੁ ਆਘਾਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: peevanaa jit man aaghaavai naam amrit ras peevanaa |1|
English: The real drink is that which satisfies the mind; this drink is the sublime essence of the Ambrosial Naam. ||1||

Gurbani: ਖਾਵਨਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੀਵਨਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: khaavanaa jit bhookh na laagai santokh sadaa tripateevanaa |2|
English: The real food is that which will never leave you hungry again; it will leave you contented and satisfied forever. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪੈਨਣਾ ਰਖੁ ਪਤਿ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਫਿਰਿ ਨਾਗੇ ਨਹੀ ਥੀਵਨਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: painanaa rakh pat paramesur fir naage nahee theevanaa |3|
English: The real clothes are those which protect your honor before the Transcendent Lord, and do not leave you naked ever again. ||3||

Gurbani: ਭੋਗਨਾ ਮਨ ਮਧੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਲੀਵਨਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: bhoganaa man madhe har ras santasangat meh leevanaa |4|
English: The real enjoyment within the mind is to be absorbed in the sublime essence of the Lord, in the Society of the Saints. ||4||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਤਾਗੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੂਈ ਆਨੀ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੀਵਨਾ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: bin taage bin sooee aanee man har bhagatee sang seevanaa |5|
English: Sew devotional worship to the Lord into the mind, without any needle or thread. ||5||

Gurbani: ਮਾਤਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਅਉਖੀਵਨਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: maatiaa har ras meh raate tis bahurr na kabahoo aaukheevanaa |6|
English: Imbued and intoxicated with the sublime essence of the Lord, this experience will never wear off again. ||6||

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿਓ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੀਵਨਾ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: milio tis sarab nidhaanaa prabh kripaal jis deevanaa |7|
English: One is blessed with all treasures, when God, in His Mercy, gives them. ||7||

Gurbani: ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਰਣ ਸੰਤ ਧੋਇ ਪੀਵਨਾ ॥੮॥੩॥੬॥
Transliteration: sukh naanak santan kee sevaa charan sant dhoe peevanaa |8|3|6|
English: O Nanak, service to the Saints beings peace; I drink in the wash water of the feet of the Saints. ||8||3||6||

[Ang 1019 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੮ ਅੰਜੁਲੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ghar 8 anjuleea |
English: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl, Eighth House, Anjulees ~ With Hands Cupped In Prayer:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਚਿੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: jis grihi bahut tisai grihi chintaa |
English: The household which is filled with abundance - that household suffers anxiety.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਥੋਰੀ ਸੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਭ੍ਰਮੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: jis grihi thoree su firai bhramantaa |
English: One whose household has little, wanders around searching for more.

Gurbani: ਦੁਹੂ ਬਿਵਸਥਾ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਭਾਲੀਐ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: duhoo bivasathaa te jo mukataa soee suhelaa bhaaleeai |1|
English: He alone is happy and at peace, who is liberated from both conditions. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਰਾਜ ਮਹਿ ਨਰਕੁ ਉਦਾਸ ਕਰੋਧਾ ॥
Transliteration: grih raaj meh narak udaas karodhaa |
English: Householders and kings fall into hell, along with renunciates and angry men,

Gurbani: ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਬੇਦ ਪਾਠ ਸਭਿ ਸੋਧਾ ॥
Transliteration: bahu bidh bed paatth sabh sodhaa |
English: and all those who study and recite the Vedas in so many ways.

Gurbani: ਦੇਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਜੋ ਰਹੈ ਅਲਿਪਤਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਘਾਲੀਐ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: dehee meh jo rahai alipataa tis jan kee pooran ghaaleeai |2|
English: Perfect is the work of that humble servant, who remains unattached while in the body. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਾਗਤ ਸੂਤਾ ਭਰਮਿ ਵਿਗੂਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaagat sootaa bharam vigootaa |
English: The mortal sleeps, even while he is awake; he is being plundered by doubt.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈਐ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: bin gur mukat na hoeeai meetaa |
English: Without the Guru, liberation is not obtained, friend.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਟਹਿ ਹਉ ਬੰਧਨ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਹਾਲੀਐ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: saadhasang tutteh hau bandhan eko ek nihaaleeai |3|
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the bonds of egotism are released, and one comes to behold the One and only Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਤ ਬੰਧਾ ਨਹ ਕਰੈ ਤ ਨਿੰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: karam karai ta bandhaa neh karai ta nindaa |
English: Doing deeds, one is placed in bondage; but if he does not act, he is slandered.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਮਨੁ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਚਿੰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: moh magan man viaapiaa chindaa |
English: Intoxicated with emotional attachment, the mind is afflicted with anxiety.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਜਾਣੈ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਹਿਆਲੀਐ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: gur prasaad sukh dukh sam jaanai ghatt ghatt raam hiaaleeai |4|
English: One who looks alike upon pleasure and pain, by Guru's Grace, sees the Lord in each and every heart. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸੰਸਾਰੈ ਮਹਿ ਸਹਸਾ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: sansaarai meh sahasaa biaapai |
English: Within the world, one is afflicted by skepticism;

Gurbani: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: akath kathaa agochar nahee jaapai |
English: he does not know the imperceptible Unspoken Speech of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਓਹੁ ਬਾਲਕ ਵਾਗੀ ਪਾਲੀਐ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: jiseh bujhaae soee boojhai ohu baalak vaagee paaleeai |5|
English: He alone understands, whom the Lord inspires to understand. The Lord cherishes him as His child. ||5||

Gurbani: ਛੋਡਿ ਬਹੈ ਤਉ ਛੂਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: chhodd bahai tau chhoottai naahee |
English: He may try to abandon Maya, but he is not released.

Gurbani: ਜਉ ਸੰਚੈ ਤਉ ਭਉ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jau sanchai tau bhau man maahee |
English: If he collects things, then his mind is afraid of losing them.

Gurbani: ਇਸ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਉਰੁ ਢਾਲੀਐ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: eis hee meh jis kee pat raakhai tis saadhoo chaur dtaaleeai |6|
English: I wave the fly-brush over that holy person, whose honor is protected in the midst of Maya. ||6||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਸੂਰਾ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਹੋਇ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo sooraa tis hee hoe maranaa |
English: He alone is a warrior hero, who remains dead to the world.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਭਾਗੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਫਿਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo bhaagai tis jonee firanaa |
English: One who runs away will wander in reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਵਰਤਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨੈ ਬੁਝਿ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਲੀਐ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: jo varataae soee bhal maanai bujh hukamai duramat jaaleeai |7|
English: Whatever happens, accept that as good. Realize the Hukam of His Command, and your evil-mindedness will be burnt away. ||7||

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jit jit laaveh tith tit laganaa |
English: Whatever He links us to, to that we are linked.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਅਪਣੇ ਜਚਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: kar kar vekhai apane jachanaa |
English: He acts, and does, and watches over His Creation.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ ਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ ॥੮॥੧॥੭॥
Transliteration: naanak ke pooran sukhadaate too dehi ta naam samaaleeai |8|1|7|
English: You are the Giver of peace, the Perfect Lord of Nanak; as You grant Your blessings, I dwell upon Your Name. ||8||1||7||

[Ang 1019 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 |
English: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬਿਰਖੈ ਹੇਠਿ ਸਭਿ ਜੰਤ ਇਕਠੇ ॥
Transliteration: birakhai hetth sabh jant ikatthe |
English: Beneath the tree, all beings have gathered.

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਤਤੇ ਇਕਿ ਬੋਲਨਿ ਮਿਠੇ ॥
Transliteration: eik tate ik bolan mitthe |
English: Some are hot-headed, and some speak very sweetly.

Gurbani: ਅਸਤੁ ਉਦੋਤੁ ਭਇਆ ਉਠਿ ਚਲੇ ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਅਉਧ ਵਿਹਾਣੀਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: asat udot bheaa utth chale jiau jiau aaudh vihaaneea |1|
English: Sunset has come, and they rise up and depart; their days have run their course and expired. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪਾਪ ਕਰੇਦੜ ਸਰਪਰ ਮੁਠੇ ॥
Transliteration: paap karedarr sarapar mutthe |
English: Those who committed sins are sure to be ruined.

Gurbani: ਅਜਰਾਈਲਿ ਫੜੇ ਫੜਿ ਕੁਠੇ ॥
Transliteration: ajaraaeel farre farr kutthe |
English: Azraa-eel, the Angel of Death, seizes and tortures them.

Gurbani: ਦੋਜਕਿ ਪਾਏ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੈ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੈ ਬਾਣੀਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: dojak paae sirajanahaarai lekhaa mangai baaneea |2|
English: They are consigned to hell by the Creator Lord, and the Accountant calls them to give their account. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਭਈਆ ਬੇਬਾ ॥
Transliteration: sang na koee bheea bebaa |
English: No brothers or sisters can go with them.

Gurbani: ਮਾਲੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਵਞੇਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: maal joban dhan chhodd vayesaa |
English: Leaving behind their property, youth and wealth, they march off.

Gurbani: ਕਰਣ ਕਰੀਮ ਨ ਜਾਤੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਤਿਲ ਪੀੜੇ ਜਿਉ ਘਾਣੀਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: karan kareem na jaato karataa til peerre jiau ghaaneea |3|
English: They do not know the kind and compassionate Lord; they shall be crushed like sesame seeds in the oil-press. ||3||

Gurbani: ਖੁਸਿ ਖੁਸਿ ਲੈਦਾ ਵਸਤੁ ਪਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: khus khus laidaa vasat paraaee |
English: You happily, cheerfully steal the possessions of others,

Gurbani: ਵੇਖੈ ਸੁਣੇ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਖੁਦਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: vekhai sune terai naal khudaaee |
English: but the Lord God is with you, watching and listening.

Gurbani: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਲਬਿ ਪਇਆ ਖਾਤ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਅਗਲੀ ਗਲ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: duneea lab peaa khaat andar agalee gal na jaaneea |4|
English: Through worldly greed, you have fallen into the pit; you know nothing of the future. ||4||

Gurbani: ਜਮਿ ਜਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਮਰੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ॥
Transliteration: jam jam marai marai fir jamai |
English: You shall be born and born again, and die and die again, only to be reincarnated again.

Gurbani: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸਜਾਇ ਪਇਆ ਦੇਸਿ ਲੰਮੈ ॥
Transliteration: bahut sajaae peaa des lamai |
English: You shall suffer terrible punishment, on your way to the land beyond.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਤਿਸੈ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ਅੰਧਾ ਤਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਹੈ ਪਰਾਣੀਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: jin keetaa tisai na jaanee andhaa taa dukh sahai paraaneea |5|
English: The mortal does not know the One who created him; he is blind, and so he shall suffer. ||5||

Gurbani: ਖਾਲਕ ਥਾਵਹੁ ਭੁਲਾ ਮੁਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: khaalak thaavahu bhulaa mutthaa |
English: Forgetting the Creator Lord, he is ruined.

Gurbani: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਖੇਲੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਰੁਠ ਤੁਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: duneea khel buraa rutth tutthaa |
English: The drama of the world is bad; it brings sadness and then happiness.

Gurbani: ਸਿਦਕੁ ਸਬੂਰੀ ਸੰਤੁ ਨ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਵਤੈ ਆਪਣ ਭਾਣੀਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: sidak sabooree sant na milio vatai aapan bhaaneea |6|
English: One who does not meet the Saint does not have faith or contentment; he wanders just as he pleases. ||6||

Gurbani: ਮਉਲਾ ਖੇਲ ਕਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਆਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: maulaa khel kare sabh aape |
English: The Lord Himself stages all this drama.

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਕਢੇ ਇਕਿ ਲਹਰਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: eik kadte ik lehar viaape |
English: Some, he lifts up, and some he throws into the waves.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਨਚਾਏ ਤਿਉ ਤਿਉ ਨਚਨਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਿਰਤ ਵਿਹਾਣੀਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: jiau nachaae tiau tiau nachan sir sir kirat vihaaneea |7|
English: As He makes them dance, so do they dance. Everyone lives their lives according to their past actions. ||7||

Gurbani: ਮਿਹਰ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: mihar kare taa khasam dhiaaee |
English: When the Lord and Master grants His Grace, then we meditate on Him.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਰਕਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: santaa sangat narak na paaee |
English: In the Society of the Saints, one is not consigned to hell.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਣ ਗੀਤਾ ਨਿਤ ਵਖਾਣੀਆ ॥੮॥੨॥੮॥੧੨॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: amrit naam daan naanak kau gun geetaa nit vakhaaneea |8|2|8|12|20|
English: Please bless Nanak with the gift of the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord; he continually sings the songs of Your Glories. ||8||2||8||12||20||

[Ang 1020 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਸੋਲਹੇ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo solahe mahalaa 1 |
English: Maaroo, Solahas, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: saachaa sach soee avar na koee |
English: The True Lord is True; there is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਰਜੀ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਫੁਨਿ ਗੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jin sirajee tin hee fun goee |
English: He who created, shall in the end destroy.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਹਣਾ ਤੁਮ ਸਿਉ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਕਰਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jiau bhaavai tiau raakhahu rahanaa tum siau kiaa mukaraaee he |1|
English: As it pleases You, so You keep me, and so I remain; what excuse could I offer to You? ||1||

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਖਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aap upaae aap khapaae |
English: You Yourself create, and You Yourself destroy.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aape sir sir dhandhai laae |
English: You yourself link each and every person to their tasks.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aape veechaaree gunakaaree aape maarag laaee he |2|
English: You contemplate Yourself, You Yourself make us worthy; You Yourself place us on the Path. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਦਾਨਾ ਆਪੇ ਬੀਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape daanaa aape beenaa |
English: You Yourself are all-wise, You Yourself are all-knowing.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਪਤੀਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape aap upaae pateenaa |
English: You Yourself created the Universe, and You are pleased.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aape paun paanee baisantar aape mel milaaee he |3|
English: You Yourself are the air, water and fire; You Yourself unite in Union. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਸਿ ਸੂਰਾ ਪੂਰੋ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape sas sooraa pooro pooraa |
English: You Yourself are the moon, the sun, the most perfect of the perfect.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਧਿਆਨਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੂਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape giaan dhiaan gur sooraa |
English: You Yourself are spiritual wisdom, meditation, and the Guru, the Warrior Hero.

Gurbani: ਕਾਲੁ ਜਾਲੁ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: kaal jaal jam johi na saakai saache siau liv laaee he |4|
English: The Messenger of Death, and his noose of death, cannot touch one, who is lovingly focused on You, O True Lord. ||4||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: aape purakh aape hee naaree |
English: You Yourself are the male, and You Yourself are the female.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਪਾਸਾ ਆਪੇ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: aape paasaa aape saaree |
English: You Yourself are the chess-board, and You Yourself are the chessman.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਪਿੜ ਬਾਧੀ ਜਗੁ ਖੇਲੈ ਆਪੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: aape pirr baadhee jag khelai aape keemat paaee he |5|
English: You Yourself staged the drama in the arena of the world, and You Yourself evaluate the players. ||5||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਭਵਰੁ ਫੁਲੁ ਫਲੁ ਤਰਵਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape bhavar ful fal taravar |
English: You Yourself are the bumble bee, the flower, the fruit and the tree.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਜਲੁ ਥਲੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸਰਵਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: aape jal thal saagar saravar |
English: You Yourself are the water, the desert, the ocean and the pool.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮਛੁ ਕਛੁ ਕਰਣੀਕਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਲਖਣਾ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: aape machh kachh karaneekar teraa roop na lakhanaa jaaee he |6|
English: You Yourself are the great fish, the tortoise, the Cause of causes; Your form cannot be known. ||6||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਰੈਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: aape dinas aape hee rainee |
English: You Yourself are the day, and You Yourself are the night.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਪਤੀਜੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬੈਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: aap pateejai gur kee bainee |
English: You Yourself are pleased by the Word of the Guru's Bani.

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਅਨਾਹਦਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: aad jugaad anaahad anadin ghatt ghatt sabad rajaaee he |7|
English: From the very beginning, and throughout the ages, the unstruck sound current resounds, night and day; in each and every heart, the Word of the Shabad, echoes Your Will. ||7||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਰਤਨੁ ਅਨੂਪੁ ਅਮੋਲੋ ॥
Transliteration: aape ratan anoop amolo |
English: You Yourself are the jewel, incomparably beautiful and priceless.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਪਰਖੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਤੋਲੋ ॥
Transliteration: aape parakhe pooraa tolo |
English: You Yourself are the Assessor, the Perfect Weigher.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਕਸਿ ਬਖਸੇ ਆਪੇ ਦੇ ਲੈ ਭਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: aape kis hee kas bakhase aape de lai bhaaee he |8|
English: You Yourself test and forgive. You Yourself give and take, O Siblings of Destiny. ||8||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਧਨਖੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਰਬਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape dhanakh aape sarabaanaa |
English: He Himself is the bow, and He Himself is the archer.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਸਿਆਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape sugharr saroop siaanaa |
English: He Himself is all-wise, beautiful and all-knowing.

Gurbani: ਕਹਤਾ ਬਕਤਾ ਸੁਣਤਾ ਸੋਈ ਆਪੇ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: kahataa bakataa sunataa soee aape banat banaaee he |9|
English: He is the speaker, the orator and the listener. He Himself made what is made. ||9||

Gurbani: ਪਉਣੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਿਤ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: paun guroo paanee pit jaataa |
English: Air is the Guru, and water is known to be the father.

Gurbani: ਉਦਰ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਧਰਤੀ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: audar sanjogee dharatee maataa |
English: The womb of the great mother earth gives birth to all.

Gurbani: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਦੁਇ ਦਾਈ ਦਾਇਆ ਜਗੁ ਖੇਲੈ ਖੇਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: rain dinas due daaee daaeaa jag khelai khelaaee he |10|
English: Night and day are the two nurses, male and female; the world plays in this play. ||10||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape machhulee aape jaalaa |
English: You Yourself are the fish, and You Yourself are the net.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਗਊ ਆਪੇ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape gaoo aape rakhavaalaa |
English: You Yourself are the cows, and You yourself are their keeper.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਜਗਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਜੈਸੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: sarab jeea jag jot tumaaree jaisee prabh furamaaee he |11|
English: Your Light fills all the beings of the world; they walk according to Your Command, O God. ||11||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਜੋਗੀ ਆਪੇ ਭੋਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: aape jogee aape bhogee |
English: You Yourself are the Yogi, and You Yourself are the enjoyer.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਰਸੀਆ ਪਰਮ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: aape raseea param sanjogee |
English: You Yourself are the reveller; You form the supreme Union.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਬਾਣੀ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: aape vebaanee nirankaaree nirbhau taarree laaee he |12|
English: You Yourself are speechless, formless and fearless, absorbed in the primal ecstasy of deep meditation. ||12||

Gurbani: ਖਾਣੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: khaanee baanee tujheh samaanee |
English: The sources of creation and speech are contained within You, Lord.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਭ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: jo deesai sabh aavan jaanee |
English: All that is seen, is coming and going.

Gurbani: ਸੇਈ ਸਾਹ ਸਚੇ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: seee saah sache vaapaaree satigur boojh bujhaaee he |13|
English: They are the true bankers and traders, whom the True Guru has inspired to understand. ||13||

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabad bujhaae satigur pooraa |
English: The Word of the Shabad is understood through the Perfect True Guru.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਰਪੂਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sarab kalaa saache bharapooraa |
English: The True Lord is overflowing with all powers.

Gurbani: ਅਫਰਿਓ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਤੂ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: afario veparavaahu sadaa too naa tis til na tamaaee he |14|
English: You are beyond our grasp, and forever independent. You do not have even an iota of greed. ||14||

Gurbani: ਕਾਲੁ ਬਿਕਾਲੁ ਭਏ ਦੇਵਾਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: kaal bikaal bhe devaane |
English: Birth and death are meaningless, for those

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੁ ਸਹਜ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਾਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: sabad sehaj ras antar maane |
English: who enjoy the sublime celestial essence of the Shabad within their minds.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਵਰਦਾਤਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: aape mukat tripat varadaataa bhagat bhaae man bhaaee he |15|
English: He Himself is the Giver of liberation, satisfaction and blessings, to those devotees who love Him in their minds. ||15||

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਮ ਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: aap niraalam gur gam giaanaa |
English: He Himself is immaculate; by contact with the Guru, spiritual wisdom is obtained.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਤੁਝ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo deesai tujh maeh samaanaa |
English: Whatever is seen, shall merge into You.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਭਿਖਿਆ ਦਰਿ ਜਾਚੈ ਮੈ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੧॥
Transliteration: naanak neech bhikhiaa dar jaachai mai deejai naam vaddaaee he |16|1|
English: Nanak, the lowly, begs for charity at Your Door; please, bless him with the glorious greatness of Your Name. ||16||1||

[Ang 1021 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 |
English: Maaroo, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਧਉਲੁ ਅਕਾਸੰ ॥
Transliteration: aape dharatee dhaul akaasan |
English: He Himself is the earth, the mythical bull which supports it and the Akaashic ethers.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਾਸੰ ॥
Transliteration: aape saache gun paragaasan |
English: The True Lord Himself reveals His Glorious Virtues.

Gurbani: ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jatee satee santokhee aape aape kaar kamaaee he |1|
English: He Himself is celibate, chaste and contented; He Himself is the Doer of deeds. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੋ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: jis karanaa so kar kar vekhai |
English: He who created the creation, beholds what He has created.

Gurbani: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਲੇਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: koe na mettai saache lekhai |
English: No one can erase the Inscription of the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aape kare karaae aape aape de vaddiaaee he |2|
English: He Himself is the Doer, the Cause of causes; He Himself is the One who bestows glorious greatness. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਚੰਚਲ ਚਿਤੁ ਚਾਲਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: panch chor chanchal chit chaaleh |
English: The five thieves cause the fickle consciousness to waver.

Gurbani: ਪਰ ਘਰ ਜੋਹਹਿ ਘਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਲਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: par ghar joheh ghar nahee bhaaleh |
English: It looks into the homes of others, but does not search its own home.

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰੁ ਢਹੈ ਢਹਿ ਢੇਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਪਤਿ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa nagar dtahai dteh dteree bin sabadai pat jaaee he |3|
English: The body-village crumbles into dust; without the Word of the Shabad, one's honor is lost. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਬੂਝੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur te boojhai tribhavan soojhai |
English: One who realizes the Lord through the Guru, comprehends the three worlds.

Gurbani: ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨੈ ਸਿਉ ਲੂਝੈ ॥
Transliteration: manasaa maar manai siau loojhai |
English: He subdues his desires, and struggles with his mind.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਤੁਧ ਹੀ ਜੇਹੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਬਾਲ ਸਖਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jo tudh seveh se tudh hee jehe nirbhau baal sakhaaee he |4|
English: Those who serve You, become just like You; O Fearless Lord, You are their best friend from infancy. ||4||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸੁਰਗੁ ਮਛੁ ਪਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape surag machh peaalaa |
English: You Yourself are the heavenly realms, this world and the nether regions of the underworld.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੀ ਬਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape jot saroopee baalaa |
English: You Yourself are the embodiment of light, forever young.

Gurbani: ਜਟਾ ਬਿਕਟ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ਸਰੂਪੀ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਕਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: jattaa bikatt bikaraal saroopee roop na rekhiaa kaaee he |5|
English: With matted hair, and a horrible, dreadful form, still, You have no form or feature. ||5||

Gurbani: ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬੀ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: bed katebee bhed na jaataa |
English: The Vedas and the Bible do not know the mystery of God.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: naa tis maat pitaa sut bhraataa |
English: He has no mother, father, child or brother.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲੇ ਸੈਲ ਉਪਾਇ ਸਮਾਏ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖਣਾ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: sagale sail upaae samaae alakh na lakhanaa jaaee he |6|
English: He created all the mountains, and levels them again; the Unseen Lord cannot be seen. ||6||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਕੀ ਮੀਤ ਘਨੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kar kar thaakee meet ghanere |
English: I have grown weary of making so many friends.

Gurbani: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਾਟੈ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: koe na kaattai avagun mere |
English: No one can rid me of my sins and mistakes.

Gurbani: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਨਾਥੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਭਉ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: sur nar naath saahib sabhanaa sir bhaae milai bhau jaaee he |7|
English: God is the Supreme Lord and Master of all the angels and mortal beings; blessed with His Love, their fear is dispelled. ||7||

Gurbani: ਭੂਲੇ ਚੂਕੇ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: bhoole chooke maarag paaveh |
English: He puts back on the Path those who have wandered and strayed.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ਤੂਹੈ ਸਮਝਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: aap bhulaae toohai samajhaaveh |
English: You Yourself make them stray, and You teach them again.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: bin naavai mai avar na deesai naavahu gat mit paaee he |8|
English: I cannot see anything except the Name. Through the Name comes salvation and merit. ||8||

Gurbani: ਗੰਗਾ ਜਮੁਨਾ ਕੇਲ ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: gangaa jamunaa kel kedaaraa |
English: The Ganges, the Jamunaa where Krishna played, Kaydar Naat'h,

Gurbani: ਕਾਸੀ ਕਾਂਤੀ ਪੁਰੀ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaasee kaantee puree duaaraa |
English: Benares, Kanchivaram, Puri, Dwaarkaa,

Gurbani: ਗੰਗਾ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਬੇਣੀ ਸੰਗਮੁ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: gangaa saagar benee sangam atthasatth ank samaaee he |9|
English: Ganga Saagar where the Ganges empties into the ocean, Trivaynee where the three rivers come together, and the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, are all merged in the Lord's Being. ||9||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: aape sidh saadhik veechaaree |
English: He Himself is the Siddha, the seeker, in meditative contemplation.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਰਾਜਨੁ ਪੰਚਾ ਕਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: aape raajan panchaa kaaree |
English: He Himself is the King and the Council.

Gurbani: ਤਖਤਿ ਬਹੈ ਅਦਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਭੇਦੁ ਭਉ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: takhat bahai adalee prabh aape bharam bhed bhau jaaee he |10|
English: God Himself, the wise Judge, sits on the throne; He takes away doubt, duality and fear. ||10||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਾਜੀ ਆਪੇ ਮੁਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape kaajee aape mulaa |
English: He Himself is the Qazi; He Himself is the Mullah.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਅਭੁਲੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਭੁਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: aap abhul na kabahoo bhulaa |
English: He Himself is infallible; He never makes mistakes.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮਿਹਰ ਦਇਆਪਤਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਨਾ ਕਿਸੈ ਕੋ ਬੈਰਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: aape mihar deaapat daataa naa kisai ko bairaaee he |11|
English: He Himself is the Giver of Grace, compassion and honor; He is no one's enemy. ||11||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: jis bakhase tis de vaddiaaee |
English: Whoever He forgives, He blesses with glorious greatness.

Gurbani: ਸਭਸੈ ਦਾਤਾ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sabhasai daataa til na tamaaee |
English: He is the Giver of all; He does not have even an iota of greed.

Gurbani: ਭਰਪੁਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੁ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: bharapur dhaar rahiaa nihakeval gupat pragatt sabh tthaaee he |12|
English: The Immaculate Lord is all pervading, permeating everywhere, both hidden and manifest. ||12||

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa saalaahee agam apaarai |
English: How can I praise the inaccessible, infinite Lord?

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰ ਮੁਰਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: saache sirajanahaar muraarai |
English: The True Creator Lord is the Enemy of ego.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮੇਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: jis no nadar kare tis mele mel milai melaaee he |13|
English: He unites those whom He blesses with His Grace; uniting them in His Union, they are united. ||13||

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਦੁਆਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: brahamaa bisan mahes duaarai |
English: Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva stand at His Door;

Gurbani: ਊਭੇ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: aoobhe seveh alakh apaarai |
English: they serve the unseen, infinite Lord.

Gurbani: ਹੋਰ ਕੇਤੀ ਦਰਿ ਦੀਸੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਦੀ ਮੈ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: hor ketee dar deesai bilalaadee mai ganat na aavai kaaee he |14|
English: Millions of others can be seen crying at His door; I cannot even estimate their numbers. ||14||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੀ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: saachee keerat saachee baanee |
English: True is the Kirtan of His Praise, and True is the Word of His Bani.

Gurbani: ਹੋਰ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: hor na deesai bed puraanee |
English: I can see no other in the Vedas and the Puraanas.

Gurbani: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਮੈ ਧਰ ਹੋਰ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: poonjee saach sache gun gaavaa mai dhar hor na kaaee he |15|
English: Truth is my capital; I sing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord. I have no other support at all. ||15||

Gurbani: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: jug jug saachaa hai bhee hosee |
English: In each and every age, the True Lord is, and shall always be.

Gurbani: ਕਉਣੁ ਨ ਮੂਆ ਕਉਣੁ ਨ ਮਰਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: kaun na mooaa kaun na marasee |
English: Who has not died? Who shall not die?

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਦਰਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੨॥
Transliteration: naanak neech kahai benantee dar dekhahu liv laaee he |16|2|
English: Nanak the lowly offers this prayer; see Him within your own self, and lovingly focus on the Lord. ||16||2||

[Ang 1022 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 |
English: Maaroo, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਅੰਨੀ ਬੋਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: doojee duramat anee bolee |
English: In duality and evil-mindedness, the soul-bride is blind and deaf.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਕੀ ਕਚੀ ਚੋਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh kee kachee cholee |
English: She wears the dress of sexual desire and anger.

Gurbani: ਘਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਛੋਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: ghar var sehaj na jaanai chhohar bin pir need na paaee he |1|
English: Her Husband Lord is within the home of her own heart, but she does not know Him; without her Husband Lord, she cannot go to sleep. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਲੈ ਭੜਕਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: antar agan jalai bharrakaare |
English: The great fire of desire blazes within her.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਤਕੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh take kunddaa chaare |
English: The self-willed manmukh looks around in the four directions.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਾਚੇ ਹਾਥਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bin satigur seve kiau sukh paaeeai saache haath vaddaaee he |2|
English: Without serving the True Guru, how can she find peace? Glorious greatness rests in the hands of the True Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh ahankaar nivaare |
English: Eradicating sexual desire, anger and egotism,

Gurbani: ਤਸਕਰ ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੰਘਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: tasakar panch sabad sanghaare |
English: she destroys the five thieves through the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨ ਖੜਗੁ ਲੈ ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਲੂਝੈ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: giaan kharrag lai man siau loojhai manasaa maneh samaaee he |3|
English: Taking up the sword of spiritual wisdom, she struggles with her mind, and hope and desire are smoothed over in her mind. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਾ ਕੀ ਰਕਤੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਬਿਦੁ ਧਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: maa kee rakat pitaa bid dhaaraa |
English: From the union of the mother's egg and the father's sperm,

Gurbani: ਮੂਰਤਿ ਸੂਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਆਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: moorat soorat kar aapaaraa |
English: the form of infinite beauty has been created.

Gurbani: ਜੋਤਿ ਦਾਤਿ ਜੇਤੀ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jot daat jetee sabh teree too karataa sabh tthaaee he |4|
English: The blessings of light all come from You; You are the Creator Lord, pervading everywhere. ||4||

Gurbani: ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਕੀਆ ਜੰਮਣ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: tujh hee keea jaman maranaa |
English: You have created birth and death.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਮਝ ਪੜੀ ਕਿਆ ਡਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur te samajh parree kiaa ddaranaa |
English: Why should anyone fear, if they come to understand through the Guru?

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਸਰੀਰਹੁ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: too deaal deaa kar dekheh dukh darad sareerahu jaaee he |5|
English: When You, O Merciful Lord, look with Your kindness, then pain and suffering leave the body. ||5||

Gurbani: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਸਿ ਰਹੇ ਭਉ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: nij ghar bais rahe bhau khaaeaa |
English: One who sits in the home of his own self, eats his own fears.

Gurbani: ਧਾਵਤ ਰਾਖੇ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: dhaavat raakhe tthaak rahaaeaa |
English: He quiets and holds his wandering mind still.

Gurbani: ਕਮਲ ਬਿਗਾਸ ਹਰੇ ਸਰ ਸੁਭਰ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: kamal bigaas hare sar subhar aatam raam sakhaaee he |6|
English: His heart-lotus blossoms forth in the overflowing green pool, and the Lord of his soul becomes his companion and helper. ||6||

Gurbani: ਮਰਣੁ ਲਿਖਾਇ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ ਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: maran likhaae manddal meh aae |
English: With their death already ordained, mortals come into this world.

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ ਚਲਣਾ ਪਰਥਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: kiau raheeai chalanaa parathaae |
English: How can they remain here? They have to go to the world beyond.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਅਮਰੁ ਸਚੇ ਅਮਰਾ ਪੁਰਿ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: sachaa amar sache amaraa pur so sach milai vaddaaee he |7|
English: True is the Lord's Command; the true ones dwell in the eternal city. The True Lord blesses them with glorious greatness. ||7||

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aap upaaeaa jagat sabaaeaa |
English: He Himself created the whole world.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਰਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jin siriaa tin dhandhai laaeaa |
English: The One who made it, assigns the tasks to it.

Gurbani: ਸਚੈ ਊਪਰਿ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: sachai aoopar avar na deesai saache keemat paaee he |8|
English: I cannot see any other above the True Lord. The True Lord does the appraisal. ||8||

Gurbani: ਐਥੈ ਗੋਇਲੜਾ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aithai goeilarraa din chaare |
English: In this green pasture, the mortal stays only a few days.

Gurbani: ਖੇਲੁ ਤਮਾਸਾ ਧੁੰਧੂਕਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: khel tamaasaa dhundhookaare |
English: He plays and frolics in utter darkness.

Gurbani: ਬਾਜੀ ਖੇਲਿ ਗਏ ਬਾਜੀਗਰ ਜਿਉ ਨਿਸਿ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਭਖਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: baajee khel ge baajeegar jiau nis supanai bhakhalaaee he |9|
English: The jugglers have staged their show, and left, like people mumbling in a dream. ||9||

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਤਖਤਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: tin kau takhat milee vaddiaaee |
English: They alone are blessed with glorious greatness at the Lord's throne,

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: nirbhau man vasiaa liv laaee |
English: who enshrine the fearless Lord in their minds, and lovingly center themselves on Him.

Gurbani: ਖੰਡੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡੀ ਪਾਤਾਲੀ ਪੁਰੀਈ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: khanddee brahamanddee paataalee pureeee tribhavan taarree laaee he |10|
English: In the galaxies and solar systems, nether regions, celestial realms and the three worlds, the Lord is in the primal void of deep absorption. ||10||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੀ ਨਗਰੀ ਤਖਤੁ ਸਚਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: saachee nagaree takhat sachaavaa |
English: True is the village, and true is the throne,

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh saach milai sukh paavaa |
English: of those Gurmukhs who meet with the True Lord, and find peace.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਣਤ ਗਵਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: saache saachai takhat vaddaaee haumai ganat gavaaee he |11|
English: In Truth, seated upon the true throne, they are blessed with glorious greatness; their egotism is eradicated, along with the calculation of their account. ||11||

Gurbani: ਗਣਤ ਗਣੀਐ ਸਹਸਾ ਜੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: ganat ganeeai sahasaa jeeai |
English: Calculating its account, the soul becomes anxious.

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਦੂਐ ਤੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: kiau sukh paavai dooai teeai |
English: How can one find peace, through duality and the three gunas - the three qualities?

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: niramal ek niranjan daataa gur poore te pat paaee he |12|
English: The One Lord is immaculate and formless, the Great Giver; through the Perfect Guru, honor is obtained. ||12||

Gurbani: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਵਿਰਲੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: jug jug viralee guramukh jaataa |
English: In each and every age, very rare are those who, as Gurmukh, realize the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਾ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: saachaa rav rahiaa man raataa |
English: Their minds are imbued with the True, all-pervading Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: tis kee ott gahee sukh paaeaa man tan mail na kaaee he |13|
English: Seeking His Shelter, they find peace, and their minds and bodies are not stained with filth. ||13||

Gurbani: ਜੀਭ ਰਸਾਇਣਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: jeebh rasaaein saachai raatee |
English: Their tongues are imbued with the True Lord, the source of nectar;

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੰਗੀ ਭਉ ਨ ਭਰਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: har prabh sangee bhau na bharaatee |
English: abiding with the Lord God, they have no fear or doubt.

Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰਵਣ ਸ੍ਰੋਤ ਰਜੇ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: sravan srot raje gurabaanee jotee jot milaaee he |14|
English: Hearing the Word of the Guru's Bani, their ears are satisfied, and their light merges into the Light. ||14||

Gurbani: ਰਖਿ ਰਖਿ ਪੈਰ ਧਰੇ ਪਉ ਧਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: rakh rakh pair dhare pau dharanaa |
English: Carefully, carefully, I place my feet upon the ground.

Gurbani: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਦੇਖਉ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: jat kat dekhau teree saranaa |
English: Wherever I go, I behold Your Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਸਿਉ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: dukh sukh dehi toohai man bhaaveh tujh hee siau ban aaee he |15|
English: Whether You grant me pain or pleasure, You are pleasing to my mind. I am in harmony with You. ||15||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਕੋ ਬੇਲੀ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: ant kaal ko belee naahee |
English: No one is anyone's companion or helper at the very last moment;

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh jaataa tudh saalaahee |
English: as Gurmukh, I realize You and praise You.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੩॥
Transliteration: naanak naam rate bairaagee nij ghar taarree laaee he |16|3|
English: O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, I am detached; in the home of my own self deep within, I am absorbed in the primal void of deep meditation. ||16||3||

[Ang 1023 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 |
English: Maaroo, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aad jugaadee apar apaare |
English: From the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages, You are infinite and incomparable.

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਖਸਮ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aad niranjan khasam hamaare |
English: You are my primal, immaculate Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੇ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saache jog jugat veechaaree saache taarree laaee he |1|
English: I contemplate the Way of Yoga, the Way of Union with the True Lord. I am truly absorbed in the primal void of deep meditation. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕੇਤੜਿਆ ਜੁਗ ਧੁੰਧੂਕਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: ketarriaa jug dhundhookaarai |
English: For so many ages, there was only pitch darkness;

Gurbani: ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: taarree laaee sirajanahaarai |
English: the Creator Lord was absorbed in the primal void.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸਾਚੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sach naam sachee vaddiaaee saachai takhat vaddaaee he |2|
English: There was the True Name, the glorious greatness of the Truth, and the glory of His true throne. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਤਜੁਗਿ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: satajug sat santokh sareeraa |
English: In the Golden Age of Truth, Truth and contentment filled the bodies.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sat sat varatai gahir ganbheeraa |
English: Truth was pervasive, Truth, deep, profound and unfathomable.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਪਰਖੈ ਸਾਚੈ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਚਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sachaa saahib sach parakhai saachai hukam chalaaee he |3|
English: The True Lord appraises the mortals on the Touchstone of Truth, and issues His True Command. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਤ ਸੰਤੋਖੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sat santokhee satigur pooraa |
English: The Perfect True Guru is true and contented.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨੇ ਸੋ ਸੂਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa sabad mane so sooraa |
English: He alone is a spiritual hero, who believes in the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਾਚੁ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ਮਾਨੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਰਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: saachee daragah saach nivaasaa maanai hukam rajaaee he |4|
English: He alone obtains a true seat in the True Court of the Lord, who surrenders to the Command of the Commander. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਤਜੁਗਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: satajug saach kahai sabh koee |
English: In the Golden Age of Truth, everyone spoke the Truth.

Gurbani: ਸਚਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: sach varatai saachaa soee |
English: Truth was pervasive - the Lord was Truth.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਭਰਮ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਖਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: man mukh saach bharam bhau bhanjan guramukh saach sakhaaee he |5|
English: With Truth in their minds and mouths, mortals were rid of doubt and fear. Truth was the friend of the Gurmukhs. ||5||

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰੇਤੈ ਧਰਮ ਕਲਾ ਇਕ ਚੂਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: tretai dharam kalaa ik chookee |
English: In the Silver Age of Traytaa Yoga, one power of Dharma was lost.

Gurbani: ਤੀਨਿ ਚਰਣ ਇਕ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਸੂਕੀ ॥
Transliteration: teen charan ik dubidhaa sookee |
English: Three feet remained; through duality, one was cut off.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪਚੈ ਅਵਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: guramukh hovai su saach vakhaanai manamukh pachai avaaee he |6|
English: Those who were Gurmukh spoke the Truth, while the self-willed manmukhs wasted away in vain. ||6||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੀਝੈ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh kade na daragah seejhai |
English: The manmukh never succeeds in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਕਿਉ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਰੀਝੈ ॥
Transliteration: bin sabadai kiau antar reejhai |
