English: Without the Word of the Shabad, how can one be pleased within?

Gurbani: ਬਾਧੇ ਆਵਹਿ ਬਾਧੇ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: baadhe aaveh baadhe jaaveh sojhee boojh na kaaee he |7|
English: In bondage they come, and in bondage they go; they understand and comprehend nothing. ||7||

Gurbani: ਦਇਆ ਦੁਆਪੁਰਿ ਅਧੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: deaa duaapur adhee hoee |
English: In the Brass Age of Dwaapur Yuga, compassion was cut in half.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਚੀਨੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh viralaa cheenai koee |
English: Only a few, as Gurmukh, remembered the Lord.

Gurbani: ਦੁਇ ਪਗ ਧਰਮੁ ਧਰੇ ਧਰਣੀਧਰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਤਿਥਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: due pag dharam dhare dharaneedhar guramukh saach tithaaee he |8|
English: Dharmic faith, which upholds and supports the earth, had only two feet; Truth was revealed to the Gurmukhs. ||8||

Gurbani: ਰਾਜੇ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰਥਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: raaje dharam kareh parathaae |
English: The kings acted righteously only out of self-interest.

Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਬੰਧੇ ਦਾਨੁ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa bandhe daan karaae |
English: Tied to hopes of reward, they gave to charities.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਥਾਕੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: raam naam bin mukat na hoee thaake karam kamaaee he |9|
English: Without the Lord's Name, liberation did not come, although they grew weary of performing rituals. ||9||

Gurbani: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਮੰਗਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: karam dharam kar mukat mangaahee |
English: Practicing religious rituals, they sought liberation,

Gurbani: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: mukat padaarath sabad salaahee |
English: but the treasure of liberation comes only by praising the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਰਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: bin gurasabadai mukat na hoee parapanch kar bharamaaee he |10|
English: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, liberation is not obtained; practicing hypocrisy, they wander around confused. ||10||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਮਤਾ ਛੋਡੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mamataa chhoddee na jaaee |
English: Love and attachment to Maya cannot be abandoned.

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਛੂਟੇ ਸਚੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: se chhootte sach kaar kamaaee |
English: They alone find release, who practice deeds of Truth.

Gurbani: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਤੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: ahinis bhagat rate veechaaree tthaakur siau ban aaee he |11|
English: Day and night, the devotees remain imbued with contemplative meditation; they become just like their Lord and Master. ||11||

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: eik jap tap kar kar teerath naaveh |
English: Some chant and practice intensive meditation, and take cleansing baths at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jiau tudh bhaavai tivai chalaaveh |
English: They walk as You will them to walk.

Gurbani: ਹਠਿ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਅਪਤੀਜੁ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਨਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: hatth nigreh apateej na bheejai bin har gur kin pat paaee he |12|
English: By stubborn rituals of self-suppression, the Lord is not pleased. No one has ever obtained honor, without the Lord, without the Guru. ||12||

Gurbani: ਕਲੀ ਕਾਲ ਮਹਿ ਇਕ ਕਲ ਰਾਖੀ ॥
Transliteration: kalee kaal meh ik kal raakhee |
English: In the Iron Age, the Dark Age of Kali Yuga, only one power remains.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਭਾਖੀ ॥
Transliteration: bin gur poore kinai na bhaakhee |
English: Without the Perfect Guru, no one has even described it.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: manamukh koorr varatai varataaraa bin satigur bharam na jaaee he |13|
English: The self-willed manmukhs have staged the show of falsehood. Without the True Guru, doubt does not depart. ||13||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਸਿਰੰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: satigur veparavaahu sirandaa |
English: The True Guru is the Creator Lord, independent and carefree.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਜਮ ਕਾਣਿ ਨ ਛੰਦਾ ਬੰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: naa jam kaan na chhandaa bandaa |
English: He does not fear death, and He is not dependent on mortal men.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਸੰਤਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: jo tis seve so abinaasee naa tis kaal santaaee he |14|
English: Whoever serves Him becomes immortal and imperishable, and will not be tortured by death. ||14||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਪੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਕਰਤਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur meh aap rakhiaa karataare |
English: The Creator Lord has enshrined Himself within the Guru.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਸੰਖ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh kott asankh udhaare |
English: The Gurmukh saves countless millions.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: sarab jeea jagajeevan daataa nirbhau mail na kaaee he |15|
English: The Life of the World is the Great Giver of all beings. The Fearless Lord has no filth at all. ||15||

Gurbani: ਸਗਲੇ ਜਾਚਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: sagale jaacheh gur bhanddaaree |
English: Everyone begs from the Guru, God's Treasurer.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: aap niranjan alakh apaaree |
English: He Himself is the immaculate, unknowable, infinite Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਚੈ ਮੈ ਦੀਜੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਰਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak saach kahai prabh jaachai mai deejai saach rajaaee he |16|4|
English: Nanak speaks the Truth; he begs from God. Please bless me with the Truth, by Your Will. ||16||4||

[Ang 1024 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 |
English: Maaroo, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: saachai mele sabad milaae |
English: The True Lord unites with those who are united with the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jaa tis bhaanaa sehaj samaae |
English: When it pleases Him, we intuitively merge with Him.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਜੋਤਿ ਧਰੀ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tribhavan jot dharee paramesar avar na doojaa bhaaee he |1|
English: The Light of the Transcendent Lord pervades the three worlds; there is no other at all, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਚਾਕਰ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: jis ke chaakar tis kee sevaa |
English: I am His servant; I serve Him.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਪਤੀਜੈ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabad pateejai alakh abhevaa |
English: He is unknowable and mysterious; He is pleased by the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਾ ਕਾ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ਕਰਤਾ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bhagataa kaa gunakaaree karataa bakhas le vaddiaaee he |2|
English: The Creator is the Benefactor of His devotees. He forgives them - such is His greatness. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦੇਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਸਾਚੇ ॥
Transliteration: dede tott na aavai saache |
English: The True Lord gives and gives; His blessings never run short.

Gurbani: ਲੈ ਲੈ ਮੁਕਰਿ ਪਉਦੇ ਕਾਚੇ ॥
Transliteration: lai lai mukar paude kaache |
English: The false ones receive, and then deny having received.

Gurbani: ਮੂਲੁ ਨ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਨ ਰੀਝਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: mool na boojheh saach na reejheh doojai bharam bhulaaee he |3|
English: They do not understand their origins, they are not pleased with the Truth, and so they wander in duality and doubt. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਗਿ ਰਹੇ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh jaag rahe din raatee |
English: The Gurmukhs remain awake and aware, day and night.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੇ ਕੀ ਲਿਵ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: saache kee liv guramat jaatee |
English: Following the Guru's Teachings, they know the Love of the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸੋਇ ਰਹੇ ਸੇ ਲੂਟੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਬਤੁ ਭਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: manamukh soe rahe se lootte guramukh saabat bhaaee he |4|
English: The self-willed manmukhs remain asleep, and are plundered. The Gurmukhs remain safe and sound, O Siblings of Destiny. ||4||

Gurbani: ਕੂੜੇ ਆਵੈ ਕੂੜੇ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: koorre aavai koorre jaavai |
English: The false come, and the false go;

Gurbani: ਕੂੜੇ ਰਾਤੀ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: koorre raatee koorr kamaavai |
English: imbued with falsehood, they practice only falsehood.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: sabad mile se daragah paidhe guramukh surat samaaee he |5|
English: Those who are imbued with the Shabad are robed in honor in the Court of the Lord; the Gurmukhs focus their consciousness on Him. ||5||

Gurbani: ਕੂੜਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਠਗੀ ਠਗਵਾੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: koorr mutthee tthagee tthagavaarree |
English: The false are cheated, and robbed by the robbers.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਵਾੜੀ ਓਜਾੜਿ ਉਜਾੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: jiau vaarree ojaarr ujaarree |
English: The garden is laid waste, like the rough wilderness.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਦਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਿਐ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: naam binaa kichh saad na laagai har bisariai dukh paaee he |6|
English: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, nothing tastes sweet; forgetting the Lord, they suffer in sorrow. ||6||

Gurbani: ਭੋਜਨੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਆਘਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: bhojan saach milai aaghaaee |
English: Receiving the food of Truth, one is satisfied.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਸਾਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: naam ratan saachee vaddiaaee |
English: True is the glorious greatness of the jewel of the Name.

Gurbani: ਚੀਨੈ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸੋਈ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: cheenai aap pachhaanai soee jotee jot milaaee he |7|
English: One who understands his own self, realizes the Lord. His light merges into the Light. ||7||

Gurbani: ਨਾਵਹੁ ਭੁਲੀ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: naavahu bhulee chottaa khaae |
English: Wandering from the Name, he endures beatings.

Gurbani: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: bahut siaanap bharam na jaae |
English: Even great cleverness does not dispel doubt.

Gurbani: ਪਚਿ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਅਚੇਤ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਅਜਗਰਿ ਭਾਰਿ ਲਦਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: pach pach mue achet na cheteh ajagar bhaar ladaaee he |8|
English: The unconscious fool does not remain conscious of the Lord; he putrifies and rots away to death, carrying his heavy load of sin. ||8||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਬਾਦ ਬਿਰੋਧਹਿ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: bin baad birodheh koee naahee |
English: No one is free of conflict and strife.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਦੇਖਾਲਿਹੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: mai dekhaalihu tis saalaahee |
English: Show me anyone who is, and I will praise him.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: man tan arap milai jagajeevan har siau banat banaaee he |9|
English: Dedicating mind and body to God, one meets the Lord, the Life of the World, and becomes just like Him. ||9||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: prabh kee gat mit koe na paavai |
English: No one knows the state and extent of God.

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਵਡਾ ਕਹਾਇ ਵਡਾਈ ਖਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: je ko vaddaa kahaae vaddaaee khaavai |
English: Whoever calls himself great, will be eaten by his greatness.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਦਾਤੀ ਸਗਲੀ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: saache saahib tott na daatee sagalee tineh upaaee he |10|
English: There is no lack of gifts of our True Lord and Master. He created all. ||10||

Gurbani: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: vaddee vaddiaaee veparavaahe |
English: Great is the glorious greatness of the independent Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਦਾਨੁ ਸਮਾਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: aap upaae daan samaahe |
English: He Himself created, and gives sustanance to all.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਦਾਤਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਰਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: aap deaal door nahee daataa miliaa sehaj rajaaee he |11|
English: The Merciful Lord is not far away; the Great Giver spontaneously unites with Himself, by His Will. ||11||

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਸੋਗੀ ਇਕਿ ਰੋਗਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: eik sogee ik rog viaape |
English: Some are sad, and some are afflicted with disease.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: jo kichh kare su aape aape |
English: Whatever God does, He does by Himself.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਉ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਅਨਹਦਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਖਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: bhagat bhaau gur kee mat pooree anahad sabad lakhaaee he |12|
English: Through loving devotion, and the Perfect Teachings of the Guru, the unstruck sound current of the Shabad is realized. ||12||

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਨਾਗੇ ਭੂਖੇ ਭਵਹਿ ਭਵਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: eik naage bhookhe bhaveh bhavaae |
English: Some wander and roam around, hungry and naked.

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਹਠੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਨ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: eik hatth kar mareh na keemat paae |
English: Some act in stubbornness and die, but do not know the value of God.

Gurbani: ਗਤਿ ਅਵਿਗਤ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: gat avigat kee saar na jaanai boojhai sabad kamaaee he |13|
English: They do not know the difference between good and bad; this is understood only through the practice of the Word of the Shabad. ||13||

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵਹਿ ਅੰਨੁ ਨ ਖਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: eik teerath naaveh an na khaaveh |
English: Some bathe at sacred shrines and refuse to eat.

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਲਾਵਹਿ ਦੇਹ ਖਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: eik agan jalaaveh deh khapaaveh |
English: Some torment their bodies in burning fire.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: raam naam bin mukat na hoee kit bidh paar langhaaee he |14|
English: Without the Lord's Name, liberation is not obtained; how can anyone cross over? ||14||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਛੋਡਹਿ ਉਝੜਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramat chhoddeh ujharr jaaee |
English: Abandoning the Guru's Teachings, some wander in the wilderness.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਪੈ ਅਵਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh raam na japai avaaee |
English: The self-willed manmukhs are destitute; they do not meditate on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਪਚਿ ਪਚਿ ਬੂਡਹਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਕੂੜਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਬੈਰਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: pach pach booddeh koorr kamaaveh koorr kaal bairaaee he |15|
English: They are ruined, destroyed and drowned from practicing falsehood; death is the enemy of the false. ||15||

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਆਵੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: hukame aavai hukame jaavai |
English: By the Hukam of the Lord's Command, they come, and by the Hukam of His Command, they go.

Gurbani: ਬੂਝੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸੋ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: boojhai hukam so saach samaavai |
English: One who realizes His Hukam, merges in the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak saach milai man bhaavai guramukh kaar kamaaee he |16|5|
English: O Nanak, he merges in the True Lord, and his mind is pleased with the Lord. The Gurmukhs do His work. ||16||5||

[Ang 1025 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 |
English: Maaroo, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape karataa purakh bidhaataa |
English: He Himself is the Creator Lord, the Architect of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: jin aape aap upaae pachhaataa |
English: He evaluates those whom He Himself has created.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aape satigur aape sevak aape srisatt upaaee he |1|
English: He Himself is the True Guru, and He Himself is the servant; He Himself created the Universe. ||1||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਨੇੜੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aape nerrai naahee doore |
English: He is near at hand, not far away.

Gurbani: ਬੂਝਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: boojheh guramukh se jan poore |
English: The Gurmukhs understand Him; perfect are those humble beings.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਏਹ ਵਡਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tin kee sangat ahinis laahaa gur sangat eeh vaddaaee he |2|
English: Associating with them night and day is profitable. This is the glorious greatness of associating with the Guru. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਸੰਤ ਭਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jug jug sant bhale prabh tere |
English: Throughout the ages, Your Saints are holy and sublime, O God.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har gun gaaveh rasan rasere |
English: They sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, savoring it with their tongues.

Gurbani: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਦਾਲਦੁ ਜਿਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਚਿੰਤ ਪਰਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ausatat kareh parahar dukh daalad jin naahee chint paraaee he |3|
English: They chant His Praises, and their pain and poverty are taken away; they are not afraid of anyone else. ||3||

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਜਾਗਤ ਰਹਹਿ ਨ ਸੂਤੇ ਦੀਸਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: oe jaagat raheh na soote deeseh |
English: They remain awake and aware, and do not appear to sleep.

Gurbani: ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਰੀਸਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: sangat kul taare saach pareeseh |
English: They serve up Truth, and so save their companions and relatives.

Gurbani: ਕਲਿਮਲ ਮੈਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਓਇ ਰਹਹਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: kalimal mail naahee te niramal oe raheh bhagat liv laaee he |4|
English: They are not stained with the filth of sins; they are immaculate and pure, and remain absorbed in loving devotional worship. ||4||

Gurbani: ਬੂਝਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: boojhahu har jan satigur baanee |
English: O humble servants of the Lord, understand the Word of the Guru's Bani.

Gurbani: ਏਹੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਸਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਦੇਹ ਪੁਰਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: ehu joban saas hai deh puraanee |
English: This youth, breath and body shall pass away.

Gurbani: ਆਜੁ ਕਾਲਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਧਿਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: aaj kaal mar jaaeeai praanee har jap jap ridai dhiaaee he |5|
English: O mortal, you shall die today or tomorrow; chant, and meditate on the Lord within your heart. ||5||

Gurbani: ਛੋਡਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਕੂੜ ਕਬਾੜਾ ॥
Transliteration: chhoddahu praanee koorr kabaarraa |
English: O mortal, abandon falsehood and your worthless ways.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਕਾਲੁ ਉਛਾਹਾੜਾ ॥
Transliteration: koorr maare kaal uchhaahaarraa |
English: Death viciously kills the false beings.

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤ ਕੂੜਿ ਪਚਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਹੁ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਚੈ ਪਚਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: saakat koorr pacheh man haumai duhu maarag pachai pachaaee he |6|
English: The faithless cynic is ruined through falsehood and his egotistical mind.On the path of duality, he rots away and decomposes. ||6||

Gurbani: ਛੋਡਿਹੁ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਤਾਤਿ ਪਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: chhoddihu nindaa taat paraaee |
English: Abandon slander and envy of others.

Gurbani: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਦਝਹਿ ਸਾਤਿ ਨ ਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: parr parr dajheh saat na aaee |
English: Reading and studying, they burn, and do not find tranquility.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਹੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: mil satasangat naam salaahahu aatam raam sakhaaee he |7|
English: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord. The Lord, the Supreme Soul, shall be your helper and companion. ||7||

Gurbani: ਛੋਡਹੁ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਬੁਰਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: chhoddahu kaam krodh buriaaee |
English: Abandon sexual desire, anger and wickedness.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਧੰਧੁ ਛੋਡਹੁ ਲੰਪਟਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: haumai dhandh chhoddahu lanpattaaee |
English: Abandon your involvement in egotistical affairs and conflicts.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰਹੁ ਤਾ ਉਬਰਹੁ ਇਉ ਤਰੀਐ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਭਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: satigur saran parahu taa ubarahu iau tareeai bhavajal bhaaee he |8|
English: If you seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru, then you shall be saved. In this way you shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean, O Siblings of Destiny. ||8||

Gurbani: ਆਗੈ ਬਿਮਲ ਨਦੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਝੇਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: aagai bimal nadee agan bikh jhelaa |
English: In the hereafter, you shall have to cross over the fiery river of poisonous flames.

Gurbani: ਤਿਥੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਜੀਉ ਇਕੇਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: tithai avar na koee jeeo ikelaa |
English: No one else will be there; your soul shall be all alone.

Gurbani: ਭੜ ਭੜ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਦੇ ਲਹਰੀ ਪੜਿ ਦਝਹਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਤਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: bharr bharr agan saagar de laharee parr dajheh manamukh taaee he |9|
English: The ocean of fire spits out waves of searing flames; the self-willed manmukhs fall into it, and are roasted there. ||9||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇ ਭਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur peh mukat daan de bhaanai |
English: Liberation comes from the Guru; He grants this blessing by the Pleasure of His Will.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋਈ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: jin paaeaa soee bidh jaanai |
English: He alone knows the way, who obtains it.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: jin paaeaa tin poochhahu bhaaee sukh satigur sev kamaaee he |10|
English: So ask one who has obtained it, O Siblings of Destiny. Serve the True Guru, and find peace. ||10||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਉਰਝਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਬੇਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur bin urajh mareh bekaaraa |
English: Without the Guru, he dies entangled in sin and corruption.

Gurbani: ਜਮੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jam sir maare kare khuaaraa |
English: The Messenger of Death smashes his head and humiliates him.

Gurbani: ਬਾਧੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਰ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਡੂਬਹਿ ਨਿੰਦ ਪਰਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: baadhe mukat naahee nar nindak ddoobeh nind paraaee he |11|
English: The slanderous person is not freed of his bonds; he is drowned, slandering others. ||11||

Gurbani: ਬੋਲਹੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਹੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: bolahu saach pachhaanahu andar |
English: So speak the Truth, and realize the Lord deep within.

Gurbani: ਦੂਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਨੰਦਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: door naahee dekhahu kar nandar |
English: He is not far away; look, and see Him.

Gurbani: ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੀ ਇਉ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: bighan naahee guramukh tar taaree iau bhavajal paar langhaaee he |12|
English: No obstacles shall block your way; become Gurmukh, and cross over to the other side. This is the way to cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||12||

Gurbani: ਦੇਹੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: dehee andar naam nivaasee |
English: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within the body.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਹੈ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: aape karataa hai abinaasee |
English: The Creator Lord is eternal and imperishable.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਜੀਉ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਜਾਈ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: naa jeeo marai na maariaa jaaee kar dekhai sabad rajaaee he |13|
English: The soul does not die, and it cannot be killed; God creates and watches over all. Through the Word of the Shabad, His Will is manifest. ||13||

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: ohu niramal hai naahee andhiaaraa |
English: He is immaculate, and has no darkness.

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਤਖਤਿ ਬਹੈ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: ohu aape takhat bahai sachiaaraa |
English: The True Lord Himself sits upon His throne.

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤ ਕੂੜੇ ਬੰਧਿ ਭਵਾਈਅਹਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਆਈ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: saakat koorre bandh bhavaaeeeh mar janameh aaee jaaee he |14|
English: The faithless cynics are bound and gagged, and forced to wander in reincarnation. They die, and are reborn, and continue coming and going. ||14||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur ke sevak satigur piaare |
English: The Guru's servants are the Beloveds of the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਬੈਸਹਿ ਤਖਤਿ ਸੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: oe baiseh takhat su sabad veechaare |
English: Contemplating the Shabad, they sit upon His throne.

Gurbani: ਤਤੁ ਲਹਹਿ ਅੰਤਰਗਤਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: tat laheh antaragat jaaneh satasangat saach vaddaaee he |15|
English: They realize the essence of reality, and know the state of their inner being. This is the true glorious greatness of those who join the Sat Sangat. ||15||

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਜਨੁ ਪਿਤਰਾ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aap tarai jan pitaraa taare |
English: He Himself saves His humble servant, and saves his ancestors as well.

Gurbani: ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਸੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sangat mukat su paar utaare |
English: His companions are liberated; He carries them across.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਲਾਲਾ ਗੋਲਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੬॥
Transliteration: naanak tis kaa laalaa golaa jin guramukh har liv laaee he |16|6|
English: Nanak is the servant and slave of that Gurmukh who lovingly focuses his consciousness on the Lord. ||16||6||

[Ang 1026 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 |
English: Maaroo, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕੇਤੇ ਜੁਗ ਵਰਤੇ ਗੁਬਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: kete jug varate gubaarai |
English: For many ages, only darkness prevailed;

Gurbani: ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: taarree laaee apar apaarai |
English: the infinite, endless Lord was absorbed in the primal void.

Gurbani: ਧੁੰਧੂਕਾਰਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਬੈਠਾ ਨਾ ਤਦਿ ਧੰਧੁ ਪਸਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: dhundhookaar niraalam baitthaa naa tad dhandh pasaaraa he |1|
English: He sat alone and unaffected in absolute darkness; the world of conflict did not exist. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੁਗ ਛਤੀਹ ਤਿਨੈ ਵਰਤਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jug chhateeh tinai varataae |
English: Thirty-six ages passed like this.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jiau tis bhaanaa tivai chalaae |
English: He causes all to happen by the Pleasure of His Will.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਸਰੀਕੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਕੋਈ ਆਪੇ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tiseh sareek na deesai koee aape apar apaaraa he |2|
English: No rival of His can be seen. He Himself is infinite and endless. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਪਤੇ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਜੁਗ ਚਤੁਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gupate boojhahu jug chatuaare |
English: God is hidden throughout the four ages - understand this well.

Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਉਦਰ ਮਝਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt varatai udar majhaare |
English: He pervades each and every heart, and is contained within the belly.

Gurbani: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕਾ ਏਕੀ ਵਰਤੈ ਕੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jug jug ekaa ekee varatai koee boojhai gur veechaaraa he |3|
English: The One and Only Lord prevails throughout the ages. How rare are those who contemplate the Guru, and understand this. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬਿੰਦੁ ਰਕਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਰੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: bind rakat mil pindd sareea |
English: From the union of the sperm and the egg, the body was formed.

Gurbani: ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਅਗਨੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: paun paanee aganee mil jeea |
English: From the union of air, water and fire, the living being is made.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਚੋਜ ਕਰੇ ਰੰਗ ਮਹਲੀ ਹੋਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਸਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: aape choj kare rang mahalee hor maaeaa moh pasaaraa he |4|
English: He Himself plays joyfully in the mansion of the body; all the rest is just attachment to Maya's expanse. ||4||

Gurbani: ਗਰਭ ਕੁੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ ਉਰਧ ਧਿਆਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: garabh kunddal meh uradh dhiaanee |
English: Within the mother's womb, upside-down, the mortal meditated on God.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: aape jaanai antarajaamee |
English: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, knows everything.

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਉਦਰ ਮਝਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: saas saas sach naam samaale antar udar majhaaraa he |5|
English: With each and every breath, he contemplated the True Name, deep within himself, within the womb. ||5||

Gurbani: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਲੈ ਜਗਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: chaar padaarath lai jag aaeaa |
English: He came into the world to obtain the four great blessings.

Gurbani: ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: siv sakatee ghar vaasaa paaeaa |
English: He came to dwell in the home of the Shiva and Shakti, energy and matter.

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੇ ਤਾ ਪਿੜ ਹਾਰੇ ਅੰਧੁਲੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: ek visaare taa pirr haare andhulai naam visaaraa he |6|
English: But he forgot the One Lord, and he has lost the game. The blind person forgets the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||6||

Gurbani: ਬਾਲਕੁ ਮਰੈ ਬਾਲਕ ਕੀ ਲੀਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: baalak marai baalak kee leelaa |
English: The child dies in his childish games.

Gurbani: ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਬਾਲੁ ਰੰਗੀਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: keh keh roveh baal rangeelaa |
English: They cry and mourn, saying that he was such a playful child.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ ਸੋ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਲੀਆ ਭੂਲਾ ਰੋਵਣਹਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: jis kaa saa so tin hee leea bhoolaa rovanahaaraa he |7|
English: The Lord who owns him has taken him back. Those who weep and mourn are mistaken. ||7||

Gurbani: ਭਰਿ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਕਿ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: bhar joban mar jaeh ki keejai |
English: What can they do, if he dies in his youth?

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਰੋਵੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: meraa meraa kar roveejai |
English: They cry out, "His is mine, he is mine!"

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਰੋਇ ਵਿਗੂਚਹਿ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: maaeaa kaaran roe vigoocheh dhrig jeevan sansaaraa he |8|
English: They cry for the sake of Maya, and are ruined; their lives in this world are cursed. ||8||

Gurbani: ਕਾਲੀ ਹੂ ਫੁਨਿ ਧਉਲੇ ਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: kaalee hoo fun dhaule aae |
English: Their black hair eventually turns grey.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਗਥੁ ਗਇਆ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: vin naavai gath geaa gavaae |
English: Without the Name, they lose their wealth, and then leave.

Gurbani: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਅੰਧੁਲਾ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ ਮੂਠੇ ਰੋਇ ਪੂਕਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: duramat andhulaa binas binaasai mootthe roe pookaaraa he |9|
English: They are evil-minded and blind - they are totally ruined; they are plundered, and cry out in pain. ||9||

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਨ ਰੋਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aap veechaar na rovai koee |
English: One who understands himself, does not cry.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur milai ta sojhee hoee |
English: When he meets the True Guru, then he understands.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਨ ਖੂਲਹਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: bin gur bajar kapaatt na khooleh sabad milai nisataaraa he |10|
English: Without the Guru, the heavy, hard doors are not opened. Obtaining the Word of the Shabad, one is emancipated. ||10||

Gurbani: ਬਿਰਧਿ ਭਇਆ ਤਨੁ ਛੀਜੈ ਦੇਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: biradh bheaa tan chheejai dehee |
English: The body grows old, and is beaten out of shape.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਪਈ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਨੇਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: raam na japee ant sanehee |
English: But he does not meditate on the Lord, His only friend, even at the end.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਚਲੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਕਾਲੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਝੂਠੁ ਖੁਆਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: naam visaar chalai muhi kaalai daragah jhootth khuaaraa he |11|
English: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he departs with his face blackened. The false are humiliated in the Court of the Lord. ||11||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਚਲੈ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: naam visaar chalai koorriaaro |
English: Forgetting the Naam, the false ones depart.

Gurbani: ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਪੜੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: aavat jaat parrai sir chhaaro |
English: Coming and going, dust falls on their heads.

Gurbani: ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: saahurarrai ghar vaas na paae peeearrai sir maaraa he |12|
English: The soul-bride finds no home in her in-laws' home, the world hereafter; she suffers in agony in this world of her parents' home. ||12||

Gurbani: ਖਾਜੈ ਪੈਝੈ ਰਲੀ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: khaajai paijhai ralee kareejai |
English: She eats, dresses and plays joyfully,

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਅਭ ਭਗਤੀ ਬਾਦਿ ਮਰੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: bin abh bhagatee baad mareejai |
English: but without loving devotional worship of the Lord, she dies uselessly.

Gurbani: ਸਰ ਅਪਸਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਚਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: sar apasar kee saar na jaanai jam maare kiaa chaaraa he |13|
English: One who does not distinguish between good and evil, is beaten by the Messenger of Death; how can anyone escape this? ||13||

Gurbani: ਪਰਵਿਰਤੀ ਨਰਵਿਰਤਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: paraviratee naravirat pachhaanai |
English: One who realizes what he has to possess, and what he has to abandon,

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਘਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sang sabad ghar jaanai |
English: associating with the Guru, comes to know the Word of the Shabad, within the home of his own self.

Gurbani: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਮੰਦਾ ਆਖਿ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਸਚਿ ਖਰਾ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: kis hee mandaa aakh na chalai sach kharaa sachiaaraa he |14|
English: Do not call anyone else bad; follow this way of life. Those who are true are judged to be genuine by the True Lord. ||14||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚ ਬਿਨਾ ਦਰਿ ਸਿਝੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: saach binaa dar sijhai na koee |
English: Without Truth, no one succeeds in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਪੈਝੈ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: saach sabad paijhai pat hoee |
English: Through the True Shabad, one is robed in honor.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: aape bakhas le tis bhaavai haumai garab nivaaraa he |15|
English: He forgives those with whom He is pleased; they silence their egotism and pride. ||15||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur kirapaa te hukam pachhaanai |
English: One who realizes the Hukam of God's Command, by the Grace of the Guru,

Gurbani: ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: jugah jugantar kee bidh jaanai |
English: comes to know the lifestyle of the ages.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੀ ਸਚੁ ਤਾਰੇ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੭॥
Transliteration: naanak naam japahu tar taaree sach taare taaranahaaraa he |16|1|7|
English: O Nanak, chant the Naam, and cross over to the other side. The True Lord will carry you across. ||16||1||7||

[Ang 1027 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 |
English: Maaroo, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: har saa meet naahee mai koee |
English: I have no other friend like the Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jin tan man deea surat samoee |
English: He gave me body and mind, and infused consciousness into my being.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਿ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਸੋ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਦਾਨਾ ਬੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sarab jeea pratipaal samaale so antar daanaa beenaa he |1|
English: He cherishes and cares for all beings; He is deep within, the wise, all-knowing Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਹਮ ਹੰਸ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur saravar ham hans piaare |
English: The Guru is the sacred pool, and I am His beloved swan.

Gurbani: ਸਾਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਰਤਨ ਲਾਲ ਬਹੁ ਸਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: saagar meh ratan laal bahu saare |
English: In the ocean, there are so many jewels and rubies.

Gurbani: ਮੋਤੀ ਮਾਣਕ ਹੀਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਤ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਭੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: motee maanak heeraa har jas gaavat man tan bheenaa he |2|
English: The Lord's Praises are pearls, gems and diamonds. Singing His Praises, my mind and body are drenched with His Love. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਹੁ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: har agam agaahu agaadh niraalaa |
English: The Lord is inaccessible, inscrutable, unfathomable and unattached.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: har ant na paaeeai gur gopaalaa |
English: The Lord's limits cannot be found; the Guru is the Lord of the World.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਤਿ ਤਾਰੇ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਰੰਗਿ ਲੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: satigur mat taare taaranahaaraa mel le rang leenaa he |3|
English: Through the Teachings of the True Guru, the Lord carries us across to the other side. He unites in His Union those who are colored by His Love. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਿਨੇਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: satigur baajhahu mukat kinehee |
English: Without the True Guru, how can anyone be liberated?

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਰਾਮ ਸਨੇਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: ohu aad jugaadee raam sanehee |
English: He has been the Friend of the Lord, from the very beginning of time, and all throughout the ages.

Gurbani: ਦਰਗਹ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਬਖਸੇ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਕੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: daragah mukat kare kar kirapaa bakhase avagun keenaa he |4|
English: By His Grace, He grants liberation in His Court; He forgives them for their sins. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: satigur daataa mukat karaae |
English: The True Guru, the Giver, grants liberation;

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਰੋਗ ਗਵਾਏ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sabh rog gavaae amrit ras paae |
English: all diseases are eradicated, and one is blessed with the Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਜਮੁ ਜਾਗਾਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਰੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਠਰੁ ਸੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: jam jaagaat naahee kar laagai jis agan bujhee tthar seenaa he |5|
English: Death, the tax collector, does not impose any tax on one whose inner fire has been put out, whose heart is cool and tranquil. ||5||

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਹੰਸ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa hans preet bahu dhaaree |
English: The body has developed a great love for the soul-swan.

Gurbani: ਓਹੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਓਹ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: ohu jogee purakh oeh sundar naaree |
English: He is a Yogi, and she is a beautiful woman.

Gurbani: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭੋਗੈ ਚੋਜ ਬਿਨੋਦੀ ਉਠਿ ਚਲਤੈ ਮਤਾ ਨ ਕੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: ahinis bhogai choj binodee utth chalatai mataa na keenaa he |6|
English: Day and night, he enjoys her with delight, and then he arises and departs without consulting her. ||6||

Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਰਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਛਾਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: srisatt upaae rahe prabh chhaajai |
English: Creating the Universe, God remains diffused throughout it.

Gurbani: ਪਉਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਗਾਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: paun paanee baisantar gaajai |
English: In the wind, water and fire, He vibrates and resounds.

Gurbani: ਮਨੂਆ ਡੋਲੈ ਦੂਤ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: manooaa ddolai doot sangat mil so paae jo kichh keenaa he |7|
English: The mind wavers, keeping company with evil passions; one obtains the rewards of his own actions. ||7||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਦੋਖ ਦੁਖ ਸਹੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: naam visaar dokh dukh saheeai |
English: Forgetting the Naam, one suffers the misery of his evil ways.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਭਇਆ ਚਲਣਾ ਕਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: hukam bheaa chalanaa kiau raheeai |
English: When the order to depart is issued, how can he remain here?

Gurbani: ਨਰਕ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਿ ਗੋਤੇ ਖਾਵੈ ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਮੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: narak koop meh gote khaavai jiau jal te baahar meenaa he |8|
English: He falls into the pit of hell, and suffers like a fish out of water. ||8||

Gurbani: ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਨਰਕ ਸਾਕਤੁ ਭੋਗਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: chauraaseeh narak saakat bhogaaeeai |
English: The faithless cynic has to endure 8.4 million hellish incarnations.

Gurbani: ਜੈਸਾ ਕੀਚੈ ਤੈਸੋ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: jaisaa keechai taiso paaeeai |
English: As he acts, so does he suffer.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਬਾਧਾ ਗ੍ਰਸਿ ਦੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: satigur baajhahu mukat na hoee kirat baadhaa gras deenaa he |9|
English: Without the True Guru, there is no liberation. Bound and gagged by his own actions, he is helpless. ||9||

Gurbani: ਖੰਡੇ ਧਾਰ ਗਲੀ ਅਤਿ ਭੀੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: khandde dhaar galee at bheerree |
English: This path is very narrow, like the sharp edge of a sword.

Gurbani: ਲੇਖਾ ਲੀਜੈ ਤਿਲ ਜਿਉ ਪੀੜੀ ॥
Transliteration: lekhaa leejai til jiau peerree |
English: When his account is read, he shall be crushed like the sesame seed in the mill.

Gurbani: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਤ ਬੇਲੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਕੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: maat pitaa kalatr sut belee naahee bin har ras mukat na keenaa he |10|
English: Mother, father, spouse and child - none is anyone's friend in the end. Without the Lord's Love, no one is liberated. ||10||

Gurbani: ਮੀਤ ਸਖੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਜਗ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: meet sakhe kete jag maahee |
English: You may have many friends and companions in the world,

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: bin gur paramesar koee naahee |
English: but without the Guru, the Transcendent Lord Incarnate, there is no one at all.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਰਾਇਣਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: gur kee sevaa mukat paraaein anadin keeratan keenaa he |11|
English: Service to the Guru is the way to liberation. Night and day, sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||11||

Gurbani: ਕੂੜੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਕਉ ਧਾਵਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: koorr chhodd saache kau dhaavahu |
English: Abandon falsehood, and pursue the Truth,

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਇਛਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: jo ichhahu soee fal paavahu |
English: and you shall obtain the fruits of your desires.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚ ਵਖਰ ਕੇ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ਸਉਦਾ ਕੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: saach vakhar ke vaapaaree virale lai laahaa saudaa keenaa he |12|
English: Very few are those who trade in the merchandise of Truth. Those who deal in it, obtain the true profit. ||12||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਲੈ ਚਲਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam vakhar lai chalahu |
English: Depart with the merchandise of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har,

Gurbani: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਹਲਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: darasan paavahu sehaj mahalahu |
English: and you shall intuitively obtain the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, in the Mansion of His Presence.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹਹਿ ਜਨ ਪੂਰੇ ਇਉ ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਚੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: guramukh khoj laheh jan poore iau samadarasee cheenaa he |13|
English: The Gurmukhs search for Him and find Him; they are the perfect humble beings. In this way, they see Him, who looks upon all alike. ||13||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਕੋ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: prabh beant guramat ko paaveh |
English: God is endless; following the Guru's Teachings, some find Him.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਸਮਝਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad man kau samajhaaveh |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they instruct their minds.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਹੁ ਇਉ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੈ ਲੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: satigur kee baanee sat sat kar maanahu iau aatam raamai leenaa he |14|
English: Accept as True, Perfectly True, the Word of the True Guru's Bani. In this way, you shall merge in the Lord, the Supreme Soul. ||14||

Gurbani: ਨਾਰਦ ਸਾਰਦ ਸੇਵਕ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: naarad saarad sevak tere |
English: Naarad and Saraswati are Your servants.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਵਡਹੁ ਵਡੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: tribhavan sevak vaddahu vaddere |
English: Your servants are the greatest of the great, throughout the three worlds.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਤੂ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: sabh teree kudarat too sir sir daataa sabh tero kaaran keenaa he |15|
English: Your creative power permeates all; You are the Great Giver of all. You created the whole creation. ||15||

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਦਰਿ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਦਰਦੁ ਵਞਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: eik dar seveh darad vayaae |
English: Some serve at Your Door, and their sufferings are dispelled.

Gurbani: ਓਇ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਛਡਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: oe daragah paidhe satiguroo chhaddaae |
English: They are robed with honor in the Court of the Lord, and emancipated by the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਬੰਧਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਤੋੜੇ ਚਿਤੁ ਚੰਚਲੁ ਚਲਣਿ ਨ ਦੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: haumai bandhan satigur torre chit chanchal chalan na deenaa he |16|
English: The True Guru breaks the bonds of egotism, and restrains the fickle consciousness. ||16||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਚੀਨਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur milahu cheenahu bidh saaee |
English: Meet the True Guru, and search for the way,

Gurbani: ਜਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jit prabh paavahu ganat na kaaee |
English: by which you may find God, and not have to answer for your account.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਭੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੭॥੨॥੮॥
Transliteration: haumai maar karahu gur sevaa jan naanak har rang bheenaa he |17|2|8|
English: Subdue your egotism, and serve the Guru; O servant Nanak, you shall be drenched with the Lord's Love. ||17||2||8||

[Ang 1028 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 |
English: Maaroo, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਸੁਰ ਸਘਾਰਣ ਰਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: asur saghaaran raam hamaaraa |
English: My Lord is the Destroyer of demons.

Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਮਈਆ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt rameea raam piaaraa |
English: My Beloved Lord is pervading each and every heart.

Gurbani: ਨਾਲੇ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਮੂਲੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਿਖੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naale alakh na lakheeai moole guramukh likh veechaaraa he |1|
English: The unseen Lord is always with us, but He is not seen at all. The Gurmukh contemplates the record. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh saadhoo saran tumaaree |
English: The Holy Gurmukh seeks Your Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh paar utaaree |
English: God grants His Grace, and carries him across to the other side.

Gurbani: ਅਗਨਿ ਪਾਣੀ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਅਤਿ ਗਹਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: agan paanee saagar at gaharaa gur satigur paar utaaraa he |2|
English: The ocean is very deep, filled with fiery water; the Guru, the True Guru, carries us across to the other side. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh andhule sojhee naahee |
English: The blind, self-willed manmukh does not understand.

Gurbani: ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: aaveh jaeh mareh mar jaahee |
English: He comes and goes in reincarnation, dying, and dying again.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਮਿਟਈ ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਅੰਧੁ ਖੁਆਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: poorab likhiaa lekh na mittee jam dar andh khuaaraa he |3|
English: The primal inscription of destiny cannot be erased. The spiritually blind suffer terribly at Death's door. ||3||

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: eik aaveh jaaveh ghar vaas na paaveh |
English: Some come and go, and do not find a home in their own heart.

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਤ ਕੇ ਬਾਧੇ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: kirat ke baadhe paap kamaaveh |
English: Bound by their past actions, they commit sins.

Gurbani: ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਲੋਭੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: andhule sojhee boojh na kaaee lobh buraa ahankaaraa he |4|
English: The blind ones have no understanding, no wisdom; they are trapped and ruined by greed and egotism. ||4||

Gurbani: ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਧਨ ਸੀਗਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: pir bin kiaa tis dhan seegaaraa |
English: Without her Husband Lord, what good are the soul-bride's decorations?

Gurbani: ਪਰ ਪਿਰ ਰਾਤੀ ਖਸਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: par pir raatee khasam visaaraa |
English: She has forgotten her Lord and Master, and is infatuated with another's husband.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਬੇਸੁਆ ਪੂਤ ਬਾਪੁ ਕੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਤਿਉ ਫੋਕਟ ਕਾਰ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: jiau besuaa poot baap ko kaheeai tiau fokatt kaar vikaaraa he |5|
English: Just as no one knows who is the father of the prostitute's son, such are the worthless, useless deeds that are done. ||5||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਪਿੰਜਰ ਮਹਿ ਦੂਖ ਘਨੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: pret pinjar meh dookh ghanere |
English: The ghost, in the body-cage, suffers all sorts of afflictions.

Gurbani: ਨਰਕਿ ਪਚਹਿ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: narak pacheh agiaan andhere |
English: Those who are blind to spiritual wisdom, putrefy in hell.

Gurbani: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੀ ਬਾਕੀ ਲੀਜੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: dharam raae kee baakee leejai jin har kaa naam visaaraa he |6|
English: The Righteous Judge of Dharma collects the balance due on the account, of those who forget the Name of the Lord. ||6||

Gurbani: ਸੂਰਜੁ ਤਪੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਝਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: sooraj tapai agan bikh jhaalaa |
English: The scorching sun blazes with flames of poison.

Gurbani: ਅਪਤੁ ਪਸੂ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਬੇਤਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: apat pasoo manamukh betaalaa |
English: The self-willed manmukh is dishonored, a beast, a demon.

Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਰੋਗੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਬੁਰਿਆਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: aasaa manasaa koorr kamaaveh rog buraa buriaaraa he |7|
English: Trapped by hope and desire, he practices falsehood, and is afflicted by the terrible disease of corruption. ||7||

Gurbani: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਰੁ ਕਲਰ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: masatak bhaar kalar sir bhaaraa |
English: He carries the heavy load of sins on his forehead and head.

Gurbani: ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਲੰਘਸਿ ਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kiau kar bhavajal langhas paaraa |
English: How can he cross the terrifying world-ocean?

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: satigur bohith aad jugaadee raam naam nisataaraa he |8|
English: From the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages, the True Guru has been the boat; through the Lord's Name, He carries us across. ||8||

Gurbani: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਜਗਿ ਹੇਤੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: putr kalatr jag het piaaraa |
English: The love of one's children and spouse is so sweet in this world.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohu pasariaa paasaaraa |
English: The expansive expanse of the Universe is attachment to Maya.

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਕੇ ਫਾਹੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਤੋੜੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: jam ke faahe satigur torre guramukh tat beechaaraa he |9|
English: The True Guru snaps the noose of Death, for that Gurmukh who contemplates the essence of reality. ||9||

Gurbani: ਕੂੜਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਚਾਲੈ ਬਹੁ ਰਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: koorr mutthee chaalai bahu raahee |
English: Cheated by falsehood, the self-willed manmukh walks along many paths;

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਦਾਝੈ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਭਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh daajhai parr parr bhaahee |
English: he may be highly educated, but he burns in the fire.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਵਡ ਦਾਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: amrit naam guroo vadd daanaa naam japahu sukh saaraa he |10|
English: The Guru is the Great Giver of the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord. Chanting the Naam, sublime peace is obtained. ||10||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਸਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: satigur tutthaa sach drirraae |
English: The True Guru, in His Mercy, implants Truth within.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖ ਮੇਟੇ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sabh dukh mette maarag paae |
English: All suffering is eradicated, and one is placed on the Path.

Gurbani: ਕੰਡਾ ਪਾਇ ਨ ਗਡਈ ਮੂਲੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਰਾਖਣਹਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: kanddaa paae na gaddee moole jis satigur raakhanahaaraa he |11|
English: Not even a thorn ever pierces the foot of one who has the True Guru as his Protector. ||11||

Gurbani: ਖੇਹੂ ਖੇਹ ਰਲੈ ਤਨੁ ਛੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: khehoo kheh ralai tan chheejai |
English: Dust mixes with dust, when the body wastes away.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਪਾਥਰੁ ਸੈਲੁ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh paathar sail na bheejai |
English: The self-willed manmukh is like a stone slab, which is impervious to water.

Gurbani: ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਵ ਕਰੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਨਰਕਿ ਸੁਰਗਿ ਅਵਤਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: karan palaav kare bahutere narak surag avataaraa he |12|
English: He cries out and weeps and wails; he is reincarnated into heaven and then hell. ||12||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਭੁਇਅੰਗਮ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa bikh bhueiangam naale |
English: They live with the poisonous snake of Maya.

Gurbani: ਇਨਿ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਘਰ ਬਹੁਤੇ ਗਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: ein dubidhaa ghar bahute gaale |
English: This duality has ruined so many homes.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਉਪਜੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਤੇ ਪਤੀਆਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: satigur baajhahu preet na upajai bhagat rate pateeaaraa he |13|
English: Without the True Guru, love does not well up. Imbued with devotional worship, the soul is satisfied. ||13||

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਉ ਬਹੁ ਧਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: saakat maaeaa kau bahu dhaaveh |
English: The faithless cynics chase after Maya.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਕਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: naam visaar kahaa sukh paaveh |
English: Forgetting the Naam, how can they find peace?

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਖਪਹਿ ਖਪਾਵਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: trihu gun antar khapeh khapaaveh naahee paar utaaraa he |14|
English: In the three qualities, they are destroyed; they cannot cross over to the other side. ||14||

Gurbani: ਕੂਕਰ ਸੂਕਰ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kookar sookar kaheeeh koorriaaraa |
English: The false are called pigs and dogs.

Gurbani: ਭਉਕਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਭਉ ਭਉ ਭਉਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: bhauk mareh bhau bhau bhauhaaraa |
English: They bark themselves to death; they bark and bark and howl in fear.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਝੂਠੇ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਹਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: man tan jhootthe koorr kamaaveh duramat daragah haaraa he |15|
English: False in mind and body, they practice falsehood; through their evil-mindedness, they lose out in the Court of the Lord. ||15||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਮਨੂਆ ਟੇਕੈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur milai ta manooaa ttekai |
English: Meeting the True Guru, the mind is stabilized.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇਕੈ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam de saran parekai |
English: One who seeks His Sanctuary is blessed with the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: har dhan naam amolak devai har jas daragah piaaraa he |16|
English: They are given the priceless wealth of the Lord's Name; singing His Praises, they are His beloveds in His court. ||16||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam saadhoo saranaaee |
English: In the Sanctuary of the Holy, chant the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur bachanee gat mit paaee |
English: Through the True Guru's Teachings, one comes to know His state and extent.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੭॥੩॥੯॥
Transliteration: naanak har jap har man mere har mele melanahaaraa he |17|3|9|
English: Nanak: chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind; the Lord, the Uniter, shall unite you with Himself. ||17||3||9||

[Ang 1030 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 |
English: Maaroo, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਘਰਿ ਰਹੁ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੁਗਧ ਇਆਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: ghar rahu re man mugadh eaane |
English: Remain in your own home, O my foolish and ignorant mind.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਅੰਤਰਗਤਿ ਧਿਆਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: raam japahu antaragat dhiaane |
English: Meditate on the Lord - concentrate deep within your being and meditate on Him.

Gurbani: ਲਾਲਚ ਛੋਡਿ ਰਚਹੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਿ ਇਉ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: laalach chhodd rachahu aparanpar iau paavahu mukat duaaraa he |1|
English: Renounce your greed, and merge with the infinite Lord. In this way, you shall find the door of liberation. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਬਿਸਰਿਐ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹਣਿ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: jis bisariai jam johan laagai |
English: If you forget Him, the Messenger of Death will catch sight of you.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਜਾਹਿ ਦੁਖਾ ਫੁਨਿ ਆਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: sabh sukh jaeh dukhaa fun aagai |
English: All peace will be gone, and you will suffer in pain in the world hereafter.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਏਹੁ ਪਰਮ ਤਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: raam naam jap guramukh jeearre ehu param tat veechaaraa he |2|
English: Chant the Name of the Lord as Gurmukh, O my soul; this is the supreme essence of contemplation. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam japahu ras meetthaa |
English: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the sweetest essence.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਡੀਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh har ras antar ddeetthaa |
English: As Gurmukh, see the essence of the Lord deep within.

Gurbani: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਹਹੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਏਹੁ ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ahinis raam rahahu rang raate ehu jap tap sanjam saaraa he |3|
English: Day and night, remain imbued with the Lord's Love. This is the essence of all chanting, deep meditation and self-discipline. ||3||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਬੋਲਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam gur bachanee bolahu |
English: Speak the Guru's Word, and the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਮਹਿ ਇਹੁ ਰਸੁ ਟੋਲਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: sant sabhaa meh ihu ras ttolahu |
English: In the Society of the Saints, search for this essence.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹਹੁ ਘਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਗਰਭ ਮਝਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: guramat khoj lahahu ghar apanaa bahurr na garabh majhaaraa he |4|
English: Follow the Guru's Teachings - seek and find the home of your own self, and you shall never be consigned to the womb of reincarnation again. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: sach teerath naavahu har gun gaavahu |
English: Bathe at the sacred shrine of Truth, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: tat veechaarahu har liv laavahu |
English: Reflect upon the essence of reality, and lovingly focus your consciousness on the Lord.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: ant kaal jam johi na saakai har bolahu raam piaaraa he |5|
English: At the very last moment, the Messenger of Death will not be able to touch you, if you chant the Name of the Beloved Lord. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਵਡ ਦਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: satigur purakh daataa vadd daanaa |
English: The True Guru, the Primal Being, the Great Giver, is all-knowing.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਸੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: jis antar saach su sabad samaanaa |
English: Whoever has Truth within himself, merges in the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਚੂਕਾ ਜਮ ਭੈ ਭਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: jis kau satigur mel milaae tis chookaa jam bhai bhaaraa he |6|
English: One whom the True Guru unites in Union, is rid of the overpowering fear of death. ||6||

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਕੀਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: panch tat mil kaaeaa keenee |
English: The body is formed from the union of the five elements.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਲੈ ਚੀਨੀ ॥
Transliteration: tis meh raam ratan lai cheenee |
English: Know that the Lord's jewel is within it.

Gurbani: ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਆਤਮ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: aatam raam raam hai aatam har paaeeai sabad veechaaraa he |7|
English: The soul is the Lord, and the Lord is the soul; contemplating the Shabad, the Lord is found. ||7||

Gurbani: ਸਤ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਰਹਹੁ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sat santokh rahahu jan bhaaee |
English: Abide in truth and contentment, O humble Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਖਿਮਾ ਗਹਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: khimaa gahahu satigur saranaaee |
English: Hold tight to compassion and the Sanctuary of the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਆਤਮੁ ਚੀਨਿ ਪਰਾਤਮੁ ਚੀਨਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਇਹੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: aatam cheen paraatam cheenahu gur sangat ihu nisataaraa he |8|
English: Know your soul, and know the Supreme Soul; associating with the Guru, you shall be emancipated. ||8||

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤ ਕੂੜ ਕਪਟ ਮਹਿ ਟੇਕਾ ॥
Transliteration: saakat koorr kapatt meh ttekaa |
English: The faithless cynics are stuck in falsehood and deceit.

Gurbani: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਨੇਕਾ ॥
Transliteration: ahinis nindaa kareh anekaa |
English: Day and night, they slander many others.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਗ੍ਰਭ ਜੋਨੀ ਨਰਕ ਮਝਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: bin simaran aaveh fun jaaveh grabh jonee narak majhaaraa he |9|
English: Without meditative remembrance, they come and then go, and are cast into the hellish womb of reincarnation. ||9||

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ॥
Transliteration: saakat jam kee kaan na chookai |
English: The faithless cynic is not rid of his fear of death.

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਕਾ ਡੰਡੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਮੂਕੈ ॥
Transliteration: jam kaa ddandd na kabahoo mookai |
English: The Messenger of Death's club is never taken away.

Gurbani: ਬਾਕੀ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੀ ਲੀਜੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਅਫਰਿਓ ਭਾਰੁ ਅਫਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: baakee dharam raae kee leejai sir afario bhaar afaaraa he |10|
English: He has to answer to the Righteous Judge of Dharma for the account of his actions; the egotistical being carries the unbearable load. ||10||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਕਤੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਕੋ ਤਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: bin gur saakat kahahu ko tariaa |
English: Tell me: without the Guru, what faithless cynic has been saved?

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਤਾ ਭਵਜਲਿ ਪਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: haumai karataa bhavajal pariaa |
English: Acting egotistically, he falls into the terrifying world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: bin gur paar na paavai koee har japeeai paar utaaraa he |11|
English: Without the Guru, no one is saved; meditating on the Lord, they are carried across to the other side. ||11||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur kee daat na mettai koee |
English: No one can erase the Guru's blessings.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਾਰੇ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jis bakhase tis taare soee |
English: The Lord carries across those whom He forgives.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: janam maran dukh nerr na aavai man so prabh apar apaaraa he |12|
English: The pains of birth and death do not even approach those whose minds are filled with God, the infinite and endless. ||12||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਭੂਲੇ ਆਵਹੁ ਜਾਵਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur te bhoole aavahu jaavahu |
English: Those who forget the Guru come and go in reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰਹੁ ਫੁਨਿ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਵਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: janam marahu fun paap kamaavahu |
English: They are born, only to die again, and continue committing sins.

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤ ਮੂੜ ਅਚੇਤ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: saakat moorr achet na cheteh dukh laagai taa raam pukaaraa he |13|
English: The unconscious, foolish, faithless cynic does not remember the Lord; but when he is stricken with pain, then he cries out for the Lord. ||13||

Gurbani: ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪੁਰਬ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕੀਏ ॥
Transliteration: sukh dukh purab janam ke kee |
English: Pleasure and pain are the consequences of the actions of past lives.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਦਾਤੈ ਦੀਏ ॥
Transliteration: so jaanai jin daatai dee |
English: The Giver, who blesses us with these - He alone knows.

Gurbani: ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਦੋਸੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਤੂ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਸਹੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: kis kau dos dehi too praanee sahu apanaa keea karaaraa he |14|
English: So who can you blame, O mortal being? The hardships you suffer are from your own actions. ||14||

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਕਰਦਾ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: haumai mamataa karadaa aaeaa |
English: Practicing egotism and possessiveness, you have come into the world.

Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਬੰਧਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aasaa manasaa bandh chalaaeaa |
English: Hope and desire bind you and lead you on.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਤ ਕਿਆ ਲੇ ਚਾਲੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਲਾਦੇ ਛਾਰ ਬਿਕਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: meree meree karat kiaa le chaale bikh laade chhaar bikaaraa he |15|
English: Indulging in egotism and self-conceit, what will you be able to carry with you, except the load of ashes from poison and corruption? ||15||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har kee bhagat karahu jan bhaaee |
English: Worship the Lord in devotion, O humble Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: akath kathahu man maneh samaaee |
English: Speak the Unspoken Speech, and the mind will merge back into the Mind.

Gurbani: ਉਠਿ ਚਲਤਾ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਖਹੁ ਘਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟੇ ਕਾਟਣਹਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: autth chalataa tthaak rakhahu ghar apunai dukh kaatte kaattanahaaraa he |16|
English: Restrain your restless mind within its own home, and the Lord, the Destroyer, shall destroy your pain. ||16||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਪਰਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: har gur poore kee ott paraatee |
English: I seek the support of the Perfect Guru, the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh har liv guramukh jaatee |
English: The Gurmukh loves the Lord; the Gurmukh realizes the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹਰਿ ਬਖਸੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੭॥੪॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: naanak raam naam mat aootam har bakhase paar utaaraa he |17|4|10|
English: O Nanak, through the Lord's Name, the intellect is exalted; granting His forgiveness, the Lord carries him across to the other side. ||17||4||10||

[Ang 1031 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 |
English: Maaroo, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: saran pare guradev tumaaree |
English: O Divine Guru, I have entered Your Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: too samarath deaal muraaree |
English: You are the Almighty Lord, the Merciful Lord.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੇ ਚੋਜ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਈ ਤੂ ਪੂਰਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tere choj na jaanai koee too pooraa purakh bidhaataa he |1|
English: No one knows Your wondrous plays; You are the perfect Architect of Destiny. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: too aad jugaad kareh pratipaalaa |
English: From the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages, You cherish and sustain Your beings.

Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਨੂਪੁ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt roop anoop deaalaa |
English: You are in each and every heart, O Merciful Lord of incomparable beauty.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਵਹਿ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਕੀਆ ਕਮਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jiau tudh bhaavai tivai chalaaveh sabh tero keea kamaataa he |2|
English: As You will, You cause all to walk; everyone acts according to Your Command. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਭਲੀ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ॥
Transliteration: antar jot bhalee jagajeevan |
English: Deep within the nucleus of all, is the Light of the Life of the World.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਘਟ ਭੋਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਨ ॥
Transliteration: sabh ghatt bhogai har ras peevan |
English: The Lord enjoys the hearts of all, and drinks in their essence.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਲੇਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਈ ਜਗਤ ਪਿਤ ਦਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aape levai aape devai tihu loee jagat pit daataa he |3|
English: He Himself gives, and He himself takes; He is the generous father of the beings of the three worlds. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jagat upaae khel rachaaeaa |
English: Creating the world, He has set His play into motion.

Gurbani: ਪਵਣੈ ਪਾਣੀ ਅਗਨੀ ਜੀਉ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: pavanai paanee aganee jeeo paaeaa |
English: He placed the soul in the body of air, water and fire.

Gurbani: ਦੇਹੀ ਨਗਰੀ ਨਉ ਦਰਵਾਜੇ ਸੋ ਦਸਵਾ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਰਹਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: dehee nagaree nau daravaaje so dasavaa gupat rahaataa he |4|
English: The body-village has nine gates; the Tenth Gate remains hidden. ||4||

Gurbani: ਚਾਰਿ ਨਦੀ ਅਗਨੀ ਅਸਰਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: chaar nadee aganee asaraalaa |
English: There are four horrible rivers of fire.

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: koee guramukh boojhai sabad niraalaa |
English: How rare is that Gurmukh who understands this, and through the Word of the Shabad, remains unattached.

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਡੂਬਹਿ ਦਾਝਹਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: saakat duramat ddoobeh daajheh gur raakhe har liv raataa he |5|
English: The faithless cynics are drowned and burnt through their evil-mindedness. The Guru saves those who are imbued with the Love of the Lord. ||5||

Gurbani: ਅਪੁ ਤੇਜੁ ਵਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੀ ਆਕਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: ap tej vaae prithamee aakaasaa |
English: Water, fire, air, earth and ether

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: tin meh panch tat ghar vaasaa |
English: in that house of the five elements, they dwell.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਤਜਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: satigur sabad raheh rang raataa taj maaeaa haumai bhraataa he |6|
English: Those who remain imbued with the Word of the True Guru's Shabad, renounce Maya, egotism and doubt. ||6||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਤੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: eihu man bheejai sabad pateejai |
English: This mind is drenched with the Shabad, and satisfied.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਆ ਟੇਕ ਟਿਕੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: bin naavai kiaa ttek ttikeejai |
English: Without the Name, what support can anyone have?

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚੋਰੁ ਮੁਹੈ ਘਰੁ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਇਨਿ ਸਾਕਤਿ ਦੂਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: antar chor muhai ghar mandar in saakat doot na jaataa he |7|
English: The temple of the body is being plundered by the thieves within, but this faithless cynic does not even recognize these demons. ||7||

Gurbani: ਦੁੰਦਰ ਦੂਤ ਭੂਤ ਭੀਹਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: dundar doot bhoot bheehaale |
English: They are argumentative demons, terrifying goblins.

Gurbani: ਖਿੰਚੋਤਾਣਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੇਤਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: khinchotaan kareh betaale |
English: These demons stir up conflict and strife.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: sabad surat bin aavai jaavai pat khoee aavat jaataa he |8|
English: Without awareness of the Shabad, one comes and goes in reincarnation; he loses his honor in this coming and going. ||8||

Gurbani: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਲਰੁ ਤਨੁ ਭਸਮੈ ਢੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: koorr kalar tan bhasamai dteree |
English: The body of the false person is just a pile of barren dirt.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੈਸੀ ਪਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: bin naavai kaisee pat teree |
English: Without the Name, what honor can you have?

Gurbani: ਬਾਧੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਜਮਕੰਕਰਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਪਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: baadhe mukat naahee jug chaare jamakankar kaal paraataa he |9|
English: Bound and gagged throughout the four ages, there is no liberation; the Messenger of Death keeps such a person under his gaze. ||9||

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਾਧੇ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਸਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jam dar baadhe mileh sajaaee |
English: At Death's door, he is tied up and punished;

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: tis aparaadhee gat nahee kaaee |
English: such a sinner does not obtain salvation.

Gurbani: ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਵ ਕਰੇ ਬਿਲਲਾਵੈ ਜਿਉ ਕੁੰਡੀ ਮੀਨੁ ਪਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: karan palaav kare bilalaavai jiau kunddee meen paraataa he |10|
English: He cries out in pain, like the fish pierced by the hook. ||10||

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤੁ ਫਾਸੀ ਪੜੈ ਇਕੇਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: saakat faasee parrai ikelaa |
English: The faithless cynic is caught in the noose all alone.

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਆ ਅੰਧੁ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: jam vas keea andh duhelaa |
English: The miserable spiritually blind person is caught in the power of Death.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਆਜੁ ਕਾਲਿ ਪਚਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: raam naam bin mukat na soojhai aaj kaal pach jaataa he |11|
English: Without the Lord's Name, liberation is not known. He shall waste away, today or tomorrow. ||11||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝੁ ਨ ਬੇਲੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur baajh na belee koee |
English: Other than the True Guru, no one is your friend.

Gurbani: ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਰਾਖਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aithai othai raakhaa prabh soee |
English: Here and hereafter, God is the Savior.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਇਉ ਸਲਲੈ ਸਲਲ ਮਿਲਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: raam naam devai kar kirapaa iau salalai salal milaataa he |12|
English: He grants His Grace, and bestows the Lord's Name. He merges with Him, like water with water. ||12||

Gurbani: ਭੂਲੇ ਸਿਖ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਮਝਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: bhoole sikh guroo samajhaae |
English: The Guru instructs His wandering Sikhs;

Gurbani: ਉਝੜਿ ਜਾਦੇ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aujharr jaade maarag paae |
English: if they go astray, He sets them on the right path.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਖਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: tis gur sev sadaa din raatee dukh bhanjan sang sakhaataa he |13|
English: So serve the Guru, forever, day and night; He is the Destroyer of pain - He is with you as your companion. ||13||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur kee bhagat kareh kiaa praanee |
English: O mortal being, what devotional worship have you performed to the Guru?

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੈ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਿ ਮਹੇਸਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: brahamai indr mahes na jaanee |
English: Even Brahma, Indra and Shiva do not know it.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਉ ਲਖੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: satigur alakh kahahu kiau lakheeai jis bakhase tiseh pachhaataa he |14|
English: Tell me, how can the unknowable True Guru be known? He alone attains this realization, whom the Lord forgives. ||14||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: antar prem paraapat darasan |
English: One who has love within, obtains the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸੁ ਪਰਸਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: gurabaanee siau preet su parasan |
English: One who enshrines love for the Word of the Guru's Bani, meets with Him.

Gurbani: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਾਈ ਘਟਿ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: ahinis niramal jot sabaaee ghatt deepak guramukh jaataa he |15|
English: Day and night, the Gurmukh sees the immaculate Divine Light everywhere; this lamp illuminates his heart. ||15||

Gurbani: ਭੋਜਨ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: bhojan giaan mahaa ras meetthaa |
English: The food of spiritual wisdom is the supremely sweet essence.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਡੀਠਾ ॥
Transliteration: jin chaakhiaa tin darasan ddeetthaa |
English: Whoever tastes it, sees the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

Gurbani: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: darasan dekh mile bairaagee man manasaa maar samaataa he |16|
English: Beholding His Darshan, the unattached one meets the Lord; subduing the mind's desires, he merges into the Lord. ||16||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਪਰਧਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: satigur seveh se paradhaanaa |
English: Those who serve the True Guru are supreme and famous.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: tin ghatt ghatt antar braham pachhaanaa |
English: Deep within each and every heart, they recognize God.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੭॥੫॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: naanak har jas har jan kee sangat deejai jin satigur har prabh jaataa he |17|5|11|
English: Please bless Nanak with the Lord's Praises, and the Sangat, the Congregation of the Lord's humble servants; through the True Guru, they know their Lord God. ||17||5||11||

[Ang 1032 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 |
English: Maaroo, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: saache saahib sirajanahaare |
English: The True Lord is the Creator of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਧਰ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਧਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: jin dhar chakr dhare veechaare |
English: He established and contemplates the worldly sphere.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aape karataa kar kar vekhai saachaa veparavaahaa he |1|
English: He Himself created the creation, and beholds it; He is True and independent. ||1||

Gurbani: ਵੇਕੀ ਵੇਕੀ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: vekee vekee jant upaae |
English: He created the beings of different kinds.

Gurbani: ਦੁਇ ਪੰਦੀ ਦੁਇ ਰਾਹ ਚਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: due pandee due raah chalaae |
English: The two travellers have set out in two directions.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur poore vin mukat na hoee sach naam jap laahaa he |2|
English: Without the Perfect Guru, no one is liberated. Chanting the True Name, one profits. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪੜਹਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਪਰੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: parreh manamukh par bidh nahee jaanaa |
English: The self-willed manmukhs read and study, but they do not know the way.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: naam na boojheh bharam bhulaanaa |
English: They do not understand the Naam, the Name of the Lord; they wander, deluded by doubt.

Gurbani: ਲੈ ਕੈ ਵਢੀ ਦੇਨਿ ਉਗਾਹੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਾ ਗਲਿ ਫਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: lai kai vadtee den ugaahee duramat kaa gal faahaa he |3|
English: They take bribes, and give false testimony; the noose of evil-mindedness is around their necks. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਪੜਹਿ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: simrit saasatr parreh puraanaa |
English: They read the Simritees, the Shaastras and the Puraanas;

Gurbani: ਵਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: vaad vakhaaneh tat na jaanaa |
English: they argue and debate, but do not know the essence of reality.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚ ਸੂਚੇ ਸਚੁ ਰਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: vin gur poore tat na paaeeai sach sooche sach raahaa he |4|
English: Without the Perfect Guru, the essence of reality is not obtained. The true and pure beings walk the Path of Truth. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: sabh saalaahe sun sun aakhai |
English: All praise God and listen, and listen and speak.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਦਾਨਾ ਸਚੁ ਪਰਾਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: aape daanaa sach paraakhai |
English: He Himself is wise, and He Himself judges the Truth.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: jin kau nadar kare prabh apanee guramukh sabad salaahaa he |5|
English: Those whom God blesses with His Glance of Grace become Gurmukh, and praise the Word of the Shabad. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਖੈ ਕੇਤੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: sun sun aakhai ketee baanee |
English: Many listen and listen, and speak the Guru's Bani.

Gurbani: ਸੁਣਿ ਕਹੀਐ ਕੋ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: sun kaheeai ko ant na jaanee |
English: Listening and speaking, no one knows His limits.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬੁਧਿ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: jaa kau alakh lakhaae aape akath kathaa budh taahaa he |6|
English: He alone is wise, unto whom the unseen Lord reveals Himself; he speaks the Unspoken Speech. ||6||

Gurbani: ਜਨਮੇ ਕਉ ਵਾਜਹਿ ਵਾਧਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: janame kau vaajeh vaadhaae |
English: At birth, the congratulations pour in;

Gurbani: ਸੋਹਿਲੜੇ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਗਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sohilarre agiaanee gaae |
English: the ignorant sing songs of joy.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜਨਮੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਪਰ ਮਰਣਾ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਪਇਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: jo janamai tis sarapar maranaa kirat peaa sir saahaa he |7|
English: Whoever is born, is sure to die, according to the destiny of past deeds inscribed upon his head by the Sovereign Lord King. ||7||

Gurbani: ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਏ ॥
Transliteration: sanjog vijog merai prabh kee |
English: Union and separation were created by my God.

Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਦੁਖਾ ਸੁਖ ਦੀਏ ॥
Transliteration: srisatt upaae dukhaa sukh dee |
English: Creating the Universe, He gave it pain and pleasure.

Gurbani: ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਨਿਰਾਲੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੀਲੁ ਸਨਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: dukh sukh hee te bhe niraale guramukh seel sanaahaa he |8|
English: The Gurmukhs remain unaffected by pain and pleasure; they wear the armor of humility. ||8||

Gurbani: ਨੀਕੇ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੇ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: neeke saache ke vaapaaree |
English: The noble people are traders in Truth.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸਉਦਾ ਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: sach saudaa lai gur veechaaree |
English: They purchase the true merchandise, contemplating the Guru.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਵਖਰੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਓਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: sachaa vakhar jis dhan palai sabad sachai omaahaa he |9|
English: One who has the wealth of the true commodity in his lap, is blessed with the rapture of the True Shabad. ||9||

Gurbani: ਕਾਚੀ ਸਉਦੀ ਤੋਟਾ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: kaachee saudee tottaa aavai |
English: The false dealings lead only to loss.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh vanaj kare prabh bhaavai |
English: The trades of the Gurmukh are pleasing to God.

Gurbani: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਾਬਤੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਚੂਕਾ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਫਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: poonjee saabat raas salaamat chookaa jam kaa faahaa he |10|
English: His stock is safe, and his capital is safe and sound. The noose of Death is cut away from around his neck. ||10||

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਆਪਣ ਭਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: sabh ko bolai aapan bhaanai |
English: Everyone speaks as they please.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਬੋਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh doojai bol na jaanai |
English: The self-willed manmukh, in duality, does not know how to speak.

Gurbani: ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਅੰਧਲੀ ਬੋਲੀ ਆਇ ਗਇਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: andhule kee mat andhalee bolee aae geaa dukh taahaa he |11|
English: The blind person has a blind and deaf intellect; coming and going in reincarnation, he suffers in pain. ||11||

Gurbani: ਦੁਖ ਮਹਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਦੁਖ ਮਹਿ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: dukh meh janamai dukh meh maranaa |
English: In pain he is born, and in pain he dies.

Gurbani: ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਮਿਟੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: dookh na mittai bin gur kee saranaa |
English: His pain is not relieved, without seeking the Sanctuary of the Guru.

Gurbani: ਦੂਖੀ ਉਪਜੈ ਦੂਖੀ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਕਿਆ ਲੈ ਆਇਆ ਕਿਆ ਲੈ ਜਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: dookhee upajai dookhee binasai kiaa lai aaeaa kiaa lai jaahaa he |12|
English: In pain he is created, and in pain he perishes. What has he brought with himself? And what will he take away? ||12||

Gurbani: ਸਚੀ ਕਰਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਿਰਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sachee karanee gur kee sirakaaraa |
English: True are the actions of those who are under the Guru's influence.

Gurbani: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਮ ਧਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aavan jaan nahee jam dhaaraa |
English: They do not come and go in reincarnation, and they are not subject to the laws of Death.

Gurbani: ਡਾਲ ਛੋਡਿ ਤਤੁ ਮੂਲੁ ਪਰਾਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਓਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: ddaal chhodd tat mool paraataa man saachaa omaahaa he |13|
English: Whoever abandons the branches, and clings to the true root, enjoys true ecstasy within his mind. ||13||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਗ ਨਹੀ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: har ke log nahee jam maarai |
English: Death cannot strike down the people of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਪੰਥਿ ਕਰਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: naa dukh dekheh panth karaarai |
English: They do not see pain on the most difficult path.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: raam naam ghatt antar poojaa avar na doojaa kaahaa he |14|
English: Deep within the nucleus of their hearts, they worship and adore the Lord's Name; there is nothing else at all for them. ||14||

Gurbani: ਓੜੁ ਨ ਕਥਨੈ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: orr na kathanai sifat sajaaee |
