English: There is no end to the Lord's sermon and Praise.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਰਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jiau tudh bhaaveh raheh rajaaee |
English: As it pleases You, I remain under Your Will.

Gurbani: ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧੇ ਜਾਨਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਚੇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: daragah paidhe jaan suhele hukam sache paatisaahaa he |15|
English: I am embellished with robes of honor in the Court of the Lord, by the Order of the True King. ||15||

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਗੁਣ ਕਥਹਿ ਘਨੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kiaa kaheeai gun katheh ghanere |
English: How can I chant Your uncounted glories?

Gurbani: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਵਡੇ ਵਡੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: ant na paaveh vadde vaddere |
English: Even the greatest of the great do not know Your limits.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਤੂ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੬॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: naanak saach milai pat raakhahu too sir saahaa paatisaahaa he |16|6|12|
English: Please bless Nanak with the Truth, and preserve his honor; You are the supreme emperor above the heads of kings. ||16||6||12||

[Ang 1033 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਦਖਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 dakhanee |
English: Maaroo, First Mehl, Dakhanee:

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰੁ ਨਗਰ ਗੜ ਅੰਦਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa nagar nagar garr andar |
English: Deep within the body-village is the fortress.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਾ ਵਾਸਾ ਪੁਰਿ ਗਗਨੰਦਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: saachaa vaasaa pur gaganandar |
English: The dwelling of the True Lord is within the city of the Tenth Gate.

Gurbani: ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਮਾਇਲੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: asathir thaan sadaa niramaaeil aape aap upaaeidaa |1|
English: This place is permanent and forever immaculate. He Himself created it. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕੋਟ ਛਜੇ ਹਟਨਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: andar kott chhaje hattanaale |
English: Within the fortress are balconies and bazaars.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਲੇਵੈ ਵਸਤੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: aape levai vasat samaale |
English: He Himself takes care of His merchandise.

Gurbani: ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਜੜੇ ਜੜਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਖੋਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bajar kapaatt jarre jarr jaanai gurasabadee kholaaeidaa |2|
English: The hard and heavy doors of the Tenth Gate are closed and locked. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they are thrown open. ||2||

Gurbani: ਭੀਤਰਿ ਕੋਟ ਗੁਫਾ ਘਰ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: bheetar kott gufaa ghar jaaee |
English: Within the fortress is the cave, the home of the self.

Gurbani: ਨਉ ਘਰ ਥਾਪੇ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: nau ghar thaape hukam rajaaee |
English: He established the nine gates of this house, by His Command and His Will.

Gurbani: ਦਸਵੈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਲੇਖੁ ਅਪਾਰੀ ਆਪੇ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: dasavai purakh alekh apaaree aape alakh lakhaaeidaa |3|
English: In the Tenth Gate, the Primal Lord, the unknowable and infinite dwells; the unseen Lord reveals Himself. ||3||

Gurbani: ਪਉਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਅਗਨੀ ਇਕ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: paun paanee aganee ik vaasaa |
English: Within the body of air, water and fire, the One Lord dwells.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕੀਤੋ ਖੇਲੁ ਤਮਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape keeto khel tamaasaa |
English: He Himself stages His wondrous dramas and plays.

Gurbani: ਬਲਦੀ ਜਲਿ ਨਿਵਰੈ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਆਪੇ ਜਲ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: baladee jal nivarai kirapaa te aape jal nidh paaeidaa |4|
English: By His Grace, water puts out the burning fire; He Himself stores it up in the watery ocean. ||4||

Gurbani: ਧਰਤਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਧਰੀ ਧਰਮ ਸਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: dharat upaae dharee dharam saalaa |
English: Creating the earth, He established it as the home of Dharma.

Gurbani: ਉਤਪਤਿ ਪਰਲਉ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: autapat parlau aap niraalaa |
English: Creating and destroying, He remains unattached.

Gurbani: ਪਵਣੈ ਖੇਲੁ ਕੀਆ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ਕਲਾ ਖਿੰਚਿ ਢਾਹਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: pavanai khel keea sabh thaaee kalaa khinch dtaahaaeidaa |5|
English: He stages the play of the breath everywhere. Withdrawing His power, He lets the beings crumble. ||5||

Gurbani: ਭਾਰ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਮਾਲਣਿ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: bhaar atthaarah maalan teree |
English: Your gardener is the vast vegetation of nature.

Gurbani: ਚਉਰੁ ਢੁਲੈ ਪਵਣੈ ਲੈ ਫੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: chaur dtulai pavanai lai feree |
English: The wind blowing around is the chauree, the fly-brush, waving over You.

Gurbani: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਦੀਪਕ ਰਾਖੇ ਸਸਿ ਘਰਿ ਸੂਰੁ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: chand sooraj due deepak raakhe sas ghar soor samaaeidaa |6|
English: The Lord placed the two lamps, the sun and the moon; the sun merges in the house of the moon. ||6||

Gurbani: ਪੰਖੀ ਪੰਚ ਉਡਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਧਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: pankhee panch uddar nahee dhaaveh |
English: The five birds do not fly wild.

Gurbani: ਸਫਲਿਓ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: safalio birakh amrit fal paaveh |
English: The tree of life is fruitful, bearing the fruit of Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਰਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚੋਗ ਚੁਗਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: guramukh sehaj ravai gun gaavai har ras chog chugaaeidaa |7|
English: The Gurmukh intuitively sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord; he eats the food of the Lord's sublime essence. ||7||

Gurbani: ਝਿਲਮਿਲਿ ਝਿਲਕੈ ਚੰਦੁ ਨ ਤਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jhilamil jhilakai chand na taaraa |
English: The dazzling light glitters, although neither the moon nor the stars are shining;

Gurbani: ਸੂਰਜ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਨ ਬਿਜੁਲਿ ਗੈਣਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sooraj kiran na bijul gainaaraa |
English: neither the sun's rays nor the lightning flashes across the sky.

Gurbani: ਅਕਥੀ ਕਥਉ ਚਿਹਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: akathee kthau chihan nahee koee poor rahiaa man bhaaeidaa |8|
English: I describe the indescribable state, which has no sign, where the all-pervading Lord is still pleasing to the mind. ||8||

Gurbani: ਪਸਰੀ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਉਜਿਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: pasaree kiran jot ujiaalaa |
English: The rays of Divine Light have spread out their brilliant radiance.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: kar kar dekhai aap deaalaa |
English: Having created the creation, the Merciful Lord Himself gazes upon it.

Gurbani: ਅਨਹਦ ਰੁਣ ਝੁਣਕਾਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਧੁਨਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: anahad run jhunakaar sadaa dhun nirbhau kai ghar vaaeidaa |9|
English: The sweet, melodious, unstruck sound current vibrates continuously in the home of the fearless Lord. ||9||

Gurbani: ਅਨਹਦੁ ਵਾਜੈ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: anahad vaajai bhram bhau bhaajai |
English: When the unstruck sound current resounds, doubt and fear run away.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਬਿਆਪਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਛਾਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: sagal biaap rahiaa prabh chhaajai |
English: God is all-pervading, giving shade to all.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਹੈ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: sabh teree too guramukh jaataa dar sohai gun gaaeidaa |10|
English: All belong to You; to the Gurmukhs, You are known. Singing Your Praises, they look beautiful in Your Court. ||10||

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aad niranjan niramal soee |
English: He is the Primal Lord, immaculate and pure.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: avar na jaanaa doojaa koee |
English: I know of no other at all.

Gurbani: ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਗਵਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: ekankaar vasai man bhaavai haumai garab gavaaeidaa |11|
English: The One Universal Creator Lord dwells within, and is pleasing to the mind of those who banishe egotism and pride. ||11||

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: amrit peea satigur deea |
English: I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar, given by the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਦੂਆ ਤੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: avar na jaanaa dooaa teea |
English: I do not know any other second or third.

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਸੁ ਅਪਰ ਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਪਰਖਿ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: eko ek su apar paranpar parakh khajaanai paaeidaa |12|
English: He is the One, Unique, Infinite and Endless Lord; He evaluates all beings and places some in His treasury. ||12||

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: giaan dhiaan sach gahir ganbheeraa |
English: Spiritual wisdom and meditation on the True Lord are deep and profound.

Gurbani: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਚੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: koe na jaanai teraa cheeraa |
English: No one knows Your expanse.

Gurbani: ਜੇਤੀ ਹੈ ਤੇਤੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: jetee hai tetee tudh jaachai karam milai so paaeidaa |13|
English: All that are, beg from You; You are attained only by Your Grace. ||13||

Gurbani: ਕਰਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਸਚੁ ਹਾਥਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: karam dharam sach haath tumaarai |
English: You hold karma and Dharma in Your hands, O True Lord.

Gurbani: ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹ ਅਖੁਟ ਭੰਡਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: veparavaah akhutt bhanddaarai |
English: O Independent Lord, Your treasures are inexhaustible.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: too deaal kirapaal sadaa prabh aape mel milaaeidaa |14|
English: You are forever kind and compassionate, God. You unite in Your Union. ||14||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਆਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: aape dekh dikhaavai aape |
English: You Yourself see, and cause Yourself to be seen.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੇ ਆਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: aape thaap uthaape aape |
English: You Yourself establish, and You Yourself disestablish.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਜੋੜਿ ਵਿਛੋੜੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: aape jorr vichhorre karataa aape maar jeevaaeidaa |15|
English: The Creator Himself unites and separates; He Himself kills and rejuvenates. ||15||

Gurbani: ਜੇਤੀ ਹੈ ਤੇਤੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: jetee hai tetee tudh andar |
English: As much as there is, is contained within You.

Gurbani: ਦੇਖਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਬੈਸਿ ਬਿਜ ਮੰਦਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: dekheh aap bais bij mandar |
English: You gaze upon Your creation, sitting within Your royal palace.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: naanak saach kahai benantee har darasan sukh paaeidaa |16|1|13|
English: Nanak offers this true prayer; gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, I have found peace. ||16||1||13||

[Ang 1034 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 |
English: Maaroo, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਵਾ ਜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: darasan paavaa je tudh bhaavaa |
English: If I am pleasing to You, Lord, then I obtain the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

Gurbani: ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: bhaae bhagat saache gun gaavaa |
English: In loving devotional worship, O True Lord, I sing Your Glorious Praises.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣੇ ਤੂ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਆਪੇ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tudh bhaane too bhaaveh karate aape rasan rasaaeidaa |1|
English: By Your Will, O Creator Lord, You have become pleasing to me, and so sweet to my tongue. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੋਹਨਿ ਭਗਤ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sohan bhagat prabhoo darabaare |
English: The devotees look beautiful in the Darbaar, the Court of God.

Gurbani: ਮੁਕਤੁ ਭਏ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: mukat bhe har daas tumaare |
English: Your slaves, Lord, are liberated.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਤੇਰੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aap gavaae terai rang raate anadin naam dhiaaeidaa |2|
English: Eradicating self-conceit, they are attuned to Your Love; night and day, they meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਈਸਰੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: eesar brahamaa devee devaa |
English: Shiva, Brahma, gods and goddesses,

Gurbani: ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਤਪੇ ਮੁਨਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: eindr tape mun teree sevaa |
English: Indra, ascetics and silent sages serve You.

Gurbani: ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਕੇਤੇ ਬਨਵਾਸੀ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jatee satee kete banavaasee ant na koee paaeidaa |3|
English: Celibates, givers of charity and the many forest-dwellers have not found the Lord's limits. ||3||

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਜਾਣਾਏ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: vin jaanaae koe na jaanai |
English: No one knows You, unless You let them know You.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਆਪਣ ਭਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: jo kichh kare su aapan bhaanai |
English: Whatever is done, is by Your Will.

Gurbani: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜੀਅ ਉਪਾਏ ਭਾਣੈ ਸਾਹ ਲਵਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh jeea upaae bhaanai saah lavaaeidaa |4|
English: You created the 8.4 million species of beings; by Your Will, they draw their breath. ||4||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਨਿਹਚਉ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jo tis bhaavai so nihchau hovai |
English: Whatever is pleasing to Your Will, undoubtedly comes to pass.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਏ ਰੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh aap ganaae rovai |
English: The self-willed manmukh shows off, and comes to grief.

Gurbani: ਨਾਵਹੁ ਭੁਲਾ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਆਇ ਜਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: naavahu bhulaa tthaur na paae aae jaae dukh paaeidaa |5|
English: Forgetting the Name, he finds no place of rest; coming and going in reincarnation, he suffers in pain. ||5||

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਾਇਆ ਊਜਲ ਹੰਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: niramal kaaeaa aoojal hansaa |
English: Pure is the body, and immaculate is the swan-soul;

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਅੰਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: tis vich naam niranjan ansaa |
English: within it is the immaculate essence of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਪੀਵੈ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: sagale dookh amrit kar peevai baahurr dookh na paaeidaa |6|
English: Such a being drinks in all his pains like Ambrosial Nectar; he never suffers sorrow again. ||6||

Gurbani: ਬਹੁ ਸਾਦਹੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: bahu saadahu dookh paraapat hovai |
English: For his excessive indulgences, he receives only pain;

Gurbani: ਭੋਗਹੁ ਰੋਗ ਸੁ ਅੰਤਿ ਵਿਗੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: bhogahu rog su ant vigovai |
English: from his enjoyments, he contracts diseases, and in the end, he wastes away.

Gurbani: ਹਰਖਹੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਨ ਮਿਟਈ ਕਬਹੂ ਵਿਣੁ ਭਾਣੇ ਭਰਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: harakhahu sog na mittee kabahoo vin bhaane bharamaaeidaa |7|
English: His pleasure can never erase his pain; without accepting the Lord's Will, he wanders lost and confused. ||7||

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਹੂਣੀ ਭਵੈ ਸਬਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: giaan vihoonee bhavai sabaaee |
English: Without spiritual wisdom, they all just wander around.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਾ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: saachaa rav rahiaa liv laaee |
English: The True Lord is pervading and permeating everywhere, lovingly engaged.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: nirbhau sabad guroo sach jaataa jotee jot milaaeidaa |8|
English: The Fearless Lord is known through the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru; one's light merges into the Light. ||8||

Gurbani: ਅਟਲੁ ਅਡੋਲੁ ਅਤੋਲੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: attal addol atol muraare |
English: He is the eternal, unchanging, immeasurable Lord.

Gurbani: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਢਾਹੇ ਫੇਰਿ ਉਸਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: khin meh dtaahe fer usaare |
English: In an instant, He destroys, ang then reconstructs.

Gurbani: ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਮਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਭੇਦਿ ਪਤੀਆਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: roop na rekhiaa mit nahee keemat sabad bhed pateeaeidaa |9|
English: He has no form or shape, no limit or value. Pierced by the Shabad, one is satisfied. ||9||

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: ham daasan ke daas piaare |
English: I am the slave of Your slaves, O my Beloved.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਾਚ ਭਲੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: saadhik saach bhale veechaare |
English: The seekers of Truth and goodness contemplate You.

Gurbani: ਮੰਨੇ ਨਾਉ ਸੋਈ ਜਿਣਿ ਜਾਸੀ ਆਪੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: mane naau soee jin jaasee aape saach drirraaeidaa |10|
English: Whoever believes in the Name, wins; He Himself implants Truth within. ||10||

Gurbani: ਪਲੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: palai saach sache sachiaaraa |
English: The Truest of the True has the Truth is His lap.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: saache bhaavai sabad piaaraa |
English: The True Lord is pleased with those who love the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਲਾ ਧਰਿ ਥਾਪੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਹੀ ਪਤੀਆਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: tribhavan saach kalaa dhar thaapee saache hee pateeaeidaa |11|
English: Exerting His power, the Lord has established Truth throughout the three worlds; with Truth He is pleased. ||11||

Gurbani: ਵਡਾ ਵਡਾ ਆਖੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: vaddaa vaddaa aakhai sabh koee |
English: Everyone calls Him the greatest of the great.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੋਝੀ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur bin sojhee kinai na hoee |
English: Without the Guru, no one understands Him.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਏ ਨਾ ਵੀਛੁੜਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: saach milai so saache bhaae naa veechhurr dukh paaeidaa |12|
English: The True Lord is pleased with those who merge in Truth; they are not separated again, and they do not suffer. ||12||

Gurbani: ਧੁਰਹੁ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੇ ਧਾਹੀ ਰੁੰਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: dhurahu vichhune dhaahee rune |
English: Separated from the Primal Lord, they loudly weep and wail.

Gurbani: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਮੁਹਲਤਿ ਪੁੰਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: mar mar janameh muhalat pune |
English: They die and die, only to be reborn, when their time has passed.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਮੇਲਿ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: jis bakhase tis de vaddiaaee mel na pachhotaaeidaa |13|
English: He blesses those whom He forgives with glorious greatness; united with Him, they do not regret or repent. ||13 |

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਭੁਗਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape karataa aape bhugataa |
English: | He Himself is the Creator, and He Himself is the Enjoyer.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape tripataa aape mukataa |
English: He Himself is satisfied, and He Himself is liberated.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਮੁਕਤੀਸਰੁ ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: aape mukat daan mukateesar mamataa mohu chukaaeidaa |14|
English: The Lord of liberation Himself grants liberation; He eradicates possessiveness and attachment. ||14||

Gurbani: ਦਾਨਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: daanaa kai sir daan veechaaraa |
English: I consider Your gifts to be the most wonderful gifts.

Gurbani: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: karan kaaran samarath apaaraa |
English: You are the Cause of causes, Almighty Infinite Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਕੀਤਾ ਅਪਣਾ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: kar kar vekhai keetaa apanaa karanee kaar karaaeidaa |15|
English: Creating the creation, You gaze upon what You have created; You cause all to do their deeds. ||15||

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: se gun gaaveh saache bhaaveh |
English: They alone sing Your Glorious Praises, who are pleasing to You, O True Lord.

Gurbani: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਹਿ ਤੁਝ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: tujh te upajeh tujh maeh samaaveh |
English: They issue forth from You, and merge again into You.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੨॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: naanak saach kahai benantee mil saache sukh paaeidaa |16|2|14|
English: Nanak offers this true prayer; meeting with the True Lord, peace is obtained. ||16||2||14||

[Ang 1035 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 |
English: Maaroo, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਰਬਦ ਨਰਬਦ ਧੁੰਧੂਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: arabad narabad dhundhookaaraa |
English: For endless eons, there was only utter darkness.

Gurbani: ਧਰਣਿ ਨ ਗਗਨਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: dharan na gaganaa hukam apaaraa |
English: There was no earth or sky; there was only the infinite Command of His Hukam.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਨ ਚੰਦੁ ਨ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: naa din rain na chand na sooraj sun samaadh lagaaeidaa |1|
English: There was no day or night, no moon or sun; God sat in primal, profound Samaadhi. ||1||

Gurbani: ਖਾਣੀ ਨ ਬਾਣੀ ਪਉਣ ਨ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: khaanee na baanee paun na paanee |
English: There were no sources of creation or powers of speech, no air or water.

Gurbani: ਓਪਤਿ ਖਪਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: opat khapat na aavan jaanee |
English: There was no creation or destruction, no coming or going.

Gurbani: ਖੰਡ ਪਤਾਲ ਸਪਤ ਨਹੀ ਸਾਗਰ ਨਦੀ ਨ ਨੀਰੁ ਵਹਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: khandd pataal sapat nahee saagar nadee na neer vahaaeidaa |2|
English: There were no continents, nether regions, seven seas, rivers or flowing water. ||2||

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਤਦਿ ਸੁਰਗੁ ਮਛੁ ਪਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: naa tad surag machh peaalaa |
English: There were no heavenly realms, earth or nether regions of the underworld.

Gurbani: ਦੋਜਕੁ ਭਿਸਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਖੈ ਕਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: dojak bhisat nahee khai kaalaa |
English: There was no heaven or hell, no death or time.

Gurbani: ਨਰਕੁ ਸੁਰਗੁ ਨਹੀ ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਆਇ ਨ ਜਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: narak surag nahee jaman maranaa naa ko aae na jaaeidaa |3|
English: There was no hell or heaven, no birth or death, no coming or going in reincarnation. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: brahamaa bisan mahes na koee |
English: There was no Brahma, Vishnu or Shiva.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: avar na deesai eko soee |
English: No one was seen, except the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਜਨਮਾ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: naar purakh nahee jaat na janamaa naa ko dukh sukh paaeidaa |4|
English: There was no female or male, no social class or caste of birth; no one experienced pain or pleasure. ||4||

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਤਦਿ ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਬਨਵਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: naa tad jatee satee banavaasee |
English: There were no people of celibacy or charity; no one lived in the forests.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਤਦਿ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸੁਖਵਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: naa tad sidh saadhik sukhavaasee |
English: There were no Siddhas or seekers, no one living in peace.

Gurbani: ਜੋਗੀ ਜੰਗਮ ਭੇਖੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਥੁ ਕਹਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: jogee jangam bhekh na koee naa ko naath kahaaeidaa |5|
English: There were no Yogis, no wandering pilgrims, no religious robes; no one called himself the master. ||5||

Gurbani: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਨਾ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: jap tap sanjam naa brat poojaa |
English: There was no chanting or meditation, no self-discipline, fasting or worship.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: naa ko aakh vakhaanai doojaa |
English: No one spoke or talked in duality.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਆਪੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: aape aap upaae vigasai aape keemat paaeidaa |6|
English: He created Himself, and rejoiced; He evaluates Himself. ||6||

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਸੁਚਿ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਤੁਲਸੀ ਮਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: naa such sanjam tulasee maalaa |
English: There was no purification, no self-restraint, no malas of basil seeds.

Gurbani: ਗੋਪੀ ਕਾਨੁ ਨ ਗਊ ਗੋੁਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: gopee kaan na gaoo guoaalaa |
English: There were no Gopis, no Krishna, no cows or cowherds.

Gurbani: ਤੰਤੁ ਮੰਤੁ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਵੰਸੁ ਵਜਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: tant mant paakhandd na koee naa ko vans vajaaeidaa |7|
English: There were no tantras, no mantras and no hypocrisy; no one played the flute. ||7||

Gurbani: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਨਹੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਾਖੀ ॥
Transliteration: karam dharam nahee maaeaa maakhee |
English: There was no karma, no Dharma, no buzzing fly of Maya.

Gurbani: ਜਾਤਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਦੀਸੈ ਆਖੀ ॥
Transliteration: jaat janam nahee deesai aakhee |
English: Social class and birth were not seen with any eyes.

Gurbani: ਮਮਤਾ ਜਾਲੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਾਥੈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਕਿਸੈ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: mamataa jaal kaal nahee maathai naa ko kisai dhiaaeidaa |8|
English: There was no noose of attachment, no death inscribed upon the forehead; no one meditated on anything. ||8||

Gurbani: ਨਿੰਦੁ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਨਹੀ ਜੀਉ ਨ ਜਿੰਦੋ ॥
Transliteration: nind bind nahee jeeo na jindo |
English: There was no slander, no seed, no soul and no life.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਤਦਿ ਗੋਰਖੁ ਨਾ ਮਾਛਿੰਦੋ ॥
Transliteration: naa tad gorakh naa maachhindo |
English: There was no Gorakh and no Maachhindra.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਤਦਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਕੁਲ ਓਪਤਿ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਗਣਤ ਗਣਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: naa tad giaan dhiaan kul opat naa ko ganat ganaaeidaa |9|
English: There was no spiritual wisdom or meditation, no ancestry or creation, no reckoning of accounts. ||9||

Gurbani: ਵਰਨ ਭੇਖ ਨਹੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣ ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: varan bhekh nahee brahaman khatree |
English: There were no castes or social classes, no religious robes, no Brahmin or Kh'shaatriya.

Gurbani: ਦੇਉ ਨ ਦੇਹੁਰਾ ਗਊ ਗਾਇਤ੍ਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: deo na dehuraa gaoo gaaeitree |
English: There were no demi-gods or temples, no cows or Gaayatri prayer.

Gurbani: ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਨਹੀ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵਣੁ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਪੂਜਾ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: hom jag nahee teerath naavan naa ko poojaa laaeidaa |10|
English: There were no burnt offerings, no ceremonial feasts, no cleansing rituals at sacred shrines of pilgrimage; no one worshipped in adoration. ||10||

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਮੁਲਾ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਕਾਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: naa ko mulaa naa ko kaajee |
English: There was no Mullah, there was no Qazi.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਸੇਖੁ ਮਸਾਇਕੁ ਹਾਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: naa ko sekh masaaeik haajee |
English: There was no Shaykh, or pilgrims to Mecca.

Gurbani: ਰਈਅਤਿ ਰਾਉ ਨ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਕਹਣੁ ਕਹਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: reeat raau na haumai duneea naa ko kehan kahaaeidaa |11|
English: There was no king or subjects, and no worldly egotism; no one spoke of himself. ||11||

Gurbani: ਭਾਉ ਨ ਭਗਤੀ ਨਾ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: bhaau na bhagatee naa siv sakatee |
English: There was no love or devotion, no Shiva or Shakti - no energy or matter.

Gurbani: ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੀਤੁ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਨਹੀ ਰਕਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: saajan meet bind nahee rakatee |
English: There were no friends or companions, no semen or blood.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ਸਾਚੇ ਏਹੋ ਭਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: aape saahu aape vanajaaraa saache eho bhaaeidaa |12|
English: He Himself is the banker, and He Himself is the merchant. Such is the Pleasure of the Will of the True Lord. ||12||

Gurbani: ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਨ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ॥
Transliteration: bed kateb na sinmrit saasat |
English: There were no Vedas, Korans or Bibles, no Simritees or Shaastras.

Gurbani: ਪਾਠ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਉਦੈ ਨਹੀ ਆਸਤ ॥
Transliteration: paatth puraan udai nahee aasat |
English: There was no recitation of the Puraanas, no sunrise or sunset.

Gurbani: ਕਹਤਾ ਬਕਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: kahataa bakataa aap agochar aape alakh lakhaaeidaa |13|
English: The Unfathomable Lord Himself was the speaker and the preacher; the unseen Lord Himself saw everything. ||13||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਾ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jaa tis bhaanaa taa jagat upaaeaa |
English: When He so willed, He created the world.

Gurbani: ਬਾਝੁ ਕਲਾ ਆਡਾਣੁ ਰਹਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: baajh kalaa aaddaan rahaaeaa |
English: Without any supporting power, He sustained the universe.

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਉਪਾਏ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਧਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: brahamaa bisan mahes upaae maaeaa mohu vadhaaeidaa |14|
English: He created Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva; He fostered enticement and attachment to Maya. ||14||

Gurbani: ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: virale kau gur sabad sunaaeaa |
English: How rare is that person who listens to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: kar kar dekhai hukam sabaaeaa |
English: He created the creation, and watches over it; the Hukam of His Command is over all.

Gurbani: ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਪਾਤਾਲ ਅਰੰਭੇ ਗੁਪਤਹੁ ਪਰਗਟੀ ਆਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: khandd brahamandd paataal aranbhe gupatahu paragattee aaeidaa |15|
English: He formed the planets, solar systems and nether regions, and brought what was hidden to manifestation. ||15||

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: taa kaa ant na jaanai koee |
English: No one knows His limits.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: poore gur te sojhee hoee |
English: This understanding comes from the Perfect Guru.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੀ ਬਿਸਮ ਭਏ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੩॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: naanak saach rate bisamaadee bisam bhe gun gaaeidaa |16|3|15|
English: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Truth are wonderstruck; singing His Glorious Praises, they are filled with wonder. ||16||3||15||

[Ang 1036 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 |
English: Maaroo, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape aap upaae niraalaa |
English: He Himself created the creation, remaining unattached.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਾ ਥਾਨੁ ਕੀਓ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: saachaa thaan keeo deaalaa |
English: The Merciful Lord has established His True Home.

Gurbani: ਪਉਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਅਗਨੀ ਕਾ ਬੰਧਨੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋਟੁ ਰਚਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: paun paanee aganee kaa bandhan kaaeaa kott rachaaeidaa |1|
English: Binding together air, water and fire, He created the fortress of the body. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਉ ਘਰ ਥਾਪੇ ਥਾਪਣਹਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: nau ghar thaape thaapanahaarai |
English: The Creator established the nine gates.

Gurbani: ਦਸਵੈ ਵਾਸਾ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: dasavai vaasaa alakh apaarai |
English: In the Tenth Gate, is the dwelling of the infinite, unseen Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਾਇਰ ਸਪਤ ਭਰੇ ਜਲਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saaeir sapat bhare jal niramal guramukh mail na laaeidaa |2|
English: The seven seas are overflowing with the Ambrosial Water; the Gurmukhs are not stained with filth. ||2||

Gurbani: ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਦੀਪਕ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: rav sas deepak jot sabaaee |
English: The lamps of the sun and the moon fill all with light.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: aape kar vekhai vaddiaaee |
English: Creating them, He beholds His own glorious greatness.

Gurbani: ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸਚੇ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jot saroop sadaa sukhadaataa sache sobhaa paaeidaa |3|
English: The Giver of peace is forever the embodiment of Light; from the True Lord, glory is obtained. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੜ ਮਹਿ ਹਾਟ ਪਟਣ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: garr meh haatt pattan vaapaaraa |
English: Within the fortress are the stores and markets; the business is transacted there.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਤੋਲਿ ਤੋਲੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: poorai tol tolai vanajaaraa |
English: The Supreme Merchant weighs with the perfect weights.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਰਤਨੁ ਵਿਸਾਹੇ ਲੇਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: aape ratan visaahe levai aape keemat paaeidaa |4|
English: He Himself buys the jewel, and He Himself appraises its value. ||4||

Gurbani: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਪਾਵਣਹਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: keemat paaee paavanahaarai |
English: The Appraiser appraises its value.

Gurbani: ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹ ਪੂਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: veparavaah poore bhanddaarai |
English: The Independent Lord is overflowing with His treasures.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਲੇ ਆਪੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਬੁਝਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: sarab kalaa le aape rahiaa guramukh kisai bujhaaeidaa |5|
English: He holds all powers, He is all-pervading; how few are those who, as Gurmukh, understand this. ||5||

Gurbani: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ॥
Transliteration: nadar kare pooraa gur bhettai |
English: When He bestows His Glance of Grace, one meets the Perfect Guru.

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ ਨ ਮਾਰੈ ਫੇਟੈ ॥
Transliteration: jam jandaar na maarai fettai |
English: The tyrannical Messenger of Death cannot strike him then.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਾਸੀ ਆਪੇ ਬਿਗਸਿ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: jiau jal antar kamal bigaasee aape bigas dhiaaeidaa |6|
English: He blossoms forth like the lotus flower in the water; he blossoms forth in joyful meditation. ||6||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਵਰਖੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape varakhai amrit dhaaraa |
English: He Himself rains down the Ambrosial Stream of jewels,

Gurbani: ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਲਾਲ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: ratan javehar laal apaaraa |
English: Diamonds, and rubies of priceless value.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: satigur milai ta pooraa paaeeai prem padaarath paaeidaa |7|
English: When they meet the True Guru, then they find the Perfect Lord; they obtain the treasure of Love. ||7||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਲਹੈ ਅਮੋਲੋ ॥
Transliteration: prem padaarath lahai amolo |
English: Whoever receives the priceless treasure of Love

Gurbani: ਕਬ ਹੀ ਨ ਘਾਟਸਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਤੋਲੋ ॥
Transliteration: kab hee na ghaattas pooraa tolo |
English: - his weight never decreases; he has perfect weight.

Gurbani: ਸਚੇ ਕਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਚੋ ਸਉਦਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: sache kaa vaapaaree hovai sacho saudaa paaeidaa |8|
English: The trader of Truth becomes true, and obtains the merchandise. ||8||

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਸਉਦਾ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa saudaa viralaa ko paae |
English: How rare are those who obtain the true merchandise.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: pooraa satigur milai milaae |
English: Meeting the Perfect True Guru, one meets with the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਮਾਨੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: guramukh hoe su hukam pachhaanai maanai hukam samaaeidaa |9|
English: One who becomes Gurmukh realizes the Hukam of His command; surrendering to His Command, one merges in the Lord. ||9||

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਆਇਆ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: hukame aaeaa hukam samaaeaa |
English: By His Command we come, and by His command we merge into Him again.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਦੀਸੈ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: hukame deesai jagat upaaeaa |
English: By His Command, the world was formed.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸੁਰਗੁ ਮਛੁ ਪਇਆਲਾ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਕਲਾ ਰਹਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: hukame surag machh peaalaa hukame kalaa rahaaeidaa |10|
English: By His Command, the heavens, this world and the nether regions were created; by His Command, His Power supports them. ||10||

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਧਉਲ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰੰ ॥
Transliteration: hukame dharatee dhaul sir bhaaran |
English: The Hukam of His Command is the mythical bull which supports the burden of the earth on its head.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਪਉਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਗੈਣਾਰੰ ॥
Transliteration: hukame paun paanee gainaaran |
English: By His Hukam, air, water and fire came into being.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਖੇਲ ਖੇਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: hukame siv sakatee ghar vaasaa hukame khel khelaaeidaa |11|
English: By His Hukam, one dwells in the house of matter and energy - Shiva and Shakti. By His Hukam, He plays His plays. ||11||

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਆਡਾਣੇ ਆਗਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: hukame aaddaane aagaasee |
English: By the Hukam of His command, the sky is spread above.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਜਲ ਥਲ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਵਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: hukame jal thal tribhavan vaasee |
English: By His Hukam, His creatures dwell in the water, on the land and throughout the three worlds.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸ ਸਦਾ ਫੁਨਿ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: hukame saas giraas sadaa fun hukame dekh dikhaaeidaa |12|
English: By His Hukam, we draw our breath and receive our food; by His Hukam, He watches over us, and inspires us to see. ||12||

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਦਸ ਅਉਤਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: hukam upaae das aautaaraa |
English: By His Hukam, He created His ten incarnations,

Gurbani: ਦੇਵ ਦਾਨਵ ਅਗਣਤ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: dev daanav aganat apaaraa |
English: and the uncounted and infinite gods and devils.

Gurbani: ਮਾਨੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਝੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: maanai hukam su daragah paijhai saach milaae samaaeidaa |13|
English: Whoever obeys the Hukam of His Command, is robed with honor in the Court of the Lord; united with the Truth, He merges in the Lord. ||13||

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਜੁਗ ਛਤੀਹ ਗੁਦਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: hukame jug chhateeh gudaare |
English: By the Hukam of His Command, the thirty-six ages passed.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: hukame sidh saadhik veechaare |
English: By His Hukam, the Siddhas and seekers contemplate Him.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਨਾਥੁ ਨਥਂੀ ਸਭ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬਖਸੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: aap naath nathanee sabh jaa kee bakhase mukat karaaeidaa |14|
English: The Lord Himself has brought all under His control. Whoever He forgives, is liberated. ||14||

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋਟੁ ਗੜੈ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa kott garrai meh raajaa |
English: In the strong fortress of the body with its beautiful doors,

Gurbani: ਨੇਬ ਖਵਾਸ ਭਲਾ ਦਰਵਾਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: neb khavaas bhalaa daravaajaa |
English: Is the king, with his special assistants and ministers.

Gurbani: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਲੋਭੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਲਬਿ ਪਾਪਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: mithiaa lobh naahee ghar vaasaa lab paap pachhutaaeidaa |15|
English: Those gripped by falsehood and greed do not dwell in the celestial home; engrossed in greed and sin, they come to regret and repent. ||15||

Gurbani: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਨਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਕਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: sat santokh nagar meh kaaree |
English: Truth and contentment govern this body-village.

Gurbani: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jat sat sanjam saran muraaree |
English: Chastity, truth and self-control are in the Sanctuary of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੪॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: naanak sehaj milai jagajeevan gurasabadee pat paaeidaa |16|4|16|
English: O Nanak, one intuitively meets the Lord, the Life of the World; the Word of the Guru's Shabad brings honor. ||16||4||16||

[Ang 1037 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 |
English: Maaroo, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਨ ਕਲਾ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: sun kalaa aparanpar dhaaree |
English: In the Primal Void, the Infinite Lord assumed His Power.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: aap niraalam apar apaaree |
English: He Himself is unattached, infinite and incomparable.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਸੁੰਨਹੁ ਸੁੰਨੁ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aape kudarat kar kar dekhai sunahu sun upaaeidaa |1|
English: He Himself exercised His Creative Power, and He gazes upon His creation; from the Primal Void, He formed the Void. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਸੁੰਨੈ ਤੇ ਸਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: paun paanee sunai te saaje |
English: From this Primal Void, He fashioned air and water.

Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਕਾਇਆ ਗੜ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: srisatt upaae kaaeaa garr raaje |
English: He created the universe, and the king in the fortress of the body.

Gurbani: ਅਗਨਿ ਪਾਣੀ ਜੀਉ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਸੁੰਨੇ ਕਲਾ ਰਹਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: agan paanee jeeo jot tumaaree sune kalaa rahaaeidaa |2|
English: Your Light pervades fire, water and souls; Your Power rests in the Primal Void. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਨਹੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sunahu brahamaa bisan mahes upaae |
English: From this Primal Void, Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva issued forth.

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਨੇ ਵਰਤੇ ਜੁਗ ਸਬਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sune varate jug sabaae |
English: This Primal Void is pervasive throughout all the ages.

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਪਦ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: eis pad veechaare so jan pooraa tis mileeai bharam chukaaeidaa |3|
English: That humble being who contemplates this state is perfect; meeting with him, doubt is dispelled. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਨਹੁ ਸਪਤ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਥਾਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: sunahu sapat sarovar thaape |
English: From this Primal Void, the seven seas were established.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਜੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ਆਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: jin saaje veechaare aape |
English: The One who created them, Himself contemplates them.

Gurbani: ਤਿਤੁ ਸਤ ਸਰਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: tit sat sar manooaa guramukh naavai fir baahurr jon na paaeidaa |4|
English: That human being who becomes Gurmukh, who bathes in the pool of Truth, is not cast into the womb of reincarnation again. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਨਹੁ ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਗੈਣਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sunahu chand sooraj gainaare |
English: From this Primal Void, came the moon, the sun and the earth.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: tis kee jot tribhavan saare |
English: His Light pervades all the three worlds.

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਨੇ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਸੁੰਨੇ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: sune alakh apaar niraalam sune taarree laaeidaa |5|
English: The Lord of this Primal Void is unseen, infinite and immaculate; He is absorbed in the Primal Trance of Deep Meditation. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਨਹੁ ਧਰਤਿ ਅਕਾਸੁ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sunahu dharat akaas upaae |
English: From this Primal Void, the earth and the Akaashic Ethers were created.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਥੰਮਾ ਰਾਖੇ ਸਚੁ ਕਲ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: bin thamaa raakhe sach kal paae |
English: He supports them without any visible support, by exercising His True Power.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸਾਜਿ ਮੇਖੁਲੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਖਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: tribhavan saaj mekhulee maaeaa aap upaae khapaaeidaa |6|
English: He fashioned the three worlds, and the rope of Maya; He Himself creates and destroys. ||6||

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਨਹੁ ਖਾਣੀ ਸੁੰਨਹੁ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: sunahu khaanee sunahu baanee |
English: From this Primal Void, came the four sources of creation, and the power of speech.

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਨਹੁ ਉਪਜੀ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: sunahu upajee sun samaanee |
English: They were created from the Void, and they will merge into the Void.

Gurbani: ਉਤਭੁਜੁ ਚਲਤੁ ਕੀਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਦੇਖਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: autabhuj chalat keea sir karatai bisamaad sabad dekhaaeidaa |7|
English: The Supreme Creator created the play of Nature; through the Word of His Shabad, He stages His Wondrous Show. ||7||

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਨਹੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਦੁਇ ਕੀਏ ॥
Transliteration: sunahu raat dinas due kee |
English: From this Primal Void, He made both night and day;

Gurbani: ਓਪਤਿ ਖਪਤਿ ਸੁਖਾ ਦੁਖ ਦੀਏ ॥
Transliteration: opat khapat sukhaa dukh dee |
English: creation and destruction, pleasure and pain.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਅਮਰੁ ਅਤੀਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: sukh dukh hee te amar ateetaa guramukh nij ghar paaeidaa |8|
English: The Gurmukh is immortal, untouched by pleasure and pain. He obtains the home of his own inner being. ||8||

Gurbani: ਸਾਮ ਵੇਦੁ ਰਿਗੁ ਜੁਜਰੁ ਅਥਰਬਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: saam ved rig jujar atharaban |
English: The Saam Veda, the Rig Veda, the Jujar Veda and the At'harva Veda

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਹੈ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ॥
Transliteration: brahame mukh maaeaa hai trai gun |
English: form the mouth of Brahma; they speak of the three gunas, the three qualities of Maya.

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋ ਤਿਉ ਬੋਲੇ ਜਿਉ ਬੋਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: taa kee keemat keh na sakai ko tiau bole jiau bolaaeidaa |9|
English: None of them can describe His worth. We speak as He inspires us to speak. ||9||

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਨਹੁ ਸਪਤ ਪਾਤਾਲ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sunahu sapat paataal upaae |
English: From the Primal Void, He created the seven nether regions.

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਨਹੁ ਭਵਣ ਰਖੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sunahu bhavan rakhe liv laae |
English: From the Primal Void, He established this world to lovingly dwell upon Him.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਆ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਕੀਆ ਕਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: aape kaaran keea aparanpar sabh tero keea kamaaeidaa |10|
English: The Infinite Lord Himself created the creation. Everyone acts as You make them act, Lord. ||10||

Gurbani: ਰਜ ਤਮ ਸਤ ਕਲ ਤੇਰੀ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: raj tam sat kal teree chhaaeaa |
English: Your Power is diffused through the three gunas: raajas, taamas and satva.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: janam maran haumai dukh paaeaa |
English: Through egotism, they suffer the pains of birth and death.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਣਿ ਚਉਥੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: jis no kripaa kare har guramukh gun chauthai mukat karaaeidaa |11|
English: Those blessed by His Grace become Gurmukh; they attain the fourth state, and are liberated. ||11||

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਨਹੁ ਉਪਜੇ ਦਸ ਅਵਤਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sunahu upaje das avataaraa |
English: From the Primal Void, the ten incarnations welled up.

Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੀਆ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: srisatt upaae keea paasaaraa |
English: Creating the Universe, He made the expanse.

Gurbani: ਦੇਵ ਦਾਨਵ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਸਾਜੇ ਸਭਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: dev daanav gan gandharab saaje sabh likhiaa karam kamaaeidaa |12|
English: He fashioned the demi-gods and demons, the heavenly heralds and celestial musicians; everyone acts according to their past karma. ||12||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਮਝੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh samajhai rog na hoee |
English: The Gurmukh understands, and does not suffer the disease.

Gurbani: ਇਹ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਉੜੀ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: eih gur kee paurree jaanai jan koee |
English: How rare are those who understand this ladder of the Guru.

Gurbani: ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗੰਤਰਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਰਾਇਣ ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਇਆ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: jugah jugantar mukat paraaein so mukat bheaa pat paaeidaa |13|
English: Throughout the ages, they are dedicated to liberation, and so they become liberated; thus they are honored. ||13||

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਸੁੰਨਹੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: panch tat sunahu paragaasaa |
English: From the Primal Void, the five elements became manifest.

Gurbani: ਦੇਹ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਕਰਮ ਅਭਿਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: deh sanjogee karam abhiaasaa |
English: They joined to form the body, which engages in actions.

Gurbani: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਦੁਇ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੀਖੇ ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਬੀਜਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: buraa bhalaa due masatak leekhe paap pun beejaaeidaa |14|
English: Both bad and good are written on the forehead, the seeds of vice and virtue. ||14||

Gurbani: ਊਤਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਨਿਰਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: aootam satigur purakh niraale |
English: The True Guru, the Primal Being, is sublime and detached.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਮਤਵਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: sabad rate har ras matavaale |
English: Attuned to the Word of the Shabad, He is intoxicated with the sublime essence of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਰਿਧਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: ridh budh sidh giaan guroo te paaeeai poorai bhaag milaaeidaa |15|
English: Riches, intellect, miraculous spiritual powers and spiritual wisdom are obtained from the Guru; through perfect destiny, they are received. ||15||

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਘਨੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: eis man maaeaa kau nehu ghaneraa |
English: This mind is so in love with Maya.

Gurbani: ਕੋਈ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਰਹੁ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: koee boojhahu giaanee karahu niberaa |
English: Only a few are spiritually wise enough to understand and know this.

Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਹਸਾ ਨਰੁ ਲੋਭੀ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: aasaa manasaa haumai sahasaa nar lobhee koorr kamaaeidaa |16|
English: In hope and desire, egotism and skepticism, the greedy man acts falsely. ||16||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: satigur te paae veechaaraa |
English: From the True Guru, contemplative meditation is obtained.

Gurbani: ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਚੇ ਘਰ ਬਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sun samaadh sache ghar baaraa |
English: And then, one dwells with the True Lord in His celestial home, the Primal State of Absorption in Deepest Samaadhi.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਦੁ ਸਬਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਰਾਮੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੭॥੫॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: naanak niramal naad sabad dhun sach raamai naam samaaeidaa |17|5|17|
English: O Nanak, the immaculate sound current of the Naad, and the Music of the Shabad resound; one merges into the True Name of the Lord. ||17||5||17||

[Ang 1038 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 |
English: Maaroo, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeh dekhaa teh deen deaalaa |
English: Wherever I look, I see the Lord, merciful to the meek.

Gurbani: ਆਇ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: aae na jaaee prabh kirapaalaa |
English: God is compassionate; He does not come or go in reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਜੀਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਰਹਿਓ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jeea andar jugat samaaee rahio niraalam raaeaa |1|
English: He pervades all beings in His mysterious way; the Sovereign Lord remains detached. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਗੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਛਾਇਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਾਪੁ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jag tis kee chhaaeaa jis baap na maaeaa |
English: The world is a reflection of Him; He has no father or mother.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭੈਣ ਨ ਭਰਾਉ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: naa tis bhain na bharaau kamaaeaa |
English: He has not acquired any sister or brother.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਓਪਤਿ ਖਪਤਿ ਕੁਲ ਜਾਤੀ ਓਹੁ ਅਜਰਾਵਰੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: naa tis opat khapat kul jaatee ohu ajaraavar man bhaaeaa |2|
English: There is no creation or destruction for Him; He has no ancestry or social status. The Ageless Lord is pleasing to my mind. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਅਕਾਲ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: too akaal purakh naahee sir kaalaa |
English: You are the Deathless Primal Being. Death does not hover over Your head.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਲੇਖ ਅਗੰਮ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: too purakh alekh agam niraalaa |
English: You are the unseen inaccessible and detached Primal Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਤ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਤਿ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਹਜ ਭਾਇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sat santokh sabad at seetal sehaj bhaae liv laaeaa |3|
English: You are true and content; the Word of Your Shabad is cool and soothing. Through it, we are lovingly, intuitively attuned to You. ||3||

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਵਰਤਾਇ ਚਉਥੈ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: trai varataae chauthai ghar vaasaa |
English: The three qualities are pervasive; the Lord dwells in His home, the fourth state.

Gurbani: ਕਾਲ ਬਿਕਾਲ ਕੀਏ ਇਕ ਗ੍ਰਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaal bikaal kee ik graasaa |
English: He has made death and birth into a bite of food.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰਬ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: niramal jot sarab jagajeevan gur anahad sabad dikhaaeaa |4|
English: The immaculate Light is the Life of the whole world. The Guru reveals the unstruck melody of the Shabad. ||4||

Gurbani: ਊਤਮ ਜਨ ਸੰਤ ਭਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aootam jan sant bhale har piaare |
English: Sublime and good are those humble Saints, the Beloveds of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਮਾਤੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har ras maate paar utaare |
English: They are intoxicated with the sublime essence of the Lord, and are carried across to the other side.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੇਣ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak ren sant jan sangat har gur parasaadee paaeaa |5|
English: Nanak is the dust of the Society of the Saints; by Guru's Grace, he finds the Lord. ||5||

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜੀਅ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: too antarajaamee jeea sabh tere |
English: You are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. All beings belong to You.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ ਹਮ ਸੇਵਕ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: too daataa ham sevak tere |
English: You are the Great Giver; I am Your slave.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ ਦੀਪਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: amrit naam kripaa kar deejai gur giaan ratan deepaaeaa |6|
English: Please be merciful and bless me with Your Ambrosial Naam, and the jewel, the lamp of the Guru's spiritual wisdom. ||6||

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: panch tat mil ihu tan keea |
English: From the union of the five elements, this body was made.

Gurbani: ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮ ਪਾਏ ਸੁਖੁ ਥੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: aatam raam paae sukh theea |
English: Finding the Lord, the Supreme Soul, peace is established.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮ ਕਰਤੂਤਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: karam karatoot amrit fal laagaa har naam ratan man paaeaa |7|
English: The good karma of past actions brings fruitful rewards, and man is blessed with the jewel of the Lord's Name. ||7||

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭੂਖ ਪਿਆਸ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: naa tis bhookh piaas man maaniaa |
English: His mind does not feel any hunger or thirst.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sarab niranjan ghatt ghatt jaaniaa |
English: He knows the Immaculate Lord to be everywhere, in each and every heart.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਕੇਵਲ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਭਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: amrit ras raataa keval bairaagee guramat bhaae subhaaeaa |8|
English: Imbued with the Lord's Ambrosial essence, he becomes a pure, detached renunciate; he is lovingly absorbed in the Guru's Teachings. ||8||

Gurbani: ਅਧਿਆਤਮ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: adhiaatam karam kare din raatee |
English: Whoever does the deeds of the soul, day and night,

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: niramal jot nirantar jaatee |
English: sees the immaculate Divine Light deep within.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੁ ਰਸਾਲੁ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਬੇਣੁ ਰਸਾਲੁ ਵਜਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: sabad rasaal rasan ras rasanaa ben rasaal vajaaeaa |9|
English: Enraptured with the delightful essence of the Shabad, the source of nectar, my tongue plays the sweet music of the flute. ||9||

Gurbani: ਬੇਣੁ ਰਸਾਲ ਵਜਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: ben rasaal vajaavai soee |
English: He alone plays the sweet music of this flute,

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kee tribhavan sojhee hoee |
English: who knows the three worlds.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: naanak boojhahu ih bidh guramat har raam naam liv laaeaa |10|
English: O Nanak, know this, through the Guru's Teachings, and lovingly focus yourself on the Lord's Name. ||10||

Gurbani: ਐਸੇ ਜਨ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aise jan virale sansaare |
English: Rare are those beings in this world,

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਹਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gurasabad veechaareh raheh niraare |
English: who contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and remain detached.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਤਰਹਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਜਗਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: aap tareh sangat kul taareh tin safal janam jag aaeaa |11|
English: They save themselves, and save all their associates and ancestors; fruitful is their birth and coming into this world. ||11||

Gurbani: ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: ghar dar mandar jaanai soee |
English: He alone knows the home of his own heart, and the door to the temple,

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jis poore gur te sojhee hoee |
English: who obtains perfect understanding from the Guru.

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਗੜ ਮਹਲ ਮਹਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਤਖਤੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa garr mehal mahalee prabh saachaa sach saachaa takhat rachaaeaa |12|
English: In the body-fortress is the palace; God is the True Master of this Palace. The True Lord established His True Throne there. ||12||

Gurbani: ਚਤੁਰ ਦਸ ਹਾਟ ਦੀਵੇ ਦੁਇ ਸਾਖੀ ॥
Transliteration: chatur das haatt deeve due saakhee |
English: The fourteen realms and the two lamps are the witnesses.

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਕ ਪੰਚ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਿਖੁ ਚਾਖੀ ॥
Transliteration: sevak panch naahee bikh chaakhee |
English: The Lord's servants, the self-elect, do not taste the poison of corruption.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਅਨੂਪ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: antar vasat anoop niramolak gur miliai har dhan paaeaa |13|
English: Deep within, is the priceless, incomparable commodity; meeting with the Guru, the wealth of the Lord is obtained. ||13||

Gurbani: ਤਖਤਿ ਬਹੈ ਤਖਤੈ ਕੀ ਲਾਇਕ ॥
Transliteration: takhat bahai takhatai kee laaeik |
English: He alone sits on the throne, who is worthy of the throne.

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਸਮਾਏ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਕ ॥
Transliteration: panch samaae guramat paaeik |
English: Following the Guru's Teachings, he subdues the five demons, and becomes the Lord's foot soldier.

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਸਹਸਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: aad jugaadee hai bhee hosee sahasaa bharam chukaaeaa |14|
English: He has existed from the very beginning of time and throughout the ages; He exists here and now, and will always exist. Meditating on Him, skepticism and doubt are dispelled. ||14||

Gurbani: ਤਖਤਿ ਸਲਾਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: takhat salaam hovai din raatee |
English: The Lord of the Throne is greeted and worshipped day and night.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
Transliteration: eihu saach vaddaaee guramat liv jaatee |
English: This true glorious greatness comes to those who love the Guru's Teachings.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੫॥੧॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: naanak raam japahu tar taaree har ant sakhaaee paaeaa |15|1|18|
English: O Nanak, meditate on the Lord, and swim across the river; they find the Lord, their best friend, in the end. ||15||1||18||

[Ang 1039 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 |
English: Maaroo, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਰੇ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har dhan sanchahu re jan bhaaee |
English: Gather in the wealth of the Lord, O humble Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਿ ਰਹਹੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sev rahahu saranaaee |
English: Serve the True Guru, and remain in His Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਤਸਕਰੁ ਚੋਰੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਗਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tasakar chor na laagai taa kau dhun upajai sabad jagaaeaa |1|
English: This wealth cannot be stolen; the celestial melody of the Shabad wells up and keeps us awake and aware. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: too ekankaar niraalam raajaa |
English: You are the One Universal Creator, the Immaculate King.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰਹਿ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਕਾਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: too aap savaareh jan ke kaajaa |
English: You Yourself arrange and resolve the affairs of Your humble servant.

Gurbani: ਅਮਰੁ ਅਡੋਲੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਅਸਥਿਰ ਥਾਨਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: amar addol apaar amolak har asathir thaan suhaaeaa |2|
English: You are immortal, immovable, infinite and priceless; O Lord, Your place is beautiful and eternal. ||2||

Gurbani: ਦੇਹੀ ਨਗਰੀ ਊਤਮ ਥਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: dehee nagaree aootam thaanaa |
English: In the body-village, the most sublime place,

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਲੋਕ ਵਸਹਿ ਪਰਧਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: panch lok vaseh paradhaanaa |
English: the supremely noble people dwell.

Gurbani: ਊਪਰਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: aoopar ekankaar niraalam sun samaadh lagaaeaa |3|
English: Above them is the Immaculate Lord, the One Universal Creator; they are lovingly absorbed in the profound, primal state of Samaadhi. ||3||

Gurbani: ਦੇਹੀ ਨਗਰੀ ਨਉ ਦਰਵਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: dehee nagaree nau daravaaje |
English: There are nine gates to the body-village;

Gurbani: ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੈ ਸਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: sir sir karanaihaarai saaje |
English: the Creator Lord fashioned them for each and every person.

Gurbani: ਦਸਵੈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ਆਪੇ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: dasavai purakh ateet niraalaa aape alakh lakhaaeaa |4|
English: Within the Tenth Gate, dwells the Primal Lord, detached and unequalled. The unknowable reveals Himself. ||4||

Gurbani: ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਲੇਖੁ ਸਚੇ ਦੀਵਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: purakh alekh sache deevaanaa |
English: The Primal Lord cannot be held to account; True is His Celestial Court.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਚਲਾਏ ਸਚੁ ਨੀਸਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: hukam chalaae sach neesaanaa |
English: The Hukam of His Command is in effect; True is His Insignia.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹਹੁ ਘਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak khoj lahahu ghar apanaa har aatam raam naam paaeaa |5|
English: O Nanak, search and examine your own home, and you shall find the Supreme Soul, and the Name of the Lord. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: sarab niranjan purakh sujaanaa |
English: The Primal Lord is everywhere, immaculate and all-knowing.

Gurbani: ਅਦਲੁ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: adal kare gur giaan samaanaa |
English: He administers justice, and is absorbed in the spiritual wisdom of the Guru.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੈ ਗਰਦਨਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਲੋਭੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh lai garadan maare haumai lobh chukaaeaa |6|
English: He seizes sexual desire and anger by their necks, and kills them; He eradicates egotism and greed. ||6||

Gurbani: ਸਚੈ ਥਾਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sachai thaan vasai nirankaaraa |
English: In the True Place, the Formless Lord abides.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aap pachhaanai sabad veechaaraa |
English: Whoever understands his own self, contemplates the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਚੈ ਮਹਲਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: sachai mehal nivaas nirantar aavan jaan chukaaeaa |7|
English: He comes to abide deep within the True Mansion of His Presence, and his comings and goings are ended. ||7||

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਚਲੈ ਨ ਪਉਣੁ ਉਡਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: naa man chalai na paun uddaavai |
English: His mind does not waver, and he is not buffeted by the winds of desire.

Gurbani: ਜੋਗੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਨਾਹਦੁ ਵਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jogee sabad anaahad vaavai |
English: Such a Yogi vibrates the unstruck sound current of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦ ਝੁਣਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ਵਾਇ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: panch sabad jhunakaar niraalam prabh aape vaae sunaaeaa |8|
English: God Himself plays the pure music of the Panch Shabad, the five primal sounds to hear. ||8||

Gurbani: ਭਉ ਬੈਰਾਗਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: bhau bairaagaa sehaj samaataa |
English: In the Fear of God, in detachment, one intuitively merges into the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਅਨਹਦਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: haumai tiaagee anahad raataa |
English: Renouncing egotism, he is imbued with the unstruck sound current.

Gurbani: ਅੰਜਨੁ ਸਾਰਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: anjan saar niranjan jaanai sarab niranjan raaeaa |9|
English: With the ointment of enlightenment, the Immaculate Lord is known; the Immaculate Lord King is pervading everywhere. ||9||

Gurbani: ਦੁਖ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: dukh bhai bhanjan prabh abinaasee |
English: God is eternal and imperishable; He is the Destroyer of pain and fear.

Gurbani: ਰੋਗ ਕਟੇ ਕਾਟੀ ਜਮ ਫਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: rog katte kaattee jam faasee |
English: He cures the disease, and cuts away the noose of death.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: naanak har prabh so bhau bhanjan gur miliai har prabh paaeaa |10|
English: O Nanak, the Lord God is the Destroyer of fear; meeting the Guru, the Lord God is found. ||10||

Gurbani: ਕਾਲੈ ਕਵਲੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: kaalai kaval niranjan jaanai |
English: One who knows the Immaculate Lord chews up death.

Gurbani: ਬੂਝੈ ਕਰਮੁ ਸੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: boojhai karam su sabad pachhaanai |
English: One who understands karma, realizes the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਚੋਜੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: aape jaanai aap pachhaanai sabh tis kaa choj sabaaeaa |11|
English: He Himself knows, and He Himself realizes. This whole world is all His play. ||11||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape saahu aape vanajaaraa |
English: He Himself is the Banker, and He Himself is the Merchant.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਪਰਖੇ ਪਰਖਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape parakhe parakhanahaaraa |
English: The Appraiser Himself appraises.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਸਿ ਕਸਵਟੀ ਲਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: aape kas kasavattee laae aape keemat paaeaa |12|
English: He Himself tests upon His Touchstone, and He Himself estimates the value. ||12||

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲਿ ਦਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: aap deaal deaa prabh dhaaree |
English: God Himself, the Merciful Lord, grants His Grace.

Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt rav rahiaa banavaaree |
English: The Gardener pervades and permeates each and every heart.

Gurbani: ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਵਸੈ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖੈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: purakh ateet vasai nihakeval gur purakhai purakh milaaeaa |13|
English: The pure, primal, detached Lord abides within all. The Guru, the Lord Incarnate, leads us to meet the Lord God. ||13||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਾਨਾ ਬੀਨਾ ਗਰਬੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: prabh daanaa beenaa garab gavaae |
English: God is wise and all-knowing; He purges men of their pride.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜਾ ਮੇਟੈ ਏਕੁ ਦਿਖਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: doojaa mettai ek dikhaae |
English: Eradicating duality, the One Lord reveals Himself.

Gurbani: ਆਸਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਅਕੁਲ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: aasaa maeh niraalam jonee akul niranjan gaaeaa |14|
English: Such a being remains unattached amidst hope, singing the Praise of the Immaculate Lord, who has no ancestry. ||14||

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਟਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: haumai mett sabad sukh hoee |
English: Eradicating egotism, he obtains the peace of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aap veechaare giaanee soee |
English: He alone is spiritually wise, who contemplates his own self.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਲਾਹਾ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੫॥੨॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: naanak har jas har gun laahaa satasangat sach fal paaeaa |15|2|19|
English: O Nanak, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the true profit is obtained; in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, the fruit of Truth is obtained. ||15||2||19||

[Ang 1040 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 |
English: Maaroo, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਸਚੈ ਘਰਿ ਰਹਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: sach kahahu sachai ghar rahanaa |
English: Speak the Truth, and remain in the home of Truth.

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰਹੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਜਗੁ ਤਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeevat marahu bhavajal jag taranaa |
English: Remain dead while yet alive, and cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਬੇੜੀ ਤੁਲਹਾ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur bohith gur berree tulahaa man har jap paar langhaaeaa |1|
English: The Guru is the boat, the ship, the raft; meditating on the Lord in your mind, you shall be carried across to the other side. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਲੋਭ ਬਿਨਾਸਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: haumai mamataa lobh binaasan |
English: Eliminating egotism, possessiveness and greed,

Gurbani: ਨਉ ਦਰ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਦਸਵੈ ਆਸਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: nau dar mukate dasavai aasan |
English: one is liberated from the nine gates, and obtains a place in the Tenth Gate.

Gurbani: ਊਪਰਿ ਪਰੈ ਪਰੈ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aoopar parai parai aparanpar jin aape aap upaaeaa |2|
English: Lofty and high, the farthest of the far and infinite, He created Himself. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਤਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: guramat levahu har liv tareeai |
English: Receiving the Guru's Teachings, and lovingly attuned to the Lord, one crosses over.

Gurbani: ਅਕਲੁ ਗਾਇ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਕਿਆ ਡਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: akal gaae jam te kiaa ddareeai |
English: Singing the Praises of the absolute Lord, why should anyone be afraid of death?

Gurbani: ਜਤ ਜਤ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਤ ਤਤ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jat jat dekhau tat tat tum hee avar na duteea gaaeaa |3|
English: Wherever I look, I see only You; I do not sing of any other at all. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: sach har naam sach hai saranaa |
English: True is the Lord's Name, and True is His Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਜਿਤੈ ਲਗਿ ਤਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: sach gurasabad jitai lag taranaa |
English: True is the Word of the Guru's Shabad, grasping it, one is carries across.

Gurbani: ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥੈ ਦੇਖੈ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਫੁਨਿ ਗਰਭਿ ਨ ਜੋਨੀ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: akath kathai dekhai aparanpar fun garabh na jonee jaaeaa |4|
English: Speaking the Unspoken, one sees the Infinite Lord, and then, he does not have to enter the womb of reincarnation again. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਚ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: sach bin sat santokh na paavai |
English: Without the Truth, no one finds sincerity or contentment.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: bin gur mukat na aavai jaavai |
English: Without the Guru, no one is liberated; coming and going in reincarnation continue.

Gurbani: ਮੂਲ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: mool mantru har naam rasaaein kahu naanak pooraa paaeaa |5|
English: Chanting the Mool Mantra, and the Name of the Lord, the source of nectar, says Nanak, I have found the Perfect Lord. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸਚ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਤਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: sach bin bhavajal jaae na tariaa |
English: Without the Truth, the terrifying world-ocean cannot be crossed.

Gurbani: ਏਹੁ ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਭਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: ehu samund athaahu mahaa bikh bhariaa |
English: This ocean is vast and unfathomable; it is overflowing with the worst poison.

Gurbani: ਰਹੈ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: rahai ateet guramat le aoopar har nirbhau kai ghar paaeaa |6|
English: One who receives the Guru's Teachings, and remains aloof and detached, obtains a place in the home of the Fearless Lord. ||6||

Gurbani: ਝੂਠੀ ਜਗ ਹਿਤ ਕੀ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jhootthee jag hit kee chaturaaee |
English: False is the cleverness of loving attachment to the world.

Gurbani: ਬਿਲਮ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: bilam na laagai aavai jaaee |
English: In no time at all, it comes and goes.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਖਪਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: naam visaar chaleh abhimaanee upajai binas khapaaeaa |7|
English: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the proud egotistical people depart; in creation and destruction they are wasted away. ||7||

Gurbani: ਉਪਜਹਿ ਬਿਨਸਹਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਬੰਧੇ ॥
Transliteration: aupajeh binaseh bandhan bandhe |
English: In creation and destruction, they are bound in bondage.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਗਲਿ ਫੰਧੇ ॥
Transliteration: haumai maaeaa ke gal fandhe |
English: The noose of egotism and Maya is around their necks.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੋ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: jis raam naam naahee mat guramat so jam pur bandh chalaaeaa |8|
English: Whoever does not accept the Guru's Teachings, and does not dwell upon the Lord's Name, is bound and bagged, and dragged into the City of Death. ||8||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੋਖ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: gur bin mokh mukat kiau paaeeai |
English: Without the Guru, how can anyone be emancipated or liberated?

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਿਉ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: bin gur raam naam kiau dhiaaeeai |
English: Without the Guru, how can anyone meditate on the Lord's Name?

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਤਰਹੁ ਭਵ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਏ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: guramat lehu tarahu bhav dutar mukat bhe sukh paaeaa |9|
English: Accepting the Guru's Teachings, cross over the arduous, terrifying world-ocean; you shall be emancipated, and find peace. ||9||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨਿ ਗੋਵਰਧਨ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: guramat krisan govaradhan dhaare |
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, Krishna lifted up the mountain of Govardhan.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਇਰਿ ਪਾਹਣ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: guramat saaeir paahan taare |
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, Rama floated stones across the ocean.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: guramat lehu param pad paaeeai naanak gur bharam chukaaeaa |10|
English: Accepting the Guru's Teachings, the supreme status is obtained; O Nanak, the Guru eradicates doubt. ||10||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਤਰਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਤਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: guramat lehu tarahu sach taaree |
English: Accepting the Guru's Teachings, cross over to the other side through Truth.

Gurbani: ਆਤਮ ਚੀਨਹੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: aatam cheenahu ridai muraaree |
English: O soul, remember the Lord within your heart.

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਕੇ ਫਾਹੇ ਕਾਟਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਅਕੁਲ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: jam ke faahe kaatteh har jap akul niranjan paaeaa |11|
English: The noose of death is cut away, meditating on the Lord; you shall obtain the Immaculate Lord, who has no ancestry. ||11||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪੰਚ ਸਖੇ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramat panch sakhe gur bhaaee |
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Holy become one's friends and Siblings of Destiny.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramat agan nivaar samaaee |
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, the inner fire is subdued and extinguished.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: man mukh naam japahu jagajeevan rid antar alakh lakhaaeaa |12|
English: Chant the Naam with your mind and mouth; know the unknowable Lord, the Life of the World, deep within the nucleus of your heart. ||12||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਤੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh boojhai sabad pateejai |
English: The Gurmukh understands, and is pleased with the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਿਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: ausatat nindaa kis kee keejai |
English: Who does he praise or slander?

Gurbani: ਚੀਨਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਜਗਦੀਸਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਗੰਨਾਥੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: cheenahu aap japahu jagadeesar har jaganaath man bhaaeaa |13|
English: Know yourself, and meditate on the Lord of the Universe; let your mind be pleased with the Lord, the Master of the Universe. ||13||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡਿ ਖੰਡਿ ਸੋ ਜਾਣਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: jo brahamandd khandd so jaanahu |
English: Know the One who pervades all the realms of the universe.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh boojhahu sabad pachhaanahu |
English: As Gurmukh, understand and realize the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਭੋਗੇ ਭੋਗਣਹਾਰਾ ਰਹੈ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt bhoge bhoganahaaraa rahai ateet sabaaeaa |14|
English: The Enjoyer enjoys each and every heart, and yet He remains detached from all. ||14||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੂਚਾ ॥
Transliteration: guramat bolahu har jas soochaa |
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, chant the Pure Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਆਖੀ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਊਚਾ ॥
Transliteration: guramat aakhee dekhahu aoochaa |
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, behold the lofty Lord with your eyes.

Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗਾਇਆ ॥੧੫॥੩॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: sravanee naam sunai har baanee naanak har rang rangaaeaa |15|3|20|
English: Whoever listens to the Lord's Name, and the Word of His Bani, O Nanak, is imbued with the color of the Lord's Love. ||15||3||20||

[Ang 1041 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Nanak Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 |
English: Maaroo, First Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਪਰਹਰੁ ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh parahar par nindaa |
English: Leave behind sexual desire, anger and the slander of others.

Gurbani: ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਤਜਿ ਹੋਹੁ ਨਿਚਿੰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: lab lobh taj hohu nichindaa |
English: Renounce greed and possessiveness, and become carefree.

Gurbani: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕਾ ਸੰਗਲੁ ਤੋੜਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bhram kaa sangal torr niraalaa har antar har ras paaeaa |1|
English: Break the chains of doubt, and remain unattached; you shall find the Lord, and the Lord's sublime essence, deep within yourself. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਿਸਿ ਦਾਮਨਿ ਜਿਉ ਚਮਕਿ ਚੰਦਾਇਣੁ ਦੇਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: nis daaman jiau chamak chandaaein dekhai |
English: As one sees the flash of lightning in the night,

Gurbani: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਪੇਖੈ ॥
Transliteration: ahinis jot nirantar pekhai |
English: see the Divine Light deep within your nucleus, day and night.

Gurbani: ਆਨੰਦ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਨੂਪੁ ਸਰੂਪਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੇਖਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aanand roop anoop saroopaa gur poorai dekhaaeaa |2|
English: The Lord, the embodiment of bliss, incomparably beautiful, reveals the Perfect Guru. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur milahu aape prabh taare |
English: So meet with the True Guru, and God Himself will save you.

Gurbani: ਸਸਿ ਘਰਿ ਸੂਰੁ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਗੈਣਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sas ghar soor deepak gainaare |
English: He placed the lamps of the sun and the moon in the home of the sky.

Gurbani: ਦੇਖਿ ਅਦਿਸਟੁ ਰਹਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਸਭੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: dekh adisatt rahahu liv laagee sabh tribhavan braham sabaaeaa |3|
English: See the invisible Lord, and remain absorbed in loving devotion. God is all throughout the three worlds. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਏ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭਉ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: amrit ras paae trisanaa bhau jaae |
English: Obtaining the sublime ambrosial essence, desire and fear are dispelled.

Gurbani: ਅਨਭਉ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: anbhau pad paavai aap gavaae |
English: The state of inspired illumination is obtained, and self-conceit is eradicated.

Gurbani: ਊਚੀ ਪਦਵੀ ਊਚੋ ਊਚਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: aoochee padavee aoocho aoochaa niramal sabad kamaaeaa |4|
English: The lofty and exalted state, the highest of the high is obtained, practicing the immaculate Word of the Shabad. ||4||

Gurbani: ਅਦ੍ਰਿਸਟ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: adrisatt agochar naam apaaraa |
English: The Naam, the Name of the invisible and unfathomable Lord, is infinite.

Gurbani: ਅਤਿ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: at ras meetthaa naam piaaraa |
English: The sublime essence of the Beloved Naam is utterly sweet.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: naanak kau jug jug har jas deejai har japeeai ant na paaeaa |5|
English: O Lord, please bless Nanak with Your Praise in each and every age; meditating on the Lord, I cannot find His limits. ||5||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: antar naam paraapat heeraa |
English: With the Naam deep within the nucleus of the self, the jewel is obtained.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਧੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har japate man man te dheeraa |
English: Meditating on the Lord, the mind is comforted and consoled by the mind itself.

Gurbani: ਦੁਘਟ ਘਟ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: dughatt ghatt bhau bhanjan paaeeai baahurr janam na jaaeaa |6|
English: On that most difficult path, the Destroyer of fear is found, and one does not have to enter the womb of reincarnation again. ||6||

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਹੇਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਰੰਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat het gur sabad tarangaa |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, inspiration for loving devotional worship wells up.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਮੰਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: har jas naam padaarath mangaa |
English: I beg for the treasure of the Naam, and the Lord's Praise.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਤਾਰੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: har bhaavai gur mel milaae har taare jagat sabaaeaa |7|
English: When it pleases the Lord, He unites me in Union with the Guru; the Lord saves the whole world. ||7||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਿਓ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਤਿ ਵਾ ਕੇ ॥
Transliteration: jin jap japio satigur mat vaa ke |
English: One who chants the Lord's Chant, attains the Wisdom of the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਜਮਕੰਕਰ ਕਾਲੁ ਸੇਵਕ ਪਗ ਤਾ ਕੇ ॥
Transliteration: jamakankar kaal sevak pag taa ke |
English: The tyrant, the Messenger of Death, becomes a servant at his feet.

Gurbani: ਊਤਮ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਜਗੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: aootam sangat gat mit aootam jag bhaujal paar taraaeaa |8|
English: In the noble congregation of the Sangat, one's state and way of life become noble as well, and one crosses over the terrifying world-ocean. ||8||

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰ ਤਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: eihu bhavajal jagat sabad gur tareeai |
English: Through the Shabad, one crosses over this terrifying world-ocean.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਰੀਐ ॥
Transliteration: antar kee dubidhaa antar jareeai |
English: The duality within is burnt away from within.

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਬਾਣ ਲੇ ਜਮ ਕਉ ਮਾਰੈ ਗਗਨੰਤਰਿ ਧਣਖੁ ਚੜਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: panch baan le jam kau maarai gaganantar dhanakh charraaeaa |9|
English: Taking up the five arrows of virtue, Death is killed, drawing the Bow of the Tenth Gate in the Mind's Sky. ||9||

Gurbani: ਸਾਕਤ ਨਰਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: saakat nar sabad surat kiau paaeeai |
English: How can the faithless cynics attain enlightened awareness of the Shabad?

Gurbani: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਆਈਐ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
Transliteration: sabad surat bin aaeeai jaaeeai |
English: Without awareness of the Shabad, they come and go in reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਰਾਇਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: naanak guramukh mukat paraaein har poorai bhaag milaaeaa |10|
English: O Nanak, the Gurmukh obtains the support of liberation; by perfect destiny, he meets the Lord. ||10||

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੈ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: nirbhau satigur hai rakhavaalaa |
English: The Fearless True Guru is our Savior and Protector.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat paraapat gur gopaalaa |
English: Devotional worship is obtained through the Guru, the Lord of the world.

Gurbani: ਧੁਨਿ ਅਨੰਦ ਅਨਾਹਦੁ ਵਾਜੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: dhun anand anaahad vaajai gur sabad niranjan paaeaa |11|
English: The blissful music of the unstruck sound current vibrates and resounds; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Immaculate Lord is obtained. ||11||

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸੋ ਸਿਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਲੇਖਾ ॥
Transliteration: nirbhau so sir naahee lekhaa |
English: He alone is fearless, who has no destiny written on His head.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਅਲੇਖੁ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਹੈ ਦੇਖਾ ॥
Transliteration: aap alekh kudarat hai dekhaa |
English: God Himself is unseen; He reveals Himself through His wondrous creative power.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਸੰਭਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: aap ateet ajonee sanbhau naanak guramat so paaeaa |12|
English: He Himself is unattached, unborn and self-existent. O Nanak, through the Guru's Teachings, He is found. ||12||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: antar kee gat satigur jaanai |
English: The True Guru knows the state of one's inner being.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: so nirbhau gur sabad pachhaanai |
English: He alone is fearless, who realizes the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਮਨੁ ਡੋਲਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: antar dekh nirantar boojhai anat na man ddolaaeaa |13|
