English: All the deeds which the manmukh does bring pain - nothing but pain.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਉ ਦਰਿ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: antar sabad naahee kiau dar jaae |
English: The Word of the Shabad is not within him; how can he go to the Court of the Lord?

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਦ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: guramukh sabad vasai man saachaa sad seve sukhadaataa he |11|
English: The True Shabad dwells deep within the mind of the Gurmukh; he serves the Giver of peace forever. ||11||

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤੂ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jeh dekhaa too sabhanee thaaee |
English: Wherever I look, I see You, everywhere.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਭ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: poorai gur sabh sojhee paaee |
English: Through the Perfect Guru, all this is known.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਦਾ ਸਦ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: naamo naam dhiaaeeai sadaa sad ihu man naame raataa he |12|
English: I meditate forever and ever on the Naam; this mind is imbued with the Naam. ||12||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੇ ਰਾਤਾ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: naame raataa pavit sareeraa |
English: Imbued with the Naam, the body is sanctified.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਡੂਬਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਨੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: bin naavai ddoob mue bin neeraa |
English: Without the Naam, they are drowned and die without water.

Gurbani: ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਇਕਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: aaveh jaaveh naam nahee boojheh ikanaa guramukh sabad pachhaataa he |13|
English: They come and go, but do not understand the Naam. Some, as Gurmukh, realize the Word of the Shabad. ||13||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: poorai satigur boojh bujhaaee |
English: The Perfect True Guru has imparted this understanding.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: vin naavai mukat kinai na paaee |
English: Without the Name, no one attains liberation.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸਹਜਿ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: naame naam milai vaddiaaee sehaj rahai rang raataa he |14|
English: Through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one is blessed with glorious greatness; he remains intuitively attuned to the Lord's Love. ||14||

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰੁ ਢਹੈ ਢਹਿ ਢੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa nagar dtahai dteh dteree |
English: The body-village crumbles and collapses into a pile of dust.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਚੂਕੈ ਨਹੀ ਫੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: bin sabadai chookai nahee feree |
English: Without the Shabad, the cycle of reincarnation is not brought to an end.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: saach salaahe saach samaavai jin guramukh eko jaataa he |15|
English: One who knows the One Lord, through the True Guru, praises the True Lord, and remains immersed in the True Lord. ||15||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jis no nadar kare so paae |
English: The True Word of the Shabad comes to dwell in the mind,

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: saachaa sabad vasai man aae |
English: When the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੮॥
Transliteration: naanak naam rate nirankaaree dar saachai saach pachhaataa he |16|8|
English: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Formless Lord, realize the True Lord in His True Court. ||16||8||

[Ang 1052 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਸੋਲਹੇ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo solahe 3 |
English: Maaroo, Solhay, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape karataa sabh jis karanaa |
English: O Creator, it is You Yourself who does all.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jant sabh teree saranaa |
English: All beings and creatures are under Your Protection.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aape gupat varatai sabh antar gur kai sabad pachhaataa he |1|
English: You are hidden, and yet permeating within all; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, You are realized. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har ke bhagat bhare bhanddaaraa |
English: Devotion to the Lord is a treasure overflowing.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape bakhase sabad veechaaraa |
English: He Himself blesses us with contemplative meditation on the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਸਹਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai soee karaseh sache siau man raataa he |2|
English: You do whatever You please; my mind is attuned to the True Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਹੀਰਾ ਰਤਨੁ ਅਮੋਲੋ ॥
Transliteration: aape heeraa ratan amolo |
English: You Yourself are the priceless diamond and jewel.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰੀ ਤੋਲੇ ਤੋਲੋ ॥
Transliteration: aape nadaree tole tolo |
English: In Your Mercy, You weigh with Your scale.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: jeea jant sabh saran tumaaree kar kirapaa aap pachhaataa he |3|
English: All beings and creatures are under Your protection. One who is blessed by Your Grace realizes his own self. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: jis no nadar hovai dhur teree |
English: One who receives Your Mercy, O Primal Lord,

Gurbani: ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜੰਮੈ ਚੂਕੈ ਫੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: marai na jamai chookai feree |
English: does not die, and is not reborn; he is released from the cycle of reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: saache gun gaavai din raatee jug jug eko jaataa he |4|
English: He sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord, day and night, and, throughout the ages, he knows the One Lord. ||4||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohi sabh jagat upaaeaa |
English: Emotional attachment to Maya wells up throughout the whole world,

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਦੇਵ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: brahamaa bisan dev sabaaeaa |
English: from Brahma, Vishnu and all the demi-gods.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣੇ ਸੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਗਿਆਨ ਮਤੀ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: jo tudh bhaane se naam laage giaan matee pachhaataa he |5|
English: Those who are pleasing to Your Will, are attached to the Naam; through spiritual wisdom and understanding, You are recognized. ||5||

Gurbani: ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਵਰਤੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: paap pun varatai sansaaraa |
English: The world is engrossed in vice and virtue.

Gurbani: ਹਰਖੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: harakh sog sabh dukh hai bhaaraa |
English: Happiness and misery are totally loaded with pain.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: guramukh hovai so sukh paae jin guramukh naam pachhaataa he |6|
English: One who becomes Gurmukh finds peace; such a Gurmukh recognizes the Naam. ||6||

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kirat na koee mettanahaaraa |
English: No one can erase the record of one's actions.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabade mokh duaaraa |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one finds the door of salvation.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: poorab likhiaa so fal paaeaa jin aap maar pachhaataa he |7|
English: One who conquers self-conceit and recognizes the Lord, obtains the fruits of his pre-destined rewards. ||7||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohi har siau chit na laagai |
English: Emotionally attached to Maya, one's consciousness is not attached to the Lord.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਘਣਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਆਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: doojai bhaae ghanaa dukh aagai |
English: In the love of duality, he will suffer terrible agony in the world hereafter.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੇ ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: manamukh bharam bhule bhekhadhaaree ant kaal pachhutaataa he |8|
English: The hypocritical, self-willed manmukhs are deluded by doubt; at the very last moment, they regret and repent. ||8||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: har kai bhaanai har gun gaae |
English: In accordance with the Lord's Will, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟੇ ਦੂਖ ਸਬਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kilabikh kaatte dookh sabaae |
English: He is rid of all sins, and all suffering.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੈ ਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: har niramal niramal hai baanee har setee man raataa he |9|
English: The Lord is immaculate, and immaculate is the Word of His Bani. My mind is imbued with the Lord. ||9||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jis no nadar kare so gun nidh paae |
English: One who is blessed with the Lord's Glance of Grace, obtains the Lord, the treasure of virtue.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: haumai meraa tthaak rahaae |
English: Egotism and possessiveness are brought to an end.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਅਵਗਣ ਕਾ ਏਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੀ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: gun avagan kaa eko daataa guramukh viralee jaataa he |10|
English: The One Lord is the only Giver of virtue and vice, merits and demerits; how rare are those who, as Gurmukh, understand this. ||10||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਅਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: meraa prabh niramal at apaaraa |
English: My God is immaculate, and utterly infinite.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape melai gur sabad veechaaraa |
English: God unites with Himself, through contemplation of the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਸਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: aape bakhase sach drirraae man tan saachai raataa he |11|
English: He Himself forgives, and implants the Truth. The mind and body are then attuned to the True Lord. ||11||

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: man tan mailaa vich jot apaaraa |
English: Within the polluted mind and body is the Light of the Infinite Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕਰਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: guramat boojhai kar veechaaraa |
English: One who understands the Guru's Teachings, contemplates this.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: haumai maar sadaa man niramal rasanaa sev sukhadaataa he |12|
English: Conquering egotism, the mind becomes immaculate forever; with his tongue, he serves the Lord, the Giver of peace. ||12||

Gurbani: ਗੜ ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਬਹੁ ਹਟ ਬਾਜਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: garr kaaeaa andar bahu hatt baajaaraa |
English: In the fortress of the body there are many shops and bazaars;

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਅਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: tis vich naam hai at apaaraa |
English: within them is the Naam, the Name of the utterly infinite Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad sadaa dar sohai haumai maar pachhaataa he |13|
English: In His Court, one is embellished forever with the Word of the Guru's Shabad; he conquers egotism and realizes the Lord. ||13||

Gurbani: ਰਤਨੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: ratan amolak agam apaaraa |
English: The jewel is priceless, inaccessible and infinite.

Gurbani: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਵਣੁ ਕਰੇ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: keemat kavan kare vechaaraa |
English: How can the poor wretch estimate its worth?

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਤੋਲਿ ਤੋਲਾਏ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabade tol tolaae antar sabad pachhaataa he |14|
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it is weighed, and so the Shabad is realized deep within. ||14||

Gurbani: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਿਸਥਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: simrit saasatr bahut bisathaaraa |
English: The great volumes of the Simritees and the Shaastras

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohu pasariaa paasaaraa |
English: Only extend the extension of attachment to Maya.

Gurbani: ਮੂਰਖ ਪੜਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: moorakh parreh sabad na boojheh guramukh viralai jaataa he |15|
English: The fools read them, but do not understand the Word of the Shabad. How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, understand. ||15||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aape karataa kare karaae |
English: The Creator Himself acts, and causes all to act.

Gurbani: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sachee baanee sach drirraae |
English: Through the True Word of His Bani, Truth is implanted deep within.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੯॥
Transliteration: naanak naam milai vaddiaaee jug jug eko jaataa he |16|9|
English: O Nanak, through the Naam, one is blessed with glorious greatness, and throughout the ages, the One Lord is known. ||16||9||

[Ang 1053 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 |
English: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: so sach sevihu sirajanahaaraa |
English: Serve the True Creator Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੇ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabade dookh nivaaranahaaraa |
English: The Word of the Shabad is the Destroyer of pain.

Gurbani: ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ਆਪੇ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: agam agochar keemat nahee paaee aape agam athaahaa he |1|
English: He is inaccessible and unfathomable; He cannot be evaluated. He Himself is inaccessible and immeasurable. ||1||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aape sachaa sach varataae |
English: The True Lord Himself makes Truth pervasive.

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਜਨ ਸਾਚੈ ਆਪੇ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: eik jan saachai aape laae |
English: He attaches some humble beings to the Truth.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: saacho seveh saach kamaaveh naame sach samaahaa he |2|
English: They serve the True Lord and practice Truth; through the Name, they are absorbed in the True Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਧੁਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਮੇਲੇ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: dhur bhagataa mele aap milaae |
English: The Primal Lord unites His devotees in His Union.

Gurbani: ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤੀ ਆਪੇ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sachee bhagatee aape laae |
English: He attaches them to true devotional worship.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਇਸੁ ਜਨਮੈ ਕਾ ਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: saachee baanee sadaa gun gaavai is janamai kaa laahaa he |3|
English: One who sings forever the Glorious Praises of the Lord, through the True Word of His Bani, earns the profit of this life. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰੁ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh vanaj kareh par aap pachhaaneh |
English: The Gurmukh trades, and understands his own self.

Gurbani: ਏਕਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: ekas bin ko avar na jaaneh |
English: He knows no other than the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਚੇ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: sachaa saahu sache vanajaare poonjee naam visaahaa he |4|
English: True is the banker, and True are His traders, who buy the merchandise of the Naam. ||4||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਜੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aape saaje srisatt upaae |
English: He Himself fashions and creates the Universe.

Gurbani: ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: virale kau gurasabad bujhaae |
English: He inspires a few to realize the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਚੇ ਕਾਟੇ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਫਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: satigur seveh se jan saache kaatte jam kaa faahaa he |5|
English: Those humble beings who serve the True Guru are true. He snaps the noose of death from around their necks. ||5||

Gurbani: ਭੰਨੈ ਘੜੇ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਸਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: bhanai gharre savaare saaje |
English: He destroys, creates, embellishes and fashions all beings,

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਜੰਤ ਪਾਜੇ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohi doojai jant paaje |
English: and attaches them to duality, attachment and Maya.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਜੇਵੜਾ ਗਲਿ ਫਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: manamukh fireh sadaa andh kamaaveh jam kaa jevarraa gal faahaa he |6|
English: The self-willed manmukhs wander around forever, acting blindly. Death has strung his noose around their necks. ||6||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aape bakhase gur sevaa laae |
English: He Himself forgives, and enjoins us to serve the Guru.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: guramatee naam man vasaae |
English: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Naam comes to dwell within the mind.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਸਾਚਾ ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: anadin naam dhiaae saachaa is jag meh naamo laahaa he |7|
English: Night and day, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the True Lord, and earn the profit of the Naam in this world. ||7||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: aape sachaa sachee naaee |
English: He Himself is True, and True is His Name.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh devai man vasaaee |
English: The Gurmukh bestows it, and enshrines it within the mind.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਸਿਰਿ ਚੂਕਾ ਕਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: jin man vasiaa se jan soheh tin sir chookaa kaahaa he |8|
English: Noble and exalted are those, within whose mind the Lord abides. Their heads are free of strife. ||8||

Gurbani: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: agam agochar keemat nahee paaee |
English: He is inaccessible and unfathomable; His value cannot be appraised.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee man vasaaee |
English: By Guru's Grace, He dwells within the mind.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਲੇਖਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੰਗੈ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: sadaa sabad saalaahee gunadaataa lekhaa koe na mangai taahaa he |9|
English: No one calls that person to account, who praises the Word of the Shabad, the Giver of virtue. ||9||

Gurbani: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਰੁਦ੍ਰੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: brahamaa bisan rudru tis kee sevaa |
English: Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva serve Him.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: ant na paaveh alakh abhevaa |
English: Even they cannot find the limits of the unseen, unknowable Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੂ ਅਪਣੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: jin kau nadar kareh too apanee guramukh alakh lakhaahaa he |10|
English: Those who are blessed by Your Glance of Grace, become Gurmukh, and comprehend the incomprehensible. ||10||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: poorai satigur sojhee paaee |
English: The Perfect True Guru has imparted this understanding.

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: eko naam man vasaaee |
English: I have enshrined the Naam, the One Name, within my mind.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀ ਤੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: naam japee tai naam dhiaaee mehal paae gun gaahaa he |11|
English: I chant the Naam, and meditate on the Naam. Singing His Glorious Praises, I enter the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||11||

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sevak seveh man hukam apaaraa |
English: The servant serves, and obeys the Command of the Infinite Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh hukam na jaaneh saaraa |
English: The self-willed manmukhs do not know the value of the Lord's Command.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਮੰਨੇ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: hukame mane hukame vaddiaaee hukame veparavaahaa he |12|
English: By the Hukam of the Lord's Command, one is exalted; by His Hukam, one is glorified; by His Hukam, one becomes carefree. ||12||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee hukam pachhaanai |
English: By Guru's Grace, one recognizes the Lord's Hukam.

Gurbani: ਧਾਵਤੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਇਕਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: dhaavat raakhai ikat ghar aanai |
English: The wandering mind is restrained, and brought back to the home of the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੇ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: naame raataa sadaa bairaagee naam ratan man taahaa he |13|
English: Imbued with the Naam, one remains forever detached; the jewel of the Naam rests within the mind. ||13||

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: sabh jag meh varatai eko soee |
English: The One Lord is pervasive throughout all the world.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee paragatt hoee |
English: By Guru's Grace, He is revealed.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੁ ਸਲਾਹਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: sabad salaaheh se jan niramal nij ghar vaasaa taahaa he |14|
English: Those humble beings who praise the Shabad are immaculate; they dwell within the home of their own inner self. ||14||

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa bhagat teree saranaaee |
English: The devotees abide forever in Your Sanctuary, Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: agam agochar keemat nahee paaee |
English: You are inaccessible and unfathomable; Your value cannot be estimated.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: jiau tudh bhaaveh tiau too raakheh guramukh naam dhiaahaa he |15|
English: As it pleases Your Will, You keep us; the Gurmukh meditates on the Naam. ||15||

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa tere gun gaavaa |
English: Forever and ever, I sing Your Glorious Praises.

Gurbani: ਸਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: sache saahib terai man bhaavaa |
English: O my True Lord and Master, may I become pleasing to Your Mind.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਸਚੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: naanak saach kahai benantee sach devahu sach samaahaa he |16|1|10|
English: Nanak offers this true prayer: O Lord, please bless me with Truth, that I may merge in the Truth. ||16||1||10||

[Ang 1054 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 |
English: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sevan se vaddabhaagee |
English: Those who serve the True Guru are very fortunate.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: anadin saach naam liv laagee |
English: Night and day, they remain lovingly attuned to the True Name.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਰਵਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਓਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sadaa sukhadaataa raviaa ghatt antar sabad sachai omaahaa he |1|
English: The Lord, the Giver of peace, abides forever deep within their hearts; they delight in the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: nadar kare taa guroo milaae |
English: When the Lord grants His Grace, one meets with the Guru.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam man vasaae |
English: The Name of the Lord is enshrined within the mind.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸਬਦੇ ਮਨਿ ਓਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: har man vasiaa sadaa sukhadaataa sabade man omaahaa he |2|
English: The Lord, the Giver of peace, abides forever within the mind; the mind is delighted with the Word of the Shabad. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: kripaa kare taa mel milaae |
English: When the Lord bestows His Mercy, He unites in His Union.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: haumai mamataa sabad jalaae |
English: Egotism and attachment are burned away by the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਇਕ ਰੰਗੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਕਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sadaa mukat rahai ik rangee naahee kisai naal kaahaa he |3|
English: In the Love of the One Lord, one remains liberated forever; he is not in conflict with anyone. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: bin satigur seve ghor andhaaraa |
English: Without serving the True Guru, there is only pitch-black darkness.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: bin sabadai koe na paavai paaraa |
English: Without the Shabad, no one crosses over to the other side.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਮਹਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jo sabad raate mahaa bairaagee so sach sabade laahaa he |4|
English: Those who are imbued with the Shabad, are very detached. They earn the profit of the True Word of the Shabad. ||4||

Gurbani: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਕਰਤੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: dukh sukh karatai dhur likh paaeaa |
English: Pain and pleasure are pre-ordained by the Creator.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: doojaa bhaau aap varataaeaa |
English: He Himself has caused the love of duality to be pervasive.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਅਲਿਪਤੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਵੇਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: guramukh hovai su alipato varatai manamukh kaa kiaa vesaahaa he |5|
English: One who becomes Gurmukh remains detached; how can anyone trust the self-willed manmukh? ||5||

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਜੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: se manamukh jo sabad na pachhaaneh |
English: Those who do not recognize the Shabad are manmukhs.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਭੈ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: gur ke bhai kee saar na jaaneh |
English: They do not know the essence of the Fear of the Guru.

Gurbani: ਭੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਮੁ ਕਾਢਿ ਲਏਗਾ ਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: bhai bin kiau nirbhau sach paaeeai jam kaadt legaa saahaa he |6|
English: Without this Fear, how can anyone find the Fearless True Lord? The Messenger of Death will pull the breath out. ||6||

Gurbani: ਅਫਰਿਓ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: afario jam maariaa na jaaee |
English: The invulnerable Messenger of Death cannot be killed.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabade nerr na aaee |
English: The Word of the Guru's Shabad prevents him from approaching.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣੇ ਤਾ ਦੂਰਹੁ ਭਾਗੈ ਮਤੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: sabad sune taa doorahu bhaagai mat maare har jeeo veparavaahaa he |7|
English: When he hears the Word of the Shabad, he runs far away. He is afraid that the self-sufficient Dear Lord will kill him. ||7||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਸਿਰਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har jeeo kee hai sabh sirakaaraa |
English: The Dear Lord is the Ruler above all.

Gurbani: ਏਹੁ ਜਮੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: ehu jam kiaa kare vichaaraa |
English: What can this wretched Messenger of Death do?

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਬੰਦਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਕਢਦਾ ਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: hukamee bandaa hukam kamaavai hukame kadtadaa saahaa he |8|
English: As slave to the Hukam of the Lord's Command, the mortal acts according to His Hukam. According to His Hukam, he is deprived of his breath. ||8||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਕੀਆ ਅਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh saachai keea akaaraa |
English: The Gurmukh realizes that the True Lord created the creation.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh pasariaa sabh paasaaraa |
English: The Gurmukh knows that the Lord has expanded the entire expanse.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: guramukh hovai so sach boojhai sabad sachai sukh taahaa he |9|
English: One who becomes Gurmukh, understands the True Lord. Through the True Word of the Shabad, he finds peace. ||9||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਕਰਮਿ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh jaataa karam bidhaataa |
English: The Gurmukh knows that the Lord is the Architect of karma.

Gurbani: ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: jug chaare gur sabad pachhaataa |
English: Throughout the four ages, he recognizes the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਨਮੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: guramukh marai na janamai guramukh guramukh sabad samaahaa he |10|
English: The Gurmukh does not die, the Gurmukh is not reborn; the Gurmukh is immersed in the Shabad. ||10||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh naam sabad saalaahe |
English: The Gurmukh praises the Naam, and the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: agam agochar veparavaahe |
English: God is inaccessible, unfathomable and self-sufficient.

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰਿ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਸਬਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: ek naam jug chaar udhaare sabade naam visaahaa he |11|
English: The Naam, the Name of the One Lord, saves and redeems throughout the four ages. Through the Shabad, one trades in the Naam. ||11||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh saant sadaa sukh paae |
English: The Gurmukh obtains eternal peace and tranqulity.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh hiradai naam vasaae |
English: The Gurmukh enshrines the Naam within his heart.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਕਾਟੇ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਫਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: guramukh hovai so naam boojhai kaatte duramat faahaa he |12|
English: One who becomes Gurmukh recognizes the Naam, and the noose of evil-mindedness is snapped. ||12||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh upajai saach samaavai |
English: The Gurmukh wells up from, and then merges back into Truth.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਨ ਜੂਨੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: naa mar jamai na joonee paavai |
English: He does not die and take birth, and is not consigned to reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲੈਦੇ ਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: guramukh sadaa raheh rang raate anadin laide laahaa he |13|
English: The Gurmukh remains forever imbued with the color of the Lord's Love. Night and day, he earns a profit. ||13||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh bhagat soheh darabaare |
English: The Gurmukhs, the devotees, are exalted and beautified in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sachee baanee sabad savaare |
English: They are embellished with the True Word of His Bani, and the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਹਜ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: anadin gun gaavai din raatee sehaj setee ghar jaahaa he |14|
English: Night and day, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, day and night, and they intuitively go to their own home. ||14||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: satigur pooraa sabad sunaae |
English: The Perfect True Guru proclaims the Shabad;

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: anadin bhagat karahu liv laae |
English: night and day, remain lovingly attuned to devotional worship.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗੁਣ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: har gun gaaveh sad hee niramal niramal gun paatisaahaa he |15|
English: One who sings forever the Glorious Praises of the Lord, becomes immaculate; Immaculate are the Glorious Praises of the Sovereign Lord . ||15||

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: gun kaa daataa sachaa soee |
English: The True Lord is the Giver of virtue.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh viralaa boojhai koee |
English: How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, understand this.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਸੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੨॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: naanak jan naam salaahe bigasai so naam beparavaahaa he |16|2|11|
English: Servant Nanak praises the Naam; he blossoms forth in the ecstasy of the Name of the self-sufficient Lord. ||16||2||11||

[Ang 1055 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 |
English: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: har jeeo sevihu agam apaaraa |
English: Serve the Dear Lord, the inaccessible and infinite.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: tis daa ant na paaeeai paaraavaaraa |
English: He has no end or limitation.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਮਤਿ ਅਗਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gur parasaad raviaa ghatt antar tith ghatt mat agaahaa he |1|
English: By Guru's Grace, one who dwells upon the Lord deep within his heart - his heart is filled with infinite wisdom. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: sabh meh varatai eko soee |
English: The One Lord is pervading and permeating amidst all.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee paragatt hoee |
English: By Guru's Grace, He is revealed.

Gurbani: ਸਭਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਕਰੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦੇਦਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: sabhanaa pratipaal kare jagajeevan dedaa rijak sanbaahaa he |2|
English: The Life of the world nurtures and cherishes all, giving sustenance to all. ||2||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: poorai satigur boojh bujhaaeaa |
English: The Perfect True Guru has imparted this understanding.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹੀ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: hukame hee sabh jagat upaaeaa |
English: By the Hukam of His Command, He created the entire Universe.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨੇ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: hukam mane soee sukh paae hukam sir saahaa paatisaahaa he |3|
English: Whoever submits to His Command, finds peace; His Command is above the heads of kings and emperors. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa satigur sabad apaaraa |
English: True is the True Guru. Infinite is the Word of His Shabad.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਦੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਸਤਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: tis dai sabad nisatarai sansaaraa |
English: Through His Shabad, the world is saved.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਦੇਦਾ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: aape karataa kar kar vekhai dedaa saas giraahaa he |4|
English: The Creator Himself created the creation; He gazes upon it, and blesses it with breath and nourishment. ||4||

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਕਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: kott madhe kiseh bujhaae |
English: Out of millions, only a few understand.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad rate rang laae |
English: Imbued with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they are colored in His Love.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਬਖਸੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: har saalaaheh sadaa sukhadaataa har bakhase bhagat salaahaa he |5|
English: They praise the Lord, the Giver of peace forever; the Lord forgives His devotees, and blesses them with His Praise. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਚੇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur seveh se jan saache |
English: Those humble beings who serve the True Guru are true.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਕਾਚਨਿ ਕਾਚੇ ॥
Transliteration: jo mar jameh kaachan kaache |
English: The falsest of the false die, only to be reborn.

Gurbani: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਅਥਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: agam agochar veparavaahaa bhagat vachhal athaahaa he |6|
English: The inaccessible, unfathomable, self-sufficient, incomprehensible Lord is the Lover of His devotees. ||6||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਾਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: satigur pooraa saach drirraae |
English: The Perfect True Guru implants Truth within.

Gurbani: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sachai sabad sadaa gun gaae |
English: Through the True Word of the Shabad, they sing His Glorious Praises forever.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਲਿਖਦਾ ਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: gunadaataa varatai sabh antar sir sir likhadaa saahaa he |7|
English: The Giver of virtue is pervading deep within the nucleus of all beings; He inscribes the time of destiny upon each and every person's head. ||7||

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa hadoor guramukh jaapai |
English: The Gurmukh knows that God is always ever-present.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੇ ਸੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੈ ॥
Transliteration: sabade sevai so jan dhraapai |
English: That humble being who serves the Shabad, is comforted and fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਓਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: anadin seveh sachee baanee sabad sachai omaahaa he |8|
English: Night and day, he serves the True Word of the Guru's Bani; he delights in the True Word of the Shabad. ||8||

Gurbani: ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧਾ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: agiaanee andhaa bahu karam drirraae |
English: The ignorant and blind cling to all sorts of rituals.

Gurbani: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਰਮ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: manahatth karam fir jonee paae |
English: They stubborn-mindedly perform these rituals, and are consigned to reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਾ ਦੋਰਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: bikhiaa kaaran lab lobh kamaaveh duramat kaa doraahaa he |9|
English: For the sake of poison, they act in greed and possessiveness, and evil-minded duality. ||9||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: pooraa satigur bhagat drirraae |
English: The Perfect True Guru implants devotional worship within.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad har naam chit laae |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he lovingly centers his consciousness on the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭੀਨੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: man tan har raviaa ghatt antar man bheenai bhagat salaahaa he |10|
English: The Lord pervades his mind, body and heart; deep within, his mind is drenched with devotional worship and praise of the Lord. ||10||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਅਸੁਰ ਸੰਘਾਰਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: meraa prabh saachaa asur sanghaaran |
English: My True Lord God is the Destroyer of demons.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad bhagat nisataaran |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, His devotees are saved.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: meraa prabh saachaa sad hee saachaa sir saahaa paatisaahaa he |11|
English: My True Lord God is forever True. He is the Emperor over the heads of kings. ||11||

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਸਚੇ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: se bhagat sache terai man bhaae |
English: True are those devotees, who are pleasing to Your Mind.

Gurbani: ਦਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: dar keeratan kareh gur sabad suhaae |
English: They sing the Kirtan of His Praises at His Door; they are embellished and exalted by the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਨਿਰਧਨ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵੇਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: saachee baanee anadin gaaveh niradhan kaa naam vesaahaa he |12|
English: Night and day, they sing the True Word of His Bani. The Naam is the wealth of the poor. ||12||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jin aape mel vichhorreh naahee |
English: Those whom You unite, Lord, are never separated again.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad sadaa saalaahee |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they praise You forever.

Gurbani: ਸਭਨਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਤੂ ਏਕੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: sabhanaa sir too eko saahib sabade naam salaahaa he |13|
English: You are the One Lord and Master over all. Through the Shabad, the Naam is praised. ||13||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਤੁਧੁਨੋ ਕੋਈ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: bin sabadai tudhuno koee na jaanee |
English: Without the Shabad, no one knows You.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਕਥੀ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: tudh aape kathee akath kahaanee |
English: You Yourself speak the Unspoken Speech.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਸੰਬਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: aape sabad sadaa gur daataa har naam jap sanbaahaa he |14|
English: You Yourself are the Shabad forever, the Guru, the Great Giver; chanting the Lord's Name, You bestow Your treasure. ||14||

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: too aape karataa sirajanahaaraa |
English: You Yourself are the Creator of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: teraa likhiaa koe na mettanahaaraa |
English: No one can erase what You have written.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਸਹਸਾ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: guramukh naam deveh too aape sahasaa ganat na taahaa he |15|
English: You Yourself bless the Gurmukh with the Naam, who is no longer skeptical, and is not held to account. ||15||

Gurbani: ਭਗਤ ਸਚੇ ਤੇਰੈ ਦਰਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat sache terai daravaare |
English: Your true devotees stand at the Door of Your Court.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੇ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sabade sevan bhaae piaare |
English: They serve the Shabad with love and affection.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਨਾਮੇ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸੋਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੩॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naam rate bairaagee naame kaaraj sohaa he |16|3|12|
English: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam remain detached; through the Naam, their affairs are resolved. ||16||3||12||

[Ang 1056 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 |
English: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਇਕੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: merai prabh saachai ik khel rachaaeaa |
English: My True Lord God has staged a play.

Gurbani: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਜੇਹਾ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: koe na kis hee jehaa upaaeaa |
English: He has created no one like anyone else.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਫਰਕੁ ਕਰੇ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਦੇਹੀ ਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aape farak kare vekh vigasai sabh ras dehee maahaa he |1|
English: He made them different, and he gazes upon them with pleasure; he placed all the flavors in the body. ||1||

Gurbani: ਵਾਜੈ ਪਉਣੁ ਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਵਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: vaajai paun tai aap vajaae |
English: You Yourself vibrate the beat of the breath.

Gurbani: ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਦੇਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: siv sakatee dehee meh paae |
English: Shiva and Shakti, energy and matter - You have placed them into the body.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਉਲਟੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee ulattee hovai giaan ratan sabad taahaa he |2|
English: By Guru's Grace, one turns away from the world, and attains the jewel of spiritual wisdom, and the Word of the Shabad. ||2||

Gurbani: ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਆਪੇ ਕੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: andheraa chaanan aape keea |
English: He Himself created darkness and light.

Gurbani: ਏਕੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਬੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: eko varatai avar na beea |
English: He alone is pervasive; there is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਬੁਧਿ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee aap pachhaanai kamal bigasai budh taahaa he |3|
English: One who realizes his own self - by Guru's Grace, the lotus of his mind blossoms forth. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅਪਣੀ ਗਹਣ ਗਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: apanee gehan gat aape jaanai |
English: Only He Himself knows His depth and extent.

Gurbani: ਹੋਰੁ ਲੋਕੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: hor lok sun sun aakh vakhaanai |
English: Other people can only listen and hear what is spoken and said.

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਾਚੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: giaanee hovai su guramukh boojhai saachee sifat salaahaa he |4|
English: One who is spiritually wise, understands himself as Gurmukh; he praises the True Lord. ||4||

Gurbani: ਦੇਹੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: dehee andar vasat apaaraa |
English: Deep within the body is the priceless object.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਪਟ ਖੁਲਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape kapatt khulaavanahaaraa |
English: He Himself opens the doors.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: guramukh sahaje amrit peevai trisanaa agan bujhaahaa he |5|
English: The Gurmukh intuitively drings in the Ambrosial Nectar, and the fire of desire is quenched. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਦੇਹੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sabh ras dehee andar paae |
English: He placed all the flavors within the body.

Gurbani: ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: virale kau gur sabad bujhaae |
English: How rare are those who understand, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਖੋਜੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਜਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: andar khoje sabad saalaahe baahar kaahe jaahaa he |6|
English: So search within yourself, and praise the Shabad. Why run around outside your self? ||6||

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਚਾਖੇ ਸਾਦੁ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: vin chaakhe saad kisai na aaeaa |
English: Without tasting, no one enjoys the flavor.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad amrit peeaeaa |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀ ਅਮਰਾ ਪਦੁ ਹੋਏ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਸੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: amrit pee amaraa pad hoe gur kai sabad ras taahaa he |7|
English: The Ambrosial Nectar is drunk, and the immoral status is obtained, when one obtains the sublime essence of the Guru's Shabad. ||7||

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸੋ ਸਭਿ ਗੁਣ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: aap pachhaanai so sabh gun jaanai |
English: One who realizes himself, knows all virtues.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad har naam vakhaanai |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he chants the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: anadin naam rataa din raatee maaeaa mohu chukaahaa he |8|
English: Night and day, he remains imbued with the Naam, day and night; he is rid of emotional attachment to Maya. ||8||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur sevaa te sabh kichh paae |
English: Serving the Guru, all things are obtained;

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: haumai meraa aap gavaae |
English: egotism, possessiveness and self-conceit are taken away.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਸੋਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: aape kripaa kare sukhadaataa gur kai sabade sohaa he |9|
English: The Lord, the Giver of peace Himself grants His Grace; He exalts and adorns with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||9||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਹੈ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur kaa sabad amrit hai baanee |
English: The Guru's Shabad is the Ambrosial Bani.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: anadin har kaa naam vakhaanee |
English: Night and day, chant the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੋ ਘਟੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: har har sachaa vasai ghatt antar so ghatt niramal taahaa he |10|
English: That heart becomes immaculate, which is filled with the True Lord, Har, Har. ||10||

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: sevak seveh sabad salaaheh |
English: His servants serve, and praise His Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa rang raate har gun gaaveh |
English: Imbued forever with the color of His Love, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਪਰਮਲ ਵਾਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: aape bakhase sabad milaae paramal vaas man taahaa he |11|
English: He Himself forgives, and unites them with the Shabad; the fragrance of sandalwood permeates their minds. ||11||

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੇ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥੇ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: sabade akath kathe saalaahe |
English: Through the Shabad, they speak the Unspoken, and praise the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਚੇ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: mere prabh saache veparavaahe |
English: My True Lord God is self-sufficient.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਸਬਦੈ ਕਾ ਰਸੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: aape gunadaataa sabad milaae sabadai kaa ras taahaa he |12|
English: The Giver of virtue Himself unites them with the Shabad; they enjoy the sublime essence of the Shabad. ||12||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਭੂਲਾ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh bhoolaa tthaur na paae |
English: The confused, self-willed manmukhs find no place of rest.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jo dhur likhiaa su karam kamaae |
English: They do those deeds which they are pre-destined to do.

Gurbani: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਾਤੇ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਖੋਜੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: bikhiaa raate bikhiaa khojai mar janamai dukh taahaa he |13|
English: Imbued with poison, they search out poison, and suffer the pains of death and rebirth. ||13||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: aape aap aap saalaahe |
English: He Himself praises Himself.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਮਾਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: tere gun prabh tujh hee maahe |
English: Your Glorious Virtues are within You alone, God.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਆਪਿ ਸਚਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੀ ਆਪੇ ਅਲਖੁ ਅਥਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: too aap sachaa teree baanee sachee aape alakh athaahaa he |14|
English: You Yourself are True, and True is the Word of Your Bani. You Yourself are invisible and unknowable. ||14||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਦਾਤੇ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: bin gur daate koe na paae |
English: Without the Guru, the Giver, no one finds the Lord,

Gurbani: ਲਖ ਕੋਟੀ ਜੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: lakh kottee je karam kamaae |
English: though one may make hundreds of thousands and millions of attempts.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਬਦੇ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: gur kirapaa te ghatt antar vasiaa sabade sach saalaahaa he |15|
English: By Guru's Grace, He dwells deep within the heart; through the Shabad, praise the True Lord. ||15||

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਧੁਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: se jan mile dhur aap milaae |
English: They alone meet Him, whom the Lord unites with Himself.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: saachee baanee sabad suhaae |
English: They are adorned and exalted with the True Word of His Bani, and the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੪॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: naanak jan gun gaavai nit saache gun gaavah gunee samaahaa he |16|4|13|
English: Servant Nanak continually sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord; singing His Glories, he is immersed in the Glorious Lord of Virtue. ||16||4||13||

[Ang 1057 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 |
English: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਏਕੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: nihachal ek sadaa sach soee |
English: The One Lord is eternal and unchanging, forever True.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: poore gur te sojhee hoee |
English: Through the Perfect Guru, this understanding is obtained.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਭੀਨੇ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੀਲੁ ਸੰਨਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har ras bheene sadaa dhiaaein guramat seel sanaahaa he |1|
English: Those who are drenched with the sublime essence of the Lord, meditate forever on Him; following the Guru's Teachings, they obtain the armor of humility. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: andar rang sadaa sachiaaraa |
English: Deep within, they love the True Lord forever.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad har naam piaaraa |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they love the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: nau nidh naam vasiaa ghatt antar chhoddiaa maaeaa kaa laahaa he |2|
English: The Naam, the embodiment of the nine treasures, abides within their hearts; they renounce the profit of Maya. ||2||

Gurbani: ਰਈਅਤਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: reeat raaje duramat doee |
English: Both the king and his subjects are involved in evil-mindedness and duality.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਏਕੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: bin satigur seve ek na hoee |
English: Without serving the True Guru, they do not become one with the Lord.

Gurbani: ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਰਾਜੁ ਤਿਨਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ek dhiaaein sadaa sukh paaein nihachal raaj tinaahaa he |3|
English: Those who meditate on the One Lord find eternal peace. Their power is eternal and unfailing. ||3||

Gurbani: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣਾ ਰਖੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aavan jaanaa rakhai na koee |
English: No one can save them from coming and going.

Gurbani: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jaman maran tisai te hoee |
English: Birth and death come from Him.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਗਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਤੇ ਪਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: guramukh saachaa sadaa dhiaavahu gat mukat tisai te paahaa he |4|
English: The Gurmukh meditates forever on the True Lord. Emancipation and liberation are obtained from Him. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: sach sanjam satiguroo duaarai |
English: Truth and self-control are found through the Door of the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: haumai krodh sabad nivaarai |
English: Egotism and anger are silenced through the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸੀਲੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: satigur sev sadaa sukh paaeeai seel santokh sabh taahaa he |5|
English: Serving the True Guru, lasting peace is found; humility and contentment all come from Him. ||5||

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: haumai mohu upajai sansaaraa |
English: Out of egotism and attachment, the Universe welled up.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabh jag binasai naam visaaraa |
English: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, all the world perishes.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਜਗਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: bin satigur seve naam na paaeeai naam sachaa jag laahaa he |6|
English: Without serving the True Guru, the Naam is not obtained. The Naam is the True profit in this world. ||6||

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਅਮਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa amar sabad suhaaeaa |
English: True is His Will, beauteous and pleasing through the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦ ਮਿਲਿ ਵਾਜਾ ਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: panch sabad mil vaajaa vaaeaa |
English: The Panch Shabad, the five primal sounds, vibrate and resonate.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: sadaa kaaraj sach naam suhelaa bin sabadai kaaraj kehaa he |7|
English: Through the True Name, one's actions are forever embellished. Without the Shabad, what can anyone do? ||7||

Gurbani: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਹਸੈ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਰੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: khin meh hasai khin meh rovai |
English: One instant, he laughs, and the next instant, he cries.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: doojee duramat kaaraj na hovai |
English: Because of duality and evil-mindedness, his affairs are not resolved.

Gurbani: ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਕਰਤੈ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਏ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਚਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: sanjog vijog karatai likh paae kirat na chalai chalaahaa he |8|
English: Union and separation are pre-ordained by the Creator. Actions already committed cannot be taken back. ||8||

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jeevan mukat gurasabad kamaae |
English: One who lives the Word of the Guru's Shabad becomes Jivan Mukta - liberated while yet alive.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: har siau sad hee rahai samaae |
English: He remains forever immersed in the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: gur kirapaa te milai vaddiaaee haumai rog na taahaa he |9|
English: By Guru's Grace, one is blessed with glorious greatness; he is not afflicted by the disease of egotism. ||9||

Gurbani: ਰਸ ਕਸ ਖਾਏ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਵਧਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: ras kas khaae pindd vadhaae |
English: Eating tasty delicacies, he fattens up his body

Gurbani: ਭੇਖ ਕਰੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: bhekh karai gurasabad na kamaae |
English: and wears religious robes, but he does not live to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: antar rog mahaa dukh bhaaree bisattaa maeh samaahaa he |10|
English: Deep with the nucleus of his being is the great disease; he suffers terrible pain, and eventually sinks into the manure. ||10||

Gurbani: ਬੇਦ ਪੜਹਿ ਪੜਿ ਬਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: bed parreh parr baad vakhaaneh |
English: He reads and studies the Vedas, and argues about them;

Gurbani: ਘਟ ਮਹਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: ghatt meh braham tis sabad na pachhaaneh |
English: God is within his own heart, but he does not recognize the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਤਤੁ ਬਿਲੋਵੈ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: guramukh hovai su tat bilovai rasanaa har ras taahaa he |11|
English: One who becomes Gurmukh churns the essence of reality; his tongue savors the sublime essence of the Lord. ||11||

Gurbani: ਘਰਿ ਵਥੁ ਛੋਡਹਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਧਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: ghar vath chhoddeh baahar dhaaveh |
English: Those who forsake the object within their own hearts, wander outside.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧੇ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh andhe saad na paaveh |
English: The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not taste the flavor of God.

Gurbani: ਅਨ ਰਸ ਰਾਤੀ ਰਸਨਾ ਫੀਕੀ ਬੋਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: an ras raatee rasanaa feekee bole har ras mool na taahaa he |12|
English: Imbued with the taste of another, their tongues speak tasteless, insipid words. They never taste the sublime essence of the Lord. ||12||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦੇਹੀ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਤਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh dehee bharam bhataaro |
English: The self-willed manmukh has doubt as his spouse.

Gurbani: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਰੈ ਨਿਤ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: duramat marai nit hoe khuaaro |
English: He dies of evil-mindedness, and suffers forever.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਮਨੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਇਆ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh man doojai laaeaa supanai sukh na taahaa he |13|
English: His mind is attached to sexual desire, anger and duality, and he does not find peace, even in dreams. ||13||

Gurbani: ਕੰਚਨ ਦੇਹੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਭਤਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: kanchan dehee sabad bhataaro |
English: The body becomes golden, with the Word of the Shabad as its spouse.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭੋਗ ਭੋਗੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: anadin bhog bhoge har siau piaaro |
English: Night and day, enjoy the enjoyments, and be in love with the Lord.

Gurbani: ਮਹਲਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਗੈਰ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਭਾਣਾ ਬੁਝਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: mahalaa andar gair mehal paae bhaanaa bujh samaahaa he |14|
English: Deep within the mansion of the self, one finds the Lord, who transcends this mansion. Realizing His Will, we merge in Him. ||14||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape devai devanahaaraa |
English: The Great Giver Himself gives.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਨਹੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: tis aagai nahee kisai kaa chaaraa |
English: No one has any power to stand against Him.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਥਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: aape bakhase sabad milaae tis daa sabad athaahaa he |15|
English: He Himself forgives, and unites us with the Shabad; The Word of His Shabad is unfathomable. ||15||

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeeo pindd sabh hai tis keraa |
English: Body and soul, all belong to Him.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa saahib tthaakur meraa |
English: The True Lord is my only Lord and Master.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੫॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: naanak gurabaanee har paaeaa har jap jaap samaahaa he |16|5|14|
English: O Nanak, through the Word of the Guru's Bani, I have found the Lord. Chanting the Lord's Chant, I merge in Him. ||16||5||14||

[Ang 1058 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 |
English: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਦ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh naad bed beechaar |
English: The Gurmukh contemplates the sound current of the Naad instead of the Vedas.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਆਪਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh giaan dhiaan aapaar |
English: The Gurmukh attains infinite spiritual wisdom and meditation.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: guramukh kaar kare prabh bhaavai guramukh pooraa paaeidaa |1|
English: The Gurmukh acts in harmony with God's Will; the Gurmukh finds perfection. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਉਲਟਿ ਪਰਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh manooaa ulatt paraavai |
English: The mind of the Gurmukh turns away from the world.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਦੁ ਵਜਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh baanee naad vajaavai |
English: The Gurmukh vibrates the Naad, the sound current of the Guru's Bani.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: guramukh sach rate bairaagee nij ghar vaasaa paaeidaa |2|
English: The Gurmukh, attuned to the Truth, remains detached, and dwells in the home of the self deep within. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਖੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਾਖੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur kee saakhee amrit bhaakhee |
English: I speak the Ambrosial Teachings of the Guru.

Gurbani: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਭਾਖੀ ॥
Transliteration: sachai sabade sach subhaakhee |
English: I lovingly chant the Truth, through the True Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਚਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sadaa sach rang raataa man meraa sache sach samaaeidaa |3|
English: My mind remains forever imbued with the Love of the True Lord. I am immersed in the Truest of the True. ||3||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਤ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh man niramal sat sar naavai |
English: Immaculate and pure is the mind of the Gurmukh, who bathes in the Pool of Truth.

Gurbani: ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: mail na laagai sach samaavai |
English: No filth attaches to him; he merges in the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: sacho sach kamaavai sad hee sachee bhagat drirraaeidaa |4|
English: He truly practices Truth forever; true devotion is implanted within him. ||4||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਬੈਣੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਨੈਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh sach bainee guramukh sach nainee |
English: True is the speech of the Gurmukh; true are the eyes of the Gurmukh.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਕਰਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh sach kamaavai karanee |
English: The Gurmukh practices and lives the Truth.

Gurbani: ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਅਵਰਾ ਸਚੁ ਕਹਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: sad hee sach kahai din raatee avaraa sach kahaaeidaa |5|
English: He speaks the Truth forever, day and night, and inspires others to speak the Truth. ||5||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੀ ਊਤਮ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh sachee aootam baanee |
English: True and exalted is the speech of the Gurmukh.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh sacho sach vakhaanee |
English: The Gurmukh speaks Truth, only Truth.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਚੋ ਸਚਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: guramukh sad seveh sacho sachaa guramukh sabad sunaaeidaa |6|
English: The Gurmukh serves the Truest of the True forever; the Gurmukh proclaims the Word of the Shabad. ||6||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh hovai su sojhee paae |
English: One who becomes Gurmukh understands.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: haumai maaeaa bharam gavaae |
English: He rids himself of egotism, Maya and doubt.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਉੜੀ ਊਤਮ ਊਚੀ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: gur kee paurree aootam aoochee dar sachai har gun gaaeidaa |7|
English: He ascends the sublime, exalted ladder of the Guru, and he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord at His True Door. ||7||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh sach sanjam karanee saar |
English: The Gurmukh practices true self-control, and acts in excellence.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh paae mokh duaar |
English: The Gurmukh obtains the gate of salvation.

Gurbani: ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: bhaae bhagat sadaa rang raataa aap gavaae samaaeidaa |8|
English: Through loving devotion, he remains forever imbued with the Lord's Love; eradicating self-conceit, he merges in the Lord. ||8||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਮਨੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh hovai man khoj sunaae |
English: One who becomes Gurmukh examines his own mind, and instructs others.

Gurbani: ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਦਾ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sachai naam sadaa liv laae |
English: He is lovingly attuned to the True Name forever.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਸੀ ਜੋ ਸਚੇ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: jo tis bhaavai soee karasee jo sache man bhaaeidaa |9|
English: They act in harmony with the Mind of the True Lord. ||9||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jaa tis bhaavai satiguroo milaae |
English: As it pleases His Will, He unites us with the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jaa tis bhaavai taa man vasaae |
English: As it pleases His Will, He comes to dwell within the mind.

Gurbani: ਆਪਣੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਭਾਣੈ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: aapanai bhaanai sadaa rang raataa bhaanai man vasaaeidaa |10|
English: As it pleases His Will, He imbues us with His Love; as it pleases His Will, He comes to dwell in the mind. ||10||

Gurbani: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਛੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: manahatth karam kare so chheejai |
English: Those who act stubborn-mindedly are destroyed.

Gurbani: ਬਹੁਤੇ ਭੇਖ ਕਰੇ ਨਹੀ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: bahute bhekh kare nahee bheejai |
English: Wearing all sorts of religious robes, they do not please the Lord.

Gurbani: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਾਤੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਦੁਖੇ ਦੁਖਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: bikhiaa raate dukh kamaaveh dukhe dukh samaaeidaa |11|
English: Tinged by corruption, they earn only pain; they are immersed in pain. ||11||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh hovai su sukh kamaae |
English: One who becomes Gurmukh earns peace.

Gurbani: ਮਰਣ ਜੀਵਣ ਕੀ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: maran jeevan kee sojhee paae |
English: He comes to understand death and birth.

Gurbani: ਮਰਣੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਜੋ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: maran jeevan jo sam kar jaanai so mere prabh bhaaeidaa |12|
English: One who looks alike upon death and birth, is pleasing to my God. ||12||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਸੁ ਹਹਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh mareh su heh paravaan |
English: The Gurmukh, while remaining dead, is respected and approved.

Gurbani: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: aavan jaanaa sabad pachhaan |
English: He realizes that coming and going are according to God's Will.

Gurbani: ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜੰਮੈ ਨਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: marai na jamai naa dukh paae man hee maneh samaaeidaa |13|
English: He does not die, he is not reborn, and he does not suffer in pain; his mind merges in the Mind of God. ||13||

Gurbani: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: se vaddabhaagee jinee satigur paaeaa |
English: Very fortunate are those who find the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: haumai vichahu mohu chukaaeaa |
English: They eradicate egotism and attachment from within.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: man niramal fir mail na laagai dar sachai sobhaa paaeidaa |14|
English: Their minds are immaculate, and they are never again stained with filth. They are honored at the Door of the True Court. ||14||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: aape kare karaae aape |
English: He Himself acts, and inspires all to act.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: aape vekhai thaap uthaape |
English: He Himself watches over all; He establishes and disestablishes.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: guramukh sevaa mere prabh bhaavai sach sun lekhai paaeidaa |15|
English: The service of the Gurmukh is pleasing to my God; one who listens to the Truth is approved. ||15||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh sacho sach kamaavai |
English: The Gurmukh practices Truth, and only Truth.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh niramal mail na laavai |
English: The Gurmukh is immaculate; no filth attaches to him.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: naanak naam rate veechaaree naame naam samaaeidaa |16|1|15|
English: O Nanak, those who contemplate the Naam are imbued with it. They merge in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||16||1||15||

[Ang 1059 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 |
English: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਭ ਸਾਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: aape srisatt hukam sabh saajee |
English: He Himself fashioned the Universe, through the Hukam of His Command.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਿ ਨਿਵਾਜੀ ॥
Transliteration: aape thaap uthaap nivaajee |
English: He Himself establishes and disestablishes, and embellishes with grace.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਨਿਆਉ ਕਰੇ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aape niaau kare sabh saachaa saache saach milaaeidaa |1|
English: The True Lord Himself administers all justice; through Truth, we merge in the True Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋਟੁ ਹੈ ਆਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa kott hai aakaaraa |
English: The body takes the form of a fortress.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohu pasariaa paasaaraa |
English: Emotional attachment to Maya has expanded throughout its expanse.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਭਸਮੈ ਕੀ ਢੇਰੀ ਖੇਹੂ ਖੇਹ ਰਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bin sabadai bhasamai kee dteree khehoo kheh ralaaeidaa |2|
English: Without the Word of the Shabad, the body is reduced to a pile of ashes; in the end, dust mingles with dust. ||2||

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੰਚਨ ਕੋਟੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa kanchan kott apaaraa |
English: The body is the infinite fortress of gold;

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jis vich raviaa sabad apaaraa |
English: it is permeated by the Infinite Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਚੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: guramukh gaavai sadaa gun saache mil preetam sukh paaeidaa |3|
English: The Gurmukh sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord forever; meeting his Beloved, he finds peace. ||3||

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa har mandar har aap savaare |
English: The body is the temple of the Lord; the Lord Himself embellishes it.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਵਸੈ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: tis vich har jeeo vasai muraare |
English: The Dear Lord dwells within it.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਣਜਨਿ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad vanajan vaapaaree nadaree aap milaaeidaa |4|
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the merchants trade, and in His Grace, the Lord merges them with Himself. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਸੂਚਾ ਜਿ ਕਰੋਧੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: so soochaa ji karodh nivaare |
English: He alone is pure, who eradicates anger.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੇ ਬੂਝੈ ਆਪੁ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sabade boojhai aap savaare |
English: He realizes the Shabad, and reforms himself.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: aape kare karaae karataa aape man vasaaeidaa |5|
English: The Creator Himself acts, and inspires all to act; He Himself abides in the mind. ||5||

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: niramal bhagat hai niraalee |
English: Pure and unique is devotional worship.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਧੋਵਹਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: man tan dhoveh sabad veechaaree |
English: The mind and body are washed clean, contemplating the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: anadin sadaa rahai rang raataa kar kirapaa bhagat karaaeidaa |6|
English: One who remains forever imbued with His Love, night and day - in His Mercy, the Lord inspires him to perform devotional worship service. ||6||

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: eis man mandar meh manooaa dhaavai |
English: In this temple of the mind, the mind wanders around.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖੁ ਪਲਰਿ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: sukh palar tiaag mahaa dukh paavai |
English: Discarding joy like straw, it suffers in terrible pain.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲੁ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: bin satigur bhette tthaur na paavai aape khel karaaeidaa |7|
English: Without meeting the True Guru, it finds no place of rest; He Himself has staged this play. ||7||

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਆਪਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: aap aparanpar aap veechaaree |
English: He Himself is infinite; He contemplates Himself.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: aape mele karanee saaree |
English: He Himself bestows Union through actions of excellence.

Gurbani: ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: kiaa ko kaar kare vechaaraa aape bakhas milaaeidaa |8|
English: What can the poor creatures do? Granting forgiveness, He unites them with Himself. ||8||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape satigur mele pooraa |
English: The Perfect Lord Himself unites them with the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਹਾਬਲ ਸੂਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sachai sabad mahaabal sooraa |
English: Through the True Word of the Shabad, he makes them brave spiritual heroes.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: aape mele de vaddiaaee sache siau chit laaeidaa |9|
English: Uniting them with Himself, He bestows glorious greatness; He inspires them to focus their consciousness on the True Lord. ||9||

Gurbani: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: ghar hee andar saachaa soee |
English: The True Lord is deep within the heart.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh viralaa boojhai koee |
English: How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, realize this.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: naam nidhaan vasiaa ghatt antar rasanaa naam dhiaaeidaa |10|
English: The treasure of the Naam abides deep within their hearts; they meditate on the Naam with their tongues. ||10||

Gurbani: ਦਿਸੰਤਰੁ ਭਵੈ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: disantar bhavai antar nahee bhaale |
English: He wanders through foreign lands, but does not look within himself.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਧਾ ਜਮਕਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohi badhaa jamakaale |
English: Attached to Maya, he is bound and gagged by the Messenger of Death.

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਤੂਟੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਰਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: jam kee faasee kabahoo na toottai doojai bhaae bharamaaeidaa |11|
English: The noose of death around his neck will never be untied; in the love of duality, he wanders in reincarnation. ||11||

Gurbani: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jap tap sanjam hor koee naahee |
English: There is no real chanting, meditation, penance or self-control,

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਕਮਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jab lag gur kaa sabad na kamaahee |
English: as long as one does not live to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad miliaa sach paaeaa sache sach samaaeidaa |12|
English: Accepting the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one obtains Truth; through Truth, one merges in the True Lord. ||12||

Gurbani: ਕਾਮ ਕਰੋਧੁ ਸਬਲ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaam karodh sabal sansaaraa |
English: Sexual desire and anger are very powerful in the world.

Gurbani: ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖ ਕਾ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: bahu karam kamaaveh sabh dukh kaa pasaaraa |
English: They lead to all sorts of actions, but these only add to all the pain.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: satigur seveh se sukh paaveh sachai sabad milaaeidaa |13|
English: Those who serve the True Guru find peace; they are united with the True Shabad. ||13||

Gurbani: ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਹੈ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: paun paanee hai baisantar |
English: Air, water and fire make up the body.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohu varatai sabh antar |
English: Emotional attachment to Maya rules deep within all.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤੇ ਜਾ ਤਿਸੈ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: jin keete jaa tisai pachhaaneh maaeaa mohu chukaaeidaa |14|
English: When one realizes the One who created him, emotional attachment to Maya is dispelled. ||14||

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਗਰਬਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: eik maaeaa mohi garab viaape |
English: Some are engrossed in emotional attachment to Maya and pride.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੇ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ॥
Transliteration: haumai hoe rahe hai aape |
English: They are self-conceited and egotistical.

Gurbani: ਜਮਕਾਲੈ ਕੀ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: jamakaalai kee khabar na paaee ant geaa pachhutaaeidaa |15|
English: They never think about the Messenger of Death; in the end, they leave, regretting and repenting. ||15||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਸੋ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: jin upaae so bidh jaanai |
English: He alone knows the Way, who created it.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh devai sabad pachhaanai |
English: The Gurmukh, who is blessed with the Shabad, realizes Him.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੨॥੧੬॥
Transliteration: naanak daas kahai benantee sach naam chit laaeidaa |16|2|16|
English: Slave Nanak offers ths prayer; O Lord, let my consciousness be attached to the True Name. ||16||2||16||

[Ang 1060 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 |
English: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਦਇਆਪਤਿ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: aad jugaad deaapat daataa |
English: From the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages, the Merciful Lord has been the Great Giver.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: poore gur kai sabad pachhaataa |
English: Through the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect Guru, He is realized.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁਨੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tudhuno seveh se tujheh samaaveh too aape mel milaaeidaa |1|
English: Those who serve You are immersed in You. You unite them in Union with Yourself. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: agam agochar keemat nahee paaee |
English: You are inaccessible and unfathomable; Your limits cannot be found.

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jant teree saranaaee |
English: All beings and creatures seek Your Sanctuary.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਵਹਿ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jiau tudh bhaavai tivai chalaaveh too aape maarag paaeidaa |2|
English: As is pleases Your Will, You guide us along; You Yourself place us on the Path. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹੈ ਭੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਹੋਸੀ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: hai bhee saachaa hosee soee |
English: The True Lord is, and shall always be.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਜੇ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aape saaje avar na koee |
English: He Himself creates - there is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਸਭਨਾ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਪਹੁਚਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sabhanaa saar kare sukhadaataa aape rijak pahuchaaeidaa |3|
English: The Giver of peace takes care of all; He Himself sustains them. ||3||

Gurbani: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: agam agochar alakh apaaraa |
English: You are inaccessible, unfathomable, invisible and infinite;

Gurbani: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਪਰਵਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: koe na jaanai teraa paravaaraa |
English: no one knows Your extent.

Gurbani: ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: aapanaa aap pachhaaneh aape guramatee aap bujhaaeidaa |4|
English: You Yourself realize Yourself. Through the Guru's Teachings, You reveal Yourself. ||4||

Gurbani: ਪਾਤਾਲ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਲੋਅ ਆਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: paataal pureea loa aakaaraa |
English: Your Almighty Command prevails throughout

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਰਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: tis vich varatai hukam karaaraa |
English: The nether worlds, realms and worlds of form.

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸਾਜੇ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਢਾਹੇ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: hukame saaje hukame dtaahe hukame mel milaaeidaa |5|
English: By the Hukam of Your Command, You create, and by Your Command, You destroy. By Your Command, You unite in Union. ||5||

Gurbani: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: hukamai boojhai su hukam salaahe |
English: One who realizes Your Command, praises Your Command.

Gurbani: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: agam agochar veparavaahe |
English: You are Inaccessible, Unfathomable and Self-Sufficient.

Gurbani: ਜੇਹੀ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: jehee mat dehi so hovai too aape sabad bujhaaeidaa |6|
English: As is the understanding You give, so do I become. You Yourself reveal the Shabad. ||6||

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਆਰਜਾ ਛਿਜਦੀ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: anadin aarajaa chhijadee jaae |
English: Night and day, the days of our lives wear away.

Gurbani: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਦੁਇ ਸਾਖੀ ਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: rain dinas due saakhee aae |
English: Night and day both bear witness to this loss.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਮੂੜਾ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਰੂਆਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: manamukh andh na chetai moorraa sir aoopar kaal rooaaeidaa |7|
English: The blind, foolish, self-willed manmukh is not aware of this; death is hovering over his head. ||7||

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: man tan seetal gur charanee laagaa |
English: The mind and body are cooled and soothed, holding tight to the Guru's Feet.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: antar bharam geaa bhau bhaagaa |
English: Doubt is eliminated from within, and fear runs away.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਬੋਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: sadaa anand sache gun gaaveh sach baanee bolaaeidaa |8|
English: One is in bliss forever, singing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord, and speaking the True Word of His Bani. ||8||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂ ਜਾਤਾ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: jin too jaataa karam bidhaataa |
English: One who knows You as the Architect of Karma,

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
