Transliteration: poorai bhaag gur sabad pachhaataa |
English: has the good fortune of perfect destiny, and recognizes the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਜਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: jat pat sach sachaa sach soee haumai maar milaaeidaa |9|
English: The Lord, the Truest of the True, is his social class and honor. Conquering his ego, he is united with the Lord. ||9||

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਕਠੋਰੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: man katthor doojai bhaae laagaa |
English: The stubborn and insensitive mind is attached to the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਅਭਾਗਾ ॥
Transliteration: bharame bhoolaa firai abhaagaa |
English: Deluded by doubt, the unfortunate wander around in confusion.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: karam hovai taa satigur seve sahaje hee sukh paaeidaa |10|
English: But if they are blessed by God's Grace, they serve the True Guru, and easily obtain peace. ||10||

Gurbani: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh aap upaae |
English: He Himself created the 8.4 million species of beings.

Gurbani: ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮਿ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: maanas janam gur bhagat drirraae |
English: Only in this human life, is devotional worship to the Guru implanted within.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: bin bhagatee bisattaa vich vaasaa bisattaa vich fir paaeidaa |11|
English: Without devotion, one lives in manure; he falls into manure again and again. ||11||

Gurbani: ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: karam hovai gur bhagat drirraae |
English: If one is blessed with His Grace, devotional worship to the Guru is implanted within.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: vin karamaa kiau paaeaa jaae |
English: Without God's Grace, how can anyone find Him?

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: aape kare karaae karataa jiau bhaavai tivai chalaaeidaa |12|
English: The Creator Himself acts, and inspires all to act; as He wills, he leads us on. ||12||

Gurbani: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: simrit saasat ant na jaanai |
English: The Simritees and the Shaastras do not know His limits.

Gurbani: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਅੰਧਾ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: moorakh andhaa tat na pachhaanai |
English: The blind fool does not recognize the essence of reality.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: aape kare karaae karataa aape bharam bhulaaeidaa |13|
English: The Creator Himself acts, and inspires all to act; He Himself deludes with doubt. ||13||

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sabh kichh aape aap karaae |
English: He Himself causes everything to be done.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aape sir sir dhandhai laae |
English: He Himself joins each and every person to his tasks.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: aape thaap uthaape vekhai guramukh aap bujhaaeidaa |14|
English: He Himself establishes and disestablishes, and watches over all; He reveals Himself to the Gurmukh. ||14||

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa saahib gahir ganbheeraa |
English: The True Lord and Master is profoundly deep and unfathomable.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sadaa salaahee taa man dheeraa |
English: Praising Him forever, the mind is comforted and consoled.

Gurbani: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: agam agochar keemat nahee paaee guramukh man vasaaeidaa |15|
English: He is inaccessible and unfathomable; His value cannot be estimated. He dwells in the mind of the Gurmukh. ||15||

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਹੋਰ ਧੰਧੈ ਲੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aap niraalam hor dhandhai loee |
English: He Himself is detached; all others are entangled in their affairs.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee boojhai koee |
English: By Guru's Grace, one comes to understand Him.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੩॥੧੭॥
Transliteration: naanak naam vasai ghatt antar guramatee mel milaaeidaa |16|3|17|
English: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to dwell deep within the heart; through the Guru's Teachings, one is united in His Union. ||16||3||17||

[Ang 1061 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 |
English: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੁਗ ਛਤੀਹ ਕੀਓ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jug chhateeh keeo gubaaraa |
English: For thirty-six ages, utter darkness prevailed.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: too aape jaaneh sirajanahaaraa |
English: Only You Yourself know this, O Creator Lord.

Gurbani: ਹੋਰ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਕਿ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: hor kiaa ko kahai ki aakh vakhaanai too aape keemat paaeidaa |1|
English: What can anyone else say? What can anyone explain? Only You Yourself can estimate Your worth. ||1||

Gurbani: ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: oankaar sabh srisatt upaaee |
English: The One Universal Creator created the entire Universe.

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਤਮਾਸਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: sabh khel tamaasaa teree vaddiaaee |
English: All the plays and dramas are to Your glory and greatness.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਕ ਕਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਆਪੇ ਭੰਨਿ ਘੜਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: aape vek kare sabh saachaa aape bhan gharraaeidaa |2|
English: The True Lord Himself makes all distinctions; He Himself breaks and builds. ||2||

Gurbani: ਬਾਜੀਗਰਿ ਇਕ ਬਾਜੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: baajeegar ik baajee paaee |
English: The Juggler has staged His juggling show.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: poore gur te nadaree aaee |
English: Through the Perfect Guru, one comes to behold it.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sadaa alipat rahai gurasabadee saache siau chit laaeidaa |3|
English: One who remains forever detached in the Word of the Guru's Shabad - his consciousness is attuned to the True Lord. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬਾਜਹਿ ਬਾਜੇ ਧੁਨਿ ਆਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: baajeh baaje dhun aakaaraa |
English: The musical instruments of the body vibrate and resound.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਵਜਾਏ ਵਜਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aap vajaae vajaavanahaaraa |
English: The Player Himself plays them.

Gurbani: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪਉਣੁ ਵਹੈ ਇਕ ਰੰਗੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਵਣੈ ਸਭ ਵਜਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: ghatt ghatt paun vahai ik rangee mil pavanai sabh vajaaeidaa |4|
English: The breath flows equally through the hearts of each and every being. Receiving the breath, all the instruments sing. ||4||

Gurbani: ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਨਿਹਚਉ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: karataa kare su nihchau hovai |
English: Whatever the Creator does, surely comes to pass.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabade haumai khovai |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, egotism is consumed.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਨਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee kisai de vaddiaaee naamo naam dhiaaeidaa |5|
English: By Guru's Grace, some are blessed with glorious greatness; they meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||5||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur seve jevadd hor laahaa naahee |
English: There is no other profit as great as service to the Guru.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਾਮੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: naam man vasai naamo saalaahee |
English: The Naam abides within my mind, and I praise the Naam.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਮੋ ਲਾਹਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: naamo naam sadaa sukhadaataa naamo laahaa paaeidaa |6|
English: The Naam is forever the Giver of peace. Through the Naam, we earn the profit. ||6||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: bin naavai sabh dukh sansaaraa |
English: Without the Name, all the world suffers in misery.

Gurbani: ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਵਧਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: bahu karam kamaaveh vadheh vikaaraa |
English: The more actions one does, the more the corruption increases.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: naam na seveh kiau sukh paaeeai bin naavai dukh paaeidaa |7|
English: Without serving the Naam, how can anyone find peace? Without the Naam, one suffers in pain. ||7||

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aap kare tai aap karaae |
English: He Himself acts, and inspires all to act.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee kisai bujhaae |
English: By Guru's Grace, He reveals Himself to a few.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋੜਹਿ ਮੁਕਤੀ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: guramukh hoveh se bandhan torreh mukatee kai ghar paaeidaa |8|
English: One who becomes Gurmukh breaks his bonds, and attains the home of liberation. ||8||

Gurbani: ਗਣਤ ਗਣੈ ਸੋ ਜਲੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: ganat ganai so jalai sansaaraa |
English: One who calculates his accounts, burns in the world.

Gurbani: ਸਹਸਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਚੁਕੈ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sahasaa mool na chukai vikaaraa |
English: His skepticism and corruption are never dispelled.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਗਣਤ ਚੁਕਾਏ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: guramukh hovai su ganat chukaae sache sach samaaeidaa |9|
English: One who becomes Gurmukh abandons his calculations; through Truth, we merge in the True Lord. ||9||

Gurbani: ਜੇ ਸਚੁ ਦੇਇ ਤ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: je sach dee ta paae koee |
English: If God grants Truth, then we may attain it.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee paragatt hoee |
English: By Guru's Grace, it is revealed.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: sach naam saalaahe rang raataa gur kirapaa te sukh paaeidaa |10|
English: One who praises the True Name, and remains imbued with the Lord's Love, by Guru's Grace, finds peace. ||10||

Gurbani: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jap tap sanjam naam piaaraa |
English: The Beloved Naam, the Name of the Lord, is chanting, meditation, penance and self-control.

Gurbani: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਾਟੇ ਕਾਟਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kilavikh kaatte kaattanahaaraa |
English: God, the Destroyer, destroys sins.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: har kai naam tan man seetal hoaa sahaje sehaj samaaeidaa |11|
English: Through the Name of the Lord, the body and mind are cooled and soothed, and one is intuitively, easily absorbed into the Celestial Lord. ||11||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਮਨਿ ਮੈਲੈ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: antar lobh man mailai mal laae |
English: With greed within them, their minds are filthy, and they spread filth around.

Gurbani: ਮੈਲੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: maile karam kare dukh paae |
English: They do filthy deeds, and suffer in pain.

Gurbani: ਕੂੜੋ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਰੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: koorro koorr kare vaapaaraa koorr bol dukh paaeidaa |12|
English: They deal in falsehood, and nothing but falsehood; telling lies, they suffer in pain. ||12||

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ ਕੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: niramal baanee ko man vasaae |
English: Rare is that person who enshrines the Immaculate Bani of the Guru's Word within his mind.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਹਸਾ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee sahasaa jaae |
English: By Guru's Grace, his skepticism is removed.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੇਤਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: gur kai bhaanai chalai din raatee naam chet sukh paaeidaa |13|
English: He walks in harmony with the Guru's Will, day and night; remembering the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he finds peace. ||13||

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਸਿਰੰਦਾ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aap sirandaa sachaa soee |
English: The True Lord Himself is the Creator.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਖਪਾਏ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aap upaae khapaae soee |
English: He Himself creates and destroys.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: guramukh hovai su sadaa salaahe mil saache sukh paaeidaa |14|
English: One who becomes Gurmukh, praises the Lord forever. Meeting the True Lord, he finds peace. ||14||

Gurbani: ਅਨੇਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰੇ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਵਸਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: anek jatan kare indree vas na hoee |
English: Making countless efforts, sexual desire is not overcome.

Gurbani: ਕਾਮਿ ਕਰੋਧਿ ਜਲੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: kaam karodh jalai sabh koee |
English: Everyone is burning in the fires of sexuality and anger.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਮਨੁ ਵਸਿ ਆਵੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਰੇ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: satigur seve man vas aavai man maare maneh samaaeidaa |15|
English: Serving the True Guru, one brings his mind under control; conquering his mind, he merges in the Mind of God. ||15||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਕੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: meraa teraa tudh aape keea |
English: You Yourself created the sense of 'mine' and 'yours.'

Gurbani: ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਜੰਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਜੀਆ ॥
Transliteration: sabh tere jant tere sabh jeea |
English: All creatures are Yours; You created all beings.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਸਦਾ ਤੂ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੪॥੧੮॥
Transliteration: naanak naam samaal sadaa too guramatee man vasaaeidaa |16|4|18|
English: O Nanak, contemplate the Naam forever; through the Guru's Teachings, the Lord abides in the mind. ||16||4||18||

[Ang 1062 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 |
English: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਦਾਤਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: har jeeo daataa agam athaahaa |
English: The Dear Lord is the Giver, inaccessible and unfathomable.

Gurbani: ਓਸੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਇ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: os til na tamaae veparavaahaa |
English: He does not have even an iota of greed; He is self-sufficient.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਅਪੜਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਈ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tis no aparr na sakai koee aape mel milaaeidaa |1|
English: No one can reach up to Him; He Himself unites in His Union. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਨਿਹਚਉ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jo kichh karai su nihchau hoee |
English: Whatever He does, surely comes to pass.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: tis bin daataa avar na koee |
English: There is no other Giver, except for Him.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮੇਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: jis no naam daan kare so paae gurasabadee melaaeidaa |2|
English: Whoever the Lord blesses with His gift, obtains it. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He unites him with Himself. ||2||

Gurbani: ਚਉਦਹ ਭਵਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਹਟਨਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: chaudah bhavan tere hattanaale |
English: The fourteen worlds are Your markets.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: satigur dikhaae antar naale |
English: The True Guru reveals them, along with one's inner being.

Gurbani: ਨਾਵੈ ਕਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਕੋ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: naavai kaa vaapaaree hovai gurasabadee ko paaeidaa |3|
English: One who deals in the Name, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, obtains it. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: satigur seviai sehaj anandaa |
English: Serving the True Guru, one obtains intuitive bliss.

Gurbani: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਆਇ ਵੁਠਾ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ॥
Transliteration: hiradai aae vutthaa govindaa |
English: The Lord of the Universe comes to dwell within the heart.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: sahaje bhagat kare din raatee aape bhagat karaaeidaa |4|
English: He intuitively practices devotional worship day and night; God Himself practices devotional worship. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਤਿਨੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: satigur te vichhurre tinee dukh paaeaa |
English: Those who are separated from the True Guru, suffer in misery.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: anadin maareeeh dukh sabaaeaa |
English: Night and day, they are punished, and they suffer in total agony.

Gurbani: ਮਥੇ ਕਾਲੇ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਦੁਖ ਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: mathe kaale mehal na paaveh dukh hee vich dukh paaeidaa |5|
English: Their faces are blackened, and they do not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. They suffer in sorrow and agony. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: satigur seveh se vaddabhaagee |
English: Those who serve the True Guru are very fortunate.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜ ਭਾਇ ਸਚੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: sehaj bhaae sachee liv laagee |
English: They intuitively enshrine love for the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਚੈ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: sacho sach kamaaveh sad hee sachai mel milaaeidaa |6|
English: They practice Truth, forever Truth; they are united in Union with the True Lord. ||6||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਚਾ ਦੇਇ ਸੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jis no sachaa dee su paae |
English: He alone obtains the Truth, unto whom the True Lord gives it.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: antar saach bharam chukaae |
English: His inner being is filled with Truth, and his doubt is dispelled.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਸਚੈ ਕਾ ਆਪੇ ਦਾਤਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: sach sachai kaa aape daataa jis devai so sach paaeidaa |7|
English: The True Lord Himself is the Giver of Truth; he alone obtains the Truth, unto whom He gives it. ||7||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aape karataa sabhanaa kaa soee |
English: He Himself is the Creator of all.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: jis no aap bujhaae boojhai koee |
English: Only one whom He instructs, understands Him.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: aape bakhase de vaddiaaee aape mel milaaeidaa |8|
English: He Himself forgives, and grants glorious greatness. He himself unites in His Union. ||8||

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਦਿਆ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: haumai karadiaa janam gavaaeaa |
English: Acting egotistically, one loses his life.

Gurbani: ਆਗੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: aagai mohu na chookai maaeaa |
English: Even in the world hereafter, emotioal attachment to Maya does not leave him.

Gurbani: ਅਗੈ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਲੇਖਾ ਲੇਵੈ ਜਿਉ ਤਿਲ ਘਾਣੀ ਪੀੜਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: agai jamakaal lekhaa levai jiau til ghaanee peerraaeidaa |9|
English: In the world hereafter, the Messenger of Death calls him to account, and crushes him like sesame seeds in the oil-press. ||9||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: poorai bhaag gur sevaa hoee |
English: By perfect destiny, one serves the Guru.

Gurbani: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਸੇਵੇ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: nadar kare taa seve koee |
English: If God grants His Grace, then one serves.

Gurbani: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਮਹਲਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: jamakaal tis nerr na aavai mehal sachai sukh paaeidaa |10|
English: The Messenger of Death cannot even approach him, and in the Mansion of the True Lord's Presence, he finds peace. ||10||

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: tin sukh paaeaa jo tudh bhaae |
English: They alone find peace, who are pleasing to Your Will.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: poorai bhaag gur sevaa laae |
English: By perfect destiny, they are attached to the Guru's service.

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੈ ਹਥਿ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: terai hath hai sabh vaddiaaee jis deveh so paaeidaa |11|
English: All glorious greatness rests in Your Hands; he alone obtains it, unto whom You give it. ||11||

Gurbani: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: andar paragaas guroo te paae |
English: Through the Guru, one's inner being is enlightened and illumined.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: naam padaarath man vasaae |
English: The wealth of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to dwell in the mind.

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: giaan ratan sadaa ghatt chaanan agiaan andher gavaaeidaa |12|
English: The jewel of spiritual wisdom ever illumines the heart, and the darkness of spiritual ignorance is dispelled. ||12||

Gurbani: ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: agiaanee andhe doojai laage |
English: The blind and ignorant are attached to duality.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਡੁਬਿ ਮੂਏ ਅਭਾਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: bin paanee ddub mooe abhaage |
English: The unfortunates are drowned without water, and die.

Gurbani: ਚਲਦਿਆ ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਾਧਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: chaladiaa ghar dar nadar na aavai jam dar baadhaa dukh paaeidaa |13|
English: When they depart from the world, they do not find the Lord's door and home; bound and gagged at Death's door, they suffer in pain. ||13||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: bin satigur seve mukat na hoee |
English: Without serving the True Guru, no one finds liberation.

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: giaanee dhiaanee poochhahu koee |
English: Go ask any spiritual teacher or meditator.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: satigur seve tis milai vaddiaaee dar sachai sobhaa paaeidaa |14|
English: Whoever serves the True Guru is blessed with glorious greatness, and honored in the Court of the True Lord. ||14||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨੋ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: satigur no seve tis aap milaae |
English: One who serves the True Guru, the Lord merges into Himself.

Gurbani: ਮਮਤਾ ਕਾਟਿ ਸਚਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: mamataa kaatt sach liv laae |
English: Cutting away attachment, one lovingly focuses on the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਵਣਜਹਿ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਨਾਮੋ ਲਾਹਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: sadaa sach vanajeh vaapaaree naamo laahaa paaeidaa |15|
English: The merchants deal forever in Truth; they earn the profit of the Naam. ||15||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape kare karaae karataa |
English: The Creator Himself acts, and inspires all to act.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabad marai soee jan mukataa |
English: He alone is liberated, who dies in the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੫॥੧੯॥
Transliteration: naanak naam vasai man antar naamo naam dhiaaeidaa |16|5|19|
English: O Nanak, the Naam dwells deep within the mind; meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||16||5||19||

[Ang 1063 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 |
English: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੋ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jo tudh karanaa so kar paaeaa |
English: Whatever You do, is done.

Gurbani: ਭਾਣੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: bhaane vich ko viralaa aaeaa |
English: How rare are those who walk in harmony with the Lord's Will.

Gurbani: ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨੇ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਭਾਣੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bhaanaa mane so sukh paae bhaane vich sukh paaeidaa |1|
English: One who surrenders to the Lord's Will finds peace; he finds peace in the Lord's Will. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh teraa bhaanaa bhaavai |
English: Your Will is pleasing to the Gurmukh.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: sahaje hee sukh sach kamaavai |
English: Practicing Truth, he intuitively finds peace.

Gurbani: ਭਾਣੇ ਨੋ ਲੋਚੈ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਨਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: bhaane no lochai bahuteree aapanaa bhaanaa aap manaaeidaa |2|
English: Many long to walk in harmony with the Lord's Will; He Himself inspires us to surrender to His Will. ||2||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨੇ ਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: teraa bhaanaa mane su milai tudh aae |
English: One who surrenders to Your Will, meets with You, Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jis bhaanaa bhaavai so tujheh samaae |
English: One who is pleased with Your Will is immersed in You.

Gurbani: ਭਾਣੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਭਾਣਾ ਕਿਸਹਿ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: bhaane vich vaddee vaddiaaee bhaanaa kiseh karaaeidaa |3|
English: Glorious greatness rests in God's Will; rare are those who accept it. ||3||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jaa tis bhaavai taa guroo milaae |
English: When it pleases His Will, He leads us to meet the Guru.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh naam padaarath paae |
English: The Gurmukh finds the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਣੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਭਾਣਾ ਦੇਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: tudh aapanai bhaanai sabh srisatt upaaee jis no bhaanaa dehi tis bhaaeidaa |4|
English: By Your Will, You created the whole Universe; those whom You bless with Your favor are pleased with Your Will. ||4||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਰੇ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh andh kare chaturaaee |
English: The blind, self-willed manmukhs practice cleverness.

Gurbani: ਭਾਣਾ ਨ ਮੰਨੇ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: bhaanaa na mane bahut dukh paaee |
English: They do not surrender to the Lord's Will, and suffer terrible pain.

Gurbani: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਏ ਘਰੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: bharame bhoolaa aavai jaae ghar mehal na kabahoo paaeidaa |5|
English: Deluded by doubt, they come and go in reincarnation; they never find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||5||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur mele de vaddiaaee |
English: The True Guru brings Union, and grants glorious greatness.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਧੁਰਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur kee sevaa dhur furamaaee |
English: The Primal Lord ordained service to the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: satigur seve taa naam paae naame hee sukh paaeidaa |6|
English: Serving the True Guru, the Naam is obtained. Through the Naam, one finds peace. ||6||

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਛੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: sabh naavahu upajai naavahu chheejai |
English: Everything wells up from the Naam, and through the Naam, perishes.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur kirapaa te man tan bheejai |
English: By Guru's Grace, the mind and body are pleased with the Naam.

Gurbani: ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਰਸਿ ਭੀਜੈ ਰਸ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: rasanaa naam dhiaae ras bheejai ras hee te ras paaeidaa |7|
English: Meditating on the Naam, the tongue is drenched with the Lord's sublime essence. Through this essence, the Essence is obtained. ||7||

Gurbani: ਮਹਲੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਕੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: mahalai andar mehal ko paae |
English: Rare are those who find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence within the mansion of their own body.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad sach chit laae |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they lovingly focus their consciousness on the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਚੁ ਦੇਇ ਸੋਈ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਏ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: jis no sach dee soee sach paae sache sach milaaeidaa |8|
English: Whoever the Lord blesses with Truth obtains Truth; he merges in Truth, and only Truth. ||8||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: naam visaar man tan dukh paaeaa |
English: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind and body suffer in pain.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohu sabh rog kamaaeaa |
English: Attached to the love of Maya, he earns nothing but disease.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੈ ਕੁਸਟੀ ਨਰਕੇ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: bin naavai man tan hai kusattee narake vaasaa paaeidaa |9|
English: Without the Name, his mind and body are afflicted with leprosy, and he obtains his home in hell. ||9||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਦੇਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: naam rate tin niramal dehaa |
English: Those who are imbued with the Naam - their bodies are immaculate and pure.

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੰਸਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਨੇਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: niramal hansaa sadaa sukh nehaa |
English: Their soul-swan is immaculate, and in the Lord's Love, they find eternal peace.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: naam salaeh sadaa sukh paaeaa nij ghar vaasaa paaeidaa |10|
English: Praising the Naam, they find eternal peace, and dwell in the home of their own inner being. ||10||

Gurbani: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabh ko vanaj kare vaapaaraa |
English: Everyone deals and trades.

Gurbani: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਤੋਟਾ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: vin naavai sabh tottaa sansaaraa |
English: Without the Name, all the world loses.

Gurbani: ਨਾਗੋ ਆਇਆ ਨਾਗੋ ਜਾਸੀ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: naago aaeaa naago jaasee vin naavai dukh paaeidaa |11|
English: Naked they come, and naked they go; without the Name, they suffer in pain. ||11||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: jis no naam dee so paae |
English: He alone obtains the Naam, unto whom the Lord gives it.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad har man vasaae |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: gur kirapaa te naam vasiaa ghatt antar naamo naam dhiaaeidaa |12|
English: By Guru's Grace, the Naam dwells deep within the heart, and one meditates upon the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||12||

Gurbani: ਨਾਵੈ ਨੋ ਲੋਚੈ ਜੇਤੀ ਸਭ ਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: naavai no lochai jetee sabh aaee |
English: Everyone who comes into the world, longs for the Name.

Gurbani: ਨਾਉ ਤਿਨਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: naau tinaa milai dhur purab kamaaee |
English: They alone are blessed with the Name, whose past actions were so ordained by the Primal Lord.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: jinee naau paaeaa se vaddabhaagee gur kai sabad milaaeidaa |13|
English: Those who obtain the Name are very fortunate. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they are united with God. ||13||

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋਟੁ ਅਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa kott at apaaraa |
English: Utterly incomparable is the fortress of the body.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਬਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: tis vich beh prabh kare veechaaraa |
English: Within it, God sits in contemplation.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਨਿਆਉ ਸਚੋ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: sachaa niaau sacho vaapaaraa nihachal vaasaa paaeidaa |14|
English: He administers true justice, and trades in Truth; through Him, one finds the eternal, unchanging dwelling. ||14||

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰ ਘਰ ਬੰਕੇ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: antar ghar banke thaan suhaaeaa |
English: Deep within the inner self are glorious homes and beautiful places.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਥਾਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh viralai kinai thaan paaeaa |
English: But rare is that person who, as Gurmukh, finds these places.

Gurbani: ਇਤੁ ਸਾਥਿ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ਸਚੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: eit saath nibahai saalaahe sache har sachaa man vasaaeidaa |15|
English: If one stays in these places, and praises the True Lord, the True Lord comes to dwell in the mind. ||15||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੈ ਕਰਤੈ ਇਕ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: merai karatai ik banat banaaee |
English: My Creator Lord has formed this formation.

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਭ ਵਥੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: eis dehee vich sabh vath paaee |
English: He has placed everything within this body.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਣਜਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੬॥੨੦॥
Transliteration: naanak naam vanajeh rang raate guramukh ko naam paaeidaa |16|6|20|
English: O Nanak, those who deal in the Naam are imbued with His Love. The Gurmukh obtains the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||16||6||20||

[Ang 1064 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 |
English: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa kanchan sabad veechaaraa |
English: Contemplating the Word of the Shabad, the body becomes golden.

Gurbani: ਤਿਥੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: tithai har vasai jis daa ant na paaraavaaraa |
English: The Lord abides there; He has no end or limitation.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: anadin har sevihu sachee baanee har jeeo sabad milaaeidaa |1|
English: Night and day, serve the Lord, and chant the True Word of the Guru's Bani. Through the Shabad, meet the Dear Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har cheteh tin balihaarai jaau |
English: I am a sacrifice to those who remember the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਿਨ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad tin mel milaau |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I unite in Union with the Lord.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਲਾਈ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: tin kee dhoor laaee mukh masatak satasangat beh gun gaaeidaa |2|
English: I touch the dust of their feet to my face and forehead; sitting in the Society of the Saints, I sing His Glorious Praises. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: har ke gun gaavaa je har prabh bhaavaa |
English: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, as I am pleasing to the Lord God.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: antar har naam sabad suhaavaa |
English: With the Lord's Name deep within my inner being, I am adorned with the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਡੀ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gurabaanee chahu kunddee suneeai saachai naam samaaeidaa |3|
English: The Word of the Guru's Bani is heard throughout the four corners of the world; through it, we merge in the True Name. ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਜਿ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਭਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: so jan saachaa ji antar bhaale |
English: That humble being, who searches within himself,

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad har nadar nihaale |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, sees the Lord with his eyes.

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਨਦਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: giaan anjan paae gurasabadee nadaree nadar milaaeidaa |4|
English: Through the Guru's Shabad, he applies the ointment of spiritual wisdom to his eyes; the Gracious Lord, in His Grace, unites him with Himself. ||4||

Gurbani: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: vaddai bhaag ihu sareer paaeaa |
English: By great good fortune, I obtained this body;

Gurbani: ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: maanas janam sabad chit laaeaa |
English: in this human life, I have focused my consciousness on the Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਸਭੁ ਅੰਧ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: bin sabadai sabh andh andheraa guramukh kiseh bujhaaeidaa |5|
English: Without the Shabad, everything is enveloped in utter darkness; only the Gurmukh understands. ||5||

Gurbani: ਇਕਿ ਕਿਤੁ ਆਏ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: eik kit aae janam gavaae |
English: Some merely waste away their lives - why have they even come into the world?

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਲਾਗੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh laage doojai bhaae |
English: The self-willed manmukhs are attached to the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਏਹ ਵੇਲਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਹਾਥਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਪਗਿ ਖਿਸਿਐ ਪਛੁਤਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: eeh velaa fir haath na aavai pag khisiai pachhutaaeidaa |6|
English: This opportunity shall not into their hands again; their foot slips, and they come to regret and repent. ||6||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad pavitru sareeraa |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the body is sanctified.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਚੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: tis vich vasai sach gunee gaheeraa |
English: The True Lord, the ocean of virtue, dwells within it.

Gurbani: ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: sacho sach vekhai sabh thaaee sach sun man vasaaeidaa |7|
English: One who sees the Truest of the True everywhere, hears the Truth, and enshrines it within his mind. ||7||

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਗਣਤ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: haumai ganat gur sabad nivaare |
English: Egotism and mental calculations are relieved through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਖਹੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: har jeeo hiradai rakhahu ur dhaare |
English: Keep the Dear Lord close, and enshrine Him in your heart.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad sadaa saalaahe mil saache sukh paaeidaa |8|
English: One who praises the Lord forever, through the Guru's Shabad, meets with the True Lord, and finds peace. ||8||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਚੇਤੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਚੇਤਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: so chete jis aap chetaae |
English: He alone remembers the Lord, whom the Lord inspires to remember.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad vasai man aae |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He comes to dwell in the mind.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਆਪੇ ਬੂਝੈ ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: aape vekhai aape boojhai aapai aap samaaeidaa |9|
English: He Himself sees, and He Himself understands; He merges all into Himself. ||9||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਮਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਥੁ ਪਾਈ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: jin man vich vath paaee soee jaanai |
English: He alone knows, who has placed the object within his mind.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabade aap pachhaanai |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he comes to understand himself.

Gurbani: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: aap pachhaanai soee jan niramal baanee sabad sunaaeidaa |10|
English: That humble being who understands himself is immaculate. He proclaims the Guru's Bani, and the Word of the Shabad. ||10||

Gurbani: ਏਹ ਕਾਇਆ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: eeh kaaeaa pavit hai sareer |
English: This body is sanctified and purified;

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਚੇਤੈ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: gurasabadee chetai gunee gaheer |
English: through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it contemplates the Lord, the ocean of virtue.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: anadin gun gaavai rang raataa gun keh gunee samaaeidaa |11|
English: One who chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord night and day, and remains attuned to His Love, chants His Glorious Virtues, immersed in the Glorious Lord. ||11||

Gurbani: ਏਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਸਭ ਮੂਲੁ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: ehu sareer sabh mool hai maaeaa |
English: This body is the source of all Maya;

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: doojai bhaae bharam bhulaaeaa |
English: in love with duality, it is deluded by doubt.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: har na chetai sadaa dukh paae bin har chete dukh paaeidaa |12|
English: It does not remember the Lord, and suffers in eternal pain. Without remembering the Lord, it suffers in pain. ||12||

Gurbani: ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: ji satigur seve so paravaan |
English: One who serves the True Guru is approved and respected.

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਹੰਸੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa hans niramal dar sachai jaan |
English: His body and soul-swan are immaculate and pure; in the Court of the Lord, he is known to be true.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵੇ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ਸੋਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: har seve har man vasaae sohai har gun gaaeidaa |13|
English: He serves the Lord, and enshrines the Lord in his mind; he is exalted, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||13||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: bin bhaagaa gur seviaa na jaae |
English: Without good destiny, no one can serve the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭੂਲੇ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh bhoole mue bilalaae |
English: The self-willed manmukhs are deluded, and die weeping and wailing.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੇਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: jin kau nadar hovai gur keree har jeeo aap milaaeidaa |14|
English: Those who are blessed by the Guru's Glance of Grace - the Dear Lord unites them with Himself. ||14||

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋਟੁ ਪਕੇ ਹਟਨਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa kott pake hattanaale |
English: In the body fortress, are the solidly-constructed markets.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲੇਵੈ ਵਸਤੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh levai vasat samaale |
English: The Gurmukh purchases the object, and takes care of it.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਊਤਮ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam dhiaae din raatee aootam padavee paaeidaa |15|
English: Meditating on the Name of the Lord, day and night, he attains the sublime, exalted status. ||15||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਚਾ ਹੈ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape sachaa hai sukhadaataa |
English: The True Lord Himself is the Giver of peace.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: poore gur kai sabad pachhaataa |
English: Through the Shabad of the Perfect Guru, He is realized.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਕੋ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੭॥੨੧॥
Transliteration: naanak naam salaahe saachaa poorai bhaag ko paaeidaa |16|7|21|
English: Nanak praises the Naam, the True Name of the Lord; through perfect destiny, He is found. ||16||7||21||

[Ang 1066 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 |
English: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਿ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: nirankaar aakaar upaaeaa |
English: The Formless Lord created the universe of form.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਬਣਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohu hukam banaaeaa |
English: By the Hukam of His Command, He created attachment to Maya.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲ ਕਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਦਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aape khel kare sabh karataa sun saachaa man vasaaeidaa |1|
English: The Creator Himself stages all the plays; hearing of the True Lord, enshrine Him in your mind. ||1||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਾਈ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਸੂਤਿ ਜਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa maaee trai gun parasoot jamaaeaa |
English: Maya, the mother, gave birth to the three gunas, the three qualities,

Gurbani: ਚਾਰੇ ਬੇਦ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਨੋ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: chaare bed brahame no furamaaeaa |
English: and proclaimed the four Vedas to Brahma.

Gurbani: ਵਰ੍ਹੇ ਮਾਹ ਵਾਰ ਥਿਤੀ ਕਰਿ ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: varhe maah vaar thitee kar is jag meh sojhee paaeidaa |2|
English: Creating the years, months, days and dates, He infused intelligence into the world. ||2||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: gur sevaa te karanee saar |
English: Service to the Guru is the most excellent action.

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam raakhahu ur dhaar |
English: Enshrine the Lord's Name within your heart.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਵਰਤੀ ਜਗ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਇਸੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: gurabaanee varatee jag antar is baanee te har naam paaeidaa |3|
English: The Word of the Guru's Bani prevails throughout the world; through this Bani, the Lord's Name is obtained. ||3||

Gurbani: ਵੇਦੁ ਪੜੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਵਾਦ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: ved parrai anadin vaad samaale |
English: He reads the Vedas, but he starts arguments night and day.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਬਧਾ ਜਮਕਾਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: naam na chetai badhaa jamakaale |
English: He does not remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord; he is bound and gagged by the Messenger of Death.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: doojai bhaae sadaa dukh paae trai gun bharam bhulaaeidaa |4|
English: In the love of duality, he suffers in pain forever; he is deluded by doubt, and confused by the three gunas. ||4||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh ekas siau liv laae |
English: The Gurmukh is in love with the One Lord alone;

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: tribidh manasaa maneh samaae |
English: he submerges in his mind the three-phased desire.

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: saachai sabad sadaa hai mukataa maaeaa mohu chukaaeidaa |5|
English: Through the True Word of the Shabad, he is liberated forever; he renounces emotional attachment to Maya. ||5||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸੇ ਹੁਣਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: jo dhur raate se hun raate |
English: Those who are so pre-ordained to be imbued, are imbued with love for the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee sahaje maate |
English: By Guru's Grace, they are intuitively intoxicated.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: satigur sev sadaa prabh paaeaa aapai aap milaaeidaa |6|
English: Serving the True Guru forever, they find God; He Himself unites them with Himself. ||6||

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa mohi bharam na paae |
English: In attachment to Maya and doubt, the Lord is not found.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਲਗਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: doojai bhaae lagaa dukh paae |
English: Attached to the love of duality, one suffers in pain.

Gurbani: ਸੂਹਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਦਿਨ ਥੋੜੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਇਸੁ ਜਾਦੇ ਬਿਲਮ ਨ ਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: soohaa rang din thorre hovai is jaade bilam na laaeidaa |7|
English: The crimson color lasts for only a few days; all too soon, it fades away. ||7||

Gurbani: ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਰੰਗਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: ehu man bhai bhaae rangaae |
English: So color this mind in the Fear and the Love of God.

Gurbani: ਇਤੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: eit rang saache maeh samaae |
English: Dyed in this color, one merges in the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਕੋ ਇਹੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: poorai bhaag ko ihu rang paae guramatee rang charraaeidaa |8|
English: By perfect destiny, some may obtain this color. Through the Guru's Teachings, this color is applied. ||8||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕਰੇ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh bahut kare abhimaan |
English: The self-willed manmukhs take great pride in themselves.

Gurbani: ਦਰਗਹ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: daragah kab hee na paavai maan |
English: In the Court of the Lord, they are never honored.

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਗੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: doojai laage janam gavaaeaa bin boojhe dukh paaeidaa |9|
English: Attached to duality, they waste their lives; without understanding, they suffer in pain. ||9||

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਆਪੁ ਲੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: merai prabh andar aap lukaaeaa |
English: My God has hidden Himself deep within the self.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee har milai milaaeaa |
English: By Guru's Grace, one is united in the Lord's Union.

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਚਾ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: sachaa prabh sachaa vaapaaraa naam amolak paaeidaa |10|
English: God is True, and True is His trade, through which the priceless Naam is obtained. ||10||

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: eis kaaeaa kee keemat kinai na paaee |
English: No one has found this body's value.

Gurbani: ਮੇਰੈ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਇਹ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: merai tthaakur ih banat banaaee |
English: My Lord and Master has worked His handiwork.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਸੋਧੈ ਆਪਹਿ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: guramukh hovai su kaaeaa sodhai aapeh aap milaaeidaa |11|
English: One who becomes Gurmukh purifies his body, and then the Lord unites him with Himself. ||11||

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਤੋਟਾ ਕਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa vich tottaa kaaeaa vich laahaa |
English: Within the body, one loses, and within the body, one wins.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਜੇ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh khoje veparavaahaa |
English: The Gurmukh seeks the self-sustaining Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਣਜਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: guramukh vanaj sadaa sukh paae sahaje sehaj milaaeidaa |12|
English: The Gurmukh trades, and finds peace forever; he intuitively merges in the Celestial Lord. ||12||

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਸਚੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa mehal sache bhanddaaraa |
English: True is the Lord's Mansion, and True is His treasure.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aape devai devanahaaraa |
English: The Great Giver Himself gives.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਮਨਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: guramukh saalaahe sukhadaate man mele keemat paaeidaa |13|
English: The Gurmukh praises the Giver of peace; his mind is united with the Lord, and he comes to know His worth. ||13||

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa vich vasat keemat nahee paaee |
English: Within the body is the object; its value cannot be estimated.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh aape de vaddiaaee |
English: He Himself grants glorious greatness to the Gurmukh.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਹਟੁ ਸੋਈ ਵਥੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਇ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: jis daa hatt soee vath jaanai guramukh dee na pachhotaaeidaa |14|
English: He alone knows this object, to whom this store belongs; the Gurmukh is blessed with it, and does not come to regret. ||14||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: har jeeo sabh meh rahiaa samaaee |
English: The Dear Lord is pervading and permeating all.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee paaeaa jaaee |
English: By Guru's Grace, He is found.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਸਬਦੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: aape mel milaae aape sabade sehaj samaaeidaa |15|
English: He Himself unites in His Union; through the Word of the Shabad, one intuitively merges with Him. ||15||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: aape sachaa sabad milaae |
English: The True Lord Himself unites us in the Word of His Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਬਦੇ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: sabade vichahu bharam chukaae |
English: Within the Shabad, doubt is driven out.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੮॥੨੨॥
Transliteration: naanak naam milai vaddiaaee naame hee sukh paaeidaa |16|8|22|
English: O Nanak, He blesses us with His Naam, and throgh the Naam, peace is found. ||16||8||22||

[Ang 1067 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 |
English: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: agam agochar veparavaahe |
English: He is inaccessible, unfathomable and self-sustaining.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: aape miharavaan agam athaahe |
English: He Himself is merciful, inaccessible and unlimited.

Gurbani: ਅਪੜਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮੇਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aparr koe na sakai tis no gurasabadee melaaeaa |1|
English: No one can reach up to Him; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is met. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੁਧੁਨੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: tudhuno seveh jo tudh bhaaveh |
English: He alone serves You, who pleases You.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabade sach samaaveh |
English: Through the Guru's Shabad, he merges in the True Lord.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: anadin gun raveh din raatee rasanaa har ras bhaaeaa |2|
English: Night and day, he chants the Lord's Praises, day and night; his tongue savors and delights in the sublime essence of the Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਮਰਣੁ ਸਵਾਰਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: sabad mareh se maran savaareh |
English: Those who die in the Shabad - their death is exalted and glorified.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: har ke gun hiradai ur dhaareh |
English: They enshrine the Lord's Glories in their hearts.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: janam safal har charanee laage doojaa bhaau chukaaeaa |3|
English: Holding tight to the Guru's feet, their lives becomes prosperous, and they are rid of the love of duality. ||3||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮੇਲੇ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: har jeeo mele aap milaae |
English: The Dear Lord unites them in Union with Himself.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabade aap gavaae |
English: Through the Guru's Shabad, self-conceit is dispelled.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਾਤੇ ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: anadin sadaa har bhagatee raate is jag meh laahaa paaeaa |4|
English: Those who remain attuned to devotional worship to the Lord, night and day, earn the profit in this world. ||4||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਾ ਮੈ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: tere gun kahaa mai kehan na jaaee |
English: What Glorious Virtues of Yours should I describe? I cannot describe them.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: ant na paaraa keemat nahee paaee |
English: You have no end or limitation. Your value cannot be estimated.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: aape deaa kare sukhadaataa gun meh gunee samaaeaa |5|
English: When the Giver of peace Himself bestows His Mercy, the virtuous are absorbed in virtue. ||5||

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਹੈ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: eis jag meh mohu hai paasaaraa |
English: In this world, emotional attachment is spread all over.

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਅੰਧਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh agiaanee andh andhaaraa |
English: The ignorant, self-willed manmukh is immersed in utter darkness.

Gurbani: ਧੰਧੈ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: dhandhai dhaavat janam gavaaeaa bin naavai dukh paaeaa |6|
English: Chasing after worldly affairs, he wastes away his life in vain; without the Name, he suffers in pain. ||6||

Gurbani: ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: karam hovai taa satigur paae |
English: If God grants His Grace, then one finds the True Guru.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: haumai mail sabad jalaae |
English: Through the Shabad, the filth of egotism is burned away.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: man niramal giaan ratan chaanan agiaan andher gavaaeaa |7|
English: The mind becomes immaculate, and the jewel of spiritual wisdom brings enlightenment; the darkness of spiritual ignorance is dispelled. ||7||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਅਨੇਕ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: tere naam anek keemat nahee paaee |
English: Your Names are countless; Your value cannot be estimated.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: sach naam har hiradai vasaaee |
English: I enshrine the Lord's True Name within my heart.

Gurbani: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਉਣੁ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: keemat kaun kare prabh teree too aape sehaj samaaeaa |8|
English: Who can estimate Your value, God? You are immersed and absorbed in Yourself. ||8||

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: naam amolak agam apaaraa |
English: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is priceless, inaccessible and infinite.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਆ ਤੋਲਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: naa ko hoaa tolanahaaraa |
English: No one can weigh it.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਤੋਲੇ ਤੋਲਿ ਤੋਲਾਏ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮੇਲਿ ਤੋਲਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: aape tole tol tolaae gurasabadee mel tolaaeaa |9|
English: You Yourself weigh, and estimate all; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, You unite, when the weight is perfect. ||9||

Gurbani: ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: sevak seveh kareh aradaas |
English: Your servant serves, and offers this prayer.

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਬਹਾਲਹਿ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
Transliteration: too aape mel bahaaleh paas |
English: Please, let me sit near You, and unite me with Yourself.

Gurbani: ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: sabhanaa jeea kaa sukhadaataa poorai karam dhiaaeaa |10|
English: You are the Giver of peace to all beings; by perfect karma, we meditate on You. ||10||

Gurbani: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਜਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jat sat sanjam ji sach kamaavai |
English: Chastity, truth and self-control come by practicing and living the Truth.

Gurbani: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: eihu man niramal ji har gun gaavai |
English: This mind becomes immaculate and pure, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਇਸੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: eis bikh meh amrit paraapat hovai har jeeo mere bhaaeaa |11|
English: In this world of poison, the Ambrosial Nectar is obtained, if it pleases my Dear Lord. ||11||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
Transliteration: jis no bujhaae soee boojhai |
English: He alone understands, whom God inspires to understand.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਅੰਦਰੁ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
Transliteration: har gun gaavai andar soojhai |
English: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, one's inner being is awakened.

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਏ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: haumai meraa tthaak rahaae sahaje hee sach paaeaa |12|
English: Egotism and possessiveness are silenced and subdued, and one intuitively finds the True Lord. ||12||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਹੋਰ ਫਿਰੈ ਘਨੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: bin karamaa hor firai ghaneree |
English: Without good karma, countless others wander around.

Gurbani: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਚੁਕੈ ਨ ਫੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: mar mar jamai chukai na feree |
English: They die, and die again, only to be reborn; they cannot escape the cycle of reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਬਿਖੁ ਕਾ ਰਾਤਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: bikh kaa raataa bikh kamaavai sukh na kabahoo paaeaa |13|
English: Imbued with poison, they practice poison and corruption, and they never find peace. ||13||

Gurbani: ਬਹੁਤੇ ਭੇਖ ਕਰੇ ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: bahute bhekh kare bhekhadhaaree |
English: Many disguise themselves with religious robes.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: bin sabadai haumai kinai na maaree |
English: Without the Shabad, no one has conquered egotism.

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: jeevat marai taa mukat paae sachai naae samaaeaa |14|
English: One who remains dead while yet alive is liberated, and merges in the True Name. ||14||

Gurbani: ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਇਸੁ ਤਨਹਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: agiaan trisanaa is taneh jalaae |
English: Spiritual ignorance and desire burn this human body.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: tis dee boojhai ji gurasabad kamaae |
English: He alone puts out this fire, who practices and lives the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: tan man seetal krodh nivaare haumai maar samaaeaa |15|
English: His body and mind are cooled and soothed, and his anger is silenced; conquering egotism, he merges in the Lord. ||15||

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa saahib sachee vaddiaaee |
English: True is the Lord and Master, and True is His glorious greatness.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee viralai paaee |
English: By Guru's Grace, a rare few attain this.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਏਕ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੨੩॥
Transliteration: naanak ek kahai benantee naame naam samaaeaa |16|1|23|
English: Nanak offers this one prayer: through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, may I merge in the Lord. ||16||1||23||

[Ang 1068 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Amardas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 |
English: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

Gurbani: ਨਦਰੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਲੈਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: nadaree bhagataa laihu milaae |
English: By Your Grace, please unite with Your devotees.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat salaahan sadaa liv laae |
English: Your devotees ever praise You, lovingly focusing on You.

Gurbani: ਤਉ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਉਬਰਹਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tau saranaaee ubareh karate aape mel milaaeaa |1|
English: In Your Sanctuary, they are saved, O Creator Lord; You unite them in Union with Yourself. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: poorai sabad bhagat suhaaee |
English: Sublime and exalted is devotion to the Perfect Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: antar sukh terai man bhaaee |
English: Peace prevails within; they are pleasing to Your Mind.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: man tan sachee bhagatee raataa sache siau chit laaeaa |2|
English: One whose mind and body are imbued with true devotion, focuses his consciousness on the True Lord. ||2||

Gurbani: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਦ ਜਲੈ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: haumai vich sad jalai sareeraa |
English: In egotism, the body is forever burning.

Gurbani: ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਭੇਟੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: karam hovai bhette gur pooraa |
English: When God grants His Grace, one meets the Perfect Guru.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: antar agiaan sabad bujhaae satigur te sukh paaeaa |3|
English: The Shabad dispels the spiritual ignorance within, and through the True Guru, one finds peace. ||3||

Gurbani: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅੰਧਾ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: manamukh andhaa andh kamaae |
English: The blind, self-willed manmukh acts blindly.

Gurbani: ਬਹੁ ਸੰਕਟ ਜੋਨੀ ਭਰਮਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: bahu sankatt jonee bharamaae |
English: He is in terrible trouble, and wanders in reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਜਮ ਕਾ ਜੇਵੜਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਕਾਟੈ ਅੰਤੇ ਬਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: jam kaa jevarraa kade na kaattai ante bahu dukh paaeaa |4|
English: He can never snap the noose of Death, and in the end, he suffers in horrible pain. ||4||

Gurbani: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: aavan jaanaa sabad nivaare |
English: Through the Shabad, one's comings and goings in reincarnation are ended.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖੈ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sach naam rakhai ur dhaare |
English: He keeps the True Name enshrined within his heart.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad marai man maare haumai jaae samaaeaa |5|
English: He dies in the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and conquers his mind; stilling his egotism, he merges in the Lord. ||5||

Gurbani: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੈ ਪਰਜ ਵਿਗੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aavan jaanai paraj vigoee |
English: Coming and going, the people of the world are wasting away.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਥਿਰੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: bin satigur thir koe na hoee |
English: Without the True Guru, no one finds permanence and stability.

Gurbani: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: antar jot sabad sukh vasiaa jotee jot milaaeaa |6|
English: The Shabad shines its Light deep within the self, and one dwells in peace; one's light merges into the Light. ||6||

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਚਿਤਵਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: panch doot chitaveh vikaaraa |
English: The five demons think of evil and corruption.

Gurbani: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਕਾ ਏਹੁ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: maaeaa moh kaa ehu pasaaraa |
English: The expanse is the manifestation of emotional attachment to Maya.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਵਸਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: satigur seve taa mukat hovai panch doot vas aaeaa |7|
English: Serving the True Guru, one is liberated, and the five demons are put under his control. ||7||

Gurbani: ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: baajh guroo hai mohu gubaaraa |
English: Without the Guru, there is only the darkness of attachment.

Gurbani: ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਡੁਬੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: fir fir ddubai vaaro vaaraa |
English: Over and over, time and time again, they are drowned.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਸਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: satigur bhette sach drirraae sach naam man bhaaeaa |8|
English: Meeting the True Guru, Truth is implanted within, and the True Name becomes pleasing to the mind. ||8||

Gurbani: ਸਾਚਾ ਦਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਦਰਵਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: saachaa dar saachaa daravaaraa |
English: True is His Door, and True is His Court, His Royal Darbaar.

Gurbani: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sache seveh sabad piaaraa |
English: The true ones serve Him, through the Beloved Word of the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਸਚੀ ਧੁਨਿ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਸਚੇ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: sachee dhun sache gun gaavaa sache maeh samaaeaa |9|
English: Singing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord, in the true melody, I am immersed and absorbed in Truth. ||9||

Gurbani: ਘਰੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕੋ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gharai andar ko ghar paae |
English: Deep within the home of the self, one finds the home of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabade sehaj subhaae |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one easily, intuitively finds it.

Gurbani: ਓਥੈ ਸੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: othai sog vijog na viaapai sahaje sehaj samaaeaa |10|
English: There, one is not afflicted with sorrow or separation; merge into the Celestial Lord with intuitive ease. ||10||

Gurbani: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਸਟਾ ਕਾ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: doojai bhaae dusattaa kaa vaasaa |
English: The evil people live in the love of duality.

Gurbani: ਭਉਦੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਮੋਹ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: bhaude fireh bahu moh piaasaa |
English: They wander around, totally attached and thirsty.

Gurbani: ਕੁਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਹਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਦੁਖੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: kusangat baheh sadaa dukh paaveh dukho dukh kamaaeaa |11|
English: They sit in evil gatherings, and suffer in pain forever; they earn pain, nothing but pain. ||11||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur baajhahu sangat na hoee |
English: Without the True Guru, there is no Sangat, no Congregation.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਪਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: bin sabade paar na paae koee |
English: Without the Shabad, no one can cross over to the other side.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: sahaje gun raveh din raatee jotee jot milaaeaa |12|
English: One who intuitively chants God's Glorious Praises day and night - his light merges into the Light. ||12||

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਪੰਖੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa birakh pankhee vich vaasaa |
English: The body is the tree; the bird of the soul dwells within it.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਚੁਗਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ॥
Transliteration: amrit chugeh gur sabad nivaasaa |
English: It drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar, resting in the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

Gurbani: ਉਡਹਿ ਨ ਮੂਲੇ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: auddeh na moole na aaveh na jaahee nij ghar vaasaa paaeaa |13|
English: It never flies away, and it does not come or go; it dwells within the home of its own self. ||13||

Gurbani: ਕਾਇਆ ਸੋਧਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: kaaeaa sodheh sabad veechaareh |
English: Purify the body, and contemplate the Shabad.

Gurbani: ਮੋਹ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਭਰਮੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: moh tthgauree bharam nivaareh |
English: Remove the poisonous drug of emotional attachment, and eradicate doubt.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: aape kripaa kare sukhadaataa aape mel milaaeaa |14|
English: The Giver of peace Himself bestows His Mercy, and unites us in Union with Himself. ||14||

Gurbani: ਸਦ ਹੀ ਨੇੜੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: sad hee nerrai door na jaanahu |
English: He is always near at hand; He is never far away.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਜੀਕਿ ਪਛਾਣਹੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad najeek pachhaanahu |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, realize that He is very near.

Gurbani: ਬਿਗਸੈ ਕਮਲੁ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੈ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਾਇਆ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: bigasai kamal kiran paragaasai paragatt kar dekhaaeaa |15|
English: Your heart-lotus shall blossom forth, and the ray of God's Divine Light shall illuminate your heart; He shall be revealed to You. ||15||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aape karataa sachaa soee |
English: The True Lord is Himself the Creator.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲੇ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Transliteration: aape maar jeevaale avar na koee |
English: He Himself kills, and gives life; there is no other at all.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੬॥੨॥੨੪॥
Transliteration: naanak naam milai vaddiaaee aap gavaae sukh paaeaa |16|2|24|
English: O Nanak, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, glorious greatness is obtained. Eradicating self-conceit, peace is found. ||16||2||24||

[Ang 1069 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਸੋਲਹੇ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo solahe mahalaa 4 |
English: Maaroo, Solahas, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸਚਾ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sachaa aap savaaranahaaraa |
English: The Lord Lord Himself is the One who exalts and embellishes.

Gurbani: ਅਵਰ ਨ ਸੂਝਸਿ ਬੀਜੀ ਕਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: avar na soojhas beejee kaaraa |
English: Do not consider any other work.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: guramukh sach vasai ghatt antar sahaje sach samaaee he |1|
English: The True Lord abides deep within the heart of the Gurmukh, who intuitively merges in the True Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਭਨਾ ਸਚੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: sabhanaa sach vasai man maahee |
English: The True Lord dwells within the minds of all.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee sehaj samaahee |
English: By Guru's Grace, they are intuitively absorbed in Him.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: gur gur karat sadaa sukh paaeaa gur charanee chit laaee he |2|
English: Calling out, "Guru, Guru", I have found eternal peace; my consciousness is focused on the Guru's feet. ||2||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੈ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: satigur hai giaan satigur hai poojaa |
English: The True Guru is spiritual wisdom; the True Guru is worship and adoration.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
Transliteration: satigur sevee avar na doojaa |
English: I serve the True Guru, and no other.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਭਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: satigur te naam ratan dhan paaeaa satigur kee sevaa bhaaee he |3|
English: From the True Guru, I have obtained the wealth, the jewel of the Naam. Service to the True Guru is pleasing to me. ||3||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਜੋ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: bin satigur jo doojai laage |
English: Without the True Guru, those who are attached to duality

Gurbani: ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਅਭਾਗੇ ॥
Transliteration: aaveh jaeh bhram mareh abhaage |
English: come and go, and wander in reincarnation; these unfortunate ones die.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: naanak tin kee fir gat hovai ji guramukh raheh saranaaee he |4|
English: O Nanak, even after they are emancipated, those who become Gurmukh remain in the Guru's Sanctuary. ||4||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਸਾਚੀ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh preet sadaa hai saachee |
English: The love of the Gurmukh is forever true.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਾਗਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਜਾਚੀ ॥
Transliteration: satigur te maagau naam ajaachee |
English: I beg for the invaluable Naam, the Name of the Lord, from the Guru.

Gurbani: ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: hohu deaal kripaa kar har jeeo rakh levahu gur saranaaee he |5|
English: O Dear Lord, please be kind, and grant Your Grace; please keep me in the Guru's Sanctuary. ||5||

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਚੁਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: amrit ras satiguroo chuaaeaa |
English: The True Guru trickles the Ambrosial Nectar into my mouth.

Gurbani: ਦਸਵੈ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: dasavai duaar pragatt hoe aaeaa |
English: My Tenth Gate has been opened and revealed.

Gurbani: ਤਹ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਵਜਹਿ ਧੁਨਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: teh anahad sabad vajeh dhun baanee sahaje sehaj samaaee he |6|
English: The unstruck sound current of the Shabad vibrates and resounds there, with the melody of the Guru's Bani; one is easily, intuitively absorbed in the Lord. ||6||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਕਰਤੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: jin kau karatai dhur likh paaee |
English: Those who are so pre-ordained by the Creator,

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤ ਵਿਹਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: anadin gur gur karat vihaaee |
English: pass their nights and days calling on the Guru.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੋ ਸੀਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: bin satigur ko seejhai naahee gur charanee chit laaee he |7|
English: Without the True Guru, no one understands; focus your consciousness on the Guru's Feet. ||7||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: jis bhaavai tis aape dee |
English: The Lord Himself blesses those with whom He is pleased.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਲੇਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh naam padaarath lee |
English: The Gurmukh receives the wealth of the Naam.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: aape kripaa kare naam devai naanak naam samaaee he |8|
English: When the Lord grants His Grace, He bestows the Naam; Nanak is immersed and absorbed in the Naam. ||8||

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: giaan ratan man paragatt bheaa |
English: The jewel of spiritual wisdom is revealed within the mind.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਲਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: naam padaarath sahaje leaa |
English: The wealth of the Naam is easily, intuitively received.

Gurbani: ਏਹ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: eeh vaddiaaee gur te paaee satigur kau sad bal jaaee he |9|
English: This glorious greatness is obtained from the Guru; I am forever a sacrifice to the True Guru. ||9||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਆ ਸੂਰੁ ਨਿਸਿ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: pragattiaa soor nis mittiaa andhiaaraa |
English: With the rising of the sun, the darkness of the night is dispelled.

Gurbani: ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਰਤਨਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: agiaan mittiaa gur ratan apaaraa |
English: Spiritual ignorance is eradicated, by the priceless jewel of the Guru.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: satigur giaan ratan at bhaaree karam milai sukh paaee he |10|
English: The True Guru is the fantastically valuable jewel of spiritual wisdom; blessed by God's Mercy, peace is found. ||10||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀ ਹੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh naam pragattee hai soe |
English: The Gurmukh obtains the Naam, and his good reputation increases.

Gurbani: ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹਛਾ ਲੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: chahu jug niramal hachhaa loe |
English: In all four ages he is considered to be pure and good.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: naame naam rate sukh paaeaa naam rahiaa liv laaee he |11|
English: Imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he finds peace. He remains lovingly focused on the Naam. ||11||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh naam paraapat hovai |
English: The Gurmukh receives the Naam.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਜਾਗੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੋਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: sahaje jaagai sahaje sovai |
English: In intuitive peace he wakes, and in intuitive peace he sleeps.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: guramukh naam samaae samaavai naanak naam dhiaaee he |12|
English: The Gurmukh is immersed and absorbed in the Naam; Nanak meditates on the Naam. ||12||

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਹੈ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: bhagataa mukh amrit hai baanee |
English: The Ambrosial Nectar of the Guru's Bani is in the mouth of the devotees.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: guramukh har naam aakh vakhaanee |
English: The Gurmukhs chant and repeat the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤ ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: har har karat sadaa man bigasai har charanee man laaee he |13|
English: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, their minds forever blossom forth; they focus their minds on the Lord's Feet. ||13||

Gurbani: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: ham moorakh agiaan giaan kichh naahee |
English: I am foolish and ignorant; I have no wisdom at all.

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਮਝ ਪੜੀ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: satigur te samajh parree man maahee |
English: From the True Guru, I have obtained understanding in my mind.

Gurbani: ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: hohu deaal kripaa kar har jeeo satigur kee sevaa laaee he |14|
English: O Dear Lord, please be kind to me, and grant Your Grace; let me be committed to serving the True Guru. ||14||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: jin satigur jaataa tin ek pachhaataa |
English: Those who know the True Guru realize the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬੇ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: sarabe rav rahiaa sukhadaataa |
English: The Giver of peace is all-pervading, permeating everywhere.

Gurbani: ਆਤਮੁ ਚੀਨਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: aatam cheen param pad paaeaa sevaa surat samaaee he |15|
English: Understanding my own soul, I have obtained the Supreme Status; my awareness is immersed in selfless service. ||15||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਆਦਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: jin kau aad milee vaddiaaee |
English: Those who are blessed with glorious greatness by the Primal Lord God

Gurbani: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: satigur man vasiaa liv laaee |
English: are lovingly focused on the True Guru, who dwells within their minds.

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੧॥
Transliteration: aap miliaa jagajeevan daataa naanak ank samaaee he |16|1|
English: The Giver of life to the world Himself meets them; O Nanak, they are absorbed in His Being. ||16||1||

[Ang 1070 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Ramdas Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 4 |
English: Maaroo, Fourth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: har agam agochar sadaa abinaasee |
English: The Lord is inaccessible and unfathomable; He is eternal and imperishable.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬੇ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਘਟ ਵਾਸੀ ॥
Transliteration: sarabe rav rahiaa ghatt vaasee |
English: He dwells in the heart, and is all-pervading, permeating everywhere.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਸਰੇਵਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tis bin avar na koee daataa har tiseh sarevahu praanee he |1|
English: There is no other Giver except Him; worship the Lord, O mortals. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਰਾਖੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kau raakhai har raakhanahaaraa |
English: No one can kill anyone

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਾਕਸਿ ਮਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: taa kau koe na saakas maaraa |
English: Who is saved by the Savior Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਊਤਮ ਬਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: so aisaa har sevahu santahu jaa kee aootam baanee he |2|
English: So serve such a Lord, O Saints, whose Bani is exalted and sublime. ||2||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਜਾਪੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਿਥਾਊ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jaa jaapai kichh kithaaoo naahee |
English: When it seems that a place is empty and void,

Gurbani: ਤਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: taa karataa bharapoor samaahee |
English: there, the Creator Lord is permeating and pervading.

Gurbani: ਸੂਕੇ ਤੇ ਫੁਨਿ ਹਰਿਆ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sooke te fun hariaa keeton har dhiaavahu choj viddaanee he |3|
English: He causes the dried-up branch to blossom forth in greenery again; so meditate on the Lord - wondrous are His ways! ||3||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੀਆ ਕੀ ਵੇਦਨ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: jo jeea kee vedan jaanai |
English: The One who knows the anguish of all beings

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: tis saahib kai hau kurabaanai |
English: unto that Lord and Master, I am a sacrifice.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਜਨ ਕਰਿ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਜੋ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: tis aagai jan kar benantee jo sarab sukhaa kaa daanee he |4|
English: Offer your prayers to the One who is the Giver of all peace and joy. ||4||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੀਐ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: jo jeeai kee saar na jaanai |
English: But one who does not know the state of the soul

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਕਹੀਐ ਅਜਾਣੈ ॥
Transliteration: tis siau kichh na kaheeai ajaanai |
English: do not say anything to such an ignorant person.

Gurbani: ਮੂਰਖ ਸਿਉ ਨਹ ਲੂਝੁ ਪਰਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: moorakh siau neh loojh paraanee har japeeai pad nirabaanee he |5|
English: Do not argue with fools, O mortals. Meditate on the Lord, in the state of Nirvaanaa. ||5||

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਚਿੰਤ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਹੈ ਕਰਤੇ ॥
Transliteration: naa kar chint chintaa hai karate |
English: Don't worry - let the Creator take care of it.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਜੰਤਾ ਸਭਤੈ ॥
Transliteration: har devai jal thal jantaa sabhatai |
English: The Lord gives to all creatures in the water and on the land.

Gurbani: ਅਚਿੰਤ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਥਰ ਕੀਟ ਪਖਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: achint daan dee prabh meraa vich paathar keett pakhaanee he |6|
English: My God bestows His blessings without being asked, even to worms in soil and stones. ||6||

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਆਸ ਮੀਤ ਸੁਤ ਭਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: naa kar aas meet sut bhaaee |
English: Do not place your hopes in friends, children and siblings.

Gurbani: ਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਆਸ ਕਿਸੈ ਸਾਹ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਕੀ ਪਰਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: naa kar aas kisai saah biauhaar kee paraaee |
English: Do not place your hopes in kings or the business of others.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਬੇਲੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਸਾਰੰਗਪਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: bin har naavai ko belee naahee har japeeai saarangapaanee he |7|
