English: Without the Lord's Name, no one will be your helper; so meditate on the Lord, the Lord of the world. ||7||

Gurbani: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: anadin naam japahu banavaaree |
English: Night and day, chant the Naam.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰੈ ਥਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: sabh aasaa manasaa poorai thaaree |
English: All your hopes and desires shall be fulfilled.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਭਵ ਖੰਡਨੁ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: jan naanak naam japahu bhav khanddan sukh sahaje rain vihaanee he |8|
English: O servant Nanak, chant the Naam, the Name of the Destroyer of fear, and your life-night shall pass in intuitive peace and poise. ||8||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: jin har seviaa tin sukh paaeaa |
English: Those who serve the Lord find peace.

Gurbani: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: sahaje hee har naam samaaeaa |
English: They are intuitively absorbed in the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਜਾਇ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਵੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: jo saran parai tis kee pat raakhai jaae poochhahu ved puraanee he |9|
English: The Lord preserves the honor of those who seek His Sanctuary; go and consult the Vedas and the Puraanas. ||9||

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: jis har sevaa laae soee jan laagai |
English: That humble being is attached to the Lord's service, whom the Lord so attaches.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਭਰਮ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur kai sabad bharam bhau bhaagai |
English: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, doubt and fear are dispelled.

Gurbani: ਵਿਚੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਜਿਉ ਕਮਲੁ ਰਹੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: viche grih sadaa rahai udaasee jiau kamal rahai vich paanee he |10|
English: In his own home, he remains unattached, like the lotus flower in the water. ||10||

Gurbani: ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਸੇਵਾ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: vich haumai sevaa thaae na paae |
English: One who serves in egotism is not accepted or approved.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਏ ॥
Transliteration: janam marai fir aavai jaae |
English: Such a person is born, only to die again, and come and go in reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਤਪੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਾਈ ਸੇਵਾ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: so tap pooraa saaee sevaa jo har mere man bhaanee he |11|
English: Perfect is that penance and that service, which is pleasing to the Mind of my Lord. ||11||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਆਖਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: hau kiaa gun tere aakhaa suaamee |
English: What Glorious Virtues of Yours should I chant, O my Lord and Master?

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: too sarab jeea kaa antarajaamee |
English: You are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of all souls.

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਮਾਗਉ ਦਾਨੁ ਤੁਝੈ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: hau maagau daan tujhai peh karate har anadin naam vakhaanee he |12|
English: I beg for blessings from You, O Creator Lord; I repeat Your Name night and day. ||12||

Gurbani: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਜੋਰੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ਬੋਲਣ ਕਾ ॥
Transliteration: kis hee jor ahankaar bolan kaa |
English: Some speak in egotistical power.

Gurbani: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਜੋਰੁ ਦੀਬਾਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ॥
Transliteration: kis hee jor deebaan maaeaa kaa |
English: Some have the power of authority and Maya.

Gurbani: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਟੇਕ ਧਰ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਤੂ ਕਰਤੇ ਰਾਖੁ ਮੈ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: mai har bin ttek dhar avar na kaaee too karate raakh mai nimaanee he |13|
English: I have no other Support at all, except the Lord. O Creator Lord, please save me, meek and dishonored. ||13||

Gurbani: ਨਿਮਾਣੇ ਮਾਣੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: nimaane maan kareh tudh bhaavai |
English: You bless the meek and dishonored with honor, as it pleases You, O Lord.

Gurbani: ਹੋਰ ਕੇਤੀ ਝਖਿ ਝਖਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: hor ketee jhakh jhakh aavai jaavai |
English: Many others argue in conflict, coming and going in reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਕਾ ਪਖੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੂ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਊਪਰਿ ਗਲ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: jin kaa pakh kareh too suaamee tin kee aoopar gal tudh aanee he |14|
English: Those people, whose side You take, O Lord and Master, are elevated and successful. ||14||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: har har naam jinee sadaa dhiaaeaa |
English: Those who meditate forever on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har,

Gurbani: ਤਿਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: tinee gur parasaad param pad paaeaa |
English: by Guru's Grace, obtain the supreme status.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਪਛੋਤਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: jin har seviaa tin sukh paaeaa bin sevaa pachhotaanee he |15|
English: Those who serve the Lord find peace; without serving Him, they regret and repent. ||15||

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਗੰਨਾਥੁ ॥
Transliteration: too sabh meh varateh har jaganaath |
English: You are pervading all, O Lord of the world.

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹਾਥੁ ॥
Transliteration: so har japai jis gur masatak haath |
English: He alone meditates on the Lord, upon whose forehead the Guru places His hand.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪੀ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਦਸਾਣੀ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੨॥
Transliteration: har kee saran peaa har jaapee jan naanak daas dasaanee he |16|2|
English: Entering the Sanctuary of the Lord, I meditate on the Lord; servant Nanak is the slave of His slaves. ||16||2||

[Ang 1071 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਸੋਲਹੇ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo solahe mahalaa 5 |
English: Maaroo, Solahas, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਕਲਾ ਉਪਾਇ ਧਰੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਧਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: kalaa upaae dharee jin dharanaa |
English: He infused His power into the earth.

Gurbani: ਗਗਨੁ ਰਹਾਇਆ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਚਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: gagan rahaaeaa hukame charanaa |
English: He suspends the heavens upon the feet of His Command.

Gurbani: ਅਗਨਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਈਧਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਾਧੀ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਭਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: agan upaae eedhan meh baadhee so prabh raakhai bhaaee he |1|
English: He created fire and locked it into wood. That God protects all, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਕਉ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: jeea jant kau rijak sanbaahe |
English: He gives nourishment to all beings and creatures.

Gurbani: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਆਪਾਹੇ ॥
Transliteration: karan kaaran samarath aapaahe |
English: He Himself is the all-powerful Creator, the Cause of causes.

Gurbani: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਨਹਾਰਾ ਸੋਈ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: khin meh thaap uthaapanahaaraa soee teraa sahaaee he |2|
English: In an instant, He establishes and disestablishes; He is your help and support. ||2||

Gurbani: ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਮਹਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: maat garabh meh jin pratipaaliaa |
English: He cherished you in your mother's womb.

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਿ ਗ੍ਰਾਸਿ ਹੋਇ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਲਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: saas graas hoe sang samaaliaa |
English: With every breath and morsel of food, He is with you, and takes care of you.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਪੀਐ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਵਡੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa japeeai so preetam vaddee jis vaddiaaee he |3|
English: Forever and ever, meditate on that Beloved; Great is His glorious greatness! ||3||

Gurbani: ਸੁਲਤਾਨ ਖਾਨ ਕਰੇ ਖਿਨ ਕੀਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: sulataan khaan kare khin keere |
English: The sultans and nobles are reduced to dust in an instant.

Gurbani: ਗਰੀਬ ਨਿਵਾਜਿ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੀਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: gareeb nivaaj kare prabh meere |
English: God cherishes the poor, and makes them into rulers.

Gurbani: ਗਰਬ ਨਿਵਾਰਣ ਸਰਬ ਸਧਾਰਣ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: garab nivaaran sarab sadhaaran kichh keemat kahee na jaaee he |4|
English: He is the Destroyer of egotistical pride, the Support of all. His value cannot be estimated. ||4||

Gurbani: ਸੋ ਪਤਿਵੰਤਾ ਸੋ ਧਨਵੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: so pativantaa so dhanavantaa |
English: He alone is honorable, and he alone is wealthy,

Gurbani: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: jis man vasiaa har bhagavantaa |
English: within whose mind the Lord God abides.

Gurbani: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪ ਭਾਈ ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: maat pitaa sut bandhap bhaaee jin ih srisatt upaaee he |5|
English: He alone is my mother, father, child, relative and sibling, who created this Universe. ||5||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਏ ਸਰਣਾ ਭਉ ਨਹੀ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: prabh aae saranaa bhau nahee karanaa |
English: I have come to God's Sanctuary, and so I fear nothing.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਿਹਚਉ ਹੈ ਤਰਣਾ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasangat nihchau hai taranaa |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I am sure to be saved.

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕਰਮ ਅਰਾਧੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਦੇ ਸਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
Transliteration: man bach karam araadhe karataa tis naahee kade sajaaee he |6|
English: One who adores the Creator in thought, word and deed, shall never be punished. ||6||

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: gun nidhaan man tan meh raviaa |
English: One whose mind and body are permeated with the Lord, the treasure of virtue,

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕੀ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਭਵਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: janam maran kee jon na bhaviaa |
English: does not wander in birth, death and reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਦੂਖ ਬਿਨਾਸ ਕੀਆ ਸੁਖਿ ਡੇਰਾ ਜਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਰਹੇ ਆਘਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
Transliteration: dookh binaas keea sukh dderaa jaa tripat rahe aaghaaee he |7|
English: Pain vanishes and peace prevails, when one is satisfied and fulfilled. ||7||

Gurbani: ਮੀਤੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: meet hamaaraa soee suaamee |
English: My Lord and Master is my best friend.

Gurbani: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: thaan thanantar antarajaamee |
English: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is in all places and interspaces.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਗਣਤ ਮਿਟਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
Transliteration: simar simar pooran paramesur chintaa ganat mittaaee he |8|
English: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Perfect Transcendent Lord, I am rid of all anxieties and calculations. ||8||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੋਟਿ ਲਖ ਬਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa naam kott lakh baahaa |
English: One who has the Name of the Lord has hundreds of thousands and millions of arms.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਧਨੁ ਤਾਹਾ ॥
Transliteration: har jas keeratan sang dhan taahaa |
English: The wealth of the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises is with him.

Gurbani: ਗਿਆਨ ਖੜਗੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੀਨਾ ਦੂਤ ਮਾਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਧਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
Transliteration: giaan kharrag kar kirapaa deenaa doot maare kar dhaaee he |9|
English: In His Mercy, God has blessed me with the sword of spiritual wisdom; I have attacked and killed the demons. ||9||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਜਾਪੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: har kaa jaap japahu jap japane |
English: Chant the Chant of the Lord, the Chant of Chants.

Gurbani: ਜੀਤਿ ਆਵਹੁ ਵਸਹੁ ਘਰਿ ਅਪਨੇ ॥
Transliteration: jeet aavahu vasahu ghar apane |
English: Be a winner of the game of life and come to abide in your true home.

Gurbani: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਨਰਕ ਨ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
Transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh narak na dekhahu rasak rasak gun gaaee he |10|
English: You shall not see the 8.4 million types of hell; sing His Glorious Praises and remain saturated with loving devotion||10||

Gurbani: ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਉਧਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: khandd brahamandd udhaaranahaaraa |
English: He is the Savior of worlds and galaxies.

Gurbani: ਊਚ ਅਥਾਹ ਅਗੰਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: aooch athaah agam apaaraa |
English: He is lofty, unfathomable, inaccessible and infinite.

Gurbani: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
Transliteration: jis no kripaa kare prabh apanee so jan tiseh dhiaaee he |11|
English: That humble being, unto whom God grants His Grace, meditates on Him. ||11||

Gurbani: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋੜਿ ਲੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮੋਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: bandhan torr lee prabh mole |
English: God has broken my bonds, and claimed me as His own.

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਨੇ ਘਰ ਗੋਲੇ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa keene ghar gole |
English: In His Mercy, He has made me the slave of His home.

Gurbani: ਅਨਹਦ ਰੁਣ ਝੁਣਕਾਰੁ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
Transliteration: anahad run jhunakaar sehaj dhun saachee kaar kamaaee he |12|
English: The unstruck celestial sound current resounds and vibrates, when one performs acts of true service. ||12||

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਬਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: man parateet banee prabh teree |
English: O God, I have enshrined faith in You within my mind.

Gurbani: ਬਿਨਸਿ ਗਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: binas gee haumai mat meree |
English: My egotistical intellect has been driven out.

Gurbani: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨੈ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਸੋਭ ਸੁਹਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
Transliteration: angeekaar keea prabh apanai jag meh sobh suhaaee he |13|
English: God has made me His own, and now I have a glorious reputation in this world. ||13||

Gurbani: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਜਗਦੀਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: jai jai kaar japahu jagadeesai |
English: Proclaim His Glorious Victory, and meditate on the Lord of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਈਸੈ ॥
Transliteration: bal bal jaaee prabh apune eesai |
English: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to my Lord God.

Gurbani: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਏਕਾ ਜਗਤਿ ਸਬਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
Transliteration: tis bin doojaa avar na deesai ekaa jagat sabaaee he |14|
English: I do not see any other except Him. The One Lord pervades the whole world. ||14||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: sat sat sat prabh jaataa |
English: True, True, True is God.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaad sadaa man raataa |
English: By Guru's Grace, my mind is attuned to Him forever.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਏਕੰਕਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
Transliteration: simar simar jeeveh jan tere ekankaar samaaee he |15|
English: Your humble servants live by meditating, meditating in remembrance on You, merging in You, O One Universal Creator. ||15||

Gurbani: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: bhagat janaa kaa preetam piaaraa |
English: The Dear Lord is the Beloved of His humble devotees.

Gurbani: ਸਭੈ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ਖਸਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: sabhai udhaaran khasam hamaaraa |
English: My Lord and Master is the Savior of all.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਸਭ ਇਛਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੧॥
Transliteration: simar naam punee sabh ichhaa jan naanak paij rakhaaee he |16|1|
English: Meditating in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, all desires are fulfilled. He has saved the honor of servant Nanak. ||16||1||

[Ang 1072 | Raag: Raag Maaroo | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਮਾਰੂ ਸੋਲਹੇ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: maaroo solahe mahalaa 5 |
English: Maaroo, Solahas, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
Transliteration: ik oankaar satigur prasaad |
English: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

Gurbani: ਸੰਗੀ ਜੋਗੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਲਪਟਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: sangee jogee naar lapattaanee |
English: The body-bride is attached to the Yogi, the husband-soul.

Gurbani: ਉਰਝਿ ਰਹੀ ਰੰਗ ਰਸ ਮਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: aurajh rahee rang ras maanee |
English: She is involved with him, enjoying pleasure and delights.

Gurbani: ਕਿਰਤ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਭਏ ਇਕਤ੍ਰਾ ਕਰਤੇ ਭੋਗ ਬਿਲਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: kirat sanjogee bhe ikatraa karate bhog bilaasaa he |1|
English: As a consequence of past actions, they have come together, enjoying pleasurable play. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਧਨ ਤਤੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: jo pir karai su dhan tat maanai |
English: Whatever the husband does, the bride willingly accepts.

Gurbani: ਪਿਰੁ ਧਨਹਿ ਸੀਗਾਰਿ ਰਖੈ ਸੰਗਾਨੈ ॥
Transliteration: pir dhaneh seegaar rakhai sangaanai |
English: The husband adorns his bride, and keeps her with himself.

Gurbani: ਮਿਲਿ ਏਕਤ੍ਰ ਵਸਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਦੇ ਧਨਹਿ ਦਿਲਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
Transliteration: mil ekatr vaseh din raatee priau de dhaneh dilaasaa he |2|
English: Joining together, they live in harmony day and night; the husband comforts his wife. ||2||

Gurbani: ਧਨ ਮਾਗੈ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: dhan maagai priau bahu bidh dhaavai |
English: When the bride asks, the husband runs around in all sorts of ways.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਆਣਿ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jo paavai so aan dikhaavai |
English: Whatever he finds, he brings to show his bride.

Gurbani: ਏਕ ਵਸਤੁ ਕਉ ਪਹੁਚਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਧਨ ਰਹਤੀ ਭੂਖ ਪਿਆਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
Transliteration: ek vasat kau pahuch na saakai dhan rahatee bhookh piaasaa he |3|
English: But there is one thing he cannot reach, and so his bride remains hungry and thirsty. ||3||

Gurbani: ਧਨ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਨਉ ਦੋਊ ਕਰ ਜੋਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: dhan karai binau doaoo kar jorai |
English: With her palms pressed together, the bride offers her prayer,

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪਰਦੇਸਿ ਨ ਜਾਹੁ ਵਸਹੁ ਘਰਿ ਮੋਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: pria parades na jaahu vasahu ghar morai |
English: "O my beloved, do not leave me and go to foreign lands; please stay here with me.

Gurbani: ਐਸਾ ਬਣਜੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਭੂਖ ਪਿਆਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
Transliteration: aisaa banaj karahu grih bheetar jit utarai bhookh piaasaa he |4|
English: Do such business within our home, that my hunger and thirst may be relieved." ||4||

Gurbani: ਸਗਲੇ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਜੁਗ ਸਾਧਾ ॥
Transliteration: sagale karam dharam jug saadhaa |
English: All sorts of religious rituals are performed in this age,

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਸੁਖੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਲਾਧਾ ॥
Transliteration: bin har ras sukh til nahee laadhaa |
English: but without the sublime essence of the Lord, not an iota of peace is found.

Gurbani: ਭਈ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਸੰਗੇ ਤਉ ਧਨ ਪਿਰ ਅਨੰਦ ਉਲਾਸਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
Transliteration: bhee kripaa naanak satasange tau dhan pir anand ulaasaa he |5|
English: When the Lord becomes Merciful, O Nanak, then in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, the bride and the husband enjoy ecstasy and bliss. ||5||

[Ang 1215 | Raag: Raag Saarang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 |
English: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਆਧਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: amrit naam maneh aadhaaro |
English: The Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the Support of the mind.

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਦੀਆ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੈ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jin deea tis kai kurabaanai gur poore namasakaaro |1| rahaau |
English: I am a sacrifice to the One who gave it to me; I humbly bow to the Perfect Guru. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬੂਝੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਜਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: boojhee trisanaa sehaj suhelaa kaam krodh bikh jaaro |
English: My thirst is quenched, and I have been intuitively embellished. The poisons of sexual desire and anger have been burnt away.

Gurbani: ਆਇ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਬਸੈ ਇਹ ਠਾਹਰ ਜਹ ਆਸਨੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aae na jaae basai ih tthaahar jeh aasan nirankaaro |1|
English: This mind does not come and go; it abides in that place, where the Formless Lord sits. ||1||

Gurbani: ਏਕੈ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਏਕੈ ਗੁਪਤਾ ਏਕੈ ਧੁੰਧੂਕਾਰੋ ॥
Transliteration: ekai paragatt ekai gupataa ekai dhundhookaaro |
English: The One Lord is manifest and radiant; the One Lord is hidden and mysterious. The One Lord is abysmal darkness.

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥੨॥੩੧॥੫੪॥
Transliteration: aad madh ant prabh soee kahu naanak saach beechaaro |2|31|54|
English: From the beginning, throughout the middle and until the end, is God. Says Nanak, reflect on the Truth. ||2||31||54||

[Ang 1215 | Raag: Raag Saarang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 |
English: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਘਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: bin prabh rehan na jaae gharee |
English: Without God, I cannot survive, even for an instant.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਤਾਹੂ ਕੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਹਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sarab sookh taahoo kai pooran jaa kai sukh hai haree |1| rahaau |
English: One who finds joy in the Lord finds total peace and perfection. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮੰਗਲ ਰੂਪ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਜੀਵਨ ਧਨ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਅਨਦ ਘਨਾ ॥
Transliteration: mangal roop praan jeevan dhan simarat anad ghanaa |
English: God is the Embodiment of bliss, the Breath of Life and Wealth; remembering Him in meditation, I am blessed with absolute bliss.

Gurbani: ਵਡ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦ ਸੰਗੇ ਗੁਨ ਰਸਨਾ ਕਵਨ ਭਨਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: vadd samarath sadaa sad sange gun rasanaa kavan bhanaa |1|
English: He is utterly All-powerful, with me forever and ever; what tongue can utter His Glorious Praises? ||1||

Gurbani: ਥਾਨ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਮਾਨ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਨਨ ਕਹਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: thaan pavitraa maan pavitraa pavitr sunan kahanahaare |
English: His Place is sacred, and His Glory is sacred; sacred are those who listen and speak of Him.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਭਵਨ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਜਾ ਮਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੩੨॥੫੫॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak te bhavan pavitraa jaa meh sant tumaare |2|32|55|
English: Says Nanak, that dwelling is sacred, in which Your Saints live. ||2||32||55||

[Ang 1215 | Raag: Raag Saarang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 |
English: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਸਨਾ ਜਪਤੀ ਤੂਹੀ ਤੂਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: rasanaa japatee toohee toohee |
English: My tongue chants Your Name, Your Name.

Gurbani: ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕ ਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਮੰਡਲ ਇਕ ਤੁਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: maat garabh tum hee pratipaalak mrit manddal ik tuhee |1| rahaau |
English: In the mother's womb, You sustained me, and in this mortal world, You alone help me. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮਹਿ ਪਿਤਾ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਫੁਨਿ ਮਾਤਾ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਮੀਤ ਹਿਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: tumeh pitaa tum hee fun maataa tumeh meet hit bhraataa |
English: You are my Father, and You are my Mother; You are my Loving Friend and Sibling.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਪਰਵਾਰ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਆਧਾਰਾ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਦਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tum paravaar tumeh aadhaaraa tumeh jeea praanadaataa |1|
English: You are my Family, and You are my Support. You are the Giver of the Breath of Life. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮਹਿ ਖਜੀਨਾ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਜਰੀਨਾ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਮਾਣਿਕ ਲਾਲਾ ॥
Transliteration: tumeh khajeenaa tumeh jareenaa tum hee maanik laalaa |
English: You are my Treasure, and You are my Wealth. You are my Gems and Jewels.

Gurbani: ਤੁਮਹਿ ਪਾਰਜਾਤ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥੨॥੩੩॥੫੬॥
Transliteration: tumeh paarajaat gur te paae tau naanak bhe nihaalaa |2|33|56|
English: You are the wish-fulfilling Elysian Tree. Nanak has found You through the Guru, and now he is enraptured. ||2||33||56||

[Ang 1215 | Raag: Raag Saarang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 |
English: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਾਹੂ ਕਾਹੂ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਹੀ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jaahoo kaahoo apuno hee chit aavai |
English: Wherever he goes, his consciousness turns to his own.

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੋ ਚੇਰੋ ਹੋਵਤ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹੀ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jo kaahoo ko chero hovat tthaakur hee peh jaavai |1| rahaau |
English: Whoever is a chaylaa (a servant) goes only to his Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਅਪਨੇ ਪਹਿ ਦੂਖ ਅਪਨੇ ਪਹਿ ਸੂਖਾ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਹੀ ਪਹਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ ॥
Transliteration: apane peh dookh apane peh sookhaa apune hee peh birathaa |
English: He shares his sorrows, his joys and his condition only with his own.

Gurbani: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪਹਿ ਤਾਨਾ ਅਪਨੇ ਹੀ ਪਹਿ ਅਰਥਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: apune peh maan apune peh taanaa apane hee peh arathaa |1|
English: He obtains honor from his own, and strength from his own; he gets an advantage from his own. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਰਾਜ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਧਨ ਮਿਲਖਾ ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਬਾਪ ਮਹਤਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kin hee raaj joban dhan milakhaa kin hee baap mahataaree |
English: Some have regal power, youth, wealth and property; some have a father and a mother.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਥੋਕ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਏ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੨॥੩੪॥੫੭॥
Transliteration: sarab thok naanak gur paae pooran aas hamaaree |2|34|57|
English: I have obtained all things, O Nanak, from the Guru. My hopes have been fulfilled. ||2||34||57||

[Ang 1215 | Raag: Raag Saarang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 |
English: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਝੂਠੋ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੋ ਮਦ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
Transliteration: jhoottho maaeaa ko mad maan |
English: False is intoxication and pride in Maya.

Gurbani: ਧ੍ਰੋਹ ਮੋਹ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਪੁਰੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਗੋਪਾਲਹਿ ਜਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: dhroh moh door kar bapure sang gopaaleh jaan |1| rahaau |
English: Get rid of your fraud and attachment, O wretched mortal, and remember that the Lord of the World is with you. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਰਾਜ ਜੋਬਨ ਅਰੁ ਉਮਰੇ ਮੀਰ ਮਲਕ ਅਰੁ ਖਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: mithiaa raaj joban ar umare meer malak ar khaan |
English: False are royal powers, youth, nobility, kings, rulers and aristocrats.

Gurbani: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਕਾਪਰ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਭੋਜਨ ਪਾਨ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mithiaa kaapar sugandh chaturaaee mithiaa bhojan paan |1|
English: False are the fine clothes, perfumes and clever tricks; false are the foods and drinks. ||1||

Gurbani: ਦੀਨ ਬੰਧਰੋ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਰੋ ਸੰਤਹ ਕੀ ਸਾਰਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: deen bandharo daas daasaro santah kee saaraan |
English: O Patron of the meek and the poor, I am the slave of Your slaves; I seek the Sanctuary of Your Saints.

Gurbani: ਮਾਂਗਨਿ ਮਾਂਗਉ ਹੋਇ ਅਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਿਲੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥੨॥੩੫॥੫੮॥
Transliteration: maangan maangau hoe achintaa mil naanak ke har praan |2|35|58|
English: I humbly ask, I beg of You, please relieve my anxiety; O Lord of Life, please unite Nanak with Yourself. ||2||35||58||

[Ang 1215 | Raag: Raag Saarang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 |
English: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਪੁਨੀ ਇਤਨੀ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: apunee itanee kachhoo na saaree |
English: By himself, the mortal cannot accomplish anything.

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਕਾਜ ਅਨਿਕ ਧਾਵਰਤਾ ਉਰਝਿਓ ਆਨ ਜੰਜਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: anik kaaj anik dhaavarataa urajhio aan janjaaree |1| rahaau |
English: He runs around chasing all sorts of projects, engrossed in other entanglements. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਦਿਉਸ ਚਾਰਿ ਕੇ ਦੀਸਹਿ ਸੰਗੀ ਊਹਾਂ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਹ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: diaus chaar ke deeseh sangee aoohaan naahee jeh bhaaree |
English: His companions of these few days will not be there when he is in trouble.

Gurbani: ਤਿਨ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਚਿ ਮਾਚਿ ਹਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਓ ਜੋ ਕਾਮਿ ਨਹੀ ਗਾਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: tin siau raach maach hit laaeo jo kaam nahee gaavaaree |1|
English: He is hand and glove with those who are of no use to him; the poor wretch is affectionately involved with them. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਨਾ ਹਮਰੋ ਬਸੁ ਚਾਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: hau naahee naahee kichh meraa naa hamaro bas chaaree |
English: I am nothing; nothing belongs to me. I have no power or control.

Gurbani: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਤਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਾਰੀ ॥੨॥੩੬॥੫੯॥
Transliteration: karan karaavan naanak ke prabh santan sang udhaaree |2|36|59|
English: O Creator, Cause of causes, Lord God of Nanak, I am saved and redeemed in the Society of the Saints. ||2||36||59||

[Ang 1216 | Raag: Raag Saarang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 |
English: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੋਹਨੀ ਮੋਹਤ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਹੋਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: mohanee mohat rahai na horee |
English: The Great Enticer Maya keeps enticing, and cannot be stopped.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਸਗਲ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਤੁਟੈ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਤੋਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saadhik sidh sagal kee piaaree tuttai na kaahoo toree |1| rahaau |
English: She is the Beloved of all the Siddhas and seekers; no one can fend her off. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਖਟੁ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਉਚਰਤ ਰਸਨਾਗਰ ਤੀਰਥ ਗਵਨ ਨ ਥੋਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: khatt saasatr ucharat rasanaagar teerath gavan na thoree |
English: Reciting the six Shaastras and visiting sacred shrines of pilgrimage do not decrease her power.

Gurbani: ਪੂਜਾ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਬਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਤਪੀਆ ਊਹਾ ਗੈਲਿ ਨ ਛੋਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: poojaa chakr barat nem tapeea aoohaa gail na chhoree |1|
English: Devotional worship, ceremonial religious marks, fasting, vows and penance - none of these will make her release her hold. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਹੋਤ ਜਗੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਮੋਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: andh koop meh patit hot jag santahu karahu param gat moree |
English: The world has fallen into the deep dark pit. O Saints, please bless me with the supreme status of salvation.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਭਇਓ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਤ ਭੋਰੀ ॥੨॥੩੭॥੬੦॥
Transliteration: saadhasangat naanak bheo mukataa darasan pekhat bhoree |2|37|60|
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak has been liberated, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of their Darshan, even for an instant. ||2||37||60||

[Ang 1216 | Raag: Raag Saarang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 |
English: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਹਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਰੇ ਖਾਟਿ ਖਾਟੁਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: kahaa kareh re khaatt khaattulee |
English: Why are you working so hard to earn profits?

Gurbani: ਪਵਨਿ ਅਫਾਰ ਤੋਰ ਚਾਮਰੋ ਅਤਿ ਜਜਰੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਰੇ ਮਾਟੁਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: pavan afaar tor chaamaro at jajaree teree re maattulee |1| rahaau |
English: You are puffed up like a bag of air, and your skin is very brittle. Your body has grown old and dusty. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਊਹੀ ਤੇ ਹਰਿਓ ਊਹਾ ਲੇ ਧਰਿਓ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਾਸਾ ਮਾਸ ਦੇਤ ਝਾਟੁਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: aoohee te hario aoohaa le dhario jaise baasaa maas det jhaattulee |
English: You move things from here to there, like the hawk swooping down on the flesh of its prey.

Gurbani: ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਓ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਜਿਉ ਸਫਰੀ ਉਦਰੁ ਭਰੈ ਬਹਿ ਹਾਟੁਲੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: devanahaar bisaario andhule jiau safaree udar bharai beh haattulee |1|
English: You are blind - you have forgotten the Great Giver. You fill your belly like a traveller at an inn. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਾਦ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਝੂਠ ਰਸ ਜਹ ਜਾਨੋ ਤਹ ਭੀਰ ਬਾਟੁਲੀ ॥
Transliteration: saad bikaar bikaar jhootth ras jeh jaano teh bheer baattulee |
English: You are entangled in the taste of false pleasures and corrupt sins; the path which you have to take is very narrow.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਮਝੁ ਰੇ ਇਆਨੇ ਆਜੁ ਕਾਲਿ ਖੁਲੑੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਗਾਂਠੁਲੀ ॥੨॥੩੮॥੬੧॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak samajh re eaane aaj kaal khulai teree gaantthulee |2|38|61|
English: Says Nanak: figure it out, you ignorant fool! Today or tomorrow, the knot will be untied! ||2||38||61||

[Ang 1216 | Raag: Raag Saarang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 |
English: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਜੀਉ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਨਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: gur jeeo sang tuhaarai jaanio |
English: O Dear Guru, by associating with You, I have come to know the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕੋਟਿ ਜੋਧ ਉਆ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਪੁਛੀਐ ਤਾਂ ਦਰਗਹ ਭੀ ਮਾਨਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kott jodh uaa kee baat na puchheeai taan daragah bhee maanio |1| rahaau |
English: There are millions of heroes, and no one pays any attention to them, but in the Court of the Lord, I am honored and respected. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਵਨ ਮੂਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਕਾ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਵਨ ਰੂਪੁ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਨਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: kavan mool praanee kaa kaheeai kavan roop drisattaanio |
English: What is the origin of the human beings? How beautiful they are!

Gurbani: ਜੋਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਭਈ ਮਾਟੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਦੁਲਭ ਦੇਹ ਬਖਾਨਿਓ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jot pragaas bhee maattee sang dulabh deh bakhaanio |1|
English: When God infuses His Light into clay, the human body is judged to be precious. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਸੇਵ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਜਪ ਤਾਪਾ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਤਤੁ ਪਛਾਨਿਓ ॥
Transliteration: tum te sev tum te jap taapaa tum te tat pachhaanio |
English: From You, I have learned to serve; from You, I have learned to chant and meditate; from You, I have realized the essence of reality.

Gurbani: ਕਰੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਰਿ ਕਟੀ ਜੇਵਰੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਨਿਓ ॥੨॥੩੯॥੬੨॥
Transliteration: kar masatak dhar kattee jevaree naanak daas dasaanio |2|39|62|
English: Placing His Hand on my forehead, He has cut away the bonds which held me; O Nanak, I am the slave of His slaves. ||2||39||62||

[Ang 1216 | Raag: Raag Saarang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 |
English: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਓ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਨਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: har har deeo sevak kau naam |
English: The Lord has blessed His servant with His Name.

Gurbani: ਮਾਨਸੁ ਕਾ ਕੋ ਬਪੁਰੋ ਭਾਈ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਰਾਖਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: maanas kaa ko bapuro bhaaee jaa ko raakhaa raam |1| rahaau |
English: What can any poor mortal do to someone who has the Lord as his Savior and Protector? ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਪਿ ਮਹਾ ਜਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਪੰਚਾ ਆਪਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੈ ਕਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: aap mahaa jan aape panchaa aap sevak kai kaam |
English: He Himself is the Great Being; He Himself is the Leader. He Himself accomplishes the tasks of His servant.

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਤ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aape sagale doot bidaare tthaakur antarajaam |1|
English: Our Lord and Master destroys all demons; He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||1||

Gurbani: ਆਪੇ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਆਪਿ ਕੀਓ ਬੰਧਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: aape pat raakhee sevak kee aap keeo bandhaan |
English: He Himself saves the honor of His servants; He Himself blesses them with stability.

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਰਾਖੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਨ ॥੨॥੪੦॥੬੩॥
Transliteration: aad jugaad sevak kee raakhai naanak ko prabh jaan |2|40|63|
English: From the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages, He saves His servants. O Nanak, how rare is the person who knows God. ||2||40||63||

[Ang 1216 | Raag: Raag Saarang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 |
English: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਤੂ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ਸਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: too mere meet sakhaa har praan |
English: O Lord, You are my Best Friend, my Companion, my Breath of Life.

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤੋ ਤੁਮਰੈ ਧਾਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: man dhan jeeo pindd sabh tumaraa ihu tan seeto tumarai dhaan |1| rahaau |
English: My mind, wealth, body and soul are all Yours; this body is sewn together by Your Blessing. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਦੀਏ ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰਾ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਦੀਏ ਮਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: tum hee dee anik prakaaraa tum hee dee maan |
English: You have blessed me with all sorts of gifts; you have blessed me with honor and respect.

Gurbani: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਾਨ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sadaa sadaa tum hee pat raakhahu antarajaamee jaan |1|
English: Forever and ever, You preserve my honor, O Inner-knower, O Searcher of hearts. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਿਨ ਸੰਤਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਤੂ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੇ ਆਏ ਪਰਵਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: jin santan jaaniaa too tthaakur te aae paravaan |
English: Those Saints who know You, O Lord and Master - blessed and approved is their coming into the world.

Gurbani: ਜਨ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ॥੨॥੪੧॥੬੪॥
Transliteration: jan kaa sang paaeeai vaddabhaagee naanak santan kai kurabaan |2|41|64|
English: The Congregation of those humble beings is obtained by great good fortune; Nanak is a sacrifice to the Saints. ||2||41||64||

[Ang 1217 | Raag: Raag Saarang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 |
English: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਕਰਹੁ ਗਤਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਮੋਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: karahu gat deaal santahu moree |
English: Save me, O Merciful Saint!

Gurbani: ਤੁਮ ਸਮਰਥ ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨਾ ਤੂਟੀ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜੋਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tum samarath kaaran karanaa toottee tum hee joree |1| rahaau |
English: You are the All-powerful Cause of causes. You have ended my separation, and joined me with God. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਬਿਖਈ ਤੁਮ ਤਾਰੇ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੈ ਪਾਈ ॥
Transliteration: janam janam ke bikhee tum taare sumat sang tumaarai paaee |
English: You save us from the corruption and sins of countless incarnations; associating with You, we obtain sublime understanding.

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: anik jon bhramate prabh bisarat saas saas har gaaee |1|
English: Forgetting God, we wandered through countless incarnations; with each and every breath, we sing the Lord's Praises. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਤੇ ਤੇ ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo jo sang mile saadhoo kai te te patit puneetaa |
English: Whoever meets with the Holy Saints - those sinners are sanctified.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਵਡਭਾਗਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜੀਤਾ ॥੨॥੪੨॥੬੫॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak jaa ke vaddabhaagaa tin janam padaarath jeetaa |2|42|65|
English: Says Nanak, those who have such high destiny, win this invaluable human life. ||2||42||65||

[Ang 1217 | Raag: Raag Saarang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 |
English: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਬਿਨਤੀ ਕਰਨ ਜਨੁ ਆਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: tthaakur binatee karan jan aaeo |
English: O my Lord and Master, Your humble servant has come to offer this prayer.

Gurbani: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਸਹਜ ਰਸ ਸੁਨਤ ਤੁਹਾਰੋ ਨਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sarab sookh aanand sehaj ras sunat tuhaaro naaeo |1| rahaau |
English: Hearing Your Name, I am blessed with total peace, bliss, poise and pleasure. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸੂਖ ਕੇ ਸਾਗਰ ਜਸੁ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਛਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: kripaa nidhaan sookh ke saagar jas sabh meh jaa ko chhaaeo |
English: The Treasure of Mercy, the Ocean of Peace - His Praises are diffused everywhere.

Gurbani: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਰੰਗ ਤੁਮ ਕੀਏ ਅਪਨਾ ਆਪੁ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: santasang rang tum kee apanaa aap drisattaaeo |1|
English: O Lord, You celebrate in the Society of the Saints; You reveal Yourself to them. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨੈਨਹੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਰਨ ਝਾਰੀ ਕੇਸਾਇਓ ॥
Transliteration: nainahu sang santan kee sevaa charan jhaaree kesaaeo |
English: With my eyes I see the Saints, and dedicate myself to serving them; I wash their feet with my hair.

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੨॥੪੩॥੬੬॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar darasan santan kaa sukh naanak ihu paaeo |2|43|66|
English: Twenty-four hours a day, I gaze upon the Blessed Vision, the Darshan of the Saints; this is the peace and comfort which Nanak has received. ||2||43||66||

[Ang 1217 | Raag: Raag Saarang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 |
English: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kee raam naam liv laagee |
English: One who is lovingly absorbed in the Lord's Name

Gurbani: ਸਜਨੁ ਸੁਰਿਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sajan suridaa suhelaa sahaje so kaheeai baddabhaagee |1| rahaau |
English: is a good-hearted friend, intuitively embellished with happiness. He is said to be blessed and fortunate. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਰਹਿਤ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਅਲਪ ਮਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: rahit bikaar alap maaeaa te ahanbudh bikh tiaagee |
English: He is rid of sin and corruption, and detached from Maya; he has renounced the poison of egotistical intellect.

Gurbani: ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸ ਆਸ ਏਕਹਿ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਹੀਐਂ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪਾਗੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: daras piaas aas ekeh kee ttek heeain pria paagee |1|
English: He thirsts for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, and he places his hopes in the One Lord alone. The Feet of his Beloved are the Support of his heart. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਚਿੰਤ ਸੋਇ ਜਾਗਨੁ ਉਠਿ ਬੈਸਨੁ ਅਚਿੰਤ ਹਸਤ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: achint soe jaagan utth baisan achint hasat bairaagee |
English: He sleeps, wakes, rises up and sits down without anxiety; he laughs and cries without anxiety.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਠਗਾਨਾ ਸੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਠਾਗੀ ॥੨॥੪੪॥੬੭॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak jin jagat tthagaanaa su maaeaa har jan tthaagee |2|44|67|
English: Says Nanak, she who has cheated the world - that Maya is cheated by the humble servant of the Lord. ||2||44||67||

[Ang 1217 | Raag: Raag Saarang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 |
English: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਅਬ ਜਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਕੋ ਨ ਪੁਕਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: ab jan aoopar ko na pukaarai |
English: Now, no one complains about the Lord's humble servant.

Gurbani: ਪੂਕਾਰਨ ਕਉ ਜੋ ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: pookaaran kau jo udam karataa gur paramesar taa kau maarai |1| rahaau |
English: Whoever tries to complain is destroyed by the Guru, the Transcendent Lord God. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਵੈਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਵੈਰੁ ਰਚਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਓਹੁ ਹਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: niravairai sang vair rachaavai har daragah ohu haarai |
English: Whoever harbors vengeance against the One who is beyond all vengenace, shall lose in the Court of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aad jugaad prabh kee vaddiaaee jan kee paij savaarai |1|
English: From the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages, it is the glorious greatness of God, that He preserves the honor of His humble servants. ||1||

Gurbani: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਸਗਲ ਭਉ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਆਧਾਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: nirbhau bhe sagal bhau mittiaa charan kamal aadhaarai |
English: The mortal becomes fearless, and all his fears are taken away, when he leans on the Support of the Lord's Lotus Feet.

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਨਾਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਇਓ ਸੰਸਾਰੈ ॥੨॥੪੫॥੬੮॥
Transliteration: gur kai bachan japio naau naanak pragatt bheo sansaarai |2|45|68|
English: Chanting the Name, through the Guru's Word, Nanak has become famous throughout the world. ||2||45||68||

[Ang 1217 | Raag: Raag Saarang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 |
English: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਸਗਲਾ ਆਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: har jan chhoddiaa sagalaa aap |
English: The Lord's humble servant has discarded all self-conceit.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਰਖਹੁ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਪੇਖਿ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jiau jaanahu tiau rakhahu gusaaee pekh jeevaan parataap |1| rahaau |
English: As You see fit, You save us, O Lord of the World. Beholding Your Glorious Grandeur, I live. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ॥
Transliteration: gur upades saadh kee sangat binasio sagal santaap |
English: Through the Guru's Instruction, and the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, all sorrow and suffering is taken away.

Gurbani: ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰ ਪੇਖਿ ਸਮਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਭਾਖਨ ਜਾਪੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: mitr satr pekh samat beechaario sagal sanbhaakhan jaap |1|
English: I look upon friend and enemy alike; all that I speak is the Lord's meditation. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤਪਤਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਸੀਤਲ ਆਘਾਨੇ ਸੁਨਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਬਿਸਮ ਭਏ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥
Transliteration: tapat bujhee seetal aaghaane sun anahad bisam bhe bisamaad |
English: The fire within me is quenched; I am cool, calm and tranquil. Hearing the unstruck celestial melody, I am wonder-struck and amazed.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰੇ ਨਾਦ ॥੨॥੪੬॥੬੯॥
Transliteration: anad bheaa naanak man saachaa pooran poore naad |2|46|69|
English: I am in ecstasy, O Nanak, and my mind is filled with Truth, through the perfect perfection of the Sound-current of the Naad. ||2||46||69||

[Ang 1219 | Raag: Raag Saarang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 |
English: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਠਾਂਢੀ ॥
Transliteration: har ke naam kee gat tthaandtee |
English: The Name of the Lord is cooling and soothing.

Gurbani: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਕਾਢੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bed puraan simrit saadhoo jan khojat khojat kaadtee |1| rahaau |
English: Searching, searching the Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees, the Holy Saints have realized this. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਿਵ ਬਿਰੰਚ ਅਰੁ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਲੋਕ ਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਜਲਤੌ ਫਿਰਿਆ ॥
Transliteration: siv biranch ar indr lok taa meh jalatau firiaa |
English: In the worlds of Shiva, Brahma and Indra, I wandered around, burning up with envy.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਭਏ ਸੀਤਲ ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਹਿਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: simar simar suaamee bhe seetal dookh darad bhram hiriaa |1|
English: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on my Lord and Master, I became cool and calm; my pains, sorrows and doubts are gone. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਤਰਿਓ ਪੁਰਾਤਨੁ ਨਵਤਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
Transliteration: jo jo tario puraatan navatan bhagat bhaae har devaa |
English: Whoever has been saved in the past or the present, was saved through loving devotional worship of the Divine Lord.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਾ ॥੨॥੫੨॥੭੫॥
Transliteration: naanak kee benantee prabh jeeo milai sant jan sevaa |2|52|75|
English: This is Nanak's prayer: O Dear God, please let me serve the humble Saints. ||2||52||75||

[Ang 1219 | Raag: Raag Saarang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 |
English: Saarang, Fifth Mehl;

Gurbani: ਜਿਹਵੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਗੁਣ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jihave amrit gun har gaau |
English: O my tongue, sing the Ambrosial Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਉਚਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: har har bol kathaa sun har kee ucharahu prabh ko naau |1| rahaau |
English: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, listen to the Lord's Sermon, and chant God's Name. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਭਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: raam naam ratan dhan sanchahu man tan laavahu bhaau |
English: So gather in the jewel, the wealth of the Lord's Name; love God with your mind and body.

Gurbani: ਆਨ ਬਿਭੂਤ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਹੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਇਹੈ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aan bibhoot mithiaa kar maanahu saachaa ihai suaau |1|
English: You must realize that all other wealth is false; this alone is the true purpose of life. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕਸ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jeea praan mukat ko daataa ekas siau liv laau |
English: He is the Giver of the soul, the breath of life and liberation; lovingly tune in to the One and Only Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਦੇਤ ਸਗਲ ਅਪਿਆਉ ॥੨॥੫੩॥੭੬॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak taa kee saranaaee det sagal apiaau |2|53|76|
English: Says Nanak, I have entered His Sanctuary; He gives sustenance to all. ||2||53||76||

[Ang 1219 | Raag: Raag Saarang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 |
English: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹੋਤੀ ਨਹੀ ਕਵਨ ਕਛੁ ਕਰਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: hotee nahee kavan kachh karanee |
English: I cannot do anything else.

Gurbani: ਇਹੈ ਓਟ ਪਾਈ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤਹ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਏਕ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: eihai ott paaee mil santah gopaal ek kee saranee |1| rahaau |
English: I have taken this Support, meeting the Saints; I have entered the Sanctuary of the One Lord of the World. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪੰਚ ਦੋਖ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਇਆ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਕੀ ਕਰਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: panch dokh chhidr eaa tan meh bikhai biaadh kee karanee |
English: The five wicked enemies are within this body; they lead the mortal to practice evil and corruption.

Gurbani: ਆਸ ਅਪਾਰ ਦਿਨਸ ਗਣਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਗ੍ਰਸਤ ਜਾਤ ਬਲੁ ਜਰਣੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aas apaar dinas gan raakhe grasat jaat bal jaranee |1|
English: He has infinite hope, but his days are numbered, and old age is sapping his strength. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਨਾਥਹ ਨਾਥ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਸਰਬ ਦੋਖ ਭੈ ਹਰਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: anaathah naath deaal sukh saagar sarab dokh bhai haranee |
English: He is the Help of the helpless, the Merciful Lord, the Ocean of Peace, the Destroyer of all pains and fears.

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਪੇਖਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਰਣੀ ॥੨॥੫੪॥੭੭॥
Transliteration: man baanchhat chitavat naanak daas pekh jeevaa prabh charanee |2|54|77|
English: Slave Nanak longs for this blessing, that he may live, gazing upon the Feet of God. ||2||54||77||

[Ang 1219 | Raag: Raag Saarang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 |
English: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਫੀਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਦ ॥
Transliteration: feeke har ke naam bin saad |
English: Without the Lord's Name, flavors are tasteless and insipid.

Gurbani: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਈਐ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਨਾਦ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: amrit ras keeratan har gaaeeai ahinis pooran naad |1| rahaau |
English: Sing the Sweet Ambrosial Praises of the Lord's Kirtan; day and night, the Sound-current of the Naad will resonate and resound. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਿਟਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਖਾਦ ॥
Transliteration: simarat saant mahaa sukh paaeeai mitt jaeh sagal bikhaad |
English: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, total peace and bliss are obtained, and all sorrows are taken away.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਭੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਘਰਿ ਲੈ ਆਵਹੁ ਲਾਦਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har har laabh saadhasang paaeeai ghar lai aavahu laad |1|
English: The profit of the Lord, Har, Har, is found in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; so load it and bring it on home. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਊਚ ਤੇ ਊਚੋ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਰਜਾਦ ॥
Transliteration: sabh te aooch aooch te aoocho ant nahee marajaad |
English: He is the Highest of all, the Highest of the high; His celestial ecomony has no limit.

Gurbani: ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਪੇਖਿ ਰਹੇ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥੨॥੫੫॥੭੮॥
Transliteration: baran na saakau naanak mahimaa pekh rahe bisamaad |2|55|78|
English: Nanak cannot even express His Glorious Grandeur; gazing upon Him, he is wonder-struck. ||2||55||78||

[Ang 1219 | Raag: Raag Saarang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 |
English: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਇਓ ਸੁਨਨ ਪੜਨ ਕਉ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: aaeo sunan parran kau baanee |
English: The mortal came to hear and chant the Word of the Guru's Bani.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਲਗਹਿ ਅਨ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਰਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: naam visaar lageh an laalach birathaa janam paraanee |1| rahaau |
English: But he has forgotten the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and he has become attached to other temptations. His life is totally worthless! ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਮਝੁ ਅਚੇਤ ਚੇਤਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਥੀ ਸੰਤਨ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: samajh achet chet man mere kathee santan akath kahaanee |
English: O my unconscious mind, become conscious and figure it out; the Saints speak the Unspoken Speech of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਲਾਭੁ ਲੈਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਅਰਾਧਹੁ ਛੁਟਕੈ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: laabh laihu har ridai araadhahu chhuttakai aavan jaanee |1|
English: So gather in your profits - worship and adore the Lord within your heart; your coming and going in reincarnation shall end. ||1||

Gurbani: ਉਦਮੁ ਸਕਤਿ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਦੇਹਿ ਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: audam sakat siaanap tumaree dehi ta naam vakhaanee |
English: Efforts, powers and clever tricks are Yours; if You bless me with them, I repeat Your Name.

Gurbani: ਸੇਈ ਭਗਤ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੇ ਲਾਗੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣੀ ॥੨॥੫੬॥੭੯॥
Transliteration: seee bhagat bhagat se laage naanak jo prabh bhaanee |2|56|79|
English: They alone are devotees, and they alone are attached to devotional worship, O Nanak, who are pleasing to God. ||2||56||79||

[Ang 1219 | Raag: Raag Saarang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 |
English: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਧਨਵੰਤ ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: dhanavant naam ke vanajaare |
English: Those who deal in the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are wealthy.

Gurbani: ਸਾਂਝੀ ਕਰਹੁ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਖਾਟਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saanjhee karahu naam dhan khaattahu gur kaa sabad veechaare |1| rahaau |
English: So become a partner with them, and earn the wealth of the Naam. Contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਛੋਡਹੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਰਵੈਰਾ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਹਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: chhoddahu kapatt hoe niravairaa so prabh sang nihaare |
English: Abandon your deception, and go beyond vengeance; see God who is always with you.

Gurbani: ਸਚੁ ਧਨੁ ਵਣਜਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਆਵਹੁ ਹਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sach dhan vanajahu sach dhan sanchahu kabahoo na aavahu haare |1|
English: Deal only in this true wealth and gather in this true wealth, and you shall never suffer loss. ||1||

Gurbani: ਖਾਤ ਖਰਚਤ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਿਖੁਟਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਗਨਤ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰੇ ॥
Transliteration: khaat kharachat kichh nikhuttat naahee aganat bhare bhanddaare |
English: Eating and consuming it, it is never exhausted; God's treasures are overflowing.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਭਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਾਵਹੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੈ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੨॥੫੭॥੮੦॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak sobhaa sang jaavahu paarabraham kai duaare |2|57|80|
English: Says Nanak, you shall go home to the Court of the Supreme Lord God with honor and respect. ||2||57||80||

[Ang 1220 | Raag: Raag Saarang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 |
English: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਵਨੁ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: prabh jee mohi kavan anaath bichaaraa |
English: O Dear God, I am wretched and helpless!

Gurbani: ਕਵਨ ਮੂਲ ਤੇ ਮਾਨੁਖੁ ਕਰਿਆ ਇਹੁ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਤੁਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kavan mool te maanukh kariaa ihu parataap tuhaaraa |1| rahaau |
English: From what source did you create humans? This is Your Glorious Grandeur. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਸਰਬ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਕਹੇ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeea praan sarab ke daate gun kahe na jaeh apaaraa |
English: You are the Giver of the soul and the breath of life to all; Your Infinite Glories cannot be spoken.

Gurbani: ਸਭ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕ ਸਰਬ ਘਟਾਂ ਆਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: sabh ke preetam srab pratipaalak sarab ghattaan aadhaaraa |1|
English: You are the Beloved Lord of all, the Cherisher of all, the Support of all hearts. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਆਪਹਿ ਏਕ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: koe na jaanai tumaree gat mit aapeh ek pasaaraa |
English: No one knows Your state and extent. You alone created the expanse of the Universe.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧ ਨਾਵ ਬੈਠਾਵਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ॥੨॥੫੮॥੮੧॥
Transliteration: saadh naav baitthaavahu naanak bhav saagar paar utaaraa |2|58|81|
English: Please, give me a seat in the boat of the Holy; O Nanak, thus I shall cross over this terrifying world-ocean, and reach the other shore. ||2||58||81||

[Ang 1220 | Raag: Raag Saarang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 |
English: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਵੈ ਰਾਮ ਸਰਣਿ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
Transliteration: aavai raam saran vaddabhaagee |
English: One who comes to the Lord's Sanctuary is very fortunate.

Gurbani: ਏਕਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਅਵਰਿ ਉਪਾਵ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: ekas bin kichh hor na jaanai avar upaav tiaagee |1| rahaau |
English: He knows of no other than the One Lord. He has renounced all other efforts. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਆਰਾਧੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: man bach kram aaraadhai har har saadhasang sukh paaeaa |
English: He worships and adores the Lord, Har, Har, in thought, word and deed; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he finds peace.

Gurbani: ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਰਸੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: anad binod akath kathaa ras saachai sehaj samaaeaa |1|
English: He enjoys bliss and pleasure, and savors the Unspoken Speech of the Lord; he merges intuitively into the True Lord. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜੋ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕੀਨੋ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਊਤਮ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa jo apunaa keeno taa kee aootam baanee |
English: Sublime and exalted is the speech of one whom the Lord, in His Mercy makes His Own.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਸਤਰੀਐ ਜੋ ਰਾਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੨॥੫੯॥੮੨॥
Transliteration: saadhasang naanak nisatareeai jo raate prabh nirabaanee |2|59|82|
English: Those who are imbued with God in the state of Nirvaanaa, O Nanak, are emancipated in the Saadh Sangat. ||2||59||82||

[Ang 1220 | Raag: Raag Saarang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 |
English: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਣਿ ਗਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jaa te saadhoo saran gahee |
English: Since I grasped hold of the Sanctuary of the Holy,

Gurbani: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਰਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: saant sehaj man bheo pragaasaa birathaa kachh na rahee |1| rahaau |
English: my mind is illuminated with tranquility, peace and poise, and I am rid of all my pain. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਬਿਨਤੀ ਏਹ ਕਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: hohu kripaal naam dehu apunaa binatee eeh kahee |
English: Please be merciful to me, O Lord, and bless me with Your Name; this is the prayer I offer to You.

Gurbani: ਆਨ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਬਿਸਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪਾਇਓ ਲਾਭੁ ਸਹੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aan biauhaar bisare prabh simarat paaeo laabh sahee |1|
English: I have forgotten my other occupations; remembering God in meditation, I have obtained the true profit. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਹ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਤਹੀ ਸਮਾਨੋ ਸਾਈ ਬਸਤੁ ਅਹੀ ॥
Transliteration: jeh te upajio tahee samaano saaee basat ahee |
English: We shall merge again into the One from whom we came; He is the Essence of Being.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਰਮੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਇਓ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਹੀ ॥੨॥੬੦॥੮੩॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak bharam gur khoeo jotee jot samahee |2|60|83|
English: Says Nanak, the Guru has eradicated my doubt; my light has merged into the Light. ||2||60||83||

[Ang 1220 | Raag: Raag Saarang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 |
English: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: rasanaa raam ko jas gaau |
English: O my tongue, sing the Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਆਨ ਸੁਆਦ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਭਲੋ ਨਾਮ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aan suaad bisaar sagale bhalo naam suaau |1| rahaau |
English: Abandon all other tastes and flavors; the taste of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is so sublime. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਬਸਾਇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਏਕ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: charan kamal basaae hiradai ek siau liv laau |
English: Enshrine the Lord's Lotus Feet within your heart; let yourself be lovingly attuned to the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਆਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: saadhasangat hohi niramal bahurr jon na aau |1|
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall become immaculate and pure; you shall not come to be reincarnated again. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਥਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jeeo praan adhaar teraa too nithaave thaau |
English: You are the Support of the soul and the breath of life; You are the Home of the homeless.

Gurbani: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੨॥੬੧॥੮੪॥
Transliteration: saas saas samaal har har naanak sad bal jaau |2|61|84|
English: With each and every breath, I dwell on the Lord, Har, Har; O Nanak, I am forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||61||84||

[Ang 1220 | Raag: Raag Saarang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 |
English: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਚਰਨ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਉ ॥
Transliteration: baikuntth gobind charan nit dhiaau |
English: To meditate on the Lotus Feet of the Lord of the Universe is heaven for me.

Gurbani: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: mukat padaarath saadhoo sangat amrit har kaa naau |1| rahaau |
English: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is the treasure of liberation and the Lord's Ambrosial Name. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਊਤਮ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣੀਜੈ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਮਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: aootam kathaa suneejai sravanee meaa karahu bhagavaan |
English: O Lord God, please be kind to me, that I may hear with my ears Your Sublime and Exalted Sermon.

Gurbani: ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਦੋਊ ਪਖ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਸੁਖ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: aavat jaat doaoo pakh pooran paaeeai sukh bisraam |1|
English: My cycle of coming and going is finally completed, and I have attained peace and tranquility. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੋਧਤ ਸੋਧਤ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਰੇਸਟ ਪੂਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: sodhat sodhat tat beechaario bhagat saresatt pooree |
English: Searching and searching, I have realized the essence of reality: devotional worship is the most sublime fulfillment.

Gurbani: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਧਿ ਊਰੀ ॥੨॥੬੨॥੮੫॥
Transliteration: kahu naanak ik raam naam bin avar sagal bidh aooree |2|62|85|
English: Says Nanak, without the Name of the One Lord, all other ways are imperfect. ||2||62||85||

[Ang 1221 | Raag: Raag Saarang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 |
English: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ॥
Transliteration: saache satiguroo daataaraa |
English: The True Guru is the True Giver.

Gurbani: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਗਲ ਦੁਖ ਨਾਸਹਿ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: darasan dekh sagal dukh naaseh charan kamal balihaaraa |1| rahaau |
English: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, all my pains are dispelled. I am a sacrifice to His Lotus Feet. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਤਿ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਸਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sat paramesar sat saadh jan nihachal har kaa naau |
English: The Supreme Lord God is True, and True are the Holy Saints; the Name of the Lord is steady and stable.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bhagat bhaavanee paarabraham kee abinaasee gun gaau |1|
English: So worship the Imperishable, Supreme Lord God with love, and sing His Glorious Praises. ||1||

Gurbani: ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਮਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: agam agochar mit nahee paaeeai sagal ghattaa aadhaar |
English: The limits of the Inaccessible, Unfathomable Lord cannot be found; He is the Support of all hearts.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਹੁ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੨॥੬੩॥੮੬॥
Transliteration: naanak vaahu vaahu kahu taa kau jaa kaa ant na paar |2|63|86|
English: O Nanak, chant, "Waaho! Waaho!" to Him, who has no end or limitation. ||2||63||86||

[Ang 1221 | Raag: Raag Saarang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 |
English: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਬਸੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੈ ॥
Transliteration: gur ke charan base man merai |
English: The Feet of the Guru abide within my mind.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਬਸੈ ਸਭ ਨੇਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: poor rahio tthaakur sabh thaaee nikatt basai sabh nerai |1| rahaau |
English: My Lord and Master is permeating and pervading all places; He dwells nearby, close to all. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
Transliteration: bandhan tor raam liv laaee santasang ban aaee |
English: Breaking my bonds, I have lovingly tuned in to the Lord, and now the Saints are pleased with me.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਭਇਓ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ਇਛਾ ਸਗਲ ਪੁਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: janam padaarath bheo puneetaa ichhaa sagal pujaaee |1|
English: This precious human life has been sanctified, and all my desires have been fulfilled. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kau kripaa karahu prabh mere so har kaa jas gaavai |
English: O my God, whoever You bless with Your Mercy - he alone sings Your Glorious Praises.

Gurbani: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੬੪॥੮੭॥
Transliteration: aatth pehar gobind gun gaavai jan naanak sad bal jaavai |2|64|87|
English: Servant Nanak is a sacrifice to that person who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, twenty-four hours a day. ||2||64||87||

[Ang 1221 | Raag: Raag Saarang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 |
English: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਨੁ ਤਉ ਗਨੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਪੇਖਾ ॥
Transliteration: jeevan tau ganeeai har pekhaa |
English: A person is judged to be alive, only if he sees the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮਨਮੋਹਨ ਫੋਰਿ ਭਰਮ ਕੀ ਰੇਖਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: karahu kripaa preetam manamohan for bharam kee rekhaa |1| rahaau |
English: Please be merciful to me, O my Enticing Beloved Lord, and erase the record of my doubts. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਕਹਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਉਪਜਤ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਿਸਾਸ ਕਿਆ ਸੇਖਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: kehat sunat kichh saant na upajat bin bisaas kiaa sekhaan |
English: By speaking and listening, tranquility and peace are not found at all. What can anyone learn without faith?

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਆਨ ਜੋ ਚਾਹਤ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਕਾਲੇਖਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: prabhoo tiaag aan jo chaahat taa kai mukh laagai kaalekhaa |1|
English: One who renounces God and longs for another - his face is blackened with filth. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਾਸਿ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਨ ਨ ਮਾਨਤ ਭੇਖਾ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai raas sarab sukh suaamee aan na maanat bhekhaa |
English: One who is blessed with the wealth of our Lord and Master, the Embodiment of Peace, does not believe in any other religious doctrine.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸ ਮਗਨ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਰਥ ਬਿਸੇਖਾ ॥੨॥੬੫॥੮੮॥
Transliteration: naanak daras magan man mohio pooran arath bisekhaa |2|65|88|
English: O Nanak, one whose mind is fascinated and intoxicated with the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan - his tasks are perfectly accomplished. ||2||65||88||

[Ang 1221 | Raag: Raag Saarang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 |
English: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਨ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮ ॥
Transliteration: simaran raam ko ik naam |
English: Meditate in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of the One Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਲਮਲ ਦਗਧ ਹੋਹਿ ਖਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਦਾਨ ਇਸਨਾਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: kalamal dagadh hohi khin antar kott daan isanaan |1| rahaau |
English: In this way, the sins of your past mistakes shall be burnt off in an instant. It is like giving millions in charity, and bathing at sacred shrines of pilgrimage. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਆਨ ਜੰਜਾਰ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਘਾਲਤ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਫੋਕਟ ਗਿਆਨ ॥
Transliteration: aan janjaar brithaa sram ghaalat bin har fokatt giaan |
English: Entangled in other affairs, the mortal suffers uselessly in sorrow. Without the Lord, wisdom is useless.

Gurbani: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਸੰਕਟ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੈ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਭਜਨ ਸੁਖ ਧਿਆਨ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: janam maran sankatt te chhoottai jagadees bhajan sukh dhiaan |1|
English: The mortal is freed of the anguish of death and birth, meditating and vibrating on the Blissful Lord of the Universe. ||1||

Gurbani: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦਾਨ ॥
Transliteration: teree saran pooran sukh saagar kar kirapaa devahu daan |
English: I seek Your Sancutary, O Perfect Lord, Ocean of Peace. Please be merciful, and bless me with this gift.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਵੈ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ॥੨॥੬੬॥੮੯॥
Transliteration: simar simar naanak prabh jeevai binas jaae abhimaan |2|66|89|
English: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on God, Nanak lives; his egotistical pride has been eradicated. ||2||66||89||

[Ang 1221 | Raag: Raag Saarang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 |
English: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਧੂਰਤੁ ਸੋਈ ਜਿ ਧੁਰ ਕਉ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Transliteration: dhoorat soee ji dhur kau laagai |
English: He alone is a Dhoorat, who is attached to the Primal Lord God.

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਧੁਰੰਧਰੁ ਸੋਈ ਬਸੁੰਧਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਏਕ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਪਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: soee dhurandhar soee basundhar har ek prem ras paagai |1| rahaau |
English: He alone is a Dhurandhar, and he alone is a Basundhar, who is absorbed in the sublime essence of Love of the One Lord. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਲਬੰਚ ਕਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਲਾਭੈ ਸੋ ਧੂਰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਮੂੜੑਾ ॥
Transliteration: balabanch karai na jaanai laabhai so dhoorat nahee moorraa |
English: One who practices deception and does not know where true profit lies is not a Dhoorat - he is a fool.

Gurbani: ਸੁਆਰਥੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਅਸਾਰਥਿ ਰਚਿਓ ਨਹ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰੂੜਾ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: suaarath tiaag asaarath rachio neh simarai prabh roorraa |1|
English: He abandons profitable enterprises and is involved in unprofitable ones. He does not meditate on the Beauteous Lord God. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸੋਈ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਸੋ ਸੂਰਾ ਸੋ ਦਾਨਾਂ ॥
Transliteration: soee chatur siaanaa panddit so sooraa so daanaan |
English: He alone is clever and wise and a religious scholar, he alone is a brave warrior, and he alone is intelligent,

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ॥੨॥੬੭॥੯੦॥
Transliteration: saadhasang jin har har japio naanak so paravaanaa |2|67|90|
English: who chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. O Nanak, he alone is approved. ||2||67||90||

[Ang 1222 | Raag: Raag Saarang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 |
English: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਜੀਵਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: har har sant janaa kee jeevan |
English: The Lord, Har, Har, is the life of the humble Saints.

Gurbani: ਬਿਖੈ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਨਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: bikhai ras bhog amrit sukh saagar raam naam ras peevan |1| rahaau |
English: Instead of enjoying corrupt pleasures, they drink in the Ambrosial Essence of the Name of the Lord, the Ocean of Peace. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸੰਚਨਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਰਤਨਾ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸੀਵਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: sanchan raam naam dhan ratanaa man tan bheetar seevan |
English: They gather up the priceless wealth of the Lord's Name, and weave it into the fabric of their mind and body.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਰਾਂਗ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਲਾਲਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਸ ਖੀਵਨਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har rang raang bhe man laalaa raam naam ras kheevan |1|
English: Imbued with the Lord's Love, their minds are dyed in the deep crimson color of devotional love; they are intoxicated with the sublime essence of the Lord's Name. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਮੀਨਾ ਜਲ ਸਿਉ ਉਰਝਾਨੋ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਲੀਵਨਿ ॥
Transliteration: jiau meenaa jal siau urajhaano raam naam sang leevan |
English: As the fish is immersed in water, they are absorbed in the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਬੂੰਦ ਪਾਨ ਸੁਖ ਥੀਵਨਿ ॥੨॥੬੮॥੯੧॥
Transliteration: naanak sant chaatrik kee niaaee har boond paan sukh theevan |2|68|91|
English: O Nanak, the Saints are like the rainbirds; they are comforted, drinking in the drops of the Lord's Name. ||2||68||91||

[Ang 1222 | Raag: Raag Saarang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 |
English: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮਹੀਨ ਬੇਤਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: har ke naamaheen betaal |
English: Without the Name of the Lord, the mortal is a ghost.

Gurbani: ਜੇਤਾ ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਤੇਤਾ ਸਭਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: jetaa karan karaavan tetaa sabh bandhan janjaal |1| rahaau |
English: All the actions he commits are just shackles and bonds. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਤ ਅਨ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕਾਟੈ ਕਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: bin prabh sev karat an sevaa birathaa kaattai kaal |
English: Without serving God, one who serves another wastes his time uselessly.

Gurbani: ਜਬ ਜਮੁ ਆਇ ਸੰਘਾਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਤਬ ਤੁਮਰੋ ਕਉਨੁ ਹਵਾਲ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jab jam aae sanghaarai praanee tab tumaro kaun havaal |1|
English: When the Messenger of Death comes to kill you, O mortal, what will your condition be then? ||1||

Gurbani: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਦਾਸ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥
Transliteration: raakh lehu daas apune kau sadaa sadaa kirapaal |
English: Please protect Your slave, O Eternally Merciful Lord.

Gurbani: ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਧਨ ਮਾਲ ॥੨॥੬੯॥੯੨॥
Transliteration: sukh nidhaan naanak prabh meraa saadhasang dhan maal |2|69|92|
English: O Nanak, my God is the Treasure of Peace; He is the wealth and property of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||69||92||

[Ang 1222 | Raag: Raag Saarang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 |
English: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: man tan raam ko biauhaar |
English: My mind and body deal only in the Lord.

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਨ ਗੀਧੇ ਪੋਹਤ ਨਹ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: prem bhagat gun gaavan geedhe pohat neh sansaar |1| rahaau |
English: Imbued with loving devotional worship, I sing His Glorious Praises; I am not affected by worldly affairs. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਇਹੁ ਸਾਧ ਕੋ ਆਚਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: sravanee keeratan simaran suaamee ihu saadh ko aachaar |
English: This is the way of life of the Holy Saint: he listens to the Kirtan, the Praises of his Lord and Master, and meditates in remembrance on Him.

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਅਸਥਿਤਿ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਕੋ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: charan kamal asathit rid antar poojaa praan ko aadhaar |1|
English: He implants the Lord's Lotus Feet deep within his heart; worship of the Lord is the support of his breath of life. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪਨੀ ਧਾਰੁ ॥
Transliteration: prabh deen deaal sunahu benantee kirapaa apanee dhaar |
English: O God, Merciful to the meek, please hear my prayer, and shower Your Blessings upon me.

Gurbani: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਉਚਰਉ ਨਿਤ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥੭੦॥੯੩॥
Transliteration: naam nidhaan uchrau nit rasanaa naanak sad balihaar |2|70|93|
English: I continually chant the treasure of the Naam with my tongue; Nanak is forever a sacrifice. ||2||70||93||

[Ang 1222 | Raag: Raag Saarang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 |
English: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮਹੀਨ ਮਤਿ ਥੋਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: har ke naamaheen mat thoree |
English: Without the Name of the Lord, his intellect is shallow.

Gurbani: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਹਿ ਸਿਰੀਧਰ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮਿਲਤ ਅੰਧ ਦੁਖ ਘੋਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: simarat naeh sireedhar tthaakur milat andh dukh ghoree |1| rahaau |
English: He does not meditate in remembrance on the Lord, his Lord and Master; the blind fool suffers in terrible agony. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੀ ਅਨਿਕ ਭੇਖ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: har ke naam siau preet na laagee anik bhekh bahu joree |
English: He does not embrace love for the Name of the Lord; he is totally attached to various religious robes.

Gurbani: ਤੂਟਤ ਬਾਰ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਜਿਉ ਗਾਗਰਿ ਜਲ ਫੋਰੀ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: toottat baar na laagai taa kau jiau gaagar jal foree |1|
English: His attachments are shattered in an instant; when the pitcher is broken, the water runs out. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਸੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਮਨੁ ਖਚਿਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਖੋਰੀ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa bhagat ras deejai man khachit prem ras khoree |
English: Please bless me, that I may worship You in loving devotion. My mind is absorbed and intoxicated with Your Delicious Love.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨੁ ਆਨ ਨ ਹੋਰੀ ॥੨॥੭੧॥੯੪॥
Transliteration: naanak daas teree saranaaee prabh bin aan na horee |2|71|94|
English: Nanak, Your slave, has entered Your Sanctuary; without God, there is no other at all. ||2||71||94||

[Ang 1222 | Raag: Raag Saarang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 |
English: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਚਿਤਵਉ ਵਾ ਅਉਸਰ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: chitvau vaa aausar man maeh |
English: In my mind, I think about that moment,

Gurbani: ਹੋਇ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਸਾਜਨ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: hoe ikatr milahu sant saajan gun gobind nit gaeh |1| rahaau |
English: when I join the Gathering of the Friendly Saints, constantly singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨ ਜੇਤੇ ਕਾਮ ਕਰੀਅਹਿ ਤੇਤੇ ਬਿਰਥੇ ਜਾਂਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: bin har bhajan jete kaam kareeeh tete birathe jaanhi |
English: Without vibrating and meditating on the Lord, whatever deeds you do will be useless.

Gurbani: ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ ਮਨਿ ਮੀਠੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਸਰ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: pooran paramaanand man meettho tis bin doosar naeh |1|
English: The Perfect Embodiment of Supreme Bliss is so sweet to my mind. Without Him, there is no other at all. ||1||

Gurbani: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਕਰਮ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਧਨ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਕਛੂਐ ਲਾਹਿ ॥
Transliteration: jap tap sanjam karam sukh saadhan tul na kachhooai laeh |
English: Chanting, deep meditation, austere self-discipline, good deeds and other techniques to being peace - they are not equal to even a tiny bit of the Lord's Name.

Gurbani: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਓ ਚਰਨਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੨॥੭੨॥੯੫॥
Transliteration: charan kamal naanak man bedhio charanah sang samaeh |2|72|95|
English: Nanak's mind is pierced through by the Lotus Feet of the Lord; it is absorbed in His Lotus Feet. ||2||72||95||

[Ang 1222 | Raag: Raag Saarang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 |
English: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੰਗੇ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
Transliteration: meraa prabh sange antarajaamee |
English: My God is always with me; He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

Gurbani: ਆਗੈ ਕੁਸਲ ਪਾਛੈ ਖੇਮ ਸੂਖਾ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aagai kusal paachhai khem sookhaa simarat naam suaamee |1| rahaau |
English: I find happiness in the world hereafter, and peace and pleasure in this world, meditating in remembrance on the Name of my Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਸਾਜਨ ਮੀਤ ਸਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਗੁਨ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
Transliteration: saajan meet sakhaa har merai gun guopaal har raaeaa |
English: The Lord is my Best Friend, my Buddy, my Companion. I sing the Glorious Praises of my Sovereign Lord King.

Gurbani: ਬਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਨਿਮਖ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਤੇ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: bisar na jaaee nimakh hiradai te poorai guroo milaaeaa |1|
English: I shall not forget Him in my heart, even for an instant; I have met with the Perfect Guru. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਾਖੇ ਦਾਸ ਅਪਨੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਵਸਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ॥
Transliteration: kar kirapaa raakhe daas apane jeea jant vas jaa kai |
English: In His Mercy, He protects His slave; all beings and creatures are in His Power.

Gurbani: ਏਕਾ ਲਿਵ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਭਉ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥੨॥੭੩॥੯੬॥
Transliteration: ekaa liv pooran paramesur bhau nahee naanak taa kai |2|73|96|
English: One who is lovingly attuned to the One, the Perfect Transcendent Lord God, O Nanak, is rid of all fear. ||2||73||96||

[Ang 1223 | Raag: Raag Saarang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 |
English: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਬਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jaa kai raam ko bal hoe |
English: One who has the Lord's Power on his side

Gurbani: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰਨ ਤਾਹੂ ਕੇ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: sagal manorath pooran taahoo ke dookh na biaapai koe |1| rahaau |
English: - all his desires are fulfilled, and no pain afflicts him. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਨਿਜੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: jo jan bhagat daas nij prabh kaa sun jeevaan tis soe |
English: That humble devotee is a slave of his God, who listens to Him, and so lives.

Gurbani: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਉ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਨ ਕੌ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: audam krau darasan pekhan kau karam paraapat hoe |1|
English: I have made the effort to gaze upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; it is obtained only by good karma. ||1||

Gurbani: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨਿਹਾਰਉ ਦੂਸਰ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
Transliteration: gur parasaadee drisatt nihaarau doosar naahee koe |
English: It is only by Guru's Grace that I see His Vision with my eyes which none can equal.

Gurbani: ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਉ ਚਰਨ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਸੰਤ ਧੋਇ ॥੨॥੭੪॥੯੭॥
Transliteration: daan dehi naanak apane kau charan jeevaan sant dhoe |2|74|97|
English: Please bless Nanak with this Gift, that he may wash the Feet of the Saints, and so live. ||2||74||97||

[Ang 1223 | Raag: Raag Saarang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 |
English: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਜੀਵਤੁ ਰਾਮ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: jeevat raam ke gun gaae |
English: I live by singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

Gurbani: ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਬੀਠੁਲੇ ਬਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: karahu kripaa gopaal beetthule bisar na kab hee jaae |1| rahaau |
English: Please be Merciful to me, O my Loving Lord of the Universe, that I may never forget You. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਨ ਨ ਦੂਜੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: man tan dhan sabh tumaraa suaamee aan na doojee jaae |
English: My mind, body, wealth and all are Yours, O my Lord and Master; there is nowhere else for me at all.

Gurbani: ਜਿਉ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਵ ਹੀ ਰਹਣਾ ਤੁਮੑਰਾ ਪੈਨੈੑ ਖਾਇ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: jiau too raakheh tiv hee rahanaa tumaraa painai khaae |1|
English: As You keep me, so do I survive; I eat and I wear whatever You give me. ||1||

Gurbani: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਜਨਮਾ ਧਾਇ ॥
Transliteration: saadhasangat kai bal bal jaaee bahurr na janamaa dhaae |
English: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; I shall never again fall into reincarnation.

Gurbani: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਇ ॥੨॥੭੫॥੯੮॥
Transliteration: naanak daas teree saranaaee jiau bhaavai tivai chalaae |2|75|98|
English: Slave Nanak seeks Your Sancuary, Lord; as it pleases Your Will, so do You guide him. ||2||75||98||

[Ang 1223 | Raag: Raag Saarang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 |
English: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੋ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: man re naam ko sukh saar |
English: O my mind, the Naam is the most sublime peace.

Gurbani: ਆਨ ਕਾਮ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਗਲ ਦੀਸਹਿ ਛਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aan kaam bikaar maaeaa sagal deeseh chhaar |1| rahaau |
English: Other affairs of Maya are corrupt. They are nothing more than dust. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਪਤਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਨਰਕ ਘੋਰ ਗੁਬਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: grihi andh koop patit praanee narak ghor gubaar |
English: The mortal has fallen into the deep dark pit of household attachment; it is a horrible, dark hell.

Gurbani: ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨੀ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਹਾਰਿਓ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਬਾਰੰ ਬਾਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: anik jonee bhramat haario bhramat baaran baar |1|
English: He wanders in various incarnations, growing weary; he wanders through them again and again. ||1||

Gurbani: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਛਲ ਦੀਨ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: patit paavan bhagat bachhal deen kirapaa dhaar |
English: O Purifier of sinners, O Lover of Your devotees, please shower Your Mercy on Your meek servant.

Gurbani: ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਾਰ ॥੨॥੭੬॥੯੯॥
Transliteration: kar jorr naanak daan maangai saadhasang udhaar |2|76|99|
English: With palms pressed together, Nanak begs for this blessing: O Lord, please save me in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||76||99||

[Ang 1223 | Raag: Raag Saarang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 |
English: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਬਿਰਾਜਿਤ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥
Transliteration: biraajit raam ko parataap |
English: The Glorious Radiance of the Lord has spread out everywhere.

Gurbani: ਆਧਿ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਸਭ ਨਾਸੀ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਤੀਨੈ ਤਾਪ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: aadh biaadh upaadh sabh naasee binase teenai taap |1| rahaau |
English: The doubts of my mind and body are all erased, and I am rid of the three diseases. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੁਝੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭ ਆਸਾ ਚੂਕੇ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥
Transliteration: trisanaa bujhee pooran sabh aasaa chooke sog santaap |
English: My thirst is quenched, and my hopes have all been fulfilled; my sorrows and sufferings are over.

Gurbani: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ ਅਚੁਤ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਆਤਮ ਧ੍ਰਾਪ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: gun gaavat achut abinaasee man tan aatam dhraap |1|
English: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Unmoving, Eternal, Unchanging Lord God, my mind, body and soul are comforted and encouraged. ||1||

Gurbani: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮਦ ਮਤਸਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਖਾਪ ॥
Transliteration: kaam krodh lobh mad matasar saadhoo kai sang khaap |
English: Sexual desire, anger, greed, pride and envy are destroyed in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

Gurbani: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਭੈ ਕਾਟਨਹਾਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਮਾਈ ਬਾਪ ॥੨॥੭੭॥੧੦੦॥
Transliteration: bhagat vachhal bhai kaattanahaare naanak ke maaee baap |2|77|100|
English: He is the Lover of His devotees, the Destroyer of fear; O Nanak, He is our Mother and Father. ||2||77||100||

[Ang 1223 | Raag: Raag Saarang | Author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji]
Gurbani: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
Transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 |
English: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

Gurbani: ਆਤੁਰੁ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: aatur naam bin sansaar |
English: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the world is miserable.

Gurbani: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਤ ਕੂਕਰੀ ਆਸਾ ਇਤੁ ਲਾਗੋ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਛਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Transliteration: tripat na hovat kookaree aasaa it laago bikhiaa chhaar |1| rahaau |
English: Like a dog, its desires are never satisfied; it clings to the ashes of corruption. ||1||Pause||

Gurbani: ਪਾਇ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਓ ਜਨਮਤ ਬਾਰੋ ਬਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: paae tthgauree aap bhulaaeo janamat baaro baar |
English: Administering the intoxicating drug, God Himself leads the mortals astray; they are reincarnated again and again.

Gurbani: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਸਿਮਰਿਓ ਜਮਕੰਕਰ ਕਰਤ ਖੁਆਰ ॥੧॥
Transliteration: har kaa simaran nimakh na simario jamakankar karat khuaar |1|
English: He does not meditate in remembrance on the Lord, even for an instant, and so the Messenger of Death makes him suffer. ||1||

Gurbani: ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਤੇਰਿਆ ਸੰਤਹ ਕੀ ਰਾਵਾਰ ॥
Transliteration: hohu kripaal deen dukh bhanjan teriaa santah kee raavaar |
English: Please be merciful to me, O Destroyer of the pains of the meek and the poor; let me be the dust of the feet of the Saints.
